lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~
lines.transliteration: ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad.

lines.english: Chant And Meditate:
lines.transliteration: jap.

lines.english: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.
lines.transliteration: aad sach jugaad  sach.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bh ee sach. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਿਚ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds ofthousands of times.
lines.transliteration: sochai soch na hova-ee jay sochee lakh vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜੇ ਲਾਇ  ਰਹਾ ਿਲਵ  ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.english: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbeddeep within.
lines.transliteration: chupai chup na hova-ee jay laa-ay rahaa liv taar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਿਖਆ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ  ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ  ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.
lines.transliteration: bhukh i-aa bh ukh na ut ree jay bannaa puree-aa bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਿਸਆਣਪਾ  ਲਖ ਹੋਿਹ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along withyou in the end.
lines.transliteration: sahas si-aanpaa lakh  hohi t a ik na chalai naal.

lines.english: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of illusion be torn away?
lines.transliteration: kiv sachi-aaraa ho-ee-ai kiv koorhai tutai paal.

lines.english: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hukam rajaa-ee chalnaa naanak likh i-aa naal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਿਨ ਆਕਾਰ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਹਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: hukmee hovan aakaar hukam na kahi-aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness areobtained.
lines.transliteration: hukmee hovan jee-a hukam milai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ  ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਿਲਿਖ  ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.
lines.transliteration: hukmee utam neech hukam likh  dukh sukh  paa-ee-ah.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ  ਇਿਕ  ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wanderaimlessly forever.
lines.transliteration: iknaa hukmee bakhsees ik hukmee sad aa bh avaa-ee-ah.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.
lines.transliteration: hukmai andar sabh  ko baahar hukam na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak hukmai jay bujhai t a ha-umai kahai na ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko taan  hovai kisai t aan.

lines.english: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko daat  jaanai neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵੈ  ਕੋ ਗੁ ਣ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਚਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko gun vad i-aa-ee-aa chaar.

lines.english: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko vidi-aa vikh am veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵੈ  ਕੋ ਸਾਿਜ  ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.english: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko saaj karay tan kh ayh.

lines.english: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko jee-a lai fir dayh.

lines.english: Some sing that He seems so very far away. pMnw 2
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko jaapai disai d oor.

lines.english: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko vaykhai haad raa had oor.

lines.english: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.
lines.transliteration: kathnaa kathee na aavai tot.

lines.english: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.
lines.transliteration: kath kath kathee kotee kot kot.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਥ ਕਿਥ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਿਟ ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.
lines.transliteration: daydaa day laid ay thak paahi.

lines.english: Throughout the ages, consumers consume.
lines.transliteration: jugaa jugantar kh aahee kh aahi.

lines.english: The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.
lines.transliteration: hukmee hukam chalaa-ay raahu.

lines.english: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak vigsai vayparvaahu. ||3||

lines.english: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib saach naa-ay bhaakh i-aa bh aa-o apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ  ਭਾਿਖਆ  ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: People beg and pray, "Give to us, give to us", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi mangahi d ayhi d ayhi d aat karay d aataar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਿਹ  ਮੰਗਿਹ ਦੇਿਹ ਦੇਿਹ ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of HisCourt?
lines.transliteration: fayr ke agai rakhee-ai jit  disai darbaar.

lines.english: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?
lines.transliteration: muhou ke bolan bolee-ai jit  sun Dharay pi-aar.

lines.english: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, andcontemplate His Glorious Greatness.
lines.transliteration: amrit vaylaa sach naa-o vadi-aa-ee veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਵੇਲਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.
lines.transliteration: karmee aavai kaprhaa nad ree mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਕਪੜਾ  ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak ayvai jaanee-ai sabh  aapay sachiaar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਚਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.
lines.transliteration: thaapi-aa na jaa-ay keetaa na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਿਪਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap niranjan so-ay.

lines.english: Those who serve Him are honored.
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa tin paa-i-aa maan.

lines.english: O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.
lines.transliteration: naanak gaavee-ai gunee niDh aan.

lines.english: Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.
lines.transliteration: gaavee-ai sunee-ai man rakh ee-ai bh aa-o.

lines.english: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.
lines.transliteration: dukh parhar sukh  ghar lai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਘਿਰ  ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom ofthe Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naad aN gurmukh  vayd aN gurmukh  rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਦੰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.
lines.transliteration: gur eesar gur gorakh barmaa gur paarbat ee maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ  ਬਰਮਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ  ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.
lines.transliteration: jay ha-o jaanaa aakh aa naahee kahn aa kathan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ  ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has given me this one understanding:
lines.transliteration: guraa ik dayhi bujh aa-ee.
sabhnaa jee-aa kaa ik d aataa so mai visar na jaa-ee. ||5|| there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੋ ਮੈ ਿਵਸਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?
lines.transliteration: tirath naavaa jay t is bhaavaa vin  bhaanay ke naa-ay karee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਵਾ  ਜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ  ਿਵਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਿਕ ਨਾਇ  ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.english: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are theygiven to receive?
lines.transliteration: jaytee sirath  upaa-ee vaykh aa vin  karmaa ke milai la-ee.

lines.english: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings,even once.
lines.transliteration: mat vich rat an javaahar maan ik jay ik gur kee sikh  sunee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਿਵਿਚ  ਰਤਨ  ਜਵਾਹਰ  ਮਾਿਣਕ  ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਿਸਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has given me this one understanding:
lines.transliteration: guraa ik dayhi bujh aa-ee.
sabhnaa jee-aa kaa ik d aataa so mai visar na jaa-ee. ||6|| there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੋ ਮੈ ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,
lines.transliteration: jay jug chaaray aarjaa hor dasoon ee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ  ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: navaa khanda vich jaan ee-ai naal chalai sabh  ko-ay. and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,

lines.punjabi: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: changa naa-o rakhaa-ay kai jas keerat  jag lay-ay. with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਗਾ  ਨਾਉ  ਰਖਾਇ  ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਜਿਗ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jay tis nad ar na aavee t a vaat  na puchh ai kay. still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinnerswould hold you in contempt.
lines.transliteration: keetaa andar keet kar d osee d os Dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਟਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕੀਟੁ ਕਿਰ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.
lines.transliteration: naanak nirgun gun  karay gun vanti-aa gun  day.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਨਰਗੁਿਣ  ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਿਤਆ  ਗੁ ਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
lines.english: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tayhaa ko-ay na sujh -ee je t is gun  ko-ay karay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਿਜ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai siDh  peer sur naath.

lines.english: Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai Dh arat Dhaval aakaas.

lines.english: Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai d eep lo-a paat aal.

lines.english: Listening-Death cannot even touch you.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai pohi na sakai kaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt aa sad aa vigaas.

lines.english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||
lines.transliteration: suni-ai d ookh paap kaa naas. ||8||

lines.english: Listening-Shiva, Brahma and Indra.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai eesar barmaa ind .

lines.english: Listening-even foul-mouthed people praise Him.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai mukh  saalaahan  mand .

lines.english: Listening-the technology of Yoga and the secrets of the body.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai jog jugat  tan bh ayd.

lines.english: Listening-the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai saasat  simrit  vayd .

lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss. pMnw 3
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt aa sad aa vigaas.

lines.english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||
lines.transliteration: suni-ai d ookh paap kaa naas. ||9||

lines.english: Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai sat  santokh gi-aan.

lines.english: Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai ath sath kaa isnaan.

lines.english: Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai parh  parh paavahi maan.

lines.english: Listening-intuitively grasp the essence of meditation.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai laagai sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt aa sad aa vigaas.

lines.english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||10||
lines.transliteration: suni-ai d ookh paap kaa naas. ||10||

lines.english: Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai saraa gun aa kay gaah.

lines.english: Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai saykh  peer paat isaah.

lines.english: Listening-even the blind find the Path.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai anDh ay paavahi raahu.

lines.english: Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.
lines.transliteration: suni-ai haath hovai asgaahu.

lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt aa sad aa vigaas.

lines.english: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||
lines.transliteration: suni-ai d ookh paap kaa naas. ||11||

lines.english: The state of the faithful cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: mannay kee gat kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.
lines.transliteration: jay ko kahai pichhai pachh utaa-ay.

lines.english: No paper, no pen, no scribe
lines.transliteration: kaagad kalam na likh anhaar.
mannay kaa bahi karan veechaar. can record the state of the faithful.

lines.english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.

lines.english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||
lines.transliteration: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.
lines.transliteration: mannai surat hovai man buDh .

lines.english: The faithful know about all worlds and realms.
lines.transliteration: mannai sagal bhavan  kee suDh .

lines.english: The faithful shall never be struck across the face.
lines.transliteration: mannai muhi chotaa naa khaa-ay.

lines.english: The faithful do not have to go with the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: mannai jam kai saath na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਨੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.

lines.english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.
lines.transliteration: mannai maarag thaak na paa-ay.

lines.english: The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.
lines.transliteration: mannai pat si-o pargat jaa-ay.

lines.english: The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.
lines.transliteration: mannai mag na chalai panth.

lines.english: The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.
lines.transliteration: mannai Dharam sayt ee san-banDh .

lines.english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.

lines.english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The faithful find the Door of Liberation.
lines.transliteration: mannai paavahi mokh d u-aar.

lines.english: The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.
lines.transliteration: mannai parvaarai saaDhaar.

lines.english: The faithful are saved, and carried across with the Sikhs of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: mannai tarai t aaray gur sikh .

lines.english: The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.
lines.transliteration: mannai naanak bhavahi na bh ikh.

lines.english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan ho-ay.

lines.english: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||
lines.transliteration: jay ko man jaanai man ko-ay. ||15||

lines.english: The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.
lines.transliteration: panch parvaan panch parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮਿਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: panchay paavahi dargahi maan.

lines.english: The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.
lines.transliteration: panchay sohahi dar raajaan.

lines.english: The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.
lines.transliteration: panchaa kaa gur ayk Dhi-aan.

lines.english: No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,
lines.transliteration: jay ko kahai karai veechaar.
kartay kai karn ai naahee sumaar. the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.

lines.english: Dhoul Dh aram d a-i-aa kaa poot . The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;

lines.transliteration: santokh  thaap rakh i-aa jin soot . this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.

lines.english: One who understands this becomes truthful.
lines.transliteration: jay ko bujhai hovai sachiaar.

lines.english: Dhavlai upar kayt aa bh aar. What a great load there is on the bull!
Dhart ee hor parai hor hor. So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!
What power holds them, and supports their weight?
lines.transliteration: tis tay bh aar talai kavan  jor.

lines.english: The names and the colors of the assorted species of beings
lines.transliteration: jee-a jaat rangaa kay naav.
sabhnaa likh i-aa vurh ee kalaam. were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.

lines.english: Who knows how to write this account?
lines.transliteration: ayhu laykhaa likh  jaanai ko-ay.

lines.english: Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!
lines.transliteration: laykhaa likh i-aa kayt aa ho-ay.

lines.english: What power! What fascinating beauty!
lines.transliteration: kaytaa t aan su-aalihu roop.

lines.english: And what gifts! Who can know their extent?
lines.transliteration: kaytee d aat jaanai koun  koot.

lines.english: You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!
lines.transliteration: keetaa pasaa-o ayko kavaa-o.

lines.english: Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.
lines.transliteration: tis tay ho-ay lakh  daree-aa-o.

lines.english: How can Your Creative Potency be described?
lines.transliteration: kudrat  kavan  kahaa veechaar.

lines.english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.

lines.english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai saa-ee bh alee kaar.

lines.english: You, Eternal and Formless One! ||16||
lines.transliteration: too sad aa salaamat  nirankaar. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ  ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Countless meditations, countless loves.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh jap asaNkh bhaa-o.

lines.english: Countless worship services, countless austere disciplines.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh poojaa asaNkh tap taa-o.

lines.english: Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh garanth mukh  vayd  paath .

lines.english: Countless Yogis, whose minds remain detached from the world. pMnw 4
lines.transliteration: asaNkh jog man rahahi ud aas.

lines.english: Countless devotees contemplate the Wisdom and Virtues of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh bh agat gun gi-aan veechaar.

lines.english: Countless the holy, countless the givers.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh sat ee asaNkh daataar.

lines.english: Countless heroic spiritual warriors, who bear the brunt of the attack in battle (who with their mouths eat steel).
lines.transliteration: asaNkh soor muh bh akh saar.

lines.english: Countless silent sages, vibrating the String of His Love.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh mon liv laa-ay t aar.

lines.english: How can Your Creative Potency be described?
lines.transliteration: kudrat  kavan  kahaa veechaar.

lines.english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.

lines.english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai saa-ee bh alee kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ  ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||17||
lines.transliteration: too sad aa salaamat  nirankaar. ||17||

lines.english: Countless fools, blinded by ignorance.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh moorakh  anDh  ghor.

lines.english: Countless thieves and embezzlers.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh chor haraamkh or.

lines.english: Countless impose their will by force.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh amar kar jaahi jor.

lines.english: Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh galvadh  hati-aa kamaahi.

lines.english: Countless sinners who keep on sinning.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh paapee paap kar jaahi.

lines.english: Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh koorh i-aar koorh ay firaahi.

lines.english: Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh malaychh  mal bh akh khaahi.

lines.english: Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh nind ak sir karahi bh aar.

lines.english: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
lines.transliteration: naanak neech kahai veechaar.

lines.english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.

lines.english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai saa-ee bh alee kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ  ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||
lines.transliteration: too sad aa salaamat  nirankaar. ||18||

lines.english: Countless names, countless places.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh naav asaNkh thaav.

lines.english: Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.
lines.transliteration: agamm agamm asaNkh lo-a.

lines.english: Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh kehahi sir bh aar ho-ay.

lines.english: From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.
lines.transliteration: akhree naam akh ree saalaah.

lines.english: From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.
lines.transliteration: akhree gi-aan geet  gun gaah.

lines.english: From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.
lines.transliteration: akhree likh an bolan  baan .

lines.english: From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.
lines.transliteration: akhraa sir sanjog vakh aan.

lines.english: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.
lines.transliteration: jin ayhi likhay t is sir naahi.

lines.english: As He ordains, so do we receive.
lines.transliteration: jiv furmaa-ay tiv t iv paahi.

lines.english: The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa keet aa taytaa naa-o.

lines.english: Without Your Name, there is no place at all.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai naahee ko thaa-o.

lines.english: How can I describe Your Creative Power?
lines.transliteration: kudrat  kavan  kahaa veechaar.

lines.english: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: vaari-aa na jaavaa ayk vaar.

lines.english: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai saa-ee bh alee kaar.

lines.english: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||
lines.transliteration: too sad aa salaamat  nirankaar. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ  ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,
lines.transliteration: bharee-ai hath pair t an dayh.
paanee Dh otai utras kh ayh. water can wash away the dirt.

lines.english: When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,
lines.transliteration: moot paleet ee kaparh  ho-ay.
day saaboon  la-ee-ai oh Dh o-ay. soap can wash them clean.

lines.english: But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,
lines.transliteration: bharee-ai mat  paapaa kai sang.
oh Dhopai naavai kai rang. it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.

lines.english: Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;
lines.transliteration: punnee paapee aakhan  naahi.
kar kar karnaa likh  lai jaahu. actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.

lines.english: You shall harvest what you plant.
lines.transliteration: aapay beej aapay hee khaahu.

lines.english: O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||
lines.transliteration: naanak hukmee aavhu jaahu. ||20||

lines.english: Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity
lines.transliteration: tirath t ap da-i-aa d at daan.
jay ko paavai til kaa maan. -these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.

lines.english: Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,
lines.transliteration: suni-aa mani-aa man keet aa bh aa-o.
antargat  tirath mal naa-o. cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.

lines.english: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh gun  tayray mai naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: vin gun  keetay bh agat na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.
lines.transliteration: su-asat aath ban ee barmaa-o.

lines.english: He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.
lines.transliteration: sat suhaan  sadaa man chaa-o.

lines.english: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?
lines.transliteration: kavan so vaylaa vakh at kavan  kavan  thit kavan  vaar.

lines.english: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?
lines.transliteration: kavan se rut ee maahu kavan  jit ho-aa aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਵਖਤੁ  ਕਵਣੁ  ਕਵਣ  ਿਥਿਤ  ਕਵਣੁ  ਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in thePuraanas.
lines.transliteration: vayl na paa-ee-aa pandtee je hovai laykh  puraan .

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਿਣ  ਿਸ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.
lines.transliteration: vakhat  na paa-i-o kaad ee-aa je likh an laykh  kuraan .

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ਪੰਡਤੀ  ਿਜ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.
lines.transliteration: thit vaar naa jogee jaan ai rut maahu naa ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਖਤੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਕਾਦੀਆ  ਿਜ ਿਲਖਿਨ  ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.
lines.transliteration: jaa kartaa sirth ee ka-o saajay aapay jaan ai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਿਤ  ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਰੁਿਤ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him? pMnw 5
lines.transliteration: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee ki-o varnee kiv jaan aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhan  sabh  ko aakh ai ik d oo ik si-aan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਖਿਣ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ  ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਿਸਆਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.
lines.transliteration: vadaa saahib vadee naa-ee keetaa jaa kaa hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||
lines.transliteration: naanak jay ko aapou jaanai agai ga-i-aa na sohai. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ  ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands ofheavenly worlds above.
lines.transliteration: paataalaa paat aal lakh  aagaasaa aagaas.

lines.english: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.
lines.transliteration: orhak orh ak bh aal thakay vayd  kahan ik vaat .

lines.punjabi: ਓੜਕ  ਓੜਕ  ਭਾਿਲ  ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਿਨ  ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥
lines.english: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only OneUniverse.
lines.transliteration: sahas athaarah kahan kat aybaa asuloo ik Dh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਅਠਾਰਹ  ਕਹਿਨ  ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ  ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.english: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finishwriting it.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa ho-ay t a likee-ai laykh ai ho-ay vin aas.

lines.english: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||
lines.transliteration: naanak vadaa aakhee-ai aapay jaan ai aap. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਪੁ  ॥
lines.english: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding
lines.transliteration: saalaahee saalaahi aytee surat  na paa-ee-aa.
nadee-aa at ai vaah pavahi samund  na jaan ee-ahi. -the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth
lines.transliteration: samund saah sult aan girhaa sayt ee maal Dh an.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦੀਆ  ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਿਹ  ਸਮੁੰਿਦ  ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: keerhee t ul na hovnee jay t is manhu na veesrahi. ||23|| -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਸਮੁੰਦ  ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ  ਿਗਰਹਾ  ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ  ਧਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.
lines.transliteration: ant na sift ee kahan  na ant .

lines.punjabi: ਕੀੜੀ  ਤੁਿਲ  ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ  ਜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਿਹ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.
lines.transliteration: ant na karn ai dayn na ant .

lines.english: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.
lines.transliteration: ant na vaykh an sunan na ant .

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ  ਦੇਿਣ  ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?
lines.transliteration: ant na jaapai ki-aa man mant .

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਿਣ  ਸੁਣਿਣ  ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.
lines.transliteration: ant na jaapai keet aa aakaar.

lines.english: Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.
lines.transliteration: ant na jaapai paaraavaar.

lines.english: Many struggle to know His limits,
lines.transliteration: ant kaaran  kaytay billaahi.
taa kay ant  na paa-ay jaahi. but His limits cannot be found.

lines.english: No one can know these limits.
lines.transliteration: ayhu ant na jaan ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.
lines.transliteration: bahutaa kahee-ai bahut aa ho-ay.

lines.english: Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.
lines.transliteration: vadaa saahib oochaa thaa-o.

lines.english: Highest of the High, above all is His Name.
lines.transliteration: oochay upar oochaa naa-o.

lines.english: Only one as Great and as High as God
lines.transliteration: ayvad oochaa hovai ko-ay.
tis oochay ka-o jaan ai so-ay. can know His Lofty and Exalted State.

lines.english: Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.
lines.transliteration: jayvad aap jaanai aap aap.

lines.english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree karmee d aat. ||24||

lines.english: His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.
lines.transliteration: bahutaa karam likh i-aa naa jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Great Giver does not hold back anything.
lines.transliteration: vadaa daat aa til na t amaa-ay.

lines.english: There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaytay mangahi joDh  apaar.

lines.english: So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.
lines.transliteration: kayti-aa gan at nahee veechaar.

lines.english: So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.
lines.transliteration: kaytay kh ap tutahi vaykaar.

lines.english: So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.
lines.transliteration: kaytay lai lai mukar paahi.

lines.english: So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.
lines.transliteration: kaytay moorakh  khaahee kh aahi.

lines.english: So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.
lines.transliteration: kayti-aa d ookh bhookh sad maar.

lines.english: Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!
lines.transliteration: ayhi bhe d aat tayree d aataar.

lines.english: Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.
lines.transliteration: band kh alaasee bh aanai ho-ay.

lines.english: No one else has any say in this.
lines.transliteration: hor aakh na sakai ko-ay.

lines.english: If some fool should presume to say that he does,
lines.transliteration: jay ko khaa-ik aakh an paa-ay.
oh jaanai jayt ee-aa muhi kh aa-ay. he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.

lines.english: He Himself knows, He Himself gives.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai aapay d ay-ay.

lines.english: Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi se bh e kay-ee kay-ay.

lines.english: One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: jis no bakhsay sifat  saalaah.

lines.english: O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||
lines.transliteration: naanak paatisaahee paat isaahu. ||25||

lines.english: Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.
lines.transliteration: amul gun amul vaapaar.

lines.english: Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.
lines.transliteration: amul vaapaaree-ay amul bhandaar.

lines.english: Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.
lines.transliteration: amul aavahi amul lai jaahi.

lines.english: Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.
lines.transliteration: amul bhaa-ay amulaa samaahi.

lines.english: Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.
lines.transliteration: amul Dharam amul d eebaan .

lines.english: Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.
lines.transliteration: amul tul amul parvaan .

lines.english: Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.
lines.transliteration: amul bakhsees amul neesaan .

lines.english: Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.
lines.transliteration: amul karam amul furmaan.

lines.english: Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!
lines.transliteration: amulo amul aakhi-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.
lines.transliteration: aakh aakh  rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi vayd  paath  puraan .

lines.english: The scholars speak and lecture.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi parh ay karahi vakh i-aan.

lines.english: Brahma speaks, Indra speaks. pMnw 6
lines.transliteration: aakhahi barmay aakh ahi ind .

lines.english: The Gopis and Krishna speak.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi gopee t ai govind .

lines.english: Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi eesar aakh ahi siDh .

lines.english: The many created Buddhas speak.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi kayt ay keet ay buDh .

lines.english: The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi d aanav aakh ahi dayv.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਿਹ  ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.english: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi sur nar mun jan sayv.

lines.english: Many speak and try to describe Him.
lines.transliteration: kaytay aakh ahi aakh an paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਿਹ ਕਿਹ ਉਿਠ ਉਿਠ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.
lines.transliteration: kaytay kahi kahi uth  uth jaahi.

lines.english: If He were to create as many again as there already are,
lines.transliteration: aytay keet ay hor karayhi.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਆਿਖ  ਨ ਸਕਿਹ  ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa aakh  na sakahi kay-ee kay-ay. even then, they could not describe Him.

lines.english: He is as Great as He wishes to be.
lines.transliteration: jayvad bhaavai t ayvad ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord knows.
lines.transliteration: naanak jaanai saachaa so-ay.

lines.english: If anyone presumes to describe God,
lines.transliteration: jay ko aakhai boluvigaarh .
taa likee-ai sir gaavaaraa gaavaar. ||26|| he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਿਜਤੁ ਬਿਹ ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?
lines.transliteration: so dar kayhaa so gh ar kayhaa jit  bahi sarab samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਅਸੰਖਾ  ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.
lines.transliteration: vaajay naad anayk asankh aa kayt ay vaavan haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਿਸਉ ਕਹੀਅਿਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.
lines.transliteration: kaytay raag paree si-o kahee-an kayt ay gaavan haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਤੁਹਨੋ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at YourDoor.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi tuhno pa-un  paan ee baisant ar gaavai raajaa Dh aram d u-aaray.

lines.english: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions,and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi chit gupat  likh jaaneh likh  likh Dharam veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ  ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi eesar barmaa dayvee sohan sad aa savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਿਣ  ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਿਤਆ  ਦਿਰ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi ind id aasan  baith ay dayviti-aa d ar naalay.

lines.english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi siDh samaaDh ee and ar gaavan saaDh  vichaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavan jatee sat ee sant okhee gaavahi veer karaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੜਿਨ  ਰਖੀਸਰ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavan pandit parh an rakh eesar jug jug vayd aa naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਸੁਰਗਾ  ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, inparadise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi mohnee-aa man mohan surgaa machh  pa-i-aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਰਤਨ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavan ratan upaa-ay t ayray ath sath tirath naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ  ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਖਾਣੀ  ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources ofcreation sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi joDh mahaabal sooraa gaavahi kh aanee chaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ  ਵਰਭੰਡਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi khand mandal varbh andaa kar kar rakh ay Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਨ  ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਰਸਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with theNectar of Your Essence.
lines.transliteration: say-ee tuDh uno gaavahi jo t uDh bhaavan rat ay tayray bh agat rasaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਸੇ ਮੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਿਨ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਕਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?
lines.transliteration: hor kaytay gaavan say mai chit  na aavan naanak ki-aa veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: so-ee so-ee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਜਾਸੀ  ਰਚਨਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਚਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He hascreated departs.
lines.transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaa-ay na jaasee rachnaa jin rachaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਿਜਨਸੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety ofMaya.
lines.transliteration: rangee rangee bhaat ee kar kar jinsee maa-i-aa jin upaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਵ ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai keet aa aapn aa jiv t is dee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karsee hukam na karn aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ  ਰਜਾਈ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanakremains subject to His Will. ||27||
lines.transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa paat isaahib naanak rahan  rajaa-ee. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸਰਮੁ  ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਕੀ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਬਭੂਿਤ ॥
lines.english: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation theashes you apply to your body.
lines.transliteration: munda sant okh saram pat  jholee Dh i-aan kee karahi bibh oot.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੁਆਰੀ  ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.
lines.transliteration: khinthaa kaal ku-aaree kaa-i-aa jugat  dandaa part eet.

lines.punjabi: ਆਈ  ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ  ਜਮਾਤੀ  ਮਿਨ ਜੀਤੈ  ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your ownmind, and conquer the world.
lines.transliteration: aa-ee panthee sagal jamaatee man jeet ai jag jeet .

lines.english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
lines.transliteration: aadays t isai aad ays.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ ਅਨੀਲੁ  ਅਨਾਿਦ  ਅਨਾਹਿਤ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all theages, He is One and the Same. ||28||
lines.transliteration: aad aneel anaad  anaahat  jug jug ayko vays. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਗਿਤ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ  ਭੰਡਾਰਿਣ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਵਾਜਿਹ ਨਾਦ  ॥
lines.english: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-currentof the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: bhugat  gi-aan d a-i-aa bh andaaran  ghat ghat vaajeh naad .

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ  ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਸਾਦ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, andall other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.
lines.transliteration: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee riDh  siDh avraa saad .

lines.english: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny. pMnw 7
lines.transliteration: sanjog vijog du-ay kaar chalaaveh laykh ay aavahi bh aag.

lines.english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
lines.transliteration: aadays t isai aad ays.

lines.english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||
lines.transliteration: aad aneel anaad  anaahat  jug jug ayko vays. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅਨੀਲੁ  ਅਨਾਿਦ  ਅਨਾਹਿਤ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.
lines.transliteration: aykaa maa-ee jugat vi-aa-ee t in chaylay parvaan .

lines.english: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.
lines.transliteration: ik sansaaree ik bhandaaree ik laa-ay d eebaan .

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ  ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ  ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.
lines.transliteration: jiv tis bh aavai t ivai chalaavai jiv hovai furmaan .

lines.english: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!
lines.transliteration: oh vaykhai onaa nad ar na aavai bahut aa ayhu vidaan .

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਿਵਡਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
lines.transliteration: aadays t isai aad ays.

lines.english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all theages, He is One and the Same. ||30||
lines.transliteration: aad aneel anaad  anaahat  jug jug ayko vays. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅਨੀਲੁ  ਅਨਾਿਦ  ਅਨਾਹਿਤ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.
lines.transliteration: aasan lo-ay lo-ay bh andaar.

lines.english: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh paa-i-aa so aykaa vaar.

lines.english: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai sirjan haar.

lines.english: O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay kee saachee kaar.

lines.english: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.
lines.transliteration: aadays t isai aad ays.

lines.english: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all theages, He is One and the Same. ||31||
lines.transliteration: aad aneel anaad  anaahat  jug jug ayko vays. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅਨੀਲੁ  ਅਨਾਿਦ  ਅਨਾਹਿਤ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, witheach tongue,
lines.transliteration: ik doo jeebh ou lakh  hohi lakh  hoveh lakh  vees.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਿਹ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
lines.english: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: lakh lakh  gayrh aa aakh ee-ahi ayk naam jagd ees.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ  ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ  ॥
lines.english: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come tomerge with Him.
lines.transliteration: ayt raahi pat  pavrh ee-aa charh ee-ai ho-ay ikees.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਿਹ  ਪਿਤ ਪਵੜੀਆ  ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.
lines.transliteration: sun galaa aakaas kee keetaa aa-ee rees.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਗਲਾ  ਆਕਾਸ  ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ  ਆਈ  ਰੀਸ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai koorh ee koorhai th ees. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  jor chupai nah jor.

lines.english: No power to beg, no power to give.
lines.transliteration: jor na mangan d ayn na jor.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਿਣ  ਦੇਿਣ  ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: No power to live, no power to die.
lines.transliteration: jor na jeevan maran  nah jor.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਿਣ  ਮਰਿਣ  ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.
lines.transliteration: jor na raaj maal man sor.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਿਜ ਮਾਿਲ  ਮਿਨ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.
lines.transliteration: jor na surtee gi-aan veechaar.

lines.english: No power to find the way to escape from the world.
lines.transliteration: jor na jugtee chh utai sansaar.

lines.english: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.
lines.transliteration: jis hath jor kar vaykhai so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||
lines.transliteration: naanak utam neech na ko-ay. ||33||

lines.english: Nights, days, weeks and seasons;
lines.transliteration: raatee rut ee thit ee vaar.
pavan paan ee agnee paat aal. wind, water, fire and the nether regions
tis vich Dh artee thaap rakh ee Dh aram saal. -in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.

lines.english: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.
lines.transliteration: tis vich jee-a jugat  kay rang.

lines.english: Their names are uncounted and endless.
lines.transliteration: tin kay naam anayk anant .

lines.english: By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.
lines.transliteration: karmee karmee ho-ay veechaar.

lines.english: God Himself is True, and True is His Court.
lines.transliteration: sachaa aap sachaa darbaar.

lines.english: There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.
lines.transliteration: tithai sohan panch parvaan .

lines.english: They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: nadree karam pavai neesaan .

lines.english: The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.
lines.transliteration: kach pakaa-ee othai paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||
lines.transliteration: naanak ga-i-aa jaapai jaa-ay. ||34||

lines.english: Dharam kh and kaa ayho Dh aram. This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.
And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan khand kaa aakh hu karam.

lines.english: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.
lines.transliteration: kaytay pavan  paan ee vaisant ar kayt ay kaan mahays.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਵੈਸੰਤਰ  ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ  ਮਹੇਸ  ॥
lines.english: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.
lines.transliteration: kaytay barmay gh aarhat gharhee-ahi roop rang kay vays.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਿਤ  ਘੜੀਅਿਹ  ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.english: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to belearned!
lines.transliteration: kaytee-aa karam bh oomee mayr kayt ay kayt ay Dh oo upd ays.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੀਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ  ॥
lines.english: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.
lines.transliteration: kaytay ind  chand  soor kayt ay kayt ay mandal d ays.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ  ਦੇਸ ॥
lines.english: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses ofvarious kinds.
lines.transliteration: kaytay siDh  buDh  naath kayt ay kayt ay dayvee vays.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਿਸਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.english: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.
lines.transliteration: kaytay d ayv d aanav mun kayt ay kayt ay rat an samund .

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ  ਮੁਿਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ  ਸਮੁੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.
lines.transliteration: kaytee-aa kh aanee kayt ee-aa ban ee kayt ay paat  narind .

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੀਆ  ਖਾਣੀ  ਕੇਤੀਆ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਿਰੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: So many intuitive people, so many selfle ss servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||
lines.transliteration: kaytee-aa surt ee sayvak kayt ay naanak ant  na ant . ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੀਆ  ਸੁਰਤੀ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.english: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan khand meh gi-aan parchand.

lines.english: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss. pMnw 8
lines.transliteration: tithai naad  binod  kod anand.

lines.english: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.
lines.transliteration: saram khand kee ban ee roop.

lines.english: Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.
lines.transliteration: tithai gh aarhat gharhee-ai bahut  anoop.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ  ਗਲਾ  ਕਥੀਆ  ਨਾ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: These things cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: taa kee-aa galaa kathee-aa naa jaahi.

lines.english: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.
lines.transliteration: jay ko kahai pichhai pachh utaa-ay.

lines.english: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.
lines.transliteration: tithai gh arhee-ai surat  mat man buDh .

lines.english: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||
lines.transliteration: tithai gh arhee-ai suraa siDh aa kee suDh . ||36||

lines.english: In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.
lines.transliteration: karam khand kee ban ee jor.

lines.english: No one else dwells there,
lines.transliteration: tithai hor na ko-ee hor.
tithai joDh  mahaabal soor. except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.

lines.english: They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.
lines.transliteration: tin meh raam rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.
lines.transliteration: tithai seet o seet aa mahimaa maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Their beauty cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: taa kay roop na kathnay jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਿਹ ਮਰਿਹ  ਨ ਠਾਗੇ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Neither death nor deception comes to those,
lines.transliteration: naa ohi mareh na thaagay jaahi.
jin kai raam vasai man maahi. within whose minds the Lord abides.

lines.english: The devotees of many worlds dwell there.
lines.transliteration: tithai bh agat vaseh kay lo-a.

lines.english: They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: karahi anand sachaa man so-ay.

lines.english: In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: sach khand vasai nirankaar.

lines.english: Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai nad ar nihaal.

lines.english: There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.
lines.transliteration: tithai kh and mandal varbh and.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
lines.english: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.
lines.transliteration: jay ko kathai ta ant  na ant .

lines.english: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.
lines.transliteration: tithai lo-a lo-a aakaar.

lines.english: As He commands, so they exist.
lines.transliteration: jiv jiv hukam tivai t iv kaar.

lines.english: He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.
lines.transliteration: vaykhai vigsai kar veechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||
lines.transliteration: naanak kathnaa karrhaa saar. ||37||

lines.english: Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.
lines.transliteration: jat paahaaraa Dh eeraj suni-aar.

lines.english: Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.
lines.transliteration: ahran mat  vayd  hathee-aar.

lines.english: With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.
lines.transliteration: bha-o kh alaa agan t ap taa-o.

lines.english: In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name, GVIAY sbdu scI tkswl ] (8-9 jpu, mÚ 1) gharh ee-ai sabad  sachee taksaal. and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God. ijn kau ndir krmu iqn kwr ] (8-9 jpu, mÚ 1) jin ka-o nadar karam t in kaar. Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace. nwnk ndrI ndir inhwl ]38] (8-10 jpu, mÚ 1) naanak nadree nad ar nihaal. ||38|| O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38|| sloku ] (8-10) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: bhaaNdaa bh aa-o amrit  tit dhaal.

lines.english: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.
lines.transliteration: pavan guroo paan ee pit aa maat aa Dh arat mahat .

lines.english: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.
lines.transliteration: divas raat  du-ay d aa-ee d aa-i-aa kh aylai sagal jagat .

lines.english: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord ofDharma.
lines.transliteration: chang-aa-ee-aa buri-aa-ee-aa vaachai Dharam had oor.

lines.english: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.
lines.transliteration: karmee aapo aapnee kay nayrh ai kay d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਣੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਧਰਿਤ  ਮਹਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed afterhaving worked by the sweat of their brows
lines.transliteration: jinee naam Dhi-aa-i-aa ga-ay maskat  ghaal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਵਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ  ਦਾਇਆ  ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ  ਜਗਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved alongwith them! ||1|| so dru rwgu Awsw mhlw 1  (8-14) so dar raag aasaa mehlaa 1 So Dar ~ That Door. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (8-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay mukh  ujlay kayt ee chh utee naal. ||1||

lines.english: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take careof all?
lines.transliteration: so dar t ayraa kayhaa so gh ar kayhaa jit  bahi sarab samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੀ  ਆਪੋ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians playall sorts of instruments there for You.
lines.transliteration: vaajay tayray naad  anayk asankh aa kayt ay tayray vaavan haaray.

lines.english: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels singhymns of You.
lines.transliteration: kaytay t ayray raag paree si-o kahee-ahi kayt ay tayray gaavan haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਕੇਤੀ  ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no pavan  paan ee baisant ar gaavai raajaa Dh aram d u-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no chit  gupat  likh jaanan likh  likh Dharam beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਿਜਤੁ ਬਿਹ ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no eesar barahmaa d ayvee sohan t ayray sad aa savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਅਸੰਖਾ  ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no ind ar ind araasan  baith ay dayviti-aa d ar naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਿਸਉ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation. pMnw 9
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no siDh  samaaDh ee and ar gaavan t uDhno saaDh  beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no jat ee sat ee sant okhee gaavan t uDhno veer karaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੜਿਨ  ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of allthe ages, sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no pandit  parhan rakh eesur jug jug vayd aa naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਮੋਹਣੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਸੁਰਗੁ  ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in thisworld, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no mohn ee-aa man mohan surag machh  pa-i-aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no rat an upaa-ay t ayray ath sath tirath naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ  ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਖਾਣੀ  ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sourcesof creation sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no joDh  mahaabal sooraa gaavan t uDhno kh aanee chaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing ofYou.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no kh and mandal barahmandaa kar kar rakh ay tayray Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਨ  ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਰਸਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued withYour Sublime Essence.
lines.transliteration: say-ee tuDh no gaavan jo t uDh bhaavan rat ay tayray bh agat rasaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਸੇ ਮੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਿਨ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think ofthem all?
lines.transliteration: hor kaytay t uDhno gaavan say mai chit  na aavan naanak ki-aa beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: so-ee so-ee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਜਾਸੀ  ਰਚਨਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਚਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He hascreated departs.
lines.transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaa-ay na jaasee rachnaa jin rachaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੀ  ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਿਜਨਸੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety ofMaya.
lines.transliteration: rangee rangee bhaat ee kar kar jinsee maa-i-aa jin upaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.
lines.transliteration: kar kar daykh ai keet aa aapn aa ji-o t is dee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karsee fir hukam na karn aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਿਤਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਹਣੁ  ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (9-9) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa pat isaahib naanak rahan  rajaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Hearing of His Greatness, everyone calls Him Great.
lines.transliteration: sun vadaa aakh ai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: But just how Great His Greatness is-this is known only to those who have seen Him.
lines.transliteration: kayvad vadaa deethaa ho-ay.

lines.english: His Value cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: keemat paa-ay na kahi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahnai vaalay t ayray rahay samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean ofExcellence.
lines.transliteration: vaday mayray saahibaa gahir gambheeraa gun ee gaheeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰਾ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your Expanse. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na jaanai t ayraa kayt aa kayvad cheeraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ  ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the intuitives met and practiced intuitive meditation.
lines.transliteration: sabh surt ee mil surat  kamaa-ee.

lines.english: All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.
lines.transliteration: sabh keemat  mil keemat  paa-ee.

lines.english: The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee Dhi-aanee gur gurhaa-ee.
kahan na jaa-ee t ayree t il vadi-aa-ee. ||2|| -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

lines.english: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,
lines.transliteration: sabh sat  sabh  tap sabh  chang-aa-ee-aa.
siDhaa purkh aa kee-aa vad i-aa-ee-aa. all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸਤ ਸਿਭ ਤਪ ਸਿਭ ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tuDh vin siDhee kinai na paa-ee-aa. -without You, no one has attained such powers.

lines.english: They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam milai naahee thaak rahaa-ee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: What can the poor helpless creatures do?
lines.transliteration: aakhan  vaalaa ki-aa vaychaaraa.

lines.english: Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.
lines.transliteration: siftee bh aray t ayray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?
lines.transliteration: jis too d eh tisai ki-aa chaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ||4||2|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (9-15) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach savaaranhaaraa. ||4||2||

lines.english: Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die.
lines.transliteration: aakhaa jeevaa visrai mar jaa-o.

lines.english: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  a-ukh aa saachaa naa-o.

lines.english: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
lines.transliteration: saachay naam kee laagai bhookh .
ut bhookhai khaa-ay chalee-ahi d ookh. ||1|| that hunger shall consume his pain. ||1||

lines.english: How can I forget Him, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o visrai mayree maa-ay.

lines.english: True is the Master, True is His Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib saachai naa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Trying to describe even an iota of the Greatness of the True Name,
lines.transliteration: saachay naam kee til vadi-aa-ee.
aakh thakay keemat  nahee paa-ee. people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.

lines.english: Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,
lines.transliteration: jay sabh mil kai aakh an paahi.

lines.english: He would not become any greater or any lesser. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vadaa na hovai ghaat na jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.
lines.transliteration: naa oh marai na hovai sog.

lines.english: He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short.
lines.transliteration: daydaa rahai na chookai bh og.

lines.english: This Virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.
lines.transliteration: gun ayho hor naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਿਟ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There never has been, and there never will be. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naa ko ho-aa naa ko ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: As Great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so Great are Your Gifts. pMnw 10
lines.transliteration: jayvad aap tayvad t ayree d aat.

lines.english: The One who created the day also created the night.
lines.transliteration: jin din kar kai keet ee raat .

lines.english: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.
lines.transliteration: khasam visaareh t ay kamjaat .

lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ||4||3|| rwgu gUjrI mhlw 4 ] (10-1) raag goojree mehlaa 4. Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai baajh sanaat . ||4||3||

lines.english: O humble servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being: I offer my humbleprayer to You, O Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kay jan satgur sat purkh aa bina-o kara-o gur paas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਤਪੁਰਖਾ  ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: I am a mere insect, a worm. O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be merciful,and bless me with the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham keeray kiram satgur sarn aa-ee kar d a-i-aa naam pargaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਿਕਰਮ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please enlighten me with the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray meet gurd ayv mo ka-o raam naam pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is my breath of life. The Kirtan of the Lord'sPraise is my life's occupation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam mayraa paraan sakh aa-ee har keerat  hamree rahraas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਹਮਰੀ  ਰਹਰਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The servants of the Lord have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, and a longing for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jan kay vad bhaag vadayray jin har har sarDh aa har pi-aas.

lines.english: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Sangat, theBlessed Congregation, their virtues shine forth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har naam milai taript aasahi mil sangat  gun pargaas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਧਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have not obtained the Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,Har, are most unfortunate; they are led away by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jin har har har ras naam na paa-i-aa tay bh aagheen  jam paas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Sangat, the HolyCongregation-cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo satgur saran  sangat  nahee aa-ay Dh arig jeevay Dh arig jeevaas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਜਮ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble servants of the Lord who have attained the Company of the True Guru,have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: jin har jan satgur sangat  paa-ee t in Dhur mast ak likh i-aa likh aas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਜੀਵੇ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਿਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat sangat  jit har ras paa-i-aa mil jan naanak naam pargaas. ||4||4|| Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Lord's Essenceis obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Light of the Naam shinesforth. ||4||4|| rwgu gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (10-8) raag goojree mehlaa 5. Raag Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਿਤਨ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਲਖਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Why, O mind, do you plot and plan, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for yourcare?
lines.transliteration: kaahay ray man chitvahi ud am jaa aahar har jee-o pari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: From rocks and stones He created living beings; He places their nourishment before them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sail pathar meh jant upaa-ay t aa kaa rijak aagai kar Dh ari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O my Dear Lord of souls, one who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, issaved.
lines.transliteration: mayray maaDha-o jee sat sangat  milay so t ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਿਚਤਵਿਹ  ਉਦਮੁ  ਜਾ ਆਹਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਪਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained, and the dry wood blossoms forthagain in lush greenery. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-i-aa sookay kaasat hari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ  ਮਿਹ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਆਗੈ  ਕਿਰ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mothers, fathers, friends, children and spouses-no one is the support of anyone else.
lines.transliteration: janan pitaa lok sut  banit aa ko-ay na kis kee Dh ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ  ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: For each and every person, our Lord and Master provides sustenance. Why are you soafraid, O mind? ||2||
lines.transliteration: sir sir rijak sambaahay thaakur kaahay man bh a-o kari-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ  ਹਿਰਆ॥੧॥
lines.english: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.
lines.transliteration: ooday ood aavai sai kosaa tis paachh ai bachray chh ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਾਉ॥ਜਨਿਨ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਕੀ ਧਿਰਆ॥
lines.english: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thoughtof this in your mind? ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin kavan  khalaavai kavan  chugaavai man meh simran kari-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸੰਬਾਹੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All the nine treasures, and the eighteen supernatural powers are held by our Lord andMaster in the Palm of His Hand.
lines.transliteration: sabh niDh aan d as asat sidh aan th aakur kar t al Dhari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਊਡੇ ਊਿਡ ਆਵੈ  ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, forever a sacrifice to You, Lord. Your Expanse has no limit, no boundary. ||4||5|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 4 so purKu (10-16) raag aasaa mehlaa 4 so purakh Raag Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, So Purakh ~ That Primal Being: <> siqgur pRswid ] (10-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bal bal sad bal jaa-ee-ai t ayraa ant  na paraavari-aa. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਵਣੁ  ਖਲਾਵੈ  ਕਵਣੁ  ਚੁਗਾਵੈ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਕਿਰਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculateand Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.
lines.transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh  niranjan har agmaa agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਿਸਧਾਨ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: All meditate, all meditate on You, Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh Dh i-aavahi sabh  Dhi-aavahi t uDh jee har sachay sirjan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਿਰਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: All living beings are Yours-You are the Giver of all souls.
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-a t umaaray jee t ooN jee-aa kaa d aataaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the Dispeller of all sorrow.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavahu sant ahu jee sabh  dookh visaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant. O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ||1|| pMnw 11
lines.transliteration: har aapay thaakur har aapay sayvak jee ki-aa naanak jant  vichaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.
lines.transliteration: tooN ghat ghat ant ar sarab nirant ar jee har ayko purakh  samaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.
lines.transliteration: ik daat ay ik bh aykhaaree jee sabh  tayray choj vidaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ ਦਾਤੇ  ਇਿਕ  ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ਜੀ ਸਿਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਿਵਡਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other thanYou.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay d aataa aapay bh ugtaa jee ha-o t uDh bin avar na jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?
lines.transliteration: tooN paarbarahm bay-ant  bay-ant  jee tayray ki-aa gun  aakh  vakh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is asacrifice. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo sayveh jo sayveh tuDh  jee jan naanak t in kurbaan aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਜੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beingsdwell in peace in this world.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavahi har Dh i-aavahi t uDh jee say jan jug meh sukh vaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.
lines.transliteration: say mukat say mukat  bha-ay jin har Dh i-aa-i-aa jee t in tootee jam kee faasee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਭਏ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜੀ ਿਤਨ  ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears aredispelled.
lines.transliteration: jin nirbha-o jin har nirbh a-o Dh i-aa-i-aa jee t in kaa bh a-o sabh  gavaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਭਉ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜੀ ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa jin sayvi-aa mayraa har jee tay har har roop samaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਜਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰੂਿਪ ਸਮਾਸੀ  ॥
