lines.english: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say Dhan say Dh an jin har Dh i-aa-i-aa jee jan naanak t in bal jaasee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਸੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyondmeasure.
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat tayree bh agat bhandaar jee bh aray bi-ant  bay-ant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਿਬਅੰਤ  ਬੇਅੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various andcountless ways.
lines.transliteration: tayray bh agat tayray bh agat salaahan t uDh jee har anik anayk anant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਅਿਨਕ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਅਨੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord;they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.
lines.transliteration: tayree anik t ayree anik karahi har poojaa jee t ap taapeh jaapeh bay-ant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਿਨਕ  ਤੇਰੀ ਅਿਨਕ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਿਹ  ਜਪਿਹ  ਬੇਅੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. Theyperform rituals and religious rites.
lines.transliteration: tayray anayk t ayray anayk parh eh baho simrit  saasat  jee kar kiri-aa kh at karam karantaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ  ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤ  ਜੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: ||4|| Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing tomy Dear Lord God. ||4||
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  say bh agat bhalay jan naanak jee jo bh aaveh mayray har bh agvant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.
lines.transliteration: tooN aad purakh  aprampar kart aa jee t uDh jayvad avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You neverchange, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: tooN jug jug ayko sad aa sad aa tooN ayko jee t ooN nihchal kart aa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay bh aavai so-ee vart ai jee t ooN aapay karahi so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ  ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shalldestroy it all.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay sarisat sabh  upaa-ee jee t uDh aapay siraj sabh  go-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ  ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰਿਜ  ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Dear Creator, the Knower of all.||5||1|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (11-14) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai kart ay kay jee jo sabh sai kaa jaan o-ee. ||5||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ  ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ  ॥੫॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa sachiaar maidaa saaN-ee.

lines.english: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo ta-o bh aavai so-ee theesee jo t ooN deh so-ee ha-o paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All belong to You, all meditate on you.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree t ooN sabh nee Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ  ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karahi tin naam rat an paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh laaDh aa manmukh  gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDh aap vichh orhi-aa aap milaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: You are the River of Life; all are within You.
lines.transliteration: tooN daree-aa-o sabh  tujh hee maahi.

lines.english: There is no one except You.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa ko-ee naahi.

lines.english: All living beings are Your playthings.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tayraa kh ayl.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separationare reunited once again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vijog mil vichhurh i-aa sanjogee mayl. ||2||

lines.english: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;
lines.transliteration: jis no too jaan aa-ihi so-ee jan jaan ai.
har gun sad  hee aakh  vakh aanai. they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.

lines.english: Those who serve You find peace.
lines.transliteration: jin har sayvi-aa tin sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3|| pMnw 12
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee har naam samaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.
lines.transliteration: too aapay kart aa tayraa kee-aa sabh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: There is no one except You.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.
lines.transliteration: too kar kar vaykh eh jaan eh so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖਿਹ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (12-2) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh pargat ho-ay. ||4||2||

lines.english: In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!
lines.transliteration: tit saravrarh ai bha-eelay nivaasaa paan ee paavak t ineh kee-aa.

lines.english: In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen themdrowning there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pankaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham daykh aa tah doobee-alay. ||1||

lines.english: In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!
lines.transliteration: man ayk na chaytas moorh  manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਕਜੁ  ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ  ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bisrat t ayray gun  gali-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਸ  ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o jatee sat ee nahee parh i-aa moorakh  mugDh aa janam bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord!||2||3|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (12-6) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak t in kee sarn aa jin t oo naahee veesri-aa. ||2||3||

lines.english: This human body has been given to you.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee paraapat  maanukh  dayhuree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪਿੜਆ  ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gobind milan  kee ih t ayree baree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ  ਿਜਨ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ  ਵੀਸਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: Nothing else will work.
lines.transliteration: avar kaaj tayrai kit ai na kaam.

lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewelof the Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangat  bhaj kayval naam. ||1||

lines.english: Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: saraNjaam laag bhavjal t aran kai.

lines.english: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam baritha jaat rang maa-i-aa kai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have not practiced meditation, self-disci pline, self-restraint or righteous living.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam Dh aram na kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have not served the Holy; I have not acknowledged the Lord, my King.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa saaDh na jaani-aa har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my actions are contemptible!
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ham neech karammaa.

lines.english: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||4|| soihlw rwgu gauVI dIpkI mhlw 1  (12-10) sohilaa raag ga-orhee d eepkee mehlaa 1 Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (12-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saran paray kee raakh o sarmaa. ||2||4||

lines.english: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted and contemplated
lines.transliteration: jai ghar keerat  aakh ee-ai kart ay kaa ho-ay beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tit ghar gaavhu sohilaa sivrihu sirjan haaro. ||1|| -in that house, sing Songs of Praise; meditate and remember the Creator Lord. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.
lines.transliteration: tum gaavhu mayray nirbh a-o kaa sohilaa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jit sohilai sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.
lines.transliteration: nit nit  jee-arh ay samaalee-an d aykhaigaa d ayvan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਦੀਪਕੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Your Gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayray d aanai keemat  naa pavai t is daatay kavan  sumaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਘਿਰ  ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come, gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.
lines.transliteration: sambat saahaa likh i-aa mil kar paavhu t ayl.

lines.english: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dayh sajan  aseesrh ee-aa ji-o hovai saahib si-o mayl. ||3||

lines.english: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; thecall comes each and every day.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar ayho paahuchaa sad -rhay nit  pavann.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸੋਿਹਲੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawingnear! ||4||1|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 ] (12-16) raag aasaa mehlaa 1. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadan haaraa simree-ai naanak say d ih aavann. ||4||1||

lines.english: There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings.
lines.transliteration: chhi-a gh ar chh i-a gur chh i-a upd ays.

lines.english: But the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur gur ayko vays anayk. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ  ਕਵਣੁ  ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Baba: that system in which the Praises of the Creator are sung
lines.transliteration: baabaa jai ghar kart ay keerat  ho-ay.
so ghar raakh  vadaa-ee t o-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. -follow that system; in it rests true greatness. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ  ਅਸੀਸੜੀਆ  ਿਜਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਿਸਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The seconds, minutes and hours, days, weeks and months,
lines.transliteration: visu-ay chasi-aa gharh ee-aa pahraa thit ee vaaree maahu ho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ  ਿਨਤ ਪਵੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj ayko rut anayk. and the various seasons originate from the one sun; pMnw 13

lines.english: O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ||2||2|| rwgu DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (13-1) raag Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Raag Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kartay kay kayt ay vays. ||2||2||

lines.english: Upon that cosmic plate of the sky, the sun and the moon are the lamps. The stars and their orbs are the studded pearls.
lines.transliteration: gagan mai thaal rav chand d eepak banay t aarikaa mandal janak mot ee.

lines.english: Dhoop mal-aanlo pavan  chavro karay sagal banraa-ay foolant  jotee. ||1|| The fragrance of sandalwood in the air is the temple incense, and the wind is the fan. All the plants of the world are the altar flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord.||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਗਨ  ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ  ਰਿਵ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ  ਬਨੇ ਤਾਿਰਕਾ  ਮੰਡਲ  ਜਨਕ  ਮੋਤੀ ॥
lines.english: What a beautiful Aartee, lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of Fear, this isYour Ceremony of Light.
lines.transliteration: kaisee aartee ho-ay. bh av kh andnaa t ayree aart ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ  ਪਵਣੁ  ਚਵਰੋ  ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ  ਬਨਰਾਇ  ਫੂਲੰਤ  ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad is the vibration of the temple drums.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anhataa sabad  vaajant  bhayree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You have thousands of eyes, and yet You have no eyes. You have thousands of forms,and yet You do not have even one.
lines.transliteration: sahas tav nain nan nain heh t ohi ka-o sahas moorat  nanaa ayk t ohee.

lines.english: You have thousands of Lotus Feet, and yet You do not have even one foot. You haveno nose, but you have thousands of noses. This Play of Yours entrances me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahas pad bimal nan ayk pad  ganDh  bin sahas t av ganDh  iv chalat  mohee. ||2||

lines.english: Amongst all is the Light-You are that Light.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh jot  jot hai so-ay.

lines.english: By this Illumination, that Light is radiant within all.
lines.transliteration: tis dai chaanan  sabh  meh chaanan  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹਿਹ ਤੋਿਹ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Light shines forth.
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee jot  pargat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਪਦ ਿਬਮਲ  ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਸ  ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ  ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: That which is pleasing to Him is the lamp-lit worship service. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so aart ee ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ ਜੋਿਤ  ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: My mind is enticed by the honey-sweet Lotus Feet of the Lord. Day and night, I thirst for them.
lines.transliteration: har charan kaval makrand  lobhit mano and ino mohi aahee pi-aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਦੈ ਚਾਨਿਣ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Bestow the Water of Your Mercy upon Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, so that he maycome to dwell in Your Name. ||4||3|| rwgu gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (13-8) raag ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kirpaa jal deh naanak saaring ka-o ho-ay jaa t ay tayrai naa-ay vaasaa. ||4||3||

lines.english: The body-village is filled to overflowing with anger and sexual desire; these werebroken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh nagar baho bh ari-aa mil saaDh oo kh andal kh anda hay.

lines.english: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poorab likhat  likhay gur paa-i-aa man har liv mandal mandaa hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ  ਲੋਿਭਤ  ਮਨੋ ਅਨਿਦਨ ਮੋਿਹ ਆਹੀ  ਿਪਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms presse d together; this is an act of great merit.
lines.transliteration: kar saaDhoo anjulee pun vadaa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਜਲੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਰੰਗ  ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ  ਵਾਸਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar dand-ut pun vadaa hay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the Taste of the Lord's Sublime Essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.
lines.transliteration: saakat har ras saad  na jaan i-aa tin ant ar ha-umai kandaa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰੋਿਧ  ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਰਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ  ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: The more they walk away, the deeper it pierces them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o chaleh chubhai d ukh paavahi jamkaal saheh sir dandaa hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਖਤ  ਿਲਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਮੰਡਲ  ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Thepain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: har jan har har naam samaanay d ukh janam maran  bhav kh anda hay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: They have found the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, andthey receive great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee purakh  paa-i-aa parmaysar baho sobh  khand barahmandaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: I am poor and meek, God, but I belong to You! Save me-please save me, O Greatestof the Great!
lines.transliteration: ham gareeb maskeen parabh t ayray har raakh  raakh  vad vadaa hay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||4|| rwgu gauVI pUrbI mhlw 5 ] (13-14) raag ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 5. Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam aDhaar tayk hai har naamay hee sukh  mandaa hay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਅੰਤਿਰ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!
lines.transliteration: kara-o baynantee sun hu mayray meet aa sant  tahal kee baylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਿਜਉ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਸਹਿਹ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell inpeace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaa khaat chalhu har laahaa aagai basan suhaylaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: This life is diminishing, day and night. Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: a-oDh gh atai d inas rain aaray. man gur mil kaaj savaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God aresaved.
lines.transliteration: ih sansaar bikaar sansay meh tari-o barahm gi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ  ਮਸਕੀਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Only those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this Sublime Essence, come toknow the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jisahi jagaa-ay pee-aavai ih ras akath kathaa tin jaanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, theLord shall dwell within your mind.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o aa-ay so-ee bihaajhahu har gur t ay maneh basayraa.

lines.english: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel ofreincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal paavhu sukh  sehjay bahur na ho-igo fayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ  ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ  ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts, O Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee purakh  biDhaatay sarDh aa man kee pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਈਹਾ  ਖਾਿਟ  ਚਲਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਹਾ  ਆਗੈ  ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||5|| pMnw 14 <> siqgur pRswid ] (14-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu isrIrwgu mhlw pihlw 1 Gru 1 ] (14-2) raag sireeraag mehlaa pahilaa 1 ghar 1. Raag Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas ihai sukh  maagai mo ka-o kar sant an kee Dh ooray. ||4||5||

lines.english: If I had a palace made of pearls, inlaid with jewels,
lines.transliteration: motee t a mand ar oosreh rat nee ta hohi jarh aa-o.
kastoor kungoo agar chand an leep aavai chaa-o. scented with musk, saffron and sandalwood, a sheer delight to behold

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਤੀ ਤ ਮੰਦਰ  ਊਸਰਿਹ  ਰਤਨੀ  ਤ ਹੋਿਹ ਜੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mat d aykh bhoolaa veesrai t ayraa chit  na aavai naa-o. ||1|| -seeing this, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਸਤੂਿਰ  ਕੁੰਗੂ ਅਗਿਰ  ਚੰਦਿਨ  ਲੀਿਪ  ਆਵੈ  ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, my soul is scorched and burnt.
lines.transliteration: har bin jee-o jal bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I consulted my Guru, and now I see that there is no other place at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai aapnaa gur poochh  daykhi-aa avar naahee thaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dhart ee ta heeray laal jarh -tee palagh  laal jarh aa-o. If the floor of this palace was a mosaic of diamonds and rubies, and if my bed wasencased with rubies,

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਆਪਣਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਿਛ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mohnee mukh  manee sohai karay rang pasaa-o. and if heavenly beauties, their faces ador ned with emeralds, tried to entice me with sensual gestures of love
mat d aykh bhoolaa veesrai t ayraa chit  na aavai naa-o. ||2|| -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤੀ  ਤ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੜਤੀ  ਪਲਿਘ  ਲਾਲ  ਜੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: If I were to become a Siddha, and work miracles, summon wealth
lines.transliteration: siDh hovaa siDh  laa-ee riDh  aakh aa aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਪਸਾਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gupat pargat ho-ay baisaa lok raakh ai bhaa-o. and become invisible and visible at will, so that people would hold me in awe

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mat d aykh bhoolaa veesrai t ayraa chit  na aavai naa-o. ||3|| -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter intomy mind. ||3||

lines.english: If I were to become an emperor and raise a huge army, and sit on a throne,
lines.transliteration: sultaan hovaa mayl laskar t akhat raakh aa paa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam haasal karee baithaa naankaa sabh  vaa-o. issuing commands and collecting taxes-O Nanak, all of this could pass away like a puffof wind.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਚਿਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter intomy mind. ||4||1|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (14-9) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mat d aykh bhoolaa veesrai t ayraa chit  na aavai naa-o. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਮੇਿਲ ਲਸਕਰ  ਤਖਿਤ  ਰਾਖਾ  ਪਾਉ ॥
lines.english: If I could live for millions and millions of years, and if the air was my food and drink,
lines.transliteration: kot kotee mayree aarjaa pavan pee-an  api-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਸਲੁ  ਕਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਭ ਵਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj d u-ay gufai na d aykhaa supnai sa-un  na thaa-o. and if I lived in a cave and never saw either the sun or the moon, and if I never slept, even in dreams

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhee t ayree keemat  naa pavai ha-o kayvad aakh aa naa-o. ||1|| -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of YourName? ||1||

lines.english: The True Lord, the Formless One, is Himself in His Own Place.
lines.transliteration: saachaa nirankaar nij thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਰਜਾ  ਪਵਣੁ  ਪੀਅਣੁ  ਅਿਪਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have heard, over and over again, and so I tell the tale; as it pleases You, Lord,please instill within me the yearning for You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sun sun  aakh an aakh -naa jay bh aavai karay t amaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਦੁਇ ਗੁਫੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸਉਣ  ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: If I was slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put into the mill andground into flour,
lines.transliteration: kusaa katee-aa vaar vaar peesan peesaa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: agee saytee jaalee-aa bh asam sayt ee ral jaa-o. burnt by fire and mixed with ashes
bhee t ayree keemat  naa pavai ha-o kayvad aakh aa naa-o. ||2|| -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness ofYour Name? ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ  ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,
lines.transliteration: pankhee ho-ay kai jay bh avaa sai asmaanee jaa-o.
nadree kisai na aav-oo naa kichh  pee-aa na kh aa-o. and if I was invisible, neither eating nor drinking anything

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਸਾ ਕਟੀਆ  ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੀਸਿਣ  ਪੀਸਾ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Name? ||3|| pMnw 15
lines.transliteration: bhee t ayree keemat  naa pavai ha-o kayvad aakh aa naa-o. ||3|| -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your

lines.english: O Nanak, if I had hundreds of thousands of stacks of paper, and if I were to read and recite and embrace love for the Lord,
lines.transliteration: naanak kaagad lakh  manaa parh  parh keechai bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਗਦ  ਲਖ ਮਣਾ ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਕੀਚੈ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: masoo tot na aavee laykh an pa-un  chalaa-o. and if ink were never to fail me, and if my pen were able to move like the wind

lines.punjabi: ਮਸੂ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਲੇਖਿਣ ਪਉਣੁ  ਚਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhee t ayree keemat  naa pavai ha-o kayvad aakh aa naa-o. ||4||2|| -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of YourName? ||4||2|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (15-2) sireeraag mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: As it is pre-ordained, people speak their words. As it is pre-ordained, they consumetheir food.
lines.transliteration: laykhai bolan  bolnaa laykh ai khaanaa kh aa-o.

lines.english: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see andhear.
lines.transliteration: laykhai vaat chalaa-ee-aa laykh ai sun  vaykh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ  ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਲੇਖੈ ਖਾਣਾ  ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.english: As it is pre-ordained, they draw their breath. Why should I go and ask the scholarsabout this? ||1||
lines.transliteration: laykhai saah lavaa-ee-ahi parh ay ke puchh an jaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਾਈਆ  ਲੇਖੈ ਸੁਿਣ ਵੇਖਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.
lines.transliteration: baabaa maa-i-aa rachnaa Dhohu.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਈਅਿਹ ਪੜੇ ਿਕ ਪੁਛਣ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The blind man has forgotten the Name; he is in limbo, neither here nor there. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anDhai naam visaari-aa naa t is ayh na oh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Life and death come to all who are born. Everything here gets devoured by Death.
lines.transliteration: jeevan marn aa jaa-ay kai aythai kh aajai kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਏਹ ਨ ਓਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.
lines.transliteration: jithai bahi samjaa-ee-ai tithai ko-ay na chali-o naal.

lines.english: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rovan vaalay jayt -rhay sabh  baneh pand paraal. ||2||

lines.english: Everyone says that God is the Greatest of the Great. No one calls Him any less.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aakh ai bahut  bahut  ghat na aakh ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਣ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਜਾਇ  ਕੈ ਏਥੈ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.
lines.transliteration: keemat kinai na paa-ee-aa kahan  na vadaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਬਿਹ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ  ਿਤਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਿਲਓ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: You are the One True Lord and Master of all the other beings, of so many worlds.||3|| nIcw AMdir nIc jwiq nIcI hU Aiq nIcu ] nw nku iqn kY sMig swiQ vifAw isau ikAw rIs ] (15- 8, isrIrwgu, mÚ 1) neechaa andar neech jaat  neechee hoo at  neech. naanak t in kai sang saath vadi-aa si- o ki-aa rees. Nanak seeks the company of the lowest of the low class, the very lowest of the low.Why should he try to compete with the great?
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahab ayk too hor jee-aa kayt ay lo-a. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵਣ  ਵਾਲੇ  ਜੇਤੜੇ  ਸਿਭ ਬੰਨਿਹ  ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In that place where the lowly are cared for-there, the Blessings of Your Glance of Grace rain down. ||4||3|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (15-9) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jithai neech samaalee-an tithai nad ar tayree bakh sees. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਿਟ  ਨ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rottingcarcass.
lines.transliteration: lab kutaa koorh  choohrh aa thag kh aaDhaa murd aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ਕਹਿਣ  ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of angeris the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.
lines.transliteration: par nindaa par mal mukh  suDh ee agan kroDh  chandaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਿਰ ਜੀਆ  ਕੇਤੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
lines.english: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are myactions, O my Creator! ||1||
lines.transliteration: ras kas aap salaahnaa ay karam mayray kart aar. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor.
lines.transliteration: baabaa bolee-ai pat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਨੀਚ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨੀਚੀ  ਹੂ ਅਿਤ  ਨੀਚੁ ॥
lines.english: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karmacan only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ootam say d ar oot am kahee-ahi neech karam bahi ro-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਵਿਡਆ  ਿਸਉ ਿਕਆ ਰੀਸ ॥
lines.english: The pleasures of gold and silver, the pleasures of women, the pleasure of thefragrance of sandalwood,
lines.transliteration: ras su-inaa ras rupaa kaaman ras parmal kee vaas.
ras ghorh ay ras sayjaa mand ar ras meeth aa ras maas. the pleasure of horses, the pleasure of a soft bed in a palace, the pleasure of sweet treats and the pleasure of hearty meals
aytay ras sareer kay kai gh at naam nivaas. ||2|| -these pleasures of the human body are so numerous; how can the Naam, the Nameof the Lord, find its dwelling in the heart? ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲਬੁ ਕੁਤਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਚੂਹੜਾ  ਠਿਗ  ਖਾਧਾ  ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.
lines.transliteration: jit boli-ai pat  paa-ee-ai so boli-aa parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਧੀ ਅਗਿਨ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!
lines.transliteration: fikaa bol viguchnaa sun  moorakh  man ajaan .

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਪੁ  ਸਲਾਹਣਾ  ਏ ਕਰਮ  ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aaveh say bh alay hor ke kahan  vakh aan. ||3||

lines.english: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeatedwith the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tin mat  tin pat  tin Dhan palai jin hird ai rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਊਤਮ  ਸੇ ਦਿਰ ਊਤਮ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ  ਬਿਹ ਰੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed uponthem?
lines.transliteration: tin kaa ki-aa salaahn aa avar su-aali-o kaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor theLord's Name. ||4||4|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (15-17) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree baahray raacheh d aan na naa-ay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰਸੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਰਸੁ ਪਰਮਲ  ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.
lines.transliteration: amal galolaa koorh kaa d itaa dayvan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਮੰਦਰ  ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਰਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.
lines.transliteration: matee maran  visaari-aa kh usee keet ee din chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ  ਕੇ ਕੈ ਘਿਟ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach mili-aa tin sofee-aa raakh an ka-o d arvaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਬੋਿਲਐ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸੋ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay ka-o sach jaan.

lines.english: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jit sayvi-ai sukh  paa-ee-ai t ayree d argeh chalai maan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਿਰ ਿਕ ਕਹਣ  ਵਖਾਣ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it. pMnw 16
lines.transliteration: sach saraa gurh baahraa jis vich sachaa naa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.
lines.transliteration: suneh vakaan eh jayt -rhay ha-o t in balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਜੇਤੜੇ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa man kh eevaa jaan ee-ai jaa mahlee paa-ay thaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ  ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,
lines.transliteration: naa-o neer chang-aa-ee-aa sat parmal t an vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa mukh  hovai ujlaa lakh  daatee ik d aat. and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ  ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ  ਇਕ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dookh  tisai peh aakh ee-ahi sookh  jisai hee paas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਿਤਸੈ ਪਿਹ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਸੂਖ ਿਜਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o manhu visaaree-ai jaa kay jee-a paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.
lines.transliteration: tis vin  sabh  apvit ar hai jayt aa painan  khaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਿਵਤਰ੍ੁ  ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ  ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਖਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5|| isrIrwgu mhlu 1 ] (16-5) sireeraag mahal 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hor galaaN sabh koorh ee-aa t uDh bhaavai parvaan . ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਰ ਗਲ  ਸਿਭ ਕੂੜੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into thepurest of paper.
lines.transliteration: jaal moh ghas mas kar mat  kaagad  kar saar.

lines.english: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then,seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o kalam kar chit  laykh aaree gur puchh  likh beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਲ  ਮੋਹੁ ਘਿਸ  ਮਸੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਿਤ ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਕਿਰ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: likh naam saalaah likh  likh ant na paaraavaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਿਰ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲੇਖਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਪੁਿਛ ਿਲਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Baba, write such an account,
lines.transliteration: baabaa ayhu laykhaa likh  jaan.
jithai laykhaa mangee-ai t ithai ho-ay sachaa neesaan . ||1|| rahaa-o. that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,
lines.transliteration: jithai mileh vadi-aa-ee-aa sad  khusee-aa sad  chaa-o.
tin mukh  tikay niklahi jin man sachaa naa-o. the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with theMark of Grace.

lines.english: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words.||2||
lines.transliteration: karam milai taa paa-ee-ai naahee galee vaa-o d u-aa-o. ||2||

lines.english: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.
lines.transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaahi uth rakh ee-ahi naav salaar.

lines.english: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.
lines.transliteration: ik upaa-ay mangtay iknaa vaday d arvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਗਲੀ  ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is alluseless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: agai ga-i-aa jaanee-ai vin  naavai vaykaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਇਿਕ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਉਿਠ ਰਖੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ayrai dar aglaa kh ap kh ap chh ijai dayh.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ ਉਪਾਏ  ਮੰਗਤੇ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.
lines.transliteration: naav jinaa sultaan kh aan hod ay dith ay kh ayh.

lines.english: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (16-12) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak uthee chali-aa sabh  koorh ay tutay nayh. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਿਪ ਖਿਪ ਿਛਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;
lines.transliteration: sabh ras mith ay mani-ai sun i-ai saalon ay.
khat t ursee mukh  bolnaa maaran  naad  kee-ay. chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have beenmade from the Sound-current of the Naad.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਠੀ ਚਿਲਆ  ਸਿਭ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they aretasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chhat eeh amrit  bhaa-o ayk jaa ka-o nad ar karay-i. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor khaan aa kh usee kh u-aar.

lines.english: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jit khaaDhai tan peerh ee-ai man meh chaleh vikaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ  ਨਾਦ  ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.
lines.transliteration: rataa painan  man rat aa supayd ee sat  daan.

lines.punjabi: ਛਤੀਹ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The blackness of sin is erased by my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on theLord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.
lines.transliteration: neelee si-aahee kadaa karn ee pahiran  pair Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karam-band sant okh kaa Dh an joban t ayraa naam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਚਲਿਹ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor painan kh usee kh u-aar.

lines.english: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jit paiDh ai tan peerh ee-ai man meh chaleh vikaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.
lines.transliteration: ghorh ay paakh ar su-inay saakh at boojh an tayree vaat.

lines.english: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.
lines.transliteration: tarkas t eer kamaan  saaNg taygband  gun Dhaat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ  ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my socialstatus. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vaajaa nayjaa pat si-o pargat karam t ayraa mayree jaat . ||3||

lines.english: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor charh-n aa kh usee kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਚਲਿਹ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jit charh i-ai tan peerh ee-ai man meh chaleh vikaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. YourGlance of Grace is my family, Lord. pMnw 17
lines.transliteration: ghar mand ar khusee naam kee nad ar tayree parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ  ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.
lines.transliteration: hukam so-ee tuDh  bhaavsee hor aakh an bahut  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਿਛ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu poochh  na karay beechaar. ||4||

lines.english: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor sa-unaa kh usee kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਚਲਿਹ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind.||1||Pause||4||7|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (17-3) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jit sut ai tan peerh ee-ai man meh chaleh vikaar. ||1|| rahaa-o. ||4||7||

lines.english: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body purefragrant incense;
lines.transliteration: kungoo kee kaaN-i-aa ratnaa kee lalit aa agar vaas t an saas.
athsath  tirath kaa mukh  tikaa t it ghat mat  vigaas. with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

lines.punjabi: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਇਆ  ਰਤਨਾ  ਕੀ ਲਿਲਤਾ  ਅਗਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਤਿਨ  ਸਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ot mat ee salaahn aa sach naam gunt aas. ||1|| -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of th e True Name, the Treasure of Excellence.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਿਟਕਾ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਘਿਟ  ਮਿਤ ਿਵਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor mat hor hor.

lines.punjabi: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o vayr kamaa-ee-ai koorhai koorhaa jor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may bewelcomed by all the world;
lines.transliteration: pooj lagai peer aakhee-ai sabh  milai sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ  ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa-o sadaa-ay aapn aa hovai siDh  sumaar. you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers
jaa pat laykh ai naa pavai sabh aa pooj kh u-aar. ||2|| -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration isfalse. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o satgur thaapi-aa t in mayt na sakai ko-ay.

lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through theNaam, they are radiant and famous.
lines.transliteration: onaa andar naam niDh aan hai naamo pargat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਪਿਤ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naa-o poojee-ai naa-o mannee-ai akhand sad aa sach so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਥਾਿਪਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?
lines.transliteration: khayhoo kh ayh ralaa-ee-ai t aa jee-o kayhaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.
lines.transliteration: jalee-aa sabh si-aan paa uth ee chali-aa ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਪੂਜੀਐ  ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court ofthe Lord? ||4||8|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (17-9) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam visaari-ai dar ga-i-aa ki-aa ho-ay. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ  ਤਾ ਜੀਉ  ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee gun  veethrai a-ugun vantee jhoor.

lines.english: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met byfalsehood.
lines.transliteration: jay lorheh var kaamn ee nah milee-ai pir koor.

lines.english: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa bayrhee naa t ulharh aa naa paa-ee-ai pir d oor. ||1||

lines.english: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur poorai t akhat adol.

lines.english: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pooraa jay karay paa-ee-ai saach at ol. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਨਹ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਿਪਰ ਕੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful. Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearlsand flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 1) parabh harmandar sohn aa tis meh maan ak laal. mot ee heeraa nirmalaa kanchan kot reesaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ  ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਪਰੁ ਦੂਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord,through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin pa-orhee garh  ki-o charh a-o gur har Dh i-aan nihaal. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me tothe Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur pa-orhee bayrh ee guroo gur t ulhaa har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the SacredShrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.
lines.transliteration: gur sar saagar bohitho gur tirath d aree-aa-o.

lines.english: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay tis bh aavai oojlee sat  sar naavan  jaa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਿਰਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਮਾਣਕ  ਲਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.
lines.transliteration: pooro pooro aakhee-ai poorai t akhat nivaas.

lines.english: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Plac e. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.
lines.transliteration: poorai thaan suhaavnai poorai aas niraas.

lines.english: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (17-16) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pooraa jay milai ki-o ghaatai gun  taas. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ  ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.
lines.transliteration: aavhu bhain ay gal milah ank sahaylrh ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਿਹਥੋ  ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਦਰੀਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil kai karah kahaanee-aa samrath kant  kee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਵਣ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saachay saahib sabh gun  a-ugan  sabh  asaah. ||1||

lines.english: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.
lines.transliteration: kartaa sabh  ko tayrai jor.

lines.english: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad beechaaree-ai jaa t oo taa ki-aa hor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਕਉ  ਘਾਟੈ  ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, "By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy yourHusband Lord?"
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay puchhahu sohaagan ee tusee raavi-aa kinee gun ee.

lines.english: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.
lines.transliteration: sahj santokh  seegaaree-aa mith aa boln ee.

lines.english: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad."||2|| pMnw 18
lines.transliteration: pir reesaaloo taa milai jaa gur kaa sabad  sunee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰੀਸਾਲੂ  ਤਾ ਿਮਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.
lines.transliteration: kaytee-aa t ayree-aa kud ratee kayvad t ayree d aat.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੀਆ  ਤੇਰੀਆ  ਕੁਦਰਤੀ  ਕੇਵਡ  ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.
lines.transliteration: kaytay t ayray jee-a jant  sifat karahi d in raat .

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaytay t ayray roop rang kayt ay jaat  ajaat . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਿਤ  ਅਜਾਿਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach milai sach oopjai sach meh saach samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through theGuru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: surat hovai pat  oogvai gurbachnee bh a-o kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪਿਤ ਊਗਵੈ  ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ  ਭਉ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (18-4) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu aapay la-ay milaa-ay. ||4||10||

lines.english: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.
lines.transliteration: bhalee saree je ubree ha-umai mu-ee gh araahu.

lines.english: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: doot lagay fir chaakree sat gur kaa vaysaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਿਜ ਉਬਰੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kalap ti-aagee baad  hai sachaa vayparvaahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.
lines.transliteration: man ray sach milai bha-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, andimmerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhai bin nirbh a-o ki-o thee-ai gurmukh  sabad  samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.
lines.transliteration: kaytaa aakh an aakh ee-ai aakh an tot na ho-ay.

lines.english: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.
lines.transliteration: mangan vaalay kayt -rhay daataa ayko so-ay.

lines.english: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells withinthe mind, there is peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis kay jee-a paraan hai man vasi-ai sukh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤਾ  ਆਖਣੁ  ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਿਣ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.
lines.transliteration: jag supnaa baajee banee khin meh kh ayl kh aylaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਗਣ  ਵਾਲੇ  ਕੇਤੜੇ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.
lines.transliteration: sanjogee mil ayksay vijogee uth jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰਾਣ  ਹੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aanaa so thee-ai avar na karn aa jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਬਨੀ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vasat  vaysaahee-ai sach vakh ar sach raas.

lines.english: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.
lines.transliteration: jinee sach vanan ji-aa gur pooray saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize theGenuine Article. ||4||11|| isrIrwgu mhlu 1 ] (18-11) sireeraag mahal 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vasat pachh aansee sach sa-ud aa jis paas. ||4||11||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaat  milai fun Dh aat ka-o sift ee sifat  samaa-ay. As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbedinto the Praiseworthy Lord.
Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.
lines.transliteration: laal gulaal gahbaraa sachaa rang charhaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਛਾਣਸੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet theTrue Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach milai santokh ee-aa har jap aykai bh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray sant  janaa kee rayn .

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa gur paa-ee-ai mukat  padaarath Dh ayn. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੁ  ਗੁਲਾਲੁ  ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: oocha-o thaan suhaavanaa oopar mahal muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves whichleads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.
lines.transliteration: sach karnee d ay paa-ee-ai d ar ghar mahal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man samjaa-ee-ai aat am raam beechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety areproduced.
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  karam kamaa-ee-ahi aas and aysaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Throughintuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.
lines.transliteration: ki-o gur bin tarikutee chh utsee sahj mili-ai sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਉ  ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ  ਊਪਿਰ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestowsHis Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal pachh aanee-ai nad ar karay mal Dh o-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ  ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there beany homecoming?
lines.transliteration: bin gur mail na utrai bin har ki-o gh ar vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.
lines.transliteration: ayko sabad veechaaree-ai avar t i-aagai aas.

lines.english: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (18-18) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daykh  dikhaa-ee-ai ha-o sad  balihaarai jaas. ||4||12||

lines.english: Dharig jeevan  duhaagan ee muth ee doojai bh aa-ay. The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks downaltogether.
lines.transliteration: kalar kayree kanDh ji-o ahinis kir dh eh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਉ  ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai sukh  naa thee-ai pir bin d ookh na jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations? pMnw 19
lines.transliteration: munDhay pir bin ki-aa seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ  ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dar gh ar dho-ee na lahai d argeh jh ooth khu-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aap sujaan na bh ul-ee sachaa vad kirsaan .

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਭੁਲਈ  ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਿਕਰਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa Dhart ee saaDh  kai sach naam d ay daan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਾਿਧ  ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtainHis Banner and Insignia. ||2||
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh upjai naam ayk karam pavai neesaan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the useof their lives?
lines.transliteration: gur ka-o jaan na jaan -ee ki-aa t is chaj achaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਿਣ  ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਿਕਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhsare in utter darkness.
lines.transliteration: anDhulai naam visaari-aa manmukh  anDh  gubaar.

lines.english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, theyare wasting away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  na chuk-ee mar janmai ho-ay kh u-aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantitiesto her hair;
lines.transliteration: chandan mol an aa-i-aa kungoo maaNg sanDh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਿਲ ਅਣਾਇਆ  ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਗ  ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: cho-aa chandan baho gh anaa paanaa naal kapoor. she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

lines.punjabi: ਚੋਆ  ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ  ਪਾਨਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jay Dhan kant  na bh aav-ee t a sabh  adambar koorh . ||4|| but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਿਤ  ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਤ ਸਿਭ ਅਡੰਬਰ  ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.
lines.transliteration: sabh ras bh ogan baad  heh sabh  seegaar vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ  ਬਾਿਦ ਹਿਹ ਸਿਭ ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful atGuru's Gate?
lines.transliteration: jab lag sabad na bh aydee-ai ki-o sohai gurd u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord.||5||13|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (19-7) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan suhaagan ee jin sah naal pi-aar. ||5||13||

lines.english: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.
lines.transliteration: sunjee d ayh daraavan ee jaa jee-o vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.english: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longeremerges.
lines.transliteration: bhaahi baland ee vijh vee Dh oo-o na niksi-o kaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ  ਜਾ ਜੀਉ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through thelove of duality. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panchay runnay dukh  bharay binsay d oojai bh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.
lines.transliteration: moorhay raam japahu gun  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਿਖ ਭਰੇ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa mohn ee sabh  muth ee ahaNkaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs ofduality.
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa doojee kaarai lag.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa laagay pach mu-ay ant ar tarisnaa ag.

lines.english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plunderedby deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray hor muth ee Dh anDhai thag. ||2||

lines.english: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.
lines.transliteration: mu-ee pareet pi-aar ga-i-aa mu-aa vair viroDh .

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa thakaa ha-o mu-ee mamt aa maa-i-aa kroDh . Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessivenessand anger.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹੋਿਰ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਿਗ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever inbalanced restraint. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam milai sach paa-ee-ai gurmukh sad aa niroDh . ||3||

lines.english: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.
lines.transliteration: sachee kaarai sach milai gurmat palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go inreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: so nar jammai naa marai naa aavai naa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰੋਧੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Courtof the Lord. ||4||14|| isrIrwgu mhl 1 ] (19-13) sireeraag mahal 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dar parDh aan so d argahi paiDh aa jaa-ay. ||4||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.
lines.transliteration: tan jal bal maatee bh a-i-aa man maa-i-aa mohi manoor.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.
lines.transliteration: a-ugan fir laagoo bh a-ay koor vajaavai t oor.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਿਰ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through thelove of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai bh armaa-ee-ai d ubiDh aa dobay poor. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man ray sabad t arahu chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਜਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਮਾਟੀ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, andcontinue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh naam na boojh i-aa mar janmai aavai jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗਣ  ਿਫਿਰ ਲਾਗੂ  ਭਏ ਕੂਿਰ ਵਜਾਵੈ  ਤੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.
lines.transliteration: tan soochaa so aakh ee-ai jis meh saachaa naa-o.

lines.english: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,
lines.transliteration: bhai sach raat ee dayhuree jihvaa sach su-aa-o.
sachee nadar nihaalee-ai bahurh  na paavai t aa-o. ||2|| is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not haveto go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਿਝਆ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.
lines.transliteration: saachay tay pavnaa bh a-i-aa pavnai t ay jal ho-ay.

lines.english: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused HisLight.
lines.transliteration: jal tay t aribhavan saaji-aa gh at ghat jot samo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor isobtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirmal mailaa naa thee-ai sabad rat ay pat  ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੀ  ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance ofGrace. pMnw 20
lines.transliteration: ih man saach santokh i-aa nad ar karay t is maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਿਚ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.
lines.transliteration: panch bhoot  sach bh ai ratay jot  sachee man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਉਗਣ  ਵੀਸਰੇ  ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਿਤ ਤਾਿਹ  ॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (20-2) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak a-ugan veesray gur raakh ay pat  taahi. ||4||15||

lines.english: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak bayrhee sach kee t aree-ai gur veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.
lines.transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaavhee poor bharay ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਇਿਕ  ਜਾਵਹੀ  ਪੂਿਰ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukhand truthful is saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manhath mat ee boodee-ai gurmukh  sach so t aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?
lines.transliteration: gur bin ki-o taree-ai sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  too mai avar na d oojaa ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.
lines.transliteration: aagai daykh -a-u da-o jalai paachh ai hari-o angoor.

lines.english: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading eachand every heart.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upjai t is tay binsai gh at ghat sach bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ  ਦੇਖਉ  ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਿਰਓ  ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaavahee saachai mahal hadoor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ  ਿਤਸ ਤੇ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.
lines.transliteration: saahi saahi tujh  sammlaa kad ay na vaysaara-o.

lines.english: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinksin the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o saahab man vasai gurmukh amrit  pay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹ  ਸਾਿਹ  ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਵਸਾਰੇਉ  ॥
lines.english: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let memerge with You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man tan t ayraa t oo Dh anee garab nivaar samay-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਜਉ  ਸਾਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੇਉ ॥
lines.english: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: jin ayhu jagat upaa-i-aa t aribhavan kar aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਸਮੇਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropesaround in the darkness.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chaanan  jaanee-ai manmukh  mugaDh  gubaar.

lines.english: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of theGuru's Teachings. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at jot nirant ree boojh ai gurmat  saar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinee jaan i-aa tin keechai saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਨਰੰਤਰੀ  ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.
lines.transliteration: sachay saytee ral milay sachay gun  pargaas.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer theirbodies and souls to God. ||5||16|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (20-10) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam santokh ee-aa jee-o pind parabh  paas. ||5||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਲ ਿਮਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sun man mit ar pi-aari-aa mil vaylaa hai ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.english: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.
lines.transliteration: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag ih t an dayh.

lines.english: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavee dh eh dh ayree t an kh ayh. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.
lines.transliteration: mayray man lai laahaa ghar jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam salaahee-ai ha-umai nivree bh aahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਢਿਹ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads ofknowledge,
lines.transliteration: sun sun  gandh an gandh ee-ai likh  parh bujheh bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa ahinis aglee ha-umai rog vikaar. but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

lines.english: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through theWisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oh vayparvaahu atolvaa gurmat  keemat  saar. ||2||

lines.english: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love andcompany of hundreds of thousands of people
lines.transliteration: lakh si-aan ap jay karee lakh  si-o pareet  milaap.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਗੰਢਣੁ  ਗੰਢੀਐ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਿੜ ਬੁਝਿਹ  ਭਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sangat saaDh  na Dh araapee-aa bin naavai d ookh santaap. -still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied.Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh,you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har jap jee-aray chhutee-ai gurmukh  cheenai aap. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head aswell.
lines.transliteration: tan man gur peh vaychi-aa man d ee-aa sir naal.

lines.english: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh,I sought and found Him.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan khoj dhandholi-aa gurmukh  khoj nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੀਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (20-17) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur mayl milaa-i-aa naanak so parabh  naal. ||4||17||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਅਰੇ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.
lines.transliteration: marnai kee chint aa nahee jeevan  kee nahee aas.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਵੇਿਚਆ  ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morselsof food.
lines.transliteration: too sarab jee-aa part ipaalahee laykh ai saas giraas.

lines.english: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar gurmukh  too vaseh ji-o bh aavai t i-o nirjaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੪॥੧੭॥
lines.english: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.
lines.transliteration: jee-aray raam japat man maan.

lines.english: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 21
lines.transliteration: antar laagee jal bujh ee paa-i-aa gurmukh  gi-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.
lines.transliteration: antar kee gat  jaanee-ai gur milee-ai sank ut aar.

lines.english: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are stillalive.
lines.transliteration: mu-i-aa jit gh ar jaa-ee-ai t it jeevd i-aa mar maar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  suhaavan ay paa-ee-ai gur veechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਇਆ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਜੀਵਿਦਆ  ਮਰੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.
lines.transliteration: anhad ban ee paa-ee-ai t ah ha-umai ho-ay binaas.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ  ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay aapn aa ha-o sad  kurbaan ai taas.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ  ਹੋਇ ਿਬਨਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord ison their lips. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kharh  dargeh painaa-ee-ai mukh  har naam nivaas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ  ਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, ofconsciousness and matter.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah rav rahay siv sakt ee kaa mayl.

lines.punjabi: ਖਿੜ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਨਾਈਐ  ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subjectto their play.
lines.transliteration: tarihu gun  banDh ee dayhuree jo aa-i-aa jag so kh ayl.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਿਸਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willedmanmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: vijogee dukh  vichh urhay manmukh  laheh na mayl. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ  ਜਿਗ  ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
lines.english: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own truehome, imbued with the Fear of God,
lines.transliteration: man bairaagee ghar vasai sach bh ai raat aa ho-ay.
gi-aan mahaaras bhogvai baahurh  bhookh na ho-ay. then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (21-7) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ih man maar mil bhee fir d ukh na ho-ay. ||5||18||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਮਹਾਰਸੁ  ਭੋਗਵੈ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.
lines.transliteration: ayhu mano moorakh lobh ee-aa lobh ay lagaa lobh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਮਲੁ ਭੀ ਿਫਿਰ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; theycome and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: sabad na bh eejai saakt aa durmat  aavan jaan.

lines.english: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sat gur jay milai t aa paa-ee-ai gun ee niDh aan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ  ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ  ਲਭਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: man ray ha-umai chhod gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court ofthe Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har gur sarvar sayv too paavahi d argeh maan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealthof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap dinas raat  gurmukh  har Dh an jaan.
