lines.english: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  har ras bh ognay sant  sabh aa mil gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam.||2||
lines.transliteration: nit ahinis har parabh  sayvi-aa sat gur dee-aa naam. ||2||

lines.english: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in theirown fire.
lines.transliteration: kookar koorh kamaa-ee-ai gur nind aa pachai pachaan.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. TheMessenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa d ukh ghano jam maar karai kh ulhaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ  ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh sukh  na paa-ee-ai gurmukh  sukh  subh aan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਿਤ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, onlythe account of your true actions is accepted.
lines.transliteration: aithai DhanDh  pitaa-ee-ai sach likh at parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਕਰ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremelyexalted.
lines.transliteration: har sajan gur sayvd aa gur karn ee parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੇ  ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless youwith His Mark of Grace. ||4||19|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (21-14) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai karam sachai neesaan. ||4||19||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.
lines.transliteration: ik til pi-aaraa veesrai rog vadaa man maahi.

lines.english: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?
lines.transliteration: ki-o dargeh pat  paa-ee-ai jaa har na vasai man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ  ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises.||1||
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai sukh paa-ee-ai agan marai gun  maahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੧੯॥
lines.english: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: man ray ahinis har gun saar.

lines.english: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is sucha person in this world! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin khin pal naam na veesrai t ay jan virlay sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਿਪਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joinedwith the Intuitive Consciousness,
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milaa-ee-ai surt ee surat  sanjog.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: hinsaa ha-umai gat ga-ay naahee sahsaa sog. then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorroware taken away.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jis har man vasai t is maylay gur sanjog. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kaaman jay karee bh ogay bh oganhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.
lines.transliteration: tis si-o nayhu na keej-ee jo d eesai chalan haar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3|| pMnw 22
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raveh sohaagan ee so parabh  sayj bh ataar. ||3||

lines.english: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: chaaray agan nivaar mar gurmukh har jal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਿਨ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਮਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: antar kamal pargaasi-aa amrit  bhari-aa agh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸਆ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਅਘਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain theTrue Lord. ||4||20|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (22-3) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur meet  kar sach paavahi d argeh jaa-ay. ||4||20||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਿਰ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speakof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har japahu pi-aari-aa gurmat lay har bol.

lines.english: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.
lines.transliteration: man sach kasvatee laa-ee-ai tulee-ai poorai t ol.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਹੁ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: keemat kinai na paa-ee-ai rid  maan ak mol amol. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ  ਲਾਈਐ ਤੁਲੀਐ  ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray har heeraa gur maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਰਦ ਮਾਣਕ  ਮੋਿਲ ਅਮੋਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night,praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  satgur paa-ee-ai ahinis sabad  salaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹੀਰਾ  ਗੁਰ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light ofthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: sach vakhar Dh an raas lai paa-ee-ai gur pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of theLord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: ji-o agan marai jal paa-i-ai ti-o t arisnaa d aasan d aas.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over theterrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jam jandaar na lag-ee i-o bh a-ojal t arai taraas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love onlyTruth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh koorh  na bh aav-ee sach rat ay sach bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਰੈ ਜਿਲ  ਪਾਇਐ  ਿਤਉ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.
lines.transliteration: saakat sach na bh aav-ee koorhai koorh ee paaN-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਇਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into theTrue Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sach ratay gur mayli-ai sachay sach samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures anddiamonds.
lines.transliteration: man meh maanak laal naam rat an pad aarath heer.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presenceis deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: sach vakhar Dh an naam hai gh at ghat gahir gambh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਿਲਐ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness andCompassion. ||4||21|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (22-10) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paa-ee-ai d a-i-aa karay har heer. ||4||21||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands andcountries.
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh aahi na vijh vai jay bh avai disant ar days.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.
lines.transliteration: antar mail na ut rai Dh arig jeevan  Dharig vays.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
lines.english: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hor kitai bh agat na hova-ee bin sat gur kay upd ays. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.
lines.transliteration: man ray gurmukh agan nivaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੇ  ਭਾਿਹ  ਨ ਿਵਝਵੈ  ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਿਦਸੰਤਰ  ਦੇਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa kahi-aa man vasai ha-umai tarisnaa maar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.
lines.transliteration: man maanak nirmol hai raam naam pat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁ ਿਕਤੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukhembraces love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  har paa-ee-ai gurmukh  har liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, youshall merge in absorption. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap ga-i-aa sukh paa-i-aa mil sallai salal samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਿਹਆ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy;they come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: jin har har naam na chayti-o so a-ogun  aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered andbewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jis satgur purakh  na bh ayti-o so bh a-ojal pachai pachaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਿਨਰਮੋਲੁ  ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and ye t it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih maanak jee-o nirmol hai i-o ka-udee bad lai jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.
lines.transliteration: jinna satgur ras milai say pooray purakh  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਲਲੈ  ਸਲਲ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of theLord, they are honored and approved.
lines.transliteration: gur mil bha-ojal langh ee-ai d argeh pat  parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਿਣ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells upwithin them. ||4||22|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (22-17) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay mukh  ujlay Dh un upjai sabad  neesaan . ||4||22||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਸੁ ਭਉਜਿਲ  ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.
lines.transliteration: vanaj karahu van jaariho vakh ar layho samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਨਰਮੋਲੁ  ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ  ਬਦਲੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Buy that object which will go along with you.
lines.transliteration: taisee vasat  visaahee-ai jaisee nibhai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜੰਨਾ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਸ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ  ਸੁਜਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: agai saahu sujaan hai laisee vasat  samaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray raam kahhu chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 23
lines.transliteration: har jas vakhar lai chalhu saho d aykhai pat ee-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?
lines.transliteration: jinaa raas na sach hai ki-o tinaa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.
lines.transliteration: khotai van aj van anji-ai man t an kh otaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਿਕਉ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: faahee faathay mirag ji-o dookh  ghano nit ro-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਿਜ  ਵਣੰਿਜਐ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the BlessedVision of the Lord-Guru.
lines.transliteration: khotay pot ai naa paveh t in har gur d aras na ho-ay.

lines.english: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.
lines.transliteration: khotay jaat  na pat  hai kh ot na seejh as ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeittheir honor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khotay kh ot kamaavan aa aa-ay ga-i-aa pat  kho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਪਿਤ ਹੈ ਖੋਿਟ ਨ ਸੀਝਿਸ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise theLord.
lines.transliteration: naanak man samjaa-ee-ai gur kai sabad saalaah.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਆਇ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.
lines.transliteration: raam naam rang rati-aa bh aar na bh aram t inaah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਾਲਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abideswithin their minds. ||4||23|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 2 ] (23-5) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 2. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: har jap laahaa aglaa nirbha-o har man maah. ||4||23||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਿਤਆ  ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ  ਿਤਨਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan joban ar fulrh aa naath ee-arh ay din chaar. Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਲਾਹਾ  ਅਗਲਾ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਹਿਰ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paban kayray pat  ji-o dh al dhul jumman haar. ||1||

lines.english: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.
lines.transliteration: rang maan lai pi-aari-aa jaa joban na-o hulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ  ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ  ਿਦਨ  ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: din thorh -rhay thakay bh a-i-aa puraan aa cholaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਬਿਣ  ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਿਜਉ ਢਿਲ  ਢੁਿਲ  ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.
lines.transliteration: sajan mayray rangulay jaa-ay sut ay jaaraan .

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਿਣ  ਲੈ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
lines.english: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||
lines.transliteration: haN bhee vanj aa dumn ee rovaa jh eenee baan . ||2||

lines.english: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?
lines.transliteration: kee na sunayhee goree-ay aapan  kannee so-ay.

lines.english: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||
lines.transliteration: lagee aavahi saahurai nit na pay-ee-aa ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣ  ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ  ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.
lines.transliteration: naanak sutee pay-ee-ai jaan  virtee sann.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ  ਬਾਿਣ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru dUjw 2 ] (23-10) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar d oojaa 2. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: gunaa gavaa-ee ganth -rhee avgan  chalee bann. ||4||24||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ  ਗੋਰੀਏ  ਆਪਣ  ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is theRavisher of all.
lines.transliteration: aapay rasee-aa aap ras aapay ravanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਗੀ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਿਨਤ  ਨ ਪੇਈਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay hovai cholrhaa aapay sayj bh ataar. ||1||

lines.english: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rang rataa mayraa saahib rav rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਾ  ਗਵਾਈ  ਗੰਠੜੀ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਚਲੀ  ਬੰਿਨ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
lines.english: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.
lines.transliteration: aapay maachhee machh ulee aapay paan ee jaal.

lines.english: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay jaal mankarh aa aapay and ar laal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ  ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: aapay baho biDh rangulaa sakh ee-ay mayraa laal.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||
lines.transliteration: nit ravai sohaagan ee daykh hamaaraa haal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.
lines.transliteration: paranvai naanak baynt ee too sarvar t oo hans.

lines.english: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. YouYourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 3 ] (23-15) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 3. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: ka-ul too hai kavee-aa t oo hai aapay vaykh  vigas. ||4||25||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਛੀ  ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Nameof the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.
lines.transliteration: ih tan Dh artee beej karmaa karo salil aapaa-o saaringpaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਲ  ਮਣਕੜਾ  ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਲਾਲੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attainthe state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man kirsaan har rid ai jammaa-ay lai i-o paavas pad  nirbaan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਰੰਗੁਲਾ  ਸਖੀਏ  ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?
lines.transliteration: kaahay garbas moorhay maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Father, children, spouse, mother and all rela tives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pit sut o sagal kaalt ar maat aa tayray hohi na ant  sakhaa-i-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵੈ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
lines.english: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soulmeditate on God.
lines.transliteration: bikhai bikaar d usat kirkh aa karay in t aj aat mai ho-ay Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਲੁ  ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ  ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਸੁ  ॥੪॥੨੫॥
lines.english: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, thenthe lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam hohi jab raakh ay kamal bigsai maDh  aasarmaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout thethree stages of life, remember death.
lines.transliteration: bees saptaahro baasro sangrahai t een kh orhaa nit  kaal saarai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ  ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਕਰੋ ਸਿਲਲ  ਆਪਾਉ  ਸਾਿਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak,in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26|| pMnw 24 isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 3 ] (24-1) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 3. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: das ath aar mai aprampro cheenai kahai naanak iv ayk t aarai. ||3||26||

lines.english: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.
lines.transliteration: amal kar Dhart ee beej sabd o kar sach kee aab nit  deh paan ee.

lines.english: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay kirsaan eemaan jammaa-ay lai bh isat dojak moorh ay ayv jaan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਲੁ  ਕਿਰ ਧਰਤੀ  ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ  ਕਿਰ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ  ਿਨਤ ਦੇਿਹ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.
lines.transliteration: mat jaan  seh galee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰਸਾਣੁ  ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ  ਲੈ ਿਭਸਤੁ  ਦੋਜਕੁ  ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maal kai maanai roop kee sobh aa it biDhee janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog,which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.
lines.transliteration: aib tan chikrh o ih man meedko kamal kee saar nahee mool paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਲ  ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਿਬਧੀ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can oneunderstand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||
lines.transliteration: bha-ur ust aad nit bhaakhi-aa bolay ki-o boojh ai jaa nah bujh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds arecolored by the love of Maya.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  sunn aa pa-un  kee ban ee ih man rat aa maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਐਬ ਤਿਨ ਿਚਕੜੋ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਿਲ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. Theyare pleasing to His Heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khasam kee nad ar dilahi pasind ay jinee kar ayk Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ  ਿਨਤ  ਭਾਿਖਆ  ਬੋਲੇ ਿਕਉ  ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' canundo them.
lines.transliteration: teeh kar rakh ay panj kar saathee naa-o sait aan mat  kat jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਣੁ  ਸੁਨਣਾ  ਪਉਣ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 4 ] (24-7) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 4. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai raahi pai chaln aa maal Dh an kit  koo sanji-aahee. ||4||27||

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮ  ਕੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਦਲਿਹ  ਪਿਸੰਦੇ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਕਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossomforth, fresh and green.
lines.transliteration: so-ee ma-ulaa jin jag ma-oli-aa hari-aa kee-aa sansaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਹ ਕਿਰ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਥੀ  ਨਾਉ  ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਿਟ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||
lines.transliteration: aab khaak jin banDh  rahaa-ee Dh an sirjan haaro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਖੈ  ਰਾਿਹ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ  ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਿਕਤ  ਕੂ ਸੰਿਜਆਹੀ  ॥੪॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Death, O Mullah-death will come,
lines.transliteration: marnaa mulaa marn aa.
bhee kart aarahu darn aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ  ਿਜਿਨ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name ofGod.
lines.transliteration: taa too mulaa t aa too kaajee jaan eh naam kh udaa-ee.

lines.english: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full.||2||
lines.transliteration: jay bahutayraa parh i-aa hoveh ko rahai na bh aree-ai paa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Namehis Support.
lines.transliteration: so-ee kaajee jin aap taji-aa ik naam kee-aa aaDh aaro.

lines.english: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaa-ay na jaasee sachaa sirjan haaro. ||3||

lines.english: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.
lines.transliteration: panj vakhat  nivaaj gujaareh parh eh kat ayb kuraan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ  ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished.||4||28|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 4 ] (24-12) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 4. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai gor sad ay-ee rahi-o peen aa kh aanaa. ||4||28||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪਿੜਆ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The dogs of greed are with me.
lines.transliteration: ayk su-aan du-ay su-aanee naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਪੁ  ਤਿਜਆ  ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.
lines.transliteration: bhalkay bh a-ukahi sad aa ba-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਜਾਸੀ  ਸਚਾ ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.
lines.transliteration: koorh chh uraa muth aa murd aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ  ਿਨਵਾਜ  ਗੁਜਾਰਿਹ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaan ak roop rahaa kart aar. ||1|| I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਖੈ  ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਪੀਣਾ  ਖਾਣਾ  ॥੪॥੨੮॥
lines.english: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.
lines.transliteration: mai pat kee pand  na karn ee kee kaar.

lines.english: I am deformed and horribly disfigured.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bigrhai roop rahaa bikraal.

lines.english: Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.
lines.transliteration: tayraa ayk naam t aaray sansaar.

lines.english: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai ayhaa aas ayho aaDhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.
lines.transliteration: mukh nind aa aakh aa din raat .

lines.english: I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!
lines.transliteration: par ghar johee neech sanaat .

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਪਿਤ ਕੀ ਪੰਿਦ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ  ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh t an vaseh chandaal.

lines.english: Dhaan ak roop rahaa kart aar. ||2|| I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||
I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.
lines.transliteration: faahee surat malookee vays.

lines.english: I am a robber-I rob the world.
lines.transliteration: ha-o thagvaarh aa thagee d ays.

lines.english: I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.
lines.transliteration: kharaa si-aan aa bahut aa bh aar.

lines.english: Dhaan ak roop rahaa kart aar. ||3|| I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||
I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.
lines.transliteration: mai keetaa na jaat aa haraamkh or.

lines.english: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ki-aa muhu daysaa d usat chor.

lines.english: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
lines.transliteration: naanak neech kahai beechaar.

lines.english: Dhaan ak roop rahaa kart aar. ||4||29|| I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 4 ] (24-19) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 4. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
There is one awareness among all created beings.
lines.transliteration: aykaa surat jayt ay hai jee-a.

lines.english: None have been created without this awareness. pMnw 25
lines.transliteration: surat vihoon aa ko-ay na kee-a.

lines.english: As is their awareness, so is their way.
lines.transliteration: jayhee surat t ayhaa t in raahu.

lines.english: According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: laykhaa iko aavhu jaahu. ||1||

lines.english: Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?
lines.transliteration: kaahay jee-a karahi chaturaa-ee.

lines.english: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: layvai dayvai dh il na paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,
lines.transliteration: tayray jee-a jee-aa kaa t ohi.
kit ka-o saahib aavahi rohi. how can You become angry with them?

lines.english: Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,
lines.transliteration: jay too saahib aavahi rohi.
too onaa kaa t ayray ohi. ||2|| still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||

lines.english: We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.
lines.transliteration: asee bolvigaarh vigaarh ah bol.

lines.english: You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: too nad ree and ar toleh t ol.

lines.english: When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.
lines.transliteration: jah karnee t ah pooree mat .

lines.english: Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karnee baajh ahu gh atay gh at. ||3||

lines.english: Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak gi-aanee kaisaa ho-ay.

lines.english: They are self-realized; they understand God.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai boojh ai so-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad karay beechaar.

lines.english: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
lines.transliteration: so gi-aanee dargeh parvaan . ||4||30|| such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 4 ] (25-5) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 4.

lines.english: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?
lines.transliteration: too daree-aa-o d aanaa beenaa mai machh ulee kaisay ant  lahaa.

lines.english: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah tah too hai t ujh tay niksee foot maraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
lines.english: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.
lines.transliteration: na jaanaa may-o na jaan aa jaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਿਨਕਸੀ  ਫੂਿਟ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa dukh  laagai t aa tujhai samaalee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਮੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਜਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.
lines.transliteration: too bh arpoor jaani-aa mai d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.
lines.transliteration: jo kachh karee so t ayrai had oor.

lines.english: You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.
lines.transliteration: too daykheh ha-o mukar paa-o.

lines.english: I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayrai kamm na t ayrai naa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa d eh taytaa ha-o kh aa-o.

lines.english: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?
lines.transliteration: bi-aa dar naahee kai d ar jaa-o.

lines.english: Nanak offers this one prayer:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayk kahai ardaas.
jee-o pind sabh t ayrai paas. ||3|| this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.
lines.transliteration: aapay nayrhai d oor aapay hee aapay manjh  mi-aano.

lines.english: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai sun ay aapay hee kud rat karay jahaano.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 4 ] (25-11) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 4. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai naankaa hukam so-ee parvaano. ||4||31||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਪੇ  ਮੰਿਝ ਿਮਆਨ ॥
lines.english: Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?
lines.transliteration: keetaa kahaa karay man maan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
lines.english: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: dayvan haaray kai hath d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
lines.english: As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.
lines.transliteration: bhaavai d ay-ay na d ay-ee so-ay.

lines.english: What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||
lines.transliteration: keetay kai kahi-ai ki-aa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.
lines.transliteration: aapay sach bhaavai t is sach.

lines.english: The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anDhaa kachaa kach nikach. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden
lines.transliteration: jaa kay rukh birakh  aaraa-o.
jayhee Dhaat  tayhaa t in naa-o. -according to their nature, He gives them all their names.

lines.english: The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: ful bhaa-o fal likh i-aa paa-ay.

lines.english: As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap beej aapay hee khaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.
lines.transliteration: kachee kanDh kachaa vich raaj.

lines.english: The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.
lines.transliteration: mat aloon ee fikaa saad .

lines.english: O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.
lines.transliteration: naanak aanay aavai raas.

lines.english: Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 5 ] (25-16) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 5. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fifth House:
lines.transliteration: vin naavai naahee saabaas. ||3||32||

lines.english: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.
lines.transliteration: achhal chh alaa-ee nah chh alai nah gh aa-o kataaraa kar sakai.

lines.english: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o saahib raakhai t i-o rahai is lobh ee kaa jee-o tal palai. ||1||

lines.english: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin tayl d eevaa ki-o jalai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil, and let the Fear of God be the wick forthe lamp of this body.
lines.transliteration: pothee puraan kamaa-ee-ai. bh a-o vatee it  tan paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach boojhan  aan jalaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Use this oil to light this lamp.
lines.transliteration: ih tayl d eevaa i-o jalai.

lines.english: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar chaanan saahib t a-o milai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਛਲ  ਛਲਾਈ  ਨਹ ਛਲੈ ਨਹ ਘਾਉ  ਕਟਾਰਾ  ਕਿਰ ਸਕੈ ॥
lines.english: This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;
lines.transliteration: it tan laagai baan ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਰਾਖੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ  ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sukh hovai sayv kamaan ee-aa. you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service). pMnw 26

lines.english: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh d unee-aa aavan  jaanee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: In the midst of this world, do seva,
lines.transliteration: vich dunee-aa sayv kamaa-ee-ai.
taa dargeh baisan  paa-ee-ai. and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.english: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 Gru 1  (26-3) sireeraag mehlaa 3 ghar 1 Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (26-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak baah ludaa-ee-ai. ||4||33||

lines.english: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus myconsciousness on Him.
lines.transliteration: ha-o satgur sayvee aapn aa ik man ik chit  bhaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those untowhom He has given this understanding.
lines.transliteration: satgur man kaamnaa t irath hai jis no d ay-ay bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਇਕ ਿਚਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.
lines.transliteration: man chindi-aa var paavn aa jo ichh ai so fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ  ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa-o Dhi-aa-ee-ai naa-o mangee-ai naamay sahj samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ  ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall bequenched.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har ras chaakh t ikh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਨਾਉ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jinee gurmukh chaakh i-aa sehjay rahay samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਿਤਖ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jinee satgur sayvi-aa t inee paa-i-aa naam niDh aan.

lines.english: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical prideof the mind is subdued.
lines.transliteration: antar har ras rav rahi-aa chookaa man abh imaan.

lines.english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.
lines.transliteration: hirdai kamal pargaasi-aa laagaa sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored inHis Court. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal har rav rahi-aa paa-i-aa dargahi maan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਮਿਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan aapn aa tay virlay sansaar.

lines.english: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa maar kai har raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin kai balihaarn ai jinaa naamay lagaa pi-aar.

lines.english: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happythroughout the four ages. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say-ee sukhee-ay chahu jugee jinaa naam akh ut apaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachmentdeparts.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai naam paa-ee-ai chookai moh pi-aas.

lines.english: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home ofthe heart.
lines.transliteration: har saytee man rav rahi-aa gh ar hee maahi ud aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinaa har kaa saad aa-i-aa ha-o t in balihaarai jaas.

lines.english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, isobtained. ||4||1||34|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (26-13) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai sach naam gunt aas. ||4||1||34||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਉਦਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.
lines.transliteration: baho bhaykh  kar bh armaa-ee-ai man hird ai kapat kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink intomanure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kaa mahal na paav-ee mar vistaa maahi samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
lines.english: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.
lines.transliteration: man ray garih hee maahi udaas.

lines.english: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam karnee so karay gurmukh  ho-ay pargaas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਿਰ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਿਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains theState of Liberation in one's own home.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man jeet i-aa gat  mukat  gharai meh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵਈ  ਮਿਰ ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the TrueCongregation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai sat sangat  mayl milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the ninecontinents of the world.
lines.transliteration: jay lakh ist aree-aa bh og karahi nav kh and raaj kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over andover again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sukh  na paav-ee fir fir jonee paahi. ||3||

lines.english: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet
lines.transliteration: har haar kanth jinee pahiri-aa gur charn ee chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਜੀਿਤਆ  ਗਿਤ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਘਰੈ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa pichh ai riDh  siDh firai onaa t il na t amaa-ay. ||4|| -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for suchthings at all. ||4||

lines.english: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.
lines.transliteration: jo parabh bh aavai so thee-ai avar na karn aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ  ਭੋਗ ਕਰਿਹ  ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35|| pMnw 27 isrIrwgu mhlw 3 Gru 1 ] (27-1) sireeraag mehlaa 3 ghar 1. Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jeevai naam lai har dayvhu sahj subh aa-ay. ||5||2||35||

lines.english: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jis hee kee sirkaar hai tis hee kaa sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kaar kamaavn ee sach gh at pargat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਿਸਰਕਾਰ  ਹੈ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.
lines.transliteration: antar jis kai sach vasai sachay sachee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਘਿਟ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach milay say na vichhurh eh tin nij gh ar vaasaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam mai har bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of HisShabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur sach parabh  nirmalaa sabad  milaavaa ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains somerged.
lines.transliteration: sabad milai so mil rahai jis na-o aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they comeand go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay ko naa milai fir fir aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ik varatd aa ayko rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, theName of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis na-o aap da-i-aal ho-ay so gurmukh  naam samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਕੋ ਨਾ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argueand debate.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  jotkee vaad  karahi beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਏਕੋ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.
lines.transliteration: mat buDh  bhavee na bujh -ee ant ar lobh  vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨਉ ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all theirwandering and roaming, they are ruined.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh bh aramd ay bh aram bh aram ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਜੋਤਕੀ  ਵਾਦ ਕਰਿਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa kamaavan aa ko-ay na maytan haar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਬੁਿਧ ਭਵੀ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up yourselfishness.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa gaakh -rhee sir d eejai aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਭਰਮਦੇ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.
lines.transliteration: sabad mileh t aa har milai sayvaa pavai sabh  thaa-ay.

lines.english: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality isuplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.
lines.transliteration: paaras parsi-ai paaras ho-ay jotee jot  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ  ਿਸਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in sat gur mili-aa aa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.
lines.transliteration: man bhukh aa bh ukhaa mat  karahi mat  too karahi pookaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਿਸ  ਪਰਿਸਐ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਹੋਇ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jin siree sabh sai day-ay aDh aar.

lines.english: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o sad aa da-i-aal hai sabh naa kard aa saar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਿਹ  ਮਤ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੂਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (27-12) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh bujh ee-ai paa-ee-ai mokh  du-aar. ||5||3||36||

lines.english: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.
lines.transliteration: jinee sun kai mani-aa t inaa nij gh ar vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ  ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, theTreasure of Excellence.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee saalaahi sach har paa-i-aa gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever asacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay say nirmalay ha-o sad  balihaarai jaas.

lines.english: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hirdai jin kai har vasai t it ghat hai pargaas. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har har nirmal Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur mast ak jin ka-o likh i-aa say gurmukh  rahay liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-thoseGurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: har santahu d aykhhu nad ar kar nikat vasai bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਘਿਟ  ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.
lines.transliteration: gurmat jinee pachh aani-aa say d aykheh sad aa had oor.

lines.english: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.
lines.transliteration: jin gun t in sad  man vasai a-ugun vanti-aa d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die infrustration. ||2||
lines.transliteration: manmukh gun  tai baahray bin naavai mard ay jhoor. ||2||

lines.english: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lordin their minds.
lines.transliteration: jin sabad guroo sun  mani-aa t in man Dh i-aa-i-aa har so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agtee rat i-aa man t an nirmal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਸੇ ਦੇਖਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.
lines.transliteration: koorhaa rang kasumbh  kaa binas jaa-ay d ukh ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਿਤਨ  ਸਦ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਿਤਆ  ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3|| pMnw 28
lines.transliteration: jis andar naam pargaas hai oh sad aa sad aa thir ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਥਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih janam padaarath paa-ay kai har naam na chayt ai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they findno place of rest at all.
lines.transliteration: pag khisi-ai rahn aa nahee aagai th a-ur na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਗ  ਿਖਿਸਐ  ਰਹਣਾ  ਨਹੀ ਆਗੈ  ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting andrepenting.
lines.transliteration: oh vaylaa hath na aavee ant ga-i-aa pachh utaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovinglyattuned to the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jis nadar karay so ubrai har sayt ee liv laa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.
lines.transliteration: daykh aa daykhee sabh  karay manmukh  boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh hird aa suDh  hai sayv pa-ee t in thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਿਤਨ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singingthe Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi har nit  parheh har gun  gaa-ay samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਤ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever.||5||4||37|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (28-5) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kee ban ee sad aa sach hai je naam rahay liv laa-ay. ||5||4||37||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਿਜ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings ofthe Guru
lines.transliteration: jinee ik man naam Dhi-aa-i-aa gurmat ee veechaar.
tin kay mukh  sad ujlay t it sachai d arbaar. -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

lines.english: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name.||1||
lines.transliteration: o-ay amrit peeveh sad aa sad aa sachai naam pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gurmukh  sadaa pat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har sadaa Dh i-aa-ee-ai mal ha-umai kadh ai Dho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose theirhonor.
lines.transliteration: manmukh naam na jaan nee vin  naavai pat  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  na aa-i-o laagay d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure theyare absorbed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vistaa kay keerhay paveh vich vistaa say vistaa maahi samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿਤ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: tin kaa janam safal hai jo chaleh sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.
lines.transliteration: kul uDhaareh aapn aa Dh an jan aydee maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਪਵਿਹ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਸੇ ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਮਾਿਹ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai jis na-o kirpaa karay rajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਲਿਹ  ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: jinee gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-i-aa vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: o-ay andrahu baahrahu nirmalay sachay sach samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਿਜਸ ਨਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings andmeditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (28-13) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aa-ay say parvaan heh jin gurmat ee har Dh i-aa-ay. ||4||5||38||

lines.english: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice,they carry on their trade.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa har Dh an raas hai gur poochh  karahi vaapaar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is theirMerchandise and Support.
lines.transliteration: har naam salaahan sadaa sad aa vakh ar har naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਏ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਿਹ ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam drirh-aa-i-aa har bh agtaa atut bhandaar. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray is man ka-o samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਿਛ ਕਰਿਹ  ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ay man aalas ki-aa karahi gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply andcontemplates.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  har kaa pi-aar hai jay gurmukh  karay beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.
lines.transliteration: pakhand bh agat na hova-ee d ubiDh aa bol kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditativecontemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so jan ralaa-i-aa naa ralai jis antar bibayk beechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: so sayvak har aakhee-ai jo har raakh ai ur Dh aar.

lines.english: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicateegotism from within.
lines.transliteration: man tan sa-upay aagai Dh aray ha-umai vichahu maar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਪਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhan gurmukh  so parvaan  hai je kad ay na aavai haar. ||3|| Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found. pMnw 29
lines.transliteration: karam milai taa paa-ee-ai vin  karmai paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh t arasd ay jis maylay so milai har aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਤਰਸਦੇ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord'sName. ||4||6||39|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (29-2) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har paa-i-aa sad aa har naam samaa-ay. ||4||6||39||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar har naam hai gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in theNaam.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai sehjay naam samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: andar rachai har sach si-o rasnaa har gun  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray jag d ukhee-aa d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਚ ਿਸਉ ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur sarnaa-ee sukh  laheh an-d in naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remainpure.
lines.transliteration: saachay mail na laag-ee man nirmal har Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਿਹ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the AmbrosialNectar of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  pachh aanee-ai har amrit  naam samaa-ay.

lines.english: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorancehas been dispelled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan parchand balaa-i-aa agi-aan anDhayraa jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism,wickedness and desire.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mailay mal bh aray ha-umai t arisnaa vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai mail na ut rai mar jameh ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhaat ur baajee palach rahay naa urvaar na paar. ||3|| Engrossed in this transitory drama, they ar e not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||
For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jap t ap sanjmee har kai naam pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa Dh i-aa-ee-ai ayk naam kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਤੁਰ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਪਲਿਚ  ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings.||4||7||40|| sRIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (29-10) sareeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai sabh naa jee-aa kaa aaDh aar. ||4||7||40||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are notbalanced or detached.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mohi vi-aapi-aa bairaag ud aasee na ho-ay.

lines.english: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, andlose their honor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad na cheenai sad aa dukh har d argahi pat  kho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai gurmukh kh o-ee-ai naam rat ay sukh  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.
lines.transliteration: mayray man ahinis poor rahee nit aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away;remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv moh parjalai gh ar hee maahi ud aasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karam kamaavai bigsai har bairaag anand.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੋਈਐ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego,they are carefree.
lines.transliteration: ahinis bhagat  karay d in raat ee ha-umai maar nichand .

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਹੀ ਿਨਤ ਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have foundthe Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag sat sangat  paa-ee har paa-i-aa sahj anand. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਉਦਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled withthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: so saaDhoo bairaagee so-ee hird ai naam vasaa-ay.

lines.english: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost hisselfishness and conceit.
lines.transliteration: antar laag na t aamas moolay vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਹਿਰ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord;he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan sat guroo d ikhaali-aa har ras pee-aa agh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਨਚੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.
lines.transliteration: jin kinai paa-i-aa saaDhsangt ee poorai bh aag bairaag.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru.They are inwardly attached to egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh fireh na jaan eh sat gur ha-umai and ar laag.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸੋਈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (29-18) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad rat ay har naam rangaa-ay bin bh ai kayhee laag. ||4||8||41||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ  ਮੂਲੇ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. Allcommodities are within.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee sa-ud aa paa-ee-ai ant ar sabh  vath ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਿਦਖਾਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ  ਅਘਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhsobtain it.
lines.transliteration: khin kh in naam samaalee-ai gurmukh  paavai ko-ay.

lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan akh ut hai vadbh aag paraapat  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਲਾਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance. pMnw 30
lines.transliteration: mayray man taj nind aa ha-umai ahaNkaar.

lines.english: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sadaa Dh i-aa-ay t oo gurmukh  aykankaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa kay mukh  ujlay gur sabd ee beechaar.

lines.english: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  sukh  paa-id ay jap jap rid ai muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghar hee vich mahal paa-i-aa gur sabd ee veechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ  ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਿਰਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay jo muh fayreh mathay t in kaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਿਵਿਚ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hoveringabove them.
lines.transliteration: an-din d ukh kamaavd ay nit  johay jam jaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਿਹ  ਮਥੇ ਿਤਨ  ਕਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intenseanxiety. ||3||
lines.transliteration: supnai sukh na d aykhnee baho chint aa parjaalay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਿਨਤ  ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa d aataa ayk hai aapay bakh as karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ  ਬਹੁ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਪਰਜਾਲੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.
lines.transliteration: kahnaa kichh oo na jaav-ee jis bh aavai t is day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (30-6) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paa-ee-ai aapay jaan ai so-ay. ||4||9||42||

lines.english: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sayvee-ai sach vadi-aa-ee day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥੪ ॥੯॥੪੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasai ha-umai door karay-i.

lines.english: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih man Dhaavat  taa rahai jaa aapay nad ar karay-i. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gurmukh  har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan sad  man vasai mahlee paavai thaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਤਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they findno shelter, no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: manmukh man t an anDh  hai tis na-o th a-ur na th aa-o.

lines.english: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.
lines.transliteration: baho jonee bha-ud aa firai ji-o sunj aiN ghar kaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਹਲੀ  ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, theName of the Lord is received. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee gh at chaann aa sabad  milai har naa-o. ||2||

lines.english: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya,there is darkness.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  bikhi-aa anDh  hai maa-i-aa moh gubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਸ ਨਉ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.
lines.transliteration: lobhee an ka-o sayvd ay parh  vayd aa karai pookaar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ  ਿਫਰੈ ਿਜਉ  ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਿਰ  ਕਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either thisshore or the one beyond. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa and ar pach mu-ay naa urvaar na paar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi visaari-aa jagat pit aa part ipaal.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger ofDeath.
lines.transliteration: baajhahu guroo achayt  hai sabh  baDh ee jamkaal.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਪਿੜ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the TrueName. ||4||10||43|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (30-13) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat ubray sachaa naam samaal. ||4||10||43||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains thefourth state of higher consciousness.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa moh hai gurmukh  cha-uthaa pad  paa-ay.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abidewithin the mind.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa maylaa-i-an har naam vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: potai jin kai punn hai t in sat sangat  maylaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gurmat  saach rahaa-o.

lines.english: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saacho saach kamaavanaa saachai sabad  milaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee naam pachhaan i-aa tin vitahu bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਉਥਾ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.
lines.transliteration: aap chhod charn ee lagaa chalaa t in kai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in theNaam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laahaa har har naam milai sehjay naam samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੋਤੈ ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam isnot obtained.
lines.transliteration: bin gur mahal na paa-ee-ai naam na paraapat ho-ay.

lines.english: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa satgur lorh  lahu jid oo paa-ee-ai sach so-ay.

lines.english: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lordcomes to pass. ||3||
lines.transliteration: asur sanghaarai sukh  vasai jo t is bhaavai so ho-ay. ||3||

lines.english: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa satgur kar jaan i-aa tayho jayhaa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.
lines.transliteration: ayhu sahsaa moolay naahee bhaa-o laa-ay jan ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਗਾ  ਚਲਾ  ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44|| pMnw 31 isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (31-1) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayk jot d u-ay moort ee sabad  milaavaa ho-ay. ||4||11||44||

lines.english: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others,instead of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit chh od bikh i-aa lobh aanay sayvaa karahi vidaan ee.

lines.english: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa Dh aram gavaaveh boojh eh naahee an-d in dukh vihaan ee.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned todeath without water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  na chayt hee doob mu-ay bin paan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਗਵਾਵਿਹ  ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਦੁਿਖ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of HisSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: man ray sadaa bh ajahu har sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ  ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad ant ar vasai t aa har visar na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.
lines.transliteration: ih sareer maa-i-aa kaa putlaa vich ha-umai d ustee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa jaman  marn aa manmukh  pat gavaa-ee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into theLight. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa jot ee jot  milaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਸਟੀ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
