lines.english: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires arefulfilled.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa at  sukh aalee jo ichh ay so fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; theLord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  tap pavit  sareeraa har har man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace isfound. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee mil pareet am sukh  paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਿਤ  ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jo satgur kee sarn aagat ee ha-o t in kai bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਸਰੀਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: dar sachai sachee vadi-aa-ee sehjay sach samaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union.||4||12||45|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (31-8) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai gurmukh  mayl milaa-o. ||4||12||45||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decoratingher body.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam kamaavn ay ji-o d ohaagan  tan seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more andmore miserable.
lines.transliteration: sayjai kant na aavee nit  nit ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.english: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to HisHouse. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pir kaa mahal na paav-ee naa deesai gh ar baar. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray ik man naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਿਜਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਤਿਨ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and findpeace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: santaa sangat  mil rahai jap raam naam sukh  paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa sohaagan ee pir raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵਈ  ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of herHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: mithaa boleh niv chaleh sayjai ravai bh ataar.

lines.english: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sobhaavant ee sohaagan ee jin gur kaa hayt  apaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਜਿਪ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sat gur milai jaa bh aagai kaa ud -u ho-ay.

lines.english: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: antrahu d ukh bharam katee-ai sukh  paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai jo chalai d ukh na paavai ko-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it isobtained.
lines.transliteration: gur kay bhaan ay vich amrit  hai sehjay paavai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.
lines.transliteration: jinaa paraapat t in pee-aa ha-umai vichahu kh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਜਾ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਾ ਉਦਉ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord.||4||13||46|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (31-16) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai sach milaavaa ho-ay. ||4||13||46||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.
lines.transliteration: jaa pir jaanai aapn aa tan man agai Dh aray-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee karam kamaavd ee-aa say-ee karam karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you withtrue greatness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sehjay saach milaavrhaa saach vadaa-ee d ay-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gur bin bh agat na ho-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhagat  na paa-ee-ai jay lochai sabh  ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through8.4 million incarnations.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh fayr pa-i-aa kaaman  doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਧਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.
lines.transliteration: bin gur need na aavee d ukhee rain  vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਦੀਆ  ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away invain. ||2|| pMnw 32
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai pir na paa-ee-ai birthaa janam gavaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o kartee jag firee naa Dh an sampai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ  ਜਗੁ ਿਫਰੀ  ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged bythe Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: anDhee naam na chayt -ee sabh  baaDh ee jamkaal.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ  ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ  ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord inthe heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai Dh an paa-i-aa har naamaa rid ai samaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, theyobtain intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay say nirmalay gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tonguessavor His Sublime Essence.
lines.transliteration: man tan raat aa rang si-o rasnaa rasan rasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away.||4||14||47|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (32-4) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rang na utrai jo har Dh ur chh odi-aa laa-ay. ||4||14||47||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਧੁਿਰ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without theGuru there is no devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kirpaa karay bh agat keejai bin gur bh agat na ho-ee.

lines.english: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.
lines.transliteration: aapai aap milaa-ay boojhai t aa nirmal hovai so-ee.

lines.english: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o saachaa saachee banee sabad  milaavaa ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕੀਜੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to comeinto the world?
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray bh agtiheen  kaahay jag aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee sayv na keenee birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives,and unites with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay jagjeevan sukh-d aata aapay bakh as milaa-ay.

lines.english: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant ay ki-aa vaychaaray ki-aa ko aakh  sunaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਭਗਿਤਹੀਣੁ  ਕਾਹੇ ਜਿਗ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aapay d ay-ay vadaa-ee aapay sayv karaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, butnone will go along with them in the end.
lines.transliteration: daykh  kutamb mohi lobh aanaa chald i-aa naal na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Valuecannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv gun  niDhaan paa-i-aa t is dee keem na paa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har parabh sakh aa meet  parabh  mayraa ant ay ho-ay sakh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishnessis not removed.
lines.transliteration: aapnai man chit  kahai kahaa-ay bin gur aap na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਏ ਿਕਆ  ਵੇਚਾਰੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਆਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes todwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o daat aa bh agat vachh al hai kar kirpaa man vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (32-12) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sobhaa surat  day-ay parabh  aapay gurmukh  day vadi-aa-ee. ||4||15||48||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ  ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan jannee jin jaa-i-aa Dh an pit aa parDh aan. sat gur sayv sukh  paa-i-aa vichahu ga-i- aa gumaan. Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one whoserves the True Guru and finds peace. His arrogant pride is banished from within.
lines.transliteration: isrIrwgu, mÚ 3)

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁਸੇਿਵ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure ofExcellence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dar sayvan sant  jan kh arhay paa-in gun ee niDh aan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur mukh Dh i-aa-ay har so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasai man t an nirmal ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਭਗਿਤ ਵਛਲੁ  ਹੈ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa ghar aa-i-aa aapay mili-aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color withintuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee salaahee-ai rangay sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, weshall never be separated again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sachai sach samaa-i-aa mil rahai na vichhurh  jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karn aa so kar rahi-aa avar na karn aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the TrueGuru, who takes them into His Own Account.
lines.transliteration: chiree vichhunay mayli-an sat gur pannai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ  ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay kaar karaa-isee avar na karnaa jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism andcorruption.
lines.transliteration: man tan rat aa rang si-o ha-umai t aj vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਿਧਆਇ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.
lines.transliteration: ahinis hirdai rav rahai nirbh a-o naam nirankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad.||4||16||49|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (32-19) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap milaa-i-an poorai sabad apaar. ||4||16||49||

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: govid gun ee niDh aan hai ant  na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within. pMnw 33
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee na paa-ee-ai ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai sad  bhai rachai aap vasai man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸਦ ਭੈ ਰਚੈ ਆਿਪ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gurmukh  boojh ai ko-ay.

lines.english: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay karam kamaavn ay janam pad aarath kh o-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.
lines.transliteration: jinee chaakhi-aa t inee saad  paa-i-aa bin chaakh ay bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.
lines.transliteration: amrit saachaa naam hai kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਿਤਨੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad.||2||
lines.transliteration: peevat hoo parvaan  bha-i-aa poorai sabad  samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.
lines.transliteration: aapay day-ay t a paa-ee-ai hor karn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਵਤ  ਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it isreceived.
lines.transliteration: dayvan  vaalay kai hath d aat hai guroo d u-aarai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jayhaa keeton t ayhaa ho-aa jayhay karam kamaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਣ  ਵਾਲੇ  ਕੈ ਹਿਥ ਦਾਿਤ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam naam hai vin  naavai nirmal na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਆ  ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through theShabad, we merge into Him.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag naam man vasai sabad  milaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (33-7) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay hee rang varatdaa har gun  paavai so-ay. ||4||17||50||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensivemeditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.
lines.transliteration: kaaN-i-aa saaDhai uraDh  tap karai vichahu ha-umai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੫੦॥
lines.english: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aDhi-aat am karam jay karay naam na kab hee paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Nameof the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad jeevat  marai har naam vasai man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਇਆ  ਸਾਧੈ ਉਰਧ  ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: sun man mayray bh aj sat gur sarn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਧਆਤਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, youshall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee chhutee-ai bikh  bhavjal sabad  gur t arnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality iscorrupting.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  sabh aa Dh aat hai d oojaa bh aa-o vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.
lines.transliteration: pandit parh ai banDh an moh baaDh aa nah boojh ai bikh i-aa pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਿਬਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਸਬਿਦ ਗੁਰ ਤਰਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourthstate, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai t arikutee chh ootai cha-uthai pad  mukat  du-aar. ||2||

lines.english: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment isdispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur tay maarag paa-ee-ai chookai moh gubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door ofLiberation.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai t aa uDh rai paa-ay mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਪੜੈ ਬੰਧਨ  ਮੋਹ ਬਾਧਾ  ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee mil rahai sach naam kartaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਿਤਰ੍ਕੁਟੀ  ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਿਦ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa at sabal hai chh aday na kit ai upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay d ukh laa-id aa bahut ee day-ay sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਉਧਰੈ  ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, theirego is banished. ||4||18||51|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (33-14) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam lagay say ubray ha-umai sabad gavaa-ay. ||4||18||51||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay gur paa-ee-ai har naamo day-ay drirh -aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਿਤ  ਸਬਲ  ਹੈ ਛਡੇ ਨ ਿਕਤੈ  ਉਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.
lines.transliteration: bin gur kinai na paa-i-o birthaa janam gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ  ਬਹੁਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receivetheir punishment. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam kamaavn ay dargeh milai sajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੧॥
lines.english: O mind, give up the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: man ray doojaa bh aa-o chukaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: antar t ayrai har vasai gur sayvaa sukh  paa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: sach banee sach sabad  hai jaa sach Dh aray pi-aar.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasai ha-umai kroDh nivaar.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai t aa paa-ay mokh  du-aar. ||2||

lines.english: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues comingand going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich jag binasdaa mar jammai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sabad  na jaan nee jaasan pat  gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord.||3|| pMnw 34
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa naa-o paa-ee-ai sachay rahai samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.
lines.transliteration: sabad mani-ai gur paa-ee-ai vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karay sad aa saachay kee liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (34-2) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath man vasi-aa naanak sahj samaa-ay. ||4||19||52||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥
lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: jinee purkhee sat gur na sayvi-o say d ukhee-ay jug chaar.

lines.english: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They areplundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.
lines.transliteration: ghar hod aa purakh  na pachh aani-aa abh imaan muth ay ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਪੁਰਖੀ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.
lines.transliteration: satguroo ki-aa fitki-aa mang thakay sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਅਿਭਮਾਿਨ  ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of theirproblems. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad na sayvi-o sabh  kaaj savaaran haar. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.
lines.transliteration: man mayray sadaa har vaykh  hadoor.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਸਿਭ ਕਾਜ  ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill youto overflowing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh  parharai sabad  rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.
lines.transliteration: sach salaahan say sachay sachaa naam aDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavnee sachay naal pi-aar.

lines.english: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu varatdaa ko-ay na maytan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The falseare plundered by falsehood. ||2||
lines.transliteration: manmukh mahal na paa-inee koorh  muth ay koorh i-aar. ||2||

lines.english: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kartaa jag mu-aa gur bin gh or anDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi visaari-aa sukh-d aata daataar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ  ਕੂਿੜ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂਿੜਆਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in theirhearts.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh t aa ubreh sach rakh eh ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa tay har paa-ee-ai sach sabad  veechaar. ||3||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism andcorruption are discarded.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv man nirmalaa ha-umai t aj vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਉਬਰਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਹ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aap chhod jeevat  marai gur kai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਿਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa Dh aavat  reh ga-ay laagaa saach pi-aar. The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the TrueOne.
Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord.||4||
lines.transliteration: sach ratay mukh  ujlay t it saachai d arbaar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਜੀਵਤ  ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do notenshrine love for the Shabad
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  na mani-o sabad  na lago pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ  ਰਿਹ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: isnaan daan jayt aa karahi d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aar. -they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aapnee kirpaa karay t aa laagai naam pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਮੰਿਨਓ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਲਗੋ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru.||5||20||53|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (34-13) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too gur kai hayt  apaar. ||5||20||53||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ  ਕਰਿਹ ਦੂਜੈ  ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.
lines.transliteration: kis ha-o sayvee ki-aa jap karee satgur poochh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ  ਨਾਮ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa man la-ee vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
lines.english: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.
lines.transliteration: ayhaa sayvaa chaakree naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the TrueWord of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naamai hee tay sukh  paa-ee-ai sachai sabad  suhaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਿਕਆ  ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਛਉ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray an-din jaag har chayt .

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਲਈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapnee kh aytee rakh  lai kooNj parh aigee kh ayt. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man kee-aa ichhaa pooree-aa sabad  rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him alwaysclose at hand.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aa-ay bh agat karahi d in raat ee har jee-o vaykh ai sad aa had oor.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ  ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned tothe True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sad aa man raat aa bh aram ga-i-aa sareerahu d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਖੇਤੀ ਰਿਖ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ  ਖੇਿਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence.||2||
lines.transliteration: nirmal saahib paa-i-aa saachaa gunee gaheer. ||2||

lines.english: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.
lines.transliteration: jo jaagay say ubray sootay ga-ay muhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ  ਇਛਾ  ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fadeaway.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad na pachh aani-o supnaa ga-i-aa vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come. pMnw 35
lines.transliteration: sunjay gh ar kaa paahun aa ji-o aa-i-aa t i-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh janam birthaa ga-i-aa ki-aa muhu d aysee jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਗਇਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap hai ha-umai vich kahan na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism iseradicated from within.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad pachh aanee-ai d ukh ha-umai vichahu gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan aapn aa ha-o t in kai laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ ਆਪਣਾ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court.||4||21||54|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (35-4) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dar sachai sachiaar heh ha-o t in balihaarai jaa-o. ||4||21||54||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰ  ਹਿਹ ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੪॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Consider the time and the moment-when should we worship the Lord?
lines.transliteration: jay vaylaa vakhat  veechaaree-ai t aa kit  vaylaa bh agat ho-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.
lines.transliteration: an-din naamay rat i-aa sachay sachee so-ay.

lines.english: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?
lines.transliteration: ik til pi-aaraa visrai bh agat kinayhee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ  ਵਖਤੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਤਾ ਿਕਤੁ  ਵੇਲਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of hisis wasted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al saach si-o saas na birthaa ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਿਤਆ  ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har kaa naam Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saachee bhagat  taa thee-ai jaa har vasai man aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸਾਚ ਿਸਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sehjay khayt ee raahee-ai sach naam beej paa-ay.

lines.english: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: khayt ee jammee aglee manoo-aa rajaa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਤਾ ਥੀਐ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit  hai jit  peetai tikh jaa-ay.

lines.english: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ih man saachaa sach rataa sachay rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  vaykh an bolnaa sabd ay rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ  ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.
lines.transliteration: banee vajee chahu jugee sacho sach sun aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਿਤਖ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them intoHimself.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa reh ga-i-aa sachai la-i-aa milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਿਚ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presenceclose at hand. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o mahal had oor hai jo sach rahay liv laa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਣੁ  ਵੇਖਣੁ  ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, itcannot be obtained.
lines.transliteration: nadree naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai vin  karmaa paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, andone comes to meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sat sangat  lahai sat gur bh aytai jis aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਿਹ ਗਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall bedispelled from within.
lines.transliteration: an-din naamay rat i-aa d ukh bikhi-aa vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ  ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name.||4||22||55|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (35-13) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad milaavrh aa naamay naam samaa-ay. ||4||22||55||

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa bh a-o tin paa-i-on jin gur kaa sabad  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwellupon the Glories of the True One.
lines.transliteration: satsangt ee sad aa mil rahay sachay kay gun  saar.

lines.english: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined intheir hearts.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa mail chukaa-ee-an har raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.english: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One.||1||
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sach man sachay naal pi-aar. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.
lines.transliteration: man mayray ha-umai mail bhar naal.

lines.english: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of theShabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har nirmal sadaa sohn aa sabad  savaaran haar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਭਉ ਿਤਨ  ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of HisShabad.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad man mohi-aa parabh  aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into theLight.
lines.transliteration: an-din naamay rat i-aa jot ee jot  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: jotee hoo parabh  jaapd aa bin sat gur boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa sat gur bh ayti-aa t in aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh  dumn ee doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay.

lines.english: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes inanguish.
lines.transliteration: tis bin gh arhee na jeevd ee dukhee rain  vihaa-ay.

lines.english: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and overagain.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaan aa anDh ulaa fir fir aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3|| pMnw 36
lines.transliteration: nadar karay parabh  aapn ee aapay la-ay milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  sund aa vaykh -daa ki-o mukar pa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੁਣਦਾ  ਵੇਖਦਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਮੁਕਿਰ  ਪਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.
lines.transliteration: paapo paap kamaavday paapay pacheh pachaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਿਹ  ਪਚਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.
lines.transliteration: so parabh nad ar na aavee manmukh  boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs findHim. ||4||23||56|| sRIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (36-3) sareeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis vaykhaalay so-ee vaykh ai naanak gurmukh  paa-ay. ||4||23||56||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ  ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਇ  ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the disease is not cured, and the pain of egotism is not removed.
lines.transliteration: bin gur rog na tut-ee ha-umai peerh  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells in the mind, and one remains immersed in His Name.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasai naamay rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਪੀੜ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found; without the Shabad,people wander, deceived by doubt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har paa-ee-ai bin sabd ai bharam bh ulaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, dwell in the balanced state of your own inner being.
lines.transliteration: man ray nij ghar vaasaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Praise the Lord's Name, and you shall no longer come and go in reincarnation.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam saalaahi too fir aavan  jaan na ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One Lord alone is the Giver, pervading everywhere. There is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: har iko daat aa varatd aa doojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Praise the Word of the Shabad, and He shall come to dwell in your mind; you shall be blessed with intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: sabad saalaahee man vasai sehjay hee sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Everything is within the Lord's Glance of Grace. As He wishes, He gives. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh nad ree and ar vaykh -daa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In egotism, all must account for their actions. In this accounting, there is no peace.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai sabhaa gan at hai gant ai na-o sukh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Acting in evil and corruption, people are immersed in corruption.
lines.transliteration: bikh kee kaar kamaavn ee bikh  hee maahi samaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵੇਖਦਾ  ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Name, they find no place of rest. In the City of Death, they suffer inagony. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai tha-ur na paa-inee jam pur d ookh sahaahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਭਾ ਗਣਤ  ਹੈ ਗਣਤੈ  ਨਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Body and soul all belong to Him; He is the Support of all.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is daa tisai daa aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਿਬਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, understanding comes, and then the Door of Liberation is found.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bujhee-ai t aa paa-ay mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ  ਜਮਪੁਿਰ  ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has no end orlimitation. ||4||24||57|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (36-10) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi tooN ant na paaraavaar. ||4||24||57||

lines.english: Those who have the Support of the True Name are in ecstasy and peace forever.
lines.transliteration: tinaa anand sad aa sukh  hai jinaa sach naam aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they obtain the True One, the Destroyer of pain.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee sach paa-i-aa d ookh nivaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੭॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True One; they love the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa saachay gun  gaavahi saachai naa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, He bestows the treasure of devotion. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kar kai aapnee d iton bh agat bhandaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O mind, sing His Glorious Praises, and be in ecstasy forever.
lines.transliteration: man ray sadaa anand gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the True Word of His Bani, the Lord is obtained, and one remains immersedin the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sachee banee har paa-ee-ai har si-o rahai samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In true devotion, the mind is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love, withintuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagt ee man laal thee-aa rat aa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The mind is fascinated by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, which cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee man mohi-aa kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The tongue imbued with the True Word of the Shabad drinks in the Amrit with delight,singing His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa ratee sabad  sachai amrit  peevai ras gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains this love, when the Lord, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ayhu rang paa-ee-ai jis no kirpaa karay rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: This world is an illusion; people pass their life-nights sleeping.
lines.transliteration: sansaa ih sansaar hai suti-aa rain  vihaa-ay.

lines.english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He lifts some out, and unites them with Himself.
lines.transliteration: ik aapnai bh aanai kadh  la-i-an aapay la-i-on milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਥੀਆ  ਰਤਾ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself abides in the mind, and drives out attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee aap man vasi-aa maa-i-aa moh chukaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself bestows glorious greatness; He inspires the Gurmukh to understand. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap vadaa-ee dit ee-an gurmukh  day-ay bujh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਰਤੀ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵੈ ਰਿਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Giver of all. He corrects those who make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa d aataa ayk hai bh uli-aa la-ay samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself has deceived some, and attached them to duality.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay aap khu-aa-i-an d oojai chh adi-an laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is found, and one's light merges into theLight.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har paa-ee-ai jot ee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਕਿਢ  ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਲਇਓਨੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Name of the Lord night and day, O Nanak, you shall be absorbed intothe Name. ||4||25||58|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (36-19) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: an-din naamay rat i-aa naanak naam samaa-ay. ||4||25||58||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous obtain Truth; they give up their desires for evil and corruption.
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee sach paa-i-aa t arisnaa t aj vikaar.

lines.english: Their minds are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Love of their Beloved is on their tongues. pMnw 37
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee man rangi-aa rasnaa paraym pi-aar.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one has found Him; reflect upon this in your mind and see.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kinai na paa-i-o kar vaykh hu man veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of the self-willed manmukhs is not washed off; they have no love for the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manmukh mail na ut rai jichar gur sabad  na karay pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, walk in harmony with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man mayray satgur kai bh aanai chal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
lines.english: Dwell within the home of your own inner being, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar;you shall attain the Peace of the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaseh amrit  peeveh t aa sukh  laheh mahal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਪੀਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਿਹ  ਮਹਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The unvirtuous have no merit; they are not allowed to sit in His Presence.
lines.transliteration: a-ugunvant ee gun  ko nahee bahan  na milai had oor.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Shabad; those without virtue are far removed from God.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sabad  na jaan -ee avgan  so parabh  door.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ  ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹਿਣ  ਨ ਿਮਲੈ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who recognize the True One are permeated and attuned to Truth.
lines.transliteration: jinee sach pachhaan i-aa sach rat ay bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Their minds are pierced through by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and God Himselfushers them into His Presence. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee man bayDh i-aa parabh  mili-aa aap had oor. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself dyes us in the Color of His Love; through the Word of His Shabad, Heunites us with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay rangan rangi-on sabd ay la-i-on milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This True Color shall not fade away, for those who are attuned to His Love.
lines.transliteration: sachaa rang na utrai jo sach rat ay liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs grow weary of wandering around in all four directions, butthey do not understand.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa bhav thakay manmukh  boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੋ ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who is united with the True Guru, meets and merges in the True Word of theShabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis satgur maylay so milai sachai sabad  samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਿਵ ਥਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I have grown weary of making so many friends, hoping that someone might be ableto end my suffering.
lines.transliteration: mitar gh anayray kar thakee mayraa d ukh kaatai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting with my Beloved, my suffering has ended; I have attained Union with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam d ukh kati-aa sabad  milaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਘਣੇਰੇ  ਕਿਰ ਥਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Earning Truth, and accumulating the Wealth of Truth, the truthful person gains areputation of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach khatn aa sach raas hai sachay sachee so-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True One, O Nanak, the Gurmukh shall not be separated from Himagain. ||4||26||59|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (37-9) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach milay say na vichhurh eh naanak gurmukh  ho-ay. ||4||26||59||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖਟਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself created the Creation; He produced the Universe, and He Himselfwatches over it.
lines.transliteration: aapay kaaran kart aa karay sarisat d aykhai aap upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੯॥
lines.english: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating all. The Unseen cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: sabh ayko ik varatd aa alakh  na lakh i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: God Himself is Merciful; He Himself bestows understanding.
lines.transliteration: aapay parabhoo d a-i-aal hai aapay d ay-ay bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਦੇਖੈ ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One dwells forever in the mind of those whoremain lovingly attached to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee sad  man vasi-aa sach rahay liv laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਿਖਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, surrender to the Guru's Will.
lines.transliteration: man mayray gur kee man lai rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Mind and body are totally cooled and soothed, and the Naam comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al sabh  thee-ai naam vasai man aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਦ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਿਚ ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Having created the creation, He supports it and takes care of it.
lines.transliteration: jin kar kaaran Dh aari-aa so-ee saar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is realized, when He Himself bestows His Glance ofGrace.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad pachh aanee-ai jaa aapay nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸਭੁ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are beautifully adorned with the Shabad in the Court of the True Lord
lines.transliteration: say jan sabday sohn ay tit sachai d arbaar.
gurmukh sachai sabad  ratay aap maylay kart aar. ||2|| -those Gurmukhs are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad; the Creator unitesthem with Himself. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਿਰ ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਧਾਿਰਆ  ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, praise the True One, who has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee sach salaahn aa jis d aa ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells in each and every heart, by the Hukam of His Command; by His Hukam, wecontemplate Him.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at aapay hukam vasai hukmay karay beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦੇ  ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: So praise Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and drive out egotism fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee salaahee-ai ha-umai vichahu kh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਆਿਪ  ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That soul-bride who lacks the Lord's Name acts without virtue, and so she grieves. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan naavai baahree avgan vantee ro-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ  ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Praising the True One, attached to the True One, I am satisfied with the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sach salaahee sach lagaa sachai naa-ay taripat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Contemplating His Virtues, I accumulate virtue and merit; I wash myself clean ofdemerits.
lines.transliteration: gun veechaaree gun  sangrahaa avgun  kadh aa Dh o-ay.

lines.english: He Himself unites us in His Union; there is no more separation.
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaa-idaa fir vaychh orhaa na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ  ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I sing the Praises of my Guru; through Him, I find that God. ||4||27||60|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (37-18) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur saalaahee aapnaa jid oo paa-ee parabh  so-ay. ||4||27||60||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਸਿਚ ਲਗਾ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Listen, listen, O soul-bride: you are overtaken by sexual desire-why do you walk likethat, swinging your arms in joy?
lines.transliteration: sun sun  kaam gahaylee-ay ki-aa chaleh baah ludaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹਾ  ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਕਢਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You do not recognize your own Husband Lord! When you go to Him, what face willyou show Him?
lines.transliteration: aapnaa pir na pachh aanhee ki-aa muhu d ayseh jaa-ay.

lines.english: I touch the feet of my sister soul-brides who have known their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee sakheeN kant pachh aani-aa ha-o t in kai laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਦੂ ਪਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੬੦॥
lines.english: If only I could be like them! Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am united in His Union. ||1|| pMnw 38
lines.transliteration: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa sat sangat  mayl milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O woman, the false ones are being cheated by falsehood.
lines.transliteration: munDhay koorh  muth ee koorh i-aar.

lines.english: God is your Husband; He is Handsome and True. He is obtained by reflecting upon the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pir parabh saachaa sohn aa paa-ee-ai gur beechaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਹਣਾ  ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize their Husband Lord; how will they spendtheir life-night?
lines.transliteration: manmukh kant  na pachh aan-ee tin ki-o rain  vihaa-ay.

lines.english: Filled with arrogance, they burn with desire; they suffer in the pain of the love ofduality.
lines.transliteration: garab atee-aa tarisnaa jaleh d ukh paavahi d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: The happy soul-brides are attuned to the Shabad; their egotism is eliminated fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ee-aa sohaagan ee tin vichahu ha-umai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਿਬ  ਅਟੀਆ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਜਲਿਹ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They enjoy their Husband Lord forever, and their life-night passes in the most blissfulpeace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa pir raaveh aapn aa tinaa sukh ay sukh  vihaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: She is utterly lacking in spiritual wisdom; she is abandoned by her Husband Lord. She cannot obtain His Love.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan vihoonee pir mut ee-aa piram na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: In the darkness of intellectual ignorance, she cannot see her Husband, and herhunger does not depart.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan matee anDh ayr hai bin pir d aykhay bh ukh na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Come and meet with me, my sister soul-brides, and unite me with my Husband.
lines.transliteration: aavhu milhu sahayleeho mai pir dayh milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਮਤੀ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She who meets the True Guru, by perfect good fortune, finds her Husband; she isabsorbed in the True One. ||3||
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sat gur milai pir paa-i-aa sach samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Those upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace become His happy soul-brides.
lines.transliteration: say sahee-aa sohaaganee jin ka-o nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who recognizes her Lord and Master places her body and mind in offering beforeHim.
lines.transliteration: khasam pachh aaneh aapn aa tan man aagai d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸਹੀਆ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within her own home, she finds her Husband Lord; her egotism is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: ghar var paa-i-aa aapn aa ha-umai d oor karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੁ  ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides are embellished and exalted; night and day they areabsorbed in devotional worship. ||4||28||61|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (38-8) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sobhaavant ee-aa sohaagan ee an-d in bhagat karay-i. ||4||28||61||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some enjoy their Husband Lord; unto whose door should I go to ask for Him?
lines.transliteration: ik pir raaveh aapnaa ha-o kai d ar poochh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀਆ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੪॥੨੮॥੬੧॥
lines.english: I serve my True Guru with love, that He may lead me to Union with my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvee bh aa-o kar mai pir d ayh milaa-ay.

lines.english: He created all, and He Himself watches over us. Some are close to Him, and some are far away.
lines.transliteration: sabh upaa-ay aapay vaykh ai kis nayrh ai kis d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਹਉ ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਪੂਛਉ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She who knows her Husband Lord to be always with her, enjoys His ConstantPresence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin pir sangay jaani-aa pir raavay sad aa had oor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਮੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O woman, you must walk in harmony with the Guru's Will.
lines.transliteration: munDhay t oo chal gur kai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਿਕਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਿਕਸੁ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, you shall enjoy your Husband, and you shall intuitively merge into theTrue One. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an-din raaveh pir aapn aa sehjay sach samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Attuned to the Shabad, the happy soul-brides are adorned with the True Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ee-aa sohaagan ee sachai sabad  seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within their own home, they obtain the Lord as their Husband, with love for the Guru.
lines.transliteration: har var paa-in ghar aapn ai gur kai hayt  pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Upon her beautiful and cozy bed, she enjoys the Love of her Lord. She is overflowingwith the treasure of devotion.
lines.transliteration: sayj suhaavee har rang ravai bhagat  bharay bh andaar.

lines.english: That Beloved God abides in her mind; He gives His Support to all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so parabh pareet am man vasai je sabh sai day-ay aDh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who praise their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: pir saalaahan aapnaa t in kai ha-o sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind and body to them, and give my head as well; I fall at their feet.
lines.transliteration: man tan arpee sir d ay-ee t in kai laagaa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਵੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who recognize the One renounce the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: jinee ik pachhaan i-aa d oojaa bh aa-o chukaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਜ ਸਭਸੈ  ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, O Nanak, and is absorbed into the True One. ||3||29||62|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (38-16) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam pachh aanee-ai naanak sach samaa-ay. ||3||29||62||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਨ ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. All things are in Your Power.
lines.transliteration: har jee sachaa sach too sabh  kichh  tayrai cheerai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਿਸਰੁ ਦੇਈ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The 8.4 million species of beings wander around searching for You, but without theGuru, they do not find You.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh t arasd ay firay bin gur bh aytay peerai.

lines.english: When the Dear Lord grants His Forgiveness, this human body finds lasting peace.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o bakhsay bakh as la-ay sookh  sadaa sareerai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I serve the True One, who is Immeasurably Deep and Profound. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sayv karee sach gahir gambheerai. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, attuned to the Naam, you shall find peace.
lines.transliteration: man mayray naam ratay sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੇਰੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and praise the Naam; there is no other at all.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naam salaahee-ai d oojaa avar na ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਤਰਸਦੇ  ਿਫਰੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੀਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay no hukam hai bahi sachaa Dh aram beechaar. The Righteous Judge of Dharma, by the Hukam of God's Command, sits andadministers True Justice.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those evil souls, ensnared by the love of duality, are subject to Your Command.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay d usat aat maa oh t ayree sarkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: The souls on their spiritual journey chant and meditate within their minds on the One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. pMnw 39
lines.transliteration: aDhi-aat mee har gun  taas man jaapeh ayk muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਜਪਿਹ  ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma serves them; blessed is the Lord who adorns them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kee sayvaa Dh aram raa-ay karai Dh an savaaran haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who eliminates mental wickedness from within the mind, and casts out emotionalattachment and egotistical pride,
lines.transliteration: man kay bikaar maneh tajai man chookai moh abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਤਜੈ ਮਿਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam raam pachh aani-aa sehjay naam samaan. comes to recognize the All-pervading Soul, and is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the self-willed manmukhs do not find liberation; they wander around like lunatics.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur mukat  na paa-ee-ai manmukh  firai d ivaan.

lines.english: They do not contemplate the Shabad; engrossed in corruption, they utter only emptywords. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad na cheenai kathnee bad nee karay bikh i-aa maahi samaan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਥਨੀ  ਬਦਨੀ  ਕਰੇ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself is everything; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap hai d oojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I speak just as He makes me speak, when He Himself makes me speak.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bolaa-ay ti-o bolee-ai jaa aap bulaa-ay so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਬੋਲਾਏ  ਿਤਉ  ਬੋਲੀਐ  ਜਾ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਲਾਏ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Gurmukh is God Himself. Through the Shabad, we merge in Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ban ee barahm hai sabad  milaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, remember the Naam; serving Him, peace is obtained. ||4||30||63|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (39-6) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too jit  sayvi-ai sukh  ho-ay. ||4||30||63||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂ ਿਜਤੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥
lines.english: The world is polluted with the filth of egotism, suffering in pain. This filth sticks tothem because of their love of duality.
lines.transliteration: jag ha-umai mail dukh  paa-i-aa mal laagee d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: This filth of egotism cannot be washed away, even by taking cleansing baths at hundreds of sacred shrines.
lines.transliteration: mal ha-umai Dhot ee kivai na ut rai jay sa-o t irath naa-ay.

lines.english: Performing all sorts of rituals, people are smeared with twice as much filth.
lines.transliteration: baho biDh karam kamaavd ay doonee mal laagee aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਗ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This filth is not removed by studying. Go ahead, and ask the wise ones. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parhi-ai mail na ut rai poochh ahu gi-aanee-aa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਧੋਤੀ ਿਕਵੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, coming to the Sanctuary of the Guru, you shall become immaculate andpure.
lines.transliteration: man mayray gur saran aavai t aa nirmal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਦੂਣੀ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of chanting the Name of the Lord, Har,Har, but their filth cannot be removed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: manmukh har har kar thakay mail na sakee Dh o-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜਐ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਪੂਛਹੁ ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With a polluted mind, devotional service cannot be performed, and the Naam, theName of the Lord, cannot be obtained.
lines.transliteration: man mailai bhagat  na hova-ee naam na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਿਣ  ਆਵੈ  ਤਾ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The filthy, self-willed manmukhs die in filth, and they depart in disgrace.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mailay mailay mu-ay jaasan pat  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਥਕੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and the filth of egotism isdispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasai mal ha-umai jaa-ay samaa-ay.

lines.english: Like a lamp lit in the darkness, the spiritual wisdom of the Guru dispels ignorance. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o anDhayrai d eepak baalee-ai t i-o gur gi-aan agi-aan t ajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਮੈਲੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: "I have done this, and I will do that"-I am an idiotic fool for saying this!
lines.transliteration: ham kee-aa ham karhagay ham moorakh gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਜਾਸਿਨ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I have forgotten the Doer of all; I am caught in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: karnai vaalaa visri-aa d oojai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: There is no pain as great as the pain of Maya; it drives people to wander all aroundthe world, until they become exhausted.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa jayvad dukh  nahee sabh  bhav thakay sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਬਾਲੀਐ  ਿਤਉ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਤਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace is found, with the True Name enshrined in theheart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee sukh  paa-ee-ai sach naam ur Dh aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਕੀਆ  ਹਮ ਕਰਹਗੇ  ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who meet and merge with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis no maylay so milai ha-o tis balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.english: This mind is attuned to devotional worship; through the True Word of Gurbani, it findsits own home.
lines.transliteration: ay man bhagt ee rat i-aa sach ban ee nij thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਭ ਭਿਵ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: With the mind so imbued, and the tongue imbued as well, sing the Glorious Praises ofthe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: man ratay jihvaa rat ee har gun  sachay gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; immerse yourself in the True One. ||4||31||64|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 Gru 1 ] (39-15) sireeraag mehlaa 4 ghar 1. Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai sachay maahi samaa-o. ||4||31||64||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Within my mind and body is the intense pain of separation; how can my Beloved come to meet me in my home?
lines.transliteration: mai man tan birahu at  aglaa ki-o pareet am milai gh ar aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਿਤਆ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਨਜ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: When I see my God, seeing God Himself, my pain is taken away.
lines.transliteration: jaa daykh aa parabh  aapn aa parabh  daykhi-ai dukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਰਤੇ ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਰਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਚੇ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I go and ask my friends, "How can I meet and merge with God?"||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay puchhaa t in sajn aa parabh  kit biDh milai milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਸਚੇ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੪॥
lines.english: O my True Guru, without You I have no other at all.
lines.transliteration: mayray satiguraa mai t ujh bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be Merciful and unite mewith the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh mugaDh  sarnaagat ee kar kirpaa maylay har so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਿਬਰਹੁ ਅਿਤ  ਅਗਲਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਘਿਰ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord. God Himself causes us to meetHim.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa har naam kaa parabh  aap milaavai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਦੇਿਖਐ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru understands the Lord God. There is no other as Great as the Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur har parabh  bujhi-aa gur jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: I have come and collapsed in the Guru's Sanctuary. In His Kindness, He has united mewith God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o gur sarnaa-ee dh eh pavaa kar d a-i-aa maylay parabh  so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰਾ  ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: No one has found Him by stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of the effort. pMnw 40
lines.transliteration: manhath kinai na paa-i-aa kar upaav thakay sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਉਪਾਵ  ਥਕੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: sahas si-aanap kar rahay man korai rang na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਕਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਨ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat.||3||
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat kinai na paa-i-o jo beejai kh aavai so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਿੜ ਕਪਿਟ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa t ayree aas parabh  sabh  jee-a t ayray t ooN raas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praisedand acclaimed.
lines.transliteration: parabh t uDhhu kh aalee ko nahee d ar gurmukh aa no saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up andsave them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 ] (40-4) sireeraag mehlaa 4. Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bikh bh a-ojal dubd ay kadh  lai jan naanak kee ard aas. ||4||1||65||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ  ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਿਢ ਲੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੧॥੬੫॥
lines.english: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.
lines.transliteration: naam milai man taripat -ee-ai bin naamai Dh arig jeevaas.

lines.english: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee gurmukh sajan  jay milai mai d asay parabh  guntaas.

lines.english: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis vitahu cha-o kh annee-ai mai naam karay pargaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਜਣੁ  ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetamaa ha-o jeevaa naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਮੈ ਨਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted theNaam within me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai jeevan naa thee-ai mayray sat gur naam drirh -aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: naam amolak ratan hai pooray sat gur paas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਨਾ ਥੀਐ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestowsthis enlightenment.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvai lagi-aa kadh  ratan dayvai pargaas.

lines.english: Dhan vadbh aagee vad bh aagee-aa jo aa-ay milay gur paas. ||2|| Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet theGuru. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, andare subject to death.
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur purakh  na bh ayti-o say bh aagheen  vas kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੈ ਲਿਗਆ  ਕਿਢ  ਰਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.
lines.transliteration: o-ay fir fir jon bhavaa-ee-ah vich vistaa kar vikraal.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਵਡ ਭਾਗੀਆ  ਜੋ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled withhorrible anger. ||3||
lines.transliteration: onaa paas du-aas na bh itee-ai jin ant ar kroDh  chandaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਵਿਸ ਕਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunateones come to bathe in it.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  amrit  sar vadbh aagee naaveh aa-ay.

lines.english: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam isimplanted within.
lines.transliteration: un janam janam kee mail utrai nirmal naam drirh -aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਦੁਆਿਸ  ਨ ਿਭਟੀਐ  ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru.||4||2||66|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 ] (40-12) sireeraag mehlaa 4. Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak utam pad  paa-i-aa sat gur kee liv laa-ay. ||4||2||66||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਨਾਵਿਹ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa gun  vithraa gun  bolee mayree maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow vi rtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sajan  gunkaaree-aa mil sajan  har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਤਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥੨॥੬੬॥
lines.english: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||
