lines.transliteration: heerai heer mil bayDhi-aa rang chaloolai naa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: mayray govindaa gun  gaavaa t aripat  man ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਗੁਣ ਿਵਥਰਾ  ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it tome. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: antar pi-aas har naam kee gur t us milaavai so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਜਣੁ  ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀਆ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਜਣ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By HisPleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.
lines.transliteration: man rangahu vadbhaageeho gur t uthaa karay pasaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੈ  ਨਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am asacrifice to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur naam drirh-aa-ay rang si-o ha-o sat gur kai bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people mayperform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur har naam na labh -ee lakh  kotee karam kamaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਿਸ ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home ofour own inner being, always near and close at hand.
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa sat gur naa milai gh ar baith i-aa nikat nit  paas.

lines.english: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.
lines.transliteration: antar agi-aan d ukh bharam hai vich parh -daa door pa-ee-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ  ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ  ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without meeting with the True Guru, no on e is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay kanchan naa thee-ai manmukh  lohu boodaa bayrh ee paas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?
lines.transliteration: satgur bohith har naav hai kit  biDh charh i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai jo chalai vich bohith baith aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਾ ਿਮਲੈ ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਿਠਆ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਿਨਤ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an vadbh aagee naankaa jinaa sat gur la-ay milaa-ay. ||4||3||67|| Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with theLord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67|| pMnw 41 isrIrwgu mhlw 4 ] (41-1) sireeraag mehlaa 4. Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way toGod-I would go with him.
lines.transliteration: ha-o panth dasaa-ee nit  kharhee ko-ee parabh  dasay t in jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ  ਿਨਤ  ਖੜੀ ਕੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਸੇ ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I follow in the footsteps of those who enjoy the Love of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: jinee mayraa pi-aaraa raavi-aa tin peechh ai laag firaa-o.

lines.english: I beg of them, I implore them; I have such a yearning to meet God! ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar minat kar jod -rhee mai parabh  milnai kaa chaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਮੰਨਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਜੋਦੜੀ  ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਲਣੈ  ਕਾ ਚਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my Siblings of Destiny, please unite me in Union with my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: mayray bhaa-ee janaa ko-ee mo ka-o har parabh  mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has shown me the Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o satgur vitahu vaari-aa jin har parabh  dee-aa d ikhaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In deep humility, I fall at the Feet of the Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay nimaanee dh eh pavaa pooray sat gur paas.

lines.english: The Guru is the Honor of the dishonored. The Guru, the True Guru, brings approval and applause.
lines.transliteration: nimaani-aa gur maan  hai gur sat gur karay saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਿਨਮਾਣੀ  ਢਿਹ ਪਵਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: I am never tired of praising the Guru, who unites me with the Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o gur saalaahi na raj-oo mai maylay har parabh paas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਾਿਣਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone, all over the world, longs for the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur no sabh  ko lochd aa jayt aa jagat  sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਨ ਰਜਊ  ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the good fortune of destiny, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is notobtained. The unfortunate ones just sit and cry.
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa d arsan naa thee-ai bh aagheen  bahi ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨੋ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਲੋਚਦਾ  ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All things happen according to the Will of the Lord God. No one can erase the pre-ordained Writ of Destiny. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo har parabh bh aanaa so thee-aa Dh ur likh i-aa na maytai ko-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ  ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਬਿਹ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself is the Lord. He Himself unites in His Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur aap har aapay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣਾ  ਸੋ ਥੀਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In His Kindness, He unites us with Himself, as we follow the Guru, the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aa kar maylsee gur sat gur peechh ai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Over all the world, He is the Life of the World, O Nanak, like water mingled with water. ||4||4||68|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 ] (41-9) sireeraag mehlaa 4. Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh jagjeevan jag aap hai naanak jal jaleh samaa-ay. ||4||4||68||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੀਛੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Essence of the Ambrosial Naam is the most sublime essence; how can I get totaste this essence?
lines.transliteration: ras amrit naam ras at  bhalaa kit  biDh milai ras kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਿਗ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਲੁ ਜਲਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥੪॥੬੮॥
lines.english: I go and ask the happy soul-brides, "How did you come to meet God?"
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay puchhahu sohaagan ee tusaa ki-o kar mili-aa parabh  aa-ay.

lines.english: They are care-free and do not speak; I massage and wash their feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: o-ay vayparvaah na bolnee ha-o mal mal Dhovaa t in paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਿਤ  ਭਲਾ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਮਲੈ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, meet with your sp iritual friend, and dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray mil sajan  har gun  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਤੁਸਾ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is your Friend, who shall drive out pain and subdueyour ego. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sajan sat gur purakh  hai d ukh kadh ai ha-umai maar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ  ਨ ਬੋਲਨੀ  ਹਉ ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੋਵਾ ਿਤਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are the happy soul-brides; their minds are filled with kindness.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhee-aa sohaagan ee tin da-i-aa pa-ee man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਜਣ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the True Guru is the Jewel. One who believes in it tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur vachan rat ann hai jo mannay so har ras kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who partake of the Lord's Sublime Essence, through the Guru's Love, areknown as great and very fortunate. ||2||
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee vad jaan ee-ahi jin har ras kh aaDhaa gur bh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: This Sublime Essence of the Lord is in the forests, in the fields and everywhere, butthe unfortunate ones do not taste it.
lines.transliteration: ih har ras van t in sabh at hai bh aagheen  nahee kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਤਨ ਦਇਆ  ਪਈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, it is not obtained. The self-willed manmukhs continue to cry inmisery.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur palai naa pavai manmukh  rahay billaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਵਚਨੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They do not bow before the True Guru; the demon of anger is within them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: o-ay satgur aagai naa niveh onaa ant ar kroDh  balaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਧਾ  ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself, Har, Har, Har, is the Sublime Essence. The Lord Himself is theEssence.
lines.transliteration: har har har ras aap hai aapay har ras ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਵਿਣ ਿਤਿਣ  ਸਭਤੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In His Kindness, He blesses the Gurmukh with  it; the Ambrosial Nectar of this Amrit trickles down.
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aa kar d ayvsee gurmukh  amrit  cho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਰਹੇ ਿਬਲਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Then, the body and mind totally blossom forth and flourish; O Nanak, the Lord comesto dwell within the mind. ||4||5||69|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 ] (41-17) sireeraag mehlaa 4. Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh t an man hari-aa ho-i-aa naanak har vasi-aa man so-ay. ||4||5||69||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਨਾ ਿਨਵਿਹ  ਓਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਬਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The day dawns, and then it ends, and the night passes away.
lines.transliteration: dinas charh ai fir aathvai rain  sabaa-ee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Man's life is diminishing, but he does not understand. Each day, the mouse of death isgnawing away at the rope of life.
lines.transliteration: aav ghatai nar naa bujh ai nit moosaa laaj tukaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਵਸੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਚੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Maya spreads out like sweet molasses; the self-willed manmukh is stuck like a fly,rotting away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurh mith aa maa-i-aa pasri-aa manmukh  lag maakh ee pachai pachaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ ਮਿਨ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬੯॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, God is my Friend and Companion.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray mai meet  sakhaa parabh  so-ay.

lines.english: Emotional attachment to children and spouse is poison; in the end, no one will go along with you as your helper. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: put kalat  moh bikh  hai ant  baylee ko-ay na ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, some embrace love for the Lord, and are saved. They remain detached and unaffected, and they find the Sanctuary of the Lord. pMnw 42
lines.transliteration: gurmat har liv ubray alipat  rahay sarn aa-ay.

lines.english: They keep death constantly before their eyes; they gather the Provisions of the Lord's Name, and receive honor.
lines.transliteration: onee chalan sad aa nihaali-aa har kh arach lee-aa pat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਹਾਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਖਰਚੁ  ਲੀਆ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. The Lord Himself takes them in His Loving Embrace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d argeh manee-ah har aap la-ay gal laa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮੰਨੀਅਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਲਏ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: For the Gurmukhs, the Way is obvious. At the Lord's Door, they face no obstructions.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa no panth pargataa d ar thaak na ko-ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ  ਦਿਰ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They praise the Lord's Name, they keep the Naam in their minds, and they remainattached to the Love of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: har naam salaahan naam man naam rahan liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹਿਨ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Celestial Music vibrates for them at the Lord's Door, and they arehonored at the True Door. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anhad Dh unee d ar vajd ay dar sachai sobh aa paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਨੀ ਦਿਰ ਵਜਦੇ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who praise the Naam are applauded by everyone.
lines.transliteration: jinee gurmukh naam sahaali-aa t inaa sabh  ko kahai saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Grant me their company, God-I am a beggar; this is my prayer.
lines.transliteration: tin kee sangat  deh parabh  mai jaachik kee ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਦੇਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੈ ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, great is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who are filled with the Light ofthe Naam within. ||4||33||31||6||70|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 Gru 1 ] (42-6) sireeraag mehlaa 5 ghar 1. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaag vaday t inaa gurmukh aa jin ant ar naam pargaas. ||4||33||31||6||70||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਿਤਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Why are you so thrilled by the sight of your son and your beautifully decorated wife?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa too rat aa daykh kai put ar kalt ar seegaar.

lines.english: You enjoy tasty delicacies, you have lots of fun, and you indulge in endless pleasures.
lines.transliteration: ras bhogeh kh usee-aa karahi maan eh rang apaar.

lines.english: You give all sorts of commands, and you act so superior.
lines.transliteration: bahut karahi furmaa-isee vart eh ho-ay afaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਸੀਗਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator does not come into the mind of the blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukh. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kartaa chit  na aavee manmukh  anDh  gavaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਿਹ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, the Lord is the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: mayray man sukh-d aata har so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸੀ  ਵਰਤਿਹ  ਹੋਇ ਅਫਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is found. By His Mercy, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-ee-ai karam paraapat ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: People are entangled in the enjoyment of fine clothes, but gold and silver are onlydust.
lines.transliteration: kaparh bh og laptaa-i-aa su-inaa rupaa kh aak.

lines.english: They acquire beautiful horses and elephants, and ornate carriages of many kinds.
lines.transliteration: haivar gaivar baho rangay kee-ay rath athaak.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They think of nothing else, and they forget all their relatives.
lines.transliteration: kis hee chit na paavhee bisri-aa sabh  saak.

lines.english: They ignore their Creator; without the Name, they are impure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sirjanhaar bh ulaa-i-aa vin  naavai naapaak. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਪਿੜ  ਭੋਿਗ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ  ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: Gathering the wealth of Maya, you earn an evil reputation.
lines.transliteration: laidaa bad  du-aa-ay t ooN maa-i-aa karahi ikat .

lines.punjabi: ਹੈਵਰ  ਗੈਵਰ  ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੇ ਕੀਏ ਰਥ ਅਥਾਕ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom you work to please shall pass away along with you.
lines.transliteration: jis no tooN patee-aa-id aa so san  tujhai anit .

lines.english: The egotistical are engrossed in egotism, ensnared by the intellect of the mind.
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaar karahi ahaNkaaree-aa vi-aapi-aa man kee mat.

lines.english: One who is deceived by God Himself, has no position and no honor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin parabh  aap bh ulaa-i-aa naa t is jaat  na pat . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਲੈਦਾ ਬਦ ਦੁਆਇ  ਤੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਇਕਤ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has led me to meet the One, my only Friend.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  milaa-i-aa iko sajan  so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ  ਸੋ ਸਣੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਅਿਨਤ  ॥
lines.english: The One is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. Why should the proud cry out in ego?
lines.transliteration: har jan kaa raakhaa ayk hai ki-aa maan as ha-umai ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ  ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ॥
lines.english: As the servant of the Lord wills, so does the Lord act. At the Lord's Door, none of hisrequests are denied.
lines.transliteration: jo har jan bhaavai so karay d ar fayr na paavai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਪਿਤ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak is attuned to the Love of the Lord, whose Light pervades the entire Universe.||4||1||71|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (42-15) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rataa rang har sabh  jag meh chaanan  ho-ay. ||4||1||71||

lines.english: With the mind caught up in playful pleasures, involved in all sorts of amusements and sights that stagger the eyes, people are led astray.
lines.transliteration: man bilaas baho rang ghan aa darisat bh ool kh usee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਿਕਆ  ਮਾਣਸ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The emperors sitting on their thrones are consumed by anxiety. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chhat arDhaar baad isaahee-aa vich sahsay paree-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਰ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray sukh  saaDh sang paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਤਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: If the Supreme Lord, the Architect of Destiny, writes such an order, then anguish andanxiety are erased. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa laykh  tin purakh  biDhaatai dukh sahsaa mit ga-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There are so many places-I have wandered through them all.
lines.transliteration: jaytay thaan banant araa t aytay bh av aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Dhan paat ee vad bh oomee-aa mayree mayree kar pari-aa. ||2|| The masters of wealth and the great land-lords have fallen, crying out, "This is mine!This is mine!"||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਿਬਲਾਸੁ  ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣਾ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਭੂਿਲ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: They issue their commands fearlessly, and act in pride.
lines.transliteration: hukam chalaa-ay nisang ho-ay vartai afri-aa.

lines.english: They subdue all under their command, but without the Name, they are reduced todust. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh ko vasgat  kar la-i-on bin naavai kh aak rali-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Even those who are served by the 33 million angelic beings, at whose door theSiddhas and the Saadhus stand,
lines.transliteration: kot tayt ees sayvkaa siDh  saaDh ik dar khari-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, in the end, all this vanishes like a dream! ||4||2||72|| pMnw 43 isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (43-1) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: girambaaree vad saahbee sabh naanak supan thee-aa. ||4||2||72|| who live in wondrous affluence and rule over mountains, oceans and vast dominions-

lines.english: Arising each day, you cherish your body, but you are idiotic, ignorant and withoutunderstanding.
lines.transliteration: bhalkay uth  papolee-ai vin  bujhay mugaDh  ajaan .

lines.english: You are not conscious of God, and your body shall be cast into the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: so parabh chit  na aa-i-o chh utaigee baybaan .

lines.punjabi: ਭਲਕੇ  ਉਿਠ ਪਪੋਲੀਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: Focus your consciousness on the True Guru; you shall enjoy bliss forever and ever.||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayt ee chit  laa-ay sad aa sad aa rang maan . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਛੁਟੈਗੀ  ਬੇਬਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, you came here to earn a profit.
lines.transliteration: paraanee t ooN aa-i-aa laahaa lain .

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਤੀ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: What useless activities are you attached to? Your life-night is coming to its end.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lagaa kit kh ufkarh ay sabh  mukd ee chalee rain . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The animals and the birds frolic and play-they do not see death.
lines.transliteration: kudam karay pas pankh ee-aa d isai naahee kaal.

lines.english: Mankind is also with them, trapped in the net of Maya.
lines.transliteration: otai saath manukh  hai faathaa maa-i-aa jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਲਗਾ  ਿਕਤੁ  ਕੁਫਕੜੇ  ਸਭ ਮੁਕਦੀ  ਚਲੀ  ਰੈਿਣ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who always remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are considered to be liberated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: muktay say-ee bh aalee-ah je sachaa naam samaal. ||2||

lines.english: That dwelling which you will have to abandon and vacate-you are attached to it inyour mind.
lines.transliteration: jo ghar chh ad gavaavn aa so lagaa man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀਆ  ਿਦਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: And that place where you must go to dwell-you have no regard for it at all.
lines.transliteration: jithai jaa-ay tuDh  vartanaa tis kee chint aa naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਓਤੈ ਸਾਿਥ  ਮਨੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਾਥਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Those who fall at the Feet of the Guru are released from this bondage. ||3||
lines.transliteration: faathay say-ee niklay je gur kee pairee paahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਸੇਈ ਭਾਲੀਅਿਹ ਿਜ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: No one else can save you-don't look for anyone else.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee rakh na sak-ee d oojaa ko na d ikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਘਰੁ ਛਿਡ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ  ਸੋ ਲਗਾ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched in all four directions; I have come to find His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa bhaal kai aa-ay pa-i-aa sarn aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True King has pulled me out and saved me from drowning! ||4||3||73|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (43-8) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai paatisaah dubd aa la-i-aa kadh aa-ay. ||4||3||73||

lines.punjabi: ਫਾਥੇ ਸੇਈ ਿਨਕਲੇ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: For a brief moment, man is a guest of the Lord; he tries to resolve his affairs.
lines.transliteration: gharh ee muhat  kaa paahun aa kaaj savaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਰਿਖ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨ ਿਦਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Engrossed in Maya and sexual desire, the fool does not understand.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaam vi-aapi-aa samjhai naahee gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਿਲ  ਕੈ ਆਇ  ਪਇਆ  ਸਰਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He arises and departs with regret, and falls into the clutches of the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: uth chali-aa pachh utaa-i-aa pari-aa vas jand aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੈ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਿਹ  ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਇਆ  ਕਢਾਇ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: You are sitting on the collapsing riverbank-are you blind?
lines.transliteration: anDhay t ooN baith aa kanDh ee paahi.

lines.english: If you are so pre-destined, then act according to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay hovee poorab likhi-aa t aa gur kaa bachan kamaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Reaper does not look upon any as unripe, half-ripe or fully ripe.
lines.transliteration: haree naahee nah daduree pakee vadhan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ  ਮੁਹਤ  ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਕਾਜ  ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Picking up and wielding their sickles, the harvesters arrive.
lines.transliteration: lai lai daat  pahut i-aa laavay kar t a-ee-aar.

lines.english: When the landlord gives the order, they cut and measure the crop. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa ho-aa hukam kirsaan d aa taa lun  mini-aa kh aytaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਿਠ ਚਿਲਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ  ਪਿਰਆ  ਵਿਸ ਜੰਦਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The first watch of the night passes away in worthless affairs, and the second passes indeep sleep.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa pahar DhanDh ai ga-i-aa d oojai bh ar so-i-aa.

lines.english: In the third, they babble nonsense, and when the fourth watch comes, the day of death has arrived.
lines.transliteration: teejai jh aakh jhakhaa-i-aa cha-uthai bh or bha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The thought of the One who bestows body and soul never enters the mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kad hee chit  na aa-i-o jin jee-o pind d ee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I sacrifice my soul tothem.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  ka-o vaari-aa jee-o kee-aa kurbaan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਹ ਡਡੁਰੀ ਪਕੀ ਵਢਣਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Through them, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the All-knowingLord God.
lines.transliteration: jis tay sojh ee man pa-ee mili-aa purakh  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦਾਤ  ਪਹੁਿਤਆ  ਲਾਵੇ  ਕਿਰ ਤਈਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak sees the Lord always with him-the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher ofhearts. ||4||4||74|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (43-15) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dithaa sad aa naal har ant arjaamee jaan . ||4||4||74||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਹੋਆ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਿਕਰਸਾਣ  ਦਾ ਤਾ ਲੁਿਣ  ਿਮਿਣਆ  ਖੇਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Let me forget everything, but let me not forget the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabhay galaa visran iko visar na jaa-o.

lines.english: DhanDh aa sabh  jalaa-ay kai gur naam d ee-aa sach su-aa-o. All my evil pursuits have been burnt away; the Guru has blessed me with the Naam,the true object of life.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਪਹਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਇਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਿਰ ਸੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Give up all other hopes, and rely on the One Hope.
lines.transliteration: aasaa sabhay laahi kai ikaa aas kamaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਜੈ  ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਇਆ  ਚਉਥੈ  ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru receive a place in the world hereafter. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jinee satgur sayvi-aa t in agai mili-aa thaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, praise the Creator.
lines.transliteration: man mayray kartay no saalaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀਆ  ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Give up all your clever tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabhay chh ad si-aan paa gur kee pairee paahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਮਿਨ ਪਈ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Pain and hunger shall not oppress you, if the Giver of Peace comes into your mind.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhukh nah vi-aapa-ee jay sukh -daata man ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਡਠਾ  ਸਦਾ ਨਾਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: No undertaking shall fail, when the True Lord is always in your heart.
lines.transliteration: kit hee kamm na chh ijee-ai jaa hird ai sachaa so-ay.

lines.english: No one can kill that one unto whom You, Lord, give Your Hand and protect.
lines.transliteration: jis tooN rakheh hath d ay tis maar na sakai ko-ay.

lines.english: Serve the Guru, the Giver of Peace; He shall remove and wash off all your faults. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata gur sayvee-ai sabh  avgan  kadh ai Dho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service. pMnw 44
lines.transliteration: sayvaa mangai sayvko laa-ee-aaN apunee sayv.

lines.english: The opportunity to work hard serving the Saadh Sangat is obtained, when the Divine Lord is pleased.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang maskat ay toothai paavaa d ayv.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਸਕਤੇ  ਤੂਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ  ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.english: Everything is in the Hands of our Lord and Master; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  vasgat  saahibai aapay karan  karayv.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਸਾਿਹਬੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਵ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who fulfills all hopes and desires. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur kai balihaarn ai mansaa sabh  poorayv. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇਵ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The One appears to be my Companion; the One is my Brother and Friend.
lines.transliteration: iko disai sajn o iko bh aa-ee meet .

lines.english: The elements and the components are all made by the One; they are held in their order by the One.
lines.transliteration: iksai dee saamagree iksai d ee hai reet .

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੈ  ਦੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ  ਇਕਸੈ  ਦੀ ਹੈ ਰੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: When the mind accepts, and is satisfied with the One, then the consciousnessbecomes steady and stable.
lines.transliteration: ikas si-o man maani-aa taa ho-aa nihchal cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਤਾ ਹੋਆ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਚੀਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: Then, one's food is the True Name, one's garments are the True Name, and one'sSupport, O Nanak, is the True Name. ||4||5||75|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (44-4) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach khaan aa sach painn aa tayk naanak sach keet . ||4||5||75||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਕੀਤੁ  ॥੪॥੫॥੭੫॥
lines.english: All things are received if the One is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sabhay thok paraapat ay jay aavai ik hath.

lines.english: The precious gift of this human life becomes fruitful when one chants the True Wordof the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath safal hai jay sachaa sabad  kath.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ  ਜੇ ਆਵੈ  ਇਕੁ ਹਿਥ ॥
lines.english: One who has such destiny written on his forehead enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur tay mahal paraapat ay jis likh i-aa hovai math. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਿਥ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the One.
lines.transliteration: mayray man aykas si-o chit laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਰਾਪਤੇ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮਿਥ ॥
lines.english: Without the One, all entanglements are worthless; emotional attachment to Maya istotally false. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aykas bin sabh Dh anDh hai sabh  mithi-aa moh maa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Hundreds of thousands of princely pleasures are enjoyed, if the True Guru bestowsHis Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: lakh kh usee-aa paat isaahee-aa jay sat gur nad ar karay-i.

lines.english: If He bestows the Name of the Lord, for even a moment, my mind and body arecooled and soothed.
lines.transliteration: nimakh ayk har naam d ay-ay mayraa man t an seet al ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਭ ਧੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny hold tight to the Feet of the True Guru.||2||
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in sat gur charan gahay. ||2||

lines.english: Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful is that time, when one is in love with the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: safal moorat saflaa gh arhee jit sachay naal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੀਆ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Suffering and sorrow do not touch those who have the Support of the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: dookh  santaap na lag-ee jis har kaa naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਖ  ਏਕ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Grasping him by the arm, the Guru lifts them up and out, and carries them across to the other side. ||3||
lines.transliteration: baah pakarh gur kaadh i-aa so-ee ut ri-aa paar. ||3||

lines.english: Embellished and immaculate is that place where the Saints gather together.
lines.transliteration: thaan suhaavaa pavit hai jithai sant  sabh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲਾ  ਘੜੀ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone finds shelter, who has met the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: dho-ee t is hee no milai jin pooraa guroo labh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ  ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak builds his house upon that site where there is no death, no birth, and no oldage. ||4||6||76|| sRIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (44-11) sareeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak baDhaa gh ar tahaaN jithai mirat  na janam jaraa. ||4||6||76||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿੜ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਿਢਆ  ਸੋਈ ਉਤਿਰਆ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditate on Him, O my soul; He is the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors.
lines.transliteration: so-ee Dhi-aa-ee-ai jee-arh ay sir saahaaN paatisaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਥੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ॥
lines.english: Place the hopes of your mind in the One, in whom all have faith.
lines.transliteration: tis hee kee kar aas man jis kaa sabh as vaysaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਢੋਈ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਨੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਭਾ  ॥
lines.english: Give up all your clever tricks, and grasp the Feet of the Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh si-aan paa chh ad kai gur kee charn ee paahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਧਾ ਘਰੁ ਤਹ ਿਜਥੈ ਿਮਰਤੁ  ਨ ਜਨਮੁ  ਜਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੬॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name with intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: man mayray sukh sahj sayt ee jap naa-o.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on God. Constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  Dhi-aa-ay t ooN gun go-ind  nit gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Seek His Shelter, O my mind; there is no other as Great as He.
lines.transliteration: tis kee sarnee par manaa jis jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਕਿਰ ਆਸ  ਮਨ ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ  ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, a profound peace is obtained. Pain and suffering will not touch you at all.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat sukh  ho-ay gh anaa dukh darad na moolay ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਸਆਣਪਾ  ਛਿਡ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, work for God; He is our True Lord and Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa kar chaakree parabh  saahib sachaa so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਤੀ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become absolutely pure, andthe noose of death shall be cut away.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  ho-ay nirmalaa katee-ai jam kee faas.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਇੰਦ ਿਨਤ  ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So offer your prayers to Him, the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata bhai bhanjno t is aagai kar ard aas.

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, the Merciful Master shall resolve your affairs. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mihar karay jis miharvaan taaN kaaraj aavai raas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ  ਪਰੁ ਮਨਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is said to be the Greatest of the Great; His Kingdom is the Highest of theHigh.
lines.transliteration: bahuto bahut  vakh aanee-ai oocho oochaa thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He has no color or mark; His Value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: varnaa chihnaa baahraa keemat kahi na sakaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please show Mercy to Nanak, God, and bless him with Your True Name. ||4||7||77|| sRIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (44-18) sareeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh ma-i-aa kar sach d ayvhu apun aa naa-o. ||4||7||77||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ ਕਟੀਐ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ॥
lines.english: One who meditates on the Naam is at peace; his face is radiant and bright.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ay so sukh ee tis mukh  oojal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ  ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕਿਰ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Obtaining it from the Perfect Guru, he is honored all over the world.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay paa-ee-ai pargat sabh nee lo-ay.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the One True Lord comes to abide within the home of the self. ||1|| pMnw 45
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai gh ar vasai ayko sachaa so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har har naam Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: The Naam is your Companion; it shall always be with you. It shall save you in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam sahaa-ee sadaa sang aagai la-ay chh adaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਆਗੈ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What good is worldly greatness?
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kee-aa vad i-aa-ee-aa kavnai aavahi kaam.

lines.english: All the pleasures of Maya are tasteless and insipid. In the end, they shall all fade away.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaa rang sabh fikaa jaat o binas nid aan.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਕੀਆ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਕਵਨੈ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਕਾਿਮ  ॥
lines.english: Perfectly fulfilled and supremely acclaimed is the one, in whose heart the Lord abides.||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hirdai har vasai so pooraa parDh aan. ||2||

lines.english: Become the dust of the Saints; renounce your selfishness and conceit.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kee hohu rayn ukaa apn aa aap t i-aag.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Give up all your schemes and your clever mental tricks, and fall at the Feet of theGuru.
lines.transliteration: upaav si-aanap sagal chh ad gur kee charn ee laag.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: He alone receives the Jewel, upon whose forehead such wondrous destiny is written.||3||
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  ratan ho-ay jis mast ak hovai bh aag. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਾਵ ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਸਗਲ  ਛਿਡ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, it is received only when God Himself bestows it.
lines.transliteration: tisai paraapat  bhaa-eeho jis d ayvai parabh  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: People serve the True Guru only when the fever of egotism has been eradicated.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa so karay jis binsai ha-umai t aap.

lines.english: Nanak has met the Guru; all his sufferings have come to an end. ||4||8||78|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (45-6) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur bhayti-aa binsay sagal sant aap. ||4||8||78||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਾਪੁ ॥
lines.english: The One is the Knower of all beings; He alone is our Savior.
lines.transliteration: ik pachhaan oo jee-a kaa iko rakh anhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਤਾਪ  ॥੪॥੮॥੭੮॥
lines.english: The One is the Support of the mind; the One is the Support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: ikas kaa man aasraa iko paraan aDh aar.

lines.english: In His Sanctuary there is eternal peace. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Creator. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis sarn aa-ee sad aa sukh  paarbarahm kart aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ  ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਇਕੋ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, give up all these efforts.
lines.transliteration: man mayray sagal upaav ti-aag.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸ  ਕਾ ਮਿਨ ਆਸਰਾ  ਇਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Dwell upon the Perfect Guru each day, and attach yourself to the One Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraaDh nit  ikas kee liv laag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One is my Brother, the One is my Friend. The One is my Mother and Father.
lines.transliteration: iko bhaa-ee mit  ik iko maat  pitaa.

lines.english: The One is the Support of the mind; He has given us body and soul.
lines.transliteration: ikas kee man tayk hai jin jee-o pind dit aa.

lines.english: May I never forget God from my mind; He holds all in the Power of His Hands. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so parabh manhu na visrai jin sabh  kichh  vas keet aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਿਧ  ਿਨਤ ਇਕਸੁ  ਕੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One is within the home of the self, and the One is outside as well. He Himself isin all places and interspaces.
lines.transliteration: ghar iko baahar iko thaan thanant ar aap.

lines.english: Meditate twenty-four hours a day on the One who created all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  jin kee-ay aath  pahar t is jaap.

lines.english: Attuned to the Love of the One, there is no sorrow or suffering. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ikas saytee rat i-aa na hovee sog sant aap. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸ  ਕੀ ਮਿਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਿਦਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: There is only the One Supreme Lord God; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh ayk hai d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਵਿਸ ਕੀਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Soul and body all belong to Him; whatever pleases His Will comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is kaa jo t is bhaavai so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਇਕੋ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਇਕੋ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, one becomes perfect; O Nanak, meditate on the True One. ||4||9||79|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (45-13) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pooraa bha-i-aa jap naanak sachaa so-ay. ||4||9||79||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਏ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled andfamous.
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur si-o chit  laa-i-aa say pooray parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਤਆ  ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom wells up in the minds of those unto whom the Lord Himself showsMercy.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o aap da-i-aal ho-ay t in upjai man gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads obtain the Name of theLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o mastak likh i-aa tin paa-i-aa har naam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray ayko naam Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਇਆ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The happiness of all happiness shall well up, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be dressed in robes of honor. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh  oopjahi d argeh paiDh aa jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The fear of death and rebirth is removed by performing loving devotional service tothe Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa bh a-o ga-i-aa bh aa-o bh agat gopaal.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure;the Lord Himself takes care of such a one.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  nirmalaa aap karay part ipaal.

lines.english: The filth of birth and death is washed away, and one is uplifted, beholding the BlessedVision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee mal katee-ai gur d arsan d aykh nihaal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਿਤਨ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਮਿਨ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is pervading all places and interspaces.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahi-aa paarbarahm parabh  so-ay.

lines.english: The One is the Giver of all-there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa d aataa ayk hai d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: In His Sanctuary, one is saved. Whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis sarn aa-ee chh utee-ai keet aa lorh ay so ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਿਹ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Perfectly fulfilled and famous are those, in whose minds the Supreme Lord Godabides.
lines.transliteration: jin man vasi-aa paarbarahm say pooray parDhaan.

lines.english: Their reputation is spotless and pure; they are famous all over the world.
lines.transliteration: tin kee sobh aa nirmalee pargat bh a-ee jahaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ  ਭਾਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on my God. ||4||10||80|| pMnw 46 isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (46-1) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinee mayraa parabh Dh i-aa-i-aa naanak t in kurbaan. ||4||10||80||

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, all my sufferings have ended, and the Peace of the Lord hascome to dwell within my mind.
lines.transliteration: mil satgur sabh  dukh ga-i-aa har sukh  vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.english: The Divine Light illuminates my inner being, and I am lovingly absorbed in the One.
lines.transliteration: antar jot  pargaasee-aa aykas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Holy Saint, my face is radiant; I have realized my pre-ordaineddestiny.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo mukh  oojlaa poorab likh i-aa paa-ay.

lines.english: I constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. Through the True Name, Ihave become spotlessly pure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun govind  nit gaavn ay nirmal saachai naa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, you shall find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur sabdee sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Working for the Perfect Guru, no one goes away empty-handed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee chaakree birthaa jaa-ay na ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of theLord, is obtained.
lines.transliteration: man kee-aa ichhaaN pooree-aa paa-i-aa naam niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is always with you; recognize Him as theCreator.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee sad aa sang karn aihaar pachh aan.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, your face shall be radiant. Chanting the Naam, you shall receive thebenefits of giving charity and taking cleansing baths.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee mukh oojlaa jap naam d aan isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ  ਇਛ  ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and greed are eliminated, and all egotistical pride is abandoned.||2||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  binsi-aa t aji-aa sabh  abhimaan. ||2||

lines.english: The Profit of the Naam is obtained, and all affairs are brought to fruition.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa laahaa laabh naam pooran ho-ay kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: In His Mercy, God unites us with Himself, and He blesses us with the Naam.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh mayli-aa d ee-aa apn aa naam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਿਬਨਿਸਆ  ਤਿਜਆ  ਸਭੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My comings and goings in reincarnation have come to an end; He Himself hasbestowed His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa reh ga-i-aa aap ho-aa miharvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਆ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have obtained my home in the True Mansion of His Presence, realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sach mahal ghar paa-i-aa gur kaa sabad  pachh aan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਦੀਆ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: His humble devotees are protected and saved; He Himself showers His Blessings uponus.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa ka-o raakh -daa aapn ee kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਰਿਹ ਗਇਆ  ਆਿਪ ਹੋਆ  ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: In this world and in the world hereafter, radiant are the faces of those who cherishand enshrine the Glories of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  mukh  oojlay saachay kay gun  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, they lovingly dwell upon His Glories; they are imbued withHis Infinite Love.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun  saard ay rat ay rang apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਦਾ  ਆਪਣੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God, the Ocean of Peace.||4||11||81|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (46-10) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm sukh saagro naanak sad  balihaar. ||4||11||81||

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ  ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: If we meet the Perfect True Guru, we obtain the Treasure of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur jay milai paa-ee-ai sabad  niDhaan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਦੇ  ਰਤੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, God, that we may meditate on Your Ambrosial Naam.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aapn ee japee-ai amrit  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੧॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death are taken away; we are intuitively centered on His Meditation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh kaatee-ai laagai sahj Dh i-aan. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, seek the Sanctuary of God.
lines.transliteration: mayray man parabh sarn aa-ee paa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Lord, there is no other at all. Meditate on the One and only Naam, theName of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bin doojaa ko nahee ayko naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਪਣੀ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: His Value cannot be estimated; He is the Vast Ocean of Excellence.
lines.transliteration: keemat kahan  na jaa-ee-ai saagar gun ee athaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O most fortunate ones, join the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation; purchase the TrueWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee mil sangt ee sachaa sabad  visaahu.

lines.english: Serve the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa sukh saagrai sir saahaa paat isaahu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I take the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet; there is no other place of rest for me.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasraa d oojaa naahee th aa-o.

lines.english: I lean upon You as my Support, O Supreme Lord God. I exist only by Your Power.
lines.transliteration: mai Dhar t ayree paarbarahm t ayrai t aan rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ  ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O God, You are the Honor of the dishonored. I seek to merge with You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nimaani-aa parabh  maan  tooN tayrai sang samaa-o. ||3||

lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name and contemplate the Lord of the World, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: har japee-ai aaraaDhee-ai aath  pahar govind .

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੈ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He preserves our soul, our breath of life, body and wealth. By His Grace, He protectsour soul.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan t an Dh an rakh ay kar kirpaa raakh ee jind .

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, all pain has been washed away, by the Supreme Lord God, the Forgiver.||4||12||82|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (46-17) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saglay dokh  utaari-an parabh  paarbarahm bakh sind. ||4||12||82||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਿਣ  ਰਹਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have fallen in love with the True Lord. He does not die, He does not come and go.
lines.transliteration: pareet lagee t is sach si-o marai na aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਾਿਣਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In separation, He is not separated from us; He is pervading and permeating amongstall.
lines.transliteration: naa vaychhorh i-aa vichh urhai sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਆਰਾਧੀਐ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Destroyer of the pain and suffering of the meek. He bears True Love for Hisservants.
lines.transliteration: deen d arad dukh bhanjnaa sayvak kai sat  bhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਾਖੀ  ਿਜੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Wondrous is the Form of the Immaculate One. Through the Guru, I have met Him, Omy mother! ||1||
lines.transliteration: achraj roop niranjano gur maylaa-i-aa maa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੋਖ ਉਤਾਿਰਅਨ ੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬਖਿਸੰਦੁ  ॥੪॥੧੨॥੮੨॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, make God your Friend. pMnw 47
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray meet  karahu parabh  so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਪਰੀਿਤ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Cursed is emotional attachment and love of Maya; no one is seen to be at peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh pareet Dh arig sukh ee na d eesai ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God is Wise, Giving, Tender-hearted, Pure, Beautiful and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: daanaa d aataa seelvant  nirmal roop apaar.

lines.english: He is our Companion and Helper, Supremely Great, Lofty and Utterly Infinite.
lines.transliteration: sakhaa sahaa-ee at  vadaa oochaa vadaa apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਅਿਤ  ਵਡਾ ਊਚਾ  ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is not known as young or old; His Court is Steady and Stable.
lines.transliteration: baalak biraDh na jaan ee-ai nihchal t is darvaar.

lines.english: Whatever we seek from Him, we receive. He is the Support of the unsupported. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo mangee-ai so-ee paa-ee-ai niDhaaraa aaDh aar. ||2||

lines.english: Seeing Him, our evil inclinations vanish; mind and body become peaceful and tranquil.
lines.transliteration: jis paykhat  kilvikh  hireh man t an hovai saaNt.

lines.english: With one-pointed mind, meditate on the One Lord, and the doubts of your mind willbe dispelled.
lines.transliteration: ik man ayk Dhi-aa-ee-ai man kee laahi bh araaNt.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਏਕੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਿਹ  ਭਰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Ev er-fresh Being. His Gift is Perfect and Complete.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan navt an sad aa pooran jaa kee d aat.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him. Day and night, do not forget Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa aaraaDh ee-ai d in visrahu nahee raat . ||3||

lines.english: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Lord of the Universe as hisCompanion.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in kaa sakh aa govind .

lines.english: I dedicate my body, mind, wealth and all to Him. I totally sacrifice my soul to Him.
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an arpee sabh o sagal vaaree-ai ih jind .

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਸਭੋ ਸਗਲ  ਵਾਰੀਐ  ਇਹ ਿਜੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing and hearing, He is always close at hand. In each and every heart, God ispervading.
lines.transliteration: daykh ai sun ai had oor sad  ghat ghat barahm ravind .

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਸਦ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਰਿਵੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Even the ungrateful ones are cherished by God. O Nanak, He is forever the Forgiver.||4||13||83|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (47-7) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: akirat-gh anaa no paald aa parabh  naanak sad  bakh sind. ||4||13||83||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਕਰਤਘਣਾ  ਨੋ ਪਾਲਦਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਖਿਸੰਦੁ  ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੩॥
lines.english: This mind, body and wealth were given by God, who naturally adorns us.
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an jin parabh  dee-aa rakh i-aa sahj savaar.

lines.english: He has blessed us with all our energy, and infused His Infinite Light deep within us.
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa kar thaapi-aa antar jot  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਦੀਆ  ਰਿਖਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God; keep Him enshrined in your heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa parabh  simree-ai ant ar rakh  ur Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਿਪਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, without the Lord, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਸਮਰੀਐ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remain in God's Sanctuary forever, and no suffering shall afflict you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh sarn aa-ee sad aa rahu d ookh na vi-aapai ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Jewels, treasures, pearls, gold and silver-all these are just dust.
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath maan kaa su-inaa rupaa kh aak.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mother, father, children and relatives-all relations are false.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  banDh paa koorh ay sabh ay saak.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is an insulting beast; he does not acknowledge the One whocreated him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin keetaa t iseh na jaan -ee manmukh  pas naapaak. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਮਾਣਕਾ  ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is pervading within and beyond, and yet people think that He is far away.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar rav rahi-aa t is no jaan ai door.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ  ਕੂੜੇ ਸਭੇ ਸਾਕ ॥
lines.english: They are engrossed in clinging desires; within their hearts there is ego and falsehood.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa laagee rach rahi-aa ant ar ha-umai koor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਪਸੁ ਨਾਪਾਕ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without devotion to the Naam, crowds of people come and go. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee naam vihoon i-aa aavahi vanj ahi poor. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Please preserve Your beings and creatures, God; O Creator Lord, please be merciful!
lines.transliteration: raakh layho parabh  karanhaar jee-a jant  kar d a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਰਿਚ ਰਿਹਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Without God, there is no saving grace. The Messenger of Death is cruel and unfeeling.
lines.transliteration: bin parabh ko-ay na rakh anhaar mahaa bikat jam bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord!||4||14||84|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (47-15) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesra-o kar apunee har ma-i-aa. ||4||14||84||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: "My body and my wealth; my ruling power, my beautiful form and country-mine!"
lines.transliteration: mayraa tan ar Dh an mayraa raaj roop mai d ays.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਿਬਕਟ  ਜਮ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You may have children, a wife and many mistresses; you may enjoy all sorts ofpleasures and fine clothes.
lines.transliteration: sut daaraa banit aa anayk bahut  rang ar vays.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਉ  ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧੪॥
lines.english: And yet, if the Name of the Lord does not abide within the heart, none of it has anyuse or value. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naam ridai na vas-ee kaaraj kit ai na laykh . ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har har naam Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: Always keep the Company of the Holy, and focus your consciousness on the Feet ofthe Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar sangat nit  saaDh  kee gur charn ee chit  laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਰੂਪ ਮੈ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads meditate on the Treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan Dh i-aa-ee-ai mast ak hovai bh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ  ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.english: All their affairs are brought to fruition, holding onto the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaaree-ah gur kee charn ee laag.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਈ  ਕਾਰਿਜ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਲੇਿਖ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The diseases of ego and doubt are cast out; they shall not come and go inreincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog bharam katee-ai naa aavai naa jaag. ||2||

lines.english: Let the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, be your cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: kar sangat t oo saaDh  kee ath sath tirath naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your soul, breath of life, mind and body shall blossom forth in lush profusion; this is the true purpose of life. pMnw 48
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan man t an haray saachaa ayhu su-aa-o.

lines.english: In this world you shall be blessed with greatness, and in the Court of the Lord you shall find your place of rest. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aithai mileh vadaa-ee-aa dargahi paavahi thaa-o. ||3||

lines.english: God Himself acts, and causes others to act; everything is in His Hands.
lines.transliteration: karay karaa-ay aap parabh sabh  kichh  tis hee haath.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਹਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself bestows life and death; He is with us, within and beyond.
lines.transliteration: maar aapay jeevaaldaa ant ar baahar saath.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Master of all hearts. ||4||15||85|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (48-3) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee sarab gh ataa kay naath. ||4||15||85||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਘਟਾ  ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Guru is Merciful; we seek the Sanctuary of God.
lines.transliteration: saran pa-ay parabh  aapn ay gur ho-aa kirpaal.

lines.english: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, all worldly entanglements are eliminated.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai upd aysi-ai binsay sarab janjaal.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is firmly implanted within my mind; through His AmbrosialGlance of Grace, I am exalted and enraptured. ||1||
lines.transliteration: andar lagaa raam naam amrit  nadar nihaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਪਣੇ  ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ  ਿਕਰਪਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man mayray satgur sayvaa saar.

lines.english: God Himself grants His Grace; do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karay da-i-aa parabh  aapn ee ik nimakh  na manhu visaar. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਲਗਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer ofdemerits.
lines.transliteration: gun govind  nit gavee-ah avgun  katan haar.

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace. Having tried all sorts of ostentatiousdisplays, I have come to see this.
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na sukh ho-ay kar dith ay bisthaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Intuitively imbued with His Praises, one is saved, crossing over the terrifying world- ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sehjay siftee rat i-aa bh avjal ut ray paar. ||2||

lines.english: The merits of pilgrimages, fasts and hundreds of thousands of techniques of austereself-discipline are found in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: tirath varat  lakh sanjmaa paa-ee-ai saaDh oo Dh oor.

lines.english: From whom are you trying to hide your actions? God sees all;
lines.transliteration: look kamaavai kis tay jaa vaykh ai sad aa had oor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰ ਿਡਠੇ ਿਬਸਥਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He is Ever-present. My God is totally pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahi-aa parabh  mayraa bh arpoor. ||3||

lines.english: True is His Empire, and True is His Comma nd. True is His Seat of True Authority.
lines.transliteration: sach paatisaahee amar sach sachay sachaa thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਵਰਤ  ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: True is the Creative Power which He has created. True is the world which He has fashioned.
lines.transliteration: sachee kudrat  Dhaaree-an sach sirji-on jahaan.

lines.punjabi: ਲੂਿਕ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਿਕਸ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chant the True Name; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.||4||16||86|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (48-10) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak japee-ai sach naam ha-o sadaa sad aa kurbaan. ||4||16||86||

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Make the effort, and chant the Lord's Name. O very fortunate ones, earn this wealth.
lines.transliteration: udam kar har jaapn aa vadbh aagee Dh an kh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੀ  ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and wash off the filth of countless incarnations. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsang har simran aa mal janam janam kee kaat. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray raam naam jap jaap.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Enjoy the fruits of your mind's desires; all suffering and sorrow shall depart. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man ichhay fal bh unch t oo sabh  chookai sog sant aap. rahaa-o.

lines.english: For His sake, you assumed this body; see God always with you.
lines.transliteration: jis kaaran t an Dh aari-aa so parabh  dithaa naal.

lines.english: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance ofGrace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poori-aa parabh aapn ee nad ar nihaal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪਣਾ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਧਨੁ ਖਾਿਟ  ॥
lines.english: The mind and body become spotlessly pure, enshrining love for the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal ho-i-aa laagee saach pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਣਾ  ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਕਾਿਟ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who dwells upon the Feet of the Supreme Lord God has truly performed allmeditations and austerities. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan bh ajay paarbarahm kay sabh  jap tap tin hee keet . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is a Gem, a Jewel, a Pearl.
lines.transliteration: ratan javayhar maan ikaa amrit  har kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਭੁੰਿਚ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ  ॥
lines.english: The essence of intuitive peace and bliss is obtained, O servant Nanak, by singing theGlories of God. ||4||17||87|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (48-15) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ras jan naanak har gun  gaa-o. ||4||17||87||

lines.english: That is the essence of the scriptures, and that is a good omen, by which one comes tochant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so-ee saasat sa-un  so-ay jit  japee-ai har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਤਨੁ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਡਠਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has given me the Wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord, and I, withoutshelter, have now obtained Shelter.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gur Dh an dee-aa mili-aa nithaavay thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ ਪੂਿਰਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Capital, and the True Way of Life, comes by chanting His Glories, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: saachee poonjee sach sanjamo aath pahar gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, God meets us, and we no longer die, or come or go inreincarnation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh bh ayti-aa maran  na aavan  jaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ ਭਜੇ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਿਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord, with single-minded love.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har bhaj sad aa ik rang.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਮਾਿਣਕਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He is contained deep within each and every heart. He is always with you, as yourHelper and Support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar rav rahi-aa sad aa sahaa-ee sang. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਰਸ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੭॥
lines.english: How can I measure the happiness of meditating on the Lord of the Universe?
lines.transliteration: sukhaa kee mit  ki-aa gan ee jaa simree govind .

lines.english: Those who taste it are satisfied and fulfilled; their souls know this Sublime Essence. pMnw 49
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhi-aa say t ariptaasi-aa uh ras jaan ai jind .

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, God, the Beloved, the Forgiver, comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: santaa sangat  man vasai parabh  pareet am bakh sind.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਬਖਿਸੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: One who has served his God is the emperor of kings||2||
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa parabh aapn aa so-ee raaj narind . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੋਈ ਰਾਜ ਨਿਰੰਦੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This is the time to speak and sing the Praise and the Glory of God, which brings themerit of millions of cleansing and purifying baths.
lines.transliteration: a-osar har jas gun raman  jit kot majan isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਸਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ  ਿਜਤੁ ਕੋਿਟ ਮਜਨ  ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The tongue which chants these Praises is worthy; there is no charity equal to this.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa uchrai gunvat ee ko-ay na pujai d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਉਚਰੈ  ਗੁਣਵਤੀ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Blessing us with His Glance of Grace, the Kind and Compassionate, All-powerful Lordcomes to dwell within the mind and body.
lines.transliteration: darisat Dh aar man t an vasai d a-i-aal purakh  miharvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: My soul, body and wealth are His. Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind Dhan t is daa ha-o sad aa sad aa kurbaan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One whom the Creator Lord has met and joined to Himself shall never again beseparated.
lines.transliteration: mili-aa kaday na vichh urhai jo mayli-aa kart aar.

lines.english: The True Creator Lord breaks the bonds of His slave.
lines.transliteration: daasaa kay banDh an kati-aa saachai sirjan haar.

lines.english: The doubter has been put back on the path; his merits and demerits have not been considered.
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa maarag paa-i-on gun  avgun  na beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the One who is the Support of every heart.||4||18||88|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (49-6) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis sarn aagat ee je sagal gh ataa aaDh aar. ||4||18||88||

lines.english: With your tongue, repeat the True Name, and your mind and body shall become pure.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa sachaa simree-ai man tan nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: Your mother and father and all your relations-without Him, there are none at all.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa saak aglay t is bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: If God Himself bestows His Mercy, then He is not forgotten, even for an instant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mihar karay jay aapnee chasaa na visrai so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸਾਕ ਅਗਲੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve the True One, as long as you have the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: man mayray saachaa sayv jichar saas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਹਰ  ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਚਸਾ ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the True One, everything is false; in the end, all shall perish. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin sachay sabh koorh  hai ant ay ho-ay binaas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My Lord and Master is Immaculate and Pure; without Him, I cannot even survive.
lines.transliteration: saahib mayraa nirmalaa tis bin rahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਿਬਨਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within my mind and body, there is such a great hunger; if only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother!
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan bh ukh at aglee ko-ee aan  milaavai maa-ay.

lines.english: I have searched the four corners of the world-without our Husband Lord, there is noother place of rest. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa bhaalee-aa sah bin avar na jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Offer your prayers to Him, who shall unite you with the Creator.
lines.transliteration: tis aagai ard aas kar jo maylay kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਭੁਖ ਅਿਤ  ਅਗਲੀ  ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of the Naam; His Treasure is perfect and overflowing.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa naam kaa pooraa jis bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ  ਸਹ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, praise the One, who has no end or limitation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa salaahee-ai ant  na paaraavaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਿਰ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Praise God, the Nurturer and Cherisher; His Wondrous Ways are unlimited.
lines.transliteration: parvardagaar salaahee-ai jis d ay chalat  anayk.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him; this is the most wonderful wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa aaraaDh ee-ai ayhaa mat  visaykh .

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God's Flavor is sweet to the minds and bodies of those who have suchblessed destiny written on their foreheads. ||4||19||89|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (49-13) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man tan mith aa tis lagai jis mast ak naanak laykh . ||4||19||89||

lines.english: Meet with the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, and contemplate the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sant janhu mil bh aa-eeho sachaa naam samaal.

lines.english: For the journey of the soul, gather those supplies which will go with you here and hereafter.
lines.transliteration: tosaa banDh hu jee-a kaa aithai othai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਿਮਠਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਖ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੯॥
lines.english: These are obtained from the Perfect Guru, when God bestows His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay paa-ee-ai apn ee nad ar nihaal.

lines.english: Those unto whom He is Merciful, receive His Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karam paraapat t is hovai jis no hou-ay d a-i-aal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਭਾਈਹੋ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, there is no other as great as the Guru.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਸਾ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot imagine any other place. The Guru leads me to meet the True Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: doojaa thaa-o na ko sujh ai gur maylay sach so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਪਣੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Those who go to see the Guru obtain all treasures.
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath t is milay jin gur dith aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਿਤਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet are very fortunate, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: gur charnee jin man lagaa say vadbh aagee maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru is All-powerful. The Guru is All-pervading, contained amongst all.
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa samrath gur gur sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God. The Guru lifts up and saves those who are drowning. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar paarbarahm gur dubdaa la-ay t araa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: How shall I praise the Guru, the All-powerful Cause of causes?
lines.transliteration: kit mukh  gur salaahee-ai karan  kaaran  samrath.

lines.english: Those, upon whose foreheads the Guru has placed His Hand, remain steady andstable.
lines.transliteration: say mathay nihchal rahay jin gur Dhaari-aa hath.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ  ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has led me to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of theLord; He has released me from the cycle of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: gur amrit naam pee-aali-aa janam maran kaa path.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I serve the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, the Dispeller of fear; my suffering has been taken away. ||3|| pMnw 50
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar sayvi-aa bhai bh anjan d ukh lath. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਲਥੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Deep and Profound Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of sin.
lines.transliteration: satgur gahir gabh eer hai sukh  saagar agh -khand.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਘਖੰਡੁ ॥
lines.english: For those who serve their Guru, there is no punishment at the hands of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jin gur sayvi-aa aapnaa jamd oot na laagai dand.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਜਮਦੂਤ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਡੰਡੁ ॥
lines.english: There is none to compare with the Guru; I have searched and looked throughout theentire universe.
lines.transliteration: gur naal tul na lag-ee kh oj dith aa barahmand.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਤੁਿਲ  ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਖੋਿਜ ਿਡਠਾ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡੁ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has bestowed the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. O Nanak, the mind is filled with peace. ||4||20||90|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (50-3) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan sat gur dee-aa sukh  naanak man meh mand. ||4||20||90||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਮੰਡੁ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੯੦॥
lines.english: People eat what they believe to be sweet, but it turns out to be bitter in taste.
lines.transliteration: mithaa kar kai kh aa-i-aa ka-urh aa upji-aa saad .

lines.english: They attach their affections to brothers and friends, uselessly engrossed in corruption.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee meet  surid  kee-ay bikh i-aa rachi-aa baad .

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਠਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਕਉੜਾ  ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: They vanish without a moment's delay; without God's Name, they are stunned andamazed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaaNday bilam na hova-ee vin  naavai bismaad . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਮੀਤ ਸੁਿਰਦ  ਕੀਏ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਰਿਚਆ  ਬਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, attach yourself to the service of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: mayray man satgur kee sayvaa laag.

lines.english: Whatever is seen, shall pass away. Abandon the intellectualizations of your mind.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so vin sanaa man kee mat  ti-aag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Like the mad dog running around in all directions,
lines.transliteration: ji-o kookar harkaa-i-aa Dhaavai d ah dis jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਿਵਣਸਣਾ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਿਤਆਗੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lobhee jant  na jaan -ee bh akh abhakh sabh  khaa-ay. the greedy person, unaware, consumes everything, edible and non-edible alike.

lines.english: Engrossed in the intoxication of sexual desire and anger, people wander through reincarnation over and over again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh mad  bi-aapi-aa fir fir jonee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Maya has spread out her net, and in it, she has placed the bait.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa jaal pasaari-aa bheet ar chog ban aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਭਖੁ ਅਭਖੁ  ਸਭ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The bird of desire is caught, and cannot find any escape, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa pankh ee faasi-aa nikas na paa-ay maa-ay.

lines.english: One who does not know the Lord who created him, comes and goes in reincarnationover and over again. ||3||
