lines.transliteration: jin keetaa t iseh na jaan -ee fir fir aavai jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਪਸਾਿਰਆ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਚੋਗ ਬਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By various devices, and in so many ways, this world is enticed.
lines.transliteration: anik parkaaree mohi-aa baho biDh ih sansaar.

lines.english: They alone are saved, whom the All-powerful, Infinite Lord protects.
lines.transliteration: jis no rakhai so rahai samrith purakh  apaar.

lines.english: The servants of the Lord are saved by the Love of the Lord. O Nanak, I am forever asacrifice to them. ||4||21||91|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 Gru 2 ] (50-10) sireeraag mehlaa 5 ghar 2. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: har jan har liv uDhray naanak sad  balihaar. ||4||21||91||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰੀ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The herdsman comes to the pasture lands-what good are his ostentatious displayshere?
lines.transliteration: go-il aa-i-aa go-ilee ki-aa tis damf pasaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ਸੋ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਥੁ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: When your allotted time is up, you must go. Take care of your real hearth and home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: muhlat punnee chaln aa tooN sammal gh ar baar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਉਧਰੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੧॥
lines.english: O mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and serve the True Guru with love.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-o manaa sat gur sayv pi-aar.

lines.english: Why do you take pride in trivial matters? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa thorh-rh ee baat  gumaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Like an overnight guest, you shall arise and depart in the morning.
lines.transliteration: jaisay rain paraahun ay uth  chalsahi parbh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਹਲਿਤ  ਪੁੰਨੀ ਚਲਣਾ  ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਲੁ  ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Why are you so attached to your household? It is all like flowers in the garden. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa tooN rataa girsat  si-o sabh  fulaa kee baagaat . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ਮਨਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Why do you say, "Mine, mine"? Look to God, who has given it to you.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree ki-aa karahi jin dee-aa so parabh  lorh.

lines.english: It is certain that you must arise and depart, and leave behind your hundreds ofthousands and millions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sarpar uthee chaln aa chh ad jaasee lakh  karorh . ||3||

lines.english: Through 8.4 million incarnations you have wandered, to obtain this rare and precioushuman life.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh bh armat i-aa d ulabh  janam paa-i-o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੈਿਣ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਉਿਠ ਚਲਸਿਹ  ਪਰਭਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the day of departure is drawingnear! ||4||22||92|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (50-16) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal tooN so din nayrh aa aa-i-o-ay. ||4||22||92||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਤੂੰ ਰਤਾ ਿਗਰਸਤ  ਿਸਉ ਸਭ ਫੁਲਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਗਾਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: As long as the soul-companion is with the body, it dwells in happiness.
lines.transliteration: tichar vaseh suhaylrh ee jichar saathee naal.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਕਆ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਦੀਆ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲੋਿੜ  ॥
lines.english: But when the companion arises and departs, then the body-bride mingles with dust.||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa saathee uthee chali-aa t aa Dh an kh aakoo raal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਪਰ  ਉਠੀ ਚਲਣਾ  ਛਿਡ ਜਾਸੀ  ਲਖ ਕਰੋਿੜ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind has become detached from the world; it longs to see the Vision of God'sDarshan.
lines.transliteration: man bairaag bha-i-aa d arsan d aykh-nai kaa chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰ੍ਮਿਤਆ  ਦੁਲਭ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਾਇਓਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so t ayraa thaan. ||1|| rahaa-o. Blessed is Your Place. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂੰ ਸੋ ਿਦਨੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਓਇ  ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੨॥
lines.english: As long as the soul-husband dwells in the body-house, everyone greets you withrespect.
lines.transliteration: jichar vasi-aa kant gh ar jee-o jee-o sabh  kahaat .

lines.english: But when the soul-husband arises and departs, then no one cares for you at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa uthee chalsee kant -rhaa taa ko-ay na puchh ai tayree baat . ||2||

lines.english: In this world of your parents' home, serve your Husband Lord; in the world beyond, inyour in-laws' home, you shall dwell in peace.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai saho sayv t ooN saahurrh ai sukh  vas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਸਾਥੀ  ਉਠੀ ਚਿਲਆ  ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, be a sincere student of proper conduct, and suffering shallnever touch you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur mil chaj achaar sikh t uDh kaday na lagai d ukh. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣੈ  ਕਾ ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone shall go to their Husband Lord. Everyone shall be given their ceremonial send-off after their marriage. pMnw 51
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa saahurai vanj -naa sabh  muklaavan haar.

lines.english: O Nanak, blessed are the happy soul-brides, who are in love with their Husband Lord. ||4||23||93|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 Gru 6 ] (51-2) sireeraag mehlaa 5 ghar 6. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan sohaagan ee jin sah naal pi-aar. ||4||23||93||

lines.english: The One Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes, who has created the creation.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  ayk ohee jin kee-aa aakaar.

lines.english: Meditate on the One, O my mind, who is the Support of all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tiseh Dh i-aavahu man mayray sarab ko aaDh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਏਕੁ ਓਹੀ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Meditate within your mind on the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan man meh Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: Give up all your clever mental tricks, and lovingly attune yourself to the True Word ofthe Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhod sagal si-aan paa saach sabad  liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Suffering, agony and fear do not cling to one whose heart is filled with the GurMantra.
lines.transliteration: dukh kalays na bh a-o bi-aapai gur mant ar hird ai ho-ay.

lines.english: Trying millions of things, people have gr own weary, but without the Guru, none have been saved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kot jatnaa kar rahay gur bin t ari-o na ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, the mind is comforted and allsins depart.
lines.transliteration: daykh  darsan man saDh aarai paap saglay jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਲੇਸੁ  ਨ ਭਉ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin kai balihaarn ai je gur kee pairee paahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਤਨਾ  ਕਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਤਿਰਓ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the True Name of the Lord comes todwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  man vasai saach har kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ  ਪਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Very fortunate are those, O Nanak, whose minds are filled with this love. ||4||24||94|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (51-7) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee naankaa jinaa man ih bh aa-o. ||4||24||94||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Gather in the Wealth of the Lord, worship the True Guru, and give up all your corruptways.
lines.transliteration: sanch har Dhan pooj sat gur chh od sagal vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord who created and adorned you, and you shall besaved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin tooN saaj savaari-aa har simar ho-ay uDh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਮਿਨ ਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੯੪॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Name of the One, the Unique and Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: jap man naam ayk apaar.

lines.english: He gave you the praanaa, the breath of life, and your mind and body. He is the Support of the heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraan man tan jineh d ee-aa rid ay kaa aaDh aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਚ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਸਗਲ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The world is drunk, engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar maat ay vi-aapi-aa sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਤੂੰ ਸਾਿਜ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and fall at their feet; your suffering and darknessshall be removed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pa-o sant sarn ee laag charn ee mitai d ookh anDh aar. ||2||

lines.english: Practice truth, contentment and kindness; this is the most excellent way of life.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh da-i-aa kamaavai ayh karn ee saar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਜਨਿਹ  ਦੀਆ ਿਰਦੇ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who is so blessed by the Formless Lord God renounces selfishness, and becomes the dust of all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap chhod sabh  ho-ay rayn aa jis d ay-ay parabh  nirankaar. ||3||

lines.english: All that is seen is You, Lord, the expansion of the expanse.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so sagal t ooNhai pasri-aa paasaar.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has removed my doubts; I recognize God in all. ||4||25||95|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (51-12) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bharam kaati-aa sagal barahm beechaar. ||4||25||95||

lines.punjabi: ਪਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੁ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਮਟੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The whole world is engrossed in bad deeds and good deeds.
lines.transliteration: dukarit  sukarit  manDh ay sansaar saglaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: God's devotee is above both, but those who understand this are very rare. ||1||
lines.transliteration: duhhooN tay rahat  bhagat hai ko-ee virlaa jaan aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master is all-pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: thaakur sarbay samaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ  ਤੂੰਹੈ ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: What should I say, and what should I hear? O my Lord and Master, You are Great, All- powerful and All-knowing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kaha-o suna-o su-aamee t ooN vad purakh  sujaan aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੯੫॥
lines.english: One who is influenced by praise and blame is not God's servant.
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan manDh ay so sayvak naahee.

lines.english: One who sees the essence of reality with impartial vision, O Saints, is very rare-oneamong millions. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tat samad rasee sant ahu ko-ee kot manDh aahee. ||2||

lines.english: People talk on and on about Him; they consider this to be praise of God.
lines.transliteration: kahan kahaavan ih keerat karlaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But rare indeed is the Gurmukh, who is above this mere talk. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kathan kahan tay mukt aa gurmukh  ko-ee virlaa. ||3||

lines.english: He is not concerned with deliverance or bondage.
lines.transliteration: gat avigat  kachh  nadar na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਉ  ਸੁਣਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||26||96|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 Gru 7 ] (51-17) sireeraag mehlaa 5 ghar 7. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:
lines.transliteration: santan kee rayn  naanak d aan paa-i-aa. ||4||26||96||

lines.english: Relying on Your Mercy, Dear Lord, I have indulged in sensual pleasures.
lines.transliteration: tayrai bh arosai pi-aaray mai laad ladaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨ  ਮੰਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are my Father and Mother. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhooleh chookeh baarik t ooN har pit aa maa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਿਟ ਮੰਧਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: It is easy to speak and talk,
lines.transliteration: suhaylaa kahan kahaavan.
tayraa bikh am bh aavan. ||1|| rahaa-o. but it is difficult to accept Your Will. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨ  ਕਹਨ  ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੋਈ ਿਵਰਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I stand tall; You are my Strength. I know that You are mine.
lines.transliteration: ha-o maan t aan kara-o t ayraa ha-o jaan-o aapaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ  ਅਿਵਗਿਤ  ਕਛੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Inside of all, and outside of all, You are our Self-sufficient Father. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh hee maDh  sabh eh tay baahar baymuht aaj baapaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੬॥
lines.english: O Father, I do not know-how can I know Your Way? pMnw 52
lines.transliteration: pitaa ha-o jaan-o naahee t ayree kavan jugt aa.

lines.english: He frees us from bondage, O Saints, and saves us from possessiveness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: banDhan mukat  santahu mayree raakh ai mamt aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਮਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Becoming Merciful, my Lord and Master has ended my comings and goings in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal th aakur rahi-o aavan  jaanaa.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God. ||4||27||97|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 Gru 1 ] (52-2) sireeraag mehlaa 5 ghar 1. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: gur mil naanak paarbarahm pachhaan aa. ||4||27||97||

lines.english: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death isconquered.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil bh aa-ee-aa kati-arh aa jamkaal.

lines.english: The True Lord and Master has come to dwell within my mind; my Lord and Master hasbecome Merciful.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib man vuthaa ho-aa kh asam d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, all my worldly entanglements have ended. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur bh ayti-aa binsi-aa sabh  janjaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ਹੋਆ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: O my True Guru, I am a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: mayray satiguraa ha-o t uDh vitahu kurbaan .

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. By the Pleasure of Your Will,You have blessed me with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray d arsan ka-o balihaarn ai tus ditaa amrit  naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who have served You with love are truly wise.
lines.transliteration: jin tooN sayvi-aa bh aa-o kar say-ee purakh  sujaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਤੁਿਸ ਿਦਤਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have the Treasure of the Naam within emancipate others as well as themselves.
lines.transliteration: tinaa pichh ai chh utee-ai jin and ar naam niDh aan.

lines.english: There is no other Giver as great as the Guru, who has given the gift of the soul. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur jayvad daat aa ko nahee jin d itaa aat am daan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ  ਸੁਜਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed and acclaimed is the coming of those who have met the Guru with lovingfaith.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay say parvaan heh jin gur mili-aa subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachay saytee rat i-aa d argeh baisan  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਦਤਾ  ਆਤਮ  ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Greatness is in the Hands of the Creator; it is obtained by pre-ordained destiny. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kartay hath vad i-aa-ee-aa poorab likh i-aa paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਏ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹਿਹ ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: True is the Creator, True is the Doer. True is our Lord and Master, and True is HisSupport.
lines.transliteration: sach kartaa sach karanhaar sach saahib sach tayk.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਤਆ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਬੈਸਣੁ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: So speak the Truest of the True. Through the True One, an intuitive and discerningmind is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sacho sach vakhaan ee-ai sacho buDh  bibayk.

lines.english: Nanak lives by chanting and meditating on the One, who is pervading within andcontained amongst all. ||4||28||98|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (52-9) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar rav rahi-aa jap naanak jeevai ayk. ||4||28||98||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: Worship the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, with your mind and body attuned to love.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysur poojee-ai man tan laa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of the soul; He gives Support to all.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa jee-a kaa sabh sai day-ay aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਵੈ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੮॥
lines.english: Act according to the Instructions of the True Guru; this is the true philosophy.
lines.transliteration: satgur bachan kamaavn ay sachaa ayhu veechaar.

lines.english: Without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all attachment to Maya is just dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin saaDhoo sangat  rati-aa maa-i-aa moh sabh  chhaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪੂਜੀਐ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har
lines.transliteration: mayray saajan har har naam samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ  ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: . In the Saadh Sangat, He dwells within the mind, and one's works are brought toperfect fruition. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  man vasai pooran hovai gh aal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਨ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Infinite. By great good fortune, the BlessedVision of His Darshan is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur samrath apaar gur vadbhaagee d arsan ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਰਿਤਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru is Imperceptible, Immaculate and Pure. There is no other as great as theGuru.
lines.transliteration: gur agochar nirmalaa gur jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true glory.
lines.transliteration: gur kartaa gur karanhaar gurmukh  sachee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nothing is beyond the Guru; whatever He wishes comes to pass. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur tay baahar kichh  nahee gur keet aa lorh ay so ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree.
lines.transliteration: gur tirath gur paarjaat  gur mansaa pooran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind. The Guru is the Giver of the Nameof the Lord, by which all the world is saved.
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa har naam d ay-ay uDh rai sabh  sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Formless; the Guru is Lofty, Inaccessible andInfinite.
lines.transliteration: gur samrath gur nirankaar gur oochaa agam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Praise of the Guru is so sublime-what can any speaker say? ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa agam hai ki-aa kathay kathanhaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਤਾ  ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All the rewards which the mind desires are with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jit-rhay fal man baachh ee-ah t it-rhay sat gur paas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਸਾ  ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Wealth of the True Name.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhay paavn ay saach naam d ay raas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਉਧਰੈ  ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru, you shall never die again.
lines.transliteration: satgur sarn ee aa-i-aaN baahurh  nahee binaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours.||4||29||99|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (52-18) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naanak kaday na visra-o ayhu jee-o pind t ayraa saas. ||4||29||99||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਹੈ ਿਕਆ  ਕਥੇ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: release comes only through the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sant janhu sun  bhaa-eeho chh ootan saachai naa-ay.

lines.english: Worship the Feet of the Guru. Let the Name of the Lord be your sacred shrine ofpilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan sarayvn ay tirath har kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਬ  ਿਲਖੇ ਪਾਵਣੇ  ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Hereafter, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord; there, even the homeless find a home. ||1|| pMnw 53
lines.transliteration: aagai dargahi manee-ah milai nithaavay thaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, service to the True Guru alone is True.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray saachee sat gur sayv.

lines.english: When the True Guru is pleased, we obtain the Perfect, Unseen, Unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur t uthai paa-ee-ai pooran alakh  abhayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has bestowed the True Name.
lines.transliteration: satgur vitahu vaari-aa jin d itaa sach naa-o.

lines.english: Night and day, I praise the True One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.
lines.transliteration: an-din sach salaahn aa sachay kay gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: True is the food, and true are the clothes, of those who chant the True Name of the True One. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach khaan aa sach painn aa sachay sachaa naa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ  ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: With each breath and morsel of food, do not forget the Guru, the Embodiment ofFulfillment.
lines.transliteration: saas giraas na visrai safal moorat gur aap.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: None is seen to be as great as the Guru. Meditate on Him twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: gur jayvad avar na dis-ee aath  pahar t is jaap.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: As He casts His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name, the Treasure ofExcellence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa paa-ee-ai sach naam gunt aas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਿਦਸਈ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru and the Transcendent Lord are one and the same, pervading andpermeating amongst all.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar ayk hai sabh meh rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਿਸ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa say-ee naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Guru, who does not die, or come and go inreincarnation. ||4||30||100|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (53-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 1 AstpdIAw ] (53-8) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 1 asatpad ee-aa. Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House, Ashtapadees:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur sarnaagat ee marai na aavai jaa-ay. ||4||30||100||

lines.english: I speak and chant His Praises, vibrating the instrument of my mind. The more I know Him, the more I vibrate it.
lines.transliteration: aakh aakh  man vaavn aa ji-o ji-o jaapai vaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥੩੦॥੧੦੦॥
lines.english: The One, unto whom we vibrate and sing-how great is He, and where is His Place?
lines.transliteration: jis no vaa-ay sunaa-ee-ai so kayvad kit  thaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who speak of Him and praise Him-they all continue speaking of Him with love.||1||
lines.transliteration: aakhan  vaalay jayt -rhay sabh  aakh  rahay liv laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, the Lord Allah is Inaccessible and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: baabaa alhu agam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਖ  ਆਿਖ  ਮਨੁ ਵਾਵਣਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਿਜਉ ਜਾਪੈ ਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Sacred is His Name, and Sacred is His Place. He is the True Cherisher. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paakee naa-ee paak thaa-ay sachaa paravdigaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਵਾਇ  ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਿਕਤੁ  ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The extent of Your Command cannot be seen; no one knows how to write it.
lines.transliteration: tayraa hukam na jaapee kayt -rhaa likh  na jaan ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਣ  ਵਾਲੇ  ਜੇਤੜੇ  ਸਿਭ ਆਿਖ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even if a hundred poets met together, they could not describe even a tiny bit of it.
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o saa-ir maylee-ah til na pujaaveh ro-ay.

lines.english: No one has found Your Value; they all merely write what they have heard again andagain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: keemat kinai na paa-ee-aa sabh  sun sun aakh ahi so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਕੀ  ਨਾਈ  ਪਾਕ ਥਾਇ  ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਿਦਗਾਰ ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Pirs, the Prophets, the spiritual teachers, the faithful, the innocents and themartyrs,
lines.transliteration: peer paikaamar saalak saadak suhd ay a-or saheed .
saykh masaa-ik kaajee mulaa d ar darvays raseed . the Shaikhs, the mystics, the Qazis, the Mullahs and the Dervishes at His Door

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ  ਕੇਤੜਾ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: barkat t in ka-o aglee parh -day rahan d arood . ||3|| -they are blessed all the more as they continue reading their prayers in praise to Him.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਸਾਇਰ  ਮੇਲੀਅਿਹ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਿਹ  ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He seeks no advice when He builds; He seeks no advice when He destroys. He seeksno advice while giving or taking.
lines.transliteration: puchh na saajay puchh  na dh aahay puchh  na dayvai lay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ਸਿਭ ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਆਖਿਹ  ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone knows His Creative Power; He Himself does all deeds.
lines.transliteration: aapnee kud rat aapay jaan ai aapay karan  karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਮਰ  ਸਾਲਕ  ਸਾਦਕ  ਸੁਹਦੇ  ਅਉਰੁ ਸਹੀਦ  ॥
lines.english: He beholds all in His Vision. He gives to those with whom He is pleased. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa vaykh ai nad ar kar jai bh aavai t ai day-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ  ਕਾਜੀ  ਮੁਲਾ  ਦਿਰ ਦਰਵੇਸ  ਰਸੀਦ  ॥
lines.english: His Place and His Name are not known, no one knows how great is His Name.
lines.transliteration: thaavaa naav na jaanee-ahi naavaa kayvad naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਕਿਤ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਅਗਲੀ  ਪੜਦੇ  ਰਹਿਨ  ਦਰੂਦ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: How great is that place where my Sovereign Lord dwells?
lines.transliteration: jithai vasai mayraa paatisaahu so kayvad hai thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਿਛ ਨ ਸਾਜੇ ਪੁਿਛ ਨ ਢਾਹੇ ਪੁਿਛ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: No one can reach it; whom shall I go and ask? ||5||
lines.transliteration: ambarh ko-ay na sak-ee ha-o kis no puchh an jaa-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਣੁ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: One class of people does not like the other, when one has been made great.
lines.transliteration: varnaa varan na bhaavnee jay kisai vadaa karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Greatness is only in His Great Hands; He gives to those with whom He is pleased.
lines.transliteration: vaday hath vadi-aa-ee-aa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਵਾ  ਨਾਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਵਾ  ਕੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He Himself regenerates, without a moment's delay. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hukam savaaray aapnai chasaa na dh il karay-i. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Everyone cries out, "More! More!", with the idea of receiving.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aakh ai bahut  bahut  lainai kai veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਬਿੜ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਹਉ ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿਣ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: How great should we call the Giver? His Gifts are beyond estimation.
lines.transliteration: kayvad daat aa aakh ee-ai d ay kai rahi-aa sumaar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਨਾ  ਵਰਨ  ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਜੇ ਿਕਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there is no deficiency; Your Storehouses are filled to overflowing, age afterage. ||7||1|| mhlw 1 ] (53-19) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tot na aavee t ayray jugah jugah bh andaar. ||7||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੇ ਹਿਥ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: All are brides of the Husband Lord; all decorate themselves for Him. pMnw 54
lines.transliteration: sabhay kant  mahaylee-aa saglee-aa karahi seegaar.

lines.english: But when the time comes to settle their accounts, their red robes are corrupt.
lines.transliteration: ganat  ganaavan  aa-ee-aa soohaa vays vikaar.

lines.english: His Love is not obtained through hypocrisy. Her false coverings bring only ruin. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pakhand paraym na paa-ee-ai kh otaa paaj kh u-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this way, the Dear Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys His bride.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o i-o pir raavai naar.

lines.english: The happy soul-bride is pleasing to You, Lord; by Your Grace, You adorn her.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavan sohaagan ee apn ee kirpaa laihi savaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਨ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੈਿਹ ਸਵਾਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: She is decorated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; her mind and body belong toher Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee seegaaree-aa t an man pir kai paas.

lines.english: With her palms pressed together, she stands, waiting on Him, and offers her Trueprayers to Him.
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  kharhee takai sach kahai ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Dyed in the deep crimson of the Love of her Darling Lord, she dwells in the Fear ofthe True One. Imbued with His Love, she is dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laal ratee sach bh ai vasee bh aa-ay rat ee rang raas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਖੜੀ ਤਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: She is said to be the hand-maiden of her Beloved Lord; His sweetheart surrenders toHis Name.
lines.transliteration: pari-a kee chayree kaaNdhee-ai laalee maanai naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਲ  ਰਤੀ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਇ  ਰਤੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: True Love is never broken; she is united in Union with the True One.
lines.transliteration: saachee pareet na t ut-ee saachay mayl milaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਕੀ ਚੇਰੀ ਕਢੀਐ  ਲਾਲੀ  ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, her mind is pierced through. I am forever asacrifice to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ee man vayDh i-aa ha-o sad  balihaarai jaa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਤੁਟਈ  ਸਾਚੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: That bride, who is absorbed into the True Guru, shall never become a widow.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan rand na bais-ee jay sat gur maahi samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਿਧਆ  ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Her Husband Lord is Beautiful; His Body is forever fresh and new. The True One does not die, and shall not go.
lines.transliteration: pir reesaaloo na-otano saacha-o marai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਬੈਸਈ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He continually enjoys His happy soul-bride; He casts His Gracious Glance of Truthupon her, and she abides in His Will. ||4||
lines.transliteration: nit ravai sohaagan ee saachee nad ar rajaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ  ਨਉਤਨੋ  ਸਾਚਉ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The bride braids her hair with Truth; her clothes are decorated with His Love.
lines.transliteration: saach Dharh ee Dh an maadee-ai kaaparh  paraym seegaar.

lines.english: Like the essence of sandalwood, He permeates her consciousness, and the Temple ofthe Tenth Gate is opened.
lines.transliteration: chandan cheet  vasaa-i-aa mand ar dasvaa d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਧੜੀ ਧਨ ਮਾਡੀਐ  ਕਾਪੜੁ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The lamp of the Shabad is lit, and the Name of the Lord is her necklace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: deepak sabad  vigaasi-aa raam naam ur haar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੀਿਤ  ਵਸਾਇਆ  ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦਸਵਾ  ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: She is the most beautiful among women; upon her forehead she wears the Jewel ofthe Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: naaree andar sohn ee mast ak man ee pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਵਗਾਿਸਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Her glory and her wisdom are magnificent; her love for the Infinite Lord is True.
lines.transliteration: sobhaa surat  suhaavan ee saachai paraym apaar.

lines.english: Other than her Beloved Lord, she knows no man. She enshrines love for the TrueGuru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin pir purakh na jaan -ee saachay gur kai hayt  pi-aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਸਾਚੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Asleep in the darkness of the night, how shall she pass her life-night without her Husband?
lines.transliteration: nis anDhi-aaree sut ee-ay ki-o pir bin rain  vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Her limbs shall burn, her body shall burn, and her mind and wealth shall burn as well.
lines.transliteration: ank jala-o tan jaalee-a-o man Dh an jal bal jaa-ay.

lines.english: When the Husband does not enjoy His bride, then her youth passes away in vain.||7||
lines.transliteration: jaa Dhan kant  na raavee-aa t aa birthaa joban jaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਕੁ ਜਲਉ  ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲੀਅਉ  ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Husband is on the Bed, but the bride is asleep, and so she does not come toknow Him.
lines.transliteration: sayjai kant mahaylrh ee soot ee boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਿਤ  ਨ ਰਾਵੀਆ  ਤਾ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: While I am asleep, my Husband Lord is awake. Where can I go for advice?
lines.transliteration: ha-o sutee pir jaagn aa kis ka-o poochh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੜੀ  ਸੂਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has led me to meet Him, and now I dwell in the Fear of God. O Nanak,His Love is always with me. ||8||2|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (54-13) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur maylee bh ai vasee naanak paraym sakh aa-ay. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸੁਤੀ ਿਪਰੁ ਜਾਗਣਾ  ਿਕਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਉ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, You are Your Own Glorious Praise. You Yourself speak it; You Yourself hear itand contemplate it.
lines.transliteration: aapay gun aapay kathai aapay sun  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੀ  ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਸਖਾਇ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Jewel, and You are the Appraiser. You Yourself are of Infinite Value.
lines.transliteration: aapay ratan parakh  tooN aapay mol apaar.

lines.english: O True Lord, You are Honor and Glory; You Yourself are the Giver. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saacha-o maan mahat t ooN aapay d ayvan haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣ ਆਪੇ  ਕਥੈ ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਿਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You are the Creator and the Cause.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tooN kartaa kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਿਖ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If it is Your Will, please save and protect me ; please bless me with the lifestyle of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  tooN har naam milai aachaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਉ  ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the flawless diamond; You Yourself are the deep crimson color.
lines.transliteration: aapay heeraa nirmalaa aapay rang majeeth.

lines.english: You Yourself are the perfect pearl; You Yourself are the devotee and the priest.
lines.transliteration: aapay motee oojlo aapay bh agat baseeth .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are praised. In each and every heart,the Unseen is seen. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad salaahn aa gh at ghat deeth  adeeth . ||2||

lines.english: You Yourself are the ocean and the boat. You Yourself are this shore, and the onebeyond.
lines.transliteration: aapay saagar bohithaa aapay paar apaar.

lines.english: O All-knowing Lord, You are the True Way. The Shabad is the Navigator to ferry usacross.
lines.transliteration: saachee vaat sujaan t ooN sabad  laghaavan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੋਤੀ ਊਜਲੋ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਤ  ਬਸੀਠੁ  ॥
lines.english: One who does not fear God shall live in fear; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nidri-aa dar jaanee-ai baajh  guroo gubaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਡੀਠੁ ਅਡੀਠੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Creator alone is seen to be Eternal; all others come and go.
lines.transliteration: asthir kartaa d aykhee-ai hor kayt ee aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Only You, Lord, are Immaculate and Pure. All others are bound up in worldly pursuits.
lines.transliteration: aapay nirmal ayk tooN hor banDh ee Dh anDhai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਵਾਟ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਤੂੰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They are lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||4|| pMnw 55
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray saachay si-o liv laa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Through the Shabad, they recognize the Dear Lord; through the Guru's Word, they are attuned to Truth.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sabad pachh aanee-ai saach rat ay gur vaak.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਿਕ  ॥
lines.english: Filth does not stick to the body of one who has secured a dwelling in his True Home.
lines.transliteration: tit tan mail na lag-ee sach gh ar jis ot aak.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਿਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਸਚ ਘਿਰ ਿਜਸੁ ਓਤਾਕੁ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name. Without theName, who are our relatives? ||5||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay sach paa-ee-ai bin naavai ki-aa saak. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਕਆ  ਸਾਕੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who have realized the Truth are at peace throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: jinee sach pachhaan i-aa say sukh ee-ay jug chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Subduing their egotism and desires, they keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai tarisnaa maar kai sach rakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: In this world, the only real profit is the Name of the One Lord; it is earned bycontemplating the Guru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jag meh laahaa ayk naam paa-ee-ai gur veechaar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਲਾਹਾ  ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Loading the Merchandise of the True Name, you shall gather in your profits foreverwith the Capital of Truth.
lines.transliteration: saacha-o vakhar laad ee-ai laabh  sadaa sach raas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਉ  ਵਖਰੁ ਲਾਦੀਐ  ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the True One, you shall sit in truthful devotion and prayer.
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh bais-ee bh agat sachee ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਬੈਸਈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਚੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Your account shall be settled with honor, in the Radiant Light of the Name of the Lord.||7||
lines.transliteration: pat si-o laykh aa nibrh ai raam naam pargaas. ||7||

lines.english: The Lord is said to be the Highest of the High; no one can perceive Him.
lines.transliteration: oochaa oocha-o aakhee-ai kaha-o na d aykhi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਾ  ਊਚਉ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਕਹਉ  ਨ ਦੇਿਖਆ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see only You. The True Guru has inspired me to see You.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah ayk t ooN satgur dee-aa d ikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Light within is revealed, O Nanak, through this intuitive understanding.||8||3|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (55-7) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jot nirant ar jaan ee-ai naanak sahj subh aa-ay. ||8||3||

lines.english: The fish did not notice the net in the deep and salty sea.
lines.transliteration: machhulee jaal na jaan i-aa sar kh aaraa asgaahu.

lines.english: It was so clever and beautiful, but why was it so confident?
lines.transliteration: at si-aan ee sohn ee ki-o keet o vaysaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਸਰੁ ਖਾਰਾ  ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: By its actions it was caught, and now death cannot be turned away from its head. ||1||
lines.transliteration: keetay kaaran  paakrh ee kaal na talai siraahu. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, just like this, see death hovering over your own heads!
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray i-o sir jaan hu kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤੇ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਪਾਕੜੀ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਟਲੈ ਿਸਰਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: People are just like this fish; unaware, the noose of death descends upon them.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o machhee t i-o maan saa pavai achint aa jaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The whole world is bound by death; without the Guru, death cannot be avoided.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag baaDh o kaal ko bin gur kaal afaar.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; they renounce duality and corruption.
lines.transliteration: sach ratay say ubray d ubiDh aa chh od vikaar.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be Truthful in the True Court. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin kai balihaarn ai dar sachai sachiaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧੋ ਕਾਲ  ਕੋ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਲੁ  ਅਫਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Think of the hawk preying on the birds, and the net in the hands of the hunter.
lines.transliteration: seechaanay ji-o pankhee-aa jaalee baDh ik haath.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਛੋਿਡ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; the others are caught by the bait.
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray hor faathay chogai saath.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Name, they are picked up and thrown away; they have no friends or companions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai chun sutee-ah ko-ay na sangee saath. ||3||

lines.english: God is said to be the Truest of the True; His Place is the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa aakhee-ai sachay sachaa thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹੋਿਰ ਫਾਥੇ ਚੋਗੈ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Those who obey the True One-their minds abide in true meditation.
lines.transliteration: jinee sachaa mani-aa tin man sach Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੁਿਣ  ਸੁਟੀਅਿਹ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੰਗੀ  ਸਾਿਥ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who become Gurmukh, and obtain spiritual wisdom-their minds and mouths areknown to be pure. ||4||
lines.transliteration: man mukh soochay jaan ee-ahi gurmukh  jinaa gi-aan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ  ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Offer your most sincere prayers to the True Guru, so that He may unite you with yourBest Friend.
lines.transliteration: satgur agai ard aas kar saajan d ay-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting your Best Friend, you shall find peace; the Messenger of Death shall takepoison and die.
lines.transliteration: saajan mili-ai sukh paa-i-aa jamd oot mu-ay bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.english: I dwell deep within the Name; the Name has come to dwell within my mind. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naavai andar ha-o vasaaN naa-o vasai man aa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਿਰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness; without the Shabad, understanding isnot obtained.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo gubaar hai bin sabd ai boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਿਨ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਮਦੂਤ  ਮੁਏ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be enlightened; remain absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee pargaas ho-ay sach rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਹਉ ਵਸ ਨਾਉ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Death does not go there; your light shall merge with the Light. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tithai kaal na sanchrai jot ee jot  samaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁ ਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Best Friend; You are All-knowing. You are the One who unites us withYourself.
lines.transliteration: tooNhai saajan t ooN sujaan  tooN aapay maylan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we praise You; You have no end orlimitation.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee salaahee-ai ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਸੰਚਰੈ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Death does not reach that place, where the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabadresounds. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tithai kaal na aprh ai jithai gur kaa sabad  apaar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, all are created. By His Command, actions areperformed.
lines.transliteration: hukmee sabhay oopjahi hukmee kaar kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Command, all are subject to death; by His Command, they merge in Truth.
lines.transliteration: hukmee kaalai vas hai hukmee saach samaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਅਪੜੈ  ਿਜਥੈ ਗੁ ਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whatever pleases His Will comes to pass. Nothing is in the hands of these beings. ||8||4|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (55-19) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai inaa jant aa vas kichh  naahi. ||8||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਭੇ ਊਪਜਿਹ  ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: If the mind is polluted, then the body is polluted, and the tongue is polluted as well. pMnw 56
lines.transliteration: man joothai t an jooth  hai jihvaa jooth ee ho-ay.

lines.english: With false mouths, people speak falsehood. How can they be made pure?
lines.transliteration: mukh jh oothai jhooth bolnaa ki-o kar soochaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਖ ਝੂਠੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Holy Water of the Shabad, they are not cleansed. From the True One alone comes Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin abh sabad  na maaNjee-ai saachay t ay sach ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਅਭ ਸਬਦ  ਨ ਮਜੀਐ  ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O soul-bride, without virtue, what happiness can there be?
lines.transliteration: munDhay gun heenee sukh  kayhi.

lines.english: The Husband Lord enjoys her with pleasure and delight; she is at peace in the love ofthe True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pir ralee-aa ras maansee saach sabad  sukh  nayhi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਰਲੀਆ  ਰਿਸ ਮਾਣਸੀ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਿਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Husband goes away, the bride suffers in the pain of separation,
lines.transliteration: pir pardaysee jay thee-ai Dh an vaaNdhee jooray-ay.
ji-o jal thorhai machh ulee karan  palaav karay-i. like the fish in shallow water, crying for mercy.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਜੇ ਥੀਐ  ਧਨ ਵਢੀ  ਝੂਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: As it pleases the Will of the Husband Lord, peace is obtained, when He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pir bhaavai sukh  paa-ee-ai jaa aapay nad ar karay-i. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਜਿਲ  ਥੋੜੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਵ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Praise your Husband Lord, together with your bridesmaids and friends.
lines.transliteration: pir saalaahee aapnaa sakh ee sahaylee naal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਾ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The body is beautified, and the mind is fascinated. Imbued with His Love, we areenraptured.
lines.transliteration: tan sohai man mohi-aa rat ee rang nihaal.

lines.english: Adorned with the Shabad, the beautiful bride enjoys her Husband with virtue. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad savaaree sohn ee pir raavay gun  naal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਨ ਸੋਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਆ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is of no use at all, if she is evil and without virtue.
lines.transliteration: kaaman kaam na aavee kh otee avgan i-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ਸੋਹਣੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: She does not find peace in this world or the next; she burns in falsehood andcorruption.
lines.transliteration: naa sukh pay-ee-ai saahurai jh ooth jalee vaykaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਖੋਟੀ ਅਵਗਿਣਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going are very difficult for that bride who is abandoned and forgotten byher Husband Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aavan vanj an daakh -rho chh odee kant  visaar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੇਈਐ  ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਝੂਿਠ ਜਲੀ  ਵੇਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The beautiful soul-bride of the Husband Lord-by what sensual pleasures has she beendoomed?
lines.transliteration: pir kee naar suhaavanee mut ee so kit  saad .

lines.english: She is of no use to her Husband if she babbles in useless arguments.
lines.transliteration: pir kai kaam na aavee bolay faadil baad .

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਮੁਤੀ ਸੋ ਿਕਤੁ  ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: At the Door of His Home, she finds no shelter; she is discarded for seeking other pleasures. ||5||
lines.transliteration: dar gh ar dho-ee naa lahai chh ootee d oojai saad . ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਬੋਲੇ ਫਾਿਦਲੁ  ਬਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read their books, but they do not understand thereal meaning.
lines.transliteration: pandit vaacheh pothee-aa naa boojh eh veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਿਦ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They give instructions to others, and then walk away, but they deal in Mayathemselves.
lines.transliteration: an ka-o matee d ay chaleh maa-i-aa kaa vaapaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਵਾਚਿਹ  ਪੋਥੀਆ  ਨਾ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Speaking falsehood, they wander around the world, while those who remain true tothe Shabad are excellent and exalted. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kathnee jhooth ee jag bh avai rahn ee sabad  so saar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਕਉ ਮਤੀ ਦੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: There are so many Pandits and astrologers who ponder over the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: kaytay pandit  jotkee bayd aa karahi beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨੀ  ਝੂਠੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ਰਹਣੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: They glorify their disputes and arguments, and in these controversies they continuecoming and going.
lines.transliteration: vaad viroDh  salaahn ay vaad ay aavan  jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਜੋਤਕੀ  ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, they are not released from their karma, although they speak andlisten and preach and explain. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin gur karam na chhutsee kahi sun  aakh  vakh aan. ||7||

lines.english: They all call themselves virtuous, but I have no virtue at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh gun vantee aakh ee-ahi mai gun  naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਮ  ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ  ਕਿਹ ਸੁਿਣ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੁ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: With the Lord as her Husband, the soul-bride is happy; I, too, love that God.
lines.transliteration: har var naar suhaavanee mai bh aavai parabh  so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ  ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, union is obtained; there is no more separation. ||8||5|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (56-12) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad milaavrh aa naa vaychh orhaa ho-ay. ||8||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਨਾਿਰ  ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You may chant and meditate, practice austerities and self-restraint, and dwell atsacred shrines of pilgrimage;
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam saaDh ee-ai t irath keechai vaas.
punn daan chang-aa-ee-aa bin saachay ki-aa t aas. you may give donations to charity, and perform good deeds, but without the TrueOne, what is the use of it all?

lines.english: As you plant, so shall you harvest. Without virtue, this human life passes away in vain.||1||
lines.transliteration: jayhaa raaDhay t ayhaa lun ai bin gun  janam vin aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧੀਐ  ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਕੀਚੈ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: O young bride, be a slave to virtue, and you shall find peace.
lines.transliteration: munDhay gun  daasee sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Renouncing wrongful actions, following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be absorbedinto the Perfect One. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avgan t i-aag samaa-ee-ai gurmat  pooraa so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਰਾਧੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਲੁਣੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਵਣਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without capital, the trader looks around in all four directions.
lines.transliteration: vin raasee vapaaree-aa t akay kundaa chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁ ਣ ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He does not understand his own origins; the merchandise remains within the door of his own house.
lines.transliteration: mool na bujhai aapn aa vasat  rahee gh ar baar.

lines.english: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vin vakh ar dukh aglaa koorh  muth ee koorh i-aar. ||2||

lines.english: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.
lines.transliteration: laahaa ahinis na-otanaa parkh ay rat an veechaar.

lines.english: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.
lines.transliteration: vasat lahai gh ar aapn ai chalai kaaraj saar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਰਹੀ ਘਰ ਬਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vanjaari-aa si-o van aj kar gurmukh  barahm beechaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਵਖਰ  ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ  ਕੂਿੜ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂਿੜਆਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.
lines.transliteration: jantaaN sangat  paa-ee-ai jay maylay maylan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਉਤਨਾ  ਪਰਖੇ  ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never againbe separated from Him.
lines.transliteration: mili-aa ho-ay na vichhurh ai jis ant ar jot  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sachai aasan sach rahai sachai paraym pi-aar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਸਉ ਵਣਜੁ  ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his ownhome.
lines.transliteration: jinee aap pachhaan i-aa gh ar meh mahal suthaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in. pMnw 57
lines.transliteration: sachay saytee rat i-aa sacho palai paa-ay.

lines.english: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||
lines.transliteration: taribh avan so parabh  jaanee-ai saacho saachai naa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan kh aree suhaavan ee jin pir jaat aa sang.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਪਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lordravishes her with love.
lines.transliteration: mahlee mahal bulaa-ee-ai so pir raavay rang.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲੀ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਈਐ  ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of herHusband Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sach suhaagan saa bh alee pir mohee gun  sang. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਿਪਿਰ  ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed theplateau, I go up the mountain.
lines.transliteration: bhoolee bh oolee thal charh aa thal charh  doogar jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਥਿਲ ਚੜਾ ਥਿਲ  ਚਿੜ ਡੂਗਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without theGuru, I do not understand.
lines.transliteration: ban meh bhoolee jay firaa bin gur boojh  na paa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਨ ਮਿਹ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਿਫਰਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਉ ॥
lines.english: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going inreincarnation, over and over again. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naavhu bhoolee jay firaa fir fir aava-o jaa-o. ||7||

lines.english: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.
lines.transliteration: puchhahu jaa-ay paDh aa-oo-aa chalay chaakar ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ਪਧਾਊਆ  ਚਲੇ ਚਾਕਰ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.
lines.transliteration: raajan jaaneh aapn aa dar ghar thaak na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਿਹ ਆਪਣਾ  ਦਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (57-5) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayko rav rahi-aa doojaa avar na ko-ay. ||8||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure aswell.
lines.transliteration: gur tay nirmal jaan ee-ai nirmal d ayh sareer.

lines.english: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.
lines.transliteration: nirmal saacho man vasai so jaanai abh  peer.

lines.english: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strikeyou. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sahjai tay sukh  aglo naa laagai jam t eer. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਾਚੋ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray mail naahee nirmal jal naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੈ  ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ  ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ  ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nirmal saachaa ayk too hor mail bh aree sabh  jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜਿਲ  ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa mandar sohn aa kee-aa karn aihaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.
lines.transliteration: rav sas deep anoop jot  taribhavan jot apaar.

lines.english: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the TrueMerchandise is traded. ||2||
lines.transliteration: haat patan garh  koth-rhee sach sa-ud aa vaapaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਣੈਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure Oneis seen.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan bhai bh anjnaa d aykh niranjan bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਸਿਸ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਜੋਿਤ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centeredand balanced.
lines.transliteration: gupat pargat sabh  jaanee-ai jay man raakh ai thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ  ਗੜ ਕੋਠੜੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ  ਵਾਪਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aisaa satgur jay milai t aa sehjay la-ay milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.
lines.transliteration: kas kasvatee laa-ee-ai parkhay hit  chit laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.
lines.transliteration: khotay th a-ur na paa-inee kh aray kh ajaanai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aas andaysaa d oor kar i-o mal jaa-ay samaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.
lines.transliteration: sukh ka-o maagai sabh  ko dukh na maagai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ  ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.
lines.transliteration: sukhai ka-o d ukh aglaa manmukh  boojh  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਇਉ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are piercedthrough by the Shabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh sam kar jaan ee-ahi sabad  bhayd sukh  ho-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਮਾਗੈ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,
lines.transliteration: bayd pukaaray vaachee-ai ban ee barahm bi-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੈ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mun jan sayvak saaDhikaa naam rat ay gunt aas. that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life ofspiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭੇਿਦ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever asacrifice to them. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sach ratay say jin  ga-ay ha-o sad  balihaarai jaas. ||6||

lines.english: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they arefilthy throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: chahu jug mailay mal bharay jin mukh  naam na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਾਿਧਕਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee bh aa-ay vihoon i-aa muhu kaalaa pat  kho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਿਜਿਣ  ਗਏ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa avgan muth ee ro-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਿਗ  ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਿਜਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united inHis Union.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat paa-i-aa dar kar milai milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੀ  ਭਾਇ  ਿਵਹੂਿਣਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotismand desire depart.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai ghar vasai ha-umai t arisnaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant.||8||7|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (57-18) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nirmal oojlay jo raatay har naa-ay. ||8||7||

lines.english: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: sun man bh oolay baavray gur kee charn ee laag.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you,and suffering shall depart.
lines.transliteration: har jap naam Dhi-aa-ay t oo jam darpai d ukh bhaag.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਊਜਲੇ  ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇ  ॥੮॥੭॥
lines.english: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1|| pMnw 58
lines.transliteration: dookh  ghano duhaagan ee ki-o thir rahai suhaag. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, I have no other place to go.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray avar naahee mai thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai Dhan naam niDh aan hai gur d ee-aa bal jaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru's Teachings bring honor. Blessed is He-may I meet and be with Him!
lines.transliteration: gurmat pat  saabaas t is tis kai sang milaa-o.

lines.english: Without Him, I cannot live, even for a moment. Without His Name, I die.
lines.transliteration: tis bin gh arhee na jeev-oo bin naavai mar jaa-o.

lines.english: I am blind-may I never forget the Naam! Under His Protection, I shall reach my truehome. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mai anDhulay naam na veesrai tayk tikee gh ar jaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵਊ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those chaylaas, those devotees, whose spiritual teacher is blind, shall not find theirplace of rest.
lines.transliteration: guroo jinaa kaa anDhulaa chaylay naahee th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਟੇਕ ਿਟਕੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained. Without the Name, what is the useof it all?
lines.transliteration: bin satgur naa-o na paa-ee-ai bin naavai ki-aa su-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਿਜਨਾ  ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ  ਚੇਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: People come and go, regretting and repenting, like crows in a deserted house. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay ga-i-aa pachhut aavnaa ji-o sunj ai ghar kaa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਉ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਕਆ  ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain; it crumbles like a wall of sand.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai dukh  dayhuree ji-o kalar kee bh eet.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ  ਿਜਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਿਰ  ਕਾਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As long as Truth does not enter into the consciousness, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found.
lines.transliteration: tab lag mahal na paa-ee-ai jab lag saach na cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਿਜਉ ਕਲਰ  ਕੀ ਭੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Shabad, we enter our home, and obtain the Eternal State of Nirvaanaa.||4||
lines.transliteration: sabad rapai gh ar paa-ee-ai nirbaan ee pad  neet. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: I ask my Guru for His Advice, and I follow the Guru's Advice.
lines.transliteration: ha-o gur poochha-o aapn ay gur puchh  kaar kamaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ ਰਪੈ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ਪਦੁ ਨੀਿਤ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: With the Shabads of Praise abiding in the mind, the pain of egotism is burnt away.
lines.transliteration: sabad salaahee man vasai ha-umai d ukh jal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਗੁਰ ਪੁਿਛ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: We are intuitively united with Him, and we meet the Truest of the True. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sehjay ho-ay milaavrhaa saachay saach milaa-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are spotless and pure; they renounce sexualdesire, anger, selfishness and conceit.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay say nirmalay t aj kaam kroDh  ahaNkaar.

lines.english: They sing the Praises of the Naam, forever and ever; they keep the Lord enshrinedwithin their hearts.
lines.transliteration: naam salaahan sad sad aa har raakh ahi ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਤਿਜ ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: How could we ever forget Him from our minds? He is the Support of all beings. ||6||
lines.transliteration: so ki-o manhu visaaree-ai sabh jee-aa kaa aaDh aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who dies in the Shabad is beyond death, and shall never die again.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai so mar rahai fir marai na d oojee vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ਸਭ ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, we find Him, and embrace love for the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabdai hee t ay paa-ee-ai har naamay lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਰ ਰਹੈ ਿਫਿਰ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, the world is deceived; it dies and is reborn, over and over again. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai jag bh oolaa firai mar janmai vaaro vaar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: All praise themselves, and call themselves the greatest of the great.
lines.transliteration: sabh salaahai aap ka-o vadahu vadayree ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਿਫਰੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, one's self cannot be known. By merely speaking and listening, whatis accomplished?
lines.transliteration: gur bin aap na cheenee-ai kahay sunay ki-aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ  ਆਪ ਕਉ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੀ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who realizes the Shabad does not act in egotism. ||8||8|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (58-12) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad pachh aanee-ai ha-umai karai na ko-ay. ||8||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨੀਐ  ਕਹੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without her Husband, the soul-bride's youth and ornaments are useless andwretched.
lines.transliteration: bin pir Dhan seegaaree-ai joban baad  khu-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੮॥
lines.english: She does not enjoy the pleasure of His Bed; without her Husband, her ornaments areabsurd.
lines.transliteration: naa maanay sukh  sayjrh ee bin pir baad  seegaar.

lines.english: The discarded bride suffers terrible pain; her Husband does not come to the bed of her home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dookh  ghano duhaagan ee naa gh ar sayj bh ataar. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, and find peace.
lines.transliteration: man ray raam japahu sukh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਾਣੇ ਸੁਿਖ ਸੇਜੜੀ  ਿਬਨੁਿਪਰ ਬਾਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, love is not found. United with the Shabad, happiness is found.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin gur paraym na paa-ee-ai sabad milai rang ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਨਾ ਘਿਰ  ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, she finds peace, and her Husband Lord adorns her with intuitivewisdom.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa sukh paa-ee-ai har var sahj seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Truly, she enjoys the Bed of her Husband, through her deep love and affection.
lines.transliteration: sach maanay pir sayjrh ee goorh aa hayt  pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, she comes to know Him. Meeting with the Guru, she maintains avirtuous lifestyle. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaan  sinjaanee-ai gur maylee gun  chaar. ||2||

lines.english: Through Truth, meet your Husband Lord, O soul-bride. Enchanted by your Husband,enshrine love for Him.
lines.transliteration: sach milhu var kaamnee pir mohee rang laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in Truth. The value of this cannot bedescribed.
lines.transliteration: man tan saach vigsi-aa keemat  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The soul-bride finds her Husband Lord in the home of her own being; she is purified by the True Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har var ghar sohaagan ee nirmal saachai naa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਿਣ  ਿਸਞਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੀ  ਗੁਣ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If the mind within the mind dies, then the Husband ravishes and enjoys His bride.
lines.transliteration: man meh manoo-aa jay marai taa pir raavai naar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਿਪਿਰ  ਮੋਹੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are woven into one texture, like pearls on a necklace around the neck.
lines.transliteration: ikat taagai ral milai gal mot ee-an kaa haar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਵਗਿਸਆ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, peace wells up; the Gurmukhs take the Support of theNaam. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa sukh  oopjai gurmukh  naam aDh aar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In an instant, one is born, and in an instant, one dies. In an instant one comes, and inan instant one goes.
lines.transliteration: khin meh upjai kh in khapai kh in aavai kh in jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who recognizes the Shabad merges into it, and is not afflicted by death. pMnw 59
lines.transliteration: sabad pachh aanai rav rahai naa t is kaal sant aa-ay.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master is Unweighable; He cannot be weighed. He cannot be found merely by talking. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saahib atul na t olee-ai kathan na paa-i-aa jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਨ ਤੋਲੀਐ  ਕਥਿਨ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The merchants and the traders have come; their profits are pre-ordained.
lines.transliteration: vaapaaree vanjaari-aa aa-ay vajahu likh aa-ay.

lines.english: Those who practice Truth reap the profits, abiding in the Will of God.
lines.transliteration: kaar kamaaveh sach kee laahaa milai rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਾ  ਿਮਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: With the Merchandise of Truth, they meet the Guru, who does not have a trace ofgreed. ||6||
lines.transliteration: poonjee saachee gur milai naa tis t il na t amaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, they are weighed and measured, in the balance and the scales of Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t ol tolaa-isee sach t araajee t ol.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤੋਿਲ  ਤਲਾਇਸੀ  ਸਚੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ  ਤੋਲੁ ॥
lines.english: The enticements of hope and desire are quieted by the Guru, whose Word is True.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa mohnee gur th aakee sach bol.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਠਾਕੀ  ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself weighs with the scale; perfect is the weighing of the Perfect One. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aap tulaa-ay t olsee pooray pooraa t ol. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤੁਲਾਏ  ਤੋਲਸੀ  ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: No one is saved by mere talk and speech, nor by reading loads of books.
lines.transliteration: kathnai kahan na chh utee-ai naa parh  pustak bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨੈ  ਕਹਿਣ  ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਨਾ ਪਿੜ ਪੁਸਤਕ  ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa soch na paa-ee-ai bin har bhagat  pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; the Guru shall unite us with the Creator. ||8||9|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (59-6) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai maylay gur kartaar. ||8||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ  ॥੮॥੯॥
lines.english: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, we find the jewel of meditative reflection.
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa jay milai paa-ee-ai rat an beechaar.

lines.english: Surrendering our minds to our Guru, we find universal love.
lines.transliteration: man deejai gur aapn ay paa-ee-ai sarab pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ  ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: We find the wealth of liberation, and our demerits are erased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukat pad aarath paa-ee-ai avgan  maytan haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gur bin gi-aan na ho-ay.

lines.english: Go and ask Brahma, Naarad and Vyaas, the writer of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: poochhahu barahmay naard ai bayd  bi-aasai ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Know that from the vibration of the Word, we obtain spiritual wisdom and meditation. Through it, we speak the Unspoken.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan Dh un jaan ee-ai akath kahaavai so-ay.

lines.english: He is the fruit-bearing Tree, luxuriantly green with abundant shade.
lines.transliteration: safli-o birakh haree-aavlaa chh aav gh anayree ho-ay.

lines.english: The rubies, jewels and emeralds are in the Guru's Treasury. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laal javayhar maankee gur bh andaarai so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: From the Guru's Treasury, we receive the Love of the Immaculate Naam, the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur bhandaarai paa-ee-ai nirmal naam pi-aar.

lines.english: We gather in the True Merchandise, through the Perfect Grace of the Infinite.
lines.transliteration: saacho vakhar sanchee-ai poorai karam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਮਾਣਕੀ  ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of peace, the Dispeller of pain, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata dukh maytn o satgur asur sangh aar. ||3||

lines.english: The terrifying world-ocean is difficult and dreadful; there is no shore on this side orthe one beyond.
lines.transliteration: bhavjal bikh am daraavn o naa kanDh ee naa paar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ  ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: There is no boat, no raft, no oars and no boatman.
lines.transliteration: naa bayrhee naa t ulharh aa naa t is vanjh  malaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣੋ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ  ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the only boat on this terrifying ocean. His Glance of Grace carries usacross. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ai kaa bohithaa nad ree paar ut aar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਡਰਾਵਣੋ  ਨਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If I forget my Beloved, even for an instant, suffering overtakes me and peace departs.
lines.transliteration: ik til pi-aaraa visrai d ukh laagai sukh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਵੰਝੁ ਮਲਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Let that tongue be burnt in flames, which does not chant the Naam with love.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa jala-o jalaavanee naam na japai rasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੈ ਕਾ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: When the pitcher of the body bursts, there is terrible pain; those who are caught by the Minister of Death regret and repent. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ghat binsai d ukh aglo jam pakrh ai pachh utaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: Crying out, "Mine! Mine!", they have departed, but their bodies, their wealth, and theirwives did not go with them.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kar ga-ay tan Dh an kalat  na saath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਜਲਉ  ਜਲਾਵਣੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਰਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, wealth is useless; deceived by wealth, they have lost their way.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai Dhan baad  hai bh oolo maarag aath.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟੁ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ  ਜਮੁ ਪਕੜੈ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saacha-o saahib sayvee-ai gurmukh aktho kaath. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਗਏ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ  ਨ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going, people wander through reincarnation; they act according to their past actions.
lines.transliteration: aavai jaa-ay bhavaa-ee-ai pa-i-ai kirat  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਬਾਿਦ  ਹੈ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਆਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: How can one's pre-ordained destiny be erased? It is written in accordance with theLord's Will.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa ki-o maytee-ai likh i-aa laykh  rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਕਥੋ  ਕਾਿਥ  ॥੬॥
