lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, no one can be saved. Through the Guru's Teachings,we are united in His Union. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na chhutee-ai gurmat  milai milaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Without Him, I have no one to call my own. My soul and my breath of life belong toHim.
lines.transliteration: tis bin mayraa ko nahee jis kaa jee-o paraan.

lines.english: May my egotism and possessiveness be burnt to ashes, and my greed and egotisticalpride consigned to the fire.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa jal bala-o lobh  jala-o abh imaan.

lines.english: O Nanak, contemplating the Shabad, the Treasure of Excellence is obtained. ||8||10|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (59-18) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad veechaaree-ai paa-ee-ai gun ee niDh aan. ||8||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ  ਪਰਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O mind, love the Lord, as the lotus loves the water.
lines.transliteration: ray man aisee har si-o pareet kar jaisee jal kamlayhi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਜਿਲ  ਬਲਉ  ਲੋਭੁ ਜਲਉ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Tossed about by the waves, it still blossoms with love.
lines.transliteration: lahree naal pachhaarh ee-ai bh ee vigsai asnayhi.

lines.english: In the water, the creatures are created; outside of the water they die. ||1|| pMnw 60
lines.transliteration: jal meh jee-a upaa-ay kai bin jal maran t inayhi. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, how can you be saved without love?
lines.transliteration: man ray ki-o chhooteh bin pi-aar.

lines.english: God permeates the inner beings of the Gurmukhs. They are blessed with the treasure of devotion. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar rav rahi-aa bakh say bh agat bhandaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.
lines.transliteration: ray man aisee har si-o pareet kar jaisee machh ulee neer.

lines.english: The more the water, the more the happiness, and the greater the peace of mind andbody.
lines.transliteration: ji-o aDhika-o t i-o sukh  ghano man t an saaNt sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਨੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of hermind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin jal gharh ee na jeev-ee parabh  jaanai abh  peer. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਅਿਧਕਉ  ਿਤਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਸਰੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.
lines.transliteration: ray man aisee har si-o pareet kar jaisee chaat rik mayh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਜਲ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The pools are overflowing with water, and the land is luxuriantly green, but what are they to her, if that single drop of rain does not fall into her mouth?
lines.transliteration: sar bhar thal haree-aavlay ik boond  na pav-ee kayh.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਮੇਹ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, she receives it; otherwise, because of her past actions, she gives herhead. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam milai so paa-ee-ai kirat pa-i-aa sir d ayh. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ ਭਿਰ ਥਲ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ  ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਕੇਹ ॥
lines.english: O mind, love the Lord, as the water loves the milk.
lines.transliteration: ray man aisee har si-o pareet kar jaisee jal d uDh ho-ay.

lines.english: The water, added to the milk, itself bears the heat, and prevents the milk fromburning.
lines.transliteration: aavtan aapay kh avai d uDh ka-o kh apan na day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with truegreatness. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl vichhunni-aa sach vadi-aa-ee d ay-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਟਣੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਖਵੈ ਦੁਧ ਕਉ ਖਪਿਣ  ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.
lines.transliteration: ray man aisee har si-o pareet kar jaisee chakvee soor.

lines.english: She does not sleep, for an instant or a moment; the sun is so far away, but she thinksthat it is near.
lines.transliteration: khin pal need  na sov-ee jaan ai door hajoor.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਕਵੀ  ਸੂਰ ॥
lines.english: Understanding does not come to the self-willed manmukh. But to the Gurmukh, the Lord is always close. ||5||
lines.transliteration: manmukh sojh ee naa pavai gurmukh  sadaa hajoor. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਸੋਵਈ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਦੂਿਰ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs make their calculations and plans, but only the actions ofthe Creator come to pass.
lines.transliteration: manmukh gan at ganaavan ee kart aa karay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  naa pavai jay lochai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਗਣਤ  ਗਣਾਵਣੀ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace isfound. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmat ho-ay t a paa-ee-ai sach milai sukh  ho-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: True love shall not be broken, if the True Guru is met.
lines.transliteration: sachaa nayhu na tut-ee jay sat gur bh aytai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds isacquired.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan padaarath paa-ee-ai t aribhavan sojhee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: So become a customer of merit, and do not forget the Immaculate Naam, the Nameof the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam na veesrai jay gun kaa gaahak ho-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Those birds which peck at the shore of the pool have played and have departed.
lines.transliteration: khayl ga-ay say paNkh-nooN jo chugd ay sar t al.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: In a moment, in an instant, we too must depart. Our play is only for today or tomorrow.
lines.transliteration: gharh ee ke muhat  ke chaln aa kh aylan aj ke kal.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਿਲ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਖਣੂੰ  ਜੋ ਚੁਗਦੇ  ਸਰ ਤਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: But those whom You unite, Lord, are united with You; they obtain a seat in the Arenaof Truth. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jis tooN mayleh so milai jaa-ay sachaa pirh  mal. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ  ਿਕ ਮੁਹਿਤ ਿਕ ਚਲਣਾ  ਖੇਲਣੁ  ਅਜੁ ਿਕ ਕਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, love does not well up, and the filth of egotism does not depart.
lines.transliteration: bin gur pareet na oopjai ha-umai mail na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ਸਚਾ ਿਪੜੁ ਮਿਲ ॥੮॥
lines.english: One who recognizes within himself that, "He is me", and who is pierced through bythe Shabad, is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: sohaN aap pachhaan ee-ai sabad  bhayd patee-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When one becomes Gurmukh and realizes his own self, what more is there left to door have done? ||9||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap pachh aanee-ai avar ke karay karaa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹੰ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਭੇਿਦ ਪਤੀਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Why speak of union to those who are already united with the Lord? Receiving theShabad, they are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: mili-aa kaa ki-aa maylee-ai sabad milay pat ee-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਵਰ  ਿਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not understand; separated from Him, they endurebeatings.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sojh ee naa pavai veechh urh chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is only the one door to His Home; there is no other place at all.||10||11|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (60-15) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dar gh ar ayk hai avar na d oojee jaa-ay. ||10||11||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਵੀਛੁਿੜ  ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded and deceived. They find no placeof rest.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh ulai bh ulaa-ee-ai bh oolee th a-ur na kaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one is shown the Way. Like the blind, they continue coming andgoing.
lines.transliteration: gur bin ko na dikh aava-ee anDh ee aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Having lost the treasure of spiritual wisdom, they depart, defrauded and plundered.||1||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan padaarath kh o-i-aa th agi-aa muth aa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਭੁਲੈ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ  ਭੂਲੀ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਕਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.
lines.transliteration: baabaa maa-i-aa bharam bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਿਦਖਾਵਈ  ਅੰਧੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Deceived by doubt, the discarded bride is not received into the Lap of her Beloved.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulee dohaagan ee naa pir ank samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The deceived bride wanders around in foreign lands; she leaves, and abandons herown home.
lines.transliteration: bhoolee firai d isantree bh oolee garihu t aj jaa-ay.

lines.english: Deceived, she climbs the plateaus and mountains; her mind wavers in doubt.
lines.transliteration: bhoolee doongar thal charh ai bharmai man dolaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਨਾ ਿਪਰ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharahu vichh unnee ki-o milai garab muth ee billaa-ay. ||2|| Separated from the Primal Being, how can she meet with Him again? Plundered by pride, she cries out and bewails. ||2||
The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord. pMnw 61
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa gur maylsee har ras naam pi-aar.

lines.english: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saach sahj sobhaa gh anee har gun  naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my HusbandLord, who else is there for me? ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh  tooN mai t ujh bin kavan bh ataar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they areso proud of their religious robes.
lines.transliteration: akhar parh  parh bhulee-ai bh aykhee bahut  abhimaan.

lines.punjabi: ਅਖਰ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਭੁਲੀਐ  ਭੇਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth ofstubborn pride is within the mind?
lines.transliteration: tirath naat aa ki-aa karay man meh mail gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਤਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, theEmperor? ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur bin kin samjaa-ee-ai man raajaa sultaan. ||4||

lines.english: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: paraym padaarath paa-ee-ai gurmukh  tat veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan aap gavaa-i-aa gur kai sabad  seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ghar hee so pir paa-i-aa gur kai hayt  apaar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace isobtained.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa chaakree man nirmal sukh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminatedfrom within.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasi-aa ha-umai vichahu kh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paa-i-aa laabh  sadaa man ho-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.
lines.transliteration: karam milai taa paa-ee-ai aap na la-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਲਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.
lines.transliteration: gur kee charnee lag rahu vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਿਗ  ਰਹੁ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sachay saytee rat i-aa sacho palai paa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਤਆ  ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.
lines.transliteration: bhulan  andar sabh  ko abh ul guroo kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਲਣ  ਅੰਦਿਰ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਭੁਲੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat man samjh aa-i-aa laagaa t isai pi-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad.||8||12|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (61-9) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach na veesrai maylay sabad apaar. ||8||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to theirchildren, relatives, households and spouses.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa maa-i-aa mohn ee sut  banDh ap gh ar naar.

lines.english: Dhan joban jag th agi-aa lab lobh  ahaNkaar. The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਘਰ ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the wholeworld. ||1||
lines.transliteration: moh thag-ulee ha-o mu-ee saa vart ai sansaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਨ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਜਗੁ ਠਿਗਆ  ਲਿਬ ਲੋਿਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetamaa mai t ujh bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ  ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai tujh  bin avar na bh aav-ee t ooN bhaaveh sukh  ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮਾ  ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: naam saalaahee rang si-o gur kai sabad sant okh.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so chalsee koorh aa moh na vaykh .

lines.english: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day.||2||
lines.transliteration: vaat vataa-oo aa-i-aa nit chald aa saath d aykh. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ॥
lines.english: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  aakh ahi kayt -rhay gur bin boojh  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ  ਕੂੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed withhonor.
lines.transliteration: naam vadaa-ee jay milai sach rapai pat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ  ਆਇਆ  ਿਨਤ ਚਲਦਾ  ਸਾਥੁ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaaveh say bh alay kh otaa kh araa na ko-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਿਣ  ਆਖਿਹ  ਕੇਤੜੇ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs arefalse.
lines.transliteration: gur sarnaa-ee chh utee-ai manmukh  khotee raas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਿਚ ਰਪੈ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: asat Dhaat  paatisaah kee gh arhee-ai sabad  vigaas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury.||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay parkhay paarkh oo pavai kh ajaanai raas. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.
lines.transliteration: tayree keemat  naa pavai sabh  dithee thok vajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਟ  ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ਕੀ ਘੜੀਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਵਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.
lines.transliteration: kahnai haath na labh -ee sach tikai pat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਰਖੇ  ਪਾਰਖੂ  ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmat t ooN salaahn aa hor keemat  kahan  na jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਿਡਠੀ  ਠੋਿਕ ਵਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism andconflict.
lines.transliteration: jit tan naam na bh aav-ee t it tan ha-umai vaad .

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਣੈ  ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਸਿਚ ਿਟਕੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.
lines.transliteration: gur bin gi-aan na paa-ee-ai bikhi-aa d oojaa saad .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਤੂੰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕੀਮਿਤ ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavee maa-i-aa feekaa saad . ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਵਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they tastethe sweet and sour flavors.
lines.transliteration: aasaa andar jammi-aa aasaa ras kas kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.
lines.transliteration: aasaa banDh chalaa-ee-ai muhay muhi chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਫੀਕਾ  ਸਾਦੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7|| pMnw 62
lines.transliteration: avgan baDh aa maaree-ai chh ootai gurmat  naa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: In all places, You are the One and Only. As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me!
lines.transliteration: sarbay thaa-ee ayk tooN ji-o bh aavai t i-o raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਥਾਈ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One abides within the mind. TheCompanionship of the Naam brings the most excellent honor.
lines.transliteration: gurmat saachaa man vasai naam bh alo pat  saakh .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਲੋ ਪਿਤ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Eradicate the disease of egotism, and chant the True Shabad, the Word of the TrueLord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog gavaa-ee-ai sabad sachai sach bh aakh. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੮॥
lines.english: You are pervading throughout the Akaashic Ethers, the nether regions and the threeworlds.
lines.transliteration: aakaasee paataal t ooN taribhavan rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: You Yourself are bhakti, loving devotional worship. You Yourself unite us in Union withYourself.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhagt ee bh aa-o t ooN aapay mileh milaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! As is Your Pleasure, so is Your Will. ||9||13|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (62-3) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai ji-o bhaavai t ivai rajaa-ay. ||9||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੯॥੧੩॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the Name of the Lord. What else should I contemplate?
lines.transliteration: raam naam man bayDhi-aa avar ke karee veechaar.

lines.english: Focusing your awareness on the Shabad, happiness wells up. Attuned to God, the most excellent peace is found.
lines.transliteration: sabad surat  sukh  oopjai parabh  raata-o sukh  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕ ਕਰੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, please save me, Lord. The Name of the Lord is my Support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  tooN mai har naam aDh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਤਉ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O mind, the Will of our Lord and Master is true.
lines.transliteration: man ray saachee khasam rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Focus your love upon the One who created and adorned your body and mind.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin tan man saaj seegaari-aa t is sayt ee liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If I cut my body into pieces, and burn them in the fire,
lines.transliteration: tan baisant ar homee-ai ik rat ee tol kataa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਿਜ  ਸੀਗਾਿਰਆ ਿਤਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tan man samDh aa jay karee an-d in agan jalaa-ay. and if I make my body and mind into firewood, and night and day burn them in thefire,
har naamai tul na puj-ee jay lakh  kotee karam kamaa-ay. ||2|| and if I perform hundreds of thousands and millions of religious rituals-still, all theseare not equal to the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਿਰ  ਹੋਮੀਐ  ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤੋਿਲ  ਕਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If my body were cut in half, if a saw was put to my head,
lines.transliteration: araDh sareer kataa-ee-ai sir karvat  Dharaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਅਗਿਨ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tan haimanchal gaalee-ai bh ee man t ay rog na jaa-ay. and if my body were frozen in the Himalayas-even then, my mind would not be free ofdisease.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਿਲ  ਨ ਪੁਜਈ  ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: None of these are equal to the Name of the Lord. I have seen and tried and tested them all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har naamai tul na puj-ee sabh  dithee thok vajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: If I made a donation of castles of gold, and gave lots of fine horses and wondrouselephants in charity,
lines.transliteration: kanchan kay kot dat  karee baho haivar gaivar d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਹੈਮੰਚਿਲ  ਗਾਲੀਐ  ਭੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoom d aan ga-oo-aa gh anee bh ee ant ar garab gumaan. and if I made donations of land and cows-even then, pride and ego would still bewithin me.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਿਲ  ਨ ਪੁਜਈ  ਸਭ ਿਡਠੀ  ਠੋਿਕ ਵਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord has pierced my mind; the Guru has given me this true gift.||4||
lines.transliteration: raam naam man bayDhi-aa gur d ee-aa sach d aan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨ  ਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਦਤੁ ਕਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਹੈਵਰ  ਗੈਵਰ  ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: There are so many stubborn-minded intelligent people, and so many who contemplatethe Vedas.
lines.transliteration: manhath buDh ee kayt ee-aa kayt ay bayd  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਿਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗਊਆ  ਘਣੀ  ਭੀ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: There are so many entanglements for the soul. Only as Gurmukh do we find the Gateof Liberation.
lines.transliteration: kaytay banDh an jee-a kay gurmukh  mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Truth is higher than everything; but higher still is truthful living. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachahu orai sabh ko upar sach aachaar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਠ ਬੁਧੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ  ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Call everyone exalted; no one seems lowly.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko oochaa aakh ee-ai neech na d eesai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord has fashioned the vessels, and His One Light pervades the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: iknai bhaaNday saaji-ai ik chaanan  tihu lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਉਪਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Receiving His Grace, we obtain Truth. No one can erase His Primal Blessing. ||6||
lines.transliteration: karam milai sach paa-ee-ai Dhur bakh as na maytai ko-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਊਚਾ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When one Holy person meets another Holy person, they abide in contentment, through the Love of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: saaDh milai saaDh oo janai sant okh vasai gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨੈ  ਭਡੇ ਸਾਿਜਐ  ਇਕੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਿਤਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They contemplate the Unspoken Speech, merging in absorption in the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa veechaaree-ai jay satgur maahi samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਧੁਿਰ ਬਖਸ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, they are contented; they go to the Court of the Lordin robes of honor. ||7||
lines.transliteration: pee amrit sant okhi-aa d argahi paiDh aa jaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every heart the Music of the Lord's Flute vibrates, night and day, withsublime love for the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at vaajai kinguree an-d in sabad  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Only those few who become Gurmukh understand this by instructing their minds.
lines.transliteration: virlay ka-o sojhee pa-ee gurmukh  man samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸੰਤੋਿਖਆ  ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam. Practicing the Shabad you shall be saved. ||8||14|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (62-16) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai chhootai sabad  kamaa-ay. ||8||14||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਵਾਜੈ ਿਕੰਗੁਰੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: There are painted mansions to behold, white-washed, with beautiful doors;
lines.transliteration: chitay d iseh Dh a-ulhar bagay bank d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kar man khusee usaari-aa d oojai hayt  pi-aar. they were constructed to give pleasure to the mind, but this is only for the sake of the love of duality.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਛੂਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੮॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes.||1||
lines.transliteration: andar kh aalee paraym bin dh eh dh ayree t an chh aar. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, this body and wealth shall not go along with you.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray t an Dh an saath na ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; through the Guru, God bestows this gift.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan nirmalo gur d aat karay parabh  so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਮਨ ਖੁਸੀ ਉਸਾਿਰਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; it is given only by the Giver.
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan nirmalo jay d ayvai d ayvan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਢਿਹ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who has the Guru, the Creator, as his Friend, shall not be questioned hereafter.
lines.transliteration: aagai poochh na hova-ee jis baylee gur kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself delivers those who are delivered. He Himself is the Forgiver. ||2|| pMnw 63
lines.transliteration: aap chhadaa-ay chh utee-ai aapay bakh sanhaar. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh looks upon his daughters, sons and relatives as his own.
lines.transliteration: manmukh jaan ai aapn ay Dh ee-aa poot  sanjog.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਧੀਆ  ਪੂਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon his wife, he is pleased. But along with happiness, they bring grief.
lines.transliteration: naaree daykh  vigaasee-ah naalay harakh  so sog.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਰੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਾਸੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਲੇ  ਹਰਖੁ ਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. Day and night, they enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  rangaavlay ahinis har ras bh og. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰੰਗਾਵਲੇ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The consciousness of the wicked, faithless cynics wanders around in search oftransitory wealth, unstable and distracted.
lines.transliteration: chit chalai vit  jaavn o saakat  dol dolaa-ay.

lines.english: Searching outside of themselves, they are ruined; the object of their search is in thatsacred place within the home of the heart.
lines.transliteration: baahar dhoondh  viguchee-ai gh ar meh vasat  suthaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਢੂੰਿਢ  ਿਵਗੁਚੀਐ  ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਵਸਤੁ  ਸੁਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, in their ego, miss it; the Gurmukhs receive it in their laps.||4||
lines.transliteration: manmukh ha-umai kar musee gurmukh  palai paa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਿਰ ਮੁਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: You worthless, faithless cynic-recognize your own origin!
lines.transliteration: saakat nirgun i-aari-aa aapn aa mool pachh aan.

lines.english: This body is made of blood and semen. It shall be consigned to the fire in the end.
lines.transliteration: rakat bind  kaa ih t ano agnee paas piraan .

lines.punjabi: ਰਕਤੁ  ਿਬੰਦੁ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੋ ਅਗਨੀ  ਪਾਿਸ ਿਪਰਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The body is under the power of the breath, according to the True Sign inscribed upon your forehead. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pavnai kai vas d ayhuree mast ak sach neesaan . ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਣੈ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Everyone begs for a long life-no one wishes to die.
lines.transliteration: bahutaa jeevan  mangee-ai mu-aa na lorh ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਮੁਆ  ਨ ਲੋੜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: A life of peace and comfort comes to that Gurmukh, within whom God dwells.
lines.transliteration: sukh jeevan  tis aakh ee-ai jis gurmukh  vasi-aa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, what good those who do not have the Blessed Vision, the Darshanof the Lord and Guru? ||6||
lines.transliteration: naam vihoonay ki-aa gan ee jis har gur d aras na ho-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਣੇ ਿਕਆ  ਗਣੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: In their dreams at night, people wander around as long as they sleep;
lines.transliteration: ji-o supnai nis bhulee-ai jab lag nid raa ho-ay.
i-o sarpan kai vas jee-arhaa ant ar ha-umai d o-ay. just so, they are under the power of the snake Maya, as long as their hearts are filledwith ego and duality.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਸਰਪਿਨ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they come to understand and see that this world isjust a dream. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmat ho-ay veechaaree-ai supnaa ih jag lo-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: As thirst is quenched with water, and the baby is satisfied with mother's milk,
lines.transliteration: agan marai jal paa-ee-ai ji-o baarik dooDh ai maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਉ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਦੂਧੈ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bin jal kamal so naa thee-ai bin jal meen maraa-ay. and as the lotus does not exist without water, and as the fish dies without water

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ  ਸੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਜਲ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: -O Nanak, so does the Gurmukh live, receiving the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||15|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (63-10) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har ras milai jeevaa har gun  gaa-ay. ||8||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਿਮਲੈ ਜੀਵਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥੮॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Beholding the terrifying mountain in this world of my father's home, I am terrified.
lines.transliteration: doongar daykh  daraavn o pay-ee-arh ai daree-aas.

lines.english: It is so difficult to climb this high mountain; there is no ladder which reaches up there.
lines.transliteration: oocha-o parbat gaakh -rho naa pa-orh ee tit taas.

lines.english: But as Gurmukh, I know that it is within my self; the Guru has brought me to Union,and so I cross over. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar jaan i-aa gur maylee t aree-aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਉ  ਪਰਬਤੁ  ਗਾਖੜੋ  ਨਾ ਪਉੜੀ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, the terrifying world-ocean is so difficult to cross-I am terrified!
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray bh avjal bikh am daraaN-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਰੀਆਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru, in His Pleasure, has met with me; the Guru has saved me,through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur ras milai gur t aaray har naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I may say, "I am going, I am going", but I know that, in the end, I must really go.
lines.transliteration: chalaa chalaa jay karee jaanaa chalan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਸ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever comes must also go. Only the Guru and the Creator are Eternal.
lines.transliteration: jo aa-i-aa so chalsee amar so gur kartaar.

lines.english: So praise the True One continually, and love His Place of Truth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhee sachaa salaahn aa sachai thaan pi-aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਾ  ਚਲਾ  ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਜਾਣਾ  ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Beautiful gates, houses and palaces, solidly built forts,
lines.transliteration: dar gh ar mehlaa sohn ay pakay kot hajaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ  ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ  ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hastee gh orhay paakh ray laskar lakh  apaar. elephants, saddled horses, hundreds of thousands of uncounted armies
kis hee naal na chali-aa khap kh ap mu-ay asaar. ||3|| -none of these will go along with anyone in the end, and yet, the fools bother themselves to exhaustion with these, and then die. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਪਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਹਜਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: You may gather gold and sliver, but wealth is just a net of entanglement.
lines.transliteration: su-inaa rupaa sanchee-ai maal jaal janjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਸਤੀ  ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ  ਲਸਕਰ  ਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: You may beat the drum and proclaim authority over the whole world, but without theName, death hovers over your head.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag meh d ohee fayree-ai bin naavai sir kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਿਲਆ  ਖਿਪ ਖਿਪ ਮੁਏ ਅਸਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: When the body falls, the play of life is over; what shall be the condition of the evil-doers then? ||4||
lines.transliteration: pind parhai jee-o kh aylsee bad failee ki-aa haal. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ  ਮਾਲੁ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਜੰਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: The husband is delighted seeing his sons, and his wife upon his bed.
lines.transliteration: putaa d aykh vigsee-ai naaree sayj bh ataar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਦੋਹੀ ਫੇਰੀਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: He applies sandalwood and scented oils, and dresses himself in his beautiful clothes.
lines.transliteration: cho-aa chandan laa-ee-ai kaaparh  roop seegaar.

lines.english: But dust shall mix with dust, and he shall depart, leaving hearth and home behind. ||5||
lines.transliteration: khayhoo kh ayh ralaa-ee-ai chh od chalai gh ar baar. ||5||

lines.english: He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a lord;
lines.transliteration: mahar malook kahaa-ee-ai raajaa raa-o ke khaan.

lines.punjabi: ਚੋਆ  ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ  ਕਾਪੜੁ  ਰੂਪੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha-uDhree raa-o sad aa-ee-ai jal balee-ai abh imaan. he may present himself as a leader or a chief, but this just burns him in the fire ofegotistical pride.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ  ਛੋਿਡ ਚਲੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh has forgotten the Naam. He is like straw, burning in theforest fire. ||6||
lines.transliteration: manmukh naam visaari-aa ji-o dav d aDhaa kaan. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਰ  ਮਲੂਕ  ਕਹਾਈਐ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਉ ਿਕ ਖਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Whoever comes into the world and indulges in ego, must depart. pMnw 64
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kar kar jaa-isee jo aa-i-aa jag maahi.

lines.english: The whole world is a store-house of lamp-black; the body and mind are blackened with it.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag kaajal koth -rhee tan man d ayh su-aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ  ਕੋਠੜੀ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਆਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are saved by the Guru are immaculate and pure; through the Word of theShabad, they extinguish the fire of desire. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say nirmalay sabad  nivaaree bh aahi. ||7||

lines.english: O Nanak, they swim across with the True Name of the Lord, the King above the headsof kings.
lines.transliteration: naanak taree-ai sach naam sir saahaa paat isaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: May I never forget the Name of the Lord! I have purchased the Jewel of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mai har naam na veesrai har naam ratan vaysaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in the terrifying world-ocean, while theGurmukhs cross over the bottomless ocean. ||8||16|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 2 ] (64-3) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 2. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh a-ojal pach mu-ay gurmukh  taray athaahu. ||8||16||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਉਜਿਲ  ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਰੇ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
lines.english: They have made this their resting place and they sit at home, but the urge to departis always there.
lines.transliteration: mukaam kar ghar baisn aa nit  chaln ai kee Dh okh.

lines.english: This would be known as a lasting place of rest, only if they were to remain stable andunchanging. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukaam taa par jaan ee-ai jaa rahai nihchal lok. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਸਣਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਚਲਣੈ  ਕੀ ਧੋਖ ॥
lines.english: What sort of a resting place is this world?
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kais mukaamay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ  ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਰਹੈ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Doing deeds of faith, pack up the supplies for your journey, and remain committed tothe Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar sidak karn ee kh arach baaDh hu laag rahu naamay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Yogis sit in their Yogic postures, and the Mullahs sit at their resting stations.
lines.transliteration: jogee ta aasan  kar bahai mulaa bahai mukaam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਸਦਕੁ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਖਰਚੁ  ਬਾਧਹੁ ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Hindu Pandits recite from their books, and the Siddhas sit in the temples of their gods. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pandit vakaan eh pothee-aa siDh  baheh d ayv sathaan. ||2||

lines.english: The angels, Siddhas, worshippers of Shiva, heavenly musicians, silent sages, Saints,priests, preachers, spiritual teachers and commanders
lines.transliteration: sur siDh gan  ganDh arab mun jan saykh  peer salaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਤ ਆਸਣੁ ਕਿਰ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਲਾ  ਬਹੈ ਮੁਕਾਿਮ  ॥
lines.transliteration: dar kooch koochaa kar ga-ay avray bh e chalan haar. ||3|| -each and every one has left, and all others shall depart as well. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਪੋਥੀਆ  ਿਸਧ ਬਹਿਹ  ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The sultans and kings, the rich and the mighty, have marched away in succession.
lines.transliteration: sultaan kh aan malook umray ga-ay kar kar kooch.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰ ਿਸਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਸਲਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: In a moment or two, we shall also depart. O my heart, understand that you must goas well! ||4||
lines.transliteration: gharh ee muhat  ke chaln aa dil samajh  tooN bhe pahooch. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਕੂਚ ਕੂਚਾ  ਕਿਰ ਗਏ ਅਵਰੇ  ਿਭ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: This is described in the Shabads; only a few understand this!
lines.transliteration: sabdaah maahi vakh aanee-ai virlaa t a boojh ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ  ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ  ਉਮਰੇ  ਗਏ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਕੂਚੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer to the One who pervades the water, the land and the air.||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai baynt ee jal thal mahee-al so-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ  ਮੁਹਿਤ  ਿਕ ਚਲਣਾ  ਿਦਲ  ਸਮਝੁ  ਤੂੰ ਿਭ ਪਹੂਚੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He is Allah, the Unknowable, the Inaccessible, All-powerful and Merciful Creator.
lines.transliteration: alaahu alakh agamm kaad ar karanhaar kareem.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦਾਹ  ਮਾਿਹ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਤ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All the world comes and goes-only the Merciful Lord is permanent. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sabh d unee aavan  jaavn ee mukaam ayk raheem. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Call permanent only the One, who does not have destiny inscribed upon His Forehead.
lines.transliteration: mukaam tis no aakh ee-ai jis sis na hovee laykh .

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਾਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਮੁ  ॥
lines.english: The sky and the earth shall pass away; He alone is permanent. ||7||
lines.transliteration: asmaan Dhart ee chalsee mukaam ohee ayk. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਵਣੀ  ਮੁਕਾਮੁ  ਏਕੁ ਰਹੀਮੁ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The day and the sun shall pass away; the night and the moon shall pass away; the hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.
lines.transliteration: din rav chalai nis sas chalai t aarikaa lakh  palo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਿਸ  ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone is permanent; Nanak speaks the Truth. ||8||17|| mhly pihly sqwrh AstpdIAw ] (64-13) mahlay pahilay sataarah asatpad ee-aa. Seventeen Ashtapadees Of The First Mehl. isrIrwgu mhlw 3 Gru 1 AstpdIAw  (64-14) sireeraag mehlaa 3 ghar 1 asatpad ee-aa Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (64-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mukaam ohee ayk hai naankaa sach bugo-ay. ||8||17||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ  ਚਲਸੀ  ਮੁਕਾਮੁ  ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: By God's Grace, the Gurmukh practices devotion; without the Guru, there is nodevotional worship.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kirpaa karay bh agat keejai bin gur bh agat na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨ  ਰਿਵ ਚਲੈ ਿਨਿਸ  ਸਿਸ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਿਰਕਾ  ਲਖ ਪਲੋਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who merges his own self into Him understands, and so becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: aapai aap milaa-ay boojhai t aa nirmal hovai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ  ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਚੁ ਬੁਗੋਇ  ॥੮॥੧੭॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Word of the Shabad, Union with Him is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sachaa sachee banee sabad  milaavaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, without devotion, why have people even come into the world?
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray bh agtiheen  kaahay jag aa-i-aa.

lines.english: They have not served the Perfect Guru; they have wasted their lives in vain.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee sayv na keenee birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕੀਜੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver. He Himself forgives, and unitesus with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay har jagjeevan daat aa aapay bakh as milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: What are these poor beings and creatures? What can they speak and say?
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant ay ki-aa vaychaaray ki-aa ko aakh  sunaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God Himself grants glory to the Gurmukhs; He joins them to His Service. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aapay d ay vadi-aa-ee aapay sayv karaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਭਗਿਤਹੀਣੁ  ਕਾਹੇ ਜਿਗ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you. pMnw 65
lines.transliteration: daykh  kutamb mohi lobh aanaa chald i-aa naal na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, I have found the Treasure of Excellence. Its value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv gun  niDhaan paa-i-aa t is kee keem na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord God is my Best Friend. In the end, He shall be my Companion and Support. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabh sakh aa har jee-o mayraa ant ay ho-ay sakh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In this world of my father's home, the Great Giver is the Life of the World. The self-willed manmukhs have lost their honor.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai jagjeevan d aataa manmukh  pat gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one knows the Way. The blind find no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur ko mag na jaan ai anDh ay tha-ur na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੋ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅੰਧੇ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: If the Lord, the Giver of Peace, does not dwell within the mind, then they shall departwith regret in the end. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har sukh-d aata man nahee vasi-aa ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਸਆ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: In this world of my father's house, through the Guru's Teachings, I have cultivatedwithin my mind the Great Giver, the Life of the World.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai jagjeevan d aataa gurmat  man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, performing devotional worship, day and night, ego and emotionalattachment are removed.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahi d in raat ee ha-umai moh chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: And then, attuned to Him, we become like Him, truly absorbed in the True One. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jis si-o raataa t aiso hovai sachay sach samaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਉ ਰਾਤਾ  ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He gives us His Love, and we contemplate the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay nadar karay bh aa-o laa-ay gur sabd ee beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, intuitive peace wells up, and ego and desire die.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai sahj oopjai ha-umai t arisnaa maar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of Virtue, dwells forever within the minds of those who keep Truth enshrined within their hearts. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har gundaat aa sad  man vasai sach rakh i-aa ur Dh aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਸਦ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ ॥੬॥
lines.english: My God is forever Immaculate and Pure; with a pure mind, He can be found.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayraa sad aa nirmalaa man nirmal paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਮਿਨ ਿਨਰਮਿਲ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If the Treasure of the Name of the Lord abides within the mind, egotism and pain aretotally eliminated.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan har man vasai ha-umai d ukh sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has instructed me in the Word of the Shabad. I am forever a sacrificeto Him. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur sabad  sunaa-i-aa ha-o sad  balihaarai jaa-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Within your own conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru,selfishness and conceit are not eradicated.
lines.transliteration: aapnai man chit  kahai kahaa-ay bin gur aap na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Lover of His devotees, the Giver of Peace. By His Grace, Heabides within the mind.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o bhagat  vachh al sukh -daata kar kirpaa man vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God blesses us with the sublime awakening of consciousness; He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh. ||8||1||18|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (65-10) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sobhaa surat  day-ay parabh  aapay gurmukh  day vadi-aa-ee. ||8||1||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੮॥੧॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Those who go around acting in egotism are struck down by the Messenger of Deathwith his club.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karam kamaavday jamdand lagai t in aa-ay.

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are uplifted and saved, in love with the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: je satgur sayvan say ubray har sayt ee liv laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਮਡੰਡੁ ਲਗੈ ਿਤਨ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man ray gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhur poorab kart ai likh i-aa tinaa gurmat  naam samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. Those who are so pre-destined by the Creator are absorbed into the Naam, throughthe Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
Without the True Guru, faith does not come, and love for the Naam is not embraced.
lines.transliteration: vin sat gur part eet na aavee naam na laago bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਗੁ ਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even in dreams, they find no peace; they sleep immersed in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: supnai sukh na paav-ee d ukh meh savai samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Even if you chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with great longing, your pastactions are still not erased.
lines.transliteration: jay har har keechai bahut lochee-ai kirat  na mayti-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਾਗੋ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's devotees surrender to His Will; those devotees are accepted at His Door.||3||
lines.transliteration: har kaa bhaan aa bh agtee mani-aa say bh agat pa-ay d ar thaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ  ਦੁਖ ਮਿਹ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Word of His Shabad within me. Without His Grace, it cannot be attained.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad d irhaavai rang si-o bin kirpaa la-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਚੈ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚੀਐ  ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਮੇਿਟਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Even if the poisonous plant is watered w ith ambrosial nectar a hundred times, it will still bear poisonous fruit. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o amrit neeree-ai bh ee bikh  fal laagai Dh aa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਪਏ ਦਿਰ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who are in love with the True Guru are pure and true.
lines.transliteration: say jan sachay nirmalay jin satgur naal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਦੜਾਵੈ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They act in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; they shed the poison of ego andcorruption. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa kamaavd ay bikh  ha-umai t aj vikaar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨੀਰੀਐ  ਭੀ ਿਬਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਧਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Acting in stubborn-mindedness, no one is saved; go and study the Simritees and theShaastras.
lines.transliteration: manhath kit ai upaa-ay na chh ootee-ai simrit  saast ar soDh hu jaa-ay.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and practicing the Shabads of theGuru, you shall be saved. ||6||
lines.transliteration: mil sangat saaDh oo ubray gur kaa sabad  kamaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਿਬਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਿਜ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Treasure, which has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam niDhaan hai jis ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਸੋਧਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are beauteous; the Creator has blessed them with His Mercy. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh say-ee sohd ay jin kirpaa karay kart aar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਬਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is the Giver; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: naanak daat aa ayk hai d oojaa a-or na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is obtained. By His Mercy, He is found. ||8||2||19|| pMnw 66 isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (66-1) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-ee-ai karam paraapat ho-ay. ||8||2||19||

lines.english: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.
lines.transliteration: pankhee birakh  suhaavrh aa sach chugai gur bh aa-ay.

lines.english: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she doesnot fly around coming and going.
lines.transliteration: har ras peevai sahj rahai udai na aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਖੀ ਿਬਰਿਖ  ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ  ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of theLord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paa-i-aa har har naam samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਹੈ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, work to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: man ray gur kee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord'sName, night and day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai jay chaleh t aa an-d in raacheh har naa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.
lines.transliteration: pankhee birakh  suhaavrh ay oodeh chahu d is jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਤਾ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਚਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa oodeh d ukh ghanay nit  daajheh tai billaahi.

lines.english: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin gur mahal na jaap-ee naa amrit fal paahi. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of theTrue One, with intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh barahm haree-aavlaa saachai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤਾ  ਊਡਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਿਨਤ  ਦਾਝਿਹ  ਤੈ ਿਬਲਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the OneWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saakhaa t een nivaaree-aa ayk sabad  liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਪਈ  ਨਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit fal har ayk hai aapay d ay-ay kh avaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, andthey do not provide any shade.
lines.transliteration: manmukh oobh ay suk ga-ay naa fal t innaa chh aa-o.

lines.english: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.
lines.transliteration: tinnaa paas na baisee-ai onaa gh ar na giraa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲੁ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord'sName. ||4||
lines.transliteration: katee-ah tai nit  jaalee-ah onaa sabad  na naa-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਊਭੇ ਸੁਿਕ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਿਤੰਨਾ  ਛਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.
lines.transliteration: hukmay karam kamaavnay pa-i-ai kirat  firaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤੰਨਾ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਨ ਬੈਸੀਐ  ਓਨਾ  ਘਰੁ ਨ ਿਗਰਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever Hesends them, there they go.
lines.transliteration: hukmay darsan d aykh-naa jah bh ayjeh t ah jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਟੀਅਿਹ ਤੈ ਿਨਤ  ਜਾਲੀਅਿਹ  ਓਨਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਨਾਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command wemerge in Truth. ||5||
lines.transliteration: hukmay har har man vasai hukmay sach samaa-o. ||5||

lines.english: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around makingmistakes.
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaaneh bapurh ay bh oolay fireh gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ  ਜਹ ਭੇਜਿਹ  ਤਹ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: manhath karam kamaavd ay nit  nit hohi kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord.||6||
lines.transliteration: antar saaNt na aavee naa sach lagai pi-aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਬਪੁੜੇ  ਭੂਲੇ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਗਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhee-aa muh sohn ay gur kai hayt  pi-aar.

lines.english: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, theyare found to be true.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagt ee sach rat ay dar sachai sachiaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਨਾ ਸਿਚ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay say parvaan hai sabh  kul kaa karahi uDh aar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ  ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.
lines.transliteration: sabh nad ree karam kamaavd ay nad ree baahar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ  ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.
lines.transliteration: jaisee nadar kar d aykhai sachaa t aisaa hee ko ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਏ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received onlyby His Mercy. ||8||3||20|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (66-14) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vadaa-ee-aa karam paraapat ho-ay. ||8||3||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ  ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai manmukh  boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within theirminds.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa mukh  oojlay har vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitiveunderstanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee sukh paa-ee-ai sehjay rahai samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray d aasan d aasaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa gur bhagat  hai virlaa paa-ay ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony withthe Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sadaa suhaag suhaagan ee jay chaleh sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.
lines.transliteration: sadaa pir nihchal paa-ee-ai naa oh marai na jaa-ay.

lines.english: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She isimmersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabad milee naa veechh urhai pir kai ank samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: har nirmal at oojlaa bin gur paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deludedby doubt.
lines.transliteration: paath parh ai naa boojh -ee bh aykhee bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ  ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeatedwith the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har sad aa paa-i-aa rasnaa har ras samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings. pMnw 67
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh chukaa-i-aa gurmatee sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, the world wanders lost in pain. The self-willed manmukh is consumed.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai jag d ukhee-aa firai manmukh aa no ga-ee kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ  ਿਫਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, meditate on the Naam; through the Shabad, you shall merge inTruth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabday naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai sabd ay sach samaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The Siddhas wander around, deluded by Maya; they are not absorbed in theSamaadhi of the Lord's Sublime Love.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa bhoolay siDh  fireh samaaDh  na lagai subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਭੂਲੇ ਿਸਧ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The three worlds are permeated by Maya; they are totally covered by it.
lines.transliteration: teenay lo-a vi-aapat  hai aDh ik rahee laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਨੇ  ਲੋਅ ਿਵਆਪਤ  ਹੈ ਅਿਧਕ  ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, liberation is not attained, and the double-mindedness of Maya doesnot go away. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin gur mukat na paa-ee-ai naa d ubiDh aa maa-i-aa jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: What is called Maya? What does Maya do?
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kis no aakhee-ai ki-aa maa-i-aa karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਕਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: These beings are bound by pleasure and pain; they do their deeds in egotism.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  ayhu jee-o baDh  hai ha-umai karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਖ ਸੁਿਖ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਬਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, doubt is not dispelled, and egotism is not eliminated from within.||6||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai bh aram na chook-ee naa vichahu ha-umai jaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਚੂਕਈ  ਨਾ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without love, there is no devotional worship. Without the Shabad, no one finds acceptance.
lines.transliteration: bin pareetee bh agat na hova-ee bin sabd ai thaa-ay na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, egotism is conquered and subdued, and the illusion of Maya isdispelled.
lines.transliteration: sabday ha-umai maaree-ai maa-i-aa kaa bh aram jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀਐ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paa-ee-ai gurmukh  sahj subh aa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, one's virtues do not shine forth; without virtue, there is nodevotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bin gur gun na jaapnee bin gun  bhagat na ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He abides within their minds. They meet thatGod with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al har man vasi-aa sahj mili-aa parabh  so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, praise the Lord. By His Grace, He is obtained.||8||4||21|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (67-8) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabday har salaahee-ai karam paraapat  ho-ay. ||8||4||21||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਹਿਜ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is created by my God; He Himself misleads us throughillusion and doubt.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh mayrai parabh keenaa aapay bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs perform their actions, but they do not understand; they waste away their lives in vain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam karahi nahee boojh eh birthaa janam gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within themind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee is jag meh chaanan  karam vasai man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and find peace.
lines.transliteration: man ray naam japahu sukh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਿਬਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Praising the Perfect Guru, you shall easily meet with that God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa salaahee-ai sahj milai parabh so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Doubt departs, and fear runs away, when you focus your consciousness on the Lord'sFeet.
lines.transliteration: bharam ga-i-aa bh a-o bh aagi-aa har charn ee chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh practices the Shabad, and the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  kamaa-ee-ai har vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the mansion of the home within the self, we merge in Truth, and the Messenger ofDeath cannot devour us. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghar mahal sach samaa-ee-ai jamkaal na sakai kh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Naam Dayv the printer, and Kabeer the weaver, obtained salvation through thePerfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: naamaa chheebaa kabeer jolaahaa pooray gur t ay gat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਭਉ ਭਾਿਗਆ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who know God and recognize His Shabad lose their ego and class consciousness.
lines.transliteration: barahm kay baytay sabad  pachh aaneh ha-umai jaat  gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their Banis are sung by the angelic beings, and no one can erase them, O Siblings ofDestiny! ||3||
lines.transliteration: sur nar tin kee ban ee gaavahi ko-ay na maytai bh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies,austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: dait put karam Dh aram kichh  sanjam na parh ai doojaa bh aa-o na jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਾ  ਛੀਬਾ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜਲਾਹਾ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Upon meeting with the True Guru, he became pure; night and day, he chanted theNaam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ayti-ai nirmal ho-aa an-d in naam vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He read only of the One and he understood only the One Name; he knew no other atall. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ayko parhai ayko naa-o boojh ai doojaa avar na jaan ai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The followers of the six different life-styles and world-views, the Yogis and theSanyaasees have gone astray in doubt without the Guru.
lines.transliteration: khat d arsan jogee sani-aasee bin gur bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੰਜਮ  ਨ ਪੜੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: If they serve the True Guru, they find the state of salvation; they enshrine the DearLord within their minds.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh t aa gat  mit paavahi har jee-o man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਐ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: They focus their consciousness on the True Bani, and their comings and goings inreincarnation are over. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachee banee si-o chit  laagai aavan  jaan rahaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਪੜੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ਬੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and argue and stir up controversies, but without the Guru, they are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: pandit parh  parh vaad  vakaan eh bin gur bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They wander around the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations; without the Shabad, theydo not attain liberation.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh fayr pa-i-aa bin sabd ai mukat  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: But when they remember the Name, then they attain the state of salvation, when theTrue Guru unites them in Union. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jaa naa-o chaytai t aa gat  paa-ay jaa sat gur mayl milaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Name of the Lord wells up, when the True Guru unites us in His Sublime Love. pMnw 68
lines.transliteration: satsangat  meh naam har upjai jaa sat gur milai subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਉਪਜੈ  ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man tan arpee aap gavaa-ee chalaa sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ਚਲਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord.||7||
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaree gur apunay vitahu je har sayt ee chit  laa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਿਜ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of theLord.
lines.transliteration: so baraahman barahm jo bind ay har sayt ee rang raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਜੋ ਿਬੰਦੇ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.
lines.transliteration: parabh nikat vasai sabh naa gh at ant ar gurmukh  virlai jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਵਰਲੈ  ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (68-4) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee gur kai sabad pachh aataa. ||8||5||22||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥੮॥੫॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.
lines.transliteration: sahjai no sabh lochd ee bin gur paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while thefanatics are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  jotkee thakay bh aykhee bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੈ  ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants HisGrace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur bhaytay sahj paa-i-aa aapn ee kirpaa karay rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਜੋਤਕੀ  ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gur bin sahj na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that TrueLord is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabdai hee t ay sahj oopjai har paa-i-aa sach so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.
lines.transliteration: sehjay gaavi-aa thaa-ay pavai bin sahjai kathnee baad.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love isbalanced and detached.
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee bhagat  oopjai sahj pi-aar bairaag.

lines.english: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitivebalance, life is useless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahjai hee tay sukh  saat ho-ay bin sahjai jeevan  baad . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਗਾਿਵਆ  ਥਾਇ  ਪਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ  ਕਥਨੀ  ਬਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease,embrace Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: sahj saalaahee sadaa sad aa sahj samaaDh  lagaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਹਿਜ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ਬੈਰਾਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotionalworship.
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee gun oochrai bh agat karay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੈ  ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਬਾਿਦ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes theSublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabday hee har man vasai rasnaa har ras kh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of theTrue One.
lines.transliteration: sehjay kaal vidaari-aa sach sarnaa-ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਰੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing thelifestyle of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sehjay har naam man vasi-aa sachee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee jinee paa-i-aa sehjay rahay samaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love ofduality.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa vich sahj na oopjai maa-i-aa doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by theirselfishness and conceit.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam kamaavn ay ha-umai jalai jalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go inreincarnation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  na chook-ee fir fir aavai jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead todelusion and doubt.
lines.transliteration: tarihu gun aa vich sahj na paa-ee-ai t arai gun  bharam bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਲੈ ਜਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?
lines.transliteration: parhee-ai gun ee-ai ki-aa kathee-ai jaa mundh hu gh uthaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਚੂਕਈ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||
lines.transliteration: cha-uthay pad meh sahj hai gurmukh  palai paa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance,understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: nirgun naam niDh aan hai sehjay sojh ee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਗੁਣਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee salaahi-aa sachay sachee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੜੀਐ  ਗੁਣੀਐ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਥੀਐ  ਜਾ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bhuli-aa sahj milaa-isee sabad  milaavaa ho-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੇ  ਪਦ ਮਿਹ ਸਹਜੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utterdarkness.
lines.transliteration: bin sahjai sabh anDh  hai maa-i-aa moh gubaar.

lines.english: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee sojhee pa-ee sachai sabad  apaar.

lines.english: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas milaa-i-an pooray gur kart aar. ||8||

lines.english: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: sehjay adisat pachh aanee-ai nirbh a-o jot  nirankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa jee-aa kaa ik d aataa jot ee jot  milaavan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation.||9||
lines.transliteration: poorai sabad salaahee-ai jis d aa ant  na paaraavaar. ||9||

lines.english: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they tradewith Him.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee-aa kaa Dhan naam hai sahj karahi vaapaar.

lines.english: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.
lines.transliteration: an-din laahaa har naam lain akh ut bharay bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23|| pMnw 69 isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (69-1) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tot na aavee d ee-ay d ayvan haar. ||10||6||23||

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle ofreincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai fayr na pavai janam maran  dukh jaa-ay.
