lines.english: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remainabsorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poorai sabad sabh  sojhee ho-ee har naamai rahai samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man mayray satgur si-o chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam sad navt ano aap vasai man aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, sodo I remain.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o raakho apunee sarn aa-ee ji-o raakh ahi ti-o rahn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੋ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad jeevat  marai gurmukh  bhavjal t arnaa. ||2||

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, throughthe Shabad, you shall be exalted.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag naa-o paa-ee-ai gurmat  sabad  suhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਸਰਣਾਈ ਿਜਉ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਰਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state ofintuitive balance. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay man vasi-aa parabh kart aa sehjay rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਰਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound inchains, they wander lost in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: iknaa manmukh sabad  na bh aavai banDh an banDh  bhavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away theirlives in vain. ||4||
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh fir fir aavai birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the TrueWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa man aanand  hai sachai sabad  rang raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੰਧਿਨ  ਬੰਿਧ ਭਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitiveease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavahi sad  nirmal sehjay naam samaat ay. ||5||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soulin all.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh amrit  banee boleh sabh  aatam raam pachh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ayko sayvan ayk araaDheh gurmukh  akath kahaan ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਦ ਿਨਰਮਲ ਸਹਜੇ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਤੇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sayvee-ai gurmukh vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਸਭ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy andunites them with Himself. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sadaa rang raat ay sach si-o apunee kirpaa karay milaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from theirsleep.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay aapay iknaa suti-aa d ay-ay jagaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad. ||8||7||24|| isrIrwgu mhlw 3 ] (69-11) sireeraag mehlaa 3. Siree Raag, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaa-idaa naanak sabad  samaa-ay. ||8||7||24||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਿਸਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai man nirmalaa bh a-ay pavit  sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.
lines.transliteration: man aanand sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa bh ayti-aa gahir gambh eer.

lines.english: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled bythe True Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachee sangat baisn aa sach naam man Dh eer. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.
lines.transliteration: man ray satgur sayv nisang.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੇਿਵਐ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਭਏ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਸਰੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai har man vasai lagai na mail pat ang. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad pat  oopjai sachay sachaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਬੈਸਣਾ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee ha-umai maar pachhaan i-aa ha-o t in balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and noplace of rest anywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: manmukh sach na jaan nee tin tha-ur na kat hoo thaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have theirhome in the True One.
lines.transliteration: sach khaan aa sach painn aa sachay hee vich vaas.

lines.english: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they havetheir dwelling.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sachaa salaahn aa sachai sabad  nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachingsthey dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh aat am raam pachh aani-aa gurmat ee nij gh ar vaas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.
lines.transliteration: sach vaykhan  sach boln aa tan man sachaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.
lines.transliteration: sachee saakhee upd ays sach sachay sachee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping andwailing. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jinnee sach visaari-aa say dukh ee-ay chalay ro-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into theworld?
lines.transliteration: satgur jinee na sayvi-o say kit  aa-ay sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears theirshrieks and cries.
lines.transliteration: jam dar baDh ay maaree-ah kook na sun ai pookaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ  ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again.||5|| pMnw 70
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa mar jameh vaaro vaar. ||5||

lines.english: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ayhu jag jaltaa d aykh kai bh aj pa-ay sat gur sarn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਭਿਜ ਪਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.
lines.transliteration: satgur sach d irhaa-i-aa sad aa sach sanjam rahn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਿਦੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਚ ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਰਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur sachaa hai bohithaa sabd ay bh avjal t arnaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਰਣਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without theTrue Guru, liberation is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh fird ay rahay bin sat gur mukat  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਿਫਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, butattached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  monee thakay d oojai bh aa-ay pat  kho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is noother at all. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur sabad  sunaa-i-aa bin sachay avar na ko-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.
lines.transliteration: jo sachai laa-ay say sach lagay nit sachee kaar karann.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ  ਸੇ ਸਿਚ ਲਗੇ ਿਨਤ  ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in theMansion of Truth.
lines.transliteration: tinaa nij gh ar vaasaa paa-i-aa sachai mahal rahann.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਮਹਿਲ  ਰਹੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the TrueName. ||8||17||8||25|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (70-6) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  sukh ee-ay sad aa sachai naam rachann. ||8||17||8||25||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਚੰਿਨ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
lines.english: When you are confronted with terrible hardships, and no one offers you any support,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o muskal at ban ai dho-ee ko-ay na d ay-ay.
laagoo ho-ay dusmanaa saak bh e bhaj khalay. when your friends turn into enemies, and even your relatives have deserted you,

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ  ਅਿਤ  ਬਣੈ ਢੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabho bh ajai aasraa chukai sabh  asraa-o. and when all support has given way, and all hope has been lost

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਸਮਨਾ  ਸਾਕ ਿਭ ਭਿਜ ਖਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chit aavai os paarbarahm lagai na t atee vaa-o. ||1|| -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, even the hot wind shall not touch you. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੋ ਭਜੈ ਆਸਰਾ  ਚੁਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master is the Power of the powerless.
lines.transliteration: saahib nitaan i-aa kaa t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ  ਵਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not come or go; He is Eternal and Permanent. Through the Word of theGuru's Shabad, He is known as True. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaa-ee thir sadaa gur sabd ee sach jaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If you are weakened by the pains of hunger and poverty,
lines.transliteration: jay ko hovai dublaa nang bh ukh kee peer.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਿਥਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: damrh aa palai naa pavai naa ko d ayvai Dh eer. with no money in your pockets, and no one will give you any comfort,
su-aarath su-aa-o na ko karay naa kichh hovai kaaj. and no one will satisfy your hopes and desires, and none of your works isaccomplished
chit aavai os paarbarahm t aa nihchal hovai raaj. ||2|| -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall obtain the eternal kingdom. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਬਲਾ  ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.english: When you are plagued by great and excessive anxiety, and diseases of the body;
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o chintaa bahut  bahut  dayhee vi-aapai rog.

lines.punjabi: ਦਮੜਾ  ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: garisat kutamb palayti-aa kad ay harakh  kaday sog. when you are wrapped up in the attachments of household and family, sometimesfeeling joy, and then other times sorrow;

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ  ਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਜੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ga-on karay chahu kunt kaa gh arhee na baisan  so-ay. when you are wandering around in all four directions, and you cannot sit or sleepeven for a moment

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਤਾ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chit aavai os paarbarahm t an man seet al ho-ay. ||3|| -if you come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then your body and mind shall becooled and soothed. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: When you are under the power of sexual desire, anger and worldly attachment, or agreedy miser in love with your wealth;
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh mohi vas kee-aa kirpan lobh  pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਸਿਤ  ਕੁਟੰਿਬ  ਪਲੇਿਟਆ  ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ  ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaaray kilvikh un agh  kee-ay ho-aa asur sangh aar. if you have committed the four great sins and other mistakes; even if you are amurderous fiend

lines.punjabi: ਗਉਣੁ  ਕਰੇ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਕਾ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pothee geet kavit  kichh  kaday na karan Dh ari-aa. who has never taken the time to listen to sacred books, hymns and poetry

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: chit aavai os paarbarahm t aa nimakh  simrat  tari-aa. ||4|| -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, and contemplate Him, even for a moment, you shall be saved. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰੋਿਧ ਮੋਿਹ ਵਿਸ ਕੀਆ  ਿਕਰਪਨ  ਲੋਿਭ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: People may recite by heart the Shaastras, the Simritees and the four Vedas;
lines.transliteration: saasat simrit  bayd  chaar mukh aagar bichray.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਉਿਨ ਅਘ  ਕੀਏ ਹੋਆ  ਅਸੁਰ  ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tapay t apeesar jogee-aa t irath gavan karay. they may be ascetics, great, self-disciplined Yogis; they may visit sacred shrines ofpilgrimage

lines.punjabi: ਪੋਥੀ ਗੀਤ  ਕਿਵਤ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਰਿਨ  ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: khat karmaa t ay dugunai poojaa kart aa naa-ay. and perform the six ceremonial rituals, over and over again, performing worshipservices and ritual bathings.

lines.english: Even so, if they have not embraced love for the Supreme Lord God, then they shallsurely go to hell. ||5||
lines.transliteration: rang na lagee paarbarahm taa sarpar narkay jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: You may possess empires, vast estates, authority over others, and the enjoyment ofmyriads of pleasures;
lines.transliteration: raaj milak sikdaaree-aa ras bh ogan bisthaar.
baag suhaavay sohnay chalai hukam afaar. you may have delightful and beautiful gardens, and issue unquestioned commands;

lines.punjabi: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ  ਜੋਗੀਆ  ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rang tamaasay baho biDh ee chaa-ay lag rahi-aa. you may have enjoyments and entertainments of all sorts and kinds, and continue toenjoy exciting pleasures

lines.punjabi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣੇ  ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ  ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: chit na aa-i-o paarbarahm t aa sarap kee joon ga-i-aa. ||6|| -and yet, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall be reincarnated as a snake. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗੀ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਤਾ ਸਰਪਰ  ਨਰਕੇ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: You may possess vast riches, maintain virtuous conduct, have a spotless reputationand observe religious customs;
lines.transliteration: bahut Dh anaadh  achaarvant  sobh aa nirmal reet .
maat pit aa sut  bhaa-ee-aa saajan sang pareet . you may have the loving affections of mother, father, children, siblings and friends;

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਗ  ਸੁਹਾਵੇ  ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: laskar tarkasband  band  jee-o jee-o saglee keet . you may have armies well-equipped with weapons, and all may salute you with respect; pMnw 71

lines.english: But still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then you shall be taken and consigned to the most hideous hell! ||7||
lines.transliteration: chit na aa-i-o paarbarahm t aa kh arh rasaat al deet. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਤਾ ਖਿੜ ਰਸਾਤਿਲ  ਦੀਤ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You may have a body free of disease and deformity, and have no worries or grief atall;
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa rog na chhid ar kichh  naa kichh  kaarh aa sog.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਛਦਰ੍ੁ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਾੜਾ  ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mirat na aavee chit  tis ahinis bh ogai bh og. you may be unmindful of death, and night and day revel in pleasures;
sabh kichh  keeton aapn aa jee-ay na sank Dh ari-aa. you may take everything as your own, and have no fear in your mind at all;

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਜੀਇ  ਨ ਸੰਕ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: chit na aa-i-o paarbarahm jamkankar vas pari-aa. ||8|| but still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਵਿਸ ਪਿਰਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord showers His Mercy, and we find the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay jis paarbarahm hovai saaDhoo sang.

lines.english: The more time we spend there, the more we come to love the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o oh vaDhaa-ee-ai t i-o ti-o har si-o rang.

lines.english: The Lord is the Master of both worlds; there is no other place of rest.
lines.transliteration: duhaa siri-aa kaa kh asam aap avar na d oojaa thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਹਾ ਿਸਿਰਆ  ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: When the True Guru is pleased and satisfied, O Nanak, the True Name is obtained.||9||1||26|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 Gru 5 ] (71-5) sireeraag mehlaa 5 ghar 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:
lines.transliteration: satgur t uthai paa-i-aa naanak sachaa naa-o. ||9||1||26||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥੯॥੧॥੨੬॥
lines.english: I do not know what pleases my Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaan-o nahee bhaavai kavan baat aa.

lines.english: O mind, seek out the way! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man khoj maarag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dhi-aanee Dh i-aan laaveh. The meditatives practice meditation,

lines.transliteration: gi-aanee gi-aan kamaaveh. and the wise practice spiritual wisdom,
parabh kin hee jaat aa. ||1|| but how rare are those who know God! ||1||

lines.english: The worshipper of Bhagaauti practices self-discipline,
lines.transliteration: bhag-ut ee rahat  jugtaa.
jogee kahat mukt aa. the Yogi speaks of liberation,
tapsee t apeh raat aa. ||2|| and the ascetic is absorbed in asceticism. ||2||

lines.english: The men of silence observe silence,
lines.transliteration: monee moniDhaaree.
sani-aasee barahamchaaree. the Sanyaasees observe celibacy,
udaasee ud aas raat aa. ||3|| and the Udaasees abide in detachment. ||3||

lines.english: There are nine forms of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  navai parkaaraa.

lines.english: The Pandits recite the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: pandit vayd  pukaaraa.

lines.english: The householders assert their faith in family life. ||4||
lines.transliteration: girsatee girsat  Dharmaat aa. ||4||

lines.english: Those who utter only One Word, those who take many forms, the naked renunciates,
lines.transliteration: ik sabdee baho roop avDh ootaa.
kaaprhee ka-ut ay jaagoot aa. the wearers of patched coats, the magicians, those who remain always awake,
ik tirath naat aa. ||5|| and those who bathe at holy places of pilgrimage-||5||

lines.english: Those who go without food, those who never touch others,
lines.transliteration: nirhaar vartee aaprasaa.
ik look na dayveh d arsaa. the hermits who never show themselves,
ik man hee gi-aataa. ||6|| and those who are wise in their own minds-||6||

lines.english: Of these, no one admits to any deficiency;
lines.transliteration: ghaat na kin hee kahaa-i-aa.
sabh kaht ay hai paa-i-aa. all say that they have found the Lord.

lines.english: But he alone is a devotee, whom the Lord has united with Himself. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jis maylay so bhagt aa. ||7||

lines.english: Abandoning all devices and contrivances, I have sought His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: sagal ukat upaavaa. t i-aagee saran paavaa.

lines.english: Nanak has fallen at the Feet of the Guru. ||8||2||27|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (71-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: isrIrwgu mhlw 1 Gru 3 ] (71-15) sireeraag mehlaa 1 ghar 3. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur charan paraat aa. ||8||2||27||

lines.english: Among Yogis, You are the Yogi;
lines.transliteration: jogee andar jogee-aa.
tooN bhogee and ar bhogee-aa. among pleasure seekers, You are the Pleasure Seeker.

lines.english: Your limits are not known to any of the beings in the heavens, in this world, or in the nether regions of the underworld. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayraa ant  na paa-i-aa surag machh  pa-i-aal jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree ha-o vaarnai kurbaan  tayray naav no. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You created the world,
lines.transliteration: tuDh sansaar upaa-i-aa.
siray sir DhanDh ay laa-i-aa. and assigned tasks to one and all.

lines.english: You watch over Your Creation, and through Your All-powerful Creative Potency, You cast the dice. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vaykheh keet aa aapn aa kar kud rat paasaa dh aal jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: You are manifest in the Expanse of Your Workshop.
lines.transliteration: pargat pahaarai jaapdaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੁਰਿਗ  ਮਿਛ ਪਇਆਿਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everyone longs for Your Name,
lines.transliteration: sabh naavai no part aapdaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ  ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh  na paa-i-o sabh  mohee maa-i-aa jaal jee-o. ||3|| but without the Guru, no one finds You. All are enticed and trapped by Maya. ||3||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur ka-o bal jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Meeting Him, the supreme status is obtained. pMnw 72
lines.transliteration: jit mili-ai param gat  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ  ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The angelic beings and the silent sages long for Him; the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sur nar mun jan lochday so sat gur dee-aa bujh aa-ay jee-o. ||4||

lines.english: How is the Society of the Saints to be known?
lines.transliteration: satsangat  kaisee jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: There, the Name of the One Lord is chanted.
lines.transliteration: jithai ayko naam vakhaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The One Name is the Lord's Command; O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ayko naam hukam hai naanak satgur d ee-aa bujh aa-ay jee-o. ||5||

lines.english: This world has been deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: ih jagat bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself, Lord, have led it astray.
lines.transliteration: aaphu tuDh  khu-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ਲਗਾ  ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਭਾਗ ਿਜਨਾ  ਕੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The discarded soul-brides suffer in terrible agony; they have no luck at all. ||6||
lines.transliteration: partaap lagaa d uhaagan ee bh aag jinaa kay naahi jee-o. ||6||

lines.english: What are the signs of the discarded brides?
lines.transliteration: duhaagan ee ki-aa neesaan ee-aa.

lines.english: They miss their Husband Lord, and they wander around in dishonor.
lines.transliteration: khasmahu gh uthee-aa fireh nimaan ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The clothes of those brides are filthy-they pass their life-night in agony. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mailay vays tinaa kaamn ee dukhee rain  vihaa-ay jee-o. ||7||

lines.english: What actions have the happy soul-brides performed?
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee ki-aa karam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They have obtained the fruit of their pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa fal paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord unites them with Himself. ||8||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay kai aapn ee aapay la-ay milaa-ay jee-o. ||8||

lines.english: Those, whom God causes to abide by His Will,
lines.transliteration: hukam jinaa no manaa-i-aa.
tin ant ar sabad  vasaa-i-aa. have the Shabad of His Word abiding deep within.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੀਆ  ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: They are the true soul-brides, who embrace love for their Husband Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sahee-aa say sohaaganee jin sah naal pi-aar jee-o. ||9||

lines.english: Those who take pleasure in God's Will
lines.transliteration: jinaa bhaan ay kaa ras aa-i-aa.
tin vichahu bh aram chukaa-i-aa. remove doubt from within.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਐਸਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, know Him as the True Guru, who unites all with the Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur aisaa jaan ee-ai jo sabh sai la-ay milaa-ay jee-o. ||10||

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, they receive the fruits of their destiny,
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai fal paa-i-aa.
jin vichahu ahkaran chukaa-i-aa. and egotism is driven out from within.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਭਾਗੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਆਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The pain of evil-mindedness is eliminated; good fortune comes and shines radiantly from their foreheads. ||11||
lines.transliteration: durmat  kaa d ukh kati-aa bh aag baith aa mast ak aa-ay jee-o. ||11||

lines.english: The Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit t ayree baan ee-aa.

lines.english: It permeates the hearts of Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: tayri-aa bh agtaa rid ai samaan ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਿਖਐ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਨਸਤਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Serving You, peace is obtained; granting Your Mercy, You bestow salvation. ||12||
lines.transliteration: sukh sayvaa and ar rakh i-ai aapn ee nad ar karahi nist aar jee-o. ||12||

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one comes to know;
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-aa jaan ee-ai.
jit mili-ai naam vakh aanee-ai. by this meeting, one comes to chant the Name.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਸਭ ਥਕੀ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, God is not found; all have grown weary of performingreligious rituals. ||13||
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh  na paa-i-o sabh  thakee karam kamaa-ay jee-o. ||13||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: ha-o satgur vitahu gh umaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I was wandering in doubt, and He has set me on the right path.
lines.transliteration: jin bharam bh ulaa maarag paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He unites us with Himself. ||14||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay jay aapn ee aapay la-ay ralaa-ay jee-o. ||14||

lines.english: You, Lord, are pervading in all,
lines.transliteration: tooN sabh naa maahi samaa-i-aa.
tin kart ai aap lukaa-i-aa. and yet, the Creator keeps Himself concealed.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਿਤ ਧਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator is revealed to the Gurmukh, within whom He has infused His Light. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh pargat ho-i-aa jaa ka-o jot  Dharee kart aar jee-o. ||15||

lines.english: The Master Himself bestows honor.
lines.transliteration: aapay khasam nivaaji-aa.

lines.english: He creates and bestows body and soul.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind day saaji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀਆ  ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He places both His Hands upon theirforeheads. ||16||
lines.transliteration: aapnay sayvak kee paij rakh ee-aa d u-ay kar mast ak Dh aar jee-o. ||16||

lines.english: All strict rituals are just clever contrivances.
lines.transliteration: sabh sanjam rahay si-aan paa.

lines.english: My God knows everything.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh sabh  kichh  jaand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪੁ  ਵਰਤਾਇਓ  ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: He has made His Glory manifest, and all people celebrate Him. ||17 |
lines.transliteration: pargat partaap vart aa-i-o sabh  lok karai jaikaar jee-o. ||17||

lines.english: | He has not considered my merits and demerits;
lines.transliteration: mayray gun avgan na beechaari-aa.
parabh apn aa birad  samaari-aa. this is God's Own Nature.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਕੈ ਰਿਖਓਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ  ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Hugging me close in His Embrace, He protects me, and now, even the hot wind does not touch me. ||18||
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay kai rakh i-on lagai na t atee vaa-o jee-o. ||18||

lines.english: Within my mind and body, I meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan parabh oo Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have obtained the fruits of my soul's desire.
lines.transliteration: jee-ay ichhi-arh aa fal paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਤੂੰ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ
lines.english: You are the Supreme Lord and Master, above the heads of kings. Nanak lives by chanting Your Name. ||19|| pMnw 73
lines.transliteration: saah paatisaah sir kh asam t ooN jap naanak jeevai naa-o jee-o. ||19||

lines.english: You Yourself created the Universe;
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay aap upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You created the play of duality, and staged it.
lines.transliteration: doojaa kh ayl kar d ikhlaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; He instructs those with whom He is pleased. ||20||
lines.transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatd aa jis bh aavai t isai bujh aa-ay jee-o. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have found God.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: By His Grace, I have shed emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: tithai maa-i-aa moh chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Showering His Mercy, He has blended me into Himself. ||21||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kar kai aapnee aapay la-ay samaa-ay jee-o. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: You are the Gopis, the milk-maids of Krishna; You are the sacred river Jamunaa; Youare Krishna, the herdsman.
lines.transliteration: gopee nai go-aalee-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself support the world.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay go-ay uth aalee-aa.

lines.english: By Your Command, human beings are fashioned. You Yourself embellish them, andthen again destroy them. ||22||
lines.transliteration: hukmee bhaaNday saaji-aa t ooN aapay bh ann savaar jee-o. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਭਡੇ ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਭੰਿਨ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Those who have focused their consciousness on the True Guru
lines.transliteration: jin satgur si-o chit  laa-i-aa.
tinee d oojaa bh aa-o chukaa-i-aa. have rid themselves of the love of duality.

lines.english: The light of those mortal beings is immaculate. They depart after redeeming their lives. ||23||
lines.transliteration: nirmal jot t in paraan ee-aa o-ay chalay janam savaar jee-o. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਤਨ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀਆ  ਓਇ ਚਲੇ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, night and day, I praise the Greatness of Your Goodness.
lines.transliteration: tayree-aa sad aa sad aa chang-aa-ee-aa. mai raat  dihai vadi-aa-ee-aaN.

lines.english: You bestow Your Gifts, even if we do not ask for them. Says Nanak, contemplate theTrue Lord. ||24||1|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (73-7) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anmangi-aa d aan d ayvnaa kaho naanak sach samaal jee-o. ||24||1||

lines.english: I fall at His Feet to please and appease Him.
lines.transliteration: pai paa-ay manaa-ee so-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਣਮੰਿਗਆ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru has united me with the Lord, the Primal Being. There is no other asgreat as He. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  milaa-i-aa t is jayvad avar na ko-ay jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is my Sweet Beloved.
lines.transliteration: gosaa-ee mihandaa ith-rh aa.

lines.english: He is sweeter than my mother or father.
lines.transliteration: amm abay thaavhu mith-rh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Among all sisters and brothers and friends, there is no one like You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhain  bhaa-ee sabh  sajnaa tuDh jayhaa naahee ko-ay jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: By Your Command, the month of Saawan has come.
lines.transliteration: tayrai hukmay saavan  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have hooked up the plow of Truth,
lines.transliteration: mai sat kaa hal jo-aa-i-aa.
naa-o beejan lagaa aas kar har bohal bakh as jamaa-ay jee-o. ||2|| and I plant the seed of the Name in hopes that the Lord, in His Generosity, will bestow a bountiful harvest. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈਣ ਭਾਈ  ਸਿਭ ਸਜਣਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, I recognize only the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o gur mil ik pachhaand aa.

lines.english: In my consciousness, I do not know of any other account.
lines.transliteration: duyaa kaagal chit  na jaand aa.

lines.english: The Lord has assigned one task to me; as it pleases Him, I perform it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har iktai kaarai laa-i-on ji-o bh aavai t iNvai nibaahi jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਬੀਜਣ  ਲਗਾ  ਆਸ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਹਲ  ਬਖਸ  ਜਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Enjoy yourselves and eat, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: tusee bh ogihu bh unchahu bh aa-eeho.

lines.english: In the Guru's Court, He has blessed me with the Robe of Honor.
lines.transliteration: gur deebaan  kavaa-ay painaa-ee-o.

lines.english: I have become the Master of my body-village; I have taken the five rivals asprisoners. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ha-o ho-aa maahar pind daa bann aad ay panj sareek jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕਤੈ  ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਂਵੈ  ਿਨਬਾਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ha-o aa-i-aa saamaiH tihandee-aa.

lines.english: The five farm-hands have become my tenants;
lines.transliteration: panj kirsaan mujayray mihdi-aa.
kann ko-ee kadh na hangh -ee naanak vuth aa gh ugh giraa-o jee-o. ||5|| none dare to raise their heads against me. O Nanak, my village is populous and prosperous. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹੋਆ  ਮਾਹਰੁ ਿਪੰਡ ਦਾ ਬੰਿਨ ਆਦੇ  ਪੰਿਜ ਸਰੀਕ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree ghummaa jaavd aa.

lines.english: I meditate on You continually.
lines.transliteration: ik saahaa tuDh  Dhi-aa-id aa.

lines.english: The village was in ruins, but You have re-populated it. I am a sacrifice to You. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ujarh thayhu vasaa-i-o ha-o t uDh vitahu kurbaan  jee-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਢ  ਨ ਹੰਘਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਵੁਠਾ ਘੁਿਘ ਿਗਰਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Beloved Lord, I meditate on You continually;
lines.transliteration: har ithai nit  Dhi-aa-id aa.

lines.english: I obtain the fruits of my mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: man chindee so fal paa-id aa.

lines.english: All my affairs are arranged, and the hunger of my mind is appeased. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sabhay kaaj savaari-an laahee-an man kee bh ukh jee-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਉਜੜੁ  ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਓ  ਹਉ ਤੁਧ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I have forsaken all my entanglements;
lines.transliteration: mai chhadi-aa sabh o DhanDh-rhaa.

lines.english: I serve the True Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gosaa-ee sayvee sachrhaa.

lines.english: I have firmly attached the Name, the Home of the Nine Treasures to my robe. ||8||
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam niDh aan har mai palai baDh aa chh ik jee-o. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ  ਸਵਾਿਰਅਨ ੁ ਲਾਹੀਅਨੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I have obtained the comfort of comforts.
lines.transliteration: mai sukhee hooN sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Word of the Shabad deep within me.
lines.transliteration: gur antar sabad  vasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru has shown me my Husband Lord; He has placed His Hand upon my forehead. ||9||
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  vikhaali-aa mast ak Dh ar kai hath jee-o. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੈ ਪਲੈ ਬਧਾ ਿਛਿਕ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: I have established the Temple of Truth.
lines.transliteration: mai baDhee sach Dh aram saal hai.

lines.english: I sought out the Guru's Sikhs, and brought them into it.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa lahd aa bh aal kai.

lines.english: I wash their feet, and wave the fan over them. Bowing low, I fall at their feet. ||10|| pMnw 74
lines.transliteration: pair Dhovaa pakh aa fayrd aa tis niv niv lagaa paa-ay jee-o. ||10||

lines.english: I heard of the Guru, and so I went to Him.
lines.transliteration: sun galaa gur peh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He instilled within me the Naam, the goodness of charity and true cleansing.
lines.transliteration: naam daan isnaan d irhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: All the world is liberated, O Nanak, by embarking upon the Boat of Truth. ||11||
lines.transliteration: sabh mukat  ho-aa saisaarrh aa naanak sachee bayrh ee chaarh  jee-o. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ  ਸੈਸਾਰੜਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾਿੜ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The whole Universe serves You, day and night.
lines.transliteration: sabh sarisat sayvay d in raat  jee-o.

lines.english: Please hear my prayer, O Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: day kann sun hu ard aas jee-o.

lines.english: I have thoroughly tested and seen all-You alone, by Your Pleasure, can save us. ||12||
lines.transliteration: thok vajaa-ay sabh  dithee-aa t us aapay la-i-an chh adaa-ay jee-o. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਠੋਿਕ ਵਜਾਇ  ਸਭ ਿਡਠੀਆ  ਤੁਿਸ ਆਪੇ  ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Now, the Merciful Lord has issued His Command.
lines.transliteration: hun hukam ho-aa miharvaan d aa.

lines.english: Let no one chase after and attack anyone else.
lines.transliteration: pai ko-ay na kisai ranjaand aa.

lines.english: Let all abide in peace, under this Benevolent Rule. ||13||
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh aalee vuth ee-aa ih ho-aa halaymee raaj jee-o. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ਵੁਠੀਆ  ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ  ਹਲੇਮੀ  ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Softly and gently, drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
lines.transliteration: jhimm jh imm amrit  varasd aa.

lines.english: I speak as my Lord and Master causes me to speak.
lines.transliteration: bolaa-i-aa bolee khasam d aa.

lines.english: I place all my faith in You; please accept me. ||14||
lines.transliteration: baho maan kee-aa t uDh upray t ooN aapay paa-ihi thaa-ay jee-o. ||14||

lines.english: Your devotees are forever hungry for You.
lines.transliteration: tayri-aa bh agtaa bh ukh sad tayree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਰੇ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਿਹ  ਥਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: O Lord, please fulfill my desires.
lines.transliteration: har lochaa pooran mayree-aa.

lines.english: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Giver of Peace. Please, take me into Your Embrace. ||15||
lines.transliteration: dayh d aras sukh -daati-aa mai gal vich laihu milaa-ay jee-o. ||15||

lines.english: I have not found any other as Great as You.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad avar na bh aali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਿਤਆ  ਮੈ ਗਲ ਿਵਿਚ  ਲੈਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: You pervade the continents, the worlds and the nether regions;
lines.transliteration: tooN deep lo-a pa-i-aali-aa.

lines.english: You are permeating all places and interspaces. Nanak: You are the True Support ofYour devotees. ||16||
lines.transliteration: tooN thaan thanant ar rav rahi-aa naanak bh agtaa sach aDh aar jee-o. ||16||

lines.english: I am a wrestler; I belong to the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: ha-o gosaa-ee daa pahilvaanrh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਿਨ  ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I met with the Guru, and I have tied a tall, plumed turban.
lines.transliteration: mai gur mil uch dumaalrh aa.

lines.english: All have gathered to watch the wrestling match, and the Merciful Lord Himself is seated to behold it. ||17||
lines.transliteration: sabh ho-ee chh injh ikthee-aa d a-yu baith aa vaykh ai aap jee-o. ||17||

lines.english: The bugles play and the drums beat.
lines.transliteration: vaat vajan tamak bh ayree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਿਛੰਝ ਇਕਠੀਆ  ਦਯੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਿਪ  ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: The wrestlers enter the arena and circle around.
lines.transliteration: mal lathay laiday fayree-aa.

lines.english: I have thrown the five challengers to the ground, and the Guru has patted me on theback. ||18||
lines.transliteration: nihtay panj ju-aan mai gur thaapee d itee kand jee-o. ||18||

lines.english: All have gathered together,
lines.transliteration: sabh ikth ay ho-ay aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਤੇ  ਪੰਿਜ ਜੁਆਨ  ਮੈ ਗੁ ਰ ਥਾਪੀ  ਿਦਤੀ ਕੰਿਡ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: ghar jaasan vaat vataa-i-aa. but we shall return home by different routes.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs reap their profits and leave, while the self-willed manmukhs lose theirinvestment and depart. ||19||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh laahaa lai ga-ay manmukh  chalay mool gavaa-ay jee-o. ||19||

lines.english: You are without color or mark.
lines.transliteration: tooN varnaa chihnaa baahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਲੈ ਗਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The Lord is seen to be manifest and present.
lines.transliteration: har diseh haajar jaahraa.

lines.english: Hearing of Your Glories again and again, Your devotees meditate on You; they are attuned to You, O Lord, Treasure of Excellence. ||20||
lines.transliteration: sun sun  tujhai Dhi-aa-id ay tayray bh agat ratay gunt aas jee-o. ||20||

lines.english: Through age after age, I am the servant of the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai jug jug da-yai sayvrh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਤੁਝੈ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The Guru has cut away my bonds.
lines.transliteration: gur katee mihdee jayvrhee.

lines.english: I shall not have to dance in the wrestling arena of life again. Nanak has searched, andfound this opportunity. ||21||2||29|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (74-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: isrIrwgu mhlw 1 phry Gru 1 ] (74-15) sireeraag mehlaa 1 pahray ghar 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl, Pehray, First House:
lines.transliteration: ha-o baahurh chh injh na nach-oo naanak a-osar laDh aa bh aal jee-o. ||21||2||29||

lines.english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you were cast into the womb,by the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: pahilai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa hukam pa-i-aa garbh aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਿਛੰਝ ਨ ਨਚਊ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਉਸਰੁ ਲਧਾ  ਭਾਿਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੧॥੨॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Upside-down, within the womb, you performed penance, O my merchant friend, and you prayed to your Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: uraDh t ap ant ar karay van jaari-aa mit raa kh asam sayt ee ard aas.

lines.english: You uttered prayers to your Lord and Master, while upside-down, and you meditatedon Him with deep love and affection.
lines.transliteration: khasam sayt ee ard aas vakh aanai uraDh  Dhi-aan liv laagaa.

lines.english: You came into this Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and you shall depart again naked.
lines.transliteration: naa marjaad aa-i-aa kal bh eetar baahurh  jaasee naagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਪਇਆ  ਗਰਭਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: As God's Pen has written on your forehead, so it shall be with your soul.
lines.transliteration: jaisee kalam vurhee hai mast ak taisee jee-arh ay paas.

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਧ  ਤਪੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਖਸਮ  ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command, you enter into the womb. ||1|| pMnw 75
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee pahilai pahrai hukam pa-i-aa garbh aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਪਇਆ  ਗਰਭਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you have forgotten to meditate.
lines.transliteration: doojai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa visar ga-i-aa Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਗਇਆ ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: From hand to hand, you are passed around, O my merchant friend, like Krishna in thehouse of Yashoda.
lines.transliteration: hatho hath nachaa-ee-ai vanjaari-aa mit raa ji-o jasud aa gh ar kaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਥੋ ਹਿਥ ਨਚਾਈਐ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਜਸੁਦਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਕਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: From hand to hand, you are passed around, and your mother says, "This is my son."
lines.transliteration: hatho hath nachaa-ee-ai paraanee maat  kahai sut  mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਥੋ ਹਿਥ ਨਚਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਮਾਤ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: O, my thoughtless and foolish mind, think: In the end, nothing shall be yours.
lines.transliteration: chayt achayt  moorh  man mayray ant  nahee kachh  tayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਅਚੇਤ  ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: You do not know the One who created the creation. Gather spiritual wisdom within your mind.
lines.transliteration: jin rach rachi-aa tiseh na jaan ai man bh eetar Dh ar gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਿਚ ਰਿਚਆ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਧਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, you have forgotten to meditate. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee d oojai pahrai visar ga-i-aa Dh i-aan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ  ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਗਇਆ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your consciousness is focusedon wealth and youth.
lines.transliteration: teejai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa Dh an joban si-o chit .

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਜੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: You have not remembered the Name of the Lord, O my merchant friend, although itwould release you from bondage.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam na chaythee van jaari-aa mit raa baDh aa chh uteh jit .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਿਹ  ਿਜਤੁ ॥
lines.english: You do not remember the Name of the Lord, and you become confused by Maya.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam na chaytai paraan ee bikal bh a-i-aa sang maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਿਬਕਲੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan si-o rat aa joban mat aa ahilaa janam gavaa-i-aa. Revelling in your riches and intoxicated with youth, you waste your life uselessly.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਿਸਉ ਰਤਾ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਮਤਾ ਅਿਹਲਾ  ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam sayt ee vaapaar na keet o karam na keet o mit. You have not traded in righteousness and Dharma; you have not made good deedsyour friends.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਨ ਕੀਤੋ  ਿਮਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, your mind is attached to wealth andyouth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak teejai pahrai paraan ee Dh an joban si-o chit . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੀਜੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Grim Reaper comes to the field.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa laavee aa-i-aa kh ayt.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਲਾਵੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਖੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: When the Messenger of Death seizes and dispatches you, O my merchant friend, noone knows the mystery of where you have gone.
lines.transliteration: jaa jam pakarh chalaa-i-aa van jaari-aa mit raa kisai na mili-aa bh ayt.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਜਿਮ ਪਕਿੜ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਭੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: So think of the Lord! No one knows this secret, of when the Messenger of Death willseize you and take you away.
lines.transliteration: bhayt  chayt  har kisai na mili-o jaa jam pakarh  chalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਤੁ ਚੇਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਜਾ ਜਿਮ ਪਕਿੜ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All your weeping and wailing then is false. In an instant, you become a stranger.
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa rud an ho-aa d o-aalai kh in meh bh a-i-aa paraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠਾ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਹੋਆ  ਦਆਲੈ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You obtain exactly what you have longed for.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee vasat paraapat  ho-ee jis si-o laa-i-aa hayt .

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਉ ਲਾਇਆ  ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the fourth watch of the night, O mortal, the Grim Reaper hasharvested your field. ||4||1|| isrIrwgu mhlw 1 ] (75-11) sireeraag mehlaa 1. Siree Raag, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee cha-uthai pahrai laavee lun i-aa kh ayt. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਲਾਵੀ  ਲੁਿਣਆ  ਖੇਤੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your innocent mind has a child-like understanding. KIru pIAY KylweIAY vxjwirAw imqRw mwq ipqw suq hyqu ] mwq ipqw suq nyhu Gnyrw mwieAw mohu
lines.transliteration: pahilai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa baalak buDh  achayt .

lines.english: You drink milk, and you are fondled so gently, O my merchant friend. The mother and father love their child so much, but in Maya, all are caught in emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: kheer pee-ai kh aylaa-ee-ai van jaari-aa mit raa maat  pitaa sut  hayt. maat  pitaa sut nayhu ghanayraa maa-i-aa moh sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਬਾਲਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਅਚੇਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: By the good fortune of good deeds done in the past, you have come, and now youperform actions to determine your future.
lines.transliteration: sanjogee aa-i-aa kirat kamaa-i-aa karn ee kaar karaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ  ਖੇਲਾਈਐ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained, and you are drowned in the loveof duality.
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na ho-ee boodee d oojai hayt .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, O mortal, you shall be saved byremembering the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee pahilai pahrai chh ootahigaa har chayt . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਆਇਆ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you are intoxicated with thewine of youth and beauty.
lines.transliteration: doojai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa bh ar joban mai mat .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਬੂਡੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਿਤ ॥
lines.english: Day and night, you are engrossed in sexual desire, O my merchant friend, and yourconsciousness is blind to the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ahinis kaam vi-aapi-aa vanjaari-aa mit raa anDh ulay naam na chit .

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਛੂਟਿਹਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is not within your heart, but all sorts of other tastes seem sweet toyou.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ghat ant ar naahee hor jaan ai ras kas meeth ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਭਿਰ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਮੈ ਮਿਤ ॥
lines.english: You have no wisdom at all, no meditation, no virtue or self-discipline; in falsehood, you are caught in the cycle of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan gun  sanjam naahee janam marhugay jh oothay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Pilgrimages, fasts, purification and self-discipline are of no use, nor are rituals,religious ceremonies or empty worship.
lines.transliteration: tirath varat  such sanjam naahee karam Dh aram nahee poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਹੋਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਰਸ ਕਸ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, emancipation comes only by loving devotional worship; through duality,people are engrossed in duality. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaa-ay bh agat nistaaraa d ubiDh aa vi-aapai d oojaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰਹੁਗੇ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
lines.english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the swans, the white hairs,come and land upon the pool of the head.
lines.transliteration: teejai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa sar hans ultharh ay aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਵਰਤ ਸੁਿਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਨਹੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.english: Youth wears itself out, and old age triumphs, O my merchant friend; as time passes, your days diminish. pMnw 76
lines.transliteration: joban ghatai jaroo-aa jin ai van jaari-aa mit raa aav gh atai d in jaa-ay.

lines.english: At the last moment, you repent-you are so blind!-when the Messenger of Death seizes you and carries you away.
lines.transliteration: ant kaal pachh utaasee anDh ulay jaa jam pakarh  chalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਪਛੁਤਾਸੀ  ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਜਾ ਜਿਮ ਪਕਿੜ  ਚਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You kept all your things for yourself, but in an instant, they are all lost.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  apunaa kar kar raakh i-aa kh in meh bh a-i-aa paraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Your intellect left you, your wisdom departed, and now you repent for the evil deeds you committed.
lines.transliteration: buDh visarjee ga-ee si-aan ap kar avgan  pachh utaa-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the third watch of the night, let your consciousness belovingly focused on God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee t eejai pahrai parabh  chayt ahu liv laa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਤੀਜੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your body grows old andweak.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa biraDh  bha-i-aa t an kh een.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਭਇਆ  ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ॥
lines.english: Your eyes go blind, and cannot see, O my merchant friend, and your ears do not hearany words.
lines.transliteration: akhee anDh  na dees-ee van jaari-aa mit raa kannee sun ai na vain .

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਕੰਨੀ  ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਵੈਣ ॥
lines.english: Your eyes go blind, and your tongue is unable to taste; you live only with the help ofothers.
lines.transliteration: akhee anDh  jeebh  ras naahee rahay paraaka-o t aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰਹੇ ਪਰਾਕਉ  ਤਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: With no virtue within, how can you find peace? The self-willed manmukh comes andgoes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: gun ant ar naahee ki-o sukh  paavai manmukh  aavan  jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the crop of life has matured, it bends, breaks and perishes; why take pride inthat which comes and goes?
lines.transliteration: kharh  pakee kurh  bhajai binsai aa-ay chalai ki-aa maan .

lines.punjabi: ਖੜੁ ਪਕੀ ਕੁਿੜ ਭਜੈ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਆਇ  ਚਲੈ ਿਕਆ  ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the Gurmukh recognizes theWord of the Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee cha-uthai pahrai gurmukh  sabad  pachh aan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Your breath comes to its end, O my merchant friend, and your shoulders are weighed down by the tyrant of old age.
lines.transliteration: orhak aa-i-aa t in saahi-aa van jaari-aa mit raa jar jarvaan aa kann.

lines.punjabi: ਓੜਕੁ  ਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸਾਿਹਆ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ  ਕੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Not one iota of virtue came into you, O my merchant friend; bound and gagged byevil, you are driven along.
lines.transliteration: ik ratee gun  na samaan i-aa van jaari-aa mit raa avgan  kharhsan bann.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਿਣਆ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਖੜਸਿਨ  ਬੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: One who departs with virtue and self-discipline is not struck down, and is notconsigned to the cycle of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: gun sanjam jaavai chot na kh aavai naa t is jaman  marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਜਾਵੈ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death and his trap cannot touch him; through loving devotionalworship, he crosses over the ocean of fear.
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai bhaa-ay bh agat bhai tarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He departs with honor, and merges in intuitive peace and poise; all his pains depart.
lines.transliteration: pat sayt ee jaavai sahj samaavai saglay d ookh mitaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਿਮਟਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, when the mortal becomes Gurmukh, he is saved and honored by theTrue Lord. ||5||2|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 ] (76-10) sireeraag mehlaa 4. Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee gurmukh  chhootai saachay t ay pat  paavai. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਛੂਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord places you in thewomb.
lines.transliteration: pahilai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa har paa-i-aa ud ar manjh aar.

lines.english: You meditate on the Lord, and chant the Lord's Name, O my merchant friend. You contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavai har uchrai van jaari-aa mit raa har har naam samaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਉਦਰ  ਮੰਝਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditating on it within the fire of thewomb, your life is sustained by dwelling on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japay aaraaDhay vich agnee har jap jeevi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: You are born and you come out, and your mother and father are delighted to see yourface.
lines.transliteration: baahar janam bha-i-aa mukh  laagaa sarsay pit aa maat  theevi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਅਗਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: Remember the One, O mortal, to whom the child belongs. As Gurmukh, reflect uponHim within your heart.
lines.transliteration: jis kee vasat t is chayt ahu paraan ee kar hird ai gurmukh  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗਾ  ਸਰਸੇ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਤ ਥੀਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, dwell upon the Lord, who shallshower you with His Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee pahilai pahrai har japee-ai kirpaa Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the mind is attached to thelove of duality.
lines.transliteration: doojai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa man laagaa d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mother and father hug you close in their embrace, claiming, "He is mine, he is mine";so is the child brought up, O my merchant friend.
lines.transliteration: mayraa mayraa kar paalee-ai vanjaari-aa mit raa lay maat  pitaa gal laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your mother and father constantly hug you close in their embrace; in their minds,they believe that you will provide for them and support them.
lines.transliteration: laavai maat pit aa sad aa gal sayt ee man jaan ai khat khavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਪਾਲੀਐ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਲੇ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The fool does not know the One who gives; instead, he clings to the gift.
lines.transliteration: jo dayvai t isai na jaan ai moorh aa ditay no laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਵੈ  ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਿਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਖਿਟ ਖਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Rare is the Gurmukh who reflects upon, meditates upon, and within his mind, is lovingly attached to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee gurmukh hovai so karai veechaar har Dh i-aavai man liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਿਤਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮੂੜਾ ਿਦਤੇ ਨੋ ਲਪਟਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, death never devours you.||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak doojai pahrai paraan ee tis kaal na kabahooN khaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਮਿਨ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your mind is entangled inworldly and household affairs.
lines.transliteration: teejai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa man lagaa aal janjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhan chit vai Dh an sanchvai van jaari-aa mit raa har naamaa har na samaal. You think of wealth, and gather wealth, O my merchant friend, but you do notcontemplate the Lord or the Lord's Name.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਜੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ  ਆਿਲ  ਜੰਜਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: You never dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, who will be your only Helper and Support in the end. pMnw 77
lines.transliteration: har naamaa har har kaday na samaalai je hovai ant  sakhaa-ee.

lines.english: This wealth, property and Maya are false. In the end, you must leave these, and depart in sorrow.
lines.transliteration: ih Dhan sampai maa-i-aa jh oothee ant  chhod chali-aa pachh utaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਝੂਠੀ ਅੰਿਤ  ਛੋਿਡ ਚਿਲਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom the Lord, in His Mercy, unites with the Guru, reflect upon the Name ofthe Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay gur maylay so har har naam samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, O mortal, they go, and are united withthe Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak teejai pahrai paraan ee say jaa-ay milay har naal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੀਜੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਸੇ ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਲ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord announces the timeof departure.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa har chalan  vaylaa aad ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਹਿਰ ਚਲਣ  ਵੇਲਾ  ਆਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Perfect True Guru, O my merchant friend; your entire life-night is passingaway.
lines.transliteration: kar sayvhu pooraa satguroo van jaari-aa mit raa sabh  chalee rain  vihaad ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਸਭ ਚਲੀ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Lord each and every instant-do not delay! You shall become eternal throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: har sayvhu khin kh in dhil mool na karihu jit  asthir jug jug hovhu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਢਲ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਕਿਰਹੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Enjoy ecstasy forever with the Lord, and do away with the pains of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: har saytee sad  maan hu ralee-aa janam maran  dukh khovhu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖ ਖੋਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Know that there is no difference between the Guru, the True Guru, and your Lord andMaster. Meeting with Him, take pleasure in the Lord's devotional service.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur su-aamee bh ayd na jaan hu jit mil har bh agat sukh aaNdee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁਖਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the life-night of the devotee isfruitful. ||4||1||3|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 ] (77-7) sireeraag mehlaa 5. Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee cha-uthai pahrai safli-o rain  bhagtaa dee. ||4||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਸਫਿਲਓ  ੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਭਗਤਾ  ਦੀ ॥੪॥
lines.english: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord placed your soul in thewomb.
lines.transliteration: pahilai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa Dh ar paa-it aa ud rai maahi.

lines.english: In the tenth month, you were made into a human being, O my merchant friend, andyou were given your allotted time to perform good deeds.
lines.transliteration: dasee maasee maanas kee-aa van jaari-aa mit raa kar muhlat  karam kamaahi.

lines.english: You were given this time to perform good deeds, according to your pre-ordaineddestiny.
lines.transliteration: muhlat kar d eenee karam kamaan ay jaisaa likh at Dhur paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਧਿਰ ਪਾਇਤਾ  ਉਦਰੈ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: God placed you with your mother, father, brothers, sons and wife.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banit aa tin bheetar parabh oo sanjo-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ  ਮਾਨਸੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਕਿਰ ਮੁਹਲਿਤ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself is the Cause of causes, good and bad-no one has control over thesethings.
lines.transliteration: karam sukaram karaa-ay aapay is jantai vas kichh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਹਲਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ  ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ  ਜੈਸਾ ਿਲਖਤੁ  ਧੁਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, the soul is placed in the womb.||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee pahilai pahrai Dh ar paa-it aa ud rai maahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਸੰਜੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the fullness of youth rises inyou like waves.
lines.transliteration: doojai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa bh ar ju-aanee lahree d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਇਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ਵਿਸ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: You do not distinguish between good and evil, O my merchant friend-your mind is intoxicated with ego.
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa na pachh aan-ee van jaari-aa mit raa man mat aa ahamay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਧਿਰ ਪਾਇਤਾ  ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mortal beings do not distinguish between good and evil, and the road ahead istreacherous.
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa na pachh aanai paraan ee aagai panth karaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਭਿਰ ਜੁਆਨੀ  ਲਹਰੀ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: They never serve the Perfect True Guru, and the cruel tyrant Death stands over theirheads.
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur kabahooN na sayvi-aa sir th aadhay jam jand aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮਤਾ ਅਹੰਮੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay jab pakras bavray t ab ki-aa jabaab karay-i. When the Righteous Judge seizes you and interrogates you, O madman, what answerwill you give him then?

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਆਗੈ  ਪੰਥੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, the fullness of youth tossesyou about like waves in the storm. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak doojai pahrai paraan ee bh ar joban lahree d ay-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the blind and ignorant persongathers poison.
lines.transliteration: teejai pahrai rain  kai van jaari-aa mit raa bikh  sanchai anDh  agi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਜਬ ਪਕਰਿਸ  ਬਵਰੇ  ਤਬ ਿਕਆ  ਜਬਾਬੁ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is entangled in emotional attachment to his wife and sons, O my merchant friend,and deep within him, the waves of greed are rising up.
lines.transliteration: putir kalt ir mohi lapti-aa van jaari-aa mit raa ant ar lahar lobh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਭਿਰ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ  ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The waves of greed are rising up within him, and he does not remember God.
lines.transliteration: antar lahar lobh aan paraanee so parabh  chit na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਜੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਰੈਿਣ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਬਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He does not join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and he suffers in terrible pain through countless incarnations.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  si-o sang na kee-aa baho jonee d ukh paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਿਤਰ੍ ਕਲਿਤਰ੍  ਮੋਿਹ ਲਪਿਟਆ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲਹਿਰ  ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He has forgotten the Creator, his Lord and Master, and he does not meditate on Him,even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: sirjanhaar visaari-aa su-aamee ik nimakh na lago Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲਹਿਰ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, the blind and ignorant person gatherspoison. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee t eejai pahrai bikh  sanchay anDh  agi-aan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਸਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਆ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, that day is drawing near.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai pahrai rain kai van jaari-aa mit raa din nayrh ai aa-i-aa so-ay.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O my merchant friend. It shall be your Friend inthe Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam samaal t ooN vanjaari-aa mit raa tayraa d argeh baylee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਤੀਜੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਸੰਚੇ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O mortal; in the end, it shall be your only companion. pMnw 78
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam samaal paraan ee ant ay ho-ay sakh aa-ee.

lines.english: This emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you; it is false to fall in love with it.
lines.transliteration: ih moh maa-i-aa tayrai sang na chaalai jh oothee pareet  lagaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਝੂਠੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The entire night of your life has passed away in darkness; but by serving the True Guru, the Divine Light shall dawn within.
lines.transliteration: saglee rain gud ree anDh i-aaree sayv sat gur chaanan  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੀ  ਰੈਿਣ ਗੁਦਰੀ ਅੰਿਧਆਰੀ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, that day is drawing near! ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paraanee cha-uthai pahrai d in nayrh ai aa-i-aa so-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਿਦਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Receiving the summons from the Lord of the Universe, O my merchant friend, youmust arise and depart with the actions you have committed.
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa aa-i-aa govind  kaa van jaari-aa mit raa uth  chalay kamaan aa saath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਆਇਆ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਉਿਠ ਚਲੇ ਕਮਾਣਾ  ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: You are not allowed a moment's delay, O my merchant friend; the Messenger ofDeath seizes you with firm hands.
lines.transliteration: ik ratee bilam na d ayvnee van jaari-aa mit raa onee t akrhay paa-ay haath.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਿਬਲਮ  ਨ ਦੇਵਨੀ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਓਨੀ ਤਕੜੇ  ਪਾਏ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Receiving the summons, people are seized and dispatched. The self-willed manmukhsare miserable forever.
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa aa-i-aa pakarh  chalaa-i-aa manmukh  sadaa duhaylay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਆਇਆ  ਪਕਿੜ  ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: But those who serve the Perfect True Guru are forever happy in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee pooraa satgur sayvi-aa say d argeh sad aa suhaylay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The body is the field of karma in this age; whatever you plant, you shall harvest.
lines.transliteration: karam Dhart ee sareer jug ant ar jo bovai so kh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਜੋ ਬੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; the self-willedmanmukhs wander forever in reincarnation. ||5||1||4|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 Gru 2 CMq  (78-7) sireeraag mehlaa 4 ghar 2 chh ant Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, Second House, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (78-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhagat  soheh d arvaaray manmukh  sadaa bh avaat . ||5||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਦਰਵਾਰੇ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਿਤ  ॥੫॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: How can the ignorant soul-bride obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is in this world of her father's home?
lines.transliteration: munDh i-aan ee pay-ee-arh ai ki-o kar har d arsan pikh ai.

lines.english: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, the Gurmukh learns the duties of herHusband's Celestial Home.
lines.transliteration: har har apnee kirpaa karay gurmukh saahurrh ai kamm sikh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ  ਪੇਈਅੜੈ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਪਖੈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home; she meditatesforever on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: saahurrhai kamm sikh ai gurmukh  har har sad aa Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਪਨੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਿਸਖੈ ॥
lines.english: She walks happily among her companions, and in the Lord's Court, she swings herarms joyfully.
lines.transliteration: sahee-aa vich firai suhaylee har dargeh baah ludaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਿਸਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Her account is cleared by the Righteous Judge of Dharma, when she chants the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa Dh aram raa-ay kee baakee jap har har naam kirkh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੀਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਫਰੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The ignorant soul-bride becomes Gurmukh, and gains the Blessed Vision of the Lord'sDarshan, while she is still in her father's house. ||1||
lines.transliteration: munDh i-aan ee pay-ee-arh ai gurmukh  har d arsan d ikhai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ  ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਕਰਖੈ  ॥
lines.english: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vee-aahu ho-aa mayray babulaa gurmukhay har paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਦਖੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. The Guru has revealed the blazing light of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayraa kati-aa gur gi-aan parchand balaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This spiritual wisdom given by the Guru shines forth, and the darkness has beendispelled. I have found the Priceless Jewel of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bali-aa gur gi-aan anDhayraa binsi-aa har rat an pad aarath laaDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਕਿਟਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The sickness of my ego has been dispelled, and my pain is over and done. Throughthe Guru's Teachings, my identity has consumed my identical identity.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog ga-i-aa dukh  laathaa aap aapai gurmat  khaaDhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਿਬਨਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਲਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained my Husband Lord, the Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form. He isImperishable; He shall never die, and He shall never ever leave.
lines.transliteration: akaal moorat var paa-i-aa abh inaasee naa kad ay marai na jaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਆਪੈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਖਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord.||2||
lines.transliteration: vee-aahu ho-aa mayray baabolaa gurmukhay har paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Meeting with the humble servants ofthe Lord, the marriage procession looks beautiful.
lines.transliteration: har sat sat ay mayray babulaa har jan mil janj  suhand ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: She who chants the Lord's Name is happy in this world of her father's home, and inthe next world of her Husband Lord, she shall be very beautiful.
lines.transliteration: payvkarhai har jap suhaylee vich saahurrh ai kharee sohand ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਸਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੰਞ ਸੁਹੰਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: In her Husband Lord's Celestial Home, she shall be most beautiful, if she hasremembered the Naam in this world.
lines.transliteration: saahurrhai vich kh aree sohand ee jin payvkarh ai naam samaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful are the lives of those who, as Gurmukh, have conquered their minds-they have won the game of life.
lines.transliteration: sabh safli-o janam t inaa d aa gurmukh  jinaa man jin  paasaa dh aali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੇਵਕੜੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Joining with the humble Saints of the Lord, my actions bring prosperity, and I haveobtained the Lord of Bliss as my Husband.
lines.transliteration: har sant janaa mil kaaraj sohi-aa var paa-i-aa purakh  anandee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਤਨਾ ਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਮਨੁ ਿਜਿਣ  ਪਾਸਾ  ਢਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Joining with the humble servants ofthe Lord, the marriage party has been embellished. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har sat sat  mayray baabolaa har jan mil janj  sohand ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸੋਿਹਆ  ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: O my father, give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry. pMnw 79
lines.transliteration: har parabh mayray babulaa har d ayvhu d aan mai d aajo.

lines.english: Give me the Lord as my wedding gown, and the Lord as my glory, to accomplish my works.
lines.transliteration: har kaprho har sobh aa dayvhu jit  savrai mayraa kaajo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਪੜੋ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਿਜਤੁ  ਸਵਰੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਜੋ  ॥
lines.english: Through devotional worship to the Lord, this ceremony is made blissful and beautiful;the Guru, the True Guru, has given this gift.
lines.transliteration: har har bhagt ee kaaj suhaylaa gur sat gur daan d ivaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਕਾਜੁ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦਾਨੁ ਿਦਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Across the continents, and throughout the Universe, the Lord's Glory is pervading.This gift is not diminished by being diffused among all.
lines.transliteration: khand varbh and har sobh aa ho-ee ih d aan na ralai ralaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਿਡ ਵਰਭੰਿਡ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Any other dowry, which the self-willed manmukhs offer for show, is only false egotism and a worthless display.
lines.transliteration: hor manmukh d aaj je rakh  dikhaaleh so koorh  ahaNkaar kach paajo.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਰ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਾਜੁ  ਿਜ ਰਿਖ ਿਦਖਾਲਿਹ  ਸੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਜੋ ॥
lines.english: O my father, please give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry.||4||
lines.transliteration: har parabh mayray babulaa har d ayvhu d aan mai d aajo. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, thesoul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine.
lines.transliteration: har raam raam mayray baabolaa pir mil Dhan vayl vaDh andee.
