lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ  ਿਪਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: In age after age, through all the ages, forever and ever, those who belong to theGuru's Family shall prosper and increase.
lines.transliteration: har jugah jugo jug jugah jugo sad peerh ee guroo chaland ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੁਗਹ  ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਹ  ਜੁਗੋ ਸਦ ਪੀੜੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਚਲੰਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: Age after age, the Family of the True Guru shall increase. As Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jug jug peerhee chalai sat gur kee jinee gurmukh  naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਪੀੜੀ  ਚਲੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Almighty Lord never dies or goes away. Whatever He gives, keeps on increasing.
lines.transliteration: har purakh na kab hee binsai jaavai nit  dayvai charh ai savaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਜਾਵੈ ਿਨਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One Lord is the Saint of Saints. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har,Har, the soul-bride is bountiful and beautiful.
lines.transliteration: naanak sant sant  har ayko jap har har naam sohand ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, thesoul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine. ||5||1|| isrIrwgu mhlw 5 CMq  (79-8) sireeraag mehlaa 5 chhant Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (79-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har raam raam mayray babulaa pir mil Dhan vayl vaDh andee. ||5||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ  ਿਪਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ  ॥੫॥੧॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa gobind  naam samaalay.

lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the Lord shall always be with you.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee mitraa har nibhai t ayrai naalay.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord shall be with you as your Helper and Support. Meditate on Him- no one who does so shall ever return empty-handed.
lines.transliteration: sang sahaa-ee har naam Dhi-aa-ee birthaa ko-ay na jaa-ay.

lines.english: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, by focusing your consciousness onthe Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: man chinday say-ee fal paavahi charan  kamal chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He is totally pervading the water and the land; He is the Lord of the World-forest.Behold Him in exaltation in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: jal thal poor rahi-aa banvaaree ghat gh at nad ar nihaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਦੇ  ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, in the Company of the Holy, burn away yourdoubts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sikh d ay-ay man pareet am saaDh sang bh aram jaalay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, without the Lord, all outward show is false.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee mitraa har bin jh ooth pasaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਸਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਜਾਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the world is an ocean of poison.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa bikh  saagar sansaaray.

lines.english: Let the Lord's Lotus Feet be your Boat, so that pain and skepticism shall not touch you.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kar bohith kart ay sahsaa d ookh na bi-aapai.

lines.english: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, meditate on God twenty-fourhours a day.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa bhaytai vadbh aagee aath  pahar parabh  jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਕਿਰ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Lord and Master of Hisservants. His Name is the Support of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee sayvak su-aamee bh agtaa naam aDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, without the Lord, all outward show is false.||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak sikh d ay-ay man pareet am bin har jh ooth pasaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa har lad ay kh ayp savlee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਸਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਝੂਠ ਪਸਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, enter through the eternal Door of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa har d ar nihchal malee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਹਿਰ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who serves at the Door of the Imperceptible and Unfathomable Lord, obtains thiseternal position.
lines.transliteration: har dar sayvay alakh  abhayvay nihchal aasan  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going; anguish and anxiety are ended.
lines.transliteration: tah janam na maran  na aavan  jaanaa sansaa d ookh mitaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵੇ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਆਸਣੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The accounts of Chitr and Gupt, the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious are torn up, and the Messenger of Death cannot do anything.
lines.transliteration: chitar gupat  kaa kaagad  faari-aa jamd ootaa kachh oo na chalee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ  ਨ ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, load the profitable cargo of the Lord'sName. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak sikh d ay-ay man pareet am har lad ay kh ayp savlee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਰ੍  ਗੁਪਤ  ਕਾ ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਫਾਿਰਆ  ਜਮਦੂਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, abide in the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa kar sant aa sang nivaaso.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਸਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, chanting the Lord's Name, the Divine Light shineswithin.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa har naam japat  pargaaso.

lines.english: Remember your Lord and Master, who is easily obtained, and all desires shall be fulfilled. pMnw 80
lines.transliteration: simar su-aamee sukhah gaamee ichh  saglee punnee-aa.

lines.english: By my past actions, I have found the Lord, the Greatest Lover. Separated from Him for so long, I am united with Him again.
lines.transliteration: purbay kamaa-ay sareerang paa-ay har milay chiree vichhunni-aa.

lines.english: Inside and out, He is pervading everywhere. Faith in Him has welled up within mymind.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sarbat  ravi-aa man upji-aa bisu-aaso.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸਰਬਿਤ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਮਿਨ ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਿਬਸੁਆਸੋ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, let the Society of the Saints be your dwelling. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak sikh d ay-ay man pareet am kar sant aa sang nivaaso. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਸਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਕਿਰ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਿਗ ਿਨਵਾਸੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, let your mind remain absorbed in loving devotion tothe Lord.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa har paraym bh agat man leenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the fish of the mind lives only when it is immersed inthe Water of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa jee-o mitraa har jal mil jeevay meenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਲ ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੀਵੇ ਮੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking in the Lord's Ambrosial Bani, the mind is satisfied, and all pleasures come toabide within.
lines.transliteration: har pee aaghaanay amrit  baanay sarab sukh aa man vuth ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੀ ਆਘਾਨੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਨੇ ਸਰ੍ਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮਨ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
lines.english: Attaining the Lord of Excellence, I sing the Songs of Joy. The True Guru, becomingmerciful, has fulfilled my desires.
lines.transliteration: sareeDhar paa-ay mangal gaa-ay ichh  punnee sat gur tuthay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ  ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੁਠੇ ॥
lines.english: He has attached me to the hem of His robe, and I have obtained the nine treasures.My Lord and Master has bestowed His Name, which is everything to me.
lines.transliteration: larh leenay laa-ay na-o niDh  paa-ay naa-o sarbas th aakur d eenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਿੜ  ਲੀਨੇ  ਲਾਏ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ  ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਦੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak instructs the Saints to teach, that the mind is imbued with loving devotion tothe Lord. ||5||1||2|| isrIrwg ky CMq mhlw 5  (80-7) sireeraag kay chhant  mehlaa 5 Chhants Of Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (80-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: fKxw ] (80-7) dakh-n aa. Dakhanaa:
lines.transliteration: naanak sikh sant  samjh aa-ee har paraym bh agat man leenaa. ||5||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਸਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਝਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ॥੫॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: My Beloved Husband Lord is deep within my heart. How can I see Him?
lines.transliteration: hath majh aahoo maa piree pasay ki-o d eedaar.

lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, O Nanak, the Support of the breath of life is found. ||1|| CMqu ] (80-9) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: sant sarn aa-ee labh -nay naanak paraan  aDhaar. ||1||

lines.english: To love the Lotus Feet of the Lord-this way of life has come into the minds of HisSaints.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o pareet reet  santan man aav-ay jee-o.

lines.english: The love of duality, this evil practice, this bad habit, is not liked by the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa bh aa-o bipreet  aneet  daasaa nah bh aav-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਲਭਣੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਅਧਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is not pleasing to the Lord's slaves; without the Blessed Vision of the Lord'sDarshan, how can they find peace, even for a moment?
lines.transliteration: daasaa nah bh aav-ay bin d arsaav-ay ik kh in Dheeraj ki-o karai.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are empty; like fish outof water, they die.
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonaa tan man heenaa jal bin machh ulee ji-o marai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਰੀਿਤ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਮਿਨ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Please meet with me, O my Beloved-You are the Support of my breath of life. Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: mil mayray pi-aaray paraan aDhaaray gun  saaDh sang mil gaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਭਾਉ ਿਬਪਰੀਿਤ  ਅਨੀਿਤ  ਦਾਸਾ  ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master of Nanak, please grant Your Grace, and permeate my body, mindand being. ||1|| fKxw ] (80-13) dakh-n aa. Dakhanaa:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay su-aamee Dhaar anoograhu man t an ank samaav-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸਾ  ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ  ਿਬਨੁ ਦਰਸਾਵਏ ਇਕ ਿਖਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: He is Beautiful in all places; I do not see any other at all.
lines.transliteration: sohandarh o habh  thaa-ay ko-ay na d isai doojrh o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਹੂਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ  ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਿਜਉ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, O Nanak, the doors are opened wide. ||1|| CMqu ] (80-14) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: khulHrhay kapaat naanak sat gur bh ayttay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਗਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Your Word is Incomparable and Infinite. I contemplate the Word of Your Bani, theSupport of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: tayray bachan anoop apaar sant an aaDh aar ban ee beechaaree-ai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਿਕ ਸਮਾਵਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I remember Him in meditation with every breath and morsel of food, with perfectfaith. How could I forget Him from my mind?
lines.transliteration: simrat saas giraas pooran bisu-aas ki-o manhu bisaaree-ai jee-o.

lines.english: How could I forget Him from my mind, even for an instant? He is the Most Worthy; Heis my very life!
lines.transliteration: ki-o manhu baysaaree-ai nimakh nahee taaree-ai gun vant paraan hamaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹੰਦੜੋ  ਹਭ ਠਾਇ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਦਸੈ ਡੂਜੜੋ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is the Giver of the fruits of the mind's desires. He knows all the useless vanities and pains of the soul.
lines.transliteration: man baaNchhat  fal dayt hai su-aamee jee-a kee birthaa saaray.

lines.english: Meditating on the Patron of lost souls, the Companion of all, your life shall not be lostin the gamble.
lines.transliteration: anaath kay naathay sarab kai saathay jap joo-ai janam na haaree-ai.

lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer to God: Please shower me with Your Mercy, and carry meacross the terrifying world-ocean. ||2|| fKxw ] (80-18) dakh-n aa. Dakhanaa:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee parabh  peh kirpaa kar bh avjal t aaree-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ  ਅਨੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਆਧਾਰ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhoorh ee majan saaDh  khay saa-ee thee-ay kirpaal. People bathe in the dust of the feet of the Saints, when the Lord becomes merciful.
I have obtained all things, O Nanak; the Lord is my Wealth and Property. ||1|| CMqu ] (80-19) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: laDhay habh ay thokrh ay naanak har Dh an maal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਬੇਸਾਰੀਐ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਨਹੀ ਟਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master's Home is beautiful. It is the resting place of His devotees, wholive in hopes of attaining it.
lines.transliteration: sundar su-aamee Dh aam bh agtah bisraam aasaa lag jeevt ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਛਤ  ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Their minds and bodies are absorbed in meditation on the Name of God; they drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. pMnw 81
lines.transliteration: man tanay galt aan simrat  parabh  naam har amrit  peevt ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਲਤਾਨ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵਤੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and become eternally stable. They know that the water of corruption is insipid and tasteless.
lines.transliteration: amrit har peevt ay sad aa thir theevt ay bikh ai ban feekaa jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪੀਵਤੇ  ਸਦਾ ਿਥਰੁ ਥੀਵਤੇ  ਿਬਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: When my God, the Lord of the Universe became merciful, I came to look upon theSaadh Sangat as the treasure.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal gopaal parabh  mayray saaDh sangat  niDh maani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: All pleasures and supreme ecstasy, O my Beloved, come to those who sew the Jewelof the Lord into their minds.
lines.transliteration: sarbaso sookh aanand  ghan pi-aaray har rat an man ant ar seevt ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬਸੋ  ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ  ਘਨ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੀਵਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: They do not forget, even for an instant, the Support of the breath of life. They live byconstantly meditating on Him, O Nanak. ||3|| fKxw ] (81-4) dakh-n aa. Dakhanaa:
lines.transliteration: ik til nahee visrai paraan aaDh aaraa jap jap naanak jeevt ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਆਧਾਰਾ  ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਵਤੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, You meet and merge with those whom you have made Your Own.
lines.transliteration: jo ta-o keenay aapn ay tinaa kooN mili-ohi.

lines.english: You Yourself are entranced, O Nanak, hearing Your Own Praises. ||1|| CMqu ] (81-5) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: aapay hee aap mohi-ohu jas naanak aap suni-ohi. ||1||

lines.english: Administering the intoxicating drug of love, I have won over the Lord of the Universe; I have fascinated His Mind.
lines.transliteration: paraym thag-uree paa-ay reejh aa-ay gobind  man mohi-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਮੋਿਹਓਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਿਣਓਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I am held in the loving embrace of the Unfathomable Lord,and I am entranced.
lines.transliteration: santan kai parsaad  agaaDh  kanth ay lag sohi-aa jee-o.

lines.english: Held in the Lord's loving embrace, I look beautiful, and all my pains have beendispelled. By the loving worship of His devotees, the Lord has come under theirpower.
lines.transliteration: har kanth lag sohi-aa d okh sabh  johi-aa bh agat lakh-yan kar vas bh a-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਪਾਇ  ਰੀਝਾਇ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: All pleasures have come to dwell in the mind; the Lord of the Universe is pleased andappeased. Birth and death have been totally eliminated.
lines.transliteration: man sarab sukh vuth ay govid  tuthay janam marn aa sabh  mit ga-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਕੰਠੇ ਲਿਗ  ਸੋਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O my companions, sing the Songs of Joy. My desires have been fulfilled, and I shallnever again be trapped or shaken by Maya.
lines.transliteration: sakhee manglo gaa-i-aa ichh  pujaa-i-aa bahurh  na maa-i-aa hohi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਿਗ  ਸੋਿਹਆ  ਦੋਖ ਸਿਭ ਜੋਿਹਆ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਲਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਣ ਕਿਰ ਵਿਸ ਭਏ ॥
lines.english: Taking hold of my hand, O Nanak, my Beloved God will not let me be swallowed up bythe world-ocean. ||4|| fKxw ] (81-9) dakh-n aa. Dakhanaa:
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay naanak parabh pi-aaray sansaar saagar nahee pohi-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਵੁਠੇ ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਤੁਠੇ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਸਿਭ ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਏ ॥
lines.english: The Master's Name is Priceless; no one knows its value.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee naam amol keem na ko-ee jaando.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੋ  ਗਾਇਆ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਇਆ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਹੋਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have good destiny recorded upon their foreheads, O Nanak, enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||1|| CMqu ] (81-10) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: jinaa bhaag mathaahi say naanak har rang maand o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੀਨੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੋਿਹਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who chant are sanctified. All those who listen are blessed, and those who writesave their ancestors.
lines.transliteration: kahtay pavit ar sunt ay sabh  Dhan likh -teeN kul taari-aa jee-o.

lines.english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat are imbued with the Lord's Love; they reflect andmeditate on God.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o saaDhoo sang naam har rang t inee barahm beechaari-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ  ਕੀਮ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਦੋ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplating God, their lives are reformed and redeemed; God has showered HisPerfect Mercy upon them.
lines.transliteration: barahm beechaari-aa janam savaari-aa pooran kirpaa parabh karee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਿਹ  ਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਦੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Taking them by the hand, the Lord has blessed them with His Praises. They no longerhave to wander in reincarnation, and they never have to die.
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay har jaso deenay jon naa Dh aavai nah maree.

lines.english: Through the Kind and Compassionate True Guru, I have met the Lord; I haveconquered sexual desire, anger and greed.
lines.transliteration: satgur d a-i-aal kirpaal bh aytat haray kaam kroDh  lobh maari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੇ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਸੁਣਤੇ  ਸਿਭ ਧੰਨੁ ਿਲਖਤੀ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਾਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Our Indescribable Lord and Master cannot be described. Nanak is devoted, forever asacrifice to Him. ||5||1||3|| isrIrwgu mhlw 4 vxjwrw  (81-15) sireeraag mehlaa 4 vanjaaraa Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, Vanajaaraa ~ The Merchant: <> siq nwmu gur pRswid ] (81-15) ik-oNkaar sat naam gur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: kathan na jaa-ay akath su-aamee sadkai jaa-ay naanak vaari-aa. ||5||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਿਤਨੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Excellent and Sublime. He created everyone.
lines.transliteration: har har utam naam hai jin siri-aa sabh  ko-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ਪੂਰਨ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The Lord cherishes all beings. He permeates each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: har jee-a sabhay part ipaald aa gh at ghat rama-ee-aa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੀਨੇ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੋ ਦੀਨੇ  ਜੋਿਨ ਨਾ ਧਾਵੈ ਨਹ ਮਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Meditate forever on that Lord. Without Him, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: so har sadaa Dh i-aa-ee-ai t is bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦਇਆਲ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ਭੇਟਤ  ਹਰੇ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who focus their consciousness on emotional attachment to Maya must leave; they depart crying out in despair.
lines.transliteration: jo mohi maa-i-aa chit laa-id ay say chh od chalay d ukh ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਅਕਥੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਦਕੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, his only Companion inthe end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa har ant  sakhaa-ee ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰੀਰਾਗੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I have none other than You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai har bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਤਮੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਸਿਰਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: 4) har gur sarnaa-ee paa-ee-ai van jaari-aa mit raa vadbh aag paraapat  ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa- o. In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Lord is found, O my merchant friend; by great goodfortune, He is obtained. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 82

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਵਣੁ ਭਾਈਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, no one has obtained the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa vin  bhaa-ee-aa har kinai na paa-i-aa naa-o.

lines.english: Those who do their deeds in ego are like the prostitute's son, who has no name.
lines.transliteration: vich ha-umai karam kamaavday ji-o vaysu-aa put  ninaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਤਾ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਤਾ ਹੋਈਐ  ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ  ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The father's status is obtained only if the Guru is pleased and bestows His Favor.
lines.transliteration: pitaa jaat  taa ho-ee-ai gur t uthaa karay pasaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; embrace love for the Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur paa-i-aa har ahinis lagaa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has realized God; he sings the Lord's Praises through the actions hedoes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak barahm pachhaan i-aa har keerat  karam kamaa-o. ||2||

lines.english: In my mind there is such a deep yearning for the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man har har lagaa chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I have found the Lord throughthe Lord God's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai naam drirh-aa-i-aa har mili-aa har parabh  naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: As long as there is youth and health, meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Along the way, the Lord shall go along with you, and in the end, He shall save you.
lines.transliteration: chaldi-aa naal har chalsee har ant ay la-ay chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਚਲਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those, within whose minds the Lord has come to dwell.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin ka-o jin har man vuth aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have not remembered the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, shall leave with regret in the end.
lines.transliteration: jinee har har naam na chayti-o say ant  ga-ay pachh utaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਸੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur mast ak har parabh  likhi-aa jan naanak naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||3|| Those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O servantNanak, meditate on the Naam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, embrace love for the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man har har pareet lagaa-ay.

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, weare carried across to the other side. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur paa-i-aa gur sabd ee paar lagh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲਘਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself creates, He Himself gives and takes away.
lines.transliteration: har aapay aap upaa-idaa har aapay d ayvai lay-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself leads us astray in doubt; the Lord Himself imparts understanding.
lines.transliteration: har aapay bharam bh ulaa-id aa har aapay hee mat  day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੁ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: The minds of the Gurmukhs are illuminated and enlightened; they are so very rare.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa man pargaas hai say virlay kay-ee kay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who find the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin ka-o jin har paa-i-aa gurmat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਮਿਨ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਹੈ ਸੇ ਿਵਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak's heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and the Lord, Har, Har, has come to dwell in the mind. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kamal pargaasi-aa man har har vuth-rh aa hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man har har japan karay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Guru, O my soul; all your sins shall be takenaway. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har gur sarnaa-ee bh aj pa-o jind oo sabh  kilvikh  dukh parharay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The All-pervading Lord dwells within each and every person's heart-how can He beobtained?
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rama-ee-aa man vasai ki-o paa-ee-ai kit  bhat.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਿਜ ਪਉ ਿਜੰਦੂ  ਸਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By meeting the Perfect Guru, the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell within theconscious mind.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa satgur bh aytee-ai har aa-ay vasai man chit .

lines.english: The Naam is my Support and Sustenance. From the Lord's Name, I obtain salvationand understanding.
lines.transliteration: mai Dhar naam aDh aar hai har naamai t ay gat  mat.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਮਈਆ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਕਤੁ  ਭਿਤ ॥
lines.english: My faith is in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name is my status andhonor.
lines.transliteration: mai har har naam visaahu hai har naamay hee jat pat .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਆਇ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is dyed in the deepcrimson color of the Lord's Love. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa rang rat -rhaa har rang rat . ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਗਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, the True Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavahu har parabh  sat.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਜਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, you shall come to know the Lord God. From the Lord God, everything was created. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee har parabh jaan i-aa sabh  har parabh  tay utpat. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਿਤ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to the Guru and meet Him.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa say aa-ay milay gur paas.

lines.english: They love to serve, O my merchant friend, and through the Guru, they are illuminatedby the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sayvak bhaa-ay van jaari-aa mit raa gur har har naam pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਸਭ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an van aj vapaaree-aa jin vakh ar lad i-arhaa har raas. Blessed, blessed is the trade of those traders who have loaded the merchandise of theWealth of the Lord.
The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant in the Court of the Lord; they come to the Lordand merge with Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa d ar mukh  ujlay say aa-ay milay har paas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੇ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, they alone find the Guru, with whom the Lord, the Treasure ofExcellence, is pleased. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur tin paa-i-aa jinaa aap t uthaa gunt aas. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਾਇ  ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavahu saas giraas.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜੁ  ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ  ਿਜਨ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਿਦਅੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs embrace the Love of the Lord in their minds; they are continually occupied with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||1|| pMnw 83 <> siqgur pRswid ] (83-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: isrIrwg kI vwr mhlw 4 slokw nwil ] (83-1) sireeraag kee vaar mehlaa 4 salokaa naal. Vaar Of Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, With Shaloks: slok mÚ 3 ] (83-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man pareet lagee t inaa gurmukh aa har naam jinaa rahraas. ||1|| rahaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: Among the ragas, Siree Raag is the best, if it inspires you to enshrine love for theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: raagaa vich sareeraag hai jay sach Dharay pi-aar.

lines.english: The True Lord comes to abide forever in the mind, and your understanding becomessteady and unequalled.
lines.transliteration: sadaa har sach man vasai nihchal mat  apaar.

lines.english: The priceless jewel is obtained, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ratan amolak paa-i-aa gur kaa sabad  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਰ੍ੀਰਾਗੁ  ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਿਚ  ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The tongue becomes true, the mind becomes true, and the body becomes true aswell.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa sachee man sachaa sachaa sareer akaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਮਿਤ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, forever true are the dealings of those who serve the True Guru. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (83-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai satgur sayvi-ai sad aa sach vaapaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: All other loves are transitory, as long as people do not love their Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: hor birhaa sabh Dh aat hai jab lag saahib pareet  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਸਚੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਰੀਰ  ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: This mind is enticed by Maya-it cannot see or hear.
lines.transliteration: ih man maa-i-aa mohi-aa vaykhan  sunan  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without seeing her Husband Lord, love does not well up; what can the blind persondo?
lines.transliteration: sah daykh ay bin pareet  na oopjai anDh aa ki-aa karay-i.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True One who takes away the eyes of spiritual wisdom-He alone canrestore them. ||2|| pauVI ] (83-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin akhee leet ee-aa so-ee sachaa d ay-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁ ਿਬਰਹਾ  ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord alone is the One Creator; there is only the One Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har iko kartaa ik iko d eebaan  har.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਵੇਖਣੁ  ਸੁਨਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord's Command is the One and Only-enshrine the One Lord in yourconsciousness.
lines.transliteration: har iksai daa hai amar iko har chit  Dhar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹ ਦੇਖੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਅੰਧਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without that Lord, there is no other at all. Remove your fear, doubt and dread.
lines.transliteration: har tis bin ko-ee naahi dar bh aram bh a-o door kar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਅਖੀ  ਲੀਤੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Praise that Lord who protects you, inside your home, and outside as well.
lines.transliteration: har tisai no saalaahi je t uDh rakhai baahar gh ar.

lines.english: When that Lord becomes merciful, and one comes to chant the Lord's Name, one swims across the ocean of fear. ||1|| slok mÚ 1 ] (83-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jis no ho-ay da-i-aal so har jap bh a-o bikh am tar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ  ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The gifts belong to our Lord and Master; how can we compete with Him?
lines.transliteration: daatee saahib sand ee-aa ki-aa chalai t is naal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕਸੈ  ਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਚਿਤ  ਧਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Some remain awake and aware, and do not receive these gifts, while others areawakened from their sleep to be blessed. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (83-10) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ik jaaganday naa lahann iknaa sut i-aa d ay-ay uth aal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਿਹ  ਡਰੁ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Faith, contentment and tolerance are the food and provisions of the angels.
lines.transliteration: sidak sabooree saad ikaa sabar t osaa malaa-ikaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਿਜ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖੈ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They obtain the Perfect Vision of the Lord, while those who gossip find no place ofrest. ||2|| pauVI ] (83-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: deedaar pooray paa-isaa thaa-o naahee kh aa-ikaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਭਉ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਤਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself created all; You Yourself delegate the tasks.
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay t uDh upaa-ay kai aap kaarai laa-ee.

lines.english: You Yourself are pleased, beholding Your Own Glorious Greatness.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay vaykh  vigsad aa aapn ee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: O Lord, there is nothing at all beyond You. You are the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: har tuDh hu baahar kichh  naahee t ooN sachaa saa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ  ਨਾ ਲਹੰਿਨ ਇਕਨਾ  ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself are contained in all places.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay aap varatd aa sabh nee hee thaa-ee.

lines.english: Meditate on that Lord, O Saints; He shall rescue and save you. ||2|| slok mÚ 1 ] (83-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har tisai Dh i-aavahu sant  janhu jo la-ay chh adaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Pride in social status is empty; pride in personal glory is useless.
lines.transliteration: fakarh jaat ee fakarh  naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਇਸਾ  ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਖਾਇਕਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One Lord gives shade to all beings.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa jee-aa ikaa chh aa-o.

lines.english: You may call yourself good;
lines.transliteration: aaphu jay ko bhalaa kahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਆਪੇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਆਿਪ  ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this will only be known when your honor is approved in God's Account. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (83-15) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa par jaapai jaa pat  laykh ai paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Die before the one whom you love;
lines.transliteration: jis pi-aaray si-o nayhu tis aagai mar chalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dharig jeevan  sansaar t aa kai paachh ai jeevn aa. ||2|| to live after he dies is to live a worthless life in this world. ||2|| pauVI ] (83-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭਨੀ  ਹੀ ਥਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the earth, and the two lamps of the sun and the moon.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay Dh artee saajee-ai chand  sooraj d u-ay d eevay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੈ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You created the fourteen world-shops, in which Your Business is transacted.
lines.transliteration: das chaar hat t uDh saaji-aa vaapaar kareevay.

lines.english: The Lord bestows His Profits on those who become Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: iknaa no har laabh d ay-ay jo gurmukh  theevay.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not touch those who drink in the True Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: tin jamkaal na vi-aapa-ee jin sach amrit  peevay.

lines.english: They themselves are saved, along with their family, and all those who follow them are saved as well. ||3|| slok mÚ 1 ] (83-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: o-ay aap chhutay parvaar si-o t in pichh ai sabh  jagat  chhuteevay. ||3||

lines.english: He created the Creative Power of the Universe, within which He dwells. pMnw 84
lines.transliteration: kudrat  kar kai vasi-aa so-ay.

lines.english: One who reflects upon his allotted span of life, becomes the slave of God.
lines.transliteration: vakhat  veechaaray so band aa ho-ay.

lines.english: The value of the Creative Power of the Universe cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  hai keemat  nahee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇ  ਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Even if its value were known, it could not be described.
lines.transliteration: jaa keemat paa-ay t a kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Some think about religious rituals and regulations,
lines.transliteration: sarai saree-at karahi beechaar.
bin boojhay kaisay paavahi paar. but without understanding, how can they cross over to the other side?

lines.english: Let sincere faith be your bowing in prayer, and let the conquest of your mind be your objective in life.
lines.transliteration: sidak kar sijd aa man kar makh sood.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see God's Presence. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (84-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jih Dhir d aykhaa tih Dhir ma-ujood . ||1||

lines.english: The Society of the Guru is not obtained like this, by trying to be near or far away.
lines.transliteration: gur sabhaa ayv na paa-ee-ai naa nayrh ai naa d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਭਾ ਏਵ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, you shall meet the True Guru, if your mind remains in His Presence. ||2|| pauVI ] (84-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur t aaN milai jaa man rahai had oor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤ ਿਮਲੈ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The seven islands, seven seas, nine continents, four Vedas and eighteen Puraanas
lines.transliteration: sapat d eep sapat  saagraa nav kh and chaar vayd  das asat puraan aa.

lines.english: -O Lord, You pervade and permeate all. Lord, everyone loves You.
lines.transliteration: har sabhnaa vich t ooN varatd aa har sabh naa bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਪਤ  ਦੀਪ ਸਪਤ  ਸਾਗਰਾ  ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਚਾਿਰ  ਵੇਦ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures meditate on You, Lord. You hold the earth in Your Hands.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ujhai Dhi-aavahi jee-a jant  har saarag paan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo gurmukh har aaraaDh aday tin ha-o kurbaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੁਝੈ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are All-pervading; You stage this wondrous drama! ||4|| slok mÚ 3 ] (84-7) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay aap varatd aa kar choj vidaan aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Why ask for a pen, and why ask for ink? Write within your heart.
lines.transliteration: kala-o masaajnee ki-aa sadaa-ee-ai hird ai hee likh  layho.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਕਿਰ ਚੋਜ ਿਵਡਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remain immersed forever in the Love of your Lord and Master, and your love for Himshall never break.
lines.transliteration: sadaa saahib kai rang rahai kabahooN na tootas nayhu.

lines.english: Pen and ink shall pass away, along with what has been written.
lines.transliteration: kala-o masaajnee jaa-isee likhi-aa bh ee naalay jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Love of your Husband Lord shall never perish. The True Lord hasbestowed it, as it was pre-ordained. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (84-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sah pareet na jaa-isee jo Dh ur chh odee sachai paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: That which is seen, shall not go along with you. What does it take to make you seethis?
lines.transliteration: nadree aavd aa naal na chal-ee vaykh hu ko vi-upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਹੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਤੂਟਿਸ  ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has implanted the True Name within; remain lovingly absorbed in theTrue One.
lines.transliteration: satgur sach drirh -aa-i-aa sach rahhu liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਉ  ਮਸਾਜਨੀ  ਜਾਇਸੀ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਭੀ ਨਾਲੇ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Word of His Shabad is True. By His Grace, it is obtained. ||2|| pauVI ] (84-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabdee sach hai karmee palai paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ  ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, You are inside and outside as well. You are the Knower of secrets.
lines.transliteration: har andar baahar ik t ooN tooN jaaneh bh ayt.

lines.english: Whatever anyone does, the Lord knows. O my mind, think of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo keechai so har jaandaa mayray man har chayt .

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਵਦਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਿਵਉਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The one who commits sins lives in fear, while the one who lives righteously rejoices.
lines.transliteration: so darai je paap kamaavdaa Dh armee vigsayt .

lines.english: O Lord, You Yourself are True, and True is Your Justice. Why should anyone be afraid?
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa aap ni-aa-o sach t aa daree-ai kayt .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who recognize the True Lord are blended with the True One. ||5|| slok mÚ 3 ] (84-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinaa naanak sach pachhaan i-aa say sach ralayt . ||5||

lines.english: Burn the pen, and burn the ink; burn the paper as well.
lines.transliteration: kalam jala-o san masvaan ee-ai kaagad  bhee jal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਭੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Burn the writer who writes in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: likhan  vaalaa jal bala-o jin likh i-aa d oojaa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਕੀਚੈ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਚੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, people do what is pre-ordained; they cannot do anything else. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (84-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhi-aa kamaavan aa avar na karn aa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: False is other reading, and false is other speaking, in the love of Maya.
lines.transliteration: hor koorh parh -naa koorh  bolnaa maa-i-aa naal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਆਉ  ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਡਰੀਐ  ਕੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, nothing is permanent; those who read and read areruined. ||2|| pauVI ] (84-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai ko thir nahee parh  parh ho-ay kh u-aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਸੇ ਸਿਚ ਰਲੇਤੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: har kee vadi-aa-ee vadee hai har keertan har kaa.

lines.english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; His Justice is totally Righteous.
lines.transliteration: har kee vadi-aa-ee vadee hai jaa ni-aa-o hai Dharam kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਮ  ਜਲਉ  ਸਣੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ  ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਭੀ ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; people receive the fruits of the soul.
lines.transliteration: har kee vadi-aa-ee vadee hai jaa fal hai jee-a kaa.

lines.english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He does not hear the words of the back-biters.
lines.transliteration: har kee vadi-aa-ee vadee hai jaa na sun-ee kahi-aa chugal kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He gives His Gifts without being asked. ||6|| slok mÚ 3 ] (84-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kee vadi-aa-ee vadee hai apuchhi-aa d aan d ayvkaa. ||6||

lines.english: Those who act in ego shall all die. Their worldly possessions shall not go along withthem.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o kartee sabh  mu-ee sampa-o kisai na naal.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Because of their love of duality, they suffer in pain. The Messenger of Death is watching all. pMnw 85
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay d ukh paa-i-aa sabh  johee jamkaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, by contemplating the True Name. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (85-1) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ubray saachaa naam samaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: We are good at talking, but our actions are bad.
lines.transliteration: galeeN asee changee-aa aachaaree buree-aah.

lines.english: Mentally, we are impure and black, but outwardly, we appear white.
lines.transliteration: manhu kusuDhaa kaalee-aa baahar chitvee-aah.

lines.english: We imitate those who stand and serve at the Lord's Door.
lines.transliteration: reesaa karih tinaarh ee-aa jo sayveh d ar kharhee-aah.

lines.english: They are attuned to the Love of their Husband Lord, and they experience the pleasure of His Love.
lines.transliteration: naal khasmai rat ee-aa maan eh sukh  ralee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਰੀਸਾ  ਕਿਰਹ  ਿਤਨਾੜੀਆ  ਜੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਦਰੁ ਖੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: They remain powerless, even while they have power; they remain humble and meek.
lines.transliteration: hodai t aan nitaanee-aa raheh nimaann ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਲ  ਖਸਮੈ  ਰਤੀਆ  ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਸੁਿਖ ਰਲੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, our lives become profitable if we associate with them. ||2|| pauVI ] (85-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak janam sakaarthaa jay tin kai sang milaah. ||2||

lines.english: You Yourself are the water, You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay jal meenaa hai aapay aapay hee aap jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਕਾਰਥਾ  ਜੇ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself cast the net, and You Yourself are the bait.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay jaal vat aa-idaa aapay vich saybaal.

lines.english: You Yourself are the lotus, unaffected and still brightly-colored in hundreds of feet ofwater.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay kamal alipat  hai sai hathaa vich gulaal.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਾ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself liberate those who think of You for even an instant.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay mukat  karaa-id aa ik nimakh  gharhee kar kh i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਵਤਾਇਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੇਬਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, nothing is beyond You. I am delighted to behold You, through the Word of theGuru's Shabad. ||7|| slok mÚ 3 ] (85-7) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har tuDh hu baahar kichh  nahee gur sabd ee vaykh  nihaal. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸੈ ਹਥਾ ਿਵਿਚ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: One who does not know the Hukam of the Lord's Command cries out in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaanai bahut aa rovai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਘੜੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਖਆਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: She is filled with deception, and she cannot sleep in peace.
lines.transliteration: andar Dh okhaa need  na sovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੇਿਖ ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: But if the soul-bride follows the Will of her Lord and Master, she shall be honored inher own home, and called to the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: jay Dhan kh asmai chalai rajaa-ee. d ar ghar sobh aa mahal bulaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, by His Mercy, this understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: naanak karmee ih mat paa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, she is absorbed into the True One. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (85-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sach samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O self-willed manmukh, devoid of the Naam, do not be misled upon beholding thecolor of the safflower.
lines.transliteration: manmukh naam vihoon i-aa rang kasumbh aa daykh na bh ul.

lines.english: Its color lasts for only a few days-it is worthless!
lines.transliteration: is kaa rang din thorh i-aa chh ochhaa is d aa mul.

lines.english: Attached to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid people waste away and die.
lines.transliteration: doojai lagay pach mu-ay moorakh  anDh  gavaar.

lines.english: Like worms, they live in manure, and in it, they die over and over again.
lines.transliteration: bistaa andar keet say pa-i pacheh vaaro vaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are dyed in the color of truth; they take on the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say rangulay gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The color of devotional worship does not fade away; they remain intuitively absorbedin the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (85-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee rang na ut rai sehjay rahai samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਿਣਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ॥
lines.english: You created the entire universe, and You Yourself bring sustenance to it.
lines.transliteration: sisat upaa-ee sabh t uDh aapay rijak sambaahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਿਦਨ ਥੋਿੜਆ  ਛੋਛਾ  ਇਸ ਦਾ ਮੁਲੁ ॥
lines.english: Some eat and survive by practicing fraud and deceit; from their mouths they dropfalsehood and lies.
lines.transliteration: ik val chhal kar kai kh aavday muhhu koorh  kusat  tinee dh aahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, You assign them their tasks.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay bh aavai so karahi t uDh otai kamm o-ay laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਪਇ ਪਚਿਹ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Some understand Truthfulness; they are given the inexhaustible treasure.
lines.transliteration: iknaa sach bujhaa-i-on t inaa at ut bhandaar d ayvaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who eat by remembering the Lord are prosperous, while those who do not remember Him stretch out their hands in need. ||8|| slok mÚ 3 ] (85-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har chayt kh aahi t inaa safal hai achayt aa hath t adaa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੀ  ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, constantly read and recite the Vedas, for the sakeof the love of Maya.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  bayd  vakaan eh maa-i-aa moh su-aa-ay.

lines.english: In the love of duality, the foolish people have forgotten the Lord's Name; they shallreceive their punishment.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay har naam visaari-aa man moorakh  milai sajaa-ay.

lines.english: They never think of the One who gave them body and soul, who provides sustenanceto all.
lines.transliteration: jin jee-o pind dit aa tis kabahooN na chayt ai jo d ayNdaa rijak sambaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਖਾਵਦੇ  ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਢਾਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: The noose of death shall not be cut away from their necks; they shall come and go inreincarnation over and over again.
lines.transliteration: jam kaa faahaa galhu na katee-ai fir fir aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਓਤੈ ਕੰਿਮ ਓਇ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything. They do what they arepre-ordained to do.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kichh oo na soojh ai anDh ulay poorab likh i-aa kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਅਤੁਟ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਦੇਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace, and the Naamcomes to abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sat gur milai sukh -daata naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤ  ਖਾਿਹ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਅਚੇਤਾ  ਹਥ ਤਡਾਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: They enjoy peace, they wear peace, and they pass their lives in the peace of peace.
lines.transliteration: sukh maan eh sukh  painn aa sukh ay sukh  vihaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they do not forget the Naam from the mind; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (85-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so naa-o manhu na visaaree-ai jit d ar sachai sobh aa paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence. pMnw 86
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sukh  paa-i-aa sach naam gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and recognize your own self; the Divine Light of the Lord's Name shall shine within.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee aap pachh aani-aa raam naam pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.
lines.transliteration: sacho sach kamaavanaa vadi-aa-ee vaday paas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਵਡੇ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers toHim.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is kaa sifat  karay ard aas.

lines.english: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abidein the peace of peace.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad salaahn aa sukh ay sukh  nivaas.

lines.english: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam manai maahi bin naavai Dh arig jeevaas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਮਨੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਜੀਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukhwastes away in emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naa-o paa-ee-ai manmukh  mohi vin aas.

lines.english: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2|| pauVI ] (86-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  tooN naanak t ayraa d aas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t ayraa t ooN sabh as daa tooN sabh naa raas.

lines.english: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day.
lines.transliteration: sabh t uDhai paashu mangd ay nit  kar ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਸੁ  ਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, andYou are close to others.
lines.transliteration: jis tooN deh tis sabh  kichh  milai iknaa d oor hai paas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਪਾਸਹ ੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ  ਿਨਤ  ਕਿਰ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify itin your mind.
lines.transliteration: tuDh baajh ahu thaa-o ko naahee jis paashu mangee-ai man vaykh hu ko nirjaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਿਤਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਦੂਿਰ ਹੈ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: All praise You, O Lord; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened. ||9|| slok mÚ 3 ] (86-7) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh t uDhai no salaahd ay dar gurmukh aa no pargaas. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਮਿਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਿਨਰਜਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud, but they areattached to the love of Maya.
lines.transliteration: pandit parh  parh uchaa kookd aa maa-i-aa mohi pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਦੇ  ਦਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: They do not recognize God within themselves-they are so foolish and ignorant!
lines.transliteration: antar barahm na cheen-ee man moorakh  gaavaar.

lines.english: In the love of duality, they try to teach the world, but they do not understandmeditative contemplation.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay jagat  parboDh adaa naa boojh ai beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਉਚਾ  ਕੂਕਦਾ  ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They lose their lives uselessly; they die, only to be re-born, over and over again. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (86-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa mar jammai vaaro vaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨਈ  ਮਿਨ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand.
lines.transliteration: jinee satgur sayvi-aa t inee naa-o paa-i-aa boojh hu kar beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਪਰਬੋਧਦਾ  ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Eternal peace and joy abide in their minds; they abandon their cries and complaints.
lines.transliteration: sadaa saaNt sukh  man vasai chookai kook pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Their identity consumes their identical identity, and their minds become pure by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapai no aap khaa-ay man nirmal hovai gur sabd ee veechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (86-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad rat ay say mukat  hai har jee-o hayt  pi-aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਨੀ ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Service to the Lord is fruitful; through it, the Gurmukh is honored and approved.
lines.transliteration: har kee sayvaa safal hai gurmukh paavai thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: That person, with whom the Lord is pleased, meets with the Guru, and meditates onthe Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis har bhaavai t is gur milai so har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਨੋ ਆਪੁ  ਖਾਇ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. The Lord carries us across.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har paa-ee-ai har paar lagh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through stubborn-mindedness, none have found Him; go and consult the Vedas onthis.
lines.transliteration: manhath kinai na paa-i-o puchh ahu vayd aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone serves the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself. ||10|| slok mÚ 3 ] (86-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har kee sayvaa so karay jis la-ay har laa-ay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he is a brave warrior, who conquers and subdues his vicious inner ego.
lines.transliteration: naanak so sooraa varee-aam jin vichahu dusat ahankaran  maari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukhs redeem their lives.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam saalaahi janam savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲਘਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They themselves are liberated forever, and they save all their ancestors.
lines.transliteration: aap ho-aa sadaa mukat  sabh  kul nist aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਪੁਛਹੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who love the Naam look beauteous at the Gate of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sohan sach du-aar naam pi-aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਲਏ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs die in egotism-even their death is painfully ugly.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mareh ahaNkaar maran  vigaarh i-aa.

lines.english: Everything happens according to the Lord's Will; what can the poor people do?
lines.transliteration: sabho vart ai hukam ki-aa karahi vichaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to self-conceit and duality, they have forgotten their Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: aaphu doojai lag kh asam visaari-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, everything is painful, and happiness is forgotten. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (86-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai sabh d ukh sukh  visaari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਹੋਆ  ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਿਨਸਤਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. It has dispelled mydoubts from within.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam dirh aa-i-aa t in vichahu bh aram chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I sing the Lord's Name and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the Divine Light shines, and now I see the Way.
lines.transliteration: raam naam har keerat gaa-ee kar chaanan  mag d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has come to dwell within me. pMnw 87
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar ayk liv laagee antar naam vasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I cannot be touched by the Messenger of Death. I am absorbed in the True Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee jam johi na saakai saachai naam samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself is All-pervading everywhere; He links those with whom He ispleased to His Name.
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay aap vart ai kart aa jo bh aavai so naa-ay laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would die inan instant. ||2|| pauVI ] (87-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam la-ay taa jeevai bin naavai kh in mar jaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਖਨੁ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who is accepted at the Court of the Lord shall be accepted in courts everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jo mili-aa har deebaan  si-o so sabh nee d eebaan ee mili-aa.

lines.english: Wherever he goes, he is recognized as honorable. Seeing his face, all sinners aresaved.
lines.transliteration: jithai oh jaa-ay tithai oh surkh aroo us kai muhi dith ai sabh  paapee t ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਦੀਬਾਣ  ਿਸਉ ਸੋ ਸਭਨੀ  ਦੀਬਾਣੀ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Within him is the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Through the Naam, he is exalted.
lines.transliteration: os antar naam niDh aan hai naamo parvaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ਿਤਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਰਖਰੂ  ਉਸ ਕੈ ਮੁਿਹ ਿਡਠੈ ਸਭ ਪਾਪੀ  ਤਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He worships the Name, and believes in the Name; the Name erases all his sinfulmistakes.
lines.transliteration: naa-o poojee-ai naa-o mannee-ai naa-ay kilvikh sabh  hiri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਵਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Name, with one-pointed mind and focused consciousness,remain forever stable in the world. ||11|| slok mÚ 3 ] (87-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinee naam Dhi-aa-i-aa ik man ik chit  say asthir jag rahi-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਪੂਜੀਐ  ਨਾਉ  ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਇ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਸਭ ਿਹਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Worship the Divine, Supreme Soul, with the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: aatmaa d ay-o poojee-ai gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਇਕ ਿਚਿਤ  ਸੇ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਜਿਗ  ਰਿਹਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: If the individual soul has faith in the Supreme Soul, then it shall obtain realizationwithin its own home.
lines.transliteration: aatmay no aat may d ee part eet ho-ay t aa gh ar hee parchaa paa-ay.

lines.english: The soul becomes steady, and does not waver, by the natural inclination of the Guru'sLoving Will.
lines.transliteration: aatmaa adol na dol-ee gur kai bh aa-ay subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮਾ  ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, intuitive wisdom does not come, and the filth of greed does notdepart from within.
lines.transliteration: gur vin sahj na aavee lobh  mail na vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮੇ  ਨੋ ਆਤਮੇ  ਦੀ ਪਰ੍ਤੀਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If the Lord's Name abides within the mind, for a moment, even for an instant, it is like bathing at all the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: khin pal har naam man vasai sabh  athsath tirath naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮਾ  ਅਡੋਲੁ  ਨ ਡੋਲਈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Filth does not stick to those who are true, but filth attaches itself to those who loveduality.
lines.transliteration: sachay mail na lag-ee mal laagai doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਵਣੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhotee mool na ut rai jay ath sath tirath naa-ay. This filth cannot be washed off, even by bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines ofpilgrimage.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh does deeds in egotism; he earns only pain and more pain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam karay ahaNkaaree sabh  dukho dukh kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the filthy ones become clean only when they meet and surrender to theTrue Guru. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (87-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mailaa oojal taa thee-ai jaa sat gur maahi samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੋਤੀ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੇ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs may be taught, but how can they really be taught?
lines.transliteration: manmukh lok samjaa-ee-ai kad ahu samjh aa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The manmukhs do not fit in at all. Because of their past actions, they are condemnedto the cycle of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ralaa-i-aa naa ralai pa-i-ai kirat  firaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈਲਾ  ਊਜਲੁ  ਤਾ ਥੀਐ  ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Loving attention to the Lord and attachment to Maya are the two separate ways; all act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: liv Dhaat  du-ay raah hai hukmee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh has conquered his own mind, by applying the Touchstone of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aapn aa man maari-aa sabad  kasvatee laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਲੋਕੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ  ਕਦਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He fights with his mind, he settles with his mind, and he is at peace with his mind.
lines.transliteration: man hee naal jhagrh aa man hee naal sath man hee manjh  samaa-ay.

lines.english: All obtain the desires of their minds, through the Love of the True Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: man jo ichhay so lahai sachai sabad  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam forever; this is how the Gurmukhsact.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad  bhunchee-ai gurmukh  kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਕਸਵਟੀ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who struggle with something other than their own mind, shall depart havingwasted their lives.
lines.transliteration: vin manai je horee naal lujh -naa jaasee janam gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ਝਗੜਾ  ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ਸਥ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਿਝ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, through stubborn-mindedness and the practice offalsehood, lose the game of life.
lines.transliteration: manmukhee manhath  haari-aa koorh  kusat  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who conquer their own mind, by Guru's Grace, lovingly focus their attention onthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man jinai har sayt ee liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs practice Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||2|| pauVI ] (87-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sach kamaavai manmukh  aavai jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਮਨੈ ਿਜ ਹੋਰੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ਲੁਝਣਾ  ਜਾਸੀ  ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen, and hear the Lord's Teachings,through the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant sun hu jan bh aa-ee har sat gur kee ik saakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੀ  ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਹਾਿਰਆ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have good destiny pre-ordained and inscribed on their foreheads, grasp itand keep it enshrined in the heart.
lines.transliteration: jis Dhur bh aag hovai mukh  mast ak tin jan lai hird ai raakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਜਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they intuitively taste the sublime, exquisite andambrosial sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har amrit kathaa saraysat oot am gur bachnee sehjay chaakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Divine Light shines in their hearts, and like the sun which removes the darknessof night, it dispels the darkness of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: tah bh a-i-aa pargaas miti-aa anDh i-aaraa ji-o sooraj rain  kiraakh ee.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, they behold with their eyes the Unseen, Imperceptible, Unknowable,Immaculate Lord. ||12|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (87-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl: pMnw 88
lines.transliteration: adisat agochar alakh  niranjan so d aykhi-aa gurmukh  aakh ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੋ ਿਸਰੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve their True Guru are certified and accepted.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay aapn aa so sir laykh ai laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ਕੈ ਰਹਿਨ  ਸਿਚ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They eradicate selfishness and conceit from within; they remain lovingly absorbed inthe True One.
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap gavaa-ay kai rahan sach liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru waste away their lives in vain.
lines.transliteration: satgur jinee na sayvi-o t inaa birthaa janam gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord does just as He pleases. No one has any say in this. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (88-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bh aavai so karay kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: With the mind encircled by wickedness and evil, people do evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: man vaykaaree vayrhi-aa vaykaaraa karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ  ਵੇਿੜਆ  ਵੇਕਾਰਾ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The ignorant worship the love of duality; in the Lord's Court they shall be punished.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay agi-aanee poojd ay dargeh milai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਪੂਜਦੇ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: So worship the Lord, the Light of the soul; without the True Guru, understanding isnot obtained.
lines.transliteration: aatam d ay-o poojee-ai bin sat gur boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditation, penance and austere self-discipline are found by surrendering to the TrueGuru's Will. By His Grace this is received.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam bh aanaa sat guroo kaa karmee palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਭਾਣਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਾ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, serve with this intuitive awareness; only that which is pleasing to the Lord is approved. ||2|| pauVI ] (88-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sayvaa surat kamaavn ee jo har bh aavai so thaa-ay paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; it will bring you eternal peace, day and night.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mayray jit sad aa sukh  hovai d in raat ee.

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; meditating on it, all sins andmisdeeds shall be erased.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mayray jit simrat  sabh  kilvikh  paap lahaat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਜਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; through it, all poverty, pain and hunger shall be removed.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mayray jit d aalad  dukh bhukh sabh  leh jaat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਪਾਪ ਲਹਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; as Gurmukh, declare your love.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mayray mukh gurmukh  pareet  lagaat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਜਤੁ  ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead by the True Lord, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13|| slok mÚ 3 ] (88-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jit mukh  bhaag likh i-aa Dh ur saachai har t it mukh  naam japaat ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੁਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad
lines.transliteration: satgur jinee na sayvi-o sabad  na keet o veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਭਾਗੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਤੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤੀ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: antar gi-aan na aa-i-o mirt ak hai sansaar. -spiritual wisdom does not enter into their hearts; they are like dead bodies in theworld.

lines.english: They go through the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations, and they are ruined throughdeath and rebirth.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh fayr pa-i-aa mar jammai ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੀਚਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone serves the True Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa so karay jis no aap karaa-ay so-ay.

lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam is within the True Guru; by His Grace, it is obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur vich naam niDh aan hai karam paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ  ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who are truly attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad-their love is foreverTrue.
lines.transliteration: sach ratay gur sabad  si-o t in sachee sad aa liv ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are united with Him shall not be separated again. They mergeimperceptibly into God. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (88-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no maylay na vichhurh ai sahj samaavai so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One who knows the Benevolent Lord God is the true devotee of Bhagaautee.
lines.transliteration: so bhag-ut ee jo bh agvant ai jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਿਸਉ ਿਤਨ  ਸਚੀ ਸਦਾ ਿਲਵ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he is self-realized.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aap pachhaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜੈ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ai ikat  ghar aan ai. He restrains his wandering mind, and brings it back to its own home within the self.
He remains dead while yet alive, and he chants the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai har naam vakh aanai.

lines.english: Such a Bhagaautee is most exalted.
lines.transliteration: aisaa bhag-ut ee utam ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, he merges into the True One. ||2|| mÚ 3 ] (88-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach samaavai so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He is full of deceit, and yet he calls himself a devotee of Bhagaautee.
lines.transliteration: antar kapat bh ag-utee kahaa-ay.

lines.english: Through hypocrisy, he shall never attain the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: pakhand paarbarahm kad ay na paa-ay.

lines.english: He slanders others, and pollutes himself with his own filth.
lines.transliteration: par nindaa karay ant ar mal laa-ay.

lines.english: Outwardly, he washes off the filth, but the impurity of his mind does not go away.
lines.transliteration: baahar mal Dhovai man kee jooth  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: He argues with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  si-o baad  rachaa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, he suffers, engrossed in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: an-din d ukhee-aa d oojai bh aa-ay rachaa-ay.

lines.english: He does not remember the Name of the Lord, but still, he performs all sorts of empty rituals.
lines.transliteration: har naam na chaytai baho karam kamaa-ay.

lines.english: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa so maytn aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||3|| pauVI ] (88-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satgur sayvay mokh  na paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Those who meditate on the True Guru shall not be burnt to ashes.
lines.transliteration: satgur jinee Dh i-aa-i-aa say karh  na savaahee.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the True Guru are satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: satgur jinee Dh i-aa-i-aa say t aripat  aghaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the True Guru are not afraid of the Messenger of Death. pMnw 89
lines.transliteration: satgur jinee Dh i-aa-i-aa t in jam dar naahee.

lines.english: Those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, fall at the Feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o ho-aa kirpaal har say satgur pairee paahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਆ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, their faces are radiant; they go to the Lord's Court in robes of honor. ||14|| slok mÚ 2 ] (89-2) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin aithai othai mukh  ujlay har d argeh paiDh ay jaahee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Chop off that head which does not bow to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo sir saaN-ee naa nivai so sir deejai daar.

lines.english: O Nanak, that human body, in which there is no pain of separation from the Lord-takethat body and burn it. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (89-3) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis pinjar meh birhaa nahee so pinjar lai jaar. ||1||

lines.english: Forgetting the Primal Lord, O Nanak, people are born and die, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: mundhhu bh ulee naankaa fir fir janam mu-ee-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਪੰਜਰ  ਮਿਹ ਿਬਰਹਾ  ਨਹੀ ਸੋ ਿਪੰਜਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mistaking it for musk, they have fallen into the stinking pit of filth. ||2|| pauVI ] (89-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kastooree kai bh olrhai gund ay dumm pa-ee-aas. ||2||

lines.english: Meditate on that Name of the Lord, O my mind, whose Command rules over all.
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai man mayray jo sabh naa upar hukam chalaa-ay.

lines.english: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which will save you at the very last moment.
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har naam japee-ai man mayray jo antee a-osar la-ay chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਸਤੂਰੀ  ਕੈ ਭੋਲੜੈ  ਗੰਦੇ ਡੁੰਿਮ ਪਈਆਸੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which shall drive out all hunger and desirefrom your mind.
