lines.transliteration: so aisaa har naam japee-ai man mayray jo man kee tarisnaa sabh  bhukh gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Very fortunate and blessed is that Gurmukh who chants the Naam; it shall bring allslanderers and wicked enemies to fall at his feet.
lines.transliteration: so gurmukh naam japi-aa vadbh aagee t in nind ak dusat sabh  pairee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਭਨਾ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Greatest Name of all, before which allcome and bow. ||15|| slok mÚ 3 ] (89-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araaDh sabh naa tay vadaa sabh  naavai agai aan  nivaa-ay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ  ਅਉਸਿਰ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: She may wear good clothes, but the bride is ugly and rude; her mind is false andimpure.
lines.transliteration: vays karay kuroop kulkhan ee man kh otai koorh i-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: She does not walk in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord. Instead, shefoolishly gives Him orders.
lines.transliteration: pir kai bhaan ai naa chalai hukam karay gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਸਿਭ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: But she who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall be spared all pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai jo chalai sabh  dukh nivaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਿਭ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਗੈ ਆਿਣ  ਿਨਵਾਏ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: That destiny which was pre-ordained by the Creator cannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa mayt na sakee-ai jo Dh ur likh i-aa kart aar.

lines.english: She must dedicate her mind and body to her Husband Lord, and enshrine love for theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man tan sa-upay kant  ka-o sabd ay Dh aray pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਕੁਰੂਿਪ  ਕੁਲਖਣੀ  ਮਿਨ ਖੋਟੈ ਕੂਿੜਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without His Name, no one has found Him; see this and reflect upon it in your heart.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai kinai na paa-i-aa daykh hu rid ai beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she is beautiful and graceful; the Creator Lord ravishes and enjoys her. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (89-12) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saa su-aali-o sulakh-n ee je raavee sirjanhaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਭ ਦੁਖ ਿਨਵਾਰਣਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Attachment to Maya is an ocean of darkness; neither this shore nor the one beyondcan be seen.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh gubaar hai tis d aa na d isai urvaar na paar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਿਖਆ ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ  ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs suffer in terrible pain; they forget the Lord'sName and drown.
lines.transliteration: manmukh agi-aanee mahaa d ukh paa-id ay dubay har naam visaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ  ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੇ  ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They arise in the morning and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are caught in thelove of duality.
lines.transliteration: bhalkay uth  baho karam kamaaveh d oojai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh aapn aa bh a-ojal ut ray paar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts; they are absorbed into the True One. ||2|| pauVI ] (89-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sach samaaveh sach naam ur Dh aar. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord pervades and permeates the water, the land and the sky; there is no otherat all.
lines.transliteration: har jal thal mahee-al bharpoor d oojaa naahi ko-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself sits upon His Throne and administers justice. He beats and drivesout the false-hearted.
lines.transliteration: har aap bahi karay ni-aa-o koorhi-aar sabh  maar kadh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਨ ਿਦਸੈ ਉਰਵਾਰ ੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord bestows glorious greatness upon those who are truthful. He administersrighteous justice.
lines.transliteration: sachi-aaraa day-ay vadi-aa-ee har Dh aram ni-aa-o kee-o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ  ਡੁਬੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: So praise the Lord, everybody; He protects the poor and the lost souls.
lines.transliteration: sabh har kee karahu ust at jin gareeb anaath raakh  lee-o-i.

lines.punjabi: ਭਲਕੇ  ਉਿਠ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He honors the righteous and punishes the sinners. ||16|| slok mÚ 3 ] (89-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaikaar kee-o dharmee-aa kaa paapee ka-o dand d ee-o-i. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਉਤਰੇ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh, the foolish bride, is a filthy, rude and evil wife.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mailee kaamn ee kulkh anee kunaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Forsaking her Husband Lord and leaving her own home, she gives her love to another.
lines.transliteration: pir chhodi-aa gh ar aapn aa par purkh ai naal pi-aar.

lines.english: Her desires are never satisfied, and she burns and cries out in pain.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa kad ay na chuk-ee jald ee karay pookaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, she is ugly and ungraceful. She is abandoned and left behind by her Husband Lord. ||1|| pMnw 90 mÚ 3 ] (90-1) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai kuroop kusohanee parhar chh odee bh ataar. ||1||

lines.english: The happy soul-bride is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; she is in love with theTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ee sohaagan ee sat gur kai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: She continually enjoys and ravishes her Beloved, with true love and affection.
lines.transliteration: sadaa raavay pir aapn aa sachai paraym pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: She is such a loveable, beautiful and noble woman.
lines.transliteration: at su-aali-o sund ree sobh aavant ee naar.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the happy soul-bride unites with the Lord of Union. ||2|| pauVI ] (90-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam sohaaganee maylee maylan haar. ||2||

lines.english: Lord, everyone sings Your Praises. You have freed us from bondage.
lines.transliteration: har tayree sabh  karahi ust at jin faathay kaadh i-aa.

lines.english: Lord, everyone bows in reverence to You. You have saved us from our sinful ways.
lines.transliteration: har tuDh no karahi sabh  namaskaar jin paapai t ay raakh i-aa.

lines.english: Lord, You are the Honor of the dishonored. Lord, You are the Strongest of the strong.
lines.transliteration: har nimaani-aa t ooN maan  har daadh ee hooN tooN daadh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਿਹ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਫਾਥੇ ਕਾਿਢਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord beats down the egocentrics and corrects the foolish, self-willed manmukhs.
lines.transliteration: har ahaNkaaree-aa maar nivaa-ay manmukh moorh  saaDh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਕਰਿਹ ਸਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਾਪੈ ਤੇ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord bestows glorious greatness on His devotees, the poor, and the lost souls. ||17|| slok mÚ 3 ] (90-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa day-ay vadi-aa-ee gareeb anaathi-aa. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਮਾਿਣਆ  ਤੂੰ ਮਾਣੁ ਹਿਰ ਡਾਢੀ  ਹੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਡਾਿਢਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, obtains the greatest glory.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai jo chalai t is vadi-aa-ee vadee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਨਵਾਏ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂੜ ਸਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Exalted Name of the Lord abides in his mind, and no one can take it away.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam utam man vasai mayt na sakai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਦੇਇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗਰੀਬ  ਅਨਾਿਥਆ  ॥
lines.english: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Grace, receives His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay jis aapnee t is karam paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, creativity is under the control of the Creator; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this! ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (90-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaran kart ay vas hai gurmukh  boojh ai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, those who worship and adore the Lord's Name night and day, vibrate theString of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: naanak har naam jinee aaraaDhi-aa an-d in har liv t aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਵਡੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Maya, the maid-servant of our Lord and Master, serves them.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa bandee kh asam kee t in agai kamaavai kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect One has made them perfect; by the Hukam of His Command, they areembellished.
lines.transliteration: poorai pooraa kar chhodi-aa hukam savaaran haar.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they understand Him, and they find the gate of salvation.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jin bujhi-aa t in paa-i-aa mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕਰਤੇ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Lord's Command; they are beaten downby the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: manmukh hukam na jaan nee tin maaray jam jand aar.

lines.english: But the Gurmukhs, who worship and adore the Lord, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinee araaDh i-aa tinee t ari-aa bh a-ojal sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.english: All their demerits are erased, and replaced with merits. The Guru Himself is their Forgiver. ||2|| pauVI ] (90-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sabh a-ugan  gunee mitaa-i-aa gur aapay bakh sanhaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਬੰਦੀ ਖਸਮ  ਕੀ ਿਤਨ  ਅਗੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's devotees have faith in Him. The Lord knows everything.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagt aa part eet har sabh  kichh  jaand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: No one is as great a Knower as the Lord; the Lord administers righteous justice.
lines.transliteration: har jayvad naahee ko-ee jaan har Dh aram beechaard aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਬੁਿਝਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Why should we feel any burning anxiety, since the Lord does not punish without justcause?
lines.transliteration: kaarhaa and aysaa ki-o keejai jaa naahee aDh ram maard aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਿਤਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: True is the Master, and True is His Justice; only the sinners are defeated.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sach ni-aa-o paapee nar haardaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O devotees, praise the Lord with your palms pressed together; the Lord saves Hishumble devotees. ||18|| slok mÚ 3 ] (90-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saalaahihu bhagt ahu kar jorh  har bh agat jan taardaa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਅਉਗਣ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਮਟਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Oh, if only I could meet my Beloved, and keep Him enshrined deep within my heart!
lines.transliteration: aapnay pareet am mil rahaa ant ar rakh aa ur Dh aar.

lines.english: I praise that God forever and ever, through love and affection for the Guru.
lines.transliteration: saalaahee so parabh sad aa sad aa gur kai hayt  pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ  ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that one upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace is united with Him; such a person is the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (90-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis nadar karay t is mayl la-ay saa-ee suhaagan  naar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਧਰਮੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, the Lord is obtained, when He bestows His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay har paa-ee-ai jaa ka-o nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾੜਾ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਧਰਿਮ ਮਾਰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: They are transformed from humans into angels, meditating on the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: maanas t ay dayvtay bh a-ay Dh i-aa-i-aa naam haray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਿਨਆਉ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਨਰੁ ਹਾਰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: They conquer their egotism and merge with the Lord; they are saved through theWord of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar milaa-i-an gur kai sabad t aray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲਾਿਹਹੁਭਗਤਹੁ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਤਾਰਦਾ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they merge imperceptibly into the Lord, who has bestowed His Favor uponthem. ||2|| pauVI ] (90-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sahj samaa-i-an har aapnee kirpaa karay. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord Himself inspires us to worship Him; He reveals His Glorious Greatness.
lines.transliteration: har aapnee bh agat karaa-ay vadi-aa-ee vaykh aali-an.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹਾ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਖਾ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself inspires us to place our faith in Him. Thus He performs His Own Service. pMnw 91
lines.transliteration: aapnee aap karay part eet aapay sayv gh aalee-an.

lines.english: The Lord bestows bliss upon His devotees, and gives them a seat in the eternal home.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa no d ay-ay anand thir gh aree bahaali-an.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਿਥਰ ੁ ਘਰੀ  ਬਹਾਿਲਅਨ ੁ ॥
lines.english: He does not give the sinners any stability or place of rest; He consigns them to the depths of hell.
lines.transliteration: paapee-aa no na day-ee thir rahan  chun  narak gh or chaali-an.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੀਆ  ਨੋ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਿਥਰੁ ਰਹਿਣ  ਚੁਿਣ  ਨਰਕ  ਘੋਿਰ  ਚਾਿਲਅਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord blesses His devotees with His Love; He sides with them and saves them.||19|| slok mÚ 1 ] (91-3) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa no d ay-ay pi-aar kar ang nist aari-an. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਅੰਗੁ  ਿਨਸਤਾਿਰਅਨ ੁ ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: False-mindedness is the drummer-woman; cruelty is the butcheress; slander of othersin one's heart is the cleaning-woman, and deceitful anger is the outcast-woman.
lines.transliteration: kubuDh doomn ee kud -i-aa kasaa-in  par nind aa gh at choohrh ee muth ee kroDh chandaal.

lines.english: What good are the ceremonial lines drawn around your kitchen, when these four areseated there with you?
lines.transliteration: kaaree kadhee ki-aa thee-ai jaaN chaaray baith ee-aa naal.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਬੁਿਧ  ਡੂਮਣੀ  ਕੁਦਇਆ  ਕਸਾਇਿਣ  ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਘਟ ਚੂਹੜੀ  ਮੁਠੀ ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਚੰਡਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Make Truth your self-discipline, and make good deeds the lines you draw; makechanting the Name your cleansing bath.
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam karnee kaaraaN naavan  naa-o japayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰੀ  ਕਢੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਥੀਐ  ਜ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੈਠੀਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who do not walk in the ways of sin, shall be exalted in the world hereafter. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (91-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak agai ootam say-ee je paapaaN pand  na dayhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਾਰ  ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਨਾਉ  ਜਪੇਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Which is the swan, and which is the crane? It is only by His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa hans ki-aa bagulaa jaa ka-o nadar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਊਤਮ  ਸੇਈ ਿਜ ਪਾਪ  ਪੰਿਦ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever is pleasing to Him, O Nanak, is transformed from a crow into a swan. ||2|| pauVI ] (91-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai naankaa kaagahu hans karay-i. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever work you wish to accomplish-tell it to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: keetaa lorh ee-ai kamm so har peh aakh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹੰਸੁ ਿਕਆ  ਬਗੁਲਾ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: He will resolve your affairs; the True Guru gives His Guarantee of Truth.
lines.transliteration: kaaraj day-ay savaar sat gur sach saakh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, you shall taste the treasure of the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: santaa sang niDh aan amrit  chaakh ee-ai.

lines.english: The Lord is the Merciful Destroyer of fear; He preserves and protects His slaves.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh anjan miharvaan d aas kee raakh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਲੋੜੀਐ  ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਆਖੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and see the Unseen Lord God. ||20|| slok mÚ 3 ] (91-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har gun gaa-ay alakh  parabh  laakh ee-ai. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Body and soul, all belong to Him. He gives His Support to all.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is kaa sabh sai day-ay aDh aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, become Gurmukh and serve Him, who is forever and ever the Giver.
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sayvee-ai sad aa sad aa daataar.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin ka-o jin Dh i-aa-i-aa har nirankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਾਖੀਐ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Their faces are forever radiant, and the whole world bows in reverence to them. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (91-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: onaa kay mukh sad  ujlay onaa no sabh  jagat  karay namaskaar. ||1||

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, I am totally transformed; I have obtained the nine treasuresto use and consume.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai ultee bh a-ee nav niDh  kharchi-o kh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ  ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Siddhis-the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers-follow in my footsteps; I dwellin my own home, within my own self.
lines.transliteration: athaarah siDh ee pichh ai lagee-aa firan nij gh ar vasai nij thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody constantly vibrates within; my mind is exalted and uplifted-I am lovingly absorbed in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: anhad Dh unee sad  vajday unman har liv laa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, devotion to the Lord abides within the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads. ||2|| pauVI ] (91-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhagat  tinaa kai man vasai jin mast ak likh i-aa Dh ur paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ  ਓਨਾ  ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਕਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a minstrel of the Lord God, my Lord and Master; I have come to the Lord's Door.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhaadh ee har parabh  khasam kaa har kai d ar aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord has heard my sad cries from within; He has called me, His minstrel, into HisPresence.
lines.transliteration: har andar sun ee pookaar dh aadhee mukh  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਉਲਟੀ  ਭਈ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਖਰਿਚਉ  ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The Lord called His minstrel in, and asked, "Why have you come here?"
lines.transliteration: har puchhi-aa dh aadhee sad  kai kit  arath t ooN aa-i-aa.

lines.english: "O Merciful God, please grant me the gift of continual meditation on the Lord's Name." hir dwqY hir nwmu jpwieAw nwnku pYnwieAw ]21]1] suDu (91-15, isrIrwgu, mÚ 3) har daat ai har naam japaa-i-aa naanak painaa-i-aa. ||21||1|| suDh u And so the Lord, the Great Giver, inspired Nanak to chant the Lord's Name, andblessed him with robes of honor. ||21||1||Sudh|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (91-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: isrIrwgu kbIr jIau kw ] eyku suAwnu kY Gir gwvxw (91-18) sireeraag kabeer jee-o kaa. ayk su-aan kai ghar gaavn aa Siree Raag, Kabeer Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Ayk Su-Aan" :
lines.transliteration: nit dayvhu d aan d a-i-aal parabh  har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਨੀ ਸਦ ਵਜਦੇ  ਉਨਮਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The mother thinks that her son is growing up; she does not understand that, day by day, his life is diminishing.
lines.transliteration: kbIr jI) jannee jaanat sut  badaa hot  hai it naa ko na jaanai je d in din avaDh  ghatat hai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਤਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਜਨ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Calling him, "Mine, mine", she fondles him lovingly, while the Messenger of Death looks on and laughs. ||1|| pMnw 92
lines.transliteration: mor mor kar aDhik laad Dh ar paykh at hee jamraa-o hasai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਡੁ ਧਿਰ ਪੇਖਤ  ਹੀ ਜਮਰਾਉ  ਹਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have misled the world so deeply in doubt.
lines.transliteration: aisaa taiN jag bh aram laa-i-aa.

lines.english: How can people understand You, when they are entranced by Maya? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaisay boojhai jab mohi-aa hai maa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੈਸੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਬ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, give up the pleasures of corruption, or else you will surely die of them.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer chh od bikh i-aa ras it  sangat  nihcha-o marn aa.

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, O mortal being, through the Word of His Bani; you shall be blessed with eternal life. In this way, shall you cross over the terrifying world-ocean.||2||
lines.transliteration: jI) rama-ee-aa japahu paraanee anat  jeevan  banee in biDh  bhav saagar t arnaa. ||2||

lines.english: As it pleases Him, people embrace love for the Lord,
lines.transliteration: jaaN tis bh aavai t aa laagai bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਛੋਿਡ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਰਸ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਨਹਚਉ  ਮਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaavaa vichahu jaa-ay. and doubt and delusion are dispelled from within.

lines.punjabi: ਰਮਈਆ  ਜਪਹੁਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਅਨਤ ਜੀਵਣ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Intuitive peace and poise well up within, and the intellect is awakened to spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: upjai sahj gi-aan mat jaagai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the inner being is touched by the Lord's Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ant ar liv laagai. ||3||

lines.english: In this association, there is no death.
lines.transliteration: it sangat  naahee marn aa.

lines.english: Recognizing the Hukam of His Command, you shall meet with your Lord and Master.||1||Second Pause|| isrIrwgu iqRlocn kw ] (92-5) sireeraag tarilochan kaa. Siree Raag, Trilochan:
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan  taa kh asmai miln aa. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa.

lines.english: The mind is totally attached to Maya; the mortal has forgotten his fear of old age anddeath.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh man aaglarhaa paraan ee jaraa maran  bha-o visar ga-i-aa.

lines.english: Gazing upon his family, he blossoms forth like the lotus flower; the deceitful personwatches and covets the homes of others. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kutamb daykh  bigsahi kamlaa ji-o par gh ar joheh kapat naraa. ||1||

lines.english: When the powerful Messenger of Death comes, no one can stand against hisawesome power.
lines.transliteration: doorh aa aa-i-ohi jameh t anaa. tin aaglarh ai mai rahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Rare, very rare, is that friend who comes and says,
lines.transliteration: ko-ee ko-ee saajan aa-ay kahai.

lines.english: "O my Beloved, take me into Your Embrace! O my Lord, please save me!"||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: iqRlocn) mil mayray beethulaa lai baahrh ee valaa-ay. mil mayray rama-ee-aa mai layhi chhadaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਆਗਲੜਾ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ  ਭਉ ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Indulging in all sorts of princely pleasures, O mortal, you have forgotten God; you have fallen into the world-ocean, and you think that you have become immortal.
lines.transliteration: anik anik bhog raaj bisray paraan ee sansaar saagar pai amar bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਿਬਗਸਿਹ  ਕਮਲਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਪਰ ਘਿਰ  ਜੋਹਿਹ ਕਪਟ  ਨਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Cheated and plundered by Maya, you do not think of God, and you waste your life inlaziness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moothaa chayt as naahee janam gavaa-i-o aalsee-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The path you must walk is treacherous and terrifying, O mortal; neither the sun northe moon shine there.
lines.transliteration: bikham gh or panth chaaln aa paraan ee rav sas t ah na parvaysaN.

lines.english: Your emotional attachment to Maya will be forgotten, when you have to leave thisworld. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh tab bisar ga-i-aa jaaN tajee-alay saNsaaraN. ||3||

lines.english: Today, it became clear to my mind that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is watchingus.
lines.transliteration: aaj mayrai man pargat bha-i-aa hai paykh ee-alay Dh aramraa-o.

lines.english: His messengers, with their awesome power, crush people between their hands; Icannot stand against them. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tah kar d al karan mahaabalee t in aaglarh ai mai rahan  na jaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: If someone is going to teach me something, let it be that the Lord is pervading the forests and fields.
lines.transliteration: jay ko mooN updays karat  hai taa van  tarin rat-rhaa naaraa-in aa.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, You Yourself know everything; so prays Trilochan, Lord. ||5||2|| sRIrwgu Bgq kbIr jIau kw ] (92-14) sareeraag bhagat  kabeer jee-o kaa. Siree Raag, Devotee Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: ai jee tooN aapay sabh  kichh  jaand aa bad at tarilochan raam-ee-aa. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭੋਗ ਰਾਜ ਿਬਸਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਪੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O religious scholar: the One Lord alone is Wondrous; no one can describe Him.
lines.transliteration: achraj ayk sunhu ray pandee-aa ab kichh kahan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੂਠਾ ਚੇਤਿਸ  ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਓ  ਆਲਸੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He fascinates the angels, the celestial singers and the heavenly musicians; he hasstrung the three worlds upon His Thread. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sur nar gan ganDh arab jin mohay t aribhavan maykh ulee laa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖਮ  ਘੋਰ ਪੰਿਥ ਚਾਲਣਾ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਰਿਵ ਸਿਸ ਤਹ ਨ ਪਰ੍ਵੇਸੰ  ॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody of the Sovereign Lord's Harp vibrates;
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam anhad kinguree baajai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਬ ਿਬਸਿਰ  ਗਇਆ  ਜ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ  ਸੰਸਾਰੰ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee disat naad  liv laagai. ||1|| rahaa-o. by His Glance of Grace, we are lovingly attuned to the Sound-current of the Naad.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੁ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ  ਹੈ ਪੇਖੀਅਲੇ  ਧਰਮਰਾਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Tenth Gate of my crown chakra is the distilling fire, and the channels of the Idaand Pingala are the funnels, to pour in and empty out the golden vat.
lines.transliteration: bhaath ee gagan siny i-aa ar chuny i-aa kanak kalas ik paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਕਰ ਦਲ ਕਰਿਨ  ਮਹਾਬਲੀ  ਿਤਨ ਆਗਲੜੈ  ਮੈ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Into that vat, there trickles a gentle stream of the most sublime and pure essence ofall distilled essences. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tis meh Dh aar chu-ai at  nirmal ras meh rasan chu-aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂੰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਕਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਤਾ ਵਿਣ ਿਤਰ੍ਿਣ  ਰਤੜਾ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Something wonderful has happened-the breath has become the cup.
lines.transliteration: ayk jo baat anoop banee hai pavan pi-aalaa saaji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਬਦਿਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨੁ ਰਾਮਈਆ  ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: In all the three worlds, such a Yogi is unique. What king can compare to him? ||3||
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan meh ayko jogee kahhu kavan hai raajaa. ||3||

lines.english: This spiritual wisdom of God, the Supreme Soul, has illuminated my being. Says Kabeer, I am attuned to His Love.
lines.transliteration: aisay gi-aan pargati-aa purkhot am kaho kabeer rang raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਚਰਜ  ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ  ਅਬ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: All the rest of the world is deluded by doubt, while my mind is intoxicated with theSublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||3|| pMnw 93 sRIrwg bwxI Bgq byxI jIau kI ] (93-1) sareeraag banee bh agat bayn ee jee-o kee. Sree Raag, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee:
lines.transliteration: a-or dunee sabh  bharam bh ulaanee man raam rasaa-in maat aa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀਰਾਗ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਬੇਣੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Pehray": <> siqgur pRswid ] (93-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: pehri-aa kai ghar gaavn aa.

lines.english: O man, when you were coiled in the cradle of the womb, upside-down, you were absorbed in meditation.
lines.transliteration: ray nar garabh kundal jab aachh at uraDh  Dhi-aan liv laagaa.

lines.english: You took no pride in your perishable body; night and day were all the same to you- you lived unknowing, in the silence of the void.
lines.transliteration: mirtak pind pad  mad naa ahinis ayk agi-aan so naagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਭ  ਕੁੰਡਲ  ਜਬ ਆਛਤ  ਉਰਧ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remember the terrible pain and suffering of those days, now that you have spreadout the net of your consciousness far and wide.
lines.transliteration: tay din sammal kasat mahaa d ukh ab chit  aDhik pasaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰਤਕ  ਿਪੰਿਡ  ਪਦ ਮਦ ਨਾ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਏਕੁ ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਸੁ ਨਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Leaving the womb, you entered this mortal world; you have forgotten the Lord fromyour mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garabh chh od mit ar mandal aa-i-aa t a-o narhar manhu bisaari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਿਦਨ  ਸੰਮਲੁ  ਕਸਟ  ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਅਬ ਿਚਤੁ  ਅਿਧਕ  ਪਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Later, you will regret and repent-you fool! Why are you engrossed in evil-mindednessand skepticism?
lines.transliteration: fir pachhut aavhigaa moorh i-aa tooN kavan kumat  bharam laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਛੋਿਡ ਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਆਇਆ  ਤਉ ਨਰਹਿਰ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਬਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Think of the Lord, or else you shall be led to the City of Death. Why are youwandering around, out of control? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chayt raam naahee jam pur jaahigaa jan bichrai anraaDh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵਿਹਗਾ  ਮੂਿੜਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਵਨ  ਕੁਮਿਤ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: You play like a child, craving sweets; moment by moment, you become moreentangled in emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: baal binod chind  ras laagaa kh in khin mohi bi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਜਾਿਹਗਾ  ਜਨੁ ਿਬਚਰੈ  ਅਨਰਾਧਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tasting good and bad, you eat nectar and then poison, and then the five passionsappear and torture you.
lines.transliteration: ras mis mayDh amrit  bikh chaakh ee ta-o panch pargat sant aapai.

lines.english: Abandoning meditation, penance and self-restraint, and the wisdom of good actions,you do not worship and adore the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam chh od sukarit  mat raam naam na araaDh i-aa.

lines.english: You are overflowing with sexual desire, and your intellect is stained with darkness; you are held in the grip of Shakti's power. ||2||
lines.transliteration: uchhli-aa kaam kaal mat  laagee t a-o aan sakat  gal baaNDhi-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸੁ ਿਮਸੁ ਮੇਧੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਬਖੁ ਚਾਖੀ  ਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਸੰਤਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: In the heat of youthful passion, you look with desire upon the faces of other men'swives; you do not distinguish between good and evil.
lines.transliteration: tarun tayj par t ari-a mukh  joheh sar apsar na pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤ  ਮਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: Drunk with sexual desire and other great sins, you go astray, and do not distinguishbetween vice and virtue.
lines.transliteration: unmat kaam mahaa bikh  bhoolai paap punn na pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਛਿਲਆ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਲ  ਮਿਤ ਲਾਗੀ  ਤਉ ਆਿਨ  ਸਕਿਤ  ਗਿਲ  ਬਿਧਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Gazing upon your children and your property, your mind is proud and arrogant; you cast out the Lord from your heart.
lines.transliteration: sut sampat  daykh ih man garbi-aa raam rid ai tay kh o-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰੁਣ ਤੇਜੁ ਪਰ ਿਤਰ੍ਅ  ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਿਹ  ਸਰੁਅਪਸਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: When others die, you measure your own wealth in your mind; you waste your life inthe pleasures of the mouth and sexual organs. ||3||
lines.transliteration: avar marat maa-i-aa man t olay t a-o bh ag mukh  janam vigo-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਨਮਤ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Your hair is whiter than the jasmine flower, and your voice has grown feeble, as if itcomes from the seventh underworld.
lines.transliteration: pundar kays kusam tay Dh a-ulay sapat  paataal kee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਦੇਿਖ ਇਹੁਮਨੁ ਗਰਿਬਆ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਖੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Your eyes water, and your intellect and strength have left you; but still, your sexualdesire churns and drives you on.
lines.transliteration: lochan sarmeh buDh bal naath ee taa kaam pavas maaDh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰ  ਮਰਤ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਤਉ ਭਗ ਮੁਿਖ ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਵਗੋਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: And so, your intellect has dried up through corruption, and the lotus flower of yourbody has wilted and withered.
lines.transliteration: taa tay bikh ai bha-ee mat  paavas kaa-i-aa kamal kumlaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਡਰ  ਕੇਸ ਕੁਸਮ  ਤੇ ਧਉਲੇ  ਸਪਤ  ਪਾਤਾਲ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You have forsaken the Bani, the Word of the Immortal Lord, in this mortal world; in the end, you shall regret and repent. ||4||
lines.transliteration: avgat baan  chhod mit ar mandal t a-o paachh ai pachh utaanaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਚਨ  ਸਰ੍ਮਿਹ  ਬੁਿਧ ਬਲ ਨਾਠੀ  ਤਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਸ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the tiny bodies of your children, love has welled up within your heart;you are proud of them, but you do not understand.
lines.transliteration: nikutee dayh d aykh Dhun upjai maan karat  nahee boojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਿਬਖੈ ਭਈ ਮਿਤ ਪਾਵਿਸ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਕੁਮਲਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You long for the dignity of a long life, but your eyes can no longer see anything.
lines.transliteration: laalach karai jeevan pad kaaran lochan kachh oo na soojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਿਤ  ਬਾਿਣ  ਛੋਿਡ ਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਮੰਡਿਲ ਤਉ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Your light has gone out, and the bird of your mind has flown away; you are no longerwelcome in your own home and courtyard.
lines.transliteration: thaakaa tayj udi-aa man pankh ee gh ar aaNgan na sukh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਕੁਟੀ  ਦੇਹ ਦੇਿਖ ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਮਾਨ ਕਰਤ  ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Baynee, listen, O devotee: who has ever attained liberation after such a death?||5|| isrIrwgu ] (93-15) sireeraag. Sree Raag:
lines.transliteration: baynee kahai sunhu ray bh agtahu maran mukat  kin paa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚੁ  ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ  ਲੋਚਨ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: You are me, and I am You-what is the difference between us?
lines.transliteration: tohee mohee mohee t ohee ant ar kaisaa.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਕਾ  ਤੇਜੁ ਉਿਡਆ  ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਘਿਰ  ਆਂਗਿਨ  ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: We are like gold and the bracelet, or water and the waves. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kanak katik jal tarang jaisaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹ ੁ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਮਰਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਿਕਿਨ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: If I did not commit any sins, O Infinite Lord,
lines.transliteration: ja-o pai ham na paap karantaa ahay anant aa.
patit paavan naam kaisay hunt aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. how would You have acquired the name, 'Redeemer of sinners'? ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਤੋਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
lines.english: You are my Master, the Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: tumH jo naa-ik aachh ahu ant arjaamee.

lines.english: The servant is known by his God, and the Lord and Master is known by His servant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh t ay jan jaaneejai jan t ay su-aamee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਹਮ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤਾ  ਅਹੇ ਅਨੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Grant me the wisdom to worship and adore You with my body.
lines.transliteration: sareer aaraaDhai mo ka-o beechaar d ayhoo.

lines.english: O Ravi Daas, one who understands that the Lord is equally in all, is very rare. ||3|| pMnw 94 rwgu mwJ caupdy Gru 1 mhlw 4 (94-1) raag maajh cha-upd ay gh ar 1 mehlaa 4 Raag Maajh, Chau-Padas, First House, Fourth Mehl: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (94-2) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: ravidaas sam d al samjh aavai ko-oo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: har har naam mai har man bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has attained spiritual perfection in the Name of the Lord. How rare are those who follow the Guru's Teachings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam siDh paa-ee ko virlaa gurmat  chalai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਿਧ  ਪਾਈ ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have loaded my pack with the provisions of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mai har har kharach la-i-aa bann palai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਖਰਚੁ  ਲਇਆ  ਬੰਿਨ ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.english: The Companion of my breath of life shall always be with me.
lines.transliteration: mayraa paraan sakh aa-ee sad aa naal chalai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਸਖਾਈ  ਸਦਾ ਨਾਿਲ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me. I have the ImperishableTreasure of the Lord in my lap. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam dirh aa-i-aa har nihchal har Dh an palai jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦੜਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is my Best Friend; He is my Beloved Lord King.
lines.transliteration: har har sajan mayraa pareet am raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If only someone would come and introduce me to Him, the Rejuvenator of my breathof life.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aan milaavai mayray paraan  jeevaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved. My eyes are welling up with tears. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-o reh na sakaa bin daykh ay pareet amaa mai neer vahay veh chalai jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮਾ  ਮੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹੇ ਵਿਹ ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Friend, the True Guru, has been my Best Friend since I was very young.
lines.transliteration: satgur mit ar mayraa baal sakh aa-ee.

lines.english: I cannot survive without seeing Him, O my mother!
lines.transliteration: ha-o reh na sakaa bin daykh ay mayree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, please show Mercy to me, that I may meet the Guru. Servant Nanak gathers the Wealth of the Lord's Name in his lap. ||4||1|| mwJ mhlw 4 ] (94-9) maajh mehlaa 4. Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kirpaa karahu gur maylhu jan naanak har Dhan palai jee-o. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕਰਹ ੁਗੁਰੁਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is my mind, body and breath of life.
lines.transliteration: maDhusood an mayray man t an paraanaa.

lines.english: I do not know any other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o har bin doojaa avar na jaanaa.

lines.english: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly Saint; he might show methe Way to my Beloved Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee sajan sant  milai vadbh aagee mai har parabh  pi-aaraa d asai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched my mind and body, through and through.
lines.transliteration: ha-o man tan kh ojee bh aal bh aalaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਸਜਣੁ  ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਦਸੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can I meet my Darling Beloved, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: ki-o pi-aaraa pareetam milai mayree maa-ee.

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I ask about the Path to God. In that Congregation, the Lord God abides. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  khoj dasaa-ee vich sangat  har parabh  vasai jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: My Darling Beloved True Guru is my Protector.
lines.transliteration: mayraa pi-aaraa pareetam sat gur rakh vaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਖੋਜੁ ਦਸਾਈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a helpless child-please cherish me.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik deen karahu part ipaalaa.

lines.english: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water of the Guru, the lotus of my heart blossoms forth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mayraa maat pit aa gur sat gur pooraa gur jal mil kamal vigsai jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Without seeing my Guru, sleep does not come.
lines.transliteration: mai bin gur daykh ay need  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਗੁਰੁਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁ ਰ ਜਲ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind and body are afflicted with the pain of separation from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: mayray man tan vayd an gur birahu lagaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, show mercy to me, that I may meet my Guru. Meeting the Guru,servant Nanak blossoms forth. ||4||2|| pMnw 95 mwJ mhlw 4 ] (95-1) maajh mehlaa 4. Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har da-i-aa karahu gur maylhu jan naanak gur mil rahsai jee-o. ||4||2||

lines.english: Read of the Lord's Glories and reflect upon the Lord's Glories.
lines.transliteration: har gun parh ee-ai har gun  gunee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਪੜੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Listen continually to the Sermon of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam kathaa nit sun ee-ai.

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall cross over the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  har gun  gaa-ay jag bh a-ojal d utar taree-ai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Come, friends, let us meet our Lord.
lines.transliteration: aa-o sakhee har mayl karayhaa.

lines.english: Bring me a message from my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetam kaa mai d ay-ay sanayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a friend, companion, beloved and brother of mine, who shows me the wayto the Lord, the Lord of all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayraa mitar sakh aa so pareet am bh aa-ee mai d asay har narharee-ai jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਸਖਾ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਭਾਈ  ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My illness is known only to the Lord and the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: mayree baydan har gur pooraa jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot continue living without chanting the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ha-o reh na sakaa bin naam vakhaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: So give me the medicine, the Mantra of the Perfect Guru. Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am saved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mai a-ukhaDh  mant ar deejai gur pooray mai har har naam uDh ree-ai jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਧਰੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am just a poor song-bird, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru,
lines.transliteration: ham chaatrik d een sat gur sarn aa-ee.
har har naam boond mukh  paa-ee. who has placed the Drop of Water, the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in my mouth.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Treasure of Water; I am just a fish in that water. Without this Water, servant Nanak would die. ||4||3|| mwJ mhlw 4 ] (95-6) maajh mehlaa 4. Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jalniDh ham jal kay meenay jan naanak jal bin maree-ai jee-o. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਲਿਨਿਧ  ਹਮ ਜਲ ਕੇ ਮੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O servants of the Lord, O Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny, let us join together!
lines.transliteration: har jan sant milhu mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Show me the way to my Lord God-I am so hungry for Him!
lines.transliteration: mayraa har parabh d ashu mai bh ukh lagaa-ee.

lines.english: Please reward my faith, O Life of the World, O Great Giver. Obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayree sarDhaa poor jagjeevan d aatay mil har d arsan man bh eejai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਸਹੁ ਮੈ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I chant the Bani of the Lord's Word.
lines.transliteration: mil satsang bolee har ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਿਮਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa mayrai man bhaan ee.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is so sweet to my mind. Meetingthe True Guru, I drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har amrit har man bh aavai mil sat gur amrit  peejai jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the Lord's Congregation is found,
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har sangat  paavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhaagheen bh aram chotaa kh aaveh. while the unfortunate ones wander around in doubt, enduring painful beatings.

lines.english: Without good fortune, the Sat Sangat is not found; without this Sangat, people are stained with filth and pollution. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa sat sang na labh ai bin sangat  mail bh areejai jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Come and meet me, O Life of the World, my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: mai aa-ay milhu jagjeevan pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਸਤਸੰਗੁ  ਨ ਲਭੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ  ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and enshrine Your Name, Har, Har, within my mind.
lines.transliteration: har har naam da-i-aa man Dh aaray.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Sweet Name has become pleasing to my mind. Servant Nanak's mind is drenched and delighted with the Naam. ||4||4|| mwJ mhlw 4 ] (95-12) maajh mehlaa 4. Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam meeth aa man bh aa-i-aa jan naanak naam man bh eejai jee-o. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, I have obtained the Lord's spiritual wisdom. I have obtained theSublime Essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har gur gi-aan har ras har paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: My mind is imbued with the Love of the Lord; I drink in the Sublime Essence of theLord.
lines.transliteration: man har rang raataa har ras pee-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: With my mouth, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; my mind is filled to overflowing with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har naam mukh har har bolee man har ras tul tul pa-ud aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Come, O Saints, and lead me to my Lord's Embrace.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sant mai gal maylaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Recite to me the Sermon of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetam kee mai kathaa sun aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲੀ  ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਟੁਿਲ ਟੁਿਲ ਪਉਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind to those Saints of the Lord, who chant the Word of the Guru's Bani with their mouths. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kay sant milhu man d ayvaa jo gurbaan ee mukh  cha-ud aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Lord has led me to meet His Saint.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har sant  milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has placed the Sublime Essence of the Lord into my mouth.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har ras mukh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਮਲਹੁਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਮੁਿਖ ਚਉਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The unfortunate ones do not find the True Guru; the self-willed manmukhs continuallyendure reincarnation through the womb. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaagheen sat gur nahee paa-i-aa manmukh  garabh  joonee nit  pa-ud aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: God, the Merciful, has Himself bestowed His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aal d a-i-aa parabh  Dhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He has totally removed the poisonous pollution of egotism.
lines.transliteration: mal ha-umai bikhi-aa sabh  nivaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਗਰਭ  ਜੂਨੀ ਿਨਿਤ  ਪਉਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the shops of the city of the human body, the Gurmukhs buy themerchandise of the Lord's Name. ||4||5|| mwJ mhlw 4 ] (95-18) maajh mehlaa 4. Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hat patan vich kaaN-i-aa har laiNday gurmukh  sa-ud aa jee-o. ||4||5||

lines.english: I meditate on the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o gun govind  har naam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Name comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: mil sangat man naam vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਟ ਪਟਣ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਉਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: The Lord God is our Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Meeting the True Guru, I enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 96
lines.transliteration: har parabh agam agochar su-aamee mil sat gur har ras keechai jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Dhan Dh an har jan jin har parabh  jaataa. Blessed, blessed are the humble servants of the Lord, who know the Lord God.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I go and ask those humble servants about the Mysteries of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay puchhaa jan har kee baat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਪੁਛਾ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I wash and massage their feet; joining with the humble servants of the Lord, I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paav malovaa mal mal Dhovaa mil har jan har ras peechai jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ  ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੋਵਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aatai naam d irhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur d arsan paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Essence is Ambrosial Nectar; through the Ambrosial Words of the Perfect Guru, this Amrit is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit ras sach amrit  bolee gur poorai amrit  leechai jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਬੋਲੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਲੀਚੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, lead me to the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the true beings.
lines.transliteration: har satsangat  sat purakh  milaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, I meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  har naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, I listen and chant the Lord's Sermon; through the Guru's Teachings, I amfulfilled by the Name of the Lord. ||4||6|| mwJ mhlw 4 ] (96-5) maajh mehlaa 4. Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har kathaa sunee mukh  bolee gurmat  har naam pareechai jee-o. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਪਰੀਚੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Come, dear sisters-let us join together.
lines.transliteration: aavhu bhain ay tusee milhu pi-aaree-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the one who tells me of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: jo mayraa pareetam d asay t is kai ha-o vaaree-aa.

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have found the Lord, my Best Friend.I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  laDhaa har sajan  ha-o sat gur vitahu gh umaa-ee-aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਦਸੇ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah tah su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਲਧਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਟਹੁਘੁਮਾਈਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are permeating each and every heart, O Lord, Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.
lines.transliteration: too gh at ghat ravi-aa ant arjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has shown me that the Lord is always with me. I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naal dikh aali-aa ha-o sat gur vitahu sad  vaari-aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: There is only one breath; all are made of the same clay; the light within all is thesame.
lines.transliteration: ayko pavan maatee sabh  aykaa sabh  aykaa jot  sabaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਦਖਾਿਲਆ  ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One Light pervades all the many and various beings. This Light intermingles withthem, but it is not diluted or obscured.
lines.transliteration: sabh ikaa jot  vartai bhin bhin na ral-ee kisai d ee ralaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਪਵਣੁ  ਮਾਟੀ  ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਿਤ ਸਬਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have come to see the One. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ik nadree aa-i-aa ha-o sat gur vitahu vat aa-i-aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਇਕਾ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਵਰਤੈ ਿਭਿਨ  ਿਭਿਨ  ਨ ਰਲਈ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਰਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak speaks the Ambrosial Bani of the Word.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bolai amrit ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਵਤਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: It is dear and pleasing to the minds of the GurSikhs.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaaN kai man pi-aaree bh aanee.

lines.english: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, shares the Teachings. The Guru, the True Guru, isGenerous to all. ||4||7||
lines.transliteration: updays karay gur sat gur pooraa gur sat gur par-upkaaree-aa jee-o. ||4||7||

lines.english: Seven Chau-Padas Of The Fourth Mehl. || mwJ mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 1 ] (96-14) maajh mehlaa 5 cha-upd ay gh ar 1. Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House:
lines.transliteration: sat cha-upd ay mahlay cha-uthay kay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: My mind longs for the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man lochai gur darsan t aa-ee.

lines.english: It cries out like the thirsty song-bird.
lines.transliteration: bilap karay chaatrik kee ni-aa-ee.

lines.english: My thirst is not quenched, and I can find no peace, without the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tarikh aa na ut rai saaNt na aavai bin d arsan sant  pi-aaray jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o gholee jee-o gh ol ghumaa-ee gur d arsan sant  pi-aaray jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your Face is so Beautiful, and the Sound of Your Words imparts intuitive wisdom.
lines.transliteration: tayraa mukh  suhaavaa jee-o sahj Dh un ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਖਾ  ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ  ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is so long since this rainbird has had even a glimpse of water.
lines.transliteration: chir ho-aa daykh ay saaringpaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan so d ays jahaa t ooN vasi-aa mayray sajan  meet  muraaray jee-o. ||2|| Blessed is that land where You dwell, O my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||2||
I am a sacrifice, I am forever a sacrifice, to my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o gholee ha-o gh ol ghumaa-ee gur sajan  meet  muraaray jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: When I could not be with You for just one moment, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga dawnedfor me.
lines.transliteration: ik gharh ee na milt ay taa kalijug hot aa.

lines.english: When will I meet You, O my Beloved Lord? pMnw 97
lines.transliteration: hun kad  milee-ai pari-a t uDh bhagvant aa.

lines.english: I cannot endure the night, and sleep does not come, without the Sight of the Beloved Guru's Court. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mohi rain na vihaavai need  na aavai bin d aykhay gur d arbaaray jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਰੈਿਣ ਨ ਿਵਹਾਵੈ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that True Court of the Beloved Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o gholee jee-o gh ol ghumaa-ee t is sachay gur d arbaaray jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By good fortune, I have met the Saint Guru.
lines.transliteration: bhaag ho-aa gur sant  milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have found the Immortal Lord within the home of my own self.
lines.transliteration: parabh abh inaasee gh ar meh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I will now serve You forever, and I shall never be separated from You, even for aninstant. Servant Nanak is Your slave, O Beloved Master. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sayv karee pal chasaa na vichhurh aa jan naanak d aas tumaaray jee-o. ||4||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice; servant Nanak is Your slave, Lord. ||Pause||1||8|| rwgu mwJ mhlw 5 ] (97-4) raag maajh mehlaa 5. Raag Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o gholee jee-o gh ol ghumaa-ee jan naanak d aas tumaaray jee-o. rahaa-o. ||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Sweet is that season when I remember You.
lines.transliteration: saa rut suhaavee jit  tuDh samaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Sublime is that work which is done for You.
lines.transliteration: so kamm suhaylaa jo tayree gh aalee.

lines.english: Blessed is that heart in which You dwell, O Giver of all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so ridaa suhaylaa jit  ridai tooN vuthaa sabh naa kay d aataaraa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Universal Father of all, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tooN saajh aa saahib baap hamaaraa.

lines.english: Your nine treasures are an inexhaustible storehouse.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh t ayrai akh ut bhandaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਘਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those unto whom You give are satisfied and fulfilled; they become Your devotees, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis tooN deh so t aripat  aghaavai so-ee bh agat tumaaraa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਰਦਾ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਿਰਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All place their hopes in You.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aasai t ayree baith aa.

lines.english: You dwell deep within each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar tooNhai vuth aa.

lines.english: All share in Your Grace; none are beyond You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabhay saajh eevaal sad aa-in t ooN kisai na d iseh baahraa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਵੈ  ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself liberate the Gurmukhs;
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay gurmukh  mukat  karaa-ihi.

lines.english: You Yourself consign the self-willed manmukhs to wander in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay manmukh  janam bh avaa-ihi.

lines.english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You; Your Entire Play is self-evident, Lord. ||4||2||9|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (97-10) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayrai balihaarai sabh  tayraa kh ayl dasaahraa jee-o. ||4||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਸਾਝੀਵਾਲ  ਸਦਾਇਿਨ  ਤੂੰ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਿਦਸਿਹ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody resounds and resonates in peaceful ease.
lines.transliteration: anhad vaajai sahj suhaylaa.

lines.english: I rejoice in the eternal bliss of the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabad anand karay sad  kaylaa.

lines.english: In the cave of intuitive wisdom I sit, absorbed in the silent trance of the Primal Void. I have obtained my seat in the heavens. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sahj gufaa meh taarh ee laa-ee aasan  ooch savaari-aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: After wandering through many other homes and houses, I have returned to my own home,
lines.transliteration: fir ghir apunay garih meh aa-i-aa.
jo lorheed aa so-ee paa-i-aa. and I have found what I was longing for.

lines.english: I am satisfied and fulfilled; O Saints, the Guru has shown me the Fearless Lord God.||2||
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaa-ay rahi-aa hai sant ahu gur anbh a-o purakh  dikhaari-aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is the King, and He Himself is the people.
lines.transliteration: aapay raajan aapay logaa.

lines.english: He Himself is in Nirvaanaa, and He Himself indulges in pleasures.
lines.transliteration: aap nirbaanee aapay bh ogaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਗੁਫਾ ਮਿਹ ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ਆਸਣੁ  ਊਚ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself sits on the throne of true justice, answering the cries and prayers of all.||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay takh at bahai sach ni-aa-ee sabh  chookee kook pukaari-aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: As I have seen Him, so have I described Him.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa dithaa mai t ayho kahi-aa.

lines.english: This Sublime Essence comes only to one who knows the Mystery of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis ras aa-i-aa jin bh ayd lahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਅਨਭਉ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਦਖਾਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: His light merges into the Light, and he finds peace. O servant Nanak, this is all the Extension of the One. ||4||3||10|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (97-15) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milee sukh  paa-i-aa jan naanak ik pasaari-aa jee-o. ||4||3||10||

lines.english: That house, in which the soul-bride has married her Husband Lord
lines.transliteration: jit ghar pir sohaag ban aa-i-aa.
tit ghar sakh ee-ay mangal gaa-i-aa. -in that house, O my companions, sing the songs of rejoicing.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਤਖਿਤ  ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਿਨਆਈ  ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ  ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਿਰਆ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Joy and celebrations decorate that house, in which the Husband Lord has adorned His soul-bride. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anad binod  titai ghar soheh jo Dh an kant  sigaaree jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: She is virtuous, and she is very fortunate;
lines.transliteration: saa gunvant ee saa vadbh aagan .
putarvant ee seelvant  sohagan . she is blessed with sons and tender-hearted. The happy soul-bride is loved by herHusband.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਕੁ ਪਸਾਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
lines.english: She is beautiful, wise, and clever. That soul-bride is the beloved of her Husband Lord.||2||
lines.transliteration: roopvant saa sugh arh bichkh an jo Dh an kant  pi-aaree jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: She is well-mannered, noble and distinguished.
lines.transliteration: achaarvant saa-ee parDh aanay.

lines.english: She is decorated and adorned with wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sabh singaar ban ay tis gi-aanay.

lines.english: She is from a most respected family; she is the queen, adorned with the Love of her Husband Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saa kulvantee saa sabh raa-ee jo pir kai rang savaaree jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਿਤਤੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਜੋ ਧਨ ਕੰਿਤ  ਿਸਗਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Her glory cannot be described;
lines.transliteration: mahimaa tis kee kahan  na jaa-ay.
jo pir mayl la-ee ang laa-ay. she melts in the Embrace of her Husband Lord. pMnw 98

lines.english: Her marriage is eternal; her Husband is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. O Servant Nanak, His Love is her only Support. ||4||4||11|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (98-1) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: thir suhaag var agam agochar jan naanak paraym saaDhaaree jee-o. ||4||4||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ  ਵਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: I have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat darsan chaahay.

lines.english: I travelled through all sorts of woods and forests.
lines.transliteration: bhaat  bhaat ban ban avgaahay.

lines.english: My Lord, Har, Har, is both absolute and related, unmanifest and manifest; is thereanyone who can come and unite me with Him? ||1||
lines.transliteration: nirgun sargun  har har mayraa ko-ee hai jee-o aan  milaavai jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: People recite from memory the wisdom of the six schools of philosophy;
lines.transliteration: khat saasat  bichrat  mukh  gi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਣੁ  ਸਰਗੁਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa tilak t irath isnaanaa. they perform worship services, wear ceremonial religious marks on their foreheads, and take ritual cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.english: They perform the inner cleansing practice with water and adopt the eighty-four Yogicpostures; but still, they find no peace in any of these. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nivlee karam aasan cha-oraaseeh in meh saaNt na aavai jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: They chant and meditate, practicing austere self-discipline for years and years;
lines.transliteration: anik barakh kee-ay jap t aapaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਵਲੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਆਸਨ  ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਇਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gavan kee-aa Dhart ee bh armaat aa. they wander on journeys all over the earth;
ik khin hird ai saaNt na aavai jogee bahurh  bahurh  uth Dhaavai jee-o. ||3|| and yet, their hearts are not at peace, even for an instant. The Yogi rises up and goesout, over and over again. ||3||

lines.english: By His Mercy, I have met the Holy Saint.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi saaDh milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਉਿਠ ਧਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; I have been blessed with patienceand composure.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al Dheeraj paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Immortal Lord God has come to dwell within my heart. Nanak sings the songs ofjoy to the Lord. ||4||5||12|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (98-7) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh abh inaasee basi-aa gh at bheetar har mangal naanak gaavai jee-o. ||4||5||12||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is Infinite and Divine;
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aprampar dayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਬਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Invisible and Inscrutable.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar alakh abh ayvaa.

lines.english: Merciful to the meek, Sustainer of the World, Lord of the Universe-meditating on the Lord, the Gurmukhs find salvation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal gopaal gobind aa har Dh i-aavahu gurmukh  gaatee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are emancipated by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh maDh usood an nist aaray.

lines.english: The Lord Krishna becomes the Gurmukh's Companion.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sangee krisan muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗਾਤੀ  ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh finds the Merciful Lord. He is not found any other way. ||2||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal d amod ar gurmukh  paa-ee-ai horat  kitai na bh aatee jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: He does not need to eat; His Hair is Wondrous and Beautiful; He is free of hate.
lines.transliteration: nirhaaree kaysav nirvairaa.

lines.english: Millions of people worship His Feet.
lines.transliteration: kot janaa jaa kay poojeh pairaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਤੁ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਭਾਤੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone is a devotee, who becomes Gurmukh, whose heart is filled with the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hird ai jaa kai har har so-ee bh agat ikaat ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Forever fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He is Infinite and Incomparable.
lines.transliteration: amogh d arsan bay-ant  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਿਹ  ਪੈਰਾ ॥
lines.english: He is Awesome and All-powerful; He is forever the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: vad samrath sadaa d aataaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ  ਇਕਾਤੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be carried across.O Nanak, rare are those who know this state! ||4||6||13|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (98-13) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam japee-ai t it taree-ai gat  naanak virlee jaat ee jee-o. ||4||6||13||

lines.english: As You command, I obey; as You give, I receive.
lines.transliteration: kahi-aa karnaa d itaa lain aa.

lines.english: You are the Pride of the meek and the poor.
lines.transliteration: gareebaa anaathaa tayraa maan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਗਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਰਲੀ  ਜਾਤੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੬॥੧੩॥
lines.english: You are everything; You are my Beloved. I am a sacrifice to Your Creative Power.||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tooNhai tooNhai mayray pi-aaray t ayree kud rat ka-o bal jaa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: By Your Will, we wander in the wilderness; by Your Will, we find the path.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai ujh arh bhaanai raahaa.

lines.english: By Your Will, we become Gurmukh and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai har gun  gurmukh  gaavaahaa.

lines.english: By Your Will, we wander in doubt through countless lifetimes. Everything happens by Your Will. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai bharam bh avai baho joonee sabh  kichh  tisai rajaa-ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one is foolish, and no one is clever.
lines.transliteration: naa ko moorakh naa ko si-aan aa.

lines.english: Your Will determines everything;
lines.transliteration: vartai sabh  kichh  tayraa bh aanaa.

lines.english: You are Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Infinite and Unfathomable. Your Valuecannot be expressed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar bay-ant athaahaa t ayree keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨੀ ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਤਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please bless me with the dust of the Saints, O my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: khaak sant an kee d ayh pi-aaray.

lines.english: I have come and fallen at Your Door, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay pa-i-aa har tayrai d u-aarai.

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. O Nanak, withnatural ease, I merge into Him. ||4||7||14|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (98-18) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh at man aagh aavai naanak milan  subh aa-ee jee-o. ||4||7||14||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਅਥਾਹਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They forget the Lord, and they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: dukh taday jaa visar jaavai.

lines.english: Afflicted with hunger, they run around in all directions.
lines.transliteration: bhukh  vi-aapai baho biDh  Dhaavai.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, they are happy forever. The Lord, Merciful to the meek, bestows it upon them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: simrat naam sad aa suhaylaa jis d ayvai d een d a-i-aalaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ  ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲਣੁ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
lines.english: My True Guru is absolutely All-powerful. pMnw 99
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa vad samrathaa.

lines.english: When I dwell upon Him in my soul, all my sorrows depart.
lines.transliteration: jee-ay samaalee taa sabh  dukh lathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਇ  ਸਮਾਲੀ  ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: The sickness of anxiety and the disease of ego are cured; He Himself cherishes me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chintaa rog ga-ee ha-o peerh aa aap karay part ipaalaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਈ ਹਉ ਪੀੜਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Like a child, I ask for everything.
lines.transliteration: baarik vaaNgee ha-o sabh kichh  mangaa.

lines.english: God is Bountiful and Beautiful; He never comes up empty.
lines.transliteration: dayday tot naahee parabh  rangaa.

lines.english: Again and again, I fall at His Feet. He is Merciful to the meek, the Sustainer of the World. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pairee pai pai bahut manaa-ee d een d a-i-aal gopaalaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਈ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru,
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur pooray.
jin banDhan kaatay saglay mayray. who has shattered all my bonds.

lines.english: With the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in my heart, I have been purified. O Nanak, HisLove has imbued me with nectar. ||4||8||15|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (99-4) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam d ay nirmal kee-ay naanak rang rasaalaa jee-o. ||4||8||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਕੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਸਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O my Love, Sustainer of the World, Merciful, Loving Lord,
lines.transliteration: laal gopaal da-i-aal rangeelay.

lines.english: Profoundly Deep, Infinite Lord of the Universe,
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer bay-ant  govind ay.

lines.english: Highest of the High, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord and Master: continually remembering You in deep meditation, I live. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ooch athaah bay-ant su-aamee simar simar ha-o jeevaaN jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: O Destroyer of pain, Priceless Treasure,
lines.transliteration: dukh bhanjan niDh aan amolay.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਹਉ ਜੀਵ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Fearless, free of hate, Unfathomable, Immeasurable,
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirvair athaah at olay.

akaal moorat ajoonee sambh ou man simrat  thandhaa theevaaN jee-o. ||2|| of Undying Form, Unborn, Self-illumined: remembering You in meditation, my mind is filled with a deep and profound peace. ||2||

lines.english: The Joyous Lord, the Sustainer of the World, is my constant Companion.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sangee har rang gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭੌ ਮਨ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He cherishes the high and the low.
lines.transliteration: ooch neech karay partipaalaa.

lines.english: The Nectar of the Name satisfies my mind. As Gurmukh, I drink in the AmbrosialNectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam rasaa-in man t ariptaa-in gurmukh  amrit  peevaaN jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: In suffering and in comfort, I meditate on You, O Beloved.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  pi-aaray t uDh Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ  ਮਨੁਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਇਣੁ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਪੀਵ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have obtained this sublime understanding from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ayh sumat guroo t ay paa-ee.

lines.english: You are Nanak's Support, O my Lord and Master; through Your Love, I swim across tothe other side. ||4||9||16|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (99-10) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee Dhar t ooNhai th aakur har rang paar pareevaaN jee-o. ||4||9||16||

lines.english: Dhan so vaylaa jit  mai sat gur mili-aa. Blessed is that time when I meet the True Guru.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੀਵ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan, I have been saved.
lines.transliteration: safal darsan nayt ar paykh at tari-aa.

lines.english: Dhan moorat  chasay pal gh arhee-aa Dh an so o-ay sanjogaa jee-o. ||1|| Blessed are the hours, the minutes and the seconds-blessed is that Union with Him. ||1||
Making the effort, my mind has become pure.
lines.transliteration: udam karat  man nirmal ho-aa.

lines.english: Walking on the Lord's Path, my doubts have all been cast out.
lines.transliteration: har maarag chalat bh aram saglaa kh o-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਮੂਰਤ ਚਸੇ ਪਲ ਘੜੀਆ  ਧੰਿਨ ਸੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru has inspired me to hear the Treasure of the Naam; all my illness hasbeen dispelled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan sat guroo sun aa-i-aa mit ga-ay saglay rogaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: The Word of Your Bani is inside and outside as well.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar t ayree ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ ਚਲਤ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ  ਖੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself chant it, and You Yourself speak it.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aap kathee t ai aap vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ  ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has said that He is One-All is the One. There shall never be any other. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa sabh ayko ayko avar na ko-ee ho-igaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: I drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence from the Guru;
lines.transliteration: amrit ras har gur t ay pee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਿਪ  ਕਥੀ ਤੈ ਆਿਪ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har painan naam bh ojan thee-aa. the Lord's Name has become my clothing and food.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਕਿਹਆ  ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇਗਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Name is my delight, the Name is my play and entertainment. O Nanak, I have made the Name my enjoyment. ||4||10||17|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (99-15) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam rang naam choj tamaasay naa-o naanak keenay bh ogaa jee-o. ||4||10||17||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I beg of all the Saints: please, give me the merchandise.
lines.transliteration: sagal santan peh vasat  ik maaNga-o.

lines.english: I offer my prayers-I have forsaken my pride.
lines.transliteration: kara-o binantee maan t i-aaga-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਿਮ  ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ  ਨਾਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਭੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, hundreds of thousands of times a sacrifice, and I pray: please, giveme the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vaar vaar jaa-ee lakh varee-aa d ayh sant an kee Dh ooraa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: tum d aatay tum purakh  biDhaatay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਤਨ ਪਿਹ ਵਸਤੁ  ਇਕ ਮਗਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are All-powerful, the Giver of Eternal Peace.
lines.transliteration: tum samrath sad aa sukh -daatay.

lines.english: You bless everyone. Please bring my life to fulfillment. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t um hee t ay varsaavai a-osar karahu hamaaraa pooraa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਜਾਈ  ਲਖ ਵਰੀਆ  ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The body-temple is sanctified by the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan,
lines.transliteration: darsan t ayrai bh avan puneet aa.
aatam garh  bikham tinaa hee jeet aa. and thus, the impregnable fort of the soul is conquered.

lines.english: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny. There is no other warrior as great as You. ||3|| pMnw 100
