lines.transliteration: tum d aatay tum purakh  biDhaatay tuDh jayvad avar na sooraa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: I applied the dust of the feet of the Saints to my face.
lines.transliteration: rayn santan kee mayrai mukh  laagee.

lines.english: My evil-mindedness disappeared, along with my misfortune and false-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: durmat  binsee kubuDh  abhaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚ ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਿਸ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਕੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
lines.english: I sit in the true home of my self; I sing His Glorious Praises. O Nanak, my falsehood has vanished! ||4||11||18|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (100-2) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach ghar bais rahay gun  gaa-ay naanak binsay kooraa jee-o. ||4||11||18||

lines.english: I shall never forget You-You are such a Great Giver!
lines.transliteration: visar naahee ayvad daat ay.

lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, and imbue me with the love of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa bhagt an sang raat ay.

lines.english: If it pleases You, let me meditate on You day and night; please, grant me this gift! ||1||
lines.transliteration: dinas rain  ji-o t uDh Dhi-aa-ee ayhu d aan mohi karn aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਜਉ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਏਹੁਦਾਨੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Into this blind clay, You have infused awareness.
lines.transliteration: maatee anDhee surat  samaa-ee.

lines.english: Everything, everywhere which You have given is good.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  dee-aa bh alee-aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: Bliss, joyful celebrations, wondrous plays and entertainment-whatever pleases You,comes to pass. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anad binod  choj t amaasay t uDh bhaavai so hon aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਣਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Everything we receive is a gift from Him
lines.transliteration: jis daa d itaa sabh  kichh  lainaa.
chhat eeh amrit  bhojan kh aanaa. -the thirty-six delicious foods to eat,
sayj sukhaalee seet al pavn aa sahj kayl rang karn aa jee-o. ||3|| cozy beds, cooling breezes, peaceful joy and the experience of pleasure. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਪਵਣਾ  ਸਹਜ  ਕੇਲ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Give me that state of mind, by which I may not forget You.
lines.transliteration: saa buDh d eejai jit  visrahi naahee.

lines.english: Give me that understanding, by which I may meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: saa mat d eejai jit  tuDh Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.english: I sing Your Glorious Praises with each and every breath. Nanak takes the Support of the Guru's Feet. ||4||12||19|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (100-7) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas saas tayray gun  gaavaa ot naanak gur charn aa jee-o. ||4||12||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
lines.english: To praise You is to follow Your Command and Your Will.
lines.transliteration: sifat saalaahan  tayraa hukam rajaa-ee.

lines.english: That which pleases You is spiritual wisdom and meditation.
lines.transliteration: so gi-aan Dhi-aan jo t uDh bhaa-ee.

lines.english: That which pleases God is chanting and meditation; to be in harmony with His Will isperfect spiritual wisdom. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so-ee jap jo parabh jee-o bh aavai bh aanai poor gi-aanaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: He alone sings Your Ambrosial Naam, who is pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam t ayraa so-ee gaavai. jo saahib t ayrai man bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਪੂਰ ਿਗਆਨਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You. The minds of the Saints areattuned to You, O my Lord and Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tooN santan kaa sant  tumaaray sant  saahib man maanaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: You cherish and nurture the Saints.
lines.transliteration: tooN santan kee karahi part ipaalaa.

lines.english: The Saints play with You, O Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: sant kh ayleh t um sang gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਸੰਤ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your Saints are very dear to You. You are the breath of life of the Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: apunay sant t uDh kharay pi-aaray t oo sant an kay paraanaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: My mind is a sacrifice to those Saints who know You,
lines.transliteration: un santan kai mayraa man kurbaanay.
jin tooN jaataa jo t uDh man bh aanay. and are pleasing to Your Mind.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਖਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤੂ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In their company I have found a lasting peace. Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||13||20|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (100-13) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl
lines.transliteration: tin kai sang sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa har ras naanak t aripat  aghaanaa jee-o. ||4||13||20||

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: : You are the Ocean of Water, and I am Your fish.
lines.transliteration: tooN jalniDh  ham meen t umaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਨੇ ॥
lines.english: Your Name is the drop of water, and I am a thirsty rainbird.
lines.transliteration: tayraa naam boond  ham chaat rik tikhhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: You are my hope, and You are my thirst. My mind is absorbed in You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumree aas pi-aasaa t umree t um hee sang man leenaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Just as the baby is satisfied by drinking milk,
lines.transliteration: ji-o baarik pee kheer agh aavai.
ji-o nirDhan Dh an daykh sukh  paavai. and the poor person is pleased by seeing wealth,
tarikh aavaNt jal peevat  thandhaa ti-o har sang ih man bh eenaa jee-o. ||2|| and the thirsty person is refreshed by drinking cool water, so is this mind drenched with delight in the Lord. ||2||

lines.english: Just as the darkness is lit up by the lamp,
lines.transliteration: ji-o anDhi-aarai d eepak pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਆਸ  ਿਪਆਸਾ  ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhartaa chit vat pooran aasaa. and the hopes of the wife are fulfilled by thinking about her husband,
mil pareetam ji-o hot  anand aa ti-o har rang man rangeenaa jee-o. ||3|| and people are filled with bliss upon meeting their beloved, so is my mind imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

lines.english: The Saints have set me upon the Lord's Path.
lines.transliteration: santan mo ka-o har maarag paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਖਾਵੰਤ  ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ  ਠੰਢਾ ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਇਹੁਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Holy Saint, I have been attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kirpaal har sang gijh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord is mine, and I am the slave of the Lord. O Nanak, the Guru has blessed mewith the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||14||21|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (100-18) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har hamraa ham har kay daasay naanak sabad  guroo sach d eenaa jee-o. ||4||14||21||

lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is eternally pure.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad aa nirmalee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਜਉ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Giver of Peace and the Dispeller of sorrow.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aa-ee d ookh bidaaran haree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen and tasted all other flavors, but to my mind, the Subtle Essence of the Lord is the sweetest of all. ||1|| pMnw 101
lines.transliteration: avar saad chakh  saglay d aykhay man har ras sabh  tay meeth aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਮੀਠਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever drinks this in, is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: jo jo peevai so taript aavai.

lines.english: Whoever obtains the Sublime Essence of the Naam becomes immortal.
lines.transliteration: amar hovai jo naam ras paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam is obtained by one whose mind is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan t iseh paraapat  jis sabad  guroo man vooth aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਨਧਾਨ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who obtains the Sublime Essence of the Lord is satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jin har ras paa-i-aa so taripat  aghaanaa.

lines.english: One who obtains this Flavor of the Lord does not waver.
lines.transliteration: jin har saad paa-i-aa so naahi dulaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੋ ਨਾਿਹ  ਡੁਲਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who has this destiny written on his forehead obtains the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  har har naamaa jis mast ak bh aageeth aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord has come into the hands of the One, the Guru, who has blessed so manywith good fortune.
lines.transliteration: har ikas hath aa-i-aa varsaanay bahut ayray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕਸੁ  ਹਿਥ ਆਇਆ  ਵਰਸਾਣੇ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Attached to Him, a great many have been liberated.
lines.transliteration: tis lag mukat  bha-ay gh anayray.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam; says Nanak, those who see the Lordare very rare. ||4||15||22|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (101-5) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaanaa gurmukh  paa-ee-ai kaho naanak virlee deeth aa jee-o. ||4||15||22||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਰਲੀ  ਡੀਠਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
lines.english: My Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the nine treasures, the supernatural spiritual powers of theSiddhas, wealth and prosperity.
lines.transliteration: niDh siDh  riDh har har har mayrai.

lines.english: He is the Deep and Profound Treasure of Life.
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath gahir gambh eerai.

lines.english: Hundreds of thousands, even millions of pleasures and delights are enjoyed by onewho falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: laakh kot kh usee-aa rang raavai jo gur laagaa paa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are sanctified,
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh at bha-ay puneet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਖ  ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ  ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sagal uDhaaray bh aa-ee meet aa. and all family and friends are saved.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Inaccessible and Unfathomable True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar su-aamee apunaa gur kirpaa tay sach Dh i-aa-ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: The One, the Guru, who is sought by all-only a few, by great good fortune, receive His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o khojeh sarab upaa-ay. vadbh aagee d arsan ko virlaa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: His Place is lofty, infinite and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me that palace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ooch apaar agochar thaanaa oh mahal guroo daykh aa-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Your Ambrosial Name is deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer amrit  naam t ayraa.

lines.english: That person is liberated, in whose heart You dwell.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-i-aa jis rid ai vasayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਥਾਨਾ  ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru cuts away all his bonds; O Servant Nanak, he is absorbed in the poise ofintuitive peace. ||4||16||23|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (101-11) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur banDhan t in kay saglay kaatay jan naanak sahj samaa-ee jee-o. ||4||16||23||

lines.english: By God's Grace, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay har har Dh i-aava-o.

lines.english: By God's Kindness, I sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: parabhoo d a-i-aa t ay mangal gaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਬੰਧਨ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ  ਕਾਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
lines.english: While standing and sitting, while sleeping and while awake, meditate on the Lord, all your life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sovat  jaagat  har Dh i-aa-ee-ai sagal avrad aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: The Holy Saint has given me the Medicine of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam a-ukhaDh  mo ka-o saaDh oo dee-aa.

lines.english: My sins have been cut out, and I have become pure.
lines.transliteration: kilbikh kaatay nirmal thee-aa.

lines.english: I am filled with bliss, and all my pains have been taken away. All my suffering hasbeen dispelled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-i-aa niksee sabh  peeraa sagal binaasay d ardaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਸੋਵਤ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਗਲ  ਅਵਰਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who has my Beloved on his side, is liberated from the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa ang karay mayraa pi-aaraa. so muktaa saagar sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who recognizes the Guru practices Truth; why should he be afraid? ||3||
lines.transliteration: sat karay jin guroo pachh aataa so kaahay ka-o dard aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Since I found the Company of the Holy and met the Guru, the demon of pride hasdeparted.
lines.transliteration: jab tay saaDh oo sangat  paa-ay. gur bh aytat ha-o ga-ee balaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਿਨਕਸੀ  ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: ||4||17||24|| With each and every breath, Nanak sings the Lord's Praises. The True Guru hascovered my sins. ||4||17||24|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (101-16) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas saas har gaavai naanak satgur dh aak lee-aa mayraa parh -daa jee-o.

lines.english: Through and through, the Lord is intermingled with His servant.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  sayvak sang raat aa.

lines.english: God, the Giver of Peace, cherishes His servant.
lines.transliteration: parabh part ipaalay sayvak sukh -daata.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the grain for the servant of my Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paanee pakh aa peesa-o sayvak kai th aakur hee kaa aahar jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: God has cut the noose from around my neck; He has placed me in His Service.
lines.transliteration: kaat silak parabh sayvaa laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਭੇਟਤ  ਹਉ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master's Command is pleasing to the mind of His servant.
lines.transliteration: hukam saahib kaa sayvak man bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਵੈ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਢਾਿਕ  ਲੀਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
lines.english: He does that which pleases his Lord and Master. Inwardly and outwardly, the servantknows his Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so-ee kamaavai jo saahib bhaavai sayvak ant ar baahar maahar jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: You are the All-knowing Lord and Master; You know all ways and means. pMnw 102
lines.transliteration: tooN daanaa th aakur sabh  biDh jaaneh.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The servant of the Lord and Master enjoys the Love and Affection of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: thaakur kay sayvak har rang maan eh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: That which belongs to the Lord and Master, belongs to His servant. The servant becomes distinguished in association with his Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh th aakur kaa so sayvak kaa sayvak th aakur hee sang jaahar jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: He, whom the Lord and Master dresses in the robes of honor, is not called to answerfor his account any longer.
lines.transliteration: apunai thaakur jo pehraa-i-aa. bahur na laykh aa puchh  bulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant. He is the pearl of the deep and unfathomableOcean of God. ||4||18||25|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (102-3) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis sayvak kai naanak kurbaan ee so gahir gabh eeraa ga-uhar jee-o. ||4||18||25||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗਭੀਰਾ  ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  ghar meh baahar naahee.

lines.english: One who searches outside is deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: baahar tolai so bharam bh ulaahee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one who has found the Lord within is happy, inwardly and outwardly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jinee antar paa-i-aa so ant ar baahar suhaylaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Slowly, gently, drop by drop, the stre am of nectar trickles down within.
lines.transliteration: jhim jh im varsai amrit  Dhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੋ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man peevai sun sabad beechaaraa.

lines.english: It enjoys bliss and ecstasy day and night, and plays with the Lord forever and ever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anad binod  karay d in raat ee sad aa sad aa har kaylaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: I have now been united with the Lord after having been separated and cut off fromHim for so many lifetimes;
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa vichhurh i-aa mili-aa.
saaDh kirpaa t ay sookaa hari-aa. by the Grace of the Holy Saint, the dried-up branches have blossomed forth again intheir greenery.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; asGurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sumat paa-ay naam Dh i-aa-ay gurmukh  ho-ay maylaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: As the waves of water merge again with the water,
lines.transliteration: jal tarang ji-o jaleh samaa-i-aa.
ti-o jot ee sang jot  milaa-i-aa. so does my light merge again into the Light.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the veil of illusion has been cut away, and I shall not go out wanderingany more. ||4||19||26|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (102-9) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bharam katay kivaarh aa bahurh  na ho-ee-ai ja-ulaa jee-o. ||4||19||26||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who have heard of You.
lines.transliteration: tis kurbaan ee jin t ooN suni-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those whose tongues speak of You.
lines.transliteration: tis balihaaree jin rasnaa bh ani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਕਟੇ ਿਕਵਾੜਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ  ਜਉਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Again and again, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on You with mind and body. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vaar vaar jaa-ee tis vitahu jo man t an tuDh aaraaDh ay jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: I wash the feet of those who walk upon Your Path.
lines.transliteration: tis charan  pakh aalee jo t ayrai maarag chaalai.

lines.english: With my eyes, I long to behold those kind people.
lines.transliteration: nain nihaalee tis purakh  da-i-aalai.

lines.english: I offer my mind to those friends, who have met the Guru and found God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man dayvaa t is apunay saajan jin gur mil so parabh  laaDh ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ ਜਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਟਹ ੁ ਜੋ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Very fortunate are those who know You.
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee jin t um jaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਚਰਣ  ਪਖਾਲੀ  ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: In the midst of all, they remain detached and balanced in Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: sabh kai maDh ay alipat  nirbaan ay.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and conquer all their evil passions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang un bh a-ojal t ari-aa sagal d oot un saaDh ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ  ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind has entered their Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: tin kee saran  pari-aa man mayraa.

lines.english: I have renounced my pride in my own strength, and the darkness of emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: maan t aan taj moh anDh ayraa.

lines.english: Please bless Nanak with the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible andUnfathomable God. ||4||20||27|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (102-14) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam daan d eejai naanak ka-o t is parabh  agam agaaDh ay jee-o. ||4||20||27||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਿਨ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਦੂਤ ਉਿਨ  ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are the tree; Your branches have blossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: tooN payd saakh  tayree foolee.

lines.english: From the very small and subtle, You have become huge and manifest.
lines.transliteration: tooN sookh am ho-aa asthoolee.

lines.english: You are the Ocean of Water, and You are the foam and the bubbles on its surface. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN jalniDh  tooN fayn bud budaa tuDh bin avar na bh aalee-ai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਧੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
lines.english: You are the thread, and You are also the beads.
lines.transliteration: tooN soot manee-ay bh ee tooNhai.

lines.english: You are the knot, and You are the primary bead of the maalaa.
lines.transliteration: tooN ganth ee mayr sir t ooNhai.

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, there is God. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant parabh  so-ee avar na ko-ay d ikhaalee-ai jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: You transcend all qualities, and You possess the supreme qualities. You are the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: tooN nirgun  sargun  sukh -daata.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਿਨਿਧ  ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are detached in Nirvaanaa, and You are the Enjoyer, imbued with love.
lines.transliteration: tooN nirbaan  rasee-aa rang raat aa.

lines.english: You Yourself know Your Own Ways; You dwell upon Yourself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: apnay kart ab aapay jaan eh aapay t uDh samaalee-ai jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: You are the Master, and then again, You are the servant.
lines.transliteration: tooN thaakur sayvak fun aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਮਿਧ ਅੰਿਤ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਿਦਖਾਲੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O God, You Yourself are the Manifest and the Unmanifest.
lines.transliteration: tooN gupat  pargat parabh  aapay.

lines.english: Slave Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises forever. Please, just for a moment, bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||21||28|| pMnw 103 mwJ mhlw 5 ] (103-1) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa gun  gaavai ik bh oree nad ar nihaalee-ai jee-o. ||4||21||28||

lines.english: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.
lines.transliteration: safal so banee jit  naam vakh aanee.

lines.english: Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kinai virlai jaan ee.

lines.english: Dhan so vaylaa jit  har gaavat  sunn aa aa-ay t ay parvaanaa jee-o. ||1|| Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||
Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved andaccepted.
lines.transliteration: say naytar parvaan  jinee d arsan paykh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਵਤ  ਸੁਨਣਾ  ਆਏ  ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.
lines.transliteration: say kar bhalay jinee har jas laykh aa.

lines.english: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to thatCongregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||
lines.transliteration: say charan suhaavay jo har maarag chalay ha-o bal t in sang pachh aanaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:
lines.transliteration: sun saajan mayray meet  pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ  ਸੁਹਾਵੇ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਿਤਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਛਾਣਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang kh in maahi uDh aaray. in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

lines.english: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings andgoings shall cease. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kilvikh kaat ho-aa man nirmal mit ga-ay aavan  jaanaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  ik bin-o kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ ਕਾਿਟ  ਹੋਆ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਏ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa dubdaa pathar leejai. please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

lines.english: ||4||22||29|| God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (103-7) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh bh a-ay kirpaalaa parabh  naanak man bh aanaa jee-o.

lines.english: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee har har t ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨੨ ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  hovai param gat  mayree.

lines.english: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled andsoothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhee seet al ho-ay manoo-aa sat gur kaa d arsan paa-ay jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,
lines.transliteration: sookh bh a-i-aa d ukh door paraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sant rasan har naam vakh aanaa. when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਿਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; noplace is left empty. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal thal neer bharay sar subh ar birthaa ko-ay na jaa-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: The Creator has showered His Kindness;
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aaree t in sirjanhaaray.

lines.english: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant saglay part ipaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਿਰ  ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: miharvaan kirpaal da-i-aalaa saglay t aripat  aghaa-ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.
lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan keeton hari-aa.

lines.english: The Doer of all did this in an instant.
lines.transliteration: karanhaar khin bh eetar kari-aa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind.||4||23||30|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (103-12) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak t isai araaDh ay man kee aas pujaa-ay jee-o. ||4||23||30||

lines.english: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa pit aa tooNhai mayraa maat aa.

lines.english: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa banDh ap tooN mayraa bh araataa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਪੁਜਾਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
lines.english: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa raakh aa sabh nee thaa-ee t aa bh a-o kayhaa kaarh aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: By Your Grace, I recognize You.
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay tuDh pachh aanaa.

lines.english: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayree ot t ooNhai mayraa maan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ  ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰ੍ਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa avar na ko-ee sabh  tayraa kh ayl akh aarhaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਸਭਨੀ  ਥਾਈ  ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ  ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have created all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tuDh upaa-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.
lines.transliteration: jit jit bhaanaa tit tit laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  keetaa tayraa hovai naahee kichh  asaarh aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ay mahaa sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay mayraa man seet laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (103-18) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai vajee vaaDhaa-ee naanak jit aa bikh aarhaa jee-o. ||4||24||31||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਅਸਾੜਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan parabh  maneh aDh aaraa.

lines.english: His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  jeeveh gun  gaa-ay apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan amrit  har naamaa har Dh i-aa-ay Dh i-aa-ay sukh  paa-i-aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਤਾ  ਿਬਖਾੜਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
lines.english: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home to the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death. pMnw 104
lines.transliteration: mansaa Dhaar jo gh ar tay aavai. saaDh sang janam maran  mitaavai.

lines.english: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aas manorath pooran hovai bhaytat  gur d arsaa-i-aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਮਨੋਰਥੁ  ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar kichh mit  nahee jaanee.

lines.english: The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and thespiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  Dhi-aavahi gi-aanee.

lines.english: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khudee mitee chookaa bh olaavaa gur man hee meh paragtaa-i-aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਦੀ ਿਮਟੀ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਭੋਲਾਵਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਗਟਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss, joy, salvation, intuitive peace andpoise.
lines.transliteration: anad mangal kali-aan  niDhaanaa. sookh  sahj har naam vakh aanaa.

lines.english: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (104-4) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ho-ay kirpaal su-aamee apnaa naa-o naanak ghar meh aa-i-aa jee-o. ||4||25||32||

lines.english: Hearing of You, I live.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  jeevaa so-ay t umaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਨਾਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
lines.english: You are my Beloved, my Lord and Master, Utterly Great.
lines.transliteration: tooN pareet am th aakur at  bhaaree.

lines.english: You alone know Your Ways; I grasp Your Support, Lord of the World. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumray kart ab tum hee jaan hu tumree ot gopaalaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  man hari-aa hovai.

lines.english: Hearing Your Sermon, all filth is removed.
lines.transliteration: kathaa sunat  mal saglee kh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਕਰਤਬ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਓਟ ਗਪਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate forever on the Merciful Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhaytat  sang saaDh  santan kai sad aa japa-o d a-i-aalaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: I dwell on my God with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: parabh apunaa saas saas samaara-o.

lines.english: This understanding has been implanted within my mind, by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: ih mat gur parsaad  man Dh aara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਟਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, the Divine Light has dawned. The Merciful Lord cherishes everyone.||3||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay ho-ay pargaasaa sarab ma-i-aa part ipaalaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: True, True, True is that God.
lines.transliteration: sat sat  sat parabh  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ ਮਿਨ ਧਾਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: Forever, forever and ever, He Himself is.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sad  aapay ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਮਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your Playful Ways are revealed, O my Beloved. Beholding them, Nanak is enraptured.||4||26||33|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (104-10) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chalit t umaaray pargat pi-aaray d aykh naanak bh a-ay nihaalaa jee-o. ||4||26||33||

lines.english: By His Command, the rain begins to fall.
lines.transliteration: hukmee varsan laagay mayhaa.

lines.english: The Saints and friends have met to chant the Naam.
lines.transliteration: saajan sant mil naam japayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਿਲਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦੇਿਖ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਏ ਿਨਹਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: seetal saaNt sahj sukh  paa-i-aa th aadh paa-ee parabh  aapay jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: God has produced everything in great abundance.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  bahut o bahut  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, God has satisfied all.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh sagal rajaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Bless us with Your Gifts, O my Great Giver. All beings and creatures are satisfied. ||2||
lines.transliteration: daat karahu mayray d aataaraa jee-a jant  sabh  Dharaapay jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: True is the Master, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਠਾਿਢ  ਪਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate forever on Him.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad t is sad aa Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: The fear of birth and death has been dispelled; emotional attachment, sorrow andsuffering have been erased. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam maran bh ai kaatay mohaa binsay sog sant aapay jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: With each and every breath, Nanak praises the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saas saas naanak saalaahay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Name, all bonds are cut away.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam kaatay sabh  faahay.

lines.english: One's hopes are fulfilled in an instant, chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||27||34|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (104-15) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pooran aas karee khin bh eetar har har har gun  jaapay jee-o. ||4||27||34||

lines.english: Come, dear friends, Saints and companions:
lines.transliteration: aa-o saajan sant meet  pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mil gaavah gun agam apaaray. let us join together and sing the Glorious Praises of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

lines.english: Those who sing and hear these praises are liberated, so let us meditate on the Onewho created us. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gaavat sun at sabh ay hee mukt ay so Dh i-aa-ee-ai jin ham kee-ay jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: The sins of countless incarnations depart,
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilbikh jaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸ  ਕਰੀ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: man chinday say-ee fal paavahi. and we receive the fruits of the mind's desires.

lines.english: So meditate on that Lord, our True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all.||2||
lines.transliteration: simar saahib so sach su-aamee rijak sabhas ka-o d ee-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, all pleasures are obtained.
lines.transliteration: naam japat sarab sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: All fears are erased, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sabh bh a-o binsai har har Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਤ  ਸੁਣਤ  ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਸੋ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who serves the Lord swims across to the other side, and all his affairs areresolved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa so paargiramee kaaraj saglay thee-ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary;
lines.transliteration: aa-ay pa-i-aa tayree sarn aa-ee.
ji-o bhaavai t i-o laihi milaa-ee. if it pleases You, unite me with You. pMnw 105

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, God; let me be committed to devotional worship. Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of Truth. ||4||28||35|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (105-1) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh bh agtee laavhu sach naanak amrit  pee-ay jee-o. ||4||28||35||

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth, has become Merciful;
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal govind  gusaa-ee.
maygh varsai sabh nee thaa-ee. the rain is falling everywhere.

lines.english: He is Merciful to the meek, always Kind and Gentle; the Creator has brought cooling relief. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal sad aa kirpaalaa th aadh paa-ee kart aaray jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਦਾ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ਠਾਿਢ  ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He cherishes all His beings and creatures,
lines.transliteration: apunay jee-a jant part ipaaray.
ji-o baarik maataa sammaaray. as the mother cares for her children.

lines.english: The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of Peace, the Lord and Master gives sustenance to all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dukh bhanjan sukh  saagar su-aamee d ayt sagal aahaaray jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ  ਆਹਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord is totally pervading and permeating the water and the land.
lines.transliteration: jal thal poor rahi-aa miharvaanaa.

lines.english: I am forever devoted, a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: sad balihaar jaa-ee-ai kurbaanaa.

lines.english: Night and day, I always meditate on Him; in an instant, He saves all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: rain d inas t is sad aa Dh i-aa-ee je kh in meh sagal uDh aaray jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈ  ਿਜ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਗਲ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: God Himself protects all;
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay saglay parabh  aapay.

lines.english: He drives out all sorrow and suffering.
lines.transliteration: utar ga-ay sabh  sog sant aapay.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are rejuvenated. O Nanak, God has bestowed His Glance of Grace. ||4||29||36|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (105-7) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam japat man t an haree-aaval parabh  naanak nad ar nihaaray jee-o. ||4||29||36||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
lines.english: Where the Naam, the Name of God the Beloved is chanted
lines.transliteration: jithai naam japee-ai parabh pi-aaray.
say asthal so-in cha-ubaaray. -those barren places become mansions of gold.

lines.english: Where the Naam, the Name of my Lord of the Universe is not chanted-those townsare like the barren wilderness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jithai naam na japee-ai mayray go-idaa say-ee nagar ujaarh ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: One who meditates as he eats dry bread,
lines.transliteration: har rukhee rotee kh aa-ay samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ  ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ  ਉਜਾੜੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har antar baahar nad ar nihaalay. sees the Blessed Lord inwardly and outwardly.

lines.english: Know this well, that one who eats and eats while practicing evil, is like a field ofpoisonous plants. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khaa-ay kh aa-ay karay bad failee jaan  visoo kee vaarh ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: One who does not feel love for the Saints,
lines.transliteration: santaa sayt ee rang na laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਇ  ਖਾਇ  ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਿਵਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saakat sang vikram kamaa-ay. misbehaves in the company of the wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics;
dulabh  dayh kh o-ee agi-aanee jarh  apun ee aap upaarh ee jee-o. ||3|| he wastes this human body, so difficult to obtain. In his ignorance, he tears up his own roots. ||3||

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek,
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  mayray d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਲਭ  ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾੜੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Ocean of Peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar mayray gur gopaalaa.

lines.english: Shower Your Mercy upon Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; please,preserve my honor. ||4||30||37|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (105-12) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naanak gun gaavai raakh o saram asaarh ee jee-o. ||4||30||37||

lines.english: I cherish in my heart the Feet of my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: charan th aakur kay rid ai samaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹ ੁ ਸਰਮ  ਅਸਾੜੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
lines.english: All my troubles and sufferings have run away.
lines.transliteration: kal kalays sabh d oor pa-i-aan ay.

lines.english: The music of intuitive peace, poise and tranquility wells up within; I dwell in theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaNt sookh  sahj Dh un upjee saaDh oo sang nivaasaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: The bonds of love with the Lord are never broken.
lines.transliteration: laagee pareet na t ootai moolay.

lines.english: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading inside and out.
lines.transliteration: har antar baahar rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੀ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਨਵਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar gun gaavaa kaatee jam kee faasaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;
lines.transliteration: amrit varkh ai anhad  banee.
man tan ant ar saaNt samaan ee. deep within my mind and body, peace and tranquility have come.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਕਾਟੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your humble servants remain satisfied and fulfilled, and the True Guru blesses themwith encouragement and comfort. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaa-ay rahay jan t ayray sat gur kee-aa d ilaasaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: We are His, and from Him, we receive our rewards.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tis t ay fal paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Showering His Mercy upon us, God has united us with Him.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh sang milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਇ  ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਿਦਲਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Our comings and goings have ended, and through great good fortune, O Nanak, ourhopes are fulfilled. ||4||31||38|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (105-17) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay vadbh aagee naanak pooran aasaa jee-o. ||4||31||38||

lines.english: The rain has fallen; I have found the Transcendent Lord God.
lines.transliteration: meehu pa-i-aa parmaysar paa-i-aa.

lines.english: All beings and creatures dwell in peace.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  sukh ee vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣ  ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
lines.english: Suffering has been dispelled, and true happiness has dawned, as we meditate on theName of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ga-i-aa kalays bha-i-aa sukh  saachaa har har naam samaalee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: The One, to whom we belong, cherishes and nurtures us.
lines.transliteration: jis kay say tin hee part ipaaray.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has become our Protector.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh bh a-ay rakh vaaray.

lines.english: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer; my efforts have been rewarded. ||2|| pMnw 106
lines.transliteration: sunee baynant ee thaakur mayrai pooran ho-ee gh aalee jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਮੇਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is the Giver of all souls.
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa ka-o dayvan haaraa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee nadar nihaaraa.

lines.english: The beings in the water, on the land and in the sky are all satisfied; I wash the Feet of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al sabh t ariptaanay saaDh oo charan pakh aalee jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ  ਸਿਭ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਣੇ  ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ  ਪਖਾਲੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind.
lines.transliteration: man kee ichh pujaavan haaraa.

lines.english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa jaa-ee balihaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this Gift; I am imbued with the Love of theDelightful Lord. ||4||32||39|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (106-4) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daan kee-aa d ukh bhanjan rat ay rang rasaalee jee-o. ||4||32||39||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਿਨ  ਰਤੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਸਾਲੀ  ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
lines.english: Mind and body are Yours; all wealth is Yours.
lines.transliteration: man tan t ayraa Dh an bh ee tayraa.

lines.english: You are my God, my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tooN thaakur su-aamee parabh  mayraa.

lines.english: Body and soul and all riches are Yours. Yours is the Power, O Lord of the World. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh raas t umaaree t ayraa jor gopaalaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Forever and ever, You are the Giver of Peace.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa tooNhai sukh -daa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I bow down and fall at Your Feet.
lines.transliteration: niv niv laagaa tayree paa-ee.

lines.english: I act as it pleases You, as You cause me to act, Kind and Compassionate Dear Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaar kamaavaa jay tuDh  bhaavaa jaa t ooN deh da-i-aalaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: O God, from You I receive; You are my decoration.
lines.transliteration: parabh t um tay lahn aa tooN mayraa gahn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ  ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ  ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whatever You give me, brings me happiness.
lines.transliteration: jo tooN deh so-ee sukh  sahn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ  ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever You keep me, is heaven. You are the Cherisher of all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jithai rakheh baikuNth tithaa-ee t ooN sabh naa kay part ipaalaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.
lines.transliteration: simar simar naanak sukh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਰਖਿਹ  ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ  ਿਤਥਾਈ  ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar t ayray gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: All my hopes and desires are fulfilled; I shall never again suffer sorrow. ||4||33||40|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (106-9) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooran ho-ay kaday na ho-ay d ukhaalaa jee-o. ||4||33||40||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has unleashed the rain clouds.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh maygh  pathaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਏ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Over the sea and over the land-over all the earth's surface, in all directions, He has brought the rain.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al dah d is varsaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Peace has come, and the thirst of all has been quenched; there is joy and ecstasyeverywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaNt bha-ee bujh ee sabh  tarisnaa anad  bha-i-aa sabh  thaa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: He is the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of pain.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata dukh bhaNjanhaaraa.

lines.english: He gives and forgives all beings.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas karay jee-a saaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਭਈ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਸਭ ਠਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself nurtures and cherishes His Creation. I fall at His Feet and surrender toHim. ||2||
lines.transliteration: apnay keetay no aap part ipaalay pa-i pairee t iseh manaa-ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Seeking His Sanctuary, salvation is obtained.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee saran pa-i-aa gat  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: With each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: saas saas har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲੇ  ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਮਨਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without Him, there is no other Lord and Master. All places belong to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis bin hor na d oojaa th aakur sabh  tisai kee-aa jaa-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਇਆ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Yours is the Honor, God, and Yours is the Power.
lines.transliteration: tayraa maan  taan parabh  tayraa.

lines.english: You are the True Lord and Master, the Ocean of Excellence.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa saahib gun ee gahayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਿਤਸੈ ਕੀਆ  ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak utters this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ||4||34||41|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (106-15) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai baynant ee aath  pahar t uDh Dhi-aa-ee jee-o. ||4||34||41||

lines.english: All happiness comes, when God is pleased.
lines.transliteration: sabhay sukh  bha-ay parabh  tuthay.

lines.english: The Feet of the Perfect Guru dwell in my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kay charan man vuth ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
lines.english: I am intuitively absorbed in the state of Samaadhi deep within. God alone knows thissweet pleasure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sahj samaaDh lagee liv ant ar so ras so-ee jaan ai jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar saahib mayraa.

lines.english: Deep within each and every heart, He dwells near and close at hand.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar vart ai nayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
lines.english: He is always detached; He is the Giver of souls. How rare is that person who understands his own self. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa alipat  jee-aa kaa d aataa ko virlaa aap pachh aanai jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗੀ  ਿਲਵ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is the sign of union with God:
lines.transliteration: parabh miln ai kee ayh neesaan ee.
man iko sachaa hukam pachhaan ee. in the mind, the Command of the True Lord is recognized.

lines.english: Intuitive peace and poise, contentment, enduring satisfaction and bliss come throughthe Pleasure of the Master's Will. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sahj santokh  sadaa tariptaasay anad  khasam kai bh aanai jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਿਲਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: God, the Great Giver, has given me His Hand.
lines.transliteration: hathee dit ee parabh  dayvan haarai.

lines.english: He has erased all the sickness of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: janam maran rog sabh  nivaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, those whom God has made His slaves, rejoice in the pleasure of singing theKirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||35||42|| pMnw 107 mwJ mhlw 5 ] (107-1) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kee-ay parabh  apunay har keert an rang maan ay jee-o. ||4||35||42||

lines.english: The Life of the World, the Sustainer of the Earth, has showered His Mercy;
lines.transliteration: keenee da-i-aa gopaal gusaa-ee.
gur kay charan vasay man maahee. the Guru's Feet have come to dwell within my mind.

lines.english: The Creator has made me His Own. He has destroyed the city of sorrow. ||1||
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-aa tin kart ai dukh kaa dayraa dh aahi-aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਵਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The True One abides within my mind and body;
lines.transliteration: man tan vasi-aa sachaa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bikh-rh aa thaan na d isai ko-ee. no place seems difficult to me now.

lines.english: All the evil-doers and enemies have now become my friends. I long only for my Lord and Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: doot dusman  sabh  sajan  ho-ay ayko su-aamee aahi-aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever He does, He does all by Himself.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so aapay aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਣ  ਸਿਭ ਸਜਣ  ਹੋਏ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: No one can know His Ways.
lines.transliteration: buDh si-aan ap kichh oo na jaapai.

lines.english: He Himself is the Helper and Support of His Saints. God has cast out my doubts anddelusions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapni-aa sant aa no aap sahaa-ee parabh  bharam bh ulaavaa laahi-aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: His Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jan kaa aaDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਿਣਆ  ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਭਰਮ  ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, they deal in the Name of the Lord. shj Anµd gwvih gux goivMd pRB nwnk srb smwihAw jIau ]4]36]43] (107-5) sahj anand gaavahi gun govind  parabh  naanak sarab samaahi-aa jee-o. ||4||36||43|| In peace and pleasure, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, God is permeating everywhere. ||4||36||43|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (107-6) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aath pahar raam naam vaapaaro.

lines.english: True is that temple, within which one meditates on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: so sach mandar jit  sach Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Blessed is that heart, within which the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung.
lines.transliteration: so ridaa suhaylaa jit  har gun  gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਅਨੰਦ  ਗਾਵਿਹ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੩॥
lines.english: Beautiful is that land, where the Lord's humble servants dwell. I am a sacrifice to theTrue Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saa Dharat  suhaavee jit  vaseh har jan sachay naam vitahu kurbaan o jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: The extent of the True Lord's Greatness cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: sach vadaa-ee keem na paa-ee.

lines.english: His Creative Power and His Bounties cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  karam na kahn aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay Dh i-aa-ay jeeveh jan t ayray sach sabad  man maan o jee-o. ||2|| Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating on You. Their minds treasure the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Praises of the True One are obtained by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahan vadbh aagee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har gun gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with Your Love are pleasing to You. The True Name is theirBanner and Insignia. ||3||
lines.transliteration: rang ratay t ayrai t uDh bhaaveh sach naam neesaan o jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਆਇ ਿਧਆਇ  ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਮਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: No one knows the limits of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachay ant na jaan ai ko-ee.

lines.english: In all places and interspaces, the True One is pervading.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar sachaa so-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the True One, the Searcher of hearts, the Knower of all.||4||37||44|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (107-12) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach Dhi-aa-ee-ai sad  hee ant arjaamee jaan o jee-o. ||4||37||44||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Beautiful is the night, and beautiful is the day,
lines.transliteration: rain suhaavarh ee dinas suhaylaa.
jap amrit naam sat sang maylaa. when one joins the Society of the Saints and chants the Ambrosial Naam.

lines.english: If you remember the Lord in meditation for a moment, even for an instant, then your life will become fruitful and prosperous. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gharh ee moorat  simrat  pal vanj ahi jeevan  safal t ithaa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਜਾਣੋ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੭ ॥੪੪॥
lines.english: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam d okh sabh  laathay.

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is always with us.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar har parabh  saathay.

lines.english: Fear, dread and doubt have been dispelled by the Perfect Guru; now, I see God everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhai bh a-o bh aram kh o-i-aa gur poorai d aykhaa sabh nee jaa-ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: God is All-powerful, Vast, Lofty and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: parabh samrath vad ooch apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਪਲ ਵੰਞਿਹ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਿਤਥਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Naam is overflowing with the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam bh aray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, there is God. Nothing else even comesclose to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aad ant  maDh  parabh  so-ee d oojaa lavai na laa-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Take pity on me, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mayray deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ  ਖੋਇਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ  ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a beggar, begging for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jaachik jaachai saaDh ravaalaa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for this gift: let me meditate on the Lord, forever and ever. ||4||38||45|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (107-17) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: deh d aan naanak jan maagai sad aa sad aa har Dh i-aa-ee jee-o. ||4||38||45||

lines.english: You are here, and You are hereafter.
lines.transliteration: aithai tooNhai aagai aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਮਿਧ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures were created by You.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jantar sabh  tayray thaapay.

lines.english: Without You, there is no other, O Creator. You are my Support and my Protection. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin avar na ko-ee kart ay mai Dh ar ot t umaaree jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: The tongue lives by chanting and meditating on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa jap jap jeevai su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਹ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੫॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh ant arjaamee.

lines.english: Those who serve the Lord find peace; they do not lose their lives in the gamble. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa tin hee sukh  paa-i-aa so janam na joo-ai haaree jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Your humble servant, who obtains the Medicine of the Naam, pMnw 108
lines.transliteration: naam avkhaDh  jin jan t ayrai paa-i-aa.
janam janam kaa rog gavaa-i-aa. is rid of the illnesses of countless lifetimes and incarnations.

lines.english: So sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night. This is the most fruitfuloccupation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har keertan gaavhu d in raat ee safal ayhaa hai kaaree jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁਗਾਵਹੁਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਫਲ  ਏਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He has adorned His slave.
lines.transliteration: darisat Dh aar apnaa d aas savaari-aa.

lines.english: Deep within each and every heart, the Supreme Lord is humbly worshipped.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar paarbarahm namaskaari-aa.

lines.english: Without the One, there is no other at all. O Baba Nanak, this is the most excellentwisdom. ||4||39||46|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (108-4) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ikas vin hor d oojaa naahee baabaa naanak ih mat  saaree jee-o. ||4||39||46||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਿਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਬਾਬਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹ ਮਿਤ ਸਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩੯॥੪੬॥
lines.english: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan rat aa raam pi-aaray.

lines.english: I sacrifice everything for Him.
lines.transliteration: sarbas deejai apnaa vaaray.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. Do not forget Him, for even one breath. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar govind  gun gaa-ee-ai bisar na ko-ee saasaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: He is a companion, a friend, and a beloved of mine,
lines.transliteration: so-ee saajan meet pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ  ਿਬਸਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam saaDhsang beechaaraa. who reflects upon the Lord's Name, in the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the world-ocean, and thenoose of death shall be cut away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang t areejai saagar katee-ai jam kee faasaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: The four cardinal blessings are obtained by serving the Lord.
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath har kee sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਰੀਜੈ ਸਾਗਰ ੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Elysian Tree, the source of all blessings, is meditation on the Unseen andUnknowable Lord.
lines.transliteration: paarjaat jap alakh  abhayvaa.

lines.english: The Guru has cut out the sinful mistakes of sexual desire and anger, and my hopeshave been fulfilled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh kilbikh  gur kaatay pooran ho-ee aasaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: That mortal who is blessed by perfect destiny meets the Lord, the Sustainer of theUniverse, in the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: pooran bhaag bh a-ay jis paraan ee. saaDh sang milay saarangpaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the mind, one is approved and accepted, whether he is a house-holder or a renunciate. ||4||40||47|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (108-9) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasi-aa jis antar parvaan  girsat  udaasaa jee-o. ||4||40||47||

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, my heart is filled with peace.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam rid ai sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: By His Grace, His devotees become famous and acclaimed.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa bhagt eeN paragtaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਿਗਰਸਤ  ਉਦਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੪੭॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the diseaseof laziness has disappeared. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsang mil har har japi-aa binsay aalas rogaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, the nine treasures are found in the Home of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: jaa kai garihi nav niDh har bh aa-ee.

lines.english: He comes to meet those who deserve it by their past actions.
lines.transliteration: tis mili-aa jis purab kamaa-ee.

lines.english: The Perfect Transcendent Lord is spiritual wisdom and meditation. God is All-powerfulto do all things. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan pooran parmaysur parabh  sabh naa galaa jogaa jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਆਲਸ  ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the Many.
lines.transliteration: aap ikantee aap pasaaraa.

lines.english: Filth does not stick to the Giver, the Life of the World. Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the pain of separation departs. ||3||
lines.transliteration: layp nahee jagjeevan daat ay darsan dith ay lahan vijogaa jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਗਲਾ  ਜੋਗਾ  ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Holding on to the hem of His Robe, the entire Universe is saved.
lines.transliteration: anchal laa-ay sabh sisat t araa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself causes His Name to be chanted.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa naa-o aap japaa-ee.

lines.english: The Boat of the Guru is found by His Grace; O Nanak, such blessed destiny is pre- ordained. ||4||41||48|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (108-14) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur bohith paa-i-aa kirpaa tay naanak Dh ur sanjogaa jee-o. ||4||41||48||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਦਾਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਿਡਠੇ ਲਹਿਨ  ਿਵਜੋਗਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: People do whatever the Lord inspires them to do.
lines.transliteration: so-ee karnaa je aap karaa-ay.

lines.english: Wherever He keeps us is a good place.
lines.transliteration: jithai rakhai saa bh alee jaa-ay.

lines.english: That person is clever and honorable, unto whom the Hukam of the Lord's Commandseems sweet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so-ee si-aanaa so pat ivantaa hukam lagai jis meeth aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਧੁਿਰ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੪੧॥੪੮॥
lines.english: Everything is strung upon the One String of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh paro-ee ikat  Dhaagai.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord attaches, are attached to His Feet.
lines.transliteration: jis laa-ay la-ay so charnee laagai.

lines.english: Those, whose inverted lotus of the crown chakra is illuminated, see the Immaculate Lord everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ooNDh kaval jis ho-ay pargaasaa t in sarab niranjan deeth aa jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Only You Yourself know Your Glory.
lines.transliteration: tayree mahimaa t ooNhai jaan eh.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਿਸਆਣਾ  ਸੋ ਪਿਤਵੰਤਾ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself recognize Your Own Self.
lines.transliteration: apnaa aap t ooN aap pachh aaneh.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your Saints, who have crushed their sexual desire, anger andgreed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree santan t ayray jin kaam kroDh  lobh peeth aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: You have no hatred or vengeance; Your Saints are immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: tooN nirvair sant  tayray nirmal.

lines.punjabi: ਊਂਧ ਕਵਲੁ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Seeing them, all sins depart.
lines.transliteration: jin daykh ay sabh  utreh kalmal.

lines.english: ||4||42||49|| Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Naam. His stubborn doubt and fear havedeparted. ||4||42||49|| pMnw 109 mWJ mhlw 5 ] (109-1) maaNjh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay Dh i-aa-ay jeevai binsi-aa bh aram bh a-o Dh eethaa jee-o.

lines.english: One who asks for a false gift,
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa mangan  jay ko-ee maagai.
tis ka-o mart ay gh arhee na laagai. shall not take even an instant to die.

lines.english: But one who continually serves the Supreme Lord God and meets the Guru, is said to be immortal. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jo sad hee sayvai so gur mil nihchal kahn aa. ||1||

lines.english: One whose mind is dedicated to loving devotional worship
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  jis kai man laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਕਹਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai an-d in nit jaagee. sings His Glorious Praises night and day, and remains forever awake and aware.

lines.english: Taking him by the hand, the Lord and Master merges into Himself that person, uponwhose forehead such destiny is written. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baah pakarh t is su-aamee maylai jis kai mast ak lahn aa. ||2||

lines.english: His Lotus Feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal bhagt aaN man vuth ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿੜ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੇਲੈ ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਲਹਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.
lines.transliteration: vin parmaysar saglay muth ay.

lines.english: I long for the dust of the feet of His humble servants. The Name of the True Lord is my decoration. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant janaaN kee Dh oorh nit baaNchheh naam sachay kaa gahn aa. ||3||

lines.english: Standing up and sitting down, I sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at har har gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਿੜ ਿਨਤ ਬਛਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, I obtain my Eternal Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat var nihchal paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: God has become merciful to Nanak. I cheerfully accept Your Will. ||4||43||50|| rwgu mwJ AstpdIAw mhlw 1 Gru 1  (109-7) raag maajh asatpad ee-aa mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Raag Maajh, Ashtapadees: First Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (109-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh ho-ay d a-i-aalaa t ayraa keet aa sahn aa. ||4||43||50||

lines.english: By His Command, all are attuned to the Word of the Shabad,
lines.transliteration: sabad rangaa-ay hukam sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ  ਸਹਣਾ  ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: sachee dargeh mahal bulaa-ay. and all are called to the Mansion of His Presence, the True Court of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O my True Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek, my mind is pleased and appeasedby the Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachay deen d a-i-aal mayray saahibaa sachay man pat ee-aavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree sabad suhaavan i-aa.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of Peace. Throughthe Guru's Teachings, it dwells in the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad aa sukh -daata gurmat ee man vasaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one is mine, and I am no one else's.
lines.transliteration: naa ko mayraa ha-o kis kayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord and Master of the three worlds is mine.
lines.transliteration: saachaa thaakur t aribhavan mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Acting in egotism, so very many have died. After making mistakes, they later repentand regret. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kar kar jaa-ay ghan ayree kar avgan  pachh otaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command chant the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan ai so har gun  vakh aanai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are glorified with the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad naam neesaan ai.

lines.english: Everyone's account is kept in the True Court, and through the Beauty of the Naam,they are saved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa d ar laykh aa sachai chh ootas naam suhaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ਘਣੇਰੀ  ਕਿਰ ਅਵਗਣ  ਪਛੋਤਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; they find no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolaa th a-ur na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are brutally beaten.
lines.transliteration: jam dar baDh aa chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Name, there are no companions or friends. Liberation comes only by meditating on the Naam. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko sang na saathee muktay naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਦਿਰ ਲੇਖਾ  ਸਚੈ ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The false shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth.
lines.transliteration: saakat koorh ay sach na bh aavai.

lines.english: Bound by duality, they come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa baaDh aa aavai jaavai.

lines.english: No one can erase pre-recorded destiny; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||5||
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa laykh  na maytai ko-ee gurmukh  mukat  karaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਸਾਥੀ  ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: In this world of her parents' house, the young bride did not know her Husband.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai pir jaat o naahee.

lines.english: Through falsehood, she has been separated from Him, and she cries out in misery.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  vichh unnee rovai Dh aahee.

lines.english: Defrauded by demerits, she does not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. Butthrough virtuous actions, her demerits are forgiven. ||6||
lines.transliteration: avgan muth ee mahal na paa-ay avgan  gun bakh saavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: She, who knows her Beloved in her parents' house,
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai jin jaat aa pi-aaraa.
gurmukh boojh ai tat beechaaraa. as Gurmukh, comes to understand the essence of reality; she contemplates her Lord.

lines.english: Her comings and goings cease, and she is absorbed in the True Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa thaak rahaa-ay sachai naam samaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਮੁਠੀ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਅਵਗਣ  ਗੁਿਣ  ਬਖਸਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs understand and describe the Indescribable.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai akath kahaavai.

lines.english: True is our Lord and Master; He loves the Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachay thaakur saacho bh aavai.

lines.english: Nanak offers this true prayer: singing His Glorious Praises, I merge with the True One. ||8||1|| mwJ mhlw 3 Gru 1 ] (109-19) maajh mehlaa 3 gh ar 1. Maajh, Third Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach kahai baynantee sach milai gun  gaavan i-aa. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਠਾਿਕ ਰਹਾਏ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: By His Mercy, we meet the True Guru. pMnw 110
lines.transliteration: karam hovai satguroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat sabad  chit laa-ay.

lines.english: Subduing your ego, you shall find a lasting peace, and your emotional attachment to Maya will be dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar sadaa sukh  paa-i-aa maa-i-aa moh chukaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, I am totally devoted to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree satgur kai balihaarn i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Divine Light has dawned; I sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee pargaas ho-aa jee an-d in har gun  gaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਜੀ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Search your body and mind, and find the Name.
lines.transliteration: tan man kh ojay t aa naa-o paa-ay.

lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ai thaak rahaa-ay. Restrain your wandering mind, and keep it in check.
Night and day, sing the Songs of the Guru's Bani; worship the Lord with intuitivedevotion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee an-d in gaavai sehjay bh agat karaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Within this body are countless objects.
lines.transliteration: is kaa-i-aa andar vasat  asankh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh attains Truth, and comes to see them.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saach milai t aa vaykh aa.

lines.english: Beyond the nine gates, the Tenth Gate is found, and liberation is obtained. TheUnstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates. ||3||
lines.transliteration: na-o darvaajay d asvai mukt aa anhad  sabad  vajaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: True is the Master, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ  ਦਸਵੈ  ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasaa-ee.

lines.english: Night and day, remain attuned to the Lord's Love forever, and you shall obtainunderstanding in the True Court. ||4||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa rahai rang raat aa dar sachai sojh ee paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Those who do not understand the nature of sin and virtue
lines.transliteration: paap punn kee saar na jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: doojai laagee bh aram bh ulaan ee. are attached to duality; they wander around deluded.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The ignorant and blind people do not know the way; they come and go inreincarnation over and over again. ||5||
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee anDhaa mag na jaan ai fir fir aavan  jaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the Guru, I have found eternal peace;
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa thaak rahaa-i-aa. my ego has been silenced and subdued.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness has been dispelled, and the heavy doorshave been opened. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee miti-aa anDh i-aaraa bajar kapaat kh ulaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Subduing my ego, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.
