lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ  ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਅੰਿਧਆਰਾ  ਬਜਰ  ਕਪਾਟ  ਖੁਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet forever.
lines.transliteration: gur charnee sad aa chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, my mind and body are immaculate and pure; I meditate on theImmaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay man t an nirmal nirmal naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: From birth to death, everything is for You.
lines.transliteration: jeevan marn aa sabh  tuDhai taa-ee.

lines.english: You bestow greatness upon those whom You have forgiven.
lines.transliteration: jis bakhsay t is day vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditating forever on the Naam, you shall be blessed in both birth anddeath. ||8||1||2|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (110-12) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay sad aa tooN jaman  maran  savaarn i-aa. ||8||1||2||

lines.english: My God is Immaculate, Inaccessible and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh nirmal agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਸਵਾਰਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: Without a scale, He weighs the universe.
lines.transliteration: bin takrh ee tolai sansaaraa.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands. Chanting His Glorious Praises, he is absorbed into the Lord of Virtue. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so-ee boojh ai gun  kahi gun ee samaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the Nameof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree har kaa naam man vasaavani-aa.

lines.english: Those who are committed to Truth remain awake and aware night and day. They arehonored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo sach laagay say an-din jaagay d ar sachai sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਹ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.
lines.transliteration: aap sunai t ai aapay vaykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, become acceptable.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so-ee jan laykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਿਚ ਲਾਗੇ  ਸੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: They are attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches; as Gurmukh, they live the Truth.||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay laa-ay la-ay so laagai gurmukh sach kamaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads-whose hand can they take?
lines.transliteration: jis aap bhulaa-ay so kithai hath paa-ay.

lines.english: That which is pre-ordained, cannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa so maytn aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who meet the True Guru are very fortunate and blessed; through perfectkarma, He is met. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin satgur mili-aa say vadbh aagee poorai karam milaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: The young bride is fast asleep in her parents' home, night and day.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai Dh an an-d in sut ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਲਾਇ  ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She has forgotten her Husband Lord; because of her faults and demerits, she is abandoned.
lines.transliteration: kant visaaree avgan  mutee.

lines.english: She wanders around continually, crying out, night and day. Without her HusbandLord, she cannot get any sleep. ||4||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa firai billaad ee bin pir need  na paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: In this world of her parents' home, she may come to know the Giver of peace,
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai sukh -daata jaat aa.
ha-umai maar gur sabad pachh aataa. if she subdues her ego, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.english: Her bed is beautiful; she ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord forever. She is adorned with the Decorations of Truth. ||5|| pMnw 111
lines.transliteration: sayj suhaavee sadaa pir raavay sach seegaar ban aavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: He created the 8.4 million species of beings.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jee-a upaa-ay.

lines.english: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, come to meet the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay t is guroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: Shedding their sins, His servants are forever pure; at the True Court, they are beautified by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh kaat sad aa jan nirmal d ar sachai naam suhaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: When they are called to settle their accounts, who will answer then?
lines.transliteration: laykhaa maagai t aa kin d ee-ai.

lines.english: There shall be no peace then, from counting out by twos and threes.
lines.transliteration: sukh naahee fun d oo-ai t ee-ai.

lines.english: The True Lord God Himself forgives, and having forgiven, He unites them withHimself. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas la-ay parabh  saachaa aapay bakh as milaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself does, and He Himself causes all to be done.
lines.transliteration: aap karay tai aap karaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is met.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad milaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. He Himself unites in His Union.||8||2||3|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (111-5) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee aapay mayl milaavani-aa. ||8||2||3||

lines.english: The One Lord Himself moves about imperceptibly.
lines.transliteration: iko aap firai parchhannaa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I see Him, and then this mind is pleased and uplifted.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vaykh aa taa ih man bh innaa.

lines.english: Renouncing desire, I have found intuitive peace and poise; I have enshrined the One within my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa t aj sahj sukh  paa-i-aa ayko man vasaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on theOne.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree ikas si-o chit laavan i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, my mind has come to its only home; it is imbued withthe True Color of the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee man ikat  ghar aa-i-aa sachai rang rangaavin -aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਤਿਜ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਏਕੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This world is deluded; You Yourself have deluded it.
lines.transliteration: ih jag bhoolaa t aiN aap bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਇਕਸੁ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the One, it has become engrossed in duality.
lines.transliteration: ik visaar doojai lobh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, it wanders around endlessly, deluded by doubt; without the Name, itsuffers in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa firai bh aram bh oolaa bin naavai d ukh paavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord, the Architect of Destiny
lines.transliteration: jo rang raatay karam biDh aatay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਤੈਂ ਆਿਪ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay jug chaaray jaat ay. -by serving the Guru, they are known throughout the four ages.

lines.english: Those, upon whom the Lord bestows greatness, are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis no aap day-ay vadi-aa-ee har kai naam samaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਫਰੈ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭ ੂਲਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Being in love with Maya, they do not think of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi har chaytai naahee.

lines.english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they suffer in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: jampur baDhaa d ukh sahaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Blind and deaf, they see nothing at all; the self-willed manmukhs rot away in sin. ||4||
lines.transliteration: annaa bolaa kichh nad ar na aavai manmukh  paap pachaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਦੇਇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those, whom You attach to Your Love, are attuned to Your Love.
lines.transliteration: ik rang raatay jo t uDh aap liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Through loving devotional worship, they become pleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay bh agat tayrai man bh aa-ay.

lines.english: They serve the True Guru, the Giver of eternal peace, and all their desires are fulfilled.||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan sad aa sukh -daata sabh  ichhaa aap pujaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨਾ  ਬੋਲਾ  ਿਕਛੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਪਾਿਪ  ਪਚਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary forever.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tayree sad aa sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself forgive us, and bless us with Glorious Greatness.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsihi d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal tis nayrh  na aavai jo har har naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭ ਇਛਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਪੁਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are attuned to His Love; they are pleasing to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din raat ay jo har bh aa-ay.

lines.english: My God merges with them, and unites them in Union.
lines.transliteration: mayrai parabh maylay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; You Yourselfinspire us to understand the Truth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sachay t ayree sarn aa-ee t ooN aapay sach bujh aavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who know the Truth are absorbed in Truth.
lines.transliteration: jin sach jaataa say sach samaan ay.

lines.english: They sing the Lord's Glorious Praises, and speak the Truth.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi sach vakh aanay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain unattached and balanced; in thehome of the inner self, they are absorbed in the primal trance of deep meditation.||8||3||4|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (111-16) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay bairaagee nij gh ar taarhee laavan i-aa. ||8||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad is truly dead.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai so mu-aa jaapai.

lines.english: Death does not crush him, and pain does not afflict him.
lines.transliteration: kaal na chaapai dukh  na sant aapai.

lines.english: His light merges and is absorbed into the Light, when he hears and merges in the Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jotee vich mil jot  samaan ee sun  man sach samaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Lord's Name, which brings us to glory.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree har kai naa-ay sobhaa paavn i-aa.

lines.english: One who serves the True Guru, and focuses his consciousness on Truth, following theGuru's Teachings, is absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sach chit  laa-i-aa gurmat ee sahj samaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This human body is transitory, and transitory are the garments it wears.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kachee kachaa cheer handhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਚਾਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to duality, no one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. pMnw 112
lines.transliteration: doojai laagee mahal na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਲਦੀ  ਿਫਰੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Night and day, day and night, they burn. Without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride suffers in terrible pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din jald ee firai d in raat ee bin pir baho d ukh paavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Her body and her status shall not go with her to the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: dayhee jaat  na aagai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Where she is called to answer for her account, there, she shall be emancipated only by true actions.
lines.transliteration: jithai laykhaa mangee-ai t ithai chh utai sach kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ  ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru shall prosper; here and hereafter, they are absorbedin the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan say Dh anvant ay aithai othai naam samaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: She who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aa-ay seegaar ban aa-ay.
gur parsaadee mahal ghar paa-ay. by Guru's Grace, obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as her home.

lines.english: Night and day, day and night, she constantly ravishes and enjoys her Beloved. She isdyed in the permanent color of His Love. ||4||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa ravai d in raat ee majeeth ai rang ban aavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਬਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Husband Lord abides with everyone, always;
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa pir vasai sad aa naalay.
gur parsaadee ko nadar nihaalay. but how rare are those few who, by Guru's Grace, obtain His Glance of Grace.

lines.english: My God is the Highest of the High; granting His Grace, He merges us into Himself.||5||
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh at  oocho oochaa kar kirpaa aap milaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਤ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: This world is asleep in emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi ih jag sutaa.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it ultimately comes to ruin.
lines.transliteration: naam visaar ant vigut aa.

lines.english: The One who put it to sleep shall also awaken it. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding dawns. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jis tay sut aa so jaagaa-ay gurmat  sojhee paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੋ ਜਾਗਾਏ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who drinks in this Nectar, shall have his delusions dispelled.
lines.transliteration: api-o pee-ai so bharam gavaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the state of liberation is attained.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad mukat  gat paa-ay.

lines.english: One who is imbued with devotion to the Lord, remains always balanced and detached.Subduing selfishness and conceit, he is united with the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee rat aa sad aa bairaagee aap maar milaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself creates, and He Himself assigns us to our tasks.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay DhanDh ai laa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself gives sustenance to the 8.4 million species of beings.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-uraasee rijak aap aprh aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam are atuned to Truth. They do that which is pleasing to His Will. ||8||4||5|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (112-9) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay sach raat ay jo t is bhaavai so kaar karaavan i-aa. ||8||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Diamonds and rubies are produced deep within the self.
lines.transliteration: andar heeraa laal ban aa-i-aa.

lines.english: They are assayed and valued tthrough the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad parakh  parkh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who have gathered Truth, speak Truth; they apply the Touch-stone of Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin sach palai sach vakaaneh sach kasvatee laavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Word of the Guru'sBani within their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree gur kee banee man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ  ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the midst of the darkness of the world, they obtain the Immaculate One, and theirlight merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anjan maahi niranjan paa-i-aa jotee jot  milaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Within this body are countless vast vistas;
lines.transliteration: is kaa-i-aa andar bahut  pasaaraa.
naam niranjan at agam apaaraa. the Immaculate Naam is totally Inaccessible and Infinite.

lines.english: He alone becomes Gurmukh and obtains it, whom the Lord forgives, and unites withHimself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so-ee paa-ay aapay bakh as milaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: My Lord and Master implants the Truth.
lines.transliteration: mayraa thaakur sach drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one's consciousness is attached to the Truth.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sach chit laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; the true ones merge in Truth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sacho sach vartai sabh nee thaa-ee sachay sach samaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The True Carefree Lord is my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: vayparvaahu sach mayraa pi-aaraa.

lines.english: He cuts out our sinful mistakes and evil actions;
lines.transliteration: kilvikh avgan  kaatan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭਨੀ  ਥਾਈ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paraym pareet sad aa Dh i-aa-ee-ai bh ai bhaa-ay bh agat darirhaavni-aa. ||4|| with love and affection, meditate forever on Him. He implants the Fear of God andloving devotional worship within us. ||4||

lines.english: Devotional worship is True, if it pleases the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat sachee jay sachay bh aavai.

lines.english: He Himself bestows it; He does not regret it later.
lines.transliteration: aapay day-ay na pachh otaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He alone is the Giver of all beings. The Lord kills with the Word of His Shabad, andthen revives. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa jee-aa kaa ayko d aataa sabd ay maar jeevaavn i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਚੀ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Other than You, Lord, nothing is mine.
lines.transliteration: har tuDh  baajh ahu mai ko-ee naahee.

lines.english: I serve You, Lord, and I praise You.
lines.transliteration: har tuDh ai sayvee t ai tuDh saalaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: You unite me with Yourself, O True God. Through perfect good karma You are obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl laihu parabh saachay poorai karam t ooN paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: For me, there is no other like You.
lines.transliteration: mai hor na ko-ee tuDh ai jayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਧੈ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: By Your Glance of Grace, my body is blessed and sanctified.
lines.transliteration: tayree nad ree seejh as dayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਹੁਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Night and day, the Lord takes care of us and protects us. The Gurmukhs are absorbedin intuitive peace and poise. ||7||
lines.transliteration: an-din saar samaal har raakh ahi gurmukh  sahj samaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
lines.english: For me, there is no other as Great as You.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad mai hor na ko-ee.

lines.english: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy. pMnw 113
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay sirjee aapay go-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਘਿੜ  ਭੰਿਨ ਸਵਾਰਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: You Yourself create, destroy and adorn. O Nanak, we are adorned and embellished with the Naam. ||8||5||6|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (113-1) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay hee gh arh bhann savaareh naanak naam suhaavan i-aa. ||8||5||6||

lines.english: He is the Enjoyer of all hearts.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at aapay bh oganhaaraa.

lines.english: The Invisible, Inaccessible and Infinite is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: alakh vart ai agam apaaraa.

lines.english: Meditating on my Lord God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am intuitively absorbed in the Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad mayraa har parabh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai sehjay sach samaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who implant the Word of the Guru'sShabad in their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree gur sabad man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: When someone understands the Shabad, then he wrestles with his own mind;subduing his desires, he merges with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabad soojh ai taa man si-o loojh ai mansaa maar samaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਿਸਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The five enemies are plundering the world.
lines.transliteration: panch doot  muheh sansaaraa.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand or appreciate this.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay suDh  na saaraa.

lines.english: Those who become Gurmukh-their houses are protected. The five enemies aredestroyed by the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so apn aa gh ar raakh ai panch d oot sabad  pachaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are forever imbued with love for the True One.
lines.transliteration: ik gurmukh sad aa sachai rang raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਚਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They serve God with intuitive ease. Night and day, they are intoxicated with His Love.
lines.transliteration: sehjay parabh sayveh an-d in maat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with their Beloved, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True one; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam sachay gun  gaavahi har d ar sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: First, the One created Himself;
lines.transliteration: aykam aykai aap upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa doojaa t aribaDh  maa-i-aa. second, the sense of duality; third, the three-phased Maya.

lines.english: The fourth state, the highest, is obtained by the Gurmukh, who practices Truth, andonly Truth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: cha-uthee pa-orhee gurmukh  oochee sacho sach kamaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Everything which is pleasing to the True Lord is true.
lines.transliteration: sabh hai sachaa jay sachay bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੀ  ਪਉੜੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਊਚੀ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who know the Truth merge in intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: jin sach jaataa so sahj samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The life-style of the Gurmukh is to serve the True Lord. He goes and blends with theTrue Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karn ee sachay sayveh saachay jaa-ay samaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Without the True One, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: sachay baajhahu ko avar na d oo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਾਚੇ ਜਾਇ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Attached to duality, the world is distracted and distressed to death.
lines.transliteration: doojai laag jag kh ap kh ap moo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh knows only the One. Serving the One, peace is obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so ayko jaan ai ayko sayv sukh  paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਿਗ  ਜਗੁ ਖਿਪ ਖਿਪ ਮੂਆ ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures are in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  saran  tumaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਏਕੋ ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: You place the chessmen on the board; You see the imperfect and the perfect as well.
lines.transliteration: aapay Dhar d aykheh kachee pakee saaree.

lines.english: Night and day, You cause people to act; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||7||
lines.transliteration: an-din aapay kaar karaa-ay aapay mayl milaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਧਿਰ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਕਚੀ  ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself unite, and You see Yourself close at hand.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay mayleh vaykh eh had oor.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You Yourself are totally pervading amongst all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh aap rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: O Nanak, God Himself is pervading and permeating everywhere; only the Gurmukhsunderstand this. ||8||6||7|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (113-13) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay aap vartai gurmukh  sojhee paavn i-aa. ||8||6||7||

lines.english: The Nectar of the Guru's Bani is very sweet.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee gur kee meeth ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Rare are the Gurmukhs who see and taste it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlai kinai chakh  deeth ee.

lines.english: The Divine Light dawns within, and the supreme essence is found. In the True Court, the Word of the Shabad vibrates. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar pargaas mahaa ras peevai d ar sachai sabad  vajaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on theGuru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree gur charnee chit  laavan i-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru is the True Pool of Nectar; bathing in it, the mind is washed clean of allfilth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur hai amrit  sar saachaa man naavai mail chukaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your limits, O True Lord, are not known to anyone.
lines.transliteration: tayraa sachay kinai ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, focus their consciousness on You.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kinai virlai chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Praising You, I am never satisfied; such is the hunger I feel for the True Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tuDh saalaahi na rajaa kabahooN sachay naavai kee bh ukh laavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਸਰ ੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I see only the One, and no other.
lines.transliteration: ayko vaykhaa avar na bee-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee amrit pee-aa.

lines.english: My thirst is quenched by the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I am absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad t ikhaa nivaaree sehjay sookh  samaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Priceless Jewel is discarded like straw;
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath palar t i-aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਨ ਰਜਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa doojai bh aa-ay laagai. the blind self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

lines.english: As they plant, so do they harvest. They shall not obtain peace, even in their dreams.||4||
lines.transliteration: jo beejai so-ee fal paa-ay supnai sukh na paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Those who are blessed with His Mercy find the Lord.
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa karay so-ee jan paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਤਖਾ ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੂਿਖ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind. pMnw 114
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, they remain in the Fear of God; conquering their fears, their doubts are dispelled. ||5||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa rahai bh ai and ar bhai maar bh aram chukaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਭੈ ਮਾਿਰ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Dispelling their doubts, they find a lasting peace.
lines.transliteration: bharam chukaa-i-aa sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is attained.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Deep within, they are pure, and their words are pure as well; intuitively, they sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: antar nirmal nirmal ban ee har gun  sehjay gaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: They recite the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  bayd  vakh aanai.
bharmay bh oolaa t at na jaan ai. but deluded by doubt, they do not understand the essence of reality.

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, they find no peace; they earn only pain and misery. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay sukh  na paa-ay d ukho dukh kamaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself acts; unto whom should we complain?
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhai ko-ee.

lines.english: How can anyone complain that the Lord has made a mistake?
lines.transliteration: aakhan  jaa-ee-ai jay bh oolaa ho-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself does, and causes things to be done; chanting the Naam, we are absorbed in the Naam. ||8||7||8|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (114-5) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay karay karaa-ay naamay naam samaavani-aa. ||8||7||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੭॥੮॥
lines.english: He Himself imbues us with His Love, with effortless ease.
lines.transliteration: aapay rangay sahj subhaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har rang charh aa-ay.

lines.english: This mind and body are so imbued, and this tongue is dyed in the deep crimson colorof the poppy. Through the Love and the Fear of God, we are dyed in this color. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan rat aa rasnaa rang chaloolee bh ai bhaa-ay rang charh aavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Fearless Lord withintheir minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree nirbha-o man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੀ  ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Fearless Lord; the Shabad has carried me acrossthe poisonous world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay har nirbh a-o Dh i-aa-i-aa bikh  bha-ojal sabad  taraavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The idiotic self-willed manmukhs try to be clever,
lines.transliteration: manmukh mugaDh  karahi chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਸਬਿਦ ਤਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naataa Dh otaa thaa-ay na paa-ee. but in spite of their bathing and washing, they shall not be acceptable.

lines.english: As they came, so shall they go, regretting the mistakes they made. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jayhaa aa-i-aa tayhaa jaasee kar avgan  pachh otaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything;
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay kichh oo na soojh ai.
maran likh aa-ay aa-ay nahee boojh ai. death was pre-ordained for them when they came into the world, but they do not understand.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਆਇਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਜਾਸੀ  ਕਿਰ ਅਵਗਣ  ਪਛੋਤਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs may practice religious rituals, but they do not obtain theName; without the Name, they lose this life in vain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam karay nahee paa-ay bin naavai janam gavaavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The practice of Truth is the essence of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sach karnee sabad  hai saar.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, the gate of salvation is found.
lines.transliteration: poorai gur paa-ee-ai mokh d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: So, night and day, listen to the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad. Let yourselfbe colored by this love. ||4||
lines.transliteration: an-din ban ee sabad  sunaa-ay sach raat ay rang rangaavin -aa. ||4||

lines.english: The tongue, imbued with the Lord's Essence, delights in His Love.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har ras raatee rang laa-ay.

lines.english: My mind and body are enticed by the Lord's Sublime Love.
lines.transliteration: man tan mohi-aa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: I have easily obtained my Darling Beloved; I am intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sehjay pareetam pi-aaraa paa-i-aa sehjay sahj milaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਾਤੀ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have the Lord's Love within, sing His Glorious Praises;
lines.transliteration: jis andar rang so-ee gun  gaavai.
gur kai sabad sehjay sukh  samaavai. through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are intuitively absorbed in celestialpeace.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who dedicate their consciousness to the Guru'sService. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree sadaa t in vitahu gur sayvaa chit  laavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: The True Lord is pleased with Truth, and only Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sacho sach pateejai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one's inner being is deeply imbued with His Love.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee andar bh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਸਦਾ ਿਤਨ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Sitting in that blessed place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, who Himselfinspires us to accept His Truth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bais suthaan har gun gaavahi aapay kar sat  manaavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: That one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtains it.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so paa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, egotism departs.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ha-umai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਿਸ ਸੁਥਾਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਮਨਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that one, within whose mind the Name dwells, is honored in the True Court. ||8||8||9|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (114-17) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar d ar sachai sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||8||8||9||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru is the greatest greatness.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: The Dear Lord automatically comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: har jee achint vasai man aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੮॥੯॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the fruit-bearing tree; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, thirst isquenched. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o safli-o birakh hai amrit  jin peet aa tis tikhaa lahaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the one who leads me to join the TrueCongregation.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree sach sangat mayl milaavan i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord Himself unites me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Through theWord of the Guru's Shabad, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 115
lines.transliteration: har satsangat  aapay maylai gur sabd ee har gun  gaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I serve the True Guru; the Word of His Shabad is beautiful.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvee sabad  suhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through it, the Name of the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Pure Lord removes the filth of egotism, and we are honored in the True Court.||2||
lines.transliteration: har nirmal ha-umai mail gavaa-ay dar sachai sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Guru, the Naam cannot be obtained.
lines.transliteration: bin gur naam na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Siddhas and the seekers lack it; they weep and wail.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik rahay billaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained; through perfect destiny, the Guru is found. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sayvay sukh na hovee poorai bh aag gur paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: This mind is a mirror; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, see themselves in it.
lines.transliteration: ih man aarsee ko-ee gurmukh vaykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਰਚਾ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸੋਖੈ ॥
lines.english: Rust does not stick to those who burn their ego.
lines.transliteration: morchaa na laagai jaa ha-umai sokhai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody of the Bani resounds through the Pure Word of the Shabad;through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are absorbed into the True One. ||4||
lines.transliteration: anhat ban ee nirmal sabad  vajaa-ay gur sabd ee sach samaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Without the True Guru, the Lord cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kihu na d aykhi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He Himself has allowed me to see Him.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa kar aap dit aa dikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਿਲ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: All by Himself, He Himself is permeating and pervading; He is intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay aap aap mil rahi-aa sehjay sahj samaavani-aa. ||5||

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh embraces love for the One.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so ikas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Doubt and duality are burned away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aram gur sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵਣਜੁ  ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Within his body, he deals and trades, and obtains the Treasure of the True Name.||6||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar van aj karay vaapaaraa naam niDh aan sach paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: The life-style of the Gurmukh is sublime; he sings the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karn ee har keerat  saar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh finds the gate of salvation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ay mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Night and day, he is imbued with the Lord's Love. He sings the Lord's Glorious Praises,and he is called to the Mansion of His Presence. ||7||
lines.transliteration: an-din rang rat aa gun  gaavai and ar mahal bulaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord leads us to meet Him.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa milai milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through perfect destiny, the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag man sabad  vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੯॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by chanting the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||8||9||10|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (115-10) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee har sachay kay gun gaavan i-aa. ||8||9||10||

lines.english: Those who lose their own selves obtain everything.
lines.transliteration: aap vanjaa-ay t aa sabh  kichh  paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enshrine Love for the True one.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee sachee liv laa-ay.

lines.english: They trade in Truth, they gather in Truth, and they deal only in Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach vanaNjahi sach sangh rahi sach vaapaar karaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਸੰਘਰਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰ ੁ ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of theLord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree har gun an-d in gaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am Yours, You are my Lord and Master. You bestow greatness through the Word ofYour Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tayraa t ooN thaakur mayraa sabad  vadi-aa-ee d ayvan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੇਵਿਣਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That time, that moment is totally beautiful,
lines.transliteration: vaylaa vakhat  sabh  suhaa-i-aa.
jit sachaa mayray man bh aa-i-aa. when the True One becomes pleasing to my mind.

lines.english: Serving the True One, true greatness is obtained. By Guru's Grace, the True One is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sachay sayvi-ai sach vadi-aa-ee gur kirpaa tay sach paavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The food of spiritual love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh ojan sat gur tuthai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸਚੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Other essences are forgotten, when the Lord's Essence comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: an ras chookai har ras man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Truth, contentment and intuitive peace and poise are obtained from the Bani, theWord of the Perfect Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sach santokh  sahj sukh  banee pooray gur t ay paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The blind and ignorant fools do not serve the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: satgur na sayveh moorakh  anDh  gavaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: fir o-ay kithhu paa-in mokh d u-aaraa. how will they find the gate of salvation?

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: They die and die, over and over again, only to be reborn, over and over again. Theyare struck down at Death's Door. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh fir fir aavahi jam dar chotaa kh aavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Those who know the essence of the Shabad, understand their own selves.
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  jaaneh taa aap pachh aaneh.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Immaculate is the speech of those who chant the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: nirmal banee sabad  vakaan eh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਤਾ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachay sayv sadaa sukh  paa-in na-o niDh  naam man vasaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Beautiful is that place, which is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.
lines.transliteration: so thaan suhaa-i-aa jo har man bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: There, sitting in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Glorious Praises of theLord are sung.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  bahi har gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, the True One is praised; the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naadresounds there. ||6|| pMnw 116
lines.transliteration: an-din har saalaahahi saachaa nirmal naad  vajaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: The wealth of the self-willed manmukhs is false, and false is their ostentatious display.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kh otee raas kh otaa paasaaraa.

lines.english: They practice falsehood, and suffer terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: koorh kamaavan d ukh laagai bh aaraa.

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; through birth and death, they lose their lives. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolay firan d in raat ee mar janmeh janam gavaavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੇ  ਭੂਲੇ ਿਫਰਿਨ  ਿਦਨ  ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: My True Lord and Master is very dear to me.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib mai at pi-aaraa.

lines.english: The Shabad of the Perfect Guru is my Support.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad aDh aaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who obtains the Greatness of the Naam, looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same. ||8||10||11|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (116-3) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee dukh  sukh  sam kar jaann i-aa. ||8||10||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The four sources of creation are Yours; the spoken word is Yours.
lines.transliteration: tayree-aa kh aanee tayree-aa ban ee.

lines.english: Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh bh aram bh ulaan ee.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, no one canreceive it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay har naam paa-i-aa bin sat gur ko-ay na paavn i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on theLord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree har saytee chit  laavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through devotion to the Guru, the True One is found; He comes to abide in the mind,with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har sachaa gur bhagt ee paa-ee-ai sehjay man vasaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, all things are obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa sabh  kichh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As are the desires one harbors, so are the rewards one receives.
lines.transliteration: jayhee mansaa kar laagai tayhaa fal paa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of all things; through perfect destiny, He is met. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa sabh naa vathoo kaa poorai bh aag milaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: This mind is filthy and polluted; it does not meditate on the One.
lines.transliteration: ih man mailaa ik na Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ  ਕਿਰ ਲਾਗੈ  ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Deep within, it is soiled and stained by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: antar mail laagee baho d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਵਥੂ ਕਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The egotists may go on pilgrimages to holy rivers, sacred shrines and foreign lands, but they only gather more of the dirt of egotism. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tat tirath disant ar bhavai ahaNkaaree hor vaDh ayrai ha-umai mal laavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, filth and pollution are removed.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa mal jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those who focus their consciousness on the Lord remain dead while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai har si-o chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਟ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਿਦਸੰਤਿਰ  ਭਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ਹੋਰੁ ਵਧੇਰੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Lord is Pure; no filth sticks to Him. Those who are attached to the True Onehave their filth washed away. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har nirmal sach mail na laagai sach laagai mail gavaavni-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo hai anDh  gubaaraa.

lines.english: The ignorant ones are blind-there is only utter darkness for them.
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee anDhaa anDh  anDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਚੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਿਚ ਲਾਗੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The maggots in manure do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot and putrefy. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bistaa kay keerhay bistaa kamaaveh fir bistaa maahi pachaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the Lord of Liberation, liberation is achieved.
lines.transliteration: muktay sayvay mukt aa hovai.

lines.english: The Word of the Shabad eradicates egotism and possessiveness.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa sabd ay kh ovai.

lines.english: So serve the Dear True Lord, night and day. By perfect good destiny, the Guru is found. ||6||
lines.transliteration: an-din har jee-o sachaa sayvee poorai bh aag gur paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: He Himself forgives and unites in His Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, the Treasure of the Naam is obtained.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay naam niDh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: By the True Name, the mind is made true forever. Serving the True Lord, sorrow isdriven out. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sachai naam sadaa man sachaa sach sayvay d ukh gavaavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: He is always close at hand-do not think that He is far away.
lines.transliteration: sadaa hajoor d oor na jaan hu.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Lord deep within your own being.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har ant ar pachh aanhu.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is received. Through the Perfect Guru,the Naam is obtained. ||8||11||12|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (116-15) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee pooray gur tay paavn i-aa. ||8||11||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who are True here, are True hereafter as well.
lines.transliteration: aithai saachay so aagai saachay.

lines.english: That mind is true, which is attuned to the True Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man sachaa sachai sabad raachay.

lines.english: They serve the True One, and practice Truth; they earn Truth, and only Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachaa sayveh sach kamaaveh sacho sach kamaavani-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧੧॥੧੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree sachaa naam man vasaavani-aa.

lines.english: They serve the True One, and are absorbed into the True One, singing the GloriousPraises of the True One. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sachay sayveh sach samaaveh sachay kay gun gaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars read, but they do not taste the essence.
lines.transliteration: pandit parh eh saad  na paavahi.

lines.english: In love with duality and Maya, their minds wander, unfocused.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay maa-i-aa man bh armaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The love of Maya has displaced all their understanding; making mistakes, they live in regret. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi sabh suDh  gavaa-ee kar avgan  pachh otaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: But if they should meet the True Guru, then they obtain the essence of reality;
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t aa tat paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaa-ay. the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in their minds. pMnw 117

lines.english: Those who die in the Shabad and subdue their own minds, obtain the door of liberation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad marai man maarai apunaa mukt ee kaa d ar paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਮੁਕਤੀ  ਕਾ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They erase their sins, and eliminate their anger;
lines.transliteration: kilvikh kaatai kroDh  nivaaray.
gur kaa sabad rakh ai ur Dh aaray. they keep the Guru's Shabad clasped tightly to their hearts.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to Truth, remain balanced and detached forever. Subduing their egotism, they are united with the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sach ratay sad aa bairaagee ha-umai maar milaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Deep within the nucleus of the self is the jewel; we receive it only if the Lord inspiresus to receive it.
lines.transliteration: antar rat an milai milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The mind is bound by the three dispositions-the three modes of Maya.
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  mansaa t aribaDh  maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Reading and reciting, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages havegrown weary, but they have not found the supreme essence of the fourth state. ||5||
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  monee thakay cha-uthay pad  kee saar na paavn i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਚਉਥੇ  ਪਦ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself dyes us in the color of His Love.
lines.transliteration: aapay rangay rang charhaa-ay.

lines.english: Only those who are steeped in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are so imbued with HisLove.
lines.transliteration: say jan raatay gur sabad  rangaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰੰਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the most beautiful color of the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praisesof the Lord, with great pleasure and joy. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har rang charhi-aa at  apaaraa har ras ras gun  gaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਿੜਆ  ਅਿਤ  ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: To the Gurmukh, the True Lord is wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and strict self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh riDh  siDh sach sanjam so-ee.

lines.english: Through the spiritual wisdom of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukh is liberated.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan naam mukat  ho-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kaar sach kamaaveh sachay sach samaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes that the Lord alone creates, and having created, He destroys.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh thaapay thaap uthaapay.

lines.english: To the Gurmukh, the Lord Himself is social class, status and all honor.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaat  pat sabh  aapay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; through the Naam, they merge in theNaam. ||8||12||13|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (117-8) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ay naamay naam samaavan i-aa. ||8||12||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧੨॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Creation and destruction happen through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: utpat parla-o sabd ay hovai.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, creation happens again.
lines.transliteration: sabday hee fir opat  hovai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows that the True Lord is all-pervading. The Gurmukh understandscreation and merger. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vart ai sabh  aapay sachaa gurmukh  upaa-ay samaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Perfect Guru within their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree gur pooraa man vasaavani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From the Guru comes peace and tranquility; worship Him with devotion, day andnight. Chanting His Glorious Praises, merge into the Glorious Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur tay saat  bhagat karay d in raat ee gun  kahi gun ee samaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh sees the Lord on the earth, and the Gurmukh sees Him in the water.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh Dh artee gurmukh  paan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਿਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਣ ਕਿਹ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh sees Him in wind and fire; such is the wonder of His Play.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pavan  baisant ar khaylai vidaan ee.

lines.english: One who has no Guru, dies over and over again, only to be re-born. One who has noGuru continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so niguraa jo mar mar jammai niguray aavan jaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The One Creator has set this play in motion.
lines.transliteration: tin kart ai ik kh ayl rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the frame of the human body, He has placed all things.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa sareerai vich sabh kichh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਨਗੁਰਾ  ਜੋ ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਿਨਗੁਰੇ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those few who are pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, obtain the Mansion ofthe Lord's Presence. He calls them into His Wondrous Palace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad bh ayd ko-ee mahal paa-ay mahlay mahal bulaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: True is the Banker, and true are His traders.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu sachay vanjaaray.

lines.english: They purchase Truth, with infinite love for the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sach vanaNjahi gur hayt  apaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਭੇਿਦ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਏ ਮਹਲੇ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They deal in Truth, and they practice Truth. They earn Truth, and only Truth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sach vihaajheh sach kamaaveh sacho sach kamaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Without investment capital, how can anyone acquire merchandise?
lines.transliteration: bin raasee ko vath ki-o paa-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have all gone astray.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay lok sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਵਹਾਝਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without true wealth, everyone goes empty-handed; going empty-handed, they sufferin pain. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin raasee sabh kh aalee chalay kh aalee jaa-ay d ukh paavn i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Some deal in Truth, through love of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ik sach vanaNjahi gur sabad  pi-aaray.

lines.english: They save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well.
lines.transliteration: aap tareh saglay kul t aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ  ਸਭ ਖਾਲੀ  ਚਲੇ ਖਾਲੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Very auspicious is the coming of those who meet their Beloved and find peace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay say parvaan ho-ay mil pareet am sukh  paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Deep within the self is the secret, but the fool looks for it outside.
lines.transliteration: antar vasat  moorh aa baahar bh aalay.

lines.english: The blind self-willed manmukhs wander around like demons;
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay fireh bayt aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਏ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੋਏ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai vath hovai tithhu ko-ay na paavai manmukh  bharam bh ulaavan i-aa. ||7|| but where the secret is, there, they do not find it. The manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||7||

lines.english: He Himself calls us, and bestows the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay dayvai sabad  bulaa-ay.

lines.english: The soul-bride finds intuitive peace and poise in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: mahlee mahal sahj sukh paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, she obtains the glorious greatness of the Naam; she hears it again andagain, and she meditates on it. ||8||13||14|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (117-19) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee aapay sun sun  Dhi-aavan i-aa. ||8||13||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਤਥਹ ੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The True Guru has imparted the True Teachings. pMnw 118
lines.transliteration: satgur saachee sikh  sunaa-ee.

lines.english: Think of the Lord, who shall be your Help and Support in the end.
lines.transliteration: har chaytahu ant  ho-ay sakh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. He has no master, and He is not born. He is obtained through love of the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar anaath ajonee satgur kai bh aa-ay paavn i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ  ਅਜੋਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who eliminate selfishness and conceit.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree aap nivaarni-aa.

lines.english: They eradicate selfishness and conceit, and then find the Lord; they are intuitivelyimmersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-ay taa har paa-ay har si-o sahj samaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: According to their pre-ordained destiny, they act out their karma.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa so karam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without good fortune, the Guru is not found. Through the Word of the Shabad, theyare united in the Lord's Union. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur paa-ee-ai naahee sabd ai mayl milaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected in the midst of the world.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh alipat  rahai sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਬਦੈ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru is their cushion, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is their Support.
lines.transliteration: gur kai takee-ai naam aDh aaray.

lines.english: Who can oppress the Gurmukh? One who tries shall perish, writhing in pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jor karay ki-aa t is no aapay kh ap dukh paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The blind self-willed manmukhs have no understanding at all.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay suDh  na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਕਆ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਖਿਪ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They are the assassins of the self, and the butchers of the world.
lines.transliteration: aatam gh aatee hai jagat  kasaa-ee.

lines.english: By continually slandering others, they carry a terrible load, and they carry the loads of others for nothing. ||4||
lines.transliteration: nindaa kar kar baho bh aar uth aavai bin majooree bh aar pahuchaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: This world is a garden, and my Lord God is the Gardener.
lines.transliteration: ih jag vaarhee mayraa parabh  maalee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਬਹੁਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਿਬਨ ੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ  ਭਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He always takes care of it-nothing is exempt from His Care.
lines.transliteration: sadaa samaalay ko naahee kh aalee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਾੜੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: As is the fragrance which He bestows, so is the fragrant flower known. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jayhee vaasnaa paa-ay tayhee vart ai vaasoo vaas jan aavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are sick and diseased in the world.
lines.transliteration: manmukh rogee hai sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ  ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ  ਵਾਸੂ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata visri-aa agam apaaraa.

lines.english: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, theyfind no peace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: dukhee-ay nit  fireh billaad ay bin gur saaNt na paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: The One who created them, knows their condition.
lines.transliteration: jin keetay so-ee biDh  jaanai.

lines.english: And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: aap karay taa hukam pachh aanai.

lines.english: Whatever He places within them, that is wh at prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jayhaa andar paa-ay t ayhaa vart ai aapay baahar paavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: I know of no other except the True One.
lines.transliteration: tis baajh ahu sachay mai hor na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.
lines.transliteration: jis laa-ay la-ay so nirmal ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਬਾਝਹ ੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the heart of those,unto whom He has given it. ||8||14||15|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (118-12) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat ant ar jis d ayvai so paavn i-aa. ||8||14||15||

lines.english: Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,
lines.transliteration: amrit naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa sabh d ukh gavaa-ay. all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.

lines.english: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee sad aa salaahay amrit  amrit  paavn i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani ofthe Word within their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree amrit ban ee man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.english: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee man vasaa-ay amrit  naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar see and behold this Amriteverywhere with their eyes.
lines.transliteration: amrit bolai sad aa mukh  vainee. amrit  vaykh ai parkh ai sad aa nain ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they causeothers to hear it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit kathaa kahai sad aa din raat ee avraa aakh  sunaavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention onHim.
lines.transliteration: amrit rang rat aa liv laa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.
lines.transliteration: amrit gur parsaadee paa-ay.

lines.english: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds andbodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit rasnaa bolai d in raat ee man t an amrit  pee-aavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: That which God does is beyond anyone's consciousness;
lines.transliteration: so kichh karai jo chit  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਆਿਖ ਸੁਨਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis daa hukam mayt na sakai ko-ee. no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

lines.english: By His Command, the Ambrosial Bani of the Word prevails, and by His Command, we drink in the Amrit. ||4||
lines.transliteration: hukmay vartai amrit  banee hukmay amrit  pee-aavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.
lines.transliteration: ajab kamm kartay har kayray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਬੋਲੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: ih man bhoolaa jaaNdaa fayray.

lines.english: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear thevibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5|| pMnw 119
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee si-o chit  laa-ay amrit  sabad  vajaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.
lines.transliteration: khotay kh aray t uDh aap upaa-ay.

lines.english: You Yourself appraise all people.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay parkh ay lok sabaa-ay.

lines.english: You appraise the true, and place them in Your Treasury; You consign the false to wander in delusion. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kharay parakh  khajaanai paa-ihi kh otay bh aram bh ulaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਿਖ  ਖਜਾਨੈ  ਪਾਇਿਹ  ਖੋਟੇ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: How can I behold You? How can I praise You?
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar vaykhaa ki-o saalaahee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I praise You through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sabad salaahee.

lines.english: In Your Sweet Will, the Amrit is found; by Your Will, You inspire us to drink in thisAmrit. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tayray bh aanay vich amrit  vasai t ooN bhaanai amrit  pee-aavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਵਸੈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਣੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Shabad is Amrit; the Lord's Bani is Amrit.
lines.transliteration: amrit sabad  amrit  har ban ee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, it permeates the heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai rid ai samaan ee.

lines.english: ||8||15||16|| O Nanak, the Ambrosial Naam is forever the Giver of peace; drinking in this Amrit, allhunger is satisfied. ||8||15||16|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (119-5) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak amrit naam sad aa sukh -daata pee amrit  sabh  bhukh leh jaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਪੀ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down, softly and gently.
lines.transliteration: amrit varsai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: How rare are those Gurmukhs who find it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa ko-ee jan paa-ay.

lines.english: Those who drink it in are satisfied forever. Showering His Mercy upon them, the Lord quenches their thirst. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit pee sad aa tariptaasay kar kirpaa t arisnaa bujh aavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those Gurmukhs who drink in this AmbrosialNectar.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree gurmukh amrit  pee-aavn i-aa.

lines.english: The tongue tastes the essence, and remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love,intuitively singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa ras chaakh sad aa rahai rang raat ee sehjay har gun  gaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, intuitive understanding is obtained;
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sahj ko paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa maaray ikas si-o liv laa-ay. subduing the sense of duality, they are in love with the One.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, then they sing the Glorious Praises of theLord; by His Grace, they merge in Truth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa har gun  gaavai nad ree sach samaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Above all is Your Glance of Grace, O God.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa upar nad ar parabh  tayree.

lines.english: Upon some it is bestowed less, and upon others it is bestowed more.
lines.transliteration: kisai thorhee kisai hai gh anayree.

lines.english: Without You, nothing happens at all; the Gurmukhs understand this. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar kichh  na hovai gurmukh  sojhee paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਨਦਰੀ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs contemplate the essence of reality;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t at hai beechaaraa.

lines.english: Your Treasures are overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit bh aray t ayray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay ko-ee na paavai gur kirpaa t ay paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvai so jan sohai.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices their inner minds.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam ant ar man mohai.

lines.english: Their minds and bodies are attuned to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word; this AmbrosialNectar is intuitively heard. ||5||
lines.transliteration: amrit man t an ban ee rat aa amrit  sahj sun aavni-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The deluded, self-willed manmukhs are ruined through the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolaa d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay.

lines.english: They do not chant the Naam, and they die, eating poison.
lines.transliteration: naam na layvai marai bikh kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, they continually sit in manure. Without selfless service, their lives are wasted away. ||6||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa vistaa meh vaasaa bin sayvaa janam gavaavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ ਮਨ ੁਤਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਰਤਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They alone drink in this Amrit, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.
lines.transliteration: amrit peevai jis no aap pee-aa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they intuitively enshrine love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sahj liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord is Himself perfectly pervading everywhere; through the Guru'sTeachings, He is perceived. ||7||
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-aa sabh aapay gurmat  nadree aavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਮਿਹ ਵਾਸਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap niranjan so-ee.

lines.english: He who has created, shall Himself destroy.
lines.transliteration: jin sirjee tin aapay go-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One withintuitive ease. ||8||16||17|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (119-16) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal sadaa t ooN sehjay sach samaavan i-aa. ||8||16||17||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.
lines.transliteration: say sach laagay jo tuDh  bhaa-ay.

lines.english: They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach sayveh sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sachaa saalaahee sachai mayl milaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree sach salaahni-aa.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into theTruest of the True. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sach Dhi-aa-in say sach raat ay sachay sach samaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸਿਚ ਲਾਗੇ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa sach sabh nee thaa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਚੈ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2|| pMnw 120
lines.transliteration: tan sachaa rasnaa sach raat ee sach sun  aakh  vakh aanni-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;
lines.transliteration: mansaa maar sach samaanee.
in man deethee sabh  aavan  jaanee. they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਨ  ਮਿਨ ਡੀਠੀ  ਸਭ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay sad aa man nihchal nij gh ar vaasaa paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rid ai dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabad jalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa vaykh saalaahee gur sabd ee sach paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਿਖ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.
lines.transliteration: jo sach raatay t in sachee liv laagee.

lines.english: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: har naam samaaleh say vadbhaagee.

lines.english: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who jointhe True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad aap milaa-ay sat sangat  sach gun  gaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਚੁ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa parh ee-ai jay laykh ay vich hovai.

lines.english: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: oh agam agochar sabad suDh  hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਿਧ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to knowHis Worth. ||6||
lines.transliteration: an-din sach sabad  saalaahee hor ko-ay na keemat  paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  thaakay saaNt na aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa jaalay suDh  na kaa-ee.

lines.english: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Tellinglies, they eat poison. ||7||
