lines.transliteration: bikh bihaajh eh bikh  moh pi-aasay koorh  bol bikh  khaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ayko jaanaa.

lines.english: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.
lines.transliteration: doojaa maar man sach samaan aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receiveit. ||8||17||18|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (120-9) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayko naam vartai man ant ar gur parsaadee paavn i-aa. ||8||17||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.
lines.transliteration: varan roop varteh sabh  tayray.

lines.english: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh fayr paveh ghan ayray.

lines.english: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru'sTeachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN ayko nihchal agam apaaraa gurmat ee boojh  bujhaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in theirminds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree raam naam man vasaavani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਫੇਰ ਪਵਿਹ  ਘਣੇਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis roop na raykh -i-aa varan na ko-ee gurmat ee aap bujh aavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.
lines.transliteration: sabh aykaa jot  jaanai jay ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai pargat ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into theLight. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gupat pargat vart ai sabh  thaa-ee jot ee jot  milaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The world is burning in the fire of desire,
lines.transliteration: tisnaa agan jalai sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਿਤ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobh abh imaan bahut  ahaNkaaraa. in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.

lines.english: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mar mar janmai pat gavaa-ay apn ee birthaa janam gavaavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad ko virlaa boojh ai.

lines.english: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: aap maaray taa t aribhavan soojh ai.

lines.english: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One.||4||
lines.transliteration: fir oh marai na marnaa hovai sehjay sach samaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਏ  ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa meh fir chit na laa-ay.

lines.english: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad  rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessedand exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sach salaahay sabh gh at ant ar sacho sach suhaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahee sadaa hajooray.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sach nadree aavai sachay hee sukh  paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.
lines.transliteration: sach man andar rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach nihchal aavai na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through theGuru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sachay laagai so man nirmal gurmatee sach samaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Praise the True One, and no other.
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahee avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained. pMnw 121
lines.transliteration: jit sayvi-ai sad aa sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (121-1) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay veechaaree sacho sach kamaavan i-aa. ||8||18||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is Immaculate and Pure; the Bani of the Word is Pure.
lines.transliteration: nirmal sabad nirmal hai ban ee.

lines.english: The Light which is pervading among all is Immaculate.
lines.transliteration: nirmal jot sabh  maahi samaan ee.

lines.english: So praise the Immaculate Word of the Lord's Bani; chanting the Immaculate Name of the Lord, all filth is washed away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nirmal banee har saalaahee jap har nirmal mail gavaavn i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace withintheir minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree sukh-d aata man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Praise the Immaculate Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Listen to theShabad, and quench your thirst. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har nirmal gur sabad salaahee sabd o sun  tisaa mitaavn i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the Immaculate Naam comes to dwell in the mind,
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਸਬਦੋ  ਸੁਿਣ ਿਤਸਾ  ਿਮਟਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal maa-i-aa moh gavaa-ay. the mind and body become Immaculate, and emotional attachment to Maya departs.

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate True Lord forever, and the ImmaculateSound-current of the Naad shall vibrate within. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirmal gun gaavai nit  saachay kay nirmal naad  vajaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Immaculate Ambrosial Nectar is obtained from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: nirmal amrit gur t ay paa-i-aa.

lines.english: When selfishness and conceit are eradicated from within, then there is no attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap mu-aa tithai moh na maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਨਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਵਜਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Immaculate is the spiritual wisdom, and utterly immaculate is the meditation, of thosewhose minds are filled with the Immaculate Bani of the Word. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirmal gi-aan Dhi-aan at  nirmal nirmal ban ee man vasaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: One who serves the Immaculate Lord becomes immaculate.
lines.transliteration: jo nirmal sayvay so nirmal hovai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the filth of egotism is washed away.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mail gur sabday Dh ovai.

lines.english: The Immaculate Bani and the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current vibrate, and inthe True Court, honor is obtained. ||4||
lines.transliteration: nirmal vaajai anhad Dh un ban ee dar sachai sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Through the Immaculate Lord, all become immaculate.
lines.transliteration: nirmal tay sabh  nirmal hovai.

lines.english: Immaculate is the mind which weaves the Word of the Lord's Shabad into itself.
lines.transliteration: nirmal manoo-aa har sabad parovai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Blessed and very fortunate are those who are committed to the Immaculate Name;through the Immaculate Name, they are blessed and beautified. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam lagay badbhaagee nirmal naam suhaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Immaculate is the one who is adorned with the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: so nirmal jo sabday sohai.

lines.english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices the mind and body.
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam man tan mohai.

lines.english: No filth ever attaches itself to the True Name; one's face is made radiant by the True One. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sach naam mal kaday na laagai mukh  oojal sach karaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: The mind is polluted by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: man mailaa hai doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: Filthy is that kitchen, and filthy is that dwelling;
lines.transliteration: mailaa cha-ukaa mailai thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ  ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: mailaa khaa-ay fir mail vaDh aa-ay manmukh  mail d ukh paavn i-aa. ||7|| eating filth, the self-willed manmukhs become even more filthy. Because of their filth, they suffer in pain. ||7||

lines.english: The filthy, and the immaculate as well, are all subject to the Hukam of God'sCommand.
lines.transliteration: mailay nirmal sabh hukam sabaa-ay.

lines.english: They alone are immaculate, who are pleasing to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say nirmal jo har saachay bhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲਾ  ਖਾਇ  ਿਫਿਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam abides deep within the minds of the Gurmukhs, who are cleansed of all their filth. ||8||19||20|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (121-14) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar gurmukh  mail chukaavan i-aa. ||8||19||20||

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is radiant, and radiant are His soul-swans.
lines.transliteration: govind oojal oojal hansaa.

lines.english: Their minds and their speech are immaculate; they are my hope and ideal.
lines.transliteration: man banee nirmal mayree mansaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Their minds are radiant, and their faces are always beautiful; they meditate on the most radiant Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man oojal sadaa mukh  soheh at  oojal naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of theLord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree gobind gun  gaavan i-aa.

lines.english: So chant Gobind, Gobind, the Lord of the Universe, day and night; sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord Gobind, through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gobid gobid  kahai d in raat ee gobid  gun sabad  sunaavni-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sing of the Lord Gobind with intuitive ease,
lines.transliteration: gobid gaavahi sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਊਜਲ  ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਅਿਤ  ਊਜਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhai oojal ha-umai mal jaa-ay. in the Fear of the Guru; you shall become radiant, and the filth of egotism shalldepart.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Remain in bliss forever, and perform devotional worship, day and night. Hear and singthe Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand raheh bh agat karahi d in raat ee sun  gobid  gun gaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬਦੁ ਗੋਿਬਦੁ  ਕਹੈ ਿਦਨ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਗੁਣ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Channel your dancing mind in devotional worship,
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa naachai bhagat  drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: Mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad manai man milaa-ay. and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, merge your mind with the Supreme

lines.english: Let your true and perfect tune be the subjugation of your love of Maya, and letyourself dance to the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sachaa taal pooray maa-i-aa moh chukaa-ay sabd ay nirat  karaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: People shout out loud and move their bodies,
lines.transliteration: oochaa kookay taneh pachh aarhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸੁਿਣ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi johi-aa jamkaalay. but if they are emotionally attached to Maya, then the Messenger of Death shall huntthem down. pMnw 122

lines.english: The love of Maya makes this mind dance, and the deceit within makes people suffer in pain. ||4||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh is maneh nachaa-ay antar kapat d ukh paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਿਹ  ਨਚਾਏ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: When the Lord inspires one to become Gurmukh, and perform devotional worship,
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat jaa aap karaa-ay.
tan man raat aa sahj subh aa-ay. then his body and mind are attuned to His Love with intuitive ease.

lines.english: The Word of His Bani vibrates, and the Word of His Shabad resounds, for the Gurmukh whose devotional worship is accepted. ||5||
lines.transliteration: banee vajai sabad  vajaa-ay gurmukh  bhagat thaa-ay paavn i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਵਜੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: One may beat upon and play all sorts of instruments,
lines.transliteration: baho taal pooray vaajay vajaa-ay.
naa ko sunay na man vasaa-ay. but no one will listen, and no one will enshrine it in the mind.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: For the sake of Maya, they set the stage and dance, but they are in love with duality,and they obtain only sorrow. ||6||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran pirh  banDh  naachai d oojai bh aa-ay d ukh paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਿਪੜ ਬੰਿਧ ਨਾਚੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those whose inner beings are attached to the Lord's Love are liberated.
lines.transliteration: jis antar pareet  lagai so mukt aa.

lines.english: They control their sexual desires, and their lifestyle is the self-discipline of Truth.
lines.transliteration: indree vas sach sanjam jugt aa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they meditate forever on the Lord. Thisdevotional worship is pleasing to the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad aa har Dh i-aa-ay ayhaa bh agat har bh aavni-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਏ  ਏਹਾ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: To live as Gurmukh is devotional worship, throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat jug chaaray ho-ee.

lines.english: This devotional worship is not obtained by any other means.
lines.transliteration: horat bh agat na paa-ay ko-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained only through devotion to the Guru. So focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||20||21|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (122-7) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam gur bhagt ee paa-ee-ai gur charn ee chit  laavan i-aa. ||8||20||21||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Serve the True One, and praise the True One.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sayvee sach saalaahee.

lines.english: With the True Name, pain shall never afflict you.
lines.transliteration: sachai naa-ay dukh  kab hee naahee.

lines.english: Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace. They enshrine the Guru's Teachingswithin their minds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata sayvan sukh  paa-in gurmat  man vasaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who intuitively enter into the peace ofSamaadhi.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree sukh sahj samaaDh  lagaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the Lord are always beautiful. The glory of their intuitive awarenessis beautiful. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo har sayveh say sadaa soheh sobh aa surat  suhaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All call themselves Your devotees,
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t ayraa bh agat kahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: say-ee bhagat  tayrai man bh aa-ay. but they alone are Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your mind.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of Your Bani, they praise You; attuned to Your Love, they worship You with devotion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach banee t uDhai saalaahan rang raat ay bh agat karaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: All are Yours, O Dear True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko sachay har jee-o t ayraa.

lines.english: Meeting the Gurmukh, this cycle of reincarnation comes to an end.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh milai t aa chookai fayraa.

lines.english: When it pleases Your Will, then we merge in the Name. You Yourself inspire us tochant the Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai t aa naa-ay rachaaveh t ooN aapay naa-o japaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਨ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine the Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Pleasure and pain, and all emotional attachments are gone.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog sabh  moh gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I am lovingly centered on the One Lord forever. I enshrine the Lord's Name within mymind. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ikas si-o liv laagee sad hee har naam man vasaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਇ  ਰਚਾਵਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your devotees are attuned to Your Love; they are always joyful.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  rang raat ay sad aa tayrai chaa-ay.

lines.english: The nine treasures of the Naam come to dwell within their minds.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.english: By perfect destiny, they find the True Guru, and through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||5||
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sat gur paa-i-aa sabd ay mayl milaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: You are Merciful, and always the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: tooN da-i-aal sad aa sukh -daata.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself unite us; You are known only to the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay mayleh gurmukh  jaataa.

lines.english: You Yourself bestow the glorious greatness of the Naam; attuned to the Naam, wefind peace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay d ayveh naam vadaa-ee naam rat ay sukh  paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa saachay t uDh saalaahee.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I know no other at all.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaat aa doojaa ko naahee.

lines.english: My mind remains immersed in the One Lord; my mind surrenders to Him, and in mymind I meet Him. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aykas si-o man rahi-aa samaa-ay man mani-ai maneh milaavani-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so saalaahay.

lines.english: Our True Lord and Master is Carefree.
lines.transliteration: saachay thaakur vayparvaahay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with the Lord. ||8||21||22|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (122-18) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar gur sabd ee har maylaavan i-aa. ||8||21||22||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਮਿਨ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.
lines.transliteration: tayray bh agat soheh saachai d arbaaray.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are adorned with the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad naam savaaray.

lines.english: They are forever in bliss, day and night; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, they merge with the Lord of Glory. ||1|| pMnw 123
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand raheh d in raat ee gun  kahi gun ee samaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who hear and enshrine the Naam within their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree naam sun man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord, the True One, the Highest of the High, subdues their ego and blendsthem with Himself. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sachaa oocho oochaa ha-umai maar milaavani-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True is the Dear Lord, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o saachaa saachee naa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some merge with Him.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee kisai milaa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, those who merge with the Lord shall not beseparated from Him again. They merge with intuitive ease into the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur sabad mileh say vichh urheh naahee sehjay sach samaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: There is nothing beyond You;
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar kachh oo na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਸੇ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the One who does, sees, and knows.
lines.transliteration: tooN kar kar vaykh eh jaan eh so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires others to act. Through the Guru's Teachings,He blends us into Himself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa gurmat  aap milaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖਿਹ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The virtuous soul-bride finds the Lord;
lines.transliteration: kaaman gun vantee har paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aa-ay seegaar ban aa-ay. she decorates herself with the Love and the Fear of God.

lines.english: She who serves the True Guru is forever a happy soul-bride. She is absorbed in thetrue teachings. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sohagan  sach upd ays samaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Those who forget the Word of the Shabad have no home and no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: sabad visaaran t inaa th a-ur na th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਸਚ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They are deluded by doubt, like a crow in a deserted house.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh oolay ji-o sunj ai ghar kaa-o.

lines.english: They forfeit both this world and the next, and they pass their lives suffering in pain and misery. ||5||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  tinee d ovai gavaa-ay d ukhay dukh vihaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Writing on and on endlessly, they run out of paper and ink.
lines.transliteration: likh-d i-aa likh -di-aa kaagad  mas kh o-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ  ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਿਖ ਿਵਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Through the love with duality, no one has found peace.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay sukh  paa-ay na ko-ee.

lines.english: They write falsehood, and they practice falsehood; they are burnt to ashes by focusing their consciousness on falsehood. ||6||
lines.transliteration: koorh likh eh tai koorh  kamaaveh jal jaaveh koorh  chit laavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs write and reflect on Truth, and only Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sacho sach likh eh veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਿਲਖਿਹ  ਤੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਕੂਿੜ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The true ones find the gate of salvation.
lines.transliteration: say jan sachay paavahi mokh d u-aar.

lines.english: True is their paper, pen and ink; writing Truth, they are absorbed in the True One.||7||
lines.transliteration: sach kaagad kalam masvaan ee sach likh  sach samaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: My God sits deep within the self; He watches over us.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh ant ar baith aa vaykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਕਲਮ  ਮਸਵਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਿਲਿਖ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who meet the Lord, by Guru's Grace, are acceptable.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee milai so-ee jan laykhai.

lines.english: O Nanak, glorious greatness is received through the Naam, which is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||23|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (123-11) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee pooray gur tay paavn i-aa. ||8||22||23||

lines.english: The Divine Light of the Supreme Soul shines forth from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: aatam raam pargaas gur t ay hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੨੨॥੨੩॥
lines.english: The filth stuck to the ego is removed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mail laagee gur sabdee kh ovai.

lines.english: One who is imbued with devotional worship to the Lord night and day becomes pure.Worshipping the Lord, He is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal an-din bh agtee raat aa bh agat karay har paavn i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who themselves worship the Lord, andinspire others to worship Him as well.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree aap bhagat  karan avraa bh agat karaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: I humbly bow to those devotees who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night andday. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 3) tinaa bh agat janaa ka-o sad  namaskaar keejai jo an-d in har gun  gaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਭਗਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord Himself is the Doer of deeds.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa kaaran  karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਨ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: As He pleases, He applies us to our tasks.
lines.transliteration: jit bhaavai t it kaarai laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through perfect destiny, we serve the Guru; serving the Guru, peace is found. ||2||
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sayvaa hovai gur sayvaa t ay sukh  paavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, obtain it.
lines.transliteration: mar mar jeevai taa kichh  paa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Lord within their minds.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Enshrining the Lord within their minds, they are liberated forever. With intuitive ease,they merge into the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa mukat  har man vasaa-ay sehjay sahj samaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they do not obtain liberation through them.
lines.transliteration: baho karam kamaavai mukat na paa-ay.

lines.english: They wander around the countryside, and in love with duality, they are ruined.
lines.transliteration: daysant ar bhavai d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay.

lines.english: The deceitful lose their lives in vain; without the Word of the Shabad, they obtain onlymisery. ||4||
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa kaptee bin sabdai d ukh paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ai thaak rahaa-ay. Those who restrain their wandering mind, keeping it steady and stable,

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee param pad paa-ay. obtain the supreme status, by Guru's Grace.

lines.english: The True Guru Himself unites us in Union with the Lord. Meeting the Beloved, peace is obtained. ||5|| pMnw 124
lines.transliteration: satgur aapay mayl milaa-ay mil pareet am sukh  paavn i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Some are stuck in falsehood, and false are the rewards they receive.
lines.transliteration: ik koorh laagay koorh ay fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਕੂਿੜ ਲਾਗੇ  ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: In love with duality, they waste away their lives in vain.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay birthaa janam gavaa-ay.

lines.english: They drown themselves, and drown their entire family; speaking lies, they eat poison. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aap dubay saglay kul dobay koorh bol bikh  khaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, look within their bodies, into their minds.
lines.transliteration: is tan meh man ko gurmukh  daykhai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: Through loving devotion, their ego evaporates.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay bh agat jaa ha-umai sokh ai.

lines.english: ||7|| The Siddhas, the seekers and the silent sages continually, lovingly focus theirconsciousness, but they have not seen the mind within the body. ||7||
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik moniDh aaree rahay liv laa-ay t in bhee tan meh man na d ikhaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਮੋਿਨਧਾਰੀ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ਿਤਨ  ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਿਦਖਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself inspires us to work;
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay kartaa so-ee.
hor ke karay keetai ki-aa ho-ee. what can anyone else do? What can be done by our doing?

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Name; we receive it, and enshrine it within the mind. ||8||23||24|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (124-5) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis naam dayvai so layvai naamo man vasaavan i-aa. ||8||23||24||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Within this cave, there is an inexhaustible treasure.
lines.transliteration: is gufaa meh akhut bh andaaraa.

lines.english: Within this cave, the Invisible and Infinite Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: tis vich vasai har alakh  apaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, selfishness and conceit are eliminated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay gupat pargat hai aapay gur sabd ee aap vanj aavan -i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Naam, theName of the Lord, within their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree amrit naam man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਵੰਞਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The taste of the Ambrosial Naam is very sweet! Through the Guru's Teachings, drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam mahaa ras meeth aa gurmat ee amrit  pee-aavn i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Subduing egotism, the rigid doors are opened.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar bajar kapaat khulaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਗੁ ਰਮਤੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Priceless Naam is obtained by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: naam amolak gur parsaadee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, the Naam is not obtained. By Guru's Grace, it is implanted withinthe mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai naam na paa-ay ko-ee gur kirpaa man vasaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru has applied the true ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan anjan sach naytree paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Deep within, the Divine Light has dawned, and the darkness of ignorance has beendispelled.
lines.transliteration: antar chaanan  agi-aan anDh ayr gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: My light has merged into the Light; my mind has surrendered, and I am blessed withGlory in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milee man maani-aa har d ar sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who look outside the body, searching for the Lord, shall not receive the Naam;they shall instead be forced to suffer the terrible pains of slavery.
lines.transliteration: sareerahu bhaalan  ko baahar jaa-ay. naam na lahai bahut  vaygaar d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand; but when they return once again to their own home, then, as Gurmukh, they find the genuine article. ||4||
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay soojh ai naahee fir gh ir aa-ay gurmukh  vath paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the True Lord is found.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sachaa har paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Within your mind and body, see the Lord, and the filth of egotism shall depart.
lines.transliteration: man tan vaykh ai ha-umai mail jaa-ay.

lines.english: Sitting in that place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever, and be absorbed inthe True Word of the Shabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bais suthaan sad har gun  gaavai sachai sabad  samaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਿਰ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those who close off the nine gates, and restrain the wandering mind,
lines.transliteration: na-o dar th aakay Dh aavat  rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਘਿਰ  ਆਇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: dasvai nij gh ar vaasaa paa-ay. come to dwell in the Home of the Tenth Gate.

lines.english: There, the Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates day and night. Through the Guru'sTeachings, the Shabad is heard. ||6||
lines.transliteration: othai anhad sabad  vajeh d in raat ee gurmat ee sabad  sunaavni-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, there is only darkness within.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai ant ar aanayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਿਸ ਸੁਥਾਿਨ  ਸਦ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The genuine article is not found, and the cycle of reincarnation does not end.
lines.transliteration: na vasat lahai na chookai fayraa.

lines.english: The key is in the hands of the True Guru; no one else can open this door. By perfect destiny, He is met. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur hath kunjee horat  dar khulai naahee gur poorai bh aag milaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: You are the hidden and the revealed in all places.
lines.transliteration: gupat pargat t ooN sabh nee thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਜਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Receiving Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee mil sojhee paa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Naam forever; as Gurmukh, enshrine it within the mind.||8||24||25|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (124-17) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi sadaa t ooN gurmukh  man vasaavan i-aa. ||8||24||25||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs meet the Lord, and inspire others to meet Him as well.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh milai milaa-ay aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਵਸਤੁ  ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Death does not see them, and pain does not afflict them.
lines.transliteration: kaal na johai dukh  na sant aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਿਥ ਕੁੰਜੀ  ਹੋਰਤੁ  ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Subduing egotism, they break all their bonds; as Gurmukh, they are adorned with theWord of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar banDhan sabh  torhai gurmukh  sabad  suhaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who look beautiful in the Name of theLord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree har har naam suhaavani-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs sing, the Gurmukhs dance, and focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 125
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gaavai gurmukh  naachai har sayt ee chit  laavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are celebrated in life and death.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jeevai marai parvaan .

lines.english: Their lives are not wasted; they realize the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aarjaa na chheejai sabad  pachh aan.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs do not die; they are not consumed by death. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh marai na kaal na kh aa-ay gurmukh  sach samaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har d ar sobh aa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well. TheGurmukhs redeem their lives. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap tarai kul saglay t aaray gurmukh  janam savaarn i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs never suffer bodily pain.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d ukh kaday na lagai sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ  ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਰਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs have the pain of egotism taken away.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ha-umai chookai peer.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The minds of the Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; no filth ever sticks to them again. The Gurmukhs merge in celestial peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man nirmal fir mail na laagai gurmukh  sahj samaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Greatness of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam milai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtain honor.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gun  gaavai sobh aa paa-ee.

lines.english: They remain in bliss forever, day and night. The Gurmukhs practice the Word of theShabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee gurmukh  sabad  karaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Shabad, night and day.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh an-d in sabd ay raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are known throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jug chaaray hai jaat aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs always sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. Through theShabad, they practice devotional worship. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gun  gaavai sad aa nirmal sabd ay bh agat karaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo hai anDh  anDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out and scream.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal garthay karahi pukaaraa.

lines.english: Night and day, they are diseased, like maggots in manure, and in manure they endure agony. ||7||
lines.transliteration: an-din rogee bistaa kay keerh ay bistaa meh d ukh paavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs know that the Lord alone acts, and causes others to act.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aapay karay karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਮਿਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: In the hearts of the Gurmukhs, the Lord Himself comes to dwell.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hird ai vuth aa aap aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. It is received from the PerfectGuru. ||8||25||26|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (125-10) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee pooray gur tay paavn i-aa. ||8||25||26||

lines.english: The One Light is the light of all bodies.
lines.transliteration: aykaa jot jot  hai sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabad d ikhaa-ay sat gur pooraa.

lines.english: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created theCreation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay farak keeton gh at ant ar aapay ban at banaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree har sachay kay gun gaavan i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom; the Gurmukh is absorbed inintuitive peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo ko sahj na paa-ay gurmukh  sahj samaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਫਰਕੁ  ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself are Beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay soheh aapay jag moheh.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself, by Your Kind Mercy, weave the thread of the world.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay nad ree jagat  paroveh.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself bestow pain and pleasure, O Creator. The Lord reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay d ukh sukh  dayveh kart ay gurmukh  har d aykhaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through Him, the Word of the Guru's Shabad is enshrined within the mind.
lines.transliteration: aapay sabad gur man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani emanates from the Word of the Shabad. TheGurmukh speaks it and hears it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabday upjai amrit  banee gurmukh  aakh  sunaavni-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਿਹ ਕਰਤੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਦੇਖਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa aapay bh ugtaa.

lines.english: One who breaks out of bondage is liberated forever.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orhay sad aa hai mukt aa.

lines.english: The True Lord is liberated forever. The Unseen Lord causes Himself to be seen. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sadaa mukat  aapay hai sachaa aapay alakh  lakhaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself is Maya, and He Himself is the Illusion.
lines.transliteration: aapay maa-i-aa aapay chhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself has generated emotional attachment throughout the entire universe.
lines.transliteration: aapay moh sabh jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself is the Giver of Virtue; He Himself sings the Lord's Glorious Praises. He chants them and causes them to be heard. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay gundaat aa gun  gaavai aapay aakh  sunaavni-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਆਪੇ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and causes others to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay aapay.

lines.english: He Himself establishes and disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaapay aapay.

lines.english: Without You, nothing can be done. You Yourself have engaged all in their tasks. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar kachh oo na hovai t ooN aapay kaarai laavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He Himself kills, and He Himself revives.
lines.transliteration: aapay maaray aap jeevaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself unites us, and unites us in Union with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: Through selfless service, eternal peace is obtained. The Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||7|| pMnw 126
lines.transliteration: sayvaa tay sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa gurmukh  sahj samaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: He Himself is the Highest of the High.
lines.transliteration: aapay oochaa oocho ho-ee.

lines.english: How rare are those who behold Him. He causes Himself to be seen.
lines.transliteration: jis aap vikhaalay so vaykh ai ko-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the hearts of thosewho see the Lord themselves, and inspire others to see Him as well. ||8||26||27|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (126-2) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat ant ar aapay vaykh  vikhaalan i-aa. ||8||26||27||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਖਾਲਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੨੬॥੨੭॥
lines.english: My God is pervading and permeating all places.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh bh arpoor rahi-aa sabh  thaa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have found Him within the home of my own heart.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ghar hee meh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I serve Him constantly, and I meditate on Him single-mindedly. As Gurmukh, I am absorbed in the True One. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sarayvee ik man Dh i-aa-ee gurmukh  sach samaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord, the Life of theWorld, within their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree jagjeevan man vasaavani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I merge with intuitive ease into the Lord, the Life ofthe World, the Fearless One, the Great Giver. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jagjeevan nirbha-o d aataa gurmat  sahj samaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of the self is the earth, its support and the nether regions of theunderworld.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh Dh artee Dh a-ul paat aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within the home of the self is the Eternally Young Beloved.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee meh pareet am sad aa hai baalaa.

lines.english: The Giver of peace is eternally blissful. Through the Guru's Teachings, we areabsorbed in intuitive peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai sukh -daata gurmat  sahj samaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: When the body is filled with ego and selfishness,
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar ha-umai mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  na chookai fayraa. the cycle of birth and death does not end.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh subdues egotism, and meditates on the Truest of the True. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so ha-umai maaray sacho sach Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Within this body are the two brothers, sin and virtue.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar paap punn d u-ay bh aa-ee.

lines.english: When the two joined together, the Universe was produced.
lines.transliteration: duhee mil kai sarisat upaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Subduing both, and entering into the Home of the One, through the Guru's Teachings,we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: dovai maar jaa-ay ikat  ghar aavai gurmat  sahj samaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of the self is the darkness of the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee maahi d oojai bh aa-ay anayraa.

lines.english: When the Divine Light dawns, ego and selfishness are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: chaanan hovai chh odai ha-umai mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਵੈ ਮਾਿਰ  ਜਾਇ  ਇਕਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Giver of peace is revealed through the Shabad, meditating upon the Naam, nightand day. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pargat sabad hai sukh -daata an-d in naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਅਨੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within the self is the Light of God; It radiates throughout the expanse of Hiscreation.
lines.transliteration: antar jot  pargat paasaaraa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee miti-aa anDh i-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and eternal peace is obtained, as one's light merges into the Light. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kamal bigaas sadaa sukh  paa-i-aa jot ee jot  milaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Within the mansion is the treasure house, overflowing with jewels.
lines.transliteration: andar mahal rat nee bh aray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Infinite Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ay naam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਬਗਾਿਸ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh, the trader, always purchases the merchandise of the Naam, and alwaysreaps profits. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh van jay sad aa vaapaaree laahaa naam sad  paavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: The Lord Himself keeps this merchandise in stock, and He Himself distributes it.
lines.transliteration: aapay vath raakhai aapay d ay-ay.

lines.english: Rare is that Gurmukh who trades in this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh van jahi kay-ee kay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਣਜੇ  ਸਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain it. Through HisMercy, it is enshrined in the mind. ||8||27||28|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (126-14) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis nadar karay so paa-ay kar kirpaa man vasaavan i-aa. ||8||27||28||

lines.english: The Lord Himself leads us to merge with Him and serve Him.
lines.transliteration: har aapay maylay sayv karaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the love of duality is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bh aa-o d oojaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੨੭॥੨੮॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord is the Bestower of eternal virtue. The Lord Himself leads us to merge in His Virtuous Goodness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har nirmal sadaa gund aataa har gun  meh aap samaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Truest of the Truewithin their hearts.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree sach sachaa hirdai vasaavan i-aa.

lines.english: The True Name is eternally pure and immaculate. Through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, it is enshrined within the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam sadaa hai nirmal gur sabd ee man vasaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Guru Himself is the Giver, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: aapay gur daat aa karam biDh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਮਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh, the humble servant who serves the Lord, comes to know Him.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayveh gurmukh har jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings look beautiful forever in the Ambrosial Naam. Through theGuru's Teachings, they receive the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad aa jan soheh gurmat  har ras paavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within the cave of this body, there is one beautiful place.
lines.transliteration: is gufaa meh ik thaan suhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, ego and doubt are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: poorai gur ha-umai bharam chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Night and day, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, you shall find Him. ||3|| pMnw 127
lines.transliteration: an-din naam salaahan rang raat ay gur kirpaa t ay paavn i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, search this cave.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ih gufaa veechaaray.

lines.english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the self.
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan antar vasai muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਏ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and decorate yourself with the Shabad. Meeting with your Beloved, you shall find peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai sabad  suhaa-ay mil pareet am sukh  paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death imposes his tax on those who are attached to duality.
lines.transliteration: jam jaagaatee d oojai bh aa-ay kar laa-ay.

lines.english: He inflicts punishment on those who forget the Name.
lines.transliteration: naavhu bhoolay d ay-ay sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ  ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ  ਲੇਵੈ ਰਤੀਅਹ ੁ ਮਾਸਾ  ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They are called to account for each instant and each moment. Every grain, everyparticle, is weighed and counted. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gharh ee muhat  kaa laykh aa layvai rat ee-ahu maasaa t ol kadh aavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: One who does not remember her Husband Lord in this world is being cheated byduality; she shall weep bitterly in the end.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai pir chayt ay naahee. d oojai muth ee rovai Dh aahee.

lines.english: She is from an evil family; she is ugly and vile. Even in her dreams, she does not meet her Husband Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kharee ku-aali-o kuroop kulkh anee supnai pir nahee paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਿਲਓ  ਕੁਰੂਿਪ  ਕੁਲਖਣੀ  ਸੁਪਨੈ ਿਪਰ ੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: She who enshrines her Husband Lord in her mind in this world
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai pir man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: -His Presence is revealed to her by the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: poorai gur hadoor d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: That soul-bride keeps her Husband Lord clasped tightly to her heart, and through theWord of the Shabad, she enjoys her Husband Lord upon His Beautiful Bed. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kaaman pir raakh i-aa kanth  laa-ay sabd ay pir raavai sayj suhaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself sends out the call, and He summons us to His Presence.
lines.transliteration: aapay dayvai sad  bulaa-ay.

lines.english: He enshrines His Name within our minds.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa naa-o man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who receives the greatness of the Naam night and day, constantly singsHis Glorious Praises. ||8||28||29|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (127-7) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee an-din sad aa gun  gaavan i-aa. ||8||28||29||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Sublime is their birth, and the place where they dwell.
lines.transliteration: ootam janam suthaan hai vaasaa.

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru remain detached in the home of their own being.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh gh ar maahi ud aasaa.

lines.english: They abide in the Lord's Love, and constantly imbued with His Love, their minds are satisfied and fulfilled with the Lord's Essence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har rang raheh sadaa rang raat ay har ras man t ariptaavni-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read of the Lord, who understandand enshrine Him within their minds.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree parh bujh  man vasaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਮਨੁਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs read and praise the Lord's Name; they are honored in the True Court.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parh eh har naam salaaheh d ar sachai sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਪਿੜ ਬੁਿਝ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: alakh abh ay-o har rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਹ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He cannot be obtained by any effort.
lines.transliteration: upaa-ay na kitee paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness,we are united in His Union. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay taa sat gur bh aytai nad ree mayl milaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: One who reads, while attached to duality, does not understand.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay parh ai nahee boojh ai.

lines.english: He yearns for the three-phased Maya.
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  maa-i-aa kaaran  loojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਦਰੀ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The bonds of the three-phased Maya are broken by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru's Shabad, liberation is achieved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  banDh an tooteh gur sabd ee gur sabd ee mukat  karaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: This unstable mind cannot be held steady.
lines.transliteration: ih man chanchal vas na aavai.

lines.english: Attached to duality, it wanders in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa laagai d ah dis Dhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਿਬਿਧ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੂਟਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: It is a poisonous worm, drenched with poison, and in poison it rots away. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa keerh aa bikh  meh raat aa bikh  hee maahi pachaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Practicing egotism and selfishness, they try to impress others by showing off.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karay tai aap jan aa-ay.

lines.english: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they gain no acceptance.
lines.transliteration: baho karam karai kichh thaa-ay na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਤਾ  ਿਬਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਪਚਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without You, Lord, nothing happens at all. You forgive those who are adorned withthe Word of Your Shabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar kichh oo na hovai bakh say sabad  suhaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪੁ  ਜਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They are born, and they die, but they do not understand the Lord.
lines.transliteration: upjai pachai har boojhai naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they wander, in love with duality.
lines.transliteration: an-din d oojai bh aa-ay firaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The lives of the self-willed manmukhs are useless; in the end, they die, regretting and repenting. ||6||
lines.transliteration: manmukh janam ga-i-aa hai birthaa ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: The Husband is away, and the wife is getting dressed up.
lines.transliteration: pir pardays sigaar ban aa-ay.

lines.english: This is what the blind, self-willed manmukhs are doing.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  aisay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ  ਹੈ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: They are not honored in this world, and they shall find no shelter in the worldhereafter. They are wasting their lives in vain. ||7||
lines.transliteration: halat na sobh aa palat  na dh o-ee birthaa janam gavaavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: How rare are those who know the Name of the Lord!
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam kinai virlai jaataa.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, the Lord is realized.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad pachh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਿਤ  ਨ ਢੋਈ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Night and day, they perform the Lord's devotional service; day and night, they findintuitive peace. ||8||
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karay d in raat ee sehjay hee sukh  paavn i-aa. ||8||

lines.english: That One Lord is pervading in all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vart ai ayko so-ee.

lines.english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are beautiful. Granting His Grace, God unites them with Himself. ||9||29||30|| pMnw 128 mwJ mhlw 3 ] (128-1) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay jan soheh kar kirpaa aap milaavan i-aa. ||9||29||30||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs read and recite; they are called Pandits-spiritual scholars.
lines.transliteration: manmukh parh eh pandit  kahaaveh.

lines.english: But they are in love with duality, and they suffer in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay mahaa d ukh paavahi.

lines.english: Intoxicated with vice, they understand nothing at all. They are reincarnated, over and over again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa maat ay kichh  soojh ai naahee fir fir joonee aavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who subdue their ego, and unite withthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree ha-umai maar milaavani-aa.

lines.english: They serve the Guru, and the Lord dwells within their minds; they intuitively drink inthe sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay har man vasi-aa har ras sahj pee-aavn i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits read the Vedas, but they do not obtain the Lord's essence.
lines.transliteration: vayd parh eh har ras nahee aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਪੀਆਵਿਣਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Intoxicated with Maya, they argue and debate.
lines.transliteration: vaad vakaan eh mohay maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The foolish intellectuals are forever in spiritual darkness. The Gurmukhs understand, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agi-aanmatee sad aa anDh i-aaraa gurmukh  boojh  har gaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Indescribable is described only through the beauteous Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aktho kathee-ai sabad suhaavai.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Truth becomes pleasing to the mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee man sacho bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨਮਤੀ  ਸਦਾ ਅੰਿਧਆਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਿਝ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who speak of the truest of the true, day and night-their minds are imbued withthe Truth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sacho sach raveh din raat ee ih man sach rangaavin -aa. ||3||

lines.english: Those who are attuned to Truth, love the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jo sach ratay t in sacho bh aavai.

lines.english: The Lord Himself bestows this gift; He shall not take it back.
lines.transliteration: aapay day-ay na pachh otaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਇਹੁਮਨੁ ਸਿਚ ਰੰਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True Lord is known forever; meeting theTrue One, peace is found. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad aa sach jaat aa mil sachay sukh  paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The filth of fraud and falsehood does not stick to those who, by Guru's Grace, remain awake and aware, night and day.
lines.transliteration: koorh kusat  tinaa mail na laagai. gur parsaadee an-d in jaagai.

lines.english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; their light merges into the Light. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam vasai ghat bh eetar jot ee jot  milaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They read about the three qualities, but they do not know the essential reality of theLord.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  parheh har t at na jaan eh.

lines.english: They forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all, and they do not recognize the Word ofthe Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: moolhu bhulay gur sabad  na pachh aaneh.

lines.english: They are engrossed in emotional attachment; they do not understand anything at all.Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. ||6||
lines.transliteration: moh bi-aapay kichh soojh ai naahee gur sabd ee har paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Vedas proclaim that Maya is of three qualities.
lines.transliteration: vayd pukaarai t aribaDh  maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, do not understand.
lines.transliteration: manmukh na boojh eh doojai bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They read of the three qualities, but they do not know the One Lord. Withoutunderstanding, they obtain only pain and suffering. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  parheh har ayk na jaan eh bin boojh ay dukh paavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases the Lord, He unites us with Himself.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavai t aa aap milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਿਬਆਪੇ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, skepticism and suffering are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee sahsaa d ookh chukaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, True is the Greatness of the Name. Believing in the Name, peace is obtained. ||8||30||31|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (128-13) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai kee sachee vadi-aa-ee naamo man sukh paavn i-aa. ||8||30||31||

lines.english: The Lord Himself is Unmanifest and Unrelated; He is Manifest and Related as well.
lines.transliteration: nirgun sargun  aapay so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who recognize this essential reality are the true Pandits, the spiritual scholars.
lines.transliteration: tat pachh aanai so pandit  ho-ee.

lines.english: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well, when theyenshrine the Lord's Name in the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap tarai saglay kul t aarai har naam man vasaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who taste the essence of the Lord, andsavor its taste.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree har ras chakh saad  paavn i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Those who taste this essence of the Lord are the pure, immaculate beings. Theymeditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhahi say jan nirmal nirmal naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who reflect upon the Shabad are beyond karma.
lines.transliteration: so nihkarmee jo sabad beechaaray.

lines.english: They subdue their ego, and find the essence of wisdom, deep within their being.
lines.transliteration: antar t at gi-aan ha-umai maaray.

lines.english: They obtain the nine treasures of the wealth of the Naam. Rising above the three qualities, they merge into the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath na-o niDh  paa-ay t arai gun  mayt samaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who act in ego do not go beyond karma.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karai nihkarmee na hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is only by Guru's Grace that one is rid of ego.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ha-umai khovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਿਖ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have discriminating minds, continually examine their own selves. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they sing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||3||
lines.transliteration: antar bibayk sad aa aap veechaaray gur sabd ee gun  gaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is the most pure and sublime Ocean. The Saintly Gurmukhs continually peckat the Naam, like swans pecking at pearls in the ocean.
lines.transliteration: har sar saagar nirmal so-ee. sant chugeh nit  gurmukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: They bathe in it continually, day and night, and the filth of ego is washed away. ||4||
lines.transliteration: isnaan karahi sadaa d in raat ee ha-umai mail chukaavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The pure swans, with love and affection, dwell in the Ocean of the Lord, and subduetheir ego. pMnw 129
lines.transliteration: nirmal hansaa paraym pi-aar. har sar vasai ha-umai maar.

lines.english: Day and night, they are in love with the True Word of the Shabad. They obtain their home in the Ocean of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ahinis pareet sabad  saachai har sar vaasaa paavn i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਾਚੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਰ ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs shall always be filthy cranes, smeared with the filth of ego.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sad aa bag mailaa ha-umai mal laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ  ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They may bathe, but their filth is not removed.
lines.transliteration: isnaan karai par mail na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who dies while yet alive, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is ridof this filth of ego. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai gur sabad  beechaarai ha-umai mail chukaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Priceless Jewel is found, in the home of one's own being,
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath gh ar tay paa-i-aa.
poorai satgur sabad  sunaa-i-aa. when one listens to the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect True Guru.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled; I have come torecognize the Divine Light within my own heart. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad miti-aa anDh i-aaraa gh at chaanan  aap pachh aanni-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਿਮਿਟਆ ਅੰਿਧਆਰਾ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਨਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself creates, and He Himself beholds.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay tai aapay vaykh ai.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvai so jan laykh ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the heart; by Guru's Grace, it is obtained.||8||31||32|| mwJ mhlw 3 ] (129-5) maajh mehlaa 3. Maajh, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat ant ar gur kirpaa t ay paavn i-aa. ||8||31||32||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
lines.english: The whole world is engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh jagat sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who are controlled by the three qualities are attached to Maya.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  deeseh mohay maa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a few come to understand; they center their consciousness in the fourth state. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ko virlaa boojhai cha-uthai pad  liv laavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away their emotionalattachment to Maya, through the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree maa-i-aa moh sabad jalaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਿਦ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who burn away this attachment to Maya, and focus their consciousness on theLord are honored in the True Court, and the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 3) maa-i-aa moh jalaa-ay so har si-o chit laa-ay har d ar mahlee sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The source, the root, of the gods and goddesses is Maya.
lines.transliteration: dayvee d ayvaa mool hai maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਮਹਲੀ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: For them, the Simritees and the Shaastras were composed.
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  jinn upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Sexual desire and anger are diffused throughout the universe. Coming and going, people suffer in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh pasri-aa sansaaray aa-ay jaa-ay d ukh paavn i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom was placed within the universe.
lines.transliteration: tis vich gi-aan rat an ik paa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it is enshrined within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ਆਇ  ਜਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Celibacy, chastity, self-discipline and the practice of truthfulness are obtained from thePerfect Guru, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam sach kamaavai gur poorai naam Dh i-aavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: In this world of her parents' home, the soul-bride has been deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai Dh an bh aram bh ulaan ee.

lines.english: Attached to duality, she later comes to regret it.
lines.transliteration: doojai laagee fir pachh otaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: She forfeits both this world and the next, and even in her dreams, she does not findpeace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  dovai gavaa-ay supnai sukh  na paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The soul-bride who remembers her Husband Lord in this world,
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai Dh an kant  samaalay.
gur parsaadee vaykhai naalay. by Guru's Grace, sees Him close at hand.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ  ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pir kai sahj rahai rang raatee sabad  singaar ban aavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who find the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: safal janam jinaa satgur paa-i-aa.
doojaa bh aa-o gur sabad  jalaa-i-aa. through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they burn their love of duality.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਸੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading deep within the heart. Joining the SatSangat, the True Congregation, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ayko rav rahi-aa ghat ant ar mil sat sangat  har gun  gaavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru-why did they even come into this world?
lines.transliteration: satgur na sayvay so kaahay aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dharig jeevan  birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. Cursed are their lives; they have uselessly wasted this human life.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam. Without the Naam, they sufferin terrible pain. ||7||
lines.transliteration: manmukh naam chit  na aavai bin naavai baho d ukh paavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created the Universe, He alone knows it.
lines.transliteration: jin sisat saajee so-ee jaanai.

lines.english: He unites with Himself those who realize the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylai sabad pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they alone receive the Naam, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is recorded. ||8||1||32||33|| mwJ mhlw 4 ] (129-18) maajh mehlaa 4. Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 3) naanak naam mili-aa tin jan ka-o jin Dh ur mast ak laykh  likhaavan i-aa. ||8||1||32||33||

lines.english: The Primal Being is Himself remote and beyond.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  aprampar aapay.

lines.english: He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaapay thaap uthaapay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਜਨ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਖਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
lines.english: The One Lord is pervading in all; those who become Gurmukh are honored. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vart ai ayko so-ee gurmukh  sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord. pMnw 130
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree nirankaaree naam Dhi-aavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has no form or shape; He is seen within each and every heart. The Gurmukhcomes to know the unknowable. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis roop na raykh -i-aa gh at ghat daykhi-aa gurmukh  alakh  lakhaavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: You are God, Kind and Merciful.
lines.transliteration: too da-i-aal kirpaal parabh  so-ee.

lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojaa avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: When the Guru showers His Grace upon us, He blesses us with the Naam; through the Naam, we merge in the Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad karay naam d ayvai naamay naam samaavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ  ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay sachaa sirjan haaraa.

lines.english: Your treasures are overflowing with devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee bh aray t ayray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. Their minds are enraptured, and they easily andintuitively enter into Samaadhi. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam milai man bh eejai sahj samaaDh  lagaavan i-aa. ||3||
