lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Night and day, I sing Your Glorious Praises, God.
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavaa parabh  tayray.

lines.english: I praise You, O my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: tuDh saalaahee pareet am mayray.

lines.english: Without You, there is no other for me to seek out. It is only by Guru's Grace that Youare found. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin avar na ko-ee jaachaa gur parsaadee t ooN paavn i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਾ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The limits of the Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar mit nahee paa-ee.

lines.english: Bestowing Your Mercy, You merge us into Yourself.
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa karahi t ooN laihi milaa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Lord. Serving the Shabad, peace is found. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad Dh i-aa-ee-ai sabad  sayv sukh  paavn i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Praiseworthy is the tongue which sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa gunvant ee gun  gaavai.

lines.english: Praising the Naam, one becomes pleasing to the True One.
lines.transliteration: naam salaahay sachay bhaavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love. Meeting the True Lord,glory is obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa rahai rang raat ee mil sachay sobh aa paavn i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam karay ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: They lose their whole lives in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: joo-ai janam sabh baajee haaree.

lines.english: Within is the terrible darkness of greed, and so they come and go in reincarnation,over and over again. ||7||
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  mahaa gubaaraa fir fir aavan  jaavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself bestows Glory on those whom He Himself has so pre-destined.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa d ay vadi-aa-ee. jin ka-o aap likh at Dhur paa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, they receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find peace. ||8||1||34|| mwJ mhlw 5 Gru 1 ] (130-10) maajh mehlaa 5 gh ar 1. Maajh, Fifth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai bha-o bh anjan gur sabd ee sukh  paavn i-aa. ||8||1||34||

lines.english: The Unseen Lord is within, but He cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: antar alakh  na jaa-ee lakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧॥੩੪॥
lines.english: He has taken the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and He keeps it wellconcealed.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan lai gujh aa rakh i-aa.

lines.english: The Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord is the highest of all. Through the Word ofthe Guru's Shabad, He is known. ||1||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar sabh t ay oochaa gur kai sabad  lakhaavan i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who chant the Naam, in this Dark Ageof Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree kal meh naam sunaavn i-aa.

lines.english: The Beloved Saints were established by the True Lord. By great good fortune, theBlessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant pi-aaray sachai Dh aaray vadbh aagee d arsan paavn i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਖਾਵਿਣਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One who is sought by the Siddhas and the seekers,
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  jisai ka-o fird ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: barahmay indar Dh i-aa-in hird ay. upon whom Brahma and Indra meditate within their hearts,

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਚੈ ਧਾਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot tayt eesaa kh ojeh t aa ka-o gur mil hird ai gaavan i-aa. ||2|| whom the three hundred thirty million demi-gods search for-meeting the Guru, one comes to sing His Praises within the heart. ||2||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, the wind breathes Your Name.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar t uDh jaapay pavnaa.

lines.english: Dhart ee sayvak paa-ik charnaa. The earth is Your servant, a slave at Your Feet.
In the four sources of creation, and in all speech, You dwell. You are dear to theminds of all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khaan ee ban ee sarab nivaasee sabh naa kai man bh aavni-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਖੋਜਿਹ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Lord and Master is known to the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib gurmukh jaapai.

lines.english: He is realized through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad sinj aapai.

lines.english: Those who drink it in are satisfied. Through the Truest of the True, they are fulfilled.||4||
lines.transliteration: jin pee-aa say-ee taript aasay sachay sach agh aavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਣੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the home of their own beings, they are peacefully and comfortably at ease.
lines.transliteration: tis gh ar sahjaa so-ee suhaylaa.

lines.english: They are blissful, enjoying pleasures, and eternally joyful.
lines.transliteration: anad binod  karay sad  kaylaa.

lines.english: They are wealthy, and the greatest kings; they center their minds on the Guru's Feet. ||5||
lines.transliteration: so Dhanvant aa so vad saahaa jo gur charn ee man laavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: First, You created nourishment;
lines.transliteration: pahilo day t aiN rijak samaahaa.
pichho d ay taiN jant upaahaa. then, You created the living beings.

lines.english: There is no other Giver as Great as You, O my Lord and Master. None approach orequal You. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad d aataa avar na su-aamee lavai na ko-ee laavan i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ  ਸੋ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to You meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: jis tooN tuthaa so t uDh Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: They practice the Mantra of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kaa mant ar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: They themselves swim across, and they save all their ancestors and families as well. In the Court of the Lord, they meet with no obstruction. ||7|| pMnw 131
lines.transliteration: aap tarai saglay kul t aaray t is dargeh th aak na paavn i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: You are so Great! You are the Highest of the High!
lines.transliteration: tooN vadaa t ooN oocho oochaa.

lines.english: You are Infinite, You are Everything!
lines.transliteration: tooN bay-ant  at moocho moochaa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to You. Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||8||1||35|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (131-2) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o kurbaanee t ayrai vanj aa naanak d aas d asaavan i-aa. ||8||1||35||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੧॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Who is liberated, and who is united?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so mukt aa ka-un  so jugt aa.

lines.english: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so gi-aanee ka-un  so bakt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ka-un so girhee ka-un  udaasee ka-un  so keemat  paa-ay jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?
lines.transliteration: kin biDh baaDh aa kin biDh  chhootaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?
lines.transliteration: kin biDh aavan  jaavan  tootaa.

lines.english: Who is subject to karma, and who is beyond karma? Who chants the Name, andinspires others to chant it? ||2||
lines.transliteration: ka-un karam ka-un  nihkarmaa ka-un  so kahai kahaa-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Who is happy, and who is sad?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so sukh ee-aa ka-un  so dukhee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਉਣ  ਿਨਹਕਰਮਾ ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Who, as sunmukh, turns toward the Guru, and who, as vaymukh, turns away from the Guru?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so sanmukh  ka-un  vaymukh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: How can one meet the Lord? How is one separated from Him? Who can reveal theway to me? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kin biDh milee-ai kin biDh  bichh urai ih biDh  ka-un  pargataa-ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so akh ar jit Dhaavat  rahtaa.

lines.english: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?
lines.transliteration: ka-un upd ays jit  dukh sukh  sam saht aa.

lines.english: What is that lifestyle, by which we may come to meditate on the Supreme Lord? How may we sing the Kirtan of His Praises? ||4||
lines.transliteration: ka-un so chaal jit  paarbarahm Dh i-aa-ay kin biDh  keert an gaa-ay jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਿਜਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mukt aa gurmukh  jugtaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਚਾਲ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਧਆਏ  ਿਕਿਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aanee gurmukh  baktaa.

lines.english: Dhan girhee ud aasee gurmukh  gurmukh  keemat  paa-ay jee-o. ||5|| Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows theLord's Value. ||5||
Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai baaDhaa gurmukh  chhootaa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aavan  jaavan  tootaa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karam gurmukh  nihkarmaa gurmukh  karay so subh aa-ay jee-o. ||6||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sukh ee-aa manmukh  dukhee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਨਹਕਰਮਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away fromthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sanmukh  manmukh  vaymukh ee-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. TheGurmukh reveals the way. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh milee-ai manmukh  vichh urai gurmukh  biDh pargataa-ay jee-o. ||7||

lines.english: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh akh ar jit Dhaavat  rahtaa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh upd ays dukh sukh  sam saht aa.

lines.english: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chaal jit  paarbarahm Dh i-aa-ay gurmukh  keert an gaa-ay jee-o. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.
lines.transliteration: saglee banat  banaa-ee aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਾਲ  ਿਜਤੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਧਆਏ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay thaapay.

lines.english: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shallmerge into the One once again. ||9||2||36|| mwJ mhlw 5 ] (131-15) maajh mehlaa 5. Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ikas tay ho-i-o anant aa naanak aykas maahi samaa-ay jee-o. ||9||2||36||

lines.english: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?
lines.transliteration: parabh abh inaasee t aa ki-aa kaarh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਤੇ ਹੋਇਓ  ਅਨੰਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕਸੁ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.
lines.transliteration: har bhagvant aa taa jan kh araa sukh aalaa.

lines.english: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan maan sukh-d aata tooN karahi so-ee sukh  paavn i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body arepleased with You.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jee-o vaaree gurmukh man t an bh aavni-aa.

lines.english: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa parbat  tooN mayraa olaa t um sang lavai na laavan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ  ਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,
lines.transliteration: tayraa keet aa jis laagai meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at paarbarahm t in jan deeth aa. comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਭਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar t ooNhai tooNhai iko ik vart aavan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ  ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ  ਤੁਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath tooN dayvan haaraa.

lines.english: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee bh aa-ay bh aray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3|| pMnw 132
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aar raakh ay tuDh say-ee poorai karam samaavan i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: You pulled me out of the deep, dark well onto the dry ground.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay kandh ai chaarh ay.

lines.english: Showering Your Mercy, You blessed Your servant with Your Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa daas nad ar nihaalay.

lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Immortal Lord. By speaking and hearing these Praises, they are not used up. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi pooran abh inaasee kahi sun  tot na aavan i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਕਿਹ ਸੁਿਣ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵਿਣਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, You are our Protector.
lines.transliteration: aithai othai tooNhai rakh vaalaa.

lines.english: In the womb of the mother, You cherish and nurture the baby.
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  meh t um hee paalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The fire of Maya does not affect those who are imbued with the Lord's Love; they singHis Glorious Praises. ||5||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa agan na pohai tin ka-o rang rat ay gun  gaavan i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: What Praises of Yours can I chant and contemplate?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gun t ayray aakh  samaalee.

lines.english: Deep within my mind and body, I behold Your Presence.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar tuDh nadar nihaalee.

lines.english: You are my Friend and Companion, my Lord and Master. Without You, I do not know any other at all. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa meet  saajan mayraa su-aamee t uDh bin avar na jaann i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਣਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O God, that one, unto whom You have given shelter,
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o tooN parabh  bha-i-aa sahaa-ee.
tis tatee vaa-o na lagai kaa-ee. is not touched by the hot winds.

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You are my Sanctuary, the Giver of peace. Chanting, meditating on You in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, You are revealed. ||7||
lines.transliteration: too saahib saran  sukh -daata satsangat  jap pargataavan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਜਿਪ ਪਰ੍ਗਟਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You are Exalted, Unfathomable, Infinite and Invaluable.
lines.transliteration: tooN ooch athaahu apaar amolaa.

lines.english: You are my True Lord and Master. I am Your servant and slave.
lines.transliteration: tooN saachaa saahib d aas tayraa golaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੋਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the King, Your Sovereign Rule is True. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.||8||3||37|| mwJ mhlw 5 Gru 2 ] (132-7) maajh mehlaa 5 gh ar 2. Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: tooN meeraa saachee th akuraa-ee naanak bal bal jaavan i-aa. ||8||3||37||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਠਕੁਰਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥੮॥੩॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Continually, continuously, remember the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: nit nit  da-yu samaalee-ai.

lines.english: Never forget Him from your mind. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mool na manhu visaaree-ai. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Join the Society of the Saints,
lines.transliteration: santaa sangat  paa-ee-ai.
jit jam kai panth na jaa-ee-ai. and you shall not have to go down the path of Death.

lines.english: Take the Provisions of the Lord's Name with you, and no stain shall attach itself to your family. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tosaa har kaa naam lai t ayray kuleh na laagai gaal jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Master
lines.transliteration: jo simranday saaN-ee-ai.
narak na say-ee paa-ee-ai. shall not be thrown down into hell.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਸਾ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੁਲਿਹ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗਾਿਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within theirminds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tatee vaa-o na lag-ee jin man vuth aa aa-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: They alone are beautiful and attractive,
lines.transliteration: say-ee sundar sohn ay.
saaDhsang jin baihn ay. who abide in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੀ  ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name-they alone are deep andthoughtful and vast. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har Dhan jinee sanji-aa say-ee gambh eer apaar jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name,
lines.transliteration: har ami-o rasaa-in peevee-ai.
muhi dithai jan kai jeevee-ai. and live by beholding the face of the Lord's servant.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਸੰਿਜਆ  ਸੇਈ ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Let all your affairs be resolved, by continually worshipping the Feet of the Guru. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaar lai nit  poojahu gur kay paav jee-o. ||4||

lines.english: He alone meditates on the Lord of the World, whom the Lord has made His Own.
lines.transliteration: jo har keetaa aapn aa. tineh gusaa-ee jaapn aa.

lines.english: He alone is a warrior, and he alone is the chosen one, upon whose forehead good destiny is recorded. ||5||
lines.transliteration: so sooraa parDhaan so mast ak jis d ai bhaag jee-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਿਭ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ਲੈ ਿਨਤ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਵ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Within my mind, I meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: man manDhay parabh  avgaahee-aa.

lines.english: For me, this is like the enjoyment of princely pleasures.
lines.transliteration: ayhi ras bhogan  paatisaahee-aa.

lines.english: Evil does not well up within me, since I am saved, and dedicated to truthful actions.||6||
lines.transliteration: mandaa mool na upji-o t aray sachee kaarai laag jee-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
lines.english: I have enshrined the Creator within my mind;
lines.transliteration: kartaa man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have obtained the fruits of life's rewards.
lines.transliteration: janmai kaa fal paa-i-aa.

lines.english: If your Husband Lord is pleasing to your mind, then your married life shall be eternal. ||7||
lines.transliteration: man bhaavand aa kant  har t ayraa thir ho-aa sohaag jee-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਤਰੇ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਿਗ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I have obtained everlasting wealth;
lines.transliteration: atal padaarath paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have found the Sanctuary of the Dispeller of fear.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh anjan kee sarn aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Grasping hold of the hem of the Lord's robe, Nanak is saved. He has won the incomparable life. ||8||4||38|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (132-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: mwJ mhlw 5 Gru 3 ] (132-18) maajh mehlaa 5 gh ar 3. Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: laa-ay anchal naanak taari-an jit aa janam apaar jee-o. ||8||4||38||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ  ਕੰਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਥਰੁ ਹੋਆ  ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the mind is held steady. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jap japay man Dheeray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Divine Guru, one's fears are erased anddispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: simar simar gurday-o mit ga-ay bh ai dooray. ||1||

lines.english: Entering the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, how could anyone feel grief any longer? ||2|| pMnw 133
lines.transliteration: saran aavai paarbarahm kee taa fir kaahay jh ooray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੈ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੀ ਤਾ ਿਫਿਰ ਕਾਹੇ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan sayv sant saaDh  kay sagal manorath pooray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸੇਵ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ayk varatd aa jal thal mahee-al pooray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints.||5||
lines.transliteration: paap binaasan sayvi-aa pavitar sant an kee Dh ooray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਿਬਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditatingon the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sabh chh adaa-ee kh asam aap har jap bh a-ee th arooray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਛਡਾਈ  ਖਸਿਮ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਭਈ ਠਰੂਰੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed.||7||
lines.transliteration: kartai kee-aa t apaavaso d usat mu-ay ho-ay mooray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤੈ  ਕੀਆ  ਤਪਾਵਸੋ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਮੁਏ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-presentLord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39|| bwrh mwhw mWJ mhlw 5 Gru 4  (133-5) baarah maahaa maaNjh mehlaa 5 gh ar 4 Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (133-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak rataa sach naa-ay har vaykh ai sad aa hajooray. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||

lines.english: By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.
lines.transliteration: kirat karam kay veechh urhay kar kirpaa maylhu raam.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰਹ  ਮਾਹਾ  ਮਝ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the tendirections. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.
lines.transliteration: chaar kunt dah d is bharamay thak aa-ay parabh  kee saam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਕਰਮ  ਕੇ ਵੀਛੁੜੇ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Dhayn d uDhai tay baahree kit ai na aavai kaam. Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਭਰ੍ਮੇ ਥਿਕ ਆਏ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.
lines.transliteration: jal bin saakh kumlaavat ee upjahi naahee d aam.

lines.punjabi: ਧੇਨੁ ਦੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.english: If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?
lines.transliteration: har naah na milee-ai saajnai kat paa-ee-ai bisraam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਖ ਕੁਮਲਾਵਤੀ  ਉਪਜਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਦਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those townsand villages are like burning furnaces.
lines.transliteration: jit ghar har kant  na pargata-ee bh ath nagar say garaam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਹ ਨ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਸਾਜਨੈ  ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਸਰਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are alluseless and vain.
lines.transliteration: sarab seegaar tambol ras san  dayhee sabh  khaam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਘਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਰ੍ਗਟਈ  ਭਿਠ ਨਗਰ  ਸੇ ਗਰ੍ਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are likethe Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: parabh su-aamee kant  vihoon ee-aa meet  sajan  sabh  jaam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਬ ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਤੰਬੋਲ  ਰਸ ਸਣੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਮ ॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer: "Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.
lines.transliteration: naanak kee banantee-aa kar kirpaa d eejai naam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੰਤ ਿਵਹੂਣੀਆ  ਮੀਤ ਸਜਣ  ਸਿਭ ਜਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence". ||1||
lines.transliteration: har maylhu su-aamee sang parabh jis kaa nihchal Dh aam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep andprofound joy arises.
lines.transliteration: chayt govind  araaDh ee-ai hovai anand gh anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਿਨਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with ourtongues.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil paa-ee-ai rasnaa naam bh anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਅਰਾਧੀਐ  ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਘਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.
lines.transliteration: jin paa-i-aa parabh aapn aa aa-ay t iseh gan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.english: Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.
lines.transliteration: ik khin t is bin jeevn aa birthaa janam jan aa.

lines.english: The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in theforests as well.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poori-aa ravi-aa vich vanaa.

lines.english: Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!
lines.transliteration: so parabh chit  na aavee kit -rhaa dukh ganaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਿਰਆ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: jinee raavi-aa so parabhoo t innaa bh aag man aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਕਤੜਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਗਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is sothirsty!
lines.transliteration: har darsan kaN-u man lochd aa naanak pi-aas manaa.

lines.english: I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chayt milaa-ay so parabh oo tis kai paa-ay lagaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੰਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਆਸ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: vaisaakh Dh eeran ki-o vaadh ee-aa jinaa paraym bichh ohu.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ  ਲਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attachedto Maya, the deceitful one.
lines.transliteration: har saajan purakh visaar kai lagee maa-i-aa Dh ohu.

lines.english: Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar na sang Dh anaa har avinaasee oh.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ਕੈ ਲਗੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਧੋਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world isperishing.
lines.transliteration: palach palach saglee mu-ee jhooth ai DhanDhai moh.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਧਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ ਓਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.
lines.transliteration: ikas har kay naam bin agai la-ee-ah khohi.

lines.punjabi: ਪਲਿਚ  ਪਲਿਚ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਮੁਈ ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: da-yu visaar viguchn aa parabh  bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਲਈਅਿਹ  ਖੋਿਹ ॥
lines.english: Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord. pMnw 134
lines.transliteration: pareetam charn ee jo lagay t in kee nirmal so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਹ ੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak makes this prayer to God: "Please, come and unite me with Yourself."
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh baynt ee parabh  milhu paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ  ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਤ ਲਗੈ ਜਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vaisaakh suhaavaa t aaN lagai jaa sant  bhaytai har so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humilitybefore Him.
lines.transliteration: har jayth jurh andaa lorh ee-ai jis agai sabh  nivann.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੇਿਠ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ  ਲੋੜੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਿਭ ਿਨਵੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one cankeep him in bondage.
lines.transliteration: har sajan d aavan  lagi-aa kisai na d ay-ee bann.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣ  ਦਾਵਿਣ  ਲਿਗਆ  ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਬੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.
lines.transliteration: maanak mot ee naam parabh  un lagai naahee sann.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਕ  ਮੋਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਉਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.
lines.transliteration: rang sabhay naaraa-in ai jayt ay man bh aavann.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਸਭੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ  ਜੇਤੇ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.
lines.transliteration: jo har lorhay so karay so-ee jee-a karann.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਅ  ਕਰੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.
lines.transliteration: jo parabh keet ay aapn ay say-ee kahee-ahi Dh an.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਤੇ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਸੇਈ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਧੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?
lines.transliteration: aapan lee-aa jay milai vichh urh ki-o rovann.

lines.english: Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss isenjoyed.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang paraapat ay naanak rang maan an.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose foreheadsuch good destiny is recorded. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har jayth rangeelaa t is Dhanee jis kai bh aag mathann. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੇਠੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥੰਿਨ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to theirHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: aasaarh t apand aa tis lagai har naahu na jinna paas.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾੜੁ  ਤਪੰਦਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਿਜੰਨਾ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have cometo rely upon mere mortals.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan purakh t i-aag kai maan as sand ee aas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਕੈ ਮਾਣਸ  ਸੰਦੀ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the nooseof Death.
lines.transliteration: duyai bh aa-ay viguchee-ai gal pa-ees jam kee faas.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਯੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਵਗੁਚੀਐ  ਗਿਲ  ਪਈਸੁ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.english: As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa beejai so lunai mathai jo likh i-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਮਥੈ ਜੋ ਿਲਿਖਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and thendepart with no hope at all.
lines.transliteration: rain vihaan ee pachh utaanee uth  chalee ga-ee niraas.

lines.english: Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin kou saaDhoo bh aytee-ai so d argeh ho-ay kh alaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੌ ਸਾਧੂ ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹ  ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aapn ee tayray d arsan ho-ay pi-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਪਣੀ  ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਹੋਇ ਿਪਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.
lines.transliteration: parabh t uDh bin d oojaa ko nahee naanak kee ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aasaarh suhand aa tis lagai jis man har charan  nivaas. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾੜੁ  ਸੁਹੰਦਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਿਨਵਾਸ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saavan sarsee kaamn ee charan kamal si-o pi-aar.

lines.english: Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her onlySupport.
lines.transliteration: man tan rat aa sach rang iko naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸਚ ਰੰਿਗ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa rang koorh aavi-aa d isan sabh ay chh aar.

lines.english: The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drinkthese in.
lines.transliteration: har amrit boond  suhaavan ee mil saaDh oo peevan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God,the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: van tin parabh  sang ma-oli-aa samrath purakh  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਣੁ ਿਤਣੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਉਿਲਆ ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!
lines.transliteration: har milnai no man lochd aa karam milaavan haar.

lines.english: Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: jinee sakhee-ay parabh  paa-i-aa haN-u tin kai sad  balihaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਖੀਏ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word ofHis Shabad.
lines.transliteration: naanak har jee ma-i-aa kar sabad savaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਮਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with theNecklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saavan t inaa suhaagan ee jin raam naam ur haar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਣੁ  ਿਤਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment toduality.
lines.transliteration: bhaad u-ay bh aram bh ulaan ee-aa d oojai lagaa hayt .

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਦੁਇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ  ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.
lines.transliteration: lakh seegaar ban aa-i-aa kaaraj naahee kayt .

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਿਜ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.
lines.transliteration: jit din dayh binsasee t it vaylai kahsan parayt .

lines.english: The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.
lines.transliteration: pakarh chalaa-in d oot jam kisai na d aynee bh ayt.

lines.punjabi: ਪਕਿੜ  ਚਲਾਇਿਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਨੀ  ਭੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.
lines.transliteration: chhad kh arhotay kh inai maahi jin si-o lagaa hayt .

lines.english: She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.
lines.transliteration: hath marorhai t an kapay si-aahhu ho-aa sayt .

lines.punjabi: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਤਨ ੁ ਕਪੇ ਿਸਆਹਹੁ ਹੋਆ  ਸੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa beejai so lunai karmaa sand -rhaa kh ayt.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਾ  ਸੰਦੜਾ  ਖੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee charan  bohith parabh  dayt.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਚਰਣ  ਬੋਿਹਥ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||
lines.transliteration: say bhaad u-ay narak na paa-ee-ah gur rakh an vaalaa hayt . ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਾਦੁਇ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਨ ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਣ  ਵਾਲਾ  ਹੇਤੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord? pMnw 135
lines.transliteration: asun paraym umaahrhaa ki-o milee-ai har jaa-ay.

lines.english: My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: man tan pi-aas d arsan gh anee ko-ee aan  milaavai maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਘਣੀ  ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.
lines.transliteration: sant sahaa-ee paraym kay ha-o t in kai laagaa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.
lines.transliteration: vin parabh  ki-o sukh  paa-ee-ai d oojee naahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jinHee chaakhi-aa paraym ras say t aripat  rahay aagh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜੰਨੀ  ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਸੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, "God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe."
lines.transliteration: aap ti-aag bint ee karahi layho parabh oo larh  laa-ay.

lines.english: Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated fromHim again.
lines.transliteration: jo har kant milaa-ee-aa se vichh urh kateh na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਕੰਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਈਆ ਿਸ ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parabh vin  doojaa ko nahee naanak har sarn aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਵਣੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell inpeace. ||8||
lines.transliteration: asoo sukhee vasand ee-aa jinaa ma-i-aa har raa-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸੂ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸੰਦੀਆ  ਿਜਨਾ ਮਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.
lines.transliteration: katik karam kamaavn ay dos na kaahoo jog.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਤਿਕ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.
lines.transliteration: parmaysar tay bh uli-aaN vi-aapan sabh ay rog.

lines.english: Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned toreincarnation, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: vaimukh ho-ay raam t ay lagan janam vijog.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਮੁਖ  ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਲਗਿਨ  ਜਨਮ  ਿਵਜੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.
lines.transliteration: khin meh ka-urh ay ho-ay ga-ay jit -rhay maa-i-aa bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਉੜੇ  ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਿਜਤੜੇ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.english: No one can then serve as your intermediary. Unto whom can we turn and cry?
lines.transliteration: vich na ko-ee kar sakai kis thai roveh roj.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਰ ਸਕੈ ਿਕਸ ਥੈ ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਰੋਜ ॥
lines.english: By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the verybeginning.
lines.transliteration: keetaa kichh oo na hova-ee likh i-aa Dh ur sanjog.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee mayraa parabh  milai t aaN utreh sabh  bi-og.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ  ਉਤਰਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਿਬਓਗ  ॥
lines.english: Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh raakh  layhi mayray saahib band ee moch.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਿਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥
lines.english: In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||
lines.transliteration: katik hovai saaDh sang binsahi sabh ay soch. ||9||

lines.english: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.
lines.transliteration: manghir maahi sohand ee-aa har pir sang baith -rhee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਿਘਿਰ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.
lines.transliteration: tin kee sobh aa ki-aa gan ee je saahib maylrh ee-aah.

lines.english: Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of theHoly Saints.
lines.transliteration: tan man ma-oli-aa raam si-o sang saaDh  sahaylrh ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁਮਨੁ ਮਉਿਲਆ  ਰਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa t ay baahree say rahan ikaylarh ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ  ਸੇ ਰਹਿਨ  ਇਕੇਲੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: tin dukh na kabhoo ut rai say jam kai vas parh ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਉਤਰੈ  ਸੇ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਪੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.
lines.transliteration: jinee raavi-aa parabh aapn aa say d isan nit  kharhee-aah.

lines.english: They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ratan javayhar laal har kanth  tinaa jarh ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਲਾਲ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਿਠ ਿਤਨਾ  ਜੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord'sDoor.
lines.transliteration: naanak baaNchhai Dh oorh tin parabh  sarnee dar parh ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਛੈ ਧੂਿੜ ਿਤਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣੀ  ਦਿਰ ਪੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnationever again. ||10||
lines.transliteration: manghir parabh  aaraaDh anaa bahurh  na janamrh ee-aah. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਿਘਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜਨਮੜੀਆਹ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugsclose in His Embrace.
lines.transliteration: pokh t ukhaar na vi-aapa-ee kanth  mili-aa har naahu.

lines.punjabi: ਪੋਿਖ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਿਵਆਪਈ  ਕੰਿਠ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Visionof the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: man bayDhi-aa charnaarbind  darsan lagrh aa saahu.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਚਰਨਾਰਿਬੰਦ  ਦਰਸਿਨ ਲਗੜਾ  ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.
lines.transliteration: ot govind gopaal raa-ay sayvaa su-aamee laahu.

lines.punjabi: ਓਟ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਰਾਇ  ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa pohi na sak-ee mil saaDh oo gun  gaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਪੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love ofthe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: jah tay upjee t ah milee sachee pareet  samaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ  ਤਹ ਿਮਲੀ  ਸਚੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਸਮਾਹ ੁ ॥
lines.english: When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again sufferseparation from Him.
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenee paarbarahm bahurh na vichh urhi-aahu.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੀਨੀ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ ਬਹ ੁਿੜ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜੀਆਹ ੁ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable andUnfathomable.
lines.transliteration: baar jaa-o lakh bayree-aa har sajan  agam agaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: saram pa-ee naaraa-inai naanak d ar pa-ee-aahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਮ  ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਿਰ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord hasforgiven. ||11||
lines.transliteration: pokh sohand aa sarab sukh  jis bakh say vayparvaahu. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਪੋਖੁ ਸਹੰਦਾ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ  ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: maagh majan sang saaDh oo-aa Dh oorhee kar isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਘ  ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧੂਆ  ਧੂੜੀ ਕਿਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam Dhi-aa-ay sun  sabh naa no kar d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸਭਨਾ  ਨੋ ਕਿਰ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind. pMnw 136
lines.transliteration: janam karam mal utrai man t ay jaa-ay gumaan.

lines.english: Sexual desire and anger shall not seduce you, and the dog of greed shall depart.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh na mohee-ai binsai lobh  su-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰੋਿਧ  ਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ  ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who walk on the Path of Truth shall be praised throughout the world.
lines.transliteration: sachai maarag chaldi-aa ust at karay jahaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Be kind to all beings-this is more meritorious than bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the giving of charity.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath sagal punn jee-a d a-i-aa parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਸਗਲ  ਪੁੰਨ ਜੀਅ  ਦਇਆ  ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Mercy, is a wise person.
lines.transliteration: jis no dayvai d a-i-aa kar so-ee purakh  sujaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have merged with God.
lines.transliteration: jinaa mili-aa parabh aapn aa naanak t in kurbaan.

lines.english: In Maagh, they alone are known as true, unto whom the Perfect Guru is Merciful.||12||
lines.transliteration: maagh suchay say kaaNdhee-ah jin pooraa gur miharvaan. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਘ  ਸੁਚੇ ਸੇ ਕਢੀਅਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, unto whom the Lord, the Friend, hasbeen revealed.
lines.transliteration: fulgun anand upaarjanaa har sajan  pargatay aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਫਲਗੁਿਣ  ਅਨੰਦ  ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints, the Lord's helpers, in their mercy, have united me with Him.
lines.transliteration: sant sahaa-ee raam kay kar kirpaa d ee-aa milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My bed is beautiful, and I have all comforts. I feel no sadness at all.
lines.transliteration: sayj suhaavee sarab sukh hun  dukhaa naahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਹੁਿਣ ਦੁਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My desires have been fulfilled-by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sovereign Lord as my Husband.
lines.transliteration: ichh punee vadbh aagnee var paa-i-aa har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of rejoicing and the Hymns of the Lord ofthe Universe.
lines.transliteration: mil sahee-aa mangal gaavhee geet govind  alaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਹੀਆ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਵਹੀ  ਗੀਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਅਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: There is no other like the Lord-there is no equal to Him.
lines.transliteration: har jayhaa avar na dis-ee ko-ee d oojaa lavai na laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਿਦਸਈ  ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He embellishes this world and the world hereafter, and He gives us our permanenthome there.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  savaari-on nihchal d itee-an jaa-ay.

lines.english: He rescues us from the world-ocean; never again do we have to run the cycle ofreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar tay rakh i-an bahurh  na janmai Dh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ  ਤੇ ਰਿਖਅਨੁਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ  ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I have only one tongue, but Your Glorious Virtues are beyond counting. Nanak issaved, falling at Your Feet.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa ayk anayk gun t aray naanak charn ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ  ਗੁਣ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In Phalgun, praise Him continually; He has not even an iota of greed. ||13||
lines.transliteration: fulgun nit  salaahee-ai jis no t il na t amaa-ay. ||13||

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.
lines.transliteration: jin jin naam Dhi-aa-i-aa t in kay kaaj saray.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Perfect Guru, the Lord-Incarnate-they are judged true in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har gur pooraa aaraaDhi-aa d argeh sach kh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਸਿਚ ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Feet are the Treasure of all peace and comfort for them; they cross overthe terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa niDh  charan  har bh a-ojal bikh am taray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਿਨਿਧ  ਚਰਣ  ਹਿਰ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They obtain love and devotion, and they do not burn in corruption.
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  tin paa-ee-aa bikh i-aa naahi jaray.

lines.english: Falsehood has vanished, duality has been erased, and they are totally overflowingwith Truth.
lines.transliteration: koorh ga-ay d ubiDh aa nasee pooran sach bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜ ਗਏ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਨਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਿਚ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They serve the Supreme Lord God, and enshrine the One Lord within their minds.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh sayvd ay man and ar ayk Dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਮਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The months, the days, and the moments are auspicious, for those upon whom theLord casts His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: maah divas moorat  bhalay jis ka-o nad ar karay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਹ ਿਦਵਸ  ਮੂਰਤ ਭਲੇ ਿਜਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for the blessing of Your Vision, O Lord. Please, shower Your Mercy uponme! ||14||1|| mwJ mhlw 5 idn rYix  (136-14) maajh mehlaa 5 d in raiian Maajh, Fifth Mehl: Day And Night: <> siqgur pRswid ] (136-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai daras d aan kirpaa karahu haray. ||14||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦਰਸ  ਦਾਨੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.
lines.transliteration: sayvee satgur aapn aa har simree d in sabh  rain.

lines.english: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.
lines.transliteration: aap ti-aag sarn ee pavaaN mukh  bolee mith -rhay vain .

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰੀ  ਿਦਨ  ਸਿਭ ਰੈਣ ॥
lines.english: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, youare my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa vichhurh i-aa har maylhu sajan  sain.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਵ ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੀ  ਿਮਠੜੇ  ਵੈਣ ॥
lines.english: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.
lines.transliteration: jo jee-a har tay vichh urhay say sukh  na vasan bh ain.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕਾ ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਸੈਣ ॥
lines.english: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen allrealms.
lines.transliteration: har pir bin chain na paa-ee-ai khoj dith ay sabh  gain.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ  ਹਿਰ ਤੇ ਿਵਛੁੜੇ  ਸੇ ਸੁਿਖ ਨ ਵਸਿਨ  ਭੈਣ ॥
lines.english: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyoneelse?
lines.transliteration: aap kamaanai vichh urhee dos na kaahoo d ayn.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਪਰ ਿਬਨੁਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਖੋਿਜ ਿਡਠੇ ਸਿਭ ਗੈਣ ॥
lines.english: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh raakh  layho hor naahee karan  karayn .

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਕਮਾਣੈ  ਿਵਛੁੜੀ  ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੇਣ ॥
lines.english: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. Unto whom should we utter our cries ofdistress?
lines.transliteration: har tuDh  vin khaakoo rooln aa kahee-ai kithai vain .

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਰੇਣ  ॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer: "May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being."||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kee banantee-aa har surjan d aykhaa nain . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਵਣੁ ਖਾਕੂ ਰੂਲਣਾ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਕਥੈ ਵੈਣ ॥
lines.english: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee birthaa so sunay har sammrith purakh  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all. pMnw 137
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan  aaraaDh anaa sabh naa kaa aaDh aar.

lines.english: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.
lines.transliteration: sasurai pay-ee-ai tis kant  kee vadaa jis parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੁਰੈ  ਪੇਈਐ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਵਡਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: oochaa agam agaaDh boDh  kichh  ant na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧ ਬੋਧ ਿਕਛੁ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble,like the dust of the feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa saa tis bh aavsee sant aa kee ho-ay chh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ  ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath d ai-aal d ayv pat it uDhaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਦੈਆਲ  ਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator hasbeen our Saving Grace.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee rakh -daa sach naam kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਰਖਦਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.
lines.transliteration: keemat ko-ay na jaan -ee ko naahee t olanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar vas rahay naanak nahee sumaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਿਸ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||
lines.transliteration: din rain  je parabh  kaN-u sayvd ay tin kai sad  balihaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਿਜ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੰਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.
lines.transliteration: sant araaDh an sad  sadaa sabh naa kaa bakh sind.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਿਨ  ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਬਖਿਸੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind jin saaji-aa kar kirpaa dit een jind .

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee aaraaDh ee-ai japee-ai nirmal mant .

lines.english: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.
lines.transliteration: keemat kahan  na jaa-ee-ai parmaysur bay-ant .

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.
lines.transliteration: jis man vasai naaraa-ino so kahee-ai bh agvant .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ  ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਭਗਵੰਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee lochaa pooree-ai milai su-aamee kant.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ  ਪੂਰੀਐ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevai jap haree dokh  sabh ay hee hant .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜੀਵੈ ਜਿਪ ਹਰੀ ਦੋਖ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਹੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: din rain  jis na visrai so hari-aa hovai jant . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਿਜਸੁ ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਜੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa parabh poorn o manj  nimaan ee thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੂਰਣੋ  ਮੰਞੁ ਿਨਮਾਣੀ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.
lines.transliteration: har ot gahee man andray jap jap jeevaaN naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੇ  ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet ofthe humble.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aapn ee jan Dh oorhee sang samaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਪਣੀ  ਜਨ ਧੂੜੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tooN raakh ahi ti-o rahaa t ayraa d itaa painaa kh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਦਤਾ  ਪੈਨਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.english: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of theHoly.
lines.transliteration: udam so-ee karaa-ay parabh  mil saaDh oo gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?
lines.transliteration: doojee jaa-ay na sujh -ee kithai kookan  jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਿਕਥੈ ਕੂਕਣ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomableand Unapproachable Lord.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan binaasan tam haran  oochay agam amaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਿਬਨਾਸਨ  ਤਮ ਹਰਣ  ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ  ਅਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.
lines.transliteration: man vichhurh i-aa har maylee-ai naanak ayhu su-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1|| vwr mwJ kI qQw slok mhlw 1  mlk murId qQw cMdRhVw sohIAw kI DunI gwvxI ] (137-13) vaar maajh kee t athaa salok mehlaa 1 malak mureed  tathaa chand arharh aa sohee-aa kee Dhunee gaavn ee. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru'sGrace: sloku mÚ 1 ] (137-15) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aanaa t it din har parsee gur kay paa-o. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕਿਲਆਣਾ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਿਦਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰਸੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the threeworlds.
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa gur hivai gh ar gur d eepak t ih lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਮਲਕ  ਮੁਰੀਦ  ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦਰ੍ਹੜਾ  ਸੋਹੀਆ  ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall findpeace. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (137-16) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: amar padaarath naankaa man maanee-ai sukh  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: First, the baby loves mother's milk;
lines.transliteration: pahilai pi-aar lagaa than d uDh.
doojai maa-ay baap kee suDh . second, he learns of his mother and father;

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਹਵੈ ਘਰੁਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਿਤਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teejai bh a-yaa bh aabhee bayb. third, his brothers, sisters-in-law and sisters;

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਮਿਨ ਮਾਿਨਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai pi-aar upannee khayd. fourth, the love of play awakens.

lines.english: Fifth, he runs after food and drink;
lines.transliteration: punjvai khaan  pee-an  kee Dh aat.
chhivai kaam na puchh ai jaat . sixth, in his sexual desire, he does not respect social customs.

lines.english: Seventh, he gathers wealth and dwells in his house;
lines.transliteration: satvai sanj kee-aa gh ar vaas.
athvai kroDh  ho-aa t an naas. eighth, he becomes angry, and his body is consumed.

lines.english: Ninth, he turns grey, and his breathing becomes labored;
lines.transliteration: naavai Dha-ulay ubh ay saah.
dasvai d aDhaa ho-aa su-aah. tenth, he is cremated, and turns to ashes.

lines.english: His companions send him off, crying out and lamenting.
lines.transliteration: ga-ay sigeet pukaaree Dh aah.

lines.english: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to go. pMnw 138
lines.transliteration: udi-aa hans dasaa-ay raah.

lines.english: He came and he went, and now, even his name has died.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa ga-i-aa mu-i-aa naa-o.

lines.english: After he left, food was offered on leaves, and the birds were called to come and eat.
lines.transliteration: pichhai pat al sad ihu kaav.

lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs love the darkness.
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh anDh  pi-aar.

lines.english: Without the Guru, the world is drowning. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (138-2) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo dubaa sansaar. ||2||

lines.english: At the age of ten, he is a child; at twenty, a youth, and at thirty, he is calledhandsome.
lines.transliteration: das baalt an bees ravan  teesaa kaa sund ar kahaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਬਾਲਤਿਣ  ਬੀਸ ਰਵਿਣ  ਤੀਸਾ  ਕਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: At forty, he is full of life; at fifty, his foot slips, and at sixty, old age is upon him.
lines.transliteration: chaaleesee pur ho-ay pachaasee pag khisai sath ee kay bodh aypaa aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਲੀਸੀ  ਪੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਚਾਸੀ  ਪਗੁ ਿਖਸੈ ਸਠੀ ਕੇ ਬੋਢੇਪਾ  ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: At seventy, he loses his intellect, and at eighty, he cannot perform his duties.
lines.transliteration: satar kaa mat iheen  aseehaaN kaa vi-uhaar na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਿਰ  ਕਾ ਮਿਤਹੀਣੁ  ਅਸੀਹ  ਕਾ ਿਵਉਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: At ninety, he lies in his bed, and he cannot understand his weakness.
lines.transliteration: navai kaa sihjaasnee mool na jaan ai ap bal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵੈ ਕਾ ਿਸਹਜਾਸਣੀ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅਪ ਬਲੁ ॥
lines.english: After seeking and searching for such a long time, O Nanak, I have seen that the world is just a mansion of smoke. ||3|| pauVI ] (138-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: dhandh olim dh oodhim dith  mai naanak jag Dh oo-ay kaa Dh avalhar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਢੰਢੋਿਲਮੁ  ਢੂਿਢਮੁ  ਿਡਠੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਧਵਲਹਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You, O Creator Lord, are Unfathomable. You Yourself created the Universe,
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa purakh  agamm hai aap sarisat upaat ee.
rang parang upaarjanaa baho baho biDh bh aatee. its colors, qualities and varieties, in so many ways and forms.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਆਿਪ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: You created it, and You alone understand it. It is all Your Play.
lines.transliteration: tooN jaaneh jin upaa-ee-ai sabh  khayl tumaat ee.

lines.english: Some come, and some arise and depart; but without the Name, all are bound to die.
lines.transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaahi uth bin naavai mar jaat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਪਾਈਐ  ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the deep crimson color of the poppy; they are dyed inthe color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rang chalooli-aa rang har rang raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਇਿਕ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਉਿਠ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: So serve the True and Pure Lord, the Supremely Powerful Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: so sayvhu sat niranjano har purakh  biDhaatee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਿਲਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are All-knowing. O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great!
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay aap sujaan  hai vad purakh  vadaat ee.

lines.english: O my True Lord, I am a sacrifice, a humble sacrifice, to those who meditate on You within their conscious mind. ||1|| slok mÚ 1 ] (138-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo man chit t uDh Dhi-aa-id ay mayray sachi-aa bal bal ha-o t in jaat ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਵਡਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: He placed the soul in the body which He had fashioned. He protects the Creationwhich He has created.
lines.transliteration: jee-o paa-ay tan saaji-aa rakh i-aa ban at banaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਚਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With their eyes, they see, and with their tongues, they speak; with their ears, theybring the mind to awareness.
lines.transliteration: akhee d aykhai jihvaa bolai kannee surat  samaa-ay.

lines.english: With their feet, they walk, and with their hands, they work; they wear and eatwhatever is given.
lines.transliteration: pairee chalai hathee karnaa d itaa painai kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਪਾਇ  ਤਨੁ ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਰਿਖਆ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They do not know the One who created the Creation. The blind fools do their darkdeeds.
lines.transliteration: jin rach rachi-aa tiseh na jaan ai anDh aa anDh  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਦੇਖੈ ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਬੋਲੈ ਕੰਨੀ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the pitcher of the body breaks and shatters into pieces, it cannot be re-createdagain.
lines.transliteration: jaa bhajai t aa theekar hovai gh aarhat gharhee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਥੀ ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਦਤਾ  ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Guru, there is no honor; without honor, no one is carried across. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (138-12) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur bin naahi pat pat  vin paar na paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਿਚ ਰਿਚਆ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They prefer the gift, instead of the Giver; such is the way of the self-willedmanmukhs.
lines.transliteration: dayNday thaavhu d itaa changa manmukh  aisaa jaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਭਜੈ ਤਾ ਠੀਕਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾੜਤ  ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: What can anyone say about their intelligence, their understanding or their cleverness?
lines.transliteration: surat mat  chaturaa-ee t aa kee ki-aa kar aakh  vakh aanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ਪਿਤ ਪਿਤ ਿਵਣੁ ਪਾਿਰ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The deeds which one commits, while sitting in one's own home, are known far andwide, in the four directions.
lines.transliteration: antar bahi kai karam kamaavai so chahu kundee jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: One who lives righteously is known as righteous; one who commits sins is known as asinner.
lines.transliteration: jo Dharam kamaavai t is Dharam naa-o hovai paap kamaan ai paapee jaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਿਦਤਾ  ਚੰਗਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਐਸਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself enact the entire play, O Creator. Why should we speak of any other?
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay kh ayl karahi sabh  kartay ki-aa d oojaa aakh  vakh aanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਿਕਆ  ਕਿਰ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: As long as Your Light is within the body, You speak through that Light. Without Your Light, who can do anything? Show me any such cleverness!
lines.transliteration: mÚ 2) jichar tayree jot  tichar jot ee vich t ooN boleh vin  jotee ko-ee kichh  karihu d ikhaa si- aanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਿਹ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੋ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord alone is Perfect and All-knowing; He is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||2|| pauVI ] (138-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh nad ree aa-i-aa har iko sugh arh sujaan ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਧਰਮ  ਨਾਉ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਿਪ  ਕਮਾਣੈ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself put it to work.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay jagat  upaa-ay kai t uDh aapay Dh anDhai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਤੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Administering the drug of emotional attachment, You Yourself have led the world astray.
lines.transliteration: moh thag-ulee paa-ay kai t uDh aaphu jagat  khu-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਚਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਿਤ ਿਤਚਰੁ ਜੋਤੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਤੂੰ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਿਵਣੁ ਜੋਤੀ  ਕੋਈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਿਰਹੁ ਿਦਖਾ  ਿਸਆਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The fire of desire is deep within; unsatisfied, people remain hungry and thirsty.
lines.transliteration: tisnaa and ar agan hai nah t iptai bhukhaa tihaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This world is an illusion; it dies and it is re-born-it comes and it goes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: sahsaa ih sansaar hai mar jammai aa-i-aa jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, emotional attachment is not broken. All have grown weary ofperforming empty rituals.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur moh na t ut-ee sabh  thakay karam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.Filled with a joyful peace, they surrender to Your Will.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai sukh  rajaa jaa t uDh bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ  ਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਖੁਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They save their families and ancestors; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them. pMnw 139
lines.transliteration: kul uDhaaray aapn aa Dh an jan aydee maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Beautiful and sublime is the glory and the understanding of those who focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||2|| sloku mÚ 2 ] (139-2) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sobhaa surat  suhaavan ee jin har sayt ee chit  laa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: To see without eyes; to hear without ears;
lines.transliteration: akhee baajh ahu vaykh -naa vin  kanna sunn aa.
pairaa baajhahu chaln aa vin  hathaa karn aa. to walk without feet; to work without hands;
jeebhai baajh ahu boln aa i-o jeevat  marn aa. to speak without a tongue-like this, one remains dead while yet alive.

lines.english: O Nanak, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merge with your Lordand Master. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (139-3) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam pachhaan  kai ta-o kh asmai miln aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਭੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਇਉ ਜੀਵਤ  ਮਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is seen, heard and known, but His subtle essence is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: disai sun ee-ai jaan ee-ai saa-o na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਣ  ਕੈ ਤਉ ਖਸਮੈ  ਿਮਲਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can the lame, armless and blind person run to embrace the Lord?
lines.transliteration: ruhlaa tundaa anDhulaa ki-o gal lagai Dh aa-ay.

lines.english: Let the Fear of God be your feet, and let His Love be your hands; let His Understanding be your eyes.
lines.transliteration: bhai kay charan  kar bh aav kay lo-in  surat  karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਸੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in this way, O wise soul-bride, you shall be united with your HusbandLord. ||2|| pauVI ] (139-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai si-aanee-ay iv kant  milaavaa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਹਲਾ ਟੁੰਡਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਗਿਲ  ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, You are the only One; You set the play of duality in motion.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa tooN ayk hai t uDh doojaa kh ayl rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਕਰ ਭਾਵ ਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: You created egotism and arrogant pride, and You placed greed within our beings.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai garab upaa-ay kai lobh ant ar jant aa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Keep me as it pleases Your Will; everyone acts as You cause them to act.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh  too sabh  karay t ayraa karaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Some are forgiven, and merge with You; through the Guru's Teachings, we are joinedto You.
lines.transliteration: iknaa bakhsahi mayl laihi gurmat ee tuDhai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Some stand and serve You; without the Name, nothing else pleases them.
lines.transliteration: ik kharh ay karahi t ayree chaakree vin  naavai hor na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੰਤਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Any other task would be worthless to them-You have enjoined them to Your TrueService.
lines.transliteration: hor kaar vaykaar hai ik sachee kaarai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the midst of children, spouse and relations, some still remain detached; they are pleasing to Your Will.
lines.transliteration: put kalat  kutamb hai ik alipat  rahay jo t uDh bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਬਖਸਿਹ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, they are pure, and they are absorbed in the True Name. ||3|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (139-10) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ohi andrahu baahrahu nirmalay sachai naa-ay samaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਖੜੇ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I may make a cave, in a mountain of gold, or in the water of the nether regions;
lines.transliteration: su-inay kai parbat gufaa karee kai paan ee pa-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਾਰ ਵੇਕਾਰ  ਹੈ ਇਿਕ  ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I may remain standing on my head, upside-down, on the earth or up in the sky;
lines.transliteration: kai vich Dhart ee kai aakaasee uraDh  rahaa sir bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ  ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਹੈ ਇਿਕ  ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਰਹੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I may totally cover my body with clothes, and wash them continually;
lines.transliteration: pur kar kaa-i-aa kaparh pahiraa Dh ovaa sad aa kaar.

lines.english: I may shout out loud, the white, red, yellow and black Vedas;
lines.transliteration: bagaa rataa pee-alaa kaalaa bayd aa karee pukaar.

lines.english: I may even live in dirt and filth. And yet, all this is just a product of evil-mindedness,and intellectual corruption.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay kucheel rahaa mal Dhaaree d urmat  mat vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨੇ  ਕੈ ਪਰਬਿਤ  ਗੁਫਾ ਕਰੀ ਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ  ਪਇਆਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: I was not, I am not, and I will never be anything at all! O Nanak, I dwell only on theWord of the Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (139-13) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o naa mai naa ha-o hovaa naanak sabad veechaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਕੈ ਆਕਾਸੀ  ਉਰਿਧ  ਰਹਾ ਿਸਿਰ  ਭਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They wash their clothes, and scrub their bodies, and try to practice self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: vastar pakh aal pakh aalay kaa-i-aa aapay sanjam hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਪੜੁ  ਪਿਹਰਾ  ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: But they are not aware of the filth staining their inner being, while they try and try towash off the outer dirt.
lines.transliteration: antar mail lagee nahee jaan ai baahrahu mal mal Dh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਗਾ  ਰਤਾ ਪੀਅਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ  ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The blind go astray, caught by the noose of Death.
lines.transliteration: anDhaa bh ool pa-i-aa jam jaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ  ਰਹਾ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: vasat paraa-ee apunee kar jaanai ha-umai vich d ukh ghaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਹੋਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the egotism of the Gurmukhs is broken, and then, they meditate on theName of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ha-umai t utai taa har har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.english: They chant the Naam, meditate on the Naam, and through the Naam, they areabsorbed in peace. ||2|| pvVI ] (139-16) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naam japay naamo aaraaDhay naamay sukh  samaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਸਤਰ੍  ਪਖਾਿਲ  ਪਖਾਲੇ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Destiny has brought together and united the body and the soul-swan.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa hans sanjog mayl milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗੀ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਹਰਹ ੁ ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He who created them, also separates them.
lines.transliteration: tin hee kee-aa vijog jin upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The fools enjoy their pleasures; they must also endure all their pains.
lines.transliteration: moorakh bh ogay bh og dukh sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: From pleasures, arise diseases and the commission of sins.
lines.transliteration: sukhhu uth ay rog paap kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: From sinful pleasures come sorrow, separation, birth and death.
lines.transliteration: harkhahu sog vijog upaa-ay kh apaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The fools try to account for their misdeeds, and argue uselessly.
lines.transliteration: moorakh gan at ganaa-ay jh agrhaa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The judgement is in the Hands of the True Guru, who puts an end to the argument.
lines.transliteration: satgur hath nibayrh  jhagarh  chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. It cannot be changed by anyone's efforts. ||4|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (139-19) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kartaa karay so hog na chalai chalaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Telling lies, they eat dead bodies. pMnw 140
