lines.transliteration: koorh bol murd aar kh aa-ay.

lines.english: And yet, they go out to teach others.
lines.transliteration: avree no samjhaavan  jaa-ay.

lines.english: They are deceived, and they deceive their companions.
lines.transliteration: muthaa aap muhaa-ay saathai.

lines.english: O Nanak, such are the leaders of men. ||1|| mhlw 4 ] (140-1) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aisaa aagoo jaapai. ||1||

lines.english: Those, within whom the Truth dwells, obtain the True Name; they speak only theTruth.
lines.transliteration: jis dai and ar sach hai so sachaa naam mukh  sach alaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They walk on the Lord's Path, and inspire others to walk on the Lord's Path as well.
lines.transliteration: oh har maarag aap chaldaa hornaa no har maarag paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਆਿਪ  ਚਲਦਾ  ਹੋਰਨਾ  ਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Bathing in a pool of holy water, they are washed clean of filth. But, by bathing in astagnant pond, they are contaminated with even more filth.
lines.transliteration: jay agai tirath ho-ay t aa mal lahai chh aparh  naatai sagvee mal laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਅਗੈ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੈ ਛਪਿੜ  ਨਾਤੈ  ਸਗਵੀ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Perfect Pool of Holy Water. Night and day, He meditates on theName of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: tirath pooraa sat guroo jo an-d in har har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਜੋ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: He is saved, along with his family; bestowing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, He saves the whole world.
lines.transliteration: oh aap chhutaa kutamb si-o d ay har har naam sabh  sarisat chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਛੁਟਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਿਸਉ ਦੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਛਡਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to one who himself chants the Naam, and inspires othersto chant it as well. ||2|| pauVI ] (140-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaarn ai jo aap japai avraa naam japaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਜੋ ਆਿਪ  ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some pick and eat fruits and roots, and live in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: ik kand mool chun  khaahi van  khand vaasaa.

lines.english: Some wander around wearing saffron robes, as Yogis and Sanyaasees.
lines.transliteration: ik bhagvaa vays kar fireh jogee saniaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਿਣ  ਖਾਿਹ ਵਣ ਖੰਿਡ ਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: But there is still so much desire within them-they still yearn for clothes and food.
lines.transliteration: andar t arisnaa bahut  chhaadan bh ojan kee aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭਗਵਾ  ਵੇਸੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: They waste their lives uselessly; they are neither householders nor renunciates.
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam gavaa-ay na girhee na udaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਬਹ ੁਤੁ ਛਾਦਨ  ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death hangs over their heads, and they cannot escape the three-phased desire.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal sirahu na utrai t aribaDh  mansaa.

lines.english: Death does not even approach those who follow the Guru's Teachings, and becomethe slaves of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee kaal na aavai nayrh ai jaa hovai d aasan d aasaa.

lines.english: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their true minds; within the home of their own inner beings, they remain detached.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad sach man gh ar hee maahi ud aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who serve their True Guru, rise from desire to desirelessness. ||5|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (140-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur sayvan aapn aa say aasaa t ay niraasaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਉਦਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: If one's clothes are stained with blood, the garment becomes polluted.
lines.transliteration: jay rat lagai kaprh ai jaamaa ho-ay paleet .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੇ ਆਸਾ  ਤੇ ਿਨਰਾਸਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who suck the blood of human beings-how can their consciousness be pure?
lines.transliteration: jo rat peeveh maan saa tin ki-o nirmal cheet .

lines.english: O Nanak, chant the Name of God, with heart-felt devotion.
lines.transliteration: naanak naa-o khud aa-ay kaa d il hachh ai mukh  layho.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਰਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਕਪੜੈ  ਜਾਮਾ  ਹੋਇ ਪਲੀਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: Everything else is just a pompous worldly show, and the practice of false deeds. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (140-11) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: avar divaajay d unee kay jh oothay amal karayhu. ||1||

lines.english: Since I am no one, what can I say? Since I am nothing, what can I be?
lines.transliteration: jaa ha-o naahee taa ki-aa aakh aa kihu naahee ki-aa hovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਉ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਕਾ ਿਦਿਲ  ਹਛੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: As He created me, so I act. As He causes me to speak, so I speak. I am full and overflowing with sins-if only I could wash them away!
lines.transliteration: keetaa karn aa kahi-aa kathnaa bh ari-aa bh ar bhar Dh ovaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਿਰ  ਿਦਵਾਜੇ  ਦੁਨੀ  ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਮਲ  ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not understand myself, and yet I try to teach others. Such is the guide I am!
lines.transliteration: aap na bujhaa lok bujh aa-ee aisaa aagoo hovaaN.

lines.english: O Nanak, the one who is blind shows others the way, and misleads all hiscompanions.
lines.transliteration: naanak anDhaa ho-ay kai d asay raahai sabh as muhaa-ay saathai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤਾ ਿਕਆ  ਆਖਾ  ਿਕਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਆ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
lines.english: But, going to the world hereafter, he shall be beaten and kicked in the face; then, itwill be obvious, what sort of guide he was! ||2|| pauVI ] (140-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: agai ga-i-aa muhay muhi paahi so aisaa aagoo jaapai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਕਥਨਾ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਭਿਰ ਭਿਰ ਧੋਵ ॥
lines.english: Through all the months and the seasons, the minutes and the hours, I dwell uponYou, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: maahaa rutee sabh  tooN gharhee moorat  veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਬੁਝਾ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ਐਸਾ  ਆਗੂ ਹੋਵ ॥
lines.english: No one has attained You by clever calculations, O True, Unseen and Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: tooN gantai kinai na paa-i-o sachay alakh  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੈ ਸਭਸੁ  ਮੁਹਾਏ  ਸਾਥੈ ॥
lines.english: That scholar who is full of greed, arrogant pride and egotism, is known to be a fool.
lines.transliteration: parhi-aa moorakh  aakh ee-ai jis lab lobh  ahaNkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ  ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਿਹ ਪਾਿਹ  ਸੁ ਐਸਾ  ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: So read the Name, and realize the Name, and contemplate the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: naa-o parhee-ai naa-o bujh ee-ai gurmat ee veechaaraa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have earned the wealth of the Naam; I possess the storehouses, overflowing with devotion to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naam Dh an kh ati-aa bh agtee bh aray bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਹਾ  ਰੁਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੂੰ ਘੜੀ  ਮੂਰਤ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Believing in the Immaculate Naam, one is hailed as true, in the True Court of theLord.
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam mani-aa dar sachai sachi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਗਣਤੈ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Light of the Infinite Lord, who owns the soul and the breath of life, is deepwithin the inner being.
lines.transliteration: jis daa jee-o paraan  hai ant ar jot  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜਆ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You alone are the True Banker, O Lord; the rest of the world is just Your petty trader.||6|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (140-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu ik tooN hor jagat  vanjaaraa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਪੜੀਐ  ਨਾਉ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let mercy be your mosque, faith your prayer-mat, and honest living your Koran.
lines.transliteration: mihar maseet sid ak muslaa hak halaal kuraan .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਆ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Make modesty your circumcision, and good conduct your fast. In this way, you shallbe a true Muslim.
lines.transliteration: saram sunat seel rojaa hohu musalmaan .

lines.english: Let good conduct be your Kaabaa, Truth your spiritual guide, and the karma of gooddeeds your prayer and chant.
lines.transliteration: karnee kaabaa sach peer kalmaa karam nivaaj.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ  ਪਰਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let your rosary be that which is pleasing to His Will. O Nanak, God shall preserve your honor. ||1|| pMnw 141 mÚ 1 ] (141-1) mehlaa 1. First Mehl
lines.transliteration: tasbee saa t is bhaavsee naanak rakh ai laaj. ||1||

lines.english: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindueating beef.
lines.transliteration: hak paraa-i-aa naankaa us soo-ar us gaa-ay.

lines.english: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.
lines.transliteration: gur peer haamaa taa bh aray jaa murd aar na kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਕੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰ  ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from thepractice of Truth.
lines.transliteration: galee bhisat  na jaa-ee-ai chh utai sach kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁਪੀਰੁ ਹਾਮਾ  ਤਾ ਭਰੇ ਜਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.
lines.transliteration: maaran paahi haraam meh ho-ay halaal na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਲੀ  ਿਭਸਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (141-3) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak galee koorhee-ee koorh o palai paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਣ  ਪਾਿਹ  ਹਰਾਮ ਮਿਹ ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.
lines.transliteration: panj nivaajaa vakhat  panj panjaa panjay naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗਲੀ  ਕੂੜੀਈ  ਕੂੜੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa sach halaal du-ay t eejaa kh air kh udaa-ay.

lines.english: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthee nee-at raas man panjvee sifat  sanaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਜ ਿਨਵਾਜਾ  ਵਖਤ ਪੰਿਜ ਪੰਜਾ ਪੰਜੇ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.
lines.transliteration: karnee kalmaa aakh  kai taa musalmaan  sadaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਸਚੁ ਹਲਾਲ  ਦੁਇ ਤੀਜਾ  ਖੈਰ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3|| pauVI ] (141-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaytay koorh i-aar koorhai koorh ee paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੀ  ਨੀਅਿਤ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਮਨੁ ਪੰਜਵੀ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.
lines.transliteration: ik ratan pad aarath van jaday ik kachai d ay vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਲਮਾ  ਆਿਖ  ਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ  ਸਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within theself.
lines.transliteration: satgur t uthai paa-ee-an and ar rat an bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੇਤੇ ਕੂਿੜਆਰ  ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died intheir endless wanderings.
lines.transliteration: vin gur kinai na laDh i-aa anDh ay bh a-uk mu-ay koorh i-aaraa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d oojai pach mu-ay naa boojh eh veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਵਣਜਦੇ  ਇਿਕ  ਕਚੈ ਦੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. Unto whom should they complain?
lines.transliteration: ikas baajhahu d oojaa ko nahee kis agai karahi pukaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਅਿਨ  ਅੰਦਿਰ ਰਤਨ  ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses ofwealth.
lines.transliteration: ik nirDhan sad aa bh a-ukd ay iknaa bh aray t ujaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਲਿਧਆ  ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਿਕ  ਮੁਏ ਕੂਿੜਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison andashes.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai hor Dh an naahee hor bikh i-aa sabh  chhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦੂਜੈ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of HisCommand, we are embellished and exalted. ||7|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (141-10) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap karaa-ay karay aap hukam savaaranhaaraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਾਝਹ ੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਿਕਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੁਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.
lines.transliteration: musalmaan kahaavan  muskal jaa ho-ay t aa musalmaan  kahaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਿਨਰਧਨ  ਸਦਾ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਇਕਨਾ  ਭਰੇ ਤੁਜਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of hispossessions be scraped away.
lines.transliteration: aval a-ul deen kar mith aa maskal maanaa maal musaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਹੋਰੁ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay muslim deen muhaan ai maran  jeevan  kaa bh aram chukh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness andconceit.
lines.transliteration: rab kee rajaa-ay mannay sir upar kartaa mannay aap gavaavai.

lines.english: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim.||1|| mhlw 4 ] (141-13) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ta-o naanak sarab jee-aa mihramat  ho-ay t a musalmaan  kahaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ  ਕਹਾਵਣੁ  ਮੁਸਕਲੁ  ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminateegotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: parhar kaam kroDh jh ooth nindaa taj maa-i-aa ahaNkaar chukh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਿਲ  ਅਉਿਲ  ਦੀਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਮਠਾ  ਮਸਕਲ  ਮਾਨਾ  ਮਾਲੁ  ਮੁਸਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Onlythen shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord amidst the darkness of the world.
lines.transliteration: taj kaam kaaminee moh t ajai taa anjan maahi niranjan paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਮੁਸਿਲਮੁ  ਦੀਨ  ਮੁਹਾਣੈ ਮਰਣ  ਜੀਵਣ  ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children andspouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: taj maan abh imaan pareet  sut daaraa t aj pi-aas aas raam liv laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ  ਮੰਨੇ ਿਸਰ ਉਪਿਰ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word ofthe Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (141-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa man vasai saach sabad har naam samaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਿਮਹਰੰਮਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਤ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ  ਕਹਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.
lines.transliteration: raajay ra-yat sikd aar ko-ay na rahsee-o.

lines.english: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: hat patan baajaar hukmee dh ahsee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਤਿਜ ਮਾਇਆ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.
lines.transliteration: pakay bank du-aar moorakh  jaanai aapn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਿਮਨੀ  ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਜਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth , shall be emptied out in an instant. qwjI rQ quKwr hwQI pwKry ] bwg imlK Gr bwr ikQY is Awpxy ] qMbU plµG invwr srwiecy
lines.transliteration: darab bh aray bh andaar reet ay ik kh anay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ  ਤਿਜ ਿਪਆਸ  ਆਸ  ਰਾਮ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations; the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions-Oh, where are those things, whichthey believe to be their own?
lines.transliteration: taajee rath t ukhaar haathee paakh ray. baag milakh  ghar baar kithai se aapn ay. tamboo palangh  nivaar saraa-ichay laalt ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerfulCreative Nature. ||8|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (141-19) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach daat aar sinaakh at kudratee. ||8||

lines.english: If the rivers became cows, giving milk, and the spring water became milk and ghee;
lines.transliteration: nadee-aa hoveh Dh aynvaa summ hoveh d uDh ghee-o.

lines.english: If all the earth became sugar, to continually excite the mind; pMnw 142
lines.transliteration: saglee Dhart ee sakar hovai kh usee karay nit  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਕਰ  ਹੋਵੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: parbat su-inaa rupaa hovai heeray laal jarh aa-o. if the mountains became gold and silver, studded with gems and jewels

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਬਤੁ  ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhee t ooNhai salaahn aa aakh an lahai na chaa-o. ||1|| -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (142-2) mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ  ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If all the eighteen loads of vegetation became fruits,
lines.transliteration: bhaar ath aarah mayvaa hovai garurh aa ho-ay su-aa-o.
chand sooraj d u-ay fird ay rakh ee-ahi nihchal hovai thaa-o. and the growing grass became sweet rice; if I were able to stop the sun and themoon in their orbits and hold them perfectly steady

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ  ਮੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਰੁੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhee t ooNhai salaahn aa aakh an lahai na chaa-o. ||2|| -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praiseswould not decrease. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (142-3) mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਦੁਇ ਿਫਰਦੇ ਰਖੀਅਿਹ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: If my body were afflicted with pain, under the evil influence of unlucky stars;
lines.transliteration: jay dayhai d ukh laa-ee-ai paap garah d u-ay raahu.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਆਖਣ  ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rat peen ay raajay sirai upar rakh ee-ahi ayvai jaapai bh aa-o. and if the blood-sucking kings were to hold power over me

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhee t ooNhai salaahn aa aakh an lahai na chaa-o. ||3|| -even if this were my condition, I would still worship and adore You, and my longingto chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||3|| mÚ 1 ] (142-5) mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਦੇਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਾਪ ਗਰਹ  ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: If fire and ice were my clothes, and the wind was my food;
lines.transliteration: agee paalaa kaparh hovai kh aanaa hovai vaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤੁ ਪੀਣੇ  ਰਾਜੇ ਿਸਰੈ ਉਪਿਰ  ਰਖੀਅਿਹ  ਏਵੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: surgai dee-aa mohn ee-aa ist aree-aa hovan naanak sabh o jaa-o. and even if the enticing heavenly beauties were my wives, O Nanak-all this shall passaway!

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ  ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praiseswould not decrease. ||4|| pvVI ] (142-6) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhee t oohai salaahn aa aakh an lahai na chaa-o. ||4||

lines.english: The foolish demon, who does evil deeds, does not know his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: badfailee gaibaanaa kh asam na jaan -ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੀ  ਪਾਲਾ  ਕਪੜੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਣਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Call him a mad-man, if he does not understand himself.
lines.transliteration: so kahee-ai dayvaanaa aap na pachh aan-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਗੈ  ਦੀਆ  ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ  ਹੋਵਿਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭੋ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The strife of this world is evil; these struggles are consuming it.
lines.transliteration: kaleh buree sansaar vaaday kh apee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਆਖਣ  ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, life is worthless. Through doubt, the people are being destroyed.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai vaykaar bh armay pachee-ai.

lines.english: One who recognizes that all spiritual paths lead to the One shall be emancipated.
lines.transliteration: raah dovai ik jaan ai so-ee sijh see.

lines.english: One who speaks lies shall fall into hell and burn.
lines.transliteration: kufar go-a kufraanai pa-i-aa d ajhsee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਦੇਵਾਨਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ  ॥
lines.english: In all the world, the most blessed and sanctified are those who remain absorbed inTruth.
lines.transliteration: sabh d unee-aa sub-haan sach samaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: One who eliminates selfishness and conceit is redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||9|| mÚ 1 sloku ] (142-9) mehlaa 1 salok. First Mehl, Shalok:
lines.transliteration: sijhai d ar deevaan aap gavaa-ee-ai. ||9||

lines.english: They alone are truly alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so jeevi-aa jis man vasi-aa so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, no one else is truly alive;
lines.transliteration: naanak avar na jeevai ko-ay.
jay jeevai pat lathee jaa-ay. those who merely live shall depart in dishonor;
sabh haraam jayt aa kichh  khaa-ay. everything they eat is impure.

lines.english: Intoxicated with power and thrilled with wealth, they delight in their pleasures, anddance about shamelessly.
lines.transliteration: raaj rang maal rang. rang rataa nachai nang.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are deluded and defrauded.
lines.transliteration: naanak thagi-aa muth aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, they lose their honor and depart. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (142-12) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vin naavai pat  ga-i-aa gavaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: What good is food, and what good are clothes,
lines.transliteration: ki-aa khaaDh ai ki-aa paiDh ai ho-ay.
jaa man naahee sachaa so-ay. if the True Lord does not abide within the mind?

lines.english: What good are fruits, what good is ghee, sweet jaggery, what good is flour, and whatgood is meat?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa mayvaa ki-aa ghi-o gurh  mithaa ki-aa maid aa ki-aa maas.

lines.english: What good are clothes, and what good is a soft bed, to enjoy pleasures and sensualdelights?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kaparh ki-aa sayj sukh aalee keejeh bh og bilaas.

lines.english: What good is an army, and what good are soldiers, servants and mansions to live in?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa laskar ki-aa nayb khavaasee aavai mahlee vaas.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, all this paraphernalia shall disappear. ||2|| pvVI ] (142-15) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam vin sabh ay tol vin aas. ||2||

lines.english: What good is social class and status? Truthfulness is measured within.
lines.transliteration: jaatee d ai ki-aa hath sach parkh ee-ai.

lines.english: Pride in one's status is like poison-holding it in your hand and eating it, you shall die.
lines.transliteration: mahuraa hovai hath maree-ai chakhee-ai.

lines.english: The True Lord's Sovereign Rule is known throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: sachay kee sirkaar jug jug jaanee-ai.

lines.english: One who respects the Hukam of the Lord's Command is honored and respected in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: hukam mannay sirdaar d ar deebaan ee-ai.

lines.english: By the Order of our Lord and Master, we have been brought into this world.
lines.transliteration: furmaanee hai kaar khasam path aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Drummer, the Guru, has announced the Lord's meditation, through the Word ofthe Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tabalbaaj beechaar sabad  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਲਸਕਰ  ਿਕਆ  ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਮਹਲੀ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Some have mounted their horses in response, and others are saddling up.
lines.transliteration: ik ho-ay asvaar iknaa saakh-t ee.

lines.english: Some have tied up their bridles, and others have already ridden off. ||10|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (142-17) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: iknee baDhay bh aar iknaa t aakh-tee. ||10||

lines.english: When the crop is ripe, then it is cut down; only the stalks are left standing.
lines.transliteration: jaa pakaa taa kati-aa rahee so palar vaarh .

lines.english: The corn on the cob is put into the thresher, and the kernels are separated from thecobs.
lines.transliteration: san keesaaraa chithi-aa kan  la-i-aa t an jhaarh.

lines.english: Placing the kernels between the two mill-stones, people sit and grind the corn.
lines.transliteration: du-ay purh  chakee jorh  kai peesan  aa-ay bahith .

lines.english: Those kernels which stick to the central axle are spared-Nanak has seen this wonderful vision! ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (142-19) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo dar rahay so ubray naanak ajab dith . ||1||

lines.english: Look, and see how the sugar-cane is cut down. After cutting away its branches, its feet are bound together into bundles, pMnw 143
lines.transliteration: vaykh je mith aa kati-aa kat kut baDh aa paa-ay.
khundh aa and ar rakh  kai d ayn so mal sajaa-ay. and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁੰਢਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਿਖ ਕੈ ਦੇਿਨ  ਸੁ ਮਲ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.
lines.transliteration: ras kas tatar paa-ee-ai tapai t ai villaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਟਟਿਰ  ਪਾਈਐ ਤਪੈ ਤੈ ਿਵਲਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.
lines.transliteration: bhee so fog samaalee-ai d ichai ag jaalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਫੋਗੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ  ਿਦਚੈ ਅਿਗ  ਜਾਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2|| pvVI ] (143-3) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak mithai pat ree-ai vaykh hu lokaa aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.
lines.transliteration: iknaa maran na chit  aas gh anayri-aa.

lines.english: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh nit kisai na kayri-aa.

lines.english: In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.
lines.transliteration: aapnarhai man chit  kahan changayri-aa.

lines.english: The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: jamraajai nit nit  manmukh  hayri-aa.

lines.english: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what theyhave been given.
lines.transliteration: manmukh loon  haaraam ki-aa na jaan i-aa.

lines.english: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: baDhay karan salaam kh asam na bh aani-aa.

lines.english: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach milai mukh naam saahib bh aavsee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਧੇ ਕਰਿਨ  ਸਲਾਮ  ਖਸਮ  ਨ ਭਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny.||11|| mÚ 1 sloku ] (143-6) mehlaa 1 salok. First Mehl, Shalok:
lines.transliteration: karsan takh at salaam likh i-aa paavsee. ||11||

lines.english: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?
lines.transliteration: machhee t aaroo ki-aa karay pankh ee ki-aa aakaas.

lines.english: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?
lines.transliteration: pathar paalaa ki-aa karay khusray ki-aa gh ar vaas.

lines.english: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.
lines.transliteration: kutay chand an laa-ee-ai bh ee so kut ee Dh aat.

lines.english: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?
lines.transliteration: bolaa jay samjaa-ee-ai parhee-ah simrit  paath .

lines.punjabi: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਲਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ਖੁਸਰੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?
lines.transliteration: anDhaa chaanan  rakhee-ai d eevay baleh pachaas.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਤੇ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ  ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕੁਤੀ  ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.english: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.
lines.transliteration: cha-unay su-inaa paa-ee-ai chun  chun  khaavai gh aas.

lines.english: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.
lines.transliteration: lohaa maaran paa-ee-ai dh ahai na ho-ay kapaas.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਾ  ਚਾਨਿਣ  ਰਖੀਐ  ਦੀਵੇ ਬਲਿਹ  ਪਚਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (143-10) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak moorakh ayhi gun  bolay sad aa vin aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਣੇ  ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਚੁਿਣ  ਚੁਿਣ ਖਾਵੈ ਘਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,
lines.transliteration: kaihaa kanchan tutai saar.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਹਾ ਮਾਰਿਣ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਢਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਸ  ॥
lines.transliteration: agnee gandh paa-ay lohaar. the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੂਰਖ ਏਿਹ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਿਵਣਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If a husband leaves his wife,
lines.transliteration: goree saytee t utai bh ataar.
puteeN gandh  pavai sansaar. their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.

lines.english: When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.
lines.transliteration: raajaa mangai dit ai gandh  paa-ay.

lines.english: When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.
lines.transliteration: bhukh i-aa gandh  pavai jaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.
lines.transliteration: kaalaa gandh nad ee-aa meeh jh ol.

lines.english: There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.
lines.transliteration: gandh pareet ee mith ay bol.

lines.english: When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.
lines.transliteration: baydaa gandh  bolay sach ko-ay.

lines.english: Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.
lines.transliteration: mu-i-aa gandh naykee sat  ho-ay.

lines.english: Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.
lines.transliteration: ayt gandh  vartai sansaar.

lines.english: The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.
lines.transliteration: moorakh gandh  pavai muhi maar.

lines.english: Nanak says this after deep reflection:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai ayhu beechaar.

lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: siftee gandh  pavai d arbaar. ||2|| through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2|| pauVI ] (143-13) pa-orhee.

lines.english: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.
lines.transliteration: aapay kudrat  saaj kai aapay karay beechaar.

lines.english: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.
lines.transliteration: ik khotay ik kh aray aapay parkh anhaar.

lines.english: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.
lines.transliteration: kharay kh ajaanai paa-ee-ah kh otay satee-ah baahar vaar.

lines.english: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-unto whom should they complain?
lines.transliteration: khotay sachee d argeh sutee-ah kis aagai karahi pukaar.

lines.english: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.
lines.transliteration: satgur pichh ai bhaj paveh ayhaa karn ee saar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸਾਿਜ  ਕੈ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.
lines.transliteration: satgur kh oti-ahu kh aray karay sabad  savaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਖੋਟੇ ਇਿਕ  ਖਰੇ ਆਪੇ  ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the TrueCourt.
lines.transliteration: sachee dargeh mannee-an gur kai paraym pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ  ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਿਹ  ਬਾਹਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator LordHimself? ||12|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (143-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ganat  tinaa d ee ko ki-aa karay jo aap bakh say kart aar. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੁਟੀਅਿਹ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buriedunder the ground.
lines.transliteration: ham jayr jimee dunee-aa peeraa masaa-ikaa raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਪਛੈ ਭਿਜ ਪਵਿਹ  ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.
lines.transliteration: may ravad baad isaahaa afjoo kh udaa-ay.

lines.english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (143-19) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk toohee ayk t uhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings, nor the Siddhas, nor theseekers shall remain on the earth.
lines.transliteration: na dayv d aanvaa naraa. na siDh  saaDh ikaa Dh araa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਦੀ ਕੋ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਿਪ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Who else is there? pMnw 144
lines.transliteration: asat ayk d igar ku-ee.

lines.english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (144-1) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk tu-ee ayk t u-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Neither the just, nor the generous, nor any humans at all, nor the seven realmsbeneath the earth, shall remain.
lines.transliteration: na daad ay dihand  aadmee. na sapat  jayr jimee.

lines.english: The One Lord alone exists. Who else is there?
lines.transliteration: asat ayk d igar ku-ee.

lines.english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||3|| mÚ 1 ] (144-2) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk tu-ee ayk t u-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the planets, nor the seven continents, nor theoceans, nor food, nor the wind-nothing is permanent.
lines.transliteration: na soor sas mandlo. na sapat d eep nah jalo. ann pa-un  thir na ku-ee.

lines.english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||4|| mÚ 1 ] (144-3) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk tu-ee ayk t u-ee. ||4||

lines.english: Our sustenance is not in the hands of any person.
lines.transliteration: na rijak dasat  aa kasay.

lines.english: The hopes of all rest in the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: hamaa raa ayk aas vasay.

lines.english: The One Lord alone exists-who else is there?
lines.transliteration: asat ayk d igar ku-ee.

lines.english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||5|| mÚ 1 ] (144-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk tu-ee ayk t u-ee. ||5||

lines.english: The birds have no money in their pockets.
lines.transliteration: paranday na giraah jar.

lines.english: They place their hopes on trees and water.
lines.transliteration: darkh at aab aas kar.

lines.english: He alone is the Giver.
lines.transliteration: dihand  su-ee.

lines.english: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||6|| mÚ 1 ] (144-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk tu-ee ayk t u-ee. ||6||

lines.english: O Nanak, that destiny which is pre-ordained and written on one's forehead
lines.transliteration: naanak lilaar likhi-aa so-ay.
mayt na saakai ko-ay. -no one can erase it.

lines.english: The Lord infuses strength, and He takes it away again.
lines.transliteration: kalaa Dharai hirai su-ee.

lines.english: You alone, O Lord, You alone. ||7|| pauVI ] (144-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ayk tu-ee ayk t u-ee. ||7||

lines.english: True is the Hukam of Your Command. To the Gurmukh, it is known.
lines.transliteration: sachaa tayraa hukam gurmukh  jaani-aa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, selfishness and conceit are eradicated, and the Truth isrealized.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee aap gavaa-ay sach pachh aani-aa.

lines.english: True is Your Court. It is proclaimed and revealed through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sach tayraa d arbaar sabad  neesaan i-aa.

lines.english: Meditating deeply on the True Word of the Shabad, I have merged into the Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad veechaar sach samaan i-aa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are always false; they are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sad aa koorh i-aar bh aram bh oolaan i-aa.

lines.english: They dwell in manure, and they do not know the taste of the Name.
lines.transliteration: vistaa andar vaas saad  na jaan i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Name, they suffer the agonies of coming and going.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai d ukh paa-ay aavan  jaani-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Appraiser, who distinguishes the counterfeit from the genuine. ||13|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (144-10) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paarakh aap jin kh otaa kh araa pachh aani-aa. ||13||

lines.english: Tigers, hawks, falcons and eagles-the Lord could make them eat grass.
lines.transliteration: seehaa baajaa chargaa kuhee-aa aynaa khavaalay gh aah.

lines.english: And those animals which eat grass-He could make them eat meat. He could makethem follow this way of life.
lines.transliteration: ghaahu kh aan tinaa maas kh avaalay ayhi chalaa-ay raah.

lines.english: He could raise dry land from the rivers, and turn the deserts into bottomless oceans.
lines.transliteration: nadee-aa vich tibay d aykhaalay thalee karay asgaah.

lines.english: He could appoint a worm as king, and reduce an army to ashes.
lines.transliteration: keerhaa thaap d ay-ay paat isaahee laskar karay su-aah.

lines.english: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a jeeveh lai saahaa jeevaalay t aa ke asaah.

lines.english: O Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, He gives us sustenance. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (144-13) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ji-o ji-o sachay bhaavai t i-o ti-o day-ay giraah. ||1||

lines.english: Some eat meat, while others eat grass.
lines.transliteration: ik maashaaree ik tarin  khaahi.

lines.english: Some have all the thirty-six varieties of delicacies,
lines.transliteration: iknaa chhat eeh amrit  paahi.
ik mitee-aa meh mitee-aa khaahi. while others live in the dirt and eat mud.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਰਖੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Some control the breath, and regulate their breathing.
lines.transliteration: ik pa-un sumaaree pa-un  sumaar.

lines.english: Some live by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: ik nirankaaree naam aaDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਹਾ  ਬਾਜਾ  ਚਰਗਾ  ਕੁਹੀਆ  ਏਨਾ ਖਵਾਲੇ  ਘਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver lives; no one dies.
lines.transliteration: jeevai daat aa marai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਾਹੁ ਖਾਿਨ ਿਤਨਾ  ਮਾਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ  ਏਿਹ ਚਲਾਏ  ਰਾਹ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who do not enshrine the Lord within their minds are deluded. ||2|| pauVI ] (144-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak muthay jaahi naahee man so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: By the karma of good actions, some come to serve the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee kaar karam kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀੜਾ  ਥਾਿਪ ਦੇਇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੀ  ਲਸਕਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, some eliminate selfishness and conceit, and meditateon the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee aap gavaa-ay naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ  ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਲੈ ਸਾਹਾ  ਜੀਵਾਲੇ  ਤਾ ਿਕ ਅਸਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: Undertaking any other task, they waste their lives in vain.
lines.transliteration: doojee kaarai lag janam gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without the Name, all that they wear and eat is poison.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh  vis paijh ai khaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Praising the True Word of the Shabad, they merge with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad saalaahi sach samaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, they do not obtain the home of peace; they areconsigned to reincarnation, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: vin sat gur sayvay naahee sukh  nivaas fir fir aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Investing counterfeit capital, they earn only falsehood in the world.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kh otee raas koorh  kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, singing the Praises of the Pure, True Lord, they depart with honor. ||14|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (144-19) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach kharaa saalaahi pat  si-o jaa-ee-ai. ||14||

lines.english: When it pleases You, we play music and sing; when it pleases You, we bathe in water. pMnw 145
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t aa vaaveh gaavahi t uDh bhaavai jal naaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਬਭੂਤਾ ਿਸੰਙੀ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਵਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases You, we smear our bodies with ashes, and blow the horn and the conch shell.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaaveh t aa karahi bibh ootaa siny ee naad  vajaavah.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਿਹ  ਕਤੇਬਾ  ਮੁਲਾ ਸੇਖ ਕਹਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases You, we read the Islamic Scriptures, and are acclaimed as Mullahsand Shaykhs.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai t aa parh eh kat aybaa mulaa saykh  kahaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases You, we become kings, and enjoy all sorts of tastes and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai t aa hoveh raajay ras kas bahut  kamaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਵਿਹ  ਿਸਰ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਿਟ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases You, we wield the sword, and cut off the heads of our enemies.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai t ayg vagaaveh sir mundee kat jaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਿਹ  ਿਦਸੰਤਿਰ  ਸੁਿਣ ਗਲਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases You, we go out to foreign lands; hearing news of home, we come back again.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai jaahi disant ar sun  galaa gh ar aavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਇ  ਰਚਾਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases You, we are attuned to the Name, and when it pleases You, webecome pleasing to You.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai naa-ay rachaaveh t uDh bhaanay tooN bhaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਹੋਿਰ ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak utters this one prayer; everything else is just the practice of falsehood. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (145-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayk kahai baynantee hor saglay koorh  kamaaveh. ||1||

lines.english: You are so Great-all Greatness flows from You. You are So Good-Goodness radiatesfrom You.
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN vadaa sabh  vadi-aaN-ee-aa changai changa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਸਿਭ ਵਿਡਆਂਈਆ  ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You are True-all that flows from You is True. Nothing at all is false.
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN sachaa t aa sabh  ko sachaa koorh aa ko-ay na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Talking, seeing, speaking, walking, living and dying-all these are transitory.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  vaykh an bolan  chalan  jeevan  marn aa Dh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਣੁ  ਵੇਖਣੁ  ਬੋਲਣੁ ਚਲਣੁ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates, and in His Command, He keeps us. ONanak, He Himself is True. ||2|| pauVI ] (145-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: hukam saaj hukmai vich rakhai naanak sachaa aap. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਿਜ  ਹੁਕਮੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਰਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਆਿਪ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serve the True Guru fearlessly, and your doubt shall be dispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv nisang bh aram chukh aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Do that work which the True Guru asks you to do.
lines.transliteration: satgur aakh ai kaar so kaar kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: When the True Guru becomes merciful, we meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t a naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ  ਕਾਰ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The profit of devotional worship is excellent. It is obtained by the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: laahaa bhagat  so saar gurmukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are trapped in the darkness of falsehood; they practice nothing but falsehood.
lines.transliteration: manmukh koorh  gubaar koorh  kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Go to the Gate of Truth, and speak the Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachay dai d ar jaa-ay sach chavaaN-ee-ai.

lines.english: The True Lord calls the true ones to the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: sachai andar mahal sach bulaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਦੈ ਦਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ਸਚੁ ਚਵਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the true ones are forever true; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||15|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (145-10) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach sadaa sachiaar sach samaa-ee-ai. ||15||

lines.english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the knife, and the kings are butchers; righteousness has sprouted wings and flown away.
lines.transliteration: kal kaatee raajay kaasaa-ee Dh aram pankh  kar udri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਚਆਰੁ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: In this dark night of falsehood, the moon of Truth is not visible anywhere.
lines.transliteration: koorh amaavas sach chand armaa d eesai naahee kah charh i-aa.

lines.english: I have searched in vain, and I am so confused; in this darkness, I cannot find thepath.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bhaal vikunnee ho-ee. aaDh aarai raahu na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਾਤੀ  ਰਾਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਪੰਖ ਕਿਰ ਉਡਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: In egotism, they cry out in pain.
lines.transliteration: vich ha-umai kar dukh  ro-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਸਚੁ ਚੰਦਰ੍ਮਾ  ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਹ ਚਿੜਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, how will they be saved? ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (145-12) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kin biDh gat  ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has appeared as a Lightin the world.
lines.transliteration: kal keerat pargat chaanan  sansaar.

lines.english: How rare are those few Gurmukhs who swim across to the other side!
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ko-ee ut rai paar.

lines.english: The Lord bestows His Glance of Grace;
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay t is dayvai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh receives the jewel. ||2|| pauVI ] (145-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh rat an so layvai. ||2||

lines.english: Between the Lord's devotees and the people of the world, there can never be any true alliance.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa tai saisaaree-aa jorh  kaday na aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Creator Himself is infallible. He cannot be fooled; no one can fool Him.
lines.transliteration: kartaa aap abh ul hai na bh ulai kisai d aa bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He blends His devotees with Himself; they practice Truth, and only Truth.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  aapay mayli-an jinee sacho sach kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord Himself leads the people of the world astray; they tell lies, and by telling lies,they eat poison.
lines.transliteration: saisaaree aap khu-aa-i-an jinee koorh  bol bol bikh  khaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They do not recognize the ultimate reality, that we all must go; they continue tocultivate the poisons of sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: chalan saar na jaan nee kaam karoDh  vis vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The devotees serve the Lord; night and day, they meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karan har chaakree jinee an-d in naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਤੈ ਸੈਸਾਰੀਆ  ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Becoming the slaves of the Lord's slaves, they eradicate selfishness and conceit fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aas ho-ay kai jinee vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਭੁਲੁ  ਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਿਕਸੈ ਦਾ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the Court of their Lord and Master, their faces are radiant; they are embellished and exalted with the True Word of the Shabad. ||16|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (145-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: onaa khasmai kai d ar mukh  ujlay sachai sabad  suhaa-i-aa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲਅਨੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who praise the Lord in the early hours of the morning and meditate on Himsingle-mindedly,
lines.transliteration: sabaahee saalaah jinee Dhi-aa-i-aa ik man.

lines.punjabi: ਸੈਸਾਰੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਇਅਨ ੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਬੋਿਲ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: say-ee pooray saah vakh-t ai upar larh  mu-ay. are the perfect kings; at the right time, they die fighting.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਣ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ  ਿਵਸੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the second watch, the focus of the mind is scattered in all sorts of ways.
lines.transliteration: doojai bahut ay raah man kee-aa mat ee kh indee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਕਰਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਜਨੀ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: So many fall into the bottomless pit; they are dragged under, and they cannot get out again. pMnw 146
lines.transliteration: bahut pa-ay asgaah got ay kh aahi na niklahi.

lines.english: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.
lines.transliteration: teejai muhee giraah bh ukh tikhaa du-ay bh a-ukee-aa.

lines.english: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.
lines.transliteration: khaaDh aa ho-ay su-aah bh ee kh aanay si-o d ostee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਧਾ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਹ  ਭੀ ਖਾਣੇ  ਿਸਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai aa-ee ooNgh akh ee meet pavaar ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੈ  ਆਈ  ਊਂਘ  ਅਖੀ  ਮੀਿਟ  ਪਵਾਿਰ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.
lines.transliteration: bhee uth  rachi-on vaad  sai vareh-aa kee pirh  baDh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਉਿਠ ਰਿਚਓਨੁ ਵਾਦੁ ਸੈ ਵਿਰਆ  ਕੀ ਿਪੜ ਬਧੀ ॥
lines.english: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God
lines.transliteration: sabhay vaylaa vakh at sabh  jay ath ee bh a-o ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਵੇਲਾ  ਵਖਤ  ਸਿਭ ਜੇ ਅਠੀ  ਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (146-3) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachaa naavan ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: say-ee pooray saah jinee pooraa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the OneLord.
lines.transliteration: athee vayparvaah rahan ikt ai rang.

lines.english: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably BeauteousLord.
lines.transliteration: darsan roop athaah virlay paa-ee-ah.

lines.english: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speechis perfect.
lines.transliteration: karam poorai pooraa guroo pooraa jaa kaa bol.

lines.english: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2|| pauVI ] (146-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak pooraa jay karay ghatai naahee t ol. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ  ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
lines.english: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN taa ki-aa hor mai sach sun aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: muthee Dh anDhai chor mahal na paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aynai chit kath or sayv gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਿਰ ਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.
lines.transliteration: jit ghat sach na paa-ay so bh ann gh arhaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਿਰ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar poorai vat tol t ulaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na aakhai gh at ha-umai jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਘਿਟ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ਸੁ ਭੰਿਨ ਘੜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.
lines.transliteration: la-ee-an kharay parakh  dar beenaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17|| slok mÚ 2 ] (146-9) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sa-udaa ikat  hat poorai gur paa-ee-ai. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੈ  ਘਿਟ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer thebody.
lines.transliteration: athee pahree ath  khand naavaa kh and sareer.

lines.english: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths ofthese virtues.
lines.transliteration: tis vich na-o niDh  naam ayk bh aaleh gun ee gaheer.

lines.punjabi: ਸਉਦਾ  ਇਕਤੁ  ਹਿਟ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they makethe Guru their spiritual teacher.
lines.transliteration: karamvantee salaahi-aa naanak kar gur peer.

lines.english: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higherconsciousness.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai pahar sabaah kai surti-aa upjai chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠੀ  ਪਹਰੀ  ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਨਾਵਾ  ਖੰਡੁਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.
lines.transliteration: tinaa d aree-aavaa si-o d ostee man mukh  sachaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਾਲਿਹ  ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.
lines.transliteration: othai amrit vandee-ai karmee ho-ay pasaa-o.

lines.english: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa kasee-ai vannee charhai charh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਹਿਰ  ਸਬਾਹ  ਕੈ ਸੁਰਿਤਆ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.
lines.transliteration: jay hovai nadar saraaf kee bahurh  na paa-ee t aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਦਰੀਆਵਾ  ਿਸਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਮਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.
lines.transliteration: satee pahree sat  bhalaa bahee-ai parh i-aa paas.

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਵੰਡੀਐ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.
lines.transliteration: othai paap punn beechaaree-ai koorhai ghatai raas.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਸੀਐ  ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.
lines.transliteration: othai khotay satee-ah kh aray keecheh saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਸਰਾਫ  ਕੀ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਤਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lordand Master. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (146-14) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bolan faad al naankaa d ukh sukh  khasmai paas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੀ ਪਹਰੀ  ਸਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਬਹੀਐ  ਪਿੜਆ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.
lines.transliteration: pa-un guroo paan ee pit aa maat aa Dh arat mahat .

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਕੂੜੈ ਘਟੈ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.
lines.transliteration: dinas raat  du-ay d aa-ee d aa-i-aa kh aylai sagal jagat .

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਿਹ  ਖਰੇ ਕੀਚਿਹ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord ofDharma.
lines.transliteration: chang-aa-ee-aa buri-aa-ee-aa vaachay Dharam had oor.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਲਣੁ  ਫਾਦਲੁ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮੈ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.
lines.transliteration: karmee aapo aapnee kay nayrh ai kay d oor.

lines.english: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed afterhaving worked by the sweat of their brow
lines.transliteration: jinee naam Dhi-aa-i-aa ga-ay maskat  ghaal.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਿਤ  ਮਹਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are savedalong with them! ||2|| pauVI ] (146-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay mukh  ujlay hor kayt ee chh utee naal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ  ਦਾਇਆ  ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ  ਜਗਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.
lines.transliteration: sachaa bhojan bh aa-o sat gur dasi-aa.

lines.english: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.
lines.transliteration: sachay hee patee-aa-ay sach vigsi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੀ  ਆਪੋ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.
lines.transliteration: sachai kot giraaN-ay nij ghar vasi-aa.

lines.english: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth inHis Love.
lines.transliteration: satgur t uthai naa-o paraym rehsi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ  ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.
lines.transliteration: sachai dai d eebaan  koorh  na jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost. pMnw 147
lines.transliteration: jhooth o jhooth vakh aan so mahal kh u-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨੀਸਾਿਣ  ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad neesaan  thaak na paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਬੁਿਝ ਵਖਾਿਣ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਈਐ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence. ||18|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (147-1) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach sun bujh  vakh aan mahal bulaa-ee-ai. ||18||

lines.english: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;
lines.transliteration: pahiraa agan hivai ghar baaDh aa bh ojan saar karaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਰਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਿਹਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਾ  ਭੋਜਨੁਸਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: saglay dookh  paan ee kar peevaa Dh artee haak chalaa-ee. and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਪਾਣੀ  ਕਿਰ ਪੀਵਾ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਹਾਕ ਚਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhar t aaraajee ambar t olee pichh ai tank charh aa-ee. and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਰ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ  ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤੋਲੀ  ਿਪਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ayvad vaDhaa maavaa naahee sabh sai nath chalaa-ee. and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were tocontrol and lead all;

lines.punjabi: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਧਾ ਮਾਵਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਭਸੈ  ਨਿਥ ਚਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: aytaa t aan hovai man and ar karee bh e aakh  karaa-ee. and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?

lines.punjabi: ਏਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕਰੀ ਿਭ ਆਿਖ  ਕਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them accordingto His Will.
lines.transliteration: jayvad saahib tayvad d aatee day day karay rajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਤੇਵਡ  ਦਾਤੀ  ਦੇ ਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the gloriousgreatness of the True Name. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (147-5) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar karay jis upar sach naam vadi-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਿਰ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਉਪਿਰ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  aakh  na raji-aa sunan  na rajay kann.

lines.english: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.
lines.transliteration: akhee d aykh na rajee-aa gun  gaahak ik vann.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਣੁ  ਆਿਖ  ਨ ਰਿਜਆ  ਸੁਨਿਣ  ਨ ਰਜੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
lines.english: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.
lines.transliteration: bhukh i-aa bh ukh na ut rai galee bh ukh na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਿਖ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕ  ਇਕ ਵੰਨ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of thePraiseworthy Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (147-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhukh aa taa rajai jaa gun  kahi gun ee samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਿਖਆ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਗਲੀ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.
lines.transliteration: vin sachay sabh  koorh  koorh  kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੁਖਾ ਤਾ ਰਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਹ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.
lines.transliteration: vin sachay koorh i-aar bann chalaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.
lines.transliteration: vin sachay t an chh aar chh aar ralaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.
lines.transliteration: vin sachay sabh  bhukh je paijh ai khaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.
lines.transliteration: vin sachay d arbaar koorh  na paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.
lines.transliteration: koorhai laalach lag mahal khu-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag th agi-o th ag aa-ee-ai jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19|| slok mÚ 1 ] (147-10) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tan meh t arisnaa ag sabad  bujhaa-ee-ai. ||19||

lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: naanak gur santokh  rukh Dharam ful fal gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਠਿਗਓ  ਠਿਗ  ਆਈਐ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of gooddeeds and meditation, it ripens.
lines.transliteration: ras rasi-aa hari-aa sadaa pakai karam Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (147-12) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pat kay saad  khaadaa lahai d aanaa kai sir d aan. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.
lines.transliteration: su-inay kaa birakh pat  parvaalaa ful javayhar laal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਰੁਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ  ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tit fal rat an lageh mukh  bhaakhit hirdai ridai nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਸਦਾ ਪਕੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਧਆਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recordeddestiny is written.
lines.transliteration: naanak karam hovai mukh mast ak likh i-aa hovai laykh .

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ  ਲਹੈ ਦਾਨਾ  ਕੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship ofthe feet of the Exalted Guru.
lines.transliteration: athisath  tirath gur kee charn ee poojai sad aa visaykh .

lines.english: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.
lines.transliteration: hans hayt lobh  kop chaaray nad ee-aa ag.

lines.english: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2|| pauVI ] (147-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: paveh dajh eh naankaa t aree-ai karmee lag. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨੇ  ਕਾ ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਪਤ ਪਰਵਾਲਾ  ਫੁਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਲਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.
lines.transliteration: jeevdi-aa mar maar na pachh otaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: This world is false, but only a few understand this.
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa ih sansaar kin samjaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.
lines.transliteration: sach na Dharay pi-aar Dh anDhai Dhaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਪੂਜੈ ਸਦਾ ਿਵਸੇਖੁ  ॥
lines.english: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.
lines.transliteration: kaal buraa khai kaal sir d unee-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕੋਪੁ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਦੀਆ  ਅਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club overtheir heads.
lines.transliteration: hukmee sir jandaar maaray d aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਿਹ  ਦਝਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਕਰਮੀ ਲਿਗ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.
lines.transliteration: aapay day-ay pi-aar man vasaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.
lines.transliteration: muhat na chasaa vilamm bh aree-ai paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (147-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bujh sach samaa-ee-ai. ||20||

lines.english: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit
lines.transliteration: tumee t umaa vis ak Dh atooraa nim fal.
man mukh vaseh t is jis t ooN chit na aavhee. -these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not rememberYou.

lines.english: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are onlydestroying themselves. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (147-19) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahee-ai kis handhan karmaa baahray. ||1||

lines.english: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low. pMnw 148
lines.transliteration: mat pankh ayroo kirat  saath kab ut am kab neech.

lines.english: Sometimes it is perched on the sandalwood tree, and sometimes it is on the branch of the poisonous swallow-wort. Sometimes, it soars through the heavens.
lines.transliteration: kab chandan kab ak daal kab uchee pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਚੰਦਿਨ  ਕਬ ਅਿਕ  ਡਾਿਲ  ਕਬ ਉਚੀ  ਪਰੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master leads us on, according to the Hukam of His Command; such is His Way. ||2|| pauVI ] (148-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam chalaa-ee-ai saahib lagee reet. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਚਲਾਈਐ  ਸਾਿਹਬ ਲਗੀ  ਰੀਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some speak and expound, and while speaking and lecturing, they pass away.
lines.transliteration: kaytay kaheh vakh aan kahi kahi jaavn aa.

lines.english: The Vedas speak and expound on the Lord, but they do not know His limits.
lines.transliteration: vayd kaheh vakh i-aan ant na paavn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿਹ  ਵਖਾਣ  ਕਿਹ ਕਿਹ ਜਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Not by studying, but through understanding, is the Lord's Mystery revealed.
lines.transliteration: parhi-ai naahee bh ayd bujhi-ai paavn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਦ ਕਹਿਹ  ਵਿਖਆਣ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: There are six pathways in the Shaastras, but how rare are those who merge in theTrue Lord through them.
lines.transliteration: khat d arsan kai bh aykh kisai sach samaavn aa.

lines.english: The True Lord is Unknowable; through the Word of His Shabad, we are embellished.
lines.transliteration: sachaa purakh alakh  sabad  suhaavan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੈ ਭੇਿਖ ਿਕਸੈ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who believes in the Name of the Infinite Lord, attains the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mannay naa-o bisankh d argeh paavn aa.

lines.english: I humbly bow to the Creator Lord; I am a minstrel singing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: khaalak ka-o aad ays dh aadhee gaavn aa.

lines.english: Nanak enshrines the Lord within his mind. He is the One, throughout the ages. ||21|| sloku mhlw 2 ] (148-5) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jug jug ayk man vasaavnaa. ||21||

lines.english: Those who charm scorpions and handle snakes only brand themselves with their ownhands.
lines.transliteration: mantree ho-ay ath oohi-aa naagee lagai jaa-ay. aapan  hathee aapn ai day koochaa aapay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਣਾ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: By the pre-ordained Order of our Lord and Master, they are beaten badly, and struckdown.
lines.transliteration: hukam pa-i-aa Dhur kh asam kaa at ee hoo Dh akaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: If the self-willed manmukhs fight with the Gurmukh, they are condemned by the Lord,the True Judge.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh si-o manmukh  arhai dubai hak ni-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਤਰ੍ੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਠੂਿਹਆ  ਨਾਗੀ  ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Lord and Master of both worlds. He beholds all and makes the exactdetermination.
lines.transliteration: duhaa siri-aa aapay kh asam vaykh ai kar vi-upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣੈ  ਦੇ ਕੂਚਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, know this well: everything is in accordance with His Will. ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (148-8) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayvai jaanee-ai sabh  kichh  tiseh rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਅਤੀ  ਹੂ ਧਕਾ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if someone judges himself, only then is he known as a real judge.
lines.transliteration: naanak parkhay aap ka-o t aa paarakh  jaan.

lines.english: If someone understands both the disease and the medicine, only then is he a wise physician.
lines.transliteration: rog daaroo d ovai bujh ai taa vaid  sujaan .

lines.english: Do not involve yourself in idle business on the way; remember that you are only aguest here.
lines.transliteration: vaat na kar-ee maamlaa jaanai mihmaan .

lines.english: Speak with those who know the Primal Lord, and renounce your evil ways.
lines.transliteration: mool jaan galaa karay haan  laa-ay haan .

lines.english: That virtuous person who does not walk in the way of greed, and who abides in Truth,is accepted and famous.
lines.transliteration: lab na chal-ee sach rahai so visat parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰਖੇ  ਆਪ  ਕਉ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: If an arrow is shot at the sky, how can it reach there?
lines.transliteration: sar sanDhay aagaas ka-o ki-o pahuchai baan .

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੋਵੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The sky above is unreachable-know this well, O archer! ||2|| pauVI ] (148-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: agai oh agamm hai vaahaydarh  jaan. ||2||

lines.english: The soul-bride loves her Husband Lord; she is embellished with His Love.
lines.transliteration: naaree purakh pi-aar paraym seegaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਜਾਿਣ  ਗਲਾ  ਕਰੇ ਹਾਿਣ  ਲਾਏ ਹਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: She worships Him day and night; she cannot be restrained from doing so.
lines.transliteration: karan bhagat  din raat  na rahnee vaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਿਬ ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਸਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਿਵਸਟੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: In the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, she has made her home; she is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mehlaa manjh nivaas sabad  savaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੇ ਆਗਾਸ  ਕਉ ਿਕਉ  ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: She is humble, and she offers her true and sincere prayer.
lines.transliteration: sach kahan ardaas say vaychaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ  ਓਹੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਵਾਹੇਦੜੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She is beautiful in the Company of her Lord and Master; she walks in the Way of HisWill.
lines.transliteration: sohan khasmai paas hukam siDh aaree-aa.

lines.english: With her dear friends, she offers her heart-felt prayers to her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: sakhee kahan ard aas manhu pi-aaree-aa.

lines.english: Cursed is that home, and shameful is that life, which is without the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai Dharig vaas fit so jeevi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਨ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਨ ਰਹਨੀ  ਵਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: But she who is adorned with the Word of His Shabad, drinks in the Amrit of HisNectar. ||22|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (148-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabad savaaree-aas amrit  peevi-aa. ||22||

lines.english: The desert is not satisfied by rain, and the fire is not quenched by desire.
lines.transliteration: maaroo meehi na taript i-aa agee lahai na bh ukh.

lines.english: The king is not satisfied with his kingdom, and the oceans are full, but still they thirstfor more.
lines.transliteration: raajaa raaj na taript i-aa saa-ir bh aray kisuk.

lines.english: O Nanak, how many times must I seek and ask for the True Name? ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (148-16) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam kee kaytee puchh aa puchh . ||1||

lines.english: Life is useless, as long as one does not know the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: nihfalaN tas janmas jaavat  barahm na bindt ay.

lines.english: Only a few cross over the world-ocean, by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: saagraN sansaaras gur parsaadee tareh kay.

lines.english: The Lord is the All-powerful Cause of causes, says Nanak after deep deliberation.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath hai kaho naanak beechaar.

lines.english: The creation is subject to the Creator, who sustains it by His Almighty Power. ||2|| pauVI ] (148-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kaaran kart ay vas hai jin kal rakh ee Dh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮੀਿਹ  ਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤਆ  ਅਗੀ  ਲਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord and Master, His minstrels dwell.
lines.transliteration: khasmai kai d arbaar dh aadhee vasi-aa.

lines.english: Singing the Praises of their True Lord and Master, the lotuses of their hearts haveblossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: sachaa khasam kalaan  kamal vigsi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕੇਤੀ  ਪੁਛਾ ਪੁਛ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Obtaining their Perfect Lord and Master, their minds are transfixed with ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: khasmahu pooraa paa-ay manhu rehsi-aa.

lines.english: Their enemies have been driven out and subdued, and their friends are very pleased.
lines.transliteration: dusman kadh ay maar sajan  sarsi-aa.

lines.english: Those who serve the Truthful True Guru are shown the True Path. pMnw 149
lines.transliteration: sachaa satgur sayvan sachaa maarag d asi-aa.

lines.english: Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad beechaar kaal viDh -usi-aa.

lines.english: Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee kathay akath sabad  savaari-aa.

lines.english: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord.||23|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (149-2) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gun geh raas har jee-o milay pi-aari-aa. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਹ ਰਾਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਮਲੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fallinto mistakes.
lines.transliteration: khati-ahu jammay kh atay karan t a khati-aa vich paahi.

lines.english: Dhotay mool na ut reh jay sa-o Dh ovan paahi. By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.

lines.punjabi: ਖਿਤਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿਨ  ਤ ਖਿਤਆ ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten.||1|| mÚ 1 ] (149-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhsay bakh see-ahi naahi t a paahee paahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੋਤੇ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਉਤਰਿਹ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.
lines.transliteration: naanak bolan jh akh-naa dukh chhad mangee-ah sukh .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਬਖਸੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਤ ਪਾਹੀ  ਪਾਿਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh du-ay d ar kaprh ay pahirahi jaa-ay manukh .

lines.english: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2|| pauVI ] (149-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jithai bolan haaree-ai t ithai changee chup. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੋਲਣੁ  ਝਖਣਾ  ਦੁਖ ਛਿਡ ਮੰਗੀਅਿਹ  ਸੁਖ ॥
lines.english: After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa daykh  andar bhaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਿਰ ਕਪੜੇ  ਪਿਹਰਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ਮਨੁਖ ॥
lines.english: There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.
lines.transliteration: sachai purakh alakh  siraj nihaali-aa.

lines.english: I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.
lines.transliteration: ujharh  bhulay raah gur vaykh aali-aa.

lines.english: Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.
lines.transliteration: satgur sachay vaahu sach samaali-aa.

lines.english: I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa ratan gh araahu d eevaa baali-aa.

lines.english: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad salaahi sukh ee-ay sach vaali-aa.

lines.english: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They aredestroyed by their own pride.
lines.transliteration: nidri-aa dar lag garab se gaali-aa.

lines.english: Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (149-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naavhu bhulaa jag firai bayt aali-aa. ||24||

lines.english: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich jammai bh ai marai bh ee bh a-o man meh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਸਚ ਵਾਿਲਆ  ॥
