lines.english: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed andapproved. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (149-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhai vich jay marai sahilaa aa-i-aa so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyablepleasures.
lines.transliteration: bhai vin  jeevai bahut  bahut  khusee-aa kh usee kamaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with ablackened face. ||2|| pauVI ] (149-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhai vin  jay marai muhi kaalai uth  jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t a sarDh aa pooree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੰਮੈ ਭੈ ਮਰੈ ਭੀ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal na kabahooN jhooree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਸਿਹਲਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t aa dukh na jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t aa har rang maan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਵਣੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਖੁਸੀ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t aa jam kaa dar kayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੈ ਿਵਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲੈ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t aa sad  hee sukh  dayhaa.

lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t aa nav niDh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤ ਸਰਧਾ  ਪੂਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (149-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur ho-ay d a-i-aal t a sach samaa-ee-ai. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਝੂਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlesslyand eat the garbage which others have thrown away.
lines.transliteration: sir khohaa-ay pee-ah malvaan ee jooth aa mang mang kh aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.
lines.transliteration: fol fadeehat  muhi lain bh arhaasaa paan ee daykh sagaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-theyare like sheep!
lines.transliteration: bhaydaa vaagee sir kh ohaa-in bh aree-an hath su-aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
lines.english: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families andrelatives cry out in distress.
lines.transliteration: maa-oo pee-oo kirat gavaa-in tabar rovan Dh aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
lines.english: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them.After their death, where will they be sent?
lines.transliteration: onaa pind na patal kiri-aa na d eevaa mu-ay kithaa-oo paahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤਾ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath d ayn na dh o-ee barahman  ann na kh aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilakmark to their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: sadaa kucheel raheh d in raat ee mathai tikay naahee.

lines.english: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.
lines.transliteration: jhundee paa-ay bahan nit  marn ai darh deebaan  na jaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇ  ਪੀਅਿਹ  ਮਲਵਾਣੀ  ਜੂਠਾ ਮੰਿਗ ਮੰਿਗ  ਖਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in theirhands, they walk along in single file.
lines.transliteration: lakee kaasay hathee fumman ago pichh ee jaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਫੋਿਲ ਫਦੀਹਿਤ  ਮੁਿਹ ਲੈਿਨ  ਭੜਾਸਾ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਸਗਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazisor Mullahs. pMnw 150
lines.transliteration: naa o-ay jogee naa o-ay jangam naa o-ay kaajee muNlaa.

lines.english: Ruined by the Merciful Lord, they wander around in disgrace, and their entire troop is contaminated.
lines.transliteration: da-yi vigo-ay fireh vigut ay fitaa vat ai galaa.

lines.english: The Lord alone kills and restores to life; no one else can protect anyone from Him.
lines.transliteration: jee-aa maar jeevaalay so-ee avar na ko-ee rakhai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਆ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾਲੇ  ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਖੈ ॥
lines.english: They go without giving alms or any cleansing baths; their shaven heads becomecovered with dust.
lines.transliteration: daanhu t ai isnaanhu vanjay bh as pa-ee sir kh uthai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨਹੁ ਤੈ ਇਸਨਾਨਹ ੁ ਵੰਜੇ ਭਸੁ ਪਈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਖੁਥੈ ॥
lines.english: The jewel emerged from the water, when the mountain of gold was used to churn it.
lines.transliteration: paanee vichahu rat an upannay mayr kee-aa maaDh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਰਤਨ  ਉਪੰਨੇ  ਮੇਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The gods established the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the festivals are celebrated and hymns are chanted.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath d ayvee thaapay purbee lagai ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਪੁਰਬੀ  ਲਗੈ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: After bathing, the Muslims recite their prayers, and after bathing, the Hindus performtheir worship services. The wise always take cleansing baths.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay nivaajaa naatai poojaa naavan sad aa sujaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਿਨਵਾਜਾ  ਨਾਤੈ  ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਵਿਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: At the time of death, and at the time of birth, they are purified, when water is pouredon their heads.
lines.transliteration: mu-i-aa jeevdi-aa gat  hovai jaaN sir paa-ee-ai paan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਇਆ  ਜੀਵਿਦਆ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਜ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the shaven-headed ones are devils. They are not pleased to hear thesewords.
lines.transliteration: naanak sirkhut ay sait aanee aynaa gal na bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਰਖੁਥੇ  ਸੈਤਾਨੀ  ਏਨਾ ਗਲ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: When it rains, there is happiness. Water is the key to all life.
lines.transliteration: vuthai ho-i-ai ho-ay bilaaval jee-aa jugat  samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵੁਠੈ ਹੋਇਐ  ਹੋਇ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਜੀਆ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: When it rains, the corn grows, and the sugar cane, and the cotton, which providesclothing for all.
lines.transliteration: vuthai ann kamaad  kapaahaa sabh sai parh -daa hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਵੁਠੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ  ਕਪਾਹਾ  ਸਭਸੈ  ਪੜਦਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: When it rains, the cows always have grass to graze upon, and housewives can churnthe milk into butter.
lines.transliteration: vuthai gh aahu chareh nit  surhee saa Dh an dahee vilovai.

lines.punjabi: ਵੁਠੈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਿਹ  ਿਨਿਤ  ਸੁਰਹੀ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦਹੀ ਿਵਲੋਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: With that ghee, sacred feasts and worship services are performed; all these efforts are blessed.
lines.transliteration: tit ghi-ay hom jag sad  poojaa pa-i-ai kaaraj sohai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਿਘਇ  ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਇਐ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the ocean, and all His Teachings are the river. Bathing within it, gloriousgreatness is obtained.
lines.transliteration: guroo samund nad ee sabh  sikhee naat ai jit vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ  ਨਦੀ  ਸਿਭ ਿਸਖੀ  ਨਾਤੈ  ਿਜਤੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the shaven-headed ones do not bathe, then seven handfuls of ashes areupon their heads. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (150-8) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jay sirkhut ay naavan naahee t aa sat  chatay sir chh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੇ ਿਸਰਖੁਥੇ  ਨਾਵਿਨ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤਾ ਸਤ ਚਟੇ ਿਸਿਰ  ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can the cold do to the fire? How can the night affect the sun?
lines.transliteration: agee paalaa ke karay sooraj kayhee raat.

lines.english: What can the darkness do to the moon? What can social status do to air and water?
lines.transliteration: chand anayraa ke karay pa-un  paan ee ki-aa jaat .

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੀ  ਪਾਲਾ  ਿਕ ਕਰੇ ਸੂਰਜ  ਕੇਹੀ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Dhart ee cheejee ke karay jis vich sabh  kichh  ho-ay. What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦ ਅਨੇਰਾ  ਿਕ ਕਰੇ ਪਉਣ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is known as honorable, whose honor the Lord preserves. ||2|| pauVI ] (150-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa pat  jaanee-ai jaa pat  rakhai so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: It is of You, O my True and Wondrous Lord, that I sing forever.
lines.transliteration: tuDh sachay sub-haan sad aa kalaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਪਿਤ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਪਿਤ ਰਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Yours is the True Court. All others are subject to coming and going.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa d eebaan  hor aavan  jaani-aa.

lines.english: Those who ask for the gift of the True Name are like You.
lines.transliteration: sach je mangeh daan se t uDhai jayhi-aa.

lines.english: Your Command is True; we are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sach tayraa furmaan sabd ay sohi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਹੋਿਰ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through faith and trust, we receive spiritual wisdom and meditation from You.
lines.transliteration: mani-ai gi-aan Dhi-aan t uDhai tay paa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Your Grace, the banner of honor is obtained. It cannot be taken away or lost.
lines.transliteration: karam pavai neesaan na chalai chalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You are the True Giver; You give continually. Your Gifts continue to increase.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa d aataar nit  dayveh charh eh savaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak begs for that gift which is pleasing to You. ||26|| sloku mÚ 2 ] (150-13) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai daan jo t uDh bhaa-i-aa. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਨ ੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have accepted the Guru's Teachings, and who have found the path, remain absorbed in the Praises of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: deekh i-aa aakh  bujhaa-i-aa sift ee sach samay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਿਨਤ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਚੜਿਹ  ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: What teachings can be imparted to those who have the Divine Guru Nanak as theirGuru? ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (150-14) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o ki-aa upd aysee-ai jin gur naanak d ay-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: We understand the Lord only when He Himself inspires us to understand Him.
lines.transliteration: aap bujhaa-ay so-ee boojh ai.

lines.english: He alone knows everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge.
lines.transliteration: jis aap sujhaa-ay t is sabh  kichh  soojh ai.

lines.english: One may talk and preach and give sermons but still yearn after Maya.
lines.transliteration: kahi kahi kathnaa maa-i-aa loojhai.

lines.english: The Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, has created the entire creation.
lines.transliteration: hukmee sagal karay aakaar.

lines.english: He Himself knows the inner nature of all.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai sarab veechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself uttered the Word.
lines.transliteration: akhar naanak akh i-o aap.

lines.english: Doubt departs from one who receives this gift. ||2|| pauVI ] (150-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: lahai bharaat  hovai jis d aat. ||2||

lines.english: I was a minstrel, out of work, when the Lord took me into His service.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhaadh ee vaykaar kaarai laa-i-aa.

lines.english: To sing His Praises day and night, He gave me His Order, right from the start.
lines.transliteration: raat d ihai kai vaar Dh arahu furmaa-i-aa.

lines.english: My Lord and Master has summoned me, His minstrel, to the True Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee sachai mahal kh asam bulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He has dressed me in the robes of His True Praise and Glory.
lines.transliteration: sachee sifat saalaah kaprh aa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name has become my food.
lines.transliteration: sachaa amrit naam bh ojan aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings, who eat this food and are satisfied, findpeace.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee kh aaDhaa raj t in sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: His minstrel spreads His Glory, singing and vibrating the Word of His Shabad. nwnk scu swlwih pUrw pwieAw ]27] suDu (150-19, mwJ, mÚ 1) naanak sach saalaahi pooraa paa-i-aa. ||27|| suDhu O Nanak, praising the True Lord, I have obtained His Perfection. ||27||Sudh|| pMnw 151 rwgu gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 1 caupdy dupdy (151-1) raag ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 1 cha-upd ay dupday Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl, Chau-Padas & Du-Padas: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (151-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee karay pasaa-o sabad  vajaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਦੁਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Fear of God is overpowering, and so very heavy,
lines.transliteration: bha-o much bh aaraa vadaa t ol.
man mat ha-ulee bolay bol. while the intellect is lightweight, as is the speech one speaks.

lines.english: So place the Fear of God upon your head, and bear that weight;
lines.transliteration: sir Dhar chalee-ai sahee-ai bh aar.
nadree karmee gur beechaar. ||1|| by the Grace of the Merciful Lord, contemplate the Guru. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Fear of God, no one crosses over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhai bin ko-ay na langh as paar.

lines.english: This Fear of God adorns the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhai bh a-o raakh i-aa bh aa-ay savaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The fire of fear within the body is burnt away by the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: bhai t an agan bh akhai bhai naal.

lines.english: Through this Fear of God, we are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh a-o gh arhee-ai sabad  savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤਿਨ ਅਗਿਨ  ਭਖੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Fear of God, all that is fashioned is false.
lines.transliteration: bhai bin gh aarhat kach nikach.

lines.english: Useless is the mold, and useless are the hammer-strokes on the mold. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anDhaa sachaa anDh ee sat. ||2||

lines.english: The desire for the worldly drama arises in the intellect,
lines.transliteration: buDhee baajee upjai chaa-o.
sahas si-aanap pavai na t aa-o. but even with thousands of clever mental tricks, the heat of the Fear of God does not come into play.

lines.english: O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed manmukh is just wind.
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh bolan  vaa-o.

lines.english: His words are worthless and empty, like the wind. ||3||1|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (151-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anDhaa akh ar vaa-o d u-aa-o. ||3||1||

lines.english: Place the Fear of God within the home of your heart; with this Fear of God in your heart, all other fears shall be frightened away.
lines.transliteration: dar ghar gh ar dar dar dar jaa-ay.

lines.english: What sort of fear is that, which frightens other fears?
lines.transliteration: so dar kayhaa jit dar dar paa-ay.

lines.english: Without You, I have other place of rest at all.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojee naahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਡਿਰ ਘਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਡਰੁ ਡਿਰ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever happens is all according to Your Will. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh vart ai sabh  tayree rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਿਜਤੁ ਡਿਰ ਡਰੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Be afraid, if you have any fear, other than the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: daree-ai jay dar hovai hor.

lines.english: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dar dar darnaa man kaa sor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The soul does not die; it does not drown, and it does not swim across.
lines.transliteration: naa jee-o marai na doobai tarai.

lines.english: The One who created everything does everything.
lines.transliteration: jin kichh kee-aa so kichh  karai.

lines.punjabi: ਡਿਰ ਡਿਰ ਡਰਣਾ  ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command we come, and by the Hukam of His Command we go.
lines.transliteration: hukmay aavai hukmay jaa-ay.

lines.english: Before and after, His Command is pervading. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai hukam samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Cruelty, attachment, desire and egotism
lines.transliteration: hans hayt aasaa asmaan.
tis vich bh ookh bahut  nai saan. - there is great hunger in these, like the raging torrent of a wild stream.

lines.english: Let the Fear of God be your food, drink and support.
lines.transliteration: bha-o kh aanaa peen aa aaDh aar.

lines.english: Without doing this, the fools simply die. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vin kh aaDhay mar hohi gavaar. ||3||

lines.english: If anyone really has anyone else - how rare is that person!
lines.transliteration: jis kaa ko-ay ko-ee ko-ay ko-ay.

lines.english: All are Yours - You are the Lord of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t ayraa t ooN sabh naa kaa so-ay.

lines.english: All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.
lines.transliteration: jaa kay jee-a jant Dh an maal.

lines.english: O Nanak, it is so difficult to describe and contemplate Him. ||4||2|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (151-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhan  bikham beechaar. ||4||2||

lines.english: Let wisdom be your mother, and contentment your father.
lines.transliteration: maataa mat  pitaa sant okh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Let Truth be your brother - these are your best relatives. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sat bh aa-ee kar ayhu visaykh . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: He has been described, but He cannot be described at all.
lines.transliteration: kahnaa hai kichh  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Your All-pervading creative nature cannot be estimated. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 152
lines.transliteration: ta-o kud rat keemat  nahee paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Modesty, humility and intuitive understanding are my mother-in-law and father-in-law;
lines.transliteration: saram surat d u-ay sasur bh a-ay.

lines.english: I have made good deeds my spouse. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karnee kaaman  kar man la-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Union with the Holy is my wedding date, and separation from the world is mymarriage.
lines.transliteration: saahaa sanjog vee-aahu vijog.

lines.english: Says Nanak, Truth is the child born of this Union. ||3||3|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (152-2) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach santat  kaho naanak jog. ||3||3||

lines.english: The union of air, water and fire
lines.transliteration: pa-unai paan ee agnee kaa mayl.
chanchal chapal buDh kaa kh ayl. - the body is the play-thing of the fickle and unsteady intellect.

lines.english: It has nine doors, and then there is the Tenth Gate.
lines.transliteration: na-o darvaajay d asvaa d u-aar.

lines.english: Reflect upon this and understand it, O wise one. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bujh ray gi-aanee ayhu beechaar. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord is the One who speaks, teaches and listens.
lines.transliteration: kathtaa bakt aa sunt aa so-ee.

lines.english: One who contemplates his own self is truly wise. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap beechaaray so gi-aanee ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The body is dust; the wind speaks through it.
lines.transliteration: dayhee maatee bolai pa-un .

lines.english: Understand, O wise one, who has died.
lines.transliteration: bujh ray gi-aanee moo-aa hai ka-un .

lines.english: Awareness, conflict and ego have died,
lines.transliteration: moo-ee surat baad  ahaNkaar.
oh na moo-aa jo daykh anhaar. ||2|| but the One who sees does not die. ||2||

lines.english: For the sake of it, you journey to sacred shrines and holy rivers;
lines.transliteration: jai kaaran t at tirath jaahee.
ratan pad aarath gh at hee maahee. but this priceless jewel is within your own heart.

lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read endlessly; they stir up arguments and controversies,
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  baad  vakh aanai.
bheet ar hod ee vasat  na jaan ai. ||3|| but they do not know the secret deep within. ||3||

lines.english: I have not died - that evil nature within me has died.
lines.transliteration: ha-o na moo-aa mayree mu-ee balaa-ay.

lines.english: The One who is pervading everywhere does not die.
lines.transliteration: oh na moo-aa jo rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur barahm dikh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Gauree, First Mehl, Dakhanee:
lines.transliteration: martaa jaat aa nad ar na aa-i-aa. ||4||4|| and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4|| gauVI mhlw 1 dKxI ] (152-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 1 d akh-nee.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the one who listens and hears, who understands and believes in the Name.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  boojh ai maanai naa-o. t aa kai sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਬਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord Himself leads us astray, there is no other place of rest for us to find.
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa-ay th a-ur na th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You impart understanding, and You unite us in Your Union. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN samjh aavahi mayl milaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: I obtain the Naam, which shall go along with me in the end.
lines.transliteration: naam milai chalai mai naal.

lines.english: Without the Name, all are held in the grip of Death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai baaDhee sabh  kaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My farming and my trading are by the Support of the Name.
lines.transliteration: khayt ee van aj naavai kee ot.

lines.english: The seeds of sin and virtue are bound together.
lines.transliteration: paap punn beej kee pot.

lines.english: Sexual desire and anger are the wounds of the soul.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh jee-a meh chot.

lines.english: The evil-minded ones forget the Naam, and then depart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chalay man khot. ||2||

lines.english: True are the Teachings of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: saachay gur kee saachee seekh.

lines.english: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, by the touchstone of Truth.
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al saach pareekh .

lines.english: This is the true mark of wisdom: that one remains detached, like the water-lily, or the lotus upon the water.
lines.transliteration: jal puraa-in ras kamal pareekh.

lines.english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, one becomes sweet, like the juice of the sugarcane. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay meeth ay ras eekh . ||3||

lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the castle of the body has ten gates.
lines.transliteration: hukam sanjogee garh d as du-aar.

lines.english: The five passions dwell there, together with the Divine Light of the Infinite.
lines.transliteration: panch vaseh mil jot apaar.

lines.english: The Lord Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.
lines.transliteration: aap tulai aapay van jaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are adorned and rejuvenated.||4||5|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (152-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam savaaranhaar. ||4||5||

lines.english: How can we know where we came from?
lines.transliteration: jaato jaa-ay kahaa t ay aavai.

lines.english: Where did we originate, and where will we go and merge?
lines.transliteration: kah upjai kah jaa-ay samaavai.

lines.english: How are we bound, and how do we obtain liberation?
lines.transliteration: ki-o baaDhi-o ki-o mukt ee paavai.

lines.english: How do we merge with intuitive ease into the Eternal, Imperishable Lord? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ki-o abhinaasee sahj samaavai. ||1||

lines.english: With the Naam in the heart and the Ambrosial Naam on our lips,
lines.transliteration: naam ridai amrit  mukh  naam.
narhar naam narhar nihkaam. ||1|| rahaa-o. through the Name of the Lord, we rise above desire, like the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: With intuitive ease we come, and with intuitive ease we depart.
lines.transliteration: sehjay aavai sehjay jaa-ay.

lines.english: From the mind we originate, and into the mind we are absorbed.
lines.transliteration: man tay upjai man maahi samaa-ay.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, we are liberated, and are not bound.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mukt o banDh  na paa-ay.

lines.english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated through the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabad beechaar chh utai har naa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: At night, lots of birds settle on the tree.
lines.transliteration: tarvar pankh ee baho nis baas.

lines.english: Some are happy, and some are sad. Caught in the desires of the mind, they perish.
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukhee-aa man moh vin aas.

lines.english: And when the life-night comes to its end, then they look to the sky.
lines.transliteration: saajh bihaag t akeh aagaas.

lines.english: They fly away in all ten directions, according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||3|| pMnw 153
lines.transliteration: dah d is Dhaaveh karam likh i-aas. ||3||

lines.english: Those who are committed to the Naam, see the world as merely a temporary pasture.
lines.transliteration: naam sanjogee go-il thaat.

lines.english: Sexual desire and anger are broken, like a jar of poison.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh footai bikh  maat.

lines.english: Without the merchandise of the Name, the house of the body and the store of themind are empty.
lines.transliteration: bin vakhar soono gh ar haat.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, the hard and heavy doors are opened. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur mil kholay bajar kapaat. ||4||

lines.english: One meets the Holy Saint only through perfect destiny.
lines.transliteration: saaDh milai poorab sanjog.

lines.english: The Lord's perfect people rejoice in the Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach rahsay pooray har log.

lines.english: Surrendering their minds and bodies, they find the Lord with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: man tan d ay lai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak falls at their feet. ||5||6|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (153-3) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai laaga-o paa-ay. ||5||6||

lines.english: The conscious mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh maa-i-aa meh cheet .

lines.english: The conscious mind is awake only to falsehood, corruption and attachment.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  vikaar jaagai hit  cheet .

lines.english: It gathers in the assets of sin and greed.
lines.transliteration: poonjee paap lobh kee keet .

lines.english: So swim across the river of life, O my mind, with the Sacred Naam, the Name of theLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tar taaree man naam sucheet . ||1||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! - Great! Great is my True Lord! I seek Your All-powerful Support.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu saachay mai tayree tayk.

lines.english: I am a sinner - You alone are pure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o paapee tooN nirmal ayk. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: Fire and water join together, and the breath roars in its fury!
lines.transliteration: agan paanee bolai bh arhvaa-o.

lines.english: The tongue and the sex organs each seek to taste.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa indree ayk su-aa-o.

lines.english: The eyes which look upon corruption do not know the Love and the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: disat vikaaree naahee bh a-o bh aa-o.

lines.english: Conquering self-conceit, one obtains the Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap maaray taa paa-ay naa-o. ||2||

lines.english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, shall never again have to die.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai fir maran  na ho-ay.

lines.english: Without such a death, how can one attain perfection?
lines.transliteration: bin moo-ay ki-o pooraa ho-ay.

lines.english: The mind is engrossed in deception, treachery and duality.
lines.transliteration: parpanch vi-aap rahi-aa man do-ay.

lines.english: Whatever the Immortal Lord does, comes to pass. ||3||
lines.transliteration: thir naaraa-in karay so ho-ay. ||3||

lines.english: So get aboard that boat when your turn comes.
lines.transliteration: bohith charha-o jaa aavai vaar.

lines.english: Those who fail to embark upon that boat shall be beaten in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: thaakay bohith d argeh maar.

lines.english: Blessed is that Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, where the Praises of the True Lord are sung.
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahee Dhan gurd u-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the One Creator Lord is pervading hearth and home. ||4||7|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (153-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dar gh ar aykankaar. ||4||7||

lines.english: The inverted heart-lotus has been turned upright, through reflective meditation onGod.
lines.transliteration: ulti-o kamal barahm beechaar.

lines.english: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
lines.transliteration: amrit Dh aar gagan d as du-aar.

lines.english: The Lord Himself is pervading the three worlds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taribh avan bayDh i-aa aap muraar. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, do not give in to doubt.
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray bharam na keejai.

lines.english: When the mind surrenders to the Name, it drinks in the essence of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man maanee-ai amrit ras peejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So win the game of life; let your mind surrender and accept death.
lines.transliteration: janam jeet maran  man maani-aa.

lines.english: When the self dies, the individual mind comes to know the Supreme Mind.
lines.transliteration: aap moo-aa man man tay jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: As the inner vision is awakened, one comes to know one's own home, deep within theself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: najar bha-ee gh ar ghar tay jaani-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is austerity, chastity and cleansing baths at sacredshrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  tirath majan naam.

lines.english: What good are ostentatious displays?
lines.transliteration: aDhik bithaar kara-o kis kaam.

lines.english: The All-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nar naaraa-in ant arjaam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਮੂਆਮ ਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: If I had faith in someone else, then I would go to that one's house.
lines.transliteration: aan man-o ta-o par gh ar jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਜਿਰ  ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: But where should I go, to beg? There is no other place for me.
lines.transliteration: kis jaacha-o naahee ko thaa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||4||8|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (153-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat sahj samaa-o. ||4||8||

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai so maran  dikhaa-ay.

lines.english: Remaining alive in this death brings joy deep within.
lines.transliteration: maran rahan  ras ant ar bhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਮਨਉ  ਤਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Overcoming egotistical pride, the Tenth Gate is found. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garab nivaar gagan pur paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Death is pre-ordained - no one who comes can remain here.
lines.transliteration: maran likh aa-ay aa-ay nahee rahn aa.

lines.english: So chant and meditate on the Lord, and remain in the Sanctuary of the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jap jaap rahan har sarn aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, duality is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a dubiDh aa bh aagai.

lines.english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: kamal bigaas man har parabh laagai.

lines.english: One who remains dead while yet alive obtains the greatest happiness hereafter. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai mahaa ras aagai. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one becomes truthful, chaste and pure.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai sach sanjam soochaa.

lines.english: Climbing up the steps of the Guru's Path, one becomes the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: gur kee pa-orhee oocho oochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜਾਿਪ  ਰਹਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Lord grants His Mercy, the fear of death is conquered. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam milai jam kaa bha-o moochaa. ||3||

lines.english: Uniting in Guru's Union, we are absorbed in His Loving Embrace.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai mil ank samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He reveals the Mansion of His Presence, within the home of theself.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa ghar mahal d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, conquering egotism, we are absorbed into the Lord. ||4||9|| pMnw 154 gauVI mhlw 1 ] (154-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai maar milaa-i-aa. ||4||9||

lines.english: Past actions cannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: kirat pa-i-aa nah maytai ko-ay.

lines.english: What do we know of what will happen hereafter?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jaanaa ki-aa aagai ho-ay.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aanaa so-ee hoo-aa.

lines.english: There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: avar na karnai vaalaa d oo-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.
lines.transliteration: naa jaanaa karam kayvad t ayree d aat.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ  ਕਰਮ  ਕੇਵਡ  ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam t ayray naam kee jaat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!
lines.transliteration: too ayvad d aataa dayvan haar.

lines.english: The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.
lines.transliteration: tot naahee t uDh bhagat bhandaar.

lines.english: One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.
lines.transliteration: kee-aa garab na aavai raas.

lines.english: The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t ayrai paas. ||2||

lines.english: You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.
lines.transliteration: too maar jeevaaleh bakh as milaa-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavee t i-o naam japaa-ay.

lines.english: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.
lines.transliteration: tooN daanaa beenaa saachaa sir mayrai.

lines.english: Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmat d ay-ay bh arosai t ayrai. ||3||

lines.english: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.
lines.transliteration: tan meh mail naahee man raat aa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee sach sabad pachh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.
lines.transliteration: tayraa t aan naam kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (154-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rahnaa bh agat sarnaa-ee. ||4||10||

lines.english: Those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar.
lines.transliteration: jin akath kahaa-i-aa api-o pee-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Other fears are forgotten, and they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an bhai visray naam samaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Why should we fear, when fear is dispelled by the Fear of God?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa daree-ai dar dareh samaanaa.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, I recognize God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad pachh aanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's essence are blessed and acclaimed, andintuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis nar raam ridai har raas. sahj subh aa-ay milay saabaas. ||2||

lines.english: Those whom the Lord puts to sleep, evening and morning
lines.transliteration: jaahi savaarai saajh bi-aal.
it ut manmukh  baaDh ay kaal. ||3|| - those self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged by Death, here and hereafter.||3||

lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, day and night, are perfect.
lines.transliteration: ahinis raam ridai say pooray.

lines.english: O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (154-10) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam milay bharam d ooray. ||4||11||

lines.english: One who loves the three qualities is subject to birth and death.
lines.transliteration: janam marai tarai gun  hitkaar.

lines.english: The four Vedas speak only of the visible forms.
lines.transliteration: chaaray bayd katheh aakaar.

lines.english: They describe and explain the three states of mind,
lines.transliteration: teen avasthaa kaheh vakh i-aan.
turee-aavasthaa sat gur tay har jaan. ||1|| but the fourth state, union with the Lord, is known only through the True Guru. ||1||

lines.english: Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one swims across.
lines.transliteration: raam bhagat  gur sayvaa t arnaa.

lines.english: Then, one is not born again, and is not subject to death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baahurh janam na ho-ay hai marn aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath kahai sabh  ko-ee.
simrit saasat  pandit  mukh  so-ee. the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Pandits speak of them as well.

lines.english: But without the Guru, they do not understand their true significance.
lines.transliteration: bin gur arath beechaar na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The treasure of liberation is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mukat pad aarath bh agat har paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those, within whose hearts the Lord dwells,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hirdai vasi-aa har so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat paraapat  ho-ee. become Gurmukh; they receive the blessings of devotional worship.

lines.english: Through devotional worship of the Lord, liberation and bliss are obtained.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  mukat  aanand .

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, supreme ecstasy is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmat paa-ay parmaanand . ||3||

lines.english: One who meets the Guru, beholds Him, and inspires others to behold Him as well.
lines.transliteration: jin paa-i-aa gur daykh  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the midst of hope, the Guru teaches us to live above hope and desire.
lines.transliteration: aasaa maahi niraas bujhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is the Master of the meek, the Giver of peace to all.
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath sarab sukh -daata.

lines.english: Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||12|| gauVI cyqI mhlw 1 ] (154-17) ga-orhee chayt ee mehlaa 1. Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har charnee man raat aa. ||4||12||

lines.english: With your nectar-like body, you live in comfort, but this world is just a passing drama.
lines.transliteration: amrit kaa-i-aa rahai sukh aalee baajee ih sansaaro.

lines.english: You practice greed, avarice and great falsehood, and you carry such a heavy burden.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh much koorh  kamaaveh bahut  uthaaveh bh aaro.

lines.english: O body, I have seen you blowing away like dust on the earth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN kaa-i-aa mai ruld ee daykhee ji-o Dh ar upar chh aaro. ||1||

lines.english: Listen - listen to my advice!
lines.transliteration: sun sun  sikh hamaaree.

lines.english: Only the good deeds which you have done shall remain with you, O my soul. This opportunity shall not come again! ||1||Pause|| pMnw 155
lines.transliteration: sukarit keet aa rahsee mayray jee-arh ay bahurh  na aavai vaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I say to you, O my body: listen to my advice!
lines.transliteration: ha-o tuDh  aakh aa mayree kaa-i-aa t ooN sun sikh hamaaree.

lines.english: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.
lines.transliteration: nindaa chind aa karahi paraa-ee jh oothee laa-it baaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ  ਤੂੰ ਸੁਿਣ ਿਸਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal and commit evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: vayl paraa-ee joheh jee-arhay karahi choree buri-aaree.

lines.english: But when the swan departs, you shall remain behind, like an abandoned woman. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hans chali-aa tooN pichh ai rahee-ayhi chh utarh ho-ee-ah naaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਿਲ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਜੋਹਿਹ  ਜੀਅੜੇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਚੋਰੀ ਬੁਿਰਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O body, you are living in a dream! What good deeds have you done?
lines.transliteration: tooN kaa-i-aa rahee-ah supnant ar tuDh ki-aa karam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਿਲਆ  ਤੂੰ ਿਪਛੈ ਰਹੀਏਿਹ  ਛੁਟਿੜ  ਹੋਈਅਿਹ  ਨਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When I stole something by deception, then my mind was pleased.
lines.transliteration: kar choree mai jaa kichh lee-aa t aa man bh alaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ  ਰਹੀਅਿਹ  ਸੁਪਨੰਤਿਰ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have no honor in this world, and I shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. My life has been lost, wasted in vain! ||3||
lines.transliteration: halat na sobh aa palat  na dh o-ee ahilaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਚੋਰੀ ਮੈ ਜਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਲੀਆ  ਤਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am totally miserable! O Baba Nanak, no one cares for me at all! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o kharee d uhaylee ho-ee baabaa naanak mayree baat  na puchh ai ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਿਤ  ਨ ਢੋਈ ਅਿਹਲਾ  ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Turkish horses, gold, silver and loads of gorgeous clothes
lines.transliteration: taajee t urkee su-inaa rupaa kaparh  kayray bh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ  ਹੋਈ ਬਾਬਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee naal na chalay naanak jharh  jharh pa-ay gavaaraa. - none of these shall go with you, O Nanak. They are lost and left behind, you fool!

lines.english: I have tasted all the sugar candy and sweets, but Your Name alone is Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||
lines.transliteration: koojaa mayvaa mai sabh kichh  chaakh i-aa ik amrit  naam t umaaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਜੀ  ਤੁਰਕੀ ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਕਪੜ  ਕੇਰੇ ਭਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Digging deep foundations, the walls are constructed, but in the end, the buildingsreturn to heaps of dust.
lines.transliteration: day d ay neev d ivaal usaaree bh asmand ar kee dh ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਝਿੜ ਝਿੜ ਪਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: People gather and hoard their possessions, and give nothing to anyone else - the poorfools think that everything is theirs.
lines.transliteration: sanchay sanch na day-ee kis hee anDh  jaanai sabh  mayree.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਜਾ  ਮੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਇਕੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Riches do not remain with anyone - not even the golden palaces of Sri Lanka. ||5||
lines.transliteration: so-in lankaa so-in maarhee sampai kisai na kayree. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਨੀਵ ਿਦਵਾਲ  ਉਸਾਰੀ  ਭਸਮੰਦਰ  ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Listen, you foolish and ignorant mind
lines.transliteration: sun moorakh  man ajaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਿਚ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hog tisai kaa bh aanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. - only His Will prevails. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਇਨ  ਲੰਕਾ  ਸੋਇਨ  ਮਾੜੀ  ਸੰਪੈ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੫॥
lines.english: My Banker is the Great Lord and Master. I am only His petty merchant.
lines.transliteration: saahu hamaaraa thaakur bh aaraa ham t is kay van jaaray.

lines.english: This soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to life. ||6||1||13|| gauVI cyqI mhlw 1 ] (155-10) ga-orhee chayt ee mehlaa 1. Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh raas t isai kee maar aapay jeevaalay. ||6||1||13||

lines.english: There are five of them, but I am all alone. How can I protect my hearth and home, O my mind?
lines.transliteration: avar panch ham ayk janaa ki-o raakha-o gh ar baar manaa.

lines.english: They are beating and plundering me over and over again; unto whom can I complain?||1||
lines.transliteration: maareh looteh neet neet  kis aagai karee pukaar janaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ  ਹਮ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Supreme Lord, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: saree raam naamaa uchar manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਿਸ  ਿਤਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਜੀਵਾਲੇ  ॥੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will have to face the awesome and cruel armyof Death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aagai jam dal bikh am gh anaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God has erected the temple of the body; He has placed the nine doors, and the soul- bride sits within.
lines.transliteration: usaar marholee raakh ai du-aaraa bh eetar baith ee saa Dh anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਿਰ  ਪੰਚ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ਿਕਉ  ਰਾਖਉ  ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: She enjoys the sweet play again and again, while the five demons are plundering her.||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit kayl karay nit  kaaman  avar lutayn so panch janaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਿਹ  ਲੂਟਿਹ  ਨੀਤ  ਨੀਤ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this way, the temple is being demolished; the body is being plundered, and thesoul-bride, left all alone, is captured.
lines.transliteration: dhaahi marh olee looti-aa d ayhuraa saa Dh an pakrh ee ayk janaa.

lines.english: Death strikes her down with his rod, the shackles are placed around her neck, andnow the five have left. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jam dandaa gal sangal parhi-aa bh aag ga-ay say panch janaa. ||3||

lines.english: The wife yearns for gold and silver, and her friends, the senses, yearn for good food.
lines.transliteration: kaaman lorh ai su-inaa rupaa mit ar lurh ayn so kh aaDhaataa.

lines.english: O Nanak, she commits sins for their sake; she shall go, bound and gagged, to the Cityof Death. ||4||2||14|| gauVI cyqI mhlw 1 ] (155-16) ga-orhee chayt ee mehlaa 1. Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paap karay tin kaaran  jaasee jampur baaDh aataa. ||4||2||14||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਾਿਰ  ਮੜੋਲੀ  ਰਾਖੈ ਦੁਆਰਾ  ਭੀਤਿਰ ਬੈਠੀ ਸਾ ਧਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Let your ear-rings be those ear-rings which pierce deep within your heart. Let yourbody be your patched coat.
lines.transliteration: mundraa t ay gh at bheetar mund raa kaaN-i-aa keejai kh inthaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਤ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਅਵਿਰ  ਲੁਟੇਿਨ  ਸੁ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let the five passions be disciples under your control, O begging Yogi, and make this mind your walking stick. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panch chaylay vas keejeh raaval ih man keejai dandaataa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਿਹ  ਮੜੋਲੀ  ਲੂਿਟਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪਕੜੀ  ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Thus you shall find the Way of Yoga.
lines.transliteration: jog jugat iv paavsit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਿਲ  ਸੰਗਲੁ  ਪਿੜਆ  ਭਾਿਗ  ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: There is only the One Word of the Shabad; everything else shall pass away. Let this be the fruits and roots of your mind's diet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad d oojaa hor naasat  kand  mool man laavsit aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ ਲੋੜੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਿਮਤਰ੍  ਲੁੜੇਿਨ  ਸੁ ਖਾਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some try to find the Guru by shaving their heads at the Ganges, but I have made theGuru my Ganges.
lines.transliteration: moond moondaa-i-ai jay gur paa-ee-ai ham gur keenee gangaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਿਤਨ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਜਾਸੀ  ਜਮਪੁਿਰ  ਬਾਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Saving Grace of the three worlds is the One Lord and Master, but those indarkness do not remember Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taribh avan taaran haar su-aamee ayk na chayt as anDh aataa. ||2||

lines.english: Practicing hypocrisy and attaching your mind to worldly objects, your doubt shall never depart. pMnw 156
lines.transliteration: kar patamb galee man laavas sansaa mool na jaavsitaa.

lines.english: If you focus your consciousness on the Feet of the One Lord, what reason would you have to chase after greed? ||3||
lines.transliteration: aykas charnee jay chit  laaveh lab lobh  kee Dh aavsit aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਜੇ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਿਹ  ਲਿਬ  ਲੋਿਭ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਿਸਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, and saturate your mind with Him.
lines.transliteration: japas niranjan rachas manaa.

lines.english: Why, O Yogi, do you make so many false and deceptive claims? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaahay boleh jogee kapat ghanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The body is wild, and the mind is foolish. Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, your life is passing away.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kamlee hans i-aanaa mayree mayree karat  bihaan eetaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, when the naked body is cremated, then you will come to regret andrepent. ||4||3||15|| gauVI cyqI mhlw 1 ] (156-3) ga-orhee chayt ee mehlaa 1. Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak naagee d aajhai fir paachh ai pachh utaaneetaa. ||4||3||15||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਮਲੀ  ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹਾਣੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, there is only the One medicine, mantra and healing herb - center yourconsciousness firmly on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  mant ar mool man aykai jay kar d arirh chit keejai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਗੀ  ਦਾਝੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Take to the Lord, the Destroyer of the sins and karma of past incarnations. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay paap karam kay katanhaaraa leejai ray. ||1||

lines.english: The One Lord and Master is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: man ayko saahib bhaa-ee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤਰ੍ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਿਚਤੁ  ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: In Your three qualities, the world is engrossed; the Unknowable cannot be known.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray t een gun aa sansaar samaaveh alakh  na lakh -naa jaa-ee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ  ਕੇ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ  ਲੀਜੈ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Maya is so sweet to the body, like sugar or molasses. We all carry loads of it.
lines.transliteration: sakar khand maa-i-aa t an meeth ee ham t a-o pand uchaa-ee ray.

lines.english: In the dark of the night, nothing can be seen. The mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life, O Siblings of Destiny! ||2||
lines.transliteration: raat anayree soojh as naahee laj tookas moosaa bh aa-ee ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਿਨ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As the self-willed manmukhs act, they suffer in pain. The Gurmukh obtains honor andgreatness.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karahi t aytaa dukh laagai gurmukh  milai vadaa-ee ray.

lines.english: Whatever He does, that alone happens; past actions cannot be erased. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tin kee-aa so-ee ho-aa kirat  na mayti-aa jaa-ee ray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਰ  ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਤਿਨ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with, and committed to the Lord's Love, are filled tooverflowing; they never lack anything.
lines.transliteration: subhar bh aray na hoveh oon ay jo raat ay rang laa-ee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਤ  ਅਨੇਰੀ  ਸੂਝਿਸ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਿਸ  ਮੂਸਾ ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If Nanak could be the dust of their feet, then he, the ignorant one, might also obtainsome. ||4||4||16|| gauVI cyqI mhlw 1 ] (156-9) ga-orhee chayt ee mehlaa 1. Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin kee pank hovai jay naanak t a-o moorh aa kichh  paa-ee ray. ||4||4||16||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੇਤਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Who is our mother, and who is our father? Where did we come from?
lines.transliteration: kat kee maa-ee baap kat  kayraa kid oo thaavhu ham aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਮੇਿਟਆ  ਜਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: We are formed from the fire of the womb within, and the bubble of water of thesperm. For what purpose are we created? ||1||
lines.transliteration: agan bimb jal bheet ar nipjay kaahay kamm upaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭਰ  ਭਰੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਊਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O my Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?
lines.transliteration: mayray saahibaa ka-un jaan ai gun  tayray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
lines.english: My own demerits cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kahay na jaanee a-ugan mayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I took the form of so many plants and trees, and so many animals.
lines.transliteration: kaytay rukh  birakh  ham cheenay kayt ay pasoo upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ  ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ ਿਕਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Many times I entered the families of snakes and flying birds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaytay naag kulee meh aa-ay kayt ay pankh  udaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਿਬੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਿਨਪਜੇ  ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਿਮ ਉਪਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I broke into the shops of the city and well-guarded palaces; stealing from them, I snuck home again.
lines.transliteration: hat patan bij mand ar bhannai kar choree gh ar aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I looked in front of me, and I looked behind me, but where could I hide from You?||3||
lines.transliteration: agahu daykh ai pichh ahu d aykhai tujh tay kahaa chh apaavai. ||3||

lines.english: I saw the banks of sacred rivers, the nine continents, the shops and bazaars of thecities.
lines.transliteration: tat tirath ham nav kh and d aykhay hat patan  baajaaraa.

lines.english: Taking the scale, the merchant begins to weigh his actions within his own heart. ||4||
lines.transliteration: lai kai takrh ee tolan laagaa gh at hee meh van jaaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਿਬਰਖ  ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ  ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: As the seas and the oceans are overflowing with water, so vast are my own sins.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa samund  saagar neer bh ari-aa t aytay a-ugan  hamaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ  ਮਿਹ ਆਏ  ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please, shower me with Your Mercy, and take pity upon me. I am a sinking stone -please carry me across! ||5||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu kichh  mihar upaavhu dubd ay pathar t aaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ  ਿਬਜ ਮੰਦਰ  ਭੰਨੈ ਕਿਰ ਚੋਰੀ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: My soul is burning like fire, and the knife is cutting deep.
lines.transliteration: jee-arhaa agan baraabar t apai bh eetar vagai kaat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਿਪਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, recognizing the Lord's Command, I am at peace, day and night. ||6||5||17|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 1 ] (156-16) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 1. Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak hukam pachh aanai sukh  hovai d in raat ee. ||6||5||17||

lines.punjabi: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ  ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ  ਬਾਜਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The nights are wasted sleeping, and the days are wasted eating.
lines.transliteration: rain gavaa-ee so-ay kai d ivas gavaa-i-aa kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲਿਣ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Human life is such a precious jewel, but it is being lost in exchange for a mere shell.||1||
lines.transliteration: heeray jaisaa janam hai ka-udee badlay jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤਾ  ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰ ੁ ਨੀਿਰ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You do not know the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam na jaani-aa raam kaa.

lines.english: You fool - you shall regret and repent in the end! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: moorhay fir paachh ai pachh utaahi ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬਰਾਬਿਰ  ਤਪੈ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: You bury your temporary wealth in the ground, but how can you love that which istemporary?
lines.transliteration: antaa Dh an Dh arnee Dh aray anat  na chaahi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those who have departed, after craving for temporary wealth, have returned homewithout this temporary wealth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anat ka-o chaahan jo ga-ay say aa-ay anat  gavaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: If people could gather it in by their own efforts, then everyone would be so lucky. pMnw 157
lines.transliteration: aapan lee-aa jay milai t aa sabh  ko bh aagath  ho-ay.

lines.english: According to the karma of past actions, one's destiny unfolds, even though everyone wants to be so lucky. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karmaa upar nibrhai jay lochai sabh  ko-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮਾ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਿਨਬੜੈ  ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He alone takes care of it.
lines.transliteration: naanak karnaa jin kee-aa so-ee saar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Hukam of our Lord and Master's Command cannot be known; He Himself blessesus with greatness. ||4||1||18|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 1 ] (157-2) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 1. Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaapee khasam kaa kisai vadaa-ee d ay-ay. ||4||1||18||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਿਕਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
lines.english: What if I were to become a deer, and live in the forest, picking and eating fruits androots
lines.transliteration: harnee hovaa ban basaa kand  mool chun  khaa-o.
gur parsaadee mayraa saho milai vaar vaar ha-o jaa-o jee-o. ||1|| - by Guru's Grace, I am a sacrifice to my Master. Again and again, I am a sacrifice, asacrifice. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਣੀ  ਹੋਵਾ ਬਿਨ ਬਸਾ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਿਣ  ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.english: I am the shop-keeper of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai banjaaran raam kee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਹਉ ਜਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is my merchandise and trade. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayraa naam vakh ar vaapaar jee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If I were to become a cuckoo, living in a mango tree, I would still contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kokil hovaa amb basaa sahj sabad beechaar.

lines.english: I would still meet my Lord and Master, with intuitive ease; the Darshan, the BlessedVision of His Form, is incomparably beautiful. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay mayraa saho milai d arsan roop apaar. ||2||

lines.english: If I were to become a fish, living in the water, I would still remember the Lord, whowatches over all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: machhulee hovaa jal basaa jee-a jant  sabh  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਕਲ  ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਿਬ  ਬਸਾ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord dwells on this shore, and on the shore beyond; I would still meetHim, and hug Him close in my embrace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: urvaar paar mayraa saho vasai ha-o mila-ugee baah pasaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਰੂਿਪ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If I were to become a snake, living in the ground, the Shabad would still dwell in mymind, and my fears would be dispelled.
lines.transliteration: naagan hovaa Dhar vasaa sabad  vasai bh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਹੋਵਾ ਜਿਲ  ਬਸਾ ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are forever the happy soul-brides, whose light merges into His Light.||4||2||19|| gauVI pUrbI dIpkI mhlw 1  (157-8) ga-orhee poorbee d eepkee mehlaa 1 Gauree Poorbee Deepkee, First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (157-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaagan ee jin jot ee jot  samaa-ay. ||4||2||19||

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਵਾਿਰ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਿਮਲਉਗੀ  ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted
lines.transliteration: jai ghar keerat  aakh ee-ai kart ay kaa ho-ay beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਗਿਨ  ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tit ghar gaavhu sohilaa sivrahu sirjan haaro. ||1|| - in that house, sing the Songs of Praise, and meditate in remembrance on the Creator

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.
lines.transliteration: tum gaavhu mayray nirbh a-o kaa sohilaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਪੂਰਬੀ  ਦੀਪਕੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree jaa-o jit sohilai sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਘਿਰ  ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.
lines.transliteration: nit nit  jee-arh ay samaalee-an d aykhaigaa d ayvan haar.

lines.english: Your gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayray d aanai keemat  naa pavai t is daatay kavan  sumaar. ||2||

lines.english: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come - let's gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.
lines.transliteration: sambat saahaa likh i-aa mil kar paavhu t ayl.

lines.english: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dayh sajan  aaseesrh ee-aa ji-o hovai saahib si-o mayl. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜਾਉ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸੋਿਹਲੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar ayho paahuchaa sad -rhay nit  pavann.

lines.english: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawingnear! ||4||1||20|| rwgu gauVI guAwryrI ] (157-15) raag ga-orhee gu-aarayree. Raag Gauree Gwaarayree: mhlw 3 caupdy ] (157-15) mehlaa 3 cha-upday. Third Mehl, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (157-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sadan haaraa simree-ai naanak say d ih aavann. ||4||1||20||

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, we meet the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai har maylaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ  ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself unites us in His Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaavai so-ee.

lines.english: My God knows all His Own Ways.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh sabh  biDh aapay jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ  ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ  ਿਜਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਿਸਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He unites those who recognize the Word of theShabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hukmay maylay sabad pachh aanai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ  ਿਨਤ  ਪਵੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: By the Fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh a-ay bh aram bh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with His Fear, we are absorbed in the Love of the True One. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhai raachai sach rang samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally dwells within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai har man vasai subhaa-ay.

lines.english: My God is Great and Almighty; His value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh bh aaraa keemat  nahee paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, I praise Him; He has no end or limitations.
lines.transliteration: sabad salaahai ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.english: My God is the Forgiver. I pray that He may forgive me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh bakh say bakh sanhaar. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, all wisdom and understanding are obtained. pMnw 158
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai sabh mat  buDh  ho-ay.

lines.english: The mind becomes pure, when the True Lord dwells within.
lines.transliteration: man nirmal vasai sach so-ay.

lines.english: When one dwells in Truth, all actions become true.
lines.transliteration: saach vasi-ai saachee sabh kaar.

lines.english: The ultimate action is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ootam karn ee sabad  beechaar. ||3||

lines.english: Through the Guru, true service is performed.
lines.transliteration: gur tay saachee sayvaa ho-ay.

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who recognizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam pachh aanai ko-ay.

lines.english: The Giver, the Great Giver, lives forever.
lines.transliteration: jeevai daat aa dayvan haar.

lines.english: Nanak enshrines love for the Name of the Lord. ||4||1||21|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (158-3) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har naamay lagai pi-aar. ||4||1||21||

lines.english: Those who obtain spiritual wisdom from the Guru are very rare.
lines.transliteration: gur tay gi-aan paa-ay jan ko-ay.

lines.english: Those who obtain this understanding from the Guru become acceptable.
lines.transliteration: gur tay boojh ai seejh ai so-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru, we intuitively contemplate the True One.
lines.transliteration: gur tay sahj saach beechaar.

lines.english: Through the Guru, the Gate of Liberation is found. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur tay paa-ay mukat  du-aar. ||1||

lines.english: Through perfect good destiny, we come to meet the Guru.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag milai gur aa-ay.

lines.english: The true ones are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saachai sahj saach samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, the fire of desire is quenched.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai tarisnaa agan bujh aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru, peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur tay saaNt vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru, we become pure, holy and true.
lines.transliteration: gur tay pavit  paavan such ho-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru, we are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur tay sabad  milaavaa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਿਤ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, everyone wanders in doubt.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo sabh  bharam bh ulaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਿਵਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਸੁਿਚ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, they suffer in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai bahutaa d ukh paa-ee.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Naam become Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so naam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: True honor is obtained through the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: darsan sachai sachee pat  ho-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Why speak of any other? He alone is the Giver.
lines.transliteration: kis no kahee-ai daat aa ik so-ee.

lines.english: When He grants His Grace, union with the Shabad is obtained.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay sabad milaavaa ho-ee.

lines.english: Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam saachay gun  gaavaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, becoming true, I am absorbed in the True One. ||4||2||22|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (158-9) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay saach samaavaa. ||4||2||22||

lines.english: True is that place, where the mind becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: so thaa-o sach man nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: True is the one who abides in Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach nivaas karay sach so-ay.

lines.english: The True Bani of the Word is known throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee jug chaaray jaapai.

lines.english: The True One Himself is everything. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  saachaa aapay aapai. ||1||

lines.english: Through the karma of good actions, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai satsang milaa-ay.

lines.english: Sing the Glories of the Lord, sitting in that place. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai bais so thaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Burn this tongue, which loves duality,
lines.transliteration: jala-o ih jihvaa doojai bh aa-ay.
har ras na chaakhai feekaa aalaa-ay. which does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and which utters insipid words.

lines.english: Without understanding, the body and mind become tasteless and insipid.
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay t an man feekaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਬੈਿਸ ਸੁ ਥਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the miserable ones depart crying out in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai dukh ee-aa chali-aa ro-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One whose tongue naturally and intuitively tastes the Lord's sublime essence, by Guru's Grace, is absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har ras chaakhi-aa sahj subh aa-ay. gur kirpaa t ay sach samaa-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with Truth, one contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad,
lines.transliteration: saachay raatee gur sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ਫੀਕਾ  ਆਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: amrit peevai nirmal Dh aar. ||3|| and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, from the immaculate stream within. ||3||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is collected in the vessel of the mind.
lines.transliteration: naam samaavai jo bhaadaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Nothing is collected if the vessel is upside-down.
lines.transliteration: ooNDhai bh aaNdai tikai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Naam abides within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee man naam nivaas.

lines.english: O Nanak, True is that vessel of the mind, which thirsts for the Shabad. ||4||3||23|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (158-16) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach bhaaNdaa jis sabad  pi-aas. ||4||3||23||

lines.english: Some sing on and on, but their minds do not find happiness.
lines.transliteration: ik gaavat rahay man saad  na paa-ay.

lines.english: In egotism, they sing, but it is wasted uselessly.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich gaavahi birthaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who love the Naam, sing the song.
lines.transliteration: gaavan gaavahi jin naam pi-aar.

lines.english: They contemplate the True Bani of the Word, and the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saachee banee sabad  beechaar. ||1||

lines.english: They sing on and on, if it pleases the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gaavat rahai jay sat gur bh aavai.

lines.english: Their minds and bodies are embellished and adorned, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan raat aa naam suhaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some sing, and some perform devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: ik gaavahi ik bhagat  karayhi.

lines.english: Without heart-felt love, the Naam is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: naam na paavahi bin asnayh.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਗਾਵਤ  ਰਹੇ ਮਿਨ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: True devotional worship consists of love for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat  gur sabad  pi-aar.

lines.english: The devotee keeps his Beloved clasped tightly to his heart. ||2|| pMnw 159
lines.transliteration: apnaa pir raakhi-aa sad aa ur Dh aar. ||2||

lines.english: The fools perform devotional worship by showing off;
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karahi moorakh  aap jan aaveh.
nach nach tapeh bahut d ukh paavahi. they dance and dance and jump all around, but they only suffer in terrible pain.

lines.punjabi: ਨਿਚ ਨਿਚ ਟਪਿਹ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: By dancing and jumping, devotional worship is not performed.
lines.transliteration: nachi-ai tapi-ai bhagat  na ho-ay.

lines.english: But one who dies in the Word of the Shabad, obtains devotional worship. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad marai bh agat paa-ay jan so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He inspires them to perform devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al bhagat karaa-ay so-ay.

lines.english: True devotional worship consists of elimin ating selfishness and conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat  vichahu aap kh o-ay.

lines.english: My True God knows all ways and means.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa sabh  biDh jaanai.

lines.english: O Nanak, He forgives those who recognize the Naam. ||4||4||24|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (159-4) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhsay naam pachh aanai. ||4||4||24||

lines.english: When someone kills and subdues his own mind, his wandering nature is also subdued.
lines.transliteration: man maaray Dhaat  mar jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without such a death, how can one find the Lord?
lines.transliteration: bin moo-ay kaisay har paa-ay.

lines.english: Only a few know the medicine to kill the mind.
lines.transliteration: man marai daaroo jaan ai ko-ay.

lines.english: One whose mind dies in the Word of the Shabad, understands Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man sabad marai boojh ai jan so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: He grants greatness to those whom He forgives.
lines.transliteration: jis no bakhsay d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad har vasai man aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukh practices doing good deeds;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karn ee kaar kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa is man kee sojh ee paavai. thus he comes to understand this mind.

lines.english: The mind is like an elephant, drunk with wine.
lines.transliteration: man mai mat maigal mikd aaraa.

lines.english: The Guru is the rod which controls it, and shows it the way. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur ankas maar jeevaalanhaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The mind is uncontrollable; how rare are those who subdue it.
lines.transliteration: man asaaDh saaDh ai jan ko-ay.

lines.english: Those who move the immovable become pure.
lines.transliteration: achar charai taa nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs embellish and beautify this mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ih man la-i-aa savaar.

lines.english: They eradicate egotism and corruption from within. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vichahu tajay vikaar. ||3||

lines.english: Those who, by pre-ordained destiny, are united in the Lord's Union,
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur raakh i-an mayl milaa-ay.
kaday na vichh urheh sabad  samaa-ay. are never separated from Him again; they are absorbed in the Shabad.

lines.english: He Himself knows His Own Almighty Power.
lines.transliteration: aapnee kalaa aapay hee jaan ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||25|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (159-10) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam pachh aanai. ||4||5||25||

lines.english: The entire world has gone insane in egotism.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich sabh jag ba-uraanaa.

lines.english: In the love of duality, it wanders deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bh aram bh ulaanaa.

lines.english: The mind is distracted by great anxiety; no one recognizes one's own self.
lines.transliteration: baho chintaa chit vai aap na pachh aanaa.

lines.english: DhanDh aa kart i-aa an-d in vihaanaa. ||1|| Occupied with their own affairs, their nights and days are passing away. ||1||
Meditate on the Lord in your hearts, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: hirdai raam ramhu mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh's tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rasnaa har rasan rasaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs recognize the Lord in their own hearts;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hird ai jin raam pachh aataa.
jagjeevan sayv jug chaaray jaataa. they serve the Lord, the Life of the World. They are famous throughout the four ages.

lines.english: They subdue egotism, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar gur sabad pachh aataa.

lines.english: God, the Architect of Destiny, showers His Mercy upon them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay parabh karam biDh aataa. ||2||

lines.english: True are those who merge into the Word of the Guru's Shabad;
lines.transliteration: say jan sachay jo gur sabad milaa-ay.

lines.english: Dhaavat  varjay th aak rahaa-ay. they restrain their wandering mind and keep it steady.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the nine treasures. It is obtained from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: naam nav niDh gur t ay paa-ay.

lines.english: By the Lord's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa tay har vasai man aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the body becomes peaceful and tranquil.
lines.transliteration: raam raam karti-aa sukh  saaNt sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells deep within - the pain of death does not touch Him.
lines.transliteration: antar vasai na laagai jam peer.

lines.english: He Himself is our Lord and Master; He is His Own Advisor.
lines.transliteration: aapay saahib aap vajeer.
