lines.english: O Nanak, serve the Lord forever; He is the treasure of glorious virtue. ||4||6||26|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (159-17) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sayv sadaa har gun ee gaheer. ||4||6||26||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Why forget Him, unto whom the soul and the breath of life belong?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o visrai jis kay jee-a paraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿਤਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਤ  ਸਰੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: Why forget Him, who is all-pervading?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o visrai sabh maahi samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਸੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਜਮ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Serving Him, one is honored and accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit sayvi-ai d argeh pat  parvaanaa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam vitahu bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰ  ॥੪॥੬॥੨੬॥
lines.english: If I were to forget You, at that very instant, I would die. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN visrahi t ad hee mar jaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those whom You Yourself have led astray, forget You. pMnw 160
lines.transliteration: tin tooN visrahi je t uDh aap bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: Thse who are in love with duality forget You.
lines.transliteration: tin tooN visrahi je d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: manmukh agi-aanee jonee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Those who are pleasing to the One Lord are assigned to His service and enshrine Him within their minds.
lines.transliteration: guAwryrI, mÚ 3) jin ik man tuth aa say sat gur sayvaa laa-ay. jin ik man t uthaa tin har man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har naam samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਤੁਠਾ ਿਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have virtue as their treasure, contemplate spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: jinaa potai punn say gi-aan beechaaree.

lines.english: Those who have virtue as their treasure, subdue egotism.
lines.transliteration: jinaa potai punn t in ha-umai maaree.

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||27|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (160-4) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo naam ratay t in ka-o balihaaree. ||4||7||27||

lines.english: You are Indescribable; how can I describe You?
lines.transliteration: tooN akath ki-o kathi-aa jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਨਾਿਮ ਰਤੇ ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੭॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Those who subdue their minds, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are absorbedin You.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad maaran  man maahi samaahi.

lines.english: Your Glorious Virtues are countless; their value cannot be estimated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  anayk keemat  nah paahi. ||1||

lines.english: The Word of His Bani belongs to Him; in Him, it is diffused.
lines.transliteration: jis kee banee t is maahi samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਾਰਣੁ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Your Speech cannot be spoken; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is chanted.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree akath kathaa gur sabad  vakh aanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਹ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where the True Guru is - there is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: jah satgur t ah sat sangat  banaa-ee.

lines.english: Where the True Guru is - there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are intuitively sung.
lines.transliteration: jah satgur sehjay har gun  gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where the True Guru is - there egotism is burnt away, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jah satgur t ahaa ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs serve Him; they obtain a place in the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa mahlee thaa-o paa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs enshrine the Naam within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar har naam vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat har naam samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤਹਾ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Giver Himself gives His Gifts,
lines.transliteration: aapay daat  karay d aataar.
pooray satgur si-o lagai pi-aar. as we enshrine love for the True Guru.

lines.english: Nanak celebrates those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.||4||8||28|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (160-10) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay t in ka-o jaikaar. ||4||8||28||

lines.english: All forms and colors come from the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykas tay sabh  roop heh rangaa.

lines.english: Air, water and fire are all kept together.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant ar sabh  sahlangaa.

lines.english: The Lord God beholds the many and various colors. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhinn bh inn vaykh ai har parabh  rangaa. ||1||

lines.english: The One Lord is wondrous and amazing! He is the One, the One and Only.
lines.transliteration: ayk achraj ayko hai so-ee.

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh veechaaray virlaa ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God is naturally pervading all places.
lines.transliteration: sahj bhavai parabh  sabh nee thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਰੂਪ ਹਿਹ ਰੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Sometimes He is hidden, and sometimes He is revealed; thus God has made the worldof His making.
lines.transliteration: kahaa gupat pargat parabh  banat banaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself wakes us from sleep. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay suti-aa d ay-ay jagaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: No one can estimate His value,
lines.transliteration: tis kee keemat  kinai na ho-ee.
kahi kahi kathan kahai sabh ko-ee. although everyone has tried, over and over again, to describe Him.

lines.english: Those who merge in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, come to understand the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur sabad samaavai boojh ai har so-ee. ||3||

lines.english: They listen to the Shabad continually; beholding Him, they merge into Him.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  vaykh ai sabad  milaa-ay.

lines.english: They obtain glorious greatness by serving the Guru.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee gur sayvaa tay paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name are absorbed in the Lord's Name.||4||9||29|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (160-15) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay har naam samaa-ay. ||4||9||29||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are asleep, in love and attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: manmukh soot aa maa-i-aa mohi pi-aar.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are awake, contemplating spiritual wisdom and the Glory of God.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaagay gun  gi-aan beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਿਹ ਕਥਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who love the Naam, are awake and aware. ||1||
lines.transliteration: say jan jaagay jin naam pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਬੂਝੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who is awake to this intuitive wisdom does not fall asleep.
lines.transliteration: sehjay jaagai savai na ko-ay.

lines.english: How rare are those humble beings who understand this through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay boojh ai jan ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The unsaintly blockhead shall never understand.
lines.transliteration: asant anaarh ee kad ay na boojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੪॥੯॥੨੯॥
lines.english: He babbles on and on, but he is infatuated with Maya.
lines.transliteration: kathnee karay tai maa-i-aa naal loojh ai.

lines.english: Blind and ignorant, he shall never be reformed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anDh agi-aanee kad ay na seejh ai. ||2||

lines.english: In this age, salvation comes only from the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh raam naam nistaaraa.

lines.english: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: virlaa ko paa-ay gur sabad veechaaraa.

lines.english: They save themselves, and save all their family and ancestors as well. ||3|| pMnw 161
lines.transliteration: aap tarai saglay kul uDh aaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਮਿਹ ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, no one is interested in good karma, or Dharmic faith.
lines.transliteration: is kalijug meh karam Dharam na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲੀ  ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਚੰਡਾਲ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: This Dark Age was born in the house of evil.
lines.transliteration: kalee kaa janam chandaal kai ghar ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਕੋ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੩੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated. ||4||10||30|| gauVI mhlw 3 guAwryrI ] (161-2) ga-orhee mehlaa 3 gu-aarayree. Gauree, Third Mehl, Gwaarayree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam binaa ko mukat na ho-ee. ||4||10||30||

lines.english: True is the Lord King, True is His Royal Command.
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar sachaa paatisaahu.

lines.english: Those whose minds are attuned to the True, Carefree Lord enter the True Mansion of His Presence, and merge in the True Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man saachai raatay har vayparvaahu. sachai mahal sach naam samaahu. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O my mind: contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sun man mayray sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam japahu bhavjal ut arahu paar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In doubt he comes, and in doubt he goes.
lines.transliteration: bharmay aavai bh armay jaa-ay.

lines.english: This world is born out of the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: ih jag janmi-aa doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord; he continues coming andgoing in reincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: manmukh na chayt ai aavai jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Does he himself go astray, or does God lead him astray?
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa ke parabh  aap bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: This soul is enjoined to the service of someone else.
lines.transliteration: ih jee-o vidaanee chaakree laa-i-aa.

lines.english: It earns only terrible pain, and this life is lost in vain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahaa dukh  khatay birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kar satguroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: Remembering the One Name, doubt is cast out from within.
lines.transliteration: ayko naam chaytay vichahu bh aram chukaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the nine treasures of the Name are obtained. ||4||11||31|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (161-7) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japay naa-o na-o niDh paa-ay. ||4||11||31||

lines.english: Go and ask the Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinaa gurmukh Dh i-aa-i-aa t in poochh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, the mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay man pat ee-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੩੧॥
lines.english: Those who earn the Lord's Name are wealthy.
lines.transliteration: say Dhanvant  har naam kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, understanding is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay sojh ee paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu mayray bhaa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs serve the Lord, and so they are accepted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa har gh aal thaa-ay paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who recognize the self - their minds become pure.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai man nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: They become Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive, and they find the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat har paavai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the intellect becomes pure and sublime,
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai mat  ootam ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਵਾ ਹਿਰ ਘਾਲ  ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sehjay sahj samaavai so-ay. ||2|| and they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

lines.english: In the love of duality, no one can serve the Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay na sayvi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: In egotism and Maya, they are eating toxic poison.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa mahaa bikh kh aa-ay.

lines.english: They are emotionally attached to their children, family and home.
lines.transliteration: put kutamb garihi mohi-aa maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs come and go in reincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa aavai jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Those, unto whom the Lord bestows His Name, worship Him night and day, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har har naam dayvai jan so-ay. an-d in bhagat gur sabd ee ho-ay.

lines.english: How rare are those who understand the Guru's Teachings!
lines.transliteration: gurmat virlaa boojh ai ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||32|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (161-14) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaavai so-ay. ||4||12||32||

lines.english: The Guru's service has been performed throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa jug chaaray ho-ee.

lines.english: Very few are those perfect ones who do this good deed.
lines.transliteration: pooraa jan kaar kamaavai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is inexhaustible; it shall never be exhausted.
lines.transliteration: akhut naam Dh an har t ot na ho-ee.

lines.english: In this world, it brings a constant peace, and at the Lord's Gate, it brings honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aithai sadaa sukh  dar sobh aa ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, have no doubt about this.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayray bharam na keejai.

lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who serve, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa amrit  ras peejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are the greatest people of the world.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say mahaa purakh  sansaaray.

lines.english: They save themselves, and they redeem all their generations as well.
lines.transliteration: aap uDhray kul sagal nist aaray.

lines.english: They keep the Name of the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakheh ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay bh a-ojal ut reh paaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes humble forever.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh sad aa man d aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Egotism is subdued, and the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar kamal pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody vibrates, as they dwell within the home of the self.
lines.transliteration: anhad vaajai nij gh ar vaasaa.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they remain detached within their own home. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay gh ar maahi ud aasaa. ||3||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, their words are true.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh t in kee sachee ban ee.

lines.english: Throughout the ages, the devotees chant and repeat these words.
lines.transliteration: jug jug bhagt ee aakh  vakh aanee.

lines.english: Night and day, they meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the Earth. pMnw 162
lines.transliteration: an-din jaapeh har saarangpaan ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are detached, in the perfect balance of Nirvaanaa. ||4||13||33|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 ] (162-1) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3. Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay nihkayval nirbaan ee. ||4||13||33||

lines.english: Through great good fortune and high destiny, one meets the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai vadbh aag sanjog.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is constantly within the heart, and one enjoys thesublime essence of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam nit  har ras bh og. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paraan ee naam har Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Be victorious in the game of life, and earn the profit of the Naam. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam jeet laahaa naam paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation come to those unto whom the Word of the Guru's Shabad is sweet.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan gur sabad  hai meeth aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a few have tasted, and seen it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay kinai virlai chakh  deeth aa. ||2||

lines.english: They may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions,
lines.transliteration: karam kaaNd baho karahi achaar.
bin naavai Dharig Dh arig ahaNkaar. ||3|| but without the Name, the egotistical ones are cursed and doomed. ||3||

lines.english: They are bound and gagged, and hung by Maya's noose;
lines.transliteration: banDhan baaDh i-o maa-i-aa faas.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, they shall be released only by Guru's Grace. ||4||14||34|| mhlw 3 gauVI bYrwgix ] (162-6) mehlaa 3 ga-orhee bairaagan . Third Mehl, Gauree Bairaagan:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak chhootai gur pargaas. ||4||14||34||

lines.english: The clouds pour their rain down upon the earth, but isn't there water within the earthas well?
lines.transliteration: jaisee Dhart ee oopar maygh ulaa barsat  hai ki-aa Dh artee maDh ay paan ee naahee.

lines.english: Water is contained within the earth; without feet, the clouds run around and let down their rain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaisay Dhart ee maDh ay paan ee pargaasi-aa bin pagaa varsat  firaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, get rid of your doubts like this.
lines.transliteration: baabaa tooN aisay bh aram chukaahee.

lines.english: As you act, so shall you become, and so you shall go and mingle. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karat  hai so-ee ko-ee hai ray t aisay jaa-ay samaahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਧਰਤੀ  ਊਪਿਰਮੇਘੁਲਾ ਬਰਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਕਆ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: As woman or man, what can anyone do?
lines.transliteration: istaree purakh  ho-ay kai ki-aa o-ay karam kamaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ  ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ  ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਪਗਾ  ਵਰਸਤ  ਿਫਰਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The many and various forms are always Yours, O Lord; they shall merge again intoYou. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop sadaa heh t ayray t ujh hee maahi samaahee. ||2||

lines.english: In countless incarnations, I went astray. Now that I have found You, I shall no longerwander.
lines.transliteration: itnay janam bh ool paray say jaa paa-i-aa t aa bh oolay naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ ਕਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਇ  ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is His work; those who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad come toknow it well. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa kaaraj so-ee par jaanai jay gur kai sabad  samaahee. ||3||

lines.english: The Shabad is Yours; You are Yourself. Where is there any doubt?
lines.transliteration: tayraa sabad  tooNhai heh aapay bh aram kahaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਤਰੀ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਿਕਆ  ਓਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one whose essence is merged with the Lord's essence does not have toenter the cycle of reincarnation again. ||4||1||15||35|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 3 ] (162-11) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 3. Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tat  tat si-o mili-aa punrap janam na aahee. ||4||1||15||35||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਹ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The whole world is under the power of Death, bound by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag kaalai vas hai baaDh aa doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤਨੇ  ਜਨਮ  ਭੂਿਲ ਪਰੇ ਸੇ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤਾ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego; they receive their just rewards. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karam kamaavday manmukh  milai sajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur charnee chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਤੂੰਹੈ ਹਿਹ ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, you shall be awarded the treasure of the Naam. In the Court of the Lord, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam niDh aan lai d argeh la-ay chh adaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਤੁ ਤਤ ਿਸਉ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਆਹੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Through 8.4 million incarnations, people wander lost; in stubborn-mindedness, theycome and go.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh bh aramd ay manhath  aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: They do not realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad; they are reincarnated over andover again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheeni-o fir fir jonee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਲੈ  ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਬਾਧਾ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh understands his own self. The Lord's Name comes to dwell within themind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap pachh aani-aa har naam vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with devotion to the Lord's Name, night and day, he merges in peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agtee rat i-aa har naamay sukh  samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: When one's mind dies in the Shabad, one radiates faith and confidence, shedding egotism and corruption.
lines.transliteration: man sabad marai part eet ho-ay ha-umai t ajay vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, through the karma of good actions, the treasure of devotionalworship and the Name of the Lord are attained. ||4||2||16||36|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 3 ] (162-17) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 3. Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak karmee paa-ee-an har naamaa bhagat  bhandaar. ||4||2||16||36||

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, has ordained that the soul is to stay in her parents' home for onlya few short days.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai d in chaar hai har har likh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਭਰਮਦੇ  ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Glorious is that soul-bride, who as Gurmukh, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sobhaavant ee naar hai gurmukh  gun gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਿਨਓ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She who cultivates virtue in her parents' home, shall obtain a home at her in-laws.
lines.transliteration: payvkarhai gun  sammlai saahurai vaas paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are intuitively absorbed into the Lord. The Lord is pleasing to theirminds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sahj samaan ee-aa har har man bh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਿਤਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Our Husband Lord dwells in this world, and in the world beyond. Tell me, how can Hebe found?
lines.transliteration: sasurai pay-ee-ai pir vasai kaho kit biDh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਜੇ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord Himself is unseen. He unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 163
lines.transliteration: aap niranjan alakh hai aapay maylaa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God Himself bestows wisdom; meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee parabh d eh mat  har naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, who places the Ambrosial Nectar in the mouth.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee sat gur milai mukh  amrit  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਮਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: When egotism and duality are eradicated, one intuitively merges in peace.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai dubiDh aa binas jaa-ay sehjay sukh  samaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself links us to His Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay aap varatd aa aapay naa-ay laa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, in their arrogant pride, do not find God; they are soignorant and foolish!
lines.transliteration: manmukh garab na paa-i-o agi-aan i-aan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਨਾਇ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They do not serve the True Guru, and in the end, they regret and repent, over andover again.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa naa karahi fir fir pachh utaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਇਆਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: They are cast into the womb to be reincarnated, and within the womb, they rot.
lines.transliteration: garabh jonee vaas paa-id ay garbh ay gal jaan ay.

lines.english: As it pleases my Creator Lord, the self-willed manmukhs wander around lost. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mayray kartay ayvai bh aavdaa manmukh  bharmaan ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਨੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ  ਗਰਭੇ  ਗਿਲ  ਜਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord God inscribed the full pre-ordained destiny upon the forehead.
lines.transliteration: mayrai har parabh laykh  likhaa-i-aa Dh ur mast ak pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ  ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ  ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਾਣੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: When one meets the Great and Courageous Guru, one meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-i-aa bh ayti-aa gur sooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਖਾਇਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my mother and father; the Lord is my relative and brother.
lines.transliteration: mayraa pitaa maat aa har naam hai har banDh ap beeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਭੇਿਟਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, please forgive me and unite me with Yourself. Servant Nanak is alowly worm. ||4||3||17||37|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 3 ] (163-7) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 3. Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har bakhas milaa-ay parabh  jan naanak keeraa. ||4||3||17||37||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਬੰਧਪੁ  ਬੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: From the True Guru, I obtained spiritual wisdom; I contemplate the Lord's essence.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay gi-aan paa-i-aa har t at beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੀਰਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੩੭॥
lines.english: My polluted intellect was enlightened by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mat maleen  pargat bh a-ee jap naam muraaraa.

lines.english: The distinction between Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter - has been destroyed,and the darkness has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: siv sakat mitaa-ee-aa chookaa anDh i-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur mast ak jin ka-o likh i-aa tin har naam pi-aaraa. ||1|| The Lord's Name is loved by those, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destinywas written. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਮਲੀਣ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: How can the Lord be obtained, O Saints? Seeing Him, my life is sustained.
lines.transliteration: har kit biDh  paa-ee-ai sant  janhu jis d aykh ha-o jeevaa.

lines.english: Without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. Unite me with the Guru, so that I may drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bin chasaa na jeevtee gur maylihu har ras peevaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and I listen to them daily; the Lord, Har, Har,has emancipated me.
lines.transliteration: ha-o har gun gaavaa nit  har sun ee har har gat  keenee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Lord's essence from the Guru; my mind and body are drenchedwith it.
lines.transliteration: har ras gur tay paa-i-aa mayraa man t an leenee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਤੀ  ਗੁਰ ਮੇਿਲਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an gur sat  purakh  hai jin bh agat har d eenee. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the True Being, who has blessed me with devotionalworship of the Lord.
From the Guru, I have obtained the Lord; I have made Him my Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis gur tay har paa-i-aa so gur ham keenee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਣੀ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਿਤ  ਕੀਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Sovereign Lord is the Giver of virtue. I am worthless and without virtue.
lines.transliteration: gundaat aa har raa-ay hai ham avgan i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The sinners sink like stones; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord carries us across.
lines.transliteration: paapee paathar doobday gurmat  har t aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁਧਨੁਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord; I am worthless and without virtue.
lines.transliteration: tooN gund aataa nirmalaa ham avgan i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save me, as You have saved the idiotsand fools. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har sarnaagat  raakh  layho moorh  mugaDh  nistaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ਹੈ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਿਣਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Eternal celestial bliss comes through the Guru's Teachings, by meditating continually on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sahj anand sadaa gurmat ee har har man Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੀ  ਪਾਥਰ  ਡੂਬਦੇ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Lord God as my Best Friend, within the home of my own self. Ising the Songs of Joy.
lines.transliteration: sajan har parabh  paa-i-aa gh ar sohilaa gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God, that I may meditate on Your Name,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har da-i-aa Dh aar parabh  baynt ee har har chayt aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those who have found the True Guru.||4||4||18||38|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 4 cauQw caupdy  (163-17) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 4 cha-uthaa cha-upd ay Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (163-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mangai Dhoorh  tin jin sat gur paa-i-aa. ||4||4||18||38||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੁ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandit - the religious scholar - recites the Shaastras and the Simritees;
lines.transliteration: pandit saasat  simrit  parhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee gorakh gorakh  kari-aa. the Yogi cries out, "Gorakh, Gorakh".

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But I am just a fool - I just chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh har har jap parh i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂਿੜ ਿਤਨ ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੩੮॥
lines.english: I do not know what my condition shall be, Lord.
lines.transliteration: naa jaanaa ki-aa gat raam hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਚਉਥਾ  ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Name of the Lord. You shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 164
lines.transliteration: har bhaj man mayray t ar bha-ojal t oo taaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Sannyaasee smears his body with ashes;
lines.transliteration: sani-aasee bibhoot  laa-ay d ayh savaaree.
par tari-a t i-aag karee barahamchaaree. renouncing other men's women, he practices celibacy.

lines.english: I am just a fool, Lord; I place my hopes in You! ||2||
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh har aas t umaaree. ||2||

lines.english: The Kh'shaatriya acts bravely, and is recognized as a warrior.
lines.transliteration: khatree karam karay soort an paavai.

lines.english: The Shoodra and the Vaisha work and slave for others;
lines.transliteration: sood vais par kirat  kamaavai.

lines.english: I am just a fool - I am saved by the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh har naam chh adaavai. ||3||

lines.english: The entire Universe is Yours; You Yourself permeate and pervade it.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree sarisat t ooN aap rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਤੂੰ ਆਿਪ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am blind - I have taken the Lord as my Support. ||4||1||39|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 4 ] (164-4) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 4. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mai anDhulay har tayk tikaa-ee. ||4||1||39||

lines.english: The Speech of the Lord is the most sublime speech, free of any attributes.
lines.transliteration: nirgun kathaa kathaa hai har kee.

lines.english: Vibrate on it, meditate on it, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: bhaj mil saaDh oo sangat  jan kee.

lines.english: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, listening to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tar bh a-ojal akath kathaa sun har kee. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: gobind sat sangat  maylaa-ay.

lines.english: My tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord, singing the Lord's Glorious Praises.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har ras rasnaa raam gun gaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਸੁਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har
lines.transliteration: jo jan Dhi-aavahi har har naamaa.
tin daasan d aas karahu ham raamaa. - please make me the slave of their slaves, Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serving Your slaves is the ultimate good deed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan kee sayvaa ootam kaamaa. ||2||

lines.english: One who chants the Speech of the Lord
lines.transliteration: jo har kee har kathaa sunaavai.
so jan hamrai man chit bh aavai. - that humble servant is pleasing to my conscious mind.

lines.english: Those who are blessed with great good fortune obtain the dust of the feet of the humble. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan pag rayn vadbh aagee paavai. ||3||

lines.english: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny are in love with the humbleSaints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa si-o pareet  ban aa-ee. jin ka-o likh at likhi-aa Dh ur paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings, O Nanak, are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.||4||2||40|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 4 ] (164-9) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 4. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tay jan naanak naam samaa-ee. ||4||2||40||

lines.english: The mother loves to see her son eat.
lines.transliteration: maataa pareet  karay put  khaa-ay.

lines.english: The fish loves to bathe in the water.
lines.transliteration: meenay pareet bh a-ee jal naa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru loves to place food in the mouth of His GurSikh. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur pareet  gursikh  mukh  paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: If only I could meet those humble servants of the Lord, O my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: tay har jan har maylhu ham pi-aaray.

lines.english: Meeting with them, my sorrows depart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin mili-aa dukh  jaahi hamaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: As the cow shows her love to her strayed calf when she finds it,
lines.transliteration: ji-o mil bachhray ga-oo pareet  lagaavai.
kaaman pareet jaa pir gh ar aavai. and as the bride shows her love for her husband when he returns home,
har jan pareet jaa har jas gaavai. ||2|| so does the Lord's humble servant love to sing the Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.english: The rainbird loves the rainwater, falling in torrents;
lines.transliteration: saaring pareet basai jal Dh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: narpat pareet  maa-i-aa d aykh pasaaraa. the king loves to see his wealth on display.

lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord loves to meditate on the Formless Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har jan pareet japai nirankaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: The mortal man loves to accumulate wealth and property.
lines.transliteration: nar paraanee pareet  maa-i-aa Dh an kh aatay.

lines.english: The GurSikh loves to meet and embrace the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gursikh pareet  gur milai galaatay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak loves to kiss the feet of the Holy. ||4||3||41|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 4 ] (164-15) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 4. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak pareet saaDh  pag chaatay. ||4||3||41||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The beggar loves to receive charity from the wealthy landlord.
lines.transliteration: bheekh ak pareet  bheekh parabh  paa-ay.

lines.english: The hungry person loves to eat food.
lines.transliteration: bhookh ay pareet  hovai ann kh aa-ay.

lines.english: The GurSikh loves to find satisfaction by meeting the Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gursikh pareet  gur mil aagh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I place my hopes in You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: har darsan d ayh har aas t umaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ  ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
lines.english: Shower me with Your Mercy, and fulfill my longing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa loch poor hamaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The song-bird loves the sun shining in her face.
lines.transliteration: chakvee pareet sooraj mukh  laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੧॥
lines.english: Meeting her Beloved, all her pains are left behind.
lines.transliteration: milai pi-aaray sabh d ukh ti-aagai.

lines.english: The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gursikh pareet  guroo mukh  laagai. ||2||

lines.english: The calf loves to suck its mother's milk;
lines.transliteration: bachhray pareet  kheer mukh  khaa-ay.
hirdai bigsai d aykhai maa-ay. its heart blossoms forth upon seeing its mother.

lines.english: The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gursikh pareet  guroo mukh  laa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: All other loves and emotional attachment to Maya are false.
lines.transliteration: hor sabh pareet  maa-i-aa moh kaachaa.

lines.english: They shall pass away, like false and transitory decorations.
lines.transliteration: binas jaa-ay kooraa kach paachaa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is fulfilled, through the Love of the True Guru. ||4||4||42|| pMnw 165 gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 4 ] (165-1) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 4. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak pareet t aripat  gur saachaa. ||4||4||42||

lines.english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding;
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa safal hai ban ee.
jit mil har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa har Dh anee. meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Lord Master.

lines.english: So many are emancipated along with those who meditate on the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin har japi-aa tin peechh ai chh ootee gh anee. ||1||

lines.english: O GurSikhs, chant the Name of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: gursikh har bolhu mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, all sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bolat sabh  paap leh jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When one meets the Guru, then the mind becomes centered.
lines.transliteration: jab gur mili-aa tab man vas aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਤ  ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  panch rahay har Dh i-aa-i-aa. The five passions, running wild, are brought to rest by meditating on the Lord.
Night and day, within the body-village, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din nagree har gun  gaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਤਬ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਸ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who apply the dust of the Feet of the True Guru to their faces,
lines.transliteration: satgur pag Dh oor jinaa mukh  laa-ee.
tin koorh  ti-aagay har liv laa-ee. renounce falsehood and enshrine love for the Lord.

lines.english: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tay har d argeh mukh  oojal bh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Service to the Guru is pleasing to the Lord Himself.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa aap har bhaavai.

lines.english: Even Krishna and Balbhadar meditated on the Lord, falling at the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: krisan balbhad aro gur pag lag Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਭਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself saves the Gurmukhs. ||4||5||43|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 4 ] (165-7) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 4. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har aap t araavai. ||4||5||43||

lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Yogi, who wields the staff of authority.
lines.transliteration: har aapay jogee dandaaDhaaree.

lines.english: The Lord Himself practices tapa - intense self-disciplined meditation; He is deeply absorbed in His primal trance. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har aapay rav rahi-aa banvaaree. har aapay tap t aapai laa-ay t aaree. ||1||

lines.english: Such is my Lord, who is all-pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: aisaa mayraa raam rahi-aa bharpoor.

lines.english: He dwells near at hand - the Lord is not far away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nikat vasai naahee har door. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Word of the Shabad. He Himself is the awareness, attuned to its music.
lines.transliteration: har aapay sabad surat  Dhun aapay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: har aapay vaykhai vigsai aapay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself chants, and the Lord Himself inspires others to chant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har aap japaa-ay aapay har jaapay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਲਾਇ  ਤਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the rainbird, and the Ambrosial Nectar raining down.
lines.transliteration: har aapay saaring amrit-Dh aara.

lines.english: The Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in.
lines.transliteration: har amrit aap pee-aavan haaraa.

lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Doer; He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har aap karay aapay nistaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Boat, the Raft and the Boatman.
lines.transliteration: har aapay bayrhee t ulhaa t aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਧੁਿਨ ਆਪੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us.
lines.transliteration: har aapay gurmatee nist aaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself carries us across to the other side. ||4||6||44|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 4 ] (165-12) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har aapay naanak paavai paaraa. ||4||6||44||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ ਜਪਾਇ  ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Master, You are my Banker. I receive only that capital which You give me.
lines.transliteration: saahu hamaaraa tooN Dhanee jaisee t ooN raas d eh taisee ham layhi.

lines.english: I would purchase the Lord's Name with love, if You Yourself, in Your Mercy, would sell it to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naam vannjah rang si-o jay aap d a-i-aal ho-ay d eh. ||1||

lines.english: I am the merchant, the peddler of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham vanjaaray raam kay.

lines.english: I trade in the merchandise and capital of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har vanaj karaavai d ay raas ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have earned the profit, the wealth of devotional worship of the Lord. I have becomepleasing to the Mind of the Lord, the True Banker.
lines.transliteration: laahaa har bhagat  Dhan kh ati-aa har sachay saah man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I chant and meditate on the Lord, loading the merchandise of the Lord's Name. TheMessenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even approach me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har jap har vakhar lad i-aa jam jaagaat ee nayrh  na aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those traders who trade in other merchandise, are caught up in the endless waves ofthe pain of Maya.
lines.transliteration: hor vanaj karahi vaapaaree-ay anant  tarangee d ukh maa-i-aa.

lines.english: According to the business in which the Lord has placed them, so are the rewards theyobtain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: o-ay jayhai vanaj har laa-i-aa fal t ayhaa t in paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਿਸ  ਦੇਿਹ ਤੈਸੀ ਹਮ ਲੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: People trade in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, when the God shows His Mercy and bestows it.
lines.transliteration: har har vanaj so jan karay jis kirpaal ho-ay parabh  day-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਜੇ ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਦੇਿਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak serves the Lord, the Banker; he shall never again be called to renderhis account. ||4||1||7||45|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 4 ] (165-18) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saahu har sayvi-aa fir laykhaa mool na lay-ee. ||4||1||7||45||

lines.english: The mother nourishes the fetus in the womb, hoping for a son,
lines.transliteration: ji-o jannee garabh paalt ee sut  kee kar aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਣਜੁ  ਕਰਾਵੈ  ਦੇ ਰਾਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa ho-ay Dhan kh aat day-ay kar bh og bilaasaa. who will grow and earn and give her money to enjoy herself.

lines.english: In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Lord, who extends His Helping Hand to us. ||1|| pMnw 166
lines.transliteration: ti-o har jan pareet  har raakh -daa day aap hathaasaa. ||1||

lines.english: O my Lord, I am so foolish; save me, O my Lord God!
lines.transliteration: mayray raam mai moorakh har raakh  mayray gus-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਸਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Your servant's praise is Your Own Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jan kee upmaa tujh eh vad-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those whose minds are pleased by the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, are joyful in the palaces of their own homes.
lines.transliteration: mandar gh ar aanand  har har jas man bh aavai.

lines.english: Their mouths savor all the sweet delicacies when they sing the Glorious Praises of theLord.
lines.transliteration: sabh ras meeth ay mukh  lageh jaa har gun  gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servants are the saviors of their families; they save their familiesfor twenty-one generations - they save the entire world! ||2||
lines.transliteration: har jan parvaar saDhaar hai ikeeh kulee sabh  jagat  chhadaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਗਿਹ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever has been done, has been done by the Lord; it is the Glorious Greatness ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kee-aa so har kee-aa har kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁਪਰਵਾਰੁਸਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੀਹ  ਕੁਲੀ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਛਡਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, in Your creatures, You are pervading; You inspire them to worship You.
lines.transliteration: har jee-a tayray t ooN varatd aa har pooj karaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord leads us to the treasure of devotional worship; He Himself bestows it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  bhandaar lahaa-id aa aapay vart aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a slave, purchased in Your market; what clever tricks do I have?
lines.transliteration: laalaa haat vihaajhi-aa ki-aa t is chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਲਹਾਇਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: If the Lord were to set me upon a throne, I would still be His slave. If I were a grass-cutter, I would still chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jay raaj bahaalay taa har gulaam gh aasee ka-o har naam kadh aa-ee.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; contemplate the Glorious Greatness of the Lord||4||2||8||46|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 4 ] (166-6) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har kee vadi-aa-ee. ||4||2||8||46||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਰਾਿਜ  ਬਹਾਲੇ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ  ਘਾਸੀ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਢਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The farmers love to work their farms;
lines.transliteration: kirsaanee kirsaan  karay lochai jee-o laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: hal jotai ud am karay mayraa put  Dhee kh aa-ay. they plow and work the fields, so that their sons and daughters may eat.

lines.english: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har,Har, and in the end, the Lord shall save them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ti-o har jan har har jap karay har ant  chhadaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: I am foolish - save me, O my Lord!
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh kee gat  keejai mayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲੁ ਜੋਤੈ ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਧੀ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, enjoin me to work and serve the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur satgur sayvaa har laa-ay ham kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਤ  ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The traders buy horses, planning to trade them.
lines.transliteration: lai turay sa-ud aagree sa-ud aagar Dh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਕੀਜੈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Dhan kh atai aasaa karai maa-i-aa moh vaDh aavai. They hope to earn wealth; their attachment to Maya increases.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਇ  ਹਮ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; chanting the Lord's Name, they find peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ti-o har jan har har bolt aa har bol sukh  paavai. ||2||

lines.english: The shop-keepers collect poison, sitting in their shops, carrying on their business.
lines.transliteration: bikh sanchai hatvaan ee-aa bahi haat kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Their love is false, their displays are false, and they are engrossed in falsehood.
lines.transliteration: moh jhooth  pasaaraa jh ooth kaa jh oothay laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਖਟੈ ਆਸਾ  ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants gather the wealth of the Lord'sName; they take the Lord's Name as their supplies. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ti-o har jan har Dh an sanchi-aa har kh arach lai jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਬੋਿਲ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: This emotional attachment to Maya and family, and the love of duality, is a noosearound the neck.
lines.transliteration: ih maa-i-aa moh kutamb hai bhaa-ay d oojai faas.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the humble servants are carried across; they becomethe slaves of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee so jan t arai jo d aasan d aas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ਝੂਠ ਕਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam; the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||4||3||9||47|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 4 ] (166-13) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa gurmukh  pargaas. ||4||3||9||47||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ  ਹਿਰ ਖਰਚੁ  ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Continuously, day and night, they are gripped by greed and deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: nit dinas raat  laalach karay bh armai bh armaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.english: The slaves labor in slavery, carrying the loads upon their heads.
lines.transliteration: vaygaar firai vaygaaree-aa sir bhaar uth aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸ ॥
lines.english: That humble being who serves the Guru is put to work by the Lord in His Home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo gur kee jan sayvaa karay so ghar kai kamm har laa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O my Lord, please break these bonds of Maya, and put me to work in Your Home.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam torh  banDh an maa-i-aa gh ar kai kamm laa-ay.

lines.english: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nit har gun  gaavah har naam samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Mortal men work for kings, all for the sake of wealth and Maya.
lines.transliteration: nar paraanee chaakree karay narpat  raajay arath sabh  maa-i-aa.

lines.english: But the king either imprisons them, or fines them, or else dies himself.
lines.transliteration: kai banDhai kai daan lay-ay kai narpat  mar jaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਿਮ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an sayvaa safal sat guroo kee jit  har har naam jap har sukh  paa-i-aa. ||2|| Blessed, rewarding and fruitful is the service of the True Guru; through it, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I have found peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4)

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਤੋਿੜ ਬੰਧਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਿਮ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everyday, people carry on their business, with all sorts of devices to earn interest, forthe sake of Maya.
lines.transliteration: nit sa-ud aa sood  keechai baho bh aat kar maa-i-aa kai t aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If they earn a profit, they are pleased, but their hearts are broken by losses.
lines.transliteration: jaa laahaa day-ay t aa sukh  manay t otai mar jaa-ee.

lines.english: One who is worthy, becomes a partner with the Guru, and finds a lasting peace forever. ||3|| pMnw 167
lines.transliteration: jo gun saajh ee gur si-o karay nit  nit sukh  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੀ  ਭੂਖ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਹੈ ਿਤਤਨੀ  ਭੂਖ ਿਫਿਰ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: The more one feels hunger for other tastes and pleasures, the more this hunger persists.
lines.transliteration: jitnee bh ookh an ras saad  hai titnee bh ookh fir laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਚੇ ਿਸਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those unto whom the Lord Himself shows mercy, sell their head to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis har aap kirpaa karay so vaychay sir gur aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੮॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is satisfied by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. He shall never feelhungry again. ||4||4||10||48|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 4 ] (167-2) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har ras taript i-aa fir bh ookh na laagai. ||4||4||10||48||

lines.english: Within my conscious mind is the constant longing for the Lord. How can I behold theBlessed Vision of Your Darshan, Lord?
lines.transliteration: hamrai man chit har aas nit  ki-o d aykhaa har d aras t umaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਆਸ  ਿਨਤ ਿਕਉ  ਦੇਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who loves the Lord knows this; the Lord is very dear to my conscious mind.
lines.transliteration: jin pareet laa-ee so jaant aa hamrai man chit  har bahut  pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਈ  ਸੋ ਜਾਣਤਾ  ਹਮਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has re-united me with my Creator Lord; I wasseparated from Him for such a long time! ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-o kurbaanee gur aapnay jin vichh urhi-aa mayli-aa mayraa sirjanhaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ  ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਿਸਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my Lord, I am a sinner; I have come to Your Sanctuary, and fallen at Your Door, Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam ham paapee saran paray har d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: My intellect is worthless; I am filthy and po lluted. Please shower me with Your Mercy sometime. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mat nirgun  ham maylai kabahooN apunee kirpaa Dh aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਹਮ ਮੇਲੈ ਕਬਹ ੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My demerits are so many and numerous. I have sinned so many times, over and overagain. O Lord, they cannot be counted.
lines.transliteration: hamray avgun bahut  bahut  hai baho baar baar har gan at na aavai.

lines.english: You, Lord, are the Merciful Treasure of Virtue. When it pleases You, Lord, You forgiveme.
lines.transliteration: tooN gunvantaa har har d a-i-aal har aapay bakh as laihi har bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. He has bestowed theTeachings of the Lord's Name, which saves me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham apraaDhee raakh ay gur sangt ee upd ays dee-o har naam chh adaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O my True Guru? When the Guruspeaks, I am transfixed with wonder.
lines.transliteration: tumray gun  ki-aa kahaa mayray sat iguraa jab gur bolah t ab bisam ho-ay jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤੀ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਦੀਓ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Can anyone else save a sinner like me? The True Guru has protected and saved me.
lines.transliteration: ham jaisay apraaDhee avar ko-ee raakh ai jaisay ham sat gur raakh  lee-ay chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਗੁਣ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰਾ  ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹ  ਤਬ ਿਬਸਮੁ  ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Guru, You are my father. O Guru, You are my mother. O Guru, You are my relative,companion and friend. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tooN gur pit aa tooNhai gur maat aa tooN gur banDh ap mayraa sakh aa sakh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਮ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My condition, O my True Guru - that condition, O Lord, is known only to You.
lines.transliteration: jo hamree biDh hot ee mayray sat iguraa saa biDh  tum har jaan hu aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਪਤਾ  ਤੂੰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਤਾ  ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੰਧਪੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I was rolling around in the dirt, and no one cared for me at all. In the Company of the Guru, the True Guru, I, the worm, have been raised up and exalted.
lines.transliteration: ham rultay firt ay ko-ee baat  na poochh -taa gur sat gur sang keeray ham thaapay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੀ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਹੋਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰਾ  ਸਾ ਿਬਿਧ  ਤੁਮ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo naanak jan kayraa jit  mili-ai chookay sabh  sog sant aapay. ||4||5||11||49|| Blessed, blessed is the Guru of servant Nanak; meeting Him, all my sorrows andtroubles have come to an end. ||4||5||11||49|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 4 ] (167-12) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bYrwgix, mÚ 4)

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਰੁਲਤੇ ਿਫਰਤੇ  ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਕੀਰੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
lines.english: The soul of the man is lured by gold and women; emotional attachment to Maya is sosweet to him.
lines.transliteration: kanchan naaree meh jee-o lubhat  hai moh meeth aa maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਚੂਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ  ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥੪੯॥
lines.english: The mind has become attached to the pleasures of houses, palaces, horses and otherenjoyments.
lines.transliteration: ghar mand ar ghorhay kh usee man an ras laa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord God does not even enter his thoughts; how can he be saved, O my LordKing? ||1||
lines.transliteration: har parabh chit  na aavee ki-o chh ootaa mayray har raa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨ  ਨਾਰੀ  ਮਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ਲੁਭਤੁ  ਹੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord, these are my lowly actions, O my Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam ih neech karam har mayray.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਘੋੜੇ ਖੁਸੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਨ ਰਿਸ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, Treasure of Virtue, Merciful Lord: please bless me with Your Grace and forgive me for all my mistakes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) gunvant aa har har d a-i-aal kar kirpaa bakh as avgan  sabh  mayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਕਉ  ਛੂਟਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have no beauty, no social status, no manners.
lines.transliteration: kichh roop nahee kichh  jaat naahee kichh  dhang na mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਇਹ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: With what face am I to speak? I have no virtue at all; I have not chanted Your Name.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa muhu lai bolah gun bihoon naam japi-aa na t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਸਿਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. This is the generous blessingof the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham paapee sang gur ubray punn satgur kayraa. ||2||

lines.english: He gave all beings souls, bodies, mouths, noses and water to drink.
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-o pind mukh  nak d ee-aa vart an ka-o paan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਛੁ  ਰੂਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: He gave them corn to eat, clothes to wear, and other pleasures to enjoy.
lines.transliteration: ann khaan aa kaparh  painan  dee-aa ras an bh ogaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ  ਗੁਣ ਿਬਹੂਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਆ  ਨ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: But they do not remember the One who gave them all this. The animals think thatthey made themselves! ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin dee-ay so chit  na aavee pasoo ha-o kar jaan ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਗੁਰ ਉਬਰੇ  ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You made them all; You are all-pervading. You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher ofhearts.
lines.transliteration: sabh keet aa tayraa varatd aa tooN antarjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਕੁ ਦੀਆ  ਵਰਤਣ  ਕਉ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: What can these wretched creatures do? This whole drama is Yours, O Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: ham jant vichaaray ki-aa karah sabh  khayl tum su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਕਪੜੁ  ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਦੀਆ ਰਸ ਅਿਨ  ਭੋਗਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak was purchased in the slave-market. He is the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||4||6||12||50|| pMnw 168 gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 4 ] (168-1) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak haat vihaajhi-aa har gulam gulaamee. ||4||6||12||50||

lines.english: Just as the mother, having given birth to a son, feeds him and keeps him in her vision
lines.transliteration: ji-o jannee sut jan  paalt ee raakh ai nad ar majh aar.
antar baahar mukh  day giraas kh in khin pochaar. - indoors and outdoors, she puts food in his mouth; each and every moment, she caresses him.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਜਨਨੀ  ਸੁਤੁ ਜਿਣ  ਪਾਲਤੀ  ਰਾਖੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਮਝਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: In just the same way, the True Guru protects His GurSikhs, who love their BelovedLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ti-o sat gur gursikh  raakh -taa har pareet  pi-aar. ||1||

lines.english: O my Lord, we are just the ignorant children of our Lord God.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam ham baarik har parabh kay hai i-aan ay.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo gur sat gur paaDh aa jin har upd ays day kee-ay si-aan ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. Hail, hail, to the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Teacher who has made mewise through the Lord's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4)

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਹੈ ਇਆਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: The white flamingo circles through the sky,
lines.transliteration: jaisee gagan firantee oodt ee kapray baagay vaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਧਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਦੇ ਕੀਏ ਿਸਆਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: oh raakhai cheet  peechh ai bich bachray nit  hirdai saar samaalee. but she keeps her young ones in her mind; she has left them behind, but she constantly remembers them in her heart.

lines.english: In just the same way, the True Guru loves His Sikhs. The Lord cherishes His GurSikhs,and keeps them clasped to His Heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ti-o sat gur sikh  pareet  har har kee gur sikh  rakhai jee-a naalee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਗਗਿਨ  ਿਫਰੰਤੀ  ਊਡਤੀ  ਕਪਰੇ  ਬਾਗੇ  ਵਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Just as the tongue, made of flesh and blood, is protected within the scissors of thethirty-two teeth
lines.transliteration: jaisay kaatee t ees bat ees hai vich raakh ai rasnaa maas rat  kayree.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤੁ  ਪੀਛੈ ਿਬਿਚ  ਬਚਰੇ  ਿਨਤ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ko-ee jaanhu maas kaat ee kai kichh  haath hai sabh  vasgat  hai har kayree. - who thinks that the power lies in the flesh or the scissors? Everything is in the Powerof the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਖ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਸਖ ਰਖੈ ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਲੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In just the same way, when someone slanders the Saint, the Lord preserves the honorof His servant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ti-o sant  janaa kee nar nind aa karahi har raakh ai paij jan kayree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਤੀ  ਤੀਸ ਬਤੀਸ  ਹੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਰਾਖੈ ਰਸਨਾ  ਮਾਸ ਰਤੁ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, let none think that they have any power. All act as the Lordcauses them to act.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee mat  ko-ee jaan hu kisee kai kichh  haath hai sabh  karay karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮਾਸ ਕਾਤੀ  ਕੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰੀ॥
lines.english: Old age, death, fever, poisons and snakes - everything is in the Hands of the Lord.Nothing can touch anyone without the Lord's Order. AYsw hir nwmu min iciq iniq iDAwvhu jn nwnk jo AMqI Aausir ley CfwieAw ]4]7]13]51] (168-9, gauVI bYrwgix, mÚ 4) aisaa har naam man chit nit  Dhi-aavahu jan naanak jo ant ee a-osar la-ay chh adaa-i- aa. ||4||7||13||51|| Within your conscious mind, O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Name of theLord, who shall deliver you in the end. ||4||7||13||51|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 4 ] (168-10) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 4. Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bYrwgix, mÚ 4) jaraa maraa taap sirat  saap sabh  har kai vas hai ko-ee laag na sakai bin har kaa laa-i- aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting Him, the mind is filled with bliss. He is called the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis mili-ai man ho-ay anand so satgur kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਿਕਸੀ  ਕੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Double-mindedness departs, and the supreme status of the Lord is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man kee dubiDh aa binas jaa-ay har param pad  lahee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਿਸਰਿਤ  ਸਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਿਗ  ਨ ਸਕੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: How can I meet my Beloved True Guru?
lines.transliteration: mayraa satgur pi-aaraa kit  biDh milai.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਿਨਿਤ  ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ  ਅਉਸਿਰ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥੫੧॥
lines.english: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him. How will I meet my Perfect Guru?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o khin kh in karee namaskaar mayraa gur pooraa ki-o milai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has led me to meet my Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har mayli-aa mayraa satgur pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਮਿਨ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The desire of His humble servant has been fulfilled. I have received the dust of theFeet of the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ichh punnee jan kayree-aa lay sat gur Dh ooraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਿਬਨਿਸ ਜਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who meet the True Guru implant devotional worship to the Lord, and listen to this devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  darirh-aavai har bh agat sunai tis satgur milee-ai.

lines.english: They never suffer any loss; they continually earn the profit of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: totaa mool na aavee har laabh  nit darirhee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਖਨੁਿਖਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਕਉ  ਿਮਲੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One whose heart blossoms forth, is not in love with duality.
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o ridai vigaas hai bh aa-o d oojaa naahee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, one is saved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.||4||8||14||52|| mhlw 4 gauVI pUrbI ] (168-16) mehlaa 4 ga-orhee poorbee. Fourth Mehl, Gauree Poorbee:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis gur mil uDh rai har gun  gaavaahee. ||4||8||14||52||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord God showered me with His Mercy; with mind and body and mouth, Ichant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har da-i-aal d a-i-aa parabh  keenee mayrai man t an mukh  har bolee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀਆ  ਲੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਧੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have been dyed in the deep and lasting color of the Lord's Love. The robe of my body is drenched with His Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rang bh a-i-aa at  goorh aa har rang bh eenee mayree cholee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁਣੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am the maid-servant of my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: apunay har parabh kee ha-o golee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਭੁ ਿਨਿਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: 4) jab ham har saytee man maani-aa kar d eeno jagat  sabh  gol amolee. ||1|| rahaa-o. When my mind surrendered to the Lord, He made all the world my slave. ||1||Pause||
Consider this well, O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny - search your own hearts, seek and find Him there.
lines.transliteration: karahu bibayk sant jan bh aa-ee kh oj hird ai daykh dhandholee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਉਧਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹੀ  ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪॥੫੨॥
lines.english: The Beauty and the Light of the Lord, Har, Har, is present in all. In all places, the Lord dwells near by, close at hand. ||2|| pMnw 169
lines.transliteration: har har roop sabh jot  sabaa-ee har nikat vasai har kolee. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, dwells close by, all over the world. He is Infinite, All-powerful and Immeasurable.
lines.transliteration: har har nikat vasai sabh jag kai aprampar purakh  atolee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਤੋਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has revealed the Lord, Har, Har, to me. I have sold my head to theGuru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har pargat kee-o gur poorai sir vaychi-o gur peh molee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਕੀਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਿਸਰੁ ਵੇਿਚਓ  ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, inside and outside, I am in the protection of Your Sanctuary; You are theGreatest of the Great, All-powerful Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jee antar baahar t um sarn aagat  tum vad purakh  vadolee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਵਡੋਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: 4) jan naanak an-din har gun  gaavai mil sat gur gur vaycholee. ||4||1||15||53|| Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, meeting the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary. ||4||1||15||53|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (169-4) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਗੁਰ ਵੇਚੋਲੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Life of the World, Infinite Lord and Master, Master of the Universe, All-powerful Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan aprampar su-aamee jagdeesur purakh  biDhaatay.

lines.english: Whichever way You turn me, O my Lord and Master, that is the way I shall go. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit maarag t um parayrhu su-aamee t it maarag ham jaat ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, my mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: raam mayraa man har saytee raat ay.

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the sublime essenceof the Lord. I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  mil raam ras paa-i-aa har raamai naam samaat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਮਾਰਿਗ ਤੁਮ ਪਰ੍ੇਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the panacea, the medicinefor the world. The Lord, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, bring peace andtranquility.
lines.transliteration: har har naam har har jag avkhaDh  har har naam har saat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who partake of the Lord's sublime essence, through the Guru's Teachings -their sins and sufferings are all eliminated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kay paap d okh sabh  binsay jo gurmat  raam ras kh aatay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads, bathe in thepool of contentment of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o likhat  likhay Dh ur mast ak tay gur sant okh sar naat ay.

lines.english: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, from those who are imbued withthe Love of the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: durmat  mail ga-ee sabh  tin kee jo raam naam rang raat ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਗ  ਅਵਖਧੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, You Yourself are Your Own Master, O God. There is no other Giver as Great as You.
lines.transliteration: raam tum aapay aap aap parabh  thaakur t um jayvad avar na d aatay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਿਭ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak lives by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; by the Lord's Mercy, hechants the Lord's Name. ||4||2||16||54|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (169-10) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam la-ay taaN jeevai har japee-ai har kirpaa t ay. ||4||2||16||54||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਲਖਤੁ  ਿਲਖੇ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਸਿਰ ਨਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Show Mercy to me, O Life of the World, O Great Giver, so that my mind may mergewith the Lord.
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa jagjeevan daat ay mayraa man har sayt ee raachay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru has bestowed His most pure and sacred Teachings. Chanting the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har, Har, my mind is transfixed and enraptured. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur bachan d ee-o at  nirmal jap har har har man maachay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੁਮ ਜੇਵਡ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, my mind and body have been pierced through by the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam mayraa man tan bayDh  lee-o har saachay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੫੪॥
lines.english: The whole world is caught and held in the mouth of Death. Through the Teachings ofthe Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I am saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pUrbI, mÚ 4) jih kaal kai mukh jagat  sabh  garsi-aa gur sat gur kai bachan har ham baachay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who are not in love with the Lord are foolish and false - they are faithlesscynics.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o pareet naahee har sayt ee tay saakat  moorh  nar kaachay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
lines.english: They suffer the most extreme agonies of birth and death; they die over and over again, and they rot away in manure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o janam maran  at bhaaree vich vistaa mar mar paachay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਚੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Merciful Cherisher of those who seek Your Sanctuary. I beg of You: pleasegrant me Your gift, Lord.
lines.transliteration: tum d a-i-aal saran  partipaalak mo ka-o d eejai d aan har ham jaachay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਬੇਿਧ ਲੀਓ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
lines.english: Make me the slave of the Lord's slaves, so that my mind might dance in Your Love.||3||
lines.transliteration: har kay daas d aas ham keejai man nirat  karay kar naachay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਕਾਲ  ਕੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਗਰ੍ਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਚੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Great Banker; God is our Lord and Master. I am His petty merchant.
lines.transliteration: aapay saah vaday parabh su-aamee ham van jaaray heh t aa chay.

lines.english: ||4||3||17||55|| My mind, body and soul are all Your capital assets. You, O God, are the True Bankerof servant Nanak. ||4||3||17||55|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (169-17) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) mayraa man tan jee-o raas sabh  tayree jan naanak kay saah parabh  saachay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂੜ ਨਰ ਕਾਚੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are Merciful, the Destroyer of all pain. Please give me Your Ear and listen to myprayer.
lines.transliteration: tum d a-i-aal sarab d ukh bhanjan ik bin-o sunhu d ay kaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮੁ  ਮਰਣੁ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਪਾਚੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please unite me with the True Guru, my breath of life; through Him, O my Lord andMaster, You are known. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis tay t um har jaanay su-aamee so sat gur mayl mayraa paraanay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਮ ਜਾਚੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, I acknowledge the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: raam ham satgur paarbarahm kar maanay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਨਾਚੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am foolish and ignorant, and my intellect is impure. Through the Teachings of theGuru, the True Guru, O Lord, I come to know You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) ham moorh mugaDh  asuDh  mat hotay gur sat gur kai bachan har ham jaanay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ਹਿਹ ਤਾ ਚੇ ॥
lines.english: All the pleasures and enjoyments which I have seen - I have found them all to be bland and insipid. pMnw 170
lines.transliteration: jitnay ras an ras ham d aykhay sabh  titnay feek feekaanay.

lines.english: I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by meeting the True Guru. It is sweet, like the juice of the sugarcane. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam amrit ras chaakh i-aa mil sat gur meeth  ras gaanay. ||2||
