lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਗਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who have not met the Guru, the True Guru, are foolish and insane - they arefaithless cynics.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o gur satgur nahee bh ayti-aa t ay saakat  moorh  divaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂੜ ਿਦਵਾਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who were pre-ordained to have no good karma at all - gazing into the lamp ofemotional attachment, they are burnt, like moths in a flame. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin kay karamheen Dh ur paa-ay d aykh deepak mohi pachaanay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਨ  ਧੁਿਰ ਪਾਏ ਦੇਿਖ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਪਚਾਨੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those whom You, in Your Mercy, have met, Lord, are committed to Your Service.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o tum d a-i-aa kar maylhu t ay har har sayv lagaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. He is famous, and through the Guru's Teachings, He merges in the Name. ||4||4||18||56|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (170-4) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) jan naanak har har har jap pargatay mat gurmat  naam samaanay. ||4||4||18||56||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਨੇ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੬॥
lines.english: O my mind, God is always with you; He is your Lord and Master. Tell me, where couldyou run to get away from the Lord?
lines.transliteration: mayray man so parabh sad aa naal hai su-aamee kaho kithai har pahu nasee-ai.

lines.english: The True Lord God Himself grants forgiveness; we are emancipated only when theLord Himself emancipates us. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har aapay bakhas la-ay parabh  saachaa har aap chh adaa-ay chh utee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਸਦਾ ਨਾਿਲ  ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਹੁ ਿਕਥੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਹੁ ਨਸੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har - chant it in your mind.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap har har har man japee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਛਡਾਏ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: 4) satgur kee sarn aa-ee bh aj pa-o mayray manaa gur sat gur peechh ai chh utee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o. Quickly now, run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my mind; following the Guru,the True Guru, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਜਪੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve God, the Giver of all peace; serving Him, you shall come to dwell inyour own home deep within.
lines.transliteration: mayray man sayvhu so parabh sarab sukh -daata jit sayvi-ai nij gh ar vasee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਿਜ ਪਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੀਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, go and enter your own home; anoint yourself with the sandalwood oil ofthe Lord's Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaa-ay lahhu gh ar apnaa gh as chand an har jas gh asee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: O my mind, the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are exalted and sublime. Earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and let your mind be happy.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har har har har har jas ootam lai laahaa har man hasee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰ੍ਬ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੇਿਵਐ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਸੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: If the Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy, bestows it, then we partake of the ambrosialessence of the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har aap da-i-aa kar d ayvai t aa amrit  har ras chakh ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਇ  ਲਹਹੁਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਘਿਸ  ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਘਸੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and attached to duality, thosefaithless cynics are strangled by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam binaa jo doojai laagay t ay saakat  nar jam gh utee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ  ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਹਸੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Such faithless cynics, who have forgotten the Naam, are thieves. O my mind, do noteven go near them. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tay saakat  chor jinaa naam visaari-aa man t in kai nikat na bh itee-ai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਖੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve the Unknowable and Immaculate Lord, the Man-lion; serving Him,your account will be cleared.
lines.transliteration: mayray man sayvhu alakh niranjan narhar jit  sayvi-ai laykh aa chh utee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ  ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰ ਜਿਮ ਘੁਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God has made servant Nanak perfect; he is not diminished by even thetiniest particle. ||5||5||19||57|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (170-13) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har parabh pooray kee-ay kh in maasaa t ol na gh atee-ai. ||5||5||19||57||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ  ਚੋਰ ਿਜਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਮਨ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਨ ਿਭਟੀਐ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: My breath of life is in Your Power, God; my soul and body are totally Yours.
lines.transliteration: hamray paraan vasgat parabh  tumrai mayraa jee-o pind sabh  tayree.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਲਖ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਨਰਹਿਰ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Be merciful to me, and show me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. There is such a great longing within my mind and body! ||1||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu har d aras d ikhaavhu mayrai man t an loch gh anayree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀਏ ਿਖਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ  ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਘਟੀਐ  ॥੫॥੫॥੧੯॥੫੭॥
lines.english: O my Lord, there is such a great longing within my mind and body to meet the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam mayrai man tan loch milan  har kayree.

lines.english: When the Guru, the Merciful Guru, showed just a little mercy to me, my Lord God came and met me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) gur kirpaal kirpaa kichant gur keenee har mili-aa aa-ay parabh  mayree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Whatever is in my conscious mind, O Lord and Master - that condition of mine isknown only to You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo hamrai man chit hai su-aamee saa biDh  tum har jaanhu mayree.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਿਦਖਾਵਹ ੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਲੋਚ ਘਣੇਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, I chant Your Name, and I find peace. I live by placing my hopes inYou, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din naam japee sukh  paa-ee nit  jeevaa aas har t ayree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਲੋਚ ਿਮਲਣ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, has shown me the Way; my Lord God came andmet me.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur d aatai panth bat aa-i-aa har mili-aa aa-ay parabh  mayree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਿਲ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕੰਚਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਆਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, I am filled with bliss; by great good fortune, all of the hopes of Hishumble servant have been fulfilled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din anad  bha-i-aa vadbh aagee sabh  aas pujee jan kayree. ||3||

lines.english: O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe, everything is under Your control.
lines.transliteration: jagannaath jagdeesur kart ay sabh  vasgat  hai har kayree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੈ  ਮਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਾ ਿਬਿਧ  ਤੁਮ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please, preserve the honor of Your humble servant. ||4||6||20||58|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (170-19) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sarnaagat  aa-ay har raakh o paij jan kayree. ||4||6||20||58||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ਿਨਤ  ਜੀਵਾ  ਆਸ  ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions. pMnw 171
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa khin na tikai baho rangee d ah dah dis chal chal haadh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆਿ ਖ ਨੁ ਨ ਿਟਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਚਿਲ  ਚਿਲ  ਹਾਢੇ ॥
lines.english: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-i-aa vadbhaagee har mant ar dee-aa man th aadhay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਦੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam ham satgur laalay kaaNdhay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: hamrai mastak d aag d agaanaa ham karaj guroo baho saadh ay.

lines.english: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherousand terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: par-upkaar punn baho kee-aa bha-o d utar taar paraadh ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਦਾਗੁ  ਦਗਾਨਾ  ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only falseintentions and goals.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o pareet rid ai har naahee t in kooray gaadh an gaadh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ੁਪੁੰਨੁਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਢੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o paanee kaagad  binas jaat  hai ti-o manmukh  garabh  galaadh ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਰਦੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਤਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ  ਗਾਢੇ  ॥
lines.english: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.
lines.transliteration: ham jaani-aa kachhoo na jaanah aagai ji-o har raakh ai ti-o thaadhay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਤ  ਹੈ ਿਤਉ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਗਰਿਭ  ਗਲਾਢੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Yourobedient dog. ||4||7||21||59|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (171-6) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ham bhool chook gur kirpaa Dh aarahu jan naanak kut ray kaadh ay. ||4||7||21||59||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ  ਆਗੈ  ਿਜਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਿਤਉ  ਠਾਢੇ ॥
lines.english: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which werebroken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh nagar baho bh ari-aa mil saaDh oo kh andal kh anda hay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁਤਰੇ  ਕਾਢੇ  ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
lines.english: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poorab likhat  likhay gur paa-i-aa man har liv mandal mandaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms presse d together; this is an act of great merit.
lines.transliteration: kar saaDhoo anjulee punn vadaa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰੋਿਧ  ਨਗਰੁਬਹੁ ਭਿਰਆ  ਿਮਿਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ  ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar dand-ut pun vadaa hay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਖਤ  ਿਲਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਮੰਡਲ  ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.
lines.transliteration: saakat har ras saad  na jaani-aa t in ant ar ha-umai kandaa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ  ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o chaleh chubhai d ukh paavahi jamkaal saheh sir dandaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Thepain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: har jan har har naam samaanay d ukh janam maran  bhav kh anda hay.

lines.english: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God,and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee purakh  paa-i-aa parmaysar baho sobh  khand barahmandaa hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਿਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest ofthe Great!
lines.transliteration: ham gareeb maskeen parabh t ayray har raakh  raakh  vad vadaa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਿਜਉ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਸਹਿਹ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (171-12) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam aDhaar tayk hai har naamay hee sukh  mandaa hay. ||4||8||22||60||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn onesdo not find the taste.
lines.transliteration: is garh meh har raam raa-ay hai kichh  saad  na paavai Dh eethaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it,through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har deen d a-i-aal anoograhu kee-aa har gur sabd ee chakh  deeth aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ  ਮਸਕੀਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam har keertan gur liv meeth aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who arecommitted to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar paarbarahm hai mil satgur laag baseeth aa.

lines.english: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence isrevealed to them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin gur bachan sukhaanay hee-arai t in aagai aan  pareeth aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਹੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਧੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings aredark.
lines.transliteration: manmukh hee-araa at  kathor hai t in ant ar kaar kareeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਿਲ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਚਿਖ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison.||3||
lines.transliteration: bisee-ar ka-o baho dooDh  pee-aa-ee-ai bikh  niksai fol futh eelaa. ||3||

lines.english: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eatthe Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har parabh aan milaavhu gur saaDh oo gh as garurh  sabad  mukh  leeth aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, thebitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (171-18) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur kay laalay golay lag sangat karoo-aa meeth aa. ||4||9||23||61||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹੈ ਿਮਿਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਬਸੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: har har arath sareer ham baychi-aa pooray gur kai aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ  ਸੁਖਾਨੇ  ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਿਤਨ  ਆਗੈ  ਆਿਣ  ਪਰੀਠਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur d aatai naam d irhaa-i-aa mukh  mast ak bh aag sabh aagay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਹੀਅਰਾ ਅਿਤ  ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਨ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 172
lines.transliteration: raam gurmat har liv laagay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rama-ee-aa ramat  raam raa-ay gur sabad  guroo liv laagay.

lines.english: ||2|| Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachingshave dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o man tan d ayva-o kaat guroo ka-o mayraa bh aram bh a-o gur bachnee bh aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਮਈਆ  ਰਮਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focusedon the Lord.
lines.transliteration: anDhi-aarai d eepak aan jalaa-ay gur gi-aan guroo liv laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਭਾਗੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened;within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayraa binas binaasi-o gh ar vasat  lahee man jaagay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਧਆਰੈ  ਦੀਪਕ  ਆਿਨ ਜਲਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: saakat baDh ik maa-i-aaDh aaree t in jam johan laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਿਬਨਾਿਸਓ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਲਹੀ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: un satgur aagai sees na baychi-aa o-ay aavahi jaahi abh aagay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਬਿਧਕ  ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਮ ਜੋਹਿਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: hamraa bin-o sunhu parabh th aakur ham saran  parabh oo har maagay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਗੈ  ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਿਚਆ ਓਇ ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਅਭਾਗੇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: 4) jan naanak kee laj paat guroo hai sir baychi-o sat gur aagay. ||5||10||24||62|| Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (172-6) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਿਬਨਉ  ਸੁਨਹੁਪਰ੍ਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਮ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, myselfishness and conceit have been abolished.
lines.transliteration: ham ahaNkaaree ahaNkaar agi-aan mat gur mili-ai aap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਲਜ ਪਾਿਤ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਿਸਰੁ ਬੇਿਚਓ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਗੇ  ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
lines.english: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog ga-i-aa sukh paa-i-aa Dh an Dh an guroo har raa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam gur kai bachan har paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਮਿਤ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me thepath and the way to find Him.
lines.transliteration: mayrai hee-arai pareet raam raa-ay kee gur maarag panth bat aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਧਨੁਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayraa jee-o pind sabh sat gur aagai jin vichh urhi-aa har gal laa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Himwithin my heart.
lines.transliteration: mayrai antar pareet  lagee d aykhan ka-o gur hird ay naal d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru.||3||
lines.transliteration: sahj anand bha-i-aa man morai gur aagai aap vaychaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਕੀ ਗੁਿਰ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.
lines.transliteration: ham apraaDh paap baho keenay kar d ustee chor churaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਗੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ ਹਿਰ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: 4) ab naanak sarnaagat  aa-ay har raakh o laaj har bh aa-i-aa. ||4||11||25||63|| Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 ] (172-13) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4. Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਦੇਖਨ  ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੇ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru'sTeachings, the mind sings.
lines.transliteration: gurmat baajai sabad  anaahad  gurmat  manoo-aa gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਮੋਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਵੇਚਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed,blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur d arsan paa-i-aa Dh an Dh an guroo liv laavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ  ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਿਰ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har liv laavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ  ਆਏ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: hamraa thaakur sat gur pooraa man gur kee kaar kamaavai.

lines.english: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham mal mal Dhovah paav guroo kay jo har har kathaa sunaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਨਾਹਦੁ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: hirdai gurmat  raam rasaa-in  jihvaa har gun  gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਧਨੁਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with theLord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man rasak rasak har ras aaghaanay fir bahur na bh ookh lagaavai. ||3||

lines.english: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee karai upaav anayk bahutayray bin kirpaa naam na paavai.

lines.english: 4) jan naanak ka-o har kirpaa Dhaaree mat  gurmat  naam d arirhaavai. ||4||12||26||64|| The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord.||4||12||26||64|| rwgu gauVI mwJ mhlw 4 ] (172-18) raag ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 4. Raag Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jind oo jap naam karammaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੋਵਹ  ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.
lines.transliteration: mat maat aa mat  jee-o naam mukh  raamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ  ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation. pMnw 173
lines.transliteration: santokh  pitaa kar gur purakh  ajnamaa.

lines.english: By great good fortune, you shall meet with the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee mil raamaa. ||1||

lines.english: I have met the Guru, the Yogi, the Primal Being; I am delighted with His Love.
lines.transliteration: gur jogee purakh mili-aa rang maan ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is imbued with the Love of the Lord; He dwells forever in Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: gur har rang rat-rh aa sad aa nirbaan ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੜਾ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I met the most accomplished and all-knowing Lord.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee mil sugh arh sujaan ee jee-o.

lines.english: My mind and body are drenched in the Love of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayraa man tan har rang bh innaa. ||2||

lines.english: Come, O Saints - let's meet together and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavhu santahu mil naam japaahaa.

lines.english: In the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, let's earn the lasting profit of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: vich sangat naam sad aa lai laahaa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Let's serve the Saints, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa santaa amrit  mukh  paahaa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਹਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By one's karma and pre-ordained destiny, they are met. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mil poorab likhi-arh ay Dh ur karmaa. ||3||

lines.english: In the month of Saawan, the clouds of Ambrosial Nectar hang over the world.
lines.transliteration: saavan varas amrit  jag chh aa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਿਣ  ਵਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The peacock of the mind chirps, and receives the Word of the Shabad, in its mouth;
lines.transliteration: man mor kuhuki-arhaa sabad  mukh  paa-i-aa.
har amrit vuth -rhaa mili-aa har raa-i-aa jee-o. the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord rains down, and the Sovereign Lord King is met.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||1||27||65|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 4 ] (173-6) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 4. Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak paraym ratannaa. ||4||1||27||65||

lines.english: Come, O sisters - let's make virtue our charms.
lines.transliteration: aa-o sakhee gun  kaaman  kareehaa jee-o.

lines.english: Let's join the Saints, and enjoy the pleasure of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: mil sant janaa rang maan ih ralee-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਉ  ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ  ਕਰੀਹਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burns steadily in my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur deepak gi-aan sad aa man balee-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਿਣਹ  ਰਲੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, being pleased and moved by pity, has led me to meet Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har tuth ai dhul dhul milee-aa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਬਲੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Darling Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan paraym lagaa har dh olay jee-o.

lines.english: The True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, has united me with my Friend.
lines.transliteration: mai maylay mitar sat gur vaycholay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I offer my mind to the Guru, who has led me to meet my God.
lines.transliteration: man dayvaaN santaa mayraa parabh  maylay jee-o.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har vitrhi-ahu sad aa gh olay jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁਦੇਵ ਸੰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dwell, O my Beloved, dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, show mercy to me and come to dwell within my mind.
lines.transliteration: vas mayray pi-aari-aa vas mayray govidaa har kar kirpaa man vas jee-o.

lines.english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; I amtransfixed with ecstasy, gazing upon the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: man chindi-arh aa fal paa-i-aa mayray govind aa gur pooraa vaykh  vigas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day, their minds are blissful and happy.
lines.transliteration: har naam mili-aa sohaaganee mayray govind aa man an-d in anad  rahas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਸੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the Lord is found, O my Lord of the Universe; earning profitcontinually, the mind laughs with joy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har paa-i-arhaa vadbh aagee-ee mayray govind aa nit  lai laahaa man has jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਮਿਨ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ  ਰਹਸੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself creates, and the Lord Himself beholds; the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: har aap upaa-ay har aapay vaykhai har aapay kaarai laa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਿਨਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ਮਿਨ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Some partake of the bounty of the Lord's favor, which never runs out, while othersreceive only a handful.
lines.transliteration: ik khaaveh bakh as tot na aavai iknaa fakaa paa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Some sit upon thrones as kings, and enjoy constant pleasures, while others must begfor charity.
lines.transliteration: ik raajay takh at baheh nit  sukh ee-ay iknaa bh ikh mangaa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਖਾਵਿਹ  ਬਖਸ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||2||28||66|| The Word of the Shabad is pervading in everyone, O my Lord of the Universe; servantNanak meditates on the Naam. ||4||2||28||66|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 4 ] (173-16) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 4. Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mwJ, mÚ 4) sabh iko sabad  varatd aa mayray govid aa jan naanak naam Dh i-aa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰਾਜੇ ਤਖਿਤ  ਬਹਿਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਿਭਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: From within my mind, from within my mind, O my Lord of the Universe, I am imbuedwith the Love of the Lord, from within my mind.
lines.transliteration: man maahee man maahee mayray govindaa har rang rat aa man maahee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
lines.english: The Lord's Love is with me, but it cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru has led me to see the unseen.
lines.transliteration: har rang naal na lakhee-ai mayray govid aa gur pooraa alakh  lakhaahee jee-o.

lines.english: He has revealed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Lord of the Universe; all poverty and pain have departed.
lines.transliteration: har har naam pargaasi-aa mayray govindaa sabh  daalad  dukh leh jaahee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the supreme status of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; by great good fortune, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har pad oot am paa-i-aa mayray govind aa vadbh aagee naam samaahee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: With his eyes, O my Beloved, with his eyes, O my Lord of the Universe - has anyoneever seen the Lord God with his eyes?
lines.transliteration: nainee mayray pi-aari-aa nain ee mayray govid aa kinai har parabh  dith-rhaa nain ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ  ਦੁਖ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are sad and depressed, O my Lord of the Universe; without herHusband Lord, the soul-bride is withering away. pMnw 174
lines.transliteration: mayraa man tan bahut  bairaagi-aa mayray govind aa har baajh ahu Dh an kumlain ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਿਗਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Saints, O my Lord of the Universe, I have found my Lord God, my Companion, my Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil paa-i-aa mayray govid aa mayraa har parabh  sajan  sainee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Life of the World, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. The night of my life now passes in peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har aa-ay mili-aa jagjeevan mayray govindaa mai sukh  vihaan ee rain ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਇ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਮੈ ਸੁਿਖ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Best Friend; my mind and body are hungryfor Him.
lines.transliteration: mai maylhu sant mayraa har parabh  sajan  mai man t an bh ukh lagaa-ee-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved; deep within, I feel the pain of separationfrom the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o reh na saka-o bin daykh ay mayray pareet am mai ant ar birahu har laa-ee-aa jee- o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਬਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਈਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Sovereign Lord King is my Beloved, my Best Friend. Through the Guru, I have met Him, and my mind has been rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: har raa-i-aa mayraa sajan pi-aaraa gur maylay mayraa man jeevaa-ee-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: 4) mayrai man tan aasaa pooree-aa mayray govind aa har mili-aa man vaaDh aa-ee-aa jee-o. ||3|| The hopes of my mind and body have been fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe;meeting the Lord, my mind vibrates with joy. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਆਸਾ  ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਮਿਨ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved; I am forever asacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: vaaree mayray govindaa vaaree mayray pi-aari-aa ha-o t uDh vitrhi-ahu sad  vaaree jee-o.

lines.english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord; O my Lord of theUniverse, please preserve my assets.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan paraym piramm kaa mayray govid aa har poonjee raakh  hamaaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਵਟਿੜਅਹ ੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through Hisguidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur visat mayl mayray govind aa har maylay kar raibaaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਿਪਰੰਮ  ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||3||29||67|| I have obtained the Lord's Name, by Your Mercy, O my Lord of the Universe; servantNanak has entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||29||67|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 4 ] (174-9) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 4. Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gauVI mwJ, mÚ 4) har naam da-i-aa kar paa-i-aa mayray govind aa jan naanak saran  tumaaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁਿਵਸਟੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਿਰ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Playful is my Lord of the Universe; playful is my Beloved. My Lord God is wondrous and playful.
lines.transliteration: chojee mayray govindaa chojee mayray pi-aari-aa har parabh  mayraa chojee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is themilkmaids who seek Him.
lines.transliteration: har aapay kaanH upaa-idaa mayray govid aa har aapay gopee kh ojee jee-o.

lines.english: The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is theRavisher and the Enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: har aapay sabh gh at bhogdaa mayray govind aa aapay rasee-aa bh ogee jee-o.

lines.english: The Lord is All-knowing - He cannot be fooled, O my Lord of the Universe. He is the True Guru, the Yogi. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har sujaan na bh ul-ee mayray govind aa aapay sat gur jogee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways!
lines.transliteration: aapay jagat upaa-id aa mayray govid aa har aap kh aylai baho rangee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਨ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਗੋਪੀ  ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Some enjoy enjoyments, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander aroundnaked, the poorest of the poor.
lines.transliteration: iknaa bhog bh ogaa-id aa mayray govind aa ik nagan fireh nang nangee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਸੀਆ  ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who beg for them.
lines.transliteration: aapay jagat upaa-id aa mayray govid aa har d aan d ayvai sabh  mangee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਭੁਲਈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: ||2|| His devotees have the Support of the Naam, O my Lord of the Universe; they beg forthe sublime sermon of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa naam aaDh aar hai mayray govind aa har kathaa mangeh har changee jee-o.

lines.english: The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfills the desires of the minds of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: har aapay bhagat  karaa-id aa mayray govind aa har bh agtaa loch man pooree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is permeating and pervading the waters and the lands, O my Lord of theUniverse; He is All-pervading - He is not far away.
lines.transliteration: aapay jal thal varatdaa mayray govid aa rav rahi-aa nahee d ooree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਇਿਕ  ਨਗਨ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is within the self, and outside as well, O my Lord of the Universe;the Lord Himself is fully pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: har antar baahar aap hai mayray govid aa har aap rahi-aa bh arpooree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is diffused everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe. TheLord Himself beholds all; His Immanent Presence is pervading everywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har aatam raam pasaari-aa mayray govind aa har vaykh ai aap had ooree jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਚੰਗੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, the music of the praanic wind is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; asthe Lord Himself plays this music, so does it vibrate and resound.
lines.transliteration: har antar vaajaa pa-un  hai mayray govind aa har aap vajaa-ay t i-o vaajai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਲੋਚ ਮਿਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, the treasure of the Naam is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord God is revealed.
lines.transliteration: har antar naam niDh aan hai mayray govind aa gur sabd ee har parabh  gaajai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵਦਾ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself leads us to enter His Sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord preserves the honor of His devotees. pMnw 175
lines.transliteration: aapay saran pavaa-id aa mayray govind aa har bh agat janaa raakh  laajai jee-o.

lines.english: ||4||4||30||68|| By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of theUniverse; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved.||4||4||30||68|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 4 ] (175-2) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 4. Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) vadbhaagee mil sangt ee mayray govind aa jan naanak naam siDh  kaajai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਮਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਸਿਧ  ਕਾਜੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
lines.english: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.
lines.transliteration: mai har naamai har birahu lagaa-ee jee-o.

lines.english: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: mayraa har parabh mit  milai sukh  paa-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: har parabh d aykh jeevaa mayree maa-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayraa naam sakhaa har bh aa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਜੀਵਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavhu sant  jee-o mayray har parabh  kayray jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.
lines.transliteration: jap gurmukh naam jee-o bh aag vadayray jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jee-o paraan har mayray jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ  ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: fir bahurh na bh avjal fayray jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.
lines.transliteration: ki-o har parabh vaykh aa mayrai man t an chaa-o jee-o.

lines.english: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.
lines.transliteration: har maylhu sant jee-o man lagaa bh aa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਵੇਖਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, myBeloved.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee paa-ee-ai har pareet am raa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ  ਮਿਨ ਲਗਾ  ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee jap naa-o jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan vadrh ee govind  parabh  aasaa jee-o.

lines.english: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.
lines.transliteration: har maylhu sant jee-o govid  parabh  paasaa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਵਡੜੀ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;
lines.transliteration: satgur mat  naam sad aa pargaasaa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ  ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak poori-arhee man aasaa jee-o. ||4||5||31||69|| the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 4 ] (175-9) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 4.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.
lines.transliteration: mayraa birhee naam milai taa jeevaa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਿਰਅੜੀ  ਮਿਨ ਆਸਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
lines.english: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.
lines.transliteration: man andar amrit  gurmat  har leevaa jee-o.

lines.english: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublimeessence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man har rang rat-rh aa har ras sad aa peevaa jee-o.

lines.english: I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har paa-i-arhaa man jeevaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਲੀਵਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan paraym lagaa har baan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: mayraa pareetam mit ar har purakh  sujaan  jee-o.

lines.english: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur maylay sant har sugh arh sujaan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਬਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o naam vitahu kurbaan jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: ha-o har har sajan har meet  dasaa-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Show me the way to the Lord, Dear Saints; I am searching all over for Him.
lines.transliteration: har dashu sant ahu jee har kh oj pavaa-ee jee-o.

lines.english: The Kind and Compassionate True Guru has shown me the Way, and I have found the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur t uth-rhaa dasay har paa-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Name of the Lord, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har naamay naam samaa-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਸਹੁਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am consumed with the pain of separation from the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai vaydan paraym har birahu lagaa-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ  ਦਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has fulfilled my desire, and I have received the Ambrosial Nectar in mymouth.
lines.transliteration: gur sarDhaa poor amrit  mukh  paa-ee jee-o.

lines.english: The Lord has become merciful, and now I meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har hohu da-i-aal har naam Dh i-aa-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||6||20||18||32||70|| mhlw 5 rwgu gauVI guAwryrI caupdy  (175-17) mehlaa 5 raag ga-orhee gu-aarayree cha-upd ay Fifth Mehl, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (175-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har ras paa-ee jee-o. ||4||6||20||18||32||70||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: How can happiness be found, O my Siblings of Destiny?
lines.transliteration: kin biDh kusal hot  mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ki-o paa-ee-ai har raam sahaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There is no happiness in owning one's own home, in all of Maya,
lines.transliteration: kusal na garihi mayree sabh maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: oochay mandar sund ar chh aa-i-aa. or in lofty mansions casting beautiful shadows.

lines.english: In fraud and greed, this human life is being wasted. ||1|| pMnw 176
lines.transliteration: jhooth ay laalach janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: He is pleased at the sight of his elephants and horses
lines.transliteration: hastee gh orhay daykh vigaasaa.
laskar jorhay nayb kh avaasaa. and his armies assembled, his servants and his soldiers.

lines.english: But the noose of egotism is tightening around his neck. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gal jayvrhee ha-umai kay faasaa. ||2||

lines.english: His rule may extend in all ten directions;
lines.transliteration: raaj kamaavai dah d is saaree.
maanai rang bh og baho naaree. he may revel in pleasures, and enjoy many women
ji-o narpat supnai bh aykhaaree. ||3|| - but he is just a beggar, who in his dream, is a king. ||3||

lines.english: The True Guru has shown me that there is only one pleasure.
lines.transliteration: ayk kusal mo ka-o satguroo bat aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਬਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord does, is pleasing to the Lord's devotee.
lines.transliteration: har jo kichh karay so har ki-aa bh agtaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਆ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has abolished his ego, and he is absorbed in the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ha-umai maar samaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: This is the way to find happiness, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: in biDh kusal hot  mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: This is the way to find the Lord, our Help and Support. ||1||Second Pause|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (176-5) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: i-o paa-ee-ai har raam sahaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o doojaa.

lines.english: Why do you doubt? What do you doubt?
lines.transliteration: ki-o bharmee-ai bh aram kis kaa ho-ee.

lines.english: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: jaa jal thal mahee-al ravi-aa so-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ubray manmukh  pat kho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: One who is protected by the Merciful Lord
lines.transliteration: jis raakhai aap raam d a-i-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis nahee d oojaa ko pahuchanhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. - no one else can rival him. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The Infinite One is pervading among all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vart ai ayk anant aa.

lines.english: So sleep in peace, and don't worry.
lines.transliteration: taa tooN sukh  so-o ho-ay achint aa.

lines.english: He knows everything which happens. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oh sabh kichh  jaanai jo vart antaa. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are dying in the thirst of duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mu-ay jin d oojee pi-aasaa.

lines.english: They wander lost through countless incarnations; this is their pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: baho jonee bhaveh Dh ur kirat  likhi-aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਿਖ ਸੋਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਿਚੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: As they plant, so shall they harvest. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejeh taisaa kh aasaa. ||3||

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind has blossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: daykh  daras man bh a-i-aa vigaasaa.

lines.english: And now everywhere I look, God is revealed to me.
lines.transliteration: sabh nad ree aa-i-aa barahm pargaasaa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak's hopes have been fulfilled by the Lord. ||4||2||71|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (176-10) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kee har pooran aasaa. ||4||2||71||

lines.english: In so many incarnations, you were a worm and an insect;
lines.transliteration: ka-ee janam bha-ay keet pat angaa.
ka-ee janam gaj meen kurangaa. in so many incarnations, you were an elephant, a fish and a deer.

lines.english: In so many incarnations, you were a bird and a snake.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee janam pankhee sarap ho-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
lines.english: In so many incarnations, you were yoked as an ox and a horse. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ka-ee janam haivar barikh jo-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: Meet the Lord of the Universe - now is the time to meet Him.
lines.transliteration: mil jagdees milan kee baree-aa.

lines.english: After so very long, this human body was fashioned for you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chirankaal ih dayh sanjaree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In so many incarnations, you were rocks and mountains;
lines.transliteration: ka-ee janam sail gir kari-aa.
ka-ee janam garabh hir kh ari-aa. in so many incarnations, you were aborted in the womb;
ka-ee janam saakh kar upaa-i-aa. in so many incarnations, you developed branches and leaves;
lakh cha-oraaseeh jon bh armaa-i-aa. ||2|| you wandered through 8.4 million incarnations. ||2||

lines.english: Through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you obtained this human life.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh a-i-o janam paraapat .

lines.english: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa bhaj har har gurmat .

lines.english: Abandon pride, falsehood and arrogance.
lines.transliteration: ti-aag maan jh ooth abhimaan.

lines.english: Remain dead while yet alive, and you shall be welcomed in the Court of the Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: jeevat mareh d argeh parvaan. ||3||

lines.english: Whatever has been, and whatever shall be, comes from You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh ho-aa so t ujh tay hog.

lines.english: No one else can do anything at all.
lines.transliteration: avar na doojaa karn ai jog.

lines.english: We are united with You, when You unite us with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: taa milee-ai jaa laihi milaa-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||72|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (176-17) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har har gun gaa-ay. ||4||3||72||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: In the field of karma, plant the seed of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: karam bhoom meh bo-ahu naam.

lines.english: Your works shall be brought to fruition.
lines.transliteration: pooran ho-ay tumaaraa kaam.

lines.english: You shall obtain these fruits, and the fear of death shall be dispelled.
lines.transliteration: fal paavahi mitai jam taraas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nit gaavahi har har gun  jaas. ||1||

lines.english: Keep the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, enshrined in your heart,
lines.transliteration: har har naam antar ur Dh aar.
seeghar kaaraj layho savaar. ||1|| rahaa-o. and your affairs shall be quickly resolved. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
lines.english: Be always attentive to your God;
lines.transliteration: apnay parabh si-o hohu saavDh aan.
taa tooN dargeh paavahi maan. thus you shall be honored in His Court. pMnw 177

lines.english: Give up all your clever tricks and devices,
lines.transliteration: ukat si-aan ap saglee t i-aag.
sant janaa kee charn ee laag. ||2|| and hold tight to the Feet of the Saints. ||2||

lines.english: The One, who holds all creatures in His Hands,
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-a heh jaa kai haath.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਅ  ਹਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaday na vichh urhai sabh  kai saath. is never separated from them; He is with them all.

lines.english: Abandon your clever devices, and grasp hold of His Support.
lines.transliteration: upaav chhod gahu t is kee ot.

lines.english: In an instant, you shall be saved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nimakh maahi hovai t ayree chh ot. ||3||

lines.english: Know that He is always near at hand.
lines.transliteration: sadaa nikat kar t is no jaan .

lines.english: Accept the Order of God as True.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee aagi-aa sat  kar maan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, eradicate selfishness and conceit.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mitaavhu aap.

lines.english: O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.||4||4||73|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (177-4) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har naam naanak jap jaap. ||4||4||73||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਿਪ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word is eternal and everlasting.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan sadaa abh inaasee.

lines.english: The Guru's Word cuts away the noose of Death.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan katee jam faasee.

lines.english: The Guru's Word is always with the soul.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan jee-a kai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan rachai raam kai rang. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Guru gives, is useful to the mind.
lines.transliteration: jo gur dee-aa so man kai kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever the Saint does - accept that as True. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant kaa kee-aa sat  kar maan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word is infallible and unchanging.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan atal achhayd .

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan katay bharam bh ayd.

lines.english: The Guru's Word never goes away;
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan katahu na jaa-ay.
gur kai bachan har kay gun gaa-ay. ||2|| through the Guru's Word, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਕਟੇ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word accompanies the soul.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan jee-a kai saath.

lines.english: The Guru's Word is the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan anaath ko naath.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word saves one from falling into hell.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan narak na pavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savors the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan rasnaa amrit ravai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ  ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word is revealed in the world.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan pargat sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, no one suffers defeat.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan na aavai haar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Guru is always kind and compassionate, unto those whom the LordHimself has blessed with His Mercy. ||4||5||74|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (177-10) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis jan ho-ay aap kirpaal. naanak satgur sad aa da-i-aal. ||4||5||74||

lines.english: He makes jewels out of the dust,
lines.transliteration: jin keetaa maatee t ay rat an.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: garabh meh raakh i-aa jin kar jat an. and He managed to preserve you in the womb.

lines.english: He has given you fame and greatness;
lines.transliteration: jin deenee sobh aa vadi-aa-ee.
tis parabh  ka-o aath  pahar Dh i-aa-ee. ||1|| meditate on that God, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, I seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: rama-ee-aa rayn saaDh jan paava-o.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur mil apunaa khasam Dh i-aava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He transformed me, the fool, into a fine speaker,
lines.transliteration: jin keetaa moorh  tay bakt aa.
jin keetaa baysurat  tay surt aa. and He made the unconscious become conscious;
jis parsaad navai niDh  paa-ee. by His Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures.

lines.english: May I never forget that God from my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so parabh man t ay bisrat  naahee. ||2||

lines.english: He has given a home to the homeless;
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa nithaavay ka-o thaan.

lines.english: He has given honor to the dishonored.
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa nimaanay ka-o maan.

lines.english: He has fulfilled all desires;
lines.transliteration: jin keenee sabh pooran aasaa.
simra-o din rain saas giraasaa. ||3|| remember Him in meditation, day and night, with every breath and every morsel of food. ||3||

lines.english: By His Grace, the bonds of Maya are cut away.
lines.transliteration: jis parsaad maa-i-aa silak kaatee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the bitter poison has become Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad amrit  bikh khaatee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I cannot do anything;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak is tay kichh  naahee.

lines.english: I praise the Lord, the Protector. ||4||6||75|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (177-17) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaaray ka-o saalaahee. ||4||6||75||

lines.english: In His Sanctuary, there is no fear or sorrow.
lines.transliteration: tis kee saran  naahee bh a-o sog.

lines.english: Without Him, nothing at all can be done.
lines.transliteration: us tay baahar kachh oo na hog.

lines.english: I have renounced clever tricks, power and intellectual corruption.
lines.transliteration: tajee si-aan ap bal buDh  bikaar.

lines.english: God is the Protector of His servant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daas apnay kee raakh anhaar. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.
lines.transliteration: jap man mayray raam raam rang.

lines.english: Within your home, and beyond it, He is always with you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar t ayrai sad  sang. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Keep His Support in your mind. pMnw 178
lines.transliteration: tis kee tayk manai meh raakh .

lines.english: Taste the ambrosial essence, the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit  ras chaakh .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Of what use are other efforts?
lines.transliteration: avar jatan kahhu ka-un kaaj.

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself protects our honor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakhai aap laaj. ||2||

lines.english: What is the human? What power does he have?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa maanukh kahhu ki-aa jor.

lines.english: All the tumult of Maya is false.
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa maa-i-aa kaa sabh  sor.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master is the One who acts, and causes others to act.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar su-aamee.

lines.english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa kay ant arjaamee. ||3||

lines.english: Of all comforts, this is the true comfort.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh  saachaa ayhu.

lines.english: Keep the Guru's Teachings in your mind.
lines.transliteration: gur updays manai meh layho.

lines.english: Those who bear love for the Name of the Lord
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o raam naam liv laagee.

lines.english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak so Dhan vadbh aagee. ||4||7||76|| - says Nanak, they are blessed, and very fortunate. ||4||7||76|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (178-4) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Listening to the Lord's sermon, my pollution has been washed away.
lines.transliteration: sun har kathaa ut aaree mail.

lines.english: I have become totally pure, and I now walk in peace.
lines.transliteration: mahaa puneet bh a-ay sukh  sail.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag paa-i-aa saaDh sang.

lines.english: I have fallen in love with the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm si-o laago rang. ||1||

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His servant has been carried across.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japat jan t aari-o.

lines.english: The Guru has lifted me up and carried me across the ocean of fire. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: agan saagar gur paar utaari-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਜਨੁ ਤਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Kirtan of His Praises, my mind has become peaceful;
lines.transliteration: kar keertan man seet al bha-ay.
janam janam kay kilvikh ga-ay. the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away.

lines.english: I have seen all the treasures within my own mind;
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan paykh ay man maahi.
ab dhoodh an kaahay ka-o jaahi. ||2|| why should I now go out searching for them? ||2||

lines.english: When God Himself becomes merciful,
lines.transliteration: parabh apunay jab bh a-ay d a-i-aal.
pooran ho-ee sayvak ghaal. the work of His servant becomes perfect.

lines.english: He has cut away my bonds, and made me His slave.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaat kee-ay apnay d aas.

lines.english: Remember, remember, remember Him in meditation; He is the treasure of excellence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar guntaas. ||3||

lines.english: He alone is in the mind; He alone is everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ayko man ayko sabh th aa-ay.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o sabh jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled all doubts.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai sabh bh aram chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak has found peace. ||4||8||77|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (178-10) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har simrat naanak sukh  paa-i-aa. ||4||8||77||

lines.english: Those who have died have been forgotten.
lines.transliteration: aglay mu-ay se paachhai paray.

lines.english: Those who survive have fastened their belts.
lines.transliteration: jo ubray say banDh lak kh aray.

lines.english: They are busily occupied in their affairs;
lines.transliteration: jih DhanDh ay meh o-ay laptaa-ay.
un tay d ugun dirhee un maa-ay. ||1|| they cling twice as hard to Maya. ||1||

lines.english: No one thinks of the time of death;
lines.transliteration: oh baylaa kachh cheet  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸੇ ਬੰਿਧ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: binas jaa-ay taahoo laptaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o. people grasp to hold that which shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The fools - their bodies are bound down by desires.
lines.transliteration: aasaa banDhee moorakh  dayh.

lines.english: They are mired in sexual desire, anger and attachment;
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lapti-o asnayh.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ  ਕਛੁ ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sir oopar thaadh o Dharam raa-ay. the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands over their heads.

lines.english: Believing it to be sweet, the fools eat poison. ||2||
lines.transliteration: meethee kar kar bikh i-aa kh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: They say, "I shall tie up my enemy, and I shall cut him down. Who dares to set foot upon my land?
lines.transliteration: ha-o banDha-o ha-o saaDh a-o bair. hamree bh oom ka-un  ghaalai pair.

lines.english: I am learned, I am clever and wise."
lines.transliteration: ha-o pandit ha-o chat ur si-aan aa.

lines.english: The ignorant ones do not recognize their Creator. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karnaihaar na bujh ai bigaanaa. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord Himself knows His Own state and condition.
lines.transliteration: apunee gat mit  aapay jaanai.

lines.english: What can anyone say? How can anyone describe Him?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ko kahai ki-aa aakh vakh aanai.

lines.english: Whatever He attaches us to - to that we are attached.
lines.transliteration: jit jit laaveh t it tit lagnaa.

lines.english: Everyone begs for their own good. ||4||
lines.transliteration: apnaa bhalaa sabh  kaahoo mangnaa. ||4||

lines.english: Everything is Yours; You are the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tayraa t ooN karnaihaar.

lines.english: You have no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: ant naahee kichh  paaraavaar.

lines.english: Please give this gift to Your servant,
lines.transliteration: daas apnay ka-o d eejai d aan.

lines.english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kabhoo na visrai naanak naam. ||5||9||78|| that Nanak might never forget the Naam. ||5||9||78|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (178-18) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5.

lines.english: By all sorts of efforts, people do not find salvation.
lines.transliteration: anik jatan nahee hot  chhutaaraa.

lines.english: Through clever tricks, the weight is only piled on more and more.
lines.transliteration: bahut si-aan ap aagal bh aaraa.

lines.english: Serving the Lord with a pure heart,
lines.transliteration: har kee sayvaa nirmal hayt.
parabh kee d argeh sobh aa sayt . ||1|| you shall be received with honor at God's Court. ||1|| pMnw 179

lines.english: O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man mayray gahu har naam kaa olaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The hot winds shall never even touch you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tujhai na laagai t aataa jholaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Like a boat in the ocean of fear;
lines.transliteration: ji-o bohith bhai saagar maahi.
anDhkaar d eepak d eepaahi. like a lamp which illumines the darkness;
agan seet kaa laahas d ookh. like fire which takes away the pain of cold
naam japat man hovat  sookh . ||2|| - just so, chanting the Name, the mind becomes peaceful. ||2||

lines.english: The thirst of your mind shall be quenched,
lines.transliteration: utar jaa-ay t ayray man kee pi-aas.
pooran hovai saglee aas. and all hopes shall be fulfilled.

lines.english: Your consciousness shall not waver.
lines.transliteration: dolai naahee tumraa cheet .

lines.english: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam as Gurmukh, O my friend. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam jap gurmukh  meet . ||3||

lines.english: He alone receives the panacea, the medicine of the Naam,
lines.transliteration: naam a-ukhaDh  so-ee jan paavai.
kar kirpaa jis aap divaavai. unto whom the Lord, in His Grace, bestows it.

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har
lines.transliteration: har har naam jaa kai hirdai vasai.

lines.english: - O Nanak, his pains and sorrows are eliminated. ||4||10||79|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (179-6) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad tih naanak nasai. ||4||10||79||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: Even with vast sums of wealth, the mind is not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: bahut d arab kar man na agh aanaa.

lines.english: Gazing upon countless beauties, the man is not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: anik roop daykh  nah pat ee-aanaa.

lines.english: He is so involved with his wife and sons - he believes that they belong to him.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar urjh i-o jaan mayree.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ  ਕਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: That wealth shall pass away, and those relatives shall be reduced to ashes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: oh binsai o-ay bhasmai dh ayree. ||1||

lines.english: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, they are crying out in pain.
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan d aykh-a-u billaat ay.

lines.english: Dharig t an Dh arig Dh an maa-i-aa sang raat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. Their bodies are cursed, and their wealth is cursed - they are imbued with Maya. ||1||Pause||
The servant carries the bags of money on his head,
lines.transliteration: ji-o bigaaree kai sir deejeh d aam.
o-ay khasmai kai garihi un d ookh sahaam. but it goes to his master's house, and he receives only pain.

lines.english: The man sits as a king in his dreams,
lines.transliteration: ji-o supnai ho-ay baisat raajaa.
naytar pasaarai t aa niraarath kaajaa. ||2|| but when he opens his eyes, he sees that it was all in vain. ||2||

lines.english: The watchman oversees the field of another,
lines.transliteration: ji-o raakhaa kh ayt oopar paraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ  ਕੈ ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ  ॥
lines.transliteration: khayt  khasam kaa raakh aa uth  jaa-ay. but the field belongs to his master, while he must get up and depart.

lines.english: He works so hard, and suffers for that field,
lines.transliteration: us khayt  kaaran  raakh aa karh ai.
tis kai paalai kachh oo na parh ai. ||3|| but still, nothing comes into his hands. ||3||

lines.english: The dream is His, and the kingdom is His;
lines.transliteration: jis kaa raaj tisai kaa supnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He who has given the wealth of Maya, has infused the desire for it.
lines.transliteration: jin maa-i-aa deenee t in laa-ee t arisnaa.

lines.english: He Himself annihilates, and He Himself restores.
lines.transliteration: aap binaahay aap karay raas.

lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer to God. ||4||11||80|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (179-12) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh aagai ard aas. ||4||11||80||

lines.english: I have gazed upon the many forms of Maya, in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: baho rang maa-i-aa baho biDh paykh ee.

lines.english: With pen and paper, I have written clever things.
lines.transliteration: kalam kaagad si-aanap laykh ee.

lines.english: I have seen what it is to be a chief, a king, and an emperor,
lines.transliteration: mahar malook ho-ay daykh i-aa kh aan.
taa tay naahee man t ariptaan. ||1|| but they do not satisfy the mind. ||1||

lines.english: Show me that peace, O Saints,
lines.transliteration: so sukh mo ka-o sant  bataavhu.
tarisnaa boojh ai man t ariptaavho. ||1|| rahaa-o. which will quench my thirst and satisfy my mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: You may have horses as fast as the wind, elephants to ride on,
lines.transliteration: as pavan hasat asvaaree.
cho-aa chandan sayj sund ar naaree. sandalwood oil, and beautiful women in bed,
nat naatik aakhaaray gaa-i-aa. actors in dramas, singing in theaters

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa meh man sant okh na paa-i-aa. ||2|| - but even with them, the mind does not find contentment. ||2||

lines.english: You may have a throne at the royal court, with beautiful decorations and soft carpets,
lines.transliteration: takhat sabh aa mandan d oleechay.
sagal mayvay sundar baageechay. all sorts of luscious fruits and beautiful gardens,
aakhayrh  birat raajan kee leelaa. the excitement of the chase and princely pleasures
man na suhaylaa parpanch heelaa. ||3|| - but still, the mind is not made happy by such illusory diversions. ||3||

lines.english: In their kindness, the Saints have told me of the True One,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa santan sach kahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਮਿਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh ih aanand  lahi-aa. and so I have obtained all comforts and joy.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har keert an gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Says Nanak, through great good fortune, I have found this. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak vadbhaagee paa-ee-ai. ||4||

lines.english: One who obtains the wealth of the Lord becomes happy.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai har Dhan so-ee suhaylaa.

lines.english: By God's Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat. ||1||Second Pause||12||81|| gauVI guAwryrI  mhlw 5 ] (179-19) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 180
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay saaDh sang maylaa. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||12||81||

lines.english: The mortal claims this body as his own.
lines.transliteration: paraanee jaan ai ih t an mayraa.

lines.english: Again and again, he clings to it.
lines.transliteration: bahur bahur u-aahoo laptayraa.

lines.english: He is entangled with his children, his wife and household affairs.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar girsat  kaa faasaa.

lines.english: He cannot be the slave of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hon na paa-ee-ai raam kay daasaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What is that way, by which the Lord's Praises might be sung?
lines.transliteration: kavan so biDh jit  raam gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: What is that intellect, by which this person might swim across, O mother?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kavan so mat jit  tarai ih maa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਸੁ ਮਿਤ ਿਜਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That which is for his own good, he thinks is evil.
lines.transliteration: jo bhalaa-ee so buraa jaanai.

lines.english: If someone tells him the truth, he looks upon that as poison.
lines.transliteration: saach kahai so bikhai samaanai.

lines.english: He cannot tell victory from defeat.
lines.transliteration: jaanai naahee jeet  ar haar.

lines.english: This is the way of life in the world of the faithless cynic. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ih valayvaa saakat sansaar. ||2||

lines.english: The demented fool drinks in the deadly poison,
lines.transliteration: jo halaahal so peevai ba-uraa.
amrit naam jaanai kar ka-uraa. while he believes the Ambrosial Naam to be bitter.

lines.english: He does not even approach the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang kai naahee nayr.
lakh cha-oraaseeh bh armat aa fayr. ||3|| he wanders lost through 8.4 million incarnations. ||3||

lines.english: The birds are caught in the net of Maya;
lines.transliteration: aykai jaal fahaa-ay pankhee.
ras ras bhog karahi baho rangee. immersed in the pleasures of love, they frolic in so many ways.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Perfect Guru has cut away the noose from those, unto whom theLord has shown His Mercy. ||4||13||82|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (180-6) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis bha-ay kirpaal. gur poorai t aa kay kaatay jaal. ||4||13||82||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, we find the Way.
lines.transliteration: ta-o kirpaa t ay maarag paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By God's Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By God's Grace, we are released from our bondage.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay banDh an chh utai.

lines.english: By Your Grace, egotism is eradicated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ta-o kirpaa t ay ha-umai t utai. ||1||

lines.english: As You assign me, so I take to Your service.
lines.transliteration: tum laavhu t a-o laagah sayv.

lines.english: By myself, I cannot do anything at all, O Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham tay kachh oo na hovai d ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If it pleases You, then I sing the Word of Your Bani.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t aa gaavaa ban ee.

lines.english: If it pleases You, then I speak the Truth.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t aa sach vakh aanee.

lines.english: If it pleases You, then the True Guru showers His Mercy upon me.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t aa sat gur ma-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.english: All peace comes by Your Kindness, God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa parabh  tayree d a-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever pleases You is a pure action of karma.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so nirmal karmaa.

lines.english: Whatever pleases You is the true faith of Dharma.
