lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so sach Dh armaa.

lines.english: The treasure of all excellence is with You.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan gun  tum hee paas.

lines.english: Your servant prays to You, O Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tooN saahib sayvak ard aas. ||3||

lines.english: The mind and body become immaculate through the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal ho-ay har rang.

lines.english: All peace is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa paava-o sat sang.

lines.english: My mind remains attuned to Your Name;
lines.transliteration: naam tayrai rahai man raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak affirms this as his greatest pleasure. ||4||14||83|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (180-13) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih kali-aan naanak kar jaat aa. ||4||14||83||

lines.english: You may taste the other flavors,
lines.transliteration: aan rasaa jaytay t ai chaakh ay.
nimakh na t arisnaa t ayree laathay. but your thirst shall not depart, even for an instant.

lines.english: But when you taste the sweet flavor the the Lord's sublime essence
lines.transliteration: har ras kaa tooN chaakh ahi saad .
chaakhat  ho-ay raheh bismaad . ||1|| - upon tasting it, you shall be wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||

lines.english: O dear beloved tongue, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit rasnaa pee-o pi-aaree.

lines.english: Imbued with this sublime essence, you shall be satisfied. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih ras raatee ho-ay t ariptaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: hay jihvay tooN raam gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: Each and every moment, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: nimakh nimakh  har har har Dh i-aa-o.

lines.english: Do not listen to any other, and do not go anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: aan na sunee-ai katahooN jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਿਹ  ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, you shall find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  vadbh aagee paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, O tongue, dwell upon God, the Unfathomable, Supreme Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar jihvay aaraaDh . paarbarahm th aakur aagaaDh .

lines.english: Here and hereafter, you shall be happy forever.
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa sadaa suhaylee.

lines.english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O tongue, you shall become priceless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavat  rasan amolee. ||3||

lines.english: All the vegetation will blossom forth for you, flowering in fruition;
lines.transliteration: banaspat ma-ulee fal ful payday.
ih ras raatee bahur na chh oday. imbued with this sublime essence, you shall never leave it again.

lines.english: No other sweet and tasty flavors can compare to it.
lines.transliteration: aan na ras kas lavai na laa-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has become my Support. ||4||15||84|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (180-19) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bha-ay hai sahaa-ee. ||4||15||84||

lines.english: The mind is the temple, and the body is the fence built around it. pMnw 181
lines.transliteration: man mandar t an saajee baar.

lines.english: The infinite substance is within it.
lines.transliteration: is hee maDhay basat  apaar.

lines.english: Within it, the great merchant is said to dwell.
lines.transliteration: is hee bheet ar sunee-at  saahu.

lines.english: Who is the trader who deals there? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kavan baapaaree jaa kaa oohaa visaahu. ||1||

lines.english: How rare is that trader who deals in the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan ko ko bi-uhaaree.

lines.english: He takes the Ambrosial Nectar as his food. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit bh ojan karay aahaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He dedicates his mind and body to serving the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan arpee sayv kareejai.

lines.english: How can we please the Lord?
lines.transliteration: kavan so jugat jit  kar bh eejai.

lines.english: I fall at His Feet, and I renounce all sense of 'mine and yours'.
lines.transliteration: paa-ay laga-o taj mayraa t ayrai.

lines.english: Who can settle this bargain? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kavan so jan jo sa-udaa jorai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ  ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can I attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence?
lines.transliteration: mahal saah kaa kin biDh paavai.

lines.english: How can I get Him to call me inside?
lines.transliteration: kavan so biDh jit  bheetar bulaavai.

lines.english: You are the Great Merchant; You have millions of traders.
lines.transliteration: tooN vad saahu jaa kay kot van jaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਿਟ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Who is the benefactor? Who can take me to Him? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kavan so daat aa lay sanchaaray. ||3||

lines.english: Seeking and searching, I have found my own home, deep within my own being.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat nij gh ar paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Lord has shown me the priceless jewel.
lines.transliteration: amol ratan saach d ikhlaa-i-aa.

lines.english: When the Great Merchant shows His Mercy, He blends us into Himself.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jab maylay saahi.

lines.english: Says Nanak, place your faith in the Guru. ||4||16||85|| gauVI mhlw 5 guAwryrI ] (181-6) ga-orhee mehlaa 5 gu-aarayree. Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Gwaarayree:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur kai vaysaahi. ||4||16||85||

lines.english: Night and day, they remain in the Love of the One.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas rahai ik rangaa.

lines.english: They know that God is always with them.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o jaan ai sad  hee sangaa.

lines.english: They make the Name of their Lord and Master their way of life;
lines.transliteration: thaakur naam kee-o un vart an.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaavan har kai d arsan. ||1|| they are satisfied and fulfilled with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

lines.english: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, their minds and bodies are rejuvenated,
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay man t an haray.
gur pooray kee sarnee paray. ||1|| rahaa-o. entering the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of the soul.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal aat am aaDh aar.

lines.english: They see only the One, and obey His Order.
lines.transliteration: ayk nihaarahi aagi-aakaar.

lines.english: There is only one trade, and one occupation.
lines.transliteration: ayko banaj ayko bi-uhaaree.

lines.english: They know no other than the Formless Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: avar na jaaneh bin nirankaaree. ||2||

lines.english: They are free of both pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog d uhhooN tay mukt ay.

lines.english: They remain unattached, joined to the Lord's Way.
lines.transliteration: sadaa alipat  jog ar jugt ay.

lines.english: They are seen among all, and yet they are distinct from all.
lines.transliteration: deeseh sabh  meh sabh  tay raht ay.

lines.english: They focus their meditation on the Supreme Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kaa o-ay Dhi-aan Dh artay. ||3||

lines.english: How can I describe the Glories of the Saints?
lines.transliteration: santan kee mahimaa kavan vakh aana-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Their knowledge is unfathomable; their limits cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: agaaDh boDh  kichh  mit nahee jaan-o.

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon me.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm mohi kirpaa keejai.

lines.english: Dhoor sant an kee naanak d eejai. ||4||17||86|| Bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||17||86|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (181-13) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
You are my Companion; You are my Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa sakh aa tooNhee mayraa meet .

lines.english: You are my Beloved; I am in love with You.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa pareet am tum sang heet .

lines.english: You are my honor; You are my decoration.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayree pat  toohai mayraa gahn aa.

lines.english: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin nimakh  na jaa-ee rahn aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.english: You are my Intimate Beloved, You are my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayray laalan t ooN mayray paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਤੁਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹੀਤੁ ॥
lines.english: You are my Lord and Master; You are my Leader. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN mayray saahib t ooN mayray kh aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਤ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: As You keep me, so do I survive.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tum raakh o tiv hee rahnaa.

lines.english: Whatever You say, that is what I do.
lines.transliteration: jo tum kahhu so-ee mohi karnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ  ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see You dwelling.
lines.transliteration: jah paykha-o t ahaa t um basnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my Fearless Lord, with my tongue, I chant Your Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o naam japa-o t ayraa rasnaa. ||2||

lines.english: You are my nine treasures, You are my storehouse.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayree nav niDh  tooN bhandaar.

lines.english: I am imbued with Your Love; You are the Support of my mind.
lines.transliteration: rang rasaa tooN maneh aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਮੋਿਹ ਕਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Glory; I am blended with You.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayree sobh aa tum sang rachee-aa.

lines.english: You are my Shelter; You are my Anchoring Support. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tooN mayree ot t ooN hai mayraa t akee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar tuhee Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have obtained Your secret from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: maram tumaaraa gur t ay paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the True Guru, the One and only Lord was implanted within me;
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay darirhi-aa ik aykai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਚੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 182
lines.transliteration: naanak daas har har har taykai. ||4||18||87|| servant Nanak has taken to the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||18||87|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (181-19) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5.

lines.english: It torments us with the expression of pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat harakh  sog bisthaar.

lines.english: It torments us through incarnations in heaven and hell.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat surag narak avt aar.

lines.english: It is seen to afflict the rich, the poor and the glorious.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat Dh an nirDh an paykh  sobh aa.

lines.english: The source of this illness which torments us is greed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mool bi-aaDhee bi-aapas lobh aa. ||1||

lines.english: Maya torments us in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa bi-aapat baho parkaaree.

lines.english: But the Saints live under Your Protection, God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant jeeveh parabh  ot tumaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: It torments us through intoxication with intellectual pride.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat ahaN-buDh  kaa maat aa.

lines.english: It torments us through the love of children and spouse.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat put ar kalt ar sang raat aa.

lines.english: It torments us through elephants, horses and beautiful clothes.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat hasat  ghorhay ar bast aa.

lines.english: It torments us through the intoxication of wine and the beauty of youth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat roop joban mad  mast aa. ||2||

lines.english: It torments landlords, paupers and lovers of pleasure.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat bh oom rank ar rangaa.

lines.english: It torments us through the sweet sounds of music and parties.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat geet  naad  sun sangaa.

lines.english: It torments us through beautiful beds, palaces and decorations.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat sayj mahal seegaar.

lines.english: It torments us through the darkness of the five evil passions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: panch doot  bi-aapat  anDh i-aar. ||3||

lines.english: It torments those who act, entangled in ego.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat karam karai ha-o faasaa.

lines.english: It torments us through household affairs, and it torments us in renunciation.
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat girsat  bi-aapat  udaasaa.

lines.english: It torments us through character, lifestyle and social status.
lines.transliteration: aachaar bi-uhaar bi-aapat ih jaat .

lines.english: It torments us through everything, except for those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  bi-aapat  bin har rang raat . ||4||

lines.english: The Sovereign Lord King has cut away the bonds of His Saints.
lines.transliteration: santan kay banDh an kaatay har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: How can Maya torment them?
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o kahaa bi-aapai maa-ay.

lines.english: 5) kaho naanak jin Dhoor sant  paa-ee. t aa kai nikat na aavai maa-ee. ||5||19||88|| Says Nanak, Maya does not draw near those who have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||19||88|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (182-8) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
The eyes are asleep in corruption, gazing upon the beauty of another.
lines.transliteration: nainhu need par d arisat vikaar.

lines.english: The ears are asleep, listening to slanderous stories.
lines.transliteration: sarvan so-ay sun  nind veechaar.

lines.english: The tongue is asleep, in its desire for sweet flavors.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa so-ee lobh meeth ai saad .

lines.english: The mind is asleep, fascinated by Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man so-i-aa maa-i-aa bismaad. ||1||

lines.english: Those who remain awake in this house are very rare;
lines.transliteration: is garih meh ko-ee jaagat rahai.
saabat vasat  oh apnee lahai. ||1|| rahaa-o. by doing so, they receive the whole thing. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: All of my companions are intoxicated with their sensory pleasures;
lines.transliteration: sagal sahaylee apnai ras maatee.
garih apunay kee khabar na jaat ee. they do not know how to guard their own home.

lines.english: The five thieves have plundered them;
lines.transliteration: musanhaar panch batvaaray.
soonay nagar paray thag-haaray. ||2|| the thugs descend upon the unguarded village. ||2||

lines.english: Our mothers and fathers cannot save us from them;
lines.transliteration: un tay raakh ai baap na maa-ee.
un tay raakh ai meet  na bh aa-ee. friends and brothers cannot protect us from them
darab si-aan ap naa o-ay raht ay. - they cannot be restrained by wealth or cleverness.

lines.english: Only through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, can those villains be brought under control. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang o-ay d usat vas hot ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Have Mercy upon me, O Lord, Sustainer of the world.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi saaringpaan.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The dust of the feet of the Saints is all the treasure I need.
lines.transliteration: santan Dh oor sarab niDh aan.

lines.english: In the Company of the True Guru, one's investment remains intact.
lines.transliteration: saabat poonjee sat gur sang.

lines.english: Nanak is awake to the Love of the Supreme Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak jaagai paarbarahm kai rang. ||4||

lines.english: He alone is awake, unto whom God shows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: so jaagai jis parabh kirpaal.

lines.english: This investment, wealth and property shall remain intact. ||1||Second Pause||20||89|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (182-15) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih poonjee saabat Dh an maal. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||20||89||

lines.english: Kings and emperors are under His Power.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai vas khaan sult aan.

lines.english: The whole world is under His Power.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai vas hai sagal jahaan.

lines.english: Everything is done by His doing;
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa kee-aa sabh kichh  ho-ay.
tis tay baahar naahee ko-ay. ||1|| other than Him, there is nothing at all. ||1||

lines.english: Offer your prayers to your True Guru;
lines.transliteration: kaho baynantee apunay sat gur paahi.

lines.english: He will resolve your affairs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaaj tumaaray d ay-ay nibaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Darbaar of His Court is the most exalted of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch jaa kaa d arbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ  ਜਹਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: His Name is the Support of all His devotees.
lines.transliteration: sagal bhagat  jaa kaa naam aDh aar.

lines.english: The Perfect Master is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sarab bi-aapat pooran Dh anee.

lines.english: His Glory is manifest in each and every heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sobhaa gh at ghat banee. ||2||

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, the home of sorrow is abolished.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat d ukh dayraa dh ahai.

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat jam kichh oo na kahai.

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, the dry branches become green again. pMnw 183
lines.transliteration: jis simrat hot  sookay haray.

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, sinking stones are made to float. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis simrat doobat  paahan t aray. ||3||

lines.english: I salute and applaud the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa ka-o sad aa jaikaar.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Support of the breath of life of His servant.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jan paraan aDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord has heard my prayer;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayree sunee ard aas.

lines.english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  mo ka-o naam nivaas. ||4||21||90|| by the Grace of the Saints, I dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||21||90|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (183-3) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5.

lines.english: By the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, the fire of desire is quenched.
lines.transliteration: satgur d arsan agan nivaaree.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, egotism is subdued.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytat ha-umai maaree.

lines.english: In the Company of the True Guru, the mind does not waver.
lines.transliteration: satgur sang naahee man dolai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh speaks the Ambrosial Word of Gurbani. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee gurmukh  bolai. ||1||

lines.english: He sees the True One pervading the whole world; he is imbued with the True One.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag saachaa jaa sach meh raat ay.

lines.english: I have become cool and tranquil, knowing God, through the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: seetal saat  gur t ay parabh  jaatay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, one chants the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  japai har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲ  ਸਾਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, one sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  har keert an gaa-o.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, all pains are erased.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  sagal d ukh mitay.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from bondage. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  banDh an tay chh utay. ||2||

lines.english: By the kind Mercy of the Saints, emotional attachment and doubt are removed.
lines.transliteration: sant kirpaa t ay mitay moh bh aram.

lines.english: Taking a bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy - this is true Dharmic faith.
lines.transliteration: saaDh rayn  majan sabh  Dharam.

lines.english: By the kindness of the Holy, the Lord of the Universe becomes merciful.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kirpaal d a-i-aal govind .

lines.english: The life of my soul is with the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhaa meh ih hamree jind . ||3||

lines.english: Meditating on the Merciful Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, I have obtained a seat in the Saadh Sangat.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDh kirpaal Dh i-aava-o. saaDh sang t aa baith an paava-o.

lines.english: I am worthless, but God has been kind to me.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun ka-o parabh  keenee d a-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, Nanak has taken to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||22||91|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (183-9) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak naam la-i-aa. ||4||22||91||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang japi-o bh agvant .

lines.english: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kayval naam dee-o gur mant .

lines.english: Shedding my ego, I have become free of hate.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan bh a-ay nirvair.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship the Guru's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar poojahu gur pair. ||1||

lines.english: Now, my evil sense of alienation is eliminated,
lines.transliteration: ab mat binsee d usat bigaanee.
jab tay sun i-aa har jas kaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o. since I have heard the Praises of the Lord with my ears. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The Savior Lord is the treasure of intuitive peace, poise and bliss.
lines.transliteration: sahj sookh aanand  niDhaan.

lines.english: He shall save me in the end.
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaar rakh  lay-ay nid aan.

lines.english: My pains, sufferings, fears and doubts have been erased.
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad binsay bh ai bharam.

lines.english: He has mercifully saved me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rakhay kar karam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself beholds, speaks and hears all.
lines.transliteration: paykhai bolai sun ai sabh  aap.

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the One who is always with you.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sang t aa ka-o man jaap.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, the Light has dawned.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  bha-i-o pargaas.

lines.english: The One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is perfectly pervading everywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: poor rahay aykai guntaas. ||3||

lines.english: Pure are those who speak, and sanctified are those who hear and sing, forever and ever, the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: kahat pavit ar sun at puneet . gun govind  gaavahi nit  neet.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa ka-o hohu kirpaal.

lines.english: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis jan kee sabh  pooran gh aal. ||4||23||92|| all one's efforts are fulfilled. ||4||23||92|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (183-15) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: He breaks our bonds, and inspires us to chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orh bolaavai raam.

lines.english: With the mind centered in meditation on the True Lord, anguish is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace.
lines.transliteration: man meh laagai saach Dhi-aan. miteh kalays sukh ee ho-ay rahee-ai.

lines.english: Such is the True Guru, the Great Giver. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aisaa daat aa sat gur kahee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: He alone is the Giver of peace, who inspires us to chant the Naam, the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: so sukh-d aata je naam japaavai.

lines.english: By His Grace, He leads us to merge with Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa tis sang milaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He unites with Himself those unto whom He has shown His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: jis ho-ay da-i-aal t is aap milaavai.

lines.english: All treasures are received from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan guroo t ay paavai.

lines.english: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, coming and going come to an end.
lines.transliteration: aap ti-aag mitai aavan  jaanaa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Supreme Lord God is recognized. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang paarbarahm pachh aanaa. ||2||

lines.english: God has become merciful to His humble servant. pMnw 184
lines.transliteration: jan oopar parabh bh a-ay d a-i-aal.

lines.english: The One Lord of the Universe is the Support of His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: jan kee tayk ayk gopaal.

lines.english: They love the One Lord; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykaa liv ayko man bhaa-o.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is all treasures for them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan jan kai har naa-o. ||3||

lines.english: They are in love with the Supreme Lord God;
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm si-o laagee pareet.
nirmal karnee saachee reet . their actions are pure, and their lifestyle is true.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai mayti-aa anDhi-aaraa.

lines.english: Nanak's God is Incomparable and Infinite. ||4||24||93|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (184-3) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa parabh apar apaaraa. ||4||24||93||

lines.english: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord, swim across.
lines.transliteration: jis man vasai tarai jan so-ay.

lines.english: Those who have the blessing of good karma, meet with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai karam paraapat ho-ay.

lines.english: Pain, disease and fear do not affect them at all.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog kachh  bha-o na bi-aapai.

lines.english: They meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within their hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rid ai har jaapai. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysur Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay ih mat  paa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar d a-i-aal.

lines.english: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant saglay part ipaal.

lines.english: He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Eternal and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar sadaa bay-ant aa.

lines.english: Meditate on Him, O my mind, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simar manaa pooray gur manntaa. ||2||

lines.english: Serving Him, all treasures are obtained.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayvaa sarab niDhaan.

lines.english: Worshipping God, honor is obtained.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee poojaa paa-ee-ai maan.

lines.english: Working for Him is never in vain;
lines.transliteration: jaa kee tahal na birthee jaa-ay.
sadaa sad aa har kay gun  gaa-ay. ||3|| forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Show Mercy to me, O God, O Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh ant arjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Unseen Lord and Master is the Treasure of Peace.
lines.transliteration: sukh niDh aan har alakh  su-aamee.

lines.english: All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary;
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant t ayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak is blessed to receive the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.||4||25||94|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (184-9) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee. ||4||25||94||

lines.english: Our way of life is in His Hands;
lines.transliteration: jee-a jugat jaa kai hai haath.
so simrahu anaath ko naath. remember Him, the Master of the masterless.

lines.english: When God comes to mind, all pains depart.
lines.transliteration: parabh chit  aa-ay sabh  dukh jaa-ay.

lines.english: All fears are dispelled through the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhai sabh  binsahi har kai naa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Why do you fear any other than the Lord?
lines.transliteration: bin har bha-o kaahay kaa maaneh.

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, why do you pretend to be at peace? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bisrat kaahay sukh  jaaneh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He established the many worlds and skies.
lines.transliteration: jin Dhaaray baho Dh aran agaas.

lines.english: The soul is illumined with His Light;
lines.transliteration: jaa kee jot jee-a pargaas.
jaa kee bakhas na maytai ko-ay. no one can revoke His Blessing.

lines.english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on God, and become fearless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simar simar parabh nirbh a-o ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on God's Name.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar simrahu parabh  naam.

lines.english: In it are the many sacred shrines of pilgrimage and cleansing baths.
lines.transliteration: anik tirath majan isnaan.

lines.english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kee sarnee paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Millions of mistakes shall be erased in an instant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kot kalank khin meh mit jaahi. ||3||

lines.english: The Perfect King is self-sufficient.
lines.transliteration: baymuhtaaj pooraa paat isaahu.

lines.english: God's servant has true faith in Him.
lines.transliteration: parabh sayvak saachaa vaysaahu.

lines.english: Giving him His Hand, the Perfect Guru protects him.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai raakhay d ay haath.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God is All-powerful. ||4||26||95|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (184-15) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paarbarahm samraath. ||4||26||95||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naam man laagaa.

lines.english: Asleep for so many incarnations, it is now awakened.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa so-i-aa jaagaa.

lines.english: I chant the Ambrosial Bani, the Glorious Praises of God.
lines.transliteration: amrit gun  uchrai parabh  banee.

lines.english: The Pure Teachings of the Perfect Guru have been revealed to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee sumat paraan ee. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on God, I have found total peace.
lines.transliteration: parabh simrat  kusal sabh  paa-ay.

lines.english: Within my home, and outside as well, there is peace and poise all around.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar sukh  sahj sabaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have recognized the One who created me.
lines.transliteration: so-ee pachhaat aa jineh upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aap milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Taking me by the arm, He has made me His Own.
lines.transliteration: baah pakar leeno kar apnaa.

lines.english: I continually chant and meditate on the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa sadaa jap japnaa. ||2||

lines.english: Mantras, tantras, all-curing medicines and acts of atonement, pMnw 185
lines.transliteration: mantar t antar a-ukh aDh punahchaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam jee-a paraan aDhaar. are all in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the soul and the breath of life.

lines.english: I have obtained the true wealth of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: saachaa Dhan paa-i-o har rang.

lines.english: I have crossed over the treacherous world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Companyof the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dutar taray saaDh  kai sang. ||3||

lines.english: Sit in peace, O Saints, with the family of friends.
lines.transliteration: sukh baishu sant  sajan parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਓ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਿਹ  ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Earn the wealth of the Lord, which is beyond estimation.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan kh ati-o jaa kaa naahi sumaar.

lines.english: He alone obtains it, unto whom the Guru has bestowed it.
lines.transliteration: jisahi paraapat t is gur d ay-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, no one shall go away empty-handed. ||4||27||96|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (185-3) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak birthaa ko-ay na hay-ay. ||4||27||96||

lines.english: The hands are sanctified instantly,
lines.transliteration: hasat puneet  hohi t atkaal.
binas jaahi maa-i-aa janjaal. and the entanglements of Maya are dispelled.

lines.english: Repeat constantly with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: rasnaa ramhu raam gun neet .
sukh paavhu mayray bh aa-ee meet . ||1|| and you shall find peace, O my friends, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

lines.english: With pen and ink, write upon your paper
lines.transliteration: likh laykh an kaagad  masvaan ee.
raam naam har amrit ban ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. the Name of the Lord, the Ambrosial Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: By this act, your sins shall be washed away.
lines.transliteration: ih kaaraj tayray jaahi bikaar.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: simrat raam naahee jam maar.

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay kay d oot na johai. The couriers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall not touch you.
The intoxication of Maya shall not entice you at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa magan na kachhoo-ai mohai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: You shall be redeemed, and through you, the whole world shall be saved,
lines.transliteration: uDhrahi aap t arai sansaar.
raam naam jap aykankaar. if you chant the Name of the One and Only Lord.

lines.english: Practice this yourself, and teach others;
lines.transliteration: aap kamaa-o avraa updays.
raam naam hirdai parvays. ||3|| instill the Lord's Name in your heart. ||3||

lines.english: That person, who has this treasure upon his forehead
lines.transliteration: jaa kai maathai ayhu niDhaan.
so-ee purakh japai bh agvaan. - that person meditates on God.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har har gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||4||28||97|| rwgu gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 caupdy dupdy  (185-10) raag ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5 cha-upd ay dupday Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (185-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ha-o tis bal jaa-o. ||4||28||97||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: That which belongs to another - he claims as his own.
lines.transliteration: jo paraa-i-o so-ee apnaa.

lines.english: That which he must abandon - to that, his mind is attracted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo taj chh odan t is si-o man rachnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me, how can he meet the Lord of the World?
lines.transliteration: kahhu gusaa-ee milee-ai kayh.

lines.english: That which is forbidden - with that, he is in love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo bibarjat t is si-o nayh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That which is false - he deems as true.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  baat saa sach kar jaat ee.

lines.english: That which is true - his mind is not attached to that at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sat hovan man lagai na raat ee. ||2||

lines.english: He takes the crooked path of the unrighteous way;
lines.transliteration: baavai maarag taydhaa chalnaa.
seeDhaa chh od apooth aa bunnaa. ||3|| leaving the straight and narrow path, he weaves his way backwards. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੁ ਬਾਤ ਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: God is the Lord and Master of both worlds.
lines.transliteration: duhaa siri-aa kaa kh asam parabh  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਹੋਵਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He, whom the Lord unites with Himself, O Nanak, is liberated. ||4||29||98|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (185-14) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis maylay naanak so muktaa ho-ee. ||4||29||98||

lines.english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, they come together through destiny.
lines.transliteration: kalijug meh mil aa-ay sanjog.

lines.english: As long as the Lord commands, they enjoy their pleasures. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jichar aagi-aa tichar bh ogeh bh og. ||1||

lines.english: By burning oneself, the Beloved Lord is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: jalai na paa-ee-ai raam sanayhee.

lines.english: Only by the actions of destiny does she rise up and burn herself, as a 'satee'.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirat sanjog sat ee uth  ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Imitating what she sees, with her stubborn mind-set, she goes into the fire.
lines.transliteration: daykh aa daykhee manhath  jal jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: She does not obtain the Company of her Beloved Lord, and she wanders through countless incarnations. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pari-a sang na paavai baho jon bhavaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: With pure conduct and self-restraint, she surrenders to her Husband Lord's Will;
lines.transliteration: seel sanjam pari-a aagi-aa maanai.
tis naaree ka-o d ukh na jamaanai. ||3|| that woman shall not suffer pain at the hands of the Messenger of Death. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, she who looks upon the Transcendent Lord as her Husband,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin pari-o parmaysar kar jaani-aa.

lines.english: Dhan sat ee dargeh parvaani-aa. ||4||30||99|| is the blessed 'satee'; she is received with honor in the Court of the Lord.||4||30||99|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 ] (185-19) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:
I am prosperous and fortunate, for I have received the True Name.
lines.transliteration: ham Dhanvant  bhaagath  sach naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਵਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural, intuitive ease. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 186
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavah sahj subh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When I opened it up and gazed upon the treasures of my father and grandfather,
lines.transliteration: pee-oo daad ay kaa kh ol dith aa kh ajaanaa.
taa mayrai man bh a-i-aa niDh aanaa. ||1|| then my mind became very happy. ||1||

lines.english: The storehouse is inexhaustible and immeas urable, overflowing with priceless jewels and rubies. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ratan laal jaa kaa kachh oo na mol. bh aray bh andaar akh oot at ol. ||2||

lines.english: The Siblings of Destiny meet together, and eat and spend,
lines.transliteration: khaaveh kh archeh ral mil bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਲਾਲ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai vaDh -do jaa-ee. ||3|| but these resources do not diminish; they continue to increase. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one who has such destiny written on his forehead,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis mastak laykh  likhaa-ay.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so ayt kh ajaanai la-i-aa ralaa-ay. ||4||31||100|| becomes a partner in these treasures. ||4||31||100|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (186-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: I was scared, scared to death, when I thought that He was far away.
lines.transliteration: dar dar martay jab jaanee-ai d oor.

lines.english: But my fear was removed, when I saw that He is pervading everywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dar chookaa daykh i-aa bh arpoor. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur apunay ka-o balihaarai.

lines.english: He shall not abandon me; He shall surely carry me across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhod na jaa-ee sarpar t aarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਡਿਰ ਡਿਰ ਮਰਤੇ  ਜਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ  ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Pain, disease and sorrow come when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog sog bisrai jab naam.

lines.english: Eternal bliss comes when one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand jaa har gun  gaam. ||2||

lines.english: Do not say that anyone is good or bad.
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa ko-ee na kaheejai.

lines.english: Renounce your arrogant pride, and grasp the Feet of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhod maan har charan gaheejai. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, remember the GurMantra;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur mantar chit aar.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukh paavahi saachai d arbaar. ||4||32||101|| you shall find peace at the True Court. ||4||32||101|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (186-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Those who have the Lord as their Friend and Companion
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa meet saajan hai samee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis jan ka-o kaho kaa kee kamee-aa. ||1|| - tell me, what else do they need? ||1||

lines.english: Those who are in love with the Lord of the Universe
lines.transliteration: jaa kee pareet gobind  si-o laagee.
dookh  darad bharam t aa kaa bh aagee. ||1|| rahaa-o. - pain, suffering and doubt run away from them. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Those who have enjoyed the flavor of the Lord's sublime essence
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o ras har ras hai aa-i-o.
so an ras naahee laptaa-i-o. ||2|| are not attracted to any other pleasures. ||2||

lines.english: Those whose speech is accepted in the Court of the Lord
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa kahi-aa dargeh chalai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਮੀਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: so kis ka-o nadar lai aavai t alai. ||3|| - what do they care about anything else? ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕਮੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who belong to the One, unto whom all things belong
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa sabh kichh  taa kaa ho-ay.

lines.english: - O Nanak, they find a lasting peace. ||4||33||102|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (186-11) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ka-o sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||4||33||102||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who look alike upon pleasure and pain
lines.transliteration: jaa kai dukh  sukh  sam kar jaapai.
taa ka-o kaarh aa kahaa bi-aapai. ||1|| - how can anxiety touch them? ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Holy Saints abide in celestial bliss.
lines.transliteration: sahj anand har saaDhoo maahi.

lines.english: They remain obedient to the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aagi-aakaaree har har raa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who have the Carefree Lord abiding in their minds
lines.transliteration: jaa kai achint vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਕਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਲੈ ਆਵੈ  ਤਲੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o chint aa kat ahooN naahi. ||2|| - no cares will ever bother them. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who have banished doubt from their minds
lines.transliteration: jaa kai binsi-o man tay bh armaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੧੦੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa kai kachh oo naahee dar jamaa. ||3|| are not afraid of death at all. ||3||

lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's Name by the Guru
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hirdai d ee-o gur naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak taa kai sagal niDh aanaa. ||4||34||103|| - says Nanak, all treasures come to them. ||4||34||103|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (186-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Lord of Unfathomable Form has His Place in the mind.
lines.transliteration: agam roop kaa man meh thaanaa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few come to understand this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kinai virlai jaanaa. ||1||

lines.english: The Ambrosial Pools of the celestial sermon
lines.transliteration: sahj kathaa kay amrit kuntaa.
jisahi paraapat t is lai bh unchaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. - those who find them, drink them in. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody of the Guru's Bani vibrates in that most special place.
lines.transliteration: anhat ban ee thaan niraalaa.

lines.english: The Lord of the World is fascinated with this melody. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa kee Dh un mohay gopaalaa. ||2||

lines.english: The numerous, countless places of celestial peace
lines.transliteration: tah sahj akh aaray anayk anant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹੀ  ਡਰੁ ਜਮਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kay sangee santaa. ||3|| - there, the Saints dwell, in the Company of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

lines.english: There is infinite joy, and no sorrow or duality.
lines.transliteration: harakh anant  sog nahee bee-aa.

lines.english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with this home. ||4||35||104|| gauVI mÚ 5 ] (186-19) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so ghar gur naanak ka-o d ee-aa. ||4||35||104||

lines.english: What form of Yours should I worship and adore?
lines.transliteration: kavan roop tayraa aaraaDh a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਰੂਪ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: What Yoga should I practice to control my body? ||1|| pMnw 187
lines.transliteration: kavan jog kaa-i-aa lay saaDha-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਗੁਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਲੈ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: What is that virtue, by which I may sing of You?
lines.transliteration: kavan gun jo tujh  lai gaava-o.

lines.english: What is that speech, by which I may please the Supreme Lord God? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kavan bol paarbarahm reejhaava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: What worship service shall I perform for You?
lines.transliteration: kavan so poojaa tayree kara-o.

lines.english: How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kavan so biDh jit  bhavjal t ara-o. ||2||

lines.english: What is that penance, by which I may become a penitent?
lines.transliteration: kavan tap jit  tapee-aa ho-ay.

lines.english: What is that Name, by which the filth of egotism may be washed away? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kavan so naam ha-umai mal kho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Virtue, worship, spiritual wisdom, meditation and all service, O Nanak,
lines.transliteration: gun poojaa gi-aan Dh i-aan naanak sagal gh aal.
jis kar kirpaa satgur milai d a-i-aal. ||4|| are obtained from the True Guru, when, in His Mercy and Kindness, He meets us.

lines.english: They alone receive this merit, and they alone know God,
lines.transliteration: tis hee gun t in hee parabh  jaataa.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis kee maan lay-ay sukh-d aata. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||36||105|| who are approved by the Giver of peace. ||1||Second Pause||36||105|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (187-5) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The body which you are so proud of, does not belong to you.
lines.transliteration: aapan tan nahee jaa ko garbaa.

lines.english: Power, property and wealth are not yours. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raaj milakh nahee aapan d arbaa. ||1||

lines.english: They are not yours, so why do you cling to them?
lines.transliteration: aapan nahee kaa ka-o laptaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਤਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਗਰਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is yours; it is received from the True Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapan naam satgur t ay paa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Children, spouse and siblings are not yours.
lines.transliteration: sut banit aa aapan nahee bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Dear friends, mother and father are not yours. ||2||
lines.transliteration: isat meet aap baap na maa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Gold, silver and money are not yours.
lines.transliteration: su-inaa roopaa fun nahee daam.

lines.english: Fine horses and magnificent elephants are of no use to you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: haivar gaivar aapan nahee kaam. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, those whom the Guru forgives, meet with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo gur bakhas milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਟ  ਮੀਤ ਆਪ  ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Everything belongs to those who have the Lord as their King. ||4||37||106|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (187-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis kaa sabh  kichh  jis kaa har raa-i-aa. ||4||37||106||

lines.english: I place the Guru's Feet on my forehead,
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan oopar mayray maathay.
taa tay dukh mayray saglay laathay. ||1|| and all my pains are gone. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur apunay ka-o kurbaanee.

lines.english: I have come to understand my soul, and I enjoy supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aatam cheen param rang maanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have applied the dust of the Guru's Feet to my face,
lines.transliteration: charan rayn  gur kee mukh  laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਊਪਿਰ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh t in sagal t i-aagee. ||2|| which has removed all my arrogant intellect. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ  ਲਾਥੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become sweet to my mind,
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad lago man meeth aa.
paarbarahm taa t ay mohi deeth aa. ||3|| and I behold the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru is the Giver of peace; the Guru is the Creator.
lines.transliteration: gur sukh-d aata gur kart aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Support of the breath of life and the soul. ||4||38||107|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (187-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan naanak gur aaDh aar. ||4||38||107||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਰੇਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, seek the One who lacks nothing. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray tooN taa ka-o aahi. jaa kai oon aa kachh hoo naahi. ||1||

lines.english: Make the Beloved Lord your friend.
lines.transliteration: har saa pareetam kar man meet .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਲਗੋ ਮਿਨ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Keep Him constantly in your mind; He is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraan aDhaar raakh o sad  cheet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O my mind, serve Him;
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray tooN taa ka-o sayv.

lines.english: He is the Primal Being, the Infinite Divine Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  aprampar d ayv. ||2||

lines.english: Place your hopes in the One
lines.transliteration: tis oopar man kar t ooN aasaa.
aad jugaad  jaa kaa bh arvaasaa. ||3|| who is the Support of all beings, from the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||3||

lines.english: His Love brings eternal peace;
lines.transliteration: jaa kee pareet sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਆਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gaavai gur mil so-ay. ||4||39||108|| meeting the Guru, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||39||108|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (187-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Whatever my Friend does, I accept.
lines.transliteration: meet karai so-ee ham maanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: My Friend's actions are pleasing to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: meet kay kart ab kusal samaanaa. ||1||

lines.english: Within my conscious mind, the One Lord is my only Support.
lines.transliteration: aykaa tayk mayrai man cheet.

lines.english: One who does this is my Friend. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis kichh karn aa so hamraa meet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਿਵ ॥
lines.english: My Friend is Carefree.
lines.transliteration: meet hamaaraa vayparvaahaa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I give my love to Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay mohi asnaahaa. ||2||

lines.english: My Friend is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: meet hamaaraa ant arjaamee.

lines.english: He is the All-powerful Being, the Supreme Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: samrath purakh paarbarahm su-aamee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master. pMnw 188
lines.transliteration: ham daasay t um th aakur mayray.

lines.english: Nanak: my honor and glory are Yours, God. ||4||40||109|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (188-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maan mahat naanak parabh  tayray. ||4||40||109||

lines.english: Those who have You on their side, O All-powerful Lord
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o tum bh a-ay samrath angaa.
taa ka-o kachh  naahee kaalangaa. ||1|| - no black stain can stick to them. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਭਏ ਸਮਰਥ  ਅੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord of wealth, those who place their hopes in You
lines.transliteration: maaDha-o jaa ka-o hai aas t umaaree.
taa ka-o kachh  naahee sansaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o. - nothing of the world can touch them at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਧਉ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਆਸ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with their Lord and Master
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hirdai th aakur ho-ay.
taa ka-o sahsaa naahee ko-ay. ||2|| - no anxiety can affect them. ||2||

lines.english: Those, unto whom You give Your consolation, God
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o tum d eenee parabh  Dheer.
taa kai nikat na aavai peer. ||3|| - pain does not even approach them. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found that Guru,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai so gur paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਨੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran daykh aa-i-aa. ||4||41||110|| who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God. ||4||41||110|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (188-5) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: This human body is so difficult to obtain; it is only obtained by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: dulabh  dayh paa-ee vadbh aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are murderers of thesoul. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam na jaapeh tay aat am gh aatee. ||1||

lines.english: Those who forget the Lord might just as well die.
lines.transliteration: mar na jaahee jinaa bisrat raam.

lines.english: Without the Naam, of what use are their lives? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam bihoon jeevan ka-un kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Eating, drinking, playing, laughing and showing off
lines.transliteration: khaat  peet khaylat hasat  bisthaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਿਹ  ਤੇ ਆਤਮ  ਘਾਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kavan arath mirtak seegaar. ||2|| - what use are the ostentatious displays of the dead? ||2||

lines.english: Those who do not listen to the Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss,
lines.transliteration: jo na suneh jas parmaanandaa.
pas pankhee t arigad  jon tay mand aa. ||3|| are worse off than beasts, birds or creeping creatures. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, the GurMantra has been implanted within me;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur mantar drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kayval naam rid maahi samaa-i-aa. ||4||42||111|| the Name alone is contained within my heart. ||4||42||111|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (188-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Whose mother is this? Whose father is this?
lines.transliteration: kaa kee maa-ee kaa ko baap.

lines.english: They are relatives in name only- they are all false. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam Dhaareek jh oothay sabh  saak. ||1||

lines.english: Why are you screaming and shouting, you fool?
lines.transliteration: kaahay ka-o moorakh bh akhlaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By good destiny and the Lord's Order, you have come into the world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil sanjog hukam tooN aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There is the one dust, the one light,
lines.transliteration: aykaa maatee aykaa jot.
ayko pavan kahaa ka-un rot. ||2|| the one praanic wind. Why are you crying? For whom do you cry? ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ  ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਪ ॥
lines.english: People weep and cry out, "Mine, mine!"
lines.transliteration: mayraa mayraa kar billaahee.

lines.english: This soul is not perishable. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maranhaar ih jee-araa naahee. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has opened my shutters;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur kholay kapaat.

lines.english: I am liberated, and my doubts have been dispelled. ||4||43||112|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (188-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-ay binsay bh aram thaat. ||4||43||112||

lines.english: Those who seem to be great and powerful,
lines.transliteration: vaday vaday jo deeseh log.
tin ka-o bi-aapai chint aa rog. ||1|| are afflicted by the disease of anxiety. ||1||

lines.english: Who is great by the greatness of Maya?
lines.transliteration: ka-un vadaa maa-i-aa vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: They alone are great, who are lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so vadaa jin raam liv laa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The landlord fights over his land each day.
lines.transliteration: bhoomee-aa bh oom oopar nit  lujhai.

lines.english: He shall have to leave it in the end, and yet his desire is still not satisfied. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chhod chalai t arisnaa nahee bujh ai. ||2||

lines.english: Says Nanak, this is the essence of Truth:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih tat  beechaaraa.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan naahee chh utkaaraa. ||3||44||113|| without the Lord's meditation, there is no salvation. ||3||44||113|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (188-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Perfect is the path; perfect is the cleansing bath.
lines.transliteration: pooraa maarag pooraa isnaan.

lines.english: Everything is perfect, if the Naam is in the heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  pooraa hird ai naam. ||1||

lines.english: One's honor remains perfect, when the Perfect Lord preserves it.
lines.transliteration: pooree rahee jaa poorai raakhee.

lines.english: His servant takes to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kee saran jan t aakee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Perfect is the peace; perfect is the contentment.
lines.transliteration: pooraa sukh pooraa sant okh.

lines.english: Perfect is the penance; perfect is the Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pooraa tap pooran raaj jog. ||2||

lines.english: On the Lord's Path, sinners are purified.
lines.transliteration: har kai maarag patit  puneet .

lines.english: Perfect is their glory; perfect is their humanity. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pooree sobhaa pooraa lokeek. ||3||

lines.english: They dwell forever in the Presence of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: karanhaar sad vasai had ooraa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect. ||4||45||114|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (188-19) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayraa satgur pooraa. ||4||45||114||

lines.english: Millions of sins are wiped away by the dust of the feet of the Saints. pMnw 189
lines.transliteration: sant kee Dh oor mitay agh  kot.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from birth and death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  janam maran  tay chh ot. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਤੇ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Blessed Vision of the Saints is the perfect cleansing bath.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d aras pooran isnaan.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, one comes to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant kirpaa t ay japee-ai naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, egotism is shed,
lines.transliteration: sant kai sang miti-aa ahaNkaar.
darisat aavai sabh  aykankaar. ||2|| and the One Lord is seen everywhere. ||2||

lines.english: By the pleasure of the Saints, the five passions are overpowered,
lines.transliteration: sant suparsan aa-ay vas panchaa.
amrit naam rid ai lai sanchaa. ||3|| and the heart is irrigated with the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa kaa pooraa karam.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis bh aytay saaDh oo kay charan. ||4||46||115|| touches the feet of the Holy. ||4||46||115|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (189-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Glories of the Lord, the heart-lotus blossoms radiantly.
lines.transliteration: har gun japat  kamal pargaasai.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all fears are dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har simrat t araas sabh  naasai. ||1||

lines.english: Perfect is that intellect, by which the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.
lines.transliteration: saa mat pooree jit  har gun  gaavai.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag saaDh oo sang paavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the treasure of the Name is obtained.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang paa-ee-ai niDh  naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਮਿਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, all one's works are brought to fruition. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang pooran sabh  kaamaa. ||2||

lines.english: Through devotion to the Lord, one's life is approved.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  janam parvaan .

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay naam vakh aan. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, that humble being is accepted,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak so jan parvaan.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai bh agvaan. ||4||47||116|| within whose heart the Lord God abides. ||4||47||116|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (189-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Those whose minds are imbued with the One Lord,
lines.transliteration: aykas si-o jaa kaa man raataa.
visree tisai paraa-ee t aataa. ||1|| forget to feel jealous of others. ||1||

lines.english: They see none other than the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: bin gobind na d eesai ko-ee.

lines.english: The Creator is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan kartaa so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who work willingly, and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har
lines.transliteration: maneh kamaavai mukh har har bolai.
so jan it ut  kateh na dolai. ||2|| - they do not waver, here or hereafter. ||2||

lines.english: Those who possess the wealth of the Lord are the true bankers.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai har Dhan so sach saahu.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has established their line of credit. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai kar deeno visaahu. ||3||

lines.english: The Giver of life, the Sovereign Lord King meets them.
lines.transliteration: jeevan purakh mili-aa har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||48||117|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (189-11) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak param pad paa-i-aa. ||4||48||117||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਿਹ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the breath of life of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: naam bhagat  kai paraan aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਿਹ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Naam is their wealth, the Naam is their occupation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naamo Dhan naamo bi-uhaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: By the greatness of the Naam, His humble servants are blessed with glory.
lines.transliteration: naam vadaa-ee jan sobhaa paa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself bestows it, in His Mercy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis aap divaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam is the home of peace of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: naam bhagat  kai sukh  asthaan.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, His devotees are approved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam rat so bh agat parvaan. ||2||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the support of His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam jan ka-o Dhaarai.

lines.english: With each and every breath, they remember the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saas saas jan naam samaarai. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, those who have perfect destiny
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis pooraa bhaag.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam sang taa kaa man laag. ||4||49||118|| - their minds are attached to the Naam. ||4||49||118|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (189-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I meditated on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Since then, my restless mind has been satisfied. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tab tay Dh aavat  man t ariptaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I have obtained the home of peace, singing His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sukh bisraam paa-i-aa gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: My troubles have ended, and the demon has been destroyed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saram miti-aa mayree hatee balaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal araaDh bh agvant aa.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, my anxiety has come to an end. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har simran tay mitee mayree chint aa. ||2||

lines.english: I have renounced all - I am an orphan. I have come to the Sanctuary of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh t aj anaath ayk saran  aa-i-o.

lines.english: Since then, I have found the highest celestial home. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ooch asthaan tab sehjay paa-i-o. ||3||

lines.english: My pains, troubles, doubts and fears are gone.
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad bharam bh a-o nasi-aa.

lines.english: The Creator Lord abides in Nanak's mind. ||4||50||119|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (189-19) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karanhaar naanak man basi-aa. ||4||50||119||

lines.english: With my hands I do His work; with my tongue I sing His Glorious Praises. pMnw 190
lines.transliteration: kar kar tahal rasnaa gun gaava-o.

lines.english: With my feet, I walk on the Path of my Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan thaakur kai maarag Dh aava-o. ||1||

lines.english: It is a good time, when I remember Him in meditation.
lines.transliteration: bhalo samo simran kee baree-aa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I cross over the terrifying world- ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simrat naam bh ai paar ut ree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With your eyes, behold the Blessed Vision of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: naytar sant an kaa d arsan paykh .

lines.english: Record the Immortal Lord God within your mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh avinaasee man meh laykh . ||2||

lines.english: Listen to the Kirtan of His Praises, at the Feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: sun keert an saaDh  peh jaa-ay.

lines.english: Your fears of birth and death shall depart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee t araas mitaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Enshrine the Lotus Feet of your Lord and Master within your heart.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal th aakur ur Dh aar.

lines.english: Thus this human life, so difficult to obtain, shall be redeemed. ||4||51||120|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (190-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dulabh  dayh naanak nist aar. ||4||51||120||

lines.english: Those, upon whom the Lord Himself showers His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o apnee kirpaa Dhaarai.
so jan rasnaa naam uchaaray. ||1|| chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with their tongues. ||1||

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, superstition and sorrow shall overtake you.
lines.transliteration: har bisrat sahsaa d ukh bi-aapai.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simrat naam bh aram bh a-o bh aagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and singing the Lord's Kirtan,
lines.transliteration: har keertan sun ai har keert an gaavai.
tis jan d ookh nikat nahee aavai. ||2|| misfortune shall not even come near you. ||2||

lines.english: Working for the Lord, His humble servants look beautiful.
lines.transliteration: har kee tahal karat jan sohai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The fire of Maya does not touch them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o maa-i-aa agan na pohai. ||3||

lines.english: Within their minds, bodies and mouths, is the Name of the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan mukh  har naam d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਕਰਤ  ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak has renounced other entanglements. ||4||52||121|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (190-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tajee-alay avar janjaal. ||4||52||121||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਇਆ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Renounce your cleverness, and your cunning tricks.
lines.transliteration: chhaad si-aanap baho chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ॥
lines.english: Seek the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee tayk tikaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Your pain shall depart, and in peace, you shall sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dukh binsay sukh  har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting the Perfect Guru, let yourself be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa bhayti-aa liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam dee-o gur mant ar.

lines.english: My worries are forgotten, and my anxiety is gone. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mitay visooray utree chint . ||2||

lines.english: Meeting with the Merciful Guru, I am in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-ay gur milat  kirpaal.

lines.english: Showering His Mercy, He has cut away the noose of the Messenger of Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa kaatay jam jaal. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur pooraa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ॥
lines.english: Maya shall no longer harass me. ||4||53||122|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (190-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taa tay bahur na bi-aapai maa-i-aa. ||4||53||122||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru Himself has saved me.
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-aa gur poorai aap.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with misfortune. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manmukh ka-o laago sant aap. ||1||

lines.english: Chant and meditate on the Guru, the Guru, O my friend.
lines.transliteration: guroo guroo jap meet hamaaray.

lines.english: Your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal hoveh d arbaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Enshrine the Feet of the Guru within your heart;
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan hird ai vasaa-ay.
dukh dusman t ayree hat ai balaa-ay. ||2|| your pains, enemies and bad luck shall be destroyed. ||2||

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is your Companion and Helper.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad t ayrai sang sahaa-ee.

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, all beings shall be kind to you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal bh a-ay saglay jee-a bh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਪ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Perfect Guru granted His Grace,
lines.transliteration: gur poorai jab kirpaa karee.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak mayree pooree paree. ||4||54||123|| says Nanak, I was totally, completely fulfilled. ||4||54||123|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (190-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Like beasts, they consume all sorts of tasty treats.
lines.transliteration: anik rasaa khaa-ay jaisay dh or.

lines.english: With the rope of emotional attachment, they are bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||
lines.transliteration: moh kee jayvree baaDhi-o chor. ||1||

lines.english: Their bodies are corpses, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: mirtak d ayh saaDh sang bihoonaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They come and go in reincarnation, and are destroyed by pain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  jonee d ukh kheenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They wear all sorts of beautiful robes,
lines.transliteration: anik bastar sund ar pehraa-i-aa.
ji-o darnaa khayt  maahi daraa-i-aa. ||2|| but they are still just scarecrows in the field, frightening away the birds. ||2||

lines.english: All bodies are of some use,
lines.transliteration: sagal sareer aavat sabh  kaam.
nihfal maanukh japai nahee naam. ||3|| but those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are totally useless. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, those unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa ka-o bha-ay d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 191
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil bh ajeh gopaalaa. ||4||55||124|| join the Saadh Sangat, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||4||55||124|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (190-19) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad quiets worries and troubles.
lines.transliteration: kal kalays gur sabad nivaaray.

lines.english: Coming and going ceases, and all comforts are obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay sukh  saaray. ||1||

lines.english: Fear is dispelled, meditating on the Fearless Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhai binsay nirbh a-o har Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har kay gun  gaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of the Lord within my heart.
lines.transliteration: charan kaval rid ant ar Dh aaray.

lines.english: The Guru has carried me across the ocean of fire. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agan saagar gur paar utaaray. ||2||

lines.english: I was sinking down, and the Perfect Guru pulled me out.
lines.transliteration: boodat jaat  poorai gur kaadh ay.

lines.english: I was cut off from the Lord for countless incarnations, and now the Guru united me with Him again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay tootay gaadhay. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis gur balihaaree.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis bhaytat  gat bha-ee hamaaree. ||4||56||125|| meeting Him, I have been saved. ||4||56||125|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (191-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, seek His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang t aa kee sarnee parahu.

lines.english: Place your mind and body in offering before Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan apnaa aagai Dh arahu. ||1||

lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam peevhu mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the fire of desire is totally quenched. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simar simar sabh t apat bujhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Renounce your arrogant pride, and end the cycle of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan janam maran  nivaarahu.

lines.english: Bow in humility to the feet of the Lord's slave. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kay daas kay charan  namaskaarahu. ||2||

lines.english: Remember God in your mind, with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: saas saas parabh maneh samaalay.

lines.english: Gather only that wealth, which shall go with you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so Dhan sanchahu jo chaalai naalay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone obtains it, upon whose forehead such destiny is written.
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  jis mast ak bh aag.

lines.english: Says Nanak, fall at the Feet of that Lord. ||4||57||126|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (191-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak taa kee charn ee laag. ||4||57||126||

lines.english: The dried branches are made green again in an instant.
lines.transliteration: sookay haray kee-ay khin maahay.

lines.english: His Ambrosial Glance irrigates and revives them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit d arisat sanch jeevaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੁ  ॥੪॥੫੭॥੧੨੬॥
lines.english: The Perfect Divine Guru has removed my sorrow.
lines.transliteration: kaatay kasat pooray gurdayv.

lines.english: He blesses His servant with His service. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sayvak ka-o deenee apunee sayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Anxiety is removed, and the desires of the mind are fulfilled,
lines.transliteration: mit ga-ee chint punee man aasaa.
karee da-i-aa sat gur gunt aasaa. ||2|| when the True Guru, the Treasure of Excellence, shows His Kindness. ||2||

lines.english: Pain is driven far away, and peace comes in its place;
lines.transliteration: dukh naath ay sukh  aa-ay samaa-ay.
