dheel na paree jaa gur furmaa-ay. ||3|| there is no delay, when the Guru gives the Order. ||3||

lines.english: Desires are fulfilled, when one meets the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: ichh punee pooray gur milay.

lines.english: O Nanak, His humble servant is fruitful and prosperous. ||4||58||127|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (191-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan sufal falay. ||4||58||127||

lines.english: The fever has departed; God has showered us with peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: taap ga-ay paa-ee parabh  saaNt.

lines.english: A cooling peace prevails; God has granted this gift. ||1||
lines.transliteration: seetal bh a-ay keenee parabh  daat. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਢੀਲ  ਨ ਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਿਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By God's Grace, we have become comfortable.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay bh a-ay suhaylay.

lines.english: Separated from Him for countless incarnations, we are now reunited with Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay bichhuray maylay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God's Name,
lines.transliteration: simrat simrat  parabh  kaa naa-o.
sagal rog kaa binsi-aa thaa-o. ||2|| the dwelling of all disease is destroyed. ||2||

lines.english: In intuitive peace and poise, chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay bolai har ban ee.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, O mortal, meditate on God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  simrahu paraan ee. ||3||

lines.english: Pain, suffering and the Messenger of Death do not even approach that one,
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad jam nayrh  na aavai.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo har gun gaavai. ||4||59||128|| says Nanak, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||59||128|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (191-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Auspicious is the day, and auspicious is the chance,
lines.transliteration: bhalay d inas bh alay sanjog.
jit bhaytay paarbarahm nirjog. ||1|| which brought me to the Supreme Lord God, the Unjoined, Unlimited One. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that time,
lines.transliteration: oh baylaa ka-o ha-o bal jaa-o.
jit mayraa man japai har naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. when my mind chants the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Blessed is that moment, and blessed is that time,
lines.transliteration: safal moorat safal oh gh aree.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jit rasnaa uchrai har haree. ||2|| when my tongue chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Haree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥੫੯॥੧੨੮॥
lines.english: Blessed is that forehead, which bows in humility to the Saints.
lines.transliteration: safal oh maathaa sant namaskaaras.

lines.english: Sacred are those feet, which walk on the Lord's Path. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan puneet  chaleh har maarag. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, auspicious is my karma,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhalaa mayraa karam.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jit bhaytay saaDh oo kay charan. ||4||60||129|| which has led me to touch the Feet of the Holy. ||4||60||129|| pMnw 192 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (192-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Keep the Word of the Guru's Shabad in your mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad raakh  man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਾਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all anxiety is removed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam simar chintaa sabh  jaahi. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Lord God, there is no one else at all.
lines.transliteration: bin bhagvant  naahee an ko-ay.

lines.english: He alone preserves and destroys. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maarai raakhai ayko so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Enshrine the Guru's Feet in your heart.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan rid ai ur Dh aar.

lines.english: Meditate on Him and cross over the ocean of fire. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agan saagar jap utreh paar. ||2||

lines.english: Focus your meditation on the Guru's Sublime Form.
lines.transliteration: gur moorat si-o laa-ay Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, you shall be honored. ||3||
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa paavahi maan. ||3||

lines.english: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag gur sarn ee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: My anxieties are over - O Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||61||130|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (192-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mitay andaysay naanak sukh  paa-i-aa. ||4||61||130||

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, all pains are gone.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat d ookh sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.english: The jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam ratan vasai man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, chant the Bani, the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jap man mayray govind kee ban ee.

lines.english: The Holy People chant the Lord's Name with their tongues. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo jan raam rasan vakh aanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ikas bin naahee doojaa ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: By His Glance of Grace, eternal peace is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee darisat sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Make the One Lord your friend, intimate and companion.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sakh aa kar ayk.

lines.english: Write in your mind the Word of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har akhar man meh laykh . ||3||

lines.english: The Lord Master is totally pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa sarbat su-aamee.

lines.english: Nanak sings the Praises of the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||62||131|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (192-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai naanak ant arjaamee. ||4||62||131||

lines.english: The whole world is engrossed in fear.
lines.transliteration: bhai meh rachi-o sabh  sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਖਰ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as their Support, feel no fear. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis bh a-o naahee jis naam aDh aaraa. ||1||

lines.english: Fear does not affect those who take to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: bha-o na vi-aapai t ayree sarn aa.

lines.english: You do whatever You please. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so-ee karn aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In pleasure and in pain, the world is coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: sog harakh meh aavan  jaanaa.

lines.english: Those who are pleasing to God, find peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin sukh  paa-i-aa jo parabh  bhaanaa. ||2||

lines.english: Maya pervades the awesome ocean of fire.
lines.transliteration: agan saagar mahaa vi-aapai maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who have found the True Guru are calm and cool. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say seetal jin sat gur paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Please preserve me, O God, O Great Preserver!
lines.transliteration: raakh lay-ay parabh  raakh anhaaraa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, what a helpless creature I am! ||4||63||132|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (192-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ki-aa jant vichaaraa. ||4||63||132||

lines.english: By Your Grace, I chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay japee-ai naa-o.

lines.english: By Your Grace, I obtain a seat in Your Court. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay dargeh thaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: Without You, O Supreme Lord God, there is no one.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin paarbarahm nahee ko-ay.

lines.english: By Your Grace, everlasting peace is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If You abide in the mind, we do not suffer in sorrow.
lines.transliteration: tum man vasay t a-o dookh na laagai.

lines.english: By Your Grace, doubt and fear run away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay bh aram bh a-o bh aagai. ||2||

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, Infinite Lord and Master,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aprampar su-aamee.

lines.english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa kay ant arjaamee. ||3||

lines.english: I offer this prayer to the True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kara-o ardaas apnay sat gur paas.

lines.english: O Nanak, may I be blessed with the treasure of the True Name. ||4||64||133|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (192-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai sach raas. ||4||64||133||

lines.english: As the husk is empty without the grain,
lines.transliteration: kan binaa jaisay thothar t ukhaa.
naam bihoon soonay say mukhaa. ||1|| so is the mouth empty without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, chant continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu nit paraan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੇ ਤਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, cursed is the body, which shall be taken back by Death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam bihoon Dharig d ayh bigaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without the Naam, no one's face shows good fortune.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa naahee mukh bh aag.

lines.english: Without the Husband, where is the marriage? ||2||
lines.transliteration: bharat  bihoon kahaa sohaag. ||2||

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, and attached to other tastes,
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar lagai an su-aa-ay.
taa kee aas na poojai kaa-ay. ||3|| no desires are fulfilled. ||3||

lines.english: O God, grant Your Grace, and give me this gift.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh apnee d aat.

lines.english: Please, let Nanak chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||65||134|| pMnw 193 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (193-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japai din raat . ||4||65||134||

lines.english: You are All-powerful, You are my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tooN samrath t ooNhai mayraa su-aamee.

lines.english: Everything comes from You; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tum tay tooN antarjaamee. ||1||

lines.english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is the Support of His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran jan ot.

lines.english: Millions are saved in Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  uDhrahi jan kot. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: As many creatures as there are - they are all Yours.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a t aytay sabh  tayray.

lines.english: By Your Grace, all sorts of comforts are obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay sookh  ghanayray. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever happens, is all according to Your Will.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh vart ai sabh  tayraa bh aanaa.

lines.english: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is absorbed in the TrueLord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hukam boojhai so sach samaan aa. ||3||

lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, God, and bestow this gift
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa deejai parabh  daan.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak simrai naam niDhaan. ||4||66||135|| upon Nanak, that he may meditate on the treasure of the Naam. ||4||66||135|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (193-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained,
lines.transliteration: taa kaa d aras paa-ee-ai vadbh aagee.
jaa kee raam naam liv laagee. ||1|| by those who are lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.english: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai har vasi-aa man maahee.
taa ka-o d ukh supnai bh ee naahee. ||1|| rahaa-o. do not suffer pain, even in dreams. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: All treasures have been placed within the minds of His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan raakh ay jan maahi.

lines.english: In their company, sinful mistakes and sorrows are taken away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa kai sang kilvikh  dukh jaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Glories of the Lord's humble servants cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: jan kee mahimaa kathee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The servants of the Supreme Lord God remain absorbed in Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jan rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Grant Your Grace, God, and hear my prayer:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh bin-o suneejai.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daas kee Dh oor naanak ka-o d eejai. ||4||67||136|| please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your slave. ||4||67||136|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (193-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, your misfortune shall be taken away,
lines.transliteration: har simrat t ayree jaa-ay balaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aan vasai man aa-ay. ||1|| and all joy shall come to abide in your mind. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate, O my mind, on the One Name.
lines.transliteration: bhaj man mayray ayko naam.

lines.english: It alone shall be of use to your soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a tayray kai aavai kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੪॥੬੭॥੧੩੬॥
lines.english: Night and day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord,
lines.transliteration: rain d inas gun  gaa-o anant aa.
gur pooray kaa nirmal manntaa. ||2|| through the Pure Mantra of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

lines.english: Give up other efforts, and place your faith in the Support of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: chhod upaav ayk tayk raakh .

lines.english: Taste the Ambrosial Essence of this, the greatest treasure. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahaa padaarath amrit  ras chaakh . ||3||

lines.english: They alone cross over the treacherous world-ocean,
lines.transliteration: bikham saagar t ay-ee jan t aray.

lines.english: O Nanak, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||4||68||137|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (193-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa ka-o nadar karay. ||4||68||137||

lines.english: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of God within my heart.
lines.transliteration: hirdai charan kamal parabh  Dhaaray.

lines.english: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, I am emancipated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooray satgur mil nist aaray. ||1||

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: govind gun  gaavhu mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Joining the Holy Saints, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo har naam Dh i-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is redeemed
lines.transliteration: dulabh  dayh ho-ee parvaan.
satgur t ay paa-i-aa naam neesaan. ||2|| when one receives the banner of the Naam from the True Guru. ||2||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the state of perfection is attained.
lines.transliteration: har simrat pooran pad  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt depart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh ai bharam mitaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord pervading.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  daykh-a-u t at rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: Slave Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||69||138|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (193-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas har kee sarn aa-ay. ||4||69||138||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: gur jee kay darsan ka-o bal jaa-o.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the True Guru, I live. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeevaa satgur naa-o. ||1||

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, O Perfect Divine Guru,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran gurdayv.
kar kirpaa laaga-o tayree sayv. ||1|| rahaa-o. show mercy to me, and commit me to Your service. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: I enshrine His Lotus Feet within my heart.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal hirdai ur Dh aaree.

lines.english: I offer my mind, body and wealth to the Guru, the Support of the breath of life. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an gur paraan aDh aaree. ||2||

lines.english: My life is prosperous, fruitful and approved;
lines.transliteration: safal janam hovai parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I know that the Guru, the Supreme Lord God, is near me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur paarbarahm nikat kar jaan. ||3||

lines.english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant Dh oor paa-ee-ai vadbh aagee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I have fallen in love with the Lord. ||4||70||139|| pMnw 194 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (194-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur bhaytat  har si-o liv laagee. ||4||70||139||

lines.english: They do their evil deeds, and pretend otherwise;
lines.transliteration: karai duhkaram d ikhaavai hor.
raam kee dargeh baaDh aa chor. ||1|| but in the Court of the Lord, they shall be bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||

lines.english: Those who remember the Lord belong to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam ramai so-ee raamaanaa.

lines.english: The One Lord is contained in the water, the land and the sky. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al ayk samaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Their inner beings are filled with poison, and yet with their mouths, they preach words of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: antar bikh  mukh  amrit  sunaavai.

lines.english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they are punished and beaten. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jam pur baaDhaa chotaa kh aavai. ||2||

lines.english: Hiding behind many screens, they commit acts of corruption,
lines.transliteration: anik parh-d ay meh kamaavai vikaar.
khin meh pargat hohi sansaar. ||3|| but in an instant, they are revealed to all the world. ||3||

lines.english: Those whose inner beings are true, who are attuned to the ambrosial essence of theNaam, the Name of the Lord
lines.transliteration: antar saach naam ras raat aa.

lines.english: - O Nanak, the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is merciful to them. ||4||71||140|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (194-5) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis kirpaal biDh aataa. ||4||71||140||

lines.english: The Lord's Love shall never leave or depart.
lines.transliteration: raam rang kaday ut ar na jaa-ay.

lines.english: They alone understand, unto whom the Perfect Guru gives it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa jis day-ay bujh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Love is true.
lines.transliteration: har rang raataa so man saachaa.

lines.english: The Love of the Beloved, the Architect of Destiny, is perfect. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laal rang pooran purakh biDh aataa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਉਤਿਰ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Sitting in the Society of the Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: santeh sang bais gun gaa-ay.

lines.english: The color of His Love shall never fade away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa kaa rang na ut rai jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, peace is not found.
lines.transliteration: bin har simran sukh nahee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: All the other loves and tastes of Maya are bland and insipid. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aan rang feekay sabh maa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Those who are imbued with love by the Guru become happy.
lines.transliteration: gur rangay say bha-ay nihaal.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has become merciful to them. ||4||72||141|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (194-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bha-ay hai d a-i-aal. ||4||72||141||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord Master, sinful mistakes are erased,
lines.transliteration: simrat su-aamee kilvikh  naasay.
sookh sahj aanand  nivaasay. ||1|| and one comes to abide in peace, celestial joy and bliss. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's humble servants place their faith in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam janaa ka-o raam bharosaa.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all anxieties are dispelled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam japat sabh  miti-o and aysaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੭੨॥੧੪੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, there is no fear or doubt.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang kachh  bha-o na bh araatee.

lines.english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung there, day and night. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal gaa-ee-ah d in raat ee. ||2||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, God has released me from bondage.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh banDh an chh ot.

lines.english: He has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kee d eenee ot. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, faith comes into the mind of His servant, who continually drinks in the Immaculate Praises of the Lord. ||4||73||142|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (194-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak man bha-ee part eet. nirmal jas peeveh jan neet . ||4||73||142||

lines.english: Those who keep their minds attached to the Lord's Feet
lines.transliteration: har charnee jaa kaa man laagaa.
dookh  darad bharam t aa kaa bh aagaa. ||1|| - pain, suffering and doubt run away from them. ||1||

lines.english: Those who deal in the Lord's wealth are perfect.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan ko vaapaaree pooraa.

lines.english: Those who are honored by the Lord are the true spiritual heroes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jisahi nivaajay so jan sooraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord of the Universe shows mercy,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bha-ay kirpaal gusaa-ee.
say jan laagay gur kee paa-ee. ||2|| fall at the Guru's Feet. ||2||

lines.english: They are blessed with peace, celestial bliss, tranquility and ecstasy;
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj saaNt aanand aa.
jap jap jeevay parmaanandaa. ||3|| chanting and meditating, they live in supreme bliss. ||3||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, I have earned the wealth of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam raas saaDh sang kh aatee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God has relieved my pain. ||4||74||143|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (194-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh apd aa kaatee. ||4||74||143||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all suffering is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: har simrat sabh  miteh kalays.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man meh parvays. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name, hundreds of thousands of times, O my dear,
lines.transliteration: uchrahu raam naam lakh baaree.
amrit ras peevhu parabh  pi-aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o. and drink deeply of the Ambrosial Essence of God. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Peace, celestial bliss, pleasures and the greatest ecstasy are obtained;
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj ras mahaa anand aa.
jap jap jeevay parmaanandaa. ||2|| chanting and meditating, you shall live in supreme bliss. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and ego are eradicated;
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mad kho-ay.
saaDh kai sang kilbikh  sabh  Dho-ay. ||3|| in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sinful mistakes are washed away.

lines.english: Grant Your Grace, O God, O Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||75||144|| pMnw 195 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (195-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak deejai saaDh  ravaalaa. ||4||75||144||

lines.english: They wear and eat the gifts from the Lord;
lines.transliteration: jis kaa dee-aa painai kh aa-ay.
tis si-o aalas ki-o banai maa-ay. ||1|| how can laziness help them, O mother? ||1||

lines.english: Forgetting her Husband Lord, and attaching herself to other affairs,
lines.transliteration: khasam bisaar aan kamm laageh.

lines.english: ||1||Pause||

lines.english: It would be like tying up an ox and trying to milk it,

ga-oo char singh paachh ai paavai. ||2|| or riding a cow to chase a tiger. ||2||

sa-uday ka-o Dh aavai bin poonjee. ||3|| the giver of all blessings; it would be like going out shopping without any money. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, consciously meditate on the Lord's Name.

lines.transliteration: simar su-aamee har saa meet. ||4||91||160||

lines.english: Pure and steady is that intellect,
lines.transliteration: saa mat nirmal kahee-at  Dheer.
raam rasaa-in peevat  beer. ||1|| which drinks in the Lord's sublime essence. ||1||

lines.english: Keep the Support of the Lord's Feet in your heart,
lines.transliteration: har kay charan hird ai kar ot.
janam maran t ay hovat  chhot. ||1|| rahaa-o. and you shall be saved from the cycle of birth and death. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Pure is that body, in which sin does not arise.
lines.transliteration: so tan nirmal jit  upjai na paap.

lines.english: In the Love of the Lord is pure glory. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam rang nirmal partaap. ||2||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, corruption is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mit jaat  bikaar.

lines.english: This is the greatest blessing of all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch ayho upkaar. ||3||

lines.english: Imbued with loving devotional worship of the Sustainer of the Universe,
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  raatay gopaal.

lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai saaDh ravaal. ||4||92||161||

lines.english: Such is my love for the Lord of the Universe;
lines.transliteration: aisee pareet govind  si-o laagee.
mayl la-ay pooran vadbhaagee. ||1|| rahaa-o. through perfect good destiny, I have been united with Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: As the wife is delighted upon beholding her husband,

ti-o har jan jeevai naam chit aaree. ||1|| so does the Lord's humble servant live by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.transliteration: poot paykh  ji-o jeevat  maat aa.
ot pot  jan har si-o raat aa. ||2|| so is the Lord's humble servant imbued with Him, through and through. ||2||

lines.english: As the greedy man rejoices upon beholding his wealth,
lines.transliteration: lobhee anad  karai paykh  Dhanaa.
jan charan kamal si-o laago manaa. ||3|| so is the mind of the Lord's humble servant attached to His Lotus Feet. ||3||

lines.english: May I never forget You, for even an instant, O Great Giver!
lines.transliteration: bisar nahee ik til d aataar.

lines.english: Nanak's God is the Support of his breath of life. ||4||93||162|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (198-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay parabh paraan aDh aar. ||4||93||162||

lines.english: Those humble beings who are accustomed to the Lord's sublime essence,
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in jo jan geeDh ay.
charan kamal paraym bhagt ee beeDh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. are pierced through with loving devotional worship of the Lord's Lotus Feet.||1||Pause||

lines.english: All other pleasures look like ashes;
lines.transliteration: aan rasaa deeseh sabh  chhaar.
naam binaa nihfal sansaar. ||1|| without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is fruitless. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself rescues us from the deep dark well.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay kaadh ay aap.

lines.english: Wondrous and Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gun govind  achraj part aap. ||2||

lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan pooran gopaal.

lines.english: The Expansive Lord God is Merciful to all beings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: barahm pasaar jee-a sang da-i-aal. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, that speech alone is excellent,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak saa kathnee saar.

lines.transliteration: maan layt jis sirjanhaar. ||4||94||163|| which is approved by the Creator Lord. ||4||94||163|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (198-18) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.transliteration: jhol mahaa ras har amrit  peejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.transliteration: nirmal udak govind  kaa naam.

lines.transliteration: majan karat pooran sabh  kaam. ||1||

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, spiritual conversations take place.
lines.transliteration: satsang t ah gosat ho-ay.

lines.english: The sinful mistakes of millions of incarnations are erased. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay kilvikh kh o-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Holy Saints meditate in remembrance, in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: simrahi saaDh karahi aanand .

lines.english: Their minds and bodies are immersed in supreme ecstasy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man tan ravi-aa parmaanand . ||3||

lines.transliteration: jisahi paraapat har charan  niDhaan. naanak d aas tiseh kurbaan. ||4||95||164||

lines.english: Do only that, by which no filth or pollution shall stick to you.
lines.transliteration: so kichh kar jit  mail na laagai.

lines.transliteration: har keertan meh ayhu man jaagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; do not be in love with duality.
lines.transliteration: ayko simar na doojaa bh aa-o.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, chant only the Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsang jap kayval naa-o. ||1||

lines.english: The karma of good actions, the Dharma of righteous living, religious rituals, fasts and worship
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam naym barat  poojaa.
paarbarahm bin jaan na doojaa. ||2|| - practice these, but do not know any other than the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

lines.english: Those who place their love in God - their works are brought to fruition. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa kee pooran ho-ee gh aal. jaa kee pareet  apunay parabh  naal. ||3||

lines.english: Infinitely invaluable is that Vaishnaav, that worshipper of Vishnu,
lines.transliteration: so baisno hai apar apaar.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin tajay bikaar. ||4||96||165|| says Nanak, who has renounced corruption. ||4||96||165|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (199-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: They desert you even when you are alive, O madman;
lines.transliteration: jeevat chh aad jaahi d ayvaanay.
mu-i-aa un tay ko varsaaNnay. ||1|| what good can they do when someone is dead? ||1||

lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe in your mind and body - this is your pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: simar govind man t an Dh ur likh i-aa.

lines.transliteration: bikhai th ag-uree jin jin kh aa-ee.

lines.english: The treacherous world-ocean is filled with terrible pain.

lines.transliteration: raam naam bin kaisay utras paar. ||3||

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved here andhereafter.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil d u-ay kul saaDh .

lines.transliteration: raam naam naanak aaraaDh. ||4||97||166||

lines.transliteration: gareebaa upar je khinjai d aarhee.

lines.english: The Creator administers true justice.
lines.transliteration: pooraa ni-aa-o karay kartaar.

lines.english: He is the Saving Grace of His slaves. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: apunay daas ka-o raakh anhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, His glory is manifest.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  pargat part aap.

lines.transliteration: nindak mu-aa upaj vad t aap. ||2||

lines.transliteration: tin maari-aa je rakh ai na ko-ay.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, his reputation is evil. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai mand ee so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord hugs His slaves close in His Embrace.
lines.transliteration: apunay daas raakh ai kanth  laa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary, and meditates on the Naam. ||4||98||167|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (199-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran naanak har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||4||98||167||

lines.english: The memorandum was proven to be false by the Lord Himself.
lines.transliteration: mahjar jhooth aa keet on aap.

lines.english: The sinner is now suffering in despair. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paapee ka-o laagaa santaap. ||1||

lines.transliteration: jisahi sahaa-ee gobid mayraa.
tis ka-o jam nahee aavai nayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. - death does not even approach them. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: In the True Court, they lie;
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh bolai koorh .
sir haath pachhorh ay anDh aa moorh . ||2|| the blind fools strike their own heads with their own hands. ||2||

lines.english: Sickness afflicts those who commit sins;
lines.transliteration: rog bi-aapay karday paap.

lines.english: God Himself sits as the Judge. ||3||
lines.transliteration: adlee ho-ay baith aa parabh  aap. ||3||

lines.transliteration: apan kamaa-i-ai aapay baaDhay.

lines.transliteration: darab ga-i-aa sabh  jee-a kai saathai. ||4||

lines.english: Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Court;
lines.transliteration: naanak saran paray darbaar.

lines.transliteration: raakhee paij mayrai kart aar. ||5||99||168|| my Creator has preserved my honor. ||5||99||168|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (199-18) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.transliteration: jan kee Dhoor man meeth  khataanee.

lines.transliteration: poorab karam likhi-aa Dh ur paraanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh man poor thiDh aa-ee.

lines.transliteration: saaDh Dh oor kar suDh  manjaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The body may be washed with loads of water,
lines.transliteration: anik jalaa jay Dhovai d ayhee.

lines.english: I have met the True Guru, who is merciful forever.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ayti-o sad aa kirpaal.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am rid of the fear of death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har simar simar kaati-aa bha-o kaal. ||3||

lines.english: Liberation, pleasures and worldly success are all in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh ugat jugat  har naa-o.

lines.english: With loving devotional worship, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||4||100||169|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (200-3) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  naanak gun  gaa-o. ||4||100||169||

lines.transliteration: jeevan padvee har kay d aas.

lines.transliteration: jin mili-aa aatam pargaas. ||1||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar Dh i-aa-ee-ai gopaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, gazing on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured.||2||101||170|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (200-6) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak darsan d aykh nihaal. ||2||101||170||

lines.english: Peace and tranquility have come; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has brought it.
lines.transliteration: saaNt bha-ee gur gobid  paa-ee.

lines.transliteration: taap paap binsay mayray bh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With your tongue, continually chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam naam nit rasan bakh aan.

lines.english: Disease shall depart, and you shall be saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binsay rog bha-ay kali-aan. ||1||

lines.english: Contemplate the Glorious Virtues of the Unfathomable Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm gun agam beechaar.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be emancipated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangam hai nist aar. ||2||

lines.english: Sing the Glories of God each and every day;
lines.transliteration: nirmal gun gaavhu nit  neet.
ga-ee bi-aaDh ubray jan meet . ||3|| your afflictions shall be dispelled, and you shall be saved, my humble friend. ||3||

lines.english: In thought, word and deed, I meditate on my God.
lines.transliteration: man bach karam parabh apnaa Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||102||171|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (200-10) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ee. ||4||102||171||

lines.transliteration: naytar pargaas kee-aa gurd ayv.

lines.transliteration: bharam ga-ay pooran bh a-ee sayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Giver of joy has saved him from smallpox.
lines.transliteration: seetlaa t ay rakh i-aa bihaaree.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has granted His Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh kirpaa Dh aaree. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone lives, who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japai so jeevai.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink deeply of the Lord's AmbrosialNectar. ||2||103||172|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (200-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how anyone find peace?
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kaisay sukh lahee-ai.

lines.english: With your tongue, chant the Praises of the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam naam jas kahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those
lines.transliteration: tin oopar jaa-ee-ai kurbaan .

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin japi-aa nirbaan. ||2||104||173|| who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||2||104||173|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (200-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: You are my Advisor; You are always with me.
lines.transliteration: tooNhai maslat  tooNhai naal.

lines.english: You preserve, protect and care for me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: toohai raakh ahi saar samaal. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the Lord, our Help and Support in this world and the next.
lines.transliteration: aisaa raam deen d unee sahaa-ee.

lines.english: He protects the honor of His slave, O my Sibling of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daas kee paij rakh ai mayray bh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He alone exists hereafter; this place is in His Power.
lines.transliteration: aagai aap ih thaan vas jaa kai.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, chant and meditate on the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar man har ka-o jaapai. ||2||

lines.transliteration: pat parvaan  sach neesaan .

lines.english: He Himself is the Giver; He Himself is the Cherisher.
lines.transliteration: aapay daat aa aap part ipaal.

lines.english: Continually, continuously, O Nanak, dwell upon the Name of the Lord. ||4||105||174|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (200-19) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nit nit  naanak raam naam samaal. ||4||105||174||

lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa bh a-i-aa kirpaal.
hirdai vasi-aa sad aa gupaal. ||1|| the Lord of the World abides in the heart forever. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, I have found eternal peace. pMnw 201
lines.transliteration: raam ravat sad  hee sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Sovereign Lord, the Perfect King, has shown His Mercy to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ma-i-aa karee pooran har raa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, one whose destiny is perfect,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa kay pooray bhaag.

lines.transliteration: har har naam asthir sohaag. ||2||106|| meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Everlasting Husband. ||2||106|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (201-2) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.transliteration: garDhap vaaNgoo laahay payt. ||1||

lines.transliteration: bin kartoot ee mukat  na paa-ee-ai.

lines.transliteration: mukat pad aarath naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis kirpaa Dhaarai.

lines.transliteration: hirdaa suDh  barahm beechaarai. ||4||107|| even his heart becomes pure, and he contemplates God. ||4||107|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (201-6) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.transliteration: satgur t umray kaaj savaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.transliteration: jan kee paij rakhee kart aaray. ||1||

lines.transliteration: baadisaah saah sabh  vas kar d eenay.
amrit naam mahaa ras peenay. ||2|| he drinks deeply of the most sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||2||

lines.english: Meditate fearlessly on the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o ho-ay bh ajahu bh agvaan.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this gift is given. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  mil keeno d aan. ||3||

lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;
lines.transliteration: saran paray parabh  antarjaamee.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ot pakree parabh su-aamee. ||4||108|| he grasps the Support of God, his Lord and Master. ||4||108|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (201-10) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਦਸਾਹ  ਸਾਹ ਸਭ ਵਿਸ ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be burned in the fire.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay bh aahi na jalai.

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be enticed by Maya.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay maa-i-aa nahee chh alai.

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be drowned in water.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay nahee doobai jalaa.

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, is prosperous and fruitful. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay sufal falaa. ||1||

lines.english: All fear is eradicated by Your Name.
lines.transliteration: sabh bh ai miteh t umaarai naa-ay.

lines.english: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhaytat  sang har har gun gaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, is free of all anxieties.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay mitai sabh  chint aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਭਾਿਹ  ਨ ਜਲੈ ॥
lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, is blessed with the Mantra of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har si-o so rachai jis saaDh kaa mannt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਹੀ ਛਲੈ ॥
lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, is not haunted by the fear of death.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay jam kee nahee t araas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਜਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, sees all his hopes fulfilled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay pooran aas. ||2||

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, does not suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay d ookh na laagai.

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, remains awake and aware, night and day.
lines.transliteration: har sang raataa an-d in jaagai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਟਤ  ਸੰਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, dwells in the home of intuitive peace.
lines.transliteration: har sang raataa sahj gh ar vasai.

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, sees his doubts and fears run away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay bh aram bh a-o nasai. ||3||

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, has the most sublime and exalted intellect.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay mat  ootam ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਸੋ ਰਚੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
lines.english: One who is attuned to the Lord, has a pure and spotless reputation.
lines.transliteration: har sang raatay nirmal so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who do not forget my God. ||4||109|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (201-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tin ka-o bal jaa-ee. jin ka-o parabh  mayraa bisrat  naahee. ||4||109||

lines.english: Through sincere efforts, the mind is made peaceful and calm.
lines.transliteration: udam karat  seetal man bh a-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Walking on the Lord's Way, all pains are taken away.
lines.transliteration: maarag chalat sagal d ukh ga-ay.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes blissful.
lines.transliteration: naam japat man bh a-ay anand.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਹਜ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, supreme bliss is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ras gaa-ay gun parmaanand. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: There is joy all around, and peace has come to my home.
lines.transliteration: khaym bh a-i-aa kusal gh ar aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, misfortune disappears. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhaytat  saaDh sang ga-ee balaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: My eyes are purified, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: naytar puneet  paykh at hee d aras.

lines.english: Dhan mast ak charan kamal hee paras. Blessed is the forehead which touches His Lotus Feet.
Working for the Lord of the Universe, the body becomes fruitful. pMnw 202
lines.transliteration: gobind kee tahal safal ih kaaN-i-aa.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  param pad  paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord is the Help and Support of His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: jan kee keenee aap sahaa-ay.

lines.english: I have found peace, falling at the feet of His slaves.
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-aa lag d aasah paa-ay.

lines.english: When selfishness is gone, then one becomes the Lord Himself;
lines.transliteration: aap ga-i-aa taa aapeh bh a-ay.
kirpaa niDhaan kee sarnee pa-ay. ||3|| seek the Sanctuary of the treasure of mercy. ||3||

lines.english: When someone finds the One he has desired,
lines.transliteration: jo chaahat so-ee jab paa-i-aa.
tab dh oodhan kahaa ko jaa-i-aa. then where should he go to look for Him?

lines.english: I have become steady and stable, and I dwell in the seat of peace.
lines.transliteration: asthir bha-ay basay sukh  aasan.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak has entered the home of peace. ||4||110|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (202-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak sukh  baasan. ||4||110||

lines.english: The merits of taking millions of ceremonial cleansing baths,
lines.transliteration: kot majan keeno isnaan.
laakh arab kh arab d eeno d aan. the giving of hundreds of thousands, billions and trillions in charity
jaa man vasi-o har ko naam. ||1|| - these are obtained by those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: Those who sing the Glories of the Lord of the World are totally pure.
lines.transliteration: sagal pavit gun gaa-ay gupaal.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਓ  ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Their sins are erased, in the Sanctuary of the Kind and Holy Saints. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paap miteh saaDhoo saran d a-i-aal. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The merits of performing all sorts of austere acts of penance and self-discipline,
lines.transliteration: bahut uraDh  tap saaDh an saaDh ay.
anik laabh manorath laaDh ay. earning huge profits and seeing one's desires fulfilled
har har naam rasan aaraaDhay. ||2|| - these are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with the tongue.

lines.english: The merits of reciting the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  bayd  bakh aanay.
jog gi-aan siDh sukh  jaanay. knowledge of the science of Yoga, spiritual wisdom and the pleasure of miraculousspiritual powers
naam japat parabh  si-o man maanay. ||3|| - these come by surrendering the mind and meditating on the Name of God. ||3||

lines.english: The wisdom of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is incomprehensible.
lines.transliteration: agaaDh boDh  har agam apaaray.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and contemplating the Naam withinour hearts,
lines.transliteration: naam japat naam rid ay beechaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, God has showered His Mercy upon us. ||4||111|| gauVI mÚ 5 ] (202-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh kirpaa Dh aaray. ||4||111||

lines.english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of the Guru within my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gur ridai basaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, the Supreme Lord God, is perfect.
lines.transliteration: gur gobind paarbarahm pooraa.

lines.english: Worshipping Him, my mind has found a lasting peace. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tiseh araaDh  mayraa man Dh eeraa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, and the Name of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: an-din japa-o guroo gur naam.

lines.english: Thus all my works are brought to perfection. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa tay siDh  bha-ay sagal kaaNm. ||2||

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind has become cool and tranquil,
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykh seetal man bh a-ay.
janam janam kay kilbikh ga-ay. ||3|| and the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, where is fear now, O Siblings of Destiny?
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kahaa bhai bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਪਉ  ਗੁ ਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Guru Himself has preserved the honor of His servant. ||4||112|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (202-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak kee aap paij rakhaa-ee. ||4||112||

lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Help and Support of His servants.
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak ka-o aap sahaa-ee.

lines.english: He always cherishes them, like their father and mother. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nit part ipaarai baap jaisay maa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: In God's Sanctuary, everyone is saved.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee saran ubrai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: That Perfect True Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan pooran sach so-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੀ ਆਿਪ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧੧੨॥
lines.english: My mind now dwells in the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: ab man basi-aa karnaihaaraa.

lines.english: My fears have been dispelled, and my soul has found the most sublime peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhai binsay aat am sukh  saaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord has granted His Grace, and saved His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnay jan raakhay.

lines.english: The sinful mistakes of so many incarnations have been washed away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilbikh laathay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਉਬਰੈ  ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Greatness of God cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: kahan na jaa-ay parabh kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is forever in His Sanctuary. ||4||113|| rwgu gauVI cyqI mhlw 5 dupdy  (202-17) raag ga-orhee chayt ee mehlaa 5 d upday Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (202-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa sarnaa-ee. ||4||113||

lines.english: The power of the Lord is universal and perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: raam ko bal pooran bhaa-ee.

lines.english: So no pain can ever afflict me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taa tay baritha na bi-aapai kaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever the Lord's slave wishes, O mother,
lines.transliteration: jo jo chitvai d aas har maa-ee.
so so kartaa aap karaa-ee. ||1|| the Creator Himself causes that to be done. ||1||

lines.english: God causes the slanderers to lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: nindak kee parabh  pat gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Fearless Lord. ||2||114|| pMnw 203 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (203-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har gun nirbh a-o gaa-ee. ||2||114||

lines.english: O Brave and Powerful God, Ocean of Peace, I fell into the pit - please, take my hand. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhuj bal beer barahm sukh  saagar garat  parat  geh layho anguree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My ears do not hear, and my eyes are not beautiful. I am in such pain; I am a poorcripple, crying at Your Door. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarvan na surat nain sund ar nahee aarat  du-aar ratat  pinguree-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਜ ਬਲ ਬੀਰ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਗਰਤ  ਪਰਤ  ਗਿਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਅੰਗੁਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Master of the poor and helpless, O Embodiment of Compassion, You are my Friendand Intimate, my Father and Mother.
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath anaath karun aa mai saajan meet  pitaa mahat ree-aa.

lines.english: Nanak holds tight to the Lord's Lotus Feet in his heart; thus the Saints cross over theterrifying world-ocean. ||2||2||115|| rwgu gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 5  (203-5) raag ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (203-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: charan kaval hirdai geh naanak bh ai saagar sant  paar ut ree-aa. ||2||2||115||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਿਨ  ਨ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨੈਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਨਹੀ ਆਰਤ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਰਟਤ  ਿਪੰਗੁਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord God, my Best Friend, please, abide with me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: da-y gusaa-ee meet ulaa t ooN sang hamaarai baas jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਜਨ  ਮੀਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਹਤਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, I cannot live, even for an instant, and my life in this world is cursed.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin gh aree na jeevnaa Dh arig rahn aa sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਵਲ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਗਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੰਤ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਰੀਆ  ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੫॥
lines.english: O Breath of Life of the soul, O Giver of peace, each and every instant I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan sukh -daati-aa nimakh  nimakh  balihaar jee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਬੈਰਾਗਿਣ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Please, God, give me the Support of Your Hand; lift me up and pull me out of this pit,O Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: hasat alamban d ayh parabh  gartahu uDh ar gopaal.

lines.punjabi: ਦਯ ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਮੀਤੁਲਾ  ਤੂੰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਮਾਰੈ  ਬਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am worthless, with such a shallow intellect; You are always Merciful to the meek.||2||
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun mat thoree-aa t ooN sad hee d een d a-i-aal. ||2||

lines.english: What comforts of Yours can I dwell upon? How can I contemplate You?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa sukh t ayray sammlaa kavan biDh ee beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਘਰੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਰਹਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: You lovingly absorb Your slaves into Your Sanctuary, O Lofty, Inaccessible and InfiniteLord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saran samaa-ee d aas hit  oochay agam apaar. ||3||

lines.english: All wealth, and the eight miraculous spiritual powers are in the supremely sublimeessence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath asat siDh  naam mahaa ras maahi.

lines.english: Those humble beings, with whom the beautifully-haired Lord is thoroughly pleased,sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: suparsan bha-ay kaysvaa say jan har gun  gaahi. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਮਿਤ ਥੋਰੀਆ  ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are my mother, father, son and relative; You are the Support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  banDh po tooN mayray paraan  aDhaar.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Lord, and swims across the poisonous world-ocean. ||5||1||116|| gauVI bYrwgix rhoey ky CMq ky Gir mÚ 5  (203-12) ga-orhee bairaagan  raho-ay kay chh ant kay gh ar mehlaa 5 Gauree Bairaagan, Chhants Of Rehoay, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (203-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak bh ajai bikh  tari-aa sansaar. ||5||1||116||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਦਾਸ ਿਹਤ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Is there anyone who will sing of the Beloved Lord?
lines.transliteration: hai ko-ee raam pi-aaro gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਅਸਟ  ਿਸਿਧ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Surely, this will bring all pleasures and comforts. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aan sookh  sach paavai. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਭਏ ਕੇਸਵਾ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਿਹ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The renunciate goes out into the woods, searching for Him.
lines.transliteration: ban ban khojat  firat bairaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ  ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਅਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: But those who embrace love for the One Lord are very rare.
lines.transliteration: birlay kaahoo ayk liv laagee.

lines.english: Those who find the Lord are very fortunate and blessed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin har paa-i-aa say vadbhaagee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਬੈਰਾਗਿਣ  ਰਹੋਏ  ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਕੇ ਘਿਰ  ਮਃ ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Gods like Brahma and Sanak yearn for Him;
lines.transliteration: barahmaadik sankaad ik chaahai.
jogee jatee siDh  har aahai. the Yogis, celibates and Siddhas yearn for the Lord.

lines.english: One who is so blessed, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jisahi paraapat so har gun  gaahai. ||2||

lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten Him.
lines.transliteration: taa kee saran  jin bisrat  naahee.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one meets the Lord's Saint.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har sant  milaahee.

lines.english: They are not subject to the cycle of birth and death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam maran t ih moolay naahee. ||3||

lines.english: Show Your Mercy, and lead me to meet You, O my Darling Beloved.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mil pareetam pi-aaray.

lines.english: Hear my prayer, O Lofty and Infinite God;
lines.transliteration: bin-o sunhu parabh ooch apaaray.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the Support of Your Name. ||4||1||117|| pMnw 204 rwgu gauVI pUrbI mhlw 5  (204-1) raag ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (204-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak maaNgat naam aDh aaray. ||4||1||117||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਪੂਰਬੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: By what virtues can I meet the Lord of life, O my mother? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kavan gun paraanpat mila-o mayree maa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have no beauty, understanding or strength; I am a stranger, from far away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: roop heen buDh bal heenee mohi pard aysan d oor tay aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I am not wealthy or youthful. I am an orph an - please, unite me with Yourself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naahin darab na joban maat ee mohi anaath kee karahu samaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪ ਹੀਨ ਬੁਿਧ ਬਲ ਹੀਨੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਪਰਦੇਸਿਨ  ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Searching and searching, I have become a renunciate, free of desire. I wander around, searching for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat bha-ee bairaagan parabh  darsan ka-o ha-o firat  tisaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਹਨ  ਦਰਬੁ  ਨ ਜੋਬਨ  ਮਾਤੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਅਨਾਥ  ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: God is Compassionate, and Merciful to the meek; O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, the fire of desire has been quenched. ||4||1||118|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (204-5) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaal parabh  naanak saaDh sang mayree jalan bujh aa-ee. ||4||1||118||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਹਉ ਿਫਰਤ  ਿਤਸਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The loving desire to meet my Beloved has arisen within my mind.
lines.transliteration: parabh milbay ka-o pareet  man laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਪਰ੍ਭ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਮੇਰੀ ਜਲਿਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧੮॥
lines.english: I touch His Feet, and offer my prayer to Him. If only I had the great good fortune to meet the Saint. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paa-ay laga-o mohi kara-o bayntee ko-oo sant  milai badbh aagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I surrender my mind to Him; I place my wealth before Him. I totally renounce myselfish ways.
lines.transliteration: man arpa-o Dhan raakh a-o aagai man kee mat  mohi sagal t i-aagee.

lines.english: One who teaches me the Sermon of the Lord God - night and day, I shall follow Him.||1||
lines.transliteration: jo parabh kee har kathaa sunaavai an-d in fira-o t is pichh ai viraagee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇ  ਲਗਉ  ਮੋਿਹ ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਕੋਊ ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the seed of the karma of past actions sprouted, I met the Lord; He is both theEnjoyer and the Renunciate.
lines.transliteration: poorab karam ankur jab pargatay bhayti-o purakh  rasik bairaagee.

lines.english: My darkness was dispelled when I met the Lord. O Nanak, after being asleep forcountless incarnations, I have awakened. ||2||2||119|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (204-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: miti-o anDhayr milat  har naanak janam janam kee so-ee jaagee. ||2||2||119||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ  ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ  ਆਗੈ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਮੋਿਹ ਸਗਲ  ਿਤਆਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Come out, O soul-bird, and let the meditative remembrance of the Lord be yourwings.
lines.transliteration: nikas ray pankhee simar har paaNkh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਪਰ੍ਭ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਿਫਰਉ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਪਛੈ ਿਵਰਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meet the Holy Saint, take to His Sanctuary, and keep the perfect jewel of the Lordenshrined in your heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo saran  gahu pooran raam rat an hee-aray sang raakh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਬ  ਕਰਮ  ਅੰਕੁਰ ਜਬ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਰਿਸਕ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Superstition is the well, thirst for pleasure is the mud, and emotional attachment is the noose, so tight around your neck.
lines.transliteration: bharam kee koo-ee t arisnaa ras pankaj at  teekh-yan moh kee faas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਟਓ  ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਿਮਲਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The only one who can cut this is the Guru of the World, the Lord of the Universe. Solet yourself dwell at His Lotus Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaatanhaar jagat gur gobid  charan kamal t aa kay karahu nivaas. ||1||

lines.english: Bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of the Universe, O God, My Beloved, Master of the meek -please, listen to my prayer.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gobind parabh  pareet am deenaa naath sunhu ard aas.

lines.english: Take my hand, O Lord and Master of Nanak; my body and soul all belong to You.||2||3||120|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (204-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar geh layho naanak kay su-aamee jee-o pind sabh t umree raas. ||2||3||120||

lines.english: My mind yearns to behold the Lord in meditation.
lines.transliteration: har paykhan ka-o simrat  man mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਿਣ  ਗਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਅਰੇ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਖੁ॥੧॥ਰਹਾਉ॥
lines.english: I think of Him, I hope and thirst for Him, day and night; is there any Saint who may bring Him near me? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aasee chitva-o d in rainee hai ko-ee sant  milaavai nayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਕੀ ਕੂਈ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਰਸ ਪੰਕਜ  ਅਿਤ  ਤੀਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਣ  ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.english: I serve the slaves of His slaves; in so many ways, I beg of Him.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa kara-o daas d aasan kee anik bh aaNt tis kara-o nihoraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ਜਗਤ  ਗੁਰ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਨਵਾਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Setting them upon the scale, I have weighed all comforts and pleasures; without the Lord's Blessed Vision, they are all totally inadequate. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tulaa Dh aar tolay sukh  saglay bin har d aras sabh o hee thoraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Praises of the Ocean of virtue; after countlessincarnations, I have been released.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  gaa-ay gun saagar janam janam ko jaat  bahoraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨੦॥
lines.english: Meeting the Lord, Nanak has found peace and bliss; his life is redeemed, andprosperity dawns for him. ||2||4||121|| rwgu gauVI pUrbI mhlw 5  (204-17) raag ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (204-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: aanad sookh  bhaytat har naanak janam kirt aarath safal savayraa. ||2||4||121||

lines.english: How may I meet my Master, the King, the Lord of the Universe?
lines.transliteration: kin biDh milai gusaa-ee mayray raam raa-ay.

lines.english: Is there any Saint, who can bestow such celestial peace, and show me the Way to Him? ||1||Pause|| pMnw 205
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aisaa sant sahj sukh -daata mohi maarag d ay-ay bat aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Unseen Lord is deep within the self; He cannot be seen; the curtain of egotism intervenes.
lines.transliteration: antar alakh  na jaa-ee lakh i-aa vich parh -daa ha-umai paa-ee.

lines.english: In emotional attachment to Maya, all the world is asleep. Tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled? ||1||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi sabho jag so-i-aa ih bh aram kahhu ki-o jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਲਿਖਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਪੜਦਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The one lives together with the other in the same house, but they do not talk to oneanother, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: aykaa sangat ikat  garihi bast ay mil baat  na kart ay bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਕਹਹੁ ਿਕਉ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the one substance, the five are miserable; that substance is in theunapproachable place. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayk basat bin panch d uhaylay oh basat  agochar th aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਾ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਇਕਤੁ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਬਸਤੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: And the one whose home it is, has locked it up, and given the key to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa garihu tin d ee-aa t aalaa kunjee gur sa-upaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ  ਿਬਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ  ਓਹ ਬਸਤੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਠਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You may make all sorts of efforts, but it cannot be obtained, without the Sanctuary ofthe True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anik upaav karay nahee paavai bin satgur sarn aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਿਤਿਨ  ਦੀਆ  ਤਾਲਾ  ਕੁੰਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਉਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those whose bonds have been broken by the True Guru, enshrine love for the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jin kay banDhan kaatay sat gur tin saaDh sangat  liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The self-elect, the self-realized beings, meet together and sing the joyous songs ofthe Lord. Nanak, there is no difference between them, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||
lines.transliteration: panch janaa mil mangal gaa-i-aa har naanak bhayd  na bh aa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਤਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This is how my Sovereign Lord King, the Lord of the Universe, is met;
lines.transliteration: mayray raam raa-ay in biDh milai gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: ||1||122|| celestial bliss is attained in an instant, and doubt is dispelled. Meeting Him, my lightmerges in the Light. ||1||Second Pause||1||122|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (205-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pUrbI, mÚ 5) sahj bha-i-aa bh aram kh in meh naath aa mil jot ee jot  samaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa.

lines.english: I am intimate with Him;
lines.transliteration: aiso parcha-o paa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਠਾ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: karee kirpaa da-i-aal beeth ulay sat gur mujh eh bat aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. granting His Grace, my Kind Beloved has told me of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  daykh-a-u t at tat tum hee mohi ih bisu-aas ho-ay aa-i-o.

lines.english: Unto whom should I pray? The Lord Himself hears all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kai peh kara-o ardaas baynt ee ja-o sunt o hai ragh uraa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: My anxiety is over. The Guru has cut away my bonds, and I have found eternal peace.
lines.transliteration: lahi-o sahsaa banDhan gur t oray t aaN sadaa sahj sukh  paa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੀ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਬੀਠੁਲੈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਮੁਝਿਹ  ਬਤਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever shall be, shall be in the end; so where can pain and pleasure be seen? ||2||
lines.transliteration: honaa saa so-ee fun hosee sukh  dukh kahaa d ikhaa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: The continents and the solar systems rest in the support of the One Lord. The Guruhas removed the veil of illusion, and shown this to me.
lines.transliteration: khand barahmand kaa ayko th aanaa gur pard aa kh ol dikhaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮੋਿਹ ਇਹੁ ਿਬਸੁਆਸੁ  ਹੋਇ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The nine treasures of the wealth of the Name of the Lord are in that one place. Where else should we go? ||3||
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam niDh aan ik th aa-ee t a-o baahar kaith ai jaa-i-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੈ ਪਿਹ ਕਰਉ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਜਉ ਸੁਨਤੋ  ਹੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The same gold is fashioned into various articles; just so, the Lord has made the manypatterns of the creation.
lines.transliteration: aykai kanik anik bhaat  saajee baho parkaar rachaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਿਹਓ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਗੁਿਰ ਤੋਰੇ ਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, my essence merges intoGod's essence. ||4||2||123|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (205-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bharam gur kh o-ee hai iv t atai tat milaa-i-o. ||4||2||123||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਿਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਾ ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This life is diminishing, day and night.
lines.transliteration: a-oDh gh atai d inas rainaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਣਾ ਗੁਿਰ ਪਰਦਾ  ਖੋਿਲ ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man gur mil kaaj savaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ  ਤਉ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕੈਠੈ ਜਾਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!
lines.transliteration: kara-o baynantee sunhu mayray meet aa sant  tahal kee baylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੈ ਕਿਨਕ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਾਿਤ  ਸਾਜੀ  ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ  ਰਚਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell inpeace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaa khaat chalhu har laahaa aagai basan suhaylaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਇਵ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਿਮਲਾਇਓ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੩॥
lines.english: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God aresaved.
lines.transliteration: ih sansaar bikaar sahsay meh tari-o barahm gi-aanee.

lines.english: Those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this sublime essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jisahi jagaa-ay pee-aa-ay har ras akath kathaa tin jaanee. ||2||

lines.english: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, theLord shall dwell within your mind.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o aa-ay so-ee vihaajhahu har gur t ay maneh basayraa.

lines.english: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel ofreincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal paavhu sukh  sehjay bahur na ho-igo fayraa. ||3||

lines.english: O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee purakh  biDhaatay sarDh aa man kee pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ  ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ  ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of theSaints. ||4||3||124|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (205-18) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas ihee sukh  maagai mo ka-o kar sant an kee Dh ooray. ||4||3||124||

lines.punjabi: ਈਹਾ  ਖਾਿਟ  ਚਲਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਹਾ  ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Save me, O My Father God.
lines.transliteration: raakh pit aa parabh  mayray.

lines.english: I am worthless and without virtue; all virtues are Yours. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun sabh gun t ayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਜਗਾਇ  ਪੀਆਏ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The five vicious thieves are assaulting my poor being; save me, O Savior Lord!
lines.transliteration: panch bikhaad ee ayk gareebaa raakh o raakh anhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ  ਸੋਈ ਿਵਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਿਹ  ਬਸੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: They are tormenting and torturing me. I have come, seeking Your Sanctuary. ||1|| pMnw 206
lines.transliteration: khayd  karahi ar bahut  santaaveh aa-i-o saran t uhaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਹ  ਅਰੁਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਿਹ  ਆਇਓ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਤੁਹਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Trying all sorts of things, I have grown weary, but still, they will not leave me alone.
lines.transliteration: kar kar haari-o anik baho bhaat ee chh odeh kat ahooN naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਹਾਿਰਓ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ  ਛੋਡਿਹ  ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: But I have heard that they can be rooted out, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; and so I seek their Shelter. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayk baat sun t aakee otaa saaDh sang mit jaahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਿਨ ਤਾਕੀ  ਓਟਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਜਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In their Mercy, the Saints have met me, and from them, I have obtained satisfaction.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa sant milay mohi t in tay Dh eeraj paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸੰਤ ਿਮਲੇ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਤਨ  ਤੇ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints have given me the Mantra of the Fearless Lord, and now I practice theWord of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: santee mant  dee-o mohi nirbh a-o gur kaa sabad  kamaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have now conquered those terrible evil-doers, and my speech is now sweet andsublime.
lines.transliteration: jeet la-ay o-ay mahaa bikh aadee sahj suhaylee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਿਤ  ਲਏ ਓਇ ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖਾਦੀ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind; I have obtained the stateof Nirvaanaa. ||4||4||125|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (206-5) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak man bha-i-aa pargaasaa paa-i-aa pad  nirbaan ee. ||4||4||125||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
lines.english: He is the Eternal King.
lines.transliteration: oh abhinaasee raa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Fearless Lord abides with you. So where does this fear come from? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o sang t umaarai bast ay ih daran kahaa t ay aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In one person, You are arrogant and proud, and in another, You are meek and humble.
lines.transliteration: ayk mahal tooN hohi afaaro ayk mahal nimaano.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਮਾਰੈ  ਬਸਤੇ  ਇਹੁਡਰਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In one person, You are all by Yourself, and in another, You are poor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk mahal tooN aapay aapay ayk mahal gareebaano. ||1||

lines.english: In one person, you are a Pandit, a religious scholar and a preacher, and in another,You are just a fool.
lines.transliteration: ayk mahal tooN pandit  baktaa ayk mahal kh al hot aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ  ਤੂੰ ਹੋਿਹ ਅਫਾਰੋ  ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ  ਿਨਮਾਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: In one person, You grab hold of everything, and in another, You accept nothing. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayk mahal tooN sabh  kichh  garaahaj ayk mahal kachh oo na layt aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ ਗਰੀਬਾਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can the poor wooden puppet do? The Master Puppeteer knows everything.
lines.transliteration: kaath kee put ree kahaa karai bapuree kh ilaavanhaaro jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ  ਤੂੰ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਬਕਤਾ  ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ  ਖਲੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.english: As the Puppeteer dresses the puppet, so is the role the puppet plays. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa bhaykh  karaavai baajeegar oh t aiso hee saaj aanai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ  ਤੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਗਰ੍ਾਹਜੁ ਏਕ ਮਹਿਲ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੇਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord has created the various chambers of assorted descriptions, and He Himself protects them.
lines.transliteration: anik kothree bahut  bhaat karee-aa aap ho-aa rakh vaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ  ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰੀ  ਿਖਲਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ  ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: As is that vessel in which the Lord places the soul, so does it dwell. What can thispoor being do? ||4||
lines.transliteration: jaisay mahal raakhai t aisai rahnaa ki-aa ih karai bichaaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਭੇਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁਓਹੁ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੁ ਆਨੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The One who created the thing, understands it; He has fashioned all of this.
lines.transliteration: jin kichh kee-aa so-ee jaanai jin ih sabh  biDh saajee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਕੋਠਰੀ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭਾਿਤ  ਕਰੀਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੋਆ  ਰਖਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord and Master is Infinite; He alone understands the value of HisCreation. ||5||5||126|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (206-11) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak aprampar su-aamee keemat apunay kaajee. ||5||5||126||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਿਲ  ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸੈ ਰਹਨਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਇਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਿਬਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Give them up - give up the pleasures of corruption;
lines.transliteration: chhod chh od ray bikh i-aa kay rasoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹ ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਸਾਜੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: urajh rahi-o ray baavar gaavar ji-o kirkh ai hari-aa-i-o pasoo-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. you are entangled in them, you crazy fool, like an animal grazing in the green fields.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਾਜੀ  ॥੫॥੫॥੧੨੬॥
lines.english: That which you believe to be of use to you, shall not go even an inch with you.
lines.transliteration: jo jaaneh tooN apunay kaajai so sang na chaalai t ayrai t asoo-aa.
