lines.english: Naked you came, and naked you shall depart. You shall go round and round the cycleof birth and death, and you shall be food for Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naago aa-i-o naag siDhaasee fayr firi-o ar kaal garsoo-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Watching, watching the transitory dramas of the world, you are embroiled and enmeshed in them, and you laugh with delight.
lines.transliteration: paykh paykh  ray kasumbh  kee leelaa raach maach t inhooN la-o hasoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਿਝ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਰੇ ਬਾਵਰ  ਗਾਵਰ  ਿਜਉ ਿਕਰਖੈ  ਹਿਰਆਇਓ  ਪਸੂਆ  ॥੧ ॥
lines.english: The string of life is wearing thin, day and night, and you have done nothing for yoursoul. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chheejat  dor d inas ar rainee jee-a ko kaaj na keeno kachh oo-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Doing your deeds, you have grown old; your voice fails you, and your body hasbecome weak.
lines.transliteration: karat karat  iv hee birDh aano haari-o ukt ay tan kh eensoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਾਜੈ  ਸੋ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਤੇਰੈ ਤਸੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: You were enticed by Maya in your youth, and your attachment for it has notdiminished, one little bit. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o mohi-o un mohnee baalaa us tay gh atai naahee ruch chasoo-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਗੋ  ਆਇਓ  ਨਾਗ  ਿਸਧਾਸੀ  ਫੇਿਰ ਿਫਿਰਓ  ਅਰੁ ਕਾਿਲ  ਗਰਸੂਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has shown me that this is the way of the world; I have abandoned thedwelling of pride, and entered Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jag aisaa mohi gureh dikh aa-i-o t a-o saran  pari-o t aj garabsu-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖ ਪੇਿਖ ਰੇ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ  ਰਾਿਚ  ਮਾਿਚ  ਿਤਨਹੂੰ ਲਉ ਹਸੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||6||127|| The Saint has shown me the Path of God; slave Nanak has implanted devotionalworship and the Praise of the Lord. ||4||6||127|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (206-18) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maarag parabh ko sant  bataa-i-o d arirhee naanak d aas bh agat har jasoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਛੀਜਤ  ਡੋਿਰ ਿਦਨਸੁ ਅਰ ੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ  ਕੋ ਕਾਜੁ  ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਛੂਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Except for You, who is mine?
lines.transliteration: tujh bin kavan hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤ  ਕਰਤ  ਇਵ ਹੀ ਿਬਰਧਾਨੋ  ਹਾਿਰਓ ਉਕਤੇ  ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਸੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, You are the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetam paraan aDh aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਉਿਨ  ਮੋਹਨੀ  ਬਾਲਾ  ਉਸ ਤੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰੁਚ ਚਸੂਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You alone know the condition of my inner being. You are my Beautiful Friend.
lines.transliteration: antar kee biDh  tum hee jaanee t um hee sajan suhaylay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੋਿਹ ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ਤਉ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਤਿਜ ਗਰਬਸੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: I receive all comforts from You, O my Unfathomable and Immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1|| pMnw 207
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai t ujh tay paa-ay mayray th aakur agah at olay. ||1||

lines.english: I cannot describe Your Manifestations, O Treasure of Excellence, O Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: baran na saaka-o tumray rangaa gun  niDhaan sukh -daatay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਰੰਗਾ ਗੁ ਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible and Imperishable; He is known through the Perfect Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar parabh abh inaasee pooray gur t ay jaat ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My doubt and fear have been taken away, and I have been made pure, since my egowas conquered.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh a-o kaat kee-ay nihkayval jab t ay ha-umai maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਿਟ  ਕੀਏ ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲ  ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My fear of birth and death has been abolished, beholding Your Blessed Vision in theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam maran ko chooko sahsaa saaDh sangat  darsaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ ਕੋ ਚੂਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਦਰਸਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I wash the Guru's Feet and serve Him; I am a sacrifice to Him, 100,000 times.
lines.transliteration: charan pakh aar kara-o gur sayvaa baar jaa-o lakh  baree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਪਖਾਿਰ  ਕਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਾਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, servant Nanak has crossed over this terrifying world-ocean; I am united with my Beloved. ||4||7||128|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (207-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad ih bh a-ojal t ari-aa jan naanak pari-a sang miree-aa. ||4||7||128||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ ਇਹ ੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਰੀਆ  ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨੮॥
lines.english: Who can please You, except You Yourself?
lines.transliteration: tujh bin kavan reejh aavai t ohee.

lines.english: Gazing upon Your Beauteous Form, all are entranced. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayro roop sagal d aykh mohee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the heavenly paradise, in the nether regions of the underworld, on the planet earthand throughout the galaxies, the One Lord is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: surag pa-i-aal mirat bh oo-a mandal sarab samaano aykai ohee.

lines.english: Everyone calls upon You with their palms pressed together, saying, "Shiva, Shiva". OMerciful Lord and Master, everyone cries out for Your Help. ||1||
lines.transliteration: siv siv karat sagal kar joreh sarab ma-i-aa th aakur t ayree d ohee. ||1||

lines.english: Your Name, O Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners, the Giver of peace,immaculate, cooling and soothing.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan th aakur naam t umraa sukh -daa-ee nirmal seet lohee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਗ  ਪਇਆਲ  ਿਮਰਤ  ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲ  ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਨੋ  ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, spiritual wisdom, meditation and glorious greatness come from dialogue anddiscourse with Your Saints. ||2||8||129|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (207-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan naanak vadi-aa-ee sant  tayray si-o gaal galohee. ||2||8||129||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਿਸਵ ਕਰਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿਹ  ਸਰਬ  ਮਇਆ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੇਰੀ ਦੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meet with me, O my Dear Beloved.
lines.transliteration: milhu pi-aaray jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸੀਤਲੋਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: O God, whatever You do - that alone happens. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee-aa t umaaraa thee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਸਉ ਗਾਲ  ਗਲੋਹੀ  ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੯॥
lines.english: Wandering around through countless incarnations, I endured pain and suffering in somany lives, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: anik janam baho jonee bharmi-aa bahur bahur d ukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Your Grace, I obtained this human body; grant me the Blessed Vision of YourDarshan, O Sovereign Lord King. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay maanukh  dayh paa-ee hai d ayh d aras har raa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: That which pleases His Will has come to pass; no one else can do anything.
lines.transliteration: so-ee ho-aa jo tis bh aanaa avar na kin hee keet aa.

lines.english: By Your Will, enticed by the illusion of emotional attachment, the people are asleep;they do not wake up. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tumrai bh aanai bharam mohi mohi-aa jaagat  naahee soot aa. ||2||

lines.english: Please hear my prayer, O Lord of Life, O Beloved, Ocean of mercy and compassion.
lines.transliteration: bin-o sunhu tum paraanpat  pi-aaray kirpaa niDh  da-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਨਮ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰ੍ਿਮਆ ਬਹ ੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Save me, O my Father God. I am an orphan - please, cherish me! ||3||
lines.transliteration: raakh layho pit aa parabh  mayray anaathah kar part ipaalaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ  ਹੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, for the sake of the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jis no tumeh d ikhaa-i-o d arsan saaDh sangat  kai paachh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Grant Your Grace, and bless us with the dust of the feet of the Saints; Nanak yearns for this peace. ||4||9||130|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (207-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa Dhoor d ayh sant an kee sukh  naanak ih baachh ai. ||4||9||130||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਜਾਗਤੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੂਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those
lines.transliteration: ha-o taa kai balihaaree.
jaa kai kayval naam aDhaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o. who take the Support of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਿਪਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਾਥਹ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: How can I recount the praises of those humble beings who are attuned to the Love ofthe Supreme Lord God?
lines.transliteration: mahimaa taa kee kayt ak ganee-ai jan paarbarahm rang raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
lines.english: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are with them. There are no other givers equal tothem. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  tinaa sang un samsar avar na d aatay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧੂਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਇਹੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੩੦॥
lines.english: They have come to save the world - those humble beings who thirst for His BlessedVision.
lines.transliteration: jagat uDh aaran  say-ee aa-ay jo jan d aras pi-aasaa.

lines.english: Those who seek their Sanctuary are carried across; in the Society of the Saints, theirhopes are fulfilled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: un kee saran parai so t ari-aa sat sang pooran aasaa. ||2||

lines.english: If I fall at their Feet, then I live; associating with those humble beings, I remain happy.
lines.transliteration: taa kai charan  para-o t aa jeevaa jan kai sang nihaalaa.

lines.english: O God, please be merciful to me, that my mind might become the dust of the feet ofYour devotees. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagt an kee rayn  ho-ay man mayraa hohu parabh oo kirpaalaa. ||3||

lines.english: Power and authority, youth and age - whatever is seen in this world, all of it shall fadeaway.
lines.transliteration: raaj joban avaDh jo d eesai sabh  kichh  jug meh gh aati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ  ਗਨੀਐ  ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever new and immaculate.Nanak has earned this wealth of the Lord. ||4||10||131|| pMnw 208 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (208-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan sad  navtan nirmal ih naanak har Dh an kh aati-aa. ||4||10||131||

lines.english: I came to the Guru, to learn the Way of Yoga.
lines.transliteration: jog jugat sun aa-i-o gur t ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਸੁਿਨ ਆਇਓ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has revealed it to me through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o satgur sabad  bujhaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is contained in the nine continents of the world, and within this body; each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him.
lines.transliteration: na-o khand parithmee is t an meh ravi-aa nimakh  nimakh  namaskaaraa.

lines.english: I have made the Guru's Teachings my ear-rings, and I have enshrined the One Formless Lord within my being. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deekh i-aa gur kee mund raa kaanee d arirhi-o ayk nirankaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਿਪਰ੍ਥਮੀ  ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have brought the five disciples together, and they are now under the control of theone mind.
lines.transliteration: panch chaylay mil bha-ay ikt araa aykas kai vas kee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁੰਦਰ੍ਾ ਕਾਨੀ ਿਦਰ੍ਿੜਓ  ਏਕੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the ten hermits become obedient to the Lord, then I became an immaculateYogi. ||2||
lines.transliteration: das bairaagan aagi-aakaaree t ab nirmal jogee thee-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਭਏ ਇਕਤਰ੍ਾ  ਏਕਸੁ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: I have burnt my doubt, and smeared my body with the ashes. My path is to see theOne and Only Lord.
lines.transliteration: bharam jaraa-ay charaa-ee bibh ootaa panth ayk kar paykh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਨ ਆਿਗਆਕਾਰੀ  ਤਬ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਥੀਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have made that intuitive peace my food; the Lord Master has written this pre-ordained destiny upon my forehead. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sahj sookh so keenee bh ugtaa jo th aakur mast ak laykh i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਜਰਾਇ  ਚਰਾਈ  ਿਬਭੂਤਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਿਰ ਪੇਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: In that place where there is no fear, I have assumed my Yogic posture. The unstruckmelody of His Bani is my horn.
lines.transliteration: jah bha-o naahee t ahaa aasan baaDh i-o singee anhat  baanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੂਖ ਸੋ ਕੀਨੀ  ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਜੋ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਿਖਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have made contemplation upon the essential reality my Yogic staff. The Love of theName in my mind is my Yogic lifestyle. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tat beechaar dandaa kar raakh i-o jugat  naam man bh aanee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤਹਾ ਆਸਨੁ ਬਾਿਧਓ ਿਸੰਗੀ  ਅਨਹਤ  ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, such a Yogi is met, who cuts away the bonds of Maya.
lines.transliteration: aisaa jogee vadbhaagee bh aytai maa-i-aa kay banDh an kaatai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਡੰਡਾ ਕਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਨੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Nanak serves and adores this wondrous person, and kisses his feet. ||5||11||132|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (208-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sayvaa pooj kara-o tis moorat  kee naanak t is pag chaatai. ||5||11||132||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਜੋਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਭੇਟੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟੈ ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an incomparably beautiful treasure. Listen, everyone, and meditate on it, O friends.
lines.transliteration: anoop padaarath naam sunhu sagal Dh i-aa-ilay meet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's medicine - their minds become pureand immaculate. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har a-ukhaDh  jaa ka-o gur d ee-aa t aa kay nirmal cheet aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Darkness is dispelled from within that body, in which the Divine Light of the Guru'sShabad shines.
lines.transliteration: anDhkaar miti-o t ih tan tay gur sabad  deepak pargaasaa.

lines.english: The noose of doubt is cut away from those who place their faith in the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bharam kee jaalee t aa kee kaatee jaa ka-o saaDh sangat  bisvaasaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੂਪ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਗਲ  ਿਧਆਇਲੇ  ਮੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The treacherous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, in the boat of the SaadhSangat.
lines.transliteration: taareelay bh avjal t aaroo bikh -rhaa bohith saaDh oo sangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਚੀਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind's desires are fulfilled, meeting the Guru, in love with the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pooran ho-ee man kee aasaa gur bhayti-o har rangaa. ||2||

lines.english: The devotees have found the treasure of the Naam; their minds and bodies are satisfied and satiated.
lines.transliteration: naam khajaanaa bh agtee paa-i-aa man t an taripat  aghaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਿਮਿਟਓ  ਿਤਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Dear Lord gives it only to those who surrender to the Lord's Command.||3||12||133|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (208-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jee-o taa ka-o d ayvai jaa ka-o hukam manaa-ay. ||3||12||133||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਬਸਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please be kind and compassionate, O Lord of my life; I am helpless, and I seek YourSanctuary, God.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa ma-i-aa kar paraanpat  moray mohi anaath saran  parabh  toree.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ  ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੂ ਿਬਖੜਾ  ਬੋਿਹਥ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please, give me Your Hand, and lift me up, out of the deep dark pit. I have no clevertricks at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anDh koop meh haath d ay raakh o kachh oo si-aanap ukat  na moree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes - You are everything. You are All-powerful;there is no other than You.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan sabh kichh  tum hee t um samrath naahee an horee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: You alone know Your condition and extent. They alone become Your servants, uponwhose foreheads such good destiny is recorded. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumree gat  mit tum hee jaanee say sayvak jin bh aag mathoree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੩॥
lines.english: You are imbued with Your servant, God; Your devotees are woven into Your Fabric,through and through.
lines.transliteration: apunay sayvak sang tum parabh  raatay ot pot bhagtan sang joree.

lines.english: O Darling Beloved, they yearn for Your Name and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, like the chakvee bird which longs to see the moon. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pari-o pari-o naam tayraa d arsan chaahai jaisay d arisat oh chand  chakoree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਿਤ  ਮੋਰੇ ਮੋਿਹ ਅਨਾਥ  ਸਰਿਣ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Between the Lord and His Saint, there is no difference at all. Among hundreds ofthousands and millions, there is scarcely one humble being.
lines.transliteration: raam sant meh bh ayd kichh  naahee ayk jan ka-ee meh laakh  karoree.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਉਕਿਤ  ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are illuminated by God, sing the Kirtan of His Praises night andday with their tongues. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hee-ai pargat parabh ho-aa an-d in keert an rasan ramoree. ||3||

lines.english: You are All-powerful and Infinite, the most lofty and exalted, the Giver of peace; OGod, You are the Support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: tum samrath apaar at  oochay sukh -daatay parabh  paraan aDh oree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ  ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Please show mercy to Nanak, O God, that he may remain in the Society of the Saints. ||4||13||134|| pMnw 209 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (209-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh keejai kirpaa un sant an kai sang sangoree. ||4||13||134||

lines.english: O Saint, You are attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tum har sayt ee raat ay sant ahu.

lines.english: Please stand my me, Architect of Destiny; please take me to my destination, Great Giver. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nibaahi layho mo ka-o purakh biDh aatay orh  pahuchaavahu d aatay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You alone know Your mystery; You are the Perfect Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: tumraa maram t umaa hee jaani-aa t um pooran purakh  biDhaatay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਬਾਿਹ  ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਓਿੜ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੁ ਦਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a helpless orphan - please keep me under Your Protection and save me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raakho saran  anaath d een ka-o karahu hamaaree gaat ay. ||1||

lines.english: Your Feet are the boat to carry us across the world-ocean; You alone know Your ways.
lines.transliteration: taran saagar bohith charan  tumaaray t um jaanhu apunee bh aatay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਮਰਮੁ  ਤੁਮਾ ਹੀ ਜਾਿਨਆ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom You keep protected, by Your Kindness, cross over to the other side. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis raakho sangay t ay tay paar paraat ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਅਨਾਥ  ਦੀਨ  ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਗਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, God, You are All-powerful; everything is in Your Hands.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  parabh  tum samrathaa sabh  kichh  tumrai haathay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਣ  ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਿਹਥ  ਚਰਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਭਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Please give me that treasure, which will go  along with me, O servant of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aisaa niDhaan d ayh mo ka-o har jan chalai hamaarai saathay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਤੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am without virtue - please bless me with virtue, so that my mind might chant theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nirgunee-aaray ka-o gun keejai har naam mayraa man jaapay.

lines.punjabi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਮਰੈ  ਹਾਥੇ ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothedand satisfied. ||4||14||135|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (209-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  naanak har bh aytay man t an seet al Dharaapay. ||4||14||135||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁਦੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਚਲੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ  ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am intuitively absorbed in the Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: sahj samaa-i-o dayv.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ  ਕਉ ਗੁਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
lines.english: The Divine True Guru has become Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o satgur bh a-ay d a-i-aal d ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ  ਧਰ੍ਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
lines.english: Cutting away the halter, He has made me His slave, and now I work for the Saints.
lines.transliteration: kaat jayvree kee-o daasro sant an tahlaa-i-o.

lines.english: I have become a worshipper of the One Name; the Guru has shown me this amazing wonder. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk naam ko thee-o poojaaree mo ka-o achraj gureh dikh aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: The Divine Light has dawned, and everything is illuminated; the Guru has revealedthis spiritual wisdom to my mind.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o pargaas sarab ujee-aaraa gur gi-aan maneh paragtaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ  ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Drinking deeply of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, my mind is satisfied,and my fears have been vanquished. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam pee-o man t aripti-aa anbh ai thahraa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: Accepting the Command of the Lord's Will, I have found total peace; the home ofsuffering has been destroyed.
lines.transliteration: maan aagi-aa sarab sukh paa-ay d ookhah thaa-o gavaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਟ  ਜੇਵਰੀ  ਕੀਓ  ਦਾਸਰੋ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਟਹਲਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: When God, our Lord and Master was totally pleased, He revealed everything in theform of ecstasy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ja-o suparsan bha-ay parabh  thaakur sabh  aanad  roop d ikhaa-i-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਥੀਓ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; this play is all set in motion by the Lord, the Sovereign King.
lines.transliteration: naa kichh aavat  naa kichh  jaavat  sabh  khayl kee-o har raa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਸਰਬ  ਉਜੀਆਰਾ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਮਨਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, our Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable. The Lord'sdevotees take His Name as their Support. ||4||15||136|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (209-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak agam agam hai thaakur bh agat tayk har naa-i-o. ||4||15||136||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਓ ਮਨੁਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤਆ  ਅਨਭੈ  ਠਹਰਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord; O my mind, hold tight tothe Support of the One
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran parmaysur man taa kee ot gaheejai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਨ  ਆਿਗਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਦੂਖਹ ਠਾਉ  ਗਵਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jin Dhaaray barahmand kh and har t aa ko naam japeejai ray. ||1|| rahaa-o. who established the solar systems and galaxies. Chant the Name of that Lord.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਭਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਭੁ ਆਨਦ  ਰੂਪੁ ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord;understanding the Hukam of His Command, peace is found.
lines.transliteration: man kee mat t i-aagahu har jan hukam boojh  sukh  paa-ee-ai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਵਤ  ਨਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਵਤ  ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever God does, accept that with pleasure; in comfort and in suffering, meditateon Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo parabh karai so-ee bh al maanhu sukh  dukh ohee Dh i-aa-ee-ai ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਮ  ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਭਗਤ  ਟੇਕ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੩੬॥
lines.english: The Creator emancipates millions of sinners in an instant, without a moment's delay.
lines.transliteration: kot patit  uDhaaray kh in meh kart ay baar na laagai ray.

lines.english: The Lord, the Destroyer of the pain and sorrow of the poor, blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||2||
lines.transliteration: deen d arad dukh bhanjan su-aamee jis bh aavai t iseh nivaajai ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀਜੈ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He is Mother and Father, the Cherisher of all; He is the Breath of life of all beings, theOcean of peace.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko maat  pitaa part ipaalak jee-a paraan sukh  saagar ray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਧਾਰੇ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਖੰਡ ਹਿਰ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਜੈ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: While giving so generously, the Creator does not diminish at all. The Source of jewels,He is All-pervading. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dayNday tot naahee t is kart ay poor rahi-o rat naagar ray. ||3||

lines.english: The beggar begs for Your Name, O Lord and Master; God is contained deep within thenucleus of each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: jaachik jaachai naam tayraa su-aamee gh at ghat ant ar so-ee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਿਤਆਗਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਿਝ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; no one returns from Him empty-handed.||4||16||137|| pMnw 210 rwgu gauVI pUrbI mhlw 5  (210-1) raag ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (210-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t aa kee sarn aa-ee jaa t ay baritha na ko-ee ray. ||4||16||137||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Never forget the Lord, Har, Har, from your mind.
lines.transliteration: har har kabhoo na manhu bisaaray.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, He is the Giver of all peace. He is the Cherisher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa sarab sukh-d aata sagal gh ataa part ipaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਈਹਾ  ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਘਟਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He removes the most terrible pains in an instant, if the tongue repeats His Name.
lines.transliteration: mahaa kasat kaatai khin bh eetar rasnaa naam chit aaray.

lines.english: In the Lord's Sanctuary there is soothing coolness, peace and tranquility. He hasextinguished the burning fire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: seetal saaNt sookh  har sarn ee jalt ee agan nivaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਕਸਟ  ਕਾਟੈ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਚਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He saves us from the hellish pit of the womb, and carries us across the terrifyingworld-ocean.
lines.transliteration: garabh kund narak t ay raakh ai bhavjal paar ut aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲ  ਸਿਤ  ਸੂਖ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣੀ  ਜਲਤੀ  ਅਗਿਨ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Adoring His Lotus Feet in the mind, the fear of death is banished. ||2||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal aaraaDhat  man meh jam kee t araas bid aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਕੁੰਡ ਨਰਕ  ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, lofty, unfathomable andinfinite.
lines.transliteration: pooran paarbarahm parmaysur oochaa agam apaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਆਰਾਧਤ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Singing His Glorious Praises, and meditating on the Ocean of peace, one's life is notlost in the gamble. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  Dhi-aavat  sukh  saagar joo-ay janam na haaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਊਚਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, O Giver to theunworthy.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mohi man leeno nirgun  kay d aataaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ  ਿਧਆਵਤ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਜੂਏ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, and bless me with Your Name; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||138|| rwgu gauVI cyqI mhlw 5  (210-8) raag ga-orhee chayt ee 1 mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (210-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apuno naam deejai naanak sad  balihaaray. ||4||1||138||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਲੋਿਭ ਮੋਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨੋ  ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: There is no peace without devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sukh naahee ray har bh agat binaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੮॥
lines.english: Be victorious, and win the priceless jewel of this human life, by meditating on Him inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeet janam ih rat an amolak saaDh sangat  jap ik kh inaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Many have renounced and left their children, wealth, spouses, joyful games andpleasures. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sut sampat  banit aa binod . chhod ga-ay baho log bh og. ||1||

lines.english: Horses, elephants and the pleasures of power
lines.transliteration: haivar gaivar raaj rang.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਿਤ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਇਹੁਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਜਿਪ ਇਕ ਿਖਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ti-aag chali-o hai moorh  nang. ||2|| - leaving these behind, the fool must depart naked. ||2||

lines.english: The body, scented with musk and sandalwood
lines.transliteration: cho-aa chandan d ayh fooli-aa.
so tan Dh ar sang rooli-aa. ||3|| - that body shall come to roll in the dust. ||3||

lines.english: Infatuated with emotional attachment, they think that God is far away.
lines.transliteration: mohi mohi-aa jaanai door hai.

lines.english: Says Nanak, he is Ever-present! ||4||1||139|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (210-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sadaa had oor hai. ||4||1||139||

lines.english: O mind, cross over with the Support of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man Dhar t arbay har naam no.

lines.english: The Guru is the boat to carry you across the world-ocean, through the waves ofcynicism and doubt. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saagar lahar sansaa sansaar gur bohith paar garaamano. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is only pitch darkness.
lines.transliteration: kal kaalakh anDh i-aaree-aa.

lines.english: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom illuminates and enlightens. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan deepak uji-aaree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The poison of corruption is spread out far and wide.
lines.transliteration: bikh bikh i-aa pasree at  ghanee.

lines.english: Only the virtuous are saved, chanting and meditating on the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ubray jap jap har gunee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਧਰ ਤਰਬੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨੋ ॥
lines.english: Intoxicated with Maya, the people are asleep.
lines.transliteration: matvaaro maa-i-aa so-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰ  ਲਹਿਰ  ਸੰਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur bhaytat  bharam bh a-o kh o-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate on the One Lord;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ayk Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at nad ree aa-i-aa. ||4||2||140|| behold Him in each and every heart. ||4||2||140|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (210-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: You alone are my Chief Advisor.
lines.transliteration: deebaan hamaaro t uhee ayk.

lines.english: I serve You with the Support of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sayvaa thaaree gureh tayk. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By various devices, I could not find You.
lines.transliteration: anik jugat nahee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Taking hold of me, the Guru has made me Your slave. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur chaakar lai laa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I have conquered the five tyrants.
lines.transliteration: maaray panch bikhaad ee-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have vanquished the army of evil. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay d al saaDh i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: I have received the One Name as His bounty and blessing.
lines.transliteration: bakhsees vajahu mil ayk naam.

lines.english: Now, I dwell in peace, poise and bliss. ||3|| pMnw 211
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  bisraam. ||3||

lines.english: The slaves of God are good.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay chaakar say bh alay.

lines.english: O Nanak, their faces are radiant. ||4||3||141|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (211-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin mukh  oojlay. ||4||3||141||

lines.english: Hey, soul: your only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jee-aray olHaa naam kaa.

lines.english: Whatever else you do or make happen, the fear of death still hangs over you.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar je karan karaavano tin meh bh a-o hai jaam kaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਿਜ ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨੋ  ਿਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਭਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਮ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is not obtained by any other efforts.
lines.transliteration: avar jatan nahee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By great good fortune, meditate on the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag har Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: You may know hundreds of thousands of clever tricks,
lines.transliteration: laakh hikmat ee jaanee-ai.
aagai til nahee maanee-ai. ||2|| but not even one will be of any use at all hereafter. ||2||

lines.english: Good deeds done in the pride of ego are swept away, like the house of sand by water. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh karam kamaavanay. garih baaloo neer bahaavanay. ||3||

lines.english: When God the Merciful shows His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaal kirpaa karai.

lines.english: Nanak receives the Naam in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.||4||4||142|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (211-5) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam naanak saaDhoo sang milai. ||4||4||142||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, dedicated hundreds of thousands of times, to my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: baarnai balihaarnai lakh baree-aa.

lines.english: His Name, and His Name alone, is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naamo ho naam saahib ko paraan aDhree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You alone are the Doer, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan tuhee ayk.

lines.english: You are the Support of all beings and creatures. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant kee t uhee tayk. ||1||

lines.english: O God, You are my power, authority and youth. You are absolute, without attributes, and also related, with the most sublime attributes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raaj joban parabh t ooN Dhanee. t ooN nirgun t ooN sargunee. ||2||

lines.english: Here and hereafter, You are my Savior and Protector.
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa tum rakh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some understand You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay ko lakh ay. ||3||

lines.english: God is All-knowing, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee parabh  sujaan.

lines.english: You are Nanak's strength and support. ||4||5||143|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (211-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak takee-aa t uhee t aan. ||4||5||143||

lines.english: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har har aaraaDhee-ai.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, He dwells in the mind; doubt, emotional attachment and fear are vanquished. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satsang har man vasai bh aram moh bh a-o saaDh ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees are heard to proclaim
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan  simrit  bhanay.
sabh ooch biraajit  jan sunay. ||1|| that the Lord's servant dwells as the highest of all. ||1||

lines.english: All places are filled with fear - know this well.
lines.transliteration: sagal asthaan bhai bh eet cheen.

lines.english: Only the Lord's servants are free of fear. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam sayvak bhai rahat  keen. ||2||

lines.english: People wander through 8.4 million incarnations.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jon fireh.

lines.english: God's people are not subject to birth and death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gobind lok nahee janam mareh. ||3||

lines.english: Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints; he has given up power,wisdom, cleverness and egotism. ||4||6||144|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (211-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bal buDh si-aanap ha-umai rahee. har saaDh  saran  naanak gahee. ||4||6||144||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ  ਮੋਹੁ ਭਉ ਸਾਧੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man raam naam gun gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Serve the Lord continually and continuously; with each and every breath, meditate onthe Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: neet neet  har sayvee-ai saas saas har Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind,
lines.transliteration: satsang har man vasai.
dukh darad anayraa bh aram nasai. ||1|| and pain, suffering, darkness and doubt depart. ||1||

lines.english: That humble being, who meditates on the Lord, by the Grace of the Saints, is notafflicted with pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  har jaapee-ai. so jan d ookh na vi-aapee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Those unto whom the Guru gives the Mantra of the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o gur har mantar d ay.
so ubri-aa maa-i-aa agan tay. ||3|| are saved from the fire of Maya. ||3||

lines.english: Be kind to Nanak, O God;
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh ma-i-aa kar.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan vaasai naam har. ||4||7||145|| let the Lord's Name dwell within my mind and body. ||4||7||145|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (211-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: With your tongue, chant the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa japee-ai ayk naam.

lines.english: In this world, it shall bring you peace, comfort and great joy; hereafter, it shall gowith your soul, and shall be of use to you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: eehaa sukh aanand  ghanaa aagai jee-a kai sang kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The disease of your ego shall be eradicated.
lines.transliteration: katee-ai tayraa ahaN rog.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਤ  ਨੀਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN gur parsaad  kar raaj jog. ||1||

lines.english: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord
lines.transliteration: har ras jin jan chaakhi-aa.
taa kee t arisnaa laathee-aa. ||2|| have their thirst quenched. ||2||

lines.english: Those who have found the Lord, the Treasure of peace,
lines.transliteration: har bisraam niDh paa-i-aa.
so bahur na kat hee Dh aa-i-aa. ||3|| shall not go anywhere else again. ||3||

lines.english: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's Name, Har, Har
lines.transliteration: har har naam jaa ka-o gur dee-aa.

lines.english: - O Nanak, their fears are removed. ||4||8||146|| pMnw 212 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (212-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kaa bh a-o ga-i-aa. ||4||8||146||

lines.english: One who forgets the Lord's Name, suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bisrai raam naam taahoo ka-o peer.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and dwell upon the Lord, find the Ocean of virtue. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  mil har raveh say gun ee gaheer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਰਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs whose hearts are filled with wisdom,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o gurmukh rid ai buDh .
taa kai kar t al nav niDh  siDh. ||1|| hold the nine treasures, and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas in thepalms of their hands. ||1||

lines.english: Those who know the Lord God as their Master,
lines.transliteration: jo jaaneh har parabh Dh anee.
kichh naahee t aa kai kamee. ||2|| do not lack anything. ||2||

lines.english: Those who realize the Creator Lord,
lines.transliteration: karnaihaar pachh aani-aa.
sarab sookh rang maan i-aa. ||3|| enjoy all peace and pleasure. ||3||

lines.english: Those whose inner homes are filled with the Lord's wealth
lines.transliteration: har Dhan jaa kai garihi vasai.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tin sang d ukh nasai. ||4||9||147|| - says Nanak, in their company, pain departs. ||4||9||147|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (212-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Your pride is so great, but what about your origins?
lines.transliteration: garab bado mool itno.

lines.english: You cannot remain, no matter how much you try to hold on. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rahan nahee gahu kitno. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That which is forbidden by the Vedas and the Saints - with that, you are in love.
lines.transliteration: baybarjat bayd  santnaa u-aahoo si-o ray hit no.

lines.english: Like the gambler losing the game of chance, you are held in the power of sensory desires. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haar joo-aar joo-aa biDhay ind ree vas lai jit no. ||1||

lines.english: The One who is All-powerful to empty out and fill up - you have no love for His LotusFeet.
lines.transliteration: haran bharan sampoornaa charan kamal rang rit no.

lines.english: O Nanak, I have been saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. I havebeen blessed by the Treasure of Mercy. ||2||10||148|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (212-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhray saaDh sang kirpaa niDh  mai d itno. ||2||10||148||

lines.english: I am the slave of my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: mohi daasro th aakur ko.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ  ਜੂਆ  ਿਬਧੇ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਵਿਸ ਲੈ ਿਜਤਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhaan parabh  kaa kh aanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. I eat whatever God gives me. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਨ  ਭਰਨ  ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਰੰਿਗ ਿਰਤਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Such is my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: aiso hai ray khasam hamaaraa.

lines.english: In an instant, He creates and embellishes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khin meh saaj savaaran haaraa. ||1||

lines.english: I do that work which pleases my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: kaam karee jay thaakur bh aavaa.

lines.english: I sing the songs of God's glory, and His wondrous play. ||2||
lines.transliteration: geet charit  parabh  kay gun gaavaa. ||2||

lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's Prime Minister;
lines.transliteration: saran pari-o th aakur vajeeraa.
tinaa d aykh mayraa man Dh eeraa. ||3|| beholding Him, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||3||

lines.english: The One Lord is my support, the One is my steady anchor.
lines.transliteration: ayk tayk ayko aaDhaaraa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is engaged in the Lord's work. ||4||11||149|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (212-11) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kee laagaa kaaraa. ||4||11||149||

lines.english: Is there anyone, who can shatter his ego,
lines.transliteration: hai ko-ee aisaa ha-umai torai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੀਤ  ਚਿਰਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: is meethee t ay ih man horai. ||1|| rahaa-o. and turn his mind away from this sweet Maya? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Humanity is in spiritual ignorance; people see things that do not exist.
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee maanukh bh a-i-aa jo naahee so lorai.

lines.english: The night is dark and gloomy; how will the morning dawn? ||1||
lines.transliteration: rain anDh aaree kaaree-aa kavan jugat  jit bhorai. ||1||

lines.english: Wandering, wandering all around, I have grown weary; trying all sorts of things, I have been searching.
lines.transliteration: bharmat o bharmat o haari-aa anik biDh ee kar torai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਾ  ਕਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੪੯॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, He has shown mercy to me; I have found the treasure of the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||12||150|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (212-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kirpaa bha-ee saaDh sangat  niDh morai. ||2||12||150||

lines.english: He is the Wish-fulfilling Jewel, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chintaaman  karun aa ma-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek;
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aalaa paarbarahm.
jaa kai simran sukh  bha-ay. ||1|| meditating in remembrance on Him, peace is obtained. ||1||

lines.english: The Wisdom of the Undying Primal Being is beyond comprehension.
lines.transliteration: akaal purakh agaaDh  boDh .

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੀ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ  ਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੋ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Hearing His Praises, millions of sins are erased. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sunat jaso kot agh  kha-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ  ਕਾਰੀਆ  ਕਵਨ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਭੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless Nanak with Your kindness, that he may repeatthe Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||13||151|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 5 ] (212-16) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 5. Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDh parabh  ma-i-aa Dh aar. naanak har har naam la-ay. ||3||13||151||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮਤੋ ਭਰ੍ਮਤੋ ਹਾਿਰਆ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਿਬਧੀ  ਕਿਰ ਟੋਰੈ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, in the Sanctuary of God, peace is found.
lines.transliteration: mayray man saran parabh oo sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: That day, when the Giver of life and peace is forgotten - that day passes uselessly. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa din bisrai paraan sukh -daata so d in jaat  ajaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You have come as a guest for one short night, and yet you hope to live for manyages.
lines.transliteration: ayk rain kay paahun t um aa-ay baho jug aas baDh aa-ay.

lines.english: Households, mansions and wealth - whatever is seen, is like the shade of a tree. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garih mandar sampai jo d eesai ji-o t arvar kee chh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: My body, wealth, and all my gardens and property shall all pass away.
lines.transliteration: tan mayraa sampai sabh  mayree baag milakh  sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.english: You have forgotten your Lord and Master, the Great Giver. In an instant, these shall belong to somebody else. ||2|| pMnw 213
lines.transliteration: dayvanhaaraa bisri-o th aakur kh in meh hot  paraa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: You wear white clothes and take cleansing baths, and anoint yourself with sandalwood oil.
lines.transliteration: pahirai baagaa kar isnaanaa cho-aa chandan laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਰੈ  ਬਾਗਾ  ਕਿਰ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ  ਚੋਆ  ਚੰਦਨ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: But you do not remember the Fearless, Formless Lord - you are like an elephant bathing in the mud. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar nahee cheeni-aa ji-o hast ee naavaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: When God becomes merciful, He leads you to meet the True Guru; all peace is in theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ja-o ho-ay kirpaal ta sat gur maylai sabh  sukh  har kay naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਤ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has liberated me from bondage; servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord. ||4||14||152|| gauVI pUrbI mhlw 5 ] (213-3) ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-i-aa banDh an gur kh olay jan naanak har gun  gaa-ay. ||4||14||152||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਗੁ ਿਰ ਖੋਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੫੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, dwell always upon the Guru, Guru, Guru.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur gur gur sad karee-ai.

lines.english: The Guru has made the jewel of this human life prosperous and fruitful. I am asacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ratan janam safal gur kee-aa d arsan ka-o baliharee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: As many breaths and morsels as you take, O my mind - so many times, sing HisGlorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: jaytay saas garaas man layt aa taytay hee gun gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਰੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then this wisdom and understanding isobtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ja-o ho-ay dai-aal sat gur apunaa t aa ih mat  buDh  paa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, taking the Naam, you shall be released from the bondage of death, and the peace of all peace will be found.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam la-ay jam banDh t ay chh ooteh sarab sukh aa sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਗਰ੍ਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਤਾ  ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Serving your Lord and Master, the True Guru, the Great Giver, you shall obtain thefruits of your mind's desires. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sayv su-aamee satgur d aataa man banchh at fal aa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਦੈਆਲੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਤਾ ਇਹ ਮਿਤ ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Creator is your beloved friend and child; it alone shall go along withyou, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: naam isat meet sut  kartaa man sang t uhaarai chaalai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਏ ਜਮ ਬੰਧ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿਹ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: So serve your True Guru, and you shall receive the Name from the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa satgur apunay kee gur t ay paa-ee-ai paalai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮਨ ਬੰਛਤ ਫਲ ਆਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When God, the Merciful Guru, showered His Mercy upon me, all my anxieties weredispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal kirpaa parabh Dh aaree binsay sarab and aysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਕਰਤਾ  ਮਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਹਾਰੈ  ਚਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the peace of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. All his sorrows havebeen dispelled. ||4||15||153|| rwgu gauVI mhlw 5  (213-10) raag ga-orhee mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (213-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh paa-i-aa har keert an miti-o sagal kalaysaa. ||4||15||153||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਾਲੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The thirst of only a few is quenched. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa birlay hee kee bujh ee hay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: People may accumulate hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, and yet the mind is not restrained.
lines.transliteration: kot joray laakh kroray man na horay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਿਨ  ਿਮਿਟਓ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਲੇਸਾ  ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੫੩॥
lines.english: They only yearn for more and more. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parai parai hee ka-o lujhee hay. ||1||

lines.english: They may have all sorts of beautiful women, but still, they commit adultery in thehomes of others.
lines.transliteration: sundar naaree anik parkaaree par garih bikaaree.

lines.english: They do not distinguish between good and bad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa nahee sujh ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: They wander around lost, trapped in the myriad bonds of Maya; they do not sing thePraises of the Treasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: anik banDhan maa-i-aa bh armat  bharmaa-i-aa gun  niDh nahee gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ  ਕਰ੍ੋਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Their minds are engrossed in poison and corruption. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man bikhai hee meh lujh ee hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਲੁਝੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, remain dead while yet alive. In theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the ocean of Maya.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o ray kirpaa karai jeevat so-ee marai saaDh sang maa-i-aa t arai.

lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||154|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (213-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so jan dar har sijh ee hay. ||4||1||154||

lines.english: The Lord is the essence of all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabhhoo ko ras har ho. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਭਰਮਤੁ  ਭਰਮਾਇਆ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਹੀ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Some practice Yoga, some indulge in pleasures; some live in spiritual wisdom, some live in meditation.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo jog kaahoo bhog kaahoo gi-aan kaahoo Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Some are bearers of the staff. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaahoo ho dand Dhar ho. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਤ  ਸੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Some chant in meditation, some practice deep, austere meditation; some worship Himin adoration, some practice daily rituals.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo jaap kaahoo taap kaahoo poojaa hom naym.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਝੀ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੪॥
lines.english: Some live the life of a wanderer. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaahoo ho ga-un kar ho. ||2||

lines.english: Some live by the shore, some live on the water; some study the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo teer kaahoo neer kaahoo bayd  beechaar.

lines.english: Nanak loves to worship the Lord. ||3||2||155|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (213-17) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naankaa bhagat  pari-a ho. ||3||2||155||

lines.english: To sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is my treasure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gun keerat niDh  moree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਿਗਆਨ  ਕਾਹੂ ਿਧਆਨ  ॥
lines.english: You are my delight, You are my praise. You are my beauty, You are my love.
lines.transliteration: tooNhee ras t ooNhee jas t ooNhee roop t oohee rang.

lines.english: O God, You are my hope and support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aas ot parabh t oree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮ ਨੇਮ ॥
lines.english: You are my pride, You are my wealth. You are my honor, You are my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: toohee maan t ooNhee Dh aan toohee pat  toohee paraan.

lines.english: The Guru has repaired that which was broken. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur tootee lai joree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੂ ਤੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: You are in the household, and You are in the forest. You are in the village, and You are in the wilderness. pMnw 214
lines.transliteration: toohee garihi t oohee ban t oohee gaa-o t oohee sun.

lines.english: Nanak: You are near, so very near! ||3||3||156|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (214-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hai naanak nayr nayree. ||3||3||156||

lines.english: I am intoxicated, intoxicated with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maato har rang maat o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I drink it in - I am drunk with it. The Guru has given it to me in charity.
lines.transliteration: ohee pee-o ohee khee-o gureh d ee-o d aan kee-o.

lines.english: My mind is drenched with it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: u-aahoo si-o man raato. ||1||

lines.english: It is my furnace, it is the cooling plaster. It is my love, it is my longing.
lines.transliteration: ohee bhaath ee ohee pochaa uhee pi-aaro uhee roochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਓ ੁਹੀ ਪੀਓ ਓ ੁਹੀ ਖੀਓ ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਦੀਓ  ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ  ॥
lines.english: My mind knows it as peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man oho sukh jaat o. ||2||

lines.english: I enjoy intuitive peace, and I play in bliss; the cycle of reincarnation is ended for me, and I am merged with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sahj kayl anad kh ayl rahay fayr bh a-ay mayl.

lines.punjabi: ਓ ੁਹੀ ਭਾਠੀ  ਓ ੁਹੀ ਪੋਚਾ ਉਹੀ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ਉਹੀ ਰੂਚਾ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is pierced through with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||4||157|| rwgu gOVI mwlvw mhlw 5  (214-5) raag gourhee maalvaa mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Maalwaa, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (214-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur sabad paraat o. ||3||4||157||

lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name; O my friend, chant it. Hereafter, the path is terrifying and treacherous. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har naam layho meetaa layho aagai bikh am panth bh ai-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਕੇਲ ਅਨਦ  ਖੇਲ ਰਹੇ ਫੇਰ ਭਏ ਮੇਲ ॥
lines.english: Serve, serve, forever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.
lines.transliteration: sayvat sayvat  sadaa sayv t ayrai sang basat  hai kaal.

lines.english: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa tooN saaDh  kee ho kaatee-ai jam jaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੌੜੀ  ਮਾਲਵਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You may make burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts and pilgrimages to sacred shrines inegotism, but your corruption only increases.
lines.transliteration: hom jag tirath kee-ay bich ha-umai baDh ay bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਆਗੈ  ਿਬਖਮ  ਪੰਥੁ ਭੈਆਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are subject to both heaven and hell, and you are reincarnated over and overagain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: narak surag du-ay bh unchanaa ho-ay bahur bahur avt aar. ||2||

lines.english: The realm of Shiva, the realms of Brahma and Indra as well - no place anywhere ispermanent.
lines.transliteration: siv puree barahm indar puree nihchal ko thaa-o naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਤ  ਸੇਵਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੇਿਵ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Without serving the Lord, there is no peace at all. The faithless cynic comes and goesin reincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin har sayvaa sukh nahee ho saakat  aavahi jaahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਹੋ ਕਾਟੀਐ  ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As the Guru has taught me, so have I spoken.
lines.transliteration: jaiso gur updaysi-aa mai t aiso kahi-aa pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਤੀਰਥ  ਕੀਏ ਿਬਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਬਧੇ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, people: sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and you shall be saved. ||4||1||158|| rwgu gauVI mwlw mhlw 5  (214-12) raag ga-orhee maalaa mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (214-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sun ray manaa kar keertan ho-ay uDh aar. ||4||1||158||

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕੁ  ਸੁਰਗੁ  ਦੁਇ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Adopting the innocent mind of a child, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-o baal buDh sukh  ray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਇੰਦਰ੍  ਪੁਰੀ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Joy and sorrow, profit and loss, birth and death, pain and pleasure - they are all the same to my consciousness, since I met the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: harakh sog haan mirat  dookh sukh  chit samsar gur milay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋ ਸਾਕਤ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As long as I plotted and planned things, I was full of frustration.
lines.transliteration: ja-o la-o ha-o kichh socha-o chit va-o t a-o la-o d ukhan bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੋ ਗੁਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ  ਮੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਿਹਆ  ਪੁਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: When I met the Kind, Perfect Guru, then I obtained bliss so easily. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ja-o kirpaal gur pooraa bhayti-aa t a-o aanad  sehjay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹੈ ਸੁਿਨ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਕਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੮॥
lines.english: The more clever tricks I tried, the more bonds I was saddled with.
lines.transliteration: jaytee si-aanap karam ha-o kee-ay t aytay banDh  paray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When the Holy Saint placed His Hand upon my forehead, then I was liberated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ja-o saaDhoo kar mast ak Dh ari-o t ab ham mukat  bha-ay. ||2||

lines.english: As long as I claimed, "Mine, mine!", I was surrounded by wickedness and corruption.
lines.transliteration: ja-o la-o mayro mayro karto t a-o la-o bikh  ghayray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਹਾਿਨ  ਿਮਰਤੁ  ਦੂਖ ਸੁਖ ਿਚਿਤ  ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: But when I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to my Lord and Master, then Ibegan to sleep in peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man tan buDh  arpee th aakur ka-o t ab ham sahj so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: As long as I walked along, carrying the load, I continued to pay the fine.
lines.transliteration: ja-o la-o pot uthaa-ee chali-a-o t a-o la-o daan bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਹਉ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੋਚਉ  ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਤਉ ਲਉ ਦੁਖਨੁ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: But I threw away that bundle, when I met the Perfect Guru; O Nanak, then I became fearless. ||4||1||159|| gauVI mwlw mhlw 5 ] (214-18) ga-orhee maalaa mehlaa 5. Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pot daar gur pooraa mili-aa ta-o naanak nirbh a-ay. ||4||1||159||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰ ੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਤਉ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have renounced my desires; I have renounced them.
lines.transliteration: bhaavan t i-aagi-o ree t i-aagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੀ  ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਕਰਮ  ਹਉ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I have renounced them; meeting the Guru, I have renounced them.
lines.transliteration: ti-aagi-o mai gur mil t i-aagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਿਰਓ  ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੁਕਤ  ਭਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All peace, joy, happiness and pleasures have come since I surrendered to the Will of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 215
lines.transliteration: sarab sukh aanand  mangal ras maan gobind ai aagi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Honor and dishonor are the same to me; I have placed my forehead upon the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan d o-oo samaanay mast ak daar gur paagi-o.

lines.english: Wealth does not excite me, and misfortune does not disturb me; I have embracedlove for my Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sampat harakh  na aapat  dookhaa rang th aakurai laagi-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਾਨੇ  ਮਸਤਕੁ  ਡਾਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਗਓ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord and Master dwells in the home; He is seen in the wilderness as well.
lines.transliteration: baas baasree aykai su-aamee udi-aan d aristaagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਪਤ  ਹਰਖੁ  ਨ ਆਪਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ  ਲਾਿਗਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have become fearless; the Saint has removed my doubts. The All-knowing Lord is pervading everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay sant  bharam d aari-o pooran sarbaagi-o. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever the Creator does, my mind is not troubled.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kart ai kaaran  keeno man buro na laagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਡਾਿਰਓ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਰਬਾਿਗਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints and the Company of the Holy, my sleeping mind has beenawakened. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  parsaad  santan kai so-i-o man jaagi-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕੀਨੋ ਮਿਨ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਲਾਿਗਓ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak seeks Your Support; he has come to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak orh t uhaaree pari-o aa-i-o sarn aagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸੋਇਓ  ਮਨੁ ਜਾਿਗਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he enjoys intuitive peace; pain nolonger touches him. ||4||2||160|| gauVI mwlw mhlw 5 ] (215-5) ga-orhee maalaa mehlaa 5. Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam rang sahj ras maanay fir d ookh na laagi-o. ||4||2||160||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਿੜ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਆਇਓ  ਸਰਣਾਿਗਓ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the jewel of my Beloved within my mind.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa laal ratan man paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜ  ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਿਗਓ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੦॥
lines.english: My body is cooled, my mind is cooled and soothed, and I am absorbed into theShabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan seet al man seet al thee-aa sat gur sabad  samaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My hunger has departed, my thirst has totally departed, and all my anxiety is forgotten.
lines.transliteration: laathee bhookh  tarisan sabh  laathee chint aa sagal bisaaree.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has placed His Hand upon my forehead; conquering my mind, I haveconquered the whole world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar mastak gur poorai Dh ari-o man jeet o jag saaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਥੀਆ  ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Satisfied and satiated, I remain steady within my heart, and now, I do not waver atall.
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaa-ay rahay rid  antar dolan t ay ab chookay.

lines.english: The True Guru has given me the inexhaustible treasure; it never decreases, and neverruns out. ||2||
lines.transliteration: akhut kh ajaanaa sat gur dee-aa t ot nahee ray mookay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਥੀ  ਭੂਖਿ ਤ ਰ੍ ਸ ਨ  ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to this wonder, O Siblings of Destiny: the Guru has given me thisunderstanding.
lines.transliteration: achraj ayk sunhu ray bhaa-ee gur aisee boojh  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਧਿਰਓ  ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੋ  ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I threw off the veil of illusion, when I met my Lord and Master; then, I forgot myjealousy of others. ||3||
lines.transliteration: laahi pardaa th aakur ja-o bh ayti-o t a-o bisree t aat paraa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਇ  ਰਹੇ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਡੋਲਨ  ਤੇ ਅਬ ਚੂਕੇ ॥
lines.english: This is a wonder which cannot be described. They alone know it, who have tasted it.
lines.transliteration: kahi-o na jaa-ee ayhu achambha-o so jaanai jin chaakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਮੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Truth has been revealed to me. The Guru has given me the treasure;I have taken it and enshrined it within my heart. ||4||3||161|| gauVI mwlw mhlw 5 ] (215-11) ga-orhee maalaa mehlaa 5. Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sach bha-ay bigaasaa gur niDh aan rid ai lai raakh i-aa. ||4||3||161||

lines.punjabi: ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਿਰ ਐਸੀ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the King, are saved.
lines.transliteration: ubrat raajaa raam kee sarn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਹ  ਪਰਦਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਉ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਤਉ ਿਬਸਰੀ  ਤਾਿਤ  ਪਰਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All other people, in the mansion of Maya, fall flat on their faces on the ground. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab lok maa-i-aa kay mandal gir gir partay Dh arnee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਓ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਏਹੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ  ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਚਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: The great men have studied the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas, and theyhave said this:
lines.transliteration: saasat simrit  bayd  beechaaray mahaa purkh an i-o kahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚ ਭਏ ਿਬਗਾਸਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਲੈ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੧॥
lines.english: "Without the Lord's meditation, there is no emancipation, and no one has ever foundpeace."||1||
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan naahee nist aaraa sookh  na kinhooN lahi-aa. ||1||

lines.english: People may accumulate the wealth of the three worlds, but the waves of greed arestill not subdued.
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan kee lakh mee joree boojh at naahee lahray.

lines.english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, where can anyone find stability? Peoplewander around endlessly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagat  kahaa thit  paavai firt o pahray pahray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਲੋਕ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਮੰਡਲ  ਿਗਿਰ  ਿਗਿਰ  ਪਰਤੇ  ਧਰਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: People engage in all sorts of mind-enticing pastimes, but their passions are notfulfilled.
lines.transliteration: anik bilaas karat man mohan pooran hot  na kaamaa.

lines.english: They burn and burn, and are never satisfied; without the Lord's Name, it is all useless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jalto jalt o kabhoo na boojh at sagal barithay bin naamaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤ  ਿਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ  ਇਉ ਕਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, my friend; this is the essence of perfect peace.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam japahu mayray meetaa ihai saar sukh  pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਿਕਨਹੂੰ ਲਿਹਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, birth and death are ended. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||4||162|| gauVI mwlw mhlw 5 ] (215-17) ga-orhee maalaa mehlaa 5. Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  janam maran  nivaarai naanak jan kee Dh ooraa. ||4||4||162||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ  ਭਵਨ  ਕੀ ਲਖਮੀ  ਜੋਰੀ ਬੂਝਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਲਹਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Who can help me understand my condition?
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o ih biDh ko samjh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਹਾ ਿਥਿਤ  ਪਾਵੈ ਿਫਰਤੋ  ਪਹਰੇ  ਪਹਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Only the Creator knows it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kartaa ho-ay janaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਿਬਲਾਸ  ਕਰਤ  ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: This person does things in ignorance; he does not chant in meditation, and does notperform any deep, self-disciplined meditation.
lines.transliteration: anjaanat kichh  ineh kamaano jap t ap kachh oo na saaDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਤੋ  ਜਲਤੋ ਕਬਹ ੂ ਨ ਬੂਝਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਰ੍ਥੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: This mind wanders around in the ten directions - how can it be restrained? ||1||
lines.transliteration: dah d is lai ih man d a-uraa-i-o kavan karam kar baaDh aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ  ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: "I am the lord, the master of my mind, body, wealth and lands. These are mine." pMnw 216
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an bh oom kaa th aakur ha-o is kaa ih mayraa.

lines.english: In doubt and emotional attachment, this person understands nothing; with this leash, these feet are tied up. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bharam moh kachh  soojh as naahee ih paikh ar pa-ay pairaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਸ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਇਹ ਪੈਖਰ  ਪਏ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: What did this person do, when he did not exist?
lines.transliteration: tab ih kahaa kamaavan pari-aa jab ih kachh oo na hot aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਵਨ  ਪਿਰਆ ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.english: When the Immaculate and Formless Lord God was all alone, He did everything byHimself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jab ayk niranjan nirankaar parabh sabh  kichh  aapeh kart aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਏਕ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪਿਹ  ਕਰਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He alone knows His actions; He created this creation.
lines.transliteration: apnay kartab aapay jaanai jin ih rachan rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਨੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹੁਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Doer. The True Guru has dispelled my doubts.||4||5||163|| gauVI mwlw mhlw 5 ] (216-4) ga-orhee maalaa mehlaa 5. Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak karanhaar hai aapay satgur bh aram chukaa-i-aa. ||4||5||163||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬੩॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, other actions are useless.
lines.transliteration: har bin avar kir-aa birthay.

lines.english: Meditative chants, intense deep meditation, austere self-discipline and rituals - theseare plundered in this world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam kamaan ay ihi orai moosay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Fasting, daily rituals, and austere self-discipline - those who keep the practice of these, are rewarded with less than a shell.
lines.transliteration: barat naym sanjam meh raht aa tin kaa aadh  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ  ਇਿਹ ਓਰੈ ਮੂਸੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hereafter, the way is different, O Siblings of Destiny. There, these things are of nouse at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aagai chalan a-or hai bh aa-ee ooNhaa kaam na aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Those who bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wander over the earth, find noplace of rest hereafter.
lines.transliteration: tirath naa-ay ar Dh arnee bh armat aa aagai th a-ur na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ  ਮਿਹ ਰਹਤਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਆਢੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There, these are of no use at all. By these things, they only please other people. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oohaa kaam na aavai ih biDh oh logan hee pat ee-aavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ  ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਊਂਹਾ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Reciting the four Vedas from memory, they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence hereafter.
lines.transliteration: chatur bayd  mukh  bachnee uchrai aagai mahal na paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਇ  ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨੀ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤਾ  ਆਗੈ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not understand the One Pure Word, utter total nonsense. ||3||
lines.transliteration: boojhai naahee ayk suDh aakhar oh saglee jh aakh jhakhaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਊਹਾ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਓਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ  ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak voices this opinion: those who practice it, swim across.
lines.transliteration: naanak kahto ih beechaaraa je kamaavai so paar garaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਤੁਰ  ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨੀ  ਉਚਰੈ ਆਗੈ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Guru, and meditate on the Naam; renounce the egotistical pride from yourmind. ||4||6||164|| gauVI mwlw 5 ] (216-10) ga-orhee maalaa 5. Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur sayvhu ar naam Dhi-aavahu t i-aagahu manhu gumaanee. ||4||6||164||

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁਓਹੁ ਸਗਲੀ  ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, I chant Your Name, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: maaDha-o har har har mukh  kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹਤੋ  ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ਿਜ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot do anything by myself, O Lord and Master. As You keep me, so I remain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham tay kachh oo na hovai su-aamee ji-o raakh o ti-o rahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: What can the mere mortal do? What is in the hands of this poor creature?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kichh karai ke karnaihaaraa ki-aa is haath bichaaray.

lines.english: As You attach us, so we are attached, O my Perfect Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit tum laavhu t it hee laagaa pooran kh asam hamaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Take pity on me, O Great Giver of all, that I may enshrine love for Your Form alone.
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa sarab kay daat ay ayk roop liv laavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਧਉ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may chant the Naam, the Name of theLord. ||2||7||165|| rwgu gauVI mwJ mhlw 5  (216-14) raag ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (216-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee har peh apunaa naam japaavhu. ||2||7||165||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਿਜਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਿਤਉ  ਰਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Merciful to the meek, O Dear Lord King,
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal d amod ar raa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.english: You have engaged millions of people in Your Service.
lines.transliteration: kot janaa kar sayv lagaa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.english: You are the Lover of Your devotees; this is Your Nature.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al tayraa birad  rakhaa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਿਤਤ  ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਖਸਮ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are totally pervading all places. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooran sabhnee jaa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: How can I behold my Beloved? What is that way of life?
lines.transliteration: ki-o paykhaa pareet am kavan  sukarn ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੫॥
lines.english: Become the slave of the Saints, and serve at their feet.
lines.transliteration: santaa d aasee sayvaa charn ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate this soul; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: ih jee-o vataa-ee bal bal jaa-ee jee-o.

lines.english: Bowing low, I fall at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tis niv niv laaga-o paa-ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਾ ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, study the books of the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: pothee pandit bayd  khojantaa jee-o.

lines.english: Some become renunciates, and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay bairaagee tirath naavant aa jee-o.

lines.english: Some sing tunes and melodies and songs.
lines.transliteration: geet naad  keert an gaavant aa jee-o.

lines.english: But I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har nirbha-o naam Dh i-aa-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: My Lord and Master has become merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal su-aamee mayray jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਵਤਾਈ  ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I was a sinner, and I have been sanctified, taking to the Guru's Feet. pMnw 217
lines.transliteration: patit pavit  lag gur kay pairay jee-o.

lines.english: Dispelling my doubts and fears, the Guru has rid me of hatred.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh a-o kaat kee-ay nirvairay jee-o.

lines.english: The Guru has fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur man kee aas pooraa-ee jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਪੂਰਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: One who has obtained the Name is wealthy.
lines.transliteration: jin naa-o paa-i-aa so Dhanvant aa jee-o.

lines.english: One who meditates on God is glorified.
lines.transliteration: jin parabh Dh i-aa-i-aa so sobh aavant aa jee-o.

lines.english: Sublime are all the actions of those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly.
lines.transliteration: jis saaDhoo sangat  tis sabh  sukarn ee jee-o.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||5||1||166|| gauVI mhlw 5 mwJ ] (217-3) ga-orhee mehlaa 5 maajh . Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sahj samaa-ee jee-o. ||5||1||166||

lines.english: Come to me, O my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: aa-o hamaarai raam pi-aaray jee-o.

lines.english: Night and day, with each and every breath, I think of You.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas saas saas chit aaray jee-o.

lines.english: O Saints, give Him this message; I fall at Your Feet.
lines.transliteration: sant d ay-o sand aysaa pai charn aaray jee-o.

lines.english: Without You, how can I be saved? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin kit  biDh taree-ai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਦੇਉ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ  ਪੈ ਚਰਣਾਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: In Your Company, I am in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: sang tumaarai mai karay anand aa jee-o.

lines.english: In the forest, the fields and the three worlds, there is peace and supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: van tin taribhavan sukh  parmaanand aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਮਾਰੈ  ਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੰਦਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My bed is beautiful, and my mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: sayj suhaavee ih man bigsandaa jee-o.

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have found this peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paykh d arsan ih sukh  lahee-ai jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: I wash Your Feet, and constantly serve You.
lines.transliteration: charan pakh aar karee nit  sayvaa jee-o.

lines.english: O Divine Lord, I worship and adore You; I bow down before You.
