lines.transliteration: poojaa archaa bandan d ayvaa jee-o.

lines.english: I am the slave of Your slaves; I chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aas naam jap layvaa jee-o.

lines.english: I offer this prayer to my Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin-o thaakur peh kahee-ai jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਲੇਵਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind and body are rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: ichh punnee mayree man t an hari-aa jee-o.

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all my pains have been taken away.
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh at sabh  dukh parhari-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been saved.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japay jap tari-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak endures this unendurable celestial bliss. ||4||2||167|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 5 ] (217-10) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 5. Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih ajar naanak sukh sahee-ai jee-o. ||4||2||167||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਿਪ ਤਿਰਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, listen, O my friend and companion, O Beloved of my mind:
lines.transliteration: sun sun  saajan man mit  pi-aaray jee-o.
man tan t ayraa ih jee-o bh e vaaray jee-o. my mind and body are Yours. This life is a sacrifice to You as well.

lines.english: May I never forget God, the Support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: visar naahee parabh paraan  aDhaaray jee-o.

lines.english: I have come to Your Eternal Sanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa t ayree sarn aa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: Meeting Him, my mind is revived, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: jis mili-ai man jeevai bhaa-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਿਭ ਵਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee so har har paa-ee jee-o.

lines.english: All things belong to God; all places belong to God.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  parabh  kaa parabh  kee-aa jaa-ee jee-o.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o sad  bal jaa-ee jeea. ||2||

lines.english: Very fortunate are those who meditate on this treasure.
lines.transliteration: ayhu niDhaan japai vadbh aagee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: They enshrine love for the Naam, the Name of the One Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan ayk liv laagee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Finding the Perfect Guru, all suffering is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-i-aa sabh d ukh mitaa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glories of God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun  gaa-i-aa jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Your Name is the treasure of jewels, Lord.
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath har naam t umaaraa jee-o.

lines.english: You are the True Banker; Your devotee is the trader.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa saahu bh agat vanjaaraa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: True is the trade of those who have the wealth of the Lord's assets.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan raas sach vaapaaraa jee-o.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||4||3||168|| rwgu gauVI mwJ mhlw 5  (217-17) raag ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (217-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaaraa jee-o. ||4||3||168||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am so proud of You, O Creator; I am so proud of You.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa baho maan  kartay tooN mayraa baho maan .

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਭਗਤੁ  ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through Your Almighty Power, I dwell in peace. The True Word of the Shabad is my banner and insignia. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jor tumaarai sukh  vasaa sach sabad  neesaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He hears and knows everything, but he keeps silent.
lines.transliteration: sabhay galaa jaat ee-aa sun  kai chup kee-aa.

lines.english: Bewitched by Maya, he never regains awareness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kad hee surat  na laDh ee-aa maa-i-aa mohrh i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The riddles and hints are given, and he sees them with his eyes. pMnw 218
lines.transliteration: day-ay bujh aarat saart aa say akh ee dith -rhi-aa.

lines.english: But he is foolish and greedy, and he never listens to what he is told. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee je moorakh lobh ee-aa mool na sun ee kahi-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਿਜ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਿਹਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Why bother to count one, two, three, four? The whole world is defrauded by the same enticements.
lines.transliteration: ikas duhu chahu ki-aa gan ee sabh  ikat saad  muth ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਦੁਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਗਣੀ  ਸਭ ਇਕਤੁ  ਸਾਿਦ  ਮੁਠੀ ॥
lines.english: Hardly anyone loves the Lord's Name; how rare is that place which is in bloom. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ik aDh naa-ay rasee-arh aa kaa virlee jaa-ay vuth ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਅਧੁ ਨਾਇ  ਰਸੀਅੜਾ  ਕਾ ਿਵਰਲੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਵੁਠੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The devotees look beautiful in the True Court; night and day, they are happy.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sachay d ar sohd ay anad  karahi d in raat .

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹਦੇ  ਅਨਦ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: They are imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; servant Nanak is a sacrificeto them. ||4||1||169|| gauVI mhlw 5 mWJ ] (218-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 5 maaNjh. Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:
lines.transliteration: rang ratay parmaysrai jan naanak t in bal jaat . ||4||1||169||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਤ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬੯  ॥
lines.english: The Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name, Lord; the Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhanjan t ayraa naam jee d ukh bhanjan t ayraa naam.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the wisdom of the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar aaraaDh ee-ai pooran sat gur gi-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: That heart, in which the Supreme Lord God abides, is the most beautiful place.
lines.transliteration: jit ghat vasai paarbarahm so-ee suhaavaa thaa-o.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who chant the GloriousPraises of the Lord with the tongue. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jam kankar nayrh na aavee rasnaa har gun  gaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: I have not understood the wisdom of serving Him, nor have I worshipped Him inmeditation.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat na jaan ee-aa naa jaapai aaraaDh .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਘਿਟ  ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: You are my Support, O Life of the World; O my Lord and Master, Inaccessible andIncomprehensible. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ot tayree jagjeevanaa mayray th aakur agam agaaDh . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful, sorrow and suffering departed.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal gusaa-ee-aa nath ay sog sant aap.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ  ਨਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਰਾਿਧ  ॥
lines.english: The hot winds do not even touch those who are protected by the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tatee vaa-o na lag-ee sat gur rakh ay aap. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru is the All-pervading Lord, the Guru is the Merciful Master; the Guru is theTrue Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur naaraa-in d a-yu gur gur sachaa sirjan haar.

lines.english: When the Guru was totally satisfied, I obtained everything. Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||2||170|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 5 ] (218-9) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 5. Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai sabh  kichh  paa-i-aa jan naanak sad  balihaar. ||4||2||170||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੀ  ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਰਖੇ ਆਿਪ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam:
lines.transliteration: har raam raam raam raamaa.
jap pooran ho-ay kaamaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. meditating on Him, all affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, one's mouth is sanctified.
lines.transliteration: raam gobind japayd i-aa ho-aa mukh  pavit ar.

lines.english: One who recites to me the Praises of the Lord is my friend and brother. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jas sunee-ai jis t ay so-ee bh aa-ee mit ar. ||1||

lines.english: All treasures, all rewards and all virtues are in the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: sabh pad aarath sabh  falaa sarab gun aa jis maahi.

lines.english: Why forget Him from your mind? Remembering Him in meditation, pain departs. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ki-o gobind manhu visaaree-ai jis simrat  dukh jaahi. ||2||

lines.english: Grasping the hem of His robe, we live, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jis larh lagi-ai jeevee-ai bh avjal pa-ee-ai paar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਜਪੇਿਦਆ  ਹੋਆ  ਮੁਖੁ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ੁ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo sang uDh aar ho-ay mukh  oojal d arbaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਈ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Praise of the Sustainer of the Universe is the essence of life, and the wealth of HisSaints.
lines.transliteration: jeevan roop gopaal jas sant janaa kee raas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਸਿਭ ਫਲਾ ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is saved, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in the True Court, he ischeered and applauded. ||4||3||171|| gauVI mwJ mhlw 5 ] (218-14) ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 5. Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ubray naam jap dar sachai saabaas. ||4||3||171||

lines.english: Sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord, O my soul, sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: meethay har gun  gaa-o jind oo tooN meeth ay har gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਲਿੜ  ਲਿਗਐ  ਜੀਵੀਐ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਈਐ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the True One, even the homeless find a home. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sachay saytee rat i-aa mili-aa nithaavay thaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All other tastes are bland and insipid; through them, the body and mind are renderedinsipid as well.
lines.transliteration: hor saad sabh  fiki-aa t an man fikaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਰੂਪ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਜਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Transcendent Lord, what can anyone do? Cursed is his life, and cursed hisreputation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vin parmaysar jo karay fit so jeevan  so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
lines.english: Grasping the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint, we cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: anchal geh kai saaDh kaa t arnaa ih sansaar.

lines.english: Worship and adore the Supreme Lord God, and all your family will be saved as well. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aaraaDhee-ai uDh rai sabh  parvaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਠੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਿਜੰਦੂ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਠੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He is a companion, a relative, and a good friend of mine, who implants the Lord'sName within my heart.
lines.transliteration: saajan banDh sumit ar so har naam hird ai day-ay.

lines.english: He washes off all my demerits, and is so generous to me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: a-ugan sabh  mitaa-ay kai par-upkaar karay-i. ||3||

lines.english: Wealth, treasures, and household are all just ruins; the Lord's Feet are the onlytreasure.
lines.transliteration: maal khajaanaa thayhu gh ar har kay charan  niDhaan.

lines.english: Nanak is a beggar standing at Your Door, God; he begs for Your charity. ||4||4||172|| pMnw 219 <> siqgur pRswid ] (219-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu gauVI mhlw 9 ] (219-1) raag ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Raag Gauree, Ninth Mehl
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachak dar t ayrai parabh  tuDhno mangai d aan. ||4||4||172||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ  ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਫਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this is the path to liberation. Become Gurmukh, and attain it. ||2||5|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (219-18) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat mukat  panth ih gurmukh  ho-ay t um paava-o. ||2||5||

lines.english: : Holy Saadhus: forsake the pride of your mind.
lines.transliteration: saaDho man kaa maan t i-aaga-o.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and the company of evil people - run away from them, day and night. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh sangat  durjan kee t aa tay ahinis bh aaga-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who knows that pain and pleasure are both the same, and honor and dishonor aswell,
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh dono sam kar jaanai a-or maan apmaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ ਦੁਰਜਨ  ਕੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਭਾਗਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog t ay rahai at eetaa tin jag t at pachh aanaa. ||1|| who remains detached from joy and sorrow, realizes the true essence in the world.||1||

lines.english: Renounce both praise and blame; seek instead the state of Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa do-oo t i-aagai kh ojai pad  nirbaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੋਨੋ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰ ੁਮਾਨੁ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, this is such a difficult game; only a few Gurmukhs understand it!||2||1|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (219-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ih khayl kath an hai kinhooN gurmukh  jaanaa. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਿਗ  ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Holy Saadhus: the Lord fashioned the creation.
lines.transliteration: saaDho rachnaa raam banaa-ee.

lines.english: One person passes away, and another thinks that he will live forever - this is a wonderbeyond understanding! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ik binsai ik asthir maanai achraj lakhi-o na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਠਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਕਨਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal beings are held in the power of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; they have forgotten the Lord, the Immortal Form.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh moh bas paraanee har moorat  bisraa-ee.

lines.english: The body is false, but they believe it to be true; it is like a dream in the night. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa tan saachaa kar maani-o ji-o supnaa rainaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever is seen, shall all pass away, like the shadow of a cloud.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so sagal binaasai ji-o baad ar kee chh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਇਕ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਲਿਖਓ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, one who knows the world to be unreal, dwells in the Sanctuary ofthe Lord. ||2||2|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (219-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jag jaani-o mithi-aa rahi-o raam sarnaa-ee. ||2||2||

lines.english: The Praise of the Lord does not come to dwell in the minds of the mortal beings.
lines.transliteration: paraanee ka-o har jas man nahee aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਸ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਿਬਸਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, they remain engrossed in Maya. Tell me, how can they sing God'sGlories? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ahinis magan rahai maa-i-aa mai kaho kaisay gun gaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨਓ  ਿਜਉ  ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਰੈਨਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this way, they bind themselves to children, friends, Maya and possessiveness.
lines.transliteration: poot meet  maa-i-aa mamt aa si-o ih biDh  aap banDh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਨਾਸੈ  ਿਜਉ ਬਾਦਰ  ਕੀ ਛਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Like the deer's delusion, this world is false; and yet, beholding it, they chase after it.||1||
lines.transliteration: marig tarisnaa ji-o jh ootho ih jag d aykh taas uth  Dhaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਗੁ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master is the source of pleasures and liberation; and yet, the fool forgets Him.
lines.transliteration: bhugat  mukat  kaa kaaran su-aamee moorh  taahi bisraavai.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely anyone who attains the Lord'smeditation. ||2||3|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (219-11) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kotan mai ko-oo bhajan raam ko paavai. ||2||3||

lines.english: Holy Saadhus: this mind cannot be restrained.
lines.transliteration: saaDho ih man gahi-o na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Fickle desires dwell with it, and so it cannot remain steady. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chanchal tarisnaa sang basat  hai yaa t ay thir na rahaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਮਗਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The heart is filled with anger and violence, which cause all sense to be forgotten.
lines.transliteration: kathan karoDh  ghat hee kay bh eetar jih suDh  sabh  bisraa-ee.

lines.english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom has been taken away from everyone; nothing canwithstand it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ratan gi-aan sabh  ko hir leenaa t aa si-o kachh  na basaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਤ ਮੀਤ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਿਸਉ ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਆਪੁ  ਬੰਧਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Yogis have tried everything and failed; the virtuous have grown weary of singingGod's Glories.
lines.transliteration: jogee jatan karat  sabh  haaray gunee rahay gun gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਿਜਉ ਝੂਠੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗ ਦੇਿਖ ਤਾਿਸ  ਉਿਠ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then every effort is successful.||2||4|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (219-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har bha-ay d a-i-aalaa t a-o sabh  biDh ban aa-ee. ||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਗਿਤ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਾ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੂੜ ਤਾਿਹ ਿਬਸਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Holy Saadhus: sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: saaDho gobind  kay gun gaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋਟਨ  ਮੈ ਕੋਊ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: You have obtained the priceless jewel of this human life; why are you uselesslywasting it? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maanas janam amolak paa-i-o birthaa kaahi gavaava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Friend of the poor. Come, and enter the Lord'sSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  deen banDh  har saran t aahi t um aava-o.

lines.english: Remembering Him, the elephant's fear was removed; so why do you forget Him? ||1||
lines.transliteration: gaj ko taraas miti-o jih simrat  tum kaahay bisraava-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਚਲ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਿਥਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Renounce your egotistical pride and your emotional attachment to Maya; focus yourconsciousness on the Lord's meditation.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan moh maa-i-aa fun bh ajan raam chit  laava-o.

lines.english: O mother, if only someone would instruct my wayward mind. pMnw 220
lines.transliteration: ko-oo maa-ee bhooli-o man samjh aavai.

lines.english: This mind listens to the Vedas, the Puraanas, and the ways of the Holy Saints, but it does not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, for even an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan saaDh  mag sun kar nimakh  na har gun gaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਸਾਧ ਮਗ ਸੁਿਨ ਕਿਰ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Having obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain, it is now being uselesslywasted.
lines.transliteration: durlabh  dayh paa-ay maanas kee birthaa janam siraavai.

lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is such a treacherous wilderness, and yet, people arein love with it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh mahaa sankat ban taa si-o ruch upjaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ  ਮਾਨਸ  ਕੀ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਸਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, God is always with them, and yet, they do not enshrine Lovefor Him.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sad aa sang parabh  taa si-o nayhu na laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਸੰਕਟ  ਬਨ ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, know that those whose hearts are filled with the Lord are liberated. ||2||6|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (220-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mukat t aahi t um maanhu jih gh at raam samaavai. ||2||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Holy Saadhus: rest and peace are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDho raam saran bisraamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਿਜਹ ਘਿਟ  ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: This is the blessing of studying the Vedas and the Puraanas, that you may meditateon the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause|| loB moh mwieAw mmqw Puin Aau ibiKAn kI syvw ] hrK sog prsY ijh nwhin so mUriq hY dyvw
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan parh ay ko ih gun simray har ko naamaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Greed, emotional attachment to Maya, possessiveness, the service of evil, pleasure and pain - those who are not touched by these, are the very embodiment of theDivine Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lobh moh maa-i-aa mamt aa fun a-o bikh i-an kee sayvaa. harakh  sog parsai jih naahan so moorat hai d ayvaa. ||1||

lines.english: Heaven and hell, ambrosial nectar and poison, gold and copper - these are all alike tothem.
lines.transliteration: surag narak amrit bikh  ay sabh  ti-o kanchan ar paisaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਪੜੇ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਗੁਨ ਿਸਮਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Praise and slander are all the same to them, as are greed and attachment. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa ay sam jaa kai lobh  moh fun t aisaa. ||2||

lines.english: They are not bound by pleasure and pain - know that they are truly wise.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  ay baaDh ay jih naahan t ih tum jaan-o gi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਫੁਿਨ ਅਉ ਿਬਿਖਅਨ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, recognize those mortal beings as liberated, who live this way of life. ||3||7|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (220-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mukat t aahi t um maan-o ih biDh  ko jo paraanee. ||3||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਪਰਸੈ ਿਜਹ ਨਾਹਿਨ  ਸੋ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mind, why have you gone crazy?
lines.transliteration: man ray kahaa bha-i-o t ai ba-uraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਗ  ਨਰਕ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਬਖੁ ਏ ਸਭ ਿਤਉ  ਕੰਚਨ  ਅਰੁ ਪੈਸਾ ॥
lines.english: Don't you know that your life is decreasing, day and night? Your life is made worthlesswith greed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ahinis a-oDh gh atai nahee jaanai bh a-i-o lobh  sang ha-uraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਏ ਸਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੁਿਨ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: That body, which you believe to be your own, and your beautiful home and spouse
lines.transliteration: jo tan t ai apno kar maani-o ar sund ar garih naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਏ ਬਾਧੇ ਿਜਹ ਨਾਹਿਨ  ਿਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: in maiN kachh t ayro ray naahan d aykho soch bichaaree. ||1|| - none of these is yours to keep. See this, reflect upon it and understand. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਉ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੋ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.english: You have wasted the precious jewel of this human life; you do not know the Way of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ratan janam apno t ai haari-o gobind  gat nahee jaanee.

lines.english: You have not been absorbed in the Lord's Feet, even for an instant. Your life haspassed away in vain! ||2||
lines.transliteration: nimakh na leen bh a-i-o charnan siN-o birthaa a-oDh  siraanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ  ਤੈ ਬਉਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, that man is happy, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak so-ee nar sukhee-aa raam naam gun gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਅਉਧ  ਘਟੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਭਇਓ  ਲੋਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਉਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the rest of the world is enticed by Maya; they do not obtain the state of fearlessdignity. ||3||8|| gauVI mhlw 9 ] (220-13) ga-orhee mehlaa 9. Gauree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: a-or sagal jag maa-i-aa mohi-aa nirbhai pad  nahee paavai. ||3||8||

lines.english: You people are unconscious; you should be afraid of sin.
lines.transliteration: nar achayt paap t ay dar ray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਤੈ ਅਪਨੋ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨਓ  ਅਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of all fear.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal sagal bh ai bhanjan saran t aahi t um par ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਮੈਂ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਿਨ  ਦੇਖੋ ਸੋਚ ਿਬਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing His Praises; enshrine His Name within your heart.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan jaas gun gaavat  taa ko naam hee-ai mo Dh ar ray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਪਨੋ  ਤੈ ਹਾਿਰਓ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Pure and sublime is the Name of the Lord in the world. Remembering it in meditation, all sinful mistakes shall be washed away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paavan naam jagat mai har ko simar simar kasmal sabh  har ray. ||1||

lines.english: You shall not obtain this human body again; make the effort - try to achieveliberation!
lines.transliteration: maanas dayh bahur nah paavai kachh oo upaa-o mukat  kaa kar ray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, sing of the Lord of compassion, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||9||251|| rwgu gauVI AstpdIAw mhlw 1 gauVI guAwryrI  (220-18) raag ga-orhee asatpad ee-aa mehlaa 1 ga-orh ee gu-aarayree Raag Gauree, Ashtapadees, First Mehl: Gauree Gwaarayree: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu gur pRswid ] (220-18) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  gur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru'sGrace:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat gaa-ay karunaa mai bh av saagar kai paar ut ar ray. ||2||9||251||

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਪਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥
lines.english: The nine treasures and the miraculous spiritual powers come by contemplating theImmaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: niDh siDh  nirmal naam beechaar.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He destroys the poison of Maya.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-aa bikh maar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰ ਅਚੇਤ  ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਡਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I am rid of the three-phased Maya, dwelling in the Pure Lord. pMnw 221
lines.transliteration: tarikutee chh ootee bimal majh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਜੀਇ  ਆਈ  ਕਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru's Teachings are useful to my soul. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kee mat jee-ay aa-ee kaar. ||1||

lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name in this way, my mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: in biDh raam ramat  man maani-aa.

lines.english: I have obtained the ointment of spiritual wisdom, recognizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan gur sabad pachh aani-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Blended with the One Lord, I enjoy intuitive peace.
lines.transliteration: ik sukh maani-aa sahj milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, my doubts have been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: nirmal banee bh aram chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Instead of the pale color of Maya, I am imbued with the deep crimson color of theLord's Love.
lines.transliteration: laal bha-ay soohaa rang maa-i-aa.

lines.english: By the Lord's Glance of Grace, the poison has been eliminated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nadar bh a-ee bikh  thaak rahaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: When I turned away, and became dead while yet alive, I was awakened.
lines.transliteration: ulat bha-ee jeevat  mar jaagi-aa.

lines.english: Chanting the Word of the Shabad, my mind is attached to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad ravay man har si-o laagi-aa.

lines.english: I have gathered in the Lord's sublime essence, and cast out the poison.
lines.transliteration: ras sangrahi bikh parhar t i-aagi-aa.

lines.english: Abiding in His Love, the fear of death has run away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay basay jam kaa bh a-o bh aagi-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਇ  ਬਸੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਿਗਆ॥੩॥
lines.english: My taste for pleasure ended, along with conflict and egotism.
lines.transliteration: saad rahay baad aN ahaNkaaraa.

lines.english: My consciousness is attuned to the Lord, by the Order of the Infinite.
lines.transliteration: chit har si-o raat aa hukam apaaraa.

lines.english: My pursuit for worldy pride and honour is over.
lines.transliteration: jaat rahay pat  kay aachaaraa.

lines.english: When He blessed me with His Glance of Grace, peace was established in my soul. ||4||
lines.transliteration: darisat bh a-ee sukh  aatam Dh aaraa. ||4||

lines.english: Without You, I see no friend at all.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin ko-ay na d aykh-a-u meet .

lines.english: Whom should I serve? Unto whom should I dedicate my consciousness?
lines.transliteration: kis sayva-o kis dayva-o cheet .

lines.english: Whom should I ask? At whose feet should I fall?
lines.transliteration: kis poochha-o kis laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.english: By whose teachings will I remain absorbed in His Love? ||5||
lines.transliteration: kis updays rahaa liv laa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: I serve the Guru, and I fall at the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvee gur laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.english: I worship Him, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karee raacha-o har naa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord's Love is my instruction, sermon and food.
lines.transliteration: sikhi-aa d eekhi-aa bh ojan bh aa-o.

lines.english: Enjoined to the Lord's Command, I have entered the home of my inner self. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hukam sanjogee nij ghar jaa-o. ||6||

lines.english: With the extinction of pride, my soul has found peace and meditation.
lines.transliteration: garab gataN sukh  aatam Dh i-aanaa.

lines.english: The Divine Light has dawned, and I am absorbed in the Light.
lines.transliteration: jot bh a-ee jot ee maahi samaanaa.

lines.english: Pre-ordained destiny cannot be erased; the Shabad is my banner and insignia.
lines.transliteration: likhat  mitai nahee sabad  neesaanaa.

lines.english: I know the Creator, the Creator of His Creation. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kartaa karn aa kart aa jaanaa. ||7||

lines.english: I am not a learned Pandit, I am not clever or wise.
lines.transliteration: nah pandit nah chat ur si-aanaa.

lines.english: I do not wander; I am not deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: nah bhoolo nah bh aram bh ulaanaa.

lines.english: I do not speak empty speech; I have recognized the Hukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: katha-o na kathnee hukam pachhaanaa.

lines.english: Nanak is absorbed in intuitive peace through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||1|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 1 ] (221-11) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 1. Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat sahj samaanaa. ||8||1||

lines.english: The mind is an elephant in the forest of the body.
lines.transliteration: man kunchar kaa-i-aa udi-aanai.

lines.english: The Guru is the controlling stick; when the Insignia of the True Shabad is applied, one obtains honor in the Court of God the King. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur ankas sach sabad neesaanai. raaj d u-aarai sobh  so maanai. ||1||

lines.english: He cannot be known through clever tricks.
lines.transliteration: chaturaa-ee nah cheeni-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without subduing the mind, how can His value be estimated? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin maaray ki-o keemat paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the house of the self is the Ambrosial Nectar, which is being stolen by the thieves.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh amrit  taskar lay-ee.

lines.english: No one can say no to them.
lines.transliteration: nannaakaar na ko-ay karay-ee.

lines.english: He Himself protects us, and blesses us with greatness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raakhai aap vadi-aa-ee d ay-ee. ||2||

lines.english: There are billions, countless billions of fires of desire at the seat of the mind.
lines.transliteration: neel aneel agan ik thaa-ee.

lines.english: They are extinguished only with the water of understanding, imparted by the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jal nivree gur boojh bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: Offering my mind, I have attained it, and I joyfully sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man day lee-aa rahas gun  gaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Just as He is within the home of the self, so is He beyond.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa ghar baahar so t aisaa.

lines.english: But how can I describe Him, sitting in a cave?
lines.transliteration: bais gufaa meh aakha-o kaisaa.

lines.english: The Fearless Lord is in the oceans, just as He is in the mountains. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saagar doogar nirbha-o aisaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੀਆ  ਰਹਿਸ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Tell me, who can kill someone who is already dead?
lines.transliteration: moo-ay ka-o kaho maaray ka-un.

lines.english: What does he fear? Who can frighten the fearless one?
lines.transliteration: nidray ka-o kaisaa dar kavan.

lines.english: He recognizes the Word of the Shabad, throughout the three worlds. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabad pachh aanai t eenay bh a-un. ||5||

lines.english: One who speaks, merely describes speech.
lines.transliteration: jin kahi-aa tin kahan vakh aani-aa.

lines.english: But one who understands, intuitively realizes.
lines.transliteration: jin boojhi-aa t in sahj pachh aani-aa.

lines.english: Seeing and reflecting upon it, my mind surrenders. ||6||
lines.transliteration: daykh  beechaar mayraa man maani-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Praise, beauty and liberation are in the One Name.
lines.transliteration: keerat soorat  mukat  ik naa-ee.

lines.english: In it, the Immaculate Lord is permeating and pervading.
lines.transliteration: tahee niranjan rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: He dwells in the home of the self, and in His own sublime place. ||7||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar bi-aap rahi-aa nij th aa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: The many silent sages lovingly praise Him. pMnw 222
lines.transliteration: ustat karahi kayt ay mun pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਨ ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Their bodies and minds are purified, as they enshrine the True Lord in their consciousness.
lines.transliteration: tan man soochai saach so cheet .

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, each and every day. ||8||2|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 1 ] (222-1) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 1. Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhaj neet aa neet . ||8||2||

lines.english: The mind does not die, so the job is not accomplished.
lines.transliteration: naa man marai na kaaraj ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The mind is under the power of the demons of evil intellect and duality.
lines.transliteration: man vas doot aa durmat  do-ay.

lines.english: But when the mind surrenders, through the Guru, it becomes one. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man maanai gur tay ik ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is without attributes; the attributes of virtue are under His control.
lines.transliteration: nirgun raam gun ah vas ho-ay.

lines.english: One who eliminates selfishness contemplates Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap nivaar beechaaray so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The deluded mind thinks of all sorts of corruption.
lines.transliteration: man bhoolo baho chit ai vikaar.

lines.english: When the mind is deluded, the load of wickedness falls on the head.
lines.transliteration: man bhoolo sir aavai bh aar.

lines.english: But when the mind surrenders to the Lord, it realizes the One and Only Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man maanai har aykankaar. ||2||

lines.english: The deluded mind enters the house of Maya.
lines.transliteration: man bhoolo maa-i-aa gh ar jaa-ay.

lines.english: Engrossed in sexual desire, it does not remain steady.
lines.transliteration: kaam birooDha-o rahai na th aa-ay.

lines.english: O mortal, lovingly vibrate the Lord's Name with your tongue. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har bhaj paraan ee rasan rasaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Elephants, horses, gold, children and spouses
lines.transliteration: gaivar haivar kanchan sut naaree.
baho chintaa pirh  chaalai haaree. - in the anxious affairs of all these, people lose the game and depart.

lines.english: In the game of chess, their pieces do not reach their destination. ||4||
lines.transliteration: joo-ai khaylan  kaachee saaree. ||4||

lines.english: They gather wealth, but only evil comes from it.
lines.transliteration: sampa-o sanchee bha-ay vikaar.

lines.english: Pleasure and pain stand in the doorway.
lines.transliteration: harakh sok ubh ay darvaar.

lines.english: Intuitive peace comes by meditating on the Lord, within the heart. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sukh sehjay jap rid ai muraar. ||5||

lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites us in His Union.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, merits are gathered in, and demerits are burned away.
lines.transliteration: gun sangrahi a-ugan  sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam pad aarath paa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: Without the Name, all live in pain.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh d ookh nivaas.

lines.english: The consciousness of the foolish, self-willed manmukh is the dwelling place of Maya.
lines.transliteration: manmukh moorh  maa-i-aa chit  vaas.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, according to pre-ordained destiny. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan Dh ur karam likh i-aas. ||7||

lines.english: The fickle mind continuously runs after fleeting things.
lines.transliteration: man chanchal Dhaavat  fun Dh aavai.

lines.english: The Pure True Lord is not pleased by filth.
lines.transliteration: saachay soochay mail na bhaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||3|| gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 1 ] (222-10) ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 1. Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har gun  gaavai. ||8||3||

lines.english: Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karti-aa nah sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: The intellect of the mind is false; only the Lord is True.
lines.transliteration: manmat jh oothee sachaa so-ay.

lines.english: All who love duality are ruined.
lines.transliteration: sagal bigootay bh aavai d o-ay.

lines.english: People act as they are pre-ordained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so kamaavai Dhur likh i-aa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: I have seen the world to be such a gambler;
lines.transliteration: aisaa jag daykh i-aa joo-aaree.
sabh sukh  maagai naam bisaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o. all beg for peace, but they forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: If the Unseen Lord could be seen, then He could be described.
lines.transliteration: adisat d isai taa kahi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without seeing Him, all descriptions are useless.
lines.transliteration: bin daykh ay kahn aa birthaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh sees Him with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d eesai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat ayk liv laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: People beg for peace, but they receive severe pain.
lines.transliteration: sukh maaNgat dukh aagal ho-ay.

lines.english: They are all weaving a wreath of corruption.
lines.transliteration: sagal vikaaree haar paro-ay.

lines.english: You are false - without the One, there is no liberation.
lines.transliteration: ayk binaa jhooth ay mukat  na ho-ay.

lines.english: The Creator created the creation, and He watches over it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar kar kartaa d aykhai so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The fire of desire is quenched by the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa agan sabad  bujhaa-ay.

lines.english: Duality and doubt are automatically eliminated.
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aram sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Naam abides in the heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naam rid ai vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the True Word of His Bani, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saachee banee har gun  gaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The True Lord abides within the body of that Gurmukh who enshrines love for Him.
lines.transliteration: tan meh saacho gurmukh  bhaa-o.

lines.english: Without the Naam, none obtain their own place.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa naahee nij thaa-o.

lines.english: The Beloved Lord King is dedicated to love.
lines.transliteration: paraym paraa-in pareet am raa-o.

lines.english: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then we realize His Name. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa boojh ai naa-o. ||5||

lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is total entanglement.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sarab janjaalaa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is filthy, cursed and dreadful.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kucheel kh uchhit bikraalaa.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, these entanglements are ended.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay chookai janjaalaa.

lines.english: In the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, you shall abide in lasting peace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad aa sukh  naalaa. ||6||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs understand the One Lord, and enshrine love for Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai ayk liv laa-ay.

lines.english: They dwell in the home of their own inner beings, and merge in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasai saach samaa-ay.

lines.english: The cycle of birth and death is ended.
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa thaak rahaa-ay.

lines.english: This understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||7||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay ih mat  paa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Speaking the speech, there is no end to it. pMnw 223
lines.transliteration: kathnee katha-o na aavai or.

lines.english: I have consulted the Guru, and I have seen that there is no other door than His.
lines.transliteration: gur puchh d aykhi-aa naahee d ar hor.

lines.english: Pain and pleasure reside in the Pleasure of His Will and His Command.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  bhaanai tisai rajaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord. ||8||4|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (223-2) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak neech kahai liv laa-ay. ||8||4||

lines.english: The duality of Maya dwells in the consciousness of the people of the world.
lines.transliteration: doojee maa-i-aa jagat  chit vaas.

lines.english: They are destroyed by sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar binaas. ||1||

lines.english: Whom should I call the second, when there is only the One?
lines.transliteration: doojaa ka-un  kahaa nahee ko-ee.

lines.english: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading among all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ayk niranjan so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The dual-minded evil intellect speaks of a second.
lines.transliteration: doojee d urmat  aakh ai do-ay.

lines.english: One who harbors duality comes and goes and dies. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aavai jaa-ay mar doojaa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Dharan  gagan nah d aykh-a-u d o-ay. In the earth and in the sky, I do not see any second.
Among all the women and the men, His Light is shining. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naaree purakh sabaa-ee lo-ay. ||3||

lines.english: In the lamps of the sun and the moon, I see His Light.
lines.transliteration: rav sas daykh -a-u d eepak uji-aalaa.

lines.english: Dwelling among all is my ever-youthful Beloved. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar pareet am baalaa. ||4||

lines.english: In His Mercy, He attuned my consciousness to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mayraa chit laa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru has led me to understand the One Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur mo ka-o ayk bujh aa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the One Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayk niranjan gurmukh jaat aa.

lines.english: Subduing duality, one comes to realize the Word of the Shabad. ||6||
lines.transliteration: doojaa maar sabad  pachh aataa. ||6||

lines.english: The Command of the One Lord prevails throughout all the worlds.
lines.transliteration: ayko hukam vartai sabh  lo-ee.

lines.english: From the One, all have arisen. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aykas tay sabh  opat ho-ee. ||7||

lines.english: There are two routes, but remember that their Lord and Master is only One.
lines.transliteration: raah dovai kh asam ayko jaan .

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad hukam pachh aan. ||8||

lines.english: He is contained in all forms, colors and minds.
lines.transliteration: sagal roop varan man maahee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, praise the One Lord. ||9||5|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (223-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ayko saalaahee. ||9||5||

lines.english: Those who live a spiritual lifestyle - they alone are true.
lines.transliteration: aDhi-aat am karam karay t aa saachaa.

lines.english: What can the false know about the secrets of liberation? ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukat bh ayd ki-aa jaan ai kaachaa. ||1||

lines.english: Those who contemplate the Way are Yogis.
lines.transliteration: aisaa jogee jugat beechaarai.

lines.english: They conquer the five thieves, and enshrine the True Lord in the heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: panch maar saach ur Dhaarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who enshrine the True Lord deep within,
lines.transliteration: jis kai antar saach vasaavai.
jog jugat kee keemat  paavai. ||2|| realize the value of the Way of Yoga. ||2||

lines.english: The sun and the moon are one and the same for them, as are household and wilderness.
lines.transliteration: rav sas ayko garih udi-aanai.

lines.english: The karma of their daily practice is to praise the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karnee keerat  karam samaanai. ||3||

lines.english: They beg for the alms of the one and only Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad ik bh ikhi-aa maagai.

lines.english: They remain awake and aware in spiritual wisdom and meditation, and the true wayof life. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan jugat  sach jaagai. ||4||

lines.english: They remain absorbed in the fear of God; they never leave it.
lines.transliteration: bhai rach rahai na baahar jaa-ay.

lines.english: Who can estimate their value? They remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: keemat ka-un  rahai liv laa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: The Lord unites them with Himself, dispelling their doubts.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay bharam chukaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: In the Guru's service is reflection upon the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa sabad veechaar.

lines.english: Subduing ego, practice pure actions. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maaray karnee saar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਰਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting, meditation, austere self-discipline and the reading of the Puraanas,
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam paath  puraan .

lines.english: Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak aprampar maan. ||8||6|| says Nanak, are contained in surrender to the Unlimited Lord. ||8||6|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (223-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 1.

lines.english: To practice forgiveness is the true fast, good conduct and contentment.
lines.transliteration: khimaa gahee barat  seel sant okhaN.

lines.english: Disease does not afflict me, nor does the pain of death.
lines.transliteration: rog na bi-aapai naa jam dokh aN.

lines.english: I am liberated, and absorbed into God, who has no form or feature. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-ay parabh  roop na raykh aN. ||1||

lines.english: What fear does the Yogi have?
lines.transliteration: jogee ka-o kaisaa dar ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord is among the trees and the plants, within the household and outside as well.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rookh birakh  garihi baahar so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Yogis meditate on the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o jogee niranjan Dh i-aavai.

lines.english: Night and day, they remain awake and aware, embracing love for the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din jaagai sach liv laavai.

lines.english: Those Yogis are pleasing to my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so jogee mayrai man bhaavai. ||2||

lines.english: The trap of death is burnt by the Fire of God.
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal barahm agnee jaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਤ  ਭਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Old age, death and pride are conquered.
lines.transliteration: jaraa maran gat  garab nivaaray.

lines.english: They swim across, and save their ancestors as well. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap tarai pit ree nist aaray. ||3||

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are the Yogis.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay so jogee ho-ay.

lines.english: Those who remain immersed in the Fear of God become fearless.
lines.transliteration: bhai rach rahai so nirbh a-o ho-ay.

lines.english: They become just like the One they serve. ||4|| pMnw 224
lines.transliteration: jaisaa sayvai taiso ho-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The Name makes a man pure and fearless.
lines.transliteration: nar nihkayval nirbha-o naa-o.

lines.english: It makes the masterless become the master of all. I am a sacrifice to him.
lines.transliteration: anaathah naath karay bal jaa-o.

lines.english: Such a person is not reincarnated again; he sings the Glories of God. ||5||
lines.transliteration: punrap janam naahee gun gaa-o. ||5||

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, he knows the One Lord;
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayko jaan ai.
gur kai sabday aap pachh aanai. through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he realizes himself.

lines.english: He bears the Banner and Insignia of the True Shabad in the Lord's Court. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad d ar neesaan ai. ||6||

lines.english: One who dies in the Shabad abides in his own home within.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai t is nij gh ar vaasaa.

lines.english: He does not come or go in reincarnation, and his hopes are subdued.
lines.transliteration: aavai na jaavai chookai aasaa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal pargaasaa. ||7||

lines.english: Whoever is seen, is driven by hope and despair,
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so aas niraasaa.
kaam karoDh bikh  bhookh pi-aasaa. by sexual desire, anger, corruption, hunger and thirst.

lines.english: O Nanak, those detached recluses who meet the Lord are so very rare. ||8||7|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (224-4) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak birlay mileh udaasaa. ||8||7||

lines.english: Meeting such a slave, peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: aiso daas milai sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: Pain is forgotten, when the True Lord is found. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dukh visrai paavai sach so-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Beholding the blessed vision of his darshan, my understanding has become perfect.
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykh bha-ee mat  pooree.

lines.english: The cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are in the dust of his feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: athsath  majan charnah Dh ooree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My eyes are contented with the constant love of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: naytar sant okhay ayk liv t aaraa.

lines.english: My tongue is purified by the most sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jihvaa soochee har ras saaraa. ||2||

lines.english: True are my actions, and deep within my being, I serve Him.
lines.transliteration: sach karnee abh  antar sayvaa.

lines.english: My mind is satisfied by the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man taript aasi-aa alakh  abhayvaa. ||3||

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I find the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh -a-u t ah tah saachaa.

lines.english: Without understanding, the world argues in falsehood. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay jh agrat jag kaachaa. ||4||

lines.english: When the Guru instructs, understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur samjhaavai sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: Show Your Mercy, and save me, O Savior Lord!
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakho rakh vaalay.

lines.english: Without understanding, people become beasts and demons. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay pasoo bh a-ay bayt aalay. ||6||

lines.english: The Guru has said that there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa avar nahee doojaa.

lines.english: So tell me, who should I see, and who should I worship? ||7||
lines.transliteration: kis kaho daykh  kara-o an poojaa. ||7||

lines.english: For the sake of the Saints, God has established the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: sant hayt  parabh  taribhavan Dhaaray.

lines.english: One who understands his own soul, contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aatam cheenai so t at beechaaray. ||8||

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with Truth and true love
lines.transliteration: saach ridai sach paraym nivaas.

lines.english: Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak ham t aa kay d aas. ||9||8|| - prays Nanak, I am his servant. ||9||8|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (224-11) ga-orhee mehlaa 1.

lines.english: Brahma acted in pride, and did not understand.
lines.transliteration: barahmai garab kee-aa nahee jaani-aa.

lines.english: Only when he was faced with the downfall of the Vedas did he repent.
lines.transliteration: bayd kee bipat  parhee pachh utaani-aa.

lines.english: Remembering God in meditation, the mind is conciliated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah parabh simray t ahee man maani-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥੯॥੮॥
lines.english: Such is the horrible pride of the world.
lines.transliteration: aisaa garab buraa sansaarai.

lines.english: The Guru eliminates the pride of those who meet Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis gur milai tis garab nivaarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Bal the King, in Maya and egotism,
lines.transliteration: bal raajaa maa-i-aa ahaNkaaree.
jagan karai baho bhaar afaaree. held his ceremonial feasts, but he was puffed up with pride.

lines.english: Without the Guru's advice, he had to go to the underworld. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin gur poochhay jaa-ay pa-i-aaree. ||2||

lines.english: Hari Chand gave in charity, and earned public praise.
lines.transliteration: hareechand d aan karai jas layvai.

lines.english: But without the Guru, he did not find the limits of the Mysterious Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin gur ant na paa-ay abh ayvai.

lines.english: The Lord Himself misleads people, and He Himself imparts understanding. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa-ay aapay mat  dayvai. ||3||

lines.english: The evil-minded Harnaakhash committed evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: durmat  harnaakhas duraachaaree.

lines.english: God, the Lord of all, is the Destroyer of pride.
lines.transliteration: parabh naaraa-in  garab par-haaree.

lines.english: He bestowed His Mercy, and saved Prahlaad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: parahlaad uDh aaray kirpaa Dh aaree. ||4||

lines.english: Raawan was deluded, foolish and unwise.
lines.transliteration: bhoolo raavan  mugaDh  achayt .

lines.english: Sri Lanka was plundered, and he lost his head.
lines.transliteration: lootee lankaa sees samayt.

lines.english: He indulged in ego, and lacked the love of the True Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: garab ga-i-aa bin satgur hayt . ||5||

lines.english: The Lord killed the thousand-armed Arjun, and the demons Madhu-keetab and Meh- khaasaa.
lines.transliteration: sahasbaahu maDh keet mahikh aasaa.

lines.english: He seized Harnaakhash and tore him apart with his nails.
lines.transliteration: harnaakh as lay nakh ahu biDh aasaa.

lines.english: The demons were slain; they did not practice devotional worship. ||6||
lines.transliteration: dait sangh aaray bin bh agat abhi-aasaa. ||6||

lines.english: The demons Jaraa-sandh and Kaal-jamun were destroyed.
lines.transliteration: jaraasanDh kaalajmun sangh aaray.

lines.english: Rakat-beej and Kaal-naym were annihilated.
lines.transliteration: rakatbeej kaalunaym bid aaray.

lines.english: Slaying the demons, the Lord saved His Saints. ||7||
lines.transliteration: dait sangh aar sant  nistaaray. ||7||

lines.english: He Himself, as the True Guru, contemplates the Shabad. pMnw 225
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur sabad  beechaaray.

lines.english: Because of the love of duality, God killed the demons.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay d ait sangh aaray.

lines.english: By their true devotion, the Gurmukhs have been saved. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saach bh agat nistaaray. ||8||

lines.english: Sinking down, Durodhan lost his honor.
lines.transliteration: boodaa durjoDh an pat  kho-ee.

lines.english: He did not know the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam na jaani-aa kartaa so-ee.

lines.english: One who makes the Lord's humble servant suffer, shall himself suffer and rot. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o dookh  pachai d ukh ho-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਿਖ ਪਚੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Janameja did not know the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: janmayjai gur sabad na jaani-aa.

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, how could he find peace?
lines.transliteration: ki-o sukh paavai bh aram bh ulaani-aa.

lines.english: Making a mistake, for even an instant, you shall regret and repent later on. ||10||
lines.transliteration: ik til bh oolay bahur pachh utaani-aa. ||10||

lines.english: Kansa the King and his warriors Kays and Chandoor had no equals.
lines.transliteration: kans kays chaaNdoor na ko-ee.

lines.english: But they did not remember the Lord, and they lost their honor.
lines.transliteration: raam na cheeni-aa apnee pat kh o-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਿਨਆ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord of the Universe, no one can be saved. ||11||
lines.transliteration: bin jagdees na raakh ai ko-ee. ||11||

lines.english: Without the Guru, pride cannot be eradicated.
lines.transliteration: bin gur garab na mayti-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one obtains Dharmic faith, composure and the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: gurmat Dh aram Dh eeraj har naa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, singing the Glories of God, His Name is received. ||12||9|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (225-6) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai gun gaa-ay. ||12||9||

lines.english: I may anoint my limbs with sandalwood oil.
lines.transliteration: cho-aa chandan ank charh aava-o.

lines.english: I may dress up and wear silk and satin clothes.
lines.transliteration: paat patambar pahir hadhaava-o.

lines.english: But without the Lord's Name, where would I find peace? ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin har naam kahaa sukh paava-o. ||1||

lines.english: So what should I wear? In what clothes should I display myself?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa pahira-o ki-aa odh d ikhaava-o.

lines.english: Without the Lord of the Universe, how can I find peace? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin jagdees kahaa sukh  paava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I may wear ear-rings, and a pearl necklace around my neck;
lines.transliteration: kaanee kundal gal motee-an kee maalaa.
laal nihaalee fool gulaalaa. my bed may be adorned with red blankets, flowers and red powder;
bin jagdees kahaa sukh  bhaalaa. ||2|| but without the Lord of the Universe, where can I search for peace? ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਨੀ  ਕੁੰਡਲ  ਗਿਲ  ਮੋਤੀਅਨ  ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I may have a beautiful woman with fascinating eyes;
lines.transliteration: nain salonee sundar naaree.
khorh  seegaar karai at  pi-aaree. she may decorate herself with the sixteen adornments, and make herself appear gorgeous.

lines.english: But without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, there is only continual suffering.||3||
lines.transliteration: bin jagdees bh ajay nit  khu-aaree. ||3||

lines.english: In his hearth and home, in his palace, upon his soft and comfortable bed,
lines.transliteration: dar gh ar mehlaa sayj sukh aalee.
ahinis fool bichhaavai maalee. day and night, the flower-girls scatter flower petals;
bin har naam so dayh d ukhaalee. ||4|| but without the Lord's Name, the body is miserable. ||4||

lines.english: Horses, elephants, lances, marching bands,
lines.transliteration: haivar gaivar nayjay vaajay.
laskar nayb khavaasee paajay. armies, standard bearers, royal attendants and ostentatious displays
bin jagdees jh oothay divaajay. ||5|| - without the Lord of the Universe, these undertakings are all useless. ||5||

lines.english: He may be called a Siddha, a man of spiritual perfection, and he may summon richesand supernatural powers;
lines.transliteration: siDh kahaava-o riDh  siDh bulaava-o.
taaj kulah sir chh atar banaava-o. he may place a crown upon his head, and carry a royal umbrella;
bin jagdees kahaa sach paava-o. ||6|| but without the Lord of the Universe, where can Truth be found? ||6||

lines.english: He may be called an emperor, a lord, and a king;
lines.transliteration: khaan malook kahaava-o raajaa.
abay tabay koorh ay hai paajaa. he may give orders - "Do this now, do this then" - but this is a false display.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his works are not accomplished. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad na savras kaajaa. ||7||

lines.english: Egotism and possessiveness are dispelled by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa gur sabad  visaaree.

lines.english: With the Guru's Teachings in my heart, I have come to know the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat jaani-aa rid ai muraaree.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||8||10|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (225-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak saran  tumaaree. ||8||10||

lines.english: Those who serve the One Lord, do not know any other.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa ayk na jaanas avray.

lines.english: They abandon the bitter worldly conflicts.
lines.transliteration: parpanch bi-aaDh t i-aagai kavray.

lines.english: Through love and truth, they meet the Truest of the True. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay milai sach saachai sach ray. ||1||

lines.english: Such are the humble devotees of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa raam bhagat  jan ho-ee.

lines.english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and their pollution is washed away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay milai mal Dh o-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The heart-lotus of the entire universe is upside-down.
lines.transliteration: ooNDho kaval sagal sansaarai.

lines.english: The fire of evil-mindedness is burning up the world.
lines.transliteration: durmat  agan jagat  parjaarai.

lines.english: They alone are saved, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so ubrai gur sabad beechaarai. ||2||

lines.english: The bumble bee, the moth, the elephant, the fish
lines.transliteration: bharing pat ang kunchar ar meenaa.
mirag marai seh apunaa keenaa. and the deer - all suffer for their actions, and die.

lines.english: Trapped by desire, they cannot see reality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa raach t at nahee beenaa. ||3||

lines.english: The lover of women is obsessed with sex.
lines.transliteration: kaam chitai kaaman  hitkaaree.

lines.english: All the wicked are ruined by their anger.
lines.transliteration: kroDh binaasai sagal vikaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ  ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Honor and good sense are lost, when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4|| pMnw 226
lines.transliteration: pat mat  khoveh naam visaaree. ||4||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is lured by another man's wife.
lines.transliteration: par ghar cheet  manmukh  dolaa-ay.

lines.english: The noose is around his neck, and he is entangled in petty conflicts.
lines.transliteration: gal jayvree DhanDh ai laptaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is emancipated, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chh ootas har gun  gaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: The lonely widow gives her body to a stranger;
lines.transliteration: ji-o tan biDh vaa par ka-o d ay-ee.
kaam daam chit  par vas say-ee. she allows her mind to be controlled by others for lust or money
bin pir taripat  na kabahooN ho-ee. ||6|| , but without her husband, she is never satisfied. ||6||

lines.english: You may read, recite and study the scriptures, the Simritees, Vedas and Puraanas;
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pothee simrit  paath aa. bayd  puraan  parhai sun  thaataa.
bin ras raatay man baho naataa. ||7|| but without being imbued with the Lord's essence, the mind wanders endlessly. ||7||

lines.english: As the rainbird thirsts longingly for the drop of rain,
lines.transliteration: ji-o chaatrik jal paraym pi-aasaa.
ji-o meenaa jal maahi ulaasaa. and as the fish delights in the water,

lines.english: Nanak is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord. ||8||11|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (226-5) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har ras pee taript aasaa. ||8||11||

lines.english: One who dies in stubbornness shall not be approved,
lines.transliteration: hath kar marai na laykh ai paavai.
vays karai baho bhasam lagaavai. even though he may wear religious robes and smear his body all over with ashes.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he comes to regret and repent in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar bahur pachhut aavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਠੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Believe in the Dear Lord, and you shall find peace of mind.
lines.transliteration: tooN man har jee-o t ooN man sookh .

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, you shall have to endure the pain of death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar saheh jam dookh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The smell of musk, sandalwood and camphor,
lines.transliteration: cho-aa chandan agar kapoor.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੂੰ ਮਿਨ ਸੂਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa magan param pad d oor. and the intoxication of Maya, takes one far away from the state of supreme dignity.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, one becomes the most false of all the false. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam bisaari-ai sabh koorh o koor. ||2||

lines.english: Lances and swords, marching bands, thrones and the salutes of others
lines.transliteration: nayjay vaajay takh at salaam.
aDhkee t arisnaa vi-aapai kaam. only increase his desire; he is engrossed in sexual desire.

lines.english: Without seeking the Lord, neither devotional worship nor the Naam are obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin har jaachay bhagat  na naam. ||3||

lines.english: Union with God is not obtained by arguments and egotism.
lines.transliteration: vaad ahaNkaar naahee parabh  maylaa.

lines.english: But by offering your mind, the comfort of the Naam is obtained.
lines.transliteration: man day paavahi naam suhaylaa.

lines.english: In the love of duality and ignorance, you shall suffer. ||4||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay agi-aan d uhaylaa. ||4||

lines.english: Without money, you cannot buy anything in the store.
lines.transliteration: bin dam kay sa-ud aa nahee haat.

lines.english: Without a boat, you cannot cross over the ocean.
lines.transliteration: bin bohith saagar nahee vaat.

lines.english: Without serving the Guru, everything is lost. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sayvay ghaatay gh aat. ||5||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who shows us the Way.
lines.transliteration: tis ka-o vaahu vaahu je vaat d ikhaavai.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who teaches the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tis ka-o vaahu vaahu je sabad  sunaavai.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who unites me in the Lord's Union. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tis ka-o vaahu vaahu je mayl milaavai. ||6||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who is the Keeper of this soul.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis ka-o jis kaa ih jee-o.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate this Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee math amrit  pee-o.

lines.english: The Glorious Greatness of the Naam is bestowed according to the Pleasure of Your Will. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam vadaa-ee tuDh  bhaanai dee-o. ||7||

lines.english: Without the Naam, how can I live, O mother?
lines.transliteration: naam binaa ki-o jeevaa maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I chant it; I remain in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: an-din japat  raha-o t ayree sarn aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, honor is attained. ||8||12|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (226-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay pat  paa-ay. ||8||12||

lines.english: Acting in egotism, the Lord is not known, even by wearing religious robes.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karat bh aykhee nahee jaani-aa.

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh, who surrenders his mind in devotional worship. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat virlay man maani-aa. ||1||

lines.english: By actions done in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the True Lord is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karat nahee sach paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: But when egotism departs, then the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jaa-ay param pad paa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The kings act in egotism, and undertake all sorts of expeditions.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kar raajay baho Dhaaveh.

lines.english: But through their egotism, they are ruined; they die, only to be reborn over and over again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai khapeh janam mar aavahi. ||2||

lines.english: Egotism is overcome only by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai nivrai gur sabad veechaarai.

lines.english: One who restrains his fickle mind subdues the five passions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chanchal mat t i-aagai panch sangh aarai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਨਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: With the True Lord deep within the self, the Celestial Mansion is intuitively found.
lines.transliteration: antar saach sahj gh ar aavahi.

lines.english: Understanding the Sovereign Lord, the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||4||
lines.transliteration: raajan jaan param gat  paavahi. ||4||

lines.english: The Guru dispels the doubts of those whose actions are true.
lines.transliteration: sach karnee gur bh aram chukh aavai.

lines.english: They focus their attention on the Home of the Fearless Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o kai gh ar taarhee laavai. ||5||

lines.english: Those who act in egotism, selfishness and conceit die; what do they gain?
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o kar marnaa ki-aa paavai.

lines.english: Those who meet the Perfect Guru are rid of all conflicts. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pooraa gur bhaytay so jh agar chukh aavai. ||6||

lines.english: Whatever exists, is in reality nothing.
lines.transliteration: jaytee hai t aytee kihu naahee.

lines.english: Obtaining spiritual wisdom from the Guru, I sing the Glories of God. ||7|| pMnw 227
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan bh ayt gun  gaahee. ||7||

lines.english: Egotism binds people in bondage, and causes them to wander around lost.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai banDhan banDh  bhavaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, peace is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||8||13|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (227-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam bhagat  sukh  paavai. ||8||13||

lines.english: First, Brahma entered the house of Death.
lines.transliteration: parathmay barahmaa kaalai ghar aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Brahma entered the lotus, and searched the nether regions, but he did not find theend of it.
lines.transliteration: barahm kamal pa-i-aal na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: He did not accept the Lord's Order - he was deluded by doubt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa nahee leenee bharam bh ulaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Whoever is created, shall be destroyed by Death.
lines.transliteration: jo upjai so kaal sanghaari-aa.

lines.english: But I am protected by the Lord; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham har raakhay gur sabad  beechaari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All the gods and goddesses are enticed by Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohay dayvee sabh  dayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Death cannot be avoided, without serving the Guru.
lines.transliteration: kaal na chhodai bin gur kee sayvaa.

lines.english: That Lord is Imperishable, Invisible and Inscrutable. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oh abhinaasee alakh  abhayvaa. ||2||

lines.english: The sultans, emperors and kings shall not remain.
lines.transliteration: sultaan kh aan baad isaah nahee rahnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Name, they shall endure the pain of death.
lines.transliteration: naamhu bhoolai jam kaa d ukh sahnaa.

lines.english: My only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as He keeps me, I survive. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mai Dhar naam ji-o raakh o rahnaa. ||3||

lines.english: The leaders and kings shall not remain.
lines.transliteration: cha-uDhree raajay nahee kisai mukaam.

lines.english: The bankers shall die, after accumulating their wealth and money.
lines.transliteration: saah mareh saNcheh maa-i-aa daam.

lines.english: Grant me, O Lord, the wealth of Your Ambrosial Naam. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mai Dhan d eejai har amrit  naam. ||4||

lines.english: The people, rulers, leaders and chiefs
lines.transliteration: ra-yat mahar mukd am sikd aarai.
nihchal ko-ay na disai sansaarai. - none of them shall be able to remain in the world.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Death is inevitable; it strikes the heads of the false. ||5||
lines.transliteration: afri-o kaal koorh sir maarai. ||5||

lines.english: Only the One Lord, the Truest of the True, is permanent.
lines.transliteration: nihchal ayk sachaa sach so-ee.

lines.english: He who created and fashioned everything, shall destroy it.
lines.transliteration: jin kar saajee tineh sabh  go-ee.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh and meditates on the Lord is honored. ||6||
lines.transliteration: oh gurmukh jaapai t aaN pat ho-ee. ||6||

lines.english: The Qazis, Shaykhs and Fakeers in religious robes
lines.transliteration: kaajee saykh bh aykh fakeeraa.
vaday kahaaveh ha-umai tan peeraa. call themselves great; but through their egotism, their bodies are suffering in pain.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਪੈ ਤ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Death does not spare them, without the Support of the True Guru. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kaal na chhodai bin sat gur kee Dh eeraa. ||7||

lines.english: The trap of Death is hanging over their tongues and eyes.
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal jihvaa ar nainee.

lines.english: Death is over their ears, when they hear talk of evil.
lines.transliteration: kaanee kaal sunai bikh  bainee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, they are plundered, day and night. ||8||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai mooth ay din rain ee. ||8||

lines.english: Death cannot touch those whose hearts are filled with the True Name of the Lord, and who sing the Glories of God.
lines.transliteration: hirdai saach vasai har naa-ay. kaal na johi sakai gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||9||14|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (227-12) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sabad  samaa-ay. ||9||14||

lines.english: They speak the Truth - not an iota of falsehood.
lines.transliteration: boleh saach mithi-aa nahee raa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs walk in the Way of the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: chaaleh gurmukh hukam rajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਜੋਿਹ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They remain unattached, in the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raheh ateet  sachay sarn aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: They dwell in their true home, and Death does not touch them.
lines.transliteration: sach ghar baisai kaal na johai.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs come and go, in the pain of emotional attachment. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: manmukh ka-o aavat  jaavat  dukh mohai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So, drink deeply of this Nectar, and speak the Unspoken Speech.
lines.transliteration: api-o pee-a-o akath kath rahee-ai.

lines.english: Dwelling in the home of your own being within, you shall find the home of intuitivepeace.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar bais sahj gh ar lahee-ai.

lines.english: One who is imbued with the Lord's sublime essence, is said to experience this peace.||2||
lines.transliteration: har ras maatay ih sukh  kahee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚ ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfectly stable, and never wavers.
lines.transliteration: gurmat chaal nihchal nahee dolai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਉ ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਵਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one intuitively chants the Name of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat saach sahj har bolai.

lines.english: Drinking in this Ambrosial Nectar, and chur ning it, the essential reality is discerned. ||3||
lines.transliteration: peevai amrit t at virolai. ||3||

lines.english: Beholding the True Guru, I have received His Teachings.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aykhi-aa d eekhi-aa leenee.
