lines.english: I have offered my mind and body, after searching deep within my own being.
lines.transliteration: man tan arpi-o ant ar gat  keenee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have come to realize the value of understanding my own soul. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gat mit  paa-ee aat am cheenee. ||4||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, is the most excellent and sublime food.
lines.transliteration: bhojan naam niranjan saar.

lines.english: The pure swan-souls see the True Light of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: param hans sach jot apaar.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the One and Only Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah aykankaar. ||5||

lines.english: One who remains pure and unblemished and practices only true deeds,
lines.transliteration: rahai niraalam aykaa sach karnee.
param pad paa-i-aa sayvaa gur charn ee. obtains the supreme status, serving at the Guru's Feet.

lines.english: The mind is reconciliated with the mind, and the ego's wandering ways come to an end. ||6||
lines.transliteration: man tay man maani-aa chookee ahaN bharman ee. ||6||

lines.english: In this way, who - who has not been saved?
lines.transliteration: in biDh ka-un  ka-un  nahee t aari-aa.

lines.english: The Lord's Praises have saved His Saints and devotees. pMnw 228
lines.transliteration: har jas sant bh agat nistaari-aa.

lines.english: I have found God - I am not searching for any other. ||7||
lines.transliteration: parabh paa-ay ham avar na bh aari-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਏ ਹਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਿਰਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Guru has shown me the unseen Mansion of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saach mahal gur alakh lakh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: His Mansion is eternal and unchanging; it is not a mere reflection of Maya.
lines.transliteration: nihchal mahal nahee chhaa-i-aa maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through truth and contentment, doubt is dispelled. ||8||
lines.transliteration: saach santokh ay bh aram chukaa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.english: That person, within whose mind the True Lord dwells
lines.transliteration: jin kai man vasi-aa sach so-ee.
tin kee sangat  gurmukh  ho-ee. - in his company, one becomes Gurmukh.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Name washes off the pollution. ||9||15|| gauVI mhlw 1 ] (228-3) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach naam mal kho-ee. ||9||15||

lines.english: One whose consciousness is permeated with the Lord's Name
lines.transliteration: raam naam chit raapai jaa kaa.
upjamp darsan keejai t aa kaa. ||1|| - receive the blessing of his darshan in the early light of dawn. ||1||

lines.english: If you do not meditate on the Lord, it is your own misfortune.
lines.transliteration: raam na japahu abhaag t umaaraa.

lines.english: In each and every age, the Great Giver is my Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jug jug daat aa parabh  raam hamaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the perfect humble beings meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat raam japai jan pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਦਾਤਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within their hearts, the unstruck melody vibrates. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tit ghat anhat  baajay t ooraa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who worship the Lord and love the Lord
lines.transliteration: jo jan raam bhagat  har pi-aar.
say parabh raakh ay kirpaa Dh aar. ||3|| - showering His Mercy, God protects them. ||3||

lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, Har, Har
lines.transliteration: jin kai hirdai har har so-ee.
tin kaa d aras paras sukh  ho-ee. ||4|| - gazing upon the blessed vision of their darshan, peace is obtained. ||4||

lines.english: Among all beings, the One Lord is pervading.
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa meh ayko ravai.

lines.english: The eogtistical, self-willed manmukhs wander in reincarnation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: manmukh ahaNkaaree fir joonee bh avai. ||5||

lines.english: They alone understand, who have found the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: so boojhai jo sat gur paa-ay.

lines.english: Subduing their ego, they receive the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maaray gur sabday paa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: How can anyone know of the Union between the being below and the Supreme Beingabove?
lines.transliteration: araDh uraDh  kee sanDh  ki-o jaanai.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain this Union; their minds are reconciliated. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sanDh  milai man maanai. ||7||

lines.english: I am a worthless sinner, without merit. What merit do I have?
lines.transliteration: ham paapee nirgun ka-o gun  karee-ai.

lines.english: When God showers His Mercy, servant Nanak is emancipated. ||8||16||
lines.transliteration: parabh ho-ay d a-i-aal naanak jan t aree-ai. ||8||16||

lines.english: Sixteen Ashtapadees Of Gwaarayree Gauree|| gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 1  (228-11) ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 1 Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (228-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: solah asatpadee-aa gu-aarayree ga-orh ee kee-aa.

lines.english: Dhaaraa. ||1|| As the dairy farmer watches over and protects his cows, so does the Lord cherish and protect us, night and day. He blesses the soul with peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gauVI bYrwgix, mÚ 1) ji-o gaa-ee ka-o go-ilee raakhahi kar saaraa. ahinis paaleh raakh  layhi aat am sukh

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Please protect me here and hereafter, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: it ut raakh o deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary; please bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ta-o sarn aagat  nadar nihaalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there You are. Save me, O Savior Lord!
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah rav rahay rakh  raakh anhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਗਾਈ  ਕਉ ਗੋਇਲੀ  ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਕਿਰ ਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver, and You are the Enjoyer; You are the Support of the breath of life.||2||
lines.transliteration: tooN daataa bh ugtaa tooNhai tooN paraan  aDhaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਪਾਲਿਹ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਿਹ ਆਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: According to the karma of past actions, people descend to the depths or rise to the heights, unless they contemplate spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: kirat pa-i-aa aDh  oorDh ee bin gi-aan beechaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the darkness is not dispelled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin upmaa jagdees kee binsai na anDh i-aaraa. ||3||

lines.english: I have seen the world being destroyed by greed and egotism.
lines.transliteration: jag binsat ham d aykhi-aa lobh ay ahaNkaaraa.

lines.english: Only by serving the Guru is God obtained, and the true gate of liberation found. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa parabh paa-i-aa sach mukat  du-aaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਹ ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਰਖੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Mansion of the Infinite Lord's Presence is within the home of one's own being. Heis beyond any boundaries.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal apaar ko aprampar so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, nothing shall endure. Through understanding, peaceis obtained. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai thir ko nahee boojh ai sukh  ho-ee. ||5||

lines.english: What have you brought, and what will you take away, when you are caught by thenoose of Death?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa lai aa-i-aa lay jaa-ay ki-aa faaseh jam jaalaa.

lines.english: Like the bucket tied to the rope in the well, you are pulled up to the Akaashic Ethers,and then lowered down to the nether regions of the underworld. ||6||
lines.transliteration: dol baDhaa kas jayvree aakaas pat aalaa. ||6||

lines.english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall automatically obtain honor.
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam na veesrai sehjay pat  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Deep within the self is the treasure of the Shabad; it is obtained only by eradicatingselfishness and conceit. ||7||
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  niDhaan hai mil aap gavaa-ee-ai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਕੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, people settle in the Lap of the Virtuous Lord.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay parabh  aapn ee gun  ank samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਿਥਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this Union cannot be broken; the true profit is obtained. ||8||1||17|| pMnw 229 gauVI mhlw 1 ] (229-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 1. Gauree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl na chook-ee laahaa sach paavai. ||8||1||17||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੭॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, and then, the account is settled.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee boojh lay t a-o ho-ay nibayraa.

lines.english: In each and every heart is the Name of the Immaculate Lord; He is my Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar naam niranjanaa so th aakur mayraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਬੂਿਝ ਲੇ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਿਨਬੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one is emancipated. See this, and reflectupon it.
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad na chh ootee-ai d aykhhu veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even though you may perform hundreds of thousands of rituals, without the Guru, there is only darkness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay lakh karam kamaavahee bin gur anDh i-aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: What can you say, to one who is blind and without wisdom?
lines.transliteration: anDhay aklee baahray ki-aa t in si-o kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਹੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਿਧਆਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the Path cannot be seen. How can anyone proceed? ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin gur panth na soojh-ee kit  biDh nirabahee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: He calls the counterfeit genuine, and does not know the value of the genuine.
lines.transliteration: khotay ka-o kh araa kahai kh aray saar na jaan ai.

lines.english: The blind man is known as an appraiser; this Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so strange!||3||
lines.transliteration: anDhay kaa naa-o paarkh oo kalee kaal vidaan ai. ||3||

lines.english: The sleeper is said to be awake, and those who are awake are like sleepers.
lines.transliteration: sootay ka-o jaagat  kahai jaagat  ka-o soot aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਖਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਖਰੇ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: The living are said to be dead, and no one mourns for those who have died. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jeevat ka-o moo-aa kahai moo-ay nahee rot aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ  ਕਲੀ  ਕਾਲ  ਿਵਡਾਣੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.
lines.transliteration: aavat ka-o jaat aa kahai jaat ay ka-o aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਤੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਗਤੁ  ਕਹੈ ਜਾਗਤ  ਕਉ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
lines.english: That which belongs to others, he calls his own, but he has no liking for that which ishis. ||5||
lines.transliteration: par kee ka-o apunee kahai apuno nahee bhaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਰੋਤਾ ॥੪॥
lines.english: That which is sweet is said to be bitter, and the bitter is said to be sweet.
lines.transliteration: meethay ka-o ka-urh aa kahai karh oo-ay ka-o meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ  ਕਹੈ ਜਾਤੇ  ਕਉ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who is imbued with the Lord's Love is slandered - his is what I have seen in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||6||
lines.transliteration: raatay kee nind aa karahi aisaa kal meh deeth aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਕਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.english: He serves the maid, and does not see his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: chayree kee sayvaa karahi thaakur nahee d eesai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਠੇ ਕਉ ਕਉੜਾ  ਕਹੈ ਕੜੂਏ  ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Churning the water in the pond, no butter is produced. ||7||
lines.transliteration: pokhar neer virolee-ai maakh an nahee reesai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਤੇ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਐਸਾ  ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who understands the meaning of this verse is my Guru.
lines.transliteration: is pad jo arthaa-ay lay-ay so guroo hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who knows his own self, is infinite and incomparable. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naanak cheenai aap ka-o so apar apaaraa. ||8||

lines.english: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself misleads the people.
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay aap varatd aa aapay bh armaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਇ ਲੇਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, that God is contained in all. ||9||2||18|| rwgu gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 3 AstpdIAw  (229-11) raag ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 3 asatpad ee-aa Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (229-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay boojh ee-ai sabh  barahm samaa-i-aa. ||9||2||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪ  ਕਉ ਸੋ ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The pollution of the mind is the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: man kaa sootak d oojaa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, people come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolay aava-o jaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥੨॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The pollution of the self-willed manmukhs will never go away,
lines.transliteration: manmukh soot ak kabeh na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jichar sabad na bh eejai har kai naa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. as long as they do not dwell on the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: All the created beings are contaminated by emotional attachment;
lines.transliteration: sabho soot ak jayt aa moh aakaar.
mar mar jammai vaaro vaar. ||2|| they die and are reborn, only to die over and over again. ||2||

lines.english: Fire, air and water are polluted.
lines.transliteration: sootak agan pa-un ai paan ee maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਚਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The food which is eaten is polluted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sootak bh ojan jayt aa kichh  khaahi. ||3||

lines.english: The actions of those who do not worship the Lord are polluted.
lines.transliteration: sootak karam na poojaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay man nirmal ho-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, pollution is eradicated,
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai soot ak jaa-ay.
marai na janmai kaal na khaa-ay. ||5|| and then, one does not suffer death and rebirth, or get devoured by death. ||5||

lines.english: You may study and examine the Shaastras and the Simritees,
lines.transliteration: saasat simrit  soDh  daykhhu ko-ay.
vin naavai ko mukat  na ho-ay. ||6|| but without the Name, no one is liberated. ||6||

lines.english: Throughout the four ages, the Naam is the ultimate; reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jug chaaray naam utam sabad  beechaar.

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Gurmukhs cross over. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kal meh gurmukh ut ras paar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਖਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The True Lord does not die; He does not come or go.
lines.transliteration: saachaa marai na aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains absorbed in the Lord. ||8||1|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (229-18) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh rahai samaa-ay. ||8||1||

lines.english: Selfless service is the support of the breath of life of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa paraan aDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Keep the Dear Lord enshrined in your heart.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o raakho hird ai ur Dh aaraa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sobh aa saach d u-aaraa. ||1||

lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, read about the Lord, and renounce your corrupt ways.
lines.transliteration: pandit har parh  tajahu vikaaraa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 230
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh a-ojal ut arahu paaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukh eradicates egotism from within.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vichahu ha-umai jaa-ay.

lines.english: No filth sticks to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mail na laagai aa-ay.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam vasai man aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Through karma and Dharma, good actions and righteous faith, the Gurmukh becomes true.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karam Dh aram sach ho-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh burns away egotism and duality.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ahaNkaar jalaa-ay d o-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Naam, and is at peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam rat ay sukh  ho-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Instruct your own mind, and understand Him.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa man parboDh ahu boojh hu so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You may preach to other people, but no one will listen.
lines.transliteration: lok samjhaavhu sun ay na ko-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh understands, and is always at peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh samjh ahu sad aa sukh  ho-ee. ||4||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are such clever hypocrites.
lines.transliteration: manmukh damf bahut  chaturaa-ee.

lines.english: No matter what they do, it is not acceptable.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kamaavai so thaa-ay na paa-ee.

lines.english: They come and go in reincarnation, and find no place of rest. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aavai jaavai tha-ur na kaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੁ ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The manmukhs perform their rituals, but they are totally selfish and conceited.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam karay bahut  abhimaanaa.

lines.english: They sit there, like storks, pretending to meditate.
lines.transliteration: bag ji-o laa-ay bahai nit Dh i-aanaa.

lines.english: Caught by the Messenger of Death, they shall regret and repent in the end. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jam pakrhi-aa t ab hee pachh utaanaa. ||6||

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay mukat  na ho-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one meets the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee milai har so-ee.

lines.english: The Guru is the Great Giver, throughout the four ages. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa jug chaaray ho-ee. ||7||

lines.english: For the Gurmukh, the Naam is social status, honor and glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaat  pat naamay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Maya, the daughter of the ocean, has been slain.
lines.transliteration: saa-ir kee putree bid aar gavaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, all clever tricks are false. ||8||2|| gauVI mÚ 3 ] (230-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai jhooth ee chat uraa-ee. ||8||2||

lines.english: Learn the Dharma of this age, O Siblings of Destiny;
lines.transliteration: is jug kaa Dharam parh ahu tum bh aa-ee.
poorai gur sabh sojh ee paa-ee. all understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, the Lord's Name is our Companion. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aithai agai har naam sakhaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ  ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Learn of the Lord, and contemplate Him in your mind.
lines.transliteration: raam parhahu man karahu beechaar.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, your filth shall be washed away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee mail utaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through argument and debate, He cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: vaad viroDh  na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: The mind and body are made insipid through the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: man tan feekaa d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, lovingly attune yourself to the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sach liv laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: This world is polluted with egotism.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mailaa ih sansaaraa.

lines.english: By taking cleansing baths daily at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, egotism is not eliminated.
lines.transliteration: nit tirath naavai na jaa-ay ahaNkaaraa.

lines.english: Without meeting the Guru, they are tortured by Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhaytay jam karay kh u-aaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Those humble beings are true, who conquer their ego.
lines.transliteration: so jan saachaa je ha-umai maarai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they conquer the five thieves.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad panch sangh aarai.

lines.english: They save themselves, and save all their generations as well. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aap tarai saglay kul t aarai. ||4||

lines.english: The Actor has staged the drama of emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi nat baajee paa-ee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs cling blindly to it.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  rahay laptaa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs remain detached, and lovingly attune themselves to the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh alipat  rahay liv laa-ee. ||5||

lines.english: The disguisers put on their various disguises.
lines.transliteration: bahutay bh aykh karai bh aykh-Dhaaree.

lines.english: Desire rages within them, and they carry on egotistically.
lines.transliteration: antar t isnaa firai ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: They do not understand themselves, and they lose the game of life. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aap na cheenai baajee haaree. ||6||

lines.english: Putting on religious robes, they act so clever,
lines.transliteration: kaaparh pahir karay chat uraa-ee.
maa-i-aa mohi at bh aram bh ulaa-ee. but they are totally deluded by doubt and emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.english: Without serving the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sayvay bahut d ukh paa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain detached forever.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sad aa bairaagee.

lines.english: Even as householders, they lovingly attune themselves to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: garihee antar saach liv laagee.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who serve the True Guru are blessed and very fortunate. ||8||3|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (230-17) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur sayveh say vadbh aagee. ||8||3||

lines.english: Brahma is the founder of the study of the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa mool vayd abh i-aasaa.

lines.english: From him emanated the gods, enticed by desire.
lines.transliteration: tis tay upjay d ayv moh pi-aasaa.

lines.english: They wander in the three qualities, and they do not dwell within their own home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  bharmay naahee nij gh ar vaasaa. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord has saved me; I have met the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ham har raakhay sat guroo milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He has implanted devotional worship of the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat har naam drirh -aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The songs of Brahma entangle people in the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  banee barahm janjaalaa.

lines.english: Reading about the debates and disputes, they are hit over the head by the Messenger of Death. pMnw 231
lines.transliteration: parh vaad  vakaan eh sir maaray jamkaalaa.

lines.english: They do not understand the essence of reality, and they gather their worthless bundles of straw. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tat na cheeneh baneh pand paraalaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਹ  ਬੰਨਿਹ  ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, in ignorance, take the path of evil.
lines.transliteration: manmukh agi-aan kumaarag paa-ay.

lines.english: They forget the Lord's Name, and in its place, they establish all sorts of rituals.
lines.transliteration: har naam bisaari-aa baho karam drirh-aa-ay.

lines.english: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, in the love of duality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhavjal doobay d oojai bh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Driven crazy, infatuated by Maya, they call themselves Pandits - religious scholars;
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaa muhtaaj pandit  kahaavai.
bikhi-aa raat aa bahut  dukh paavai. stained with corruption, they suffer terrible pain.

lines.english: The noose of the Messenger of Death is around their necks; they are constantly tormented by death. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jam kaa gal jayvrhaa nit  kaal sant aavai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਿਲ  ਜੇਵੜਾ  ਿਨਤ ਕਾਲੁ  ਸੰਤਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jamkaal nayrh  na aavai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, they burn away their ego and duality.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai doojaa sabad  jalaavai.

lines.english: Attuned to the Name, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naamay raatay har gun  gaavai. ||5||

lines.english: Maya is the slave of the Lord's devotees; it works for them.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa daasee bh agtaa kee kaar kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਦਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who falls at their feet attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: charnee laagai t aa mahal paavai.

lines.english: He is forever immaculate; he is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sad hee nirmal sahj samaavai. ||6||

lines.english: Those who listen to the Lord's Sermon are seen to be the wealthy people in this world.
lines.transliteration: har kathaa suneh say Dh anvant  diseh jug maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ  ਿਦਸਿਹ  ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone bows down to them, and adores them, night and day.
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o sabh  niveh an-d in pooj karaahee.

lines.english: They intuitively savor the Glories of the True Lord within their minds. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sehjay gun raveh saachay man maahee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵਿਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has revealed the Shabad;
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur sabad  sunaa-i-aa.
tarai gun  maytay cha-uthai chit  laa-i-aa. it eradicates the three qualities, and attunes the consciousness to the fourth state.

lines.english: O Nanak, subduing egotism, one is absorbed into God. ||8||4|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (231-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai maar barahm milaa-i-aa. ||8||4||

lines.english: Brahma studied the Vedas, but these lead only to debates and disputes.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa vayd parh ai vaad  vakh aanai.

lines.english: He is filled with darkness; he does not understand himself.
lines.transliteration: antar t aamas aap na pachh aanai.

lines.english: And yet, if he chants the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he finds God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa parabh  paa-ay gur sabad  vakh aanai. ||1||

lines.english: So serve the Guru, and you shall not be consumed by death.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa kara-o fir kaal na khaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have been consumed by the love of duality. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: manmukh kh aaDhay doojai bh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Becoming Gurmukh, the sinful mortals are purified.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paraan ee apraaDh ee seeDh ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find intuitive peace and poise deep within.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ant ar sahj reeDh ay.

lines.english: I have found my God, through the Guru's Shabad, and I have been reformed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh paa-i-aa gur kai sabad  seeDh ay. ||2||

lines.english: God Himself unites us in Union with the True Guru,
lines.transliteration: satgur maylay parabh  aap milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਰੀਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mayray parabh saachay kai man bh aa-ay. when we become pleasing to the Mind of my True God.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the poise of celestial peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi sahj subh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: bin gur saachay bharam bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs constantly eat poison.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay sad aa bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.english: They are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his rod, and they suffer in constant pain. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jam dand saheh sadaa d ukh paa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not catch sight of those who enter the Sanctuary of theLord.
lines.transliteration: jamoo-aa na johai har kee sarnaa-ee.

lines.english: Subduing egotism, they lovingly center their consciousness on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar sach liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.english: They keep their consciousness constantly focused on the Lord's Name. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sadaa rahai har naam liv laa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੂਆ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are pure and immaculate.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say jan nirmal pavit aa.

lines.english: Merging their minds into the Mind, they conquer the entire world.
lines.transliteration: man si-o man milaa-ay sabh jag jeet aa.

lines.english: In this way, you too shall find happiness, O my friend. ||6||
lines.transliteration: in biDh kusal t ayrai mayray meet aa. ||6||

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with fruitful rewards.
lines.transliteration: satguroo sayvay so fal paa-ay.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in their hearts; selfishness and conceit depart from within them.
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates for them. ||7||
lines.transliteration: anhad ban ee sabad  vajaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Who - who has not been purified by the True Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny?
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay kavan kavan na seeDh o mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The devotees are purified, and honored in His Court.
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee seeDh ay dar sobh aa paa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, greatness is in the Lord's Name. ||8||5|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (231-17) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam vadi-aa-ee. ||8||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਕਵਨੁਕਵਨੁ ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who speak of the three qualities - their doubts do not depart.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  vakh aanai bharam na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Their bonds are not broken, and they do not obtain liberation.
lines.transliteration: banDhan na t ooteh mukat  na paa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru is the Bestower of liberation in this age. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukat d aataa sat gur jug maahi. ||1||

lines.english: Those mortals who become Gurmukh give up their doubts.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paraan ee bh aram gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The celestial music wells up, when they lovingly attune their consciousness to the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sahj Dhun upjai har liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਨ ਤੂਟਿਹ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are controlled by the three qualities have death hovering over their heads. pMnw 232
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  kaalai kee sir kaaraa.

lines.english: They do not remember the Name of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam na cheeteh upaavan haaraa.

lines.english: They die, and are reborn, over and over, again and again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mar jameh fir vaaro vaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Those whose guru is spiritually blind - their doubts are not dispelled.
lines.transliteration: anDhay guroo t ay bh aram na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Abandoning the Source of all, they have become attached to the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: mool chhod laagay d oojai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Infected with poison, they are immersed in poison. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa maat aa bikh  maahi samaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Believing Maya to be the source of all, they wander in doubt.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kar mool jantar bh armaa-ay.

lines.english: They have forgotten the Dear Lord, and they are in love with duality.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o visri-aa doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: The supreme status is obtained only by those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jis nadar karay so param gat  paa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.english: One who has Truth pervading within, radiates Truth outwardly as well.
lines.transliteration: antar saach baahar saach vart aa-ay.

lines.english: The Truth does not remain hidden, even though one may try to hide it.
lines.transliteration: saach na chhapai jay ko rakh ai chh apaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਛਪਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The spiritually wise know this intuitively. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee boojheh sahj subh aa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs keep their consciousness lovingly centered on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saach rahi-aa liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Ego and Maya are burned away by the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa sabad jalaa-ay.

lines.english: My True God unites them in His Union. ||6||
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa mayl milaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: The True Guru, The Giver, preaches the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa sabad  sunaa-ay.

lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ai thaak rahaa-ay. He controls, and restrains, and holds still the wandering mind.
Understanding is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||7||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay sojh ee paa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: The Creator Himself has created the universe; He Himself shall destroy it.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa sarisat siraj jin go-ee.

lines.english: Without Him, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this! ||8||6|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (232-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh boojh ai ko-ee. ||8||6||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam, the Priceless Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam amolak gurmukh paavai.

lines.english: They serve the Name, and through the Name, they are absorbed in intuitive peaceand poise.
lines.transliteration: naamo sayvay naam sahj samaavai.

lines.english: With their tongues, they continually sing the Ambrosial Naam.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rasnaa nit  gaavai.

lines.english: They obtain the Lord's Name; the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay so har ras paavai. ||1||

lines.english: Night and day, within your heart, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: an-din hird ai japa-o jagd eesaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain the supreme state of peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paava-o param pad  sookh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Peace comes to fill the hearts of those
lines.transliteration: hirdai sookh  bha-i-aa pargaas.
gurmukh gaavahi sach gunt aas. who, as Gurmukh, sing of the True Lord, the treasure of excellence.

lines.english: They become the constant slaves of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aas nit  hoveh d aas.

lines.english: Within their households and families, they remain always detached. ||2||
lines.transliteration: garih kutamb meh sadaa ud aas. ||2||

lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, become Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat gurmukh  ko ho-ee.

lines.english: They alone obtain the supreme treasure.
lines.transliteration: param padaarath paavai so-ee.

lines.english: Eradicating the three qualities, they become pure.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maytay nirmal ho-ee.

lines.english: They are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sehjay saach milai parabh so-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Emotional attachment to family does not exist,
lines.transliteration: moh kutamb si-o pareet na ho-ay.
jaa hirdai vasi-aa sach so-ay. when the True Lord abides within the heart.

lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh is pierced through and held steady.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man bayDh i-aa asthir ho-ay.

lines.english: One who recognizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command understands the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan ai boojh ai sach so-ay. ||4||

lines.english: You are the Creator Lord - there is no other for me.
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa mai avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: I serve You, and through You, I obtain honor.
lines.transliteration: tujh sayvee t ujh tay pat  ho-ay.

lines.english: God showers His Mercy, and I sing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahi gaavaa parabh so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The light of the jewel of the Naam permeates the entire world. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naam ratan sabh  jag meh lo-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: To the Gurmukhs, the Word of God's Bani seems so sweet.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ban ee meeth ee laagee.

lines.english: Deep within, their hearts blossom forth; night and day, they lovingly center themselves on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: antar bigsai an-d in liv laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The True Lord is intuitively obtained, by His Grace.
lines.transliteration: sehjay sach mili-aa parsaadee.

lines.english: The True Guru is obtained by the destiny of perfect good fortune. ||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur paa-i-aa poorai vadbh aagee. ||6||

lines.english: Egotism, possessiveness, evil-mindedness and suffering depart,
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa d urmat  dukh naas.
jab hirdai raam naam gunt aas. when the Lord's Name, the Ocean of Virtue, comes to dwell within the heart.

lines.english: The intellect of the Gurmukhs is awakened, and they praise God,
lines.transliteration: gurmukh buDh  pargatee parabh  jaas.
jab hirdai ravi-aa charan  nivaas. ||7|| when the Lord's Lotus Feet come to dwell within the heart. ||7||

lines.english: They alone receive the Naam, unto whom it is given.
lines.transliteration: jis naam day-ay so-ee jan paa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs shed their ego, and merge with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh maylay aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Name abides within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: hirdai saachaa naam vasaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||7|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (232-19) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay saach samaa-ay. ||8||7||

lines.english: The mind has intuitively healed itself, through the Fear of God. pMnw 233
lines.transliteration: man hee man savaari-aa bhai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The mind is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; it is lovingly attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad man rangi-aa liv laa-ay.

lines.english: It abides within its own home, in harmony with the Lord's Will. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vasi-aa parabh  kee rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, egotistical pride departs,
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai jaa-ay abh imaan.
govid paa-ee-ai gun ee niDh aan. ||1|| rahaa-o. and the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The mind becomes detached and free of desire, when it experiences the Fear of God, through the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man bairaagee jaa sabad bh a-o kh aa-ay.

lines.english: My Immaculate God is pervading and contained among all.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh nirmalaa sabh  tai rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਜਾ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭਉ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one is united in His Union. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay milai milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਸਭ ਤੈ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The slave of the Lord's slave attains peace.
lines.transliteration: har daasan ko d aas sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: My Lord God is found in this way.
lines.transliteration: mayraa har parabh in biDh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Lord, one comes to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa tay raam gun  gaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Dharig baho jeevan  jit har naam na lagai pi-aar. Cursed is that long life, during which love for the Lord's Name is not enshrined.
Dharig sayj sukh aalee kaaman  moh gubaar. Cursed is that comfortable bed which lures one into the darkness of attachment to sexual desire.

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the birth of that person who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tin safal janam jin naam aDh aar. ||4||

lines.english: Dharig Dh arig garihu kutamb jit  har pareet  na ho-ay. Cursed, cursed is that home and family, in which the love of the Lord is not embraced.
He alone is my friend, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so-ee hamaaraa meet jo har gun  gaavai so-ay.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no other for me. ||5||
lines.transliteration: har naam binaa mai avar na ko-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: From the True Guru, I have obtained salvation and honor.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay ham gat  pat paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: I have meditated on the Name of the Lord, and all my sufferings have been erased.
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aa-i-aa d ookh sagal mitaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਹਮ ਗਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am in constant bliss, lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand har naam liv laa-ee. ||6||

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, I came to understand my body.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai ham ka-o sareer suDh bh a-ee.

lines.english: The fires of ego and desire have been totally quenched.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai tarisnaa sabh  agan bujh -ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਰੀਰ  ਸੁਿਧ ਭਈ ॥
lines.english: Anger has been dispelled, and I have grasped hold of tolerance. ||7||
lines.transliteration: binsay kroDh kh imaa geh la-ee. ||7||

lines.english: The Lord Himself showers His Mercy, and bestows the Naam.
lines.transliteration: har aapay kirpaa karay naam dayvai.

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh, who receives the jewel of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rat an ko virlaa layvai.

lines.english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Unknowable, the Incomprehensible. ||8||8|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (233-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu gauVI bYrwgix mhlw 3 ] (233-11) raag ga-orhee bairaagan  mehlaa 3. Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gun gaavai har alakh  abhayvai. ||8||8||

lines.english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, are seen to be unfaithful and evil.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay jo muh fayray t ay vaimukh  buray d isann.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵੈ  ॥੮॥੮॥
lines.english: They shall be bound and beaten night and day; they shall not have this opportunity again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din baDh ay maaree-an fir vaylaa naa lahann. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, please shower Your Mercy upon me, and save me!
lines.transliteration: har har raakho kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.english: O Lord God, please lead me to meet the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, that Imay dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  maylaa-ay parabh  har hird ai har gun  saar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖ  ਬੁਰੇ ਿਦਸੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those devotees are pleasing to the Lord, who as Gurmukh, walk in harmony with theWay of the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  har bh aavday jo gurmukh  bhaa-ay chalann.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਨ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਵੇਲਾ  ਨਾ ਲਹੰਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Subduing their selfishness and conceit, and performing selfless service, they remaindead while yet alive. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap chhod sayvaa karan jeevat  mu-ay rahann. ||2||

lines.english: The body and the breath of life belong to the One - perform the greatest service toHim.
lines.transliteration: jis daa pind paraan  hai tis kee sir kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਲਾਇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Why forget Him from your mind? Keep the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oh ki-o manhu visaaree-ai har rakhee-ai hird ai Dhaar. ||3||

lines.english: Receiving the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains honor; believing in the Naam,one is at peace.
lines.transliteration: naam mili-ai pat paa-ee-ai naam mani-ai sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵਦੇ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਾਇ  ਚਲੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is obtained from the True Guru; by His Grace, God is found. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay naam paa-ee-ai karam milai parabh  so-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਨ  ਜੀਵਤ  ਮੁਏ ਰਹੰਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They turn their faces away from the True Guru; they continue to wander aimlessly.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay jo muhu fayray o-ay bh aramd ay naa tikann.

lines.english: Dharat  asmaan na jh al-ee vich vistaa pa-ay pachann. ||5|| They are not accepted by the earth or the sky; they fall into manure, and rot. ||5||
This world is deluded by doubt - it has taken the drug of emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: ih jag bharam bh ulaa-i-aa moh th ag-ulee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Maya does not draw near those who have met with the True Guru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur bh ayti-aa t in nayrh  na bh itai maa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are very beautiful; they cast off the filth of selfishness and conceit. pMnw 234
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan so sohn ay ha-umai mail gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are immaculate and pure. They walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay say nirmalay chaleh sat gur bh aa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Lord God, You are the One and Only Giver; You forgive us, and unite us withYourself.
lines.transliteration: har parabh d aataa ayk t ooN tooN aapay bakh as milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; if it is Your Will, please save him! ||8||1||9|| rwgu gauVI pUrbI mhlw 4 krhly  (234-3) raag ga-orhee poorbee mehlaa 4 karhalay Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl, Karhalay: <> siqgur pRswid ] (234-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sarnaagat ee ji-o bh aavai t ivai chh adaa-ay. ||8||1||9||

lines.english: O my wandering mind, you are like a camel - how will you meet the Lord, your Mother?
lines.transliteration: karhalay man pardaysee-aa ki-o milee-ai har maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਪੂਰਬੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਕਰਹਲੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When I found the Guru, by the destiny of perfect good fortune, my Beloved came andembraced me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur bhaag poorai paa-i-aa gal mili-aa pi-aaraa aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O camel-like mind, meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa satgur purakh  Dhi-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਿਗ  ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗਿਲ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਿਪਆਰਾ ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, contemplate the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa veechaaree-aa har raam naam Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: When you are called to answer for your account, the Lord Himself shall release you.||2||
lines.transliteration: jithai laykhaa mangee-ai har aapay la-ay chh adaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: O camel-like mind, you were once very pure; the filth of egotism has now attacheditself to you.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa at nirmalaa mal laagee ha-umai aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your Beloved Husband is now manifest before you in your own home, but you are separated from Him, and you suffer such pain! ||3||
lines.transliteration: partakh  pir gh ar naal pi-aaraa vichh urh chotaa kh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my beloved camel-like mind, search for the Lord within your own heart.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa mayray pareetamaa har rid ai bhaal bh aalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He cannot be found by any device; the Guru will show you the Lord within your heart.||4||
lines.transliteration: upaa-ay kitai na labh -ee gur hird ai har d aykhaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: O my beloved camel-like mind, day and night, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa mayray pareetamaa d in rain  har liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਰਦੈ ਭਾਿਲ  ਭਾਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Return to your own home, and find the palace of love; meet the Guru, and meet theLord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ghar jaa-ay paavahi rang mahlee gur maylay har maylaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਦੇਖਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, you are my friend; abandon hypocrisy and greed.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa tooN meet  mayraa pakh and lobh  tajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮਾ ਿਦਨ ੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The hypocritical and the greedy are struck down; the Messenger of Death punishesthem with his club. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pakhand lobh ee maaree-ai jam dand d ay-ay sajaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, you are my breath of life; rid yourself of the pollution of hypocrisyand doubt.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa mayray paraan tooN mail pakh and bh aram gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru is the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord's Nectar; join the Holy Congregation, and wash away this pollution. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har amrit sar gur poori-aa mil sangt ee mal leh jaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ  ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, listen only to the Teachings of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa mayray pi-aari-aa ik gur kee sikh sun aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This emotional attachment to Maya is so pervasive. Ultimately, nothing shall go alongwith anyone. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ih moh maa-i-aa pasri-aa ant saath na ko-ee jaa-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਸਰ ੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਿਰਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਤੀ  ਮਲੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, my good friend, take the supplies of the Lord's Name, and obtainhonor.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa mayray saajnaa har kharach lee-aa pat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਿਸਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, you shall be robed with honor, and the Lord Himself shallembrace you. ||9||
lines.transliteration: har dargeh painaa-i-aa har aap la-i-aa gal laa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਪਸਿਰਆ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, one who surrenders to the Guru becomes Gurmukh, and works forthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa gur mani-aa gurmukh kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਖਰਚੁ  ਲੀਆ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Offer your prayers to the Guru; O servant Nanak, He shall unite you with the Lord.||10||1|| gauVI mhlw 4 ] (234-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 4. Gauree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur aagai kar jod-rh ee jan naanak har maylaa-ay. ||10||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਲਇਆ  ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: O contemplative camel-like mind, contemplate and look carefully.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa veechaaree-aa veechaar daykh  samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The forest-dwellers have grown weary of wandering in the forests; following the Guru's Teachings, see your Husband Lord within your heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ban fir thakay ban vaasee-aa pir gurmat rid ai nihaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਕਿਰ ਜੋਦੜੀ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਇ  ॥੧੦॥੧॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, dwell upon the Guru and the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa gur govind samaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O camel-like contemplative mind, the self-willed manmukhs are caught in the greatnet.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa veechaaree-aa manmukh faathi-aa mahaa jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal who becomes Gurmukh is liberated, dwelling upon the Name of the Lord,Har, Har. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paraan ee mukat  hai har har naam samaal. ||2||

lines.english: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, seek the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, andthe True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa mayray pi-aari-aa satsangat  satgur bh aal.

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, meditate on the Lord, and the Lord, Har, Har, shall go alongwith you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  lag har Dh i-aa-ee-ai har har chalai t ayrai naal. ||3||

lines.english: O very fortunate camel-like mind, with one Glance of Grace from the Lord, you shall be enraptured. pMnw 235
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa vadbhaagee-aa har ayk nad ar nihaal.

lines.english: If the Lord Himself saves you, then you shall be saved. Dwell upon the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aap chhadaa-ay chh utee-ai sat gur charan  samaal. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਛਡਾਏ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, dwell upon the Divine Light within the body.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa mayray pi-aari-aa vich dayhee jot  samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has shown me the nine treasures of the Naam. The Merciful Lord hasbestowed this gift. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur na-o niDh naam vikh aali-aa har d aat karee d a-i-aal. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਖਾਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਿਲ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, you are so fickle; give up your cleverness and corruption.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa tooN chanchlaa chat uraa-ee chh ad vikraal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ  ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਛਿਡ ਿਵਕਰਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; at the very last moment, the Lord shallliberate you. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har har naam samaal tooN har mukat  karay ant  kaal. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂੰ ਹਿਰ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਿਲ ॥੬॥
lines.english: O camel-like mind, you are so very fortunate; dwell upon the jewel of spiritualwisdom.
lines.transliteration: man karhalaa vadbhaagee-aa t ooN gi-aan rat an samaal.

lines.english: You hold in your hands the sword of the Guru's spiritual wisdom; with this destroyerof death, kill the Messenger of Death. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan kharh ag hath Dh aari-aa jam maari-arh aa jamkaal. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ  ਹਿਥ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ਜਮੁ ਮਾਿਰਅੜਾ  ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The treasure is deep within, O camel-like mind, but you wander around outside indoubt, searching for it.
lines.transliteration: antar niDh aan man karhalay bh aram bh aveh baahar bh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਵਿਹ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Perfect Guru, the Primal Being, you shall discover that the Lord, your Best Friend, is with you. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur purakh pooraa bh ayti-aa har sajan  laDh-rhaa naal. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਲਧੜਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: You are engrossed in pleasures, O camel-like mind; dwell upon the Lord's lasting loveinstead!
lines.transliteration: rang rat-rh ay man karhalay har rang sad aa samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੜੇ  ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; serve the Guru, and dwell upon theWord of the Shabad. ||9||
lines.transliteration: har rang kaday na ut rai gur sayvaa sabad  samaal. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: We are birds, O camel-like mind; the Lord, the Immortal Primal Being, is the tree.
lines.transliteration: ham pankhee man karhalay har t arvar purakh  akaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are very fortunate - they find it. O servant Nanak, dwell upon theNaam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||2|| rwgu gauVI guAwryrI mhlw 5 AstpdIAw  (235-9) raag ga-orhee gu-aarayree mehlaa 5 asatpad ee-aa Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu gur pRswid ] (235-9) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  gur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru'sGrace:
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gurmukh  paa-i-aa jan naanak naam samaal. ||10||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੧੦॥੨॥
lines.english: When this mind is filled with pride,
lines.transliteration: jab ih man meh karat gumaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਨਾਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tab ih baavar firat  bigaanaa. then it wanders around like a madman and a lunatic.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਰਤ  ਗੁਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: But when it becomes the dust of all,
lines.transliteration: jab ih hoo-aa sagal kee reenaa.
taa tay rama-ee-aa gh at ghat cheenaa. ||1|| then it recognizes the Lord in each and every heart. ||1||

lines.english: The fruit of humility is intuitive peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: sahj suhaylaa fal maskeenee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਚੀਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur apunai mohi d aan d eenee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When he believes others to be bad,
lines.transliteration: jab kis ka-o ih jaanas mandaa.
tab saglay is mayleh fand aa. then everyone lays traps for him.

lines.english: But when he stops thinking in terms of 'mine' and 'yours',
lines.transliteration: mayr tayr jab ineh chukaa-ee.
taa tay is sang nahee bairaa-ee. ||2|| then no one is angry with him. ||2||

lines.english: When he clings to 'my own, my own',
lines.transliteration: jab in apunee apnee Dhaaree.
tab is ka-o hai muskal bh aaree. then he is in deep trouble.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: But when he recognizes the Creator Lord,
lines.transliteration: jab in karnaihaar pachh aataa.
tab is no naahee kichh  taataa. ||3|| then he is free of torment. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: When he entangles himself in emotional attachment,
lines.transliteration: jab in apuno baaDhi-o mohaa.
aavai jaa-ay sadaa jam johaa. he comes and goes in reincarnation, under the constant gaze of Death.

lines.english: But when all his doubts are removed,
lines.transliteration: jab is tay sabh  binsay bh armaa.
bhayd  naahee hai paarbrahmaa. ||4|| then there is no difference between him and the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

lines.english: When he perceives differences,
lines.transliteration: jab in kichh kar maanay bh aydaa.
tab tay dookh dand ar kh aydaa. then he suffers pain, punishment and sorrow.

lines.english: But when he recognizes the One and Only Lord,
lines.transliteration: jab in ayko aykee boojhi-aa.
tab tay is no sabh  kichh  soojh i-aa. ||5|| he understands everything. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
lines.english: When he runs around for the sake of Maya and riches,
lines.transliteration: jab ih Dhaavai maa-i-aa arthee.
nah taript aavai nah t is laathee. he is not satisfied, and his desires are not quenched.

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਿਝਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: But when he runs away from Maya,
lines.transliteration: jab is tay ih ho-i-o ja-ulaa.
peechhai laag chalee uth  ka-ulaa. ||6|| then the Goddess of Wealth gets up and follows him. ||6||

lines.english: When, by His Grace, the True Guru is met,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa ja-o satgur mili-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ  ਜਉਲਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: man mandar meh d eepak jali-o. the lamp is lit within the temple of the mind.

lines.english: When he realizes what victory and defeat really are,
lines.transliteration: jeet haar kee sojh ee karee.
ta-o is gh ar kee keemat  paree. ||7|| then he comes to appreciate the true value of his own home. ||7|| pMnw 236

lines.english: The One Lord is the Creator of all things, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan sabh kichh  aykai.

lines.english: He Himself is wisdom, contemplation and discerning understanding.
lines.transliteration: aapay buDh beechaar bibaykai.

lines.english: He is not far away; He is near at hand, with all.
lines.transliteration: door na nayrai sabh  kai sangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: So praise the True One, O Nanak, with love! ||8||1|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (236-2) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahan naanak har rangaa. ||8||1||

lines.english: Serving the Guru, one is committed to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay naamay laagaa.

lines.english: It is received only by those who have such good destiny inscribed upon their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: tis ka-o mili-aa jis mast ak bh aagaa.

lines.english: The Lord dwells within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: tis kai hird ai ravi-aa so-ay.

lines.english: Their minds and bodies become peaceful and stable. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al nihchal ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, sing such Praises of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: aisaa keertan kar man mayray.
eehaa oohaa jo kaam tayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o. which shall be of use to you here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Meditating on Him, fear and misfortune depart,
lines.transliteration: jaas japat bh a-o apd aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Dhaavat  manoo-aa aavai th aa-ay. and the wandering mind is held steady.
Meditating on Him, suffering shall never again overtake you.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat fir d ookh na laagai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, this ego runs away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat ih ha-umai bh aagai. ||2||

lines.english: Meditating on Him, the five passions are overcome.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat vas aavahi panchaa.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, Ambrosial Nectar is collected in the heart.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat rid ai amrit  sanchaa.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, this desire is quenched.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat ih t arisnaa bujh ai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat har d argeh sijh ai. ||3||

lines.english: Meditating on Him, millions of mistakes are erased.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat kot miteh apraaDh .

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one becomes Holy, blessed by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat har hoveh saaDh .

lines.english: Meditating on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat man seet al hovai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, all filth is washed away. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat mal saglee kh ovai. ||4||

lines.english: Meditating on Him, the jewel of the Lord is obtained.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat rat an har milai.

lines.english: One is reconciled with the Lord, and shall not abandon Him again.
lines.transliteration: bahur na chhodai har sang hilai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, many acquire a home in the heavens.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat ka-ee baikunth  vaas.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one abides in intuitive peace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat sukh  sahj nivaas. ||5||

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one is not affected by this fire.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat ih agan na pohat .

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one is not under the gaze of Death.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat ih kaal na johat .

lines.english: Meditating on Him, your forehead shall be immaculate.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat t ayraa nirmal maathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ  ਇਹ ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਪੋਹਤ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him, all pains are destroyed. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat saglaa d ukh laathaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ  ਇਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਜੋਹਤ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him, no difficulties are encountered.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat muskal kachh oo na banai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one hears the unstruck melody.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat sun  anhat  Dhunai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one acquires this pure reputation.
lines.transliteration: jaas japat ih nirmal so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ  ਮੁਸਕਲੁ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਨੈ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him, the heart-lotus is turned upright. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat kamal seeDh aa ho-ay. ||7||

lines.english: The Guru has bestowed His Glance of Grace upon all,
lines.transliteration: gur subh d arisat sabh  oopar karee.
jis kai hirdai mant ar day haree. within whose hearts the Lord has implanted His Mantra.

lines.english: The unbroken Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is their food and nourishment.
lines.transliteration: akhand keert an tin bhojan chooraa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, they have the Perfect True Guru. ||8||2|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (236-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis satgur pooraa. ||8||2||

lines.english: Those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad within their hearts
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad rid  antar Dh aarai.
panch janaa si-o sang nivaarai. cut their connections with the five passions.

lines.english: They keep the ten organs under their control;
lines.transliteration: das ind ree kar raakh ai vaas.
taa kai aat mai ho-ay pargaas. ||1|| their souls are enlightened. ||1||

lines.english: They alone acquire such stability,
lines.transliteration: aisee darirh -taa taa kai ho-ay.
jaa ka-o da-i-aa ma-i-aa parabh  so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. whom God blesses with His Mercy and Grace. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Friend and foe are one and the same to them.
lines.transliteration: saajan dusat jaa kai ayk samaanai.

lines.english: Whatever they speak is wisdom.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa bolan  taytaa gi-aanai.

lines.english: Whatever they hear is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa sunn aa taytaa naam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever they see is meditation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaytaa paykh an taytaa Dh i-aan. ||2||

lines.english: They awaken in peace and poise; they sleep in peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: sehjay jaagan sehjay so-ay.

lines.english: That which is meant to be, automatically happens.
lines.transliteration: sehjay hotaa jaa-ay so ho-ay.

lines.english: In peace and poise, they remain detached; in peace and poise, they laugh.
lines.transliteration: sahj bairaag sehjay hee hasnaa.

lines.english: In peace and poise, they remain silent; in peace and poise, they chant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sehjay choop sehjay hee japnaa. ||3||

lines.english: In peace and poise they eat; in peace and poise they love.
lines.transliteration: sehjay bhojan sehjay bh aa-o.

lines.english: The illusion of duality is easily and totally removed.
lines.transliteration: sehjay miti-o sagal duraa-o.

lines.english: They naturally join the Saadh Sangat, the Society of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: sehjay ho-aa saaDhoo sang.

lines.english: In peace and poise, they meet and merge with the Supreme Lord God. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sahj mili-o paarbarahm nisang. ||4||

lines.english: They are at peace in their homes, and they are at peace while detached. pMnw 237
lines.transliteration: sehjay garih meh sahj udaasee.

lines.english: In peace, their bodies' duality is eliminated.
lines.transliteration: sehjay dubiDh aa tan kee naasee.

lines.english: Bliss comes naturally to their minds.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sahj man bha-i-aa anand.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਮਿਨ ਭਇਆ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: They meet the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||5||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o bh ayti-aa parmaanand . ||5||

lines.english: In peaceful poise, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sehjay amrit pee-o naam.

lines.english: In peace and poise, they give to the poor.
lines.transliteration: sehjay keeno jee-a ko daan.

lines.english: Their souls naturally delight in the Lord's Sermon.
lines.transliteration: sahj kathaa meh aatam rasi-aa.

lines.english: The Imperishable Lord abides with them. ||6||
lines.transliteration: taa kai sang abh inaasee vasi-aa. ||6||

lines.english: In peace and poise, they assume the unchanging position.
lines.transliteration: sehjay aasan asthir bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In peace and poise, the unstruck vibration of the Shabad resounds.
lines.transliteration: sehjay anhat sabad  vajaa-i-aa.

lines.english: In peace and poise, the celestial bells resound.
lines.transliteration: sehjay run jh unkaar suhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਰੁਣਝ ੁ ਣ ਕ ਾ ਰ ੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Within their homes, the Supreme Lord God is pervading. ||7||
lines.transliteration: taa kai gh ar paarbarahm samaa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: With intuitive ease, they meet the Lord, according to their karma.
lines.transliteration: sehjay jaa ka-o pari-o karmaa.

lines.english: With intuitive ease, they meet with the Guru, in the true Dharma.
lines.transliteration: sehjay gur bhayti-o sach Dh armaa.

lines.english: Those who know, attain the poise of intuitive peace.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sahj bha-i-aa so jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||8||3|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (237-6) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t aa kai kurbaan ai. ||8||3||

lines.english: First, they come forth from the womb.
lines.transliteration: parathmay garabh vaas t ay tari-aa.

lines.english: They become attached to their children, spouses and families.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar kutamb sang juri-aa.

lines.english: The foods of various sorts and appearances will surely pass away, O wretched mortal! ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhojan anik parkaar baho kapray. sarpar gavan karhigay bapuray. ||1||

lines.english: What is that place which never perishes?
lines.transliteration: kavan asthaan jo kabahu na tarai.

lines.english: What is that Word by which the dirt of the mind is removed? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kavan sabad jit  durmat  harai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Realm of Indra, death is sure and certain.
lines.transliteration: indar puree meh sarpar marn aa.

lines.english: The Realm of Brahma shall not remain permanent.
lines.transliteration: barahm puree nihchal nahee rahnaa.

lines.english: The Realm of Shiva shall also perish.
lines.transliteration: siv puree kaa ho-igaa kaalaa.

lines.english: The three dispositions, Maya and the demons shall vanish. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa binas bit aalaa. ||2||

lines.english: The mountains, the trees, the earth, the sky and the stars;
lines.transliteration: gir tar Dh aran gagan ar t aaray.
rav sas pavan paavak neeraaray. the sun, the moon, the wind, water and fire;
dinas rain  barat  ar bh aydaa. day and night, fasting days and their determination;
saasat simrit  binashigay bayd aa. ||3|| the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas shall pass away. ||3||

lines.english: The sacred shrines of pilgrimage, gods, temples and holy books;
lines.transliteration: tirath d ayv d ayhuraa pothee.
maalaa tilak soch paak hot ee. rosaries, ceremonial tilak marks on the forehead, meditative people, the pure, and the performers of burnt offerings;

lines.english: Dhotee dand-ut  parsaad an bh ogaa. wearing loin cloths, bowing in reverence and the enjoyment of sacred foods

lines.transliteration: gavan karaigo saglo logaa. ||4|| - all these, and all people, shall pass away. ||4||

lines.english: Social classes, races, Muslims and Hindus;
lines.transliteration: jaat varan t urak ar hind oo.
pas pankhee anik jon jind oo. beasts, birds and the many varieties of beings and creatures;
sagal paasaar deesai paasaaraa. the entire world and the visible universe
binas jaa-igo sagal aakaaraa. ||5|| - all forms of existence shall pass away. ||5||

lines.english: Through the Praises of the Lord, devotional worship, spiritual wisdom and the essenceof reality,
lines.transliteration: sahj sifat bh agat tat gi-aanaa.
sadaa anand nihchal sach thaanaa. eternal bliss and the imperishable true place are obtained.

lines.english: There, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's Glorious Praises aresung with love.
lines.transliteration: tahaa sangat  saaDh  gun rasai.

lines.english: There, in the city of fearlessness, He dwells forever. ||6||
lines.transliteration: anbha-o nagar t ahaa sad  vasai. ||6||

lines.english: There is no fear, doubt, suffering or anxiety there;
lines.transliteration: tah bh a-o bh armaa sog na chint aa.
aavan jaavan  mirat  na hot aa. there is no coming or going, and no death there.

lines.english: There is eternal bliss, and the unstruck celestial music there.
lines.transliteration: tah sad aa anand anhat  aakh aaray.

lines.english: The devotees dwell there, with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises as their support. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vaseh keert an aaDh aaray. ||7||

lines.english: There is no end or limitation to the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kaa ant na paar.

lines.english: Who can embrace His contemplation?
lines.transliteration: ka-un karai t aa kaa beechaar.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when the Lord showers His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis kirpaa karai.

lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nihchal thaan saaDhsang t arai. ||8||4|| the imperishable home is obtained; in the Saadh Sangat, you shall be saved. ||8||4|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (237-17) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: One who kills this is a spiritual hero.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so-ee sooraa.

lines.english: One who kills this is perfect.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so-ee pooraa.

lines.english: One who kills this obtains glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray tiseh vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: One who kills this is freed of suffering. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray tis kaa d ukh jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.
lines.transliteration: aisaa ko-ay je dubiDh aa maar gavaavai.

lines.english: Killing it, he attains Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 238
lines.transliteration: iseh maar raaj jog kamaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One who kills this has no fear.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray tis ka-o bh a-o naahi.

lines.english: One who kills this is absorbed in the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so naam samaahi.

lines.english: One who kills this has his desires quenched.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray tis kee t arisnaa bujh ai.

lines.english: One who kills this is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so dargeh sijh ai. ||2||

lines.english: One who kills this is wealthy and prosperous.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so Dhanvant aa.

lines.english: One who kills this is honorable.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so pativant aa.

lines.english: One who kills this is truly a celibate.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so-ee jatee.

lines.english: One who kills this attains salvation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray tis hovai gat ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ  ਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who kills this - his coming is auspicious.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray tis kaa aa-i-aa ganee.

lines.english: One who kills this is steady and wealthy.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so nihchal Dhanee.

lines.english: One who kills this is very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so vadbhaagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਨਿਦਨ ੁ ਜਾਗਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: One who kills this remains awake and aware, night and day. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so an-din jaagaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who kills this is Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so jeevan muktaa.

lines.english: One who kills this lives a pure lifestyle.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray tis kee nirmal jugt aa.

lines.english: One who kills this is spiritually wise.
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so-ee sugi-aanee.

lines.english: One who kills this meditates intuitively. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jo is maaray so sahj Dhi-aanee. ||5||

lines.english: Without killing this, one is not acceptable, even though one may perform millions ofrituals, chants and austerities.
