lines.transliteration: is maaree bin thaa-ay na parai. kot karam jaap tap karai.

lines.english: Without killing this, one does not escape the cycle of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin janam na mitai.

lines.english: Without killing this, one does not escape death. ||6||
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin jam tay nahee chh utai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without killing this, one does not obtain spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin gi-aan na ho-ee.

lines.english: Without killing this, one's impurity is not washed off.
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin jooth na Dh o-ee.

lines.english: Without killing this, everything is filthy.
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin sabh kichh  mailaa.

lines.english: Without killing this, everything is a losing game. ||7||
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin sabh kichh  ja-ulaa. ||7||

lines.english: When the Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, bestows His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bha-ay kirpaal kirpaa niDh .
tis bh a-ee kh alaasee ho-ee sagal siDh . one obtains release, and attains total perfection.

lines.english: One whose duality has been killed by the Guru,
lines.transliteration: gur dubiDh aa jaa kee hai maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak so barahm beechaaree. ||8||5|| says Nanak, contemplates God. ||8||5|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (238-10) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then everyone is his friend.
lines.transliteration: har si-o jurai ta sabh  ko meet .

lines.english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then his consciousness is steady.
lines.transliteration: har si-o jurai ta nihchal cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is not afflicted by worries.
lines.transliteration: har si-o jurai na vi-aapai kaarhhaa.

lines.english: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is emancipated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har si-o jurai ta ho-ay nist aaraa. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray tooN har si-o jor.

lines.english: Nothing else is of any use to you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaaj tuhaarai naahee hor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The great and powerful people of the world
lines.transliteration: vaday vaday jo dunee-aad aar.
kaahoo kaaj naahee gaavaar. are of no use, you fool!

lines.english: The Lord's slave may be born of humble origins,
lines.transliteration: har kaa daas neech kul sun eh.
tis kai sang kh in meh uDh rahi. ||2|| but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ||2||

lines.english: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of cleansing baths.
lines.transliteration: kot majan jaa kai sun naam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on it is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.
lines.transliteration: kot poojaa jaa kai hai Dhi-aan.

lines.english: Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to giving millions in alms.
lines.transliteration: kot punn sun har kee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਮਜਨ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਿਣ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: To know the way, through the Guru, is equal to millions of rewards. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kot falaa gur tay biDh  jaanee. ||3||

lines.english: Within your mind, over and over again, think of Him,
lines.transliteration: man apunay meh fir fir chayt.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਪੁੰਨ ਸੁਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: binas jaahi maa-i-aa kay hayt. and your love of Maya shall depart.

lines.english: The Imperishable Lord is always with you.
lines.transliteration: har abhinaasee t umrai sang.

lines.english: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: man mayray rach raam kai rang. ||4||

lines.english: Working for Him, all hunger departs.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam utrai sabh  bhookh.

lines.english: Working for Him, the Messenger of Death will not be watching you.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam na joheh doot .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam tayraa vad gamar.

lines.english: Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam hoveh tooN amar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਉਤਰੈ  ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
lines.english: His servant does not suffer punishment.
lines.transliteration: jaa kay chaakar ka-o nahee daan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਜੋਹਿਹ  ਦੂਤ ॥
lines.english: His servant suffers no loss.
lines.transliteration: jaa kay chaakar ka-o nahee baan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In His Court, His servant does not have to answer for his account.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai daft ar puchh ai na laykh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: So serve Him with distinction. ||6||
lines.transliteration: taa kee chaakree karahu bisaykh aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ  ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
lines.english: He is not lacking in anything.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai oon naahee kaahoo baat.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ  ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is One, although He appears in so many forms.
lines.transliteration: aykeh aap anaykeh bhaat .

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਿਰ  ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: By His Glance of Grace, you shall be happy forever.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee darisat ho-ay sad aa nihaal.

lines.english: So work for Him, O my mind. ||7||
lines.transliteration: man mayray kar taa kee gh aal. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
lines.english: No one is clever, and no one is foolish.
lines.transliteration: naa ko chatur naahee ko moorh aa.

lines.english: No one is weak, and no one is a hero. pMnw 239
lines.transliteration: naa ko heen naahee ko sooraa.

lines.english: As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.
lines.transliteration: jit ko laa-i-aa t it hee laagaa.

lines.english: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed. ||8||6|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (239-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so sayvak naanak jis bhaagaa. ||8||6||

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.
lines.transliteration: bin simran jaisay sarap aarjaaree.

lines.english: This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ti-o jeeveh saakat  naam bisaaree. ||1||

lines.english: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,
lines.transliteration: ayk nimakh jo simran meh jee-aa.

lines.english: ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot dinas laakh  sadaa thir thee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever.

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.
lines.transliteration: bin simran Dharig karam karaas.

lines.english: Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaag batan bistaa meh vaas. ||2||

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.
lines.transliteration: bin simran bha-ay kookar kaam.

lines.english: The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saakat baysu-aa poot  ninaam. ||3||

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.
lines.transliteration: bin simran jaisay seeny chh ataaraa.

lines.english: The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||
lines.transliteration: boleh koor saakat mukh  kaaraa. ||4||

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.
lines.transliteration: bin simran garDhabh  kee ni-aa-ee.

lines.english: The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saakat thaan bh arisat firaa-ee. ||5||

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.
lines.transliteration: bin simran kookar harkaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saakat lobh ee banDh  na paa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.
lines.transliteration: bin simran hai aatam gh aatee.

lines.english: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||
lines.transliteration: saakat neech t is kul nahee jaat ee. ||7||

lines.english: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: jis bha-i-aa kirpaal t is satsang milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (239-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur jagat t araa-i-aa. ||8||7||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mohi param gat paa-ee.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai mayree paij rakhaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan Dhi-aa-i-o mohi naa-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad mohi mili-aa thaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan sun rasan vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ ਮੋਿਹ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, my speech is like nectar. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay amrit  mayree ban ee. ||2||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, my selfishness and conceit have been removed.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan miti-aa mayraa aap.

lines.english: Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained glorious greatness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kee da-i-aa t ay mayraa vad part aap. ||3||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan miti-aa mayraa bharam.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan paykhi-o sabh  barahm. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਸੁਿਣ ਰਸਨ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, I practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan keeno raaj jog.

lines.english: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sang tari-aa sabh  log. ||5||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mayray kaaraj siDh.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ  ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan paa-i-aa naa-o niDh. ||6||

lines.english: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,
lines.transliteration: jin jin keenee mayray gur kee aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਸਭੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee katee-ai jam kee faasaa. ||7|| has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan jaagi-aa mayraa karam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (239-15) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur bhayti-aa paarbarahm. ||8||8||

lines.english: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o simra-o saas saas.

lines.english: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur mayray paraan sat gur mayree raas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa darsan d aykh daykh jeevaa.

lines.english: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan Dh o-ay Dh o-ay peevaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ ਜਾਿਗਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ  ॥
lines.english: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur kee rayn nit  majan kara-o.

lines.english: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee ha-umai mal hara-o. ||2||

lines.english: I wave the fan over the Guru.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o jh oolaava-o paakh aa.

lines.english: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahaa agan tay haath d ay raakh aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I carry water for the Guru's household;
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai garihi dh ova-o paan ee.
jis gur tay akal gat  jaanee. ||4|| from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਦੇਿਖ ਜੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai garihi peesa-o neet .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5|| pMnw 240
lines.transliteration: jis parsaad vairee sabh  meet . ||5||

lines.english: The Guru who gave me my soul,
lines.transliteration: jin gur mo ka-o deenaa jee-o.
aapunaa daasraa aapay mul lee-o. ||6|| has Himself purchased me, and made me His slave. ||6||

lines.english: He Himself has blessed me with His Love.
lines.transliteration: aapay laa-i-o apnaa pi-aar.

lines.english: Forever and ever, I humbly bow to the Guru. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa tis gur ka-o karee namaskaar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: My troubles, conflicts, fears, doubts and pains have been dispelled;
lines.transliteration: kal kalays bhai bh aram d ukh laathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਭੈ ਭਰ੍ਮ  ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayraa gur samraathaa. ||8||9|| says Nanak, my Guru is All-powerful. ||8||9|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (240-3) ga-orhee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. Please bless me with Your Name.
lines.transliteration: mil mayray gobind apnaa naam d ayh.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cursed, cursed is love and intimacy.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa Dharig Dh arig asnayhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without the Naam, one who dresses and eats well
lines.transliteration: naam binaa jo pahirai khaa-ay.
ji-o kookar joothan meh paa-ay. ||1|| is like a dog, who falls in and eats impure foods. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Naam, all occupations are useless, like decorations on a dead body. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa jaytaa bi-uhaar. ji-o mirt ak mithi-aa seegaar. ||2||

lines.english: One who forgets the Naam and indulges in pleasures,
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar karay ras bhog.
sukh supnai nahee t an meh rog. ||3|| shall find no peace, even in dreams; his body shall become diseased. ||3||

lines.english: One who renounces the Naam and engages in other occupations,
lines.transliteration: naam ti-aag karay an kaaj.
binas jaa-ay jhooth ay sabh  paaj. ||4|| shall see all of his false pretenses fall away. ||4||

lines.english: One whose mind does not embrace love for the Naam
lines.transliteration: naam sang man pareet na laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਨਹੀ ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kot karam karto narak jaavai. ||5|| shall go to hell, even though he may perform millions of ceremonial rituals. ||5||

lines.english: One whose mind does not contemplate the Name of the Lord
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam jin man na aaraaDhaa.
chor kee ni-aa-ee jam pur baaDhaa. ||6|| is bound like a thief, in the City of Death. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Hundreds of thousands of ostentatious shows and great expanses
lines.transliteration: laakh adambar bahut  bisthaaraa.
naam binaa jhooth ay paasaaraa. ||7|| - without the Naam, all these displays are false. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਿਨ ਨ ਆਰਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being repeats the Name of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam so-ee jan lay-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. ||8||10|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (240-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naanak jis day-ay. ||8||10||

lines.english: My mind longs for that Friend, who shall stand by me in the beginning, in the middleand in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  jo ant  nibaahai. so saajan mayraa man chaahai. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's Love goes with us forever.
lines.transliteration: har kee pareet sad aa sang chaalai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect and Merciful Lord cherishes all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal purakh  pooran parat ipaalai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He shall never perish, and He shall never abandon me.
lines.transliteration: binsat naahee chh od na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading and permeating. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jah paykhaa t ah rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He is Beautiful, All-knowing, the most Clever, the Giver of life.
lines.transliteration: sundar sugh arh chatur jee-a d aataa.

lines.english: God is my Brother, Son, Father and Mother. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee poot  pitaa parabh  maat aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਚਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Support of the breath of life; He is my Wealth.
lines.transliteration: jeevan paraan aDhaar mayree raas.

lines.english: Abiding within my heart, He inspires me to enshrine love for Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: pareet laa-ee kar rid ai nivaas. ||4||

lines.english: The Lord of the World has cut away the noose of Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa silak kaatee gopaal.

lines.english: He has made me His own, blessing me with His Glance of Grace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kar apunaa leeno nadar nihaal. ||5||

lines.english: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, all diseases are healed.
lines.transliteration: simar simar kaatay sabh rog.

lines.english: Meditating on His Feet, all comforts are enjoyed. ||6||
lines.transliteration: charan Dh i-aan sarab sukh  bhog. ||6||

lines.english: The Perfect Primal Lord is Ever-fresh and Ever-young.
lines.transliteration: pooran purakh navt an nit  baalaa.

lines.english: The Lord is with me, inwardly and outwardly, as my Protector. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har antar baahar sang rakh vaalaa. ||7||

lines.english: Says Nanak, that devotee who realizes the state of the Lord, Har, Har, is blessed with the treasure of the Naam. ||8||11|| rwgu gauVI mwJ mhlw 5  (240-17) raag ga-orhee maajh  mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (240-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har har pad cheen. sarbas naam bh agat ka-o d een. ||8||11||

lines.english: Countless are those who wander around searching for You, but they do not find Yourlimits.
lines.transliteration: khojat  firay asaNkh ant na paaree-aa.

lines.english: They alone are Your devotees, who are blessed by Your Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: say-ee ho-ay bhagat  jinaa kirpaaree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree-aa har vaaree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Continually hearing of the terrifying path, I am so afraid.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  panth daraa-o bahut  bhaihaaree-aa.

lines.english: I have sought the Protection of the Saints; please, save me! ||2|| pMnw 241
lines.transliteration: mai takee ot sant aah layho ubaaree-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Fascinating and Beauteous Beloved is the Giver of support to all.
lines.transliteration: mohan laal anoop sarab saaDhaaree-aa.

lines.english: I bow low and fall at the Feet of the Guru; if only I could see the Lord! ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur niv niv laaga-o paa-ay dayh d ikhaaree-aa. ||3||

lines.english: I have made many friends, but I am a sacrifice to the One alone.
lines.transliteration: mai kee-ay mitar anayk ikas balihaaree-aa.

lines.english: No one has all virtues; the Lord alone is filled to overflowing with them. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabh gun  kis hee naahi har poor bh andaaree-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਗੁਣ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: His Name is chanted in the four directions; those who chant it are embellished with peace.
lines.transliteration: chahu dis japee-ai naa-o sookh  savaaree-aa.

lines.english: I seek Your Protection; Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||
lines.transliteration: mai aahee orh t uhaar naanak balihaaree-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਆਹੀ  ਓਿੜ ਤੁਹਾਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Guru reached out to me, and gave me His Arm; He lifted me up, out of the pit ofemotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: gur kaadhi-o bh ujaa pasaar moh koopaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਿਢਓ  ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਿਰ  ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have won the incomparable life, and I shall not lose it again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: mai jeeti-o janam apaar bahur na haaree-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਜੀਿਤਓ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I have obtained the treasure of all; His Speech is unspoken and subtle.
lines.transliteration: mai paa-i-o sarab niDhaan akath kathaaree-aa.

lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, I am honored and glorified; I swing my arms in joy. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har dargeh sobh aavant  baah ludaaree-aa. ||7||

lines.english: Servant Nanak has received the invaluable and incomparable jewel.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak laDhaa rat an amol aapaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਧਾ  ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean; I proclaim this loudly to all. ||8||12|| gauVI mhlw 5  (241-7) ga-orhee mehlaa 5 Gauree, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (241-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa bha-ojal t aree-ai kaha-o pukaaree-aa. ||8||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਕਹਉ  ਪੁਕਾਰੀਆ  ॥੮॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Dye yourself in the color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: naaraa-in har rang rango.

lines.english: Chant the Name of the One Lord with your tongue, and ask for Him alone.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jap jihvaa har ayk mango. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Renounce your ego, and dwell upon the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: taj ha-umai gur gi-aan bh ajo.

lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.||1||
lines.transliteration: mil sangat Dh ur karam likh i-o. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever you see, shall not go with you.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so sang na ga-i-o.

lines.english: The foolish, faithless cynics are attached - they waste away and die. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saakat moorh  lagay pach mu-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: The Name of the Fascinating Lord is all-pervading forever.
lines.transliteration: mohan naam sadaa rav rahi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਗਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Among millions, how rare is that Gurmukh who attains the Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay kinai gurmukh  lahi-o. ||3||

lines.english: Greet the Lord's Saints humbly, with deep respect.
lines.transliteration: har santan kar namo namo.

lines.english: You shall obtain the nine treasures, and receive infinite peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh paavahi at ul sukh o. ||4||

lines.english: With your eyes, behold the holy people;
lines.transliteration: nain alova-o saaDh jano.
hirdai gaavhu naam niDh o. ||5|| in your heart, sing the treasure of the Naam. ||5||

lines.english: Abandon sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh t ajo.

lines.english: Thus you shall be rid of both birth and death. ||6||
lines.transliteration: janam maran duhu t ay rahi-o. ||6||

lines.english: Pain and darkness shall depart from your home,
lines.transliteration: dookh  anDh ayraa gh ar tay miti-o.
gur gi-aan darirh aa-i-o d eep bali-o. ||7|| when the Guru implants spiritual wisdom within you, and lights that lamp. ||7||

lines.english: One who serves the Lord crosses over to the other side.
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa so paar pari-o.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh saves the world. ||8||1||13|| mhlw 5 gauVI ] (241-14) mehlaa 5 ga-orhee. Fifth Mehl, Gauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh jagat  tari-o. ||8||1||13||

lines.english: Dwelling upon the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru, the Guru, my doubts have beendispelled.
lines.transliteration: har har gur gur karat bh aram ga-ay.

lines.english: My mind has obtained all comforts. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayrai man sabh sukh  paa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I was burning, on fire, and the Guru poured water on me; He is cooling and soothing,like the sandalwood tree. ||1||
lines.transliteration: balto jalt o ta-uki-aa gur chand an seet laa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled; the Guru has lit the lamp of spiritualwisdom. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayraa mit ga-i-aa gur gi-aan d eepaa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: The ocean of fire is so deep; the Saints have crossed over, in the boat of the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paavak saagar gahro char santan naav t araa-i-o. ||3||

lines.english: I have no good karma; I have no Dharmic faith or purity. But God has taken me bythe arm, and made me His own. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naa ham karam na Dharam such parabh  geh bh ujaa aapaa-i-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ  ਭਰਮ  ਗਏ ॥
lines.english: The Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, the Lover of His Saints - these are theNames of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bha-o kh andan d ukh bhanjno bh agat vachh al har naa-i-o. ||5||

lines.english: He is the Master of the masterless, Merciful to the meek, All-powerful, the Support ofHis Saints. ||6||
lines.transliteration: anaathah naath kirpaal deen sammrith sant  otaa-i-o. ||6||

lines.english: I am worthless - I offer this prayer, O my Lord King: "Please, grant me the BlessedVision of Your Darshan."||7||
lines.transliteration: nirgunee-aaray kee bayntee d ayh d aras har raa-i-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਬਲਤੋ  ਜਲਤੋ  ਤਉਿਕਆ  ਗੁਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Your servant has come toYour Door. ||8||2||14|| pMnw 242 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (242-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran tuhaaree th aakur sayvak d u-aarai aa-i-o. ||8||2||14||

lines.english: He is immersed in the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures; engrossed in them, the blind fool does not understand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rang sang bikhi-aa kay bh ogaa in sang anDh  na jaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਇਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਅੰਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: "I am earning profits, I am getting rich", he says, as his life passes away. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o sancha-o ha-o khaatt aa saglee avaDh  bihaanee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸੰਚਉ  ਹਉ ਖਾਟਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ  ਅਵਧ  ਿਬਹਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: "I am a hero, I am famous and distinguished; no one is equal to me."||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o sooraa parDhaan ha-o ko naahee mujh eh samaanee. ||2||

lines.english: "I am young, cultured, and born of a good family." In his mind, he is proud andarrogant like this. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jobanvant achaar kuleenaa man meh ho-ay gumaanee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੁਝਿਹ  ਸਮਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is trapped by his false intellect, and he does not forget this until he dies. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ji-o uljhaa-i-o baaDh  buDh  kaa mart i-aa nahee bisraanee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤ ਅਚਾਰ  ਕੁਲੀਨਾ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Brothers, friends, relatives and companions who live after him - he entrusts his wealthto them. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee meet  banDh ap sakh ay paachh ay tinhoo ka-o sampaanee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਉਲਝਾਇਓ  ਬਾਧ ਬੁਿਧ ਕਾ ਮਰਿਤਆ  ਨਹੀ ਿਬਸਰਾਨੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: That desire, to which the mind is attached, at the last moment, becomes manifest.||6||
lines.transliteration: jit laago man baasnaa ant  saa-ee paragtaanee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਸਖੇ ਪਾਛੇ ਿਤਨਹੂ ਕਉ ਸੰਪਾਨੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He may perform religious deeds, but his mind is egotistical, and he is bound by thesebonds. ||7|| dieAwl purK ikrpw krhu nwnk dws dswnI ]8]3]15]44] jumlw (242-5, gauVI, mÚ 5) da-i-aal purakh  kirpaa karahu naanak d aas d asaanee. ||8||3||15||44|| jumlaa O Merciful Lord, please bless me Your Mercy, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||8||3||15||44||Total|| <> siqnwmu krqw purKu gurpRswid ] (242-7) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  gurparsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru'sGrace: rwgu gauVI pUrbI CMq mhlw 1 ] (242-7) raag ga-orhee poorbee chh ant mehlaa 1. Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh such karam kar ih banDh an banDh aanee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਲਾਗੋ  ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ  ਅੰਿਤ ਸਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟਾਨੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: For the bride, the night is painful; sleep does not come.
lines.transliteration: munDh rain  duhaylrh ee-aa jee-o need  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਸੁਿਚ ਕਰਮ  ਕਿਰ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ  ਬੰਧਾਨੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The soul-bride has grown weak, in the pain of separation from her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan d ublee-aa jee-o pir kai haavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਕਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ  ॥੮॥੩॥੧੫॥੪੪॥
lines.english: Dhan thee-ee d ubal kant  haavai kayv nain ee daykh-ay. The soul-bride is wasting away, in the pain of separation from her Husband; how canshe see Him with her eyes?
Her decorations, sweet foods, sensuous pleasures and delicacies are all false; they areof no account at all.
lines.transliteration: seegaar mith ras bh og bh ojan sabh  jhooth kitai na laykh -ay.

lines.english: Intoxicated with the wine of youthful pride, she has been ruined, and her breasts nolonger yield milk.
lines.transliteration: mai mat joban garab gaalee d uDhaa than ee na aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਰੈਿਣ ਦੁਹੇਲੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when He causes her to meet Him; without Him, sleep does not come to her. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan milai milaa-ee bin pir need  na aav-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦੁਬਲੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The bride is dishonored without her Beloved Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: munDh nimaanrh ee-aa jee-o bin Dh anee pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਥੀਈ  ਦੁਬਿਲ  ਕੰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਕੇਵ ਨੈਣੀ  ਦੇਖਏ  ॥
lines.english: How can she find peace, without enshrining Him in her heart?
lines.transliteration: ki-o sukh paarh aigee bin ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਿਮਠ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਜਨ  ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਿਕਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without her Husband, her home is not worth living in; go and ask your sisters andcompanions. ibnu nwm pRIiq ipAwru nwhI vsih swic suhylI Aw ] scu min sjn sMqoiK mylw gurmqI shu jwixAw
lines.transliteration: naah bin ghar vaas naahee puchh ahu sakh ee sahaylee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਤ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਗਾਲੀ  ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ  ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, there is no love and affection; but with her True Lord, she abides in peace. Through mental truthfulness and contentment, unionwith the True Friend is attained; through the Guru's Teachings, the Husband Lord isknown.
lines.transliteration: bin naam pareet pi-aar naahee vaseh saach suhaylee-aa. sach man sajan sant okh maylaa gurmatee saho jaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who does not abandon the Naam, is intuitively absorbed inthe Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na chhodai saa Dh an naam sahj samaan ee-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Come, O my sisters and companions - let's enjoy our Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil sakhee sahaylrh eeho ham pir raavayhaa.

lines.english: I will ask the Guru, and write His Word as my love-note.
lines.transliteration: gur puchh likh -ugee jee-o sabad  sanayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਹ ਿਬਨੁ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has shown me the True Word of the Shabad. The self-willed manmukhs will regret and repent.
lines.transliteration: sabad saachaa gur d ikhaa-i-aa manmukh ee pachh utaanee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਿਪਆਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: My wandering mind became steady, when I recognized the True One.
lines.transliteration: nikas jaata-o rahai asthir jaam sach pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਸਜਨ  ਸੰਤੋਿਖ  ਮੇਲਾ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਹੁ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Teachings of Truth are forever new; the love of the Shabad is forever fresh.
lines.transliteration: saach kee mat sad aa na-ut an sabad  nayhu navayla-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Glance of Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained;let's meet Him, O my sisters and companions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree sahj saachaa milhu sakh ee sahayleeho. ||3||

lines.english: My desire has been fulfilled - my Friend has come to my home.
lines.transliteration: mayree ichh punee jee-o ham gh ar saajan aa-i-aa.

lines.english: At the Union of husband and wife, the songs of rejoicing were sung.
lines.transliteration: mil var naaree mangal gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Singing the songs of joyful praise and love to Him, the soul-bride's mind is thrilled anddelighted.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay mangal paraym rahsee munDh  man omaaha-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਕਿਸ  ਜਾਤਉ  ਰਹੈ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਜਾਿਮ  ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: My friends are happy, and my enemies are unhappy; meditating on the True Lord, thetrue profit is obtained.
lines.transliteration: saajan rahansay dusat vi-aapay saach jap sach laaha-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਉਤਨ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਓ  ॥
lines.english: With her palms pressed together, the soul-bride prays, that she may remain immersedin the Love of her Lord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: kar jorh saa Dh an karai bint ee rain  din ras bh innee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Husband Lord and the soul-bride revel together; my desires are fulfilled. ||4||1|| pMnw 243 gauVI CMq mhlw 1 ] (243-1) ga-orhee chh ant mehlaa 1. Gauree, Chhant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pir Dhan karahi ralee-aa ichh  mayree punnee-aa. ||4||1||

lines.english: Hear me, O my Dear Husband God - I am all alone in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: sun naah parabh oo jee-o aykalrh ee ban maahay.

lines.english: How can I find comfort without You, O my Carefree Husband God?
lines.transliteration: ki-o Dheeraigee naah binaa parabh  vayparvaahay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਨਾਹ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਜੀਉ  ਏਕਲੜੀ  ਬਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Dhan naah baajh ahu reh na saakai bikh am rain  ghanayree-aa. The soul-bride cannot live without her Husband; the night is so painful for her.
Sleep does not come. I am in love with my Beloved. Please, listen to my prayer!
lines.transliteration: nah need aavai paraym bh aavai sun  baynant ee mayree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਿਬਖਮ  ਰੈਿਣ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Other than my Beloved, no one cares for me; I cry all alone in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: baajhahu pi-aaray ko-ay na saaray aykalrh ee kurlaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਨੀਦ  ਆਵੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਿਣ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਮੇਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the bride meets Him when He causes her to meet Him; without her Beloved, she suffers in pain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan milai milaa-ee bin pareet am dukh paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਰੇ ਏਕਲੜੀ  ਕੁਰਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: She is separated from her Husband Lord - who can unite her with Him?
lines.transliteration: pir chhodi-arh ee jee-o kavan  milaavai.

lines.english: Tasting His Love, she meets Him, through the Beautiful Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ras paraym milee jee-o sabad suhaavai.

lines.english: Adorned with the Shabad, she obtains her Husband, and her body is illuminated with the lamp of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sabday suhaavai t aa pat  paavai d eepak d ayh ujaarai.

lines.english: Listen, O my friends and companions - she who is at peace dwells upon the True Lordand His True Praises.
lines.transliteration: sun sakh ee sahaylee saach suhaylee saachay kay gun  saarai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਸੁਹਾਵੈ  ਤਾ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੀਪਕ  ਦੇਹ ਉਜਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, she is ravished and enjoyed by her Husband Lord; sheblossoms forth with the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: satgur maylee t aa pir raavee bigsee amrit  banee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Husband Lord enjoys His bride when she is pleasing to His Mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan t aa pir raavay jaa t is kai man bh aanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਲੀ  ਤਾ ਿਪਿਰ  ਰਾਵੀ  ਿਬਗਸੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Fascination with Maya made her homeless; the false are cheated by falsehood.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohnee neegh ree-aa jee-o koorh  muth ee koorh i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਾ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can the noose around her neck be untied, without the Most Beloved Guru?
lines.transliteration: ki-o khoolai gal jayvarh ee-aa jee-o bin gur at  pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਨੀਘਰੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੂਿੜ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂਿੜਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: One who loves the Beloved Lord, and reflects upon the Shabad, belongs to Him.
lines.transliteration: har pareet pi-aaray sabad  veechaaray t is hee kaa so hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਖੂਲੈ ਗਲ ਜੇਵੜੀਆ  ਜੀਉ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: How can giving donations to charities and countless cleansing baths wash off the filthwithin the heart?
lines.transliteration: punn daan anayk naavan  ki-o ant ar mal Dh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, no one attains salvation. Stubborn self-discipline and living in the wilderness are of no use at all.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa gat ko-ay na paavai hath  nigrahi baybaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਨਾਵਣ ਿਕਉ  ਅੰਤਰ  ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the home of Truth is attained through the Shabad. How can the Mansion ofHis Presence be known through duality? ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak sach ghar sabad  sinjaapai d ubiDh aa mahal ke jaan ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਗਿਤ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਿਠ ਿਨਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਬੇਬਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: True is Your Name, O Dear Lord; True is contemplation of Your Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tayraa naam sachaa jee-o sabad  sachaa veechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ ਿਸਞਾਪੈ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਕ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: True is the Mansion of Your Presence, O Dear Lord, and True is trade in Your Name.
lines.transliteration: tayraa mahal sachaa jee-o naam sachaa vaapaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Trade in Your Name is very sweet; the devotees earn this profit night and day.
lines.transliteration: naam kaa vaapaar meethaa bh agat laahaa and ino.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Other than this, I can think of no other merchandise. So chant the Naam each andevery moment.
lines.transliteration: tis baajh  vakh ar ko-ay na soojh ai naam layvhu kh in khino.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: The account is read; by the Grace of the True Lord and good karma, the Perfect Lordis obtained.
lines.transliteration: parakh laykh aa nad ar saachee karam poorai paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਵਖਰ ੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਵਹੁਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੋ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Nectar of the Name is so sweet. Through the Perfect True Guru, it isobtained. ||4||2|| rwgu gauVI pUrbI CMq mhlw 3  (243-14) raag ga-orhee poorbee chh ant mehlaa 3 Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, Third Mehl: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu gurpRswid ] (243-14) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  gurparsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meethaa gur poorai sach paa-i-aa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਿਖ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride offers her prayers to her Dear Lord; she dwells upon His GloriousVirtues.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan bin-o karay jee-o har kay gun  saaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: khin pal reh na sakai jee-o bin har pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਪੂਰਬੀ  ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਨਾਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord; without the Guru, the Mansion of HisPresence is not found.
lines.transliteration: bin har pi-aaray reh na saakai gur bin mahal na paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Guru says, she should surely do, to extinguish the fire of desire.
lines.transliteration: jo gur kahai so-ee par keejai tisnaa agan bujh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜੀਉ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is True; there is no one except Him. Without serving Him, peace is not found.
lines.transliteration: har saachaa so-ee tis bin avar na ko-ee bin sayvi-ai sukh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride, whom the Lord Himself unites, is united with Him; HeHimself merges with her. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan milai milaa-ee jis no aap milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan rain  suhaylrh ee-ay jee-o har si-o chit  laa-ay. The life-night of the soul-bride is blessed and joyful, when she focuses herconsciousness on her Dear Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: She serves the True Guru with love; she eradicates selfishness from within.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay bh aa-o karay jee-o vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Eradicating selfishness and conceit from within , and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, she is in love with the Lord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap gavaa-ay har gun gaa-ay an-d in laagaa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਰੈਿਣ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀਏ  ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, dear friends and companions of the soul - immerse yourselves in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. pMnw 244
lines.transliteration: sun sakh ee sahaylee jee-a kee maylee gur kai sabad  samaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਓ  ॥
lines.english: Dwell upon the Lord's Glories, and you shall be loved by your Husband, embracing love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har gun saaree t aa kant  pi-aaree naamay Dh aree pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ  ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰੀ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name around her neckis loved by her Husband Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman naah pi-aaree raam naam gal haaro. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਨਾਹ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਿਲ  ਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhan aykalrh ee jee-o bin naah pi-aaray. The soul-bride who is without her beloved Husband is all alone.
She is cheated by the love of duality, without the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay muth ee jee-o bin gur sabad  karaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਮੁਠੀ ਜੀਉ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਕਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad of her Beloved, how can she cross over the treacherous ocean?Attachment to Maya has led her astray.
lines.transliteration: bin sabad pi-aaray ka-un  dutar taaray maa-i-aa mohi kh u-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਖੁਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Ruined by falsehood, she is deserted by her Husband Lord. The soul-bride does not attain the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: koorh vigut ee taa pir mut ee saa Dh an mahal na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਿੜ ਿਵਗੁਤੀ ਤਾ ਿਪਿਰ  ਮੁਤੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: But she who is attuned to the Guru's Shabad is intoxicated with celestial love; nightand day, she remains absorbed in Him.
lines.transliteration: gur sabday raat ee sehjay maat ee an-d in rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who remains constantly steeped in His Love, is blended bythe Lord into Himself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sad aa rang raat ee har jee-o aap milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If the Lord merges us with Himself, we are merged with Him. Without the Dear Lord,who can merge us with Him?
lines.transliteration: taa milee-ai har maylay jee-o har bin kavan  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without our Beloved Guru, who can dispel our doubt?
lines.transliteration: bin gur pareetam aapn ay jee-o ka-un  bharam chukaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਜੀਉ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, doubt is dispelled. O my mother, this is the way to meet Him; this is how the soul-bride finds peace.
lines.transliteration: gur bharam chukaa-ay i-o milee-ai maa-ay t aa saa Dh an sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਏ  ਇਉ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Without serving the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. Without the Guru, the Way isnot found.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa bin ghor anDh aar bin gur mag na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: That wife who is intuitively imbued with the color of His Love, contemplates the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kaaman rang raat ee sehjay maat ee gur kai sabad  veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੀ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband, by enshrining love for the Beloved Guru. ||4||1|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (244-8) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paa-i-aa gur kai bh aa-ay pi-aaray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Without my Husband, I am utterly dishonored. Without my Husband Lord, how can Ilive, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: pir bin kharee nimaan ee jee-o bin pir ki-o jeevaa mayree maa-ee.

lines.english: Without my Husband, sleep does not come, and my body is not adorned with mybridal dress.
lines.transliteration: pir bin need na aavai jee-o kaaparh  tan na suhaa-ee.

lines.english: The bridal dress looks beautiful upon my body, when I am pleasing to my HusbandLord. Following the Guru's Teachings, my consciousness is focused on Him.
lines.transliteration: kaapar tan suhaavai jaa pir bh aavai gurmat ee chit  laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਕਾਪੜੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I become His happy soul-bride forever, when I serve the True Guru; I sit in the Lap ofthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: sadaa suhaagan  jaa sat gur sayvay gur kai ank samaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਪਰੁ ਤਿਨ  ਸੁਹਾਵੈ  ਜਾ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, whoravishes and enjoys her. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in thisworld.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdai maylaa t aa pir raavee laahaa naam sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband, when she dwells upon the GloriousPraises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman naah pi-aaree jaa har kay gun  saaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ  ਮੇਲਾ  ਤਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੀ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride enjoys the Love of her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan rang maan ay jee-o aapn ay naal pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਨਾਹ ਿਪਆਰੀ ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Imbued with His Love night and day, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ahinis rang raatee jee-o gur sabad  veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, she conquers her ego, and in this way, she meetsher Beloved.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad veechaaray ha-umai maaray in biDh  milhu pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: She is the happy soul-bride of her Lord, who is forever imbued with the Love of theTrue Name of her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan sohagan  sadaa rang raat ee saachai naam pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੇ ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Abiding in the Company of our Guru, we grasp the Ambrosial Nectar; we conquer andcast out our sense of duality.
lines.transliteration: apunay gur mil rahee-ai amrit gahee-ai d ubiDh aa maar nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride attains her Husband Lord, and forgets all her pains. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paa-i-aa saglay d ookh visaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗਹੀਐ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride has forgotten her Husband Lord, because of love and emotionalattachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: kaaman pirahu bh ulee jee-o maa-i-aa mohi pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਿਵਸਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The false bride is attached to falsehood; the insincere one is cheated by insincerity.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee jhooth lagee jee-o koorh  muth ee koorh i-aaray.

lines.english: She who drives out her falsehood, and acts according to the Guru's Teachings, does not lose her life in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: koorh nivaaray gurmat  saaray joo-ai janam na haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੀ ਝੂਿਠ ਲਗੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੂਿੜ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂਿੜਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: One who serves the Word of the Guru's Shabad is absorbed in the True Lord; sheeradicates egotism from within.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad sayvay sach samaavai vichahu ha-umai maaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਾਰੇ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So let the Name of the Lord abide within your heart; decorate yourself in this way.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam ridai vasaa-ay aisaa karay seegaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੇਵੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਿਵਚਹ ੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride who takes the Support of the True Name is intuitivelyabsorbed in the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sahj samaan ee jis saachaa naam aDh aaro. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ  ਐਸਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Meet me, O my Dear Beloved. Without You, I am totally dishonored.
lines.transliteration: mil mayray pareetamaa jee-o t uDh bin kh aree nimaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Sleep does not come to my eyes, and I have no desire for food or water.
lines.transliteration: mai nainee need  na aavai jee-o bh aavai ann na paan ee.

lines.english: I have no desire for food or water, and I am dying from the pain of separation. Without my Husband Lord, how can I find peace? pMnw 245
lines.transliteration: paanee ann na bh aavai maree-ai haavai bin pir ki-o sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: I offer my prayers to the Guru; if it pleases the Guru, He shall unite me with Himself.
lines.transliteration: gur aagai kara-o binantee jay gur bh aavai ji-o milai t ivai milaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਕਰਉ  ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਜਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਿਮਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Giver of peace has united me with Himself; He Himself has come to my home to meet me.
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl la-ay sukh-d aata aap mili-aa gh ar aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is forever the Lord's favorite wife; her Husband Lord does notdie, and He shall never leave. ||4||2|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (245-2) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sad aa suhaagan  naa pir marai na jaa-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is pierced through with the sublime essence of the Lord, in intuitivepeace and poise.
lines.transliteration: kaaman har ras bayDh ee jee-o har kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The Enticer of hearts has enticed her, and her sense of duality has been easilydispelled.
lines.transliteration: man mohan mohi lee-aa jee-o dubiDh aa sahj samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਬੇਧੀ ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Her sense of duality has been easily dispelled, and the soul-bride obtains her HusbandLord; following the Guru's Teachings, she makes merry.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa sahj samaa-ay kaaman  var paa-ay gurmat ee rang laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਲੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: This body is filled to overflowing with falsehood, deception and the commission ofsins.
lines.transliteration: ih sareer koorh kusat  bhari-aa gal t aa-ee paap kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh practices that devotional worship, by which the celestial music wells up;without this devotional worship, filth is not removed.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat jit sahj Dh un upjai bin bh agtee mail na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੂਿੜ ਕੁਸਿਤ ਭਿਰਆ  ਗਲ ਤਾਈ  ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride who sheds selfishness and conceit from within, is dear to her Beloved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman pireh pi-aaree vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਿਬਨ ੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride has found her Husband Lord, through the love and affection of theGuru.
lines.transliteration: kaaman pir paa-i-aa jee-o gur kai bh aa-ay pi-aaray.

lines.english: She passes her life-night sleeping in peace, enshrining the Lord in her heart.
lines.transliteration: rain sukh  sutee jee-o ant ar ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Enshrining Him deep within her heart night and day, she meets her Beloved, and her pains depart.
lines.transliteration: antar ur Dh aaray milee-ai pi-aaray an-d in dukh nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਸੁਿਖ ਸੁਤੀ ਜੀਉ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Deep within the mansion of her inner being, she enjoys her Husband Lord, reflectingupon the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: antar mahal pir raavay kaaman  gurmat ee veechaaray.

lines.english: She drinks deeply of the Nectar of the Naam, day and night; she conquers and castsoff her sense of duality.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam pee-aa d in raat ee dubiDh aa maar nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride meets her True Lord, through the Infinite Love of theGuru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak sach milee sohagan gur kai hayt  apaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ  ਿਦਨ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Come, and shower Your Mercy upon me, my most Darling, Dear Beloved.
lines.transliteration: aavhu da-i-aa karay jee-o pareet am at  pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲੀ  ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The soul-bride offers her prayers to You, to adorn her with the True Word of Your Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kaaman bin-o karay jee-o sach sabad  seegaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Adorned with the True Word of Your Shabad, she conquers her ego, and as Gurmukh,her affairs are resolved.
lines.transliteration: sach sabad seegaaray ha-umai maaray gurmukh  kaaraj savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ  ਸਿਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Throughout the ages, the One Lord is True; through the Guru's Wisdom, He is known.
lines.transliteration: jug jug ayko sachaa so-ee boojhai gur beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is engrossed in sexual desire, and tormented by emotionalattachment. With whom should she lodge her complaints?
lines.transliteration: manmukh kaam vi-aapee mohi sant aapee kis aagai jaa-ay pukaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁ ਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest, without the most BelovedGuru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh thaa-o na paa-ay bin gur at  pi-aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਿਵਆਪੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The bride is foolish, ignorant and unworthy. Her Husband Lord is Unapproachable andIncomparable.
lines.transliteration: munDh i-aan ee bh olee nigun ee-aa jee-o pir agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself unites us in His Union; He Himself forgives us.
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milee-ai jee-o aapay bakhsan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ  ਭੋਲੀ ਿਨਗੁਣੀਆ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride's Beloved Husband Lord is the Forgiver of sins; He is contained in eachand every heart.
lines.transliteration: avgan bakh sanhaaraa kaaman  kant pi-aaraa gh at ghat rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: The True Guru has made me understand this understanding, that the Lord is obtained through love, affection and loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: paraym pareet bh aa-ay bh agtee paa-ee-ai sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਕੰਤੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: She remains forever in bliss, day and night; she remains immersed in His Love, nightand day.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee an-d in rahai liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who obtains the nine treasures, intuitively obtains herHusband Lord. ||4||3|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (245-16) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay har var paa-i-aa saa Dhan na-o niDh  paa-ee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The sea of Maya is agitated and turbulent; how can anyone cross over this terrifyingworld-ocean?
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa sar sabal vartai jee-o ki-o kar d utar tari-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Make the Lord's Name your boat, and install the Word of the Shabad as the boatman.
lines.transliteration: raam naam kar bohithaa jee-o sabad kh ayvat vich paa-ay.

lines.english: With the Shabad installed as the boatman, the Lord Himself shall take you across. Inthis way, the difficult ocean is crossed.
lines.transliteration: sabad kh ayvat vich paa-ay har aap lagh aa-ay in biDh  dutar taree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਰੁ ਸਬਲੁ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains devotional worship of the Lord, and thus remains dead while yetalive.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat paraapat  hovai jeevt i-aa i-o maree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟ ੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In an instant, the Lord's Name erases his sinful mistakes, and his body becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: khin meh raam naam kilvikh  kaatay bh a-ay pavit  sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟ ੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਾਏ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ ਲਘਾਏ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, emancipation is obtained, and the slag iron is transformed into gold. ||1|| pMnw 246
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam nistaaraa kanchan bh a-ay manooraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਤਰੀ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਜੀਉ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਿਬਿਧ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Men and women are obsessed with sex; they do not know the Way of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: istaree purakh  kaam vi-aapay jee-o raam naam kee biDh  nahee jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਖਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜੀਉ  ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Mother, father, children and siblings are very dear, but they drown, even withoutwater.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  bhaa-ee kh aray pi-aaray jee-o doob mu-ay bin paan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਧਾਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: They are drowned to death without water - they do not know the path of salvation,and they wander around the world in egotism.
lines.transliteration: doob mu-ay bin paanee gat  nahee jaan ee ha-umai Dh aat sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ  ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: All those who come into the world shall depart. Only those who contemplate the Gurushall be saved.
lines.transliteration: jo aa-i-aa so sabh ko jaasee ubray gur veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who become Gurmukh and chant the Lord's Name, save themselves and savetheir families as well.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai raam naam vakh aanai aap t arai kul t aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਮਲੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; through the Guru's Teachings, they meet their Beloved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat ant ar gurmat  milay pi-aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋ ਿਥਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is stable. This world is just a drama.
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin ko thir naahee jee-o baajee hai sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਚੀ ਜੀਉ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Implant true devotional worship within your heart, and trade in the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: darirh  bhagat sachee jee-o raam naam vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Trade in the Lord's Name is infinite and unfathomable. Through the Guru's Teachings,this wealth is obtained.
lines.transliteration: raam naam vaapaaraa agam apaaraa gurmatee Dh an paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: This selfless service, meditation and devotio n is true, if you eliminate selfishness and conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat bh agat ih saachee vichahu aap gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮਿਤ ਹੀਣ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I am senseless, foolish, idiotic and blind, but the True Guru has placed me on thePath.
lines.transliteration: ham mat heen  moorakh  mugaDh  anDh ay sat gur maarag paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਵੇ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are adorned with the Shabad; night and day, they sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sabad  suhaavay an-d in har gun  gaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਜੀਉ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and inspires others to act; He Himself embellishes us with the Wordof His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay karay aap jee-o aapay sabad savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਜੀਉ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Shabad; in each and every age, He loves His devotees.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur aap sabad  jee-o jug jug bh agat pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: In age after age, He loves His devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them, and HeHimself enjoins them to worship Him with devotion.
lines.transliteration: jug jug bhagat  pi-aaray har aap savaaray aapay bh agtee laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is All-knowing, and He Himself is All-seeing; He inspires us to serve Him.
lines.transliteration: aapay daanaa aapay beenaa aapay sayv karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਕਾਟੇ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Giver of merits, and the Destroyer of demerits; He causes His Nameto dwell within our hearts.
lines.transliteration: aapay gundaat aa avgun  kaatay hird ai naam vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਸਚੇ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Lord, who Himself is the Doer, the Cause ofcauses. ||4||4|| gauVI mhlw 3 ] (246-11) ga-orhee mehlaa 3. Gauree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sad balihaaree sachay vitahu aapay karay karaa-ay. ||4||4||

lines.english: Serve the Guru, O my dear soul; meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa kar piraa jee-o har naam Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਰ ਿਪਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Do not leave me, O my dear soul - you shall find the Lord while sitting within thehome of your own being.
lines.transliteration: manjahu d oor na jaahi piraa jee-o gh ar baith i-aa har paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਞਹੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਿਪਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਿਠਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: You shall obtain the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being, focusing your consciousness constantly upon the Lord, with true intuitive faith.
lines.transliteration: ghar baith i-aa har paa-ay sad aa chit  laa-ay sehjay sat  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਿਠਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਤ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru brings great peace; they alone do it, whom the Lord inspires to doso.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa kharee sukh aalee jis no aap karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They plant the seed of the Name, and the Name sprouts within; the Name abideswithin the mind.
lines.transliteration: naamo beejay naamo jammai naamo man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, glorious greatness rests in the True Name; It is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sach naam vadi-aa-ee poorab likhi-aa paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is so sweet, O my dear; taste it, and focus your consciousnesson it.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam meethaa piraa jee-o jaa chaakh ahi chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਪਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਜਾ ਚਾਖਿਹ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Taste the sublime essence of the Lord with your tongue, my dear, and renounce thepleasures of other tastes.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har ras chaakh muyay jee-o an ras saad  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਮੁਯੇ ਜੀਉ  ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: You shall obtain the everlasting essence of the Lord when it pleases the Lord; yourtongue shall be adorned with the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sadaa har ras paa-ay jaa har bh aa-ay rasnaa sabad  suhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਏ ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a lasting peace is obtained; so remainlovingly focused on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ay sad aa sukh  paa-ay naam rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: From the Naam we originate, and into the Naam we shall pass; through the Naam, weare absorbed in the Truth.
lines.transliteration: naamay upjai naamay binsai naamay sach samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਪਜੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਿਬਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam is obtained through the Guru's Teachings; He Himself attaches usto it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam gurmatee paa-ee-ai aapay la-ay lavaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਲਵਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Working for someone else, O my dear, is like forsaking the bride, and going to foreigncountries.
lines.transliteration: ayh vidaanee chaakree piraa jee-o Dh an chh od pard ays siDh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਿਵਡਾਣੀ  ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਪਰਾ ਜੀਉ  ਧਨ ਛੋਿਡ ਪਰਦੇਿਸ  ਿਸਧਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: In duality, no one has ever found peace, O my dear; you are greedy for corruptionand greed.
lines.transliteration: doojai kinai sukh  na paa-i-o piraa jee-o bikh i-aa lobh  lubhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਿਕਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਿਪਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਲੋਿਭ ਲੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Greedy for corruption and greed, and deluded by doubt, how can anyone find peace?
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa lobh  lubhaa-ay bh aram bh ulaa-ay oh ki-o kar sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ ਲੋਿਭ ਲੁਭਾਏ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਓਹੁ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Working for strangers is very painful; doing so, one sells himself and loses his faith in the Dharma. pMnw 247
lines.transliteration: chaakree vidaanee kh aree d ukhaalee aap vaych Dh aram gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Bound by Maya, the mind is not stable. Each and every moment, it suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa banDhan tikai naahee kh in khin dukh santaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the pain of Maya is taken away by focusing one's consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak maa-i-aa kaa dukh  taday chookai jaa gur sabd ee chit  laa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are foolish and crazy, O my dear; they do not enshrine the Shabad within their minds.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mugaDh  gaavaar piraa jee-o sabad  man na vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ਿਪਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The delusion of Maya has made them blind, O my dear; how can they find the Way ofthe Lord?
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaa bharam anDh  piraa jee-o har maarag ki-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਿਪਰਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: How can they find the Way, without the Will of the True Guru? The manmukhsfoolishly display themselves.
lines.transliteration: ki-o maarag paa-ay bin satgur bh aa-ay manmukh  aap gan aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's servants are forever comfortable. They focus their consciousness on theGuru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: har kay chaakar sadaa suhaylay gur charn ee chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਗੁ ਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lordforever.
lines.transliteration: jis no har jee-o karay kirpaa sadaa har kay gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਕਰੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world.The Lord Himself imparts this understanding to the Gurmukh. ||4||5||7|| rwgu gauVI CMq mhlw 5  (247-6) raag ga-orhee chh ant mehlaa 5 Raag Gauree, Chhant, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (247-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratan jag laahaa gurmukh  aap bujh aa-ay. ||4||5||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਗ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
lines.english: My mind has become sad and depressed; how can I see God, the Great Giver?
lines.transliteration: mayrai man bairaag bha-i-aa jee-o ki-o d aykhaa parabh  daatay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My Friend and Companion is the Dear Lord, the Guru, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: mayray meet sakh aa har jee-o gur purakh  biDhaatay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਕਉ  ਦੇਖਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is the Master of the Goddess of Wealth; how can I, in my sadness, meet You?
lines.transliteration: purkho biDh aataa ayk sareeDh ar ki-o milah t ujhai udeen ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: My hands serve You, and my head is at Your Feet. My mind, dishonored, yearns forthe Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: kar karahi sayvaa sees charnee man aas d aras nimaan ee-aa.

lines.english: With each and every breath, I think of You, day and night; I do not forget You, for aninstant, even for a moment.
lines.transliteration: saas saas na gharh ee visrai pal moorat  din raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੇਵਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਿਨ ਆਸ  ਦਰਸ  ਿਨਮਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am thirsty, like the rainbird; how can I meet God, the Great Giver? ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saaring ji-o pi-aasay ki-o milee-ai parabh d aatay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਨ ਘੜੀ  ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਪਲੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: I offer this one prayer - please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: ik bin-o kara-o jee-o sun kant  pi-aaray.

lines.english: My mind and body are enticed, beholding Your wondrous play.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man tan mohi lee-aa jee-o d aykh chalat  tumaaray.

lines.english: Beholding Your wondrous play, I am enticed; but how can the sad, forlorn bride find contentment?
lines.transliteration: chaltaa t umaaray d aykh mohee ud aas Dh an ki-o Dh eer-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਲੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਦੇਿਖ ਚਲਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord is Meritorious, Merciful and Eternally Young; He is overflowing with all excellences.
lines.transliteration: gunvant  naah d a-i-aal baalaa sarab gun  bharpoor-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਤਾ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਦੇਿਖ ਮੋਹੀ ਉਦਾਸ  ਧਨ ਿਕਉ  ਧੀਰਏ  ॥
lines.english: The fault is not with my Husband Lord, the Giver of peace; I am separated from Himby my own mistakes.
lines.transliteration: pir dos naahee sukh ah daatay ha-o vichh urhee buri-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤ  ਨਾਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਬਾਲਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਏ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, and return home, O my Beloved HusbandLord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d a-i-aa Dh aarahu gh ar aavhu naah pi-aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੁਖਹ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਹਉ ਿਵਛੁੜੀ  ਬੁਿਰਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I surrender my mind, I surrender my whole body; I surrender all my lands.
lines.transliteration: ha-o man arpee sabh t an arpee arpee sabh  daysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵਹੁ ਨਾਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I surrender my head to that beloved friend, who brings me news of God.
lines.transliteration: ha-o sir arpee tis meet  pi-aaray jo parabh  day-ay sad aysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਅਰਪੀ ਸਿਭ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.english: I have offered my head to the Guru, the most exalted; He has shown me that God iswith me.
lines.transliteration: arpi-aa ta sees suthaan gur peh sang parabh oo dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਸਰੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮੀਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ  ਦੇਇ ਸਦੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: In an instant, all suffering is removed. I have obtained all my mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: khin maahi saglaa d ookh miti-aa manhu chind i-aa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਿਪਆ  ਤ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਥਾਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, the soul-bride makes merry; all her anxieties are erased.
lines.transliteration: din rain  ralee-aa karai kaaman  mitay sagal and aysaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have met the Husband Lord of my longing. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak kant  mili-aa lorh -tay ham jaisaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਮਟੇ ਸਗਲ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is filled with bliss, and congratulations are pouring in.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man anad bh a-i-aa jee-o vajee vaaDh aa-ee.

lines.english: My Darling Beloved has come home to me, and all my desires have been satisfied.
lines.transliteration: ghar laal aa-i-aa pi-aaraa sabh  tikhaa bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have met my Sweet Lord and Master of the Universe, and my companions sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: mili-aa ta laal gupaal th aakur sakh ee mangal gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: All my friends and relatives are happy, and all traces of my enemies have beenremoved.
lines.transliteration: sabh meet  banDh ap harakh  upji-aa d oot thaa-o gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਤ ਲਾਲੁ  ਗੁਪਾਲੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody vibrates in my home, and the bed has been made up for myBeloved.
lines.transliteration: anhat vaajay vajeh gh ar meh pir sang sayj vichh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਹਰਖੁ  ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਦੂਤ ਥਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am in celestial bliss. I have obtained the Lord, the Giver of peace, as my Husband. ||4||1|| pMnw 248 gauVI mhlw 5 ] (248-1) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sahj rahai har mili-aa kant  sukh -daa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.english: O Mohan, your temple is so lofty, and your mansion is unsurpassed.
lines.transliteration: mohan tayray oochay mand ar mahal apaaraa.

lines.english: O Mohan, your gates are so beautiful. They are the worship-houses of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: mohan tayray sohan d u-aar jee-o sant  Dharam saalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮਹਲ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam saal apaar d ai-aar th aakur sad aa keert an gaavhay. In these incomparable worship-houses, they continually sing Kirtan, the Praises of their Lord and Master.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਿਨ ਦੁਆਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ  ਸਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Where the Saints and the Holy gather together, there they meditate on you.
lines.transliteration: jah saaDh sant  ikatar hoveh t ahaa t ujheh Dh i-aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਸਾਲ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਦੈਆਰ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Be Kind and Compassionate, O Merciful Lord; be Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: kar da-i-aa ma-i-aa d a-i-aal su-aamee hohu d een kirpaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤਰ੍  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤਹਾ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਿਧਆਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; receiving Your Darshan, Iam totally at peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d aras pi-aasay mil d arsan sukh  saaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹੋਹੁ ਦੀਨ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Mohan, your speech is incomparable; wondrous are your ways.
lines.transliteration: mohan tayray bachan anoop chaal niraalee.

lines.english: O Mohan, you believe in the One. Everything else is dust to you.
lines.transliteration: mohan tooN maaneh ayk jee avar sabh  raalee.

lines.english: You adore the One Lord, the Unknowable Lord and Master; His Power gives Supportto all.
lines.transliteration: maaneh ta ayk alaykh  thaakur jineh sabh  kal Dh aaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਤੂੰ ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਏਕੁ ਜੀ ਅਵਰ  ਸਭ ਰਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, you have captured the heart of the Primal Being, the Lordof the World.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bachan gur kai vas kee-aa aad  purakh  banvaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਤ ਏਕੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਿਜਨਿਹ  ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself move, and You Yourself stand still; You Yourself support the whole creation.
