lines.transliteration: tooN aap chali-aa aap rahi-aa aap sabh  kal Dh aaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਚਿਨ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਕੀਆ  ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please preserve my honor; all Your servants seek the Protection of YourSanctuary. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak paij raakh o sabh  sayvak saran t umaaree-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਿਪ  ਚਿਲਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Mohan, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, meditates on you; they meditate onthe Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: mohan tuDh  satsangat  Dhi-aavai d aras Dh i-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Mohan, the Messenger of Death does not even approach those who meditate onYou, at the last moment.
lines.transliteration: mohan jam nayrh na aavai t uDh jaapeh nid aanaa.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot touch those who meditate on You single-mindedly.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal tin ka-o lagai naahee jo ik man Dh i-aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪਿਹ  ਿਨਦਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who worship and adore You in thought, word and deed, obtain all fruits andrewards.
lines.transliteration: man bachan karam je tuDh  araaDh eh say sabh ay fal paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੋ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are foolish and stupid, filthy with urine and manure, become all-knowingupon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: mal moot moorh  je mugaDh  hotay se d aykh daras sugi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਬਚਿਨ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਜ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਹ  ਸੇ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, Your Kingdom is Eternal, O Perfect Primal Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak raaj nihchal pooran purakh  bhagvaanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਿਜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਹੋਤੇ ਿਸ ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸੁ  ਸੁਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Mohan, you have blossomed forth with the flower of your family.
lines.transliteration: mohan tooN sufal fali-aa san  parvaaray.

lines.english: O Mohan, your children, friends, siblings and relatives have all been saved.
lines.transliteration: mohan putar meet  bhaa-ee kutamb sabh  taaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਤੂੰ ਸੁਫਲੁ  ਫਿਲਆ  ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You save those who give up their egotistical pride, upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: taari-aa jahaan lahi-aa abh imaan jinee d arsan paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸਿਭ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who call you 'blessed'.
lines.transliteration: jinee tuDh no Dh an kahi-aa t in jam nayrh  na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਿਰਆ  ਜਹਾਨੁ ਲਿਹਆ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Your Virtues are unlimited - they cannot be  described, O True Guru, Primal Being, Destroyer of demons.
lines.transliteration: bay-ant gun  tayray kathay na jaahee sat gur purakh  muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਤੁਧਨੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਿਹਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, Yours is that Anchor, holding onto which the whole world is saved.||4||2|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (248-14) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl, sloku ] (248-14) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak tayk raakh ee jit lag tari-aa sansaaray. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਥੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Countless sinners have been purified; I am a sacrifice, over and over again, to You.
lines.transliteration: patit asaNkh puneet  kar punah punah balihaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੀ  ਿਜਤੁ ਲਿਗ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditation on the Lord's Name is the fire which burns away sinful mistakes like straw. ||1|| CMq ] (248-15) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam jap paavko tin kilbikh  dahanhaar. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Masterof Wealth.
lines.transliteration: jap manaa tooN raam naraa-in  govind aa har maaDh o.

lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay manaa muraar mukand ay katee-ai kaal d ukh faaDh o. Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, the Destroyer of ego, the Giver of salvation, whocuts away the noose of agonizing death.
Meditate lovingly on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, the Destroyer of distress, theProtector of the poor, the Lord of excellence.
lines.transliteration: dukhharan  deen saran  sareeDh ar charan kamal araaDh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਕਿਰ ਪੁਨਹ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The treacherous path of death and the terrifying ocean of fire are crossed over bymeditating in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: jam panth bikh-rh aa agan saagar nimakh  simrat  saaDh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਪਾਵਕੋ  ਿਤਨ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਦਾਹਨਹਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate day and night on the Lord, the Destroyer of desire, the Purifier of pollution.
lines.transliteration: kalimalah daht aa suDh  kartaa dinas rain  araaDh o.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, please be Merciful to me, O Cherisher of the world, Lord of the Universe,Lord of wealth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak karahu kirpaa gopaal gobind  maaDh o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, remember the Lord in meditation; He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear, the Sovereign Lord King.
lines.transliteration: simar manaa daamod ar dukhhar bh ai bhanjan har raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਆਇ  ਮਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ਮੁਕੰਦੇ  ਕਟੀਐ  ਕਾਲ  ਦੁਖ ਫਾਧੋ ॥
lines.english: He is the Greatest Lover, the Merciful Master, the Enticer of the mind, the Support ofHis devotees - this is His very nature. pMnw 249
lines.transliteration: sareerango da-i-aal manohar bh agat vachh al bird aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He fulfills the desires of the mind.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al purakh  pooran maneh chind i-aa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਮ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਾਰੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He lifts us up out of the deep, dark pit; enshrine His Name within your mind.
lines.transliteration: tam anDh  koop t ay uDh aarai naam man vasaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰ ਿਸਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The gods, the Siddhas, the angels, the heavenly singers, the silent sages and the devotees sing Your countless Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sur siDh gan  ganDh arab mun jan gun  anik bh agtee gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, O Supreme Lord God, my King. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak karahu kirpaa paarbarahm har raa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਮਨਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ੁ ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, be conscious of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, whowields all power.
lines.transliteration: chayt manaa paarbarahm parmaysar sarab kalaa jin Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਅਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is All-powerful, the Embodiment of compassion. He is the Master of each and everyheart;
lines.transliteration: karunaa mai samrath su-aamee gh at ghat paraan  aDhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Support of the breath of life. He is the Giver of the breath of life, of mind, body and soul. He is Infinite, Inaccessible and Unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: paraan man t an jee-a d aataa bay-ant  agam apaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਜੋਗੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਰਬ  ਦੋਖ ਿਬਦਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The All-powerful Lord is our Sanctuary; He is the Enticer of the mind, who banishes allsorrows.
lines.transliteration: saran jog samrath mohan sarab d okh bidaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਿਭ ਦੋਖ ਿਬਨਸਿਹ  ਜਪਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: All illnesses, sufferings and pains are dispelled, by chanting the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rog sog sabh d okh binsahi japat  naam muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, All-powerful Lord; You are the Wielder of allpower. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak karahu kirpaa samrath sabh  kal Dh aaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ਮਨਾ ਅਚੁਤ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable, Eternal, Merciful Master, theHighest of all.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-o manaa achut  abhinaasee sabh  tay ooch d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸੰਭਰੁ ਦੇਵਨ  ਕਉ ਏਕੈ ਸਰਬ  ਕਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Sustainer of the Universe, the Great Giver; He is the Cherisher ofall.
lines.transliteration: bisambhar d ayvan ka-o aykai sarab karai part ipaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ਮਹਾ ਦਇਆਲ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਿਕਸੈ ॥
lines.english: The Cherisher Lord is so very merciful and wise; He is compassionate to all.
lines.transliteration: partipaal mahaa d a-i-aal d aanaa d a-i-aa Dh aaray sabh  kisai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਾਸੈ ਜੀਅ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਬਸੈ ॥
lines.english: The pains of death, greed and emotional attachment simply vanish, when God comesto dwell in the soul.
lines.transliteration: kaal kantak lobh moh naasai jee-a jaa kai parabh  basai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਦੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ  ਸੇਵਾ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਘਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, then one's service becomes perfectly fruitful.
lines.transliteration: suparsan dayvaa safal sayvaa bh a-ee pooran gh aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜਪਤ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੈਆਲਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled by meditating on the Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||4||3|| gauVI mhlw 5 ] (249-9) ga-orhee mehlaa 5. Gauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak ichh  punee japat  deen d ai-aalaa. ||4||3||

lines.english: Listen, O my companions: let's join together and make the effort, to surrender to ourHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sun sakh ee-ay mil ud am karayhaa manaa-ay laihi har kant ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਖੀਏ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ  ਮਨਾਇ  ਲੈਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਕੰਤੈ ॥
lines.english: Renouncing our pride, let's charm Him with the potion of devotional worship, and themantra of the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: maan ti-aag kar bh agat thag-uree mohah saaDh oo mant ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਕਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਮੋਹਹ  ਸਾਧੂ ਮੰਤੈ ॥
lines.english: O my companions, when He comes under our power, He shall never leave us again.This is the good nature of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sakhee vas aa-i-aa fir chh od na jaa-ee ih reet  bhalee bh agvant ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਵਿਸ ਆਇਆ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਇਹ ਰੀਿਤ  ਭਲੀ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God dispels the fear of old age, death and hell; He purifies His beings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak jaraa maran bh ai narak nivaarai puneet  karai t is jant ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ  ਭੈ ਨਰਕ  ਿਨਵਾਰੈ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਕਰੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listen, O my companions, to my sincere prayer: let's make this firm resolve.
lines.transliteration: sun sakh ee-ay ih bh alee binant ee ayhu mat aaNt pakaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਖੀਏ  ਇਹ ਭਲੀ ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਏਹੁਮਤਤੁ  ਪਕਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: In the peaceful poise of intuitive bliss, violence will be gone, as we sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay upaaDh  rahat  ho-ay geet  govind eh gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਉਪਾਿਧ  ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਗੀਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦਿਹ  ਗਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Our pains and troubles shall be eradicated, and our doubts shall be dispelled; we will receive the fruits of our minds' desires.
lines.transliteration: kal kalays miteh bharam naaseh man chind i-aa fal paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਨਾਸਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect,Transcendent Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran parmaysar naanak naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: O my companions, I yearn for Him continually; I invoke His Blessings, and pray thatGod may fulfill my hopes.
lines.transliteration: sakhee ichh  karee nit  sukh  manaa-ee parabh  mayree aas pujaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਇਛ ਕਰੀ ਿਨਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ਪੁਜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I thirst for His Feet, and I long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I look for Himeverywhere.
lines.transliteration: charan pi-aasee daras bairaagan paykh a-o thaan sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਿਪਆਸੀ  ਦਰਸ  ਬੈਰਾਗਿਨ  ਪੇਖਉ  ਥਾਨ ਸਬਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I search for traces of the Lord in the Society of the Saints; they will unite me with theAll-powerful Primal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: khoj laha-o har sant  janaa sang sammrith purakh  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਿਜ ਲਹਉ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਥ  ਪੁਰਖ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble, noble beings who meet the Lord, the Giver of peace, are veryblessed, O my mother. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin mili-aa surijan sukh -daata say vadbh aagee maa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਿਰਜਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my companions, now I dwell with my Beloved Husband; my mind and body areattuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sakhee naal vasaa apunay naah pi-aaray mayraa man t an har sang hili-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ਵਸਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਹਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O my companions: now I sleep well, since I found my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sun sakh ee-ay mayree need  bhalee mai aapnarh aa pir mili-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਖੀਏ  ਮੇਰੀ ਨੀਦ  ਭਲੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਨੜਾ  ਿਪਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: My doubts have been dispelled, and I have found intuitive peace and tranquility through my Lord and Master. I have been enlightened, and my heart-lotus hasblossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: bharam kh o-i-o saaNt sahj su-aamee pargaas bh a-i-aa ka-ul kh ili-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ  ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਕਉਲੁ  ਿਖਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, as my Husband; ONanak, my marriage shall last forever. ||4||4||2||5||11|| pMnw 250 <> siqgur pRswid ] (250-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: gauVI bwvn AKrI mhlw 5 ] (250-1) ga-orhee baavan akh ree mehlaa 5. Gauree, Baavan Akhree ~ The 52 Letters, Fifth Mehl: sloku ] (250-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: var paa-i-aa parabh ant arjaamee naanak sohaag na tali-aa. ||4||4||2||5||11||

lines.english: The Divine Guru is my mother, the Divine Guru is my father; the Divine Guru is myTranscendent Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv maat aa gurd ayv pit aa gurd ayv su-aamee parmaysuraa.

lines.english: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is myrelative and brother.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv sakh aa agi-aan bh anjan gurd ayv banDh ip sahod araa.

lines.english: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is theMantra which never fails.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv d aataa har naam upd aysai gurd ayv mant  niroDh araa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the Image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv saaNt sat buDh  moorat  gurdayv paaras paras paraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸਖਾ ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਬੰਿਧਪ  ਸਹੋਦਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine ambrosia;bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv t irath amrit  sarovar gur gi-aan majan apramparaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮੰਤੁ ਿਨਰੋਧਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is thePurifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv kart aa sabh  paap hart aa gurd ayv pat it pavit  karaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸਿਤ  ਸਿਤ ਬੁਿਧ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਪਾਰਸ  ਪਰਸ  ਪਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru existed at the primal beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one issaved.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv aad  jugaad  jug jug gurd ayv mant  har jap uDh raa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolishsinner, but holding onto Him, I am carried across.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv sangat  parabh  mayl kar kirpaa ham moorh  paapee jit  lag taraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਿਭ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਪਿਤਤ ਪਿਵਤ  ਕਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord;Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1|| sloku ] (250-7) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: gurdayv sat gur paarbarahm parmaysar gurd ayv naanak har namaskaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮੰਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਉਧਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and causes others to act; He Himself can do everything.
lines.transliteration: aapeh kee-aa karaa-i-aa aapeh karnai jog.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਿਲ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਲਿਗ  ਤਰਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One Lord is pervading everywhere; there has never been any other, and there never shall be. ||1|| pauVI ] (250-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayko rav rahi-aa doosar ho-aa na hog. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ONG: I humbly bow in reverence to the One Universal Creator, to the Holy True Guru.
lines.transliteration: o-aN saaDh sat gur namaskaaraN.

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is the Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant niraNkaaraN.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਿਹ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਾਇਆ  ਆਪਿਹ  ਕਰਨੈ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is in the absolute state of primal meditation; He Himself is in the seat ofpeace.
lines.transliteration: aapeh sunn aapeh sukh aasan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ  ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself listens to His Own Praises.
lines.transliteration: aapeh sunat aap hee jaasan.

lines.english: He Himself created Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapan aap aapeh upaa-i-o.

lines.english: He is His Own Father, He is His Own Mother.
lines.transliteration: aapeh baap aap hee maa-i-o.

lines.english: He Himself is subtle and etheric; He Himself is manifest and obvious.
lines.transliteration: aapeh sookham aapeh asthoolaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, His wondrous play cannot be understood. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lakhee na jaa-ee naanak leelaa. ||1||

lines.english: O God, Merciful to the meek, please be kind to me,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Shalok:
lines.transliteration: tayray sant an kee man ho-ay ravaalaa. rahaa-o. that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||Pause|| sloku ] (250-11) salok.

lines.english: He Himself is formless, and also formed; the One Lord is without attributes, and alsowith attributes.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar aakaar aap nirgun sargun ayk.

lines.english: Describe the One Lord as One, and Only One; O Nanak, He is the One, and the many.||1|| pauVI ] (250-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aykeh ayk bakhaanano naanak ayk anayk. ||1||

lines.english: ONG: The One Universal Creator created the Creation through the Word of the PrimalGuru.
lines.transliteration: o-aN gurmukh kee-o akaaraa.

lines.english: He strung it upon His one thread.
lines.transliteration: aykeh soot parovanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: He created the diverse expanse of the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: bhinn bh inn tarai gun  bisthaaraN.

lines.english: From formless, He appeared as form.
lines.transliteration: nirgun tay sargun d aristaaraN.

lines.english: The Creator has created the creation of all sorts.
lines.transliteration: sagal bhaat  kar karahi upaa-i-o.

lines.english: The attachment of the mind has led to birth and death.
lines.transliteration: janam maran man moh badhaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਿਹ  ਏਕ ਬਖਾਨਨੋ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is above both, untouched and unaffected.
lines.transliteration: duhoo bh aat tay aap niraaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, He has no end or limitation. ||2|| sloku ] (250-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak ant na paaraavaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who gather Truth, and the riches of the Lord's Name, are rich and veryfortunate.
lines.transliteration: say-ee saah bhagvant  say sach sampai har raas.

lines.english: O Nanak, truthfulness and purity are obtained from Saints such as these. ||1|| pvVI ] (250-16) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach such paa-ee-ai tih sant an kai paas. ||1||

lines.english: SASSA: True, True, True is that Lord.
lines.transliteration: sasaa sat sat  sat so-oo.

lines.english: No one is separate from the True Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  tay bh inn na ko-oo.

lines.english: They alone enter the Lord's Sanctuary, whom the Lord inspires to enter.
lines.transliteration: so-oo saran parai jih paa-yaN.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, they sing and preach the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: simar simar gun gaa-ay sunaa-yaN.

lines.english: Doubt and skepticism do not affect them at all.
lines.transliteration: sansai bharam nahee kachh  bi-aapat .

lines.english: They behold the manifest glory of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: pargat partaap t aahoo ko jaapat .

lines.english: They are the Holy Saints - they reach this destination.
lines.transliteration: so saaDhoo ih pahuchanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||3|| sloku ] (250-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai sad  balihaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁਿਚ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਤਹ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an kahaa pukaart ay maa-i-aa moh sabh  koor. Why are you crying out for riches and wealth? All this emotional attachment to Maya is false. pMnw 251
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ||1|| pvVI ] (251-1) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonay naankaa hot jaat  sabh  Dhoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ  ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: DhaDh aa Dh oor puneet  tayray janoo-aa. DHADHA: The dust of the feet of the Saints is sacred.
Dhan t ay-oo jih ruch i-aa manoo-aa. Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.
Dhan nahee baachh eh surag na aachh eh. They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.
They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: at pari-a pareet  saaDh  raj raacheh.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਿਹ  ਸੁਰਗ  ਨ ਆਛਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: DhanDh ay kahaa bi-aapahi t aahoo. jo ayk chh aad an kat eh na jaahoo. How can worldly affairs affect those who do not abandon the One Lord, and who go nowhere else?
One whose heart is filled with God's Name,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hee-ai dee-o parabh  naam.

lines.english: O Nanak, is a perfect spiritual being of God. ||4|| slok ] (251-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDh pooran bh agvaan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਿਡ  ਅਨ ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
lines.english: By all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubborn-mindedness, noone has ever met God.
lines.transliteration: anik bhaykh  ar ny i-aan Dh i-aan manhath  mili-a-o na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ  ਦੀਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His Mercy, are devotees of spiritualwisdom. ||1|| pauVI ] (251-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kirpaa bha-ee bh agat nyi-aanee so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: NGANGA: Spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.
lines.transliteration: nyany aa ny i-aan nahee mukh  baata-o.

lines.english: It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shaastras and scriptures.
lines.transliteration: anik jugat saast ar kar bh aata-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਿਙਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਿਮਿਲਅਉ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nyi-aanee so-ay jaa kai d arirh so-oo.

lines.english: Hearing and telling stories, no one attains Yoga.
lines.transliteration: kahat sunat  kachh  jog na ho-oo.

lines.english: They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: nyi-aanee rahat  aagi-aa d arirh jaa kai.

lines.english: Heat and cold are all the same to them.
lines.transliteration: usan seet samsar sabh  taa kai.

lines.english: The true people of spiritual wisdom are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality;
lines.transliteration: nyi-aanee t at gurmukh  beechaaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||5|| sloku ] (251-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa ka-o kirpaa Dhaaree. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
lines.english: Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals andbeasts.
lines.transliteration: aavan aa-ay sarisat meh bin boojhay pas dh or.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand; upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ||1|| pauVI ] (251-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh so bujh ai jaa kai bh aag mathor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਨ  ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: yaa jug meh aykeh ka-o aa-i-aa.

lines.english: But ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.
lines.transliteration: janmat mohi-o mohnee maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation.
lines.transliteration: garabh kunt meh uraDh  tap kart ay.

lines.english: They remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: saas saas simrat parabh  rahtay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਨ  ਆਏ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਮਿਹ ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
lines.english: But now, they are entangled in things which they must leave behind.
lines.transliteration: urajh paray jo chh od chh adaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They forget the Great Giver from their minds.
lines.transliteration: dayvanhaar maneh bisraanaa.

lines.english: Dhaarahu kirpaa jisahi gusaa-ee. it  ut naanak t is bisrahu naahee. ||6|| O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, do not forget Him, here orhereafter. ||6|| sloku ] (251-11) salok. Shalok:

lines.punjabi: ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਏਕਿਹ  ਕਉ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command, we come, and by His Command, we go; no one is beyond His Command.
lines.transliteration: aavat hukam binaas hukam aagi-aa bh inn na ko-ay.

lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds arefilled with the Lord. ||1|| pauVI ] (251-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa tih mitai naanak jih man so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਕੁੰਟ ਮਿਹ ਉਰਧ  ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: This soul has lived in many wombs.
lines.transliteration: ay-oo jee-a bahut garabh  vaasay.

lines.english: Enticed by sweet attachment, it has been trapped in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: moh magan meeth jon faasay.

lines.english: This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: in maa-i-aa tarai gun  bas keenay.

lines.english: Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: aapan moh ghatay gh at deenay.

lines.english: O friend, tell me some way,
lines.transliteration: ay saajan kachh kahhu upaa-i-aa.
jaa tay t ara-o bikh am ih maa-i-aa. by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.

lines.english: The Lord showers His Mercy, and leads us to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa satsang milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਿਬਨਾਸ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਆਿਗਆ  ਿਭੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, Maya does not even come near. ||7|| sloku ] (251-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai nikat na maa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: God Himself causes one to perform good and bad actions.
lines.transliteration: kirat kamaavan subh  asubh  keenay t in parabh  aap.

lines.english: The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord,what can anyone do? ||1|| pauVI ] (251-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: pas aapan ha-o ha-o karai naanak bin har kahaa kamaat. ||1||

lines.english: The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.
lines.transliteration: aykeh aap karaavanhaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself distributes sins and noble acts.
lines.transliteration: aapeh paap punn bisthaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸ ਕੀਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.
lines.transliteration: i-aa jug jit jit  aapeh laa-i-o.

lines.english: They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.
lines.transliteration: so so paa-i-o jo aap divaa-i-o.

lines.english: No one knows His limits.
lines.transliteration: u-aa kaa ant na jaanai ko-oo.

lines.english: Whatever He does, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo jo karai so-oo fun ho-oo.

lines.english: From the One, the entire expanse of the Universe emanated.
lines.transliteration: aykeh tay saglaa bisthaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||8|| sloku ] (251-19) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap savaaranhaaraa. ||8||

lines.english: Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; the tumult of his passion islike the dye of the safflower, which fades away all too soon.
lines.transliteration: raach rahay banitaa binod  kusam rang bikh  sor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਤ  ਕਮਾਵਨ  ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ  ਕੀਨੇ ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, seek God's Sanctuary, and your selfishness and conceit shall be taken away. ||1|| pMnw 252 pauVI ] (252-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tih sarnee para-o binas jaa-ay mai mor. ||1||

lines.english: O mind: without the Lord, whatever you are involved in shall bind you in chains.
lines.transliteration: ray man bin har jah rachahu tah t ah banDh an paahi.

lines.english: The faithless cynic does those deeds which will never allow him to be emancipated.
lines.transliteration: jih biDh kat hoo na chh ootee-ai saakat  tay-oo kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the lovers of rituals carry the unbearable load.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o kartay karam rat  taa ko bh aar afaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When there is no love for the Naam, then these rituals are corrupt.
lines.transliteration: pareet nahee ja-o naam si-o t a-o ay-oo karam bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਰਮ  ਰਤ ਤਾ ਕੋਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The rope of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.
lines.transliteration: baaDhay jam kee jayvree meeth ee maa-i-aa rang.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.
lines.transliteration: bharam kay mohay nah bujh eh so parabh  sadhoo sang.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.english: When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mudcannot be washed clean.
lines.transliteration: laykhai gan at na chh ootee-ai kaachee bh eet na suDh .

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਿਹ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.english: One who is made to understand - O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculateunderstanding. ||9|| sloku ] (252-5) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaa-ay naankaa t ih gurmukh  nirmal buDh . ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਕਾਚੀ  ਭੀਿਤ  ਨ ਸੁਿਧ ॥
lines.english: One whose bonds are cut away joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: tootay banDhan jaas kay ho-aa saaDh oo sang.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on the deep and lasting color of His Love. ||1|| pauVI ] (252-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jo raatay rang ayk kai naanak goorh aa rang. ||1||

lines.english: RARRA: Dye this heart of yours in the color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: raaraa rangahu i-aa man apnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ ਹੋਆ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - chant it with your tongue.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu jap rasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੂੜਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.
lines.transliteration: ray ray dargeh kahai na ko-oo.

lines.english: Everyone shall welcome you, saying, "Come, and sit down."
lines.transliteration: aa-o baith aad ar subh  day-oo.

lines.english: In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.
lines.transliteration: u-aa mahlee paavahi too baasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: There is no birth or death, or destruction there.
lines.transliteration: janam maran nah ho-ay binaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ  ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
lines.english: One who has such karma written on his forehead,
lines.transliteration: mastak karam likh i-o Dh ur jaa kai.

lines.english: O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ||10|| sloku ] (252-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: har sampai naanak ghar t aa kai. ||10||

lines.english: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment entangle the blind and thefoolish.
lines.transliteration: laalach jhooth  bikaar moh bi-aapat  moorh ay anDh .

lines.english: Bound down by Maya, O Nanak, a foul odor clings to them. ||1|| pauVI ] (252-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: laag paray durganDh  si-o naanak maa-i-aa banDh . ||1||

lines.english: LALLA: People are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;
lines.transliteration: lalaa lapat bikhai ras raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਘਿਰ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh maa-i-aa mad  maat ay. they are drunk with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.

lines.english: In this Maya, they are born and die.
lines.transliteration: i-aa maa-i-aa meh janmeh marnaa.

lines.english: People act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o hukam tivai t i-o karnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਗ  ਪਰੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ  ਿਸਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one is perfect, and no one is imperfect.
lines.transliteration: ko-oo oon na ko-oo pooraa.

lines.english: No one is wise, and no one is foolish.
lines.transliteration: ko-oo sughar na ko-oo mooraa.

lines.english: Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavhu t it tit lagnaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ||11|| sloku ] (252-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak thaakur sad aa alipanaa. ||11||

lines.english: My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the World, the Lord of the Universe, is deep,profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: laal gupaal gobind parabh  gahir gambh eer athaah.

lines.english: There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is not worried. ||1|| pauVI ] (252-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: doosar naahee avar ko naanak bayparvaah. ||1||

lines.english: LALLA: There is no one equal to Him.
lines.transliteration: lalaa taa kai lavai na ko-oo.

lines.english: He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.
lines.transliteration: aykeh aap avar nah ho-oo.

lines.english: He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.
lines.transliteration: hovanhaar hot sad  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: No one has ever found His limit.
lines.transliteration: u-aa kaa ant na kaahoo paa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the ant and in the elephant, He is totally pervading.
lines.transliteration: keet hasat meh poor samaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਅਥਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by everyone everywhere.
lines.transliteration: pargat purakh sabh  thaa-oo jaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਸਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਵਰ  ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That one, unto whom the Lord has given His Love
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o deeno har ras apnaa.

lines.english: - O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||12|| sloku ] (252-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har har t ih japnaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਲਲਾ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
lines.english: One who knows the taste of the Lord's sublime essence, intuitively enjoys the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: aatam ras jih jaani-aa har rang sehjay maan .

lines.english: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate istheir coming into the world! ||1|| pauVI ] (252-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan Dh an Dh an jan aa-ay t ay parvaan . ||1||

lines.english: How fruitful is the coming into the world, of those
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa safal taahoo ko ganee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਆ  ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaas rasan har har jas bhanee-ai. whose tongues celebrate the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.english: They come and dwell with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
lines.transliteration: aa-ay baseh saaDhoo kai sangay.
an-din naam Dh i-aavahi rangay. night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Naam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed is the birth of those humble beings who are attuned to the Naam;
lines.transliteration: aavat so jan naameh raat aa.
jaa ka-o da-i-aa ma-i-aa biDh aataa. the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, bestows His Kind Mercy upon them.

lines.english: They are born only once - they shall not be reincarnated again.
lines.transliteration: aykeh aavan fir jon na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਸੁ ਿਜਹ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||13|| sloku ] (252-19) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak har kai daras samaa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਿਨ ਧਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਜਨ ਆਏ  ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting it, the mind is filled with bliss; love  of duality is eliminated, and pain, distress and desires are quenched. O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, the Name of theLord. ||1|| pMnw 253 pauVI ] (253-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gauVI, mÚ 5) yaas japat man ho-ay anand binsai d oojaa bh aa-o. d ookh darad tarisnaa bujh ai naanak naam samaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: YAYYA: Burn away duality and evil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: ya-yaa jaara-o durmat  do-oo.

lines.english: Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: tiseh t i-aag sukh  sehjay so-oo.

lines.english: Yaya: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the Saints;
lines.transliteration: ya-yaa jaa-ay parahu sant sarnaa.
jih aasar i-aa bhavjal t arnaa. with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.english: Yaya: One who weaves the One Name into his heart, does not have to take birthagain.
lines.transliteration: ya-yaa janam na aavai so-oo. ayk naam lay maneh paro-oo.

lines.english: Yaya: This human life shall not be wasted, if you take the Support of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: ya-yaa janam na haaree-ai gur pooray kee tayk.

lines.english: O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ||14|| sloku ] (253-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tih sukh  paa-i-aa jaa kai hee-arai ayk. ||14||

lines.english: The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.
lines.transliteration: antar man t an bas rahay eet  oot kay meet .

lines.punjabi: ਯਯਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ||1|| pauVI ] (253-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai updaysi-aa naanak japee-ai neet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who will be your Help andSupport in the end.
lines.transliteration: an-din simrahu t aas ka-o jo ant  sahaa-ee ho-ay.

lines.english: This poison shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.
lines.transliteration: ih bikhi-aa d in chaar chh i-a chh aad chali-o sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਿਸ ਰਹੇ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Who is our mother, father, son and daughter?
lines.transliteration: kaa ko maat pit aa sut  Dhee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ  ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ  ਨੀਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Household, wife, and other things shall not go along with you.
lines.transliteration: garih banitaa kachh  sang na lee-aa.

lines.english: So gather that wealth which shall never perish,
lines.transliteration: aisee sanch jo binsat naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pat sayt ee apunai gh ar jaahee. so that you may go to your true home with honor.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਦਨ  ਚਾਿਰ ਿਛਅ  ਛਾਿਡ  ਚਿਲਓ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang kal keert an gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: - O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ||15|| sloku ] (253-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay t ay bahur na aa-i-aa. ||15||

lines.english: He may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famousspiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;
lines.transliteration: at sund ar kuleen chat ur mukh  nyi-aanee Dh anvant .

lines.english: God. ||1|| pauVI ] (253-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: mirtak kahee-ahi naankaa jih pareet  nahee bh agvant . ||1|| but even so, he is looked upon as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord

lines.english: NGANGA: He may be a scholar of the six Shaastras.
lines.transliteration: nyany aa kh at saast ar ho-ay ny i-aataa.

lines.english: He may practice inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.
lines.transliteration: poorak kumbhak raychak karmaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He may practice spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritualcleansing baths.
lines.transliteration: nyi-aan Dh i-aan t irath isnaanee.

lines.english: He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in thewilderness like a hermit.
lines.transliteration: sompaak apras udi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਕੁਲੀਨ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਮੁਿਖ ਿਙਆਨੀ  ਧਨਵੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,
lines.transliteration: raam naam sang man nahee haytaa.
jo kachh keeno so-oo anayt aa. then everything he does is transitory.

lines.english: Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,
lines.transliteration: u-aa tay oot am gan-o chandalaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, if the Lord of the World abides in his mind. ||16|| sloku ] (253-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak jih man baseh gupaalaa. ||16||

lines.english: He wanders around in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to thedictates of his karma.
lines.transliteration: kunt chaar dah d is bharamay karam kirat  kee raykh .

lines.english: Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one'spre-ordained destiny. ||1|| pvVI ] (253-13) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sookh d ookh mukat  jon naanak likh i-o laykh . ||1||

lines.english: KAKKA: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: kakaa kaaran kartaa so-oo.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
lines.english: No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.
lines.transliteration: likhi-o laykh  na maytat  ko-oo.

lines.english: Nothing can be done a second time.
lines.transliteration: nahee hot kachh  do-oo baaraa.

lines.english: The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: karnaihaar na bhoolanhaaraa.

lines.english: To some, He Himself shows the Way.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo panth dikh aarai aapai.

lines.english: While He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo udi-aan bh armat  pachh utaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਿਰ  ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਭਰ੍ਮੇ ਕਰਮ  ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
lines.english: He Himself has set His own play in motion.
lines.transliteration: aapan khayl aap hee keeno.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਜੋਿਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਲਿਖਓ  ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ||17|| sloku ] (253-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jo jo deeno so naanak leeno. ||17||

lines.english: People continue to eat and consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are neverexhausted.
lines.transliteration: khaat  kharchat  bilchh at rahay toot na jaahi bh andaar.

lines.english: So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted.||1|| pauVI ] (253-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har har japat anayk jan naanak naahi sumaar. ||1||

lines.english: KHAKHA: The All-powerful Lord lacks nothing;
lines.transliteration: khakh aa kh oonaa kachh  nahee t is samrath kai paahi.
jo daynaa so d ay rahi-o bh aavai t ah tah jaahi. whatever He is to give, He continues to give - let anyone go anywhere he pleases.

lines.english: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: kharach kh ajaanaa naam Dh an i-aa bh agtan kee raas.

lines.english: With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive po ise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of excellence.
lines.transliteration: khimaa gareebee anad  sahj japat  raheh gunt aas.

lines.english: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, play happily and blossom forth.
lines.transliteration: khayleh bigsahi anad  si-o jaa ka-o hot  kirpaal.

lines.english: Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthyand beautiful.
lines.transliteration: sadeev ganeev suhaavanay raam naam garihi maal.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ  ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੀਨੋ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace suffer neither torture, norpain, nor punishment.
lines.transliteration: khayd  na dookh na daan t ih jaa ka-o nad ar karee.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ||18|| pMnw 254 sloku ] (254-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo parabh bh aani-aa pooree t inaa paree. ||18||

lines.english: See, that even by calculating and scheming in their minds, people must surely depart in the end.
lines.transliteration: gan min daykh hu manai maahi sarpar chalno log.

lines.english: Hopes and desires for transitory things are erased for the Gurmukh; O Nanak, theName alone brings true health. ||1|| pauVI ] (254-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aas anit gurmukh  mitai naanak naam arog. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਨ  ਿਮਿਨ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਰਪਰ  ਚਲਨੋ  ਲੋਗ ॥
lines.english: GAGGA: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with each and everybreath; meditate on Him forever.
lines.transliteration: gagaa gobid gun  ravhu saas saas jap neet .

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਅਿਨਤ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਅਰੋਗ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can you rely on the body? Do not delay, my friend;
lines.transliteration: kahaa bisaasaa dayh kaa bilam na kariho meet .
nah baarik nah jobnai nah birDhee kachh  banDh . there is nothing to stand in Death's way - neither in childhood, nor in youth, nor in oldage.

lines.punjabi: ਗਗਾ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹੁ ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਜਿਪ ਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: That time is not known, when the noose of Death shall come and fall on you.
lines.transliteration: oh bayraa nah boojhee-ai ja-o aa-ay parai jam fanDh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਿਬਸਾਸਾ  ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਿਬਲਮ  ਨ ਕਿਰਹੋ  ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: See, that even spiritual scholars, those who meditate, and those who are clever shallnot stay in this place.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee Dhi-aanee chat ur paykh  rahan nahee ih th aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਨਹ ਜੋਬਨੈ  ਨਹ ਿਬਰਧੀ  ਕਛੁ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Only the fool clings to that, which everyone else has abandoned and left behind.
lines.transliteration: chhaad chh aad saglee ga-ee moorh  tahaa laptaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਬੇਰਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਜਉ ਆਇ  ਪਰੈ ਜਮ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one who has such good destiny written on his forehead remembers the Lord in meditation.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad simrat  rahai jaahoo mast ak bh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਿਧਆਨੀ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਪੇਿਖ ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਹ ਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who obtain the Beloved Lord astheir Husband. ||19|| sloku ] (254-6) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak aa-ay safal tay jaa ka-o pari-ahi suhaag. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਿਡ  ਛਾਿਡ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਗਈ ਮੂੜ ਤਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched all the Shaastras and the Vedas, and they say nothing except this:
lines.transliteration: ghokh ay saast ar bayd  sabh  aan na kh athata-o ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਰਹੈ ਜਾਹੂ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗ ॥
lines.english: "In the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore, O Nanak, the One Lordalone exists."||1|| pauVI ] (254-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee hun  hovat  naanak aykai so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਏ  ਸਫਲ  ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਪਰ੍ਅਿਹ  ਸੁਹਾਗ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: GHAGHA: Put this into your mind, that there is no one except the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghagh aa gh aalhu maneh ayh bin har d oosar naahi.

lines.english: There never was, and there never shall be. He is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: nah ho-aa nah hovnaa jat kat  ohee samaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਘੋਖੇ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਬੇਦ ਸਭ ਆਨ  ਨ ਕਥਤਉ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You shall be absorbed into Him, O mind, if you come to His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ghooleh t a-o man ja-o aavahi sarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਹੁਿਣ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be of any real use to you.
lines.transliteration: naam tat  kal meh punharchanaa.

lines.english: So many work and slave continually, but they come to regret and repent in the end.
lines.transliteration: ghaal gh aal anik pachh utaavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਘਘਾ  ਘਾਲਹੁ ਮਨਿਹ  ਏਹ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਦੂਸਰ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, how can they find stability?
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagat  kahaa thit  paavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਹੋਆ  ਨਹ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They alone taste the supreme essence, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar,
lines.transliteration: ghol mahaa ras amrit  tih pee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘੂਲਿਹ  ਤਉ ਮਨ ਜਉ ਆਵਿਹ  ਸਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, unto whom the Lord, the Guru, gives it. ||20|| sloku ] (254-10) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak har gur jaa ka-o dee-aa. ||20||

lines.english: He has counted all the days and the breaths, and placed them in people's destiny;they do not increase or decrease one little bit.
lines.transliteration: nyan ghaalay sabh  divas saas nah badh an gh atan t il saar.

lines.english: Those who long to live in doubt and emotional attachment, O Nanak, are total fools.||1|| pauVI ] (254-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jeevan loreh bharam moh naanak t ay-oo gavaar. ||1||

lines.english: NGANGA: Death seizes those whom God has made into faithless cynics.
lines.transliteration: nyany aa ny araasai kaal t ih jo saakat  parabh  keen.

lines.english: They are born and they die, enduring countless incarnations; they do not realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
lines.transliteration: anik jon janmeh mareh aatam raam na cheen.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਿਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: They alone find spiritual wisdom and meditation,
lines.transliteration: nyi-aan Dh i-aan t aahoo ka-o aa-ay.
kar kirpaa jih aap divaa-ay. whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy;

lines.punjabi: ਙਿਣ ਘਾਲੇ  ਸਭ ਿਦਵਸ  ਸਾਸ ਨਹ ਬਢਨ  ਘਟਨ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: nyant ee ny anee nahee ko-oo chh ootai. no one is emancipated by counting and calculating.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਲੋਰਿਹ  ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇਊ ਗਵਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The vessel of clay shall surely break.
lines.transliteration: kaachee gaagar sarpar footai.

lines.english: They alone live, who, while alive, meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so jeevat jih jeevat  japi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਙੰਙਾ ਙਰ੍ਾਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਤਹ ਜੋ ਸਾਕਤ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਨ ॥
lines.english: They are respected, O Nanak, and do not remain hidden. ||21|| sloku ] (254-14) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-ay naanak nah chh api-aa. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨ ॥
lines.english: Focus your consciousness on His Lotus Feet, and the inverted lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.
lines.transliteration: chit chit va-o charn aarbind  ooDh  kaval bigsaaNt.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe Himself becomes manifest, O Nanak, through the Teachingsof the Saints. ||1|| pauVI ] (254-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-ay aapeh gobind  naanak sant  mataaNt. ||1||

lines.english: CHACHA: Blessed, blessed is that day, when I became attached to the Lord's LotusFeet.
lines.transliteration: chachaa charan kamal gur laagaa. Dhan Dh an u-aa d in sanjog sabh aagaa.

lines.english: After wandering around in the four quarters and the ten directions,
lines.transliteration: chaar kunt dah d is bharam aa-i-o.

lines.english: God showed His Mercy to me, and then I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee kirpaa t ab darsan paa-i-o.

lines.english: By pure lifestyle and meditation, all duality is removed.
lines.transliteration: chaar bichaar binsi-o sabh d oo-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes immaculate.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang man nirmal hoo-aa.

lines.english: Anxieties are forgotten, and the One Lord alone is seen,
lines.transliteration: chint bisaaree ayk d aristayt aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, by those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||22|| sloku ] (254-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak gi-aan anjan jih naytaraa. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਭਏ ਆਪਿਹ  ਗਿਬੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਮਤਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the mind is at peace, chanting and singing theGlorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: chhaat ee seet al man sukh ee chh ant gobid  gun gaa-ay.

lines.english: Show such Mercy, O God, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||1|| pauVI ] (254-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aisee kirpaa karahu parabh naanak d aas d asaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: CHHACHHA: I am Your child-slave.
lines.transliteration: chhachh aa chh ohray d aas tumaaray.

lines.english: I am the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves.
lines.transliteration: daas d aasan kay paaneehaaray.

lines.english: Chhachha: I long to become the dust under the feet of Your Saints. pMnw 255
lines.transliteration: chhachh aa chh aar hot  tayray sant aa.

lines.english: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God!
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa karahu bhagvant aa.

lines.english: I have given up my excessive cleverness and scheming,
lines.transliteration: chhaad si-aanap baho chat uraa-ee.
santan kee man tayk tikaa-ee. and I have taken the support of the Saints as my mind's support.

lines.english: Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,
lines.transliteration: chhaar kee put ree param gat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the Saints. ||23|| sloku ] (255-2) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa ka-o sant sahaa-ee. ||23||

lines.english: Practicing oppression and tyranny, he puffs himself up; he acts in corruption with hisfrail, perishable body.
lines.transliteration: jor julam fooleh ghano kaachee d ayh bikaar.

lines.english: He is bound by his egotistical intellect; O Nanak, salvation comes only through theNaam, the Name of the Lord. ||1|| pauVI ] (255-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh banDh an paray naanak naam chh utaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਿਹ  ਘਨੋ ਕਾਚੀ  ਦੇਹ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: JAJJA: When someone, in his ego, believes that he has become something,
lines.transliteration: jajaa jaanai ha-o kachh hoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baaDhi-o ji-o nalinee bh aram soo-aa. he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.

lines.english: When he believes, in his ego, that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,
lines.transliteration: ja-o jaanai ha-o bhagat  gi-aanee.
aagai thaakur t il nahee maanee. then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the Universe shall have no regard for him at all.

lines.english: When he believes himself to be a preacher,
lines.transliteration: ja-o jaanai mai kathnee kartaa.
bi-aapaaree basuDhaa ji-o firt aa. he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.

lines.english: But one who conquers his ego in the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jih ha-umai maaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, meets the Lord. ||24|| sloku ] (255-6) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ka-o milay muraaree. ||24||

lines.english: Rise early in the morning, and chant the Naam; worship and adore the Lord, night andday.
lines.transliteration: jhaalaagh ay uth  naam jap nis baasur aaraaDh .

lines.english: Anxiety shall not afflict you, O Nanak, and your misfortune shall vanish. ||1|| pauVI ] (255-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kaarHaa tujh ai na bi-aapa-ee naanak mitai upaaDh . ||1||

lines.english: JHAJHA: Your sorrows shall depart,
lines.transliteration: jhajhaa jhooran mitai t umaaro.
raam naam si-o kar bi-uhaaro. when you deal with the Lord's Name.

lines.punjabi: ਝਾਲਾਘੇ  ਉਿਠ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਿਨਿਸ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਆਰਾਿਧ  ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic dies in sorrow and pain;
lines.transliteration: jhoorat  jhoorat saakat  moo-aa.
jaa kai ridai hot  bhaa-o bee-aa. his heart is filled with the love of duality.

lines.english: Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,
lines.transliteration: jhareh kasamal paap t ayray manoo-aa.
amrit kathaa sat sang sunoo-aa. listening to the ambrosial speech in the Society of the Saints.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and wickedness fall away,
lines.transliteration: jhareh kaam kroDh  darustaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, from those who are blessed by the Mercy of the Lord of the World. ||25|| sloku ] (255-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa ka-o kirpaa gusaa-ee. ||25||

lines.english: You can try all sorts of things, but you still cannot remain here, my friend.
lines.transliteration: njatan karahu t um anik biDh  rahan na paavhu meet .

lines.english: But you shall live forevermore, O Nanak, if you vibrate and love the Naam, the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har. ||1|| pvVI ] (255-10) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jeevat rahhu har har bh ajahu naanak naam pareet . ||1||

lines.english: NYANYA: Know this as absolutely correct, that that this ordinary love shall come to anend.
lines.transliteration: njanjaa njaan aho d arirh sahee binas jaat  ayh hayt .

lines.english: You may count and calculate as much as you want, but you cannot count how manyhave arisen and departed.
lines.transliteration: gantee gan a-o na gan  saka-o ooth  siDhaaray kayt .

lines.english: Whoever I see shall perish. With whom should I associate?
lines.transliteration: njo paykh a-o so binast a-o kaa si-o karee-ai sang.

lines.english: Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.
lines.transliteration: njaan aho i-aa biDh  sahee chit  jhooth-o maa-i-aa rang.

lines.punjabi: ਞਤਨ  ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਿਨਕ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: He alone knows, and he alone is a Saint, who is free of doubt.
lines.transliteration: njanat so-ee sant  su-ay bh aram t ay keechit  bhinn.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਰਹਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is lifted up and out of the deep dark pit; the Lord is totally pleased with him.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay tih kadh ahu jih hovhu suparsan.

lines.english: God's Hand is All-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: njaa kai haath samrath t ay kaaran karnai jog.

lines.punjabi: ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਸਹੀ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਤ  ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the One, who joins us to Himself. ||26|| sloku ] (255-14) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tih ust at kara-o nj ahoo kee-o sanjog. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤੀ  ਗਣਉ  ਨ ਗਿਣ  ਸਕਉ  ਊਿਠ ਿਸਧਾਰੇ  ਕੇਤ ॥
lines.english: The bondage of birth and death is broken and peace is obtained, by serving the Holy.
lines.transliteration: tootay banDhan janam maran saaDh  sayv sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ  ਸੋ ਿਬਨਸਤਉ  ਕਾ ਿਸਉ ਕਰੀਐ  ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, may I never forget from my mind, the Treasure of Virtue, the SovereignLord of the Universe. ||1|| pauVI ] (255-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak manhu na beesrai gun niDh  gobid  raa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਸਹੀ ਿਚਤ  ਝੂਠਉ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Work for the One Lord; no one returns empty-handed from Him.
lines.transliteration: tahal karahu ta-o ayk kee jaa t ay baritha na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਤੇ ਕੀਿਚਤ  ਿਭੰਨ ॥
lines.english: When the Lord abides within your mind, body, mouth and heart, then whatever youdesire shall come to pass.
lines.transliteration: man tan mukh  hee-ai basai jo chaahhu so ho-ay.

lines.english: He alone obtains the Lord's service, and the Mansion of His Presence, unto whom the Holy Saint is compassionate.
lines.transliteration: tahal mahal taa ka-o milai jaa ka-o saaDh  kirpaal.

lines.punjabi: ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ  ਕਰਨੈ  ਜੋਗ ॥
lines.english: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, only when the Lord Himselfshows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  ta-o basai ja-o aapan hohi d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਹ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰਉ  ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ  ਸੰਜੋਗ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: I have searched and searched, across so many worlds, but without the Name, there isno peace.
lines.transliteration: tohay taahay baho bhavan bin naavai sukh  naahi.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death retreats from those who dwell in the Saadh Sangat.
lines.transliteration: taleh jaam kay doot  tih jo saaDh oo sang samaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ  ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Again and again, I am forever devoted to the Saints.
lines.transliteration: baar baar jaa-o sant sad kay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਰਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my sins from so long ago have been erased. ||27|| sloku ] (255-19) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak paap binaasay kad kay. ||27||

lines.english: Those beings, with whom the Lord is thoroughly pleased, meet with no obstacles atHis Door.
lines.transliteration: thaak na hot ee tinhu d ar jih hovhu suparsan.

lines.punjabi: ਟਹਲ  ਕਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings whom God has made His own, O Nanak, are blessed, so very blessed. ||1|| pMnw 256 pauVI ] (256-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jo jan parabh apunay karay naanak t ay Dh an Dh an. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਧਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: T'HAT'HA: Those who have abandoned all else, and who cling to the One Lord alone, do not make trouble for anyone's mind.
lines.transliteration: thathaa manoo-aa th aaheh naahee. jo sagal t i-aag aykeh laptaahee.

lines.english: Those who are totally absorbed and preoccupied with Maya are dead;
lines.transliteration: thahak th ahak maa-i-aa sang moo-ay.
u-aa kai kusal na kathoo hoo-ay. they do not find happiness anywhere.

lines.english: One who dwells in the Society of the Saints finds a great peace;
lines.transliteration: thaaNdh paree sant eh sang basi-aa.
amrit naam t ahaa jee-a rasi-aa. the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam becomes sweet to his soul.

lines.english: That humble being, who is pleasing to his Lord and Master
lines.transliteration: thaakur apunay jo jan bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: - O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ||28|| sloku ] (256-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak u-aa kaa man seetlaa-i-aa. ||28||

lines.english: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All- powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.
lines.transliteration: dand-ut band an anik baar sarab kalaa samrath.

lines.english: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give NanakYour Hand. ||1|| pauVI ] (256-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: dolan tay raakh o parabh oo naanak d ay kar hath. ||1||

lines.english: DADDA: This is not your true place; you must know where that place really is.
lines.transliteration: dadaa dayraa ih nahee jah dayraa tah jaan.

lines.english: You shall come to realize the way to that place, through the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: u-aa dayraa kaa sanjamo gur kai sabad pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਡੰਡਉਿਤ  ਬੰਦਨ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਾਰ ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਸਮਰਥ  ॥
lines.english: This place, here, is established by hard work,
lines.transliteration: i-aa dayraa ka-o saram kar ghaalai.

lines.punjabi: ਡੋਲਨ  ਤੇ ਰਾਖਹੁਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa tasoo nahee sang chaalai. but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

lines.english: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,
lines.transliteration: u-aa dayraa kee so mit jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਡਡਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o darisat pooran bh agvaanai. upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.

lines.punjabi: ਉਆ  ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
lines.transliteration: dayraa nihchal sach saaDhsang paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਆ  ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਿਰ ਘਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29|| sloku ] (256-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan nah dolaa-i-aa. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਚਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can placeany obstacle in His Way.
lines.transliteration: dhaahan laagay Dh aram raa-ay kineh na gh aali-o banDh .

lines.english: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1|| pauVI ] (256-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ubray jap haree saaDhsang san-banDh . ||1||

lines.english: DHADHA: Where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within yourown mind.
lines.transliteration: dhadh aa dh oodhat kah firahu dh oodhan i-aa man maahi.

lines.english: God is with you, so why do you wander around from forest to forest?
lines.transliteration: sang tuhaarai parabh  basai ban ban kahaa firaahi.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, tear down the mound of yourfrightful, egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: dhayree Dh ahhu saaDh sang ahaN-buDh  bikraal.

lines.english: You shall find peace, and abide in intuitive bliss; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan, you shall be delighted.
lines.transliteration: sukh paavhu sehjay bashu d arsan d aykh nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਹਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਿਕਨਿਹ  ਨ ਘਾਿਲਓ  ਬੰਧ ॥
lines.english: One who has such a mound as this, dies and suffers the pain of reincarnation throughthe womb.
lines.transliteration: dhayree jaamai jam marai garabh  jon d ukh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਜਿਪ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਸਨਬੰਧ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who is intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in egotism, selfishnessand conceit, shall continue coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: moh magan laptat rahai ha-o ha-o aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the Holy Saints; I have come to theirSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: dhahat  dhahat ab dh eh paray saaDh  janaa sarnaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਢਢਾ  ਢੂਢਤ  ਕਹ ਿਫਰਹੁਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: God has cut away the noose of my pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself.||30|| sloku ] (256-13) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: dukh kay faahay kaati-aa naanak lee-ay samaa-ay. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਬਸੈ ਬਨੁਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਿਫਰਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of theUniverse, O Nanak
lines.transliteration: jah saaDhoo gobid  bhajan keert an naanak neet .

lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o n aa tooN nah chh uteh nikat na jaa-ee-ahu d oot. ||1|| - the Righteous Judge says, "Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, orelse neither you nor I shall escape!"||1|| pauVI ] (256-14) pa-orhee.

lines.english: NANNA: One who conquers his own soul, wins the battle of life.
lines.transliteration: naanaa ran  tay seejh ee-ai aat am jeet ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ ਜਿਮ ਮਰੈ ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who dies, while fighting against egotism and alienation, becomes sublime and beautiful.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai an si-o lar marai so sobhaa d oo ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਲਪਟਤ  ਰਹੈ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who eradicates his ego, remains dead while yet alive, through the Teachings ofthe Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: manee mitaa-ay jeevat  marai gur pooray upd ays.

lines.punjabi: ਢਹਤ  ਢਹਤ  ਅਬ ਢਿਹ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He conquers his mind, and meets the Lord; he is dressed in robes of honor.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa jeetai har milai t ih soort an vays.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: He does not claim anything as his own; the One Lord is his Anchor and Support.
lines.transliteration: naa ko jaan ai aapn o aykeh tayk aDh aar.

lines.english: Night and day, he continually contemplates the Almighty, Infinite Lord God.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas simrat  rahai so parabh  purakh  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਭਜਨੁਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma of the deeds he does.
lines.transliteration: rayn sagal i-aa man karai ay-oo karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਣਾ ਹਉ ਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਣਹ ਛੁਟਿਹ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he attains everlasting peace. ONanak, such is his pre-ordained destiny. ||31|| sloku ] (256-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhai sad aa sukh  naanak likh i-aa paa-ay. ||31||

lines.english: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an arpa-o t isai parabh oo milaavai mohi.

lines.punjabi: ਣਾਣਾ  ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ  ਆਤਮ  ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death doesnot see me any longer. ||1|| pauVI ] (256-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak bharam bh a-o kaatee-ai chookai jam kee joh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਅਨ ਿਸਉ ਲਿਰ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: tataa taa si-o pareet  kar gun  niDh gobid  raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਣੀ ਿਮਟਾਇ  ਜੀਵਤ  ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ  ॥
lines.english: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched. pMnw 257
lines.transliteration: fal paavahi man baachh-t ay tapat tuhaaree jaa-ay.

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.
lines.transliteration: taraas mitai jam panth kee jaas basai man naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਿਮਟੈ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: gat paavahi mat  ho-ay pargaas mahlee paavahi th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.
lines.transliteration: taahoo sang na Dh an chalai garih joban nah raaj.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ  ਜੋਬਨ  ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.
lines.transliteration: satsang simrat  rahhu ihai t uhaarai kaaj.

lines.english: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.
lines.transliteration: taataa kachh oo na ho-ee hai ja-o t aap nivaarai aap.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਤਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਿਨਵਾਰੈ  ਆਪ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32|| sloku ] (257-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: paratipaalai naanak hameh aapeh maa-ee baap. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਮਿਹ  ਆਪਿਹ  ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways; but they are not satisfied, andtheir thirst is not quenched.
lines.transliteration: thaakay baho biDh gh aaltay taripat  na tarisnaa laath.

lines.english: Gathering in and hoarding what they can, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but thewealth of Maya does not go with them in the end. ||1|| pauVI ] (257-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sanch sanch saakat moo-ay naanak maa-i-aa na saath. ||1||

lines.english: T'HAT'HA: Nothing is permanent - why do you stretch out your feet?
lines.transliteration: thathaa thir ko-oo nahee kaa-ay pasaarahu paav.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਚ ਸੰਿਚ ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ  ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful actions as you chase after Maya.
lines.transliteration: anik banch bal chhal karahu maa-i-aa ayk upaav.

lines.english: You work to fill up your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.
lines.transliteration: thailee sanchahu saram karahu thaak parahu gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਥਥਾ ਿਥਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇ  ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
lines.english: But this shall be of no use to you at all at that very last instant.
lines.transliteration: man kai kaam na aavee antay a-osar baar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਬੰਚ ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ  ॥
lines.english: You shall find stability only by vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe, and acceptingthe Teachings of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: thit paavhu gobid  bhajahu sant eh kee sikh  layho.

lines.punjabi: ਥੈਲੀ  ਸੰਚਹੁਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਰਹ ੁ ਥਾਿਕ  ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!
lines.transliteration: pareet karahu sad  ayk si-o i-aa saachaa asnayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ  ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.english: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. All ways and means are in His Hands alone.
lines.transliteration: kaaran karan karaavano sabh biDh  aykai haath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਿਤ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਭਜਹੁ ਸੰਤਹ  ਕੀ ਿਸਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, I am just a helplesscreature. ||33|| sloku ] (257-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavhu t it tit lageh naanak jant  anaath. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਕਰਹ ੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਿਸਉ ਇਆ  ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.
lines.transliteration: daasah ayk nihaari-aa sabh  kachh  dayvanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਨ  ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨੋ  ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: They continue to contemplate Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their Support. ||1|| pauVI ] (257-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: saas saas simrat raheh naanak d aras aDh aar. ||1||

lines.english: DADDA: The One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.
lines.transliteration: dadaa daataa ayk hai sabh  ka-o d ayvanhaar.

lines.english: There is no limit to His Giving. His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.
lines.transliteration: dayNday tot na aavee agnat  bharay bh andaar.

lines.english: The Great Giver is alive forever.
lines.transliteration: dainhaar sad  jeevanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ  ਅਧਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?
lines.transliteration: man moorakh ki-o t aahi bisaaraa.

lines.english: No one is at fault, my friend.
lines.transliteration: dos nahee kaahoo ka-o meet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਦਾ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh banDh parabh  keetaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਅਗਨਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself removes the pains of the Gurmukh; O Nanak, he is fulfilled. ||34|| sloku ] (257-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: darad  nivaareh jaa kay aapay. naanak t ay tay gurmukh  Dharaapay. ||34||

lines.english: Dhar jee-aray ik tayk t oo laahi bidaanee aas. O my soul, grasp the Support of the One Lord; give up your hopes in others.
O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your affairs shall beresolved. ||1|| pauVI ] (257-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai kaaraj aavai raas. ||1||

lines.english: DhaDh aa Dh aavat  ta-o mitai sat sang ho-ay baas. DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society ofthe Saints.
Dhur t ay kirpaa karahu aap t a-o ho-ay maneh pargaas. If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.
Dhan saachaa t ay-oo sach saahaa. Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.
The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.
lines.transliteration: har har poonjee naam bihaasaa.

lines.english: Dheeraj jas sobh aa tih bani-aa. Patience, glory and honor come to those

lines.punjabi: ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ  ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ ਲਾਿਹ  ਿਬਡਾਨੀ  ਆਸ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam sarvan jih suni-aa. who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.english: That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jih gh at rahay samaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35|| sloku ] (257-17) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tih jan milee vadaa-ee. ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਧਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ  ਤਉ ਿਮਟੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who chants the Naam, and meditates on the Naam with love inwardlyand outwardly,
lines.transliteration: naanak naam naam jap japi-aa antar baahar rang.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਰ ਤੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਿਹ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai updaysi-aa narak naahi saaDh sang. ||1|| receives the Teachings from the Perfect Guru; he joins the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, and does not fall into hell. ||1|| pauVI ] (257-18) pa-orhee.

lines.english: NANNA: Those whose minds and bodies are filled with the Naam, the Name of theLord, shall not fall into hell.
lines.transliteration: nannaa narak pareh tay naahee. jaa kai man t an naam basaahee.

lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Naam,
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan gurmukh  jo japt ay.
bikh maa-i-aa meh naa o-ay kh aptay. are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.

lines.english: Those who have been given the Mantra of the Naam by the Guru, shall not be turned away. pMnw 258
lines.transliteration: nannaakaar na hotaa t aa kaho. naam mant ar gur d eeno jaa kaho.

lines.english: They are filled and fulfilled with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, the Treasure of sublime wealth;
lines.transliteration: niDh niDh aan har amrit  pooray.
