lines.english: O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates for them. ||36|| sloku ] (258-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: tah baajay naanak anhad  tooray. ||36||

lines.english: The Guru, the Supreme Lord God, preserved my honor, when I renounced hypocrisy,emotional attachment and corruption.
lines.transliteration: pat raakh ee gur paarbarahm t aj parpanch moh bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਤਿਜ ਪਰਪੰਚ  ਮੋਹ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, worship and adore the One, who has no end or limitation. ||1|| pauVI ] (258-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak so-oo aaraaDhee-ai ant  na paaraavaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਊ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: PAPPA: He is beyond estimation; His limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: papaa parmit paar na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Sovereign Lord King is inaccessible;
lines.transliteration: patit paavan agam har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is the Purifier of sinners. Millions of sinners are purified;
lines.transliteration: hot puneet  kot apraaDh oo.
amrit naam jaapeh mil saaDh oo. they meet the Holy, and chant the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.english: Deception, fraud and emotional attachment are eliminated,
lines.transliteration: parpach Dharoh moh mitnaaee.
jaa ka-o raakho aap gusaa-ee. by those who are protected by the Lord of the World.

lines.english: He is the Supreme King, with the royal canopy above His Head.
lines.transliteration: paatisaahu chh atar sir so-oo.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||37|| sloku ] (258-5) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak doosar avar na ko-oo. ||37||

lines.english: The noose of Death is cut, and one's wanderings cease; victory is obtained, when one conquers his own mind.
lines.transliteration: faahay kaatay mitay gavan fatih bh a-ee man jeet .

lines.english: O Nanak, eternal stability is obtained from the Guru, and one's day-to-day wanderingscease. ||1|| pauVI ] (258-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur tay thit  paa-ee firan mitay nit  neet. ||1||

lines.english: FAFFA: After wandering and wandering for so long, you have come;
lines.transliteration: fafaa firat firat  too aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਿਮਟੇ ਗਵਨ  ਫਿਤਹ  ਭਈ ਮਿਨ ਜੀਤ  ॥
lines.transliteration: darulabh  dayh kalijug meh paa-i-aa. in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, you have obtained this human body, so very difficult toobtain.

lines.english: This opportunity shall not come into your hands again.
lines.transliteration: fir i-aa a-osar charai na haathaa.

lines.english: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.
lines.transliteration: naam japahu ta-o katee-ah faasaa.

lines.english: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation over and over again,
lines.transliteration: fir fir aavan jaan na ho-ee.
aykeh ayk japahu jap so-ee. if you chant and meditate on the One and Only Lord.

lines.english: Shower Your Mercy, O God, Creator Lord,
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa parabh karnaihaaray.

lines.english: Shalok:
lines.transliteration: mayl layho naanak baychaaray. ||38|| and unite poor Nanak with Yourself. ||38|| sloku ] (258-9) salok.

lines.english: Hear my prayer, O Supreme Lord God, Merciful to the meek, Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: bin-o sunhu tum paarbarahm d een d a-i-aal gupaal.

lines.english: The dust of the feet of the Holy is peace, wealth, great enjoyment and pleasure forNanak. ||1|| pauVI ] (258-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sukh sampai baho bh og ras naanak saaDh  ravaal. ||1||

lines.english: BABBA: One who knows God is a Brahmin.
lines.transliteration: babaa barahm jaanat t ay barahmaa.

lines.english: A Vaishnaav is one who, as Gurmukh, lives the righteous life of Dharma.
lines.transliteration: baisno tay gurmukh  such Dh armaa.

lines.english: One who eradicates his own evil is a brave warrior;
lines.transliteration: beeraa aapan buraa mitaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਉ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taahoo buraa nikat nahee aavai. no evil even approaches him.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Man is bound by the chains of his own egotism, selfishness and conceit.
lines.transliteration: baaDhi-o aapan ha-o ha-o banDh aa.

lines.english: The spiritually blind place the blame on others.
lines.transliteration: dos d ayt aagah ka-o anDh aa.

lines.english: But all debates and clever tricks are of no use at all.
lines.transliteration: baat cheet  sabh  rahee si-aanap.

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone comes to know, whom the Lord inspires to know. ||39|| sloku ] (258-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jisahi janaavhu so jaanai naanak. ||39||

lines.english: The Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of sin and sorrow - enshrine that Lord in yourmind.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh anjan agh  dookh naas maneh araaDh  haray.

lines.english: One whose heart abides in the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, does not wanderaround in doubt. ||1|| pauVI ] (258-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: satsang jih rid  basi-o naanak t ay na bh aramay. ||1||

lines.english: BHABHA: Cast out your doubt and delusion
lines.transliteration: bhabh aa bh aram mitaavhu apnaa.
i-aa sansaar sagal hai supnaa. - this world is just a dream.

lines.english: The angelic beings, goddesses and gods are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: bharmay sur nar d ayvee d ayvaa.

lines.english: The Siddhas and seekers, and even Brahma are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: bharmay siDh  saaDh ik barahmayvaa.

lines.english: Wandering around, deluded by doubt, people are ruined.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram maanukh  dahkaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਘ  ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸ ਮਨਿਹ  ਅਰਾਿਧ  ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: It is so very difficult and treacherous to cross over this ocean of Maya.
lines.transliteration: dutar mahaa bikh am ih maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗ  ਿਜਹ ਿਰਦ ਬਿਸਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਨ ਭਰ੍ਮੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That Gurmukh who has eradicated doubt, fear and attachment,
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh aram bh ai moh mitaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, obtains supreme peace. ||40|| sloku ] (258-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tayh param sukh  paa-i-aa. ||40||

lines.english: Maya clings to the mind, and causes it to waver in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa dolai baho biDhee man lapti-o t ih sang.

lines.english: When You, O Lord, restrain someone from asking for wealth, then, O Nanak, he comes to love the Name. ||1|| pauVI ] (258-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: maagan tay jih t um rakh ahu so naanak naameh rang. ||1||

lines.english: MAMMA: The beggar is so ignorant
lines.transliteration: mamaa maaganhaar i-aanaa.
daynhaar d ay rahi-o sujaanaa. - the Great Giver continues to give. He is All-knowing.

lines.english: Whatever He gives, He gives once and for all.
lines.transliteration: jo deeno so aykeh baar.

lines.english: O foolish mind, why do you complain, and cry out so loud?
lines.transliteration: man moorakh kah karahi pukaar.

lines.english: Whenever you ask for something, you ask for worldly things;
lines.transliteration: ja-o maageh ta-o maageh bee-aa.
jaa tay kusal na kaahoo thee-aa. no one has obtained happiness from these.

lines.english: If you must ask for a gift, then ask for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: maagan maag ta aykeh maag.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਡੋਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਧੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਪਿਟਓ ਿਤਹ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by Him, you shall be saved. ||41|| pMnw 259 slok ] (259-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa tay pareh paraag. ||41||

lines.english: Perfect is the intellect, and most distinguished is the reputation, of those whose mindsare filled with the Mantra of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: mat pooree parDh aan tay gur pooray man mant .

lines.english: Those who come to know their God, O Nanak, are very fortunate. ||1|| pauVI ] (259-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jih jaani-o parabh aapunaa naanak t ay bh agvant . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨ  ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
lines.english: MAMMA: Those who understand God's mystery are satisfied, joining the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: mamaa jaahoo maram pachhaanaa. bh aytat saaDh sang pat ee-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੁਨਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They look upon pleasure and pain as the same.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  u-aa kai samat  beechaaraa.

lines.english: They are exempt from incarnation into heaven or hell.
lines.transliteration: narak surag rahat a-ut aaraa.

lines.english: They live in the world, and yet they are detached from it.
lines.transliteration: taahoo sang t aahoo nirlaypaa.

lines.english: The Sublime Lord, the Primal Being, is totally pervading each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: pooran ghat gh at purakh  bisaykh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਉਆ  ਕੈ ਸਮਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In His Love, they find peace.
lines.transliteration: u-aa ras meh u-aahoo sukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, Maya does not cling to them at all. ||42|| sloku ] (259-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak lipat nahee t ih maa-i-aa. ||42||

lines.english: Listen, my dear friends and companions: without the Lord, there is no salvation.
lines.transliteration: yaar meet sun saajanhu bin har chh ootan naahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who falls at the Feet of the Guru, has his bonds cut away. ||1|| pvVI ] (259-5) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tih banDh an katay gur kee charnee paahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਆ  ਰਸ ਮਿਹ ਉਆਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: YAYYA: People try all sorts of things,
lines.transliteration: ya-yaa jatan karat  baho biDh ee-aa.
ayk naam bin kah la-o siDhee-aa. but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?

lines.english: Those efforts, by which emancipation may be attained
lines.transliteration: yaahoo jatan kar hot  chhutaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਯਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਿਨ ਸਾਜਨਹੁਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: u-aahoo jatan saaDh  sangaaraa. - those efforts are made in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everyone has this idea of salvation,
lines.transliteration: yaa ubran Dhaarai sabh  ko-oo.
u-aahi japay bin ubar na ho-oo. but without meditation, there can be no salvation.

lines.english: The All-powerful Lord is the boat to carry us across.
lines.transliteration: yaahoo taran t aaran samraathaa.

lines.english: O Lord, please save these worthless beings!
lines.transliteration: raakh layho nirgun narnaathaa.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs in thought, word and deed
lines.transliteration: man bach karam jih aap janaa-ee.

lines.english: - O Nanak, their intellect is enlightened. ||43|| sloku ] (259-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tih mat  pargatee aa-ee. ||43||

lines.english: Do not be angry with anyone else; look within your own self instead.
lines.transliteration: ros na kaahoo sang karahu aapan aap beechaar.

lines.english: Be humble in this world, O Nanak, and by His Grace you shall be carried across. ||1|| pauVI ] (259-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ho-ay nimaanaa jag rahhu naanak nadree paar. ||1||

lines.english: RARRA: Be the dust under the feet of all.
lines.transliteration: raaraa rayn hot sabh  jaa kee.

lines.english: Give up your egotistical pride, and the balance of your account shall be written off.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan chh utai tayree baakee.

lines.english: Then, you shall win the battle in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: ran dargahi t a-o seejh eh bh aa-ee.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ja-o gurmukh raam naam liv laa-ee.

lines.english: Your evil ways shall be slowly and steadily blotted out, by the Shabad, the Incomparable Word of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: rahat rahat  reh jaahi bikaaraa. gur pooray kai sabad  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ  ਆਪੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: You shall be imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Nectar of theNaam.
lines.transliteration: raatay rang naam ras maat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਿਨਮਾਨਾ  ਜਿਗ ਰਹਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord, the Guru, has given this gift. ||44|| sloku ] (259-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak har gur keenee daat ay. ||44||

lines.english: The afflictions of greed, falsehood and corruption abide in this body.
lines.transliteration: laalach jhooth  bikhai bi-aaDh  i-aa d ayhee meh baas.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਰਾ  ਰੇਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, O Nanak, the Gurmukh abides in peace. ||1|| pauVI ] (259-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har har amrit gurmukh  pee-aa naanak sookh  nivaas. ||1||

lines.english: LALLA: One who takes the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: lalaa laava-o a-ukhaDh  jaahoo.
dookh  darad tih miteh kh inaahoo. is cured of his pain and sorrow in an instant.

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with the medicine of the Naam,
lines.transliteration: naam a-ukhaDh  jih rid ai hitaavai.
taahi rog supnai nahee aavai. is not infested with disease, even in his dreams.

lines.english: The medicine of the Lord's Name is in all hearts, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har a-ukhaDh  sabh  ghat hai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows how to prepare it.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray bin biDh na banaa-ee.

lines.english: When the Perfect Guru gives the instructions to prepare it,
lines.transliteration: gur poorai sanjam kar dee-aa.

lines.english: Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak ta-o fir d ookh na thee-aa. ||45|| then, O Nanak, one does not suffer illness again. ||45|| sloku ] (259-16) salok.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚ  ਝੂਠ ਿਬਖੈ ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਇਆ  ਦੇਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਬਾਸ ॥
lines.english: The All-pervading Lord is in all places. There is no place where He does not exist.
lines.transliteration: vaasudayv sarbat ar mai oon na kat hoo th aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੂਿਖ ਿਨਵਾਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Inside and outside, He is with you. O Nanak, what can be hidden from Him? ||1|| pauVI ] (259-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sang hai naanak kaa-ay d uraa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: WAWWA: Do not harbor hatred against anyone.
lines.transliteration: vavaa vair na karee-ai kaahoo.

lines.english: In each and every heart, God is contained.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar barahm samaahoo.

lines.english: The All-pervading Lord is permeating and pervading the oceans and the land.
lines.transliteration: vaasudayv jal thal meh ravi-aa.

lines.english: How rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, sing of Him.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad virlai hee gavi-aa.

lines.english: Hatred and alienation depart from those
lines.transliteration: vair viroDh mitay t ih man t ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਸਭ ਘਟ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har keertan gurmukh  jo sunt ay. who, as Gurmukh, listen to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who becomes Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and rises above all social classes and status symbols. ||46|| pMnw 260 sloku ] (260-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: varan chihan saglah tay raht aa. naanak har har gurmukh  jo kaht aa. ||46||

lines.english: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the foolish, ignorant, faithless cynic wasteshis life.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karat bihaanee-aa saakat  mugaDh  ajaan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੋ ਕਹਤਾ  ॥੪੬॥
lines.english: He dies in agony, like one dying of thirst; O Nanak, this is because of the deeds hehas done. ||1|| pauVI ] (260-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: rharh ak mu-ay ji-o t arikhaavaNt naanak kirat  kamaan. ||1||

lines.english: RARRA: Conflict is eliminated in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
lines.transliteration: rhaarh aa rhaarh mitai sang saaDh oo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹਾਨੀਆ ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਅਜਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Dharma.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam t at naam araaDh oo. meditate in adoration on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the essence of karma and

lines.english: When the Beautiful Lord abides within the heart,
lines.transliteration: roorho jih basi-o rid  maahee.
u-aa kee rhaarh  mitat  binsaahee. conflict is erased and ended.

lines.english: The foolish, faithless cynic picks arguments
lines.transliteration: rhaarh  karat  saakat  gaavaaraa.
jayh hee-ai ahaN-buDh bikaaraa. - his heart is filled with corruption and egotistical intellect.

lines.english: RARRA: For the Gurmukh, conflict is eliminated in an instant, O Nanak, through theTeachings. ||47|| sloku ] (260-5) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: rhaarh aa gurmukh  rhaarh mitaa-ee. nimakh  maahi naanak samjh aa-ee. ||47||

lines.english: O mind, grasp the Support of the Holy Saint; give up your clever arguments.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kee man ot gahu ukat  si-aanap t i-aag.

lines.english: One who has the Guru's Teachings within his mind, O Nanak, has good destinyinscribed upon his forehead. ||1|| pauVI ] (260-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur deekh i-aa jih man basai naanak mast ak bh aag. ||1||

lines.english: SASSA: I have now entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am so tired of reciting the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: sasaa saran paray ab haaray. saastar simrit  bayd  pookaaray.

lines.english: I searched and searched and searched, and now I have come to realize,
lines.transliteration: soDhat  soDh at soDh  beechaaraa.
bin har bhajan nahee chh utkaaraa. that without meditating on the Lord, there is no emancipation.

lines.english: With each and every breath, I make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: saas saas ham bhoolanhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ਉਕਿਤ  ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਿਤਆਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: You are All-powerful, endless and infinite.
lines.transliteration: tum samrath agnat  apaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਿਖਆ  ਿਜਹ ਮਿਨ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me, Merciful Lord!
lines.transliteration: saran paray kee raakh d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Nanak is Your child, O Lord of the World. ||48|| sloku ] (260-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tumray baal gupaalaa. ||48||

lines.english: When selfishness and conceit are erased, peace comes, and the mind and body are healed.
lines.transliteration: khudee mitee t ab sukh  bha-ay man t an bh a-ay arog.

lines.english: O Nanak, then He comes to be seen - the One who is worthy of praise. ||1|| pauVI ] (260-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak daristee aa-i-aa ust at karnai jog. ||1||

lines.english: KHAKHA: Praise and extol Him on High,
lines.transliteration: khakh aa kh araa saraaha-o t aahoo.
jo khin meh oonay subh ar bharaahoo. who fills the empty to over-flowing in an instant.

lines.english: When the mortal being becomes totally humble,
lines.transliteration: kharaa nimaanaa hot  paraanee.
an-din jaapai parabh  nirbaanee. then he meditates night and day on God, the Detached Lord of Nirvaanaa.

lines.english: If it pleases the Will of our Lord and Master, then He blesses us with peace.
lines.transliteration: bhaavai kh asam t a u-aa sukh  daytaa.

lines.english: Such is the Infinite, Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aiso aagnataa.

lines.english: He forgives countless sins in an instant.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh kh atay kh in bakh sanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਦੀ ਿਮਟੀ  ਤਬ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||49|| sloku ] (260-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib sadaa d a-i-aaraa. ||49||

lines.english: I speak the Truth - listen, O my mind: take to the Sanctuary of the Sovereign LordKing.
lines.transliteration: sat kaha-o sun man mayray saran parahu har raa-ay.

lines.english: Give up all your clever tricks, O Nanak, and He shall absorb you into Himself. ||1|| pauVI ] (260-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ukat si-aanap sagal t i-aag naanak la-ay samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: SASSA: Give up your clever tricks, you ignorant fool!
lines.transliteration: sasaa si-aanap chhaad i-aanaa.

lines.english: God is not pleased with clever tricks and commands.
lines.transliteration: hikmat hukam na parabh  patee-aanaa.

lines.english: You may practice a thousand forms of cleverness,
lines.transliteration: sahas bhaat  karahi chat uraa-ee.
sang tuhaarai ayk na jaa-ee. but not even one will go along with you in the end.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ  ਤ ਉਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on that Lord, that Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: so-oo so-oo jap din raat ee.

lines.english: O soul, He alone shall go along with you.
lines.transliteration: ray jee-a chalai tuhaarai saathee.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord Himself commits to the service of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: saaDh sayvaa laavai jih aapai.

lines.english: O Nanak, are not afflicted by suffering. ||50|| sloku ] (260-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ka-o d ookh na bi-aapai. ||50||

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and keeping it in your mind, you shall findpeace.
lines.transliteration: har har mukh t ay bolnaa man vooth ai sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਕਹਉ  ਸੁਿਨ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਿਨ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord is pervading everywhere; He is contained in all spaces andinterspaces. ||1|| pauVI ] (260-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh meh rav rahi-aa thaan thanant ar so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Behold! The Lord God is totally pervading each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: hayra-o ghat gh at sagal kai poor rahay bh agvaan.

lines.english: Forever and ever, the Guru's wisdom has been the Destroyer of pain.
lines.transliteration: hovat aa-ay sad  sadeev d ukh bhanjan gur gi-aan.

lines.english: Quieting the ego, ecstasy is obtained. Where the ego does not exist, God Himself is there.
lines.transliteration: ha-o chhutkai ho-ay anand t ih ha-o naahee t ah aap.

lines.english: The pain of birth and death is removed, by the power of the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: hatay d ookh janmah maran sat sang part aap.

lines.english: He becomes kind to those who lovingly enshrine the Name of the Merciful Lord within their hearts, in the Society of the Saints. pMnw 261
lines.transliteration: hit kar naam d arirhai da-i-aalaa. sant eh sang hot  kirpaalaa.

lines.english: In this world, no one accomplishes anything by himself.
lines.transliteration: orai kachhoo na kinhoo kee-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, everything is done by God. ||51|| sloku ] (261-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kachh  parabh  tay hoo-aa. ||51||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇ ਹੂਆ ॥੫੧॥
lines.english: Because of the balance due on his account, he can never be released; he makes mistakes each and every moment.
lines.transliteration: laykhai kat eh na chh ootee-ai kh in khin bhoolanhaar.

lines.english: O Forgiving Lord, please forgive me, and carry Nanak across. ||1|| pauVI ] (261-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bakhsanhaar bakh as lai naanak paar ut aar. ||1||

lines.english: The sinner is unfaithful to himself; he is ignorant, with shallow understanding.
lines.transliteration: loon haraamee gunahgaar baygaanaa alap mat .

lines.punjabi: ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not know the essence of all, the One who gave him body, soul and peace.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind jin sukh d ee-ay t aahi na jaanat  tat.

lines.english: For the sake of personal profit and Maya, he goes out, searching in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: laahaa maa-i-aa kaarnay dah d is dhoodhan jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ  ਬੇਗਾਨਾ  ਅਲਪ  ਮਿਤ ॥
lines.english: He does not enshrine the Generous Lord God, the Great Giver, in his mind, even foran instant.
lines.transliteration: dayvanhaar d aataar parabh  nimakh  na maneh basaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਤਾਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਨਤ  ਤਤ ॥
lines.english: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment - these are what he collectswithin his mind.
lines.transliteration: laalach jhooth  bikaar moh i-aa sampai man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਨੇ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਢੂਢਨ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The worst perverts, thieves and slanderers - he passes his time with them.
lines.transliteration: lampat chor nindak mahaa t inhoo sang bihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ  ਦਾਤਾਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਮਨਿਹ  ਬਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But if it pleases You, Lord, then You forgive the counterfeit along with the genuine.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t aa bakh as laihi kh otay sang kh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚ  ਝੂਠ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮੋਹ ਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Supreme Lord God, then even a stone will float on water. ||52|| sloku ] (261-6) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaavai paarbarahm paahan neer t aray. ||52||

lines.english: Eating, drinking, playing and laughing, I have wandered through countlessincarnations.
lines.transliteration: khaat  peet khaylat hasat  bharmay janam anayk.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈਿਹ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Please, God, lift me up and out of the terrifying world-ocean. Nanak seeks YourSupport. ||1|| pauVI ] (261-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhavjal t ay kaadh ahu parabh oo naanak t ayree tayk. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਾਹਨ  ਨੀਿਰ  ਤਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
lines.english: Playing, playing, I have been reincarnated countless times, but this has only broughtpain.
lines.transliteration: khaylat  khaylat aa-i-o anik jon d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: Troubles are removed, when one meets with the Holy; immerse yourself in the Wordof the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: khayd  mitay saaDh oo milat  satgur bachan samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ  ਹਸਤ  ਭਰਮੇ  ਜਨਮ  ਅਨੇਕ  ॥
lines.english: Adopting an attitude of tolerance, and gathering truth, partake of the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name.
lines.transliteration: khimaa gahee sach sanchi-o kh aa-i-o amrit  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਜਲ  ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When my Lord and Master showed His Great Mercy, I found peace, happiness andbliss.
lines.transliteration: kharee kirpaa th aakur bh a-ee anad  sookh  bisraam.

lines.english: My merchandise has arrived safely, and I have made a great profit; I have returnedhome with honor.
lines.transliteration: khayp nibaahee bahut  laabh  ghar aa-ay pat ivant.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਲਤ  ਖੇਲਤ  ਆਇਓ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has given me great consolation, and the Lord God has come to meet me.
lines.transliteration: kharaa d ilaasaa gur d ee-aa aa-ay milay bh agvant .

lines.english: He Himself has acted, and He Himself acts. He was in the past, and He shall be in thefuture.
lines.transliteration: aapan kee-aa karahi aap aagai paachhai aap.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਮਾ  ਗਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਿਚਓ  ਖਾਇਓ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the One, who is contained in each and every heart. ||53|| sloku ] (261-11) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak so-oo saraahee-ai je ghat gh at rahi-aa bi-aap. ||53||

lines.english: O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord, Ocean of compassion.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay parabh sarnaagat ee kirpaa niDh  da-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਪ ਿਨਬਾਹੀ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲਾਭ ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ਪਿਤਵੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is filled with the One Word of the Lord, O Nanak, becomes totallyblissful. ||1|| pauVI ] (261-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ayk akhar har man basat  naanak hot  nihaal. ||1||

lines.english: In the Word, God established the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: akhar meh t aribhavan parabh  Dhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਗੈ  ਪਾਛੈ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: Created from the Word, the Vedas are contemplated.
lines.transliteration: akhar kar kar bayd  beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਊ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਬਆਿਪ  ॥੫੩॥
lines.english: From the Word, came the Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: akhar saast ar simrit  puraanaa.

lines.english: From the Word, came the sound current of the Naad, speeches and explanations.
lines.transliteration: akhar naad  kathan vakh -yaanaa.

lines.english: From the Word, comes the way of liberation from fear and doubt.
lines.transliteration: akhar mukat  jugat  bhai bharmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਅਖਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਬਸਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੋਤ ਿਨਹਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From the Word, come religious rituals, karma, sacredness and Dharma.
lines.transliteration: akhar karam kirat  such Dh armaa.

lines.english: In the visible universe, the Word is seen.
lines.transliteration: daristimaan akh ar hai jayt aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God remains unattached and untouched. ||54|| sloku ] (261-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak paarbarahm nirlaypaa. ||54||

lines.english: With pen in hand, the Inaccessible Lord writes man's destiny on his forehead.
lines.transliteration: hath kalamm agamm mastak likh aavat ee.

lines.english: The Lord of Incomparable Beauty is involved with all.
lines.transliteration: urajh rahi-o sabh  sang anoop roopaavat ee.

lines.english: I cannot describe Your Praises with my mouth, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: ustat kahan na jaa-ay mukh ahu tuhaaree-aa.

lines.english: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; he is a sacrifice to You. ||1|| pauVI ] (261-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: mohee daykh  daras naanak balihaaree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O Immovable Lord, O Supreme Lord God, Imperishable, Destroyer of sins:
lines.transliteration: hay achut hay paarbarahm abh inaasee agh naas.

lines.english: O Perfect, All-pervading Lord, Destroyer of pain, Treasure of virtue:
lines.transliteration: hay pooran hay sarab mai dukh  bhanjan gunt aas.

lines.english: O Companion, Formless, Absolute Lord, Support of all:
lines.transliteration: hay sangee hay nirankaar hay nirgun sabh  tayk.

lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, Treasure of excellence, with clear eternal understanding:
lines.transliteration: hay gobid hay gun  niDhaan jaa kai sad aa bibayk.

lines.english: Most Remote of the Remote, Lord God: You are, You were, and You shall always be.
lines.transliteration: hay aprampar har haray heh bhee hovanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਿਝ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Constant Companion of the Saints, You are the Support of the unsupported.
lines.transliteration: hay santeh kai sad aa sang niDh aaraa aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, I am Your slave. I am worthless, I have no worth at all. pMnw 262
lines.transliteration: hay thaakur ha-o d aasro mai nirgun gun nahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ  ਹੀਐ  ਪਰੋਇ  ॥੫੫॥
lines.english: Nanak: grant me the Gift of Your Name, Lord, that I may string it and keep it within my heart. ||55|| sloku ] (262-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak deejai naam d aan raakh a-o hee-ai paro-ay. ||55||

lines.english: The Divine Guru is our mother, the Divine Guru is our father; the Divine Guru is ourLord and Master, the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv maat aa gurd ayv pit aa gurd ayv su-aamee parmaysuraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਗੁ ਰਦੇਵ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is myrelative and brother.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv sakh aa agi-aan bh anjan gurd ayv banDh ip sahod araa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸਖਾ ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਬੰਿਧਪ  ਸਹੋਦਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is theMantra which never fails.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv d aataa har naam upd aysai gurd ayv mant  niroDh araa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮੰਤੁ ਿਨਰੋਧਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv saaNt sat buDh  moorat  gurdayv paaras paras paraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸਿਤ  ਸਿਤ ਬੁਿਧ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਪਾਰਸ  ਪਰਸ  ਪਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine nectar;bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv t irath amrit  sarovar gur gi-aan majan apramparaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is thePurifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv kart aa sabh  paap hart aa gurd ayv pat it pavit  karaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਿਭ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਪਿਤਤ ਪਿਵਤ  ਕਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru existed in the very beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv aad  jugaad  jug jug gurd ayv mant  har jap uDh raa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮੰਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਉਧਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolishsinner, but holding onto Him, I will be carried across.
lines.transliteration: gurdayv sangat  parabh  mayl kar kirpaa ham moorh  paapee jit  lag taraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਿਲ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਲਿਗ  ਤਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord;Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurdayv sat gur paarbarahm parmaysar gurd ayv naanak har namaskaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Read this Shalok at the beginning, and at the end. || gauVI suKmnI mÚ 5 ] (262-8) ga-orhee sukh manee mehlaa 5. Gauree Sukhmani, Fifth Mehl, sloku ] (262-8) salok. Shalok: <> siqgur pRswid ] (262-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ayhu salok aad ant  parh-naa.

lines.english: I bow to the Primal Guru.
lines.transliteration: aad gur-ay namah.

lines.english: I bow to the Guru of the ages.
lines.transliteration: jugaad gur-ay namah.

lines.english: I bow to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur-ay namah.

lines.english: I bow to the Great, Divine Guru. ||1|| AstpdI ] (262-9) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: saree gurdayv-ay namah. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
lines.transliteration: simra-o simar simar sukh paava-o.

lines.english: Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.
lines.transliteration: kal kalays tan maahi mitaava-o.

lines.english: Remember in praise the One who pervades the whole Universe.
lines.transliteration: simra-o jaas bisumbhar aykai.

lines.english: His Name is chanted by countless people, in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: naam japat agnat  anaykai.

lines.english: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the purest of utterances,
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  suDh aakh-yar.
keenay raam naam ik aakh-yar. were created from the One Word of the Name of the Lord.

lines.english: That one, in whose soul the One Lord dwells
lines.transliteration: kinkaa ayk jis jee-a basaavai.
taa kee mahimaa ganee na aavai. - the praises of his glory cannot be recounted.

lines.english: Those who yearn only for the blessing of Your Darshan
lines.transliteration: kaaNkhee aykai d aras t uhaaro.

lines.english: - Nanak: save me along with them! ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak un sang mohi uDhaaro. ||1||

lines.english: Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.
lines.transliteration: sukhmanee sukh  amrit  parabh  naam.

lines.english: The minds of the devotees abide in a joyful peace. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kai man bisraam. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਗਨੀ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran garabh  na basai.

lines.english: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran d ookh jam nasai.

lines.english: Remembering God, death is eliminated.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran kaal parharai.

lines.english: Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran d usman tarai.

lines.english: Remembering God, no obstacles are met.
lines.transliteration: parabh simrat  kachh  bighan na laagai.

lines.english: Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran an-d in jaagai.

lines.english: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran bh a-o na bi-aapai.

lines.english: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran d ukh na sant aapai.

lines.english: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: parabh kaa simran saaDh  kai sang.

lines.english: All treasures, O Nanak, are in the Love of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan naanak har rang. ||2||

lines.english: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran riDh  siDh na-o niDh .

lines.english: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran gi-aan Dh i-aan t at buDh .

lines.english: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran jap t ap poojaa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran binsai d oojaa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran t irath isnaanee.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran d argeh maanee.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran ho-ay so bh alaa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran sufal falaa.

lines.english: They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate. pMnw 263
lines.transliteration: say simrahi jin aap simraa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai laaga-o paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.
lines.transliteration: parabh kaa simran sabh  tay oochaa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, many are saved.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran uDh ray moochaa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran t arisnaa bujh ai.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran sabh  kichh  sujhai.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran naahee jam t araasaa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran pooran aasaa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran man kee mal jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰਿਨ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rid  maahi samaa-ay.

lines.english: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee baseh saaDh  kee rasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਿਹ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak jan kaa daasan d asnaa. ||4||

lines.english: Those who remember God are wealthy.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi say Dh anvant ay.

lines.english: Those who remember God are honorable.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi say pat ivantay.

lines.english: Those who remember God are approved.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi say jan parvaan.

lines.english: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi say purakh  parDh aan.

lines.english: Those who remember God are not lacking.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi se baymuht aajay.

lines.english: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi se sarab kay raajay.

lines.english: Those who remember God dwell in peace.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi say sukh vaasee.

lines.english: Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi sad aa abh inaasee.

lines.english: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: simran tay laagay jin aap d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak jan kee mangai ravaalaa. ||5||

lines.english: Those who remember God generously help others.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi say par-upkaaree.

lines.english: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi t in sad  balihaaree.

lines.english: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi say mukh  suhaavay.

lines.english: Those who remember God abide in peace.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi t in sookh  bihaavai.

lines.english: Those who remember God conquer their souls.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi t in aat am jeet aa.

lines.english: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi t in nirmal reet aa.

lines.english: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi t in anad  ghanayray.

lines.english: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o simrahi baseh har nayray.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
lines.transliteration: sant kirpaa t ay an-d in jaag.

lines.english: O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak simran poorai bhaag. ||6||

lines.english: Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran kaaraj pooray.

lines.english: Remembering God, one never grieves.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran kabahu na jh ooray.

lines.english: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran har gun baanee.

lines.english: Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran sahj samaanee.

lines.english: Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran nihchal aasan.

lines.english: Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran kamal bigaasan.

lines.english: Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai simran anhad  jhunkaar.

lines.english: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: sukh parabh  simran kaa ant  na paar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਮਰਨ  ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
lines.english: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.
lines.transliteration: simrahi say jan jin ka-o parabh ma-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin jan sarnee pa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.
lines.transliteration: har simran kar bhagat  pargataa-ay.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.
lines.transliteration: har simran lag bayd upaa-ay.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.
lines.transliteration: har simran bha-ay siDh  jatee daatay.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.
lines.transliteration: har simran neech chahu kunt jaatay.

lines.english: For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.
lines.transliteration: har simran Dhaaree sabh  Dharnaa.

lines.english: Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: simar simar har kaaran karnaa.

lines.english: For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.
lines.transliteration: har simran kee-o sagal akaaraa.

lines.english: In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.
lines.transliteration: har simran meh aap nirankaaraa.

lines.english: By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis aap bujhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1|| sloku ] (263-19) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har simran t in paa-i-aa. ||8||1||

lines.english: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and everyheart, O Masterless One:
lines.transliteration: deen d arad dukh bhanjnaa gh at ghat naath anaath.

lines.english: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1|| pMnw 264 AstpdI ] (264-1) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: saran t umHaaree aa-i-o naanak kay parabh  saath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਆਇਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings
lines.transliteration: jah maat pit aa sut  meet  na bh aa-ee.

lines.english: - O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.
lines.transliteration: man oohaa naam tayrai sang sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,
lines.transliteration: jah mahaa bha-i-aan d oot jam d alai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tah kayval naam sang t ayrai chalai. there, only the Naam shall go along with you.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ  ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Where the obstacles are so very heavy,
lines.transliteration: jah muskal hovai at bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ko naam khin maahi uDh aaree. the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

lines.english: By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.
lines.transliteration: anik punahcharan karat nahee t arai.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.
lines.transliteration: har ko naam kot paap parharai.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam japahu man mayray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਿਟ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak paavhu sookh gh anayray. ||1||

lines.english: The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;
lines.transliteration: sagal sarisat ko raajaa dukh ee-aa.
har kaa naam japat ho-ay sukh ee-aa. one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.

lines.english: Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.
lines.transliteration: laakh karoree banDh  na parai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam japat nist arai.

lines.english: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.
lines.transliteration: anik maa-i-aa rang tikh  na bujh aavai.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam japat aagh aavai.

lines.english: Upon that path where you must go all alone,
lines.transliteration: jih maarag ih jaat ikaylaa.
tah har naam sang hot  suhaylaa. there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.

lines.english: On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam man sadaa Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh param gat  paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.
lines.transliteration: chhootat  nahee kot lakh  baahee.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.
lines.transliteration: naam japat t ah paar paraahee.

lines.english: Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,
lines.transliteration: anik bighan jah aa-ay sangh aarai.
har kaa naam tat kaal uDh aarai. the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

lines.english: Through countless incarnations, people are born and die.
lines.transliteration: anik jon janmai mar jaam.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.
lines.transliteration: naam japat paavai bisraam.

lines.english: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.
lines.transliteration: ha-o mailaa mal kabahu na Dhovai.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam kot paap khovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ  ਮਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam japahu man rang.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਿਟ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak paa-ee-ai saaDh kai sang. ||3||

lines.english: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,
lines.transliteration: jih maarag kay ganay jaahi na kosaa.
har kaa naam oohaa sang tosaa. there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਮਾਰਗ  ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਜਾਿਹ  ਨ ਕੋਸਾ ॥
lines.english: On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,
lines.transliteration: jih paidai mahaa anDh gubaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੋਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sang ujee-aaraa. the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

lines.english: On that journey where no one knows you,
lines.transliteration: jahaa panth tayraa ko na sinj aanoo.
har kaa naam tah naal pachh aanoo. with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

lines.english: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,
lines.transliteration: jah mahaa bha-i-aan t apat baho gh aam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਿਲ  ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah har kay naam kee t um oopar chh aam. there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ  ਤਪਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,
lines.transliteration: jahaa tarikh aa man t ujh aakrakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਊਪਿਰ  ਛਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah naanak har har amrit  barkh ai. ||4|| there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||

lines.english: Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kee bart an naam.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਬਰਖੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kai man bisraam.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam daas kee ot.

lines.english: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.
lines.transliteration: har kai naam uDhray jan kot.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
lines.english: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: har jas karat sant  din raat .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਧਰੇ  ਜਨ ਕੋਿਟ ॥
lines.english: Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.
lines.transliteration: har har a-ukhaDh  saaDh  kamaat .

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.
lines.transliteration: har jan kai har naam niDhaan.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jan keeno daan.

lines.english: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan rang rat ay rang aykai.

lines.english: O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak jan kai birat bibaykai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam jan ka-o mukat jugat .

lines.english: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har kai naam jan ka-o taripat  bhugat.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam jan kaa roop rang.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਭੁਗਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.
lines.transliteration: har naam japat kab parai na bh ang.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam jan kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਕਬ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor. pMnw 265
lines.transliteration: har kai naam jan sobhaa paa-ee.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam jan ka-o bhog jog.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.
lines.transliteration: har naam japat kachh  naahi bi-og.

lines.english: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jan raataa har naam kee sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak poojai har har dayvaa. ||6||

lines.english: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.
lines.transliteration: har har jan kai maal khajeenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਲੁ  ਖਜੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan jan ka-o aap parabh  deenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.
lines.transliteration: har har jan kai ot sataan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.
lines.transliteration: har partaap jan avar na jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਤਾਿਪ  ਜਨ ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  jan har ras raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh naam ras maat ay.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar jan har har japai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੈ ॥
lines.english: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.
lines.transliteration: har kaa bhagat  pargat nahee chh apai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  mukat  baho karay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak jan sang kaytay t aray. ||7||

lines.english: This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: paarjaat ih har ko naam.

lines.english: The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: kaamDhayn har har gun  gaam.

lines.english: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay oot am har kee kathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.
lines.transliteration: naam sunat d arad dukh lathaa.

lines.english: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.
lines.transliteration: naam kee mahimaa sant rid  vasai.

lines.english: By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sant part aap d urat sabh  nasai.

lines.english: The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa sang vadbh aagee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: sant kee sayvaa naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: There is nothing equal to the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam tul kachh  avar na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਤੁਿਲ  ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2|| sloku ] (265-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam paavai jan ko-ay. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched throughthem all.
lines.transliteration: baho saastar baho simrit ee paykh ay sarab dh adhol.

lines.english: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1|| AstpdI ] (265-9) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: poojas naahee har haray naanak naam amol. ||1||

lines.english: Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;
lines.transliteration: jaap taap gi-aan sabh  Dhi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਿਸ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khat saast ar simrit  vakh i-aan. the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;
jog abhi-aas karam Dh aram kiri-aa. the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;
sagal ti-aag ban maDh ay firi-aa. the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;
anik parkaar kee-ay baho jatnaa. the performance of all sorts of works;
punn daan homay baho rat naa. donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;
sareer kataa-ay homai kar raatee. cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;
varat naym karai baho bh aatee. keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts
nahee tul raam naam beechaar. - none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

lines.english: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam japee-ai ik baar. ||1||

lines.english: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;
lines.transliteration: na-o khand parithmee firai chir jeevai.
mahaa udaas t apeesar theevai. you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: agan maahi homat paraan. and burn yourself in fire;
kanik asav haivar bhoom d aan. you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;
ni-ulee karam karai baho aasan. you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;
jain maarag sanjam at saaDh an. you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;
nimakh nimakh  kar sareer kataavai. piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;
ta-o bh ee ha-umai mail na jaavai. but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

lines.english: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam samsar kachh naahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam japat  gat paahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;
lines.transliteration: man kaamnaa tirath d ayh chh utai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਕਛੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: garab gumaan na man tay hutai. but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You may practice cleansing day and night,
lines.transliteration: soch karai dinas ar raat .
man kee mail na tan t ay jaat . but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਬੁ  ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
lines.english: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,
lines.transliteration: is dayhee ka-o baho saaDh naa karai.
man tay kabhoo na bikh i-aa tarai. but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,
lines.transliteration: jal Dhovai baho d ayh aneet .

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: suDh kahaa ho-ay kaachee bh eet. but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

lines.english: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;
lines.transliteration: man har kay naam kee mahimaa ooch.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam uDhray pat it baho mooch. ||3||

lines.english: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you. pMnw 266
lines.transliteration: bahut si-aan ap jam kaa bh a-o bi-aapai.

lines.english: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar t arisan naa Dh araapai.

lines.english: Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh  anayk agan nahee bujh ai.

lines.english: Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot upaav dargeh nahee sijh ai.

lines.english: You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,
lines.transliteration: chhootas naahee oobh  pa-i-aal.
mohi bi-aapahi maa-i-aa jaal. if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.

lines.english: All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,
lines.transliteration: avar kartoot  saglee jam daanai.
govind bh ajan bin t il nahee maanai. which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam japat d ukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai sahj subhaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: One who prays for the four cardinal blessings
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath jay ko maagai.
saaDh janaa kee sayvaa laagai. should commit himself to the service of the Saints.

lines.english: If you wish to erase your sorrows,
lines.transliteration: jay ko aapunaa dookh  mitaavai.
har har naam ridai sad  gaavai. sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.

lines.english: If you long for honor for yourself,
lines.transliteration: jay ko apunee sobhaa lorai.
saaDhsang ih ha-umai chh orai. then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,
lines.transliteration: jay ko janam maran t ay darai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kee sarnee parai. then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

lines.english: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan
lines.transliteration: jis jan ka-o parabh d aras pi-aasaa.

lines.english: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਸਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Among all persons, the supreme person is the one
lines.transliteration: sagal purakh meh purakh  parDh aan.
saaDhsang jaa kaa mitai abh imaan. who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: One who sees himself as lowly,
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o jo jaanai neechaa.
so-oo ganee-ai sabh t ay oochaa. shall be accounted as the highest of all.

lines.english: One whose mind is the dust of all,
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa man ho-ay sagal kee reenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ  ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam tin gh at ghat cheenaa. recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਿਨ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਚੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,
lines.transliteration: man apunay tay buraa mitaanaa.
paykhai sagal sarisat saajnaa. looks upon all the world as his friend.

lines.english: One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,
lines.transliteration: sookh d ookh jan sam d aristayt aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak paap punn nahee laypaa. ||6||

lines.english: To the poor, Your Name is wealth.
lines.transliteration: nirDhan ka-o Dh an tayro naa-o.

lines.english: To the homeless, Your Name is home.
lines.transliteration: nithaavay ka-o naa-o tayraa thaa-o.

lines.english: To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.
lines.transliteration: nimaanay ka-o parabh t ayro maan.

lines.english: To all, You are the Giver of gifts.
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa ka-o d ayvhu d aan.

lines.english: O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar su-aamee.

lines.english: Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa kay ant arjaamee.

lines.english: You alone know Your own condition and state.
lines.transliteration: apnee gat mit  jaanhu aapay.

lines.english: You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: aapan sang aap parabh raat ay.

lines.english: You alone can celebrate Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: tumHree ust at tum tay ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak avar na jaanas ko-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Of all religions, the best religion
lines.transliteration: sarab Dharam meh saraysat Dh aram.
har ko naam jap nirmal karam. is to chant the Name of the Lord and maintain pure conduct.

lines.english: Of all religious rituals, the most sublime ritual
lines.transliteration: sagal kir-aa meh ootam kiri-aa.
saaDhsang d urmat  mal hiri-aa. is to erase the filth of the dirty mind in the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: Of all efforts, the best effort
lines.transliteration: sagal udam meh ud am bh alaa.
har kaa naam japahu jee-a sadaa. is to chant the Name of the Lord in the heart, forever.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ  ਸਦਾ ॥
lines.english: Of all speech, the most ambrosial speech
lines.transliteration: sagal baanee meh amrit baanee.
har ko jas sun rasan bakhaanee. is to hear the Lord's Praise and chant it with the tongue.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਿਨ ਰਸਨ  ਬਖਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Of all places, the most sublime place,
lines.transliteration: sagal thaan tay oh oot am thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, is that heart in which the Name of the Lord abides. ||8||3|| sloku ] (266-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak jih ghat vasai har naam. ||8||3||

lines.english: You worthless, ignorant fool - dwell upon God forever.
lines.transliteration: nirgunee-aar i-aani-aa so parabh sad aa samaal.

lines.english: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1|| AstpdI ] (266-17) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tis cheet  rakh naanak nibhee naal. ||1||

lines.english: Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;
lines.transliteration: rama-ee-aa kay gun chayt paraanee.
kavan mool tay kavan d aristaanee. what is your origin, and what is your appearance?

lines.english: He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you
lines.transliteration: jin tooN saaj savaar seegaari-aa.
garabh agan meh jineh ubaari-aa. - in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.

lines.english: In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.
lines.transliteration: baar bivasthaa tujh eh pi-aarai d ooDh.

lines.english: In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.
lines.transliteration: bhar joban bh ojan sukh  sooDh .

lines.english: As you grow old, family and friends are there to feed you as you rest. pMnw 267
lines.transliteration: biraDh bh a-i-aa oopar saak sain. mukh  api-aa-o baith  ka-o d ain.

lines.english: This worthless person has not appreciated in the least, all the good deeds done for him.
lines.transliteration: ih nirgun gun kachhoo na boojh ai.

lines.english: If you bless him with forgiveness, O Nanak, only then will he be saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bakhas layho t a-o naanak seejh ai. ||1||

lines.english: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad Dh ar oopar sukh  baseh.

lines.english: With your children, siblings, friends and spouse, you laugh.
lines.transliteration: sut bh araat meet  banit aa sang haseh.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤ ਭਰ੍ਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਸਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, you drink in cool water.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad peeveh seet al jalaa.

lines.english: You have peaceful breezes and priceless fire.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aa-ee pavan paavak amulaa.

lines.english: By His Grace, you enjoy all sorts of pleasures.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad bh ogeh sabh  rasaa.

lines.english: You are provided with all the necessities of life.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree sang saath basaa.

lines.english: He gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue,
lines.transliteration: deenay hasat  paav karan nayt ar rasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨੇ  ਹਸਤ  ਪਾਵ ਕਰਨ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਰਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tiseh t i-aag avar sang rachnaa. and yet, you forsake Him and attach yourself to others.

lines.english: Such sinful mistakes cling to the blind fools;
lines.transliteration: aisay dokh  moorh  anDh  bi-aapay.

lines.english: Nanak: uplift and save them, God! ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaadh layho parabh  aapay. ||2||

lines.english: From beginning to end, He is our Protector,
lines.transliteration: aad ant  jo raakh anhaar.
tis si-o pareet  na karai gavaar. and yet, the ignorant do not give their love to Him.

lines.english: Serving Him, the nine treasures are obtained,
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayvaa nav niDh paavai.
taa si-o moorh aa man nahee laavai. and yet, the foolish do not link their minds with Him.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master is Ever-present, forever and ever,
lines.transliteration: jo thaakur sad  sadaa hajooray.
taa ka-o anDh aa jaanat  dooray. and yet, the spiritually blind believe that He is far away.

lines.english: In His service, one obtains honor in the Court of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: jaa kee tahal paavai dargeh maan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiseh bisaarai mugaDh  ajaan. and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.

lines.english: Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa ih bh oolanhaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak raakhanhaar apaar. ||3||

lines.english: Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.
lines.transliteration: ratan t i-aag ka-udee sang rachai.

lines.english: They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.
lines.transliteration: saach chhod jh ooth sang machai.

lines.english: That which passes away, they believe to be permanent.
lines.transliteration: jo chhadnaa so asthir kar maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ  ਸੁ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.
lines.transliteration: jo hovan so door paraanai.

lines.english: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.
lines.transliteration: chhod jaa-ay t is kaa saram karai.

lines.english: They turn away from the Lord, their Help and Support, who is always with them.
lines.transliteration: sang sahaa-ee tis parharai.

lines.english: They wash off the sandalwood paste;
lines.transliteration: chandan layp ut aarai Dh o-ay.
garDhab pareet  bhasam sang ho-ay. like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.

lines.english: They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop meh pat it bikraal.

lines.english: Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaadh layho parabh  da-i-aal. ||4||

lines.english: They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.
lines.transliteration: kartoot  pasoo kee maanas jaat .

lines.english: They curse others day and night.
lines.transliteration: lok pachaaraa karai din raat .

lines.english: Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.
lines.transliteration: baahar bhaykh  antar mal maa-i-aa.

lines.english: They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.
lines.transliteration: chhapas naahi kachh  karai chh apaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,
lines.transliteration: baahar gi-aan Dhi-aan isnaan.
antar bi-aapai lobh  su-aan. but within clings the dog of greed.

lines.english: The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.
lines.transliteration: antar agan baahar t an su-aah.

lines.english: There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?
lines.transliteration: gal paathar kaisay tarai athaah.

lines.english: Those, within whom God Himself abides
lines.transliteration: jaa kai antar basai parabh  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਸੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: - O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan sahj samaat . ||5||

lines.english: By listening, how can the blind find the path?
lines.transliteration: sun anDhaa kaisay maarag paavai.

lines.english: Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.
lines.transliteration: kar geh layho orh nibhaavai.

lines.english: How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?
lines.transliteration: kahaa bujhaarat  boojh ai doraa.

lines.english: Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.
lines.transliteration: nis kahee-ai ta-o samjh ai bhoraa.

lines.english: How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: kahaa bisanpad gaavai gung.

lines.english: He may try, but his voice will fail him.
lines.transliteration: jatan karai t a-o bh ee sur bh ang.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ  ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
lines.english: How can the cripple climb up the mountain?
lines.transliteration: kah pingul parbat par bh avan.

lines.english: He simply cannot go there.
lines.transliteration: nahee hot oohaa us gavan.

lines.english: O Creator, Lord of Mercy - Your humble servant prays;
lines.transliteration: kartaar karun aa mai d een baynt ee karai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤਾਰ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak tumree kirpaa t arai. ||6||

lines.english: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.
lines.transliteration: sang sahaa-ee so aavai na cheet.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਸੁ ਆਵੈ  ਨ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: He shows love to his enemies.
lines.transliteration: jo bairaa-ee taa si-o pareet .

lines.english: He lives in a castle of sand.
lines.transliteration: baloo-aa kay garih bheet ar basai.

lines.english: He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.
lines.transliteration: anad kayl maa-i-aa rang rasai.

lines.english: He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.
lines.transliteration: darirh  kar maanai maneh part eet.

lines.english: Death does not even come to mind for the fool.
lines.transliteration: kaal na aavai moorhay cheet .

lines.english: Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,
lines.transliteration: bair biroDh kaam kroDh  moh.
jhooth  bikaar mahaa lobh  Dharoh. falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit: pMnw 268

lines.english: So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.
lines.transliteration: i-aahoo jugat bihaanay ka-ee janam.

lines.english: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak raakh layho aapan kar karam. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ  ਕਿਰ ਕਰਮ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.
lines.transliteration: too th aakur t um peh ard aas.

lines.english: This body and soul are all Your property.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t ayree raas.

lines.english: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.
lines.transliteration: tum maat  pitaa ham baarik t ayray.

lines.english: In Your Grace, there are so many joys!
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa meh sookh  ghanayray.

lines.english: No one knows Your limits.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na jaanai tumraa ant .

lines.english: O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,
lines.transliteration: oochay tay oochaa bh agvant .
sagal samagree tumrai sut ir Dhaaree. the whole creation is strung on Your thread.

lines.english: That which has come from You is under Your Command.
lines.transliteration: tum t ay ho-ay so aagi-aakaaree.

lines.english: You alone know Your state and extent.
lines.transliteration: tumree gat  mit tum hee jaanee.

lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4|| sloku ] (268-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa kurbaanee. ||8||4||

lines.english: One who renounces God the Giver, and attaches himself to other affairs
lines.transliteration: daynhaar parabh  chhod kai laageh aan su-aa-ay.

lines.english: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1|| AstpdI ] (268-6) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahoo na seejh-ee bin naavai pat  jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁਪਰ੍ਭ ਛੋਿਡ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਿਹ  ਆਨ  ਸੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;
lines.transliteration: das bast oo lay paachh ai paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿਤ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ayk basat kaaran bikh ot gavaavai. for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

lines.english: But what if that one thing were not given, and the ten were taken away?
lines.transliteration: ayk bhee na d ay-ay d as bh ee hir lay-ay.

lines.english: Then, what could the fool say or do?
lines.transliteration: ta-o moorh aa kaho kahaa karay-i.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.
lines.transliteration: jis thaakur si-o naahee chaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਦਸ ਭੀ ਿਹਿਰ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o keejai sad  namaskaaraa.

lines.english: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man laagaa parabh meeth aa.
sarab sookh t aahoo man vooth aa. - all pleasures come to abide in his mind.
