lines.english: One who abides by the Lord's Will,
lines.transliteration: jis jan apnaa hukam manaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab thok naanak tin paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,
lines.transliteration: agnat saahu apnee d ay raas.
khaat  peet bartai anad  ulaas. who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

lines.english: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,
lines.transliteration: apunee amaan kachh bahur saahu lay-ay.
agi-aanee man ros karay-i. the ignorant person shows his anger.

lines.english: He himself destroys his own credibility,
lines.transliteration: apnee parteet  aap hee kh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਅਮਾਨ  ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahur us kaa bisvaas na hovai. and he shall not again be trusted.

lines.english: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,
lines.transliteration: jis kee basat t is aagai raakh ai.
parabh kee aagi-aa maanai maathai. and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,
us tay cha-ugun karai nihaal. the Lord will make him happy four times over.

lines.english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib sadaa d a-i-aal. ||2||

lines.english: The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away - know that they are transitory.
lines.transliteration: anik bhaat  maa-i-aa kay hayt . sarpar hovat  jaan anayt .

lines.english: People fall in love with the shade of the tree,
lines.transliteration: birakh kee chh aa-i-aa si-o rang laavai.
oh binsai uho man pachhut aavai. and when it passes away, they feel regret in their minds.

lines.english: Whatever is seen, shall pass away;
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so chaalanhaar.
lapat rahi-o tah anDh  anDh aar. and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.

lines.english: One who gives her love to a passing traveler
lines.transliteration: bataa-oo si-o jo laavai nayh.
taa ka-o haath na aavai kayh. - nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

lines.english: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.
lines.transliteration: man har kay naam kee pareet sukh -daa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naanak aap la-ay laa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: False are body, wealth, and all relations.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa tan Dh an kutamb sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਿਥ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਕੇਹ ॥
lines.english: False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa ha-umai mamtaa maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: False are power, youth, wealth and property.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa raaj joban Dhan maal.

lines.english: False are sexual desire and wild anger.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa kaam kroDh bikraal.

lines.english: False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa rath hastee asav bast araa.

lines.english: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa rang sang maa-i-aa paykh hast aa.

lines.english: False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa Dharoh moh abh imaan.

lines.english: False are pride and self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa aapas oopar karat gumaan.

lines.english: Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: asthir bhagat  saaDh  kee saran.

lines.english: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak jap jap jeevai har kay charan. ||4||

lines.english: False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa sarvan par nindaa suneh.

lines.english: False are the hands which steal the wealth of others. pMnw 269
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa hasat par d arab ka-o hireh.

lines.english: False are the eyes which gaze upon the beauty of another's wife.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa naytar paykh at par t ari-a roopaad .

lines.english: False is the tongue which enjoys delicacies and external tastes.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa rasnaa bhojan an savaad .

lines.english: False are the feet which run to do evil to others.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa charan par bikaar ka-o Dhaaveh.

lines.english: False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa man par lobh lubh aaveh.

lines.english: False is the body which does not do good to others.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa tan nahee par-upkaaraa.

lines.english: False is the nose which inhales corruption.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa baas layt bikaaraa.

lines.english: Without understanding, everything is false.
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay mithi-aa sabh  bha-ay.

lines.english: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||
lines.transliteration: safal dayh naanak har har naam la-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
lines.transliteration: birthee saakat kee aarjaa.

lines.english: Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?
lines.transliteration: saach binaa kah hovat soochaa.

lines.english: Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: birthaa naam binaa tan anDh .

lines.english: From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.
lines.transliteration: mukh aavat  taa kai d urganDh .

lines.english: Without the remembrance of the Lord, day and night pass in vain,
lines.transliteration: bin simran din rain baritha bihaa-ay.
maygh binaa ji-o kh aytee jaa-ay. like the crop which withers without rain.

lines.english: Without meditation on the Lord of the Universe, all works are in vain,
lines.transliteration: gobid bh ajan bin barithay sabh  kaam.
ji-o kirpan kay niraarath daam. like the wealth of a miser, which lies useless.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an tay jan jih gh at basi-o har naa-o. Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਿਜਹ ਘਿਟ  ਬਿਸਓ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaa-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He says one thing, and does something else.
lines.transliteration: rahat avar kachh  avar kamaavat .

lines.english: There is no love in his heart, and yet with his mouth he talks tall.
lines.transliteration: man nahee pareet mukh ahu gandh  laavat .

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਮੁਖਹ ੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.
lines.transliteration: jaananhaar parabhoo parbeen.

lines.english: He is not impressed by outward display.
lines.transliteration: baahar bhaykh  na kaahoo bh een.

lines.english: One who does not practice what he preaches to others,
lines.transliteration: avar updaysai aap na karai.
aavat jaavat  janmai marai. shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.

lines.english: One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord
lines.transliteration: jis kai antar basai nirankaar.
tis kee seekh  tarai sansaar. - by his teachings, the world is saved.

lines.english: Those who are pleasing to You, God, know You.
lines.transliteration: jo tum bh aanay t in parabh  jaataa.

lines.english: Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak un jan charan paraataa. ||7||

lines.english: Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.
lines.transliteration: kara-o bayntee paarbarahm sabh  jaanai.

lines.english: He Himself values His own creatures.
lines.transliteration: apnaa kee-aa aapeh maanai.

lines.english: He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.
lines.transliteration: aapeh aap aap karat nibayraa.

lines.english: To some, He appears far away, while others perceive Him near at hand.
lines.transliteration: kisai door janaavat  kisai bujh aavat  nayraa.

lines.english: He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.
lines.transliteration: upaav si-aanap sagal tay rahat .

lines.english: He knows all the ways and means of the soul.
lines.transliteration: sabh kachh  jaanai aat am kee rahat .

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ  ਕੀ ਰਹਤ  ॥
lines.english: Those with whom He is pleased are attached to the hem of His robe.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is la-ay larh  laa-ay.

lines.english: He is pervading all places and interspaces.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.
lines.transliteration: so sayvak jis kirpaa karee.

lines.english: Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5|| sloku ] (269-13) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: nimakh nimakh  jap naanak haree. ||8||5||

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - may these be gone, andegotism as well.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ar lobh  moh binas jaa-ay ahaNmayv.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; please bless me with Your Grace, O Divine Guru.||1|| AstpdI ] (269-14) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee kar parsaad  gurdayv. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਅਹੰਮੇਵ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad chh ateeh amrit  khaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੁ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis thaakur ka-o rakh  man maahi. enshrine that Lord and Master within your mind.

lines.english: By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad suganDh at tan laaveh.
tis ka-o simrat  param gat  paavahi. remembering Him, the supreme status is obtained.

lines.english: By His Grace, you dwell in the palace of peace;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad baseh sukh  mand ar.
tiseh Dh i-aa-ay sad aa man and ar. meditate forever on Him within your mind.

lines.english: By His Grace, you abide with your family in peace;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad garih sang sukh  basnaa.
aath pahar simrahu t is rasnaa. keep His remembrance upon your tongue, twenty-four hours a day.

lines.english: By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad rang ras bh og.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa Dh i-aa-ee-ai Dh i-aavan jog. ||1||

lines.english: By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad paat patambar hadh aaveh.
tiseh t i-aag kat  avar lubh aaveh. why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?

lines.english: By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad sukh  sayj so-eejai.

lines.english: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: man aath pahar t aa kaa jas gaaveejai.

lines.english: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone; pMnw 270
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ujh sabh  ko-oo maanai.
mukh t aa ko jas rasan bakh aanai. with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਖ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayro raht aa Dh aram.

lines.english: O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: man sadaa Dh i-aa-ay kayval paarbarahm.

lines.english: Meditating on God, you shall be honored in His Court;
lines.transliteration: parabh jee japat  dargeh maan paavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, you shall return to your true home with honor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak pat sayt ee gh ar jaaveh. ||2||

lines.english: By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad aarog kanchan d ayhee.
liv laavhu tis raam sanayhee. attune yourself to that Loving Lord.

lines.english: By His Grace, your honor is preserved;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayraa olaa rahat .

lines.english: O mind, chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, and find peace.
lines.transliteration: man sukh paavahi har har jas kahat .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, all your deficits are covered;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayray sagal chh idar dhaakay.

lines.english: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: man sarnee par thaakur parabh  taa kai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ  ਪਰੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, no one can rival you;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ujh ko na pahoochai.

lines.english: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.
lines.transliteration: man saas saas simrahu parabh oochay.

lines.english: By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad paa-ee d arulabh  dayh.

lines.english: O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kee bh agat karayh. ||3||

lines.english: By His Grace, you wear decorations;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad aabh ookhan pehreejai.

lines.english: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?
lines.transliteration: man tis simrat  ki-o aalas keejai.

lines.english: By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad asav hasat  asvaaree.

lines.english: O mind, never forget that God.
lines.transliteration: man tis parabh  ka-o kabhoo na bisaaree.

lines.english: By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad baag milakh  Dhanaa.
raakh paro-ay parabh  apunay manaa. keep God enshrined in your heart.

lines.english: O mind, the One who formed your form
lines.transliteration: jin tayree man banat  banaa-ee.
oothat  baith at sad tiseh Dh i-aa-ee. - standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.

lines.english: Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;
lines.transliteration: tiseh Dh i-aa-ay jo ayk alkh ai.
eehaa oohaa naanak tayree rakh ai. ||4|| here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||

lines.english: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad karahi punn baho d aan.

lines.english: O mind, meditate on Him, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: man aath pahar kar t is kaa Dh i-aan.

lines.english: By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t oo aachaar bi-uhaaree.
tis parabh  ka-o saas saas chit aaree. think of God with each and every breath.

lines.english: By His Grace, your form is so beautiful;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayraa sund ar roop.
so parabh simrahu sad aa anoop. constantly remember God, the Incomparably Beautiful One.

lines.english: By His Grace, you have such high social status;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayree neekee jaat .
so parabh simar sad aa din raat . remember God always, day and night.

lines.english: By His Grace, your honor is preserved;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayree pat  rahai.
gur parsaad naanak jas kahai. ||5|| by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||

lines.english: By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad suneh karan naad .

lines.english: By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad paykh eh bismaad .

lines.english: By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad boleh amrit  rasnaa.

lines.english: By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad sukh  sehjay basnaa.

lines.english: By His Grace, your hands move and work.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad hasat  kar chaleh.

lines.english: By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad sampooran faleh.

lines.english: By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad param gat  paavahi.

lines.english: By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad sukh  sahj samaaveh.

lines.english: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?
lines.transliteration: aisaa parabh t i-aag avar kat  laagahu.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak man jaagahu. ||6||

lines.english: By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ooN pargat sansaar.
tis parabh  ka-o mool na manhu bisaar. never forget God from your mind.

lines.english: By His Grace, you have prestige;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayraa part aap.

lines.english: O foolish mind, meditate on Him!
lines.transliteration: ray man moorh t oo taa ka-o jaap.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, your works are completed;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ayray kaaraj pooray.

lines.english: O mind, know Him to be close at hand.
lines.transliteration: tiseh jaan man sad aa hajooray.

lines.english: By His Grace, you find the Truth;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad t ooN paavahi saach.

lines.english: O my mind, merge yourself into Him.
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray tooN taa si-o raach.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, everyone is saved;
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad sabh  kee gat  ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak jaap japai jap so-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.
lines.transliteration: aap japaa-ay japai so naa-o.

lines.english: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. pMnw 271
lines.transliteration: aap gaavaa-ai so har gun gaa-o.

lines.english: By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay ho-ay pargaas.

lines.english: By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: parabhoo d a-i-aa t ay kamal bigaas.

lines.english: When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: parabh suparsan basai man so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.
lines.transliteration: parabh d a-i-aa t ay mat  ootam ho-ay.

lines.english: All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan parabh  tayree ma-i-aa.

lines.english: No one obtains anything by himself.
lines.transliteration: aaphu kachhoo na kinhoo la-i-aa.

lines.english: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavhu t it lageh har naath.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਨ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6|| sloku ] (271-3) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak in kai kachhoo na haath. ||8||6||

lines.english: Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;
lines.transliteration: agam agaaDh paarbarahm so-ay.
jo jo kahai so muktaa ho-ay. whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Listen, O friends, Nanak prays, to the wonderful story of the Holy. ||1|| AstpdI ] (271-5) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: sun meetaa naanak binvant aa. saaDh  janaa kee achraj kathaa. ||1||

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang mukh  oojal hot .

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mal saglee kh ot.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang mitai abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਹੋਤ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang pargatai sugi-aan.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang bujh ai parabh  nayraa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang sabh  hot nibayraa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang paa-ay naam rat an.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬੁਝੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang ayk oopar jat an.

lines.english: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee mahimaa barnai ka-un paraanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDh kee sobh aa parabh  maahi samaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਏਕ ਊਪਿਰ  ਜਤਨੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang agochar milai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang sad aa parfulai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang aavahi bas panchaa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang amrit  ras bh unchaa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang ho-ay sabh  kee rayn.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਬਿਸ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang manohar bain.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang na kat ahooN Dhaavai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang asthit  man paavai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang maa-i-aa t ay bh inn.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak parabh  suparsan. ||2||

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang d usman sabh  meet .

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, there is great purity.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kai sang mahaa puneet .

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, no one is hated.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang kis si-o nahee bair.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one's feet do not wander.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang na beegaa pair.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, no one seems evil.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang naahee ko mand aa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, supreme bliss is known.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jaanay parmaanand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਬੀਗਾ  ਪੈਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the fever of ego departs.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang naahee ha-o t aap.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one renounces all selfishness.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang t ajai sabh  aap.

lines.english: He Himself knows the greatness of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai saaDh badaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Holy are at one with God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDh parabh oo ban aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ  ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang na kabhoo Dh aavai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains everlasting peace.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang sad aa sukh  paavai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one grasps the Incomprehensible.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang basat  agochar lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one can endure the unendurable.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kai sang ajar sahai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one abides in the loftiest place.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang basai thaan oochai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kai sang mahal pahoochai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one's Dharmic faith is firmly established.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang d arirhai sabh  Dharam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸੈ ਥਾਿਨ  ਊਚੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one dwells with the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang kayval paarbarahm.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang paa-ay naam niDh aan.

lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Holy. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDhoo kai kurbaan. ||4||

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang sabh  kul uDh aarai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one's friends, acquaintances and relatives are redeemed.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang saajan meet  kutamb nist aarai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, that wealth is obtained.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kai sang so Dh an paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone benefits from that wealth.
lines.transliteration: jis Dhan t ay sabh  ko varsaavai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the Lord of Dharma serves.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang Dh aram raa-ay karay sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the divine, angelic beings sing God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang sobh aa surd ayvaa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one's sins fly away.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kai sang paap palaa-in.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one sings the Ambrosial Glories.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang amrit  gun gaa-in.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, all places are within reach. pMnw 272
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang sarab thaan gamm.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਫਲ  ਜਨੰਮ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, one's life becomes fruitful. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDh kai sang safal jannam. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang nahee kachh  ghaal.

lines.english: The Blessed Vision of their Darshan brings a sublime, happy peace.
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytat hot nihaal.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, blemishes are removed.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang kalookh at harai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, hell is far away.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang narak parharai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਈਹਾ  ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one is happy here and hereafter.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang eehaa oohaa suhaylaa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the separated ones are reunited with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bichh urat har maylaa.

lines.english: The fruits of one's desires are obtained.
lines.transliteration: jo ichhai so-ee fal paavai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, no one goes empty-handed.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang na birthaa jaavai.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God dwells in the hearts of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm saaDh rid  basai.

lines.english: O Nanak, listening to the sweet words of the Holy, one is saved. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhrai saaDh  sun rasai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੁਨਉ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang sun-o har naa-o.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har kay gun gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, do not forget Him from your mind.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang na man t ay bisrai.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, you shall surely be saved.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang sarpar nist arai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਗੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, God seems very sweet.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang lagai parabh  meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, He is seen in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kai sang gh at ghat deeth aa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, we become obedient to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh a-ay aagi-aakaaree.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, we obtain the state of salvation.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang gat  bha-ee hamaaree.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, all diseases are cured.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kai sang mitay sabh  rog.

lines.english: O Nanak, one meets with the Holy, by highest destiny. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDh bh aytay sanjog. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee mahimaa bayd  na jaaneh.

lines.english: They can describe only what they have heard.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa suneh t aytaa bakh i-aaneh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਿਤਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The greatness of the Holy people is beyond the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee upmaa t ihu gun  tay door.

lines.english: The greatness of the Holy people is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee upmaa rahee bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅੰਤ ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Holy people has no limit.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee sobh aa kaa naahee ant .

lines.english: The glory of the Holy people is infinite and eternal.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee sobh aa sad aa bay-ant .

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ  ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Holy people is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee sobh aa ooch t ay oochee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Holy people is the greatest of the great.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee sobh aa mooch t ay moochee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Holy people is theirs alone;
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee sobh aa saaDh  ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥੮॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there is no difference between the Holy people and God. ||8||7|| sloku ] (272-10) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDh parabh  bhayd na bh aa-ee. ||8||7||

lines.english: The True One is on his mind, and the True One is upon his lips.
lines.transliteration: man saachaa mukh saachaa so-ay.

lines.english: He sees only the One.
lines.transliteration: avar na paykhai aykas bin ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, these are the qualities of the God-conscious being. ||1|| AstpdI ] (272-11) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak ih lachhan  barahm gi-aanee ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The God-conscious being is always unattached,
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sadaa nirlayp.
jaisay jal meh kamal alayp. as the lotus in the water remains detached.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is always unstained,
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sadaa nird okh.
jaisay soor sarab ka-o sokh. like the sun, which gives its comfort and warmth to all.

lines.english: The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai darisat samaan.
jaisay raaj rank ka-o laagai tul pavaan. like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.

lines.english: The God-conscious being has a steady patience,
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai Dheeraj ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ  ਤੁਿਲ  ਪਵਾਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ji-o basuDhaa ko-oo kh odai ko-oo chand an layp. like the earth, which is dug up by one, and anointed with sandal paste by another.

lines.english: This is the quality of the God-conscious being:
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa ihai gunaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ  ਲੇਪ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, his inherent nature is like a warming fire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak ji-o paavak kaa sahj subhaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee nirmal tay nirmalaa.
jaisay mail na laagai jalaa. filth does not stick to water.

lines.english: The God-conscious being's mind is enlightened,
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai man ho-ay pargaas.
jaisay Dhar oopar aakaas. like the sky above the earth.

lines.english: To the God-conscious being, friend and foe are the same.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai mitar sat ar samaan.

lines.english: The God-conscious being has no egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai naahee abhimaan.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee ooch tay oochaa.

lines.english: Within his own mind, he is the most humble of all.
lines.transliteration: man apnai hai sabh t ay neechaa.

lines.english: They alone become God-conscious beings,
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee say jan bha-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਅਪਨੈ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whom God Himself makes so. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak jin parabh aap karay-i. ||2||

lines.english: The God-conscious being is the dust of all.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sagal kee reenaa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.
lines.transliteration: aatam ras barahm gi-aanee cheenaa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kee sabh oopar ma-i-aa.

lines.english: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee tay kachh  buraa na bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is always impartial. pMnw 273
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sadaa samad rasee.

lines.english: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kee darisat amrit  barsee.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee banDhan t ay mukt aa.

lines.english: The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kee nirmal jugtaa.

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa bhojan gi-aan.

lines.english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak barahm gi-aanee kaa barahm Dhi-aan. ||3||

lines.english: The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee ayk oopar aas.

lines.english: The God-conscious being shall never perish.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa nahee binaas.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai gareebee samaahaa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee par-upkaar omaahaa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai naahee DhanDh aa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee lay Dhaavat  banDh aa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being acts in the common good.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai ho-ay so bhalaa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being blossoms in fruitfulness.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sufal falaa.

lines.english: In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sang sagal uDhaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak barahm gi-aanee japai sagal sansaar. ||4||

lines.english: The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai aykai rang.

lines.english: The God-conscious being dwells with God.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai basai parabh sang.

lines.english: The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai naam aaDhaar.

lines.english: The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai naam parvaar.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sadaa sad  jaagat .

lines.english: The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee ahaN-buDh t i-aagat .

lines.english: In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai man parmaanand.

lines.english: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai ghar sad aa anand.

lines.english: The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sukh sahj nivaas.

lines.english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak barahm gi-aanee kaa nahee binaas. ||5||

lines.english: The God-conscious being knows God.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee barahm kaa baytaa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee ayk sang haytaa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is carefree.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai ho-ay achint.

lines.english: Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa nirmal mant.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee jis karai parabh aap.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is gloriously great.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa bad partaap.

lines.english: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by greatgood fortune.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa daras badbh aagee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee ka-o bal bal jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee ka-o khojeh mahaysur.

lines.english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak barahm gi-aanee aap parmaysur. ||6||

lines.english: The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kee keemat naahi.

lines.english: The God-conscious being has all within his mind.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kai sagal man maahi.

lines.english: Who can know the mystery of the God-conscious being?
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa ka-un jaanai bhayd .

lines.english: Forever bow to the God-conscious being.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee ka-o sadaa ad ays.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਕਾ ਕਿਥਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਅਧਾਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The God-conscious being cannot be described in words.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa kathi-aa na jaa-ay aDhaakh -yar.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is the Lord and Master of all.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sarab kaa thaakur.

lines.english: Who can describe the limits of the God-conscious being?
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kee mit ka-un bakh aanai.

lines.english: Only the God-conscious being can know the state of the God-conscious being.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kee gat barahm gi-aanee jaanai.

lines.english: The God-conscious being has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa ant na paar.

lines.english: O Nanak, to the God-conscious being, bow forever in reverence. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak barahm gi-aanee ka-o sadaa namaskaar. ||7||

lines.english: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sabh sarisat kaa kart aa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee sad jeevai nahee mart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee mukat jugat  jee-a kaa d aataa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee pooran purakh biDh aataa.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee anaath kaa naath.

lines.english: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa sabh oopar haath.

lines.english: The God-conscious being owns the entire creation. pMnw 274
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kaa sagal akaar.

lines.english: The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee aap nirankaar.

lines.english: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee kee sobhaa barahm gi-aanee banee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8|| sloku ] (274-2) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak barahm gi-aanee sarab kaa Dhanee. ||8||8||

lines.english: One who enshrines the Naam within the heart,
lines.transliteration: ur Dhaarai jo ant ar naam.
sarab mai paykhai bh agvaan. who sees the Lord God in all,
nimakh nimakh  thaakur namaskaarai. who, each and every moment, bows in reverence to the Lord Master

lines.english: - O Nanak, such a one is the true 'touch-nothing Saint', who emancipates everyone.||1|| AstpdI ] (274-3) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak oh apras sagal nistaarai. ||1||

lines.english: One whose tongue does not touch falsehood;
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa naahee rasnaa paras.
man meh pareet niranjan d aras. whose mind is filled with love for the Blessed Vision of the Pure Lord,
par tari-a roop na paykh ai nayt ar. whose eyes do not gaze upon the beauty of others' wives,
saaDh kee tahal sat sang hayt . who serves the Holy and loves the Saints' Congregation,
karan na sunai kaahoo kee nindaa. whose ears do not listen to slander against anyone,
sabh t ay jaanai aapas ka-o mand aa. who deems himself to be the worst of all,
gur parsaad bikh i-aa parharai. who, by Guru's Grace, renounces corruption,
man kee baasnaa man tay tarai. who banishes the mind's evil desires from his mind,

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਸ  ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: indree jit  panch d okh tay rahat . who conquers his sexual instincts and is free of the five sinful passions

lines.english: - O Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely one such 'touch-nothing Saint'. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kot maDhay ko aisaa apras. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughlypleased.
lines.transliteration: baisno so jis oopar suparsan.

lines.english: He dwells apart from Maya.
lines.transliteration: bisan kee maa-i-aa tay ho-ay bh inn.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਐਸਾ  ਅਪਰਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Performing good deeds, he does not seek rewards.
lines.transliteration: karam karat hovai nihkaram.

lines.english: Spotlessly pure is the religion of such a Vaishnaav;
lines.transliteration: tis baisno kaa nirmal Dh aram.
kaahoo fal kee ichhaa nahee baachh ai. he has no desire for the fruits of his labors.

lines.english: He is absorbed in devotional worship and the singing of Kirtan, the songs of the Lord'sGlory.
lines.transliteration: kayval bhagat  keert an sang raachai.

lines.english: Within his mind and body, he meditates in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar simran gopaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ  ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
lines.english: He is kind to all creatures.
lines.transliteration: sabh oopar hovat  kirpaal.

lines.english: He holds fast to the Naam, and inspires others to chant it.
lines.transliteration: aap darirh ai avrah naam japaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, such a Vaishnaav obtains the supreme status. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak oh baisno param gat paavai. ||2||

lines.english: The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.
lines.transliteration: bhag-ut ee bh agvant  bhagat kaa rang.

lines.english: He forsakes the company of all wicked people.
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aagai d usat kaa sang.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All doubts are removed from his mind.
lines.transliteration: man tay binsai saglaa bh aram.

lines.english: He performs devotional service to the Supreme Lord God in all.
lines.transliteration: kar poojai sagal paarbarahm.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, the filth of sin is washed away.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang paapaa mal kh ovai.

lines.english: The wisdom of such a Bhagaautee becomes supreme.
lines.transliteration: tis bh ag-utee kee mat  ootam hovai.

lines.english: He constantly performs the service of the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: bhagvant  kee tahal karai nit  neet.

lines.english: He dedicates his mind and body to the Love of God.
lines.transliteration: man tan arpai bisan pareet .

lines.english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide in his heart.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan hirdai basaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, such a Bhagaautee attains the Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak aisaa bhag-ut ee bh agvant  ka-o paavai. ||3||

lines.english: He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.
lines.transliteration: so pandit jo man parboDh ai.

lines.english: He searches for the Lord's Name within his own soul.
lines.transliteration: raam naam aatam meh soDh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ  ਭਗਉਤੀ  ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam naam saar ras peevai.

lines.english: By that Pandit's teachings, the world lives.
lines.transliteration: us pandit kai upd ays jag jeevai.

lines.english: He implants the Sermon of the Lord in his heart.
lines.transliteration: har kee kathaa hirdai basaavai.

lines.english: Such a Pandit is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: so pandit fir jon na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਸੁ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He understands the fundamental essence of the Vedas, the Puraanas and theSimritees.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  boojh ai mool.

lines.english: In the unmanifest, he sees the manifest world to exist.
lines.transliteration: sookham meh jaanai asthool.

lines.english: He gives instruction to people of all castes and social classes.
lines.transliteration: chahu varnaa ka-o day upd ays.

lines.english: O Nanak, to such a Pandit, I bow in salutation forever. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak us pandit ka-o sad aa ad ays. ||4||

lines.english: The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.
lines.transliteration: beej mantar sarab ko gi-aan.

lines.english: Anyone, from any class, may chant the Naam.
lines.transliteration: chahu varnaa meh japai ko-oo naam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਸੁ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.
lines.transliteration: jo jo japai tis kee gat  ho-ay.

lines.english: And yet, rare are those who attain it, in the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang paavai jan ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ  ਮਿਹ ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, He enshrines it within.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa antar ur Dh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Even beasts, ghosts and the stone-hearted are saved.
lines.transliteration: pas parayt mugh ad paathar ka-o t aarai.

lines.english: The Naam is the panacea, the remedy to cure all ills.
lines.transliteration: sarab rog kaa a-ukhad  naam.

lines.english: Singing the Glory of God is the embodiment of bliss and emancipation.
lines.transliteration: kali-aan roop mangal gun  gaam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੁ ਪਰ੍ੇਤ  ਮੁਘਦ  ਪਾਥਰ  ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: It cannot be obtained by any religious rituals.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo jugat kit ai na paa-ee-ai Dh aram.

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone obtains it, whose karma is so pre-ordained. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak tis milai jis likh i-aa Dh ur karam. ||5||

lines.english: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God pMnw 275
lines.transliteration: jis kai man paarbarahm kaa nivaas.
tis kaa naam sat  raamd aas. - his name is truly Ram Das, the Lord's servant.

lines.english: He comes to have the Vision of the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
lines.transliteration: aatam raam t is nad ree aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Deeming himself to be the slave of the Lord's slaves, he obtains it.
lines.transliteration: daas d asant an bhaa-ay t in paa-i-aa.

lines.english: He knows the Lord to be Ever-present, close at hand.
lines.transliteration: sadaa nikat nikat har jaan.

lines.english: Such a servant is honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so daas d argeh parvaan.

lines.english: To His servant, He Himself shows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: apunay daas ka-o aap kirpaa karai.

lines.english: Such a servant understands everything.
lines.transliteration: tis daas ka-o sabh  sojhee parai.

lines.english: Amidst all, his soul is unattached.
lines.transliteration: sagal sang aatam ud aas.

lines.english: Such is the way, O Nanak, of the Lord's servant. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aisee jugat naanak raamd aas. ||6||

lines.english: One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,
lines.transliteration: parabh kee aagi-aa aat am hit aavai.
jeevan mukat so-oo kahaavai. is said to be Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

lines.english: As is joy, so is sorrow to him.
lines.transliteration: taisaa harakh  taisaa us sog.

lines.english: He is in eternal bliss, and is not separated from God.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand t ah nahee bi-og.

lines.english: As is gold, so is dust to him.
lines.transliteration: taisaa suvran t aisee us maatee.

lines.english: As is ambrosial nectar, so is bitter poison to him.
lines.transliteration: taisaa amrit  taisee bikh  khaatee.

lines.english: As is honor, so is dishonor.
lines.transliteration: taisaa maan t aisaa abh imaan.

lines.english: As is the beggar, so is the king.
lines.transliteration: taisaa rank t aisaa raajaan.

lines.english: Whatever God ordains, that is his way.
lines.transliteration: jo vartaa-ay saa-ee jugat .

lines.english: O Nanak, that being is known as Jivan Mukta. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak oh purakh kahee-ai jeevan mukat . ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kay saglay thaa-o.

lines.english: According to the homes in which they are placed, so are His creatures named.
lines.transliteration: jit jit ghar raakh ai taisaa t in naa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: aapay karan karaavan jog.

lines.english: Whatever pleases God, ultimately comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aavai so-ee fun hog.

lines.english: He Himself is All-pervading, in endless waves.
lines.transliteration: pasri-o aap ho-ay anat t arang.

lines.english: The playful sport of the Supreme Lord God cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: lakhay na jaahi paarbarahm kay rang.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.english: As the understanding is given, so is one enlightened.
lines.transliteration: jaisee mat d ay-ay t aisaa pargaas.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Creator, is eternal and everlasting.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kartaa abinaas.

lines.english: Forever, forever and ever, He is merciful.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sad aa da-i-aal.

lines.english: Remembering Him, remembering Him in meditation, O Nanak, one is blessed with ecstasy. ||8||9|| sloku ] (275-10) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: simar simar naanak bha-ay nihaal. ||8||9||

lines.english: Many people praise the Lord. He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: ustat karahi anayk jan ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, God created the creation, with its many ways and various species. ||1|| AstpdI ] (275-11) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak rachnaa parabh rachee baho biDh  anik parkaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਜਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Many millions are His devotees.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot ho-ay poojaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਚਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਰਚੀ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Many millions perform religious rituals and worldly duties.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot aachaar bi-uhaaree.

lines.english: Many millions become dwellers at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot bha-ay t irath vaasee.

lines.english: Many millions wander as renunciates in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot ban bharmeh ud aasee.

lines.english: Many millions listen to the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot bayd kay sarot ay.

lines.english: Many millions become austere penitents.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot tapeesur hot ay.

lines.english: Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot aatam Dh i-aan Dh aareh.

lines.english: Many millions of poets contemplate Him through poetry.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot kab kaab beechaareh.

lines.english: Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot navtan naam Dh i-aavahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, none can find the limits of the Creator. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kartay kaa ant  na paavahi. ||1||

lines.english: Many millions become self-centered.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot bha-ay abh imaanee.

lines.english: Many millions are blinded by ignorance.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot anDh agi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Many millions are stone-hearted misers.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot kirpan kathor.

lines.english: Many millions are heartless, with dry, withered souls.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot abhig aat am nikor.

lines.english: Many millions steal the wealth of others.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot par darab ka-o hireh.

lines.english: Many millions slander others.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot par dookh naa karahi.

lines.english: Many millions struggle in Maya.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot maa-i-aa saram maahi.

lines.english: Many millions wander in foreign lands.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot pardays bh armaahi.

lines.english: Whatever God attaches them to - with that they are engaged.
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavhu t it tit lagnaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the workings of His creation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kartay kee jaanai kart aa rachnaa. ||2||

lines.english: Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot siDh jat ee jogee.

lines.english: Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot raajay ras bhogee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ  ਰਚਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot pankhee sarap upaa-ay.

lines.english: Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot paathar birakh nipjaa-ay.

lines.english: Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot pavan paan ee baisant ar.

lines.english: Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot days bh oo mandal.

lines.english: Many millions are the moons, suns and stars. pMnw 276
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot sasee-ar soor nakh-yat ar.

lines.english: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot dayv d aanav ind ar sir chh atar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਈ ਕੋਿਟ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ  ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਿਸਿਰ  ਛਤਰ੍ ॥
lines.english: He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree apnai soot Dh aarai.

lines.english: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak jis jis bhaavai t is tis nist aarai. ||3||

lines.english: Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot raajas taamas saat ak.

lines.english: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot bayd puraan simrit  ar saasat .

lines.punjabi: ਕਈ ਕੋਿਟ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ ਅਰ ੁ ਸਾਸਤ  ॥
lines.english: Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot kee-ay ratan samud .

lines.english: Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot naanaa parkaar jant.

lines.english: Many millions are made long-lived.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot kee-ay chir jeevay.

lines.english: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot giree mayr suvran theevay.

lines.english: Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - thegods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot jakh-y kinnar pisaach.

lines.english: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot bhoot  parayt  sookar marigaach.

lines.punjabi: ਕਈ ਕੋਿਟ ਭੂਤਪ ਰ੍ ੇ ਤ  ਸੂਕਰ ਿਮਰ੍ਗਾਚ  ॥
lines.english: He is near to all, and yet far from all;
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay nayrai sabh hoo tay door.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak aap alipat rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||4||

lines.english: Many millions inhabit the nether regions.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot paataal kay vaasee.

lines.english: Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot narak surag nivaasee.

lines.english: Many millions are born, live and die.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot janmeh jeeveh mareh.

lines.english: Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot baho jonee fireh.

lines.english: Many millions eat while sitting at ease.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot baithat  hee kh aahi.

lines.english: Many millions are exhausted by their labors.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot ghaaleh thak paahi.

lines.english: Many millions are created wealthy.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot kee-ay Dhanvant .

lines.english: Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot maa-i-aa meh chint.

lines.english: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.
lines.transliteration: jah jah bhaan aa tah tah raakh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ  ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh  parabh  kai haathay. ||5||

lines.english: Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot bha-ay bairaagee.

lines.english: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam naam sang tin liv laagee.

lines.english: Many millions are searching for God.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot parabh ka-o kh ojantay.

lines.english: Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: aatam meh paarbarahm lahant ay.

lines.english: Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot darsan parabh  pi-aas.

lines.english: They meet with God, the Eternal.
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o mili-o parabh  abinaas.

lines.english: Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot maageh satsang.

lines.english: They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm tin laagaa rang.

lines.english: Those with whom He Himself is pleased,
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o ho-ay aap suparsan.

lines.english: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan sad aa Dh an Dh an. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot khaan ee ar kh and.

lines.english: Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot akaas barahmand.

lines.english: Many millions are the divine incarnations.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot ho-ay avtaar.

lines.english: In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee jugat keeno bisthaar.

lines.english: So many times, He has expanded His expansion.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee baar pasri-o paasaar.

lines.english: Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa ik aykankaar.

lines.english: Many millions are created in various forms.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot keenay baho bhaat .

lines.english: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.
lines.transliteration: parabh t ay ho-ay parabh  maahi samaat .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: His limits are not known to anyone.
lines.transliteration: taa kaa ant  na jaanai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aapay aap naanak parabh so-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot paarbarahm kay daas.

lines.english: Their souls are enlightened.
lines.transliteration: tin hovat  aatam pargaas.

lines.english: Many millions know the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot tat  kay bayt ay.

lines.english: Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.
lines.transliteration: sadaa nihaarahi ayko nayt aray.

lines.english: Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot naam ras peeveh.

lines.english: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: amar bha-ay sad  sad hee jeeveh.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰ  ਭਏ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kot naam gun gaavahi.

lines.english: They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: aatam ras sukh  sahj samaaveh.

lines.english: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: apunay jan ka-o saas saas samaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10|| sloku ] (276-17) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak o-ay parmaysur kay pi-aaray. ||8||10||

lines.english: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  parabh  ayk hai d oosar naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky andall space. ||1|| AstpdI ] (276-19) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis balihaarn ai jal thal mahee-al so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan karnai jog.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That which pleases Him, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee hog.

lines.english: In an instant, He creates and destroys. pMnw 277
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa.

lines.english: He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: ant nahee kichh  paaraavaaraa.

lines.english: By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.
lines.transliteration: hukmay Dhaar aDh ar rahaavai.

lines.english: By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.
lines.transliteration: hukmay upjai hukam samaavai.

lines.english: By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.
lines.transliteration: hukmay ooch neech bi-uhaar.

lines.english: By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.
lines.transliteration: hukmay anik rang parkaar.

lines.english: Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.
lines.transliteration: kar kar daykh ai apnee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh meh rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: If it pleases God, one attains salvation.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aavai maanukh  gat paavai.

lines.english: If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aavai t aa paathar t araavai.

lines.english: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aavai bin saas t ay raakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
lines.english: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aavai t aa har gun  bhaakhai.

lines.english: If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aavai t aa pat it uDhaarai.

lines.english: He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.
lines.transliteration: aap karai aapan beechaarai.

lines.english: He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
lines.transliteration: duhaa siri-aa kaa aap su-aamee.

lines.english: He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: khaylai bigsai ant arjaamee.

lines.english: As He wills, He causes actions to be done.
lines.transliteration: jo bhaavai so kaar karaavai.

lines.english: Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak daristee avar na aavai. ||2||

lines.english: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?
lines.transliteration: kaho maanukh t ay ki-aa ho-ay aavai.

lines.english: Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.
lines.transliteration: is kai haath ho-ay taa sabh  kichh  lay-ay.

lines.english: Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karay-i.

lines.english: Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.
lines.transliteration: anjaanat bikh i-aa meh rachai.

lines.english: If they knew better, they would save themselves.
lines.transliteration: jay jaanat aapan aap bachai.

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa d ah dis Dhaavai.

lines.english: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.
lines.transliteration: nimakh maahi chaar kunt fir aavai.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis apnee bhagat  day-ay.

lines.english: - O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan naam milay-ay. ||3||

lines.english: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.
lines.transliteration: khin meh neech keet ka-o raaj.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm gareeb nivaaj.

lines.english: Even one who has never been seen at all,
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa darisat kachh oo na aavai.
tis tatkaal d ah dis paragtaavai. becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.

lines.english: And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o apunee karai bakhsees.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ  ਨ ਗਨੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kaa laykh aa na ganai jagd ees. - the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

lines.english: Soul and body are all His property.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is kee raas.

lines.english: Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at pooran barahm pargaas.

lines.english: He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.
lines.transliteration: apnee banat  aap banaa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevai daykh  badaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;
lines.transliteration: is kaa bal naahee is haath.
karan karaavan sarab ko naath. the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.

lines.english: The helpless beings are subject to His Command.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aakaaree bapuraa jee-o.

lines.english: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee fun thee-o.

lines.english: Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo ooch neech meh basai.

lines.english: Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo sog harakh rang hasai.

lines.english: Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo nind chind  bi-uhaar.

lines.english: Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions ofthe underworld.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo oobh akaas pa-i-aal.

lines.english: Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo baytaa barahm beechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak aap milaavanhaar. ||5||

lines.english: Sometimes, they dance in various ways.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo nirat karai baho bh aat.

lines.english: Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo so-ay rahai din raat .

lines.english: Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo mahaa kroDh bikraal.

lines.english: Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.
lines.transliteration: kabahooN sarab kee hot ravaal.

lines.english: Sometimes, they sit as great kings.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo ho-ay bahai bad raajaa.

lines.english: Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.
lines.transliteration: kabahu bhaykh aaree neech kaa saajaa.

lines.english: Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo apkeerat meh aavai.

lines.english: Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo bhalaa bh alaa kahaavai.

lines.english: As God keeps them, so they remain.
lines.transliteration: ji-o parabh raakh ai tiv hee rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak sach kahai. ||6||

lines.english: Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo ho-ay pandit karay bakh -yaan.

lines.english: Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo moniDhaaree laavai Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo tat t irath isnaan.

lines.english: Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo siDh saaDh ik mukh  gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਿਤ  ਪਤੰਗ  ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo keet hasat pat ang ho-ay jee-aa.

lines.english: They may wander and roam through countless incarnations. pMnw 278
lines.transliteration: anik jon bharmai bh armee-aa.

lines.english: In various costumes, like actors, they appear.
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop ji-o savaagee dikh aavai.

lines.english: As it pleases God, they dance.
lines.transliteration: ji-o parabh bh aavai t ivai nachaavai.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak doojaa avar na ko-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo saaDhsangat  ih paavai.

lines.english: From that place, he does not have to come back again.
lines.transliteration: us asthaan tay bahur na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ  ਤੇ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.
lines.transliteration: antar ho-ay gi-aan pargaas.

lines.english: That place does not perish.
lines.transliteration: us asthaan kaa nahee binaas.

lines.english: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the OneLord.
lines.transliteration: man tan naam rat ay ik rang.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sadaa baseh paarbarahm kai sang.

lines.english: As water comes to blend with water,
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal meh jal aa-ay khataanaa.
ti-o jot ee sang jot  samaanaa. his light blends into the Light.

lines.english: Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.
lines.transliteration: mit ga-ay gavan paa-ay bisraam.

lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11|| sloku ] (278-5) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh kai sad  kurbaan. ||8||11||

lines.english: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.
lines.transliteration: sukhee basai maskeenee-aa aap nivaar t alay.

lines.english: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride.||1|| AstpdI ] (278-6) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: baday baday ahaNkaaree-aa naanak garab galay. ||1||

lines.english: One who has the pride of power within,
lines.transliteration: jis kai antar raaj abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so narakpaatee hovat  su-aan. shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.

lines.english: One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,
lines.transliteration: jo jaanai mai jobanvant.
so hovat bistaa kaa jant . shall become a maggot in manure.

lines.english: One who claims to act virtuously,
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o karamvant kahaavai.
janam marai baho jon bharmaavai. shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

lines.english: Dhan bh oom kaa jo karai gumaan. One who takes pride in wealth and lands

lines.transliteration: so moorakh anDh aa agi-aan. is a fool, blind and ignorant.

lines.english: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis kai hirdai gareebee basaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਭੂਿਮ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨ ੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak eehaa mukat aagai sukh  paavai. ||1||

lines.english: Dhanvant aa ho-ay kar garbaavai. One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

lines.transliteration: tarin samaan kachh  sang na jaavai. - not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਈਹਾ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਆਗੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,
lines.transliteration: baho laskar maanukh oopar karay aas.
pal bheet ar taa kaa ho-ay binaas. but he shall vanish in an instant.

lines.english: One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay aap jaanai balvant .
khin meh ho-ay jaa-ay bh asmant . in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ  ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self
lines.transliteration: kisai na badai aap ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay t is karay kh u-aaree. - the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.
One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jaa kaa mitai abh imaan.

lines.english: O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so jan naanak dargeh parvaan. ||2||

lines.english: If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,
lines.transliteration: kot karam karai ha-o Dhaaray.
saram paavai saglay birthaaray. he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.

lines.english: If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,
lines.transliteration: anik tapasi-aa karay ahaNkaar.
narak surag fir fir avtaar. he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

lines.english: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar aat am nahee d arvai.
har dargeh kaho kaisay gavai. - how can he go to the Court of the Lord?

lines.english: One who calls himself good
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o jo bhalaa kahaavai.
tiseh bh alaa-ee nikat na aavai. - goodness shall not draw near him.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਆਤਮ  ਨਹੀ ਦਰ੍ਵੈ ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is the dust of all
lines.transliteration: sarab kee rayn jaa kaa man ho-ay.
kaho naanak taa kee nirmal so-ay. ||3|| - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||

lines.english: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,
lines.transliteration: jab lag jaanai mujh t ay kachh  ho-ay.
tab is ka-o sukh  naahee ko-ay. he shall have no peace.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,
lines.transliteration: jab ih jaanai mai kichh kart aa.
tab lag garabh  jon meh firt aa. he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,
lines.transliteration: jab Dhaarai ko-oo bairee meet .

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab lag nihchal naahee cheet . his mind shall not come to rest.

lines.english: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,
lines.transliteration: jab lag moh magan sang maa-ay.
tab lag Dh aram raa-ay d ay-ay sajaa-ay. the Righteous Judge shall punish him.

lines.english: By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay banDh an tootai.
gur parsaad naanak ha-o chh ootai. ||4|| by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand. pMnw 279
lines.transliteration: sahas khatay lakh  ka-o uth  Dhaavai.
