lines.english: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.
lines.transliteration: taripat  na aavai maa-i-aa paachh ai paavai.

lines.english: He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,
lines.transliteration: anik bhog bikh i-aa kay karai.
nah taript aavai kh ap kh ap marai. but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.

lines.english: Without contentment, no one is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: binaa santokh  nahee ko-oo raajai.

lines.english: Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.
lines.transliteration: supan manorath barithay sabh kaajai.

lines.english: Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: naam rang sarab sukh ho-ay.

lines.english: Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: badbhaagee kisai paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.english: He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan aapay aap.

lines.english: Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa naanak har jaap. ||5||

lines.english: The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan karnaihaar.

lines.english: What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?
lines.transliteration: is kai haath kahaa beechaar.

lines.english: As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.
lines.transliteration: jaisee darisat karay t aisaa ho-ay.

lines.english: God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap aap parabh so-ay.

lines.english: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh keeno so apnai rang.

lines.english: He is far from all, and yet with all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay door sabh hoo kai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਿਰ ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.
lines.transliteration: boojhai d aykhai karai bibayk.

lines.english: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.
lines.transliteration: aapeh ayk aapeh anayk.

lines.english: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.
lines.transliteration: marai na binsai aavai na jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak sad hee rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.
lines.transliteration: aap updaysai samjh ai aap.

lines.english: He Himself mingles with all.
lines.transliteration: aapay rachi-aa sabh kai saath.

lines.english: He Himself created His own expanse.
lines.transliteration: aap keeno aapan bisthaar.

lines.english: All things are His; He is the Creator.
lines.transliteration: sabh kachh  us kaa oh karnaihaar.

lines.english: Without Him, what could be done?
lines.transliteration: us tay bh inn kahhu kichh  ho-ay.

lines.english: In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar aykai so-ay.

lines.english: In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.
lines.transliteration: apunay chalit aap karn aihaar.

lines.english: He produces His plays with infinite variety.
lines.transliteration: ka-utak karai rang aapaar.

lines.english: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.
lines.transliteration: man meh aap man apunay maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak keemat kahan na jaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sat sat  sat parabh  su-aamee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kinai vakh i-aanee.

lines.english: True, True, True is the Creator of all.
lines.transliteration: sach sach sach sabh keenaa.

lines.english: Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay kinai birlai cheenaa.

lines.english: Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.
lines.transliteration: bhalaa bh alaa bh alaa t ayraa roop.

lines.english: You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.
lines.transliteration: at sund ar apaar anoop.

lines.english: Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,
lines.transliteration: nirmal nirmal nirmal tayree ban ee.
ghat gh at sunee sarvan bakh -yaan ee. heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.

lines.english: Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure
lines.transliteration: pavitar pavit ar pavit ar puneet .

lines.english: Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naam japai naanak man pareet. ||8||12|| - chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12|| sloku ] (279-12) salok.

lines.english: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: sant saran jo jan parai so jan uDh ranhaar.

lines.english: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again.||1|| AstpdI ] (279-14) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: sant kee nind aa naankaa bahur bahur avt aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਿਨ  ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan aarjaa gh atai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan jam t ay nahee chh utai.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan sukh  sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan narak meh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan mat  ho-ay maleen.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan sobh aa tay heen.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਨਰਕ  ਮਿਹ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.
lines.transliteration: sant kay hat ay ka-o rakh ai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਮਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ  ॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan thaan bh arsat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
lines.english: But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,
lines.transliteration: sant kirpaal kirpaa jay karai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak satsang nind ak bh ee tarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਥਾਨ ਭਰ੍ਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d ookhan tay mukh  bhavai.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.
lines.transliteration: santan kai d ookhan kaag ji-o lavai.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.
lines.transliteration: santan kai d ookhan sarap jon paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan tarigad  jon kirmaa-ay.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.
lines.transliteration: santan kai d ookhan tarisnaa meh jalai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਸਰਪ ਜੋਿਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan sabh  ko chh alai.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan tayj sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d ookhan neech neechaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
lines.english: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest. pMnw 280
lines.transliteration: sant d okhee kaa thaa-o ko naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak sant bh aavai t aa o-ay bh ee gat  paahi. ||2||

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa nind ak mahaa att aa-ee.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa nind ak kh in tikan na paa-ee.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa nind ak mahaa hat i-aaraa.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa nind ak parmaysur maaraa.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa nind ak raaj t ay heen.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa nind ak dukhee-aa ar d een.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.
lines.transliteration: sant kay nind ak ka-o sarab rog.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.
lines.transliteration: sant kay nind ak ka-o sad aa bijog.

lines.english: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.
lines.transliteration: sant kee nind aa dokh meh d okh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak sant bh aavai t aa us kaa bh ee ho-ay mokh . ||3||

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee sad aa apvit .

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee kisai kaa nahee mit .

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee ka-o daan laagai.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee ka-o sabh  ti-aagai.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee mahaa ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee sad aa bikaaree.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee janmai marai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ  ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.
lines.transliteration: sant kee d ookhnaa sukh  tay tarai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਾਉ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee ka-o naahee th aa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak sant bh aavai t aa la-ay milaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee aDh  beech t ay tootai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਿਕਤੈ  ਕਾਿਜ  ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee kit ai kaaj na pahoochai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਭਰ੍ਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee ka-o ud i-aan bh armaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee ujh arh paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅੰਤਰ  ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee ant ar tay thothaa.
ji-o saas binaa mirtak kee lothaa. like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee kee jarh  kichh  naahi.

lines.english: He himself must eat what he has planted.
lines.transliteration: aapan beej aapay hee khaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee ka-o avar na raakh anhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਿਰ ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak sant bh aavai t aa la-ay ubaar. ||5||

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee i-o billaa-ay.
ji-o jal bihoon machhulee t arhafrhaa-ay. - like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee bh ookhaa nahee raajai.
ji-o paavak eeDhan nahee Dh araapai. as fire is not satisfied by fuel.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee chh utai ikaylaa.
ji-o boo-aarh t il khayt maahi d uhaylaa. like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਧਰਮ  ਤੇ ਰਹਤ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee Dh aram t ay rahat .

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee sad  mithi-aa kahat .

lines.english: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.
lines.transliteration: kirat nind ak kaa Dh ur hee pa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bh aavai so-ee thi-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਿਬਗੜ  ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee bigarh  roop ho-ay jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee ka-o d argeh milai sajaa-ay.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee sad aa sahkaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He does not die, but he does not live either.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee na marai na jeevaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sant kay d okhee kee pujai na aasaa.

lines.english: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa d okhee uth  chalai niraasaa.

lines.english: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.
lines.transliteration: sant kai d okh na taristai ko-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;
lines.transliteration: jaisaa bhaavai t aisaa ko-ee ho-ay.
pa-i-aa kirat na maytai ko-ay. no one can erase their past actions.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak jaanai sachaa so-ay. ||7||

lines.english: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at tis kay oh karnaihaar.

lines.english: Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa tis ka-o namaskaar.

lines.english: Praise God, day and night.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee ust at karahu d in raat .

lines.english: Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.
lines.transliteration: tiseh Dh i-aavahu saas giraas.

lines.english: Everything happens as He wills.
lines.transliteration: sabh kachh  vartai tis kaa kee-aa.

lines.english: As He wills, so people become.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa karay taisaa ko thee-aa.

lines.english: He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.
lines.transliteration: apnaa khayl aap karnaihaar.

lines.english: Who else can speak or deliberate upon this? pMnw 281
lines.transliteration: doosar ka-un kahai beechaar.

lines.english: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karai tis aapan naam d ay-ay.

lines.english: Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13|| sloku ] (281-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: badbhaagee naanak jan say-ay. ||8||13||

lines.english: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!
lines.transliteration: tajahu si-aanap sur janhu simrahu har har raa-ay.

lines.english: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt andfear shall depart. ||1|| AstpdI ] (281-3) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: ayk aas har man rakhahu naanak d ookh bharam bh a-o jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਜਹੁ ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਸੁਿਰ ਜਨਹੁਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.
lines.transliteration: maanukh kee tayk barithee sabh  jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਆਸ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਰਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Great Giver is the One Lord God.
lines.transliteration: dayvan ka-o aykai bh agvaan.

lines.english: By His gifts, we are satisfied,
lines.transliteration: jis kai dee-ai rahai agh aa-ay.
bahur na tarisnaa laagai aa-ay. and we suffer from thirst no longer.

lines.english: The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.
lines.transliteration: maarai raakhai ayko aap.

lines.english: Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.
lines.transliteration: maanukh kai kichh  naahee haath.

lines.english: Understanding His Order, there is peace.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa hukam boojh  sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa naam rakh  kanth  paro-ay.

lines.english: Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar parabh so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak bighan na laagai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.
lines.transliteration: ustat man meh kar nirankaar.

lines.english: O my mind, make this your true occupation.
lines.transliteration: kar man mayray sat bi-uhaar.

lines.english: Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: nirmal rasnaa amrit pee-o.

lines.english: Your soul shall be forever peaceful.
lines.transliteration: sadaa suhaylaa kar layhi jee-o.

lines.english: With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: nainhu paykh th aakur kaa rang.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang binsai sabh  sang.

lines.english: With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: charan chala-o maarag gobind.

lines.english: Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.
lines.transliteration: miteh paap japee-ai har bind.

lines.english: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.
lines.transliteration: kar har karam sarvan har kathaa.

lines.english: In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har dargeh naanak oojal mathaa. ||2||

lines.english: Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,
lines.transliteration: badbhaagee t ay jan jag maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਮ  ਸਰ੍ਵਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har kay gun gaahi. who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.

lines.english: Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: raam naam jo karahi beechaar.
say Dhanvant  ganee sansaar. are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed
lines.transliteration: man tan mukh  boleh har mukh ee.
sadaa sad aa jaanhu t ay sukh ee. - know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.

lines.english: One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk ayk pachhaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: it ut kee oh sojh ee jaanai. understands this world and the next.

lines.english: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,
lines.transliteration: naam sang jis kaa man maani-aa.
naanak tineh niranjan jaani-aa. ||3|| the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad aapan aap sujh ai.
tis kee jaanhu t arisnaa bujh ai. know that then, his thirst is quenched.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har har jas kahat .

lines.english: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.
lines.transliteration: sarab rog tay oh har jan rahat .

lines.english: Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din keert an kayval bakh -yaan.

lines.english: In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.
lines.transliteration: garihsat meh so-ee nirbaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ  ॥
lines.english: One who places his hopes in the One Lord
lines.transliteration: ayk oopar jis jan kee aasaa.
tis kee katee-ai jam kee faasaa. - the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.

lines.english: One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kee jis man bhookh .

lines.english: O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak tiseh na laageh d ookh. ||4||

lines.english: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o har parabh man chit  aavai.
so sant suhaylaa nahee dulaavai. - that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.

lines.english: Those unto whom God has granted His Grace
lines.transliteration: jis parabh apunaa kirpaa karai.
so sayvak kaho kis tay darai. - who do those servants need to fear?

lines.english: As God is, so does He appear;
lines.transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa d aristaa-i-aa.
apunay kaaraj meh aap samaa-i-aa. in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.

lines.english: Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!
lines.transliteration: soDhat  soDh at soDh at seejh i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad t at sabh  boojh i-aa.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.
lines.transliteration: jab daykh -a-u t ab sabh  kichh  mool.

lines.english: O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak so sookham so-ee asthool. ||5||

lines.english: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.
lines.transliteration: nah kichh janmai nah kichh  marai.

lines.english: He Himself stages His own drama.
lines.transliteration: aapan chalit aap hee karai.

lines.english: Coming and going, seen and unseen,
lines.transliteration: aavan jaavan darisat an-d arisat.
aagi-aakaaree Dhaaree sabh  sarisat. all the world is obedient to His Will. pMnw 282

lines.english: He Himself is All-in-Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap sagal meh aap.

lines.english: In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: anik jugat rach thaap uthaap.

lines.english: He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee naahee kichh  khand.

lines.english: Dhaaran  Dhaar rahi-o barahmand. He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.
Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: alakh abh ayv purakh  partaap.

lines.english: As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aap japaa-ay ta naanak jaap. ||6||

lines.english: Those who know God are glorious.
lines.transliteration: jin parabh jaat aa so sobh aavant .

lines.english: The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.
lines.transliteration: sagal sansaar uDhrai t in mant .

lines.english: God's servants redeem all.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak sagal uDh aaran.

lines.english: God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak d ookh bisaaran.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl la-ay kirpaal.

lines.english: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad jap bh a-ay nihaal.

lines.english: He alone is committed to serve them,
lines.transliteration: un kee sayvaa so-ee laagai.
jis no kirpaa karahi badbhaagai. upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.

lines.english: Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.
lines.transliteration: naam japat paavahi bisraam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਉ ਊਤਮ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin purakh  ka-o oot am kar maan. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ  ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so parabh  kai rang.

lines.english: Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa basai har sang.

lines.english: By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay hovai so ho-ay.

lines.english: Acknowledge that Creator Lord;
lines.transliteration: karnaihaar pachh aanai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: parabh kaa kee-aa jan meeth  lagaanaa.

lines.english: As He is, so does He appear.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa d aristaanaa.

lines.english: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upjay t is maahi samaa-ay.

lines.english: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.
lines.transliteration: o-ay sukh niDh aan unhoo ban aa-ay.

lines.english: Unto His own, He has given His honor.
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o aap deeno maan.

lines.english: O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14|| sloku ] (282-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh jan ayko jaan. ||8||14||

lines.english: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa bharpoor parabh  birthaa jaananhaar.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1|| AstpdI ] (282-10) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran uDhree-ai naanak t is balihaar. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.
lines.transliteration: tootee gaadhanhaar gopaal.

lines.english: He Himself cherishes all beings.
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa aapay partipaal.

lines.english: The cares of all are on His Mind;
lines.transliteration: sagal kee chintaa jis man maahi.
tis tay birthaa ko-ee naahi. no one is turned away from Him.

lines.english: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray sadaa har jaap.

lines.english: The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee parabh  aapay aap.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,
lines.transliteration: aapan kee-aa kachhoo na ho-ay.
jay sa-o paraanee lochai ko-ay. even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

lines.english: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.
lines.transliteration: tis bin naahee t ayrai kichh  kaam.

lines.english: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gat naanak jap ayk har naam. ||1||

lines.english: One who is good-looking should not be vain;
lines.transliteration: roopvant ho-ay naahee mohai.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਿਪ ਏਕ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: parabh kee jot  sagal gh at sohai. the Light of God is in all hearts.

lines.english: Dhanvant aa ho-ay ki-aa ko garbai. Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: All riches are His gifts.
lines.transliteration: jaa sabh kichh  tis kaa d ee-aa d arbai.

lines.english: One may call himself a great hero,
lines.transliteration: at sooraa jay ko-oo kahaavai.
parabh kee kalaa binaa kah Dh aavai. but without God's Power, what can anyone do?

lines.english: One who brags about giving to charities
lines.transliteration: jay ko ho-ay bahai daat aar.
tis daynhaar jaanai gaavaar. - the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

lines.english: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego
lines.transliteration: jis gur parsaad t ootai ha-o rog.

lines.english: - O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak so jan sadaa arog. ||2||

lines.english: As a palace is supported by its pillars,
lines.transliteration: ji-o mandar ka-o thaamai thamman.
ti-o gur kaa sabad  maneh asthamman. so does the Guru's Word support the mind.

lines.english: As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,
lines.transliteration: ji-o paakhaan  naav charh  tarai.
paraanee gur charan  lagat  nistarai. so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.

lines.english: As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,
lines.transliteration: ji-o anDhkaar d eepak pargaas.
gur darsan d aykh man ho-ay bigaas. so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

lines.english: 5) ji-o mahaa udi-aan meh maarag paavai. t i-o saaDh oo sang mil jot  paragtaavai. The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.
I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;
lines.transliteration: tin sant an kee baachh a-o Dh oor.

lines.english: O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak kee har lochaa poor. ||3||

lines.english: O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail? pMnw 283
lines.transliteration: man moorakh kaahay billaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: purab likhay kaa likh i-aa paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: dookh  sookh  parabh  dayvanhaar.

lines.english: Abandon others, and think of Him alone.
lines.transliteration: avar ti-aag t oo tiseh chit aar.

lines.english: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.
lines.transliteration: jo kachh karai so-ee sukh  maan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa kaahay fireh ajaan.

lines.english: What things did you bring with you?
lines.transliteration: ka-un basat aa-ee t ayrai sang.

lines.english: You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.
lines.transliteration: lapat rahi-o ras lobhee pat ang.

lines.english: Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap hirday maahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak pat sayt ee gh ar jaahi. ||4||

lines.english: This merchandise, which you have come to obtai
lines.transliteration: jis vakhar ka-o lain t oo aa-i-aa.
raam naam santan gh ar paa-i-aa. n - the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.

lines.english: Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind, purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan layho man mol. raam naam hird ay meh t ol.

lines.english: Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.
lines.transliteration: laad kh ayp sant eh sang chaal.

lines.english: Give up other corrupt entanglements.
lines.transliteration: avar ti-aag bikh i-aa janjaal.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an kahai sabh  ko-ay. "Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,

lines.transliteration: mukh oojal har d argeh so-ay. and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.

lines.english: In this trade, only a few are trading.
lines.transliteration: ih vaapaar virlaa vaapaarai.

lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai sad  balihaarai. ||5||

lines.english: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.
lines.transliteration: charan saaDh kay Dh o-ay Dh o-ay pee-o.

lines.english: Dedicate your soul to the Holy.
lines.transliteration: arap saaDh ka-o apnaa jee-o.

lines.english: Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee Dh oor karahu isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.english: To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.
lines.transliteration: saaDh oopar jaa-ee-ai kurbaan.

lines.english: Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: saaDh sayvaa vadbh aagee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har keert an gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.
lines.transliteration: anik bighan t ay saaDh oo raakh ai.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay amrit ras chaakh ai.

lines.english: Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.
lines.transliteration: ot gahee santeh d ar aa-i-aa.

lines.english: All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh naanak t ih paa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
lines.english: He infuses life back into the dead.
lines.transliteration: mirtak ka-o jeevaalanhaar.

lines.english: He gives food to the hungry.
lines.transliteration: bhookh ay ka-o d ayvat  aDhaar.

lines.english: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan jaa kee d aristee maahi.

lines.english: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.
lines.transliteration: purab likhay kaa lahn aa paahi.

lines.english: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tis kaa oh karnai jog.

lines.english: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oosar ho-aa na hog.

lines.english: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.
lines.transliteration: jap jan sadaa sad aa din rain ee.

lines.english: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch nirmal ih karn ee.

lines.english: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis ka-o naam dee-aa.

lines.english: - O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak so jan nirmal thee-aa. ||7||

lines.english: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man gur kee parteet .
tis jan aavai har parabh  cheet . comes to dwell upon the Lord God.

lines.english: He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhagat sunee-ai t ihu lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is in his heart.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hirdai ayko ho-ay.

lines.english: True are his actions; true are his ways.
lines.transliteration: sach karnee sach t aa kee rahat .

lines.english: True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.
lines.transliteration: sach hirdai sat  mukh  kahat .

lines.english: True is his vision; true is his form.
lines.transliteration: saachee darisat saachaa aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ  ॥
lines.english: He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach vartai saachaa paasaar.

lines.english: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jin sach kar jaataa.

lines.english: - O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15|| sloku ] (283-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak so jan sach samaataa. ||8||15||

lines.english: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: roop na raykh na rang kichh  tarihu gun  tay parabh  bhinn.

lines.english: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1|| AstpdI ] (283-17) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: tiseh bujh aa-ay naankaa jis hovai suparsan. ||1||

lines.english: Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee parabh  man meh raakh .

lines.english: Renounce your love and attachment to people.
lines.transliteration: maanukh kee t oo pareet  ti-aag.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਭੰਨ ॥
lines.english: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.
lines.transliteration: tis tay parai naahee kichh  ko-ay.

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading among all.
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar ayko so-ay.

lines.english: He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,
lines.transliteration: aapay beenaa aapay daanaa.

lines.english: Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer gaheer sujaanaa.

lines.english: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysur gobind.
kirpaa niDhaan d a-i-aal bakh sand. the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.

lines.english: To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings pMnw 284
lines.transliteration: saaDh t ayray kee charnee paa-o.
naanak kai man ih anraa-o. ||1|| - this is the longing of Nanak's mind. ||1||

lines.english: He is the Fulfiller of wishes, who can give us Sanctuary;
lines.transliteration: mansaa pooran sarnaa jog.
jo kar paa-i-aa so-ee hog. that which He has written, comes to pass.

lines.english: He destroys and creates in the twinkling of an eye.
lines.transliteration: haran bharan jaa kaa nayt ar for.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਨ  ਭਰਨ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਫੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: No one else knows the mystery of His ways.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa mant ar na jaanai hor.

lines.english: He is the embodiment of ecstasy and everlasting joy.
lines.transliteration: anad roop mangal sad  jaa kai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ  ਸਦ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: I have heard that all things are in His home.
lines.transliteration: sarab thok sunee-ah ghar t aa kai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਥੋਕ ਸੁਨੀਅਿਹ  ਘਿਰ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: Among kings, He is the King; among yogis, He is the Yogi.
lines.transliteration: raaj meh raaj jog meh jogee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Among ascetics, He is the Ascetic; among householders, He is the Enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: tap meh t apeesar garihsat  meh bh ogee.

lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay Dh i-aa-ay bh agtah sukh  paa-i-aa. By constant meditation, His devotee finds peace.
O Nanak, no one has found the limits of that Supreme Being. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak tis purakh  kaa kinai ant  na paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਾ ਿਕਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There is no limit to His play.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee leelaa kee mit naahi.

lines.english: All the demigods have grown weary of searching for it.
lines.transliteration: sagal dayv haaray avgaahi.

lines.english: What does the son know of his father's birth?
lines.transliteration: pitaa kaa janam ke jaanai poot .

lines.english: All are strung upon His string.
lines.transliteration: sagal paro-ee apunai soot.

lines.english: He bestows good sense, spiritual wisdom and meditation on His humble servants and slaves who meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: sumat gi-aan Dh i-aan jin d ay-ay. jan d aas naam Dh i-aavahi say-ay.

lines.english: He leads some astray in the three qualities;
lines.transliteration: tihu gun  meh jaa ka-o bh armaa-ay.
janam marai fir aavai jaa-ay. they are born and die, coming and going over and over again.

lines.english: The high and the low are His places.
lines.transliteration: ooch neech tis kay asthaan.

lines.english: As He inspires us to know Him, O Nanak, so is He known. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa janaavai taisaa naanak jaan. ||3||

lines.english: Many are His forms; many are His colors.
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop naanaa jaa kay rang.

lines.english: Many are the appearances which He assumes, and yet He is still the One.
lines.transliteration: naanaa bhaykh  karahi ik rang.

lines.english: In so many ways, He has extended Himself.
lines.transliteration: naanaa biDh keeno bisthaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਰੂਪ ਨਾਨਾ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.english: The Eternal Lord God is the One, the Creator.
lines.transliteration: parabh abh inaasee aykankaar.

lines.english: He performs His many plays in an instant.
lines.transliteration: naanaa chalit karay kh in maahi.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord is pervading all places.
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-o pooran sabh th aa-ay.

lines.english: In so many ways, He created the creation.
lines.transliteration: naanaa biDh kar banat  banaa-ee.

lines.english: He alone can estimate His worth.
lines.transliteration: apnee keemat aapay paa-ee.

lines.english: All hearts are His, and all places are His.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at tis kay sabh  tis kay th aa-o.

lines.english: Nanak lives by chanting, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeevai naanak har naa-o. ||4||

lines.english: The Naam is the Support of all creatures.
lines.transliteration: naam kay Dhaaray saglay jant .

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is the Support of the earth and solar systems.
lines.transliteration: naam kay Dhaaray kh and barahmand.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Naam is the Support of the Simritees, the Vedas and the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: naam kay Dhaaray simrit  bayd  puraan.

lines.english: The Naam is the Support by which we hear of spiritual wisdom and meditation.
lines.transliteration: naam kay Dhaaray sunan gi-aan Dh i-aan.

lines.english: The Naam is the Support of the Akaashic ethers and the nether regions.
lines.transliteration: naam kay Dhaaray aagaas paat aal.

lines.english: The Naam is the Support of all bodies.
lines.transliteration: naam kay Dhaaray sagal aakaar.

lines.english: The Naam is the Support of all worlds and realms.
lines.transliteration: naam kay Dhaaray puree-aa sabh  bhavan.

lines.english: Associating with the Naam, listening to it with the ears, one is saved.
lines.transliteration: naam kai sang uDhray sun sarvan.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord mercifully attaches to His Naam
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis aapnai naam laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ  ਸਭ ਭਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: - O Nanak, in the fourth state, those humble servants attain salvation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak cha-uthay pad meh so jan gat  paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਰੇ ਸੁਿਨ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: His form is true, and true is His place.
lines.transliteration: roop sat jaa kaa sat  asthaan.

lines.english: His personality is true - He alone is supreme.
lines.transliteration: purakh sat  kayval parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਉਥੇ  ਪਦ ਮਿਹ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.english: His acts are true, and true is His Word.
lines.transliteration: kartoot  sat sat jaa kee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਿਤ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is permeating all.
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  sabh  maahi samaan ee.

lines.english: True are His actions; His creation is true.
lines.transliteration: sat karam jaa kee rachnaa sat .

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤੂਿਤ  ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: His root is true, and true is what originates from it.
lines.transliteration: mool sat sat  utpat.

lines.english: True is His lifestyle, the purest of the pure.
lines.transliteration: sat karn ee nirmal nirmalee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਕਰਮੁ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ  ਸਿਤ ॥
lines.english: All goes well for those who know Him.
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaa-ay t iseh sabh  bhalee.

lines.english: The True Name of God is the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: sat naam parabh  kaa sukh -daa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak has obtained true faith from the Guru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bisvaas sat naanak gur t ay paa-ee. ||6||

lines.english: True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: sat bachan saaDh oo upd ays.

lines.english: True are those into whose hearts He enters.
lines.transliteration: sat tay jan jaa kai rid ai parvays.

lines.english: One who knows and loves the Truth
lines.transliteration: sat nirat  boojh ai jay ko-ay.
naam japat t aa kee gat  ho-ay. - chanting the Naam, he obtains salvation.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਰਦੈ ਪਰ੍ਵੇਸ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is True, and all that He has made is true.
lines.transliteration: aap sat kee-aa sabh  sat.

lines.english: He Himself knows His own state and condition. pMnw 285
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai apnee mit gat .

lines.english: He is the Creator Lord of His world.
lines.transliteration: jis kee sarisat so karnaihaar.

lines.english: No one else understands Him, although they may try.
lines.transliteration: avar na boojh karat  beechaar.

lines.english: The created cannot know the extent of the Creator.
lines.transliteration: kartay kee mit  na jaanai kee-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bh aavai so vart ee-aa. ||7||

lines.english: Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!
lines.transliteration: bisman bisam bha-ay bismaad .

lines.english: One who realizes this, comes to taste this state of joy.
lines.transliteration: jin boojhi-aa t is aa-i-aa savaad .

lines.english: God's humble servants remain absorbed in His Love.
lines.transliteration: parabh kai rang raach jan rahay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਿਚ  ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, they receive the four cardinal blessings.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan padaarath lahay.

lines.english: They are the givers, the dispellers of pain.
lines.transliteration: o-ay daat ay dukh kaatanhaar.

lines.english: In their company, the world is saved.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sang tarai sansaar.

lines.english: The slave of the Lord's servant is so very blessed.
lines.transliteration: jan kaa sayvak so vadbhaagee.

lines.english: In the company of His servant, one becomes attached to the Love of the One.
lines.transliteration: jan kai sang ayk liv laagee.

lines.english: His humble servant sings the Kirtan, the songs of the glory of God.
lines.transliteration: gun gobid keert an jan gaavai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, he receives the fruits of his rewards. ||8||16|| sloku ] (285-5) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak fal paavai. ||8||16||

lines.english: True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,
lines.transliteration: aad sach jugaad  sach.

lines.english: True here and now. O Nanak, He shall forever be True. ||1|| AstpdI ] (285-6) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: hai bhe sach naanak hosee bh e sach. ||1||

lines.english: His Lotus Feet are True, and True are those who touch Them.
lines.transliteration: charan sat sat  parsanhaar.

lines.english: His devotional worship is True, and True are those who worship Him.
lines.transliteration: poojaa sat sat  sayvd aar.

lines.english: The Blessing of His Vision is True, and True are those who behold it.
lines.transliteration: darsan sat  sat paykh anhaar.

lines.english: His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.
lines.transliteration: naam sat sat  Dhi-aavanhaar.

lines.english: He Himself is True, and True is all that He sustains.
lines.transliteration: aap sat sat  sabh  Dhaaree.

lines.english: He Himself is virtuous goodness, and He Himself is the Bestower of virtue.
lines.transliteration: aapay gun aapay gun kaaree.

lines.english: The Word of His Shabad is True, and True are those who speak of God.
lines.transliteration: sabad sat  sat parabh  baktaa.

lines.english: Those ears are True, and True are those who listen to His Praises.
lines.transliteration: surat sat  sat jas sunt aa.

lines.english: All is True to one who understands.
lines.transliteration: bujhanhaar ka-o sat  sabh  ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, True, True is He, the Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sat sat  parabh  so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart
lines.transliteration: sat saroop rid ai jin maani-aa.
karan karaavan tin mool pachh aani-aa. recognizes the Cause of causes as the Root of all.

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with faith in God
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ridai bisvaas parabh  aa-i-aa.
tat gi-aan t is man paragtaa-i-aa. - the essence of spiritual wisdom is revealed to his mind.

lines.english: Coming out of fear, he comes to live without fear.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay nirbh a-o ho-ay basaanaa.

lines.english: He is absorbed into the One, from whom he originated.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upji-aa t is maahi samaanaa.

lines.english: When something blends with its own,
lines.transliteration: basat maahi lay basat  gadaa-ee.
taa ka-o bh inn na kahnaa jaa-ee. it cannot be said to be separate from it.

lines.english: This is understood only by one of discerning understanding.
lines.transliteration: boojhai boojh anhaar bibayk.

lines.english: Meeting with the Lord, O Nanak, he becomes one with Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naaraa-in milay naanak ayk. ||2||

lines.english: The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: thaakur kaa sayvak aagi-aakaaree.

lines.english: The servant worships his Lord and Master forever.
lines.transliteration: thaakur kaa sayvak sad aa poojaaree.

lines.english: The servant of the Lord Master has faith in his mind.
lines.transliteration: thaakur kay sayvak kai man part eet.

lines.english: The servant of the Lord Master lives a pure lifestyle.
lines.transliteration: thaakur kay sayvak kee nirmal reet .

lines.english: The servant of the Lord Master knows that the Lord is with him.
lines.transliteration: thaakur ka-o sayvak jaanai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: God's servant is attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parabh kaa sayvak naam kai rang.

lines.english: God is the Cherisher of His servant.
lines.transliteration: sayvak ka-o parabh paalanhaaraa.

lines.english: The Formless Lord preserves His servant.
lines.transliteration: sayvak kee raakhai nirankaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: Unto His servant, God bestows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: so sayvak jis da-i-aa parabh  Dhaarai.

lines.english: O Nanak, that servant remembers Him with each and every breath. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak so sayvak saas saas samaarai. ||3||

lines.english: He covers the faults of His servant.
lines.transliteration: apunay jan kaa pardaa dh aakai.

lines.english: He surely preserves the honor of His servant.
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak kee sarpar raakhai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਮਾਰੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He blesses His slave with greatness.
lines.transliteration: apnay daas ka-o d ay-ay vadaa-ee.

lines.english: He inspires His servant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak ka-o naam japaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servant.
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak kee aap pat raakh ai.

lines.english: No one knows His state and extent.
lines.transliteration: taa kee gat  mit ko-ay na laakh ai.

lines.english: No one is equal to the servant of God.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak ka-o ko na pahoochai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੀ ਆਿਪ  ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.english: The servant of God is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak ooch t ay oochay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੈ  ॥
lines.english: One whom God applies to His own service, O Nanak
lines.transliteration: jo parabh apnee sayvaa laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so sayvak dah d is paragtaa-i-aa. ||4|| - that servant is famous in the ten directions. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
lines.english: He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;
lines.transliteration: neekee keeree meh kal raakhai.
bhasam karai laskar kot laakh ai. it can then reduce the armies of millions to ashes

lines.english: Those whose breath of life He Himself does not take away pMnw 286
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saas na kaadhat  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ  ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: - He preserves them, and holds out His Hands to protect them.
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o raakh at day kar haath.

lines.english: You may make all sorts of efforts,
lines.transliteration: maanas jatan karat  baho bh aat.
tis kay kart ab birthay jaat . but these attempts are in vain.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਵਰ ੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: No one else can kill or preserve
lines.transliteration: maarai na raakhai avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: - He is the Protector of all beings.
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa kaa raakhaa so-ay.

lines.english: So why are you so anxious, O mortal?
lines.transliteration: kaahay soch karahi ray paraanee.

lines.english: Meditate, O Nanak, on God, the invisible, the wonderful! ||5||
lines.transliteration: jap naanak parabh alakh  vidaan ee. ||5||

lines.english: Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: baaraN baar baar parabh japee-ai.

lines.english: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: pee amrit ih man t an Dh arpee-ai.

lines.english: The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;
lines.transliteration: naam ratan jin gurmukh  paa-i-aa.
tis kichh  avar naahee d aristaa-i-aa. they see no other than God.

lines.english: Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhan naamo roop rang.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.
lines.transliteration: naamo sukh har naam kaa sang.

lines.english: Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam
lines.transliteration: naam ras jo jan taript aanay.
man tan naameh naam samaanay. - their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.

lines.english: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sovat  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jan kai sad kaam. ||6|| says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||

lines.english: Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.
lines.transliteration: bolhu jas jihbaa din raat .

lines.english: God Himself has given this gift to His servants.
lines.transliteration: parabh apnai jan keenee d aat.

lines.english: Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,
lines.transliteration: karahi bhagat  aatam kai chaa-ay.
parabh apnay si-o raheh samaa-ay. they remain absorbed in God Himself.

lines.english: They know the past and the present.
lines.transliteration: jo ho-aa hovat so jaanai.

lines.english: They recognize God's Own Command.
lines.transliteration: parabh apnay kaa hukam pachh aanai.

lines.english: Who can describe His Glory?
lines.transliteration: tis kee mahimaa ka-un bakh aana-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਿਹ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa gun kahi ayk na jaan-o.

lines.english: Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  baseh hajooray.
kaho naanak say-ee jan pooray. ||7|| - says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

lines.english: O my mind, seek their protection;
lines.transliteration: man mayray tin kee ot layhi.
man tan apnaa t in jan d eh. give your mind and body to those humble beings.

lines.english: Those humble beings who recognizes God
lines.transliteration: jin jan apnaa parabhoo pachh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ  ਥੋਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: so jan sarab thok kaa daat aa. are the givers of all things.

lines.english: In His Sanctuary, all comforts are obtained.
lines.transliteration: tis kee saran sarab sukh  paavahi.

lines.english: By the Blessing of His Darshan, all sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: tis kai d aras sabh  paap mitaaveh.

lines.english: So renounce all other clever devices,
lines.transliteration: avar si-aanap saglee chhaad.
tis jan kee t oo sayvaa laag. and enjoin yourself to the service of those servants.

lines.english: Your comings and goings shall be ended.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan na hovee tayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਸਦ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, worship the feet of God's humble servants forever. ||8||17|| sloku ] (286-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis jan kay poojahu sad  pairaa. ||8||17||

lines.english: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  jin jaani-aa sat gur tis kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਜਿਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.||1|| AstpdI ] (286-13) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: tis kai sang sikh  uDhrai naanak har gun gaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਸਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.
lines.transliteration: satgur sikh  kee karai part ipaal.

lines.english: The Guru is always merciful to His servant.
lines.transliteration: sayvak ka-o gur sadaa d a-i-aal.

lines.english: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.
lines.transliteration: sikh kee gur d urmat  mal hirai.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee har naam uchrai.

lines.english: The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.
lines.transliteration: satgur sikh  kay banDh an kaatai.

lines.english: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sikh bikaar t ay haatai.

lines.english: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: satgur sikh  ka-o naam Dh an day-ay.

lines.english: The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sikh vadbh aagee hay.

lines.english: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.
lines.transliteration: satgur sikh  kaa halat  palat  savaarai.

lines.english: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur sikh  ka-o jee-a naal samaarai. ||1||

lines.english: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,
lines.transliteration: gur kai garihi sayvak jo rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਸਖ ਕਉ ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਸਮਾਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee aagi-aa man meh sahai. is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

lines.english: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o kar kachh na janaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har naam ridai sad  Dhi-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਸ  ਕਉ ਕਿਰ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who sells his mind to the True Guru
lines.transliteration: man baychai satgur kai paas.
tis sayvak kay kaaraj raas. - that humble servant's affairs are resolved.

lines.english: One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,
lines.transliteration: sayvaa karat ho-ay nihkaamee.
tis ka-o hot  paraapat  su-aamee. shall attain his Lord and Master. pMnw 287

lines.english: He Himself grants His Grace;
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa jis aap karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak so sayvak gur kee mat lay-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent
lines.transliteration: bees bisvay gur kaa man maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sayvak parmaysur kee gat jaanai. - that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

lines.english: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so satgur jis rid ai har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: anik baar gur ka-o bal jaa-o.

lines.english: He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan jee-a kaa d aataa.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar paarbarahm rang raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮਿਹ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ॥
lines.english: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.
lines.transliteration: barahm meh jan jan meh paarbarahm.

lines.english: He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.
lines.transliteration: aykeh aap nahee kachh bh aram.

lines.english: By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.
lines.transliteration: sahas si-aanap la-i-aa na jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak aisaa gur badbhaagee paa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.
lines.transliteration: safal darsan paykh at puneet .

lines.english: Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.
lines.transliteration: parsat charan gat  nirmal reet .

lines.english: Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,
lines.transliteration: bhaytat  sang raam gun ravay.
paarbarahm kee dargeh gavay. and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.

lines.english: Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: sun kar bachan karan aaghaanay.

lines.english: The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: man santokh  aatam pat ee-aanay.

lines.english: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.
lines.transliteration: pooraa gur akh-ya-o jaa kaa mant ar.

lines.english: Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.
lines.transliteration: amrit d arisat paykh ai ho-ay sant .

lines.english: Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.
lines.transliteration: gun bi-ant  keemat  nahee paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bhaavai t is la-ay milaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.
lines.transliteration: jihbaa ayk ustat  anayk.

lines.english: The True Lord, of perfect perfection - no speech can take the mortal to Him.
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  pooran bibayk. kaahoo bol na pahuchat  paraanee.

lines.english: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar parabh nirbaanee.

lines.english: He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: niraahaar nirvair sukh-d aa-ee.

lines.english: No one can estimate His worth.
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kinai na paa-ee.

lines.english: Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.
lines.transliteration: anik bhagat  band an nit  karahi.

lines.english: In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal hirdai simrahi.

lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaree sat gur apnay.
naanak jis parsaad aisaa parabh  japnay. ||5|| by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||

lines.english: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ih har ras paavai jan ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.
lines.transliteration: amrit peevai amar so ho-ay.

lines.english: That person whose mind is illuminated by the treasure of excellence, never dies.
lines.transliteration: us purakh kaa naahee kad ay binaas. jaa kai man pargatay gunt aas.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har kaa naam lay-ay.

lines.english: The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.
lines.transliteration: sach updays sayvak ka-o d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: moh maa-i-aa kai sang na layp.

lines.english: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man meh raakhai har har ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
lines.english: In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.
lines.transliteration: anDhkaar d eepak pargaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak bharam moh d ukh tah tay naasay. ||6||

lines.english: In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.
lines.transliteration: tapat maahi th aadh vartaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-i-aa d ukh naath ay bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The fear of birth and death is dispelled,
lines.transliteration: janam maran kay mitay andaysay.
saaDhoo kay pooran upd aysay. by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.

lines.english: Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.
lines.transliteration: bha-o chookaa nirbh a-o ho-ay basay.

lines.english: All evils are dispelled from the mind.
lines.transliteration: sagal bi-aaDh man t ay kh ai nasay.

lines.english: He takes us into His favor as His own.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tin kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jap naam muraaree.

lines.english: Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,
lines.transliteration: thit paa-ee chookay bh aram gavan.

lines.english: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sun naanak har har jas sarvan. ||7||

lines.english: He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.
lines.transliteration: nirgun aap sargun bhee ohee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.
lines.transliteration: kalaa Dhaar jin saglee mohee.

lines.english: God Himself sets His play in motion.
lines.transliteration: apnay charit parabh  aap banaa-ay.

lines.english: Only He Himself can estimate His worth.
lines.transliteration: apunee keemat aapay paa-ay.

lines.english: There is none, other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bin doojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: Permeating all, He is the One.
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar ayko so-ay.

lines.english: Through and through, He pervades in form and color.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  ravi-aa roop rang.

lines.english: He is revealed in the Company of the Holy. pMnw 288
lines.transliteration: bha-ay pargaas saaDh  kai sang.

lines.english: Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.
lines.transliteration: rach rachnaa apnee kal Dhaaree.

lines.english: So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18|| sloku ] (288-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: anik baar naanak balihaaree. ||8||18||

lines.english: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.
lines.transliteration: saath na chaalai bin bhajan bikh i-aa saglee chh aar.

lines.english: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1|| AstpdI ] (288-3) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: har har naam kamaavanaa naanak ih Dhan saar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਜਨ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil karahu beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁਧਨੁਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayk simar naam aaDhaar.

lines.english: Forget all other efforts, O my friend
lines.transliteration: avar upaav sabh meet  bisaarahu.
charan kamal rid meh ur Dh aarahu. - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.

lines.english: God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran so parabh samrath.

lines.english: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: darirh  kar gahhu naam har vath.

lines.english: Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: ih Dhan sanchahu hovhu bh agvant .

lines.english: Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kaa nirmal mant .

lines.english: Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.
lines.transliteration: ayk aas raakho man maahi.

lines.english: All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab rog naanak mit jaahi. ||1||

lines.english: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions
lines.transliteration: jis Dhan ka-o chaar kunt uth  Dhaaveh.
so Dhan har sayvaa t ay paavahi. - you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

lines.english: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend
lines.transliteration: jis sukh ka-o nit  baachh eh meet .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੁੰਟ ਉਿਠ ਧਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: so sukh saaDh oo sang pareet . - that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The glory, for which you perform good deeds
lines.transliteration: jis sobhaa ka-o karahi bh alee karnee.
saa sobhaa bh aj har kee sarnee. - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.

lines.english: All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease
lines.transliteration: anik upaavee rog na jaa-ay.
rog mitai har avkhaDh  laa-ay. - the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan meh har naam niDh aan.

lines.english: Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jap naanak dargahi parvaan. ||2||

lines.english: Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man parboDhahu har kai naa-ay.

lines.english: Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.
lines.transliteration: dah d is Dhaavat  aavai th aa-ay.

lines.english: No obstacle stands in the way of one
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o bigh an na laagai ko-ay.
jaa kai ridai basai har so-ay. whose heart is filled with the Lord.

lines.english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.
lines.transliteration: kal taat ee thaaNdhaa har naa-o.

lines.english: Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.
lines.transliteration: simar simar sadaa sukh  paa-o.

lines.english: Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: bha-o binsai pooran ho-ay aas.

lines.english: By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-ay aat am pargaas.

lines.english: You shall go to that home, and live forever.
lines.transliteration: tit ghar jaa-ay basai abh inaasee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kaatee jam faasee. ||3||

lines.english: One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.
lines.transliteration: tat beechaar kahai jan saachaa.

lines.english: Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.
lines.transliteration: janam marai so kaacho kaachaa.

lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.
lines.transliteration: aavaa gavan mitai parabh sayv.

lines.english: Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: aap ti-aag saran gurd ayv.

lines.english: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.
lines.transliteration: i-o ratan janam kaa ho-ay uDh aar.

lines.english: Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: har har simar paraan aaDhaar.

lines.english: By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved
lines.transliteration: anik upaav na chhootanhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮ  ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  bayd  beechaaray. - not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

lines.english: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  karahu man laa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||
lines.transliteration: man banchhat  naanak fal paa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Your wealth shall not go with you;
lines.transliteration: sang na chaalas tayrai Dh anaa.
tooN ki-aa laptaavahi moorakh  manaa. why do you cling to it, you fool?

lines.english: Children, friends, family and spouse
lines.transliteration: sut meet  kutamb ar banit aa.
in tay kahhu t um kavan sanaathaa. - who of these shall accompany you?

lines.english: Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya
lines.transliteration: raaj rang maa-i-aa bisthaar.
in tay kahhu kavan chh utkaar. - who has ever escaped from these?

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਕਵਨ  ਸਨਾਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry
lines.transliteration: as hastee rath asvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਬਸਥਾਰ॥ਇਨ  ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ  ਛੁਟਕਾਰ॥
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa damf jh ooth paasaaree. - false shows and false displays.

lines.english: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;
lines.transliteration: jin dee-ay t is bujh ai na bigaanaa.
naam bisaar naanak pachhut aanaa. ||5|| forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||

lines.english: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;
lines.transliteration: gur kee mat t ooN layhi i-aanay.
bhagat  binaa baho doobay si-aanay. without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਤੂੰ ਲੇਿਹ ਇਆਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  karahu man meet .
nirmal ho-ay tumHaaro cheet . your consciousness shall become pure.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind; pMnw 289
lines.transliteration: charan kamal raakho man maahi.
janam janam kay kilbikh jaahi. the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.

lines.english: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.
lines.transliteration: aap japahu avraa naam japaavhu.

lines.english: Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sunat kahat  rahat  gat paavhu.

lines.english: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saar bhoot  sat har ko naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay naanak gun gaa-o. ||6||

lines.english: Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat t ayree ut ras mail.

lines.english: The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.
lines.transliteration: binas jaa-ay ha-umai bikh fail.

lines.english: You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.
lines.transliteration: hohi achint basai sukh  naal.

lines.english: With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: saas garaas har naam samaal.

lines.english: Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.
lines.transliteration: chhaad si-aanap saglee manaa.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang paavahi sach Dh anaa.

lines.english: So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.
lines.transliteration: har poonjee sanch karahu bi-uhaar.

lines.english: In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall beacclaimed.
lines.transliteration: eehaa sukh d argeh jaikaar.

lines.english: See the One permeating all;
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar ayko d aykh.
kaho naanak jaa kai mastak laykh . ||7|| says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Meditate on the One, and worship the One.
lines.transliteration: ayko jap ayko saalaahi.

lines.english: Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.
lines.transliteration: ayk simar ayko man aahi.

lines.english: Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.
lines.transliteration: aykas kay gun gaa-o anant.

lines.english: With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.
lines.transliteration: man tan jaap ayk bh agvant .

lines.english: The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk ayk har aap.

lines.english: The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o parabh bi-aap.

lines.english: The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.
lines.transliteration: anik bisthaar ayk tay bh a-ay.

lines.english: Adoring the One, past sins are removed.
lines.transliteration: ayk araaDh paraachh at ga-ay.

lines.english: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar ayk parabh  raataa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19|| sloku ] (289-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak ik jaat aa. ||8||19||

lines.english: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: firat firat  parabh  aa-i-aa pari-aa t a-o sarnaa-ay.

lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1|| AstpdI ] (289-10) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh baynt ee apnee bh agtee laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:
lines.transliteration: jaachak jan jaachai parabh d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa dayvhu har naam. please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.

lines.english: I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kee maaga-o Dh oor.

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm mayree sarDhaa poor.
sadaa sad aa parabh  kay gun gaava-o. may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.

lines.english: With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.
lines.transliteration: saas saas parabh t umeh Dh i-aava-o.
