lines.english: May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laagai pareet.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kara-o parabh  kee nit  neet.

lines.english: You are my only Shelter, my only Support.
lines.transliteration: ayk ot ayko aaDhaar.

lines.english: Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak maagai naam parabh saar. ||1||

lines.english: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee d arisat mahaa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.
lines.transliteration: har ras paavai birlaa ko-ay.

lines.english: Those who taste it are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhi-aa say jan t ariptaanay.

lines.english: They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.
lines.transliteration: pooran purakh nahee dolaanay.

lines.english: They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.
lines.transliteration: subhar bh aray paraym ras rang.

lines.english: Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: upjai chaa-o saaDh kai sang.

lines.english: Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.
lines.transliteration: paray saran aan sabh t i-aag.

lines.english: Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.
lines.transliteration: antar pargaas an-d in liv laag.

lines.english: Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: badbhaagee japi-aa parabh  so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sukh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sayvak kee mansaa pooree bha-ee.

lines.english: From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay nirmal mat  la-ee.

lines.english: Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o parabh ho-i-o d a-i-aal.

lines.english: He has made His servant eternally happy.
lines.transliteration: sayvak keeno sadaa nihaal.

lines.english: The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaat mukat  jan bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.
lines.transliteration: janam maran dookh  bharam ga-i-aa.

lines.english: Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,
lines.transliteration: ichh punee sarDh aa sabh  pooree.
rav rahi-aa sad sang hajooree. imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

lines.english: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tin lee-aa milaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt ee naam samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o bisrai je ghaal na bh aanai.

lines.english: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do? pMnw 290
lines.transliteration: so ki-o bisrai je kee-aa jaanai.

lines.english: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o bisrai jin sabh kichh  dee-aa.

lines.english: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o bisrai je jeevan jee-aa.

lines.english: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o bisrai je agan meh raakhai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ko birlaa laakh ai.

lines.english: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o bisrai je bikh t ay kaadh ai.

lines.english: Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa tootaa gaadhai.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai tat  ihai bujh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: parabh apnaa naanak jan Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: O friends, O Saints, make this your work.
lines.transliteration: saajan sant karahu ih kaam.

lines.english: Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aan ti-aag japahu har naam.

lines.english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paavhu.

lines.english: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.
lines.transliteration: aap japahu avrah naam japaavhu.

lines.english: By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-ay t aree-ai sansaar.

lines.english: Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.
lines.transliteration: bin bhagt ee tan hosee chh aar.

lines.english: All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aan sookh  niDh naam.

lines.english: Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.
lines.transliteration: boodat jaat  paa-ay bisraam.

lines.english: All sorrows shall vanish.
lines.transliteration: sagal dookh  kaa hovat  naas.

lines.english: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japahu guntaas. ||5||

lines.english: Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;
lines.transliteration: upjee pareet paraym ras chaa-o.
man tan ant ar ihee su-aa-o. within my mind and body, this is my purpose:
naytarahu paykh  daras sukh  ho-ay. beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.

lines.english: My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: man bigsai saaDh charan Dh o-ay.

lines.english: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kai man t an rang.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Rare is the one who obtains their company.
lines.transliteration: birlaa ko-oo paavai sang.

lines.english: Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:
lines.transliteration: ayk basat d eejai kar ma-i-aa.
gur parsaad naam jap la-i-aa. by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

lines.english: His Praises cannot be spoken;
lines.transliteration: taa kee upmaa kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak rahi-aa sarab samaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.
lines.transliteration: parabh bakh sand deen d a-i-aal.

lines.english: He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al sad aa kirpaal.

lines.english: The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,
lines.transliteration: anaath naath gobind gupaal.
sarab ghataa karat  partipaal. the Nourisher of all beings.

lines.english: The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  kaaran  kartaar.

lines.english: The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kay paraan aDh aar.

lines.english: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,
lines.transliteration: jo jo japai so ho-ay puneet.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-ay laavai man heet . focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.

lines.english: I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: ham nirgunee-aar neech ajaan.

lines.english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak tumree saran purakh  bhagvaan. ||7||

lines.english: Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,
lines.transliteration: sarab baikunth mukat  mokh  paa-ay.
ayk nimakh har kay gun gaa-ay. if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.

lines.english: So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,
lines.transliteration: anik raaj bhog badi-aa-ee.
har kay naam kee kathaa man bhaa-ee. come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Abundant foods, clothes and music
lines.transliteration: baho bhojan kaapar sangeet .
rasnaa japtee har har neet . come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

lines.english: His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;
lines.transliteration: bhalee so karnee sobh aa Dh anvant .
hirdai basay pooran gur mant . the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.

lines.english: O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang parabh  dayh nivaas.

lines.english: All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20|| sloku ] (290-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh naanak pargaas. ||8||20||

lines.english: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: sargun nirgun nirankaar sunn samaaDhee aap.

lines.english: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1|| AstpdI ] (290-17) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: aapan kee-aa naankaa aapay hee fir jaap. ||1||

lines.english: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,
lines.transliteration: jab akaar ih kachh na d aristayt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਿਫਿਰ  ਜਾਿਪ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paap punn tab kah t ay hot aa. who then committed sins and performed good deeds?

lines.english: When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,
lines.transliteration: jab Dhaaree aapan sunn samaaDh .
tab bair biroDh  kis sang kamaat . then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਬ ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.english: When there was no color or shape to be seen,
lines.transliteration: jab is kaa baran chihan na jaapat.
tab harakh  sog kaho kiseh bi-aapat . then who experienced joy and sorrow?

lines.english: When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,
lines.transliteration: jab aapan aap aap paarbarahm.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਰਨੁਿਚਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਤ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tab moh kahaa kis hovat  bharam. then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts? pMnw 291

lines.english: He Himself has staged His own drama;
lines.transliteration: aapan khayl aap vart eejaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak karnaihaar na doojaa. ||1||

lines.english: When there was only God the Master,
lines.transliteration: jab hovat parabh  kayval Dh anee.
tab banDh  mukat  kaho kis ka-o ganee. then who was called bound or liberated?

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਹੁ ਿਕਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,
lines.transliteration: jab aykeh har agam apaar.
tab narak surag kaho ka-un a-ut aar. then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਨਰਕ  ਸੁਰਗ  ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ  ਅਉਤਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,
lines.transliteration: jab nirgun parabh sahj subh aa-ay.
tab siv sakat  kahhu kit  thaa-ay. then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

lines.english: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,
lines.transliteration: jab aapeh aap apnee jot Dh arai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਆਪਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਧਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab kavan nidar kavan kat  darai. then who was fearless, and who was afraid?

lines.english: He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;
lines.transliteration: aapan chalit aap karnaihaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak thaakur agam apaar. ||2||

lines.english: When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee sukh  aapan aasan.
tah janam maran kaho kahaa binaasan. then where was birth, death and dissolution?

lines.english: When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,
lines.transliteration: jab pooran kartaa parabh  so-ay.
tab jam kee t araas kahhu kis ho-ay. then who was afraid of death?

lines.english: When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,
lines.transliteration: jab abigat agochar parabh  aykaa.
tab chit ar gupat  kis poochh at laykh aa. then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?

lines.english: When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,
lines.transliteration: jab naath niranjan agochar agaaDhay.
tab ka-un chh utay ka-un banDh an baaDh ay. then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਕਉਨ  ਛੁਟੇ ਕਉਨ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਬਾਧੇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.
lines.transliteration: aapan aap aap hee acharjaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak aapan roop aap hee uparjaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪਨ  ਰੂਪ ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,
lines.transliteration: jah nirmal purakh purakh  pat hotaa.
tah bin mail kahhu ki-aa Dh otaa. there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?

lines.english: When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,
lines.transliteration: jah niranjan nirankaar nirbaan.
tah ka-un ka-o maan ka-un abh imaan. then who was honored, and who was dishonored?

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ  ਕਉ ਮਾਨ ਕਉਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,
lines.transliteration: jah saroop kayval jagdees.
tah chh al chh idar lagat  kaho kees. then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

lines.english: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,
lines.transliteration: jah jot saroopee jot  sang samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਰੂਪੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸੰਿਗ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tah kiseh bh ookh kavan t ariptaavai. then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?

lines.english: He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan karnaihaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak kartay kaa naahi sumaar. ||4||

lines.english: When His Glory was contained within Himself,
lines.transliteration: jab apnee sobhaa aapan sang banaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ  ਸੋਭਾ ਆਪਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tab kavan maa-ay baap mit ar sut  bhaa-ee. then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ  ਮਾਇ  ਬਾਪ ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,
lines.transliteration: jah sarab kalaa aapeh parbeen.
tah bayd  katayb kahaa ko-oo cheen. then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ  ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
lines.english: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,
lines.transliteration: jab aapan aap aap ur Dhaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ  ਆਪੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ta-o sagan apasgan kahaa beechaarai. then who considered omens to be good or bad?

lines.english: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,
lines.transliteration: jah aapan ooch aapan aap nayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ  ਊਚ ਆਪਨ  ਆਿਪ  ਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah ka-un th aakur ka-un kahee-ai chayraa. then who was called master, and who was called disciple?

lines.english: We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bisman bisam rahay bismaad.

lines.english: O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak apnee gat jaanhu aap. ||5||

lines.english: When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,
lines.transliteration: jah achhal achh ayd abhayd samaa-i-aa.
oohaa kiseh bi-aapat maa-i-aa. then who was swayed by Maya?

lines.english: When He paid homage to Himself,
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o aapeh aadays.
tihu gun  kaa naahee parvays. then the three qualities were not prevailing.

lines.english: When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,
lines.transliteration: jah aykeh ayk ayk bhagvant aa.
tah ka-un achint  kis laagai chint aa. then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?

lines.english: When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,
lines.transliteration: jah aapan aap aap patee-aaraa.
tah ka-un kathai ka-un sunnaihaaraa. then who spoke and who listened?

lines.english: He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: baho bay-ant ooch t ay oochaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak aapas ka-o aapeh pahoochaa. ||6||

lines.english: When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,
lines.transliteration: jah aap rachi-o parpanch akaar.
tihu gun  meh keeno bisthaar. he made the world subject to the three dispositions.

lines.english: Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of. pMnw 292
lines.transliteration: paap punn tah bh a-ee kahaavat .

lines.english: Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.
lines.transliteration: ko-oo narak ko-oo surag banchhaavat .

lines.english: Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,
lines.transliteration: aal jaal maa-i-aa janjaal.
ha-umai moh bharam bh ai bhaar. egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;
dookh  sookh  maan apmaan. pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor
anik parkaar kee-o bakh-yaan. - these came to be described in various ways.

lines.english: He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.
lines.transliteration: aapan khayl aap kar d aykhai.

lines.english: He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||
lines.transliteration: khayl sankochai t a-o naanak aykai. ||7||

lines.english: Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.
lines.transliteration: jah abigat bh agat tah aap.

lines.english: He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.
lines.transliteration: jah pasrai paasaar sant part aap.

lines.english: He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
lines.transliteration: duhoo paakh  kaa aapeh Dh anee.

lines.english: His Praise is to Himself alone.
lines.transliteration: un kee sobhaa unhoo banee.

lines.english: He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.
lines.transliteration: aapeh ka-utak karai anad  choj.

lines.english: He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.
lines.transliteration: aapeh ras bhogan nirjog.

lines.english: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is aapan naa-ay laavai.

lines.english: He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is khayl kh ilaavai.

lines.english: He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: baysumaar athaah agnat at olai.

lines.english: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21|| sloku ] (292-6) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bulaavhu ti-o naanak d aas bolai. ||8||21||

lines.english: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailingeverywhere.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant kay th aakuraa aapay vart anhaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1|| AstpdI ] (292-7) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayko pasri-aa doojaa kah d aristaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ  ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.
lines.transliteration: aap kathai aap sunnaihaar.

lines.english: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.
lines.transliteration: aapeh ayk aap bisthaar.

lines.english: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavai t aa sarisat upaa-ay.

lines.english: As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapnai bhaan ai la-ay samaa-ay.

lines.english: Without You, nothing can be done.
lines.transliteration: tum t ay bh inn nahee kichh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.
lines.transliteration: aapan soot sabh  jagat  paro-ay.

lines.english: One whom God Himself inspires to understand
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o parabh jee-o aap bujh aa-ay.
sach naam so-ee jan paa-ay. - that person obtains the True Name.

lines.english: He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.
lines.transliteration: so samadrasee t at kaa bayt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sagal sarisat kaa jaytaa. ||1||

lines.english: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jantar sabh  taa kai haath.

lines.english: He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal anaath ko naath.

lines.english: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.
lines.transliteration: jis raakhai t is ko-ay na maarai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤਰ੍ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.
lines.transliteration: so moo-aa jis manhu bisaarai.

lines.english: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?
lines.transliteration: tis taj avar kahaa ko jaa-ay.

lines.english: Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.
lines.transliteration: sabh sir ayk niranjan raa-ay.

lines.english: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee jugat jaa kai sabh  haath.

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar jaanhu saath.

lines.english: He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.
lines.transliteration: gun niDhaan bay-ant  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa balihaar. ||2||

lines.english: The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahay da-i-aal.

lines.english: His kindness extends to all.
lines.transliteration: sabh oopar hovat  kirpaal.

lines.english: He Himself knows His own ways.
lines.transliteration: apnay kartab jaanai aap.

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee rahi-o bi-aap.

lines.english: He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: paratipaalai jee-an baho bh aat.

lines.english: That which He has created meditates on Him.
lines.transliteration: jo jo rachi-o so tiseh Dh i-aat.

lines.english: Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karahi har kay gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.
lines.transliteration: man antar bisvaas kar maani-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karanhaar naanak ik jaani-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.
lines.transliteration: jan laagaa har aykai naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His hopes do not go in vain.
lines.transliteration: tis kee aas na birthee jaa-ay.

lines.english: The servant's purpose is to serve;
lines.transliteration: sayvak ka-o sayvaa ban aa-ee.
hukam boojh param pad  paa-ee. obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.

lines.english: Beyond this, he has no other thought.
lines.transliteration: is tay oopar nahee beechaar.

lines.english: Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man basi-aa nirankaar.

lines.english: His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t or bha-ay nirvair.

lines.english: Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: an-din poojeh gur kay pair.

lines.english: He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next. pMnw 293
lines.transliteration: ih lok sukhee-ay parlok suhaylay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak har parabh aapeh maylay. ||4||

lines.english: Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil karahu anand.

lines.english: Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavhu parabh parmaanand .

lines.english: Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam naam tat  karahu beechaar.

lines.english: Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.
lines.transliteration: darulabh  dayh kaa karahu uDh aar.

lines.english: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;
lines.transliteration: amrit bachan har kay gun gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਚਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: paraan taran kaa ihai su-aa-o. this is the way to save your mortal soul.

lines.english: Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  paykh ahu nayraa.

lines.english: Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.
lines.transliteration: mitai agi-aan binsai anDhayraa.

lines.english: Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.
lines.transliteration: sun updays hird ai basaavhu.

lines.english: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||
lines.transliteration: man ichhay naanak fal paavhu. ||5||

lines.english: Embellish both this world and the next;
lines.transliteration: halat palat  du-ay layho savaar.
raam naam antar ur Dh aar. enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.

lines.english: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee pooree deekh i-aa.

lines.english: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jis man basai tis saach pareekh i-aa.

lines.english: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.
lines.transliteration: man tan naam japahu liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad man t ay bh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Deal in the true trade, O trader,
lines.transliteration: sach vaapaar karahu vaapaaree.
dargeh nibhai kh ayp tumaaree. and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.

lines.english: Keep the Support of the One in your mind.
lines.transliteration: aykaa tayk rakhahu man maahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak bahur na aavahi jaahi. ||6||

lines.english: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?
lines.transliteration: tis tay door kahaa ko jaa-ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: ubrai raakhanhaar Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o japai sagal bh a-o mitai.

lines.english: By God's Grace, mortals are released.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay paraan ee chh utai.

lines.english: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: jis parabh raakh ai tis naahee d ookh.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.
lines.transliteration: naam japat man hovat  sookh .

lines.english: Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.
lines.transliteration: chintaa jaa-ay mitai ahaNkaar.

lines.english: No one can equal that humble servant.
lines.transliteration: tis jan ka-o ko-ay na pahuchanhaar.

lines.english: The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.
lines.transliteration: sir oopar thaadh aa gur sooraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kay kaaraj pooraa. ||7||

lines.english: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.
lines.transliteration: mat pooree amrit  jaa kee d arisat.

lines.english: Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh at uDhrat sarisat.

lines.english: His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jaa kay anoop.

lines.english: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.
lines.transliteration: safal darsan sund ar har roop.

lines.english: Dhan sayvaa sayvak parvaan. Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee purakh  parDh aan.

lines.english: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.
lines.transliteration: jis man basai so hot nihaal.

lines.english: Death does not draw near him.
lines.transliteration: taa kai nikat na aavat  kaal.

lines.english: One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,
lines.transliteration: amar bha-ay amraa pad  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Shalok:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||8||22|| meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22|| sloku ] (293-14) salok.

lines.english: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled thedarkness of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan gur dee-aa agi-aan anDh ayr binaas.

lines.english: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1|| AstpdI ] (293-15) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa tay sant  bhayti-aa naanak man pargaas. ||1||

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.
lines.transliteration: satsang ant ar parabh  deeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God's Name is sweet to me.
lines.transliteration: naam parabhoo kaa laagaa meeth aa.

lines.english: All things are contained in the Heart of the One,
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree aykas ghat maahi.
anik rang naanaa daristaahi. although they appear in so many various colors.

lines.english: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh amrit  parabh  kaa naam.

lines.english: Within the human body is its place of rest.
lines.transliteration: dayhee meh is kaa bisraam.

lines.english: The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh anhat  tah naad .

lines.english: The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: kahan na jaa-ee achraj bismaad.

lines.english: He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.
lines.transliteration: tin daykhi-aa jis aap d ikhaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak tis jan sojh ee paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.
lines.transliteration: so antar so baahar anant .

lines.english: Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at bi-aap rahi-aa bh agvant .

lines.english: Dharan maahi aakaas pa-i-aal. In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld

lines.transliteration: sarab lok pooran partipaal. - in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher. pMnw 294

lines.english: In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ban tin parbat  hai paarbarahm.

lines.english: As He orders, so do His creatures act.
lines.transliteration: jaisee aagi-aa taisaa karam.

lines.english: He permeates the winds and the waters.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant ar maahi.

lines.english: He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: chaar kunt dah d isay samaahi.

lines.english: Without Him, there is no place at all.
lines.transliteration: tis tay bh inn nahee ko th aa-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak sukh  paa-o. ||2||

lines.english: See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  meh d aykh.

lines.english: In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.
lines.transliteration: sasee-ar soor nakh-yat ar meh ayk.

lines.english: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.
lines.transliteration: banee parabh  kee sabh  ko bolai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.
lines.transliteration: aap adol na kabhoo dolai.

lines.english: With absolute power, He plays His play.
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa kar khaylai kh ayl.

lines.english: His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.
lines.transliteration: mol na paa-ee-ai gunah amol.

lines.english: In all light, is His Light.
lines.transliteration: sarab jot meh jaa kee jot .

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਿਤ ॥
lines.english: Dhaar rahi-o su-aamee ot  pot. The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.
By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad bh aram kaa naas.

lines.english: O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin meh ayhu bisaas. ||3||

lines.english: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kaa paykh an sabh  barahm.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ॥
lines.english: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kai hird ai sabh  Dharam.

lines.english: The Saint hears words of goodness.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa suneh subh  bachan.

lines.english: He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: sarab bi-aapee raam sang rachan.

lines.english: This is the way of life of one who knows God.
lines.transliteration: jin jaataa t is kee ih rahat .

lines.english: True are all the words spoken by the Holy.
lines.transliteration: sat bachan saaDh oo sabh  kahat .

lines.english: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.
lines.transliteration: jo jo ho-ay so-ee sukh maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar parabh jaanai.

lines.english: He dwells inside, and outside as well.
lines.transliteration: antar basay baahar bh ee ohee.

lines.english: O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak darsan d aykh sabh  mohee. ||4||

lines.english: He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.
lines.transliteration: aap sat kee-aa sabh  sat.

lines.english: The entire creation came from God.
lines.transliteration: tis parabh  tay saglee ut pat.

lines.english: As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.
lines.transliteration: tis bh aavai t aa karay bisthaar.

lines.english: As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.
lines.transliteration: tis bh aavai t aa aykankaar.

lines.english: His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: anik kalaa lakhee nah jaa-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: Who is near, and who is far away?
lines.transliteration: kavan nikat kavan kahee-ai door.

lines.english: He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap aap bharpoor.

lines.english: One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart
lines.transliteration: antargat  jis aap janaa-ay.

lines.english: - O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak tis jan aap bujh aa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: In all forms, He Himself is pervading.
lines.transliteration: sarab bhoot  aap vart aaraa.

lines.english: Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.
lines.transliteration: sarab nain aap paykhanhaaraa.

lines.english: All the creation is His Body.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree jaa kaa tanaa.

lines.english: He Himself listens to His Own Praise.
lines.transliteration: aapan jas aap hee sunaa.

lines.english: The One has created the drama of coming and going.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan ik khayl banaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He made Maya subservient to His Will.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aakaaree keenee maa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the midst of all, He remains unattached.
lines.transliteration: sabh kai maDh  alipat o rahai.

lines.english: Whatever is said, He Himself says.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kahn aa so aapay kahai.

lines.english: By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa aavai aagi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa bhaavai t aa la-ay samaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.
lines.transliteration: is tay ho-ay so naahee buraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਬੁਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Other than Him, who can do anything?
lines.transliteration: orai kahhu kinai kachh karaa.

lines.english: He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.
lines.transliteration: aap bhalaa kart oot at neekee.

lines.english: He Himself knows His Own Being.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai apnay jee kee.

lines.english: He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.
lines.transliteration: aap saach Dhaaree sabh  saach.

lines.english: Through and through, He is blended with His creation.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  aapan sang raach.

lines.english: His state and extent cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: taa kee gat  mit kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.
lines.transliteration: doosar ho-ay t a sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.english: His actions are all approved and accepted.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa kee-aa sabh  parvaan.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak ih jaan. ||7||

lines.english: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.
lines.transliteration: jo jaanai tis sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: God blends that one into Himself.
lines.transliteration: aap milaa-ay la-ay parabh so-ay.

lines.english: He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.
lines.transliteration: oh Dhanvant  kulvant  pativant.

lines.english: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat jis rid ai bhagvant .

lines.english: Dhan Dh an Dh an jan aa-i-aa. Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being; pMnw 295

lines.transliteration: jis parsaad sabh  jagat  taraa-i-aa. by his grace, the whole world is saved.

lines.english: This is his purpose in life;
lines.transliteration: jan aavan kaa ihai su-aa-o.
jan kai sang chit aavai naa-o. in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.

lines.english: He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.
lines.transliteration: aap mukat mukat  karai sansaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23|| sloku ] (295-2) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis jan ka-o sad aa namaskaar. ||8||23||

lines.english: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.
lines.transliteration: pooraa parabh aaraaDh i-aa pooraa jaa kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the PerfectLord. ||1|| AstpdI ] (295-3) asatpadee. Ashtapadee:
lines.transliteration: naanak pooraa paa-i-aa pooray kay gun gaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kaa sun updays.
paarbarahm nikat kar paykh. see the Supreme Lord God near you.

lines.english: With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,
lines.transliteration: saas saas simrahu gobind.
man antar kee ut rai chind . and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.

lines.english: Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,
lines.transliteration: aas anit t i-aagahu t arang.
sant janaa kee Dh oor man mang. and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.

lines.english: Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.
lines.transliteration: aap chhod baynt ee karahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang agan saagar t arahu.

lines.english: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan kay bh ar layho bh andaar.

lines.english: Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak gur pooray namaskaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਿਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss
lines.transliteration: khaym kusal sahj aanand .
saaDhsang bh aj parmaanand . - in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.

lines.english: You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!
lines.transliteration: narak nivaar uDhaarahu jee-o.

lines.english: Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gun gobind amrit  ras pee-o.

lines.english: Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord
lines.transliteration: chit chit vahu naaraa-in  ayk.

lines.english: - He has One Form, but He has many manifestations.
lines.transliteration: ayk roop jaa kay rang anayk.

lines.english: Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,
lines.transliteration: gopaal daamod ar deen d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ  ॥
lines.english: Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhanjan pooran kirpaal.

lines.english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.
lines.transliteration: simar simar naam baaraN baar.

lines.english: O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak jee-a kaa ihai aDhaar. ||2||

lines.english: The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: utam salok saaDh  kay bachan.

lines.english: These are priceless rubies and gems.
lines.transliteration: amuleek laal ayhi ratan.

lines.english: One who listens and acts on them is saved.
lines.transliteration: sunat kamaavat  hot uDhaar.

lines.english: He himself swims across, and saves others as well.
lines.transliteration: aap tarai lokah nist aar.

lines.english: His life is prosperous, and his company is fruitful;
lines.transliteration: safal jeevan safal taa kaa sang.
jaa kai man laagaa har rang. his mind is imbued with the love of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.
lines.transliteration: jai jai sabad anaahad  vaajai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: sun sun anad karay parabh  gaajai.

lines.english: The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: pargatay gupaal mahaaNt kai maathay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਸੁਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhray t in kai saathay. ||3||

lines.english: Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: saran jog sun sarnee aa-ay.

lines.english: Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aap milaa-ay.

lines.english: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.
lines.transliteration: mit ga-ay bair bha-ay sabh  rayn.

lines.english: I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam saaDh sang lain.

lines.english: The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;
lines.transliteration: suparsan bha-ay gurd ayv.
pooran ho-ee sayvak kee sayv. the service of His servant has been rewarded.

lines.english: I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,
lines.transliteration: aal janjaal bikaar tay raht ay.
raam naam sun rasnaa kahtay. hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.

lines.english: By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: kar parsaad d a-i-aa parabh  Dhaaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak nibhee khayp hamaaree. ||4||

lines.english: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,
lines.transliteration: parabh kee ust at karahu sant  meet .
saavDhaan aykaagar cheet . with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.
lines.transliteration: sukhmanee sahj gobind  gun naam.

lines.english: When it abides in the mind, one becomes wealthy.
lines.transliteration: jis man basai so hot niDh aan.

lines.english: All desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sarab ichhaa t aa kee pooran ho-ay.

lines.english: One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.
lines.transliteration: parDhaan purakh  pargat sabh  lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਇਛਾ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He obtains the highest place of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch paa-ay asthaan.

lines.english: He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.
lines.transliteration: bahur na hovai aavan jaan.

lines.english: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: har Dhan kh aat chalai jan so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak jisahi paraapat ho-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਿਟ  ਚਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;
lines.transliteration: khaym saaNt riDh nav niDh .
buDh gi-aan sarab t ah siDh . wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;
bidi-aa t ap jog parabh  Dhi-aan. learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God; pMnw 296

lines.english: The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;
lines.transliteration: gi-aan saraysat ootam isnaan.
chaar padaarath kamal pargaas. the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਿਧ ਸਗਲ  ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kai maDh  sagal t ay ud aas. in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;
sundar chat ur tat kaa bayt aa. beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;
samadrasee ayk d aristayt aa. to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਫਲ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਭਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih fal tis jan kai mukh  bhanay. gur naanak naam bachan man sunay. ||6|| - these blessings come to one who, through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ  ਮਿਨ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who chants this treasure in his mind
lines.transliteration: ih niDhaan japai man ko-ay.
sabh jug meh t aa kee gat  ho-ay. - in every age, he attains salvation.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.
lines.transliteration: gun gobind  naam Dh un ban ee.

lines.english: The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar bayd  bakh aanee.

lines.english: The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.
lines.transliteration: sagal mataaNt kayval har naam.

lines.english: It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.
lines.transliteration: gobind bh agat kai man bisraam.

lines.english: Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kot apraaDh saaDh sang mitai.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: sant kirpaa t ay jam t ay chh utai.

lines.english: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai mastak karam parabh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਕਰਮ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||
lines.transliteration: saaDh saran  naanak t ay aa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love
lines.transliteration: jis man basai sunai laa-ay pareet.
tis jan aavai har parabh  cheet . - that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

lines.english: The pains of birth and death are removed.
lines.transliteration: janam maran taa kaa d ookh nivaarai.

lines.english: The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.
lines.transliteration: dulabh  dayh tatkaal uDh aarai.

lines.english: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.
lines.transliteration: nirmal sobhaa amrit  taa kee baanee.

lines.english: The One Name permeates his mind.
lines.transliteration: ayk naam man maahi samaanee.

lines.english: Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog binsay bh ai bharam.

lines.english: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: saaDh naam nirmal t aa kay karam.

lines.english: His glory becomes the highest of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch t aa kee sobh aa banee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24|| iQqI gauVI mhlw 5 ] (296-10) thitee ga-orh ee mehlaa 5. T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, sloku ] (296-10) salok. Shalok: <> siqgur pRswid ] (296-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak ih gun naam sukh manee. ||8||24||

lines.english: The Creator Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land, and the sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poori-aa su-aamee sirjanhaar.

lines.english: In so many ways, the One, the Universal Creator has diffused Himself, O Nanak. ||1|| pauVI ] (296-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: anik bhaaNt ho-ay pasri-aa naanak aykankaar. ||1||

lines.english: The first day of the lunar cycle: Bow in humility and meditate on the One, theUniversal Creator Lord God.
lines.transliteration: aykam aykankaar parabh kara-o band naa Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Praise God, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World; seek the Sanctuaryof the Lord, our King.
lines.transliteration: gun gobind  gupaal parabh  saran para-o har raa-ay.

lines.english: Place your hopes in Him, for salvation and peace; all things come from Him.
lines.transliteration: taa kee aas kali-aan  sukh  jaa tay sabh  kachh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I wandered around the four corners of the world and in the ten directions, but I sawnothing except Him.
lines.transliteration: chaar kunt dah d is bharmi-o t is bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: I listened to the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, and I pondered over them in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  sunay baho biDh  kara-o beechaar.

lines.english: The Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the FormlessLord.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran bh ai haran sukh  saagar nirankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower - there is no place at all without Him.
lines.transliteration: daataa bh ugtaa daynhaar t is bin avar na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਸੁਖ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You shall obtain all that you desire, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: jo chaaheh so-ee milai naanak har gun gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮਓ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, each and every day.
lines.transliteration: gobind jas gaa-ee-ai har neet .

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸੁਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕਰਉ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and vibrate, meditate on Him, O myfriend. ||1||Pause|| sloku ] (296-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: mil bhajee-ai saaDh sang mayray meet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਭੈ ਹਰਨ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Bow in humility to the Lord, over and over again, and enter the Sanctuary of the Lord,our King.
lines.transliteration: kara-o bandnaa anik vaar saran para-o har raa-ay.

lines.english: Doubt is eradicated, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, and the love of duality is eliminated. ||2|| pauVI ] (296-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bharam katee-ai naanak saaDh sang d utee-aa bh aa-o mitaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਿਮਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The second day of the lunar cycle: Get rid of your evil-mindedness, and serve theGuru continually.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa d urmat  door kar gur sayvaa kar neet .

lines.english: The jewel of the Lord's Name shall come to dwell in your mind and body, when yourenounce sexual desire, anger and greed, O my friend.
lines.transliteration: raam ratan man t an basai t aj kaam kroDh  lobh meet .

lines.english: Conquer death and obtain eternal life; all your troubles will depart.
lines.transliteration: maran mitai jeevan milai binsahi sagal kalays.

lines.english: Renounce your self-conceit and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe; loving devotion to Him shall permeate your being. pMnw 297
lines.transliteration: aap tajahu gobind  bhajahu bh aa-o bh agat parvays.

lines.english: You shall earn profit and suffer no loss, and in the Court of the Lord you shall be honored.
lines.transliteration: laabh milai t otaa hirai har d argeh pat ivant.

lines.english: Those who gather in the riches of the Lord's Name are truly wealthy, and veryblessed.
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan sanchvai saach saah bh agvant .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ  ਸਾਚ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: So, when standing up and sitting down, vibrate upon the Lord, and cherish the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at har bh ajahu saaDh oo sang pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, evil-mindedness is eradicated, when the Supreme Lord God comes to dwellin the mind. ||2|| sloku ] (297-3) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak durmat  chhut ga-ee paarbarahm basay cheet . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਛੁਿਟ ਗਈ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬਸੇ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The world is in the grip of the three qualities; only a few attain the fourth state ofabsorption.
lines.transliteration: teen bi-aapahi jagat  ka-o t uree-aa paavai ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Saints are pure and immaculate; the Lord abides within their minds.||3|| pauVI ] (297-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sant nirmal bh a-ay jin man vasi-aa so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ  ਿਬਆਪਿਹ  ਜਗਤ  ਕਉ ਤੁਰੀਆ  ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The third day of the lunar cycle: Those who are bound by the three qualities gatherpoison as their fruit; now they are good, and now they are bad.
lines.transliteration: taritee-aa t arai gun  bikhai fal kab ut am kab neech.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਿਨਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They wander endlessly in heaven and hell, until death annihilates them.
lines.transliteration: narak surag bharamt a-o gh ano sad aa sangh aarai meech.

lines.english: In pleasure and pain and worldly cynicism, they pass their lives acting in ego.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog sahsaa sansaar ha-o ha-o karat  bihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਤੀਆ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਿਬਖੈ ਫਲ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ  ਕਬ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
lines.english: They do not know the One who created them; they think up all sorts of schemes and plans.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-ay tiseh na jaan nee chit vahi anik upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤਉ  ਘਣੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ  ਮੀਚੁ ॥
lines.english: Their minds and bodies are distracted by pleasure and pain, and their fever neverdeparts.
lines.transliteration: aaDh bi-aaDh  upaaDh  ras kabahu na t ootai t aap.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਸਹਸਾ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They do not realize the glorious radiance of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran Dhanee nah boojh ai part aap.

lines.english: So many are being drowned in emotional attachment and doubt; they dwell in themost horrible hell.
lines.transliteration: moh bharam boodat  ghano mahaa narak meh vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਧ  ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਉਪਾਿਧ  ਰਸ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾਪ ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and save me! Nanak places his hopes in You.||3|| sloku ] (297-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh raakh  layho naanak t ayree aas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ  ਧਨੀ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਰਤਾਪ  ॥
lines.english: One who renounces egotistical pride is intelligent, wise and refined.
lines.transliteration: chatur si-aan aa sugh arh so-ay jin t aji-aa abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ  ਬੂਡਤ  ਘਣੋ ਮਹਾ ਨਰਕ  ਮਿਹ ਵਾਸ ॥
lines.english: The four cardinal blessings, and the eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas areobtained, O Nanak, by meditating, vibrating on the Lord's Name. ||4|| pauVI ] (297-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat siDh  bhaj naanak har naam. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The fourth day of the lunar cycle: Listening to the four Vedas, and contemplating the essence of reality, I have come to realize
lines.transliteration: chaturath chaaray bayd  sun soDh i-o tat beechaar.
sarab khaym kali-aan  niDh raam naam jap saar. that the treasure of all joy and comfort is found in sublime meditation on the Lord'sName.

lines.english: One is saved from hell, suffering is destroyed, countless pains depart,
lines.transliteration: narak nivaarai dukh  harai t ooteh anik kalays.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: meech hutai jam tay chh utai har keert an parvays. death is overcome, and one escapes the Messenger of Death, by absorption in theKirtan of the Lord's Praises.

lines.english: Fear departs, and one savors the Ambrosial Nectar, imbued with the Love of theFormless Lord.
lines.transliteration: bha-o binsai amrit  rasai rang rat ay nirankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਤੁਰਿਥ  ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਿਣ ਸੋਿਧਓ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Pain, poverty and impurity are removed, with the Support of the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: dukh daarid apvit artaa naaseh naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ ਖੇਮ ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The angels, the seers and the silent sages search for the Ocean of peace, theSustainer of the world.
lines.transliteration: sur nar mun jan khojt ay sukh  saagar gopaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ  ਿਨਵਾਰੈ  ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ਤੂਟਿਹ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਕਲੇਸ  ॥
lines.english: The mind becomes pure, and one's face is radiant, O Nanak, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4|| sloku ] (297-13) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: man nirmal mukh oojlaa ho-ay naanak saaDh  ravaal. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਚੁ ਹੁਟੈ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨ  ਪਰਵੇਸ  ॥
lines.english: The five evil passions dwell in the mind of one who is engrossed in Maya.
lines.transliteration: panch bikaar man meh basay raachay maa-i-aa sang.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, one becomes pure, O Nanak, imbued with the Love of God. ||5|| pauVI ] (297-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang ho-ay nirmalaa naanak parabh  kai rang. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਦਾਿਰਦ  ਅਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਤਾ ਨਾਸਿਹ  ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The fifth day of the lunar cycle: They are the self-elect, the most distinguished, whoknow the true nature of the world.
lines.transliteration: pancham panch parDhaan t ay jih jaani-o parpanch.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤੇ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: The many colors and scents of flowers - all worldly deceptions are transitory and false.
lines.transliteration: kusam baas baho rang ghan o sabh  mithi-aa balbanch.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ  ਹੋਇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: People do not see, and they do not understand; they do not reflect upon anything.
lines.transliteration: nah jaapai nah boojhee-ai nah kachh  karat  beechaar.

lines.english: The world is pierced through with attachment to tastes and pleasures, engrossed inignorance.
lines.transliteration: su-aad moh ras bayDh i-o agi-aan rachi-o sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਬਸੇ ਰਾਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Those who perform empty religious rituals will be born, only to die again. They wander through endless incarnations.
lines.transliteration: janam maran baho jon bh arman  keenay karam anayk.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਹੋਇ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੫॥
lines.english: They do not meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord; their minds do notunderstand.
lines.transliteration: rachanhaar nah simri-o man na beechaar bibayk.

lines.english: By loving devotion to the Lord God, you shall not be polluted by Maya at all.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh agat bhagvaan sang maa-i-aa lipat  na ranch.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚਿਮ  ਪੰਚ ਪਰ੍ਧਾਨ  ਤੇ ਿਜਹ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, how rare are those, who are not engrossed in worldly entanglements. ||5|| sloku ] (297-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak birlay paa-ee-ah jo na racheh parpanch. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਸਮ  ਬਾਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣੋ ਸਭ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਬਲਬੰਚੁ  ॥
lines.english: The six Shaastras proclaim Him to be the greatest; He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: khat saast ar oochou kaheh ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The devotees look beauteous, O Nanak, when they sing the Glories of God at HisDoor. ||6|| pauVI ] (297-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  soheh gun  gaavt ay naanak parabh  kai d u-aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਆਦ  ਮੋਹ ਰਸ ਬੇਿਧਓ  ਅਿਗਆਿਨ  ਰਿਚਓ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The sixth day of the lunar cycle: The six Shaastras say, and countless Simriteesassert, pMnw 298
lines.transliteration: khastam kh at saast ar kaheh simrit  katheh anayk.

lines.punjabi: ਊਤਮੁ  ਊਚੌ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸੇਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: ootam oochou paarbarahm gun  ant na jaan eh saykh . that the Supreme Lord God is the most sublime and lofty. Even the thousand-tongued serpent does not know the limits of His Glories.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਰਦ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸੁਕ ਿਬਆਸ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: Naarad, the humble beings, Suk and Vyaasa sing the Praises of the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: naarad mun jan suk bi-aas jas gaavat  gobind .

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਗੀਧੇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਬੀਧੇ ਭਗਤ  ਰਚੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: They are imbued with the Lord's essence; united with Him; they are absorbed indevotional worship of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ras geeDhay har si-o beeDh ay bh agat rachay bh agvant .

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਿਬਨਿਸਓ  ਪਾਈ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment, pride and doubt are eliminated, when one takes to theSanctuary of the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: moh maan bharam binsi-o paa-ee saran d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਬਸੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਿਨਹਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: His Lotus Feet abide within my mind and body and I am enraptured, beholding theBlessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man tan basay d arsan d aykh nihaal.

lines.english: People reap their profits, and suffer no loss, when they embrace love for the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: laabh milai t otaa hirai saaDh sang liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਿਟ ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: They gather in the treasure of the Lord, the Ocean of Excellence, O Nanak, bymeditating on the Naam. ||6|| sloku ] (298-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: khaat kh ajaanaa gun  niDh haray naanak naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: In the gathering of the Saints, chant the Praises of the Lord, and speak the Truth with love.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal har jas katheh boleh sat  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਥਿਹ  ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the mind becomes contented, enshrining love for the One Lord. ||7|| pauVI ] (298-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak man santokh ee-ai aykas si-o liv laa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: The seventh day of the lunar cycle: Gather the wealth of the Naam; this is a treasurewhich shall never be exhausted.
lines.transliteration: saptam sanchahu naam Dh an toot na jaahi bh andaar.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, He is obtained; He has no end or limitations.
lines.transliteration: santsangat  meh paa-ee-ai ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਪਤਿਮ  ਸੰਚਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਟੂਿਟ ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce your selfishness and conceit, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord of theUniverse; take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.
lines.transliteration: aap tajahu gobind  bhajahu saran parahu har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Your pains shall depart - swim across the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain the fruitsof your mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: dookh  harai bh avjal t arai man chind i-aa fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਭਜਹੁ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who meditates on the Lord twenty-four hours a day - fruitful and blessed is hiscoming into the world.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar man har japai safal janam parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਹਰੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, realize that the Creator Lord is always with you.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sad aa sang karnaihaar pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੈ ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He is your friend, your companion, your very best friend, who imparts the Teachings of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so saajan so sakhaa meet  jo har kee mat  day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to one who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7|| sloku ] (298-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis balihaarn ai har har naam japay-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord twenty-four hours a day; renounce otherentanglements.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaa-ee-ah t ajee-ah avar janjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਤਸੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Minister of Death cannot even see that person, O Nanak, unto whom God ismerciful. ||8|| pauVI ] (298-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jamkankar johi na sak-ee naanak parabhoo d a-i-aal. ||8||

lines.english: The eighth day of the lunar cycle: The eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the ninetreasures,
lines.transliteration: astamee asat siDh nav niDh .

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਿਹ  ਤਜੀਅਿਹ  ਅਵਿਰ ਜੰਜਾਲ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath pooran buDh . all precious things, perfect intellect,

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਦਇਆਲ  ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kaval pargaas sadaa aanand . the opening of the heart-lotus, eternal bliss,
nirmal reet niroDh ar mant . pure lifestyle, the infallible Mantra,
sagal Dharam pavit ar isnaan. all Dharmic virtues, sacred purifying baths,
sabh meh ooch bisaykh  gi-aan. the most lofty and sublime spiritual wisdom
har har bhajan pooray gur sang. - these are obtained by meditating, vibrating upon the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Perfect Guru.

lines.english: You shall be saved, O Nanak, by lovingly chanting the Lord's Name. ||8|| sloku ] (298-13) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jap taree-ai naanak naam har rang. ||8||

lines.english: He does not remember the Lord in meditation; he is fascinated by the pleasures ofcorruption.
lines.transliteration: naaraa-in nah simri-o mohi-o su-aad  bikaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, forgetting the Naam, he is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||9|| pauVI ] (298-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam bisaari-ai narak surag avtaar. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: The ninth day of the lunar cycle: The nine holes of the body are defiled.
lines.transliteration: na-umee navay chhid ar apveet .

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੮॥
lines.english: People do not chant the Lord's Name; instead, they practice evil.
lines.transliteration: har naam na jaapeh karat bipreet .

lines.english: They commit adultery, slander the Saints,
lines.transliteration: par tari-a rameh bakeh saaDh  nind.
karan na sunhee har jas bind. and do not listen to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Praise.

lines.english: They steal others' wealth for the sake of their own bellies,
lines.transliteration: hireh par darab ud ar kai t aa-ee.
agan na nivrai tarisnaa na bujh aa-ee. but the fire is not extinguished, and their thirst is not quenched.

lines.english: Without serving the Lord, these are their rewards.
lines.transliteration: har sayvaa bin ayh fal laagay.

lines.english: O Nanak, forgetting God, the unfortunate people are born, only to die. ||9|| sloku ] (298-17) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh bisrat  mar jameh abh aagay. ||9||

lines.english: I have wandered, searching in the ten directions - wherever I look, there I see Him.
lines.transliteration: das d is khojat mai firi-o jat  daykh-a-u t at so-ay.

lines.english: The mind comes to be controlled, O Nanak, if He grants His Perfect Grace. ||10|| pauVI ] (298-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: man bas aavai naankaa jay pooran kirpaa ho-ay. ||10||

lines.english: The tenth day of the lunar cycle: Overpower the ten sensory and motor organs;
lines.transliteration: dasmee d as du-aar bas keenay.
man santokh  naam jap leenay. your mind will be content, as you chant the Naam.

lines.english: With your ears, hear the Praises of the Lord of the World;
lines.transliteration: karnee sunee-ai jas gopaal.
nainee paykhat  saaDh  da-i-aal. with your eyes, behold the kind, Holy Saints.

lines.english: With your tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa gun gaavai bay-ant.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਿਦਸ ਖੋਜਤ  ਮੈ ਿਫਿਰਓ  ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In your mind, remember the Perfect Lord God. pMnw 299
lines.transliteration: man meh chitvai pooran bh agvant .

lines.english: With your hands and feet, work for the Saints.
lines.transliteration: hasat charan sant  tahal kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, this way of life is obtained by God's Grace. ||10|| sloku ] (299-2) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak ih sanjam parabh kirpaa paa-ee-ai. ||10||

lines.english: Describe the Lord as the One, the One and Only. How rare are those who know thetaste of this essence.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk bakhaanee-ai birlaa jaan ai savaad .

lines.english: The Glories of the Lord of the Universe cannot be known. O Nanak, He is totallyamazing and wonderful! ||11|| pauVI ] (299-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gun gobind  na jaan ee-ai naanak sabh  bismaad . ||11||

lines.english: The eleventh day of the lunar cycle: Behold the Lord, the Lord, near at hand.
lines.transliteration: aykaadasee nikat paykh ahu har raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭੁ ਿਬਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Subdue the desires of your sexual organs, and listen to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: indree bas kar sun hu har naam.

lines.english: Let your mind be content, and be kind to all beings.
lines.transliteration: man santokh  sarab jee-a d a-i-aa.

lines.english: In this way, your fast will be successful.
lines.transliteration: in biDh barat  sampooran bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਬਿਸ ਕਿਰ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  man raakh ai ik th aa-ay. Keep your wandering mind restrained in one place.
Your mind and body shall become pure, chanting the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man tan suDh  japat  har naa-ay.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is pervading amongst all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh poor rahay paarbarahm.

lines.english: O Nanak, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this alone is the eternal faith of Dharma. ||11|| sloku ] (299-6) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak har keertan kar atal ayhu Dh aram. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਜਪਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Evil-mindedness is eliminated, by meeting with and serving the compassionate HolySaints.
lines.transliteration: durmat  haree sayvaa karee bh aytay saaDh  kirpaal.

lines.english: Nanak is merged with God; all his entanglements have come to an end. ||12|| pauVI ] (299-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh si-o mil rahay binsay sagal janjaal. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਅਟਲ  ਏਹੁ ਧਰਮ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The twelfth day of the lunar cycle: Dedicate yourself to giving charity, chanting theNaam and purification.
lines.transliteration: du-aad asee d aan naam isnaan.

lines.english: Worship the Lord with devotion, and get rid of your pride.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  karahu t aj maan.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har amrit paan karahu saaDh sang.

lines.english: The mind is satisfied by lovingly singing the Kirtan of God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: man taript aasai keert an parabh  rang.

lines.english: The Sweet Words of His Bani soothe everyone.
lines.transliteration: komal banee sabh  ka-o sant okhai.

lines.english: The soul, the subtle essence of the five elements, cherishes the Nectar of the Naam,the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: panch bhoo aat maa har naam ras pokh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਤਿਜ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: This faith is obtained from the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay ayh nihcha-o paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, dwelling upon the Lord, you shall not enter the womb of reincarnationagain. ||12|| sloku ] (299-10) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam ramat fir jon na aa-ee-ai. ||12||

lines.english: Engrossed in the three qualities, one's efforts do not succeed.
lines.transliteration: teen gun aa meh bi-aapi-aa pooran hot  na kaam.

lines.english: When the Saving Grace of sinners dwells in the mind, O Nanak, then one is saved by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13|| pauVI ] (299-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran  man basai naanak chh ootai naam. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਪੋਖੈ ॥
lines.english: The thirteenth day of the lunar cycle: The world is in the fever of the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: tar-udsee t een taap sansaar.

lines.english: It comes and goes, and is reincarnated in hell.
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  narak avt aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, does not enter into the minds of the people.
lines.transliteration: har har bhajan na man meh aa-i-o.

lines.english: They do not sing the Praises of God, the Ocean of peace, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar parabh  nimakh  na gaa-i-o.

lines.english: This body is the embodiment of pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog kaa d ayh kar baaDh i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਮਿਹ ਿਬਆਿਪਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.english: It suffers from the chronic and incurable disease of Maya.
lines.transliteration: deeragh  rog maa-i-aa aasaaDh i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣੁ  ਮਿਨ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: By day, people practice corruption, wearing themselves out.
lines.transliteration: dineh bikaar karat  saram paa-i-o.

lines.english: And then with sleep in their eyes, they mutter in dreams.
lines.transliteration: nainee need supan barrh aa-i-o.

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, this is their condition.
lines.transliteration: har bisrat hovat  ayh haal.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the kind and compassionate Primal Being. ||13|| sloku ] (299-14) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: saran naanak parabh purakh  da-i-aal. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is pervading in all the four directions and the fourteen worlds.
lines.transliteration: chaar kunt cha-odah bh avan sagal bi-aapat  raam.

lines.english: O Nanak, He is not seen to be lacking anything; His works are perfectly complete.||14|| pauVI ] (299-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak oon na daykh ee-ai pooran t aa kay kaam. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਿਰ ਬਾਿਧਓ  ॥
lines.english: The fourteenth day of the lunar cycle: God Himself is in all four directions.
lines.transliteration: cha-udeh chaar kunt parabh  aap.

lines.english: On all worlds, His radiant glory is perfect.
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan pooran part aap.

lines.english: The One God is diffused in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: dasay d isaa ravi-aa parabh  ayk.

lines.english: Dharan akaas sabh  meh parabh  paykh . Behold God in all the earth and sky.
In the water, on the land, in the forests and mountains, and in the nether regions of the underworld,
lines.transliteration: jal thal ban parbat paat aal.
parmaysvar tah baseh d a-i-aal. the Merciful Transcendent Lord is abiding.

lines.english: The Lord God is in all mind and matter, subtle and manifest.
lines.transliteration: sookham asthool sagal bh agvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਦਹ  ਭਵਨ  ਸਗਲ ਿਬਆਪਤ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes God. ||14|| sloku ] (299-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh barahm pachh aan. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਊਨ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The soul is conquered, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glories of God.
lines.transliteration: aatam jeet aa gurmat ee gun  gaa-ay gobind .

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, fear is dispelled, O Nanak, and anxiety is ended. ||15|| pauVI ] (299-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sant parsaadee bh ai mitay naanak binsee chind . ||15||

lines.english: The day of the new moon: My soul is at peace; the Divine Guru has blessed me with contentment. pMnw 300
lines.transliteration: amaavas aatam sukh ee bh a-ay sant okh dee-aa gurd ayv.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, in intuitive peace and poise; I have dedicated myself to serving God. tUty bMDn bhu ibkwr sPl pUrn qw ky kwm ] durmiq imtI haumY CutI ismrq hir ko nwm ] (300- 1, iQqI gauVI, mÚ 5) tootay banDhan baho bikaar safal pooran t aa kay kaam. d urmat  mitee ha-umai chhutee simrat  har ko naam. One who meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord - his bonds are broken, all his sins are erased, and his works are brought to perfect fruition; his evil-mindedness disappears, and his ego is subdued.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al saaNt sahj laagaa parabh  kee sayv.

lines.punjabi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਸਫਲ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
