lines.english: Taking to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, his comings and goings inreincarnation are ended.
lines.transliteration: saran gahee paarbarahm kee miti-aa aavaa gavan.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਮਟੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਛੁਟੀ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He saves himself, along with his family, chanting the Praises of God, the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: aap tari-aa kutamb si-o gun  gubind  parabh  ravan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਗਹੀ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੀ ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਆਵਾ  ਗਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: I serve the Lord, and I chant the Name of God.
lines.transliteration: har kee tahal kamaavnee japee-ai parabh  kaa naam.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਿਸਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਿਬੰਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, Nanak has obtained peace and comfortable ease. ||15|| sloku ] (300-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay paa-i-aa naanak sukh  bisraam. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: The perfect person never wavers; God Himself made him perfect.
lines.transliteration: pooran kabahu na doltaa pooraa kee-aa parabh  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮੁ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Day by day, he prospers; O Nanak, he shall not fail. ||16|| pauVI ] (300-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: din din charh ai savaa-i-aa naanak hot  na gh aat. ||16||

lines.english: The day of the full moon: God alone is Perfect; He is the All-powerful Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: poornamaa pooran parabh ayk karan  kaaran  samrath.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਤਾ  ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is kind and compassionate to all beings and creatures; His Protecting Hand isover all.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant d a-i-aal purakh  sabh  oopar jaa kaa hath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੋਤ ਨ ਘਾਿਟ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Lord of the Universe; through the Guru, He acts.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan gobind  gur kee-aa jaa kaa ho-ay.

lines.english: God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is All-knowing, Unseen andImmaculately Pure.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee parabh  sujaan alakh  niranjan so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨਮਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is the Knower of all ways and means.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysaro sabh biDh  jaanan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਥੁ ॥
lines.english: He is the Support of His Saints, with the Power to give Sanctuary. Twenty-four hours a day, I bow in reverence to Him.
lines.transliteration: sant sahaa-ee saran jog aath  pahar namaskaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀਆ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: His Unspoken Speech cannot be understood; I meditate on the Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa nah boojhee-ai simrahu har kay charan.

lines.english: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Master of the masterless; Nanak has enteredGod's Sanctuary. ||16|| sloku ] (300-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran anaath naath naanak parabh  kee saran. ||16||

lines.english: My pain is gone, and my sorrows have departed, since I took to the Sanctuary of theLord, my King.
lines.transliteration: dukh binsay sahsaa ga-i-o saran gahee har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਰਿਨ  ਜੋਗੁ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਨਮਸਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praisesof the Lord. ||17|| pauVI ] (300-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: man chinday fal paa-i-aa naanak har gun gaa-ay. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: Some sing, some listen, and some contemplate;
lines.transliteration: ko-ee gaavai ko sunai ko-ee karai beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਨ ਅਨਾਥ  ਨਾਥ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: ko updaysai ko d arirhai tis kaa ho-ay uDh aar. some preach, and some implant the Name within; this is how they are saved.

lines.english: Their sinful mistakes are erased, and they become pure; the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.
lines.transliteration: kilbikh kaatai ho-ay nirmalaa janam janam mal jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਗਇਓ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਗਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In this world and the next, their faces shall be radiant; they shall not be touched byMaya.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  mukh  oojlaa nah pohai t is maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਦੇ  ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: They are intuitively wise, and they are Vaishnaavs, worshippers of Vishnu; they arespiritually wise, wealthy and prosperous.
lines.transliteration: so surtaa so baisno so gi-aanee Dh anvant .

lines.english: They are spiritual heros, of noble birth, who vibrate upon the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: so sooraa kulvant so-ay jin bh aji-aa bh agvant .

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ  ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Kh'shatriyas, the Brahmins, the low-caste Soodras, the Vaisha workers and theoutcast pariahs are all saved,
lines.transliteration: khatree baraahman  sood  bais uDh rai simar chandaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ  ਕੋ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੈ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Vaar In Gauree, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (300-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mÚ 4 ] (300-16) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin jaani-o parabh aapnaa naanak t iseh ravaal. ||17|| meditating on the Lord. Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who know his God.||17|| gauVI kI vwr mhlw 4 ] (300-15) ga-orhee kee vaar mehlaa 4.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਕਾਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is kind and compassionate; all are alike to Him.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  da-i-aal hai jis no samat  sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ  ਨਹ ਪੋਹੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He looks upon all impartially; with pure faith in the mind, He is obtained.
lines.transliteration: ayk darisat kar d aykh-daa man bh aavnee t ay siDh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾ  ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ  ਸੋ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਧਨਵੰਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar is within the True Guru; He is exalted and sublime, of Godlystatus.
lines.transliteration: satgur vich amrit  hai har ut am har pad  so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ  ਸੋਇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਭਿਜਆ  ਭਗਵੰਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, one meditates on the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain Him. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (300-18) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa tay har Dh i-aa-ee-ai gurmukh  paavai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ  ਸੂਦੁ ਬੈਸੁ ਉਧਰੈ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਚੰਡਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Egotism and Maya are total poison; in these, people continually suffer loss in thisworld.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa sabh bikh  hai nit  jag totaa sansaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh earns the profit of the wealth of the Lord's Name, contemplating theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: laahaa har Dhan kh ati-aa gurmukh  sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: The poisonous filth of egotism is removed, when one enshrines the Ambrosial Nameof the Lord within the heart. pMnw 301
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mail bikh ut rai har amrit  har ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਕਾਰਜ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਿਸਿਧ  ਹਿਹ ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: All the Gurmukh's affairs are brought to perfect completion; the Lord has showered him with His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaraj t in kay siDh  heh jin gurmukh  kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who meets the Primal Lord remains blended with the Lord, the CreatorLord. ||2|| pauVI ] (301-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo Dhur milay say mil rahay har maylay sirjan haar. ||2||

lines.english: You are True, O True Lord and Master. You are the Truest of the True, O Lord of theWorld.
lines.transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sachaa gosaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੋਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone meditates on You; everyone falls at Your Feet.
lines.transliteration: tuDhuno sabh  Dhi-aa-id ee sabh  lagai t ayree paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ  ਸਭ ਿਧਆਇਦੀ ਸਭ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Your Praises are graceful and beautiful; You save those who speak them.
lines.transliteration: tayree sifat  su-aali-o saroop hai jin keet ee tis paar lagh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸੁਆਿਲਉ  ਸਰੂਪ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲਘਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You reward the Gurmukhs, who are absorbed in the True Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa no fal paa-id aa sach naam samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my Great Lord and Master, great is Your glorious greatness. ||1|| slok mÚ 4 ] (301-4) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vaday mayray saahibaa vadee tayree vadi-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name, all other praise and speech is insipid and tasteless.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai hor salaahn aa sabh  bolan  fikaa saad .

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs praise their own egos; their attachment to egotism is useless.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ahaNkaar salaahd ay ha-umai mamt aa vaad .

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ  ਸਭੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ  ਿਫਕਾ  ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: Those whom they praise, die; they all waste away in conflict.
lines.transliteration: jin saalaahan say mareh khap jaavai sabh  apvaad .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਵਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (301-7) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh ubray jap har har parmaanaad . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਨ  ਸੇ ਮਰਿਹ  ਖਿਪ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਾਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: O True Guru, tell me of my Lord God, that I may meditate on the Naam within mymind.
lines.transliteration: satgur har parabh  das naam Dh i-aa-ee man haree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰਮਾਨਾਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is sacred and pure; chanting it, all my pain has been takenaway. ||2|| pauVI ] (301-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam pavit har mukh  bolee sabh  dukh parharee. ||2||

lines.english: You Yourself are the Formless Lord, the Immaculate Lord, our Sovereign King.
lines.transliteration: too aapay aap nirankaar hai niranjan har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord with one-pointed mind, are rid of all their pain.
lines.transliteration: jinee too ik man sach Dh i-aa-i-aa t in kaa sabh  dukh gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਮਿਨ ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.english: You have no equal, next to whom I might sit and speak of You.
lines.transliteration: tayraa sareek ko naahee jis no lavai laa-ay sun aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਿਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the only Giver as great as Yourself. You are Immaculate; O True Lord, youare pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad d aataa toohai niranjanaa t oohai sach mayrai man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O my True Lord and Master, Your Name is the Truest of the True. ||2|| slok mÚ 4 ] (301-11) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sachay mayray saahibaa sachay sach naa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within the mind is the disease of ego; the self-willed manmukhs, the evil beings,are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: man antar ha-umai rog hai bh aram bh oolay manmukh  durjanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated, only when one meets the True Guru, our HolyFriend. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (301-12) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rog gavaa-ay mil satgur saaDh oo sajnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mind and body of the Gurmukh are imbued with the Love of the Lord, theTreasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: man tan rat aa rang si-o gurmukh  har gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਤੂਹੈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord. Hail to the Guru, who has united me with the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (301-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har sarnaagat ee har maylay gur saabaas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Personification of Creativity, the Inaccessible Lord. With whom should Icompare You?
lines.transliteration: too kart aa purakh  agamm hai kis naal t oo varh ee-ai.

lines.english: If there was anyone else as great as You, I would name him; You alone are likeYourself.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad ho-ay so aakh ee-ai t uDh jayhaa t oohai parh ee-ai.

lines.english: You are the One, permeating each and every heart; You are revealed to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: too gh at ghat ik varatd aa gurmukh  pargarh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦੁਰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the True Lord and Master of all; You are the Highest of all.
lines.transliteration: too sachaa sabh as daa kh asam hai sabh  doo too charh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ਿਮਿਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever You do, O True Lord - that is what happens, so why should we grieve? ||3|| slok mÚ 4 ] (301-15) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too karahi so sachay ho-isee t aa kaa-it  karhee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of my Beloved, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan paraym piramm kaa ath ay pahar lagann.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God, that he may dwell in peace with the True Guru. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (301-17) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kirpaa Dhaar parabh  satgur sukh  vasann. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those whose inner beings are filled with the Love of their Beloved, look beautiful asthey speak.
lines.transliteration: jin andar pareet  piramm kee ji-o bolan t ivai sohann.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself knows all; the Beloved Lord has infused His Love. ||2|| pauVI ] (301-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak har aapay jaandaa jin laa-ee pareet  pirann. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਿਕਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਤੂ ਵੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Creator Lord, You Yourself are infallible; You never make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa aap abh ul hai bh ulan vich naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਪੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever You do is good, O True Lord; this understanding is obtained through theWord of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: too karahi so sachay bh alaa hai gur sabad  bujhaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: too karan  kaaran  samrath hai d oojaa ko naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਭਸ  ਦਾ ਖਸਮੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਤੂ ਚੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master, You are inaccessible and merciful. Everyone meditates on You. pMnw 302
lines.transliteration: too saahib agam d a-i-aal hai sabh  tuDh Dhi-aahee.

lines.english: All beings are Yours; You belong to all. You deliver all. ||4|| slok mÚ 4 ] (302-1) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-a t ayray t oo sabh as daa too sabh  chhadaahee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ  ਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਛਡਾਹੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Listen, O my Friend, to my message of love; my eyes are fixed upon You.
lines.transliteration: sun saajan paraym sand aysraa akh ee taar lagann.

lines.english: The Guru was pleased - He united servant Nanak with his friend, and now he sleeps inpeace. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (302-2) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai sajan  mayli-aa jan naanak sukh  savann. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਾਜਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਸੰਦੇਸਰਾ  ਅਖੀ  ਤਾਰ ਲਗੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Merciful Giver; He is always compassionate.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa da-i-aal hai jis no d a-i-aa sad aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਵੰਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru has no hatred within Him; He beholds the One God everywhere.
lines.transliteration: satgur and rahu nirvair hai sabh  daykhai barahm ik so-ay.

lines.english: Anyone who directs hate against the One who has no hate, shall never be satisfiedwithin.
lines.transliteration: nirvairaa naal je vair chalaa-iday t in vichahu t isti-aa na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆ  ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru wishes everyone well; how can anything bad happen to Him?
lines.transliteration: satgur sabh naa d aa bh alaa manaa-id aa tis daa buraa ki-o ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: As one feels towards the True Guru, so are the rewards he receives.
lines.transliteration: satgur no jayhaa ko ichh -daa tayhaa fal paa-ay ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator knows everything; nothing can be hidden from Him. ||2|| pauVI ] (302-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kartaa sabh  kichh  jaand aa jid oo kichh  gujhaa na ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ  ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਿਕਉ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One who has been made great by his Lord and Master - know him to be great!
lines.transliteration: jis no saahib vadaa karay so-ee vad jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛਦਾ  ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By His Pleasure, the Lord and Master forgives those who are pleasing to His Mind.
lines.transliteration: jis saahib bhaavai t is bakh as la-ay so saahib man bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਿਜਦੂ ਿਕਛੁ  ਗੁਝਾ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who tries to compete with Him is a senseless fool.
lines.transliteration: jay ko os dee rees karay so moorh  ajaan ee.

lines.english: One who is united with the Lord by the True Guru, sings His Praises and speaks His Glories.
lines.transliteration: jis no satgur maylay so gun  ravai gun  aakh  vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord is True; one who understands Him is absorbed in Truth. ||5|| slok mÚ 4 ] (302-9) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sach hai bujh sach samaan ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is true, immaculate and eternal; He has no fear, hatred or form.
lines.transliteration: har sat niranjan amar hai nirbh a-o nirvair nirankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਓਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮੂੜ ਅਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who chant and meditate on Him, who single-mindedly focus their consciousness on Him, are rid of the burden of their ego.
lines.transliteration: jin japi-aa ik man ik chit t in lathaa ha-umai bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord - hail to those Saintly beings!
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh har aaraaDh i-aa tin sant  janaa jaikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਬੁਿਝ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: If someone slanders the Perfect True Guru, he will be rebuked and reproached by thewhole world.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee nindaa karay pooray sat guroo kee t is no fit fit kahai sabh  sansaar.

lines.english: The Lord Himself abides within the True Guru; He Himself is His Protector.
lines.transliteration: satgur vich aap varatd aa har aapay rakh anhaar.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo gun  gaavd aa tis no sad aa sad aa namaskaar. Blessed, Blessed is the Guru, who sings the Glories of God. Unto Him, I bow foreverand ever in deepest reverence.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਇਕ ਿਚਿਤ  ਿਤਨ ਲਥਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਭਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have meditated on the Creator Lord. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (302-13) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin ka-o vaari-aa jin japi-aa sirjan haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself made the earth; He Himself made the sky.
lines.transliteration: aapay Dhart ee saajee-an aapay aakaas.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਿਨੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੀ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਫਟੁ ਿਫਟੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the beings there, and He Himself places food in their mouths.
lines.transliteration: vich aapay jant upaa-i-an mukh  aapay d ay-ay giraas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself is the Treasure of Excellence.
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay aap varatd aa aapay hee gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He shall take away all your sinful mistakes. ||2|| pauVI ] (302-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay t oo sabh  kilvikh  katay t aas. ||2||

lines.english: You, O True Lord and Master, are True; the Truth is pleasing to the True One.
lines.transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sachay bh aavai.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who praise You, O True Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  sach salaahd ay tin jam kankar nayrh  na aavai.

lines.english: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord; the Lord is pleasing to their hearts.
lines.transliteration: tin kay mukh  dar ujlay jin har hird ai sachaa bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਪੇ  ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਿਗਰਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The false ones are left behind; because of the falsehood and deceit in their hearts,they suffer in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: koorhi-aar pichh aahaa satee-an koorh  hirdai kapat mahaa d ukh paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Black are the faces of the false; the false remain just false. ||6|| slok mÚ 4 ] (302-17) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: muh kaalay koorhi-aaree-aa koorh i-aar koorh o ho-ay jaavai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਕਟੇ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the field of Dharma; as one plants the seeds there, so are the fruitsobtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur Dh artee Dh aram hai t is vich jayhaa ko beejay t ayhaa fal paa-ay.

lines.english: The GurSikhs plant ambrosial nectar, and obtain the Lord as their ambrosial fruit.
lines.transliteration: gursikhee amrit  beeji-aa t in amrit  fal har paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Their faces are radiant in this world and the next; in the Court of the Lord, they arerobed with honor.
lines.transliteration: onaa halat palat  mukh  ujlay o-ay har d argeh sachee painaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Some have cruelty in their hearts - they cons tantly act in cruelty; as they plant, so are the fruits which they eat. pMnw 303
lines.transliteration: iknHaa andar kh ot nit khot kamaaveh oh jayhaa beejay t ayhaa fal kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਖੋਟੁ ਿਨਤ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਓਹੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
lines.english: When the True Guru, the Tester, observes with His Glance, the selfish ones are all exposed.
lines.transliteration: jaa satgur saraaf nad ar kar d aykhai su-aavgeer sabh  ugharh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਆਵਗੀਰ  ਸਿਭ ਉਘਿੜ  ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: As one thinks, so does he receive, and so does the Lord make him known.
lines.transliteration: o-ay jayhaa chitvahi nit  tayhaa paa-in o-ay t ayho jayhay d a-yi vajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਜੇਹਾ ਿਚਤਵਿਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਓਇ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੇ ਦਿਯ  ਵਜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is pervading at both ends; He continually acts, and beholds His own play. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (303-3) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak duhee siree kh asam aapay vart ai nit kar kar d aykhai chalat  sabaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਹੀ ਿਸਰੀ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਨਤ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ  ਸਬਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal is of one mind - whatever he dedicates it to, in that he is successful.
lines.transliteration: ik man ik varatdaa jit  lagai so thaa-ay paa-ay.

lines.english: Some talk a lot, but they eat only that which is in their own homes.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee galaa karay ghanayree-aa je gh ar vath hovai saa-ee kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained, and egotism does not departfrom within.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sojh ee naa pavai ahaNkaar na vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਗਲਾ  ਕਰੇ ਘਨੇਰੀਆ  ਿਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਈ  ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Suffering and hunger cling to the egotistical people; they hold out their hands and begfrom door to door.
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaaree-aa no dukh  bhukh hai hath t adeh gh ar ghar mangaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their falsehood and fraud cannot remain concealed; their false appearances fall off inthe end.
lines.transliteration: koorh th agee gujh ee naa rahai mulammaa paaj leh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ  ਨੋ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਹਥੁ ਤਡਿਹ  ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ ਮੰਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny comes to meet God through the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis hovai poorab likhi-aa t is satgur milai parabh  aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ  ਗੁਝੀ  ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ  ਪਾਜੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Just as iron is transmuted into gold by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, so arepeople transformed by joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.
lines.transliteration: ji-o lohaa paaras bhaytee-ai mil sangat  suvran ho-ay jaa-ay.

lines.english: O God, You are the Master of servant Nanak; as it pleases You, You lead him. ||2|| pauVI ] (303-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay parabh t oo Dh anee ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਿਸ  ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੁਵਰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who serves the Lord with all his heart - the Lord Himself unites him with Himself.
lines.transliteration: jin har hirdai sayvi-aa t in har aap milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He enters into a partnership with virtue and merit, and burns off all his demerits with the fire of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gun kee saajh  tin si-o karee sabh  avgan  sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.english: Demerits are purchased cheap, like straw; he alone gathers merit, who is so blessedby the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: a-ugan vikan  palree jis d eh so sachay paa-ay.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has erased my demerits, and revealed my virtuousmerits.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay jin a-ugan  mayt gun  pargatee-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਿਝ ਿਤਨ ਿਸਉ ਕਰੀ ਸਿਭ ਅਵਗਣ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh chants the glorious greatness of the great Lord God. ||7|| slok mÚ 4 ] (303-11) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee vaday kee gurmukh aalaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗਣ  ਿਵਕਿਣ  ਪਲਰੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Great is the greatness within the True Guru, who meditates night and day on theName of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: satgur vich vadee vadi-aa-ee jo an-d in har har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਅਉਗਣ  ਮੇਿਟ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: The repetition of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is his purity and self-restraint; withthe Name of the Lord, He is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har har naam ramat such sanjam har naamay hee t ariptaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਲਾਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is His power, and the Lord's Name is His Royal Court; the Lord's Name protects Him.
lines.transliteration: har naam taan  har naam d eebaan  har naamo rakh  karaavai.

lines.english: One who centers his consciousness and worships the Guru, obtains the fruits of hismind's desires.
lines.transliteration: jo chit laa-ay poojay gur moorat  so man ichh ay fal paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜੋ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: But one who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall be killed and destroyed by theCreator.
lines.transliteration: jo nindaa karay sat gur pooray kee t is kart aa maar d ivaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: This opportunity shall not come into his hands again; he must eat what he himself hasplanted.
lines.transliteration: fayr oh vaylaa os hath na aavai oh aapnaa beeji-aa aapay kh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਰਖ ਕਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He shall be taken to the most horrible hell, with his face blackened like a thief, and anoose around his neck.
lines.transliteration: narak ghor muhi kaalai kh arhi-aa ji-o t askar paa-ay galaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ ਪੂਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: But if he should again take to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate on theName of the Lord, Har, Har, then he shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: fir satgur kee sarn ee pavai t aa ubrai jaa har har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਮਾਰ ਿਦਵਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks and proclaims the Lord's Story; as it pleases the Creator, so does hespeak. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (303-16) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har baataa aakh  sunaa-ay naanak har kart ay ayvai bh aavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਫੇਿਰ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਓਸੁ ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਓਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਬੀਿਜਆ  ਆਪੇ  ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: One who does not obey the Hukam, the Command of the Perfect Guru - that self- willed manmukh is plundered by his ignorance and poisoned by Maya.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kaa hukam na mannai oh manmukh agi-aan muth aa bikh  maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਿਕ  ਘੋਿਰ  ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲੈ  ਖਿੜਆ  ਿਜਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਇ  ਗਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Within him is falsehood, and he sees everyone else as false; the Lord has tied theseuseless conflicts around his neck.
lines.transliteration: os andar koorh  koorh o kar bujh ai anhoday jhagrhay da-yi os d ai gal paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਬਰੈ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He babbles on and on, but the words he speaks please no one.
lines.transliteration: oh gal farosee karay bahutayree os d aa boli-aa kisai na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤੇ  ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: 4) oh ghar gh ar handh ai ji-o rann d ohaagan  os naal muhu jorh ay os bh ee lachh an laa-i- aa. He wanders from house to house like an abandoned woman; whoever associates withhim is stained by the mark of evil as well.
Those who become Gurmukh avoid him; they forsake his company and sit hear the Guru. pMnw 304
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay so alipat o vart ai os d aa paas chh ad gur paas bahi jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O chosen people, O self-elect, one who does not publicly affirm his Guru is not a good person; he loses all his profits and capital.
lines.transliteration: jo gur gopay aapnaa so bh alaa naahee panchahu on laahaa mool sabh  gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪੰਚਹੁ ਓਿਨ ਲਾਹਾ  ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: People used to chant and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Nanak, but now theWords of the Perfect Guru have come to be the most exalted of all.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa aagam nigam naanak aakh sun aa-ay pooray gur kaa bachan upar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ ਆਗਮੁ  ਿਨਗਮੁ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਉਪਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||2|| The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is pleasing to the GurSikh; the self-willedmanmukhs have lost this opportunity. ||2|| pauVI ] (304-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa vadi-aa-ee bh aavai gur pooray kee manmukh aa oh vaylaa hath na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Lord is truly the greatest of all; he alone obtains Him, who is anointed bythe Guru.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa sabh d oo vadaa hai so la-ay jis sat gur tikay.

lines.english: He is the True Guru, who meditates on the True Lord. The True Lord and the TrueGuru are truly One.
lines.transliteration: so satgur je sach Dh i-aa-id aa sach sachaa sat gur ikay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਟਕੇ ॥
lines.english: He is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has totally conquered his five passions.
lines.transliteration: so-ee satgur purakh  hai jin panjay d oot keetay vas chh ikay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਜ ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੇ ॥
lines.english: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who praises himself, is filled with falsehood within. Cursed, cursed is his ugly face.
lines.transliteration: je bin satgur sayvay aap gan aa-iday tin and ar koorh  fit fit muh fikay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਕੀਤੇ  ਵਿਸ ਿਛਕੇ  ॥
lines.english: His words are not pleasing to anyone; his face is blackened, and he is separated fromthe True Guru. ||8|| slok mÚ 4 ] (304-6) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: o-ay bolay kisai na bhaavnee muh kaalay sat gur tay chukay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪੁ  ਗਣਾਇਦੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕੂੜੁ ਿਫਟੁ ਿਫਟੁ ਮੁਹ ਿਫਕੇ ॥
lines.english: Everyone is the field of the Lord God; the Lord Himself cultivates this field.
lines.transliteration: har parabh kaa sabh  khayt hai har aap kirsaan ee laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਚੁਕੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh grows the crop of forgiveness, while the self-willed manmukh loses even his roots.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bakh as jamaa-ee-an manmukh ee mool gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They all plant for their own good, but the Lord causes to grow only that field withwhich He is pleased.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko beejay aapn ay bh alay no har bh aavai so kh ayt jamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰਸਾਣੀ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The GurSikh plants the seed of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and obtains the Lord'sAmbrosial Naam as his Ambrosial Fruit.
lines.transliteration: gursikhee har amrit  beeji-aa har amrit  naam fal amrit  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਜਮਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ  ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mouse of Death is continually gnawing away at the crop, but the Creator Lord hasbeaten it off and driven it away.
lines.transliteration: jam choohaa kiras nit kurkad aa har kart ai maar kadh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਆਪਣੇ  ਭਲੇ ਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The farm was successful, by the Love of the Lord, and the crop was produced byGod's Grace.
lines.transliteration: kirsaanee jammee bh aa-o kar har bohal bakh as jamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖੀ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਬੀਿਜਆ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He has removed all the burning and anxiety of those, who have meditated on the TrueGuru, the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: tin kaa kaarh aa and aysaa sabh  laahi-on jinee sat gur purakh  Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੁ ਚੂਹਾ ਿਕਰਸ  ਿਨਤ  ਕੁਰਕਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, one who worships and adores the Naam, the Name of the Lord,swims across, and saves the whole world as well. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (304-11) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam araaDhi-aa aap t ari-aa sabh  jagat  taraa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਸਾਣੀ  ਜੰਮੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਹਲ  ਬਖਸ  ਜਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is occupied with greed all day long, although he may claimotherwise.
lines.transliteration: saaraa din laalach ati-aa manmukh  horay galaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਕਾੜਾ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਸਭੁ ਲਾਿਹਓਨੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: At night, he is overcome by fatigue, and all his nine holes are weakened.
lines.transliteration: raatee oogh ai dabi-aa navay sot  sabh  dhilaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Over the head of the manmukh is the order of the woman; to her, he ever holds outhis promises of goodness.
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa d ai sir joraa amar hai nit  dayveh bh alaa.

lines.english: Those men who act according to the orders of women are impure, filthy and foolish.
lines.transliteration: joraa daa aakh i-aa purakh  kamaavd ay say apvit  amayDh  khalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰਾ  ਿਦਨੁ ਲਾਲਿਚ ਅਿਟਆ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਰੇ ਗਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those impure men are engrossed in sexual desire; they consult their women and walkaccordingly.
lines.transliteration: kaam vi-aapay kusuDh nar say joraa puchh  chalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਤੀ  ਊਘੈ ਦਿਬਆ  ਨਵੇ ਸੋਤ ਸਿਭ ਿਢਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who walks as the True Guru tells him to, is the true man, the best of the best.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai aakh i-ai jo chalai so sat  purakh  bhal bhalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਦੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਜੋਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਨਤ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created all women and men; the Lord Himself plays every play.
lines.transliteration: joraa purakh sabh  aap upaa-i-an har kh ayl sabh  khilaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਰਾ ਦਾ ਆਿਖਆ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਸੇ ਅਪਿਵਤ  ਅਮੇਧ  ਖਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: You created the entire creation; O Nanak, it is the best of the best. ||2|| pauVI ] (304-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree ban at banaavan ee naanak bh al bhalaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਕੁਸੁਧ  ਨਰ ਸੇ ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਿਛ ਚਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are carefree, unfathomable and immeasurable; how can You be measured?
lines.transliteration: too vayparvaahu athaahu hai at ul ki-o t ulee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਆਿਖਐ  ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.english: Those who have met the True Guru and who meditate on You are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee je t uDh Dhi-aa-id ay jin sat gur milee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਰਖ  ਸਿਭ ਆਿਪ ਉਪਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਹਿਰ ਖੇਲ ਸਿਭ ਿਖਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the True Guru's Bani is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes perfect.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee ban ee sat  saroop hai gurbaan ee ban ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਵਣੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Jealously emulating the True Guru, some others may speak of good and bad, but thefalse are destroyed by their falsehood.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee reesai hor kach pich bold ay say koorh i-aar koorh ay jharh parhee-ai.

lines.english: Deep within them is one thing, and in their mouths is another; they suck in the poison of Maya, and then they painfully waste away. ||9|| slok mÚ 4 ] (304-18) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: onHaa andar hor mukh  hor hai bikh  maa-i-aa no jh akh mard ay karh ee-ai. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਿਕਉ  ਤੁਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Service to the True Guru is immaculate and pure; those humble beings who are pureperform this service.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa nirmalee nirmal jan ho-ay so sayvaa gh aalay.

lines.english: Those who have deceit, corruption and falsehood within - the True Lord Himself casts them out like lepers. pMnw 305
lines.transliteration: jin andar kapat vikaar jh ooth o-ay aapay sachai vakh  kadh ay jajmaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚਆਰ  ਿਸਖ ਬਿਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਘਾਲਿਨ  ਕੂਿੜਆਰ  ਨ ਲਭਨੀ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਥਾਇ  ਭਾਲੇ ॥
lines.english: The truthful Sikhs sit by the True Guru's side and serve Him. The false ones search, but find no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: sachiaar sikh bahi sat gur paas gh aalan koorh i-aar na labh nee kit ai thaa-ay bh aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਆਿਖਆ  ਸੁਖਾਵੈ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਮੁਹ ਭਲੇਰੇ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਦਿਯ  ਗਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are not pleased with the Words of the True Guru - their faces are cursed,and they wander around, condemned by God.
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur kaa aakh i-aa sukh aavai naahee t inaa muh bh alayray fireh d a-yi gaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਿਕਚਰਕੁ ਵੇਰਾਈਅਿਨ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੇਤਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not have the Love of the Lord within their hearts - how long can those demonic, self-willed manmukhs be consoled?
lines.transliteration: jin andar pareet  nahee har kayree say kichrak vayraa-ee-an manmukh  baytaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਮਨੁ ਥਾਇ  ਰਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਵਥੁ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: One who meets the True Guru, keeps his mind in its own place; he spends only hisown assets.
lines.transliteration: satgur no milai so aapn aa man thaa-ay rakh ai oh aap vart ai aapn ee vath naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਇਿਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਵਿਖ ਕਢੈ ਠਗਵਾਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, some are united with the Guru; to some, the Lord grants peace, while others - deceitful cheats - suffer in isolation. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (305-4) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak iknaa gur mayl sukh d ayvai ik aapay vakh  kadh ai thagvaalay. ||1||

lines.english: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name deep within their hearts - the Lordresolves their affairs.
lines.transliteration: jinaa andar naam niDh aan har t in kay kaaj d a-yi aad ay raas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਕਾਜ  ਦਿਯ  ਆਦੇ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: They are no longer subservient to other people; the Lord God sits by them, at theirside.
lines.transliteration: tin chookee muht aajee lokan kee har parabh  ang kar baith aa paas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਚੂਕੀ  ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ  ਲੋਕਨ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ  ਕਿਰ ਬੈਠਾ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: When the Creator is on their side, then everyone is on their side. Beholding their vision, everyone applauds them.
lines.transliteration: jaaN kartaa val t aa sabh  ko val sabh  darsan d aykh karahi saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਕਰਤਾ  ਵਿਲ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਲ  ਸਿਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Kings and emperors are all created by the Lord; they all come and bow in reverenceto the Lord's humble servant.
lines.transliteration: saahu paatisaahu sabh  har kaa kee-aa sabh  jan ka-o aa-ay karahi rahraas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਿਭ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਰਹਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Great is the greatness of the Perfect Guru. Serving the Great Lord, I have obtainedimmeasurable peace.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee vadee vadi-aa-ee har vadaa sayv atul sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਵਡਾ ਸੇਿਵ ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has bestowed this eternal gift upon the Perfect Guru; His blessings increaseday by day.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai daan d ee-aa har nihchal nit  bakh say charh ai savaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਿਨਤ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer, who cannot endure His greatness, is destroyed by the Creator Himself.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee nindak vadi-aa-ee d aykh na sakai so kart ai aap pachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੇਿਖ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator, who protects His devoteesforever. ||2|| pauVI ] (305-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gun bolai kart ay kay bh agtaa no sad aa rakh -daa aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੇ ਭਗਤਾ  ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਦਾ  ਆਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You, O Lord and Master, are inaccessible and merciful; You are the Great Giver, All-knowing.
lines.transliteration: too saahib agam d a-i-aal hai vad d aataa daanaa.

lines.english: I can see no other as great as You; O Lord of Wisdom, You are pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad mai hor ko d is naa aavee t oohaiN sugh arh mayrai man bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to your family and everything you see is temporary, coming and going.
lines.transliteration: moh kutamb dis aavd aa sabh  chalan haaraa aavan  jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਿਦਿਸ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਤੂਹੈਂ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who attach their consciousness to anything except the True Lord are false, andfalse is their pride.
lines.transliteration: jo bin sachay horat chit  laa-id ay say koorh i-aar koorh aa tin maan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਿਦਿਸ  ਆਵਦਾ  ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰਾ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the True Lord; without the True Lord, the ignorant rot awayand putrefy to death. ||10|| slok mÚ 4 ] (305-13) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach Dhi-aa-ay t oo bin sachay pach pach mu-ay ajaan aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਰਤੁ  ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ  ਸੇ ਕੂਿੜਆਰ  ਕੂੜਾ ਿਤਨ ਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: At first, he did not show respect to the Guru; later, he offered excuses, but it is nouse.
lines.transliteration: ago day sat  bhaa-o na d ichai pichh o day aakh i-aa kamm na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਿਚ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The wretched, self-willed manmukhs wander around and are stuck mid-way; how canthey find peace by mere words?
lines.transliteration: aDh vich firai manmukh  vaychaaraa galee ki-o sukh  paavai.

lines.english: Those who have no love for the True Guru within their hearts come with falsehood, and leave with falsehood.
lines.transliteration: jis andar pareet  nahee sat gur kee so koorh ee aavai koorh ee jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਿਦਚੈ  ਿਪਛੋ ਦੇ ਆਿਖਆ  ਕੰਿਮ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: When my Lord God, the Creator, grants His Grace, then they come to see the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jay kirpaa karay mayraa har parabh kart aa taaN satgur paarbarahm nad ree aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਧ ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਫਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਗਲੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Then, they drink in the Nectar, the Word of the Guru's Shabad; all burning, anxiety,and doubts are eliminated.
lines.transliteration: taa api-o peevai sabad  gur kayraa sabh  kaarh aa and aysaa bh aram chukh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ  ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: They remain in ecstasy forever, day and night; O servant Nanak, they sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (305-16) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee jan naanak an-d in har gun  gaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਤ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who calls himself a Sikh of the Guru, the True Guru, shall rise in the earlymorning hours and meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur kaa jo sikh  akhaa-ay so bh alkay uth  har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਅਿਪਉ  ਪੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਾੜਾ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Upon arising early in the morning, he is to bathe, and cleanse himself in the pool ofnectar.
lines.transliteration: udam karay bh alkay parbh aatee isnaan karay amrit  sar naavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Following the Instructions of the Guru, he is to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.All sins, misdeeds and negativity shall be erased.
lines.transliteration: updays guroo har har jap jaapai sabh  kilvikh  paap d okh leh jaavai.

lines.english: Then, at the rising of the sun, he is to sing Gurbani; whether sitting down or standingup, he is to meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: fir charhai d ivas gurbaan ee gaavai bahd i-aa uth -di-aa har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਜੋ ਿਸਖੁ ਅਖਾਏ  ਸੁ ਭਲਕੇ  ਉਿਠ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who meditates on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and every morsel of food - that GurSikh becomes pleasing to the Guru's Mind. pMnw 306
lines.transliteration: jo saas giraas Dhi-aa-ay mayraa har har so gursikh  guroo man bh aavai.

lines.english: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is kind and compassionate - upon that GurSikh, the Guru's Teachings are bestowed.
lines.transliteration: jis no da-i-aal hovai mayraa su-aamee t is gursikh  guroo upd ays sun aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਗੁਰੂ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of that GurSikh, who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it. ||2|| pauVI ] (306-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak Dhoorh  mangai t is gursikh  kee jo aap japai avrah naam japaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਧੂਿੜ ਮੰਗੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਕੀ ਜੋ ਆਿਪ  ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord - they are very rare.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  sach Dh i-aa-id ay say virlay thorh ay.

lines.english: Those who worship and adore the One Lord in their conscious minds - through theirgenerosity, countless millions are fed.
lines.transliteration: jo man chit ik araaDh -day tin kee barkat  khaahi asaNkh karorh ay.

lines.english: All meditate on You, but they alone are accepted, who are pleasing to their Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: tuDhuno sabh  Dhi-aa-id ee say thaa-ay pa-ay jo saahib lorh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਦੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਿਤ  ਖਾਿਹ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਕਰੋੜੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who eat and dress without serving the True Guru die; after death, thosewretched lepers are consigned to reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: jo bin satgur sayvay kh aaday paind ay say mu-ay mar jammay korhHay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ  ਸਭ ਿਧਆਇਦੀ  ਸੇ ਥਾਇ  ਪਏ ਜੋ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਲੋੜੇ ॥
lines.english: In His Sublime Presence, they talk sweetly, but behind His back, they exude poison from their mouths.
lines.transliteration: o-ay haajar mithaa bold ay baahar vis kadh eh mukh  gholay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਖਾਦੇ ਪੈਨਦੇ  ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੇ ਕੋੜੇ ॥
lines.english: The evil-minded are consigned to separation from the Lord. ||11|| slok mÚ 4 ] (306-5) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man khotay d a-yi vichh orhay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਿਮਠਾ  ਬੋਲਦੇ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਵਸੁ ਕਢਿਹ  ਮੁਿਖ ਘੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: The faithless baymukh sent out his faithless se rvant, wearing a blue-black coat, filled with filth and vermin.
lines.transliteration: mal joo-ee bhari-aa neelaa kaalaa kh iDholrhaa tin vaimukh  vaymukh ai no paa-i-aa.

lines.english: No one in the world will sit near him; the self-willed manmukh fell into manure, andreturned with even more filth covering him.
lines.transliteration: paas na day-ee ko-ee bahan  jagat  meh gooh parh  sagvee mal laa-ay manmukh  aa-i- aa.

lines.english: The faithless baymukh was sent to slander and back-bite others, but when he went there, the faces of both he and his faithless master were blackened instead. qV suixAw sBqu jgq ivic BweI vymuKu sxY nPr Y paulI paudI Pwvw hoie kY auiT Gir AwieAw ] (306-8, gauVI, mÚ 4) tarh suni-aa sabh at jagat  vich bh aa-ee vaimukh  sanai nafrai pa-ulee pa-ud ee faavaa ho-ay kai uth gh ar aa-i-aa. It was immediately heard throughout the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, that this faithless man, along with his servant, was kicked and beaten with shoes; inhumiliation, they got up and returned to their homes.
lines.transliteration: gauVI, mÚ 4) paraa-ee jo nindaa chuglee no vaimukh  kar kai bh ayji-aa othai bh ee muhu kaalaa duhaa vaymukh aa daa karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲੁ ਜੂਈ ਭਿਰਆ  ਨੀਲਾ  ਕਾਲਾ  ਿਖਧੋਲੜਾ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਵੇਮੁਿਖ  ਵੇਮੁਖੈ  ਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: 4) agai sangtee kurh mee vaimukh  ralnaa na milai t aa vahutee bh ateejeeN fir aan  ghar paa-i-aa. The faithless baymukh was not allowed to mingle with others; his wife and niece thenbrought him home to lie down.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਿਸ  ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਿਣ  ਜਗਤ ਮਿਹ ਗੂਹ ਪਿੜ ਸਗਵੀ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਇ  ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He has lost both this world and the next; he cries out continually, in hunger and thirst.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  dovai ga-ay nit  bhukhaa kookay t ihaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਾਈ  ਜੋ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਚੁਗਲੀ  ਨੋ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਭੇਿਜਆ ਓਥੈ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ  ਦੁਹਾ ਵੇਮੁਖਾ  ਦਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an su-aamee kart aa purakh  hai jin ni-aa-o sach bahi aap karaa-i-aa. Blessed, blessed is the Creator, the Primal Being, our Lord and Master; He Himself sitsand dispenses true justice.

lines.punjabi: ਤੜ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਸਭਤੁ  ਜਗਤ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਭਾਈ  ਵੇਮੁਖੁ  ਸਣੈ ਨਫਰੈ ਪਉਲੀ  ਪਉਦੀ  ਫਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਉਿਠ ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru is punished and destroyed by the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo nindaa karay sat gur pooray kee so saachai maar pachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ  ਕੁੜਮੀ  ਵੇਮੁਖੁ  ਰਲਣਾ  ਨ ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਭਤੀਜੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਿਣ  ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This Word is spoken by the One who created the whole universe. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (306-12) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayhu akhar t in aakh i-aa jin jagat  sabh  upaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ  ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਿਨਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਿਤਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who has a poor beggar for a master - how can he be well-fed?
lines.transliteration: saahib jis kaa nangaa bhukh aa hovai t is daa nafar kithhu raj kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਨਆਉ  ਸਚੁ ਬਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If there is something in his master's house, he can get it; but how can he get what isnot there?
lines.transliteration: je saahib kai ghar vath hovai so nafrai hath aavai an hodee kithhu paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਾਿਰ ਪਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Serving him, who will be called to answer for his account? That service is painful anduseless.
lines.transliteration: jis dee sayvaa keet ee fir laykh aa mangee-ai saa sayvaa a-ukh ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਿਤਿਨ  ਆਿਖਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2|| pauVI ] (306-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sayvaa karahu har gur safal darsan kee fir laykh aa mangai na ko-ee. ||2||

lines.english: O Nanak, the Saints consider, and the four Vedas proclaim,
lines.transliteration: naanak vichaareh sant jan chaar vayd  kahand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਨੰਗਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਨਫਰੁ ਿਕਥਹੁ ਰਿਜ ਖਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat  mukh ai tay bold ay say vachan hovand ay. that whatever the Lord's devotees utter with their mouths, shall come to pass.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਫਰੈ  ਹਿਥ ਆਵੈ  ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਿਕਥਹੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He is manifest in His cosmic workshop. All people hear of this.
lines.transliteration: pargat pahaaraa jaapdaa sabh  lok sun anday.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਉਖੀ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The stubborn men who fight with the Saints shall never find peace.
lines.transliteration: sukh na paa-in mugaDh  nar sant  naal kh ahand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਸਫਲ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਿਫਿਰ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they only burn in their egos.
lines.transliteration: o-ay lochan onaa gunai no o-ay ahaNkaar sarh anday.

lines.english: What can those wretched ones do, since, from the very beginning, their destiny iscursed with evil.
lines.transliteration: o-ay vichaaray ki-aa karahi jaa bhaag Dh ur mand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵੀਚਾਰਿਹ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਚਾਿਰ  ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God are of no use to anyone.
lines.transliteration: jo maaray tin paarbarahm say kisai na sand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ  ਸੇ ਵਚਨ  ਹੋਵੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who hate the One who has no hatred - according to the true justice of Dharma, they shall perish.
lines.transliteration: vair karahi nirvair naal Dharam ni-aa-ay pachand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਪਹਾਰਾ  ਜਾਪਦਾ  ਸਿਭ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are cursed by the Saints will continue wandering aimlessly.
lines.transliteration: jo jo sant saraapi-aa say fireh bh avand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਿਲ  ਖਹੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||12|| slok mÚ 4  ] (306-19) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok Fourth Mehl: pMnw 307
lines.transliteration: payd muNdhaahooN kati-aa t is daal sukand ay. ||12||

lines.english: Great is the greatness of the Guru, who meditates on the Lord within.
lines.transliteration: antar har guroo Dh i-aa-id aa vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਿਸ ਿਦਤੀ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਘਟਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By His Pleasure, the Lord has bestowed this upon the Perfect True Guru; it is not diminished one bit by anyone's efforts.
lines.transliteration: tus ditee poorai sat guroo gh atai naahee ik t il kisai d ee gh ataa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੈ ਵਿਲ ਹੈ ਤ ਝਿਖ ਝਿਖ ਮਰੈ ਸਭ ਲਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord and Master is on the side of the True Guru; and so, all those whooppose Him waste away to death in anger, envy and conflict.
lines.transliteration: sach saahib satguroo kai val hai t aaN jhakh jhakh marai sabh  lokaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਧਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Creator, blackens the faces of the slanderers, and increases the glory ofthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: nindkaa kay muh kaalay karay har kart ai aap vaDh aa-ee.

lines.english: As the slanderers spread their slander, so does the Guru's glory increase day by day.
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o nindak nind  karahi t i-o ti-o nit  nit charh ai savaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਪੈਰੀ ਆਿਣ  ਸਭ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak worships the Lord, who makes everyone fall at His Feet. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (307-4) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har aaraaDhi-aa t in pairee aan  sabh  paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: One who enters into a calculated relationship with the True Guru loses everything, thisworld and the next.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayt ee gan at je rakh ai halat  palat  sabh  tis kaa ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਤੀ ਗਣਤ  ਿਜ ਰਖੈ ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He grinds his teeth continually and foams at the mouth; screaming in anger, heperishes.
lines.transliteration: nit jhahee-aa paa-ay jh agoo sutay jh akh-daa jhakh-daa jharh pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਝਹੀਆ  ਪਾਏ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟੇ ਝਖਦਾ  ਝਖਦਾ  ਝਿੜ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He continually chases after Maya and wealth, but even his own wealth flies away.
lines.transliteration: nit upaav karai maa-i-aa Dh an kaaran  aglaa Dh an bh ee ud ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਧਨ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਅਗਲਾ  ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਉਿਡ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: What shall he earn, and what shall he eat? Within his heart, there is only cynicism andpain.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa oh khatay ki-aa oh kh aavai jis and ar sahsaa d ukh pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਓਹੁ ਖਟੇ ਿਕਆ  ਓਹੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who hates the One who has no hatred, shall bear the load of all the sins of theworld on his head.
lines.transliteration: nirvairai naal je vair rachaa-ay sabh paap jagt ai kaa t in sir la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਵੈਰੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਜ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ  ਸਭੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਜਗਤੈ  ਕਾ ਿਤਿਨ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He shall find no shelter here or hereafter; his mouth blisters with the slander in hisheart.
lines.transliteration: os agai pichhai dh o-ee naahee jis and ar nind aa muhi amb pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਮੁਿਹ ਅੰਬੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If gold comes into his hands, it turns to dust.
lines.transliteration: jay su-inay no oh hath paa-ay taa kh ayhoo sayt ee ral ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸੁਇਨੇ  ਨੋ ਓਹੁ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਖੇਹੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਲ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But if he should come again to the Sanctuary of the Guru, then even his past sins shall be forgiven.
lines.transliteration: jay gur kee sarnee fir oh aavai t aa pichh lay a-ugan  bakh as la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ  ਤਾ ਿਪਛਲੇ  ਅਉਗਣ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, night and day. Remembering the Lord inmeditation, wickedness and sins are erased. ||2|| pauVI ] (307-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak an-din naam Dh i-aa-i-aa har simrat  kilvikh  paap ga-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਪਾਪ ਗਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Truest of the True; Your Regal Court is the most exalted of all.
lines.transliteration: toohai sachaa sach t oo sabh  doo upar t oo deebaan .

lines.english: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord, serve the Truth; O True Lord, they takepride in You.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  sach Dh i-aa-id ay sach sayvan sachay t ayraa maan .

lines.punjabi: ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਉਪਿਰ  ਤੂ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Within them is the Truth; their faces are radiant, and they speak the Truth. O TrueLord, You are their strength.
lines.transliteration: onaa andar sach mukh  ujlay sach bolan sachay t ayraa t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who, as Gurmukh, praise You are Your devotees; they have the insignia andthe banner of the Shabad, the True Word of God.
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  jinee gurmukh  salaahi-aa sach sabad  neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਿਨ  ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I am truly a sacrifice, forever devoted to those who serve the True Lord. ||13|| slok mÚ 4 ] (307-13) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach je sachay sayvday t in vaaree sad  kurbaan . ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਲਾਿਹਆ  ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur maaray poorai sat guroo say-ee hun  satgur maaray. Those who were cursed by the Perfect True Guru, from the very beginning, are evennow cursed by the True Guru.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਜ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਿਤਨ ਵਾਰੀ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Even though they may have a great longing to associate with the Guru, the Creatordoes not allow it.
lines.transliteration: jay maylan no bahut ayraa lochee-ai na d ay-ee milan  kartaaray.

lines.english: They shall not find shelter in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; in the Sangat,the Guru has proclaimed this.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  dho-ee naa lahan vich sangat  gur veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੇਈ ਹੁਿਣ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Whoever goes out to meet them now, will be destroyed by the tyrant, the Messengerof Death.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee jaa-ay milai hun onaa no t is maaray jam jand aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਮੇਲਣ  ਨੋ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ  ਨ ਦੇਈ ਿਮਲਣ  ਕਰਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who were condemned by Guru Nanak were declared counterfeit by Guru Angadas well.
lines.transliteration: gur baabai fitkay say fitay gur angad keet ay koorh i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਿਨ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru of the third generation thought, "What lies in the hands of these poorpeople?"
lines.transliteration: gur teejee peerh ee veechaari-aa ki-aa hath aynaa vaychaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਿਮਲੈ ਹੁਿਣ ਓਨਾ  ਨੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru of the fourth generation saved all these slanderers and evil-doers.
lines.transliteration: gur cha-uthee peerhee tiki-aa t in nind ak dusat sabh  taaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਬਾਬੈ ਿਫਟਕੇ  ਸੇ ਿਫਟੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਅੰਗਿਦ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਕੂਿੜਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: If any son or Sikh serves the True Guru, then all of his affairs will be resolved.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee put sikh  sayvaa karay sat guroo kee t is kaaraj sabh  savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੀਜੀ  ਪੀੜੀ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਹਿਥ ਏਨਾ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He obtains the fruits of his desires - children, wealth, property, union with the Lord and emancipation.
lines.transliteration: jo ichhai so fal paa-isee put  Dhan lakh mee kh arh maylay har nist aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਚਉਥੀ  ਪੀੜੀ  ਿਟਿਕਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਦੁਸਟ ਸਿਭ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: All treasures are in the True Guru, who has enshrined the Lord within the heart.
lines.transliteration: sabh niDh aan sat guroo vich jis and ar har ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਪੁਤੁ ਿਸਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਿਭ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such blessed destiny ispre-ordained.
lines.transliteration: so paa-ay pooraa satguroo jis likh i-aa likh at lilaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ  ਖਿੜ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs who love the Lord, their Friend. ||1|| pMnw 308 mÚ 4 ] (308-1) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak maagai Dhoorh  tin jo gursikh  mit pi-aaray. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord Himself bestows glorious greatness; He Himself causes the world to comeand fall at their feet.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o aap day-ay vadi-aa-ee jagat  bhee aapay aan  tin ka-o pairee paa-ay.

lines.english: We should only be afraid, if we try to do things by ourselves; the Creator is increasingHis Power in every way.
lines.transliteration: daree-ai taaN jay kichh  aap d oo keechai sabh  kartaa aapn ee kalaa vaDh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਿਪ  ਦੇਇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਭੀ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਣ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny: this is the Arena of the Beloved True Lord; His powerbrings everyone to bow in humility.
lines.transliteration: daykh hu bh aa-ee ayhu akh aarhaa har pareet am sachay kaa jin aapn ai jor sabh  aan nivaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਡਰੀਐ  ਤ ਜੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪ  ਦੂ ਕੀਚੈ  ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਕਲਾ  ਵਧਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, our Lord and Master, preserves and protects His devotees; He blackens thefaces of the slanderers and evil-doers.
lines.transliteration: aapni-aa bh agtaa kee rakh  karay har su-aamee nind kaa d ustaa kay muh kaalay karaa- ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ਏਹੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਜੋਿਰ ਸਿਭ ਆਿਣ  ਿਨਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The glorious greatness of the True Guru increases day by day; the Lord inspires Hisdevotees to continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee vadi-aa-ee nit  charh ai savaa-ee har keerat  bhagat nit aap karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਿਣਆ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਰਖ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਨੰਦਕਾ ਦੁਸਟਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ  ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O GurSikhs, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day; through the TrueGuru, the Creator Lord will come to dwell within the home of your inner being.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam japahu gursikh ahu har kart aa sat gur gh aree vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਨਤ  ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਆਿਪ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O GurSikhs, know that the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, is true, absolutely true.The Creator Lord Himself causes the Guru to chant it.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee ban ee sat  sat kar jaan hu gursikh ahu har kart aa aap muhhu kadh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਘਰੀ  ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Lord makes the faces of His GurSikhs radiant; He makes the whole world applaud and acclaim the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa kay muh ujlay karay har pi-aaraa gur kaa jaikaar sansaar sabh at karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; the Lord Himself preserves the honor of Hisslave. ||2|| pauVI ] (308-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har d aasan kee har paij rakh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਉਜਲੇ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਸਭਤੁ  ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O My True Lord and Master, You Yourself are my True Lord King.
lines.transliteration: too sachaa saahib aap hai sach saah hamaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Please, implant within me the true treasure of Your Name; O God, I am Your merchant.
lines.transliteration: sach poojee naam drirh-aa-ay parabh  vanjaaray thaaray.

lines.english: I serve the True One, and deal in the True One; I chant Your Wondrous Praises.
lines.transliteration: sach sayveh sach vananj laihi gun  kathah niraaray.

lines.english: Those humble beings who serve the Lord with love meet Him; they are adorned withthe Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sayvak bhaa-ay say jan milay gur sabad  savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O my True Lord and Master, You are unknowable; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, You are known. ||14|| slok mÚ 4 ] (308-10) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too sachaa saahib alakh  hai gur sabad  lakhaaray. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ਥਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: One whose heart is filled with jealousy of others, never comes to any good.
lines.transliteration: jis andar t aat paraa-ee hovai t is daa kad ay na hovee bh alaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਿਜ  ਲੈਿਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਹ  ਿਨਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: No one pays any attention to what he says; he is just a fool, crying out endlessly inthe wilderness.
lines.transliteration: os dai aakh i-ai ko-ee na lagai nit  ojaarh ee pookaaray kh alaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: One whose heart is filled with malicious gossip, is known as a malicious gossip;everything he does is in vain.
lines.transliteration: jis andar chuglee chuglo vajai keet aa kart i-aa os d aa sabh  ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਖਾਰੇ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Night and day, he continually gossips about others; his face has been blackened, and he cannot show it to anyone.
lines.transliteration: nit chuglee karay an hodee paraa-ee muhu kadh  na sakai os d aa kaalaa bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: The body is the field of action, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; as you plant, so shall youharvest.
lines.transliteration: karam Dhart ee sareer kalijug vich jayhaa ko beejay t ayhaa ko kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਤਾਿਤ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.english: Justice is not passed on mere words; if someone eats poison, he dies.
lines.transliteration: galaa upar tapaavas na ho-ee vis kh aaDhee tatkaal mar jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸ ਦੈ ਆਿਖਐ  ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਨਤ  ਓਜਾੜੀ  ਪੂਕਾਰੇ  ਖਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, behold the justice of the True Creator; as people act, so theyare rewarded.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee vaykh hu ni-aa-o sach kart ay kaa jayhaa ko-ee karay t ayhaa ko-ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਚੁਗਲੀ  ਚੁਗਲੋ  ਵਜੈ ਕੀਤਾ  ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਓਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has bestowed total understanding upon servant Nanak; he speaks andproclaims the words of the Lord's Court. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (308-15) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o sabh sojh ee paa-ee har d ar kee-aa baat aa aakh  sunaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਚੁਗਲੀ  ਕਰੇ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਮੁਹੁ ਕਿਢ  ਨ ਸਕੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who separate themselves from the Guru, in spite of His Constant Presence -they find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: hodai part akh guroo jo vichh urhay tin ka-o d ar dho-ee naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਏ ॥
lines.english: If someone goes to meet with those dull-faced slanderers, he will find their facescovered with spit.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee jaa-ay milai tin nind kaa muh fikay thuk thuk muhi paahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਲਾ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਤਪਾਵਸੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਿਵਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ  ਤਤਕਾਲ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those who are cursed by the True Guru, are cursed by all the world. They wander around endlessly.
lines.transliteration: jo satgur fitkay say sabh  jagat  fitkay nit  bhambal bh oosay kh aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਿਨਆਉ  ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਾ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not publicly affirm their Guru wander around, moaning and groaning.
lines.transliteration: jin gur gopi-aa aapnaa say laid ay dh ahaa firaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ  ਬਾਤਾ  ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Their hunger shall never depart; afflicted by constant hunger, they cry out in pain.
lines.transliteration: tin kee bh ukh kaday na ut rai nit  bhukhaa bh ukh kookaahee.

lines.english: No one hears what they have to say; they live in constant fear and terror, until theyfinally die.
lines.transliteration: onaa daa aakh i-aa ko na sun ai nit ha-ulay ha-ul maraahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਦੈ ਪਰਤਿਖ  ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਿਵਛੁੜੇ ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਦਿਰ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: They cannot bear the glorious greatness of the True Guru, and they find no place ofrest, here or hereafter.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee vadi-aa-ee vaykh  na saknee onaa agai pichh ai thaa-o naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਨ ਿਨੰਦਕਾ  ਮੁਹ ਿਫਕੇ ਥੁਕ ਥੁਕ ਮੁਿਹ ਪਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who go out to meet with those who have been cursed by the True Guru, lose all remnants of their honor. pMnw 309
lines.transliteration: jo satgur maaray t in jaa-ay mileh rahd ee kh uhdee sabh  pat gavaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਰਹਦੀ  ਖੁਹਦੀ  ਸਭ ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: They have already become like lepers; cursed by the Guru, whoever meets them is also afflicted with leprosy.
lines.transliteration: o-ay agai kustee gur kay fitkay je os milai tis kusat uth aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਿਫਟਕੇ  ਿਜ ਓਸੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਕੁਸਟੁ ਉਠਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, I pray that I may not even catch sight of those, who focus their consciousnesson the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: har tin kaa d arsan naa karahu jo d oojai bh aa-ay chit  laahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur kart ai aap likh  paa-i-aa t is naal kihu chaaraa naahee. That which the Creator pre-ordained from the very beginning - there can be no escape from that.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਕਹੁ ਚਾਰਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no one canequal it.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam araaDh t oo tis aparh  ko na sakaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧ  ਤੂ ਿਤਸੁ ਅਪਿੜ  ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Great is the greatness of His Name; it increases, day by day. ||2|| mÚ 4 ] (309-4) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naavai kee vadi-aa-ee vadee hai nit savaa-ee charh ai charh aahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਿਨਤ ਸਵਾਈ  ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Great is the greatness of that humble being, whom the Guru Himself anointed in HisPresence.
lines.transliteration: je hoNdai guroo bahi tiki-aa tis jan kee vadi-aa-ee vadee ho-ee.

lines.english: All the world comes and bows to him, falling at his feet. His praises spread throughoutthe world.
lines.transliteration: tis ka-o jagat  nivi-aa sabh  pairee pa-i-aa jas vart i-aa lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਹੋਂਦੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਹ ਿਟਿਕਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The galaxies and solar systems bow in reverence to him; the Perfect Guru has placedHis hand upon his head, and he has become perfect.
lines.transliteration: gauVI, mÚ 4) tis ka-o kh and barahmand namaskaar karahi jis kai mast ak hath Dh ari-aa gur poorai so pooraa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਨਿਵਆ  ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਇਆ  ਜਸੁ ਵਰਿਤਆ  ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The glorious greatness of the Guru increases day by day; no one can equal it.
lines.transliteration: gur kee vadi-aa-ee nit charh ai savaa-ee aparh  ko na sako-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਥੁ ਧਿਰਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Creator Lord Himself established him; God preserves his honor. ||3|| pauVI ] (309-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kartai aap bahi tiki-aa aapay paij rakh ai parabh  so-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਨਤ  ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ  ਅਪਿੜ  ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕੋਈ  ॥
lines.english: The human body is a great fortress, with its shops and streets within.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kot apaar hai andar hatnaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਬਿਹ ਿਟਿਕਆ  ਆਪੇ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh who comes to trade gathers the cargo of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sa-ud aa jo karay har vasat  samaalay.

lines.english: He deals in the treasure of the Lord's Name, the jewels and the diamonds.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan har van jee-ai heeray parvaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਹਟਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who search for this treasure outside of the body, in other places, are foolishdemons.
lines.transliteration: vin kaa-i-aa je hor thai Dh an kh ojday say moorh  baytaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਉਦਾ  ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਵਸਤੁ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They wander around in the wilderness of doubt, like the deer who searches for themusk in the bushes. ||15|| slok mÚ 4 ] (309-10) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: say ujharh  bharam bh avaa-ee-ah ji-o jh aarh mirag bh aalay. ||15||

lines.english: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall have difficulty in this world.
lines.transliteration: jo nindaa karay sat gur pooray kee so a-ukh aa jag meh ho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਿਜ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਧਨੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੇ  ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: He is caught and thrown into the most horrible hell, the well of pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: narak ghor d ukh khoohu hai othai pakarh  oh dh o-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਉਝਿੜ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਵਾਈਅਿਹ  ਿਜਉ ਝਾੜ ਿਮਰਗੁ  ਭਾਲੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: No one listens to his shrieks and cries; he cries out in pain and misery.
lines.transliteration: kook pukaar ko na sunay oh a-ukh aa ho-ay ho-ay ro-i-aa.

lines.english: He totally loses this world and the next; he has lost all of his investment and profit.
lines.transliteration: on halat palat  sabh  gavaa-i-aa laahaa mool sabh  kho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਅਉਖਾ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਹੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is like the ox at the oil-press; each morning when he rises, God places the yoke upon him.
lines.transliteration: oh taylee sand aa balad  kar nit  bhalkay uth  parabh  jo-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ  ਘੋਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਖੂਹੁ ਹੈ ਓਥੈ ਪਕਿੜ  ਓਹੁ ਢੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord always sees and hears everything; nothing can be concealed from Him.
lines.transliteration: har vaykhai sun ai nit sabh  kichh  tidoo kichh  gujhaa na ho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਉਖਾ  ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: As you plant, so shall you harvest, according to what you planted in the past.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejay so lunai jayhaa purab kinai bo-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਨ ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by God's Grace washes the feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis kirpaa karay parabh aapn ee tis satgur kay charan  Dho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਤੇਲੀ  ਸੰਦਾ ਬਲਦੁ  ਕਿਰ ਿਨਤ  ਭਲਕੇ  ਉਿਠ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਜੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is carried across by the Guru, the True Guru, like iron which is carried across bywood.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur pichh ai tar ga-i-aa ji-o lohaa kaath  sango-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਿਨਤ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਤਦੂ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਗੁਝਾ  ਨ ਹੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, peace is obtained. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (309-16) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay t oo jap har har naam sukh  ho-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਿਕਨੈ ਬੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Very fortunate is the soul-bride, who, as Gurmukh, meets the Lord, her King.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee-aa sohaagan ee jinaa gurmukh  mili-aa har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Her inner being is illiminated with His Divine Light; O Nanak, she is absorbed in HisName. ||2|| pauVI ] (309-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: antar jot  pargaasee-aa naanak naam samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਪਛੈ ਤਿਰ ਗਇਆ  ਿਜਉ  ਲੋਹਾ ਕਾਠ ਸੰਗੋਇਆ  ॥
