lines.english: This body is the home of Dharma; the Divine Light of the True Lord is within it.
lines.transliteration: ih sareer sabh Dh aram hai jis and ar sachay kee vich jot .

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hidden within it are the jewels of mystery; how rare is that Gurmukh, that selflessservant, who digs them out.
lines.transliteration: guhaj ratan vich luk rahay ko-ee gurmukh  sayvak kadh ai khot.

lines.english: When someone realizes the All-pervading Soul, then he sees the One and Only Lordpermeating, through and through.
lines.transliteration: sabh aat am raam pachh aani-aa taaN ik ravi-aa iko ot  pot.

lines.english: He sees the One, he believes in the One, and with his ears, he listens only to the One. pMnw 310
lines.transliteration: ik daykh i-aa ik mani-aa iko sun i-aa sarvan  sarot .

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਿਤ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is your service to the Lord, the Truest of the True. ||16|| slok mÚ 4 ] (310-1) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too sach sachay sayvaa t ayree hot . ||16||

lines.english: All joy is in the hearts of those, within whose minds the Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: sabh ras t in kai rid ai heh jin har vasi-aa man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਰਸ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਿਰਦੈ ਹਿਹ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, their faces are radiant, and everyone goes to see them.
lines.transliteration: har dargahi t ay mukh  ujlay t in ka-o sabh  daykhan jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਭ ਦੇਖਣ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Fearless Lord have no fear.
lines.transliteration: jin nirbha-o naam Dh i-aa-i-aa t in ka-o bh a-o ko-ee naahi.

lines.english: Those who have such pre-destined destiny remember the Sublime Lord.
lines.transliteration: har utam t inee sarayvi-aa jin ka-o Dh ur likh i-aa aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਉਤਮੁ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਸਰੇਿਵਆ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਆਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those, within whose minds the Lord abides, are robed with honor in the Court of theLord.
lines.transliteration: tay har d argahi painaa-ee-ah jin har vuth aa man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਪੈਨਾਈਅਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They are carried across, along with all their family, and the whole world is saved alongwith them.
lines.transliteration: o-ay aap taray sabh  kutamb si-o t in pichh ai sabh  jagat  chhadaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਿਸਉ ਿਤਨ ਿਪਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਛਡਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please unite servant Nanak with Your humble servants; beholding them, beholding them, I live. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (310-5) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har mayl jan tin vaykh  vaykh  ham jeevaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਜਨ ਿਤਨ  ਵੇਿਖ ਵੇਿਖ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That land, where my True Guru comes and sits, becomes green and fertile.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhart ee bh a-ee haree-aavalee jithai mayraa sat gur baith aa aa-ay.

lines.english: Those beings who go and behold my True Guru are rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: say jant bh a-ay haree-aavlay jinee mayraa sat gur daykhi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ  ਿਜਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an pit aa Dh an Dh an kul Dh an Dh an so jannee jin guroo jan i-aa maa-ay. Blessed, blessed is the father; blessed, ble ssed is the family; blessed, blessed is the mother, who gave birth to the Guru.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜੰਤ ਭਏ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo jin naam araaDh i-aa aap t ari-aa jinee dith aa tinaa la-ay chh adaa-ay. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who worships and adores the Naam; He saves Himself,and emancipates those who see Him.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਿਪਤਾ  ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨਨੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਣਆ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, be kind, and unite me with the True Guru, that servant Nanak may wash Hisfeet. ||2|| pauVI ] (310-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har satgur maylhu d a-i-aa kar jan naanak Dh ovai paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਿਡਠਾ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Truest of the True is the Immortal True Guru; He has enshrined the Lord deep withinHis heart.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa satgur amar hai jis and ar har ur Dh aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Truest of the True is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has conquered sexual desire, anger and corruption.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa satgur purakh  hai jin kaam kroDh  bikh maari-aa.

lines.english: When I see the Perfect True Guru, then deep within, my mind is comforted andconsoled.
lines.transliteration: jaa dithaa pooraa sat guroo t aaN andrahu man saaDh aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru; I am devoted and dedicated to Him, forever andever.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay sad aa sad aa gh um vaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: A Gurmukh wins the battle of life whereas a self-willed manmukh loses it. ||17|| slok mÚ 4 ] (310-11) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jit aa manmukh  haari-aa. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਡਠਾ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਤ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru; then, as Gurmukh, we chant theLord's Name, and meditate on it.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa satgur mayli-on mukh  gurmukh  naam Dh i-aa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਿਮ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: We do that which pleases the True Guru; the Perfect Guru comes to dwell in the homeof the heart.
lines.transliteration: so karay je satgur bh aavsee gur pooraa gh aree vasaa-isee.

lines.english: Those who have the treasure of the Naam deep within - all their fears are removed.
lines.transliteration: jin andar naam niDh aan hai t in kaa bh a-o sabh  gavaa-isee.

lines.english: They are protected by the Lord Himself; others struggle and fight against them, but they only come to death.
lines.transliteration: jin rakhan  ka-o har aap ho-ay hor kayt ee jhakh jhakh jaa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲਓਨੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam; the Lord shall deliver you, here andhereafter. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (310-15) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay t oo har halat  palat  chhodaa-isee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਵਸੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਘਰੀ  ਵਸਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The glorious greatness of the Guru, the True Guru, is pleasing to the GurSikh's mind.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa kai man bh aavdee gur sat gur kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord preserves the honor of the True Guru, which increases day by day.
lines.transliteration: har raakho paij sat guroo kee nit  charh ai savaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਰਖਣ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਹੋਇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ  ਝਿਖ ਝਿਖ ਜਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is in the Mind of the Guru, the True Guru; the Supreme LordGod saves Him.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur kai man paarbarahm hai paarbarahm chh adaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਛੋਡਾਇਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Power and Support of the Guru, the True Guru; all come to bowbefore Him.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur t aan deebaan  har t in sabh  aan nivaa-ee.

lines.english: Those who have gazed lovingly upon my True Guru - all their sins are taken away.
lines.transliteration: jinee dithaa mayraa sat gur bh aa-o kar t in kay sabh  paap gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਦੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and they obtain great glory.
lines.transliteration: har dargeh t ay mukh  ujlay baho sobh aa paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੀ ਿਨਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||2|| pauVI ] (310-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mangai Dhoorh  tin jo gur kay sikh  mayray bh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਛਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I chant the Praises and Glories of the True One. True is the glorious greatness of theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o aakh salaahee sifat  sach sach sachay kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤਾਣੁ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਭ ਆਿਣ  ਿਨਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I praise the True Lord, and the Praises of the True Lord. His worth cannot be estimated. pMnw 311
lines.transliteration: saalaahee sach salaah sach sach keemat kinai na paa-ee.

lines.english: Those who have tasted the true essence of the True Lord, remain satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa ras jinee chakhi-aa say t aripat  rahay aagh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਚਿਖਆ  ਸੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They know this essence of the Lord, but they say nothing, like the mute who tastesthe sweet candy, and says nothing.
lines.transliteration: ih har ras say-ee jaanday ji-o gooNgai mith i-aa-ee kh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਦੇ  ਿਜਉ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਿਮਿਠਆਈ  ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru serves the Lord God; His vibration vibrates and resounds in themind. ||18|| slok mÚ 4 ] (311-2) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har parabh sayvi-aa man vajee vaaDh aa-ee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਮਿਨ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Those who have a festering boil within - they alone know its pain.
lines.transliteration: jinaa andar umarthal say-ee jaan an soolee-aa.

lines.english: Those who know the pain of separation from the Lord - I am forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: har jaaneh say-ee birahu ha-o t in vitahu sad  ghum gh olee-aa.

lines.english: O Lord, please lead me to meet the Guru, the Primal Being, my Friend; my head shallroll in the dust under His feet.
lines.transliteration: har maylhu sajan purakh  mayraa sir t in vitahu t al rolee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਿਬਰਹੁ ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਿਮ ਘੋਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am the slave of the slaves of those GurSikhs who serve Him.
lines.transliteration: jo sikh gur kaar kamaaveh ha-o gulam t inaa kaa golee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਿਸਰੁ ਿਤਨ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਤਲ ਰੋਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love - their robesare drenched in the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har rang chaloolai jo ratay t in bhinee har rang cholee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਸਖ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਹਉ ਗੁਲਮੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਾ ਗੋਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Grant Your Grace, and lead Nanak to meet the Guru; I have sold my head to Him.||1|| mÚ 4 ] (311-6) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naanak mayl gur peh sir vaychi-aa molee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੈ  ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਿਤਨ  ਿਭਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਚੋਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The body is full of mistakes and misdeeds; how can it become pure, O Saints?
lines.transliteration: a-uganee bh ari-aa sareer hai ki-o sant ahu nirmal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਿਲ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਿਸਰੁ ਵੇਿਚਆ  ਮੋਲੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh purchases virtues, which wash off the sin of egotism.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gun  vayhaajh ee-ah mal ha-umai kadh ai Dho-ay.

lines.english: True is the trade which purchases the True Lord with love.
lines.transliteration: sach vanaNjahi rang si-o sach sa-ud aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗਣੀ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਕਉ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: No loss will come from this, and the profit comes by the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: totaa mool na aavee laahaa har bh aavai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਣ ਵੇਹਾਝੀਅਿਹ  ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they alone purchase the Truth, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny. ||2|| pauVI ] (311-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin sach van anji-aa jinaa Dh ur likh i-aa paraapat  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਹ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I praise the True One, who alone is worthy of praise. The True Primal Being is True - this is His unique quality.
lines.transliteration: saalaahee sach salaahnaa sach sachaa purakh  niraalay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Lord, the Truth comes to dwell in the mind. The Lord, the Truest ofthe True, is my Protector.
lines.transliteration: sach sayvee sach man vasai sach sachaa har rakhvaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਿਜਆ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who worship and adore the Truest of the True, shall go and merge with theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa jinee araaDhi-aa say jaa-ay ralay sach naalay.

lines.english: Those who do not serve the Truest of the True - those self-willed manmukhs arefoolish demons.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa jinee na sayvi-aa say manmukh moorh  baytaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: With their mouths, they babble on about this and that, like the drunkard who has drunk his wine. ||19|| slok mhlw 3 ] (311-11) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: oh aal pataal muhhu bold ay ji-o peet ai mad  matvaalay. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Gauree Raga is auspicious, if, through it, one comes to think of his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ga-orhee raag sulakh -nee jay kh asmai chit  karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਿਜਨੀ  ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਸੇ ਜਾਇ  ਰਲੇ ਸਚ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: He should walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; this should be hisdecoration.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai chalai sat guroo kai aisaa seegaar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਿਜਨੀ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Word of the Shabad is our spouse; ravish and enjoy it, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad bh ataar hai sad aa sad aa raavay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਆਲੁ  ਪਤਾਲੁ  ਮੁਹਹੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ  ਿਜਉ  ਪੀਤੈ ਮਿਦ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Like the deep crimson color of the madder plant - such is the dye which shall coloryou, when you dedicate your soul to the True One.
lines.transliteration: ji-o ublee majeethai rang gahgahaa t i-o sachay no jee-o d ay-ay.

lines.english: One who loves the True Lord is totally imbued with the Lord's Love, like the deepcrimson color of the poppy.
lines.transliteration: rang chaloolai at rat ee sachay si-o lagaa nayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਰਾਿਗ  ਸੁਲਖਣੀ  ਜੇ ਖਸਮੈ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Falsehood and deception may be covered with false coatings, but they cannot remainhidden.
lines.transliteration: koorh th agee gujh ee naa rahai koorh  mulammaa palayt Dh arayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੈ ਐਸਾ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: False is the uttering of praises, by those who love falsehood.
lines.transliteration: koorhee karan vadaa-ee-aa koorh ay si-o lagaa nayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He alone is True; He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (311-15) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa aap hai aapay nadar karay-i. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਉਬਲੀ  ਮਜੀਠੈ  ਰੰਗੁ ਗਹਗਹਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਜੀਉ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Lord's Praises are sung. In the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy, the Beloved Lord is met.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  meh har ust at hai sang saaDh oo milay pi-aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੈ  ਅਿਤ  ਰਤੀ ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਲਗਾ  ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Blessed is that mortal being, who shares the Teachings for the good of others.
lines.transliteration: o-ay purakh paraan ee Dh an jan heh upd ays karahi par-upkaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ  ਗੁਝੀ  ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ  ਪਲੇਿਟ  ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He implants the Name of the Lord, and he preaches the Name of the Lord; throughthe Name of the Lord, the world is saved.
lines.transliteration: har naam darirh aaveh har naam sun aaveh har naamay jag nist aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੀ ਕਰਿਨ ਵਡਾਈਆ  ਕੂੜੇ ਿਸਉ ਲਗਾ  ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Everyone longs to see the Guru; the world, and the nine continents, bow down toHim.
lines.transliteration: gur vaykhan  ka-o sabh  ko-ee lochai nav kh and jagat  namaskaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself have established the True Guru; You Yourself have adorned the Guru.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay aap rakh i-aa sat gur vich gur aapay t uDh savaari-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself worship and adore the True Guru; You inspire others to worship Him as well, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: too aapay poojeh pooj karaaveh sat gur ka-o sirjan haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਹੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧੂ ਿਮਲੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: If someone separates himself from the True Guru, his face is blackened, and he is destroyed by the Messenger of Death. pMnw 312
lines.transliteration: ko-ee vichhurh  jaa-ay sat guroo paashu t is kaalaa muhu jam maari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਪਾਸਹੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਲਾ  ਮੁਹੁ ਜਿਮ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He shall find no shelter, here or hereafter;  the GurSikhs have realized this in their minds.
lines.transliteration: tis agai pichh ai dho-ee naahee gursikh ee man veechaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being who meets the True Guru is saved; he cherishes the Naam, theName of the Lord, in his heart.
lines.transliteration: satguroo no milay say-ee jan ubray jin hird ai naam samaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨੋ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ  ਿਜਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak says: O GurSikhs, O my sons, meditate on the Lord; only the Lord shallsave you. ||2|| mhlw 3 ] (312-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay gursikh put hahu har japi-ahu har nist aari-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਪੁਤਹਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਅਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Egotism has led the world astray, along with evil-mindedness and the poison ofcorruption.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jagat bh ulaa-i-aa d urmat  bikhi-aa bikaar.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, we are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, while theself-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a nad ar ho-ay manmukh  anDh  anDh i-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord absorbs into Himself those whom He inspires to love the Word ofHis Shabad. ||3|| pauVI ] (312-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay mayl la-ay jis no sabad laa-ay pi-aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਨਦਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧ ਅੰਿਧਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: True are the Praises and the Glories of the True One; he alone speaks them, whose mind is softened within.
lines.transliteration: sach sachay kee sifat salaah hai so karay jis and ar bhijai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਾਏ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who worship the One Lord with single-minded devotion - their bodies shallnever perish.
lines.transliteration: jinee ik man ik araaDhi-aa t in kaa kanDh  na kabhoo chh ijai.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an purakh  saabaas hai jin sach rasnaa amrit  pijai. Blessed, blessed and acclaimed is that person, who tastes with his tongue theAmbrosial Nectar of the True Name.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹ  ਹੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਿਭਜੈ ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is pleased with the Truest of the True is accepted in the True Court.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa jin man bhaavd aa say man sachee d argeh lijai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਕੰਧੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਿਛਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an janam sachi-aaree-aa mukh  ujal sach karijai. ||20|| Blessed, blessed is the birth of those true beings; the True Lord brightens their faces.||20|| slok mÚ 4 ] (312-8) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ  ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਪਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics go and bow before the Guru, but their minds are corrupt andfalse, totally false.
lines.transliteration: saakat jaa-ay niveh gur aagai man kh otay koorh  koorh i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਦਾ  ਸੇ ਮਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ  ਿਲਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: When the Guru says, "Rise up, my Siblings of Destiny", they sit down, crowded in likecranes.
lines.transliteration: jaa gur kahai uthahu mayray bh aa-ee bahi jaahi gh usar bagulaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਿਚਆਰੀਆ  ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲ  ਸਚੁ ਕਿਰਜੈ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The True Guru prevails among His GurSikhs; they pick out and expel the wanderers.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa and ar sat gur vart ai chun  kadh ay laDh ovaaray.

lines.english: Sitting here and there, they hide their faces; being counterfeit, they cannot mix with the genuine.
lines.transliteration: o-ay agai pichhai bahi muhu chh apaa-in na ralnee kh otay-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਨਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਮਿਨ ਖੋਟੇ ਕੂਿੜ ਕੂਿੜਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: There is no food for them there; the false go into the filth like sheep.
lines.transliteration: onaa daa bh akh so othai naahee jaa-ay koorh  lahan bh aydaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਉਠਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਹ ਜਾਿਹ  ਘੁਸਿਰ ਬਗੁਲਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: If you try to feed the faithless cynic, he will spit out poison from his mouth.
lines.transliteration: jay saakat nar kh aavaa-ee-ai lochee-ai bikh  kadh ai mukh  uglaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਚੁਿਣ  ਕਢੇ ਲਧੋਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, let me not be in the company of the faithless cynic, who is cursed by theCreator Lord.
lines.transliteration: har saakat sayt ee sang na karee-ahu o-ay maaray sirjan haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਬਿਹ ਮੁਹੁ ਛਪਾਇਿਨ  ਨ ਰਲਨੀ  ਖੋਟੇਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: This drama belongs to the Lord; He performs it, and He watches over it. Servant Nanak cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (312-12) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis kaa ih khayl so-ee kar vaykh ai jan naanak naam samaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਦਾ ਭਖੁ ਸੁ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਕੂੜੁ ਲਹਿਨ  ਭੇਡਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is inaccessible; He has enshrined the Lord's Namewithin His heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  agamm hai jis and ar har ur Dh aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਾਕਤੁ  ਨਰੁ ਖਾਵਾਈਐ  ਲੋਚੀਐ  ਿਬਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਉਗਲਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: No one can equal the True Guru; the Creator Lord is on His side.
lines.transliteration: satguroo no aparh  ko-ay na sak-ee jis val sirjan haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੇਤੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਓਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Devotional worship of the Lord is the sword and armor of the True Guru; He has killed and cast out Death, the torturer.
lines.transliteration: satguroo kaa kh arhag sanjo-o har bh agat hai jit  kaal kantak maar vidaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Protector of the True Guru. The Lord saves all those whofollow in the footsteps of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satguroo kaa rakh anhaaraa har aap hai sat guroo kai pichh ai har sabh  ubaari-aa.

lines.english: One who thinks evil of the Perfect True Guru - the Creator Lord Himself destroys him.
lines.transliteration: jo mandaa chit vai pooray sat guroo kaa so aap upaavan haarai maari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: These words will be confirmed as true in the Court of the Lord; servant Nanak revealsthis mystery. ||2|| pauVI ] (312-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ayh gal hovai har dargeh sachay kee jan naanak agam veechaari-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨੋ ਅਪਿੜ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਵਿਲ  ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who dwell upon the True Lord while asleep, utter the True Name when they areawake.
lines.transliteration: sach suti-aa jinee araaDh i-aa jaa uth ay taa sach chavay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਖੜਗੁ  ਸੰਜੋਉ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਵਡਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: How rare in the world are those Gurmukhs who dwell upon the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say virlay jug meh jaanee-ahi jo gurmukh  sach ravay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਾ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਭ ਉਬਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the True Name, night and day.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin ka-o je an-d in sach lavay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮੰਦਾ ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਪੂਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਾ ਸੋ ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is pleasing to their minds and bodies; they go to the Court of the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: jin man tan sachaa bh aavdaa say sachee d argeh gavay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਗਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਗਮੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak chants the True Name; truly, the True Lord is forever brand new. ||21|| sloku mÚ 4 ] (312-19) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bolai sach naam sach sachaa sadaa navay. ||21||

lines.english: Who is asleep, and who is awake? Those who are Gurmukh are approved. pMnw 313
lines.transliteration: ki-aa savnaa ki-aa jaagn aa gurmukh  tay parvaan .

lines.english: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each and every breath and morsel of food, are the perfect and famous persons.
lines.transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visrai say pooray purakh parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ  ਪਰਧਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace they find the True Guru; night and day, they meditate.
lines.transliteration: karmee satgur paa-ee-ai an-d in lagai Dh i-aan.

lines.english: I join the society of those persons, and in so doing, I am honored in the Court of theLord.
lines.transliteration: tin kee sangat  mil rahaa d argeh paa-ee maan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹਾ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਈ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: While asleep, they chant, "Waaho! Waaho!", and while awake, they chant, "Waaho!"as well.
lines.transliteration: sa-uday vaahu vaahu uchrahi uth -day bh ee vaahu karayn.

lines.punjabi: ਸਉਦੇ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਉਚਰਿਹ  ਉਠਦੇ  ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, radiant are the faces of those, who rise up early each day, and dwell uponthe Lord. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (313-3) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay mukh  ujlay je nit  uth samaalayn. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਜ ਿਨਤ  ਉਿਠ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serving his True Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvee-ai aapn aa paa-ee-ai naam apaar.

lines.english: The drowning person is lifted up and out of the terrifying world-ocean; the Great Givergives the gift of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bha-ojal dubd i-aa kadh  la-ay har d aat karay d aataar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਆਪਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an say saah hai je naam karahi vaapaar. Blessed, blessed are those bankers who trade the Naam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉਜਿਲ  ਡੁਬਿਦਆ  ਕਿਢ ਲਏ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Sikhs, the traders come, and through the Word of His Shabad, they are carriedacross.
lines.transliteration: vanjaaray sikh  aavd ay sabad  laghaavan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਹੈ ਿਜ ਨਾਿਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, they alone serve the Creator Lord, who are blessed by His Grace.||2|| pauVI ] (313-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jin ka-o kirpaa bha-ee t in sayvi-aa sirjan haar. ||2||

lines.english: Those who truly worship and adore the True Lord, are truly the humble devotees ofthe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach sachay kay jan bhagat  heh sach sachaa jinee araaDh i-aa.

lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who search and seek, find the True One within themselves.
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh kh oj dhandholi-aa t in and rahu hee sach laaDh i-aa.

lines.english: Those who truly serve their True Lord and Master, overwhelm and conquer Death, the torturer.
lines.transliteration: sach saahib sach jinee sayvi-aa kaal kantak maar tinee saaDh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਿਜਨੀ  ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True One is truly the greatest of all; those who serve the True One are blendedwith the True One.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa sabh d oo vadaa hai sach sayvan say sach ralaaDh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੋਿਜ ਢੰਢੋਿਲਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed and acclaimed is the Truest of the True; serving the Truest of the True, oneblossoms forth in fruition. ||22|| slok mÚ 4 ] (313-9) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach sachay no saabaas hai sach sachaa sayv falaaDhi-aa. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਸਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is foolish; he wanders around without the Naam, the Nameof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manmukh paraan ee mugaDh  hai naamheen  bharmaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸੇ ਸਿਚ ਰਲਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, his mind is not held steady, and he is reincarnated, over and overagain.
lines.transliteration: bin gur manoo-aa naa tikai fir fir joonee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਿਵ ਫਲਾਿਧਆ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: But when the Lord God Himself becomes merciful to him, then the True Guru comesto meet him.
lines.transliteration: har parabh aap d a-i-aal hohi t aaN satgur mili-aa aa-ay.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam; the pains of birth and death shall come to an end.||1|| mÚ 4 ] (313-11) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too janam maran  dukh jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾਮਹੀਣ  ਭਰਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I praise my Guru in so many ways, with joyful love and affection.
lines.transliteration: gur saalaahee aapnaa baho biDh  rang subh aa-ay.

lines.english: My mind is imbued with the True Guru; He has preserved the make of its making.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayt ee man rat aa rakh i-aa ban at banaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਹੋਿਹ ਤ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: My tongue is not satisfied by praising Him; He has linked my consciousness with theLord, my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa saalaahi na raj-ee har pareetam chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my mind hungers for the Name of the Lord; my mind is satisfied, tasting thesublime essence of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (313-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai kee man bhukh  hai man t ariptai har ras kh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The True Lord is truly known for His all-powerful creative nature; He fashioned thedays and the nights.
lines.transliteration: sach sachaa kudrat  jaanee-ai d in raat ee jin ban aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਰੰਿਗ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I praise that True Lord, forever and ever; True is the glorious greatness of the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: so sach salaahee sadaa sad aa sach sachay kee-aa vad i-aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਿਖਆ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: True are the Praises of the Praiseworthy True Lord; the value of the True Lord cannotbe appraised.
lines.transliteration: saalaahee sach salaah sach sach keemat kinai na paa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਨ ਰਜਈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When someone meets the Perfect True Guru, then His Sublime Presence comes to be seen.
lines.transliteration: jaa mili-aa pooraa satguroo t aa haajar nad ree aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਮਿਨ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who praise the True Lord - all their hunger is gone. ||23|| slok mÚ 4 ] (313-16) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach gurmukh jinee sahaali-aa t inaa bh ukhaa sabh  gavaa-ee-aa. ||23||

lines.english: Searching and examining my mind and body, I have found that God, whom I longedfor.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan kh oj khojayd i-aa so parabh  laDhaa lorh .

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਜਾਣੀਐ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਬਣਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the Guru, the Divine Intermediary, who has united me with the LordGod. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (313-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: visat guroo mai paa-i-aa jin har parabh d itaa jorh . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀਆ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who is attached to Maya is totally blind and deaf.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aaDhaaree at  annaa bolaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ  ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: He does not listen to the Word of the Shabad; he makes a great uproar and tumult.
lines.transliteration: sabad na sun -ee baho rol gh acholaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਤਾ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs chant and meditate on the Shabad, and lovingly center theirconsciousness on it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaapai sabad  liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਲਾਿਹਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਭੁਖਾ ਸਿਭ ਗਵਾਈਆ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: They hear and believe in the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har naam sun mannay har naam samaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever pleases God, He causes that to be done.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so karay karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਿਜ ਖੋਜੇਿਦਆ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਧਾ  ਲੋਿੜ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, human beings are the instruments which vibrate as God plays them. ||2|| pMnw 314 pauVI ] (314-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vajdaa jant  vajaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: You, O Creator, know everything which occurs within our beings.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa sabh  kichh  jaand aa jo jee-aa and ar vart ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਜੋ ਜੀਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵਰਤੈ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself, O Creator, are incalculable, while the entire world is within the realm of calculation.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa aap agn at hai sabh  jag vich gant ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਗਣਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਵਿਚ ਗਣਤੈ  ॥
lines.english: Everything happens according to Your Will; You created all.
lines.transliteration: sabh keet aa tayraa varatd aa sabh  tayree bant ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤੈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the One, pervading in each and every heart; O True Lord and Master, this isYour play.
lines.transliteration: too gh at ghat ik varatd aa sach saahib chalt ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਚਲਤੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who meets the True Guru meets the Lord; no one can turn him away. ||24|| sloku mÚ 4 ] (314-3) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur no milay so har milay naahee kisai part ai. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨੋ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਸੈ ਪਰਤੈ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Hold this mind steady and stable; become Gurmukh and focus your consciousness.
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa darirh  kar rakh ee-ai gurmukh  laa-ee-ai chit .

lines.english: How could you ever forget Him, with each breath and morsel of food, sitting down orstanding up?
lines.transliteration: ki-o saas giraas visaaree-ai bahdi-aa uth -di-aa nit .

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਕਿਰ ਰਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਾਈਐ  ਿਚਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: My anxiety about birth and death has ended; this soul is under the control of the LordGod.
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan  kee chint aa ga-ee ih jee-arh aa har parabh  vas.

lines.english: If it pleases You, then save servant Nanak, and bless him with Your Name. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (314-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh  too jan naanak naam bakh as. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣ  ਜੀਵਣ  ਕੀ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਗਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਵਿਸ ॥
lines.english: The egotistical, self-willed manmukh does not know the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence; one moment he is here, and the next moment he is there.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ahaNkaaree mahal na jaan ai khin aagai kh in peechh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is always invited, but he does not go to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. Howshall he be accepted in the Court of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: sadaa bulaa-ee-ai mahal na aavai ki-o kar d argeh seejh ai.

lines.english: How rare are those who know the Mansion of the True Guru; they stand with their palms pressed together.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa mahal virlaa jaan ai sad aa rahai kar jorh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਖਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਿਖਨੁ ਪੀਛੈ ॥
lines.english: If my Lord grants His Grace, O Nanak, He restores them to Himself. ||2|| pauVI ] (314-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aapnee kirpaa karay har mayraa naanak la-ay bahorh . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੀਝੈ ॥
lines.english: Fruitful and rewarding is that service, which is pleasing to the Guru's Mind.
lines.transliteration: saa sayvaa keetee safal hai jit  satgur kaa man mannay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ॥
lines.english: When the Mind of the True Guru is pleased, then sins and misdeeds run away.
lines.transliteration: jaa satgur kaa man mani-aa t aa paap kasamal bh annay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਏ ਬਹੋਿੜ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Sikhs listen to the Teachings imparted by the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: updays je d itaa sat guroo so sun i-aa sikh ee kannay.

lines.english: Those who surrender to the True Guru's Will are imbued with the four-fold Love of theLord.
lines.transliteration: jin satgur kaa bh aanaa mani-aa t in charh ee chavgan  vannay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ  ਸਫਲ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
lines.english: This is the unique and distinct life-style of the Gurmukhs: listening to the Guru'sTeachings, their minds blossom forth. ||25|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (314-11) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih chaal niraalee gurmukhee gur d eekhi-aa sun  man bh innay. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਸੰਮਲ  ਭੰਨੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not affirm their Guru shall have no home or place of rest.
lines.transliteration: jin gur gopi-aa aapnaa t is tha-ur na th aa-o.

lines.english: They lose both this world and the next; they have no place in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  dovai ga-ay d argeh naahee thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਿਤਨ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਿਣ  ਵੰਨੇ ॥
lines.english: This opportunity to bow at the Feet of the True Guru shall never come again.
lines.transliteration: oh vaylaa hath na aavee fir satgur lageh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਚਾਲ  ਿਨਰਾਲੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ  ਗੁਰ ਦੀਿਖਆ  ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨੁ ਿਭੰਨੇ ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: If they miss out on being counted by the True Guru, they shall pass their lives in pain and misery.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee gant ai ghusee-ai d ukhay dukh vihaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himselfthose with whom He is pleased.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  nirvair hai aapay la-ay jis laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਿਪਆ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, are emancipated in theCourt of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (314-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak darsan jinaa vaykh aali-on t inaa d argeh la-ay chh adaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ  ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is ignorant, evil-minded and egotistical.
lines.transliteration: manmukh agi-aan d urmat  ahaNkaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਫਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਲਗਿਹ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: antar kroDh  joo-ai mat  haaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਗਣਤੈ  ਘੁਸੀਐ  ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਿਖ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He commits the sins of fraud and unrighteousness.
lines.transliteration: koorh kusat  oh paap kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਜਸੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: What can he hear, and what can he tell others?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa oh sunai ki-aa aakh  sunaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਜਨਾ  ਵੇਖਾਿਲਓਨ ੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is blind and deaf; he loses his way, and wanders lost in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: annaa bolaa khu-ay ujh arh paa-ay.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation;
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa aavai jaa-ay.
bin satgur bh aytay thaa-ay na paa-ay. without meeting the True Guru, he finds no place of rest.

lines.english: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||2|| pauVI ] (314-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhi-aa kamaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Those who have hearts as hard as stone, do not sit near the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin kay chit kath or heh say baheh na sat gur paas.

lines.english: Truth prevails there; the false ones do not attune their consciousness to it.
lines.transliteration: othai sach varatdaa koorh i-aaraa chit  udaas.

lines.english: By hook or by crook, they pass their time, and then they go back to sit with the false ones again.
lines.transliteration: o-ay val chhal kar jh at kadh -day fir jaa-ay baheh koorh i-aaraa paas.

lines.english: Falsehood does not mix with the Truth; O people, check it out and see.
lines.transliteration: vich sachay koorh na gad-ee man vaykh hu ko nirjaas.

lines.english: The false go and mingle with the false, while the truthful Sikhs sit by the side of theTrue Guru. ||26|| pMnw 315 slok mÚ 5 ] (315-1) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: koorhi-aar kh oorhi-aaree jaa-ay ralay sachiaar sikh  baith ay sat gur paas. ||26||

lines.english: By their own efforts, the slanderers have destroyed all remnants of themselves.
lines.transliteration: rahday kh uhday nind ak maari-an kar aapay aahar.

lines.english: The Support of the Saints, O Nanak, is manifest, pervading everywhere. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (315-2) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant sahaa-ee naankaa vart ai sabh  jaahar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਦੇ  ਖੁਹਦੇ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਮਾਿਰਅਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਹਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who went astray from the Primal Being in the very beginning - where can theyfind refuge?
lines.transliteration: mundhhu bh ulay mundh  tay kithai paa-in hath.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਜਾਹਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are struck down by the All-powerful, the Cause of causes. ||2|| pauVI 5 ] (315-3) pa-orhee 5. Pauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tinnai maaray naankaa je karan  kaaran  samrath. ||2||

lines.english: They take the noose in their hands, and go out at night to strangle others, but God knows everything, O mortal.
lines.transliteration: lai faahay raatee t ureh parabh  jaanai paraan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਮੁੰਢ ਤੇ ਿਕਥੈ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਹਥੁ ॥
lines.english: They spy on other men's women, concealed in their hiding places.
lines.transliteration: takeh naar paraa-ee-aa luk and ar thaanee.

lines.english: They break into well-protected places, and revel in sweet wine.
lines.transliteration: sanHee dayniH vikhamm thaa-ay mith aa mad  maan ee.

lines.english: But they shall come to regret their actions - they create their own karma.
lines.transliteration: karmee aapo aapnee aapay pachh utaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਰਾਤੀ  ਤੁਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall crush them like sesame seeds in the oil-press.||27|| slok mÚ 5 ] (315-5) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ajraa-eel faraystaa t il peerh ay gh aanee. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਤਕਿਹ  ਨਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਈਆ  ਲੁਿਕ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਠਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The servants of the True King are acceptable and approved.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sachay saah kay say-ee parvaan.

lines.english: Those ignorant ones who serve duality, O Nanak, rot, waste away and die. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (315-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: doojaa sayvan naankaa say pach pach mu-ay ajaan . ||1||

lines.english: That destiny which was pre-ordained by God from the very beginning cannot beerased.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa laykh  parabh  maytn aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is Nanak's capital; he meditates on it forever. ||2|| pauVI 5 ] (315-7) pa-orhee 5. Pauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan vakh ro naanak sad aa Dh i-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One who has received a kick from the Lord God - where can he place his foot?
lines.transliteration: naaraa-in la-i-aa naath ooNgarhaa pair kithai rakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੇ ਸੇਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He commits countless sins, and continually eats poison.
lines.transliteration: kardaa paap amit i-aa nit  viso chakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸੇ ਪਿਚ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slandering others, he wastes away and dies; within his body, he burns.
lines.transliteration: nindaa kard aa pach mu-aa vich d ayhee bh akhai.

lines.english: One who has been struck down by the True Lord and Master - who can save himnow?
lines.transliteration: sachai saahib maari-aa ka-un t is no rakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਲੇਖੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਟਣਾ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Unseen Lord, the Primal Being. ||28|| slok mÚ 5 ] (315-9) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis sarn aagat ee jo purakh  alkhai. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the most horrible hell, there is terrible pain and suffering. It is the place of theungrateful.
lines.transliteration: narak ghor baho d ukh ghanay akirat -ghanaa kaa thaan.

lines.english: They are struck down by God, O Nanak, and they die a most miserable death. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (315-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin parabh  maaray naankaa ho-ay ho-ay mu-ay haraam. ||1||

lines.english: All kinds of medicines may be prepared, but there is no cure for the slanderer.
lines.transliteration: avkhaDh  sabh ay keet i-an nind ak kaa d aaroo naahi.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads, O Nanak, putrefy and rot in reincarnation.||2|| pauVI 5 ] (315-11) pa-orhee 5. Pauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa-ay naankaa pach pach jonee paahi. ||2||

lines.english: By His Pleasure, the True Guru has blessed me with the inexhaustible wealth of theName of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: tus ditaa poorai sat guroo har Dh an sach akh ut.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ॥
lines.english: All my anxiety is ended; I am rid of the fear of death.
lines.transliteration: sabh and aysay mit ga-ay jam kaa bh a-o chh ut.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and other evils have been subdued in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh buri-aa-ee-aaN sang saaDh oo tut.

lines.english: Those who serve another, instead of the True Lord, die unfulfilled in the end.
lines.transliteration: vin sachay d oojaa sayvd ay hu-ay marsan but.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ  ਘੋਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਅਿਕਰਤਘਣਾ  ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with forgiveness; he is united with the Naam, the Nameof the Lord. ||29|| slok mÚ 4 ] (315-14) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur bakhsi-aa naamai sang jut. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਾਮੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is not a penitent, who is greedy within his heart, and who constantly chases afterMaya like a leper.
lines.transliteration: tapaa na hovai and arahu lobh ee nit  maa-i-aa no firai jajmaali-aa.

lines.english: When this penitent was first invited, he re fused our charity; but later he repented and sent his son, who was seated in the congregation.
lines.transliteration: gauVI, mÚ 4) ago day sad i-aa sat ai dee bh ikhi-aa la-ay naahee pichh o day pachh utaa-ay kai aan tapai put  vich bahaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਖਧ  ਸਭੇ ਕੀਿਤਅਨੁ ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਕਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The village elders all laughed, saying that the waves of greed have destroyed thispenitent.
lines.transliteration: panch log sabh hasan  lagay t apaa lobh  lahar hai gaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਪਿਚ ਪਿਚ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dharam haari-aa. If he sees only a little wealth, he does not bother to go there; but when he sees a lot of wealth, the penitent forsakes his vows.
lines.transliteration: jithai thorhaa Dh an vaykh ai tithai t apaa bh itai naahee Dh an bahut ai dith ai tapai

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, he is not a penitent  - he is only a stork. Sitting together, the Holy Congregation has so decided.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ayhu t apaa na hovee bagulaa hai bahi saaDh  janaa veechaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਿਸ ਿਦਤਾ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ॥
lines.english: The penitent slanders the True Primal Being, and sings the praises of the material world. For this sin, he is cursed by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) sat purakh  kee t apaa nind aa karai sansaarai kee ust atee vich hovai ayt  dokhai tapaa da-yi maari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਏ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੁਟੁ ॥
lines.english: Behold the fruit the penitent gathers, for slandering the Great Primal Being; all hislabors have gone in vain.
lines.transliteration: mahaa purkhaaN kee nind aa kaa vaykh  je tapay no fal lagaa sabh  ga-i-aa t apay kaa ghaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਬੁਿਰਆਈਆਂ  ਸੰਿਗ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੁਟੁ ॥
lines.english: When he sits outside among the elders, he is called a penitent;
lines.transliteration: baahar bahai panchaa vich tapaa sad aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦੂਜਾ  ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਹੁਇ ਮਰਸਿਨ  ਬੁਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: andar bahai t apaa paap kamaa-ay. but when he sits within the congregation, the penitent commits sin. pMnw 316

lines.english: The Lord has exposed the penitent's secret sin to the elders. Drm rwie jmkMkrw no AwiK CifAw eysu qpy no iqQY KiV pwiehu ijQY mhw mhW hiqAwirAw ] (316- 1, gauVI, mÚ 4) Dharam raa-ay jamkankraa no aakh  chhadi-aa ays t apay no t ithai kh arh paa-ihu jithai mahaa mahaaN hati-aari-aa. The Righteous Judge of Dharma said to the Messenger of Death, "Take this penitent and put him with the worst of the worst murderers."
lines.transliteration: har andarlaa paap panchaa no ugh aa kar vaykh aali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ  ਪਾਪੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਨੋ ਉਘਾ  ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one is to look at the face of this penitent again. He has been cursed by the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: fir ays tapay d ai muhi ko-ee lagahu naahee ayhu sat gur hai fitkaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਜਮਕੰਕਰਾ  ਨੋ ਆਿਖ ਛਿਡਆ  ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਿਤਥੈ ਖਿੜ ਪਾਇਹੁ ਿਜਥੈ ਮਹਾ ਮਹ ਹਿਤਆਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks and reveals what has taken place in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kai dar vart i-aa so naanak aakh  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ  ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਦੈ ਮੁਿਹ ਕੋਈ ਲਗਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਏਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਹੈ ਿਫਟਕਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He alone understands, who is blessed and adorned by the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (316-4) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so boojhai jo d a-yi savaari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਵਰਿਤਆ  ਸੁ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The devotees of the Lord worship and adore the Lord, and the glorious greatness ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aaN har aaraaDh i-aa har kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord's devotees continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises; the Name of the Lord isthe Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: har keertan bh agat nit gaaNvday har naam sukh -daa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord ever bestows upon His devotees the glorious greatness of His Name, whichincreases day by day.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aaN no nit  naavai d ee vadi-aa-ee bakh see-an nit  charh ai savaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord inspires His devotees to sit, steady and stable, in the home of their inner being. He preserves their honor.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aaN no thir gh aree bahaali-an apn ee paij rakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਭਗਤ  ਿਨਤ ਗਵਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord summons the slanderers to answer for their accounts, and He punishes themseverely.
lines.transliteration: nindkaaN paashu har laykh aa mangsee baho d ay-ay sajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ  ਨੋ ਿਨਤ  ਨਾਵੈ ਦੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਿਨਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: As the slanderers think of acting, so are the fruits they obtain.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa nindak apn ai jee-ay kamaavd ay tayho fal paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ  ਨੋ ਿਥਰੁ ਘਰੀ  ਬਹਾਿਲਅਨ ੁ ਅਪਣੀ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Actions done in secrecy are sure to come to light, even if one does it underground.
lines.transliteration: andar kamaan aa sarpar ugh -rhai bhaavai ko-ee bahi Dh artee vich kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in joy, beholding the glorious greatness of the Lord.||2|| pauVI mÚ 5 ] (316-8) pa-orhee mehlaa 5. Pauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak daykh  vigsi-aa har kee vadi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਅਪਣੈ  ਜੀਇ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਤੇਹੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Protector of His devotees; what can the sinner do to them?
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaaN kaa raakh aa har aap hai ki-aa paapee karee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕਮਾਣਾ  ਸਰਪਰ  ਉਘੜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਬਿਹ ਧਰਤੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The proud fool acts in pride, and eating his own poison, he dies.
lines.transliteration: gumaan karahi moorh gumaanee-aa vis kh aaDhee maree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: His few days have come to an end, and he is cut down like the crop at harvest.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay lagay nee dih thorh -rhay ji-o pakaa kh ayt lunee-ai.

lines.english: According to one's actions, so is one spoken of.
lines.transliteration: jayhay karam kamaavday t ayvayho bh anee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਿਕਆ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਕਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Glorious and great is the Lord and Master of servant Nanak; He is the Master of all. ||30|| slok mÚ 4 ] (316-11) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kaa khasam vadaa hai sabh naa d aa Dh anee-ai. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਮੂੜ ਗੁਮਾਨੀਆ  ਿਵਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all; they are caught ingreed and egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh moolhu bh uli-aa vich lab lobh  ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਲਗੇ ਨੀ ਿਦਹ ਥੋੜੜੇ  ਿਜਉ ਪਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੁਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: They pass their nights and days in conflict and struggle; they do not contemplate theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jhagrh aa kard i-aa an-d in gud rai sabad  na karahi veechaar.

lines.english: The Creator has taken away all their understanding and purity; all their speech is eviland corrupt.
lines.transliteration: suDh mat  kartai sabh  hir la-ee bolan sabh  vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ  ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ  ਦਾ ਧਣੀਐ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within their hearts there isgreat desire, ignorance and darkness.
lines.transliteration: ditai kitai na sant okhee-ah ant ar tisnaa baho agi-aan anDh -yaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, it is good to break away from the self-willed manmukhs, who have love andattachment to Maya. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (316-14) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukhaa naalo t utee bh alee jin maa-i-aa moh pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਿਲਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of duality, do not love the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: jinaa andar d oojaa bh aa-o hai t inHaa gurmukh  pareet  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਝਗੜਾ  ਕਰਿਦਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰਿਹ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They come and go, and wander in reincarnation; even in their dreams, they find nopeace.
lines.transliteration: ohu aavai jaa-ay bhavaa-ee-ai supnai sukh  na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਧ ਮਿਤ ਕਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਿਹਿਰ  ਲਈ ਬੋਲਿਨ  ਸਭੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They practice falsehood and they speak falsehood; attached to falsehood, they become false.
lines.transliteration: koorh kamaavai koorh  uchrai koorh  lagi-aa koorh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਤੈ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਿਹ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਬਹੁ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The love of Maya is total pain; in pain they perish, and in pain they cry out.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh d ukh hai d ukh binsai d ukh ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲੋ  ਤੁਟੀ ਭਲੀ ਿਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there can be no union between the love of worldliness and the love of theLord, no matter how much everyone may desire it.
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhaat  livai jorh  na aavee jay lochai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: Those who have the treasure of virtuous deeds find peace through the Word of theGuru's Shabad. ||2|| pauVI mÚ 5 ] (316-17) pa-orhee mehlaa 5. Pauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o potai punn pa-i-aa t inaa gur sabd ee sukh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਿਤਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Saints and the silent sages think, and the four Vedas proclaim,
lines.transliteration: naanak vichaareh sant mun janaaN chaar vayd  kahand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਭਵਾਈਐ  ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat  mukh ai tay bold ay say vachan hovand ay. that whatever the Lord's devotees speak comes to pass.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਕੂੜੁ ਉਚਰੈ  ਕੂਿੜ ਲਿਗਆ  ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He is revealed in His cosmic workshop; all people hear of it.
lines.transliteration: pargat pahaarai jaapday sabh  lok sun anday.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਿਖ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The foolish people, who fight with the Saints, find no peace.
lines.transliteration: sukh na paa-in mugaDh  nar sant  naal kh ahand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਾਤੁ ਿਲਵੈ ਜੋੜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they are burning with egotism.
lines.transliteration: o-ay lochan onaa gunaa no o-ay ahaNkaar sarh anday.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਇਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: What can those wretched ones do? Their evil destiny was pre-ordained. pMnw 317
lines.transliteration: o-ay vaychaaray ki-aa karahi jaaN bhaag Dh ur mand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਚਾਰੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਿਰ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God do not belong to anyone.
lines.transliteration: jo maaray tin paarbarahm say kisai na sand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਸੇ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who hate the One who has no hatred, are destroyed by righteous justice.
lines.transliteration: vair karan nirvair naal Dharam ni-aa-ay pachand ay.

lines.english: Those who are cursed by the Saints wander around lost.
lines.transliteration: jo jo sant saraapi-aa say fireh bh avand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਿਤ ਸਰਾਿਪਆ  ਸੇ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਭਵੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||31|| slok mÚ 5 ] (317-3) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: payd mundhaahoo kati-aa t is daal sukand ay. ||31||

lines.english: Guru Nanak implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; He is All-powerful,to create and destroy.
lines.transliteration: gur naanak har naam drirh-aa-i-aa bh annan  gharhan samrath.

lines.english: Remember God forever, my friend, and all your suffering will disappear. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (317-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh sad aa samaaleh mit ar too dukh sabaa-i-aa lath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਭੰਨਣ  ਘੜਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: The hungry person does not care about honor, dishonor or harsh words.
lines.transliteration: khuDh i-aavant  na jaan -ee laaj kulaaj kubol.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿਹ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਤੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ਲਥੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for the Name of the Lord; please grant Your Grace, and unite me withYourself. ||2|| pauVI ] (317-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak maaNgai naam har kar kirpaa sanjog. ||2||

lines.english: According to the deeds which one does, so are the fruits one obtains.
lines.transliteration: javayhay karam kamaavdaa t avayhay falt ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਿਧਆਵੰਤੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਲਾਜ  ਕੁਲਾਜ  ਕੁਬੋਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: If someone chews on red-hot iron, his throat will be burned.
lines.transliteration: chabay tat aa loh saar vich sangh ai palt ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਗੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The halter is put around his neck and he is led away, because of the evil deeds he has done.
lines.transliteration: ghat galaavaaN chaali-aa t in doot amal t ay.

lines.english: None of his desires are fulfilled; he continually steals the filth of others.
lines.transliteration: kaa-ee aas na punnee-aa nit par mal hirt ay.

lines.english: The ungrateful wretch does not appreciate what he has been given; he wanders lostin reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: kee-aa na jaanai aakirat -ghan vich jonee firt ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਬੇ ਤਤਾ  ਲੋਹ ਸਾਰੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਘੈ ਪਲਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: He loses all support, when the Support of the Lord is taken away from him.
lines.transliteration: sabhay Dh iraaN nikhutee-as hir la-ee-as Dh ar tay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਤ  ਗਲਾਵ  ਚਾਿਲਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਦੂਿਤ  ਅਮਲ  ਤੇ ॥
lines.english: He does not let the embers of strife die down, and so the Creator destroys him.
lines.transliteration: vijhan  kalah na d ayvdaa taaN la-i-aa kart ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਈ  ਆਸ  ਨ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ  ਿਨਤ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਿਹਰਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who indulge in egotism crumble and fall to the ground. ||32|| slok mÚ 3 ] (317-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo jo kartay ahamay-o jh arh Dhartee parh -tay. ||32||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is blessed with spiritual wisdom and a discerning intellect.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan bibayk buDh  ho-ay.

lines.english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and weaves this garland into his heart.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai hird ai haar paro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਝਣ  ਕਲਹ  ਨ ਦੇਵਦਾ  ਤ ਲਇਆ  ਕਰਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: He becomes the purest of the pure, a being of supreme understanding.
lines.transliteration: pavit paavan param beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਤੇ  ਅਹੰਮੇਉ  ਝਿੜ ਧਰਤੀ  ਪੜਤੇ  ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: Whoever he meets, he saves and carries across.
lines.transliteration: je os milai tis paar ut aaree.

lines.english: The fragrance of the Lord's Name permeates his being deep within.
lines.transliteration: antar har naam baasnaa samaan ee.

lines.english: He is honored in the Court of the Lord, and his speech is the most sublime.
lines.transliteration: har dar sobh aa mahaa ut am ban ee.

lines.english: Those who hear him are delighted.
lines.transliteration: je purakh sun ai so ho-ay nihaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one obtains the wealth and property of the Naam. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (317-12) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai paa-i-aa naam Dh an maal. ||1||

lines.english: The sublime state of the True Guru is not known; no one knows what pleases thePerfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kay jee-a kee saar na jaapai ke poorai sat gur bh aavai.

lines.english: Deep within the hearts of His GurSikhs, the True Guru is pervading. The Guru ispleased with those who long for His Sikhs.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaaN andar sat guroo vart ai jo sikh aaN no lochai so gur kh usee aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਾ ਉਤਮ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: 4) satgur aakh ai so kaar kamaavan so jap kamaaveh gursikh aaN kee gh aal sachaa thaa- ay paavai. As the True Guru directs them, they do their work and chant their prayers. The TrueLord accepts the service of His GurSikhs. ivxu siqgur ky hukmY ij gurisKW pwshu kMmu krwieAw loVy iqsu gurisKu iPir nyiV n AwvY ] (317- 14, gauVI, mÚ 4) vin sat gur kay hukmai je gursikh aaN paashu kamm karaa-i-aa lorh ay tis gursikh  fir nayrh na aavai. But those who want the GurSikhs to work for them, without the Order of the True Guru - the Guru's Sikhs shall not come near them again.
One who works diligently for the Guru, the True Guru - the GurSikhs work for him.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur agai ko jee-o laa-ay gh aalai t is agai gursikh  kaar kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who comes to deceive, who rises up and goes out to deceive - the GurSikhs shallnever come near him.
lines.transliteration: je thagee aavai th agee uth  jaa-ay t is nayrh ai gursikh  mool na aavai.

lines.english: Nanak proclaims and announces this wisdom of God.
lines.transliteration: barahm beechaar naanak aakh sun aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਿਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: One who is not pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru may do his deeds, but that being will only suffer in terrible pain. ||2|| pauVI ] (317-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: je vin sat gur kay man mannay kamm karaa-ay so jant  mahaa d ukh paavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਜੋ ਿਸਖ  ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O True Lord and Master, You are so very great. As great as You are, You are thegreatest of the great.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa saahib at  vadaa t uhi jayvad t ooN vad vaday.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ  ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਿਨ  ਸੁ ਜਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone is united with You, whom You un ite with Yourself. You Yourself bless and forgive us, and tear up our accounts.
lines.transliteration: jis tooN mayleh so t uDh milai t ooN aapay bakh as laihi laykh aa chh aday.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਿਜ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਪਾਸਹੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ਲੋੜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਿਫਿਰ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One whom You unite with Yourself, whole-heartedly serves the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis no tooN aap milaa-id aa so sat gur sayvay man gad gaday.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਗੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ  ਲਾਇ  ਘਾਲੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the True One, the True Lord and Master; my soul, body, flesh and bones areall Yours.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa saahib sach t oo sabh  jee-o pind chamm t ayraa haday.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਠਗੀ  ਆਵੈ ਠਗੀ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: If it pleases You, then save me, True Lord. Nanak places the hopes of his mind in You alone, O greatest of the great! ||33||1|| Sudh|| pMnw 318 gauVI kI vwr mhlw 5 rwie kmwldI mojdI kI vwr kI Duin aupir gwvxI (318-2) ga-orhee kee vaar mehlaa 5 raa-ay kamaald ee mojd ee kee vaar kee Dh un upar gaavnee Gauree Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl: Sung To The Tune Of Vaar Of Raa-I Kamaaldee- Mojadee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (318-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mÚ 5 ] (318-3) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh  tooN sachi-aa naanak man aas t ayree vad vaday. ||33||1|| suDh .

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਿਚਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਆਸ  ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ॥੩੩॥੧॥
lines.english: Auspicious and approved is the birth of that humble being who chants the Name ofthe Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jo jan japai so aa-i-aa parvaan.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that humble being who vibrates and meditates on God, the Lord of Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: tis jan kai balihaarn ai jin bh aji-aa parabh  nirbaan .

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਰਾਇ  ਕਮਾਲਦੀ  ਮੋਜਦੀ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਿਰ  ਗਾਵਣੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, upon meeting the All-knowing Lord, thePrimal Being.
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh  kati-aa har bh ayti-aa purakh  sujaan .

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, he crosses over the world-ocean; O servant Nanak, hehas the strength and support of the True Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (318-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant sang saagar t aray jan naanak sachaa t aan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I rise up in the early morning hours, and the Holy Guest comes into my home.
lines.transliteration: bhalkay uth  paraahun aa mayrai gh ar aava-o.

lines.english: I wash His feet; He is always pleasing to my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: paa-o pakhaalaa t is kay man t an nit  bhaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I hear the Naam, and I gather in the Naam; I am lovingly attuned to the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam sunay naam sangrahai naamay liv laava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My home and wealth are totally sanctified as I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: garihu Dhan sabh  pavit ar ho-ay har kay gun  gaava-o.

lines.english: The Trader in the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is found by great good fortune. ||2|| pauVI ] (318-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har naam vaapaaree naankaa vadbhaagee paava-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਲਕੇ  ਉਿਠ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases You is good; True is the Pleasure of Your Will.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so bh alaa sach t ayraa bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਉ ਪਖਾਲਾ  ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਿਨਤ  ਭਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are the One, pervading in all; You are contained in all.
lines.transliteration: too sabh  meh ayk varatd aa sabh  maahi samaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are diffused throughout and permeating all places and interspaces; You are known to be deep within the hearts of all beings.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahi-aa jee-a and ar jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and submitting to His Will, theTrue Lord is found.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil paa-ee-ai man sachay bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਵਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak takes to the Sanctuary of God; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||1|| slok mÚ 5 ] (318-10) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee sad  sad kurbaan aa. ||1||

lines.english: If you are conscious, then be conscious of the True Lord, Your Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: chaytaa ee t aaN chayt  saahib sachaa so Dh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, come aboard upon the boat of the service of the True Guru, and cross overthe terrifying world-ocean. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (318-11) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur sayv charh  bohith bh a-ojal paar pa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਸਭ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He wears his body, like clothes of wind - what a proud fool he is!
lines.transliteration: vaa-oo sanday kaprh ay pahirahi garab gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜੀਅ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they will not go with him in the end; they shall be burnt to ashes. ||2|| pauVI ] (318-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naal na chalnee jal bal ho-ay chhaar. ||2||

lines.english: They alone are delivered from the world, who are preserved and protected by theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: say-ee ubray jagai vich jo sachai rakhay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I live by beholding the faces of those who taste the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: muhi dithai t in kai jeevee-ai har amrit  chakh ay.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are burnt away, in theCompany of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh sang saaDh aa bh akhay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਤਾ  ਈ ਤ ਚੇਿਤ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.english: God grants His Grace, and the Lord Himself tests them.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aapn ee har aap parkh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਚਿੜ ਬੋਿਹਿਥ  ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, His play is not known; no one can understand it. ||2|| slok mÚ 5 ] (318-14) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak chalat na jaapnee ko sakai na lakh ay. ||2||

lines.english: O Nanak, that day is beautiful, when God comes to mind.
lines.transliteration: naanak so-ee dinas suhaavrh aa jit parabh  aavai chit .

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਊ ਸੰਦੇ ਕਪੜੇ  ਪਿਹਰਿਹ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਗਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Cursed is that day, no matter how pleasant the season, when the Supreme Lord Godis forgotten. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (318-15) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jit din visrai paarbarahm fit bh alayree rut . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਲਨੀ  ਜਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, become friends with the One, who holds everything in His hands.
lines.transliteration: naanak mitraa-ee t is si-o sabh  kichh  jis kai haath.

lines.english: They are accounted as false friends, who do not go with you, for even one step. ||2|| pauVI ] (318-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kumitraa say-ee kaaNdhee-ah ik vikh  na chaleh saath. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ  ਜਗੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਰਖੇ ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; meet togetherand drink it in, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam niDh aan hai mil peevhu bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਹ ਿਡਠੈ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਚਖੇ ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, peace is found, and all thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat sukh  paa-ee-ai sabh  tikhaa bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧਾ  ਭਖੇ ॥
lines.english: So serve the Supreme Lord God and the Guru, and you shall never be hungry again.
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa paarbarahm gur bhukh  rahai na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਪਰਖੇ  ॥
lines.english: All your desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain the status of immortality.
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath punni-aa amraa pad paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ  ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਲਖੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You alone are as great as Yourself, O Supreme Lord God; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3|| slok mÚ 5 ] (318-19) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad t oohai paarbarahm naanak sarn aa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: I have seen all places; there is no place without Him.
lines.transliteration: dith-rh o habh  thaa-ay oon  na kaa-ee jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru find the object of life. ||1|| pMnw 319 mÚ 5 ] (319-1) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laDhaa t in su-aa-o jinaa sat gur bh ayti-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Like the flash of lightning, worldly affairs last only for a moment.
lines.transliteration: daamnee chamat kaar t i-o vart aaraa jag kh ay.

lines.english: The only thing which is pleasing, O Nanak, is that which inspires one to meditate onthe Name of the Master. ||2|| pauVI ] (319-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: vath suhaavee saa-ay naanak naa-o japando t is Dhanee. ||2||

lines.english: People have searched all the Simritees and Shaastras, but no one knows the Lord's value.
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar soDh  sabh  kinai keem na jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਥੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਉ  ਜਪੰਦੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: That being, who joins the Saadh Sangat enjoys the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhaytai saaDh sang so har rang maan ee.

lines.english: True is the Naam, the Name of the Creator, the Primal Being. It is the mine ofprecious jewels.
lines.transliteration: sach naam kartaa purakh  ayh rat naa kh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਸੋਿਧ ਸਿਭ ਿਕਨੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: That mortal, who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead,meditates in remembrance on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mastak hovai likh i-aa har simar paraan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please bless Nanak, Your humble guest, with the supplies of the True Name.||4|| slok mÚ 5 ] (319-4) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tosaa d ichai sach naam naanak mihmaan ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਏਹ ਰਤਨਾ  ਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: He harbors anxiety within himself, but to the eyes, he appears to be happy; hishunger never departs.
lines.transliteration: antar chint aa nain ee sukh ee mool na ut rai bh ukh.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's sorrows have ever departed. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (319-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam bin kisai na latho dukh . ||1||

lines.english: Those caravans which did not load the Truth have been plundered.
lines.transliteration: muth-rh ay say-ee saath jinee sach na lad i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, and acknowledge the One Lord, arecongratulated. ||2|| pauVI ] (319-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak say saabaas jinee gur mil ik pachhaan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਨੈਣੀ  ਸੁਖੀ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.english: Beautiful is that place, where the Holy people dwell.
lines.transliteration: jithai baisan saaDh jan so thaan suhand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੋ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They serve their All-powerful Lord, and they give up all their evil ways.
lines.transliteration: o-ay sayvan sammrith aapnaa binsai sabh  mand aa.

lines.english: The Saints and the Vedas proclaim, that the Supreme Lord God is the Saving Grace ofsinners.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran  paarbarahm sant  bayd  kahand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਠੜੇ  ਸੇਈ ਸਾਥ ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਲਿਦਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Lover of Your devotees - this is Your natural way, in each and every age.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al tayraa birad  hai jug jug vart andaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak asks for the One Name, which is pleasing to his mind and body. ||5|| slok mÚ 5 ] (319-9) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai ayk naam man tan bh aavand aa. ||5||

lines.english: The sparrows are chirping, and dawn has come; the wind stirs up the waves.
lines.transliteration: chirhee chuhkee pahu futee vagan bahut  tarang.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਬੈਸਿਨ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Such a wondrous thing the Saints have fashioned, O Nanak, in the Love of the Naam.||1|| mÚ 5 ] (319-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: achraj roop santan rachay naanak naameh rang. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਥੁ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਸਭੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.english: Homes, palaces and pleasures are there, where You, O Lord, come to mind.
lines.transliteration: ghar mand ar khusee-aa t ahee jah t oo aavahi chit .

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਕਹੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: All worldly grandeur, O Nanak, is like false and evil friends. ||2|| pauVI ] (319-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kee-aa vad i-aa-ee-aa naanak sabh  kumit . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਵਰਤੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord is the true capital; how rare are those who understand this.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan sachee raas hai kinai virlai jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਾਚੈ  ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਭਾਵੰਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He alone receives it, O Siblings of Destiny, unto whom the Architect of Destiny givesit.
lines.transliteration: tisai paraapat  bhaa-irahu jis d ay-ay biDh aataa.

lines.english: His servant is imbued with the Love of the Lord; his body and mind blossom forth.
lines.transliteration: man tan bh eetar ma-oli-aa har rang jan raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੜੀ  ਚੁਹਕੀ  ਪਹੁ ਫੁਟੀ ਵਗਿਨ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਰੰਗ  ॥
