lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and all of his sufferings are removed.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang gun  gaa-i-aa sabh  dokhah kh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਚਰਜ  ਰੂਪ ਸੰਤਨ  ਰਚੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮਿਹ  ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone lives, who acknowledges the One Lord. ||6|| slok mÚ 5 ] (319-13) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so-ee jeevi-aa jin ik pachhaat aa. ||6||

lines.english: The fruit of the swallow-wort plant looks beautiful, attached to the branch of the tree;
lines.transliteration: khakh -rhee-aa suhaavee-aa lagrh ee-aa ak kanth .

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਤਹੀ ਜਹ ਤੂ ਆਵਿਹ  ਿਚਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: birah vichhorh aa Dh anee si-o naanak sahsai ganth . ||1|| but when it is separated from the stem of its Master, O Nanak, it breaks apart intothousands of fragments. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (319-14) mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਕੀਆ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਭ ਕੁਿਮਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die a complete death.
lines.transliteration: visaarayday mar ga-ay mar bh e na sakahi mool.

lines.english: Those who turn their backs on the Lord suffer, like the thief impaled on the gallows.||2|| pauVI ] (319-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: vaimukh ho-ay raam t ay ji-o t askar upar sool. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਿਕਨੈ ਿਵਰਲੈ  ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The One God is the treasure of peace; I have heard that He is eternal and imperishable.
lines.transliteration: sukh niDh aan parabh  ayk hai abh inaasee sun i-aa.

lines.english: He is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Lord is said to bepermeating each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poori-aa ghat gh at har bh ani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਮਉਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He looks alike upon the high and the low, the ant and the elephant.
lines.transliteration: ooch neech sabh ik samaan keet hast ee ban i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ਸਿਭ ਦੋਖਹ  ਖਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Friends, companions, children and relatives are all created by Him.
lines.transliteration: meet sakh aa sut  banDh ipo sabh  tis day jan i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Naam, enjoys the Lord's love and affection.||7|| slok mÚ 5 ] (319-18) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tus naanak d ayvai jis naam t in har rang man i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each breath and morsel of food, whose mindsare filled with the Mantra of the Lord's Name
lines.transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visrai har naamaaN man mant.

lines.english: Dhan se say-ee naankaa pooran so-ee sant . ||1|| - they alone are blessed; O Nanak, they are the perfect Saints. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (319-19) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
Twenty-four hours a day, he wanders around, driven by his hunger for food.
lines.transliteration: athay pahar bh a-udaa firai kh aavan  sand -rhai sool.

lines.english: How can he escape from falling into hell, when he does not remember the Prophet? ||2|| pMnw 320 pauVI ] (320-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: dojak pa-ud aa ki-o rahai jaa chit  na ho-ay rasool. ||2||

lines.english: Serve Him, O mortals, who has the Lord's Name in His lap.
lines.transliteration: tisai sarayvhu paraan eeho jis d ai naa-o palai.

lines.english: You shall dwell in peace and ease in this world; in the world hereafter, it shall go withyou.
lines.transliteration: aithai rahhu suhayli-aa agai naal chalai.

lines.english: So build your home of true righteousness, with the unshakable pillars of Dharma.
lines.transliteration: ghar banDh hu sach Dh aram kaa gad thamm ahlai.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਰਹਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਿਲਆ  ਅਗੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Take the Support of the Lord, who gives support in the spiritual and material worlds.
lines.transliteration: ot laihu naaraa-inai d een d unee-aa jh alai.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੁ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਸਚ ਧਰਮ  ਕਾ ਗਿਡ  ਥੰਮੁ ਅਹਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak grasps the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he humbly bows in His Court. ||8|| slok mÚ 5 ] (320-3) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pakrhay charan  har t is dargeh malai. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਓਟ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ  ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਝਲੈ ॥
lines.english: The beggar begs for charity: give to me, O my Beloved!
lines.transliteration: jaachak mangai daan d eh pi-aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਕੜੇ  ਚਰਣ  ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਲੈ ॥੮॥
lines.english: O Great Giver, O Giving Lord, my consciousness is continually centered on You.
lines.transliteration: dayvan haar d aataar mai nit  chitaari-aa.

lines.english: The immeasurable warehouses of the Lord can never be emptied out.
lines.transliteration: nikhut na jaa-ee mool at ul bhandaari-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Word of the Shabad is infinite; it has arranged everything perfectly.||1|| mÚ 5 ] (320-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad apaar t in sabh  kichh  saari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O Sikhs, love the Word of the Shabad; in life and death, it is our only support.
lines.transliteration: sikhahu sabad  pi-aariho janam maran kee tayk.

lines.english: Your face shall be radiant, and you shall find a lasting peace, O Nanak, rememberingthe One Lord in meditation. ||2|| pauVI ] (320-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal sad aa sukh ee naanak simrat  ayk. ||2||

lines.english: There, the Ambrosial Nectar is distributed; the Lord is the Bringer of peace.
lines.transliteration: othai amrit vandee-ai sukh ee-aa har karn ay.

lines.english: They are not placed upon the path of Death, and they shall not have to die again.
lines.transliteration: jam kai panth na paa-ee-ah fir naahee marnay.

lines.english: One who comes to savor the Lord's Love experiences it.
lines.transliteration: jis no aa-i-aa paraym ras tisai hee jarn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਏਕ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Holy beings chant the Bani of the Word, like nectar flowing from a spring.
lines.transliteration: banee uchrahi saaDh  jan ami-o chaleh jh arnay.

lines.english: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those who have implanted the Lord's Name within their minds. ||9|| slok mÚ 5 ] (320-8) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paykh d arsan naanak jeevi-aa man and ar Dh arnay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਵੰਡੀਐ  ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕਰਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Perfect True Guru, suffering ends.
lines.transliteration: satgur poorai sayvi-ai d ookhaa kaa ho-ay naas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਿਥ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਰਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam in adoration, one's affairs come to be resolved. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (320-9) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araaDhi-ai kaaraj aavai raas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਰਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, misfortune departs, and one comes to abide in peace and bliss.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat sankat chh uteh anad  mangal bisraam.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਉਚਰਿਹ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਅਿਮਉ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਝਰਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord - do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||2|| pauVI ] (320-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak japee-ai sadaa har nimakh  na bisara-o naam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਮਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਧਰਣੇ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: How can I estimate the glory of those, who have found the Lord, Har, Har?
lines.transliteration: tin kee sobh aa ki-aa gan ee jinee har har laDh aa.

lines.english: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is released from bondage.
lines.transliteration: saaDhaa sarn ee jo pavai so chh utai baDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਦੂਖਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord does not burn in thewomb of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai abinaasee-ai jon garabh  na daDhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਅਰਾਿਧਐ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who meets the Guru and the Supreme Lord God, who reads and understands,enters the state of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: gur bhayti-aa paarbarahm har parh  bujh samDh aa.

lines.english: Nanak has obtained that Lord Master, who is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||10|| slok mÚ 5 ] (320-13) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paa-i-aa so Dhan ee har agam agDh aa. ||10||

lines.english: People do not perform their duties, but instead, they wander around aimlessly.
lines.transliteration: kaam na karhee aapnaa fireh avt aa lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਿਬਸਰਉ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if they forget the Name, how can they ever find peace? ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (320-14) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naa-ay visaari-ai sukh kinayhaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The bitter poison of corruption is everywhere; it clings to the substance of the world.
lines.transliteration: bikhai ka-urh -tan sagal maahi jagat  rahee laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਿਕਆ  ਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the humble being has realized that the Name of the Lord alone is sweet.||2|| pauVI ] (320-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan veechaari-aa meethaa har kaa naa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਾ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਜੋ ਪਵੈ ਸੋ ਛੁਟੈ ਬਧਾ ॥
lines.english: This is the distinguishing sign of the Holy Saint, that by meeting with him, one issaved.
lines.transliteration: ih neesaanee saaDh  kee jis bh aytat taree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀਐ  ਜੋਿਨ ਗਰਿਭ  ਨ ਦਧਾ ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not come near him; he never has to die again.
lines.transliteration: jamkankar nayrh na aavee fir bahurh  na maree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿੜ ਬੁਿਝ ਸਮਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: He crosses over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar sansaar bikh  so paar ut ree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਧਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: So weave the garland of the Lord's Glorious Praises into your mind, and all your filth shall be washed away.
lines.transliteration: har gun gufhu man maal har sabh  mal parharee-ai.

lines.english: Nanak remains blended with his Beloved, the Supreme Lord God. ||11|| slok mÚ 5 ] (320-18) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pareetam mil rahay paarbarahm narharee-ai. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਹੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਅਵਤਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, approved is the birth of those, within whose consciousness the Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: naanak aa-ay say parvaan hai jin har vuth aa chit .

lines.english: Useless talk and babbling is useless, my friend. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (320-19) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gaalHee al palaalee-aa kamm na aavahi mit. ||1||

lines.english: I have come to see the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Inaccessible, Wonderful Lord. pMnw 321
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh d aristee aa-i-aa pooran agam bismaad .

lines.english: Nanak has made the Lord's Name his wealth, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (321-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam Dhan keet aa pooray gur parsaad . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਤਾ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhohu na chalee kh asam naal lab mohi vigut ay. Deception does not work with our Lord and Master; through their greed and emotional attachment, people are ruined.
They do their evil deeds, and sleep in the intoxication of Maya.
lines.transliteration: kartab karan bh alayri-aa mad  maa-i-aa sut ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੋਹੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ  ਖਸਮ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਲਿਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਗੁਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Time and time again, they are consigned to reincarnation, and abandoned on the pathof Death.
lines.transliteration: fir fir joon bhavaa-ee-an jam maarag mut ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤਬ  ਕਰਿਨ  ਭਲੇਿਰਆ  ਮਿਦ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੁਤੇ ॥
lines.english: They receive the consequences of their own actions, and are yoked to their pain.
lines.transliteration: keetaa paa-in aapn aa dukh saytee jut ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, if one forgets the Name, all the seasons are evil. ||12|| slok mÚ 5 ] (321-3) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naa-ay visaari-ai sabh mand ee rut ay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਦੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
lines.english: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, be at peace;
lines.transliteration: uthand i-aa bahand i-aa suvand iaa sukh  so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are cooled andsoothed. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (321-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi-ai man tan seet al ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Filled with greed, he constantly wanders around; he does not do any good deeds.
lines.transliteration: laalach ati-aa nit firai su-aarath karay na ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord abides within the mind of one who meets with the Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (321-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jis gur bhaytai naankaa t is man vasi-aa so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਲਾਿਹਐ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All material things are bitter; the True Name alone is sweet.
lines.transliteration: sabhay vast oo ka-urh ee-aa sachay naa-o mith aa.

lines.english: Those humble servants of the Lord who taste it, come to savor its flavor.
lines.transliteration: saad aa-i-aa t in har janaaN chakh  saaDh ee dith aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਿਚ  ਅਿਟਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਫਰੈ ਸੁਆਰਥੁ  ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: It comes to dwell within the mind of those who are so pre-destined by the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jis likhi-aa man t isai vuth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere; He destroys the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: ik niranjan rav rahi-aa bhaa-o d uyaa kuth aa.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the Lord's Name, with his palms pressed together; by His Pleasure,God has granted it. ||13|| slok mÚ 5 ] (321-8) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naanak mangai jorh kar parabh  dayvai t uthaa. ||13||

lines.english: The most excellent begging is begging for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaachrhee saa saar jo jaachand ee haykrh o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਚਿਖ ਸਾਧੀ  ਿਡਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Other talk is corrupt, O Nanak, except that of the Lord Master. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (321-9) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gaalHee bi-aa vikaar naanak Dhan ee vihoon ee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: One who recognizes the Lord is very rare; his mind is pierced through with the Love ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: neehi je viDhaa man pachh aanoo virlo thi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਾਉ ਦੁਯਾ  ਕੁਠਾ ॥
lines.english: Such a Saint is the Uniter, O Nanak - he straightens out the path. ||2|| pauVI ] (321-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jorhanhaaraa sant  naanak paaDh ar paDh ro. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜੋਿੜ ਕਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Serve Him, O my soul, who is the Giver and the Forgiver.
lines.transliteration: so-ee sayvihu jee-arhay d aataa bakh sind.

lines.english: All sinful mistakes are erased, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh sabh  binaas hon simrat  govind .

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਚੜੀ  ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ  ਹੇਕੜੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Holy Saint has shown me the Way to the Lord; I chant the GurMantra.
lines.transliteration: har maarag saaDhoo d asi-aa japee-ai gurmant .

lines.english: The taste of Maya is totally bland and insipid; the Lord alone is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa su-aad sabh  fiki-aa har man bh aavand .

lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay naanak parmaysrai jin d itee jind . ||14|| Meditate, O Nanak, on the Transcendent Lord, who has blessed you with your soul and your life. ||14|| slok mÚ 5 ] (321-12) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
The time has come to plant the seed of the Lord's Name; one who plants it, shall eatits fruit.
lines.transliteration: vat lagee sachay naam kee jo beejay so kh aa-ay.

lines.english: He alone receives it, O Nanak, whose destiny is so pre-ordained. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (321-13) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  naankaa jis no likh i-aa aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: If one begs, then he should beg for the Name of the True One, which is given only byHis Pleasure.
lines.transliteration: mangnaa t a sach ik jis t us dayvai aap.

lines.english: Eating this gift from the Lord and Master, O Nanak, the mind is satisfied. ||2|| pauVI ] (321-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jit khaaDhai man t aripat -ee-ai naanak saahib d aat. ||2||

lines.english: They alone earn profit in this world, who have the wealth of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: laahaa jag meh say khateh jin har Dh an raas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਸਾਧੂ ਦਿਸਆ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: They do not know the love of duality; they place their hopes in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa bh aa-o na jaan nee sachay d ee aas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੁਆਦ  ਸਿਭ ਿਫਿਕਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: They serve the One Eternal Lord, and give up everything else.
lines.transliteration: nihchal ayk sarayvi-aa hor sabh vin aas.

lines.english: One who forgets the Supreme Lord God - useless is his breath.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jis visrai tis birthaa saas.

lines.english: God draws His humble servant close in His loving embrace and protects him - Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15|| slok mÚ 5 ] (321-17) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay jan rakh i-aa naanak bal jaas. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਵਤ ਲਗੀ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God gave the Order, and the rain automatically began to fall.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm furmaa-i-aa meehu vuthaa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was totally satisfied andsatiated.
lines.transliteration: ann Dhan bahut  upji-aa parithmee rajee t ipat aghaa-ay.

lines.english: Forever and ever, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and pain and poverty shallrun away.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa gun  uchrai d ukh daalad  ga-i-aa bilaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਗਣਾ  ਤ ਸਚੁ ਇਕੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਤੁਿਸ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive, according to the Will of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa paa-i-aa mili-aa t isai rajaa-ay.

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord keeps you alive; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (321-19) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl: pMnw 322
lines.transliteration: parmaysar jeevaali-aa naanak tisai Dh i-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevan pad nirbaan  iko simree-ai.

lines.english: There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?
lines.transliteration: doojee naahee jaa-ay kin biDh  Dheeree-ai.

lines.english: I have seen the whole world - without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all.
lines.transliteration: dithaa sabh  sansaar sukh  na naam bin.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Body and wealth shall return to dust - hardly anyone realizes this.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an hosee chh aar jaan ai ko-ay jan.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਿਦ  ਿਕ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Pleasure, beauty and delicious tastes are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?
lines.transliteration: rang roop ras baad ke karahi paraan ee-aa.

lines.english: One whom the Lord Himself misleads, does not understand His awesome power.
lines.transliteration: jis bhulaa-ay aap t is kal nahee jaan ee-aa.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord attain Nirvaanaa, singing the Praises of the True One.
lines.transliteration: rang ratay nirbaan  sachaa gaavhee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak: those who are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord, seek Sanctuary at Your Door.||2|| pauVI ] (322-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran d u-aar jay t uDh bhaavhee. ||2||

lines.english: Those who are attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, do not suffer birth and death.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  na tinH ka-o jo har larh  laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who remain awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - their lives are approved.
lines.transliteration: jeevat say parvaan  ho-ay har keert an jaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੋਏ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਿਨ  ਜਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who attain the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jin paa-i-aa say-ee vadbh aagay.

lines.english: But those who forget the Name - their lives are cursed, and broken like thin strands ofthread.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay visri-ai Dharig jeevn aa tootay kach Dh aagay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands,even millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines. ||16|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (322-6) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhoorh  puneet  saaDh  lakh kot piraagay. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧੂਿੜ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਸਾਧ ਲਖ ਕੋਿਟ ਿਪਰਾਗੇ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Dharan  suvannee kh arh ratan jarh aavee har paraym purakh  man vuth aa. Like the beautiful earth, adorned with jewels of grass - such is the mind, within which the Love of the Lord abides.
All one's affairs are easily resolved, O Nanak, when the Guru, the True Guru, ispleased. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (322-7) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabhay kaaj suhaylrh ay thee-ay gur naanak sat gur tuthaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਣ  ਸੁਵੰਨੀ  ਖੜ ਰਤਨ  ਜੜਾਵੀ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
lines.english: Roaming and wandering in the ten directions, over water, mountains and forests
lines.transliteration: firdee fird ee dah disaa jal parbat  banraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ  ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ  ਥੀਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jithai dithaa mirt ako il bahith ee aa-ay. ||2|| - wherever the vulture sees a dead body, he flies down and lands. ||2|| pauVI ] (322-8) pa-orhee.

lines.english: One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practice Truth.
lines.transliteration: jis sarab sukhaa fal lorh ee-ah so sach kamaava-o.

lines.english: Behold the Supreme Lord God near you, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of theOne Lord.
lines.transliteration: nayrhai d aykh-a-u paarbarahm ik naam Dh i-aava-o.

lines.english: Become the dust of all men's feet, and so merge with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay sagal kee raynukaa har sang samaava-o.

lines.english: Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honor.
lines.transliteration: dookh  na day-ee kisai jee-a pat  si-o gh ar jaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਿਹ  ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks of the Purifier of sinners, the Creator, the Primal Being. ||17|| slok dohw mÚ 5 ] (322-11) salok dohaa mehlaa 5. Shalok, Dohaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  kartaa purakh  naanak sun aava-o. ||17||

lines.english: I have made the One Lord my Friend; He is All-powerful to do everything.
lines.transliteration: ayk je saajan mai kee-aa sarab kalaa samrath.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ  ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (322-12) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-o hamaaraa khannee-ai har man t an sand -rhee vath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਿਕਸੈ ਜੀਅ  ਪਿਤ ਿਸਉ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Take my hand, O my Beloved; I shall never forsake You.
lines.transliteration: jay kar gaheh pi-aarrhay t uDh na chh odaa mool.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਣਾਵਉ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those who forsake the Lord, are the most evil people; they shall fall into the horriblepit of hell. ||2|| pauVI ] (322-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har chhodan say d urjanaa parh eh dojak kai sool. ||2||

lines.english: All treasures are in His Home; whatever the Lord does, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: sabh niDh aan gh ar jis d ai har karay so hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਿਜ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeeveh sant jan paapaa mal Dh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ  ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is takenaway.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal hirdai vaseh sankat sabh  khovai.

lines.english: One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa jis bhaytee-ai mar janam na rovai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿਹ  ਿਪਆਰੜੇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਿਲ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He hasbestowed it. ||18|| slok fKxw mÚ 5 ] (322-16) salok dakh-n aa mehlaa 5. Shalok, Dakhanaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh d aras pi-aas naanak gh anee kirpaa kar d ayvai. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਛੋਡਿਨ  ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਦੋਜਕ  ਕੈ ਸੂਿਲ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,
lines.transliteration: bhoree bh aram vanj aa-ay piree muhabat  hik too.

lines.english: Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jithahu vanjai jaa-ay t ithaa-oo ma-ujood  so-ay. ||1|| then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (322-17) mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਹਿਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?
lines.transliteration: charh kai gh orh-rhai kund ay pakrh eh kh oondee d ee kh aydaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਪਾ  ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2|| pauVI ] (322-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: hansaa saytee chit  ulaaseh kukarh  dee odaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਸਿਭ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears aresaved, O my friend.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa uchrai har sarvanee sun ai so uDh rai mit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.
lines.transliteration: har jas likheh laa-ay bh aavnee say hasat  pavit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਘਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacredshrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath majnaa sabh  punn t in kitaa.

lines.english: They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption. pMnw 323
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar tay uDh ray bikh i-aa garh  jitaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19|| slok mÚ 5 ] (323-1) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak larh laa-ay uDh aari-an d a-yu sayv amit aa. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਇ  ਉਧਾਿਰਅਨ ੁ ਦਯੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਅਿਮਤਾ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: DhanDh -rhay kulaah chit  na aavai haykrh o. Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.
O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (323-2) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak say-ee tann futann jinaa saaN-ee visrai. ||1||

lines.english: The ghost has been transformed into an angel by the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraytahu keet on dayvtaa tin karn aihaaray.

lines.english: God has emancipated all the Sikhs and resolved their affairs.
lines.transliteration: sabhay sikh  ubaari-an parabh  kaaj savaaray.

lines.english: He has seized the slanderers and thrown them to the ground, and declared them falsein His Court.
lines.transliteration: nindak pakarh  pachh aarhi-an jh oothay darbaaray.

lines.english: Nanak's God is glorious and great; He Himself creates and adorns. ||2|| pauVI ] (323-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa parabh vadaa hai aap saaj savaaray. ||2||

lines.english: God is unlimited; He has no limit; He is the One who does everything.
lines.transliteration: parabh bay-ant  kichh  ant naahi sabh  tisai karn aa.

lines.english: The Inaccessible and Unapproachable Lord and Master is the Support of His beings.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar saahibo jee-aaN kaa parnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਆਿਪ  ਸਾਿਜ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Giving His Hand, He nurtures and cherishes; He is the Filler and Fulfiller.
lines.transliteration: hasat d ay-ay part ipaald aa bh aran pokh an karnaa.

lines.english: He Himself is Merciful and Forgiving. Chanting the True Name, one is saved.
lines.transliteration: miharvaan bakhsind  aap jap sachay t arnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases You - that alone is good; slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||20|| slok mÚ 5 ] (323-6) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so bh alaa naanak d aas sarn aa. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੋ  ਜੀਆਂ  ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who belongs to God has no hunger.
lines.transliteration: tinnaa bh ukh na kaa rahee jis d aa parabh  hai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਸਤ  ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਦਾ  ਭਰਣ  ਪੋਖਣੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (323-7) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak charnee lagi-aa uDh rai sabh o ko-ay. ||1||

lines.english: If the beggar begs for the Lord's Name every day, his Lord and Master will grant his request.
lines.transliteration: jaachik mangai nit naam saahib karay kabool.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord is the most generous host; He does not lack anythingat all. ||2|| pauVI ] (323-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak parmaysar jajmaan tiseh bh ukh na mool. ||2||

lines.english: To imbue the mind with the Lord of the Universe is the true food and dress.
lines.transliteration: man rataa govind  sang sach bh ojan jorh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤੰਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: To embrace love for the Name of the Lord is to possess horses and elephants.
lines.transliteration: pareet lagee har naam si-o ay hast ee gh orhay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਿਗਆ  ਉਧਰੈ  ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: To meditate on the Lord steadfastly is to rule over kingdoms of property and enjoy allsorts of pleasures.
lines.transliteration: raaj milakh kh usee-aa gh anee Dh i-aa-ay mukh  na morh ay.

lines.english: The minstrel begs at God's Door - he shall never leave that Door. nwnk min qin cwau eyhu inq pRB kau loVy ]21]1] suDu kIcy  (323-10, gauVI, mÚ 5) naanak man tan chaa-o ayhu nit  parabh  ka-o lorh ay. ||21||1|| suDh  keechay Nanak has this yearning in his mind and body - he longs continually for God. ||21||1||Sudh Keechay|| rwgu gauVI BgqW kI bwxI  (323-12) raag ga-orhee bh agtaaN kee ban ee Raag Gauree, The Word Of The Devotees: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu gur pRswid ] (323-12) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  gur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace: gauVI guAwryrI sRI kbIr jIau ky caupdy 14 ] (323-13) ga-orhee gu-aarayree saree kabeer jee-o kay cha-upd ay 14. Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourteen Chau-Padas Of Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee dar parabh  mangn aa dar kad ay na chh orhay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਚਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਿਨਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: I was on fire, but now I have found the Water of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi jalat raam jal paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਿਲ ॥੨॥
lines.english: This Water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam udak t an jalat  bujhaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: To subdue their minds, some go off into the forests;
lines.transliteration: man maaran kaaran  ban jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jal bin bhagvant  na paa-ee-ai. ||1|| but that Water is not found without the Lord God. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਏ ਹਸਤੀ  ਘੋੜੇ ॥
lines.english: That fire has consumed angels and mortal beings,
lines.transliteration: jih paavak sur nar hai jaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਿਮਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਘਣੀ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam udak jan jalat  ubaaray. ||2|| but the Water of the Lord's Name saves His humble servants from burning. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਢੀ  ਦਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ  ਦਰੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
lines.english: In the terrifying world-ocean, there is an ocean of peace.
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar sukh  saagar maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਿਨਤ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥
lines.english: I continue to drink it in, but this Water is never exhausted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: peev rahay jal nikhutat  naahee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਨਾਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, like the rainbird remembering the water.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer bhaj saringpaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧੪॥
lines.english: The Water of the Lord's Name has quenched my thirst. ||4||1|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (323-17) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: raam udak mayree t ikhaa bujh aanee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਜਲਤ  ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, my thirst for the Water of Your Name will not go away.
lines.transliteration: maaDha-o jal kee pi-aas na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The fire of my thirst burns even more brightly in that Water. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jal meh agan uthee aDh ikaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am just a fish in that Water.
lines.transliteration: tooN jalniDh  ha-o jal kaa meen.

lines.english: In that Water, I remain; without that Water, I would perish. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jal meh raha-o jaleh bin kheen. ||1||

lines.english: You are the cage, and I am Your parrot.
lines.transliteration: tooN pinjar ha-o soo-ataa t or.

lines.english: So what can the cat of death do to me? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jam manjaar kahaa karai mor. ||2||

lines.english: You are the tree, and I am the bird.
lines.transliteration: tooN tarvar ha-o pankh ee aahi.

lines.english: I am so unfortunate - I cannot see the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan! ||3|| pMnw 324
lines.transliteration: mand-bh aagee t ayro d arsan naahi. ||3||

lines.english: You are the True Guru, and I am Your new disciple.
lines.transliteration: tooN satgur ha-o na-ut an chaylaa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please meet me - this is my very last chance! ||4||2|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (324-1) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer mil ant kee baylaa. ||4||2||

lines.english: When I realize that there is One, and only One Lord,
lines.transliteration: jab ham ayko ayk kar jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tab logah kaahay d ukh maani-aa. ||1|| why then should the people be upset? ||1||

lines.english: I am dishonored; I have lost my honor.
lines.transliteration: ham aptah apunee pat  kho-ee.

lines.english: No one should follow in my footsteps. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hamrai khoj parahu mat  ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am bad, and bad in my mind as well.
lines.transliteration: ham manday mand ay man maahee.

lines.english: I have no partnership with anyone. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saajh paat  kaahoo si-o naahee. ||2||

lines.english: I have no shame about honor or dishonor.
lines.transliteration: pat apat  taa kee nahee laaj.

lines.english: But you shall know, when your own false covering is laid bare. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tab jaanhugay jab ugh raigo paaj. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਅਪਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, honor is that which is accepted by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer pat har parvaan.

lines.english: Give up everything - meditate, vibrate upon the Lord alone. ||4||3|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (324-5) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: sarab ti-aag bh aj kayval raam. ||4||3||

lines.english: If Yoga could be obtained by wandering around naked,
lines.transliteration: nagan firat jou paa-ee-ai jog.
ban kaa mirag mukat sabh  hog. ||1|| then all the deer of the forest would be liberated. ||1||

lines.english: What does it matter whether someone goes naked, or wears a deer skin,
lines.transliteration: ki-aa naagay ki-aa baaDhay chaam.
jab nahee cheenas aatam raam. ||1|| rahaa-o. if he does not remember the Lord within his soul? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: If the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas could be obtained by shaving the head,
lines.transliteration: mood mundaa-ay jou siDh paa-ee.
muktee bh ayd na ga-ee-aa kaa-ee. ||2|| then why haven't sheep found liberation? ||2||

lines.english: If someone could save himself by celibacy, O Siblings of Destiny,
lines.transliteration: bind raakh  jou taree-ai bh aa-ee.
khusrai ki-o na param gat  paa-ee. ||3|| why then haven't eunuchs obtained the state of supreme dignity? ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O men, O Siblings of Destiny:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer sunhu nar bhaa-ee.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin kin gat paa-ee. ||4||4|| without the Lord's Name, who has ever found salvation? ||4||4|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (324-8) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: Those who take their ritual baths in the evening and the morning
lines.transliteration: sanDhi-aa paraat  isnaan karaahee.
ji-o bha-ay d aadur paanee maahee. ||1|| are like the frogs in the water. ||1||

lines.english: When people do not love the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: ja-o pai raam raam rat naahee.
tay sabh  Dharam raa-ay kai jaahee. ||1|| rahaa-o. they must all go to the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Those who love their bodies and try different looks,
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa rat baho roop rachaahee.
tin ka-o d a-i-aa supnai bh ee naahee. ||2|| do not feel compassion, even in dreams. ||2||

lines.english: The wise men call them four-footed creatures;
lines.transliteration: chaar charan kaheh baho aagar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਿਤ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sukh  paavahi kal saagar. ||3|| the Holy find peace in this ocean of pain. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੈ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, why do you perform so many rituals?
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer baho kaa-ay kareejai.

lines.english: Renounce everything, and drink in the supreme essence of the Lord. ||4||5|| kbIr jI gauVI ] (324-12) kabeer jee ga-orhee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: sarbas chhod mahaa ras peejai. ||4||5||

lines.english: What use is chanting, and what use is penance, fasting or devotional worship,
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jap ki-aa tap ki-aa barat  poojaa.
jaa kai ridai bh aa-o hai d oojaa. ||1|| to one whose heart is filled with the love of duality? ||1||

lines.english: O humble people, link your mind to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ray jan man maaDha-o si-o laa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Through cleverness, the four-armed Lord is not obtained. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chaturaa-ee na chat urbhuj paa-ee-ai. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Set aside your greed and worldly ways.
lines.transliteration: parhar lobh ar lokaachaar.

lines.english: Set aside sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parhar kaam kroDh ahaNkaar. ||2||

lines.english: Ritual practices bind people in egotism;
lines.transliteration: karam karat baDh ay ahaNmayv.
mil paathar kee karhee sayv. ||3|| meeting together, they worship stones. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, He is obtained only by devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer bhagat  kar paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through innocent love, the Lord is met. ||4||6|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (324-16) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: bholay bh aa-ay milay ragh uraa-i-aa. ||4||6||

lines.english: In the dwelling of the womb, there is no ancestry or social status.
lines.transliteration: garabh vaas meh kul nahee jaat ee.

lines.english: All have originated from the Seed of God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: barahm bind t ay sabh  utpaatee. ||1||

lines.english: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: since when have you been a Brahmin?
lines.transliteration: kaho ray pandit baaman kab kay ho-ay.

lines.english: Don't waste your life by continually claiming to be a Brahmin. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baaman kahi kahi janam mat kh o-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If you are indeed a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin mother,
lines.transliteration: jou tooN baraahman  barahman ee jaa-i-aa.
ta-o aan baat kaahay nahee aa-i-aa. ||2|| then why didn't you come by some other way? ||2||

lines.english: How is it that you are a Brahmin, and I am of a low social status?
lines.transliteration: tum kat  baraahman  ham kat  sood .

lines.english: How is it that I am formed of blood, and you are made of milk? ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham kat lohoo t um kat  dooDh. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, one who contemplates God,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jo barahm beechaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਵਾਸ ਮਿਹ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: so baraahman kahee-at  hai hamaarai. ||4||7|| is said to be a Brahmin among us. ||4||7|| pMnw 325 gauVI kbIr jI ] (325-1) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: In the darkness, no one can sleep in peace.
lines.transliteration: anDhkaar sukh  kabeh na so-ee hai.

lines.english: The king and the pauper both weep and cry. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raajaa rank do-oo mil ro-ee hai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ  ਸੁਿਖ ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: As long as the tongue does not chant the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: ja-o pai rasnaa raam na kahibo.
upjat binsat  rovat  rahibo. ||1|| rahaa-o. the person continues coming and going in reincarnation, crying out in pain.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਹਬੋ  ॥
lines.english: It is like the shadow of a tree;
lines.transliteration: jas daykh ee-ai t arvar kee chh aa-i-aa.
paraan ga-ay kaho kaa kee maa-i-aa. ||2|| when the breath of life passes out of the mortal being, tell me, what becomes of hiswealth? ||2||

lines.english: It is like the music contained in the instrument;
lines.transliteration: jas jantee meh jee-o samaanaa.
moo-ay maram ko kaa kar jaanaa. ||3|| how can anyone know the secret of the dead? ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਗਏ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Like the swan on the lake, death hovers over the body.
lines.transliteration: hansaa sarvar kaal sareer.

lines.english: Drink in the Lord's sweet elixir, Kabeer. ||4||8|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (325-4) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in pee-o ray kabeer. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਏ ਮਰਮੁ  ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕਰ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The creation is born of the Light, and the Light is in the creation.
lines.transliteration: jot kee jaat  jaat kee jot ee.

lines.english: It bears two fruits: the false glass and the true pearl. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tit laagay kanchoo-aa fal mot ee. ||1||

lines.english: Where is that home, which is said to be free of fear?
lines.transliteration: kavan so ghar jo nirbh a-o kahee-ai.

lines.english: There, fear is dispelled and one lives without fear. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-o bh aj jaa-ay abh ai ho-ay rahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ  ਕੀ ਜਾਿਤ ਜਾਿਤ  ਕੀ ਜੋਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: On the banks of sacred rivers, the mind is not appeased.
lines.transliteration: tat tirath nahee man pat ee-aa-ay.

lines.english: People remain entangled in good and bad deeds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chaar achaar rahay urjhaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Sin and virtue are both the same.
lines.transliteration: paap punn du-ay ayk samaan.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਭਿਜ ਜਾਇ ਅਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the home of your own being, is the Philosopher's Stone; renounce your search for any other virtue. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar paaras t ajahu gun aan. ||3||

lines.english: Kabeer: O worthless mortal, do not lose the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kabeer nirgun naam na ros.

lines.english: Keep this mind of yours involved in this involvement. ||4||9|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (325-8) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: is parchaa-ay parach rahu ays. ||4||9||

lines.english: He claims to know the Lord, who is beyond measure and beyond thought;
lines.transliteration: jo jan parmit parman jaanaa.
baatan hee baikunth  samaanaa. ||1|| by mere words, he plans to enter heaven. ||1||

lines.english: I do not know where heaven is.
lines.transliteration: naa jaanaa baikunth kahaa hee.

lines.english: Everyone claims that he plans to go there. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaan jaan sabh kaheh t ahaa hee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By mere talk, the mind is not appeased.
lines.transliteration: kahan kahaavan nah patee-a-ee hai.

lines.english: The mind is only appeased, when egotism is conquered. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ta-o man maanai jaa t ay ha-umai ja-ee hai. ||2||

lines.english: As long as the mind is filled with the desire for heaven,
lines.transliteration: jab lag man baikunth kee aas.
tab lag ho-ay nahee charan nivaas. ||3|| he does not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, unto whom should I tell this?
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ih kahee-ai kaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਿਭ ਕਹਿਹ  ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven. ||4||10|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (325-12) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  baikunth ay aahi. ||4||10||

lines.english: We are born, and we grow, and having grown, we pass away.
lines.transliteration: upjai nipjai nipaj samaa-ee.

lines.english: Before our very eyes, this world is passing away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nainah daykh at ih jag jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can you not die of shame, claiming, "This world is mine"?
lines.transliteration: laaj na marahu kahhu ghar mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਿਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, nothing is yours. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ant kee baar nahee kachh  tayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Trying various methods, you cherish your body,
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar kaa-i-aa paalee.
martee baar agan sang jaalee. ||2|| but at the time of death, it is burned in the fire. ||2||

lines.english: You apply sandalwood oil to your limbs,
lines.transliteration: cho-aa chandan mard an angaa.
so tan jalai kaath  kai sangaa. ||3|| but that body is burned with the firewood. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O virtuous people:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer sunhu ray gunee-aa.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: binsaigo roop daykh ai sabh  dunee-aa. ||4||11|| your beauty shall vanish, as the whole world watches. ||4||11|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (325-15) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: Why do you cry and mourn, when another person dies?
lines.transliteration: avar moo-ay ki-aa sog kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Do so only if you yourself are to live. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ta-o keejai ja-o aapan jeejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I shall not die as the rest of the world dies,
lines.transliteration: mai na mara-o maribo sansaaraa.
ab mohi mili-o hai jee-aavanhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. for now I have met the life-giving Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: People anoint their bodies with fragrant oils,
lines.transliteration: i-aa dayhee parmal mahkand aa.
taa sukh  bisray parmaanand aa. ||2|| and in that pleasure, they forget the supreme bliss. ||2||

lines.english: There is one well, and five water-carriers.
lines.transliteration: koo-ataa ayk panch panihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Even though the rope is broken, the fools continue trying to draw water. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tootee laaj bharai mat  haaree. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ik buDh beechaaree.

lines.english: There is no well, and no water-carrier. ||4||12|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (325-19) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: naa oh koo-ataa naa panihaaree. ||4||12||

lines.english: The mobile and immobile creatures, insects and moths
lines.transliteration: asthaavar jangam keet patangaa.
anik janam kee-ay baho rangaa. ||1|| - in numerous lifetimes, I have passed through those many forms. ||1|| pMnw 326

lines.english: I lived in many such homes, O Lord,
lines.transliteration: aisay ghar ham bahut  basaa-ay.
jab ham raam garabh ho-ay aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. before I came into the womb this time. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਗਰਭ  ਹੋਇ ਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I was a Yogi, a celibate, a penitent, and a Brahmchaaree, with strict self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee t apee barahamchaaree.

lines.english: Sometimes I was a king, sitting on the throne, and sometimes I was a beggar. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kabhoo raajaa chhat arpat kabhoo bh aykhaaree. ||2||

lines.english: The faithless cynics shall die, while the Saints shall all survive.
lines.transliteration: saakat mareh sant  sabh  jeeveh.

lines.english: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence with their tongues. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in rasnaa peeveh. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, O God, have mercy on me.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer parabh kirpaa keejai.

lines.english: I am so tired; now, please bless me with Your perfection. ||4||13|| gauVI kbIr jI kI nwil rlwie iliKAw mhlw 5 ] (326-4) ga-orhee kabeer jee kee naal ralaa-ay likh i-aa mehlaa 5. Gauree, Kabeer Jee, With Writings Of The Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: haar paray ab pooraa deejai. ||4||13||

lines.english: Kabeer has seen such wonders!
lines.transliteration: aiso achraj daykh i-o kabeer.

lines.english: Mistaking it for cream, the people are churning water. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daDh kai bh olai birolai neer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ਰਲਾਇ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ॥
lines.english: The donkey grazes upon the green grass;
lines.transliteration: haree angooree gadhaa charai.
nit uth  haasai heegai marai. ||1|| arising each day, he laughs and brays, and then dies. ||1||

lines.english: The bull is intoxicated, and runs around wildly.
lines.transliteration: maataa bh aisaa ammuhaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: He romps and eats and then falls into hell. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kud kud  charai rasaat al paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, a strange sport has become manifest:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer pargat bha-ee kh ayd.
laylay ka-o chooghai nit  bhayd. ||3|| the sheep is sucking the milk of her lamb. ||3||

lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, my intellect is enlightened.
lines.transliteration: raam ramat mat  pargatee aa-ee.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Guru has blessed me with this understanding. ||4||1||14|| gauVI kbIr jI pMcpdy ] (326-7) ga-orhee kabeer jee panchpad ay. Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer gur sojhee paa-ee. ||4||1||14||

lines.english: I am like a fish out of water,
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal chhod baahar bh a-i-o meenaa.
poorab janam ha-o tap kaa heenaa. ||1|| because in my previous life, I did not practice penance and intense meditation. ||1||

lines.english: Now tell me, Lord, what will my condition be?
lines.transliteration: ab kaho raam kavan gat moree.

lines.english: I left Benares - I had little common sense. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tajee lay banaaras mat  bha-ee thoree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I wasted my whole life in the city of Shiva;
lines.transliteration: sagal janam siv puree gavaa-i-aa.
martee baar maghar uth  aa-i-aa. ||2|| at the time of my death, I moved to Magahar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਬ  ਜਨਮ  ਹਉ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਹੀਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: For many years, I practiced penance and intense meditation at Kaashi;
lines.transliteration: bahut baras t ap kee-aa kaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਵਨ  ਗਿਤ  ਮੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran bha-i-aa maghar kee baasee. ||3|| now that my time to die has come, I have come to dwell at Magahar! ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਜੀ  ਲੇ ਬਨਾਰਸ  ਮਿਤ ਭਈ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Kaashi and Magahar - I consider them the same.
lines.transliteration: kaasee maghar sam beechaaree.

lines.english: With inadequate devotion, how can anyone swim across? ||4||
lines.transliteration: ochhee bh agat kaisay ut ras paaree. ||4||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Guru and Ganaysha and Shiva all know
lines.transliteration: kaho gur gaj siv sabh ko jaanai.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: mu-aa kabeer ramat saree raamai. ||5||15|| that Kabeer died chanting the Lord's Name. ||5||15|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (326-12) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: You may anoint your limbs with sandalwood oil,
lines.transliteration: cho-aa chandan mard an angaa.
so tan jalai kaath  kai sangaa. ||1|| but in the end, that body will be burned with the firewood. ||1||

lines.english: Why should anyone take pride in this body or wealth?
lines.transliteration: is tan Dh an kee kavan badaa-ee.

lines.english: Dharan parai urvaar na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. They shall end up lying on the ground; they shall not go along with you to the worldbeyond. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਜ ਿਸਵ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: They sleep by night and work during the day,
lines.transliteration: raat je soveh d in karahi kaam.
ik khin layhi na har ko naam. ||2|| but they do not chant the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||2||

lines.english: They hold the string of the kite in their hands, and chew betel leaves in their mouths,
lines.transliteration: haath ta dor mukh  khaa-i-o t ambor.
martee baar kas baaDh i-o chor. ||3|| but at the time of death, they shall be tied up tight, like thieves. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, and immersed in His Love, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat ras ras har gun gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ  ਬਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and find peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: raamai raam ramat sukh  paavai. ||4||

lines.english: In His Mercy, He implants the Naam within us;
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kar kai naam darirh aa-ee.
har har baas suganDh basaa-ee. ||5|| inhale deeply the sweet aroma and fragrance of the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, remember Him, you blind fool!
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer chayt  ray anDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਲੇਿਹ ਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord is True; all worldly affairs are false. ||6||16|| gauVI kbIr jI iqpdy cwrquky ] (326-17) ga-orhee kabeer jee t ipday chaart ukay. Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Ti-Padas And Chau-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: sat raam jh oothaa sabh  DhanDhaa. ||6||16||

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਿਥ  ਤ ਡੋਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਖਾਇਓ  ਤੰਬੋਰ  ॥
lines.english: I have turned away from death and turned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jam tay ulat bh a-ay hai raam.

lines.english: Pain has been eliminated, and I dwell in peac and comfort.
lines.transliteration: dukh binsay sukh  kee-o bisraam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: My enemies have been transformed into friends.
lines.transliteration: bairee ulat bha-ay hai meet aa.

lines.english: The faithless cynics have been transformed into good-hearted people. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saakat ulat sujan bh a-ay cheet aa. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I feel that everything brings me peace.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi sarab kusal kar maani-aa.

lines.english: Peace and tranquility have come, since I realized the Lord of the Universe.||1||Pause|| pMnw 327
lines.transliteration: saaNt bha-ee jab gobid  jaani-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My body was afflicted with millions of diseases.
lines.transliteration: tan meh hot ee kot upaaDh .

lines.english: They have been transformed into the peaceful, tranquil concentration of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: ulat bha-ee sukh  sahj samaaDh .

lines.english: When someone understands his own self,
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaanai aapai aap.
rog na bi-aapai teenou t aap. ||2|| he no longer suffers from illness and the three fevers. ||2||

lines.english: My mind has now been restored to its original purity.
lines.transliteration: ab man ulat sanaatan hoo-aa.

lines.english: When I became dead while yet alive, only then did I come to know the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tab jaani-aa jab jeevat  moo-aa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I am now immersed in intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer sukh sahj samaava-o.

lines.english: I do not fear anyone, and I do not strike fear into anyone else. ||3||17|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (327-3) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: aap na dara-o na avar daraava-o. ||3||17||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਡਰਉ  ਨ ਅਵਰ  ਡਰਾਵਉ  ॥੩॥੧੭॥
lines.english: When the body dies, where does the soul go?
lines.transliteration: pind moo-ai jee-o kih ghar jaat aa.

lines.english: It is absorbed into the untouched, unstruck melody of the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabad at eet anaahad  raataa.

lines.english: Only one who knows the Lord realizes Him.
lines.transliteration: jin raam jaani-aa tineh pachh aani-aa.

lines.english: The mind is satisfied and satiated, like the mute who eats the sugar candy and justsmiles, without speaking. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o goongay saakar man maani-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the spiritual wisdom which the Lord has imparted.
lines.transliteration: aisaa gi-aan kathai banvaaree.

lines.english: O mind, hold your breath steady within the central channel of the Sushmanaa.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man ray pavan darirh  sukh man naaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Adopt such a Guru, that you shall not have to adopt another again.
lines.transliteration: so gur karahu je bahur na karnaa.

lines.english: Dwell in such a state, that you shall never have to dwell in any other.
lines.transliteration: so pad ravhu je bahur na ravnaa.

lines.english: Embrace such a meditation, that you shall never have to embrace any other.
lines.transliteration: so Dhi-aan Dh arahu je bahur na Dh arnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਜ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਕਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Die in such a way, that you shall never have to die again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aisay marahu je bahur na marnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਦੁ ਰਵਹੁ ਿਜ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਰਵਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Turn your breath away from the left channel, and away from the right channel, andunite them in the central channel of the Sushmanaa.
lines.transliteration: ultee gangaa jamun milaava-o.

lines.english: At their confluence within your mind, take your bath there without water.
lines.transliteration: bin jal sangam man meh nHaava-o.

lines.english: To look upon all with an impartial eye - let this be your daily occupation.
lines.transliteration: lochaa samsar ih bi-uhaaraa.

lines.english: Contemplate this essence of reality - what else is there to contemplate? ||3||
lines.transliteration: tat beechaar ki-aa avar beechaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Water, fire, wind, earth and ether
lines.transliteration: ap tayj baa-ay parithmee aakaasaa.
aisee rahat raha-o har paasaa. - adopt such a way of life and you shall be close to the Lord.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer niranjan Dhi-aava-o.

lines.english: Go to that home, which you shall never have to leave. ||4||18|| gauVI kbIr jI iqpdy ] (327-10) ga-orhee kabeer jee t ipday. Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Ti-Padas:
lines.transliteration: tit ghar jaa-o je bahur na aava-o. ||4||18||

lines.english: He cannot be obtained by offering your weight in gold.
lines.transliteration: kanchan si-o paa-ee-ai nahee tol.

lines.english: But I have bought the Lord by giving my mind to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man day raam lee-aa hai mol. ||1||

lines.english: Now I recognize that He is my Lord.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi raam apunaa kar jaani-aa.

lines.english: My mind is intuitively pleased with Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay mayraa man maani-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Brahma spoke of Him continually, but could not find His limit.
lines.transliteration: barahmai kath kath ant na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ  ਹੈ ਮੋਿਲ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Because of my devotion to the Lord, He has come to sit within the home of my innerbeing. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam bhagat  baith ay gh ar aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have renounced my restless intellect.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer chanchal mat t i-aagee.

lines.english: It is my destiny to worship the Lord alone. ||3||1||19|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (327-13) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kayval raam bhagat  nij bh aagee. ||3||1||19||

lines.english: That death which terrifies the entire world
lines.transliteration: jih marnai sabh jagat  taraasi-aa.
so marnaa gur sabad pargaasi-aa. ||1|| - the nature of that death has been revealed to me, through the Word of the Guru'sShabad. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੈ  ਕਿਥ ਕਿਥ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Now, how shall I die? My mind has already accepted death.
lines.transliteration: ab kaisay mara-o maran man maani-aa.

lines.english: Those who do not know the Lord, die over and over again, and then depart.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mar mar jaatay jin raam na jaani-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Everyone says, "I will die, I will die."
lines.transliteration: marno maran kahai sabh ko-ee.

lines.english: But he alone becomes immortal, who dies with intuitive understanding. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sehjay marai amar ho-ay so-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, my mind is filled with bliss;
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer man bha-i-aa anand aa.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: ga-i-aa bharam rahi-aa parmaanand aa. ||3||20|| my doubts have been eliminated, and I am in ecstasy. ||3||20|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (327-16) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: There is no special place where the soul aches; where should I apply the ointment?
lines.transliteration: kat nahee th a-ur mool kat  laava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ  ਮਰਿਨ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched the body, but I have not found such a place. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khojat  tan meh th a-ur na paava-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਤੇ  ਿਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone knows it, who feels the pain of such love;
lines.transliteration: laagee ho-ay so jaanai peer.
raam bhagat  anee-aalay t eer. ||1|| rahaa-o. the arrows of the Lord's devotional worship are so sharp! ||1||Pause||

lines.english: I look upon all His soul-brides with an impartial eye;
lines.transliteration: ayk bhaa-ay d aykh-a-u sabh  naaree.
ki-aa jaan-o sah ka-un pi-aaree. ||2|| how can I know which ones are dear to the Husband Lord? ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, one who has such destiny inscribed upon her forehead
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jaa kai mastak bh aag.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: sabh parhar t aa ka-o milai suhaag. ||3||21|| - her Husband Lord turns all others away, and meets with her. ||3||21|| pMnw 328 gauVI kbIr jI ] (328-1) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: One who has the Lord as his Master, O Siblings of Destiny
lines.transliteration: jaa kai har saa thaakur bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat anant  pukaaran  jaa-ee. ||1|| - countless liberations knock at his door. ||1||

lines.english: If I say now that my trust is in You alone, Lord,
lines.transliteration: ab kaho raam bharosaa t oraa.
tab kaahoo kaa kavan nihoraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. then what obligation do I have to anyone else? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: He bears the burden of the three worlds;
lines.transliteration: teen lok jaa kai heh bh aar.
so kaahay na karai partipaar. ||2|| why should He not cherish you also? ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ  ਲੋਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਹ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ik buDh beechaaree.

lines.english: If the mother poisons her own child, what can anyone do? ||3||22|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (328-3) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: ki-aa bas ja-o bikh d ay meht aaree. ||3||22||

lines.english: Without Truth, how can the woman be a true satee - a widow who burns herself on her husband's funeral pyre?
lines.transliteration: bin sat sat ee ho-ay kaisay naar.

lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, see this and contemplate it within your heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pandit d aykhhu rid ai beechaar. ||1||

lines.english: Without love, how can one's affection increase?
lines.transliteration: pareet binaa kaisay baDh ai sanayhu.

lines.english: As long as there is attachment to pleasure, there can be no spiritual love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab lag ras tab lag nahee nayhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who, in his own soul, believes the Queen Maya to be true,
lines.transliteration: saahan sat karai jee-a apnai.
so ramyay ka-o milai na supnai. ||2|| does not meet the Lord, even in dreams. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਸੁ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who surrenders her body, mind, wealth, home and self
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an garihu sa-up sareer.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: so-ee suhaagan kahai kabeer. ||3||23|| - she is the true soul-bride, says Kabeer. ||3||23|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (328-6) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: The whole world is engrossed in corruption.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa bi-aapi-aa sagal sansaar.

lines.english: This corruption has drowned entire families. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa lai doobee parvaar. ||1||

lines.english: O man, why have you wrecked your boat and sunk it?
lines.transliteration: ray nar naav cha-urh kat  borhee.

lines.english: You have broken with the Lord, and joined hands with corruption. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har si-o torh  bikhi-aa sang jorh ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Angels and human beings alike are burning in the raging fire.
lines.transliteration: sur nar daaDh ay laagee aag.

lines.english: The water is near at hand, but the beast does not drink it in. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nikat neer pas peevas na jhaag. ||2||

lines.english: By constant contemplation and awareness, the water is brought forth.
lines.transliteration: chaytat  chayt at niksi-o neer.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਵ ਚਉਿੜ ਕਤ ਬੋੜੀ ॥
lines.english: That water is immaculate and pure, says Kabeer. ||3||24|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (328-10) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: so jal nirmal kathat kabeer. ||3||24||

lines.english: That family, whose son has no spiritual wisdom or contemplation
lines.transliteration: jih kul poot na gi-aan beechaaree.
biDhvaa kas na bh a-ee meht aaree. ||1|| - why didn't his mother just become a widow? ||1||

lines.english: That man who has not practiced devotional worship of the Lord
lines.transliteration: jih nar raam bhagat  neh saaDh ee.
janmat kas na mu-o apraaDh ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. - why didn't such a sinful man die at birth? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: So many pregnancies end in miscarriage - why was this one spared?
lines.transliteration: much much garabh ga-ay keen bachi-aa.

lines.english: He lives his life in this world like a deformed amputee. ||2||
lines.transliteration: budbhuj roop jeevay jag majh i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, beautiful and handsome people are just ugly hunch-backs. ||3||25|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (328-13) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jaisay sundar saroop. naam binaa jaisay kubaj kuroop. ||3||25||

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those humble beings who take the Name of their Lord andMaster. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jan layhi khasam kaa naa-o. t in kai sad  balihaarai jaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Pure Lord are pure.
lines.transliteration: so nirmal nirmal har gun gaavai.

lines.english: They are my Siblings of Destiny, so dear to my heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so bhaa-ee mayrai man bh aavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am the dust of the lotus feet of those whose hearts are filled with the All-pervadingLord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jih ghat raam rahi-aa bh arpoor. t in kee pag pankaj ham Dh oor. ||2||

lines.english: I am a weaver by birth, and patient of mind.
lines.transliteration: jaat julaahaa mat  kaa Dh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਚੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰਭ  ਗਏ ਕੀਨ ਬਿਚਆ  ॥
lines.english: Slowly, steadily, Kabeer chants the Glories of God. ||3||26|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (328-16) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: sahj sahj gun ramai kabeer. ||3||26||

lines.english: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the nectar trickles down, distilled from my furnace.
lines.transliteration: gagan rasaal chu-ai mayree bhaath ee.

lines.english: I have gathered in this most sublime essence, making my body into firewood. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sanch mahaa ras tan bh a-i-aa kaath ee. ||1||

lines.english: He alone is called intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise,
lines.transliteration: u-aa ka-o kahee-ai sahj matvaaraa.

lines.english: ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: peevat raam ras gi-aan beechaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. who drinks in the juice of the Lord's essence, contemplating spiritual wisdom.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੇਿਹ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Intuitive poise is the bar-maid who comes to serve it.
lines.transliteration: sahj kalaalan ja-o mil aa-ee.

lines.english: I pass my nights and days in ecstasy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aanand maat ay an-d in jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Through conscious meditation, I linked my consciousness with the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: cheenat cheet  niranjan laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, then I obtained the Fearless Lord. ||3||27|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (328-19) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer tou anbh a-o paa-i-aa. ||3||27||

lines.english: The natural tendency of the mind is to chase the mind. pMnw 329
lines.transliteration: man kaa subhaa-o maneh bi-aapee.

lines.english: Who has established himself as a Siddha, a being of miraculous spiritual powers, by killing his mind? ||1||
lines.transliteration: maneh maar kavan siDh thaapee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਿਨ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Who is that silent sage, who has killed his mind?
lines.transliteration: kavan so mun jo man maarai.

lines.english: By killing the mind, tell me, who is saved? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man ka-o maar kahhu kis taarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Everyone speaks through the mind.
lines.transliteration: man antar bolai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.english: Without killing the mind, devotional worship is not performed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man maaray bin bhagat  na ho-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, one who knows the secret of this mystery,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jo jaanai bhay-o.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: man maDhusood an taribhavan day-o. ||3||28|| beholds within his own mind the Lord of the three worlds. ||3||28|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (329-3) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: The stars which are seen in the sky
lines.transliteration: o-ay jo deeseh ambar t aaray.
kin o-ay cheetay cheet anhaaray. ||1|| - who is the painter who painted them? ||1||

lines.english: Tell me, O Pandit, what is the sky attached to?
lines.transliteration: kaho ray pandit ambar kaa si-o laagaa.

lines.english: Very fortunate is the knower who knows this. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: boojhai boojh anhaar sabh aagaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਅੰਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਿਸਉ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: The sun and the moon give their light;
lines.transliteration: sooraj chand karahi ujee-aaraa.

lines.english: God's creative extension extends everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh meh pasri-aa barahm pasaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, he alone knows this,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jaanaigaa so-ay.

lines.english: ||3||29|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (329-6) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: hirdai raam mukh  raamai ho-ay. ||3||29|| whose heart is filled with the Lord, and whose mouth is also filled with the Lord.

lines.english: The Simritee is the daughter of the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: bayd kee put ree simrit  bhaa-ee.

lines.english: She has brought a chain and a rope. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaNkal jayvree lai hai aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: She has imprisoned the people in her own city.
lines.transliteration: aapan nagar aap tay baaDh i-aa.

lines.english: She has tightened the noose of emotional attachment and shot the arrow of death.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: moh kai faaDh kaal sar saaNDhi-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By cutting, she cannot be cut, and she cannot be broken.
lines.transliteration: katee na katai toot nah jaa-ee.

lines.english: She has become a serpent, and she is eating the world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saa saapan ho-ay jag ka-o khaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Before my very eyes, she has plundered the entire world.
lines.transliteration: ham daykh at jin sabh  jag looti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਫਾਿਧ  ਕਾਲ  ਸਰੁ ਸਿਧਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, I have escaped her. ||3||30|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (329-9) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer mai raam kahi chhooti-aa. ||3||30||

lines.english: I have grasped the reins and attached the bridle;
lines.transliteration: day-ay muhaar lagaam pahiraava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਟੀ ਨ ਕਟੈ ਤੂਿਟ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal ta jeen gagan d a-oraava-o. ||1|| abandoning everything, I now ride through the skies. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਸਾਪਿਨ  ਹੋਇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I made self-reflection my mount,
lines.transliteration: apnai beechaar asvaaree keejai.
sahj kai paavrhai pag Dh ar leejai. ||1|| rahaa-o. and in the stirrups of intuitive poise, I placed my feet. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਿਹ ਛੂਿਟਆ  ॥੩॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Come, and let me ride you to heaven.
lines.transliteration: chal ray baikunth t ujheh lay t aara-o.

lines.english: If you hold back, then I shall strike you with the whip of spiritual love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hicheh ta paraym kai chaabuk maara-o. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, those who remain detached from the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible arethe best riders. ||3||31|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (329-12) ga-orhee kabeer jee. Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer bh alay asvaaraa. bayd  katayb tay raheh niraaraa. ||3||31||

lines.english: That mouth, which used to eat the five delicacies
lines.transliteration: jih mukh paaNcha-o amrit  khaa-ay.

lines.english: - I have seen the flames being applied to that mouth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tih mukh  daykhat lookat laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਕੈ ਪਾਵੜੈ ਪਗੁ ਧਿਰ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, my King, please rid me of this one affliction:
lines.transliteration: ik dukh  raam raa-ay kaatahu mayraa.
agan dahai ar garabh  basayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. may I not be burned in fire, or cast into the womb again. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਚਲੁ ਰੇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਲੇ ਤਾਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: The body is destroyed by so many ways and means.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa bigootee baho biDh  bhaatee.

lines.english: Some burn it, and some bury it in the earth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ko jaaray ko gad lay maatee. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please reveal to me Your Lotus Feet;
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer har charan d ikhaavhu.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: paachhai t ay jam ki-o na path aavhu. ||3||32|| after that, go ahead and send me to my death. ||3||32|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (329-15) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: He Himself is the fire, and He Himself is the wind.
lines.transliteration: aapay paavak aapay pavnaa.

lines.english: When our Lord and Master wishes to burn someone, then who can save him? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaarai khasam t a raakh ai kavnaa. ||1||

lines.english: When I chant the Lord's Name, what does it matter if my body burns?
lines.transliteration: raam japat t an jar kee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਕਾਟਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: My consciousness remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam chit rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Who is burned, and who suffers loss?
lines.transliteration: kaa ko jarai kaahi ho-ay haan.

lines.english: The Lord plays, like the juggler with his ball. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nat vat khaylai saarigpaan. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, chant the two letters of the Lord's Name - Raa Maa.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer akhar d u-ay bh aakh.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋ ਜਾਰੇ ਕੋ ਗਿਡ  ਲੇ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If He is your Lord and Master, He will protect you. ||3||33|| gauVI kbIr jI dupdy ] (329-18) ga-orhee kabeer jee d upday. Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Du-Padas:
lines.transliteration: ho-igaa khasam t a lay-igaa raakh . ||3||33||

lines.english: I have not practiced Yoga, or focused my consciousness on meditation.
lines.transliteration: naa mai jog Dhi-aan chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without renunciation, I cannot escape Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin bairaag na chhootas maa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: How have I passed my life? pMnw 330
lines.transliteration: kaisay jeevan ho-ay hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have not taken the Lord's Name as my Support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab na ho-ay raam naam aDhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have searched the skies,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer khoja-o asmaan.

lines.english: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: raam samaan na daykh -a-u aan. ||2||34|| and have not seen another, equal to the Lord. ||2||34|| gauVI kbIr jI ] (330-2) ga-orhee kabeer jee.

lines.english: That head which was once embellished with the finest turban
lines.transliteration: jih sir rach rach baaDhat  paag.
so sir chunch savaareh kaag. ||1|| - upon that head, the crow now cleans his beak. ||1||

lines.english: What pride should we take in this body and wealth?
lines.transliteration: is tan Dh an ko ki-aa garab-ee-aa.

lines.english: Why not hold tight to the Lord's Name instead? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam kaahay na darirh -ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mind:
