lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu man mayray.

lines.english: Thirty-Five Steps Of Gauree Gwaarayree. || rwgu gauVI guAwryrI AstpdI kbIr jI kI (330-5) raag ga-orhee gu-aarayree asatpad ee kabeer jee kee Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Ashtapadees Of Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (330-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ihee havaal hohigay tayray. ||2||35|| this may be your fate as well! ||2||35|| gauVI guAwryrI ky pdy pYqIs ] (330-4) ga-orhee gu-aarayree kay pad ay pait ees.

lines.english: People beg for pleasure, but pain comes instead.
lines.transliteration: sukh maaNgat dukh aagai aavai.

lines.english: I would rather not beg for that pleasure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so sukh hamhu na maaNgi-aa bh aavai. ||1||

lines.english: People are involved in corruption, but still, they hope for pleasure.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa ajahu surat  sukh  aasaa.

lines.english: How will they find their home in the Sovereign Lord King? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaisay ho-ee hai raajaa raam nivaasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ  ਅਸਟਪਦੀ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Even Shiva and Brahma are afraid of this pleasure,
lines.transliteration: is sukh t ay siv barahm daraanaa.
so sukh hamhu saach kar jaanaa. ||2|| but I have judged that pleasure to be true. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਨ ਮਿਗਆ  ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even sages like Sanak and Naarad, and the thousand-headed serpent,
lines.transliteration: sankaadik naarad  mun saykh aa.
tin bh ee tan meh man nahee paykh aa. ||3|| did not see the mind within the body. ||3||

lines.english: Anyone can search for this mind, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o ko-ee khojahu bh aa-ee.

lines.english: When it escapes from the body, where does the mind go? ||4||
lines.transliteration: tan chh ootay man kahaa samaa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Jai Dayv and Naam Dayv
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jaiday-o naamaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kai paraym in hee hai jaanaaN. ||5|| came to know this, through loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||5||

lines.english: This mind does not come or go.
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o nahee aavan jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One whose doubt is dispelled, knows the Truth. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jis kaa bharam ga-i-aa t in saach pachh aanaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This mind has no form or outline.
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o roop na raykh-i-aa kaa-ee.

lines.english: By God's Command it was created; understanding God's Command, it will be absorbed into Him again. ||7||
lines.transliteration: hukmay ho-i-aa hukam boojh samaa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: Does anyone know the secret of this mind?
lines.transliteration: is man kaa ko-ee jaanai bhay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨ ॥੫॥
lines.english: This mind shall merge into the Lord, the Giver of peace and pleasure. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ih man leen bh a-ay sukh -day-o. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ  ਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: There is One Soul, and it pervades all bodies.
lines.transliteration: jee-o ayk ar sagal sareeraa.

lines.english: Kabeer dwells upon this Mind. ||9||1||36|| gauVI guAwryrI ] (330-13) ga-orhee gu-aarayree. Gauree Gwaarayree:
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o rav rahay kabeeraa. ||9||1||36||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are awake to the One Name, day and night
lines.transliteration: ahinis ayk naam jo jaagay.
kaytak siDh  bha-ay liv laagay. ||1|| rahaa-o. - many of them have become Siddhas - perfect spiritual beings - with theirconsciousness attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
lines.english: The seekers, the Siddhas and the silent sages have all lost the game.
lines.transliteration: saaDhak siDh  sagal mun haaray.

lines.english: The One Name is the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree, which saves them and carries them across. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk naam kalip tar t aaray. ||1||

lines.english: Those who are rejuvenated by the Lord, do not belong to any other.
lines.transliteration: jo har haray so hohi na aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, they realize the Name of the Lord. ||2||37|| gauVI BI soriT BI ] (330-15) ga-orhee bh ee sorath  bhee. Gauree And Also Sorat'h:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raam naam pachhaanaa. ||2||37||

lines.english: O shameless being, don't you feel ashamed?
lines.transliteration: ray jee-a nilaj laaj tohi naahee.

lines.english: You have forsaken the Lord - now where will you go? Unto whom will you turn?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har taj kat  kaahoo kay jaaNhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One whose Lord and Master is the highest and most exalted
lines.transliteration: jaa ko thaakur oochaa ho-ee.
so jan par ghar jaat  na sohee. ||1|| - it is not proper for him to go to the house of another. ||1||

lines.english: That Lord and Master is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: so saahib rahi-aa bharpoor.

lines.english: The Lord is always with us; He is never far away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sang naahee har d oor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਿਹ ਨ ਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Even Maya takes to the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: kavlaa charan saran hai jaa kay.

lines.english: Tell me, what is there which is not in His home? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho jan kaa naahee ghar t aa kay. ||3||

lines.english: Everyone speaks of Him; He is All-powerful.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko-oo kahai jaas kee baat aa.

lines.english: He is His Own Master; He is the Giver. ||4||
lines.transliteration: so samrath nij pat hai d aataa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤਿਜ ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, he alone is perfect in this world,
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer pooran jag so-ee.
jaa kay hirdai avar na ho-ee. ||5||38|| in whose heart there is none other than the Lord. ||5||38|| pMnw 331

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਿਪਤਾ  ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
lines.english: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?
lines.transliteration: ka-un ko poot pit aa ko kaa ko.

lines.english: Who dies? Who inflicts pain? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ka-un marai ko day-ay sant aapo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਠਗ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the thug, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.
lines.transliteration: har thag jag ka-o th ag-uree laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਿਬਓਗ  ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kay bi-og kaisay jee-a-o mayree maa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whose husband is he? Whose wife is she?
lines.transliteration: ka-un ko purakh ka-un kee naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨ  ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਕਉਨ  ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplate this reality within your body. ||2||
lines.transliteration: i-aa tat  layho sareer bichaaree. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and satisfied with the thug.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer thag si-o man maani-aa.

lines.english: The effects of the drug have vanished, since I recognized the thug. ||3||39||
lines.transliteration: ga-ee thag-uree th ag pehchaani-aa. ||3||39||

lines.english: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.
lines.transliteration: ab mo ka-o bha-ay raajaa raam sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have cut away birth and death, and attained the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kat param gat paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਕਿਟ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  dee-o ralaa-ay.

lines.english: He has rescued me from the five demons.
lines.transliteration: panch doot  tay lee-o chh adaa-ay.

lines.english: I chant with my tongue and meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam japa-o jap rasnaa.

lines.english: He has made me his own slave. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amol daas kar leeno apnaa. ||1||

lines.english: The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.
lines.transliteration: satgur keeno par-upkaar.

lines.english: He has lifted me up, out of the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: kaadh leen saagar sansaar.

lines.english: I have fallen in love with His Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laagee pareet.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gobind basai nit aa nit  cheet . ||2||

lines.english: The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa tapat  bujhi-aa angi-aar.

lines.english: My mind is contented with the Support of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: man santokh  naam aaDh aar.

lines.english: God, the Lord and Master, is totally permeating the water and the land.
lines.transliteration: jal thal poor rahay parabh su-aamee.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jat paykh a-o tat antarjaamee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.
lines.transliteration: apnee bhagat  aap hee d arirhaa-ee.

lines.english: By pre-ordained destiny, one meets Him, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhat  mili-aa mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: When He grants His Grace, one is perfectly fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jis kirpaa karay tis pooran saaj.

lines.english: Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ||4||40||
lines.transliteration: kabeer ko su-aamee gareeb nivaaj. ||4||40||

lines.english: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.
lines.transliteration: jal hai sootak thal hai soot ak soot ak opat  ho-ee.

lines.english: There is pollution in birth, and more pollution in death; all beings are ruined bypollution. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janmay sootak moo-ay fun soot ak soot ak paraj bigo-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਥਿਲ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਸੂਤਕ  ਓਪਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?
lines.transliteration: kaho ray pandee-aa ka-un paveetaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੇ  ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਮੂਏ ਫੁਿਨ ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਸੂਤਕ  ਪਰਜ  ਿਬਗੋਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aisaa gi-aan japahu mayray meetaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There is pollution in the eyes, and pollution in speech; there is pollution in the ears as well.
lines.transliteration: nainhu sootak bainhu soot ak soot ak sarvanee ho-ee.

lines.english: Standing up and sitting down, one is polluted; one's kitchen is polluted as well. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sootak laagai soot ak parai raso-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.
lines.transliteration: faasan kee biDh sabh  ko-oo jaanai chh ootan kee ik ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਸਰ੍ਵਨੀ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, those who meditate on the Lord within their hearts, are not polluted.||3||41|| gauVI ] (331-14) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raam ridai bichaarai soot ak tinai na ho-ee. ||3||41||

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ  ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Resolve this one conflict for me, O Lord,
lines.transliteration: jhagraa ayk nibayrahu raam.

lines.punjabi: ਫਾਸਨ  ਕੀ ਿਬਿਧ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ਛੂਟਨ  ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja-o tum apnay jan sou kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o. if you require any work from Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਿਬਚਾਰੈ  ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਿਤਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
lines.english: Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?
lines.transliteration: ih man badaa ke jaa sa-o man maani-aa.

lines.english: Is the Lord greater, or one who knows the Lord? ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam badaa kai raameh jaani-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Is Brahma greater, or the One who created Him?
lines.transliteration: barahmaa badaa ke jaas upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਅਪਨੇ  ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Are the Vedas greater, or the One from which they came? ||2||
lines.transliteration: bayd badaa ke jahaaN tay aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have become depressed;
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ha-o bha-i-aa ud aas.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ ਿਕ ਜਾ ਸਉ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Raag Gauree Chaytee:
lines.transliteration: tirath badaa ke har kaa d aas. ||3||42|| is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ||3||42|| rwgu gauVI cyqI ] (331-17) raag ga-orhee chayt ee.

lines.english: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.
lines.transliteration: daykh ou bh aa-ee ga-yaan kee aa-ee aaNDhee.

lines.english: It has totally blown away the thatched huts of doubt, and torn apart the bonds ofMaya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabhai udaanee bh aram kee taatee rahai na maa-i-aa baaNDhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of emotionalattachment have come crashing down.
lines.transliteration: duchit ay kee d u-ay thoon giraanee moh balaydaa tootaa.

lines.english: The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has beenbroken. ||1|| pMnw 332
lines.transliteration: tisnaa chh aan paree Dh ar oopar d urmat  bhaaNdaa footaa. ||1||

lines.english: Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.
lines.transliteration: aaNDhee paachh ay jo jal barkh ai tihi tayraa jan bh eenaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਆਂਧੀ  ਪਾਛੇ ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ  ਿਤਿਹ  ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, my mind became enlightened, when I saw the sun rise. ||2||43|| gauVI cyqI  (332-3) ga-orhee chayt ee Gauree Chaytee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (332-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer man bha-i-aa pargaasaa ud ai bhaan jab cheenaa. ||2||43||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਿਨ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ  ॥੨॥੪੩॥
lines.english: They do not listen to the Lord's Praises, and they do not sing the Lord's Glories,
lines.transliteration: har jas suneh na har gun gaavahi.
baatan hee asmaan giraaveh. ||1|| but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿਹ  ਨ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: What can anyone say to such people?
lines.transliteration: aisay logan si-o ki-aa kahee-ai.

lines.english: You should always be careful around those whom God has excluded from Hisdevotional worship. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo parabh kee-ay bh agat tay baahaj t in tay sad aa daraanay rahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They do not offer even a handful of water,
lines.transliteration: aap na deh churoo bh ar paanee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਿਤ  ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ  ਿਤਨ  ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ  ਰਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tih nind eh jih gangaa aanee. ||2|| while they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ||2||

lines.english: Sitting down or standing up, their ways are crooked and evil.
lines.transliteration: baithat  uthat kutilt aa chaaleh.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਦੇਿਹ ਚੁਰੂ ਭਿਰ ਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: They ruin themselves, and then they ruin others. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap ga-ay a-uran hoo ghaaleh. ||3||

lines.english: They know nothing except evil talk.
lines.transliteration: chhaad kuchrachaa aan na jaaneh.

lines.english: They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ||4||
lines.transliteration: barahmaa hoo ko kahi-o na maaneh. ||4||

lines.english: They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.
lines.transliteration: aap ga-ay a-uran hoo khoveh.

lines.english: They set their own temple on fire, and then they fall asleep within it. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aag lagaa-ay mandar mai soveh. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਹੂ ਕੋ ਕਿਹਓ  ਨ ਮਾਨਿਹ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.
lines.transliteration: avran hasat aap heh kaaNnay.

lines.english: Seeing them, Kabeer is embarrassed. ||6||1||44|| rwgu gauVI bYrwgix kbIr jI  (332-10) raag ga-orhee bairaagan  kabeer jee Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (332-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o d aykh kabeer lajaanay. ||6||1||44||

lines.english: He does not honor his ancestors while they are alive, but he holds feasts in their honor after they have died.
lines.transliteration: jeevat pit ar na maanai ko-oo moo-ayN siraaDh  karaahee.

lines.english: Tell me, how can his poor ancestors receive what the crows and the dogs have eatenup? ||1||
lines.transliteration: pitar bh ee bapuray kaho ki-o paavahi ka-oo-aa kookar kh aahee. ||1||

lines.english: If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o kusal bataavhu ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਬੈਰਾਗਿਣ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kusal kusal kartay jag binsai kusal bh ee kaisay ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਿਪਤਰ  ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਏਂ ਿਸਰਾਧ  ਕਰਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.
lines.transliteration: maatee kay kar dayvee d ayvaa t is aagai jee-o d ayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਤਰ  ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ  ਕਹੁ ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਕਊਆ  ਕੂਕਰ  ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aisay pitar t umaaray kahee-ahi aapan kahi-aa na layhee. ||2||

lines.english: You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, youshall suffer in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: sarjee-o kaateh nirjee-o poojeh ant kaal ka-o bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਸਲੁ  ਕੁਸਲੁ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਜਗੁ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਕੁਸਲੁ  ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifyingworld-ocean. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee bh ai doobay sansaaree. ||3||

lines.english: You worship gods and goddesses, but you do not know the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: dayvee d ayvaa poojeh doleh paarbarahm nahee jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਟੀ  ਕੇ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestors; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ||4||1||45|| gauVI ] (332-16) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: jI) kahat kabeer akul nahee chayt i-aa bikh i-aa si-o laptaanaa. ||4||1||45||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੇ ਿਪਤਰ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਆਪਨ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who remains dead while yet alive, will live even after death; thus he merges intothe Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai marai fun jeevai aisay sunn samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਜੀਉ  ਕਾਟਿਹ  ਿਨਰਜੀਉ  ਪੂਜਿਹ  ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ  ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Remaining pure in the midst of impurity, he will never again fall into the terrifyingworld-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anjan maahi niranjan rahee-ai bahurh na bh avjal paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ  ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam aisaa kheer bilo-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਿਹ  ਡੋਲਿਹ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way,drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmat manoo-aa asthir raakh o in biDh  amrit  pee-o-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਅਕੁਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਚੇਿਤਆ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਸਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
lines.english: The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and thestate of enlightenment has dawned.
lines.transliteration: gur kai baan bajar kal chh aydee pargati-aa pad  pargaasaa.

lines.english: In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sakat aDh ayr jayvrh ee bh aram chookaa nihchal siv gh ar baasaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਿਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਿਨ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Maya has drawn her bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O Siblings of Destiny. pMnw 333
lines.transliteration: tin bin baan ai Dhanakh  chadh aa-ee-ai ih jag bayDh i-aa bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ  ਧਨਖੁ  ਚਢਾਈਐ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The drowning person is blown around in the ten directions by the wind, but I hold tight to the string of the Lord's Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dah d is boodee pavan jh ulaavai dor rahee liv laa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਬੂਡੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਵੈ  ਡੋਿਰ ਰਹੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The disturbed mind has been absorbed in the Lord; duality and evil-mindedness haverun away.
lines.transliteration: unman manoo-aa sunn samaanaa dubiDh aa durmat  bhaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨਮਿਨ  ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਿਨ ਸਮਾਨਾ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਭਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have seen the One Lord, the Fearless One; I am attuned to the Nameof the Lord. ||4||2||46|| gauVI bYrwgix iqpdy ] (333-3) ga-orhee bairaagan  tipday. Gauree Bairaagan, Ti-Padas:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer anbha-o ik d aykhi-aa raam naam liv laagee. ||4||2||46||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਅਨਭਉ  ਇਕੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥੪੬॥
lines.english: I turned my breath inwards, and pierced through the six chakras of the body, and myawareness was centered on the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.
lines.transliteration: ultat pavan chakar kh at bhayday surat  sunn anraagee.

lines.english: Search for the One who does not come or go, who does not die and is not born, O renunciate. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavai na jaa-ay marai na jeevai taas kh oj bairaagee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਲਟਤ  ਪਵਨ  ਚਕਰ੍ ਖਟੁ ਭੇਦੇ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸੁੰਨ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: My mind has turned away from the world, and is absorbed in the Mind of God.
lines.transliteration: mayray man man hee ulat samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੈ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, my understanding has been changed; otherwise, I was totallyignorant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad akal bh a-ee avrai naat ar thaa baygaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਉਲਿਟ  ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: That which was near has become distant, and again, that which was distant is near,for those who realize the Lord as He is.
lines.transliteration: nivrai door d oor fun nivrai jin jaisaa kar maani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਅਕਿਲ  ਭਈ ਅਵਰੈ  ਨਾਤਰੁ ਥਾ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste.||2||
lines.transliteration: alutee kaa jaisay bh a-i-aa baraydaa jin pee-aa t in jaani-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Unto whom should I speak Your speech, O Lord; it is beyond the three qualities. Isthere anyone with such discerning wisdom?
lines.transliteration: tayree nirgun kathaa kaa-ay si-o kahee-ai aisaa ko-ay bibaykee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਵਰੈ  ਦੂਿਰ ਦੂਿਰ ਫੁਿਨ ਿਨਵਰੈ  ਿਜਿਨ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, as is the fuse which you apply, so is the flash you will see. ||3||3||47|| gauVI ] (333-8) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jin dee-aa paleet aa tin taisee jh al daykhee. ||3||3||47||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਉਤੀ  ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ  ਬਰੇਡਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੀਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There is no rainy season, ocean, sunshine or shade, no creation or destruction there.
lines.transliteration: tah paavas sinDh  Dhoop nahee chh ahee-aa t ah utpat parla-o naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਿਨਰਗੁਨ ਕਥਾ ਕਾਇ  ਿਸਉ ਕਹੀਐ  ਐਸਾ  ਕੋਇ ਿਬਬੇਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: No life or death, no pain or pleasure is felt there. There is only the Primal Trance of Samaadhi, and no duality. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jeevan mirat na d ukh sukh  bi-aapai sunn samaaDh  do-oo t ah naahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਦੀਆ  ਪਲੀਤਾ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਤੈਸੀ ਝਲ ਦੇਖੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੪੭॥
lines.english: The description of the state of intuitive poise is indescribable and sublime.
lines.transliteration: sahj kee akath kathaa hai niraaree.

lines.english: It is not measured, and it is not exhausted. It is neither light nor heavy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tul nahee chadh ai jaa-ay na mukaat ee halukee lagai na bh aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਪਾਵਸ  ਿਸੰਧੁ ਧੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਛਹੀਆ  ਤਹ ਉਤਪਿਤ  ਪਰਲਉ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Neither lower nor upper worlds are there; neither day nor night are there.
lines.transliteration: araDh uraDh  do-oo t ah naahee raat  dinas t ah naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਿਮਰਤੁ ਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no water, wind or fire; there, the True Guru is contained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal nahee pavan paavak fun naahee satgur t ahaa samaahee. ||2||

lines.english: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord dwells there within Himself; by Guru's Grace,He is found.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar rahai nirantar gur kirpaa t ay lahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਿਲ  ਨਹੀ ਚਢੈ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਮੁਕਾਤੀ  ਹਲੁਕੀ  ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Companyof the Holy. ||3||4||48|| gauVI ] (333-13) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer bal jaa-o gur apunay satsangat  mil rahee-ai. ||3||4||48||

lines.english: With both sin and virtue, the ox of the body is purchased; the air of the breath is thecapital which has appeared.
lines.transliteration: paap punn du-ay bail bisaahay pavan poojee pargaasi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਧ  ਉਰਧ  ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The bag on its back is filled with desire; this is how we purchase the herd. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa goon  bharee gh at bheetar in biDh  taaNd bisaahi-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ  ਫੁਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My Lord is such a wealthy merchant!
lines.transliteration: aisaa naa-ik raam hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He has made the whole world his peddler. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal sansaar kee-o banjaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀਐ  ॥੩॥੪॥੪੮॥
lines.english: Sexual desire and anger are the tax-collectors, and the waves of the mind are thehighway robbers.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh d u-ay bh a-ay jagaat ee man t arang batvaaraa.

lines.english: The five elements join together and divide up their loot. This is how our herd isdisposed of! ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch tat  mil d aan nibayreh taaNdaa ut ri-o paaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਬੈਲ ਿਬਸਾਹੇ  ਪਵਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: This is the state of affairs now!
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu ab aisee ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਗੂਿਣ  ਭਰੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਟਡ ਿਬਸਾਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Going uphill, the ox has grown weary; throwing off his load, he continues on hisjourney. ||3||5||49|| gauVI pMcpdw ] (333-17) ga-orhee panchpad aa. Gauree, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: ghaatee chadh at bail ik thaakaa chalo gon chh itkaa-ee. ||3||5||49||

lines.english: For a few short days, the soul-bride stays in her parent's house; then, she must go toher in-laws.
lines.transliteration: payvkarhai d in chaar hai saahurrh ai jaan aa.

lines.english: The blind, foolish and ignorant people do not know this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anDhaa lok na jaan -ee moorakh  ay-aan aa. ||1||

lines.english: Tell me, why is the bride wearing her ordinary clothes?
lines.transliteration: kaho dadee-aa baaDhai Dh an kh arhee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਏ ਜਗਾਤੀ  ਮਨ ਤਰੰਗ  ਬਟਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The guests have arrived at her home, and her Husband has come to take her away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paahoo ghar aa-ay muklaa-oo aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਦਾਨੁ ਿਨਬੇਰਿਹ  ਟਡਾ  ਉਤਿਰਓ  ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Who has lowered the rope of the breath down, into the well of the world which wesee?
lines.transliteration: oh je disai kh oohrh ee ka-un laaj vahaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਬ ਐਸੀ  ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The rope of the breath breaks away from the pitcher of the body, and the water-carrier gets up and departs. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laaj gharh ee si-o t oot parh ee uth  chalee panihaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘਾਟੀ  ਚਢਤ  ਬੈਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਕਾ  ਚਲੋ ਗੋਿਨ ਿਛਟਕਾਈ  ॥੩॥੫॥੪੯॥
lines.english: When the Lord and Master is kind and grants His Grace, then her affairs are all resolved. pMnw 334
lines.transliteration: saahib ho-ay da-i-aal kirpaa karay apunaa kaaraj savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, if she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa sohagan  jaanee-ai gur sabad  beechaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Bound by the actions she has committed, she wanders around - see this andunderstand.
lines.transliteration: kirat kee baaNDhee sabh  firai d aykhhu beechaaree.

lines.english: What can we say to her? What can the poor soul-bride do? ||4||
lines.transliteration: ays no ki-aa aakhee-ai ki-aa karay vichaaree. ||4||

lines.english: Disappointed and hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no support or encouragement in her consciousness.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee niraasee uth  chalee chit  banDh  na Dh eeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਈ ਿਨਰਾਸੀ  ਉਿਠ ਚਲੀ  ਿਚਤ  ਬੰਿਧ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: So remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet, and hurry to His Sanctuary, Kabeer!||5||6||50|| gauVI ] (334-3) ga-orhee. Gauree :
lines.transliteration: har kee charnee laag rahu bh aj saran  kabeeraa. ||5||6||50||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੁ ਭਜੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਕਬੀਰਾ  ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
lines.english: The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: jogee kaheh jog bhal meeth aa avar na d oojaa bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Those who shave their heads, and those who amputate their limbs, and those whoutter only a single word, all say that they have attained the spiritual perfection of theSiddhas. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rundit mundit  aykai sabd ee ay-ay kaheh siDh  paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਿਹ  ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, the blind ones are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: har bin bharam bh ulaanay anDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁੰਿਡਤ ਮੁੰਿਡਤ  ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ  ਏਇ ਕਹਿਹ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: And those, to whom I go to find release - they themselves are bound by all sorts ofchains. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa peh jaa-o aap chhutkaavan t ay baaDh ay baho fanDh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The soul is re-absorbed into that from which it originated, when one leaves this path of errors.
lines.transliteration: jah tay upjee t ahee samaanee ih biDh  bisree t ab hee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਪਿਹ ਜਾਉ  ਆਪੁ  ਛੁਟਕਾਵਿਨ  ਤੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The scholarly Pandits, the virtuous, the brave and the generous, all assert that theyalone are great. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pandit gun ee soor ham d aatay ayhi kaheh bad ham hee. ||2||

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Without understanding,what can anyone do?
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaa-ay so-ee boojh ai bin boojh ay ki-o rahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ  ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਬਸਰੀ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled, and in this way, the jewel isobtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai anDh ayraa chookai in biDh  maan ak lahee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ  ਏਿਹ ਕਹਿਹ  ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Give up the evil actions of your left and right hands, and grasp hold of the Feet of theLord.
lines.transliteration: taj baavay d aahnay bikaaraa har pad  darirh kar rahee-ai.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the mute has tasted the molasses, but what can he say about it if he isasked? ||4||7||51|| rwgu gauVI pUrbI kbIr jI ] (334-10) raag ga-orhee poorbee kabeer jee. Raag Gauree Poorbee, Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (334-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer gooNgai gurh kh aa-i-aa poochh ay tay ki-aa kahee-ai. ||4||7||51||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਚੂਕੈ ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Where something existed, now there is nothing. The five elements are no longer there.
lines.transliteration: jah kachh ahaa t ahaa kichh  naahee panch t at tah naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ  ਿਬਕਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਦੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਕਿਰ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breathsthrough these be counted now? ||1||
lines.transliteration: irhaa pingulaa sukh man band ay ay avgan kat  jaahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹੀਐ  ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
lines.english: The string has been broken, and the Sky of the Tenth Gate has been destroyed.Where has your speech gone?
lines.transliteration: taagaa t ootaa gagan binas ga-i-aa t ayraa bolat  kahaa samaa-ee.

lines.english: This cynicism afflicts me, night and day; who can explain this to me and help me understand? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kbIr jI) ayh sansaa mo ka-o an-din bi-aapai mo ka-o ko na kahai samjh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Where the world is - the body is not there; the mind is not there either.
lines.transliteration: jah barbhand pind t ah naahee rachanhaar t ah naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ  ਤਹਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Joiner is forever unattached; now, within whom is the soul said to be contained?||2||
lines.transliteration: jorhanhaaro sad aa ateetaa ih kahee-ai kis maahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇੜਾ  ਿਪੰਗੁਲਾ  ਸੁਖਮਨ  ਬੰਦੇ ਏ ਅਵਗਨ  ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: By joining the elements, people cannot join them, and by breaking, they cannot bebroken, until the body perishes.
lines.transliteration: jorhee jurh ai na t orhee tootai jab lag ho-ay binaasee.

lines.english: Of whom is the soul the master, and of whom is it the servant? Where, and to whomdoes it go? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaa ko thaakur kaa ko sayvak ko kaahoo kai jaasee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਗਾ  ਤੂਟਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਗਇਆ  ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ  ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have lovingly focused my attention on that place where the Lord dwells, day and night.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer liv laag rahee hai jahaa basay din raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਿਬਆਪੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Only He Himself truly knows the secrets of His mystery; He is eternal andindestructible. ||4||1||52|| gauVI ] (334-16) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: u-aa kaa maram ohee par jaanai oh ta-o sad aa abh inaasee. ||4||1||52||

lines.english: Let contemplation and intuitive meditation be your two ear-rings, and true wisdomyour patched overcoat.
lines.transliteration: surat simrit  du-ay kannee mund a parmit  baahar kh inthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the cave of silence, dwell in your Yogic posture; let the subjugation of desire beyour spiritual path. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sunn gufaa meh aasan baisan  kalap bibarjit  panthaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ  ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਕਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my King, I am a Yogi, a hermit, a renunciate.
lines.transliteration: mayray raajan mai bairaagee jogee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: I do not die or suffer pain or separation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: marat na sog bi-ogee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is the bag to carry myashes.
lines.transliteration: khand barahmand meh siny ee mayraa batoo-aa sabh  jag bh asmaaDh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਿਦਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Eliminating the three qualities and finding release from this world is my deep meditation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taarhee laagee t aripal paltee-ai chh ootai ho-ay pasaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਆ  ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
lines.english: My mind and breath are the two gourds of my fiddle, and the Lord of all the ages is its frame. pMnw 335
lines.transliteration: man pavan du-ay t oombaa karee hai jug jug saarad  saajee.

lines.english: The string has become steady, and it does not break; this guitar vibrates with the unstruck melody. ||3||
lines.transliteration: thir bha-ee t antee tootas naahee anhad  kinguree baajee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਰੁ ਭਈ ਤੰਤੀ  ਤੂਟਿਸ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਿਕੰਗੁਰੀ  ਬਾਜੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Hearing it, the mind is enraptured and becomes perfect; it does not waver, and it isnot affected by Maya.
lines.transliteration: sun man magan bha-ay hai pooray maa-i-aa dol na laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਮਨ ਮਗਨ  ਭਏ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਡੋਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, the bairaagee, the renunciate, who has played such a game, is notreincarnated again into the world of form and substance. ||4||2||53|| gauVI ] (335-3) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer taa ka-o punrap janam nahee kh ayl ga-i-o bairaagee. ||4||2||53||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨਹੀ ਖੇਿਲ ਗਇਓ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
lines.english: Nine yards, ten yards, and twenty-one yards - weave these into the full piece of cloth;
lines.transliteration: gaj nav gaj das gaj ikees puree-aa ayk t anaa-ee.
saath soot  nav kh and baht ar paat lago aDh ikaa-ee. ||1|| take the sixty threads and add nine joints to the seventy-two on the loom. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਜ ਨਵ ਗਜ ਦਸ ਗਜ ਇਕੀਸ  ਪੁਰੀਆ  ਏਕ ਤਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Life weaves itself into its patterns.
lines.transliteration: ga-ee bunaavan maaho.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਠ ਸੂਤ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਹਤਿਰ  ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗੋ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Leaving her home, the soul goes to the world of the weaver. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghar chh odi-ai jaa-ay julaaho. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This cloth cannot be measured in yards or weighed with weights; its food is two and ahalf measures.
lines.transliteration: gajee na mini-ai tol na t ulee-ai paachan sayr adh aa-ee.

lines.english: If it does not obtain food right away, it quarrels with the master of the house. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jou kar paachan bayg na paavai jhagar karai gh arhaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: How many days will you sit here, in opposition to your Lord and Master? When willthis opportunity come again?
lines.transliteration: din kee baith  khasam kee barkas ih baylaa kat  aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਜੀ  ਨ ਿਮਨੀਐ  ਤੋਿਲ  ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ  ਪਾਚਨੁ ਸੇਰ ਅਢਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Leaving his pots and pans, and the bobbins wet with his tears, the weaver souldeparts in jealous anger. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhootay koonday bh eegai puree-aa chali-o julaaho reesaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੌ ਕਿਰ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਬੇਿਗ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਝਗਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਘਰਹਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The wind-pipe is empty now; the thread of the breath does not come out any longer.The thread is tangled; it has run out.
lines.transliteration: chhochh ee nalee t ant nahee niksai nat ar rahee urjh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਠ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਸ  ਇਹ ਬੇਲਾ  ਕਤ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: So renounce the world of form and substance while you remain here, O poor soul;says Kabeer: you must understand this! ||4||3||54|| gauVI ] (335-8) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: chhod pasaar eehaa rahu bapuree kaho kabeer samjh aa-ee. ||4||3||54||

lines.punjabi: ਛੂਟੇ ਕੂੰਡੇ ਭੀਗੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ  ਚਿਲਓ  ਜੁਲਾਹੋ  ਰੀਸਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: When one light merges into another, what becomes of it then?
lines.transliteration: ayk jot aykaa milee kimbaa ho-ay maho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਛੀ  ਨਲੀ  ਤੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਨਤਰ  ਰਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That person, within whose heart the Lord's Name does not well up - may that person burst and die! ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit ghat naam na oopjai foot marai jan so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਈਹਾ  ਰਹੁ ਬਪੁਰੀ  ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਮਝਾਈ  ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
lines.english: O my dark and beautiful Lord,
lines.transliteration: saaval sundar raam-ee-aa.
mayraa man laagaa tohi. ||1|| rahaa-o. my mind is attached to You. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Meeting with the Holy, the perfection of the Siddhas is obtained. What good is Yogaor indulgence in pleasures?
lines.transliteration: saaDh milai siDh  paa-ee-ai ke ayhu jog ke bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਘਿਟ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਫੂਿਟ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the two meet together, the business is conducted, and the link with the Lord'sName is established. ||2||
lines.transliteration: duhu mil kaaraj oopjai raam naam sanjog. ||2||

lines.english: People believe that this is just a song, but it is a meditation on God.
lines.transliteration: log jaanai ih geet hai ih t a-o barahm beechaar.

lines.english: It is like the instructions given to the dying man at Benares. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o kaasee updays ho-ay maanas mart ee baar. ||3||

lines.english: Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with conscious awareness
lines.transliteration: ko-ee gaavai ko sunai har naamaa chit  laa-ay.

lines.english: ||4||1||4||55|| gauVI ] (335-12) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer sansaa nahee ant param gat  paa-ay. ||4||1||4||55|| - says Kabeer, without a doubt, in the end, he obtains the highest status.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਹੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who try to do things by their own efforts are drowned in the terrifying world-ocean; they cannot cross over.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jat an karat  tay doobay bh av saagar nahee t aari-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ  ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who practice religious rituals and strict self-discipline - their egotistical prideshall consume their minds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam kart ay baho sanjam ahaN-buDh  man jaari-o ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਕਾਸੀ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਹੋਇ ਮਾਨਸ  ਮਰਤੀ  ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your Lord and Master has given you the breath of life and food to sustain you; Oh,why have you forgotten Him?
lines.transliteration: saas garaas ko daat o thaakur so ki-o manhu bisaari-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ  ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Human birth is a priceless jewel, which has been squandered in exchange for aworthless shell. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: heeraa laal amol janam hai ka-udee badlai haari-o ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥੫੫॥
lines.english: The thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt afflict you; you do not contemplate theLord in your heart.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa t arikhaa bh ookh bharam laagee hird ai naahi beechaari-o ray.

lines.english: Intoxicated with pride, you cheat yourself; you have not enshrined the Word of theGuru's Shabad within your mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: unmat maan hiri-o man maahee gur kaa sabad  na Dh aari-o ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਜਤਨ  ਕਰਤ  ਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਿਰਓ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who are deluded by sensual pleasures, who are tempted by sexual delights and enjoy wine are corrupt.
lines.transliteration: su-aad lubh at indree ras parayri-o mad  ras lait  bikaari-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮ  ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਮਨੁ ਜਾਿਰਓ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: But those who, through destiny and good karma, join the Society of the Saints, floatover the ocean, like iron attached to wood. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam bhaag sant an sangaanay kaasat loh uDh aari-o ray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸ ਗਰ੍ਾਸ  ਕੋ ਦਾਤੋ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਬਸਾਿਰਓ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  jon janam bh aram thaakay ab d ukh kar ham haari-o ray. I have wandered in doubt and confusion, through birth and reincarnation; now, I amso tired. I am suffering in pain and wasting away.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰਾ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਅਮੋਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ  ਬਦਲੈ  ਹਾਿਰਓ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, meeting with the Guru, I have obtained supreme joy; my love and devotion have saved me. ||4||1||5||56|| gauVI ] (335-19) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: jI) kahi kabeer gur milat mahaa ras paraym bh agat nistaari-o ray. ||4||1||5||56||

lines.english: Like the straw figure of a female elephant, fashioned to trap the bull elephant, O crazymind, the Lord of the Universe has staged the drama of this world.
lines.transliteration: kaalboot kee hast anee man ba-uraa ray chalat  rachi-o jagd ees.

lines.english: Attracted by the lure of sexual desire, the elephant is captured, O crazy mind, andnow the halter is placed around its neck. ||1|| pMnw 336
lines.transliteration: kaam su-aa-ay gaj bas paray man ba-uraa ray ankas sahi-o sees. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ਅੰਕਸੁ  ਸਿਹਓ  ਸੀਸ ॥੧॥
lines.english: So escape from corruption and immerse yourself in the Lord; take this advice, O crazy mind.
lines.transliteration: bikhai baach har raach samajh  man ba-uraa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਚੁ ਸਮਝੁ  ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: You have not meditated fearlessly on the Lord, O crazy mind; you have not embarkedupon the Lord's Boat. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nirbhai ho-ay na har bh ajay man ba-uraa ray gahi-o na raam jahaaj. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਿਰ ਭਜੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ਗਿਹਓ  ਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The monkey stretches out its hand, O crazy mind, and takes a handful of corn;
lines.transliteration: markat mustee anaaj kee man ba-uraa ray leenee haath pasaar.
chhootan ko sahsaa pari-aa man ba-uraa ray naachi-o gh ar ghar baar. ||2|| now unable to escape, O crazy mind, it is made to dance door to door. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਕਟ  ਮੁਸਟੀ  ਅਨਾਜ  ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Like the parrot caught in the trap, O crazy mind, you trapped by the affairs of Maya.
lines.transliteration: ji-o nalnee soo-ataa gahi-o man ba-uraa ray maa-yaa ih bi-uhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਛੂਟਨ  ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ  ਪਿਰਆ  ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ਨਾਿਚਓ  ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Like the weak dye of the safflower, O crazy mind, so is the expanse of this world ofform and substance. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa rang kasumbh kaa man ba-uraa ray t i-o pasri-o paasaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਨਲਨੀ  ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਿਹਓ  ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ਮਾਯਾ  ਇਹੁ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: There are so many holy shrines in which to bathe, O crazy mind, and so many gods toworship.
lines.transliteration: naavan ka-o tirath gh anay man ba-uraa ray poojan ka-o baho d ayv.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਕਾ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ਿਤਉ  ਪਸਿਰਓ  ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, you shall not be saved like this, O crazy mind; only by serving the Lordwill you find release. ||4||1||6||57|| gauVI ] (336-6) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer chhootan nahee man ba-uraa ray chh ootan har kee sayv. ||4||1||6||57||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵਨ  ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ  ਘਨੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰੇ ਪੂਜਨ  ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.english: Fire does not burn it, and the wind does not blow it away; thieves cannot get near it.
lines.transliteration: agan na dahai pavan nahee magnai t askar nayr na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
lines.english: Accumulate the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth does not go anywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan kar sanch-unee so Dh an kat  hee na jaavai. ||1||

lines.english: My wealth is God, the Lord of Wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth: this is called the most excellent wealth.
lines.transliteration: hamraa Dhan maaDh a-o gobind  DharneeDhar ihai saar Dh an kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਦਹੈ ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ  ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨੇਿਰ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The peace which is obtained by serving God, the Lord of the Universe - that peacecannot be found in kingdoms or power. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo sukh parabh  gobind  kee sayvaa so sukh  raaj na lahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ  ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Shiva and Sanak, in their search for this wealth, became Udaasees, and renounced theworld.
lines.transliteration: is Dhan kaaran  siv sankaad ik khojat bha-ay ud aasee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਧਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is filled with the Lord of liberation, and whose tongue chants theName of the Lord, shall not be caught by the noose of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man mukand jihbaa naaraa-in parai na jam kee faasee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਿਜ  ਨ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My own wealth is the spiritual wisdom and devotion given by the Guru; my mind isheld steady in perfect neutral balance.
lines.transliteration: nij Dhan gi-aan bh agat gur d eenee t aas sumat  man laagaa.

lines.english: It is like water for the burning soul, like an anchoring support for the wandering mind; the bondage of doubt and fear is dispelled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jalat ambh  thambh  man Dh aavat  bharam banDh an bh a-o bh aagaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਿਸਵ ਸਨਕਾਿਦਕ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer: O you who are intoxicated with sexual desire, reflect upon this in yourheart, and see.
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer madan kay maat ay hird ai daykh beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ  ਿਜਹਬਾ  ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Within your home there are hundreds of thousands, millions of horses and elephants;but within my home is the One Lord. ||4||1||7||58|| gauVI ] (336-12) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: tum gh ar laakh  kot asav hast ee ham gh ar ayk muraaree. ||4||1||7||58||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਧਨੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ  ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Like the monkey with a handful of grain, who will not let go because of greed
lines.transliteration: ji-o kap kay kar musat chanan kee lubaDh na t i-aag da-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਤ  ਅੰਭ ਥੰਿਭ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਭਰਮ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo karam kee-ay laalach si-o tay fir gareh pari-o. ||1|| - just so, all the deeds committed in greed ultimately become a noose around one'sneck. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਮਦਨ  ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship, human life passes away in vain.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bin birthay janam ga-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਘਿਰ  ਲਾਖ  ਕੋਿਟ ਅਸ ਹਸਤੀ  ਹਮ ਘਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
lines.english: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, without vibrating and meditatingon the Lord God, one does not abide in Truth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  bhagvaan bh ajan bin kahee na sach rahi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Like the flower which blossoms in the wilderness with no one to enjoy its fragrance,
lines.transliteration: ji-o udi-aan kusam parfulit  kineh na gh araa-o la-i-o.

lines.english: Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taisay bh armat  anayk jon meh fir fir kaal ha-i-o. ||2|| so do people wander in reincarnation; over and over again, they are destroyed by

lines.english: This wealth, youth, children and spouse which the Lord has given you - this is all justa passing show.
lines.transliteration: i-aa Dhan joban ar sut  daaraa paykh an ka-o jo da-i-o.

lines.english: Those who are caught and entangled in these are carried away by sensual desire.||3||
lines.transliteration: tin hee maahi atak jo urjh ay ind ree parayr la-i-o. ||3||

lines.english: Age is the fire, and the body is the house of straw; on all four sides, this play is beingplayed out.
lines.transliteration: a-oDh anal t an tin ko mand ar chahu d is thaat th a-i-o.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, to cross over the terriffying world-ocean, I have taken to the Shelter ofthe True Guru. ||4||1||8||59|| gauVI ] (336-18) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer bhai saagar t aran ka-o mai sat gur ot la-i-o. ||4||1||8||59||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਕੁਸਮ  ਪਰਫੁਿਲਤ  ਿਕਨਿਹ  ਨ ਘਰ੍ਾਉ  ਲਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The water of the sperm is cloudy, and the egg of the ovary is crimson.
lines.transliteration: paanee mailaa maatee goree.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਸੇ ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: From this clay, the puppet is fashioned. ||1||
lines.transliteration: is maatee kee putree joree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਆ  ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ  ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ  ਪੇਖਨ  ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: I am nothing, and nothing is mine.
lines.transliteration: mai naahee kachh aahi na moraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਅਟਿਕ  ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ  ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਰ ਲਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: This body, wealth, and all delicacies are Yo urs, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an sabh  ras gobind  toraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਧ  ਅਨਲ  ਤਨੁ ਿਤਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਿਦਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Into this clay, the breath is infused. pMnw 337
lines.transliteration: is maatee meh pavan samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Your Power, You have set this false contrivance in motion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa parpanch jor chalaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Some collect hundreds of thousands of dollars,
lines.transliteration: kinhoo laakh paaNch kee joree.
ant kee baar gagree-aa foree. ||3|| but in the end, the pitcher of the body bursts. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, that single foundation which you have laid
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ik neev usaaree.

lines.english: Gauree:
lines.transliteration: khin meh binas jaa-ay ahaNkaaree. ||4||1||9||60|| will be destroyed in an instant - you are so egotistical. ||4||1||9||60|| gauVI ] (337-3) ga-orhee.

lines.english: Just as Dhroo and Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, so should you meditate on theLord, O my soul. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam japa-o jee-a aisay aisay. Dharoo par-hilaad  japi-o har jaisay. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, I have placed my faith in You;
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal bh arosay t ayray.
sabh parvaar charh aa-i-aa bayrh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. along with all my family, I have come aboard Your boat. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: When it is pleasing to Him, then He inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavai t aa hukam manaavai.

lines.english: He causes this boat to cross over. ||2||
lines.transliteration: is bayrhay ka-o paar lagh aavai. ||2||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, such understanding is infused into me;
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad aisee buDh  samaanee.
chook ga-ee fir aavan jaanee. ||3|| my comings and goings in reincarnation have ended. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer bhaj saarigpaanee.

lines.english: In this world, in the world beyond and everywhere, He alone is the Giver.||4||2||10||61|| gauVI 9 ] (337-6) ga-orhee 9. Gauree 9:
lines.transliteration: urvaar paar sabh ayko d aanee. ||4||2||10||61||

lines.english: He leaves the womb, and comes into the world;
lines.transliteration: jon chhaad ja-o jag meh aa-i-o.
laagat pavan kh asam bisraa-i-o. ||1|| as soon as the air touches him, he forgets his Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.english: O my soul, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-araa har kay gunaa gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You were upside-down, living in the womb; you generated the intense meditative heatof 'tapas'.
lines.transliteration: garabh jon meh uraDh  tap kart aa.

lines.english: Then, you escaped the fire of the belly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ta-o jath ar agan meh raht aa. ||2||

lines.english: After wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, you came.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jon bh aram aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਨ ਛਾਿਡ  ਜਉ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: If you stumble and fall now, you shall find no home or place of rest. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ab kay chhutkay th a-ur na th aa-i-o. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer bhaj saarigpaanee.

lines.english: He is not seen to be coming or going; He is the Knower of all. ||4||1||11||62|| gauVI pUrbI ] (337-10) ga-orhee poorbee. Gauree Poorbee:
lines.transliteration: aavat d eesai jaat  na jaanee. ||4||1||11||62||

lines.english: Don't wish for a home in heaven, and don't be afraid to live in hell.
lines.transliteration: surag baas na baachhee-ai daree-ai na narak nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਮਿਹ ਉਰਧ  ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever will be will be, so don't get your hopes up in your mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: honaa hai so ho-ee hai maneh na keejai aas. ||1||

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: rama-ee-aa gun gaa-ee-ai.
jaa tay paa-ee-ai param niDh aan. ||1|| rahaa-o. from whom the most excellent treasure is obtained. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕੇ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਠਾਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What good is chanting, penance or self-mortification? What good is fasting orcleansing baths,
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jap ki-aa tap sanjamo ki-aa barat  ki-aa isnaan.
jab lag jugat na jaanee-ai bh aa-o bh agat bhagvaan. ||2|| unless you know the way to worship the Lord God with loving devotion? ||2||

lines.english: Don't feel so delighted at the sight of wealth, and don't weep at the sight of sufferingand adversity.
lines.transliteration: sampai daykh  na harkh ee-ai bipat  daykh na ro-ay.

lines.english: As is wealth, so is adversity; whatever the Lord proposes, comes to pass. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o sampai ti-o bipat  hai biDh  nay rachi-aa so ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਗ  ਬਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਾਛੀਐ  ਡਰੀਐ  ਨ ਨਰਿਕ  ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, now I know that the Lord dwells within the hearts of His Saints;
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ab jaani-aa santan rid ai majh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਨਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਨਿਹ  ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sayvak so sayvaa bhalay jih gh at basai muraar. ||4||1||12||63|| that servant performs the best service, whose heart is filled with the Lord.

lines.english: O my mind, even if you carry someone's burden, they don't belong to you.
lines.transliteration: ray man tayro ko-ay nahee kh inch lay-ay jin bh aar.

lines.english: This world is like the perch of the bird on the tree. ||1||
lines.transliteration: birakh basayro pankh  ko taiso ih sansaar. ||1||

lines.english: I drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam ras pee-aa ray.

lines.english: With the taste of this essence, I have forgotten all other tastes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jih ras bisar ga-ay ras a-or. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਗਵਾਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Why should we weep at the death of others, when we ourselves are not permanent?
lines.transliteration: a-or mu-ay ki-aa ro-ee-ai ja-o aapaa thir na rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਪੈ ਦੇਿਖ ਨ ਹਰਖੀਐ  ਿਬਪਿਤ  ਦੇਿਖ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Whoever is born shall pass away; why should we cry out in grief? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo upjai so binas hai dukh  kar rovai balaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਸੰਪੈ ਿਤਉ  ਿਬਪਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਬਧ ਨੇ ਰਿਚਆ  ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: We are re-absorbed into the One from whom we came; drink in the Lord's essence, and remain attached to Him.
lines.transliteration: jah kee upjee tah rachee peevat  mard an laag.

lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer chit chayt i-aa raam simar bairaag. ||3||2||13||64||

lines.transliteration: panth nihaarai kaamnee lochan bharee lay usaasaa.

lines.transliteration: ur na bheejai pag naa kh isai har d arsan kee aasaa. ||1||

lines.transliteration: udahu na kaagaa kaaray.
bayg mileejai apunay raam pi-aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o. so that I may quickly meet my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, to obtain the status of eternal life, worship the Lord with devotion.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer jeevan pad kaaran har kee bh agat kareejai.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is my only Support; with my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name. ||2||1||14||65|| rwgu gauVI 11 ] (338-3) raag ga-orhee 11. Raag Gauree 11:
lines.transliteration: ayk aaDhaar naam naaraa-in rasnaa raam raveejai. ||2||1||14||65||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਦ ਕਾਰਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: All around, there are thick bushes of sweet basil, and there in the midst of the forest,the Lord is singing with joy.
lines.transliteration: aas paas ghan t ursee kaa birvaa maajh  banaa ras gaa-ooN ray.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥

lines.transliteration: u-aa kaa saroop daykh  mohee gu-aaran mo ka-o chh od na aa-o na jaahoo ray. ||1||

lines.english: My mind is attached to Your Feet, O Archer of the Universe;
lines.transliteration: tohi charan man laago saaringDh ar.

lines.transliteration: so milai jo badbhaago. ||1|| rahaa-o. he alone meets You, who is blessed by great good fortune. ||1||Pause||
