lines.transliteration: bindraaban man haran manohar krisan charaavat  gaa-oo ray.

lines.english: You are my Lord Master, the Archer of the Universe; my name is Kabeer.||2||2||15||66|| gauVI pUrbI 12 ] (338-7) ga-orhee poorbee 12. Gauree Poorbee 12:
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa thaakur t uhee saaringDh ar mohi kabeeraa naa-oo ray. ||2||2||15||66||

lines.english: Many people wear various robes, but what is the use of living in the forest?
lines.transliteration: bipal bastar kayt ay hai pahiray ki-aa ban maDh ay baasaa.

lines.english: What good does it do if a man burns incense before his gods? What good does it do to dip one's body in water? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahaa bha-i-aa nar d ayvaa Dh okhay ki-aa jal bori-o gi-aat aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬੰਦਰ੍ਾਬਨ  ਮਨ ਹਰਨ  ਮਨੋਹਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨ  ਚਰਾਵਤ  ਗਾਊ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O soul, I know that I will have to depart.
lines.transliteration: jee-aray jaahigaa mai jaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਿਰੰਗਧਰ  ਮੋਿਹ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
lines.english: You ignorant idiot: understand the Imperishable Lord.
lines.transliteration: abigat samajh  i-aanaa.

lines.english: Whatever you see, you will not see that again, but still, you cling to Maya.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jat jat  daykh-a-u bahur na paykh a-o sang maa-i-aa laptaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਪਲ  ਬਸਤਰ੍  ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਿਹਰੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The spiritual teachers, meditators and the great preachers are all engrossed in theseworldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee Dhi-aanee baho upd aysee ih jag saglo Dh anDhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ  ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ ਿਕਆ  ਜਿਲ  ਬੋਿਰਓ  ਿਗਆਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the One Lord, this world is blinded by Maya. ||2||1||16||67|| gauVI 12 ] (338-11) ga-orhee 12. Gauree 12:
lines.transliteration: kbIr jI) kahi kabeer ik raam naam bin i-aa jag maa-i-aa anDhaa. ||2||1||16||67||

lines.english: O people, O victims of this Maya, abandon your doubts and dance out in the open.
lines.transliteration: man ray chhaadahu bh aram pargat ho-ay naachahu i-aa maa-i-aa kay daaNday.

lines.english: What sort of a hero is one who is afraid to face the battle? What sort of satee is she who, when her time comes, starts collecting her pots and pans? ||1||
lines.transliteration: soor ke sanmukh ran t ay darpai sat ee ke saaNchai bh aaNday. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਲਪਟਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Stop your wavering, O crazy people!
lines.transliteration: dagmag chhaad ray man ba-uraa.

lines.english: Now that you have taken up the challenge of death, let yourself burn and die, andattain perfection. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ab ta-o jaray maray siDh  paa-ee-ai leeno haath sanDh -uraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀ ਿਧਆਨੀ  ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ  ਧੰਧਾ ॥
lines.english: The world is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya; in this way it is plunderedand ruined.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh maa-i-aa kay leenay i-aa biDh  jagat  bigoot aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਇਆ  ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, do not forsake the Lord, your Sovereign King, the Highest of the High.||2||2||17||68|| gauVI 13 ] (338-14) ga-orhee 13. Gauree 13:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raajaa raam na chhoda-o sagal ooch t ay oochaa. ||2||2||17||68||

lines.english: Your Command is upon my head, and I no longer question it.
lines.transliteration: furmaan tayraa sirai oopar fir na karat  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਡਡੇ ॥
lines.english: You are the river, and You are the boatman; salvation comes from You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuhee d aree-aa t uhee karee-aa t ujhai tay nist aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰੁ ਿਕ ਸਨਮੁਖ  ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ  ਸਤੀ ਿਕ ਸਚੈ ਭਡੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O human being, embrace the Lord's meditation,
lines.transliteration: banday band agee ikt ee-aar.
saahib ros Dhara-o ke pi-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o. whether your Lord and Master is angry with you or in love with you. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ ਿਸਿਧ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਲੀਨੋ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਸੰਧਉਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is my Support, like the flower blossoming in the water.
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa aaDh aar mayraa ji-o fool ja-ee hai naar.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I am the slave of Your home; I live or die as You will. ||2||18||69|| gauVI ] (338-17) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer gulaam ghar kaa jee-aa-ay bh aavai maar. ||2||18||69||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ  ਇਆ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਬਗੂਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, Krishna's father Nand was totally exhausted.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jee-a jon meh bh armat  nand  baho thaako ray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ  ਸਗਲ  ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
lines.english: Because of his devotion, Krishna was incarnated in his home; how great was the goodfortune of this poor man! ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  hayt avtaar lee-o hai bh aag bado bapuraa ko ray. ||1||

lines.english: You say that Krishna was Nand's son, but whose son was Nand himself?
lines.transliteration: tumH jo kahat  ha-o nand  ko nand an nand  so nand an kaa ko ray.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਸਰੈ ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਨ ਕਰਤ  ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Dharan akaas d aso d is naahee t ab ih nand  kahaa tho ray. ||1|| rahaa-o. When there was no earth or ether or the ten directions, where was this Nand then?||1||Pause|| pMnw 339
He does not fall into misfortune, and He does not take birth; His Name is theImmaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: sankat nahee parai jon nahee aavai naam niranjan jaa ko ray.

lines.english: Kabeer's Lord is such a Lord and Master, who has no mother or father. ||2||19||70|| gauVI ] (339-2) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kabeer ko su-aamee aiso thaakur jaa kai maa-ee na baapo ray. ||2||19||70||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਕਿਟ  ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Slander me, slander me - go ahead, people, and slander me.
lines.transliteration: ninda-o nind a-o mo ka-o log nind a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਈ  ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
lines.english: Slander is pleasing to the Lord's humble servant.
lines.transliteration: nindaa jan ka-o kh aree pi-aaree.

lines.english: Slander is my father, slander is my mother. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nindaa baap nind aa meht aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If I am slandered, I go to heaven;
lines.transliteration: nindaa ho-ay t a baikunth  jaa-ee-ai.
naam padaarath maneh basaa-ee-ai. the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within my mind.

lines.english: If my heart is pure, and I am slandered,
lines.transliteration: ridai suDh  ja-o nind aa ho-ay.
hamray kapray nindak Dh o-ay. ||1|| then the slanderer washes my clothes. ||1||

lines.english: One who slanders me is my friend;
lines.transliteration: nindaa karai so hamraa meet .
nindak maahi hamaaraa cheet . the slanderer is in my thoughts.

lines.english: The slanderer is the one who prevents me from being slandered.
lines.transliteration: nindak so jo nind aa horai.

lines.english: The slanderer wishes me long life. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hamraa jeevan nindak lorai. ||2||

lines.english: I have love and affection for the slanderer.
lines.transliteration: nindaa hamree paraym pi-aar.

lines.english: Slander is my salvation.
lines.transliteration: nindaa hamraa karai uDh aar.

lines.english: Slander is the best thing for servant Kabeer.
lines.transliteration: jan kabeer ka-o nindaa saar.

lines.english: The slanderer is drowned, while I am carried across. ||3||20||71||
lines.transliteration: nindak doobaa ham ut ray paar. ||3||20||71||

lines.english: O my Sovereign Lord King, You are Fearless; You are the Carrier to carry us across, O my Lord King. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam tooN aisaa nirbh a-o taran t aaran raam raa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When I was, then You were not; now that You are, I am not.
lines.transliteration: jab ham hotay t ab tum naahee ab t um hahu ham naahee.

lines.english: Now, You and I have become one; seeing this, my mind is content. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ab ham tum ayk bh a-ay heh aykai d aykhat man pat ee-aahee. ||1||

lines.english: When there was wisdom, how could there be strength? Now that there is wisdom,strength cannot prevail.
lines.transliteration: jab buDh hot ee tab bal kaisaa ab buDh  bal na kh ataa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਤਰਨ  ਤਾਰਨ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Lord has taken away my wisdom, and I have attained spiritualperfection. ||2||21||72|| gauVI ] (339-10) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer buDh har la-ee mayree buDh  badlee siDh  paa-ee. ||2||21||72||

lines.english: He fashioned the body chamber with six rings, and placed within it the incomparablething.
lines.transliteration: khat naym kar koth -rhee baaNDhee basat  anoop beech paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: He made the breath of life the watchman, with lock and key to protect it; the Creatordid this in no time at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kunjee kulaf paraan kar raakhay kart ay baar na laa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਿਹ ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ  ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Keep your mind awake and aware now, O Sibling of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: ab man jaagat rahu ray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: You were careless, and you have wasted your life; your home is being plundered by thieves. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gaafal ho-ay kai janam gavaa-i-o chor musai ghar jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਬੁਿਧ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਅਬ ਬੁਿਧ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The five senses stand as guards at the gate, but now can they be trusted?
lines.transliteration: panch pahroo-aa dar meh raht ay tin kaa nahee pat ee-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਬੁਿਧ ਹਿਰ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਿਧ ਬਦਲੀ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
lines.english: When you are conscious in your consciousness, you shall be enlightened andilluminated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chayt suchayt  chit ho-ay rahu t a-o lai pargaas ujaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Seeing the nine openings of the body, the soul-bride is led astray; she does not obtainthat incomparable thing.
lines.transliteration: na-o ghar d aykh jo kaaman bh oolee basat  anoop na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਿਰ ਕੋਠੜੀ  ਬਧੀ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, the nine openings of the body are being plundered; rise up to the TenthGate, and discover the true essence. ||3||22||73|| gauVI ] (339-14) ga-orhee. Gauree:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer navai gh ar moosay d asvaiN tat samaa-ee. ||3||22||73||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਤੇ  ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mother, I do not know any other, except Him.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mohi avar na jaani-o aanaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ  ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My breath of life resides in Him, whose praises are sung by Shiva and Sanak and somany others. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: siv sankaad jaas gun gaavahi t aas baseh moray paraanaanaaN. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਫਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਓ  ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My heart is illuminated by spiritual wisdom; meeting the Guru, I meditate in the Sky of the Tenth Gate.
lines.transliteration: hirday pargaas gi-aan gur gammit  gagan mandal meh Dh i-aanaanaaN.

lines.english: The diseases of corruption, fear and bondage have run away; my mind has come toknow peace in its own true home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bikhai rog bh ai banDh an bh aagay man nij gh ar sukh  jaanaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ  ਦਰ ਮਿਹ ਰਹਤੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with a balanced single-mindedness, I know and obey God; nothing else entersmy mind.
lines.transliteration: ayk sumat rat  jaan maan parabh  doosar maneh na aanaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਸੁਚੇਤ  ਿਚਤ  ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਉਜਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind has become fragrant with the scent of sandalwood; I have renouncedegotistical selfishness and conceit. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chandan baas bh a-ay man baasan t i-aag gh ati-o abh imaanaanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਿਖ ਜੁ ਕਾਮਿਨ  ਭੂਲੀ ਬਸਤੁ  ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being, who sings and meditates on the Praises of his Lord and Master, isthe dwelling-place of God.
lines.transliteration: jo jan gaa-ay Dhi-aa-ay jas th aakur t aas parabh oo hai thaanaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ ਦਸਵੈਂ  ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
lines.english: He is blessed with great good fortune; the Lord abides in his mind. Good karmaradiates from his forehead. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tih bad bh aag basi-o man jaa kai karam parDh aan mathaanaanaa. ||3||

lines.english: I have broken the bonds of Maya; the intuitive peace and poise of Shiva has dawned within me, and I am merged in oneness with the One. pMnw 340
lines.transliteration: kaat sakat siv sahj pargaasi-o aykai ayk samaanaanaa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have found absolute peace. My mind has ceased its wanderings; I am happy. ||4||23||74|| rwgu gauVI pUrbI bwvn AKrI kbIr jIau kI  (340-2) raag ga-orhee poorbee baavan akh ree kabeer jee-o kee Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu gurpRswid ] (340-2) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  gurparsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru'sGrace:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer gur bhayt mahaa sukh  bharmat  rahay man maanaanaaN. ||4||23||74||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਗੁਰ ਭੇਿਟ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
lines.english: Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.
lines.transliteration: baavan achhar lok t arai sabh  kachh  in hee maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਪੂਰਬੀ  ਬਾਵਨ  ਅਖਰੀ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਨਾਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ay akhar kh ir jaahigay o-ay akh ar in meh naahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਵਨ  ਅਛਰ  ਲੋਕ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever there is speech, there are letters.
lines.transliteration: jahaa bol tah achh ar aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਅਖਰ  ਿਖਿਰ  ਜਾਿਹਗੇ  ਓਇ ਅਖਰ  ਇਨ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where there is no speech, there, the mind rests on nothing.
lines.transliteration: jah abol tah man na rahaavaa.

lines.english: He is in both speech and silence.
lines.transliteration: bol abol maDh hai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ  ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: No one can know Him as He is. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jas oh hai tas lakh ai na ko-ee. ||2||

lines.english: If I come to know the Lord, what can I say; what good does it do to speak?
lines.transliteration: alah laha-o ta-o ki-aa kaha-o kaha-o t a ko upkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਸ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is contained in the seed of the banyan-tree, and yet, His expanse spreads across the three worlds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: batak beej meh rav rahi-o jaa ko teen lok bisthaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਹ  ਲਹਉ  ਤਉ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਉ  ਕਹਉ  ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who knows the Lord understands His mystery, and bit by bit, the mysterydisappears.
lines.transliteration: alah lahantaa bh ayd chhai kachh  kachh  paa-i-o bh ayd.

lines.punjabi: ਬਟਕ  ਬੀਜ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਓ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਿਨ  ਲੋਕ ਿਬਸਥਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Turning away from the world, one's mind is pierced through with this mystery, andone obtains the Indestructible, Impenetrable Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ulat bhayd  man bayDh i-o paa-i-o abh ang achh ayd. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਹ  ਲਹੰਤਾ  ਭੇਦ ਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਭੇਦ ॥
lines.english: The Muslim knows the Muslim way of life; the Hindu knows the Vedas and Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: turak t areekat  jaanee-ai hind oo bayd  puraan.

lines.punjabi: ਉਲਿਟ  ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਓ ਪਾਇਓ  ਅਭੰਗ  ਅਛੇਦ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: To instruct their minds, people ought to study some sort of spiritual wisdom. ||5||
lines.transliteration: man samjhaavan kaarnay kachh oo-ak parh ee-ai gi-aan. ||5||

lines.english: I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar aad mai jaanaa.

lines.english: I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes and erases.
lines.transliteration: likh ar maytai t aahi na maanaa.

lines.english: If someone knows the One, the Universal Creator,
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar lakhai ja-o ko-ee.
so-ee lakh maytn aa na ho-ee. ||6|| he shall not perish, since he knows Him. ||6||

lines.english: KAKKA: When the rays of Divine Light come into the heart-lotus,
lines.transliteration: kakaa kiran kamal meh paavaa.
sas bigaas sampat nahee aavaa. the moon-light of Maya cannot enter the basket of the mind.

lines.english: And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,
lines.transliteration: ar jay tahaa kusam ras paavaa.
akah kahaa kahi kaa samjhaavaa. ||7|| he cannot describe the indescribable; he could speak, but who would understand?||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: KHAKHA: The mind has entered this cave.
lines.transliteration: khakh aa ihai kh orh man aavaa.

lines.english: It does not leave this cave to wander in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: khorh ay chh aad na d ah dis Dhaavaa.

lines.english: Knowing their Lord and Master, people show compassion;
lines.transliteration: khasmahi jaan  khimaa kar rahai.
ta-o ho-ay nikh i-a-o akh ai pad  lahai. ||8|| then, they become immortal, and attain the state of eternal dignity. ||8||

lines.english: GAGGA: One who understands the Guru's Word
lines.transliteration: gagaa gur kay bachan pachhaanaa.
doojee baat  na Dh ar-ee kaanaa. does not listen to anything else.

lines.english: He remains like a hermit and does not go anywhere,
lines.transliteration: rahai bihamgam kateh na jaa-ee.
agah gahai geh gagan rahaa-ee. ||9|| when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the Tenth Gate. ||9||

lines.english: GHAGHA: He dwells in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghagh aa gh at ghat nimsai so-ee.

lines.english: Even when the body-pitcher bursts, he does not diminish.
lines.transliteration: ghat footay gh at kabeh na ho-ee.

lines.english: When someone finds the Path to the Lord within his own heart,
lines.transliteration: taa gh at maahi gh aat ja-o paavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਘਿਟ  ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so ghat chh aad avgh at kat  Dhaavaa. ||10|| why should he abandon that Path to follow some other path? ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਿਹ  ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: NGANGA: Restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.
lines.transliteration: nyany aa nigrahi sanayhu kar nirvaaro sand ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਿਡ  ਅਵਘਟ  ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Even if you do not see the Path, do not run away; this is the highest wisdom. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naahee daykh  na bh aajee-ai param si-aanap ayh. ||11||

lines.english: CHACHA: He painted the great picture of the world.
lines.transliteration: chachaa rachit chit ar hai bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਿਖ ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ  ਪਰਮ  ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Forget this picture, and remember the Painter.
lines.transliteration: taj chit rai chayt ahu chit kaaree.

lines.english: This wondrous painting is now the problem.
lines.transliteration: chitar bachit ar ihai avjh ayraa.

lines.english: Forget this picture and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ||12||
lines.transliteration: taj chit rai chit  raakh  chitayraa. ||12||

lines.english: CHHACHHA: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is here with you.
lines.transliteration: chhachh aa ihai chh atarpat paasaa.

lines.english: Why are you so unhappy? Why don't you abandon your desires?
lines.transliteration: chhak ke na rahhu chh aad ke na aasaa.

lines.english: O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,
lines.transliteration: ray man mai ta-o chh in chh in samjh aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਛਿਕ  ਿਕ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਛਾਿਡ  ਿਕ ਨ ਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taahi chh aad kat  aap baDh aavaa. ||13|| but you forsake Him, and entangle yourself with others. ||13||

lines.english: JAJJA: If someone burns his body while he is still alive,
lines.transliteration: jajaa ja-o tan jeevat  jaraavai.
joban jaar jugat so paavai. and burns away the desires of his youth, then he finds the right way.

lines.english: When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and that of others,
lines.transliteration: as jar par jar jar jab rahai.
tab jaa-ay jot  ujaara-o lahai. ||14|| then he finds the Divine Light. ||14|| pMnw 341

lines.english: JHAJHA: You are entangled in the world, and you do not know how to get untangled.
lines.transliteration: jhajhaa urajh  surajh  nahee jaanaa.

lines.english: You hold back in fear, and are not approved by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rahi-o jhajh ak naahee parvaanaa.

lines.english: Why do you talk such nonsense, trying to convince others?
lines.transliteration: kat jh akh jhakh a-uran samjh aavaa.

lines.english: Stirring up arguments, you shall only obtain more arguments. ||15||
lines.transliteration: jhagar kee-ay jh agara-o hee paavaa. ||15||

lines.english: NYANYA: He dwells near you, deep within your heart; why do you leave Him and go far away?
lines.transliteration: njanjaa nikat jo gh at rahi-o d oor kahaa t aj jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਞੰਞਾ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਜੁ ਘਟ ਰਿਹਓ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਹਾ ਤਿਜ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I searched the whole world for Him, but I found Him near myself. ||16||
lines.transliteration: jaa kaaran jag dh oodhi-a-o nayra-o paa-i-a-o t aahi. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਜਗੁ ਢੂਿਢਅਉ  ਨੇਰਉ  ਪਾਇਅਉ  ਤਾਿਹ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: TATTA: It is such a difficult path, to find Him within your own heart.
lines.transliteration: tataa bikat ghaat gh at maahee.

lines.english: Open the doors within, and enter the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: khol kapaat mahal ke na jaahee.

lines.english: But when the Lord of the three worlds enters into the body,
lines.transliteration: ja-o taribh avan tan maahi samaavaa.
ta-o t ateh tat mili-aa sach paavaa. ||22|| then one's essence merges with the essence of reality, and the True Lord is attained.

lines.english: T'HAT'HA: He is Unfathomable; His depths cannot be fathomed.
lines.transliteration: thathaa athaah thaah nahee paavaa.

lines.english: He is Unfathomable; this body is impermanent, and unstable.
lines.transliteration: oh athaah ih thir na rahaavaa.

bin hee thaabhah mand ir thambh ai. ||23|| without any pillars, he wishes to support a mansion. ||23||

lines.english: DADDA: Whatever is seen shall perish.

lines.english: DhaDh aa arDh ahi uraDh  nibayraa. DHADHA: When one ascends from the lower realms of the earth to the higher realms of the heavens, then everything is resolved.
The Lord dwells in both the lower and higher worlds.

lines.transliteration: arDhah chh aad uraDh  ja-o aavaa.

lines.transliteration: taa fal fank lakh ai ja-o ko-ee.

lines.english: MAMMA: Clinging to the source, the mind is satisfied.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਢੈ ਨ ਘਟਤਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: On the fourth day of the lunar cycle, restrain your fickle mind,
lines.transliteration: cha-othahi chanchal man ka-o gahhu.
kaam kroDh sang kabahu na bahhu. and do not ever associate with sexual desire or anger.

lines.english: On land and sea, He Himself is in Himself.
lines.transliteration: jal thal maahay aapeh aap.

lines.english: He Himself meditates and chants His Chant. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapai japahu aapnaa jaap. ||5||

lines.english: On the fifth day of the lunar cycle, the five elements expand outward.
lines.transliteration: paaNchai panch tat  bisthaar.

lines.english: Men are occupied in the pursuit of gold and women.
lines.transliteration: kanik kaaminee jug bi-uhaar.

lines.english: How rare are those who drink in the pure essence of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: paraym suDhaa ras peevai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਸੰਿਗ  ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਹਹੁ ॥
lines.english: They shall never again suffer the pains of old age and death. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jaraa maran d ukh fayr na ho-ay. ||6||

lines.english: On the sixth day of the lunar cycle, the six chakras run in six directions.
lines.transliteration: chhath  khat chakar chh ahoo-aN dis Dhaa-ay.

lines.english: Without enlightenment, the body does not remain steady.
lines.transliteration: bin parchai nahee thiraa rahaa-ay.

lines.english: So erase your duality and hold tight to forgiveness,
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa mayt kh imaa geh rahhu.
karam Dharam kee sool na sahhu. ||7|| and you will not have to endure the torture of karma or religious rituals. ||7||

lines.english: On the seventh day of the lunar cycle, know the Word as True,
lines.transliteration: saataiN sat kar baachaa jaan .

lines.punjabi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਫੇਿਰ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aatam raam layho parvaan . and you shall be accepted by the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

lines.english: Your doubts shall be eradicated, and your pains eliminated,
lines.transliteration: chhootai sansaa mit jaahi d ukh.
sunn sarovar paavhu sukh. ||8|| and in the ocean of the celestial void, you shall find peace. ||8||

lines.english: On the eighth day of the lunar cycle, the body is made of the eight ingredients.
lines.transliteration: astamee asat Dhaat  kee kaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਕੀ ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Within it is the Unknowable Lord, the King of the supreme treasure.
lines.transliteration: taa meh akul mahaa niDh  raa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Guru, who knows this spiritual wisdom, reveals the secret of this mystery.
lines.transliteration: gur gam gi-aan bataavai bh ayd.

lines.english: Turning away from the world, He abides in the Unbreakable and Impenetrable Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: ultaa rahai abhang achh ayd. ||9||

lines.english: On the ninth day of the lunar cycle, discipline the nine gates of the body.
lines.transliteration: na-umee navai du-aar ka-o saaDh .

lines.english: Keep your pulsating desires restrained.
lines.transliteration: bahtee mansaa raakh o baaNDh.

lines.english: Forget all your greed and emotional attachment; pMnw 344
lines.transliteration: lobh moh sabh  beesar jaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਅਮਰ  ਫਲ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug jeevhu amar fal khaahu. ||10|| you shall live throughout the ages, eating the fruit of immortality. ||10||

lines.english: On the tenth day of the lunar cycle, there is ecstasy in all directions.
lines.transliteration: dasmee d ah dis ho-ay anand.

lines.english: Doubt is dispelled, and the Lord of the Universe is met.
lines.transliteration: chhootai bh aram milai gobind .

lines.english: He is the Embodiment of light, the incomparable essence.
lines.transliteration: jot saroopee t at anoop.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਲ  ਨ ਮਲ ਨ ਛਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਧੂਪ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He is stainless, without stain, beyond both sunshine and shade. ||11||
lines.transliteration: amal na mal na chhaah nahee Dh oop. ||11||

lines.english: On the eleventh day of the lunar cycle, if you run in the direction of the One,
lines.transliteration: aykaadasee ayk d is Dhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ta-o jonee sankat bahur na aavai. you will not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation again.

lines.english: Your body will become cool, immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: seetal nirmal bh a-i-aa sareeraa.

lines.english: The Lord was said to be far away, but He is found near at hand. ||12||
lines.transliteration: door bat aavat  paa-i-aa neeraa. ||12||

lines.english: On the twelfth day of the lunar cycle, twelve suns rise.
lines.transliteration: baaras baarah ugvai soor.

lines.english: Day and night, the celestial bugles vibrate the unstruck melody.
lines.transliteration: ahinis baajay anhad t oor.

lines.english: Then, one beholds the Father of the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: daykh i-aa tihoo-aN lok kaa pee-o.

lines.english: This is wonderful! The human being has become God! ||13||
lines.transliteration: achraj bha-i-aa jeev t ay see-o. ||13||

lines.english: On the thirteenth day of the lunar cycle, the thirteen holy books proclaim
lines.transliteration: tayras t ayrah agam bakh aan.
araDh uraDh  bich sam pehchaan . that you must recognize the Lord in the nether regions of the underworld as well asthe heavens.

lines.english: There is no high or low, no honor or dishonor.
lines.transliteration: neech ooch nahee maan amaan.

lines.english: The Lord is pervading and permeating all. ||14||
lines.transliteration: bi-aapik raam sagal saamaan. ||14||

lines.english: On the fourteenth day of the lunar cycle, in the fourteen worlds
lines.transliteration: cha-udas cha-od ah lok majh aar.
rom rom meh baseh muraar. and on each and every hair, the Lord abides.

lines.english: Center yourself and meditate on truth and contentment.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh kaa Dh arahu Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Speak the speech of God's spiritual wisdom. ||15||
lines.transliteration: kathnee kathee-ai barahm gi-aan. ||15||

lines.english: On the day of the full moon, the full moon fills the heavens.
lines.transliteration: pooni-o pooraa chand akaas.

lines.english: Its power is diffused through its gentle light.
lines.transliteration: pasrahi kalaa sahj pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਮਿਧ ਹੋਇ ਰਿਹਆ  ਥੀਰ ॥
lines.english: In the beginning, in the end, and in the middle, God remains firm and steady.
lines.transliteration: aad ant  maDh  ho-ay rahi-aa theer.

lines.english: Kabeer is immersed in the ocean of peace. ||16|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (344-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu gauVI vwr kbIr jIau ky 7 ] (344-9) raag ga-orhee vaar kabeer jee-o kay 7. Raag Gauree, The Seven Days Of The Week Of Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar meh rameh kabeer. ||16||

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord each and every day.
lines.transliteration: baar baar har kay gun gaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੇ ੭॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, you shall come to know the mystery of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur gam bhayd  so har kaa paava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: On Sunday, begin the devotional worship of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: aadit karai bh agat aarambh .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਮ ਭੇਦੁ ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa mandar mansaa thambh . and restrain the desires within the temple of the body.

lines.english: When your attention is focused day and night upon that imperishable place,
lines.transliteration: ahinis akhand surhee jaa-ay.
ta-o anhad  bayn  sahj meh baa-ay. ||1|| then the celestial flutes play the unstruck melody in tranquil peace and poise. ||1||

lines.english: On Monday, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down from the moon.
lines.transliteration: somvaar sas amrit jh arai.

lines.english: Tasting it, all poisons are removed in an instant.
lines.transliteration: chaakhat  bayg sagal bikh  harai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਅਨਹਦ  ਬੇਣੁ ਸਹਜ  ਮਿਹ ਬਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Restrained by Gurbani, the mind remains indoors;
lines.transliteration: banee roki-aa rahai d u-aar.
ta-o man mat vaaro peevanhaar. ||2|| drinking in this Nectar, it is intoxicated. ||2||

lines.english: On Tuesday, understand reality;
lines.transliteration: mangalvaaray lay maaheet.
panch chor kee jaanai reet . you must know the way the five thieves work.

lines.english: Those who leave their own home to go out wandering
lines.transliteration: ghar chh odayN baahar jin jaa-ay.
naatar kh araa risai hai raa-ay. ||3|| shall feel the terrible wrath of the Lord, their King. ||3||

lines.english: On Wednesday, one's understanding is enlightened.
lines.transliteration: buDhvaar buDh  karai pargaas.

lines.english: The Lord comes to dwell in the lotus of the heart.
lines.transliteration: hirdai kamal meh har kaa baas.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, one comes to look alike upon pleasure and pain,
lines.transliteration: gur mil do-oo ayk sam Dh arai.
uraDh pank lai sooDh aa karai. ||4|| and the inverted lotus is turned upright. ||4||

lines.english: On Thursday, wash off your corruption.
lines.transliteration: barihaspat bikh i-aa d ay-ay bahaa-ay.

lines.english: Forsake the trinity, and attach yourself to the One God.
lines.transliteration: teen d ayv ayk sang laa-ay.

lines.english: At the confluence of the three rivers of knowledge, right action and devotion, there,
lines.transliteration: teen nad ee tah tarikutee maahi.
ahinis kasmal Dhoveh naahi. ||5|| why not wash away your sinful mistakes? ||5||

lines.english: On Friday, keep up and complete your fast;
lines.transliteration: sukarit sahaarai so ih barat  charh ai.
an-din aap aap si-o larh ai. day and night, you must fight against your own self.

lines.english: If you restrain your five senses,
lines.transliteration: surkhee paaNcha-o raakh ai sabai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਹਾਰੈ  ਸੁ ਇਹ ਬਰ੍ਿਤ ਚੜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ta-o d oojee d arisat na paisai kabai. ||6|| then you shall not cast your glance on another. ||6||

lines.english: On Saturday, keep the candle of God's Light steady within your heart;
lines.transliteration: thaavar thir kar raakhai so-ay. jot  dee vatee gh at meh jo-ay.
baahar bheet ar bha-i-aa pargaas. you will be enlightened, inwardly and outwardly.

lines.english: All your karma will be erased. ||7|| pMnw 345
lines.transliteration: tab hoo-aa sagal karam kaa naas. ||7||

lines.english: Know that as long as you place your hopes in others,
lines.transliteration: jab lag ghat meh d oojee aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਿਹ ਦੂਜੀ  ਆਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ta-o la-o mahal na laabh ai jaan. you shall not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਹਿਲ  ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.english: When you embrace love for the Lord,
lines.transliteration: ramat raam si-o laago rang.

lines.english: Raag Gauree Chaytee, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (345-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer tab nirmal ang. ||8||1|| says Kabeer, then, you shall become pure in your very fiber. ||8||1|| rwgu gauVI cyqI bwxI nwmdyau jIau kI  (345-3) raag ga-orhee chayt ee ban ee naamd ay-o jee-o kee

lines.english: God makes even stones float.
lines.transliteration: dayvaa paahan t aaree-alay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਚੇਤੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: So why shouldn't Your humble slave also float across, chanting Your Name, O Lord? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam kahat jan kas na t aray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You saved the prostitute, and the ugly hunch-back; You helped the hunter and Ajaamal swim across as well.
lines.transliteration: taareelay ganikaa bin roop kubijaa bi-aaDh  ajaamal t aaree-alay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ  ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot - even he was liberated.
lines.transliteration: charan baDhik jan t ay-oo mukat  bha-ay.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who chant the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-o bal bal jin raam kahay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ  ਗਿਨਕਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਿਬਜਾ  ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਅਜਾਮਲੁ  ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: You saved Bidur, the son of the slave-girl, and Sudama; You restored Ugrasain to histhrone.
lines.transliteration: daasee sut  jan bid ar sud aamaa ugarsain ka-o raaj d ee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਬਿਧਕ  ਜਨ ਤੇਊ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਏ ॥
lines.english: Without meditation, without penance, without a good family, without good deeds, Naam Dayv's Lord and Master saved them all. ||2||1|| rwgu gauVI rivdws jI ky pdy gauVI guAwryrI (345-8) raag ga-orhee ravid aas jee kay pad ay ga-orh ee gu-aarayree Raag Gauree, Padas Of Ravi Daas Jee, Gauree Gwaarayree: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu gurpRswid ] (345-9) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  gurparsaad . One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru'sGrace:
lines.transliteration: jI) jap heen tap heen kul heen karam heen naamay kay su-aamee t ay-oo t aray. ||2||1||

lines.english: The company I keep is wretched and low, and I am anxious day and night;
lines.transliteration: mayree sangat poch soch d in raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਿਬਦਰੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ  ਉਗਰ੍ਸੈਨ  ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mayraa karam kutiltaa janam kubh aaNtee. ||1|| my actions are crooked, and I am of lowly birth. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਕਰ੍ਮ ਹੀਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, Master of the earth, Life of the soul,
lines.transliteration: raam gus-ee-aa jee-a kay jeevnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ  ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਨਾਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi na bisaarahu mai jan tayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. please do not forget me! I am Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Take away my pains, and bless Your humble servant with Your Sublime Love.
lines.transliteration: mayree harahu bipat jan karahu subh aa-ee.

lines.english: I shall not leave Your Feet, even though my body may perish. ||2||
lines.transliteration: charan na chh aada-o sareer kal jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, I seek the protection of Your Sanctuary;
lines.transliteration: kaho ravidaas para-o t ayree saabh aa.
bayg milhu jan kar na bilaaNbaa. ||3||1|| please, meet Your humble servant - do not delay! ||3||1||

lines.english: Baygumpura, 'the city without sorrow', is the name of the town.
lines.transliteration: baygam puraa sahar ko naa-o.

lines.english: There is no suffering or anxiety there.
lines.transliteration: dookh  andohu nahee t ihi thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਨ ਛਾਡਉ  ਸਰੀਰ  ਕਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There are no troubles or taxes on commodities there.
lines.transliteration: naaN tasvees kh iraaj na maal.

lines.english: There is no fear, blemish or downfall there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kha-uf na kh ataa na t aras javaal. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I have found this most excellent city.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi khoob vat an gah paa-ee.

lines.english: There is lasting peace and safety there, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: oohaaN khair sad aa mayray bh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God's Kingdom is steady, stable and eternal.
lines.transliteration: kaa-im daa-im sad aa paat isaahee.

lines.english: There is no second or third status; all are equal there.
lines.transliteration: dom na saym ayk so aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਉਫੁ  ਨ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਤਰਸੁ  ਜਵਾਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That city is populous and eternally famous.
lines.transliteration: aabaadaan sad aa mashoor.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who live there are wealthy and contented. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oohaaN ganee baseh maamoor. ||2||

lines.english: They stroll about freely, just as they please.
lines.transliteration: ti-o ti-o sail karahi ji-o bh aavai.

lines.english: They know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and no one blocks their way.
lines.transliteration: mahram mahal na ko atkaavai.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, the emancipated shoe-maker:
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas kh alaas chamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: gauVI bYrwgix rivdws jIau ] (345-17) ga-orhee bairaagan  ravid aas jee-o. Gauree Bairaagan, Ravi Daas Jee:
lines.transliteration: jo ham sahree so meet hamaaraa. ||3||2|| whoever is a citizen there, is a friend of mine. ||3||2|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (345-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad .

lines.english: The path to God is very treacherous and mountainous, and all I have is this worthless ox.
lines.transliteration: ghat avgh at doogar gh anaa ik nirgun  bail hamaar.

lines.english: I offer this one prayer to the Lord, to preserve my capital. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ram-ee-ay si-o ik bayntee mayree poonjee raakh  muraar. ||1||

lines.english: Is there any merchant of the Lord to join me? My cargo is loaded, and now I am leaving. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 346
lines.transliteration: ko banjaaro raam ko mayraa taaNdaa laadi-aa jaa-ay ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am the merchant of the Lord; I deal in spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: ha-o banjaaro raam ko sahj kara-o ba-yaapaar.

lines.english: I have loaded the Wealth of the Lord's Name; the world has loaded poison. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mai raam naam Dhan laad i-aa bikh  laadee sansaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸਹਜ  ਕਰਉ  ਬਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O you who know this world and the world beyond: write whatever nonsense youplease about me.
lines.transliteration: urvaar paar kay daanee-aa likh  layho aal pat aal.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਿਦਆ ਿਬਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The club of the Messenger of Death shall not strike me, since I have cast off all entanglements. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mohi jam dand na laag-ee tajeelay sarab janjaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਵਾਰ  ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ  ਪਤਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Love of this world is like the pale, temporary color of the safflower.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa rang kasumbh kaa t aisaa ih sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਤਜੀਲੇ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੰਜਾਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The color of my Lord's Love, however, is permanent, like the dye of the madder plant.So says Ravi Daas, the tanner. ||4||1|| gauVI pUrbI rivdws jIau  (346-5) ga-orhee poorbee ravid aas jee-o Gauree Poorbee, Ravi Daas Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (346-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mayray ram-ee-ay rang majeeth kaa kaho ravid aas chamaar. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The frog in the deep well knows nothing of its own country or other lands;
lines.transliteration: koop bhari-o jaisay d aadiraa kachh  days bid ays na boojh .

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ  ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਚਮਾਰ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aisay mayraa man bikhi-aa bimohi-aa kachh  aaraa paar na soojh . ||1|| just so, my mind, infatuated with corruption, understands nothing about this world orthe next. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਉੜੀ  ਪੂਰਬੀ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀਉ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord of all worlds: reveal to me, even for an instant, the Blessed Vision of YourDarshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan kay naa-ikaa ik chh in daras d ikhaa-ay jee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਪੁ ਭਿਰਓ  ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਿਦਰਾ  ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਿਬਦੇਸੁ  ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
lines.english: My intellect is polluted; I cannot understand Your state, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: malin bha-ee mat  maaDh vaa tayree gat  lakhee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਬਮੋਿਹਆ  ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ  ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Take pity on me, dispel my doubts, and teach me true wisdom. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa bharam chook-ee mai sumat  dayh samjh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਨ  ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ  ਇਕੁ ਿਛਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਦਖਾਇ  ਜੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even the great Yogis cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues; they are beyond words.
lines.transliteration: jogeesar paavahi nahee tu-a gun  kathan apaar.

lines.english: I am dedicated to Your loving devotional worship, says Ravi Daas the tanner. ||3||1|| gauVI bYrwgix  (346-10) ga-orhee bairaagan Gauree Bairaagan: <> siqgur pRswid ] (346-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  kai kaarn ai kaho ravid aas chamaar. ||3||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਲਨ  ਭਈ ਮਿਤ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਲਖੀ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, was Truth; in the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, charitable feasts; in the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, there was worship.
lines.transliteration: satjug sat  taytaa jagee d u-aapar poojaachaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ  ਮੈ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In those three ages, people held to these three ways. But in the Iron Age of KaliYuga, the Name of the Lord is your only Support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: teenou jug t eenou d irhay kal kayval naam aDh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀਸਰ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਨਹੀ ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: How can I swim across?
lines.transliteration: paar kaisay paa-ibo ray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ  ਕਹੁ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਚਮਾਰ  ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.english: No one has explained to me,
lines.transliteration: mo sa-o ko-oo na kahai samjhaa-ay.
jaa tay aavaa gavan bilaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. so that I might understand how I can escape reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਜੁਿਗ  ਸਤੁ ਤੇਤਾ  ਜਗੀ  ਦੁਆਪਿਰ  ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: So many forms of religion have been described; the whole world is practicing them.
lines.transliteration: baho biDh Dh aram niroopee-ai kart aa deesai sabh  lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਨੌ  ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ  ਿਦੜੇ ਕਿਲ  ਕੇਵਲ  ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What actions will bring emancipation, and total perfection? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kavan karam tay chh ootee-ai jih saaDh ay sabh  siDh ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One may distinguish between good and evil actions, and listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,
lines.transliteration: karam akram beechaaree-ai sankaa sun bayd puraan.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਸਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sansaa sad hird ai basai ka-un hirai abh imaan. ||3|| but doubt still persists. Skepticism continually dwells in the heart, so who caneradicate egotistical pride? ||3||

lines.english: Outwardly, he washes with water, but deep within, his heart is tarnished by all sortsof vices.
lines.transliteration: baahar udak pakh aaree-ai gh at bheetar bibiDh  bikaar.

lines.english: So how can he become pure? His method of purification is like that of an elephant,covering himself with dust right after his bath! ||4||
lines.transliteration: suDh kavan par ho-ibo such kunchar biDh  bi-uhaar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਧਰਮ ਿਨਰੂਪੀਐ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: With the rising of the sun, the night is brought to its end; the whole world knows this.
lines.transliteration: rav pargaas rajnee jathaa gat jaanat  sabh  sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਕਰਮ  ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਿਜਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਿਸਿਧ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: It is believed that with the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, copper is immediatelytransformed into gold. ||5||
lines.transliteration: paaras maano taabo chh u-ay kanak hot  nahee baar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਿਨ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: When one meets the Supreme Philosopher's Stone, the Guru, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on one's forehead,
lines.transliteration: param paras gur bhaytee-ai poorab likh at lilaat.
unman man man hee milay chhutkat  bajar kapaat. ||6|| then the soul blends with the Supreme Soul, and the stubborn doors are opened wide.||6||

lines.english: Through the way of devotion, the intellect is imbued with Truth; doubts,entanglements and vices are cut away.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  jugat  mat sat karee bh aram banDh an kaat bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ  ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ  ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਬਉਹਾਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The mind is restrained, and one attains joy, contemplating the One Lord, who is bothwith and without qualities. ||7||
lines.transliteration: so-ee bas ras man milay gun nirgun ayk bichaar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਿਤ  ਜਾਨਤ  ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I have tried many methods, but by turning it away, the noose of doubt is not turnedaway.
lines.transliteration: anik jatan nigreh kee-ay taaree na tarai bh aram faas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਸ  ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ ਕਨਕ  ਹੋਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Love and devotion have not welled up within me, and so Ravi Daas is sad anddepressed. ||8||1|| pMnw 347 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (347-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 Gru 1 so dru ] (347-3) raag aasaa mehlaa 1 ghar 1 so d ar. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, First House, So Dar ~ That Gate:
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  nahee oopjai t aa tay ravid aas ud aas. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: What is that Gate, and what is that Home, in which You sit and take care of all?
lines.transliteration: so dar t ayraa kayhaa so gh ar kayhaa jit  bahi sarab samHaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Countless musical instruments of so many various kinds vibrate there for You; so many are the musicians there for You.
lines.transliteration: vaajay tayray naad  anayk asankh aa kayt ay tayray vaavan haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਿਜਤੁ  ਬਿਹ ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: There are so many Ragas there for You, along with their accompanying harmonies; somany minstrels sing to You.
lines.transliteration: kaytay t ayray raag paree si-o kahee-ahi kayt ay tayray gaavan haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਅਸੰਖਾ  ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The winds sing to You, as do water and fire; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings atYour Door.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no pa-un  paan ee baisant ar gaavai raajaa Dh aram d u-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਿਸਉ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Chitar and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the subconscious, sing toYou; they know, and they write, and on the basis of what they write, the Lord ofDharma passes judgement.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no chit  gupat  likh jaanan likh  likh Dharam veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਧਰਮ  ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Shiva and Brahma and the Goddess Parvaati, so beautiful and ever adorned by You,sing to You.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no eesar barahmaa d ayvee sohan t ayray sad aa savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਜਾਣਿਨ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Indras, seated upon their celestial thrones, with the deities at Your Gate, sing toYou.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no ind ar ind araasan  baith ay dayviti-aa d ar naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing to You, and the Holy Saints, in their contemplative meditation, sing to You.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no siDh  samaaDh ee and ar gaavniH tuDhno saaDh  beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾਸਿਣ  ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਿਤਆ  ਦਿਰ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The celibates, the truthful and the patient beings sing to You, and the mighty warriorssing to You.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no jat ee sat ee sant okhee gaavan t uDhno veer karaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਿਸਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The scholarly Pandits sing to You, along with the holy Rishis and the readers of theVedas throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: gaavan tuDh no pandit  parhay rakh eesur jug jug bayd aa naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Mohinis, the heavenly beauties who entice the heart in paradise, in this world andin the nether regions, sing to You.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no mohn ee-aa man mohan surag machh  pa-i-aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੜੇ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਬੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The fourteen priceless jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places ofpilgrimage, sing to You.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no rat an upaa-ay t ayray jayt ay ath sath tirath naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਮੋਹਣੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਸੁਰਗੁ  ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The mighty warriors and the divine heroes sing to You, and the four sources ofcreation sing to You.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no joDh  mahaabal sooraa gaavniH tuDhno kh aanee chaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਰਤਨ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਤੇਰੇ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The continents, the worlds and the solar systems, created and installed by Your Hand,sing to You.
lines.transliteration: gaavniH tuDh no kh and mandal barahmandaa kar kar rakh ay tayray Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ  ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਖਾਣੀ  ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They alone sing to You, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who are imbued with thenectar of Your devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: say-ee tuDh no gaavniH jo tuDh bhaavniH ratay tayray bh agat rasaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So many others sing to You, they do not come into my mind; how can Nanak think of them?
lines.transliteration: hor kaytay t uDhno gaavan say mai chit  na aavan naanak ki-aa beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਨ  ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਰਸਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: That Lord and Master - He is True, foreve r True; He is True, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: so-ee so-ee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਸੇ ਮੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਿਨ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He who created the creation is True, and He shall always be True; He shall not depart, even when the creation departs.
lines.transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaa-ay na jaasee rachnaa jin rachaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He created the world of Maya with its various colors and species.
lines.transliteration: rangee rangee bhaat ee jinsee maa-i-aa jin upaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਜਾਸੀ  ਰਚਨਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਚਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Having created the creation, He Himself watches over it, as it pleases His Greatness.
lines.transliteration: kar kar daykh ai keet aa apn aa ji-o t is dee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, that is what He does. No one can issue any commands to Him. pMnw 348
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karsee fir hukam na karn aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: He is the King, the King of Kings, the Emperor of Kings! Nanak lives in surrender to His Will. ||1||1|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (348-1) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa pat  saahib naanak rahan  rajaa-ee. ||1||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਿਤ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਹਣੁ  ਰਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥੧॥
lines.english: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.
lines.transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh  niranjan har agmaa agam apaaraa.

lines.english: All meditate, all meditate on You, O Dear Lord, O True Creator.
lines.transliteration: sabh Dh i-aavahi sabh  Dhi-aavahi t uDh jee har sachay sirjan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: All beings are Yours; You are the Giver of all beings.
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-a t umaaray jee t ooN jee-aa kaa d aataaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the One who takes away all pain.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavahu sant ahu jee sabh  dookh visaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Master, and He Himself is His own servant. O Nanak, howinsignificant are mortal beings! ||1||
lines.transliteration: har aapay thaakur har aapay sayvak jee ki-aa naanak jant  vichaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: You are totally pervading within each and every heart; O Lord, You are the One PrimalBeing, All-permeating.
lines.transliteration: tooN ghat ghat ant ar sarab nirant ar jee har ayko purakh  samaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜੀ ਿਕਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some are givers, and some are beggars; all of this is Your wondrous play!
lines.transliteration: ik daat ay ik bh aykhaaree jee sabh  tayray choj vidaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know of no other thanYou.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay d aataa aapay bh ugtaa jee ha-o t uDh bin avar na jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਇਿਕ  ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ਜੀ ਸਿਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਿਵਡਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Supreme Lord God, Infinite and Eternal; what Glorious Praises of Yours should I speak and chant?
lines.transliteration: tooN paarbarahm bay-ant  bay-ant  jee tayray ki-aa gun  aakh  vakh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Unto those who serve, unto those who serve You, slave Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo sayveh jo sayveh tuDh  jee jan naanak t inH kurbaan aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਕਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord, those who meditate on You, O Dear Lord, those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavahi har Dh i-aavahi t uDh jee say jan jug meh sukh  vaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਜੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They are liberated, they are liberated, who meditate on the Lord; the noose of Death is cut away from them.
lines.transliteration: say mukat say mukat  bha-ay jinH har Dh i-aa-i-aa jee-o t in tootee jam kee faasee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord, all their fears aredispelled.
lines.transliteration: jin nirbha-o jinH har nirbh a-o Dh i-aa-i-aa jee-o t in kaa bh a-o sabh  gavaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਭਏ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਤਨ ਟੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have served, those who have served my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jinH sayvi-aa jinH sayvi-aa mayraa har jee-o tay har har roop samaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who have meditated on the Dear Lord; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say Dhan say Dh an jin har Dh i-aa-i-aa jee-o jan naanak t in bal jaasee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਜਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰੂਿਪ ਸਮਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure, overflowing, infinite and endless.
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat tayree bh agat bhandaar jee bh aray bay-ant  bay-ant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ  ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, O Dear Lord, in many and various ways.
lines.transliteration: tayray bh agat tayray bh agat salaahan t uDh jee har anik anayk anant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਬੇਅੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: For You, so many, for You, so very many, O Dear Lord, perform worship and adoration; they practice penance and endlessly chant in meditation.
lines.transliteration: tayree anik t ayree anik karahi har poojaa jee t ap taapeh jaapeh bay-ant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਅਿਨਕ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਅਨੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: 4) tayray anayk t ayray anayk parh eh baho simrit  saasat  jee kar kiri-aa kh at karam karantaa. For You, many - for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras; they perform religious rituals and the six ceremonies.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਿਨਕ  ਤੇਰੀ ਅਿਨਕ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਿਹ  ਜਪਿਹ  ਬੇਅੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: ||4|| Those devotees, those devotees are good, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to myLord God. ||4||
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  say bh agat bhalay jan naanak jee jo bh aaveh mayray har bh agvant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ  ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਿਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤ  ਜੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਿਰਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Primal Being, the Unrivalled Creator Lord; there is no other as Great asYou.
lines.transliteration: tooN aad purakh  aprampar kart aa jee t uDh jayvad avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: You are the One, age after age; forever and ever, You are One and the same. You arethe Eternal, Unchanging Creator.
lines.transliteration: tooN jug jug ayko sad aa sad aa tooN ayko jee t ooN nihchal kart aa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਿਦ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. Whatever You Yourself do, happens.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay bh aavai so-ee vart ai jee t ooN aapay karahi so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the entire Universe, and having done so, You Yourself shalldestroy it all.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay sarisat sabh  upaa-ee jee t uDh aapay siraj sabh  go-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ  ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||2|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (348-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 caupdy Gru 2 ] (348-19) raag aasaa mehlaa 1 cha-upday gh ar 2. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chaupaday, Second House:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai kart ay kay jee jo sabh sai kaa jaan o-ee. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ  ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰਿਜ  ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Hearing, everyone calls You Great,
lines.transliteration: sun vadaa aakh ai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ  ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ  ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kayvad vadaa deethaa ho-ee. but only one who has seen You, knows just how Great You are. pMnw 349

lines.english: No one can measure Your Worth, or describe You.
lines.transliteration: keemat paa-ay na kahi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who describe You, remain absorbed in You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahnai vaalay t ayray rahay samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.
lines.transliteration: vaday mayray saahibaa gahir gambheeraa gun ee gaheeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਗਿਹਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰਾ॥
lines.english: No one knows the greatness of Your expanse. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee na jaanai t ayraa kayt aa kayvad cheeraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ  ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the contemplators met together and practiced contemplation;
lines.transliteration: sabh surt ee mil surat  kamaa-ee.
sabh keemat  mil keemat  paa-ee. all the appraisers met together and tried to appraise You.

lines.english: The theologians, the meditators and the teachers of teachers
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee Dhi-aanee gur gur haa-ee.
kahan na jaa-ee t ayree t il vadi-aa-ee. ||2|| could not express even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

lines.english: All Truth, all austerities, all goodness,
lines.transliteration: sabh sat  sabh  tap sabh  chang-aa-ee-aa.
siDhaa purkh aa kee-aa vadi-aa-ee-aaN. and the greatness of the Siddhas, the beings of perfect spiritual powers

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸਤ ਸਿਭ ਤਪ ਸਿਭ ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tuDh vin siDhee kinai na paa-ee-aa. - without You, none has attained such spiritual powers.

lines.english: They are obtained by Your Grace; their flow cannot be blocked. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam milai naahee thaak rahaa-ee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: What can the helpless speaker do?
lines.transliteration: aakhan  vaalaa ki-aa baychaaraa.

lines.english: Your bounties are overflowing with Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: siftee bh aray t ayray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: And the one, unto whom You give - why should he think of any other?
lines.transliteration: jis tooN deh tisai ki-aa chaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Embellisher. ||4||1|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (349-6) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach savaaranhaaraa. ||4||1||

lines.english: Chanting the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.
lines.transliteration: aakhaa jeevaa visrai mar jaa-o.

lines.english: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  a-ukh aa saachaa naa-o.

lines.english: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
lines.transliteration: saachay naam kee laagai bhookh .
tit bhookhai khaa-ay chalee-ahi d ookh. ||1|| then that hunger shall consume his pains. ||1||

lines.english: So how could I ever forget Him, O my Mother?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o visrai mayree maa-ay.

lines.english: True is the Master, and True is His Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib saachai naa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: People have grown weary of trying to appraise the greatness of the True Name, butthey have not been able to appraise even an iota of it.
lines.transliteration: saachay naam kee til vadi-aa-ee. aakh  thakay keemat  nahee paa-ee.

lines.english: Even if they were all to meet together and recount them,
lines.transliteration: jay sabh mil kai aakh an paahi.

lines.english: You would not be made any greater or lesser. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vadaa na hovai ghaat na jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He does not die - there is no reason to mourn.
lines.transliteration: naa oh marai na hovai sog.

lines.english: He continues to give, but His Provisions are never exhausted.
lines.transliteration: dayNdaa rahai na chookai bh og.

lines.english: This Glorious Virtue is His alone - no one else is like Him;
lines.transliteration: gun ayho hor naahee ko-ay.
naa ko ho-aa naa ko ho-ay. ||3|| there has never been anyone like Him, and there never shall be. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਿਟ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: As Great as You Yourself are, so Great are Your Gifts.
lines.transliteration: jayvad aap tayvad t ayree d aat.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: It is You who created day and night as well.
lines.transliteration: jin din kar kai keet ee raat .

lines.english: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.
lines.transliteration: khasam visaareh t ay kamjaat .

lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, people are wretched outcasts. ||4||2|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (349-12) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai baajh sanaat . ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master hears it in His Mansion.
lines.transliteration: jay dar maaNgat kook karay mahlee kh asam sun ay.

lines.english: Whether He receives him or pushes him away, it is the Gift of the Lord's Greatness.||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaavai Dh eerak bh aavai Dh akay ayk vadaa-ee d ay-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Recognize the Lord's Light within all, and do not consider social class or status; thereare no classes or castes in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaanhu jot  na poochh ahu jaat ee aagai jaat  na hay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself acts, and He Himself inspires us to act.
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay aap karay-i.

lines.english: He Himself considers our complaints.
lines.transliteration: aap ulaamayH chit Dh aray-ay.

lines.english: Since You, O Creator Lord, are the Doer,
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN karanhaar kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਦਿਰ ਮਗਤੁ  ਕੂਕ ਕਰੇ ਮਹਲੀ  ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ki-aa muhtaajee ki-aa sansaar. ||2|| why should I submit to the world? ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵੈ ਧੀਰਕ  ਭਾਵੈ ਧਕੇ ਏਕ ਵਡਾਈ  ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself created and You Yourself give.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay aapay day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜੋਿਤ  ਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਤੀ  ਆਗੈ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself eliminate evil-mindedness;
lines.transliteration: aapay durmat  maneh karay-i.
gur parsaad vasai man aa-ay. by Guru's Grace, You come to abide in our minds,
dukh anHayraa vichahu jaa-ay. ||3|| and then, pain and darkness are dispelled from within. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself infuses love for the Truth.
lines.transliteration: saach pi-aaraa aap karay-i.

lines.english: Unto others, the Truth is not bestowed.
lines.transliteration: avree ka-o saach na day-ay.

lines.english: If He bestows it upon someone, says Nanak, then, in the world hereafter, that personis not called to account. ||4||3|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (349-17) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay kisai day-ay vakh aanai naanak aagai poochh  na lay-ay. ||4||3||

lines.english: The urges of the heart are like cymbals and ankle-bells;
lines.transliteration: taal mad eeray gh at kay gh aat.
dolak d unee-aa vaajeh vaaj. the drum of the world resounds with the beat.

lines.english: Naarad dances to the tune of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;
lines.transliteration: naarad naachai kal kaa bh aa-o.
jatee sat ee kah raakh ahi paa-o. ||1|| where can the celibates and the men of truth place their feet? ||1||

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vitahu kurbaan.

lines.english: The world is blind; our Lord and Master is All-seeing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anDhee d unee-aa saahib jaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਕਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਗੈ  ਪੂਛ ਨ ਲੇਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: The disciple feeds on the Guru;
lines.transliteration: guroo paashu fir chaylaa khaa-ay.
taam pareet  vasai gh ar aa-ay. out of love for bread, he comes to dwell in his home. pMnw 350

lines.english: If one were to live and eat for hundreds of years,
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o var-hi-aa jeevan kh aan.
khasam pachh aanai so d in parvaan . ||2|| that day alone would be auspicious, when he recognizes his Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.english: Beholding the sight of the petitioner, compassion is not aroused.
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykhi-ai da-i-aa na ho-ay.

lines.english: No one lives without give and take.
lines.transliteration: la-ay dit ay vin  rahai na ko-ay.

lines.english: The king administers justice only if his palm is greased.
lines.transliteration: raajaa ni-aa-o karay hath ho-ay.

lines.english: No one is moved by the Name of God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kahai khud aa-ay na maanai ko-ay. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;
lines.transliteration: maanas moorat  naanak naam.
karnee kut aa dar furmaan. by their deeds they are dogs - this is the Command of the Lord's Court.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jaan ai mihmaan.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 1 ] (350-4) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taa kichh  dargeh paavai maan. ||4||4|| then he gains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||

lines.english: As much as the Shabad is in the mind, so much is Your melody; as much as the form of the universe is, so much is Your body, Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa sabad  surat  Dhun taytee jayt aa roop kaa-i-aa t ayree.

lines.english: You Yourself are the tongue, and You Yourself are the nose. Do not speak of any other, O my mother. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay rasnaa aapay basnaa avar na d oojaa kaha-o maa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਧੁਿਨ ਤੇਤੀ  ਜੇਤਾ  ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is One;
lines.transliteration: saahib mayraa ayko hai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਸਨਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕਹਉ  ਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the One and Only; O Siblings of Destiny, He is the One alone. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayko hai bhaa-ee ayko hai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself kills, and He Himself emancipates; He Himself gives and takes.
lines.transliteration: aapay maaray aapay chhodai aapay layvai d ay-ay.

lines.english: He Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai aapay vigsai aapay nad ar karay-i. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever He is to do, that is what He is doing. No one else can do anything.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karn aa so kar rahi-aa avar na karn aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ  ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ  ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: As He projects Himself, so do we describe Him; this is all Your Glorious Greatness,Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa vartai t aiso kahee-ai sabh  tayree vadi-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ  ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the bottle of wine; Maya is the sweet wine, and theintoxicated mind continues to drink it in.
lines.transliteration: kal kalvaalee maa-i-aa mad meeth aa man mat vaalaa peevat  rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੋ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus poor Nanak speaks. ||4||5|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (350-9) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay roop karay baho bhaaNteeN naanak bapurh aa ayv kahai. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ  ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;
lines.transliteration: vaajaa mat pakh aavaj bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ  ਪੀਵਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ho-ay anand sadaa man chaa-o. thus bliss and lasting pleasure shall be produced in your mind.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਤੀਂ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬਪੁੜਾ  ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: This is devotional worship, and this is the practice of penance.
lines.transliteration: ayhaa bhagat  ayho t ap taa-o.

lines.english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: it rang naachahu rakh  rakh paa-o. ||1||

lines.english: Know that the perfect beat is the Praise of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: pooray taal jaan ai saalaah.
hor nachnaa kh usee-aa man maah. ||1|| rahaa-o. other dances produce only temporary pleasure in the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Play the two cymbals of truth and contentment.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh vajeh d u-ay t aal.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਿਖ ਰਿਖ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Let your ankle bells be the lasting Vision of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: pairee vaajaa sadaa nihaal.

lines.english: Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.
lines.transliteration: raag naad nahee d oojaa bh aa-o.

lines.english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: it rang naachahu rakh  rakh paa-o. ||2||

lines.english: Let the fear of God within your heart and mind be your spinning dance,
lines.transliteration: bha-o fayree hovai man cheet .
bahdi-aa uth -di-aa neet aa neet . and keep up, whether sitting or standing.

lines.english: To roll around in the dust is to know that the body is only ashes.
lines.transliteration: laytan layt jaan ai tan su-aahu.

lines.english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||3||
lines.transliteration: it rang naachahu rakh  rakh paa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਿਖ ਰਿਖ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Keep the company of the disciples, the students who love the teachings.
lines.transliteration: sikh sabh aa deekhi-aa kaa bh aa-o.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, listen to the True Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sun -naa saachaa naa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, chant it, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhan  vayraa vayr.

lines.english: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||4||6|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (350-15) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: it rang naachahu rakh  rakh pair. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਿਖ ਰਿਖ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He created the air, and He supports the whole world; he bound water and fire together.
lines.transliteration: pa-un upaa-ay Dh aree sabh  Dhartee jal agnee kaa banDh  kee-aa.

lines.english: The blind, ten-headed Raavan had his heads cut off, but what greatness was obtainedby killing him? ||1||
lines.transliteration: anDhulai d ehsir moond kataa-i-aa raavan  maar ki-aa vadaa bh a-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: What Glories of Yours can be chanted?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa upmaa tayree aakh ee jaa-ay.

lines.english: You are totally pervading everywhere; You love and cherish all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN sarbay poor rahi-aa liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਿਖ ਰਿਖ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬  ॥
lines.english: You created all beings, and You hold the world in Your Hands; what greatness is it toput a ring in the nose of the black cobra, as Krishna did?
lines.transliteration: jee-a upaa-ay jugat hath keenee kaalee nath ki-aa vadaa bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are subtly diffused and pervading inall. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kis tooN purakh  joroo ka-un  kahee-ai sarab nirant ar rav rahi-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ  ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ  ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Brahma, the bestower of blessings, entered the stem of the lotus, with his relatives, tofind the extent of the universe.
lines.transliteration: naal kutamb saath vardaat aa barahmaa bh aalan  sarisat ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ  ਦਹਿਸਿਰ  ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ  ਰਾਵਣੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਕਆ  ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Proceeding on, he could not find its limits; what glory was obtained by killing Kansa,the king? ||3||
lines.transliteration: aagai ant na paa-i-o t aa kaa kans chh ayd ki-aa vadaa bh a-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The jewels were produced and brought forth by churning the ocean of milk. The other gods proclaimed "We are the ones who did this!" pMnw 351
lines.transliteration: ratan upaa-ay Dh aray kh eer mathi-aa hor bh akhlaa-ay je asee kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਮਿਥਆ  ਹੋਿਰ ਭਖਲਾਏ  ਿਜ ਅਸੀ  ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, by hiding, how can the Lord be hidden? He has given each their share, one by one. ||4||7|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (351-2) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak chhapai ki-o chh api-aa aykee aykee vand d ee-aa. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਛਪੈ ਿਕਉ  ਛਿਪਆ  ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਿਡ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: The vine of good actions and character has spread out, and it bears the fruit of theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: karam kartoot  bayl bisthaaree raam naam fal hoo-aa.

lines.english: The Name has no form or outline; it vibrates with the unstruck Sound Current; through the Word of the Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is revealed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis roop na raykh  anaahad  vaajai sabad  niranjan kee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਤੂਿਤ  ਬੇਿਲ  ਿਬਸਥਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
lines.english: One can speak on this only when he knows it.
lines.transliteration: karay vakhi-aan  jaanai jay ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ  ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit peevai so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who drink it in are enraptured; their bonds and shackles are cut away.
lines.transliteration: jinH pee-aa say masat bh a-ay hai t ootay banDh an faahay.

lines.english: When one's light blends into the Divine Light, then the desire for Maya is ended. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  samaan ee bh eetar taa chh oday maa-i-aa kay laahay. ||2||

lines.english: Among all lights, I behold Your Form; all the worlds are Your Maya.
lines.transliteration: sarab jot roop t ayraa d aykhi-aa sagal bh avan t ayree maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਪੀਆ  ਸੇ ਮਸਤ  ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਫਾਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Among the tumults and forms, He sits in serene detachment; He bestows His Glance of Grace upon those who are engrossed in the illusion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raarai roop niraalam baithaa nad ar karay vich chh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
