lines.english: The Yogi who plays on the instrument of the Shabad gains the Blessed Vision of theInfinitely Beautiful Lord.
lines.transliteration: beenaa sabad  vajaavai jogee d arsan roop apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੋਿਤ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਨ  ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He, the Lord, is immersed in the Unstruck Shabad of the Word, says Nanak, thehumble and meek. ||4||8|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (351-7) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabad anaahad  so saho raat aa naanak kahai vichaaraa. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰੂਿਪ ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਬੈਠਾ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਿਵਿਚ ਛਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My virtue is that I carry the load of my words upon my head.
lines.transliteration: mai gun galaa kay sir bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਣਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਜਾਵੈ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਰੂਿਪ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The real words are the Words of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: galee galaa sirjanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਨਾਹਿਦ  ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਿਵਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: How useless are eating, drinking and laughing,
lines.transliteration: khaan aa peen aa hasn aa baad .
jab lag ridai na aavahi yaad . ||1|| if the Lord is not cherished in the heart! ||1||

lines.english: Why should someone care for anything else,
lines.transliteration: ta-o parvaah kayhee ki-aa keejai.
janam janam kichh leejee leejai. ||1|| rahaa-o. if throughout his life, he gathers in that which is truly worth gathering? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The intellect of the mind is like a drunken elephant.
lines.transliteration: man kee mat mat aagal mat aa.

lines.english: Whatever one utters is totally false, the most false of the false.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh bolee-ai sabh  khato khataa.

lines.english: So what face should we put on to offer our prayer,
lines.transliteration: ki-aa muhu lai keechai ardaas.
paap punn du-ay saakh ee paas. ||2|| when both virtue and vice are close at hand as witnesses? ||2||

lines.english: As You make us, so we become.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa tooN karahi t aisaa ko ho-ay.

lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: As is the understanding which You bestow, so do we receive.
lines.transliteration: jayhee tooN mat deh tayhee ko paavai.

lines.english: As it pleases Your Will, so do You lead us. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay bh aavai t ivai chalaavai. ||3||

lines.english: The divine crystalline harmonies, their consorts, and their celestial families
lines.transliteration: raag ratan paree-aa parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich upjai amrit  saar. - from them, the essence of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

lines.english: O Nanak, this is the wealth and property of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak kartay kaa ih Dh an maal.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਿਹ ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: If only this essential reality were understood! ||4||9|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (351-13) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay ko boojhai ayhu beechaar. ||4||9||

lines.english: When by His Grace He came to my home, then my companions met together tocelebrate my marriage.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnai ghar aa-i-aa t aa mil sakh ee-aa kaaj rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Beholding this play, my mind became blissful; my Husband Lord has come to marryme. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khayl d aykh man anad  bha-i-aa saho vee-aahan  aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: So sing - yes, sing the songs of wisdom and reflection, O brides.
lines.transliteration: gaavhu gaavhu kaamnee bibayk beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: My spouse, the Life of the world, has come into my home. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hamrai ghar aa-i-aa jagjeevan bh ataar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When I was married within the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, I met my Husband Lord, and I came to know Him.
lines.transliteration: guroo du-aarai hamraa vee-aahu je ho-aa jaaN saho mili-aa t aaN jaani-aa.

lines.english: The Word of His Shabad is pervading the three worlds; when my ego was quieted, mymind became happy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tihu lokaa meh sabad  ravi-aa hai aap ga-i-aa man maani-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪਨੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ਤਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਖੀਆ  ਕਾਜੁ  ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself arranges His own affairs; His affairs cannot be arranged by anyone else.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa kaaraj aap savaaray horan kaaraj na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ  ਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the affair of this marriage, truth, contentment, mercy and faith are produced; but how rare is that Gurmukh who understands it! ||3||
lines.transliteration: jit kaaraj sat  santokh da-i-aa Dh aram hai gurmukh  boojh ai ko-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, that Lord alone is the Husband of all.
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak sabh naa kaa pir ayko so-ay.

lines.english: She, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, becomes the happy soul-bride.||4||10|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (351-18) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay saa sohagan  ho-ay. ||4||10||

lines.english: Home and forest are the same, for one who dwells in the balance of intuitive peaceand poise.
lines.transliteration: garihu ban samsar sahj subhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਹਮਰਾ  ਵੀਆਹੁ ਿਜ ਹੋਆ  ਜ ਸਹੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਤ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: His evil-mindedness departs, and the Praises of God take its place.
lines.transliteration: durmat  gat bha-ee keerat  thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਿਹ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਹੈ ਆਪੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: To chant the True Name with one's mouth is the true ladder. pMnw 352
lines.transliteration: sach pa-orhee saacha-o mukh  naaN-o.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one finds one's own place within the self. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv paa-ay nij thaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: To conquer the mind is the knowledge of the six Shaastras.
lines.transliteration: man chooray khat d arsan jaan .

lines.english: The Divine Light of the Lord God is perfectly pervading. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab jot pooran bh agvaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Excessive thirst for Maya makes people wear all sorts of religious robes.
lines.transliteration: aDhik t i-aas bh aykh baho karai.

lines.english: The pain of corruption destroys the body's peace.
lines.transliteration: dukh bikhi-aa sukh  tan parharai.

lines.english: Sexual desire and anger steal the wealth of the self within.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ant ar Dh an hirai.

lines.english: But by abandoning duality, one is emancipated through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa chh od naam nist arai. ||2||

lines.english: In the Lord's Praise and adoration is intuitive peace, poise and bliss.
lines.transliteration: sifat salaahan  sahj anand.

lines.english: The Love of the Lord God is one's family and friends.
lines.transliteration: sakhaa sain paraym gobind .

lines.english: He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Forgiver.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay aapay bakhsind .

lines.english: My body and mind belong to the Lord; my life is at His Command. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tan man har peh aagai jind . ||3||

lines.english: Falsehood and corruption cause terrible suffering.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  vikaar mahaa d ukh dayh.

lines.english: All the religious robes and social classes look just like dust.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh  varan d eeseh sabh  khayh.

lines.english: Whoever is born, continues to come and go.
lines.transliteration: jo upjai so aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, only the Naam and the Lord's Command are eternal and everlasting.||4||11|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (352-5) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak asthir naam rajaa-ay. ||4||11||

lines.english: In the pool is the one incomparably beautiful lotus.
lines.transliteration: ayko sarvar kamal anoop.

lines.english: It blossoms continually; its form is pure and fragrant.
lines.transliteration: sadaa bigaasai parmal roop.

lines.english: The swans pick up the bright jewels.
lines.transliteration: oojal motee choogeh hans.

lines.english: They take on the essence of the All-powerful Lord of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa jagdeesai aNs. ||1||

lines.english: Whoever is seen, is subject to birth and death.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so upjai binsai.

lines.english: In the pool without water, the lotus is not seen. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin jal sarvar kamal na deesai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How rare are those who know and understand this secret.
lines.transliteration: birlaa boojhai paavai bh ayd.

lines.english: The Vedas continually speak of the three branches.
lines.transliteration: saakhaa t een kahai nit  bayd .

lines.english: One who merges into the knowledge of the Lord as absolute and related,
lines.transliteration: naad bind  kee surat  samaa-ay.
satgur sayv param pad  paa-ay. ||2|| serves the True Guru and obtains the supreme status. ||2||

lines.english: One who is imbued with the Love of the Lord and dwells continually upon Him is liberated.
lines.transliteration: mukto raat a-o rang ravaaNta-o.

lines.english: He is the king of kings, and blossoms forth continually.
lines.transliteration: raajan raaj sadaa bigsaaNta-o.

lines.english: That one whom You preserve, by bestowing Your Mercy, O Lord,
lines.transliteration: jis tooN raakh ahi kirpaa Dh aar.
boodat paahan t aareh t aar. ||3|| even the sinking stone - You float that one across. ||3||

lines.english: Your Light is pervading the three worlds; I know that You are permeating the threeworlds.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan meh jot  taribhavan meh jaan i-aa.

lines.english: When my mind turned away from Maya, I came to dwell in my own home.
lines.transliteration: ulat bha-ee gh ar ghar meh aan i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak falls at the feet of that person who immerses himself in the Lord's Love, andperforms devotional worship night and day. ||4||12|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (352-11) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ahinis bhagat  karay liv laa-ay. naanak t in kai laagai paa-ay. ||4||12||

lines.english: Receiving the True Teachings from the Guru, arguments depart.
lines.transliteration: gurmat saachee hujat  door.

lines.english: But through excessive cleverness, one is only plastered with dirt.
lines.transliteration: bahut si-aan ap laagai Dh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਉਲਟ  ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਆਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of attachment is removed by the True Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: laagee mail mitai sach naa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one remains lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad rahai liv laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: He is the Presence Ever-present; offer your prayers to Him.
lines.transliteration: hai hajoor haajar ardaas.

lines.english: Pain and pleasure are in the Hands of God, the True Creator. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  saach kart ay parabh  paas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who practices falsehood comes and goes.
lines.transliteration: koorh kamaavai aavai jaavai.

lines.english: By speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: kahan kathan vaaraa nahee aavai.

lines.english: Whatever one sees, is not understood.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa daykh aa soojh  boojh  na paavai.

lines.english: Without the Name, satisfaction does not enter into the mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai man taripat  na aavai. ||2||

lines.english: Whoever is born is afflicted by disease,
lines.transliteration: jo janmay say rog vi-aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa dookh  santaapay. tortured by the pain of egotism and Maya.

lines.english: They alone are saved, who are protected by God.
lines.transliteration: say jan baachay jo parabh raakh ay.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, they drink in the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv amrit  ras chaakh ay. ||3||

lines.english: The unstable mind is restrained by tasting this Nectar.
lines.transliteration: chalta-o man raakh ai amrit  chaakh ai.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one comes to cherish the Ambrosial Nectar of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv amrit  sabad  bhaakhai.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the state of liberation is obtained.
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad mukat  gat paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||13|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (352-18) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||4||13||

lines.english: Whatever He has done, has proved to be true.
lines.transliteration: jo tin kee-aa so sach thee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sat gur dee-aa.

lines.english: With the Naam in the heart, the mind is not separated from the Lord.
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam naahee man bh ang.

lines.english: Night and day, one dwells with the Beloved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din naal pi-aaray sang. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, please keep me in the Protection of Your Sanctuary. pMnw 353
lines.transliteration: har jee-o raakho apnee sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord; I have received the wealth of the Naam and the nine treasures. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har ras paa-i-aa naam padaarath na-o niDh  paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those whose karma and Dharma - whose actions and faith - are in the True Name ofthe True Lord
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam sach saachaa naa-o.

lines.english: - I am forever a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: taa kai sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Lord are accepted and respected.
lines.transliteration: jo har raatay say jan parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: In their company, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kee sangat  param niDh aan. ||2||

lines.english: Blessed is that bride, who has obtained the Lord as her Husband.
lines.transliteration: har var jin paa-i-aa Dhan naaree.

lines.english: She is imbued with the Lord, and she reflects upon the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har si-o raatee sabad  veechaaree.

lines.english: She saves herself, and saves her family and friends as well.
lines.transliteration: aap tarai sangat  kul taarai.

lines.english: She serves the True Guru, and contemplates the essence of reality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv t at veechaarai. ||3||

lines.english: The True Name is my social status and honor.
lines.transliteration: hamree jaat pat  sach naa-o.

lines.english: The love of the Truth is my karma and Dharma - my faith and my actions, and my self-control.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam sanjam sat  bhaa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who is forgiven by the Lord is not called to account.
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhsay poochh  na ho-ay.

lines.english: The One Lord erases duality. ||4||14|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (353-5) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: doojaa maytay ayko so-ay. ||4||14||

lines.english: Some come, and after they come, they go.
lines.transliteration: ik aavahi ik jaaveh aa-ee.

lines.english: Some are imbued with the Lord; they remain absorbed in Him.
lines.transliteration: ik har raatay raheh samaa-ee.

lines.english: Some find no place of rest at all, on the earth or in the sky.
lines.transliteration: ik Dharan gagan meh th a-ur na paavahi.

lines.english: Those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord are the most unfortunate. ||1||
lines.transliteration: say karamheen har naam na Dh i-aavahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਧਰਿਨ  ਗਗਨ  ਮਿਹ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, the way to salvation is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay gat  mit paa-ee.

lines.english: This world is a terrifying ocean of poison; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord helps us cross over. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih sansaar bikh vat  at bha-ojal gur sabd ee har paar langh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those, whom God unites with Himself,
lines.transliteration: jinH ka-o aap la-ay parabh mayl.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਿਬਖੁ ਵਤ ਅਿਤ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o kaal na saakai payl. cannot be crushed by death.

lines.english: The beloved Gurmukhs remain immaculately pure,
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nirmal raheh pi-aaray.
ji-o jal ambh oopar kamal niraaray. ||2|| like the lotus in the water, which remains untouched. ||2||

lines.english: Tell me: who should we call good or bad?
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa kaho kis no kahee-ai.

lines.english: Behold the Lord God; the truth is revealed to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: deesai barahm gurmukh  sach lahee-ai.

lines.english: I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, contemplating the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: akath katha-o gurmat veechaar.

lines.english: I join the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, and I find God's limits. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mil gur sangat paava-o paar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਸੈ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Shaastras, the Vedas, the Simritees and all their many secrets;
lines.transliteration: saasat bayd  simrit  baho bh ayd.
athsath  majan har ras rayd . bathing at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage - all this is found by enshrining the sublime essence of the Lord in the heart.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are immaculately pure; no filth sticks to them.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nirmal mail na laagai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in the heart, by the greatest pre-ordained destiny. ||4||15|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (353-12) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hirdai naam vaday Dh ur bhaagai. ||4||15||

lines.english: Bowing down, again and again, I fall at the Feet of my Guru; through Him, I have seen the Lord, the Divine Self, within.
lines.transliteration: niv niv paa-ay laga-o gur apunay aatam raam nihaari-aa.

lines.english: Through contemplation and meditation, the Lord dwells within the heart; see this, andunderstand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karat beechaar hird ai har ravi-aa hird ai daykh beechaari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: So speak the Lord's Name, which shall emancipate you.
lines.transliteration: bolhu raam karay nistaaraa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the jewel of the Lord is found; ignorance is dispelled, and the DivineLight shines forth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad rat an har laabh ai mitai agi-aan ho-ay ujee-aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਿਵ  ਿਨਿਵ  ਪਾਇ  ਲਗਉ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਨਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: By merely saying it with the tongue, one's bonds are not broken, and egotism anddoubt do not depart from within.
lines.transliteration: ravnee ravai banDhan nahee t ooteh vich ha-umai bh aram na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਹਰਦੈ ਦੇਿਖ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But when one meets the True Guru, egotism departs, and then, one realizes hisdestiny. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a ha-umai t ootai t aa ko laykh ai paa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and dear to His devotees; it is the ocean ofpeace - enshrine it within the heart.
lines.transliteration: har har naam bhagat  pari-a pareet am sukh  saagar ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਭੈ ਿਮਟੈ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lover of His devotees, the Life of the World, the Lord bestows the Guru'sTeachings upon the intellect, and one is emancipated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al jagjeevan d aataa mat  gurmat  har nist aaray. ||3||

lines.english: One who dies fighting against his own stubborn mind finds God, and the desires of the mind are quieted.
lines.transliteration: man si-o joojh marai parabh  paa-ay mansaa maneh samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਵਨੀ  ਰਵੈ ਬੰਧਨ  ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟਿਹ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the Life of the World bestows His Mercy, one is intuitively attuned to theLove of the Lord. ||4||16|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (353-18) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa karay jagjeevan sahj bhaa-ay liv laa-ay. ||4||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Unto whom do they speak? Unto whom do they preach? Who understands? Let themunderstand themselves.
lines.transliteration: kis ka-o kaheh sunaaveh kis ka-o kis samjh aavahi samajh  rahay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Who do they teach? Through study, they come to realize the Lord's Glorious Virtues. Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, they come to dwell in contentment.||1|| pMnw 354
lines.transliteration: kisai parhaaveh parh  gun boojh ay sat gur sabad  santokh rahay. ||1||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, realize that He is pervading in all bodies;
lines.transliteration: aisaa gurmat ramat  sareeraa.

lines.english: O my soul, vibrate on the Profound, Unfathomable Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bhaj mayray man gahir gambh eeraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Loving devotion to the Lord brings endless waves of joy and delight.
lines.transliteration: anat t arang bh agat har rangaa.

lines.english: One who dwells with the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, is sanctified.
lines.transliteration: an-din soochay har gun  sangaa.

lines.english: The birth into the world of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa janam saakat sansaaraa.

lines.english: The humble devotee of the Lord remains unattached. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam bhagat  jan rahai niraaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The body which sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is sanctified.
lines.transliteration: soochee kaa-i-aa har gun gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The soul remains conscious of the Lord, absorbed in His Love.
lines.transliteration: aatam cheen rahai liv laa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord is the Infinite Primal Being, beyond the beyond, the priceless jewel.
lines.transliteration: aad apaar aprampar heeraa.

lines.english: My mind is totally content, imbued with my Beloved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: laal rataa mayraa man Dh eeraa. ||3||

lines.english: Those who speak and babble on and on, are truly dead.
lines.transliteration: kathnee kaheh kaheh say moo-ay.

lines.english: God is not far away - O God, You are right here.
lines.transliteration: so parabh d oor naahee parabh  tooN hai.

lines.english: I have seen that the whole world is engrossed in Maya.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag d aykhi-aa maa-i-aa chh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||17|| Awsw mhlw 1 iqqukw ] (354-6) aasaa mehlaa 1 tit ukaa. Aasaa, First Mehl, Ti-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||4||17||

lines.english: One is a beggar, living on charity;
lines.transliteration: ko-ee bheekh ak bh eekhi-aa kh aa-ay.
ko-ee raajaa rahi-aa samaa-ay. another is a king, absorbed in himself.

lines.english: One receives honor, and another dishonor.
lines.transliteration: kis hee maan kisai apmaan.

lines.english: The Lord destroys and creates; He is enshrined in His meditation.
lines.transliteration: dhaahi usaaray Dh aray Dh i-aan.

lines.english: There is no other as great as You.
lines.transliteration: tujh tay vadaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: So whom should I present to You? Who is good enough? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kis vaykhaalee changa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.
lines.transliteration: mai taaN naam t ayraa aaDh aar.

lines.english: You are the Great Giver, the Doer, the Creator. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN daataa karanhaar kart aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have not walked on Your Path; I have followed the crooked path.
lines.transliteration: vaat na paava-o veegaa jaa-o.

lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, I find no place to sit.
lines.transliteration: dargeh baisan  naahee thaa-o.

lines.english: I am mentally blind, in the bondage of Maya.
lines.transliteration: man kaa anDhulaa maa-i-aa kaa banDh .

lines.english: The wall of my body is breaking down, wearing away, growing weaker.
lines.transliteration: kheen kh araab hovai nit  kanDh .

lines.english: You have such high hopes of eating and living
lines.transliteration: khaan  jeevan  kee bahut ee aas.
laykhai t ayrai saas giraas. ||2|| - your breaths and morsels of food are already counted! ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Night and day they are blind - please, bless them with Your Light.
lines.transliteration: ahinis anDhulay d eepak d ay-ay.

lines.english: They are drowning in the terrifying world-ocean, crying out in pain.
lines.transliteration: bha-ojal doobat  chint  karay-i.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant, hear and believe in the Name.
lines.transliteration: kaheh suneh jo maaneh naa-o. ha-o balihaarai t aa kai jaa-o.

lines.english: Nanak utters this one prayer;
lines.transliteration: naanak ayk kahai ardaas.
jee-o pind sabh t ayrai paas. ||3|| soul and body, all belong to You, Lord. ||3||

lines.english: When You bless me, I chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: jaaN tooN deh japee t ayraa naa-o.

lines.english: Thus I find my seat in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dargeh baisan  hovai thaa-o.

lines.english: When it pleases You, evil-mindedness departs,
lines.transliteration: jaaN tuDh  bhaavai t aa durmat  jaa-ay.
gi-aan ratan man vasai aa-ay. and the jewel of spiritual wisdom comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one comes to meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa sat gur milai.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||18|| Awsw mhlw 1 pMcpdy ] (354-14) aasaa mehlaa 1 panchpaday. Aasaa, First Mehl, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak bh avjal t arai. ||4||18||

lines.english: A cow without milk; a bird without wings; a garden without water - totally useless!
lines.transliteration: duDh bin Dh ayn pankh  bin pankh ee jal bin ut -bhuj kaam naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: What is an emperor, without respect? The chamber of the soul is so dark, without the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa sultaan salaam vihoon aa anDh ee koth ee tayraa naam naahee. ||1||

lines.english: How could I ever forget You? It would be so painful!
lines.transliteration: kee visrahi dukh  bahut aa laagai.

lines.english: I would suffer such pain - no, I shall not forget You! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dukh laagai t ooN visar naahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The eyes grow blind, the tongue does not taste, and the ears do not hear any sound.
lines.transliteration: akhee anDh  jeebh  ras naahee kannee pavan  na vaajai.

lines.english: He walks on his feet only when supported by someone else; without serving the Lord,such are the fruits of life. ||2||
lines.transliteration: charnee chalai pajoot aa aagai vin  sayvaa fal laagay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਧ ਿਬਨੁ ਧੇਨੁ ਪੰਖ ਿਬਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਉਤਭੁਜ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Word is the tree; the garden of the heart is the farm; tend it, and irrigate it withthe Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: akhar birakh  baag bh u-ay chokh ee sinchit  bhaa-o karayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਸਲਾਮ  ਿਵਹੂਣਾ ਅੰਧੀ  ਕੋਠੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All these trees bear the fruit of the Name of the One Lord; but without the karma ofgood actions, how can anyone obtain it? ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa fal laagai naam ayko bin karmaa kaisay layhee. ||3||

lines.english: As many living beings are there are, they are all Yours. Without selfless service, noone obtains any reward.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a t aytay sabh  tayray vin  sayvaa fal kisai naahee.

lines.english: Pain and pleasure come by Your Will; without the Name, the soul does not even exist. ||4||
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  bhaanaa tayraa hovai vin  naavai jee-o rahai naahee. ||4||

lines.english: To die in the Teachings is to live. Otherwise, what is life? That is not the way. pMnw 355
lines.transliteration: mat vich maran  jeevan  hor kaisaa jaa jeevaa t aaN jugat  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਜਾ ਜੀਵਾ  ਤ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, He grants life to the living beings; O Lord, please keep me according to Your Will. ||5||19|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (355-2) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jeevaalay jee-aa jah bhaavai t ah raakh  tuhee. ||5||19||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜੀਵਾਲੇ  ਜੀਆ  ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੫॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Let the body be the Brahmin, and let the mind be the loin-cloth;
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa barahmaa man hai Dhot ee.
gi-aan janay-oo Dhi-aan kuspaat ee. let spiritual wisdom be the sacred thread, and meditation the ceremonial ring.

lines.english: I seek the Name of the Lord and His Praise as my cleansing bath.
lines.transliteration: har naamaa jas jaacha-o naa-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I am absorbed into God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee barahm samaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate God in such a way
lines.transliteration: paaNday aisaa barahm beechaar.
naamay such naamo parha-o naamay chaj aachaar. ||1|| rahaa-o. that His Name may sanctify you, that His Name may be your study, and His Name your wisdom and way of life. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The outer sacred thread is worthwhile only as long as the Divine Light is within.
lines.transliteration: baahar janay-oo jichar jot hai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਿਚ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਚਜੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhotee tikaa naam samaal. So make the remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your loin-cloth andthe ceremonial mark on your forehead.
Here and hereafter, the Name alone shall stand by you.
lines.transliteration: aithai othai nibhee naal.

lines.english: Do not seek any other actions, except the Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vin naavai hor karam na bh aal. ||2||

lines.english: Worship the Lord in loving adoration, and burn your desire for Maya.
lines.transliteration: poojaa paraym maa-i-aa parjaal.

lines.english: Behold only the One Lord, and do not seek out any other.
lines.transliteration: ayko vaykhhu avar na bh aal.

lines.english: Become aware of reality, in the Sky of the Tenth Gate;
lines.transliteration: cheenHai tat gagan d as du-aar.
har mukh paath  parhai beechaar. ||3|| read aloud the Lord's Word, and contemplate it. ||3||

lines.english: With the diet of His Love, doubt and fear depart.
lines.transliteration: bhojan bh aa-o bh aram bh a-o bh aagai.

lines.english: With the Lord as your night watchman, no thief will dare to break in.
lines.transliteration: paahroo-araa chhab chor na laagai.

lines.english: Let the knowledge of the One God be the ceremonial mark on your forehead.
lines.transliteration: tilak lilaat jaan ai parabh  ayk.

lines.english: Let the realization that God is within you be your discrimination. ||4||
lines.transliteration: boojhai barahm ant ar bibayk. ||4||

lines.english: Through ritual actions, God cannot be won over;
lines.transliteration: aachaaree nahee jeeti-aa jaa-ay.
paath parh ai nahee keemat  paa-ay. by reciting sacred scriptures, His value cannot be estimated.

lines.english: The eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas do not know His mystery.
lines.transliteration: asat dasee chahu bh ayd na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Guru has shown me the Lord God. ||5||20|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (355-9) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur barahm d ikhaa-i-aa. ||5||20||

lines.english: He alone is the selfless servant, slave and humble devotee,
lines.transliteration: sayvak daas bh agat jan so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਟ  ਦਸੀ ਚਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur kaa d aas gurmukh  ho-ee. who as Gurmukh, becomes the slave of his Lord and Master.

lines.english: He, who created the Universe, shall ultimately destroy it.
lines.transliteration: jin sir saajee tin fun go-ee.

lines.english: Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa avar na ko-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh reflects upon the True Name; in the True Court, he is found to be true. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saach naam gur sabad veechaar. gurmukh  saachay saachai d arbaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The true supplication, the true prayer
lines.transliteration: sachaa araj sachee ardaas.
mahlee khasam sun ay saabaas. - within the Mansion of His Sublime Presence, the True Lord Master hears andapplauds these.

lines.english: He summons the truthful to His Heavenly Throne
lines.transliteration: sachai takh at bulaavai so-ay.
day vadi-aa-ee karay so ho-ay. ||2|| and bestows glorious greatness upon them; that which He wills, comes to pass. ||2||

lines.english: The Power is Yours; You are my only Support.
lines.transliteration: tayraa t aan toohai d eebaan .

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my true password.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad sach neesaan .

lines.english: One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, goes to Him openly.
lines.transliteration: mannay hukam so pargat jaa-ay.

lines.english: With the password of truth, his way is not blocked. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sach neesaanai th aak na paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Pandit reads and expounds on the Vedas,
lines.transliteration: pandit parh eh vakaan eh vayd .
antar vasat  na jaan eh bh ayd. but he does not know the secret of the thing within himself.

lines.english: Without the Guru, understanding and realization are not obtained;
lines.transliteration: gur bin sojhee boojh  na ho-ay.
saachaa rav rahi-aa parabh so-ay. ||4|| but still God is True, pervading everywhere. ||4||

lines.english: What should I say, or speak or describe?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ha-o aakhaa aakh  vakh aanee.

lines.english: Only You Yourself know, O Lord of total wonder.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay jaan eh sarab vidaan ee.

lines.english: Nanak takes the Support of the Door of the One God.
lines.transliteration: naanak ayko dar d eebaan .

lines.english: There, at the True Door, the Gurmukhs sustain themselves. ||5||21|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (355-16) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saach t ahaa gud raan. ||5||21||

lines.english: The clay pitcher of the body is miserable; it suffers in pain through birth and death.
lines.transliteration: kaachee gaagar dayh d uhaylee upjai binsai d ukh paa-ee.

lines.english: How can this terrifying world-ocean be crossed over? Without the Lord - Guru, itcannot be crossed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih jag saagar dut ar ki-o t aree-ai bin har gur paar na paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all, O my Beloved; without you, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na ko-ee mayray pi-aaray t ujh bin avar na ko-ay haray.

lines.english: You are in all colors and forms; he alone is forgiven, upon whom You bestow YourGlance of Grace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarbee rangee roopee tooNhai tis bakh say jis nad ar karay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Maya, my mother-in-law, is evil; she does not let me live in my own home. The vicious one does not let me meet with my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: saas buree ghar vaas na d ayvai pir si-o milan  na day-ay buree.

lines.english: I serve at the feet of my companions and friends; the Lord has showered me with His Mercy, through Guru's Grace. ||2|| pMnw 356
lines.transliteration: sakhee saajnee kay ha-o charan sarayva-o har gur kirpaa t ay nad ar Dh aree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਚਰਨ  ਸਰੇਵਉ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਨਦਿਰ  ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Reflecting upon my self, and conquering my mind, I have seen that there is no other friend like You.
lines.transliteration: aap beechaar maar man daykh i-aa tum saa meet  na avar ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਨੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਤੁਮ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: As You keep me, so do I live. You are the Giver of peace and pleasure. Whatever Youdo, comes to pass. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o tooN raakh ahi tiv hee rahn aa dukh sukh  dayveh karahi so-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਿਤਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Hope and desire have both been dispelled; I have renounced my longing for the threequalities.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa do-oo binaasat  tarihu gun  aas niraas bh a-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ ਦੋਊ ਿਬਨਾਸਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਆਸ  ਿਨਰਾਸ  ਭਈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the state of ecstasy, taking to the Shelter of the Saints'Congregation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: turee-aavasthaa gurmukh  paa-ee-ai sant  sabh aa kee ot lahee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ ॥੪॥
lines.english: All wisdom and meditation, all chanting and penance, come to one whose heart isfilled with the Invisible, Inscrutable Lord.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan saglay sabh  jap tap jis har hird ai alakh  abhayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਸਿਭ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one whose mind is imbued with the Lord's Name, finds the Guru'sTeachings, and intuitively serves. ||5||22|| Awsw mhlw 1 pMcpdy ] (356-5) aasaa mehlaa 1 panchpaday. Aasaa, First Mehl, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam man raataa gurmat  paa-ay sahj sayvaa. ||5||22||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਵਾ ॥੫॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Your attachment to your family, your attachment to all your affairs
lines.transliteration: moh kutamb moh sabh kaar.
moh tum t ajahu sagal vaykaar. ||1|| - renounce all your attachments, for they are all corrupt. ||1||

lines.english: Renounce your attachments and doubts, O brother,
lines.transliteration: moh ar bharam t ajahu t umH beer.
saach naam riday ravai sareer. ||1|| rahaa-o. and dwell upon the True Name within your heart and body. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਤਜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਬੀਰ ॥
lines.english: When one receives the nine treasures of the True Name,
lines.transliteration: sach naam jaa nav niDh paa-ee.
rovai poot na kalpai maa-ee. ||2|| his children do not weep, and his mother does not grieve. ||2||

lines.english: In this attachment, the world is drowning.
lines.transliteration: ayt mohi doobaa sansaar.

lines.english: Few are the Gurmukhs who swim across. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ko-ee ut rai paar. ||3||

lines.english: In this attachment, people are reincarnated over and over again.
lines.transliteration: ayt mohi fir joonee paahi.

lines.english: Attached to emotional attachment, they go to the city of Death. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mohay laagaa jam pur jaahi. ||4||

lines.english: You have received the Guru's Teachings - now practice meditation and penance.
lines.transliteration: gur deekh i-aa lay jap t ap kamaahi.

lines.english: If attachment is not broken, no one is approved. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naa moh tootai naa thaa-ay paahi. ||5||

lines.english: But if He bestows His Glance of Grace, then this attachment departs.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa ayhu moh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਿਖਆ  ਲੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, then one remains merged in the Lord. ||6||23|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (356-10) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har si-o rahai samaa-ay. ||6||23||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਾ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He Himself does everything, the True, Invisible, Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap karay sach alakh apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, You are the Forgiver. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-o paapee tooN bakh sanhaar. ||1||

lines.english: By Your Will, everything come to pass.
lines.transliteration: tayraa bh aanaa sabh  kichh  hovai.

lines.english: One who acts in stubborn-mindedness is ruined in the end. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: manhath keechai ant  vigovai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is engrossed in falsehood.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kee mat  koorh  vi-aapee.

lines.english: Without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, it suffers in sin. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin har simran paap sant aapee. ||2||

lines.english: Renounce evil-mindedness, and you shall reap the rewards.
lines.transliteration: durmat  ti-aag laahaa kichh  layvhu.

lines.english: Whoever is born, comes through the Unknowable and Mysterious Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo upjai so alakh abh ayvhu. ||3||

lines.english: Such is my Friend and Companion;
lines.transliteration: aisaa hamraa sakhaa sahaa-ee.
gur har mili-aa bhagat  darirhaa-ee. ||4|| meeting with the Guru, the Lord, devotion was implanted within me. ||4||

lines.english: In all other transactions, one suffers loss.
lines.transliteration: sagleeN sa-odeeN totaa aavai.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||5||24|| Awsw mhlw 1 caupdy ] (356-14) aasaa mehlaa 1 cha-upday. Aasaa, First Mehl, Chau-Padas:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam man bhaavai. ||5||24||

lines.english: Contemplate and reflect upon knowledge, and you will become a benefactor to others.
lines.transliteration: vidi-aa veechaaree t aaN par-upkaaree.

lines.english: When you conquer the five passions, then you shall come to dwell at the sacred shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaaN panch raasee taaN tirath vaasee. ||1||

lines.english: You shall hear the vibrations of the tinkling bells, when your mind is held steady.
lines.transliteration: ghungh roo vaajai jay man laagai.

lines.english: So what can the Messenger of Death do to me hereafter? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ta-o jam kahaa karay mo si-o aagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When you abandon hope and desire, then you become a true Sannyaasi.
lines.transliteration: aas niraasee ta-o sani-aasee.

lines.english: When the Yogi practices abstinence, then he enjoys his body. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaaN jat jogee t aaN kaa-i-aa bh ogee. ||2||

lines.english: Through compassion, the naked hermit reflects upon his inner self.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa d igambar d ayh beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਪੰਚ ਰਾਸੀ  ਤ ਤੀਰਥ  ਵਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He slays his own self, instead of slaying others. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap marai avraa nah maaree. ||3||

lines.english: You, O Lord, are the One, but You have so many Forms.
lines.transliteration: ayk too hor vays bahut ayray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਜਮੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੋ ਿਸਉ ਆਗੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak does not know Your wondrous plays. ||4||25|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (356-18) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaanai choj na t ayray. ||4||25||

lines.english: I am not stained by only one sin, that could be washed clean by virtue.
lines.transliteration: ayk na bharee-aa gun  kar Dh ovaa.

lines.english: My Husband Lord is awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayraa saho jaagai ha-o nis bhar sovaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਜਤੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਤ ਕਾਇਆ  ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In this way, how can I become dear to my Husband Lord?
lines.transliteration: i-o ki-o kant pi-aaree hovaa.

lines.english: My Husband Lord remains awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 357
lines.transliteration: saho jaagai ha-o nis bhar sovaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With hope and desire, I approach His Bed,
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aasee sayjai aavaa.
aagai sah bhaavaa ke na bh aavaa. ||2|| but I do not know whether He will be pleased with me or not. ||2||

lines.english: How do I know what will happen to me, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jaanaa ki-aa ho-igaa ree maa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I cannot survive. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har darsan bin rahan na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have not tasted His Love, and my thirst is not quenched.
lines.transliteration: paraym na chaakhi-aa mayree t is na bujh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਤਸ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: My beautiful youth has run away, and now I, the soul-bride, repent and regret. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ga-i-aa so joban Dhan pachh utaanee. ||3||

lines.english: Even now, I am held by hope and desire.
lines.transliteration: ajai so jaaga-o aas pi-aasee.

lines.english: I am depressed; I have no hope at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-eelay ud aasee raha-o niraasee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: She overcomes her egotism, and adorns herself;
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kho-ay karay seegaar.
ta-o kaaman  sayjai ravai bh ataar. ||4|| the Husband Lord now ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride on His Bed. ||4||

lines.english: Then, O Nanak, the bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of her Husband Lord;
lines.transliteration: ta-o naanak kant ai man bh aavai.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 1 ] (357-5) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chhod vadaa-ee apn ay kh asam samaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o. ||26|| she sheds her self-conceit, and is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||26||

lines.english: In this world of my father's house, I, the soul-bride, have been very childish;
lines.transliteration: payvkarhai Dh an kh aree i-aan ee.

lines.english: I did not realize the value of my Husband Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis sah kee mai saar na jaan ee. ||1||

lines.english: My Husband is the One; there is no other like Him.
lines.transliteration: saho mayraa ayk doojaa nahee ko-ee.

lines.english: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay maylaavaa ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the next world of my in-law's house, I, the the soul-bride, shall realize Truth;
lines.transliteration: saahurrhai Dh an saach pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I shall come to know the celestial peace of my Husband Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay apn aa pir jaan i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, such wisdom comes to me,
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aisee mat aavai.
taaN kaaman  kantai man bh aavai. ||3|| so that the soul-bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of the Husband Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, she who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak bh ai bhaav kaa karay seegaar.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 1 ] (357-9) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sad hee sayjai ravai bh ataar. ||4||27|| enjoys her Husband Lord forever on His Bed. ||4||27||

lines.english: No one is anyone else's son, and no one is anyone else's mother.
lines.transliteration: na kis kaa poot na kis kee maa-ee.

lines.english: Through false attachments, people wander around in doubt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhooth ai mohi bh aram bh ulaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O My Lord and Master, I am created by You.
lines.transliteration: mayray saahib ha-o keetaa t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਭੈ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If You give it to me, I will chant Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaaN tooN deh japee naa-o t ayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That person who is filled with all sorts of sins may pray at the Lord's Door,
lines.transliteration: bahutay a-ugan  kookai ko-ee.
jaa tis bh aavai bakh say so-ee. ||2|| but he is forgiven only when the Lord so wills. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਿਕਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, evil-mindedness is destroyed.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee durmat  kho-ee.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah ayko so-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, if one comes to such an understanding,
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak aisee mat  aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਉ  ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Awsw mhlw 1 dupdy ] (357-12) aasaa mehlaa 1 dupd ay. Aasaa, First Mehl, Du-Padas:
lines.transliteration: taaN ko sachay sach samaavai. ||4||28|| then he is absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||4||28||

lines.english: In that pool of the world, the people have their homes; there, the Lord has created water and fire.
lines.transliteration: tit saravrarh ai bha-eelay nivaasaa paan ee paavak t ineh kee-aa.

lines.english: In the mud of earthly attachment, their feet have become mired, and I have seenthem drowning there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pankaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham daykh aa tah doobee-alay. ||1||

lines.english: O foolish people, why don't you remember the One Lord?
lines.transliteration: man ayk na chaytas moorh  manaa.

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bisrat t ayray gun  gali-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am not a celibate, nor am I truthful, nor a scholar; I was born foolish and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o jatee sat ee nahee parh i-aa moorakh  mugDh aa janam bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who do not forget You, Lord. ||2||29|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (357-16) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak t inH kee sarn aa jinH tooN naahee veesri-aa. ||2||29||

lines.english: There are six systems of philosophy, six teachers, and six doctrines;
lines.transliteration: chhi-a gh ar chh i-a gur chh i-a upd ays.
gur gur ayko vays anayk. ||1|| but the Teacher of teachers is the One Lord, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

lines.english: That system, where the Praises of the Creator are sung
lines.transliteration: jai ghar kart ay keerat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਕਜੁ  ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ  ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so ghar raakh  vadaa-ee t ohi. ||1|| rahaa-o. - follow that system; in it rests greatness. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਸ  ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: As the seconds, minutes, hours, days, weekdays months and seasons all originatefrom the one sun,
lines.transliteration: visu-ay chasi-aa gharh ee-aa pahraa thit ee vaaree maahu bh a-i-aa. sooraj ayko rut anayk.

lines.english: O Nanak, so do all forms originate from the One Creator. ||2||30|| pMnw 358 <> siqgur pRswid ] (358-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw Gru 3 mhlw 1 ] (358-1) aasaa ghar 3 mehlaa 1. Aasaa, Third House, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kartay kay kayt ay vays. ||2||30||

lines.english: You may have thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and lances, and thousands of men to rise and salute you.
lines.transliteration: lakh laskar lakh  vaajay nayjay lakh  uth karahi salaam.

lines.english: Your rule may extend over thousands of miles, and thousands of men may rise tohonor you.
lines.transliteration: lakhaa upar furmaa-is t ayree lakh  uth raakh ahi maan.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ  ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖ ਉਿਠ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਲਾਮੁ  ॥
lines.english: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of your ostentatious show is useless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaaN pat laykh ai naa pavai t aaN sabh  niraafal kaam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲਖਾ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਫੁਰਮਾਇਿਸ  ਤੇਰੀ ਲਖ ਉਿਠ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, the world is in turmoil.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam binaa jag DhanDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਪਿਤ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤ ਸਿਭ ਿਨਰਾਫਲ  ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even though the fool may be taught again and again, he remains the blindest of theblind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay bahutaa samjaa-ee-ai bh olaa bh ee so anDh o anDh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You may earn thousands, collect thousands, and spend thousands of dollars;thousands may come, and thousands may go.
lines.transliteration: lakh kh atee-ah lakh  sanjee-ah kh aajeh lakh  aavahi lakh  jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ  ਭੋਲਾ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then where will you go to find a safehaven? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaaN pat laykh ai naa pavai t aaN jee-a kithai fir paahi. ||2||

lines.english: Thousands of Shaastras may be explained to the mortal, and thousands of Panditsmay read the Puraanas to him;
lines.transliteration: lakh saasat  samjh aavan ee lakh  pandit  parheh puraan .

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਿਹ  ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਿਹ  ਖਾਜਿਹ  ਲਖ ਆਵਿਹ  ਲਖ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaaN pat laykh ai naa pavai t aaN sabh ay kuparvaan . ||3|| but, if his honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of this is unacceptable. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਪਿਤ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤ ਜੀਅ  ਿਕਥੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਪਾਿਹ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Honor comes from the True Name, the Name of the Merciful Creator.
lines.transliteration: sach naam pat oopjai karam naam kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ  ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ  ਲਖ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਪੁਰਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: If it abides in the heart, day and night, O Nanak, then the mortal shall swim across, by His Grace. ||4||1||31|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (358-7) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ahinis hirdai jay vasai naanak nad ree paar. ||4||1||31||

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਪਿਤ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The One Name is my lamp; I have put the oil of suffering into it.
lines.transliteration: deevaa mayraa ayk naam d ukh vich paa-i-aa t ayl.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਪਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Its flame has dried up this oil, and I have escaped my meeting with the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: un chaanan oh sokh i-aa chookaa jam si-o mayl. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.english: O people, do not make fun of me.
lines.transliteration: lokaa mat ko fakarh  paa-ay.

lines.english: Thousands of wooden logs, piled up together, need only a tiny flame to burn.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lakh marh i-aa kar aykth ay ayk rat ee lay bh aahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਵਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇਲੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is my festive dish, of rice balls on leafy plates; the True Name of the CreatorLord is my funeral ceremony.
lines.transliteration: pind patal mayree kaysa-o kiri-aa sach naam kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਉਿਨ  ਚਾਨਿਣ  ਓਹੁ ਸੋਿਖਆ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਜਮ ਿਸਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, in the past and in the future, this is my support. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aithai othai aagai paachhai ayhu mayraa aaDh aar. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord's Praise is my River Ganges and my city of Benares; my soul takes its sacredcleansing bath there.
lines.transliteration: gang banaaras sifat t umaaree naavai aat am raa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਮਿੜਆ  ਕਿਰ ਏਕਠੇ  ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That becomes my true cleansing bath, if night and day, I enshrine love for You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sachaa naavan t aaN thee-ai jaaN ahinis laagai bh aa-o. ||3||

lines.english: The rice balls are offered to the gods and the dead ancestors, but it is the Brahmins who eat them!
lines.transliteration: ik lokee hor chhamichh aree baraahman  vat pind kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਤਿਲ  ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the rice balls of the Lord are a gift which is never exhausted. ||4||2||32|| Awsw Gru 4 mhlw 1 (358-12) aasaa ghar 4 mehlaa 1 Aasaa, Fourth House, First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (358-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak pind bakhsees kaa kabahooN nikhootas naahi. ||4||2||32||

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ  ਪਾਛੈ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gods, yearning for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, suffered throughpain and hunger at the sacred shrines.
lines.transliteration: dayvit i-aa d arsan kai t aa-ee d ookh bhookh tirath kee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਿਸ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The yogis and the celibates live their disciplined lifestyle, while others wear saffronrobes and become hermits. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee jugat  meh raht ay kar kar bh agvay bh aykh bha-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਤ ਥੀਐ  ਜ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: For Your sake, O Lord Master, they are imbued with love.
lines.transliteration: ta-o kaaran  saahibaa rang rat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਿਮਛਰੀ  ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ  ਵਿਟ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your Names are so many, and Your Forms are endless. No one can tell how mayGlorious Virtues You have. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray naam anaykaa roop anant aa kahan  na jaahee t ayray gun  kaytay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Leaving behind hearth and home, palaces, elephants, horses and native lands, mortals have journeyed to foreign lands.
lines.transliteration: dar gh ar mehlaa hast ee gh orhay chh od vilaa-it  days ga-ay.

lines.english: The spiritual leaders, prophets, seers and men of faith renounced the world, andbecame acceptable. ||2||
lines.transliteration: peer paykaaNbar saalik saadik chh odee d unee-aa thaa-ay pa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਿਤਆ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ  ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: Renouncing tasty delicacies, comfort, happiness and pleasures, some have abandonedtheir clothes and now wear skins.
lines.transliteration: saad sahj sukh  ras kas t ajee-alay kaaparh  chhoday chamarh  lee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜਤੀ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਰਹਤੇ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਭਗਵੇ  ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who suffer in pain, imbued with Your Name, have become beggars at YourDoor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dukhee-ay d aradvand dar tayrai naam rat ay darvays bh a-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Some wear skins, and carry begging bowls, bearing wooden staffs, and sitting on deerskins. Others raise their hair in tufts and wear sacred threads and loin-cloths.
lines.transliteration: khalrh ee kh apree lakrh ee chamrh ee sikh aa soot  Dhotee keenHee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ  ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ  ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Lord Master, I am just Your puppet. Prays Nanak, what is my social statusto be? ||4||1||33|| pMnw 359 Awsw Gru 5 mhlw 1 (359-1) aasaa ghar 5 mehlaa 1 Aasaa, Fifth House, First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (359-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: tooN saahib ha-o saaNgee tayraa paran vai naanak jaat  kaisee. ||4||1||33||

lines.english: The five evil passions dwell hidden within the mind.
lines.transliteration: bheet ar panch gupat  man vaasay.

lines.english: They do not remain still, but move around like wanderers. ||1||
lines.transliteration: thir na raheh jaisay bhaveh ud aasay. ||1||

lines.english: My soul does not stay held by the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayraa da-i-aal sayt ee thir na rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੇਤੀ ਿਥਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: It is greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical, and totally attached to Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lobhee kaptee paapee paakh andee maa-i-aa aDh ik lagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਪਾਖੰਡੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਅਿਧਕ  ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I will decorate my neck with garlands of flowers.
lines.transliteration: fool maalaa gal pahir-ugee haaro.

lines.english: When I meet my Beloved, then I will put on my decorations. ||2||
lines.transliteration: milaigaa pareetam t ab kar-ugee seegaaro. ||2||

lines.english: I have five companions and one Spouse.
lines.transliteration: panch sakhee ham ayk bh ataaro.

lines.english: It is ordained from the very beginning, that the soul must ultimately depart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: payd lagee hai jee-arhaa chaalan haaro. ||3||

lines.english: The five companions will lament together.
lines.transliteration: panch sakhee mil rud an karayhaa.

lines.english: When the soul is trapped, prays Nanak, it is called to account. ||4||1||34|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (359-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw Gru 6 mhlw 1 ] (359-8) aasaa ghar 6 mehlaa 1. Aasaa, Sixth House, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saahu pajootaa paran vat naanak laykh aa dayhaa. ||4||1||34||

lines.english: If the pearl of the mind is strung like a jewel on the thread of the breath,
lines.transliteration: man motee jay gahn aa hovai pa-un  hovai soot  Dhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
lines.english: His lovely bride. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khimaa seegaar kaaman  tan pahirai raavai laal pi-aaree. ||1|| and the soul-bride adorns her body with compassion, then the Beloved Lord will enjoy

lines.english: O my Love, I am fascinated by Your many glories;
lines.transliteration: laal baho gun kaaman  mohee.

lines.english: Your Glorious Virtues are not found in any other. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  hohi na avree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪਉਣੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: If the bride wears the garland of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, around her neck, and ifshe uses the toothbrush of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: har har haar kanth lay pahirai d aamod ar dant lay-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਮਾ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਤਿਨ ਪਿਹਰੈ  ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar kartaa kangan pahirai in biDh  chit Dharay-ee. ||2|| and if she fashions and wears the bracelet of the Creator Lord around her wrist, thenshe shall hold her consciousness steady. ||2||

lines.english: She should make the Lord, the Slayer of demons, her ring, and take the Transcendent Lord as her silken clothes.
lines.transliteration: maDhusood an kar mund ree pahirai parmaysar pat lay-ee.

lines.english: Dheeraj Dh arhee banDh aavai kaaman  sareerang surmaa d ay-ee. ||3|| The soul-bride should weave patience into the braids of her hair, and apply the lotionof the Lord, the Great Lover. ||3||
If she lights the lamp in the mansion of her mind, and makes her body the bed of theLord,
lines.transliteration: man mandar jay d eepak jaalay kaa-i-aa sayj karay-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਿਠ ਲੇ ਪਿਹਰੈ  ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
lines.english: Awsw mhlw 1 ] (359-13) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gi-aan raa-o jab sayjai aavai ta naanak bh og karay-ee. ||4||1||35|| then, when the King of spiritual wisdom comes to her bed, He shall take her, andenjoy her. ||4||1||35||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਕਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕੰਗਨ  ਪਿਹਰੈ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਚਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The created being acts as he is made to act; what can be said to him, O Siblings ofDestiny?
lines.transliteration: keetaa hovai karay karaa-i-aa t is ki-aa kahee-ai bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ  ਪਿਹਰੈ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord is to do, He is doing; what cleverness could be used to affect Him?||1||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karn aa so kar rahi-aa keet ay ki-aa chat uraa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੀਰਜੁ  ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਰ੍ੀਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰਮਾ  ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Order of Your Will is so sweet, O Lord; this is pleasing to You.
lines.transliteration: tayraa hukam bh alaa t uDh bhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਜਾਲੇ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is honored with greatness, who is absorbed in the True Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ka-o milai vadaa-ee saachay naam samaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਰਾਉ ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ  ਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
lines.english: The deeds are done according to pre-ordained destiny; no one can turn back thisOrder.
lines.transliteration: kirat pa-i-aa parvaan aa likh i-aa baahurh  hukam na ho-ee.

lines.english: As it is written, so it comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa likhi-aa t aisaa parh i-aa mayt na sakai ko-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He who talks on and on in the Lord's Court is known as a joker.
lines.transliteration: jay ko dargeh bahut aa bolai naa-o pavai baajaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੋ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is not successful in the game of chess, and his chessmen do not reach their goal.||3||
lines.transliteration: satranj baajee pakai naahee kachee aavai saaree. ||3||

lines.english: By himself, no one is literate, learned or wise; no one is ignorant or evil.
lines.transliteration: naa ko parhi-aa pandit  beenaa naa ko moorakh  mand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When, as a slave, one praises the Lord, only then is he known as a human being.||4||2||36|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (359-18) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bandee and ar sifat  karaa-ay t aa ka-o kahee-ai band aa. ||4||2||36||

lines.english: Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the ear-rings in your mind, and wear thepatched coat of tolerance.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad manai meh mund raa kh inthaa kh imaa hadh aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਪਇਆ  ਪਰਵਾਣਾ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord does, look upon that as good; thus you shall obtain the treasure of Sehj Yoga. ||1|| pMnw 360
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai bh alaa kar maan-o sahj jog niDh  paava-o. ||1||

lines.english: O father, the soul which is united in union as a Yogi, remains united in the supreme essence throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: baabaa jugtaa jee-o jugah jug jogee param t ant meh jogaN.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਜੁਗਤਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਜੁਗਹ  ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ  ਪਰਮ  ਤੰਤ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
lines.english: One who has obtained the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord - hisbody enjoys the pleasure of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam niranjan paa-i-aa gi-aan kaa-i-aa ras bh ogaN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਗਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ  ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Lord's City, he sits in his Yogic posture, and he forsakes his desires andconflicts.
lines.transliteration: siv nagree meh aasan baisa-o kalap t i-aagee baad aN.

lines.english: The sound of the horn ever rings out its beautiful melody, and day and night, he isfilled with the sound current of the Naad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sinyee sabad  sadaa Dh un sohai ahinis poorai naad aN. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਨਗਰੀ  ਮਿਹ ਆਸਿਣ  ਬੈਸਉ  ਕਲਪ  ਿਤਆਗੀ  ਬਾਦੰ ॥
lines.english: My cup is reflective meditation, and spiritual wisdom is my walking stick; to dwell inthe Lord's Presence is the ashes I apply to my body.
lines.transliteration: pat veechaar gi-aan mat  dandaa varat maan bibh ootaN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸੰਙੀ  ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਿਨ ਸੋਹੈ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Praise of the Lord is my occupation; and to live as Gurmukh is my pure religion.||3||
lines.transliteration: har keerat rahraas hamaaree gurmukh  panth at eetaN. ||3||

lines.english: My arm-rest is to see the Lord's Light in all, although their forms and colors are so numerous.
lines.transliteration: saglee jot hamaaree sammi-aa naanaa varan anaykaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਰਹਰਾਿਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: love only the Supreme Lord God. ||4||3||37|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (360-5) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun bh arthar jogee paarbarahm liv aykaN. ||4||3||37||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਸੰਿਮਆ  ਨਾਨਾ  ਵਰਨ  ਅਨੇਕੰ  ॥
lines.english: Make spiritual wisdom your molasses, and meditation your scented flowers; let gooddeeds be the herbs.
lines.transliteration: gurh kar gi-aan Dh i-aan kar Dh aavai kar karn ee kas paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਣ ਭਰਥਿਰ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਲਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Let devotional faith be the distilling fire, and your love the ceramic cup. Thus thesweet nectar of life is distilled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaath ee bh avan paraym kaa pochaa it  ras ami-o chu-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, the mind is intoxicated with the Naam, drinking in its Nectar. It remainsabsorbed in the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: baabaa man matvaaro naam ras peevai sahj rang rach rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਧਾਵੈ ਕਿਰ ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, remaining attached to the Love of the Lord, the celestial music of theShabad resounds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ahinis banee paraym liv laagee sabad anaahad  gahi-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਠੀ  ਭਵਨੁ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਿਸ ਅਿਮਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord naturally gives the cup of Truth, to the one upon whom He casts HisGlance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: pooraa saach pi-aalaa sehjay tiseh pee-aa-ay jaa ka-o nad ar karay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ  ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜ  ਰੰਗ ਰਿਚ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who trades in this Nectar - how could he ever love the wine of the world? ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit kaa vaapaaree hovai ki-aa mad  chhoochh ai bhaa-o Dh aray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਬਨੀ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਨਾਹਦ  ਗਿਹਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Teachings of the Guru, the Ambrosial Bani - drinking them in, one becomes acceptable and renowned.
lines.transliteration: gur kee saakhee amrit  banee peevat  hee parvaan  bha-i-aa.

lines.english: Unto the one who loves the Lord's Court, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, ofwhat use is liberation or paradise? ||3||
lines.transliteration: dar darsan kaa pareet am hovai mukat  baikunth ay karai ki-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਿਪਆਲਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪੀਆਏ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Praises, one is forever a Bairaagee, a renunciate, and one'slife is not lost in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: siftee rat aa sad  bairaagee joo-ai janam na haarai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਕਆ  ਮਿਦ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: drink in the intoxicating nectar of the Lord.||4||4||38|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (360-12) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun bh arthar jogee kh eevaa amrit  Dhaarai. ||4||4||38||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ ਪੀਵਤ  ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Having attacked Khuraasaan, Baabar terrified Hindustan.
lines.transliteration: khuraasaan kh asmaanaa kee-aa hind usataan daraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ  ਕਰੈ ਿਕਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself does not take the blame, but has sent the Mugal as themessenger of death.
lines.transliteration: aapai dos na d ay-ee kart aa jam kar mugal charh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਫਤੀ  ਰਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: There was so much slaughter that the people screamed. Didn't You feel compassion, Lord? ||1||
lines.transliteration: aytee maar pa-ee karlaan ay taiN kee d arad na aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਣ ਭਰਥਿਰ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਖੀਵਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
lines.english: O Creator Lord, You are the Master of all.
lines.transliteration: kartaa t ooN sabh naa kaa so-ee.

lines.english: If some powerful man strikes out against another man, then no one feels any grief intheir mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay saktaa sakt ay ka-o maaray t aa man ros na ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: But if a powerful tiger attacks a flock of sheep and kills them, then its master mustanswer for it.
lines.transliteration: saktaa seehu maaray pai vagai kh asmai saa pursaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ  ਜਮੁ ਕਿਰ ਮੁਗਲੁ  ਚੜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This priceless country has been laid waste and defiled by dogs, and no one pays anyattention to the dead.
lines.transliteration: ratan vigaarh  vigo-ay kut eeN mu-i-aa saar na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ  ਤੈਂ ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ  ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; I gaze upon Your Glorious Greatness.||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay jorh vichh orhay aapay vaykh  tayree vadi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: One may give himself a great name, and revel in the pleasures of the mind,
lines.transliteration: jay ko naa-o Dharaa-ay vadaa saad  karay man bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ  ਸਕਤੇ  ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਨ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khasmai nad ree keerh aa aavai jayt ay chugai d aanay. but in the Eyes of the Lord and Master, he is just a worm, for all the corn that he eats.

lines.english: Only one who dies to his ego while yet alive, obtains the blessings, O Nanak, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||3||5||39|| rwgu Awsw Gru 2 mhlw 3  (360-18) raag aasaa ghar 2 mehlaa 3 Raag Aasaa, Second House, Third Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (360-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mar mar jeevai taa kichh  paa-ay naanak naam vakh aanay. ||3||5||39||

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਤਾ  ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੈ ਵਗੈ ਖਸਮੈ  ਸਾ ਪੁਰਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: har darsan paavai vadbh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਿਵਗਾਿੜ  ਿਵਗੋਏ  ਕੁਤੀ ਮੁਇਆ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, true detachment is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sachai bairaag.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜੋਿੜ ਿਵਛੋੜੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The six systems of philosophy are pervasive, pMnw 361
lines.transliteration: khat d arsan vart ai vart aaraa.
gur kaa darsan agam apaaraa. ||1|| but the Guru's system is profound and unequalled. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru's system is the way to liberation.
lines.transliteration: gur kai darsan mukat  gat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saachaa aap vasai man so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through the Guru's system, the world is saved,
lines.transliteration: gur darsan uDh rai sansaaraa.
jay ko laa-ay bhaa-o pi-aaraa. if it is embraced with love and affection.

lines.english: How rare is that person who truly loves the Guru's Way.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o pi-aaraa laa-ay virlaa ko-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru's system, everlasting peace is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kai darsan sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Through the Guru's system, the Door of Salvation is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur kai darsan mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one's family is saved.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvai parvaar saaDh aar.

lines.english: There is no salvation for those who have no Guru.
lines.transliteration: niguray ka-o gat kaa-ee naahee.

lines.english: Beguiled by worthless sins, they are struck down. ||3||
lines.transliteration: avgan muth ay chotaa kh aahee. ||3||

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body finds peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sukh  saaNt sareer.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is not afflicted by pain.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t aa ka-o lagai na peer.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਤ ਸਰੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not come near him.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal tis nayrh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||1||40|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (361-6) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh saach samaavai. ||4||1||40||

lines.english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, eradicates his self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: sabad mu-aa vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: He serves the True Guru, with no iota of self-interest.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t il na t amaa-ay.

lines.english: The Fearless Lord, the Great Giver, ever abides in his mind.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o d aataa sad aa man ho-ay.

lines.english: The True Bani of the Word is obtained only by good destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachee banee paa-ay bh aag ko-ay. ||1||

lines.english: So gather merits, and let your demerits depart from within you.
lines.transliteration: gun sangrahu vichahu a-ogun  jaahi.

lines.english: You shall be absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad samaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who purchases merits, knows the value of these merits.
lines.transliteration: gunaa kaa gaahak hovai so gun  jaanai.

lines.english: He chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word, and the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit sabad  naam vakh aanai.

lines.english: Through the True Bani of the Word, he becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: saachee banee soochaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Through merit, the Name is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gun tay naam paraapat  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਾ  ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: The invaluable merits cannot be acquired.
lines.transliteration: gun amolak paa-ay na jaahi.

lines.english: The pure mind is absorbed into the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man nirmal saachai sabad samaahi.

lines.english: How very fortunate are those who meditate on the Naam,
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee jinH naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਣ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa gund aataa man vasaa-i-aa. ||3|| and ever enshrine in their minds the Lord, the Giver of merit. ||3||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who gather merits.
lines.transliteration: jo gun sangrahai t inH balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.english: At the Gate of Truth, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.
lines.transliteration: dar saachai saachay gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself spontaneously bestows His gifts.
lines.transliteration: aapay dayvai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the value of the Lord cannot be described. ||4||2||41|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (361-12) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak keemat kahan  na jaa-ay. ||4||2||41||

lines.english: Great is the greatness of the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: satgur vich vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: He merges in His Merger, those who have been separated for so long.
lines.transliteration: chiree vichhunay mayl milaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself merges the merged in His Merger.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself knows His own worth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapnee keemat  aapay paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: How can anyone appraise the Lord's worth?
lines.transliteration: har kee keemat kin biDh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one may merge with the Infinite,Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har aprampar agam agochar gur kai sabad milai jan ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Few are the Gurmukhs who know His worth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh keemat  jaanai ko-ay.

lines.english: How rare are those who receive the Lord's Grace.
lines.transliteration: virlay karam paraapat ho-ay.

lines.english: Through the Sublime Bani of His Word, one becomes sublime.
lines.transliteration: oochee banee oochaa ho-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh chants the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
