lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  vakh aanai ko-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain;
lines.transliteration: vin naavai d ukh darad sareer.
satgur bh aytay t aa utrai peer. but when one meets the True Guru, then that pain is removed.

lines.english: Without meeting the Guru, the mortal earns only pain.
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhaytay d ukh kamaa-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh receives only more punishment. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bahut ee milai sajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The essence of the Lord's Name is so very sweet;
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam meethaa at  ras ho-ay.
peevat rahai pee-aa-ay so-ay. he alone drinks it, whom the Lord causes to drink it.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the essence of the Lord is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay har ras paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, salvation is attained. ||4||3||42|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (361-18) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay gat  paa-ay. ||4||3||42||

lines.english: My God is True, deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa gahir gambh eer.

lines.english: Serving Him, the body acquires peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: sayvat hee sukh  saaNt sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, His humble servants easily swim across.
lines.transliteration: sabad t aray jan sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: I fall at their feet forever and ever. ||1|| pMnw 362
lines.transliteration: tin kai ham sad  laagah paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Those being whose minds are imbued and drenched with the Lord's Love
lines.transliteration: jo man raatay har rang laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kaa janam maran  dukh laathaa t ay har d argeh milay subh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. - their pains of birth and death are taken away. They are automatically ushered into the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who has tasted the Shabad, obtains the true flavor.
lines.transliteration: sabad chaakh ai saachaa saad  paa-ay.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord abides within his mind.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord God is Eternal and All-pervading.
lines.transliteration: har parabh sad aa rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay nayrhai aapay d oor. ||2||

lines.english: Everyone talks and speaks through speech;
lines.transliteration: aakhan  aakh ai bakai sabh  ko-ay.
aapay bakhas milaa-ay so-ay. the Lord Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

lines.english: By merely speaking and talking, He is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: kahnai kathan na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He comes to abide in the mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad vasai man aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Gurmukh eradicates his self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: He is imbued with the Lord's Love, having discarded worldly attachment.
lines.transliteration: har rang raatay moh chukaa-ay.

lines.english: He contemplates the utterly Immaculate Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: at nirmal gur sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our Salvation. ||4||4||43|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (362-6) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam savaaranhaar. ||4||4||43||

lines.english: Attached to the love of duality, one only incurs pain.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay lagay d ukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, one's life is wasted away in vain.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, understanding is obtained,
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvai sojh ee ho-ay.
doojai bh aa-ay na laagai ko-ay. ||1|| and then, one is not attached to the love of duality. ||1||

lines.english: Those who hold fast to their roots, become acceptable.
lines.transliteration: mool laagay say jan parvaan.

lines.english: Night and day, they meditate within their hearts on the Lord's Name; through theWord of the Guru's Shabad, they know the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an-din raam naam jap hird ai gur sabd ee har ayko jaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who is attached to the branch, does not receive the fruits.
lines.transliteration: daalee laagai nihfal jaa-ay.

lines.english: For blind actions, blind punishment is received.
lines.transliteration: aNDheeN kammee anDh  sajaa-ay.

tay an-d in naam sad aa Dh i-aavahi gur pooray t ay bh agat visaykh . ||1|| rahaa-o. night and day, meditates forever on the Naam; he obtains the wondrous blessing of devotional love from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.transliteration: jinH ka-o har parabh la-ay milaa-ay.
tinH kee gahan  gat kahee na jaa-ay. - their sublime state cannot be described.

ootam pad vee har naam samaa-ee. ||2|| of the most exalted order, and I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.transliteration: kahi kahi kahnaa aakh  sunaa-ay. jay sa-o gh aalay thaa-ay na paa-ay. ||3||

lines.transliteration: jahaaN sabad vasai t ahaaN dukh jaa-ay.

lines.english: By the jewel of spiritual wisdom, one is easily absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan ratan saachai sahj samaa-ay. ||4||

lines.transliteration: deevaa balai na sojh ee paa-ay. ||1||

lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan  milai parabh  so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, one's devotion is accepted,
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan bhagat  thaa-ay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aap vasai man aa-ay. ||4|| and then, the Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He leads us to meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa karay satguroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: Then, one's devotion becomes steady, and the consciousness is centered upon theLord.
lines.transliteration: nihchal bhagat  har si-o chit  laa-ay.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with Devotion have truthful reputations.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  ratay tinH sachee so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace is obtained. ||5||12||51|| Awsw Gru 8 kwPI mhlw 3  (365-4) aasaa ghar 8 kaafee mehlaa 3 Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Third Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (365-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sukh  ho-ay. ||5||12||51||

lines.english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, one meets the True Guru, and true understanding isobtained.
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai sat gur milai sach sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides in the mind, and one comes to understand the Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasai har boojhai so-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord, the Great Giver, is One. There is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: mai saho daat aa ayk hai avar naahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਿਰ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's merciful favor, He abides in the mind, and then, a lasting peace ensues.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay man vasai t aa sad aa sukh  ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਸਹੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: In this age, the Lord's Name is fearless; it is obtained by meditative reflection uponthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh nirbha-o har naam hai paa-ee-ai gur veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is under Death's power. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai jam kai vas hai manmukh anDh  gavaar. ||2||

lines.english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the humble being performs His service, andunderstands the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai jan sayvaa karai boojh ai sach so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, He is to be praised; surrendering to His Will, peaceensues. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai salaahee-ai bh aanai mani-ai sukh  ho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the prize of this human birth is obtained, and theintellect is exalted.
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai janam pad aarath paa-i-aa mat  ootam ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, you shall beemancipated. ||4||39||13||52|| Awsw mhlw 4 Gru 2  (365-11) aasaa mehlaa 4 ghar 2 Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (365-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi tooN gurmukh  gat ho-ee. ||4||39||13||52||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are the True Creator, my Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa sachiaar maidaa saaN-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: That which is pleasing to Your Will, comes to pass. Whatever You give, that is what I receive. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo ta-o bh aavai so-ee theesee jo t ooN deh so-ee ha-o paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੫੨॥
lines.english: All are Yours; all meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree t ooN sabh nee Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He alone, whom You bless with Your Mercy, obtains the jewel of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karahi tin naam rat an paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh laaDh aa manmukh  gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ  ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself separate the mortals, and You Yourself unite them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDh aap vichh orhi-aa aap milaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: You are the River - all are within You.
lines.transliteration: tooN daree-aa-o sabh  tujh hee maahi.

lines.english: Other than You, there is no one at all.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa ko-ee naahi.

lines.english: All beings and creatures are your play-things.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tayraa kh ayl.

lines.english: The united ones are separated, and the separated ones are re-united. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vijog mil vichhurh i-aa sanjogee mayl. ||2||

lines.english: That humble being, whom You inspire to understand, understands;
lines.transliteration: jis no too jaan aa-ihi so-ee jan jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun sad  hee aakh  vakh aanai. he continually speaks and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.english: One who serves the Lord, obtains peace.
lines.transliteration: jin har sayvi-aa tin sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is easily absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee har naam samaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator; by Your doing, all things come to be.
lines.transliteration: too aapay kart aa tayraa kee-aa sabh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: You watch over the creation, and understand it.
lines.transliteration: too kar kar vaykh eh jaan eh so-ay.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||53|| pMnw 366 <> siqgur pRswid ] (366-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw Gru 2 mhlw 4 ] (366-1) raag aasaa ghar 2 mehlaa 4. Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh pargat ho-ay. ||4||1||53||

lines.english: Some form alliances with friends, children and siblings.
lines.transliteration: kis hee Dharh aa kee-aa mit ar sut  naal bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Some form alliances with in-laws and relatives.
lines.transliteration: kis hee Dharh aa kee-aa kurh am sakay naal javaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਿਲ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Some form alliances with chiefs and leaders for their own selfish motives.
lines.transliteration: kis hee Dharh aa kee-aa sikd aar cha-uDh ree naal aapn ai su-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ  ਕੁੜਮ  ਸਕੇ ਨਾਿਲ  ਜਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My alliance is with the Lord, who is pervading everywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hamaaraa Dharh aa har rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ  ਿਸਕਦਾਰ  ਚਉਧਰੀ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; the Lord is my only support.
lines.transliteration: ham har si-o Dharh aa kee-aa mayree har tayk.

lines.english: Other than the Lord, I have no other faction or alliance; I sing of the countless andendless Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai har bin pakh Dh arhaa avar na ko-ee ha-o har gun  gaavaa asaNkh anayk. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: Those with whom you form alliances, shall perish.
lines.transliteration: jinH si-o Dharh ay karahi say jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਅਨੇਕ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Making false alliances, the mortals repent and regret in the end.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  Dharhay kar pachh otaahi.

lines.english: Those who practice falsehood shall not last.
lines.transliteration: thir na raheh man khot kamaahi.

lines.english: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; there is no one more powerful than Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham har si-o Dharh aa kee-aa jis kaa ko-ee samrath naahi. ||2||

lines.english: All these alliances are mere extensions of the love of Maya.
lines.transliteration: ayh sabh Dh arhay maa-i-aa moh pasaaree.

lines.english: Only fools argue over Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa ka-o loojheh gaavaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ  ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They are born, and they die, and they lose the game of life in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: janam mareh joo-ai baajee haaree.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਸਿਭ ਧੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My alliance is with the Lord, who embellishes all, in this world and the next. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hamrai har Dharh aa je halat  palat  sabh  savaaree. ||3||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the five thieves instigate alliances and conflicts.
lines.transliteration: kalijug meh Dharh ay panch chor jh agrhaa-ay.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit have increased.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh abh imaan vaDh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਧੜਾ ਿਜ ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace, joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay tis sat sang milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਮਿਹ ਧੜੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: My alliance is with the Lord, who has destroyed all these alliances. ||4||
lines.transliteration: hamraa har Dharh aa jin ayh Dh arhay sabh  gavaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: In the false love of duality, people sit and form alliances.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa doojaa bh aa-o Dh arhay bahi paavai.

lines.english: They complain about other peoples' faults, while their own self-conceit only increases.
lines.transliteration: paraa-i-aa chhid ar atkalai aapn aa ahaNkaar vaDh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਧੜਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਿਭ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: As they plant, so shall they harvest.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejai taisaa kh aavai.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has joined the Lord's alliance of Dharma, which shall conquer the whole world. ||5||2||54|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (366-11) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kaa har Dharh aa Dh aram sabh  sarisat jin  aavai. ||5||2||54||

lines.english: Constantly listening to the Ambrosial Gurbani in the heart, it becomes pleasing to themind.
lines.transliteration: hirdai sun  sun man amrit  bhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through Gurbani, the Incomprehensible Lord is comprehended. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee har alakh  lakhaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਿਜਿਣ  ਆਵੈ  ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my sisters.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam sunhu mayree bh ainaa.

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the heart; with your mouth, recite the Ambrosial Hymns of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayko rav rahi-aa ghat ant ar mukh  bolhu gur amrit  bainaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mind and body are filled with divine love, and great sadness.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan paraym mahaa bairaag.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  paa-i-aa vadbh aag. ||2||

lines.english: In the love of duality, the mortals wander through poisonous Maya.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bh aveh bikh  maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The unfortunate ones do not meet the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaagheen nahee sat gur paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord Himself inspires us to drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Elixir.
lines.transliteration: amrit har ras har aap pee-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, O Nanak, the Lord is obtained. ||4||3||55|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (366-15) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai naanak har paa-i-aa. ||4||3||55||

lines.english: The Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan paraym naam aaDh aar.

lines.english: I chant the Naam; the Naam is the essence of peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japee naamo sukh saar. ||1||

lines.english: So chant the Naam, O my friends and companions.
lines.transliteration: naam japahu mayray saajan sainaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਪੀਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, there is nothing else for me. By great good fortune, as Gurmukh, Ihave received the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa mai avar na ko-ee vadai bhaag gurmukh  har lainaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without the Naam, I cannot live.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa nahee jeevi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag gurmukh  har paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who lack the Naam have their faces rubbed in the dirt of Maya.
lines.transliteration: naamheen kaalakh mukh  maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, cursed, cursed are their lives. ||3|| pMnw 367
lines.transliteration: naam binaa Dharig Dh arig jeevaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Great Lord is obtained by great good destiny.
lines.transliteration: vadaa vadaa har bhaag kar paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਗ ਕਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed with the Naam. ||4||4||56|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (367-2) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam d ivaa-i-aa. ||4||4||56||

lines.english: I sing His Glorious Praises, and through the Word of His Bani, I speak His GloriousPraises.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa gun  bolee ban ee.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I chant and recite the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har gun  aakh  vakh aanee. ||1||

lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the Naam, my mind becomes blissful.
lines.transliteration: jap jap naam man bha-i-aa anand aa.

lines.english: The True Guru has implanted the True Name of the True Lord within me; I sing HisGlorious Praises, and taste the supreme ecstasy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sat sat  satgur naam d irhaa-i-aa ras gaa-ay gun  parmaanand aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਇਆ  ਅਨੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai har jan logaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦੜਾਇਆ  ਰਿਸ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the detached, absolute Lord is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag paa-ay har nirjogaa. ||2||

lines.english: Those without virtue are stained by Maya's filth.
lines.transliteration: gun vihoon  maa-i-aa mal Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਲੋਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Lacking virtue, the egotistical die, and suffer reincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vin gun  janam mu-ay ahaNkaaree. ||3||

lines.english: The ocean of the body yields pearls of virtue.
lines.transliteration: sareer sarovar gun pargat kee-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh churns this ocean, and discovers this essence. ||4||5||57|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (367-6) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh math t at kadh ee-ay. ||4||5||57||

lines.english: I listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Naam is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: naam sunee naamo man bh aavai.

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag gurmukh  har paavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰੀਿਰ  ਸਰੋਵਿਰ  ਗੁ ਣ ਪਰਗਿਟ  ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: Chant the Naam, as Gurmukh, and be exalted.
lines.transliteration: naam japahu gurmukh pargaasaa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, I have no other support; the Naam is woven into all my breathsand morsels of food. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa mai Dhar nahee kaa-ee naam ravi-aa sabh  saas giraasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam illuminates my mind; listening to it, my mind is pleased.
lines.transliteration: naamai surat sunee man bh aa-ee.

lines.english: One who speaks the Naam - he alone is my friend and companion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo naam sunaavai so mayraa meet sakh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Naam, the fools depart naked.
lines.transliteration: naamheen ga-ay moorh  nangaa.

lines.english: They burn away to death, chasing the poison of Maya, like the moth chasing the flame. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pach pach mu-ay bikh d aykh patangaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਿਗਰਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself establishes, and, having established, disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaapay thaap uthaapay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself bestows the Naam. ||4||6||58|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (367-10) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dayvai har aapay. ||4||6||58||

lines.english: The vine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, has taken root in the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har har vayl vaDh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: It bears the fruit of the Lord; its taste is so tasty! ||1||
lines.transliteration: fal laagay har rasak rasaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in endless waves of joy.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jap anat t arangaa.

lines.english: Chant and repeat the Naam; through the Guru's Teachings praise the Lord, and slaythe horrible serpent of the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jap jap naam gurmat saalaahee maari-aa kaal jamkankar bh u-i-angaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord has implanted His devotional worship in the Guru.
lines.transliteration: har har gur meh bhagat  rakhaa-ee.

lines.english: When the Guru is pleased, He bestows it upon His Sikh, O my siblings of Destiny. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur tuth aa sikh  dayvai mayray bh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: One who acts in ego, knows nothing about the Way.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karam kichh biDh  nahee jaan ai.

lines.english: He acts like an elephant, who takes a bath, and then throws dust on his head. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o kunchar naa-ay khaak sir chh aanai. ||3||

lines.english: If one's destiny is great and exalted,
lines.transliteration: jay vad bhaag hoveh vad oochay.

lines.english: O Nanak, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate, True Lord. ||4||7||59|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (367-15) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam jaapeh sach soochay. ||4||7||59||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਅਨਤ  ਤਰੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind suffers hunger for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam kee man bhookh  lagaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hearing the Naam, my mind is satisfied, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam suni-ai man taript ai mayray bh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Naam, O my friends, O GurSikhs.
lines.transliteration: naam japahu mayray gursikh meet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਹ ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Naam, and through the Naam, obtain peace; through the Guru's Teachings, enshrine the Naam in your heart and mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam japahu naamay sukh paavhu naam rakh ahu gurmat  man cheet aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind is in bliss.
lines.transliteration: naamo naam sunee man sarsaa.

lines.english: Reaping the profit of the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings, my soul has blossomedforth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam laahaa lai gurmat bigsaa. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal is a leper, blinded by emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kustee moh anDhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ॥
lines.english: All his actions are fruitless; they lead only to painful entanglements. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh nihfal karam kee-ay d ukh DhanDhaa. ||3||

lines.english: The very fortunate ones chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har har jas japai vadbhaagee.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, one embraces love for the Naam.||4||8||60|| pMnw 368 <> siqgur pRswid ] (368-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: mhlw 4 rwgu Awsw Gru 6 ky 3 ] (368-1) mehlaa 4 raag aasaa ghar 6 kay 3. Fourth Mehl, Raag Aasaa, 3 Of Sixth House :
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat naam liv laagee. ||4||8||60||

lines.english: You may pluck the strings with your hand, O Yogi, but your playing of the harp is in vain.
lines.transliteration: hath kar tant  vajaavai jogee thothar vaajai bayn.

lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Yogi, and this mindof yours shall be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmat har gun  bolhu jogee ih manoo-aa har rang bh ayn. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਥ ਕਿਰ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਥੋਥਰ  ਵਾਜੈ ਬੇਨ ॥
lines.english: O Yogi, give your intellect the Teachings of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jogee har dayh mat ee upd ays.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, the One Lord, is pervading throughout all the ages; I humbly bow down to Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jug jug har har ayko vartai t is aagai ham aad ays. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You sing in so many Ragas and harmonies, and you talk so much, but this mind ofyours is only playing a game.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi raag bhaat  baho boleh ih manoo-aa kh aylai kh ayl.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You work the well and irrigate the fields, but the oxen have already left to graze in thejungle. ||2||
lines.transliteration: joveh koop sinchan ka-o basuDhaa uth  bail ga-ay char bayl. ||2||

lines.english: In the field of the body, plant the Lord's Name, and the Lord will sprout there, like alush green field.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar meh karam har bovhu har jaamai hari-aa khayt .

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਰਾਗ  ਭਾਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
lines.english: O mortal, hook up your unstable mind like an ox, and irrigate your fields with the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa asthir bail man jovhu har sinchahu gurmat jayt . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਵਿਹ  ਕੂਪ ਿਸੰਚਨ  ਕਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਉਿਠ ਬੈਲ ਗਏ ਚਿਰ ਬੇਲ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Yogis, the wandering Jangams, and all the world is Yours, O Lord. According tothe wisdom which You give them, so do they follow their ways.
lines.transliteration: jogee jangam sarisat sabh t umree jo d ayh mat ee tit chayl.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰ  ਮਿਹ ਕਰਮ  ਹਿਰ ਬੋਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਮੈ ਹਿਰਆ  ਖੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: O Lord God of servant Nanak, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, please link mymind to You. ||4||9||61|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (368-7) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay parabh ant arjaamee har laavhu manoo-aa payl. ||4||9||61||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਸੰਚਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜੇਤੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: How long must one search for angle bells and cymbals, and how long must one playthe guitar?
lines.transliteration: kab ko bhaalai gh unghroo taalaa kab ko bajaavai rabaab.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੰਗਮ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਸਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਜੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਿਤਤੁ  ਚੇਲ ॥
lines.english: In the brief instant between coming and going, I meditate on the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  baar kh in laagai ha-o t ab lag samaara-o naam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੇਲ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੧॥
lines.english: Such is the devotional love which has been produced in my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man aisee bhagat  ban aa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Lord, I cannot live even for an instant, like the fish which dies withoutwater. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o har bin khin pal reh na saka-o jaisay jal bin meen mar jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਭਾਲੈ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਤਾਲਾ  ਕਬ ਕੋ ਬਜਾਵੈ  ਰਬਾਬੁ  ॥
lines.english: How long must one tune the five strings, and assemble the seven singers, and how long will they raise their voices in song?
lines.transliteration: kab ko-oo maylai panch sat gaa-in  kab ko raag Dh un uth aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਬਾਰ ਿਖਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਹਉ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the time it takes to select and assemble these musicians, a moment elapses, andmy mind sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maylat chunat  khin pal chasaa laagai t ab lag mayraa man raam gun gaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਐਸੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: How long must one dance and stretch out one's feet, and how long must one reachout with one's hands?
lines.transliteration: kab ko naachai paav pasaarai kab ko haath pasaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Stretching out one's hands and feet, there is a moment's delay; and then, my mindmeditates on the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: haath paav pasaarat bilam t il laagai t ab lag mayraa man raam samHaarai. ||3||

lines.english: How long must one satisfy the people, in order to obtain honor?
lines.transliteration: kab ko-oo logan ka-o patee-aavai lok pat eenai naa pat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਲੈ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ ਗਾਇਣ  ਕਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਗ ਧੁਿਨ ਉਠਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, meditate forever in your heart on the Lord, and then everyone willcongratulate you. ||4||10||62|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (368-13) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har hirdai sad  Dhi-aavahu t aa jai jai karay sabh  ko-ay. ||4||10||62||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਲਤ ਚੁਨਤ  ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ  ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Join the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation; joining the Company of the Holy,sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  milee-ai har saaDh oo mil sangat  har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰੈ  ਕਬ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: With the sparkling jewel of spiritual wisdom, the heart is illumined, and ignorance is dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan ratan bali-aa gh at chaanan  agi-aan anDh ayraa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰਤ  ਿਬਲਮੁ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਰੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O humble servant of the Lord, let your dancing be meditation on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har jan naachahu har har Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਗਨ  ਕਉ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ  ਲੋਿਕ  ਪਤੀਣੈ  ਨਾ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If only I cold meet such Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny; I would wash the feet ofsuch servants. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aisay sant mileh mayray bh aa-ee ham jan kay Dh ovah paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਦ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind; night and day, center yourconsciousness on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mayray an-din har liv laa-ay.

lines.english: You shall have the fruits of your desires, and you shall never feel hunger again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo ichhahu so-ee fal paavhu fir bh ookh na laagai aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Infinite Lord Himself is the Creator; the Lord Himself speaks, and causes us tospeak.
lines.transliteration: aapay har aprampar kartaa har aapay bol bulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints are good, who are pleasing to Your Will; their honor is approved by You.||3||
lines.transliteration: say-ee sant bh alay t uDh bhaaveh jinH kee pat  paavahi thaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਲਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak is not satisfied by chanting the Lord's Glorious Praises; the more he chantsthem, the more he is at peace.
lines.transliteration: naanak aakh na raajai har gun  ji-o aakh ai ti-o sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself has bestowed the treasure of devotional love; His customers purchase virtues, and carry them home. ||4||11||63|| pMnw 369 <> siqgur pRswid ] (369-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw Gru 8 ky kwPI mhlw 4 ] (369-1) raag aasaa ghar 8 kay kaafee mehlaa 4. Raag Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhandaar d ee-ay har apunay gun  gaahak van aj lai jaa-ay. ||4||11||63||

lines.english: Death is ordained from the very beginning, and yet ego makes us cry.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa maran Dh uraahu ha-umai ro-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, as Gurmukh, one becomes stable and steady. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ay asthir ho-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: Blessed is the Perfect Guru, through whom the way of Death is known.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray saabaas chalan jaan i-aa.

lines.english: The sublime people earn the profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam so saar sabad samaan i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The days of one's life are pre-ordained; they will come to their end, O mother.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhay dayh se aa-ay maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One must depart, today or tomorrow, according to the Lord's Primal Order. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chalan aj ke kaleh Dh arahu furmaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Useless are the lives of those, who have forgotten the Naam.
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam tinaa jinHee naam visaari-aa.

lines.english: They play the game of chance in this world, and lose their mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: joo-ai khaylan  jag ke ih man haari-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Those who have found the Guru are at peace, in life and in death.
lines.transliteration: jeevan maran  sukh  ho-ay jinHaa gur paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the true ones are truly absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||12||64|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (369-6) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay sach sach samaa-i-aa. ||4||12||64||

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ  ਜਿਗ  ਿਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਿਰਆ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Having obtained the treasure of this human birth, I meditate on the Naam, the Nameof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath paa-ay naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਿਣ  ਮਰਿਣ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bujh sach samaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny practice the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jinH Dhur likh i-aa laykh  tinHee naam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Lord summons the truthful to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dar sachai sachiaar mahal bulaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Deep within is the treasure of the Naam; it is obtained by the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: antar naam niDh aan gurmukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din naam Dh i-aa-ay har gun  gaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Deep within are infinite substances, but the self-willed manmukh does not find them.
lines.transliteration: antar vasat  anayk manmukh  nahee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: In egotism and pride, the mortal's proud self consumes him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai garbai garab aap khu-aa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, his identity consumes his identical identity.
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay aap aap khu-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind is illumined, and meets the True Lord. ||4||13||65|| rwgu AwswvrI Gru 16 ky 2 mhlw 4 suDMg  (369-11) raag aasaavaree ghar 16 kay 2 mehlaa 4 suDh ang Raag Aasaavaree, 2 Of Sixteenth House, Fourth Mehl, Sudhang: <> siqgur pRswid ] (369-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gurmat man pargaas sachaa paa-ee-ai. ||4||13||65||

lines.english: Night and day, I sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o an-din har naam keert an kara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: AwswvrI, mÚ 4) satgur mo ka-o har naam bat aa-i-aa ha-o har bin kh in pal reh na saka-o. ||1|| rahaa- o. The True Guru has revealed to me the Name of the Lord; without the Lord, I cannotlive, for a moment, even an instant. ||1||Pause||
My ears hear the Lord's Kirtan, and I contemplate Him; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: hamrai sarvan simran har keert an ha-o har bin reh na saka-o ha-o ik kh in.

lines.english: As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can the Lord's slave live without serving Him? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaisay hans sarvar bin reh na sakai taisay har jan ki-o rahai har sayvaa bin. ||1||

lines.english: Some enshrine love for duality in their hearts, and some pledge love for worldlyattachments and ego.
lines.transliteration: kinhooN pareet laa-ee d oojaa bh aa-o rid  Dhaar kinhooN pareet  laa-ee moh apmaan.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ  ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: AwswvrI, mÚ 4) har jan pareet laa-ee har nirbaan  pad naanak simrat  har har bh agvaan. ||2||14||66|| The Lord's servant embraces love for the Lord and the state of Nirvaanaa; Nanak contemplates the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||14||66|| AwswvrI mhlw 4 ] (369-16) aasaavaree mehlaa 4. Aasaavaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: O mother, my mother, tell me about my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee moro pareetam raam bat aavhu ree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ  ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, I cannot live for a moment, even an instant; I love Him, like thecamel loves the vine. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o har bin khin pal reh na saka-o jaisay karhal bayl reejh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mind has become sad and distant, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my Friend.
lines.transliteration: hamraa man bairaag birkat bh a-i-o har d arsan meet  kai taa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ  ਸਰ੍ਵਣੁ  ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ॥
lines.english: As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, I cannot live without the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 370
lines.transliteration: jaisay al kamlaa bin reh na sakai taisay mohi har bin rahan na jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਲ  ਕਮਲਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Keep me under Your Protection, O Beloved Master of the Universe; fulfill my faith, O Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: raakh saran  jagdeesur pi-aaray mohi sarDh aa poor har gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮੋਿਹ ਸਰਧਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he beholds the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||39||13||15||67|| rwgu Awsw Gru 2 mhlw 5  (370-4) raag aasaa ghar 2 mehlaa 5 Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (370-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) jan naanak kai man anad hot  hai har d arsan nimakh  dikhaa-ee. ||2||39||13||15||67||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਨਮਖ ਿਦਖਾਈ  ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
lines.english: One who loves her, is ultimately devoured.
lines.transliteration: jin laa-ee pareet so-ee fir kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: One who seats her in comfort, is totally terrified by her.
lines.transliteration: jin sukh baith aalee t is bha-o bahut  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Siblings, friends and family, beholding her, argue.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee meet  kutamb d aykh bibaad ay.

lines.english: But she has come under my control, by Guru's Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham aa-ee vasgat gur parsaad ay. ||1||

lines.english: Beholding her, all are bewitched:
lines.transliteration: aisaa daykh  bimohit  ho-ay.

saaDhik siDh  surdayv manukh aa bin saaDh oo sabh  Dharohan Dh arohay. ||1|| rahaa- o. the strivers, the Siddhas, the demi-gods, angels and mortals. All, except the Saadhus,are deceived by her deception. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Some wander around as renunciates, but they are engrossed in sexual desire.
lines.transliteration: ik fireh udaasee t inH kaam vi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮਨੁਖਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਿਭ ਧਰ੍ੋਹਿਨ  ਧਰ੍ੋਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some grow rich as householders, but she does not belong to them.
lines.transliteration: ik saNcheh girhee tinH ho-ay na aapai.

lines.english: Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.
lines.transliteration: ik satee kahaaveh t inH bahut  kalpaapai.

lines.english: The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham har raakhay lag sat gur paavai. ||2||

lines.english: She leads astray the penitents who practice penance.
lines.transliteration: tap kart ay tapsee bh oolaa-ay.

lines.english: The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.
lines.transliteration: pandit mohay lobh  sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਲਿਗ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  mohay mohi-aa aakaas.

lines.english: The True Guru has saved me, by giving me His Hand. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham satgur raakh ay day kar haath. ||3||

lines.english: She is the slave of those who are spiritually wise.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee kee ho-ay vartee d aas.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁ ਣ ਮੋਹੇ ਮੋਿਹਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: With her palms pressed together, she serves them and offers her prayer:
lines.transliteration: kar jorhay sayvaa karay ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: "Whatever you wish, that is what I shall do."
lines.transliteration: jo tooN kaheh so kaar kamaavaa.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, she does not draw near to the Gurmukh. ||4||1|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (370-11) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh nayrh  na aavaa. ||4||1||

lines.english: I have been separated from my Beloved by Maya (my mother-in-law).
lines.transliteration: sasoo tay pir keenee vaakh .

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਿਹ  ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are dying of grief.
lines.transliteration: dayr jith aanee mu-ee d ookh santaap.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I am no longer swayed by the fear of Death (my elder brother-in-law).
lines.transliteration: ghar kay jith ayray kee chookee kaan .

lines.english: I am protected by my All-knowing, Wise Husband Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pir rakhi-aa keenee sugh arh sujaan . ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O people: I have tasted the elixir of love.
lines.transliteration: sunhu lokaa mai paraym ras paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The evil ones are dead, and my enemies are destroyed. The True Guru has given methe Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: durjan maaray vairee sangh aaray sat gur mo ka-o har naam d ivaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: First, I renounced my egotistical love of myself.
lines.transliteration: parathmay ti-aagee ha-umai pareet .

lines.english: Second, I renounced the ways of the world.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa t i-aagee logaa reet .

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ  ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing the three qualities, I look alike upon friend and enemy.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  ti-aag d urjan meet  samaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਜਨ  ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਵਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: And then, the fourth state of bliss was revealed to me by the Holy One. ||2||
lines.transliteration: turee-aa gun  mil saaDh  pachh aanay. ||2||

lines.english: In the cave of celestial bliss, I have obtained a seat.
lines.transliteration: sahj gufaa meh aasan baaDh i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord of Light plays the unstruck melody of bliss.
lines.transliteration: jot saroop anaahad  vaaji-aa.

lines.english: I am in ecstasy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand gur sabad veechaar.

lines.english: Imbued with my Beloved Husband Lord, I am the blessed, happy soul-bride. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pari-a si-o raatee Dh an sohagan  naar. ||3||

lines.english: Servant Nanak chants the wisdom of God;
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bolay barahm beechaar.
jo sunay kamaavai so ut rai paar. one who listens and practices it, is carried across and saved.

lines.english: He is not born, and he does not die; he does not come or go.
lines.transliteration: janam na marai na aavai na jaa-ay.

lines.english: He remains blended with the Lord. ||4||2|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (370-18) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har saytee oh rahai samaa-ay. ||4||2||

lines.english: The bride shows such special devotion, and has such an agreeable disposition.
lines.transliteration: nij bhagt ee seelvant ee naar.

lines.english: Her beauty is incomparable, and her character is perfect.
lines.transliteration: roop anoop pooree aachaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The house in which she dwells is such a praiseworthy house.
lines.transliteration: jit garihi vasai so garihu sobh aavant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain that state||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ee kinai virlai jant aa. ||1||

lines.english: As the soul-bride of pure actions, I have met with the Guru. pMnw 371
lines.transliteration: sukarnee kaaman  gur mil ham paa-ee.

lines.english: In worship, marriage and in the next world, such a soul-bride looks beautiful.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaj kaaj parthaa-ay suhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: As long as she lived with her father,
lines.transliteration: jichar vasee pitaa kai saath.
tichar kant  baho firai ud aas. her Husband wandered around in sadness.

lines.english: I served and surrendered to the Lord, the True Being;
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa sat purakh  manaa-i-aa.
gur aanee gh ar meh t aa sarab sukh  paa-i-aa. ||2|| the Guru brought my bride to my home, and I obtained total happiness. ||2||

lines.english: She is blessed with all sublime attributes, and her generations are unblemished.
lines.transliteration: bateeh sulakh -nee sach sant at poot. aagi-aakaaree sugh arh saroop.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਆਣੀ  ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Her Husband, her Lord and Master, fulfills her heart's desires.
lines.transliteration: ichh pooray man kant  su-aamee.

lines.english: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are now totally content. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal santokh ee dayr jayth aanee. ||3||

lines.english: She is the most noble of all the family.
lines.transliteration: sabh parvaarai maahi saraysat.

lines.english: She counsels and advises her hope and desire.
lines.transliteration: matee d ayvee d ayvar jaysat.

lines.english: Dhan so garihu jit  pargatee aa-ay. How blessed is that household, in which she has appeared.
O servant Nanak, she passes her time in perfect peace and comfort. ||4||3|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (371-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sukhay sukh  vihaa-ay. ||4||3||

lines.english: Whatever I resolve, she does not allow it to come to pass.
lines.transliteration: mataa kara-o so pakan na d ay-ee.

lines.english: She stands blocking the way of goodness and self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: seel sanjam kai nikat khalo-ee.

lines.english: She wears many disguises, and assumes many forms,
lines.transliteration: vays karay baho roop dikh aavai.
garihi basan na day-ee vakh  vakh  bharmaavai. ||1|| and she does not allow me to dwell in my own home. She forces me to wander around in different directions. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤਾ ਕਰਉ  ਸੋ ਪਕਿਨ  ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
lines.english: She has become the mistress of my home, and she does not allow me to live in it.
lines.transliteration: ghar kee naa-ik gh ar vaas na d ayvai.

lines.english: If I try, she fights with me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jatan kara-o urjh aa-ay parayvai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dhur kee bh ayjee aa-ee aamar. In the beginning, she was sent as a helper,

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਬਸਿਨ  ਨ ਦੇਈ ਵਿਖ ਵਿਖ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: na-o khand jeet ay sabh  thaan thanant ar. but she has overwhelmed the nine continents, all places and interspaces.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਿਕ  ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
lines.english: She has not spared even the river banks, the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the Yogisand Sannyaasees,
lines.transliteration: tat tirath na chh odai jog sanni-aas.
parh thaakay simrit  bayd  abhi-aas. ||2|| or those who tirelessly read the Simritees and study the Vedas. ||2||

lines.english: Wherever I sit, she sits there with me.
lines.transliteration: jah baisa-o tah naalay baisai.

lines.english: She has imposed her power upon the whole world.
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan meh sabal parvaysai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ  ਸਿਭ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰ  ॥
lines.english: Seeking meager protection, I am not protected from her.
lines.transliteration: hochhee saran  pa-i-aa rahan  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਟ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਿਨਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me, O my friend: unto whom should I turn for protection? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho meetaa ha-o kai peh jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: I heard of His Teachings, and so I have come to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sun upd ays sat gur peh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, within me.
lines.transliteration: gur har har naam mohi mantar drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.english: And now, I dwell in the home of my own inner self; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vasi-aa gun  gaa-ay anant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਛੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਇਆ  ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have met God, O Nanak, and I have become care-free. ||4||
lines.transliteration: parabh mili-o naanak bh a-ay achint aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ  ਹਉ ਕੈ ਪਿਹ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My home is now my own, and she is now my mistress.
lines.transliteration: ghar mayraa ih naa-ik hamaaree.

lines.english: She is now my servant, and the Guru has made me intimate with the Lord.||1||Second Pause||4||4|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (371-13) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih aamar ham gur kee-ay darbaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: First, they advised me to send a letter.
lines.transliteration: parathmay mataa je pat ree chalaava-o.

lines.english: Second, they advised me to send two men.
lines.transliteration: dutee-ay mat aa du-ay maanukh  pahuchaava-o.

lines.english: Third, they advised me to make the effort and do something.
lines.transliteration: taritee-ay mat aa kichh  kara-o upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: But I have renounced everything, and I meditate only on You, God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mai sabh kichh  chhod parabh  tuhee Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਆਮਿਰ  ਹਮ ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now, I am totally blissful, carefree and at ease.
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand achint sehjaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The enemies and evil-doers have perished, and I have obtained peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dusman d oot mu-ay sukh  paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The True Guru has imparted the Teachings to me.
lines.transliteration: satgur mo ka-o d ee-aa upd ays.

lines.english: My soul, body and everything belong to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh har kaa d ays.

lines.english: Whatever I do, is by Your Almighty Power.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karee so t ayraa t aan.

lines.english: You are my only Support, You are my only Court. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tooN mayree ot t ooNhai deebaan . ||2||

lines.english: If I were to renounce You, God, unto whom could I turn?
lines.transliteration: tuDhno chh od jaa-ee-ai parabh  kaiN Dhar.

lines.english: There is no other, comparable to You.
lines.transliteration: aan na bee-aa tayree samsar.

lines.english: Who else is Your servant to serve?
lines.transliteration: tayray sayvak ka-o kis kee kaan .

lines.english: The faithless cynics are deluded; they wander around in the wilderness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saakat bh oolaa firai baybaan . ||3||

lines.english: Your Glorious Greatness cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: tayree vadi-aa-ee kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Wherever I am, you save me, hugging me close in Your embrace.
lines.transliteration: jah kah raakh laihi gal laa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: God has preserved his honor, and congratulations are pouring in. ||4||5|| pMnw 372 Awsw mhlw 5 ] (372-1) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh raakh ee paij vajee vaaDh aa-ee. ||4||5||

lines.english: Having wandered through foreign lands, I have come here to do business.
lines.transliteration: pardays jh aag sa-ud ay ka-o aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I heard of the incomparable and profitable merchandise.
lines.transliteration: vasat anoop sun ee laabh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have gathered in my pockets my capital of virtue, and I have brought it here withme.
lines.transliteration: gun raas baneh palai aanee.

lines.english: Beholding the jewel, this mind is fascinated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daykh  ratan ih man laptaanee. ||1||

lines.english: I have come to the door of the Trader.
lines.transliteration: saah vaapaaree du-aarai aa-ay.

lines.english: Please display the merchandise, so that the business may be transacted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vakhar kaadh ahu sa-ud aa karaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Trader has sent me to the Banker.
lines.transliteration: saahi pathaa-i-aa saahai paas.

lines.english: The jewel is priceless, and the capital is priceless.
lines.transliteration: amol ratan amolaa raas.

lines.english: O my gentle brother, mediator and friend
lines.transliteration: visat subhaa-ee paa-i-aa meet .

lines.english: - I have obtained the merchandise, and my consciousness is now steady and stable. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sa-udaa mili-aa nihchal cheet . ||2||

lines.english: I have no fear of thieves, of wind or water.
lines.transliteration: bha-o nahee t askar pa-un  na paanee.

lines.english: I have easily made my purchase, and I easily take it away.
lines.transliteration: sahj vihaajee sahj lai jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਤਸਕਰ  ਪਉਣ  ਨ ਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have earned Truth, and I shall have no pain.
lines.transliteration: sat kai kh ati-ai d ukh nahee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have brought this merchandise home, safe and sound. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sahee salaamat gh ar lai aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤ ਕੈ ਖਿਟਐ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have earned the profit, and I am happy.
lines.transliteration: mili-aa laahaa bha-ay anand.

lines.english: Dhan saah pooray bakh sind. Blessed is the Banker, the Perfect Bestower.
How rare is the Gurmukh who obtains this merchandise;
lines.transliteration: ih sa-udaa gurmukh  kinai virlai paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak has brought this profitable merchandise home. ||4||6|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (372-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sahlee khayp naanak lai aa-i-aa. ||4||6||

lines.english: He does not consider my merits or demerits.
lines.transliteration: gun avgan mayro kachh na beechaaro.

lines.english: He does not look at my beauty, color or decorations.
lines.transliteration: nah daykh i-o roop rang seeNgaaro.

lines.english: I do not know the ways of wisdom and good conduct.
lines.transliteration: chaj achaar kichh biDh  nahee jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: But taking me by the arm, my Husband Lord has led me to His Bed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baah pakar pari-a sayjai aanee. ||1||

lines.english: Hear, O my companions, my Husband, my Lord Master, possesses me.
lines.transliteration: sunibo sakhee kant  hamaaro kee-alo kh asmaanaa.

lines.english: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, He protects me as His Own. What do theseignorant people know? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar mastak Dh aar raakh i-o kar apunaa ki-aa jaanai ih lok ajaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My married life now appears so beauteous;
lines.transliteration: suhaag hamaaro ab hun sohi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨਬੋ  ਸਖੀ ਕੰਿਤ ਹਮਾਰੋ  ਕੀਅਲੋ  ਖਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kant mili-o mayro sabh  dukh johi-o. my Husband Lord has met me, and He sees all my pains.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within the courtyard of my heart, the glory of the moon shines.
lines.transliteration: aaNgan mayrai sobhaa chand .

lines.english: Night and day, I have fun with my Beloved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nis baasur pari-a sang anand. ||2||

lines.english: My clothes are dyed the deep crimson color of the poppy.
lines.transliteration: bastar hamaaray rang chalool.

lines.english: All the ornaments and garlands around my neck adorn me.
lines.transliteration: sagal aabhran  sobh aa kanth  fool.

lines.english: Gazing upon my Beloved with my eyes, I have obtained all treasures;
lines.transliteration: pari-a paykhee d arisat paa-ay sagal niDh aan.

lines.english: I have shaken off the power of the evil demons. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dusat d oot kee chookee kaan. ||3||

lines.english: I have obtained eternal bliss, and I constantly celebrate.
lines.transliteration: sad kh usee-aa sad aa rang maan ay.

lines.english: With the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied in my ownhome.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam garih meh t ariptaanay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when the happy soul-bride is adorned by her Beloved,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ja-o pireh seegaaree.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (372-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: thir sohaagan sang bhat aaree. ||4||7|| she is forever happy with her Husband Lord. ||4||7||

lines.english: They give you donations and worship you.
lines.transliteration: daan d ay-ay kar poojaa karnaa.

lines.english: You take from them, and then deny that they have given anything to you.
lines.transliteration: lait dayt unH mookar parnaa.

lines.english: That door, through which you must ultimately go, O Brahmin
lines.transliteration: jit dar tumH hai baraahman  jaanaa.
tit dar tooNhee hai pachh utaanaa. ||1|| - at that door, you will come to regret and repent. ||1||

lines.english: Such Brahmins shall drown, O Siblings of Destiny;
lines.transliteration: aisay baraahman doobay bh aa-ee.
niraapraaDh chit vahi buri-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. they think of doing evil to the innocent. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Within them is greed, and they wander around like mad dogs.
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  fireh halkaa-ay.

lines.english: They slander others and carry loads of sin upon their heads.
lines.transliteration: nindaa karahi sir bh aar uth aa-ay.

lines.english: Intoxicated by Maya, they do not think of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moothaa chayt ai naahee.

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, they wander off on many paths. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa bahut ee raahee. ||2||

lines.english: Outwardly, they wear various religious robes,
lines.transliteration: baahar bhaykh  karahi gh anayray.
antar bikh i-aa ut ree gh ayray. but within, they are enveloped by poison.

lines.english: They instruct others, but do not understand themselves.
lines.transliteration: avar updaysai aap na boojh ai.

lines.english: Such Brahmins will never be emancipated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aisaa baraahman kahee na seejh ai. ||3||

lines.english: O foolish Brahmin, reflect upon God.
lines.transliteration: moorakh baaman  parabh oo samaal.

lines.english: He watches and hears, and is always with you.
lines.transliteration: daykh at sunat  tayrai hai naal.

lines.english: Says Nanak, if this is your destiny,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jay hovee bhaag.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (372-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 373
lines.transliteration: maan chhod gur charn ee laag. ||4||8|| renounce your pride, and grasp the Guru's Feet. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਗਤੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Pain and disease have left my body, and my mind has become pure; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog bh a-ay gat  tan tay man nirmal har har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am in bliss, meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and now, mymind does not go wandering. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay anand mil saaDh oo sang ab mayraa man kat  hee na jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: My burning desires are quenched, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O mother.
lines.transliteration: tapat bujhee gur sabd ee maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਗਇਓ  ਤਾਪ ਸਭ ਸਹਸਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fever of doubt has been totally eliminated; meeting the Guru, I am cooled andsoothed, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binas ga-i-o taap sabh  sahsaa gur seet al mili-o sahj subh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dhaavat  rahay ayk ik boojh i-aa aa-ay basay ab nihchal thaa-ay. My wandering has ended, since I have realized the One and Only Lord; now, I havecome to dwell in the eternal place.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਤ  ਰਹੇ ਏਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਬੂਿਝਆ  ਆਇ  ਬਸੇ ਅਬ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your Saints are the Saving Grace of the world; beholding the Blessed Vision of theirDarshan, I remain satisfied. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jagat uDh aaran sant  tumaaray d arsan paykh at rahay agh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ  ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have left behind the sins of countless incarnations, now that I have grasped the feet of the eternal Holy Guru.
lines.transliteration: janam dokh  paray mayray paachh ai ab pakray nihchal saaDh oo paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਦੋਖ ਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My mind sings the celestial melody of bliss,
lines.transliteration: sahj Dhun gaavai mangal manoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਮਨੂਆ ਅਬ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਿਨ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਖਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ab taa ka-o fun kaal na kh aa-ay. ||3|| and death shall no longer consume it. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord, the Cause of all causes, is All-powerful, the Giver of peace; He is my Lord,my Lord King.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samrath hamaaray sukh-d aa-ee mayray har har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਇ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: Nanak lives by chanting Your Name, O Lord; You are my helper, with me, through andthrough. ||4||9|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (373-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa jap jeevai naanak ot  pot mayrai sang sahaa-ay. ||4||9||

lines.english: The slanderer cries out and bewails.
lines.transliteration: arrhaavai billaavai nind ak.

lines.english: He has forgotten the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord; the slanderer reaps therewards of his own actions. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysar bisri-aa apnaa keet aa paavai nind ak. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If someone is his companion, then he shall be taken along with him.
lines.transliteration: jay ko-ee us kaa sangee hovai naalay la-ay siDhaavai.

lines.english: Like the dragon, the slanderer carries his huge, useless loads, and burns in his own fire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anhod aa ajgar bh aar uth aa-ay nind ak agnee maahi jalaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ਲਏ ਿਸਧਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak proclaims and announces what happens at the Door of the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: parmaysar kai du-aarai je ho-ay bit eetai so naanak aakh  sunaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ  ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਅਗਨੀ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਜਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble devotees of the Lord are forever in bliss; singing the Kirtan of the Lord'sPraises, they blossom forth. ||2||10|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (373-10) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa ka-o sad aa anand hai har keert an gaa-ay bigsaavai. ||2||10||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ  ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਿਜ ਹੋਇ ਿਬਤੀਤੈ  ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Even though I totally decorated myself,
lines.transliteration: ja-o mai kee-o sagal seegaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ  ਿਬਗਸਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: ta-o bh ee mayraa man na pat ee-aaraa. still, my mind was not satisfied.

lines.english: I applied various scented oils to my body,
lines.transliteration: anik suganDhat  tan meh laava-o.
oh sukh t il samaan nahee paava-o. and yet, I did not obtain even a tiny bit of pleasure from this.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Within my mind, I hold such a desire,
lines.transliteration: man meh chitva-o aisee aasaa-ee.
pari-a daykh at jeeva-o mayree maa-ee. ||1|| that I may live only to behold my Beloved, O my mother. ||1||

lines.english: O mother, what should I do? This mind cannot rest.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee kahaa kara-o ih man na Dheerai.

lines.english: It is bewitched by the tender love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pari-a pareetam bairaag hirai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Garments, ornaments, and such exquisite pleasures
lines.transliteration: bastar bibh ookhan sukh  bahut  bisaykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
lines.english: - I look upon these as of no account.
lines.transliteration: o-ay bhee jaan-o kit ai na laykh ai.

lines.english: Likewise, honor, fame, dignity and greatness,
lines.transliteration: pat sobh aa ar maan mahat .
aagi-aakaaree sagal jagat. obedience by the whole world,
garihu aisaa hai sundar laal. and a household as beautiful as a jewel.

lines.english: If I am pleasing to God's Will, then I shall be blessed, and forever in bliss. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aavaa t aa sad aa nihaal. ||2||

lines.english: With foods and delicacies of so many different kinds,
lines.transliteration: binjan bhojan anik parkaar.
rang tamaasay bahut  bisthaar. and such abundant pleasures and entertainments,
raaj milakh ar bahut  furmaa-is. power and property and absolute command
man nahee Dharaapai t arisnaa naa jaa-is. - with these, the mind is not satisfied, and its thirst is not quenched.

lines.english: Without meeting Him, this day does not pass.
lines.transliteration: bin milbay ih din na bihaavai.

lines.english: Meeting God, I find peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: milai parabhoo t aa sabh  sukh  paavai. ||3||

lines.english: By searching and seeking, I have heard this news,
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat sunee ih so-ay.
saaDhsangat  bin tari-o na ko-ay. that without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, no one swims across.

lines.english: One who has this good destiny written upon his forehead, finds the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis mastak bh aag tin sat gur paa-i-aa.

lines.english: His hopes are fulfilled, and his mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: pooree aasaa man taript aa-i-aa.

lines.english: When one meets God, then his thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: parabh mili-aa t aa chookee danjh aa.

lines.english: Nanak has found the Lord, within his mind and body. ||4||11|| Awsw mhlw 5  pMcpdy ] (373-19) aasaa mehlaa 5 panchpaday. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padas: pMnw 374
lines.transliteration: naanak laDhaa man t an manjh aa. ||4||11||

lines.english: First, your social status is high.
lines.transliteration: parathmay tayree neekee jaat .

lines.english: Second, you are honored in society.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa t ayree manee-ai paaNt.

lines.english: Third, your home is beautiful.
lines.transliteration: taritee-aa t ayraa sund ar thaan.

lines.english: But you are so ugly, with self-conceit in your mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bigarh roop man meh abh imaan. ||1||

lines.english: O beautiful, attractive, wise and clever woman:
lines.transliteration: sohnee saroop sujaan bichkh an.
at garbai mohi faakee t ooN. ||1|| rahaa-o. you have been trapped by your pride and attachment. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Your kitchen is so clean.
lines.transliteration: at soochee t ayree paaksaal.

lines.english: You take your bath, and worship, and apply the crimson mark upon your forehead;
lines.transliteration: kar isnaan poojaa tilak laal.
galee garbeh mukh goveh gi-aan. with your mouth you speak wisdom, but you are destroyed by pride.

lines.english: The dog of greed has ruined you in every way. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh biDh  kho-ee lobh  su-aan. ||2||

lines.english: You wear your robes and enjoy pleasures;
lines.transliteration: kaapar pahirahi bhogeh bh og.
aachaar karahi sobhaa meh log. you practice good conduct to impress people;
cho-aa chandan suganDh  bisthaar. you apply scented oils of sandalwood and musk,
sangee khotaa kroDh  chandaal. ||3|| but your constant companion is the demon of anger. ||3||

lines.english: Other people may be your water-carriers;
lines.transliteration: avar jon tayree panihaaree.
is Dhart ee meh t ayree sikd aaree. in this world, you may be a ruler.

lines.english: Gold, silver and wealth may be yours,
lines.transliteration: su-inaa roopaa tujh  peh d aam.
seel bigaari-o tayraa kaam. ||4|| but the goodness of your conduct has been destroyed by sexual promiscuity. ||4||

lines.english: That soul, upon whom the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o darisat ma-i-aa har raa-ay.
saa bandee t ay la-ee chh adaa-ay. is delivered from bondage.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's sublime essence is obtained.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil har ras paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, how fruitful is that body. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak safal oh kaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: All graces and all comforts shall come to you, as the happy soul-bride;
lines.transliteration: sabh roop sabh  sukh  banay suhaagan.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 iekquky 2 ] (374-9) aasaa mehlaa 5 iktukay 2. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ik-Tukas 2 :
lines.transliteration: at sund ar bichkh an tooN. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||12|| you shall be supremely beautiful and wise. ||1||Second Pause||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਰੂਪ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: One who is seen to be alive, shall surely die.
lines.transliteration: jeevat d eesai t is sarpar marn aa.

lines.english: But he who is dead shall remain ever-lasting. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mu-aa hovai tis nihchal rahn aa. ||1||

lines.english: Those who die while yet alive, shall through this death, live on.
lines.transliteration: jeevat mu-ay mu-ay say jeevay.

lines.english: They place the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as medicine in their mouths, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam avkhaDh  mukh  paa-i-aa gur sabd ee ras amrit  peevay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The clay pot of the body shall be broken.
lines.transliteration: kaachee matukee binas binaasaa.

lines.english: One who has eliminated the three qualities dwells in the home of his inner self. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis chhootai t arikutee t is nij gh ar vaasaa. ||2||

lines.english: One who climbs high, shall fall into the nether regions of the underworld.
lines.transliteration: oochaa charhai so pavai pa-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharan parh ai tis lagai na kaalaa. ||3|| One who lies upon the ground, shall not be touched by death. ||3||
Those who continue to wander around, achieve nothing.
lines.transliteration: bharmat  firay t in kichh oo na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings, become steady and stable. ||4||
lines.transliteration: say asthir jin gur sabad kamaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: This body and soul all belong to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh har kaa maal.

lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I am enraptured. ||5||13|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (374-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur mil bha-ay nihaal. ||5||13||

lines.english: The puppet of the body has been fashioned with great skill.
lines.transliteration: putree t ayree biDh  kar thaatee.

lines.english: Know for sure that it shall turn to dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaan sat kar ho-igee maatee. ||1||

lines.english: Remember your origins, O thoughtless fool.
lines.transliteration: mool samaalahu achayt gavaaraa.

lines.english: Why are you so proud of yourself? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: itnay ka-o t umH ki-aa garbay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are a guest, given three meals a day;
lines.transliteration: teen sayr kaa d ihaarh ee mihmaan.
avar vasat t ujh paahi amaan. ||2|| other things are entrusted to you. ||2||
bistaa asat rakat  paraytay chaam. you are just excrement, bones and blood, wrapped up in skin
is oopar lay raakhi-o gumaan. ||3|| - this is what you are taking such pride in! ||3||

lines.english: If you could understand even one thing, then you would be pure.
lines.transliteration: ayk vasat boojh eh taa hoveh paak.

lines.english: Without understanding, you shall be forever impure. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay t ooN sadaa naapaak. ||4||

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur ka-o kurbaan.
jis tay paa-ee-ai har purakh  sujaan. ||5||14|| through Him, I obtain the Lord, the All-knowing Primal Being. ||5||14||

lines.english: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ik-Tukas, Chau-Padas:
lines.transliteration: aasaa mehlaa 5 iktukay cha-upd ay.

lines.english: One moment, one day, is for me many days.
lines.transliteration: ik gharh ee dinas mo ka-o bahut  dihaaray.

lines.english: My mind cannot survive - how can I meet my Beloved? ||1||
lines.transliteration: man na rahai kaisay mila-o pi-aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ  ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਤਾ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਪਾਕ ॥
lines.english: I cannot endure one day, even one instant without Him. pMnw 375
lines.transliteration: ik pal dinas mo ka-o kabahu na bihaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਮਿਨ ਆਸ  ਘਨੇਰੀ  ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ  ਸੰਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਿਪਰਿਹ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind's desire for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so great. Is there any Saintwho can lead me to meet my Beloved? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darsan kee man aas gh anayree ko-ee aisaa sant  mo ka-o pireh milaavai. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: The four watches of the day are like the four ages.
lines.transliteration: chaar pahar chahu jugah samaanay.

lines.english: And when night comes, I think that it shall never end. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rain bh a-ee t ab ant  na jaanay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The five demons have joined together, to separate me from my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: panch doot  mil pirahu vichh orhee.

lines.english: Wandering and rambling, I cry out and wring my hands. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram rovai haath pachh orhee. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord has revealed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har daras d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (375-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aatam cheeneh param sukh  paa-i-aa. ||4||15|| realizing his own self, he has obtained supreme peace. ||4||15||

lines.english: In the Lord's service, are the greatest treasures.
lines.transliteration: har sayvaa meh param niDhaan.

lines.english: Serving the Lord, the Ambrosial Naam comes into one's mouth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har sayvaa mukh amrit  naam. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord is my Companion; He is with me, as my Help and Support.
lines.transliteration: har mayraa saathee sang sakhaa-ee.

lines.english: In pain and pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present. How can the poor Messenger of Death frighten me now? ||1||Pause||
