lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  simree t ah ma-ujood  jam bapuraa mo ka-o kahaa daraa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is my Support; the Lord is my Power.
lines.transliteration: har mayree ot mai har kaa taan .

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਖ ਸੁਿਖ ਿਸਮਰੀ  ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ  ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is my Friend; He is my mind's advisor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har mayraa sakhaa man maahi d eebaan . ||2||

lines.english: The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.
lines.transliteration: har mayree poonjee mayraa har vaysaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth, with the Lord as my Banker. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh Dh an kh atee har mayraa saahu. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, this wisdom has come.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay ih mat  aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ||4||16|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (375-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kai ank samaavai. ||4||16||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: When God shows His Mercy, then this mind is focused on Him.
lines.transliteration: parabh ho-ay kirpaal t a ih man laa-ee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, all rewards are obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sabh ai fal paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥੧੬॥
lines.english: O my mind, why are you so sad? My True Guru is Perfect.
lines.transliteration: man ki-o bairaag karhigaa satgur mayraa pooraa.

lines.english: He is the Giver of blessings, the treasure of all comforts; His Ambrosial Pool of Nectaris always overflowing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mansaa kaa daat aa sabh  sukh  niDhaan amrit  sar sad  hee bh arpooraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who enshrines His Lotus Feet within the heart,
lines.transliteration: charan kamal rid  antar Dh aaray.
pargatee jot milay raam pi-aaray. ||2|| meets the Beloved Lord; the Divine Light is revealed to him. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਕਉ  ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਕਰਿਹਗਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The five companions have met together to sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: panch sakhee mil mangal gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਸਿਰ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody, the sound current of the Naad, vibrates and resounds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anhad ban ee naad  vajaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, when the Guru is totally pleased, one meets the Lord, the King.
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuth aa mili-aa har raa-ay.

lines.english: Then, the night of one's life passes in peace and natural ease. ||4||17|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (375-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukh rain  vihaan ee sahj subh aa-ay. ||4||17||

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har pargatee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil satgur Dh an pooraa paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Gather such a wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: aisaa har Dhan sanchee-ai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: It cannot be burned by fire, and water cannot drown it; it does not forsake society, orgo anywhere else. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhaahi na jaalai jal nahee doobai sang chh od kar kat ahu na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: It does not run short, and it does not run out.
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai nikh ut na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Eating and consuming it, the mind remains satisfied. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khaa-ay kh arach man rahi-aa agh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He is the true banker, who gathers the wealth of the Lord within his own home.
lines.transliteration: so sach saahu jis ghar har Dh an sanchaan aa.

lines.english: With this wealth, the whole world profits. ||3||
lines.transliteration: is Dhan t ay sabh  jag varsaan aa. ||3||

lines.english: He alone receives the Lord's wealth, who is pre-ordained to receive it.
lines.transliteration: tin har Dh an paa-i-aa jis purab likh ay kaa lahn aa.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, at that very last moment, the Naam shall be your only decoration. ||4||18|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (375-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ant vaar naam gahn aa. ||4||18||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਲੈ  ਜਿਲ  ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਕਿਰ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Just like the farmer, He plants His crop,
lines.transliteration: jaisay kirsaan bovai kirsaanee.
kaachee paakee baadh paraanee. ||1|| and, whether it is ripe or unripe, He cuts it down. ||1||

lines.english: Just so, you must know this well, that whoever is born, shall die.
lines.transliteration: jo janmai so jaanhu moo-aa.

lines.english: Only the devotee of the Lord of the Universe becomes stable and permanent.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: govind bh agat asthir hai thee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਘਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The day shall certainly be followed by the night.
lines.transliteration: din tay sarpar pa-usee raat .

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: And when the night passes, the morning shall again dawn. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rain ga-ee fir ho-ay parbh aat. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ  ਿਲਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the love of Maya, the unfortunate ones remain in sleep.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi so-ay rahay abhaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਵਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ  ॥੪॥੧੮॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few remain awake and aware. ||3|| pMnw 376
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ko virlaa jaagay. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gun gaa-ee-ah neet .

lines.english: Your face shall be radiant, and your consciousness shall be immaculately pure. ||4||19|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (376-1) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal ho-ay nirmal cheet . ||4||19||

lines.english: The nine treasures are Yours - all treasures are Yours.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh t ayrai sagal niDh aan.

lines.english: The Fulfiller of desires saves mortals in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ichhaa poorak rakh ai nid aan. ||1||

lines.english: You are my Beloved, so what hunger can I have?
lines.transliteration: tooN mayro pi-aaro t aa kaisee bh ookhaa.

lines.english: When You dwell within my mind, pain does not touch me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN man vasi-aa lagai na d ookhaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever You do, is acceptable to me.
lines.transliteration: jo tooN karahi so-ee parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਲਗੈ ਨ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O True Lord and Master, True is Your Order. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachay saahib tayraa sach furmaan . ||2||

lines.english: When it is pleasing to Your Will, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai t aa har gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: Within Your Home, there is justice, forever and ever. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tayrai gh ar sad aa sad aa hai ni-aa-o. ||3||

lines.english: O True Lord and Master, You are unknowable and mysterious.
lines.transliteration: saachay saahib alakh abh ayv.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is committed to Your service. ||4||20|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (376-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laa-i-aa laagaa sayv. ||4||20||

lines.english: He is near at hand; He is the eternal Companion of the soul.
lines.transliteration: nikat jee-a kai sad hee sangaa.

lines.english: His Creative Power is all-pervading, in form and color. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kudrat  vartai roop ar rangaa. ||1||

lines.english: My mind does not worry; it does not grieve, or cry out.
lines.transliteration: karHai na jhurai naa man rovanhaaraa.

lines.english: Imperishable, Unshakable, Unapproachable and forever safe and sound is my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avinaasee avigat agochar sad aa salaamat  khasam hamaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Unto whom does Your servant pay homage?
lines.transliteration: tayray d aasray ka-o kis kee kaan .

lines.english: His King preserves his honor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis kee meeraa raakhai aan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੈ ਨ ਝੁਰੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: That slave, whom God has released from the restrictions of social status
lines.transliteration: jo la-udaa parabh kee-aa ajaat .

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ  ਅਿਵਗਤੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਿਤ  ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis la-uday ka-o kis kee t aat. ||3|| - who can now hold him in bondage? ||3||

lines.english: The Lord is absolutely independent, and totally care-free;
lines.transliteration: vaymuhtaajaa vayparvaahu.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, chant His Glorious Praises. ||4||21|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (376-9) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahhu gur vaahu. ||4||21||

lines.english: Forsaking the Lord's sublime essence, the mortal is intoxicated with false essences.
lines.transliteration: har ras chhod hochh ai ras maat aa.

lines.english: The substance is within the home of the self, but the mortal goes out to find it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghar meh vasat  baahar uth  jaataa. ||1||

lines.english: He cannot hear the true ambrosial discourse.
lines.transliteration: sunee na jaa-ee sach amrit kaathaa.

lines.english: Attached to false scriptures, he is engaged in argument. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raar karat jh oothee lag gaathaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He takes his wages from his Lord and Master, but he serves another.
lines.transliteration: vajahu saahib kaa sayv biraanee.

lines.english: With such sins, the mortal is engrossed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aisay gunah achhaad i-o paraanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He tries to hide from the One who is always with him.
lines.transliteration: tis si-o look jo sad  hee sangee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਵਸਤੁ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He begs from Him, again and again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaam na aavai so fir fir mangee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਸਚੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਾਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, God is merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: As it pleases Him, He cherishes us. ||4||22|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (376-13) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o kar part ipaalaa. ||4||22||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my soul, my life, my wealth.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan Dhan har ko naam.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, it is with me, to help me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaaN un sang kaam. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, everything else is useless.
lines.transliteration: bin har naam avar sabh thoraa.

lines.english: My mind is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaavai har d arsan man moraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Gurbani is the jewel, the treasure of devotion.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhandaar gurbaan ee laal.

lines.english: Singing, hearing and acting upon it, one is enraptured. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gaavat sunat  kamaavat  nihaal. ||2||

lines.english: My mind is attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laago maan.

lines.english: The True Guru, in His Pleasure, has given this gift. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur t oothai keeno d aan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Unto Nanak, the Guru has revealed these instructions:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur deekh i-aa d eenH.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (376-16) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh abh inaasee gh at ghat cheenH. ||4||23|| recognize the Imperishable Lord God in each and every heart. ||4||23||

lines.english: The All-pervading Lord has established joys and celebrations.
lines.transliteration: anad binod  bharaypur Dh aari-aa.

lines.english: He Himself embellishes His own works. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apunaa kaaraj aap savaari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Perfect is the Creation of the Perfect Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: poor samagree pooray thaakur kee.

lines.english: His magnificent greatness is totally all-pervading. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharipur Dh aar rahee sobh  jaa kee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: His Name is the treasure; His reputation is immaculate.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan jaa kee nirmal so-ay.

lines.english: He Himself is the Creator; there is no other. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa avar na ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  taa kai haath.

lines.english: God is pervading in all, and is always with them. ||3|| pMnw 377
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa parabh sabh  kai saath. ||3||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has fashioned His perfect fashion.
lines.transliteration: pooraa gur pooree banat  banaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees are blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||24|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (377-1) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  milee vadi-aa-ee. ||4||24||

lines.english: I have shaped this mind in the mold of the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad banaavahu ih man.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I have gathered the wealth of theLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa darsan sanchahu har Dh an. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O sublime understanding, come, enter into my mind,
lines.transliteration: ootam mat  mayrai rid ai tooN aa-o.

lines.english: Dhi-aava-o gaava-o gun  govind aa at pareet am mohi laagai naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. that I may meditate and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, andlove so dearly the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਆਵਉ  ਗਾਵਉ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮੋਿਹ ਲਾਗੈ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am satisfied and satiated by the True Name.
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaavan saachai naa-ay.

lines.english: My cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is the dust of the Saints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: athsath  majan sant  Dhooraa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I recognize that the One Creator is contained in all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh jaan-o kart aa ayk.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my understanding is refined.||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  mil buDh  bibayk. ||3||

lines.english: I have become the servant of all; I have renounced my ego and pride.
lines.transliteration: daas sagal kaa chh od abh imaan.

lines.english: The Guru has given this gift to Nanak. ||4||25|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (377-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur deeno d aan. ||4||25||

lines.english: My intellect has been enlightened, and my understanding is perfect.
lines.transliteration: buDh pargaas bh a-ee mat  pooree.

lines.english: Thus my evil-mindedness, which kept me far from Him, has been removed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa tay binsee d urmat  dooree. ||1||

lines.english: Such are the Teachings which I have received from the Guru;
lines.transliteration: aisee gurmat paa-ee-alay.

lines.english: ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: boodat gh or anDh  koop meh niksi-o mayray bh aa-ee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o. while I was drowning in the pitch black well, I was saved, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.english: The Guru is the boat to cross over the totally unfathomable ocean of fire; He istreasure of jewels. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mahaa agaah agan kaa saagar. gur bohith taaray rat naagar. ||2||

lines.english: This ocean of Maya is dark and treacherous.
lines.transliteration: dutar anDh  bikham ih maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡਤ  ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਿਨਕਿਸਓ  ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has revealed the way to cross over it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pargat maarag dikh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: I do not have the ability to chant or practice intense meditation.
lines.transliteration: jaap taap kachh  ukat na moree.

lines.english: Guru Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||26|| Awsw mhlw 5 iqpdy 2 ] (377-9) aasaa mehlaa 5 tipd ay 2. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ti-Padas:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak sarnaagat  toree. ||4||26||

lines.english: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence is forever imbued with it,
lines.transliteration: har ras peevat sad  hee raat aa.
aan rasaa khin meh leh jaat aa. while other essences wear off in an instant.

lines.english: Intoxicated with the Lord's sublime essence, the mind is forever in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: har ras kay maatay man sad aa anand.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕਛੁ ਉਕਿਤ  ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Other essences bring only anxiety. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aan rasaa meh vi-aapai chind. ||1||

lines.english: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence, is intoxicated and enraptured;
lines.transliteration: har ras peevai almasat mat vaaraa.
aan rasaa sabh hochh ay ray. ||1|| rahaa-o. all other essences have no effect. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The value of the Lord's sublime essence cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: har ras kee keemat kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord's sublime essence permeates the homes of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har ras saaDhoo haat samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: One may spend thousands and millions, but it cannot be purchased.
lines.transliteration: laakh karoree milai na kayh.

lines.english: He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jisahi paraapat t is hee d eh. ||2||

lines.english: Tasting it, Nanak is wonder-struck.
lines.transliteration: naanak chaakh bh a-ay bismaad .

lines.english: Through the Guru, Nanak has obtained this taste.
lines.transliteration: naanak gur tay aa-i-aa saad .

lines.english: Here and hereafter, it does not leave him.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  kat chhod na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is imbued and enraptured with the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||27|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (377-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak geeDhaa har ras maahi. ||3||27||

lines.english: If she renounces and eliminates her sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, andher evil-mindedness and self-conceit as well;
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh mitaavai chh utkai d urmat  apunee Dh aaree.
ho-ay nimaanee sayv kamaaveh t aa pareet am hoveh man pi-aaree. ||1|| and if, becoming humble, she serves Him, then she becomes dear to her Beloved'sHeart. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O beautiful soul-bride: By the Word of the Holy Saint, you shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: sun sund ar saaDh oo bachan uDh aaree.

lines.english: Your pain, hunger and doubt shall vanish, and you shall obtain peace, O happy soul-bride. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dookh  bhookh mitai t ayro sahsaa sukh  paavahi t ooN sukh man naaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Washing the Guru's feet, and serving Him, the soul is sanctified, and the thirst for sinis quenched.
lines.transliteration: charan pakh aar kara-o gur sayvaa aat am suDh  bikh ti-aas nivaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If you become the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves, then you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: daasan kee ho-ay d aas d aasree t aa paavahi sobh aa har d u-aaree. ||2||

lines.english: This is right conduct, and this is the correct lifestyle, to obey the Command of theLord's Will; this is your devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: ihee achaar ihee bi-uhaaraa aagi-aa maan bhagat  ho-ay t umHaaree.

lines.english: One who practices this Mantra, O Nanak, swims across the terrifying world-ocean.||3||28|| pMnw 378 Awsw mhlw 5 dupdy ] (378-1) aasaa mehlaa 5 dupd ay. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas:
lines.transliteration: jo ih mantar kamaavai naanak so bh a-ojal paar ut aaree. ||3||28||

lines.english: You have been blessed with this human body.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee paraapat  maanukh  dayhuree-aa.

lines.english: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gobind milan  kee ih t ayree baree-aa.

lines.english: Other efforts are of no use to you.
lines.transliteration: avar kaaj tayrai kit ai na kaam.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangat  bhaj kayval naam. ||1||

lines.english: Make the effort, and cross over the terrifying world ocean.
lines.transliteration: saraNjaam laag bhavjal t aran kai.

lines.english: This human life is passing away in vain, in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam baritha jaat rang maa-i-aa kai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have not practiced meditation, penanc e, self-restraint or righteous living;
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam Dh aram na kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have not served the Holy Saints, and I do not know the Lord, my King.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa saaDh na jaani-aa har raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my actions are vile and despicable;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ham neech karammaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary - please, preserve my honor. ||2||29|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (378-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran paray kee raakh o sarmaa. ||2||29||

lines.english: Without You, there is no other for me; You alone are in my mind.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar naahee mai d oojaa t ooN mayray man maahee.

lines.english: You are my Friend and Companion, God; why should my soul be afraid? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN saajan sangee parabh  mayraa kaahay jee-a daraahee. ||1||

lines.english: You are my support, You are my hope.
lines.transliteration: tumree ot t umaaree aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: While sitting down or standing up, while sleeping or waking, with every breath and morsel of food, I never forget You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baithat  oothat sovat  jaagat  visar naahee t ooN saas giraasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ  ਡਰਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Protect me, please protect me, O God; I have come to Your Sanctuary; the ocean offire is so horrible.
lines.transliteration: raakh raakh  saran  parabh  apnee agan saagar vikraalaa.

lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of peace to Nanak; I am Your child, O Lord of the World.||2||30|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (378-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay sukh-d aatay sat gur ham t umray baal gupaalaa. ||2||30||

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਠਤ  ਊਠਤ  ਸੋਵਤ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਿਵਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਸ ਿਗਰਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord God has saved me, His slave.
lines.transliteration: har jan leenay parabhoo chh adaa-ay.

lines.english: My mind has surrendered to my Beloved; my fever has taken poison and died.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pareetam si-o mayro man maani-aa t aap mu-aa bikh  khaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੀ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਿਵਕਰਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Cold and heat do not touch me at all, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: paalaa taa-oo kachh oo na bi-aapai raam naam gun gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਬਾਲ  ਗੁਪਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥੩੦॥
lines.english: My consciousness is not affected by the witch, Maya; I take to the Sanctuary of theLord's Lotus Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daakee ko chit kachh oo na laagai charan kamal sarnaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has shown His Mercy to me; He Himself is my Help and Support.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  bha-ay kirpaalaa ho-ay aap sahaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak ever sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; his doubts andpains are eliminated. ||2||31|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (378-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun niDhaan nit  gaavai naanak sahsaa d ukh mitaa-ay. ||2||31||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਸਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have taken the medicine of the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  khaa-i-o har ko naa-o.

lines.english: I have found peace, and the seat of pain has been removed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-ay d ukh binsi-aa thaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਲਾ  ਤਾਊ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The fever has been broken, by the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: taap ga-i-aa bachan gur pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਡਾਕੀ  ਕੋ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਸਰਨਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am in ecstasy, and all of my sorrows have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-i-aa sabh  mitay visooray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ਹੋਏ ਆਿਪ  ਸਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures obtain peace,
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sagal sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditating on the Supreme Lord God. ||2||32|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (378-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm naanak man Dhi-aa-i-aa. ||2||32||

lines.english: That time, which the mortal does not wish for, eventually comes.
lines.transliteration: baaNchhat  naahee so baylaa aa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Command, how can understanding be understood? ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin hukmai ki-o bujhai bujh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The body is consumed by water, fire and earth.
lines.transliteration: thadh ee taatee mitee kh aa-ee.

lines.english: But the soul is neither young nor old, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: oh na baalaa boodhaa bh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: naanak daas saaDh  sarnaa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he has shaken off the fear of death. ||2||33|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (378-16) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad bh a-o paar paraa-ee. ||2||33||

lines.english: Forever and ever, the soul is illumined;
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa aat am pargaas.
saaDhsangat  har charan  nivaas. ||1|| in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it dwells at the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name each and every day, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: raam naam nit jap man mayray.

lines.english: You shall find lasting peace, contentment and tranquility, and all your sins shall depart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: seetal saaNt sadaa sukh  paavahi kilvikh  jaahi sabh ay man t ayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect good karma,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa kay pooran karam.
satgur bh aytay pooran paarbarahm. ||2||34|| meets the True Guru, and obtains the Perfect Supreme Lord God. ||2||34||

lines.english: Thirty-four Shabads in Second House. || Awsw mhlw 5 ] (378-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: doojay gh ar kay cha-ut ees.

lines.english: She who has the Lord God as her Friend pMnw 379
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa har su-aamee parabh baylee.
peerh ga-ee fir nahee d uhaylee. ||1|| rahaa-o. her pain is dispelled, and she shall not become sad again. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, He joins her with His Feet,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa charan sang maylee.
sookh sahj aanand  suhaylee. ||1|| and she attains celestial peace, joy and comfort. ||1||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Immeasurable Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang gun  gaa-ay at olee.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, she becomes invaluable. ||2||35|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (379-3) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har simrat naanak bh a-ee amolee. ||2||35||

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication with Maya and jealousy - I have lost all of these inthe game of chance.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh maa-i-aa mad  matsar ay kh aylat sabh  joo-ai haaray.

lines.english: Purity, contentment, compassion, faith and truthfulness - I have ushered these intothe home of my self. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh da-i-aa Dh aram sach ih apunai garih bh eetar vaaray. ||1||

lines.english: All the loads of birth and death have been removed.
lines.transliteration: janam maran chookay sabh bh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ  ਏ ਖੇਲਤ  ਸਿਭ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saints' Society, my mind has become pure; the Perfect Guru has saved mein an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: milat sang bh a-i-o man nirmal gur poorai lai kh in meh t aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਹ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind has become the dust of all, and everyone seems a sweet friend to me.
lines.transliteration: sabh kee rayn ho-ay rahai manoo-aa saglay d eeseh meet  pi-aaray.

lines.english: My Lord and Master is contained in all. He gives His Gifts to all beings, and cherishes them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh maDh ay ravi-aa mayraa th aakur d aan d ayt sabh  jee-a samHaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਭਇਓ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the One and only; from the One, the One and only, came the expanse ofthe entire creation.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk aap ik aykai aykai hai saglaa paasaaray.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating, all the humble beings have become Holy; meditating on theNaam, the Name of the Lord, so many have been saved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jap jap ho-ay sagal saaDh jan ayk naam Dh i-aa-ay bahut  uDhaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਮੀਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is deep, profound and infinite; He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer bi-ant  gusaa-ee ant  nahee kichh  paaraavaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਰਿਵਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: ||4||36|| By Your Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; meditating, meditating, he humblybows to God. ||4||36|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (379-9) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay gun gaavai naanak Dh i-aa-ay Dh i-aa-ay parabh  ka-o namaskaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਆਿਪ  ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਸਗਲਾ  ਪਾਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are Infinite, Eternal and Incomprehensible; all this is Your Creation.
lines.transliteration: too bi-ant  avigat  agochar ih sabh  tayraa aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What clever games can we play, when everything is contained in You? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ham jant karah chat uraa-ee jaaN sabh  kichh  tujhai majh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰ ਿਬਅੰਤ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O my True Guru, protect me, Your child, through the power of Your play.
lines.transliteration: mayray satgur apnay baalik raakh o leelaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੩੬॥
lines.english: Grant me the good sense to ever sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Inaccessible and Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dayh sumat  sadaa gun  gaavaa mayray th aakur agam apaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The mortal is preserved in the womb of his mother, by the Support of the Naam, theName of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: jaisay janan jathar meh paraanee oh raht aa naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਿਬਅੰਤੁ  ਅਿਵਗਤੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: anad karai saas saas samHaarai naa pohai agnaar. ||2|| he makes merry, and with each and every breath he remembers the Lord, and the firedoes not touch him. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਹ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਜ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਝੈ ਮਝਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Others' wealth, others' wives, and the slander of others - renounce your craving forthese.
lines.transliteration: par Dhan par d aaraa par nind aa in si-o pareet  nivaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਬਾਿਲਕ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲੀਲਾ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart, and hold to the Support of the PerfectGuru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sayvee rid ant ar gur pooray kai aaDh aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Houses, mansions and palaces which you see - none of these shall go with you.
lines.transliteration: garihu mandar mehlaa jo d eeseh naa ko-ee sangaar.

lines.english: As long as you live in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O servant Nanak, remember theNaam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||37|| Awsw Gru 3 mhlw 5  (379-16) aasaa ghar 3 mehlaa 5 Aasaa, Third House, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (379-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jab lag jeeveh kalee kaal meh jan naanak naam samHaar. ||4||37||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਿਨ  ਜਠਰ  ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਓਹੁ ਰਹਤਾ  ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Power, property, youth, household, fame and the beauty of youth;
lines.transliteration: raaj milak joban garih sobhaa roopvant  jo-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੁ  ਕਰੈ ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਮਾਰੈ  ਨਾ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bahut d arab hast ee ar gh orhay laal laakh  bai aanee. great wealth, elephants, horses and jewels, purchased with tens of thousands of dollars;

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ  ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਇਨ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai dargahi kaam na aavai chh od chalai abh imaanee. ||1|| hereafter, these shall be of no avail in the Court of the Lord; the proud must depart,leaving them behind. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਸੇਵੀ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਿਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Why center your consciousness on any other than the Lord?
lines.transliteration: kaahay ayk binaa chit laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ਜੋ ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਗਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, forever and ever, meditate on theLord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sovat  jaagat  sadaa sad aa har Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਕਲੀ  ਕਾਲ  ਮਿਹ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥੩੭॥
lines.english: He may have the most wondrous and beautiful arenas, and be victorious on the field of battle. pMnw 380
lines.transliteration: mahaa bachitar sund ar aakh aarhay ran  meh jit ay pavaarh ay.

lines.english: He may proclaim, "I can kill anyone, I can capture anyone, and I can release anyone."
lines.transliteration: ha-o maara-o ha-o banDha-o chh oda-o mukh  tay ayv babaarh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਾਰਉ  ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ  ਛੋਡਉ  ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਏਵ ਬਬਾੜੇ  ॥
lines.english: But when the Order comes from the Supreme Lord God, he departs and leaves in a day. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa hukam paarbarahm kaa chhod chali-aa ayk d ihaarh ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕਾ ਛੋਿਡ ਚਿਲਆ ਏਕ ਿਦਹਾੜੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions, but he does not knowthe Creator Lord, the Doer of all.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam jugat  baho kart aa karn aihaar na jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: He teaches, but does not practice what he preaches; he does not realize the essentialreality of the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: updays karai aap na kamaavai t at sabad  na pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਕਰੈ ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਤਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Naked he came, and naked he shall depart; he is like an elephant, throwing dust onhimself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naaNgaa aa-i-aa naaNgo jaasee ji-o hastee kh aak chh aanai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਗਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਨਗੋ  ਜਾਸੀ  ਿਜਉ ਹਸਤੀ  ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Saints, and friends, listen to me: all this world is false.
lines.transliteration: sant sajan sunhu sabh  meet aa jhoothaa ayhu pasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਿਭ ਮੀਤਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Continually claiming, "Mine, mine", the mortals are drowned; the fools waste awayand die.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kar kar doobay khap kh ap mu-ay gavaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਡੂਬੇ ਖਿਪ ਖਿਪ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; throughthe True Name, I am emancipated. ||4||1||38|| rwgu Awsw Gru 5 mhlw 5  (380-6) raag aasaa ghar 5 mehlaa 5 Raag Aasaa, Fifth House, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (380-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur mil naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa saach naam nist aaraa. ||4||1||38||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ ਸਾਿਚ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩੮॥
lines.english: The whole world is asleep in doubt; it is blinded by worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: bharam meh so-ee sagal jagat  DhanDh anDh .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: How rare is that humble servant of the Lord who is awake and aware. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-oo jaagai har jan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਮਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ  ਜਗਤ  ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥
lines.english: The mortal is intoxicated with the great enticement of Maya, which is dearer to himthan life.
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohnee magan pari-a pareet paraan.

lines.english: How rare is the one who renounces it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ko-oo ti-aagai virlaa. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful; so is the Mantra of the Saint.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal aanoop har sant mant .

lines.english: How rare is that holy person who is attached to them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ko-oo laagai saaDhoo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਆਨੂਪ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of divine knowledgeis awakened;
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDhoo sang jaagay gi-aan rang.

lines.english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw Gru 6 mhlw 5 ] (380-11) raag aasaa ghar 6 mehlaa 5. Raag Aasaa, Sixth House, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagay kirpaa. ||4||1||39|| the Lord's Mercy is bestowed upon those who are blessed with such good destiny.||4||1||39|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (380-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad .

lines.english: Whatever pleases You is acceptable to me; that alone brings peace and ease to my mind.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so parvaanaa sookh  sahj man so-ee.

lines.english: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, All-powerful and Infinite; there is none otherthan You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath apaaraa avar naahee ray ko-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Your humble servants sing Your Glorious Praises with enthusiasm and love.
lines.transliteration: tayray jan rasak rasak gun  gaavahi.

lines.english: That alone is good advice, wisdom and cleverness for Your humble servant, which Youdo or cause to be done. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maslat mat aa si-aan ap jan kee jo t ooN karahi karaaveh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ  ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਮਿਨ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy, I have obtained its sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam t umaaraa pi-aaray saaDh sang ras paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Praises of the Lord, thetreasure of peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaa-ay say-ee jan pooray sukh  niDhaan har gaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One who has Your Support, O Lord Master, is not afflicted by anxiety.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o tayk tumHaaree su-aamee t aa ka-o naahee chint aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਲਿਤ  ਮਤਾ ਿਸਆਣਪ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਕਰਾਵਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by Your Kind Mercy, is the best, the most fortunate king. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o da-i-aa t umaaree ho-ee say saah bh alay bh agvant aa. ||3||

lines.english: Doubt, attachment, and deceit have all disappeared, since I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: bharam moh Dh aroh sabh  niksay jab kaa d arsan paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dealing in the Naam, O Nanak, we become truthful, and in the Love of the Lord'sName, we are absorbed. ||4||1 | 40|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (380-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vartan  naam naanak sach keenaa har naamay rang samaa-i-aa. ||4||1||40||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਇ  ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He washes off the filth of other peoples' incarnations, but he obtains the rewards ofhis own actions.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee mal Dhovai paraa-ee aapn aa keet aa paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He has no peace in this world, and he has no place in the Court of the Lord. In theCity of Death, he is tortured. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaa sukh nahee d argeh dh o-ee jam pur jaa-ay pachaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਹੋਈ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਭਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The slanderer loses his life in vain.
lines.transliteration: nindak ahilaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹ ਧਰ੍ੋਹ ਸਿਭ ਿਨਕਸੇ ਜਬ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He cannot succeed in anything, and in the world hereafter, he finds no place at all.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pahuch na saakai kaahoo baatai aagai th a-ur na paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਤਿਣ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਕੀਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Such is the fate of the wretched slanderer - what can the poor creature do?
lines.transliteration: kirat pa-i-aa nind ak bapuray kaa ki-aa oh karai bichaaraa.

lines.english: He is ruined there, where no one can protect him; with whom should he lodge his complaint? ||2|| pMnw 381
lines.transliteration: tahaa bigoot aa jah ko-ay na raakh ai oh kis peh karay pukaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The slanderer shall never attain emancipation; this is the Will of the Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: nindak kee gat  katahooN naahee kh asmai ayvai bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਖਸਮੈ  ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The more the Saints are slandered, the more they dwell in peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo jo nind karay sant an kee t i-o sant an sukh  maanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਿਨੰਦ  ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਿਤਉ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Saints have Your Support, O Lord and Master; You are the Saints' Help and Support.
lines.transliteration: santaa tayk t umaaree su-aamee t ooN santan kaa sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Saints are saved by the Lord; the slanderers are drowned in thedeep. ||4||2||41|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (381-3) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sant har raakh ay nind ak dee-ay rurh aa-ee. ||4||2||41||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
lines.english: He washes outwardly, but within, his mind is filthy; thus he loses his place in bothworlds.
lines.transliteration: baahar Dho-ay ant ar man mailaa d u-ay th a-ur apunay kh o-ay.

lines.english: Here, he is engrossed in sexual desire, an ger and emotional attachment; hereafter, he shall sigh and weep. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaa kaam kroDh mohi vi-aapi-aa aagai mus mus ro-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ  ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਖੋਏ ॥
lines.english: The way to vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe is different.
lines.transliteration: govind bh ajan kee mat  hai horaa.

lines.punjabi: ਈਹਾ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਆਗੈ  ਮੁਿਸ ਮੁਿਸ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Destroying the snake-hole, the snake is not killed; the deaf person does not hear theLord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: varmee maaree saap na mar-ee naam na sun-ee doraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਭਜਨ  ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: He renounces the affairs of Maya, but he does not appreciate the value of devotionalworship.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kee kirat chh od gavaa-ee bh agtee saar na jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਮੀ  ਮਾਰੀ  ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੁਨਈ  ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He finds fault with the Vedas and the Shaastras, and does not know the essence ofYoga. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bayd saast ar ka-o t arkan laagaa t at jog na pachh aanai. ||2||

lines.english: He stands exposed, like a counterfeit coin, when inspected by the Lord, the Assayer.
lines.transliteration: ughar ga-i-aa jaisaa kh otaa dh aboo-aa nad ar saraafaa aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਛੋਿਡ ਗਵਾਈ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can we hideanything from Him? ||3||
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee sabh  kichh  jaanai us t ay kahaa chh apaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਕਉ ਤਰਕਿਨ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Through falsehood, fraud and deceit, the mortal collapses in an instant - he has nofoundation at all.
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat banch nimmunee-aad aa binas ga-i-aa t atkaalay.

lines.english: Truly, truly, truly, Nanak speaks; look within your own heart, and realize this.||4||3||42|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (381-9) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sat sat  sat naanak kahi-aa apnai hird ai daykh samaalay. ||4||3||42||

lines.punjabi: ਉਘਿਰ  ਗਇਆ  ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਸਰਾਫਾ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Making the effort, the mind becomes pure; in this dance, the self is silenced.
lines.transliteration: udam karat  hovai man nirmal naachai aap nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਨੈ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The five passions are kept under control, and the One Lord dwells in the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panch janaa lay vasgat raakh ai man meh aykankaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Your humble servant dances and sings Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: tayraa jan nirat  karay gun gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਅਪਨੈ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
lines.english: He plays upon the guitar, tambourine and cymbals, and the unstruck sound current ofthe Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rabaab pakhaavaj t aal gh unghroo anhad  sabad  vajaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: First, he instructs his own mind, and then, he leads others.
lines.transliteration: parathmay man parboDhai apnaa paachh ai avar reejh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾਚੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He chants the Lord's Name and meditates on it in his heart; with his mouth, heannounces it to all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap hirdai jaapai mukh  tay sagal sunaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਰਾਖੈ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and washes their feet; heapplies the dust of the Saints to his body
lines.transliteration: kar sang saaDhoo charan pakh aarai sant  Dhoor tan laavai.

lines.english: He surrenders his mind and body, and places them before the Guru; thus, he obtainsthe true wealth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man tan arap Dh aray gur aagai sat  padaarath paavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਬਾਬੁ  ਪਖਾਵਜ  ਤਾਲ  ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਜਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever listens to, and beholds the Guru with faith, shall see his pains of birth and death taken away.
lines.transliteration: jo jo sunai paykhai laa-ay sarDh aa taa kaa janam maran d ukh bhaagai.

lines.english: Such a dance eliminates hell; O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ||4||4||43|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (381-15) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aisee nirat narak nivaarai naanak gurmukh  jaagai. ||4||4||43||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਥਮੇ  ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ  ਪਾਛੈ ਅਵਰ  ਰੀਝਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The lowly outcaste becomes a Brahmin, and the untouchable sweeper becomes pureand sublime.
lines.transliteration: aDham chandaalee bh a-ee barahman ee sood ee tay sarestaa-ee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਜਾਪੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ  ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The burning desire of the nether regions and the etheric realms is finally quenchedand extinguished. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paataalee aakaasee sakh nee lahbar boojh ee kh aa-ee ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ  ਪਖਾਰੈ  ਸੰਤ ਧੂਿਰ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The house-cat has been taught otherwise, and is terrified upon seeing the mouse.
lines.transliteration: ghar kee bilaa-ee avar sikh aa-ee moosaa d aykh daraa-ee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਸਿਤ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru has put the tiger under the control of the sheep, and now, the dog eatsgrass. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aj kai vas gur keeno kayhar kookar tineh lagaa-ee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ  ਸਰਧਾ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: Without pillars, the roof is supported, and the homeless have found a home.
lines.transliteration: baajh thoonee-aa chh apraa thaamiH-aa neegh ari-aa gh ar paa-i-aa ray.

lines.english: Without the jeweller, the jewel has been set, and the wonderful stone shines forth.||2||
lines.transliteration: bin jarhee-ay lai jarh i-i jarh aavaa thayvaa achraj laa-i-aa ray. ||2||

lines.english: The claimant does not succeed by placing his claim, but by keeping silent, he obtains justice.
lines.transliteration: daadee daad na pahuchanhaaraa choopee nirna-o paa-i-aa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਧਮ  ਚੰਡਾਲੀ  ਭਈ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਣੀ  ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ ਸਰ੍ੇਸਟਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The dead sit on costly carpets, and what is seen with the eyes shall vanish. ||3|| pMnw 382
lines.transliteration: maal duleechai baith ee lay mirt ak nain d ikhaalan Dh aa-i-aa ray. ||3||

lines.english: One who claims to know, is ignorant; he does not know the Knower of all.
lines.transliteration: so-ee ajaan kahai mai jaanaa jaanan haar na chh aanaa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ  ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ  ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰ ੁ ਨ ਛਾਨਾ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me the Ambrosial Nectar to drink in; savoring it andrelishing it, I blossom forth in bliss. ||4||5||44|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (382-2) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur ami-o pee-aa-i-aa rasak rasak bigsaanaa ray. ||4||5||44||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਅਿਮਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਿਬਗਸਾਨਾ  ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
lines.english: He has cut away my bonds, and overlooked my shortcomings, and so He hasconfirmed His nature.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaat bisaaray a-ugan apnaa birad  samHaari-a.

lines.english: Becoming merciful to me, like a mother or a father, he has come to cherish me as Hisown child. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay kirpaal maat pit  ni-aa-ee baarik ji-o part ipaari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The GurSikhs are preserved by the Guru, by the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gursikh raakh ay gur gopaal.

lines.english: He rescues them from the terrible world ocean, casting His Glance of Grace upon them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaadh lee-ay mahaa bh avjal t ay apnee nad ar nihaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we escape from the Messenger of Death; hereand hereafter, we obtain peace.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran jam t ay chh utee-ai halat  palat  sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਏ ਮਹਾ ਭਵਜਲ  ਤੇ ਅਪਨੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With every breath and morsel of food, meditate, and chant with your tongue,continually, each and every day; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saas giraas japahu jap rasnaa neet neet  gun gaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Through loving devotional worship, the supreme status is obtained, and in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy, sorrows are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  paraym param pad  paa-i-aa saaDh sang d ukh naath ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰਿਣ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am not worn down, I do not die, and nothing strikes fear in me, since I have thewealth of the Lord's Immaculate Name in my purse. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhijai na jaa-ay kichh  bha-o na bi-aapay har Dh an nirmal gaath ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਨੀਤ  ਨੀਤ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, God becomes the mortal's Help and Support; here andhereafter, He is the Savior Lord.
lines.transliteration: ant kaal parabh  bha-ay sahaa-ee it  ut raakh anhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
lines.english: He is my breath of life, my friend, support and wealth; O Nanak, I am forever asacrifice to Him. ||4||6||45|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (382-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paraan meet heet  Dhan mayrai naanak sad  balihaaray. ||4||6||45||

lines.punjabi: ਿਛਜੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਭਉ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਗਾਠੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Since You are my Lord and Master, what is there for me to fear? Other than You, who else should I praise?
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN saahib t aa bh a-o kayhaa ha-o t uDh bin kis saalaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ  ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are the One and only, and so do all things exist; without You, there is nothing atall for me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk tooN taa sabh  kichh  hai mai t uDh bin d oojaa naahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
lines.english: O Father, I have seen that the world is poison.
lines.transliteration: baabaa bikh d aykhi-aa sansaar.

lines.english: Save me, O Lord of the Universe! Your Name is my only Support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rakhi-aa karahu gusaa-ee mayray mai naam t ayraa aaDh aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: You know completely the condition of my mind; who else could I go to tell of it?
lines.transliteration: jaaneh birthaa sabh aa man kee hor kis peh aakh  sunaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world has gone crazy; obtainingthe Naam, it finds peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh  jag ba-uraa-i-aa naam milai sukh  paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: What shall I say? Unto whom shall I speak? What I have to say, I say to God.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kahee-ai kis aakh sun aa-ee-ai je kahn aa so parabh  jee paas.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਖਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everything which exists was created by You. You are my hope, forever and ever. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  keetaa tayraa vart ai sad aa sad aa tayree aas. ||3||

lines.english: If you bestow greatness, then it is Your gr eatness; here and hereafter, I meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: jay deh vadi-aa-ee t aa tayree vadi-aa-ee it  ut tujheh Dh i-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਸਭਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਆਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God of Nanak is forever the Giver of peace; Your Name is my only strength. ||4||7||46|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (382-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay parabh sad aa sukh -daatay mai t aan tayraa ik naa-o. ||4||7||46||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Lord Master; Your humble servant drinks in thissupreme elixir.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam t umHaaraa th aakur ayhu mahaa ras janeh pee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ਿਜ ਕਹਣਾ  ਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The fearful load of sins from countless incarnations has vanished; doubt and dualityare also dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam janam chookay bhai bh aaray d urat binaasi-o bh aram bee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I live by beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh at mai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਦੇਿਹ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਿਧਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Listening to Your Words, O True Guru, my mind and body are cooled and soothed.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sun kar bachan tumHaaray sat gur man t an mayraa th aar thee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ  ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; YouYourself have caused this to happen.
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay bh a-i-o saaDh sang ayhu kaaj t umH aap kee-o.

lines.english: Holding fast to Your Feet, O God, the poison is easily neutralized. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dirh kar charan  gahay parabh  tumHray sehjay bikh i-aa bh a-ee kh ee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਨਿਹ  ਪੀਓ ॥
lines.english: Your Name, O God, is the treasure of peace; I have received this everlasting Mantra.
lines.transliteration: sukh niDh aan naam parabh  tumraa ayhu abh inaasee mant ar lee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਰੇ ਦੁਰਤੁ  ਿਬਨਾਿਸਓ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਬੀਓ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Showing His Mercy, the True Guru has given it to me, and my fever and pain and hatred are annulled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi satgur d eenaa t aap sant aap mayraa bair gee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Dhan so maan as dayhee paa-ee jit  parabh  apnai mayl lee-o. Blessed is the attainment of this human body, by which God blends Himself with me.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਕਿਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਰੁ ਥੀਓ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan so kalijug saaDh sang keert an gaa-ee-ai naanak naam aDh aar hee-o. ||4||8||47|| Blessed, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.O Nanak, the Naam is my onlySupport. ||4||8||47|| pMnw 383 Awsw mhlw 5 ] (383-1) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
Everything is pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?
lines.transliteration: aagai hee tay sabh  kichh  hoo-aa avar ke jaan ai gi-aanaa.

lines.english: The errant child has been forgiven by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhool chook apnaa baarik bakh si-aa paarbarahm bh agvaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ  ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੂਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: My True Guru is always merciful; He has saved me, the meek one.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa sad aa da-i-aalaa mohi d een ka-o raakh  lee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ  ਬਾਿਰਕੁ  ਬਖਿਸਆ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਭਗਵਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has cured me of my disease, and I have obtained the greatest peace; He has placed the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in my mouth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaati-aa rog mahaa sukh paa-i-aa har amrit  mukh  naam d ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਨ  ਕਉ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He has washed away my countless sins; He has cut away my bonds, and I am liberated.
lines.transliteration: anik paap mayray parhari-aa banDhan kaatay mukat  bha-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has taken me by the arm, and pulled me out of the terrible, deep dark pit. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anDh koop mahaa gh or tay baah pakar gur kaadh  lee-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I have become fearless, and all my fears have been erased. The Savior Lord has savedme.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay sagal bh a-o miti-aa raakh ay raakh anhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਹਿਰਆ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟੇ ਮੁਕਤ  ਭਏ ॥
lines.english: Such is Your generosity, O my God, that You have resolved all my affairs. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aisee daat  tayree parabh  mayray kaaraj sagal savaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿਰ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind has met with my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan saahib man maylaa.

lines.english: Taking to His Sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ||4||9||48|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (383-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran pa-i-aa naanak sohaylaa. ||4||9||48||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If I forget You, then everyone becomes my enemy. When You come to mind, thenthey serve me.
lines.transliteration: tooN visrahi t aaN sabh  ko laagoo cheet  aavahi t aaN sayvaa.

lines.english: I do not know any other at all, O True, Invisible, Inscrutable Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: avar na ko-oo doojaa soojh ai saachay alakh  abhayvaa. ||1||

lines.english: When You come to mind, You are always merciful to me; what can the poor people do to me?
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sadaa da-i-aalaa logan ki-aa vaychaaray.

lines.english: Tell me, who should I call good or bad, since all beings are Yours? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa kaho kis no kahee-ai saglay jee-a t umHaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਿਵਸਰਿਹ  ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ  ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਤ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: You are my Shelter, You are my Support; giving me Your hand, You protect me.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk t ayraa aaDh aaraa haath d ay-ay t ooN raakh ahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ  ਸੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That humble being, upon whom You bestow Your Grace, is not touched by slander orsuffering. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis jan oopar tayree kirpaa t is ka-o bip na ko-oo bh aakhai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਤ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਲੋਗਨ  ਿਕਆ  ਵੇਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: That is peace, and that is greatness, which is pleasing to the mind of the Dear LordGod.
lines.transliteration: oho sukh ohaa vadi-aa-ee jo parabh  jee man bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are all-knowing, You are forever compassionate; obtaining Your Name, I revel init and make merry. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tooN daanaa t ooN sad miharvaanaa naam milai rang maan ee. ||3||

lines.english: I offer my prayer to You; my body and soul are all Yours.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aagai ard aas hamaaree jee-o pind sabh  tayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ  ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this is all Your greatness; no one even knows my name. ||4||10||49|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (383-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sabh t ayree vadi-aa-ee ko-ee naa-o na jaan ai mayraa. ||4||10||49||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਤੇਰੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਿਬਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Show Your Mercy, O God, O Searcher of hearts, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I might obtain You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh ant arjaamee saaDh sang har paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: When You open Your Door, and reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the mortalis not relegated to reincarnation again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khol kivaar d ikhaalay d arsan punrap janam na aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ  ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting with my Beloved Lord aand Master, all my pains are taken away.
lines.transliteration: mila-o pareetam su-aamee apunay saglay d ookh hara-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: I am saved and carried across, in the company of those who remember the SupremeLord God in their hearts. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jiniH ridai araaDh i-aa taa kai sang t ara-o ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
lines.english: This world is a great wilderness, an ocean of fire, in which mortals abide, in pleasureand pain.
lines.transliteration: mahaa udi-aan paavak saagar bh a-ay harakh  sog meh basnaa.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, the mortal becomes immaculately pure; with his tongue,he chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ayt bh a-i-aa man nirmal jap amrit  har rasnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He preserves his body and wealth, and takes everything as his own; such are thesubtle bonds which bind him.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an thaap kee-o sabh  apnaa komal banDh an baaNDhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਿਲ ਿਕਵਾਰ  ਿਦਖਾਲੇ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal becomes liberated, meditating on the Name of the Lord,Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad bh a-ay jan mukt ay har har naam araaDh i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲਉ  ਪਰੀਤਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: God, the Savior, has saved those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay parabh  raakh anhaarai jo parabh  apunay bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਰਦੈ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਰਉ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The soul and body are all Yours, O Great Giver; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice. ||4||11||50|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (383-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t umHraa daatay naanak sad  kurbaan ay. ||4||11||50||

lines.english: You have avoided the slumber of attachment and impurity - by whose favor has thishappened?
lines.transliteration: moh malan need t ay chh utkee ka-un anoograhu bh a-i-o ree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਪਾਵਕ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਭਏ ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਮਿਹ ਬਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The great enticer does not affect you. Where has your laziness gone? ||1||Pause|| pMnw 384
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohnee tuDh  na vi-aapai t ayraa aalas kahaa ga-i-o ree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How have you escaped from the treachery of sexual desire, anger and egotism?
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar gaakh ro sanjam ka-un chh uti-o ree.

lines.english: The holy beings, angels and demons of the three qualities, and all the worlds have been plundered. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sur nar dayv asur t arai gunee-aa saglo bh avan luti-o ree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ  ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਕਉਨ  ਛੁਿਟਓ ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The forest fire has burnt down so much of the grass; how rare are the plants whichhave remained green.
lines.transliteration: daavaa agan bahut  tarin jaalay ko-ee hari-aa boot rahi-o ree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ  ਸਗਲੋ  ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਿਟਓ  ਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is so All-powerful, that I cannot even describe Him; no one can chant His Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aiso samrath varan na saaka-o taa kee upmaa jaat  na kahi-o ree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਵਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਣ  ਜਾਲੇ ਕੋਈ ਹਿਰਆ  ਬੂਟੁ ਰਿਹਓ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: In the store-room of the lamp-black, I did not turn black; my color remainedimmaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: kaajar koth meh bh a-ee na kaaree nirmal baran bani-o ree.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਵਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਜਾਤ  ਨ ਕਿਹਓ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Maha Mantra, the Great Mantra, within my heart, and Ihave heard the wondrous Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahaa mantar gur hird ai basi-o achraj naam suni-o ree. ||3||

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, God has looked upon me with favor, and He has attached me toHis feet.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh nad ar avlokan apunai charan  lagaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਜਰ  ਕੋਠ ਮਿਹ ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਬਰਨੁ ਬਿਨਓ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Through loving devotional worship, O Nanak, I have obtained peace; in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy, I am absorbed into the Lord. ||4||12||51|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (384-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw Gru 7 mhlw 5 ] (384-7) raag aasaa ghar 7 mehlaa 5. Raag Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  naanak sukh  paa-i-aa saaDh oo sang samaa-ee. ||4||12||51||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਬਿਸਓ ਅਚਰਜ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਿਨਓ  ਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: That red dress looks so beautiful on your body.
lines.transliteration: laal cholnaa tai t an sohi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਦਿਰ  ਅਵਲੋਕਨ  ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਚਰਿਣ  ਲਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Your Husband Lord is pleased, and His heart is enticed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: surijan bhaanee t aaN man mohi-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
lines.english: Whose handiwork is this red beauty of yours?
lines.transliteration: kavan banee ree tayree laalee.

lines.english: Whose love has rendered the poppy so red? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kavan rang tooN bha-ee gulaalee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are so beautiful; you are the happy soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: tum hee sund ar tumeh suhaag.

lines.english: Your Beloved is in your home; good fortune is in your home. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tum gh ar laalan t um gh ar bhaag. ||2||

lines.english: You are pure and chaste, you are most distinguished.
lines.transliteration: tooN satvantee tooN parDh aan.

lines.english: You are pleasing to Your Beloved, and you have sublime understanding. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tooN pareet am bh aanee t uhee sur gi-aan. ||3||

lines.english: I am pleasing to my Beloved, and so I am imbued with the deep red color.
lines.transliteration: pareetam bh aanee t aaN rang gulaal.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have been totally blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak subh d arisat nihaal. ||4||

lines.english: Listen, O companions: this is my only work;
lines.transliteration: sun ree sakhee ih hamree gh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਘਿਰ  ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਘਿਰ  ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: God Himself is the One who embellishes and adorns. ||1||Second Pause||1||52|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (384-11) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh aap seegaar savaaranhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||1||52||

lines.english: I suffered in pain, when I thought He was far away;
lines.transliteration: dookh  ghano jab hot ay door.
ab maslat mohi milee had oor. ||1|| but now, He is Ever-present, and I receive His instructions. ||1||

lines.english: My pride is gone, O friends and companions;
lines.transliteration: chukaa nihoraa sakhee sahayree.
bharam ga-i-aa gur pir sang mayree. ||1|| rahaa-o. my doubt is dispelled, and the Guru has united me with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ  ਘਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: My Beloved has drawn me near to Him, and seated me on His Bed;
lines.transliteration: nikat aan pari-a sayj Dharee.

lines.english: I have escaped the clutches of others. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaan kadh an tay chh oot paree. ||2||

lines.english: In the mansion of my heart, shines the Light of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mandar mayrai sabad  ujaaraa.

lines.english: My Husband Lord is blissful and playful. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anad binod ee kh asam hamaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: According to the destiny written upon my forehead, my Husband Lord has come home to me.
lines.transliteration: mastak bh aag mai pir gh ar aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has obtained the eternal marriage. ||4||2||53|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (384-15) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: thir sohaag naanak jan paa-i-aa. ||4||2||53||

lines.english: My mind is attached to the True Name.
lines.transliteration: saach naam mayraa man laagaa.

lines.english: My dealings with other people are only superficial. ||1||
lines.transliteration: logan si-o mayraa thaath aa baagaa. ||1||

lines.english: Outwardly, I am on good terms with all;
lines.transliteration: baahar soot sagal si-o ma-ulaa.
alipat raha-o jaisay jal meh ka-ulaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. but I remain detached, like the lotus upon the water. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: By word of mouth, I talk with everyone;
lines.transliteration: mukh kee baat  sagal si-o kart aa.
jee-a sang parabh apunaa Dh artaa. ||2|| but I keep God clasped to my heart. ||2||

lines.english: I may appear utterly terrible,
lines.transliteration: dees aavat  hai bahut  bheehaalaa.
sagal charan kee ih man raalaa. ||3|| but my mind is the dust of all men's feet.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru. pMnw 385
lines.transliteration: naanak jan gur pooraa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, He has shown me the One Lord. ||4||3||54|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (385-1) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayk d ikhaa-i-aa. ||4||3||54||

lines.english: The mortal revels in joy, in the vigor of youth;
lines.transliteration: paavat ralee-aa joban balee-aa.
naam binaa maatee sang ralee-aa. ||1|| but without the Name, he mingles with dust. ||1||

lines.english: He may wear ear-rings and fine clothes,
lines.transliteration: kaan kundlee-aa bastar odh alee-aa.
sayj sukhlee-aa man garablee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. and have a comfortable bed, and his mind may be so proud. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: He may have elephants to ride, and golden umbrellas over his head;
lines.transliteration: talai kunchree-aa sir kanik chh atree-aa.
har bhagat  binaa lay Dh aran gadlee-aa. ||2|| but without devotional worship to the Lord, he is buried beneath the dirt. ||2||

lines.english: He may enjoy many women, of exquisite beauty;
lines.transliteration: roop sundree-aa anik ist aree-aa.
har ras bin sabh su-aad  fikree-aa. ||3|| but without the sublime essence of the Lord, all tastes are tasteless. ||3||

lines.english: Deluded by Maya, the mortal is led into sin and corruption.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa chhalee-aa bikaar bikh lee-aa.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful, Compassionate Lord. ||4||4||55|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (385-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran naanak parabh  purakh  da-i-alee-aa. ||4||4||55||

lines.english: There is a garden, in which so many plants have grown.
lines.transliteration: ayk bageechaa payd ghan kari-aa.

lines.english: They bear the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam as their fruit. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam t ahaa meh fali-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Consider this, O wise one,
lines.transliteration: aisaa karahu beechaar gi-aanee.
jaa tay paa-ee-ai pad  nirbaanee. by which you may attain the state of Nirvaanaa.

lines.english: All around this garden are pools of poison, but within it is the Ambrosial Nectar, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aas paas bikhoo-aa kay kuntaa beech amrit  hai bh aa-ee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There is only one gardener who tends it.
lines.transliteration: sinchanhaaray aykai maalee.

lines.english: He takes care of every leaf and branch. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khabar karat  hai paat  pat daalee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਸ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਿਬਖੂਆ  ਕੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਬੀਿਚ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He brings all sorts of plants and plants them there.
lines.transliteration: sagal banaspat aan  jarhaa-ee.

lines.english: They all bear fruit - none is without fruit. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saglee foolee nifal na kaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: One who receives the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam from the Guru
lines.transliteration: amrit fal naam jin gur t ay paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਬਿਰ  ਕਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਪਾਤ ਪਤ ਡਾਲੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: - O Nanak, such a servant crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||5||56|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (385-10) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t aree t in maa-i-aa. ||4||5||56||

lines.english: The pleasures of royalty are derived from Your Name.
lines.transliteration: raaj leelaa tayrai naam banaa-ee.

lines.english: I attain Yoga, singing the Kirtan of Your Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jog bani-aa tayraa keert an gaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All comforts are obtained in Your Shelter.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa banay t ayrai olHai.

lines.english: The True Guru has removed the veil of doubt. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharam kay pard ay sat gur kh olHay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Understanding the Command of the Lord's Will, I revel in pleasure and joy.
lines.transliteration: hukam boojh rang ras maan ay.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, I obtain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa mahaa nirbaan ay. ||3||

lines.english: One who recognizes You is recognized as a householder, and as a renunciate.
lines.transliteration: jin tooN jaataa so girsat  udaasee parvaan .

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he dwells in Nirvaanaa. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam rataa so-ee nirbaan . ||2||

lines.english: One who has obtained the treasure of the Naam
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o mili-o naam niDhaanaa.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (385-13) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak t aa kaa poor kh ajaanaa. ||4||6||57|| - prays Nanak, his treasure-house is filled to overflowing. ||4||6||57||

lines.english: Journeying to sacred shrines of pilgrimage, I see the mortals acting in ego.
lines.transliteration: tirath jaa-o t a ha-o ha-o kart ay.

lines.english: If I ask the Pandits, I find them tainted by Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pandit poochh a-o ta maa-i-aa raat ay. ||1||

lines.english: Show me that place, O friend,
lines.transliteration: so asthaan bataavhu meet aa.
jaa kai har har keertan neet aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are forever sung. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The Shaastras and the Vedas speak of sin and virtue;
lines.transliteration: saastar bayd  paap punn veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਨਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰ ਖਜਾਨਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: narak surag fir fir a-utaar. ||2|| they say that mortals are reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again. ||2||

lines.english: In the householder's life, there is anxiety, and in the life of the renunciate, there isegotism.
lines.transliteration: girsat meh chint  udaas ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਜਾਉ  ਤ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Performing religious rituals, the soul is entangled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam karat jee-a ka-o janjaar. ||3||

lines.english: By God's Grace, the mind is brought under control;
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay man vas aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh t aree t in maa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har keert an gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: This place is found through the Guru. ||1||Second Pause||7||58|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (385-18) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih asthaan guroo tay paa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||7||58||

lines.english: Within my home there is peace, and outwardly there is peace as well.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh sookh  baahar fun sookh aa.
