lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains are erased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har simrat sagal binaasay d ookhaa. ||1||

lines.english: There is total peace, when You come into my mind. pMnw 386
lines.transliteration: sagal sookh jaaN tooN chit aaNvaiN.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone is pleasing to Your Will, who chants the Naam. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so naam japai jo jan tuDh  bhaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al jap naam t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, the house of pain is demolished. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har japat dh ahai d ukh dayraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਤ  ਢਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone, who understands the Command of the Lord's Will, is approved.
lines.transliteration: hukam boojhai so-ee parvaan.

lines.english: The True Shabad of the Word of God is his trademark and insignia. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saach sabad jaa kaa neesaan. ||3||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam drirh-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, my mind has found peace. ||4||8||59|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (386-3) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak mayrai man sukh  paa-i-aa. ||4||8||59||

lines.punjabi: ਭਨਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੮॥੫੯॥
lines.english: Wherever You send me, there I go.
lines.transliteration: jahaa pathaavhu t ah tah jaa-eeN.

lines.english: Whatever You give me, brings me peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo tum d ayh so-ee sukh  paa-eeN. ||1||

lines.english: I am forever the chaylaa, the humble disciple, of the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: sadaa chayray govind  gosaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, I am satisfied and satiated. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay taripat  aghaa-eeN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever You give me, I wear and eat.
lines.transliteration: tumraa d ee-aa painHa-o kh aa-eeN.

lines.english: By Your Grace, O God, my life passes peacefully. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ta-o parsaad  parabh  sukh ee valaa-eeN. ||2||

lines.english: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar tujhai Dhi-aa-eeN.

lines.english: I recognize none as equal to You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tumHrai lavai na ko-oo laa-eeN. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, this is my continual meditation:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nit ivai Dh i-aa-eeN.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (386-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gat hovai sant eh lag paa-eeN. ||4||9||60|| that I may be emancipated, clinging to the Feet of the Saints. ||4||9||60||

lines.english: While standing up, and sitting down, and even while asleep, meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sovat  Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Walking on the Way, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maarag chalat haray har gaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: With your ears, listen to the Ambrosial Sermon.
lines.transliteration: sarvan suneejai amrit kathaa.

lines.english: Listening to it, your mind shall be filled with bliss, and the troubles and diseases of your mind shall all depart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaas sunee man ho-ay anandaa d ookh rog man saglay lathaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: While you work at your job, on the road and at the beach, meditate and chant.
lines.transliteration: kaaraj kaam baat ghaat japeejai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad har amrit  peejai. ||2||

lines.english: The humble being who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night,
lines.transliteration: dinas rain har keert an gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਿਨ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ  ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਮਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਥਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so jan jam kee vaat na paa-ee-ai. ||3|| does not have to go with the Messenger of Death. ||3||

lines.english: One who does not forget the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, is emancipated;
lines.transliteration: aath pahar jis visrahi naahee.

lines.english: O Nanak, I fall at his feet. ||4||10||61|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (386-11) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gat hovai naanak t is lag paa-ee. ||4||10||61||

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, one abides in peace;
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran sookh nivaas.
bha-ee kali-aan  dukh hovat  naas. ||1|| one becomes happy, and suffering is ended. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Celebrate, make merry, and sing God's Glories.
lines.transliteration: anad karahu parabh  kay gun gaavhu.

lines.english: Forever and ever, surrender to the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur apnaa sad  sadaa manaavahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Act in accordance with the Shabad, the True Word of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa sach sabad  kamaavahu.

lines.english: Remain steady and stable within the home of your own self, and find God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: thir ghar baith ay parabh  apnaa paavhu. ||2||

lines.english: Do not harbor evil intentions against others in your mind,
lines.transliteration: par kaa buraa na raakho cheet .
tum ka-o d ukh nahee bh aa-ee meet . ||3|| and you shall not be troubled, O Siblings of Destiny, O friends. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੁ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Tantric exercise, and the Mantra, given by the Guru.
lines.transliteration: har har tant  mant  gur d eenHaa.

lines.english: Nanak knows this peace alone, night and day. ||4||11||62|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (386-15) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih sukh naanak an-d in cheenHaa. ||4||11||62||

lines.english: That wretched being, whom no one knows
lines.transliteration: jis neech ka-o ko-ee na jaanai.
naam japat uho chahu kunt maanai. ||1|| - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is honored in the four directions. ||1||

lines.english: I beg for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, give it to me, O Beloved!
lines.transliteration: darsan maaga-o d eh pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: Serving You, who, who has not been saved? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumree sayvaa ka-un ka-un na t aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ  ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
lines.english: That person, whom no one wants to be near
lines.transliteration: jaa kai nikat na aavai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal sarisat u-aa kay charan mal Dho-ee. ||2|| - the whole world comes to wash the dirt of his feet. ||2||

lines.english: That mortal, who is of no use to anyone at all
lines.transliteration: jo paraanee kaahoo na aavat kaam.
sant parsaad  taa ko japee-ai naam. ||3|| - by the Grace of the Saints, he meditates on the Naam. ||3||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the sleeping mind awakens.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang man sovat  jaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਉਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Then, O Nanak, God seems sweet. ||4||12||63|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (386-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tab parabh  naanak meeth ay laagay. ||4||12||63||

lines.english: With my eyes, I behold the One and Only Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayko aykee nain nihaara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ  ਕਉਨ  ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, I contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 387
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har naam samHaara-o. ||1||

lines.english: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: raam raamaa raamaa gun gaava-o.

lines.english: By the graceful favor of the Saints, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant part aap saaDh  kai sangay har har naam Dh i-aava-o ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਤਾਿਪ  ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Everything is strung on His string.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree jaa kai soot paro-ee.

lines.english: He is contained in each and every heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar ravi-aa so-ee. ||2||

lines.english: He creates and destroys in an instant.
lines.transliteration: opat parla-o kh in meh kart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਿਤ ਪਰੋਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself remains unattached, and without attributes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap alaypaa nirgun rahtaa. ||3||

lines.english: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan antarjaamee.

lines.english: Nanak's Lord and Master celebrates in bliss. ||4||13||64|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (387-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anand karai naanak kaa su-aamee. ||4||13||64||

lines.english: My wandering through millions of births has ended.
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay rahay bhavaaray.

lines.english: I have won, and not lost, this human body, so difficult to obtain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dulabh  dayh jeet ee nahee haaray. ||1||

lines.english: My sins have been erased, and my sufferings and pains are gone.
lines.transliteration: kilbikh binaasay d ukh darad door.

lines.english: I have been sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay puneet  santan kee Dh oor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Saints of God have the ability to save us;
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sant  uDhaaran jog.
tis bh aytay jis Dh ur sanjog. ||2|| they meet with those of us who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.english: My mind is filled with bliss, since the Guru gave me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man aanand mant ar gur d ee-aa.

lines.english: My thirst has been quenched, and my mind has become steady and stable. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tarisan bujh ee man nihchal thee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the nine treasures, and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath na-o niDh  siDh.

lines.english: O Nanak, I have obtained understanding from the Guru. ||4||14||65|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (387-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur tay paa-ee buDh . ||4||14||65||

lines.english: My thirst, and the darkness of ignorance have been removed.
lines.transliteration: mitee ti-aas agi-aan anDh ayray.

lines.english: Serving the Holy Saints, countless sins are obliterated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDh sayvaa agh  katay gh anayray. ||1||

lines.english: I have obtained celestial peace and immense joy.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ghanaa.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, my mind has become immaculately pure, and I have heard the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay bh a-ay man nirmal har har har har naam sunaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The stubborn foolishness of my mind is gone;
lines.transliteration: binsi-o man kaa moorakh dh eethaa.

lines.english: God's Will has become sweet to me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh kaa bh aanaa laagaa meeth aa. ||2||

lines.english: I have grasped the Feet of the Perfect Guru,
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kay charan gahay.
kot janam kay paap lahay. ||3|| and the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

lines.english: The jewel of this life has become fruitful.
lines.transliteration: ratan janam ih safal bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God has shown mercy to me. ||4||15||66|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (387-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh karee ma-i-aa. ||4||15||66||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I contemplate, forever and ever, the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: satgur apnaa sad  sadaa samHaaray.
gur kay charan kays sang jhaaray. ||1|| with my hair, I dust the feet of the Guru. ||1||

lines.english: Be wakeful, O my awakening mind!
lines.transliteration: jaag ray man jaaganhaaray.

lines.english: Without the Lord, nothing else shall be of use to you; false is emotional attachment,and useless are worldly entanglements. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin har avar na aavas kaamaa jhooth aa moh mithi-aa pasaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee si-o rang laa-ay.

lines.english: When the Guru shows His Mercy, pain is destroyed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal ho-ay dukh  jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Guru, there is no other place of rest.
lines.transliteration: gur bin doojaa naahee thaa-o.

lines.english: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru gives the Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa gur d ayvai naa-o. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur paarbarahm parmaysar aap.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, O Nanak, meditate on the Guru. ||4||16||67|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (387-16) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aath pahar naanak gur jaap. ||4||16||67||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਕੇਸ ਸੰਿਗ  ਝਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the tree, and the branches extending out.
lines.transliteration: aapay payd bisthaaree saakh.

lines.english: He Himself preserves His own crop. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnee khayt ee aapay raakh . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵਿਸ  ਕਾਮਾ  ਝੂਠਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਪਸਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see that One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  paykh a-o aykai ohee.

lines.english: Deep within each and every heart, He Himself is contained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar aapay so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is the sun, and the rays emanating from it.
lines.transliteration: aapay soor kiran bisthaar.

lines.english: He is concealed, and He is revealed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so-ee gupat so-ee aakaar. ||2||

lines.english: He is said to be of the highest attributes, and without attributes.
lines.transliteration: sargun nirgun  thaapai naa-o.

lines.english: Both converge onto His single point. ||3||
lines.transliteration: duh mil aykai keeno th aa-o. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt and fear.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bharam bh a-o kh o-i-aa.

lines.english: With my eyes, I perceive the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, to be everywhere. ||4||17||68|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (387-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anad roop sabh  nain alo-i-aa. ||4||17||68||

lines.english: I know nothing of arguments or cleverness. pMnw 388
lines.transliteration: ukat si-aanap kichh oo na jaanaa.

lines.english: Day and night, I chant Your Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: din rain  tayraa naam vakh aanaa. ||1||

lines.english: I am worthless; I have no virtue at all.
lines.transliteration: mai nirgun gun naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: God is the Creator, the Cause of all causes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar parabh so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am foolish, stupid, ignorant and thoughtless;
lines.transliteration: moorakh mugaDh  agi-aan aveechaaree.

lines.english: Your Name is my mind's only hope. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam tayray kee aas man Dh aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਮਿਨ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline or good actions;
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam na saaDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕਰਮ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: naam parabhoo kaa maneh araaDh aa. ||3|| but within my mind, I have worshipped God's Name. ||3||

lines.english: I know nothing, and my intellect is inadequate.
lines.transliteration: kichhoo na jaanaa mat  mayree thoree.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, O God, You are my only Support. ||4||18||69|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (388-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvat naanak ot parabh  toree. ||4||18||69||

lines.english: These two words, Har, Har, make up my maalaa.
lines.transliteration: har har akhar d u-ay ih maalaa.

lines.english: Continually chanting and reciting this rosary, God has become merciful to me, Hishumble servant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: japat japat  bha-ay d een d a-i-aalaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਖਰ  ਦੁਇ ਇਹ ਮਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I offer my prayer to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: kara-o bayntee sat gur apunee.

lines.english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, and keep me safe in Your Sanctuary; please, give me the maalaa, the rosary of Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakho sarn aa-ee mo ka-o d ayh haray har japnee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who enshrines this rosary of the Lord's Name within his heart,
lines.transliteration: har maalaa ur antar Dh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa d ookh nivaarai. ||2|| is freed of the pains of birth and death. ||2||

lines.english: The humble being who contemplates the Lord within his heart, and chants the Lord'sName, Har, Har, with his mouth,
lines.transliteration: hirdai samaalai mukh  har har bolai.
so jan it ut  kateh na dolai. ||3|| never wavers, here or hereafter. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one who is imbued with the Name,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo raachai naa-ay.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (388-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har maalaa taa kai sang jaa-ay. ||4||19||70|| goes to the next world with the maalaa of the Lord's Name. ||4||19||70||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: All things belong to Him - let yourself belong to Him as well.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa sabh kichh  tis kaa ho-ay.

lines.english: No stain clings to such a humble being. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis jan layp na bi-aapai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's servant is liberated forever.
lines.transliteration: har kaa sayvak sad hee mukt aa.

lines.english: Whatever He does, is pleasing to His servant; the way of life of His slave is immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so-ee bh al jan kai at  nirmal d aas kee jugt aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who renounces everything, and enters the Lord's Sanctuary
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag har sarn ee aa-i-aa.
tis jan kahaa bi-aapai maa-i-aa. ||2|| - how can Maya cling to him? ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: With the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his mind,
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan jaa kay man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis ka-o chint aa supnai naahi. ||3|| he suffers no anxiety, even in dreams. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur pooraa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: My doubts and attachments have been totally obliterated. ||4||20||71|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (388-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bharam moh sagal binsaa-i-aa. ||4||20||71||

lines.english: When my God is totally pleased with me,
lines.transliteration: ja-o suparsan ho-i-o parabh mayraa.
taaN dookh bharam kaho kaisay nayraa. ||1|| then, tell me, how can suffering or doubt draw near me? ||1||

lines.english: Continually listening to Your Glory, I live.
lines.transliteration: sun sun jeevaa so-ay tumHaaree.

lines.english: I am worthless - save me, O Lord! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun ka-o layho uDhaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My suffering has been ended, and my anxiety is forgotten.
lines.transliteration: mit ga-i-aa dookh  bisaaree chint aa.

lines.english: I have obtained my reward, chanting the Mantra of the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: fal paa-i-aa jap satgur mannt aa. ||2||

lines.english: He is True, and True is His glory.
lines.transliteration: so-ee sat sat  hai so-ay.

lines.english: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, keep Him clasped to your heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: simar simar rakh kanth  paro-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, what action is there left to do,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ka-un uh karmaa.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (388-16) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man vasi-aa har naamaa. ||4||21||72|| by one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name? ||4||21||72||

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism lead to ruin.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar vigoot ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's humble servants are redeemed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har simran kar har jan chhootay. ||1||

lines.english: The mortals are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.
lines.transliteration: so-ay rahay maa-i-aa mad maat ay.

lines.english: The devotees remain awake, imbued with the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaagat bh agat simrat  har raat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In emotional attachment and doubt, the mortals wander through countlessincarnations.
lines.transliteration: moh bharam baho jon bh avaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The devotees remain ever-stable, meditating on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: asthir bhagat  har charan  Dhi-aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Bound to household and possessions, the mortals are lost in the deep, dark pit.
lines.transliteration: banDhan anDh  koop garih mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥੪॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
lines.english: The Saints are liberated, knowing the Lord to be near at hand. ||3||
lines.transliteration: muktay sant  bujheh har nayraa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one who has taken to God's Sanctuary,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo parabh sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (389-1) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai gat  paa-ee. ||4||22||73|| obtains peace in this world, and salvation in the world hereafter. ||4||22||73|| pMnw 389

lines.english: You are my waves, and I am Your fish.
lines.transliteration: too mayraa t arang ham meen t umaaray.

lines.english: You are my Lord and Master; I wait at Your Door. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too mayraa th aakur ham t ayrai d u-aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਰੰਗੁ  ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Creator, and I am Your servant.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayraa kart aa ha-o sayvak t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have taken to Your Sanctuary, O God, most profound and excellent. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saran gahee parabh  gunee gahayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਤਾ  ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: You are my life, You are my Support.
lines.transliteration: too mayraa jeevan t oo aaDh aar.

lines.english: Beholding You, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tujheh paykh  bigsai ka-ulaar. ||2||

lines.english: You are my salvation and honor; You make me acceptable.
lines.transliteration: too mayree gat  pat too parvaan.

lines.english: You are All-powerful, You are my strength. ||3||
lines.transliteration: too samrath mai t ayraa t aan. ||3||

lines.english: Night and day, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of excellence.
lines.transliteration: an-din japa-o naam gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਤੂ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer to God. ||4||23||74|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (389-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh peh ard aas. ||4||23||74||

lines.english: The mourner practices falsehood;
lines.transliteration: rovanhaarai jhooth  kamaanaa.
has has sog karat baygaanaa. ||1|| he laughs with glee, while mourning for others. ||1||

lines.english: Someone has died, while there is singing in someone else's house.
lines.transliteration: ko moo-aa kaa kai ghar gaavan.

lines.english: One mourns and bewails, while another laughs with glee. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ko rovai ko has has paavan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: From childhood to old age,
lines.transliteration: baal bivasthaa tay birDh aanaa.
pahuch na mookaa fir pachhut aanaa. ||2|| the mortal does not attain his goals, and he comes to regret in the end. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਕਾ ਕੈ ਘਿਰ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The world is under the influence of the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: tarihu gun  meh vart ai sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋ ਹਿਸ ਹਿਸ ਪਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal is reincarnated, again and again, into heaven and hell. ||3||
lines.transliteration: narak surag fir fir a-utaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one who is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo laa-i-aa naam.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (389-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: safal janam taa kaa parvaan. ||4||24||75|| becomes acceptable, and his life becomes fruitful. ||4||24||75||

lines.english: She remains asleep, and does not know the news of God.
lines.transliteration: so-ay rahee parabh kh abar na jaanee.

lines.english: The day dawns, and then, she regrets. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhor bh a-i-aa bahur pachh utaanee. ||1||

lines.english: Loving the Beloved, the mind is filled with celestial bliss.
lines.transliteration: pari-a paraym sahj man anad Dh ara-o ree.

lines.english: You yearn to meet with God, so why do you delay? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh milbay kee laalsaa t aa tay aalas kahaa kara-o ree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He came and poured His Ambrosial Nectar into your hands,
lines.transliteration: kar meh amrit aan  nisaari-o.
khisar ga-i-o bh oom par d aari-o. ||2|| but it slipped through your fingers, and fell onto the ground. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are burdened with desire, emotional attachment and egotism;
lines.transliteration: saad mohi laad ee ahaNkaaray.
dos naahee parabh  karnaihaaray. ||3|| it is not the fault of God the Creator. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਸਹਿਜ  ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਧਰਉ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the darkness of doubt is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mitay bh aram anDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਬੇ  ਕੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ  ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਲਸੁ  ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ  ਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends us with Himself. ||4||25||76|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (389-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak maylee sirjanhaaray. ||4||25||76||

lines.english: I long for the Lotus Feet of my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kee aas pi-aaray.

lines.english: The wretched Messenger of Death has run away from me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jamkankar nas ga-ay vichaaray. ||1||

lines.english: You enter into my mind, by Your Kind Mercy.
lines.transliteration: too chit  aavahi t ayree ma-i-aa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all diseases are destroyed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simrat naam sagal rog kh a-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Death gives so much pain to others,
lines.transliteration: anik dookh  dayveh avraa ka-o.
pahuch na saakeh jan tayray ka-o. ||2|| but it cannot even come near Your slave. ||2||

lines.english: My mind thirsts for Your Vision;
lines.transliteration: daras t ayray kee pi-aas man laagee.
sahj anand basai bairaagee. ||3|| in peaceful ease and bliss, I dwell in detachment. ||3||

lines.english: Hear this prayer of Nanak:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee ardaas sun eejai.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (389-16) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kayval naam riday meh d eejai. ||4||26||77|| please, infuse Your Name into his heart. ||4||26||77||

lines.english: My mind is satisfied, and my entanglements have been dissolved.
lines.transliteration: man taript aano mitay janjaal.

lines.english: God has become merciful to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh apunaa ho-i-aa kirpaal. ||1||

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, everything has turned out well.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  bhalee banee.

lines.english: His House is overflowing with all things; I have met Him, the Fearless Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai garihi sabh kichh  hai pooran so bh ayti-aa nirbh ai Dhanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਹੁਿਚ ਨ ਸਾਕਿਹ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Kind Mercy of the Holy Saints, the Naam has been implanted within me.
lines.transliteration: naam drirh-aa-i-aa saaDh  kirpaal.

lines.english: The most dreadful desires have been eliminated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mit ga-ee bhookh  mahaa bikraal. ||2||

lines.english: My Master has given me a gift;
lines.transliteration: thaakur apunai keenee d aat.
jalan bujhee man ho-ee saaNt. ||3|| the fire has been extinguished, and my mind is now at peace. ||3||

lines.english: My search has ended, and my mind is absorbed in celestial bliss. pMnw 390
lines.transliteration: mit ga-ee bhaal man sahj samaanaa.

lines.english: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||27||78|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (390-1) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paa-i-aa naam khajaanaa. ||4||27||78||

lines.english: Those who are attuned to their Lord and Master
lines.transliteration: thaakur si-o jaa kee ban aa-ee.
bhojan pooran rahay agh aa-ee. ||1|| are satisfied and fulfilled with the perfect food. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's devotees never run short of anything.
lines.transliteration: kachhoo na thoraa har bh agtan ka-o.

lines.english: They have plenty to eat, spend, enjoy and give. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khaat  kharchat  bilchh at dayvan ka-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: One who has the Unfathomable Lord of the Universe as his Master
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa Dhanee agam gusaa-ee.
maanukh kee kaho kayt  chalaa-ee. ||2|| - how can any mere mortal stand up to him? ||2||

lines.english: One who is served by the eighteen supernatural powers of the Siddhas
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayvaa das asat siDh aa-ee.
palak disat t aa kee laagahu paa-ee. ||3|| - grasp his feet, even for an instant. ||3||

lines.english: That one, upon whom You have showered Your Mercy, O my Lord Master
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o da-i-aa karahu mayray su-aamee.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (390-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak naahee tin kaamee. ||4||28||79|| - says Nanak, he does not lack anything. ||4||28||79||

lines.english: When I meditate on my True Guru,
lines.transliteration: ja-o mai apunaa satgur Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tab mayrai man mahaa sukh  paa-i-aa. ||1|| my mind becomes supremely peaceful. ||1||

lines.english: The record of my account is erased, and my doubts are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: mit ga-ee ganat  binaasi-o sansaa.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servant is blessed withgood fortune. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay jan bh a-ay bh agvant aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When I remember my Lord and Master,
lines.transliteration: ja-o mai apunaa saahib cheet.

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ta-o bh a-o miti-o mayray meet . ||2|| my fears are dispelled, O my friend. ||2||

lines.english: When I took to Your Protection, O God,
lines.transliteration: ja-o mai ot gahee parabh t ayree.
taaN pooran ho-ee mansaa mayree. ||3|| my desires were fulfilled. ||3||

lines.english: Gazing upon the wonder of Your play, my mind has become encouraged.
lines.transliteration: daykh  chalit  man bh a-ay d ilaasaa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak relies on You alone. ||4||29||80|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (390-9) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayraa bh arvaasaa. ||4||29||80||

lines.english: Night and day, the mouse of time gnaws away at the rope of life.
lines.transliteration: an-din moosaa laaj tukaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Falling into the well, the mortal eats the sweet treats of Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: girat koop meh kh aahi mith aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Thinking and planning, the night of the life is passing away.
lines.transliteration: sochat saachat  rain bihaanee.

lines.english: Thinking of the many pleasures of Maya, the mortal never remembers the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik rang maa-i-aa kay chitvat  kabhoo na simrai saringpaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Believing the shade of the tree to be permanent, he builds his house beneath it.
lines.transliteration: darum kee chh aa-i-aa nihchal garihu baaNDhi-aa.

lines.english: But the noose of death is around his neck, and Shakti, the power of Maya, has aimedher arrows at him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaal kai faaNs sakat sar saaNDhi-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The sandy shore is being washed away by the waves,
lines.transliteration: baaloo kanaaraa tarang mukh  aa-i-aa.
so thaan moorh nihchal kar paa-i-aa. ||3|| but the fool still believes that place to be permanent. ||3||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Name of the Lord, the King.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang japi-o har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਿਚਤਵਤ  ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਿਸਮਰੈ ਸਾਿਰੰਗਪਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak lives by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||30||81|| Awsw mhlw 5 duquky 9 ] (390-13) aasaa mehlaa 5 dut ukay 9. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Du-Tukas 9:
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevai har gun gaa-ay. ||4||30||81||

lines.english: With that, you are engaged in playful sport;
lines.transliteration: un kai sang too kart ee kayl.
un kai sang ham tum sang mayl. with that, I am joined to you.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਕੈ ਫਿਸ  ਸਕਤ  ਸਰੁ ਸਿਧਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: With that, everyone longs for you;
lines.transliteration: unH kai sang tum sabh  ko-oo lorai.
os binaa ko-oo mukh nahee jorai. ||1|| without it, no one would even look at your face. ||1||

lines.english: Where is that detached soul now contained?
lines.transliteration: tay bairaagee kahaa samaa-ay.

lines.english: Without it, you are miserable. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis bin t uhee d uhayree ree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With that, you are the woman of the house;
lines.transliteration: unH kai sang too garih meh maahar.
unH kai sang too ho-ee hai jaahar. with that, you are respected.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੂ ਕਰਤੀ  ਕੇਲ ॥
lines.english: With that, you are caressed;
lines.transliteration: unH kai sang too rakh ee papol.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੇਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: os binaa tooN chhutkee rol. ||2|| without it, you are reduced to dust. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
lines.english: With that, you have honor and respect;
lines.transliteration: unH kai sang tayraa maan mahat .
unH kai sang tum saak jagat . with that, you have relatives in the world.

lines.english: With that, you are adorned in every way;
lines.transliteration: unH kai sang tayree sabh  biDh thaatee.
os binaa tooN ho-ee hai maatee. ||3|| without it, you are reduced to dust. ||3||

lines.english: That detached soul is neither born, nor dies.
lines.transliteration: oh bairaagee marai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੂ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਮਿਹ ਮਾਹਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: It acts according to the Command of the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: hukmay baaDhaa kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, having fashioned the body, the Lord unites the soul with it, and separatesthem again;
lines.transliteration: jorh vichh orhay naanak thaap.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੂ ਰਖੀ ਪਪੋਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: He alone knows His All-powerful creative nature. ||4||31||82|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (390-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 391
lines.transliteration: apnee kudrat  jaanai aap. ||4||31||82||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰਤਾ  ਨਾ ਹਮ ਡਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He does not die, so I do not fear.
lines.transliteration: naa oh martaa naa ham dari-aa.

lines.english: He does not perish, so I do not grieve.
lines.transliteration: naa oh binsai naa ham karhi-aa.

lines.english: He is not poor, so I do not hunger.
lines.transliteration: naa oh nirDhan naa ham bh ookhay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is not in pain, so I do not suffer. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa os dookh  na ham ka-o d ookhay. ||1||

lines.english: There is no other Destroyer than Him.
lines.transliteration: avar na ko-oo maaranvaaraa.

lines.english: He is my very life, the Giver of life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a-o hamaaraa jee-o daynhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is not bound, so I am not in bondage.
lines.transliteration: naa us banDhan naa ham baaDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ  ਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
lines.english: He has no occupation, so I have no entanglements.
lines.transliteration: naa us DhanDh aa naa ham Dh aaDhay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਧਾਧੇ ॥
lines.english: He has no impurities, so I have no impurities.
lines.transliteration: naa us mail na ham ka-o mailaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮੈਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is in ecstasy, so I am always happy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: os anand ta ham sad  kaylaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਓਸੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਤ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He has no anxiety, so I have no cares.
lines.transliteration: naa us soch na ham ka-o sochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਚੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
lines.english: He has no stain, so I have no pollution.
lines.transliteration: naa us layp na ham ka-o pochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਪੋਚਾ ॥
lines.english: He has no hunger, so I have no thirst.
lines.transliteration: naa us bhookh  na ham ka-o t arisnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Since He is immaculately pure, I correspond to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa uho nirmal taaN ham jachnaa. ||3||

lines.english: I am nothing; He is the One and only.
lines.transliteration: ham kichh naahee aykai ohee.

lines.english: Before and after, He alone exists.
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai ayko so-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru has taken away my doubts and mistakes;
lines.transliteration: naanak gur kho-ay bh aram bh angaa.

lines.english: He and I, joining together, are of the same color. ||4||32||83|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (391-6) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ham o-ay mil ho-ay ik rangaa. ||4||32||83||

lines.english: Serve Him in many different ways;
lines.transliteration: anik bhaaNt kar sayvaa karee-ai.

lines.english: Dedicate your soul, your breath of life and your wealth to Him.
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan Dhan aagai Dh aree-ai.

lines.english: Carry water for Him, and wave the fan over Him - renounce your ego.
lines.transliteration: paanee pakhaa kara-o t aj abh imaan.

lines.english: Make yourself a sacrifice to Him, time and time again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik baar jaa-ee-ai kurbaan. ||1||

lines.english: She alone is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to God.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee suhaagan jo parabh  bhaa-ee.

lines.english: In her company, I may meet Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis kai sang mila-o mayree maa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am the water-carrier of the slaves of His slaves.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aasee kee panihaar.

lines.english: I treasure in my soul the dust of their feet.
lines.transliteration: unH kee rayn basai jee-a naal.

lines.english: By that good destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I obtain their society.
lines.transliteration: maathai bhaag t a paava-o sang.

lines.english: Through His Love, the Lord Master meets me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: milai su-aamee apunai rang. ||2||

lines.english: I dedicate all to Him - chanting and meditation, austerity and religious observances.
lines.transliteration: jaap taap d ayva-o sabh  naymaa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: I offer all to Him - good actions, righteous conduct and incense burning.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam arpa-o sabh  homaa.

lines.english: Renouncing pride and attachment, I become the dust of the feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: garab moh taj hova-o rayn.

lines.english: In their society, I behold God with my eyes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: unH kai sang daykh -a-u parabh  nain. ||3||

lines.english: Each and every moment, I contemplate and adore Him.
lines.transliteration: nimakh nimakh  ayhee aaraaDh a-o.

lines.english: Day and night, I serve Him like this.
lines.transliteration: dinas rain  ayh sayvaa saaDh a-o.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, the Cherisher of the World, has become merciful;
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal gupaal gobind .

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਦੇਖਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨੈਨ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (391-13) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak bakh sind. ||4||33||84|| in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, He forgives us. ||4||33||84||

lines.english: In the Love of God, eternal peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  sadaa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: In the Love of God, one is not touched by pain.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  dukh lagai na ko-ay.

lines.english: In the Love of God, the filth of ego is washed away.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  ha-umai mal kh o-ay.

lines.english: In the Love of God, one becomes forever immaculate. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  sad nirmal ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O friend: show such love and affection to God,
lines.transliteration: sunhu meet aisaa paraym pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan ghat gh at aaDh aar. ||1|| rahaa-o. the Support of the soul, the breath of life, of each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Love of God, all treasures are obtained.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  bha-ay sagal niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Love of God, the Immaculate Naam fills the heart.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  ridai nirmal naam.

lines.english: In the Love of God, one is eternally embellished.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  sad sobh aavant .

lines.english: In the Love of God, all anxiety is ended. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  sabh  mitee hai chint . ||2||

lines.english: In the Love of God, one crosses over this terrible world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  ih bh avjal t arai.

lines.english: In the Love of God, one does not fear death.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  jam t ay nahee darai.

lines.english: In the Love of God, all are saved.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  sagal uDh aarai.

lines.english: The Love of God shall go along with you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee pareet  chalai sangaaray. ||3||

lines.english: By himself, no one is united, and no one goes astray.
lines.transliteration: aaphu ko-ee milai na bhoolai.

lines.english: One who is blessed by God's Mercy, joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jis kirpaal tis saaDh sang gh oolai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tayrai kurbaan .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੈ ॥
lines.english: O God, You are the Support and the Strength of the Saints. ||4||34||85|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (391-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant ot parabh  tayraa t aan. ||4||34||85||

lines.english: Becoming a king, the mortal wields his royal authority;
lines.transliteration: bhoopat  ho-ay kai raaj kamaa-i-aa.
kar kar anrath vihaajee maa-i-aa. oppressing the people, he gathers wealth. pMnw 392

lines.english: Gathering it and collecting it, he fills his bags.
lines.transliteration: sanchat sanchat  thailee keenHee.

lines.english: But God takes it away from him, and gives it to another. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh us t ay daar avar ka-o d eenHee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਡਾਿਰ  ਅਵਰ  ਕਉ ਦੀਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal is like an unbaked clay pot in water;
lines.transliteration: kaach gagree-aa ambh majh ree-aa.
garab garab u-aahoo meh paree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. indulging in pride and egotism, he crumbles down and dissolves. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Being fearless, he becomes unrestrained.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o ho-i-o bh a-i-aa nihangaa.

lines.english: He does not think of the Creator, who is ever with him.
lines.transliteration: cheet na aa-i-o kart aa sangaa.

lines.english: He raises armies, and collects arms.
lines.transliteration: laskar jorhay kee-aa sambaahaa.

lines.english: But when the breath leaves him, he turns to ashes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: niksi-aa fook ta ho-ay ga-i-o su-aahaa. ||2||

lines.english: He has lofty palaces, mansions and queens,
lines.transliteration: oochay mandar mahal ar raanee.
hasat gh orhay jorh ay man bh aanee. elephants and pairs of horses, delighting the mind;
vad parvaar poot ar Dh ee-aa. he is blessed with a great family of sons and daughters.

lines.english: But, engrossed in attachment, the blind fool wastes away to death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mohi pachay pach anDhaa moo-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The One who created him destroys him.
lines.transliteration: jineh upaahaa tineh binaahaa.

lines.english: Enjoyments and pleasures are like just a dream.
lines.transliteration: rang rasaa jaisay supnaahaa.

lines.english: He alone is liberated, and possesses regal power and wealth,
lines.transliteration: so-ee muktaa t is raaj maal.

lines.english: O Nanak, whom the Lord Master blesses with His Mercy. ||4||35||86|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (392-6) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas jis kh asam d a-i-aal. ||4||35||86||

lines.english: The mortal is in love with this,
lines.transliteration: inH si-o pareet karee gh anayree.
ja-o milee-ai ta-o vaDh ai vaDh ayree. but the more he has, the more he longs for more.

lines.english: It hangs around his neck, and does not leave him.
lines.transliteration: gal chamrhee ja-o chh odai naahee.

lines.english: But falling at the feet of the True Guru, he is saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: laag chhuto sat gur kee paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I have renounced and discarded Maya, the Enticer of the world.
lines.transliteration: jag mohnee ham ti-aag gavaa-ee.

lines.english: I have met the Absolute Lord, and congratulations are pouring in. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nirgun mili-o vajee vaDhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: She is so beautiful, she captivates the mind.
lines.transliteration: aisee sundar man ka-o mohai.

lines.english: On the road, and the beach, at home, in the forest and in the wilderness, she touches us.
lines.transliteration: baat ghaat garihi ban ban johai.

lines.english: She seems so sweet to the mind and body.
lines.transliteration: man tan laagai ho-ay kai meeth ee.

lines.english: But by Guru's Grace, I have seen her to be deceptive. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad mai kh otee deeth ee. ||2||

lines.english: Her courtiers are also great deceivers.
lines.transliteration: agrak us kay vaday thagaa-oo.

lines.english: They do not spare even their fathers or mothers.
lines.transliteration: chhodeh naahee baap na maa-oo.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਮੀਠੀ  ॥
lines.english: They have enslaved their companions.
lines.transliteration: maylee apnay un lay baaNDhay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have subjugated them all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay mai saglay saaDh ay. ||3||

lines.english: Now, my mind is filled with bliss;
lines.transliteration: ab morai man bha-i-aa anand.
bha-o chookaa tootay sabh  fand. my fear is gone, and the noose is cut away.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when I met the True Guru,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa satgur paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I came to dwell within my home in absolute peace. ||4||36||87|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (392-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ghar saglaa mai sukh ee basaa-i-aa. ||4||36||87||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he knows the Lord to be near at hand;
lines.transliteration: aath pahar nikat kar jaanai.
parabh kaa kee-aa meeth aa maanai. he surrenders to the Sweet Will of God.

lines.english: The One Name is the Support of the Saints;
lines.transliteration: ayk naam santan aaDh aar.
ho-ay rahay sabh kee pag chh aar. ||1|| they remain the dust of the feet of all. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, to the way of life of the Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny;
lines.transliteration: sant rahat  sunhu mayray bh aa-ee.
u-aa kee mahimaa kathan na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. their praises cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Their occupation is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vartan  jaa kai kayval naam.

lines.english: The Kirtan, the Praise of the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is their rest.
lines.transliteration: anad roop keert an bisraam.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Friends and enemies are one and the same to them.
lines.transliteration: mitar sat ar jaa kai ayk samaanai.

lines.english: They know of no other than God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh apunay bin avar na jaanai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਆ  ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They erase millions upon millions of sins.
lines.transliteration: kot kot agh katan haaraa.

lines.english: They dispel suffering; they are givers of the life of the soul.
lines.transliteration: dukh door karan jee-a kay d aataaraa.

lines.english: They are so brave; they are men of their word.
lines.transliteration: soorbeer bachan kay balee.

lines.english: The Saints have enticed Maya herself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ka-ulaa bapuree santee chh alee. ||3||

lines.english: Their company is cherished even by the gods and the angels.
lines.transliteration: taa kaa sang baachh eh surd ayv.

lines.english: Blessed is their Darshan, and fruitful is their service.
lines.transliteration: amogh d aras safal jaa kee sayv.

lines.english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak offers his prayer:
lines.transliteration: kar jorh naanak karay ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਨ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Treasure of Excellence, please bless me with the service of the Saints. ||4||37||88|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (392-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mohi santeh tahal d eejai gunt aas. ||4||37||88||

lines.english: All peace and comforts are in the meditation of the One Name.
lines.transliteration: sagal sookh jap aykai naam.

lines.english: All righteous actions of Dharma are in the singing of the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sagal Dharam har kay gun  gaam.

lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is so very pure and sacred. pMnw 393
lines.transliteration: mahaa pavitar saaDh  kaa sang.

lines.english: Meeting with them, love for God is embraced. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis bhaytat  laagai parabh  rang. ||1||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, bliss is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad o-ay aanand  paavai.

lines.english: Meditating upon Him in remembrance, the mind is illumined; his state and condition cannot be described. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis simrat man ho-ay pargaasaa t aa kee gat  mit kahan na jaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਮਿਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Fasts, religious vows, cleansing baths, and worship to Him;
lines.transliteration: varat naym majan t is poojaa.
bayd puraan t in simrit  suneejaa. listening to the Vedas, Puraanas, and Shaastras.

lines.english: Extremely pure is he, and immaculate is his place,
lines.transliteration: mahaa puneet jaa kaa nirmal thaan.
saaDhsangat  jaa kai har har naam. ||2|| who meditates upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||

lines.english: That humble being becomes renowned all over the world.
lines.transliteration: pargati-o so jan saglay bhavan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Even sinners are purified, by the dust of his feet.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  taa kee pag rayn.

lines.english: One who has met the Lord, the Lord our King,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bhayti-o har har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee gat  mit kathan na jaa-ay. ||3|| his condition and state cannot be described. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, with palms pressed together, I meditate;
lines.transliteration: aath pahar kar jorh  Dhi-aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I yearn to obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: un saaDhaa kaa d arsan paava-o.

lines.english: Merge me, the poor one, with You, O Lord;
lines.transliteration: mohi gareeb ka-o layho ralaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||38||89|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (393-6) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aa-ay pa-ay sarnaa-ay. ||4||38||89||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes his cleansing bath in water;
lines.transliteration: aath pahar ud ak isnaanee.
sad hee bh og lagaa-ay sugi-aanee. he makes continual offerings to the Lord; he is a true man of wisdom.

lines.english: He never leaves anything uselessly.
lines.transliteration: birthaa kaahoo chhodai naahee.

lines.english: Again and again, he falls at the Lord's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bahur bahur tis laagah paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the Saalagraam, the stone idol, which I serve;
lines.transliteration: saalgiraam hamaarai sayvaa.
poojaa archaa bandan d ayvaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. such is my worship, flower-offerings and divine adoration as well. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: His bell resounds to the four corners of the world.
lines.transliteration: ghantaa jaa kaa sunee-ai chahu kunt.

lines.english: His seat is forever in heaven.
lines.transliteration: aasan jaa kaa sadaa baikunth .

lines.english: His chauri, his fly-brush, waves over all.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa chavar sabh oopar jh oolai.

lines.english: His incense is ever-fragrant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa kaa Dh oop sad aa parfulai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘੰਟਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਨੀਐ  ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ॥
lines.english: He is treasured in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at sampat hai ray jaa kaa.

lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is His Eternal Court.
lines.transliteration: abhag sabh aa sang hai saaDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਚਵਰੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਝੂਲੈ ॥
lines.english: His Aartee, his lamp-lit worship service, is the Kirtan of His Praises, which bringslasting bliss.
lines.transliteration: aartee keert an sad aa anand.

lines.english: His Greatness is so beautiful, and ever limitless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahimaa sundar sad aa bay-ant . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
lines.english: He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained;
lines.transliteration: jisahi paraapat t is hee lahnaa.
sant charan oh aa-i-o sarnaa. he takes to the Sanctuary of the Saints' Feet.

lines.english: I hold in my hands the Saalagraam of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: haath charhi-o har saalgiraam.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me this Gift. ||4||39||90|| Awsw mhlw 5 pMcpdw ] (393-12) aasaa mehlaa 5 panchpadaa. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Pada:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur keeno daan. ||4||39||90||

lines.english: That highway, upon which the water-carrier is plundered
lines.transliteration: jih paidai lootee panihaaree.
so maarag santan d ooraaree. ||1|| - that way is far removed from the Saints. ||1||

lines.english: The True Guru has spoken the Truth.
lines.transliteration: satgur poorai saach kahi-aa.

lines.english: Your Name, O Lord, is the Way to Salvation; the road of the Messenger of Death is far away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam tayray kee mukt ay beethee jam kaa maarag d oor rahi-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That place, where the greedy toll-collector dwells
lines.transliteration: jah laalach jaagaatee gh aat.
door rahee uh jan t ay baat. ||2|| - that path remains far removed from the Lord's humble servant. ||2||

lines.english: There, where so very many caravans of men are caught,
lines.transliteration: jah aavtay bahut gh an saath.
paarbarahm kay sangee saaDh. ||3|| the Holy Saints remain with the Supreme Lord. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਬੀਥੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਦੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chitra and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the unconscious, writethe accounts of all mortal beings,
lines.transliteration: chitar gupat  sabh  likh-tay laykh aa.
bhagat  janaa ka-o d arisat na paykh aa. ||4|| but they cannot even see the Lord's humble devotees. ||4||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one whose True Guru is Perfect
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis satgur pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਿਰ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਟ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 dupdw 1 ] (393-17) aasaa mehlaa 5 dupd aa 1. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Du-Pada 1:
lines.transliteration: vaajay taa kai anhad  tooraa. ||5||40||91|| - the unblown bugles of ecstasy vibrate for him. ||5||40||91||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Naam is learned;
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang sikh aa-i-o naam.
sarab manorath pooran kaam. all desires and tasks are fulfilled.

lines.english: My thirst has been quenched, and I am satiated with the Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: bujh ga-ee t arisnaa har jaseh agh aanay.

lines.english: I live by chanting and meditating upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeevaa saarigpaanay. ||1||

lines.english: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Creator, the Cause of all causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan saran pari-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have entered the home of celestial bliss. Darkness is dispelled, andthe moon of wisdom has risen. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 394
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad sahj gh ar paa-i-aa miti-aa anDh ayraa chand  charh i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;
lines.transliteration: laal javayhar bharay bh andaar.

lines.english: I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai jap nirankaar.

lines.english: How rare is that humble being, who drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: amrit sabad  peevai jan ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he attains the state of highest dignity. ||2||41||92|| Awsw Gru 7 mhlw 5 ] (394-2) aasaa ghar 7 mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kee param gat  ho-ay. ||2||41||92||

lines.english: Meditate continually on the Name of the Lord within your heart.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam ridai nit  Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Thus you shall save all your companions and associates. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sangee saathee sagal taraaN-ee. ||1||

lines.english: My Guru is always with me, near at hand.
lines.transliteration: gur mayrai sang sadaa hai naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simar simar tis sad aa samHaalay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your actions seem so sweet to me.
lines.transliteration: tayraa kee-aa meeth aa laagai.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||42||93|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (394-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naam padaarath naanak maaNgai. ||2||42||93||

lines.english: The world is saved by the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  tari-aa sansaar.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Support of the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam maneh aaDhaar. ||1||

lines.english: The Saints worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Divine Guru;
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gurdayv pi-aaray.
poojeh sant har pareet  pi-aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o. they love the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: She who has such good destiny written upon her forehead,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai mastak likh i-aa bh aag.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (394-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak taa kaa thir sohaag. ||2||43||94|| says Nanak, is blessed with the eternal happy marriage with the Lord. ||2||43||94||

lines.english: The Order of my Husband Lord seems so sweet to me.
lines.transliteration: meethee aagi-aa pir kee laagee.

lines.english: My Husband Lord has driven out the one who was my rival.
lines.transliteration: sa-ukan ghar kee kant  ti-aagee.

lines.english: My Beloved Husband has decorated me, His happy soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: pari-a sohaagan seegaar karee.

lines.english: He has quieted the burning thirst of my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man mayray kee tapat  haree. ||1||

lines.english: It is good that I submitted to the Will of my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhalo bh a-i-o pari-a kahi-aa maani-aa.

lines.english: I have realized celestial peace and poise within this home of mine. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj is gh ar kaa jaani-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am the hand-maiden, the attendant of my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bandee pari-a kh ijmatd aar.

lines.english: He is eternal and imperishable, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: oh abhinaasee agam apaar.

lines.english: Holding the fan, sitting at His Feet, I wave it over my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: lay pakhaa pari-a jh ala-o paa-ay.

lines.english: The five demons who tortured me have run away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhaag ga-ay panch d oot laavay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am not from a noble family, and I am not beautiful.
lines.transliteration: naa mai kul naa sobhaavant .

lines.english: What do I know? Why am I pleasing to my Beloved?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jaanaa ki-o bhaanee kant .

lines.english: I am a poor orphan, destitute and dishonored.
lines.transliteration: mohi anaath gareeb nimaanee.

lines.english: My Husband took me in, and made me His queen. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kant pakar ham keenee raanee. ||3||

lines.english: When I saw my Beloved's face before me,
lines.transliteration: jab mukh pareet am saajan laagaa.

lines.english: I became so happy and peaceful; my married life was blessed.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj mayraa Dh an sohaagaa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak moree pooran aasaa.

lines.english: The True Guru has united me with God, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||95|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (394-13) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur maylee parabh  guntaasaa. ||4||1||95||

lines.english: A frown creases her forehead, and her look is evil.
lines.transliteration: maathai tarikutee d arisat karoor.

lines.english: Her speech is bitter, and her tongue is rude.
lines.transliteration: bolai ka-urhaa jihbaa kee foorh .

lines.english: She is always hungry, and she believes her Husband to be far away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa bh ookhee pir jaanai d oor. ||1||

lines.english: Such is Maya, the woman, which the One Lord has created.
lines.transliteration: aisee istaree ik raam upaa-ee.

lines.english: She is devouring the whole world, but the Guru has saved me, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: un sabh jag kh aa-i-aa ham gur raakh ay mayray bh aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Administering her poisons, she has overcome the whole world.
lines.transliteration: paa-ay thag-ulee sabh  jag johi-aa.

lines.english: She has bewitched Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahaaday-o mohi-aa.

lines.english: Only those Gurmukhs who are attuned to the Naam are blessed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam lagay say sohi-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Performing fasts, religious observances and atonements, the mortals have grownweary.
lines.transliteration: varat naym kar thaakay punharchanaa.

lines.english: They wander over the entire planet, on pilgrimages to the banks of sacred rivers.
lines.transliteration: tat tirath bh avay sabh  Dharnaa.

lines.english: But they alone are saved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say ubray je satgur kee sarnaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ  ਹਮ ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to Maya, the whole world is in bondage.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi sabho jag baaDh aa.

lines.english: The foolish self-willed manmukhs are consumed by their egotism.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai pachai manmukh mooraakh aa.

lines.english: Taking me by the arm, Guru Nanak has saved me. ||4||2||96|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (394-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak baah pakar ham raakhaa. ||4||2||96||

lines.english: Everything is painful, when one forgets the Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: sarab dookh  jab bisrahi su-aamee.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, such a mortal is useless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa kaam na paraanee. ||1||

lines.english: The Saints are satisfied, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har. pMnw 395
lines.transliteration: sant t ariptaasay har har Dh ayaa-ay.

lines.english: Bestowing Your Mercy, God, You attach us to Your Name; all peace comes by Your Will. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apunai naa-ay laa-ay sarab sookh parabh  tumree rajaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਨਾਇ  ਲਾਏ ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is Ever-present; one who deems Him to be far away, dies again and again,repenting. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sang hovat ka-o jaanat  door. so jan mart aa nit  nit jhoor. ||2||

lines.english: The mortals do not remember the One, who has given them everything.
lines.transliteration: jin sabh kichh  dee-aa t is chit vat naahi.

lines.english: Engrossed in such terrible corruption, their days and nights waste away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikhi-aa meh d in rain jaahi. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance of the One Lord God.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh simrahu ayk.

lines.english: Salvation is obtained, in the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. ||4||3||97|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (395-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gat paa-ee-ai gur pooray tayk. ||4||3||97||

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are totallyrejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: naam japat man t an sabh  hari-aa.

lines.english: All sins and sorrows are washed away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kalmal dokh  sagal parhari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: How blessed is that day, O my Siblings of Destiny,
lines.transliteration: so-ee divas bh alaa mayray bh aa-ee.
har gun gaa-ay param gat paa-ee. rahaa-o. when the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung, and the supreme status is obtained.||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Worshipping the feet of the Holy Saints,
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kay poojay pair.
mitay updareh man t ay bair. ||2|| troubles and hatred are eliminated from the mind. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, conflict is ended,
lines.transliteration: gur pooray mil jhagar chukaa-i-aa.
panch doot  sabh  vasgat  aa-i-aa. ||3|| and the five demons are totally subdued. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: jis man vasi-aa har kaa naam.

lines.english: O Nanak - I am a sacrifice to him. ||4||4||98|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (395-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis oopar kurbaan. ||4||4||98||

lines.english: O singer, sing of the One,
lines.transliteration: gaav layhi too gaavanhaaray.
jee-a pind kay paraan aDhaaray. who is the Support of the soul, the body and the breath of life.

lines.english: Serving Him, all peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayvaa sarab sukh paavahi.

lines.english: You shall no longer go to any other. ||1||
lines.transliteration: avar kaahoo peh bahurh na jaaveh. ||1||

lines.english: My Blissful Lord Master is forever in bliss; meditate continually and forever, on the Lord, the treasure of excellence.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand anandee saahib gun niDh aan nit  nit jaapee-ai.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints; by their kind favor, God comes to dwell in themind. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: balihaaree tis sant  pi-aaray jis parsaad  parabh  man vaasee-ai. rahaa-o.

lines.english: His gifts are never exhausted.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa daan nikh ootai naahee.

lines.english: In His subtle way, He easily absorbs all.
lines.transliteration: bhalee bh aat sabh  sahj samaahee.

lines.english: His benevolence cannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee bakhas na maytai ko-ee.

lines.english: So enshrine that True Lord within your mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man vaasaa-ee-ai saachaa so-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: His house is filled with all sorts of articles;
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree garih jaa kai pooran.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰ  ਕਾਹੂ ਪਿਹ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God's servants never suffer pain.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak d ookh na jh ooran.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਅਨੰਦੀ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਗੁਨ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਜਾਪੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Holding to His Support, the state of fearless dignity is obtained.
lines.transliteration: ot gahee nirbha-o pad  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਾਸੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, sing of the Lord, the treasure of excellence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saas saas so gun niDh gaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: He is not far from us, wherever we go.
lines.transliteration: door na ho-ee kat hoo jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: When He shows His Mercy, we obtain the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa har har paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: I offer this prayer to the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: ardaas karee pooray gur paas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||99|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (395-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai har Dhan raas. ||4||5||99||

lines.english: First, the pains of the body vanish;
lines.transliteration: parathmay miti-aa tan kaa d ookh.
man sagal ka-o ho-aa sookh. then, the mind becomes totally peaceful.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਦੂਖ ਨ ਝੂਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: In His Mercy, the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur deeno naa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bal bal tis sat gur ka-o jaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: I have obtained the Perfect Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-i-o mayray bhaa-ee.

lines.english: All illness, sorrows and sufferings are dispelled, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rog sog sabh d ookh binaasay sat gur kee sarn aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The feet of the Guru abide within my heart;
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan hirdai vasaa-ay.

lines.english: I have received all the fruits of my heart's desires.
lines.transliteration: man chintat  saglay fal paa-ay.

lines.english: The fire is extinguished, and I am totally peaceful.
lines.transliteration: agan bujhee sabh  ho-ee saaNt.

lines.english: Showering His Mercy, the Guru has given this gift. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur keenee daat . ||2||

lines.english: The Guru has given shelter to the shelterless.
lines.transliteration: nithaavay ka-o gur deeno thaan.

lines.english: The Guru has given honor to the dishonored.
lines.transliteration: nimaanay ka-o gur keeno maan.

lines.english: Shattering his bonds, the Guru has saved His servant.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaat sayvak kar raakh ay.

lines.english: I taste with my tongue the Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit baanee rasnaa chaakh ay. ||3||

lines.english: By great good fortune, I worship the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag pooj gur charnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Forsaking everything, I have obtained God's Sanctuary. pMnw 396
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag paa-ee parabh  sarnaa.

lines.english: That humble being, O Nanak, unto whom the Guru grants His Mercy, is forever enraptured. ||4||6||100|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (396-2) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak jaa ka-o bha-i-aa d a-i-aalaa. so jan ho-aa sad aa nihaalaa. ||4||6||100||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has truly given a child.
lines.transliteration: satgur saachai d ee-aa bh ayj.

lines.english: The long-lived one has been born to this destiny.
lines.transliteration: chir jeevan upji-aa sanjog.

lines.english: He came to acquire a home in the womb,
lines.transliteration: udrai maahi aa-ay kee-aa nivaas.
maataa kai man bahut  bigaas. ||1|| and his mother's heart is so very glad. ||1||

lines.english: A son is born - a devotee of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jammi-aa poot bh agat govind  kaa.

lines.english: This pre-ordained destiny has been revealed to all. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pargati-aa sabh meh likh i-aa Dh ur kaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the tenth month, by the Lord's Order, the baby has been born.
lines.transliteration: dasee maasee hukam baalak janam lee-aa.

lines.english: Sorrow is dispelled, and great joy has ensued.
lines.transliteration: miti-aa sog mahaa anand thee-aa.

lines.english: The companions blissfully sing the songs of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee sakh ee anand gaavai.

lines.english: This is pleasing to the Lord Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachay saahib kai man bhaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਬਾਲਕ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The vine has grown, and shall last for many generations.
lines.transliteration: vaDhee vayl baho peerh ee chaalee.

lines.english: Dharam kalaa har banDh  bahaalee. The Power of the Dharma has been firmly established by the Lord.
That which my mind wishes for, the True Guru has granted.
lines.transliteration: man chindi-aa sat guroo d ivaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have become carefree, and I fix my attention on the One Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay achint  ayk liv laa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: As the child places so much faith in his father,
lines.transliteration: ji-o baalak pitaa oopar karay baho maan .

lines.english: I speak as it pleases the Guru to have me speak.
lines.transliteration: bulaa-i-aa bolai gur kai bhaan .

lines.english: This is not a hidden secret;
lines.transliteration: gujhee chh annee naahee baat .

lines.english: Guru Nanak, greatly pleased, has bestowed this gift. ||4||7||101|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (396-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuth aa keenee d aat. ||4||7||101||

lines.english: Giving His Hand, the Perfect Guru has protected the child.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray raakhi-aa d ay haath.

lines.english: The glory of His servant has become manifest. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-i-aa jan kaa part aap. ||1||

lines.english: I contemplate the Guru, the Guru; I meditate on the Guru, the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur gur japee guroo gur Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.english: I offer my heart-felt prayer to the Guru, and it is answered. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee ardaas guroo peh paa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: saran paray saachay gurdayv.

lines.english: The service of His servant has been fulfilled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pooran ho-ee sayvak sayv. ||2||

lines.english: He has preserved my soul, body, youth and breath of life.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind joban raakhai paraan.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||3||8||102|| Awsw Gru 8 kwPI mhlw 5  (396-12) aasaa ghar 8 kaafee mehlaa 5 Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (396-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur ka-o kurbaan. ||3||8||102||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਹ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am Your purchased slave, O True Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: mai bandaa bai kh areed  sach saahib mayraa.

lines.english: My soul and body, and all of this, everything is Yours. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is daa sabh  kichh  hai tayraa. ||1||

lines.english: You are the honor of the dishonored. O Master, in You I place my trust.
lines.transliteration: maan nimaan ay tooN Dhanee tayraa bh arvaasaa.

lines.english: Without the True One, any other support is false - know this well. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin saachay an tayk hai so jaanhu kaachaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your Command is infinite; no one can find its limit.
lines.transliteration: tayraa hukam apaar hai ko-ee ant  na paa-ay.

lines.english: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, walks in the Way of the Lord's Will. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis gur pooraa bhaytsee so chalai rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Cunning and cleverness are of no use.
lines.transliteration: chaturaa-ee si-aan paa kit ai kaam na aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: That which the Lord Master gives, by the Pleasure of His Will - that is pleasing to me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tuthaa saahib jo d ayvai so-ee sukh  paa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One may perform tens of thousands of actions, but attachment to things is notsatisfied.
lines.transliteration: jay lakh karam kamaa-ee-ahi kichh  pavai na banDh aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has made the Naam his Support. He has renounced otherentanglements. ||4||1||103|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (396-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak keetaa naam Dh ar hor chh odi-aa Dh anDhaa. ||4||1||103||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have pursued all pleasures, but none is as great as the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai bh aali-aa har jayvad na ko-ee.
