lines.english: By the Pleasure of the Guru's Will, the True Lord Master is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ay tay paa-ee-ai sach saahib so-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ  ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay sad  sad kurbaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ  ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please, grant me this one blessing, that I may never, even for an instant, forget Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam na visra-o ik khin chasaa ih keejai d aanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How very fortunate are those who have the wealth of the Lord deep within the heart. pMnw 397
lines.transliteration: bhaagath  sachaa so-ay hai jis har Dh an ant ar.

lines.english: They escape from the great noose of death; they are permeated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so chhootai mahaa jaal t ay jis gur sabad  nirant ar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ  ਤੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can I chant the Glorious Praises of the Guru? The Guru is the ocean of Truth andclear understanding.
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa ki-aa kahaa gur bibayk sat sar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਬਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord, from the very beginning, and throughout theages. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oh aad jugaad ee jugah jug pooraa parmaysar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਜੁਗਹ  ਜੁਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, my mind is filledwith the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aavahu sad  sadaa har har man rangay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is my soul, my breath of life, and wealth; O Nanak, He is with me forever.||4||2||104|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (397-3) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan Dh an guroo hai naanak kai sangay. ||4||2||104||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
lines.english: If the Invisible and Infinite Lord dwells within my mind, even for a moment,
lines.transliteration: saa-ee alakh apaar bh oree man vasai.
dookh  darad rog maa-ay maidaa habh  nasai. ||1|| then all my pains, troubles, and diseases vanish. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭੋਰੀ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vanjaa kurbaan  saa-ee aapn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ  ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him, a great joy wells up within my mind and body. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hovai anad gh anaa man t an jaapn ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have heard only a little bit of news about the True Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: bindak gaaleh sun ee sachay t is Dhanee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ  ਘਣਾ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਪਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have obtained the peace of all peace, O my mother; I cannot estimate its worth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sookhee hooN sukh  paa-ay maa-ay na keem gan ee. ||2||

lines.english: He is so beautiful to my eyes; beholding Him, I have been bewitched.
lines.transliteration: nain pasand o so-ay paykh  must aak bh a-ee.

lines.english: I am worthless, O my mother; He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe.||3||
lines.transliteration: mai nirgun mayree maa-ay aap larh  laa-ay la-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਇ  ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is beyond the world of the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible.
lines.transliteration: bayd kat ayb sansaar habh aa hooN baahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ  ਸੋਇ ਪੇਿਖ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ  ਭਈ ॥
lines.english: The Supreme King of Nanak is immanent and manifest. ||4||3||105|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (397-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa paatisaahu d isai jaahraa. ||4||3||105||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਿਨਰਗੁਿਣ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ  ਆਿਪ  ਲਿੜ ਲਾਇ  ਲਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Tens of thousands of devotees worship and adore You, chanting, "Beloved, Beloved."
lines.transliteration: laakh bh agat aaraaDh eh japt ay pee-o pee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: How shall You unite me, the worthless and corrupt soul, with Yourself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kavan jugat maylaava-o nirgun  bikh-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: You are my Support, O Merciful God, Lord of the Universe, Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk govind  gupaal d a-i-aal parabh .

lines.english: You are the Master of all; the entire creation is Yours. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN sabh naa kay naath t ayree sarisat sabh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਖ  ਭਗਤ  ਆਰਾਧਿਹ  ਜਪਤੇ  ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.english: You are the constant help and support of the Saints, who behold You Ever-present.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sahaa-ee sant  paykh eh sad aa hajoor.

lines.english: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die, engulfed in sorrow andpain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonrhi-aa say marniH visoor visoor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ॥
lines.english: Those servants, who lovingly perform the Lord's service, are freed from the cycle ofreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: daas d aastan bhaa-ay miti-aa t inaa ga-on .

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What shall be the fate of those who forget the Naam? ||3||
lines.transliteration: visri-aa jinHaa naam tinaarh aa haal ka-un . ||3||

lines.english: As are the cattle which have strayed, so is the entire world.
lines.transliteration: jaisay pas hariH-aa-o taisaa sansaar sabh .

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਸੰਤ ਪੇਖਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O God, please cut away Nanak's bonds, and unite him with Yourself. ||4||4||106|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (397-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak banDhan kaat milaavhu aap parabh . ||4||4||106||

lines.english: Forget all other things, and dwell upon the Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: habhay thok visaar hiko kh i-aal kar.

lines.english: Lay aside your false pride, and dedicate your mind and body to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa laahi gumaan man t an arap Dh ar. ||1||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, praise the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar saalaahi sirjanhaar t ooN.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਿਰਆਉ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
lines.english: I live by Your bountiful gifts - please, shower me with Your Mercy! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeevaaN tayree d aat kirpaa karahu mooN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So, do that work, by which your face shall be made radiant.
lines.transliteration: so-ee kamm kamaa-ay jit mukh  ujlaa.

lines.english: He alone becomes attached to the Truth, O Lord, unto whom You give it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so-ee lagai sach jis tooN deh alaa. ||2||

lines.english: So build and adorn that house, which shall never be destroyed.
lines.transliteration: jo na dhahand o mool so gh ar raas kar.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਿਹ  ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Enshrine the One Lord within your consciousness; He shall never die. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hiko chit vasaa-ay kad ay na jaa-ay mar. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord is dear to those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.
lines.transliteration: tinHaa pi-aaraa raam jo parabh  bhaani-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak describes the indescribable. ||4||5||107|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (397-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad akath naanak vakh aani-aa. ||4||5||107||

lines.english: What are they like - those who do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: jinHaa na visrai naam say kinayhi-aa.

lines.english: Know that there is absolutely no difference; they are exactly like the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhayd  na jaan hu mool saaN-ee jayhi-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਿਚ ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਅਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The mind and body are enraptured, meeting with You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan ho-ay nihaal t umH sang bh ayti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਨ  ਢਹੰਦੋ  ਮੂਿਲ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਕਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Peace is obtained, by the favor of the Lord's humble servant; all pains are taken away.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-aa jan parsaad  dukh sabh  mayti-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: As many as are the continents of the world, so many have been saved.
lines.transliteration: jaytay kh and barahmand uDh aaray t inH khay.

lines.english: Those, in whose minds You Yourself dwell, O Lord, are the perfect devotees. ||2|| pMnw 398
lines.transliteration: jinH man vuthaa aap pooray bh agat say. ||2||

lines.english: Those whom You approve, are approved.
lines.transliteration: jis no mannay aap so-ee maanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਸਭ ਠਾਈ  ਜਾਨੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Such a celebrated and honored person is known everywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pargat purakh parvaan  sabh  thaa-ee jaanee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: Day and night, with every breath to worship and adore the Lord
lines.transliteration: dinas rain  aaraaDh  samHaalay saah saah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (398-2) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee lochaa poor sachay paatisaah. ||4||6||108|| - please, O True Supreme King, fulfill this, Nanak's desire. ||4||6||108||

lines.english: He, my Lord Master, is fully pervading all places.
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-aa sarab thaa-ay hamaaraa kh asam so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਠਾਇ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He is the One Lord Master, the roof over our heads; there is no other than Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk saahib sir chhat  doojaa naahi ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਛਤੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As it pleases Your Will, please save me, O Savior Lord.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  raakh anhaari-aa.

lines.english: Without You, my eyes see no other at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na ko-ay nad ar nihaari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God Himself is the Cherisher; He takes care of each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: partipaalay parabh  aap gh at ghat saaree-ai.

lines.english: That person, within whose mind You Yourself dwell, never forgets You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis man vuthaa aap t is na visaaree-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He does that which is pleasing to Himself.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so aap aapan  bhaani-aa.

lines.english: He is known as the help and support of His devotees, throughout the ages. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa sahaa-ee jug jug jaan i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਆਪਣ ਭਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting and meditating up the Lord's Name, the mortal never comes to regret anything.
lines.transliteration: jap jap har kaa naam kaday na jh ooree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, fulfill my desire, OLord. ||4||7||109|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (398-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daras pi-aas lochaa pooree-ai. ||4||7||109||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Why are you sleeping, and forgetting the Name, O careless and foolish mortal?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa soveh naam visaar gaafal gahili-aa.

lines.english: So many have been washed away and carried off by this river of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kiteeN it daree-aa-ay vaNnjniH vehd i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, get aboard the boat of the Lord's Lotus Feet, and cross over.
lines.transliteration: bohithrhaa har charan  man charh  langh ee-ai.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun  gaa-ay saaDh oo sangee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You may enjoy various pleasures, but they are useless without the Name.
lines.transliteration: bhogeh bh og anayk vin  naavai sunj i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਿਹਥੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਮਨ ਚਿੜ ਲੰਘੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Without devotion to the Lord, you shall die in sorrow, again and again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  binaa mar mar runni-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You may dress and eat and apply scented oils to your body,
lines.transliteration: kaparh bh og suganDh  tan mard an maaln aa.
bin simran tan chh aar sarpar chaaln aa. ||3|| but without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, your body shall surely turn todust, and you shall have to depart. ||3||

lines.english: How very treacherous is this world-ocean; how very few realize this!
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikham sansaar virlai paykh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਬਨਾ  ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਰੁੰਿਨਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Salvation rests in the Lord's Sanctuary; O Nanak, this is your pre-ordained destiny. ||4||8||110|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (398-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chhootan har kee saran  laykh  naanak laykh i-aa. ||4||8||110||

lines.punjabi: ਕਪੜ  ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ  ਤਿਨ ਮਰਦਨ  ਮਾਲਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: No one is anyone's companion; why take any pride in others?
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na kis hee sang kaahay garbee-ai.

lines.english: With the Support of the One Name, this terrible world-ocean is crossed over. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk naam aaDhaar bh a-ojal t arbee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: You are the True Support of me, the poor mortal, O my Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: mai gareeb sach tayk tooN mayray sat gur pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਿਖਆ  ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, my mind is encouraged. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daykh  tumHaaraa d arsano mayraa man Dh eeray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Royal powers, wealth, and worldly involvements are of no use at all.
lines.transliteration: raaj maal janjaal kaaj na kitai gano.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my Support; this wealth is everlasting. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har keertan aaDh aar nihchal ayhu Dh ano. ||2||

lines.english: As many as are the pleasures of Maya, so many are the shadows they leave.
lines.transliteration: jaytay maa-i-aa rang t ayt pachh aavi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ  ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs sing of the Naam, the treasure of peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sukh kaa naam niDh aan gurmukh  gaavi-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਦਰਸਨੋ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the True Lord, the treasure of excellence; O God, You are deep and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: sachaa gunee niDh aan tooN parabh  gahir gambh eeray.

lines.english: The Lord Master is the hope and support of Nanak's mind. ||4||9||111|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (398-16) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aas bharosaa kh asam kaa naanak kay jee-aray. ||4||9||111||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ਜੰਜਾਲੁ  ਕਾਿਜ  ਨ ਿਕਤੈ  ਗਨ ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him, suffering is removed, and celestial peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat d ukh jaa-ay sahj sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.||1||
lines.transliteration: rain d inas kar jorh  har har Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: He alone is Nanak's God, unto whom all beings belong.
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa parabh so-ay jis kaa sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: He is totally pervading everywhere, the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab rahi-aa bharpoor sachaa sach so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, He is my companion and my helper; He is the One to berealized.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sang sahaa-ee gi-aan jog.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਭਰੋਸਾ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ  ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
lines.english: Adoring Him, my mind is cured of all its ailments. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tiseh araaDh  manaa binaasai sagal rog. ||2||

lines.english: The Savior Lord is infinite; He saves us from the fire of the womb. pMnw 399
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaar apaar raakh ai agan maahi.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is soothing and cool; remembering it in meditation, the inner fire is quenched. ||3||
lines.transliteration: seetal har har naam simrat  tapat jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਤਪਿਤ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Peace, poise, and immense bliss, O Nanak, are obtained, when one becomes the dustof the feet of the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ghanaa naanak jan Dh ooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਘਣਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: All of one's affairs are perfectly resolved, meeting with the Perfect Guru.||4||10||112|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (399-2) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaaraj saglay siDh bh a-ay bh ayti-aa gur pooraa. ||4||10||112||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਭਏ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is the treasure of excellence; He is known only to theGurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gobind gun ee niDh aan gurmukh  jaanee-ai.

lines.english: When He shows His Mercy and Kindness, we revel in the Lord's Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay kirpaal da-i-aal har rang maan ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: Come, O Saints - let us join together and speak the Sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sant milaah har kathaa kahaan ee-aa.

lines.english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and ignore the criticism of others. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an-din simreh naam t aj laaj lokaan ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and so I obtain immense bliss.
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeevaa naam hovai anad gh anaa.

lines.english: Attachment to the world is useless and vain; it is false, and perishes in the end. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa moh sansaar jhooth aa vin sanaa. ||2||

lines.english: How rare are those who embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sang nayhu kinai virlai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ  ਘਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan suhaavaa mukh  jin har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||3|| Blessed and beautiful is that mouth, which meditates on the Lord. ||3||
The pains of birth, death and reincarnation are erased by meditating on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh kaal simrat  mit jaav-ee.

lines.english: That alone is Nanak's joy, which is pleasing to God. ||4||11||113|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (399-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kai sukh so-ay jo parabh  bhaav-ee. ||4||11||113||

lines.english: Come, O friends: let us meet together and enjoy all the tastes and flavors.
lines.transliteration: aavhu meet ikat ar ho-ay ras kas sabh  bhunchah.

lines.english: Let us join together and chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and so wipe away our sins. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam har har japah mil paapaa munchah. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਈ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
lines.english: Reflect upon the essence of reality, O Saintly beings, and no troubles shall afflict you.
lines.transliteration: tat veechaarahu sant  janhu t aa tay bigh an na laagai.

lines.english: All of the thieves shall be destroyed, as the Gurmukhs remain wakeful. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kheen bh a-ay sabh  taskaraa gurmukh  jan jaagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਇਕਤਰ੍  ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਿਭ ਭੁੰਚਹ  ॥
lines.english: Take wisdom and humility as your supplies, and burn away the poison of pride.
lines.transliteration: buDh gareebee kh arach laihu ha-umai bikh  jaarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਾਪਾ  ਮੁੰਚਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True is that shop, and perfect the transaction; deal only in the merchandise of theNaam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachaa hat pooraa sa-udaa vakh ar naam vaapaarahu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are accepted and approved, who dedicate their souls, bodies and wealth.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind Dhan arpi-aa say-ee pat ivantay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਿਭ ਤਸਕਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to their God, celebrate in happiness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapnarhay parabh  bhaani-aa nit  kayl karant ay. ||3||

lines.english: Those fools, who drink in the wine of evil-mindedness, become the husbands ofprostitutes.
lines.transliteration: durmat  mad jo peevt ay bikh lee pat  kamlee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਿਧ ਗਰੀਬੀ  ਖਰਚੁ  ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: But those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, O Nanak, are intoxicated with the Truth. ||4||12||114|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (399-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in jo rat ay naanak sach amlee. ||4||12||114||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਹਟੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ  ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I made the effort; I did it, and made a beginning.
lines.transliteration: udam kee-aa karaa-i-aa aarambh  rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam. The Guru has implanted this Mantrawithin me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japay jap jeevnaa gur mant ar drirh -aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I fall at the Feet of the True Guru, who has dispelled my doubts.
lines.transliteration: paa-ay parah satguroo kai jin bh aram bid aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਦੁ ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ  ਿਬਖਲੀ  ਪਿਤ ਕਮਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Bestowing His Mercy, God has dressed me, and decorated me with the Truth.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aapn ee sach saaj savaari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਿਣ  ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ  ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
lines.english: Taking me by the hand, He made me His own, through the True Order of HisCommand.
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay aapnay sach hukam rajaa-ee.

lines.english: That gift which God gave to me, is perfect greatness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo parabh d itee daat saa pooran vadi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chant the Name of theDestroyer of ego.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa gun  gaa-ee-ah jap naam muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵਣਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My vows have been honored, by the Grace of God and the True Guru, who has showered His Mercy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naym nibaahi-o satguroo parabh  kirpaa Dh aaree. ||3||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has given the wealth of the Naam, and the profit of singing theLord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhan gun  gaa-o laabh  poorai gur d itaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਜ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saints are the traders, O Nanak, and the Infinite Lord God is their Banker.||4||13||115|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (399-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vanjaaray sant  naankaa parabh  saahu amit aa. ||4||13||115||

lines.english: One who has You as His Master, O God, is blessed with great destiny.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa thaakur t uhee parabh  taa kay vadbh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੀਨੇ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਰਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is happy, and forever at peace; his doubts and fears are all dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: oh suhaylaa sad sukh ee sabh  bharam bh a-o bh aagaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਦਤੀ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am the slave of the Lord of the Universe; my Master is the greatest of all.
lines.transliteration: ham chaakar gobind kay th aakur mayraa bh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਿਹ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is my True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan sagal biDh so sat guroo hamaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There is no other whom I should fear. pMnw 400
lines.transliteration: doojaa naahee a-or ko t aa kaa bh a-o karee-ai.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is obtained, and the impassable world-ocean is crossed over. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa mahal paa-ee-ai jag dut ar taree-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By Your Glance of Grace, peace is obtained, and the treasure fills the mind.
lines.transliteration: darisat t ayree sukh  paa-ee-ai man maahi niDh aanaa.

lines.english: That servant, unto whom You bestow Your Mercy, is approved and accepted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o tum kirpaal bh a-ay sayvak say parvaanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ਭਏ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: How rare is that person who drinks in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord's Kirtan.
lines.transliteration: amrit ras har keert ano ko virlaa peevai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੋ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਪੀਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the commodity of the One Name; he lives by chanting andmeditating on it within his heart. ||4||14||116|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (400-3) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vajahu naanak milai ayk naam rid jap jap jeevai. ||4||14||116||

lines.punjabi: ਵਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੧੬॥
lines.english: I am God's maid-servant; He is the highest of all.
lines.transliteration: jaa parabh kee ha-o chayrulee so sabh  tay oochaa.

lines.english: All things, big and small, are said to belong to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  taa kaa kaaNdhee-ai thoraa ar moochaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੁਲੀ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: I surrender my soul, my breath of life, and my wealth, to my Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan mayraa Dhano saahib kee manee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਢੀਐ  ਥੋਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through His Name, I become radiant; I am known as His slave. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam jisai kai oojlee tis d aasee ganee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੋ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੀ ਮਨੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are Carefree, the Embodiment of Bliss. Your Name is a gem, a jewel.
lines.transliteration: vayparvaahu anand mai naa-o maanak heeraa.

lines.english: One who has You as her Master, is satisfied, satiated and happy forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rajee Dhaa-ee sad aa sukh  jaa kaa t ooN meeraa. ||2||

lines.english: O my companions and fellow maidens, please implant that balanced understanding within me.
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahayree sang kee sumat  darirhaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ  ਮੈ ਨਾਉ  ਮਾਣਕ  ਹੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Holy Saints lovingly, and find the treasure of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sayvhu saaDhoo bh aa-o kar t a-o niDh  har paava-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਜੀ ਧਾਈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All are servants of the Lord Master, and all call Him their own.
lines.transliteration: saglee daasee th aakurai sabh  kahtee mayraa.

lines.english: She alone dwells in peace, O Nanak, whom the Lord adorns. ||4||15||117|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (400-8) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jisahi seegaaray naankaa tis sukh eh basayraa. ||4||15||117||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਤਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Become the servant of the Saints, and learn this way of life.
lines.transliteration: santaa kee ho-ay d aasree ayhu achaaraa sikh  ree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੀ  ਦਾਸੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰੈ  ਸਭ ਕਹਤੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Of all virtues, the most sublime virtue is to see your Husband Lord near at hand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sagal gunaa gun  ootmo bh artaa door na pikh  ree. ||1||

lines.english: So, dye this mind of yours with the color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: ih man sundar aapn aa har naam majeeth ai rang ree.

lines.english: Renounce cleverness and cunning, and know that the Sustainer of the world is with you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ti-aag si-aan ap chaat uree t ooN jaan gupaaleh sang ree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਰੀ  ਏਹੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ  ਿਸਖੁ ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Whatever your Husband Lord says, accept that, and make it your decoration.
lines.transliteration: bhartaa kahai so maanee-ai ayhu seegaar ban aa-ay ree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ  ਗੁਣ ਊਤਮੋ  ਭਰਤਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਿਪਖੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forget the love of duality, and chew upon this betel leaf. ||2||
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aa-o visaaree-ai ayhu t ambolaa kh aa-ay ree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਜੀਠੈ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Make the Word of the Guru's Shabad your lamp, and let your bed be Truth.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad kar d eepko ih sat  kee sayj bichh aa-ay ree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਚਾਤੁਰੀ  ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੁ  ਗੁਪਾਲਿਹ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, stand with your palms pressed together, and the Lord, yourKing, shall meet you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar kar jorh  rahu t a-o bh aytai har raa-ay ree. ||3||

lines.english: She alone is cultured and embellished, and she alone is of incomparable beauty.
lines.transliteration: tis hee chaj seegaar sabh  saa-ee roop apaar ree.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਤਾ  ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ  ਏਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: She alone is the happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who is pleasing to the Creator Lord.||4||16||118|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (400-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saa-ee sohagan naankaa jo bh aanee kart aar ree. ||4||16||118||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ਏਹੁ ਤੰਬੋਲਾ  ਖਾਇ  ਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As long as there are doubts in the mind, the mortal staggers and falls.
lines.transliteration: deegan dolaa ta-oo la-o ja-o man kay bh armaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਿਰ ਦੀਪਕੋ  ਇਹ ਸਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ ਿਬਛਾਇ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The Guru removed my doubts, and I have obtained my place of rest. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bharam kaatay gur aapn ai paa-ay bisraamaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those quarrelsome enemies have been overcome, through the Guru.
lines.transliteration: o-ay bikhaad ee dokhee-aa t ay gur t ay hootay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਚਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਈ  ਰੂਿਪ ਅਪਾਿਰ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: I have now escaped from them, and they have run away from me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham chhootay ab unHaa tay o-ay ham t ay chh ootay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਸਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਜੋ ਭਾਣੀ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੧੮॥
lines.english: He is concerned with 'mine and yours', and so he is held in bondage.
lines.transliteration: mayraa tayraa jaant aa tab hee t ay banDh aa.

lines.english: When the Guru dispelled my ignorance, then the noose of death was cut away frommy neck. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kaatee agi-aantaa t ab chh utkay fanDh aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਡੀਗਨ  ਡੋਲਾ  ਤਊ ਲਉ ਜਉ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: As long as he does not understand the Command of God's Will, he remains miserable.
lines.transliteration: jab lag hukam na boojh-t aa tab hee la-o d ukhee-aa.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, he comes to recognize God's Will, and then, he becomeshappy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur mil hukam pachhaan i-aa tab hee t ay sukh ee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: I have no enemies and no adversaries; no one is wicked to me.
lines.transliteration: naa ko dusman d okhee-aa naahee ko mand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਿਬਖਾਦੀ  ਦੋਖੀਆ  ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੂਟੇ ॥
lines.english: That servant, who performs the Lord's service, O Nanak, is the slave of the Lord Master. ||4||17||119|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (400-18) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa sayvko naanak khasmai band aa. ||4||17||119||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਅਬ ਉਨਾ  ਤੇ ਓਇ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Peace, celestial poise and absolute bliss are obtained, singing the Kirtan of the Lord'sPraises.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanad  ghanaa har keert an gaa-o.

lines.english: Bestowing His Name, the True Guru removes the evil omens. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garah nivaaray satguroo d ay apn aa naa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਨਤਾ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. pMnw 401
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay sad  sad bal jaa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru; meeting Him, I am absorbed into the True Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: guroo vitahu ha-o vaari-aa jis mil sach su-aa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Good omens and bad omens affect those who do not keep the Lord in the mind.
lines.transliteration: sagun apasgun tis ka-o lageh jis cheet  na aavai.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not approach those who are pleasing to the Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tis jam nayrh  na aavee jo har parabh  bhaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗੁਨ  ਅਪਸਗੁਨ ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਿਹ  ਿਜਸੁ ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Donations to charity, meditation and penance - above all of them is the Naam.
lines.transliteration: punn daan jap t ap jayt ay sabh  oopar naam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who chants with his tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his works arebrought to perfect completion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har rasnaa jo japai tis pooran kaam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: His fears are removed, and his doubts and attachments are gone; he sees none otherthan God.
lines.transliteration: bhai binsay bh aram moh ga-ay ko d isai na bee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God preserves him, and no pain or sorrow afflicts him anylonger. ||4||18||120|| Awsw Gru 9 mhlw 5  (401-5) aasaa ghar 9 mehlaa 5 Aasaa, Ninth House, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (401-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak raakhay paarbarahm fir d ookh na thee-aa. ||4||18||120||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਮੋਹ ਗਏ ਕੋ ਿਦਸੈ ਨ ਬੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplating Him within my consciousness, I obtain total peace; but hereafter, will Ibe pleasing to Him or not?
lines.transliteration: chitva-o chit av sarab sukh  paava-o aagai bh aava-o ke na bh aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਿਫਿਰ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ  ॥੪॥੧੮॥੧੨੦॥
lines.english: There is only One Giver; all others are beggars. Who else can we turn to? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk daat aar sagal hai jaachik d oosar kai peh jaava-o. ||1||

lines.english: When I beg from others, I am ashamed.
lines.transliteration: ha-o maaga-o aan lajaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਿਚਤਿਵ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ  ਆਗੈ  ਭਾਵਉ  ਿਕ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord Master is the Supreme King of all; who else is equal to Him?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal chhat arpat ayko th aakur ka-un samsar laava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ  ਹੈ ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਦੂਸਰ ਕੈ ਪਿਹ ਜਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Standing up and sitting down, I cannot live without Him. I search and search for theBlessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: ooth-o baisa-o reh bh e na saaka-o d arsan kh oj khojaava-o.

lines.english: Even Brahma and the sages Sanak, Sanandan, Sanaatan and Sanat Kumar, find it difficult to obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) barahmaadik sankaad ik sanak sanand an sanaat an sanat kumaar t inH ka-o mahal dulbh aava-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਛਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਏਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਲਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: He is unapproachable and unfathomable; His wisdom is deep and profound; His valuecannot be appraised.
lines.transliteration: agam agam aagaaDh boDh  keemat  parai na paava-o.

lines.english: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Lord, the Primal Being, and I meditate onthe True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taakee saran  sat purakh  kee sat gur purakh  Dhi-aava-o. ||3||

lines.english: God, the Lord Master, has become kind and compassionate; He has cut the noose ofdeath away from my neck.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal d a-i-aal parabh  thaakur kaati-o banDh  garaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਉ  ਬੈਸਉ  ਰਿਹ ਿਭ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਖੋਿਜ ਖੋਜਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, now that I have obtained the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Ishall not have to be reincarnated again. ||4||1||121|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (401-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ja-o saaDhsang paa-i-o t a-o fir janam na aava-o. ||4||1||121||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦਕ  ਸਨਕਾਿਦਕ  ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ  ਸਨਾਤਨ  ਸਨਤਕੁਮਾਰ  ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ  ਦੁਲਭਾਵਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Inwardly, I sing His Praises, and outwardly, I sing His Praises; I sing His Praises whileawake and asleep.
lines.transliteration: antar gaava-o baahar gaava-o gaava-o jaag savaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਮ  ਆਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਧ ਕੀਮਿਤ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord of the Universe; He has given it to me as mysupplies, to carry with me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sang chalan ka-o tosaa d eenHaa gobind  naam kay bi-uhaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਕੀ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖ  ਕੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਧਆਵਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have forgotten and forsaken other things.
lines.transliteration: avar bisaaree bisaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਿਟਓ  ਬੰਧੁ ਗਰਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has given me the Gift of the Naam; this alone is my Support.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam daan gur poorai d ee-o mai ayho aaDh aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਤਉ ਿਫਿਰ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
lines.english: I sing His Praises while suffering, and I sing His Praises while I am at peace as well. Icontemplate Him while I walk along the Path.
lines.transliteration: dookh an gaava-o sukh  bhee gaava-o maarag panth samHaaree.

lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Naam within my mind, and my thirst has been quenched.||2||
lines.transliteration: naam darirh  gur man meh d ee-aa moree t isaa bujh aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗਾਵਉ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਗਾਵਉ  ਗਾਵਉ  ਜਾਿਗ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I sing His Praises during the day, and I sing His Praises during the night; I sing themwith each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: din bh ee gaava-o rainee gaava-o gaava-o saas saas rasnaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਦੀਨਾ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, this faith is established, that the Lord is with us, in life and in death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  meh bisaas ho-ay har jeevat  marat  sangaaree. ||3||

lines.english: Bless servant Nanak with this gift, O God, that he may obtain, and enshrine in hisheart, the dust of the feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o ih daan d ayh parabh  paava-o sant  rayn ur Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ  ਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hear the Lord's Sermon with your ears, and behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshanwith your eyes; place your forehead upon the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||122|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (401-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House,Fifth Mehl: Awsw Gru 10 mhlw 5 ] (401-19) aasaa ghar 10 mehlaa 5. One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House,Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarvanee kathaa nain daras paykh a-o mast ak gur charnaaree. ||4||2||122||

lines.english: That which you believe to be permanent, is a guest here for only a few days. pMnw 402
lines.transliteration: jis no tooN asthir kar maaneh t ay paahun d o daahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਸਗਲ  ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਸਭ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਅਸਨਾਹਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Children, wives, homes, and all possessions - attachment to all of these is false. ||1||
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar garih sagal samagree sabh  mithi-aa asnaahaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਹੈ ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
lines.english: O mind, why do you burst out laughing?
lines.transliteration: ray man ki-aa karahi hai haa haa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਦੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਿਰਚੰਦਉਰੀ  ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: See with your eyes, that these things are only mirages. So earn the profit of meditation on the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darisat d aykh jaisay harichand -uree ik raam bh ajan lai laahaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: It is like the clothes which you wear on your body - they wear off in a few days.
lines.transliteration: jaisay bastar d ayh odh aanay d in do-ay chaar bh oraahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ  ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ  ਿਦਨ  ਦੋਇ ਚਾਿਰ ਭੋਰਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: How long can you run upon a wall? Ultimately, you come to its end. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bheet  oopray kayt ak Dh aa-ee-ai ant  orko aahaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੀਿਤ  ਊਪਰੇ  ਕੇਤਕੁ  ਧਾਈਐ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਓਰਕੋ  ਆਹਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: It is like salt, preserved in its container; when it is put into water, it dissolves.
lines.transliteration: jaisay ambh kund kar raakh i-o parat  sinDh  gal jaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਪਰਤ  ਿਸੰਧੁ ਗਿਲ  ਜਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the Order of the Supreme Lord God comes, the soul arises, and departs in aninstant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aavag aagi-aa paarbarahm kee uth jaasee muhat  chasaahaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਗ  ਆਿਗਆ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੀ ਉਿਠ ਜਾਸੀ  ਮੁਹਤ  ਚਸਾਹਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O mind, your steps are numbered, your moments spent sitting are numbered, and thebreaths you are to take are numbered.
lines.transliteration: ray man laykhai chaaleh laykh ai baiseh laykh ai laid aa saahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਿਹ  ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਿਹ  ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Sing forever the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, and you shall be saved, under theShelter of the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||123|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (402-6) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa keerat  kar naanak har kee ubray sat gur charan  otaahaa. ||4||1||123||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣ  ਓਟਾਹਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩  ॥
lines.english: That which was upside-down has been set upright; the deadly enemies andadversaries have become friends.
lines.transliteration: apusat baat t ay bh a-ee seeDh ree doot dusat sajna-ee.

lines.english: In the darkness, the jewel shines forth, and the impure understanding has become pure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anDhkaar meh rat an pargaasi-o maleen buDh  hachh na-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਸਟ  ਬਾਤ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ  ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ  ਸਜਨਈ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful,
lines.transliteration: ja-o kirpaa gobind bh a-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ  ਮਿਹ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸਓ ਮਲੀਨ  ਬੁਿਧ ਹਛਨਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I found peace, wealth and the fruit of the Lord's Name; I have met the True Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh sampat  har naam fal paa-ay sat gur mil-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: No one knew me, the miserable miser, but now, I have become famous all over theworld.
lines.transliteration: mohi kirpan ka-o ko-ay na jaanat sagal bh avan pargata-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਲਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Before, no one would even sit with me, but now, all worship my feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sang baithno kahee na paavat  hun sagal charan  sayv-ee. ||2||

lines.english: I used to wander in search of pennies, but now, all the desires of my mind aresatisfied.
lines.transliteration: aadh aadh  ka-o firat  dhoondh -tay man sagal t arisan bujh  ga-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਕਰਪਨ  ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਨ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟਈ  ॥
lines.english: I could not bear even one criticism, but now, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy, I am cooled and soothed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk bol bhee kh avto naahee saaDh sangat  seetla-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਬੈਠਨੋ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੁਿਣ ਸਗਲ  ਚਰਣ  ਸੇਵਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord can one meretongue describe?
lines.transliteration: ayk jeeh gun kavan vakh aanai agam agam agma-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਢ  ਆਢ  ਕਉ ਿਫਰਤ  ਢੂੰਢਤੇ  ਮਨ ਸਗਲ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਬੁਿਝ ਗਈ ॥
lines.english: Please, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||2||124|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (402-11) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daas d aas d aas ko karee-ahu jan naanak har sarn a-ee. ||4||2||124||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ ਖਵਤੋ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੀਤਲਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O fool, you are so slow to earn your profits, and so quick to run up losses.
lines.transliteration: ray moorhay laahay ka-o t ooN dheelaa dh eelaa t otay ka-o bayg Dh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਗੁ ਣ ਕਵਨ  ਵਖਾਨੈ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਮਈ  ॥
lines.english: You do not purchase the inexpensive merchandise; O sinner, you are tied to yourdebts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sasat vakh ar tooN ghinneh naahee paapee baaDh aa raynaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
lines.english: O True Guru, You are my only hope.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ayree aasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Your Name is the Purifier of sinners, O Supreme Lord God; You are my only Shelter.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: patit paavan t ayro naam paarbarahm mai ayhaa otaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ  ਢੀਲਾ  ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਬੇਿਗ  ਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Listening to the evil talk, you are caught up in it, but you are hesitant to chant theNaam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ganDhan  vain suneh urjh aavahi naam lait  alkaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸਤ  ਵਖਰੁ ਤੂੰ ਿਘੰਨਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਬਾਧਾ  ਰੇਨਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are delighted by slanderous talk; your understanding is corrupt. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nind chind  ka-o bahut  umaahi-o boojh ee ultaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Others' wealth, others' wives and the slander of others - eating the uneatable, youhave gone crazy.
lines.transliteration: par Dhan par t an par t ee nind aa akh aaDh khaahi harkaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have not enshrined love for the True Faith of Dharma; hearing the Truth, you are enraged. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saach Dharam si-o ruch nahee aavai sat  sunat  chhohaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: O God, Merciful to the meek, Compassionate Lord Master, Your Name is the Supportof Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaal parabh  thaakur bh agat tayk har naa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੰਧਣ  ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਉਰਝਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary; O God, make him Your Own, and preserve hishonor. ||4||3||125|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (402-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl
lines.transliteration: naanak aahi saran parabh  aa-i-o raakh  laaj apnaa-i-aa. ||4||3||125||

lines.english: : They are attached to falsehood; clinging to the transitory, they are trapped inemotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa sang sang laptaa-ay moh maa-i-aa kar baaDhay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਅਖਾਿਧ  ਖਾਿਹ  ਹਰਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever they go, they do not think of the Lord; they are blinded by intellectualegotism. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah jaano so cheet na aavai ahaN-buDh  bha-ay aaNDhay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ  ਿਸਉ ਰੁਿਚ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ  ਸਿਤ ਸੁਨਤ  ਛੋਹਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O mind, O renunciate, why don't you adore Him?
lines.transliteration: man bairaagee ki-o na araaDhay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਭਗਤ  ਟੇਕ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You dwell in that flimsy chamber, with all the sins of corruption. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaach kothree maahi t ooN bastaa sang sagal bikh ai kee bi-aaDh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਿਹ  ਸਰਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਇਓ  ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ  ਅਪਨਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
lines.english: Crying out, "Mine, mine", your days and nights pass away; moment by moment, your life is running out. pMnw 403
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree karat d in rain bihaavai pal kh in chh eejai arjaaDh ay.

lines.english: The sweet flavors tempt you, and you are occupied by your false and filthy business. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaisay meethai saad  lobhaa-ay jh ooth DhanDh durgaaDh ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਿਦ  ਲੋਭਾਏ  ਝੂਠ ਧੰਿਧ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your senses are beguiled by sensual pleasures of sex, by anger, greed and emotionalattachment.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ar lobh  moh ih ind ree ras laptaaDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਇਹ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਰਿਸ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ  ॥
lines.english: The All-powerful Architect of Destiny has ordained that you shall be reincarnated overand over again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dee-ee bh avaaree purakh  biDhaatai bahur bahur janmaaDh ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਈ  ਭਵਾਰੀ  ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੈ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: When the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, then, as Gurmukh,you shall find absolute peace.
lines.transliteration: ja-o bha-i-o kirpaal d een d ukh bhanjan t a-o gur mil sabh  sukh  laaDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord, day and night, and all your sickness shall bebanished. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak din rain Dh i-aava-o maar kaadh ee sagal upaaDh ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਿਧਆਵਉ  ਮਾਿਰ ਕਾਢੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਉਪਾਧੇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Meditate in this way, O Siblings of Destiny, on the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: i-o japi-o bhaa-ee purakh  biDhaatay.

lines.english: 5) bha-i-o kirpaal d een d ukh bhanjan janam maran  dukh laathay. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||4||4||126|| The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful; He has removed thepains of birth and death. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||126|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (403-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: For a moment of sexual pleasure, you shall suffer in pain for millions of days.
lines.transliteration: nimakh kaam su-aad  kaaran  kot d inas d ukh paavahi.

lines.english: For an instant, you may savor pleasure, but afterwards, you shall regret it, again andagain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gharee muhat  rang maan eh fir bahur bahur pachh utaavahi. ||1||

lines.english: O blind man, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your King.
lines.transliteration: anDhay chayt  har har raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਖ  ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਕੋਿਟ ਿਦਨਸ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Your day is drawing near. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayraa so d in nayrh ai aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੀ  ਮੁਹਤ  ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are deceived, beholding with your eyes, the bitter melon and swallow-wort.
lines.transliteration: palak darisat d aykh bhoolo aak neem ko t ooNmar.

lines.english: But, like the companionship of a poisonous snake, so is the desire for another'sspouse. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa sang bisee-ar si-o hai ray taiso hee ih par garihu. ||2||

lines.english: For the sake of your enemy, you commit sins, while you neglect the reality of your faith.
lines.transliteration: bairee kaaran paap kart aa basat  rahee amaanaa.

lines.english: Your friendship is with those who abandon you, and you are angry with your friends.||3||
lines.transliteration: chhod jaahi t in hee si-o sangee saajan si-o bairaanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਲਕ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਦੇਿਖ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਕ  ਨੀਮ ਕੋ ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The entire world is entangled in this way; he alone is saved, who has the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: sagal sansaar ihai biDh bi-aapi-o so ubri-o jis gur pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਿਬਸੀਅਰ  ਿਸਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean; my body has becomesanctified. ||4||5||127|| Awsw mhlw 5 dupdy ] (403-10) aasaa mehlaa 5 dupd ay. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl Dupadas:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhav saagar t ari-o bh a-ay puneet  sareeraa. ||4||5||127||

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, You behold whatever we do in secrecy; the fool may stubbornly deny it.
lines.transliteration: look kamaano so-ee tumH paykh i-o moorh  mugaDh  mukraanee.

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਜਾਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਿਸਉ ਸੰਗੀ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਿਸਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By his own actions, he is tied down, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap kamaanay ka-o lay baaNDhay fir paachh ai pachh utaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਬਆਿਪਓ  ਸੋ ਉਬਿਰਓ ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: My God knows, ahead of time, all things.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayray sabh  biDh aagai jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਰਓ  ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਸਰੀਰਾ  ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
lines.english: Deceived by doubt, you may hide your actions, but in the end, you shall have toconfess the secrets of your mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharam kay moosay t ooN raakh at pardaa paachh ai jee-a kee maanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever they are attached to, they remain joined to that. What can any mere mortal do?
lines.transliteration: jit jit laa-ay t it tit laagay ki-aa ko karai paraanee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੂਿਕ  ਕਮਾਨੋ  ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Please, forgive me, O Supreme Lord Master. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You.||2||6||128|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (403-14) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bakhas laihu paarbarahm su-aamee naanak sad  kurbaanee. ||2||6||128||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਕਮਾਨੇ  ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਧੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself preserves His servants; He causes them to chant His Name.
lines.transliteration: apunay sayvak kee aapay raakhai aapay naam japaavai.

lines.english: Wherever the business and affairs of His servants are, there the Lord hurries to be.||1||
lines.transliteration: jah jah kaaj kirat sayvak kee t ahaa t ahaa uth  Dhaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ  ਪਰਦਾ  ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord appears near at hand to His servant.
lines.transliteration: sayvak ka-o niktee ho-ay dikh aavai.

lines.english: Whatever the servant asks of his Lord and Master, immediately comes to pass.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jo kahai thaakur peh sayvak t atkaal ho-ay aavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that servant, who is pleasing to his God.
lines.transliteration: tis sayvak kai ha-o balihaaree jo apnay parabh  bhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
lines.english: Hearing of his glory, the mind is rejuvenated; Nanak comes to touch his feet.||2||7||129|| Awsw Gru 11 mhlw 5  (403-18) aasaa ghar 11 mehlaa 5 Aasaa, Eleventh House, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (403-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: tis kee so-ay sun ee man hari-aa t is naanak parsan  aavai. ||2||7||129||

lines.english: The actor displays himself in many disguises, but he remains just as he is.
lines.transliteration: natoo-aa bhaykh  dikhaavai baho biDh  jaisaa hai oh t aisaa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੀ ਆਪੇ  ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The soul wanders through countless incarnations in doubt, but it does not come to dwell in peace. ||1|| pMnw 404
lines.transliteration: anik jon bharmi-o bh aram bh eetar sukh eh naahee parvaysaa ray. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, my friends and companions, without the Lord, Har, Har, you shall perish.
lines.transliteration: saajan sant hamaaray meet aa bin har har aaneet aa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਮੀਤਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਨੀਤਾ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and win this precious treasure of human life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil har gun  gaa-ay ih janam pad aarath jeet aa ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਜੀਤਾ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God has created Maya of the three qualities; tell me, how can it be crossed over?
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa barahm kee keenHee kahhu kavan biDh  taree-ai ray.

lines.english: The whirlpool is awesome and unfathomable; only through the Word of the Guru'sShabad is one carried across. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghooman gh ayr agaah gaakh ree gur sabd ee paar ut ree-ai ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ  ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Searching and searching endlessly, seeking and deliberating, Nanak has realized the true essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat khoj beechaari-o t at naanak ih jaanaa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਘੂਮਨ  ਘੇਰ ਅਗਾਹ  ਗਾਖਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਰੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meditating on the invaluable treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the jewel ofthe mind is satisfied. ||3||1||130|| Awsw mhlw 5 dupdy ] (404-5) aasaa mehlaa 5 dupd ay. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dupadas:
lines.transliteration: simrat naam niDh aan nirmolak man maan ak pat ee-aanaa ray. ||3||1||130||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਿਜ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਤਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਾ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within my mind; whatever I ask for, I receive.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad mayrai man vasi-aa jo maaga-o so paava-o ray.

lines.english: This mind is satisfied with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it does not goout, anywhere, anymore. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam rang ih man taript aanaa bahur na kat ahooN Dhaava-o ray. ||1||

lines.english: My Lord and Master is the highest of all; night and day, I sing the Glories of HisPraises.
lines.transliteration: hamraa thaakur sabh  tay oochaa rain  dinas t is gaava-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ  ਸੋ ਪਾਵਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; through Him, I frighten you.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa t is tay tujheh daraava-o ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਨਾ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵਉ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When I behold my God, my Lord and Master, I do not pay any attention to any other.
lines.transliteration: jab daykh -a-u parabh  apunaa su-aamee t a-o avrahi cheet  na paava-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: God Himself has adorned servant Nanak; his doubts and fears have been dispelled, and he writes the account of the Lord. ||2||2||131|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (404-9) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas parabh  aap pehraa-i-aa bh aram bh a-o mayt likh aava-o ray. ||2||2||131||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ  ਿਤਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਡਰਾਵਉ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The four castes and social classes, and the preachers with the six Shaastras on theirfinger-tips,
lines.transliteration: chaar baran cha-uhaa kay mardan kh at darsan kar t alee ray.
sundar sugh ar saroop si-aanay panchahu hee mohi chh alee ray. ||1|| the beautiful, the refined, the shapely and the wise - the five passions have enticedand beguiled them all. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਉ ਅਵਰਿਹ  ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਵਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Who has seized and conquered the five powerful fighters? Is there anyone strongenough?
lines.transliteration: jin mil maaray panch soorbeer aiso ka-un balee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਪਿਹਰਾਇਆ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਿਟ ਿਲਖਾਵਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He alone, who conquers and defeats the five demons, is perfect in this Dark Age ofKali Yuga. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin panch maar bidaar gud aaray so pooraa ih kalee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They are so awesome and great; they cannot be controlled, and they do not runaway. Their army is mighty and unyielding.
lines.transliteration: vadee kom vas bhaageh naahee muhkam fa-uj hath lee ray.

lines.english: Says Nanak, that humble being who is under the protection of the Saadh Sangat,crushes those terrible demons. ||2||3||132|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (404-13) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tin jan nird ali-aa saaDh sangat  kai jh alee ray. ||2||3||132||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਬਰਨ  ਚਉਹਾ  ਕੇ ਮਰਦਨ  ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਰ ਤਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Sublime Sermon of the Lord is the best thing for the soul. All other tastes areinsipid. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: neekee jee-a kee har kathaa ootam aan sagal ras feekee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ  ਸਰੂਪ  ਿਸਆਨੇ  ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਮੋਿਹ ਛਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The worthy beings, heavenly singers, silent sages and the knowers of the sixShaastras proclaim that nothing else is worthy of consideration. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baho gun Dhun mun jan kh at bayt ay avar na kichh  laa-eekee ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ  ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: It is the cure for evil passions, unique, unequalled and peace-giving; in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, drink it in. ||2||4||133|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (404-15) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bikhaaree niraaree apaaree sehjaaree saaDh sang naanak peekee ray. ||2||4||133||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੰਚ ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਬਦਾਿਰ  ਗੁਦਾਰੇ  ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਇਹ ਕਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Beloved has brought forth a river of nectar. The Guru has not held it back from mymind, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hamaaree pi-aaree amrit Dh aaree gur nimakh  na man t ay taaree ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Beholding it, and touching it, I am sweetened and delighted. It is imbued with theCreator's Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: darsan parsan sarsan harsan rang rangee kart aaree ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਕੋਮ ਵਿਸ ਭਾਗਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਹਕਮ  ਫਉਜ  ਹਠਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Chanting it even for a moment, I rise to the Guru; meditating on it, one is not trapped by the Messenger of Death. The Lord has placed it as a garland around Nanak's neck,and within his heart. ||2||5||134|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (404-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: khin ram gur gam har d am nah jam har kanth  naanak ur haaree ray. ||2||5||134||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਿਨ ਿਨਰਦਿਲਆ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਝਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is exalted and sublime. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: neekee saaDh sangaanee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Every day, hour and moment, I continually sing and speak of Govind, Govind, the Lordof the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pahar moorat pal gaavat  gaavat  govind  govind  vakh aanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਕੀ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਊਤਮ  ਆਨ  ਸਗਲ  ਰਸ ਫੀਕੀ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Walking, sitting and sleeping, I chant the Lord's Praises; I treasure His Feet in mymind and body. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chaalat baisat  sovat  har jas man t an charan kh ataanee. ||2||

lines.english: I am so small, and You are so great, O Lord and Master; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.||3||6||135|| pMnw 405 rwgu Awsw mhlw 5 Gru 12 (405-1) raag aasaa mehlaa 5 ghar 12 Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Twelfth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (405-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: haN-o ha-uro too th aakur ga-uro naanak saran pachh aanee. ||3||6||135||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce all your cleverness and remember the Supreme, Formless Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ti-aag sagal si-aanpaa bh aj paarbarahm nirankaar.

lines.english: Without the One True Name, everything appears as dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk saachay naam baajhahu sagal d eesai chh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਗਲ  ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Know that God is always with you.
lines.transliteration: so parabh jaan ee-ai sad  sang.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one understands, and is imbued with the Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee boojhee-ai ayk har kai rang. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ  ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਏਕ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seek the Shelter of the One All-powerful Lord; there is no other place of rest.
lines.transliteration: saran samrath ayk kayree d oojaa naahee th aa-o.

lines.english: The vast and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, singing continually the GloriousPraises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mahaa bha-ojal langh ee-ai sad aa har gun  gaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death are overcome, and one does not have to suffer in the City of Death.
lines.transliteration: janam maran nivaaree-ai d ukh na jam pur ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਲੰਘੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom Godshows His Mercy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan so-ee paa-ay kirpaa karay parabh  so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀਐ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is my Anchor and Support; the One Lord alone is the power of my mind.
lines.transliteration: ayk tayk aDhaar ayko ayk kaa man jor.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him;without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||4||1||136|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (405-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak japee-ai mil saaDhsangat  har bin avar na hor. ||4||1||136||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਿਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The soul, the mind, the body and the breath of life belong to God. He has given alltastes and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: jee-o man tan paraan parabh  kay d ee-ay sabh  ras bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬  ॥
lines.english: He is the Friend of the poor, the Giver of life, the Protector of those who seek HisSanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deen banDh ap jee-a d aataa saran  raakh an jog. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man Dhi-aa-ay har har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ ਸਿਭ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, He is our Helper and Companion; embrace love and affection forthe One Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  sahaa-ay sangay ayk si-o liv laa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਬੰਧਪ  ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਰਿਣ ਰਾਖਣ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They meditate on the Vedas and the Shaastras, to swim across the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bayd saast ar jan Dh i-aavahi t aran ka-o sansaar.

lines.english: The many religious rituals, good deeds of karma and Dharmic worship - above all ofthese is the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam anayk kiri-aa sabh  oopar naam achaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਸਹਾਇ  ਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism depart, meeting with the Divine True Guru.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar binsai milai sat gur dayv.

lines.english: Implant the Naam within, perform devotional worship to the Lord and serve God - thisis good. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam darirh  kar bh agat har kee bh alee parabh  kee sayv. ||3||

lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord; You are the Honor of the dishonored.
lines.transliteration: charan saran  da-i-aal t ayree t ooN nimaan ay maan .

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਜਨ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤਰਣ  ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You are the Support of my soul, my breath of life; O God, You are Nanak's strength.||4||2||137|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (405-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan aDh aar tayraa naanak kaa parabh  taan. ||4||2||137||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He wavers and falters, and suffers such great pain, without the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: dol dol mahaa dukh  paa-i-aa binaa saaDh oo sang.

lines.english: The profit of the sublime essence of the Lord of the Universe is obtained, by the Loveof the One Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khaat laabh  gobind  har ras paarbarahm ik rang. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਕਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਲੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Chant continually the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har ko naam japee-ai neet.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਣ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਿਨਮਾਣੇ  ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, meditate on God, and renounce other love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saas saas Dhi-aa-ay so parabh  ti-aag avar pareet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
lines.english: God is the Doer, the All-powerful Cause of causes; He Himself is the Giver of life.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath so parabh  jee-a d aataa aap.

lines.english: So renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ti-aag sagal si-aan paa aath  pahar parabh  jaap. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਡੋਿਲ  ਡੋਿਲ  ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨਾ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.english: He is our best friend and companion, our help and support; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: meet sakh aa sahaa-ay sangee ooch agam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਿਟ  ਲਾਭੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Enshrine His Lotus Feet within your heart; He is the Support of the soul. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basaa-ay hird ai jee-a ko aaDh aar. ||3||

lines.english: Show Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh paarbarahm gun  tayraa jas gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਅਵਰ  ਪਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Total peace, and the greatest greatness, O Nanak, are obtained by living to chant theName of the Lord. ||4||3||138|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (405-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh vadee vadi-aa-ee jap jeevai naanak naa-o. ||4||3||138||

lines.english: I make the effort, as You cause me to do, my Lord and Master, to behold You in theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: udam kara-o karaavahu th aakur paykh at saaDh oo sang.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: I am imbued with the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har; God Himself has coloredme in His Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har naam charaavahu rangan aapay hee parabh rang. ||1||

lines.english: I chant the Lord's Name within my mind.
lines.transliteration: man meh raam naamaa jaap.

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ  ਸੰਗੀ  ਊਚ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Bestow Your Mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my Helper.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa vashu mayrai hirdai ho-ay sahaa-ee aap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਬਸਾਇ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listening continually to Your Name, O Beloved God, I yearn to behold You. pMnw 406
lines.transliteration: sun sun  naam t umaaraa pareet am parabh  paykh an kaa chaa-o.

lines.english: Please, be kind to me - I am just a worm. This is my object and purpose. ||2||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu kiram apunay ka-o ihai manorath su-aa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰਮ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ  ਸੁਆਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My body and wealth are Yours; You are my God - nothing is in my power.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an tayraa t ooN parabh  mayraa hamrai vas kichh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਿਸ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: As You keep me, so do I live; I eat what You give me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o raakhahi t i-o ti-o rahn aa tayraa d ee-aa kh aahi. ||3||

lines.english: The sins of countless incarnations are washed away, by bathing in the dust of the Lord's humble servants.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilvikh kaatai majan har jan Dh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: By loving devotional worship, doubt and fear depart; O Nanak, the Lord is Ever-present. ||4||4||139|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (406-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay bh agat bharam bh a-o naasai har naanak sad aa hajoor. ||4||4||139||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰਮ  ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
lines.english: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is unapproachable and incomprehensible; healone obtains it, who has such good destiny recorded upon his forehead.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar daras t ayraa so paa-ay jis mast ak bh aag.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord God has bestowed His Mercy, and the True Guru has granted the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap kirpaal kirpaa parabh Dh aaree sat gur bakh si-aa har naam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru is the Saving Grace in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: kalijug uDhaari-aa gurd ayv.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਿਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਧਾਰੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬਖਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even those fools and idiots, stained with feces and urine, have all taken to Yourservice. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mal moot moorh  je mugh ad hotay sabh  lagay t ayree sayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator, who established the entire world. You are contained inall.
lines.transliteration: too aap kart aa sabh  sarisat Dh artaa sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਿਜ ਮੁਘਦ  ਹੋਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharam raajaa bismaad  ho-aa sabh  pa-ee pairee aa-ay. ||2|| The Righteous Judge of Dharma is wonder-struck, at the sight of everyone falling atthe Lord's Feet. ||2||
The Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, and the Brass Age ofDwaapar Yuga are good; but the best is the Dark Age, the Iron Age, of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: satjug t araytaa du-aapar bh anee-ai kalijug oot mo jugaa maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: As we act, so are the rewards we receive; no one can take the place of another. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ah kar karay so ah kar paa-ay ko-ee na pakrhee-ai kisai thaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਿਬਸਮਾਦੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, whatever Your devotees ask for, You do. This is Your Way, Your verynature.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o so-ee karahi je bhagat  tayray jaacheh ayhu t ayraa birad .

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਜੁਗੁ  ਤਰ੍ੇਤਾ  ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ  ਕਿਲਜੁਗੁ  ਊਤਮੋ ਜੁਗਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I beg for this gift; Lord, please bless Your Saints with Your Vision. ||4||5||140|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 5 Gru 13  (406-11) raag aasaa mehlaa 5 ghar 13 Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thirteenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (406-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar jorh naanak d aan maagai apn i-aa sant aa deh har d aras. ||4||5||140||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹ  ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਿਹ  ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ  ਿਕਸੈ ਥਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O True Guru, by Your Words,
lines.transliteration: satgur bachan t umHaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿਹ ਿਜ ਭਗਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: nirgun nist aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o. even the worthless have been saved. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ  ਅਪਿਣਆ  ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
lines.english: Even the most argumentative, vicious and indecent people, have been purified in Yourcompany. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikhaad ee dusat apvaad ee tay puneet  sangaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have wandered in reincarnation, and those who have been consigned tohell - even their families have been redeemed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: janam bhavant ay narak parh antay tinH kay kul uDh aaray. ||2||

lines.english: Those whom no one knew, and those whom no one respected - even they havebecome famous and respected at the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na jaanai ko-ay na maanai say pargat har du-aaray. ||3||

lines.english: What praise, and what greatness should I attribute to You? Nanak is a sacrifice to You, each and every moment. ||4||1||141|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (406-15) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kavan upmaa day-o kavan vadaa-ee naanak kh in khin vaaray. ||4||1||141||

lines.english: The crazy people are asleep. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baavar so-ay rahay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖਾਦੀ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਅਪਵਾਦੀ  ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They are intoxicated with attachment to their families and sensory pleasures; they areheld in the grip of falsehood. ||1||
lines.transliteration: moh kutamb bikhai ras maat ay mithi-aa gahan gahay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਭਵੰਤੇ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਪੜੰਤੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The false desires, and the dream-like delights and pleasures - these, the self-willedmanmukhs call true. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mithan manorath supan aanand ulaas man mukh  sat kahay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is with them, but they donot find even a tiny bit of its mystery. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam pad aarath sangay t il maram na lahay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ  ਵਡਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, O Lord, You save those, who take to the Sanctuary of the Sat Sangat,the True Congregation. ||4||2||142|| Awsw mhlw 5 iqpdy ] (406-17) aasaa mehlaa 5 tipd ay. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Tipadas:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakhay sat sangay naanak saran  aahay. ||4||2||142||

lines.english: I seek the Love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ohaa paraym piree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Gold, jewels, giant pearls and rubies - I have no need for them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kanik maanik gaj mot ee-an laalan nah naah nahee. ||1||

lines.english: Imperial power, fortunes, royal command and mansions pMnw 407
lines.transliteration: raaj na bhaag na hukam na saad an.

lines.english: - I have no desire for these. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kichh kichh  na chaahee. ||2||

lines.english: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, and dedication to the Saints
lines.transliteration: charnan sarnan santan band an.
sukho sukh  paahee. - these bring me peace and pleasure.

lines.english: O Nanak, my burning fire has been put out,
lines.transliteration: naanak tapat  haree.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (407-2) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: milay paraym piree. ||3||3||143|| obtaining the Love of the Beloved. ||3||3||143||

lines.english: The Guru has revealed Him to my eyes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gureh dikh aa-i-o lo-inaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Here and there, in each and every heart, and each and every being, You, OFascinating Lord, You exist. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eeteh oot eh gh at ghat ghat ghat tooNhee tooNhee mohinaa. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Support of the earth; You are the One and only, Beauteous Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaaran karnaa Dhaaran Dh arnaa aykai aykai sohinaa. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting the Saints, and beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, Nanak is asacrifice to them; he sleeps in absolute peace. ||3||4||144|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (407-5) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: santan parsan balihaaree d arsan naanak sukh  sukh  so-inaa. ||3||4||144||
