lines.punjabi: ਈਤਿਹ  ਊਤਿਹ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਿਹਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless.
lines.transliteration: har har naam amolaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਨ  ਕਰਨਾ  ਧਾਰਨ  ਧਰਨਾ  ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਿਹਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: It brings peace and poise. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: oh sahj suhaylaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਪਰਸਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸੁਿਖ ਸੋਇਨਾ  ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
lines.english: The Lord is my Companion and Helper; He shall not forsake me or leave me. He isunfathomable and unequalled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sang sahaa-ee chhod na jaa-ee oh agah at olaa. ||1||

lines.english: He is my Beloved, my brother, father and mother; He is the Support of His devotees.||2||
lines.transliteration: pareetam bh aa-ee baap moro maa-ee bh agtan kaa olHaa. ||2||

lines.english: The Invisible Lord is seen through the Guru; O Nanak, this is the wondrous play of theLord. ||3||5||145|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (407-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: alakh lakh aa-i-aa gur t ay paa-i-aa naanak ih har kaa cholHaa. ||3||5||145||

lines.english: Please help me sustain my devotion.
lines.transliteration: aapunee bhagat  nibaahi.

lines.english: O Lord Master, I have come to You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: thaakur aa-i-o aahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ  ਅਤੋਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life becomes fruitful. Lord, please place Your Feet within my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath ho-ay sakaarath hird ai charan basaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਭਾਈ  ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਓਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This is liberation, and this is the best way of life; please, keep me in the Society of theSaints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayh muktaa ayh jugt aa raakh o sant  sangaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਚੋਲਾ  ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, I am absorbed in celestial peace; O Nanak, I sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||6||146|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (407-10) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aava-o sahj samaava-o naanak har gun gaahi. ||3||6||146||

lines.english: The Feet of my Lord and Master are so Beautiful!
lines.transliteration: thaakur charan  suhaavay.

lines.english: The Lord's Saints obtain them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har santan paavay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They eradicate their self-conceit and serve the Lord; drenched in His Love, they singHis Glorious Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-i-aa sayv kamaa-i-aa gun ras ras gaavay. ||1||

lines.english: They place their hopes in Him, and they thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Nothing else is pleasing to them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aykeh aasaa daras pi-aasaa aan na bh aavay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਚਰਨ  ਬਸਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is Your Mercy, Lord; what can Your poor creatures do? Nanak is devoted, asacrifice to You. ||3||7||147|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (407-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa t uhaaree ki-aa jant  vichaaree naanak bal bal jaavay. ||3||7||147||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Remember the One Lord in meditation within your mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk simar man maahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਉ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਿਹ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and enshrine Him within your heart.Without Him there is no other. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aavahu rid ai basaavhu t is bin ko naahee. ||1||

lines.english: Entering God's Sanctuary, all rewards are obtained, and all pains are taken away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh sarnee aa-ee-ai sarab fal paa-ee-ai saglay d ukh jaahee. ||2||

lines.english: He is the Giver of all beings, the Architect of Destiny; O Nanak, He is contained ineach and every heart. ||3||8||148|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (407-15) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-an ko daat aa purakh  biDhaataa naanak gh at ghat aahee. ||3||8||148||

lines.english: One who forgets the Lord is dead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bisrat so moo-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtains all rewards. That person becomes happy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aavai sarab fal paavai so jan sukh ee-aa hoo-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਗੁਨ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਗਾਵੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who calls himself a king, and acts in ego and pride, is caught by his doubts, like aparrot in a trap. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raaj kahaavai ha-o karam kamaavai baaDhi-o nalinee bh aram soo-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਿਹ  ਆਸਾ  ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਸਾ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one who meets the True Guru, becomes permanent and immortal.||3||9||149|| Awsw mhlw 5 Gru 14  (407-18) aasaa mehlaa 5 ghar 14 Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fourteenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (407-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis satgur bh ayti-aa so jan nihchal thee-aa. ||3||9||149||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਤੁਹਾਰੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
lines.english: That love is forever fresh and new,
lines.transliteration: oh nayhu navaylaa.
apunay pareetam si-o laag rahai. ||1|| rahaa-o. which is for the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: One who is pleasing to God shall not be reincarnated again.
lines.transliteration: jo parabh bh aavai janam na aavai.

lines.english: He remains absorbed in the loving devotional worship of the Lord, in the Love of the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 408
lines.transliteration: har paraym bhagat  har pareet  rachai. ||1||

lines.english: He is blended with God, by dedicating his mind to Him.
lines.transliteration: parabh sang mileejai ih man d eejai.

lines.english: Bless Nanak with Your Name, O Lord - please, shower Your Mercy upon him! ||2||1||150|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (408-2) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai apnee da-i-aa karahu. ||2||1||150||

lines.english: Please, come to me, O Beloved Lord; without You, no one can comfort me.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil raam pi-aaray tum bin Dh eeraj ko na karai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One may read the Simritees and the Shaastras, and perform all sorts of religiousrituals; and yet, without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, God, there is no peace atall. ||1||
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar baho karam kamaa-ay parabh  tumray d aras bin sukh  naahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤੁਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ  ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: People have grown weary of observing fasts, vows and rigorous self-discipline; Nanakabides with God, in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||2||2||151|| Awsw mhlw 5 Gru 15 pVqwl  (408-5) aasaa mehlaa 5 ghar 15 parh -taal Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fifteenth House, Partaal: <> siqgur pRswid ] (408-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: varat naym sanjam kar thaakay naanak saaDh  saran parabh  sang vasai. ||2||2||151||

lines.english: He sleeps, intoxicated by corruption and Maya; he does not come to realize or understand.
lines.transliteration: bikaar maa-i-aa maad so-i-o soojh  boojh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਏ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਦਰਸ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seizing him by the hair, the Messenger of Death pulls him up; then, he comes to hissenses. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pakar kays jam uthaari-o t ad hee gh ar jaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
lines.english: Those who are attached to the poison of greed and sin grab at the wealth of others;they only bring pain on themselves.
lines.transliteration: lobh bikh i-aa bikh ai laagay hir vit  chit dukhaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: They are intoxicated by their pride in those things which shall be destroyed in aninstant; those demons do not understand. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khin bh angunaa kai maan maat ay asur jaan eh naahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਾਿਦ  ਸੋਇਓ  ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Vedas, the Shaastras and the holy men proclaim it, but the deaf do not hear it.
lines.transliteration: bayd saast ar jan pukaareh sunai naahee doraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਕਿਰ  ਕੇਸ ਜਿਮ ਉਠਾਿਰਓ  ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the game of life is over, and he has lost, and he breathes his last, then the foolregrets and repents in his mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nipat baajee haar mookaa pachhut aa-i-o man bh oraa. ||2||

lines.english: He paid the fine, but it is in vain - in the Court of the Lord, his account is not credited.
lines.transliteration: daan sagal gair vajeh bhari-aa d eevaan laykh ai na pari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ  ਕੈ ਮਾਿਨ  ਮਾਤੇ ਅਸੁਰ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those deeds which would have covered him - those deeds, he has not done. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jayNh kaaraj rahai olHaa so-ay kaam na kari-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru has shown me the world to be thus; I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aiso jag mohi gur dikh aa-i-o t a-o ayk keerat  gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਹ  ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਡੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Renouncing his pride in strength and cleverness, Nanak has come to the Lord'sSanctuary. ||4||1||152|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (408-11) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maan taan t aj si-aanap saran  naanak aa-i-aa. ||4||1||152||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਪਿਟ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਹਾਿਰ  ਮੂਕਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ  ਮਿਨ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dealing in the Name of the Lord of the Universe,
lines.transliteration: baapaar govind naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ  ਗੈਰ ਵਜਿਹ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਦੀਵਾਨ  ਲੇਖੈ ਨ ਪਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: saaDh sant  manaa-ay pari-a paa-ay gun gaa-ay panch naad  toor bajaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. and pleasing the Saints and holy men, obtain the Beloved Lord and sing His GloriousPraises; play the sound current of the Naad with the five instruments. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਿਜ  ਰਹੈ ਓਲਾ  ਸੋਇ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਰਆ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Obtaining His Mercy, I easily gained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; now, I amimbued with the Love of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa paa-ay sehjaa-ay darsaa-ay ab raat i-aa govind  si-o.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Saints, I feel love and affection for my Beloved Lord Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant sayv pareet  naath rang laalan laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਿਜ ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਸਰਿਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within my mind, and I rejoice that I shall nothave to come back again. I have obtained celestial poise, and the treasure within mymind.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan man drirh-aa-ay rahsaa-ay nahee aa-ay sehjaa-ay man niDh aan paa-ay.

lines.english: I have renounced all of the affairs of my mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ajee manai kee kaam karaa.

lines.english: It has been so long, so long, so long, so very long, since my mind has felt such a great thirst.
lines.transliteration: chir chir chir chir bha-i-aa man bahut  pi-aas laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ  ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, and show Yourself to me.
lines.transliteration: har darsano d ikhaavhu mohi t um bat aavhu.

lines.english: Nanak the meek has entered Your Sanctuary; please, take me in Your embrace.||2||2||153|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (408-16) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak deen saran  aa-ay gal laa-ay. ||2||2||153||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ  ਦਰਸਾਏ  ਅਬ ਰਾਿਤਆ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਿਸਉ ॥
lines.english: Who can destroy the fortress of sin,
lines.transliteration: ko-oo bikham gaar t orai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਿਵ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਾਥ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ  ਲਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aas Dhoh moh bh aram hee t ay horai. ||1|| rahaa-o. and release me from hope, thirst, deception, attachment and doubt? ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਰਹਸਾਏ  ਨਹੀ ਆਏ  ਸਹਜਾਏ ਮਿਨ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: How can I escape the afflictions of sexual desire, anger, greed and pride? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  maan ih bi-aaDh  chhorai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤਜੀ  ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, love the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lordof the Universe.
lines.transliteration: satsang naam rang gun govind  gaava-o.

lines.english: Night and day, meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: andino parabh  Dhi-aava-o.

lines.english: I have captured and demolished the walls of doubt.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh eet jeet mitaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਆਏ  ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam is my only treasure. ||2||3||154|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (408-19) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: niDh naam naanak morai. ||2||3||154||

lines.english: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed;
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  ti-aag.
man simar gobind naam. remember the Name of the Lord of the Universe in your mind.

lines.english: Meditation on the Lord is the only fruitful action. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 409
lines.transliteration: har bhajan safal kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Renounce pride, attachment, corruption and falsehood, and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: taj maan moh vikaar mithi-aa jap raam raam raam.

lines.english: O mortal, attach yourself to the Feet of the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man santnaa kai charan laag. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਜਿਪ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God is the Sustainer of the world, Merciful to the meek, the Purifier of sinners, the Transcendent Lord God. Awaken, and meditate on His Feet.
lines.transliteration: parabh gopaal d een d a-i-aal pat it paavan paarbarahm har charan  simar jaag.

lines.english: Perform His devotional worship, O Nanak, and your destiny shall be fulfilled.||2||4||155|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (409-3) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar bhagat  naanak pooran bh aag. ||2||4||155||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਜਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Pleasure and pain, detachment and ecstasy - the Lord has revealed His Play.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: harakh sog bairaag anandee kh ayl ree d ikhaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One moment, the mortal is in fear, and the next moment he is fearless; in a moment,he gets up and departs.
lines.transliteration: khinhoo-aN bhai nirbh ai khinhoo-aN khinhoo-aN uth Dhaa-i-o.

lines.english: One moment, he enjoys pleasures, and the next moment, he leaves and goes away.||1||
lines.transliteration: khinhoo-aN ras bh ogan kh inhoo-aN khinhoo t aj jaa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ  ਅਨੰਦੀ  ਖੇਲੁ ਰੀ ਿਦਖਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One moment, he practices Yoga and intense meditation, and all sorts of worship; thenext moment, he wanders in doubt.
lines.transliteration: khinhoo-aN jog taap baho poojaa kh inhoo-aN bharmaa-i-o.

lines.english: One moment, O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Mercy and blesses him with His Love, inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||5||156|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 5 Gru 17 AwswvrI  (409-7) raag aasaa mehlaa 5 ghar 17 aasaavaree Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Seventeenth House, Aasaavaree: <> siqgur pRswid ] (409-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: khinhoo-aN kirpaa saaDh oo sang naanak har rang laa-i-o. ||2||5||156||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gobind gobind  kar haaN.

lines.english: Cherish the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, in your mind.
lines.transliteration: har har man pi-aar haaN.

lines.english: The Guru says to install it in your consciousness.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa so chit Dh ar haaN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨਹੂੰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੫॥੧੫੬॥
lines.english: Turn away from others, and turn to Him.
lines.transliteration: an si-o tor fayr haaN.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੭ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Thus you shall obtain your Beloved, O my companion. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aisay laalan paa-i-o ree sakhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the pool of the world is the mud of attachment.
lines.transliteration: pankaj moh sar haaN.

lines.english: Stuck in it, his feet cannot walk towards the Lord.
lines.transliteration: pag nahee chalai har haaN.

lines.english: The fool is stuck;
lines.transliteration: gahdi-o moorh nar haaN.
anin upaav kar haaN. he cannot do anything else.

lines.english: Only by entering the Lord's Sanctuary, O my companion, will you be released. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ta-o niksai saran pai ree sakh ee. ||1||

lines.english: Thus your consciousness shall be stable and steady and firm.
lines.transliteration: thir thir chit thir haaN.

lines.english: Wilderness and household are the same.
lines.transliteration: ban garihu samsar haaN.

lines.english: Deep within dwells the One Husband Lord;
lines.transliteration: antar ayk pir haaN.
baahar anayk Dhar haaN. outwardly, there are many distractions.

lines.english: Practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.
lines.transliteration: raajan jog kar haaN.

lines.english: Says Nanak, this is the way to dwell with the people, and yet remain apart from them.||2||1||157|| AwswvrI mhlw 5 ] (409-12) aasaavaree mehlaa 5. Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak log agolee ree sakhee. ||2||1||157||

lines.english: Cherish one desire only:
lines.transliteration: mansaa ayk maan haaN.
gur si-o nayt Dh i-aan haaN. meditate continually on the Guru.

lines.english: Install the wisdom of the Saints' Mantra.
lines.transliteration: darirh  sant mant  gi-aan haaN.

lines.english: Serve the Feet of the Guru,
lines.transliteration: sayvaa gur charaan haaN.
ta-o milee-ai gur kirpaan mayray manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. and you shall meet Him, by Guru's Grace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ  ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
lines.english: All doubts are dispelled,
lines.transliteration: tootay an bharaan haaN.
ravi-o sarab thaan haaN. and the Lord is seen to be pervading all places.

lines.english: The fear of death is dispelled,
lines.transliteration: lahi-o jam bha-i-aan haaN.
paa-i-o payd thaan haaN. and the primal place is obtained.

lines.english: Then, all subservience is removed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ta-o chookee sagal kaan. ||1||

lines.english: One who has such destiny recorded upon his forehead, obtains it;
lines.transliteration: lahno jis mathaan haaN.
bhai paavak paar paraan haaN. he crosses over the terrifying ocean of fire.

lines.english: He obtains a place in the home of his own self,
lines.transliteration: nij ghar t iseh thaan haaN.
har ras raseh maan haaN. and enjoys the most sublime essence of the Lord's essence.

lines.english: His hunger is appeased;
lines.transliteration: laathee tis bh ukaan haaN.

lines.english: Nanak, he is absorbed in celestial peace, O my mind. ||2||2||158|| AwswvrI mhlw 5 ] (409-17) aasaavaree mehlaa 5. Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sahj samaa-i-o ray manaa. ||2||2||158||

lines.english: Sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har har gunee haaN.

lines.english: Meditate on the celestial music.
lines.transliteration: japee-ai sahj Dhunee haaN.

lines.english: The tongues of the holy Saints repeat it.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo rasan bh anee haaN.

lines.english: I have heard that this is the way to emancipation.
lines.transliteration: chhootan biDh  sunee haaN.

lines.english: This is found by the greatest merit, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paa-ee-ai vad punee mayray manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The silent sages search for Him.
lines.transliteration: khojeh jan munee haaN.

lines.english: God is the Master of all.
lines.transliteration: sarab kaa parabh Dh anee haaN.

lines.english: It is so difficult to find Him in this world, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: dulabh  kal d unee haaN.

lines.english: He is the Dispeller of distress.
lines.transliteration: dookh  binaasanee haaN.

lines.english: God is the Fulfiller of desires, O my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh pooran aasnee mayray manaa. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, serve Him. pMnw 410
lines.transliteration: man so sayvee-ai haaN.

lines.english: He is unknowable and inscrutable.
lines.transliteration: alakh abh ayvee-ai haaN.

lines.english: Enshrine love for Him.
lines.transliteration: taaN si-o pareet  kar haaN.

lines.english: He does not perish, or go away, or die.
lines.transliteration: binas na jaa-ay mar haaN.

lines.english: He is known only through the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur tay jaani-aa haaN.

lines.english: Nanak, my mind is satisfied with the Lord, O my mind. ||2||3||159|| AwswvrI mhlw 5 ] (410-2) aasaavaree mehlaa 5. Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak man maani-aa mayray manaa. ||2||3||159||

lines.english: Grab hold of the Support of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykaa ot gahu haaN.

lines.english: Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad kaho haaN.

lines.english: Submit to the Order of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa sat saho haaN.

lines.english: Receive the treasure in your mind.
lines.transliteration: maneh niDhaan lahu haaN.

lines.english: Thus you shall be absorbed in peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukheh samaa-ee-ai mayray manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who is dead while yet alive,
lines.transliteration: jeevat jo marai haaN.
dutar so t arai haaN. crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.english: One who becomes the dust of all
lines.transliteration: sabh kee rayn ho-ay haaN.
nirbha-o kaha-o so-ay haaN. - he alone is called fearless.

lines.english: His anxieties are removed
lines.transliteration: mitay andaysi-aa haaN.
sant upd aysi-aa mayray manaa. ||1|| by the Teachings of the Saints, O my mind. ||1||

lines.english: That humble being, who takes happiness in the Naam, the Name of the Lord
lines.transliteration: jis jan naam sukh haaN.
tis nikat na kad ay dukh haaN. - pain never draws near him.

lines.english: One who listens to the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: jo har har jas sunay haaN.
sabh ko t is mannay haaN. is obeyed by all men.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨੇ ਹ ॥
lines.english: How fortunate it is that he came into the world;
lines.transliteration: safal so aa-i-aa haaN.

lines.english: Nanak, he is pleasing to God, O my mind. ||2||4||160|| AwswvrI mhlw 5 ] (410-7) aasaavaree mehlaa 5. Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh bh aa-i-aa mayray manaa. ||2||4||160||

lines.english: Meeting together, let us sing the Praises of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: mil har jas gaa-ee-ai haaN.
param pad paa-ee-ai haaN. and attain the supreme state.

lines.english: Those who obtain that sublime essence,
lines.transliteration: u-aa ras jo biDhay haaN.
taa ka-o sagal siDh ay haaN. obtain all of the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

lines.english: They remain awake and aware night and day;
lines.transliteration: an-din jaagi-aa haaN.

lines.english: Nanak, they are blessed by great good fortune, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naanak badbhaagi-aa mayray manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Let us wash the feet of the Saints;
lines.transliteration: sant pag Dh o-ee-ai haaN.
durmat  kho-ee-ai haaN. our evil-mindedness shall be cleansed.

lines.english: Becoming the dust of the feet of the Lord's slaves,
lines.transliteration: daasah rayn ho-ay haaN.
bi-aapai dukh  na ko-ay haaN. one shall not be afflicted with pain.

lines.english: Taking to the Sanctuary of His devotees,
lines.transliteration: bhagt aaN saran par haaN.
janam na kaday mar haaN. he is no longer subject to birth and death.

lines.english: They alone become eternal,
lines.transliteration: asthir say bha-ay haaN.
har har jinH jap la-ay mayray manaa. ||1|| who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. ||1||

lines.english: You are my Friend, my Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet t ooN haaN.

lines.english: Please, implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.
lines.transliteration: naam drirh-aa-ay mooN haaN.

lines.english: Without Him, there is not any other.
lines.transliteration: tis bin naahi ko-ay haaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਜਨ ਜਿਪ ਲਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within my mind, I worship Him in adoration.
lines.transliteration: maneh araaDh so-ay haaN.

lines.english: I do not forget Him, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: nimakh na veesrai haaN.

lines.english: How can I live without Him?
lines.transliteration: tis bin ki-o sarai haaN.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur ka-o kurbaan jaa-o haaN.

lines.english: Nanak, chant the Name, O my mind. ||2||5||161|| AwswvrI mhlw 5 ] (410-13) aasaavaree mehlaa 5. Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak japay naa-o mayray manaa. ||2||5||161||

lines.english: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: kaaran karan tooN haaN.

lines.english: I cannot think of any other.
lines.transliteration: avar naa sujhai mooN haaN.

lines.english: Whatever You do, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: karahi so ho-ee-ai haaN.

lines.english: I sleep in peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: sahj sukh so-ee-ai haaN.

lines.english: Dheeraj man bh a-ay haaN. My mind has become patient,

lines.transliteration: parabh kai d ar pa-ay mayray manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. since I fell at God's Door, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangmay haaN.

lines.english: I gained perfect control over my senses.
lines.transliteration: pooran sanjmay haaN.

lines.english: Ever since I rid myself of my self-conceit,
lines.transliteration: jab tay chh utay aap haaN.
tab tay mitay t aap haaN. my sufferings have ended.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਪਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ਰਹਾਉ॥
lines.english: He has showered His Mercy upon me.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa Dhaaree-aa haaN.

lines.english: The Creator Lord has preserved my honor, O my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pat rakh  banvaaree-aa mayray manaa. ||1||

lines.english: Know that this is the only peace;
lines.transliteration: ih sukh jaanee-ai haaN.
har karay so maanee-ai haaN. accept whatever the Lord does.

lines.english: No one is bad.
lines.transliteration: mandaa naahi ko-ay haaN.

lines.english: Become the dust of the Feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant kee rayn ho-ay haaN.

lines.english: He Himself preserves those
lines.transliteration: aapay jis rakhai haaN.
har amrit so chakh ai mayray manaa. ||2|| who taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, O my mind. ||2||

lines.english: One who has no one to call his own
lines.transliteration: jis kaa naahi ko-ay haaN.

lines.english: - God belongs to him.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa parabh oo so-ay haaN.

lines.english: God knows the state of our innermost being.
lines.transliteration: antargat  bujhai haaN.

lines.english: He knows everything.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tis sujh ai haaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸੋ ਚਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please, Lord, save the sinners.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaar layho haaN.

lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer, O my mind. ||3||6||162|| AwswvrI mhlw 5 iekqukw ] (410-19) aasaavaree mehlaa 5 iktukaa. Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl, Ik-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak ardaas ayhu mayray manaa. ||3||6||162||

lines.english: O my stranger soul,
lines.transliteration: o-ay pardaysee-aa haaN.
sunat sand aysi-aa haaN. ||1|| rahaa-o. listen to the call. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Whatever you are attached to, pMnw 411
lines.transliteration: jaa si-o rach rahay haaN.
sabh ka-o t aj ga-ay haaN. you shall have to leave it all behind.

lines.english: These things seem like only a dream,
lines.transliteration: supnaa ji-o bha-ay haaN.
har naam jiniH la-ay. ||1|| to one who takes the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.english: Forsaking the Lord, and clinging to another,
lines.transliteration: har taj an lagay haaN.
janmeh mar bhagay haaN. they run toward death and reincarnation.

lines.english: But those humble beings, who attach themselves to the Lord, Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: har har jan lahay haaN.
jeevat say rahay haaN. continue to live.

lines.english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy,
lines.transliteration: jisahi kirpaal ho-ay haaN.

lines.english: O Nanak, becomes His devotee. ||2||7||163||232|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (411-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw mhlw 9 ] (411-4) raag aasaa mehlaa 9. Raag Aasaa, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  so-ay. ||2||7||163||232||

lines.english: Who should I tell the condition of the mind?
lines.transliteration: birthaa kaha-o ka-un si-o man kee.

lines.english: Engrossed in greed, running around in the ten directions, you hold to your hopes ofwealth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lobh garsi-o d as hoo d is Dhaavat  aasaa laagi-o Dh an kee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: For the sake of pleasure, you suffer such great pain, and you have to serve each andevery person.
lines.transliteration: sukh kai hayt  bahut  dukh paavat  sayv karat  jan jan kee.

lines.english: You wander from door to door like a dog, unconscious of the Lord's meditation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: du-aareh d u-aar su-aan ji-o dolat  nah suDh  raam bh ajan kee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਿਭ ਗਰ੍ਿਸਓ  ਦਸ ਹੂ ਿਦਸ ਧਾਵਤ  ਆਸਾ  ਲਾਿਗਓ  ਧਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You lose this human life in vain, and You are not even ashamed when others laugh at you.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam akaarath khovat  laaj na lok hasan kee.

lines.english: O Nanak, why not sing the Lord's Praises, so that you may be rid of the body's evildisposition? ||2||1||233|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 AstpdIAw Gru 2  (411-9) raag aasaa mehlaa 1 asatpadee-aa gh ar 2 Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtapadees, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (411-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jas ki-o nahee gaavat kumat  binaasai t an kee. ||2||1||233||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਤ  ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ  ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: He descends the treacherous precipice, to bathe in the cleansing pool;
lines.transliteration: utar avgh at sarvar nHaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਆਰਿਹ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਸੁਆਨ  ਿਜਉ  ਡੋਲਤ  ਨਹ ਸੁਧ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ  ਕੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bakai na bolai har gun gaavai. without speaking or saying anything, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸ  ਜਨਮ  ਅਕਾਰਥ  ਖੋਵਤ  ਲਾਜ  ਨ ਲੋਕ ਹਸਨ  ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: Like water vapor in the sky, he remains absorbed in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jal aakaasee sunn samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਿਕਉ  ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਤ  ਕੁਮਿਤ ਿਬਨਾਸੈ  ਤਨ ਕੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩੩॥
lines.english: He churns the true pleasures to obtain the supreme nectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ras sat jh ol mahaa ras paavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to such spiritual wisdom, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: aisaa gi-aan sunhu abh moray.

lines.english: The Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharipur Dh aar rahi-aa sabh  tha-uray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who makes Truthfulness his fast and religious vows, does not suffer the pain of death.
lines.transliteration: sach barat naym na kaal sant aavai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he burns away his anger.
lines.transliteration: satgur sabad  karoDh  jalaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਝੋਿਲ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, immersed in the Samaadhi of deep meditation.
lines.transliteration: gagan nivaas samaaDh lagaavai.

lines.english: Touching the philosopher's stone, he obtains the supreme status. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paaras paras param pad paavai. ||2||

lines.english: For the benefit of the mind, churn the true essence of reality;
lines.transliteration: sach man kaaran t at bilovai.
subhar sarvar mail na Dh ovai. bathing in the over-flowing tank of nectar, filth is washed away.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਬਰ੍ਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ  ਸੰਤਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: We become like the One with whom we are imbued.
lines.transliteration: jai si-o raataa t aiso hovai.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay so hovai. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru is cool and soothing like ice; He puts out the fire of the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur hiv seetal agan bujh aavai.

lines.english: Smear your body with the ashes of dedicated service,
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat bibh oot charh aavai.
darsan aap sahj gh ar aavai. and live in the home of peace - make this your religious order.

lines.english: Let the Immaculate Bani of the Word be your playing of the flute. ||4||
lines.transliteration: nirmal banee naad  vajaavai. ||4||

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom within is the supreme, sublime nectar.
lines.transliteration: antar gi-aan mahaa ras saaraa.

lines.english: Contemplation of the Guru is one's bathing at holy places of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: tirath majan gur veechaaraa.

lines.english: Worship and adoration within is the Lord's dwelling.
lines.transliteration: antar poojaa thaan muraaraa.

lines.english: He is the One who blends one's light with the Divine Light. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milaavan haaraa. ||5||

lines.english: He delights in the delightful wisdom of loving the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ras rasi-aa mat aykai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: He is one of the self-elect - he merges with the Lord, who occupies the throne.
lines.transliteration: takhat nivaasee panch samaa-ay.

lines.english: He performs his works in obedience to the Will of his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: kaar kamaa-ee khasam rajaa-ay.

lines.english: The Unknowable Lord cannot be understood. ||6||
lines.transliteration: avigat naath na lakh i-aa jaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: The lotus originates in the water, and yet it remains distinct from the water.
lines.transliteration: jal meh upjai jal tay d oor.

lines.english: Just so, the Divine Light pervades and permeates the water of the world.
lines.transliteration: jal meh jot rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: Who is near, and who is far away?
lines.transliteration: kis nayrhai kis aakh aa door.

lines.english: I sing the Glories of the Lord, the treasure of virtue; I behold Him ever-present. ||7||
lines.transliteration: niDh gun  gaavaa d aykh hadoor. ||7||

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, there is none other than Him. pMnw 412
lines.transliteration: antar baahar avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so fun ho-ay.

lines.english: Listen, O Bharthari Yogi - Nanak speaks after deliberation;
lines.transliteration: sun bh arthar naanak kahai beechaar.

lines.english: Awsw mhlw 1 ] (412-2) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam mayraa aaDhaar. ||8||1|| the Immaculate Name is my only Support. ||8||1||

lines.english: All meditation, all austerities, and all clever tricks,
lines.transliteration: sabh jap sabh  tap sabh  chaturaa-ee.
oojharh  bharmai raahi na paa-ee. lead one to wander in the wilderness, but he does not find the Path.

lines.english: Without understanding, he is not approved;
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay ko thaa-ay na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜਪ ਸਿਭ ਤਪ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonai maathay chh aa-ee. ||1|| without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ashes are thrown upon one's head. ||1||

lines.english: True is the Master; the world comes and goes.
lines.transliteration: saach Dhan ee jag aa-ay binaasaa.

lines.english: The mortal is emancipated, as Gurmukh, as the Lord's slave. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhootas paraan ee gurmukh  daasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The world is bound by its attachments to the many desires.
lines.transliteration: jag mohi baaDhaa bahut ee aasaa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, some become free of desire.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee ik bh a-ay ud aasaa.

lines.english: Within them is the Naam, and their heart lotus blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: antar naam kamal pargaasaa.

lines.english: They have no fear of death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tinH ka-o naahee jam kee t araasaa. ||2||

lines.english: The men of the world are conquered by woman; they love the ladies.
lines.transliteration: jag tari-a jit  kaaman  hitkaaree.

lines.english: Attached to children and wife, they forget the Naam.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar lag naam visaaree.

lines.english: They waste this human life in vain, and lose the game in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa baajee haaree.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru is the best occupation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay karn ee saaree. ||3||

lines.english: One who speaks egotistically in public,
lines.transliteration: baahrahu ha-umai kahai kahaa-ay.
andrahu mukat  layp kad ay na laa-ay. never attains liberation within.

lines.english: One who burns away his attachment to Maya, by the Word of the Guru's Shabad,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh gur sabad jalaa-ay.
nirmal naam sad hird ai Dhi-aa-ay. ||4|| meditates forever within his heart on the Immaculate Naam. ||4||

lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ai thaak rahaa-ay. He restrains his wandering mind, and keeps it under control.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The company of such a Sikh is obtained only by Grace.
lines.transliteration: sikh sangat  karam milaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, he goes astray and continues coming and going.
lines.transliteration: gur bin bhoolo aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Bestowing His Mercy, the Lord unites him in Union. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay sanjog milaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: I cannot describe the Beauteous Lord.
lines.transliteration: roorho kaha-o na kahi-aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: I speak the unspoken; I cannot estimate His value.
lines.transliteration: akath katha-o nah keemat paa-ee.

lines.english: All pain and pleasure come by Your Will.
lines.transliteration: sabh d ukh tayray sookh  rajaa-ee.

lines.english: All pain is eradicated by the True Name. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sabh d ukh maytay saachai naa-ee. ||6||

lines.english: He plays the instrument without hands, and dances without feet.
lines.transliteration: kar bin vaajaa pag bin taalaa.

lines.english: But if he understands the Word of the Shabad, then he shall behold the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: jay sabad bujh ai taa sach nihaalaa.

lines.english: With the True Lord within the self, all happiness comes.
lines.transliteration: antar saach sabh ay sukh  naalaa.

lines.english: Showering His Mercy, the Preserving Lord preserves him. ||7||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay raakh ai rakh vaalaa. ||7||

lines.english: He understands the three worlds; he eliminates his self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan soojh ai aap gavaavai.

lines.english: He understands the Bani of the Word, and he is absorbed into the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: banee boojh ai sach samaavai.

lines.english: Contemplating the Shabad, he enshrines love for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad veechaaray ayk liv t aaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, blessed is the Lord, the Embellisher. ||8||2|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (412-13) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan savaaran haaraa. ||8||2||

lines.english: There are innumerable writings; those who write them take pride in them.
lines.transliteration: laykh asaNkh likh likh maan.

lines.english: When one's mind accepts the Truth, he understands, and speaks of it.
lines.transliteration: man maanee-ai sach surat vakh aan.

lines.english: Words, spoken and read again and again, are useless loads.
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee parh  parh bhaar.

lines.english: There are innumerable writings, but the Infinite Lord remains unwritten. ||1||
lines.transliteration: laykh asaNkh alaykh  apaar. ||1||

lines.english: Know that such a True Lord is the One and only.
lines.transliteration: aisaa saachaa tooN ayko jaan .

lines.english: Understand that birth and death come according to the Lord's Will. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa hukam pachh aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Because of attachment to Maya, the world is bound by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi jag baaDhaa jamkaal.

lines.english: These bonds are released when one remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: baaNDhaa chh ootai naam samHaal.

lines.english: The Guru is the Giver of peace; do not look for any other.
lines.transliteration: gur sukh-d aata avar na bh aal.

lines.english: In this world, and the next, He shall stand by you. ||2||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  nibhee t uDh naal. ||2||

lines.english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, embraces love for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai t aaN ayk liv laa-ay.

lines.english: One who eats the uneatable, has his doubts dispelled.
lines.transliteration: achar charai taaN bharam chukaa-ay.

lines.english: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Naam abides in his mind.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat man naam vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Becoming Gurmukh, he merges into the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay t a sach samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The One who created the earth and the Akaashic ethers of the sky,
lines.transliteration: jin Dhar saajee gagan akaas.
jin sabh thaapee thaap uthaap. established all; He establishes and disestablishes.

lines.english: He Himself is permeating all.
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar aapay aap.

lines.english: He does not consult anyone; He Himself forgives. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kisai na poochhay bakh say aap. ||4||

lines.english: You are the Ocean, over-flowing with jewels and rubies.
lines.transliteration: too pur saagar maan ak heer.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are immaculate and pure, the true treasure of virtue. pMnw 413
lines.transliteration: too nirmal sach gun ee gaheer.

lines.english: Peace is enjoyed, meeting the Guru, the Spiritual Teacher.
lines.transliteration: sukh maanai bh aytai gur peer.

lines.english: The Lord is the only Master; He is the only Minister. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ayko saahib ayk vajeer. ||5||

lines.english: The world is held in bondage; he alone is emancipated, who conquers his ego.
lines.transliteration: jag bandee mukt ay ha-o maaree.

lines.english: How rare in the world is that wise person, who practices this.
lines.transliteration: jag gi-aanee virlaa aachaaree.

lines.english: How rare in this world is that scholar who reflects upon this.
lines.transliteration: jag pandit virlaa veechaaree.

lines.english: Without meeting the True Guru, all wander in ego. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay sabh  firai ahaNkaaree. ||6||

lines.english: The world is unhappy; only a few are happy.
lines.transliteration: jag dukh ee-aa sukh ee-aa jan ko-ay.

lines.english: The world is diseased, from its indulgences; it weeps over its lost virtue.
lines.transliteration: jag rogee bhogee gun  ro-ay.

lines.english: The world wells up, and then subsides, losing its honor.
lines.transliteration: jag upjai binsai pat kh o-ay.

lines.english: He alone, who becomes Gurmukh, understands. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai boojh ai so-ay. ||7||

lines.english: His price is so costly; His weight is unbearable.
lines.transliteration: mahgho mol bh aar afaar.

lines.english: He is immovable and undeceivable; enshrine Him in your mind, through the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: atal achhal gurmat ee Dh aar.

lines.english: Meet Him through love, become pleasing to Him, and act in fear of Him.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay milai bh aavai bh a-ikaar.

lines.english: Nanak the lowly says this, after deep contemplation. ||8||3|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (413-5) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak neech kahai beechaar. ||8||3||

lines.english: When someone dies, the five passions meet and mourn his death.
lines.transliteration: ayk marai panchay mil roveh.

lines.english: Overcoming self-conceit, he washes off his filth with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jaa-ay sabad mal Dh oveh.

lines.english: One who knows and understands, enters the home of peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: samajh soojh  sahj gh ar hoveh.

lines.english: Without understanding, he loses all his honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay saglee pat  khoveh. ||1||

lines.english: Who dies, and who weeps for him?
lines.transliteration: ka-un marai ka-un  rovai ohee.

lines.english: O Lord, Creator, Cause of causes, You are over the heads of all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  sabh sai sir t ohee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Who weeps over the pain of the dead?
lines.transliteration: moo-ay ka-o rovai dukh  ko-ay.

lines.english: Those who weep, do so over their own troubles.
lines.transliteration: so rovai jis baydan ho-ay.

lines.english: God knows the condition of those who are so affected.
lines.transliteration: jis beetee jaan ai parabh  so-ay.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay so ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One who remains dead while yet alive, is saved, and saves others as well.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marn aa taaray t arnaa.

lines.english: Celebrate the Victory of the Lord; taking to His Sanctuary, the supreme status is obtained.
lines.transliteration: jai jagdees param gat  sarnaa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur charn aa.

lines.english: The Guru is the boat; through the Shabad of His Word, the terrifying world-ocean iscrossed over. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur bohith sabad bh ai tarnaa. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself is Fearless; His Divine Light is contained in all.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o aap nirant ar jot .

lines.english: Without the Name, the world is defiled and untouchable.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sootak jag chh ot.

lines.english: Through evil-mindedness, they are ruined; why should they cry out and weep?
lines.transliteration: durmat  binsai ki-aa kahi rot .

lines.english: They are born only to die, without hearing the music of devotional worship. ||4||
lines.transliteration: janam moo-ay bin bhagat  sarot . ||4||

lines.english: Only one's true friends mourn one's death.
lines.transliteration: moo-ay ka-o sach roveh meet.

lines.english: Those under the sway of the three dispositions continue to mourn on and on.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  roveh neet aa neet .

lines.english: Disregarding pain and pleasure, center your consciousness on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  parhar sahj sucheet .

lines.english: Dedicate your body and mind to the Love of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tan man sa-opa-o krisan pareet . ||5||

lines.english: The One Lord dwells within the various and countless beings.
lines.transliteration: bheet ar ayk anayk asaNkh.

lines.english: There are so many rituals and religious faiths, their number is innumerable.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam baho sankh  asaNkh.

lines.english: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, one's life is in vain.
lines.transliteration: bin bhai bh agtee janam biranth.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi mil parmaaranth. ||6||

lines.english: He Himself dies, and He Himself kills.
lines.transliteration: aap marai maaray bhee aap.

lines.english: He Himself establishes, and having established, disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay thaap uthaap.

lines.english: He created the Universe, and by His Divine  Nature, instilled His Divine Light into it.
lines.transliteration: sarisat upaa-ee jotee t oo jaat .

lines.english: One who reflects upon the Word of the Shabad, meets the Lord, without doubt. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sabad veechaar milan  nahee bh araat. ||7||

lines.english: Pollution is the burning fire, which is consuming the world.
lines.transliteration: sootak agan bh akhai jag kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Pollution is in the water, upon the land, and everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sootak jal thal sabh  hee thaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, people are born and die in pollution.
lines.transliteration: naanak sootak janam mareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they drink in the Lord's sublime elixir. ||8||4|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 ] (413-16) raag aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har ras peejai. ||8||4||

lines.english: One who contemplates his own self, tests the worth of the jewel.
lines.transliteration: aap veechaarai so parkhay heeraa.

lines.english: With a single glance, the Perfect Guru saves him.
lines.transliteration: ayk darisat t aaray gur pooraa.

lines.english: When the Guru is pleased, one's mind comforts itself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur maanai man tay man Dh eeraa. ||1||

lines.english: He is such a banker, who tests us.
lines.transliteration: aisaa saahu saraafee karai.

lines.english: By His True Glance of Grace, we are blessed with the Love of the One Lord, and aresaved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saachee nadar ayk liv t arai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The capital of the Naam is immaculate and sublime.
lines.transliteration: poonjee naam niranjan saar.

lines.english: That peddler is rendered pure, who is imbued with the Truth.
lines.transliteration: nirmal saach rataa paikaar.

lines.english: Praising the Lord, in the house of poise, he attains the Guru, the Creator. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sifat sahj gh ar gur kart aar. ||2||

lines.english: One who burns away hope and desire through the Word of the Shabad,
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa sabad jalaa-ay.
raam naraa-in kahai kahaa-ay. chants the Lord's Name, and inspires others to chant it as well.

lines.english: Through the Guru, he finds the Path home, to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||3|| pMnw 414
lines.transliteration: gur tay vaat mahal gh ar paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: His body becomes golden, by the Lord's Incomparable Light.
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa jot anoop.

lines.english: He beholds the divine beauty in all the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan dayvaa sagal saroop.

lines.english: That inexhaustible wealth of Truth is now in my lap. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mai so Dhan palai saach akh oot. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੂਟੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: In the five elements, the three worlds, the nine regions and the four directions, the Lord is pervading.
lines.transliteration: panch teen nav chaar samaavai.

lines.english: Dharan  gagan kal Dh aar rahaavai. He supports the earth and the sky, exercising His almighty power.
He turns the outgoing mind around. ||5||
lines.transliteration: baahar jaata-o ulat paraavai. ||5||

lines.english: The fool does not realize what he sees with his eyes.
lines.transliteration: moorakh ho-ay na aakh ee soojh ai.

lines.english: He does not taste with his tongue, and does not understand what is said.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa ras nahee kahi-aa boojhai.

lines.english: Intoxicated with poison, he argues with the world. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa maat aa jag si-o loojh ai. ||6||

lines.english: In the uplifting society, one is uplifted.
lines.transliteration: ootam sangat  ootam hovai.

lines.english: He chases after virtue and washes off his sins.
lines.transliteration: gun ka-o Dh aavai avgan  Dhovai.

lines.english: Without serving the Guru, celestial poise is not obtained. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sayvay sahj na hovai. ||7||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a diamond, a jewel, a ruby.
lines.transliteration: heeraa naam javayhar laal.

lines.english: The pearl of the mind is the inner wealth.
lines.transliteration: man motee hai t is kaa maal.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord tests us, and blesses us with His Glance of Grace. ||8||5|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (414-5) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parkhai nad ar nihaal. ||8||5||

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, meditation and satisfaction of the mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan Dh i-aan man maan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mahlee mahal pachh aan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Word of the Shabad, as his Insignia. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh surat  sabad  neesaan. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the loving devotional worship of the Lord's contemplation.
lines.transliteration: aisay paraym bhagat  veechaaree.

lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes the True Name, the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachaa naam muraaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Day and night, he remains immaculately pure, and abides in the sublime place.
lines.transliteration: ahinis nirmal thaan suthaan.

lines.english: He gains the wisdom of the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan nihkayval gi-aan.

lines.english: Through the True Guru, the Command of the Lord's Will is realized. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachay gur tay hukam pachh aan. ||2||

lines.english: He enjoys true pleasure, and suffers no pain.
lines.transliteration: saachaa harakh naahee t is sog.

lines.english: He enjoys the ambrosial wisdom, and the highest sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: amrit gi-aan mahaa ras bh og.

lines.english: He overcomes the five evil passions, and becomes the happiest of all men. ||3||
lines.transliteration: panch samaa-ee sukhee sabh  log. ||3||

lines.english: Your Divine Light is contained in all; everyone belongs to You.
lines.transliteration: saglee jot t ayraa sabh  ko-ee.

lines.english: You Yourself join and separate again.
lines.transliteration: aapay jorh vichh orhay so-ee.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay so ho-ee. ||4||

lines.english: He demolishes, and He builds; by His Order, he merges us into Himself.
lines.transliteration: dhaahi usaaray hukam samaavai.

lines.english: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, happens.
lines.transliteration: hukmo vartai jo t is bhaavai.

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one obtains the Perfect Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur bin pooraa ko-ay na paavai. ||5||

lines.english: In childhood and old age, he does not understand.
lines.transliteration: baalak biraDh na surat  paraan.

lines.english: In the prime of youth, he is drowned in his pride.
lines.transliteration: bhar joban boodai abh imaan.

lines.english: Without the Name, what can the fool obtain? ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ki-aa lahas nidaan. ||6||

lines.english: He does not know the One who blesses him with nourishment and wealth.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa an Dhan sahj na jaanaa.

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, he later regrets and repents.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaanaa fir pachh utaanaa.

lines.english: The noose of death is around the neck of that crazy madman. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gal faahee ba-uraa ba-uraanaa. ||7||

lines.english: I saw the world drowning, and I ran away in fear.
lines.transliteration: boodat jag d aykhi-aa ta-o dar bh aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: How very fortunate are those who have been saved by the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur raakh ay say vadbh aagay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are attached to the feet of the Guru. ||8||6|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (414-14) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur kee charnee laagay. ||8||6||

lines.english: They sing religious songs, but their consciousness is wicked.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi geetay cheet  aneet ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡਤ  ਜਗੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਤਉ ਡਿਰ ਭਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: They sing the songs, and call themselves divine,
lines.transliteration: raag sunaa-ay kahaaveh beet ay.
bin naavai man jhooth  aneet ay. ||1|| but without the Name, their minds are false and wicked. ||1||

lines.english: Where are you going? O mind, remain in your own home.
lines.transliteration: kahaa chalhu man rahhu gharay.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are satisfied with the Lord's Name; searching, they easily find the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam t ariptaasay kh ojat paavhu sahj haray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment fill the mind and body;
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh man moh sareeraa.
lab lobh ahaNkaar so peeraa. greed and egotism lead only to pain.

lines.english: How can the mind be comforted without the Lord's Name? ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin ki-o man Dheeraa. ||2||

lines.english: One who cleanses himself within, knows the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: antar naavan  saach pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੇ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the condition of his innermost being.
lines.transliteration: antar kee gat  gurmukh  jaanai.

lines.english: Without the True Word of the Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is notrealized. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saach sabad bin mahal na pachh aanai. ||3||

lines.english: One who merges his form into the Formless Lord,
lines.transliteration: nirankaar meh aakaar samaavai.
akal kalaa sach saach tikaavai. abides in the True Lord, the Powerful, beyond power.

lines.english: Such a person does not enter into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: so nar garabh jon nahee aavai. ||4||

lines.english: Go there, where you may obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord. pMnw 415
lines.transliteration: jahaaN naam milai tah jaa-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, perform good deeds.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee karam kamaa-o.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naamay raataa har gun  gaa-o. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the Guru, I have come to understand myself.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay aap pachh aataa.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Giver of Peace, abides within my mind.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam vasi-aa sukh -daata.

lines.english: Night and day, I am imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Naam. ||6||
lines.transliteration: an-din ban ee naamay raat aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਾਏ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: When my God attaches someone to Him, only then is that person attached.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh laa-ay t aa ko laagai.

lines.english: Conquering ego, he remains awake to the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maaray sabday jaagai.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, he enjoys lasting peace. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aithai othai sadaa sukh  aagai. ||7||

lines.english: The fickle mind does not know the way.
lines.transliteration: man chanchal biDh naahee jaan ai.

lines.english: The filthy self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mailaa sabad  na pachh aanai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh chants the Immaculate Naam. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nirmal naam vakh aanai. ||8||

lines.english: I offer my prayer to the Lord,
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aagai karee ardaas.
saaDhoo jan sangat  ho-ay nivaas. that I might dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: There, sins and sufferings are erased, and one is illumined with the Lord's Name. ||9||
lines.transliteration: kilvikh d ukh kaatay har naam pargaas. ||9||

lines.english: In reflective meditation, I have come to love good conduct.
lines.transliteration: kar beechaar aachaar paraataa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the True Guru, I recognize the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur bachnee ayko jaat aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, my mind is imbued with the Lord's Name. ||10||7|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (415-6) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam man raataa. ||10||7||

lines.english: The mind of the faithless cynic is like a crazy elephant.
lines.transliteration: man maigal saakat d ayvaanaa.

lines.english: It wanders around the forest, distracted by attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: ban khand maa-i-aa mohi hairaanaa.

lines.english: It goes here and there, hounded by death.
lines.transliteration: it ut jaahi kaal kay chaapay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਾਿਹ  ਕਾਲ  ਕੇ ਚਾਪੇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh seeks, and finds his own home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kh oj lahai gh ar aapay. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind finds no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabdai man nahee th a-uraa.

lines.english: Remember in meditation the Lord's Name, the most pure and sublime; renounce yourbitter egotism. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simrahu raam naam at nirmal avar t i-aagahu ha-umai ka-uraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਅਵਰ  ਿਤਆਗਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਉਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tell me, how can this stupid mind be rescued?
lines.transliteration: ih man mugaDh kahhu ki-o rahsee.

lines.english: Without understanding, it shall suffer the pains of death.
lines.transliteration: bin samjhay jam kaa d ukh sahsee.

lines.english: The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay sat gur maylai.

lines.english: The True Lord conquers and overcomes the tortures of death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaal kantak maaray sach paylai. ||2||

lines.english: This mind commits its deeds of karma, and this mind follows the Dharma.
lines.transliteration: ih man karmaa ih man Dharmaa.

lines.english: This mind is born of the five elements.
lines.transliteration: ih man panch tat  tay janmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: This foolish mind is perverted and greedy.
lines.transliteration: saakat lobh ee ih man moorh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤੇ ਜਨਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the mind of the Gurmukh becomes beautiful. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam japai man roorh aa. ||3||

lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh finds the Lord's home.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man asthaanay so-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh comes to know the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t aribhavan sojhee ho-ee.

lines.english: This mind is a Yogi, an enjoyer, a practicer of austerities.
lines.transliteration: ih man jogee bhogee t ap taapai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh understands the Lord God Himself. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh cheenHai har parabh  aapai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਭੋਗੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: This mind is a detached renunciate, forsaking egotism.
lines.transliteration: man bairaagee ha-umai ti-aagee.

lines.english: Desire and duality afflict each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at mansaa d ubiDh aa laagee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh drinks in the Lord's sublime essence;
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in gurmukh  chaakh ai.
dar gh ar mahlee har pat  raakh ai. ||5|| at His Door, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, He preserves his honor. ||5||

lines.english: This mind is the king, the hero of cosmic battles.
lines.transliteration: ih man raajaa soor sangraam.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਮਹਲੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh becomes fearless through the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ih man nirbha-o gurmukh  naam.

lines.english: Overpowering and subduing the five passions,
lines.transliteration: maaray panch apunai vas kee-ay.
ha-umai garaas ikat thaa-ay kee-ay. ||6|| holding ego in its grip, it confines them to one place. ||6||

lines.english: The Gurmukh renounces other songs and tastes.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raag su-aad  an ti-aagay.

lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh is awakened to devotion.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ih man bh agtee jaagay.

lines.english: Hearing the unstruck music of the sound current, this mind contemplates the Shabad, and accepts it.
lines.transliteration: anhad sun  maani-aa sabad  veechaaree.

lines.english: Understanding itself, this soul becomes attuned to the Formless Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aatam cheeneh bh a-ay nirankaaree. ||7||

lines.english: This mind becomes immaculately pure, in the Court and the Home of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih man nirmal dar gh ar so-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh shows his love through loving devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat bhaa-o Dh un ho-ee.

lines.english: Night and day, by Guru's Grace, sing the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: ahinis har jas gur parsaad.

lines.english: God dwells in each and every heart, since the very beginning of time, and throughoutthe ages. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at so parabh  aad jugaad . ||8||

lines.english: This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in ih man maat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes the essence of totality.
lines.transliteration: sarab rasaa-in gurmukh  jaataa.

lines.english: For the sake of devotional worship, he dwells at the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  hayt gur charan  nivaasaa.

lines.english: Nanak is the humble servant of the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||9||8|| pMnw 416 Awsw mhlw 1 ] (416-1) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jan kay daasan d aasaa. ||9||8||

lines.english: When the body perishes, whose wealth is it?
lines.transliteration: tan binsai Dh an kaa ko kahee-ai.

lines.english: Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?
lines.transliteration: bin gur raam naam kat lahee-ai.

lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is my Companion and Helper.
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan sang sakh aa-ee.

lines.english: Night and day, center your loving attention on the Immaculate Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ahinis nirmal har liv laa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, who is ours?
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin kavan hamaaraa.

lines.english: I look upon pleasure and pain alike; I shall not forsake the Naam, the Name of theLord. The Lord Himself forgives me, and blends me with Himself. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh sam kar naam na chh oda-o aapay bakh as milaavan haaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The fool loves gold and women.
lines.transliteration: kanik kaamnee hayt gavaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Attached to duality, he has forgotten the Naam.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa laagay naam visaaraa.

lines.english: O Lord, he alone chants the Naam, whom You have forgiven.
lines.transliteration: jis tooN bakh sahi naam japaa-ay.

lines.english: Death cannot touch one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: doot na laag sakai gun gaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver; the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: har gur daat aa raam gupaalaa.

lines.english: If it is pleasing to Your Will, please preserve me, O Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  da-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਿਗ  ਸਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, my mind is pleased with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam mayrai man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: My diseases are cured, and my pains are taken away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: rog mitay dukh  thaak rahaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: There is no other medicine, Tantric charm or mantra.
lines.transliteration: avar na a-ukhaDh  tant na mannt aa.

lines.english: Meditative remembrance upon the Lord, Har, Har, destroys sins.
lines.transliteration: har har simran kilvikh  hantaa.

lines.english: You Yourself cause us to stray from the path, and forget the Naam.
lines.transliteration: tooN aap bh ulaaveh naam visaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
lines.english: Showering Your Mercy, You Yourself save us. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay raakh ahi kirpaa Dh aar. ||4||

lines.english: The mind is diseased with doubt, superstition and duality.
lines.transliteration: rog bharam bh ayd man d oojaa.

lines.english: Without the Guru, it dwells in doubt, and contemplates duality.
lines.transliteration: gur bin bharam jaapeh jap d oojaa.

lines.english: The Guru reveals the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  gur d aras na d aykheh.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, what use is human life? ||5||
lines.transliteration: vin gur sabd ai janam ke laykh eh. ||5||

lines.english: Beholding the Marvellous Lord, I am wonder-struck and astonished.
lines.transliteration: daykh  achraj rahay bismaad .

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ  ਨ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, of the angels and holy men, He dwells in celestial Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at sur nar sahj samaaDh .

lines.english: I have enshrined the All-pervading Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: bharipur Dh aar rahay man maahee.

lines.english: There is no one else equal to You. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tum samsar avar ko naahee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ॥
lines.english: For the sake of devotional worship, we chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee bhagat  hayt mukh  naam.

lines.english: The Lord's devotees dwell in the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant bh agat kee sangat  raam.

lines.english: Breaking his bonds, one comes to meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t oray sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੇਤੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are emancipated, by the Guru-given knowledge of the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: chhootai gurmukh  har gur gi-aan. ||7||

lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot touch him with pain;
lines.transliteration: naa jamdoot  dookh tis laagai.
jo jan raam naam liv jaagai. the Lord's humble servant remains awake to the Love of the Naam.

lines.english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells with His devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al bhagtaa har sang.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are liberated, through the Love of the Lord. ||8||9|| Awsw mhlw 1 iekqukI ] (416-13) aasaa mehlaa 1 iktukee. Aasaa, First Mehl, Ik-Tukee:
lines.transliteration: naanak mukat bh a-ay har rang. ||8||9||

lines.english: One who serves the Guru, knows his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvay so thaakur jaanai.

lines.english: His pains are erased, and he realizes the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dookh  mitai sach sabad  pachh aanai. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, O my friends and companions.
lines.transliteration: raam japahu mayree sakhee sakh ainee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, you shall behold God with your eyes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv d aykhhu parabh  nainee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: People are entangled with mother, father and the world.
lines.transliteration: banDhan maat  pitaa sansaar.

lines.english: They are entangled with sons, daughters and spouses. ||2||
lines.transliteration: banDhan sut  kanniaa ar naar. ||2||

lines.english: They are entangled with religious rituals, and religious faith, acting in ego.
lines.transliteration: banDhan karam Dh aram ha-o kee-aa.

lines.english: They are entangled with sons, wives and others in their minds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: banDhan put  kalat  man bee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The farmers are entangled by farming.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kirkh ee karahi kirsaan.

lines.english: People suffer punishment in ego, and the Lord King exacts the penalty from them. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai dann sahai raajaa mangai daan. ||4||

lines.english: They are entangled in trade without contemplation.
lines.transliteration: banDhan sa-ud aa an veechaaree.

lines.english: They are not satisfied by attachment to the expanse of Maya. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tipat naahee maa-i-aa moh pasaaree. ||5||

lines.english: They are entangled with that wealth, amassed by bankers.
lines.transliteration: banDhan saah saNcheh Dh an jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without devotion to the Lord, they do not become acceptable. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagat  na pav-ee thaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਡੰਨੁ ਸਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They are entangled with the Vedas, religious discussions and egotism.
lines.transliteration: banDhan bayd  baad  ahaNkaar.

lines.english: They are entangled, and perish in attachment and corruption. ||7||
lines.transliteration: banDhan binsai moh vikaar. ||7||

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam sarnaa-ee.

lines.english: One who is saved by the True Guru, does not suffer entanglement. ||8||10|| pMnw 417 rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 AstpdIAw Gru 3  (417-1) raag aasaa mehlaa 1 asatpadee-aa gh ar 3 Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtapadees, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (417-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: satgur raakh ay banDh  na paa-ee. ||8||10||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Those heads adorned with braided hair, with their parts painted with vermillion
lines.transliteration: jin sir sohan patee-aa maaNgee paa-ay sanDhoor.
say sir kaatee munnee-aniH gal vich aavai Dh oorh. - those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਿਸਰ ਕਾਤੀ  ਮੁੰਨੀਅਿਨ  ਗਲ ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਵੈ  ਧੂਿੜ ॥
lines.english: They lived in palatial mansions, but now, they cannot even sit near the palaces. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mehlaa andar hod ee-aa hun  bahan  na milniH hadoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਹੋਦੀਆ  ਹੁਿਣ ਬਹਿਣ  ਨ ਿਮਲਿਨ  ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hail to You, O Father Lord, Hail to You!
lines.transliteration: aadays baabaa aad ays.

lines.english: O Primal Lord. Your limits are not known; You create, and create, and behold the scenes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  tayraa ant  na paa-i-aa kar kar d aykheh vays. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਵੇਸ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When they were married, their husbands looked so handsome beside them.
lines.transliteration: jadahu see-aa vee-aahee-aa laarh ay sohan paas.

lines.english: They came in palanquins, decorated with ivory;
lines.transliteration: heedolee charh aa-ee-aa d and khand keet ay raas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਦਹੁ ਸੀਆ  ਵੀਆਹੀਆ  ਲਾੜੇ  ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.transliteration: uprahu paanee vaaree-ai jh alay jh imkan paas. ||2|| water was sprinkled over their heads, and glittering fans were waved above them.||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਡੋਲੀ  ਚਿੜ ਆਈਆ  ਦੰਦ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਤੇ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: They were given hundreds of thousands of coins when they sat, and hundreds of thousands of coins when they stood.
lines.transliteration: ik lakh lehniH behth ee-aa lakh  lehniH kharhee-aa.

lines.english: They ate coconuts and dates, and rested comfortably upon their beds.
lines.transliteration: garee chhuhaaray kh aaNdee-aa maan niH sayjrh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਿਨ ਬਿਹਠੀਆ  ਲਖੁ ਲਹਿਨ  ਖੜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: But ropes were put around their necks, and their strings of pearls were broken. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tinH gal silkaa paa-ee-aa t utniH motsaree-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Dhan joban d u-ay vairee ho-ay jinHee rakh ay rang laa-ay. Their wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them so much pleasure, have nowbecome their enemies.
The order was given to the soldiers, who dishonored them, and carried them away.
lines.transliteration: dootaa no furmaa-i-aa lai chalay pat  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਵੈਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਿਜਨੀ  ਰਖੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If it is pleasing to God's Will, He bestows greatness; if is pleases His Will, He bestowspunishment. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jay tis bh aavai d ay vadi-aa-ee jay bh aavai d ay-ay sajaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਤਾ  ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If someone focuses on the Lord beforehand, then why should he be punished?
lines.transliteration: ago day jay chayt ee-ai t aaN kaa-it  milai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The kings had lost their higher consciousness, reveling in pleasure and sensuality.
lines.transliteration: saahaaN surat gavaa-ee-aa rang t amaasai chaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੋ  ਦੇ ਜੇ ਚੇਤੀਐ  ਤ ਕਾਇਤੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Since Baabar's rule has been proclaimed, even the princes have no food to eat. ||5||
lines.transliteration: baabarvaanee fir ga-ee ku-ir na rotee kh aa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਗਵਾਈਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਤਮਾਸੈ  ਚਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Muslims have lost their five times of daily prayer, and the Hindus have lost their worship as well.
lines.transliteration: iknaa vakhat  khu-aa-ee-ah iknHaa poojaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਰਵਾਣੀ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਗਈ ਕੁਇਰੁ ਨ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Without their sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women bathe and apply the frontalmarks to their foreheads?
lines.transliteration: cha-ukay vin hind vaanee-aa ki-o tikay kadh eh naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਵਖਤ  ਖੁਆਈਅਿਹ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They never remembered their Lord as Raam, and now they cannot even chantKhudaa-i||6||
lines.transliteration: raam na kabhoo chayti-o hun  kahan  na milai kh udaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: Some have returned to their homes, and meeting their relatives, they ask about theirsafety.
lines.transliteration: ik ghar aavahi aapn ai ik mil mil puchh eh sukh .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਹੁਿਣ ਕਹਿਣ  ਨ ਿਮਲੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: For some, it is pre-ordained that they shall sit and cry out in pain.
lines.transliteration: iknHaa ayho likhi-aa bahi bahi roveh d ukh.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਇਿਕ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪੁਛਿਹ ਸੁਖ ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass. O Nanak, what is the fate of mankind?||7||11|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (417-13) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai naanak ki-aa maanukh . ||7||11||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਏਹੋ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਬਿਹ ਬਿਹ ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ॥
lines.english: Where are the games, the stables, the horses? Where are the drums and the bugles?
lines.transliteration: kahaa so khayl t abaylaa gh orhay kahaa bh ayree sehnaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਆ  ਮਾਨੁਖ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Where are the sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?
