lines.transliteration: kahaa so taygband  gaadayrarh  kahaa so laal kavaa-ee.

lines.english: Where are the rings and the beautiful faces? They are no longer to be seen here. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahaa so aarsee-aa muh bankay aithai diseh naahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਤਬੇਲਾ  ਘੋੜੇ ਕਹਾ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਹਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This world is Yours; You are the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ih jag tayraa t oo gosaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ  ਗਾਡੇਰਿੜ  ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਲਾਲ  ਕਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. You distribute wealth as it pleases You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk gharh ee meh thaap uthaapay jar vand d ayvai bh aaN-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਆਰਸੀਆ  ਮੁਹ ਬੰਕੇ ਐਥੈ ਿਦਸਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where are the houses, the gates, the hotels and palaces? Where are those beautifulway-stations?
lines.transliteration: kahaaN so ghar d ar mandap mehlaa kahaa so bank saraa-ee.

lines.english: Where are those beautiful women, reclining on their beds, whose beauty would notallow one to sleep?
lines.transliteration: kahaaN so sayj sukhaalee kaaman  jis vaykh  need  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪੇ  ਜਰੁ ਵੰਿਡ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where are those betel leaves, their sellers, and the haremees? They have vanishedlike shadows. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kahaa so paan tambolee harmaa ho-ee-aa chh aa-ee maa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: For the sake of this wealth, so many were ruined; because of this wealth, so manyhave been disgraced.
lines.transliteration: is jar kaaran gh anee vigut ee in jar gh anee kh u-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹ ਸੁ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਮੰਡਪ  ਮਹਲਾ  ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਬੰਕ ਸਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: It was not gathered without sin, and it does not go along with the dead.
lines.transliteration: paapaa baajhahu hovai naahee mu-i-aa saath na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹ ਸੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਜਸੁ ਵੇਿਖ ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those, whom the Creator Lord would destroy - first He strips them of virtue. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis no aap khu-aa-ay kart aa kh us la-ay changi-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ  ਹਰਮਾ  ਹੋਈਆ  ਛਾਈ  ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Millions of religious leaders failed to halt the invader, when they heard of the Emperor's invasion. pMnw 418
lines.transliteration: kotee hoo peer varaj rahaa-ay jaa meer suni-aa Dh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He burned the rest-houses and the ancient temples; he cut the princes limb from limb, and cast them into the dust.
lines.transliteration: thaan mukaam jalay bij mandar muchh  muchh  ku-ir rulaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਮੁਕਾਮ  ਜਲੇ ਿਬਜ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮੁਿਛ ਮੁਿਛ ਕੁਇਰ  ਰੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: None of the Mugals went blind, and no one performed any miracle. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee mugal na ho-aa anDhaa kinai na parchaa laa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਮੁਗਲੁ  ਨ ਹੋਆ  ਅੰਧਾ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਰਚਾ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The battle raged between the Mugals and the Pat'haans, and the swords clashed onthe battlefield.
lines.transliteration: mugal pathaan aa bh a-ee larh aa-ee ran  meh t ayg vagaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਗਲ  ਪਠਾਣਾ  ਭਈ ਲੜਾਈ  ਰਣ ਮਿਹ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They took aim and fired their guns, and they attacked with their elephants.
lines.transliteration: onHee tupak t aan chalaa-ee onHee hasat  chirh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨੀ  ਤੁਪਕ  ਤਾਿਣ ਚਲਾਈ  ਓਨੀ  ਹਸਿਤ  ਿਚੜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those men whose letters were torn in the Lord's Court, were destined to die, OSiblings of Destiny. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jinH kee cheeree dargeh paatee t inHaa marn aa bh aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੀ ਚੀਰੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਟੀ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਭਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Hindu women, the Muslim women, the Bhattis and the Rajputs
lines.transliteration: ik hindvaan ee avar t urkaan ee bh ati-aan ee thakuraan ee.
iknHaa payran sir kh ur paatay iknHaa vaas masaan ee. - some had their robes torn away, from head to foot, while others came to dwell inthe cremation ground.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਪੇਰਣ  ਿਸਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਾਟੇ ਇਕਨਾ  ਵਾਸੁ ਮਸਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Their husbands did not return home - how did they pass their night? ||6||
lines.transliteration: jinH kay bankay gharee na aa-i-aa t inH ki-o rain  vihaan ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਘਰੀ  ਨ ਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਕਉ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act. Unto whom should we complain?
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa kis no aakh  sunaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will; unto whom should we go and cry?
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  tayrai bh aanai hovai kis thai jaa-ay roo-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਕਸ ਥੈ ਜਾਇ  ਰੂਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Commander issues His Command, and is pleased. O Nanak, we receive what is written in our destiny. ||7||12|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (418-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw kwPI mhlw 1 Gru 8 AstpdIAw ] (418-7) aasaa kaafee mehlaa 1 ghar 8 asatpad ee-aa. Aasaa, Kaafee, First Mehl, Eighth House, Ashtapadees:
lines.transliteration: hukmee hukam chalaa-ay vigsai naanak likhi-aa paa-ee-ai. ||7||12||

lines.english: As the shepherd is in the field for only a short time, so is one in the world.
lines.transliteration: jaisay go-il go-ilee taisay sansaaraa.

lines.english: Practicing falsehood, they build their homes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: koorh kamaaveh aad mee baaNDheh gh ar baaraa. ||1||

lines.english: Wake up! Wake up! O sleepers, see that the travelling merchant is leaving.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaagahu jaagahu sootiho chali-aa van jaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Go ahead and build your houses, if you think you will stay here forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: neet neet  ghar baaNDhee-ah jay rahn aa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਆਦਮੀ  ਬਧਿਹ  ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The body shall fall, and the soul shall depart; if only they knew this. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pind pavai jee-o chalsee jay jaanai ko-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Why do you cry out and mourn for the dead? The Lord is, and shall always be.
lines.transliteration: ohee ohee ki-aa karahu hai hosee so-ee.

lines.english: You mourn for that person, but who will mourn for you? ||3||
lines.transliteration: tum rovhugay os no t umH ka-o ka-un  ro-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਤ  ਨੀਤ  ਘਰ ਬਧੀਅਿਹ  ਜੇ ਰਹਣਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa pitihu bh aa-eeho t umH koorh  kamaavahu. You are engrossed in worldly entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny, and you arepracticing falsehood.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ਚਲਸੀ  ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The dead person does not hear anything at all; your cries are heard only by otherpeople. ||4||
lines.transliteration: oh na sun-ee kat  hee t umH lok sun avhu. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੀ ਓਹੀ ਿਕਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Only the Lord, who causes the mortal to sleep, O Nanak, can awaken him again.
lines.transliteration: jis tay sut aa naankaa jaagaa-ay so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਰੋਵਹੁਗੇ ਓਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਕਉਣੁ  ਰੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who understands his true home, does not sleep. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jay ghar boojh ai aapn aa taaN need  na ho-ee. ||5||

lines.english: If the departing mortal can take his wealth with him,
lines.transliteration: jay chaldaa lai chali-aa kichh  sampai naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ  ਕਤ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: taa Dh an sanchahu d aykh kai boojh hu beechaaray. ||6|| then go ahead and gather wealth yourself. See this, reflect upon it, and understand.

lines.english: Make your deals, and obtain the true merchandise, or else you shall regret it later.
lines.transliteration: vanaj karahu makh sood laihu mat  pachh otaavahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ  ਤ ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Abandon your vices, and practice virtue, and you shall obtain the essence of reality.||7||
lines.transliteration: a-ugan chh odahu gun  karahu aisay t at paraavahu. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਚਲਦਾ  ਲੈ ਚਿਲਆ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam bh oom sat  beej kar aisee kiras kamaavahu. Plant the seed of Truth in the soil of Dharmic faith, and practice such farming.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Only then will you be known as a merchant, if you take your profits with you. ||8||
lines.transliteration: taaN vaapaaree jaan ee-ahu laahaa lai jaavhu. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ  ਲੈਹੁ ਮਤ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: If the Lord shows His Mercy, one meets the True Guru; contemplating Him, onecomes to understand.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai satgur milai boojh ai beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗਣ  ਛੋਡਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਹੁ ਐਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਾਵਹੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Then, one chants the Naam, hears the Naam, and deals only in the Naam. ||9||
lines.transliteration: naam vakhaan ai sun ay naam naamay bi-uhaaraa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮੁ  ਭੂਿਮ ਸਤੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਿਰ ਐਸੀ  ਿਕਰਸ  ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: As is the profit, so is the loss; this is the way of the world.
lines.transliteration: ji-o laahaa totaa t ivai vaat chald ee aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਜਾਣੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases His Will, O Nanak, is glory for me. ||10||13|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (418-16) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai naankaa saa-ee vadi-aa-ee. ||10||13||

lines.english: I have searched in the four directions, but no one is mine.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa dhoodh ee-aa ko neemHee maidaa.

lines.english: If it pleases You, O Lord Master, then You are mine, and I am Yours. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jay tuDh  bhaavai saahibaa t oo mai ha-o t aidaa. ||1||

lines.english: There is no other door for me; where shall I go to worship?
lines.transliteration: dar beebh aa mai neemiH ko kai karee salaam.

lines.english: You are my only Lord; Your True Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hiko maidaa too Dh anee saachaa mukh  naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some serve the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, and some serve spiritualteachers; they beg for wealth and miraculous powers.
lines.transliteration: siDhaa sayvan siDh  peer maageh riDh  siDh.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂਢੀਆ  ਕੋ ਨੀਮੀ  ਮੈਡਾ ॥
lines.english: May I never forget the Naam, the Name of the One Lord. This is the wisdom of the True Guru. ||2|| pMnw 419
lines.transliteration: mai ik naam na veesrai saachay gur buDh. ||2||

lines.english: Why do the Yogis, the revellers, and the beggars wander in foreign lands?
lines.transliteration: jogee bhogee kaaprh ee ki-aa bh aveh disant ar.

lines.english: They do not understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the essence of excellence within them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheenhee t at saar nirant ar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨਹੀ  ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਿਨਰੰਤਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, the teachers and astrologers, and those whoendlessly read the Puraanas,
lines.transliteration: pandit paaDh ay jo-isee nit  parheh puraan aa.
antar vasat  na jaan anHee gh at barahm lukaan aa. ||4|| do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਲੁਕਾਣਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacredshrines.
lines.transliteration: ik tapsee ban meh t ap karahi nit  tirath vaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ ਤਪਸੀ  ਬਨ ਮਿਹ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਨਤ ਤੀਰਥ  ਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The unenlightened people do not understand themselves - why have they becomerenunciates? ||5||
lines.transliteration: aap na cheeneh taamsee kaahay bh a-ay ud aasaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨਿਹ  ਤਾਮਸੀ  ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Some control their sexual energy, and are known as celibates.
lines.transliteration: ik bind jat an kar raakh -day say jat ee kahaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ ਿਬੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖਦੇ  ਸੇ ਜਤੀ  ਕਹਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: But without the Guru's Word, they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation.||6||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad na chh oothee bh aram aavahi jaaveh. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਦ  ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Some are householders, servants, and seekers, attached to the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: ik girhee sayvak saaDhikaa gurmat ee laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਾਿਧਕਾ  ਗੁ ਰਮਤੀ  ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: They hold fast to the Naam, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam daan isnaan d arirh har bh agat so jaagay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, the Gate of the Lord's Home is found, and that place is recognized.
lines.transliteration: gur tay d ar ghar jaan ee-ai so jaa-ay sinj aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਸੋ ਜਾਇ  ਿਸਞਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak does not forget the Naam; his mind has surrendered to the True Lord.||8||14|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (419-6) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai saachay man maanai. ||8||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Stilling the desires of the mind, the mortal truly crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maneh samaa-ilay bha-ojal sach t arnaa.

lines.english: In the very beginning, and throughout the ages, You have been the Merciful Lord andMaster; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  da-i-aal t oo thaakur t ayree sarn aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਲੇ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਸਿਚ ਤਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver, and I am a mere beggar. Lord, please grant me the Blessed Visionof Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: too daatou ham jaachikaa har d arsan d eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; the temple of his mind resounds with joy.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai man mand ar bheejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ  ਹਮ ਜਾਿਚਕਾ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing false greed, one comes to realize the Truth.
lines.transliteration: koorhaa laalach chh odee-ai t a-o saach pachh aanai.

lines.english: So let yourself be absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and know this supreme realization. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad samaa-ee-ai parmaarath jaan ai. ||2||

lines.english: This mind is a greedy king, engrossed in greed.
lines.transliteration: ih man raajaa lobhee-aa lubh -ta-o lobh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ  ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh eliminates his greed, and comes to an understanding with the Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh lobh  nivaaree-ai har si-o ban  aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Planting the seeds in the rocky soil, how can one reap a profit?
lines.transliteration: kalar khayt ee beejee-ai ki-o laahaa paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ  ਲੁਭਤਉ  ਲੋਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is not pleased with Truth; the false are buried in falsehood.||4||
lines.transliteration: manmukh sach na bh eej-ee koorh  koorh  gadaavai. ||4||

lines.english: So renounce greed - you are blind! Greed only brings pain.
lines.transliteration: laalach chhodahu anDh iho laalach d ukh bhaaree.

lines.english: When the True Lord dwells within the mind, the poisonous ego is conquered. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saachou saahib man vasai ha-umai bikh maaree. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਸਿਚ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂਿੜ ਗਡਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Renounce the evil way of duality, or you shall be plundered, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa chh od kuvaatarh ee mooshugay bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚੁ  ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਿਧਹੋ  ਲਾਲਿਚ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, praise the Naam, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru's protection. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam salaahee-ai satgur sarn aa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone. His life is cursed and useless.
lines.transliteration: manmukh pathar sail hai Dh arig jeevan  feekaa.

lines.english: No matter now long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry at its core. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jal meh kaytaa raakh ee-ai abh  antar sookaa. ||7||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the Perfect Guru has given it to me.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam niDhaan hai poorai gur d ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਫੀਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||15|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (419-15) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai math amrit pee-aa. ||8||15||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਕੇਤਾ  ਰਾਖੀਐ  ਅਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The travellers travel from one road to another.
lines.transliteration: chalay chalanhaar vaat vataa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: DhanDh  pitay sansaar sach na bh aa-i-aa. ||1|| The world is engrossed in its entanglements, and does not appreciate the Truth. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਮਿਥ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆ  ॥੮॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Why wander around, and why go searching, when the Guru's Shabad reveals Him tous?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa bhavee-ai ki-aa dh oodhee-ai gur sabad  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Leaving behind egotism and attachment, I have arrived at my own home. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mamtaa moh visarji-aa apnai gh ar aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through Truth, one meets the True One; He is not obtained through falsehood.
lines.transliteration: sach milai sachiaar koorh na paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Centering your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sachay si-o chit laa-ay bahurh  na aa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.
lines.transliteration: mo-i-aa ka-o ki-aa rovhu ro-ay na jaanhoo.

lines.english: Weep by praising the True Lord, and recognize His Command. ||3||
lines.transliteration: rovhu sach salaahi hukam pachhaan hoo. ||3||

lines.english: Blessed is the birth of one who is destined to abide by the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: hukmee vajahu likhaa-ay aa-i-aa jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: He obtains the true profit, realizing the Lord's Command. ||4|| pMnw 420
lines.transliteration: laahaa palai paa-ay hukam sinjaan ee-ai. ||4||

lines.english: If it pleases the Commander, one goes to His Court, robed in honor.
lines.transliteration: hukmee paiDhaa jaa-ay d argeh bh aanee-ai.

lines.english: By His Command, God's slaves are hit over the head. ||5||
lines.transliteration: hukmay hee sir maar band rabaan ee-ai. ||5||

lines.english: The profit is earned by enshrining Truth and justice in the mind.
lines.transliteration: laahaa sach ni-aa-o man vasaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: They obtain what is written in their destiny, and overcome pride. ||6||
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa palai paa-ay garab vanj aa-ee-ai. ||6||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are hit over the head, and consumed by conflict.
lines.transliteration: manmukhee-aa sir maar vaad  khapaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The cheaters are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ||7||
lines.transliteration: thag muth ee koorh i-aar baneh chalaa-ee-ai. ||7||

lines.english: Enshrine the Lord Master in your mind, and you shall not have to repent.
lines.transliteration: saahib ridai vasaa-ay na pachh otaavhee.

lines.english: He forgives our sins, when we practice the Teachings of the Guru's Word. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gunhaaN bakhsan haar sabad  kamaavahee. ||8||

lines.english: Nanak begs for the True Name, which is obtained by the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai sach gurmukh gh aalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace.||9||16|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (420-5) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mai tujh  bin avar na ko-ay nad ar nihaalee-ai. ||9||16||

lines.english: Why should I go searching in the forests, when the woods of my home are so green?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jangal dhoodh ee jaa-ay mai gh ar ban haree-aavlaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਜੰਗਲੁ  ਢੂਢੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਮੈ ਘਿਰ  ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Word of the Shabad has instantaneously come and settled in my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach tikai ghar aa-ay sabad  utaavalaa. ||1||

lines.english: Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah so-ay avar na jaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Working for the Guru, one realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaa-ay mahal pachhaan ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Lord blends us with Himself, when it is pleasing to His Mind.
lines.transliteration: aap milaavai sach taa man bh aav-ee.

lines.english: One who ever walks in accordance with His Will, merges into His Being. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chalai sadaa rajaa-ay ank samaava-ee. ||2||

lines.english: When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind flourishes.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib man vasai vasi-aa man so-ee.

lines.english: He Himself grants greatness; His Gifts are never exhausted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay day vad i-aa-ee-aa d ay tot na ho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Serving this and that person, how can one obtain the Lord's Court?
lines.transliteration: abay tabay kee chaakree ki-o d argeh paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||
lines.transliteration: pathar kee bayrhee jay charh ai bhar naal budaavai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: So offer your mind, and surrender your head with it.
lines.transliteration: aapnarhaa man vaychee-ai sir d eejai naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਥਰ  ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਜੇ ਚੜੈ ਭਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਬੁਡਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes the true essence, and finds the home of his own self. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vasat  pachh aanee-ai apnaa gh ar bhaalay. ||5||

lines.english: People discuss birth and death; the Creator created this.
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa aakh ee-ai t in kart ai kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who conquer their selfhood and remain dead, shall never have to die again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-i-aa mar rahay fir maran na thee-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Do those deeds which the Primal Lord has ordered for you.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee kaar kamaavnee Dh ur kee furmaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਮਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਥੀਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value?||7||
lines.transliteration: jay man satgur d ay milai kin keemat  paa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That Lord Master is the Assayer of the jewel of the mind; He places the value on it.
lines.transliteration: ratnaa paarakh  so Dh anee tin keemat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਕਿਨ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, True is the Glory of that one, in whose mind the Lord Master dwells.||8||17|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (420-13) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachee vadi-aa-ee. ||8||17||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨਾ  ਪਾਰਖੁ  ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਿਤਿਨ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deluded by doubt and duality.
lines.transliteration: jinHee naam visaari-aa doojai bh aram bh ulaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੮॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those who abandon the roots and cling to the branches, shall obtain only ashes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mool chhod daalee lagay ki-aa paavahi chh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Name, how can one be emancipated? Who knows this?
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ki-o chhootee-ai jay jaan ai ko-ee.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh is emancipated; the self-willed manmukhs lose theirhonor. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay t a chh ootee-ai manmukh  pat kho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਡਾਲੀ  ਲਗੇ ਿਕਆ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਛਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who serve the One Lord become perfect in their understanding, O Siblings ofDestiny.
lines.transliteration: jinHee ayko sayvi-aa pooree mat bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord's humble servant finds Sanctuary in Him, the Immaculate One, from the verybeginning, and throughout the ages. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  niranjanaa jan har sarn aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: saahib mayraa ayk hai avar nahee bhaa-ee.

lines.english: By the Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa tay sukh  paa-i-aa saachay parthaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, although many may claim to have doneso.
lines.transliteration: gur bin kinai na paa-i-o kaytee kahai kahaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself reveals the Way, and implants true devotion within. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aap dikh aavai vaatrh eeN sachee bh agat drirh -aa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Even if the self-willed manmukh is instructed, he stills goes into the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: manmukh jay samjaa-ee-ai bh ee ujh arh jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be emancipated; he shall die, and sink into hell. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na chhootsee mar narak samaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਕੇਤੀ  ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He wanders through birth and death, and never chants the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: janam marai bharmaa-ee-ai har naam na layvai.

lines.english: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6|| pMnw 421
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  naa pavai bin gur kee sayvai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈਐ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਭੀ ਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever service the Lord causes us to do, that is just what we do.
lines.transliteration: jayhee sayv karaa-ee-ai karnee bh ee saa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself acts; who else should be mentioned? He beholds His own greatness. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhee-ai vaykh ai vadi-aa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He alone serves the Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa so karay jis aap karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, offering his head, one is emancipated, and honored in the Court of the Lord.||8||18|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (421-2) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sir day chh ootee-ai d argeh pat  paa-ay. ||8||18||

lines.english: Beautiful is the Supreme Lord and Master, and beautiful is the Word of the Guru'sBani.
lines.transliteration: roorho th aakur maahro roorh ee gurbaan ee.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and the supreme status ofNirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag sat gur milai paa-ee-ai pad  nirbaan ee. ||1||

lines.english: I am the lowest slave of Your slaves; I am Your most humble servant.
lines.transliteration: mai olHgee-aa olHgee ham chhoroo thaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਓਲਗੀਆ  ਓਲਗੀ ਹਮ ਛੋਰੂ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: As You keep me, I live. Your Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o tooN raakh ahi ti-o rahaa mukh  naam hamaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਰਹਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind acceptsYour Will, and so You are pleased with me.
lines.transliteration: darsan kee pi-aasaa gh anee bh aanai man bh aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Greatness is in the Hands of my Lord and Master; by His Will, honor is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur haath vad i-aa-ee-aa bh aanai pat  paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਿਪਆਸਾ  ਘਣੀ  ਭਾਣੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Do not think that the True Lord is far away; He is deep within.
lines.transliteration: saacha-o door na jaan ee-ai ant ar hai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਭਾਣੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I find Him pervading; how can I estimate His value? ||3||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah rav rahay kin keemat  ho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਉ  ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself does, and He Himself undoes. He Himself beholds His glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: aap karay aapay haray vaykhai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਿਕਿਨ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Becoming Gurmukh, one beholds Him, and so, His value is appraised. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay nihaalee-ai i-o keemat  paa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ  ਹਰੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: So earn your profits while you are alive, by serving the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jeevdi-aa laahaa milai gur kaar kamaavai.

lines.english: If it is so pre-ordained, then one finds the True Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: poorab hovai likhi-aa t aa sat gur paavai. ||5||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs continually lose, and wander around, deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: manmukh t otaa nit  hai bh armeh bh armaa-ay.

lines.english: The blind manmukhs do not remember the Lord; how can they obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan? ||6||
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  na chayt -ee ki-o d arsan paa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: One's coming into the world is judged worthwhile only if one lovingly attunes oneselfto the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: taa jag aa-i-aa jaan ee-ai saachai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ  ਿਕਉ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, one becomes invaluable; his light merges into the Light. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur bhaytay paaras bh a-ay jot ee jot  milaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਜਿਗ  ਆਇਆ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਸਾਚੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, he remains detached, and serves the Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: ahinis rahai niraalmo kaar Dhur kee karn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਭਏ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet, are content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||19|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (421-10) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam santokh ee-aa raat ay har charn ee. ||8||19||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ ਰਹੈ ਿਨਰਾਲਮੋ  ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: No matter how much one may describe the Lord, His limits still cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: kaytaa aakh an aakh ee-ai t aa kay ant  na jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ  ਰਾਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ॥੮॥੧੯॥
lines.english: I am without any support; You, O Lord, are my only Support; You are my almightypower. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mai niDhri-aa Dh ar ayk t ooN mai t aan sataanaa. ||1||

lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer, that he may be adorned with the True Name.
lines.transliteration: naanak kee ardaas hai sach naam suhaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤਾ  ਆਖਣੁ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: When self-conceit is eradicated, and understanding is obtained, one meets the Lord,through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap ga-i-aa sojhee pa-ee gur sabd ee maylaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਿਨਧਿਰਆ  ਧਰ ਏਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ  ਸਤਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Abandoning egotism and pride, one obtains contemplative understanding.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai garab gavaa-ee-ai paa-ee-ai veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਸਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the mind surrenders to the Lord Master, He bestows the support of the Truth.||2||
lines.transliteration: saahib si-o man maani-aa day saach aDh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮੇਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Day and night, remain content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; that is the trueservice.
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam santokh ee-aa sayvaa sach saa-ee.

lines.english: No misfortune troubles one who follows the Command of the Lord's Will. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o bigh an na laag-ee chaalai hukam rajaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: One who follows the Command of the Lord's Will is taken into the Lord's Treasury.
lines.transliteration: hukam rajaa-ee jo chalai so pavai khajaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The counterfeit find no place there; they are mixed with the false ones. ||4||
lines.transliteration: khotay th avar na paa-inee ralay jooth aanai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, the genuine coins are treasured; with them, the true merchandise is purchased.
lines.transliteration: nit nit  kharaa samaalee-ai sach sa-ud aa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ  ਚਾਲੈ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਰਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The false ones are not seen in the Lord's Treasury; they are seized and cast into thefire again. ||5||
lines.transliteration: khotay nad ar na aavnee lay agan jalaa-ee-ai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਿਮ ਰਜਾਈ  ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who understand their own souls, are themselves the Supreme Soul.
lines.transliteration: jinee aatam cheeni-aa parmaat am so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਵਰ  ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ  ਰਲੇ ਜੂਠਾਨੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the tree of ambrosial nectar, which bears the ambrosial fruit. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ayko amrit birakh  hai fal amrit  ho-ee. ||6||

lines.english: Those who taste the ambrosial fruit remain satisfied with Truth.
lines.transliteration: amrit fal jinee chaakh i-aa sach rahay agh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਨੀ  ਲੇ ਅਗਿਨ  ਜਲਾਈਐ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They have no doubt or sense of separation - their tongues taste the divine taste. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tinnaa bh aram na bh ayd hai har rasan rasaa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: By His Command, and through your past actions, you came into the world; walk forever according to His Will.
lines.transliteration: hukam sanjogee aa-i-aa chal sadaa rajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Please, grant virtue to Nanak, the virtueless one; bless him with the gloriousgreatness of the Truth. ||8||20|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (421-19) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: a-ogani-aaray ka-o gun  naankai sach milai vadaa-ee. ||8||20||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਸਿਚ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Name speaks the truth.
lines.transliteration: man raata-o har naa-ay sach vakh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤੰਨਾ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: What would the people lose, if I became pleasing to You, O Lord? ||1|| pMnw 422
lines.transliteration: lokaa daa ki-aa jaa-ay jaa t uDh bhaani-aa. ||1||

lines.english: As long as there is the breath of life, meditate on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ja-o lag jee-o paraan sach Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: You shall receive the profit of singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laahaa har gun gaa-ay milai sukh  paa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True is Your Service; bless me with it, O Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachee tayree kaar d eh da-i-aal t ooN.

lines.english: I live by praising You; You are my Anchor and Support. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o jeevaa tuDh  saalaahi mai tayk aDh aar tooN. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ ਦੇਿਹ ਦਇਆਲ  ਤੂੰ ॥
lines.english: I am Your servant, the gate-keeper at Your Gate; You alone know my pain.
lines.transliteration: dar sayvak d arvaan d arad tooN jaanhee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: How wonderful is Your devotional worship! It removes all pains. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  tayree hairaan d arad gavaavhee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਦਰਵਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs know that by chanting the Naam, they shall dwell in His Court, in His Presence.
lines.transliteration: dargeh naam had oor gurmukh  jaansee.

lines.english: True and acceptable is that time, when one recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: vaylaa sach parvaan sabad  pachh aansee. ||4||

lines.english: Those who practice Truth, contentment and love, obtain the supplies of the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh kar bh aa-o t osaa har naam say-ay.

lines.english: So banish corruption from your mind, and the True One will grant you Truth. ||5||
lines.transliteration: manhu chhod vikaar sachaa sach d ay-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਕਿਰ ਭਾਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
lines.english: The True Lord inspires true love in the truthful.
lines.transliteration: sachay sachaa nayhu sachai laa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself administers justice, as it pleases His Will. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay ni-aa-o jo tis bh aa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: True is the gift of the True, Compassionate Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachay sachee daat  deh da-i-aal hai.

lines.english: Day and night, I serve the One whose Name is priceless. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tis sayvee d in raat  naam amol hai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਦੇਿਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: You are so sublime, and I am so lowly, but I am called Your slave.
lines.transliteration: tooN utam ha-o neech sayvak kaaNdhee-aa.

lines.english: Please, shower Nanak with Your Glance of Grace, that he, the separated one, may merge with You again, O Lord. ||8||21|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (422-8) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar karayhu milai sach vaaNdhee-aa. ||8||21||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ  ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਕਢੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: How can coming and going, the cycle of reincarnation be ended? And how can onemeet the Lord?
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa ki-o rahai ki-o maylaa ho-ee.

lines.english: The pain of birth and death is so great, in constant skepticism and duality. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa d ukh ghano nit sahsaa d o-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Name, what is life? Cleverness is detestable and cursed.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ki-aa jeevnaa fit Dharig chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: One who does not serve the Holy True Guru, is not pleased by devotion to the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur saaDh  na sayvi-aa har bh agat na bh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਿਨਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Coming and going is ended only when one finds the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaavan  ta-o rahai paa-ee-ai gur pooraa.

lines.english: He gives the wealth and capital of the Lord's Name, and false doubt is destroyed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan raas d ay-ay binsai bh aram kooraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Joining the humble Saintly beings, let us sing the blessed, blessed Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa ka-o mil rahai Dh an Dh an jas gaa-ay.

lines.english: The Primal Lord, the Infinite, is obtained by the Gurmukh. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  apramparaa gurmukh  har paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਵਣੁ  ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The drama of the world is staged like the show of a buffoon.
lines.transliteration: natoo-ai saaNg banaa-i-aa baajee sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਦੇਇ ਿਬਨਸੈ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: For an instant, for a moment, the show is seen, but it disappears in no time at all.||4||
lines.transliteration: khin pal baajee d aykhee-ai ujh rat nahee baaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The game of chance is played on the board of egotism, with the pieces of falsehoodand ego.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai cha-uparh kh aylnaa jhoothay ahaNkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The whole world loses; he alone wins, who reflects upon the Word of the Guru'sShabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabh jag haarai so jin ai gur sabad  veechaaraa. ||5||

lines.english: As is the cane in the hand of the blind man, so is the Lord's Name for me.
lines.transliteration: ji-o anDhulai hath tohn ee har naam hamaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ  ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਉਝਰਤ  ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my Support, night and day and morning. ||6||
lines.transliteration: raam naam har tayk hai nis da-ut  savaarai. ||6||

lines.english: As You keep me, Lord, I live; the Lord's Name is my only Support.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tooN raakh ahi ti-o rahaa har naam aDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਿਜਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: It is my only comfort in the end; the gate of salvation is found by His humble servants. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ant sakh aa-ee paa-i-aa jan mukat  du-aaraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਿਥ ਟੋਹਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: The pain of birth and death is removed, by chanting and meditating on the Naam, theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh mayti-aa jap naam muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਿਨਿਸ  ਦਉਤ  ਸਵਾਰੈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, is saved by the Perfect Guru. ||8||22|| Awsw mhlw 3 AstpdIAw Gru 2  (422-17) aasaa mehlaa 3 asatpadee-aa gh ar 2 Aasaa, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (422-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai pooraa gur taaray. ||8||22||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਿਤਉ ਰਹਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees are contained in the ocean of Your Name;the River Ganges is held in Your Feet.
lines.transliteration: saasat bayd  simrit  sar tayraa sursaree charan  samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਖਾਈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The intellect can understand the world of the three modes, but You, O Primal Lord,are totally astounding. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saakhaa t een mool mat  raavai t ooN taaN sarab vidaan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖ ਮੇਿਟਆ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on His Feet, and chants the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taa kay charan  japai jan naanak bolay amrit  banee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Three hundred thirty million gods are Your servants. You bestow wealth, and the supernatural powers of the Siddhas; You are the Support of the breath of life. pMnw 423
lines.transliteration: taytees karorh ee daas tumHaaray riDh  siDh paraan  aDhaaree.

lines.english: His beauteous forms cannot be comprehended; what can anyone accomplish by discussing and debating? ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa kay roop na jaahee lakh -nay ki-aa kar aakh  veechaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਲਖਣੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਿਰ ਆਿਖ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Throughout the ages, You are the three qualities, and the four sources of creation.
lines.transliteration: teen gun aa tayray jug hee ant ar chaaray t ayree-aa kh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ ਗੁਣਾ  ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ  ਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: If You show Your Mercy, then one obtains the supreme status, and speaks theUnspoken Speech. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam hovai taa param pad  paa-ee-ai kathay akath kahaan ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Creator; all are created by You. What can any mortal being do?
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa kee-aa sabh  tayraa ki-aa ko karay paraan ee.

lines.english: He alone, upon whom You shower Your Grace, is absorbed into the Truth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o nadar karahi t ooN apnee saa-ee sach samaan ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone who comes and goes chants Your Name.
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa sabh  ko-ee layt  hai jayt ee aavan  jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ  ਸਾਈ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: When it is pleasing to Your Will, then the Gurmukh understands. Otherwise, the self- willed manmukhs wander in ignorance. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaavai t aa gurmukh  boojh ai hor manmukh  firai i-aan ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You gave the four Vedas to Brahma, for him to read and read continually, and reflectupon.
lines.transliteration: chaaray vayd barahmay ka-o d ee-ay parh  parh karay veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਿਫਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The wretched one does not understand His Command, and is reincarnated intoheaven and hell. ||6||
lines.transliteration: taa kaa hukam na boojh ai bapurh aa narak surag avt aaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੇ  ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every age, He creates the kings, who are sung of as His Incarnations.
lines.transliteration: jugah jugah kay raajay kee-ay gaavahi kar avtaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਸੁਰਿਗ  ਅਵਤਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Even they have not found His limits; what can I speak of and contemplate? ||7||
lines.transliteration: tin bh ee ant  na paa-i-aa t aa kaa ki-aa kar aakh  veechaaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗਹ  ਜੁਗਹ  ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਕਿਰ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are True, and all that You do is True. If You bless me with the Truth, I will speakon it.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa t ayraa kee-aa sabh  saachaa d eh ta saach vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਿਰ ਆਿਖ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: One whom You inspire to understand the Truth, is easily absorbed into the Naam.||8||1||23|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (423-8) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o sach bujhaaveh apn aa sehjay naam samaan ee. ||8||1||23||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has dispelled my doubts.
lines.transliteration: satgur hamraa bh aram gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਿਹ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
lines.english: He has enshrined the Immaculate Name of the Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: har naam niranjan man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Focusing on the Word of the Shabad, I have obtained lasting peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabad cheen sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O my mind, to the essence of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sun man mayray t at gi-aan.

lines.english: The Great Giver knows our condition completely; the Gurmukh obtains the treasure ofthe Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dayvan  vaalaa sabh  biDh jaanai gurmukh  paa-ee-ai naam niDh aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The great glory of meeting the True Guru is
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay kee vadi-aa-ee.
jin mamtaa agan t arisnaa bujh aa-ee. that it has quenched the fire of possessiveness and desire;

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਣ  ਵਾਲਾ  ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sehjay maataa har gun  gaa-ee. ||2|| imbued with peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vin gur pooray ko-ay na jaan ee.

lines.english: Attached to Maya, they are engrossed in duality.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi doojai lobh aanee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh receives the Naam, and the Bani of the Lord's Word. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam milai har ban ee. ||3||

lines.english: Service to the Guru is the most excellent and sublime penance of penances.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tapaaN sir tap saar.

lines.english: The Dear Lord dwells in the mind, and all suffering departs.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o man vasai sabh d ookh visaaran haar.

lines.english: Then, at the Gate of the True Lord, one appears truthful. ||4||
lines.transliteration: dar saachai d eesai sachiaar. ||4||

lines.english: Serving the Guru, one comes to know the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay t aribhavan sojhee ho-ay.

lines.english: Understanding his own self, he obtains the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan  har paavai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਵਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of His Bani, we enter the Mansion of His Presence. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saachee banee mahal paraapat  ho-ay. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the Guru, all of one's generations are saved.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sabh  kul uDh aaray.

lines.english: Keep the Immaculate Naam enshrined within your heart.
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam rakhai ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be adorned with True Glory. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saachee sobhaa saach d u-aaray. ||6||

lines.english: How very fortunate are they, who are committed to the Guru's service.
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee je gur sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are engaged in devotional worship; the True Name is implanted within them.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat sach naam drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Naam, all of one's generations are saved. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naamay uDhray kul sabaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Nanak chants the true thought.
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai veechaar.

lines.english: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhahu ur Dh aar.

lines.english: Imbued with devotion to the Lord, the gate of salvation is found. ||8||2||24|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (423-18) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har bhagt ee raat ay mokh  du-aar. ||8||2||24||

lines.english: Everyone lives, hoping in hope.
lines.transliteration: aasaa aas karay sabh ko-ee.

lines.english: Understanding His Command, one becomes free of desire.
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhai niraasaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: So many are asleep in hope.
lines.transliteration: aasaa vich sutay ka-ee lo-ee.

lines.english: He alone wakes up, whom the Lord awakens. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so jaagai jaagaavai so-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The True Guru has led me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Naam, hunger does not go away. pMnw 424
lines.transliteration: satgur naam bujh aa-i-aa vin  naavai bh ukh na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Naam, the fire of desire is extinguished; the Naam is obtained by His Will. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naamay tarisnaa agan bujh ai naam milai t isai rajaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, realize the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kal keerat sabad  pachh aan.

lines.english: By this devotional worship, egotism is eliminated.
lines.transliteration: ayhaa bhagat  chookai abh imaan.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one becomes approved.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai hovai parvaan.

lines.english: So know the One, who created hope and desire. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin aasaa keetee t is no jaan. ||2||

lines.english: What shall we offer to one who proclaims the Word of the Shabad?
lines.transliteration: tis ki-aa d eejai je sabad  sunaa-ay.

lines.english: By His Grace, the Naam is enshrined within our minds.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Offer your head, and shed your self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: ih sir deejai aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: One who understands the Lord's Command finds lasting peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhay sad aa sukh  paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself does, and causes others to do.
lines.transliteration: aap karay tai aap karaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself enshrines His Name in the mind of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: aapay gurmukh naam vasaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself misleads us, and He Himself puts us back on the Path.
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaavai aap maarag paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, we merge into the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sach samaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of the Lord's Bani.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai ban ee.

lines.english: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs speak it and chant it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jug jug aakh  vakh aanee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt and attachment.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mohi bh aram bh olaan ee.

lines.english: Without the Name, everyone wanders around insane. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh firai ba-uraan ee. ||5||

lines.english: Throughout the three worlds, is the one Maya.
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan meh aykaa maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The fool reads and reads, but holds tight to duality.
lines.transliteration: moorakh parh  parh doojaa bh aa-o drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He performs all sorts of rituals, but still suffers terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: baho karam kamaavai dukh  sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Reflective meditation upon the Shabad is such sweet nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit meeth aa sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: Night and day, one enjoys it, subduing his ego.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh ogay ha-umai maar.

lines.english: When the Lord showers His Mercy, we enjoy celestial bliss.
lines.transliteration: sahj anand kirpaa Dhaar.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, love the True Lord forever. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sad aa sach pi-aar. ||7||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, and read and reflect upon the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har jap parhee-ai gur sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: Subdue your ego and meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jap parhee-ai ha-umai maar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਪੜੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, and be imbued with fear and love of the True One.
lines.transliteration: har japee-ai bha-ay sach pi-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart, through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||3||25|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (424-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw mhlw 3 AstpdIAw Gru 8 kwPI ] (424-11) raag aasaa mehlaa 3 asatpadee-aa gh ar 8 kaafee. Raag Aasaa, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees, Eighth House, Kaafee:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam gurmat ur Dh aar. ||8||3||25||

lines.english: Peace emanates from the Guru; He puts out the fire of desire.
lines.transliteration: gur tay saaNt oopjai jin t arisnaa agan bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained from the Guru; it is the greatestgreatness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur tay naam paa-ee-ai vadee vadi-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Keep the One Name in your consciousness, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: ayko naam chayt mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing the world on fire, I have hurried to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jagat jaland aa daykh kai bh aj pa-ay sarn aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਿਤ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਜਿਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom emanates from the Guru; reflect upon the supreme essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: gur tay gi-aan oopjai mahaa t at beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, the Lord's Mansion and His Court are attained; His devotionalworship is overflowing with treasures. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur tay gh ar dar paa-i-aa bh agtee bh aray bh andaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; he achieves reflective meditation andunderstanding.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai boojh ai veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਭਿਜ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is the Lord's devotee, immersed in His Praises; the Infinite Word of theShabad dwells within him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat salaah hai ant ar sabad  apaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Happiness emanates from the Gurmukh; he never suffers pain.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sookh  oopjai d ukh kaday na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਮਹਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh conquers his ego, and his mind is immaculately pure. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ha-umai maaree-ai man nirmal ho-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, self-conceit is removed, and understanding of the threeworlds is obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai aap ga-i-aa t aribhavan sojhee paa-ee.

lines.english: The Immaculate Divine Light is pervading and permeating everywhere; one's lightmerges into the Light. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nirmal jot pasar rahee jot ee jot  milaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru instructs, and one's intellect becomes sublime.
lines.transliteration: poorai gur samjhaa-i-aa mat  ootam ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੂਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: A cooling and soothing peace comes within, and through the Naam, peace is obtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: antar seet al saaNt ho-ay naamay sukh  ho-ee. ||6||

lines.english: One meets the Perfect True Guru only when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur t aaN milai jaaN nadar karay-ee.

lines.english: All sins and vices are eradicated, and one shall never again suffer pain or distress. ||7|| pMnw 425
lines.transliteration: kilvikh paap sabh  katee-ah fir d ukh bighan na ho-ee. ||7||

lines.english: Glory is in His Hands; He bestows His Name, and attaches us to it.
lines.transliteration: aapnai hath vad i-aa-ee-aa d ay naamay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਹਿਥ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the treasure of the Naam abides within the mind, and glory is obtained. ||8||4||26|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (425-2) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niDhaan man vasi-aa vadi-aa-ee paa-ay. ||8||4||26||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Listen, O mortal: enshrine His Name within your mind; He shall come to meet withyou, O my Sibling of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: sun man man vasaa-ay t ooN aapay aa-ay milai mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Night and day, center your consciousness on true devotional worship of the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din sachee bh agat kar sachai chit  laa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the One Naam, and you shall find peace, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: ayko naam Dhi-aa-ay t ooN sukh  paavahi mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Eradicate egotism and duality, and your glory shall be glorious. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai doojaa d oor kar vadee vadi-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The angels, humans and silent sages long for this devotional worship, but without theTrue Guru, it cannot be attained.
lines.transliteration: is bhagt ee no sur nar mun jan lochd ay vin  satgur paa-ee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers read their books, but they donot understand. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pandit parh -day jot ikee t in boojh  na paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself keeps all in His Hand; nothing else can be said.
lines.transliteration: aapai thai sabh rakh i-on kichh  kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਨੋ ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਈ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever He gives, is received. The Guru has imparted this understanding to me.||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay day-ay so paa-ee-ai gur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੜਦੇ  ਜੋਿਤਕੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tis day sabh naa kaa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਿਖਓਨੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: So who can we call bad, since there is no other? ||4||
lines.transliteration: mandaa kis no aakh ee-ai jay d oojaa ho-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਿਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Command of the One Lord is pervading throughout; duty to the One Lord is upon the heads of all.
lines.transliteration: iko hukam varatdaa aykaa sir kaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਿਤਸ ਦੇ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself has led them astray, and placed greed and corruption within their hearts.||5||
lines.transliteration: aap bhavaalee d itee-an ant ar lobh  vikaaraa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He has sanctified those few Gurmukhs who understand Him, and reflect upon Him.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay gurmukh keet i-an boojh an veechaaraa.

lines.english: He grants devotional worship to them, and within them is the treasure. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhee onaa no bakh see-an ant ar bhandaaraa. ||6||

lines.english: The spiritual teachers know nothing but the Truth; they obtain true understanding.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee-aa no sabh sach hai sach sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੀਿਤਅਨੁ ਬੂਝਿਨ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: They are led astray by Him, but they do not go astray, because they know the TrueLord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: o-ay bhulaa-ay kisai d ay na bh ulnHee sach jaan an so-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੀ ਓਨਾ  ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Within the homes of their bodies, the five passions are pervading, but here, the fiveare well-behaved.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh panch varatd ay panchay veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not overcome; through the Naam, the egois conquered. ||8||5||27|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (425-11) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satgur vas na aavnHee naam ha-umai maaree. ||8||5||27||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦੇ ਨ ਭੁਲਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਿਨ  ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Everything is within the home of your own self; there is nothing beyond it.
lines.transliteration: gharai and ar sabh  vath hai baahar kichh  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ  ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the inner heart are opened wide. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-ee-ai antar kapat kh ulaahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਵਿਸ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀ  ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
lines.english: From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay har paa-ee-ai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The treasure of the Naam is within; the Perfect True Guru has shown this to me.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: antar naam niDh aan hai poorai sat gur dee-aa d ikhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name, finds it, and obtains the jewel ofcontemplation.
lines.transliteration: har kaa gaahak hovai so la-ay paa-ay ratan veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He opens the doors deep within, and through the Eyes of Divine Vision, beholds thetreasure of liberation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: andar kh olai d ib disat d aykhai mukat  bhandaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.
lines.transliteration: andar mahal anayk heh jee-o karay vasayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, and he shall not have to go throughreincarnation again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man chindi-aa fal paa-isee fir ho-ay na fayraa. ||3||

lines.english: The appraisers cherish the commodity of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: paarkhee-aa vath samaal la-ee gur sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Naam is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath amul saa gurmukh  paavai ko-ee. ||4||

lines.english: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the homeof the self, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: baahar bhaalay so ki-aa lahai vath gh arai and ar bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਮਹਲ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਹਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The entire world is wandering around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukhslose their honor. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa sabh  jag firai manmukh  pat gavaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes out to another's home.
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar chh oday aapn aa par gh ar jhoothaa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਖੀਆ  ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Naam, he is beaten and struck down. ||6||
lines.transliteration: chorai vaaNgoo pakrhee-ai bin naavai chotaa kh aa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਅਮੁਲੁ  ਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who know their own home, are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: jinHee ghar jaat aa aapn aa say sukh ee-ay bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਿਕਆ  ਲਹੈ ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They realize God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru.||7||
lines.transliteration: antar barahm pachh aani-aa gur kee vadi-aa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੇ  ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਫਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He Himself gives gifts, and He Himself bestows understanding; unto whom can wecomplain?
lines.transliteration: aapay daan karay kis aakh ee-ai aapay d ay-ay bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਪਰ ਘਿਰ  ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall obtain glory in the True Court. ||8||6||28|| pMnw 426 Awsw mhlw 3 ] (426-1) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay t ooN dar sachai sobh aa paa-ee. ||8||6||28||

lines.english: Those who recognize their own selves, enjoy the sweet flavor, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: aapai aap pachhaan i-aa saad  meeth aa bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are emancipated; they love theTruth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhi-ai mukat  bha-ay jinHaa saacho bh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਚਾਿਖਐ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਭਏ ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Beloved Lord is the purest of the pure; He comes to dwell in the pure mind.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o nirmal nirmalaa nirmal man vaasaa.

lines.english: Praising the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, one remains unaffected bycorruption. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee salaahee-ai bikh i-aa maahi ud aasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, they do not understand themselves -they are totallyblind, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai aap na jaap-ee sabh  anDh ee bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated, and in the end, only the Naamshall be your companion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee gh at chaann aa naam ant  sakhaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਜਾਪਈ  ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They are occupied with the Naam, and only the Naam; they deal only in the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naamay hee naam varatday naamay vart aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਤ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Deep within their hearts is the Naam; upon their lips is the Naam; they contemplate the Word of God, and the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: antar naam mukh  naam hai naamay sabad  veechaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਰਤਦੇ  ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: They listen to the Naam, believe in the Naam, and through the Naam, they obtainglory.
lines.transliteration: naam sunee-ai naam mannee-ai naamay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They praise the Naam, forever and ever, and through the Naam, they obtain theMansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam salaahay sadaa sad aa naamay mahal paa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਨਾਮੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Naam, their hearts are illumined, and through the Naam, they obtainhonor.
lines.transliteration: naamay hee ghat chaann aa naamay sobh aa paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Through the Naam, peace wells up; I seek the Sanctuary of the Naam. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naamay hee sukh oopjai naamay sarn aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko-ay na mannee-ai manmukh pat  gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: In the City of Death, they are tied down and beaten, and they lose their lives in vain.||6||
lines.transliteration: jam pur baaDhay maaree-ah birthaa janam gavaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who realize the Naam, all serve the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naamai kee sabh sayvaa karai gurmukh  naam bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: So believe in the Naam, and only the Naam; through the Naam, glorious greatness isobtained. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naamhu hee naam mannee-ai naamay vadi-aa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He alone receives it, unto whom it is given. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naamis realized.
lines.transliteration: jis no dayvai t is milai gurmat ee naam bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਨਾਮੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, everything is under the influence of the Naam; by perfect good destiny, afew obtain it. ||8||7||29|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (426-9) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh  naavai kai vas hai poorai bh aag ko paa-ee. ||8||7||29||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁ ਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The deserted brides do not obtain the Mansion of their Husband's Presence, nor dothey know His taste.
lines.transliteration: duhaagan ee mahal na paa-inHee na jaan an pir kaa su-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਕੋ ਪਾਈ  ॥੮॥੭॥੨੯॥
lines.english: They speak harsh words, and do not bow to Him; they are in love with another. ||1||
lines.transliteration: fikaa boleh naa niveh doojaa bh aa-o su-aa-o. ||1||

lines.english: How can this mind come under control?
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa ki-o kar vas aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ  ਨ ਜਾਣਿਨ  ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it is held in check; instructed in spiritual wisdom, it returns to itshome. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee thaakee-ai gi-aan mat ee gh ar aavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself adorns the happy soul-brides; they bear Him love and affection.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee aap savaaree-on laa-ay paraym pi-aar.

lines.english: They live in harmony with the Sweet Will of the True Guru, naturally adorned with the Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai chald ee-aa naamay sahj seegaar. ||2||

lines.english: They enjoy their Beloved forever, and their bed is decorated with Truth.
lines.transliteration: sadaa raaveh pir aapn aa sachee sayj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਠਾਕੀਐ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਮਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They are fascinated with the Love of their Husband Lord; meeting their Beloved, theyobtain peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pir kai paraym mohee-aa mil pareetam sukh  paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom is the incomparable decoration of the happy soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan apaar seegaar hai sobhaavant ee naar.

lines.english: She is so beautiful - she is the queen of all; she enjoys the love and affection of herHusband Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saa sabhraa-ee sund ree pir kai hayt  pi-aar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਦੀਆ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Lord, the Unseen, the Infinite, has infused His Love among the happy soul-brides.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee vich rang rakh i-on sachai alakh  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They serve their True Guru, with true love and affection. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan aapn aa sachai bh aa-ay pi-aar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਮੋਹੀਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The happy soul-bride has adorned herself with the necklace of virtue.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee seegaar ban aa-i-aa gun  kaa gal haar.

lines.english: She applies the perfume of love to her body, and within her mind is the jewel ofreflective meditation. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paraym pirmal tan laavn aa ant ar rat an veechaar. ||6||

lines.english: Those who are imbued with devotional worship are the most exalted. Their social standing and honor come from the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  ratay say oot maa jat  pat sabd ay ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਰੰਗੁ ਰਿਖਓਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਅਲਿਖ  ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, all are low class, like maggots in manure. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh neech jaat  hai bistaa kaa keerh aa ho-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Everyone proclaims, "Me, me!"; but without the Shabad, the ego does not depart.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o kardee sabh  firai bin sabd ai ha-o na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ  ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਿਲ  ਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam lose their ego; they remain absorbedin the True Lord. ||8||8||30|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (426-19) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay t in ha-umai ga-ee sachai rahay samaa-ay. ||8||8||30||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਪਰਮਲੁ  ਤਿਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are spotless and pure; their reputation isforever true.
lines.transliteration: sachay ratay say nirmalay sad aa sachee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਊਤਮਾ  ਜਿਤ ਪਿਤ ਸਬਦੇ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Here, they are known in each and every home, and hereafter, they are famous throughout the ages. ||1|| pMnw 427
lines.transliteration: aithai ghar gh ar jaapd ay aagai jug jug pargat ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O beauteous and joyful mind, imbue yourself with your true color.
lines.transliteration: ay man roorhHai rangulay t ooN sachaa rang charh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਰੂੜੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ  ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If you imbue yourself with the Beauteous Word of the Guru's Bani, then this color shall never fade away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: roorhee ban ee jay rapai naa ih rang lahai na jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am lowly, filthy, and totally egotistical; I am attached to the corruption of duality.
lines.transliteration: ham neech mailay at abh imaanee d oojai bh aa-ay vikaar.

lines.english: But meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, I am transformed into gold; I amblended with the Pure Light of the Infinite Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur paaras mili-ai kanchan ho-ay nirmal jot apaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ  ਮੈਲੇ ਅਿਤ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love; meeting withthe Guru, this color is applied.
lines.transliteration: bin gur ko-ay na rangee-ai gur mili-ai rang charhaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪਾਰਿਸ  ਿਮਿਲਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਏ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੋਿਤ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Fear, and the Love of the Guru, are absorbed in thePraise of the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhai bh aa-ay jo rat ay sift ee sach samaa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰੰਗੀਐ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without fear, the cloth is not dyed, and the mind is not rendered pure.
lines.transliteration: bhai bin laag na lag-ee naa man nirmal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਿਸਫਤੀ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without fear, the performance of rituals is false, and one finds no place of rest. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bin bhai karam kamaavn ay jhoothay thaa-o na ko-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਲਾਿਗ  ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Only those whom the Lord imbues, are so imbued; they join the Sat Sangat, the TrueCongregation.
lines.transliteration: jis no aapay rangay so rapsee satsangat  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਝੂਠੇ ਠਾਉ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, the Sat Sangat emanates, and one easily merges into the Love of the True One. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay sat sangat  oopjai sehjay sach subh aa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਰੰਗੇ ਸੁ ਰਪਸੀ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all remain like beasts and animals.
lines.transliteration: bin sangtee sabh  aisay raheh jaisay pas dh or.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They do not know the One who created them; without the Name, all are thieves. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jiniH keetay t isai na jaan anHee bin naavai sabh  chor. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ  ਸਿਭ ਐਸੇ ਰਹਿਹ  ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
lines.english: Some purchase merits and sell off their demerits; through the Guru, they obtain peaceand poise.
lines.transliteration: ik gun vihaajh eh a-ugan  viknahi gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਿਤਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਿਭ ਚੋਰ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, they obtain the Name, which comes to dwell deep within. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay naa-o paa-i-aa vuth aa and ar aa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਗੁਣ ਿਵਹਾਝਿਹ  ਅਉਗਣ  ਿਵਕਣਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He assigns tasks to each and every person.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa d aataa ayk hai sir Dh anDhai laa-ay.
