lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਵੁਠਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਆਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord embellishes us with the Name; attached to the Word of theShabad, we are merged into Him. ||8||9||31|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (427-9) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naamay laa-ay savaari-an sabday la-ay milaa-ay. ||8||9||31||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone longs for the Name, but he alone receives it, unto whom the Lord shows HisMercy.
lines.transliteration: sabh naavai no lochd ee jis kirpaa karay so paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਿਰਅਨ ੁ ਸਬਦੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੮॥੯॥੩੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name, there is only pain; he alone obtains peace, whose mind is filled with the Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh d ukh hai sukh  tis jis man vasaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: You are infinite and merciful; I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: tooN bay-ant  da-i-aal hai t ayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚਦੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay paa-ee-ai naamay vadi-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, there is only the One Lord. He has created the world, with itsmany varieties.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayk hai baho biDh  sarisat upaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: According to the Order of His Will, He makes us act. What else can we talk about, OSiblings of Destiny? ||2||
lines.transliteration: hukmay kaar karaa-idaa d oojaa kis kahee-ai bh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਮੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Knowledge and ignorance are all your making; You have control over these.
lines.transliteration: bujh-n aa abujh -naa tuDh kee-aa ih t ayree sir kaar.

lines.english: Some, You forgive, and unite with Yourself; while others, the wicked, you strike downand drive out of Your Court. ||3||
lines.transliteration: iknHaa bakhsihi mayl laihi ik d argeh maar kadh ay koorh i-aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਉਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Some, from the very beginning, are pure and pious; You attach them to Your Name.
lines.transliteration: ik Dhur pavit  paavan heh t uDh naamay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਿਕਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, peace wells up; through the True Word of the Shabad, one comesto understand. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sukh  oopjai sachai sabad  bujhaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਝਣਾ  ਅਬੁਝਣਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਆ  ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Some are crooked, filthy and vicious; the Lord Himself has led them astray from the Name.
lines.transliteration: ik kuchal kucheel vikhlee pat ay naavhu aap kh u-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਬਖਿਸਿਹ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਇਿਕ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢੇ ਕੂਿੜਆਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They have no intuition, no understanding and no self-discipline; they wander arounddelirious. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naa on siDh na buDh  hai na sanjmee fireh ut vataa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਧੁਿਰ ਪਿਵਤ ਪਾਵਨ  ਹਿਹ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He grants faith to those whom He has blessed with His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay jis aapn ee tis no bh aavnee laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: This mind finds truth, contentment and self-discipline, hearing the Immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh ih sanjmee man nirmal sabad  sunaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਕੁਚਲ  ਕੁਚੀਲ ਿਵਖਲੀ  ਪਤੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: By reading books, one cannot reach Him; by speaking and talking, His limits cannot befound.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa parh  na pahoochee-ai kath kahn ai ant  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਨ ਿਸਿਧ  ਨ ਬੁਿਧ ਹੈ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੀ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਉਤਵਤਾਏ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, His value is found; through the True Word of the Shabad,understanding is obtained. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur tay keemat  paa-ee-ai sach sabad  sojhee paa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: So reform this mind and body, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ih man dayhee soDh  tooN gur sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, within this body is the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is found through the Love of the Infinite Guru. ||8||10||32|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (427-19) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak is dayhee vich naam niDh aan hai paa-ee-ai gur kai hayt  apaar. ||8||10||32||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ ਪਿੜ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੀਐ  ਕਿਥ ਕਹਣੈ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The happy soul-brides are imbued with Truth; they are adorned with the Word of theGuru's Shabad. pMnw 428
lines.transliteration: sach ratee-aa sohaagan ee jinaa gur kai sabad  seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They find their Husband Lord within their own home, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghar hee so pir paa-i-aa sachai sabad  veechaar. ||1||

lines.english: Through merits, their demerits are forgiven, and they embrace love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: avgan gun ee bakh saa-i-aa har si-o liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The soul-bride then obtains the Lord as her Husband; meeting the Guru, this unioncomes about. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har var paa-i-aa kaamnee gur mayl milaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some do not know the Presence of their Husband Lord; they are deluded by dualityand doubt.
lines.transliteration: ik pir hadoor na jaan anHee doojai bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਿਪਰੁ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮ ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: How can the forsaken brides meet Him? Their life night passes in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ki-o paa-iniH dohaaganee d ukhee rain  vihaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Those whose minds are filled with the True Lord, perform truthful actions.
lines.transliteration: jin kai man sach vasi-aa sachee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they serve the Lord with poise, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din sayveh sahj si-o sachay maahi samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਹਜ  ਿਸਉ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The forsaken brides wander around, deluded by doubt; telling lies, they eat poison.
lines.transliteration: duhaagan ee bh aram bh ulaa-ee-aa koorh  bol bikh  khaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਈਆ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They do not know their Husband Lord, and upon their deserted bed, they suffer inmisery. ||4||
lines.transliteration: pir na jaanan aapn aa sunj ee sayj d ukh paahi. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੇਜ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The True Lord is the One and only; do not be deluded by doubt, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib ayk hai mat man bh aram bh ulaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਭਰਿਮ ਭੁਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Consult with the Guru, serve the True Lord, and enshrine the Immaculate Truth withinyour mind. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur poochh sayvaa karahi sach nirmal man vasaahi. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਿਛ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਿਹ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The happy soul-bride always finds her Husband Lord; she banishes egotism and self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee sad aa pir paa-i-aa ha-umai aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਉਮੈ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She remains attached to her Husband Lord, night and day, and she finds peace uponHis Bed of Truth. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pir saytee an-d in geh rahee sachee sayj sukh  paa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗਿਹ ਰਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who shouted, "Mine, mine!" have departed, without obtaining anything.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kar ga-ay palai kichh na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਗਏ ਪਲੈ ਿਕਛੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The separated one does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and departs, repenting in the end. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mahal naahee dohaaganee ant  ga-ee pachh utaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: That Husband Lord of mine is the One and only; I am in love with the One alone.
lines.transliteration: so pir mayraa ayk hai aykas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕਸੁ  ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the soul-bride longs for peace, she should enshrine the Lord's Namewithin her mind. ||8||11||33|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (428-9) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jay sukh lorh eh kaamn ee har kaa naam man vasaa-ay. ||8||11||33||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇ  ॥੮॥੧੧॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Those whom the Lord has caused to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, naturally,intuitively, enjoy the sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: amrit jinHaa chh akhaa-i-on ras aa-i-aa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord is care-free; he does not have even an iota of greed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachaa vayparvaahu hai tis no t il na t amaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਿਜਨਾ  ਚਖਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and trickles into the mouths of the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: amrit sachaa varasd aa gurmukh aa mukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Their minds are forever rejuvenated, and they naturally, intuitively, sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man sadaa haree-aavlaa sehjay har gun  gaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are forever forsaken brides; they cry out and bewail at theLord's Gate.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sad aa duhaagan ee dar kharhee-aa billaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who do not enjoy the sublime taste of their Husband Lord, act according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jinHaa pir kaa su-aad na aa-i-o jo Dh ur likh i-aa so kamaahi. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukh plants the seed of the True Name, and it sprouts. He deals in the TrueName alone.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh beejay sach jamai sach naam vaapaar.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord has attached to this profitable venture, are granted the treasureof devotional worship. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo it laahai laa-i-an bh agtee day-ay bh andaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਦੁ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ ਸ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is forever the true, happy soul-bride; she adorns herself with the fear ofGod and devotion to Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa sohaagan ee bh ai bhagat seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੀਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਜਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, she enjoys her Husband Lord; she keeps Truth enshrined within herheart. ||4||
lines.transliteration: an-din raaveh pir aapn aa sach rakh eh ur Dh aar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਹੈ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਦੇਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa pir raavi-aa aapnaa t inHaa vitahu bal jaa-o.

lines.english: They dwell forever with their Husband Lord; they eradicate self-conceit from within.||5||
lines.transliteration: sadaa pir kai sang raheh vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਭੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੀਗਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed, and their faces are radiant, from thelove and affection of their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al mukh  ujlay pir kai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਹ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ ॥੪॥
lines.english: They enjoy their Husband Lord upon His cozy bed, having conquered their ego and desire. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sayj sukhaalee pir ravai ha-umai t arisnaa maar. ||6||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He comes into our homes, through our infinite Love for the Guru.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa ghar aa-i-aa gur kai hayt  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The happy soul-bride obtains the One Lord as her Husband. ||7||
lines.transliteration: var paa-i-aa sohaaganee kayval ayk muraar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: All of her sins are forgiven; the Uniter unites her with Himself.
lines.transliteration: sabhay gunah bakh saa-ay la-i-on maylay maylan haar.

lines.english: O Nanak, chant such chants, that hearing them, He may enshrine love for you.||8||12||34|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (428-19) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhan  aakh ee-ai jay sun  Dharay pi-aar. ||8||12||34||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Merit is obtained from the True Guru, when God causes us to meet Him. pMnw 429
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay gun  oopjai jaa parabh  maylai so-ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with intuitive ease and poise, spiritual wisdom is revealed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sehjay naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai gi-aan pargat ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਦੂਿਰ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, do not think of the Lord as being far away; behold Him ever close at hand.
lines.transliteration: ay man mat jaan eh har d oor hai sad aa vaykh  hadoor.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਸੁਣਦਾ  ਸਦ ਵੇਖਦਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is always listening, and always watching over us; the Word of His Shabad is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sad sund aa sad  vaykh -daa sabad  rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs understand their own selves; they meditate single-mindedly on theLord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap pachh aani-aa tinHee ik man Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: They enjoy their Husband Lord continually; through the True Name, they find peace.||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa raveh pir aapn aa sachai naam sukh  paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਰਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, no one belongs to you; contemplate the Shabad, and see this.
lines.transliteration: ay man tayraa ko nahee kar vaykh  sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: So run to the Lord's Sanctuary, and find the gate of salvation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har sarnaa-ee bh aj pa-o paa-ihi mokh  du-aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਿਜ ਪਉ ਪਾਇਿਹ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen to the Shabad, and understand the Shabad, and lovingly focus yourconsciousness on the True One.
lines.transliteration: sabad sun ee-ai sabad  bujhee-ai sach rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਸਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, conquer your ego, and in the True Mansion of the Lord'sPresence, you shall find peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabday ha-umai maaree-ai sachai mahal sukh  paa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀਐ  ਸਚੈ ਮਹਿਲ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory; without the Name, there is no glory.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh sobhaa naam kee bin naavai sobh  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The glory of this Maya lasts for only a few days; it disappears in an instant. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ih maa-i-aa kee sobhaa chaar d ihaarh ay jaad ee bilam na ho-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਾਿਰ  ਿਦਹਾੜੇ  ਜਾਦੀ  ਿਬਲਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Naam are already dead, and they continue dying.
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa say mu-ay mar jaahi.

lines.english: They do not enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord's taste; they sink into the manure.||6||
lines.transliteration: har ras saad na aa-i-o bistaa maahi samaahi. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Some are forgiven by the Lord; He unites them with Himself, and keeps themattached to the Naam, night and day.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay bakhas milaa-i-an an-d in naamay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They practice Truth, and abide in Truth; being truthful, they merge into Truth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sach kamaaveh sach raheh sachay sach samaahi. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਿਚ ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, the world does not hear, and does not see; deaf and blind, itwanders around.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai sun ee-ai na d aykhee-ai jag bolaa anHaa bh armaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਜਗੁ ਬੋਲਾ  ਅੰਨਾ  ਭਰਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, it obtains only misery; the Naam is received only by His Will. ||8||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai dukh  paa-isee naam milai t isai rajaa-ay. ||8||

lines.english: Those persons who link their consciousness with the Word of His Bani, are immaculately pure, and approved by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin banee si-o chit  laa-i-aa say jan nirmal parvaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, and in the Court of the Lord, they are known as true. ||9||13||35|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (429-11) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinHaa kad ay na veesrai say d ar sachay jaan . ||9||13||35||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਸੇ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥੯॥੧੩॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the devotees are known; their words are true.
lines.transliteration: sabdou hee bh agat jaapd ay jinH kee ban ee sachee ho-ay.

lines.english: They eradicate ego from within themselves; they surrender to the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord, and meet with the True One. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap ga-i-aa naa-o mani-aa sach milaavaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੌ  ਹੀ ਭਗਤ  ਜਾਪਦੇ  ਿਜਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His humble servants obtain honor.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jan kee pat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਨਾਉ  ਮੰਿਨਆ ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: How blessed is their coming into the world! Everyone adores them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: safal tinHaa kaa janam hai t inH maanai sabh  ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Ego, self-centeredness, excessive anger and pride are the lot of mankind.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa jaat hai at  kroDh  abhimaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲੁ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਹੈ ਿਤਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: If one dies in the Word of the Shabad, then he is rid of this, and his light is mergedinto the Light of the Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabad marai t aa jaat  jaa-ay jot ee jot  milai bh agvaan. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, my life has been blessed.
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur bh ayti-aa safal janam hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਿਤ  ਹੈ ਅਿਤ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam, and my storehouse is inexhaustible, filled to overflowing. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam navai niDh paa-i-aa bh aray akh ut bhandaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਜਾਿਤ  ਜਾਇ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who love the Naam come as dealers in the merchandise of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: aavahi is raasee kay vaapaaree-ay jinHaa naam pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who become Gurmukh obtain this wealth; deep within, they contemplate theShabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so Dh an paa-ay t inHaa ant ar sabad  veechaaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਭਰੇ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The egotistical, self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of devotionalworship.
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee saar na jaan anHee manmukh  ahaNkaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਹ  ਇਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ  ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dharahu aap kh u-aa-i-an joo-ai baajee haaree. ||5|| The Primal Lord Himself has beguiled them; they lose their lives in the gamble. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਤਨਾ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without loving affection, devotional worship is not possible, and the body cannot be atpeace.
lines.transliteration: bin pi-aarai bhagat  na hova-ee naa sukh  ho-ay sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੀ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion, the mind becomessteady. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paraym padaarath paa-ee-ai gur bh agtee man Dh eer. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਇਅਨ ੁ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ  ਹਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He alone performs devotional worship, whom the Lord so blesses; he contemplatesthe Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jis no bhagat  karaa-ay so karay gur sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਆਰੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰੀਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The One Name abides in his heart, and he conquers his ego and duality. ||7||
lines.transliteration: hirdai ayko naam vasai ha-umai d ubiDh aa maar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਿਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The One Name is the social status and honor of the devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kee jat  pat ayko naam hai aapay la-ay savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They remain forever in the Protection of His Sanctuary. As it pleases His Will, He arranges their affairs. ||8|| pMnw 430
lines.transliteration: sadaa sarn aa-ee t is kee ji-o bh aavai t i-o kaaraj saar. ||8||

lines.english: The worship of the Lord is unique - it is known only by reflecting upon the Guru.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  niraalee alaah d ee jaapai gur veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਨਰਾਲੀ  ਅਲਾਹ  ਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Naam, through the Lord's Fear and devotion, is embellished with the Naam. ||9||14||36|| Awsw mhlw 3 ] (430-2) aasaa mehlaa 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam hirdai vasai bh ai bhagtee naam savaar. ||9||14||36||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥੯॥੧੪॥੩੬॥
lines.english: He wanders around, engrossed in other pleasures, but without the Naam, he suffers inpain.
lines.transliteration: an ras meh bholaa-i-aa bin naamai d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding.||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  na bh ayti-o je sachee boojh  bujhaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਮਿਹ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my insane mind, drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayray baavlay har ras chakh saad  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਿਜ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Attached to other pleasures, you wander around, and your life wastes away uselessly. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an ras laagaa tooN fireh birthaa janam gavaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਿਖ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In this age, the Gurmukhs are pure; they remain absorbed in the love of the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh gurmukh nirmalay sach naam raheh liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਰਿਸ ਲਾਗਾ  ਤੂੰ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the destiny of good karma, nothing can be obtained; what can we say or do?||2||
lines.transliteration: vin karmaa kichh  paa-ee-ai nahee ki-aa kar kahi-aa jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He understands his own self, and dies in the Word of the Shabad; he banishescorruption from his mind.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan eh sabad  mareh manhu t aj vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ  ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He hurries to the Guru's Sanctuary, and is forgiven by the Forgiving Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur sarnaa-ee bh aj pa-ay bakh say bakh sanhaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਹੀ ਿਕਆ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਹਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Name, peace is not obtained, and pain does not depart from within.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sukh na paa-ee-ai naa d ukh vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣਿਹ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਮਨਹੁ ਤਿਜ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: This world is engrossed in attachment to Maya; it has gone astray in duality anddoubt. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ih jag maa-i-aa mohi vi-aapi-aa doojai bh aram bh ulaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਿਜ ਪਏ ਬਖਸੇ  ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The forsaken soul-brides do not know the value of their Husband Lord; how can they decorate themselves?
lines.transliteration: duhaagan ee pir kee saar na jaan hee ki-aa kar karahi seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they continually burn, and they do not enjoy the Bed of their HusbandLord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa jald ee-aa fireh sayjai ravai na bh ataar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The happy soul-brides obtain the Mansion of His Presence, eradicating their self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee mahal paa-i-aa vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਿਪਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਿਰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They decorate themselves with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and their HusbandLord unites them with Himself. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee seegaaree-aa apn ay seh la-ee-aa milaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲਦੀਆ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਨ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: He has forgotten death, in the darkness of attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: marnaa manhu visaari-aa maa-i-aa moh gubaar.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs die again and again, and are reborn; they die again, andare miserable at the Gate of Death. ||7||
lines.transliteration: manmukh mar mar jameh bh ee mareh jam d ar hohi kh u-aar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ  ਅਪਣੇ  ਸਿਹ ਲਈਆ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: They alone are united, whom the Lord unites with Himself; they contemplate theWord of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aap milaa-i-an say milay gur sabad veechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam; their faces are radiant, in that True Court.||8||22||15||37|| Awsw mhlw 5 AstpdIAw Gru 2  (430-13) aasaa mehlaa 5 asatpadee-aa gh ar 2 Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (430-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaanay mukh  ujlay t it sachai d arbaar. ||8||22||15||37||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਭੀ ਮਰਿਹ ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਹੋਿਹ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: When the five virtues were reconciled, and the five passions were estranged, Ienshrined the five within myself, and cast out the other five. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panch manaa-ay panch rusaa-ay. panch vasaa-ay panch gavaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: In this way, the village of my body became inhabited, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: inH biDh nagar vuth aa mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥੮॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Vice departed, and the Guru's spiritual wisdom was implanted within me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: durat ga-i-aa gur gi-aan d arirhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The fence of true Dharmic religion has been built around it.
lines.transliteration: saach Dharam kee kar d eenee vaar.

lines.english: The spiritual wisdom and reflective meditation of the Guru has become its strong gate.||2||
lines.transliteration: farhay muhkam gur gi-aan beechaar. ||2||

lines.english: So plant the seed of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O friends, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: naam khayt ee beejahu bh aa-ee meet .

lines.english: Deal only in the constant service of the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sa-udaa karahu gur sayvhu neet . ||3||

lines.english: With intuitive peace and happiness, all the shops are filled.
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj sukh  kay sabh  haat.

lines.english: The Banker and the dealers dwell in the same place. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saah vaapaaree aykai thaat. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ  ਕੀ ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ  ਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: There is no tax on non-believers, nor any fines or taxes at death.
lines.transliteration: jayjee-aa dann ko la-ay na jagaat.

lines.english: The True Guru has set the Seal of the Primal Lord upon these goods. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur kar d eenee Dh ur kee chh aap. ||5||

lines.english: So load the merchandise of the Naam, and set sail with your cargo.
lines.transliteration: vakhar naam lad  khayp chalaavahu.

lines.english: Earn your profit, as Gurmukh, and you shall return to your own home. ||6||
lines.transliteration: lai laahaa gurmukh gh ar aavhu. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਹਾਟ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Banker, and His Sikhs are the traders.
lines.transliteration: satgur saahu sikh  vanjaaray.

lines.english: Their merchandise is the Naam, and meditation on the True Lord is their account.||7||
lines.transliteration: poonjee naam laykhaa saach samHaaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਜੀਆ  ਡੰਨੁ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਜਗਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: One who serves the True Guru dwells in this house.
lines.transliteration: so vasai it gh ar jis gur pooraa sayv.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ  ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਪ ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Divine City is eternal. ||8||1|| pMnw 431 AwswvrI mhlw 5 Gru 3 (431-1) aasaavaree mehlaa 5 ghar 3 Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (431-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: abichal nagree naanak dayv. ||8||1||

lines.english: My mind is in love with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har si-o laagee pareet.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; my lifestyle is pure and true. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har har japat  nirmal saachee reet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਾਚੀ ਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I think of him in somany ways.
lines.transliteration: darsan kee pi-aas gh anee chit vat anik parkaar.

lines.english: So be Merciful, O Supreme Lord; shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, Destroyer ofpride. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karahu anoograhu paarbarahm har kirpaa Dhaar muraar. ||1||

lines.english: My stranger soul has come to join the Saadh Sangat.
lines.transliteration: man pardaysee aa-i-aa mili-o saaDh  kai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That commodity, which I longed for, I have found in the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis vakhar ka-o chaaht aa so paa-i-o naameh rang. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: There are so many pleasures and delights of Maya, but they pass away in an instant.
lines.transliteration: jaytay maa-i-aa rang ras binas jaahi kh in maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਵਖਰ  ਕਉ ਚਾਹਤਾ  ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ  ਨਾਮਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your devotees are imbued with Your Name; they enjoy peace everywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  ratay tayray naam si-o sukh  bhuNcheh sabh  thaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਿਖਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The entire world is seen to be passing away; only the Lord's Name is lasting andstable.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag chalt a-o paykh ee-ai nihchal har ko naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚਿਹ  ਸਭ ਠਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: So make friends with the Holy Saints, so that you may obtain a lasting place of rest.||4||
lines.transliteration: kar mitraa-ee saaDh  si-o nihchal paavahi th aa-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਤਉ  ਪੇਖੀਐ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Friends, acquaintances, children and relatives - none of these shall be yourcompanion.
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sut  banDh paa ko-oo hot  na saath.

lines.english: The Lord's Name alone shall go with you; God is the Master of the meek. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ayk nivaahoo raam naam deenaa kaa parabh  naath. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ  ਕੋਊ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Boat; attached to Them, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal bohith bha-ay lag saagar t ari-o t ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਿਨਵਾਹੂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨਾ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਾਥ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, I embrace True Love for God. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bhayti-o pooraa sat guroo saachaa parabh  si-o nayh. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਬੋਿਹਥ  ਭਏ ਲਿਗ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਰਓ  ਤੇਹ ॥
lines.english: The prayer of Your Holy Saints is, "May I never forget You, for even one breath or morsel of food."
lines.transliteration: saaDh t ayray kee jaachnaa visar na saas giraas.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will is good; by Your Sweet Will, my affairs are adjusted.||7||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so bh alaa t ayrai bh aanai kaaraj raas. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਚਨਾ  ਿਵਸਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: I have met my Beloved, the Ocean of Peace, and Supreme Bliss has welled up withinme.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar pareet am milay upjay mahaa anand.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਾਰਜ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, all my pains have been eradicated, meeting with God, the Lord ofSupreme Bliss. ||8||1||2|| Awsw mhlw 5 ibrhVy Gru 4 CMqw kI jiq (431-11) aasaa mehlaa 5 birharhay gh ar 4 chh antaa kee jat Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Birharray ~ Songs Of Separation, To Be Sung In The Tune Of TheChhants. Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (431-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sabh d ukh mitay parabh  bhaytay parmaanand . ||8||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਮਲੇ ਉਪਜੇ  ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: Remember the Supreme Lord God, O Beloved, and make yourself a sacrifice to theBlessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh simree-ai pi-aaray d arsan ka-o bal jaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਿਮਟੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: Remembering Him, sorrows are forgotten, O Beloved; how can one forsake Him? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis simrat d ukh beesrahi pi-aaray so ki-o t ajnaa jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਿਬਰਹੜੇ  ਘਰੁ ੪ ਛੰਤਾ  ਕੀ ਜਿਤ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I would sell this body to the Saint, O Beloved, if he would lead me to my Dear Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih tan vaychee sant  peh pi-aaray pareet am day-ay milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਸਮਰੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The pleasures and adornments of corruption are insipid and useless; I have forsakenand abandoned them, O my Mother. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sukh seegaar bikh i-aa kay feekay t aj chh oday mayree maa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Lust, anger and greed left me, O Beloved, when I fell at the Feet of the True Guru.||5||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  taj ga-ay pi-aaray sat gur charnee paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਦੇਇ ਿਮਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who are imbued with the Lord, O Beloved, do not go anywhereelse. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jo jan raatay raam si-o pi-aaray anat  na kaahoo jaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕੇ ਫੀਕੇ ਤਿਜ ਛੋਡੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who have tasted the Lord's sublime essence, O Beloved, remain satisfied andsatiated. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har ras jinHee chaakhi-aa pi-aaray t aripat  rahay aagh aa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਜ ਗਏ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: One who grasps the Hem of the Gown of the Holy Saint, O Nanak, crosses over theterrible world-ocean. ||8||1||3||
lines.transliteration: anchal gahi-aa saaDh kaa naanak bh ai saagar paar paraa-ay. ||8||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਅਨਤ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death are removed, O Beloved, when the mortal meets with theLord, the King. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh katee-ai pi-aaray jab bh aytai har raa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: God is so Beautiful, so Refined, so Wise - He is my very life! Reveal to me YourDarshan! ||2||
lines.transliteration: sundar sugh ar sujaan  parabh  mayraa jeevan d aras d ikhaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਚਲੁ  ਗਿਹਆ  ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਇ  ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: Those beings who are separated from You, O Beloved, are born only to die; they eat the poison of corruption. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo jee-a tujh  tay beechh uray pi-aaray janam mareh bikh  khaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jis tooN mayleh so milai pi-aaray t is kai laaga-o paa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਿਦਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jo sukh d arsan paykh -tay pi-aaray mukh  tay kahan  na jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ  ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰੇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6|| pMnw 432
lines.transliteration: saachee pareet na t ut-ee pi-aaray jug jug rahee samaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਤੁਟਈ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases You is good, O Beloved; Your Will is Eternal. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so bh alaa pi-aaray t ayree amar rajaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤੇਰੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Nanak, those who are imbued with the Love of the All-Pervading Lord, O Beloved, remain intoxicated with His Love, in natural ease. ||8||2||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak rang ratay naaraa-in ai pi-aaray maat ay sahj subh aa-ay. ||8||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: You know all about my condition, O Beloved; who can I speak to about it? ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh biDh  tum hee jaant ay pi-aaray kis peh kaha-o sunaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਤੇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਕਹਉ  ਸੁਨਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of all beings; they eat and wear what You give them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tooN daataa jee-aa sabh naa kaa t ayraa d itaa pahirahi kh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਦਤਾ  ਪਿਹਰਿਹ  ਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will, O Beloved; they do not come from any other. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh tayree aagi-aa pi-aaray d oojee naahee jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whatever You cause me to do, that I do, O Beloved; I cannot do anything else. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo tooN karaaveh so karee pi-aaray avar kichh  karan  na jaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਵਿਹ  ਸੋ ਕਰੀ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on theLord's Name. ||5||
lines.transliteration: din rain  sabh  suhaavan ay pi-aaray jit  japee-ai har naa-o. ||5||

lines.english: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon hisforehead. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saa-ee kaar kamaavnee pi-aaray Dh ur mast ak laykh  likhaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਸਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਜਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each andevery heart. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ayko aap varatdaa pi-aaray gh at ghat rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਖਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Lift me up out of the deep pit of the world, O Beloved; Nanak has taken to YourSanctuary. ||8||3||22||15||2||42|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 ptI ilKI  (432-8) raag aasaa mehlaa 1 patee likhee Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Patee Likhee ~ The Poem Of The Alphabet: <> siqgur pRswid ] (432-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sansaar koop tay uDh ar lai pi-aaray naanak har sarn aa-ay. ||8||3||22||15||2||42||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Sassa: He who created the world, is the One Lord and Master of all.
lines.transliteration: sasai so-ay sarisat jin saajee sabhnaa saahib ayk bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਿਰ  ਲੈ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ॥੮॥੩॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੨॥੪੨॥
lines.english: Those whose consciousness remains committed to His Service - blessed is their birth and their coming into the world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sayvat rahay chit  jinH kaa laagaa aa-i-aa t inH kaa safal bh a-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਪਟੀ ਿਲਖੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, why forget Him? You foolish mind!
lines.transliteration: man kaahay bhoolay moorh  manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੈ ਸੋਇ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਾਜੀ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When your account is adjusted, O brother, only then shall you be judged wise.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab laykhaa d ayveh beeraa t a-o parh i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਤ  ਰਹੇ ਿਚਤੁ  ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Eevree: The Primal Lord is the Giver; He alone is True.
lines.transliteration: eevrhee aad  purakh  hai d aataa aapay sachaa so-ee.

lines.english: No accounting is due from the Gurmukh who understands the Lord through theseletters. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aynaa akhraa meh jo gurmukh  boojh ai tis sir laykh  na ho-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਬੀਰਾ  ਤਉ ਪਿੜਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Ooraa: Sing the Praises of the One whose limit cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: oorhai upmaa t aa kee keejai jaa kaa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who perform service and practice truth, obtain the fruits of their rewards. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sayvaa karahi say-ee fal paavahi jinHee sach kamaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਈਵੜੀ  ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Nganga: One who understands spiritual wisdom becomes a Pandit, a religious scholar.
lines.transliteration: nyany ai nyi-aan boojh ai jay ko-ee parh i-aa pandit  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨਾ ਅਖਰਾ  ਮਿਹ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who recognizes the One Lord among all beings does not talk of ego. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa meh ayko jaanai t aa ha-umai kahai na ko-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਊੜੈ ਉਪਮਾ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Kakka: When the hair grows grey, then it shines without shampoo.
lines.transliteration: kakai kays pundar jab hoo-ay vin saaboon ai ujli-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The hunters of the King of Death come, and bind him in the chains of Maya. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jam raajay kay hayroo aa-ay maa-i-aa kai sangal banDh la-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਙੰਙੈ ਿਙਆਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਪਿੜਆ  ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Khakha: The Creator is the King of the world; He enslaves by giving nourishment.
lines.transliteration: khakh ai khundkaar saah aalam kar kh areed  jin kh arach d ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਮਿਹ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: By His Binding, all the world is bound; no other Command prevails. ||6||
lines.transliteration: banDhan jaa kai sabh  jag baaDh i-aa avree kaa nahee hukam pa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਕੈ ਕੇਸ ਪੁੰਡਰ  ਜਬ ਹੂਏ ਿਵਣੁ ਸਾਬੂਣੈ  ਉਜਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Gagga: One who renounces the singing of the songs of the Lord of the Universe, becomes arrogant in his speech.
lines.transliteration: gagai go-ay gaa-ay jin chhodee galee gobid  garab bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੇ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਏ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿਲ  ਬੰਿਧ ਲਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: One who has shaped the pots, and made the world the kiln, decides when to putthem in it. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gharh  bhaaNday jin aavee saajee chaarh an vaahai t a-ee kee-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਖਖੈ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਹ ਆਲਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ਖਰੀਿਦ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਖਰਚੁ ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Ghagha: The servant who performs service, remains attached to the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ghagh ai ghaal sayvak jay gh aalai sabad  guroo kai laag rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਿਨ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਿਧਆ  ਅਵਰੀ  ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who recognizes bad and good as one and the same - in this way he is absorbedinto the Lord and Master. ||8||
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa jay sam kar jaan ai in biDh  saahib ramat  rahai. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਇ ਗਾਇ  ਿਜਿਨ ਛੋਡੀ ਗਲੀ  ਗੋਿਬਦੁ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Chacha: He created the four Vedas, the four sources of creation, and the four ages
lines.transliteration: chachai chaar vayd jin saajay chaaray kh aanee chaar jugaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿੜ  ਭਡੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਵੀ  ਸਾਜੀ  ਚਾੜਣ  ਵਾਹੈ ਤਈ ਕੀਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug jogee khaan ee bh ogee parh i-aa pandit  aap thee-aa. ||9|| - through each and every age, He Himself has been the Yogi, the enjoyer, the Pandit and the scholar. ||9|| pMnw 433

lines.english: Chhachha: Ignorance exists within everyone; doubt is Your doing, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: chhachh ai chh aa-i-aa vart ee sabh  antar tayraa kee-aa bh aram ho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਛਛੈ ਛਾਇਆ  ਵਰਤੀ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Having created doubt, You Yourself cause them to wander in delusion; those whom You bless with Your Mercy meet with the Guru. ||10||
lines.transliteration: bharam upaa-ay bh ulaa-ee-an aapay t ayraa karam ho-aa t inH guroo mili-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਭੁਲਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਆਪੇ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਿਤਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Jajja: That humble being who begs for wisdom has wandered begging through 8.4million incarnations.
lines.transliteration: jajai jaan mangat jan jaachai lakh  cha-oraaseeh bh eekh bhavi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਜੈ ਜਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ  ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ  ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਭੀਖ ਭਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord takes away, and the One Lord gives; I have not heard of any other.||11||
lines.transliteration: ayko layvai ayko dayvai avar na d oojaa mai sun i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਮੈ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Jhajha: O mortal being, why are you dying of anxiety? Whatever the Lord is to give,He shall keep on giving.
lines.transliteration: jhajhai jhoor marahu ki-aa paraan ee jo kichh  daynaa so d ay rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਝਝੈ ਝੂਿਰ ਮਰਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਦੇਣਾ  ਸੁ ਦੇ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: He gives, and gives, and watches over us; according to the Orders which He issues,His beings receive nourishment. ||12||
lines.transliteration: day d ay vaykh ai hukam chalaa-ay ji-o jee-aa kaa rijak pa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ  ਿਜਉ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Nyanya: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then I do not behold any other.
lines.transliteration: njanjai nad ar karay jaa d aykhaa doojaa ko-ee naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਞੰਞੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is totally pervading everywhere; the One Lord abides within the mind. ||13||
lines.transliteration: ayko rav rahi-aa sabh thaa-ee ayk vasi-aa man maahee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਏਕੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Tatta: Why do you practice hypocrisy, O mortal? In a moment, in an instant, you shallhave to get up and depart.
lines.transliteration: tatai tanch karahu ki-aa paraanee gh arhee ke muhat  ke uth  chaln aa.

lines.punjabi: ਟਟੈ ਟੰਚੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਘੜੀ ਿਕ ਮੁਹਿਤ  ਿਕ ਉਿਠ ਚਲਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Don't lose your life in the gamble - hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||14||
lines.transliteration: joo-ai janam na haarahu apnaa bh aaj parh ahu tum har sarn aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹਾਰਹੁਅਪਣਾ  ਭਾਿਜ  ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: T'hat'ha: Peace pervades within those who link their consciousness to the Lord's LotusFeet.
lines.transliteration: thathai thaadh vartee tin ant ar har charn ee jinH kaa chit  laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਠਠੈ ਠਾਿਢ ਵਰਤੀ  ਿਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings, whose consciousness is so linked, are saved; by Your Grace,they obtain peace. ||15||
lines.transliteration: chit laagaa say-ee jan nist aray t a-o parsaadee sukh  paa-i-aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਿਨਸਤਰੇ  ਤਉ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Dadda: Why do you make such ostentatious shows, O mortal? Whatever exists, shallall pass away.
lines.transliteration: dadai damf karahu ki-aa paraanee jo kichh  ho-aa so sabh  chaln aa.

lines.punjabi: ਡਡੈ ਡੰਫੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: So serve Him, who is contained and pervading among everyone, and you shall obtainpeace. ||16||
lines.transliteration: tisai sarayvhu t aa sukh  paavhu sarab nirant ar rav rahi-aa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Dhadha: He Himself establishes and disestablishes; as it pleases His Will, so does Heact.
lines.transliteration: dhadh ai dhaahi usaarai aapay ji-o t is bhaavai t ivai karay.

lines.punjabi: ਢਢੈ ਢਾਿਹ  ਉਸਾਰੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਜਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Having created the creation, He watches over it; He issues His Commands, and emancipates those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||17||
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai hukam chalaa-ay t is nist aaray jaa ka-o nad ar karay. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Nanna: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, sings His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: naanai ravat  rahai gh at ant ar har gun  gaavai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਣਾਣੈ  ਰਵਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: One whom the Creator Lord unites with Himself, is not consigned to reincarnation.||18||
lines.transliteration: aapay aap milaa-ay kartaa punrap janam na ho-ee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Tatta: The terrible world-ocean is so very deep; its limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: tatai taaroo bh avjal ho-aa t aa kaa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਰੂ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I do not have a boat, or even a raft; I am drowning - save me, O Savior King! ||19||
lines.transliteration: naa tar naa t ulhaa ham boodas t aar layhi t aaran  raa-i-aa. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਤਰ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਹਮ ਬੂਡਿਸ  ਤਾਿਰ  ਲੇਿਹ ਤਾਰਣ  ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: T'hat'ha: In all places and interspaces, He is; everything which exists, is by His doing.
lines.transliteration: thathai thaan thaanantar so-ee jaa kaa kee-aa sabh  ho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਥਥੈ ਥਾਿਨ  ਥਾਨੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: What is doubt? What is called Maya? Whatever pleases Him is good. ||20||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa bharam ki-aa maa-i-aa kahee-ai jo t is bhaavai so-ee bh alaa. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Dadda: Do not blame anyone else; blame instead your own actions.
lines.transliteration: dadai dos na d ay-oo kisai d os karammaa aapn i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਦੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਿਕਸੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ  ਆਪਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever I did, for that I have suffered; I do not blame anyone else. ||21||
lines.transliteration: jo mai kee-aa so mai paa-i-aa dos na d eejai avar janaa. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ  ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ  ਅਵਰ  ਜਨਾ ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: DhaDh ai Dhaar kalaa jin chh odee har cheejee jin rang kee-aa. Dhadha: His power established and upholds the earth; the Lord has imparted His color to everything.

lines.punjabi: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਿਰ ਕਲਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਛੋਡੀ ਹਿਰ ਚੀਜੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰੰਗ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: His gifts are received by everyone; all act according to His Command. ||22||
lines.transliteration: tis daa dee-aa sabh nee lee-aa karmee karmee hukam pa-i-aa. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਦੀਆ  ਸਭਨੀ  ਲੀਆ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Nanna: The Husband Lord enjoys eternal pleasures, but He is not seen or understood.
lines.transliteration: nannai naah bhog nit  bhogai naa deeth aa naa sammli-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾਹ ਭੋਗ ਿਨਤ  ਭੋਗੈ ਨਾ ਡੀਠਾ  ਨਾ ਸੰਮਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am called the happy soul-bride, O sister, but my Husband Lord has never met me.||23||
lines.transliteration: galee ha-o sohagan bh ainay kant  na kabahooN mai mili-aa. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਗਲੀ  ਹਉ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਭੈਣੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮੈ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Pappa: The Supreme King, the Transcendent Lord, created the world, and watchesover it.
lines.transliteration: papai paatisaahu parmaysar vaykh an ka-o parpanch kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ  ਕਉ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He sees and understands, and knows everything; inwardly and outwardly, he is fullypervading. ||24||
lines.transliteration: daykh ai boojh ai sabh  kichh  jaanai ant ar baahar rav rahi-aa. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Faffa: The whole world is caught in the noose of Death, and all are bound by itschains.
lines.transliteration: fafai faahee sabh jag faasaa jam kai sangal banDh  la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਫਫੈ ਫਾਹੀ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਸਾ  ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿਲ  ਬੰਿਧ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they alone are saved, who hurry to enter the Lord's Sanctuary.||25||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee say nar ubray je har sarnaagat  bhaj pa-i-aa. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸੇ ਨਰ ਉਬਰੇ  ਿਜ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ  ਭਿਜ ਪਇਆ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Babba: He set out to play the game, on the chess-board of the four ages. pMnw 434
lines.transliteration: babai baajee khaylan  laagaa cha-uparh  keetay chaar jugaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਾਰੀ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਪਾਸਾ  ਢਾਲਿਣ  ਆਿਪ  ਲਗਾ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: He made all beings and creatures his chessmen, and He Himself threw the dice. ||26||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  saaree keet ay paasaa dh aalan  aap lagaa. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਿਹ  ਸੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Bhabha: Those who search, find the fruits of their rewards; by Guru's Grace, they live in the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: bhabh ai bhaaleh say fal paavahi gur parsaadee jinH ka-o bh a-o pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਮੂੜੇ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, and they do not remember the Lord; thefools are consigned to the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations. ||27||
lines.transliteration: manmukh fireh na cheet eh moorh ay lakh  cha-oraaseeh fayr pa-i-aa. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਰਣੁ  ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਮਰਣੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਤਬ ਚੇਤਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: Mamma: In emotional attachment, he dies; he only thinks of the Lord, the Love ofNectar, when he dies.
lines.transliteration: mammai moh maran maDh usood an maran  bha-i-aa t ab chayt vi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਅਵਰੋ  ਪਿੜਆ  ਮੰਮਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵੀਸਿਰਆ ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: As long as the body is alive, he reads other things, and forgets the letter 'm', whichstands for marnaa - death. ||28||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa bheet ar avro parh i-aa mammaa akh ar veesri-aa. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਯਯੈ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਦ ਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Yaya: He is never reincarnated again, if he recognizes the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ya-yai janam na hovee kad hee jay kar sach pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਖੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh speaks, the Gurmukh understands, and the Gurmukh knows only theOne Lord. ||29||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aakh ai gurmukh  boojh ai gurmukh  ayko jaan ai. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੇਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਜੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Rarra: The Lord is contained among all; He created all beings.
lines.transliteration: raarai rav rahi-aa sabh ant ar jayt ay kee-ay jant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭ ਲਾਏ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਿਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Having created His beings, He has put them all to work; they alone remember the Naam, upon whom He bestows His Grace. ||30||
lines.transliteration: jant upaa-ay Dh anDhai sabh  laa-ay karam ho-aa t in naam la-i-aa. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਲਲੈ ਲਾਇ  ਧੰਧੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਛੋਡੀ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Lalla: He has assigned people to their tasks, and made the love of Maya seem sweetto them.
lines.transliteration: lalai laa-ay DhanDh ai jin chh odee meeth aa maa-i-aa moh kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਣਾ  ਪੀਣਾ  ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਸਹਣਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: We eat and drink; we should endure equally whatever occurs, by His Will, by HisCommand. ||31||
lines.transliteration: khaan aa peen aa sam kar sahn aa bh aanai taa kai hukam pa-i-aa. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ  ਕਉ ਿਜਿਨ  ਵੇਸੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wawa: The all-pervading Transcendent Lord beholds the world; He created the form itwears.
lines.transliteration: vavai vaasuday-o parmaysar vaykh an ka-o jin vays kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: He beholds, tastes, and knows everything; He is pervading and permeating inwardlyand outwardly. ||32|| VwVY rwiV krih ikAw pRwxI iqsih iDAwvhu ij Amru hoAw ] iqsih iDAwvhu sic smwvhu Esu
lines.transliteration: vaykhai chaakh ai sabh  kichh  jaanai ant ar baahar rav rahi-aa. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ੜਾੜੈ ਰਾਿੜ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਿਜ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Rarra: Why do you quarrel, O mortal? Meditate on the Imperishable Lord, and be absorbed into the True One. Become a sacrifice to Him. ||33||
lines.transliteration: rhaarh ai raarh  karahi ki-aa paraan ee tiseh Dh i-aavahu je amar ho-aa. t iseh Dh i- aavahu sach samaavahu os vitahu kurbaan kee-aa. ||33||

lines.english: Haha: There is no other Giver than Him; having created the creatures, He gives themnourishment.
lines.transliteration: haahai hor na ko-ee daat aa jee-a upaa-ay jin rijak d ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, be absorbed into the Lord's Name, and night and day, reap the Profit of the Lord's Name. ||34||
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aavahu har naam samaavahu an-d in laahaa har naam lee-aa. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ  ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: Airaa: He Himself created the world; whatever He has to do, He continues to do.
lines.transliteration: aa-irhai aap karay jin chh odee jo kichh  karnaa so kar rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇੜੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਛੋਡੀ ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੁ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: He acts, and causes others to act, and He knows everything; so says Nanak, the poet.||35||1|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 3 ptI  (434-13) raag aasaa mehlaa 3 patee Raag Aasaa, Third Mehl, Patee - The Alphabet: <> siqgur pRswid ] (434-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: karay karaa-ay sabh kichh  jaanai naanak saa-ir iv kahi-aa. ||35||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਇਰ  ਇਵ ਕਿਹਆ  ॥੩੫॥੧॥
lines.english: Ayo, Angai: The whole world which was created - Kaahkai, Ghangai: It shall passaway.
lines.transliteration: ayo anyai sabh  jag aa-i-aa kaakh ai ghanyai kaal bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਪਟੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Reeree, Laalee: People commit sins, and falling into vice, forget virtue. ||1||
lines.transliteration: reeree lalee paap kamaanay parh  avgan  gun veesri-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਯੋ ਅੰਙੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਇਆ  ਕਾਖੈ ਘੰਙੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, why have you studied such an account,
lines.transliteration: man aisaa laykhaa t ooN kee parh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੀਰੀ  ਲਲੀ  ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੇ  ਪਿੜ ਅਵਗਣ  ਗੁਣ ਵੀਸਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: laykhaa d aynaa tayrai sir rahi-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. which shall call you to answer for payment? ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਐਸਾ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਤੂੰ ਕੀ ਪਿੜਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sidhan, Ngaayiyai: You do not remember the Lord. Nanna: You do not take the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: siDhaNnyaa-ee-ai simrahi naahee nannai naa t uDh naam la-i-aa.

lines.english: Chhachha: You are wearing away, every night and day; you fool, how will you findrelease? You are held in the grip of death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chhachh ai chh eejeh ahinis moorh ay ki-o chh ooteh jam paakrh i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Babba: You do not understand, you fool; deluded by doubt, you are wasting your life.
lines.transliteration: babai boojheh naahee moorh ay bh aram bh ulay t ayraa janam ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧੰਙਾਇਐ  ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without justification, you call yourself a teacher; thus you take on the loads of others.||3||
lines.transliteration: anhod aa naa-o Dh araa-i-o paaDh aa avraa kaa bh aar tuDh la-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਛਛੈ ਛੀਜਿਹ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਮੂੜੇ ਿਕਉ  ਛੂਟਿਹ  ਜਿਮ ਪਾਕਿੜਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Jajja: You have been robbed of your Light, you fool; in the end, you shall have todepart, and you shall regret and repent.
lines.transliteration: jajai jot hir la-ee t ayree moorh ay ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaavhigaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਬੈ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੂੜੇ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You have not remembered the One Word of the Shabad, and so you shall have toenter the womb over and over again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad t ooN cheeneh naahee fir fir joonee aavhigaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ  ਨਾਉ  ਧਰਾਇਓ  ਪਾਧਾ ਅਵਰਾ  ਕਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Read that which is written on your forehead, O Pandit, and do not teach wickedness to others. pMnw 435
lines.transliteration: tuDh sir likh i-aa so parh  pandit  avraa no na sikh aal bikh i-aa.

lines.english: First, the teacher is tied down, and then, the noose is placed around the pupil's neck. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pahilaa faahaa pa-i-aa paaDhay pichh o day gal chaatrh i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਫਾਹਾ  ਪਇਆ  ਪਾਧੇ ਿਪਛੋ ਦੇ ਗਿਲ  ਚਾਟਿੜਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Sassa: You have lost your self-discipline, you fool, and you have accepted an offering under false pretenses.
lines.transliteration: sasai sanjam ga-i-o moorhay ayk d aan tuDh kuthaa-ay la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੈ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਗਇਓ  ਮੂੜੇ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ  ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment forperforming the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saa-ee putree jajmaan kee saa t ayree ayt  Dhaan kh aaDhai tayraa janam ga-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ੀ ਜਜਮਾਨ  ਕੀ ਸਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਏਤੁ ਧਾਿਨ  ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted withthe great disease of ego.
lines.transliteration: mammai mat hir la-ee t ayree moorh ay ha-umai vadaa rog pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਮੈ ਮਿਤ ਿਹਿਰ  ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourselffor the sake of Maya. ||7||
lines.transliteration: antar aat mai barahm na cheenHi-aa maa-i-aa kaa muht aaj bh a-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰ  ਆਤਮੈ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਨ ਚੀਿਨਆ  ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached topossessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kakai kaam kroDh bh armi-ohu moorh ay mamt aa laagay t uDh har visri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਭਰਿਮਓਹੁਮੂੜੇ ਮਮਤਾ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਵਸਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you aredrowned to death. ||8||
lines.transliteration: parheh gun eh tooN bahut  pukaareh vin  boojh ay tooN doob mu-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਪੜਿਹ ਗੁਣਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਹ  ਿਵਣੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Tatta: In anger, you are burnt, you fool. T'hat'ha: That place where you live, is cursed.
lines.transliteration: tatai taamas jali-ohu moorh ay thathai thaan bh arisat ho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਮਿਸ  ਜਿਲਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨ ਭਿਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Ghagha: You go begging from door to door, you fool. Dadda: But still, you do notreceive the gift. ||9||
lines.transliteration: ghagh ai ghar ghar fireh t ooN moorh ay dadai daan na t uDh la-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਘਘੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਦਦੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Pappa: You shall not be able to swim across, you fool, since you are engrossed inworldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: papai paar na pavhee moorhay parpanch t ooN palach rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪਵਹੀ  ਮੂੜੇ ਪਰਪੰਿਚ ਤੂੰ ਪਲਿਚ  ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself has ruined you, you fool; this is the destiny written on yourforehead. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sachai aap khu-aa-i-ohu moorh ay ih sir t ayrai laykh  pa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਇਓਹ ੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਇਹੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you havebecome engrossed in Maya.
lines.transliteration: bhabh ai bhavjal dubohu moorh ay maa-i-aa vich galt aan bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਭੈ ਭਵਜਿਲ  ਡੁਬੋਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਗਲਤਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who comes to know the One Lord, by Guru's Grace, is carried across in aninstant. ||11||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ayko jaanai ayk gh arhee meh paar pa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਏਕ ਘੜੀ  ਮਿਹ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Wawa: Your turn has come, you fool, but you have forgotten the Lord of Light.
lines.transliteration: vavai vaaree aa-ee-aa moorhay vaasud ay-o t uDh veesri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ  ਆਈਆ  ਮੂੜੇ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ  ਤੁਧੁ ਵੀਸਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: This opportunity shall not come again, you fool; you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||12||
lines.transliteration: ayh vaylaa na lehsahi moorhay fir t ooN jam kai vas pa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਨ ਲਹਸਿਹ  ਮੂੜੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਤੂੰ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਪਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.
lines.transliteration: jhajhai kad ay na jh ooreh moorh ay sat gur kaa upd ays sun  tooN vikhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਝਝੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰਿਹ  ਮੂੜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਸੁਿਣ ਤੂੰ ਿਵਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a badreputation. ||13||
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu gur nahee ko-ee niguray kaa hai naa-o buraa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਿਨਗੁਰੇ  ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ  ਬੁਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: DhaDh ai Dhaavat  varaj rakh  moorh ay ant ar tayrai niDh aan pa-i-aa. Dhadha: Restrain your wandering mind, you fool; deep within you the treasure is tobe found.

lines.punjabi: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ  ਵਰਿਜ  ਰਖੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord;throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hoveh t aa har ras peeveh jugaa jugant ar khaahi pa-i-aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਿਹ  ਜੁਗਾ  ਜੁਗੰਤਿਰ  ਖਾਿਹ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Gagga: Keep the Lord of the Universe in your mind, you fool; by mere words, no onehas ever attained Him.
lines.transliteration: gagai gobid chit  kar moorh ay galee kinai na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਿਬਦੁ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਲੀ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall beforgiven. ||15||
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan hirdai vasaa-ay moorh ay pichh lay gunah sabh  bakh as la-i-aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਸਾਇ  ਮੂੜੇ ਿਪਛਲੇ  ਗੁਨਹ  ਸਭ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternalpeace.
lines.transliteration: haahai har kathaa boojh t ooN moorh ay taa sad aa sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਬੂਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The more the self-willed manmukhs read, the more pain they suffer. Without the TrueGuru, liberation is not obtained. ||16||
lines.transliteration: manmukh parh eh taytaa dukh laagai vin  satgur mukat  na ho-ee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਤੇਤਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Rarra: Center your consciousness on the Lord, you fool; abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raarai raam chit kar moorh ay hird ai jinH kai rav rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਮੂੜੇ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, those who recognize the Lord, understand the absolute Lord. ||17||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jinHee raam pachhaat aa nirgun  raam t inHee boojh  lahi-aa. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਤਨੀ  ਬੂਿਝ ਲਿਹਆ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Your limits cannot be known; the indescribable Lord cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: tayraa ant  na jaa-ee lakh i-aa akath na jaa-ee har kathi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਲਿਖਆ  ਅਕਥੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਕਿਥਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whose who have met the True Guru, have their accounts settled.||18||1||2|| rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 CMq Gru 1 (435-18) raag aasaa mehlaa 1 chhant  ghar 1 Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (435-19) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jinH ka-o satgur mili-aa t inH kaa laykh aa nibrh i-aa. ||18||1||2||

lines.english: O beautiful young bride, my Beloved Lord is very playful.
lines.transliteration: munDh joban baalrh ee-ay mayraa pir ralee-aalaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan pir nayhu gh anaa ras pareet  da-i-aalaa raam. When the bride enshrines great love for her Husband Lord, He becomes merciful, andloves her in return. pMnw 436
Dhan pireh maylaa ho-ay su-aamee aap parabh  kirpaa karay. The soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when the Lord Master Himself showers His favor upon her.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਿਪਰਿਹ  ਮੇਲਾ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Her bed is decorated in the company of her Beloved, and her seven pools are filledwith ambrosial nectar.
lines.transliteration: sayjaa suhaavee sang pir kai saat sar amrit  bharay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਸਾਤ ਸਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Merciful True Lord, that I may obtain the Wordof the Shabad, and sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: kar da-i-aa ma-i-aa d a-i-aal saachay sabad  mil gun  gaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਓ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, gazing upon her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is delighted, and her mind isfilled with joy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naankaa har var daykh  bigsee munDh  man omaaha-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਿਬਗਸੀ  ਮੁੰਧ ਮਿਨ ਓਮਾਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O bride of natural beauty, offer your loving prayers to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: munDh sahj salonrh ee-ay ik paraym binant ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ  ਇਕ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is pleasing to my mind and body; I am intoxicated in my Lord God'sCompany.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan har bh aavai parabh  sangam raat ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਗਿਮ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Love of God, I pray to the Lord, and through the Lord's Name, Iabide in peace.
lines.transliteration: parabh paraym raat ee har binant ee naam har kai sukh  vasai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੁਿਖ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: If you recognize His Glorious Virtues, then you shall come to know God; thus virtueshall dwell in you, and sin shall run away.
lines.transliteration: ta-o gun  pachh aaneh taa parabh  jaaneh gun ah vas avgan  nasai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਤਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਗੁਣਹ  ਵਿਸ ਅਵਗਣ  ਨਸੈ ॥
lines.english: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant; by merely talking and listening about You, I am not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: tuDh baajh  ik til reh na saakaa kahan  sunan  na Dh eej-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ  ਕਹਿਣ ਸੁਨਿਣ  ਨ ਧੀਜਏ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak proclaims, "O Beloved, O Beloved!" His tongue and mind are drenched with theLord's sublime essence. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naankaa pari-o pari-o kar pukaaray rasan ras man bheej-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਕਿਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ  ਰਸਨ  ਰਿਸ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my companions and friends, my Husband Lord is the merchant.
lines.transliteration: sakheeho sahaylrh eeho mayraa pir van jaaraa raam.

lines.english: I have purchased the Lord's Name; its sweetness and value are unlimited.
lines.transliteration: har naamo vananjrh i-aa ras mol apaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਵਣੰਜਿੜਆ  ਰਿਸ ਮੋਿਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: His value is invaluable; the Beloved dwells in His true home. If it is pleasing to God,then He blesses His bride.
lines.transliteration: mol amolo sach ghar dh olo parabh  bhaavai t aa munDh  bhalee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਲ ਅਮੋਲੋ  ਸਚ ਘਿਰ  ਢੋਲੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਭਲੀ ॥
lines.english: Some enjoy sweet pleasures with the Lord, while I stand crying at His door.
lines.transliteration: ik sang har kai karahi ralee-aa ha-o pukaaree dar kh alee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਕਰਿਹ  ਰਲੀਆ  ਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ  ਦਿਰ ਖਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord Himself arranges our affairs.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath sareeDh ar aap kaaraj saar-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਾਰਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed is the soul-bride, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace; sheenshrines the Word of the Shabad in her heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree Dh an sohagan  sabad  abh saaDh aar-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਭ ਸਾਧਾਰਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In my home, the true songs of rejoicing resound; the Lord God, my Friend, has cometo me.
lines.transliteration: ham ghar saachaa sohilrh aa parabh  aa-i-arh ay meet aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਘਿਰ  ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਇਅੜੇ  ਮੀਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He enjoys me, and imbued with His Love, I have captivated His heart, and given mine to Him.
lines.transliteration: raavay rang raat-rh i-aa man lee-arh aa deetaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਿੜਆ  ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ  ਦੀਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I gave my mind, and obtained the Lord as my Husband; as it pleases His Will, Heenjoys me.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa man d ee-aa har var lee-aa ji-o bh aavai t i-o raav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਲੀਆ  ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have placed my body and mind before my Husband Lord, and through the Shabad, Ihave been blessed. Within the home of my own self, I have obtained the ambrosialfruit.
lines.transliteration: tan man pir aagai sabad  sabh aagai gh ar amrit  fal paav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਆਗੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਭਾਗੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: He is not obtained by intellectual recitation or great cleverness; only by love does the mind obtain Him.
lines.transliteration: buDh paath  na paa-ee-ai baho chat uraa-ee-ai bh aa-ay milai man bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਿਠ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈਐ  ਭਾਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Master is my Best Friend; I am not an ordinary person. ||4||1|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (436-13) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak thaakur meet  hamaaray ham naahee lokaan ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ  ਲੋਕਾਣੇ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds with the vibrations of the celestialinstruments.
lines.transliteration: anhado anhad  vaajai run  jhunkaaray raam.

lines.english: My mind, my mind is imbued with the Love of my Darling Beloved.
lines.transliteration: mayraa mano mayraa man raataa laal pi-aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦੋ  ਅਨਹਦੁ  ਵਾਜੈ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, my detached mind remains absorbed in the Lord, and I obtain my home in the profound trance of the celestial void.
lines.transliteration: an-din raat aa man bairaagee sunn mandal gh ar paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਲਾਲ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has revealed to me the Primal Lord, the Infinite, my Beloved, theUnseen.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  aprampar pi-aaraa sat gur alakh  lakhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਿਲ  ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's posture and His seat are permanent; my mind is absorbed in reflectivecontemplation upon Him.
lines.transliteration: aasan baisan  thir naaraa-in  tit man raat aa veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the detached ones are imbued with His Name, the unstruck melody, and thecelestial vibrations. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay bairaagee anhad  run jhunkaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਿਣ  ਬੈਸਿਣ  ਿਥਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me, how can I reach that unreachable, that unreachable city?
lines.transliteration: tit agam t it agam puray kaho kit  biDh jaa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By practicing truthfulness and self-restraint , by contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sach sanjamo saar gunaa gur sabad  kamaa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Practicing the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to the home of his own innerbeing, and obtains the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: sach sabad kamaa-ee-ai nij gh ar jaa-ee-ai paa-ee-ai gun ee niDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ  ਸਾਿਰ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He has no stems, roots, leaves or branches, but He is the Supreme Lord over theheads of all.
lines.transliteration: tit saakh aa mool pat  nahee daalee sir sabh naa parDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਈਐ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Practicing intensive meditation, chanting an d self-discipline, people have grown weary; stubbornly practicing these rituals, they still have not found Him.
lines.transliteration: jap tap kar kar sanjam thaakee hath  nigrahi nahee paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਾਖਾ  ਮੂਲੁ ਪਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਲੀ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਪਰਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through spiritual wisdom, the Lord, the Life of the world, is met; the TrueGuru imparts this understanding. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak sahj milay jagjeevan satgur boojh  bujhaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਸੰਜਮ  ਥਾਕੀ ਹਿਠ ਿਨਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the ocean, the mountain of jewels, overflowing with jewels. pMnw 437
lines.transliteration: gur saagro ratnaagar t it ratan gh anayray raam.

lines.english: Take your bath in the seven seas, O my mind, and become pure.
lines.transliteration: kar majno sapat saray man nirmal mayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਮਜਨੋ  ਸਪਤ  ਸਰੇ ਮਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
