lines.english: One bathes in the water of purity when it is pleasing to God, and obtains the five virtues by reflective meditation.
lines.transliteration: nirmal jal nHaa-ay jaa parabh bh aa-ay panch milay veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜਿਲ  ਨਾਏ ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਿਮਲੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, deceit and corruption, he enshrines the True Namein his heart.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh kapat bikh i-aa taj sach naam ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ  ਕਪਟੁ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਤਿਜ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: When the waves of ego, greed and avarice subside, he finds the Lord Master, Mercifulto the meek.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai lobh lahar lab thaakay paa-ay d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਲੋਭ ਲਹਿਰ ਲਬ ਥਾਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there is no place of pilgrimage comparable to the Guru; the True Guru is theLord of the world. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak gur samaan tirath nahee ko-ee saachay gur gopaalaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have searched the jungles and forests, and looked upon all the fields.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ban bano daykh  rahee t arin daykh sabaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੋ ਦੇਿਖ ਰਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਣੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: You created the three worlds, the entire universe, everything.
lines.transliteration: taribh avno tujheh kee-aa sabh  jagat  sabaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣੋ  ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: You created everything; You alone are permanent. Nothing is equal to You.
lines.transliteration: tayraa sabh  kee-aa t ooN thir thee-aa t uDh samaan ko naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ  ਤੂੰ ਿਥਰੁ ਥੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver - all are Your beggars; without You, who should we praise?
lines.transliteration: tooN daataa sabh  jaachik t ayray t uDh bin kis saalaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭ ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: You bestow Your gifts, even when we do not ask for them, O Great Giver; devotion to You is a treasure over-flowing.
lines.transliteration: anmangi-aa d aan d eejai d aatay tayree bh agat bharay bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਣਮੰਿਗਆ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation; so says Nanak, the meek. ||4||2|| Awsw mhlw 1 ] (437-7) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na ho-ee naanak kahai veechaaraa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind, my mind is attuned to the Love of my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayraa mano mayraa man raataa raam pi-aaray raam.

lines.english: The True Lord Master, the Primal Being, the Infinite One, is the Support of the earth.
lines.transliteration: sach saahibo aad purakh  aprampro Dh aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He is unfathomable, unapproachable, infinite and incomparable. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Lord above all.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar apar apaaraa paarbarahm parDhaano.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੋ  ਆਿਦ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ  ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He is the Lord, from the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore; knowthat all else is false.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee hai bh ee hosee avar jh oothaa sabh  maano.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰਧਾਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: If one does not appreciate the value of good deeds and Dharmic faith, how can oneobtain clarity of consciousness and liberation?
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam kee saar na jaan ai surat  mukat  ki-o paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad; night and day, he meditateson the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sabad  pachh aanai ahinis naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: My mind, my mind has come to accept, that the Naam is our only Friend.
lines.transliteration: mayraa mano mayraa man maani-aa naam sakhaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Egotism, worldly attachment, and the lures of Maya shall not go with you.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa maa-i-aa sang na jaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Mother, father, famliy, children, cleverness, property and spouses - none of these shallgo with you.
lines.transliteration: maataa pit  bhaa-ee sut  chaturaa-ee sang na sampai naaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have renounced Maya, the daughter of the ocean; reflecting upon reality, I havetrampled it under my feet.
lines.transliteration: saa-ir kee putree parhar t i-aagee charan  talai veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤਾ  ਿਪਤ ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਤ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord has revealed this wondrous show; wherever I look, there I see Him.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  ik chalat  dikhaa-i-aa jah d aykhaa tah so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਇਰ  ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰ੍ੀ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਿਤਆਗੀ  ਚਰਣ  ਤਲੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I shall not forsake the Lord's devotional worship; in the natural course, what shall be, shall be. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak har kee bhagat  na chh oda-o sehjay ho-ay so ho-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: My mind, my mind has become immaculately pure, contemplating the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayraa mano mayraa man nirmal saach samaalay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਛੋਡਉ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have dispelled my vices, and now I walk in the company of the virtuous.
lines.transliteration: avgan mayt chalay gun  sangam naalay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Discarding my vices, I do good deeds, and in the True Court, I am judged as true.
lines.transliteration: avgan parhar karn ee saaree d ar sachai sachi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਮੇਿਟ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮ  ਨਾਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My coming and going has come to an end; as Gurmukh, I reflect upon the nature ofreality.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaavan  thaak rahaa-ay gurmukh  tat veechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰੀ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O my Dear Friend, You are my all-knowing companion; grant me the glory of YourTrue Name.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sujaan  sakhaa tooN sach milai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਵਣੁ  ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਹਾਏ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam has been revealed to me; such are the Teachings Ihave received from the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratan pargaasi-aa aisee gurmat  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have carefully applied the healing ointment to my eyes, and I am attuned to theImmaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach anjno anjan saar niranjan raataa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਐਸੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He is permeating my mind and body, the Life of the world, the Lord, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: man tan rav rahi-aa jagjeevano d aataa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਅੰਜਨੋ  ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਿਰ  ਿਨਰੰਜਿਨ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My mind is imbued with the Lord, the Great Giver, the Life of the world; I have merged and blended with Him, with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan daat aa har man raat aa sahj milai maylaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, and the Saints' Society, by God's Grace, peace isobtained.
lines.transliteration: saaDh sabh aa sant aa kee sangat  nadar parabh oo sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The renunciates remain absorbed in devotional worship to the Lord; they are rid ofemotional attachment and desire.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  ratay bairaagee chookay moh pi-aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, how rare is that unattached servant, who conquers his ego, and remainspleased with the Lord. ||4||3|| pMnw 438 rwgu Awsw mhlw 1 CMq Gru 2 (438-1) raag aasaa mehlaa 1 chhant  ghar 2 Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (438-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai maar pateen ay virlay d aas ud aasaa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: tooN sabh nee thaa-ee jithai ha-o jaa-ee saachaa sirjan haar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ  ਥਾਈ  ਿਜਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰ ੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of all, the Architect of Destiny, the Dispeller of distress.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa d aataa karam biDh aataa dookh bisaaran haar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਦੂਖ ਿਬਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Master is the Dispeller of distress; all that happens is by His doing.
lines.transliteration: dookh  bisaaran haar su-aamee keet aa jaa kaa hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਿਬਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Millions upon millions of sins, He destroys in an instant.
lines.transliteration: kot kotantar paapaa kayray ayk gh arhee meh kh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਪਾਪਾ  ਕੇਰੇ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ  ਮਿਹ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He calls a swan a swan, and a crane a crane; He contemplates each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: hans se hansaa bag se bagaa ghat gh at karay beechaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸ ਿਸ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਿਸ ਬਗਾ  ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN sabh nee thaa-ee jithai ha-o jaa-ee saachaa sirjan haar jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ  ਥਾਈ ਿਜਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰ ੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world.
lines.transliteration: jinH ik man Dhi-aa-i-aa t inH sukh  paa-i-aa t ay virlay sansaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਿਵਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who live the Guru's Teachings;they never return defeated.
lines.transliteration: tin jam nayrh  na aavai gur sabad  kamaavai kabahu na aavahi haar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਹਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who appreciate the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, never suffer defeat;the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.
lines.transliteration: tay kabahu na haareh har har gun  saareh t inH jam nayrh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death are ended for those who are attached to the feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  tinHaa kaa chookaa jo har laagay paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਾ ਚੂਕਾ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਗੇ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, and the fruit of the Lord; they enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: gurmat har ras har fal paa-i-aa har har naam ur Dh aar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jinH ik man Dhi-aa-i-aa t inH sukh  paa-i-aa t ay virlay sansaar jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - unto Him I am a sacrifice.
lines.transliteration: jin jagat upaa-i-aa Dh anDhai laa-i-aa t isai vitahu kurbaan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸੈ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: So serve Him, and gather profit, and you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: taa kee sayv kareejai laahaa leejai har d argeh paa-ee-ai maan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਲੀਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being, who recognizes the One Lord alone, obtains honor in the Court ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: har dargeh maan so-ee jan paavai jo nar ayk pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who meditates on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, obtains the ninetreasures; he chants and repeats continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: oh nav niDh paavai gurmat  har Dh i-aavai nit  har gun  aakh  vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁ ਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਿਨਤ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, take the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the most sublime Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam tisai kaa leejai har oot am purakh  parDh aan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮੁ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin jagat upaa-i-aa Dh anDhai laa-i-aa ha-o t isai vitahu kurbaan jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਿਤਸੈ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life.
lines.transliteration: naam lain se soheh tin sukh  fal hoveh maaneh say jin  jaahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਿਨ  ਿਸ ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਸੇ ਿਜਿਣ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Their blessings are not exhausted, if it pleases the Lord, even though numerous agesmay pass.
lines.transliteration: tin fal t ot na aavai jaa t is bhaavai jay jug kayt ay jaahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਫਲ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Even though numerous ages may pass, O Lord Master, their blessings are notexhausted.
lines.transliteration: jay jug kaytay jaahi su-aamee t in fal t ot na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਿਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਫਲ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: They do not age, they do not die and fall into hell, if they meditate on the Naam, theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tinH jaraa na marn aa narak na parn aa jo har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਨ ਪਰਣਾ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, do not wither, O Nanak; they are notafflicted by pain.
lines.transliteration: har har karahi se sookeh naahee naanak peerh na kh aahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਸ ਸੂਕਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੀੜ ਨ ਖਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life. ||4||1||4|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (438-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw mhlw 1 CMq Gru 3 ] (438-18) aasaa mehlaa 1 chhant  ghar 3. Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Third House:
lines.transliteration: naam lainiH se soheh tinH sukh  fal hoveh maaneh say jin  jaahi jee-o. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਿਨ  ਿਸ ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਸੇ ਿਜਿਣ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Listen, O black deer: why are you so attached to the orchard of passion?
lines.transliteration: tooN sun harnaa kaali-aa kee vaarh ee-ai raat aa raam.

lines.english: The fruit of sin is sweet for only a few days, and then it grows hot and bitter.
lines.transliteration: bikh fal meeth aa chaar d in fir hovai t aataa raam.

lines.english: That fruit which intoxicated you has now become bitter and painful, without the Naam. pMnw 439
lines.transliteration: fir ho-ay taat aa kh araa maat aa naam bin part aapa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਜੇਵ ਸਾਇਰ  ਦੇਇ ਲਹਰੀ  ਿਬਜੁਲ  ਿਜਵੈ ਚਮਕਏ  ॥
lines.english: It is temporary, like the waves on the sea, and the flash of lightning.
lines.transliteration: oh jayv saa-ir day-ay lahree bijul jivai chamka-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਰਾਖਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਿਬਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, there is no other protector, but you have forgotten Him.
lines.transliteration: har baajh raakh aa ko-ay naahee so-ay t ujheh bisaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਿਹ  ਹਰਣਾ  ਕਾਿਲਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O black deer. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak chayt ray man mareh harn aa kaali-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਰਾ  ਫੂਿਲ ਭਵੰਿਤਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O bumble bee, you wander among the flowers, but terrible pain awaits you.
lines.transliteration: bhavraa fool bh avant i-aa d ukh at bhaaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਿਛਆ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have asked my Guru for true understanding.
lines.transliteration: mai gur poochhi-aa aapn aa saachaa beechaaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਪੂਿਛਆ  ਭਵਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ  ਰਾਤਓ  ॥
lines.english: I have asked my True Guru for understanding about the bumble bee, who is so involved with the flowers of the garden.
lines.transliteration: beechaar satgur mujh ai poochh i-aa bh avar baylee raat a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚਿੜਆ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਿੜਆ  ਤੇਲੁ ਤਾਵਿਣ  ਤਾਤਓ  ॥
lines.english: When the sun rises, the body will fall, and it will be cooked in hot oil.
lines.transliteration: sooraj charhi-aa pind parh i-aa tayl taavan  taata-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਮਿਗ ਬਾਧਾ  ਖਾਿਹ  ਚੋਟਾ ਸਬਦ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬੇਤਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: You shall be bound and beaten on the road of Death, without the Word of the Shabad, O madman.
lines.transliteration: jam mag baaDhaa kh aahi chotaa sabad  bin bayt aali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਿਹ  ਭਵਰਾ  ਕਾਿਲਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O bumble bee. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak chayt ray man mareh bh avraa kaali-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅਿੜਆ  ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ  ਿਕਤੁ  ਪਵਿਹ  ਜੰਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O my stranger soul, why do you fall into entanglements?
lines.transliteration: mayray jee-arhi-aa pard aysee-aa kit  paveh janjaalay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਿਹ  ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The True Lord abides within your mind; why are you trapped by the noose of Death?
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib man vasai kee faaseh jam jaalay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀ  ਨੈਣ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਜਾਲੁ  ਬਿਧਿਕ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The fish leaves the water with tearful eyes, when the fisherman casts his net.
lines.transliteration: machhulee vichh unnee nain  runnee jaal baDh ik paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The love of Maya is sweet to the world, but in the end, this delusion is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sansaar maa-i-aa moh meethaa ant  bharam chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਛੋਿਡ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: So perform devotional worship, link your consciousness to the Lord, and dispel anxiety from your mind.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kar chit  laa-ay har si-o chh od manhu and aysi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਰੇ ਮਨ ਜੀਅਿੜਆ  ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the Truth; focus your consciousness on the Lord, O my stranger soul.||3||
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak chayt ray man jee-arh i-aa pard aysee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The rivers and streams which separate may sometime be united again.
lines.transliteration: nadee-aa vaah vichh unni-aa maylaa sanjogee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਵਸੁ ਭਰੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In age after age, that which is sweet, is full of poison; how rare is the Yogi who understands this.
lines.transliteration: jug jug meethaa vis bh aray ko jaan ai jogee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ ਿਜਿਨ  ਚੇਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: That rare person who centers his consciousness on the True Guru, knows intuitivelyand realizes the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee sahj jaanai har pachh aanai sat guroo jin chayt i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਿਹ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਅਚੇਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the thoughtless fools wander in doubt, andare ruined.
lines.transliteration: bin naam har kay bharam bh oolay pacheh mugaDh  achayt i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਧਾਹੀ  ਰੁੰਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are not touched by devotional worship and the Name of the TrueLord, shall weep and wail loudly in the end.
lines.transliteration: har naam bhagat  na rid ai saachaa say ant  Dhaahee runni-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਚਰੀ  ਿਵਛੁੰਿਨਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the Truth; through the True Word of the Shabad, those long separatedfrom the Lord, are united once again. ||4||1||5|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (439-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw mhlw 3 CMq Gru 1 ] (439-12) aasaa mehlaa 3 chhant  ghar 1. Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, First House:
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak sabad saachai mayl chiree vichh unni-aa. ||4||1||5||

lines.english: Within my home, the true wedding songs of rejoicing are sung; my home is adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ham gharay saachaa sohilaa saachai sabad  suhaa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: Dhan pir mayl bh a-i-aa parabh  aap milaa-i-aa raam. The soul-bride has met her Husband Lord; God Himself has consummated this union.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਘਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God Himself has consummated this union; the soul-bride enshrines Truth within hermind, intoxicated with peaceful poise.
lines.transliteration: parabh aap milaa-i-aa sach man vasaa-i-aa kaaman  sehjay maat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਿਪਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and beautified with Truth, sheenjoys her Beloved forever, imbued with His Love.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad seegaaree sach savaaree sad aa raavay rang raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Eradicating her ego, she obtains her Husband Lord, and then, the sublime essence ofthe Lord dwells within her mind.
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-ay har var paa-ay taa har ras man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੀ  ਸਿਚ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, fruitful and prosperous is her entire life; she is embellished with the Wordof the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur sabad savaaree safli-o janam sabaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride who has been led astray by duality and doubt, does not attain herHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojrh ai kaaman  bharam bh ulee har var na paa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ਸਫਿਲਉ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That soul-bride has no virtue, and she wastes her life in vain.
lines.transliteration: kaaman gun  naahee birthaa janam gavaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੜੈ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੀ ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed, ignorant and disgraceful manmukh wastes her life in vain, and in the end, she comes to grief.
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam gavaa-ay manmukh i-aan ee a-ugan vantee jhooray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: But when she serves her True Guru, she obtains peace, and then she meets herHusband Lord, face to face.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa sat gur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa t aa pir mili-aa had ooray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਇਆਣੀ  ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ  ਝੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Beholding her Husband Lord, she blossoms forth; her heart is delighted, and she isbeautified by the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: daykh  pir vigsee and rahu sarsee sachai sabad  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਹਦੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, the soul-bride wanders around, deluded by doubt. Meeting her Beloved, she obtains peace. ||2|| pMnw 440
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai kaaman  bharam bh ulaan ee mil pareet am sukh  paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The soul-bride knows that her Husband Lord is with her; the Guru unites her in this union.
lines.transliteration: pir sang kaaman jaan i-aa gur mayl milaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Within her heart, she is merged with the Shabad, and the fire of her desire is easilyextinguished.
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  milee sehjay t apat bujhaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੀ ਸਹਜੇ  ਤਪਿਤ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Shabad has quenched the fire of desire, and within her heart, peace andtranquility have come; she tastes the Lord's essence with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: sabad t apat bujhaa-ee ant ar saaNt aa-ee sehjay har ras chaakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਤਪਿਤ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting her Beloved, she enjoys His Love continually, and her speech rings with the True Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam apn ay sad aa rang maan ay sachai sabad  subh aakhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅਪਣੇ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: Reading and studying continually, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silentsages have grown weary; wearing religious robes, liberation is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  monee thaakay bh aykhee mukat  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮੋਨੀ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without devotional worship, the world has gone insane; through the TrueWord of the Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin bhagt ee jag ba-uraanaa sachai sabad  milaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Bliss permeates the mind of the soul-bride, who meets her Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan man anad  bha-i-aa har jee-o mayl pi-aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is enraptured with the sublime essence of the Lord, through theincomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan har kai ras rasee gur kai sabad  apaaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰਿਸ ਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad, she meets her Beloved; shecontinually contemplates and enshrines His Glorious Virtues in her mind.
lines.transliteration: sabad apaaray milay pi-aaray sad aa gun  saaray man vasay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Her bed was adorned when she enjoyed her Husband Lord; meeting with her Beloved,her demerits were erased.
lines.transliteration: sayj suhaavee jaa pir raavee mil pareetam avgan  nasay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਜਾ ਿਪਿਰ  ਰਾਵੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਨਸੇ ॥
lines.english: That house, within which the Lord's Name is continually meditated upon, resoundswith the wedding songs of rejoicing, throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: jit ghar naam har sad aa Dh i-aa-ee-ai sohilrh aa jug chaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਘਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, we are in bliss forever; meeting the Lord, our affairs are resolved. ||4||1||6|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (440-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw mhlw 3 CMq Gru 3 ] (440-8) aasaa mehlaa 3 chhant  ghar 3. Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, Third House:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sad aa anad  hai har mili-aa kaaraj saaray. ||4||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: O my beloved friend, dedicate yourself to the devotional worship of your HusbandLord.
lines.transliteration: saajan mayray pareetmahu t um sah kee bh agat karayho.

lines.english: Serve your Guru constantly, and obtain the wealth of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvhu sadaa aapn aa naam pad aarath layho.

lines.english: Dedicate yourself to the worship of your Husband Lord; this is pleasing to yourBeloved Husband.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karahu t um sahai kayree jo sah pi-aaray bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇਹੋ  ॥
lines.english: If you walk in accordance with your own will, then your Husband Lord will not bepleased with you.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa bh aanaa tum karahu t aa fir sah kh usee na aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਲੇਹੋ ॥
lines.english: This path of loving devotional worship is very difficult; how rare are those who find it,through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaav ih maarag bikh -rhaa gur d u-aarai ko paav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, that one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, links his consciousness to the worship of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jis karay kirpaa so har bhagt ee chit  laav-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਭਾਣਾ  ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਿਫਿਰ  ਸਹ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: O my detached mind, unto whom do you show your detachment?
lines.transliteration: mayray man bairaagee-aa tooN bairaag kar kis d ikhaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਵ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਿਬਖੜਾ  ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord live in the joy of the Lord, forever andever.
lines.transliteration: har sohilaa tinH sad sadaa jo har gun  gaavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So become detached, and renounce hypocrisy; Your Husband Lord knows everything.
lines.transliteration: kar bairaag tooN chhod pakh and so saho sabh  kichh  jaan-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ  ਤੂੰ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਸੁ ਿਦਖਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Gurmukh realizes theCommand of His Will.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al ayko so-ee gurmukh hukam pachh aan-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਿਤਨ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One who realizes the Lord's Command, obtains all peace and comforts.
lines.transliteration: jin hukam pachhaat aa haree kayraa so-ee sarab sukh  paav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਤੂੰ ਛੋਿਡ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਏ  ॥
lines.english: Thus says Nanak: such a detached soul remains absorbed in the Lord's Love, day andnight. ||2||
lines.transliteration: iv kahai naanak so bairaagee an-din har liv laav-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever you wander, O my mind, the Lord is there with you.
lines.transliteration: jah jah man tooN Dhaavdaa tah tah har t ayrai naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce your cleverness, O my mind, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: man si-aanap chh odee-ai gur kaa sabad  samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਵ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your Husband Lord is always with you, if you remember the Lord's Name, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: saath tayrai so saho sad aa hai ik kh in har naam samaalhay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ  ਤਹ ਤਹ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The sins of countless incarnations shall be washed away, and in the end, you shallobtain the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay tayray paap katay ant  param pad  paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: You shall be linked to the True Lord, and as Gurmukh, remember Him forever.
lines.transliteration: saachay naal tayraa gandh  laagai gurmukh  sadaa samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਥ  ਤੇਰੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Thus says Nanak: wherever you go, O my mind, the Lord is there with you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak jah man tooN Dhaavdaa tah har t ayrai sad aa naalay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind is held steady; it comes to abide in itsown home.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai Dh aavat  thamiH-aa nij gh ar vasi-aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਿਲ  ਤੇਰਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: It purchases the Naam, chants the Naam, and remains absorbed in the Naam. pMnw 441
lines.transliteration: naam vihaajhay naam la-ay naam rahay samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਥੰਿਮਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਦਸਵਾ  ਦੁਆਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  thamiH-aa sat gur mili-ai d asvaa d u-aar paa-i-aa. The outgoing, wandering soul, upon meeting the True Guru, opens the Tenth Gate.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਥੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਥੰਿਮ ਰਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There, Ambrosial Nectar is food and the celestial music resounds; the world is held spell-bound by the music of the Word.
lines.transliteration: tithai amrit  bhojan sahj Dh un upjai jit  sabad  jagat  thamiH rahaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ  ਵਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ  ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The many strains of the unstruck melody resound there, as one merges in Truth.
lines.transliteration: tah anayk vaajay sad aa anad  hai sachay rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਥੰਿਮਆ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਆਏ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Thus says Nanak: by meeting the True Guru, the wandering soul becomes steady, and comes to dwell in the home of its own self. ||4||
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak satgur mili-ai Dh aavat  thamiH-aa nij gh ar vasi-aa aa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ  ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, you are the embodiment of the Divine Light - recognize your own origin.
lines.transliteration: man tooN jot saroop hai aapn aa mool pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, the Dear Lord is with you; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.
lines.transliteration: man har jee tayrai naal hai gurmat ee rang maan .

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਤ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਮਰਣ  ਜੀਵਣ  ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Acknowledge your origin, and then you shall know your Husband Lord, and sounderstand death and birth.
lines.transliteration: mool pachhaan eh taaN saho jaan eh maran  jeevan  kee sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਤ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, know the One; then, you shall not love any other.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ayko jaaneh t aaN doojaa bh aa-o na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ  ਤਾ ਹੋਆ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Peace comes to the mind, and gladness resounds; then, you shall be acclaimed.
lines.transliteration: man saaNt aa-ee vajee vaDh aa-ee t aa ho-aa parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਹੈ ਅਪਣਾ  ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Thus says Nanak: O my mind, you are the very image of the Luminous Lord;recognize the true origin of your self. ||5||
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak man tooN jot saroop hai apn aa mool pachh aan. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਿਬ  ਅਿਟਆ  ਗਾਰਿਬ  ਲਿਦਆ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, you are so full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart.
lines.transliteration: man tooN gaarab ati-aa gaarab lad i-aa jaahi.

lines.english: The fascinating Maya has fascinated you, over and over again, and lured you into reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohnee mohi-aa fir fir joonee bh avaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਰਿਬ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਮਨ ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Clinging to pride, you shall depart, O foolish mind, and in the end, you shall regretand repent.
lines.transliteration: gaarab laagaa jaahi mugaDh man ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaavhay.

lines.english: You are afflicted with the diseases of ego and desire, and you are wasting your lifeaway in vain.
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaar tisnaa rog lagaa birthaa janam gavaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord, and shall regret andrepent hereafter.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mugaDh  cheet eh naahee agai ga-i-aa pachh utaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਿਬ  ਅਿਟਆ  ਗਾਰਿਬ  ਲਿਦਆ  ਜਾਵਹੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Thus says Nanak: O mind, you are full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart.||6||
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak man tooN gaarab ati-aa gaarab lad i-aa jaavhay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਤ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਜ ਹਉ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਨਮਾਣਾ  ਹੋਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O mind, don't be so proud of yourself, as if you know it all; the Gurmukh is humbleand modest.
lines.transliteration: man tooN mat maan  karahi je ha-o kichh  jaand aa gurmukh  nimaan aa hohu.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਹਉ ਬੁਿਧ ਹੈ ਸਿਚ ਸਬਿਦ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Within the intellect are ignorance and ego; through the True Word of the Shabad, thisfilth is washed off.
lines.transliteration: antar agi-aan ha-o buDh  hai sach sabad  mal kh ohu.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਨਮਾਣਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਅਗੈ ਮਤ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੁ  ਲਖਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: So be humble, and surrender to the True Guru; do not attach your identity to yourego.
lines.transliteration: hohu nimaanaa sat guroo agai mat  kichh  aap lakh aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਜਿਲਆ  ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: The world is consumed by ego and self-identity; see this, lest you lose your own self as well.
lines.transliteration: aapnai ahaNkaar jagat  jali-aa mat  tooN aapn aa aap gavaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਿਹ  ਕਾਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Make yourself follow the Sweet Will of the True Guru; remain attached to His SweetWill.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai karahi kaar sat gur kai bh aanai laag rahu.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪੁ  ਛਿਡ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਨ ਿਨਮਾਣਾ  ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Thus says Nanak: renounce your ego and self-conceit, and obtain peace; let yourmind abide in humility. ||7||
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak aap chhad sukh  paavahi man nimaan aa ho-ay rahu. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਿਚਿਤ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so vaylaa jit  mai sat gur mili-aa so saho chit  aa-i-aa. Blessed is that time, when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into myconsciousness.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I became so very blissful, and my mind and body found such a natural peace.
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand sahj bha-i-aa man t an sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਇਆ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਵਗਣ  ਸਿਭ ਿਵਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord came into my consciousness; I enshrined Him within my mind, and Irenounced all vice.
lines.transliteration: so saho chit aa-i-aa man vasaa-i-aa avgan  sabh  visaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟ  ਹੋਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleased Him, virtues appeared in me, and the True Guru Himself adorned me.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aanaa gun  pargat ho-ay sat gur aap savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੋਏ ਿਜਨੀ  ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਿੜਆ  ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings become acceptable, who cling to the One Name and renounce the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: say jan parvaan ho-ay jinHee ik naam d irhi-aa d utee-aa bh aa-o chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Thus says Nanak: blessed is the time when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness. ||8||
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak Dhan so vaylaa jit  mai sat gur mili-aa so saho chit  aa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਜੰਤ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੇ ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Some people wander around, deluded by doubt; their Husband Lord Himself hasmisled them.
lines.transliteration: ik jant bh aram bh ulay t in seh aap bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: They wander around in the love of duality, and they do their deeds in ego.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay fireh ha-umai karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਕੁਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Their Husband Lord Himself has misled them, and put them on the path of evil.Nothing lies in their power.
lines.transliteration: tin seh aap bh ulaa-ay kumaarag paa-ay t in kaa kichh  na vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ ਅਵਗਿਤ  ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹ ਰਚਨ  ਰਚਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You alone know their ups and downs, You, who created the creation.
lines.transliteration: tin kee gat  avgat  tooNhai jaan eh jin ih rachan rachaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Command of Your Will is very strict; how rare is the Gurmukh who understands.
lines.transliteration: hukam tayraa kh araa bh aaraa gurmukh  kisai bujh aa-ay.

lines.english: Thus says Nanak: what can the poor creatures do, when You mislead them into doubt? ||9|| pMnw 442
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak ki-aa jant vichaaray jaa t uDh bharam bh ulaa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰੇ  ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: O My True Lord Master, True is Your glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: sachay mayray saahibaa sachee tayree vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Lord and Master. Your creative power cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: tooN paarbarahm bay-ant  su-aamee t ayree kud rat kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: True is Your glorious greatness; when You enshrine it within the mind, one sings YourGlorious Praises forever.
lines.transliteration: sachee tayree vadi-aa-ee jaa ka-o t uDh man vasaa-ee sad aa tayray gun  gaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: He sings Your Glorious Praises, when it is pleasing to You, O True Lord; he centers hisconsciousness on You.
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  gaavahi jaa t uDh bhaaveh sachay si-o chit  laavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: One whom You unite with Yourself, as Gurmukh, remains absorbed in You.
lines.transliteration: jis no tooN aapay mayleh so gurmukh  rahai samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲਿਹ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: ||10||2||7||5||2||7|| Thus says Nanak: O my True Lord Master, True is Your Glorious Greatness.||10||2||7||5||2||7|| rwgu Awsw CMq mhlw 4 Gru 1 (442-5) raag aasaa chhant  mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 Raag Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (442-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: i-o kahai naanak sachay mayray saahibaa sachee tayree vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧੦॥੨॥੭॥੫॥੨॥੭॥
lines.english: Life - I have found real life, as Gurmukh, through His Love.
lines.transliteration: jeevno mai jeevan paa-i-aa gurmukh bh aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ  ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name - He has given me the Lord's Name, and enshrined it within my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: har naamo har naam dayvai mayrai paraan vasaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨੋ  ਮੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har within my breath of lfe, and all mydoubts and sorrows have departed.
lines.transliteration: har har naam mayrai paraan vasaa-ay sabh sansaa d ookh gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਿਨ  ਵਸਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have meditated on the invisible and unapproachable Lord, through the Guru's Word,and I have obtained the pure, supreme status.
lines.transliteration: adisat agochar gur bachan Dh i-aa-i-aa pavit ar param pad  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਿਨ  ਵਸਾਏ  ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody resounds, and the instruments ever vibrate, singing the Bani ofthe True Guru.
lines.transliteration: anhad Dh un vaajeh nit  vaajay gaa-ee sat gur ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਦਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God the Great Giver has given me a gift; He has blended my light into theLight. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak daat  karee parabh  daatai jotee jot  samaan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਵਾਜਿਹ  ਿਨਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਗਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs die in their self-willed stubbornness, declaring that thewealth of Maya is theirs.
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa manmukh  mu-ay mayree kar maa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਦਾਤੈ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which comes for amoment, and departs in an instant.
lines.transliteration: khin aavai kh in jaavai d urganDh  marh ai chit  laa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮੁਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which is transitory,like the fading color of the safflower.
lines.transliteration: laa-i-aa durganDh  marh ai chit  laagaa ji-o rang kasumbh  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਆਵੈ  ਿਖਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ  ਮੜੈ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One moment, they are facing east, and the next instant, they are facing west; they continue spinning around, like the potter's wheel.
lines.transliteration: khin poorab kh in pachh am chh aa-ay ji-o chak kumHi-aar bh avaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਇਆ  ਦੁਰਗੰਧ  ਮੜੈ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਜਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In sorrow, they eat, and in sorrow, they gather things and try to enjoy them, but they only increase their stores of sorrow.
lines.transliteration: dukh khaaveh d ukh saNcheh bh ogeh d ukh kee biraDh  vaDh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਖਨੁ ਪਛਿਮ  ਛਾਏ ਿਜਉ  ਚਕੁ ਕੁਿਮਆਿਰ  ਭਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one easily crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, when he comes to theSanctuary of the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak bikham suhaylaa t aree-ai jaa aavai gur sarn aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵਿਹ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਚਿਹ  ਭੋਗਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਵਧਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord, my Lord Master is sublime, unapproachable and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: mayraa thaakuro th aakur neekaa agam athaahaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਜਾ ਆਵੈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord - I seek the wealth of the Lord, from my True Guru, the DivineBanker.
lines.transliteration: har poojee har poojee chaahee mayray satgur saahaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੀਕਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਥਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I seek the wealth of the Lord, to purchase the Naam; I sing and love the GloriousPraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har poojee chaahee naam bisaahee gun gaavai gun  bhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੂਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have totally renounced sleep and hunger, and through deep meditation, I amabsorbed into the Absolute Lord.
lines.transliteration: need bh ookh sabh  parhar t i-aagee sunnay sunn samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਬਸਾਹੀ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The traders of one kind come and take away the Name of the Lord as their profit.
lines.transliteration: vanjaaray ik bh aatee aavahi laahaa har naam lai jaahay.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਦ  ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਿਤਆਗੀ  ਸੁੰਨੇ ਸੁੰਿਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, dedicate your mind and body to the Guru; one who is so destined, attains it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak man tan arap gur aagai jis paraapat  so paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੇ ॥
lines.english: The great ocean is full of the treasures of jewels upon jewels.
lines.transliteration: ratnaa rat an pad aarath baho saagar bh ari-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਪਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani, see them come into theirhands.
lines.transliteration: banee gurbaan ee laagay t inH hath charh i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨਾ  ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਭਿਰਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: This priceless, incomparable jewel comes into the hands of those who are committedto the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee laagay t inH hath charh i-aa nirmolak rat an apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਤਨ ਹਿਥ ਚਿੜਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They obtain the immeasurable Name of the Lord, Har, Har; their treasure isoverflowing with devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: har har naam atolak paa-i-aa t ayree bh agat bharay bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਤਨ ਹਿਥ ਚਿੜਆ  ਿਨਰਮੋਲਕੁ  ਰਤਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have churned the ocean of the body, and I have seen the incomparable thing comeinto view.
lines.transliteration: samund virol sareer ham d aykhi-aa ik vasat  anoop d ikhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਕੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is God, and God is the Guru, O Nanak; there is no difference between the two, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||8|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (442-19) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur govind govind  guroo hai naanak bh ayd na bh aa-ee. ||4||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ  ਿਵਰੋਿਲ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਇਕ ਵਸਤੁ  ਅਨੂਪ ਿਦਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Slowly, slowly, slowly, very slowly, the drops of Ambrosial Nectar trickle down. pMnw 443
lines.transliteration: jhim jh imay jh im jhim varsai amrit  Dhaaraa raam.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, the Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhay gurmukh  nadree raam pi-aaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਜਗਤ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, the Emancipator of the world, is dear to him; the Name of the Lord is his glory.
lines.transliteration: raam naam pi-aaraa jagat nist aaraa raam naam vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਿਗ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲਘਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the boat, which carries the Gurmukhacross.
lines.transliteration: kalijug raam naam bohithaa gurmukh paar lagh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: This world, and the world hereafter, are adorned with the Lord's Name; theGurmukh's lifestyle is the most excellent.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  raam naam suhaylay gurmukh  karnee saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, bestowing His kindness, the Lord gives the gift of His emancipating Name.||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak daat  da-i-aa kar d ayvai raam naam nist aaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਆ ਦੁਖ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, which destroys my sorrows and erasesmy sins.
lines.transliteration: raamo raam naam japi-aa dukh  kilvikh  naas gavaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਮੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Associating with the Guru, associating with the Guru, I practice meditation; I haveenshrined the Lord within my heart.
lines.transliteration: gur parchai gur parchai Dhi-aa-i-aa mai hird ai raam ravaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵਆ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: I enshrined the Lord within my heart, and obtained the supreme status, when I came to the Sanctuary of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ravi-aa raam hirdai param gat  paa-ee jaa gur sarn aa-ee aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਨਾਵ ਡੁਬਦੀ ਿਨਕਲੀ  ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦੜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: My boat was sinking under the weight of greed and corruption, but it was upliftedwhen the True Guru implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.
lines.transliteration: lobh vikaar naav dubd ee niklee jaa sat gur naam d irhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has given me the gift of spiritual life, and I center my consciousnesson the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jee-a daan gur poorai d ee-aa raam naam chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord Himself has mercifully given this gift to me; O Nanak, I take to theSanctuary of the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap kirpaal kirpaa kar dayvai naanak gur sarn aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਣੀ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਿਭ ਸੁਹਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Bani of the Lord's Name, all my affairs were brought to perfection andembellished.
lines.transliteration: banee raam naam sun ee siDh  kaaraj sabh  suhaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਮੇ ਰੋਿਮ ਰੋਿਮ ਰੋਮੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: With each and every hair, with each and every hair, as Gurmukh, I meditate on theLord.
lines.transliteration: romay rom rom romay mai gurmukh raam Dh i-aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹੋਇ ਆਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Lord's Name, and become pure; He has no form or shape.
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhi-aa-ay pavit  ho-ay aa-ay t is roop na raykh -i-aa kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਭ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, is permeating my heart deep within, and all ofmy desire and hunger has disappeared.
lines.transliteration: raamo raam ravi-aa ghat ant ar sabh  tarisnaa bh ookh gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are totally adorned with peace and tranquility; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord has been revealed to me.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al seegaar sabh  ho-aa gurmat  raam pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ਹਮ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself has shown His kind mercy to Nanak; He has made me the slave ofthe slaves of His slaves. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak aap anoograhu kee-aa ham daasan d aasan d aasaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂੜ ਅਭਾਗੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, are foolish, unfortunate, self-willed manmukhs.
lines.transliteration: jinee raamo raam naam visaari-aa say manmukh moorh  abhaagee raam.

lines.english: Within, they are engrossed in emotional attachment; each and every moment, Mayaclings to them.
lines.transliteration: tin ant ray moh vi-aapai kh in khin maa-i-aa laagee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਅਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of Maya clings to them, and they become unfortunate fools - they do not lovethe Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mal laagee moorh bh a-ay abh aagee jin raam naam nah bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੋਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The egotistical and proud perform all sorts of rituals, but they shy away from theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: anayk karam karahi abhimaanee har raamo naam choraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ  ਕਾਲੂਖਤ  ਮੋਹ ਅੰਿਧਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The path of Death is very arduous and painful; it is stained with the darkness ofemotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikham jam panth d uhaylaa kaalookh at moh anDh i-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and finds the gate of salvation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-i-aa t aa paa-ay mokh  du-aaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and the Lord Guru, are known by the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: raamo raam naam guroo raam gurmukhay jaan ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਿਖਨੁ ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲੀ  ਭਰਮਦਾ  ਇਕਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਣੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One moment, this mind is in the heavens, and the next, it is in the nether regions; the Guru brings the wandering mind back to one-pointedness.
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa khin oobh  paa-i-aalee bh armad aa ikat  ghar aan ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਣੈ  ਸਭ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: When the mind returns to one-pointedness, one totally understands the value ofsalvation, and enjoys the subtle essence of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man ikat gh ar aan ai sabh  gat mit jaanai har raamo naam rasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦ  ਉਧਾਿਰ  ਤਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name preserves the honor of His servant, as He preserved andemancipated Prahlaad.
lines.transliteration: jan kee paij rakhai raam naamaa par-hilaad  uDhaar taraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਊਚਾ  ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿਤਆ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: So repeat continually the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; chanting His GloriousVirtues, His limit cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: raamo raam ramo ram oochaa gun keht i-aa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Nanak is drenched in happiness, hearing the Name of the Lord; he is merged in theName of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam sun bh eenay raamai naam samaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਨ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those beings, whose minds are filled the Lord's Name, forsake all anxiety.
lines.transliteration: jin antray raam naam vasai t in chint aa sabh  gavaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਅਰਥਾ  ਸਿਭ ਧਰਮ  ਿਮਲੇ ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They obtain all wealth, and all Dharmic faith, and the fruits of their minds' desires.
lines.transliteration: sabh arthaa sabh  Dharam milay man chind i-aa so fal paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They obtain the fruits of their hearts' desires, meditating on the Lord's Name, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man chindi-aa fal paa-i-aa raam naam Dh i-aa-i-aa raam naam gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: Evil-mindedness and duality depart, and their understanding is enlightened. They attach their minds to the Name of the Lord. pMnw 444
lines.transliteration: durmat  kabuDh  ga-ee suDh  ho-ee raam naam man laa-ay.

lines.english: Their lives and bodies become totally blessed and fruitful; the Lord's Name illumines them.
lines.transliteration: safal janam sareer sabh ho-aa jit  raam naam pargaasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by continually vibrating upon the Lord, day and night, the Gurmukhs abidein the home of the inner self. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhaj sad aa din raat ee gurmukh  nij gh ar vaasi-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਿਸਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who place their faith in the Lord's Name, do not attach their consciousness toanother.
lines.transliteration: jin sarDhaa raam naam lagee t inH doojai chit  na laa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਰਧਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗੀ  ਿਤਨ ਦੂਜੈ ਿਚਤੁ  ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Even if the entire earth were to be transformed into gold, and given to them, withoutthe Naam, they love nothing else.
lines.transliteration: jay Dhart ee sabh  kanchan kar d eejai bin naavai avar na bh aa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਭ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਦੀਜੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is pleasing to their minds, and they obtain supreme peace; whenthey depart in the end, it shall go with them as their support.
lines.transliteration: raam naam man bhaa-i-aa param sukh  paa-i-aa ant  chald i-aa naal sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have gathered the capital, the wealth of the Lord's Name; it does not sink, and does not depart.
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan poonjee sanchee naa doobai naa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚੀ ਨਾ ਡੂਬੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the only true support in this age; the Messenger of Death does notdraw near it.
lines.transliteration: raam naam is jug meh tulhaa jamkaal nayrh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs recognize the Lord; in His Mercy, He unites them withHimself. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh raam pachh aataa kar kirpaa aap milaavai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: True, True is the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the Gurmukh knows the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raamo raam naam satay sat  gurmukh  jaani-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੇ ਸਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's servant is the one who commits himself to the Guru's service, anddedicates his mind and body as an offering to Him.
lines.transliteration: sayvko gur sayvaa laagaa jin man tan arap charh aa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕੋ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਚੜਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He dedicates his mind and body to Him, placing great faith in Him; the Guru lovinglyunites His servant with Himself.
lines.transliteration: man tan arpi-aa bahut  man sarDh i-aa gur sayvak bh aa-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪਆ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਨ ਸਰਿਧਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਾਇ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Master of the meek, the Giver of souls, is obtained through the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath jee-aa kaa d aataa pooray gur t ay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥੁ ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Sikh, and the Sikh's Guru, are one and the same; both spread the Guru'sTeachings.
lines.transliteration: guroo sikh sikh  guroo hai ayko gur upd ays chalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਿਸਖੁ ਿਸਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਚਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Mantra of the Lord's Name is enshrined within the heart, O Nanak, and we merge with the Lord so easily. ||8||2||9|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (444-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw CMq mhlw 4 Gru 2 ] (444-10) aasaa chhant  mehlaa 4 gh ar 2. Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: raam naam mant hird ai dayvai naanak milan  subh aa-ay. ||8||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥੮॥੨॥੯॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is thePurifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: har har kartaa d ookh binaasan pat it paavan har naam jee-o.

lines.english: One who lovingly serves the Lord, obtains the supreme status. Service to the Lord,Har, Har, is more exalted than anything.
lines.transliteration: har sayvaa bhaa-ee param gat  paa-ee har oot am har har kaam jee-o.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the most exalted occupation; chanting the Name ofthe Lord, one becomes immortal.
lines.transliteration: har ootam kaam japee-ai har naam har japee-ai asthir hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਦੂਖ ਿਬਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of both birth and death are eradicated, and one comes to sleep in peacefulease.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ovai d ukh maytay sehjay hee sukh  sovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, O Lord and Master, shower Your Mercy upon me; within my mind, I chant theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa Dhaarahu th aakur har japee-ai aat am raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮੁ  ਕਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har kartaa d ookh binaasan pat it paavan har naam jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸੁਿਖ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chantthe Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug oot am har japee-ai sat gur bh aa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, read of the Lord; as Gurmukh, hear of the Lord. Chanting and listening to the Lord's Name, pain departs.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har parh ee-ai gurmukh  har sun ee-ai har japat  sunat dukh jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਦੂਖ ਿਬਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਿਤਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, pains are removed. Through the Name of the Lord, supreme peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japi-aa dukh  binsi-aa har naam param sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਕਿਲਜੁਿਗ  ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru illumines the heart; this Light dispels thedarkness of spiritual ignorance.
lines.transliteration: satgur gi-aan bali-aa gh at chaanan  agi-aan anDh ayr gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਪੜੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪਤ  ਸੁਣਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, Har, Har, upon whose foreheads suchdestiny is written.
lines.transliteration: har har naam tinee aaraaDh i-aa jin mast ak Dh ur likh  paa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਿਬਨਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug oot am har japee-ai sat gur bh aa-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਬਿਲਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profitof the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: har har man bhaa-i-aa param sukh  paa-i-aa har laahaa pad  nirbaan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਨੀ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਜਨ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He embraces love for the Lord, and the Lord's Name becomes his companion. His doubts, and his comings and goings are ended. pMnw 445
lines.transliteration: har pareet lagaa-ee har naam sakh aa-ee bh aram chookaa aavan  jaan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: His comings and goings, doubts and fears come to an end, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa bh aram bh a-o bh aagaa har har har gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The sins and pains of countless incarnations are washed away, and he merges intothe Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilvikh d ukh utray har har naam samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਭਾਗ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed by such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Lord, and theirlives become fruitful and approved.
lines.transliteration: jin har Dhi-aa-i-aa Dh ur bhaag likh  paa-i-aa t in safal janam parvaan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਹਾ  ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profitof the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har man bhaa-i-aa param sukh  paa-i-aa har laahaa pad  nirbaan  jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ  ਤੇ ਊਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted arethose people of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jinH har meeth lagaanaa t ay jan parDh aanaa t ay oot am har har log jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is their glorious greatness; the Lord's Name is their companion andhelper. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy the sublime essence ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: har naam vadaa-ee har naam sakhaa-ee gur sabd ee har ras bh og jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਮਹਾ ਿਨਰਜੋਗ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, and remain totally detached. By great good fortune, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har ras bhog mahaa nirjog vadbh aagee har ras paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ  ਪੂਰੇ ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: So very blessed and truly perfect are those, who through Guru's Instruction meditateon the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say Dhan vaday sat  purkh aa pooray jin gurmat  naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਰੇਣੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਗ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਨ ਚੂਕਾ  ਸੋਗੁ ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; his mind is rid of sorrow and separation.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak rayn mangai pag saaDh oo man chookaa sog vijog jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ  ਤੇ ਊਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||10|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (445-7) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinH har meeth lagaanaa t ay jan parDh aanaa t ay oot am har har log jee-o. ||4||3||10||

lines.english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation;religion stood upon four feet.
lines.transliteration: satjug sabh  santokh sareeraa pag chaaray Dh aram Dh i-aan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਜੁਿਗ  ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਸਰੀਰਾ  ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: With mind and body, they sang of the Lord, and attained supreme peace. In theirhearts was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues.
lines.transliteration: man tan har gaavahi param sukh  paavahi har hird ai har gun  gi-aan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਪਰਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Their wealth was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues; the Lord wastheir success, and to live as Gurmukh was their glory.
lines.transliteration: gun gi-aan pad aarath har har kirt aarath sobh aa gurmukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਤਾਰਥੁ  ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, they saw only the One Lord God; for them there was no other second.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar har parabh  ayko d oojaa avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: They centered their consciousness lovingly on the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Namewas their companion, and in the Court of the Lord, they obtained honor.
lines.transliteration: har har liv laa-ee har naam sakhaa-ee har d argeh paavai maan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation;religion stood upon four feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satjug sabh  santokh sareeraa pag chaaray Dh aram Dh i-aan jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਜੁਿਗ  ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਸਰੀਰਾ  ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: taytaa jug aa-i-aa ant ar jor paa-i-aa jat  sanjam karam kamaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਤਾ  ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The fourth foot of religion dropped off, and three remained. Their hearts and mindswere inflamed with anger.
lines.transliteration: pag cha-uthaa khisi-aa t arai pag tiki-aa man hird ai kroDh  jalaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ  ਿਖਿਸਆ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਪਗ ਿਟਿਕਆ  ਮਿਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਜਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Their hearts and minds were filled with the horribly poisonous essence of anger. Thekings fought their wars and obtained only pain.
lines.transliteration: man hirdai kroDh  mahaa bisloDh  nirap Dh aaveh larh  dukh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਮਹਾ ਿਬਸਲੋਧੁ  ਿਨਰਪ  ਧਾਵਿਹ  ਲਿੜ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds were afflicted with the illness of egotism, and their self-conceit andarrogance increased.
lines.transliteration: antar mamt aa rog lagaanaa ha-umai ahaNkaar vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਮਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If my Lord, Har, Har, shows His Mercy, my Lord and Master eradicates the poison by the Guru's Teachings and the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa Dhaaree mayrai th aakur bikh  gurmat  har naam leh jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਿਬਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taytaa jug aa-i-aa ant ar jor paa-i-aa jat  sanjam karam kamaa-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਤਾ  ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna.
lines.transliteration: jug du-aapur aa-i-aa bh aram bh armaa-i-aa har gopee kaanH upaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਦੁਆਪੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਰਮਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਗੋਪੀ  ਕਾਨ ਉਪਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The penitents practiced penance, they offered sacred feasts and charity, andperformed many rituals and religious rites.
lines.transliteration: tap taapan t aapeh jag punn aarambh eh at kiri-aa karam kamaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ  ਤਾਪਿਹ  ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਆਰੰਭਿਹ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: They performed many rituals and religious rites; two legs of religion dropped away, and only two legs remained.
lines.transliteration: kiri-aa karam kamaa-i-aa pag du-ay kh iskaa-i-aa d u-ay pag tikai tikaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਪਗ ਦੁਇ ਿਖਸਕਾਇਆ  ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਿਟਕੈ ਿਟਕਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: So many heroes waged great wars; in their egos they were ruined, and they ruinedothers as well.
lines.transliteration: mahaa juDh joDh  baho keenHay vich ha-umai pachai pachaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਜੋਧ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Compassionate to the poor, led them to meet the Holy Guru. Meeting theTrue Guru, their filth is washed away.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal gur saaDh  milaa-i-aa mil sat gur mal leh jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਿਲ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਲੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and the people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna. ||3|| pMnw 446
lines.transliteration: jug du-aapur aa-i-aa bh aram bh armaa-i-aa har gopee kaanH upaa-ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact.
lines.transliteration: kalijug har kee-aa pag tarai kh iskee-aa pag cha-uthaa tikai tikaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਗੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਪਗ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਿਖਸਕੀਆ  ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ  ਿਟਕੈ ਿਟਕਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Acting in accordance with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the medicine of the Lord'sName is obtained. Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, divine peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad kamaa-i-aa a-ukh aDh har paa-i-aa har keerat  har saaNt paa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ  ਪਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The season of singing the Lord's Praise has arrived; the Lord's Name is glorified, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, grows in the field of the body.
lines.transliteration: har keerat rut  aa-ee har naam vadaa-ee har har naam kh ayt jamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਰੁਿਤ ਆਈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, if one plants any other seed than the Name, all profitand capital is lost.
lines.transliteration: kalijug beej beejay bin naavai sabh laahaa mool gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਿਗ  ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru, who has revealed to him the Naam withinhis heart and mind.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur pooraa paa-i-aa man hirdai naam lakh aa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religionwere lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact. ||4||4||11|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (446-5) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaljug har kee-aa pag tarai kh iskee-aa pag cha-uthaa tikai tikaa-ay jee-o. ||4||4||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਜੁਗੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਪਗ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਿਖਸਕੀਆ  ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ  ਿਟਕੈ ਿਟਕਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supremestatus; the Lord seems so sweet to her mind and body.
lines.transliteration: har keerat man bh aa-ee param gat  paa-ee har man t an meeth  lagaan jee-o.

lines.english: She obtains the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, she meditates on the Lord, and the destiny written on her forehead is fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: har har ras paa-i-aa gurmat har Dh i-aa-i-aa Dh ur mast ak bh aag puraan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur mast ak bh aag har naam suhaag har naamai har gun  gaa-i-aa. By that high destiny written on her forehead, she chants the Name of the Lord, herHusband, and through the Name of the Lord, she sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The jewel of immense love sparkles on her forehead, and she is adorned with theName of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mastak man ee pareet  baho pargatee har naamai har sohaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹਾਗੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Her light blends with the Supreme Light, and she obtains God; meeting the True Guru,her mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milee parabh  paa-i-aa mil sat gur manoo-aa maan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਮਣੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supremestatus; the Lord seems sweet to her mind and body. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har keerat man bh aa-ee param gat  paa-ee har man t an meeth  lagaan jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਨ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they arethe most exalted and acclaimed people.
lines.transliteration: har har jas gaa-i-aa param pad paa-i-aa t ay oot am jan parDh aan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ  ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I bow at their feet; each and every moment, I wash the feet of those, unto whom theLord seems sweet.
lines.transliteration: tinH ham charan  sarayveh kh in khin pag Dh ovah jin har meeth  lagaan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਊਤਮ  ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord seems sweet to them, and they obtain the supreme status; their faces areradiant and beautiful with good fortune.
lines.transliteration: har meethaa laa-i-aa param sukh  paa-i-aa mukh  bhaagaa rat ee chaaray.
