lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਹਮ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰੇਵਹ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਗ ਧੋਵਹ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, they sing the Lord's Name, and wear the garland of the Lord's Name around their necks; they keep the Lord's Name in their throats.
lines.transliteration: gurmat har gaa-i-aa har haar ur paa-i-aa har naamaa kanth  Dhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They look upon all with equality, and recognize the Supreme Soul, the Lord, pervadingamong all.
lines.transliteration: sabh ayk d arisat samat  kar d aykhai sabh  aatam raam pachh aan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਉਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਕੰਿਠ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they arethe most exalted and acclaimed people. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har jas gaa-i-aa param pad paa-i-aa t ay oot am jan parDh aan jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਏਕ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਸਮਤੁ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, savors thesublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  man bh aa-ee har rasan rasaa-ee vich sangat  har ras ho-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਊਤਮ  ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He meditates in adoration upon the Lord, Har, Har, and through the Word of theGuru's Shabad, he blossoms forth. He plants no other seed.
lines.transliteration: har har aaraaDhi-aa gur sabad  vigaasi-aa beejaa avar na ko-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: There is no Nectar, other than the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. One who drinks it in,knows the way.
lines.transliteration: avar na ko-ay har amrit so-ay jin pee-aa so biDh  jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਵਗਾਿਸਆ  ਬੀਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo pooraa parabh  paa-i-aa lag sangat  naam pachh aanai. Hail, hail to the Perfect Guru; through Him, God is found. Joining the Sangat, theNaam is understood.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸੋਇ ਿਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ  ਸੋ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: I serve the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. Without the Naam, there is no otherat all.
lines.transliteration: naamo sayv naamo aaraaDhai bin naamai avar na ko-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਲਿਗ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  man bh aa-ee har rasan rasaa-ee vich sangat  har ras ho-ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੇਿਵ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across,and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har da-i-aa parabh  Dhaarahu paakh an ham t aarahu kadh  layvhu sabad  subh aa-ay jee- o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am stuck in the swamp of emotional attachment, and I am sinking. O Lord God,please, take me by the arm.
lines.transliteration: moh cheekarh faathay nigh rat ham jaat ay har baaNh parabh oo pakraa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ  ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਢ  ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: God took me by the arm, and I obtained the highest understanding; as His slave, I grasped the Guru's feet. pMnw 447
lines.transliteration: parabh baaNh pakraa-ee oot am mat  paa-ee gur charn ee jan laagaa.

lines.english: I chant and meditate in adoration upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, according to the good destiny written upon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japi-aa aaraaDhi-aa mukh  mast ak bh aag sabh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਆ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak, and the Name of the Lord,Har, Har, seems so sweet to his mind.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kirpaa Dhaaree man har har meeth aa laa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: 4) har da-i-aa parabh  Dhaarahu paakh an ham t aarahu kadh  layvhu sabad  subh aa-ay jee- o. ||4||5||12|| O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across,and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||12|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (447-3) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ  ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਢ  ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
lines.english: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har in his mind - the Lord ispleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is a great yearning for theLord.
lines.transliteration: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bh agat janaa man chaa-o jee-o.

lines.english: Those humble beings who remain dead while yet alive, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar;through the Guru's Teachings, their minds embrace love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo jan mar jeevay tinH amrit  peevay man laagaa gurmat  bhaa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds love the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru is Merciful to them. They are JivanMukta - liberated while yet alive, and they are at peace.
lines.transliteration: man har har bhaa-o gur karay pasaa-o jeevan mukat  sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਮਿਰ ਜੀਵੇ ਿਤਨ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵੇ ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Their birth and death, through the Name of the Lord, are illustrious, and in theirhearts and minds, the Lord, Har, Har, abides.
lines.transliteration: jeevan maran  har naam suhaylay man har har hird ai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, abides in their minds, and through the Guru'sTeachings, they savor the Lord, Har, Har; they drink in the sublime essence of theLord with abandon.
lines.transliteration: man har har vasi-aa gurmat har rasi-aa har har ras gataak pee-aa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਿਣ  ਮਰਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his mind - the Lord ispleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is such a great yearning forthe Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bh agat janaa man chaa-o jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਗਟਾਕ  ਪੀਆਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away.
lines.transliteration: jag maran na bh aa-i-aa nit  aap lukaa-i-aa mat  jam pakrai lai jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is the One and Only; this soul cannot be concealed from Him.
lines.transliteration: har antar baahar har parabh  ayko ih jee-arh aa rakh i-aa na jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਗ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਆਪੁ  ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ  ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: How can one keep one's soul, when the Lord wishes to have it? All things belong to Him, and He shall take them away.
lines.transliteration: ki-o jee-o rakheejai har vasat  lorheejai jis kee vasat  so lai jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਰਿਖਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around in pathetic lamentation, trying all medicinesand remedies.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karan  palaav kar bh armay sabh  a-ukh aDh daaroo laa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਜੀਉ  ਰਖੀਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਵਸਤੁ  ਲੋੜੀਜੈ  ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ  ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: God, the Master, unto whom all things belong, shall take them away; the Lord's servant is redeemed by living the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jis kee vasat parabh  la-ay su-aamee jan ubray sabad  kamaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਵ  ਕਿਰ ਭਰਮੇ ਸਿਭ ਅਉਖਧ  ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jag maran na bh aa-i-aa nit  aap lukaa-i-aa mat  jam pakrai lai jaa-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਏ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur maran  likhaa-i-aa gurmukh  sohaa-i-aa jan ubray har har Dh i-aan jee-o. Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਗ ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਆਪੁ  ਲੁਕਾਇਆ  ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ  ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Lord they obtain honor, and through the Lord's Name, gloriousgreatness. In the Court of the Lord, they are robed in honor.
lines.transliteration: har sobhaa paa-ee har naam vadi-aa-ee har d argeh paiDh ay jaan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਰਣੁ  ਿਲਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਹਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Robed in honor in the Court of the Lord, in the perfection of the Lord's Name, they obtain peace through the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har dargeh paiDh ay har naamai seeDh ay har naamai t ay sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of both birth and death are eliminated, and they merge into the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ovai d ukh maytay har raamai naam samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੀਧੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's servants meet with God and merge into Oneness. The Lord's servant andGod are one and the same.
lines.transliteration: har jan parabh ral ayko ho-ay har jan parabh  ayk samaan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur maran  likhaa-i-aa gurmukh  sohaa-i-aa jan ubray har har Dh i-aan jee-o. ||3|| Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਿਲ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਏ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Onlyby attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent.
lines.transliteration: jag upjai binsai binas binaasai lag gurmukh asthir ho-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਰਣੁ  ਿਲਖਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਹਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru implants His Mantra within the heart, and one savors the sublime essence of the Lord; the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord trickles into his mouth.
lines.transliteration: gur mantar drirh -aa-ay har rasak rasaa-ay har amrit  har mukh  cho-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ  ਿਬਨਸੈ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਿਬਨਾਸੈ  ਲਿਗ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Obtaining the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord, the dead are restored to life, and do notdie again.
lines.transliteration: har amrit ras paa-i-aa mu-aa jeevaa-i-aa fir baahurh  maran  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਚੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, one obtains the immortal status, and mergesinto the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har har naam amar pad paa-i-aa har naam samaavai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੁਆ  ਜੀਵਾਇਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only Support and Anchor of servant Nanak; without the Naam, there is nothing else at all.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam aDhaar tayk hai bin naavai avar na ko-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮਰ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Onlyby attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent.||4||6||13|| pMnw 448 Awsw mhlw 4 CMq ] (448-1) aasaa mehlaa 4 chhant . Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant:
lines.transliteration: jag upjai binsai binas binaasai lag gurmukh asthir ho-ay jee-o. ||4||6||13||

lines.english: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless.
lines.transliteration: vadaa mayraa govind agam agochar aad  niranjan nirankaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਿਦ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: His condition cannot be described; His Glorious Greatness is immeasurable. My Lord of the Universe is invisible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: taa kee gat  kahee na jaa-ee amit  vadi-aa-ee mayraa govind  alakh  apaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਅਿਮਿਤ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is invisible, infinite and unlimited. He Himself knows Himself.
lines.transliteration: govind alakh  apaar aprampar aap aapn aa jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: What should these poor creatures say? How can they speak of and describe You?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ih jant vichaaray kahee-ahi jo t uDh aakh  vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਇਹ ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰੇ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: That Gurmukh who is blessed by Your Glance of Grace contemplates You.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karahi t ooN apnee so gurmukh  karay veechaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadaa mayraa govind agam agochar aad  niranjan nirankaar jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਿਦ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: tooN aad purakh  aprampar kart aa tayraa paar na paa-i-aa jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are pervading and permeating each and every heart, everywhere, You arecontained in all.
lines.transliteration: tooN ghat ghat ant ar sarab nirant ar sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Within the heart is the Transcendent, Supreme Lord God, whose limits cannot befound.
lines.transliteration: ghat ant ar paarbarahm parmaysar t aa kaa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He has no form or shape; He is unseen and unknown. The Gurmukh sees the unseenLord.
lines.transliteration: tis roop na raykh  adisat agochar gurmukh  alakh  lakhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਿਦਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He remains in continual ecstasy, day and night, and is spontaneously absorbed intothe Naam.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee sehjay naam samaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found.||2||
lines.transliteration: tooN aad purakh  aprampar kart aa tayraa paar na paa-i-aa jaa-ay jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is thetreasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: tooN sat parmaysar sad aa abh inaasee har har gun ee niDh aan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਿਤ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God, Har, Har, is the One and only; there is no other at all. You Yourself are the all-knowing Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har parabh ayko avar na ko-ee t ooN aapay purakh  sujaan jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are the all-knowing Lord, the most exalted and auspicious; there is no other asgreat as You.
lines.transliteration: purakh sujaan t ooN parDh aan tuDh jayvad avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading in all; whatever You do, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: tayraa sabad  sabh  tooNhai vart eh tooN aapay karahi so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵਰਤਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord God is permeating all; the Gurmukh comes to understand the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: har sabh meh ravi-aa ayko so-ee gurmukh  lakhi-aa har naam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਵਆ  ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਿਖਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is thetreasure of virtue. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tooN sat parmaysar sad aa abh inaasee har har gun ee niDh aan jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਿਤ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do weact.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ooNhai kart aa sabh  tayree vadi-aa-ee ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. All are merged into Your Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay bh aavai t ivai chalaaveh sabh  tayrai sabad  samaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਿਹ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases Your Will, we obtain greatness through Your Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabh sabad  samaavai jaaN tuDh bhaavai t ayrai sabad  vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਜ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains wisdom, and eliminates his self-conceit, and remains absorbed in the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh buDh  paa-ee-ai aap gavaa-ee-ai sabd ay rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈਐ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains Your incomprehensible Shabad; O Nanak, he remains merged inthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: tayraa sabad  agochar gurmukh  paa-ee-ai naanak naam samaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||7||14|| You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do weact. ||4||7||14|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (448-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw mhlw 4 CMq Gru 4 ] (448-17) aasaa mehlaa 4 chhant  ghar 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House:
lines.transliteration: sabh t ooNhai kart aa sabh  tayree vadi-aa-ee ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
lines.english: My eyes are wet with the Nectar of the Lord, and my mind is imbued with His Love, OLord King.
lines.transliteration: har amrit bh innay lo-in aa man paraym rat annaa raam raajay.

lines.english: The Lord applied His touch-stone to my mind, and found it one hundred per cent gold.
lines.transliteration: man raam kasvatee laa-i-aa kanchan sovinnaa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I am dyed in the deep red of the poppy, and my mind and body aredrenched with His Love. pMnw 449
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rang chalooli-aa mayraa man t ano bh innaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੁਸਿਕ  ਝਕੋਿਲਆ  ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is drenched with His Fragrance; blessed, blessed is his entire life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak musak jhakoli-aa sabh  janam Dh an Dh annaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਅਣੀਆਲੇ  ਅਣੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The Bani of the Lord's Love is the pointed arrow, which has pierced my mind, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: har paraym banee man maari-aa an ee-aalay an ee-aa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਪੀਰ ਿਪਰੰਮ  ਕੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Only those who feel the pain of this love, know how to endure it.
lines.transliteration: jis laagee peer piramm kee so jaanai jaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਮਿਰ ਜੀਵੈ ਮਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, are said to be Jivan Mukta, liberatedwhile yet alive.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat so aakh ee-ai mar jeevai maree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the True Guru, that he may cross over the terrifyingworld-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak satgur mayl har jag d utar taree-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਿਮਲੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ ਰੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: I am foolish and ignorant, but I have taken to His Sanctuary; may I merge in the Loveof the Lord of the Universe, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh mugaDh  sarnaagat ee mil govind  rangaa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਇਕ ਮੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, I have obtained the Lord, and I beg for the one blessing ofdevotion to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har paa-i-aa har bhagat  ik mangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਵਗਾਿਸਆ ਜਿਪ ਅਨਤ  ਤਰੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body blossom forth through the Word of the Shabad; I meditate on theLord of infinite waves.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man tan sabad  vigaasi-aa jap anat  tarangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਤਸੰਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting with the humble Saints, Nanak finds the Lord, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mil sant janaa har paa-i-aa naanak sat sangaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੁਿਣ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: O Merciful to the meek, hear my prayer, O Lord God; You are my Master, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal sun  baynt ee har parabh  har raa-i-aa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name, Har, Har; please, place it in my mouth.
lines.transliteration: ha-o maaga-o saran har naam kee har har mukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ ਵਛਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਜ  ਰਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: It is the Lord's natural way to love His devotees; O Lord, please preserve my honor!
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al har birad  hai har laaj rakh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, and has been saved by the Name of theLord. ||4||8||15|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (449-8) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sarnaagat ee har naam t araa-i-aa. ||4||8||15||

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I searched and searched, and found the Lord, my Friend, my SovereignLord King.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh dh oondh  dhoodhaydi-aa har sajan  laDhaa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਢੂੰਿਢ  ਢੂਢੇਿਦਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਲਧਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Within the walled fortress of my golden body, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa kot garh vich har har siDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਿਵਿਚ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel, a diamond; my mind and body are pierced through.
lines.transliteration: har har heeraa ratan hai mayraa man t an viDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹੀਰਾ  ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਵਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur bh aag vaday har paa-i-aa naanak ras guDh aa. ||1|| By the great good fortune of pre-ordained destiny, I have found the Lord. Nanak is permeated with His sublime essence. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ ਰਿਸ ਗੁਧਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I stand by the roadside, and ask the way; I am just a youthful bride of the Lord King.
lines.transliteration: panth dasaavaa nit  kharhee munDh  joban baalee raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਵਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਖੜੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਬਾਲੀ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has caused me to remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I follow thePath to Him.
lines.transliteration: har har naam chaytaa-ay gur har maarag chaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਇ  ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body; I have burntaway the poison of ego.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan naam aaDh aar hai ha-umai bikh  jaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: O True Guru, unite me with the Lord, unite me with the Lord, adorned with garlandsof flowers. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak satgur mayl har har mili-aa banvaalee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਬਨਵਾਲੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my Love, come and meet me as Gurmukh; I have been separated from You for solong, Lord King.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pi-aaray aa-ay mil mai chiree vichh unay raam raajay.

lines.english: My mind and body are sad; my eyes are wet with the Lord's sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man tan bahut  bairaagi-aa har nain  ras bh innay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਿਗਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨੈਣ ਰਿਸ ਿਭੰਨੇ ॥
lines.english: Show me my Lord God, my Love, O Guru; meeting the Lord, my mind is pleased.
lines.transliteration: mai har parabh pi-aaraa d as gur mil har man mannay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਦਿਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
lines.english: I am just a fool, O Nanak, but the Lord has appointed me to perform His service. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-o moorakh kaarai laa-ee-aa naanak har kammay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਮੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru's body is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar; He sprinkles it upon me, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: gur amrit bh innee d ayhuree amrit  burkay raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਭੰਨੀ  ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਬੁਰਕੇ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Those whose minds are pleased with the Word of the Guru's Bani, drink in theAmbrosial Nectar again and again.
lines.transliteration: jinaa gurbaanee man bh aa-ee-aa amrit  chhak chh akay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਛਿਕ  ਛਕੇ ॥
lines.english: As the Guru is pleased, the Lord is obtained, and you shall not be pushed around anymore.
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai har paa-i-aa chookay Dh ak Dh akay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਚੂਕੇ ਧਕ ਧਕੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant becomes the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, the Lord and Hisservant are one and the same. ||4||9||16|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (449-16) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jan har har ho-i-aa naanak har ikay. ||4||9||16||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹੋਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਇਕੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
lines.english: The treasure of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's devotional service, is found through theGuru, the True Guru, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: har amrit bh agat bhandaar hai gur sat gur paasay raam raajay.

lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, is the True Banker, who gives to His Sikh the capital of theLord.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur sachaa saahu hai sikh  day-ay har raasay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਪਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an van jaaraa van aj hai gur saahu saabaasay. Blessed, blessed is the trader and the trade; how wonderful is the Banker, the Guru!

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਿਸਖ ਦੇਇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, they alone obtain the Guru, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur tinHee paa-i-aa jin Dh ur likh at lilaat likh aasay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਵਣਜੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁ ਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are my True Banker, O Lord; the whole world is Your trader, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: sach saahu hamaaraa tooN Dhanee sabh  jagat  vanjaaraa raam raajay.

lines.english: You fashioned all vessels, O Lord, and that which dwells within is also Yours.
lines.transliteration: sabh bh aaNday tuDhai saaji-aa vich vasat  har thaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Whatever You place in that vessel, that alone comes out again. What can the poor creatures do? pMnw 450
lines.transliteration: jo paavahi bhaaNday vich vasat  saa niklai ki-aa ko-ee karay vaychaaraa.

lines.english: The Lord has given the treasure of His devotional worship to servant Nanak. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har bakhsi-aa har bh agat bhandaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਬਖਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O Lord and Master? You are the most infinite of the infinite, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: ham ki-aa gun t ayray vithreh su-aamee t ooN apar apaaro raam raajay.

lines.english: I praise the Lord's Name, day and night; this alone is my hope and support.
lines.transliteration: har naam saalaahah din raat  ayhaa aas aaDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਵਥਰਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੂੰ ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: I am a fool, and I know nothing. How can I find Your limits?
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh kichh oo-a na jaan haa kiv paavah paaro.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ  ਆਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord, the water-carrier of the slaves of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har d aas panihaaro. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਿਕਛੂਅ  ਨ ਜਾਣਹਾ  ਿਕਵ ਪਾਵਹ  ਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, You save me; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, O God, O LordKing.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  lai ham saran  parabh  aa-ay raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸ ਪਿਨਹਾਰੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am wandering around, ruining myself day and night; O Lord, please save my honor!
lines.transliteration: ham bhool vigaarh ah dinas raat  har laaj rakh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੈ ਹਮ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: I am just a child; You, O Guru, are my father. Please give me understanding andinstruction.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik tooN gur pit aa hai d ay mat  samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਭੂਿਲ ਿਵਗਾੜਹ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਜ  ਰਖਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is known as the Lord's slave; O Lord, please preserve his honor!||4||10||17|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (450-6) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak daas har kaaNdhi-aa har paij rakh aa-ay. ||4||10||17||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਪਤਾ  ਹੈ ਦੇ ਮਿਤ ਸਮਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have the blessed pre-ordained destiny of the Lord written on theirforeheads, meet the True Guru, the Lord King.
lines.transliteration: jin mastak Dh ur har likh i-aa tinaa sat gur mili-aa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਿਢਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ  ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
lines.english: The Guru removes the darkness of ignorance, and spiritual wisdom illuminates theirhearts.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayraa kati-aa gur gi-aan gh at bali-aa.

lines.english: They find the wealth of the jewel of the Lord, and then, they do not wander any longer.
lines.transliteration: har laDhaa rat an pad aaratho fir bahurh  na chali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and in meditation, hemeets the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam aaraaDhi-aa aaraaDh  har mili-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਕਿਟਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਘਿਟ  ਬਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have not kept the Lord's Name in their consciousness - why did theybother to come into the world, O Lord King?
lines.transliteration: jinee aisaa har naam na chayti-o say kaahay jag aa-ay raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਲਧਾ  ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ  ਿਫਿਰ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਚਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and without the Naam, it is all futileand useless.
lines.transliteration: ih maanas janam d ulambh  hai naam binaa birthaa sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਆਰਾਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now, in this most fortunate season, he does not plant the seed of the Lord's Name;what will the hungry soul eat, in the world hereafter?
lines.transliteration: hun vat ai har naam na beeji-o agai bh ukhaa ki-aa kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਿਗ  ਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are born again and again. O Nanak, such is the Lord's Will.||2||
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa no fir janam hai naanak har bh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਦੁਲੰਭੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: You, O Lord, belong to all, and all belong to You. You created all, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: tooN har t ayraa sabh  ko sabh  tuDh upaa-ay raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਿਣ ਵਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੀਿਜਓ  ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਿਕਆ  ਖਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Nothing is in anyone's hands; all walk as You cause them to walk.
lines.transliteration: kichh haath kisai d ai kichh  naahee sabh  chaleh chalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਿਫਿਰ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They alone are united with You, O Beloved, whom You cause to be so united; they alone are pleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: jinH tooN mayleh pi-aaray say t uDh mileh jo har man bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਿਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has met the True Guru, and through the Lord's Name, he has beencarried across. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak satgur bh ayti-aa har naam t araa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਿਭ ਚਲਿਹ  ਚਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Some sing of the Lord, through musical Ragas and the sound current of the Naad,through the Vedas, and in so many ways. But the Lord, Har, Har, is not pleased bythese, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee gaavai raagee naadee bayd ee baho bh aat kar nahee har har bh eejai raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those who are filled with fraud and corruption within - what good does it do for themto cry out?
lines.transliteration: jinaa antar kapat vikaar hai t inaa ro-ay ki-aa keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord knows everything, although they may try to hide their sins and thecauses of their diseases.
lines.transliteration: har kartaa sabh  kichh  jaand aa sir rog hath d eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰਾਗੀ  ਨਾਦੀ  ਬੇਦੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਨਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs whose hearts are pure, obtain the Lord, Har, Har, bydevotional worship. ||4||11||18|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (450-15) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinaa naanak gurmukh hird aa suDh  hai har bh agat har leejai. ||4||11||18||

lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of the Lord, Har, Har, are the wisest andmost clever people, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: jin antar har har pareet  hai tay jan sugh arh si-aan ay raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਰੋਗ ਹਥੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Even if they misspeak outwardly, they are still very pleasing to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jay baahrahu bhul chuk bold ay bh ee kh aray har bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The Lord's Saints have no other place. The Lord is the honor of the dishonored.
lines.transliteration: har santaa no hor thaa-o naahee har maan  nimaan ay.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Royal Court for servant Nanak; the Lord's power is his only power. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam deebaan  hai har t aan sataanay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਘੜ ਿਸਆਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Wherever my True Guru goes and sits, that place is beautiful, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: jithai jaa-ay bahai mayraa satguroo so thaan suhaavaa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਭੁਿਲ ਚੁਿਕ ਬੋਲਦੇ  ਭੀ ਖਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Sikhs seek out that place; they take the dust and apply it to their faces.
lines.transliteration: gusikheeN so thaan bh aali-aa lai Dh oor mukh  laavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਣੁ ਿਨਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: The works of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord's Name, are approved.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa kee gh aal thaa-ay pa-ee jin har naam Dh i-aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਤਾਣੁ  ਸਤਾਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who worship the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord causes them to be worshippedin turn. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jinH naanak satgur pooji-aa t in har pooj karaavaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਜਾਇ  ਬਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Sikh keeps the Love of the Lord, and the Name of the Lord, in his mind. He loves You, O Lord, O Lord King. pMnw 451
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa man har pareet  hai har naam har t ayree raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: He serves the Perfect True Guru, and his hunger and self-conceit are eliminated.
lines.transliteration: kar sayveh pooraa satguroo bh ukh jaa-ay leh mayree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ  ਲਿਹ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The hunger of the Gursikh is totally eliminated; indeed, many others are satisfied through them.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa kee bh ukh sabh  ga-ee t in pichh ai hor kh aa-ay gh anayree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਗਈ ਿਤਨ ਿਪਛੈ ਹੋਰ ਖਾਇ  ਘਨੇਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has planted the Seed of the Lord's Goodness; this Goodness of theLord shall never be exhausted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har punn beeji-aa fir tot na aavai har punn kayree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਿਜਆ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The minds of the Gursikhs rejoice, because they have seen my True Guru, O LordKing.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa man vaaDh aa-ee-aa jin mayraa sat guroo dith aa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ  ਿਜਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਡਠਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: If someone recites to them the story of the Lord's Name, it seems so sweet to themind of those Gursikhs.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee kar gal sunaavai har naam kee so lagai gursikh aa man mith aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਕਿਰ ਗਲ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਲਗੈ ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਮਿਨ ਿਮਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Gursikhs are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; my True Guru is verypleased with them.
lines.transliteration: har dargeh gursikh  painaa-ee-ah jinHaa mayraa sat gur tuthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਪੈਨਾਈਅਿਹ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has become the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, abides within hismind. ||4||12||19|| Awsw mhlw 4 ] (451-5) aasaa mehlaa 4. Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har har ho-i-aa har har man vuthaa. ||4||12||19||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹੋਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Those who meet my Perfect True Guru - He implants within them the Name of the Lord, the Lord King.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa bhayti-aa mayraa pooraa sat guroo t in har naam d arirh-aavai raam raajay.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name have all of their desire and hunger removed.
lines.transliteration: tis kee t arisnaa bh ukh sabh  utrai jo har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Deathcannot even approach them.
lines.transliteration: jo har har naam Dhi-aa-id ay tinH jam nayrh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may ever chant the Name ofthe Lord; through the Name of the Lord, he is saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har kirpaa kar nit japai har naam har naam t araavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਿਤਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, meet no obstacles in their path, OLord King.
lines.transliteration: jinee gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-i-aa t inaa fir bigh an na ho-ee raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਨਤ  ਜਪੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ ਤਰਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to the almighty True Guru are worshipped by everyone.
lines.transliteration: jinee satgur purakh  manaa-i-aa t in poojay sabh  ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who serve their Beloved True Guru obtain eternal peace.
lines.transliteration: jinHee satgur pi-aaraa sayvi-aa t inHaa sukh  sad ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Those who meet the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord Himself meets them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jinHaa naanak satgur bh ayti-aa t inHaa mili-aa har so-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Those Gurmukhs, who are filled with His Love, have the Lord as their Saving Grace, OLord King.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa antar gurmukh  pareet  hai tinH har rakh anhaaraa raam raajay.

lines.english: How can anyone slander them? The Lord's Name is dear to them.
lines.transliteration: tinH kee nind aa ko-ee ki-aa karay jinH har naam pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Those whose minds are in harmony with the Lord - all their enemies attack them in vain.
lines.transliteration: jin har saytee man maani-aa sabh  dusat jh akh maaraa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord Protector.||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa har rakh anhaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਸਭ ਦੁਸਟ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every age, He creates His devotees and preserves their honor, O LordKing.
lines.transliteration: har jug jug bhagat  upaa-i-aa paij rakh -daa aa-i-aa raam raajay.

lines.english: The Lord killed the wicked Harnaakhash, and saved Prahlaad.
lines.transliteration: harnaakh as dusat har maari-aa parahlaad  taraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: He turned his back on the egotists and slanderers, and showed His Face to NaamDayv.
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaaree-aa nindkaa pith  day-ay naamd ay-o mukh  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ  ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦੁ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has so served the Lord, that He will deliver him in the end.||4||13||20|| Awsw mhlw 4 CMq Gru 5 (451-15) aasaa mehlaa 4 chhant  ghar 5 Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (451-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aisaa har sayvi-aa ant la-ay chh adaa-i-aa. ||4||13||20||

lines.english: O my dear beloved stranger mind, please come home!
lines.transliteration: mayray man pardaysee vay pi-aaray aa-o gh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Meet with the Lord-Guru, O my dear beloved, and He will dwell in the home of your self.
lines.transliteration: har guroo milaavhu mayray pi-aaray ghar vasai haray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Revel in His Love, O my dear beloved, as the Lord bestows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: rang ralee-aa maanhu mayray pi-aaray har kirpaa karay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਵੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਆਉ  ਘਰੇ ॥
lines.english: As Guru Nanak is pleased, O my dear beloved, we are united with the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuth aa mayray pi-aaray maylay haray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਘਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I have not tasted divine love, O my dear beloved, within my heart.
lines.transliteration: mai paraym na chaakhi-aa mayray pi-aaray bh aa-o karay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਲੀਆ  ਮਾਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The mind's desires are not quenched, O my dear beloved, but I still hold out hope.
lines.transliteration: man tarisnaa na bujh ee mayray pi-aaray nit  aas karay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤੁਠਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Youth is passing away, O my dear beloved, and death is stealing away the breath oflife.
lines.transliteration: nit joban jaavai mayray pi-aaray jam saas hiray.

lines.english: The virtuous bride realizes the good fortune of her destiny, O my dear beloved; ONanak, she enshrines the Lord within her heart. ||2|| pMnw 452
lines.transliteration: bhaag man ee sohagan  mayray pi-aaray naanak har ur Dh aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਰਿਤਅੜੇ  ਮੈਡੇ ਲੋਇਣ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਬੂੰਦ ਿਜਵੈ ॥
lines.english: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, like the song-bird with the rain drop.
lines.transliteration: pir rati-arh ay maiday lo-in  mayray pi-aaray chaat rik boond  jivai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
lines.english: My mind is cooled and soothed, O my dear beloved, by drinking in the rain drops ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: man seetal ho-aa mayray pi-aaray har boond  peevai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਨ ਿਬਰਹੁ ਜਗਾਵੈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਪਵੈ ਿਕਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Separation from my Lord keeps my body awake, O my dear beloved; I cannot sleep atall.
lines.transliteration: tan birahu jagaavai mayray pi-aaray need  na pavai kivai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਲਧਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਲਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the Lord, the True Friend, O my dear beloved, by loving the Guru.||3||
lines.transliteration: har sajan laDh aa mayray pi-aaray naanak guroo livai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਿੜ ਚੇਤੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਭਲੀਅ  ਰੁਤੇ ॥
lines.english: In the month of Chayt, O my dear beloved, the pleasant season of spring begins.
lines.transliteration: charh chayt  basant  mayray pi-aaray bh alee-a rut ay.

lines.english: But without my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, my courtyard is filled with dust.
lines.transliteration: pir baajh-rh i-ahu mayray pi-aaray aaNgan Dhoorh lutay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਆਸ ਉਡੀਣੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
lines.english: But my sad mind is still hopeful, O my dear beloved; my eyes are both fixed uponHim.
lines.transliteration: man aas udeenee mayray pi-aaray d u-ay nain jut ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਸੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਜਉ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਤੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Beholding the Guru, Nanak is filled with wondrous joy, like a child, gazing upon hismother. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur naanak daykh  vigsee mayray pi-aaray ji-o maat  sutay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੁਣਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has preached the sermon of the Lord, O my dear beloved.
lines.transliteration: har kee-aa kathaa kahaanee-aa mayray pi-aaray sat guroo sun aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਿੜਅਹ ੁ ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਜਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, O my dear beloved, who has united me with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur vitrhi-ahu ha-o gh olee mayray pi-aaray jin har maylaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਆਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਅੜਾ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has fulfilled all my hopes, O my dear beloved; I have obtained the fruits of my heart's desires.
lines.transliteration: sabh aasaa har pooree-aa mayray pi-aaray man chind i-arhaa fal paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਠੜਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: When the Lord is pleased, O my dear beloved, servant Nanak is absorbed into theNaam. ||5||
lines.transliteration: har tuth -rhaa mayray pi-aaray jan naanak naam samaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Without the Beloved Lord, there is no play of love.
lines.transliteration: pi-aaray har bin paraym na khaylsaa.

lines.english: How can I find the Guru? Grasping hold of Him, I behold my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: ki-o paa-ee gur jit lag pi-aaraa d aykhsaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਤੜੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੇਲਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, O Great Giver, let me meet the Guru; as Gurmukh, may I merge with You.
lines.transliteration: har daat -rhay mayl guroo mukh  gurmukh  maylsaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ਸਾ ॥੬॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the Guru, O my dear beloved; such was the destiny inscribed uponhis forehead. ||6||14||21|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (452-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu Awsw mhlw 5 CMq Gru 1 ] (452-10) raag aasaa mehlaa 5 chhant  ghar 1. Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak paa-i-aa mayray pi-aaray Dhur mast ak laykh  saa. ||6||14||21||

lines.english: Joy - great joy! I have seen the Lord God!
lines.transliteration: ando anad  ghanaa mai so parabh  deeth aa raam.

lines.english: Tasted - I have tasted the sweet essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: chaakhi-arh aa chaakh i-arhaa mai har ras meeth aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੋ  ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ  ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The sweet essence of the Lord has rained down in my mind; by the pleasure of the True Guru, I have attained peaceful ease.
lines.transliteration: har ras meethaa man meh vooth aa sat gur toothaa sahj bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਖਅੜਾ  ਚਾਿਖਅੜਾ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have come to dwell in the home of my own self, and I sing the songs of joy; the fivevillains have fled.
lines.transliteration: garihu vas aa-i-aa mangal gaa-i-aa panch dusat o-ay bh aag ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੂਠਾ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am soothed and satisfied with the Ambrosial Bani of His Word; the friendly Saint ismy advocate.
lines.transliteration: seetal aagh aanay amrit  baan ay saajan sant  baseeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਵਿਸ ਆਇਆ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ  ਓਇ ਭਾਿਗ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my mind is in harmony with the Lord; I have seen God with my eyes.||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har si-o man maani-aa so parabh nain ee deeth aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲ  ਆਘਾਣੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੇ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੰਤ ਬਸੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Adorned - adorned are my beauteous gates, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: sohi-arhay sohi-arh ay mayray bank d u-aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁਮਾਿਨਆ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨੈਣੀ  ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Guests - my guests are the Beloved Saints, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: paahunarhay paahunarh ay mayray sant  pi-aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਿਹਅੜੇ  ਸੋਿਹਅੜੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Saints have resolved my affairs; I humbly bowed to them, and committed myself to their service.
lines.transliteration: sant pi-aaray kaaraj saaray namaskaar kar lagay sayvaa.

lines.english: He Himself is the groom's party, and He Himself the bride's party; He Himself is theLord and Master; He Himself is the Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanjee aapay maanj ee aap su-aamee aap d ayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਾਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ  ਕਿਰ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: He Himself resolves His own affairs; He Himself sustains the Universe.
lines.transliteration: apnaa kaaraj aap savaaray aapay Dh aaran Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਞੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਞੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਦੇਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my Bridegroom is sitting in my home; the gates of my body arebeautifully adorned. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak saho ghar meh baith aa sohay bank d u-aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਧਾਰਨ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The nine treasures - the nine treasures come into my home, Lord.
lines.transliteration: nav niDhay na-o niDh ay mayray gh ar meh aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Everything - I obtain everything, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  mai sabh  kichh  paa-i-aa naam Dh i-aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਿਨਧੇ ਨਉ ਿਨਧੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਆਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Lord of the Universe becomes the one's eternalcompanion, and he dwells in peaceful ease.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ee sad aa sakh aa-ee sahj subh aa-ee govind aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: His calculations are ended, his wanderings cease, and his mind is no longer afflictedwith anxiety.
lines.transliteration: ganat  mitaa-ee chookee Dh aa-ee kad ay na vi-aapai man chind aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਖਾਈ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord of the Universe reveals Himself, and the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates, the drama of wondrous splendor is enacted.
lines.transliteration: govind gaajay anhad  vaajay achraj sobh  banaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤ  ਿਮਟਾਈ  ਚੂਕੀ ਧਾਈ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਮਨ ਿਚੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, when my Husband Lord is with me, I obtain the nine treasures. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak pir mayrai sangay taa mai nav niDh  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ  ਵਾਜੇ ਅਚਰਜ  ਸੋਭ ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Over-joyed - over-joyed are all my brothers and friends. pMnw 453
lines.transliteration: sarsi-arhay sarsi-arh ay mayray bh aa-ee sabh  meet aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਸਅੜੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ਸਭ ਮੀਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, I have won the most arduous battle in the arena of life.
lines.transliteration: bikhmo bikh am akh aarhaa mai gur mil jeet aa raam.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, I am victorious; praising the Lord, Har, Har, the walls of the fortress of doubt have been destroyed.
lines.transliteration: gur mil jeetaa har har keet aa tootee bh eetaa bh aram garh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੀਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਤਾ  ਤੂਟੀ ਭੀਤਾ  ਭਰਮ  ਗੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the wealth of so many treasures; the Lord Himself has stood by myside.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa khajaanaa bahut  niDhaanaa saan ath mayree aap kh arhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਆ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ਸਾਣਥ  ਮੇਰੀ ਆਿਪ  ਖੜਾ ॥
lines.english: He is the man of spiritual wisdom, and he is the leader, whom God has made His own.
lines.transliteration: so-ee sugi-aanaa so parDhaanaa jo parabh  apnaa keet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਿਗਆਨਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪਨਾ  ਕੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, when the Lord and Master is on my side, then my brothers and friendsrejoice. ||4||1|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (453-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaaN val su-aamee taa sarsay bh aa-ee meet aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜ ਵਿਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਾ ਸਰਸੇ  ਭਾਈ  ਮੀਤਾ  ॥੪॥੧  ॥
lines.english: Inexpressible is the sermon of the inexpressible Lord; it cannot be known at all.
lines.transliteration: akthaa har akath kathaa kichh jaa-ay na jaan ee raam.

lines.english: The demi-gods, mortal beings, angels and silent sages express it in their peacefulpoise.
lines.transliteration: sur nar sur nar mun jan sahj vakhaan ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥਾ  ਹਿਰ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In their poise, they recite the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord's Word; they embrace lovefor the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: sehjay vakhaan ee ami-o ban ee charan  kamal rang laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸਹਿਜ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the One incomprehensible and immaculate Lord, they obtain the fruitsof their heart's desires.
lines.transliteration: jap ayk alakh parabh  niranjan man chind i-aa fal paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing self-conceit, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, their lightmerges into the Light.
lines.transliteration: taj maan moh vikaar d oojaa jot ee jot  samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one enjoys the Lord's Love forever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak gur parsaadee sad aa har rang maan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Saints - the Lord's Saints are my friends, my best friends and helpers.
lines.transliteration: har santaa har sant  sajan mayray meet  sahaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sat Sangat, theTrue Congregation.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee vadbh aagee sat sangat  paa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I obtained it, and I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; my pains and sufferings have been taken away.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee paa-ay naam Dh i-aa-ay laathay d ookh santaapai.

lines.english: I have grasped the Guru's Feet, and my doubts and fears are gone. He Himself haserased my self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: gur charnee laagay bh aram bh a-o bh aagay aap mitaa-i-aa aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਲਾਥੇ  ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, God has united me with Himself; no longer do I suffer the painsof separation, and I shall not have to go anywhere.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa maylay parabh apunai vichh urh kateh na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am forever Your slave, Lord; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d aas tayraa sad aa har sarn aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਲੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Gate - at the Lord's Gate, Your beloved devotees look beautiful.
lines.transliteration: har daray har d ar sohan t ayray bh agat pi-aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, again and again a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: vaaree tin vaaree jaavaa sad  balihaaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice, and I humbly bow to them; meeting them, I know God.
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaray kar namaskaaray jin bh aytat parabh  jaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰੀ ਿਤਨ ਵਾਰੀ  ਜਾਵਾ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect and All-powerful Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is contained in each andevery heart, everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rav rahi-aa sabh  thaa-ee pooran purakh  biDhaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ  ਕਿਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ  ਿਜਨ ਭੇਟਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Naam, and do not lose this life in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-i-aa naam Dhi-aa-i-aa joo-ai janam na haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, shower Your Mercy upon me, and protect me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  tayree raakh  kirpaa Dh aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Innumerable - innumerable are Your Glorious Virtues; how many of them can I sing?
lines.transliteration: bay-antaa bay-ant  gun tayray kayt ak gaavaa raam.

lines.english: The dust of Your feet, of Your feet, I have obtained, by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: tayray charn aa tayray charan  Dhoorh vadbh aagee paavaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਅੰਤਾ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੇਤਕ  ਗਾਵਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Bathing in the Lord's dust, my filth has been washed away, and the pains of birth anddeath have departed.
lines.transliteration: har Dhoorh ee nHaa-ee-ai mail gavaa-ee-ai janam maran  dukh laathay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣਾ  ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣ  ਧੂਿੜ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਵਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, the Transcendent Lord God is ever-present, always with us.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sad aa had ooray parmaysar parabh  saathay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਈਐ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ  ॥
lines.english: Suffering departs, and there is peace; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, one isnot consigned to reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: mitay dookh  kali-aan  keert an bahurh  jon na paavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, in the Guru's Sanctuary, one swims across, and is pleasing to God.||4||2|| Awsw CMq mhlw 5 Gru 4  (453-17) aasaa chhant  mehlaa 5 gh ar 4 Aasaa, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (453-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak gur saran  taree-ai aapn ay parabh  bhaavaa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਟੇ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਕੀਰਤਨ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਪਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; He alone is sweet to my mind, the Lord King.
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal man bayDhi-aa kichh  aan na meeth aa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਿਣ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord in adoration; I behold theLord King in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: mil santsangat  aaraaDh i-aa har gh at ghatay deeth aa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I behold the Lord in each and every heart, and the Ambrosial Nectar rains down uponme; the pains of birth and death are gone.
lines.transliteration: har ghat gh atay deeth aa amrit o vooth aa janam maran d ukh naath ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਮੀਠਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, all my pains are erased, and the knot of ego has been untied. pMnw 454
lines.transliteration: gun niDh  gaa-i-aa sabh  dookh mitaa-i-aa ha-umai binsee gaath ay.

lines.english: My Beloved shall not leave me to go anywhere - this is His natural way; my mind is imbued with the lasting color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: pari-o sahj subhaa-ee chh od na jaa-ee man laagaa rang majeeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord have pierced Nanak's mind, and now, nothing else seemssweet to him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naanak bayDhay charan kamal kichh  aan na meeth aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੇਧੇ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Just like the fish which revels in water, I am intoxicated with the sublime essence ofthe Lord, my Lord King.
lines.transliteration: ji-o raatee jal maachh ulee t i-o raam ras maat ay raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਜਿਲ  ਮਾਛੁਲੀ  ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, and blessed me with salvation in my life; I love the Lord, my King.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai updaysi-aa jeevan gat  bhaatay raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਗਿਤ  ਭਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts, blesses me with salvation in my life; HeHimself attaches me to His Love.
lines.transliteration: jeevan gat su-aamee ant arjaamee aap lee-ay larh  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਗਿਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਆਿਪ ਲੀਏ ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the treasure of jewels, the perfect manifestation; He shall not forsake usto go anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: har ratan pad aaratho pargato poorno chh od na kat hoo jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥੋ  ਪਰਗਟੋ  ਪੂਰਨੋ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: God, the Lord Master, is so accomplished, beauteous, and all-knowing; His gifts arenever exhausted.
lines.transliteration: parabh sugh ar saroop sujaan su-aamee t aa kee mitai na d aatay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਿਮਟੈ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: As the fish is enraptured by the water, so is Nanak intoxicated by the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal sang raatee maachh ulee naanak har maat ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਮਾਛੁਲੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, the Lord, the Lord my King, is the Supportof my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boond  ji-o har paraan aDh aaraa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕੁ  ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਿਜਉ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: My Lord King is more beloved than all wealth, treasure, children, siblings and friends.
lines.transliteration: maal khajeenaa sut  bharaat meet  sabh ahooN tay pi-aaraa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਲੁ  ਖਜੀਨਾ  ਸੁਤ ਭਰ੍ਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The absolute Lord, the Primal Being, is more beloved than all; His condition cannot beknown.
lines.transliteration: sabhahooN tay pi-aaraa purakh  niraaraa t aa kee gat  nahee jaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਾਰਾ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never forget the Lord, for an instant, for a single breath; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.
lines.transliteration: har saas giraas na bisrai kabahooN gur sabdee rang maan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਨ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਕਬਹੂੰ ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord God is the Life of the Universe; His Saints drink in the Lord's sublimeessence. Meditating on Him, doubts, attachments and pains are shaken off.
lines.transliteration: parabh purakh  jagjeevano sant  ras peevno jap bh aram moh d ukh daaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ  ਸੰਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨੋ  ਜਿਪ ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, so does Nanak love the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boond  ji-o naanak har pi-aaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Meeting the Lord, my Lord King, my desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: milay naraa-in aapn ay maanoratho pooraa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋ  ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The walls of doubt have been torn down, meeting the Brave Guru, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: dhaath ee bh eet bharamm kee bh aytat gur sooraa raam raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਠੀ  ਭੀਿਤ  ਭਰੰਮ  ਕੀ ਭੇਟਤ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny; God is the Giver of alltreasures - He is merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: pooran gur paa-ay purab likhaa-ay sabh  niDh deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਿਲਖਾਏ  ਸਭ ਿਨਿਧ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, is God, the most beautiful Guru, theSustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant parabh  so-ee sund ar gur gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਮਿਧ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The dust of the feet of the Holy purifies sinners, and brings great joy, bliss andecstasy.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ghanayray pat it paavan saaDh oo Dh ooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Infinite Lord, has met with Nanak, and his desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||3|| Awsw mhlw 5 CMq Gru 6 (454-13) aasaa mehlaa 5 chhant  ghar 6 Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (454-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku ] (454-14) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: har milay naraa-in naankaa maanoratho pooraa. ||4||1||3||

lines.english: Those beings, unto whom the Lord God shows His Mercy, meditate on the Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bha-ay kirpaal parabh  har har say-ee japaat .

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੬ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they embrace love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy. ||1|| CMqu ] (454-15) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak pareet lagee t inH raam si-o bh aytat saaDh  sangaat . ||1||

lines.english: Just like water, which loves milk so much that it will not let it burn - O my mind, solove the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jal duDh  ni-aa-ee reet  ab duDh aach nahee man aisee pareet  haray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ  ॥
lines.english: The bumble bee becomes enticed by the lotus, intoxicated by its fragrance, and doesnot leave it, even for a moment.
lines.transliteration: ab urjhi-o al kamlayh baasan maahi magan ik kh in bhee naahi tarai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ ਿਤਨ  ਰਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਭੇਟਤ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Do not let up your love for the Lord, even for an instant; dedicate all your decorations and pleasures to Him.
lines.transliteration: khin naahi taree-ai pareet  haree-ai seegaar habh  ras arpee-ai.

lines.english: Where painful cries are heard, and the Way of Death is shown, there, in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not be afraid.
lines.transliteration: jah dookh  sunee-ai jam panth bh anee-ai t ah saaDh sang na darpee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਿਨਆਈ  ਰੀਿਤ  ਅਬ ਦੁਧ ਆਚ  ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and all sins and sorrows shalldepart.
lines.transliteration: kar keerat govind  gunee-ai sagal paraachh at dukh haray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਉਰਿਝਓ  ਅਿਲ  ਕਮਲੇਹ  ਬਾਸਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਮਗਨ  ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾਿਹ  ਟਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, O mind, andenshrine love for the Lord; love the Lord this way in your mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak chhant  govind  har kay man har si-o nayhu karayhu aisee man pareet haray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਨਾਿਹ ਟਰੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹਰੀਐ  ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਹਿਭ ਰਸ ਅਰਪੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: As the fish loves the water, and is not content even for an instant outside it, O my mind, love the Lord in this way. pMnw 455
lines.transliteration: jaisee machhulee neer ik kh in bhee naa Dh eeray man aisaa nayhu karayhu.

lines.english: Like the song-bird, thirsting for the rain-drops, chirping each and every moment to the beautiful rain clouds.
lines.transliteration: jaisee chaatrik pi-aas kh in khin boond  chavai baras suhaavay mayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਵੈ ਬਰਸੁ  ਸੁਹਾਵੇ  ਮੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: So love the Lord, and give to Him this mind of yours; totally focus your consciousnesson the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har pareet kareejai ih man d eejai at  laa-ee-ai chit  muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਅਿਤ  ਲਾਈਐ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Do not take pride in yourself, but seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: maan na keejai saran pareejai d arsan ka-o balihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੀਜੈ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: When the Guru is totally pleased, the separated soul-bride is re-united with herHusband Lord; she sends the message of her true love.
lines.transliteration: gur suparsannay mil naah vichhunay Dh an daydee saach sanayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨੇ ਿਮਲੁ ਨਾਹ ਿਵਛੁੰਨੇ  ਧਨ ਦੇਦੀ  ਸਾਚੁ ਸਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Infinite Lord Master; O my mind, love Him andenshrine such love for Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak chhant  anant  thaakur kay har si-o keejai nayhaa man aisaa nayhu karayhu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਛੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਨੇਹਾ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ  ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The chakvi bird is in love with the sun, and thinks of it constantly; her greatestlonging is to behold the dawn.
lines.transliteration: chakvee soor sanayhu chitvai aas gh anee kad  dinee-ar d aykhee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਕਵੀ  ਸੂਰ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਆਸ  ਘਣੀ  ਕਿਦ  ਿਦਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The cuckoo is in love with the mango tree, and sings so sweetly. O my mind, love theLord in this way.
lines.transliteration: kokil amb pareet chavai suhaavee-aa man har rang keejee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਕਲ  ਅੰਬ ਪਰੀਿਤ  ਚਵੈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ  ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Love the Lord, and do not take pride in yourself; everyone is a guest for a singlenight.
lines.transliteration: har pareet kareejai maan na keejai ik raat ee kay habh  paahun i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ  ਕੇ ਹਿਭ ਪਾਹੁਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Now, why are you entangled in pleasures, and engrossed in emotional attachment?Naked we come, and naked we go.
lines.transliteration: ab ki-aa rang laa-i-o moh rachaa-i-o naagay aavan jaavan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਿਕਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ  ਮੋਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ  ਨਾਗੇ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਵਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Seek the eternal Sanctuary of the Holy and fall at their feet, and the attachments which you feel shall depart.
lines.transliteration: thir saaDhoo sarn ee parh ee-ai charn ee ab tootas moh jo kit ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ  ਪੜੀਐ ਚਰਣੀ  ਅਬ ਟੂਟਿਸ  ਮੋਹੁ ਜੁ ਿਕਤੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Merciful Lord God, and enshrine love for theLord, O my mind; otherwise, how will you come to behold the dawn? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak chhant  da-i-aal purakh  kay man har laa-ay pareet  kab d inee-ar d aykhee- ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਇ  ਪਰੀਿਤ  ਕਬ ਿਦਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Like the deer in the night, who hears the sound of the bell and gives his heart - O mymind, love the Lord in this way.
lines.transliteration: nis kurank jaisay naad sun  sarvan ee hee-o divai man aisee pareet  keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਿਸ  ਕੁਰੰਕ  ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਦ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਹੀਉ ਿਡਵੈ  ਮਨ ਐਸੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Like the wife, who is bound by love to her husband, and serves her beloved - like this,give your heart to the Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaisee tarun  bhataar urjh ee pireh sivai ih man laal d eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਤਰੁਿਣ ਭਤਾਰ  ਉਰਝੀ  ਿਪਰਿਹ  ਿਸਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲ  ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Give your heart to your Beloved Lord, and enjoy His bed, and enjoy all pleasure andbliss.
lines.transliteration: man laaleh deejai bh og kareejai habh  khusee-aa rang maan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਿਹ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਭੋਗ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ਹਿਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained my Husband Lord, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of HisLove; after such a long time, I have met my Friend.
lines.transliteration: pir apnaa paa-i-aa rang laal banaa-i-aa at  mili-o mit ar chiraan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਬਣਾਇਆ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਿਚਰਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Guru became my advocate, then I saw the Lord with my eyes. No one else looks like my Beloved Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur thee-aa saakhee t aa dith am aakh ee pir jayhaa avar na d eesai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਆ  ਸਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਿਡਠਮੁ  ਆਖੀ  ਿਪਰ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the merciful and fascinating Lord, O mind. Grasp thelotus feet of the Lord, and enshrine such love for Him in your mind. ||4||1||4|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (455-12) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl|| sloku ] (455-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) kaho naanak chhant  da-i-aal mohan kay man har charan  gaheejai aisee man pareet keejai. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ  ਮੋਹਨ  ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਗਹੀਜੈ ਐਸੀ  ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: From forest to forest, I wandered searching; I am so tired of taking baths at sacredshrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: ban ban firtee kh ojtee haaree baho avgaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, when I met the Holy Saint, I found the Lord within my mind. ||1|| CMq ] (455-13) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaytay saaDh  jab har paa-i-aa man maahi. ||1||

lines.english: Countless silent sages and innumerable ascetics seek Him;
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o khojeh asaNkh munee anayk t apay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਿਫਰਤੀ  ਖੋਜਤੀ  ਹਾਰੀ  ਬਹੁ ਅਵਗਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: barahmay kot araaDheh gi-aanee jaap japay. millions of Brahmas meditate and adore Him; the spiritual teachers meditate andchant His Name.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਬ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through chanting, deep meditation, strict and austere self-discipline, religious rituals,sincere worship, endless purifications and humble salutations,
lines.transliteration: jap taap sanjam kiri-aa poojaa anik soDh an band naa.
kar gavan basuDhaa t eerthah majan milan ka-o niranjanaa. wandering all over the earth and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, people seekto meet the Pure Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਿਹ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕ  ਤਪੇ ॥
lines.english: Mortals, forests, blades of grass, animals and birds all meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: maanukh ban t in pasoo pankh ee sagal t ujheh araaDh atay.

lines.english: The Merciful Beloved Lord, the Lord of the Universe is found; O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, salvation is attained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal laal gobind  naanak mil saaDh sangat  ho-ay gat ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਪੂਜਾ ਅਿਨਕ  ਸੋਧਨ ਬੰਦਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of incarnations of Vishnu and Shiva, with matted hair
lines.transliteration: kot bisan avtaar sankar jataaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਤੀਰਥਹ  ਮਜਨੁ ਿਮਲਨ  ਕਉ ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: chaaheh tujh eh da-i-aar man t an ruch apaar. yearn for You, O Merciful Lord; their minds and bodies are filled with infinite longing.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਬਨੁ ਿਤਨੁ ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਅਰਾਧਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Master, the Lord of the Universe, is infinite and unapproachable; God is theall-pervading Lord of all.
lines.transliteration: apaar agam gobind th aakur sagal poorak parabh  Dhanee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਲਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The angels, the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, the heavenly heralds andcelestial singers meditate on You. The Yakhsha demons, the guards of the divinetreasures, and the Kinnars, the dancers of the god of wealth chant Your GloriousPraises.
lines.transliteration: sur siDh gan  ganDh arab Dh i-aavahi jakh  kinnar gun  bhanee.

lines.english: Millions of Indras and countless gods and super-human beings meditate on the LordMaster and celebrate His Praises.
lines.transliteration: kot indar anayk d ayvaa japat  su-aamee jai jai kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਹਿਹ  ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਦਇਆਰ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਰੁਚ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord is the Master of the masterless, O Nanak; joining the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anaath naath da-i-aal naanak saaDh sangat  mil uDh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਾਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
lines.english: Millions of gods and goddesses of wealth serve Him in so many ways. pMnw 456
lines.transliteration: kot dayvee jaa ka-o sayveh lakh imee anik bh aat.

lines.english: The invisible and visible beings worship Him in adoration, along with wind and water, day and night.
lines.transliteration: gupat pargat jaa ka-o araaDh eh pa-un  paan ee dinas raat .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਰਾਧਿਹ  ਪਉਣ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The stars, the moon and the sun meditate on Him; the earth and the sky sing to Him.
lines.transliteration: nakhi-at ar sasee-ar soor Dh i-aavahi basuDh  gagnaa gaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਿਖਅਤਰ੍ ਸਸੀਅਰ  ਸੂਰ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਬਸੁਧ  ਗਗਨਾ  ਗਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: All the sources of creation, and all languages meditate on Him, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: sagal khaan ee sagal ban ee sad aa sad aa Dh i-aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਖਾਣੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Simritees, the Puraanas, the four Vedas and the six Shaastras meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: simrit puraan  chatur bayd ah kh at saast ar jaa ka-o japaat .

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਬੇਦਹ  ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His Saints; O Nanak, He is met in the Societyof the Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: patit paavan bh agat vachh al naanak milee-ai sang saat . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੀਐ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਿਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As much as God has revealed to us, that much we can speak with our tongues.
lines.transliteration: jaytee parabh oo janaa-ee rasnaa t ayt bhanee.
