lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਜਨਾਈ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਤੇਤ ਭਨੀ ॥
lines.english: Those unknown ones who serve You cannot be counted.
lines.transliteration: anjaanat jo sayvai t aytee nah jaa-ay ganee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ  ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਤੀ  ਨਹ ਜਾਇ  ਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Imperishable, incalculable, and unfathomable is the Lord and Master; He is everywhere, inside and out.
lines.transliteration: avigat agnat  athaah th aakur sagal manjh ay baahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਵਗਤ ਅਗਨਤ  ਅਥਾਹ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਮੰਝੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: We are all beggars, He is the One and only Giver; He is not far away, but is with us,ever-present.
lines.transliteration: sarab jaachik ayk daat aa nah d oor sangee jaahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਨਹ ਦੂਿਰ ਸੰਗੀ  ਜਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is in the power of His devotees; those whose souls are united with Him - how cantheir praises be sung?
lines.transliteration: vas bhagat  thee-aa milay jee-aa t aa kee upmaa kit  ganee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਸ ਭਗਤ  ਥੀਆ  ਿਮਲੇ ਜੀਆ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਿਕਤ  ਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: May Nanak receive this gift and honor, of placing his head on the feet of the HolySaints. ||4||2||5|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (456-7) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, slok ] (456-7) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: ih daan maan naanak paa-ay sees saaDh ah Dh ar charnee. ||4||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਾਏ ਸੀਸੁ ਸਾਧਹ  ਧਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Make the effort, O very fortunate ones, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord King.
lines.transliteration: udam karahu vadbh aageeho simrahu har har raa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain total peace, and your pains and troubles and doubts shall depart. ||1|| CMqu ] (456-8) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis simrat sabh  sukh  hoveh d ookh darad bharam jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe; don't be lazy.
lines.transliteration: naam japat gobind  nah alsaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ  ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not have to go to the City of Death.
lines.transliteration: bhaytat  saaDh oo sang jam pur nah jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Pain, trouble and fear will not afflict you; meditating on the Naam, a lasting peace isfound.
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad na bh a-o bi-aapai naam simrat  sad sukh ee.

lines.english: With each and every breath, worship the Lord in adoration; meditate on the Lord Godin your mind and with your mouth.
lines.transliteration: saas saas araaDh har har Dh i-aa-ay so parabh  man mukh ee.

lines.english: O kind and compassionate Lord, O treasure of sublime essence, treasure ofexcellence, please link me to Your service.
lines.transliteration: kirpaal da-i-aal rasaal gun  niDh kar d a-i-aa sayvaa laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਨਹ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak: may I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and not be lazy in chanting theNaam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai charan jampai naam japat  gobind  nah alsaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ  ਨ ਭਉ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
lines.english: The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: paavan patit  puneet  naam niranjanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ ਅਰਾਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਿਨ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
lines.english: The darkness of doubt is removed by the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritualwisdom.
lines.transliteration: bharam anDh ayr binaas gi-aan gur anjnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਰਸਾਲ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: By the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, one meets the Immaculate Lord God, who is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan anjan parabh niranjan jal thal mahee-al poori-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਚਰਣ  ਜੰਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If He dwells within the heart, for even an instant, sorrows are forgotten.
lines.transliteration: ik nimakh jaa kai rid ai vasi-aa mitay t iseh visoori-aa.

lines.english: The wisdom of the all-powerful Lord and Master is incomprehensible; He is theDestroyer of the fears of all.
lines.transliteration: agaaDh boDh  samrath su-aamee sarab kaa bh a-o bh anjnaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet. The Purifier of sinners is the Naam,the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai charan jampai paavan pat it puneet  naam niranjanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have grasped the protection of the merciful Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, thetreasure of grace.
lines.transliteration: ot gahee gopaal da-i-aal kirpaa niDh ay.

lines.english: I take the support of Your lotus feet, and in the protection of Your Sanctuary, I attainperfection.
lines.transliteration: mohi aasar tu-a charan t umaaree saran siDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਧ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's lotus feet are the cause of causes; the Lord Master saves even the sinners.
lines.transliteration: har charan kaaran karan su-aamee patit  uDhran har haray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਚਰਣ  ਜੰਪੈ ਪਾਵਨ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: So many are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, contemplating theNaam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saagar sansaar bhav ut aar naam simrat  baho t aray.

lines.english: In the beginning and in the end, countless are those who seek the Lord. I have heard that the Society of the Saints is the way to salvation.
lines.transliteration: aad ant  bay-ant  khojeh sunee uDh ran sat sang biDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਆਸਰ  ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਿਸਧੇ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and grasp the protection of the Lordof the Universe, the merciful, the ocean of kindness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai charan jampai ot gahee gopaal da-i-aal kirpaa niDh ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਰਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al har birad  aap banaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਬਹੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Wherever the Saints worship the Lord in adoration, there He is revealed.
lines.transliteration: jah jah sant araaDh eh tah tah paragtaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਿਤ ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਖੋਜਿਹ  ਸੁਨੀ ਉਧਰਨ  ਸੰਤਸੰਗ  ਿਬਧੇ ॥
lines.english: God blends Himself with His devotees in His natural way, and resolves their affairs.
lines.transliteration: parabh aap lee-ay samaa-ay sahj subh aa-ay bh agat kaaraj saari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਚਰਨ  ਜੰਪੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਧੇ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the ecstasy of the Lord's Praises, they obtain supreme joy, and forget all their sorrows. pMnw 457
lines.transliteration: aanand har jas mahaa mangal sarab d ookh visaari-aa.

lines.english: The brilliant flash of the One Lord is revealed to them - they behold Him in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: chamatkaar pargaas d ah dis ayk t ah daristaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet; the Lord is the Lover of Hisdevotees; this is His natural way. ||4||3||6|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (457-2) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai charan jampai bh agat vachh al har birad  aap banaa-i-aa. ||4||3||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਚਰਣ  ਜੰਪੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਬਨਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
lines.english: The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away.
lines.transliteration: thir santan sohaag marai na jaav-ay.

lines.english: She, whose home is blessed by her Husband Lord, enjoys Him forever.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai garihi har naahu so sad hee raav-ay.

lines.english: God is eternal and immortal, forever young and immaculately pure.
lines.transliteration: avinaasee avigat so parabh  sadaa navt an nirmalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਹੁ ਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: He is not far away, He is ever-present; the Lord and Master fills the ten directions,forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: nah door sad aa had oor th aakur d ah dis pooran sad  sadaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ  ਅਿਵਗਤੁ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Lord of souls, the source of salvation and wisdom. The Love of my DearBeloved is pleasing to me.
lines.transliteration: paraanpat gat  mat jaa tay pari-a pareet  pareet am bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਦੂਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks what the Guru's Teachings have led him to know. The Husband Lord ofthe Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai gur bachan jaan ai thir sant an sohaag marai na jaav-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਿਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o raam bhat aar taa kai anad  ghanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਥਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That soul-bride is happy, and her glory is perfect.
lines.transliteration: sukhvant ee saa naar sobh aa poor ban aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ  ਘਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: She obtains honor, greatness and happiness, singing the Praise of the Lord. God, the Great Being, is always with her.
lines.transliteration: maan mahat  kali-aan  har jas sang surjan so parabh oo.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ  ਸਾ ਨਾਿਰ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪੂਿਰ ਬਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: She attains total perfection and the nine treasures; her home lacks nothing. -everything is there.
lines.transliteration: sarab siDh nav niDh  tit garihi nahee oonaa sabh  kachh oo.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ  ਕਿਲਆਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ॥
lines.english: Her speech is so sweet; she obeys her Beloved Lord; her marriage is permanent andeverlasting.
lines.transliteration: maDhur baanee pireh maanee thir sohaag t aa kaa ban aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਨਹੀ ਊਨਾ  ਸਭੁ ਕਛੂ ॥
lines.english: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: One who has the Lord asher Husband enjoys great bliss. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai gur bachan jaan ai jaa ko raam bh ataar taa kai anad  ghanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਧੁਰ  ਬਾਨੀ  ਿਪਰਿਹ  ਮਾਨੀ ਿਥਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਬਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints.
lines.transliteration: aa-o sakhee sant  paas sayvaa laagee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ  ਘਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let us grind their corn, wash their feet and so renounce our self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: peesa-o charan pakh aar aap t i-aagee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਉ  ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਿਸ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Let us shed our egos, and our troubles shall be removed; let us not display ourselves.
lines.transliteration: taj aap mitai sant aap aap nah jaan aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Let us take to His Sanctuary and obey Him, and be happy with whatever He does.
lines.transliteration: saran gaheejai maan leejai karay so sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਟੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਆਪੁ  ਨਹ ਜਾਣਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Let us become the slaves of His slaves, and shed our sadness, and with our palmspressed together, remain wakeful day and night.
lines.transliteration: kar daas d aasee t aj udaasee kar jorh  din rain  jaagee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਗਹੀਜੈ  ਮਾਿਨ  ਲੀਜੈ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings; come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai gur bachan jaan ai aa-o sakh ee sant  paas sayvaa laagee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ  ਤਿਜ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਜਾਗੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to Hisservice.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai mastak bh aag se sayvaa laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਉ  ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਿਸ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who attains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has his desires fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: taa kee pooran aas jinH saaDh sang paa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord; remember the Lord ofthe Universe in meditation.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har kai rang gobind  simran  laagi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗ ਿਸ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Doubt, emotional attachment, sin and duality - he renounces them all.
lines.transliteration: bharam moh vikaar d oojaa sagal t ineh t i-aagi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸ  ਿਜਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Peace, poise and tranquility fill his mind, and he sings the Lord's Glorious Praises withjoy and delight.
lines.transliteration: man saaNt sahj subh aa-o vooth aa anad  mangal gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਿਸਮਰਣ  ਲਾਿਗਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||4||7|| Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: one who has such gooddestiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service. ||4||4||7|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (457-15) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, sloku ] (457-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai gur bachan jaan ai jaa kai mast ak bh aag se sayvaa laa-i-aa.

lines.english: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Messenger of Death willhave nothing to say to you.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japanti-aa kachh  na kahai jamkaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਸੁਭਾਉ  ਵੂਠਾ ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the mind and body will be at peace, and in the end, you shall merge withthe Lord of the world. ||1|| CMq ] (457-16) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak man tan sukh ee ho-ay ant ay milai gopaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਭਾਗ ਿਸ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: Let me join the Society of the Saints - save me, Lord!
lines.transliteration: mila-o santan kai sang mohi uDh aar layho.

lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer: give me Your Name, O Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: bin-o kara-o kar jorh har har naam d ayh.

lines.english: I beg for the Lord's Name, and fall at His feet; I renounce my self-conceit, by Yourkindness.
lines.transliteration: har naam maaga-o charan laaga-o maan t i-aaga-o t umH da-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਿਤਆ  ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: I shall not wander anywhere else, but take to Your Sanctuary. O God, embodiment ofmercy, have mercy on me.
lines.transliteration: katahooN na Dh aava-o saran  paava-o karun aa mai parabh  kar ma-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O all-powerful, indescribable, infinite and immaculate Lord Master, listen to this, my prayer.
lines.transliteration: samrath agath apaar nirmal sunhu su-aamee bin-o ayhu.

lines.english: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, let my cycle ofbirth and death come to an end. ||1|| pMnw 458
lines.transliteration: kar jorh naanak d aan maagai janam maran  nivaar layho. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sinner, devoid of wisdom, worthless, destitute and vile.
lines.transliteration: apraaDhee mat iheen nirgun anaath neech.

lines.english: I am deceitful, hard-hearted, lowly and entangled in the mud of emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: sath kath or kulheen bi-aapat  moh keech.

lines.english: I am stuck in the filth of doubt and egotistical actions, and I try not to think of death.
lines.transliteration: mal bharam karam ahaN mamt aa maran  cheet  na aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ  ਅਹੰ ਮਮਤਾ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: In ignorance, I cling to the pleasures of woman and the joys of Maya.
lines.transliteration: banitaa binod  anand maa-i-aa agi-aant aa laptaav-ay.

lines.english: My youth is wasting away, old age is approaching, and Death, my companion, iscounting my days.
lines.transliteration: khisai joban baDh ai jaroo-aa d in nihaaray sang meech.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, my hope is in You, Lord; please preserve me, the lowly one, in theSanctuary of the Holy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak aas t ayree saran  saaDh oo raakh  neech. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਸ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਾਧੂ ਰਾਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have wandered through countless incarnations, suffering terrible pain in these lives.
lines.transliteration: bharmay janam anayk sankat mahaa jon.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੇ  ਜਨਮ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਮਹਾ ਜੋਨ ॥
lines.english: I am entangled in sweet pleasures and gold.
lines.transliteration: lapat rahi-o tih sang meeth ay bh og son.

lines.punjabi: ਲਪਿਟ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਤਹ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੀਠੇ ਭੋਗ ਸੋਨ ॥
lines.english: After wandering around with such great loads of sin, I have come, after wandering through so many foreign lands.
lines.transliteration: bharmat  bhaar agnat  aa-i-o baho pard ayseh Dh aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਭਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ  ਆਇਓ  ਬਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਦੇਸਹ  ਧਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Now, I have taken the protection of God, and I have found total peace in the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: ab ot Dhaaree parabh  muraaree sarab sukh  har naa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਓਟ ਧਾਰੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: God, my Beloved, is my protector; nothing was done, or will ever be done, by myselfalone.
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaaray parabh  pi-aaray mujh  tay kachh oo na ho-aa hon.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਆ  ਹੋਨ ॥
lines.english: I have found peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak; by Your mercy, I swim across theworld-ocean. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  naanak kirpaa t ayree t arai bh a-un. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਤਰੈ ਭਉਨ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You saved those who only pretended to believe, so what doubts should Your truedevotees have?
lines.transliteration: naam Dhaareek uDh aaray bh agtah sansaa ka-un.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀਕ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਭਗਤਹ  ਸੰਸਾ ਕਉਨ  ॥
lines.english: By every means possible, listen to the Praises of the Lord with your ears.
lines.transliteration: jayn kayn parkaaray har har jas sunhu sarvan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਨ ਕੇਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: Listen with your ears to the Word of the Lord's Bani, the hymns of spiritual wisdom; thus you shall obtain the treasure in your mind.
lines.transliteration: sun sarvan baanee purakh gi-aanee man niDh aanaa paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਬਾਨੀ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਮਿਨ ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ਪਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Love of the Lord God, the Architect of Destiny, sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har rang raatay parabh  biDhaatay raam kay gun  gaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: The earth is the paper, the forest is the pen and the wind is the writer,
lines.transliteration: basuDh kaagad  banraaj kalmaa likh an ka-o jay ho-ay pavan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੁਧ  ਕਾਗਦ ਬਨਰਾਜ  ਕਲਮਾ  ਿਲਖਣ  ਕਉ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਪਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: Awsw mhlw 5 ] (458-10) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bay-ant ant  na jaa-ay paa-i-aa gahee naanak charan  saran. ||4||5||8|| but still, the end of the endless Lord cannot be found. O Nanak, I have taken to theSanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||5||8||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਨ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord is the Lord God of all beings. I have taken to His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: purakh pat ay bh agvaan t aa kee saran  gahee.

lines.english: My life has become fearless, and all my anxieties have been removed.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay paraan chint aa sagal lahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਖ  ਪਤੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.english: I know the Lord as my mother, father, son, friend, well-wisher and close relative.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  meet  surijan isat banDh ap jaan i-aa.

lines.english: The Guru has led me to embrace Him; the Saints chant His Pure Praises.
lines.transliteration: geh kanth laa-i-aa gur milaa-i-aa jas bimal sant  vakh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਿਰਜਨ  ਇਸਟ  ਬੰਧਪ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: His Glorious Virtues are infinite, and His greatness is unlimited. His value cannot be described at all.
lines.transliteration: bay-ant gun  anayk mahimaa keemat  kachh oo na jaa-ay kahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਜਸੁ ਿਬਮਲ  ਸੰਤ ਵਖਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: God is the One and only, the Unseen Lord and Master; O Nanak, I have grasped Hisprotection. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh ayk anik alakh  thaakur ot naanak t is gahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ  ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਕਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The world is a pool of nectar, when the Lord becomes our helper.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban sansaar sahaa-ee aap bh a-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਏਕ ਅਿਨਕ  ਅਲਖ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name - his days of suffering are ended.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ur haar bikh kay d ivas ga-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਹਾਈ  ਆਿਪ  ਭਏ ॥
lines.english: His state of doubt, attachment and sin is erased, and the cycle of reincarnation intothe womb is totally ended.
lines.transliteration: gat bh aram moh bikaar binsay jon aavan  sabh  rahay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਿਬਖੁ ਕੇ ਿਦਵਸ  ਗਏ ॥
lines.english: The ocean of fire becomes cool, when one grasps the hem of the robe of the HolySaint.
lines.transliteration: agan saagar bha-ay seet al saaDh  anchal geh rahay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਤੁ ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਜੋਿਨ ਆਵਣ  ਸਭ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World, the merciful all-powerful Lord -the Holy Saints proclaim the victory of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: govind gupaal d a-i-aal sammrith bol saaDh oo har jai ja-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ  ਸਾਧ ਅੰਚਲ  ਗਿਹ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, in the perfect Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay pooran saaDh sang paa-ee param gat ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਥ  ਬੋਿਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਿਰ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord permeating and pervading all.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah sang ayko rav rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਪਾਈ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਤੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, He Himself dwells, but how rare is that person who realizes this.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at vaasee aap virlai kinai lahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਹ ਸੰਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; He iscontained in the ant and the elephant.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poor pooran keet hasat samaani-aa.

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, He exists. By Guru's Grace, He isknown.
lines.transliteration: aad ant ay maDh  so-ee gur parsaadee jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਿਰ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕੀਟ ਹਸਿਤ  ਸਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: God created the expanse of the universe, God created the play of the world. Hishumble servants call Him the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: barahm pasri-aa barahm leelaa govind gun  niDh jan kahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਧ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts; O Nanak, He isthe One, pervading and permeating all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: simar su-aamee antarjaamee har ayk naanak rav rahi-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਲੀਲਾ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਜਿਨ ਕਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, become beauteous by remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord. pMnw 459
lines.transliteration: din rain  suhaavarh ee aa-ee simrat  naam haray.

lines.english: In love with the Lord's Lotus Feet, corruption and sin depart.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sang pareet  kalmal paap taray.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Pain, hunger and poverty run away, and the path is clearly revealed.
lines.transliteration: dookh  bhookh daridar naath ay pargat mag d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਦਾਿਰਦਰ੍  ਨਾਠੇ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਮਗੁ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is attuned to the Naam, and obtains the desires of the mind.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangay naam rangay man lorh eedaa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ  ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਿਨ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, desires are fulfilled; all one'sfamily and relatives are saved.
lines.transliteration: har daykh  darsan ichh  punnee kul samboohaa sabh  taray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹਾ  ਸਿਭ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Day and night, he is in bliss, night and day, remembering the Lord in meditation, ONanak. ||4||6||9|| Awsw mhlw 5 CMq Gru 7  (459-4) aasaa mehlaa 5 chhant  ghar 7 Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (459-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku ] (459-5) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: dinas rain  anand an-d in simrant  naanak har haray. ||4||6||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਅਨੰਦ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਿਸਮਰੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
lines.english: It is the most sublime contemplation, to speak of the Lord of the Universe in the pureSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: subh chint an gobind  raman  nirmal saaDh oo sang.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੭ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, never the Naam, even for a moment; bless me with Your Grace, Lord God!||1|| CMq ] (459-6) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na visra-o ik gharh ee kar kirpaa bh agvant . ||1||

lines.english: The night is wet with dew, and the stars twinkle in the heavens.
lines.transliteration: bhinnee rainrh ee-ai chaamkan t aaray.

lines.english: The Saints remain wakeful; they are the Beloveds of my Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaageh sant janaa mayray raam pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਵਸਰਉ  ਇਕ ਘੜੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Beloveds of the Lord remain ever wakeful, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: raam pi-aaray sadaa jaageh naam simrahi and ino.

lines.english: In their hearts, they meditate on the lotus feet of God; they do not forget Him, evenfor an instant.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal Dh i-aan hird ai parabh  bisar naahee ik kh ino.

lines.english: They renounce their pride, emotional attachment and mental corruption, and burnaway the pain of wickedness.
lines.transliteration: taj maan moh bikaar man kaa kalmalaa d ukh jaaray.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, the Saints, the beloved servants of the Lord, remain ever wakeful. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sad aa jaageh har d aas sant  pi-aaray. ||1||

lines.english: My bed is adorned in splendor.
lines.transliteration: mayree sayjrhee-ai aadambar ban i-aa.

lines.english: My mind is filled with bliss, since I heard that God is coming.
lines.transliteration: man anad bh a-i-aa parabh  aavat  suni-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਬਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਲਮਲਾ  ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Meeting God, the Lord and Master, I have entered the realm of peace; I am filled with joy and delight.
lines.transliteration: parabh milay su-aamee sukh ah gaamee chaav mangal ras bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is joined to me, in my very fiber; my sorrows have departed, and my body, mindand soul are all rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: ang sang laagay dookh  bhaagay paraan  man t an sabh  haray.

lines.english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of mywedding is auspicious.
lines.transliteration: man ichh paa-ee parabh  Dhi-aa-ee sanjog saahaa subh  gani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਵਤ  ਸੁਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, when I meet the Lord of excellence, I came to experience all pleasureand bliss. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak milay sareeDh ar sagal aanand  ras ban i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ  ਗਾਮੀ  ਚਾਵ ਮੰਗਲ  ਰਸ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I meet with my companions and say, "Show me the insignia of my Husband Lord."
lines.transliteration: mil sakhee-aa puchh eh kaho kant  neesaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਦੂਖ ਭਾਗੇ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਿਭ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I am filled with the sublime essence of His Love, and I do not know how to sayanything.
lines.transliteration: ras paraym bharee kachh  bol na jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਧਆਈ  ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਸੁਭ ਗਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Glorious Virtues of the Creator are profound, mysterious and infinite; even theVedas cannot find His limits.
lines.transliteration: gun goorh  gupat  apaar kart ay nigam ant  na paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਰਸੁ ਬਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: With loving devotion, I meditate on the Lord Master, and sing the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-ay Dh i-aa-ay su-aamee sad aa har gun  gaavhay.

lines.english: Filled with all virtues and spiritual wisdom, I have become pleasing to my God.
lines.transliteration: sagal gun sugi-aan pooran aapn ay parabh  bhaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਸ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, imbued with the color of the Lord's Love, I am imperceptibly absorbed into Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak rang raat ee paraym sahj samaan ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੂੜ ਗੁਪਤ  ਅਪਾਰ ਕਰਤੇ  ਿਨਗਮ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: When I began to sing the songs of rejoicing to the Lord, my friends became glad, andmy troubles and enemies departed.
lines.transliteration: sukh sohilrh ay har gaavan  laagay. saajan sarsi-arh ay dukh dusman bh aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: My peace and happiness increased; I rejoiced in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, andGod Himself blessed me with His mercy.
lines.transliteration: sukh sahj sarsay har naam rahsay parabh  aap kirpaa Dh aaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਗੁਣ ਸੁਿਗਆਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have grasped the Lord's feet, and remaining ever wakeful, I have met the Lord, theCreator.
lines.transliteration: har charan laagay sad aa jaagay milay parabh  banvaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The appointed day came, and I attained peace and poise; all treasures are in the feetof God.
lines.transliteration: subh d ivas aa-ay sahj paa-ay sagal niDh  parabh  paagay.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, the Lord's humble servants always seek the Sanctuary of the Lord andMaster. ||4||1||10|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (459-17) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  su-aamee sad aa har jan t aagay. ||4||1||10||

lines.english: Rise up and go forth, O traveller; why do you delay?
lines.transliteration: uth vanj  vataa-oorh i-aa tai ki-aa chir laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਸਰਸੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹਸੇ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Your allotted time is now complete - why are you engrossed in falsehood?
lines.transliteration: muhlat punrh ee-aa kit  koorh  lobhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: You desire that which is false; deceived by Maya, you commit innumerable sins.
lines.transliteration: koorhay lubh aa-i-aa Dh ohu maa-i-aa karahi paap amit i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭ ਿਦਵਸ  ਆਏ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Your body shall become a pile of dust; the Messenger of Death has spotted you, and will conquer you. pMnw 460
lines.transliteration: tan bh asam dh ayree jameh hayree kaal bapurh ai jiti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਲੁ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਵੈਸੀ ਰਿਹਓ  ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Abandoning your wealth and youth, you will have to leave, without any food or clothing.
lines.transliteration: maal joban chhod vaisee rahi-o painan  khaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਮਾਣਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਜੁਿਲਆ  ਨਹ ਜਾਇ  ਿਕਰਤੁ ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, only your actions shall go with you; the consequences of your actionscannot be erased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kamaanaa sang juli-aa nah jaa-ay kirat  mitaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Like the deer, captured on a moon-lit night,
lines.transliteration: faathohu mirag jivai paykh rain  chand raa-in .
sookhahu d ookh bha-ay nit  paap kamaa-in . so does the constant commission of sins turn pleasure into pain.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪਾ ਕਮਾਣੇ  ਛਡਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਘਿਤ  ਗਲਾਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: The sins you have committed shall not leave you; placing the noose around your neck, they shall lead you away.
lines.transliteration: paapaa kamaanay chh adeh naahee lai chalay gh at galaavi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਚੰਦਉਰੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਮੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਰਾਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: Beholding an illusion, you are deceived, and on your bed, you enjoy a false lover.
lines.transliteration: harichand-uree d aykh mooth aa koorh  sayjaa raavi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਿਬ ਲੋਿਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਭਇਆ  ਸਮਾਇਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: You are intoxicated with greed, avarice and egotism; you are engrossed in self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh ahaNkaar maat aa garab bh a-i-aa samaa-in .

lines.english: O Nanak, like the deer, you are being destroyed by your ignorance; your comings andgoings shall never end. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak marig agi-aan binsay nah mitai aavan jaa-in . ||2||

lines.english: The fly is caught in the sweet candy - how can it fly away?
lines.transliteration: mithai makh  mu-aa ki-o la-ay odaaree.

lines.english: The elephant has fallen into the pit - how can it escape?
lines.transliteration: hastee garat  pa-i-aa ki-o t aree-ai t aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ  ਭਇਆ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਖਸਮੁ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: It shall be so difficult to swim across, for one who does not remember the Lord andMaster, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: taran duhaylaa bh a-i-aa kh in meh kh asam chit  na aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖਾ ਸਜਾਈ  ਗਣਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੀਆ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਪਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: His sufferings and punishments are beyond reckoning; he receives the consequencesof his own actions.
lines.transliteration: dookh aa sajaa-ee gan at naahee kee-aa apn aa paa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਝਾ  ਕਮਾਣਾ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ  ਈਤ ਉਤਿਹ  ਖੁਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: His secret deeds are exposed, and he is ruined here and hereafter.
lines.transliteration: gujhaa kamaan aa pargat ho-aa eet  uteh kh u-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਝੁ ਮੂਠਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੋ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the self-willed egotistical manmukh is defrauded. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur baajh  mooth aa manmukh o ahaNkaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਜੀਵੇ ਲਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's slaves live by holding on to God's feet.
lines.transliteration: har kay daas jeevay lag parabh  kee charn ee.

lines.english: The Lord and Master embraces those who seek His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: kanth lagaa-ay lee-ay t is thaakur sarn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਲ ਬੁਿਧ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He blesses them with power, wisdom, knowledge and meditation; He Himself inspiresthem to chant His Name.
lines.transliteration: bal buDh gi-aan Dh i-aan apn aa aap naam japaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੋਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and He Himself saves theworld.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  aap ho-aa aap jagat  taraa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Preserver preserves those whose actions are always pure.
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay rakh anhaarai sad aa nirmal karn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they never have to go to hell; the Lord's Saints are under the Lord'sProtection. ||4||2||11|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (460-11) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak narak na jaahi kabahooN har sant har kee sarn ee. ||4||2||11||

lines.english: Be gone, O my laziness, that I may pray to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vanj mayray aalsaa har paas baynant ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵੰਞੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਆਲਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: I enjoy my Husband Lord, and look beautiful with my God.
lines.transliteration: raava-o saho aapnarhaa parabh  sang sohant ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਵਉ  ਸਹੁ ਆਪਨੜਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੋਹੰਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: I look beautiful in the Company of my Husband Lord; I enjoy my Lord Master day and night.
lines.transliteration: sangay sohantee kant  su-aamee d inas rain ee raavee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਗੇ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ  ਕੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਣੀ ਰਾਵੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I live by remembering God with each and every breath, beholding the Lord, andsinging His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: saas saas chitaar jeevaa parabh  paykh  har gun  gaavee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਚਤਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੇਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The pain of separation has grown shy, for I have obtained the Blessed Vision of HisDarshan; His Ambrosial Glance of Grace has filled me with bliss.
lines.transliteration: birhaa lajaa-i-aa daras paa-i-aa ami-o d arisat siNchant ee.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the One I was seeking. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak mayree ichh  punnee milay jis kh ojantee. ||1||

lines.english: Run away, O sins; the Creator has entered my home.
lines.transliteration: nas vanjahu kilvikh ahu kart aa gh ar aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The demons within me have been burnt; the Lord of the Universe has revealedHimself to me.
lines.transliteration: dootah dahan bh a-i-aa govind  paragtaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Beloved Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself; in theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant His Name.
lines.transliteration: pargatay gupaal gobind laalan saaDh sang vakh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਲਾਲਨ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਵਖਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen the Wondrous Lord; He showers His Ambrosial Nectar upon me, and by Guru's Grace, I know Him.
lines.transliteration: aacharaj deethaa ami-o vooth aa gur parsaadee jaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਚਰਜੁ  ਡੀਠਾ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਵੂਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is at peace, resounding with the music of bliss; the Lord's limits cannot befound.
lines.transliteration: man saaNt aa-ee vajee vaDh aa-ee nah ant  jaa-ee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ  ਨਹ ਅੰਤੁ ਜਾਈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, God brings us to union with Himself, in the poise of celestial peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sukh  sahj maylaa parabh oo aap ban aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਮੇਲਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਆਿਪ  ਬਣਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They do not have to see hell, if they remember the Lord in meditation.
lines.transliteration: narak na deeth-rh i-aa simrat  naaraa-in .

lines.english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma applauds them, and the Messenger of Death runsaway from them.
lines.transliteration: jai jai Dharam karay d oot bha-ay palaa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਭਏ ਪਲਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam Dh eeraj sahj sukh ee-ay saaDh sangat  har bh ajay. Dharmic faith, patience, peace and poise are obtained by vibrating upon the Lord inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਧੀਰਜ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜੇ ॥
lines.english: Showering His Blessings, He saves those who renounce all attachments and egotism.
lines.transliteration: kar anoograhu raakh leenay moh mamt aa sabh  tajay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਨੇ  ਮੋਹ ਮਮਤਾ  ਸਭ ਤਜੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord embraces us; the Guru unites us with Him. Meditating on the Lord of theUniverse, we are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: geh kanth laa-ay gur milaa-ay govind  japat  aghaa-in.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਏ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਜਪਤ  ਅਘਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, remembering the Lord and Master in meditation, all hopes are fulfilled. ||3|| pMnw 461
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak simar su-aamee sagal aas pujaa-in . ||3||

lines.english: Grasping the Lord's Feet, the treasure of the Siddhas, what suffering can I feel?
lines.transliteration: niDh siDh  charan  gahay t aa kayhaa kaarh aa.

lines.english: Everything is in His Power - He is my God.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  vas jisai so parabh oo asaarh aa.

lines.english: Holding me the the arm, He blesses me with His Name; placing His Hand upon my forehead, He saves me.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa leenay naam d eenay kar Dh aar mast ak raakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ  ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨੇ  ਕਰੁ ਧਾਿਰ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਰਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: The world-ocean does not trouble me, for I have drunk the sublime elixir of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar nah vi-aapai ami-o har ras chaakhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am victoriouson the great battlefield of life.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangay naam rangay ran  jeet vadaa akh aarhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ  ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਣੁ ਜੀਿਤ  ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master; the Messenger ofDeath shall not destroy me again. ||4||3||12|| Awsw mhlw 5 ] (461-4) aasaa mehlaa 5. Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  su-aamee bahurh  jam na upaarh aa. ||4||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜਿਮ ਨ ਉਪਾੜਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Those actions you perform, day and night, are recorded upon your forehead.
lines.transliteration: din raat  kamaa-i-arh o so aa-i-o maathai.

lines.english: And the One, from whom you hide these actions - He sees them, and is always with you.
lines.transliteration: jis paas lukaa-id-rh o so vaykh ee saathai.

lines.english: The Creator Lord is with you; He sees you, so why commit sins?
lines.transliteration: sang daykh ai karan haaraa kaa-ay paap kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: So perform good deeds, and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall neverhave to go to hell.
lines.transliteration: sukarit keejai naam leejai narak mool na jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ਕਾਇ  ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the Lord's Name in meditation; it alone shall goalong with you.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har naam simrahu chalai t ayrai saathay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤੁ  ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ  ਨਰਿਕ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: So vibrate continually in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, andthe sins you committed shall be erased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaj saaDh sangat  sadaa naanak miteh d okh kamaat ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
lines.english: Practicing deceit, you fill your belly, you ignorant fool!
lines.transliteration: valvanch kar udar bh areh moorakh  gaavaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਟਿਹ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Great Giver, continues to give you everything.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  day rahi-aa har d ayvan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਲਵੰਚ  ਕਿਰ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਿਹ  ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver is always merciful. Why should we forget the Lord Master from ourminds?
lines.transliteration: daataar sad aa da-i-aal su-aamee kaa-ay manhu visaaree-ai.

lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, and vibrate fearlessly; all your relations shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangay bh aj nisangay kul samoohaa t aaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਾਇ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas, the seekers, the demi-gods, the silent sages and the devotees, all take the Naam as their support.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik dayv mun jan bh agat naam aDh aaraa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, vibrate continually upon God, the One Creator Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sad aa bh ajee-ai parabh  ayk karnaihaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਦੇਵ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Do not practice deception - God is the Assayer of all.
lines.transliteration: khot na keech-ee parabh  parkh anhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਭਜੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who practice falsehood and deceit are reincarnated in the world.
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat kamaavd arhay janmeh sansaaraa.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the One Lord, cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar tinHee tari-aa jinHee ayk Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, flattery and slander, they enter the Sanctuary ofGod.
lines.transliteration: taj kaam kroDh  anind  nindaa parabh  sarnaa-ee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The lofty, inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master is pervading the water, the landand the sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al ravi-aa su-aamee ooch agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਿਨੰਦ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, He is the support of His servants; His Lotus Feet are their onlysustenance. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak tayk jan kee charan  kamal aDh aaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਊਚ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Behold - the world is a mirage; nothing here is permanent.
lines.transliteration: paykh harichand -urrhee asthir kichh  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The pleasures of Maya which are here, shall not go with you.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa rang jaytay say sang na jaahee.

lines.english: The Lord, your companion, is always with you; remember Him day and night.
lines.transliteration: har sang saathee sadaa t ayrai d inas rain  samaalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the One Lord, there is no other; burn away the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: har ayk bin kachh avar naahee bh aa-o d utee-aa jaalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਥੀ  ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Know in your mind, that the One God is your friend, youth, wealth and everything.
lines.transliteration: meet joban maal sarbas parabh  ayk kar man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਏਕ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਜਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, by great good fortune, we find the Lord, and merge in peace and celestial poise. ||4||4||13|| Awsw mhlw 5 CMq Gru 8 (461-17) aasaa mehlaa 5 chhant  ghar 8 Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Eighth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (461-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak vadbh aag paa-ee-ai sookh  sahj samaahee. ||4||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Maya is the wall of doubt - Maya is the wall of doubt. It is such a powerful anddestructive intoxicant; it corrupts and wastes away one's life.
lines.transliteration: kamlaa bharam bh eet kamlaa bh aram bh eet hay t eekhan mad bipreet  hay avaDh akaarath jaat.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸੂਿਖ ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: In the terrible, impenetrable world-forest - in the terrible, impenetrable world-forest, the thieves are plundering man's house in broad daylight; night and day, this life isbeing consumed.
lines.transliteration: gahbar ban ghor gahbar ban gh or hay garih moosat  man chor hay d inkaro an-d in khaat .

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੮ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The days of your life are being consumed; they are passing away without God. So meet God, the Merciful Lord. pMnw 462
lines.transliteration: din kh aat jaat bihaat  parabh  bin milhu parabh  karun aa pat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ  ਿਬਹਾਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
lines.english: I passed through so many births and deaths; without Union with the Beloved, I did not obtain salvation.
lines.transliteration: janam maran anayk beet ay pari-a sang bin kachh  nah gat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਬੀਤੇ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਸੰਗ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹ ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.english: I am without the status of high birth, beauty, glory or spiritual wisdom; without You,who is mine, O Mother?
lines.transliteration: kul roop Dhoop gi-aanheenee t ujh binaa mohi kavan maat .

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਲ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਿਗਆਨਹੀਨੀ  ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨਾ  ਮੋਿਹ ਕਵਨ  ਮਾਤ ॥
lines.english: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I enter the Lord's Sanctuary; O belovedalmighty Lord and Master, please, save me! ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar jorh naanak saran  aa-i-o pari-a naath narhar karahu gaat . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਆਇਓ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ  ਕਰਹੁ ਗਾਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Like a fish out of water - like a fish out of water, separated from the Lord, the mind and body perish; how can I live, without my Beloved?
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) meenaa jalheen meenaa jalheen hay oh bichhurat  man t an kh een hay kat  jeevan pari- a bin hot.

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਨਾ  ਜਲਹੀਨ  ਮੀਨਾ  ਜਲਹੀਨ  ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਿਬਛੁਰਤ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਖੀਨ ਹੇ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹੋਤ ॥
lines.english: Awsw, mÚ 5) sanmukh seh baan sanmukh  seh baan hay marig arpay man t an paraan hay oh bayDhi-o sahj sarot . Facing the arrow head-on - facing the arrow head-on, the deer surrenders his mind, body and breath of life; he is struck by the hunter's soothing music.

lines.punjabi: ਸਨਮੁਖ  ਸਿਹ ਬਾਨ ਸਨਮੁਖ  ਸਿਹ ਬਾਨ ਹੇ ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਅਰਪੇ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬੇਿਧਓ ਸਹਜ  ਸਰੋਤ  ॥
lines.english: I have enshrined love for my Beloved. In order to meet Him, I have become a renunciate. Cursed is that body which remains without Him, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: pari-a pareet laagee mil bairaagee kh in rahan Dh arig tan tis binaa.

lines.english: My eyelids do not close, for I am absorbed in the love of my Beloved. Day and night,my mind thinks only of God.
lines.transliteration: palkaa na laagai pari-a paraym paagai chitvant  an-din parabh  manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਲਕਾ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਾਗੈ  ਿਚਤਵੰਿਤ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Lord, intoxicated with the Naam, fear, doubt and duality have all leftme.
lines.transliteration: sareerang raatay naam maat ay bh ai bharam d utee-aa sagal kh ot.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀਰੰਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ  ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਖੋਤ ॥
lines.english: Bestow Your mercy and compassion, O merciful and perfect Lord, that Nanak may beintoxicated with Your Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar ma-i-aa da-i-aa d a-i-aal pooran har paraym naanak magan hot . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਮਇਆ  ਦਇਆ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਗਨ  ਹੋਤ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The bumble-bee is buzzing - the bumble-bee is buzzing, intoxicated with the honey, the flavor and the fragrance; because of its love for the lotus, it entangles itself. cwiqRk icq ipAws cwiqRk icq ipAws hy Gn bUMd biciqR min Aws hy Al pIvq ibnsq qwp ] (462-8, Awsw, mÚ 5) chaatrik chit  pi-aas chaat rik chit  pi-aas hay gh an boond  bachit ar man aas hay al peevat binsat  taap. The mind of the rainbird thirsts - the mind of the rainbird thirsts; its mind longs forthe beautiful rain-drops from the clouds. Drinking them in, its fever departs.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) alee-al guNjaat alee-al guNjaat hay makrand  ras baasan maat  hay pareet  kamal banDhaavat  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲੀਅਲ  ਗੁੰਜਾਤ  ਅਲੀਅਲ  ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਹੇ ਮਕਰੰਦ  ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ  ਮਾਤ ਹੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਮਲ  ਬੰਧਾਵਤ  ਆਪ  ॥
lines.english: O Destroyer of fever, Remover of pain, please unite me with You. My mind and body have such great love for You.
lines.transliteration: taapaa binaasan d ookh naasan mil paraym man t an at ghanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਚਤ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਚਤ  ਿਪਆਸ ਹੇ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਿਚਿਤਰ੍  ਮਿਨ ਆਸ  ਹੇ ਅਲ ਪੀਵਤ  ਿਬਨਸਤ  ਤਾਪ ॥
lines.english: O my beautiful, wise and all-knowing Lord and Master, with what tongue should Ichant Your Praises?
lines.transliteration: sundar chat ur sujaan su-aamee kavan rasnaa gun  bhanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਪਾ  ਿਬਨਾਸਨ  ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਨ  ਿਮਲੁ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਅਿਤ  ਘਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Take me by the arm, and grant me Your Name. One who is blessed with Your Glanceof Grace, has his sins erased.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa layvhu naam d ayvhu d arisat Dh aarat mitat  paap.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਵਨ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Nanak meditates on the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; beholding His Vision, he suffersno more. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak jampai patit  paavan har d aras paykh at nah sant aap. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਾਰਤ  ਿਮਟਤ  ਪਾਪ ॥
lines.english: Awsw, mÚ 5) chitva-o chit  naath chit va-o chit  naath hay rakh  layvhu saran  anaath hay mil chaa-o chaa-eelay paraan. I focus my consciousness on the Lord - I focus my consciousness upon the Lord; I amhelpless - please, keep me under Your Protection. I yearn to meet You, my soulhungers for You.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜੰਪੈ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਨਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Awsw, mÚ 5) sundar t an Dh i-aan sund ar tan Dh i-aan hay man lubaDh  gopaal gi-aan hay jaachik jan raakhat  maan. I meditate on Your beautiful body - I meditate on Your beautiful body; my mind is fascinated by Your spiritual wisdom, O Lord of the world. Please, preserve the honorof Your humble servants and beggars.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਵਉ ਿਚਤ  ਨਾਥ ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਿਚਤ  ਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਅਨਾਥ  ਹੇ ਿਮਲੁ ਚਾਉ  ਚਾਈਲੇ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ॥
lines.english: God bestows perfect honor and destroys pain; He has fulfilled all my desires.
lines.transliteration: parabh maan pooran d ukh bideeran sagal ichh  pujant ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਤਨ ਿਧਆਨ  ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਤਨ ਿਧਆਨ  ਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਲੁਬਧ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਹੇ ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਜਨ ਰਾਖਤ  ਮਾਨ ॥
lines.english: How very blessed was that day when the Lord embraced me; meeting my Husband Lord, my bed was beautified.
lines.transliteration: har kanth laagay d in sabh aagay mil naah sayj suhant ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਿਬਦੀਰਨ  ਸਗਲ  ਇਛ ਪੁਜੰਤੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: When God granted His Grace and met me, all my sins were erased.
lines.transliteration: parabh d arisat Dh aaree milay muraaree sagal kalmal bh a-ay haan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਦਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਨਾਹ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੰਤੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi, thetreasure of excellence. ||4||1||14|| <> siqnwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (462-17) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear.No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: Awsw mhlw 1 ] (462-18) aasaa mehlaa 1. Aasaa, First Mehl: vwr slokw nwil slok BI mhly pihly ky ilKy tuMfy As rwjY kI DunI ] (462-18) vaar salokaa naal salok bhee mahlay pahilay kay likh ay tunday as raajai kee Dh unee. Vaar With Shaloks, And Shaloks Written By The First Mehl. To Be Sung To The TuneOf 'Tunda-Asraajaa': sloku mÚ 1 ] (462-19) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak mayree aas pooran milay sareeDh ar gun  niDhaan. ||4||1||14||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਿਮਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਭਏ ਹਾਨ ॥
lines.english: A hundred times a day, I am a sacrifice to my Guru;
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay d i-uhaarh ee sad  vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
lines.english: He made angels out of men, without delay. ||1|| pMnw 463 mhlw 2 ] (463-1) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin maanas t ay dayvtay kee-ay karat  na laagee vaar. ||1||

lines.english: If a hundred moons were to rise, and a thousand suns appeared,
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o chandaa ugvahi sooraj charh eh hajaar.

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aytay chaanan  hidi-aaN gur bin gh or anDh aar. ||2|| even with such light, there would still be pitch darkness without the Guru. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (463-2) mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਚੰਦਾ  ਉਗਵਿਹ  ਸੂਰਜ  ਚੜਿਹ  ਹਜਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who do not think of the Guru, and who think of themselves as clever,
lines.transliteration: naanak guroo na chaytnee man aapn ai suchayt .

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੇ ਚਾਨਣ  ਹੋਿਦਆਂ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chhutay t il boo-aarh  ji-o sunj ay and ar khayt. shall be left abandoned in the field, like the scattered sesame.

lines.english: They are abandoned in the field, says Nanak, and they have a hundred masters toplease.
lines.transliteration: khayt ai and ar chh uti-aa kaho naanak sa-o naah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ  ਮਿਨ ਆਪਣੈ  ਸੁਚੇਤ  ॥
lines.english: The wretches bear fruit and flower, but within their bodies, they are filled with ashes.||3|| pauVI ] (463-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: falee-ah fulee-ah bapurhay bh ee tan vich su-aah. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself created Himself; He Himself assumed His Name.
lines.transliteration: aapeenHai aap saaji-o aapeenHai rachi-o naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਤੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਛੁਿਟਆ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਉ ਨਾਹ ॥
lines.english: Secondly, He fashioned the creation; seated within the creation, He beholds it withdelight.
lines.transliteration: duyee kud rat saajee-ai kar aasan  ditho chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਫਲੀਅਿਹ  ਫੁਲੀਅਿਹ  ਬਪੁੜੇ  ਭੀ ਤਨ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੁਆਹ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; by Your Pleasure, You bestow Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: daataa kart aa aap t ooN tus dayveh karahi pasaa-o.

lines.english: You are the Knower of all; You give life, and take it away again with a word.
lines.transliteration: tooN jaano-ee sabh sai day laisahi jind  kavaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੀਨੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਸਾਿਜਓ  ਆਪੀਨੈ  ਰਿਚਓ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Seated within the creation, You behold it with delight. ||1|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (463-6) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar aasan dith o chaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਯੀ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸਾਜੀਐ  ਕਿਰ ਆਸਣੁ  ਿਡਠੋ ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: True are Your worlds, True are Your solar Systems.
lines.transliteration: sachay tayray kh and sachay barahmand.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਤਾ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਤੂੰ ਤੁਿਸ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਸਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: True are Your realms, True is Your creation.
lines.transliteration: sachay tayray lo-a sachay aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੋਈ  ਸਭਸੈ  ਦੇ ਲੈਸਿਹ  ਿਜੰਦੁ  ਕਵਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: True are Your actions, and all Your deliberations.
lines.transliteration: sachay tayray karn ay sarab beechaar.

lines.english: True is Your Command, and True is Your Court.
lines.transliteration: sachaa tayraa amar sachaa d eebaan .

lines.english: True is the Command of Your Will, True is Your Order.
lines.transliteration: sachaa tayraa hukam sachaa furmaan .

lines.english: True is Your Mercy, True is Your Insignia.
lines.transliteration: sachaa tayraa karam sachaa neesaan .

lines.english: Hundreds of thousands and millions call You True.
lines.transliteration: sachay tuDh  aakh ahi lakh  karorh .

lines.english: In the True Lord is all power, in the True Lord is all might.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabh t aan sachai sabh  jor.

lines.english: True is Your Praise, True is Your Adoration.
lines.transliteration: sachee tayree sifat  sachee saalaah.

lines.english: True is Your almighty creative power, True King.
lines.transliteration: sachee tayree kud rat sachay paat isaah.

lines.english: O Nanak, true are those who meditate on the True One.
lines.transliteration: naanak sach Dhi-aa-in sach.

lines.english: Those who are subject to birth and death are totally false. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (463-10) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo mar jammay so kach nikach. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਿਭ ਤਾਿਣ  ਸਚੈ ਸਿਭ ਜੋਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Great is His greatness, as great as His Name.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee jaa vadaa naa-o.

lines.english: Great is His greatness, as True is His justice.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee jaa sach ni-aa-o.

lines.english: Great is His greatness, as permanent as His Throne.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee jaa nihchal thaa-o.

lines.english: Great is His greatness, as He knows our utterances.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee jaanai aalaa-o.

lines.english: Great is His greatness, as He understands all our affections.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee bujhai sabh  bhaa-o.

lines.english: Great is His greatness, as He gives without being asked.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee jaa puchh na d aat.

lines.english: Great is His greatness, as He Himself is all-in-all.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee jaa aapay aap.

lines.english: O Nanak, His actions cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: naanak kaar na kathnee jaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever He has done, or will do, is all by His Own Will. ||2|| mhlw 2 ] (463-13) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: keetaa karn aa sarab rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: This world is the room of the True Lord; within it is the dwelling of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih jag sachai kee hai koth-rh ee sachay kaa vich vaas.

lines.english: By His Command, some are merged into Him, and some, by His Command, are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: iknHaa hukam samaa-ay la-ay iknHaa hukmay karay vinaas.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜਾ ਪੁਿਛ ਨ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Some, by the Pleasure of His Will, are lifted up out of Maya, while others are made todwell within it.
lines.transliteration: iknHaa bhaan ai kadh  la-ay iknHaa maa-i-aa vich nivaas.

lines.english: No one can say who will be rescued.
lines.transliteration: ayv bhe aakh  na jaap-ee je kisai aan ay raas.

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is known as Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself. ||3|| pauVI ] (463-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh jaan ee-ai jaa ka-o aap karay pargaas. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, having created the souls, the Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharmato read and record their accounts.
lines.transliteration: naanak jee-a upaa-ay kai likh naavai Dh aram bahaali-aa.

lines.english: There, only the Truth is judged true; the sinners are picked out and separated.
lines.transliteration: othai sachay hee sach nibrhai chun  vakh  kadh ay jajmaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਚੈ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਠੜੀ  ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The false find no place there, and they go to hell with their faces blackened.
lines.transliteration: thaa-o na paa-in koorhi-aar muh kaalHai dojak chaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਮਾਇ  ਲਏ ਇਕਨਾ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਿਵਣਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with Your Name win, while the cheaters lose.
lines.transliteration: tayrai naa-ay rat ay say jin  ga-ay haar ga-ay se th agan vaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਭਾਣੈ ਕਿਢ  ਲਏ ਇਕਨਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record the accounts. ||2|| slok mÚ 1 ] (463-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: likh naavai Dh aram bahaali-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਵ ਿਭ ਆਿਖ  ਨ ਜਾਪਈ  ਿਜ ਿਕਸੈ ਆਣੇ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Wonderful is the sound current of the Naad, wonderful is the knowledge of the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: vismaad naad  vismaad  vayd .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Wonderful are the beings, wonderful are the species.
lines.transliteration: vismaad jee-a vismaad  bhayd.

lines.english: Wonderful are the forms, wonderful are the colors.
lines.transliteration: vismaad roop vismaad  rang.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਅ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਿਲਿਖ  ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ  ਬਹਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wonderful are the beings who wander around naked. pMnw 464
lines.transliteration: vismaad naagay fireh jant .

lines.english: Wonderful is the wind, wonderful is the water.
lines.transliteration: vismaad pa-un  vismaad  paan ee.

lines.english: Wonderful is fire, which works wonders.
lines.transliteration: vismaad agnee kh aydeh vidaan ee.

lines.english: Wonderful is the earth, wonderful the sources of creation.
lines.transliteration: vismaad Dh artee vismaad  khaanee.

lines.english: Wonderful are the tastes to which mortals are attached.
lines.transliteration: vismaad saad  lageh paraan ee.

lines.english: Wonderful is union, and wonderful is separation.
lines.transliteration: vismaad sanjog vismaad  vijog.

lines.english: Wonderful is hunger, wonderful is satisfaction.
lines.transliteration: vismaad bh ukh vismaad  bhog.

lines.english: Wonderful is His Praise, wonderful is His adoration.
lines.transliteration: vismaad sifat  vismaad  saalaah.

lines.english: Wonderful is the wilderness, wonderful is the path.
lines.transliteration: vismaad ujh arh vismaad  raah.

lines.english: Wonderful is closeness, wonderful is distance.
lines.transliteration: vismaad nayrh ai vismaad  door.

lines.english: How wonderful to behold the Lord, ever-present here.
lines.transliteration: vismaad d aykhai haajraa hajoor.

lines.english: Beholding His wonders, I am wonder-struck.
lines.transliteration: vaykh vidaan  rahi-aa vismaad .

lines.english: O Nanak, those who understand this are blessed with perfect destiny. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (464-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bujhan  poorai bh aag. ||1||

lines.english: By His Power we see, by His Power we hear; by His Power we have fear, and theessence of happiness.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  disai kud rat sunee-ai kud rat bha-o sukh  saar.

lines.english: By His Power the nether worlds exist, and the Akaashic ethers; by His Power theentire creation exists.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  paataalee aakaasee kud rat sarab aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਿਦਸੈ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਭਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Power the Vedas and the Puraanas exist, and the Holy Scriptures of the Jewish,Christian and Islamic religions. By His Power all deliberations exist.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  vayd  puraan  kataybaa kud rat sarab veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਪਾਤਾਲੀ  ਆਕਾਸੀ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ ਸਰਬ  ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Power we eat, drink and dress; by His Power all love exists.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  khaanaa peen aa painHan kudrat sarab pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਕਤੇਬਾ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸਰਬ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: - By His Power come the species of all kinds and colors; by His Power the living beingsof the world exist.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  jaatee jinsee rangee kud rat jee-a jahaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਖਾਣਾ  ਪੀਣਾ  ਪੈਨਣੁ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Power virtues exist, and by His Power vices exist. By His Power come honorand dishonor.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  naykee-aa kud rat badee-aa kud rat maan abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਜਾਤੀ  ਿਜਨਸੀ  ਰੰਗੀ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਜੀਅ  ਜਹਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: By His Power wind, water and fire exist; by His Power earth and dust exist.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  pa-un  paan ee baisant ar kud rat Dhartee kh aak.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਨੇਕੀਆ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ ਬਦੀਆ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਮਾਨੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ॥
lines.english: Everything is in Your Power, Lord; You are the all-powerful Creator. Your Name is the Holiest of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree kud rat tooN kaad ir kart aa paakee naa-ee paak.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਖਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Command of His Will, He beholds and pervades the creation;He is absolutely unrivalled. ||2|| pauVI ] (464-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukmai andar vaykh ai vart ai taako t aak. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ ਤੂੰ ਕਾਿਦਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪਾਕੀ  ਨਾਈ  ਪਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: Enjoying his pleasures, one is reduced to a pile of ashes, and the soul passes away.
lines.transliteration: aapeenHai bhog bh og kai ho-ay bh asmarh  bha-ur siDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ  ਤਾਕੋ  ਤਾਕੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He may be great, but when he dies, the chain is thrown around his neck, and he is ledaway.
lines.transliteration: vadaa ho-aa duneed aar gal sangal gh at chalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: There, his good and bad deeds are added up; sitting there, his account is read.
lines.transliteration: agai karnee keerat  vaachee-ai bahi laykh aa kar samjh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੀਨੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਿਗ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮਿੜ  ਭਉਰੁ ਿਸਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is whipped, but finds no place of rest, and no one hears his cries of pain.
lines.transliteration: thaa-o na hovee pa-udee-ee hun  sunee-ai ki-aa roo-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ  ਦੁਨੀਦਾਰੁ ਗਿਲ  ਸੰਗਲੁ  ਘਿਤ  ਚਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The blind man has wasted his life away. ||3|| slok mÚ 1 ] (464-12) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man anDhai janam gavaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਕਰਣੀ  ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਵਾਚੀਐ  ਬਿਹ ਲੇਖਾ  ਕਿਰ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God, the wind and breezes ever blow.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich pavan  vahai sad vaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਉਦੀਈ  ਹੁਿਣ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਿਕਆ ਰੂਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God, thousands of rivers flow.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich chaleh lakh  daree-aa-o.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, fire is forced to labor.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich agan kadh ai vaygaar.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, the earth is crushed under its burden.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich Dh artee dabee bh aar.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, the clouds move across the sky.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich ind  firai sir bh aar.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands at His Door.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich raajaa Dh aram d u-aar.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, the sun shines, and in the Fear of God, the moon reflects.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich sooraj bh ai vich chand .

lines.english: They travel millions of miles, endlessly.
lines.transliteration: koh karorhee chalat  na ant .

lines.english: In the Fear of God, the Siddhas exist, as do the Buddhas, the demi-gods and Yogis.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich siDh  buDh  sur naath.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, the Akaashic ethers are stretched across the sky.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich aadaan ay aakaas.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, the warriors and the most powerful heroes exist.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich joDh  mahaabal soor.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, multitudes come and go.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich aavahi jaaveh poor.

lines.english: God has inscribed the Inscription of His Fear upon the heads of all.
lines.transliteration: sagli-aa bha-o likh i-aa sir laykh .

lines.english: O Nanak, the Fearless Lord, the Formless Lord, the True Lord, is One. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (464-16) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nirbha-o nirankaar sach ayk. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord is fearless and formless; myriads of others, like Rama, are meredust before Him.
lines.transliteration: naanak nirbha-o nirankaar hor kayt ay raam ravaal.

lines.english: There are so many stories of Krishna, so many who reflect over the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: kaytee-aa kanH kahaan ee-aa kayt ay bayd  beechaar.

lines.english: So many beggars dance, spinning around to the beat.
lines.transliteration: kaytay nacheh mangt ay girh  murh  pooreh t aal.

lines.english: The magicians perform their magic in the market place, creating a false illusion.
lines.transliteration: baajaaree baajaar meh aa-ay kadheh baajaar.

lines.english: They sing as kings and queens, and speak of this and that.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi raajay raanee-aa boleh aal pat aal.

lines.english: They wear earrings, and necklaces worth thousands of dollars.
lines.transliteration: lakh taki-aa kay mund -rhay lakh  taki-aa kay haar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੀਆ  ਕੰਨ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ  ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those bodies on which they are worn, O Nanak, those bodies turn to ashes. pMnw 465
lines.transliteration: jit tan paa-ee-ah naankaa say t an hoveh chh aar.

lines.english: Wisdom cannot be found through mere words. To explain it is as hard as iron.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan na galee-ee dhoodh ee-ai kathnaa karrh aa saar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਗਲੀਈ  ਢੂਢੀਐ  ਕਥਨਾ  ਕਰੜਾ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Grace, then alone it is received; other tricks and orders are useless. ||2|| pauVI ] (465-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: karam milai taa paa-ee-ai hor hikmat  hukam kh u-aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹੋਰ ਿਹਕਮਿਤ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If the Merciful Lord shows His Mercy, then the True Guru is found.
lines.transliteration: nadar karahi jay aapn ee taa nad ree sat gur paa-i-aa.

lines.english: This soul wandered through countless incarnations, until the True Guru instructed it inthe Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ayhu jee-o bahutay janam bh arammi-aa t aa sat gur sabad  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There is no giver as great as the True Guru; hear this, all you people.
lines.transliteration: satgur jayvad d aataa ko nahee sabh  suni-ahu lok sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜਨਮ  ਭਰੰਿਮਆ  ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the True Lord is found; He removes self-conceit from within,
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai sach paa-i-aa jinHee vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਿਣਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin sacho sach bujhaa-i-aa. ||4|| and instructs us in the Truth of Truths. ||4|| slok mÚ 1 ] (465-5) salok mehlaa 1.

lines.english: All the hours are the milk-maids, and the quarters of the day are the Krishnas.
lines.transliteration: gharh ee-aa sabh ay gopee-aa pahar kanH gopaal.

lines.english: The wind, water and fire are the ornaments; the sun and moon are the incarnations.
lines.transliteration: gahnay pa-un  paan ee baisant ar chand  sooraj avt aar.

lines.english: All of the earth, property, wealth and articles are all entanglements.
lines.transliteration: saglee Dhart ee maal Dh an vart an sarab janjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀਆ  ਸਭੇ ਗੋਪੀਆ  ਪਹਰ  ਕੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without divine knowledge, one is plundered, and devoured by theMessenger of Death. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (465-7) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak musai gi-aan vihoonee kh aa-ay ga-i-aa jamkaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਹਣੇ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਅਵਤਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The disciples play the music, and the gurus dance.
lines.transliteration: vaa-in chaylay nachan gur.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੀ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਮਾਲੁ  ਧਨੁ ਵਰਤਿਣ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੰਜਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: They move their feet and roll their heads.
lines.transliteration: pair halaa-in fayrniH sir.

lines.english: The dust flies and falls upon their hair.
lines.transliteration: ud ud raavaa jhaatai paa-ay.

lines.english: Beholding them, the people laugh, and then go home.
lines.transliteration: vaykhai lok hasai gh ar jaa-ay.

lines.english: They beat the drums for the sake of bread.
lines.transliteration: rotee-aa kaaran pooreh t aal.

lines.english: They throw themselves upon the ground.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaarh eh Dh artee naal.

lines.english: They sing of the milk-maids, they sing of the Krishnas.
lines.transliteration: gaavan gopee-aa gaavan kaanH.

lines.english: They sing of Sitas, and Ramas and kings.
lines.transliteration: gaavan seetaa raajay raam.

lines.english: The Lord is fearless and formless; His Name is True.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar sach naam.

lines.english: The entire universe is His Creation.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa kee-aa sagal jahaan.

lines.english: Those servants, whose destiny is awakened, serve the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayveh karam charhaa-o.

lines.english: The night of their lives is cool with dew; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhinnee rain  jinHaa man chaa-o.

lines.english: Contemplating the Guru, I have been taught these teachings;
lines.transliteration: sikhee sikh i-aa gur veechaar.
nadree karam lagh aa-ay paar. granting His Grace, He carries His servants across.

lines.english: The oil-press, the spinning wheel, the grinding stones, the potter's wheel,
lines.transliteration: koloo charkhaa chakee chak.
thal vaarolay bahut anant . the numerous, countless whirlwinds in the desert,
laatoo maaDhaan ee-aa angaah. the spinning tops, the churning sticks, the threshers,
pankhee bh a-udee-aa lain na saah. the breathless tumblings of the birds,
soo-ai chaarh bh avaa-ee-ah jant . and the men moving round and round on spindles

lines.english: - O Nanak, the tumblers are countless and endless.
lines.transliteration: naanak bha-ud i-aa gan at na ant .

lines.english: The Lord binds us in bondage - so do we spin around.
lines.transliteration: banDhan banDh  bhavaa-ay so-ay.

lines.english: According to their actions, so do all people dance.
lines.transliteration: pa-i-ai kirat nachai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: Those who dance and dance and laugh, shall weep on their ultimate departure.
lines.transliteration: nach nach haseh chaleh say ro-ay.

lines.english: They do not fly to the heavens, nor do they become Siddhas.
lines.transliteration: ud na jaahee siDh na hohi.

lines.english: They dance and jump around on the urgings of their minds.
lines.transliteration: nachan kud an man kaa chaa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Fear of God, have the love of God intheir minds as well. ||2|| pauVI ] (465-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jinH man bha-o t inHaa man bh aa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਿਚ ਨਿਚ ਹਸਿਹ ਚਲਿਹ  ਸੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Your Name is the Fearless Lord; chanting Your Name, one does not have to go to hell.
lines.transliteration: naa-o tayraa nirankaar hai naa-ay la-i-ai narak na jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Soul and body all belong to Him; asking Him to give us sustenance is a waste.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is daa day kh aajai aakh  gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: If you yearn for goodness, then perform good deeds and feel humble.
lines.transliteration: jay lorheh changa aapn aa kar punnhu neech sad aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Even if you remove the signs of old age, old age shall still come in the guise of death.
lines.transliteration: jay jarvaanaa parharai jar vays karayd ee aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: No one remains here when the count of the breaths is full. ||5|| slok mÚ 1 ] (465-17) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ko rahai na bharee-ai paa-ee-ai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਇ  ਲਇਐ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Muslims praise the Islamic law; they read and reflect upon it.
lines.transliteration: musalmaanaa sifat saree-at  parh parh karahi beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਦੇ ਖਾਜੈ ਆਿਖ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's bound servants are those who bind themselves to see the Lord's Vision.
lines.transliteration: banday say je paveh vich band ee vaykh an ka-o d eedaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਚੰਗਾ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਕਿਰ ਪੁੰਨਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Hindus praise the Praiseworthy Lord; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, His formis incomparable.
lines.transliteration: hindoo saalaahee saalaahan d arsan roop apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਰਹਰੈ  ਜਰੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀ  ਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: They bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, making offerings of flowers, and burningincense before idols.
lines.transliteration: tirath naaveh archaa poojaa agar vaas behkaar.

lines.english: The Yogis meditate on the absolute Lord there; they call the Creator the Unseen Lord. pMnw 466
lines.transliteration: jogee sunn Dhi-aavniH jaytay alakh  naam kart aar.

lines.english: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.
lines.transliteration: sookham moorat  naam niranjan kaa-i-aa kaa aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖਮ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.
