lines.transliteration: satee-aa man sant okh upjai d aynai kai veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੀਆ  ਮਿਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They give and give, but ask a thousand-fold more, and hope that the world will honor them.
lines.transliteration: day d ay mangeh sahsaa goon aa sobh  karay sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਿਹ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਗੂਣਾ  ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The thieves, adulterers, perjurers, evil-doers and sinners
lines.transliteration: choraa jaaraa tai koorh i-aaraa kh aaraabaa vaykaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ  ਤੈ ਕੂਿੜਆਰਾ  ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ik hodaa kh aa-ay chaleh aithaa-oo t inaa bh e kaa-ee kaar. - after using up what good karma they had, they depart; have they done any gooddeeds here at all?

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਐਥਾਊ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਭ ਕਾਈ  ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: There are beings and creatures in the water and on the land, in the worlds anduniverses, form upon form.
lines.transliteration: jal thal jee-aa puree-aa lo-aa aakaaraa aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਜੀਆ  ਪੁਰੀਆ  ਲੋਆ  ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever they say, You know; You care for them all.
lines.transliteration: o-ay je aakhahi so t ooNhai jaan eh tinaa bh e tayree saar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਿਜ ਆਖਿਹ  ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the hunger of the devotees is to praise You; the True Name is their onlysupport.
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt aa bh ukh saalaahan  sach naam aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They live in eternal bliss, day and night; they are the dust of the feet of the virtuous.||1|| mÚ 1 ] (466-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand raheh d in raat ee gun vanti-aa paa chh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਣਵੰਿਤਆ  ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The clay of the Muslim's grave becomes clay for the potter's wheel.
lines.transliteration: mitee musalmaan kee payrhai pa-ee kumHi-aar.

lines.english: Pots and bricks are fashioned from it, and it cries out as it burns.
lines.transliteration: gharh  bhaaNday itaa kee-aa jald ee karay pukaar.

lines.english: The poor clay burns, burns and weeps, as the fiery coals fall upon it.
lines.transliteration: jal jal rovai bapurhee jh arh jharh paveh angi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿੜ  ਭਡੇ ਇਟਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਜਲਦੀ  ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator created the creation; the Creator Lord alone knows. ||2|| pauVI ] (466-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin kartai kaaran  kee-aa so jaan ai kart aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਜਿਲ  ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ  ਝਿੜ ਝਿੜ ਪਵਿਹ  ਅੰਿਗਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kinai na paa-i-o bin sat gur kinai na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He has placed Himself within the True Guru; revealing Himself, He declares thisopenly.
lines.transliteration: satgur vich aap rakh i-on kar pargat aakh  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, eternal liberation is obtained; He has banished attachmentfrom within.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai sad aa mukat  hai jin vichahu moh chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This is the highest thought, that one's consciousness is attached to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: utam ayhu beechaar hai jin sachay si-o chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਪੁ  ਰਿਖਓਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Thus the Lord of the World, the Great Giver is obtained. ||6|| slok mÚ 1 ] (466-10) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan daat aa paa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In ego they come, and in ego they go.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich aa-i-aa ha-o vich ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਤਮੁ  ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In ego they are born, and in ego they die.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich jammi-aa ha-o vich mu-aa.

lines.english: In ego they give, and in ego they take.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich dit aa ha-o vich la-i-aa.

lines.english: In ego they earn, and in ego they lose.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich khati-aa ha-o vich ga-i-aa.

lines.english: In ego they become truthful or false.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich sachiaar koorhi-aar.

lines.english: In ego they reflect on virtue and sin.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich paap punn veechaar.

lines.english: In ego they go to heaven or hell.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich narak surag avtaar.

lines.english: In ego they laugh, and in ego they weep.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich hasai ha-o vich rovai.

lines.english: In ego they become dirty, and in ego they are washed clean.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich bharee-ai ha-o vich Dh ovai.

lines.english: In ego they lose social status and class.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich jaatee jinsee kh ovai.

lines.english: In ego they are ignorant, and in ego they are wise.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich moorakh ha-o vich si-aan aa.

lines.english: They do not know the value of salvation and liberation.
lines.transliteration: mokh mukat  kee saar na jaan aa.

lines.english: In ego they love Maya, and in ego they are kept in darkness by it.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vich maa-i-aa ha-o vich chhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Living in ego, mortal beings are created.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kar kar jant upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai boojhai t aa dar soojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without spiritual wisdom, they babble and argue.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan vihoonaa kath kath loojh ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, by the Lord's Command, destiny is recorded.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukmee likee-ai laykh.

lines.english: As the Lord sees us, so are we seen. ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (466-16) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jayhaa vaykheh t ayhaa vaykh . ||1||

lines.english: This is the nature of ego, that people perform their actions in ego.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai ayhaa jaat hai ha-umai karam kamaahi.

lines.english: This is the bondage of ego, that time and time again, they are reborn.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai ay-ee banDhnaa fir fir jonee paahi.

lines.english: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kithhu oopjai kit sanjam ih jaa-ay.

lines.english: This ego exists by the Lord's Order; people wander according to their past actions.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai ayho hukam hai pa-i-ai kirat firaahi.

lines.english: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai deeragh  rog hai d aaroo bh ee is maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਏਹਾ ਜਾਿਤ  ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: If the Lord grants His Grace, one acts according to the Teachings of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay jay aapnee t aa gur kaa sabad  kamaahi.

lines.english: Nanak says, listen, people: in this way, troubles depart. ||2|| pauVI ] (466-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sunhu janhu it  sanjam d ukh jaahi. ||2||

lines.english: Those who serve are content. They meditate on the Truest of the True. pMnw 467
lines.transliteration: sayv keetee sant okhee-eeN jinHee sacho sach Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: They do not place their feet in sin, but do good deeds and live righteously in Dharma.
lines.transliteration: onHee mandai pair na rakh i-o kar sukarit  Dharam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨੀ  ਮੰਦੈ ਪੈਰੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਓ  ਕਿਰ ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They burn away the bonds of the world, and eat a simple diet of grain and water.
lines.transliteration: onHee dunee-aa t orhay banDh naa ann paan ee thorh aa kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ  ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Great Forgiver; You give continually, more and more each day.
lines.transliteration: tooN bakh seesee aglaa nit  dayveh charh eh savaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸੀਸੀ  ਅਗਲਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਚੜਿਹ  ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By His greatness, the Great Lord is obtained. ||7|| slok mÚ 1 ] (467-3) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadi-aa-ee vadaa paa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: Men, trees, sacred shrines of pilgrimage, banks of sacred rivers, clouds, fields,
lines.transliteration: purkhaaN birkh aaN teerthaaN tataaN maygh aaN khaytaaNh.
deepaaN lo-aaN mandlaaN khandaaN varbh andaaNh. islands, continents, worlds, solar systems, and universes;
andaj jayraj ut-bh ujaaN khaanee sayt jaaNh. the four sources of creation - born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth andborn of sweat;
so mit jaan ai naankaa saraaN mayraaN jantaah. oceans, mountains, and all beings - O Nanak, He alone knows their condition.

lines.english: O Nanak, having created the living beings, He cherishes them all.
lines.transliteration: naanak jant upaa-ay kai sammaalay sabh naah.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਮਿਤ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਰ ਮੇਰ ਜੰਤਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator who created the creation, takes care of it as well.
lines.transliteration: jin kartai karn aa kee-aa chint aa bh e karn ee taah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਸੰਮਾਲੇ  ਸਭਨਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: He, the Creator who formed the world, cares for it.
lines.transliteration: so kartaa chint aa karay jin upaa-i-aa jag.

lines.english: Unto Him I bow and offer my reverence; His Royal Court is eternal.
lines.transliteration: tis johaaree su-asat  tis tis deebaan  abhag.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, of what use is the frontal mark of the Hindus, or their sacred thread? ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (467-7) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam bin ki-aa tikaa ki-aa tag. ||1||

lines.english: Hundreds of thousands of virtues and good actions, and hundreds of thousands ofblessed charities,
lines.transliteration: lakh naykee-aa chang-aa-ee-aa lakh  punnaa parvaan .
lakh t ap upar t eerthaaN sahj jog baybaan . hundreds of thousands of penances at sacred shrines, and the practice of Sehj Yoga inthe wilderness,
lakh soort an sangraam ran  meh chh uteh paraan . hundreds of thousands of courageous actions and giving up the breath of life on the field of battle,

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਨੇਕੀਆ  ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh surt ee lakh  gi-aan Dh i-aan parh ee-ah paath  puraan . hundreds of thousands of divine understandings, hundreds of thousands of divinewisdoms and meditations and readings of the Vedas and the Puraanas

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਤਪ ਉਪਿਰ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਸਹਜ  ਜੋਗ ਬੇਬਾਣ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kartai karn aa kee-aa likh i-aa aavan  jaan. - before the Creator who created the creation, and who ordained coming and going,

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਸੂਰਤਣ  ਸੰਗਰਾਮ  ਰਣ ਮਿਹ ਛੁਟਿਹ  ਪਰਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, all these things are false. True is the Insignia of His Grace. ||2|| pauVI ] (467-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak matee mithi-aa karam sachaa neesaan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤੀ  ਲਖ ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਪੜੀਅਿਹ  ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: You alone are the True Lord. The Truth of Truths is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib ayk tooN jin sacho sach vart aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He alone receives the Truth, unto whom You give it; then, he practices Truth.
lines.transliteration: jis tooN deh tis milai sach t aa tinHee sach kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is found. In His Heart, Truth is abiding.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai sach paa-i-aa jinH kai hird ai sach vasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The fools do not know the Truth. The self-willed manmukhs waste their lives away invain.
lines.transliteration: moorakh sach na jaan anHee manmukh ee janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Why have they even come into the world? ||8|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (467-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vich dunee-aa kaahay aa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਿਤਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You may read and read loads of books; you may read and study vast multitudes ofbooks.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  gadee lad ee-ah parh  parh bharee-ah saath.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You may read and read boat-loads of books; you may read and read and fill pits withthem.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  bayrh ee paa-ee-ai parh  parh gadee-ah kh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖੀ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You may read them year after year; you may read them as many months are thereare.
lines.transliteration: parhee-ah jayt ay baras baras parh ee-ah jayt ay maas.

lines.english: You may read them all your life; you may read them with every breath.
lines.transliteration: parhee-ai jayt ee aarjaa parh ee-ah jayt ay saas.

lines.english: O Nanak, only one thing is of any account: everything else is useless babbling and idletalk in ego. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (467-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laykhai ik gal hor ha-umai jh akh-naa jhaakh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਗਡੀ  ਲਦੀਅਿਹ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਭਰੀਅਿਹ  ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.english: The more one write and reads,
lines.transliteration: likh likh  parhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਗਡੀਅਿਹ  ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: taytaa karh i-aa. the more one burns.

lines.punjabi: ਪੜੀਅਿਹ  ਜੇਤੇ ਬਰਸ  ਬਰਸ  ਪੜੀਅਿਹ  ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਸ ॥
lines.english: The more one wanders at sacred shrines of pilgrimage,
lines.transliteration: baho tirath bh avi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੜੀਐ  ਜੇਤੀ  ਆਰਜਾ  ਪੜੀਅਿਹ  ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: tayto lavi-aa. the more one talks uselessly.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਖੈ ਇਕ ਗਲ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਝਖਣਾ  ਝਾਖ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The more one wears religious robes, the more pain he causes his body.
lines.transliteration: baho bhaykh  kee-aa d ayhee d ukh dee-aa.

lines.english: O my soul, you must endure the consequences of your own actions.
lines.transliteration: saho vay jee-aa apnaa kee-aa.

lines.english: One who does not eat the corn, misses out on the taste.
lines.transliteration: ann na khaa-i-aa saad  gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: One obtains great pain, in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: baho dukh  paa-i-aa d oojaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: One who does not wear any clothes,
lines.transliteration: bastar na pahirai.
ahinis kahrai. suffers night and day.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਆ  ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through silence, he is ruined.
lines.transliteration: mon vigootaa.

lines.english: How can the sleeping one be awakened without the Guru?
lines.transliteration: ki-o jaagai gur bin sootaa.

lines.english: One who goes barefoot
lines.transliteration: pag upaytaan aa.
apnaa kee-aa kamaan aa. suffers by his own actions.

lines.english: One who eats filth and throws ashes on his head
lines.transliteration: al mal khaa-ee sir chh aa-ee paa-ee.
moorakh anDh ai pat  gavaa-ee. - the blind fool loses his honor.

lines.english: Without the Name, nothing is of any use.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai kichh  thaa-ay na paa-ee.

lines.english: One who lives in the wilderness, in cemetaries and cremation grounds
lines.transliteration: rahai baybaanee marh ee masaan ee.
anDh na jaan ai fir pachh utaanee. - that blind man does not know the Lord; he regrets and repents in the end. pMnw 468

lines.english: One who meets the True Guru finds peace.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay so sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, when the Lord grants His Grace, He is obtained.
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar karay so paa-ay.

lines.english: He becomes free of hope and fear, and burns away his ego with the Word of theShabad. ||2|| pauVI ] (468-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aas andaysay t ay nihkayval ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਅੰਦੇਸੇ  ਤੇ ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲੁ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your devotees are pleasing to Your Mind, Lord. They look beautiful at Your door,singing Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  tayrai man bh aavday dar sohan keerat  gaavd ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are denied Your Grace, find no shelter at Your Door; theycontinue wandering.
lines.transliteration: naanak karmaa baahray dar dh o-a na lehnHee Dh aavday.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਦੇ  ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹਿਨ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗਾਵਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: Some do not understand their origins, and without cause, they display their self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: ik mool na bujhniH aapn aa an hodaa aap gan aa-iday.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮਾ  ਬਾਹਰੇ  ਦਿਰ ਢੋਅ ਨ ਲਹਨੀ  ਧਾਵਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am the Lord's minstrel, of low social status; others call themselves high caste.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhaadh ee kaa neech jaat  hor ut am jaat  sadaa-iday.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ  ਗਣਾਇਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: I seek those who meditate on You. ||9|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (468-5) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tinH mangaa je t ujhai Dhi-aa-id ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ  ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਿਤ  ਹੋਿਰ ਉਤਮ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਸਦਾਇਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: False is the king, false are the subjects; false is the whole world.
lines.transliteration: koorh raajaa koorh  parjaa koorh  sabh  sansaar.

lines.english: False is the mansion, false are the skyscrapers; false are those who live in them.
lines.transliteration: koorh mandap koorh  maarh ee koorh  baisan haar.

lines.english: False is gold, and false is silver; false are those who wear them.
lines.transliteration: koorh su-inaa koorh  rupaa koorh  painHanhaar.

lines.english: False is the body, false are the clothes; false is incomparable beauty.
lines.transliteration: koorh kaa-i-aa koorh  kaparh  koorh  roop apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: False is the husband, false is the wife; they mourn and waste away.
lines.transliteration: koorh mee-aa koorh  beebee kh ap ho-ay kh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ  ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The false ones love falsehood, and forget their Creator.
lines.transliteration: koorh koorhai nayhu lagaa visri-aa kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: With whom should I become friends, if all the world shall pass away?
lines.transliteration: kis naal keechai dost ee sabh  jag chalan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ  ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ॥
lines.english: False is sweetness, false is honey; through falsehood, boat-loads of men have drowned.
lines.transliteration: koorh mith aa koorh  maakh i-o koorh  dobay poor.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ  ਖਿਪ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks this prayer: without You, Lord, everything is totally false. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (468-8) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai baynt ee tuDh baajh  koorh o koorh . ||1||

lines.english: One knows the Truth only when the Truth is in his heart.
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaan ee-ai jaa rid ai sachaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਕੀਚੈ  ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: The filth of falsehood departs, and the body is washed clean.
lines.transliteration: koorh kee mal ut rai tan karay hachh aa Dh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਿਮਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਿਖਉ  ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: One knows the Truth only when he bears love to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaan ee-ai jaa sach Dh aray pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, the mind is enraptured; then, he attains the gate of salvation.
lines.transliteration: naa-o sun man rehsee-ai t aa paa-ay mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: One knows the Truth only when he knows the true way of life.
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaan ee-ai jaa jugat  jaanai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Dharat  kaa-i-aa saaDh  kai vich d ay-ay kart aa bee-o. Preparing the field of the body, he plants the Seed of the Creator.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One knows the Truth only when he receives true instruction.
lines.transliteration: sach taa par jaan ee-ai jaa sikh  sachee lay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਸਿਚ ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Showing mercy to other beings, he makes donations to charities.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa jaan ai jee-a kee kichh  punn d aan karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ  ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: One knows the Truth only when he dwells in the sacred shrine of pilgrimage of his own soul.
lines.transliteration: sach taaN par jaan ee-ai jaa aat am tirath karay nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He sits and receives instruction from the True Guru, and lives in accordance with HisWill.
lines.transliteration: satguroo no puchh  kai bahi rahai karay nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਤ  ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਿਧ  ਕੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ  ਬੀਉ ॥
lines.english: Truth is the medicine for all; it removes and washes away our sins.
lines.transliteration: sach sabhnaa ho-ay d aaroo paap kadh ai Dho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਿਸਖ ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks this prayer to those who have Truth in their laps. ||2|| pauVI ] (468-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai baynt ee jin sach palai ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਿਕਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: The gift I seek is the dust of the feet of the Saints; if I were to obtain it, I would applyit to my forehead.
lines.transliteration: daan mahindaa t alee kh aak jay milai t a mast ak laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਤ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਆਤਮ  ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਕਰੇ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce false greed, and meditate single-mindedly on the unseen Lord.
lines.transliteration: koorhaa laalach chh adee-ai ho-ay ik man alakh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨੋ ਪੁਿਛ ਕੈ ਬਿਹ ਰਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: As are the actions we commit, so are the rewards we receive.
lines.transliteration: fal tayvayho paa-ee-ai jayvayhee kaar kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If it is so pre-ordained, then one obtains the dust of the feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: jay hovai poorab likhi-aa t aa Dh oorh tinHaa dee paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਿਜਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: But through small-mindedness, we forfeit the merits of selfless service. ||10|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (468-16) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mat thorh ee sayv gavaa-ee-ai. ||10||

lines.english: There is a famine of Truth; falsehood prevails, and the blackness of the Dark Age ofKali Yuga has turned men into demons.
lines.transliteration: sach kaal koorh vart i-aa kal kaalakh  baytaal.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨੁ ਮਿਹੰਡਾ  ਤਲੀ  ਖਾਕੁ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Those who planted their seed have departed with honor; now, how can the shatteredseed sprout?
lines.transliteration: bee-o beej pat lai ga-ay ab ki-o ugvai d aal.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ  ਛਡੀਐ  ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: If the seed is whole, and it is the proper season, then the seed will sprout.
lines.transliteration: jay ik ho-ay ta ugvai rut ee hoo rut  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇਵੇਹੀ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without treatment, the raw fabric cannot be dyed.
lines.transliteration: naanak paahai baahraa korai rang na so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਤਾ ਧੂਿੜ ਿਤਨਾ  ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God it is bleached white, if the treatment of modesty is applied to thecloth of the body.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich kh umb charh aa-ee-ai saram paahu t an ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, if one is imbued with devotional worship, his reputation is not false. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (468-19) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt ee jay rapai koorhai so-ay na ko-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Greed and sin are the king and prime minister; falsehood is the treasurer.
lines.transliteration: lab paap du-ay raajaa maht aa koorh  ho-aa sikd aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਿਤਆ  ਕਿਲ  ਕਾਲਖ  ਬੇਤਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, the chief advisor, is summoned and consulted; they all sit together and contemplate their plans. pMnw 469
lines.transliteration: kaam nayb sad puchh ee-ai bahi bahi karay beechaar.

lines.english: Their subjects are blind, and without wisdom, they try to please the will of the dead.
lines.transliteration: anDhee rayat  gi-aan vihoon ee bh aahi bh aray murd aar.

lines.english: The spiritually wise dance and play their musical instruments, adorning themselveswith beautiful decorations.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee nacheh vaajay vaaveh roop karahi seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਨਚਿਹ  ਵਾਜੇ ਵਾਵਿਹ  ਰੂਪ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They shout out loud, and sing epic poems and heroic stories.
lines.transliteration: oochay kookeh vaadaa gaavahi joDh aa kaa veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚੇ ਕੂਕਿਹ  ਵਾਦਾ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਜੋਧਾ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The fools call themselves spiritual scholars, and by their clever tricks, they love togather wealth.
lines.transliteration: moorakh pandit  hikmat  hujat  sanjai karahi pi-aar.

lines.english: Dharmee Dh aram karahi gaavaaveh mangeh mokh  du-aar. The righteous waste their righteousness, by asking for the door of salvation.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮੀ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਗਾਵਾਵਿਹ  ਮੰਗਿਹ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They call themselves celibate, and abandon their homes, but they do not know thetrue way of life.
lines.transliteration: jatee sad aaveh jugat  na jaan eh chh ad baheh gh ar baar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੀ  ਸਦਾਵਿਹ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਛਿਡ ਬਹਿਹ  ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Everyone calls himself perfect; none call themselves imperfect.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko pooraa aapay hovai gh at na ko-ee aakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਪੇ  ਹੋਵੈ ਘਿਟ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ  ॥
lines.english: If the weight of honor is placed on the scale, then, O Nanak, one sees his true weight. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (469-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pat parvaan aa pichh ai paa-ee-ai t aa naanak t oli-aa jaapai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ  ਿਪਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ  ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਿਲਆ  ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Evil actions become publicly known; O Nanak, the True Lord sees everything.
lines.transliteration: vadee so vajag naankaa sachaa vaykh ai so-ay.

lines.english: Everyone makes the attempt, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does.
lines.transliteration: sabhnee chh aalaa maaree-aa kart aa karay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਦੀ ਸੁ ਵਜਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In the world hereafter, social status and power mean nothing; hereafter, the soul isnew.
lines.transliteration: agai jaat na jor hai agai jee-o navay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨੀ  ਛਾਲਾ  ਮਾਰੀਆ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those few, whose honor is confirmed, are good. ||3|| pauVI ] (469-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jin kee laykhai pat  pavai changay say-ee kay-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਨਵੇ ॥
lines.english: Dhur karam jinaa ka-o t uDh paa-i-aa t aa tinee kh asam Dh i-aa-i-aa. Only those whose karma You have pre-ordained from the very beginning, O Lord,meditate on You.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਵੈ ਚੰਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nothing is in the power of these beings; You created the various worlds.
lines.transliteration: aynaa jantaa kai vas kichh  naahee t uDh vaykee jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Some, You unite with Yourself, and some, You lead astray.
lines.transliteration: iknaa no tooN mayl laihi ik aaphu t uDh khu-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਮੁ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤਾ ਿਤਨੀ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace You are known; through Him, You reveal Yourself.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay jaan i-aa jithai t uDh aap bujh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਵੇਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: We are easily absorbed in You. ||11|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (469-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee sach samaa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਇਿਕ  ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Suffering is the medicine, and pleasure the disease, because where there is pleasure, there is no desire for God.
lines.transliteration: dukh daaroo sukh  rog bh a-i-aa jaa sukh  taam na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਜਾਿਣਆ ਿਜਥੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੁ  ਬੁਝਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Creator Lord; I can do nothing. Even if I try, nothing happens. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa karn aa mai naahee jaa ha-o karee na ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power which is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree kudrat  vasi-aa.

lines.english: Your limits cannot be known. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayraa ant  na jaa-ee lakh i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਿਮ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Your Light is in Your creatures, and Your creatures are in Your Light; Your almighty power is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jaat meh jot  jot meh jaat aa akal kalaa bh arpoor rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the True Lord and Master; Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, iscarried across.
lines.transliteration: tooN sachaa saahib sifat  su-aaliha-o jin keet ee so paar pa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak speaks the stories of the Creator Lord; whatever He is to do, He does. ||2|| mÚ 2 ] (469-13) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kartay kee-aa baat aa jo kichh  karnaa so kar rahi-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Way of Yoga is the Way of spiritual wisdom; the Vedas are the Way of theBrahmins.
lines.transliteration: jog sabdaN gi-aan sabd aN bayd  sabd aN baraahman eh.

lines.english: The Way of the Khshatriya is the Way of bravery; the Way of the Shudras is service toothers.
lines.transliteration: khatree sabd aN soor sabd aN sood ar sabd aN paraa kirt eh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ ਜੋਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਜਾਤਾ  ਅਕਲ  ਕਲਾ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: 2) sarab sabdaN ayk sabd aN jay ko jaan ai bhay-o. naanak t aa kaa d aas hai so-ee niranjan day-o. ||3|| The Way of all is the Way of the One; Nanak is a slave to one who knows this secret; he himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||3|| mÚ 2 ] (469-15) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸੁਆਿਲਉ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤੀ  ਸੋ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord Krishna is the Divine Lord of all; He is the Divinity of the individual soul.
lines.transliteration: ayk krisanN sarab dayvaa d ayv d ayvaa t a aatmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ  ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੁ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak is a slave to anyone who understands this mystery of the all-pervading Lord; he himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||4|| mÚ 1 ] (469-16) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aatmaa baasd ayvsi-y jay ko jaan ai bhay-o. naanak t aa kaa d aas hai so-ee niranjan day-o. ||4||

lines.english: Water remains confined within the pitcher, but without water, the pitcher could nothave been formed;
lines.transliteration: kumbhay baDh aa jal rahai jal bin kumbh  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਸਬਦੰ  ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ  ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gi-aan kaa baDhaa man rahai gur bin gi-aan na ho-ay. ||5|| just so, the mind is restrained by spiritual wisdom, but without the Guru, there is nospiritual wisdom. ||5|| pauVI ] (469-17) pa-orhee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਸਬਦੰ  ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ  ਸੂਦਰ੍ ਸਬਦੰ  ਪਰਾ ਿਕਰ੍ਤਹ  ॥
lines.english: If an educated person is a sinner, then the illiterate holy man is not to be punished.
lines.transliteration: parhi-aa hovai gunahgaar t aa omee saaDh  na maaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸਬਦੰ  ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਭੇਉ ॥
lines.english: As are the deeds done, so is the reputation one acquires.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa ghaalay gh aalnaa tayvayho naa-o pachaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: So do not play such a game, which will bring you to ruin at the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisee kalaa na khaydee-ai jit  dargeh ga-i-aa haaree-ai.

lines.english: The accounts of the educated and the illiterate shall be judged in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: parhi-aa at ai omee-aa veechaar agai veechaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨੰ  ਸਰਬ  ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who stubbornly follows his own mind shall suffer in the world hereafter. ||12|| pMnw 470 sloku mÚ 1 ] (470-1) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: muhi chalai so agai maaree-ai. ||12||

lines.english: O Nanak, the soul of the body has one chariot and one charioteer.
lines.transliteration: naanak mayr sareer kaa ik rath ik rathvaahu.

lines.english: In age after age they change; the spiritually wise understand this.
lines.transliteration: jug jug fayr vataa-ee-ah gi-aanee bujheh t aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ  ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਥੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, contentment was the chariot and righteousness thecharioteer.
lines.transliteration: satjug rath sant okh kaa Dh aram agai rathvaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਫੇਿਰ ਵਟਾਈਅਿਹ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਬੁਝਿਹ  ਤਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, celibacy was the chariot and power the charioteer.
lines.transliteration: tarayt ai rath jat ai kaa jor agai rathvaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਜੁਿਗ  ਰਥੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ  ਅਗੈ  ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, penance was the chariot and truth the charioteer.
lines.transliteration: du-aapur rath t apai kaa sat  agai rathvaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੇਤੈ ਰਥੁ ਜਤੈ ਕਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, fire is the chariot and falsehood the charioteer. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (470-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaljug rath agan kaa koorh agai rathvaahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਆਪੁਿਰ  ਰਥੁ ਤਪੈ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Sama Veda says that the Lord Master is robed in white; in the Age of Truth,everyone desired Truth, abided in Truth, and was merged in the Truth.
lines.transliteration: saam kahai saytambar su-aamee sach meh aachh ai saach rahay. sabh  ko sach samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਜੁਿਗ  ਰਥੁ ਅਗਿਨ  ਕਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਗੈ  ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Rig Veda says that God is permeating and pervading everywhere;
lines.transliteration: rig kahai rahi-aa bharpoor.
raam naam dayvaa meh soor. among the deities, the Lord's Name is the most exalted.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਤੰਬਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਚ ਮਿਹ ਆਛੈ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name, sins depart;
lines.transliteration: naa-ay la-i-ai paraachhat  jaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, then, one obtains salvation.
lines.transliteration: naanak ta-o mokh antar paahi.

lines.english: In the Jujar Veda, Kaan Krishna of the Yaadva tribe seduced Chandraavali by force.
lines.transliteration: juj meh jor chhalee chand raaval kaanH krisan jaad am bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: He brought the Elysian Tree for his milk-maid, and revelled in Brindaaban.
lines.transliteration: paarjaat gopee lai aa-i-aa bind raaban meh rang kee-aa.

lines.english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Atharva Veda became prominent; Allah became theName of God.
lines.transliteration: kal meh bayd atharban  hoo-aa naa-o kh udaa-ee alhu bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: Men began to wear blue robes and garments; Turks and Pat'haans assumed power.
lines.transliteration: neel bastar lay kaprh ay pahiray t urak path aanee amal kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਜ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਰ ਛਲੀ  ਚੰਦਰ੍ਾਵਿਲ  ਕਾਨ  ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨੁ ਜਾਦਮੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The four Vedas each claim to be true.
lines.transliteration: chaaray vayd ho-ay sachiaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ  ਗੋਪੀ  ਲੈ ਆਇਆ  ਿਬੰਦਰ੍ਾਬਨ  ਮਿਹ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Reading and studying them, four doctrines are found.
lines.transliteration: parheh gun eh tinH chaar veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ  ਹੂਆ ਨਾਉ  ਖੁਦਾਈ  ਅਲਹੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: With loving devotional worship, abiding in humility, O Nanak, salvation is attained. ||2|| pauVI ] (470-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh agat kar neech sad aa-ay. t a-o naanak mokh antar paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਲ  ਬਸਤਰ੍  ਲੇ ਕਪੜੇ  ਪਿਹਰੇ ਤੁਰਕ  ਪਠਾਣੀ  ਅਮਲੁ  ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to cherish the LordMaster.
lines.transliteration: satgur vitahu vaari-aa jit  mili-ai kh asam samaali-aa.

lines.english: He has taught me and given me the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and withthese eyes, I behold the world.
lines.transliteration: jin kar updays gi-aan anjan d ee-aa inHee nayt ree jagat  nihaali-aa.

lines.english: Those dealers who abandon their Lord and Master and attach themselves to another,are drowned.
lines.transliteration: khasam chh od doojai lagay dubay say van jaari-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru is the boat, but few are those who realize this.
lines.transliteration: satguroo hai bohithaa virlai kinai veechaari-aa.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He carries them across. ||13|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (470-12) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa paar utaari-aa. ||13||

lines.english: The simmal tree is straight as an arrow; it is very tall, and very thick.
lines.transliteration: simmal rukh saraa-iraa at  deeragh  at much.

lines.english: But those birds which visit it hopefully, depart disappointed.
lines.transliteration: o-ay je aavahi aas kar jaahi niraasay kit.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਇਨੀ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Its fruits are tasteless, its flowers are nauseating, and its leaves are useless.
lines.transliteration: fal fikay ful bakbakay kamm na aavahi pat.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sweetness and humility, O Nanak, are the essence of virtue and goodness.
lines.transliteration: mithat  neevee naankaa gun  chang-aa-ee-aa t at.

lines.english: Everyone bows down to himself; no one bows down to another.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko nivai aap ka-o par ka-o nivai na ko-ay.

lines.english: Dhar t aaraajoo t olee-ai nivai so ga-uraa ho-ay. When something is placed on the balancing scale and weighed, the side whichdescends is heavier.
The sinner, like the deer hunter, bows down twice as much.
lines.transliteration: apraaDhee d oonaa nivai jo hant aa miragaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸੰਮਲ  ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਰਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਦੀਰਘ  ਅਿਤ  ਮੁਚੁ ॥
lines.english: But what can be achieved by bowing the head, when the heart is impure? ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (470-16) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sees nivaa-i-ai ki-aa thee-ai jaa ridai kusuDh ay jaahi. ||1||

lines.english: You read your books and say your prayers, and then engage in debate;
lines.transliteration: parh pust ak sanDh i-aa baad aN.

lines.punjabi: ਫਲ ਿਫਕੇ ਫੁਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ  ਕੰਿਮ ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਪਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: sil poojas bagul samaaDhaN. you worship stones and sit like a stork, pretending to be in Samaadhi.

lines.english: With your mouth you utter falsehood, and you adorn yourself with preciousdecorations;
lines.transliteration: mukh jh ooth bibhookhan saaraN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਿਨਵੈ ਆਪ  ਕਉ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਿਨਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taraipaal t ihaal bichaaraN. you recite the three lines of the Gayatri three times a day.

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਰ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ  ਤੋਲੀਐ  ਿਨਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Around your neck is a rosary, and on your forehead is a sacred mark;
lines.transliteration: gal maalaa tilak lilaataN.
du-ay Dh otee bast ar kapaataN. upon your head is a turban, and you wear two loin cloths.

lines.english: If you knew the nature of God,
lines.transliteration: jay jaanas barahmaN karmaN.
sabh fokat nischa-o karmaN. you would know that all of these beliefs and rituals are in vain.

lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate with deep faith;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nihcha-o Dhi-aavai.

lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: vin sat gur vaat na paavai. ||2|| without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||2|| pauVI ] (470-18) pa-orhee.

lines.english: Abandoning the world of beauty, and beautiful clothes, one must depart.
lines.transliteration: kaparh roop suhaavan aa chh ad dunee-aa and ar jaavn aa.

lines.english: He obtains the rewards of his good and bad deeds.
lines.transliteration: mandaa changa aapn aa aapay hee keet aa paavn aa.

lines.english: He may issue whatever commands he wishes, but he shall have to take to the narrow path hereafter. pMnw 471
lines.transliteration: hukam kee-ay man bhaavd ay raahi bh eerhai agai jaavn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਏ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਦੇ  ਰਾਿਹ  ਭੀੜੈ ਅਗੈ  ਜਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He goes to hell naked, and he looks hideous then.
lines.transliteration: nangaa dojak chaali-aa t aa disai kh araa daraavan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੰਗਾ  ਦੋਜਿਕ  ਚਾਿਲਆ  ਤਾ ਿਦਸੈ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He regrets the sins he committed. ||14|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (471-2) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar a-ugan pachh otaavan aa. ||14||

lines.english: Make compassion the cotton, contentment the thread, modesty the knot and truth thetwist.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa kapaah sant okh soot jat gandh ee sat  vat.

lines.english: This is the sacred thread of the soul; if you have it, then go ahead and put it on me.
lines.transliteration: ayhu janay-oo jee-a kaa ha-ee ta paaday gh at.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਕਪਾਹ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸੂਤੁ ਜਤੁ ਗੰਢੀ  ਸਤੁ ਵਟੁ ॥
lines.english: It does not break, it cannot be soiled by filth, it cannot be burnt, or lost.
lines.transliteration: naa ayhu tutai naa mal lagai naa ayhu jalai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਹਈ ਤ ਪਾਡੇ ਘਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhan so maan as naankaa jo gal chalay paa-ay. Blessed are those mortal beings, O Nanak, who wear such a thread around theirnecks.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You buy the thread for a few shells, and seated in your enclosure, you put it on.
lines.transliteration: cha-ukarh mul an aa-i-aa bahi cha-ukai paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਜੋ ਗਿਲ  ਚਲੇ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whispering instructions into others' ears, the Brahmin becomes a guru.
lines.transliteration: sikhaa kann charh aa-ee-aa gur baraahman  thi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਕਿੜ  ਮੁਿਲ ਅਣਾਇਆ  ਬਿਹ ਚਉਕੈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But he dies, and the sacred thread falls away, and the soul departs without it. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (471-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: oh mu-aa oh jharh  pa-i-aa vayt gaa ga-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: He commits thousands of robberies, thousands of acts of adultery, thousands of falsehoods and thousands of abuses.
lines.transliteration: lakh choree-aa lakh  jaaree-aa lakh  koorh ee-aa lakh  gaal.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਮੁਆ  ਓਹੁ ਝਿੜ ਪਇਆ  ਵੇਤਗਾ  ਗਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He practices thousands of deceptions and secret deeds, night and day, against hisfellow beings.
lines.transliteration: lakh th agee-aa pahinaamee-aa raat  dinas jee-a naal.

lines.english: The thread is spun from cotton, and the Brahmin comes and twists it.
lines.transliteration: tag kapaahahu kat ee-ai baamHan vatay aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚੋਰੀਆ  ਲਖ ਜਾਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਕੂੜੀਆ  ਲਖ ਗਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The goat is killed, cooked and eaten, and everyone then says, "Put on the sacredthread."
lines.transliteration: kuhi bakraa rinniH khaa-i-aa sabh  ko aakh ai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਠਗੀਆ  ਪਿਹਨਾਮੀਆ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: When it wears out, it is thrown away, and another one is put on.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay puraanaa sutee-ai bh ee fir paa-ee-ai hor.

lines.punjabi: ਤਗੁ ਕਪਾਹਹੁ ਕਤੀਐ ਬਾਮਣੁ  ਵਟੇ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the thread would not break, if it had any real strength. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (471-8) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tag na t ut-ee jay t ag hovai jor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਿਹ ਬਕਰਾ  ਿਰੰਿਨ  ਖਾਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Believing in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord's Praise is the true sacred thread.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai pat oopjai saalaahee sach soot .

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ  ਸੁਟੀਐ  ਭੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Such a sacred thread is worn in the Court of the Lord; it shall never break. ||3|| mÚ 1 ] (471-9) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dargeh and ar paa-ee-ai t ag na t ootas poot . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ  ਜੇ ਤਿਗ  ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: There is no sacred thread for the sexual organ, and no thread for woman.
lines.transliteration: tag na ind ree tag na naaree.

lines.english: The man's beard is spat upon daily.
lines.transliteration: bhalkay thuk pavai nit  daarhee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਪਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੂਤੁ ॥
lines.english: There is no sacred thread for the feet, and no thread for the hands;
lines.transliteration: tag na pairee t ag na hathee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਗਹ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਿਸ  ਪੂਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tag na jihvaa t ag na akh ee. no thread for the tongue, and no thread for the eyes.

lines.english: The Brahmin himself goes to the world hereafter without a sacred thread.
lines.transliteration: vaytgaa aapay vat ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਤਗੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Twisting the threads, he puts them on others.
lines.transliteration: vat Dhaagay avraa gh atai.

lines.english: He takes payment for performing marriages;
lines.transliteration: lai bhaarh  karay vee-aahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਹਥੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kadh kaagal d asay raahu. reading their horoscopes, he shows them the way.

lines.english: Hear, and see, O people, this wondrous thing.
lines.transliteration: sun vaykh hu lokaa ayhu vidaan .

lines.english: He is mentally blind, and yet his name is wisdom. ||4|| pauVI ] (471-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: man anDhaa naa-o sujaan . ||4||

lines.english: One, upon whom the Merciful Lord bestows His Grace, performs His service.
lines.transliteration: saahib ho-ay da-i-aal kirpaa karay t aa saa-ee kaar karaa-isee.

lines.english: That servant, whom the Lord causes to obey the Order of His Will, serves Him.
lines.transliteration: so sayvak sayvaa karay jis no hukam manaa-isee.

lines.english: Obeying the Order of His Will, he becomes acceptable, and then, he obtains theMansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: hukam mani-ai hovai parvaan t aa kh asmai kaa mahal paa-isee.

lines.english: One who acts to please His Lord and Master, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: khasmai bh aavai so karay manhu chind i-aa so fal paa-isee.

lines.english: Then, he goes to the Court of the Lord, wearing robes of honor. ||15|| slok mÚ 1 ] (471-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taa dargeh paiDh aa jaa-isee. ||15||

lines.english: They tax the cows and the Brahmins, but the cow-dung they apply to their kitchen willnot save them.
lines.transliteration: ga-oo biraahman ka-o kar laavhu gobar t aran na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਈ  ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dhotee tikaa t ai japmaalee Dh aan malaychh aaN khaa-ee. They wear their loin cloths, apply ritual frontal marks to their foreheads, and carry their rosaries, but they eat food with the Muslims.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, you perform devotional worship indoors, but read the Islamicsacred texts, and adopt the Muslim way of life.
lines.transliteration: antar poojaa parh eh kat aybaa sanjam t urkaa bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਿਮ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ  ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce your hypocrisy!
lines.transliteration: chhodeelay paakh andaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੈ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Taking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall swim across. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (471-17) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam la-i-ai jaahi tarand aa. ||1||

lines.english: The man-eaters say their prayers.
lines.transliteration: maanas kh aanay karahi nivaaj.

lines.english: Those who wield the knife wear the sacred thread around their necks.
lines.transliteration: chhuree vagaa-in t in gal t aag.

lines.punjabi: ਗਊ ਿਬਰਾਹਮਣ  ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਰ  ਤਰਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In their homes, the Brahmins sound the conch.
lines.transliteration: tin gh ar barahman  pooreh naad .

lines.punjabi: ਧੋਤੀ ਿਟਕਾ  ਤੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ  ਧਾਨੁ ਮਲੇਛ  ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They too have the same taste.
lines.transliteration: unHaa bhe aavahi o-ee saad .

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪੂਜਾ ਪੜਿਹ  ਕਤੇਬਾ  ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਤੁਰਕਾ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: False is their capital, and false is their trade.
lines.transliteration: koorhee raas koorh aa vaapaar.

lines.english: Speaking falsehood, they take their food.
lines.transliteration: koorh bol karahi aahaar.

lines.english: The home of modesty and Dharma is far from them.
lines.transliteration: saram Dharam kaa dayraa d oor.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are totally permeated with falsehood.
lines.transliteration: naanak koorh rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: The sacred marks are on their foreheads, and the saffron loin-cloths are around their waists;
lines.transliteration: mathai tikaa tayrh  Dhotee kakh aa-ee.
hath chhuree jagat  kaasaa-ee. in their hands they hold the knives - they are the butchers of the world! pMnw 472

lines.english: Wearing blue robes, they seek the approval of the Muslim rulers.
lines.transliteration: neel vastar pahir hoveh parvaan .

lines.english: Accepting bread from the Muslim rulers, they still worship the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: malaychh Dh aan lay poojeh puraan .

lines.english: They eat the meat of the goats, killed after the Muslim prayers are read over them,
lines.transliteration: abhaakh i-aa kaa kuth aa bakraa kh aanaa.
cha-ukay upar kisai na jaanaa. but they do not allow anyone else to enter their kitchen areas.

lines.english: They draw lines around them, plastering the ground with cow-dung.
lines.transliteration: day kai cha-ukaa kadh ee kaar.

lines.english: The false come and sit within them.
lines.transliteration: upar aa-ay baithay koorh i-aar.

lines.english: They cry out, "Do not touch our food, or it will be polluted!"
lines.transliteration: mat bh itai vay mat  bhitai. ih ann asaadaa fitai.

lines.english: But with their polluted bodies, they commit evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: tan fitai fayrh  karayn.

lines.english: With filthy minds, they try to cleanse their mouths.
lines.transliteration: man joothai chulee bh arayn.

lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sach Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: If you are pure, you will obtain the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (472-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: such hovai taa sach paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: All are within Your mind; You see and move them under Your Glance of Grace, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: chitai and ar sabh  ko vaykh  nadree hayth  chalaa-id aa.

lines.english: You Yourself grant them glory, and You Yourself cause them to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay day vad i-aa-ee-aa aapay hee karam karaa-id aa.

lines.english: The Lord is the greatest of the great; great is His world. He enjoins all to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: vadahu vadaa vad maydnee siray sir Dh anDhai laa-id aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤੈ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਿਖ ਨਦਰੀ ਹੇਿਠ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: If he should cast an angry glance, He can transform kings into blades of grass.
lines.transliteration: nadar upth ee jay karay sult aanaa gh aahu karaa-id aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Even though they may beg from door to door, no one will give them charity. ||16|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (472-7) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dar mangan bh ikh na paa-id aa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਿਸਰੇ ਿਸਿਰ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: The thief robs a house, and offers the stolen goods to his ancestors.
lines.transliteration: jay mohaakaa ghar muhai gh ar muhi pit ree day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਉਪਠੀ  ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾ  ਘਾਹੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the world hereafter, this is recognized, and his ancestors are considered thieves aswell.
lines.transliteration: agai vasat sinj aanee-ai pit ree chor karay-i.

lines.english: The hands of the go-between are cut off; this is the Lord's justice.
lines.transliteration: vadhee-ah hath d alaal kay musfee ayh karay-i.

lines.english: O Nanak, in the world hereafter, that alone is received, which one gives to the needy from his own earnings and labor. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (472-8) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak agai so milai je khatay gh aalay d ay-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਮੋਹਾਕਾ  ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਿਹ ਿਪਤਰੀ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: As a woman has her periods, month after month,
lines.transliteration: ji-o joroo sirnaavanee aavai vaaro vaar.
joothay jooth aa mukh  vasai nit  nit ho-ay kh u-aar. so does falsehood dwell in the mouth of the false; they suffer forever, again andagain.

lines.punjabi: ਵਢੀਅਿਹ  ਹਥ ਦਲਾਲ  ਕੇ ਮੁਸਫੀ  ਏਹ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are not called pure, who sit down after merely washing their bodies.
lines.transliteration: soochay ayhi na aakhee-ahi bahan je pindaa Dh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਗੈ ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਜ ਖਟੇ ਘਾਲੇ  ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Only they are pure, O Nanak, within whose minds the Lord abides. ||2|| pauVI ] (472-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: soochay say-ee naankaa jin man vasi-aa so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: With saddled horses, as fast as the wind, and harems decorated in every way;
lines.transliteration: turay palaan ay pa-un  vayg har rangee haram savaari-aa.
kothay mandap maarh ee-aa laa-ay baith ay kar paasaari-aa. in houses and pavilions and lofty mansions, they dwell, making ostentatious shows.

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਵਸੈ ਿਨਤ ਿਨਤ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They act out their minds' desires, but they do not understand the Lord, and so they are ruined.
lines.transliteration: cheej karan man bhaavd ay har bujh an naahee haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਚੇ ਏਿਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਬਹਿਨ  ਿਜ ਿਪੰਡਾ  ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Asserting their authority, they eat, and beholding their mansions, they forget aboutdeath.
lines.transliteration: kar furmaa-is khaa-i-aa vaykh  mahlat  maran  visaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਚੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: But old age comes, and youth is lost. ||17|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (472-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jar aa-ee joban haari-aa. ||17||

lines.english: If one accepts the concept of impurity, then there is impurity everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jay kar sootak mannee-ai sabh  tai soot ak ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਰੇ ਪਲਾਣੇ  ਪਉਣ  ਵੇਗ ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਮ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: In cow-dung and wood there are worms.
lines.transliteration: gohay atai lakrh ee and ar keerh aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ  ਮਾੜੀਆ  ਲਾਇ  ਬੈਠੇ ਕਿਰ ਪਾਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: As many as are the grains of corn, none is without life.
lines.transliteration: jaytay d aanay ann kay jee-aa baajh  na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਜ ਕਰਿਨ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਬੁਝਿਨ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: First, there is life in the water, by which everything else is made green.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa paanee jee-o hai jit  hari-aa sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਿਸ  ਖਾਇਆ  ਵੇਿਖ ਮਹਲਿਤ  ਮਰਣੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: How can it be protected from impurity? It touches our own kitchen.
lines.transliteration: sootak ki-o kar rakh ee-ai soot ak pavai raso-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, impurity cannot be removed in this way; it is washed away only by spiritual wisdom. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (472-16) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sootak ayv na ut rai gi-aan ut aaray Dh o-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The impurity of the mind is greed, and the impurity of the tongue is falsehood.
lines.transliteration: man kaa sootak lobh  hai jihvaa soot ak koorh .

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਸਭ ਤੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The impurity of the eyes is to gaze upon the beauty of another man's wife, and hiswealth.
lines.transliteration: akhee soot ak vaykh -naa par t ari-a par Dh an roop.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਹੇ ਅਤੈ ਲਕੜੀ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕੀੜਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The impurity of the ears is to listen to the slander of others.
lines.transliteration: kannee sootak kann pai laa-it baaree kh aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਦਾਣੇ  ਅੰਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਆ  ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the mortal's soul goes, bound and gagged to the city of Death. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (472-18) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hansaa aadmee baDh ay jam pur jaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All impurity comes from doubt and attachment to duality.
lines.transliteration: sabho soot ak bh aram hai d oojai lagai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਰਖੀਐ  ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਪਵੈ ਰਸੋਇ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death are subject to the Command of the Lord's Will; through His Will wecome and go.
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa hukam hai bh aanai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੂਤਕੁ  ਏਵ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਉਤਾਰੇ  ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Eating and drinking are pure, since the Lord gives nourishment to all.
lines.transliteration: khaan aa peen aa pavit ar hai d iton rijak sambaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs, who understand the Lord, are not stained by impurity. ||3|| pMnw 473 pauVI ] (473-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jinHee gurmukh bujh i-aa tinHaa soot ak naahi. ||3||

lines.english: Praise the Great True Guru; within Him is the greatest greatness.
lines.transliteration: satgur vadaa kar salaahee-ai jis vich vadee-aa vad i-aa-ee-aa.

lines.english: When the Lord causes us to meet the Guru, then we come to see them.
lines.transliteration: seh maylay taa nad ree aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਡੀਆ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases Him, they come to dwell in our minds.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aanaa taa man vasaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: By His Command, when He places His hand on our foreheads, wickedness departs from within.
lines.transliteration: kar hukam mastak hath Dh ar vichahu maar kadh ee-aa buri-aa-ee-aa.

lines.english: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, the nine treasures are obtained. ||18|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (473-3) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: seh tuth ai na-o niDh  paa-ee-aa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਥੁ ਧਿਰ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢੀਆ  ਬੁਿਰਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: First, purifying himself, the Brahmin comes and sits in his purified enclosure.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa suchaa aap ho-ay suchai baithaa aa-ay.

lines.english: The pure foods, which no one else has touched, are placed before him.
lines.transliteration: suchay agai rakhi-on ko-ay na bh iti-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: Being purified, he takes his food, and begins to read his sacred verses.
lines.transliteration: suchaa ho-ay kai jayvi-aa lagaa parhan  salok.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਸੁਚਾ ਆਿਪ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: But it is then thrown into a filthy place - whose fault is this?
lines.transliteration: kuhthee jaa-ee sati-aa kis ayhu lagaa dokh .

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਚੇ ਅਗੈ ਰਿਖਓਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਭਿਟਓ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The corn is sacred, the water is sacred; the fire and salt are sacred as well; when the fifth thing, the ghee, is added,
lines.transliteration: ann dayvt aa paan ee dayvtaa baisant ar dayvtaa loon  panjvaa paa-i-aa gh irat.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇਿਵਆ  ਲਗਾ  ਪੜਿਣ ਸਲੋਕੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taa ho-aa paak pavit . then the food becomes pure and sanctified.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਹਥੀ  ਜਾਈ  ਸਿਟਆ  ਿਕਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਲਗਾ  ਦੋਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Coming into contact with the sinful human body, the food becomes so impure that isis spat upon.
lines.transliteration: paapee si-o tan gadi-aa thukaa pa-ee-aa t it.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਦੇਵਤਾ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ  ਲੂਣੁ ਪੰਜਵਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਘਰਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: That mouth which does not chant the Naam, and without the Name eats tasty foods
lines.transliteration: jit mukh  naam na oochrahi bin naavai ras kh aahi.

lines.english: - O Nanak, know this: such a mouth is to be spat upon. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (473-7) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayvai jaanee-ai t it mukh  thukaa paahi. ||1||

lines.english: From woman, man is born; within woman, man is conceived; to woman he is engagedand married.
lines.transliteration: bhand jammee-ai bh and nimmee-ai bh and mangan  vee-aahu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਚਰਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰਸ ਖਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Woman becomes his friend; through woman, the future generations come.
lines.transliteration: bhandahu hovai d ostee bh andahu chalai raahu.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When his woman dies, he seeks another woman; to woman he is bound.
lines.transliteration: bhand mu-aa bh and bh aalee-ai bh and hovai banDh aan.

lines.english: So why call her bad? From her, kings are born.
lines.transliteration: so ki-o mandaa aakh ee-ai jit  jameh raajaan.

lines.punjabi: ਭੰਿਡ ਜੰਮੀਐ  ਭੰਿਡ ਿਨੰਮੀਐ  ਭੰਿਡ ਮੰਗਣੁ  ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
lines.english: From woman, woman is born; without woman, there would be no one at all.
lines.transliteration: bhandahu hee bh and oopjai bh andai baajh  na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਭੰਡਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, only the True Lord is without a woman.
lines.transliteration: naanak bhandai baahraa ayko sachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੰਡੁ ਮੁਆ  ਭੰਡੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ  ਭੰਿਡ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: That mouth which praises the Lord continually is blessed and beautiful.
lines.transliteration: jit mukh  sadaa salaahee-ai bh aagaa rat ee chaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, those faces shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (473-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay mukh  oojlay t it sachai d arbaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੀ ਭੰਡੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All call You their own, Lord; one who does not own You, is picked up and thrown away.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aakh ai aapn aa jis naahee so chun  kadh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Everyone receives the rewards of his own actions; his account is adjusted accordingly.
lines.transliteration: keetaa aapo aapn aa aapay hee laykh aa sandh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਭਾਗਾ  ਰਤੀ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Since one is not destined to remain in this world anyway, why should he ruin himselfin pride?
lines.transliteration: jaa rahnaa naahee ait  jag taa kaa-it  gaarab handh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Do not call anyone bad; read these words, and understand.
lines.transliteration: mandaa kisai na aakh ee-ai parh  akhar ayho bujh ee-ai.

lines.english: Don't argue with fools. ||19|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (473-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: moorkhai naal na lujh ee-ai. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੋ ਚੁਿਣ  ਕਢੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, speaking insipid words, the body and mind become insipid.
lines.transliteration: naanak fikai boli-ai tan man fikaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਆਪੋ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ  ਸੰਢੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He is called the most insipid of the insipid; the most insipid of the insipid is hisreputation.
lines.transliteration: fiko fikaa sadee-ai fikay fikee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਰਹਣਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਐਤੁ ਜਿਗ  ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ  ਗਾਰਿਬ  ਹੰਢੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The insipid person is discarded in the Court of the Lord, and the insipid one's face is spat upon.
lines.transliteration: fikaa dargeh satee-ai muhi thukaa fikay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ  ਪਿੜ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਹੋ ਬੁਝੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The insipid one is called a fool; he is beaten with shoes in punishment. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (473-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: fikaa moorakh aakh ee-ai paan aa lahai sajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Those who are false within, and honorable on the outside, are very common in thisworld.
lines.transliteration: andrahu jh oothay paij baahar d unee-aa and ar fail.

lines.english: Even though they may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, still, theirfilth does not depart.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath jay naaveh ut rai naahee mail.

lines.english: Those who have silk on the inside and rags on the outside, are the good ones in thisworld.
lines.transliteration: jinH pat andar baahar gud arh tay bh alay sansaar.

lines.english: They embrace love for the Lord, and contemplate beholding Him.
lines.transliteration: tinH nayhu lagaa rab sayt ee daykhnHay veechaar.

lines.english: In the Lord's Love, they laugh, and in the Lord's Love, they weep, and also keepsilent.
lines.transliteration: rang haseh rang roveh chup bhee kar jaahi.

lines.english: They do not care for anything else, except their True Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: parvaah naahee kisai kayree baajh sachay naah.

lines.english: Sitting, waiting at the Lord's Door, they beg for food, and when He gives to them, they eat.
lines.transliteration: dar vaat upar kh arach mangaa jabai d ay-ay t a khaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਪੈਜ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਫੈਲੁ ॥
lines.english: There is only One Court of the Lord, and He has only one pen; there, you and I shallmeet.
lines.transliteration: deebaan ayko kalam aykaa hamaa t umHaa mayl.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਜੇ ਨਾਵਿਹ  ਉਤਰੈ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੈਲੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, the accounts are examined; O Nanak, the sinners arecrushed, like oil seeds in the press. ||2|| pMnw 474 pauVI ] (474-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: dar la-ay laykh aa peerh  chhutai naankaa ji-o t ayl. ||2||

lines.english: You Yourself created the creation; You Yourself infused Your power into it.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee karnaa kee-o kal aapay hee t ai Dhaaree-ai.

lines.english: You behold Your creation, like the losing and winning dice of the earth.
lines.transliteration: daykh eh keet aa aapn aa Dh ar kachee pakee saaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ  ਕੀਓ  ਕਲ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਤੈ ਧਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever has come, shall depart; all shall have their turn.
lines.transliteration: jo aa-i-aa so chalsee sabh ko-ee aa-ee vaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਧਿਰ ਕਚੀ  ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He who owns our soul, and our very breath of life - why should we forget that Lord and Master from our minds?
lines.transliteration: jis kay jee-a paraan heh ki-o saahib manhu visaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ  ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਈ  ਵਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: With our own hands, let us resolve our own affairs. ||20|| sloku mhlw 2 ] (474-3) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapan hathee aapn aa aapay hee kaaj savaaree-ai. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰਾਣ  ਹਿਹ ਿਕਉ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: What sort of love is this, which clings to duality?
lines.transliteration: ayh kinayhee aaskee doojai lagai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣ  ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਕਾਜੁ  ਸਵਾਰੀਐ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is called a lover, who remains forever immersed in absorption.
lines.transliteration: naanak aasak kaaNdhee-ai sad  hee rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: But one who feels good only when good is done for him, and feels bad when thingsgo badly
lines.transliteration: changai changa kar mannay mandai mand aa ho-ay.

lines.english: Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aasak ayhu na aakhee-ai je laykh ai vart ai so-ay. ||1|| - do not call him a lover. He trades only for his own account. ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (474-5) mehlaa 2.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਸਕੁ  ਕਢੀਐ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who offers both respectful greetings and rude refusal to his master, has gonewrong from the very beginning.
lines.transliteration: salaam jabaab dovai karay mundh hu gh uthaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ  ਕਿਰ ਮੰਨੇ ਮੰਦੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, both of his actions are false; he obtains no place in the Court of the Lord.||2|| pauVI ] (474-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak dovai koorh ee-aa thaa-ay na kaa-ee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਕੁ  ਏਹੁ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serving Him, peace is obtained; meditate and dwell upon that Lord and Master forever.
lines.transliteration: jit sayvi-ai sukh  paa-ee-ai so saahib sad aa samHaalee-ai.

lines.english: Why do you do such evil deeds, that you shall have to suffer so?
lines.transliteration: jit keet aa paa-ee-ai aapn aa saa gh aal buree ki-o gh aalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਲਾਮੁ  ਜਬਾਬੁ  ਦੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Do not do any evil at all; look ahead to the future with foresight.
lines.transliteration: mandaa mool na keech-ee d ay lammee nad ar nihaalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੋਵੈ ਕੂੜੀਆ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: So throw the dice in such a way, that you shall not lose with your Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ji-o saahib naal na haaree-ai tavayhaa paasaa dh aalee-ai.

lines.english: Do those deeds which shall bring you profit. ||21|| sloku mhlw 2 ] (474-9) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kichh laahay upar gh aalee-ai. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: If a servant performs service, while being vain and argumentative,
lines.transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakree naalay gaarab vaad.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਾ ਘਾਲ  ਬੁਰੀ ਿਕਉ  ਘਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.transliteration: galaa karay ghan ayree-aa kh asam na paa-ay saad . he may talk as much as he wants, but he shall not be pleasing to his Master.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ  ਦੇ ਲੰਮੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: But if he eliminates his self-conceit and th en performs service, he shall be honored.
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-ay sayvaa karay taa kichh  paa-ay maan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ  ਤੇਵੇਹਾ  ਪਾਸਾ  ਢਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if he merges with the one with whom he is attached, his attachment becomes acceptable. ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (474-11) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no lagaa tis milai lagaa so parvaan. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever is in the mind, comes forth; spoken words by themselves are just wind.
lines.transliteration: jo jee-ay ho-ay so ugvai muh kaa kahi-aa vaa-o.

lines.english: He sows seeds of poison, and demands Ambrosial Nectar. Behold - what justice isthis? ||2|| mhlw 2 ] (474-12) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: beejay bikh mangai amrit  vaykh hu ayhu ni-aa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਨਾਲੇ  ਗਾਰਬੁ  ਵਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: Friendship with a fool never works out right.
lines.transliteration: naal i-aanay d ostee kad ay na aavai raas.

lines.punjabi: ਗਲਾ  ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਖਸਮ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: As he knows, he acts; behold, and see that it is so.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa jaanai t ayho vart ai vaykh hu ko nirjaas.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: One thing can be absorbed into another thing, but duality keeps them apart.
lines.transliteration: vastoo and ar vasat  samaavai d oojee hovai paas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਲਗਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one can issue commands to the Lord Master; offer instead humble prayers.
lines.transliteration: saahib saytee hukam na chalai kahee ban ai ard aas.

lines.english: Practicing falsehood, only falsehood is obtained. O Nanak, through the Lord's Praise, one blossoms forth. ||3|| mhlw 2 ] (474-14) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: koorh kamaan ai koorh o hovai naanak sifat  vigaas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੀਇ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਉਗਵੈ  ਮੁਹ ਕਾ ਕਿਹਆ  ਵਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Friendship with a fool, and love with a pompous person,
lines.transliteration: naal i-aanay d ostee vadaaroo si-o nayhu.

lines.english: Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paanee and ar leek ji-o t is daa thaa-o na thayhu. ||4|| are like lines drawn in water, leaving no trace or mark. ||4|| mhlw 2 ] (474-15) mehlaa 2.

lines.english: If a fool does a job, he cannot do it right.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay i-aanaa karay kamm aan  na sakai raas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਲ  ਇਆਣੇ  ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Even if he does something right, he does the next thing wrong. ||5|| pauVI ] (474-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jay ik aDh changee karay d oojee bh ee vayraas. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਿਨਰਜਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: If a servant, performing service, obeys the Will of his Master,
lines.transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakree jay chalai khasmai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਸਤੂ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.transliteration: hurmat t is no aglee oh vajahu bh e doonaa kh aa-ay. his honor increases, and he receives double his wages.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਸੇਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਕਹੀ ਬਣੈ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: But if he claims to be equal to his Master, he earns his Master's displeasure.
lines.transliteration: khasmai karay baraabaree fir gairat  andar paa-ay.

lines.english: He loses his entire salary, and is also beaten on his face with shoes.
lines.transliteration: vajahu gavaa-ay aglaa muhay muhi paanaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Let us all celebrate Him, from whom we receive our nourishment.
lines.transliteration: jis daa d itaa kh aavnaa tis kahee-ai saabaas.

lines.english: O Nanak, no one can issue commands to the Lord Master; let us offer prayers instead. ||22|| sloku mhlw 2 ] (474-19) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na chal-ee naal khasam chalai ard aas. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਣੀ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਲੀਕ  ਿਜਉ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਥੇਹੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: What sort of gift is this, which we receive only by our own asking? pMnw 475
lines.transliteration: ayh kinayhee daat  aapas t ay jo paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, that is the most wonderful gift, which is received from the Lord, when He is totally pleased. ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (475-1) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saa karmaat saahib t uthai jo milai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਿਤ  ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੁਠੈ ਜੋ ਿਮਲੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What sort of service is this, by which the fear of the Lord Master does not depart?
lines.transliteration: ayh kinayhee chaakree jit bh a-o kh asam na jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is called a servant, who merges with the Lord Master. ||2|| pauVI ] (475-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sayvak kaadhee-ai je sayt ee kh asam samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਿਕਨੇਹੀ  ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਭਉ ਖਸਮ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's limits cannot be known; He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: naanak ant na jaapnHee har t aa kay paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਕਾਢੀਐ  ਿਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਖਸਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself creates, and then He Himself destroys.
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay saakh-t ee fir aap karaa-ay maar.

lines.english: Some have chains around their necks, while some ride on many horses.
lines.transliteration: iknHaa galee janjeeree-aa ik turee charh eh bisee-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and He Himself causes us to act. Unto whom should I complain?
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay karay aap ha-o kai si-o karee pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਸਾਖਤੀ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਮਾਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He Himself takes care of it. ||23|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (475-5) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak karnaa jin kee-aa fir t is hee karn ee saar. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ ਗਲੀ  ਜੰਜੀਰੀਆ  ਇਿਕ  ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਿਹ  ਿਬਸੀਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself fashioned the vessel of the body, and He Himself fills it.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhaaNday saaji-an aapay pooran  day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਹਉ ਕੈ ਿਸਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Into some, milk is poured, while others remain on the fire.
lines.transliteration: iknHee duDh  samaa-ee-ai ik chulHai rehniH charh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Some lie down and sleep on soft beds, while others remain watchful.
lines.transliteration: ik nihaalee pai savniH ik upar rahan kharh ay.

lines.english: He adorns those, O Nanak, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (475-7) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tinHaa savaaray naankaa jinH ka-o nad ar karay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਡੇ ਸਾਿਜਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਪੂਰਣੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself creates and fashions the world, and He Himself keeps it in order.
lines.transliteration: aapay saajay karay aap jaa-ee bhe rakh ai aap.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨੀ  ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ  ਇਿਕ  ਚੁਲੈ ਰਹਿਨ  ਚੜੇ ॥
lines.english: Having created the beings within it, He oversees their birth and death.
lines.transliteration: tis vich jant  upaa-ay kai d aykhai thaap uthaap.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਿਨਹਾਲੀ  ਪੈ ਸਵਿਨ  ਇਿਕ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਰਹਿਨ  ਖੜੇ ॥
lines.english: Unto whom should we speak, O Nanak, when He Himself is all-in-all? ||2|| pauVI ] (475-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kis no kahee-ai naankaa sabh kichh  aapay aap. ||2||

lines.english: The description of the greatness of the Great Lord cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: vaday kee-aa vadi-aa-ee-aa kichh  kahn aa kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: He is the Creator, all-lowerful and benevolent; He gives sustenance to all beings.
lines.transliteration: so kartaa kaad ar kareem d ay jee-aa rijak sambaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਜਾਈ  ਿਭ ਰਖੈ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal does that work, which has been pre-destined from the very beginning.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee kaar kamaavnee Dh ur chh odee t innai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, except for the One Lord, there is no other place at all. so kry ij iqsY rjwie ]24]1] suDu (475-10, Awsw, mÚ 2) so karay je tisai rajaa-ay. ||24||1|| suDh u He does whatever He wills. ||24||1|| Sudh|| <> siqnwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gurpRswid ] (475-12) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gurparsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu Awsw bwxI Bgqw kI ] (475-13) raag aasaa banee bh agtaa kee. Raag Aasaa, The Word Of The Devotees: kbIr jIau nwmdyau jIau rivdws jIau ] (475-13) kabeer jee-o naamday-o jee-o ravid aas jee-o. Kabeer, Naam Dayv And Ravi Daas. Awsw sRI kbIr jIau ] (475-13) aasaa saree kabeer jee-o. Aasaa, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: naanak aykee baahree hor doojee naahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Falling at the Feet of the Guru, I pray, and ask Him, "Why was man created?
lines.transliteration: gur charan laag ham binvat aa poochh at kah jee-o paa-i-aa.

lines.english: What deeds cause the world to come into being, and be destroyed? Tell me, that I may understand."||1||
lines.transliteration: kavan kaaj jag upjai binsai kahhu mohi samjhaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੇ ਕੀਆ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Divine Guru, please, show Mercy to me, and place me on the right path, by whichthe bonds of fear may be cut away.
lines.transliteration: dayv karahu d a-i-aa mohi maarag laavhu jit  bhai banDh an tootai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਾਦਰ  ਕਰੀਮੁ  ਦੇ ਜੀਆ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸੰਬਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death come from past actions and karma; peace comes whenthe soul finds release from reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh  fayrh  karam sukh  jee-a janam t ay chh ootai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਧੁਿਰ ਛੋਡੀ ਿਤੰਨੈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal does not break free from the bonds of the noose of Maya, and he does notseek the shelter of the profound, absolute Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa faas banDh nahee faarai ar man sunn na lookay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ  ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
