lines.english: He does not realize the dignity of the self, and Nirvaanaa; because of this, his doubtdoes not depart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapaa pad nirbaan  na cheenHi-aa in biDh  abhi-o na chookay. ||2||

lines.english: The soul is not born, even though he thinks it is born; it is free from birth and death.
lines.transliteration: kahee na upjai upjee jaanai bh aav abh aav bihoon aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧੁ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਨਾਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When the mortal gives up his ideas of birth and death, he remains constantlyabsorbed in the Lord's Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: udai asat  kee man buDh  naasee t a-o sad aa sahj liv leen aa. ||3||

lines.english: As the reflection of an object blends in the water when the pitcher is broken,
lines.transliteration: ji-o partibimb bimb ka-o milee hai ud ak kumbh  bigraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਜੀਉ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Awsw ] (476-1) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer aisaa gun bh aram bh aagaa t a-o man sunn samaanaaN. ||4||1|| says Kabeer, just so virtue dispels doubt, and then the soul is absorbed in the profound, absolute Lord. ||4||1|| pMnw 476

lines.english: They wear loin cloths, three and a half yards long, and triple-wound sacred threads.
lines.transliteration: gaj saadhay t ai tai Dhotee-aa t ihray paa-in t ag.

lines.english: They have rosaries around their necks, and they carry glittering jugs in their hands.
lines.transliteration: galee jinHaa japmaalee-aa lotay hath nibag.

lines.punjabi: ਗਜ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੈ ਤੈ ਧੋਤੀਆ  ਿਤਹਰੇ  ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਤਗ ॥
lines.english: They are not called Saints of the Lord - they are thugs of Benares. ||1||
lines.transliteration: o-ay har kay sant na aakh ee-ahi baanaaras kay th ag. ||1||

lines.english: Such 'saints' are not pleasing to me;
lines.transliteration: aisay sant na mo ka-o bh aaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਬਾਨਾਰਿਸ  ਕੇ ਠਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daalaa si-o paydaa gatkaavahi. ||1|| rahaa-o. they eat the trees along with the branches. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They wash their pots and pans before putting them on the stove, and they wash thewood before lighting it.
lines.transliteration: baasan maaNj charaaveh oopar kaathee Dh o-ay jalaaveh.

lines.english: They dig up the earth and make two fireplaces, but they eat the whole person! ||2||
lines.transliteration: basuDhaa kh od karahi d u-ay choolHay saaray maan as khaaveh. ||2||

lines.english: Those sinners continually wander in evil deeds, while they call themselves touch- nothing saints.
lines.transliteration: o-ay paapee sadaa fireh apraaDh ee mukh ahu apras kahaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਸਨ  ਮਿਜ  ਚਰਾਵਿਹ  ਊਪਿਰ  ਕਾਠੀ  ਧੋਇ ਜਲਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They wander around forever and ever in their self-conceit, and all their families aredrowned. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa fireh abh imaanee sagal kutamb dubaaveh. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਖੋਿਦ ਕਰਿਹ ਦੁਇ ਚੂਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣਸ  ਖਾਵਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is attached to that, to which the Lord has attached him, and he acts accordingly.
lines.transliteration: jit ko laa-i-aa t it hee laagaa t aisay karam kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਪਾਪੀ  ਸਦਾ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਪਰਸ  ਕਹਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, one who meets the True Guru, is not reincarnated again. ||4||2|| Awsw ] (476-6) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jis satgur bh aytai punrap janam na aavai. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਡੁਬਾਵਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Father has comforted me. He has given me a cozy bed, and placed His AmbrosialNectar in my mouth.
lines.transliteration: baap dilaasaa mayro keenHaa. sayj sukh aalee mukh  amrit  deenHaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਤ  ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ  ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: How could I forget that Father from my mind?
lines.transliteration: tis baap ka-o ki-o manhu visaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: When I go to the world hereafter, I shall not lose the game. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aagai ga-i-aa na baajee haaree. ||1||

lines.english: Maya is dead, O mother, and I am very happy.
lines.transliteration: mu-ee mayree maa-ee ha-o kharaa sukh aalaa.

lines.english: I do not wear the patched coat, nor do I feel the chill. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pahira-o nahee daglee lagai na paalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Father, who gave me life.
lines.transliteration: bal tis baapai jin ha-o jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He put an end to my association with the five deadly sins.
lines.transliteration: panchaa tay mayraa sang chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have conquered those five demons, and trampled them underfoot.
lines.transliteration: panch maar paavaa tal d eenay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ਹਉ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har simran mayraa man tan bh eenay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਰਉ  ਨਹੀ ਦਗਲੀ  ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Father is the Great Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: pitaa hamaaro vad gosaa-ee.

lines.english: How shall I go to that Father?
lines.transliteration: tis pit aa peh ha-o ki-o kar jaa-ee.

lines.english: When I met the True Guru, He showed me the Way.
lines.transliteration: satgur milay t a maarag d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Father of the Universe is pleasing to my mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jagat pit aa mayrai man bh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: I am Your son, and You are my Father.
lines.transliteration: ha-o poot t ayraa t ooN baap mayraa.

lines.english: We both dwell in the same place.
lines.transliteration: aykai thaahar d uhaa basayraa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant knows only the One.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jan ayko boojhi-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have come to know everything. ||4||3|| Awsw ] (476-12) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad mai sabh  kichh  soojh i-aa. ||4||3||

lines.english: In one pot, they put a boiled chicken, and in the other pot, they put wine.
lines.transliteration: ikat pat ar bhar urkat kurkat ikat  patar bhar paanee.

lines.english: The five Yogis of the Tantric ritual sit there, and in their midst sits the noseless one,the shameless queen. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aas paas panch jogee-aa baithay beech nakat d ay raanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਪੂਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The bell of the shameless queen, Maya, rings in both worlds.
lines.transliteration: naktee ko thangan baadaa dooN.

lines.english: Some rare person of discriminating wisdom has cut off your nose. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kineh bibaykee kaatee tooN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Within all dwells the noseless Maya, who kills all, and destroys them.
lines.transliteration: sagal maahi naktee kaa vaasaa sagal maar a-uhayree.

lines.english: She says, "I am the sister, and the daughter of the sister of everyone; I am the hand-maiden of one who marries me."||2||
lines.transliteration: sagli-aa kee ha-o bahin bhaanjee jineh baree t is chayree. ||2||

lines.english: My Husband is the Great One of discriminating wisdom; He alone is called a Saint.
lines.transliteration: hamro bhart aa bado bibaykee aapay sant  kahaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਤੁ  ਪਤਿਰ ਭਿਰ ਉਰਕਟ  ਕੁਰਕਟ  ਇਕਤੁ  ਪਤਿਰ  ਭਿਰ ਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: He stands by me, and no one else comes near me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oh hamaarai maathai kaa-im a-or hamrai nikat na aavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਸ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਪੰਚ ਜੋਗੀਆ  ਬੈਠੇ ਬੀਿਚ  ਨਕਟ  ਦੇ ਰਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have cut off her nose, and cut off her ears, and cutting her into bits, I have expelledher.
lines.transliteration: naakahu kaatee kaanahu kaatee kaat koot kai daaree.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, she is the darling of the three worlds, but the enemy of the Saints.||4||4|| Awsw ] (476-18) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer santan kee bairan t een lok kee pi-aaree. ||4||4||

lines.english: The Yogis, celibates, penitents and Sannyaasees make pilgrimages to all the sacredplaces.
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee t apee sani-aasee baho t irath bh armanaa.

lines.english: The Jains with shaven heads, the silent ones, the beggars with matted hair - in theend, they all shall die. ||1||
lines.transliteration: luNjit muNjit mon jataaDh ar ant  ta-oo marnaa. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate, therefore, on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: taa tay sayvee-alay raamnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਨਕਟੀ  ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਗਲ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਅਉਹੇਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: What can the Messenger of Death do to one whose tongue loves the Name of the Lord? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam naam hit jaa kai kahaa karai jamnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਿਲਆ  ਕੀ ਹਉ ਬਿਹਨ  ਭਾਨਜੀ  ਿਜਨਿਹ  ਬਰੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who know the Shaastras and the Vedas, astrology and the rules of grammar of many languages; pMnw 477
lines.transliteration: aagam nirgam jotik jaaneh baho baho bi-aakarnaa.
tant mant ar sabh  a-ukh aDh jaaneh ant  ta-oo marnaa. ||2|| those who know Tantras and mantras and all medicines - even they shall die in the end. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤਰ੍ ਸਭ ਅਉਖਧ  ਜਾਨਿਹ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who enjoy regal power and rule, royal canopies and thrones, many beautifulwomen,
lines.transliteration: raaj bhog ar chh atar singh aasan baho sund ar ramnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਛਤਰ੍ ਿਸੰਘਾਸਨ  ਬਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਰਮਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: paan kapoor subaasak chandan ant  ta-oo marnaa. ||3|| betel nuts, camphor and fragrant sandalwood oil - in the end, they too shall die. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ  ਸੁਬਾਸਕ  ਚੰਦਨ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have searched all the Vedas, Puraanas and Simritees, but none of these can saveanyone.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  sabh  khojay kahoo na oobarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਿਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਭ ਖੋਜੇ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਊਬਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord, and eliminate birth and death. ||4||5|| Awsw ] (477-3) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer i-o raameh jampa-o mayt janam marnaa. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਇਉ ਰਾਮਿਹ  ਜੰਪਉ  ਮੇਿਟ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨਾ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: The elephant is the guitar player, the ox is the drummer, and the crow plays thecymbals.
lines.transliteration: feel rabaabee balad pakh aavaj ka-oo-aa t aal bajaavai.

lines.english: Putting on the skirt, the donkey dances around, and the water buffalo performsdevotional worship. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pahir cholnaa gadhaa naachai bh aisaa bh agat karaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਫੀਲੁ ਰਬਾਬੀ  ਬਲਦੁ  ਪਖਾਵਜ  ਕਊਆ  ਤਾਲ  ਬਜਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the King, has cooked the cakes of ice,
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam kakree-aa baray pakaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਿਰ  ਚੋਲਨਾ  ਗਦਹਾ  ਨਾਚੈ ਭੈਸਾ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kinai boojhanhaarai kh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. but only the rare man of understanding eats them. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Sitting in his den, the lion prepares the betel leaves, and the muskrat brings the betelnuts.
lines.transliteration: baith singh  ghar paan lagaavai gh ees gal-uray li-aavai.

lines.english: Going from house to house, the mouse sings the songs of joy, and the turtle blows onthe conch-shell. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar musree mangal gaavahi kachh oo-aa sankh  bajaavai. ||2||

lines.english: The son of the sterile woman goes to get married, and the golden canopy is spreadout for him.
lines.transliteration: bans ko poot bee-aahan chali-aa su-inay mandap chh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਿਠ ਿਸੰਘੁ ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਨ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਘੀਸ  ਗਲਉਰੇ  ਿਲਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He marries a beautiful and enticing young woman; the rabbit and the lion sing their praises. ||3||
lines.transliteration: roop kanniaa sundar bayDh ee sasai singh  gun gaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਮੁਸਰੀ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਕਛੂਆ  ਸੰਖੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - the ant has eaten the mountain.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu keetee parbat  khaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਸ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਬੀਆਹਨ  ਚਿਲਆ  ਸੁਇਨੇ  ਮੰਡਪ  ਛਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The turtle says, "I need a burning coal, also." Listen to this mystery of the Shabad.||4||6|| Awsw ] (477-9) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kachhoo-aa kahai angaar bh e lora-o lookee sabad  sunaa-i-aa. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪ ਕੰਿਨਆ  ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਬੇਧੀ ਸਸੈ ਿਸੰਘ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The body is a bag with seventy-two chambers, and one opening, the Tenth Gate.
lines.transliteration: batoo-aa ayk bahtar aaDh aaree ayko jisahi d u-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੀਟੀ  ਪਰਬਤੁ  ਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a real Yogi on this earth, who asks for the primal world of the nineregions. ||1||
lines.transliteration: navai khand kee parithmee maagai so jogee jag saaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਛੂਆ  ਕਹੈ ਅੰਗਾਰ  ਿਭ ਲੋਰਉ  ਲੂਕੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਨਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Such a Yogi obtains the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: aisaa jogee na-o niDh paavai.

lines.english: He lifts his soul up from below, to the skies of the Tenth Gate. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tal kaa barahm lay gagan charaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਟੂਆ  ਏਕੁ ਬਹਤਿਰ  ਆਧਾਰੀ  ਏਕੋ ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He makes spiritual wisdom his patched coat, and meditation his needle. He twists thethread of the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: khinthaa gi-aan Dh i-aan kar soo-ee sabad  taagaa math gh aalai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵੈ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਿਪਰ੍ਥਮੀ  ਮਾਗੈ  ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ  ਜਿਗ ਸਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Making the five elements his deer skin to sit on, he walks on the Guru's Path. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch tat  kee kar mirgaan ee gur kai maarag chaalai. ||2||

lines.english: He makes compassion his shovel, his body the firewood, and he kindles the fire of divine vision.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa faahuree kaa-i-aa kar Dh oo-ee d arisat kee agan jalaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਲ ਕਾ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਲੇ ਗਗਿਨ  ਚਰਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He places love within his heart, and he remains in deep meditation throughout thefour ages. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis kaa bh aa-o la-ay rid  antar chahu jug t aarhee laavai. ||3||

lines.english: All Yoga is in the Name of the Lord; the body and the breath of life belong to Him.
lines.transliteration: sabh jogt an raam naam hai jis kaa pind paraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਿਗਆਨ ਿਧਆਨ  ਕਿਰ ਸੂਈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਤਾਗਾ  ਮਿਥ ਘਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, if God grants His Grace, He bestows the insignia of Truth. ||4||7|| Awsw ] (477-14) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jay kirpaa Dhaarai d ay-ay sachaa neesaanaa. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਮਰਗਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਾਲੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Where have the Hindus and Muslims come from? Who put them on their differentpaths?
lines.transliteration: hindoo t urak kahaa t ay aa-ay kin ayh raah chalaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਫਾਹੁਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਧੂਈ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕੀ ਅਗਿਨ  ਜਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Think of this, and contemplate it within your mind, O men of evil intentions. Who willgo to heaven and hell? ||1||
lines.transliteration: dil meh soch bichaar kavaad ay bh isat dojak kin paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ਲਏ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Qazi, which book have you read?
lines.transliteration: kaajee tai kavan kat ayb bakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜੋਗਤਣ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Such scholars and students have all died, and none of them have discovered the inner meaning. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parhHat gunat  aisay sabh  maaray kinhooN khabar na jaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: Because of the love of woman, circumcision is done; I don't believe in it, O Siblings ofDestiny.
lines.transliteration: sakat sanayhu kar sunat  karee-ai mai na bad -ugaa bh aa-ee.

lines.english: If God wished me to be a Muslim, it would be cut off by itself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ja-o ray khud aa-ay mohi t urak karaigaa aapan hee kat jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ  ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਏ  ਿਕਿਨ  ਏਹ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: If circumcision makes one a Muslim, then what about a woman?
lines.transliteration: sunat kee-ay t urak jay ho-igaa a-urat  kaa ki-aa karee-ai.

lines.english: She is the other half of a man's body, and she does not leave him, so he remains aHindu. ||3||
lines.transliteration: araDh sareeree naar na chh odai t aa tay hind oo hee rahee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: Give up your holy books, and remember the Lord, you fool, and stop oppressingothers so badly.
lines.transliteration: chhaad kat ayb raam bh aj ba-uray julam karat  hai bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪੜਤ  ਗੁਨਤ  ਐਸੇ ਸਭ ਮਾਰੇ ਿਕਨਹੂੰ ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer has grasped hold of the Lord's Support, and the Muslims have utterly failed.||4||8|| Awsw ] (477-19) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kabeerai pakree tayk raam kee turak rahay pachihaaree. ||4||8||

lines.english: As long as the oil and the wick are in the lamp, everything is illuminated. pMnw 478
lines.transliteration: jab lag tayl d eevay mukh  baatee tab soojh ai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵੇ ਮੁਿਖ ਬਾਤੀ  ਤਬ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: But when the oil is burnt, the wick goes out, and the mansion becomes desolate. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayl jalay baat ee thehraanee soonnaa mand ar ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਲ ਜਲੇ ਬਾਤੀ  ਠਹਰਾਨੀ  ਸੂੰਨਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mad-man, no one will keep you, for even a moment.
lines.transliteration: ray ba-uray tuhi gh aree na raakh ai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਬਉਰੇ  ਤੁਿਹ ਘਰੀ  ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN raam naam jap so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Tell me, whose mother is that, whose father is that, and which man has a wife?
lines.transliteration: kaa kee maat pit aa kaho kaa ko kavan purakh  kee jo-ee.

lines.english: When the pitcher of the body breaks, no one cares for you at all. Everyone says, "Take him away, take him away!"||2||
lines.transliteration: ghat footay ko-oo baat  na poochh ai kaadh ahu kaadh ahu ho-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਵਨ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕੀ ਜੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Sitting on the threshold, his mother cries, and his brothers take away the coffin.
lines.transliteration: dayhuree baith ee maat aa rovai kh atee-aa lay ga-ay bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Taking down her hair, his wife cries out in sorrow, and the swan-soul departs allalone. ||3||
lines.transliteration: lat chhitkaa-ay t iree-aa rovai hans ikaylaa jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਾਤਾ  ਰੋਵੈ ਖਟੀਆ  ਲੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints, about the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu bh ai saagar kai t aa-ee.

lines.english: This human suffers torture and the Messenger of Death will not leave him alone, OLord of the World. ||4||9|| duquky (478-5) dutukay Du-Tukas <> siqgur pRswid ] (478-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: is banday sir julam hot  hai jam nahee hatai gusaa-ee. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Chau-Padas, Ik-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: aasaa saree kabeer jee-o kay cha-upday ikt ukay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਿਸਿਰ  ਜੁਲਮੁ  ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਟੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: Sanak and Sanand, the sons of Brahma, could not find the Lord's limits.
lines.transliteration: sanak sanand ant nahee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Brahma wasted his life away, continually reading the Vedas. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bayd parh ay parh  barahmay janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਇਕਤੁਕੇ  ॥
lines.english: Churn the churn of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa bilovahu mayray bhaa-ee.

lines.english: Churn it steadily, so that the essence, the butter, may not be lost. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sahj bilovahu jaisay tat  na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪਿੜ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੇ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Make your body the churning jar, and use the stick of your mind to churn it.
lines.transliteration: tan kar matukee man maahi bilo-ee.

lines.english: Gather the curds of the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: is matukee meh sabad sanjo-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The churning of the Lord is to reflect upon Him within your mind.
lines.transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa man kaa beechaaraa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Ambrosial Nectar flows into us. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad paavai amrit  Dhaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, if the Lord, our King casts His Glance of Grace,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer nadar karay jay meeNraa.

lines.english: Awsw ] (478-10) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: raam naam lag utray t eeraa. ||4||1||10|| one is carried across to the other side, holding fast to the Lord's Name. ||4||1||10||

lines.english: The wick has dried up, and the oil is exhausted.
lines.transliteration: baatee sookee t ayl nikh ootaa.

lines.english: The drum does not sound, and the actor has gone to sleep. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mandal na baajai nat pai soot aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਨਦਿਰ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The fire has gone out, and no smoke is produced.
lines.transliteration: bujh ga-ee agan na niksi-o Dh ooN-aa.

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; there is no other second.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa ayk avar nahee doo-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The string has broken, and the guitar makes no sound.
lines.transliteration: tootee tant  na bajai rabaab.

lines.english: He mistakenly ruins his own affairs. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhool bigaari-o apnaa kaaj. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਲੁ  ਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਨਟੁ ਪੈ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When one comes to understand, he forgets his preaching, ranting and raving, and arguing. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee kahan kahaavan. samajh  paree t a-o bisri-o gaavan. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the state of supreme dignity is never far from those who conquer thefive demons of the body passions. ||4||2||11|| Awsw ] (478-14) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer panch jo chooray. t in tay naahi param pad  dooray. ||4||2||11||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਏਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As many mistakes as the son commits,
lines.transliteration: sut apraaDh  karat  hai jayt ay.
jannee cheet na raakh as taytay. ||1|| his mother does not hold them against him in her mind. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, I am Your child.
lines.transliteration: raam-ee-aa ha-o baarik tayraa.

lines.english: Why not destroy my sins? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaahay na khandas avgan mayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If the son, in anger, runs away,
lines.transliteration: jay at karop karay kar Dh aa-i-aa.
taa bh ee cheet  na raakh as maa-i-aa. ||2|| even then, his mother does not hold it against him in her mind. ||2||

lines.english: My mind has fallen into the whirlpool of anxiety.
lines.transliteration: chint bh avan man pari-o hamaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, how can I cross over to the other side? ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kaisay utras paaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Please, bless my body with pure and lasting understanding, Lord;
lines.transliteration: deh bimal mat  sadaa sareeraa.

lines.english: Awsw ] (478-17) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: sahj sahj gun ravai kabeeraa. ||4||3||12|| in peace and poise, Kabeer chants the Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||12||

lines.english: My pilgrimage to Mecca is on the banks of the Gomati River;
lines.transliteration: haj hamaaree gomtee t eer.
jahaa baseh peetambar peer. ||1|| the spiritual teacher in his yellow robes dwells there. ||1||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! How wondrously he sings.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu ki-aa khoob gaavt aa hai.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 479
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam mayrai man bhaavt aa hai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Naarada the sage, and Shaarada the goddess of knowledge, serve the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naarad saarad  karahi kh avaasee.

lines.english: The goddess Lakhshmi sits by Him as His slave. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paas baithee beebee kavlaa d aasee. ||2||

lines.english: The mala is around my neck, and the Lord's Name is upon my tongue.
lines.transliteration: kanthay maalaa jihvaa raam.

lines.english: I repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a thousand times, and bow in reverence toHim. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sahaNs naam lai lai kara-o salaam. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer raam gun gaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੰਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਕਰਉ  ਸਲਾਮੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I teach both Hindus and Muslims. ||4||4||13|| Awsw sRI kbIr jIau ky pMcpdy 9 duquky 5  (479-4) aasaa saree kabeer jee-o kay panchpaday 9 d utukay 5 Aasaa, Kabeer Jee, 9 Panch-Padas, 5 Du-Tukas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (479-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: hindoo t urak d o-oo samjh aava-o. ||4||4||13||

lines.english: You tear off the leaves, O gardener, but in each and every leaf, there is life.
lines.transliteration: paatee t orai maalini paat ee paat ee jee-o.

lines.english: That stone idol, for which you tear off those leaves - that stone idol is lifeless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis paahan ka-o paatee t orai so paahan nirjee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੇ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ  ੯ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: In this, you are mistaken, O gardener.
lines.transliteration: bhoolee maalnee hai ay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਤੀ  ਤੋਰੈ ਮਾਿਲਨੀ  ਪਾਤੀ  ਪਾਤੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Living Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur jaagt aa hai d ay-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਾਹਨ  ਕਉ ਪਾਤੀ  ਤੋਰੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਹਨ  ਿਨਰਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Brahma is in the leaves, Vishnu is in the branches, and Shiva is in the flowers.
lines.transliteration: barahm paatee bisan daaree fool sankard ay-o.

lines.english: When you break these three gods, whose service are you performing? ||2||
lines.transliteration: teen d ayv part akh toreh karahi kis kee say-o. ||2||

lines.english: The sculptor carves the stone and fashions it into an idol, placing his feet upon its chest.
lines.transliteration: paakhaan gadh  kai moorat  keenHee day kai chh aatee paa-o.

lines.english: If this stone god was true, it would devour the sculptor for this! ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay ayh moorat saachee hai t a-o garhHanhaaray kh aa-o. ||3||

lines.english: Rice and beans, candies, cakes and cookies
lines.transliteration: bhaat  pahit  ar laapsee karkaraa kaasaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ  ਦੇਵ ਪਰ੍ਤਿਖ  ਤੋਰਿਹ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਕਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhoganhaaray bh ogi-aa is moorat  kay mukh  chhaar. ||4|| - the priest enjoys these, while he puts ashes into the mouth of the idol. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖਾਨ  ਗਿਢ  ਕੈ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਕੀਨੀ  ਦੇ ਕੈ ਛਾਤੀ  ਪਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The gardener is mistaken, and the world is mistaken, but I am not mistaken.
lines.transliteration: maalin bhoolee jag bh ulaanaa ham bh ulaanay naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਏਹ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਸਾਚੀ  ਹੈ ਤਉ ਗੜਣਹਾਰੇ  ਖਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Lord preserves me; the Lord, my King, has showered His Blessings upon me. ||5||1||14|| Awsw ] (479-10) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ham raam raakhay kirpaa kar har raa-ay. ||5||1||14||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਤੁ ਪਿਹਿਤ  ਅਰੁ ਲਾਪਸੀ  ਕਰਕਰਾ  ਕਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Twelve years pass in childhood, and for another twenty years, he does not practiceself-discipline and austerity.
lines.transliteration: baarah baras baalpan beetay bees baras kachh  tap na kee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭੋਗਨਹਾਰੇ  ਭੋਿਗਆ  ਇਸੁ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: For another thirty years, he does not worship God in any way, and then, when he isold, he repents and regrets. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tees baras kachh  dayv na poojaa fir pachh utaanaa biraDh  bha-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਲਿਨ  ਭੂਲੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ  ਹਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: His life wastes away as he cries out, "Mine, mine!"
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kartay janam ga-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥੫॥੧॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The pool of his power has dried up. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saa-ir sokh bh ujaN bali-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He makes a dam around the dried-up pool, and with his hands, he makes a fencearound the harvested field.
lines.transliteration: sookay sarvar paal banDhaavai loon ai khayt hath vaar karai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰਹ  ਬਰਸ  ਬਾਲਪਨ  ਬੀਤੇ ਬੀਸ ਬਰਸ  ਕਛੁ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ  ॥
lines.english: When the thief of Death comes, he quickly carries away what the fool had tried to preserve as his own. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aa-i-o chor turant ah lay ga-i-o mayree raakh at mugaDh  firai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਸ ਬਰਸ  ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਿਫਿਰ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ  ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਭਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: His feet and head and hands begin to tremble, and the tears flow copiously from hiseyes.
lines.transliteration: charan sees kar kampan laagay nainee neer asaar bahai.

lines.english: His tongue has not spoken the correct words, but now, he hopes to practice religion!||3||
lines.transliteration: jihvaa bachan suDh nahee niksai t ab ray Dh aram kee aas karai. ||3||

lines.english: If the Dear Lord shows His Mercy, one enshrines love for Him, and obtains the Profitof the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kirpaa karai liv laavai laahaa har har naam lee-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he receives the wealth of the Lord's Name, which alone shall go withhim, when he departs in the end. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har Dhan paa-i-o ant ay chald i-aa naal chali-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਕੇ ਸਰਵਿਰ  ਪਾਿਲ  ਬੰਧਾਵੈ  ਲੂਣੈ ਖੇਿਤ ਹਥ ਵਾਿਰ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - he shall not take any other wealth with him.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu an Dh an kachh oo-ai lai na ga-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਓ  ਚੋਰੁ ਤੁਰੰਤਹ ਲੇ ਗਇਓ  ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਤ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਿਫਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the summons comes from the King, the Lord of the Universe, the mortal departs, leaving behind his wealth and mansions. ||5||2||15|| Awsw ] (479-17) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: aa-ee talab gopaal raa-ay kee maa-i-aa mand ar chh od chali-o. ||5||2||15||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸੀਸੁ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਅਸਾਰ  ਬਹੈ ॥
lines.english: To some, the Lord has given silks and satins, and to some, beds decorated withcotton ribbons.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo deenHay paat patambar kaahoo palagh  nivaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਹੀ ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਤਬ ਰੇ ਧਰਮ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਕਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Some do not even have a poor patched coat, and some live in thatched huts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaahoo garee godree naahee kaahoo kh aan paraaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਵੈ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਓ  ॥
lines.english: Do not indulge in envy and bickering, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: ahirakh vaad  na keejai ray man.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਅੰਤੇ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਚਿਲਓ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By continually doing good deeds, these are obtained, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukarit kar kar leejai ray man. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਛੂਐ  ਲੈ ਨ ਗਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The potter works the same clay, and colors the pots in different ways.
lines.transliteration: kumHaarai ayk jo maatee goonDhee baho biDh  baanee laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਈ  ਤਲਬ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੰਦਰ  ਛੋਿਡ ਚਿਲਓ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Into some, he sets pearls, while to others, he attaches filth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaahoo meh motee mukt aahal kaahoo bi-aaDh  lagaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: God gave wealth to the miser for him to preserve, but the fool calls it his own. pMnw 480
lines.transliteration: soomeh Dhan raakh an ka-o d ee-aa mugaDh  kahai Dh an mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਨ  ਕਉ ਦੀਆ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਕਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: When the Messenger of Death strikes him with his club, in an instant, everything is settled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jam kaa dand moond meh laagai khin meh karai nibayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਿਹ ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਰੈ ਿਨਬੇਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant is called the most exalted Saint; he obeys the Command ofthe Lord's Order, and obtains peace.
lines.transliteration: har jan ootam bh agat sadaavai aagi-aa man sukh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਊਤਮੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਸਦਾਵੈ  ਆਿਗਆ  ਮਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord, he accepts as True; he enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai sat  kar maanai bh aanaa man vasaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - it is false to call out, "Mine, mine."
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer sunhu ray santahu mayree mayree jh oothee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
lines.english: Breaking the bird cage, death takes the bird away, and only the torn threads remain.||5||3||16|| Awsw ] (480-4) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: chirgat faar chataaraa lai ga-i-o taree t aagree chh ootee. ||5||3||16||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਰਗਟ  ਫਾਿਰ  ਚਟਾਰਾ  ਲੈ ਗਇਓ  ਤਰੀ ਤਾਗਰੀ  ਛੂਟੀ ॥੫॥੩॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I am Your humble servant, Lord; Your Praises are pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: ham maskeen khud aa-ee band ay tum raajas man bh aavai.

lines.english: The Lord, the Primal Being, the Master of the poor, does not ordain that they shouldbe oppressed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: alah aval deen ko saahib jor nahee furmaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮਸਕੀਨ  ਖੁਦਾਈ  ਬੰਦੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਜਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Qazi, it is not right to speak before Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaajee boli-aa ban nahee aavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਹ  ਅਵਿਲ  ਦੀਨ  ਕੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Keeping your fasts, reciting your prayers, and reading the Kalma, the Islamic creed,shall not take you to paradise.
lines.transliteration: rojaa Dharai nivaaj gujaarai kalmaa bh isat na ho-ee.

lines.english: The Temple of Mecca is hidden within your mind, if you only knew it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satar kaabaa gh at hee bh eetar jay kar jaanai ko-ee. ||2||

lines.english: That should be your prayer, to administer justice. Let your Kalma be the knowledge ofthe unknowable Lord.
lines.transliteration: nivaaj so-ee jo ni-aa-o bichaarai kalmaa aklahi jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਿਨਵਾਜ  ਗੁਜਾਰੈ  ਕਲਮਾ ਿਭਸਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Spread your prayer mat by conquering your five desires, and you shall recognize thetrue religion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paachahu mus muslaa bichhaavai t ab ta-o deen pachh aanai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਿਰ  ਕਾਬਾ  ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Recognize Your Lord and Master, and fear Him within your heart; conquer youregotism, and make it worthless.
lines.transliteration: khasam pachh aan taras kar jee-a meh maar man ee kar feekee.

lines.english: As you see yourself, see others as well; only then will you become a partner inheaven. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aap janaa-ay avar ka-o jaanai tab ho-ay bh isat sareekee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਚਹੁ ਮੁਿਸ ਮੁਸਲਾ  ਿਬਛਾਵੈ  ਤਬ ਤਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The clay is one, but it has taken many forms; I recognize the One Lord within themall.
lines.transliteration: maatee ayk bhaykh  Dhar naanaa t aa meh barahm pachh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੁ  ਪਛਾਿਨ  ਤਰਸ ਕਿਰ ਜੀਅ  ਮਿਹ ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਣੀ ਕਿਰ ਫੀਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have abandoned paradise, and reconciled my mind to hell. ||5||4||17|| Awsw ] (480-10) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeeraa bhisat  chhod kar d ojak si-o man maanaa. ||5||4||17||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਜਨਾਇ  ਅਵਰ  ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਿਭਸਤ  ਸਰੀਕੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: From the city of the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, not even a drop rains down.Where is the music of the sound current of the Naad, which was contained in it?
lines.transliteration: gagan nagar ik boond na barkh ai naad  kahaa jo samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਟੀ  ਏਕ ਭੇਖ ਧਿਰ ਨਾਨਾ  ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Master of wealth has taken away the Supreme Soul. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysur maaDho param hans lay siDh aanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਿਭਸਤ  ਛੋਿਡ ਕਿਰ ਦੋਜਕ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੪॥੧੭॥
lines.english: O Father, tell me: where has it gone? It used to dwell within the body,
lines.transliteration: baabaa boltay t ay kahaa ga-ay d ayhee kay sang raht ay.
surat maahi jo nirt ay kart ay kathaa baart aa kaht ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. and dance in the mind, teaching and speaking. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਗਗਨ  ਨਗਿਰ  ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਬਰਖੈ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Where has the player gone - he who made this temple his own?
lines.transliteration: bajaavanhaaro kahaa ga-i-o jin ih mandar keenHaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਮਾਧੋ ਪਰਮ  ਹੰਸੁ ਲੇ ਿਸਧਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No story, word or understanding is produced; the Lord has drained off all the power.||2||
lines.transliteration: saakhee sabad  surat  nahee upjai kh inch t ayj sabh  leenHaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਬੋਲਤੇ  ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਗਏ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: The ears, your companions, have gone deaf, and the power of your organs isexhausted.
lines.transliteration: saravnan bikal bha-ay sang t ayray ind ree kaa bal thaakaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਜੋ ਿਨਰਤੇ  ਕਰਤੇ ਕਥਾ ਬਾਰਤਾ  ਕਹਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your feet have failed, your hands have gone limp, and no words issue forth from yourmouth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan rahay kar dharak paray hai mukh ahu na niksai baat aa. ||3||

lines.english: Having grown weary, the five enemies and all the thieves have wandered awayaccording to their own will.
lines.transliteration: thaakay panch doot  sabh  taskar aap aapn ai bharamt ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ  ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਕੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The elephant of the mind has grown weary, and the heart has grown weary as well; through its power, it used to pull the strings. ||4||
lines.transliteration: thaakaa man kunchar ur thaakaa tayj soot  Dhar ramt ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਖੀ  ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੈ  ਿਖੰਿਚ  ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is dead, and the bonds of the ten gates are opened; he has left all his friends andbrothers.
lines.transliteration: mirtak bh a-ay d asai band  chhootay mit ar bhaa-ee sabh  chhoray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਨਨ  ਿਬਕਲ  ਭਏ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੇ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਥਾਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, one who meditates on the Lord, breaks his bonds, even while yet alive.||5||5||18|| Awsw iekquky 4 ] (480-16) aasaa iktukay 4. Aasaa, 4 Ik-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeeraa jo har Dh i-aavai jeevat  banDh an toray. ||5||5||18||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਢਰਿਕ  ਪਰੇ ਹੈ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਬਾਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: No one is more powerful than the she-serpent Maya,
lines.transliteration: sarpanee tay oopar nahee balee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭ ਤਸਕਰ  ਆਪ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jin barahmaa bisan mahaaday-o chh alee-aa. ||1|| who deceived even Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰ  ਉਰੁ ਥਾਕਾ  ਤੇਜੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਧਿਰ ਰਮਤੇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Having bitten and struck them down, she now sits in the immaculate waters.
lines.transliteration: maar maar sarpanee nirmal jal paithee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰਤਕ  ਭਏ ਦਸੈ ਬੰਦ ਛੂਟੇ ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਭਾਈ  ਸਭ ਛੋਰੇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have seen her, who has bitten the three worlds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin taribh avan dasee-alay gur parsaad  deeth ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਜੀਵਤ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋਰੇ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੮॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, why is she called a she-serpent?
lines.transliteration: sarpanee sarpanee ki-aa kahhu bhaa-ee.

lines.english: One who realizes the True Lord, devours the she-serpent. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin saach pachhaani-aa t in sarpanee kh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: No one else is more frivolous than this she-serpent.
lines.transliteration: sarpanee tay aan chh oochh  nahee avraa.

lines.english: When the she-serpent is overcome, what can the Messengers of the King of Death do? ||3|| pMnw 481
lines.transliteration: sarpanee jeetee kahaa karai jamraa. ||3||

lines.english: This she-serpent is created by Him.
lines.transliteration: ih sarpanee taa kee keet ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਸਰ੍ਪਨੀ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: What power or weakness does she have by herself? ||4||
lines.transliteration: bal abal ki-aa is tay ho-ee. ||4||

lines.english: If she abides with the mortal, then his soul abides in his body.
lines.transliteration: ih bastee t aa basat  sareeraa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Kabeer has easily crossed over. ||5||6||19|| Awsw ] (481-2) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad sahj t aray kabeeraa. ||5||6||19||

lines.english: Why bother to read the Simritees to a dog?
lines.transliteration: kahaa su-aan ka-o simrit sunaa-ay.

lines.english: Why bother to sing the Lord's Praises to the faithless cynic? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahaa saakat peh har gun gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Remain absorbed in the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: raam raam raam ramay ram rahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਸਾਕਤ  ਪਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Do not bother to speak of it to the faithless cynic, even by mistake. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saakat si-o bh ool nahee kahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੇ ਰਿਮ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Why offer camphor to a crow?
lines.transliteration: ka-oo-aa kahaa kapoor charaa-ay.

lines.english: Why give the snake milk to drink? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kah bisee-ar ka-o dooDh  pee-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, discriminating understanding isattained.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  mil bibayk buDh  ho-ee.

lines.english: That iron which touches the Philosopher's Stone becomes gold. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paaras paras lohaa kanchan so-ee. ||3||

lines.english: The dog, the faithless cynic, does everything as the Lord causes him to do.
lines.transliteration: saakat su-aan sabh  karay karaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He does the deeds pre-ordained from the very beginning. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so karam kamaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: If you take Ambrosial Nectar and irrigate the neem tree with it,
lines.transliteration: amrit lai lai neem sinchaa-ee.

lines.english: Awsw ] (481-7) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer u-aa ko sahj na jaa-ee. ||5||7||20|| still, says Kabeer, its natural qualities are not changed. ||5||7||20||

lines.english: A fortress like that of Sri Lanka, with the ocean as a moat around it
lines.transliteration: lankaa saa kot samund see kh aa-ee.
tih raavan gh ar khabar na paa-ee. ||1|| - there is no news about that house of Raavan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਉਆ  ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੫॥੭॥੨੦  ॥
lines.english: What shall I ask for? Nothing is permanent.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa maaga-o kichh thir na rahaa-ee.

lines.english: I see with my eyes that the world is passing away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daykh at nain chali-o jag jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲੰਕਾ  ਸਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਮੁੰਦ  ਸੀ ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Thousands of sons and thousands of grandsons
lines.transliteration: ik lakh poot  savaa lakh  naatee.
tih raavan gh ar dee-aa na baat ee. ||2|| - but in that house of Raavan, the lamps and wicks have gone out. ||2||

lines.english: The moon and the sun cooked his food.
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj jaa kay t apat raso-ee.

lines.english: The fire washed his clothes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: baisantar jaa kay kapray Dh o-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Under Guru's Instructions, one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: gurmat raamai naam basaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਪੂਤ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ ਨਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: asthir rahai na katahooN jaa-ee. ||4|| becomes permanent, and does not go anywhere. ||4||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, people:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤਪਤ  ਰਸੋਈ  ॥
lines.english: Awsw ] (481-11) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na ho-ee. ||5||8||21|| without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated. ||5||8||21||

lines.english: First, the son was born, and then, his mother.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa poot pichh airee maa-ee.

lines.english: The guru falls at the feet of the disciple. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur laago chaylay kee paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Listen to this wonderful thing, O Siblings of Destiny!
lines.transliteration: ayk achambha-o sunhu t umH bhaa-ee.

lines.english: I saw the lion herding the cows. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daykh at singh  charaavat  gaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The fish of the water gives birth upon a tree.
lines.transliteration: jal kee machhulee t arvar bi-aa-ee.

lines.english: I saw a cat carrying away a dog. ||2||
lines.transliteration: daykh at kutraa lai ga-ee bilaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The branches are below, and the roots are above.
lines.transliteration: talai ray baisaa oopar soolaa.

lines.english: The trunk of that tree bears fruits and flowers. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis kai payd lagay fal foolaa. ||3||

lines.english: Riding a horse, the buffalo takes him out to graze.
lines.transliteration: ghorai char bh ais charaavan jaa-ee.

lines.english: The bull is away, while his load has come home. ||4||
lines.transliteration: baahar bail gon ghar aa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, one who understands this hymn,
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer jo is pad  boojh ai.

lines.english: 22 Chau-Padas And Panch-Padas, Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, 8 Tri-Padas, 7 Du-Tukas, 1 Ik- Tuka: <> siqgur pRswid ] (481-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: raam ramat t is sabh  kichh  soojh ai. ||5||9||22|| and chants the Lord's Name, comes to understand everything. ||5||9||22|| bweIs caupdy qQw pMcpdy Awsw sRI kbIr jIau ky iqpdy 8 duquky 7 iekqukw 1 (481-15) baa-ees cha-upday t athaa panchpad ay aasaa saree kabeer jee-o kay t ipday 8 d utukay 7 iktukaa 1

lines.english: The Lord created the body from sperm, and protected it in the fire pit.
lines.transliteration: bind t ay jin pind kee-aa agan kund rahaa-i-aa.

lines.english: For ten months He preserved you in your mother's womb, and then, after you were born, you became attached to Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: das maas maat aa ud ar raakh i-aa bahur laagee maa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, why have you attached yourself to greed, and lost the jewel of life?
lines.transliteration: paraanee kaahay ka-o lobh laagay rat an janam kh o-i-aa.

lines.english: You did not plant the seeds of good actions in the earth of your past lives.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: poorab janam karam bhoom beej naahee bo-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: From an infant, you have grown old. That which was to happen, has happened.
lines.transliteration: baarik tay biraDh  bha-i-aa honaa so ho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੁ ਇਸ ਪਦ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by your hair, why do you cry out then? ||2|| pMnw 482
lines.transliteration: jaa jam aa-ay jhot pakrai t abeh kaahay ro-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: You hope for long life, while Death counts your breaths.
lines.transliteration: jeevnai kee aas karahi jam nihaarai saasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨੈ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜਮੁ ਿਨਹਾਰੈ  ਸਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The world is a game, O Kabeer, so throw the dice consciously. ||3||1||23|| Awsw ] (482-2) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: baajeegaree sansaar kabeeraa chayt dh aal paasaa. ||3||1||23||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰੀ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਢਾਿਲ  ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੩॥
lines.english: I make my body the dying vat, and within it, I dye my mind. I make the five elementsmy marriage guests.
lines.transliteration: tan rainee man pun rap kar ha-o paacha-o t at baraat ee.

lines.english: I take my marriage vows with the Lord, my King; my soul is imbued with His Love.||1||
lines.transliteration: raam raa-ay si-o bhaavar laiha-o aat am tih rang raat ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਪੁਨ ਰਿਪ ਕਿਰ ਹਉ ਪਾਚਉ  ਤਤ ਬਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Sing, sing, O brides of the Lord, the marriage songs of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gaa-o gaa-o ree dulhanee mangalchaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਿਸਉ ਭਾਵਿਰ ਲੈਹਉ  ਆਤਮ  ਿਤਹ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, my King, has come to my house as my Husband. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayray garih aa-ay raajaa raam bhat aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Within the lotus of my heart, I have made my bridal pavilion, and I have spoken thewisdom of God.
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal meh bayd ee rach lay barahm gi-aan uchaaraa.

lines.english: I have obtained the Lord King as my Husband - such is my great good fortune. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam raa-ay so doolahu paa-i-o as badbh aag hamaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The angles, holy men, silent sages, and the 330,000,000 deities have come in theirheavenly chariots to see this spectacle.
lines.transliteration: sur nar mun jan ka-utak aa-ay kot t aytees ujaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਭ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਿਹ ਬੇਦੀ ਰਿਚ ਲੇ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਉਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have been taken in marriage by the One Supreme Being, the Lord God. ||3||2||24|| Awsw ] (482-6) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer mohi bi-aahi chalay hai purakh ayk bh agvaanaa. ||3||2||24||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਸੋ ਦੂਲਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਅਸ ਬਡਭਾਗ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am bothered by my mother-in-law, Maya, and loved by my father-in-law, the Lord. I fear even the name of my husband's elder brother, Death.
lines.transliteration: saas kee dukh ee sasur kee pi-aaree jayth  kay naam dara-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉਤਕ  ਆਏ  ਕੋਿਟ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਉਜਾਨ ॥
lines.english: O my mates and companions, my husband's sister, misunderstanding has seized me,and I am burning with the pain of separation from my husband's younger brother,divine knowledge. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahaylee nanad  gahaylee d ayvar kai bireh jara-o ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਬਆਿਹ  ਚਲੇ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਖ  ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥੨॥੨੪॥
lines.english: My mind has gone insane, since I forgot the Lord. How can I lead a virtuous lifestyle?
lines.transliteration: mayree mat ba-uree mai raam bisaari-o kin biDh  rahan raha-o ray.

lines.english: He rests in the bed of my mind, but I cannot see Him with my eyes. Unto whomshould I tell my sufferings? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sayjai ramat nain nahee paykh a-o ih d ukh kaa sa-o kaha-o ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਸਸੁਰ  ਕੀ ਿਪਆਰੀ ਜੇਠ ਕੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਡਰਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: My step-father, egotism, fights with me, and my mother, desire, is always intoxicated.
lines.transliteration: baap saavkaa karai laraa-ee maa-i-aa sad mat vaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਨਨਦ  ਗਹੇਲੀ  ਦੇਵਰ  ਕੈ ਿਬਰਿਹ  ਜਰਉ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When I stayed with my elder brother, meditation, then I was loved by my HusbandLord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baday bhaa-ee kai jab sang hot ee tab ha-o naah pi-aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮਿਤ ਬਉਰੀ  ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਿਬਸਾਿਰਓ  ਿਕਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਰਹਿਨ  ਰਹਉ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, the five passions argue with me, and in these arguments, my life is wasting away.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer panch ko jh agraa jh agrat janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜੈ ਰਮਤੁ  ਨੈਨ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਉ  ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾ ਸਉ ਕਹਉ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The false Maya has bound the whole world, but I have obtained peace, chanting theName of the Lord. ||3||3||25|| Awsw ] (482-11) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee maa-i-aa sabh  jag baaDh i-aa mai raam ramat  sukh  paa-i-aa. ||3||3||25||

lines.english: In my house, I constantly weave the thread, while you wear the thread around yourneck, O Brahmin.
lines.transliteration: ham ghar soot  taneh nit  taanaa kanth  janay-oo t umaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਪੁ ਸਾਵਕਾ  ਕਰੈ ਲਰਾਈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਦ ਮਤਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You read the Vedas and sacred hymns, while I have enshrined the Lord of theUniverse in my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumH ta-o bayd  parhahu gaa-it aree gobind  ridai hamaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਈ  ਕੈ ਜਬ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਨਾਹ ਿਪਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Upon my tongue, within my eyes, and within my heart, abides the Lord, the Lord ofthe Universe.
lines.transliteration: mayree jihbaa bisan nain naaraa-in hirdai baseh gobind aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਪੰਚ ਕੋ ਝਗਰਾ  ਝਗਰਤ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When you are interrogated at Death's door, O mad-man, what will you say then?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jam du-aar jab poochh as bavray t ab ki-aa kahas mukand aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਿਧਆ  ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥੩॥੨੫॥
lines.english: I am a cow, and You are the herdsman, the Sustainer of the World. You are mySaving Grace, lifetime after lifetime.
lines.transliteration: ham goroo tum gu-aar gusaa-ee janam janam rakh vaaray.

lines.english: You have never taken me across to graze there - what sort of a herdsman are You? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kabahooN na paar utaar charaa-ihu kaisay kh asam hamaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਘਿਰ  ਸੂਤੁ ਤਨਿਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਤਾਨਾ  ਕੰਿਠ ਜਨੇਊ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are a Brahmin, and I am a weaver of Benares; can You understand my wisdom?
lines.transliteration: tooN baamHan mai kaaseek julhaa boojh hu mor gi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਤਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਾਇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਿਰਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You beg from emperors and kings, while I meditate on the Lord. ||3||4||26|| Awsw ] (482-15) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: tumH ta-o jaachay bh oopat  raajay har sa-o mor Dh i-aanaa. ||3||4||26||

lines.english: The life of the world is only a dream; life is just a dream.
lines.transliteration: jag jeevan aisaa supnay jaisaa jeevan supan samaanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰ  ਜਬ ਪੂਛਿਸ  ਬਵਰੇ  ਤਬ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਿਸ  ਮੁਕੰਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Believing it to be true, I grasped at it, and abandoned the supreme treasure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saach kar ham gaath d eenee chh od param niDh aanaN. ||1||

lines.english: O Father, I have enshrined love and affection for Maya,
lines.transliteration: baabaa maa-i-aa moh hit keenH.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਗੋਰੂ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਆਰ  ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਰਖਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jin gi-aan ratan hir leenH. ||1|| rahaa-o. which has taken the jewel of spiritual wisdom away from me. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਿਰ  ਚਰਾਇਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਖਸਮ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The moth sees with its eyes, but it still becomes entangled; the insect does not seethe fire.
lines.transliteration: nain daykh  patang urjh ai pas na d aykhai aag.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਬਾਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ  ਬੂਝਹੁ ਮੋਰ ਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to gold and woman, the fool does not think of the noose of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaal faas na mugaDh chayt ai kanik kaamin laag. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਤਉ ਜਾਚੇ  ਭੂਪਿਤ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਸਉ ਮੋਰ ਿਧਆਨਾ  ॥੩॥੪॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Reflect upon this, and abandon sin; the Lord is a boat to carry you across.
lines.transliteration: kar bichaar bikaar parhar taran t aaran so-ay.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, such is the Lord, the Life of the World; there is no one equal to Him. ||3||5||27|| Awsw ] (482-19) aasaa. Aasaa: pMnw 483
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer jagjeevan aisaa dut ee-a naahee ko-ay. ||3||5||27||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਅਬ ਫੁਿਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: In the past, I have taken many forms, but I shall not take form again.
lines.transliteration: ja-o mai roop kee-ay bahutayray ab fun roop na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਗਾ  ਤੰਤੁ ਸਾਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਕਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The strings and wires of the musical instrument are worn out, and I am in the power of the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taagaa t ant saaj sabh  thaakaa raam naam bas ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I no longer dance to the tune.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi naachno na aavai.

lines.english: My mind no longer beats the drum. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayraa man mandaree-aa na bajaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have burnt away sexual desire, anger and attachment to Maya, and the pitcher of my desires has burst.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh maa-i-aa lai jaaree t arisnaa gaagar footee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਲੈ ਜਾਰੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਗਾਗਿਰ  ਫੂਟੀ ॥
lines.english: The gown of sensuous pleasures is worn out, and all my doubts have been dispelled.||2||
lines.transliteration: kaam cholnaa bha-i-aa hai puraanaa ga-i-aa bh aram sabh  chhootee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਚੋਲਨਾ  ਭਇਆ  ਹੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ  ਗਇਆ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਸਭੁ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I look upon all beings alike, and my conflict and strife are ended.
lines.transliteration: sarab bhoot  aykai kar jaani-aa chookay baad  bibaad aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਭੂਤ ਏਕੈ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਚੂਕੇ ਬਾਦ ਿਬਬਾਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, when the Lord showed His Favor, I obtained Him, the Perfect One.||3||6||28|| Awsw ] (483-5) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer mai pooraa paa-i-aa bha-ay raam parsaad aa. ||3||6||28||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਸਾਦਾ  ॥੩॥੬॥੨੮॥
lines.english: You keep your fasts to please Allah, while you murder other beings for pleasure.
lines.transliteration: rojaa Dharai manaavai alhu su-aad at jee-a sangh aarai.

lines.english: You look after your own interests, and so not see the interests of others. What good isyour word? ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapaa daykh  avar nahee d aykhai kaahay ka-o jh akh maarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਮਨਾਵੈ  ਅਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਦਿਤ  ਜੀਅ  ਸੰਘਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Qazi, the One Lord is within you, but you do not behold Him by thought orcontemplation.
lines.transliteration: kaajee saahib ayk tohee meh t ayraa soch bichaar na d aykhai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਅਵਰ  ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You do not care for others, you are a religious fanatic, and your life is of no account at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khabar na karahi d een kay ba-uray t aa tay janam alaykh ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਜੀ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਤੋਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਿਚ ਿਬਚਾਿਰ  ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: Your holy scriptures say that Allah is True, and that he is neither male nor female.
lines.transliteration: saach katayb bakh aanai alhu naar purakh  nahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਕਰਿਹ  ਦੀਨ  ਕੇ ਬਉਰੇ  ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਲੇਖੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But you gain nothing by reading and studying, O mad-man, if you do not gain theunderstanding in your heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: padhay gunay naahee kachh  ba-uray ja-o d il meh kh abar na ho-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Allah is hidden in every heart; reflect upon this in your mind.
lines.transliteration: alhu gaib sagal ghat bh eetar hird ai layho bichaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਤੇਬ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ਅਲਹੁ ਨਾਿਰ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is within both Hindu and Muslim; Kabeer proclaims this out loud.||3||7||29|| Awsw ] iqpdw ] iekqukw ] (483-9) aasaa. tipd aa. ikt ukaa. Aasaa, Ti-Pada, Ik-Tuka:
lines.transliteration: hindoo t urak duhoo-aN meh aykai kahai kabeer pukaaree. ||3||7||29||

lines.punjabi: ਪਢੇ ਗੁਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਛੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਉ ਿਦਲ  ਮਿਹ ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have decorated myself to meet my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: kee-o singaar milan kay taa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਹੁ ਗੈਬੁ ਸਗਲ  ਘਟ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਲੇਹੁ ਿਬਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: But the Lord, the Life of the Word, the Sustainer of the Universe, has not come tomeet me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har na milay jagjeevan gusaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ  ਪੁਕਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥੭॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The Lord is my Husband, and I am the Lord's bride.
lines.transliteration: har mayro pir ha-o har kee bahuree-aa.

lines.english: The Lord is so great, and I am infinitesimally small. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam baday mai tanak lahuree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dhan pir aykai sang basayraa. The bride and the Groom dwell together.
They lie upon the one bed, but their union is difficult. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sayj ayk pai milan duhayraa. ||2||

lines.english: Dhan suhaagan jo pee-a bh aavai. Blessed is the soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

Says Kabeer, she shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||3||8||30|| Awsw sRI kbIr jIau ky dupdy  (483-13) aasaa saree kabeer jee-o kay dupd ay Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (483-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer fir janam na aavai. ||3||8||30||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the Diamond of the Lord pierces the diamond of my mind, the fickle mindwaving in the wind is easily absorbed into Him.
lines.transliteration: heerai heeraa bayDh pavan man sehjay rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: This Diamond fills all with Divine Light; through the True Guru's Teachings, I havefound Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sagal jot in heerai bayDh ee sat gur bachnee mai paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The sermon of the Lord is the unstruck, endless song.
lines.transliteration: har kee kathaa anaahad baanee.

lines.english: Becoming a swan, one recognizes the Diamond of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hans hu-ay heeraa lay-ay pachhaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have seen such a Diamond, permeating and pervading the world.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer heeraa as daykh i-o jag mah rahaa samaa-ee.

lines.english: The hidden diamond became visible, when the Guru revealed it to me. ||2||1||31|| Awsw ] (483-17) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: guptaa heeraa pargat bh a-i-o jab gur gam d ee-aa d ikhaa-ee. ||2||1||31||

lines.english: My first wife, ignorance, was ugly, of low social status and bad character; she was evilin my home, and in her parents' home.
lines.transliteration: pahilee karoop kujaat kulakh nee saahurai pay-ee-ai buree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My present bride, divine understanding, is beautiful, wise and well-behaved; I havetaken her to my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ab kee saroop sujaan sulakhnee sehjay ud ar Dh aree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ  ਬੇਿਧ ਪਵਨ  ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: It has turned out so well, that my first wife has died.
lines.transliteration: bhalee saree mu-ee mayree pahilee baree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਇਿਨ  ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਨੀ  ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: May she, whom I have now married, live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jug jug jeeva-o mayree ab kee Dharee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, when the younger bride came, the elder one lost her husband.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jab lahuree aa-ee badee kaa suhaag tari-o.

lines.english: The younger bride is with me now, and the elder one has taken another husband. ||2||2||32|| pMnw 484 Awsw ] (484-1) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: lahuree sang bha-ee ab mayrai jayth ee a-or Dh ari-o. ||2||2||32||

lines.english: My daughter-in-law was first called Dhannia, the woman of wealth,
lines.transliteration: mayree bahuree-aa ko Dhanee-aa naa-o.
lay raakhi-o raam janee-aa naa-o. ||1|| but now she is called Raam-jannia, the servant of the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: These shaven-headed saints have ruined my house.
lines.transliteration: inH mundee-an mayraa ghar Dh unDh raavaa.

lines.english: They have caused my son to start chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bitvahi raam ram-oo-aa laavaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O mother:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu mayree maa-ee.

lines.english: Awsw ] (484-3) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: inH mundee-an mayree jaat gavaa-ee. ||2||3||33|| these shaven-headed saints have done away with my low social status. ||2||3||33||

lines.english: Stay, stay, O daughter-in-law - do not cover your face with a veil.
lines.transliteration: rahu rahu ree bahuree-aa ghoongh at jin kaadh ai.

lines.english: In the end, this shall not bring you even half a shell. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ant kee baar lahaigee na aadh ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The one before you used to veil her face;
lines.transliteration: ghoongh at kaadh  ga-ee t ayree aagai.
un kee gail tohi jin laagai. ||1|| do not follow in her footsteps. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਹੁ ਰਹੁ ਰੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ  ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਿਜਿਨ ਕਾਢੈ  ॥
lines.english: The only merit in veiling your face is
lines.transliteration: ghoongh at kaadh ay kee ihai badaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਲਹੈਗੀ  ਨ ਆਢੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: din das paaNch bahoo bh alay aa-ee. ||2|| that for a few days, people will say, "What a noble bride has come". ||2||

lines.english: Your veil shall be true only if
lines.transliteration: ghoongh at tayro t a-o par saachai.
har gun gaa-ay koodeh ar naachai. ||3|| you skip, dance and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the soul-bride shall win,
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer bahoo t ab jeet ai.

lines.english: Awsw ] (484-7) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavat janam bit eetai. ||4||1||34|| only if she passes her life singing the Lord's Praises. ||4||1||34||

lines.english: I would rather be cut apart by a saw, than have You turn Your back on me.
lines.transliteration: karvat bh alaa na karvat t ayree.

lines.english: Hug me close, and listen to my prayer. ||1||
lines.transliteration: laag galay sun bintee mayree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਕੂਦਿਹ  ਅਰੁ ਨਾਚੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to You - please, turn Your face to me, O Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree mukh fayr pi-aaray.

lines.english: Why have You turned Your back to me? Why have You killed me? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karvat day mo ka-o kaahay ka-o maaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Even if You cut my body apart, I shall not pull my limbs away from You.
lines.transliteration: ja-o tan cheereh ang na mora-o.

lines.english: Even if my body falls, I shall not break my bonds of love with You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pind parai ta-o pareet  na tora-o. ||2||

lines.english: Between You and I, there is no other.
lines.transliteration: ham tum beech bh a-i-o nahee ko-ee.

lines.english: You are the Husband Lord, and I am the soul-bride. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tumeh so kant  naar ham so-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O people:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਵਟੁ ਦੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Awsw ] (484-10) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: ab tumree part eet na ho-ee. ||4||2||35|| now, I place no reliance in you. ||4||2||35||

lines.english: No one knows the secret of God, the Cosmic Weaver.
lines.transliteration: koree ko kaahoo maram na jaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰਿਹ  ਅੰਗੁ  ਨ ਮੋਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: He has stretched out the fabric of the whole world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh jag aan t anaa-i-o t aanaaN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When you listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,
lines.transliteration: jab tum sun lay bayd  puraanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਬੀਚੁ ਭਇਓ  ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab ham it nak pasri-o t aanaaN. ||1|| you shall know that the whole world is only a small piece of His woven fabric. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨਾਿਰ  ਹਮ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Dharan akaas kee kargah banaa-ee. He has made the earth and sky His loom.
Upon it, He moves the two bobbins of the sun and the moon. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj d u-ay saath chalaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Placing my feet together, I have accomplished one thing - my mind is pleased with that Weaver.
lines.transliteration: paa-ee jor baat ik keenee t ah taaNtee man maanaaN.

lines.english: I have come to understand my own home, and recognize the Lord within my heart.||3||
lines.transliteration: jolaahay ghar apnaa cheenHaaN ghat hee raam pachh aanaaN. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, when my body workshop breaks,
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer kaargah t oree.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਰੀ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Awsw ] (484-14) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: sootai soot  milaa-ay koree. ||4||3||36|| the Weaver shall blend my thread with His thread. ||4||3||36||

lines.english: With filth within the heart, even if one bathes at sacred places of pilgrimage, still, heshall not go to heaven.
lines.transliteration: antar mail jay t irath naavai t is baikunth  na jaanaaN.

lines.english: Nothing is gained by trying to please others - the Lord cannot be fooled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lok pateen ay kachh oo na hovai naahee raam ayaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਿਨ ਲੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Worship the One Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: poojahu raam ayk hee dayvaa.

lines.english: The true cleansing bath is service to the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saachaa naavan gur kee sayvaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If salvation can be obtained by bathing in water, then what about the frog, which is always bathing in water?
lines.transliteration: jal kai majan jay gat hovai nit  nit mayNduk naaveh.

lines.english: As is the frog, so is that mortal; he is reincarnated, over and over again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaisay mayNduk taisay o-ay nar fir fir jonee aavahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਈ  ਜੋਿਰ ਬਾਤ ਇਕ ਕੀਨੀ  ਤਹ ਤਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
lines.english: If the hard-hearted sinner dies in Benaares, he cannot escape hell.
lines.transliteration: manhu kathor marai baanaaras narak na baaNchi-aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਲਾਹੇ  ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਚੀਨ  ਘਟ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ॥੩॥
lines.english: And even if the Lord's Saint dies in the cursed land of Haramba, still, he saves all hisfamily. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kaa sant marai haarh ambai t a saglee sain t araa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Where there is neither day nor night, and neither Vedas nor Shaastras, there, theFormless Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: dinas na rain bayd  nahee saast ar tahaa basai nirankaaraa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, meditate on Him, O mad-men of the world. ||4||4||37|| pMnw 485 <> siqgur pRswid ] (485-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Awsw bwxI sRI nwmdyau jI kI (485-1) aasaa banee saree naamd ay-o jee kee Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Naam Dayv Jee:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer nar tiseh Dh i-aavahu baavri-aa sansaaraa. ||4||4||37||

lines.english: In the one and in the many, He is pervading and permeating; wherever I look, there He is.
lines.transliteration: ayk anayk bi-aapak poorak jat d aykh-a-u t at so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ  ਿਬਆਪਕ  ਪੂਰਕ  ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The marvellous image of Maya is so fascinating; how few understand this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa chitar bachit ar bimohit  birlaa boojh ai ko-ee. ||1||

lines.english: God is everything, God is everything. Without God, there is nothing at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh gobind  hai sabh  gobind  hai gobind  bin nahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: As one thread holds hundreds and thousands of beads, He is woven into His creation.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: soot ayk man  sat sahaNs jaisay ot  pot parabh  so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਿਣ ਸਤ ਸਹੰਸ  ਜੈਸੇ ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The waves of the water, the foam and bubbles, are not distinct from the water.
lines.transliteration: jal tarang ar fayn bud budaa jal t ay bh inn na ho-ee.

lines.english: This manifested world is the playful game of the Supreme Lord God; reflecting uponit, we find that it is not different from Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ih parpanch paarbarahm kee leelaa bichrat aan na ho-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ  ਅਰੁ ਫੇਨ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ  ਜਲ ਤੇ ਿਭੰਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: False doubts and dream objects - man believes them to be true.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa bharam ar supan manorath sat  padaarath jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਿਬਚਰਤ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has instructed me to try to do good deeds, and my awakened mind hasaccepted this. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sukarit mansaa gur upd aysee jaagat  hee man maani-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਸਿਤ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, see the Creation of the Lord, and reflect upon it in your heart.
lines.transliteration: kahat naamd ay-o har kee rachnaa d aykhhu rid ai beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤ  ਮਨਸਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, and deep within the very nucleus of all, is the One Lord. ||4||1|| Awsw ] (485-7) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar sarab nirant ar kayval ayk muraaree. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Bringing the pitcher, I fill it with water, to bathe the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aaneelay kumbh bh araa-eelay ood ak thaakur ka-o isnaan kara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਕੇਵਲ  ਏਕ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: But 4.2 million species of beings are in the water - how can I use it for the Lord, OSiblings of Destiny? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ba-i-aalees lakh jee jal meh hot ay beeth al bhailaa kaa-ay kara-o. ||1||

lines.english: Wherever I go, the Lord is there.
lines.transliteration: jatar jaa-o t at beeth al bhailaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੀਲੇ  ਕੁੰਭ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ  ਊਦਕ  ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: He continually plays in supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand karay sad kaylaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਇਆਲੀਸ  ਲਖ ਜੀ ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਹੋਤੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ  ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ  ਕਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I bring flowers to weave a garland, in worshipful adoration of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aaneelay fool paro-eelay maalaa thaakur kee ha-o pooj kara-o.

lines.english: But the bumble bee has already sucked out the fragrance - how can I use it for theLord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||
lines.transliteration: pahilay baas la-ee hai bhavrah beeth al bhailaa kaa-ay kara-o. ||2||

lines.english: I carry milk and cook it to make pudding, with which to feed the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aaneelay dooDh  reeDh aa-eelay kh eeraN thaakur ka-o naivayd  kara-o.

lines.english: But the calf has already tasted the milk - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||3||
lines.transliteration: pahilay dooDh  bitaari-o bachh rai beeth al bhailaa kaa-ay kara-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੀਲੇ  ਫੂਲ ਪਰੋਈਲੇ  ਮਾਲਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੀ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is here, the Lord is there; without the Lord, there is no world at all.
lines.transliteration: eebhai beeth al oobh ai beeth al beeth al bin sansaar nahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੇ  ਬਾਸੁ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਹ  ਬੀਠਲ  ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ  ਕਰਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are totally permeating and pervading all places andinterspaces. ||4||2|| Awsw ] (485-12) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar naamaa paran vai poor rahi-o t ooN sarab mahee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੀਲੇ  ਦੂਧੁ ਰੀਧਾਈਲੇ  ਖੀਰੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਉ ਨੈਵੇਦੁ  ਕਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is the yardstick, and my tongue is the scissors.
lines.transliteration: man mayro gaj jihbaa mayree kaatee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੇ  ਦੂਧੁ ਿਬਟਾਿਰਓ  ਬਛਰੈ  ਬੀਠਲੁ  ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ  ਕਰਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I measure it out and cut off the noose of death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: map map kaata-o jam kee faasee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਈਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ  ਊਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ  ਬੀਠਲ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.english: What do I have to do with social status? What do I have to with ancestry?
lines.transliteration: kahaa kara-o jaatee kah kara-o paat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮਾ  ਪਰ੍ਣਵੈ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ  ਮਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam ko naam japa-o din raat ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I dye myself in the color of the Lord, and sew what has to be sewn.
lines.transliteration: raaNgan raaNga-o seevan seeva-o.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, I cannot live, even for a moment. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin gharee-a na jeeva-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਪ ਮਿਪ ਕਾਟਉ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I perform devotional worship, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kara-o har kay gun gaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ  ਜਾਤੀ  ਕਹ ਕਰਉ  ਪਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar apnaa kh asam Dh i-aava-o. ||3||

lines.english: My needle is gold, and my thread is silver.
lines.transliteration: su-inay kee soo-ee rupay kaa Dhaagaa.

lines.english: Naam Dayv's mind is attached to the Lord. ||4||3|| Awsw ] (485-16) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: naamay kaa chit har sa-o laagaa. ||4||3||

lines.english: The snake sheds its skin, but does not lose its venom.
lines.transliteration: saap kunch chhodai bikh  nahee chh aadai.

lines.english: The heron appears to be meditating, but it is concentrating on the water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: udak maahi jaisay bag Dh i-aan maadai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Why do you practice meditation and chanting,
lines.transliteration: kaahay ka-o keejai Dhi-aan japannaa.
jab tay suDh  naahee man apnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. when your mind is not pure? ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨੇ  ਕੀ ਸੂਈ ਰੁਪੇ ਕਾ ਧਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: That man who feeds like a lion,
lines.transliteration: singhach bh ojan jo nar jaanai.
aisay hee thagd ay-o bakh aanai. ||2|| is called the god of thieves. ||2||

lines.english: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master has settled my inner conflicts. pMnw 486
lines.transliteration: naamay kay su-aamee laahi lay jhagraa.

lines.english: Drink in the sublime elixir of the Lord, O deceitful one. ||3||4|| Awsw ] (486-1) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in pee-o ray dagraa. ||3||4||

lines.english: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God, dislikes other desires.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm je cheenHsee aasaa tay na bh aavsee.

lines.english: He focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotional worship, and keeps his mindfree of anxiety. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raamaa bhagt ah chayt ee-alay achint  man raakh see. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਜ ਚੀਨਸੀ  ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨ ਭਾਵਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, how will you cross over the world-ocean, if you are filled with the water ofcorruption?
lines.transliteration: kaisay man tarhigaa ray sansaar saagar bikh ai ko banaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਾ  ਭਗਤਹ  ਚੇਤੀਅਲੇ  ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the falseness of Maya, you have gone astray, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee maa-i-aa d aykh kai bh oolaa ray manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਤਰਿਹਗਾ  ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਿਬਖੈ ਕੋ ਬਨਾ ॥
lines.english: You have given me birth in the house of a calico-printer, but I have found the Teachings of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: chheepay kay gh ar janam d ailaa gur upd ays bh ailaa.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saint, Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||2||5|| Awsw bwxI sRI rivdws jIau kI  (486-5) aasaa banee saree ravid aas jee-o kee Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Ravi Daas Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (486-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad .
