One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: santeh kai parsaad  naamaa har bh aytulaa. ||2||5||

lines.english: The deer, the fish, the bumble bee, the moth and the elephant are destroyed, eachfor a single defect.
lines.transliteration: marig meen bharing pat ang kunchar ayk d okh binaas.

lines.punjabi: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਘਿਰ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਦੈਲਾ  ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
lines.english: So the one who is filled with the five incurable vices - what hope is there for him?||1||
lines.transliteration: panch dokh  asaaDh  jaa meh t aa kee kayt ak aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹ  ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਨਾਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭੇਟੁਲਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: O Lord, he is in love with ignorance.
lines.transliteration: maaDho abid i-aa hit  keen.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: His lamp of clear wisdom has grown dim. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bibayk deep maleen. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The creeping creatures live thoughtless lives, and cannot discriminate between goodand evil.
lines.transliteration: tarigad  jon achayt  sambh av punn paap asoch.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ  ਜਾ ਮਿਹ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ  ਆਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and yet, they keep company with the low. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maanukhaa avt aar dulabh  tihee sangat  poch. ||2||

lines.english: Wherever the beings and creatures are, they are born according to the karma of theirpast actions.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant jahaa jahaa lag karam kay bas jaa-ay.

lines.english: The noose of death is unforgiving, and it shall catch them; it cannot be warded off.||3||
lines.transliteration: kaal faas abaDh laagay kachh  na chalai upaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: O servant Ravi Daas, dispel your sorrow and doubt, and know that Guru-givenspiritual wisdom is the penance of penances.
lines.transliteration: ravidaas d aas ud aas taj bharam t apan t ap gur gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਗਦ  ਜੋਿਨ ਅਚੇਤ  ਸੰਭਵ  ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੋਚ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Destroyer of the fears of Your humble devotees, make me supremely blissfulin the end. ||4||1|| Awsw ] (486-10) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  jan bh ai haran parmaanand  karahu nid aan. ||4||1||

lines.english: Your Saints are Your body, and their company is Your breath of life.
lines.transliteration: sant t ujhee tan sangat  paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਲਗੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕੇ ਬਿਸ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By the True Guru-given spiritual wisdom, I know the Saints as the gods of gods. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur gi-aan jaanai sant  dayvaa d ayv. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਫਾਸ ਅਬਧ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਕਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਉਪਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, God of gods, grant me the Society of the Saints, the sublime essence of theSaints' conversation, and the Love of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jI) sant chee sangat  sant kathaa ras. sant  paraym maajh ai deejai d ayvaa d ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ  ਤਜੁ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਤਪਨ  ਤਪੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ॥
lines.english: The Character of the Saints, the lifestyle of the Saints, and the service of the servantof the Saints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant aachran  sant cho maarag sant  cha olahg olahgn ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ  ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਨਦਾਨ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I ask for these, and for one thing more - devotional worship, which shall fulfill mydesires.
lines.transliteration: a-or ik maaga-o bhagat  chint aaman .

lines.english: Do not show me the wicked sinners. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janee likh aavahu asant  paapee san . ||3||

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, he alone is wise, who knows this:
lines.transliteration: ravidaas bh anai jo jaan ai so jaan .

lines.english: Awsw ] (486-14) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: sant anaNteh ant ar naahee. ||4||2|| there is no difference between the Saints and the Infinite Lord. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਚੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਤ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ॥
lines.english: You are sandalwood, and I am the poor castor oil plant, dwelling close to you.
lines.transliteration: tum chand an ham irand baapuray sang t umaaray baasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਮਾਝੈ ਦੀਜੈ  ਦੇਵਾ  ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: From a lowly tree, I have become exalted; Your fragrance, Your exquisite fragrance now permeates me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: neech rookh t ay ooch bh a-ay hai ganDh  suganDh  nivaasaa. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of the company of Your Saints;
lines.transliteration: maaDha-o sat sangat  saran t umHaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਆਚਰਣ  ਸੰਤ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਸੰਤ ਚ ਓਲਗ  ਓਲਗਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am worthless, and You are so benevolent. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham a-ugan tumH upkaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are the white and yellow threads of silk, and I am like a poor worm.
lines.transliteration: tum makh -tool supayd  sapee-al ham bapuray jas keeraa.

lines.english: O Lord, I seek to live in the Company of the Saints, like the bee with its honey. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  mil rahee-ai maaDh a-o jaisay maDh up makh eeraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵਦਾਸੁ  ਭਣੈ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my birth is low as well.
lines.transliteration: jaatee ochh aa paat ee ochh aa ochh aa janam hamaaraa.

lines.english: I have not performed the service of the Lord, the Lord, says Ravi Daas the cobbler.||3||3|| Awsw ] (486-18) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam kee sayv na keenee kahi ravidaas chamaaraa. ||3||3||

lines.english: What would it matter, if my body were cut into pieces?
lines.transliteration: kahaa bha-i-o ja-o t an bh a-i-o chh in chh in.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦਨ  ਹਮ ਇਰੰਡ  ਬਾਪੁਰੇ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਬਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: If I were to lose Your Love, Lord, then Your humble servant would be afraid. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paraym jaa-ay ta-o darpai t ayro jan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚ ਰੂਖ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ  ਿਨਵਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your lotus feet are the home of my mind.
lines.transliteration: tujheh charan arbind  bhavan man.

lines.english: Drinking in Your Nectar, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paan karat paa-i-o paa-i-o raam-ee-aa Dh an. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Prosperity, adversity, property and wealth are just Maya. pMnw 487
lines.transliteration: sampat bipat  patal maa-i-aa Dh an.

lines.english: Your humble servant is not engrossed in them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa meh magan hot  na tayro jan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਮਗਨ  ਹੋਤ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your humble servant is tied by the rope of Your Love.
lines.transliteration: paraym kee jayvree baaDhi-o t ayro jan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ  ਬਾਿਧਓ  ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨ ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, what benefit would I get by escaping from it? ||3||4|| Awsw ] (487-2) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas chootibo kavan gun. ||3||4||

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray.
lines.transliteration: har har har har har har haray.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, the humble are carried across to salvation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har simrat jan ga-ay nist ar taray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Lord's Name, Kabeer became famous and respected.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kabeer ujaagar.

lines.english: The accounts of his past incarnations were torn up. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kaatay kaagar. ||1||

lines.english: Because of Naam Dayv's devotion, the Lord drank the milk he offered.
lines.transliteration: nimat naamd ay-o d ooDh pee-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He shall not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation into the world again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ta-o jag janam sankat nahee aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Servant Ravi Daas is imbued with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: jan ravidaas raam rang raat aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he shall not have to go to hell. ||3||5||
lines.transliteration: i-o gur parsaad narak nahee jaat aa. ||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਜਗ ਜਨਮ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: How does the puppet of clay dance?
lines.transliteration: maatee ko putraa kaisay nachat  hai.

lines.english: He looks and listens, hears and speaks, and runs around. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daykh ai daykhai sunai bolai d a-ori-o firat  hai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਨਰਕ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: When he acquires something, he is inflated with ego.
lines.transliteration: jab kachh paavai t ab garab karat  hai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਟੀ  ਕੋ ਪੁਤਰਾ  ਕੈਸੇ ਨਚਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: But when his wealth is gone, then he cries and bewails. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa ga-ee tab rovan lagat  hai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਉਿਰਓ ਿਫਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In thought, word and deed, he is attached to the sweet and tangy flavors.
lines.transliteration: man bach karam ras kaseh lubhaanaa.

lines.english: When he dies, no one knows where he has gone. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binas ga-i-aa jaa-ay kahoo-aN samaanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਗਰਬੁ  ਕਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, the world is just a dramatic play, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas baajee jag bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਗਈ ਤਬ ਰੋਵਨੁ ਲਗਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have enshrined love for the Lord, the star of the show. ||3||6|| Awsw bwxI Bgq DMny jI kI  (487-9) aasaa banee bh agat Dhannay jee kee Aasaa, The Word Of Devotee Dhanna Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (487-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: baajeegar sa-o mohi pareet ban aa-ee. ||3||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰ੍ਮ ਰਸ ਕਸਿਹ  ਲੁਭਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I wandered through countless incarnations, but mind, body and wealth never remainstable.
lines.transliteration: bharmat  firat baho janam bilaanay t an man Dh an nahee Dh eeray.

lines.english: Attached to, and stained by the poisons of sexual desire and greed, the mind hasforgotten the jewel of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laalach bikh kaam lubaDh  raataa man bisray parabh  heeray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The poisonous fruit seems sweet to the demented mind, which does not know the difference between good and evil.
lines.transliteration: bikh fal meeth  lagay man ba-uray chaar bichaar na jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ  ਸਉ ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥੩॥੬॥
lines.english: Turning away from virtue, his love for other things increases, and he weaves againthe web of birth and death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun tay pareet  badh ee an bh aaNtee janam maran fir t aani-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਧੰਨੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He does not know the way to the Lord, who dwells within his heart; burning in thetrap, he is caught by the noose of death.
lines.transliteration: jugat jaan nahee rid ai nivaasee jalat  jaal jam fanDh  paray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਿਫਰਤ  ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ  ਿਬਲਾਨੇ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Gathering the poisonous fruits, he fills his mind with them, and he forgets God, theSupreme Being, from his mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bikh fal sanch bh aray man aisay param purakh  parabh  man bisray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚ  ਿਬਖੁ ਕਾਮ ਲੁਬਧ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਿਬਸਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹੀਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has given the wealth of spiritual wisdom; practicing meditation, the mindbecomes one with Him.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan parvays gureh Dhan d ee-aa Dh i-aan maan man ayk ma-ay.

lines.english: Embracing loving devotional worship for the Lord, I have come to know peace;satisfied and satiated, I have been liberated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  maanee sukh  jaani-aa t aripat  aghaanay mukat  bha-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਫਲ ਮੀਠ ਲਗੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ  ਚਾਰ ਿਬਚਾਰ  ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who is filled with the Divine Light, recognizes the undeceivable Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jot samaa-ay samaanee jaa kai achh lee parabh  pehchaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਤੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਢੀ ਅਨ ਭਤੀ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਿਫਿਰ ਤਾਿਨਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhannai Dh an paa-i-aa Dh arneeDhar mil jan sant  samaani-aa. ||4||1|| Dhanna has obtained the Lord, the Sustainer of the World, as his wealth; meeting thehumble Saints, he merges in the Lord. ||4||1|| mhlw 5 ] (487-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਜਾਿਨ  ਨਹੀ ਿਰਦੈ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਜਲਤ  ਜਾਲ  ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv's mind was absorbed into God, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind.
lines.transliteration: gobind gobind  gobind  sang naamd ay-o man leen aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਫਲ ਸੰਿਚ ਭਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੇ ਪਰਮ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਨ ਿਬਸਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The calico-printer, worth half a shell, became worth millions. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aadh d aam ko chh eepro ho-i-o laakh eenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਪਰ੍ਵੇਸੁ  ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਏਕ ਮਏ ॥
lines.english: Abandoning weaving and stretching thread, Kabeer enshrined love for the Lord's lotusfeet.
lines.transliteration: bunnaa tannaa t i-aag kai pareet  charan kabeeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਾਨੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਨੇ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: A weaver from a lowly family, he became an ocean of excellence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: neech kulaa jolaaharaa bha-i-o guneey gaheeraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਨੀ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਛਲੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਿਹਚਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Ravi Daas, who used to carry dead cows every day, renounced the world of Maya.
lines.transliteration: ravidaas dh uvant aa dh or neet  tin ti-aagee maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: He became famous in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and obtained theBlessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pargat ho-aa saaDhsang har d arsan paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Sain, the barber, the village drudge, became famous in each and every house.
lines.transliteration: sain naa-ee butkaaree-aa oh gh ar ghar suni-aa.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God dwelled in his heart, and he was counted among the devotees. ||3|| pMnw 488
lines.transliteration: hirday vasi-aa paarbarahm bh agtaa meh gani-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Hearing this, Dhanna the Jaat applied himself to devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: ih biDh sun kai jaatro uth  bhagtee laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਸੁਿਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਟਰੋ  ਉਿਠ ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe met him personally; Dhanna was so very blessed. ||4||2||
lines.transliteration: milay partakh  gusaa-ee-aa Dh annaa vadbh aagaa. ||4||2||

lines.english: O my consciousness, why don't you remain conscious of the Merciful Lord? How can you recognize any other?
lines.transliteration: ray chit chayt as kee na d a-yaal d amod ar bibahi na jaanas ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਿਚਤ  ਚੇਤਿਸ  ਕੀ ਨ ਦਯਾਲ  ਦਮੋਦਰ  ਿਬਬਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਨਿਸ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You may run around the whole universe, but that alone happens which the CreatorLord does. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay Dhaaveh barahmand kh and ka-o kart aa karai so ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਧਾਵਿਹ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਖੰਡ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the water of the mother's womb, He fashioned the body with ten gates.
lines.transliteration: jannee kayray udar ud ak meh pind kee-aa d as du-aaraa.

lines.english: He gives it sustenance, and preserves it in fire - such is my Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: day-ay ahaar agan meh raakh ai aisaa kh asam hamaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਨੀ  ਕੇਰੇ ਉਦਰ  ਉਦਕ  ਮਿਹ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ  ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The mother turtle is in the water, and her babies are out of the water. She has nowings to protect them, and no milk to feed them.
lines.transliteration: kummee jal maahi tan t is baahar pankh  kheer tin naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਇ ਅਹਾਰੁ ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਿਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਐਸਾ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, the Fascinating Lord takes care ofthem. See this, and understand it in your mind||2||
lines.transliteration: pooran parmaanand manohar samajh  daykh man maahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁੰਮੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਿਹ  ਤਨ ਿਤਸੁ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਪੰਖ ਖੀਰੁ ਿਤਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The worm lies hidden under the stone - there is no way for him to escape.
lines.transliteration: paakhan  keet gupat  ho-ay raht aa taa cho maarag naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ਮਨੋਹਰ  ਸਮਿਝ  ਦੇਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Dhanna, the Perfect Lord takes care of him. Fear not, O my soul. ||3||3|| Awsw syK PrId jIau kI bwxI  (488-7) aasaa saykh fareed  jee-o kee ban ee Aasaa, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (488-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahai Dhannaa pooran t aahoo ko mat  ray jee-a daraaNhee. ||3||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖਿਣ  ਕੀਟੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਹੋਇ ਰਹਤਾ  ਤਾ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are true, whose love for God is deep and heart-felt.
lines.transliteration: dilahu muhabat  jinH say-ee sachi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਧੰਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ  ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਮਤ ਰੇ ਜੀਅ  ਡਰਹੀ  ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who have one thing in their heart, and something else in their mouth, are judged to be false. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jinH man hor mukh hor se kaaNdhay kachi-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with love for the Lord, are delighted by His Vision.
lines.transliteration: ratay isak kh udaa-ay rang d eedaar kay.

lines.english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are a burden on the earth.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: visri-aa jinH naam tay bh u-ay bh aar thee-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਹੋਰੁ ਿਸ ਕਢੇ  ਕਿਚਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those whom the Lord attaches to the hem of His robe, are the true dervishes at HisDoor.
lines.transliteration: aap lee-ay larh laa-ay d ar darvays say.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤੇ ਇਸਕ  ਖੁਦਾਇ ਰੰਿਗ ਦੀਦਾਰ  ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them, and fruitful is their coming into the world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin Dh an jan aydee maa-o aa-ay safal say. ||2||

lines.english: O Lord, Sustainer and Cherisher, You are infinite, unfathomable and endless.
lines.transliteration: parvardagaar apaar agam bay-ant  too.

lines.english: Those who recognize the True Lord - I kiss their feet. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jinaa pachhaat aa sach chummaa pair mooN. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਲੀਏ  ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਇ  ਦਿਰ ਦਰਵੇਸ  ਸੇ ॥
lines.english: I seek Your Protection - You are the Forgiving Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayree panah kh udaa-ay t oo bakh sandgee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ  ਮਾਉ ਆਏ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਸੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please, bless Shaykh Fareed with the bounty of Your meditative worship. ||4||1|| Awsw ] (488-12) aasaa. Aasaa:
lines.transliteration: saykh fareed ai khair deejai band agee. ||4||1||

lines.english: Says Shaykh Fareed, O my dear friend, attach yourself to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bolai saykh fareed  pi-aaray alah lagay.

lines.english: This body shall turn to dust, and its home shall be a neglected graveyard. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih tan hosee kh aak nimaan ee gor gh aray. ||1||

lines.english: You can meet the Lord today, O Shaykh Fareed, if you restrain your bird-like desireswhich keep your mind in turmoil. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aaj milaavaa saykh fareed  taakim koonjarh ee-aa manhu machind -rhee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If I had known that I was to die, and not return again,
lines.transliteration: jay jaanaa mar jaa-ee-ai gh um na aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: I would not have ruined myself by clinging to the world of falsehood. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee dunee-aa lag na aap vanj aa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: So speak the Truth, in righteousness, and do not speak falsehood.
lines.transliteration: bolee-ai sach Dharam jh ooth na bolee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖਾਕ ਿਨਮਾਣੀ  ਗੋਰ ਘਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The disciple ought to travel the route, pointed out by the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo gur dasai vaat mureed aa jolee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੁ ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ  ਟਾਿਕਮ  ਕੂੰਜੜੀਆ  ਮਨਹੁ ਮਿਚੰਦੜੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seeing the youths being carried across, the hearts of the beautiful young soul-brides are encouraged.
lines.transliteration: chhail langh anday paar goree man Dh eeri-aa.

lines.english: Those who side with the glitter of gold, are cut down with a saw. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kanchan vannay paasay kalvat cheeri-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈਐ  ਘੁਿਮ ਨ ਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Shaykh, no one's life is permanent in this world.
lines.transliteration: saykh haiyaat ee jag na ko-ee thir rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਲਿਗ  ਨ ਆਪੁ  ਵਞਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That seat, upon which we now sit - many others sat on it and have since departed.||5||
lines.transliteration: jis aasan ham baith ay kayt ay bais ga-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਲੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ  ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: As the swallows appear in the month of Katik, forest fires in the month of Chayt, andlightning in Saawan,
lines.transliteration: katik kooNjaaN chayt  da-o saavan  bijulee-aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ਵਾਟ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ  ਜੋਲੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: see-aalay sohandee-aaN pir gal baahrh ee-aaN. ||6|| and as the bride's arms adorn her husband's neck in winter;||6||

lines.punjabi: ਛੈਲ ਲੰਘੰਦੇ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਗੋਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Just so, the transitory human bodies pass away. Reflect upon this in your mind.
lines.transliteration: chalay chalanhaar vichaaraa lay-ay mano.

lines.english: It takes six months to form the body, but it breaks in an instant. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gandhayd i-aaN chhi-a maah t urhandi-aa hik kh ino. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਖ ਹੈਯਾਤੀ  ਜਿਗ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਿਥਰੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Fareed, the earth asks the sky, "Where have the boatmen gone?"
lines.transliteration: jimee puchhai asmaan fareed aa kh ayvat kinn ga-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਆਸਿਣ  ਹਮ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੈਿਸ ਗਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Some have been cremated, and some lie in their graves; their souls are suffering rebukes. ||8||2|| pMnw 489 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (489-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu gUjrI mhlw 1 caupdy Gru 1 ] (489-3) raag goojree mehlaa 1 cha-upday gh ar 1. Raag Goojaree, First Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House:
lines.transliteration: jaalan goraaN naal ulaamay jee-a sahay. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I would make Your Name the sandalwood, and my mind the stone to rub it on;
lines.transliteration: tayraa naam karee chann aathee-aa jay man ursaa ho-ay.
karnee kungoo jay ralai gh at ant ar poojaa ho-ay. ||1|| for saffron, I would offer good deeds; thus, I perform worship and adoration within my heart. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਚਨਣਾਠੀਆ  ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਉਰਸਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Perform worship and adoration by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord;without the Name, there is no worship and adoration. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: poojaa keechai naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai bin naavai pooj na ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਕੁੰਗੂ ਜੇ ਰਲੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: If one were to wash his heart inwardly, like the stone idol which is washed on theoutside,
lines.transliteration: baahar dayv pakh aalee-ah jay man Dh ovai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕੀਚੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jooth lahai jee-o maajee-ai mokh  pa-i-aan aa ho-ay. ||2|| his filth would be removed, his soul would be cleansed, and he would be liberatedwhen he departs. ||2||

lines.english: Even beasts have value, as they eat grass and give milk.
lines.transliteration: pasoo mileh chang-aa-ee-aa kharh  khaaveh amrit  deh.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਦੇਵ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਿਹ  ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal's life is cursed, as are the actions he performs. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam vihoonay aad mee Dh arig jeevan  karam karayhi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਿਠ ਲਹੈ ਜੀਉ  ਮਾਜੀਐ  ਮੋਖ ਪਇਆਣਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord is hear at hand - do not think that He is far away. He always cherishes us,and remembers us.
lines.transliteration: nayrhaa hai d oor na jaan i-ahu nit  saaray samHaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੂ ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ਖੜੁ ਖਾਵਿਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਦੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: Whatever He gives us, we eat; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||4||1|| gUjrI mhlw 1 ] (489-8) goojree mehlaa 1. Goojaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo dayvai so kh aavnaa kaho naanak saachaa hay. ||4||1||

lines.english: From the lotus of Vishnu's navel, Brahma was born; He chanted the Vedas with a melodious voice.
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal t ay barahmaa upjay bayd  parheh mukh  kanth  savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨੇੜਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਿਣਅਹੁ ਿਨਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੰਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: He could not find the Lord's limits, and he remained in the darkness of coming andgoing. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa ko ant  na jaa-ee lakh -naa aavat  jaat rahai gubaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Why should I forget my Beloved? He is the support of my very breath of life.
lines.transliteration: pareetam ki-o bisrahi mayray paraan  aDhaar.

lines.english: The perfect beings perform devotional worship to Him. The silent sages serve Himthrough the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee bhagat  karahi jan pooray mun jan sayveh gur veechaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਭ  ਕਮਲ  ਤੇ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਉਪਜੇ  ਬੇਦ ਪੜਿਹ  ਮੁਿਖ ਕੰਿਠ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: His lamps are the sun and the moon; the One Light of the Destroyer of ego fills thethree worlds.
lines.transliteration: rav sas deepak jaa kay t aribhavan aykaa jot  muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਲਖਣਾ  ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਰਹੈ ਗੁਬਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh remains immaculately pure, day and night, while the self- willed manmukh is enveloped by the darkness of night. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay so ahinis nirmal manmukh  rain anDh aar. ||2||

lines.english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi are continually in conflict; what can they see with their twoeyes?
lines.transliteration: siDh samaaDh  karahi nit  jhagraa d uhu lochan ki-aa hayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who has the Divine Light within his heart, and is awakened to the melody of theWord of the Shabad - the True Guru settles his conflicts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: antar jot  sabad  Dhun jaagai sat gur jh agar nibayray. ||3||

lines.english: O Lord of angels and men, infinite and unborn, Your True Mansion is incomparable.
lines.transliteration: sur nar naath bay-ant ajonee saachai mahal apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਸਿਸ ਦੀਪਕ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਏਕਾ ਜੋਿਤ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak merges imperceptibly into the Life of the world; shower Your mercy upon him, and save him. ||4||2|| pMnw 490 rwgu gUjrI mhlw 3 Gru 1 (490-1) raag goojree mehlaa 3 ghar 1 Raag Goojaree, Third Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (490-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sahj milay jagjeevan nadar karahu nist aaraa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Dharig ivayhaa jeevn aa jit har pareet  na paa-ay. Cursed is that life, in which the Lord's Love is not obtained.

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਇਵੇਹਾ  ਜੀਵਣਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Cursed is that occupation, in which the Lord is forgotten, and one becomes attached to duality. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit kamm har veesrai d oojai lagai jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਕੰਿਮ ਹਿਰ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: 3) aisaa satgur sayvee-ai manaa jit  sayvi-ai govid  pareet  oopjai avar visar sabh  jaa-ay. Serve such a True Guru, O my mind, that by serving Him, God's Love may be produced, and all others may be forgotten.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਮਨਾ ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਅਵਰ  ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your consciousness shall remain attached to the Lord; there shall be no fear of oldage, and the supreme status shall be obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har saytee chit  geh rahai jaraa kaa bh a-o na hova-ee jeevan pad vee paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਚਤੁ  ਗਿਹ ਰਹੈ ਜਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: A divine peace wells up from God's Love; behold, it comes from devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: gobind pareet  si-o ik sahj upji-aa vaykh  jaisee bh agat banee.

lines.english: When my identity consumed my identical identity, then my mind became immaculately pure, and my light was blended with the Divine Light. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap saytee aap kh aa-i-aa t aa man nirmal ho-aa jot ee jot  sam-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਸਉ ਇਕੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਵੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.english: Without good fortune, such a True Guru cannot be found, no matter how much allmay yearn for Him.
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa aisaa sat gur na paa-ee-ai jay lochai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪੁ  ਖਾਇਆ  ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If the veil of falsehood is removed from within, then lasting peace is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: koorhai kee paal vichahu niklai taa sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, what service can the servant perform for such a True Guru? He should offerhis life, his very soul, to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak aisay satgur kee ki-aa oh sayvak sayvaa karay gur aagai jee-o Dh aray-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਿਲ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਿਨਕਲੈ  ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: If he focuses his consciousness on the Will of the True Guru, then the True GuruHimself will bless him. ||4||1||3|| gUjrI mhlw 3 ] (490-8) goojree mehlaa 3. Goojaree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa chit  karay sat gur aapay kirpaa karay-i. ||4||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਐਸੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਿਕਆ  ਓਹੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਧਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Lord; do not serve anyone else.
lines.transliteration: har kee tum sayvaa karahu d oojee sayvaa karahu na ko-ay jee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: Serving the Lord, you shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires; serving another,your life shall pass away in vain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kee sayvaa tay manhu chind i-aa fal paa-ee-ai d oojee sayvaa janam birthaa jaa-ay jee. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord is my Love, the Lord is my way of life, the Lord is my speech andconversation.
lines.transliteration: har mayree pareet reet  hai har mayree har mayree kathaa kahaanee jee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, my mind is saturated with the Lord's Love; this is what makes up myservice. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad mayraa man bh eejai ayhaa sayv banee jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਇ  ਜੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is my Simritees, the Lord is my Shaastras; the Lord is my relative and theLord is my brother.
lines.transliteration: har mayraa simrit har mayraa saast ar har mayraa banDh ap har mayraa bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਰੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਨੀ  ਜੀ ॥
lines.english: I am hungry for the Lord; my mind is satisfied with the Name of the Lord. The Lord is my relation, my helper in the end. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 3) har kee mai bhookh  laagai har naam mayraa man t ariptai har mayraa saak ant  ho-ay sakhaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵ ਬਨੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, other assets are false. They do not go with the mortal when hedeparts.
lines.transliteration: har bin hor raas koorhee hai chald i-aa naal na jaa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord is my wealth, which shall go with me; wherever I go, it will go. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har mayraa Dhan mayrai saath chaalai jahaa ha-o jaa-o t ah jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who is attached to falsehood is false; false are the deeds he does.
lines.transliteration: so jhooth aa jo jh oothay laagai jh oothay karam kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਭੂਖ ਲਾਗੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਅੰਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, everything happens according to the Will of the Lord; no one has any say in this at all. ||4||2||4|| gUjrI mhlw 3 ] (490-15) goojree mehlaa 3. Goojaree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak har kaa bhaan aa ho-aa kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ee. ||4||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਰਾਿਸ  ਕੂੜੀ ਹੈ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in this age; only theGurmukh obtains it.
lines.transliteration: jug maahi naam dulambh  hai gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਿਥ  ਚਾਲੈ  ਜਹਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਤਹ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Name, no one is liberated; let anyone make other efforts, and see. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai mukat na hova-ee vaykh hu ko vi-upaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਗੈ  ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਹੋਆ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one remainsabsorbed in Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai har man vasai sehjay rahai samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When God instills His fear, a balanced detachment springs up in the mind.
lines.transliteration: jaaN bha-o paa-ay aapn aa bairaag upjai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗ ਮਾਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through this detachment, the Lord is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the Lord.||2||
lines.transliteration: bairaagai tay har paa-ee-ai har si-o rahai samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਿਵਉਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone is liberated, who conquers his mind; Maya does not stick to him again.
lines.transliteration: say-ay mukat je man jin eh fir Dh aat na laagai aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, and obtains the understanding of the three worlds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dasvai d u-aar rahat  karay t aribhavan sojhee paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Guru, one becomes the Guru; behold, His Wondrous Will. pMnw 491
lines.transliteration: naanak gur tay gur ho-i-aa vaykh hu tis kee rajaa-ay.

lines.english: This deed was done by the Creator Lord; one's light merges into the Light. ||4||3||5|| gUjrI mhlw 3 ] (491-1) goojree mehlaa 3. Goojaree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih kaaran kart aa karay jot ee jot  samaa-ay. ||4||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: Everyone chants the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam; but by such chanting, the Lord is notobtained.
lines.transliteration: raam raam sabh ko kahai kahi-ai raam na ho-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, the fruits areobtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee raam man vasai taa fal paavai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਹਐ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One who enshrines love for God within his mind,
lines.transliteration: antar govind  jis laagai pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਰਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har tis kad ay na veesrai har har karahi sad aa man cheet . ||1|| rahaa-o. never forgets the Lord; he continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in hisconscious mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with hypocrisy, who are called saints only for their outward show
lines.transliteration: hirdai jinH kai kapat vasai baahrahu sant  kahaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa mool na chuk-ee ant  ga-ay pachh utaahi. ||2|| - their desires are never satisfied, and they depart grieving in the end. ||2||

lines.english: Although one may bathe at many places of pilgrimage, still, his ego never departs.
lines.transliteration: anayk tirath jay jat an karai t aa ant ar kee ha-umai kad ay na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: That man, whose sense of duality does not depart - the Righteous Judge of Dharmashall punish him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis nar kee dubiDh aa na jaa-ay Dh aram raa-ay t is day-ay sajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That humble being, unto whom God showers His Mercy, obtains Him; how few are theGurmukhs who understand Him.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai so-ee jan paa-ay gurmukh boojh ai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਜੇ ਜਤਨ  ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if one conquers his ego within, then he comes to meet the Lord. ||4||4||6|| gUjrI mhlw 3 ] (491-7) goojree mehlaa 3. Goojaree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vichahu ha-umai maaray taaN har bh aytai so-ee. ||4||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਨਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That humble being who eliminates his ego is at peace; he is blessed with an ever-stable intellect.
lines.transliteration: tis jan saaNt sadaa mat  nihchal jis kaa abh imaan gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: That humble being is immaculately pure, who, as Gurmukh, understands the Lord, and focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so jan nirmal je gurmukh boojh ai har charn ee chit  laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੇ ਤ ਹਿਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: O my unconscious mind, remain conscious of the Lord, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.
lines.transliteration: har chayt achayt  manaa jo ichh eh so fal ho-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the sublime elixir of the Lord; by continually drinkingit in, you shall have eternal peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har ras paavahi peevat raheh sad aa sukh  ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਮਿਤ ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: When one meets the True Guru, he becomes the philosopher's stone, with the abilityto transform others, inspiring them to worship the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay t aa paaras hovai paaras ho-ay t a pooj karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who worships the Lord in adoration, obtains his rewards; instructing others, he reveals the Truth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo us poojay so fal paa-ay deekh i-aa d ayvai saach bujh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤ  ਅਚੇਤ  ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਇਛਿਹ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Without becoming the philosopher's stone, he does not inspire others to worship theLord; without instructing his own mind, how can he instruct others?
lines.transliteration: vin paarsai pooj na hova-ee vin  man parchay avraa samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪੀਵਤ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The ignorant, blind man calls himself the guru, but to whom can he show the way?||3||
lines.transliteration: guroo sadaa-ay agi-aanee anDh aa kis oh maarag paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, without His Mercy, nothing can be obtained. One upon whom He casts HisGlance of Grace, obtains Him.
lines.transliteration: naanak vin nad ree kichh oo na paa-ee-ai jis nad ar karay so paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, God bestows greatness, and projects the Word of His Shabad.||4||5||7|| gUjrI mhlw 3 pMcpdy ] (491-13) goojree mehlaa 3 panchpaday. Goojaree, Third Mehl, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee day vadi-aa-ee apn aa sabad  vartaa-ay. ||4||5||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਉਸੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਿਖਆ  ਦੇਵੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wisdom is not produced in Benares, nor is wisdom lost in Benares.
lines.transliteration: naa kaasee mat oopjai naa kaasee mat  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਪਾਰਸੈ  ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਮਨ ਪਰਚੇ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਸਮਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, wisdom is produced, and then, one obtains this understanding. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai mat  oopjai t aa ih sojh ee paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਏ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਿਕਸੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, O mind, and enshrine the Shabad of His Word withinyour mind.
lines.transliteration: har kathaa tooN sun ray man sabad  man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: If your intellect remains stable and steady, then doubt shall depart from within you.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih mat t ayree thir rahai t aaN bharam vichahu jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਅਪਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਰਤਾਏ  ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet within your heart, and your sins shall be erased.
lines.transliteration: har charan rid ai vasaa-ay t oo kilvikh  hoveh naas.

lines.english: If your soul overcomes the five elements, then you shall come to have a home at thetrue place of pilgrimage. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch bhoo aat maa vas karahi t aa tirath karahi nivaas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ  ਮਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ  ਮਿਤ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This mind of the self-centered manmukh is so stupid; it does not obtain anyunderstanding at all.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ih man mugaDh  hai sojh ee kichh oo na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਮਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It does not understand the Name of the Lord; it departs repenting in the end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam na bujh-ee ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਿਣ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In this mind are found Benares, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the Shaastras; the True Guru has explained this.
lines.transliteration: ih man kaasee sabh t irath simrit  satgur dee-aa bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਮਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਥਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਤ ਭਰਮੁ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sixty-eight places of pilgrimage remain with one, whose heart is filled with theLord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath t is sang raheh jin har hird ai rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: O Nanak, upon meeting the True Guru, the Order of the Lord's Will is understood, andthe One Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai hukam bujh i-aa ayk vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ  ਤੂ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to You, O True Lord, are true. They remain absorbed in You. ||5||6||8|| pMnw 492 gUjrI mhlw 3 qIjw ] (492-1) goojree mehlaa 3 teejaa. Goojaree, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai sabh  sach hai sachay rahai samaa-ay. ||5||6||8||

lines.english: The One Name is the treasure, O Pandit. Listen to these True Teachings.
lines.transliteration: ayko naam niDhaan pandit  sun sikh sach so-ee.

lines.english: No matter what you read in duality, reading and contemplating it, you shall only continue to suffer. ||1||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay jayt aa parh eh parh at gunat sadaa dukh ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਸੁਿਣ ਿਸਖੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: So grasp the Lord's lotus feet; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cometo understand.
lines.transliteration: har charnee t ooN laag rahu gur sabad  sojhee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਜੇਤਾ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਪੜਤ  ਗੁਣਤ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: With your tongue, taste the sublime elixir of the Lord, and your mind shall be rendered immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har ras rasnaa chaakh t ooN taaN man nirmal ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਤੂੰ ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the mind becomes content, and then, hunger and desire willnot trouble you any longer.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai man sant okhee-ai t aa fir t arisnaa bh ookh na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਚਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਤ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Obtaining the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one does not go knockingat other doors. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan paa-i-aa par gh ar jaa-ay na ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh babbles on and on, but he does not understand.
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee jay karay manmukh  boojh  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ  ਤਾ ਿਫਿਰ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One whose heart is illumined, by Guru's Teachings, obtains the Name of the Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee gh at chaann aa har naam paavai so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You may listen to the Shaastras, but you do not understand, and so you wander fromdoor to door.
lines.transliteration: sun saast ar tooN na bujh hee taa fireh baaro baar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨੀ  ਬਦਨੀ  ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He is a fool, who does not understand his own self, and who does not enshrine lovefor the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: so moorakh jo aap na pachh aan-ee sach na Dh aray pi-aar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Lord has fooled the world - no one has any say in this at all.
lines.transliteration: sachai jagat dahkaa-i-aa kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਤੂੰ ਨ ਬੁਝਹੀ  ਤਾ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He does whatever He pleases, according to His Will. ||5||7||9|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (492-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu gUjrI mhlw 4 caupdy Gru 1 ] (492-8) raag goojree mehlaa 4 cha-upday gh ar 1. Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bh aavai so karay ji-o t is kee rajaa-ay. ||5||7||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ  ਸਿਚ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Pr imal Being, I offer my prayers to You, O Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kay jan satgur sat  purkh aa ha-o bin-o kara-o gur paas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਜਗਤੁ  ਡਹਕਾਇਆ ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am an insect and a worm; O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, be mercifuland bestow upon me the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham keeray kiram satgur sarn aa-ee kar d a-i-aa naam pargaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਉ  ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੫॥੭॥੯॥
lines.english: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please illuminate me with the Light of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray meet gurd ayv mo ka-o raam naam pargaas.

lines.english: By Guru's Instructions, the Naam is my breath of life, and the Praise of the Lord is myoccupation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam mayraa paraan sakh aa-ee har keerat  hamree rahraas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord's servants have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, Har,Har, and a thirst for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jan kay vadbhaag vadayray jin har har sarDh aa har pi-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ  ਹਉ ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Company ofthe Holy, their virtues shine forth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har naam milai taript aasahi mil sangat  gun pargaas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਿਕਰਮ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have not obtained the essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are taken away by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jinH har har har ras naam na paa-i-aa tay bh aagheen  jam paas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Company of theHoly - cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo satgur saran  sangat  nahee aa-ay Dh arig jeevay Dh arig jeevaas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਹਮਰੀ  ਰਹਰਾਿਸ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those humble servants of the Lord, who have obtained the Company of the TrueGuru, have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: jin har jan satgur sangat  paa-ee t in Dhur mast ak likh i-aa likh aas.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat sangat  jit har ras paa-i-aa mil naanak naam pargaas. ||4||1|| Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Naam shinesforth. ||4||1|| gUjrI mhlw 4 ] (492-15) goojree mehlaa 4. Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ  ਵਡੇਰੇ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਧਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe is the Beloved of the minds of those who join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. The Shabad of His Word fascinates their minds.
lines.transliteration: govind govind  pareet am man pareet am mil sat sangat  sabad  man mohai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chant, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe; God is the One who gives gifts to all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jap govind govind  Dhi-aa-ee-ai sabh  ka-o d aan d ay-ay parabh  ohai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O my Siblings of Destiny, the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind, has enticed and fascinated my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayray bhaa-ee janaa mo ka-o govind  govind  govind  man mohai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਆਏ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਿਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind; joining the Holy Society of the Guru, Your humble servant is beautified. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: govind govind  govind  gun gaavaa mil gur saaDh sangat  jan sohai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਿਤਨ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਲਖਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Devotional worship to the Lord is an ocean of peace; through the Guru's Teachings,wealth, prosperity and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas fall at our feet.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar har bh agat hai gurmat  ka-ulaa riDh  siDh laagai pag ohai.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Support of His humble servant; he chants the Lord's Name, and with the Lord's Name he is adorned. ||2|| pMnw 493
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o raam naam aaDhaaraa har naam japat  har naamay sohai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Evil-minded, unfortunate and shallow-minded are those who feel anger in their minds, when they hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: durmat  bhaagheen mat  feekay naam sunat  aavai man rohai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਭਾਗਹੀਨ  ਮਿਤ ਫੀਕੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ  ਆਵੈ ਮਿਨ ਰੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: You may place ambrosial nectar before crows and ravens, but they will be satisfiedonly by eating manure and dung with their mouths. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ka-oo-aa kaag ka-o amrit ras paa-ee-ai t ariptai vistaa kh aa-ay mukh  gohai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਊਆ  ਕਾਗ  ਕਉ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਖਾਇ  ਮੁਿਖ ਗੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Speaker of Truth, is the pool of Ambrosial Nectar; bathing withinit, the crow becomes a swan.
lines.transliteration: amrit sar sat gur sat ivaadee jit naatai ka-oo-aa hans hohai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਵਾਦੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਨਾਤੈ  ਕਊਆ  ਹੰਸੁ ਹੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those who, through the Guru'sTeachings, with the Naam, wash away the filth of their hearts. ||4||2|| gUjrI mhlw 4 ] (493-4) goojree mehlaa 4. Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan Dh an vaday vadbh aagee jinH gurmat  naam rid ai mal Dh ohai. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted, and exalted is their speech. With theirmouths, they speak for the benefit of others.
lines.transliteration: har jan ootam oot am ban ee mukh  boleh par-upkaaray.

lines.english: Those who listen to them with faith and devotion, are blessed by the Lord; showeringHis Mercy, He saves them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jan sunai sarDh aa bh agat saytee kar kirpaa har nist aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ  ਊਤਮ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Lord, please, let me meet the beloved servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam mo ka-o har jan mayl pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਰਧਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੇਤੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Perfect Guru, is my Beloved, my very breath of life; the Guru hassaved me, the sinner. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetam paraan sat gur gur pooraa ham paapee gur nist aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are fortunate, so very fortunate; their Support is the Name of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vadbh aagee vadbh aagay jin har har naam aDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗੁ ਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through theGuru's Teachings, they obtain this treasure-house of devotional worship. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har amrit har ras paavahi gurmat  bhagat bhandaaray. ||2||

lines.english: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the TruePrimal Being, are most unfortunate; they are destroyed by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jin darsan sat gur sat  purakh  na paa-i-aa t ay bh aagheen  jam maaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਵਡਭਾਗੇ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: ||3|| They are like dogs, pigs and jackasses; they are cast into the womb of reincarnation,and the Lord strikes them down as the worst of murderers. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say kookar sookar garDhabh  paveh garabh  jonee d a-yi maaray mahaa hat i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, Kind to the poor, please shower Your mercy upon Your humble servant, andsave him.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal hohu jan oopar kar kirpaa layho ubaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਜਿਮ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary; if it pleases You, Lord, please savehim. ||4||3|| gUjrI mhlw 4 ] (493-10) goojree mehlaa 4. Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan har kee sarnaa-ee har bh aavai har nist aaray. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਕੂਕਰ  ਸੂਕਰ  ਗਰਧਭ  ਪਵਿਹ  ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਨੀ ਦਿਯ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਹਿਤਆਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Be Merciful and attune my mind, so that I might meditate continually on the Lord'sName, night and day.
lines.transliteration: hohu da-i-aal mayraa man laavhu ha-o an-d in raam naam nit  Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is all peace, all virtue and all wealth; remembering Him, all misery andhunger depart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  sabh  gun sabh  niDhaan har jit  japi-ai d ukh bhukh sabh  leh jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, the Lord's Name is my companion and brother.
lines.transliteration: man mayray mayraa raam naam sakhaa har bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, I sing the Praises of the Lord's Name; it shall be my helpand support in the end, and it shall deliver me in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmat raam naam jas gaavaa ant  baylee d argeh la-ay chh adaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਉ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਤ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Giver, O God, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; by Your Grace, You have infused longing for You in my mind.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay d aataa parabh  antarjaamee kar kirpaa loch mayrai man laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਭ ਗੁਣ ਸਿਭ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਜਤੁ ਜਿਪਐ  ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind and body long for the Lord; God has fulfilled my longing. I have entered theSanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mai man tan loch lagee har sayt ee parabh  loch pooree sat gur sarn aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Human birth is obtained through good actions; without the Name, it is cursed, totallycursed, and it passes away in vain.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam punn kar paa-i-aa bin naavai Dh arig Dh arig birthaa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਾ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਬੇਲੀ ਦਰਗਹ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains only suffering for his delicacies to eat. His mouth is insipid, and his face is spat upon, again and again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa ras kas dukh  khaavai mukh  feekaa thuk thook mukh  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Those humble beings, who have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord God, Har, Har, areblessed with glory in the Court of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jo jan har parabh har har sarn aa tin dargeh har har d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੋਚ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an saabaas kahai parabh  jan ka-o jan naanak mayl la-ay gal laa-ee. ||4||4|| Blessed, blessed and congratulations, says God to His humble servant. O servantNanak, He embraces him, and blends him with Himself. ||4||4|| gUjrI mhlw 4 ] (493-17) goojree mehlaa 4. Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Gurmukhs, O my friends and companions, give me the gift of the Lord's Name, thelife of my very life.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sakh ee sahaylee mayree mo ka-o d ayvhu d aan har paraan jeevaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪੁੰਿਨ ਕਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: ||1|| I am the slave, the servant of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord God, thePrimal Being, night and day. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham hovah laalay golay gursikhaa kay jinHaa an-d in har parabh  purakh  Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਰਸ ਕਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੀਕਾ  ਥੁਕ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Within my mind and body, I have enshrined love for the feet of the Guru's Sikhs.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan birahu gursikh  pag laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my life-mates, O Sikhs of the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, instruct me in theTeachings, that I might merge in the Lord's Merger. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 494
lines.transliteration: gUjrI, mÚ 4) mayray paraan sakhaa gur kay sikh  bhaa-ee mo ka-o karahu upd ays har milai milaa-i- aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਖ ਭਾਈ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When it pleases the Lord God, he causes us to meet the Gurmukhs; the Hymns of the Guru, the True Guru, are very sweet to their minds.
lines.transliteration: jaa har parabh bh aavai t aa gurmukh  maylay jinH vachan guroo sat gur man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Very fortunate are the beloved Sikhs of the Guru; through the Lord, they attain thesupreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur kay sikh  pi-aaray har nirbaan ee nirbaan  pad paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਮੇਲੇ ਿਜਨ ਵਚਨ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the Guru, is loved by the Lord. The Naam,the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and pleasing to their minds.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  gur kee har pi-aaree jin har har naam meeth aa man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਿਸਖ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ਿਨਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who does not obtain the Association of the True Guru, is a most unfortunatesinner; he is consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin satgur sangat  sang na paa-i-aa say bh aagheen  paapee jam kh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If God, the Kind Master, Himself shows His kindness, then the Lord causes the Gurmukh to merge into Himself.
lines.transliteration: aap kirpaal kirpaa parabh Dh aaray har aapay gurmukh  milai milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਜਿਮ ਖਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Words of the Guru's Bani; through them, one isabsorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5|| gUjrI mhlw 4 ] (494-6) goojree mehlaa 4. Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bolay gun ban ee gurbaan ee har naam samaa-i-aa. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਧਾਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲੈ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who has found the Lord God through the True Guru, has made the Lord seem sosweet to me, through the His Teachings.
lines.transliteration: jin satgur purakh  jin har parabh  paa-i-aa mo ka-o kar upd ays har meeth  lagaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬੋਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, and totally rejuvenated; by greatgood fortune, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al sabh  hari-aa ho-aa vadbh aagee har naam Dh i-aavai. ||1||

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, let anyone who can implant the Lord's Name within me, comeand meet with me.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray mo ka-o ko-ee aa-ay milai har naam d arirh-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Unto my Beloved, I give my mind and body, and my very breath of life. He speaks tome of the sermon of my Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetam paraan man t an sabh  dayvaa mayray har parabh  kee har kathaa sunaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸਭ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dheeraj Dh aram gurmat  har paa-i-aa nit  har naamai har si-o chit  laavai. Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained courage, faith and the Lord. He keepsmy mind focused continually on the Lord, and the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਰੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Words of the True Guru's Teachings are Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit trickles into the mouth of the one who chants them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit bachan sat gur kee ban ee jo bolai so mukh  amrit  paavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Immaculate is the Naam, which cannot be stained by filth. Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Naam with love.
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam jit mail na laagai gurmat  naam japai liv laavai.

lines.english: That man who has not found the wealth of the Naam is most unfortunate; he diesover and over again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath jin nar nahee paa-i-aa say bh aagheen  mu-ay mar jaavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧੀਰਜੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The source of bliss, the Life of the world, the Great Giver brings bliss to all whomeditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aanad mool jagjeevan d aataa sabh  jan ka-o anad  karahu har Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਬਚਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਿਖ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Great Giver, all beings belong to You. O servant Nanak, You forgive theGurmukhs, and merge them into Yourself. ||4||6|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (494-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: gUjrI mhlw 4 Gru 3 ] (494-15) goojree mehlaa 4 ghar 3. Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: tooN daataa jee-a sabh  tayray jan naanak gurmukh  bakh as milaavai. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Mother, father and sons are all made by the Lord;
lines.transliteration: maa-ee baap putar sabh  har kay kee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਿਜਨ ਨਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਮੁਏ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa ka-o san-banDh  har kar d ee-ay. ||1|| the relationships of all are established by the Lord. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: I have given up all my strength, O my brother.
lines.transliteration: hamraa jor sabh rahi-o mayray beer.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਸਿਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: The mind and body belong to the Lord, and the human body is entirely under His control. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kaa tan man sabh  har kai vas hai sareer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord Himself infuses devotion into His humble devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa ka-o sarDh aa aap har laa-ee.

lines.english: In the midst of family life, they remain unattached. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vichay garisat ud aas rahaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਬਾਪ ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਸਿਭ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: When inner love is established with the Lord,
lines.transliteration: jab antar pareet  har si-o ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਉ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਦੀਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tab jo kichh  karay so mayray har parabh  bhaa-ee. ||3|| then whatever one does, is pleasing to my Lord God. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਜੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਿਹਓ  ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
lines.english: I do those deeds and tasks which the Lord has set me to;
lines.transliteration: jit kaarai kamm ham har laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do that which He makes me to do. ||4||
lines.transliteration: so ham karah jo aap karaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Those whose devotional worship is pleasing to my God
lines.transliteration: jin kee bhagat  mayray parabh  bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਧਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: - O Nanak, those humble beings center their minds lovingly on the Lord's Name. ||5||1||7||16|| pMnw 495 gUjrI mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 1  (495-1) goojree mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 1 Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (495-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: tay jan naanak raam naam liv laa-ee. ||5||1||7||16||

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Why, O mind, do you contrive your schemes, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?
lines.transliteration: kaahay ray man chitvahi ud am jaa aahar har jee-o pari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਿਚਤਵਿਹ  ਉਦਮੁ  ਜਾ ਆਹਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਪਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: From rocks and stones, He created the living beings, and He places before them theirsustenance. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sail pathar meh jant upaa-ay t aa kaa rijak aagai kar Dh ari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ  ਮਿਹ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਿਰਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕਿਰ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my Dear Lord of Souls, one who meets with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation,is saved.
lines.transliteration: mayray maaDha-o jee sat sangat  milay se t ari-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status, and the dry branch blossoms forth ingreenery. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-i-aa sookay kaasat hari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ  ਹਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mother, father, friends, children, and spouse - no one is the support of any other.
lines.transliteration: janan pitaa lok sut  banit aa ko-ay na kis kee Dh ari-aa.

lines.english: For each and every individual, the Lord and Master provides sustenance; why do you fear, O my mind? ||2||
lines.transliteration: sir sir rijak sambaahay thaakur kaahay man bh a-o kari-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਿਨ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਕੀ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.
lines.transliteration: oodai ood aavai sai kosaa tis paachh ai bachray chh ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸੰਬਾਹੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thoughtof this in your mind? ||3||
lines.transliteration: un kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man meh simran kari-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਊਡੈ ਊਿਡ ਆਵੈ  ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ  ਛਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: All treasures and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are held bythe Lord and Master in the palm of His hand.
lines.transliteration: sabh niDh aan d as asat sidh aan th aakur kar t al Dhari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕਵਨੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ  ਕਵਨੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਕਿਰਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, and forever a sacrifice to You - Your vastexpanse has no limit. ||4||1|| gUjrI mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 2  (495-8) goojree mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 2 Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (495-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bal bal sad bal jaa-ee-ai t ayraa ant  na paraavari-aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਦਸ ਅਸਟ  ਿਸਧਾਨ  ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: They perform the four rituals and six religious rites; the world is engrossed in these.
lines.transliteration: kiri-aachaar karahi khat karmaa it  raatay sansaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈਐ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਿਰਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: They are not cleansed of the filth of their ego within; without the Guru, they lose thegame of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar mail na ut rai ha-umai bin gur baajee haaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, please, grant Your Grace and preserve me.
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur rakh  layvhu kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਿਰਆਚਾਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਇਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Out of millions, hardly anyone is a servant of the Lord. All the others are mere traders. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay ko virlaa sayvak hor saglay bi-uhaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ  ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have searched all the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees, and they all affirm onething:
lines.transliteration: saasat bayd  simrit  sabh  soDh ay sabh  aykaa baat  pukaaree.
bin gur mukat na ko-oo paavai man vaykh hu kar beechaaree. ||2|| without the Guru, no one obtains liberation; see, and reflect upon this in your mind.||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਹੋਿਰ ਸਗਲੇ  ਿਬਉਹਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even if one takes cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, andwanders over the whole planet,
lines.transliteration: athsath  majan kar isnaanaa bh aram aa-ay Dh ar saaree.
anik soch karahi din raat ee bin sat gur anDh i-aaree. ||3|| and performs all the rituals of purification day and night, still, without the True Guru,there is only darkness. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤ  ਬੇਦ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਿਭ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਬਾਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  Dhaavat  sabh  jag Dh aa-i-o ab aa-ay har d u-aaree. Roaming and wandering around, I have travelled over the whole world, and now, Ihave arrived at the Lord's Door.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਿਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord has eliminated my evil-mindedness, and enlightened my intellect; O servantNanak, the Gurmukhs are saved. ||4||1||2|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (495-14) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: durmat  mayt buDh  pargaasee jan naanak gurmukh  taaree. ||4||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਮਜਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਆਏ  ਧਰ ਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord is my chanting, the wealth of the Lord is my deep meditation;the wealth of the Lord is the food I enjoy.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan jaap har Dh an taap har Dh an bh ojan bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਸੋਚ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨ  ਰਾਤੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅੰਿਧਆਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I do not forget the Lord, Har, Har, from my mind, even for an instant; I have foundHim in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nimakh na bisara-o man t ay har har saaDh sangat  meh paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਤ  ਧਾਵਤ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਧਾਇਓ  ਅਬ ਆਏ  ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mother, your son has returned home with a profit:
lines.transliteration: maa-ee khaat aa-i-o gh ar poot aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੇਿਟ ਬੁਿਧ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har Dhan chalt ay har Dh an baisay har Dh an jaagat  sootaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. the wealth of the Lord while walking, the wealth of the Lord while sitting, and thewealth of the Lord while waking and sleeping. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The wealth of the Lord is my cleansing bath, the wealth of the Lord is my wisdom; Icenter my meditation on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan isnaan har Dh an gi-aan har sang laa-ay Dh i-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਪ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਪ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord is my raft, the wealth of the Lord is my boat; the Lord, Har, Har, is the ship to carry me across. ||2|| pMnw 496
lines.transliteration: har Dhan t ulhaa har Dh an bayrh ee har har t aar paraanaa. ||2||

lines.english: Through the wealth of the Lord, I have forgotten my anxiety; through the wealth of the Lord, my doubt has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan mayree chint  visaaree har Dh an laahi-aa Dh okhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਚੰਤ  ਿਵਸਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਧਿਨ ਲਾਿਹਆ  ਧੋਖਾ ॥
lines.english: From the wealth of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures; the true essence of the Lord has come into my hands. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har Dhan t ay mai nav niDh  paa-ee haath chari-o har thokaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ ਹਾਿਥ  ਚਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਥੋਕਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: No matter how much I eat and expend this wealth, it is not exhausted; here andhereafter, it remains with me.
lines.transliteration: kaavahu kharchahu t ot na aavai halat  palat  kai sangay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਖਰਚਹੁ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਹਲਤ  ਪਲਤ  ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
lines.english: Loading the treasure, Guru Nanak has given it, and this mind is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||4||2||3|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (496-3) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: laad kh ajaanaa gur naanak ka-o d ee-aa ih man har rang rangay. ||4||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਦ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਦੀਆ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: Remembering Him, all sins are erased, and ones generations are saved.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat sabh  kilvikh  naaseh pit ree ho-ay uDh aaro.

lines.english: So meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har; He has no end or limitation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so har har tumH sad hee jaapahu jaa kaa ant  na paaro. ||1||

lines.english: O son, this is your mother's hope and prayer,
lines.transliteration: pootaa maat aa kee aasees.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh na bisara-o t umH ka-o har har sad aa bh ajahu jagd ees. ||1|| rahaa-o. that you may never forget the Lord, Har, Har, even for an instant. May you evervibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: May the True Guru be kind to you, and may you love the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: satgur t umH ka-o ho-ay d a-i-aalaa sat sang t ayree pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਿਬਸਰਉ  ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: May the preservation of your honor by the Transcendent Lord be your clothes, and may the singing of His Praises be your food. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaaparh pat  parmaysar raakh ee bh ojan keert an neet . ||2||

lines.english: So drink in forever the Ambrosial Nectar; may you live long, and may the meditativeremembrance of the Lord give you infinite delight.
lines.transliteration: amrit peevhu sad aa chir jeevhu har simrat  anad  anant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: May joy and pleasure be yours; may your hopes be fulfilled, and may you never betroubled by worries. ||3||
lines.transliteration: rang tamaasaa pooran aasaa kabeh na bi-aapai chint aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਪੜੁ  ਪਿਤ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਾਖੀ  ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਿਤ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let this mind of yours be the bumble bee, and let the Lord's feet be the lotus flower.
lines.transliteration: bhavar t umHaaraa ih man hova-o har charn aa hohu ka-ulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਚਰੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਅਨਦ  ਅਨੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says servant Nanak, attach your mind to them, and blossom forth like the song-bird,upon finding the rain-drop. ||4||3||4|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (496-9) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas un sang laptaa-i-o ji-o booNdeh chaat rik ma-ulaa. ||4||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸਾ  ਕਬਿਹ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He decides to go to the west, but the Lord leads him away to the east.
lines.transliteration: mataa karai pachh am kai t aa-ee poorab hee lai jaat .

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਰੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵਉ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣਾ  ਹੋਹੁ ਕਉਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He holds all matters in His hands.||1||
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa aapan haath mat aat. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਉਨ ਸੰਿਗ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ  ਿਜਉ  ਬੂੰਦਿਹ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕੁ  ਮਉਲਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: Cleverness is of no use at all.
lines.transliteration: si-aanap kaahoo kaam na aat.

lines.english: Whatever my Lord and Master deems to be right - that alone comes to pass. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo anroopi-o thaakur mayrai ho-ay rahee uh baat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਪਛਮ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪੂਰਬ  ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਤ  ॥
lines.english: In his desire to acquire land and accumulate wealth, one's breath escapes him.
lines.transliteration: days kamaavan Dh an joran kee mansaa beechay niksay saas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ  ਆਪਨ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਮਤਾਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He must leave all his armies, assistants and servants; rising up, he departs to the Cityof Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laskar nayb khavaas sabh  ti-aagay jam pur ooth  siDhaas. ||2||

lines.english: Believing himself to be unique, he clings to his stubborn mind, and shows himself off.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay annan manhath kee d arirh-taa aapas ka-o jaanaat .

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਅਨਰੂਿਪਓ  ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਮੇਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਬਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That food, which the blameless people have condemned and discarded, he eats againand again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo anind nind  kar chh odi-o so-ee fir fir kh aat. ||3||

lines.english: One, unto whom the Lord shows His natural mercy, has the noose of Death cut awayfrom him.
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay bh a-ay kirpaalaa t is jan kee kaatee faas.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਨ  ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ  ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ  ਬੀਚੇ ਿਨਕਸੇ  ਸਾਸ ॥
