lines.english: Says Nanak, one who meets the Perfect Guru, is celebrated as a householder as wellas a renunciate. ||4||4||5|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (496-15) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur pooraa bhayti-aa parvaan  girsat  udaas. ||4||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਲਸਕਰ  ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ  ਸਭ ਿਤਆਗੇ  ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਊਿਠ ਿਸਧਾਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, have their bonds broken.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan jin jan japi-o t in kay banDh an kaatay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਿਨ ਮਨਹਠ  ਕੀ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਤਾ  ਆਪਸ  ਕਉ ਜਾਨਾਤ  ॥
lines.english: Sexual desirer, anger, the poison of Maya and egotism - they are rid of theseafflictions. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh maa-i-aa bikh  mamt aa ih bi-aaDh  tay haatay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਅਿਨੰਦੁ  ਿਨੰਦੁ  ਕਿਰ ਛੋਿਡਓ  ਸੋਈ ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਖਾਤ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chants the Praises ofthe Lord,
lines.transliteration: har jas saaDhsang mil gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ  ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad bh a-i-o man nirmal sarab sukh aa sukh  paa-i-a-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. has his mind purified, by Guru's Grace, and he obtains the joy of all joys. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਿਗਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ  ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord does, he sees that as good; such is the devotional service heperforms.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kee-o so-ee bh al maanai aisee bh agat kamaanee.

lines.english: He sees friends and enemies as all the same; this is the sign of the Way of Yoga. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mitar sat ar sabh  ayk samaanay jog jugat  neesaanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਿਨ ਜਿਪਓ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟੇ ॥
lines.english: The all-pervading Lord is fully filling all places; why should I go anywhere else?
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o sarab thaa-ee aan na katahooN jaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਮਤਾ  ਇਹ ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਤੇ ਹਾਟੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is permeating and pervading within each and every heart; I am immersed in HisLove, dyed in the color of His Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar sarab nirant ar rang ravi-o rang raat aa. ||3||

lines.english: When the Lord of the Universe becomes kind and compassionate, then one enters the home of the Fearless Lord. pMnw 497
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal d a-i-aal gupaalaa t aa nirbh ai kai gh ar aa-i-aa.

lines.english: His troubles and worries are ended in an instant; O Nanak, he merges in celestial peace. ||4||5||6|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (497-2) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kal kalays mitay khin bh eetar naanak sahj samaa-i-aa. ||4||5||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਿਮਟੇ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: Whoever I approach to ask for help, I find him full of his own troubles.
lines.transliteration: jis maanukh peh kara-o baynt ee so apnai d ukh bhari-aa.

lines.english: One who worships in his heart the Supreme Lord God, crosses over the terrifyingworld-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jin ridai araaDh i-aa tin bha-o saagar t ari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਿਹ ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਸੋ ਅਪਨੈ  ਦੁਿਖ ਭਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one, except the Guru-Lord, can dispel our pain and sorrow.
lines.transliteration: gur har bin ko na baritha dukh  kaatai.

lines.english: Forsaking God, and serving another, one's honor, dignity and reputation aredecreased. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh t aj avar sayvak jay ho-ee hai t it maan mahat  jas gh aatai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
lines.english: Relatives, relations and family bound through Maya are of no avail.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kay san-banDh sain saak kit  hee kaam na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਿਜ ਅਵਰ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ  ਜਸੁ ਘਾਟੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's servant, although of lowly birth, is exalted. Associating with him, one obtains the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kaa daas neech kul oochaa t is sang man baaNchhat fal paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Through corruption, one may obtain thousands and millions of enjoyments, but evenso, his desires are not satisfied through them.
lines.transliteration: laakh kot bikh i-aa kay binjan t aa meh t arisan na boojh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਸਨਬੰਧ  ਸੈਨ ਸਾਕ ਿਕਤ  ਹੀ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of lights appear, and theincomprehensible is understood. ||3||
lines.transliteration: simrat naam kot ujee-aaraa basat  agochar soojh ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਊਚਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨ ਬਛਤ  ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wandering and roaming around, I have come to Your Door, Destroyer of fear, O LordKing.
lines.transliteration: firat firat  tumHrai du-aar aa-i-aa bh ai bhanjan har raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਖ  ਕੋਿਟ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕੇ ਿਬੰਜਨ  ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of the Holy; in it, he finds peace.||4||6||7|| gUjrI mhlw 5 pMcpdw Gru 2  (497-9) goojree mehlaa 5 panchpadaa gh ar 2 Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Pada, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (497-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saaDh kay charan Dh oor jan baachh ai sukh  naanak ih paa-i-aa. ||4||6||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਿਟ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਸੂਝੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: First, he came to dwell in his mother's womb; leaving it, he came into the world.
lines.transliteration: parathmay garabh maat aa kai vaasaa oohaa chh od Dh aran meh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਰਤ  ਿਫਰਤ  ਤੁਮਰੈ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Splendid mansions, beautiful gardens and palaces - none of these shall go with him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chitar saal sund ar baag mand ar sang na kachh hoo jaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਧੂਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
lines.english: All other greeds of the greedy are false.
lines.transliteration: avar sabh mithi-aa lobh  labee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has given me the Name of the Lord, which my soul has come totreasure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai dee-o har naamaa jee-a ka-o ayhaa vasat  fabee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਥਮੇ  ਗਰਭ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਕੈ ਵਾਸਾ  ਊਹਾ ਛੋਿਡ ਧਰਿਨ  ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Surrounded by dear friends, relatives, children, siblings and spouse, he laughsplayfully.
lines.transliteration: isat meet banDh ap sut  bhaa-ee sang banit aa rach hasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਰ੍  ਸਾਲ  ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਬਾਗ  ਮੰਦਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But when the very last moment arrives, Death seizes him, while they merely look on. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jab antee a-osar aa-ay bani-o hai unH paykh at hee kaal garsi-aa. ||2||

lines.english: By continual oppression and exploitation, he accumulates wealth, gold, silver andmoney,
lines.transliteration: kar kar anrath bihaajhee sampai su-inaa roopaa d aamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਸਤੁ  ਫਬੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaarh ee ka-o oh bh aarhaa mili-aa hor sagal bh a-i-o biraanaa. ||3|| but the load-bearer gets only paltry wages, while the rest of the money passes on toothers. ||3||

lines.english: He grabs and collects horses, elephants and chariots, and claims them as his own.
lines.transliteration: haivar gaivar rath sambaahay gahu kar keenay mayray.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਟ  ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਰਿਚ ਹਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: But when he sets out on the long journey, they will not go even one step with him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jab tay ho-ee laaNmee Dh aa-ee chaleh naahee ik pairay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਅੰਤੀ  ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਿਨਓ  ਹੈ ਉਨ ਪੇਖਤ  ਹੀ ਕਾਿਲ  ਗਰ੍ਿਸਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my wealth; the Naam is my princely pleasure; theNaam is my family and helper.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhan naam sukh  raajaa naam kutamb sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਅਨਰਥ  ਿਬਹਾਝੀ  ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੂਪਾ ਦਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has given Nanak the wealth of the Naam; it neither perishes, nor comes orgoes. ||5||1||8|| gUjrI mhlw 5 iqpdy Gru 2  (497-17) goojree mehlaa 5 tipd ay gh ar 2 Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Ti-Padas, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (497-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naam sampat gur naanak ka-o d ee-ee oh marai na aavai jaa-ee. ||5||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾੜੀ ਕਉ ਓਹੁ ਭਾੜਾ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹੋਰੁ ਸਗਲ  ਭਇਓ  ਿਬਰਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My sorrows are ended, and I am filled with peace. The fire of desire within me hasbeen quenched.
lines.transliteration: dukh binsay sukh  kee-aa nivaasaa t arisnaa jalan bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈਵਰ  ਗੈਵਰ  ਰਥ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ  ਗਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਕੀਨੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, withinme; it neither dies, nor goes anywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan sat guroo drirh -aa-i-aa binas na aavai jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਲਮੀ  ਧਾਈ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਇਕ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, the bonds of Maya are cut away.
lines.transliteration: har jap maa-i-aa banDhan t ootay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਜਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When my God becomes kind and compassionate, one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and is emancipated. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 498
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal d a-i-aal parabh  mayray saaDh sangat  mil chh ootay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, absorbed in loving devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har kay gun gaavai bh agat paraym ras maat aa.

lines.english: He remains unaffected by both fortune and misfortune, and he recognizes the CreatorLord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: harakh sog d uhu maahi niraalaa karn aihaar pachh aataa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord saves those who belong to Him, and all pathways are opened to them.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh  lee-aa sagal jugat  ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਰਾਲਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the value of the Merciful Lord God cannot be described. ||3||1||9|| gUjrI mhlw 5 dupdy Gru 2  (498-4) goojree mehlaa 5 dupd ay gh ar 2 Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (498-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh purakh  da-i-aalaa keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee. ||3||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਰਿਖ ਲੀਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has sanctified the sinners and made them His own; all bow in reverence toHim.
lines.transliteration: patit pavit ar lee-ay kar apunay sagal karat  namaskaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੁਰਖ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
lines.english: No one asks about their ancestry and social status; instead, they yearn for the dust of their feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baran jaat ko-oo poochh ai naahee baachh eh charan ravaaro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord Master, such is Your Name.
lines.transliteration: thaakur aiso naam t umHaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਲੀਏ ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਰਤ  ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: You are called the Lord of all creation; You give Your unique support to Your servant.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal sarisat ko Dhan ee kaheejai jan ko ang niraaro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਨੁ ਜਾਿਤ  ਕੋਊ ਪੂਛੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਬਾਛਿਹ  ਚਰਨ ਰਵਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained understanding;singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is his only support.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak buDh  paa-ee har keert an aaDh aaro.

lines.english: The Lord's servants, Naam Dayv, Trilochan, Kabeer and Ravi Daas the shoe-makerhave been liberated. ||2||1||10|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (498-8) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naamday-o t arilochan kabeer d aasro mukat  bha-i-o chammi-aaro. ||2||1||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਹੀਜੈ  ਜਨ ਕੋ ਅੰਗੁ  ਿਨਰਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one understands the Lord; who can understand His plans?
lines.transliteration: hai naahee ko-oo boojhanhaaro jaanai kavan bh ataa.

lines.english: Shiva, Brahma and all the silent sages cannot understand the state of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: siv biranch ar sagal mon jan geh na sakaahi gataa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: God's sermon is profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee agam agaaDh  kathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਦਾਸਰੋ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਇਓ ਚੰਿਮਆਰੋ  ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He is heard to be one thing, but He is und erstood to be something else again; He is beyond description and explanation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sunee-ai avar avar biDh bujh ee-ai bakan kathan raht aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is the devotee, and He Himself is the Lord and Master; He is imbued withHimself.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhagt aa aap su-aamee aapan sang rat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੋ  ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾ ॥
lines.english: Nanak's God is pervading and permeating everywhere; wherever he looks, He is there.||2||2||11|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (498-11) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ko parabh poor rahi-o hai paykh i-o jat ar kat aa. ||2||2||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਿਬਰੰਿਚ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ  ਮੋਿਨ ਜਨ ਗਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਾਿਹ  ਗਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord has no plans, politics or other clever tricks.
lines.transliteration: mataa masoorat  avar si-aanap jan ka-o kachh oo na aa-i-o.

lines.english: Whenever the occasion arises, there, he meditates on the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah jah a-osar aa-ay bani-o hai tahaa t ahaa har Dh i-aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨੀਐ  ਅਵਰ  ਅਵਰ  ਿਬਿਧ ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਬਕਨ  ਕਥਨ  ਰਹਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is the very nature of God to love His devotees;
lines.transliteration: parabh ko bh agat vachh al bird aari-o.

lines.english: He cherishes His servant, and caresses him as His own child. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karay partipaal baarik kee ni-aa-ee jan ka-o laad ladaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਪਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਤਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's servant sings the Kirtan of His Praises as his worship, deep meditation,self-discipline and religious observances.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam Dh aram har keert an jan gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਹੈ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਜਤਰ੍ ਕਤਾ  ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, and has received the blessings of fearlessness and peace. ||2||3||12|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (498-15) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran pari-o naanak thaakur kee abh ai daan sukh  paa-i-o. ||2||3||12||

lines.english: Worship the Lord in adoration, day and night, O my dear - do not delay for a moment.
lines.transliteration: din raat ee aaraaDh ahu pi-aaro nimakh  na keejai dh eelaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਿਤ  ਅਵਰ  ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Saints with loving faith, and set aside your pride and stubbornness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant sayvaa kar bh aavnee laa-ee-ai t i-aag maan haath eelaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ  ਬਿਨਓ  ਹੈ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fascinating, playful Lord is my very breath of life and honor.
lines.transliteration: mohan paraan maan raageelaa.

lines.english: He abides in my heart; beholding His playful games, my mind is fascinated.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baas rahi-o hee-aray kai sangay paykh mohi-o man leelaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਡ  ਲਡਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remembering Him, my mind is in bliss, and the rust of my mind is removed.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat man hot  anand aa utrai manhu jangeelaa.

lines.english: The great honor of meeting the Lord cannot be described; O Nanak, it is infinite,beyond measure. ||2||4||13|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (498-18) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: milbay kee mahimaa baran na saaka-o naanak parai pareelaa. ||2||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: They call themselves silent sages, Yogis and scholars of the Shaastras, but Maya has has them all under her control.
lines.transliteration: mun jogee saastarag kahaavat  sabh  keenHay bas apnahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੀ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The three gods, and the 330,000,000 demi-gods, were astonished. ||1|| pMnw 499
lines.transliteration: teen d ayv ar korh  tayteesaa t in kee hairat  kachh  na rahee. ||1||

lines.english: The power of Maya is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: balvant bi-aap rahee sabh  mahee.

lines.english: Her secret is known only by Guru's Grace - no one else knows it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar na jaanas ko-oo marmaa gur kirpaa tay lahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਸ  ਕੋਊ ਮਰਮਾ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਲਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Conquering and conquering, she has conquered everywhere, and she clings to the whole world.
lines.transliteration: jeet jeet  jeetay sabh  thaanaa sagal bh avan laptahee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, she surrenders to the Holy Saint; becoming his servant, she falls at hisfeet. ||2||5||14|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (499-3) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak saaDh t ay bh aagee ho-ay chayree charan gahee. ||2||5||14||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਿਤ  ਜੀਿਤ  ਜੀਤੇ  ਸਿਭ ਥਾਨਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਨ  ਲਪਟਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer, meditating on my Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  karee baynant ee thaakur apnaa Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ  ਹੋਇ ਚੇਰੀ ਚਰਨ  ਗਹੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Giving me His hand, the Transcendent Lord has saved me, and erased all my sins. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ay parmaysar saglaa d urat mitaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord and Master Himself has become merciful.
lines.transliteration: thaakur ho-ay aap d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਕਰੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have been emancipated, the embodiment of bliss; I am the child of the Lord of theUniverse - He has carried me across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ee kali-aan  aanand  roop hu-ee hai ubray baal gupaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਿਰ  ਸਗਲਾ  ਦੁਰਤੁ  ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting her Husband, the soul-bride sings the songs of joy, and celebrates her Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: mil var naaree mangal gaa-i-aa thaakur kaa jaikaar.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has emancipated everyone. ||2||6||15|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (499-6) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis gur balihaaree jin sabh  kaa kee-aa uDh aar. ||2||6||15||

lines.punjabi: ਭਈ ਕਿਲਆਣ ਆਨੰਦ  ਰੂਪ ਹੁਈ ਹੈ ਉਬਰੇ  ਬਾਲ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mother, father, siblings, children and relatives - their power is insignificant.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banDh ap tin kaa bal hai thoraa.

lines.english: I have seen the many pleasures of Maya, but none goes with them in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik rang maa-i-aa kay paykhay kichh  saath na chaalai bh oraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਵਰ ਨਾਰੀ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Lord Master, other than You, no one is mine.
lines.transliteration: thaakur t ujh bin aahi na moraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੫॥
lines.english: I am a worthless orphan, devoid of merit; I long for Your Support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi anaath nirgun gun naahee mai aahi-o t umHraa Dh oraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Your lotus feet; here and hereafter, Yours is the only power.
lines.transliteration: bal bal bal bal charan t umHaaray eehaa oohaa t umHaaraa joraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained the Blessed Visionof Your Darshan; my obligations to all others are annulled. ||2||7||16|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (499-10) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak d aras paa-i-o binsi-o sagal nihoraa. ||2||7||16||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਪੇਖੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਭੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He rids us of entanglements, doubt and emotional attachment, and leads us to loveGod.
lines.transliteration: aal jaal bharam moh t ajaavai parabh  saytee rang laa-ee.

lines.english: He implants this instruction in our minds, for us to sing the Glorious Praises of theLord, in peace and poise. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man ka-o ih updays d arirh-aavai sahj sahj gun  gaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਅਨਾਥ  ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੈ ਆਿਹਓ  ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਧੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O friend, the Saintly Guru is such a helper.
lines.transliteration: saajan aiso sant sahaa-ee.

lines.english: Meeting Him, the bonds of Maya are released, and one never forgets the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis bhaytay t ooteh maa-i-aa banDh  bisar na kabahooN jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਚਰਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਈਹਾ  ਊਹਾ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਜੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Practicing, practicing various actions in so many ways, I came to recognize this as the best way.
lines.transliteration: karat karat  anik baho bh aatee neekee ih th ahraa-ee.

lines.english: Joining the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, andcrosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||8||17|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (499-13) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo har jas gaavai naanak bh avjal paar paraa-ee. ||2||8||17||

lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; His value cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa keemat  jaa-ay na karee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਲ  ਜਾਲ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਾਵੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He turns the king into a beggar in an instant, and He infuses splendor into the lowly.||1||
lines.transliteration: raajaa rank karai khin bh eetar neechah jot  Dharee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵੈ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhi-aa-ee-ai apno sad aa haree. Meditate forever on Your Lord.
Why should I feel worry or anxiety, when I am here for only a short time. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: soch andaysaa t aa kaa kahaa karee-ai jaa meh ayk gh aree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤੂਟਿਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਬੰਧ ਿਬਸਿਰ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my support, O my Perfect True Guru; my mind has taken to the protection ofYour Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: tumHree tayk pooray mayray sat gur man saran t umHaarai paree.

lines.english: Nanak, I am a foolish and ignorant child; reach out to me with Your hand, Lord, andsave me. ||2||9||18|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (499-17) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: achayt i-aanay baarik naanak ham t um raakh o Dhaar karee. ||2||9||18||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤ  ਕਰਤ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ  ਨੀਕੀ  ਇਹ ਠਹਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of all beings; please, come to dwell within my mind.
lines.transliteration: tooN daataa jee-aa sabh naa kaa bashu mayray man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਈ  ॥੨॥੮॥੧੭॥
lines.english: That heart, within which Your lotus feet are enshrined, suffers no darkness or doubt.||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal rid  maahi samaa-ay t ah bh aram anDh ayraa naahee. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord Master, wherever I remember You, there I find You.
lines.transliteration: thaakur jaa simraa t ooN taahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Show Mercy to me, O God, Cherisher of all, that I may sing Your Praises forever.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa sarab partipaalak parabh  ka-o sad aa salaahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਰੰਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਨੀਚਹ  ਜੋਿਤ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, I contemplate Your Name; O God, I long for You alone.
lines.transliteration: saas saas tayraa naam samaara-o t um hee ka-o parabh  aahee.

lines.english: O Nanak, my support is the Creator Lord; I have renounced all other hopes. ||2||10||19|| pMnw 500 gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (500-1) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tayk bha-ee kart ay kee hor aas bidaan ee laahee. ||2||10||19||

lines.english: Show Mercy to me, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I sing Your Praises night and day.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnaa daras d eejai jas gaava-o nis ar bh or.

lines.english: With my hair, I wash the feet of Your slave; this is my life's purpose. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kays sang daas pag jh aara-o ihai manorath mor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਦੀਜੈ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ  ਿਨਿਸ  ਅਰੁ ਭੋਰ ॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master, without You, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: thaakur t ujh bin bee-aa na hor.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸ ਸੰਿਗ  ਦਾਸ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ  ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, in my mind I remain conscious of You; with my tongue I worship You, andwith my eyes, I gaze upon You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chit chit va-o har rasan araaDh a-o nirkh a-o tumree or. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Merciful Lord, O Lord and Master of all,  with my palms pressed together I pray to You.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal purakh  sarab kay th aakur bin-o kara-o kar jor.

lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, chants Your Name, and is redeemed in the twinkling of an eye.||2||11||20|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (500-5) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam japai naanak daas t umro uDh ras aakh ee for. ||2||11||20||

lines.english: Overwhelming the realm of Brahma, the realm of Shiva and the realm of Indra, Mayahas come running here.
lines.transliteration: barahm lok ar rudr lok aa-ee ind ar lok t ay Dh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰਉ  ਕਰ ਜੋਿਰ ॥
lines.english: But she cannot touch the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; she washes and massages their feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  ka-o johi na saakai mal mal Dh ovai paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ  ਉਧਰਿਸ  ਆਖੀ  ਫੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Now, I have come and entered the Lord's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi aa-ay pari-o sarnaa-ay.

lines.english: This awful fire has burned so many; the True Guru has cautioned me about it.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: guhaj paavko bahut parjaarai mo ka-o sat gur dee-o hai bat aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਲੋਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੁਦਰ੍ ਲੋਕ ਆਈ  ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਲੋਕ ਤੇ ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It clings to the necks of the Siddhas, and the seekers, the demi-gods, angels andmortals.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik ar jakh -y kinnar nar rahee kanth  urjhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਉ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has the support of God the Creator, who has millions of slaves like her.||2||12||21|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (500-8) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ang kee-aa parabh kart ai jaa kai kot aisee d aasaa-ay. ||2||12||21||

lines.english: His bad reputation is erased, he is acclaimed all over the world, and he obtains a seatin the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: apjas mitai hovai jag keerat d argeh baisan  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਹਜ  ਪਾਵਕੋ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਰ੍ਜਾਰੈ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਓ  ਹੈ ਬਤਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fear of death is removed in an instant, and he goes to the Lord's House in peaceand bliss. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jam kee taraas naas ho-ay kh in meh sukh  anad  saytee gh ar jaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: His works do not go in vain.
lines.transliteration: jaa tay gh aal na birthee jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਅਰੁ ਜਖਯ੍ਯ੍ ਿਕੰਨਰ  ਨਰ ਰਹੀ ਕੰਿਠ ਉਰਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, remember your God in meditation; meditate on Him continually in your mind and body. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar simrahu parabh  apnaa man t an sad aa Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਗੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਰਤੈ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੋਿਟ ਐਸੀ  ਦਾਸਾਇ  ॥੨॥੧੨॥੨੧॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; whatever You give me,God, that is what I receive.
lines.transliteration: mohi saran deen d ukh bhanjan t ooN deh so-ee parabh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Nanak is imbued with the love of Your lotus feet; O Lord, please preserve the honor ofYour slave. ||2||13||22|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (500-12) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak rang raat ay har d aasah paij rakh aa-ee-ai. ||2||13||22||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਜਸੁ ਿਮਟੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਗ  ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਬੈਸਣੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The all-sustaining Lord is the Giver of all beings; His devotional worship is anoverflowing treasure.
lines.transliteration: bisamvbhar jee-an ko d aataa bh agat bharay bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ  ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Service to Him is not wasted; in an instant, He emancipates. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayvaa nifal na hovat kh in meh karay uDh aar. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Lord's lotus feet.
lines.transliteration: man mayray charan kamal sang raach.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seek from Him, who is worshipped by all beings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal jee-a jaa ka-o aaraaDheh t aahoo ka-o t ooN jaach. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Creator Lord; You, O God, are the support of my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: naanak saran t umHaaree kart ay tooN parabh  paraan aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਸਰਿਨ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He who is protected by You, O Helper Lord - what can the world do to him?||2||14||23|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (500-16) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ho-ay sahaa-ee jis tooN raakh ahi tis kahaa karay sansaar. ||2||14||23||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਹ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥੧੩॥੨੨॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself has protected the honor of His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: jan kee paij savaaree aap.

lines.english: The Guru has given the medicine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, and all afflictions aregone. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam dee-o gur avkh aDh utar ga-i-o sabh  taap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸੰਭਰ  ਜੀਅਨ  ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Transcendent Lord, in His Mercy, has preserved Har Gobind.
lines.transliteration: harigobind rakh i-o parmaysar apunee kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਨਫਲ  ਨ ਹੋਵਤ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The disease is over, and there is joy all around; we ever contemplate the Glories ofGod. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mitee bi-aaDh sarab sukh  ho-ay har gun  sadaa beechaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਚੁ ॥
lines.english: My Creator Lord has made me His own; such is the glorious greatness of the PerfectGuru.
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-o mayrai kartai gur pooray kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜੀਅ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਿਹ  ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਚੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak laid the immovable foundation, which grows higher and higher each day. ||2||15||24|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (500-19) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: abichal neev Dharee gur naanak nit  nit charh ai savaa-ee. ||2||15||24||

lines.english: You never focused your consciousness on the Lord. pMnw 501
lines.transliteration: kabhoo har si-o cheet na laa-i-o.

lines.english: DhanDh aa karat  bihaanee a-uDh ahi gun  niDh naam na gaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. You have spent your life engaged in worldly pursuits; you have not sung the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹਾਨੀ  ਅਉਧਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Shell by shell, you accumulate money; in various ways, you work for this.
lines.transliteration: ka-udee ka-udee jorat kaptay anik jugat  kar Dh aa-i-o.

lines.english: Forgetting God, you suffer awful pain beyond measure, and you are consumed by theGreat Enticer, Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bisrat parabh  kaytay dukh ganee-ah mahaa mohnee kh aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਡੀ  ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਤ  ਕਪਟੇ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਧਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Show Mercy to me, O my Lord and Master, and do not hold me to account for myactions.
lines.transliteration: karahu anoograhu su-aamee mayray ganhu na mohi kamaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਿਹ  ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ  ਖਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O merciful and compassionate Lord God, ocean of peace, Nanak has taken to YourSanctuary, Lord. ||2||16||25|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (501-4) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gobind d a-i-aal kirpaal sukh  saagar naanak har sarn aa-i-o. ||2||16||25||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗਨਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਿਹ ਕਮਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: With your tongue, chant the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam raam ravant.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੧੬॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Renounce other false occupations, and vibrate forever on the Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhod aan bi-uhaar mithi-aa bh aj sad aa bh agvant . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One Name is the support of His devotees; in this world, and in the worldhereafter, it is their anchor and support.
lines.transliteration: naam ayk aDhaar bh agtaa eet  aagai tayk.

lines.english: In His mercy and kindness, the Guru has given me the divine wisdom of God, and adiscriminating intellect. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gobind d ee-aa gur gi-aan buDh  bibayk. ||1||

lines.english: The all-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is the Master of wealth -I seek His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath sareeDh ar saran  taa kee gahee.

lines.english: Liberation and worldly success come from the dust of the feet of the Holy Saints;Nanak has obtained the Lord's treasure. ||2||17||26|| gUjrI mhlw 5 Gru 4 caupdy  (501-8) goojree mehlaa 5 ghar 4 cha-upd ay Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (501-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mukat jugat  ravaal saaDh oo naanak har niDh  lahee. ||2||17||26||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ  ਈਤ ਆਗੈ  ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: Give up all your clever tricks, and seek the Sanctuary of the Holy Saint.
lines.transliteration: chhaad sagal si-aan paa saaDh  sarnee aa-o.

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysaro parabhoo kay gun  gaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥ  ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.english: O my consciousness, contemplate and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ray chit charan  kamal araaDh .

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ ਰਵਾਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਿਧ  ਲਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੨੬॥
lines.english: You shall obtain total peace and salvation, and all troubles shall depart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh kali-aan  paavahi mitai sagal upaaDh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Mother, father, children, friends and siblings - without the Lord, none of them are real.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  meet  bhaa-ee t is binaa nahee ko-ay.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, He is the companion of the soul; He is pervading everywhere.||2||
lines.transliteration: eet oot  jee-a naal sangee sarab ravi-aa so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Millions of plans, tricks, and efforts are of no use, and serve no purpose.
lines.transliteration: kot jatan upaav mithi-aa kachh  na aavai kaam.

lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure, and obtainssalvation, through the Name of God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saran saaDh oo nirmalaa gat  ho-ay parabh  kai naam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਮਟੈ ਸਗਲ  ਉਪਾਿਧ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God is profound and merciful, lofty and exalted; He gives Sanctuary to the Holy.
lines.transliteration: agam da-i-aal parabh oo oochaa saran  saaDh oo jog.

lines.english: He alone obtains the Lord, O Nanak, who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny to meet Him. ||4||1||27|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (501-14) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis paraapat  naankaa jis likh i-aa Dh ur sanjog. ||4||1||27||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Serve your Guru forever, and chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa gur sayv sad hee ramhu gun  gobind .

lines.punjabi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਸੰਗੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, worship the Lord, Har, Har, in adoration, and the anxietyof your mind will be dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saas saas araaDh har har leh jaa-ay man kee chind . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਤਨ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਕਛੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਕਾਿਮ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of God.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jaap parabh kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਾਧੂ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You shall be blessed with peace, poise and pleasure, and you shall find theimmaculate place. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj anand paavahi milee nirmal thaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਊਚਾ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, redeem your mind, and adore theLord, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang uDh aar ih man aath  pahar aaraaDh .

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and egotism will be dispelled, and all troubles shall end. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar binsai mitai sagal upaaDh . ||2||

lines.english: The Lord Master is immovable, immortal and inscrutable; seek His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: atal achhayd  abhayd su-aamee saran  taa kee aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਮਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: Worship in adoration the lotus feet of the Lord in your heart, and center your consciousness lovingly on Him alone. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal araaDh  hirdai ayk si-o liv laa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਅਰਾਿਧ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਚੰਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me, and He Himself has forgiven me.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh d a-i-aa Dh aaree bakh as leenHay aap.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has given me His Name, the treasure of peace; O Nanak, meditate on thatGod. ||4||2||28|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (501-19) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab sukh har naam d ee-aa naanak so parabh  jaap. ||4||2||28||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on God, and my doubts are gone. pMnw 502
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee parabh Dh i-aa-i-aa ga-ee sankaa t oot.

lines.english: Pain, ignorance and fear have left me, and my sins have been dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dukh anayraa bh ai binaasay paap ga-ay nikh oot. ||1||

lines.english: My mind is filled with love for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam kee man pareet.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Holy Saint, under His Instruction, I meditate on the Lord of the Universe, in the most immaculate way. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDh bachan gobind  Dhi-aa-ay mahaa nirmal reet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Chanting, deep meditation and various rituals are contained in the fruitful meditative remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaap taap anayk karn ee safal simrat  naam.

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself has protected me, and all my works have beenbrought to fruition. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar anoograhu aap raakhay bh a-ay pooran kaam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਕਰਣੀ ਸਫਲ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, may I never forget You, O God, Almighty Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: saas saas na bisar kabahooN barahm parabh samrath.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਰਾਖੇ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can my tongue describe Your countless virtues? They are uncountable, andforever indescribable. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun anik rasnaa ki-aa bakh aanai agnat  sadaa akath. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਨ ਿਬਸਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਮਰਥ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Remover of the pains of the poor, the Savior, the Compassionate Lord,the Bestower of Mercy.
lines.transliteration: deen d arad nivaar t aaran  da-i-aal kirpaa karan .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਅਿਨਕ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ਅਗਨਤ  ਸਦਾ ਅਕਥ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Remembering the Naam in meditation, the state of eternal dignity is obtained; Nanakhas grasped the protection of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||29|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (502-6) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: atal padvee naam simran  darirh naanak har har saran . ||4||3||29||

lines.english: Intellectual egotism and great love for Maya are the most serious chronic diseases.
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh baho sagh an maa-i-aa mahaa d eeragh  rog.

lines.punjabi: ਅਟਲ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਨਾਮ ਿਸਮਰਣ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the medicine, which is potent to cure everything. The Guru has given me the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naam a-ukhaDh  gur naam d eeno karan  kaaran  jog. ||1||

lines.english: My mind and body yearn for the dust of the Lord's humble servants.
lines.transliteration: man tan baachh ee-ai jan Dh oor.

lines.english: With it, the sins of millions of incarnations are obliterated. O Lord of the Universe,please fulfill my desire. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay laheh paatik gobind  lochaa poor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਬਹੁ ਸਘਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਹਾ ਦੀਰਘ  ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, one is hounded by dreadful desires.
lines.transliteration: aad ant ay maDh  aasaa kookree bikraal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's spiritual wisdom, we sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord ofthe Universe, and the noose of death is cut away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan keertan gobind  ramn aN kaatee-ai jam jaal. ||2||

lines.english: Those who are cheated by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachmentsuffer reincarnation forever.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh mooth ay sad aa aavaa gavan .

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਲਹਿਹ  ਪਾਿਤਕ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਲੋਚਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By loving devotional worship to God, and meditative remembrance of the Lord of theWorld, one's wandering in reincarnation is ended. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabh paraym bh agat gupaal simran  mitat  jonee bh avan. ||3||

lines.english: Friends, children, spouses and well-wishers are burnt by the three fevers.
lines.transliteration: mitar put ar kalt ar sur rid  teen taap jalant .

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one's miseries are ended, as one meets the Saintly servants of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jap raam raamaa dukh  nivaaray milai har jan sant . ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਰਮਣੰ  ਕਾਟੀਐ  ਜਮ ਜਾਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wandering around in all directions, they cry out, "Nothing can save us!"
lines.transliteration: sarab biDh bh aramt ay pukaareh kat eh naahee chh ot.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮੂਠੇ ਸਦਾ ਆਵਾ  ਗਵਣ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Infinite Lord; he holds fastto their Support. ||5||4||30|| gUjrI mhlw 5 Gru 4 dupdy  (502-13) goojree mehlaa 5 ghar 4 d upday Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (502-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har charan saran  apaar parabh  kay d arirh gahee naanak ot. ||5||4||30||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਿਸਮਰਣ  ਿਮਟਤ  ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਣ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the Lord of wealth, the fulfilling vision, the Almighty Cause ofcauses.
lines.transliteration: aaraaDh sareeDh ar safal moorat  karan  kaaran  jog.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਸੁਰ ਿਰਦ ਤੀਿਨ  ਤਾਪ ਜਲੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: Uttering His Praises, and hearing of His infi nite glory, you shall never suffer separation from Him again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun raman  sarvan  apaar mahimaa fir na hot  bi-og. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਦੁਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥੪॥
lines.english: O my mind, worship the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: man charnaarbind  upaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ਪੁਕਾਰਿਹ  ਕਤਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਛੋਿਟ ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance, strife and sorrow are ended, and the noose of theMessenger of Death is snapped. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kal kalays mitant simran  kaat jamd oot faas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਣ ਅਪਾਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਟ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, and your enemies shall be consumed; there is no other way.
lines.transliteration: satar d ahan har naam kahan avar kachh  na upaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Show Mercy, O my God, and bestow upon Nanak the taste of the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord. ||2||1||31|| gUjrI mhlw 5 ] (502-17) goojree mehlaa 5. Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar anoograhu parabhoo mayray naanak naam su-aa-o. ||2||1||31||

lines.punjabi: ਆਰਾਿਧ  ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਸਫਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: You are the Almighty Lord, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Destroyer of pain, the King ofhappiness.
lines.transliteration: tooN samrath saran ko d aataa dukh bhanjan sukh  raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਸਰ੍ਵਣ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਿਫਿਰ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਿਬਓਗੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Troubles depart, and fear and doubt are dispelled, singing the Glorious Praises of theImmaculate Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaahi kalays mitay bhai bh armaa nirmal gun  parabh  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, without You, there is no other place.
lines.transliteration: govind t ujh bin avar na th aa-o.

lines.english: Show Mercy to me, O Supreme Lord Master, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa paarbarahm su-aamee japee tumaaraa naa-o. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, I am attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet; by great good fortune, I have embraced love for Him. pMnw 503
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv lagay har charnee vadai bh aag liv laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਿਵ ਲਗੇ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: My heart lotus blossoms forth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have renounced evil-mindedness and intellectualism. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaval pargaas bha-ay saaDh sangay d urmat  buDh  ti-aagee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਲ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਤਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, andremembers the Lord in meditation, who is Kind to the poor,
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har kay gun  gaavai simrai d een d ai-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੈਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarai sangat  sabh  uDhrai binsay sagal janjaalaa. ||3|| saves himself, and redeems all his generations; all of his bonds are released. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਭ ਉਧਰੈ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I take the Support of Your Feet, O God, O Lord and Master; you are with me throughand through, God.
lines.transliteration: charan aDh aar tayraa parabh  su-aamee ot  pot parabh  saath.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਅਧਾਰੁਤੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, God; giving him His hand, the Lord has protectedhim. ||4||2||32|| gUjrI AstpdIAw mhlw 1 Gru 1  (503-5) goojree asatpadee-aa mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Goojaree, Ashtapadees, First Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (503-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saran pari-o naanak parabh t umree d ay raakh i-o har haath. ||4||2||32||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਦੇ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਹਿਰ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.english: In the one village of the body, live the five thieves; they have been warned, but theystill go out stealing.
lines.transliteration: ayk nagree panch chor basee-alay barjat choree Dh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: One who keeps his assets safe from the three modes and the ten passions, O Nanak, attains liberation and emancipation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tarihd as maal rakh ai jo naanak mokh  mukat  so paavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਨਗਰੀ  ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ  ਬਰਜਤ  ਚੋਰੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Center your mind on the all-pervading Lord, the Wearer of garlands of the jungles.
lines.transliteration: chaytahu baasud ay-o banvaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਹਦਸ  ਮਾਲ  ਰਖੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Let your rosary be the chanting of the Lord's Name in your heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam ridai japmaalee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Its roots extend upwards, and its branches reach down; the four Vedas are attachedto it.
lines.transliteration: uraDh mool jis saakh  talaahaa chaar bayd  jit laagay.

lines.english: He alone reaches this tree with ease, O Nanak, who remains wakeful in the Love ofthe Supreme Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahj bhaa-ay jaa-ay t ay naanak paarbarahm liv jaagay. ||2||

lines.english: The Elysian Tree is the courtyard of my house; in it are the flowers, leaves and stemsof reality.
lines.transliteration: paarjaat gh ar aagan mayrai puhap pat ar tat daalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਧ  ਮੂਲ ਿਜਸੁ ਸਾਖ ਤਲਾਹਾ ਚਾਿਰ  ਬੇਦ ਿਜਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the self-existent, immaculate Lord, whose Light is pervading everywhere;renounce all your worldly entanglements. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sarab jot niranjan sambh oo chh odahu bahut  janjaalaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਭਾਇ  ਜਾਇ  ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਲਵ  ਜਾਗੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Listen, O seekers of Truth - Nanak begs you to renounce the traps of Maya.
lines.transliteration: sun sikh vantay naanak binvai chh odahu maa-i-aa jaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਗਿਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੁਹਪ  ਪਤਰ੍ ਤਤੁ ਡਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Reflect within your mind, that by enshrining love for the One Lord, you shall not besubject to birth and death again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: man beechaar ayk liv laagee punrap janam na kaalaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਸੰਭੂ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He alone is said to be a Guru, he alone is said to be a Sikh, and he alone is said to bea physician, who knows the patient's illness.
lines.transliteration: so guroo so sikh kathee-alay so vaid  je jaan ai rogee.

lines.english: He is not affected by actions, responsibilities and entanglements; in theentanglements of his household, he maintains the detachment of Yoga. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tis kaaran  kamm na Dh anDhaa naahee Dh anDhai girhee jogee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਏਕ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਕਾਲਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He renounces sexual desire, anger, egotism, greed, attachment and Maya.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar t ajee-alay lobh  moh t is maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਿਸਖੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ  ਸੋ ਵੈਦੁ ਿਜ ਜਾਣੈ  ਰੋਗੀ ॥
lines.english: Within his mind, he meditates on the reality of the Imperishable Lord; by Guru's Gracehe finds Him. ||6||
lines.transliteration: man tat  avigat  Dhi-aa-i-aa gur parsaadee paa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾਹੀ  ਧੰਧੈ ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਜੋਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation are all said to be God's gifts; all of the demons areturned white before him.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan sabh  daat kathee-alay sayt  baran sabh  dootaa.

lines.english: He enjoys the taste of the honey of God's lotus; he remains awake, and does not fallasleep. ||7||
lines.transliteration: barahm kamal maDh t aas rasaad aN jaagat  naahee soot aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ  ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਤਸ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This lotus is very deep; its leaves are the nether regions, and it is connected to thewhole universe.
lines.transliteration: mahaa gambheer pat ar paat aalaa naanak sarab ju-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਤੁ ਅਿਵਗਤੁ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, I shall not have to enter the womb again; I have renounced the poison of corruption, and I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||1|| gUjrI mhlw 1 ] (503-15) goojree mehlaa 1. Goojaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: updays guroo mam puneh na garbh aN bikh taj amrit  pee-aa-i-aa. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਥੀਅਲੇ  ਸੇਤ ਬਰਨ  ਸਿਭ ਦੂਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who beg of God the Great Giver - their numbers cannot be counted.
lines.transliteration: kavan kavan jaacheh parabh d aatay taa kay ant  na pareh sumaar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਧੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਰਸਾਦੰ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੂਤਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: You, Almighty True Lord, fulfill the desires within their hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaisee bhookh  ho-ay abh  antar tooN samrath sach d ayvan haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਪਤਰ੍ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੁਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline and truth are my foundations.
lines.transliteration: ai jee jap tap sanjam sach aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਦੇਸ  ਗੁ ਰੂ ਮਮ ਪੁਨਿਹ  ਨ ਗਰਭੰ  ਿਬਖੁ ਤਿਜ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆਇਆ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: Bless me with Your Name, Lord, that I may find peace. Your devotional worship is atreasure over-flowing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam deh sukh  paa-ee-ai t ayree bh agat bharay bh andaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some remain absorbed in Samaadhi, their minds fixed lovingly on the One Lord; theyreflect only on the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh raheh liv laagay aykaa aykee sabad  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਕਵਨ  ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਤੇ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਰਿਹ  ਸੁਮਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: In that state, there is no water, land, earth or sky; only the Creator Lord Himselfexists. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal thal Dharan  gagan t ah naahee aapay aap kee-aa kart aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਹੋਇ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no intoxication of Maya there, and no shadow, nor the infinite light of the sunor the moon.
lines.transliteration: naa tad  maa-i-aa magan na chh aa-i-aa naa sooraj chand  na jot  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The eyes within the mind which see everything - with one glance, they see the three worlds. ||3|| pMnw 504
lines.transliteration: sarab darisat lochan abh  antar aykaa nad ar so t aribhavan saar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਲੋਚਨ  ਅਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਏਕਾ ਨਦਿਰ  ਸੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He created air, water and fire, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva - the whole creation.
lines.transliteration: pavan paan ee agan t in kee-aa barahmaa bisan mahays akaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ  ਅਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: All are beggars; You alone are the Great Giver, God. You give Your gifts according to Your own considerations. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sarbay jaachik tooN parabh  daataa daat karay apunai beechaar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਤੂੰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Three hundred thirty million gods beg of God the Master; even as He gives, Histreasures are never exhausted.
lines.transliteration: kot tayt ees jaacheh parabh  naa-ik d ayday tot naahee bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਜਾਚਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਇਕ  ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨਾਹੀ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing can be contained in a vessel turned upside-down; Ambrosial Nectar pours intothe upright one. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ooNDhai bh aaNdai kachh  na samaavai seeDh ai amrit  parai nihaar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਊਂਧੈ ਭਡੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਸੀਧੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਰੈ ਿਨਹਾਰ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi beg for wealth and miracles, and proclaim His victory.
lines.transliteration: siDh samaaDh ee ant ar jaacheh riDh  siDh jaach karahi jaikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਜਾਿਚ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜੈਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: As is the thirst within their minds, so is the water which You give to them. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jaisee pi-aas ho-ay man antar t aiso jal d ayveh parkaar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਿਪਆਸ  ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੈਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਿਹ ਪਰਕਾਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The most fortunate ones serve their Guru; there is no difference between the DivineGuru and the Lord.
lines.transliteration: baday bhaag gur sayveh apunaa bh ayd naahee gurd ayv muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਮੁਰਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot see those who come to realize within their minds the contemplative meditation of the Word of the Shabad. ||7||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o kaal naahee jam johai boojh eh ant ar sabad  beechaar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I shall never ask anything else of the Lord; please, bless me with the Love of YourImmaculate Name.
lines.transliteration: ab tab avar na maaga-o har peh naam niranjan d eejai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the Ambrosial Water; O Lord, shower Your Mercy uponhim, and bless him with Your Praise. ||8||2|| gUjrI mhlw 1 ] (504-7) goojree mehlaa 1. Goojaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak chaatrik amrit  jal maagai har jas d eejai kirpaa Dh aar. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਜਲੁ ਮਾਗੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: O Dear One, he is born, and then dies; he continues coming and going; without theGuru, he is not emancipated.
lines.transliteration: ai jee janam marai aavai fun jaavai bin gur gat nahee kaa-ee.

lines.english: Those mortals who become Gurmukhs are attuned to the Naam, the Name of theLord; through the Name, they obtain salvation and honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paraan ee naamay raat ay naamay gat  pat paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਨਿਮ ਮਰੈ ਆਵੈ  ਫੁਿਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁ ਰ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, focus your consciousness lovingly on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray raam naam chit  laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one begs of the Lord God; such is the glorious greatness of theNaam. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har parabh jaachay aisee naam badaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Dear One, so many wear various religious robes, for begging and filling their bellies.
lines.transliteration: ai jee bahutay bh aykh karahi bh ikhi-aa ka-o kayt ay ud ar bharan kai t aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਚੇ  ਐਸੀ  ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship to the Lord, O mortal, there can be no peace. Without the Guru, pride does not depart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagat  naahee sukh  paraanee bin gur garab na jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: O Dear One, death hangs constantly over his head. Incarnation after incarnation, it ishis enemy.
lines.transliteration: ai jee kaal sadaa sir oopar th aadhay janam janam vairaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਕਉ ਕੇਤੇ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਨ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad are saved. The True Guru hasimparted this understanding. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad rat ay say baachay sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Messenger of Death cannot see the mortal, or torturehim.
lines.transliteration: gur sarnaa-ee johi na saakai d oot na sakai sant aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਕਾਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਿਸਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਠਾਢੇ ਜਨਿਮ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਵੈਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am imbued with the Imperishable and Immaculate Lord Master, and lovinglyattached to the Fearless Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: avigat naath niranjan raat ay nirbh a-o si-o liv laa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਬਾਚੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Dear One, implant the Naam within me; lovingly attached to the Naam, I lean onthe True Guru's Support.
lines.transliteration: ai jee-o naam dirh ahu naamay liv laavhu sat gur tayk tikaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, He does; no one can erase His actions. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karsee kirat  na mayti-aa jaa-ee. ||5||

lines.english: O Dear One, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Guru; I have no love for any other except You.
lines.transliteration: ai jee bhaag paray gur saran  tumHaaree mai avar na d oojee bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀਉ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦੜਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਟੇਕ ਿਟਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I constantly call upon the One Lord; since the very beginning, and throughout theages, He has been my help and support. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ab tab ayko ayk pukaara-o aad  jugaad  sakhaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ  ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਮੇਿਟਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Dear One, please preserve the Honor of Your Name; I am hand and glove with You.
lines.transliteration: ai jee raakho paij naam apunay kee t ujh hee si-o ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਿਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਮੈ ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Bless me with Your Mercy, and reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, OGuru. Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away my ego. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur daras d ikhaavhu ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਉ  ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Dear One, what should I ask of You? Nothing appears permanent; whoever comesinto this world shall depart.
lines.transliteration: ai jee ki-aa maaga-o kichh rahai na d eesai is jag meh aa-i-aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਿਸਉ ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Bless Nanak with the wealth of the Naam, to adorn his heart and neck. ||8||3|| gUjrI mhlw 1 ] (504-18) goojree mehlaa 1. Goojaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam padaarath d eejai hird ai kanth  banaa-ee. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਦਖਾਵਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Dear One, I am not high or low or in the middle. I am the Lord's slave, and I seekthe Lord's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ai jee naa ham utam neech na maDh im har sarn aagat  har kay log.

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਿਕਆ  ਮਾਗਉ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਰਹੈ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am detached from the world; I have forgotten sorrow, separation and disease. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay kayval bairaagee sog bijog bisarjit  rog. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕੰਿਠ ਬਣਾਈ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, by Guru's Grace, I perform devotional worship to my Lord and Master. pMnw 505
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray gur kirpaa t ay bh agat thaakur kee.

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with the Hymns of the True Guru, obtains the Pure Lord. He is not under the power of the Messenger of Death, nor does he owe Death anything.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur vaak hird ai har nirmal naa jam kaan  na jam kee baakee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਵਾਿਕ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਿਣ  ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord with his tongue, and abides with God; hedoes whatever pleases the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har gun rasan raveh parabh  sangay jo t is bhaavai sahj haree.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, life passes in vain in the world, and every moment isuseless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin har naam baritha jag jeevan har bin nihfal mayk gharee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਨ  ਰਵਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਗੇ ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The false have no place of rest, either inside or outside; the slanderer does not findsalvation.
lines.transliteration: ai jee khotay th a-ur naahee gh ar baahar nind ak gat  nahee kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਜਿਗ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਮੇਕ ਘਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Even if one is resentful, God does not withhold His blessings; day by day, theyincrease. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ros karai parabh bakh as na maytai nit  nit charh ai savaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: No one can take away the Guru's gifts; my Lord and Master Himself has given them.
lines.transliteration: ai jee gur kee daat  na maytai ko-ee mayrai th aakur aap d ivaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬਖਸ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The black-faced slanderers, with slander in their mouths, do not appreciate the Guru's gifts. ||4||
lines.transliteration: nindak nar kaalay mukh  nindaa jinH gur kee d aat na bh aa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਦਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: God forgives and blends with Himself those who take to His Sanctuary; He does notdelay for an instant.
lines.transliteration: ai jee saran paray parabh  bakh as milaavai bilam na aDh oo-aa raa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਨਰ ਕਾਲੇ  ਮੁਖ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He is the source of bliss, the Greatest Lord; through the True Guru, we are united inHis Union. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aanad mool naath sir naathaa sat gur mayl milaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਿਬਲਮ  ਨ ਅਧੂਆ  ਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through His Kindness, the Kind Lord pervades us; through Guru's Teachings, ourwanderings cease.
lines.transliteration: ai jee sadaa d a-i-aal d a-i-aa kar ravi-aa gurmat  bharman chukaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨਦ  ਮੂਲੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਨਾਥਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Touching the philosopher's stone, metal is transformed into gold. Such is the gloriousgreatness of the Society of the Saints. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paaras bhayt kanchan Dh aat ho-ee sat sangat  kee vadi-aa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਰਿਵਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਭਰ੍ਮਿਨ  ਚੁਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the immaculate water; the mind is the bather, and the True Guru is thebath attendant, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har jal nirmal man isnaanee majan satgur bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਭੇਿਟ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਈ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: That humble being who joins the Sat Sangat shall not be consigned to reincarnationagain; his light merges into the Light. ||7||
lines.transliteration: punrap janam naahee jan sangat jot ee jot  milaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਲੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ  ਮਜਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Great Primal Lord, the infinite tree of life; I am a bird perched on Your branches.
lines.transliteration: tooN vad purakh  agamm t arovar ham pankh ee tujh maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਨਰਿਪ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Grant to Nanak the Immaculate Naam; throughout the ages, he sings the Praises ofthe Shabad. ||8||4|| gUjrI mhlw 1 Gru 4  (505-11) goojree mehlaa 1 ghar 4 Goojaree, First Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (505-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niranjan deejai jug jug sabad  salaahee. ||8||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਗੰਮ  ਤਰੋਵਰੁ ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The devotees worship the Lord in loving adoration. They thirst for the True Lord, withinfinite affection.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  paraym aaraaDh itaN sach pi-aas param hit aN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਹੀ  ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.english: They tearfully beg and implore the Lord; in love and affection, their consciousness isat peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: billaap bilal binantee-aa sukh  bhaa-ay chit  hitaN. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and take to His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jap man naam har sarnee.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the boat to cross over the world-ocean. Practice such a way of life.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar taar t aaran  ram naam kar karn ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O mind, even death wishes you well, when you remember the Lord through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ay man mirat subh  chi-aNtaN gur sabad  har ramn aN.

lines.english: The intellect receives the treasure, the knowledge of reality and supreme bliss, byrepeating the Lord's Name in the mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mat t at gi-aanaN kali-aan  niDhaanaN har naam man ramn aN. ||2||

lines.english: The fickle consciousness wanders around chasing after wealth; it is intoxicated withworldly love and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: chal chit vit  bharmaa bh aramaN jag moh magan hit aN.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਤਾਿਰ  ਤਾਰਣ  ਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਿਰ ਕਰਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Devotion to the Naam is permanently implanted within the mind, when it is attuned tothe Guru's Teachings and His Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: thir naam bhagat  dirhaN matee gur vaak sabad  rataN. ||3||

lines.english: Wandering around, doubt is not dispelled; afflicted by reincarnation, the world is beingruined.
lines.transliteration: bharmaat  bharam na chook-ee jag janam bi-aaDh  khapaN.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਿਮਰਤ  ਸੁਭ ਿਚੰਤੰ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਰਮਣੰ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's eternal throne is free of this affliction; he is truly wise, who takes the Naamas his deep meditation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: asthaan har nihkayvalaN sat mat ee naam t apaN. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੰ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਿਨਧਾਨੰ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਨ ਰਮਣੰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This world is engrossed in attachment and transitory love; it suffers the terrible painsof birth and death.
lines.transliteration: ih jag moh hayt bi-aapit aN dukh aDhik janam marn aN.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲ ਿਚਤ  ਿਵਤ ਭਰ੍ਮਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੰ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਿਹਤੰ ॥
lines.english: Run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, chant the Lord's Name in your heart, and youshall swim across. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bhaj saran  satgur oobrahi har naam rid  ramn aN. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦੜੰ ਮਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਿਕ ਸਬਦ  ਰਤੰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teaching, the mind becomes stable; the mind accepts it, and reflects upon it in peaceful poise.
lines.transliteration: gurmat nihchal man man manaN sahj beechaaraN.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮਾਿਤ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਚੂਕਈ  ਜਗੁ ਜਨਿਮ  ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਖਪੰ ॥
lines.english: That mind is pure, which enshrines Truth within, and the most excellent jewel of spiritual wisdom. ||6||
lines.transliteration: so man nirmal jit saach ant ar gi-aan rat an saaraN. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲੰ  ਸਿਤ ਮਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਤਪੰ ॥੪॥
lines.english: By the Fear of God, and Love of God, and by devotion, man crosses over the terrifyingworld-ocean, focusing his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. pMnw 506
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aa-ay bh agat tar bhavjal manaa chit  laa-ay har charn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ੁ  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, the most pure and sacred, is within my heart; this body is Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har naam hirdai pavit ar paavan ih sareer t a-o sarn ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਿਰ  ਿਨਵਾਰਣੰ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਿਸ  ਮਨੰ ॥
lines.english: The waves of greed and avarice are subdued, by treasuring the Lord's Name in themind.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh lahar nivaaran aN har naam raas manaN.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਤੁਹੀ ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਰਨੰ  ॥੮॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: Subdue my mind, O Pure Immaculate Lord; says Nanak, I have entered YourSanctuary. ||8||1||5|| gUjrI mhlw 3 Gru 1  (506-3) goojree mehlaa 3 ghar 1 Goojaree, Third Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (506-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: man maar tuhee niranjanaa kaho naankaa sarnaN. ||8||1||5||

lines.english: I dance, and make this mind dance as well.
lines.transliteration: nirat karee ih man nachaa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I eliminate my self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aap gavaa-ee.

lines.english: One who keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord is liberated; he obtains thefruits of his desires. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chit thir raakh ai so mukat  hovai jo ichh ee so-ee fal paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤੁ  ਿਥਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So dance, O mind, before your Guru.
lines.transliteration: naach ray man gur kai aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਚੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: If you dance according to the Guru's Will, you shall obtain peace, and in the end, thefear of death shall leave you. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai naacheh t aa sukh  paavahi ant ay jam bh a-o bh aagai. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾਚਿਹ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਅੰਤੇ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord Himself causes to dance, is called a devotee. He Himself links usto His Love.
lines.transliteration: aap nachaa-ay so bhagat  kahee-ai aapn aa pi-aar aap laa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself sings, He Himself listens, and He puts this blind mind on the right path.||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay gaavai aap sunaavai is man anDh ay ka-o maarag paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨਚਾਏ  ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: One who dances night and day, and banishes Shakti's Maya, enters the House of theLord Shiva, where there is no sleep.
lines.transliteration: an-din naachai sakat  nivaarai siv gh ar need  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The world is asleep in Maya, the house of Shakti; it dances, jumps and sings in duality. The self-willed manmukh has no devotion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saktee gh ar jagat  sootaa naachai taapai avro gaavai manmukh  bhagat na ho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਕਿਤ  ਿਨਵਾਰੈ  ਿਸਵ ਘਿਰ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The angels, mortals, renunciates, ritualists, silent sages and beings of spiritual wisdomdance.
lines.transliteration: sur nar virat pakh  karmee naachay mun jan gi-aan beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਸੂਤਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਟਾਪੈ ਅਵਰੋ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Siddhas and seekers, lovingly focused on the Lord, dance, as do the Gurmukhs,whose minds dwell in reflective meditation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik liv laagee naachay jin gurmukh  buDh  veechaaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਿਵਰਿਤ  ਪਿਖ ਕਰਮੀ ਨਾਚੇ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਿਗਆਨ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The planets and solar systems dance in the three qualities, as do those who bear lovefor You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: khand barahmand t arai gun  naachay jin laagee har liv t umaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਨਾਚੇ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੁਿਧ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The beings and creatures all dance, and the four sources of creation dance. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh ay hee naachay naacheh kh aanee chaaree. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਚੇ  ਿਜਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: They alone dance, who are pleasing to You, and who, as Gurmukhs, embrace love forthe Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaaveh say-ee naacheh jin gurmukh  sabad  liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਨਾਚਿਹ  ਖਾਣੀ  ਚਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
lines.english: They are devotees, with the essence of spiritual wisdom, who obey the Hukam of HisCommand. ||6||
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  say t at gi-aanee jin ka-o hukam manaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: This is devotional worship, that one loves the True Lord; without service, one cannotbe a devotee.
lines.transliteration: ayhaa bhagat  sachay si-o liv laagai bin sayvaa bh agat na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: If one remains dead while yet alive, he reflects upon the Shabad, and then, he obtains the True Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai t aa sabad  beechaarai t aa sach paavai ko-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: So many people dance for the sake of Maya; how rare are those who contemplatereality.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kai arath bahut lok naachay ko virlaa t at beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, that humble being obtains You, Lord, upon whom You show Mercy.||8||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee so-ee jan paa-ay jin ka-o kirpaa tumaaree. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਅਰਿਥ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਚੇ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: If I forget the True Lord, even for an instant, that time passes in vain.
lines.transliteration: ik dam saachaa veesrai saa vaylaa birthaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, constantly remember the Lord; He Himself shall forgiveyou, according to His Will. ||9||
lines.transliteration: saahi saahi sadaa samaalee-ai aapay bakh say karay rajaa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone dance, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who, as Gurmukhs, contemplatethe Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: say-ee naacheh jo tuDh  bhaaveh je gurmukh  sabad  veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹ  ਸਾਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, they alone find celestial peace, whom You bless with Your Grace.||10||1||6|| gUjrI mhlw 4 Gru 2  (506-16) goojree mehlaa 4 ghar 2 Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (506-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak say sahj sukh paavahi jin ka-o nad ar tumaaree. ||10||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਿਹ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, like an infant without milk.
lines.transliteration: har bin jee-araa reh na sakai ji-o baalak kheer aDh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧੦॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: The inaccessible and incomprehensible Lord God is obtained by the Gurmukh; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar parabh gurmukh  paa-ee-ai apunay sat gur kai balihaaree. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a boat to carry you across.
lines.transliteration: man ray har keerat t ar taaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ  ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਿਜਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs obtain the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You bless them with Your Grace. ||Pause|| pMnw 507
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam amrit  jal paa-ee-ai jin ka-o kirpaa t umaaree. rahaa-o.
