lines.english: Sanak, Sanandan and Naarad the sage serve You; night and day, they continue to chant Your Name, O Lord of the jungle.
lines.transliteration: sanak sanandan naarad  mun sayveh an-d in japat  raheh banvaaree.

lines.english: Slave Prahlaad sought Your Sanctuary, and You saved his honor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarnaagat  parahlaad  jan aa-ay t in kee paij savaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਨਕ  ਸਨੰਦਨ  ਨਾਰਦ  ਮੁਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਪਤ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The One unseen immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere, as is the Light of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: alakh niranjan ayko vart ai aykaa jot  muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦ  ਜਨ ਆਏ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All are beggars, You alone are the Great Giver. Reaching out our hands, we beg from You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh jaachik t oo ayko d aataa maageh haath pasaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਖ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ  ਏਕਾ ਜੋਿਤ  ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The speech of the humble devotees is sublime; they sing continually the wondrous,Unspoken Speech of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kee oot am ban ee gaavahi akath kathaa nit  ni-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Their lives become fruitful; they save themselves, and all their generations. ||4||
lines.transliteration: safal janam bha-i-aa t in kayraa aap t aray kul t aaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਿਨਤ ਿਨਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in duality and evil-mindedness; within themis the darkness of attachment.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d ubiDh aa durmat  bi-aapay jin ant ar moh gubaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They do not love the sermon of the humble Saints, and they are drowned along withtheir families. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee kathaa na bh aavai o-ay doobay san  parvaaree. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਬਆਪੇ  ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: By slandering, the slanderer washes the filth off others; he is an eater of filth, and aworshipper of Maya.
lines.transliteration: nindak nind aa kar mal Dh ovai oh malbh akh maa-i-aaDh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He indulges in the slander of the humble Saints; he is neither on this shore, nor theshore beyond. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee nind aa vi-aapay naa urvaar na paaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਿਰ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਲਭਖੁ  ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: All this worldly drama is set in motion by the Creator Lord; He has infused Hisalmighty strength into all.
lines.transliteration: ayhu parpanch khayl kee-aa sabh  kartai har kart ai sabh  kal Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The thread of the One Lord runs through the world; when He pulls out this thread, the One Creator alone remains. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har ayko soot vart ai jug ant ar soot  khinchai aykankaaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ  ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: With their tongues, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and savor Them. Theyplace the sublime essence of the Lord upon their tongues, and savor it.
lines.transliteration: rasan rasan ras gaavahi har gun rasnaa har ras Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਸੂਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੂਤੁ ਿਖੰਚੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, other than the Lord, I ask for nothing else; I am in love with the Love of theLord's sublime essence. ||8||1||7|| gUjrI mhlw 5 Gru 2  (507-10) goojree mehlaa 5 ghar 2 Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (507-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak har bin avar na maaga-o har ras pareet pi-aaree. ||8||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਿਨ  ਰਸਿਨ  ਰਿਸ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Among kings, You are called the King. Among land-lords, You are the Land-lord.
lines.transliteration: raajan meh tooN raajaa kahee-ahi bh ooman meh bh oomaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
lines.english: Among masters, You are the Master. Among tribes, Yours is the Supreme Tribe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: thaakur meh th akuraa-ee t ayree koman sir komaa. ||1||

lines.english: My Father is wealthy, deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: pitaa mayro bado Dh anee agmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਨ  ਮਿਹ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਜਾ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਭੂਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਭੂਮਾ ॥
lines.english: What praises should I chant, O Creator Lord? Beholding You, I am wonder-struck.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ustat kavan kareejai kart ay paykh  rahay bismaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮਿਹ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕੋਮਨ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਕੋਮਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Among the peaceful, You are called the Peaceful One. Among givers, You are the Greatest Giver.
lines.transliteration: sukhee-an meh sukh ee-aa t ooN kahee-ahi d aatan sir d aataa.

lines.english: Among the glorious, You are said to be the Most Glorious. Among revellers, You arethe Reveller. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayjan meh t ayjvansee kahee-ahi rasee-an meh raat aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਵਨ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਪੇਿਖ ਰਹੇ ਿਬਸਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Among warriors, You are called the Warrior. Among indulgers, You are the Indulger.
lines.transliteration: sooran meh sooraa tooN kahee-ahi bh ogan meh bh ogee.

lines.english: Among householders, You are the Great Householder. Among yogis, You are the Yogi.||3||
lines.transliteration: garastan meh t ooN bado garihsat ee jogan meh jogee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੀਅਨ  ਮਿਹ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਦਾਤਨ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Among creators, You are called the Creator. Among the cultured, You are the CulturedOne.
lines.transliteration: kartan meh t ooN kartaa kahee-ahi aachaaran meh aachaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਜਨ  ਮਿਹ ਤੇਜਵੰਸੀ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਰਸੀਅਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Among bankers, You are the True Banker. Among merchants, You are the Merchant.||4||
lines.transliteration: saahan meh tooN saachaa saahaa vaapaaran meh vaapaaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰਨ  ਮਿਹ ਸੂਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਭੋਗਨ  ਮਿਹ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.english: Among courts, Yours is the Court. Yours is the Most Sublime of Sanctuaries.
lines.transliteration: darbaaran meh t ayro d arbaaraa saran paalan teekaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰ੍ਸਤਨ  ਮਿਹ ਤੂੰ ਬਡੋ ਿਗਰ੍ਹਸਤੀ ਜੋਗਨ  ਮਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The extent of Your wealth cannot be determined. Your Coins cannot be counted. ||5||
lines.transliteration: lakhimee kayt ak ganee na jaa-ee-ai gan na saka-o seekaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤਨ  ਮਿਹ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਆਚਾਰਨ  ਮਿਹ ਆਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Among names, Your Name, God, is the most respected. Among the wise, You are the Wisest.
lines.transliteration: naaman meh tayro parabh  naamaa gi-aanan meh gi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹਨ  ਮਿਹ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਵਾਪਾਰਨ  ਮਿਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Among ways, Yours, God, is the Best Way. Among purifying baths, Yours is the MostPurifying. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jugtan meh t ayree parabh  jugtaa isnaanan meh isnaanee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਬਾਰਨ  ਮਿਹ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ  ਸਰਨ  ਪਾਲਨ  ਟੀਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: Among spiritual powers, Yours, O God, are the Spiritual Powers. Among actions, Yoursare the Greatest Actions.
lines.transliteration: siDhan meh t ayree parabh  siDhaa karman sir karmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਿਖਮੀ  ਕੇਤਕ  ਗਨੀ  ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ਗਿਨ  ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਸੀਕਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Among wills, Your Will, God, is the Supreme Will. Of commands, Yours is the Supreme Command. ||7|| pMnw 508
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa meh tayree parabh  aagi-aa hukman sir hukmaa. ||7||

lines.english: As You cause me to speak, so do I speak, O Lord Master. What other power do I have?
lines.transliteration: ji-o bolaaveh ti-o bolah su-aamee kud rat kavan hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਬੋਲਾਵਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਬੋਲਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਵਨ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, sing His Praises; they are sovery dear to God. ||8||1||8|| gUjrI mhlw 5 Gru 4  (508-3) goojree mehlaa 5 ghar 4 Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (508-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak jas gaa-i-o jo parabh  kee at  pi-aaree. ||8||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
lines.english: O Lord, Man-lion Incarnate, Companion to the poor, Divine Purifier of sinners;
lines.transliteration: naath narhar deen banDh av pat it paavan d ayv.

lines.english: O Destroyer of fear and dread, Merciful Lord  Master, Treasure of Excellence, fruitful is Your service. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhai t araas naas kirpaal gun  niDh safal su-aamee sayv. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ  ਦੀਨ  ਬੰਧਵ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Cherisher of the World, Guru-Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: har gopaal gur gobind.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਸਫਲ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord. Carry me across the terrifyingworld-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: charan saran  da-i-aal kaysav t aar jag bh av sinDh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Dispeller of sexual desire and anger, Eliminator of intoxication and attachment,Destroyer of ego, Honey of the mind;
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh haran mad  moh d ahan muraar man makrand .

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਣ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਕੇਸਵ  ਤਾਿਰ  ਜਗ ਭਵ ਿਸੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran nivaar Dh arneeDhar pat  raakh  parmaanand . ||2|| set me free from birth and death, O Sustainer of the earth, and preserve my honor, OEmbodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

lines.english: The many waves of desire for Maya are burnt away, when the Guru's spiritual wisdomis enshrined in the heart, through the Guru's Mantra.
lines.transliteration: jalat anik t arang maa-i-aa gur gi-aan har rid  mant .

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਹਰਨ  ਮਦ ਮੋਹ ਦਹਨ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ਮਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: Destroy my egotism, O Merciful Lord; dispel my anxiety, O Infinite Primal Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhayd  ahaN-buDh  karun aa mai chint  mayt purakh  anant . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਧਰਣੀਧਰ  ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Remember in meditation the Almighty Lord, every moment and every instant; meditate on God in the celestial peace of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: simar samrath pal mahoorat parabh  Dhi-aan sahj samaaDh .

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਤ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਤਰੰਗ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਰਦ ਮੰਤ ॥
lines.english: O Merciful to the meek, perfectly blissful Lord, I beg for the dust of the feet of theHoly. ||4||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal parsann pooran jaachee-ai raj saaDh . ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਛੇਿਦ  ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਿਚੰਤ  ਮੇਿਟ ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਨੰਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment is false, desire is filthy, and longing is corrupt.
lines.transliteration: moh mithan durant  aasaa baasnaa bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਪਲ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ॥
lines.english: Please, preserve my faith, dispel these doubts from my mind, and save me, OFormless Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: rakh Dh aram bh aram bid aar man t ay uDh ar har nirankaar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ ਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਜਾਚੀਐ  ਰਜ ਸਾਧ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Dhanaadh  aadh  bhandaar har niDh  hot jinaa na cheer. They have become wealthy, loaded with the treasures of the Lord's riches; they werelacking even clothes.
The idiotic, foolish and senseless people have become virtuous and patient, receivingthe Gracious Glance of the Lord of wealth. ||6||
lines.transliteration: khal mugaDh  moorh  kataakh -y sareeDh ar bha-ay gun  mat Dheer. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰਖੁ ਧਰਮ  ਭਰਮ ਿਬਦਾਿਰ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Become Jivan-Mukta, liberated while yet alive, by meditating on the Lord of theUniverse, O mind, and maintaining faith in Him in your heart.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat jagd ees jap man Dh aar rid  parteet.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਿਢ  ਆਿਢ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਿਧ  ਹੋਤ ਿਜਨਾ  ਨ ਚੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Show kindness and mercy to all beings, and realize that the Lord is pervadingeverywhere; this is the way of life of the enlightened soul, the supreme swan. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jee-a da-i-aa ma-i-aa sarbat ar ramn aN param hansah reet . ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਖਲ ਮੁਗਧ  ਮੂੜ ਕਟਾਖਯ੍ਯ੍  ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਮਿਤ ਧੀਰ ॥੬॥
lines.english: He grants the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to those who listen to His Praises, and who, with their tongues, chant His Name.
lines.transliteration: dayt darsan sarvan har jas rasan naam uchaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਤ  ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਰਦ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: They are part and parcel, life and limb with the Lord God; O Nanak, they feel the Touch of God, the Savior of sinners. ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57|| gUjrI kI vwr mhlw 3 iskMdr ibrwihm kI vwr kI DunI gwauxI  (508-14) goojree kee vaar mehlaa 3 sikandar biraahim kee vaar kee Dh unee gaa-un ee Goojaree Ki Vaar, Third Mehl, Sung In The Tune Of The Vaar Of Sikandar & Biraahim: <> siqgur pRswid ] (508-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku mÚ 3 ] (508-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ang sang bhagvaan parsan parabh  naanak pat it uDhaar. ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ  ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਰਮਣੰ  ਪਰਮ  ਹੰਸਹ  ਰੀਿਤ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: This world perishing in attachment and possessiveness; no one knows the way of life.
lines.transliteration: ih jagat mamt aa mu-aa jeevan  kee biDh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ  ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, obtains the supreme status of life.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai jo chalai t aaN jeevan  padvee paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗ  ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ਪਰਸਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰ  ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥੫॥੧॥੧॥੨॥੫੭॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Feet, live foreverand ever.
lines.transliteration: o-ay sadaa sad aa jan jeevt ay jo har charn ee chit  laahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਿਸਕੰਦਰ  ਿਬਰਾਿਹਮ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਉਣੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Lord abides in the minds of the Gurmukhs, who merge incelestial bliss. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (508-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree man vasai gurmukh  sahj samaahi. ||1||

lines.english: Within the self is the pain of doubt; engrossed in worldly affairs, they are killingthemselves.
lines.transliteration: andar sahsaa d ukh hai aapai sir Dh anDhai maar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਮੁਆ  ਜੀਵਣ  ਕੀ ਿਬਿਧ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are in love with, and attachedto Maya.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay sut ay kabeh na jaageh maa-i-aa moh pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤ ਜੀਵਣ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They do not think of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad. This is the conduct of the self-willed manmukhs. pMnw 509
lines.transliteration: naam na cheeteh sabad  na vichaareh ih manmukh  kaa aachaar.

lines.english: 3) har naam na paa-i-aa janam birthaa gavaa-i-aa naanak jam maar karay khu-aar. ||2|| They do not obtain the Lord's Name, and they waste away their lives in vain; O Nanak, the Messenger of Death punishes and dishonors them. ||2|| pauVI ] (509-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਮੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He created Himself - at that time, there was no other.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa aap upaa-i-on t adahu hor na ko-ee.

lines.english: He consulted Himself for advice, and what He did came to pass.
lines.transliteration: mataa masoorat  aap karay jo karay so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਉਪਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਤਦਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: At that time, there were no Akaashic Ethers, no nether regions, nor the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: tadahu aakaas na paat aal hai naa t arai lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਿਤ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: At that time, only the Formless Lord Himself existed - there was no creation.
lines.transliteration: tadahu aapay aap nirankaar hai naa opat  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਕਾਸੁ  ਨ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.english: As it pleased Him, so did He act; without Him, there was no other. ||1|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (509-4) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o tis bh aavai t ivai karay t is bin avar na ko-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਪਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: My Master is eternal. He is seen by practicing the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saahib mayraa sadaa hai d isai sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.english: He never perishes; He does not come or go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: oh a-uhaanee kad ay naahi naa aavai naa jaa-ay.

lines.english: So serve Him, forever and ever; He is contained in all.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa so sayvee-ai jo sabh  meh rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਿਦਸੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Why serve another who is born, and then dies?
lines.transliteration: avar doojaa ki-o sayvee-ai jammai t ai mar jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਅਉਹਾਣੀ  ਕਦੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ਨਾ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: 3) nihfal tin kaa jeevi-aa je kh asam na jaan eh aapn aa avree ka-o chit  laa-ay. Fruitless is the life of those who do not know their Lord and Master, and who center their consciousness on others.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it cannot be known, how much punishment the Creator shall inflict on them. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (509-7) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayv na jaap-ee kartaa kayt ee day-ay sajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਿਕਉ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai sabh o vart ai sach.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਫਲੁ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਿਜ ਖਸਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਅਵਰੀ  ਕਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one becomesacceptable, and then obtains the fruit of Truth.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam bujh parvaan  ho-ay t aa fal paavai sach.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕੇਤੀ  ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He wanders around babbling and speaking, but he does not understand the Lord'sCommand at all. He is blind, the falsest of the false. ||2|| pauVI ] (509-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee kart aa firai hukmai mool na bujh -ee anDh aa kach nikach. ||2||

lines.english: Creating union and separation, He laid the foundations of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: sanjog vijog upaa-i-on saristee kaa mool rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By His Command, the Lord of Light fashioned the Universe, and infused His DivineLight into it.
lines.transliteration: hukmee sarisat saajee-an jotee jot  milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਿਝ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.english: From the Lord of Light, all light originates. The True Guru proclaims the Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: jotee hooN sabh  chaann aa sat gur sabad  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨੀ  ਬਦਨੀ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਫਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਕਚੁ ਿਨਕਚੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, under the influence of the three dispositions, were put to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays tarai gun  sir Dh anDhai laa-i-aa.

lines.english: He created the root of Maya, and the peace obtained in the fourth state of consciousness. ||2|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (509-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaa mool rachaa-i-on turee-aa sukh  paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: That alone is chanting, and that alone is deep meditation, which is pleasing to theTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: so jap so tap je sat gur bh aavai.

lines.english: Pleasing the True Guru, glorious greatness is obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai vadi-aa-ee paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਹੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, renouncing self-conceit, one merges into the Guru. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (509-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap chhod gur maahi samaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਿਸਿਰ  ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: How rare are those who receive the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sikh ko virlaa layvai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਤੁਰੀਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone receives it, whom the Lord Himself blesses with glorious greatness.||2|| pauVI ] (509-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis aap vadi-aa-ee dayvai. ||2||

lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is spiritual darkness; it is very difficult and such a heavy load.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh agi-aan hai bikham at  bhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Loaded with so very many stones of sin, how can the boat cross over?
lines.transliteration: pathar paap baho ladi-aa ki-o t aree-ai t aaree.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Lord's devotional worship night and day are carriedacross.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agtee rat i-aa har paar ut aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Under the Instruction of the Guru's Shabad, one sheds egotism and corruption, andthe mind becomes immaculate.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee man nirmalaa ha-umai chh ad vikaaree.

lines.english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, is our Saving Grace.||3|| sloku ] (509-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai har har nist aaree. ||3||

lines.english: O Kabeer, the gate of liberation is narrow, less than one-tenth of a mustard seed.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mukat d u-aaraa sankurh aa raa-ee d asvai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: The mind has become as big as an elephant; how can it pass through this gate?
lines.transliteration: man ta-o maigal ho-ay rahaa niksi-aa ki-o kar jaa-ay.

lines.english: If one meets such a True Guru, by His Pleasure, He shows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: aisaa satgur jay milai t uthaa karay pasaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Then, the gate of liberation becomes wide open, and the soul easily passes through. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (509-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mukat d u-aaraa moklaa sehjay aava-o jaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਥਰ  ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਲਿਦਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the gate of liberation is very narrow; only the very tiny can pass through.
lines.transliteration: naanak mukat d u-aaraa at  neekaa naanHaa ho-ay so jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਿਤਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through egotism, the mind has become bloated. How can it pass through?
lines.transliteration: ha-umai man asthool hai ki-o kar vich day jaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, egotism departs, and one is filled with the Divine Light. pMnw 510
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai ha-umai ga-ee jot  rahee sabh  aa-ay.

lines.english: Then, this soul is liberated forever, and it remains absorbed in celestial bliss. ||2|| pauVI ] (510-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ih jee-o sadaa mukat  hai sehjay rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: God created the Universe, and He keeps it under His power.
lines.transliteration: parabh sansaar upaa-ay kai vas aapn ai keet aa.

lines.english: God cannot be obtained by counting; the mortal wanders in doubt.
lines.transliteration: gantai parabh oo na paa-ee-ai d oojai bh armeet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਆਪਣੈ  ਕੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one remains dead while yet alive; understanding Him, he is absorbed in the Truth.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai jeevat  marai bujh  sach sameet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is eradicated, and one is united in theLord's Union.
lines.transliteration: sabday ha-umai kh o-ee-ai har mayl mileet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਬੁਿਝ ਸਿਚ ਸਮੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He knows everything, and Himself does everything; beholding His Creation, Herejoices. ||4|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (510-4) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  jaanai karay aap aapay vigseet aa. ||4||

lines.english: One who has not focused his consciousness on the True Guru, and into whose mindthe Naam does not come
lines.transliteration: satgur si-o chit  na laa-i-o naam na vasi-o man aa-ay.

lines.english: Dharig ivayhaa jeevi-aa ki-aa jug meh paa-i-aa aa-ay. - cursed is such a life. What has he gained by coming into the world?
Maya is false capital; in an instant, its false covering falls off.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa khotee raas hai ayk chasay meh paaj leh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਨ ਲਾਇਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਓ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: When it slips from his hand, his body turns black, and his face withers away.
lines.transliteration: hathahu chhurh kee tan si-aahu ho-ay bad an jaa-ay kumlaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਇਵੇਹਾ  ਜੀਿਵਆ ਿਕਆ  ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru - peace comes to abide in their minds.
lines.transliteration: jin satgur si-o chit  laa-i-aa t inH sukh  vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They meditate on the Name of the Lord with love; they are lovingly attuned to theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aavahi rang si-o har naam rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਤਨੁ ਿਸਆਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਦਨੁ ਜਾਇ  ਕੁਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Guru has bestowed upon them the wealth, which remainscontained within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur so Dh an sa-upi-aa je jee-a meh rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are imbued with supreme love; its color increases day by day. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (510-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: rang tisai ka-o aglaa vannee charh ai charh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Maya is a serpent, clinging to the world.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa ho-ee naagnee jagat rahee laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਿਪਆ  ਿਜ ਜੀਅ  ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever serves her, she ultimately devours.
lines.transliteration: is kee sayvaa jo karay tis hee ka-o fir kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਕਉ ਅਗਲਾ  ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is a snake-charmer; he has trampled her and thrown her down, andcrushed her underfoot.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ko-ee gaarrh oo tin mal d al laa-ee paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone are saved, who remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (510-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak say-ee ubray je sach rahay liv laa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਹੋਈ ਨਾਗਨੀ  ਜਗਿਤ  ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The minstrel cries out, and God hears him.
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee karay pukaar parabh oo sun aa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਿਫਿਰ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is comforted within his mind, and he obtains the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: andar Dh eerak ho-ay pooraa paa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਕੋਈ ਗਾਰੜੂ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਮਿਲ ਦਿਲ  ਲਾਈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever destiny is pre-ordained by the Lord, those are the deeds he does.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa laykh  say karam kamaa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ  ਿਜ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the Lord and Master becomes Merciful, then one obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as his home.
lines.transliteration: jaa hovai khasam d a-i-aal t aa mahal gh ar paa-isee.

lines.english: That God of mine is so very great; as Gurmukh, I have met Him. ||5|| slok mÚ 3 ] (510-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so parabh mayraa at  vadaa gurmukh  maylaa-isee. ||5||

lines.english: There is One Lord God of all; He remains ever-present.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa saho ayk hai sad  hee rahai hajoor.

lines.english: O Nanak, if one does not obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then within one'sown home, the Lord seems far away.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na mann-ee taa gh ar hee and ar door.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: They alone obey the Lord's Command, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: hukam bhee t inHaa manaa-isee jinH ka-o nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਸਮੁ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Obeying His Command, one obtains peace, and becomes the happy, loving soul-bride. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (510-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hukam man sukh paa-i-aa paraym suhaagan  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਿਤ  ਵਡਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੇਲਾਇਸੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: She who does not love her Husband Lord, burns and wastes away all through thenight of her life.
lines.transliteration: rain sabaa-ee jal mu-ee kant  na laa-i-o bh aa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-brides dwell in peace; they have the Lord, their King, as theirHusband. ||2|| pauVI ] (510-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh vasan sohaagan ee jinH pi-aaraa purakh  har raa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਸਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Roaming over the entire world, I have seen that the Lord is the only Giver.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag fir mai d aykhi-aa har iko d aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਈ  ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The Lord cannot be obtained by any device at all; He is the Architect of Karma.
lines.transliteration: upaa-ay kitai na paa-ee-ai har karam biDh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭੀ ਿਤਨਾ  ਮਨਾਇਸੀ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and theLord is easily revealed within.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har man vasai har sehjay jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fire of desire within is quenched, and one bathes in the Lord's Pool of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: andrahu t arisnaa agan bujh ee har amrit  sar naat aa.

lines.english: The great greatness of the great Lord God - the Gurmukh speaks of this. ||6|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (510-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee vaday kee gurmukh bolaat aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਸਬਾਈ  ਜਿਲ  ਮੁਈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: What love is this between the body and soul, which ends when the body falls?
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa hans ki-aa pareet hai je pa-i-aa hee chh ad jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਿਖ ਵਸਿਨ  ਸਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Why feed it by telling lies? When you leave, it does not go with you. pMnw 511
lines.transliteration: ays no koorh bol ke kh avaalee-ai je chald i-aa naal na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਿਲ ਿਕ ਖਵਾਲੀਐ  ਿਜ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The body is merely blind dust; go, and ask the soul.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa mitee anDh hai pa-un ai puchh ahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਿਮਟੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਪਉਣੈ  ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The soul answers, "I am enticed by Maya, and so I come and go, again and again."
lines.transliteration: ha-o taa maa-i-aa mohi-aa fir fir aavaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I do not know my Lord and Master's Command, by which I would merge in the Truth. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (511-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na jaato kh asam kaa je rahaa sach samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਿਜ ਰਹਾ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only permanent wealth; all other wealth comes and goes.
lines.transliteration: ayko nihchal naam Dhan hor Dh an aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Thieves cannot steal this wealth, nor can robbers take it away.
lines.transliteration: is Dhan ka-o t askar johi na sak-ee naa ochkaa lai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This wealth of the Lord is embedded in the soul, and with the soul, it shall depart.
lines.transliteration: ih har Dhan jee-ai sayt ee rav rahi-aa jee-ai naalay jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਨਾ ਓਚਕਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It is obtained from the Perfect Guru; the self-willed manmukhs do not receive it.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay paa-ee-ai manmukh  palai na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਐ  ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜੀਐ  ਨਾਲੇ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan vaapaaree naankaa jinHaa naam Dh an kh ati-aa aa-ay. ||2|| Blessed are the traders, O Nanak, who have come to earn the wealth of the Naam.||2|| pauVI ] (511-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My Master is so very great, true, profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: mayraa saahib at vadaa sach gahir gambh eeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਆ  ਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The whole world is under His power; everything is the projection of Him.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag t is kai vas hai sabh  tis kaa cheeraa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the eternal wealth is obtained, bringing peace and patience to themind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-ee-ai nihchal Dhan Dh eeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਿਤ  ਵਡਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, the Lord dwells in the mind, and one meets the Brave Guru.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa tay har man vasai bh aytai gur sooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਚੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous praise the ever-stable, permanent, perfect Lord. ||7|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (511-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee salaahi-aa sad aa thir nihchal har pooraa. ||7||

lines.english: 3) Dharig t inHaa daa jeevi-aa jo har sukh  parhar t i-aagd ay dukh ha-umai paap kamaa-ay. Cursed is the life of those who forsake and throw away the peace of the Lord's Name, and suffer pain instead by practicing ego and sin.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of Maya; they have nounderstanding at all.
lines.transliteration: manmukh agi-aanee maa-i-aa mohi vi-aapay t inH boojh  na kaa-ee paa-ay.

lines.english: In this world and in the world beyond, they do not find peace; in the end, they departregretting and repenting.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  o-ay sukh  na paavahi ant  ga-ay pachh utaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one may meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and egotismdeparts from within him.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ko naam Dhi-aa-ay t is ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਦਾ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਿਤਆਗਦੇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes and falls at the Guru's Feet.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (511-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis poorab hovai likhi-aa so gur charn ee aa-ay paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਿਤਨ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is like the inverted lotus; he has neither devotional worship,nor the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ooDh aa ka-ul hai naa t is bhagat na naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਓਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He remains engrossed in material wealth, and his efforts are false.
lines.transliteration: saktee and ar varatd aa koorh  tis kaa hai upaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His consciousness is not softened within, and the words from his mouth are insipid.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa and ar chit  na bh ij-ee mukh  feekaa aalaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਆਇ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not mingle with the righteous; within him are falsehood and selfishness.
lines.transliteration: o-ay Dharam ralaa-ay naa ralniH onaa and ar koorh  su-aa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord has arranged things, so that the self-willed manmukhs aredrowned by telling lies, while the Gurmukhs are saved by chanting the Lord's Name.||2|| pauVI ] (511-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: vwr, mÚ 3) naanak kartai ban at banaa-ee manmukh  koorh  bol bol dubay gurmukh  taray jap har naa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਊਧਾ ਕਉਲੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਗਿਤ ਨ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without understanding, one must wander around the cycle of reincarnation, andcontinue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay vadaa fayr pa-i-aa fir aavai jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਤੀ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਉਪਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who has not served the True Guru, shall depart regretting and repenting in the end.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa na keet ee-aa ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਿਚਤੁ  ਨ ਿਭਜਈ  ਮੁਿਖ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, one finds the Guru, and ego is banished from within.
lines.transliteration: aapnee kirpaa karay gur paa-ee-ai vichahu aap gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਧਰਿਮ  ਰਲਾਏ  ਨਾ ਰਲਿਨ  ਓਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Hunger and thirst depart from within, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa bh ukh vichahu ut rai sukh  vasai man aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ ਬੋਿਲ ਡੁਬੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਰੇ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, praise Him with love in your heart. ||8|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (511-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa salaahee-ai hird ai liv laa-ee. ||8||

lines.english: One who serves his True Guru, is worshipped by everyone.
lines.transliteration: je satgur sayvay aapn aa tis no poojay sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਵਡਾ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Of all efforts, the supreme effort is the attainment of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa upaavaa sir upaa-o hai har naam paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Peace and tranquility come to dwell within  the mind; meditating within the heart, there comes a lasting peace.
lines.transliteration: antar seet al saat  vasai jap hird ai sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Amrit is his food, and the Ambrosial Amrit is his clothes; O Nanak,through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (511-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: amrit kh aanaa amrit  painn aa naanak naam vadaa-ee ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, listen to the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the treasure of virtue. pMnw 512
lines.transliteration: ay man gur kee sikh sun  har paavahi gun ee niDh aan.

lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, shall dwell in your mind, and your egotism and pride shall depart.
lines.transliteration: har sukh-d aata man vasai ha-umai jaa-ay gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then, night and day, onecenters his meditation on the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (512-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai t aa an-d in laagai Dh i-aan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਤਾ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is totally truthful, content and pure.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh sabh  sach hai gurmukh  pavit aa.

lines.english: Deception and wickedness have departed from within him, and he easily conquers hismind.
lines.transliteration: andrahu kapat vikaar ga-i-aa man sehjay jit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਿਵਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: There, the Divine Light and the essence of bliss are manifest, and ignorance iseliminated.
lines.transliteration: tah jot  pargaas anand ras agi-aan gavit aa.

lines.english: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and manifests the excellence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din har kay gun  ravai gun  pargat kit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਜੋਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਅਨੰਦ  ਰਸੁ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਗਿਵਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Giver of all; the Lord alone is our friend. ||9|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (512-4) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa d aataa ayk hai iko har mit aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਿਕਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who understands God, who lovingly centers his mind on the Lord night and day,is called a Brahmin.
lines.transliteration: barahm binday so baraahman  kahee-ai je an-d in har liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਤਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Consulting the True Guru, he practices Truth and self-restraint, and he is rid of thedisease of ego.
lines.transliteration: satgur puchh ai sach sanjam kamaavai ha-umai rog t is jaa-ay.

lines.english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and gathers in His Praises; his light isblended with the Light.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai gun  sangrahai jot ee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਬੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਜ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: In this world, one who knows God is very rare; eradicating ego, he is absorbed inGod.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh ko virlaa barahm gi-aanee je ha-umai mayt samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਛੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting him, peace is obtained; night and day, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (512-7) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis no mili-aa sad aa sukh  paa-ee-ai je an-d in har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੈ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Within the ignorant self-willed manmukh is deception; with his tongue, he speaks lies.
lines.transliteration: antar kapat manmukh  agi-aanee rasnaa jh ooth bolaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਿਜ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਿਟ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Practicing deception, he does not please the Lord God, who always sees and hearswith natural ease.
lines.transliteration: kapat keetai har purakh  na bh eejai nit  vaykh ai sun ai subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, he goes to instruct the world, but he is engrossed in the poisonof Maya and attachment to pleasure.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay jaa-ay jag parboDh ai bikh  maa-i-aa moh su-aa-ay.

lines.english: By doing so, he suffers in constant pain; he is born and then dies, and comes andgoes again and again.
lines.transliteration: it kamaan ai sad aa dukh paavai jammai marai fir aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਪਟੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His doubts do not leave him at all, and he rots away in manure.
lines.transliteration: sahsaa mool na chuk-ee vich vistaa pachai pachaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਪਿਟ  ਕੀਤੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਿਨਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One, unto whom my Lord Master shows His Mercy, listens to the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay mayraa su-aamee tis gur kee sikh  sunaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਜਾਇ  ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He meditates on the Lord's Name, and sings the Lord's Name; in the end, the Lord'sName will deliver him. ||2|| pauVI ] (512-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aavai har naamo gaavai har naamo ant  chhadaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, are the perfect persons in the world.
lines.transliteration: jinaa hukam manaa-i-on tay pooray sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They serve their Lord Master, and reflect upon the Perfect Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saahib sayvniH aapnaa poorai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਿਸਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They serve the Lord, and love the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har kee sayvaa chaakree sachai sabad pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਿਤ  ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, as they eradicate egotism fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: har kaa mahal tinHee paa-i-aa jinH ha-umai vichahu maar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with Him, chanting the Name of the Lord, andenshrining it within their hearts. ||10|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (512-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mil rahay jap har naamaa ur Dh aar. ||10||

lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord; the celestial sound-current resounds within him,and he focuses his consciousness on the True Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh Dh i-aan sahj Dh un upjai sach naam chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh remains imbued with the Lord's Love, night and day; his mind is pleasedwith the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh an-d in rahai rang raat aa har kaa naam man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord, and the Gurmukh naturally loves the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har vaykh eh gurmukh  har boleh gurmukh  har sahj rang laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਨ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and the pitch-black darkness ofignorance is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh gi-aan paraapat  hovai t imar agi-aan aDh ayr chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by the Perfect Lord's Grace - as Gurmukh, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (512-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no karam hovai Dhur pooraa t in gurmukh  har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru do not embrace love for the Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur jinaa na sayvi-o sabad  na lago pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They do not meditate on the Celestial Naam, the Name of the Lord - why did theyeven bother to come into the world?
lines.transliteration: sehjay naam na Dhi-aa-i-aa kit  aa-i-aa sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Time and time again, they are reincarnated, and they rot away forever in manure.
lines.transliteration: fir fir joonee paa-ee-ai vistaa sadaa kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸਹਿਜ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They are attached to false greed; they are not on this shore, nor on the one beyond. pMnw 513
lines.transliteration: koorhai laalach lagi-aa naa urvaar na paar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਿਜ ਆਿਪ  ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Creator Lord unites them with Himself. ||2|| pauVI ] (513-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ubray je aap maylay kart aar. ||2||

lines.english: The devotees look beauteous in the True Court of the Lord; they abide in the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sachai d ar sohd ay sachai sabad  rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਸਚੈ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹਦੇ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਰਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Love wells up in them; they are attracted by the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: har kee pareet t in oopjee har paraym kasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਤਨ ਊਪਜੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They abide in the Lord's Love, they remain imbued with the Lord's Love forever, andwith their tongues, they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har rang raheh sadaa rang raat ay rasnaa har ras pi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਿਪਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful are the lives of those Gurmukhs who recognize the Lord and enshrine Him intheir hearts.
lines.transliteration: safal janam jinHee gurmukh jaat aa har jee-o rid ai vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, they wander around crying out in misery; in the love of duality,they are ruined. ||11|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (513-4) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo firai billaad ee doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay. ||11||

lines.english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the devotees earn the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they obtain the supreme status of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kalijug meh naam niDhaan bh agtee kh ati-aa har ut am pad  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, they enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds, and theymeditate on the Naam, night and day.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv har naam man vasaa-i-aa an-d in naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਖਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਉਤਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of their own selves, they remain unattached, through the Guru'sTeachings; they burn away egotism and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: vichay garih gur bachan udaasee ha-umai moh jalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਿਵ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They save themselves, and they save the whole world. Blessed are the mothers whogave birth to them.
lines.transliteration: aap tari-aa kul jagat  taraa-i-aa Dh an jan aydee maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚੇ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He alone finds such a True Guru, upon whose forehead the Lord inscribed such pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: aisaa satgur so-ee paa-ay jis Dh ur mast ak har likh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਕੁਲ ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to his Guru; when he was wandering in doubt, He placedhim on the Path. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (513-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak balihaaree gur aapnay vitahu jin bh aram bh ulaa maarag paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਸੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Beholding Maya with her three dispositions, he goes astray; he is like the moth, whichsees the flame, and is consumed.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa vaykh  bhulay ji-o d aykh deepak pat ang pachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁ ਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mistaken, deluded Pandits gaze upon Maya, and watch to see whether anyone has offered them something.
lines.transliteration: pandit bh ul bhul maa-i-aa vaykh eh dikhaa kinai kihu aan  charh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the love of duality, they read continually about sin, while the Lord has withheld HisName from them.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay parh eh nit  bikhi-aa naavhu d a-yi kh u-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ  ਵੇਿਖ ਭੁਲੇ ਿਜਉ ਦੇਿਖ ਦੀਪਿਕ  ਪਤੰਗ ਪਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Yogis, the wandering hermits and the Sannyaasees have gone astray; theiregotism and arrogance have increased greatly.
lines.transliteration: jogee jangam sani-aasee bhulay onHaa ahaNkaar baho garab vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਭੁਿਲ ਭੁਿਲ ਮਾਇਆ  ਵੇਖਿਹ  ਿਦਖਾ  ਿਕਨੈ ਿਕਹੁ ਆਿਣ  ਚੜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They do not accept the true donations of clothes and food, and their lives are ruinedby their stubborn minds.
lines.transliteration: chhaad an bh ojan na laihee sat  bhikhi-aa manhath  janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਪੜਿਹ ਿਨਤ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਨਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਯ  ਖੁਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Among these, he alone is a man of poise, who, as Gurmukh, meditates on the Naam,the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayt-rh i-aa vichahu so jan samDh aa jin gurmukh  naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੰਗਮ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਭੁਲੇ ਓਨਾ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Unto whom should servant Nanak speak and complain? All act as the Lord causesthem to act. ||2|| pauVI ] (513-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kis no aakh sun aa-ee-ai jaa kard ay sabh  karaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਹੀ ਸਤ ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya, sexual desire, anger and egotism are demons.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh parayt hai kaam kroDh  ahaNkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤਿੜਆ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Because of them, mortals are subject to death; above their heads hangs the heavyclub of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: ayh jam kee sirkaar hai aynHaa upar jam kaa dand karaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ਜਾ ਕਰਦੇ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, are led onto the path of Death.
lines.transliteration: manmukh jam mag paa-ee-aniH jinH doojaa bh aa-o pi-aaraa.

lines.english: In the City of Death, they are tied up and beaten, and no one hears their cries.
lines.transliteration: jam pur baDhay maaree-an ko sun ai na pookaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰੇਤੁ  ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace meets the Guru; as Gurmukh, he isemancipated. ||12|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (513-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay tis gur milai gurmukh  nistaaraa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਿਸਰਕਾਰ  ਹੈ ਏਨਾ ਉਪਿਰ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: By egotism and pride, the self-willed manmukhs are enticed, and consumed.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa mohn ee manmukh aa no ga-ee kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜਮ ਮਿਗ ਪਾਈਅਿਨ  ਿਜਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who center their consciousness on duality are caught in it, and remain stuck.
lines.transliteration: jo mohi doojai chit  laa-id ay tinaa vi-aap rahee laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਨ  ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: But when it is burnt away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, only then does it departfrom within.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad parjaalee-ai t aa ayh vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.english: The body and mind become radiant and bright, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord,comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: tan man hovai ujlaa naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is the antidote to Maya; the Gurmukh obtains it. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (513-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak maa-i-aa kaa maaran har naam hai gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This mind has wandered through so many ages; it has not remained stable - itcontinues coming and going.
lines.transliteration: ih man kayt-rh i-aa jug bh armi-aa thir rahai na aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮੋਿਹ ਦੂਜੈ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਦੇ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਵਆਿਪ  ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When it is pleasing to the Lord's Will, then He causes the soul to wander; He has setthe world-drama in motion.
lines.transliteration: har bhaan aa taa bh armaa-i-an kar parpanch kh ayl upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ  ਤਾ ਏਹ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord forgives, then one meets the Guru, and becoming stable, he remains absorbed in the Lord. pMnw 514
lines.transliteration: jaa har bakhsay t aa gur milai asthir rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the mind, the mind is satisfied, and then, nothing comes or goes. ||2|| pauVI ] (514-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak man hee tay man maani-aa naa kichh  marai na jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਨਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The body is the fortress of the Infinite Lord; it is obtained only by destiny.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kot apaar hai milnaa sanjogee.

lines.english: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He Himself is the Enjoyer of pleasures.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar aap vas rahi-aa aapay ras bh ogee.

lines.english: He Himself remains detached and unaffected; while unattached, He is still attached.
lines.transliteration: aap ateet  alipat  hai nirjog har jogee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਿਸ ਰਿਹਆ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.english: He does whatever He pleases, and whatever He does, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so karay har karay so hogee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਨਰਜੋਗੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜੋਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name, and separation from the Lord is ended. ||13|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (514-4) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai leh jaahi vijogee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀ ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord Himself causes us to praise Him, through the True Word ofthe Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu aap akhaa-id aa gur sabd ee sach so-ay.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is His Eulogy and Praise; how rare are the Gurmukhs who understandthis.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu sifat salaah hai gurmukh  boojh ai ko-ay.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Word of His Bani, by which we meet our True Lord.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu banee sach hai sach milaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਅਖਾਇਦਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chanting Waaho! Waaho! God is attained; by His Grace, He is obtained.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (514-6) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu karti-aa parabh  paa-i-aa karam paraapat  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the tongue is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu kartee rasnaa sabad  suhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Shabad, one comes to meet God.
lines.transliteration: poorai sabad parabh  mili-aa aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: How very fortunate are those, who with their mouths, chant Waaho! Waaho!
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee-aa vaahu vaahu muhhu kadh aa-ee.

lines.english: How beautiful are those persons who chant Waaho! Waaho! ; people come tovenerate them.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karahi say-ee jan sohnay t inH ka-o parjaa poojan  aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤੀ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸੁਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is obtained by His Grace; O Nanak, honor is obtained at the Gate ofthe True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (514-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karam paraapat hovai naanak d ar sachai sobh aa paa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Within the fortress of body, are the hard and rigid doors of falsehood, deception andpride.
lines.transliteration: bajar kapaat kaa-i-aa garhH bheetar koorh  kusat  abhimaanee.

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, the blind and ignorant self-willed manmukhs cannot see them.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh oolay nad ar na aavnee manmukh  anDh  agi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਹ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਪਰਜਾ  ਪੂਜਣ  ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: They cannot be found by any efforts; wearing their religious robes, the wearers have grown weary of trying.
lines.transliteration: upaa-ay kitai na labh nee kar bh aykh thakay bh aykhvaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The doors are opened only by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and then, one chantsthe Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee kh olaa-ee-aniH har naam japaanee.

lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Tree of Ambrosial Nectar; those who drink in this Nectar aresatisfied. ||14|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (514-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jee-o amrit birakh  hai jin pee-aa t ay tariptaanee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਬਜਰ  ਕਪਾਟ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਗੜ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the night of one's life passes in peace.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karti-aa rain  sukh  vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੂਲੇ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਨੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! I am in eternal bliss, O my mother!
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karti-aa sad aa anand hovai mayree maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਲਭਨੀ  ਕਿਰ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਵਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, I have fallen in love with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karti-aa har si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਖੋਲਾਈਅਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Through the karma of good deeds, I chant it, and inspire others tochant it as well.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karmee bolai bolaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਪੀਆ  ਤੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, one obtains honor.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karti-aa sobh aa paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! is the Will of the True Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (514-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu sat rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani of the True Word. Searching, the Gurmukhs have found it.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu banee sach hai gurmukh  laDhee bh aal.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! They chant the Word of the Shabad. Waaho! Waaho! They enshrine itin their hearts.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu sabday uchrai vaahu vaahu hird ai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the Gurmukhs easily obtain the Lord, after searching.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karti-aa har paa-i-aa sehjay gurmukh  bhaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who reflect upon the Lord, Har, Har, within theirhearts. ||2|| pauVI ] (514-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee naankaa har har rid ai samaal. ||2||

lines.english: O my utterly greedy mind, you are constantly engrossed in greed.
lines.transliteration: ay manaa at lobh ee-aa nit  lobhay raat aa.

lines.english: In your desire for the enticing Maya, you wander in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mansaa mohnee d ah dis firaat aa.

lines.english: Your name and social status shall not go with you hereafter; the self-willed manmukh is consumed by pain.
lines.transliteration: agai naa-o jaat na jaa-isee manmukh  dukh khaataa.

lines.english: Your tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord; it utters only insipidwords.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har ras na chakhi-o feekaa bolaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਲਧੀ  ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar are satisfied. ||15|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (514-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinaa gurmukh amrit  chaakh i-aa say jan t ariptaataa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦੇ  ਉਚਰੈ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is True, profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakh ee-ai je sachaa gahir gambh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of virtue, intelligence and patience. pMnw 515
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakh ee-ai je gund aataa mat  Dheer.

lines.english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is permeating and pervading in all.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakh ee-ai je sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of sustenance to all.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakh ee-ai je d aydaa rijak sabaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜ ਦੇਦਾ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸਬਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! - praise the One Lord, revealed by the True Guru. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (515-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu iko kar salaahee-ai je satgur d ee-aa d ikhaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! The Gurmukhs praise the Lord continually, while the self-willedmanmukhs eat poison and die.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu gurmukh sad aa karahi manmukh  mareh bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.english: They have no love for the Lord's Praises, and they pass their lives in misery.
lines.transliteration: onaa vaahu vaahu na bhaav-ee d ukhay dukh vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ  ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and they center their consciousness onthe Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh amrit  peevn aa vaahu vaahu karahi liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਿਖ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! are immaculate and pure; they obtain theknowledge of the three worlds. ||2|| pauVI ] (515-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu karahi say jan nirmalay taribh avan sojhee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵਣਾ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Will, one meets the Guru, serves Him, and worships the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai gur milai sayvaa bh agat baneejai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਹ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Will, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one easily drinks in thesublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai har man vasai sehjay ras peejai.

lines.english: By the Lord's Will, one finds peace, and continually earns the Lord's Profit.
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai sukh  paa-ee-ai har laahaa nit  leejai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਨੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is seated on the Lord's throne, and he dwells continually in the home of his own being.
lines.transliteration: har kai takh at bahaalee-ai nij gh ar sad aa vaseejai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone surrenders to the Lord's Will, who meets the Guru. ||16|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (515-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kaa bhaan aa tinee mani-aa jinaa guroo mileejai. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਹਾ  ਿਨਤ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Those humble beings ever praise the Lord, unto whom the LordHimself grants understanding.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu say jan sadaa karahi jinH ka-o aapay d ay-ay bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਤਖਿਤ  ਬਹਾਲੀਐ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਵਸੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, the mind is purified, and egotism departs from within.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karti-aa man nirmal hovai ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh who continually chants Waaho! Waaho! attains the fruits of his heart'sdesires.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu gursikh jo nit  karay so man chind i-aa fal paa-ay.

lines.english: Beauteous are those humble beings who chant Waaho! Waaho! O Lord, let me jointhem!
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karahi say jan sohnay har t inH kai sang milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within my heart, I chant Waaho! Waaho!, and with my mouth, Waaho! Waaho!
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu hirdai uchraa mukh ahu bh ee vaahu vaahu karay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! - unto them I dedicate my body and mind. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (515-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo karahi ha-o tan man t inH ka-o d ay-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਜੋ ਿਨਤ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Lord Master; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu saahib sach hai amrit jaa kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the Lord are blessed with the fruit; I am a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa tin fal paa-i-aa ha-o t in balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਉਚਰਾ  ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਉ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is the treasure of virtue; he alone tastes it, who is so blessed.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu gunee niDh aan hai jis no d ay-ay so kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਿਹ  ਹਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਨ ਕਉ  ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is pervading and permeating the oceans and the land; the Gurmukh attains Him.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu jal thal bharpoor hai gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Let all the Gursikhs continually praise Him. Waaho! Waaho! The Perfect Guru is pleased with His Praises.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu gursikh nit  sabh  karahu gur pooray vaahu vaahu bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who chants Waaho! Waaho! with his heart and mind - the Messenger ofDeath does not approach him. ||2|| pauVI ] (515-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo man chit karay t is jamkankar nayrh  na aavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Truest of the True; True is the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sachaa sach hai sachee gurbaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Guru, the Truth is realized, and one is easily absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay sach pachh aanee-ai sach sahj samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they remain awake, and do not sleep; in wakefulness, the night oftheir lives passes.
lines.transliteration: an-din jaageh naa saveh jaagat  rain vihaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, arethe most worthy persons.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har ras chaakh i-aa say punn paraan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; the ignorant rot away and die. ||17|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (515-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bin gur kinai na paa-i-o pach mu-ay ajaanee. ||17||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani, the Word, of the Formless Lord. There is no other asgreat as He is.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu banee nirankaar hai t is jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is unfathomable and inaccessible. Waaho! Waaho! He is theTrue One.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu agam athaahu hai vaahu vaahu sachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਿਚ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! He is the self-existent Lord. Waaho! Waaho! As He wills, so it comesto pass.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu vayparvaahu hai vaahu vaahu karay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਹ  ਨਾ ਸਵਿਹ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtainedby the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu amrit naam hai gurmukh  paavai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! This is realized by His Grace, as He Himself grants His Grace. pMnw 516
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karmee paa-ee-ai aap da-i-aa kar d ay-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! This is obtained by the Gurmukhs, who hold tight to the Naam, night and day. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (516-1) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu gurmukh paa-ee-ai an-d in naam la-ay-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained, and the sense of duality doesnot depart.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay saat  na aavee d oojee naahee jaa-ay.

lines.english: No matter how much one may wish, without the Lord's Grace, He is not found.
lines.transliteration: jay bahutayraa lochee-ai vin  karmai na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are filled with greed and corruption are ruined by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa antar lobh  vikaar hai d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They cannot escape birth and death, and with egotism within them, they suffer in misery.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  na chuk-ee ha-umai vich d ukh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who center their consciousness on the True Guru, never go empty-handed.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa satgur si-o chit  laa-i-aa so kh aalee ko-ee naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: tin jam kee t alab na hova-ee naa o-ay d ukh sahaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਸੁ ਖਾਲੀ  ਕੋਈ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they merge in the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (516-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ubray sachai sabad  samaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is called a minstrel, who enshrines love for his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee tis no aakh ee-ai je kh asmai Dh aray pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Standing at the Lord's Door, he serves the Lord, and reflects upon the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: dar kh arhaa sayvaa karay gur sabd ee veechaar.

lines.english: The minstrel attains the Lord's Gate and Mansion, and he keeps the True Lord claspedto his heart.
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee dar ghar paa-isee sach rakh ai ur Dh aar.

lines.english: The status of the minstrel is exalted; he loves the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee kaa mahal aglaa har kai naa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਖੜਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The service of the minstrel is to meditate on the Lord; he is emancipated by the Lord. ||18|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (516-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee kee sayvaa chaakree har jap har nist aar. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਢੀ  ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ  ਸਚੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The milkmaid's status is very low, but she attains her Husband Lord
lines.transliteration: goojree jaat gavaar jaa saho paa-ay aapn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਅਗਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad veechaar an-d in har jap jaapn aa. when she reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and chants the Lord's Name,night and day.

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਢੀ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਿਰ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: She who meets the True Guru, lives in the Fear of God; she is a woman of noble birth.
lines.transliteration: jis satgur milai t is bha-o pavai saa kulvant ee naar.

lines.english: She alone realizes the Hukam of her Husband Lord's Command, who is blessed by theCreator Lord's Mercy.
lines.transliteration: saa hukam pachhaan ai kant  kaa jis no kirpaa keet ee kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਗਵਾਿਰ  ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: She who is of little merit and ill-mannered, is discarded and forsaken by her HusbandLord.
lines.transliteration: oh kuchjee kulkhan ee parhar chh odee bh ataar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: By the Fear of God, filth is washed off, and the body becomes immaculately pure.
lines.transliteration: bhai pa-i-ai mal katee-ai nirmal hovai sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ  ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The soul is enlightened, and the intellect is exalted, meditating on the Lord, the oceanof excellence.
lines.transliteration: antar pargaas mat  ootam hovai har jap gun ee gaheer.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਕੰਤ ਕਾ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who dwells in the Fear of God, lives in the Fear of God, and acts in the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich baisai bh ai rahai bh ai vich kamaavai kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਕੁਚਜੀ  ਕੁਲਖਣੀ  ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He obtains peace and glorious greatness here, in the Lord's Court, and at the Gate ofSalvation.
lines.transliteration: aithai sukh vad i-aa-ee-aa d argeh mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ  ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and one's light merges in theInfinite Light.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay nirbh a-o paa-ee-ai mil jot ee jot  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that bride alone is good, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master, and whomthe Creator Lord Himself forgives. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (516-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak khasmai bh aavai saa bh alee jis no aapay bakh say kart aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਬੈਸੈ ਭੈ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Praise the Lord, forever and ever, and make yourself a sacrifice to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa salaahee-ai sachay ka-o bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, let that tongue be burnt, which renounces the One Lord, and attaches itselfto another. ||2|| pauVI ] (516-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayk chhod d oojai lagai saa jihvaa jal jaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: From a single particle of His greatness, He  created His incarnations, but they indulged in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: ansaa a-utaar upaa-i-on bh aa-o d oojaa kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They ruled like kings, and fought for pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: ji-o raajay raaj kamaavday d ukh sukh  bhirhee-aa.

lines.english: Those who serve Shiva and Brahma do not find the limits of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: eesar barahmaa sayvday ant  tinHee na lahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਸਚੇ ਕਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Fearless, Formless Lord is unseen and invisible; He is revealed only to theGurmukh.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar alakh  hai gurmukh  pargatee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਸਾ ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There, one does not suffer sorrow or separation; he becomes stable and immortal inthe world. ||19|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (516-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tithai sog vijog na vi-aapa-ee asthir jag thee-aa. ||19||

lines.english: All these things come and go, all these things of the world.
lines.transliteration: ayhu sabh kichh  aavan  jaan hai jayt aa hai aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਸਾ  ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who knows this written account is acceptable and approved.
lines.transliteration: jin ayhu laykhaa likh i-aa so ho-aa parvaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, anyone who takes pride in himself is foolish and unwise. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (516-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
