lines.transliteration: naanak jay ko aap ganaa-id aa so moorakh  gaavaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਅੰਤੁ ਿਤਨੀ  ਨ ਲਹੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mind is the elephant, the Guru is the elephant-driver, and knowledge is the whip.Wherever the Guru drives the mind, it goes.
lines.transliteration: man kunchar peelak guroo gi-aan kundaa jah khinchay t ah jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the whip, the elephant wanders into the wilderness, again andagain. ||2|| pauVI ] (516-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak hastee kunday baahraa fir fir ujh arh paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I offer my prayer to the One, from whom I was created. pMnw 517
lines.transliteration: tis aagai ard aas jin upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Serving my True Guru, I have obtained all the fruits.
lines.transliteration: satgur apn aa sayv sabh  fal paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I meditate continually on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naa-o sad aa Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, I am rid of my pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kai sang d ukh mitaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, I have become care-free; I have obtained the imperishable wealth of the Lord. ||20|| slok mÚ 3 ] (517-3) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bha-ay achint  har Dh an nihchalaa-i-aa. ||20||

lines.english: Raising the embankments of the mind's field, I gaze at the heavenly mansion.
lines.transliteration: khayt  mi-aalaa uchee-aa gh ar uchaa nirn a-o.

lines.english: When devotion comes to the mind of the soul-bride, she is visited by the friendlyguest.
lines.transliteration: mahal bhagt ee gh ar sarai sajan  paahun i-a-o.

lines.english: O clouds, if you are going to rain, then go ahead and rain; why rain after the seasonhas passed?
lines.transliteration: barsanaa ta baras gh anaa bahurh  barseh kaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਸਰੈ ਸਜਣ  ਪਾਹੁਿਣਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who obtain the Lord in their minds. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (517-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tinH balihaarn ai jinH gurmukh  paa-i-aa man maahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਸਨਾ  ਤ ਬਰਸੁ  ਘਨਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਬਰਸਿਹ  ਕਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: That which is pleasing is sweet, and one who is sincere is a friend.
lines.transliteration: mithaa so jo bh aavdaa sajan  so je raas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he is known as a Gurmukh, whom the Lord Himself enlightens. ||2|| pauVI ] (517-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh jaan ee-ai jaa ka-o aap karay pargaas. ||2||

lines.english: O God, Your humble servant offers his prayer to You; You are my True Master.
lines.transliteration: parabh paas jan kee ard aas too sachaa saaN-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਠਾ  ਸੋ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਦਾ  ਸਜਣੁ  ਸੋ ਿਜ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Protector, forever and ever; I meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: too rakh vaalaa sad aa sad aa ha-o t uDh Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਿਪ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All the beings and creatures are Yours; You are pervading and permeating in them.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tayri-aa t oo rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: One who slanders Your slave is crushed and destroyed.
lines.transliteration: jo daas t ayray kee nind aa karay t is maar pachaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਸ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਈ  ॥
lines.english: Falling at Your Feet, Nanak has renounced his cares, and has become care-free. ||21|| slok mÚ 3 ] (517-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chintaa chh ad achint  rahu naanak lag paa-ee. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Building up its hopes, the world dies, but its hopes do not die or depart.
lines.transliteration: aasaa kartaa jag mu-aa aasaa marai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਤੇਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, hopes are fulfilled only by attaching one's consciousness to the True Lord.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (517-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aasaa pooree-aa sachay si-o chit laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਪਚਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Hopes and desires shall die only when He, who created them, takes them away.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa mar jaa-isee jin keetee so lai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਛਿਡ ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਿਗ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, nothing is permanent, except the Name of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (517-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nihchal ko nahee baajhahu har kai naa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself created the world, with His perfect workmanship.
lines.transliteration: aapay jagat upaa-i-on kar pooraa thaat.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ  ਆਸਾ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the true banker, He Himself is the merchant, and He Himself is thestore.
lines.transliteration: aapay saahu aapay vanjaaraa aapay hee har haat.

lines.english: He Himself is the ocean, He Himself is the boat, and He Himself is the boatman.
lines.transliteration: aapay saagar aapay bohithaa aapay hee khayvaat.

lines.english: He Himself is the Guru, He Himself is the disciple, and He Himself shows thedestination. jn nwnk nwmu iDAwie qU siB iklivK kwtu ]22]1] suDu (517-12, gUjrI kI vwr, mÚ 3) jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay t oo sabh  kilvikh  kaat. ||22||1|| suDh u O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and all your sins shallbe eradicated. ||22||1||Sudh|| rwgu gUjrI vwr mhlw 5  (517-14) raag goojree vaar mehlaa 5 Raag Goojaree, Vaar, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (517-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku mÚ 5 ] (517-15) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay gur chaylaa hai aapay aapay dasay gh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇਸੀ  ਿਜਿਨ ਕੀਤੀ  ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within yourself, worship the Guru in adoration, and with your tongue, chant theGuru's Name.
lines.transliteration: antar gur aaraaDh -naa jihvaa jap gur naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let your eyes behold the True Guru, and let your ears hear the Guru's Name.
lines.transliteration: naytree sat gur paykh -naa sarvan ee sunn aa gur naa-o.

lines.english: Attuned to the True Guru, you shall receive a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayt ee rat i-aa d argeh paa-ee-ai th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਕਿਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this treasure is bestowed on those who are blessed with His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kirpaa karay jis no ayh vath day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
lines.english: In the midst of the world, they are known as the most pious - they are rare indeed.||1|| mÚ 5 ] (517-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jag meh utam kaadh ee-ah virlay kay-ee kay-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਖੇਵਾਟੁ ॥
lines.english: O Savior Lord, save us and take us across.
lines.transliteration: rakhay rakh anhaar aap ubaari-an.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਦਸੇ ਘਾਟੁ ॥
lines.english: Falling at the feet of the Guru, our works are embellished with perfection.
lines.transliteration: gur kee pairee paa-ay kaaj savaari-an.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਕਾਟੁ ॥੨੨॥੧॥
lines.english: You have become kind, merciful and compassionate; we do not forget You from ourminds.
lines.transliteration: ho-aa aap da-i-aal manhu na visaari-an.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are carried across the terrifyingworld-ocean.
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kai sang bh avjal t aari-an.

lines.english: In an instant, You have destroyed the faithless cynics and slanderous enemies.
lines.transliteration: saakat nind ak dusat kh in maahi bid aari-an.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ  ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਜਿਪ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: That Lord and Master is my Anchor and Support; O Nanak, hold firm in your mind. pMnw 518
lines.transliteration: tis saahib kee tayk naanak manai maahi.

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, happiness comes, and all sorrows and pains simply vanish. ||2|| pauVI ] (518-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jis simrat sukh  ho-ay saglay d ookh jaahi. ||2||

lines.english: He is without relatives, immaculate, all-powerful, unapproachable and infinite.
lines.transliteration: akul niranjan purakh agam apaaree-ai.

lines.english: Truly, the True Lord is seen to be the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa sach sach nihaaree-ai.

lines.english: Nothing established by You appears to be false.
lines.transliteration: koorh na jaapai kichh  tayree Dh aaree-ai.

lines.english: The Great Giver gives sustenance to all those He has created.
lines.transliteration: sabhsai d ay daataar jayt  upaaree-ai.

lines.english: He has strung all on only one thread; He has infused His Light in them.
lines.transliteration: ikat soot  paro-ay jot  sanjaaree-ai.

lines.english: By His Will, some drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and by His Will, some arecarried across.
lines.transliteration: hukmay bhavjal manjh  hukmay t aaree-ai.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, he alone meditates on You, upon whose forehead such blessed destinyis inscribed.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee-o t uDh Dhi-aa-ay so-ay jis bh aag mathaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਸੋਇ ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Your condition and state cannot be known; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (518-4) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tayree gat  mit lakhee na jaa-ay ha-o t uDh balihaaree-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਲਖੀ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, you automatically come to dwell within my mind.
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN tuseh miharvaan achint  vaseh man maahi.

lines.english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I find the nine treasures within the home ofmy own self.
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN tuseh miharvaan na-o niDh  ghar meh paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿਹ ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨ  ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I act according to the Guru's Instructions.
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN tuseh miharvaan t aa gur kaa mant ar kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿਹ  ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, then Nanak is absorbed in the True One. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (518-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN tuseh miharvaan t aa naanak sach samaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿਹ ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨ  ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Many sit on thrones, to the sounds of musical instruments.
lines.transliteration: kitee baihniH baihn ay much vajaa-in vaj.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿਹ  ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨ  ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's honor is safe. ||2|| pauVI ] (518-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam vin kisai na rahee-aa laj. ||2||

lines.english: The followers of the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran, standing at Your Door, meditateon You.
lines.transliteration: tuDh Dhi-aa-eeniH bayd  kataybaa san  kharhay.

lines.english: Uncounted are those who fall at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: gantee gan ee na jaa-ay t ayrai d ar parh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਣੁ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਰਹੀਆ  ਲਜ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Brahma meditates on You, as does Indra on his throne.
lines.transliteration: barahmay tuDh  Dhi-aa-eeniH indar ind raasan aa.

lines.english: Shiva and Vishnu, and their incarnations, chant the Lord's Praise with their mouths,
lines.transliteration: sankar bisan avtaar har jas mukh  bhanaa.
peer pikaabar saykh masaa-ik a-ulee-ay. as do the Pirs, the spiritual teachers, the prophets and the Shaykhs, the silent sages and the seers.

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤੀ  ਗਣੀ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਤੇਰੈ ਦਿਰ ਪੜੇ ॥
lines.english: Through and through, the Formless Lord is woven into each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  nirankaar gh at ghat ma-ulee-ay.

lines.english: One is destroyed through falsehood; through righteousness, one prospers.
lines.transliteration: koorhahu karay vin aas Dh armay t agee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਕਰ  ਿਬਸਨ  ਅਵਤਾਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord links him to, to that he is linked. ||2|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (518-11) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jit jit laa-ihi aap t it tit lagee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: He is reluctant to do good, but eager to practice evil.
lines.transliteration: chaNgi-aa-eeN aalak karay buri-aa-eeN ho-ay sayr.

lines.english: O Nanak, today or tomorrow, the feet of the careless fool shall fall into the trap. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (518-12) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aj kal aavsee gaafal faahee payr. ||1||

lines.english: No matter how evil my ways are, still, Your Love for me is not concealed.
lines.transliteration: kitee-aa kudh ang gujh aa thee-ai na hit .

lines.english: Nanak: You, O Lord, conceal my short-comings and dwell within my mind; You are mytrue friend. ||2|| pauVI ] (518-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tai seh dh aki-aa man meh sachaa mit . ||2||

lines.english: I beg of You, O Merciful Lord: please, make me the slave of Your slaves.
lines.transliteration: ha-o maaga-o tujh ai da-i-aal kar d aasaa goli-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਿਗਆਈ ਆਲਕੁ  ਕਰੇ ਬੁਿਰਆਈ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I obtain the nine treasures and royalty; chanting Your Name, I live.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh paa-ee raaj jeevaa boli-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਜੁ ਕਿਲ  ਆਵਸੀ ਗਾਫਲ  ਫਾਹੀ  ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The great ambrosial treasure, the Nectar of the Naam, is in the home of the Lord'sslaves.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam niDh aan d aasaa gh ar ghanaa.

lines.english: In their company, I am in ecstasy, listening to Your Praises with my ears.
lines.transliteration: tin kai sang nihaal sarvan ee jas sun aa.

lines.english: Serving them, my body is purified.
lines.transliteration: kamaavaa tin kee kaar sareer pavit  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੈ ਸਿਹ ਢਿਕਆ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਚਾ ਿਮਤੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I wave the fans over them, and carry water for them; I grind the corn for them, and washing their feet, I am over-joyed.
lines.transliteration: pakhaa paan ee pees bigsaa pair Dh o-ay.

lines.english: By myself, I can do nothing; O God, bless me with Your Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: aaphu kachhoo na ho-ay parabh  nadar nihaalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ  ਤੁਝੈ ਦਇਆਲ  ਕਿਰ ਦਾਸਾ  ਗੋਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am worthless - please, bless me with a seat in the place of worship of the Saints.||3|| slok mÚ 5 ] (518-16) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun d ichai thaa-o sant  Dharam saalee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: O Friend, I pray that I may remain forever the dust of Your Feet.
lines.transliteration: saajan tayray charan kee ho-ay rahaa sad  Dhoor.

lines.english: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, and beholds You ever-present. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (518-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran t uhaaree-aa paykh a-o sad aa hajoor. ||1||

lines.english: Countless sinners become pure, by fixing their minds on the Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  asaNkh hohi har charn ee man laag.

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਾਵਾ ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Name of God is the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, O Nanak, for one who has such destiny written upon his forehead. ||2|| pauVI ] (518-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath naam parabh  jis naanak mast ak bh aag. ||2||

lines.english: With every breath and morsel of food, chant the Name of the Lord, the Cherisher.
lines.transliteration: nit japee-ai saas giraas naa-o paravd igaar d aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਦਿਰ ਿਨਹਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord does not forget one upon whom He has bestowed His Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis no karay rahamm tis na visaard aa.

lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself destroys. pMnw 519
lines.transliteration: aap upaavanhaar aapay hee maard aa.

lines.english: The Knower knows everything; He understands and contemplates.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  jaanai jaan  bujh veechaard aa.

lines.english: By His creative power, He assumes numerous forms in an instant.
lines.transliteration: anik roop khin maahi kud rat Dhaardaa.

lines.english: One whom the Lord attaches to the Truth is redeemed.
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay sach tiseh uDh aardaa.

lines.english: One who has God on his side is never conquered.
lines.transliteration: jis dai hovai val so kad ay na haard aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਿਲ  ਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: His Court is eternal and imperishable; I humbly bow to Him. ||4|| slok mÚ 5 ] (519-3) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa abh ag deebaan  hai ha-o t is namaskaard aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਭਗੁ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, and burn them in the fire.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  chhodee-ai d eejai agan jalaa-ay.

lines.english: As long as you are alive, O Nanak, meditate continually on the True Name. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (519-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jeevdi-aa nit  jaapee-ai naanak saachaa naa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my God, I have obtained all the fruits.
lines.transliteration: simrat simrat  parabh  aapn aa sabh  fal paa-ay aahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, I worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has united mewith the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (519-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araaDhi-aa gur poorai d ee-aa milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One who has been instructed by the Guru is liberated in this world.
lines.transliteration: so muktaa sansaar je gur upd aysi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਆਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He avoids disaster, and his anxiety is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: tis kee ga-ee balaa-ay mitay and aysi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Beholding the blessed vision of his Darshan, the world is over-joyed.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa d arsan d aykh jagat  nihaal ho-ay.

lines.english: In the company of the Lord's humble servants, the world is over-joyed, and the filth of sin is washed away.
lines.transliteration: jan kai sang nihaal paapaa mail Dho-ay.

lines.english: There, they meditate on the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.
lines.transliteration: amrit saachaa naa-o othai jaapee-ai.

lines.english: The mind becomes content, and its hunger is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: man ka-o ho-ay santokh  bhukhaa Dh araapee-ai.

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with the Name, has his bonds cut away.
lines.transliteration: jis ghat vasi-aa naa-o t is banDh an kaatee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ਪਾਪਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some rare person earns the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||5|| slok mÚ 5 ] (519-8) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kinai virlai har Dh an kh aatee-ai. ||5||

lines.english: Within my mind, I think thoughts of always rising early, and making the effort.
lines.transliteration: man meh chitva-o chit vanee ud am kara-o uth  neet.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਭੁਖਾ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, my Friend, please bless Nanak with the habit of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (519-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har keertan kaa aahro har d ayh naanak kay meet . ||1||

lines.english: Casting His Glance of Grace, God has saved me; my mind and body are imbued withthe Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: darisat Dh aar parabh  raakh i-aa man t an rat aa mool.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, have their cries of suffering taken away.||2|| pauVI ] (519-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo parabh bh aanee-aa mara-o vichaaree sool. ||2||

lines.english: When your soul is feeling sad, offer your prayers to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee birthaa ho-ay so gur peh ardaas kar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਿਚਤਵਨੀ  ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰਉ  ਉਿਠ ਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce all your cleverness, and dedicate your mind and body to Him.
lines.transliteration: chhod si-aan ap sagal man t an arap Dh ar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਆਹਰੋ  ਹਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Worship the Feet of the Guru, and your evil-mindedness shall be burnt away.
lines.transliteration: poojahu gur kay pair durmat  jaa-ay jar.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the terrifyingand difficult world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kai sang bh avjal bikh am tar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੂਿਲ ॥
lines.english: Serve the True Guru, and in the world hereafter, you shall not die of fear.
lines.transliteration: sayvhu satgur d ayv agai na marahu dar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ  ਮਰਉ  ਿਵਚਾਰੀ ਸੂਿਲ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In an instant, he shall make you happy, and the empty vessel shall be filled to overflowing.
lines.transliteration: khin meh karay nihaal oon ay subh ar bhar.

lines.english: The mind becomes content, meditating forever on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man ka-o ho-ay santokh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai sad aa har.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਿਰ ॥
lines.english: He alone dedicates himself to the Guru's service, unto whom the Lord has granted HisGrace. ||6|| slok mÚ 5 ] (519-14) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so lagaa satgur sayv jaa ka-o karam Dh ur. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਿਰ ॥
lines.english: I am attached to the right place; the Uniter has united me.
lines.transliteration: lagrhee suthaan jorh anhaarai jorh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਾਇ  ਜਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there are hundreds and thousands of waves, but my Husband Lord does notlet me drown. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (519-15) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak lahree lakh sai aan duban  day-ay na maa piree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਤਿਰ ॥
lines.english: In the dreadful wilderness, I have found the one and only companion; the Name ofthe Lord is the Destroyer of distress.
lines.transliteration: ban bheehaavalai hik saathee laDh am dukh hartaa har naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੇਵ ਅਗੈ  ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਡਿਰ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints, O Nanak; through them, my affairs have been brought to fulfillment. ||2|| pauVI ] (519-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaa-ee sant pi-aaray naanak pooran kaamaaN. ||2||

lines.english: All treasures are obtained, when we are attuned to Your Love.
lines.transliteration: paa-ee-an sabh niDh aan tayrai rang rat i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ॥
lines.english: One does not have to suffer regret and repentance, when he meditates on You.
lines.transliteration: na hovee pachhot aa-o t uDh no japt i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਲਗਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮੁ  ਧੁਿਰ ॥੬॥
lines.english: No one can equal Your humble servant, who has Your Support.
lines.transliteration: pahuch na sakai ko-ay tayree tayk jan.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! How wonderful is the Perfect Guru! Cherishing Him in my mind, Iobtain peace.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray vaahu vaahu sukh lahaa chit aar man.

lines.english: The treasure of the Lord's Praise comes from the Guru; by His Mercy, it is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur peh sifat bh andaar karmee paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਹਰੀ  ਲਖ ਸੈ ਆਨ  ਡੁਬਣ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਾ ਿਪਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace, one does not wander any more.
lines.transliteration: satgur nad ar nihaal bahurh  na Dh aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord preserves him - He makes him His own slave.
lines.transliteration: rakhai aap d a-i-aal kar d aasaa aapn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਨ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੈ ਿਹਕੁ ਸਾਥੀ  ਲਧਮੁ  ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listening, hearing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, I live. ||7|| pMnw 520 slok mÚ 5 ] (520-1) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har har har naam jeevaa sun sun ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Husband Lord, You have given me the silk gown of Your Love to cover and protectmy honor.
lines.transliteration: paraym patolaa tai seh d itaa dh akan koo pat  mayree.

lines.english: You are all-wise and all-knowing, O my Master; Nanak: I have not appreciated Yourvalue, Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (520-2) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daanaa beenaa saa-ee maidaa naanak saar na jaan aa tayree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਟੋਲਾ  ਤੈ ਸਿਹ ਿਦਤਾ  ਢਕਣ  ਕੂ ਪਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: By Your meditative remembrance, I have found everything; nothing seems difficult tome.
lines.transliteration: taidai simran  habh  kichh  laDham bikh am na dith am ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨਾ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਸਾਈ  ਮੈਡਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One whose honor the True Lord Master has preserved - O Nanak, no one can dishonorhim. ||2|| pauVI ] (520-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jis pat rakh ai sachaa saahib naanak mayt na sakai ko-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, there comes a great peace.
lines.transliteration: hovai sukh gh anaa da-yi Dh i-aa-i-ai.

lines.english: Multitudes of illnesses vanish, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vanjai rogaa gh aan har gun  gaa-i-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਿਤ ਰਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Utter peace pervades within, when God comes to mind.
lines.transliteration: andar vart ai thaadh parabh  chit aa-i-ai.

lines.english: One's hopes are fulfilled, when one's mind is filled with the Name.
lines.transliteration: pooran hovai aas naa-ay man vasaa-i-ai.

lines.english: No obstacles stand in the way, when one eliminates his self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na lagai bighan aap gavaa-i-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਐ  ॥
lines.english: The intellect attains the blessing of spiritual wisdom from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan padaarath mat  gur t ay paa-i-ai.

lines.english: He receives everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives.
lines.transliteration: tin paa-ay sabh ay thok jis aap d ivaa-i-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ  ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਐ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Lord and Master of all; all are under Your Protection. ||8|| slok mÚ 5 ] (520-7) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tooN sabh naa kaa kh asam sabh  tayree chh aa-i-ai. ||8||

lines.english: Crossing the stream, my foot does not get stuck - I am filled with love for You.
lines.transliteration: nadee t arand -rhee maidaa kh oj na kh umbh ai manjh  muhabat  tayree.

lines.english: O Lord, my heart is attached to Your Feet; the Lord is Nanak's raft and boat. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (520-8) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ta-o sah charn ee maidaa hee-arh aa seet am har naanak t ulhaa bayrh ee. ||1||

lines.english: The sight of them banishes my evil-mindedness; they are my only true friends.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa disand-rh i-aa d urmat  vanjai mit ar asaadrh ay say-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਐ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: I have searched the whole world; O servant Nanak, how rare are such persons! ||2|| pauVI ] (520-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhoodh aydee jag sabaa-i-aa jan naanak virlay kay-ee. ||2||

lines.english: You come to mind, O Lord and Master, when I behold Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: aavai saahib chit t ayri-aa bh agtaa dith i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦੀ  ਤਰੰਦੜੀ  ਮੈਡਾ ਖੋਜੁ ਨ ਖੁੰਭੈ ਮੰਿਝ ਮੁਹਬਿਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The filth of my mind is removed, when I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy.
lines.transliteration: man kee katee-ai mail saaDhsang vuth i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮੈਡਾ ਹੀਅੜਾ  ਸੀਤਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਬੇੜੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fear of birth and death is dispelled, meditating on the Word of His humbleservant.
lines.transliteration: janam maran bh a-o katee-ai jan kaa sabad  jap.

lines.english: The Saints untie the bonds, and all the demons are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kh olniH sant doot sabh  jaahi chh ap.

lines.english: They inspire us to love Him, the One who established the entire universe.
lines.transliteration: tis si-o laa-iniH rang jis d ee sabh  Dhaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਕੇਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The seat of the inaccessible and infinite Lord is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: oochee hooN oochaa thaan agam aapaaree-aa.

lines.english: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, with each and every breath,meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas kar jorh  saas saas Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: When the Lord Himself becomes merciful, then we attain the Society of His devotees.||9|| slok mÚ 5 ] (520-13) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaa aapay ho-ay da-i-aal t aaN bhagat sang paa-ee-ai. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ  ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਵੁਿਠਆ  ॥
lines.english: In this wondrous forest of the world, there is chaos and confusion; shrieks emanatefrom the highways.
lines.transliteration: baar vidaanrhai hummas Dh ummas kookaa pa-ee-aa raahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ  ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਜਿਪ ॥
lines.english: I am in love with You, O my Husband Lord; O Nanak, I cross the jungle joyfully. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (520-14) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ta-o sah sayt ee lagrh ee doree naanak anad  saytee ban gaahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਖੋਲਿਨ ਸੰਤ ਦੂਤ ਸਿਭ ਜਾਿਹ  ਛਿਪ ॥
lines.english: The true society is the company of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachee baisak tinHaa sang jin sang japee-ai naa-o.

lines.english: Do not associate with those, O Nanak, who look out only for their own interests. ||2|| pauVI ] (520-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: tinH sang sang na keech-ee naanak jinaa aapn aa su-aa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚੀ  ਹੂੰ ਊਚਾ  ਥਾਨੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Approved is that time, when one meets the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: saa vaylaa parvaan jit  satgur bh ayti-aa.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he does not suffer pain again.
lines.transliteration: ho-aa saaDhoo sang fir d ookh na tayti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ  ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤ ਭਗਤ  ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: When he attains the eternal place, he does not have to enter the womb again.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa nihchal thaan fir garabh na layti-aa.

lines.english: He comes to see the One God everywhere.
lines.transliteration: nadree aa-i-aa ik sagal barahmayti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਰ  ਿਵਡਾਨੜੈ  ਹੁੰਮਸ ਧੁੰਮਸ  ਕੂਕਾ  ਪਈਆ  ਰਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: He focuses his meditation on the essence of spiritual wisdom, and withdraws his attention from other sights.
lines.transliteration: tat gi-aan laa-ay Dh i-aan d arisat samayti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਗੜੀ ਡੋਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਦ  ਸੇਤੀ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All chants are chanted by one who chants them with his mouth.
lines.transliteration: sabho japee-ai jaap je mukh ahu bolayti-aa.

lines.english: Realizing the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he becomes happy, and he is filled withpeace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: hukmay bujh nihaal sukh  sukh ayti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬੈਸਕ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਜਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are assayed, and placed in the Lord's treasury, are not declared counterfeit again. ||10|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (520-19) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parakh kh ajaanai paa-ay say bahurh  na kh oti-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੁਆਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The pincers of separation are so painful to endure.
lines.transliteration: vichhohay jamboor kh avay na vanj an gaakh -rhay.

lines.english: If only the Master would come to meet me! O Nanak, I would then obtain all the truecomforts. ||1|| pMnw 521 mÚ 5 ] (521-1) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay so Dhan ee milann naanak sukh  sambooh sach. ||1||

lines.english: The earth is in the water, and the fire is contained in the wood.
lines.transliteration: jimee vasandee paan ee-ai eeDh an rakhai bhaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, yearn for that Lord, who is the Support of all. ||2|| pauVI ] (521-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak so saho aahi jaa kai aadhal habh  ko. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਆਿਹ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਢਿਲ  ਹਭੁ ਕੋ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The works which You have done, O Lord, could only have been performed by You.
lines.transliteration: tayray keet ay kamm t uDhai hee gochray.

lines.english: That alone happens in the world, which You, O Master, have done.
lines.transliteration: so-ee vartai jag je kee-aa t uDh Dhuray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ  ਕੰਮ ਤੁਧੈ ਹੀ ਗੋਚਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am wonderstruck beholding the wonder of Your Almighty Creative Power.
lines.transliteration: bisam bha-ay bismaad  daykh kudrat tayree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ  ਜਿਗ  ਿਜ ਕੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary - I am Your slave; if it is Your Will, I shall be emancipated.
lines.transliteration: saran paray t ayree d aas kar gat  ho-ay mayree-aa.

lines.english: The treasure is in Your Hands; according to Your Will, You bestow it.
lines.transliteration: tayrai hath niDh aan bh aavai t is deh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਕਿਰ ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: One, upon whom You have bestowed Your Mercy, is blessed with the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jis no ho-ay da-i-aal har naam say-ay layhi.

lines.english: You are unapproachable, unfathomable and infinite; Your limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar bay-ant ant  na paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ਲੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: One, unto whom You have been compassionate, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11|| slok mÚ 5 ] (521-5) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no hohi kirpaal so naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The ladles cruise through the food, but they do not know the taste of it.
lines.transliteration: karh-chh ee-aa firaNniH su-aa-o na jaan niH sunjee-aa.

lines.english: I long to see the faces of those, O Nanak, who are imbued with the essence of the Lord's Love. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (521-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: say-ee mukh d isaNniH naanak rat ay paraym ras. ||1||

lines.english: Through the Tracker, I discovered the tracks of those who ruined my crops.
lines.transliteration: khojee laDh am kh oj chh adee-aa ujaarh .

lines.english: You, O Lord, have put up the fence; O Nanak, my fields shall not be plundered again.||2|| pauVI ] (521-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: tai seh d itee vaarh  naanak kh ayt na chh ij-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਖ ਿਦਸੰਿਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਤੇ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਿਸ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Worship in adoration that True Lord; everything is under His Power.
lines.transliteration: aaraaDhihu sachaa so-ay sabh  kichh  jis paas.

lines.english: He Himself is the Master of both ends; in an instant, He adjusts our affairs.
lines.transliteration: duhaa siri-aa kh asam aap kh in meh karay raas.

lines.english: Renounce all your efforts, and hold fast to His Support.
lines.transliteration: ti-aagahu sagal upaav t is kee ot gahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਿਹ ਿਦਤੀ  ਵਾਿੜ ਨਾਨਕ  ਖੇਤੁ ਨ ਿਛਜਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Run to His Sanctuary, and you shall obtain the comfort of all comforts.
lines.transliteration: pa-o sarnaa-ee bh aj sukh ee hooN sukh  lahu.

lines.english: The karma of good deeds, the righteousness of Dharma and the essence of spiritual wisdom are obtained in the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam t at gi-aan sant aa sang ho-ay.

lines.english: Chanting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, no obstacle shall block your way.
lines.transliteration: japee-ai amrit naam bigh an na lagai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਹਾ ਿਸਿਰਆ  ਖਸਮੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord abides in the mind of one who is blessed by His Kindness.
lines.transliteration: jis no aap da-i-aal t is man vuth i-aa.

lines.english: All treasures are obtained, when the Lord and Master is pleased. ||12|| slok mÚ 5 ] (521-10) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paa-ee-aniH sabh niDh aan saahib t uthi-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਿਜ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਲਹੁ ॥
lines.english: I have found the object of my search - my Beloved took pity on me.
lines.transliteration: laDham labh anhaar karam karand o maa piree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: There is One Creator; O Nanak, I do not see any other. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (521-11) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: iko sirjanhaar naanak bi-aa na pasee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੀਐ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Take aim with the arrow of Truth, and shoot down sin.
lines.transliteration: paaprhi-aa pachh aarh baan  sachaavaa saNniH kai.

lines.english: Cherish the Words of the Guru's Mantra, O Nanak, and you shall not suffer in pain. ||2|| pauVI ] (521-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur mantarh aa chit aar naanak d ukh na theev-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! The Creator Lord Himself has brought about peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu sirjanhaar paa-ee-an th aadh aap.

lines.english: He is Kind to all beings and creatures; meditate forever on Him.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant miharvaan t is no sad aa jaap.

lines.english: The all-powerful Lord has shown Mercy, and my cries of suffering are ended.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aaree samrath chukay bil bilaap.

lines.english: My fevers, pains and diseases are gone, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: nathay t aap d ukh rog pooray gur part aap.

lines.english: The Lord has established me, and protected me; He is the Cherisher of the poor.
lines.transliteration: keetee-an aapn ee rakh  gareeb nivaaj thaap.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪਿੜਆ  ਪਛਾਿੜ  ਬਾਣੁ  ਸਚਾਵਾ  ਸੰਿਨ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself has delivered me, breaking all my bonds.
lines.transliteration: aapay la-i-an chhadaa-ay banDh an sagal kaap.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੜਾ  ਿਚਤਾਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਵਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My thirst is quenched, my hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is contented and satisfied.
lines.transliteration: tisan bujh ee aas punnee man sant okh Dharaap.

lines.english: The greatest of the great, the Infinite Lord and Master - He is not affected by virtue and vice. ||13|| slok mÚ 5 ] (521-16) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadee hooN vadaa apaar khasam jis layp na punn paap. ||13||

lines.english: They alone meditate on the Lord God, Har, Har, unto whom the Lord is Merciful.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bha-ay kirpaal parabh  har har say-ee japaat .

lines.english: O Nanak, they enshrine love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (521-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pareet lagee t in raam si-o bh aytat saaDh  sangaat . ||1||

lines.english: Contemplate the Lord, O very fortunate ones; He is pervading in the water, the landand the sky.
lines.transliteration: raam ramhu badbhaageeho jal thal mahee-al so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਠੇ ਤਾਪ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਤਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal encounters nomisfortune. ||2|| pauVI ] (521-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araaDhi-ai bigh an na laagai ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The speech of the devotees is approved; it is accepted in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa boli-aa parvaan  hai d argeh pavai thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: Your devotees take to Your Support; they are imbued with the True Name.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa tayree tayk rat ay sach naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਆਸ  ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨ ਸੰਤੋਿਖ  ਧਰ੍ਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: One unto whom You are Merciful, has his sufferings depart. pMnw 522
lines.transliteration: jis no ho-ay kirpaal tis kaa d ookh jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Merciful Lord, You bless Your devotees with Your Grace.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  tayray d a-i-aal onHaa mihar paa-ay.

lines.english: Suffering, pain, terrible disease and Maya do not afflict them.
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad vad rog na pohay t is maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This is the Support of the devotees, that they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa ayhu aDh aar gun  govind  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, day and night, they meditate on the One and Only Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa din rain  iko ik Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Amrit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humbleservants remain satisfied with the Naam. ||14|| slok mÚ 5 ] (522-3) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: peevat amrit  naam jan naamay rahay agh aa-ay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਵਿਤ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Millions of obstacles stand in the way of one who forgets the Name.
lines.transliteration: kot bighan t is laagt ay jis no visrai naa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, night and day, he croaks like a raven in a deserted house. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (522-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak an-din bilpat ay ji-o sunj ai ghar kaa-o. ||1||

lines.english: Beauteous is that season, when I am united with my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: piree milaavaa jaa thee-ai saa-ee suhaavee rut.

lines.english: I do not forget Him for a moment or an instant; O Nanak, I contemplate Himconstantly. ||2|| pauVI ] (522-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gharh ee muhat  nah veesrai naanak ravee-ai nit . ||2||

lines.english: Even brave and mighty men cannot withstand the powerful and overwhelming armywhich the five passions have gathered.
lines.transliteration: soorbeer varee-aam kinai na horhee-ai. fa-uj sat aanee haath  panchaa jorh ee-ai.

lines.english: The ten organs of sensation attach even detached renunciates to sensory pleasures.
lines.transliteration: das naaree a-uDh oot dayn chamorh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ  ਮੁਹਤੁ  ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਵੀਐ  ਿਨਤ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They seek to conquer and overpower them, and so increase their following.
lines.transliteration: jin jin  lainiH ralaa-ay ayho aynaa lorh ee-ai.

lines.english: The world of the three dispositions is under their influence; no one can stand againstthem.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  in kai vas kinai na morh ee-ai.

lines.english: So tell me - how can the fort of doubt and the moat of Maya be overcome?
lines.transliteration: bharam kot maa-i-aa kh aa-ee kaho kit  biDh torhee-ai.

lines.english: Worshipping the Perfect Guru, this awesome force is subdued.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraaDh bikh am dal forh ee-ai.

lines.english: I stand before Him, day and night, with my palms pressed together. ||15|| slok mÚ 5 ] (522-9) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis agai d in raat  rahaa kar jorh ee-ai. ||15||

lines.english: All sins are washed away, by continually singing the Lord's Glories.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh sabh ay utran neet  neet gun gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਮੋੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of afflictions are produced, O Nanak, when the Name is forgotten. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (522-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kot kalaysaa oopjahi naanak bisrai naa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਕੋਟੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਖਾਈ  ਕਹੁ ਿਕਤੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਤੋੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one comes to know the Perfect Way.
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur bh ayti-ai pooree hovai jugat .

lines.english: While laughing, playing, dressing and eating, he is liberated. ||2|| pauVI ] (522-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: hasandi-aa kh ayland i-aa painand i-aa kh aavand i-aa vichay hovai mukat . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਰਹਾ ਕਰ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has demolished the fortress of doubt.
lines.transliteration: so satgur Dh an Dh an jin bh aram garh  torhi-aa.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail! Hail! to the True Guru, who has united me with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so satgur vaahu vaahu jin har si-o jorh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਸਭੇ ਉਤਰਿਨ  ਨੀਤ  ਨੀਤ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has given me the medicine of the inexhaustible treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan akh ut gur d ay-ay d aroo-o.

lines.english: He has banished the great and terrible disease.
lines.transliteration: mahaa rog bikraal tinai bid aroo-o.

lines.english: I have obtained the great treasure of the wealth of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa naam niDhaan bahut  khajaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਭੇਿਟਐ  ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained eternal life, recognizing my own self.
lines.transliteration: jitaa janam apaar aap pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਸੰਿਦਆ  ਖੇਲੰਿਦਆ  ਪੈਨੰਿਦਆ ਖਾਵੰਿਦਆ  ਿਵਚੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Glory of the all-powerful Divine Guru cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: mahimaa kahee na jaa-ay gur samrath dayv.

lines.english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, infinite, unseen and unknowable. ||16|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (522-14) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur paarbarahm parmaysur aprampar alakh abh ayv. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਭਰਮ  ਗੜੁ ਤੋਿੜਆ  ॥
lines.english: Make the effort, and you shall live; practicing it, you shall enjoy peace.
lines.transliteration: udam karayd i-aa jee-o t ooN kamaavd i-aa sukh  bhunch.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਜੋਿੜਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhi-aa-id i-aa tooN parabh oo mil naanak ut ree chint . ||1|| Meditating, you shall meet God, O Nanak, and your anxiety shall vanish. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (522-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
Bless me with sublime thoughts, O Lord of the Universe, and contemplation in theimmaculate Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: subh chint an gobind  raman  nirmal saaDh oo sang.

lines.english: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for even an instant; bemerciful to me, Lord God. ||2|| pauVI ] (522-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na visra-o ik gharh ee kar kirpaa bh agvant . ||2||

lines.english: Whatever happens is according to Your Will, so why should I be afraid?
lines.transliteration: tayraa keet aa ho-ay t a kaahay darpee-ai.

lines.english: Meeting Him, I meditate on the Name - I offer my soul to Him.
lines.transliteration: jis mil japee-ai naa-o tis jee-o arpee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਹਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ  ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.english: When the Infinite Lord comes to mind, one is enraptured.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-ai chit nihaal saahib baysumaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Who can touch one who has the Formless Lord on his side?
lines.transliteration: tis no pohay kavan  jis val nirankaar.

lines.english: Everything is under His control; no one is beyond Him.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tis kai vas na ko-ee baahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰੇਿਦਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਤੂੰ ਕਮਾਵਿਦਆ  ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚੁ ॥
lines.english: He, the True Lord, dwells in the minds of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: so bhagt aa man vuth aa sach samaaharaa.

lines.english: Your slaves meditate on You; You are the Savior, the Protector Lord. pMnw 523
lines.transliteration: tayray d aas Dh i-aa-in t uDh tooN rakhan vaali-aa.

lines.english: You are the Almighty Overlord of all; You bless us with Your Glance of Grace. ||17|| slok mÚ 5 ] (523-1) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sir sabhnaa samrath nad ar nihaali-aa. ||17||

lines.english: Take away my sexual desire, anger, pride, greed, emotional attachment and evildesires.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh mad  lobh moh d usat baasnaa nivaar.

lines.english: Protect me, O my God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (523-2) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raakh layho parabh  aapn ay naanak sad  balihaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਦ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਸਟ  ਬਾਸਨਾ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By eating and eating, the mouth is worn out; by wearing clothes, the limbs grow weary.
lines.transliteration: khaaNdi-aa kh aaNdi-aa muhu gh athaa painand i-aa sabh  ang.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਪਣੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, cursed are the lives of those who are not attuned to the Love of the TrueLord. ||2|| pauVI ] (523-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dharig t inaa d aa jeevi-aa jin sach na lago rang. ||2||

lines.english: As is the Hukam of Your Command, so do things happen.
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o tayraa hukam t ivai ti-o hovn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਿਦਆ  ਖਿਦਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਘਠਾ  ਪੈਨੰਿਦਆ  ਸਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Wherever You keep me, there I go and stand.
lines.transliteration: jah jah rakheh aap t ah jaa-ay kh arhovanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਦਾ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਿਜਨ ਸਿਚ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: With the Love of Your Name, I wash away my evil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: naam tayrai kai rang d urmat  Dhovnaa.

lines.english: By continually meditating on You, O Formless Lord, my doubts and fears are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jap jap tuDh  nirankaar bh aram bh a-o kh ovnaa.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to Your Love, shall not be trapped in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: jo tayrai rang rat ay say jon na jovn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਰਖਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਤਹ ਜਾਇ  ਖੜੋਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, they behold the One Lord with their eyes.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ik nain  alovan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਧੋਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who recognize the Lord's Command never weep.
lines.transliteration: jinHee pachhaat aa hukam t inH kaday na rovn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are blessed with the gift of the Name, woven into the fabric of their minds. ||18|| slok mÚ 5 ] (523-7) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naa-o naanak bakhsees man maahi parovan aa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਜੋਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not remember the Lord while they are alive, shall mix with the dustwhen they die.
lines.transliteration: jeevdi-aa na chayt i-o mu-aa raland -rho khaak.

lines.english: O Nanak, the foolish and filthy faithless cynic passes his life engrossed in the world.||1|| mÚ 5 ] (523-8) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dunee-aa sang gud aari-aa saakat  moorh  napaak. ||1||

lines.english: One who remembers the Lord while he is alive, shall be imbued with the Lord's Lovewhen he dies.
lines.transliteration: jeevandi-aa har chayt i-aa marand i-aa har rang.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਖਸੀਸ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਪਰੋਵਣਾ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The precious gift of his life is redeemed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Companyof the Holy. ||2|| pauVI ] (523-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath t aari-aa naanak saaDh oo sang. ||2||

lines.english: From the beginning, and through the ages, You have been our Protector and Preserver.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee aap rakh an vaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਿਦਆ  ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਮੁਆ  ਰਲੰਦੜੋ  ਖਾਕ ॥
lines.english: True is Your Name, O Creator Lord, and True is Your Creation.
lines.transliteration: sach naam kartaar sach pasaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਗੁਦਾਿਰਆ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂੜ ਨਪਾਕ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You do not lack anything; You are filling each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: oonaa kahee na ho-ay gh atay gh at saari-aa.

lines.english: You are merciful and all-powerful; You Yourself cause us to serve You.
lines.transliteration: miharvaan samrath aapay hee ghaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵੰਿਦਆ  ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤਆ  ਮਰੰਿਦਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: Those whose minds in which You dwell are forever at peace.
lines.transliteration: jinH man vuthaa aap say sad aa sukh aali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਤਾਿਰਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Having created the creation, You Yourself cherish it.
lines.transliteration: aapay rachan rachaa-ay aapay hee paali-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself are everything, O infinite, endless Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap bay-ant  apaari-aa.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Protection and Support of the Perfect Guru. ||19|| slok mÚ 5 ] (523-12) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee tayk naanak sammHaali-aa. ||19||

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, the Transcendent Lord has saved me.
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ar ant  parmaysar rakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਊਣਾ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਘਟੇ ਘਿਟ  ਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has blessed me with the Lord's Name, and I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: satgur d itaa har naam amrit  chakh i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of theLord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: saaDhaa sang apaar an-d in har gun  ravai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ  ਵੁਠਾ ਆਿਪ  ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained all my objectives, and I shall not wander in reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: paa-ay manorath sabh jonee nah bh avai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਪਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Everything is in the Hands of the Creator; He does what is done.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  kartay hath kaaran  jo karai.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Holy, which shall deliver him.||1|| mÚ 5 ] (523-15) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai daan sant aa Dh oor tarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਮਾਿਲਆ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Enshrine Him in your mind, the One who created you.
lines.transliteration: tis no man vasaa-ay jin upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Whoever meditates on the Lord and Master obtains peace.
lines.transliteration: jin jan Dhi-aa-i-aa kh asam t in sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਮਿਧ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰਮੇਸਿਰ  ਰਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the birth, and approved is the coming of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: safal janam parvaan gurmukh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command shall be blessed - so has the Lord and Master ordained.
lines.transliteration: hukmai bujh nihaal kh asam furmaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਾ  ਸੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy does not wander.
lines.transliteration: jis ho-aa aap kirpaal so nah bharmaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਸਿਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਭਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord and Master gives him, with that he is content.
lines.transliteration: jo jo dit aa kh asam so-ee sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਹਿਥ ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the kindness of the Lord, our Friend, realizes theHukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: naanak jisahi da-i-aal bujh aa-ay hukam mit .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਿਰ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: But those whom the Lord Himself causes to wander, continue to die, and takereincarnation again. ||2|| pauVI ] (523-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jisahi bhulaa-ay aap mar mar jameh nit . ||2||

lines.english: The slanderers are destroyed in an instant; they are not spared for even a moment.
lines.transliteration: nindak maaray t atkaal kh in tikan  na ditay.

lines.english: God will not endure the sufferings of His slaves, but catching the slanderers, He binds them to the cycle of reincarnation. pMnw 524
lines.transliteration: parabh d aas kaa d ukh na kh av sakahi farh  jonee jut ay.

lines.english: Grabbing them by the hair on their heads, the Lord throws them down, and leaves them on the path of Death.
lines.transliteration: mathay vaal pachhaarh i-an jam maarag mut ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਥੇ ਵਾਿਲ  ਪਛਾਿੜਅਨ ੁ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਮੁਤੇ ॥
lines.english: They cry out in pain, in the darkest of hells.
lines.transliteration: dukh lagai billaan i-aa narak gh or sut ay.

lines.english: But hugging His slaves close to His Heart, O Nanak, the True Lord saves them. ||20|| slok mÚ 5 ] (524-2) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay d aas rakh i-an naanak har sat ay. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਦਾਸ ਰਿਖਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, O fortunate ones; He is pervading the waters and the earth.
lines.transliteration: raam japahu vadbhaageeho jal thal pooran so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and no misfortune shall strikeyou. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (524-3) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-ai bigh an na laagai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Millions of misfortunes block the way of one who forgets the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot bighan t is laagt ay jis no visrai naa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, like a crow in a deserted house, he cries out, night and day. ||2|| pauVI ] (524-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak an-din bilpat ay ji-o sunj ai ghar kaa-o. ||2||

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of the Great Giver, one's heart's desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: simar simar daat aar manorath poori-aa.

lines.english: The hopes and desires of the mind are realized, and sorrows are forgotten.
lines.transliteration: ichh punnee man aas ga-ay visoori-aa.

lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained; I have searched for itfor so long.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa naam niDhaan jis no bh aaldaa.

lines.english: My light is merged into the Light, and my labors are over.
lines.transliteration: jot milee sang jot  rahi-aa gh aaldaa.

lines.english: I abide in that house of peace, poise and bliss.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  vuthay tit ghar.

lines.english: My comings and goings have ended - there is no birth or death there.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay janam na t ahaa mar.

lines.english: The Master and the servant have become one, with no sense of separation. gur pRswid nwnk sic smwieAw ]21]1]2] suDu (524-7, gUjrI, mÚ 5) gur parsaad naanak sach samaa-i-aa. ||21||1||2|| suDh u By Guru's Grace, Nanak is absorbed in the True Lord. ||21||1||2||Sudh|| rwgu gUjrI Bgqw kI bwxI  (524-7) raag goojree bhagt aa kee ban ee Raag Goojaree, The Words Of The Devotees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (524-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sRI kbIr jIau kw caupdw Gru 2 dUjw ] (524-8) saree kabeer jee-o kaa cha-upadaa gh ar 2 d oojaa. Chau-Padas Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:
lines.transliteration: saahib sayvak ik ik daristaa-i-aa.

lines.english: With four feet, two horns and a mute mouth, how could you sing the Praises of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: chaar paav du-ay sing gung mukh  tab kaisay gun ga-eehai.

lines.english: Standing up and sitting down, the stick shall still fall on you, so where will you hideyour head? ||1||
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at thaygaa parihai t ab kat  mood luka-eehai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣ  ਰਹੇ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਤਹਾ ਮਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, you are like a stray ox;
lines.transliteration: har bin bail biraanay hu-eehai.
faatay naakan tootay kaaDhan kod a-o ko bh us kh a-eehai. ||1|| rahaa-o. with your nose torn, and your shoulders injured, you shall have only the straw ofcoarse grain to eat. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: All day long, you shall wander in the forest, and even then, your belly will not be full.
lines.transliteration: saaro din dolat  ban mahee-aa ajahu na payt agh -eehai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You did not follow the advice of the humble devotees, and so you shall obtain thefruits of your actions. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan bhagt an ko kaho na maano kee-o apno pa-eehai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕਾ ਚਉਪਦਾ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੂਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Enduring pleasure and pain, drowned in the great ocean of doubt, you shall wander in numerous reincarnations.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  karat  mahaa bh aram boodo anik jon bh aram-eehai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਪਾਵ ਦੁਇ ਿਸੰਗ  ਗੁੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਤਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਈਹੈ  ॥
lines.english: You have lost the jewel of human birth by forgetting God; when will you have such anopportunity again? ||3||
lines.transliteration: ratan janam kh o-i-o parabh  bisri-o ih a-osar kat  pa-eehai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਠੇਗਾ  ਪਿਰਹੈ  ਤਬ ਕਤ ਮੂਡ ਲੁਕਈਹੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You turn on the wheel of reincarnation, like an ox at the oil-press; the night of yourlife passes away without salvation.
lines.transliteration: bharmat  firat taylak kay kap ji-o gat  bin rain bih-eehai.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the Lord, you shall pound your head, and regretand repent. ||4||1|| gUjrI Gru 3 ] (524-14) goojree ghar 3. Goojaree, Third House:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer raam naam bin moond Dh unay pachh ut-eehai. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਫਾਟੇ ਨਾਕਨ ਟੂਟੇ ਕਾਧਨ  ਕੋਦਉ  ਕੋ ਭੁਸੁ ਖਈਹੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer's mother sobs, cries and bewails
lines.transliteration: mus mus rovai kabeer kee maa-ee.

lines.english: - O Lord, how will my grandchildren live? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ay baarik kaisay jeeveh raghuraa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰੋ ਿਦਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ  ਬਨ ਮਹੀਆ  ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਪੇਟ ਅਘਈਹੈ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer has given up all his spinning and weaving,
lines.transliteration: tannaa bunnaa sabh  taji-o hai kabeer.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੋ ਕਹੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੋ ਕੀਓ  ਅਪਨੋ  ਪਈਹੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam likh lee-o sareer. ||1|| rahaa-o. and written the Name of the Lord on his body. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ  ਮਹਾ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਬੂਡੋ ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰਮਈਹੈ  ॥
lines.english: As long as I pass the thread through the bobbin,
lines.transliteration: jab lag taagaa baaha-o bayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਖੋਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਬਸਿਰਓ  ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਪਈਹੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I forget the Lord, my Beloved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tab lag bisrai raam sanayhee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਿਫਰਤ  ਤੇਲਕ  ਕੇ ਕਿਪ ਿਜਉ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਿਬਹਈਹੈ  ॥
lines.english: My intellect is lowly - I am a weaver by birth,
lines.transliteration: ochhee mat  mayree jaat  julaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਧੁਨੇ ਪਛੁਤਈਹੈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam lahi-o mai laahaa. ||3|| but I have earned the profit of the Name of the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mother
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu mayree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਸ ਮੁਿਸ ਰੋਵੈ ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Goojaree, Padas Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (525-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: hamraa in kaa daat aa ayk ragh uraa-ee. ||4||2|| - the Lord alone is the Provider, for me and my children. ||4||2|| pMnw 525 gUjrI sRI nwmdyv jI ky pdy Gru 1  (525-1) goojree saree naamdayv jee kay pad ay gh ar 1

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ  ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: If You gave me an empire, then what glory would be in it for me?
lines.transliteration: jou raaj deh t a kavan badaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੌ ਰਾਜੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਕਵਨ  ਬਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: If You made me beg for charity, what would it take away from me? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jou bheekh  mangaaveh t a ki-aa gh at jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੌ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਵਿਹ  ਤ ਿਕਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, O my mind, and you shall obtain the state of Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: tooN har bh aj man mayray pad  nirbaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation any longer. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bahur na ho-ay tayraa aavan jaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਵਨ  ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You created all, and You lead them astray in doubt.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ai upaa-ee bh aram bh ulaa-ee.

lines.english: They alone understand, unto whom You give understanding. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis tooN dayveh t iseh bujh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a sahsaa jaa-ee.

lines.english: Who else should I worship? I can see no other. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kis ha-o pooja-o doojaa nad ar na aa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: One stone is lovingly decorated,
lines.transliteration: aykai paathar keejai bhaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸੁ ਹਉ ਪੂਜਉ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: doojai paathar Dh aree-ai paa-o. while another stone is walked upon.

lines.english: If one is a god, then the other must also be a god.
lines.transliteration: jay oh day-o t a oh bh ee dayvaa.

lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, I serve the Lord. ||4||1|| gUjrI Gru 1 ] (525-6) goojree ghar 1. Goojaree, First House:
lines.transliteration: kahi naamday-o ham har kee sayvaa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਉ ਤ ਓਹੁ ਭੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: He does not have even a trace of impurity - He is beyond impurity. He is fragrantly scented - He has come to take His Seat in my mind.
lines.transliteration: malai na laachhai paar malo paramlee-o baith o ree aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: No one saw Him come - who can know Him, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavat kinai na paykh i-o kavnai jaan ai ree baa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Who can describe Him? Who can understand Him? The all-pervading Lord has noancestors, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ka-un kahai kin  boojh ee-ai rama-ee-aa aakul ree baa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲੈ ਨ ਲਾਛੈ  ਪਾਰ ਮਲੋ ਪਰਮਲੀਓ  ਬੈਠੋ ਰੀ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: As the path of a bird's flight across the sky cannot be seen,
lines.transliteration: ji-o aakaasai pankhee-alo kh oj nirkh i-o na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਕਵਨੈ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਰੀ ਬਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal maajhai maachh lo maarag paykh -no na jaa-ee. ||2|| and the path of a fish through the water cannot be seen;||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਕਹੈ ਿਕਿਣ  ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਰਮਈਆ  ਆਕੁਲੁ  ਰੀ ਬਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As the mirage leads one to mistake the sky for a pitcher filled with water
lines.transliteration: ji-o aakaasai gharh oo-alo marig t arisnaa bh ari-aa.

lines.english: ||3||2|| gUjrI sRI rivdws jI ky pdy Gru 3  (525-10) goojree saree ravidaas jee kay pad ay gh ar 3 Goojaree, Padas Of Ravi Daas Jee, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (525-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naamay chay su-aamee beethlo jin t eenai jari-aa. ||3||2|| - so is God, the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, who fits these three comparisons.

lines.english: The calf has contaminated the milk in the teats.
lines.transliteration: dooDh  ta bachh rai thanhu bitaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਮਾਝੈ ਮਾਛਲੋ  ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੇਖਣੋ  ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The bumble bee has contaminated the flower, and the fish the water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: fool bhavar jal meen bigaari-o. ||1||

lines.english: O mother, where shall I find any offering for the Lord's worship?
lines.transliteration: maa-ee gobind poojaa kahaa lai charaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਬੀਠਲੋ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਤੀਨੈ  ਜਿਰਆ  ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: I cannot find any other flowers worthy of the incomparable Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar na fool anoop na paava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The snakes encircle the sandalwood trees.
lines.transliteration: mailaagar bayrHay hai bhu-i-angaa.

lines.english: Poison and nectar dwell there together. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bikh amrit  baseh ik sangaa. ||2||

lines.english: Dhoop d eep na-eebayd eh baasaa. Even with incense, lamps, offerings of food and fragrant flowers,

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਪੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਰਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaisay pooj karahi tayree d aasaa. ||3|| how are Your slaves to worship You? ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I dedicate and offer my body and mind to You.
lines.transliteration: tan man arpa-o pooj charaava-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I attain the immaculate Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad niranjan paava-o. ||4||

lines.english: I cannot worship You, nor offer You flowers.
lines.transliteration: poojaa archaa aahi na toree.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, what shall my condition be hereafter? ||5||1|| gUjrI sRI iqRlocn jIau ky pdy Gru 1  (525-16) goojree saree tarilochan jee-o kay pad ay gh ar 1 Goojaree, Padas Of Trilochan Jee, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (525-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas kavan gat  moree. ||5||1||

lines.english: You have not cleansed the filth from within yourself, although outwardly, you wear the dress of a renunciate.
lines.transliteration: antar mal nirmal nahee keenaa baahar bh aykh udaasee.

lines.english: In the heart-lotus of your self, you have not recognized God - why have you become a Sannyaasee? ||1|| pMnw 526
lines.transliteration: hirdai kamal gh at barahm na cheenHaa kaahay bh a-i-aa sani-aasee. ||1||

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, O Jai Chand,
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolee ray jai chand aa.
nahee nahee cheenHi-aa parmaanandaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. you have not realized the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: You eat in each and every house, fattening your body; you wear the patched coat and the ear-rings of the beggar, for the sake of wealth.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar khaa-i-aa pind baDh aa-i-aa kh inthaa mund a maa-i-aa.

lines.english: You apply the ashes of cremation to your body, but without a Guru, you have notfound the essence of reality. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhoom masaan  kee bh asam lagaa-ee gur bin t at na paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਖਾਇਆ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਬਧਾਇਆ  ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਮੁੰਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Why bother to chant your spells? Why bother to practice austerities? Why bother tochurn water?
lines.transliteration: kaa-ay japahu ray kaa-ay taphu ray kaa-ay bilovahu paan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਿਮ ਮਸਾਣ  ਕੀ ਭਸਮ  ਲਗਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa, who has created the 8.4 million species of beings.||3||
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jiniH upaa-ee so simrahu nirbaan ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇ  ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ  ਤਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ  ਿਬਲੋਵਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Why bother to carry the water-pot, O saffron-robed Yogi? Why bother to visit thesixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage?
lines.transliteration: kaa-ay kamandal kaaprhee-aa ray ath sath kaa-ay firaa-ee.

lines.english: Says Trilochan, listen, mortal: you have no corn - what are you trying to thresh? ||4||1|| gUjrI ] (526-5) goojree. Goojaree:
lines.transliteration: badat  tarilochan sun ray paraan ee kan  bin gaahu ke paahee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇ  ਕਮੰਡਲੁ  ਕਾਪੜੀਆ  ਰੇ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਕਾਇ  ਿਫਰਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of wealth, and dies in such thoughts,
lines.transliteration: ant kaal jo lachh mee simrai aisee chint aa meh jay marai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਦਿਤ ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨੁ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਕਣ ਿਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੁ ਿਕ ਪਾਹੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarap jon val val a-utarai. ||1|| shall be reincarnated over and over again, in the form of serpents. ||1||

lines.english: O sister, do not forget the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aree baa-ee gobid naam mat  beesrai. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਜੋ ਲਛਮੀ ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਐਸੀ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮਿਹ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, he who thinks of women, and dies in such thoughts,
lines.transliteration: ant kaal jo ist aree simrai aisee chint aa meh jay marai.
baysvaa jon val val a-utarai. ||2|| shall be reincarnated over and over again as a prostitute. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰੀ  ਬਾਈ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਤ ਬੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of his children, and dies in such thoughts,
lines.transliteration: ant kaal jo larh ikay simrai aisee chint aa meh jay marai.
sookar jon val val a-utarai. ||3|| shall be reincarnated over and over again as a pig. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਜੋ ਇਸਤਰ੍ੀ  ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਐਸੀ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮਿਹ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of mansions, and dies in such thoughts,
lines.transliteration: ant kaal jo mand ar simrai aisee chint aa meh jay marai.
parayt jon val val a-ut arai. ||4|| shall be reincarnated over and over again as a goblin. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਜੋ ਲਿੜਕੇ  ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਐਸੀ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮਿਹ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, one who thinks of the Lord, and dies in such thoughts,
lines.transliteration: ant kaal naaraa-in  simrai aisee chint aa meh jay marai.

lines.english: Goojaree, Padas Of Jai Dayv Jee, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (526-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: badat  tilochan t ay nar mukt aa peet ambar vaa kay rid ai basai. ||5||2|| says Trilochan, that man shall be liberated; the Lord shall abide in his heart. ||5||2|| gUjrI sRI jYdyv jIau kw pdw Gru 4  (526-12) goojree saree jaidayv jee-o kaa pad aa gh ar 4

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਜੋ ਮੰਦਰ  ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਐਸੀ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮਿਹ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: In the very beginning, was the Primal Lord, unrivalled, the Lover of Truth and other virtues.
lines.transliteration: parmaad purakh manopimaN sat aad bhaav rat aN.

lines.english: He is absolutely wonderful, transcending creation; remembering Him, all areemancipated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parmad-bh utaN parkarit  paraN jadchint sarab gat aN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਐਸੀ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮਿਹ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Dwell only upon the beauteous Name of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: kayval raam naam manormaN.

lines.punjabi: ਬਦਿਤ ਿਤਲੋਚਨੁ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਪੀਤੰਬਰੁ ਵਾ ਕੇ ਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bad amrit  tat ma-i-aN. the embodiment of ambrosial nectar and reality.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਜੈਦੇਵ  ਜੀਉ  ਕਾ ਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, the fear of birth, old age and death will not trouble you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: na danot  jasmarn ayn janam jaraaDh  maran  bha-i-aN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮਾਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖਮਨੋਿਪਮੰ  ਸਿਤ ਆਿਦ  ਭਾਵ ਰਤੰ ॥
lines.english: If you desire to escape the fear of the Messenger of Death, then praise the Lordjoyfully, and do good deeds.
lines.transliteration: ichhas jamaad  paraabh -yaN jas savast  sukarit  kirt-aN.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤੰ  ਪਰਿਕਰ੍ਿਤ  ਪਰੰ ਜਿਦਿਚੰਿਤ  ਸਰਬ  ਗਤੰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the past, present and future, He is always the same; He is the embodiment ofsupreme bliss. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhav bh oot bhaav sam-bi-yam parmaN parsanmid aN. ||2||

lines.english: If you seek the path of good conduct, forsake greed, and do not look upon othermen's property and women.
lines.transliteration: lobhaad  darisat par garihaN jadibiDh aacharn aN.

lines.english: Renounce all evil actions and evil inclinations, and hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: taj sakal d uhkarit  durmat ee bh aj chakarDh ar sarn aN. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਦਨੋਿਤ ਜਸਮਰਣੇਨ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਰਾਿਧ  ਮਰਣ  ਭਇਅੰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Worship the immaculate Lord, in thought, word and deed.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  nij nihkayvlaa rid  karman aa bachsaa.

lines.english: What is the good of practicing Yoga, giving feasts and charity, and practicingpenance? ||4||
lines.transliteration: jogayn kiN jagayn kiN daad ayn kiN tapsaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਇਛਿਸ  ਜਮਾਿਦ  ਪਰਾਭਯੰ  ਜਸੁ ਸਸਿਤ ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤ  ਿਕਰ੍ਤੰ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the Universe, O man; He is the source of all the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.
lines.transliteration: gobind gobind ayt jap nar sakal siDh  padaN.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਾਵ ਸਮਿਬਯ੍ਯ੍ਅੰ  ਪਰਮੰ  ਪਰ੍ਸੰਨਿਮਦੰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Jai Dayv has openly come to Him; He is the salvation of all, in the past, present andfuture. ||5||1|| pMnw 527 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (527-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu dyvgMDwrI mhlw 4 Gru 1 ] (527-3) raag dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 4 gh ar 1. Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fourth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: jaidayv aa-i-o t as safutaN bhav bh oot sarab gat aN. ||5||1||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Those who become the humble servants of the Lord and Master, lovingly focus theirminds on Him.
lines.transliteration: sayvak jan banay thaakur liv laagay.

lines.english: Those who chant Your Praises, through the Guru's Teachings, have great good fortunerecorded upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo tumraa jas kaht ay gurmat  tin mukh  bhaag sabh aagay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The bonds and shackles of Maya are shattered, by lovingly focusing their minds on theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tootay maa-i-aa kay banDhan faahay har raam naam liv laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਤਨ  ਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind is enticed by the Guru, the Enticer; beholding Him, I am wonder-struck. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hamraa man mohi-o gur mohan ham bisam bha-ee mukh  laagay. ||1||

lines.english: I slept through the entire dark night of my life, but through the tiniest bit of the Guru's Grace, I have been awakened.
lines.transliteration: saglee rain so-ee anDh i-aaree gur kichant  kirpaa jaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਫਾਹੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Beautiful Lord God, Master of servant Nanak, there is none comparable to You.||2||1|| dyvgMDwrI ] (527-7) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay parabh sund ar su-aamee mohi t um sar avar na laagay. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਗੁਰ ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਹਮ ਿਬਸਮ  ਭਈ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tell me - on what path will I find my Beauteous Lord?
lines.transliteration: mayro sundar kahhu milai kit  galee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੀ  ਰੈਿਣ ਸੋਈ ਅੰਿਧਆਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕੰਚਤ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਜਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, show me the Way, and I shall follow. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kay sant bat aavhu maarag ham peechh ai laag chalee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: I cherish in my heart the Words of my Beloved; this is the best way.
lines.transliteration: pari-a kay bachan sukhaanay hee-arai ih chaal banee hai bh alee.

lines.english: The bride may be hunch-backed and short, but if she is loved by her Lord Master, shebecomes beautiful, and she melts in the Lord's embrace. ||1||
