lines.transliteration: laturee maDhuree th aakur bh aa-ee oh sund ar har dh ul milee. ||1||

lines.english: There is only the One Beloved - we are all soul-brides of our Husband Lord. She whois pleasing to her Husband Lord is good.
lines.transliteration: ayko pari-o sakhee-aa sabh  pari-a kee jo bh aavai pir saa bh alee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਹਮ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਿਗ  ਚਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can poor, helpless Nanak do? As it pleases the Lord, so does he walk. ||2||2|| dyvgMDwrI ] (527-11) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gareeb ki-aa karai bichaaraa har bhaavai t it raahi chalee. ||2||2||

lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man mukh har har har bolee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ  ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਇਹ ਚਾਲ  ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ਭਲੀ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of the poppy. His shawl is saturated with the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rang chaloolai raat ee har paraym bh eenee cholee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਟੁਰੀ ਮਧੁਰੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਭਾਈ  ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਢੁਿਲ  ਿਮਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I wander around here and there, like a madman, bewildered, seeking out my DarlingLord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o fira-o divaanee aaval baaval t is kaaran  har dh olee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਸਖੀਆ  ਸਭ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਕੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਪਰ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ॥
lines.english: I shall be the slave of the slave of whoever unites me with my Darling Beloved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee maylai mayraa pareetam pi-aaraa ham t is kee gul golee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗਰੀਬੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੈ ਿਬਚਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਰਾਿਹ  ਚਲੀ  ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: So align yourself with the Almighty True Guru; drink in and savor the Ambrosial Nectarof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  manaavahu apunaa har amrit  pee jh olee-ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Lord within. ||2||3|| dyvgMDwrI ] (527-15) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jan naanak paa-i-aa har laaDh aa dayh tolee-ai. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Now, I have come, exhausted, to my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ab ham chalee thaakur peh haar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭੀਨੀ  ਚੋਲੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now that I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, God, please, either save me, or kill me. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 528
lines.transliteration: jab ham saran parabh oo kee aa-ee raakh  parabh oo bh aavai maar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have burnt in the fire the clever devices and praises of the world.
lines.transliteration: lokan kee chaturaa-ee upmaa t ay baisant ar jaar.

lines.english: Some speak good of me, and some speak ill of me, but I have surrendered my body to You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee bhalaa kaha-o bh aavai buraa kaha-o ham t an dee-o hai dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਕਨ  ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਤੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever comes to Your Sanctuary, O God, Lord and Master, You save by YourMerciful Grace.
lines.transliteration: jo aavat saran  thaakur parabh  tumree t is raakh o kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹਉ  ਹਮ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਓ  ਹੈ ਢਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord; O Lord, please, protect hishonor! ||2||4|| dyvgMDwrI ] (528-3) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saran t umaaree har jee-o raakh o laaj muraar. ||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਆਵਤ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai ha-o t is balihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: I live by continuously beholding the Blessed Vision of the Holy Guru's Darshan; within His Mind is the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daykh  daykh jeevaa saaDh  gur d arsan jis hird ai naam muraaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are pure and immaculate, O God, Almighty Lord and Master; how can I, theimpure one, meet You?
lines.transliteration: tum pavit ar paavan purakh  parabh  su-aamee ham ki-o kar milah jooth aaree.

lines.english: I have one thing in my mind, and another thing on my lips; I am such a poor, unfortunate liar! ||1||
lines.transliteration: hamrai jee-ay hor mukh hor hot  hai ham karamheen  khoorhi-aaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਦੇਿਖ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I appear to chant the Lord's Name, but within my heart, I am the most wicked of thewicked.
lines.transliteration: hamree mudar naam har su-aamee rid  antar dusat d ustaaree.

lines.english: As it pleases You, save me, O Lord and Master; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.||2||5|| dyvgMDwrI ] (528-7) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh o su-aamee jan naanak saran  tumHaaree. ||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ ਪਾਵਨ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਲਹ  ਜੂਠਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, the beautiful are just like the noseless ones.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam binaa sundar hai naktee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ  ਜੀਇ  ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂਿੜਆਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Like the son, born into the house of a prostitute, his name is cursed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o baysu-aa kay ghar poot  jamat  hai tis naam pari-o hai Dh arkatee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੀ  ਮੁਦਰ੍ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not have the Name of their Lord and Master within their hearts, are the most wretched, deformed lepers.
lines.transliteration: jin kai hirdai naahi har su-aamee t ay bigarh  roop bayrkatee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Like the person who has no Guru, they may know many things, but they are cursed inthe Court of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o niguraa baho baataa jaan ai oh har d argeh hai bh arsatee. ||1||

lines.english: Those, unto whom my Lord Master becomes Merciful, long for the feet of the Holy. nwnk piqq pivq imil sMgiq gur siqgur pwCY CuktI ]2]6] Ckw  1 (528-10, dyvgMDwrI mÚ 4) naanak patit  pavit  mil sangat  gur sat gur paachh ai chh uktee. ||2||6|| chh akaa 1 O Nanak, the sinners become pure, joining the Company of the Holy; following the Guru, the True Guru, they are emancipated. ||2||6|| First Set of Six|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 Gru 2  (528-12) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (528-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o da-i-aal ho-aa mayraa su-aamee t inaa saaDh  janaa pag chaktee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਹੈ ਨਕਟੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mother, I focus my consciousness on the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee gur charnee chit  laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ  ਕੇ ਘਿਰ  ਪੂਤੁ ਜਮਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ਧਰ੍ਕਟੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As God shows His Mercy, the lotus of my heart blossoms, and forever and ever, Imeditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh ho-ay kirpaal kamal pargaasay sad aa sad aa har Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One Lord is within, and the One Lord is outside; the One Lord is contained in all.
lines.transliteration: antar ayko baahar ayko sabh  meh ayk samaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇ ਿਬਗੜ  ਰੂਪ ਬੇਰਕਟੀ  ॥
lines.english: Within the heart, beyond the heart, and in all places, God, the Perfect One, is seen to be permeating. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghat avgh at ravi-aa sabh  thaa-ee har pooran barahm d ikhaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਨਗੁਰਾ  ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਓਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਹੈ ਭਰ੍ਸਟੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So many of Your servants and silent sages sing Your Praises, but no one has found Your limits.
lines.transliteration: ustat karahi sayvak mun kayt ay tayraa ant  na kat hoo paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਚਕਟੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Giver of peace, Destroyer of pain, Lord and Master - servant Nanak is forever asacrifice to You. ||2||1|| dyvgMDwrI ] (528-16) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aatay dukh bhanjan su-aamee jan naanak sad  bal jaa-ee-ai. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਿਵਤ  ਿਮਿਲ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਛੈ ਛੁਕਟੀ  ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: O mother, whatever is to be, shall be.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee honhaar so ho-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਛਕਾ  ੧ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: God pervades His pervading creation; one gains, while another loses. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raach rahi-o rachnaa parabh apnee kahaa laabh  kahaa kh o-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sometimes he blossoms in bliss, while at other times, he suffers in mourning.Sometimes he laughs, and sometimes he weeps.
lines.transliteration: kah fooleh aanand bikh ai sog kab hasno kab ro-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰਗਾਸੇ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sometimes he is filled with the filth of ego, while at other times, he washes it off inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kabhoo mail bharay abh imaanee kab saaDh oo sang Dh o-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: No one can erase the actions of God; I cannot see any other like Him.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na maytai parabh kaa kee-aa d oosar naahee alo-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru; by His Grace, I sleep in peace. ||2||2|| pMnw 529 dyvgMDwrI ] (529-1) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis gur balihaaree jih parsaad  sukh  so-ee-ai. ||2||2||

lines.english: O mother, I hear of death, and think of it, and I am filled with fear.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee sunat soch bh ai darat .

lines.english: Renouncing 'mine and yours' and egotism, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayr tayr t aja-o abh imaanaa saran su-aamee kee parat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਤਜਉ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੀ ਪਰਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever He says, I accept that as good. I do not say "No" to what He says.
lines.transliteration: jo jo kahai so-ee bhal maan-o naahi na kaa bol karat .

lines.english: Let me not forget Him, even for an instant; forgetting Him, I die. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nimakh na bisara-o hee-ay moray t ay bisrat  jaa-ee ha-o marat . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਨ ਕਾ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Giver of peace, God, the Perfect Creator, endures my great ignorance.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aa-ee pooran parabh  kartaa mayree bahut  i-aanap jarat .

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਿਬਸਰਉ  ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਜਾਈ  ਹਉ ਮਰਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am worthless, ugly and of low birth, O Nanak, but my Husband Lord is theembodiment of bliss. ||2||3|| dyvgMDwrI ] (529-4) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: nirgun karoop kulheen naanak ha-o anad  roop su-aamee bh arat. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਇਆਨਪ  ਜਰਤ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant forever the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: man har keerat kar sad ahooN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਿਨ ਕਰੂਿਪ  ਕੁਲਹੀਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਉ ਅਨਦ  ਰੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭਰਤ  ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: By singing, hearing and meditating on Him, all, whether of high or low status, are saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gaavat sunat  japat  uDhaarai baran abranaa sabh ahooN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is absorbed into the One from which he originated, when he understands the Way.
lines.transliteration: jah tay upji-o t ahee samaa-i-o ih biDh  jaanee t abahooN.

lines.english: Wherever this body was fashioned, it was not allowed to remain there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jahaa jahaa ih dayhee Dh aaree rahan na paa-i-o kabahooN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਜਪਤ  ਉਧਾਰੈ  ਬਰਨ  ਅਬਰਨਾ  ਸਭਹੂੰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Peace comes, and fear and doubt are dispelled, when God becomes Merciful.
lines.transliteration: sukh aa-i-o bh ai bharam binaasay kirpaal hoo-ay parabh  jabhoo.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my hopes have been fulfilled, renouncing my greed in the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy. ||2||4|| dyvgMDwrI ] (529-8) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayray pooray manorath saaDhsang t aj labahooN. ||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਇਓ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਨੀ  ਤਬਹੂੰ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, act as it pleases God.
lines.transliteration: man ji-o apunay parabh bh aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਇਹ ਦੇਹੀ ਧਾਰੀ  ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਕਬਹੂੰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Become the lowest of the low, the very least of the tiny, and speak in utmost humility.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: neechahu neech neech at naanHaa ho-ay gareeb bulaava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇਓ  ਭੈ ਭਰਮ  ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਹੂਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਬਹੂ ॥
lines.english: The many ostentatious shows of Maya are useless; I withhold my love from these.
lines.transliteration: anik adambar maa-i-aa kay birthay taa si-o pareet  ghataava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਤਿਜ ਲਬਹੂੰ ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: As something pleases my Lord and Master, in that I find my glory. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o apuno su-aamee sukh maanai t aa meh sobh aa paava-o. ||1||

lines.english: I am the slave of His slaves; becoming the dust of the feet of his slaves, I serve His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aas rayn  daasan kee jan kee tahal kamaava-o.

lines.english: I obtain all peace and greatness, O Nanak, living to chant His Name with my mouth.||2||5|| dyvgMDwrI ] (529-11) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh badi-aa-ee naanak jeeva-o mukh ahu bulaava-o. ||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਿਤ  ਨਾਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dear God, by Your Grace, my doubts have been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee t a-o parsaad  bharam d aari-o.

lines.english: By Your Mercy, all are mine; I reflect upon this in my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay sabh  ko apnaa man meh ihai beechaari-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਅਡੰਬਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਿਬਰਥੇ  ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਘਟਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of sins are erased, by serving You; the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan drivesaway sorrow.
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh mitay t ayree sayvaa d arsan d ookh utaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting Your Name, I have obtained supreme peace, and my anxieties and diseaseshave been cast out. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japat mahaa sukh  paa-i-o chint aa rog bid aari-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸਨ  ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੀ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਕਮਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander are forgotten, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  jhooth nindaa saaDh oo sang bisaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਬਿਡਆਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਵਉ  ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ  ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: The ocean of mercy has cut away the bonds of Maya; O Nanak, He has saved me.||2||6|| dyvgMDwrI ] (529-15) dayvganDh aaree. Dayv-Gandhaaree:
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa banDh kaatay kirpaa niDh  naanak aap uDh aari-o. ||2||6||

lines.english: All the cleverness of my mind is gone.
lines.transliteration: man sagal si-aanap rahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਤਉ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਡਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes; Nanak holds tight to HisSupport. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar su-aamee naanak ot gahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਪਨਾ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Erasing my self-conceit, I have entered His Sanctuary; these are the Teachingsspoken by the Holy Guru.
lines.transliteration: aap mayt pa-ay sarnaa-ee ih mat  saaDh oo kahee.

lines.english: Surrendering to the Will of God, I attain peace, and the darkness of doubt is dispelled.||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee aagi-aa maan sukh  paa-i-aa bh aram aDh ayraa lahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਪਰਾਧ  ਿਮਟੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਦੂਖੁ ਉਤਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: I know that You are all-wise, O God, my Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jaan parbeen su-aamee parabh mayray saran  tumaaree ahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਰੋਗੁ ਿਬਦਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; the value of Your Almighty Creative Power cannot be estimated. ||2||7|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (529-18) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaray kud rat keem na pahee. ||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਬਸਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God is my praanaa, my breath of life; He is the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: har paraan parabhoo sukh -daatay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਬੰਧ ਕਾਟੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਧਾਿਰਓ ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, only a few know Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kaahoo jaat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your Saints are Your Beloveds; death does not consume them.
lines.transliteration: sant t umaaray t umray pareet am tin ka-o kaal na kh aatay.

lines.english: They are dyed in the deep crimson color of Your Love, and they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1|| pMnw 530
lines.transliteration: rang tumaarai laal bh a-ay hai raam naam ras maat ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The greatest sins, and millions of pains and diseases are destroyed by Your Gracious Glance, O God.
lines.transliteration: mahaa kilbikh kot d okh rogaa parabh  darisat t uhaaree haat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਕੋਿਟ ਦੋਖ ਰੋਗਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਤੁਹਾਰੀ  ਹਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: While sleeping and waking, Nanak sings the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har; he falls atthe Guru's feet. ||2||8|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (530-2) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sovat jaag har har har gaa-i-aa naanak gur charan paraat ay. ||2||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਵਤ  ਜਾਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ  ਪਰਾਤੇ  ॥੨॥੮॥
lines.english: I have seen that God with my eyes everywhere.
lines.transliteration: so parabh jat  kat paykh i-o nain ee.

lines.english: The Giver of peace, the Giver of souls, His Speech is Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aa-ee jee-an ko d aataa amrit  jaa kee bain ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਿਖਓ ਨੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints dispel the darkness of ignorance; the Guru is the Giver of the gift of life.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan aDhayraa sant ee kaati-aa jee-a d aan gur d ainee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਜੀਅਨ  ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬੈਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has made me His own; I was on fire, but now I am cooled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa kar leeno apunaa jaltay seet al hon ee. ||1||

lines.english: The karma of good deeds, and the Dharma of righteous faith, have not been producedin me, in the least; nor has pure conduct welled up in me.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam kichh  upaj na aa-i-o nah upjee nirmal karn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ  ਸੰਤੀ ਕਾਿਟਆ ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing cleverness and self-mortification, O Nanak, I fall at the Guru's feet.||2||9|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (530-6) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chhaad si-aanap sanjam naanak laago gur kee charn ee. ||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਲੀਨੋ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਜਲਤੇ  ਸੀਤਲ  ਹੋਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name, and earn the profit.
lines.transliteration: har raam naam jap laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਿਕਛੁ ਉਪਿਜ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਨਹ ਉਪਜੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਕਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You shall attain salvation, peace, poise and bliss, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gat paavahi sukh  sahj anand aa kaatay jam kay faahaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਿਡ  ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਸੰਜਮ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਾਗੋ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Searching, searching, searching and reflecting, I have found that the Lord's Name iswith the Saints.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat khoj beechaari-o har sant  janaa peh aahaa.

lines.english: They alone obtain this treasure, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tinHaa paraapat  ayhu niDh aanaa jinH kai karam likh aahaa. ||1||

lines.english: They are very fortunate and honorable; they are the perfect bankers.
lines.transliteration: say badbhaagee say pat ivantay say-ee pooray saahaa.

lines.english: They are beautiful, so very wise and handsome; O Nanak, purchase the Name of theLord, Har, Har. ||2||10|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (530-9) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sundar sugh arh saroop t ay naanak jinH har har naam visaahaa. ||2||10||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਅਨੰਦਾ  ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mind, why are you so puffed up with egotism?
lines.transliteration: man kah ahaNkaar afaaraa.

lines.english: Whatever is seen in this foul, impure and filthy world, is only ashes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: durganDh  apvit ar apaavan bh eetar jo d eesai so chh aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਿਜ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਿਹ ਆਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remember the One who created you, O mortal; He is the Support of your soul, andthe breath of life.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tis simar paraanee jee-o paraan jin Dh aaraa.

lines.english: One who forsakes Him, and attaches himself to another, dies to be reborn; he is such an ignorant fool! ||1||
lines.transliteration: tiseh t i-aag avar laptaavahi mar janmeh mugaDh  gavaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ  ਸੇ ਪਿਤਵੰਤੇ  ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am blind, mute, crippled and totally lacking in understanding; O God, Preserver ofall, please preserve me!
lines.transliteration: anDh gung pingul mat  heenaa parabh  raakh o raakh anhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਸੁਘੜ  ਸਰੂਪ  ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਹਾ  ॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Creator, the Cause of causes is all-powerful; O Nanak, how helpless are Hisbeings! ||2||11|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (530-13) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar samrathaa ki-aa naanak jant bichaaraa. ||2||11||

lines.english: God is the nearest of the near.
lines.transliteration: so parabh nayrai hoo t ay nayrai.

lines.english: Remember Him, meditate on Him, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of theUniverse, day and night, evening and morning. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simar Dhi-aa-ay gaa-ay gun gobind  din rain saajh  savayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਗੰਧ  ਅਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਅਪਾਵਨ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਛਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Redeem your body in the invaluable Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chantingthe Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: uDhar d ayh d ulabh  saaDh oo sang har har naam japayrai.

lines.english: Do not delay for an instant, even for a moment. Death is keeping you constantly in hisvision. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gharee na muhat  na chasaa bilambahu kaal nit eh nit  hayrai. ||1||

lines.english: Lift me up out of the dark dungeon, O Creator Lord; what is there which is not in Your home?
lines.transliteration: anDh bilaa t ay kaadh ahu kart ay ki-aa naahee gh ar tayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਅਵਰ  ਲਪਟਾਵਿਹ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਗਵਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Bless Nanak with the Support of Your Name, that he may find great happiness andpeace. ||2||12|| Cky 2 ] (530-16) chhakay 2. Second Set of Six|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (530-16) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam aDhaar d eejai naanak ka-o aanad  sookh  ghanayrai. ||2||12||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਿਪੰਗੁਲ  ਮਿਤ ਹੀਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, meet with the Guru, and worship the Naam in adoration.
lines.transliteration: man gur mil naam araaDhi-o.

lines.english: You shall obtain peace, poise, bliss, joy and pleasure, and lay the foundation ofeternal life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  mangal ras jeevan kaa mool baaDh i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave, and shattered the bonds ofMaya.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apunaa daas keeno kaatay maa-i-aa faaDh i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Through loving devotion, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe,I have escaped the Path of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh agat gaa-ay gun  gobid  jam kaa maarag saaDh i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਗਾਇ  ਗੁਨ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਸਾਝ ਸਵੇਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When he became Merciful, the rust was removed, and I found the priceless treasure.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o anoograhu miti-o morchaa amol pad aarath laaDh i-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a hundred thousand times, to my unapproachable, unfathomable Lord and Master. ||2||13|| pMnw 531 dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (531-1) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: balihaarai naanak lakh bayraa mayray th aakur agam agaaDh i-o. ||2||13||

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਬੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧਓ  ॥੨॥੧੩॥
lines.english: O mother, how fruitful is the birth of one who sings the Glories of God, and enshrineslove for the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dyvgMDwrI mÚ 5) maa-ee jo parabh kay gun gaavai. safal aa-i-aa jeevan fal t aa ko paarbarahm liv laavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Beautiful, wise, brave and divine is one who obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Companyof the Holy.
lines.transliteration: sundar sugh arh soor so bayt aa jo saaDh oo sang paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with his tongue, and does not have towander in reincarnation again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam uchaar karay har rasnaa bahurh na jonee Dh aavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਆਇਆ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord God pervades his mind and body; he does not look upon any other.
lines.transliteration: pooran barahm ravi-aa man tan meh aan na d aristee aavai.

lines.english: Hell and disease do not afflict one who joins the Company of the Lord's humbleservants, O Nanak; the Lord attaches him to the hem of His robe. ||2||14|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (531-5) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: narak rog nahee hovat jan sang naanak jis larh  laavai. ||2||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੂਰੁ ਸੋ ਬੇਤਾ ਜੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: His fickle mind is entangled in a dream.
lines.transliteration: chanchal supnai hee urjhaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not even understand this much, that someday he shall have to depart; he has gone crazy with Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: itnee na boojh ai kabhoo chalnaa bikal bh a-i-o sang maa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਆਨ  ਨ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੀ  ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is engrossed in the delight of the flower's color; he strives only to indulge incorruption.
lines.transliteration: kusam rang sang ras rachi-aa bikhi-aa ayk upaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ  ਰੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਵਤ  ਜਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Hearing about greed, he feels happy in his mind, and he runs after it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lobh sunai man sukh  kar maanai bayg t ahaa uth  Dhaa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: Wandering and roaming all around, I have endured great pain, but now, I have cometo the door of the Saint.
lines.transliteration: firat firat  bahut  saram paa-i-o sant  du-aarai aa-i-o.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Supreme Lord Master has blended Nanak with Himself.||2||15|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (531-8) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karee kirpaa paarbarahm su-aamee naanak lee-o samaa-i-o. ||2||15||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤਨੀ  ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਚਲਨਾ  ਿਬਕਲ  ਭਇਓ  ਸੰਿਗ ਮਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All peace is found in the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa gur charnaa.

lines.english: They drive away my sins and purify my mind; their Support carries me across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kalimal daaran maneh saaDhaaran ih aasar mohi t arnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਸਮ  ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਚਆ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਏਕ ਉਪਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: This is the labor which I perform: worship, flower-offerings, service and devotion.
lines.transliteration: poojaa archaa sayvaa bandan ihai tahal mohi karnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭ ਸੁਨੈ ਮਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੇਿਗ  ਤਹਾ ਉਿਠ ਧਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind blossoms forth and is enlightened, and I am not cast into the womb again.||1||
lines.transliteration: bigsai man hovai pargaasaa bahur na garbhai parnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਰਤ  ਿਫਰਤ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਸੰਤ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: I behold the fruitful vision of the Saint; this is the meditation I have taken.
lines.transliteration: safal moorat parsa-o sant an kee ihai Dh i-aanaa Dh arnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੀ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੀਓ  ਸਮਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Lord Master has become Merciful to Nanak, and he has entered the Sanctuary ofthe Holy. ||2||16|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (531-12) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal th aakur naanak ka-o pari-o saaDh  kee sarnaa. ||2||16||

lines.english: Offer your prayer to your Lord.
lines.transliteration: apunay har peh bintee kahee-ai.

lines.english: You shall obtain the four blessings, and the treasures of bliss, pleasure, peace, poiseand the spiritual powers of the Siddhas. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath anad  mangal niDh  sookh  sahj siDh  lahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਮਲ  ਡਾਰਨ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਧਾਰਨ  ਇਹ ਆਸਰ  ਮੋਿਹ ਤਰਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Renounce your self-conceit, and grasp hold of the Guru's feet; hold tight to the hemof God's robe.
lines.transliteration: maan ti-aag har charnee laaga-o t is parabh  anchal gahee-ai.

lines.english: The heat of the ocean of fire does not affect one who longs for the Lord and Master's Sanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aaNch na laagai agan saagar tay saran su-aamee kee ahee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ  ਸੇਵਾ ਬੰਦਨ  ਇਹੈ ਟਹਲ  ਮੋਿਹ ਕਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Again and again, God puts up with the millions of sins of the supremely ungratefulones.
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh mahaa akrit -ghan bahur bahur parabh  sahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਗਰਭੈ  ਪਰਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The embodiment of mercy, the Perfect Transcendent Lord - Nanak longs for HisSanctuary. ||2||17|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (531-15) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karunaa mai pooran parmaysur naanak t is saranhee-ai. ||2||17||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਪਰਸਉ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਿਧਆਨਾ  ਧਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Place the Guru's feet within your heart,
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan ridai parvaysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਿਰਓ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ  ॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: rog sog sabh d ookh binaasay ut ray sagal kalaysaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. and all illness, sorrow and pain shall be dispelled; all suffering shall come to an end.||1||Pause||

lines.english: The sins of countless incarnations are erased, as if one has taken purifying baths atmillions of sacred shrines.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilbikh naaseh kot majan isnaanaa.

lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by singing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe, and centering one's mind in meditation on Him.||1||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan gaavat  gun gobind  laago sahj Dh i-aanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave; breaking my bonds, He has saved me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apunaa daas keeno banDh an tor niraaray.

lines.english: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and the Bani of Your Word; slaveNanak is a sacrifice to You. ||2||18|| Cky 3 ] (531-19) chhakay 3. Third Set of Six|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (531-19) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jap jap naam jeevaa tayree ban ee naanak d aas balihaaray. ||2||18||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਲਾਗਉ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਚਲੁ  ਗਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O mother, I long to see the Feet of God. pMnw 532
lines.transliteration: maa-ee parabh kay charan nihaara-o.

lines.english: Be Merciful to me, O my Lord and Master, that I might never forsake them from my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karahu anoograhu su-aamee mayray man tay kabahu na daara-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡਾਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Applying the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead, I burn away thepoison of sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo Dh oor laa-ee mukh  mast ak kaam kroDh  bikh jaara-o.

lines.english: I judge myself to be the lowest of all; in this way, I instill peace within my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay neech aat am kar maan-o man meh ih sukh  Dhaara-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਿਰ ਲਾਈ  ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਿਬਖੁ ਜਾਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord and Master, and I shake off all my sins.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavah thaakur abh inaasee kalmal saglay jh aara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਆਤਮ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨਉ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found the gift of the treasure of the Naam, O Nanak; I hug it close, andenshrine it in my heart. ||2||19|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (532-4) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan naanak d aan paava-o kanth  laa-ay ur Dh aara-o. ||2||19||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਝਾਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dear God, I long to behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee-o paykh a-o daras t umaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ  ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰਉ  ॥੨॥੧੯॥
lines.english: I cherish this beautiful meditation day and night; You are dearer to me than my soul,dearer than life itself. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sundar Dh i-aan Dh aar din rainee jee-a paraan t ay pi-aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have studied and contemplated the essence of the Shaastras, the Vedas and thePuraanas.
lines.transliteration: saastar bayd  puraan avilokay simrit  tat beechaaraa.

lines.english: Protector of the meek, Lord of the breath of life, O Perfect One, carry us across theterrifying world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath paraanpat  pooran bh avjal uDh ranhaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਤੇ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Since the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the humble devotees have beenYour servants; in the midst of the world of corruption, You are their Support.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  bhagat jan sayvak t aa kee bikh ai aDh aaraa.

lines.english: Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of such humble beings; the Transcendent Lord is the Giver of all. ||2||20|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (532-8) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin jan kee Dh oor baachh ai nit naanak parmaysar d ayvanhaaraa. ||2||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਅਿਵਲੋਕੇ  ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your humble servant, O Lord, is intoxicated with Your sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: tayraa jan raam rasaa-in  maat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਿਤ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਵਜਲ  ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who obtains the treasure of the Nectar of Your Love, does not renounce it to gosomewhere else. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraym rasaa niDh jaa ka-o upjee chh od na kat hoo jaat aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਿਬਖੈ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: While sitting, he repeats the Lord's Name, Har, Har; while sleeping, he repeats theLord's Name, Har, Har; he eats the Nectar of the Lord's Name as his food.
lines.transliteration: baithat  har har sovat  har har har ras bh ojan kh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਬਾਛੈ ਿਨਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy is equal to taking cleansing baths at thesixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath majan keeno saaDh oo Dh ooree naat aa. ||1||

lines.english: How fruitful is the birth of the Lord's humble servant; the Creator is his Father.
lines.transliteration: safal janam har jan kaa upji-aa jin keeno sa-ut biDh aataa.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who recognizes the Perfect Lord God, takes all with him, and saveseveryone. ||2||21|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (532-11) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sagal samooh lai uDhray naanak pooran barahm pachh aataa. ||2||21||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸਾ ਿਨਿਧ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਉਪਜੀ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mother, without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee gur bin gi-aan na paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: They wander around, weeping and crying out in various ways, but the Lord of theWorld does not meet them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik parkaar firat billaat ay milat  nahee gosaa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਠਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਵਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The body is tied up with emotional attachment, disease and sorrow, and so it is luredinto countless reincarnations.
lines.transliteration: moh rog sog tan baaDh i-o baho jonee bh armaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ  ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He finds no place of rest without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; towhom should he go and cry? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tikan na paavai bin satsangat  kis aagai jaa-ay roo-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਨੋ ਸਉਤੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: When my Lord and Master shows His Mercy, we lovingly focus our consciousness onthe feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: karai anoograhu su-aamee mayraa saaDh charan chit  laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸਮੂਹ ਲੈ ਉਧਰੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥੨॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The most horrible agonies are dispelled in an instant, O Nanak, and we merge in theBlessed Vision of the Lord. ||2||22|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (532-15) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sankat ghor katay kh in bheetar naanak har d aras samaa-ee-ai. ||2||22||

lines.english: The Lord and Master Himself has become Merciful.
lines.transliteration: thaakur ho-ay aap d a-i-aal.

lines.english: I have been emancipated, and I have become the embodiment of bliss; I am the Lord's child - He has saved me. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ee kali-aan  anand roop ho-ee hai ubray baal gupaal. rahaa-o.

lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer; within my mind, I meditate on theSupreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  karee baynant ee paarbarahm man Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Giving me His hand, the Transcendent Lord has eradicated all my sins. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ay parmaysur saglaa d urat mitaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਿਧਓ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Husband and wife join together in rejoicing, celebrating the Victory of the LordMaster.
lines.transliteration: var naaree mil mangal gaa-i-aa thaakur kaa jaikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਟਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਰੂਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the humble servant of the Lord, who emancipateseveryone. ||2||23|| pMnw 533 <> siqgur pRswid ] (533-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (533-2) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jan ka-o bal jaa-ee-ai jo sabhnaa karay uDh aar. ||2||23||

lines.english: I offer my prayer to my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: apunay satgur peh bin-o kahi-aa.

lines.english: The Destroyer of distress has become kind and merciful, and all my anxiety is over. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal d a-i-aal d ukh bhanjan mayraa sagal and aysraa ga-i-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am a sinner, hypocritical and greedy, but still, He puts up with all of my merits anddemerits.
lines.transliteration: ham paapee paakhandee lobh ee hamraa gun avgun sabh  sahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਗਲ  ਅੰਦੇਸਰਾ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Placing His hand on my forehead, He has exalted me. The wicked ones who wanted todestroy me have been killed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar mastak Dh aar saaj nivaajay mu-ay d usat jo kh a-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: He is generous and benevolent, the beautifier of all, the embodiment of peace; theBlessed Vision of His Darshan is so fruitful!
lines.transliteration: par-upkaaree sarab saDhaaree safal d arsan sehaj-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਪਾਖੰਡੀ  ਲੋਭੀ ਹਮਰਾ  ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, He is the Giver to the unworthy; I enshrine His Lotus Feet within myheart. ||2||24|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (533-5) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nirgun ka-o d aataa charan  kamal ur Dh ari-aa. ||2||24||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਸਾਿਜ  ਿਨਵਾਜੇ  ਮੁਏ ਦੁਸਟ  ਜੋ ਖਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My God is the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: anaath naath parabh hamaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਸਧਾਰੀ  ਸਫਲ  ਦਰਸਨ ਸਹਜਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Savior Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saran aa-i-o raakhanhaaray. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਕਉ ਦਾਤਾ  ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਉਰ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Protect me on all sides, O Lord;
lines.transliteration: sarab paakh raakh  muraaray.
aagai paachhai ant ee vaaray. ||1|| protect me in the future, in the past, and at the very last moment. ||1||

lines.english: Whenever something comes to mind, it is You.
lines.transliteration: jab chitva-o t ab tuhaaray.

lines.english: Contemplating Your virtues, my mind is sanctified. ||2||
lines.transliteration: un samHaar mayraa man saDhaaray. ||2||

lines.english: I hear and sing the Hymns of the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: sun gaava-o gur bachnaaray.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaa-o saaDh d arsaaray. ||3||

lines.english: Within my mind, I have the Support of the One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: man meh raakha-o ayk asaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, my God is the Creator of all. ||4||25|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (533-9) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh mayray karnaihaaray. ||4||25||

lines.english: God, this is my heart's desire:
lines.transliteration: parabh ihai manorath mayraa.

lines.english: O treasure of kindness, O Merciful Lord, please make me the slave of your Saints. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan d a-i-aal mohi d eejai kar sant an kaa chayraa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the early hours of the morning, I fall at the feet of Your humble servants; night andday, I obtain the Blessed Vision of their Darshan.
lines.transliteration: paraatehkaal laaga-o jan charnee nis baasur d aras paava-o.

lines.english: Dedicating my body and mind, I serve the humble servant of the Lord; with mytongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tan man arap kara-o jan sayvaa rasnaa har gun gaava-o. ||1||

lines.english: With each and every breath, I meditate in remembrance on my God; I live continuallyin the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: saas saas simra-o parabh apunaa sat sang nit  rahee-ai.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only support and wealth; O Nanak, from this,I obtain bliss. ||2||26|| rwgu dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 Gru 3  (533-13) raag dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 3 Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (533-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ayk aDhaar naam Dh an moraa anad  naanak ih lahee-ai. ||2||26||

lines.english: O friend, such is the Dear Lord whom I have obtained.
lines.transliteration: meetaa aisay har jee-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਜੈ  ਕਿਰ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: He does not leave me, and He always keeps me company. Meeting the Guru, night and day, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhod na jaa-ee sad  hee sangay an-d in gur mil gaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I met the Fascinating Lord, who has blessed me with all comforts; He does not leaveme to go anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: mili-o manohar sarab sukhainaa t i-aag na kat hoo jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਤਹਕਾਲ  ਲਾਗਉ  ਜਨ ਚਰਨੀ  ਿਨਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen the mortals of many and various types, but they are not equal to even ahair of my Beloved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik anik bhaat  baho paykh ay pari-a rom na samsar laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ ਕਰਉ  ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: His palace is so beautiful! His gate is so wonderful! The celestial melody of the soundcurrent resounds there.
lines.transliteration: mandar bh aag sobh  du-aarai anhat  run jhun laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਸਮਰਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਿਨਤ  ਰਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I enjoy eternal bliss; I have obtained a permanent place in the home ofmy Beloved. ||2||1||27|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (533-17) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sadaa rang maan ay garih pari-a theet ay sad  thaa-ay. ||2||1||27||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਅਨਦੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੨॥੨੬॥
lines.english: My mind longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and His Name.
lines.transliteration: darsan naam ka-o man aachh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I have wandered everywhere, and now I have come to follow the Saint. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharam aa-i-o hai sagal thaan ray aahi pari-o sant  paachh ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whom should I serve? Whom should I worship in adoration? Whoever I see shall pass away. pMnw 534
lines.transliteration: kis ha-o sayvee kis aaraaDhee jo d istai so gaachh ai.

lines.english: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; my mind longs for the dust of their Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kee sarnee paree-ai charan  rayn man baachh ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ  ਪਰੀਐ  ਚਰਣ  ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not know the way, and I have no virtue. It is so difficult to escape from Maya!
lines.transliteration: jugat na jaanaa gun nahee ko-ee mahaa d utar maa-ay aachh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇ  ਆਛੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has come and fallen at the Guru's feet; all of his evil inclinations have vanished.||2||2||28|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (534-3) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aa-ay pa-i-o naanak gur charnee ta-o ut ree sagal d uraachh ai. ||2||2||28||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਪਇਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਦੁਰਾਛੈ  ॥੨॥੨॥੨੮॥
lines.english: O Beloved, Your Words are Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: amritaa pari-a bachan t uhaaray.

lines.english: O supremely beautiful Enticer, O Beloved, You are among all, and yet distinct from all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: at sund ar manmohan pi-aaray sabh hoo maDh  niraaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I do not seek power, and I do not seek liberation. My mind is in love with Your LotusFeet.
lines.transliteration: raaj na chaaha-o mukat na chaaha-o man pareet  charan kamlaaray.

lines.english: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - I seek only the Blessed Vision of my Lord and Master's Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: barahm mahays siDh mun ind raa mohi th aakur hee d arsaaray. ||1||

lines.english: I have come, helpless, to Your Door, O Lord Master; I am exhausted - I seek theSanctuary of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: deen d u-aarai aa-i-o th aakur saran pari-o sant  haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਚਾਹਉ  ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have met my Enticing Lord God; my mind is cooled and soothed - itblossoms forth in joy. ||2||3||29|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (534-6) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh milay manohar man seet al bigsaaray. ||2||3||29||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮਹੇਸ  ਿਸਧ ਮੁਿਨ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾ ਮੋਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹੀ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, His servant swims across to salvation.
lines.transliteration: har jap sayvak paar utaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਆਇਓ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਸੰਤ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: When God becomes merciful to the meek, then one does not have to sufferreincarnation, only to die again. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal bh a-ay parabh  apnay bahurh  janam nahee maari-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲੇ ਮਨੋਹਰ  ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲ  ਿਬਗਸਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੩॥੨੯॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of theLord, and he does not lose the jewel of this human life.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangam gun  gaavah har kay rat an janam nahee haari-o.

lines.english: Singing the Glories of God, he crosses over the ocean of poison, and saves all hisgenerations as well. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh gun gaa-ay bikh ai ban t ari-aa kulah samooh uDh aari-o. ||1||

lines.english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within his heart, and with every breath and morsel of food, he chants the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basi-aa rid bh eetar saas giraas uchaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨਹੀ ਮਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has grasped the Support of the Lord of the Universe; again and again, he is asacrifice to Him. ||2||4||30|| rwgu dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 Gru 4  (534-11) raag dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 4 Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (534-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak ot gahee jagdeesur punah punah balihaari-o. ||2||4||30||

lines.english: Some wander around the forests, wearing religious robes, but the Fascinating Lordremains distant from them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karat firay ban bh aykh mohan rahat  niraar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਮ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨਹੀ ਹਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: They talk, preach, and sing their lovely songs, but within their minds, the filth of theirsins remains. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kathan sunaavan geet neekay gaavan man meh Dh artay gaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਿਬਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਕੁਲਹ  ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They may be very beautiful, extremely clever, wise and educated, and they may speakvery sweetly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: at sund ar baho chat ur si-aanay bid i-aa rasnaa chaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਬਿਸਆ  ਿਰਦ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਉਚਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: To forsake pride, emotional attachment, and the sense of 'mine and yours', is the pathof the double-edged sword. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maan moh mayr tayr bibarjit  ayhu maarag kh anday Dh aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਪੁਨਹ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰਓ  ॥੨॥੪॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, they alone swim across the terrifying world-ocean, who, by God's Grace, join the Society of the Saints. ||4||1||31|| rwgu dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 Gru 5  (534-15) raag dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 5 Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (534-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tin bh avjal t aree-alay parabh  kirpaa sant  sangaar. ||4||1||31||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen the Lord to be on high; the Fascinating Lord is the highest of all.
lines.transliteration: mai paykhi-o ree oochaa mohan sabh  tay oochaa.

lines.english: No one else is equal to Him - I have made the most extensive search on this.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan na samsar ko-oo laagai dhoodh  rahay ham moochaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Utterly infinite, exceedingly great, deep and unfathomable - He is lofty, beyond reach.
lines.transliteration: baho bay-ant at  bado gaahro thaah nahee aghoochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨ  ਸੁਨਾਵਨ  ਗੀਤ  ਨੀਕੇ  ਗਾਵਨ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਧਰਤੇ ਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: His weight cannot be weighed, His value cannot be estimated. How can the Enticer ofthe mind be obtained? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tol na t ulee-ai mol na mulee-ai kat  paa-ee-ai man roochaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ  ਿਸਆਨੇ  ਿਬਿਦਆ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਚਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Millions search for Him, on various paths, but without the Guru, none find Him.
lines.transliteration: khoj asankh aa anik t apanthaa bin gur nahee pahoochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਿਬਬਰਿਜਤ ਏਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord Master has become Merciful. Meeting the Holy Saint, I drink in the sublime essence. ||2||1||32|| pMnw 535 dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (535-1) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kirpaa karee thaakur mil saaDh oo ras bh oonchaa. ||2||1||32||

lines.english: I have looked in so many ways, but there is no other like the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai baho biDh paykh i-o doojaa naahee ree ko-oo.

lines.english: On all the continents and islands, He is permeating and fully pervading; He is in all worlds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khand d eep sabh  bheetar ravi-aa poor rahi-o sabh  lo-oo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਰੀ ਕੋਊ ॥
lines.english: He is the most unfathomable of the unfathomable; who can chant His Praises? Mymind lives by hearing news of Him.
lines.transliteration: agam agammaa kavan mahimmaa man jeevai sun so-oo.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਭ ਲੋਊ ॥੧॥
lines.english: People in the four stages of life, and in the four social classes are liberated, by servingYou, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chaar aasram chaar barannaa mukat bh a-ay sayvt o-oo. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Word of His Shabad within me; I have attained thesupreme status. My sense of duality has been dispelled, and now, I am at peace.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad drirh -aa-i-aa param pad  paa-i-aa d utee-a ga-ay sukh  ho-oo.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੰਮਾ  ਕਵਨ  ਮਿਹੰਮਾ  ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੁਿਨ ਸੋਊ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have easily crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, obtaining thetreasure of the Lord's Name. ||2||2||33|| rwgu dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 Gru 6  (535-5) raag dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 6 Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (535-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhav saagar t ari-aa har niDh  paa-ee sahjo-oo. ||2||2||33||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਆਸਰਮ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਬਰੰਨਾ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਏ ਸੇਵਤੋਊ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Know that there is One and only One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykai ray har aykai jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਦੁਤੀਅ  ਗਏ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਊ ॥
lines.english: O Gurmukh, know that He is One. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aykai ray gurmukh jaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ਸਹਜੋਊ  ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Why are you wandering around? O Siblings of Destiny, don't wander around; He ispermeating and pervading everywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaahay bharmat  ha-o t um bh armahu na bh aa-ee ravi-aa ray ravi-aa sarab thaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: As the fire in the forest, without control, cannot serve any purpose
lines.transliteration: ji-o baisantar kaasat majh aar bin sanjam nahee kaaraj saar.
bin gur na paavaigo har jee ko du-aar. - just so, without the Guru, one cannot attain the Gate of the Lord.

lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, renounce your ego; says Nanak, in this way, thesupreme treasure is obtained. ||2||1||34|| dyvgMDwrI 5 ] (535-9) dayvganDh aaree 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mil sangat t aj abh imaan kaho naanak paa-ay hai param niDh aan. ||2||1||34||

lines.english: His state cannot be known. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaanee na jaa-ee taa kee gaat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੇ ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਹਉ ਤੁਮ ਭਰ੍ਮਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ਰਿਵਆ ਰੇ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਥਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can I behold Him through clever tricks? Those who tell this story are wonder- struck and amazed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kah paykhaara-o ha-o kar chat uraa-ee bisman bismay kahan kahaat . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕਾਸਟ  ਮਝਾਿਰ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਜਮ  ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The servants of God, the celestial singers, the Siddhas and the seekers,
lines.transliteration: gan ganDh arab siDh  ar saaDh ik.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar dayv barahm barahmaad ik. the angelic and divine beings, Brahma and those like Brahma,

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਤਿਜ ਅਿਭਮਾਨ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਪਰਮ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪  ॥
lines.transliteration: chatur bayd  uchrat  din raat . and the four Vedas proclaim, day and night,
agam agam thaakur aagaaDh . that the Lord and Master is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਨੀ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਾਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Endless, endless are His Glories, says Nanak; they cannot be described - they arebeyond our reach. ||2||2||35|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (535-12) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun bay-ant bay-ant  bhan naanak kahan na jaa-ee parai paraat . ||2||2||35||

lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay gaa-ay karnaihaar. I meditate, and sing of the Creator Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹ ਪੇਖਾਰਉ  ਹਉ ਕਿਰ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਿਬਸਮਨ  ਿਬਸਮੇ  ਕਹਨ  ਕਹਾਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have become fearless, and I have found peace, poise and bliss, remembering theinfinite Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-o naahee sukh  sahj anand aa anik ohee ray ayk samaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Guru, of the most fruitful image, has placed His hand upon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: safal moorat gur mayrai maathai.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there, I find Him with me.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  paykh a-o tat tat saathai.

lines.english: The Lotus Feet of the Lord are the Support of my very breath of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal mayray paraan aDhaar. ||1||

lines.english: My God is all-powerful, unfathomable and utterly vast.
lines.transliteration: samrath athaah badaa parabh mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਭਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਿਤ  ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master is close at hand - He dwells in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar saahib nayraa.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary and the Support of God, who has no end or limitation. ||2||3||36|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 ] (535-15) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5. Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taakee saran aasar parabh  naanak jaa kaa ant  na paaraavaar. ||2||3||36||

lines.english: Turn away, O my mind, turn away.
lines.transliteration: ultee ray man ultee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਓਹੀ ਰੇ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Turn away from the faithless cynic.
lines.transliteration: saakat si-o kar ultee ray.

lines.english: False is the love of the false one; break the ties, O my mind, and your ties shall be broken. Break your ties with the faithless cynic. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) jhooth ai kee ray jh ooth pareet  chhutkee ray man chh utkee ray saakat  sang na chhutkee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who enters a house filled with soot is blackened.
lines.transliteration: ji-o kaajar bhar mand ar raakh i-o jo paisai kaalookh ee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
lines.english: Dhoorahu hee t ay bh aag ga-i-o hai jis gur mil chh utkee t arikutee ray. ||1|| Run far away from such people! One who meets the Guru escapes from the bondageof the three dispositions. ||1||
I beg this blessing of You, O Merciful Lord, ocean of mercy - please, don't bring me face to face with the faithless cyincs. pMnw 536
lines.transliteration: maaga-o daan kirpaal kirpaa niDh  mayraa mukh  saakat  sang na jutsee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖੁ ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਜੁਟਸੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: ||2||4||37|| Make servant Nanak the slave of Your slave; let his head roll in the dust under thefeet of the Holy. ||2||4||37|| rwgu dyvgMDwrI mhlw 5 Gru 7  (536-3) raag dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 7 Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (536-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak daas d aas ko karee-ahu mayraa moond saaDh  pagaa hayth  rulsee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਸਾਧ ਪਗਾ  ਹੇਿਠ ਰੁਲਸੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੭॥
lines.english: You are all-powerful, at all times; You show me the Way; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: sabh d in kay samrath panth bith ulay ha-o bal bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Your Saints sing to You with love; I fall at their feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gaavan bhaavan sant an torai charan uvaa kai paa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਦਨ  ਕੇ ਸਮਰਥ  ਪੰਥ ਿਬਠੁਲੇ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Praiseworthy Lord, Enjoyer of celestial peace, Embodiment of mercy, One InfiniteLord, Your place is so beautiful. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaasan baasan sahj kayl karunaa mai ayk anant  anoopai th aa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਨ  ਭਾਵਨ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਤੋਰੈ ਚਰਨ  ਉਵਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Riches, supernatural spiritual powers and wealth are in the palm of Your hand. OLord, Life of the World, Master of all, infinite is Your Name.
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  niDh kar tal jagjeevan sarab naath anaykai naa-o.

lines.english: Show Kindness, Mercy and Compassion to Nanak; hearing Your Praises, I live.||2||1||38||6||44|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (536-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu dyvgMDwrI mhlw 9 ] (536-8) raag dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 9. Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa ma-i-aa kirpaa naanak ka-o sun sun jas jeevaa-o. ||2||1||38||6||44||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਸਨ  ਬਾਸਨ  ਸਹਜ  ਕੇਲ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਅਨੰਤ  ਅਨੂਪੈ ਠਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This mind does not follow my advice one tiny bit.
lines.transliteration: yeh man naik na kahi-o karai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਿਨਿਧ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਨਾਥ ਅਨੇਕੈ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am so tired of giving it instructions - it will not refrain from its evil-mindedness.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: seekh sikh aa-ay rahi-o apnee see d urmat  tay na tarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਸੁਿਨ ਸੁਿਨ ਜਸੁ ਜੀਵਾਉ  ॥੨॥੧॥੩੮॥੬॥੪੪॥
lines.english: It has gone insane with the intoxication of Maya; it does not chant the Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: mad maa-i-aa kai bh a-i-o baavro har jas neh uchrai.

lines.english: Practicing deception, it tries to cheat th e world, and so it fills its belly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar parpanch jagat ka-o dahkai apno ud ar bharai. ||1||

lines.english: Like a dog's tail, it cannot be straightened; it will not listen to what I tell it.
lines.transliteration: su-aan poochh ji-o ho-ay na sooDh o kahi-o na kaan Dh arai.

lines.punjabi: ਯਹ ਮਨੁ ਨੈਕ ਨ ਕਿਹਓ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, vibrate forever the Name of the Lord, and all your affairs shall be adjusted. ||2||1|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 9 ] (536-11) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 9. Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhaj raam naam nit  jaa tay kaaj sarai. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਖ ਿਸਖਾਇ ਰਿਹਓ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਸੀ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਤੇ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All things are mere diversions of life:
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  jeevat  ko bivhaar.
maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banDh ap ar fun garih kee naar. ||1|| rahaa-o. mother, father, siblings, children, relatives and the wife of your home. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਦ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਭਇਓ  ਬਾਵਰੋ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਹ ਉਚਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: When the soul is separated from the body, then they will cry out, calling you a ghost.
lines.transliteration: tan tay paraan hot  jab ni-aaray tayrat  parayt  pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਜਗਤ  ਕਉ ਡਹਕੈ  ਅਪਨੋ  ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one will let you stay, for even half an hour; they drive you out of the house. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aaDh gh aree ko-oo neh raakh ai ghar tay dayt nikaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਆਨ  ਪੂਛ ਿਜਉ  ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਧੋ ਕਿਹਓ  ਨ ਕਾਨ  ਧਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The created world is like an illusion, a mirage - see this, and reflect upon it in your mind.
lines.transliteration: marig tarisnaa ji-o jag rachnaa yeh d aykhhu rid ai bichaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਨਤ  ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਜੁ  ਸਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, vibrate forever the Name of the Lord, which shall deliver you. ||2||2|| dyvgMDwrI mhlw 9 ] (536-15) dayvganDh aaree mehlaa 9. Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhaj raam naam nit  jaa tay hot  uDhaar. ||2||2||

lines.english: In this world, I have seen love to be false.
lines.transliteration: jagat mai jh oothee daykhee pareet .

lines.english: Whether they are spouses or friends, all are concerned only with their own happiness.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: apnay hee sukh si-o sabh  laagay ki-aa d aaraa ki-aa meet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਅਰੁ ਫੁਿਨ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All say, "Mine, mine", and attach their consciousness to you with love.
lines.transliteration: mayra-o mayra-o sabhai kahat  hai hit  si-o baaDh i-o cheet .

lines.english: But at the very last moment, none shall go along with you. How strange are the waysof the world! ||1||
lines.transliteration: ant kaal sangee nah ko-oo ih achraj hai reet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਹੋਤ ਜਬ ਿਨਆਰੇ  ਟੇਰਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਿਤ ਪੁਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The foolish mind has not yet reformed itself, although I have grown weary ofcontinually instructing it.
lines.transliteration: man moorakh ajhoo nah samjh at sikh dai haari-o neet .

lines.punjabi: ਆਧ  ਘਰੀ  ਕੋਊ ਨਿਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਦੇਤ ਿਨਕਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, singing the Songs of God.||2||3||6||38||47|| pMnw 537 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (537-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu ibhwgVw caupdy mhlw 5 Gru 2 ] (537-3) raag bihaagarhaa cha-upd ay mehlaa 5 gh ar 2. Raag Bihaagraa, Chau-Padas, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: naanak bha-ojal paar parai ja-o gaavai parabh  kay geet . ||2||3||6||38||47||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: To associate with your arch enemies,
lines.transliteration: dootan sangree-aa.
bhu-i-angan basree-aa. is to live with poisonous snakes;

lines.english: I have made the effort to shake them off. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik upree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Then, I repeated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: ta-o mai har har karee-aa.
ta-o sukh  sehjaree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. and I obtained celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: False is the love of the many emotional attachments,
lines.transliteration: mithan mohree-aa. an ka-o mayree-aa.
vich ghooman gh iree-aa. ||2|| which suck the mortal into the whirlpool of reincarnation. ||2||

lines.english: All are travellers,
lines.transliteration: sagal batree-aa.
birakh ik t aree-aa. who have gathered under the world-tree,
baho banDheh paree-aa. ||3|| and are bound by their many bonds. ||3||

lines.english: Eternal is the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: thir saaDh safree-aa.
jah keertan haree-aa. where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

lines.english: Nanak seeks this Sanctuary. ||4||1|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (537-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu ibhwgVw mhlw 9 ] (537-8) raag bihaagarhaa mehlaa 9. Raag Bihaagraa, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sarnaree-aa. ||4||1||

lines.english: No one knows the state of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kee gat neh ko-oo jaanai.

lines.english: The Yogis, the celibates, the penitents, and all sorts of clever people have failed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee t apee pach haaray ar baho log si-aanay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In an instant, He changes the beggar into a king, and the king into a beggar.
lines.transliteration: chhin meh raa-o rank ka-o kar-ee raa-o rank kar daaray.

lines.english: He fills what is empty, and empties what is full - such are His ways. ||1||
lines.transliteration: reetay bh aray bh aray sakh naavai yeh t aa ko bivhaaray. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself spread out the expanse of His Maya, and He Himself beholds it.
lines.transliteration: apnee maa-i-aa aap pasaaree aapeh daykh anhaaraa.

lines.english: He assumes so many forms, and plays so many games, and yet, He remains detachedfrom it all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop Dharay baho rangee sabh  tay rahai ni-aaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਿਹ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: Incalculable, infinite, incomprehensible and immaculate is He, who has misled theentire world.
lines.transliteration: agnat apaar alakh  niranjan jih sabh  jag bh armaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜਤੀ  ਤਪੀ ਪਿਚ ਹਾਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਿਸਆਨੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Cast off all your doubts; prays Nanak, O mortal, focus your consciousness on His Feet.||3||1||2|| rwgu ibhwgVw CMq mhlw 4 Gru 1  (537-13) raag bihaagarhaa chh ant mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 Raag Bihaagraa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (537-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sagal bharam t aj naanak paraan ee charan t aahi chit  laa-i-o. ||3||1||2||

lines.english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; as Gurmukh, meditate on the invaluable Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai mayree jind urhee-ay gurmukh  naam amolay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਛਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਈ  ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਿਰ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. The Lord is dear to my mind. With the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, my mind is washedclean. pMnw 538
lines.transliteration: har ras beeDhaa har man pi-aaraa man har ras naam jh akolay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਨਾਿਮ  ਝਕੋਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instructions, hold your mind steady; O my soul, do not let it wander anywhere.
lines.transliteration: gurmat man th ehraa-ee-ai mayree jind urhee-ay anat  na kaahoo dolay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੀ  ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਅਨਤ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One who utters the Bani of the Praises of the Lord God, O Nanak, obtains the fruits ofhis heart's desires. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man chindi-arh aa fal paa-i-aa har parabh  gun naanak ban ee bolay raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਅੜਾ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਬੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, the Ambrosial Name abides within the mind, O my soul; withyour mouth, utter the words of ambrosia.
lines.transliteration: gurmat man amrit  vuth-rhaa mayree jind urhee-ay mukh  amrit  bain alaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਵੁਠੜਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਮੁਿਖ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬੈਣ ਅਲਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Words of the devotees are Ambrosial Nectar, O my soul; hearing them in themind, embrace loving affection for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee bh agat janaa kee mayree jind urhee-ay man sun ee-ai har liv laa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਮਿਨ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Separated for so very long, I have found the Lord God; He holds me close in Hisloving embrace.
lines.transliteration: chiree vichhunnaa har parabh  paa-i-aa gal mili-aa sahj subh aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਰੀ  ਿਵਛੁੰਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗਿਲ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||2|| Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, O my soul; the unstruck sound-current of theShabad vibrates within. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak man anad bh a-i-aa hai mayree jind urhee-ay anhat  sabad  vajaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਅਨਹਤ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If only my friends and companions would come and unite me with my Lord God, O mysoul.
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahaylee mayree-aa mayree jind urhee-ay ko-ee har parabh  aan milaavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਮੇਰੀਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਕੋਈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I offer my mind to the one who recites the sermon of my Lord God, O my soul.
lines.transliteration: ha-o man dayva-o t is aapn aa mayree jind urhee-ay har parabh  kee har kathaa sunaavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ  ਿਤਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, ever worship the Lord in adoration, O my soul, and you shall obtain thefruits of your heart's desires.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa araaDh  har mayree jind urhee-ay man chind i-arhaa fal paavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਅਰਾਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਅੜਾ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||3|| O Nanak, hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary; O my soul, those who meditate on the Lord'sName are very fortunate. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaj har sarn aagat ee mayree jind urhee-ay vadbh aagee naam Dh i-aavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਜੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: By His Mercy, God comes to meet us, O my soul; through the Guru's Teachings, Hereveals His Name.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aa-ay mil mayree jind urhee-ay gurmat  naam pargaasay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, I am so sad, O my soul - as sad as the lotus without water.
lines.transliteration: ha-o har baajh udeen ee-aa mayree jind urhee-ay ji-o jal bin kamal ud aasay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਮਲ ਉਦਾਸੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has united me, O my soul, with the Lord, my best friend, the LordGod.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai maylaa-i-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay har sajan  har parabh  paasay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo har d asi-aa mayree jind urhee-ay jan naanak naam bigaasay raam. ||4||1|| Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has shown me the Lord, O my soul; servant Nanakblossoms forth in the Name of the Lord. ||4||1|| rwgu ibhwgVw mhlw 4 ] (538-11) raag bihaagarhaa mehlaa 4. Raag Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਦਿਸਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਬਗਾਸੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar, O my soul; through the Guru'sTeachings, this Nectar is obtained.
lines.transliteration: amrit har har naam hai mayree jind urhee-ay amrit  gurmat  paa-ay raam.

lines.english: Pride in Maya is poison, O my soul; through the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name, thispoison is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa bikh hai mayree jind urhee-ay har amrit  bikh leh jaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The dry mind is rejuvenated, O my soul, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: man sukaa hari-aa ho-i-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay har har naam Dh i-aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਿਬਖੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||1|| The Lord has given me the pre-ordained blessing of high destiny, O my soul; servantNanak merges in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har bhaag vaday likh  paa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay jan naanak naam samaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My mind is attached to the Lord, O my soul, like the infant, sucking his mother's milk.
lines.transliteration: har saytee man bayDh i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay ji-o baalak lag d uDh kheeray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, I find no peace, O my soul; I am like the song-bird, crying out without the rain drops.
lines.transliteration: har bin saaNt na paa-ee-ai mayree jind urhee-ay ji-o chaat rik jal bin tayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਲਕ  ਲਿਗ  ਦੁਧ ਖੀਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my soul; He shall tell you of the Glorious Virtues of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: satgur sarn ee jaa-ay pa-o mayree jind urhee-ay gun  dasay har parabh  kayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਿਜਉ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕੁ  ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਟੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||2|| Servant Nanak has merged into the Lord, O my soul; the many melodies of theShabad resound within his heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har maylaa-i-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay gh ar vaajay sabad  ghanayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਪਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਣ ਦਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through egotism, the self-willed manmukhs are separated, O my soul; bound topoison, they are burnt by egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ha-umai vichh urhay mayree jind urhee-ay bikh  baaDh ay ha-umai jaalay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ  ਘਣੇਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Like the pigeon, which itself falls into the trap, O my soul, all the self-willedmanmukhs fall under the influence of death.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) ji-o pankhee kapot  aap banHaa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay t i-o manmukh  sabh  vas kaalay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਹਉਮੈ ਿਵਛੁੜੇ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਬਖੁ ਬਾਧੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those self-willed manmukhs who focus their consciousness on Maya, O my soul, arefoolish, evil demons. pMnw 539
lines.transliteration: jo mohi maa-i-aa chit laa-id ay mayree jind urhee-ay say manmukh  moorh  bitaalay raam.

lines.english: ||3|| The Lord's humble servants beseech and implore Him, and enter His Sanctuary, O mysoul; Guru Nanak becomes their Divine Protector. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan taraahi t araahi sarn aagat ee mayree jind urhee-ay gur naanak har rakh vaalay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servants are saved, through the Love of the Lord, O my soul; by their pre-ordained good destiny, they obtain the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jan har liv ubray mayree jindurh ee-ay Dh ur bhaag vaday har paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਧੁਿਰ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
