lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the ship, O my soul, and the Guru is thehelmsman. Through the Word of the Shabad, He ferries us across.
lines.transliteration: har har naam pot hai mayree jind urhee-ay gur kh ayvat sabad  taraa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਰ ਖੇਵਟ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is all-powerful and very kind, O my soul; through the Guru, theTrue Guru, He seems so sweet.
lines.transliteration: har har purakh d a-i-aal hai mayree jind urhee-ay gur sat gur meeth  lagaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, and hear my prayer, O Lord, Har, Har; please, let servant Nanak meditate on Your Name. ||4||2|| ibhwgVw mhlw 4 ] (539-5) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 4. Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa sun baynt ee har har jan naanak naam Dh i-aa-i-aa raam. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸੁਿਣ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: In this world, the best occupation is to sing the Praises of the Naam, O my soul.Singing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord is enshrined in the mind.
lines.transliteration: jag sukarit keerat  naam hai mayree jind urhee-ay har keerat  har man Dh aaray raam.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is immaculate and pure, O my soul. Chanting theName of the Lord, Har, Har, one is saved.
lines.transliteration: har har naam pavit hai mayree jind urhee-ay jap har har naam uDh aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਗ  ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤੁ  ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: All sins and errors are erased, O my soul; with the Naam, the Gurmukh washes offthis filth.
lines.transliteration: sabh kilvikh  paap d ukh kati-aa mayree jind urhee-ay mal gurmukh  naam ut aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, servant Nanak meditates on the Lord; even fools and idiots like me have been saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vad punnee har Dhi-aa-i-aa jan naanak ham moorakh  mugaDh  nistaaray raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਪਾਪ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਟਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਤਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, O my soul, overpower the five passions.
lines.transliteration: jo har naam Dhi-aa-id ay mayree jind urhee-ay t inaa panchay vasgat  aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The nine treasures of the Naam are within, O my soul; the Great Guru has made mesee the unseen Lord.
lines.transliteration: antar nav niDh  naam hai mayree jind urhee-ay gur sat gur alakh  lakhaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਪੰਚੇ ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has fulfilled my hopes and desires, O my soul; meeting the Lord, all myhunger is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: gur aasaa mansaa pooree-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay har mili-aa bh ukh sabh  jaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: 4) Dhur mast ak har parabh  likhi-aa mayree jind urhee-ay jan naanak har gun  gaa-ay raam. ||2|| O servant Nanak, he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O my soul, uponwhose forehead God has inscribed such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am a deceitful sinner, O my soul, a cheat, and a robber of others' wealth.
lines.transliteration: ham paapee balvanchee-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay pard arohee th ag maa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: But, by great good fortune, I have found the Guru, O my soul; through the PerfectGuru, I have found the way to salvation.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur paa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay gur poorai gat  mit paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਬਲਵੰਚੀਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਪਰਦਰ੍ੋਹੀ  ਠਗ ਮਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: 4) gur amrit har mukh  cho-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay fir mard aa bahurh  jeevaa-i-aa raam. The Guru has poured the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name into my mouth, O my soul, and now, my dead soul has come to life again.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||3|| O servant Nanak: those who meet the True Guru, O my soul, have all of their painstaken away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak satgur jo milay mayree jind urhee-ay t in kay sabh  dukh gavaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਚੋਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਫਿਰ ਮਰਦਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is sublime, O my soul; chanting it, one's sins are washed away.
lines.transliteration: at oot am har naam hai mayree jind urhee-ay jit  japi-ai paap gavaat ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਜੋ ਿਮਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru, the Lord, has purified even the sinners, O my soul; now, they are famousand respected in the four directions and throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: patit pavit ar gur har kee-ay mayree jind urhee-ay chahu kundee chahu jug jaat ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਜਿਪਐ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਤੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The filth of egotism is totally wiped away, O my soul, by bathing in the Ambrosial Poolof the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mail sabh ut ree mayree jind urhee-ay har amrit  har sar naat ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਿਗ  ਜਾਤੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||4||3|| Even sinners are carried across, O my soul, if they are imbued with the Lord's Name,even for an instant, O servant Nanak. ||4||3|| ibhwgVw mhlw 4 ] (539-17) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 4. Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apraaDhee paapee uDh ray mayree jind urhee-ay jan naanak kh in har raat ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਤੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, O my soul, to those who take the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tinH ka-o mayree jind urhee-ay jinH har har naam aDh aaro raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਉਧਰੇ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਖਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, implanted the Name within me, O my soul, and He hascarried me across the terrifying world-ocean of poison.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur naam drirh -aa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay bikh  bha-ojal t aaran haaro raam.

lines.english: Those who have meditated one-pointedly on the Lord, O my soul - I proclaim the Victory of those saintly beings. pMnw 540
lines.transliteration: jin ik man har Dhi-aa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay t in sant  janaa jaikaaro raam.

lines.english: ||1|| Nanak has found peace, meditating on the Lord, O my soul; the Lord is the Destroyerof all pain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak har jap sukh paa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay sabh  dookh nivaaran haaro raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸਿਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed is that tongue, O my soul, which sings the Glorious Praises of theLord God.
lines.transliteration: saa rasnaa Dhan Dh an hai mayree jind urhee-ay gun  gaavai har parabh  kayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Sublime and splendid are those ears, O my soul, which listen to the Kirtan of theLord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: tay sarvan bh alay sobh neek heh mayree jind urhee-ay har keert an sun eh har t ayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਭਲੇ ਸੋਭਨੀਕ  ਹਿਹ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Sublime, pure and pious is that head, O my soul, which falls at the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: so sees bhalaa pavit ar paavan hai mayree jind urhee-ay jo jaa-ay lagai gur pairay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੀਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਜਾਇ  ਲਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||2|| Nanak is a sacrifice to that Guru, O my soul; the Guru has placed the Name of theLord, Har, Har, in my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur vitahu naanak vaari-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay jin har har naam chit ayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਚਤੇਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Blessed and approved are those eyes, O my soul, which gaze upon the Holy TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: tay nayt ar bhalay parvaan  heh mayree jind urhee-ay jo saaDh oo sat gur daykheh raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਭਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹਿਹ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Sacred and sanctified are those hands, O my soul, which write the Praises of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: tay hasat  puneet  pavit ar heh mayree jind urhee-ay jo har jas har har laykh eh raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਹਸਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਹਿਹ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲੇਖਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I worship continually the feet of that humble being, O my soul, who walks on the Pathof Dharma - the path of righteousness.
lines.transliteration: tis jan kay pag nit  poojee-ah mayree jind urhee-ay jo maarag Dh aram chalayseh raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਿਨਤ ਪੂਜੀਅਿਹ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਧਰਮ  ਚਲੇਸਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||3|| Nanak is a sacrifice to those, O my soul, who hear of the Lord, and believe in theLord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin vitahu vaari-aa mayree jind urhee-ay har sun  har naam manayseh raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨੇਸਿਹ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dharat  paataal aakaas hai mayree jind urhee-ay sabh  har har naam Dh i-aavai raam. The earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the Akaashic ethers, O my soul,all meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਤ  ਪਾਤਾਲੁ  ਆਕਾਸੁ  ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸਭ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Wind, water and fire, O my soul, continually sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant aro mayree jind urhee-ay nit  har har har jas gaavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਨਤ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The woods, the meadows and the whole world, O my soul, chant with their mouths the Lord's Name, and meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: van tarin sabh  aakaar hai mayree jind urhee-ay mukh  har har naam Dh i-aavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਵਣੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਣੁ  ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who, as Gurmukh, focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotionalworship - O my soul, he is robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4|| ibhwgVw mhlw 4 ] (540-11) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 4. Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) naanak tay har d ar painHaa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay jo gurmukh  bhagat man laavai raam. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਗਿਤ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: jin har har naam na chayti-o mayree jind urhee-ay t ay manmukh  moorh  i-aan ay raam.

lines.english: Those who attach their consciousness to emotional attachment and Maya, O my soul,depart regretfully in the end.
lines.transliteration: jo mohi maa-i-aa chit laa-id ay mayree jind urhee-ay say ant  ga-ay pachh utaanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂੜ ਇਆਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord, O my soul; those self-willedmanmukhs are deluded by sin.
lines.transliteration: har dargeh dh o-ee naa lahniH mayree jind urhee-ay jo manmukh  paap lubh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮੋਿਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਦੇ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||1|| O servant Nanak, those who meet the Guru are saved, O my soul; chanting the Nameof the Lord, they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur mil ubray mayree jindurh ee-ay har jap har naam samaan ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਿਨ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਪਾਿਪ  ਲੁਭਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Go, everyone, and meet the True Guru; O my soul, He implants the Name of the Lord,Har, har, within the heart.
lines.transliteration: sabh jaa-ay milhu sat guroo ka-o mayree jind urhee-ay jo har har naam d arirh-aavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Do not hesitate for an instant - meditate on the Lord, O my soul; who knows whetherhe shall draw another breath?
lines.transliteration: ibhwgVw, mÚ 4) har japdi-aa kh in dhil na keej-ee mayree jind urhee-ay mat  ke jaapai saahu aavai ke na aavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: That time, that moment, that instant, that second is so fruitful, O my soul, when my Lord comes into my mind.
lines.transliteration: ibhwgVw, mÚ 4) saa vaylaa so moorat saa gh arhee so muhat  safal hai mayree jind urhee-ay jit  har mayraa chit aavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਪਿਦਆ  ਿਖਨੁ ਿਢਲ  ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਮਤੁ ਿਕ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਵੈ  ਿਕ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||2|| Servant Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my soul, andnow, the Messenger of Death does not draw near him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay jamkankar nayrh  na aavai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ  ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਾ ਘੜੀ  ਸੋ ਮੁਹਤੁ  ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord continually watches, and hears everything, O my soul; he alone is afraid,who commits sins.
lines.transliteration: har vaykhai sun ai nit sabh  kichh  mayree jind urhee-ay so darai jin paap kamt ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One whose heart is pure within, O my soul, casts off all his fears.
lines.transliteration: jis antar hird aa suDh  hai mayree jind urhee-ay t in jan sabh  dar sut gh atay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਿਨਤ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸੋ ਡਰੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਾਪ ਕਮਤੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One who has faith in the Fearless Name of the Lord, O my soul - all his enemies andattackers speak against him in vain. pMnw 541
lines.transliteration: har nirbha-o naam pat eeji-aa mayree jind urhee-ay sabh  jhakh maaran d usat kupt ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਪਤੀਿਜਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸਿਭ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਨੁ ਦੁਸਟ  ਕੁਪਤੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||3|| Nanak has served the Perfect Guru, O my soul, who causes all to fall at His feet. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa naanak sayvi-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay jin pairee aan  sabh  ghatay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਸੇਿਵਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੈਰੀ ਆਿਣ  ਸਿਭ ਘਤੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Serve such a Lord continuously, O my soul, who is the Great Lord and Master of all.
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har nit sayvee-ai mayree jind urhee-ay jo sabh  doo saahib vadaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਤ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਵਡਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: 4) jinHee ik man ik araaDhi-aa mayree jind urhee-ay t inaa naahee kisai d ee kichh  chadaa raam. Those who single-mindedly worship Him in adoration, O my soul, are not subservientto anyone.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਿਕਛੁ ਚਡਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, I have obtained the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, O my soul; allthe slanderers and trouble-makers bark in vain.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvi-ai har mahal paa-i-aa mayree jindurh ee-ay jh akh maaran sabh  nindak ghandaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਹਿਰ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਝਖ ਮਾਰਨੁ ਸਿਭ ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਘੰਡਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has meditated on the Name, O my soul; such is the pre-ordaineddestiny which the Lord written on his forehead. ||4||5|| ibhwgVw mhlw 4 ] (541-5) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 4. Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay Dh ur mast ak har likh  chhadaa raam. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਛਡਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: All beings are Yours - You permeate them all. O my Lord God, You know what they doin their hearts.
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-a t ayray t ooN varatd aa mayray har parabh  tooN jaaneh jo jee-ay kamaa-ee-ai raam.

lines.english: The Lord is with them, inwardly and outwardly, O my soul; He sees everything, but the mortal denies the Lord in his mind.
lines.transliteration: har antar baahar naal hai mayree jind urhee-ay sabh  vaykh ai man mukraa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਜੋ ਜੀਇ  ਕਮਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is far away from the self-willed manmukhs, O my soul; all their efforts are invain.
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa no har d oor hai mayree jind urhee-ay sabh  birthee gh aal gavaa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਨਾਿਲ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸਭ ਵੇਖੈ ਮਿਨ ਮੁਕਰਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: 4) jan naanak gurmukh Dh i-aa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay har haajar nad ree aa-ee-ai raam. ||1|| Servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, meditates on the Lord, O my soul; he beholds the Lordever-present. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਦੂਿਰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸਭ ਿਬਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They are devotees, and they are servants, O my soul, who are pleasing to the Mind ofmy God.
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  say sayvak mayree jind urhee-ay jo parabh  mayray man bh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord, O my soul; night and day, theyremain absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say har dargeh painaa-i-aa mayree jind urhee-ay ahinis saach samaan ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In their company, the filth of one's sins is washed away, O my soul; imbued with theLord's Love, one comes to bear the Mark of His Grace.
lines.transliteration: tin kai sang mal ut rai mayree jind urhee-ay rang raat ay nad ar neesaan ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||2|| Nanak offers his prayer to God, O my soul; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy, he is satisfied. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh baynt ee mayree jind urhee-ay mil saaDh oo sang agh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਦਿਰ ਨੀਸਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O tongue, chant the Name of God; O my soul, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your desires shall be extinguished.
lines.transliteration: hay rasnaa jap gobindo mayree jind urhee-ay jap har har t arisnaa jaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਅਘਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He, unto whom my Supreme Lord God shows Mercy, O my soul, enshrines the Namein his mind.
lines.transliteration: jis da-i-aa karay mayraa paarbarahm mayree jind urhee-ay t is man naam vasaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਿਪ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੋ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One who meets the Perfect True Guru, O my soul, obtains the treasure of the Lord'swealth.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaytay pooraa sat guroo mayree jind urhee-ay so har Dh an niDh  paa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, one joins the Company of the Holy, O my soul. O Nanak, singthe Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee sangat  milai mayree jind urhee-ay naanak har gun  gaa-ay raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In the places and interspaces, O my soul, the Supreme Lord God, the Great Giver, ispervading.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahi-aa mayree jind urhee-ay paarbarahm parabh  daataa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: His limits cannot be found, O my soul; He is the Perfect Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: taa kaa ant  na paa-ee-ai mayree jind urhee-ay pooran purakh  biDhaataa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He cherishes all beings, O my soul, as the mother and father cherish their child.
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa partipaald aa mayree jind urhee-ay ji-o baalak pit  maat aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖੁ ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: ||4||6|| By thousands of clever tricks, He cannot be obtained, O my soul; servant Nanak, asGurmukh, has come to know the Lord. ||4||6|| Ckw 1 ] (541-17) chhakaa 1. First Set of Six|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 CMq Gru 1  (541-18) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5 chh ant ghar 1 Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (541-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sahas si-aanap nah milai mayree jind urhee-ay jan naanak gurmukh  jaataa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਦਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਲਕ  ਿਪਤ ਮਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have seen one miracle of the Lord, O my Dear Beloved - whatever He does isrighteous and just.
lines.transliteration: har kaa ayk achambha-o d aykhi-aa mayray laal jee-o jo karay so Dh aram ni-aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਿਸਆਣਪ ਨਹ ਿਮਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਦੁੜੀਏ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: The Lord has fashioned this beautiful arena, O my Dear Beloved, where all come and go. pMnw 542
lines.transliteration: har rang akhaarh aa paa-i-on mayray laal jee-o aavan  jaan sabaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਸਬਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The One who fashioned the world causes them to come and go.
lines.transliteration: aavan t a jaan aa tineh kee-aa jin mayd an sirjee-aa.

lines.english: Some meet the True Guru - the Lord invites them into the Mansion of His Presence; others wander around, deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: iknaa mayl satgur mahal bulaa-ay ik bh aram bh oolay fird i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਮੇਿਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਏ  ਇਿਕ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੂਲੇ ਿਫਰਿਦਆ  ॥
lines.english: You alone know Your limits; You are contained in all.
lines.transliteration: ant tayraa t ooNhai jaan eh tooN sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the Truth: listen, Saints - the Lord dispenses even-handed justice. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak sunhu sant ahu har vart ai Dharam ni-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਵਰਤੈ  ਧਰਮ  ਿਨਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Come and join me, O my beautiful dear beloveds; let's worship the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aavhu milhu sahayleeho mayray laal jee-o har har naam araaDhay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੁ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Let's serve the Perfect True Guru, O my dear beloveds, and clear away the Path ofDeath.
lines.transliteration: kar sayvhu pooraa satguroo mayray laal jee-o jam kaa maarag saaDh ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Having cleared the treacherous path, as Gurmukhs, we shall obtain honor in the Courtof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maarag bikh-rh aa saaDh  gurmukh  har d argeh sobh aa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਿਬਖੜਾ  ਸਾਿਧ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, lovingly focus their consciousness on theLord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o biDhaat ai Dharahu likh i-aa tinHaa rain  din liv laa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Self-conceit, egotism and emotional attachment are eradicated when one joins theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa moh chh utaa jaa sang mili-aa saaDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਮੋਹੁ ਛੁਟਾ ਜਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਾਧੇ ॥
lines.english: Says servant Nanak, one who contemplates the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, isliberated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan kahai naanak mukat ho-aa har har naam araaDh ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let's join hands, O Saints; let's come together, O my dear beloveds, and worship the imperishable, Almighty Lord.
lines.transliteration: kar jorhihu sant  ikatar ho-ay mayray laal jee-o abh inaasee purakh  poojayhaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤਰ੍  ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਜੇਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I sought Him through uncounted forms of adoration, O my dear beloveds; now, I dedicate my entire mind and body to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: baho biDh poojaa kh ojee-aa mayray laal jee-o ih man t an sabh  arpayhaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਪੂਜਾ ਖੋਜੀਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪੇਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The mind, body and all wealth belong to God; so what can anyone offer to Him inworship?
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an sabh  parabh oo kayraa ki-aa ko pooj charh aava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕੇਰਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: He alone merges in the lap of God, unto whom the Merciful Lord Master becomescompassionate.
lines.transliteration: jis ho-ay kirpaal da-i-aal su-aamee so parabh  ank samaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny written on his forehead, comes to bear lovefor the Guru.
lines.transliteration: bhaag mast ak ho-ay jis kai t is gur naal sanayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਗੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹੋਇ ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਸਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says servant Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, let's worshipthe Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan kahai naanak mil saaDhsangat  har har naam poojayhaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਜੇਹਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I wandered around, searching in the ten directions, O my dear beloveds, but I cameto find the Lord in the home of my own being.
lines.transliteration: dah d is khojat ham firay mayray laal jee-o har paa-i-arh aa gh ar aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਖੋਜਤ  ਹਮ ਿਫਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: 5) har mandar har jee-o saaji-aa mayray laal jee-o har t is meh rahi-aa samaa-ay raam. The Dear Lord has fashioned the body as the temple of the Lord, O my dear beloveds; the Lord continues to dwell there.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master Himself is pervading everywhere; through the Guru, He isrevealed.
lines.transliteration: sarbay samaanaa aap su-aamee gurmukh  pargat ho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Darkness is dispelled, and pains are removed, when the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
lines.transliteration: miti-aa aDhayraa d ookh naath aa ami-o har ras cho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਅਧੇਰਾ  ਦੂਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, the Lord and Master is there. The Supreme Lord God is everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jahaa daykh aa tahaa su-aamee paarbarahm sabh  thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸਭ ਠਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Says servant Nanak, meeting the True Guru, I have found the Lord, within the homeof my own being. ||4||1|| rwgu ibhwgVw mhlw 5 ] (542-15) raag bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5. Raag Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan kahai naanak satgur milaa-i-aa har paa-i-arh aa gh ar aa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: He is dear to me; He fascinates my mind; He is the ornament of my heart, the supportof the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: at pareet am man mohnaa gh at sohnaa paraan aDh aaraa raam.

lines.english: The Glory of the Beloved, Merciful Lord of th e Universe is beautiful; He is infinite and without limit.
lines.transliteration: sundar sobh aa laal gopaal d a-i-aal kee apar apaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨਾ  ਘਟ ਸੋਹਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Compassionate Sustainer of the World, Beloved Lord of the Universe, please, joinwith Your humble soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: gopaal da-i-aal gobind  laalan milhu kant  nimaan ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਸੋਭਾ ਲਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਕੀ ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My eyes long for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; the night passes, but I cannotsleep.
lines.transliteration: nain tarsan d aras parsan nah need  rain vihaan ee-aa.

lines.english: I have applied the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my food. These are all my decorations.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan naam binjan bha-ay sagal seegaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨ ਤਰਸਨ  ਦਰਸ  ਪਰਸਨ  ਨਹ ਨੀਦ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, let's meditate on the Saint, that he may unite us with our Husband Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai sant jampai mayl kant  hamaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: I endure thousands of reprimands, and still, my Lord has not met with me.
lines.transliteration: laakh ulaahanay mohi har jab lag nah milai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਸੰਤ ਜੰਪੈ ਮੇਿਲ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I make the effort to meet with my Lord, but none of my efforts work.
lines.transliteration: milan ka-o kara-o upaav kichh hamaaraa nah chalai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਖ  ਉਲਾਹਨੇ  ਮੋਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹ ਿਮਲੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Unsteady is my consciousness, and unstable is my wealth; without my Lord, I cannot be consoled. pMnw 543
lines.transliteration: chal chit bit  anit pari-a bin kavan biDh ee na Dh eejee-ai.

lines.english: Food, drink and decorations are useless; without my Husband Lord, how can I survive?
lines.transliteration: khaan paan seegaar birthay har kant  bin ki-o jeejee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਿਬਰਥੇ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਤ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਉ  ਜੀਜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I yearn for Him, and desire Him night and day. I cannot live without Him, even for aninstant.
lines.transliteration: aasaa pi-aasee rain dinee-ar reh na sakee-ai ik t ilai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਿਪਆਸੀ  ਰੈਿਨ ਿਦਨੀਅਰੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, O Saint, I am Your slave; by Your Grace, I meet my Husband Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai sant d aasee t a-o parsaad  mayraa pir milai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਸੰਤ ਦਾਸੀ  ਤਉ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I share a bed with my Beloved, but I do not behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: sayj ayk pari-o sang daras na paa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਸੰਿਗ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I have endless demerits - how can my Lord call me to the Mansion of His Presence?
lines.transliteration: avgan mohi anayk kat mahal bulaa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਅਨੇਕ  ਕਤ ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The worthless, dishonored and orphaned soul-bride prays, "Meet with me, O God, treasure of mercy."
lines.transliteration: nirgun nimaanee anaath binvai milhu parabh  kirpaa niDh ay.

lines.english: The wall of doubt has been shattered, and now I sleep in peace, beholding God, theLord of the nine treasures, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh eet kho-ee-ai sahj so-ee-ai parabh  palak paykh at nav niDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੀਿਤ  ਖੋਈਐ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੋਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਲਕ  ਪੇਖਤ ਨਵ ਿਨਧੇ ॥
lines.english: If only I could come into the Mansion of my Beloved Lord's Presence! Joining withHim, I sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: garihi laal aavai mahal paavai mil sang mangal gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਆਵੈ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਵੈ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints; please, reveal to me the BlessedVision of Your Darshan. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai sant sarn ee mohi d aras d ikhaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਦਖਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: santan kai parsaad  har har paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind is at peace; the fire within has been quenched.
lines.transliteration: ichh punnee man saaNt tapat bujhaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਤਪਿਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is that day, and beauteous is that night, and countless are the joys,celebrations and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: saflaa so dinas rain ay suhaavee anad  mangal ras gh anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲਾ  ਸੁ ਿਦਨਸ  ਰੈਣੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Sustainer of the World, has been revealed. With what tongue can I speak of His Glory?
lines.transliteration: pargatay gupaal gobind laalan kavan rasnaa gun  bhanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਲਾਲਨ ਕਵਨ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Doubt, greed, emotional attachment and corruption are taken away; joining with mycompanions, I sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: bharam lobh  moh bikaar thaakay mil sakh ee mangal gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਥਾਕੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Saint, who has led me to merge with the Lord, Har,Har. ||4||2|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 ] (543-9) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5. Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai sant jampai jin har har sanjog milaa-i-aa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਸੰਤ ਜੰਪੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਜੋਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Shower Your Mercy upon me, O Guru, O Perfect Supreme Lord God, that I mightchant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur paarbarahm pooray an-din naam vakh aanaa raam.

lines.english: I speak the Ambrosial Words of the Guru's Bani, praising the Lord. Your Will is sweetto me, Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee uchraa har jas mith aa laagai t ayraa bh aanaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Show kindness and compassion, O Sustainer of the Word, Lord of the Universe;without You, I have no other.
lines.transliteration: kar da-i-aa ma-i-aa gopaal gobind  ko-ay naahee t ujh binaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਉਚਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਿਮਠਾ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Almighty, sublime, infinite, perfect Lord - my soul, body, wealth and mind are Yours.
lines.transliteration: samrath agath apaar pooran jee-o tan Dh an tumH manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am foolish, stupid, masterless, fickle, powerless, lowly and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: moorakh mugaDh  anaath chanchal balheen neech ajaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਮਰਥ  ਅਗਥ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਜੀਉ  ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  tayree rakh  layho aavan  jaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ  ਅਨਾਥ  ਚੰਚਲ  ਬਲਹੀਨ  ਨੀਚ ਅਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, I have found the Dear Lord, and I constantly singthe Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhah sarn ee paa-ee-ai har jee-o gun  gaavah har neet aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੇਰੀ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhoor bh agtan kee man t an laga-o har jee-o sabh  patit puneet aa raam. Applying the dust of the devotees to the mind and body, O Dear Lord, all sinners aresanctified.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਹ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨੀਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The sinners are sanctified in the company of those who have met the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: patitaa puneet aa hohi t inH sang jinH biDhaataa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਿਰ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੀ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਲਗਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਭ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are given the gift of the life of thesoul; their gifts increase day by day.
lines.transliteration: naam raatay jee-a d aatay nit  deh charh eh savaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Wealth, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures cometo those who meditate on the Lord, and conquer their own soul.
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  nav niDh  har jap jinee aat am jeet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਿਨਤ  ਦੇਿਹ ਚੜਿਹ  ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, it is only by great good fortune that the Holy Saints, the Lord'scompanions, are found, O friends. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak vadbh aag paa-ee-ah saaDh  saajan meet aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who deal in Truth, O Dear Lord, are the perfect bankers.
lines.transliteration: jinee sach vananji-aa har jee-o say pooray saahaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ਸਾਧ ਸਾਜਨ  ਮੀਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They possess the great treasure, O Dear Lord, and they reap the profit of the Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: bahut kh ajaanaa t inn peh har jee-o har keert an laahaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਿਜਆ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and greed do not cling to those who are attuned to God.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh na lobh  bi-aapai jo jan parabh  si-o raat i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਿਤੰਨ  ਪਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They know the One, and they believe in the One; they are intoxicated with the Lord'sLove.
lines.transliteration: ayk jaaneh ayk maaneh raam kai rang maati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਨ ਲੋਭੁ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਉ ਰਾਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: They fall at the Feet of the Saints, and seek their Sanctuary; their minds are filled withjoy.
lines.transliteration: lag sant charn ee parh ay sarn ee man t inaa omaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਜਾਨਿਹ  ਏਕੁ ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਮਾਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, those who have the Naam in their laps are the true bankers. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak jin naam palai say-ee sachay saahaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਲਿਗ  ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣੀ  ਪੜੇ ਸਰਣੀ  ਮਿਨ ਿਤਨਾ  ਓਮਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on that Dear Lord, who supports all by His almighty strength. pMnw 544
lines.transliteration: naanak so-ee simree-ai har jee-o jaa kee kal Dhaaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਿਸਮਰੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In their minds, the Gurmukhs do not forget the Dear Lord, the Primal Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh manhu na veesrai har jee-o kart aa purakh  muraaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Pain, disease and fear do not cling to those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog na bh a-o bi-aapai jinHee har har Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਉ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain their pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  taray bh avjal poorab likh i-aa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪੂਰਿਬ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They are congratulated and applauded, their minds are at peace, and they meet theinfinite Lord God.
lines.transliteration: vajee vaDhaa-ee man saaNt aa-ee mili-aa purakh  apaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ  ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, my desires arefulfilled. ||4||3|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 Gru 2  (544-5) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siq nwmu gur pRswid ] (544-5) ik-oNkaar sat naam gur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak simar har har ichh  punnee hamaaree. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਸਮਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O peaceful night, grow longer - I have come to enshrine love for my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: vaDh sukh  rainrh ee-ay pari-a paraym lagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਹਾਗੜਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O painful sleep, grow shorter, so that I may constantly grasp His Feet.
lines.transliteration: ghat d ukh need -rhee-ay parsa-o sad aa pagaa.

lines.english: I long for the dust of His Feet, and beg for His Name; for His Love, I have renouncedthe world.
lines.transliteration: pag Dhoor baaNchha-o sad aa jaacha-o naam ras bairaaganee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟੁ ਦੁਖ ਨੀਦੜੀਏ  ਪਰਸਉ  ਸਦਾ ਪਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am imbued with the Love of my Beloved, and I am naturally intoxicated with it; I have forsaken my awful evil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: pari-a rang raatee sahj maat ee mahaa d urmat  ti-aaganee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਗ ਧੂਿਰ ਬਛਉ  ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ  ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: He has taken me by the arm, and I am saturated with His Love; I have met myBeloved on the Path of Truth.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa leenHee paraym bh eenee milan pareet am sach magaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜ  ਮਾਤੀ  ਮਹਾ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਤਆਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please Lord, shower Your Mercy on me, that I may remain attached toYour Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak Dh aar kirpaa raha-o charn ah sang lagaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੀ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭੀਨੀ  ਿਮਲਨੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸਚ ਮਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my friends and companions, let us remain attached to the Feet of God.
lines.transliteration: mayree sakhee sahaylrh eeho parabh  kai charan  lagah.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਹਉ  ਚਰਣਹ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within my mind is great love for my Beloved; I beg for the Lord's devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: man pari-a paraym ghan aa har kee bh agat mangah.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਚਰਿਣ  ਲਗਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's devotional worship is obtained, meditating on God. Let us go and meet thehumble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  paa-ee-ai parabh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai jaa-ay milee-ai har janaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਘਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮੰਗਹ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce pride, emotional attachment and corruption, and dedicate this body, wealthand mind to Him.
lines.transliteration: maan moh bikaar tajee-ai arap t an Dh an ih manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord God is great, perfect, glorious, absolutely perfect; meeting the Lord, Har,Har, the wall of doubt is torn down.
lines.transliteration: bad purakh pooran gun  sampooran bh aram bh eet har har mil bh agah.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਬਕਾਰੁ ਤਜੀਐ  ਅਰਿਪ  ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, hear these teachings, O friends - chant the Lord's Name constantly, over and over again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sun  mant ar sakh ee-ay har naam nit  nit nit japah. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਗੁਣ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੀਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਭਗਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's bride is a happy wife; she enjoys all pleasures.
lines.transliteration: har naar suhaaganay sabh  rang maan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਣ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਸਖੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਤ ਿਨਤ ਿਨਤ ਜਪਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She does not sit around like a widow, because the Lord God lives forever.
lines.transliteration: raaNd na bais-ee parabh purakh  chiraan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਰ  ਸੁਹਾਗਣੇ  ਸਿਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: She does not suffer pain - she meditates on God. She is blessed, and very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: nah dookh  paavai parabh  Dhi-aavai Dh an tay badbh aagee-aa.

lines.english: She sleeps in peaceful ease, her sins are erased, and she wakes to the joy and love ofthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: sukh sahj soveh kilbikh  khoveh naam ras rang jaagee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਧੰਿਨ ਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: She remains absorbed in her Beloved - the Lord's Name is her ornament. The Wordsof her Beloved are sweet and pleasing to her.
lines.transliteration: mil paraym rahnaa har naam gahn aa pari-a bachan meeth ay bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੋਵਿਹ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਖੋਵਿਹ  ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਰੰਿਗ ਜਾਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have obtained my mind's desires; I have met my eternal HusbandLord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak man ichh  paa-ee har milay purakh  chiraan ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਹਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਬਚਨ  ਮੀਠੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: The songs of bliss resound, and millions of pleasures are found in that house;
lines.transliteration: tit garihi sohilrh ay kod anand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਚਰਾਣੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man tan rav rahi-aa parabh  parmaanand aa. the mind and body are permeated by God, the Lord of supreme bliss.

lines.english: My Husband Lord is infinite and merciful; He is the Lord of wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Saving Grace of sinners.
lines.transliteration: har kant anant  da-i-aal sareeDh ar gobind  patit uDhaaran o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: God, the Giver of mercy, the Lord, the Destroyer of pride, carries us across theterrifying world-ocean of poison.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa Dh aaree har muraaree bh ai sinDh  saagar t aarno.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord lovingly embraces whoever comes to the Lord's Sanctuary - this is the wayof the Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: jo saran aavai t is kanth  laavai ih birad  su-aamee sand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ਭੈ ਿਸੰਧੁ ਸਾਗਰ  ਤਾਰਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have met my Husband Lord, who plays with me forever. ||4||1||4|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 ] (544-19) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5. Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak har kant  mili-aa sad aa kayl karand aa. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਰਿਣ  ਆਵੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਵੈ  ਇਹੁ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੰਦਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Feet are the Pools of Ambrosial Nectar; your dwelling is there, O my mind. pMnw 545
lines.transliteration: har charan sarovar t ah karahu nivaas manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਨਾਸੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Take your cleansing bath in the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord, and all of your sins shall be wiped away, O my soul.
lines.transliteration: kar majan har saray sabh kilbikh  naas manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਮਜਨੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਸਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਨਾਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Take your cleansing ever in the Lord God, O friends, and the pain of darkness shall bedispelled.
lines.transliteration: kar sadaa majan gobind  sajan d ukh anDh ayraa naasay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਕਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Birth and death shall not touch you, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.
lines.transliteration: janam maran na ho-ay t is ka-o katai jam kay faasay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ  ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਤਹਾ ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸੋ  ॥
lines.english: So join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and be imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there, your hopes shall be fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangay naam rangay t ahaa pooran aaso.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, that I might dwell at Your LotusFeet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak Dh aar kirpaa har charan  kamal nivaaso. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਸਦਾ ਅਨਹਦ  ਝੁਣਕਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: There is bliss and ecstasy there always, and the unstruck celestial melody resoundsthere.
lines.transliteration: tah anad  binod  sadaa anhad  jhunkaaro raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meeting together, the Saints sing God's Praises, and celebrate His Victory.
lines.transliteration: mil gaavahi sant janaa parabh  kaa jaikaaro raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਖਸਮ  ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸ ਰੰਿਗ ਿਭੰਨੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting together, the Saints sing the Praises of the Lord Master; they are pleasing tothe Lord, and saturated with the sublime essence of His love and affection.
lines.transliteration: mil sant gaavahi kh asam bh aaveh har paraym ras rang bh innee-aa.

lines.english: They obtain the profit of the Lord, eliminate their self-conceit, and meet Him, fromwhom they were separated for so long.
lines.transliteration: har laabh paa-i-aa aap mitaa-i-aa milay chiree vichh unni-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ  ਦਇਆ ਕੀਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਏਕ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Taking them by the arm, He makes them His own; God, the One, inaccessible andinfinite, bestows His kindness.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa leenay d a-i-aa keenHay parabh  ayk agam apaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, forever immaculate are those who sing the Praises of the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sad aa nirmal sach sabad  run jhunkaaro. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Listen, O most fortunate ones, to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sun vadbh aagee-aa har amrit  banee raam.

lines.english: He alone, whose karma is so pre-ordained, has it enter into his heart.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o karam likhee t is ridai samaan ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ ਿਤਨੀ  ਜਾਣੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He alone knows the Unspoken Speech, unto whom God has shown His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: akath kahaanee t inee jaan ee jis aap parabh  kirpaa karay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰੁ ਥੀਆ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸਾ  ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He becomes immortal, and shall not die again; his troubles, disputes and pains aredispelled.
lines.transliteration: amar thee-aa fir na moo-aa kal kalaysaa dukh  haray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਰਿਣ ਪਾਈ  ਤਿਜ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: He finds the Sanctuary of the Lord; he does not forsake the Lord, and does not leave.God's Love is pleasing to his mind and body.
lines.transliteration: har saran paa-ee t aj na jaa-ee parabh  pareet  man t an bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਗਾਈਐ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, sing forever the Sacred Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sad aa gaa-ee-ai pavit ar amrit  banee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਗਲਤੁ  ਭਏ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are intoxicated - this state cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: man tan galat  bha-ay kichh  kahan  na jaa-ee raam.

lines.english: We originated from Him, and into Him we shall merge once again.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upji-arh aa tin lee-aa samaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਤੀ ਉਦਕੁ  ਉਦਿਕ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I merge into God's Light, through and through, like water merging into water.
lines.transliteration: mil barahm jotee ot  potee ud ak ud ak samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਏਕੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਨਹ ਦੂਜਾ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord permeates the water, the land and the sky - I do not see any other.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al ayk ravi-aa nah doojaa d aristaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਣ ਿਤਰ੍ਿਣ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਪੂਿਰ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is totally permeating the woods, meadows and the three worlds. I cannot express His worth.
lines.transliteration: ban tarin taribhavan poor pooran keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਹ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, He alone knows - He who created this creation. ||4||2||5|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 ] (545-13) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5. Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak aap jaan ai jin ayh ban at banaa-ee. ||4||2||5||

lines.english: The Saints go around, searching for God, the support of their breath of life.
lines.transliteration: khojat  sant fireh parabh  paraan  aDhaaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਸੰਤ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They lose the strength of their bodies, if they do not merge with their Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: taan tan kh een bh a-i-aa bin milat  pi-aaray raam.

lines.english: O God, my Beloved, please, bestow Your kindness upon me, that I may merge withYou; by Your Mercy, attach me to the hem of Your robe.
lines.transliteration: parabh milhu pi-aaray ma-i-aa Dh aaray kar d a-i-aa larh  laa-ay leejee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਇਆ  ਧਾਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਇ  ਲੀਜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Bless me with Your Name, that I may chant it, O Lord and Master; beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.
lines.transliteration: deh naam apnaa japa-o su-aamee har d aras paykh ay jeejee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਜਪਉ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸ  ਪੇਖੇ ਜੀਜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He is all-powerful, perfect, eternal and unchanging, exalted, unapproachable and infinite.
lines.transliteration: samrath pooran sadaa nihchal ooch agam apaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਮਰਥ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਊਚ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, bestow Your Mercy upon me, O Beloved of my soul, that I may mergewith You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak Dh aar kirpaa milhu paraan pi-aaray. ||1||

lines.english: I have practiced chanting, intensive meditation and fasting, to see Your Feet, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: jap tap barat  keenay paykh an ka-o charn aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਬਰਤ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਪੇਖਨ  ਕਉ ਚਰਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: But still, my burning is not quenched, without the Sanctuary of the Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: tapat na kat eh bujh ai bin su-aamee sarn aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤਪਿਤ  ਨ ਕਤਿਹ  ਬੁਝੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, God - please, cut away my bonds and carry me across theworld-ocean.
lines.transliteration: parabh saran  tayree kaat bayree sansaar saagar t aaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਿਟ  ਬੇਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am masterless, worthless, and I know nothing; please do not count up my meritsand demerits.
lines.transliteration: anaath nirgun kachh na jaanaa mayraa gun  a-ugan  na beechaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥ  ਿਨਰਗੁਿਨ  ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਉਗਣੁ  ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Sustainer of the world, O Beloved, Almighty Cause ofcauses.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal gopaal pareet am samrath kaaran  karnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਕਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the rain-drop of the Lord's Name; meditating on the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har, he lives. ||2|| pMnw 546
lines.transliteration: naanak chaatrik har boond  maagai jap jeevaa har har charn aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੂੰਦ ਮਾਗੈ  ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar from the pool of the Lord; chant the Name of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: ami-a sarovaro pee-o har har naamaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਮਅ  ਸਰੋਵਰੋ  ਪੀਉ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, one meets the Lord; meditating on Him, one's affairs areresolved.
lines.transliteration: santeh sang milai jap pooran kaamaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹ  ਸੰਿਗ ਿਮਲੈ ਜਿਪ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਮਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God is the One who accomplishes everything; He is the Dispeller of pain. Never forgetHim from your mind, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: sabh kaam pooran d ukh bideeran har nimakh  manhu na beesrai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰਨ  ਦੁਖ ਿਬਦੀਰਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਮਖ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is blissful, night and day; He is forever True. All Glories are contained in the Lordin the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aanand an-d in sad aa saachaa sarab gun  jagdeesrai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Incalculable, lofty and infinite is the Lord and Master. Unapproachable is His home.
lines.transliteration: agnat  ooch apaar th aakur agam jaa ko Dh aamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਣਤ  ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਧਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Greatest Lover. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak mayree ichh  pooran milay sareerang raamaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸਰ੍ੀਰੰਗ  ਰਾਮਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The fruits of many millions of charitable feasts come to those who listen to and singthe Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee kotik jag falaa sun gaavanhaaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਈ ਕੋਿਟਕ  ਜਗ ਫਲਾ ਸੁਿਣ ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all one's generations are carried across.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japat kul saglay t aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ  ਤਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, one is beautified; what Praises of His can I chant?
lines.transliteration: har naam japat sohant  paraan ee taa kee mahimaa kit  ganaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਸੋਹੰਤ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਿਕਤ ਗਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never forget the Lord; He is the Beloved of my soul. My mind constantly yearns for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: har bisar naahee paraan pi-aaray chitvant  darsan sad  manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਚਤਵੰਿਤ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Auspicious is that day, when God, the lofty, inaccessible and infinite, hugs me close inHis embrace.
lines.transliteration: subh d ivas aa-ay geh kanth  laa-ay parabh  ooch agam apaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭ ਿਦਵਸ  ਆਏ  ਗਿਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, everything is fruitful - I have met my supremely beloved Lord God.||4||3||6|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 CMq ] (546-8) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5 chh ant. Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak safal sabh  kichh  parabh  milay at  pi-aaray. ||4||3||6||

lines.english: Why are you imbued with the love of another? That path is very dangerous.
lines.transliteration: an kaa-ay raat-rh i-aa vaat d uhaylee raam.

lines.english: O sinner, no one is your friend.
lines.transliteration: paap kamaavdi-aa t ayraa ko-ay na baylee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਕਾਏ ਰਾਤਿੜਆ  ਵਾਟ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: No one shall be your friend, and you shall forever regret your actions.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na baylee ho-ay tayraa sad aa pachh otaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਿਦਆ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: You have not chanted with your tongue the Praises of the Sustainer of the World;when will these days come again?
lines.transliteration: gun gupaal na jaapeh rasnaa fir kadahu say d ih aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਏ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ  ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: The leaf, separated from the branch, shall not be joined with it again; all alone, it falls on its way to death.
lines.transliteration: tarvar vichh unay nah paat  jurh-tay jam mag ga-un ikaylee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਨ ਜਪਿਹ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਿਫਿਰ ਕਦਹੁ ਸੇ ਿਦਹ ਆਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, without the Lord's Name, the soul wanders, forever suffering. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak bin naam har kay sad aa firat  duhaylee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਵਰ  ਿਵਛੁੰਨੇ  ਨਹ ਪਾਤ ਜੁੜਤੇ  ਜਮ ਮਿਗ ਗਉਨੁ ਇਕੇਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are practicing deception secretly, but the Lord, the Knower, knows all.
lines.transliteration: tooN valvanch look karahi sabh  jaanai jaan ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸਦਾ ਿਫਰਤ  ਦੁਹੇਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma reads your account, you shall be squeezed likea sesame seed in the oil-press.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa Dh aram bh a-i-aa t il peerh ay gh aanee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਵਲਵੰਚ  ਲੂਿਕ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਭ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: For the actions you committed, you shall suffer the penalty; you shall be consigned tocountless reincarnations.
lines.transliteration: kirat kamaan ay dukh saho paraan ee anik jon bh armaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ  ਧਰਮ  ਭਇਆ ਿਤਲ  ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the love of Maya, the great enticer, you shall lose the jewel of thishuman life.
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohnee sang raataa rat an janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਤ  ਕਮਾਣੇ  ਦੁਖ ਸਹੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Except for the One Name of the Lord, you are clever in everything else.
lines.transliteration: ikas har kay naam baajhahu aan kaaj si-aan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ  ਸੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, those who have such pre-ordained destiny are attracted to doubt andemotional attachment. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak laykh  likhi-aa bh aram mohi lubh aanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਆਨ  ਕਾਜ  ਿਸਆਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: No one advocates for the ungrateful person, who is separated from the Lord.
lines.transliteration: beech na ko-ay karay akrit-gh an vichh urh pa-i-aa.

lines.english: The hard-hearted Messenger of Death comes and seizes him.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay kharay kath in jamkankar pakarh  la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ਅਿਕਰ੍ਤਘਣੁ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He seizes him, and leads him away, to pay for his evil deeds; he was imbued with Maya, the great enticer.
lines.transliteration: pakrhay chalaa-i-aa apn aa kamaa-i-aa mahaa mohnee raat i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਏ  ਖਰੇ ਕਿਠਨ ਜਮਕੰਕਿਰ  ਪਕਿੜ  ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He was not Gurmukh - he did not chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of theUniverse; and now, the hot irons are put to his chest.
lines.transliteration: gun govind gurmukh  na japi-aa t apat thamH gal laat i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਕੜੇ  ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ  ਰਾਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is ruined by sexual desire, anger and egotism; deprived of spiritual wisdom, hecomes to regret.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar mooth aa kh o-ay gi-aan pachh utaapi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ਤਪਤ  ਥੰਮ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, by his cursed destiny he has gone astray; with his tongue, he does notchant the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sanjog bh oolaa har jaap rasan na jaapi-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ਮੂਠਾ ਖੋਇ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਿਪਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, God, no one is our savior.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin ko naahee parabh  raakh anhaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਜੋਿਗ  ਭੂਲਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੁ ਰਸਨ  ਨ ਜਾਿਪਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: It is Your Nature, Lord, to save the sinners.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran  har birad  tumaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Savior of sinners, I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Lord and Master,Compassionate Ocean of Mercy.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran saran su-aamee kirpaa niDh  da-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Please, rescue me from the deep, dark pit, O Creator, Cherisher of all hearts.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay uDh ar kart ay sagal gh at part ipaalaa.

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary; please, cut away these heavy bonds, and give me the Support of the One Name. pMnw 547
lines.transliteration: saran tayree kat mahaa bayrh ee ik naam d eh aDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please, give me Your Hand and save me, O Lord of the Universe, Merciful to the meek. ||4||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak kar d ay-ay raakh o gobind  deen d a-i-aaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਦਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ  ਗਿਣਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: That day is judged to be fruitful, when I merged with my Lord.
lines.transliteration: so din safal gan i-aa har parabh oo milaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਗਿਟਆ  ਦੁਖ ਦੂਿਰ ਪਰਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Total happiness was revealed, and pain was taken far away.
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  pargati-aa d ukh door paraa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਿਨਤ  ਗਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Peace, tranquility, joy and eternal happiness come from constantly singing theGlorious Praises of the Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: sukh sahj anad  binod  sad hee gun gupaal nit  gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I lovingly remember the Lord; Ishall not wander again in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: bhaj saaDh sangay milay rangay bahurh  jon na Dh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਏ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He has naturally hugged me close in His Loving Embrace, and the seed of my primaldestiny has sprouted.
lines.transliteration: geh kanth laa-ay sahj subh aa-ay aad  ankur aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, He Himself has met me, and He shall never again leave me. ||5||4||7|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 CMq ] (547-5) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5 chh ant. Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak aap mili-aa bahurh  kathoo na jaa-i-aa. ||5||4||7||

lines.english: Listen to my prayer, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sunhu banantee-aa su-aamee mayray raam.

lines.english: I am filled with millions of sins, but still, I am Your slave.
lines.transliteration: kot apraaDh bh aray bh ee tayray chayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਅਪਰ੍ਾਧ  ਭਰੇ ਭੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Destroyer of pain, Bestower of Mercy, Fascinating Lord, Destroyer of sorrow and strife,
lines.transliteration: dukh haran kirpaa karan mohan kal kalayseh bh anjnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਨ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰਨ  ਮੋਹਨ  ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸਹ  ਭੰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary; please preserve my honor. You are all-pervading, OImmaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: saran tayree rakh  layho mayree sarab mai niranjanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਤੇਰੀ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਬ  ਮੈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: He hears and beholds all; God is with us, the nearest of the near.
lines.transliteration: sunat paykh at sang sabh  kai parabh  nayrhoo t ay nayray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨਤ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਭ ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨੇਰਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master, hear Nanak's prayer; please save the servants of Your household. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ardaas naanak sun su-aamee rakh  layho gh ar kay chayray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਰਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਚੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are eternal and all-powerful; I am a mere beggar, Lord.
lines.transliteration: too samrath sad aa ham d een bh aykhaaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸਦਾ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ  ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am intoxicated with the love of Maya - save me, Lord!
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi magan kadh layho muraaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਕਿਢ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Bound down by greed, emotional attachment and corruption, I have made so many mistakes.
lines.transliteration: lobh mohi bikaar baaDh i-o anik d okh kamaavanay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਿਭ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਬਕਾਿਰ ਬਾਿਧਓ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਵਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: The creator is both attached and detached from entanglements; one obtains the fruitsof his own actions.
lines.transliteration: alipat banDh an rahat  kartaa kee-aa apnaa paavnay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਲਪਤ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਰਹਤ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਪਾਵਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Show kindness to me, O Purifier of sinners; I am so tired of wandering throughreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: kar anoograhu patit  paavan baho jon bh aramt ay haaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of the Lord; God is the Support of my soul, and mybreath of life. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d aas har kaa parabh  jee-a paraan aDh aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are great and all-powerful; my understanding is so inadequate, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: too samrath vadaa mayree mat  thoree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਿਤ ਥੋਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: You cherish even the ungrateful ones; Your Glance of Grace is perfect, Lord.
lines.transliteration: paaleh akirat-gh anaa pooran d arisat t ayree raam.

lines.english: Your wisdom is unfathomable, O Infinite Creator. I am lowly, and I know nothing.
lines.transliteration: agaaDh boDh  apaar kart ay mohi neech kachh oo na jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਿਧ ਅਪਾਰ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਮੋਿਹ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Forsaking the jewel, I have saved the shell; I am a lowly, ignorant beast.
lines.transliteration: ratan t i-aag sangrehan ka-udee pasoo neech i-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹਨ  ਕਉਡੀ  ਪਸੂ ਨੀਚੁ ਇਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have kept that which forsakes me, and is very fickle, continually committing sins,again and again.
lines.transliteration: ti-aag chalt ee mahaa chanchal d okh kar kar joree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਿਗ ਚਲਤੀ  ਮਹਾ ਚੰਚਿਲ  ਦੋਖ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Almighty Lord and Master; please, preserve my honor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak saran samrath su-aamee paij raakho moree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I was separated from Him, and now, He has united me with Himself.
lines.transliteration: jaa tay veechh urhi-aa tin aap milaa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangmay har gun  gaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਮੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the ever-sublime blissful Lord isrevealed to me.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay govid  sadaa neekay kali-aan  mai pargat bh a-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਗੋਿਵਦ ਸਦਾ ਨੀਕੇ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਮੈ ਪਰਗਟ  ਭਏ ॥
lines.english: My bed is adorned with God; my God has made me His own.
lines.transliteration: sayjaa suhaavee sang parabh kai aapn ay parabh  kar la-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਿਰ ਲਏ ॥
lines.english: Abandoning anxiety, I have become carefree, and I shall not suffer in pain any longer.
lines.transliteration: chhod chint  achint  ho-ay bahurh  dookh na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਿਚੰਤ  ਅਿਚੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the ocean of excellence. ||4||5||8|| ibhwgVw mhlw 5 CMq ] (547-17) bihaagarhaa mehlaa 5 chh ant. Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak darsan paykh  jeevay govind  gun niDh gaa-i-aa. ||4||5||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਿਖ ਜੀਵੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
lines.english: O you of sublime faith, chant the Lord's Name; why do you remain silent?
lines.transliteration: bol suDharmeerh i-aa mon kat  Dhaaree raam.
too nayt ree daykh chali-aa maa-i-aa bi-uhaaree raam. with your eyes, you have seen the treacherous ways of Maya.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਿਲ  ਸੁਧਰਮੀਿੜਆ  ਮੋਿਨ ਕਤ ਧਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Nothing shall go along with you, except the Name of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: sang tayrai kachh  na chaalai binaa gobind  naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਨੇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਚਿਲਆ  ਮਾਇਆ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Land, clothes, gold and silver - all of these things are useless.
lines.transliteration: days vays suvran roopaa sagal oon ay kaamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਿਬਨਾ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Children, spouse, worldly honors, elephants, horses and other corrupting influences shall not go with you.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar na sang sobh aa hasat  ghor vikaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਸ ਵੇਸ ਸੁਵਰਨ  ਰੂਪਾ ਸਗਲ  ਊਣੇ ਕਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the whole world is false. ||1|| pMnw 548
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak bin saaDh sangam sabh  mithi-aa sansaaree. ||1||

lines.english: O king, why are you sleeping? Why don't you wake up to reality?
lines.transliteration: raajan ki-o so-i-aa too need  bharay jaagat  kat naahee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਨ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੋਇਆ  ਤੂ ਨੀਦ  ਭਰੇ ਜਾਗਤ  ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: It is useless to cry and whine about Maya, but so many cry out and bewail.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa jhooth  rudan kayt ay billaahee raam.

lines.english: So many cry out for Maya, the great enticer, but without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace.
lines.transliteration: billaahi kaytay mahaa mohan bin naam har kay sukh  nahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਲਲਾਿਹ  ਕੇਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Thousands of clever tricks and efforts will not succeed. One goes wherever the Lord wills him to go.
lines.transliteration: sahas si-aanap upaav thaakay jah bh aavat  tah jaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਉਪਾਵ ਥਾਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵਤ  ਤਹ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is all-pervading everywhere; He isin each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: aad ant ay maDh  pooran sarbat ar ghat ghat aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਧ ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਆਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat go to the house of the Lord withhonor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak jin saaDh sangam say pat  saytee gh ar jaahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮੁ  ਸੇ ਪਿਤ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O king of mortals, know that your palaces and wise servants shall be of no use in theend.
lines.transliteration: narpat jaan  garahi-o sayvak si-aan ay raam.

lines.english: You shall certainly have to separate yourself from them, and their attachment shallmake you feel regret.
lines.transliteration: sarpar veechhurh anaa mohay pachh utaanay raam.

lines.english: Beholding the phantom city, you have gone astray; how can you now find stability?
lines.transliteration: harichand-uree d aykh bhoolaa kahaa asthit  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਚੰਦਉਰੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਭੂਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਅਸਿਥਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Absorbed in things other than the Name of the Lord, this human life is wasted in vain.
lines.transliteration: bin naam har kay aan rachnaa ahilaa janam gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਆਨ  ਰਚਨਾ  ਅਿਹਲਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Indulging in egotistical actions, your thirst is not quenched. Your desires are notfulfilled, and you do not attain spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karat na t arisan boojh ai nah kaaNm pooran gi-aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਮ ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਗਆਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, so many have departed with regret. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak bin naam har kay kayt i-aa pachh utaanay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਕੇਿਤਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhaar anugraho apnaa kar leenaa raam. Showering His blessings, the Lord has made me His own.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਿਰ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੋ ਅਪਨਾ  ਕਿਰ ਲੀਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Grasping me by the arm, He has pulled me out of the mud, and He has blessed me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: bhujaa geh kaadh  lee-o saaDh oo sang d eenaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਜਾ ਗਿਹ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਓ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Worshipping the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, all my sins and sufferings are burnt away.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangam har araaDh ay sagal kalmal d ukh jalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਅਰਾਧੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
lines.english: This is the greatest religion, and the best act of charity; this alone shall go along withyou.
lines.transliteration: mahaa Dharam sud aan kiri-aa sang t ayrai say chalay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਧਰਮ  ਸੁਦਾਨ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੈ ਸੇ ਚਲੇ ॥
lines.english: My tongue chants in adoration the Name of the One Lord and Master; my mind andbody are drenched in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa araaDhai ayk su-aamee har naam man t an bh eenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਅਰਾਧੈ  ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whoever the Lord unites with Hims elf, is filled with all virtues. ||4||6||9|| ibhwgVy kI vwr mhlw 4  (548-11) bihaagarhay kee vaar mehlaa 4 Vaar Of Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (548-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mÚ 3 ] (548-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no har milaa-ay so sarab gun parbeenaa. ||4||6||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਸੋ ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਪਰਬੀਨਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, peace is obtained; do not search for peace anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sukh  paa-ee-ai hor thai sukh  na bh aal.

lines.english: The soul is pierced by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. The Lord dwells ever with thesoul.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man bh aydee-ai sad aa vasai har naal.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, who are blessed by theLord with His Glance of Grace. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (548-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinaa ka-o milai jin har vaykh ai nad ar nihaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Lord's Praise is such a blessed gift; he alone obtains it to spend,unto whom the Lord bestows it.
lines.transliteration: sifat kh ajaanaa bakh as hai jis bakh sai so kh archai kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਭੇਦੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, it does not come to hand; all have grown weary of performingreligious rituals.
lines.transliteration: satgur bin hath na aavee sabh  thakay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs of the world lack this wealth; when they are hungry in the next world, what will they have to eat there? ||2|| pauVI ] (548-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh jagat  Dhanheen  hai agai bh ukhaa ke kh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You created all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree t oo sabh as daa sabh  tuDh upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਫਿਤ ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਬਖਸ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੈ  ਸੋ ਖਰਚੈ  ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You are pervading within all - all meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa vich t oo varatd aa too sabh nee Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You accept the devotional worship of those who are pleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: tis dee too bh agat thaa-ay paa-ihi jo t uDh man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਧਨਹੀਣੁ  ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਿਕ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases the Lord God happens; all act as You cause them to act.
lines.transliteration: jo har parabh bh aavai so thee-ai sabh  karan t ayraa karaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Praise the Lord, the greatest of all; He preserves the honor of the Saints. ||1|| slok mÚ 3 ] (548-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: salaahihu har sabhnaa t ay vadaa jo sant  janaaN kee paij rakh -daa aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ  ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the spiritually wise one has conquered all others.
lines.transliteration: naanak gi-aanee jag jeetaa jag jeet aa sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: Through the Name, his affairs are brought to perfection; whatever happens is by HisWill.
lines.transliteration: naamay kaaraj siDh hai sehjay ho-ay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਭਗਿਤ  ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਇਿਹ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, his mind is held steady; no one can make him waver.
lines.transliteration: gurmat mat  achal hai chalaa-ay na sakai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਿਨ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord makes His devotee His own, and his affairs are adjusted. pMnw 549
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa har angeekaar karay kaaraj suhaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have been led astray from the very beginning; within them lurks greed, avarice and ego.
