lines.transliteration: manmukh moolhu bh ulaa-i-an vich lab lobh  ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Their nights and days pass in argument, and they do not reflect upon the Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: jhagrh aa kard i-aa an-d in gud rai sabad  na karai veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਝਗੜਾ  ਕਰਿਦਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Creator has taken away their subtle intellect, and all their speech is corrupt.
lines.transliteration: suDh mat  kartai hir la-ee bolan sabh  vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਧ ਮਿਤ ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਹਿਰ  ਲਈ ਬੋਲਿਨ  ਸਭੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within them is desire, and thegreat darkness of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: ditai kitai na sant okhee-an ant ar tarisnaa bahut  ag-yaan anDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਤੈ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਿਨ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it is right to break with the self-willed manmukhs; to them, the love of Mayais sweet. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (549-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukhaa naalahu t utee-aa bh alee jinaa maa-i-aa mohi pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਨਾਲਹੁ ਤੁਟੀਆ ਭਲੀ ਿਜਨਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can fear and doubt do to those, who have given their heads to the Creator, andto the True Guru?
lines.transliteration: tinH bha-o sansaa ki-aa karay jin sat gur sir kart aar.

lines.english: Dhur t in kee paij rakh -daa aapay rakh anhaar. He who has preserved honor from the beginning of time, He shall preserve their honor as well.
Meeting their Beloved, they find peace; they reflect upon the True Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam sukh  paa-i-aa sachai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I serve the Giver of Peace; He Himself is the Assessor. ||2|| pauVI ] (549-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh-d aata sayvi-aa aapay parkh anhaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: All beings are Yours; You are the wealth of all.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tayri-aa t oo sabh naa raas.

lines.english: One unto whom You give, obtains everything; there is no one else to rival You.
lines.transliteration: jis no too d eh tis sabh  kichh  milai ko-ee hor sareek naahee t uDh paas.

lines.english: You alone are the Great Giver of all; I offer my prayer unto You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: too iko d aataa sabh as daa har peh ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਤੇਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: One with whom You are pleased, is accepted by You; how blessed is such a person!
lines.transliteration: jis dee t uDh bhaavai t is dee too man laihi so jan saabaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਿਤਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Your wondrous play is pervading everywhere. I place my pain and pleasure beforeYou. ||2|| slok mÚ 3 ] (549-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayraa choj varatd aa dukh sukh  tuDh paas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭਸ  ਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are pleasing to the True Lord; they are judged to be true in the TrueCourt.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sachai bh aavday dar sachai sachiaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈਿਹ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The minds of such friends are filled with bliss, as they reflect upon the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saajan man aanand hai gur kaa sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They enshrine the Shabad within their hearts; their pain is dispelled, and the Creatorblesses them with the Divine Light.
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  vasaa-i-aa d ukh kati-aa chaanan  kee-aa kart aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Savior Lord shall save them, and shower them with His Mercy. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (549-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rakhan haaraa rakh see aapn ee kirpaa Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੈ ਭਾਵਦੇ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Guru, and wait upon Him; as you work, maintain the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa chaakree bhai rach kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: As you serve Him, you will become like Him, as you walk according to His Will.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa sayvai tayho hovai jay chalai t isai rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸਾਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself is everything; there is no other place to go. ||2|| pauVI ] (549-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh  aap hai avar na d oojee jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: You alone know Your greatness - no one else is as great as You.
lines.transliteration: tayree vadi-aa-ee t oohai jaand aa tuDh jayvad avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: If there were some other rival as great as You, then I would speak of him. You alone are as great as You are.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad hor sareek hovai t aa aakh ee-ai t uDh jayvad t oohai ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਭੈ ਰਿਚ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who serves You obtains peace; who else can compare to You?
lines.transliteration: jin too sayvi-aa t in sukh  paa-i-aa hor t is dee rees karay ki-aa ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਿਤਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You are all-powerful to destroy and create, O Great Giver; with palms pressed together, all stand begging before You. quDu jyvfu dwqwru mY koeI ndir n AwveI quDu sB sY no dwnu idqw KMfI vrBMfI pwqwlI pureI sB
lines.transliteration: too bh annan  gharhan samrath d aataar heh t uDh agai mangan  no hath jorh  khalee sabh ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I see none as great as You, O Great Giver; You give in charity to the beings of all the continents, worlds, solar systems, nether regions and universes. ||3|| slok mÚ 3 ] (549-16) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad d aataar mai ko-ee nad ar na aavee t uDh sabh sai no d aan d itaa kh andee varbhandee paat aalee pur-ee sabh  lo-ee. ||3||

lines.english: O mind, you have no faith, and you have not embraced love for the Celestial Lord;
lines.transliteration: man parteet  na aa-ee-aa sahj na lago bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Lord will you stubborn-mindedly sing?
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  na paa-i-o manhath  ki-aa gun  gaa-ay. you do not enjoy the sublime taste of the Word of the Shabad - what Praises of the

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, his coming alone is approved, who, as Gurmukh, merges into the True Lord.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (549-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aa-i-aa so parvaan hai je gurmukh  sach samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਤੂ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹੋਰੁ ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The fool does not understand his own self; he annoys others with his speech.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa aap na pachh aanai moorh aa avraa aakh  dukhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਭੰਨਣ  ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹਿਹ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਮੰਗਣ  ਨੋ ਹਥ ਜੋਿੜ ਖਲੀ  ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: His underlying nature does not leave him; separated from the Lord, he suffers cruelblows.
lines.transliteration: mundhai d ee kh aslat na ga-ee-aa anDh ay vichh urh chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਸੈ  ਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਿਦਤਾ  ਖੰਡੀ ਵਰਭੰਡੀ  ਪਾਤਾਲੀ  ਪੁਰਈ  ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Through the fear of the True Guru, he has not changed and reformed himself, so that he might merge in the lap of God. pMnw 550
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh ai bhann na gh arhi-o rahai ank samaa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, his doubts never stop; without the Word of the Shabad, he suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: an-din sahsaa kad ay na chookai bin sabd ai dukh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਹਸਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and greed are so powerful within him; he passes his lifeconstantly entangled in worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  antar sablaa nit  DhanDhaa karat  vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਲਾ  ਿਨਤ ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ  ਿਵਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: His feet, hands, eyes and ears are exhausted; his days are numbered, and his death is immanent.
lines.transliteration: charan kar d aykhat sun thakay d ih mukay nayrh ai aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਰ ਦੇਖਤ  ਸੁਿਣ ਥਕੇ ਿਦਹ ਮੁਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: The True Name does not seem sweet to him - the Name by which the nine treasuresare obtained.
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam na lago meethaa jit  naam nav niDh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਨਾਿਮ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: But if he remains dead while yet alive, then by so dying, he truly lives; thus, he attains liberation.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai marai fun jeevai t aaN mokh antar paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ  ਫੁਿਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਤ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Dhur karam na paa-i-o paraan ee vin  karmaa ki-aa paa-ay. But if he is not blessed with such pre-orda ined karma, then without this karma, what can he obtain?

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਮੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਪਰਾਣੀ  ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਿਕਆ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you fool; through theShabad, you shall obtain salvation and wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad samaal t oo moorh ay gat  mat sabd ay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਸਬਦੇ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone finds the True Guru, wh o eliminates self-conceit from within. ||2|| pauVI ] (550-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur t ad hee paa-ay jaaN vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਜ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One whose consciousness is filled with my Lord Master - why should he feel anxious about anything?
lines.transliteration: jis dai chit  vasi-aa mayraa su-aamee t is no ki-o and aysaa kisai galai d aa lorh ee-ai.

lines.english: 3) har sukh-d aata sabh naa galaa kaa t is no Dh i-aa-id i-aa kiv nimakh  gharhee muhu morhee-ai. The Lord is the Giver of Peace, the Lord of all things; why would we turn our faces away from His meditation, even for a moment, or an instant? ijin hir iDAwieAw iqs no srb kilAwx hoey i nq sMq jnw kI sMgiq jwie bhIAY muhu joVIAY ] (550-6, ibhwgVw, mÚ 3) jin har Dhi-aa-i-aa t is no sarab kali-aan  ho-ay nit  sant janaa kee sangat  jaa-ay bahee- ai muhu jorhee-ai. One who meditates on the Lord obtains all pleasures and comforts; let us go each and every day, to sit in the Saints' Society.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਉ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਿਕਸੈ ਗਲੈ ਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: All the pain, hunger, and disease of the Lord's servant are eradicated; the bonds ofthe humble beings are torn away.
lines.transliteration: sabh d ukh bhukh rog ga-ay har sayvak kay sabh  jan kay banDh an torhee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਗਲਾ  ਕਾ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਧਆਇਿਦਆ  ਿਕਵ ਿਨਮਖ  ਘੜੀ  ਮੁਹੁ ਮੋੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Grace, one becomes the Lord's devotee; beholding the face of the Lord's humble devotee, the whole world is saved and carried across. ||4|| slok mÚ 3 ] (550-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ibhwgVw, mÚ 3) har kirpaa tay ho-aa har bh agat har bh agat janaa kai muhi dith ai jagat  tari-aa sabh lorhee-ai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਸਰਬ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਹੋਏ ਿਨਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਜਾਇ  ਬਹੀਐ  ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Let that tongue, which has not tasted the Name of the Lord, be burnt.
lines.transliteration: saa rasnaa jal jaa-o jin har kaa su-aa-o na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋੜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his tonguesavors the Word of the Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (550-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rasnaa sabad rasaa-ay jin har har man vasaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹੋਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਿਹ ਿਡਠੈ ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਸਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਐ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Let that tongue, which has forgotten the Name of the Lord, be burnt.
lines.transliteration: saa rasnaa jal jaa-o jin har kaa naa-o visaari-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the tongue of the Gurmukh chants the Lord's Name, and loves the Name ofthe Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (550-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh rasnaa har japai har kai naa-ay pi-aari-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ਿਜਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Master, the servant and the devotee; the Lord Himself is theCause of causes.
lines.transliteration: har aapay thaakur sayvak bh agat har aapay karay karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਸਾਇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices. As He wills, so does He enjoin us.
lines.transliteration: har aapay vaykhai vigsai aapay jit  bhaavai t it laa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord places some on the Path, and the Lord leads others into the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: har iknaa maarag paa-ay aapay har iknaa ujharh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the True Master; True is His justice. He arranges and beholds all His plays.
lines.transliteration: har sachaa saahib sach tapaavas kar vaykh ai chalat  sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak speaks and sings the Glorious Praises of the TrueLord. ||5|| slok mÚ 3 ] (550-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kahai jan naanak har sachay kay gun  gaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: How rare is the dervish, the Saintly renunciate, who understands renunciation.
lines.transliteration: darvaysee ko jaan see virlaa ko d arvays.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Cursed is the life, and cursed are the clothes, of one who wanders around, beggingfrom door to door.
lines.transliteration: jay ghar gh ar handh ai mangd aa Dh ig jeevan  Dhig vays.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਜਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: But, if he abandons hope and anxiety, and as Gurmukh receives the Name as hischarity,
lines.transliteration: jay aasaa andaysaa t aj rahai gurmukh  bhikhi-aa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕਨਾ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਇਕਨਾ  ਉਝਿੜ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis kay charan pakh aalee-ah naanak ha-o balihaarai jaa-o. ||1|| then Nanak washes his feet, and is a sacrifice to him. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (550-17) mehlaa 3.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ  ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ  ਸਬਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the tree has one fruit, but two birds are perched upon it.
lines.transliteration: naanak tarvar ayk fal d u-ay pankh ayroo aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.english: They are not seen coming or going; these birds have no wings.
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  na deeshee naa par pankh ee taahi.

lines.english: One enjoys so many pleasures, while the other, through the Word of the Shabad,remains in Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: baho rangee ras bhogi-aa sabad  rahai nirbaan .

lines.english: Imbued with the subtle essence of the fruit of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, the soul bears the True Insignia of God's Grace. ||2|| pauVI ] (550-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har ras fal raatay naankaa karam sachaa neesaan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਹੰਢੈ ਮੰਗਦਾ  ਿਧਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਿਧਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the field, and He Himself is the farmer. He Himself grows and grinds thecorn.
lines.transliteration: aapay Dhart ee aapay hai raahak aap jammaa-ay peesaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਆਸਾ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਤਿਜ  ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself cooks it, He Himself puts the food in the dishes, and He Himself sits down to eat. pMnw 551
lines.transliteration: aap pakaavai aap bhaaNday d ay-ay parosai aapay hee bahi kh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਇ ਪਰੋਸੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਬਿਹ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the water, He Himself gives the tooth-pick, and He Himself offers the mouthwash.
lines.transliteration: aapay jal aapay day chh ingaa aapay chulee bh araavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਲੁ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇ ਿਛੰਗਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਚੁਲੀ  ਭਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself calls and seats the congregation, and He Himself bids them goodbye.
lines.transliteration: aapay sangat sad  bahaalai aapay vid aa karaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਿਦ ਬਹਾਲੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਵਦਾ  ਕਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy - the Lord causes him to walkaccording to His Will. ||6|| slok mÚ 3 ] (551-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaal hovai har aapay tis no hukam manaavai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Rituals and religions are all just entanglements; bad and good are bound up with them.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam sabh  banDh naa paap punn san-banDh .

lines.english: Those things done for the sake of children and spouse, in ego and attachment, arejust more bonds.
lines.transliteration: mamtaa moh so banDh naa put ar kalt ar so Dh anDh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਸਿਭ ਬੰਧਨਾ  ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see the noose of attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah jayvree maa-i-aa kaa san-banDh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਮਤਾ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸੁ ਬੰਧਨਾ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਸੁ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, the world is engrossed in blind entanglements. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (551-4) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam bin vartan  vartai anDh . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ  ॥
lines.english: The blind receive the Divine Light, when they merge with the Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: anDhay chaanan  taa thee-ai jaa sat gur milai rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਵਰਤਿਣ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਅੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They break their bonds, and dwell in Truth, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orhai sach vasai agi-aan aDh ayraa jaa-ay.

lines.english: They see that everything belongs to the One who created and fashioned the body.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  daykhai tisai kaa jin kee-aa t an saaj.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਤਾ ਥੀਐ  ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Creator - the Creator preserves his honor. ||2|| pauVI ] (551-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran kart aar kee kart aa raakh ai laaj. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋੜੈ ਸਿਚ ਵਸੈ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Creator, sitting all by Himself, created the Universe, he did not consult with any of His servants;
lines.transliteration: jadahu aapay thaat kee-aa bahi kart ai tadahu puchh  na sayvak bee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਦੇਖੈ ਿਤਸੈ ਕਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਤਨੁ ਸਾਿਜ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tadahu ki-aa ko layvai ki-aa ko d ayvai jaaN avar na d oojaa kee-aa. so what can anyone take, and what can anyone give, when He did not create anyother like Himself?

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਕਰਤਾਰ  ਕੀ ਕਰਤਾ  ਰਾਖੈ ਲਾਜ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Then, after fashioning the world, the Creator blessed all with His blessings.
lines.transliteration: fir aapay jagat upaa-i-aa kart ai daan sabh naa ka-o d ee-aa.

lines.english: He Himself instructs us in His service, and as Gurmukh, we drink in His AmbrosialNectar.
lines.transliteration: aapay sayv banaa-ee-an gurmukh  aapay amrit  pee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ਥਾਟੁ ਕੀਆ  ਬਿਹ ਕਰਤੈ  ਤਦਹੁ ਪੁਿਛ ਨ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਬੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is formless, and He Himself is formed; whatever He Himself does, comesto pass. ||7|| slok mÚ 3 ] (551-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap nirankaar aakaar hai aapay aapay karai so thee-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਦਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਜ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs serve God forever; night and day, they are steeped in the Love of theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parabh  sayveh sad  saachaa an-d in sahj pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਉ ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: They are in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; in this world and in the next, they keep Him clasped to their hearts.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand gaavahi gun  saachay araDh  uraDh  ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਵ ਬਣਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਆਪੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Their Beloved dwells deep within; the Creator pre-ordained this destiny.
lines.transliteration: antar pareet am vasi-aa Dh ur karam likh i-aa kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰ  ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He blends them into Himself; He Himself showers His Mercy upon them.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (551-12) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap milaa-i-an aapay kirpaa Dhaar. ||1||

lines.english: By merely talking and speaking, He is not found. Night and day, sing His GloriousPraises continually.
lines.transliteration: kahi-ai kathi-ai na paa-ee-ai an-din rahai sad aa gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without His Merciful Grace, no one finds Him; many have died barking and bewailing.
lines.transliteration: vin karmai kinai na paa-i-o bh a-uk mu-ay billaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਰਿਧ  ਉਰਿਧ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: When the mind and body are saturated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the LordHimself comes to dwell in his mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man t an bh ijai aap vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਮੁ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, He is found; He unites us in His Union. ||2|| pauVI ] (551-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai aapay la-ay milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is the Vedas, the Puraanas and all the Shaastras; He Himself chants them, and He Himself is pleased.
lines.transliteration: aapay vayd puraan  sabh  saasat  aap kathai aap bh eejai.

lines.english: He Himself sits down to worship, and He Himself creates the world.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee bahi poojay kartaa aap parpanch kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਐ  ਕਿਥਐ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is a householder, and He Himself is a renunciate; He Himself utters theUnutterable.
lines.transliteration: aap parvirat aap nirvirt ee aapay akath katheejai.

lines.english: He Himself is all goodness, and He Himself causes us to act; He Himself remainsdetached.
lines.transliteration: aapay punn sabh aap karaa-ay aap alipat  varteejai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਭਜੈ ਆਿਪ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself grants pleasure and pain; the Creator Himself bestows His gifts. ||8|| slok mÚ 3 ] (551-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay sukh d ukh dayvai kart aa aapay bakh as kareejai. ||8||

lines.english: O Shaykh, abandon your cruel nature; live in the Fear of God and give up yourmadness.
lines.transliteration: saykhaa and rahu jor chh ad too bh a-o kar jh al gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Fear of the Guru, many have been saved; in this fear, find the FearlessLord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhai kayt ay nist aray bh ai vich nirbh a-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਸਿਭ ਸਾਸਤ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਥੈ ਆਿਪ  ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Pierce your stone heart with the Word of the Shabad; let peace and tranquility come to abide in your mind.
lines.transliteration: man kathor sabad  bhayd tooN saaNt vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਬਿਹ ਪੂਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: If good deeds are done in this state of peace, they are approved by the Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: saaNtee vich kaar kamaavn ee saa kh asam paa-ay thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਪਰਿਵਰਿਤ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਰਿਵਰਤੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through sexual desire and anger, no one has ever found God - go, and askany wise man. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (551-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl: pMnw 552
lines.transliteration: naanak kaam kroDh kinai na paa-i-o puchh ahu gi-aanee jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੋ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is emotionally attached to Maya - he has no love for the Naam.
lines.transliteration: manmukh maa-i-aa moh hai naam na lago pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਕੂੜੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੈ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He practices falsehood, gathers in falsehood, and makes falsehood his sustenance.
lines.transliteration: koorh kamaavai koorh  sangrahai koorh  karay aahaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚ ਮਰਿਹ  ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He collects the poisonous wealth of Maya, and then dies; in the end, it is all reducedto ashes.
lines.transliteration: bikh maa-i-aa Dh an sanch mareh ant ay ho-ay sabh  chhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He practices religious rituals, purity and austere self-discipline, but within, there is greed and corruption.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam such sanjam karahi ant ar lobh  vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੁ ਥਾਇ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whatever the self-willed manmukh does, is not acceptable; in the Court of the Lord, he is dishonored. ||2|| pauVI ] (552-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak je manmukh kamaavai so thaa-ay naa pavai d argahi ho-ay kh u-aar. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself created the four sources of creation, and He Himself fashioned speech; HeHimself formed the worlds and solar systems.
lines.transliteration: aapay khaan ee aapay ban ee aapay kh and varbh and karay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਖਾਣੀ  ਆਪੇ ਬਾਣੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਖੰਡ ਵਰਭੰਡ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the ocean, and He Himself is the sea; He Himself puts the pearls in it.
lines.transliteration: aap samund aap hai saagar aapay hee vich rat an Dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਸਮੁੰਦੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਰਤਨ  ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, the Lord enables the Gurmukh to find these pearls.
lines.transliteration: aap lahaa-ay karay jis kirpaa jis no gurmukh karay haray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਲਹਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the terrifying world-ocean, and He Himself is the boat; He Himself is theboatman, and He Himself ferries us across.
lines.transliteration: aapay bha-ojal aap hai bohithaa aapay kh ayvat aap t aray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes us to act; no one else can equal You, Lord. ||9|| slok mÚ 3 ] (552-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa avar na d oojaa t ujhai saray. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਤੁਝੈ ਸਰੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Fruitful is service to the True Guru, if one does so with a sincere mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa safal hai jay ko karay chit  laa-ay.

lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, is obtained, and the mind comes to be free of anxiety.
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paa-ee-ai achint  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ  ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, and the mind is rid of egotism and self- conceit.
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh  katee-ai ha-umai mamt aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: One achieves the ultimate state, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: utam pad vee paa-ee-ai sachay rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (552-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab jin ka-o likhi-aa t inaa sat gur mili-aa aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਤਮ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the boat in thisDark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: naam rataa sat guroo hai kalijug bohith ho-ay.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh crosses over; the True Lord dwells within him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so paar pavai jinaa and ar sachaa so-ay.

lines.english: He remembers the Naam, he gathers in the Naam, and he obtains honor through theNaam.
lines.transliteration: naam samHaalay naam sangrahai naamay hee pat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹੈ ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the True Guru; by His Grace, the Name is obtained. ||2|| pauVI ] (552-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur paa-i-aa karam paraapat  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਿਰ ਪਵੈ ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Philosopher's Stone, He Himself is the metal, and He Himself is transformed into gold.
lines.transliteration: aapay paaras aap Dhaat  hai aap keet on kanchan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, He Himself is the servant, and He Himself is theDestroyer of sins.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaakur sayvak aapay aapay hee paap kh andan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself enjoys every heart; the Lord Master Himself is the basis of all illusion.
lines.transliteration: aapay sabh gh at bhogvai su-aamee aapay hee sabh  anjan.

lines.english: He Himself is the discerning one, and He Himself is the Knower of all; He Himselfbreaks the bonds of the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: aap bibayk aap sabh bayt aa aapay gurmukh  bhanjan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਿਪ  ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is not satisfied by merely praising You, O Creator Lord; You are theGreat Giver of peace. ||10|| sloku mÚ 4 ] (552-14) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saalaahi na rajai tuDh  kartay too har sukh -daata vadan. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, the deeds which are done are only chains binding thesoul.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay jee-a kay banDh naa jayt ay karam kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, they find no place of rest. They die, only to be born again - they continue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay th avar na paavhee mar jameh aavahi jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਬਬੇਕੁ ਆਿਪ  ਸਭੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭੰਜਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, their speech is insipid. They do not enshrine theNaam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay fikaa boln aa naam na vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਨ ਰਜੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਵਡਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and gagged, and beaten inthe City of Death; they depart with blackened faces. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (552-16) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satgur sayvay jam pur baDh ay maaree-ah muhi kaalai uth  jaahi. ||1||

lines.english: Some wait upon and serve the True Guru; they embrace love for the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ik satgur kee sayvaa karahi chaakree har naamay lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ  ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they reform their lives, and redeem their generations as well. ||2|| pauVI ] (552-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak janam savaaran aapnaa kul kaa karan uDh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਠਵਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ  ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the school, He Himself is the teacher, and He Himself brings thestudents to be taught.
lines.transliteration: aapay chaatsaal aap hai paaDhaa aapay chaatrh ay parh an ka-o aan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਿਫਕਾ  ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the father, He Himself is the mother, and He Himself makes the childrenwise.
lines.transliteration: aapay pitaa maat aa hai aapay aapay baalak karay si-aan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲੈ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In one place, He teaches them to read and understand everything, while in another place, He Himself makes them ignorant.
lines.transliteration: ik thai parh bujh ai sabh  aapay ik thai aapay karay i-aan ay.

lines.english: Some, You summon to the Mansion of Your Presence within, when they are pleasing to Your Mind, O True Lord. pMnw 553
lines.transliteration: iknaa andar mahal bulaa-ay jaa aap t ayrai man sachay bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਏ  ਜਾ ਆਿਪ  ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: That Gurmukh, whom You have blessed with greatness - that humble being is known in Your True Court. ||11|| sloku mrdwnw 1 ] (553-2) salok mardaanaa 1. Shalok, Mardaanaa:
lines.transliteration: jinaa aapay gurmukh d ay vadi-aa-ee say jan sachee d argahi jaan ay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਜਾਣੇ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the vessel, filled with the wine of sexual desire; the mindis the drunkard.
lines.transliteration: kal kalvaalee kaam mad manoo-aa peevan haar.

lines.english: Anger is the cup, filled with emotional attachment, and egotism is the server.
lines.transliteration: kroDh katoree mohi bh aree peelaavaa ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲਵਾਲੀ  ਕਾਮੁ ਮਦੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: Drinking too much in the company of falsehood and greed, one is ruined.
lines.transliteration: majlas koorhay lab kee pee pee ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਮੋਿਹ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਵਾ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: So let good deeds be your distillery, and Truth your molasses; in this way, make themost excellent wine of Truth.
lines.transliteration: karnee laahan  sat gurh sach saraa kar saar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਜਲਸ  ਕੂੜੇ ਲਬ ਕੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Make virtue your bread, good conduct the ghee, and modesty the meat to eat.
lines.transliteration: gun manday kar seel gh i-o saram maas aahaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਲਾਹਿਣ  ਸਤੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, these are obtained, O Nanak; partaking of them, one's sins depart. ||1|| mrdwnw 1 ] (553-5) mardaanaa 1. Mardaanaa:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ee-ai naankaa kh aaDhai jaahi bikaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਮੰਡੇ ਕਿਰ ਸੀਲੁ  ਿਘਉ  ਸਰਮੁ  ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The human body is the vat, self-conceit is the wine, and desire is the company of drinking buddies.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa laahan aap mad  majlas t arisnaa Dh aat.

lines.english: The cup of the mind's longing is overflowing with falsehood, and the Messenger ofDeath is the cup-bearer.
lines.transliteration: mansaa katoree koorh bh aree peelaa-ay jamkaal.

lines.english: Drinking in this wine, O Nanak, one takes on countless sins and corruptions.
lines.transliteration: it mad  peetai naankaa bahut ay kh atee-ah bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਲਾਹਿਣ  ਆਪੁ  ਮਦੁ ਮਜਲਸ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.english: So make spiritual wisdom your molasses, the Praise of God your bread, and the Fearof God the meat you eat.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan gurh saalaah manday bh a-o maas aahaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ  ਕਟੋਰੀ  ਕੂਿੜ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਏ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this is the true food; let the True Name be your only Support. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak ih bhojan sach hai sach naam aaDh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਮਿਦ ਪੀਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਬਹੁਤੇ ਖਟੀਅਿਹ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: If the human body is the vat, and self-realization is the wine, then a stream ofAmbrosial Nectar is produced.
lines.transliteration: kaaNyaaN laahan aap mad  amrit  tis kee Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ  ਮੰਡੇ ਭਉ ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Society of the Saints, the cup of the Lord's Love is filled with this Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, one's corruptions and sins are wiped away. ||3|| pauVI ] (553-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: satsangat  si-o maylaap ho-ay liv katoree amrit  bharee pee pee kateh bikaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself is the angelic being, the heavenly herald, and the celestial singer. HeHimself is the one who explains the six schools of philosophy.
lines.transliteration: aapay sur nar gan ganDh arbaa aapay kh at darsan kee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਯ  ਲਾਹਿਣ  ਆਪੁ  ਮਦੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh; He Himself is the Gurmukh, who speaksthe Unspoken Speech.
lines.transliteration: aapay siv sankar mahaysaa aapay gurmukh akath kahaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਸਉ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ  ਹੋਇ ਿਲਵ  ਕਟੋਰੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭਰੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਕਟਿਹ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Yogi, He Himself is the Sensual Enjoyer, and He Himself is theSannyaasee, wandering through the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: aapay jogee aapay bhogee aapay sani-aasee firai bibaan ee.

lines.english: He discusses with Himself, and He teaches Himself; He Himself is discrete, graceful and wise.
lines.transliteration: aapai naal gosat aap updaysai aapay sugh arh saroop si-aan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Staging His own play, He Himself watches it; He Himself is the Knower of all beings.||12|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (553-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapnaa choj kar vaykh ai aapay aapay sabh naa jee-aa kaa hai jaan ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਵ ਸੰਕਰ  ਮਹੇਸਾ  ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: That evening prayer alone is acceptable, which brings the Lord God to my consciousness.
lines.transliteration: ayhaa sanDhi-aa parvaan  hai jit  har parabh  mayraa chit  aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਭੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਿਫਰੈ ਿਬਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Love for the Lord wells up within me, and my attachment to Maya is burnt away.
lines.transliteration: har si-o pareet oopjai maa-i-aa moh jalaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਗੋਸਿਟ ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਦੇਸੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਿਸਆਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, duality is conquered, and the mind becomes stable; I have made contemplative meditation my evening prayer.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee dubiDh aa marai manoo-aa asthir sanDh i-aa karay veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਚੋਜੁ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh may recite his evening prayers, but his mind is not centered on it; through birth and death, he is ruined. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (553-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sanDhi-aa karai manmukh ee jee-o na tikai mar jammai ho-ay kh u-aar. ||1||

lines.english: I wandered over the whole world, crying out, "Love, O Love!", but my thirst was notquenched.
lines.transliteration: pari-o pari-o kartee sabh  jag firee mayree pi-aas na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹਾ ਸੰਿਧਆ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, my desires are satisfied; I found my Beloved, whenI returned to my own home. ||2|| pauVI ] (553-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai mayree pi-aas ga-ee pir paa-i-aa gh ar aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the supreme essence, He Himself is the essence of all. He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant.
lines.transliteration: aapay tant  param t ant sabh  aapay aapay th aakur d aas bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਸੰਿਧਆ  ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the people of the eighteen castes; God Himself acquired Hisdomain.
lines.transliteration: aapay das ath  varan upaa-i-an aap barahm aap raaj la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਿਧਆ  ਕਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਨ ਿਟਕੈ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself kills, and He Himself redeems; He Himself, in His Kindness, forgives us. Heis infallible
lines.transliteration: aapay maaray aapay chhodai aapay bakh say karay d a-i-aa.

lines.english: - He never errs; the justice of the True Lord is totally True.
lines.transliteration: aap abhul na bh ulai kab hee sabh  sach t apaavas sach thi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਕਰਤੀ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਫਰੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs as Gurmukh - duality and doubt depart from within them. ||13|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (553-19) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay jinaa bujhaa-ay gurmukh  tin and rahu d oojaa bh aram ga-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਪਆਸ  ਗਈ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That body, which does not remember the Lord's Name in meditation in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be reduced to dust.
lines.transliteration: har naam na simrahi saaDhsang t ai tan udai kh ayh.

lines.english: Cursed and insipid is that body, O Nanak, which does not know the One who created it. ||1|| pMnw 554 mÚ 5 ] (554-1) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin keetee t isai na jaan -ee naanak fit aloon ee dayh. ||1||

lines.english: Let the Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within your heart, and with your tongue, chantGod's Name.
lines.transliteration: ghat vaseh charn aarbind  rasnaa japai gupaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate in remembrance on God, and nurture this body. ||2|| pauVI ] (554-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak so parabh simree-ai t is dayhee ka-o paal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਚਰਣਾਰਿਬੰਦ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਜਪੈ ਗੁ ਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself is the sixty-eight sacred places of pilgrimage; He Himself takesthe cleansing bath in them.
lines.transliteration: aapay athsath  tirath kart aa aap karay isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਸਮਰੀਐ  ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਪਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself practices austere self-discipline; the Lord Master Himself causes us tochant His Name.
lines.transliteration: aapay sanjam vartai savaamee aap japaa-ihi naam.

lines.english: He Himself becomes merciful to us; the Destroyer of fear Himself gives in charity toall.
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aal ho-ay bh a-o kh andan aap karai sabh  daan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: One whom He has enlightened and made Gurmukh, ever obtains honor in His Court.
lines.transliteration: jis no gurmukh aap bujh aa-ay so sad  hee d argahi paa-ay maan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਾਮੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਜਪਾਇਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: One whose honor the Lord Master has preserved, comes to know the True Lord. ||14|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (554-5) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis dee paij rakh ai har su-aamee so sachaa har jaan. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without meeting the True Guru, the world is blind, and it does blind deeds.
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satgur bh aytay jag anDh  hai anDh ay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਸੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: It does not focus its consciousness on the Word of the Shabad, which would bringpeace to abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: sabdai si-o chit  na laav-ee jit  sukh  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Always afflicted with the dark passions of low energy, it wanders around, passing itsdays and nights burning.
lines.transliteration: taamas lagaa sad aa firai ahinis jalat  bihaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; no one has any say in this. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (554-7) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੇਟੇ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has commanded us to do this:
lines.transliteration: satguroo furmaa-i-aa kaaree ayh karayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਨ ਲਾਵਈ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo du-aarai ho-ay kai saahib sammaalayhu. through the Guru's Gate, meditate on the Lord Master.

lines.english: The Lord Master is ever-present. He tears away the veil of doubt, and installs His Light within the mind.
lines.transliteration: saahib sadaa hajoor hai bh armai kay chh a-urh  kat kai ant ar jot  Dharayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar - take this healing medicine!
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam amrit hai d aaroo ayhu laa-ayhu.

lines.english: Enshrine the Will of the True Guru in your consciousness, and make the True Lord'sLove your self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa chit  rakhahu sanjam sachaa nayhu.

lines.english: O Nanak, you shall be kept in peace here, and hereafter, you shall celebrate with the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (554-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak aithai sukhai and ar rakh see agai har si-o kayl karayhu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੰਮਾਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the vast variety of Nature, and He Himself makes it bear fruit.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhaar ath aarah ban aspat  aapay hee fal laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ  ਕੇ ਛਉੜ  ਕਿਟ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Gardener, He Himself irrigates all the plants, and He Himself putsthem in His mouth.
lines.transliteration: aapay maalee aap sabh sinchai aapay hee muhi paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਏਹੁ ਲਾਏਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself gives, and causesothers to give.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa aapay bh ugtaa aapay d ay-ay d ivaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਰਖਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the Protector; He Himself is permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: aapay saahib aapay hai raakhaa aapay rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਖਸੀ  ਅਗੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak speaks of the greatness of the Lord, the Creator, who has no greed atall. ||15|| slok mÚ 3 ] (554-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak vadi-aa-ee aakhai har kart ay kee jis no t il na t amaa-ay. ||15||

lines.english: One person brings a full bottle, and another fills his cup.
lines.transliteration: maanas bh ari-aa aan i-aa maan as bh ari-aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ  ਬਣਸਪਿਤ  ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking the wine, his intelligence departs, and madness enters his mind;
lines.transliteration: jit peet ai mat  door ho-ay baral pavai vich aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਲੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਭੁ ਿਸੰਚੈ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਮੁਿਹ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapnaa paraa-i-aa na pachh aan-ee kh asmahu Dh akay kh aa-ay. he cannot distinguish between his own and others, and he is struck down by his Lordand Master.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਿਦਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking it, he forgets his Lord and Master, and he is punished in the Court of theLord.
lines.transliteration: jit peet ai khasam visrai d argeh milai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੈ ਰਾਖਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Do not drink the false wine at all, if it is in your power.
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa mad  mool na peech-ee jay kaa paar vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਆਖੈ  ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਏ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets the mortal; by His Grace, one obtains theTrue Wine.
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree sach mad  paa-ee-ai sat gur milai jis aa-ay.

lines.english: He shall dwell forever in the Love of the Lord Master, and obtain a seat in the Mansion of His Presence. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (554-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa saahib kai rang rahai mahlee paavai thaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸੁ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਆਿਣਆ  ਮਾਣਸੁ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: When this world comes to understand, it remains dead while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: ih jagat jeevat  marai jaa is no sojh ee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਿਤ ਦੂਿਰ ਹੋਇ ਬਰਲੁ  ਪਵੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord puts him to sleep, he remains asleep; when He wakes him up, heregains consciousness.
lines.transliteration: jaa tiniH savaali-aa t aaN sav rahi-aa jagaa-ay t aaN suDh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਪਰਾਇਆ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ  ਖਸਮਹੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He causes him to meet the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar karay jay aapn ee sat gur maylai so-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, remain dead while yet alive, and you shall not have to die again.||2|| pauVI ] (554-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jeevat  marai t aa fir maran  na ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਪੀਚਈ  ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਿਰ  ਵਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By His doing, everything happens; what does He care for anyone else?
lines.transliteration: jis daa keet aa sabh  kichh  hovai t is no parvaah naahee kisai kayree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਸਚੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, everyone eats whatever You give - all are subservient to You. pMnw 555
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tayraa d itaa sabh  ko kh aavai sabh  muht aajee kadh ai tayree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਦਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ  ਕਢੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: One who praises You obtains everything; You bestow Your Mercy upon him, O Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: je tuDh  no saalaahay so sabh  kichh  paavai jis no kirpaa niranjan kayree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ  ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਵੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਕੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: He alone is a true banker and trader, who loads the merchandise of the wealth of theYour Name, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: so-ee saahu sachaa vanjaaraa jin vakh ar lad i-aa har naam Dh an tayree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਵਖਰੁ ਲਿਦਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: O Saints, let everyone praise the Lord, who has destroyed the pile of the love ofduality. ||16|| slok ] (555-3) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: sabh t isai no saalaahihu sant ahu jin d oojay bh aav kee maar vidaaree dh ayree. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਤਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਿਹਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਵਡਾਰੀ  ਢੇਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the world is dying - dying to death, but no one knows how to truly die.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa martaa mart aa jag mu-aa mar bh e na jaanai ko-ay.

lines.english: Whoever dies, let him die such a death, that he does not have to die again. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (555-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aisee marnee jo marai bahur na marnaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਮਰਤਾ  ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ  ਮਿਰ ਿਭ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: What do I know? How will I die? What sort of death will it be?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jaanaa kiv marhagay kaisaa marn aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਮਰਨੀ  ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: If I do not forget the Lord Master from my mind, then my death will be easy.
lines.transliteration: jay kar saahib manhu na veesrai taa sahilaa marn aa ho-ay.

lines.english: The world is terrified of death; everyone longs to live.
lines.transliteration: marnai t ay jagat  darai jeevi-aa lorh ai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one who dies while yet alive, understands the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jeevat marai hukmai boojh ai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਤਾ ਸਿਹਲਾ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who dies such a death, lives forever. ||2|| pauVI ] (555-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak aisee marnee jo marai taa sad  jeevan  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣੈ  ਤੇ ਜਗਤੁ  ਡਰੈ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਲੋੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the Lord Master Himself becomes merciful, the Lord Himself causes His Name to be chanted.
lines.transliteration: jaa aap kirpaal hovai har su-aamee taa aapn aaN naa-o har aap japaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself causes us to meet the True Guru, and blesses us with peace. His servant ispleasing to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur mayl sukh  dayvai aapn aaN sayvak aap har bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਐਸੀ  ਮਰਨੀ  ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He causes others to fall at the feet ofHis devotees.
lines.transliteration: aapni-aa sayvkaa kee aap paij rakh ai aapn i-aa bh agtaa kee pairee paavai.

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay hai har kaa kee-aa har jan sayvak nayrh  na aavai. The Righteous Judge of Dharma is a creation of the Lord; he does not approach thehumble servant of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਾ ਆਪਣ  ਨਾਉ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ ਜਪਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: ||17|| One who is dear to the Lord, is dear to all; so many others come and go in vain.||17|| slok mÚ 3 ] (555-10) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo har kaa pi-aaraa so sabhnaa kaa pi-aaraa hor kayt ee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਣ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The entire world roams around, chanting, "Raam, Raam, Lord, Lord", but the Lordcannot be obtained like this.
lines.transliteration: raam raam kartaa sabh  jag firai raam na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਿਣਆ  ਸੇਵਕਾ  ਕੀ ਆਿਪ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿਣਆ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and so very great; He is unweighable, and cannot beweighed.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar at vadaa at ul na t uli-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: No one can evaluate Him; He cannot be purchased at any price.
lines.transliteration: keemat kinai na paa-ee-aa kit ai na la-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸੋ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ  ਝਿਖ ਝਿਖ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His mystery is known; in this way, He comesto dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bh aydi-aa in biDh  vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself is infinite; by Guru's Grace, He is known to be permeating andpervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: naanak aap amay-o hai gur kirpaa tay rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਫਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself comes to blend, and having blended, remains blended. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (555-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay mili-aa mil rahi-aa aapay mili-aa aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਿਤ  ਵਡਾ ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਨ ਤੁਿਲਆ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my soul, this is the wealth of the Naam; through it, comes peace, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: ay man ih Dhan naam hai jit  sadaa sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਲਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It never brings any loss; through it, one earns profits forever.
lines.transliteration: totaa mool na aavee laahaa sad  hee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭੇਿਦਆ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਵਿਸਆ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Eating and spending it, it never decreases; He continues to give, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: khaaDh ai kharchi-ai t ot na aavee sad aa sad aa oh d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਮੇਉ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who has no skepticism at all never suffers humiliation.
lines.transliteration: sahsaa mool na hova-ee haanat  kaday na ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Lord, when the Lord bestows HisGlance of Grace. ||2|| pauVI ] (555-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paa-ee-ai jaa ka-o nad ar karay-i. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is deep within all hearts, and He Himself is outside them.
lines.transliteration: aapay sabh gh at and ray aapay hee baahar.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is prevailing unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.
lines.transliteration: aapay gupat varatd aa aapay hee jaahar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: For thirty-six ages, He created the darkness, abiding in the void.
lines.transliteration: jug chhat eeh gubaar kar vart i-aa sunnaahar.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਧੈ ਖਰਿਚਐ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: There were no Vedas, Puraanas or Shaastras there; only the Lord Himself existed.
lines.transliteration: othai vayd puraan na saast aa aapay har narhar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਹਾਣਤ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself sat in the absolute trance, withdrawn from everything.
lines.transliteration: baithaa t aarhee laa-ay aap sabh  doo hee baahar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Only He Himself knows His state; He Himself is the unfathomable ocean. ||18|| slok mÚ 3 ] (555-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapnee mit  aap jaand aa aapay hee ga-uhar. ||18||

lines.english: In egotism, the world is dead; it dies and dies, again and again. pMnw 556
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich jagat mu-aa mard o mard aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: As long as there is breath in the body, he does not remember the Lord; what will he do in the world hereafter?
lines.transliteration: jichar vich damm hai t ichar na chayt -ee ke karayg agai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਚਰੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਚਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ  ਿਕ ਕਰੇਗੁ  ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who remembers the Lord is a spiritual teacher; the ignorant one acts blindly.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee ho-ay so chaytann ho-ay agi-aanee anDh  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਚੇਤੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whatever one does in this world, determines what he shall receive in theworld hereafter. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (556-2) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aythai kamaavai so milai agai paa-ay jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhur kh asmai kaa hukam pa-i-aa vin  satgur chayt i-aa na jaa-ay. From the very beginning, it has been the Will of the Lord Master, that He cannot beremembered without the True Guru.
Meeting the True Guru, he realizes that the Lord is permeating and pervading deepwithin him; he remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai ant ar rav rahi-aa sad aa rahi-aa liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਖਸਮੈ  ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚੇਿਤਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, he constantly remembers the Lord in meditation; not asingle breath passes in vain.
lines.transliteration: dam d am sad aa samaald aa damm na birthaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His fears of birth and death depart, and he obtains the honored state of eternal life.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa bha-o ga-i-aa jeevan pad vee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਮ ਦਿਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਦਾ  ਦੰਮੁ ਨ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He bestows this rank upon that mortal, upon whom He showers His Mercy.||2|| pauVI ] (556-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ih martabaa t is no d ay-ay jis no kirpaa karay rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is all-wise and all-knowing; He Himself is supreme.
lines.transliteration: aapay daanaaN beeni-aa aapay parDh aanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਮਰਤਬਾ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself reveals His form, and He Himself enjoins us to His meditation.
lines.transliteration: aapay roop dikh aaldaa aapay laa-ay Dh i-aanaaN.

lines.english: He Himself poses as a silent sage, and He Himself speaks spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: aapay monee varatdaa aapay kathai gi-aanaaN.

lines.english: He does not seem bitter to anyone; He is pleasing to all.
lines.transliteration: ka-urhaa kisai na lag-ee sabh naa hee bh aanaa.

lines.english: His Praises cannot be described; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||19|| slok mÚ 1 ] (556-8) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ustat baran na sakee-ai sad  sad kurbaanaa. ||19||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, the demons have taken birth.
lines.transliteration: kalee andar naankaa jinnaaN daa a-ut aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉੜਾ  ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਹੀ ਭਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The son is a demon, and the daughter is a demon; the wife is the chief of thedemons. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (556-9) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: put jinooraa Dh ee-a jinnooree joroo jinna d aa sikd aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਕੀਐ  ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The Hindus have forgotten the Primal Lord; they are going the wrong way.
lines.transliteration: hindoo moolay bh oolay akh utee jaaNhee.

lines.english: As Naarad instructed them, they are worshipping idols. They are blind and mute, theblindest of the blind.
lines.transliteration: naarad kahi-aa se pooj karaaNhee. anDh ay gungay anDh  anDh aar.

lines.english: The ignorant fools pick up stones and worship them.
lines.transliteration: paathar lay poojeh mugaDh gavaar.

lines.english: But when those stones themselves sink, who will carry you across? ||2|| pauVI ] (556-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ohi jaa aap dubay tum kahaa t aranhaar. ||2||

lines.english: Everything is in Your power; You are the True King.
lines.transliteration: sabh kihu t ayrai vas hai t oo sachaa saahu.

lines.english: The devotees are imbued with the Love of the One Lord; they have perfect faith in Him.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  ratay rang ayk kai pooraa vaysaahu.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the ambrosial food; His humble servants eat their fill.
lines.transliteration: amrit bh ojan naam har raj raj jan kh aahu.

lines.english: All treasures are obtained - meditative remembrance on the Lord is the true profit.
lines.transliteration: sabh pad aarath paa-ee-an simran  sach laahu.

lines.english: The Saints are very dear to the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak; the Lord isunapproachable and unfathomable. ||20|| slok mÚ 3 ] (556-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant pi-aaray paarbarahm naanak har agam agaahu. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਹ ਜਾ ਆਿਪ ਡੁਬੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਾ ਤਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Everything comes by the Lord's Will, and everything goes by the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  hukmay aavd aa sabh  kichh  hukmay jaa-ay.

lines.english: If some fool believes that he is the creator, he is blind, and acts in blindness.
lines.transliteration: jay ko moorakh aaphu jaan ai anDh aa anDh  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਹੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the Lord showers His Mercy upon him. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (556-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam ko gurmukh bujh ai jis no kirpaa karay rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਰਤੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone is a Yogi, and he alone finds the Way, who, as Gurmukh, obtains the Naam.
lines.transliteration: so jogee jugat so paa-ay jis no gurmukh  naam paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਜ ਰਿਜ ਜਨ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: In the body-village of that Yogi are all blessings; this Yoga is not obtained by outwardshow.
lines.transliteration: tis jogee kee nagree sabh  ko vasai bh aykhee jog na ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, such a Yogi is very rare; the Lord is manifest in his heart. ||2|| pauVI ] (556-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak aisaa virlaa ko jogee jis ghat pargat ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: He Himself created the creatures, and He Himself supports them.
lines.transliteration: aapay jant upaa-i-an aapay aaDh aar.

lines.english: He Himself is seen to be subtle, and He Himself is obvious.
lines.transliteration: aapay sookham bh aalee-ai aapay paasaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਦਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself remains a solitary recluse, and He Himself has a huge family.
lines.transliteration: aap ikaatee ho-ay rahai aapay vad parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak asks for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai daan har sant aa raynaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੋ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ ਬੁਝੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cannot see any other Giver; You alone are the Giver, O Lord. ||21||1|| Sudh|| pMnw 557 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (557-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu vfhMsu mhlw 1 Gru 1 ] (557-3) raag vad-hans mehlaa 1 ghar 1. Raag Wadahans, First Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: hor daat aar na sujh -ee too dayvan haar. ||21||1|| suDh .

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: To the addict, there is nothing like the drug; to the fish, there is nothing else likewater.
lines.transliteration: amlee amal na ambrhai machh ee neer na ho-ay.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to their Lord - everyone is pleasing to them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo ratay seh aapn ai tin bhaavai sabh  ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਲੀ  ਅਮਲੁ  ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ  ਮਛੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, cut apart into pieces, a sacrifice to Your Name, O Lord Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree vanjaa kh annee-ai vanj aa ta-o saahib kay naavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਿਹ ਆਪਣੈ  ਿਤਨ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is the fruitful tree; His Name is ambrosial nectar.
lines.transliteration: saahib safli-o rukh-rh aa amrit  jaa kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਵੰਞਾ ਤਉ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who drink it in are satisfied; I am a sacrifice to them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin pee-aa tay t aripat  bha-ay ha-o t in balihaarai jaa-o. ||2||

lines.english: You are not visible to me, although You dwell with everyone.
lines.transliteration: mai kee nadar na aavhee vaseh habh ee-aaN naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਰੁਖੜਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: How can the thirst of the thirsty be quenched, with that wall between me and thepond? ||3||
lines.transliteration: tikhaa tihaa-i-aa ki-o lahai jaa sar bh eetar paal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਪੀਆ  ਤੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤ  ਭਏ ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak is Your merchant; You, O Lord Master, are my merchandise.
lines.transliteration: naanak tayraa baan ee-aa t oo saahib mai raas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਕੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਹੀ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਹਭੀਆਂ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is cleansed of doubt, only when I praise You, and pray to You. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 ] (557-8) vad-hans mehlaa 1. Wadahans, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man tay Dh okhaa taa lahai jaa sifat  karee ard aas. ||4||1||

lines.english: The virtuous bride enjoys her Husband Lord; why does the unworthy one cry out?
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee saho raavi-aa nirgun  kookay kaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਬਾਣੀਆ  ਤੂ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮੈ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: If she were to become virtuous, then she too could enjoy her Husband Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jay gunvant ee thee rahai t aa bh ee saho raavan  jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੋਖਾ ਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord is loving and playful; why should the soul-bride enjoy anyone else? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayraa kant reesaaloo kee Dh an avraa raavay jee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If the soul-bride does good deeds, and strings them on the thread of her mind,
lines.transliteration: karnee kaaman  jay thee-ai jay man Dh aagaa ho-ay.
maanak mul na paa-ee-ai leejai chit  paro-ay. ||2|| she obtains the jewel, which cannot be purchased for any price, strung upon thethread of her consciousness. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ  ਥੀ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I ask, but do not follow the way shown to me; still, I claim to have reached mydestination.
lines.transliteration: raahu dasaa-ee na julaaN aakh aaN ambrh ee-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ  ਕੀ ਧਨ ਅਵਰਾ  ਰਾਵੇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not speak with You, O my Husband Lord; how then can I come to have a place inYour home? ||3||
lines.transliteration: tai sah naal akoo-an aa ki-o theevai gh ar vaas. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, without the One Lord, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: naanak aykee baahraa doojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਾਮਣ  ਜੇ ਥੀਐ  ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਗਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If the soul-bride remains attached to You, then she shall enjoy her Husband Lord.||4||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 Gru 2 ] (557-13) vad-hans mehlaa 1 ghar 2. Wadahans, First Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: tai sah lagee jay rahai bh ee saho raavai so-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਮੁਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਲੀਜੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਪਰੋਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The peacocks are singing so sweetly, O sister; the rainy season of Saawan has come.
lines.transliteration: moree run jh un laa-i-aa bh ainay saavan  aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਈ  ਨ ਜੁਲ  ਆਖ  ਅੰਮੜੀਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Your beauteous eyes are like a string of charms, fascinating and enticing the soul- bride.
lines.transliteration: tayray munDh  kataaray jayvdaa t in lobh ee lobh  lubhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਿਲ  ਅਕੂਅਣਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਥੀਵੈ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I would cut myself into pieces for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I am a sacrificeto Your Name.
lines.transliteration: tayray d arsan vitahu kh annee-ai vanj aa tayray naam vitahu kurbaan o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I take pride in You; without You, what could I be proud of?
lines.transliteration: jaa too t aa mai maan  kee-aa hai t uDh bin kayhaa mayraa maan o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਲਗੀ  ਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: So smash your bracelets along with your bed, O soul-bride, and break your arms,along with the arms of your couch.
lines.transliteration: choorhaa bh ann palangh  si-o munDh ay san  baahee san  baahaa.

lines.english: In spite of all the decorations which you have made, O soul-bride, your Husband Lord is enjoying someone else. pMnw 558
lines.transliteration: aytay vays karayd ee-ay munDh ay saho raat o avraahaa.

lines.english: You don't have the bracelets of gold, nor the good crystal jewelry; you haven't dealt with the true jeweller.
lines.transliteration: naa manee-aar na choorhee-aa naa say vangoorh ee-aahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਨੀਆਰੁ ਨ ਚੂੜੀਆ  ਨਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਗੁੜੀਆਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those arms, which do not embrace the neck of the Husband Lord, burn in anguish.
lines.transliteration: jo sah kanth na lagee-aa jalan se bahrh ee-aahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਜਲਨੁ ਿਸ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: All my companions have gone to enjoy their Husband Lord; which door should I, the wretched one, go to?
lines.transliteration: sabh sahee-aa saho raavan  ga-ee-aa ha-o d aaDhee kai d ar jaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸਹੀਆ  ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਣ  ਗਈਆ  ਹਉ ਦਾਧੀ  ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਜਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: O friend, I may look very attractive, but I am not pleasing to my Husband Lord at all.
lines.transliteration: ammaalee ha-o kharee suchjee t ai sah ayk na bh aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਚਜੀ  ਤੈ ਸਹ ਏਿਕ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have woven my hair into lovely braids, and saturated their partings with vermillion;
lines.transliteration: maath guNdaa-eeN patee-aa bh aree-ai maag sanDh ooray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਠ  ਗੁੰਦਾਈ ਪਟੀਆ  ਭਰੀਐ  ਮਾਗ  ਸੰਧੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: agai ga-ee na mannee-aa mara-o visoor visooray. but when I go before Him, I am not accepted, and I die, suffering in anguish.

lines.english: I weep; the whole world weeps; even the birds of the forest weep with me.
lines.transliteration: mai rovandee sabh  jag runaa runnrh ay van hu pankh ayroo.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਰੋਵੰਦੀ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਰੁਨਾ ਰੁੰਨੜੇ ਵਣਹੁ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ  ॥
lines.english: The only thing which doesn't weep is my body's sense of separateness, which hasseparated me from my Lord.
lines.transliteration: ik na runaa mayray tan kaa birhaa jin ha-o pirahu vichh orhee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਨ ਰੁਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਿਬਰਹਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਉ ਿਪਰਹੁ ਿਵਛੋੜੀ  ॥
lines.english: In a dream, He came, and went away again; I cried so many tears.
lines.transliteration: supnai aa-i-aa bhee ga-i-aa mai jal bh ari-aa ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਆਇਆ  ਭੀ ਗਇਆ  ਮੈ ਜਲੁ ਭਿਰਆ  ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I can't come to You, O my Beloved, and I can't send anyone to You.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na sakaa tujh  kan pi-aaray bh ayj na sakaa ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਨ ਸਕਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਿਨ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਭੇਿਜ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Come to me, O blessed sleep - perhaps I will see my Husband Lord again.
lines.transliteration: aa-o sabhaagee need -rhee-ay mat  saho d aykhaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਉ  ਸਭਾਗੀ  ਨੀਦੜੀਏ  ਮਤੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One who brings me a message from my Lord and Master - says Nanak, what shall I give to Him?
lines.transliteration: tai saahib kee baat  je aakh ai kaho naanak ki-aa d eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਿਜ ਆਖੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਆ  ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Cutting off my head, I give it to Him to sit upon; without my head, I shall still serveHim.
lines.transliteration: sees vadhay kar baisan  deejai vin  sir sayv kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਸੁ ਵਢੇ ਕਿਰ ਬੈਸਣੁ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਿਸਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Why haven't I died? Why hasn't my life just ended? My Husband Lord has become astranger to me. ||1||3|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 Gru 1  (558-9) vad-hans mehlaa 3 ghar 1 Wadahans, Third Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (558-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ki-o na mareejai jee-arhaa na d eejai jaa saho bh a-i-aa vidaan aa. ||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ  ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਨ ਦੀਜੈ  ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਭਇਆ  ਿਵਡਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: When the mind is filthy, everything is filthy; by washing the body, the mind is notcleaned.
lines.transliteration: man mailai sabh kichh  mailaa t an Dh otai man hachh aa na ho-ay.

lines.english: This world is deluded by doubt; how rare are those who understand this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih jagat bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa virlaa boojh ai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੈਲਾ  ਤਿਨ ਧੋਤੈ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the One Name.
lines.transliteration: jap man mayray too ayko naam.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਜਗਤੁ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru has given me this treasure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur d ee-aa mo ka-o ayhu niDh aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Even if one learns the Yogic postures of the Siddhas, and holds his sexual energy in check,
lines.transliteration: siDhaa kay aasan  jay sikh ai ind ree vas kar kamaa-ay.
man kee mail na utrai ha-umai mail na jaa-ay. ||2|| still, the filth of the mind is not removed, and the filth of egotism is not eliminated.||2||

lines.english: This mind is not controlled by any other discipline, except the Sanctuary of the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o hor sanjam ko naahee vin sat gur kee sarn aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧਾ  ਕੇ ਆਸਣ ਜੇ ਿਸਖੈ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਵਿਸ ਕਿਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one is transformed beyond description. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai ultee bh a-ee kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, one who dies upon meeting the True Guru, shall be rejuvenated throughthe Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak sat gur ka-o mild o marai gur kai sabad  fir jeevai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of his attachment and possessiveness shall depart, and his mind shallbecome pure. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (558-15) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mamtaa kee mal ut rai ih man hachh aa ho-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਉਲਟੀ  ਭਈ ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By His Grace, one serves the True Guru; by His Grace, service is performed.
lines.transliteration: nadree sat gur sayvee-ai nad ree sayvaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਣਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਉ ਿਮਲਦੋ  ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਫਿਰ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By His grace, this mind is controlled, and by His Grace, it becomes pure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nadree ih man vas aavai nad ree man nirmal ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਮਤਾ  ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, think of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man chayt sachaa so-ay.

lines.english: Think of the One Lord, and you shall obtain peace; you shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayko cheeteh t aa sukh  paavahi fir d ookh na moolay ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਰੀ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, one dies while yet alive, and by His Grace, the Word of the Shabad isenshrined in the mind.
lines.transliteration: nadree mar kai jeevee-ai nad ree sabad  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਰੀ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਸ ਆਵੈ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By His Grace, one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and by HisCommand, one merges into the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nadree hukam bujh ee-ai hukmay rahai samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: That tongue, which does not savor the sublime essence of the Lord - may that tonguebe burned off!
lines.transliteration: jin jihvaa har ras na chakhi-o saa jihvaa jal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: It remains attached to other pleasures, and through the love of duality, it suffers inpain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an ras saaday lag rahee d ukh paa-i-aa d oojai bh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The One Lord grants His Grace to all; He Himself makes distinctions.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa nad ar ayk hai aapay farak karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਰੀ  ਮਿਰ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, the fruits are obtained, and one is blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||4||2|| pMnw 559 vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (559-1) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai fal paa-i-aa naam vadaa-ee d ay-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is darkness; without the Guru, there is no wisdom.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh gubaar hai gur bin gi-aan na ho-ee.

lines.english: Those who are attached to the Word of the Shabad understand; duality has ruined thepeople. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabad lagay t in bujh i-aa d oojai paraj vigo-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, under Guru's Instruction, do good deeds.
lines.transliteration: man mayray gurmat karn ee saar.

lines.english: Dwell forever and ever upon the Lord God, and you shall find the gate of salvation.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har parabh  raveh t aa paavahi mokh  du-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord alone is the treasure of virtue; He Himself gives, and then one receives.
lines.transliteration: gunaa kaa niDh aan ayk hai aapay d ay-ay t aa ko paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
