lines.english: Without the Name, all are separated from the Lord; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, one meets the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh vichh urhee gur kai sabad  milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Acting in ego, they lose, and nothing comes into their hands.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree karday gh at ga-ay t inaa hath kihu na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਾ  ਕਾ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, they find Truth, and merge into the True Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai sach milay sach naam samaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Hope and desire abide in this body, but the Lord's Light shines within as well.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa ayhu sareer hai antar jot  jagaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਦੇ  ਘਿਟ ਗਏ ਿਤਨਾ  ਹਿਥ ਿਕਹੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs remain in bondage; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||4||3|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (559-7) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh banDh  hai gurmukh  mukat  karaa-ay. ||4||3||

lines.english: The faces of the happy soul-brides are radiant forever; through the Guru, they arepeacefully poised.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee sad aa mukh  ujlaa gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ  ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਜਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They enjoy their Husband Lord constantly, eradicating their ego from within. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa pir raaveh aapn aa vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਏ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man too har har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru has led me to understand the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur mo ka-o har d ee-aa bujh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The abandoned brides cry out in their suffering; they do not attain the Mansion of theLord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: duhaagan ee kh aree-aa billaad ee-aa t inaa mahal na paa-ay.

lines.english: In the love of duality, they appear so ugly; they suffer in pain as they go to the worldbeyond. ||2||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay karoopee d ookh paavahi aagai jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous soul-bride constantly chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord; she enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within her heart.
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee nit  gun ravai hird ai naam vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The unvirtuous woman suffers, and cries out in pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: a-uganvant ee kaamn ee dukh laagai billaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The One Lord and Master is the Husband Lord of all; His Praises cannot be expressed.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa bh ataar ayk hai su-aamee kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, He has separated some from Himself, while others are to His Name. ||4||4|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (559-12) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay vayk keeti-an naamay la-i-an laa-ay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਕਰੂਪੀ  ਦੂਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ ਆਗੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is always sweet to me; through the Word of theGuru's Shabad, I come to taste it.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad  meeth aa laagaa gur sabd ee saad  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, I am merged in peace and poise; the DearLord is enshrined in the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sahj samaan ee har jee-o man vasaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord, showing His Mercy, has caused me to meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kar kirpaa satguroo milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect True Guru, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਕ ਕੀਿਤਅਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Through Brahma, the hymns of the Vedas were revealed, but the love of Maya spread.
lines.transliteration: barahmai bayd ban ee pargaasee maa-i-aa moh pasaaraa.

lines.english: The wise one, Shiva, remains absorbed in himself, but he is engrossed in dark passions and excessive egotism. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mahaaday-o gi-aanee vart ai ghar aapn ai taamas bahut  ahaNkaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Vishnu is always busy reincarnating himself - who will save the world?
lines.transliteration: kisan sadaa avt aaree rooDh aa kit  lag tarai sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with spiritual wisdom in this age; they are rid of thedarkness of emotional attachment. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan rat ay jug ant ar chookai moh gubaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one is emancipated; the Gurmukh crosses over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa t ay nist aaraa gurmukh  tarai sansaaraa.

lines.english: The detached renunciates are imbued with the True Name; they attain the gate ofsalvation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saachai naa-ay ratay bairaagee paa-in mokh  du-aaraa. ||4||

lines.english: The One True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; He cherishes everyone.
lines.transliteration: ayko sach vartai sabh  antar sabh naa karay part ipaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੈ  ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ  ਪਰਗਾਸੀ  ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the One Lord, I do not know any other; He is the Merciful Master ofall. ||5||5|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (559-19) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ikas bin mai avar na jaanaa sabh naa d eevaan d a-i-aalaa. ||5||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਤਾਮਸੁ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh practices true self-discipline, and attains the essence of wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach sanjam t at gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰੂਧਾ ਿਕਤੁ  ਲਿਗ  ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the True Lord. ||1|| pMnw 560
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachay lagai Dh i-aan. ||1||

lines.english: As Gurmukh, O my mind, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man mayray naam samaal.

lines.english: It shall stand by you always, and go with you. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa nibhai chalai t ayrai naal. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The True Lord is the social status and honor of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaat  pat sach so-ay.

lines.english: Within the Gurmukh, is God, his friend and helper. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar sakh aa-ee parabh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He alone becomes Gurmukh, whom the Lord so blesses.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jis no aap karay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with greatness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap vadaa-ee d ayvai so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Gurmukh lives the True Word of the Shabad, and practices good deeds.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  sach karn ee saar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, emancipates his family and relations. ||4||6|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (560-4) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak parvaarai saaDh aar. ||4||6||

lines.english: My tongue is intuitively attracted to the taste of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har saad lagee sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: My mind is satisfied, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man taript i-aa har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਿਦ  ਲਗੀ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Lasting peace is obtained, contemplating the Shabad, the True Word of God.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh  saachai sabad  veechaaree.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapnay sat gur vitahu sad aa balihaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My eyes are content, lovingly focused on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: akhee sant okhee-aa ayk liv laa-ay.

lines.english: My mind is content, having forsaken the love of duality. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man santokh i-aa d oojaa bh aa-o gavaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The frame of my body is at peace, through the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dayh sareer sukh  hovai sabad  har naa-ay.

lines.english: The fragrance of the Naam permeates my heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam parmal hirdai rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, one who has such great destiny written upon his forehead,
lines.transliteration: naanak mastak jis vadbh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||7|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (560-8) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee sahj bairaag. ||4||7|| through the Bani of the Guru's Word, easily and intuitively becomes free of desire.

lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay naam paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the True Word of God, one merges in the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sach samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my soul, obtain the treasure of the Naam,
lines.transliteration: ay man naam niDhaan t oo paa-ay.
aapnay gur kee man lai rajaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. by submitting to the Will of your Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, filth is washed away from within.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad vichahu mail gavaa-ay.

lines.english: The Immaculate Naam comes to abide within the mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam vasai man aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, the world wanders around.
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa firai sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It dies, and is born again, and is ruined by the Messenger of Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mar janmai jam karay khu-aar. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak say vadbhaagee jin har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Name within their minds. ||4||8|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (560-12) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasaa-i-aa. ||4||8||

lines.english: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai naavai naal viroDh hai d u-ay na vaseh ik th aa-ay.

lines.english: In egotism, selfless service cannot be performed, and so the soul goes unfulfilled.||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich sayvaa na hova-ee taa man birthaa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, think of the Lord, and practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har chayt man mayray t oo gur kaa sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.english: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with theLord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hukam maneh taa har milai t aa vichahu ha-umai jaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Egotism is within all bodies; through egotism, we come to be born.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai sabh sareer hai ha-umai opat  ho-ay.

lines.english: Egotism is total darkness; in egotism, no one can understand anything. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vadaa gubaar hai ha-umai vich bujh na sakai ko-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਵਰੋਧੁ  ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਿਹ  ਇਕ ਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In egotism, devotional worship cannot be performed, and the Hukam of the Lord's Command cannot be understood.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich bhagat  na hova-ee hukam na bujh i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In egotism, the soul is in bondage, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does notcome to abide in the mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich jee-o banDh hai naam na vasai man aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, egotism is eliminated, and then, the True Lordcomes to dwell in the mind||
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai ha-umai ga-ee t aa sach vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਹ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One starts practicing truth, abides in truth and by serving the True One gets absorbedin Him. ||4||9||12|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 Gru 1  (560-18) vad-hans mehlaa 4 ghar 1 Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (560-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sach kamaavai sach rahai sachay sayv samaa-ay. ||4||9||12||

lines.english: There is one bed, and One Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sayj ayk ayko parabh th aakur.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਓਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh enjoys the Lord, the ocean of peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har raavay sukh  saagar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਵਡਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਬੁਿਝ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind longs to meet my Beloved Lord. pMnw 561
lines.transliteration: mai parabh milan  paraym man aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਲਾਵੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru leads me to meet my Beloved; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to myGuru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa maylaavai mayraa pareetam ha-o vaar vaar aapn ay guroo ka-o jaasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My body is over-flowing with corruption;
lines.transliteration: mai avgan bh arpoor sareeray.
ha-o ki-o kar milaa apnay pareet am pooray. ||2|| how can I meet my Perfect Beloved? ||2||

lines.english: The virtuous ones obtain my Beloved;
lines.transliteration: jin gunvant ee mayraa pareet am paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I do not have these virtues. How can I meet Him, O my mother? ||3||
lines.transliteration: say mai gun naahee ha-o ki-o milaa mayree maa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਉ ਿਕਉ  ਿਮਲਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am so tired of making all these efforts.
lines.transliteration: ha-o kar kar thaakaa upaav bahutayray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਥਾਕਾ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Please protect Nanak, the meek one, O my Lord. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 ] (561-4) vad-hans mehlaa 4. Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gareeb raakho har mayray. ||4||1||

lines.english: My Lord God is so beautiful. I do not know His worth.
lines.transliteration: mayraa har parabh sund ar mai saar na jaan ee.

lines.english: Abandoning my Lord God, I have become entangled in duality. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-o har parabh chh od doojai lobh aanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: How can I meet with my Husband? I don't know.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ki-o kar pir ka-o mila-o i-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਛੋਿਡ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: She who pleases her Husband Lord is a happy soul-bride. She meets with herHusband Lord - she is so wise. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo pir bhaavai saa sohagan  saa-ee pir ka-o milai si-aan ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am filled with faults; how can I attain my Husband Lord?
lines.transliteration: mai vich dos ha-o ki-o kar pir paavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ ਸਾਈ  ਿਪਰ ਕਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਸਆਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have many loves, but I am not in Your thoughts, O my Husband Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayray anayk pi-aaray ha-o pir chit  na aavaa. ||2||

lines.english: She who enjoys her Husband Lord, is the good soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: jin pir raavi-aa saa bhalee suhaagan .

lines.english: I don't have these virtues; what can I, the discarded bride, do? ||3||
lines.transliteration: say mai gun naahee ha-o ki-aa karee d uhaagan . ||3||

lines.english: The soul-bride continually, constantly enjoys her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: nit suhaagan  sadaa pir raavai.

lines.english: I have no good fortune; will He ever hold me close in His embrace? ||4||
lines.transliteration: mai karamheen kab hee gal laavai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You, O Husband Lord, are meritorious, while I am without merit.
lines.transliteration: too pir gun vantaa ha-o a-ogun i-aaraa.

lines.english: I am worthless; please forgive Nanak, the meek. ||5||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 Gru 2  (561-10) vad-hans mehlaa 4 ghar 2 Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (561-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mai nirgun bakh as naanak vaychaaraa. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ  ਕਬ ਹੀ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Within my mind there is such a great yearning; how will I attain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?
lines.transliteration: mai man vadee aas haray ki-o kar har darsan paavaa.

lines.english: I go and ask my True Guru; with the Guru's advice, I shall teach my foolish mind.
lines.transliteration: ha-o jaa-ay puchhaa apnay sat gurai gur puchh  man mugaDh  samjh aavaa.

lines.english: The foolish mind is instructed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and meditatesforever on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa man samjh ai gur sabd ee har har sad aa Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Mercy of my Beloved, focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak jis nadar karay mayraa pi-aaraa so har charn ee chit  laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ  ਹਰੇ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I dress myself in all sorts of robes for my Husband, so that my True Lord God will bepleased.
lines.transliteration: ha-o sabh vays karee pir kaaran  jay har parabh  saachay bh aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ  ਪੁਛਾ ਅਪਨੇ  ਸਤਗੁਰੈ  ਗੁਰ ਪੁਿਛ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਸਮਝਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: But my Beloved Husband Lord does not even cast a glance in my direction; how can Ibe consoled?
lines.transliteration: so pir pi-aaraa mai nadar na d aykhai ha-o ki-o kar Dh eeraj paavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: For His sake, I adorn myself with adornments, but my Husband is imbued with thelove of another.
lines.transliteration: jis kaaran ha-o seegaar seegaaree so pir rat aa mayraa avraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed is that soul-bride, who enjoys her True, SublimeHusband Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan Dh an Dh an sohagan  jin pir raavi-arh aa sach savraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸਿਭ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੀ ਿਪਰ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I go and ask the fortunate, happy soul-bride, "How did you attain Him - your HusbandLord, my God?"
lines.transliteration: ha-o jaa-ay puchhaa sohaag suhaagan  tusee ki-o pir paa-i-arh aa parabh  mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਮੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਧੀਰਜੁ  ਪਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: She answers, "My True Husband blessed me with His Mercy; I abandoned thedistinction between mine and yours.
lines.transliteration: mai oopar nadar karee pir saachai mai chh odi-arh aa mayraa t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਹਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ  ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਵਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dedicate everything, mind, body and soul, to the Lord God; this is the Path to meetHim, O sister."
lines.transliteration: sabh man t an jee-o karahu har parabh  kaa it  maarag bh ainay milee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਿਵਅੜਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸਵਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If her God gazes upon her with favor, O Nanak, her light merges into the Light. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapnarhaa parabh  nadar kar d aykhai naanak jot  jotee ralee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ  ਪੁਛਾ ਸੋਹਾਗ  ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਤੁਸੀ ਿਕਉ  ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind and body to the one who brings me a message from my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jo har parabh kaa mai d ay-ay sanayhaa t is man t an apn aa dayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਊਪਿਰ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੀ ਿਪਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਛੋਿਡਅੜਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: I wave the fan over him every day, serve him and carry water for him.
lines.transliteration: nit pakh aa fayree sayv kamaavaa t is aagai paan ee dh ovaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਭੈਣੇ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Constantly and continuously, I serve the Lord's humble servant, who recites to me the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. pMnw 562
lines.transliteration: nit nit  sayv karee har jan kee jo har har kathaa sun aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo gur sat gur pooraa naanak man aas pujaa-ay. ||4|| Hail, hail unto the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, who fulfills Nanak's heart's desires. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਆਸ  ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Lord, let me meet the Guru, my best friend; meeting Him, I meditate on the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: gur sajan mayraa mayl haray jit  mil har naam Dh i-aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਿਲ ਹਰੇ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I seek the Lord's sermon from the Guru, the True Guru; joining with Him, I sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur paashu har gosat poochh aaN kar saaNjhee har gun  gaavaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੋਸਿਟ ਪੂਛ ਕਿਰ ਸਝੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵ ॥
lines.english: Each and every day, forever, I sing the Lord's Praises; my mind lives by hearing YourName.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa nit  nit sad har kay man jeevai naam sun  tayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਦ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that moment when I forget my Lord and Master - at that moment, my soul dies. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak jit vaylaa visrai mayraa su-aamee t it vaylai mar jaa-ay jee-o mayraa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਵੇਲੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ਮੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Everyone longs to see the Lord, but he alone sees Him, whom the Lord causes to seeHim.
lines.transliteration: har vaykhan  ka-o sabh  ko-ee lochai so vaykh ai jis aap vikh aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖਣ  ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਵਖਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: One upon whom my Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace, cherishes the Lord, Har,Har forever.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay mayraa pi-aaraa so har har sad aa samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: He alone cherishes the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever, who meets my Perfect TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: so har har naam sadaa sad aa samaalay jis sat gur pooraa mayraa mili-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's humble servant and the Lord become One; meditating on theLord, he blends with the Lord. ||6||1||3|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 Gru 1  (562-8) vad-hans mehlaa 5 ghar 1 Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (562-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jan har ikay ho-ay har jap har saytee rali-aa. ||6||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਇਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਲਆ  ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: His Darbaar, His Court, is the most lofty and exalted.
lines.transliteration: at oochaa t aa kaa d arbaaraa.

lines.english: It has no end or limitations.
lines.transliteration: ant naahee kichh  paaraavaaraa.

lines.english: Millions, millions, tens of millions seek,
lines.transliteration: kot kot kot lakh Dh aavai.
ik til t aa kaa mahal na paavai. ||1|| but they cannot find even a tiny bit of His Mansion. ||1||

lines.english: What is that auspicious moment, when God is met? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: suhaavee ka-un so vaylaa jit  parabh  maylaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tens of thousands of devotees worship Him in adoration.
lines.transliteration: laakh bh agat jaa ka-o aaraaDh eh.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tens of thousands of ascetics practice austere discipline.
lines.transliteration: laakh t apeesar t ap hee saaDh eh.

lines.english: Tens of thousands of Yogis practice Yoga.
lines.transliteration: laakh jogeesar kart ay jogaa.

lines.english: Tens of thousands of pleasure seekers seek pleasure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laakh bh ogeesar bh ogeh bh ogaa. ||2||

lines.english: He dwells in each and every heart, but only a few know this.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at vaseh jaan eh thoraa.

lines.english: Is there any friend who can rip apart the screen of separation?
lines.transliteration: hai ko-ee saajan pard aa toraa.

lines.english: I can only make the effort, if the Lord is merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: kara-o jatan jay ho-ay miharvaanaa.

lines.english: I sacrifice my body and soul to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o d ay-ee jee-o kurbaanaa. ||3||

lines.english: After wandering around for so long, I have finally come to the Saints;
lines.transliteration: firat firat  santan peh aa-i-aa.
dookh  bharam hamaaraa sagal mitaa-i-aa. all of my pains and doubts have been eradicated.

lines.english: God summoned me to the Mansion of His Presence, and blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of His Name.
lines.transliteration: mahal bulaa-i-aa parabh amrit  bhoonchaa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my God is lofty and exalted. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 ] (562-15) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh mayraa oochaa. ||4||1||

lines.english: Dhan so vaylaa jit  darsan karn aa. Blessed is that time, when the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is given;
I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur charn aa. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Giver of souls, O my Beloved God.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kay daat ay pareet am parabh  mayray.

lines.english: My soul lives by reflecting upon the Name of God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man jeevai parabh naam chit ayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: True is Your Mantra, Ambrosial is the Bani of Your Word.
lines.transliteration: sach mantar t umaaraa amrit  banee.

lines.english: Cooling and soothing is Your Presence, all-knowing is Your gaze. ||2||
lines.transliteration: seetal purakh  darisat sujaan ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: True is Your Command; You sit upon the eternal throne.
lines.transliteration: sach hukam tumaaraa t akhat nivaasee.

lines.english: My eternal God does not come or go. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaavai mayraa parabh abh inaasee. ||3||

lines.english: You are the Merciful Master; I am Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: tum miharvaan d aas ham d eenaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is totally permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 ] (562-19) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib bharpur leen aa. ||4||2||

lines.english: You are infinite - only a few know this.
lines.transliteration: too bay-ant  ko virlaa jaan ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some come to understand You through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ko sabad  pachh aanai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your servant offers this prayer, O Beloved: pMnw 563
lines.transliteration: sayvak kee ardaas pi-aaray.

lines.english: I live by meditating on Your Feet, God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jap jeevaa parabh charan  tumaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O my Merciful and Almighty God, O Great Giver,
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal purakh  mayray parabh  daatay.
jisahi janaavhu tineh t um jaat ay. ||2|| he alone knows You, whom You so bless. ||2||

lines.english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa jaa-ee balihaaree.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, I seek Your Protection. ||3||
lines.transliteration: it ut daykh-a-u ot t umaaree. ||3||

lines.english: I am without virtue; I know none of Your Glorious Virtues.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun gun  kichh oo na jaat aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, seeing the Holy Saint, my mind is imbued with You. ||4||3|| vfhMsu mÚ 5 ] (563-3) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDhoo d aykh man raat aa. ||4||3||

lines.english: God is perfect - He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee so parabh  pooraa.

lines.english: He blesses us with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daan d ay-ay saaDh oo kee Dh ooraa. ||1||

lines.english: Bless me with Your Grace, God, O Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: I seek Your Protection, O Perfect Lord, Sustainer of the World. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree ot pooran gopaalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is totally pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al rahi-aa bharpooray.

lines.english: God is near at hand, not far away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nikat vasai naahee parabh d ooray. ||2||

lines.english: One whom He blesses with His Grace, meditates on Him.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har kay gun  gaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant saglay part ipaaray.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door. ||4||4|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 ] (563-7) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran pari-o naanak har du-aaray. ||4||4||

lines.english: You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: too vad d aataa ant arjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: God, the Perfect Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading in all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ravi-aa pooran parabh  su-aamee. ||1||

lines.english: The Name of my Beloved God is my only support.
lines.transliteration: mayray parabh pareet am naam aDh aaraa.

lines.english: I live by hearing, continually hearing Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o sun sun  jeevaa naam t umaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  satgur mayray pooray.

lines.english: My mind is purified by the dust of the Saints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal ho-ay santaa Dh ooray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਵਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my heart.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal hirdai ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tayray d arsan ka-o jaa-ee balihaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਜੀਵਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Show mercy unto me, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa tayray gun  gaavaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I obtain peace. ||4||5|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 ] (563-11) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japat sukh  paavaa. ||4||5||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of theLord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har amrit  peejai.

lines.english: The soul does not die, nor does it ever waste away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa jee-o marai na kabhoo chheejai. ||1||

lines.english: By great good fortune, one meets the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur pooraa paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one meditates on God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay parabh oo Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is the jewel, the pearl, the gem, the diamond.
lines.transliteration: ratan javaahar har maan ak laalaa.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I am in ecstasy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simar simar parabh bh a-ay nihaalaa. ||2||

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Sanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  paykh a-o saaDh oo sarn aa.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my soul becomes immaculately pure. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay nirmal man karn aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within each and every heart, dwells my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar mayraa su-aamee vooth aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, when God bestows His Mercy. ||4||6|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 ] (563-14) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam paa-i-aa parabh t oothaa. ||4||6||

lines.english: Do not forget me, O God, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: visar naahee parabh d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  pooran kirpaalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Wherever You come to mind, that place is blessed.
lines.transliteration: jah chit aavahi so thaan suhaavaa.

lines.english: The moment I forget You, I am stricken with regret. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit vaylaa visrahi t aa laagai haavaa. ||1||

lines.english: All beings are Yours; You are their constant companion.
lines.transliteration: tayray jee-a t oo sad  hee saathee.

lines.english: Please, give me Your hand, and pull me up out of this world-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar tay kadh  day haathee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਵੂਠਾ ॥
lines.english: Coming and going are by Your Will.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa tum hee kee-aa.

lines.english: One whom You save is not afflicted by suffering. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis too raakh ahi tis dookh na thee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: You are the One and only Lord and Master; there is no other.
lines.transliteration: too ayko saahib avar na hor.

lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer with his palms pressed together. ||4||7|| vfhMsu mÚ 5 ] (563-19) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bin-o karai naanak kar jor. ||4||7||

lines.english: When You allow Yourself to be known, then we know You.
lines.transliteration: too jaan aa-ihi t aa ko-ee jaan ai.

lines.english: We chant Your Name, which You have given to us. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayraa d ee-aa naam vakh aanai. ||1||

lines.english: You are wonderful! Your creative potency is amazing! ||1||Pause|| pMnw 564
lines.transliteration: too achraj kud rat tayree bismaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You Yourself are the Cause of causes, You Yourself are the Creator.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay kaaran  aapay karn aa.

lines.english: By Your Will, we are born, and by Your Will, we die. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hukmay jaman hukmay marn aa. ||2||

lines.english: Your Name is the Support of our mind and body.
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa man t an aaDh aaree.

lines.english: This is Your blessing to Nanak, Your slave. ||3||8|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 Gru 2  (564-3) vad-hans mehlaa 5 ghar 2 Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (564-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas bakh sees t umaaree. ||3||8||

lines.english: Deep within me, there is a longing to meet my Beloved; how can I attain my Perfect Guru?
lines.transliteration: mayrai antar lochaa milan  kee pi-aaray ha-o ki-o paa-ee gur pooray.

lines.english: Even though a baby may play hundreds of games, he cannot survive without milk.
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o khayl kh aylaa-ee-ai baalak reh na sakai bin kh eeray.

lines.english: The hunger within me is not satisfied, O my friend, even though I am servedhundreds of dishes.
lines.transliteration: mayrai antar bh ukh na ut rai ammaalee jay sa-o bh ojan mai neeray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਚਾ  ਿਮਲਣ  ਕੀ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਉ ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Beloved; how can my soul find relief, without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan? ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan paraym piramm kaa bin d arsan ki-o man Dh eeray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ  ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਖੀਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Listen, O my dear friends and siblings - lead me to my True Friend, the Giver ofpeace.
lines.transliteration: sun sajan  mayray pareet am bh aa-ee mai maylihu mit ar sukh -daata.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਭੋਜਨ  ਮੈ ਨੀਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He knows all the troubles of my soul; every day, he tells me stories of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: oh jee-a kee mayree sabh bayd an jaan ai nit sunaavai har kee-aa baat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਿਪਰੰਮ  ਕਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ  ਿਕਉ  ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. I cry out for Him, just as the song-birdcries for the drop of water.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ik khin t is bin reh na sakaa ji-o chaat rik jal ka-o billaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਜਣ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਭਾਈ  ਮੈ ਮੇਿਲਹੁ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing? You save even worthless beings like me.||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o ki-aa gun t ayray saar samaalee mai nirgun  ka-o rakh  laytaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬੇਦਨ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਨਤ  ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਬਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have become depressed, waiting for my Husband Lord, O my friend; when shall myeyes behold my Husband?
lines.transliteration: ha-o bha-ee udeen ee kant  ka-o ammaalee so pir kad  nainee daykhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਿਜਉ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕੁ  ਜਲ ਕਉ ਿਬਲਲਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have forgotten how to enjoy all pleasures; without my Husband Lord, they are of nouse at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh ras bh ogan visray bin pir kit ai na laykh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਲੀ  ਮੈ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਕਉ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: These clothes do not please my body; I cannot dress myself.
lines.transliteration: ih kaaparh t an na sukh va-ee kar na saka-o ha-o vaysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਭਈ ਉਡੀਣੀ  ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਕਿਦ  ਨੈਣੀ  ਦੇਖਾ ॥
lines.english: I bow to those friends of mine, who have enjoyed their Beloved Husband Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jinee sakhee laal raavi-aa pi-aaraa t in aagai ham aad aysaa. ||3||

lines.english: I have adorned myself with all sorts of decorations, O my friend, but without my Husband Lord, they are of no use at all.
lines.transliteration: mai sabh seegaar ban aa-i-aa ammaalee bin pir kaam na aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਈ  ਕਿਰ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਹਉ ਵੇਸਾ ॥
lines.english: When my Husband does not care for me, O my friend, then my youth passes, totallyuseless.
lines.transliteration: jaa seh baat na puchh ee-aa ammaalee t aa birthaa joban sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਖੀ ਲਾਲੁ  ਰਾਿਵਆ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਿਤਨ ਆਗੈ  ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an tay sohaagan ee ammaalee jin saho rahi-aa samaa-ay. Blessed, blessed are the happy soul-brides, O my friend, who are blended with theirHusband Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਸਿਭ ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਬਣਾਇਆ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those happy soul-brides; I wash their feet again and again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaari-aa tin sohaagan ee ammaalee t in kay Dh ovaa sad  paa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਸਿਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਤਾ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: As long as I suffered from duality and doubt, O my friend, I thought God was faraway.
lines.transliteration: jichar doojaa bh aram saa ammaalee t ichar mai jaan i-aa parabh  dooray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਿਜਨ ਸਹੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: But when I met the Perfect True Guru, O my friend, then all my hopes and desireswere fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jaa mili-aa pooraa satguroo ammaalee t aa aasaa mansaa sabh  pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.english: I have obtained all pleasures and comforts, O my friend; my Husband Lord is all- pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: mai sarab sukhaa sukh  paa-i-aa ammaalee pir sarab rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਚਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ  ਸਾ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਿਤਚਰੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love, O my friend; I fall at the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||5||1||9|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 AstpdIAw  (564-17) vad-hans mehlaa 3 asatpadee-aa Wadahans, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (564-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har rang maani-aa ammaalee gur sat gur kai lag pairay. ||5||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਤਾ ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: True is the Bani of His Word, and True is the melody; True is contemplativemeditation on the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sach Dh un sach sabad  veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਸਰਬ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I praise the True Lord. Blessed, blessed is my great good fortune. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din sach salaahn aa Dh an Dh an vadbh aag hamaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਿਣਆ  ਅੰਮਾਲੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਲਿਗ  ਪੈਰੇ ॥੫॥੧॥੯॥
lines.english: O my mind, let yourself be a sacrifice to the True Name.
lines.transliteration: man mayray saachay naam vitahu bal jaa-o.

lines.english: If you become the slave of the Lord's slaves, you shall obtain the True Name. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 565
lines.transliteration: daasan d aasaa ho-ay raheh t aa paavahi sachaa naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: True is the tongue which is imbued with Truth, and true are the mind and body.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa sachee sach ratee t an man sachaa ho-ay.

lines.english: By praising any other than the True Lord, one's whole life is wasted. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin saachay hor salaahnaa jaaseh janam sabh  kho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਸਚੀ ਸਿਚ ਰਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Let Truth be the farm, Truth the seed, and Truth the merchandise you trade.
lines.transliteration: sach khayt ee sach beejn aa saachaa vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਜਾਸਿਹ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Night and day, you shall earn the profit of the Lord's Name; you shall have the treasure overflowing with the wealth of devotional worship. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din laahaa sach naam Dh an bh agat bharay bh andaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਜਣਾ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let Truth be your food, and let Truth be yo ur clothes; let your True Support be the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach khaan aa sach painn aa sach tayk har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who is so blessed by the Lord, obtains a seat in the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jis no bakhsay t is milai mahlee paa-ay thaa-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: In Truth we come, and in Truth we go, and then, we are not consigned toreincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: aavahi sachay jaaveh sachay fir joonee mool na paahi.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are hailed as True in the True Court; they merge in the True Lord.||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d ar saachai sachiaar heh saachay maahi samaahi. ||5||

lines.english: Deep within they are True, and their minds are True; they sing the Glorious Praises ofthe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: antar sachaa man sachaa sachee sifat  sanaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਹ  ਸਚੇ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੇ ਿਫਿਰ  ਜੂਨੀ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: In the true place, they praise the True Lord; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sachai thaan sach salaahnaa sat gur balihaarai jaa-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰ  ਹਿਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਿਹ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: True is the time, and true is the moment, when one falls in love with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach vaylaa moorat sach jit  sachay naal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Then, he sees Truth, and speaks the Truth; he realizes the True Lord pervading the entire Universe. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sach vaykh-n aa sach boln aa sachaa sabh  aakaar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਥਾਿਨ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one merges with the True Lord, when He merges with Himself.
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai maylay taa milay aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਿਜਤੁ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: As it pleases Him, He preserves us; He Himself ordains His Will. ||8||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (565-8) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh see aapay karay rajaa-ay. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: His mind wanders in the ten directions - how can he sing the Glorious Praises of theLord?
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa dah d is Dhaavdaa oh kaisay har gun  gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਿਮਲੇ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The sensory organs are totally engrossed in sensuality; sexual desire and angerconstantly afflict him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: indree vi-aap rahee aDh ikaa-ee kaam kroDh  nit santaavai. ||1||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! Chant His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu sehjay gun raveejai.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain in this age; under Guru's Instruction, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam is jug meh dulabh  hai gurmat  har ras peejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਧਾਵਦਾ  ਓਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering the Word of the Shabad, the mind becomes immaculately pure, andthen, one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad cheen man nirmal hovai t aa har kay gun  gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਿਵਆਿਪ  ਰਹੀ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਨਤ  ਸੰਤਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand his own self, and then, he comesto dwell in the home of his inner self. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee aapai aap pachh aanai taa nij gh ar vaasaa paavai. ||2||

lines.english: O my mind, be imbued forever with the Lord's Love, and sing forever the GloriousPraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayray sadaa rang raat ay sad aa har kay gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਦੁਲਭੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord is forever the Giver of peace; from Him, one receives the fruitsof his heart's desires. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har nirmal sadaa sukh -daata man chind i-aa fal paa-o. ||3||

lines.english: I am lowly, but I have been exalted, entering the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham neech say ootam bh a-ay har kee sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He has lifted up the sinking stone; True is His glorious greatness. ||4||
lines.transliteration: paathar dubdaa kaadh  lee-aa saachee vadi-aa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਤਾ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: From poison, I have been transformed into Ambrosial Nectar; under Guru'sInstruction, I have obtained wisdom.
lines.transliteration: bikh say amrit  bha-ay gurmat  buDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: From bitter herbs, I have been transformed into sandalwood; this fragrance permeates me deep within. ||5||
lines.transliteration: akahu parmal bha-ay ant ar vaasnaa vasaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: This human birth is so precious; one must earn the right to come into the world.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam d ulambh  hai jag meh kh ati-aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਸੇ ਊਤਮ  ਭਏ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By perfect destiny, I met the True Guru, and I meditate on the Lord's Name. ||6||
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sat gur milai har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਆ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; attached to corruption, they waste away theirlives in vain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay bikh  lagay ahilaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਸੇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is forever an ocean of peace, but the manmukhs do not lovethe Word of the Shabad. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa sukh  saagar saachaa sabad  na bh aa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਹੁ ਪਰਮਲ  ਭਏ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਾਸਨਾ  ਵਸਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Everyone can chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with their mouths, but only a fewenshrine it within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: mukhahu har har sabh  ko karai virlai hird ai vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਦੁਲੰਭੁ  ਹੈ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਖਿਟਆ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, attain liberation andemancipation. ||8||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 CMq  (565-18) vad-hans mehlaa 1 chhant Wadahans, First Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (565-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin kai hirdai vasi-aa mokh  mukat  tinH paa-i-aa. ||8||2||

lines.english: Why bother to wash the body, polluted by falsehood?
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa koorh vigaarh  kaahay naa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭੂਲੇ ਿਬਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਅਿਹਲਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One's cleansing bath is only approved, if he practices Truth.
lines.transliteration: naataa so parvaan  sach kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: When there is Truth within the heart, then one becomes True, and obtains the True Lord. pMnw 566
lines.transliteration: jab saach andar ho-ay saachaa t aam saachaa paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without pre-ordained destiny, understanding is not attained; talking and babbling, one wastes his life away.
lines.transliteration: likhay baajh ahu surat  naahee bol bol gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਖੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਬੋਿਲ  ਬੋਿਲ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever you go and sit, speak well, and write the Word of the Shabad in yourconsciousness.
lines.transliteration: jithai jaa-ay bahee-ai bhalaa kahee-ai surat  sabad  likhaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਜਾਇ  ਬਹੀਐ  ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਲਖਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Why bother to wash the body which is polluted by falsehood? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa koorh vigaarh  kaahay naa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak.
lines.transliteration: taa mai kahi-aa kahan  jaa tujhai kahaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਹਆ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naam mayrai man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, seems so sweet to my mind; it has destroyed the dwelling of pain.
lines.transliteration: naam meethaa maneh laagaa d ookh dayraa dh aahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਦੂਿਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Peace came to dwell in my mind, when You gave the Order.
lines.transliteration: sookh man meh aa-ay vasi-aa jaam t ai furmaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਆਇ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਜਾਿਮ  ਤੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: It is Yours to bestow Your Grace, and it is mine to speak this prayer; You createdYourself.
lines.transliteration: nadar t uDh ardaas mayree jinn aap upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਜੰਿਨ  ਆਪੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa mai kahi-aa kahan  jaa tujhai kahaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਹਆ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done.
lines.transliteration: vaaree khasam kadh aa-ay kirat  kamaavan aa.

lines.english: Do not speak ill of others, or get involved in arguments.
lines.transliteration: mandaa kisai na aakh  jhagrhaa paavn aa.

lines.english: Do not get into arguments with the Lord, or you shall ruin yourself.
lines.transliteration: nah paa-ay jhagrh aa su-aam sayt ee aap aap vanj aavan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਪਾਇ  ਝਗੜਾ  ਸੁਆਿਮ  ਸੇਤੀ ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੁ  ਵਞਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: If you challenge the One, with whom you must abide, you will cry in the end.
lines.transliteration: jis naal sangat kar sareekee jaa-ay ki-aa roo-aavan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਜਾਇ  ਿਕਆ  ਰੂਆਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Be satisfied with what God gives you; tell your mind not to complain uselessly.
lines.transliteration: jo day-ay sahn aa maneh kahn aa aakh  naahee vaavn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸਹਣਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਆਿਖ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਵਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vaaree khasam kadh aa-ay kirat  kamaavan aa. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself created all, and He blesses then with His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: sabh upaa-ee-an aap aapay nad ar karay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: No one asks for that which is bitter; everyone asks for sweets.
lines.transliteration: ka-urhaa ko-ay na maagai meeth aa sabh  maagai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉੜਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਸਭ ਮਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone ask for sweets, and behold, it is as the Lord wills.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko-ay meeth aa mang d aykhai khasam bh aavai so karay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮੰਿਗ ਦੇਖੈ ਖਸਮ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Giving donations to charity, and performing various religious rituals are not equal tothe contemplation of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: kichh punn d aan anayk karn ee naam t ul na samasray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਛੁ  ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਨਾਮ ਤੁਿਲ  ਨ ਸਮਸਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are blessed with the Naam have had such good karma pre-ordained.
lines.transliteration: naankaa jin naam mili-aa karam ho-aa Dhur kad ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਕਦੇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created all, and He blesses them with His Glance of Grace. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 ] (566-11) vad-hans mehlaa 1. Wadahans, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh upaa-ee-an aap aapay nad ar karay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Show mercy to me, that I may chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: karahu da-i-aa t ayraa naam vakh aanaa.

lines.english: You Yourself created all, and You are pervading among all.
lines.transliteration: sabh upaa-ee-ai aap aapay sarab samaan aa.

lines.english: You Yourself are pervading among all, and You link them to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: sarbay samaanaa aap t oohai upaa-ay Dh anDhai laa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਐ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some, You have made kings, while others go about begging.
lines.transliteration: ik tujh  hee kee-ay raajay iknaa bh ikh bhavaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਤੂਹੈ ਉਪਾਇ  ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: You have made greed and emotional attachment seem sweet; they are deluded by this delusion.
lines.transliteration: lobh moh t ujh kee-aa meeth aa ayt  bharam bh ulaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਜੇ ਇਕਨਾ  ਿਭਖ ਭਵਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Be ever merciful to me; only then can I chant Your Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa d a-i-aa karahu apn ee taam naam vakh aanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੀਆ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਏਤੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa hai saachaa sad aa mai man bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਅਪਣੀ  ਤਾਿਮ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My pains are dispelled, and I am permeated with peace.
lines.transliteration: dookh  ga-i-aa sukh  aa-ay samaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਦਾ ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You.
lines.transliteration: gaavan sur nar sugharh  sujaan aa.

lines.english: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You; they are pleasing to YourMind.
lines.transliteration: sur nar sugharh  sujaan  gaavahi jo t ayrai man bh aavhay.

lines.english: Enticed by Maya, they do not remember the Lord, and they waste away their lives in vain.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohay cheeteh naahee ahilaa janam gavaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ  ਸੁਜਾਣ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Some fools and idiots never think of the Lord; whoever has come, shall have to go.
lines.transliteration: ik moorh mugaDh  na cheet eh moolay jo aa-i-aa t is jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੇ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਿਹਲਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa sad aa saachaa so-ay mai man bh aanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਮੂਲੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: tayraa vakh at suhaavaa amrit  tayree ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਇ ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your servants serve You with love; these mortals are attached to Your essence.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayveh bhaa-o kar laagaa saa-o paraan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਖਤੁ  ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those mortals are attached to Your essence, who are blessed with the AmbrosialName.
lines.transliteration: saa-o paraanee t inaa laagaa jinee amrit  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਲਾਗਾ  ਸਾਉ ਪਰਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with Your Name, prosper more and more, day by day.
lines.transliteration: naam tayrai jo-ay raat ay nit  charh eh savaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Some do not practice good deeds, or live righteously; nor do they practice self-restraint. They do not realize the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ik karam Dharam na ho-ay sanjam jaam na ayk pachh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਇ ਰਾਤੇ ਿਨਤ  ਚੜਿਹ  ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Ever beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vakhat  suhaavaa sad aa tayraa amrit  tayree ban ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਜਾਿਮ  ਨ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Name. pMnw 567
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree saachay naavai.

lines.english: Your rule shall never end.
lines.transliteration: raaj tayraa kabahu na jaavai.

lines.english: Your rule is eternal and unchanging; it shall never come to an end.
lines.transliteration: raajo ta t ayraa sad aa nihchal ayhu kabahu na jaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੋ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਏਹੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: He alone becomes Your servant, who contemplates You in peaceful ease.
lines.transliteration: chaakar ta t ayraa so-ay hovai jo-ay sahj samaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Enemies and pains shall never touch him, and sin shall never draw near him.
lines.transliteration: dusman t a dookh na lagai moolay paap nayrh  na aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the One Lord, and Your Name. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree sadaa hovaa ayk t ayray naav-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਾ ਏਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵਏ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Throughout the ages, Your devotees sing the Kirtan of Your Praises, O Lord Master, at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: jugah jugantar bh agat tumaaray. keerat  karahi su-aamee t ayrai d u-aaray.

lines.english: They meditate on the One True Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaapeh ta saachaa ayk muraaray.

lines.english: Only then do they meditate on the True Lord, when they enshrine Him in their minds.
lines.transliteration: saachaa muraaray taam jaapeh jaam man vasaavhay.

lines.english: Doubt and delusion are Your making; when these are dispelled,
lines.transliteration: bharmo bh ulaavaa t ujheh kee-aa jaam ayhu chukaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ਤਾਿਮ  ਜਾਪਿਹ  ਜਾਿਮ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee karahu kirpaa layho jamahu ubaaray. then, by Guru's Grace, You grant Your Grace, and save them from the noose of Death.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੋ  ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਕੀਆ  ਜਾਿਮ  ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Throughout the ages, they are Your devotees. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jugah jugantar bh agat tumaaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O my Great Lord and Master, You are unfathomable and infinite.
lines.transliteration: vaday mayray saahibaa alakh apaaraa.

lines.english: How should I make and offer my prayer? I do not know what to say.
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar kara-o baynantee ha-o aakh  na jaan aa.

lines.english: If You bless me with Your Glance of Grace, I realize the Truth.
lines.transliteration: nadar karahi t aa saach pachh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਹਉ ਆਿਖ  ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Only then do I come to realize the Truth, when You Yourself instruct me.
lines.transliteration: saacho pachhaan aa taam t ayraa jaam aap bujh aavhay.

lines.english: The pain and hunger of the world are Your making; dispel this doubt.
lines.transliteration: dookh  bhookh sansaar kee-ay sahsaa ayhu chukaavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੋ ਪਛਾਣਾ  ਤਾਿਮ  ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਿਮ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, ones skepticism is taken away, when he understands the Guru's wisdom.
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak jaa-ay sahsaa bujh ai gur beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਕੀਏ ਸਹਸਾ ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Great Lord Master is unfathomable and infinite. ||6||
lines.transliteration: vadaa saahib hai aap alakh apaaraa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਾਇ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਬੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful.
lines.transliteration: tayray bankay lo-in  dant reesaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਹੈ ਆਿਪ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Your nose is so graceful, and Your hair is so long.
lines.transliteration: sohnay nak jin lammrh ay vaalaa.

lines.english: Your body is so precious, cast in gold.
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa su-inay kee dhaalaa.

lines.english: His body is cast in gold, and He wears Krishna's mala; meditate on Him, O sisters.
lines.transliteration: sovann dhaalaa krisan maalaa japahu t usee sahayleeho.

lines.english: You shall not have to stand at Death's door, O sisters, if you listen to these teachings.
lines.transliteration: jam du-aar na hohu kh arhee-aa sikh  sunhu mahayleeho.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਵੰਨ  ਢਾਲਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨ  ਮਾਲਾ  ਜਪਹੁ ਤੁਸੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ  ॥
lines.english: From a crane, you shall be transformed into a swan, and the filth of your mind shallbe removed.
lines.transliteration: hans hansaa bag bagaa lahai man kee jaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਨ ਹੋਹੁ ਖੜੀਆ  ਿਸਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ  ॥
lines.english: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bankay lo-in d ant reesaalaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਬਗਾ  ਲਹੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet.
lines.transliteration: tayree chaal suhaavee maDh uraarh ee ban ee.

lines.english: You coo like a songbird, and your youthful beauty is alluring.
lines.transliteration: kuhkan kokilaa taral ju-aan ee.

lines.english: Your youthful beauty is so alluring; it pleases You, and it fulfills the heart's desires.
lines.transliteration: tarlaa ju-aan ee aap bh aanee ichh  man kee pooree-ay.

lines.english: Like an elephant, You step with Your Feet so carefully; You are satisfied with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: saarang ji-o pag Dharai th im thim aap aap sanDh oora-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਲਾ  ਜੁਆਣੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਭਾਣੀ  ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਏ  ॥
lines.english: She who is imbued with the Love of such a Great Lord, flows intoxicated, like the waters of the Ganges.
lines.transliteration: sareerang raatee firai maat ee ud ak gangaa vaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਿਜਉ ਪਗੁ ਧਰੈ ਿਠਿਮ  ਿਠਿਮ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੁ  ਸੰਧੂਰਏ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave, O Lord; Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is sosweet. ||8||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 CMq  (567-15) vad-hans mehlaa 3 chhant Wadahans, Third Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (567-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d aas har kaa t ayree chaal suhaavee maDh uraarh ee ban ee. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀਰੰਗ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਫਰੈ ਮਾਤੀ  ਉਦਕੁ  ਗੰਗਾ  ਵਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Let yourself be imbued with the Love of your Husband Lord, O beautiful, mortal bride.
lines.transliteration: aapnay pir kai rang rat ee mu-ee-ay sobh aavant ee naaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਮਧੁਰਾੜੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: Let yourself remain merged in the True Word of the Shabad, O mortal bride; savorand enjoy the Love of your Beloved Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad mil rahee mu-ee-ay pir raavay bh aa-ay pi-aaray.

lines.english: The Husband Lord embellishes His beloved bride with His True Love; she is in lovewith the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sachai bhaa-ay pi-aaree kant  savaaree har har si-o nayhu rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੀ ਮੁਈਏ  ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ  ਨਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Renouncing her self-centeredness, she attains her Husband Lord, and remains merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-i-aa taa pir paa-i-aa gur kai sabad  samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀ ਮੁਈਏ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: That soul bride is adorned, who is attracted by His Love, and who treasures the Loveof her Beloved within her heart.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan sabad  suhaa-ee paraym kasaa-ee ant ar pareet  pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਕੰਿਤ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord blends that soul bride with Himself; the True King adorns her. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan mayl la-ee pir aapay saachai saahi savaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਤਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O worthless bride, see your Husband Lord ever-present.
lines.transliteration: nirgunvant -rhee-ay pir d aykh hadooray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕਸਾਈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who, as Gurmukh, enjoys her Husband Lord, O mortal bride, knows Him to be all- pervading everywhere. pMnw 568
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinee raavi-aa mu-ee-ay pir rav rahi-aa bh arpooray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਵਆ  ਮੁਈਏ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is all-pervading everywhere; behold Him ever-present. Throughout the ages, know Him as the One.
lines.transliteration: pir rav rahi-aa bharpooray vaykh  hajooray jug jug ayko jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ਵੇਖੁ ਹਜੂਰੇ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan baalee bh olee pir sahj raavai mili-aa karam biDh aataa. The young, innocent bride enjoys her Husband Lord; she meets Him, the Architect ofkarma.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ  ਭੋਲੀ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਾਵੈ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, and utters the sublime Word of theShabad, remains immersed in the Lord's Ambrosial Pool.
lines.transliteration: jin har ras chaakhi-aa sabad  subh aakhi-aa har sar rahee bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸੁਭਾਿਖਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਰ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who, through the Shabad, remains in His Presence. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman saa pir bh aavai sabd ay rahai had ooray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਾ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Go and ask the happy soul-brides, O mortal bride, who have eradicated their self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee jaa-ay poochh ahu mu-ee-ay jinee vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਮੁਈਏ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have not eradicated their self-conceit, O mortal bride, do not realize theHukam of their Husband Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: pir kaa hukam na paa-i-o mu-ee-ay jinee vichahu aap na gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਮੁਈਏ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who eradicate their self-conceit, obtain their Husband Lord; they delight in HisLove.
lines.transliteration: jinee aap gavaa-i-aa tinee pir paa-i-aa rang si-o ralee-aa maan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਰਲੀਆ  ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.english: Ever imbued with His Love, in perfect poise and grace, she repeats His Name, nightand day.
lines.transliteration: sadaa rang raat ee sehjay maat ee an-d in naam vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Very fortunate is that bride, who focuses her consciousness on Him; her Lord's Love isso sweet to her.
lines.transliteration: kaaman vadbh aagee ant ar liv laagee har kaa paraym subh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride who is adorned with Truth, is imbued with her Lord's Love, inthe state of perfect poise. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman sehjay raat ee jin sach seegaar ban aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Overcome your egotism, O mortal bride, and walk in the Guru's Way.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar mu-ee-ay too chal gur kai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਮੁਈਏ  ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Thus you shall ever enjoy your Husband Lord, O mortal bride, and obtain an abode in the home of your own inner being.
lines.transliteration: har var raaveh sadaa mu-ee-ay nij gh ar vaasaa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਮੁਈਏ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Obtaining an abode in the home of her inner being, she vibrates the Word of theShabad, and is a happy soul-bride forever.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paa-ay sabad  vajaa-ay sad aa suhaagan  naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Husband Lord is delightful, and forever young; night and day, He embellishes Hisbride.
lines.transliteration: pir ralee-aalaa joban baalaa an-din kant  savaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਲਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਕੰਿਤ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Her Husband Lord activates the destiny written on her forehead, and she is adornedwith the True Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har var sohaago mastak bh aago sachai sabad  suhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੋ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਸੁਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is imbued with the Love of the Lord, when she walksaccording to the Will of the True Guru. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (568-10) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman har rang raat ee jaa chalai sat gur bh aa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜਾ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: All dealings of the Gurmukh are good, if they are accomplished with poise and grace.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabh  vaapaar bh alaa jay sehjay keejai raam.

lines.english: Night and day, he repeats the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he earns his profits,drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam vakh aanee-ai laahaa har ras peejai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਕੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He earns the profit of the subtle essence of the Lord, meditating on the Lord, and repeating the Naam, night and day.
lines.transliteration: laahaa har ras leejai har raaveejai an-din naam vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He gathers in merits, and eliminates demerits, and realizes his own self.
lines.transliteration: gun sangrahi avgan  viknahi aapai aap pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਵੀਜੈ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he drinks in the essence of the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmat paa-ee vadee vadi-aa-ee sachai sabad  ras peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਿਵਕਣਿਹ  ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, devotional worship of the Lord is wonderful, but only a few Gurmukhsperform it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak har kee bhagat  niraalee gurmukh  virlai keejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, plant the crop of the Lord within the field of your body, and let it grow.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kh aytee har ant ar beejee-ai har leejai sareer jamaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਨਰਾਲੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਵਰਲੈ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within the home of your own being, enjoy the Lord's subtle essence, and earn profitsin the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: aapnay gh ar and ar ras bh unch t oo laahaa lai parthaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੇਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬੀਜੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਲੀਜੈ  ਸਰੀਿਰ  ਜਮਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: This profit is earned by enshrining the Lord within your mind; blessed is this farmingand trade.
lines.transliteration: laahaa parthaa-ay har man vasaa-ay Dhan kh aytee vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੇ  ਘਰ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਚੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਾ  ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord's Name, and enshrining Him within your mind, you shall cometo understand the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aa-ay man vasaa-ay boojh ai gur beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਪਰਥਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ਧਨੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of this farming and trade; their hunger and thirst will not go away.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kh aytee van aj kar thaakay t arisnaa bh ukh na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, plant the seed of the Name within your mind, and adorn yourself with theTrue Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam beej man andar sachai sabad  subh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings engage in the Lord's Trade, who have the jewel of such pre-ordained destiny upon their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: har vaapaar say jan laagay jinaa mastak man ee vadbh aago raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਿਜ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, the soul dwells in the home of the self; through the TrueWord of the Shabad, she becomes unattached.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee man nij gh ar vasi-aa sachai sabad  bairaago raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਾਪਾਿਰ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਮਣੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: By the destiny written upon their foreheads, they become truly unattached, and byreflective meditation, they are imbued with Truth.
lines.transliteration: mukh mast ak bh aago sach bairaago saach rat ay veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੈਰਾਗੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is insane; through theShabad, the ego is conquered.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag ba-uraanaa sabd ay ha-umai maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੋ ਸਿਚ ਬੈਰਾਗੋ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to the True Word of the Shabad, wisdom comes forth. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Husband Lord. pMnw 569
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad laag mat  upjai gurmukh  naam sohaago.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, and by the destiny written on her forehead, she enjoys Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad milai bh a-o bh anjan har raavai mast ak bh aago. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਵੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All farming and trading is by Hukam of His Will; surrendering to the Lord's Will,glorious greatness is obtained.
lines.transliteration: khayt ee van aj sabh  hukam hai hukmay man vadi-aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ  ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand the Lord's Will, and by His Will, heis united in His Union.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee hukam boojh ee-ai hukmay mayl milaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: By His Will, one merges and easily blends with Him. The Shabads of the Guru areincomparable.
lines.transliteration: hukam milaa-ee sahj samaa-ee gur kaa sabad apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਿਮ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, true greatness is obtained, and one is embellished with Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachee vadi-aa-ee gur tay paa-ee sach savaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He finds the Destroyer of fear, and eradicates his self-conceit; as Gurmukh, he isunited in His Union.
lines.transliteration: bha-o bh anjan paa-i-aa aap gavaa-i-aa gurmukh  mayl milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Name of the immaculate, inaccessible, unfathomable Commander ispermeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (569-5) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak naam niranjan agam agochar hukmay rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਿਹਆ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: man mayri-aa too sad aa sach samaal jee-o.

lines.english: Dwell in peace in the home of your own self, and the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.
lines.transliteration: aapnai gh ar too sukh  vaseh pohi na sakai jamkaal jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The noose of the Messenger of Death shall not touch you, when you embrace love forthe True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai saachai sabad liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਤੂ ਸੁਿਖ ਵਸਿਹ  ਪੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Ever imbued with the True Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and its coming andgoing is ended.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach rat aa man nirmal aavan  jaan rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The love of duality and doubt have ruined the self-willed manmukh, who is lured awayby the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bh aram vigut ee manmukh  mohee jamkaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਚ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਰਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O my mind: contemplate the True Lord forever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sun man mayray t oo sad aa sach samaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਿਵਗੁਤੀ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside.
