lines.transliteration: man mayri-aa antar t ayrai niDh aan hai baahar vasat  na bh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Eat only that which is pleasing to the Lord, and as Gurmukh, receive the blessing ofHis Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: jo bhaavai so bh unch t oo gurmukh  nadar nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਨ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace, O my mind; the Name of the Lord, your help and support, is within you.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nad ar nihaal man mayray ant ar har naam sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭੁੰਿਚ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are blind, and devoid of wisdom; they are ruined by thelove of duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ulay gi-aan vihoon ay doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, no one is emancipated. All are bound by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko chhootai naahee sabh  baaDh ee jamkaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak antar t ayrai niDh aan hai t oo baahar vasat  na bh aal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ  ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, obtaining the blessing of this human birth, some are engaged in the tradeof Truth.
lines.transliteration: man mayri-aa janam padaarath paa-ay kai ik sach lagay vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਨ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They serve their True Guru, and the Infinite Word of the Shabad resounds withinthem.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan aapn aa ant ar sabad  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਇਿਕ ਸਿਚ ਲਗੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Within them is the Infinite Shabad, and the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord;through the Naam, the nine treasures are obtained.
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  apaaraa har naam pi-aaraa naamay na-o niDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; theysuffer in pain, and through duality, they lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: manmukh maa-i-aa moh vi-aapay d ookh santaapay d oojai pat  gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਨਾਮੇ ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: But those who conquer their ego, and merge in the True Shabad, are totally imbued with Truth.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar sach sabad samaan ay sach rat ay aDh ikaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਦੂਿਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it is so difficult to obtain this human life; the True Guru imparts thisunderstanding. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak maanas janam d ulambh  hai sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਿਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, those who serve their True Guru are the most fortunate beings.
lines.transliteration: man mayray satgur sayvan aapn aa say jan vadbh aagee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਦੁਲੰਭੁ  ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who conquer their minds are beings of renunciation and detachment.
lines.transliteration: jo man maareh aapnaa say purakh  bairaagee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They are beings of renunciation and detachment, who lovingly focus theirconsciousness on the True Lord; they realize and understand their own selves.
lines.transliteration: say jan bairaagee sach liv laagee aapnaa aap pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Their intellect is steady, deep and profound; as Gurmukh, they naturally chant theNaam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mat nihchal at  goorh ee gurmukh  sehjay naam vakh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸਿਚ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Some are lovers of beautiful young women; emotional attachment to Maya is verydear to them. The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs remain asleep.
lines.transliteration: ik kaaman hit kaaree maa-i-aa mohi pi-aaree manmukh  so-ay rahay abh aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਅਿਤ  ਗੂੜੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਹਜੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who intuitively serve their Guru, have perfect destiny. ||4||3|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (569-18) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay sayveh gur apnaa say pooray vadbh aagay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਹਤਕਾਰੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Purchase the jewel, the invaluable treasure; the True Guru has given this understanding.
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath van jee-ah sat gur dee-aa bujh aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: The profit of profits is the devotional worship of the Lord; one's virtues merge into thevirtues of the Lord. pMnw 570
lines.transliteration: laahaa laabh har bh agat hai gun  meh gun ee samaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੈਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: One's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord; he comes to understand his own self. He earns the profit of devotional worship in this world.
lines.transliteration: gun meh gun ee samaa-ay jis aap bujh aa-ay laahaa bh agat saisaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Without devotion, there is no peace; through duality, one's honor is lost, but under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with the Support of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: bin bhagt ee sukh  na ho-ee d oojai pat  kho-ee gurmat  naam aDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਏਤੁ ਵਾਪਾਿਰ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He ever earns the profit of the merchandise of the Naam, whom the Lord employs inthis Trade.
lines.transliteration: vakhar naam sad aa laabh  hai jis no ayt  vaapaar laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਵਣਜੀਅਿਹ ਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He purchases the jewel, the invaluable treasure, unto whom the True Guru has giventhis understanding. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath van jee-ah jaaN satgur day-ay bujh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh d ukh hai kh otaa ih vaapaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਵਣੀ ਬਹੁ ਵਧਿਹ  ਿਵਕਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Speaking falsehood, one eats poison, and the evil within increases greatly.
lines.transliteration: koorh bol bikh  khaavnee baho vaDh eh vikaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਵਧਿਹ  ਿਵਕਾਰਾ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The evil within increases greatly, in this world of doubt; without the Name, one's honor is lost.
lines.transliteration: baho vaDheh vikaaraa sahsaa ih sansaaraa bin naavai pat  kho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Reading and studying, the religious scholars argue and debate; but withoutunderstanding, there is no peace.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  vaad  vakaan eh bin boojh ay sukh  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Their comings and goings never end; emotional attachment to Maya is dear to them.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa kad ay na chookai maa-i-aa moh pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh d ukh hai kh otaa ih vaapaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਪਰਖੀਅਿਨ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The counterfeit and the genuine are all assayed in the Court of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: khotay kh aray sabh  parkh ee-an t it sachay kai d arbaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੁਟੀਅਿਨ  ਊਭੇ ਕਰਿਨ  ਪੁਕਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The counterfeit are cast out of the Court, and they stand there, crying out in misery.
lines.transliteration: khotay d argeh sutee-an oobh ay karan pukaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਊਭੇ ਕਰਿਨ  ਪੁਕਾਰਾ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਗਵਾਰਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They stand there, crying out in misery; the foolish, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs havewasted their lives.
lines.transliteration: oobhay karan pukaaraa mugaDh  gavaaraa manmukh  janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Maya is the poison which has deluded the world; it does not love the Naam, the Nameof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa maa-i-aa jin jagat  bhulaa-i-aa saachaa naam na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਿਲ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are resentful toward the Saints; they harvest only pain inthis world.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sant aa naal vair kar d ukh khatay sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਿਨ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੈ ਦਰਵਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The counterfeit and the genuine are assayed in that True Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khotay kh aray parkh ee-an t it sachai d arvaaraa raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything.
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhee-ai hor karn aa kichh oo na jaa-ee raam.

lines.english: As He pleases, He engages us; such is His glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: jit bhaavai t it laa-isee ji-o t is dee vadi-aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਈ  ਵਰੀਆਮੁ  ਨ ਫੁਸੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Such is His glorious greatness - He Himself causes all to act; no one is a warrior or a coward.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tis d ee vadi-aa-ee aap karaa-ee varee-aam na fusee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Architect of karma - He Himself grantsforgiveness.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan daat aa karam biDh aataa aapay bakh say so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated, O Nanak, and through the Naam, honor isobtained.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aap gavaa-ee-ai naanak naam pat paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything. ||4||4|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (570-13) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhee-ai hor karn aa kichh oo na jaa-ee. ||4||4||

lines.english: The True merchandise is the Lord's Name. This is the true trade.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sa-udaa har naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, we trade in the Lord's Name; its value is very great.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har naam van jee-ai at  mol afaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜੀਐ  ਅਿਤ  ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The value of this true trade is very great; those who are engaged in the true trade are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: at mol afaaraa sach vaapaaraa sach vaapaar lagay vadbh aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ  ਸਚ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਸਿਚ ਵਾਪਾਿਰ  ਲਗੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, they are imbued with devotion, and they enshrine love forthe True Name.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar bh agtee raat ay sach naam liv laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤੇ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Favor, obtains Truth, and reflects upon the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay so-ee sach paa-ay gur kai sabad  veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Name find peace; they deal only in the TrueName. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay t in hee sukh  paa-i-aa saachai kay vaapaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Egotistical involvement in Maya is filth; Maya is overflowing with filth.
lines.transliteration: haN-umai maa-i-aa mail hai maa-i-aa mail bhareejai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉਮੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, the mind is made pure and the tongue tastes the subtleessence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee man nirmalaa rasnaa har ras peejai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The tongue tastes the subtle essence of the Lord, and deep within, the heart isdrenched with His Love, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har ras peejai antar bh eejai saach sabad  beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within, the well of the heart is overflowing with the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar; the water-carrier draws and drinks in the water of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: antar kh oohtaa amrit  bhari-aa sabd ay kaadh  pee-ai panihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਖੂਹਟਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਪੀਐ  ਪਿਨਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the Lord's favor is attuned to the Truth; with his tongue, hechants the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jis nadar karay so-ee sach laagai rasnaa raam raveejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਚ ਲਾਗੈ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are immaculate.The others are full of the filth of egotism. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say nirmal hor ha-umai mail bh areejai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੋਰ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All the religious scholars and astrologers read and study, and argue and shout. Who are they trying to teach? pMnw 571
lines.transliteration: pandit jot kee sabh  parh parh kookd ay kis peh karahi pukaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਕੂਕਦੇ  ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੁਕਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The filth of attachment to Maya clings to their hearts; they deal in Maya alone.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh antar mal laagai maa-i-aa kay vaapaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They love to deal in Maya in this world; coming and going, they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kay vaapaaraa jagat pi-aaraa aavan  jaan dukh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਜਗਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਵਿਣ  ਜਾਿਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The worm of poison is addicted to poison; it is immersed in manure.
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa keerh aa bikh  si-o laagaa bistaa maahi samaa-ee.

lines.english: He does what is pre-ordained for him; no one can erase his destiny.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so-ay kamaavai ko-ay na maytan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋਇ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, lasting peace is found; the ignorant fools die screaming. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay t in sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa hor moorakh  kook mu-ay gaavaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਿਤਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹੋਿਰ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੂਿਕ  ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Their minds are colored by emotional attachment to Maya; because of this emotionalattachment, they do not understand.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi man rangi-aa mohi suDh na kaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਿਗਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਸੁਿਧ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The soul of the Gurmukh is imbued with the Lord's Love; the love of duality departs.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ih man rangee-ai d oojaa rang jaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਐ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The love of duality departs, and the soul merges in Truth; the warehouse is overflowing with Truth.
lines.transliteration: doojaa rang jaa-ee saach samaa-ee sach bh aray bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਸਿਚ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, comes to understand; the Lord embellishes him withTruth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so-ee boojh ai sach savaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਿਚ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord causes to merge; nothing else can besaid or done.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay so har milai hor kahnaa kichh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, one is deluded by doubt; but some, imbued with theName, enshrine love for the Lord. ||4||5|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (571-7) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa ik naam rat ay rang laa-ay. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਇਿਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: O my mind, the world comes and goes in birth and death; only the True Name shall emancipate you in the end.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa aavaa ga-on sansaar hai ant  sach nibayrh aa raam.

lines.english: When the True Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then one does not have to enter thecycle of reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: aapay sachaa bakhas la-ay fir ho-ay na fayraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ ਆਵਾ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਿਚ ਿਨਬੇੜਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again, and he is emancipated inthe end; as Gurmukh, he obtains glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: fir ho-ay na fayraa ant sach nibayrh aa gurmukh  milai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਚਾ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਿਫਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with love for the True Lord, he is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and heremains absorbed in the Celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachai rang raatay sehjay maat ay sehjay rahay samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਿਚ ਿਨਬੇੜਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is pleasing to his mind; he enshrines the True Lord in his mind; attunedto the Word of the Shabad, he is emancipated in the end.
lines.transliteration: sachaa man bhaa-i-aa sach vasaa-i-aa sabad  ratay ant  nibayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, merge in the True Lord; they are notcast into the terrifying world-ocean again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say sach samaan ay bahur na bh avjal fayraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਿਨਬੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is total madness; through the love of duality, one isruined.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh baral hai d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਭਵਜਿਲ  ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mother and father - all are subject to this love; in this love, they are entangled.
lines.transliteration: maataa pit aa sabh  hayt hai hayt ay palchaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਰਲੁ  ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They are entangled in this love, on account of their past actions, which no one can erase.
lines.transliteration: haytay palchaa-ee purab kamaa-ee mayt na sakai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤਾ  ਿਪਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The One who created the Universe, beholds it; no other is as great as He.
lines.transliteration: jin sarisat saajee so kar vaykhai t is jayvad avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ  ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਕਮਾਈ  ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukh is consumed by his burning rage; without the Word ofthe Shabad, peace is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa tap tap kh apai bin sabd ai saaNt na aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, everyone is deluded, ruined by emotional attachment toMaya. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai sabh ko-ee bh ulaa maa-i-aa mohi kh u-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਤਿਪ ਤਿਪ ਖਪੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing that this world on fire, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayhu jag jaltaa d aykh kai bh aj pa-ay har sarn aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਖੁਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I offer my prayer to the Perfect Guru: please save me, and bless me with Yourglorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: ardaas kareeN gur pooray aagai rakh  layvhu d ayh vadaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਭਿਜ ਪਏ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Preserve me in Your Sanctuary, and bless me with the glorious greatness of the Nameof the Lord; there is no other Giver as great as You.
lines.transliteration: rakh layvhu sarn aa-ee har naam vadaa-ee t uDh jayvad avar na d aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਗੈ  ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who are engaged in serving You are very fortunate; throughout the ages, theyknow the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa laagay say vadbhaagay jug jug ayko jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: You may practice celibacy, truth, austere self-discipline and rituals, but without the Guru, you shall not be emancipated.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam karam kamaavai bin gur gat  nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ  ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone understands the Word of the Shabad, who goes and seeks theLord's Sanctuary. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak tis no sabad  bujhaa-ay jo jaa-ay pavai har sarn aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That understanding, imparted by the Lord, wells up; there is no other understanding.
lines.transliteration: jo har mat d ay-ay saa oopjai hor mat  na kaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਜੋ ਜਾਇ  ਪਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Deep within, and beyond as well, You alone are, O Lord; You Yourself impart thisunderstanding.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayk t oo aapay d eh bujh aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਇ ਸਾ ਊਪਜੈ  ਹੋਰ ਮਿਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One whom He Himself blesses with this understanding, does not love any other. AsGurmukh, he tastes the subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay deh bujh aa-ee avar na bh aa-ee gurmukh  har ras chaakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਿਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: In the True Court, he is forever True; with love, he chants the True Word of the Shabad. pMnw 572
lines.transliteration: dar saachai sad aa hai saachaa saachai sabad  subh aakhi-aa.

lines.english: Within his home, he finds the home of his own being; the True Guru blesses him with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh nij gh ar paa-i-aa sat gur day-ay vadaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਿਨਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; their understanding is true, and approved. ||4||6|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 CMq  (572-3) vad-hans mehlaa 4 chhant Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (572-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo naam ratay say-ee mahal paa-in mat  parvaan  sach saa-ee. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਮਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: My mind, my mind - the True Guru has blessed it with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man mayrai man satgur pareet  lagaa-ee raam.

lines.english: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, within my mind.
lines.transliteration: har har har har naam mayrai man vasaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, dwells within my mind; He is the Destroyer of allpain.
lines.transliteration: har har naam mayrai man vasaa-ee sabh d ookh visaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan;blessed, blessed is my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur d arsan paa-i-aa Dh an Dh an sat guroo hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ਸਿਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਵਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: While standing up and sitting down, I serve the True Guru; serving Him, I have foundpeace.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at satgur sayvah jit  sayvi-ai saaNt paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind, my mind - the True Guru has blessed it with the Lord's Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayrai man mayrai man satgur pareet  lagaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I live, I live, and I blossom forth, beholding the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o jeevaa ha-o jeevaa satgur d aykh sarsay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, the Name of the Lord, He has implanted within me; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I blossom forth.
lines.transliteration: har naamo har naam drirh-aa-ay jap har har naam vigsay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੇਿਖ ਸਰਸੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and throughthe Name of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: jap har har naam kamal pargaasay har naam navaN niDh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਗਸੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The disease of egotism has been eradicated, suffering has been eliminated, and Ihave entered the Lord's state of celestial Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog ga-i-aa dukh  laathaa har sahj samaaDh  lagaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਲ  ਪਰਗਾਸੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the glorious greatness of Name of the Lord from the True Guru;beholding the Divine True Guru, my mind is at peace.
lines.transliteration: har naam vadaa-ee satgur t ay paa-ee sukh  satgur dayv man parsay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I live, I live, and I blossom forth, beholding the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o jeevaa ha-o jeevaa satgur d aykh sarsay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: If only someone would come, if only someone would come, and lead me to meet myPerfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aan ko-ee aan  milaavai mayraa sat gur pooraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੇਿਖ ਸਰਸੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind and body, my mind and body - I cut my body into pieces, and I dedicatethese to Him.
lines.transliteration: ha-o man tan ha-o man t an dayvaa t is kaat sareeraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Cutting my mind and body apart, cutting them into pieces, I offer these to the one, who recites to me the Words of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o man tan kaat kaat t is day-ee jo sat gur bachan sun aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਿਟ  ਸਰੀਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My unattached mind has renounced the world; obtaining the Blessed Vision of theGuru's Darshan, it has found peace.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man bairaag bha-i-aa bairaagee mil gur d arsan sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਿਟ ਕਾਿਟ  ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਈ ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਨ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, O Giver of Peace, please, grant Your Grace, and bless me with thedust of the feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karahu sukh-d aatay dayh sat gur charan ham Dh ooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: If only someone would come, if only someone would come, and lead me to meet myPerfect True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aan ko-ee aan  milaavai mayraa sat gur pooraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਦੇਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਨ  ਹਮ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: A Giver as great as the Guru, as great as the Guru - I cannot see any other.
lines.transliteration: gur jayvad gur jayvad daat aa mai avar na ko-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He blesses me with the gift of the Lord's Name, the gift of the Lord's Name; He is theImmaculate Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har daano har d aan d ayvai har purakh  niranjan so-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who worship in adoration the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - their pain, doubtsand fears are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jinee aaraaDhi-aa t in kaa d ukh bharam bh a-o bh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨੋ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through their loving service, those very fortunate ones, whose minds are attached tothe Guru's Feet, meet Him.
lines.transliteration: sayvak bhaa-ay milay vadbh aagee jin gur charnee man laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself causes us to meet the Guru; meeting the Almighty True Guru, peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har aap milaa-ay mil satgur purakh  sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: A Giver as great as the Guru, as great as the Guru - I cannot see any other. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 ] (572-17) vad-hans mehlaa 4. Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur jayvad gur jayvad daat aa mai avar na ko-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, I am - without the Guru, I am totally dishonored.
lines.transliteration: haN-u gur bin haN-u gur bin kharee nimaan ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Life of the World, the Life of the World, the Great Giver has led me to meet andmerge with the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan jagjeevan daat aa gur mayl samaan ee raam.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, I have merged into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Ichant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditate on it.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayl har naam samaan ee jap har har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਿਨਮਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I was seeking and searching for Him, the Lord, my best friend, and I have found Him within the home of my own being. pMnw 573
lines.transliteration: jis kaaran haN-u dhoondh  dhoodhaydee so sajan  har gh ar paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I see the One Lord, and I know the One Lord; I realize Him within my soul.
lines.transliteration: ayk darisat har ayko jaat aa har aat am raam pachh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਦਰ੍ਿਸ੍ਟ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, I am - without the Guru, I am totally dishonored. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haN-u gur bin haN-u gur bin kharee nimaan ee. ||1||

lines.english: Those who have found the True Guru, the True Guru, the Lord God unites them in His Union.
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur jin sat gur paa-i-aa t in har parabh  mayl milaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Their feet, their feet, I adore; I fall at their feet.
lines.transliteration: tin charan  tin charan  sarayveh ham laagah t in kai paa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਚਰਣ ਿਤਨ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰੇਵਹ  ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, I adore the feet of those who meditate on the True Guru, and theAlmighty Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har har charan sarayveh t in kay jin sat gur purakh  parabh  Dha-yaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰੇਵਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Greatest Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; please, rewardmy faith, O Lord King.
lines.transliteration: too vadd aataa ant arjaamee mayree sarDh aa poor har raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਵਡਦਾਤਾ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Gursikh, my faith is rewarded; night and day, I sing the Glorious Praisesof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gursikh mayl mayree sarDh aa pooree an-d in raam gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਮੇਿਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ  ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have found the True Guru, the True Guru, the Lord God unites them in HisUnion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin satgur jin sat gur paa-i-aa t in har parabh  mayl milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to the Gursikhs, my dear friends.
lines.transliteration: haN-u vaaree haN-u vaaree gursikh meet  pi-aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਮੀਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They chant the Lord's Name, the Lord's Name; the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.
lines.transliteration: har naamo har naam sunaa-ay mayraa pareet am naam aDh aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the companion of my breath of life; without it, Icannot live for an instant or a moment.
lines.transliteration: har har naam mayraa paraan sakhaa-ee t is bin gh arhee nimakh  nahee jeevaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੜੀ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of peace, shows His Mercy, and the Gurmukh drinks inthe Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karay sukh-d aata gurmukh  amrit  peevaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵ ॥
lines.english: The Lord blesses him with faith, and unites him in His Union; He Himself adorns him.
lines.transliteration: har aapay sarDhaa laa-ay milaa-ay har aapay aap savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਰਧਾ  ਲਾਇ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to the Gursikhs, my dear friends. ||3||
lines.transliteration: haN-u vaaree haN-u vaaree gursikh meet  pi-aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਮੀਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, is the Immaculate Almighty Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har aapay har aapay purakh niranjan so-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, unites us with Himself; that which He does,comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: har aapay har aapay maylai karai so ho-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲੈ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord God, that alone comes to pass; nothing else can bedone.
lines.transliteration: jo har parabh bh aavai so-ee hovai avar na karn aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Even by very clever tricks, He cannot be obtained; all have grown weary of practicing cleverness.
lines.transliteration: bahut si-aan ap la-i-aa na jaa-ee kar thaakay sabh  chaturaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak beholds the Lord; without the Lord, I have no other atall.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jan naanak d aykhi-aa mai har bin avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, is the Immaculate Almighty Lord God. ||4||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 ] (573-12) vad-hans mehlaa 4. Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har aapay har aapay purakh niranjan so-ee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord, the True Guru, the Lord, the True Guru - if only I could meet the Lord, theTrue Guru; His Lotus Feet are so pleasing to me.
lines.transliteration: har satgur har sat gur mayl har sat gur charan  ham bh aa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: The darkness of my ignorance was dispelled, when the Guru applied the healingointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.
lines.transliteration: timar agi-aan gavaa-i-aa gur gi-aan anjan gur paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣ  ਹਮ ਭਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has applied the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes, andthe darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan anjan satguroo paa-i-aa agi-aan anDh ayr binaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਮਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, I have obtained the supreme status; I meditate on the Lord withevery breath, and every morsel of food.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv param pad  paa-i-aa har japi-aa saas giraasay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਧੇਰ  ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those, upon whom the Lord God has bestowed His Grace, are committed to the service of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin kaN-u har parabh kirpaa Dh aaree t ay sat gur sayvaa laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਿਵ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ਸਾਸ ਿਗਰਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the True Guru, the Lord, the True Guru - if only I could meet the Lord, theTrue Guru; His Lotus Feet are so pleasing to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har satgur har sat gur mayl har sat gur charan  ham bh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਤੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My True Guru, my True Guru is my Beloved; without the Guru, I cannot live.
lines.transliteration: mayraa satgur mayraa sat gur pi-aaraa mai gur bin rahan  na jaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣ  ਹਮ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He gives me the Name of the Lord, the Name of the Lord, my only companion in theend.
lines.transliteration: har naamo har naam dayvai mayraa ant  sakhaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my only companion in the end; the Guru, the TrueGuru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.
lines.transliteration: har har naam mayraa ant sakh aa-ee gur sat gur naam drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਖਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: There, where neither child nor spouse shall accompany you, the Name of the Lord,Har, Har shall emancipate you.
lines.transliteration: jithai put kalat ar ko-ee baylee naahee t ithai har har naam chh adaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਖਾਈ  ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat gur purakh  niranjan jit  mil har naam Dh i-aa-ee. Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, the Immaculate, Almighty Lord God; meeting Him,I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤਰ੍ੁ  ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਤਥੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਛਡਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My True Guru, my True Guru is my Beloved; without the Guru, I cannot live. ||2|| pMnw 574
lines.transliteration: mayraa satgur mayraa sat gur pi-aaraa mai gur bin rahan  na jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who have not obtained the Blessed Vision, the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the Almighty Lord God,
lines.transliteration: jinee darsan jinee d arsan sat gur purakh  na paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin nihfal t in nihfal janam sabh  baritha gavaa-i-aa raam. they have fruitlessly, fruitlessly wasted their whole lives in vain.

lines.english: They have wasted away their whole lives in vain; those faithless cynics die a regretfuldeath.
lines.transliteration: nihfal janam tin baritha gavaa-i-aa t ay saakat  mu-ay mar jh ooray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਤਨ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੁਏ ਮਿਰ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They have the jewel-treasure in their own homes, but still, they are hungry; thoseunlucky wretches are far away from the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghar hod ai ratan pad aarath bh ookhay bh aagheen  har d ooray.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਹੋਦੈ ਰਤਿਨ  ਪਦਾਰਿਥ  ਭੂਖੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਹਿਰ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please, let me not see those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord,Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: har har tin kaa d aras na karee-ahu jinee har har naam na Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ  ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee darsan jinee d arsan sat gur purakh  na paa-i-aa. ||3|| and who have not obtained the Blessed Vision, the Blessed Vision of the Darshan ofthe True Guru, the Almighty Lord God. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a song-bird, I am a meek song-bird; I offer my prayer to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham chaatrik ham chaat rik deen har paas baynant ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਹਮ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: If only I could meet the Guru, meet the Guru, O my Beloved; I dedicate myself to thedevotional worship of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur mil gur mayl mayraa pi-aaraa ham satgur karah bh agtee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਗੁਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਹਮ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਰਹ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I worship the Lord, Har, Har, and the True Guru; the Lord God has granted His Grace.
lines.transliteration: har har satgur karah bh agtee jaaN har parabh  kirpaa Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਰਹ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਜ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, I have no other friend. The Guru, the True Guru, is my very breath of life.
lines.transliteration: mai gur bin avar na ko-ee baylee gur satgur paraan  hamHaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted the Naam within me; the Name of the Lord, Har,Har, the True Name.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur naam darirhHaa-i-aa har har naam har sat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਤੀ ॥
lines.english: I am a song-bird, I am a meek song-bird; I offer my prayer to the Lord. ||4||3|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 ] (574-9) vad-hans mehlaa 4. Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ham chaatrik ham chaat rik deen har paas baynant ee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਹਮ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, show Your Mercy, show Your Mercy, and let me meet the True Guru, theGiver of peace.
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa har kirpaa kar satgur mayl sukh -daata raam.

lines.english: I go and ask, I go and ask from the True Guru, about the sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham poochhah ham poochh ah sat gur paas har baat aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I ask about the sermon of the Lord from the True Guru, who has obtained thetreasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: satgur paas har baat  poochh ah jin naam pad aarath paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪੂਛਹ  ਹਮ ਪੂਛਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਬਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I bow at His Feet constantly, and pray to Him; the Guru, the True Guru, has shownme the Way.
lines.transliteration: paa-ay lagah nit karah binant ee gur sat gur panth bat aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਬਾਤ ਪੂਛਹ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a devotee, who looks alike upon pleasure and pain; he is imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: so-ee bhagat  dukh sukh  samat  kar jaan ai har har naam har raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਹ  ਿਨਤ ਕਰਹ  ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, show Your Mercy, show Your Mercy, and let me meet the True Guru, theGiver of peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa har kirpaa kar gur satgur mayl sukh -daata. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮਤੁ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listen as Gurmukh, listen as Gurmukh, to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; allegotism and sins are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: sun gurmukh  sun gurmukh  naam sabh  binsay haN-umai paapaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,the troubles of the world vanish.
lines.transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam lathi-arhay jag t aapaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸੁਿਣ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਿਭ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਹੰਉਮੈ  ਪਾਪਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are rid of their suffering andsins.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jinee aaraaDhi-aa t in kay d ukh paap nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਥਅੜੇ  ਜਿਗ ਤਾਪਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has placed the sword of spiritual wisdom in my hands; I haveovercome and slain the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: satgur gi-aan kh arhag hath d eenaa jamkankar maar bid aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God, the Giver of peace, has granted His Grace, and I am rid of pain, sin anddisease.
lines.transliteration: har parabh kirpaa Dh aaree sukh -daatay dukh laathay paap sant aapaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਖੜਗੁ  ਹਿਥ ਦੀਨਾ  ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Listen as Gurmukh, listen as Gurmukh, to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; all egotism and sins are eradicated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sun gurmukh  sun gurmukh  naam sabh  binsay haN-umai paapaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ  ਪਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam mayrai man bhaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸੁਿਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਭ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਹੰਉਮੈ  ਪਾਪਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Speaking as Gurmukh, speaking as Gurmukh, chanting the Naam, all disease iseradicated.
lines.transliteration: mukh gurmukh  mukh  gurmukh  jap sabh  rog gavaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, chanting the Naam, all disease is eradicated, and the body becomes freeof disease.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jap sabh  rog gavaa-i-aa arogat  bha-ay sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੁਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਿਪ ਸਿਭ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, one remains absorbed in the Perfect Poise of Samaadhi; meditate onthe Name of the Lord, the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din sahj samaaDh  har laagee har japi-aa gahir gambh eeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਿਪ ਸਿਭ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅਰੋਗਤ  ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whether of high or low social status, one who meditates on the Naam obtains thesupreme treasure.
lines.transliteration: jaat ajaat  naam jin Dh i-aa-i-aa t in param pad aarath paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind. ||3|| pMnw 575
lines.transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam mayrai man bhaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Grant Your Grace, grant Your Grace, O Lord, and save me.
lines.transliteration: har Dhaarahu har Dh aarahu kirpaa kar kirpaa layho ubaaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, I am a worthless sinner, I am meek, but I am Yours, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham paapee ham paapee nirgun d een tumHaaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਦੀਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am a worthless sinner, and I am meek, but I am Yours; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham paapee nirgun d een tumHaaray har d ai-aal sarn aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਦੀਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਦੈਆਲ  ਸਰਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of absolute peace; I am a stone - carry meacross and save me.
lines.transliteration: too dukh bhanjan sarab sukh -daata ham paathar t aray t araa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ  ਤਰੇ ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, servant Nanak has obtained the subtle essence of the Lord;through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is saved.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ayt raam ras paa-i-aa jan naanak naam uDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੇਿਟ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Grant Your Grace, grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me. ||4||4|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 GoVIAw  (575-5) vad-hans mehlaa 4 ghorh ee-aa Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Ghorees ~ The Wedding Procession Songs: <> siqgur pRswid ] (575-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har Dhaarahu har Dh aarahu kirpaa kar kirpaa layho ubaaray raam. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: This body-horse was created by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dayh t ayjan  jee raam upaa-ee-aa raam.

lines.english: Dhan maan as janam punn paa-ee-aa raam. Blessed is human life, which is obtained by virtuous actions.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਤੇਜਿਣ  ਜੀ ਰਾਿਮ  ਉਪਾਈਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Human life is obtained only by the most virtuous actions; this body is radiant andgolden.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam vad punnay paa-i-aa d ayh so kanchan changrh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪੁੰਿਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of the poppy; he is imbued with the new color of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rang chaloolaa paavai har har har nav rangrh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨ  ਚੰਗੜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: This body is so very beautiful; it chants the Name of the Lord, and it is adorned withthe Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: ayh dayh so baaNkee jit  har jaapee har har naam suhaavee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰੰਗੁ ਚਲੂਲਾ  ਪਾਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the body is obtained; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is itscompanion; O servant Nanak, the Lord has created it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee paa-ee naam sakh aa-ee jan naanak raam upaa-ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਬਕੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I place the saddle on the body-horse, the saddle of realization of the Good Lord.
lines.transliteration: dayh paava-o jeen bujh  changa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਿਮ ਉਪਾਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Riding this horse, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: charh langh aa jee bikh am bh u-i-angaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਪਾਵਉ  ਜੀਨੁ ਬੁਿਝ ਚੰਗਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The terrifying world-ocean is rocked by countless waves, but the Gurmukh is carriedacross.
lines.transliteration: bikham bh u-i-angaa anat  tarangaa gurmukh  paar langh aa-ay.

lines.english: Embarking upon the boat of the Lord, the very fortunate ones cross over; the Guru,the Boatman, carries them across through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har bohith charh vadbh aagee langh ai gur kh ayvat sabad  taraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖਮੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ  ਅਨਤ  ਤਰੰਗਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, imbued with the Lord's Love, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,the Lord's lover loves the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din har rang har gun  gaavai har rangee har rangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਬੋਿਹਿਥ  ਚਿੜ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਲੰਘੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਿਦ ਤਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has obtained the state of Nirvaanaa, the state of ultimate goodness, the state of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak nirbaan pad  paa-i-aa har ut am har pad  changa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
lines.english: For a bridle in my mouth, the Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within me.
lines.transliteration: karhee-aal mukh ay gur gi-aan drirh -aa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਰਬਾਣ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰ ਉਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਦੁ ਚੰਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He has applied the whip of the Lord's Love to my body.
lines.transliteration: tan paraym har chaabak laa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: Applying the whip of the Lord's Love to his body, the Gurmukh conquers his mind, andwins the battle of life.
lines.transliteration: tan paraym har har laa-ay chaabak man jin ai gurmukh  jeeti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਚਾਬਕੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He trains his untrained mind with the Word of the Shabad, and drinks in therejuvenating essence of the Lord's Nectar.
lines.transliteration: agh-rh o gharhaavai sabad  paavai api-o har ras peet i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਇ  ਚਾਬਕੁ  ਮਨੁ ਿਜਣੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੀਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Listen with your ears to the Word, uttered by the Guru, and attune your body-horse tothe Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: sun sarvan  banee gur vakh aanee har rang t uree charh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਘੜੋ  ਘੜਾਵੈ  ਸਬਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਿਪਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has crossed over the long and treacherous path. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahaa maarag panth bikh-rh aa jan naanak paar langh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਰ੍ਵਣ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਵਖਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The transitory body-horse was created by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghorh ee tayjan  dayh raam upaa-ee-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਿਬਖੜਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed is that body-horse which meditates on the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jit har parabh  jaapai saa Dh an Dh an tukhaa-ee-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਘੋੜੀ  ਤੇਜਿਣ  ਦੇਹ ਰਾਿਮ  ਉਪਾਈਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Blessed and acclaimed is that body-horse which meditates on the Lord God; it is obtained by the merits of past actions.
lines.transliteration: jit har parabh  jaapai saa Dh an saabaasai Dh ur paa-i-aa kirat  jurhandaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੁਖਾਈਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Riding the body-horse, one crosses over the terrifying world ocean; the Gurmukhmeets the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: charh d ayharh  ghorhee bikh am lagh aa-ay mil gurmukh  parmaanand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸੈ  ਧੁਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਕਰਤੁ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, has perfectly arranged this wedding; the Saints have cometogether as a marriage party.
lines.transliteration: har har kaaj rachaa-i-aa poorai mil sant janaa janj  aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਿੜ ਦੇਹਿੜ  ਘੋੜੀ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਲਘਾਏ  ਿਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has obtained the Lord as his Spouse; joining together, the Saints singthe songs of joy and congratulations. ||4||1||5|| vfhMsu mhlw 4 ] (575-19) vad-hans mehlaa 4. Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har var paa-i-aa mangal mil sant janaa vaaDh aa-ee. ||4||1||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਾਜੁ  ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਪੂਰੈ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੰਞ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The body is the Lord's horse; the Lord imbues it with the fresh and new color.
lines.transliteration: dayh t ayjnarh ee har nav rangee-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਾਧਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: From the Guru, I ask for the Lord's spiritual wisdom. pMnw 576
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan guroo har mangee-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਮੰਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਚੰਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਜਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I ask for the Lord's spiritual wisdom, and the Lord's sublime sermon; through the Name of the Lord, I have come to know His value and His state.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan mangee har kathaa changee har naam gat mit  jaanee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਫਿਲਉ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਖਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator has made my life totally fruitful; I chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh janam safli-o kee-aa kart ai har raam naam vakh aanee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਮੰਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant begs for the Lord's Name, for the Lord's Praises, and for devotional worship of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har raam naam salaahi har parabh har bh agat har jan mangee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਚੰਗੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says servant Nanak, listen, O Saints: devotional worship of the Lord, the Lord of theUniverse, is sublime and good. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan kahai naanak sunhu sant ahu har bh agat govind  changee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The golden body is saddled with the saddle of gold.
lines.transliteration: dayh kanchan jeen suvinaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿੜ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: It is adorned with the jewel of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jarh har har naam rat annaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿੜ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਖ ਘਣੇ ॥
lines.english: Adorned with the jewel of the Naam, one obtains the Lord of the Universe; he meetsthe Lord, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtains all sorts of comforts.
lines.transliteration: jarh naam rat an govind  paa-i-aa har milay har gun  sukh  ghanay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਹਿਰ ਬਣੇ ॥
lines.english: He obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and he meditates on the Name of theLord; by great good fortune, he assumes the color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad paa-i-aa har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa vadbh aagee har rang har ban ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਵਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He meets his Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; His body isever-new, and His color is ever-fresh.
lines.transliteration: har milay su-aamee antarjaamee har navt an har nav rangee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੰਗੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak chants and realizes the Naam; he begs for the Name of the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai naam jaan ai har naam har parabh  mangee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੜੀਆਲੁ  ਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has placed the reins in the mouth of the body-horse.
lines.transliteration: karhee-aal mukh ay gur ankas paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਿਸ ਆਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The mind-elephant is overpowered by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man maigal gur sabad vas aa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਆਇਆ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The bride obtains the supreme status, as her mind is brought under control; she is thebeloved of her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: man vasgat aa-i-aa param pad  paa-i-aa saa Dh an kant  pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਸੋਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within her inner self, she is in love with her Lord; in His home, she is beautiful -she is the bride of her Lord God.
lines.transliteration: antar paraym lagaa har sayt ee gh ar sohai har parabh  naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, she is intuitively absorbed in bliss; she obtains the LordGod, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har rang raatee sehjay maat ee har parabh  har har paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ  ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak, the Lord's slave, says that only the very fortunate meditate on theLord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak jan har daas kahat  hai vadbh aagee har har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਘੋੜੀ  ਜੀ ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The body is the horse, upon which one rides to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dayh gh orhee jee jit  har paa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one sings the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: mil satgur jee mangal gaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇਵਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the songs of joy to the Lord, serve the Name of the Lord, and become theservant of His servants.
lines.transliteration: har gaa-ay mangal raam naamaa har sayv sayvak sayvkee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਇ  ਪਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੰਗ ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: You shall go and enter the Mansion of the Beloved Lord's Presence, and lovingly enjoyHis Love.
lines.transliteration: parabh jaa-ay paavai rang mahlee har rang maan ai rang kee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਰਾਮ ਗਾਏ  ਮਿਨ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, so pleasing to my mind; following the Guru'sTeachings, I meditate on the Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: gun raam gaa-ay man subh aa-ay har gurmat ee man Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਦੇਹ ਘੋੜੀ  ਚਿੜ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; mounting the body-horse, hehas found the Lord. ||4||2||6|| rwgu vfhMsu mhlw 5 CMq Gru 4  (576-14) raag vad-hans mehlaa 5 chhant  ghar 4 Raag Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (576-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kirpaa Dhaaree d ayh gh orhee charh  har paa-i-aa. ||4||2||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, I have found my Beloved Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gur mil laDhaa jee raam pi-aaraa raam.

lines.english: I have made this body and mind a sacrifice, a sacrificial offering to my Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih tan man d it-rhaa vaaro vaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਦਤੜਾ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Dedicating my body and mind, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, andshaken off the fear of death.
lines.transliteration: tan man d itaa bh avjal jit aa chookee kaaNn jamaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਦਤਾ  ਭਵਜਲੁ ਿਜਤਾ  ਚੂਕੀ  ਕਿਣ  ਜਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I have become immortal; my comings and goings have ceased.
lines.transliteration: asthir thee-aa amrit pee-aa rahi-aa aavan  jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਥੀਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have found that home, of celestial Samaadhi; the Name of the Lord is my onlySupport.
lines.transliteration: so ghar laDh aa sahj samDh aa har kaa naam aDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਲਧਾ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਧਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I enjoy peace and pleasure; I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sukh maan ay ralee-aaN gur pooray kaN-u namaskaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਮਾਣੇ  ਰਲੀਆਂ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੰਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listen, O my friend and companion
lines.transliteration: sun sajan  jee maidrh ay meet aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਜਣ  ਜੀ ਮੈਡੜੇ  ਮੀਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mantar sabad  sach d eetaa raam. - the Guru has given the Mantra of the Shabad, the True Word of God.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚੁ ਦੀਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on this True Shabad, I sing the songs of joy, and my mind is rid of anxiety.
lines.transliteration: sach sabad Dh i-aa-i-aa mangal gaa-i-aa chookay manhu ad aysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਅਦੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have found God, who never leaves; forever and ever, He sits with me.
lines.transliteration: so parabh paa-i-aa kat eh na jaa-i-aa sad aa sad aa sang baisaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਇਆ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬੈਸਾ ॥
lines.english: One who is pleasing to God receives true honor. The Lord God blesses him with wealth. pMnw 577
lines.transliteration: parabh jee bh aanaa sachaa maan aa parabh  har Dh an sehjay d eetaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ  ਦੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to such a humble being. O Lord, You bless all with Your bountiful blessings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis jan balihaaree t ayraa d aan sabh nee hai leet aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ  ਹੈ ਲੀਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When it pleases You, then I am satisfied and satiated.
lines.transliteration: ta-o bh aanaa taaN taripat  aghaa-ay raam.

lines.english: My mind is soothed and calmed, and all my thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: man thee-aa thandh aa sabh  tarisan bujh aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ  ਠੰਢਾ ਸਭ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My mind is soothed and calmed, the burning has ceased, and I have found so manytreasures.
lines.transliteration: man thee-aa thandh aa chookee danjh aa paa-i-aa bahut  khajaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ  ਠੰਢਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਡੰਝਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: All the Sikhs and servants partake of them; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sikh sayvak sabh  bhunchan  lagay haN-u sat gur kai kurbaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਖ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਿਭ ਭੁੰਚਣ  ਲਗੇ ਹੰਉ ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have become fearless, imbued with the Love of my Lord Master, and I have shakenoff the fear of death.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay kh asam rang raat ay jam kee t araas bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਖਸਮ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak, Your humble servant, lovingly embraces Your meditation; O Lord, bewith me always. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa sang sayvak t ayree bh agat karaN-o liv laa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੰਉ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My hopes and desires have been fulfilled, O my Lord.
lines.transliteration: pooree aasaa jee mansaa mayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ  ਜੀ ਮਨਸਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am worthless, without virtue; all virtues are Yours, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun jee-o sabh  gun tayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਿਭ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: All virtues are Yours, O my Lord and Master; with what mouth should I praise You?
lines.transliteration: sabh gun  tayray th aakur mayray kit  mukh  tuDh saalaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਕਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: You did not consider my merits and demerits; you forgave me in an instant.
lines.transliteration: gun avgun  mayraa kichh  na beechaari-aa bakh as lee-aa kh in maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੀਆ  ਿਖਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the nine treasures, congratulations are pouring in, and the unstruck melody resounds.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh paa-ee vajee vaaDh aa-ee vaajay anhad  tooray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ  ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ  ਤੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord within my own home, and all my anxietyis forgotten. ||4||1|| sloku ] (577-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai var ghar paa-i-aa mayray laathay jee sagal visooray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਥੇ  ਜੀ ਸਗਲ  ਿਵਸੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Why do you listen to falsehood? It shall vanish like a gust of wind.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa sunayd o koorh  vanjan pavan  jhulaari-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, those ears are acceptable, which listen to the True Master. ||1|| CMqu ] (577-9) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak sunee-ar t ay parvaan  jo sun ayday sach Dh anee. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who listen with their ears to the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: tin gh ol ghumaa-ee jin parabh  sarvan ee sun i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਣੀਅਰ  ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Blissful and comfortable are those, who with their tongues chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: say sahj suhaylay jin har har rasnaa bhan i-aa raam.

lines.english: They are naturally embellished, with priceless virtues; they have come to save theworld.
lines.transliteration: say sahj suhaylay gunah amolay jagat  uDhaaran  aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਿਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God's Feet are the boat, which carries so many across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhai bohith saagar parabh  charn aa kayt ay paar lagh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਭਿਣਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with the favor of my Lord and Master, are not asked to rendertheir account.
lines.transliteration: jin kaN-u kirpaa karee mayrai thaakur t in kaa laykh aa na gan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਗੁਣਹ  ਅਮੋਲੇ  ਜਗਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣ  ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who listen to God with their ears. ||1|| sloku ] (577-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis gh ol ghumaa-ee jin parabh  sarvan ee sun i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਬੋਿਹਥ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਚਰਣਾ  ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲਘਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: With my eyes, I have seen the Light of the Lord, but my great thirst is not quenched.
lines.transliteration: lo-in lo-ee dith  pi-aas na bujh ai moo gh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ  ਨ ਗਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those eyes are different, which behold my Husband Lord. ||1|| CMqu ] (577-13) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak say akh-rh ee-aaN bi-ann jinee disand o maa piree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਿਤਸੁ ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਸੁਿਣਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jinee har parabh dith aa tin kurbaan ay raam.

lines.english: In the True Court of the Lord, they are approved.
lines.transliteration: say saachee dargeh bh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਇਣ  ਲੋਈ ਿਡਠ ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: They are approved by their Lord and Master, and acclaimed as supreme; they are imbued with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: thaakur maanay say parDh aanay har sayt ee rang raat ay.

lines.english: They are satiated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and they merge in celestialpeace; in each and every heart, they see the all-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: har raseh aghaa-ay sahj samaa-ay gh at ghat rama-ee-aa jaat ay.

lines.english: They alone are the friendly Saints, and they alone are happy, who are pleasing totheir Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: say-ee sajan sant  say sukh ee-ay th aakur apn ay bh aanay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God. ||2|| sloku ] (577-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin har parabh dith aa tin kai sad  kurbaan ay. ||2||

lines.english: The body is blind, totally blind and desolate, without the Naam.
lines.transliteration: dayh anDh aaree anDh  sunjee naam vihoon ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਮਾਨੇ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, fruitful is the life of that being, within whose heart the True Lord and Master abides. ||1|| CMqu ] (577-17) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak safal jannam jai ghat vuth aa sach Dh anee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸਿਹ  ਅਘਾਏ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਮਈਆ  ਜਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am cut into pieces as a sacrifice, to those who have seen my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: tin kh annee-ai vanj aaN jin mayraa har parabh  deeth aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਸਜਣ  ਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਪਣੇ  ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: His humble servants partake of the Sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, andare satiated.
lines.transliteration: jan chaakh agh aanay har har amrit  meeth aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਡਠਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord seems sweet to their minds; God is merciful to them, His Ambrosial Nectarrains down upon them, and they are at peace.
lines.transliteration: har maneh meethaa parabh oo toothaa ami-o vooth aa sukh  bha-ay.

lines.english: Pain is eliminated and doubt is dispelled from the body; chanting the Name of theLord of the World, their victory is celebrated.
lines.transliteration: dukh naas bh aram binaas t an tay jap jagd ees eesah jai ja-ay.

lines.english: They are rid of emotional attachment, their sins are erased, and their association with the five passions is broken off. pMnw 578
lines.transliteration: moh rahat bikaar thaakay panch t ay sang t ootaa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am every bit a sacrifice to those, within whose hearts my Lord God abides. ||3|| sloku ] (578-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tin kh annee-ai vanj aa jin gh at mayraa har parabh  vooth aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਵੰਞਾ ਿਜਨ ਘਿਟ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who long for the Lord, are said to be His servants.
lines.transliteration: jo lorheed ay raam sayvak say-ee kaaNdhi-aa.

lines.english: Nanak knows this Truth, that the Lord is not different from His Saint. ||1|| CMqu ] (578-2) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaanay sat  saaN-ee sant  na baahraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦੇ  ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇਈ ਕਿਢਆ  ॥
lines.english: As water mixes and blends with water,
lines.transliteration: mil jal jaleh khataanaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾਣੇ  ਸਿਤ ਸਈ  ਸੰਤ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sang jotee jot  milaanaa raam. so does one's light mix and blend with the Lord's Light.

lines.english: Merging with the perfect, all-powerful Creator, one comes to know his own self.
lines.transliteration: sammaa-ay pooran purakh kart ay aap aapeh jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: Then, he enters the celestial state of absolute Samaadhi, and speaks of the One andOnly Lord.
lines.transliteration: tah sunn sahj samaaDh  laagee ayk ayk vakh aanee-ai.

lines.english: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is liberated; He Himself speaks of Himself.
lines.transliteration: aap guptaa aap mukt aa aap aap vakh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਮਾਇ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪਿਹ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, doubt, fear and the limitations of the three qualities are dispelled, as one merges into the Lord, like water blending with water. ||4||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 5 ] (578-5) vad-hans mehlaa 5. Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bharam bh ai gun  binaasay mil jal jaleh kh ataanaa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਸੁੰਿਨ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: God is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: parabh karan  kaaran  samrathaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਗੁਪਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੁ  ਵਖਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: He preserves the whole world, reaching out with His hand.
lines.transliteration: rakh jagat  sagal d ay hathaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੈ ਗੁਣ ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਜਲੁ ਜਲਿਹ  ਖਟਾਨਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: He is the all-powerful, safe Sanctuary, Lord and Master, Treasure of mercy, Giver ofpeace.
lines.transliteration: samrath sarnaa jog su-aamee kirpaa niDh  sukh -daata.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your slaves, who recognize only the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: haN-u kurbaanee d aas tayray jinee ayk pachh aataa.

lines.english: His color and shape cannot be seen; His description is indescribable.
lines.transliteration: varan chihan na jaa-ay lakhi-aa kathan t ay akthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਗਲ  ਦੇ ਹਥਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, hear my prayer, O God, Almighty Creator, Cause of causes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sun hu bint ee parabh  karan  kaaran  samrathaa. ||1||

lines.english: These beings are Yours; You are their Creator.
lines.transliteration: ayhi jee-a tayray t oo kart aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਜਨੀ  ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: God is the Destroyer of pain, suffering and doubt.
lines.transliteration: parabh d ookh darad bharam hart aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਨੁ ਿਚਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਲਿਖਆ  ਕਥਨ  ਤੇ ਅਕਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: Eliminate my doubt, pain and suffering in an instant, and preserve me, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: bharam d ookh darad nivaar kh in meh rakh  layho d een d ai-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਿਬਨਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are mother, father and friend, O Lord and Master; the whole world is Your child,O Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa su-aam sajan  sabh  jagat  baal gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਿਹ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One who comes seeking Your Sanctuary, obtains the treasure of virtue, and does nothave to enter the cycle of birth and death again.
lines.transliteration: jo saran aavai gun  niDhaan paavai so bahurh  janam na mart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਹਰਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. All beings are Yours; You are their Creator. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d aas tayraa sabh  jee-a t ayray t oo kart aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ਦੀਨ  ਦੈਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day,
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har Dh i-aa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਆਿਮ ਸਜਣੁ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਬਾਲ  ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: man ichhi-arh aa fal paa-ee-ai raam. the fruits of the heart's desires are obtained.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਰਿਣ  ਆਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਮਰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your heart's desires are obtained, meditating on God, and the fear of death isdispelled.
lines.transliteration: man ichh paa-ee-ai parabh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai miteh jam kay t araasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I sing of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, andmy hopes are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gobid gaa-i-aa saaDh  sangaa-i-aa bh a-ee pooran aasaa.

lines.english: Renouncing egotism, emotional attachment and all corruption, we become pleasing to the Mind of God.
lines.transliteration: taj maan moh vikaar saglay parabh oo kai man bh aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, day and night, meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d inas rain ee sad aa har har Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਜਮ ਕੇ ਤਰ੍ਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: At the Lord's Door, the unstruck melody resounds.
lines.transliteration: dar vaajeh anhat  vaajay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬਦੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, sings.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at har gobind  gaajay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe sings, and abides forever; He is unfathomable, profoundlydeep, lofty and exalted.
lines.transliteration: govid gaajay sad aa biraajay agam agochar oochaa.

lines.english: His virtues are infinite - none of them can be described. No one can reach Him.
lines.transliteration: gun bay-ant  kichh  kahan  na jaa-ee ko-ay na sakai pahoochaa.

lines.english: He Himself creates, and He Himself sustains; all beings and creatures are fashioned byHim.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay aap partipaalay jee-a jant  sabh  saajay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਗਾਜੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, happiness comes from devotional worship of the Naam; at His Door, theunstruck melody resounds. ||4||3|| rwgu vfhMsu mhlw 1 Gru 5 AlwhxIAw  (578-18) raag vad-hans mehlaa 1 ghar 5 alaahan ee-aa Raag Wadahans, First Mehl, Fifth House, Alaahanees ~ Songs Of Mourning: <> siqgur pRswid ] (578-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sukh  naam bh agtee dar vajeh anhad  vaajay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਗਾਜੇ  ਸਦਾ ਿਬਰਾਜੇ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਊਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan sirand aa sachaa paat isaahu jin jag Dh anDhai laa-i-aa. Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks.
