lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥
lines.english: When one's time is up, and the measure is full, this dear soul is caught, and driven off. pMnw 579
lines.transliteration: muhlat punee paa-ee bh aree jaanee-arh aa gh at chalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: This dear soul is driven off, when the pre-ordained Order is received, and all the relatives cry out in mourning.
lines.transliteration: jaanee ghat  chalaa-i-aa likh i-aa aa-i-aa runnay veer sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਨੀ  ਘਿਤ  ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਆਇਆ  ਰੁੰਨੇ ਵੀਰ ਸਬਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The body and the swan-soul are separated, when one's days are past and done, O mymother.
lines.transliteration: kaaN-i-aa hans thee-aa vaychhorh aa jaaN din punnay mayree maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਇਆ  ਹੰਸ ਥੀਆ  ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਜ ਿਦਨ  ਪੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ॥
lines.english: As is one's pre-ordained Destiny, so does one receive, according to one's past actions.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa likhi-aa t ayhaa paa-i-aa jayhaa purab kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan sirand aa sachaa paat isaahu jin jag Dh anDhai laa-i-aa. ||1|| Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks.||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਿਸਰੰਦਾ  ਸਚਾ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyonehas to pass this way.
lines.transliteration: saahib simrahu mayray bhaa-eeho sabh naa ayhu pa-i-aan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: These false entanglements last for only a few days; then, one must surely move on to the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: aythai DhanDh aa koorh aa chaar d ihaa aagai sarpar jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਥੈ ਧੰਧਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਚਾਿਰ  ਿਦਹਾ  ਆਗੈ  ਸਰਪਰ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He must surely move on to the world hereafter, like a guest; so why does he indulgein ego?
lines.transliteration: aagai sarpar jaanaa ji-o mihmaan aa kaahay gaarab keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ  ਸਰਪਰ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਿਮਹਮਾਣਾ  ਕਾਹੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord; serving Him, you shall obtain peace in His Court.
lines.transliteration: jit sayvi-ai d argeh sukh  paa-ee-ai naam t isai kaa leejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: In the world hereafter, no one's commands will be obeyed. According to their actions,each and every person proceeds.
lines.transliteration: aagai hukam na chalai moolay sir sir ki-aa vihaanaa.

lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyonehas to pass this way. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saahib simrihu mayray bhaa-eeho sabh naa ayhu pa-i-aan aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਿਸਮਿਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is anopportunity to please Him.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai samrath so thee-ai heelrh aa ayhu sansaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥ  ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਹੀਲੜਾ  ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The True Creator Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the air.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al rav rahi-aa saachrhaa sirjan haaro.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਾਚੜਾ  ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The True Creator Lord is invisible and infinite; His limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: saachaa sirjanhaaro alakh  apaaro t aa kaa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the coming of those, who meditate single-mindedly on Him.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa tin kaa safal bh a-i-aa hai ik man jinee Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹੈ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਿਜਨੀ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He destroys, and having destroyed, He creates; by His Order, He adorns us.
lines.transliteration: dhaahay dh aahi usaaray aapay hukam savaaran haaro.

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਹੇ ਢਾਿਹ ਉਸਾਰੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai samrath so thee-ai heelrh aa ayhu sansaaro. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥ  ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਹੀਲੜਾ  ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: naanak runnaa baabaa jaanee-ai jay rovai laa-ay pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: One who weeps for the sake of worldly objects, O Baba, weeps totally in vain.
lines.transliteration: vaalayvay kaaran baabaa ro-ee-ai rovan  sagal bikaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਲੇਵੇ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਬਾਬਾ  ਰੋਈਐ  ਰੋਵਣੁ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: This weeping is all in vain; the world forgets the Lord, and weeps for the sake ofMaya.
lines.transliteration: rovan sagal bikaaro gaafal sansaaro maa-i-aa kaaran  rovai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵਣੁ  ਸਗਲ ਿਬਕਾਰੋ  ਗਾਫਲੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He does not distinguish between good and evil, and wastes away this life in vain.
lines.transliteration: changa mandaa kichh  soojh ai naahee ih t an ayvai kh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਗਾ  ਮੰਦਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Everyone who comes here, shall have to leave; to act in ego is false.
lines.transliteration: aithai aa-i-aa sabh ko jaasee koorh  karahu ahankaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਆਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ  ਕੂਿੜ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 ] (579-13) vad-hans mehlaa 1. Wadahans, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak runnaa baabaa jaanee-ai jay rovai laa-ay pi-aaro. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name.
lines.transliteration: aavhu milhu sahayleeho sachrhaa naam la-ayhaaN.

lines.english: Let us weep over the body's separation from the Lord and Master; let us remember Him in contemplation.
lines.transliteration: rovah birhaa tan kaa aapn aa saahib samHaalayhaaN.

lines.english: Let us remember the Lord and Master in contemplation, and keep a watchful eye onthe Path. We shall have to go there as well.
lines.transliteration: saahib samHaalih panth nihaalih asaa bhe othai jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵਹ  ਿਬਰਹਾ  ਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਹ ॥
lines.english: He who has created, also destroys; whatever happens is by His Will.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa kee-aa tin hee lee-aa ho-aa t isai kaa bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਮਾਿਲਹ  ਪੰਥੁ ਿਨਹਾਿਲਹ  ਅਸਾ  ਿਭ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever He has done, has come to pass; how can we command Him?
lines.transliteration: jo tin kar paa-i-aa so aagai aa-i-aa asee ke hukam karayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਲੀਆ  ਹੋਆ ਿਤਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavhu milhu sahayleeho sachrhaa naam la-ayhaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਿਨ  ਕਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਆਇਆ  ਅਸੀ  ਿਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die.
lines.transliteration: maran na mand aa lokaa aakh ee-ai jay mar jaan ai aisaa ko-ay.

lines.english: Serve your Almighty Lord and Master, and your path in the world hereafter will be easy.
lines.transliteration: sayvihu saahib samrath aapnaa panth suhaylaa aagai ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਜੇ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਐਸਾ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Take this easy path, and you shall obtain the fruits of your rewards, and receive honorin the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: panth suhaylai jaavhu taaN fal paavhu aagai milai vadaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਿਵਹੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥੁ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਆਗੈ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Go there with your offering, and you shall merge in the True Lord; your honor shall be confirmed.
lines.transliteration: bhaytai si-o jaavhu sach samaavahu t aaN pat laykh ai paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਥ ਸੁਹੇਲੈ  ਜਾਵਹੁ ਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You shall obtain a place in the Mansion of the Lord Master's Presence; being pleasingto Him, you shall enjoy the pleasures of His Love.
lines.transliteration: mahlee jaa-ay paavhu khasmai bh aavahu rang si-o ralee-aa maan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਟੈ ਿਸਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਤ ਪਿਤ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maran na mand aa lokaa aakh ee-ai jay ko-ee mar jaan ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਖਸਮੈ  ਭਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.english: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God. pMnw 580
lines.transliteration: maran mun saa soori-aa hak hai jo ho-ay maran parvaan o.

lines.english: They alone are acclaimed as brave warriors in the world hereafter, who receive true honor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sooray say-ee aagai aakhee-ahi d argeh paavahi saachee maan o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਆਗੈ  ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਮਾਣੋ ॥
lines.english: They are honored in the Court of the Lord; they depart with honor, and they do notsuffer pain in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: dargeh maan  paavahi pat  si-o jaaveh aagai d ookh na laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਣੁ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪਿਤ ਿਸਉ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਆਗੈ  ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: They meditate on the One Lord, and obtain the fruits of their rewards. Serving theLord, their fear is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: kar ayk Dhi-aavahi t aaN fal paavahi jit  sayvi-ai bh a-o bh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: Do not indulge in egotism, and dwell within your own mind; the Knower Himselfknows everything.
lines.transliteration: oochaa nahee kahnaa man meh rahn aa aapay jaan ai jaan o.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਾ  ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਹਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maran mun saaN soori-aa hak hai jo ho-ay mareh parvaan o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣੁ  ਮੁਣਸ  ਸੂਿਰਆ  ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਿਹ  ਪਰਵਾਣੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play.
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa ro-ee-ai baajee hai ih sansaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ  ਰੋਈਐ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Master beholds His work, and contemplates His creative potency.
lines.transliteration: keetaa vaykh ai saahib aapn aa kud rat karay beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: He contemplates His creative potency, having established the Universe. He whocreated it, He alone knows.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  beechaaray Dh aaran  Dhaaray jin kee-aa so jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ਧਾਰਣ  ਧਾਰੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself beholds it, and He Himself understands it. He Himself realizes the Hukamof His Command.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai aapay boojh ai aapay hukam pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ  ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: He who created these things, He alone knows. His subtle form is infinite.
lines.transliteration: jin kichh kee-aa so-ee jaan ai taa kaa roop apaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play. ||4||2|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 dKxI ] (580-7) vad-hans mehlaa 1 dakh -nee. Wadahans, First Mehl, Dakhanee:
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa ro-ee-ai baajee hai ih sansaaro. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ  ਰੋਈਐ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Creator Lord is True - know this well; He is the True Sustainer.
lines.transliteration: sach sirandaa sachaa jaan ee-ai sachrh aa parvad gaaro.

lines.english: He Himself fashioned His Own Self; the True Lord is invisible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: jin aapeenai aap saaji-aa sachrhaa alakh  apaaro.

lines.english: He brought together, and then separated, the two grinding stones of the earth and the sky; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
lines.transliteration: du-ay purh  jorh vichh orhi-an gur bin gh or anDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਪੀਨੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਸਾਿਜਆ ਸਚੜਾ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: He created the sun and the moon; night and day, they move according to HisThought. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sooraj chand sirji-an ahinis chalat  veechaaro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਜੋਿੜ ਿਵਛੋਿੜਅਨ ੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O True Lord and Master, You are True. O True Lord, bless me with Your Love.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sachrhaa saahib sach t oo sachrh aa deh pi-aaro. rahaa-o.

lines.english: You created the Universe; You are the Giver of pain and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: tuDh sirjee mayd nee d ukh sukh  dayvan haaro.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੜਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੜਾ  ਦੇਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: You created woman and man, the love of poison, and emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: naaree purakh sirji-ai bikh  maa-i-aa moh pi-aaro.

lines.english: The four sources of creation, and the power of the Word, are also of Your making.You give Support to all beings.
lines.transliteration: khaan ee ban ee tayree-aa d eh jee-aa aaDh aaro.

lines.english: You have made the Creation as Your Throne; You are the True Judge. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kudrat  takhat rachaa-i-aa sach nibayrh anhaaro. ||2||

lines.english: You created comings and goings, but You are ever-stable, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavaa gavan sirji-aa t oo thir karn aihaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਣੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਤੇਰੀਆ  ਦੇਿਹ ਜੀਆ  ਆਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: In birth and death, in coming and going, this soul is held in bondage by corruption.
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa aa-ay ga-i-aa baDh ik jee-o bikaaro.

lines.english: The evil person has forgotten the Naam; he has drowned - what can he do now?
lines.transliteration: bhoodrh ai naam visaari-aa boodrh ai ki-aa t is chaaro.

lines.english: Forsaking merit, he has loaded the poisonous cargo of demerits; he is a trader of sins. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun chh od bikh  ladi-aa avgun  kaa van jaaro. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਆਇ  ਗਇਆ  ਬਿਧਕੁ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਬਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The beloved soul has received the Call, the Command of the True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sad-rh ay aa-ay t inaa jaanee-aa hukam sachay kart aaro.

lines.english: The soul, the husband, has become separated from the body, the bride. The Lord isthe Re-uniter of the separated ones.
lines.transliteration: naaree purakh vichh unni-aa vichh urhi-aa maylan haaro.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਿਡ ਿਬਖੁ ਲਿਦਆ  ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: No one cares for your beauty, O beautiful bride.; the Messenger of Death is boundonly by the Lord Commander's Command.
lines.transliteration: roop na jaanai sohn ee-ai hukam baDh ee sir kaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦੜੇ  ਆਏ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਜਾਨੀਆ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਚੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: He does not distinguish between young children and old people; he tears apart loveand affection. ||4||
lines.transliteration: baalak biraDh na jaan nee torhan hayt  pi-aaro. ||4||

lines.english: The nine doors are closed by the True Lord's Command, and the swan-soul takesflight into the skies.
lines.transliteration: na-o dar th aakay hukam sachai hans ga-i-aa gain aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੋਹਣੀਐ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਬਧੀ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: The body-bride is separated, and defrauded by falsehood; she is now a widow - her husband's body lies dead in the courtyard.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan chh utee muth ee jhooth viDh-nee-aa mirat karhaa anny narhay baaray.

lines.english: The widow cries out at the door, "The light of my mind has gone out, O my mother,with his death."
lines.transliteration: surat mu-ee mar maa-ee-ay mahal runnee d ar baaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਚੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: So cry out, O soul-brides of the Husband Lord, and dwell on the Glorious Praises ofthe True Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: rovhu kant mahayleeho sachay kay gun  saaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਛੁਟੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਝੂਿਠ ਿਵਧਣੀਆ  ਿਮਰਤਕੜਾ  ਅੰਙਨੜੇ  ਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Her loved one is cleansed, bathed in water, and dressed in silken robes.
lines.transliteration: jal mal jaanee naavaali-aa kaparh pat ambaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਮੁਈ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਈਏ  ਮਹਲ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The musicians play, and the Bani of the True Lord's Words are sung; the five relativesfeel as if they too are dead, so deadened are their minds.
lines.transliteration: vaajay vajay sachee baanee-aa panch mu-ay man maaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ  ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: "Separation from my beloved is like death to me!" cries the widow. "My life in thisworld is cursed and worthless!"
lines.transliteration: jaanee vichhunnrh ay mayraa maran  bha-i-aa Dh arig jeevan  sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਮਿਲ ਜਾਨੀ  ਨਾਵਾਿਲਆ  ਕਪਿੜ  ਪਿਟ ਅੰਬਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: But she alone is approved, who dies, while yet still alive; she lives for the sake of theLove of her Beloved. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai so jaan ee-ai pir sachrh ai hayt  pi-aaray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜੇ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ  ਪੰਚ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So cry out in mourning, you who have come to mourn; this world is false and fraudulent. pMnw 581
lines.transliteration: tusee rovhu rovan  aa-eeho jh ooth muth ee sansaaray.

lines.english: I too have been defrauded, chasing after worldly entanglements; my Husband Lord has forsaken me - I practice the evil deeds of a wife without a spouse.
lines.transliteration: ha-o muth-rh ee Dh anDhai Dhaavan ee-aa pir chh odi-arh ee viDh ankaaray.

lines.english: In each and every home, are the brides of the Husband Lord; they gaze upon theirHandsome Lord with love and affection.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar kant  mahaylee-aa roorh ai hayt  pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਕੰਤੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ  ਰੂੜੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I sing the Praises of my True Husband Lord, and through the Naam, the Name of myHusband Lord, I blossom forth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mai pir sach salaahnaa ha-o rehsi-arh ee naam bh ataaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਹਉ ਰਹਿਸਅੜੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਭਤਾਰੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the soul-bride's dress is transformed, and she is adorned withTruth.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai vays palti-aa saa Dhan sach seegaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਵੇਸੁ ਪਲਿਟਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Come and meet with me, O brides of the Lord; let's meditate in remembrance on theCreator Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavhu milhu sahayleeho simrahu sirjanhaaro.

lines.english: Through the Naam, the soul-bride becomes the Lord's favorite; she is adorned withTruth.
lines.transliteration: ba-ee-ar naam sohaaganee sach savaaran haaro.

lines.english: Do not sing the songs of separation, O Nanak; reflect upon God. ||8||3|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 ] (581-4) vad-hans mehlaa 1. Wadahans, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gaavhu geet na birharh aa naanak barahm beechaaro. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ  ਨ ਿਬਰਹੜਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: The One who creates and dissolves the world - that Lord and Master alone knows His creative power.
lines.transliteration: jin jag siraj samaa-i-aa so saahib kudrat  jaanovaa.

lines.english: Do not search for the True Lord far away; recognize the Word of the Shabad in eachand every heart.
lines.transliteration: sachrhaa d oor na bh aalee-ai gh at ghat sabad  pachh aanovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗੁ ਿਸਰਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ਸੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਜਾਣੋਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Recognize the Shabad, and do not think that the Lord is far away; He created thiscreation.
lines.transliteration: sach sabad pachh aanhu door na jaan hu jin ayh rachnaa raachee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੜਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣੋਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains peace; without the Naam,he plays a losing game.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ay t aa sukh  paa-ay bin naavai pirh  kaachee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ  ਰਾਚੀ  ॥
lines.english: The One who established the Universe, He alone knows the Way; what can anyonesay?
lines.transliteration: jin thaapee biDh jaan ai so-ee ki-aa ko kahai vakh aano.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਪੜ ਕਾਚੀ  ॥
lines.english: The One who established the world cast the net of Maya over it; accept Him as yourLord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin jag thaap vataa-i-aa jaalo so saahib parvaan o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਥਾਪੀ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੋਈ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਵਖਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, he has come, and now he must get up and depart; this world is only a way-station.
lines.transliteration: baabaa aa-i-aa hai uth chaln aa aDh  panDh ai hai sansaarovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗੁ ਥਾਿਪ  ਵਤਾਇਆ  ਜਾਲ ਸੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Upon each and every head, the True Lord writes their destiny of pain and pleasure,according to their past actions.
lines.transliteration: sir sir sachrhai likh i-aa d ukh sukh  purab veechaarovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਹੈ ਉਿਠ ਚਲਣਾ  ਅਧ ਪੰਧੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੋਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: He bestows pain and pleasure, according to the deeds done; the record of these deeds stays with the soul.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  dee-aa jayhaa kee-aa so nibhai jee-a naalay.

lines.english: He does those deeds which the Creator Lord causes him to do; he attempts no otheractions.
lines.transliteration: jayhay karam karaa-ay kartaa d oojee kaar na bh aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ  ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸੋ ਿਨਬਹੈ  ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is detached, while the world is entangled in conflict; by HisCommand, He emancipates it.
lines.transliteration: aap niraalam DhanDh ai baaDh ee kar hukam chh adaavan haaro.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
lines.english: He may put this off today, but tomorrow he is seized by death; in love with duality, hepractices corruption. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aj kal kardi-aa kaal bi-aapai d oojai bh aa-ay vikaaro. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਧੀ  ਕਿਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The path of death is dark and dismal; the way cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: jam maarag panth na sujh-ee ujh arh anDh  gubaarovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜੁ ਕਿਲ  ਕਰਿਦਆ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਬਆਪੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਵਕਾਰੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There is no water, no quilt or mattress, and no food there.
lines.transliteration: naa jal layf tulaa-ee-aa naa bh ojan parkaarovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗ  ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਉਝੜੁ  ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੋਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: He receives no food there, no honor or water, no clothes or decorations.
lines.transliteration: bhojan bh aa-o na th andhaa paan ee naa kaaparh  seegaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਲੇਫ ਤੁਲਾਈਆ  ਨਾ ਭੋਜਨ  ਪਰਕਾਰੋਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: The chain is put around his neck, and the Messenger of Death standing over his headstrikes him; he cannot see the door of his home.
lines.transliteration: gal sangal sir maaray oobhou naa d eesai gh ar baaro.

lines.punjabi: ਭੋਜਨ  ਭਾਉ ਨ ਠੰਢਾ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਨਾ ਕਾਪੜੁ  ਸੀਗਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The seeds planted on this path do not sprout; bearing the weight of his sins upon his head, he regrets and repents.
lines.transliteration: ib kay raahay jamman naahee pachhut aanay sir bh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਲ  ਸੰਗਲੁ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਮਾਰੇ ਊਭੌ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Lord, no one is his friend; reflect upon this as true. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin saachay ko baylee naahee saachaa ayhu beechaaro. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਹੇ ਜੰਮਿਨ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਭਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: O Baba, they alone are known to truly weep and wail, who meet together and weep,chanting the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: baabaa roveh raveh so jaanee-ahi mil rovai gun  saarayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Defrauded by Maya and worldly affairs, the weepers weep.
lines.transliteration: rovai maa-i-aa muth-rh ee Dh anDh-rhaa rovan haarayvaa.

lines.english: DhanDh aa rovai mail na Dh ovai supnant ar sansaaro. They weep for the sake of worldly affairs, and they do not wash off their own filth; theworld is merely a dream.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਰਵਿਹ  ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Like the juggler, deceiving by his tricks, one is deluded by egotism, falsehood andillusion.
lines.transliteration: ji-o baajeegar bharmai bh oolai jh ooth muth ee ahankaaro.

lines.english: The Lord Himself reveals the Path; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.
lines.transliteration: aapay maarag paavanhaaraa aapay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Naam, are protected by the Perfect Guru, O Nanak;they merge in celestial bliss. ||4||4|| vfhMsu mhlw 1 ] (581-17) vad-hans mehlaa 1. Wadahans, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam ratay gur poorai raakh ay naanak sahj subh aa-ay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮੈ  ਭੂਲੈ ਝੂਿਠ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, whoever has come, will rise up and leave; this world is merely a false show.
lines.transliteration: baabaa aa-i-aa hai uth chaln aa ih jag jh ooth pasaarovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: One's true home is obtained by serving the True Lord; real Truth is obtained by being truthful.
lines.transliteration: sachaa ghar sachrh ai sayvee-ai sach kh araa sachi-aarovaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: By falsehood and greed, no place of rest is found, and no place in the world hereafteris obtained.
lines.transliteration: koorh lab jaaN thaa-ay na paasee agai lahai na th aa-o.

lines.english: No one invites him to come in and sit down. He is like a crow in a deserted home.
lines.transliteration: antar aa-o na baishu kahee-ai ji-o sunj ai ghar kaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਹੈ ਉਿਠ ਚਲਣਾ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੋਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Trapped by birth and death, he is separated from the Lord for such a long time; thewhole world is wasting away.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  vadaa vaychh orhaa binsai jag sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੜੈ  ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਚਆਰੋਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Greed, worldly entanglements and Maya deceive the world. Death hovers over its head, and causes it to weep. ||1|| pMnw 582
lines.transliteration: lab DhanDh ai maa-i-aa jagat  bhulaa-i-aa kaal kh arhaa roo-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Come, O Baba, and Siblings of Destiny - let's join together; take me in your arms, and bless me with your prayers.
lines.transliteration: baabaa aavhu bhaa-eeho gal milah mil mil d ayh aaseesaa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਆਵਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ  ਗਿਲ  ਿਮਲਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਦੇਹ ਆਸੀਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: O Baba, union with the True Lord cannot be broken; bless me with your prayers forunion with my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: baabaa sachrhaa mayl na chuk-ee pareet am kee-aa d ayh aseesaa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਸਚੜਾ  ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਕੀਆ  ਦੇਹ ਅਸੀਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Bless me with your prayers, that I may perform devotional worship service to my Lord; for those already united with Him, what is there to unite?
lines.transliteration: aaseesaa dayvho bh agat karayvho mili-aa kaa ki-aa maylo.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸੀਸਾ  ਦੇਵਹੋ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇਵਹੋ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਮੇਲੋ ॥
lines.english: Some have wandered away from the Name of the Lord, and lost the Path. The Wordof the Guru's Shabad is the true game.
lines.transliteration: ik bhoolay naavhu thayhhu thaavhu gur sabd ee sach kh aylo.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਥੇਹਹੁ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੋ ॥
lines.english: Do not go on Death's path; remain merged in the Word of the Shabad, the true formthroughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: jam maarag nahee jaanaa sabad  samaan aa jug jug saachai vaysay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਸਾਚੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Through good fortune, we meet such friends and relatives, who meet with the Guru,and escape the noose of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saajan sain milhu sanjogee gur mil kh olay faasay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੈਣ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਖੋਲੇ ਫਾਸੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Baba, we come into the world naked, into pain and pleasure, according to the record of our account.
lines.transliteration: baabaa naaNgrhaa aa-i-aa jag meh d ukh sukh  laykh  likhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਨਗੜਾ ਆਇਆ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The call of our pre-ordained destiny cannot be altered; it follows from our pastactions.
lines.transliteration: likhi-arh aa saahaa naa talai jayhrh aa purab kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਿਖਅੜਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਨਾ ਟਲੈ ਜੇਹੜਾ  ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord sits and writes of ambrosial nectar, and bitter poison; as the Lordattaches us, so are we attached.
lines.transliteration: bahi saachai likhi-aa amrit  bikhi-aa jit  laa-i-aa t it laagaa.

lines.english: The Charmer, Maya, has worked her charms, and the multi-colored thread is aroundeveryone's neck.
lines.transliteration: kamani-aaree kaaman  paa-ay baho rangee gal t aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣਆਰੀ  ਕਾਮਣ  ਪਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਗਿਲ ਤਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through shallow intellect, the mind becomes shallow, and one eats the fly, along with the sweets.
lines.transliteration: hochhee mat  bha-i-aa man hochh aa gurh  saa makh ee kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਛੀ ਮਿਤ ਭਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾ ਮਖੀ ਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Contrary to custom, he comes into the Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and naked he isbound down and sent away again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naa marjaad aa-i-aa kal bh eetar naaNgo banDh  chalaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ  ਆਇਆ  ਕਿਲ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਨਗੋ ਬੰਿਧ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Baba, weep and mourn if you must; the beloved soul is bound and driven off.
lines.transliteration: baabaa rovhu jay kisai rovnaa jaanee-arh aa banDh  pathaa-i-aa hai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਰੋਵਹੁ ਜੇ ਿਕਸੈ ਰੋਵਣਾ  ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ  ਬੰਿਧ ਪਠਾਇਆ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The pre-ordained record of destiny cannot be erased; the summons has come fromthe Lord's Court.
lines.transliteration: likhi-arh aa laykh  na maytee-ai d ar haakaararh aa aa-i-aa hai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਿਖਅੜਾ  ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੀਐ  ਦਿਰ ਹਾਕਾਰੜਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The messenger comes, when it pleases the Lord, and the mourners begin to mourn.
lines.transliteration: haakaaraa aa-i-aa jaa tis bh aa-i-aa runnay rovan haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਕਾਰਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਜਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ਰੁੰਨੇ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Sons, brothers, nephews and very dear friends weep and wail.
lines.transliteration: put bh aa-ee bh aateejay roveh pareet am at  pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਤੀਜੇ  ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Let him weep, who weeps in the Fear of God, cherishing the virtues of God. No onedies with the dead.
lines.transliteration: bhai rovai gun  saar samaalay ko marai na mu-i-aa naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਕੋ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮੁਇਆ  ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, throughout the ages, they are known as wise, who weep, remembering theTrue Lord. ||4||5|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 mhlw qIjw  (582-12) vad-hans mehlaa 3 mehlaa teejaa Wadahans, Third Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (582-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jug jug jaan sijaan aa roveh sach samaalay. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੁਿਗ ਜੁਿਗ  ਜਾਣ  ਿਸਜਾਣਾ  ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Praise God, the True Lord; He is all-powerful to do all things.
lines.transliteration: parabh sachrh aa har salaahee-ai kaaraj sabh  kichh  karnai jog.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਮਹਲਾ  ਤੀਜਾ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to endure suffering.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan rand na kabhoo bais-ee naa kad ay hovai sog.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਚੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣੈ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: She shall never suffer - night and day, she enjoys pleasures; that soul-bride merges in the Mansion of her Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: naa kaday hovai sog an-d in ras bh og saa Dh an mahal samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਬੈਸਈ  ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: She knows her Beloved, the Architect of karma, and she speaks words of ambrosialsweetness.
lines.transliteration: jin pari-o jaataa karam biDh aataa bolay amrit  banee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਿਲ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous soul-brides dwell on the Lord's virtues; they keep their Husband Lord intheir remembrance, and so they never suffer separation from Him.
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee-aa gun  saareh apn ay kant  samaaleh naa kad ay lagai vijogo.

lines.english: So praise your True Husband Lord, who is all-powerful to do all things. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachrhaa pir salaahee-ai sabh  kichh  karnai jogo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀਆ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਹ  ਅਪਣੇ  ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਲਿਹ  ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਲਗੈ ਿਵਜੋਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord and Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad; He blends allwith Himself.
lines.transliteration: sachrhaa saahib sabad  pachh aanee-ai aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: That soul-bride is imbued with the Love of her Husband Lord, who banishes her self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan pari-a kai rang rat ee vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੜਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Eradicating her ego from within herself, death shall not consume her again; as Gurmukh, she knows the One Lord God.
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap gavaa-ay fir kaal na khaa-ay gurmukh  ayko jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੀ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The desire of the soul-bride is fulfilled; deep within herself, she is drenched in HisLove. She meets the Great Giver, the Life of the World.
lines.transliteration: kaaman ichh  punnee ant ar bhinnee mili-aa jagjeevan d aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with love for the Shabad, she is like a youth intoxicated; she merges into thevery being of her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad rang raat ee joban maat ee pir kai ank samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਭੰਨੀ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad. He blends all withHimself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sachrhaa saahib sabad  pachh aanee-ai aapay la-ay milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਮਾਤੀ  ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him. pMnw 583
lines.transliteration: jinee aapnaa kant  pachh aani-aa ha-o t in poochh a-o sant aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Renouncing ego, I serve them; thus I meet my True Husband Lord, with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: aap chhod sayvaa karee pir sachrh aa milai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The True Husband Lord comes to meet the soul-bride who practices Truth, and isimbued with the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: pir sachaa milai aa-ay saach kamaa-ay saach sabad Dh an raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਿਮਲੈ ਆਏ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਧਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: She shall never become a widow; she shall always be a happy bride. Deep within herself, she dwells in the celestial bliss of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: kaday na raaNd sad aa sohagan  antar sahj samaaDh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰਡ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਧੀ  ॥
lines.english: Her Husband Lord is fully pervading everywhere; beholding Him ever-present, sheenjoys His Love, with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: pir rahi-aa bharpooray vaykh  hadooray rang maan ay sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him.||3||
lines.transliteration: jinee aapnaa kant  pachh aani-aa ha-o t in poochh a-o sant aa jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the Feet of theTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: pirahu vichhunnee-aa bh ee milah jay sat gur laagah saachay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰਹੁ ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀਆ  ਭੀ ਿਮਲਹ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਲਾਗਹ  ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is forever merciful; through the Word of His Shabad, demerits areburnt away.
lines.transliteration: satgur sad aa da-i-aal hai avgun  sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Burning away her demerits through the Shabad, the soul-bride eradicates her love ofduality, and remains absorbed in the True, True Lord.
lines.transliteration: a-ogun sabad  jalaa-ay d oojaa bh aa-o gavaa-ay sachay hee sach raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗੁਣ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਏ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਏ  ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Shabad, everlasting peace is obtained, and egotism and doubt aredispelled.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa ha-umai ga-ee bh araatee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਈ ਭਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Husband Lord is forever the Giver of peace; O Nanak, through theWord of His Shabad, He is met.
lines.transliteration: pir nirmaa-il sadaa sukh -daata naanak sabad  milaa-ay.

lines.english: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the feet of the True Guru. ||4||1|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (583-7) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pirahu vichhunnee-aa bh ee milah jay sat gur laagah saachay paa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰਹੁ ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀਆ  ਭੀ ਿਮਲਹ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਲਾਗਹ  ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate theWord of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: suni-ahu kant  mahayleeho pir sayvihu sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: The worthless bride does not know her Husband Lord - she is deluded; forgetting herHusband Lord, she weeps and wails.
lines.transliteration: avganvant ee pir na jaan -ee muth ee rovai kant  visaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ  ਿਪਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: She weeps, thinking of her Husband Lord, and she cherishes His virtues; her HusbandLord does not die, and does not leave.
lines.transliteration: rovai kant sammaal sad aa gun  saar naa pir marai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, she knows the Lord; through the Word of His Shabad, He is realized;through True Love, she merges with Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaat aa sabad  pachh aataa saachai paraym samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਸੰਮਾਿਲ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ਨਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: She who does not know her Husband Lord, the Architect of karma, is deluded byfalsehood - she herself is false.
lines.transliteration: jin apnaa pir nahee jaat aa karam biDh aataa koorh  muth ee koorh i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਸਾਚੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate theWord of His Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: suni-ahu kant  mahayleeho pir sayvihu sabad  veechaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ ਅਪਣਾ  ਿਪਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਕੂਿੜ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂਿੜਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag aap upaa-i-on aavan  jaan sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ  ਿਪਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The love of Maya has ruined the world; people die, to be re-born, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh khu-aa-i-an mar jammai vaaro vaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: People die to be re-born, over and over again, while their sins increase; withoutspiritual wisdom, they are deluded.
lines.transliteration: mar jammai vaaro vaaraa vaDheh bikaaraa gi-aan vihoon ee mooth ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਅਨ ੁ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, the Husband Lord is not found; the worthless, false bride wastes her life away, weeping and wailing.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai pir na paa-i-o janam gavaa-i-o rovai avgun i-aaree jh oothee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ  ਵਧਿਹ  ਿਬਕਾਰਾ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਵਹੂਣੀ ਮੂਠੀ ॥
lines.english: He is my Beloved Husband Lord, the Life of the World - for whom should I weep?They alone weep, who forget their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: pir jagjeevan kis no ro-ee-ai rovai kant visaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਿਪਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਓ  ਰੋਵੈ ਅਵਗੁਿਣਆਰੀ  ਝੂਠੀ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh jag aap upaa-i-on aavan  jaan sansaaray. ||2||

lines.english: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave.
lines.transliteration: so pir sachaa sad hee saachaa hai naa oh marai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The ignorant soul-bride wanders in delusion; in the love of duality, she sits like awidow.
lines.transliteration: bhoolee firai Dh an i-aan ee-aa rand baith ee doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ  ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: She sits like a widow, in the love of duality; through emotional attachment to Maya, she suffers in pain. She is growing old, and her body is withering away.
lines.transliteration: rand baithee d oojai bh aa-ay maa-i-aa mohi d ukh paa-ay aav gh atai tan chh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲੀ ਿਫਰੈ ਧਨ ਇਆਣੀਆ  ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Whatever has come, all that shall pass away; through the love of duality, they sufferin pain.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh aa-i-aa sabh  kichh  jaasee d ukh laagaa bh aa-ay d oojai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: They do not see the Messenger of Death; they long for Maya, and their consciousnessis attached to greed.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal na soojhai maa-i-aa jag loojh ai lab lobh  chit laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਸੀ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਭਾਇ  ਦੂਜੈ ॥
lines.english: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave.||3||
lines.transliteration: so pir saachaa sad hee saachaa naa oh marai na jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਗੁ ਲੂਝੈ ਲਿਬ  ਲੋਿਭ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not knowthat their Husband is with them.
lines.transliteration: ik roveh pireh vichhunnee-aa anDh ee naa jaan ai pir naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they may meet with their True Husband, and cherish Him alwaysdeep within.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee saachaa pir milai antar sad aa samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰਿਹ ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀਆ  ਅੰਧੀ  ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਪਰੁ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: She cherishes her Husband deep within herself - He is always with her; the self-willedmanmukhs think that He is far away.
lines.transliteration: pir antar samaalay sad aa hai naalay manmukh  jaataa dooray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਪਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: This body rolls in the dust, and is totally useless; it does not realize the Presence of the Lord and Master. pMnw 584
lines.transliteration: ih tan rulai rulaa-i-aa kaam na aa-i-aa jin kh asam na jaat aa had ooray.

lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride is united in Union; she cherishes her Beloved Husband forever, deep within herself.
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan milai milaa-ee pir ant ar sad aa samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਿਪਰੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not knowthat their Husband is with them. ||4||2|| vfhMsu mÚ 3 ] (584-2) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ik roveh pireh vichhunnee-aa anDh ee na jaan ai pir hai naalay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰਿਹ  ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਪਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but myTrue Husband Lord is always with me.
lines.transliteration: roveh pireh vichhunnee-aa mai pir sachrh aa hai sad aa naalay.

lines.english: Those who know that they must depart, serve the True Guru, and dwell upon theNaam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee chalan sahee jaan i-aa sat gur sayveh naam samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰਿਹ  ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀਆ  ਮੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ  ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They dwell constantly upon the Naam, and the True Guru is with them; they serve theTrue Guru, and so obtain peace.
lines.transliteration: sadaa naam samaalay sat gur hai naalay sat gur sayv sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਚਲਣੁ  ਸਹੀ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, they kill death, and enshrine the True Lord within their hearts;they shall not have to come and go again.
lines.transliteration: sabday kaal maar sach ur Dh aar fir aavan  jaan na ho-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; bestowing His Gracious Glance,one is enraptured.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naa-ee vaykhai nad ar nihaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: roveh pirahu vichhunnee-aa mai pir sachrh aa hai sad aa naalay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ  ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved?
lines.transliteration: parabh mayraa saahib sabh  doo oochaa hai kiv milaaN pareet am pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਿਪਰਹੁ ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀਆ  ਮੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ  ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the True Guru united me, then I was naturally united with my Husband Lord,and now, I keep Him clasped to my heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur maylee t aaN sahj milee pir raakh i-aa ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ  ਹੈ ਿਕਵ ਿਮਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I constantly, lovingly cherish my Beloved within my heart; through the True Guru, Isee my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: sadaa ur Dh aaray nayhu naal pi-aaray sat gur tay pir d isai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਲੀ ਤ ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The cloak of Maya's love is false; wearing it, one slips and loses his footing.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh kaa kachaa cholaa tit  paiDh ai pag kh isai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਿਪਰੁ ਿਦਸੈ ॥
lines.english: That cloak is true, which is dyed in the color of the Love of my Beloved; wearing it,my inner thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: pir rang raataa so sachaa cholaa t it paiDh ai tikhaa nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਕਾ ਕਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਪੈਧੈ ਪਗੁ ਿਖਸੈ ॥
lines.english: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved? ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh mayraa saahib sabh  doo oochaa hai ki-o milaa pareet am pi-aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਪੈਧੈ ਿਤਖਾ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray.
lines.transliteration: mai parabh sach pachh aani-aa hor bh oolee avgan i-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ  ਹੈ ਿਕਉ  ਿਮਲਾ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I dwell constantly upon my Beloved Husband Lord, and reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mai sadaa raavay pir aapn aa sachrh ai sabad  veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਿਣਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The bride reflects upon the True Shabad, and is imbued with His Love; she meets withthe True Guru, and finds her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad veechaaray rang raat ee naaray mil sat gur pareet am paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਿਪਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਚੜੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within, she is imbued with His Love, and intoxicated with delight; her enemies and sufferings are all taken away.
lines.transliteration: antar rang raat ee sehjay maat ee ga-i-aa d usman d ookh sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਨਾਰੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Surrender body and soul to your Guru, and then you shall become happy; your thirst and pain shall be taken away.
lines.transliteration: apnay gur kaN-u tan man d eejai t aaN man bh eejai t arisnaa d ookh nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੀ  ਗਇਆ  ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray.||3||
lines.transliteration: mai pir sach pachhaan i-aa hor bh oolee avgan i-aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਤ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitchdarkness.
lines.transliteration: sachrhai aap jagat  upaa-i-aa gur bin gh or anDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਿਣਆਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself unites, and causes us to unite with Him; He Himself blesses us with HisLove.
lines.transliteration: aap milaa-ay aap milai aapay day-ay pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੜੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself blesses us with His Love, and deals in celestial peace; the life of theGurmukh is reformed.
lines.transliteration: aapay day-ay pi-aaro sahj vaapaaro gurmukh  janam savaaray.

lines.english: Dhan jag meh aa-i-aa aap gavaa-i-aa d ar saachai sachi-aaro. Blessed is his coming into the world; he banishes his self-conceit, and is acclaimed as true in the Court of the True Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਵਾਪਾਰੋ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The light of the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines within his heart, O Nanak, and heloves the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan ratan gh at chaanan  ho-aa naanak naam pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitchdarkness. ||4||3|| vfhMsu mhlw 3 ] (584-16) vad-hans mehlaa 3. Wadahans, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sachrhai aap jagat  upaa-i-aa gur bin gh or anDh aaro. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਰਤਿਨ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it.
lines.transliteration: ih sareer jajree hai is no jar pahuchai aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੜੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while others die, to be reincarnated;they continue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray hor mar jammai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going, and in the end, theydepart regretfully. Without the Name, there is no peace.
lines.transliteration: hor mar jameh aavahi jaaveh ant ga-ay pachh utaavahi bin naavai sukh  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ  ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: As one acts here, so does he obtain his rewards; the self-willed manmukh loses hishonor.
lines.transliteration: aithai kamaavai so fal paavai manmukh hai pat  kho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹੋਰੁ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: In the City of Death, there is pitch darkness, and huge clouds of dust; neither sister nor brother is there.
lines.transliteration: jam pur ghor anDh aar mahaa gubaar naa t ithai bh ain na bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih sareer jajree hai is no jar pahuchai aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਹੈ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself. pMnw 585
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kanchan taaN thee-ai jaaN satgur la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤ ਥੀਐ  ਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Doubt and Maya have been removed from within me, and I am merged in the Naam, the True Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bharam maa-i-aa vichahu katee-ai sachrh ai naam samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਸਚੜੈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Merged in the True Name of the Lord, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; meetingmy Beloved, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: sachai naam samaa-ay har gun gaa-ay mil pareet am sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I am in constant bliss, day and night; egotism has been dispelled from within me.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee vichahu haN-umai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਹੰਉਮੈ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I fall at the feet of those who enshrine the Naam within their consciousness.
lines.transliteration: jinee purkhee har naam chit  laa-i-aa t in kai haN-u laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaaN-i-aa kanchan taaN thee-ai jaa sat gur la-ay milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਇਆ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤ ਥੀਐ  ਜਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding.
lines.transliteration: so sachaa sach salaahee-ai jay satgur d ay-ay bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt; going to the world hereafter, what face will they display?
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aram bh ulaan ee-aa ki-aa muhu d aysan aagai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ  ਿਕਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਿਨ  ਆਗੈ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: What face will they show, when they go there? They will regret and repent for theirsins; their actions will bring them only pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa dayn muhu jaa-ay avgun  pachh utaa-ay d ukho dukh kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਦੇਿਨ  ਮੁਹੁ ਜਾਏ ਅਵਗੁਿਣ  ਪਛੁਤਾਏ  ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Naam are dyed in the deep crimson color of theLord's Love; they merge into the Being of their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam ratee-aa say rang chaloolaa pir kai ank samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੀਆ  ਸੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲਾ  ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I can conceive of no other as great as the Lord; unto whom should I go and speak?
lines.transliteration: tis jayvad avar na soojh -ee kis aagai kahee-ai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so sachaa sach salaahee-ai jay satgur d ay-ay bujh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I fall at the feet of those who praise the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: jinee sachrhaa sach sahaali-aa haN-u tin laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੜਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਿਹਆ  ਹੰਉ ਿਤਨ  ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings are true, and immaculately pure; meeting them, all filth iswashed off.
lines.transliteration: say jan sachay nirmalay tin mili-aa mal sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਿਤਨ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Meeting them, all filth is washed off; bathing in the Pool of Truth, one becomestruthful, with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: tin mili-aa mal sabh  jaa-ay sachai sar naa-ay sachai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has given me the realization of the Naam, the Immaculate Name of the Lord, the unfathomable, the imperceptible.
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan agam agochar satgur d ee-aa bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who perform devotional worship to the Lord night and day, are imbued with HisLove; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahi rang raat ay naanak sach samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I fall at the feet of those who meditate on the Truest of the True. ||4||4|| vfhMs kI vwr mhlw 4 llW bhlImw kI Duin gwvxI (585-11) vad-hans kee vaar mehlaa 4 lalaaN behleemaa kee Dhun gaavn ee Vaar Of Wadahans, Fourth Mehl: To Be Sung In The Tune Of Lalaa-Behleemaa: <> siqgur pRswid ] (585-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mÚ 3 ] (585-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinee sachrhaa sach Dh i-aa-i-aa haN-u tin kai laaga-o paa-ay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੜਾ  ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਹੰਉ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The great swans are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they enshrine the TrueName within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay vad hans hai sach naam ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਹੰਸ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਲਲ  ਬਹਲੀਮਾ  ਕੀ ਧੁਿਨ ਗਾਵਣੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: They gather Truth, remain always in Truth, and love the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sach sangr-hahi sad sach raheh sachai naam pi-aar.

lines.english: They are always pure and immaculate - filth does not touch them; they are blessedwith the Grace of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa nirmal mail na lag-ee nad ar keet ee kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਵਡ ਹੰਸ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who, night and day, meditate on the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (585-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-o tin kai balihaarn ai jo an-d in jaapeh muraar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹਿਹ  ਸਦ ਸਿਚ ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I thought that he was a great swan, so I associated with him.
lines.transliteration: mai jaani-aa vad hans hai taa mai kee-aa sang.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕੀਤੀ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: If I had known that he was only a wretched heron from birth, I would not havetouched him. ||2|| mÚ 3 ] (585-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay jaanaa bag bapurh aa ta janam na d aydee ang. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਜੋ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਪਿਹ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seeing the swans swimming, the herons became envious.
lines.transliteration: hansaa vaykh t arand i-aa bagaaN bhe aa-yaa chaa-o.

lines.english: But the poor herons drowned and died, and floated with their heads down, and theirfeet above. ||3|| pauVI ] (585-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: dub mu-ay bag bapurhay sir t al upar paa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ  ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are Yourself, all by Yourself; You Yourself created the creation.
lines.transliteration: too aapay hee aap aap hai aap kaaran  kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ  ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ  ਤ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਦੇਦੀ  ਅੰਗੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself are Yourself the Formless Lord; there is no other than You.
lines.transliteration: too aapay aap nirankaar hai ko avar na bee-aa.

lines.english: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes; what You do, comes to be.
lines.transliteration: too karan  kaaran  samrath hai t oo karahi so thee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸਾ ਵੇਿਖ ਤਰੰਿਦਆ  ਬਗ  ਿਭ ਆਯਾ  ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: You give gifts to all beings, without their asking.
lines.transliteration: too an mangi-aa d aan d ayvnaa sabh naahaa jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਡੁਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ  ਿਸਰੁ ਤਿਲ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Everyone proclaims, "Waaho! Waaho! Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has given the supreme gift of the Name of the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 586 sloku mÚ 3 ] (586-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh aakh ahu sat gur vaahu vaahu jin d aan har naam mukh  dee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The entire universe is in fear; only the Dear Lord is fearless.
lines.transliteration: bhai vich sabh  aakaar hai nirbh a-o har jee-o so-ay.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, fear cannotstay there.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai har man vasai t ithai bh a-o kad ay na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Enemies and pain cannot come close, and no one can touch him.
lines.transliteration: dusman d ukh tis no nayrh  na aavai pohi na sakai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਥੈ ਭਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh reflects upon the Lord in his mind; whatever pleases the Lord - that alone comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man veechaari-aa jo t is bhaavai so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਪੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself preserves one's honor; He alone resolves our affairs. ||1||- mÚ 3 ] (586-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay hee pat rakh see kaaraj savaaray so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਿਨ ਵੀਚਾਿਰਆ ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Some friends are leaving, some have already left, and those remaining will eventuallyleave.
lines.transliteration: ik sajan chalay ik chal ga-ay rahd ay bh ee fun jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਪਿਤ ਰਖਸੀ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, come and go regretting.
lines.transliteration: jinee satgur na sayvi-o say aa-ay ga-ay pachh utaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to Truth are not separated; serving the True Guru,they merge into the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (586-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach ratay say na vichh urheh sat gur sayv samaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਸਜਣ  ਚਲੇ ਇਿਕ  ਚਿਲ  ਗਏ ਰਹਦੇ  ਭੀ ਫੁਿਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Meet with that True Guru, the True Friend, within whose mind the Lord, the virtuousOne, abides.
lines.transliteration: tis milee-ai sat gur sajn ai jis ant ar har gun kaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਸੇ ਆਇ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Meet with that Beloved True Guru, who has subdued ego from within himself.
lines.transliteration: tis milee-ai sat gur pareet amai jin haN-umai vichahu maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed is the Perfect True Guru, who has given the Lord's Teachings to reform the whole world.
lines.transliteration: so satgur pooraa Dh an Dh an hai jin har upd ays day sabh  sarisat savaaree.

lines.english: O Saints, meditate constantly on the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying,poisonous world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: nit japi-ahu sant ahu raam naam bh a-ojal bikh  taaree.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has taught me about the Lord; I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (586-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har updaysi-aa gur vitrh i-ahu haN-u sad  vaaree. ||2||

lines.english: Service to, and obedience to the True Guru, is the essence of comfort and peace.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa chaakree sukh ee hooN sukh  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਦੇ ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਿਸ੍ਟ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Doing so, one obtains honor here, and the door of salvation in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aithai milan vadi-aa-ee-aa d argeh mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਜਿਪਅਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਉਜਲ  ਿਬਖੁ ਤਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: In this way, perform the tasks of Truth, wear Truth, and take the Support of the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavnee sach painan  sach naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਿੜਅਹ ੁ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Associating with Truth, obtain Truth, and love the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sachee sangat sach milai sachai naa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, be always happy, and you shall be acclaimedas True in the True Court.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad harakh  sadaa dar sachai sachiaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone serves the True Guru, whom the Creator has blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (586-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur kee sayvaa so karai jis no nad ar karai kart aar. ||1||

lines.english: Cursed is the life, and cursed is the dwelling, of those who serve another.
lines.transliteration: hor vidaanee chaakree Dh arig jeevan  Dharig vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Abandoning the Ambrosial Nectar, they turn to poison; they earn poison, and poison istheir only wealth.
lines.transliteration: amrit chh od bikh  lagay bikh  khatnaa bikh  raas.

lines.english: Poison is their food, and poison is their dress; they fill their mouths with morsels ofpoison.
lines.transliteration: bikh kh aanaa bikh  painn aa bikh  kay mukh  giraas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਰਖੁ  ਸਦਾ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In this world, they earn only pain and suffering, and dying, they go to abide in hell.
lines.transliteration: aithai dukh o dukh kamaavan aa mu-i-aa narak nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have filthy faces; they do not know the Word of theShabad; in sexual desire and anger they waste away.
lines.transliteration: manmukh muhi mailai sabad  na jaan nee kaam karoDh  vinaas.

lines.english: They forsake the Fear of the True Guru, and because of their stubborn ego, theirefforts do not come to fruition.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh a-o chh odi-aa manhath  kamm na aavai raas.

lines.english: In the City of Death, they are bound and beaten, and no one hears their prayers.
lines.transliteration: jam pur baDhay maaree-ah ko na sun ay ard aas.

lines.english: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; the Gurmukh abides in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (586-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhi-aa kamaavan aa gurmukh  naam nivaas. ||2||

lines.english: Serve the True Guru, O Holy people; He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, inour minds.
lines.transliteration: so satgur sayvihu saaDh  jan jin har har naam drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਮੁਇਆ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Worship the True Guru day and night; He leads us the meditate on the Lord of theUniverse, the Master of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: so satgur poojahu d inas raat  jin jagannaath jagd ees japaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਿਹ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਿਧ  ਿਵਣਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Behold the True Guru, each and every moment; He shows us the Divine Path of theLord.
lines.transliteration: so satgur d aykhhu ik nimakh  nimakh  jin har kaa har panth bat aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone fall at the feet of the True Guru; He has dispelled the darkness ofemotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: tis sat gur kee sabh  pagee pavahu jin moh anDh ayr chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone hail and praise the True Guru, who has led us to find the treasure of theLord's devotional worship. ||3|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (586-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so satgur kahhu sabh  Dhan Dh an jin har bh agat bhandaar lahaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, hunger departs; by wearing the robes of a beggar, hunger does not depart. pMnw 587
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai bh ukh ga-ee bh aykhee bh ukh na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Afflicted with pain, he wanders from house to house, and in the world hereafter, he receives double punishment.
lines.transliteration: dukh lagai gh ar ghar firai agai d oonee milai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਖ ਲਗੈ ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਫਰੈ ਅਗੈ ਦੂਣੀ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Peace does not come to his heart - he is not content to eat what comes his way.
lines.transliteration: andar sahj na aa-i-o sehjay hee lai kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਲੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: With his stubborn mind, he begs, and grabs, and annoys those who give.
lines.transliteration: manhath jis t ay mangn aa lain aa dukh manaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਣਾ  ਲੈਣਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਮਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Instead of wearing these beggar's robes, it is better to be a householder, and give toothers.
lines.transliteration: is bhaykh ai thaavhu girho bh alaa jithahu ko varsaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਭੇਖੈ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਿਗਰਹੋ  ਭਲਾ ਿਜਥਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Word of the Shabad, acquire understanding; the otherswander, deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay tinaa sojh ee pa-ee d oojai bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਿਤਨਾ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They act according to their past actions; it is useless to talk to them.
lines.transliteration: pa-i-ai kirat kamaavan aa kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਇਐ  ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing unto the Lord are good; He upholds their honor.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (587-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bh aaveh say bh alay jin kee pat  paavahi thaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਿਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਥਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one finds a lasting peace; the pains of birth and death areremoved.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai sad aa sukh  janam maran  dukh jaa-ay.

lines.english: He is not troubled by anxiety, and the carefree Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: chintaa mool na hova-ee achint  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within himself, is the sacred shrine of spiritual wisdom, revealed by the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: antar t irath gi-aan hai sat gur dee-aa bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: His filth is removed, and his soul becomes immaculately pure, bathing in the sacredshrine, the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: mail ga-ee man nirmal ho-aa amrit sar t irath naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The friend meets with the True Friend, the Lord, through the love of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sajan milay sajn aa sachai sabad  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਿਰ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of his own being, he finds the Divine Self, and his light blends withthe Light.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee parchaa paa-i-aa jot ee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not leave the hypocrite; he is led away in dishonor.
lines.transliteration: pakhand jamkaal na chh od-ee lai jaasee pat  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are saved; they are in love with theTrue Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (587-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say ubray sachay si-o liv laa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਛੋਡਈ  ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Go, and sit in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Name of the Lord is churned.
lines.transliteration: tit jaa-ay bahhu sat sangt ee jithai har kaa har naam bilo-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In peace and poise, contemplate the Lord's Name - don't lose the essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee har naam layho har tat  na kh o-ee-ai.

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, constantly, day and night, and you shall beaccepted in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nit japi-ahu har har d inas raat  har d argeh dh oo-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਜਾਇ  ਬਹਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ  ਿਜਥੈ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਬਲੋਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He alone finds the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such a pre-ordained destinyis written.
lines.transliteration: so paa-ay pooraa satguroo jis Dh ur mast ak lilaat likh o-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਖੋਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone bow in worship to the Guru, who utters the sermon of the Lord. ||4|| slok mÚ 3 ] (587-11) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis gur kaN-u sabh  namaskaar karahu jin har kee har gaal galo-ee-ai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਜਿਪਅਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਢੋਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The friends who love the True Guru, meet with the Lord, the True Friend.
lines.transliteration: sajan milay sajn aa jin sat gur naal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਜਸੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਲਾਿਟ  ਿਲਖੋਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting their Beloved, they meditate on the True Lord with love and affection.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam t inee Dh i-aa-i-aa sachai paraym pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਸਿਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਲ  ਗਲੋਈਐ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Their minds are appeased by their own minds, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man hee tay man maani-aa gur kai sabad  apaar.

lines.english: These friends are united, and will not be separated again; they have been united bythe Creator Lord Himself.
lines.transliteration: ayhi sajan milay na vichh urheh je aap maylay kart aar.

lines.english: Some do not believe in the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; they do notcontemplate the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: iknaa darsan kee part eet na aa-ee-aa sabad  na karahi veechaar.

lines.english: The separated ones are in love with duality - what more separation can they suffer?
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa kaa ki-aa vichh urhai jinaa d oojai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs lasts for only a few short days.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sayt ee dostee thorh -rhi-aa d in chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਏਿਹ ਸਜਣ  ਿਮਲੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਿਜ ਆਿਪ  ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: This friendship is broken in an instant; this friendship leads to corruption.
lines.transliteration: is pareetee t utdee vilam na hova-ee it  dostee chalan vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਈਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰਿਹ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They do not fear the True Lord within their hearts, and they do not love the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jinaa andar sachay kaa bh a-o naahee naam na karahi pi-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, why become friends with those whom the Creator Lord Himself has misled?||1|| mÚ 3 ] (587-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin si-o ki-aa keechai d ostee je aap bh ulaa-ay kart aar. ||1||

lines.english: Some remain constantly imbued with the Lord's Love; I am forever a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: ik sadaa ikt ai rang raheh t in kai ha-o sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ  ਤੁਟਦੀ  ਿਵਲਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਇਤੁ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਚਲਿਨ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind, soul and wealth to them; bowing low, I fall at their feet.
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an arpee t in ka-o niv niv laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Meeting them, the soul is satisfied, and one's hunger and thirst all depart.
lines.transliteration: tin mili-aa man sant okhee-ai t arisnaa bh ukh sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਸਉ ਿਕਆ ਕੀਚੈ  ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਿਜ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are happy forever; they lovingly focus their minds on the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (587-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sukh ee-ay sad aa sachay si-o liv laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who recites the sermon of the Lord's Teachings. pMnw 588
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o ha-o vaari-aa jin har kee har kathaa sun aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru, who has led me to serve the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o sad  balihaarn ai jin har sayvaa ban at banaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That Beloved True Guru is always with me; wherever I may be, He will save me.
lines.transliteration: so satgur pi-aaraa mayrai naal hai jithai kithai maino la-ay chh adaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਹੈ ਿਜਥੈ ਿਕਥੈ ਮੈਨੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Most blessed is that Guru, who imparts understanding of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o saabaas hai jin har sojh ee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has given me the Lord's Name, and fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||5|| slok mÚ 3 ] (588-4) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur vitahu vaari-aa jin har naam dee-aa mayray man kee aas puraa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਪੁਰਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Consumed by desires, the world is burning and dying; burning and burning, it criesout.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa d aaDhee jal mu-ee jal jal karay pukaar.

lines.english: But if it meets with the cooling and soothing True Guru, it does not burn any longer.
lines.transliteration: satgur seet al jay milai fir jalai na d oojee vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਦਾਧੀ  ਜਿਲ  ਮੁਈ ਜਿਲ  ਜਿਲ  ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, and without contemplating the Word of the Shabad, noone becomes fearless. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (588-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai nirbh a-o ko nahee jichar sabad  na karay veechaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੀਤਲ  ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Wearing ceremonial robes, the fire is not quenched, and the mind is filled withanxiety.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh ee agan na bujh -ee chint aa hai man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਿਜਚਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Destroying the snake's hole, the snake is not killed; it is just like doing deeds withouta Guru.
lines.transliteration: varmee maaree saap na marai ti-o niguray karam kamaahi.

lines.english: Serving the Giver, the True Guru, the Shabad comes to abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa sayvee-ai sabad  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖੀ ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਬੁਝਈ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The mind and body are cooled and soothed; peace ensues, and the fire of desire is quenched.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al saaNt ho-ay t arisnaa agan bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਮੀ  ਮਾਰੀ  ਸਾਪੁ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਿਤਉ  ਿਨਗੁਰੇ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The supreme comforts and lasting peace are obtained, when one eradicates ego fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: sukhaa sir sad aa sukh  ho-ay jaa vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He alone becomes a detached Gurmukh, who lovingly focuses his consciousness onthe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ud aasee so karay je sach rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Anxiety does not affect him at all; he is satisfied and satiated with the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: chintaa mool na hova-ee har naam rajaa aagh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਾ ਿਸਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, no one is saved; they are utterly ruined by egotism. ||2|| pauVI ] (588-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam binaa nah chhootee-ai ha-umai pacheh pachaa-ay. ||2||
