lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, obtain all peace and comforts.
lines.transliteration: jinee har har naam Dhi-aa-i-aa t inee paa-i-arh ay sarab sukh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਜਾ ਆਘਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the entire life of those, who hunger for the Name of the Lord in their minds.
lines.transliteration: sabh janam t inaa kaa safal hai jin har kay naam kee man laagee bh ukhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਚਿਹ  ਪਚਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who worship the Lord in adoration, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad,forget all their pains and suffering.
lines.transliteration: jinee gur kai bachan aaraaDhi-aa t in visar ga-ay sabh  dukhaa.

lines.english: Those Gursikhs are good Saints, who care for nothing other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tay sant  bhalay gursikh  hai jin naahee chint  paraa-ee chukh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਪਾਇਅੜੇ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an tinaa kaa guroo hai jis amrit  fal har laagay mukh aa. ||6|| Blessed, blessed is their Guru, whose mouth tastes the Ambrosial Fruit of the Lord's Name. ||6|| slok mÚ 3 ] (588-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ਭੁਖਾ ॥
lines.english: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Messenger of Death is the enemy of life, but he actsaccording to the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: kal meh jam jandaar hai hukmay kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਗਏ ਸਿਭ ਦੁਖਾ ॥
lines.english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while the self-willed manmukhsreceive their punishment.
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray manmukh aa day-ay sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਗੁ ਰਿਸਖ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਚੰਤ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਚੁਖਾ ॥
lines.english: The world is under the control, and in the bondage of the Messenger of Death; no onecan hold him back.
lines.transliteration: jamkaalai vas jag baaNDhi-aa t is daa faroo na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਗੇ  ਮੁਖਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: So serve the One who created Death; as Gurmukh, no pain shall touch you.
lines.transliteration: jin jam keetaa so sayvee-ai gurmukh  dukh na ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, Death serves the Gurmukhs; the True Lord abides in their minds. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (588-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh jam sayvaa karay jin man sachaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This body is filled with disease; without the Word of the Shabad, the pain of the disease of ego does not depart.
lines.transliteration: ayhaa kaa-i-aa rog bharee bin sabd ai dukh ha-umai rog na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When one meets the True Guru, then he becomes immaculately pure, and heenshrines the Lord's Name within his mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t aa nirmal hovai har naamo man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ  ਵਿਸ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਧਆ  ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਫਰੂ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Peace-Giving Lord, his pains are automatically forgotten. ||2|| pauVI ] (588-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa sukh -daata dukh visri-aa sahj subh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ  ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has taught me about the Lord, the Life ofthe World.
lines.transliteration: jin jagjeevan updaysi-aa t is gur ka-o ha-o sad aa gh umaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਮੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am every bit a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lover of Nectar, who has revealed the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o ha-o kh annee-ai jin maDh usood an har naam sun aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has totally cured me of the fatal disease of egotism.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o ha-o vaarn ai jin ha-umai bikh  sabh  rog gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਿਗ ਭਰੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Glorious and great are the virtues of the Guru, who has eradicated evil, and instructed me in virtue. pMnw 589
lines.transliteration: tis sat gur ka-o vad punn hai jin avgan  kat gun ee samjh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਕਿਟ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਝਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru meets with those upon whose foreheads such blessed destiny is recorded. ||7|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (589-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so satgur t in ka-o bh ayti-aa jin kai mukh  mast ak bh aag likh  paa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਭਾਗੁ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: They alone worship the Lord, who remain dead while yet alive; the Gurmukhs worshipthe Lord continually.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karahi marjeevrh ay gurmukh  bhagat sadaa ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, which no one candestroy.
lines.transliteration: onaa ka-o Dhur bh agat khajaanaa bakh si-aa mayt na sakai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They obtain the treasure of virtue, the One True Lord, within their minds.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan man paa-i-aa ayko sachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਬਖਿਸਆ  ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with the Lord; they shall never be separatedagain. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (589-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mil rahay fir vichh orhaa kad ay na ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He does not serve the True Guru; how can he reflect upon the Lord?
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayv na keenee-aa ki-aa oh karay veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਿਵਛੋੜਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not appreciate the value of the Shabad; the fool wanders in corruption and sin.
lines.transliteration: sabdai saar na jaan -ee bikh  bhoolaa gaavaar.

lines.english: The blind and ignorant perform all sorts of ritualistic actions; they are in love withduality.
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee anDh baho karam kamaavai d oojai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who take unjustified pride in themselves, are punished and humiliated by theMessenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: anhod aa aap gan aa-iday jam maar karay t in khu-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, who else is there to ask? The Lord Himself is the Forgiver. ||2|| pauVI ] (589-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no aakhee-ai jaa aapay bakh sanhaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You, O Creator, know all things; all beings belong to You.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa sabh  kichh  jaand aa sabh  jee-a t umaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਣਾਇਦੇ  ਜਮੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਿਤਨ  ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to You, You unite with Yourself; what can the poor creaturesdo?
lines.transliteration: jis too bh aavai t is too mayl laihi ki-aa jant  vichaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are all-powerful, the Cause of causes, the True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: too karan  kaaran  samrath hai sach sirjan haaray.

lines.english: Only those unite with you, Beloved Lord, whom you approve and who meditate on Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: jis too mayleh pi-aari-aa so t uDh milai gurmukh  veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has allowed me to see my unseen Lord. ||8|| slok mÚ 3 ] (589-10) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur aapn ay jin mayraa har alakh  lakhaaray. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਿਕਆ  ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Assayer of jewels; He contemplates the jewel.
lines.transliteration: ratnaa paarakh  jo hovai so rat naa karay veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He is ignorant and totally blind - he does not appreciate the value of the jewel.
lines.transliteration: ratnaa saar na jaan -ee agi-aanee anDh  anDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Jewel is the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Knower alone knows it.
lines.transliteration: ratan guroo kaa sabad  hai boojh ai boojh anhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਰੇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The fools take pride in themselves, and are ruined in birth and death.
lines.transliteration: moorakh aap gan aa-iday mar jameh ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone obtains the jewel, who, as Gurmukh, enshrines love for it.
lines.transliteration: naanak ratnaa so lahai jis gurmukh  lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨਾ  ਪਾਰਖੁ  ਜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਰਤਨਾ  ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, make the Name of theLord your daily occupation.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa naam uchrai har naamo nit  bi-uhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨਾ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If the Lord shows His Mercy, then I keep Him enshrined within my heart. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (589-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay jay aapnee t aa har rakh aa ur Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They do not serve the True Guru, and they do not embrace love for the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayv na keenee-aa har naam na lago pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ  ਗਣਾਇਦੇ  ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Do not even think that they are alive - the Creator Lord Himself has killed them.
lines.transliteration: mat t um jaan hu o-ay jeevd ay o-ay aap maaray kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਤਨਾ  ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Egotism is such a terrible disease; in the love of duality, they do their deeds.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vadaa rog hai bhaa-ay d oojai karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਿਨਤ  ਿਬਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs are in a living death; forgetting the Lord, theysuffer in pain. ||2|| pauVI ] (589-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh jeevd i-aa mu-ay har visri-aa d ukh paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Let all bow in reverence, to that humble being whose heart is pure within.
lines.transliteration: jis antar hird aa suDh  hai tis jan ka-o sabh  namaskaaree.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that humble being whose mind is filled with the treasure of theNaam.
lines.transliteration: jis andar naam niDh aan hai t is jan ka-o ha-o balihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੋ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He has a discriminating intellect; he meditates on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis andar buDh  bibayk hai har naam muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਦੇ  ਓਇ ਆਿਪ  ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: That True Guru is a friend to all; everyone is dear to Him.
lines.transliteration: so satgur sabh naa kaa mit  hai sabh  tiseh pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading everywhere; reflect upon the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||9|| slok mÚ 3 ] (589-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh aat am raam pasaari-aa gur buDh  beechaaree. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਜੀਵਿਦਆ  ਮੁਏ ਹਿਰ ਿਵਸਿਰਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, the soul is in the bondage of deeds done in ego.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay jee-a kay banDh naa vich ha-umai karam kamaahi.

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, one finds no place of rest; he dies, and isreincarnated, and continues coming and going.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay th a-ur na paavhee mar jameh aavahi jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, one's speech is vapid and insipid; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not abide in his mind. pMnw 590
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay fikaa boln aa naam na vasai man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਿਫਕਾ  ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and beaten in the City of Death; they arise and depart with blackened faces. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (590-2) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satgur sayvay jam pur baDh ay maaree-an muhi kaalai uth  jaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਨ ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲੈ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Burn away those rituals which lead you to forget the Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaala-o aisee reet jit  mai pi-aaraa veesrai.

lines.english: O Nanak, sublime is that love, which preserves my honor with my Lord Master. ||2|| pauVI ] (590-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak saa-ee bhalee pareet  jit saahib sayt ee pat  rahai. ||2||

lines.english: Serve the One Lord, the Great Giver; meditate on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: har iko daat aa sayvee-ai har ik Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਪਰੀਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਤ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you shall obtain your heart's desires.
lines.transliteration: har iko daat aa mangee-ai man chind i-aa paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: But if you beg from another, then you shall be shamed and destroyed.
lines.transliteration: jay doojay paashu mangee-ai t aa laaj maraa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਇਕੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who serves the Lord obtains the fruits of his rewards; all of his hunger is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa tin fal paa-i-aa t is jan kee sabh  bhukh gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who night and day, meditate within their hearts on theName of the Lord. ||10|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (590-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin vitahu vaari-aa jin an-d in hird ai har naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਤਾ ਲਾਜ  ਮਰਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is pleased with His humble devotees; my Beloved Lord attaches them to Himself.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kaN-u aap t uthaa mayraa pi-aaraa aapay la-i-an jan laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਸੇਿਵਆ ਿਤਿਨ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord blesses His humble devotees with royalty; He fashions the true crown upontheir heads.
lines.transliteration: paatisaahee bh agat janaa ka-o d itee-an sir chh at sachaa har ban aa-ay.

lines.english: They are always at peace, and immaculately pure; they perform service for the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh ee-ay nirmalay sat gur kee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: They are not said to be kings, who die in conflict, and then enter again the cycle ofreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: raajay o-ay na aakhee-ahi bh irh mareh fir joonee paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੰਉ ਆਿਪ  ਤੁਠਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, they wander about with their noses cut off indisgrace; they get no respect at all. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (590-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai nakeeN vadh eeN fireh sobh aa mool na paahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਿਦਤੀਅਨੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਛਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰ ਬਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing the teachings, he does not appreciate them, as long as he is not Gurmukh,attached to the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sun sikh i-ai saad  na aa-i-o jichar gurmukh  sabad  na laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam comes to abide in the mind, and doubts and fearsrun away.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai naam man vasai vichahu bh aram bh a-o bh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੇ ਓਇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਿਭਿੜ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: As he knows the True Guru, so he is transformed, and then, he lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa satgur no jaan ai tayho hovai t aa sach naam liv laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕੀ ਵਢੀ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained; he shall beresplendent in the Court of the Lord hereafter. ||2|| pauVI ] (590-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee har dar sohan aagai. ||2||

lines.english: The minds of the Gursikhs are filled with the love of the Lord; they come and worshipthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaaN man har pareet  hai gur poojan  aavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਿਸਿਖਐ  ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਿਜਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: They trade lovingly in the Lord's Name, and depart after earning the profit of theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har naam vanaNjahi rang si-o laahaa har naam lai jaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: The faces of the Gursikhs are radiant; in the Court of the Lord, they are approved.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa kay mukh  ujlay har d argeh bh aaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, is the treasure of the Lord's Name; how very fortunate arethe Sikhs who share in this treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur bohal har naam kaa vadbh aagee sikh  gun saaNjh karaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those Gursikhs who, sitting and standing, meditate on the Lord'sName. ||11|| slok mÚ 3 ] (590-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tinaa gursikh aa kaN-u ha-o vaari-aa jo bahd i-aa uth -di-aa har naam Dh i-aavahi. ||11||

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure, which the Gurmukhsobtain.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niDhaan hai gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਣ  ਆਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are blind; they do not realize that it is within their ownhome. They die barking and crying. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (590-16) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: manmukh gh ar hod ee vath na jaan nee anDh ay bh a-uk mu-ay billaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਹ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: That body is golden and immaculate, which is attached to the True Name of the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa nirmalee jo sach naam sach laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਭਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Pure Light of the Luminous Lord, and his doubts and fearsrun away.
lines.transliteration: nirmal jot niranjan paa-i-aa gurmukh  bharam bh a-o bh aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਸਖ ਗੁਣ ਸਝ ਕਰਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find lasting peace; night and day, they remain detached,while in the Love of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (590-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sad aa sukh  paavahi an-d in har bairaagee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕੰਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਜੋ ਬਹਿਦਆ  ਉਠਿਦਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed are those Gursikhs, who, with their ears, listen to the Guru's Teachings about the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say gursikh Dh an Dh an hai jinee gur upd ays sun i-aa har kannee.

lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, implants the Naam within them, and their egotism andduality are silenced.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur naam drirh -aa-i-aa t in haN-umai d ubiDh aa bh annee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: There is no friend, other than the Name of the Lord; the Lord's humble servants reflect upon this and see. pMnw 591
lines.transliteration: bin har naavai ko mitar naahee veechaar dith aa har jannee.

lines.english: Those Gursikhs, with whom the Lord is pleased, accept the Word of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jinaa gursikhaa ka-o har sant usat hai t inee sat gur kee gal mannee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਗਲ ਮੰਨੀ ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam are imbued with the four-fold color of the Lord's Love. ||12|| slok mÚ 3 ] (591-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-id ay tinee charh ee chavgan  vannee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਿਣ  ਵੰਨੀ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is cowardly and ugly; lacking the Name of the Lord, his noseis cut off in disgrace.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kaa-ir karoop hai bin naavai nak naahi.

lines.english: Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs, and even in his dreams, he finds nopeace.
lines.transliteration: an-din Dh anDhai vi-aapi-aa supnai bh ee sukh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਕਾਇਰੁ ਕਰੂਪੁ  ਹੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he shall be saved; otherwise, he is held in bondage, and suffers in pain. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (591-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh hoveh t aa ubrahi naahi t a baDh ay dukh sahaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਭੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs always look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; they practice the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa dar sohn ay gur kaa sabad  kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਉਬਰਿਹ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਤ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is a lasting peace and happiness deep within them; at the Court of the TrueLord, they receive honor.
lines.transliteration: antar saaNt sadaa sukh  dar sachai sobh aa paahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with the Name of the Lord; they mergeimperceptibly into the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (591-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har naam paa-i-aa sehjay sach samaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, and was saved.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh par-hilaad  jap har gat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਸਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, Janak lovingly centered his consciousness on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh janak har naam liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, Vashisht taught the Teachings of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh basist har upd ays sun aa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one has found the Lord's Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: bin gur har naam na kinai paa-i-aa mayray bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਿਦ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord blesses the Gurmukh with devotion. ||13|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (591-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har bh agat har aap lahaa-ee. ||13||

lines.english: One who has no faith in the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of theShabad,
lines.transliteration: satgur kee part eet na aa-ee-aa sabad  na laago bh aa-o.
os no sukh na upjai bh aavai sa-o gayrh aa aava-o jaa-o. shall find no peace, even though he may come and go hundreds of times.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਕਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meets the True Lord with natural ease; he is in love with theLord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (591-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sahj milai sachay si-o liv laa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਲਹਾਈ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: O mind, search for such a True Guru, by serving whom the pains of birth and deathare dispelled.
lines.transliteration: ay man aisaa satgur kh oj lahu jit  sayvi-ai janam maran  dukh jaa-ay.

lines.english: Doubt shall never afflict you, and your ego shall be burnt away through the Word ofthe Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sahsaa mool na hova-ee ha-umai sabad jalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਈਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਲਾਗੋ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The veil of falsehood shall be torn down from within you, and Truth shall come todwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: koorhai kee paal vichahu niklai sach vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸਉ ਗੇੜਾ  ਆਵਉ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Peace and happiness shall fill your mind deep within, if you act according to truth andself-discipline.
lines.transliteration: antar saaNt man sukh  ho-ay sach sanjam kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, you shall meet the True Guru, and then the DearLord, by His Sweet Will, shall bless you with His Mercy. ||2|| pauVI ] (591-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorai karam satgur milai har jee-o kirpaa karay rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The whole world comes under the control of one whose home is filled with the Lord,the King.
lines.transliteration: jis kai ghar d eebaan har hovai t is kee muth ee vich jagat  sabh  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is subject to no one else's rule, and the Lord, the King, causes everyone to fall athis feet.
lines.transliteration: tis ka-o t alkee kisai d ee naahee har d eebaan sabh  aan pairee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਿਜ ਲਹੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One may run away from the courts of other men, but where can one go to escape theLord's Kingdom? so AYsw hir dIbwnu visAw Bgqw kY ihrdY iqin rhdy Kuhdy Awix siB Bgqw AgY KlvwieAw ] (591-15, vfhMsu, mÚ 3) so aisaa har deebaan vasi-aa bh agtaa kai hird ai tin rahd ay kh uhday aan  sabh  bhagtaa agai khalvaa-i-aa. The Lord is such a King, who abides in the hearts of His devotees; He brings the others, and makes them stand before His devotees.
lines.transliteration: maansaa ki-ahu d eebaan ahu ko-ee nas bh aj niklai har d eebaan ahu ko-ee kithai jaa-i- aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: 3) har naavai kee vadi-aa-ee karam paraapat hovai gurmukh  virlai kinai Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||14|| The glorious greatness of the Lord's Name is obtained only by His Grace; how few arethe Gurmukhs who meditate on Him. ||14|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (591-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਿਲ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਿਨਕਲੈ  ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, the people of the world are dead; they waste theirlives away in vain.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay jagat  mu-aa birthaa janam gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In love with duality, they suffer terrible pain; they die, and are reincarnated, andcontinue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay at  dukh lagaa mar jammai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They live in manure, and are reincarnated again and again.
lines.transliteration: vistaa andar vaas hai fir fir joonee paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, the Messenger of Death punishes them; in the end, theydepart regretting and repenting. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (591-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai jam maarsee ant ga-i-aa pachh utaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In this world, there is one Husband Lord; all other beings are His brides. pMnw 592
lines.transliteration: is jag meh purakh ayk hai hor saglee naar sabaa-ee.

lines.english: He enjoys the hearts of all, and yet He remains detached; He is unseen; He cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at bhogvai alipat  rahai alakh  na lakh -naa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ  ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru reveals Him, and through the Word of His Shabad, we come tounderstand Him.
lines.transliteration: poorai gur vaykhaali-aa sabd ay sojh ee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਵੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve their Husband Lord, become like Him; their egos are burnt away byHis Shabad.
lines.transliteration: purkhai sayveh say purakh  hoveh jinee ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He has no rival, no attacker, no enemy.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa sareek ko nahee naa ko kantak vairaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਵੈਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: His rule is unchanging and eternal; He does not come or go.
lines.transliteration: nihchal raaj hai sadaa t is kayraa naa aavai naa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, His servant serves Him, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din sayvak sayvaa karay har sachay kay gun  gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Beholding the Glorious Greatness of the True Lord, Nanak blossoms forth. ||2|| pauVI ] (592-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaykh vigsi-aa har sachay kee vadi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are forever filled with the Name of the Lord, have the Name of the Lord as their Protector.
lines.transliteration: jin kai har naam vasi-aa sad hird ai har naamo t in kaN-u rakh anhaaraa.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is my father, the Lord's Name is my mother; the Lord's Name is myhelper and friend.
lines.transliteration: har naam pitaa har naamo maat aa har naam sakh aa-ee mit ar hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਦ ਿਹਰਦੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਿਤਨ  ਕੰਉ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: My conversation is with the Lord's Name, and my counseling is with the Lord's Name;the Lord's Name always takes care of me.
lines.transliteration: har naavai naal galaa har naavai naal maslat har naam hamaaree kard aa nit  saaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my most beloved society, the Lord's Name is my ancestry, and the Lord's Name is my family.
lines.transliteration: har naam hamaaree sangat at  pi-aaree har naam kul har naam parvaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਗਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਮਸਲਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਕਰਦਾ  ਿਨਤ ਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: ||15|| The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, has bestowed upon servant Nanak the Name of theLord; in this world, and in the next, the Lord ever saves me. ||15|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (592-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 3) jan naanak kaN-u har naam har gur dee-aa har halat  palat  sadaa karay nist aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meet the True Guru, ever sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: jin kaN-u satgur bh ayti-aa say har keerat  sadaa kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੰਉ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ ਹਿਰ ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name naturally fills their minds, and they are absorbed in the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: achint har naam t in kai man vasi-aa sachai sabad  samaahi.

lines.english: They redeem their generations, and they themselves obtain the state of liberation.
lines.transliteration: kul uDhaareh aapn aa mokh  padvee aapay paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is pleased with those who fall at the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm tin kaN-u sant usat bh a-i-aa jo gur charnee jan paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; by His Grace, the Lord preserves his honor. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (592-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai kar kirpaa har laaj rakh aahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: In egotism, one is assailed by fear; he passes his life totally troubled by fear.
lines.transliteration: haN-umai andar kh arhak hai kh arhkay kh arhak vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਤਨ ਕੰਉ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਜਨ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Egotism is such a terrible disease; he dies, to be reincarnated - he continues comingand going.
lines.transliteration: haN-umai vadaa rog hai mar jammai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਜ  ਰਖਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the True Guru, God Incarnate.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t inaa sat gur mili-aa parabh  aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, they are redeemed; their egos are burnt away through theWord of the Shabad. ||2|| pauVI ] (592-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur parsaadee ubray ha-umai sabad jalaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉਮੈ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਖੜਕੁ  ਹੈ ਖੜਕੇ  ਖੜਿਕ  ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my immortal, unfathomable, imperishable Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har naam hamaaraa parabh abigat  agochar abh inaasee purakh  biDhaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉਮੈ  ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I serve the Lord's Name, I worship the Lord's Name, and my soul is imbued with theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har naam ham sarayveh har naam ham poojah har naamay hee man raataa.

lines.english: I know of no other as great as the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name shall deliver me inthe end.
lines.transliteration: har naamai jayvad ko-ee avar na soojhai har naamo ant  chhadaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Generous Guru has given me the Lord's Name; blessed, blessed are the Guru'smother and father.
lines.transliteration: har naam dee-aa gur par-upkaaree Dh an Dh an guroo kaa pit aa maat aa.

lines.english: I ever bow in humble reverence to my True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to know the Lord's Name. ||16|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (592-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: haN-u satgur apun ay kaN-u sad aa namaskaaree jit  mili-ai har naam mai jaat aa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਬਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who does not serve the Guru as Gurmukh, who does not love the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayv na keenee-aa har naam na lago pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਸਰ੍ੇਵਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਪੂਜਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  na aa-i-o mar janmai vaaro vaar. and who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, shall die, and be reborn, over and over again.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਿਤ  ਛਡਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not think of the Lord; why did he even come intothe world?
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  na chayt -ee kit  aa-i-aa saisaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ  ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that Gurmukh, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, crosses overthe world-ocean. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (592-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin ka-o nadar karay say gurmukh  langh ay paar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਪੁਣੇ  ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Only the Guru is awake; the rest of the world is asleep in emotional attachment anddesire.
lines.transliteration: iko satgur jaagt aa hor jag soot aa mohi pi-aas.

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru and remain wakeful, are imbued with the True Name, the treasure of virtue. pMnw 593
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan jaagann say jo rat ay sach naam gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਗੰਿਨ  ਸੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਗੁਣਤਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not think of the Lord; they are ruined through birth and death.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  na chayt nee janam mar hohi binaas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਿਰ ਹੋਿਹ ਿਬਨਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is their destiny, pre-ordained by the Primal Lord God. ||2|| pauVI ] (593-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh t inee naam Dh i-aa-i-aa jin kaN-u Dh ur poorab likh i-aas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my food; eating the thirty-six varieties of it, I am satisfied andsatiated.
lines.transliteration: har naam hamaaraa bhojan chh ateeh parkaar jit  khaa-i-ai ham ka-o t aripat  bha-ee.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is my clothing; wearing it, I shall never be naked again, and mydesire to wear other clothing is gone.
lines.transliteration: har naam hamaaraa painan jit  fir nangay na hovah hor painan  kee hamaaree saraDh ga-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਭੋਜਨੁ ਛਤੀਹ  ਪਰਕਾਰ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਖਾਇਐ  ਹਮ ਕਉ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਭਈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my business, the Lord's Name is my commerce; the True Guru has blessed me with its use.
lines.transliteration: vfhMsu, mÚ 3) har naam hamaaraa vanaj har naam vaapaar har naamai kee ham kaN-u sat gur kaarkunee dee-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਫਿਰ  ਨੰਗੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹ ਹੋਰ ਪੈਨਣ  ਕੀ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਸਰਧ  ਗਈ ॥
lines.english: I record the account of the Lord's Name, and I shall not be subject to death again.
lines.transliteration: har naamai kaa ham laykhaa likh i-aa sabh  jam kee aglee kaan  ga-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਵਣਜੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਕੰਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਕਾਰਕੁਨੀ  ਦੀਈ  ॥
lines.english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord's Name; they are blessed by the Lord,and receive their pre-ordained destiny. ||17|| slok mÚ 3 ] (593-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vfhMsu, mÚ 3) har kaa naam gurmukh kinai virlai Dh i-aa-i-aa jin kaN-u Dh ur karam paraapat  likhat pa-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਾ ਹਮ ਲੇਖਾ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸਭ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਅਗਲੀ  ਕਾਿਣ  ਗਈ ॥
lines.english: The world is blind and ignorant; in the love of duality, it engages in actions.
lines.transliteration: jagat agi-aanee anDh  hai d oojai bh aa-ay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਨੈ ਿਵਰਲੈ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਿਲਖਤੁ  ਪਈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: But those actions which are performed in the love of duality, cause only pain to thebody.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay jayt ay karam karay d ukh lagai t an Dh aa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, peace wells up, when one acts according to the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sukh oopjai jaa gur kaa sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He acts according to the True Word of the Guru's Bani; night and day, he meditateson the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee karam karay an-d in naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ  ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as the Lord Himself engages him, so is he engaged; no one has any say inthis matter. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (593-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jit aapay laa-ay t it lagay kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within the home of my own being, is the everlasting treasure of the Naam; it is atreasure house, overflowing with devotion.
lines.transliteration: ham ghar naam kh ajaanaa sad aa hai bh agat bharay bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul; the Great Giver lives forever.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa jee-a kaa sad  jeevai d ayvan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਾਏ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਲਗੇ ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, I continually sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise, through the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: an-din keert an sad aa karahi gur kai sabad  apaaraa.

lines.english: I recite continually the Guru's Shabads, which have been effective throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: sabad guroo kaa sad  uchrahi jug jug vart aavan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਘਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: This mind ever abides in peace, dealing in peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa sadaa sukh  vasai sehjay karay vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within me is the Guru's Wisdom, the Lord's jewel, the Bringer of liberation.
lines.transliteration: antar gur gi-aan har rat an hai mukat  karaavan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains this, and is judgedto be True in the Court of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (593-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no nadar karay so paa-ay so hovai d ar sachi-aaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਉਚਰਿਹ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an so gursikh  kahee-ai jo sat gur charn ee jaa-ay pa-i-aa. Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who goes and falls at the Feet of the TrueGuru.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਿਖ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an so gursikh  kahee-ai jin har naamaa mukh  raam kahi-aa. Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who with his mouth, utters the Name of theLord.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an so gursikh  kahee-ai jis har naam sun i-ai man anad  bha-i-aa. Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, whose mind, upon hearing the Lord's Name, becomes blissful.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਰ ਸਿਚਆਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an so gursikh  kahee-ai jin sat gur sayvaa kar har naam la-i-aa. Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who serves the True Guru, and so obtainsthe Lord's Name.
I bow forever in deepest respect to that Sikh of the Guru, who walks in the Way of the Guru. ||18|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (593-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis gursikh  kaN-u haN-u sad aa namaskaaree jo gur kai bh aanai gursikh  chali-aa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ  ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one has ever found the Lord through stubborn-mindedness. All have grown wearyof performing such actions.
lines.transliteration: manhath kinai na paa-i-o sabh  thakay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through their stubborn-mindedness, and by wearing their disguises, they are deluded;they suffer in pain from the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: manhath bh aykh kar bh aramd ay dukh paa-i-aa d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਿਣਐ  ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Riches and the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are all emotionalattachments; through them, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to dwellin the mind.
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  sabh  moh hai naam na vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and the darkness of spiritualignorance is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay man nirmal hovai agi-aan anDh ayraa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਕੰਉ ਹੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਚਿਲਆ ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The jewel of the Naam is revealed in the home of one's own being; O Nanak, one merges in celestial bliss. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (593-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl: pMnw 594
lines.transliteration: naam ratan gh ar pargat ho-aa naanak sahj samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੋ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: One who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, who does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  na aa-i-o naam na lago pi-aar.
rasnaa fikaa bolnaa nit  nit ho-ay kh u-aar. and who speaks insipid words with his tongue, is ruined, again and again.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਪਇਐ  ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he acts according to the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase.||2|| pauVI ] (594-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirat pa-i-ai kamaavan aa ko-ay na maytan haar. ||2||

lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat  purakh  satguroo hamaaraa jit  mili-ai ham ka-o saaNt aa-ee. Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have found peace.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat  purakh  satguroo hamaaraa jit  mili-ai ham har bh agat paa-ee. Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my Tr ue Guru; meeting Him, I have attained the Lord's devotional worship.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an har bh agat satguroo hamaaraa jis kee sayvaa t ay ham har naam liv laa- ee. Blessed, blessed is the Lord's devotee, my True Guru; serving Him, I have come toenshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an har gi-aanee sat guroo hamaaraa jin vairee mit ar ham ka-o sabh  sam darisat d ikhaa-ee. Blessed, blessed is the Knower of the Lord, my True Guru; He has taught me to look upon friend and foe alike.
lines.transliteration: vfhMsu, mÚ 3)

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਵੈਰੀ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਿਦਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat guroo mit ar hamaaraa jin har naam si-o hamaaree pareet  banaa-ee. ||19|| Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, my best friend; He has led me to embrace love for the Name of the Lord. ||19|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (594-6) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is at home, while the Husband Lord is away; she cherishes Hismemory, and mourns His absence.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee munDh  vidays pir nit  jhooray sammHaalay.

lines.english: She shall meet Him without delay, if she rids herself of duality. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (594-7) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mildi-aaN dhil na hova-ee jay nee-at  raas karay. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, false is the speech of one who acts without loving the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak gaalee koorhee-aa baajh  pareet  karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲਿਦਆ  ਿਢਲ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜੇ ਨੀਅਿਤ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He judges things to be good, only as long as the Lord gives and he receives. ||2|| pauVI ] (594-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: tichar jaan ai bhalaa kar jichar layvai d ay-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord, who created the creatures, also protects them.
lines.transliteration: jin upaa-ay jee-a tin har raakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗਾਲੀ  ਕੂੜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰੀਿਤ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: I have tasted the food of Ambrosial Nectar, the True Name.
lines.transliteration: amrit sachaa naa-o bh ojan chaakh i-aa.

lines.english: I am satisfied and satiated, and my hunger is appeased.
lines.transliteration: tipat rahay aagh aa-ay mitee bh abhaakhi-aa.

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading in all, but rare are those who realize this.
lines.transliteration: sabh and ar ik vart ai kinai virlai laakh i-aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is enraptured, in the Protection of God. ||20|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (594-10) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bha-ay nihaal parabh  kee paakh i-aa. ||20||

lines.english: All the living beings of the world behold the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur no sabh  ko vaykh -daa jayt aa jagat  sansaar.

lines.english: One is not liberated by merely seeing Him, unless one contemplates the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: dithai mukat  na hova-ee jichar sabad  na karay veechaar.

lines.english: The filth of ego is not removed, and he does not enshrine love for the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mail na chuk-ee naam na lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਏ ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਪਾਿਖਆ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The Lord forgives some, and unites them with Himself; they forsake their duality andsinful ways.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay bakhas milaa-i-an d ubiDh aa taj vikaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, some behold the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, with love andaffection; conquering their ego, they meet with the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (594-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ik darsan d aykh mar milay sat gur hayt  pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਦਾ  ਜੇਤਾ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The foolish, blind clown does not serve the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satguroo na sayvi-o moorakh  anDh  gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਡਠੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In love with duality, he endures terrible suffering, and burning, he cries out in pain.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bahut  dukh laagaa jalt aa karay pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He forgets the Guru, for the sake of mere objects, but they will not come to his rescuein the end.
lines.transliteration: jin kaaran guroo visaari-aa say na upkaray ant ee vaar.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Instructions, Nanak has found peace; the Forgiving Lord hasforgiven him. ||2|| pauVI ] (594-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmatee sukh  paa-i-aa bakh say bakh sanhaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਿਕ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਮਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself, all by Yourself, are the Creator of all. If there were any other, then I would speak of another.
lines.transliteration: too aapay aap aap sabh  kartaa ko-ee d oojaa ho-ay so avro kahee-ai.

lines.english: The Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak; He Himself is pervading the waterand the land.
lines.transliteration: har aapay bolai aap bulaavai har aapay jal thal rav rahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself destroys, and the Lord Himself saves. O mind, seek and remain inthe Lord's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: har aapay maarai har aapay chhodai man har sarn ee parh  rahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਜਲਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Other than the Lord, no one can kill or rejuvenate. O mind, do not be anxious -remain fearless. auTidAw bhidAw suiqAw sdw sdw hir nwmu iDAweIAY jn nwnk gurmuiK hir lhIAY ]21]1] suDu (594-18, vfhMsu, mÚ 3) uth-d i-aa bahd i-aa sut i-aa sad aa sad aa har naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai jan naanak gurmukh har lahee-ai. ||21||1|| suDhu While standing, sitting, and sleeping, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord's Name;O servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall attain the Lord. ||21||1||Sudh|| pMnw 595 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (595-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: soriT mhlw 1 Gru 1 caupdy ] (595-3) sorath mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 cha-upd ay. Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas:
lines.transliteration: har bin ko-ee maar jeevaal na sakai man ho-ay nichind nisal ho-ay rahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Death comes to all, and all must suffer separation.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa marn aa aa-i-aa vaychh orhaa sabh naah.

lines.english: Go and ask the clever people, whether they shall meet in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: puchhahu jaa-ay si-aan i-aa aagai milan  kinaah.

lines.english: Those who forget my Lord and Master shall suffer in terrible pain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin mayraa saahib veesrai vadrhee vayd an tinaah. ||1||

lines.english: So praise the True Lord,
lines.transliteration: bhee saalaahihu saachaa so-ay.
jaa kee nadar sad aa sukh  ho-ay. rahaa-o. by whose Grace peace ever prevails. ||Pause||

lines.english: Praise Him as great; He is, and He shall ever be.
lines.transliteration: vadaa kar salaahnaa hai bh ee hosee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You alone are the Great Giver; mankind cannot give anything.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa d aataa ayk t oo maan as daat na ho-ay.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; what good does it do to cry out in protest? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai rann ke runnai ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Dhart ee upar kot garh  kaytee ga-ee vajaa-ay. Many have proclaimed their sovereignty over millions of fortresses on the earth, but they have now departed.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਮਾਣਸ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: And those, whom even the sky could not contain, had ropes put through their noses.
lines.transliteration: jo asmaan na maavnee tin nak nathaa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਰੰਨ ਿਕ ਰੁੰਨੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O mind, if you only knew the torment in your future, you would not relish the sweetpleasures of the present. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay man jaaneh soolee-aa kaahay mith aa kh aahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤੀ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਕੇਤੀ  ਗਈ ਵਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as many as are the sins one commits, so many are the chains around hisneck.
lines.transliteration: naanak a-ogun jayt -rhay taytay galee janjeer.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਅਸਮਾਿਨ  ਨ ਮਾਵਨੀ ਿਤਨ ਨਿਕ ਨਥਾ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If he possesses virtues, then the chains are cut away; these virtues are his brothers,his true brothers.
lines.transliteration: jay gun hon t a katee-an say bh aa-ee say veer.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸੂਲੀਆ  ਕਾਹੇ ਿਮਠਾ  ਖਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Going to the world hereafter, those who have no Guru are not accepted; they arebeaten, and expelled. ||4||1|| soriT mhlw 1 Gru 1 ] (595-10) sorath mehlaa 1 gh ar 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: agai ga-ay na mannee-an maar kadhahu vaypeer. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਉਗੁਣ  ਜੇਤੜੇ  ਤੇਤੇ ਗਲੀ  ਜੰਜੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: Make your mind the farmer, good deeds the farm, modesty the water, and your bodythe field.
lines.transliteration: man haalee kirsaanee karn ee saram paan ee tan kh ayt.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਿਨ ਤ ਕਟੀਅਿਨ  ਸੇ ਭਾਈ  ਸੇ ਵੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, contentment the plow, and your humble dress the fence.
lines.transliteration: naam beej santokh  suhaagaa rakh  gareebee vays.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ  ਗਏ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਅਿਨ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢਹੁ ਵੇਪੀਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Doing deeds of love, the seed shall sprout, and you shall see your home flourish. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o karam kar jammsee say gh ar bhaagath  daykh. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, the wealth of Maya does not go with anyone.
lines.transliteration: baabaa maa-i-aa saath na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਹਾਲੀ  ਿਕਰਸਾਣੀ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਰਮੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਤਨੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: This Maya has bewitched the world, but only a rare few understand this. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: in maa-i-aa jag mohi-aa virlaa boojhai ko-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸੁਹਾਗਾ  ਰਖੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ  ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Make your ever-decreasing life your shop, and make the Lord's Name yourmerchandise.
lines.transliteration: haan hat kar aarjaa sach naam kar vath.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਉ ਕਰਮ  ਕਿਰ ਜੰਮਸੀ  ਸੇ ਘਰ ਭਾਗਠ  ਦੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Make understanding and contemplation your warehouse, and in that warehouse, storethe Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: surat soch kar bh aaNdsaal t is vich t is no rakh .

lines.english: Deal with the Lord's dealers, earn your profits, and rejoice in your mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vanjaari-aa si-o van aj kar lai laahaa man has. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਗੁ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.
lines.transliteration: sun saasat  sa-ud aagree sat  ghorhay lai chal.

lines.english: Gather up merits for your travelling expenses, and do not think of tomorrow in yourmind.
lines.transliteration: kharach bann chang-aa-ee-aa mat  man jaan eh kal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਣੁ ਹਟੁ ਕਿਰ ਆਰਜਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰ ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.english: When you arrive in the land of the Formless Lord, you shall find peace in the Mansion of His Presence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirankaar kai days jaahi t aa sukh  laheh mahal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸੋਚ ਕਿਰ ਭਡਸਾਲ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Let your service be the focusing of your consciousness, and let your occupation be theplacing of faith in the Naam. pMnw 596
lines.transliteration: laa-ay chit kar chaakree man naam kar kamm.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਨੁ ਬਦੀਆ  ਕਿਰ ਧਾਵਣੀ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ  ਧੰਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Let your work be restraint from sin; only then will people call you blessed.
lines.transliteration: bann badee-aa kar Dh aavnee taa ko aakh ai Dhan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਣ  ਵੰਨੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord shall look upon you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be blessed with honor four times over. ||4||2|| soriT mÚ 1 cauquky ] (596-2) sorath mehlaa 1 cha-ut ukay. Sorat'h, First Mehl, Chau-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaykhai nad ar kar charh ai chavgan  vann. ||4||2||

lines.english: The son is dear to his mother and father; he is the wise son-in-law to his father-in-law.
lines.transliteration: maa-ay baap ko baytaa neekaa sasurai chatur javaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇ  ਬਾਪ ਕੋ ਬੇਟਾ ਨੀਕਾ  ਸਸੁਰੈ  ਚਤੁਰੁ ਜਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The father is dear to his son and daughter, and the brother is very dear to his brother.
lines.transliteration: baal kanniaa kou baap pi-aaraa bhaa-ee kou at  bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਲ  ਕੰਿਨਆ  ਕੌ ਬਾਪੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ ਭਾਈ  ਕੌ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By the Order of the Lord's Command, he leaves his house and goes outside, and in aninstant, everything becomes alien to him.
lines.transliteration: hukam bha-i-aa baahar gh ar chh odi-aa kh in meh bh a-ee paraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ  ਬਾਹਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Name of the Lord, does not give in charity, and does not cleanse his consciousness; his body rolls in the dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam daan isnaan na manmukh  tit tan Dh oorh Dhumaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਧੂਿੜ ਧੁਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mind is comforted by the Comforter of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: man maani-aa naam sakhaa-ee.

lines.english: I fall at the Guru's feet - I am a sacrifice to Him; He has given me to understand thetrue understanding. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paa-ay para-o gur kai balihaarai jin saachee boojh bujh aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇ  ਪਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The mind is impressed with the false love of the world; he quarrels with the Lord'shumble servant.
lines.transliteration: jag si-o jhooth  pareet  man bayDh i-aa jan si-o vaad  rachaa-ee.

lines.english: Infatuated with Maya, night and day, he sees only the worldly path; he does not chantthe Naam, and drinking poison, he dies.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa magan ahinis mag johai naam na layvai marai bikh kh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਿਸਉ ਝੂਠ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is imbued and infatuated with vicious talk; the Word of the Shabad does not comeinto his consciousness.
lines.transliteration: ganDhan  vain rataa hit kaaree sabd ai surat  na aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is not imbued with the Lord's Love, and he is not impressed by the taste of theName; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rang na raataa ras nahee bayDh i-aa manmukh  pat gavaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੰਧਣ  ਵੈਿਣ ਰਤਾ ਿਹਤਕਾਰੀ  ਸਬਦੈ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: He does not enjoy celestial peace in the Company of the Holy, and there is not even abit of sweetness on his tongue.
lines.transliteration: saaDh sabh aa meh sahj na chaakh i-aa jihbaa ras nahee raa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਿਸ ਨਹੀ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He calls his mind, body and wealth his own; he has no knowledge of the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an apunaa kar jaani-aa d ar kee kh abar na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਹ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਚਾਿਖਆ ਿਜਹਬਾ  ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Closing his eyes, he walks in darkness; he cannot see the home of his own being, OSiblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: akhee meet chali-aa anDh i-aaraa gh ar dar disai na bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Tied up at Death's door, he finds no place of rest; he receives the rewards of his ownactions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jam dar baaDh aa tha-ur na paavai apunaa kee-aa kamaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਮੀਿਟ ਚਿਲਆ  ਅੰਿਧਆਰਾ  ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਿਦਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then I see Him with my own eyes; He isindescribable, and cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa akh ee vaykh aa kahn aa kathan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਬਾਧਾ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: With my ears, I continually listen to the Word of the Shabad, and I praise Him; HisAmbrosial Name abides within my heart.
lines.transliteration: kannee sun sun  sabad  salaahee amrit  ridai vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਅਖੀ  ਵੇਖਾ ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is Fearless, Formless and absolutely without vengeance; I am absorbed in HisPerfect Light.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar nirvair pooran jot  samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਨੀ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Guru, doubt is not dispelled; through the True Name, gloriousgreatness is obtained. ||4||3|| soriT mhlw 1 duquky ] (596-12) sorath mehlaa 1 d utukay. Sorat'h, First Mehl, Du-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur vin bh aram na bh aagai sach naam vadi-aa-ee. ||4||3||

lines.english: In the realm of land, and in the realm of water, Your seat is the chamber of the four directions.
lines.transliteration: purh Dh artee purh  paan ee aasan  chaar kunt cha-ubaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਵਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Yours is the one and only form of the entire universe; Your mouth is the mint tofashion all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan  kee moorat  aykaa mukh  tayrai taksaalaa. ||1||

lines.english: O my Lord Master, Your play is so wonderful!
lines.transliteration: mayray saahibaa tayray choj vidaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੜੁ ਧਰਤੀ  ਪੁੜੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ਆਸਣੁ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਬਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; You Yourself arecontained in all. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al bharipur leen aa aapay sarab samaan aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਣ  ਕੀ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਏਕਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਤੇਰੈ ਟਕਸਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see Your Light, but what is Your form?
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah jot  tumaaree t ayraa roop kinayhaa.

lines.english: You have one form, but it is unseen; there is none like any other. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ikat roop fireh parchh annaa ko-ay na kis hee jayhaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਭਿਰਪੁਿਰ  ਲੀਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The beings born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat, allare created by You.
lines.transliteration: andaj jayraj ut-bh uj sayt aj tayray keet ay jant aa.

lines.english: I have seen one glory of Yours, that You are pervading and permeating in all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk purab mai tayraa d aykhi-aa too sabh naa maahi ravant aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੋਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਿਕਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your Glories are so numerous, and I do not know even one of them; I am such a fool- please, give me some of them!
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  bahut ay mai ayk na jaan i-aa mai moorakh  kichh  deejai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਤੁ  ਰੂਿਪ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਪਰਛੰਨਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, listen, O my Lord Master: I am sinking like a stone - please, save me! ||4||4|| soriT mhlw 1 ] (596-17) sorath mehlaa 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak sun  mayray saahibaa dubd aa pathar leejai. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਡਜ  ਜੇਰਜ  ਉਤਭੁਜ  ਸੇਤਜ  ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ  ਜੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am a wicked sinner and a great hypocrite; You are the Immaculate and FormlessLord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o paapee patit  param paakh andee t oo nirmal nirankaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ  ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਰਵੰਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar, I am imbued with supreme bliss; O Lord and Master, Iseek Your Sanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit chaakh  param ras raat ay thaakur saran  tumaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਿਕਛੁ  ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Creator Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.
lines.transliteration: kartaa t oo mai maan  nimaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: In my lap is the honor and glory of the wealth of the Name; I merge into the TrueWord of the Shabad. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maan mahat  naam Dh an palai saachai sabad  samaan ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are perfect, while I am worthless and imperfect. You are profound, while I am trivial. pMnw 597
lines.transliteration: too pooraa ham ooray hochh ay too ga-uraa ham ha-uray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਊਰੇ ਹੋਛੇ ਤੂ ਗਉਰਾ  ਹਮ ਹਉਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is imbued with You, day and night and morning, O Lord; my tongue chants Your Name, and my mind meditates on You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tujh hee man raat ay ahinis parbh aatay har rasnaa jap man ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਪਰਭਾਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are True, and I am absorbed into You; through the mystery of the Shabad, I shall ultimately become True as well.
lines.transliteration: tum saachay ham t um hee raachay sabad  bhayd fun saachay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਚੇ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭੇਿਦ ਫੁਿਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Naam day and night are pure, while those who die tobe reborn are impure. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam ratay say soochay mar janmay say kaachay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੇ  ਸੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I do not see any other like the Lord; who else should I praise? No one is equal to Him.
lines.transliteration: avar na deesai kis saalaahee t iseh sareek na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਿਕਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves; by Guru's Instruction, I know Him. ||4||5|| soriT mhlw 1 ] (597-4) sorath mehlaa 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak d aasan d aasaa gurmat  jaani-aa so-ee. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: He is unknowable, infinite, unapproachable and imperceptible. He is not subject todeath or karma.
lines.transliteration: alakh apaar agamm agochar naa t is kaal na karmaa.

lines.english: His caste is casteless; He is unborn, self-illumined, and free of doubt and desire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaat ajaat  ajonee sambh a-o naa t is bhaa-o na bh armaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਅਗੰਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਕਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: saachay sachiaar vitahu kurbaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਤ  ਅਜਾਿਤ  ਅਜੋਨੀ  ਸੰਭਉ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਰਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has no form, no color and no features; through the True Word of the Shabad, Hereveals Himself. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naa tis roop varan nahee raykh -i-aa saachai sabad  neesaan . rahaa-o.

lines.english: He has no mother, father, sons or relatives; He is free of sexual desire; He has no wife.
lines.transliteration: naa tis maat  pitaa sut  banDh ap naa t is kaam na naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He has no ancestry; He is immaculate. He is infinite and endless; O Lord, Your Light ispervading all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: akul niranjan apar parampar saglee jot t umaaree. ||2||

lines.english: Deep within each and every heart, God is hidden; His Light is in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar barahm lukaa-i-aa gh at ghat jot sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The heavy doors are opened by Guru's Instructions; one becomes fearless, in thetrance of deep meditation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bajar kapaat muktay gurmat ee nirbh ai taarhee laa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਕੁਲ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਅਪਰ  ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਗਲੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord created all beings, and placed death over the heads of all; all the world isunder His Power.
lines.transliteration: jant upaa-ay kaal sir jant aa vasgat  jugat  sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the treasure is obtained; living the Word of the Shabad, one isemancipated. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv pad aarath paavahi chh ooteh sabad  kamaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬਜਰ  ਕਪਾਟ  ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the pure vessel, the True Name is contained; how few are those who practice trueconduct.
lines.transliteration: soochai bhaadai saach samaavai virlay soochaachaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਸਿਰ ਜੰਤਾ  ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਸਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The individual soul is united with the Supreme Soul; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary,Lord. ||5||6|| soriT mhlw 1 ] (597-11) sorath mehlaa 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tantai ka-o param t ant milaa-i-aa naanak saran  tumaaree. ||5||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਛੂਟਿਹ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Like a fish without water is the faithless cynic, who dies of thirst.
lines.transliteration: ji-o meenaa bin paanee-ai t i-o saakat  marai pi-aas.

lines.english: So shall you die, O mind, without the Lord, as your breath goes in vain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ti-o har bin maree-ai ray manaa jo birthaa jaavai saas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਤੈ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ  ਤੰਤੁ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Lord's Name, and praise Him.
lines.transliteration: man ray raam naam jas lay-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, how will you obtain this juice? The Guru shall unite you with the Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin gur ih ras ki-o laha-o gur maylai har day-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: For the Gurmukh, meeting with the Society of the Saints is like making a pilgrimage toa sacred shrine.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil sangt ee gurmukh  tirath ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ  ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਵੈ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The benefit of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is obtained bythe Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath majnaa gur d aras paraapat  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Like the Yogi without abstinence, and like penance without truth and contentment,
lines.transliteration: ji-o jogee jat baahraa t ap naahee sat  santokh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਿਕਉ  ਲਹਉ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ti-o naamai bin d ayhuree jam maarai ant ar dokh. ||3|| so is the body without the Lord's Name; death will slay it, because of the sin within.

lines.english: The faithless cynic does not obtain the Lord's Love; the Lord's Love is obtained only through the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: saakat paraym na paa-ee-ai har paa-ee-ai sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One who meets with the Guru, the Giver of pleasure and pain, says Nanak, isabsorbed in the Lord's Praise. ||4||7|| soriT mhlw 1 ] (597-16) sorath mehlaa 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh daataa gur milai kaho naanak sifat  samaa-ay. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਮਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You, God, are the Giver of gifts, the Lord of perfect understanding; I am a merebeggar at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: too parabh  daataa daan mat  pooraa ham thaaray bh aykhaaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਜਤ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਤਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ॥
lines.english: What should I beg for? Nothing remains permanent; O Lord, please, bless me withYour Beloved Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mai ki-aa maaga-o kichh thir na rahaa-ee har d eejai naam pi-aaree jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਨਾਮੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਦੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the forest, is permeating andpervading.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rav rahi-aa banvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the water, on the land, and in the sky, He is pervading but hidden; through theWord of the Guru's Shabad, He is revealed. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al gupto vart ai gur sabd ee daykh nihaaree jee-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic Ethers, theGuru, the True Guru, has shown me the Lord; He has showered me with His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: marat pa-i-aal akaas d ikhaa-i-o gur sat gur kirpaa Dh aaree jee-o.

lines.english: He is the unborn Lord God; He is, and shall ever be. Deep within your heart, behold Him, the Destroyer of ego. ||2|| pMnw 598
lines.transliteration: so barahm ajonee hai bhee honee gh at bheetar daykh muraaree jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: This wretched world is caught in birth and death; in the love of duality, it has forgotten devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam maran ka-o ih jag bapurho in d oojai bh agat visaaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਪੁੜੋ  ਇਿਨ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਵਸਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the Guru's Teachings are obtained; the faithless cynic losesthe game of life. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a gurmat  paa-ee-ai saakat  baajee haaree jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਹਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Breaking my bonds, the True Guru has set me free, and I shall not be cast into thewomb of reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: satgur banDh an torh niraaray bahurh  na garabh  majh aaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋਿੜ ਿਨਰਾਰੇ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, and the Lord, the Formless Lord,dwells within my mind. ||4||8|| soriT mhlw 1 ] (598-4) sorath mehlaa 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gi-aan ratan pargaasi-aa har man vasi-aa nirankaaree jee-o. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Name, for which you have come into the world - that AmbrosialNectar is with the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis jal niDh kaaran  tum jag aa-ay so amrit  gur paahee jee-o.

lines.english: Renounce costumes, disguises and clever tricks; this fruit is not obtained by duplicity. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chhodahu vays bh aykh chaturaa-ee d ubiDh aa ih fal naahee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਜਲ ਿਨਿਧ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮ ਜਿਗ  ਆਏ  ਸੋ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, remain steady, and do not wander away.
lines.transliteration: man ray thir rahu mat kat  jaahee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਵੇਸੁ ਭੇਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By searching around on the outside, you shall only suffer great pain; the AmbrosialNectar is found within the home of your own being. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baahar dhoodh at bahut  dukh paavahi gh ar amrit  ghat maahee jee-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਿਥਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce corruption, and seek virtue; committing sins, you shall only come to regretand repent.
lines.transliteration: avgun chh od gun aa ka-o Dh aavahu kar avgun  pachh utaahee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਢੂਢਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਘਿਰ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You do not know the difference between good and evil; again and again, you sink intothe mud. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sar apsar kee saar na jaaneh fir fir keech budaahee jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Within you is the great filth of greed and falsehood; why do you bother to wash yourbody on the outside?
lines.transliteration: antar mail lobh  baho jh oothay baahar naavhu kaahee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਛੋਿਡ ਗੁਣਾ  ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord always, under Guru's Instruction; only then will your innermost being be emancipated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam japahu sad gurmukh  antar kee gat  taahee jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ  ਕੀਚ  ਬੁਡਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let greed and slander be far away from you, and renounce falsehood; through theTrue Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall obtain the true fruit.
lines.transliteration: parhar lobh nind aa koorh  ti-aagahu sach gur bachnee fal paahee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਲੋਭ ਬਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਨਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, You preserve me, Dear Lord; servant Nanak sings the Praises of Your Shabad. ||4||9|| soriT mhlw 1 pMcpdy ] (598-10) sorath mehlaa 1 panchpad ay. Sorat'h, First Mehl, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh o har jee-o jan naanak sabad  salaahee jee-o. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You cannot save your own home from being plundered; why do you spy on thehouses of others?
lines.transliteration: apnaa ghar moosat  raakh  na saakeh kee par gh ar johan laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਿਤਆਗਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: That Gurmukh who joins himself to the Guru's service, saves his own home, andtastes the Lord's Nectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar raakh ahi jay ras chaakh ahi jo gurmukh  sayvak laagaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: O mind, you must realize what your intellect is focused on.
lines.transliteration: man ray samajh kavan mat  laagaa.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is involved with other tastes; theunfortunate wretch shall come to regret it in the end. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam visaar an ras lobhaanay fir pachh utaahi abh aagaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਤ ਰਾਿਖ  ਨ ਸਾਕਿਹ  ਕੀ ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹਨ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: When things come, he is pleased, but when they go, he weeps and wails; this painand pleasure remains attached to him.
lines.transliteration: aavat ka-o harakh  jaat ka-o roveh ih d ukh sukh  naalay laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਹ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself causes him to enjoy pleasure and endure pain; the Gurmukh,however, remains unaffected. ||2||
