lines.transliteration: aapay dukh  sukh  bhog bh ogaavai gurmukh  so anraagaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਮਝੁ  ਕਵਨ  ਮਿਤ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: What else can be said to be above the subtle essence of the Lord? One who drinks it in is satisfied and satiated.
lines.transliteration: har ras oopar avar ki-aa kahee-ai jin pee-aa so taript aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ਅਨ ਰਸ ਲੋਭਾਨੇ  ਿਫਿਰ ਪਛੁਤਾਿਹ  ਅਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who is lured by Maya loses this juice; that faithless cynic is tied to his evil-mindedness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohit jin ih ras kh o-i-aa jaa saakat  durmat  laagaa. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord is the life of the mind, the Master of the breath of life; the Divine Lord iscontained in the body.
lines.transliteration: man kaa jee-o pavanpat d ayhee d ayhee meh d ay-o samaagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਕਉ ਹਰਖ  ਜਾਤ  ਕਉ ਰੋਵਿਹ  ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲੇ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: If You so bless us, Lord, then we sing Your Praises; the mind is satisfied and fulfilled,lovingly attached to the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jay too d eh ta har ras gaa-ee man t ariptai har liv laagaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਿਗ ਭੋਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋ ਅਨਰਾਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the subtle essence of the Lord isobtained; meeting the Guru, the fear of death departs.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  meh har ras paa-ee-ai gur mili-ai jam bh a-o bh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਊਪਿਰ  ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੀਆ  ਸੋ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chant the Name of the Lord, as Gurmukh; you shall obtain the Lord, andrealize your pre-ordained destiny. ||5||10|| soriT mhlw 1 ] (598-18) sorath mehlaa 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam jap gurmukh har paa-ay mast ak bh aagaa. ||5||10||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਿਹਤ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਖੋਇਆ  ਜਾ ਸਾਕਤ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Destiny, pre-ordained by the Lord, looms over the heads of all beings; no one iswithout this pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa sir laykh Dh uraahoo bin laykh ai nahee ko-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ  ਪਵਨਪਿਤ  ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਦੇਉ ਸਮਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Only He Himself is beyond destiny; creating the creation by His creative power, He beholds it, and causes His Command to be followed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap alaykh kud rat kar d aykhai hukam chalaa-ay so-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਈ  ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and be at peace.
lines.transliteration: man ray raam japahu sukh ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, serve at the Guru's feet; the Lord is the Giver, and the Enjoyer. ||Pause|| pMnw 599
lines.transliteration: ahinis gur kay charan sarayvhu har daat aa bh ugtaa so-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He is within - see Him outside as well; there is no one, other than Him.
lines.transliteration: jo antar so baahar d aykhhu avar na d oojaa ko-ee jee-o.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, look upon all with the single eye of equality; in each and every heart, the Divine Light is contained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ayk d arisat kar d aykhhu gh at ghat jot samo-ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Restrain your fickle mind, and keep it steady within its own home; meeting the Guru,this understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: chaltou th aak rakh ahu gh ar apnai gur mili-ai ih mat  ho-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮੋਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Seeing the unseen Lord, you shall be amazed and delighted; forgetting your pain, you shall be at peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: daykh  adrist raha-o bismaad ee dukh bisrai sukh  ho-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਤੌ  ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਖਹੁ ਘਿਰ ਅਪਨੈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਇਹ ਮਿਤ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking in the ambrosial nectar, you shall attain the highest bliss, and dwell withinthe home of your own self.
lines.transliteration: peevhu api-o param sukh paa-ee-ai nij gh ar vaasaa ho-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਅਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੁ ਰਹਉ  ਿਬਸਮਾਦੀ  ਦੁਖੁ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: So sing the Praises of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fear of birth and death, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: janam maran bh av bh anjan gaa-ee-ai punrap janam na ho-ee jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅਿਪਉ  ਪਰਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The essence, the immaculate Lord, the Light of all - I am He and He is me - there isno difference between us.
lines.transliteration: tat niranjan jot  sabaa-ee sohaN bhayd na ko-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Infinite Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God - Nanak has met with Him, theGuru. ||5||11|| soriT mhlw 1 Gru 3  (599-7) sorath mehlaa 1 gh ar 3 Sorat'h, First Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (599-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: aprampar paarbarahm parmaysar naanak gur mili-aa so-ee jee-o. ||5||11||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਜੋਿਤ ਸਬਾਈ  ਸੋਹੰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: When I am pleasing to Him, then I sing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavaa t ad hee gaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Singing His Praises, I receive the fruits of my rewards.
lines.transliteration: taa gaavay kaa fal paavaa.

lines.english: The rewards of singing His Praises are obtained when He Himself gives them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gaavay kaa fal ho-ee. jaa aapay dayvai so-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the treasure is obtained;
lines.transliteration: man mayray gur bachnee niDh paa-ee.
taa tay sach meh rahi-aa samaa-ee. rahaa-o. this is why I remain immersed in the True Name. ||Pause||

lines.english: When I awoke within myself to the Guru's Teachings,
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee ant ar jaagee.
taa chanchal mat  ti-aagee. then I renounced my fickle intellect.

lines.english: When the Light of the Guru's Teachings dawned,
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee kaa ujee-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਚ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taa miti-aa sagal anDh -yaaraa. ||2|| and then all darkness was dispelled. ||2||

lines.english: When the mind is attached to the Guru's Feet,
lines.transliteration: gur charnee man laagaa.
taa jam kaa maarag bh aagaa. then the Path of Death recedes.

lines.english: Through the Fear of God, one attains the Fearless Lord;
lines.transliteration: bhai vich nirbh a-o paa-i-aa.
taa sahjai kai gh ar aa-i-aa. ||3|| then, one enters the home of celestial bliss. ||3||

lines.english: Prays Nanak, how rare are those who reflect and understand,
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak boojh ai ko beechaaree.
is jag meh karnee saaree. the most sublime action in this world.

lines.english: The noblest deed is to sing the Lord's Praises,
lines.transliteration: karnee keerat  ho-ee.

lines.english: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (599-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jaa aapay mili-aa so-ee. ||4||1||12|| and so meet the Lord Himself. ||4||1||12|| soriT mhlw 3 Gru 1  (599-14) sorath mehlaa 3 gh ar 1

lines.english: All of Your servants, who relish the Word of Your Shabad, serve You.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayv karahi sabh t ayree jin sabd ai saad  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they become pure, eradicating self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay nirmal ho-aa jin vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Night and day, they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; they areadorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavahi nit  saachay gur kai sabad  suhaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, I am Your child; I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur ham baarik saran  tumaaree.

lines.english: You are the One and Only Lord, the Truest of the True; You Yourself are the Destroyer of ego. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayko sachaa sach too kayval aap muraaree. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who remain wakeful obtain God; through the Word of the Shabad, theyconquer their ego.
lines.transliteration: jaagat rahay t inee parabh  paa-i-aa sabd ay ha-umai maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਜਨ ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Immersed in family life, the Lord's humble servant ever remains detached; he reflectsupon the essence of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: girhee meh sadaa har jan ud aasee gi-aan t at beechaaree.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, he finds eternal peace, and he keeps the Lord enshrined in hisheart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa har raakh i-aa ur Dh aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This mind wanders in the ten directions; it is consumed by the love of duality. pMnw 600
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa dah d is Dhaavdaa doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord's Name; he wastes away his life in vain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mugaDh  har naam na chayt ai birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: But when he meets the True Guru, then he obtains the Name; he sheds egotism andemotional attachment. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay t aa naa-o paa-ay ha-umai moh chukaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servants are True - they practice Truth, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har jan saachay saach kamaaveh gur kai sabad veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord God unites them with Himself, and they keep the True Lord enshrinedin their hearts.
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl la-ay parabh saachai saach rakh i-aa ur Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ਏਹਾ ਰਾਿਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Name, I have obtained salvation and understanding; this aloneis my wealth. ||4||1|| soriT mhlw 3 ] (600-3) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naavhu gat mat  paa-ee ayhaa raas hamaaree. ||4||1||

lines.english: The True Lord has blessed His devotees with the treasure of devotional worship, andthe wealth of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  khajaanaa bh agtan ka-o d ee-aa naa-o har Dh an sach so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਉ ਦੀਆ  ਨਾਉ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Naam, shall never be exhausted; no one can estimate its worth.
lines.transliteration: akhut naam Dh an kad ay nikh utai naahee kinai na keemat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਦੇ ਿਨਖੁਟੈ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: With the wealth of the Naam, their faces are radiant, and they attain the True Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: naam Dhan mukh  ujlay ho-ay har paa-i-aa sach so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਧਿਨ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਹੋਏ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found.
lines.transliteration: man mayray gur sabdee har paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, the world wanders around, and receives its punishment in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai jag bh uldaa fird aa dargeh milai sajaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Within this body dwell the five thieves: sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and egotism.
lines.transliteration: is dayhee and ar panch chor vaseh kaam kroDh  lobh moh ahaNkaaraa.

lines.english: They plunder the Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not realize it; no onehears his complaint.
lines.transliteration: amrit looteh manmukh  nahee boojh eh ko-ay na sun ai pookaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਿਰ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਸਿਹ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The world is blind, and its dealings are blind as well; without the Guru, there is onlypitch darkness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anDhaa jagat  anDh  vartaaraa baajh  guroo gubaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਲੂਟਿਹ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Indulging in egotism and possessiveness, they are ruined; when they depart, nothinggoes along with them.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa kar kar vigutay kihu chalai na chald i-aa naal.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਾ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਅੰਧੁ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ  ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: But one who becomes Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and ever contemplates theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so naam Dh i-aavai sad aa har naam samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਿਵਗੁਤੇ  ਿਕਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of Gurbani, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; blessedwith the Lord's Glance of Grace, he is enraptured. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sachee banee har gun  gaavai nad ree nad ar nihaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is a steady light within the heart. The Lord'sdecree is over the heads of even kings.
lines.transliteration: satgur gi-aan sad aa gh at chaanan  amar sir baad isaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Night and day, the Lord's devotees worship Him; night and day, they gather in the true profit of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahi d in raat ee raam naam sach laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਅਮਰੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਬਾਿਦਸਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; attuned to the Shabad, hefinds the Lord. ||4||2|| soriT mÚ 3 ] (600-12) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam nistaaraa sabad  ratay har paahaa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: If one becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves, then he finds the Lord, and eradicatesego from within.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aas hovai t aa har paa-ay vichahu aap gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord of bliss is his object of devotion; night and day, he sings the Glorious Praisesof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa kaaraj har anand hai an-d in har gun  gaa-ee.

lines.english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the Lord's devotees remain ever as one, absorbedin the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay sad aa ik rangee har si-o rahay samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, Your Glance of Grace is True.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o saachee nadar t umaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਹਿਰ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Show mercy to Your slave, O Beloved Lord, and preserve my honor. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapni-aa d aasaa no kirpaa kar pi-aaray raakh o paij hamaaree. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Continually praising the Word of the Shabad, I live; under Guru's Instruction, my fear has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sabad salaahee sad aa ha-o jeevaa gurmat ee bh a-o bh aagaa.

lines.english: My True Lord God is so beautiful! Serving the Guru, my consciousness is focused on Him.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa at  su-aali-o gur sayvi-aa chit  laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਿਣਆ  ਦਾਸਾ  ਨੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who chants the True Word of the Shabad, and the Truest of the True, the Wordof His Bani, remains wakeful, day and night. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachaa sabad sachee sach ban ee so jan an-d in jaagaa. ||2||

lines.english: He is so very deep and profound, the Giver of eternal peace; no one can find His limit.
lines.transliteration: mahaa gambheer sad aa sukh -daata tis kaa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Perfect Guru, one becomes carefree, enshrining the Lord within the mind.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee sayvaa keenee achint har man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਸੁਆਿਲਉ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: The mind and body become immaculately pure, and a lasting peace fills the heart; doubt is eradicated from within. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal sad aa sukh  antar vichahu bh aram chukaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Way of the Lord is always such a difficult path; only a few find it, contemplatingthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kaa maarag sadaa panth vikh -rhaa ko paa-ay gur veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Shabad, he renounces ego andcorruption.
lines.transliteration: har kai rang raataa sabd ay maat aa ha-umai t ajay vikaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਨੀ  ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, and the Love of the One Lord, he is embellished with the Word of the Shabad. ||4||3|| pMnw 601 soriT mhlw 3 ] (601-1) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rataa ik rangee sabad  savaaran haaraa. ||4||3||

lines.english: Dear Beloved Lord, I praise You continually, as long as there is the breath within my body.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tuDh  no sad aa saalaahee pi-aaray jichar gh at ant ar hai saasaa.

lines.english: If I were to forget You, for a moment, even for an instant, O Lord Master, it would belike fifty years for me.
lines.transliteration: ik pal khin visrahi t oo su-aamee jaan a-o baras pachaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੁਧੁ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹੈ ਸਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: I was always such a fool and an idiot, O Siblings of Destiny, but now, through theWord of the Guru's Shabad, my mind is enlightened. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham moorh mugaDh  sadaa say bh aa-ee gur kai sabad  pargaasaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਵਸਰਿਹ  ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਾਣਉ  ਬਰਸ  ਪਚਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dear Lord, You Yourself bestow understanding.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tum aapay d ayh bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਸਦਾ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dear Lord, I am forever a sacrifice to You; I am dedicated and devoted to Your Name.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tuDh  vitahu vaari-aa sad  hee t ayray naam vitahu bal jaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have died in the Word of the Shabad, and through the Shabad, I am dead while yetalive, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Shabad, I have been liberated.
lines.transliteration: ham sabad mu-ay sabad  maar jeevaalay bh aa-ee sabd ay hee mukat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, my mind and body have been purified, and the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.
lines.transliteration: sabday man t an nirmal ho-aa har vasi-aa man aa-ee.

lines.english: The Guru is the Giver of the Shabad; my mind is imbued with it, and I remainabsorbed in the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabad gur d aataa jit man raat aa har si-o rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੁਏ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾਲੇ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਹੀ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not know the Shabad are blind and deaf; why did they even bother tocome into the world?
lines.transliteration: sabad na jaan eh say annay bolay say kit  aa-ay sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: They do not obtain the subtle essence of the Lord's elixir; they waste away their lives,and are reincarnated over and over again.
lines.transliteration: har ras na paa-i-aa birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa jameh vaaro vaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਿਹਆ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs are like maggots in manure, and in manurethey rot away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bistaa kay keerhay bistaa maahi samaan ay manmukh  mugaDh  gubaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸੇ ਅੰਨੇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸੇ ਿਕਤੁ  ਆਏ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself creates us, watches over us, and places us on the Path, O Siblings ofDestiny; there is no one other than Him.
lines.transliteration: aapay kar vaykhai maarag laa-ay bh aa-ee t is bin avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: No one can erase that which is pre-ordained, O Siblings of Destiny; whatever theCreator wills, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so ko-ay na maytai bh aa-ee kart aa karay so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਗੁਬਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; O Siblings ofDestiny, there is no other at all. ||4||4|| soriT mhlw 3 ] (601-10) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasi-aa man antar bh aa-ee avar na d oojaa ko-ee. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਲਾਏ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs practice devotional worship, and become pleasing to God; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat karahi parabh  bhaaveh an-d in naam vakh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself protect and take care of Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kee saar karahi aap raakh ahi jo t ayrai man bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਭਾਈ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of virtue, realized through the Word of Your Shabad. Uttering YourGlories, we merge with You, O Glorious Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too gund aataa sabad  pachh aataa gun  kahi gun ee samaan ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, remember always the Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har jee-o sadaa samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, He alone shall be your best friend; He shall always stand byyou. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ant kaal t ayraa baylee hovai sad aa nibhai t ayrai naal. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: The gathering of the wicked enemies shall always practice falsehood; they do notcontemplate understanding.
lines.transliteration: dusat cha-ukarh ee sad aa koorh  kamaaveh naa boojh eh veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਗੁਣ ਕਿਹ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Who can obtain fruit from the slander of evil enemies? Remember that Harnaakhashwas torn apart by the Lord's claws.
lines.transliteration: nindaa d ustee t ay kin fal paa-i-aa harn aakhas nakh eh bid aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Prahlaad, the Lord's humble servant, constantly sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Dear Lord saved him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: par-hilaad jan sad  har gun  gaavai har jee-o la-ay ubaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਿਲ  ਤੇਰਾ ਬੇਲੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਿਨਬਹੈ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs see themselves as being very virtuous; they haveabsolutely no understanding at all.
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o baho bhalaa kar jaan eh manmukh  mat na kaa-ee.

lines.english: They indulge in slander of the humble spiritual people; they waste their lives away,and then they have to depart.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo jan kee nind aa vi-aapay jaasan janam gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਟ  ਚਉਕੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: They never think of the Lord's Name, and in the end, they depart, regretting andrepenting. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam kaday cheet eh naahee ant  ga-ay pachh utaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਦੁਸਟੀ  ਤੇ ਿਕਿਨ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਰਣਾਖਸ  ਨਖਿਹ  ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord makes the lives of His devotees fruitful; He Himself links them to the Guru'sservice.
lines.transliteration: safal janam bhagt aa kaa keet aa gur sayvaa aap laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦੁ  ਜਨੁ ਸਦ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial bliss, night andday, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabday raat ay sehjay maat ay an-d in har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਸ  ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣਿਹ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮਿਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak utters this prayer: O Lord, please, let me fall at their feet. ||4||5|| soriT mhlw 3 ] (601-18) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai baynant ee ha-o laagaa t in kai paa-ay. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਜਾਸਿਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a Sikh, a friend, a relative and a sibling, who walks in the Way of the Guru's Will.
lines.transliteration: so sikh sakh aa banDh ap hai bh aa-ee je gur kay bh aanay vich aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਚੇਤਿਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who walks according to his own will, O Siblings of Destiny, suffers separationfrom the Lord, and shall be punished.
lines.transliteration: aapnai bh aanai jo chalai bh aa-ee vichh urh chotaa kh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਾ ਕੀਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਿਪ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, peace is never obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; again andagain, he regrets and repents. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sukh  kaday na paavai bh aa-ee fir fir pachh otaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's slaves are happy, O Siblings of Destiny. pMnw 602
lines.transliteration: har kay daas suhaylay bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The sins and sorrows of countless lifetimes are eradicated; the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilbikh d ukh kaatay aapay mayl milaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: All of these relatives are like chains upon the soul, O Siblings of Destiny; the world isdeluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: ih kutamb sabh jee-a kay banDh an bh aa-ee bh aram bh ulaa saiNsaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Guru, the chains cannot be broken; the Gurmukhs find the door ofsalvation.
lines.transliteration: bin gur banDhan tooteh naahee gurmukh  mokh  du-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਭਾਈ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾ ਸੈਂਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who performs rituals without realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad, shall die and be reborn, again and again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karam karahi gur sabad na pachh aaneh mar janmeh vaaro vaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ  ਟੂਟਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The world is entangled in egotism and possessiveness, O Siblings of Destiny, but noone belongs to anyone else.
lines.transliteration: ha-o mayraa jag palach rahi-aa bhaa-ee ko-ay na kis hee kayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glories of theLord; they dwell in the home of their own inner being.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mahal paa-in gun  gaavan nij gh ar ho-ay basayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਪਲਿਚ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: One who understands here, realizes himself; the Lord God belongs to him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aithai boojhai so aap pachh aanai har parabh  hai tis kayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਬਸੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is forever merciful, O Siblings of Destiny; without good destiny, whatcan anyone obtain?
lines.transliteration: satguroo sad aa da-i-aal hai bh aa-ee vin  bhaagaa ki-aa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He looks alike upon all with His Glance of Gr ace, but people receive the fruits of their rewards according to their love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayk nadar kar vaykh ai sabh  oopar jayhaa bh aa-o t ayhaa fal paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind,then self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||6|| soriT mhlw 3 cOquky ] (602-7) sorath mehlaa 3 chout ukay. Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Chau-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar vichahu aap gavaa-ee-ai. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਜੇਹਾ ਭਾਉ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: True devotional worship is obtained only through the True Guru, when the True Word of His Bani is in the heart.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat  satgur tay hovai sachee hird ai ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained; egotism is obliterated through theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay sad aa sukh  paa-ay ha-umai sabad  samaan ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru, there is no true devotion; otherwise, people wander around,deluded by ignorance.
lines.transliteration: bin gur saachay bhagat  na hovee hor bh oolee firai i-aan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੀ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, suffering in constant pain; they drown anddie, even without water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manmukh fireh sad aa dukh paavahi doob mu-ay vin  paan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, remain forever in the Lord's Sanctuary, under His Protection.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ray sad aa rahhu sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਿਫਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He preserves our honor, and blesses us with the gloryof the Lord's Name. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapnee nad ar karay pat  raakh ai har naamo d ay vadi-aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਿਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to understand himself, contemplating the TrueWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay aap pachh aataa sabad  sachai veechaaraa.

lines.english: The Lord, the Life of the world, ever abides in his heart, and he renounces sexualdesire, anger and egotism.
lines.transliteration: hirdai jagjeevan sad  vasi-aa t aj kaam kroDh  ahaNkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is ever-present, permeating and pervading all places; the Name of the Infinite Lord is enshrined within the heart.
lines.transliteration: sadaa hajoor ravi-aa sabh  thaa-ee hird ai naam apaaraa.

lines.english: Throughout the ages, through the Word of His Bani, His Shabad is realized, and theName becomes so sweet and beloved to the mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jug jug banee sabad  pachh aanee naa-o meeth aa maneh pi-aaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, one realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord; fruitful is his life, andhis coming into the world.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv jin naam pachh aataa safal janam jag aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਦ ਵਿਸਆ  ਤਿਜ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Tasting the sublime elixir of the Lord, his mind is satisfied and satiated forever;singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, he is fulfilled and satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakh sad aa man t aripti-aa gun  gaavai gun ee agh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The lotus of his heart blossoms forth, he is ever imbued with the Lord's Love, and theunstruck melody of the Shabad resounds within him.
lines.transliteration: kamal pargaas sadaa rang raat aa anhad  sabad  vajaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੀ  ਨਾਉ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: His body and mind become immaculately pure; his speech becomes immaculate aswell, and he merges in the Truest of the True. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tan man nirmal nirmal ban ee sachay sach samaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਿਜਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਜਿਗ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one knows the state of the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, it comesto abide in the heart.
lines.transliteration: raam naam kee gat ko-ay na boojh ai gurmat  ridai samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤਆ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣੀ ਅਘਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the Path; his tongue savors the sublimeessence of the Lord's Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so mag pachh aanai har ras rasan rasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meditation, austere self-discipline and self-restraint are all obtained from the Guru; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide within the heart.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam sabh  gur t ay hovai hird ai naam vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਨਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings who praise the Naam are beautiful; they are honoredin the Court of the True Lord. ||4||7|| soriT mÚ 3 duquky ] (602-17) sorath mehlaa 3 d utukay. Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Du-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaaleh say jan sohan dar saachai pat  paa-ee. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one turns away from the world, O Siblings of Destiny; whenhe remains dead while yet alive, he obtains true understanding.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai ultee bh a-ee bh aa-ee jeevat  marai t aa boojh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਮਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is the Guru, and he alone is a Sikh, O Siblings of Destiny, whose lightmerges in the Light. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so guroo so sikh hai bh aa-ee jis jot ee jot  milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, be lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man ray har har saytee liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, it seems so sweet to the mind, O Siblings of Destiny;the Gurmukhs obtain a place in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause|| pMnw 603
lines.transliteration: man har jap meethaa laagai bh aa-ee gurmukh  paa-ay har thaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, love for the Lord does not well up, O Siblings of Destiny; the self- willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: bin gur pareet na oopjai bh aa-ee manmukh  doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟਿਹ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਭਾਈ  ਪਲੈ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Actions performed by the manmukh are like the threshing of the chaff - they obtain nothing for their efforts. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tuh kuteh manmukh  karam karahi bh aa-ee palai kichh oo na paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਰਿਵਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, the Naam comes to permeate the mind, O Siblings of Destiny, withtrue love and affection.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai naam man ravi-aa bhaa-ee saachee pareet  pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He always sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, with infinitelove for the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa har kay gun  ravai bh aa-ee gur kai hayt  apaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: How blessed and approved is his coming into the world, O Siblings of Destiny, whofocuses his mind on serving the Guru.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa so parvaan hai bh aa-ee je gur sayvaa chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮੇਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny, through the Wordof the Guru's Shabad, and we merge with the Lord. ||4||8|| soriT mhlw 3 Gru 1 ] (603-4) sorath mehlaa 3 gh ar 1. Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam har paa-ee-ai bhaa-ee gur sabd ee maylaa-ay. ||4||8||

lines.english: The three worlds are entangled in the three qualities, O Siblings of Destiny; the Guruimparts understanding.
lines.transliteration: tihee gun ee taribhavan vi-aapi-aa bh aa-ee gurmukh  boojh  bujhaa-ay.

lines.english: Attached to the Lord's Name, one is emancipated, O Siblings of Destiny; go and askthe wise ones about this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam lag chhootee-ai bh aa-ee poochh ahu gi-aanee-aa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਿਗ  ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਪੂਛਹੁ ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mind, renounce the three qualities, and focus your consciousness on the fourth state.
lines.transliteration: man ray tarai gun  chhod cha-uthai chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਛੋਿਡ ਚਉਥੈ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord abides in the mind, O Siblings of Destiny; ever sing the Glorious Praisesof the Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tayrai man vasai bh aa-ee sad aa har kay gun  gaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: From the Naam, everyone originated, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, theydie away.
lines.transliteration: naamai tay sabh  oopjay bh aa-ee naa-ay visri-ai mar jaa-ay.

lines.english: The ignorant world is blind, O Siblings of Destiny; those who sleep are plundered.||2||
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee jagat anDh  hai bh aa-ee soot ay ga-ay muhaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਊਪਜੇ  ਭਾਈ  ਨਾਇ  ਿਵਸਿਰਐ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who remain awake are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they cross overthe terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaagay say ubray bh aa-ee bh avjal paar ut aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In this world, the Name of the Lord is the true profit, O Siblings of Destiny; keep itenshrined within your heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jag meh laahaa har naam hai bhaa-ee hird ai rakh i-aa ur Dh aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਗੇ  ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਭਾਈ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: In the Guru's Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny, you shall be saved; be lovingly attunedto the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur sarnaa-ee ubray bh aa-ee raam naam liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਿਖਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is the boat, and the Name is the raft, O Siblings ofDestiny; setting out on it, the Lord's humble servant crosses over the world-ocean.||4||9|| soriT mhlw 3 Gru 1 ] (603-10) sorath mehlaa 3 gh ar 1. Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak naa-o bayrhaa naa-o t ulharh aa bh aa-ee jit  lag paar jan paa-ay. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਭਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the ocean of peace in the world; there is no other place of rest and peace.
lines.transliteration: satgur sukh  saagar jag ant ar hor thai sukh  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਉ  ਬੇੜਾ ਨਾਉ  ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਤੁ ਲਿਗ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਜਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: The world is afflicted with the painful disease of egotism; dying, only to be reborn, itcries out in pain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jagat d ukh rog vi-aapi-aa mar janmai rovai Dh aahee. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain peace.
lines.transliteration: paraanee sat gur sayv sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: If you serve the True Guru, you shall find peace; otherwise, you shall depart, afterwasting away your life in vain. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh t aa sukh  paavahi naahi t a jaahigaa janam gavaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਦੁਿਖ ਰੋਿਗ ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Led around by the three qualities, he does many deeds, but he does not come to tasteand savor the subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  Dhaat baho karam kamaaveh har ras saad  na aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He says his evening prayers, and makes offerings of water, and recites his morningprayers, but without true understanding, he still suffers in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sanDhi-aa t arpan  karahi gaa-it aree bin boojh ay dukh paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਤ ਜਾਿਹਗਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who serves the True Guru is very fortunate; as the Lord so wills, he meets withthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay so vadbh aagee jis no aap milaa-ay.

lines.english: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, His humble servants remain ever satisfied; they eradicate self-conceit from within themselves. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har ras pee jan sadaa t ariptaasay vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁ ਣ ਧਾਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This world is blind, and all act blindly; without the Guru, no one finds the Path.
lines.transliteration: ih jag anDhaa sabh  anDh  kamaavai bin gur mag na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਧਆ  ਤਰਪਣੁ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਗਾਇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one sees with his eyes, and finds the True Lordwithin the home of his own being. ||4||10|| soriT mhlw 3 ] (603-16) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur milai t a akh ee vaykh ai gharai and ar sach paa-ay. ||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, he suffers in terrible pain, and throughout the fourages, he wanders aimlessly.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay bahut aa dukh laagaa jug chaaray bh armaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੇ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am poor and meek, and throughout the ages, You are the Great Giver - please, grant me the understanding of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham deen t um jug jug d aatay sabd ay deh bujh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧਾ  ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Dear Beloved Lord, please show mercy to me.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kirpaa karahu tum pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਅਖੀ  ਵੇਖੈ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Unite me in the Union of the True Guru, the Great Giver, and give me the support ofthe Lord's Name. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa mayl milaavhu har naam d ayvhu aaDh aaray. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Conquering my desires and duality, I have merged in celestial peace, and I have found the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maar dubiDh aa sahj samaan ee paa-i-aa naam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਭਰਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord, and my soul has become immaculately pure; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||2|| pMnw 604
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakh man nirmal ho-aa kilbikh  kaatan haaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Dying in the Word of the Shabad, you shall live forever, and you shall never die again.
lines.transliteration: sabad marahu fir jeevhu sad  hee t aa fir maran  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰਹੁ ਿਫਿਰ  ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤਾ ਿਫਿਰ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is ever-sweet to the mind; but how few are those who obtain the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad aa man meeth aa sabd ay paavai ko-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਮੀਠਾ  ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Great Giver keeps His Gifts in His Hand; He gives them to those with whom He ispleased.
lines.transliteration: daatai daat rakhee hath apn ai jis bh aavai t is day-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਤੈ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਰਖੀ ਹਿਥ ਅਪਣੈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they find peace, and in the Court of the Lord, theyare exalted. ||4||11|| soriT mhlw 3 ] (604-3) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sukh  paa-i-aa d argeh jaapeh say-ee. ||4||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ  ਜਾਪਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the divine melody wells up within, and one is blessed withwisdom and salvation.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa sahj Dh un upjai gat  mat tad hee paa-ay.

lines.english: The True Name of the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and through the Name, onemerges in the Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sachaa man vasi-aa naamay naam samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਗਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the whole world is insane.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sabh  jag ba-uraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not realize the Word of the Shabad; they aredeluded by false doubts. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa sabad  na jaan ai jhoothai bharam bh ulaanaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The three-faced Maya had led them astray in doubt, and they are snared by the nooseof egotism.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa ha-umai banDh an kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਝੂਠੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death hang over their heads, and being reborn from the womb, they sufferin pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  sir oopar oobh a-o garabh  jon d ukh paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The three qualities permeate the whole world; acting in ego, it loses its honor.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  varteh sagal sansaaraa ha-umai vich pat  kho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ  ਭਰਿਮ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: But one who becomes Gurmukh comes to realize the fourth state of celestial bliss; hefinds peace through the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai cha-uthaa pad  cheenai raam naam sukh  ho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਿਸਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਊਭਉ  ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The three qualities are all Yours, O Lord; You Yourself created them. Whatever Youdo, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  sabh  tayray t oo aapay kart aa jo t oo karahi so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਿਹ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; through the Shabad, he is rid of egotism. ||4||12|| soriT mhlw 4 Gru 1  (604-10) sorath mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (604-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam nistaaraa sabd ay ha-umai kh o-ee. ||4||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਚਉਥਾ  ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap varatdaa pi-aaraa aapay aap apaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਿਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: My Beloved Himself is the trader in this world; He Himself is the true banker.
lines.transliteration: vanjaaraa jag aap hai pi-aaraa aapay saachaa saahu.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.english: My Beloved Himself is the trade and the trader; He Himself is the true credit. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay vanaj vapaaree-aa pi-aaraa aapay sach vaysaahu. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and praise His Name.
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam salaah.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Beloved, Ambrosial, unapproachable and unfathomable Lord isobtained. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay paa-ee-ai pi-aaraa amrit  agam athaah. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਜਗੁ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself sees and hears everything; He Himself speaks through themouths of all beings.
lines.transliteration: aapay sun sabh  vaykh -daa pi-aaraa mukh  bolay aap muhaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵਣਜੁ  ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself leads us into the wilderness, and He Himself shows us the Way.
lines.transliteration: aapay ujharh  paa-id aa pi-aaraa aap vikh aalay raahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is Himself all-in-all; He Himself is carefree. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay hee sabh aap hai pi-aaraa aapay vayparvaahu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਥਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, created everything; He Himself links all to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap upaa-idaa pi-aaraa sir aapay Dh anDh-rhai laahu.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself creates the Creation, and He Himself destroys it.
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay saakh-t ee pi-aaraa aap maaray mar jaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸਭ ਵੇਖਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੇ ਆਿਪ ਮੁਹਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the wharf, and He Himself is the ferryman, who ferries us across. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay patan  paat-nee pi-aaraa aapay paar langh aahu. ||3||

lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the ocean, and the boat; He Himself is the Guru, the boatmanwho steers it
lines.transliteration: aapay saagar bohithaa pi-aaraa gur khayvat aap chalaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: . The Beloved Himself sets sail and crosses over; He, the King, beholds His wondrousplay.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee charh langh -daa pi-aaraa kar choj vaykh ai paat isaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਧੰਧੜੈ  ਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the Merciful Master; O servant Nanak, He forgives and blendswith Himself. ||4||1|| soriT mhlw 4 cauQw ] (604-18) sorath mehlaa 4 cha-uthaa. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay aap da-i-aal hai pi-aaraa jan naanak bakh as milaahu. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਸਾਖਤੀ  ਿਪਆਰਾ ਆਿਪ  ਮਾਰੇ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is born of the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; He Himself is the continents and all the worlds.
lines.transliteration: aapay andaj jayraj saytaj ut -bhuj aapay kh and aapay sabh  lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਤਣੁ  ਪਾਤਣੀ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself is the thread, and He Himself is the many beads; through His AlmightyPower, He has strung the worlds. pMnw 605
lines.transliteration: aapay soot aapay baho man ee-aa kar sakt ee jagat  paro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਸੂਤਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸੂਤੁ ਿਖੰਚੇ ਢਿਹ ਢੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He holds the thread, and when He withdraws the thread, the beads scatter into heaps. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay hee soot-Dh aar hai pi-aaraa soot  khinchay dh eh dh ayree ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, there is no other than the Lord for me.
lines.transliteration: mayray man mai har bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਚੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Beloved Naam is within the True Guru; in His Mercy, he pours theAmbrosial Nectar into my mouth. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur vich naam niDh aan hai pi-aaraa kar d a-i-aa amrit  mukh  cho-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself is in all the oceans and lands; whatever God does, comes topass.
lines.transliteration: aapay jal thal sabhat  hai pi-aaraa parabh  aapay karay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਲ ਥਿਲ ਸਭਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved brings nourishment to all; there is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa rijak samaahad aa pi-aaraa d oojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸਮਾਹਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself plays, and whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay khayl kh aylaa-id aa pi-aaraa aapay karay so ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, is immaculate and pure; He Himself is immaculateand pure.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee aap nirmalaa pi-aaraa aapay nirmal so-ay.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself determines the value of all; whatever He does comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: aapay keemat paa-id aa pi-aaraa aapay karay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is unseen - He cannot be seen; He Himself causes us to see.||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay alakh na lakh ee-ai pi-aaraa aap lakh aavai so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਲਖਾਵੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is deep and profound and unfathomable; there is no other asgreat as He.
lines.transliteration: aapay gahir gambheer hai pi-aaraa t is jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself enjoys every heart; He is contained within every woman andman.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at aapay bh ogvai pi-aaraa vich naaree purakh  sabh  so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ  ਭੋਗਵੈ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਿਵਿਚ ਨਾਰੀ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Beloved is pervading everywhere, but He is hidden; through the Guru,He is revealed. ||4||2|| soriT mhlw 4 ] (605-7) sorath mehlaa 4. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gupat varatd aa pi-aaraa gurmukh  pargat ho-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself, the Beloved, is Himself all-in-all; He Himself establishes anddisestablishes.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee sabh aap hai pi-aaraa aapay thaap uthaapai.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself beholds, and rejoices; God Himself works wonders, and beholds them.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykh vigsad aa pi-aaraa kar choj vaykh ai parabh  aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is contained in all the woods and meadows; as Gurmukh, Hereveals Himself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay van t in sabh at hai pi-aaraa aapay gurmukh  jaapai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਸਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਕਿਰ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate, O mind, on the Lord, Har, Har; through the sublime essence of Lord's Name,you shall be satisfied.
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam ras Dharaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵਿਣ ਿਤਿਣ  ਸਭਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, is the sweetest juice; through the Word of theGuru's Shabad, its taste is revealed. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam mahaa ras meeth aa gur sabd ee chakh  jaapai. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved is Himself the place of pilgrimage and the raft; God Himself ferriesHimself across.
lines.transliteration: aapay tirath t ulharh aa pi-aaraa aap t arai parabh  aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਚਿਖ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself casts the net over all the world; the Lord Himself is the fish.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaal vataa-id aa pi-aaraa sabh  jag machh ulee har aapai.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself is infallible; He makes no mistakes. There is no other like Him tobe seen. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap abhul na bh ul-ee pi-aaraa avar na d oojaa jaapai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਤੁਲਹੜਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi's horn, and the sound current of the Naad; He Himselfplays the tune.
lines.transliteration: aapay sinyee naad  hai pi-aaraa Dh un aap vajaa-ay aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਵਤਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi, the Primal Being; He Himself practices intense meditation.
lines.transliteration: aapay jogee purakh hai pi-aaraa aapay hee t ap taapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਅਭੁਲੁ  ਨ ਭੁਲਈ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; God Himself imparts theTeachings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur aap hai chaylaa upd ays karai parabh  aapai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਸੰਙੀ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਧੁਿਨ ਆਿਪ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself inspires us to chant His Name, and He Himself practicesmeditation.
lines.transliteration: aapay naa-o japaa-idaa pi-aaraa aapay hee jap jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself is the juice of it.
lines.transliteration: aapay amrit aap hai pi-aaraa aapay hee ras aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਚੇਲਾ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਕਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself praises Himself; servant Nanak is satisfied, with the sublimeessence of the Lord. ||4||3|| soriT mhlw 4 ] (605-15) sorath mehlaa 4. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay aap salaahadaa pi-aaraa jan naanak har ras Dh araapai. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਨਾਉ  ਜਪਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: God Himself is the balance scale, He Himself is the weigher, and He Himself weighswith the weights.
lines.transliteration: aapay kandaa aap taraajee parabh  aapay t ol tolaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the banker, He Himself is the trader, and He Himself makes the trades.
lines.transliteration: aapay saahu aapay vanjaaraa aapay van aj karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਲਾਹਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself fashioned the world, and He Himself counter-balances it with a gram. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay Dhart ee saajee-an pi-aarai pichh ai tank charh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: My mind meditates on the Lord, Har, Har, and finds peace.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har har Dhi-aa-ay sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕੰਡਾ ਆਿਪ  ਤਰਾਜੀ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪੇ  ਤੋਿਲ  ਤੋਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, is a treasure; the Perfect Guru has made itseem sweet to me. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam niDhaan hai pi-aaraa gur poorai meeth aa laa-i-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਵਣਜੁ  ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the earth, and He Himself is the water; He Himself acts, andcauses others to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay Dhart ee aap jal pi-aaraa aapay karay karaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself issues His Commands, and keeps the water and the land bounddown.
lines.transliteration: aapay hukam varatdaa pi-aaraa jal maatee banDh  rakhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself instills the Fear of God; He binds the tiger and the goat together. ||2|| pMnw 606
lines.transliteration: aapay hee bha-o paa-id aa pi-aaraa bann bakree seehu hadh aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Beloved Lord Himself is the firewood, and He Himself keeps the fire within the wood.
lines.transliteration: aapay kaasat aap har pi-aaraa vich kaasat agan rakhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਿਨ  ਰਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Lord Himself, all by Himself, permeates them, and because of the Fear of God, the fire cannot burn the wood.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee aap varatdaa pi-aaraa bh ai agan na sakai jalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਭੈ ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself kills and revives; all draw the breath of life, given by Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay maar jeevaa-idaa pi-aaraa saah laid ay sabh  lavaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਿਰ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸਾਹ ਲੈਦੇ ਸਿਭ ਲਵਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is power and presence; He Himself engages us in our work.
lines.transliteration: aapay taan  deebaan  hai pi-aaraa aapay kaarai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਤਾਣੁ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: As the Beloved makes me walk, I walk, as it pleases my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ji-o aap chalaa-ay ti-o chalee-ai pi-aaray ji-o har parabh  mayray bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਆਿਪ  ਚਲਾਏ  ਿਤਉ  ਚਲੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਜਉ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the musician, and the musical instrument; servant Nanakvibrates His vibration. ||4||4|| soriT mhlw 4 ] (606-5) sorath mehlaa 4. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay jantee jant  hai pi-aaraa jan naanak vajeh vajaa-i-aa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜੰਤੀ  ਜੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਜਿਹ  ਵਜਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself created the Universe; He made the light of the sun and themoon.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat upaa-idaa pi-aaraa kar sooraj chand  chaanaan .

lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the power of the powerless; He Himself is the honor of thedishonored.
lines.transliteration: aap nitaan i-aa taan hai pi-aaraa aap nimaan i-aa maan .

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਚੰਦੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself grants His Grace and protects us; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aa kar rakh -daa pi-aaraa aapay sugh arh sujaan . ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and receive His Insignia.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap raam naam neesaan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰ ਰਖਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  mil Dh i-aa-ay t oo har har bahurh  na aavan  jaan. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself pervades His Glorious Praises, and He Himself approves them.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee gun varatd aa pi-aaraa aapay hee parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself grants His forgiveness, and He Himself bestows the Insignia ofTruth.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas karaa-id aa pi-aaraa aapay sach neesaan .

lines.english: The Beloved Himself obeys His Will, and He Himself issues His Command. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay hukam varatdaa pi-aaraa aapay hee furmaan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the treasure of devotion; He Himself gives His gifts.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhagat  bhandaar hai pi-aaraa aapay d ayvai d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸ  ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service, and He Himself blesses them withhonor.
lines.transliteration: aapay sayv karaa-idaa pi-aaraa aap d ivaavai maan .

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi; He Himself is the treasure ofexcellence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay taarh ee laa-id aa pi-aaraa aapay gun ee niDh aan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵੈ ਦਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the greatest; He Himself is supreme.
lines.transliteration: aapay vadaa aap hai pi-aaraa aapay hee parDhaan .

lines.english: The Beloved Himself appraises the value; He Himself is the scale, and the weights.
lines.transliteration: aapay keemat paa-id aa pi-aaraa aapay t ul parvaan .

lines.english: The Beloved Himself is unweighable - He weighs Himself; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||5|| soriT mhlw 4 ] (606-13) sorath mehlaa 4. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay atul t ulaa-id aa pi-aaraa jan naanak sad  kurbaan . ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵਡਾ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਪਰਧਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service; He Himself blesses them with thejoy of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: aapay sayvaa laa-idaa pi-aaraa aapay bh agat omaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਤੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself causes us to sing His Glorious Praises; He Himself is absorbed inthe Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay gun gaavaa-id aa pi-aaraa aapay sabad  samaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਤੁਲਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the scribe; He Himself inscribes Hisinscription. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay laykhan  aap likh aaree aapay laykh  likhaahaa. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, joyfully chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap raam naam omaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਉਮਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those very fortunate ones are in ecstasy night and day; through the Perfect Guru,they obtain the profit of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an-din anad  hovai vadbh aagee lai gur poorai har laahaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the milk-maid and Krishna; He Himself herds the cows in thewoods.
lines.transliteration: aapay gopee kaan hai pi-aaraa ban aapay ga-oo charaahaa.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself is the blue-skinned, handsome one; He Himself plays on Hisflute.
lines.transliteration: aapay saaval sundraa pi-aaraa aapay vans vajaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself took the form of a child, and destroyed Kuwalia-peer, the madelephant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kuvlee-aa peerh aap maraa-id aa pi-aaraa kar baalak roop pachaahaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਲੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself sets the stage; He performs the plays, and He Himself watchesthem.
lines.transliteration: aap akhaarh aa paa-id aa pi-aaraa kar vaykh ai aap chojaahaa.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself assumed the form of the child, and killed the demons Chandoor, Kansa and Kaysee.
lines.transliteration: kar baalak roop upaa-idaa pi-aaraa chandoor kans kays maaraahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੋਪੀ  ਕਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਬਿਨ ਆਪੇ  ਗਊ ਚਰਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself, by Himself, is the embodiment of power; He shatters the powerof the fools and idiots. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay hee bal aap hai pi-aaraa bal bhannai moorakh  mugDh aahaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਵਲ  ਸੁੰਦਰਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Himself created the whole world. In His hands He holds the power of the ages. pMnw 607
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay jagat  upaa-id aa pi-aaraa vas aapay jugat  hathaahaa.

lines.english: The Beloved Himself puts the chains around their necks; as God pulls them, must they go.
lines.transliteration: gal jayvrhee aapay paa-id aa pi-aaraa ji-o parabh  khinchai t i-o jaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਲ  ਜੇਵੜੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਿਜਉ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਖੰਚੈ ਿਤਉ  ਜਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever harbors pride shall be destroyed, O Beloved; meditating on the Lord, Nanakis absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||6|| soriT mÚ 4 duquky ] (607-2) sorath mehlaa 4 d utukay. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Du-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: jo garbai so pachsee pi-aaray jap naanak bhagat  samaahaa. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗਰਬੈ  ਸੋ ਪਚਸੀ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਮਾਹਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Separated from the Lord for countless lifetimes, the self-willed manmukh suffers inpain, engaged in acts of egotism.
lines.transliteration: anik janam vichhurh ay dukh paa-i-aa manmukh  karam karai ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: Beholding the Holy Saint, I found God; O Lord of the Universe, I seek Your Sanctuary.||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo parsat  hee parabh  paa-i-aa gobid  saran  tumaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਨਮ  ਿਵਛੁੜੇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Love of God is very dear to me.
lines.transliteration: gobid pareet  lagee at  pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪਰਸਤ  ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When I joined the Sat Sangat, the Company of the Holy People, the Lord, theembodiment of peace, came into my heart. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab satsang bh a-ay saaDh oo jan hird ai mili-aa saaNt muraaree. rahaa-o.

lines.english: You dwell, hidden, within my heart day and night, Lord; but the poor fools do notunderstand Your Love.
lines.transliteration: too hird ai gupat  vaseh d in raat ee tayraa bh aa-o na bujh eh gavaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਸਤਸੰਗ  ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਿਤ  ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Almighty True Guru, God was revealed to me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and reflect upon His Glories. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  mili-aa parabh  pargati-aa gun  gaavai gun  veechaaree. ||2||

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have become enlightened; peace has come, and evil-mindedness hasbeen dispelled from my mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pargaas bh a-i-aa saat  aa-ee d urmat  buDh  nivaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਬੁਝਿਹ  ਗਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Understanding the relationship of the individual soul with God, I have found peace, inYour Sat Sangat, Your True Congregation, O Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aatam barahm cheen sukh  paa-i-aa sat sangat  purakh  tumaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed by Your Kind Mercy, meet the Almighty Lord, and find theGuru.
lines.transliteration: purkhai purakh  mili-aa gur paa-i-aa jin ka-o kirpaa bh a-ee t umaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਸਾਿਤ  ਆਈ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the immeasurable, celestial peace; night and day, he remains awaketo the Lord, the Master of the Forest of the Universe. ||4||7|| soriT mhlw 4 ] (607-9) sorath mehlaa 4. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak atul sahj sukh  paa-i-aa an-d in jaagat  rahai banvaaree. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The inner depths of my mind are pierced by love for the Lord; I cannot live withoutthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: har si-o pareet ant ar man bayDh i-aa har bin rahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Just as the fish dies without water, I die without the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o machhulee bin neerai binsai t i-o naamai bin mar jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: O my God, please bless me with the water of Your Name.
lines.transliteration: mayray parabh kirpaa jal d ayvhu har naa-ee.

lines.english: I beg for Your Name, deep within myself, day and night; through the Name, I find peace. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o antar naam mangaa d in raat ee naamay hee saaNt paa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The song-bird cries out for lack of water - without water, its thirst cannot bequenched.
lines.transliteration: ji-o chaatrik jal bin billaavai bin jal pi-aas na jaa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the water of celestial bliss, and is rejuvenated, blossoming forththrough the blessed Love of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jal paavai sukh  sehjay hari-aa bh aa-ay subh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are hungry, wandering around in the ten directions; withoutthe Name, they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh ookhay dah dis doleh bin naavai d ukh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਗਾ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They are born, only to die, and enter into reincarnation again; in the Court of theLord, they are punished. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam marai fir jonee aavai dargahi milai sajaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, then one comes to sing His Glorious Praises; deepwithin the nucleus of his own self, he finds the sublime essence of the Lord's elixir.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahi taa har gun  gaavah har ras ant ar paa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord has become Merciful to meek Nanak, and through the Word of the Shabad,his desires are quenched. ||4||8|| soriT mhlw 4 pMcpdw ] (607-15) sorath mehlaa 4 panchpad aa. Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: naanak deen d a-i-aal bh a-ay hai t arisnaa sabad  bujhaa-ee. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If one eats the uneatable, then he becomes a Siddha, a being of perfect spirituality; through this perfection, he obtains wisdom.
lines.transliteration: achar charai taa siDh  ho-ee siDh ee tay buDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭੂਖੇ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਡੋਲਿਹ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When the arrow of the Lord's Love pierces his body, then his doubt is eradicated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paraym kay sar laagay tan bh eetar taa bh aram kaati-aa jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰੈ ਿਫਿਰ  ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵੈ  ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Lord of the Universe, please bless Your humble servant with glory.
lines.transliteration: mayray gobid apunay jan ka-o d eh vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instructions, enlighten me with the Lord's Name, that I may dwellforever in Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmat raam naam pargaasahu sad aa rahhu sarn aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਹੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: This whole world is engrossed in coming and going; O my foolish and ignorant mind,be mindful of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih sansaar sabh aavan  jaanaa man moorakh  chayt  ajaan aa.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, please, take pity upon me, and unite me with the Guru, that I maymerge in the Lord's Name. ||2|| ijs kI vQu soeI pRBu jwxY ijs no dyie su pwey ] vsqu AnUp Aiq Agm Agocr guru pUrw AlKu
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kirpaa karahu gur maylhu taa har naam samaan aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਿਸਿਧ  ਹੋਈ ਿਸਧੀ  ਤੇ ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Only one who has it knows God; he alone has it, to whom God has given it - so very beautiful, unapproachable and unfathomable. Through the Perfect Guru, theunknowable is known. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis kee vath so-ee parabh jaan ai jis no d ay-ay so paa-ay. vasat  anoop at  agam agochar gur pooraa alakh lakh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੇ ਸਰ ਲਾਗੇ  ਤਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਤਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Only one who tastes it knows it, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but cannot speak of it. pMnw 608
lines.transliteration: jin ih chaakhee so-ee jaan ai goongay kee mith i-aa-ee.

lines.english: The jewel is concealed, but it is not concealed, even though one may try to conceal it. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ratan lukaa-i-aa lookai naahee jay ko rakh ai lukaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ  ਲੂਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Everything is Yours, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; You are the Lord God of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tayraa t oo ant arjaamee t oo sabh naa kaa parabh  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He alone receives the gift, unto whom You give it; O servant Nanak, there is no oneelse. ||5||9|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 1 iqquky  (608-3) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 t itukay Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Ti-Tukas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (608-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jis no daat  karahi so paa-ay jan naanak avar na ko-ee. ||5||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੫॥੯॥
lines.english: Who should I ask? Who should I worship? All were created by Him.
lines.transliteration: kis ha-o jaachee kis aaraaDhee jaa sabh  ko keet aa hosee.

lines.english: Whoever appears to be the greatest of the great, shall ultimately be mixed with thedust.
lines.transliteration: jo jo deesai vadaa vadayraa so so kh aakoo ralsee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸੁ ਹਉ ਜਾਚੀ  ਿਕਸ ਆਰਾਧੀ  ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੀਤਾ  ਹੋਸੀ ॥
lines.english: The Fearless, Formless Lord, the Destroyer of Fear bestows all comforts, and the nine treasures. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar bh av kh andan sabh  sukh  nav niDh  daysee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ  ਸੋ ਸੋ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਲਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, Your gifts alone satisfy me.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tayree d aatee raajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਦੇਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Why should I praise the poor helpless man? Why should I feel subservient to him?||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maanas bapurh aa ki-aa saalaahee ki-aa t is kaa muht aajaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: All things come to one who meditates on the Lord; the Lord satisfies his hunger.
lines.transliteration: jin har Dhi-aa-i-aa sabh  kichh  tis kaa t is kee bh ookh gavaa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, bestows such wealth, that it can never be exhausted.
lines.transliteration: aisaa Dhan d ee-aa sukh -daatai nikh ut na kab hee jaa-ee.

lines.english: I am in ecstasy, absorbed in celestial peace; the True Guru has united me in HisUnion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-i-aa sukh  sahj samaan ay sat gur mayl milaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam, night and day,and recite the Naam.
lines.transliteration: man naam jap naam aaraaDh an-d in naam vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ  ਿਨਖੁਿਟ  ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to the Teachings of the Holy Saints , and all fear of death will be dispelled.
lines.transliteration: updays sun  saaDh  santan kaa sabh  chookee kaan  jamaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those blessed by God's Grace are attached to the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o kirpaal ho-aa parabh mayraa say laagay gur kee ban ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਿਧ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Who can estimate Your worth, God? You are kind and compassionate to all beings.
lines.transliteration: keemat ka-un  karai parabh  tayree t oo sarab jee-aa d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ  ਕਾਿਣ  ਜਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Everything which You do, prevails; I am just a poor child - what can I do?
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  keetaa tayraa vart ai ki-aa ham baal gupaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥੩॥
