lines.english: Protect and preserve Your servant Nanak; be kind to him, like a father to his son. ||4||1|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 1 cOquky ] (608-11) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 chout ukay. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Chau-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: raakh layho naanak jan t umraa ji-o pit aa poot  kirpaalaa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਕਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Praise the Guru, and the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; enshrine Him inyour mind, body and heart.
lines.transliteration: gur govind salaahee-ai bh aa-ee man t an hird ai Dhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਕਆ  ਹਮ ਬਾਲ  ਗੁਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let the True Lord and Master abide in your mind, O Siblings of Destiny; this is themost excellent way of life.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib man vasai bhaa-ee ayhaa karn ee saar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਿਜਉ ਿਪਤਾ  ਪੂਤ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Those bodies, in which the Name of the Lord does not well up, O Siblings of Destiny -those bodies are reduced to ashes.
lines.transliteration: jit tan naam na oopjai bh aa-ee say t an ho-ay chh aar.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Siblings of Destiny;they take the Support of the One and Only Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  ka-o vaari-aa bh aa-ee jin aykankaar aDh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਧਾਰ ॥
lines.english: So worship and adore that True Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; He alone does everything.
lines.transliteration: so-ee sach araaDhan aa bh aa-ee jis t ay sabh  kichh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Siblings of Destiny, that without Him, there is no other at all. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai jaanaa-i-aa bh aa-ee t is bin avar na ko-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they putrefy and die, O Siblings of Destiny;their numbers cannot be counted.
lines.transliteration: naam vihoonay pach mu-ay bh aa-ee gan at na jaa-ay gan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਭਾਈ ਿਜਨ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ  ਅਧਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without Truth, purity cannot be achieved, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is true andunfathomable.
lines.transliteration: vin sach soch na paa-ee-ai bh aa-ee saachaa agam Dh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Coming and going do not end, O Siblings of Destiny; pride in worldly valuables isfalse.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  na chuk-ee bh aa-ee jh oothee dunee man ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਜਾਣਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh saves millions of people, O Siblin gs of Destiny, blessing them with even a particle of the Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kot uDh aardaa bh aa-ee d ay naavai ayk kan ee. ||2||

lines.english: I have searched through the Simritees and the Shaastras, O Siblings of Destiny -without the True Guru, doubt does not depart.
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  soDh i-aa bh aa-ee vin  satgur bh aram na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਣੇ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਭਾਈ  ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਗਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: They are so tired of performing their many deeds, O Siblings of Destiny, but they fallinto bondage again and again.
lines.transliteration: anik karam kar thaaki-aa bhaa-ee fir fir banDh an paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਸਚ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.english: I have searched in the four directions, O Siblings of Destiny, but without the True Guru, there is no place at all. pMnw 609
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa soDhee-aa bh aa-ee vin  satgur naahee jaa-ay.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I found the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur paa-i-aa bh aa-ee har har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Truth is forever pure, O Siblings of Destiny; those who are true are pure.
lines.transliteration: sach sadaa hai nirmalaa bh aa-ee nirmal saachay so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਭਾਈ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, O Siblings of Destiny, then one obtainsHim.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay jis aapn ee bh aa-ee t is paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Among millions, O Siblings of Destiny, hardly one humble servant of the Lord is found.
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay jan paa-ee-ai bh aa-ee virlaa ko-ee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਭਾਈ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is imbued with the True Name, O Siblings of Destiny; hearing it, the mind andbody become immaculately pure. ||4||2|| soriT mhlw 5 duquky ] (609-3) sorath mehlaa 5 d utukay. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Du-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak rataa sach naam bh aa-ee sun  man t an nirmal ho-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਤਾ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: As long as this person believes in love and hate, it is difficult for him to meet the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ja-o la-o bhaa-o abh aa-o ih maanai t a-o la-o milan  dooraa-ee.

lines.english: As long as he discriminates between himself and others, he will distance himself fromthe Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aan aapnaa karat beechaaraa t a-o la-o beech bikh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਭਾਉ ਅਭਾਉ  ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਿਮਲਣੁ  ਦੂਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, grant me such understanding,
lines.transliteration: maaDhvay aisee d ayh bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਆਪਨਾ  ਕਰਤ  ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬੀਚੁ ਿਬਖਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sayva-o saaDh gaha-o ot charnaa nah bisrai muhat  chasaa-ee. rahaa-o. that I might serve the Holy Saints, and seek the protection of their feet, and not forget them, for a moment, even an instant. ||Pause||

lines.english: O foolish, thoughtless and fickle mind, such understanding did not come into yourheart.
lines.transliteration: ray man mugaDh achayt  chanchal chit  tum aisee rid ai na aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਉ  ਸਾਧ ਗਹਉ  ਓਟ ਚਰਨਾ  ਨਹ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing the Lord of Life, you have become engrossed in other things, and you areinvolved with your enemies. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paraanpat t i-aag aan t oo rachi-aa urjh i-o sang bairaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Sorrow does not afflict one who does not harbor self-conceit; in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, I have attained this understanding.
lines.transliteration: sog na bi-aapai aap na thaapai saaDhsangat  buDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ  ਅਚੇਤ  ਚੰਚਲ  ਿਚਤ  ਤੁਮ ਐਸੀ  ਿਰਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Know that the babbling of the faithless cynic is like wind passing by. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saakat kaa baknaa i-o jaan-o jaisay pavan jh ulaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਿਤ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਆਨ ਤੂ ਰਿਚਆ  ਉਰਿਝਓ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬੈਰਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This mind is inundated by millions of sins - what can I say?
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh achh aadi-o ih man kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਥਾਪੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak, Your humble servant has come to Your Sanctuary, God; please, erase all hisaccounts. ||4||3|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (609-9) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak deen saran aa-i-o parabh  sabh  laykh aa rakh ahu uth aa-ee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾ ਬਕਨਾ  ਇਉ ਜਾਨਉ  ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Children, spouses, men and women in one's household, are all bound by Maya.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar lok garih banit aa maa-i-aa sanbanDh ayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਪਰਾਧ  ਅਛਾਿਦਓ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, none of them shall stand by you; their love is totally false. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ant kee baar ko kh araa na hosee sabh  mithi-aa asnayhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਆਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ  ਰਖਹੁ ਉਠਾਈ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O man, why do you pamper your body so?
lines.transliteration: ray nar kaahay paporahu dayhee.

lines.english: It shall disperse like a cloud of smoke; vibrate upon the One, the Beloved Lord.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ood jaa-igo Dhoom baad ro ik bh aajahu raam sanayhee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍ ਲੋਕ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਨਬੰਧੇਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: There are three ways in which the body can be consumed - it can be thrown intowater, given to the dogs, or cremated to ashes.
lines.transliteration: teen sany i-aa kar d ayhee keenee jal kookar bh asmayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਕੋ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਅਸਨੇਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He considers himself to be immortal; he sits in his home, and forgets the Lord, theCause of causes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay aamro garih meh baithaa karan  kaaran  bisrohee. ||2||

lines.english: In various ways, the Lord has fashioned the beads, and strung them on a slenderthread.
lines.transliteration: anik bhaat  kar man ee-ay saajay kaachai t aag parohee.

lines.punjabi: ਊਿਡ ਜਾਇਗੋ  ਧੂਮੁ ਬਾਦਰੋ  ਇਕੁ ਭਾਜਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The thread shall break, O wretched man, and then, you shall repent and regret. ||3||
lines.transliteration: toot jaa-igo soot  baapuray fir paachh ai pachh utohee. ||3||

lines.english: He created you, and after creating you, He adorned you - meditate on Him day and night.
lines.transliteration: jin tum sirjay siraj savaaray t is Dhi-aavahu d in rainayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ  ਸੰਿਙਆ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ  ਜਲ ਕੂਕਰ  ਭਸਮੇਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: God has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; I hold tight to the Support of theTrue Guru. ||4||4|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (609-15) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak parabh kirpaa Dh aaree mai sat gur ot gahayhee. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਆਮਰੋ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਮਿਹ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਿਬਸਰੋਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I met the True Guru, by great good fortune, and my mind has been enlightened.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa bhayti-o vadbh aagee maneh bh a-i-aa pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਾਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਣੀਏ  ਸਾਜੇ ਕਾਚੈ  ਤਾਿਗ  ਪਰੋਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: No one else can equal me, because I have the loving support of my Lord and Master.||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na pahuchanhaaraa doojaa apunay saahib kaa bh arvaasaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂਿਟ ਜਾਇਗੋ  ਸੂਤੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤੋਹੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: apunay satgur kai balihaarai.

lines.english: I am at peace in this world, and I shall be in celestial peace in the next; my home isfilled with bliss. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aagai sukh paachh ai sukh  sahjaa gh ar aanand  hamaarai. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਓਟ ਗਹੇਹੀ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Creator, my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee karnaihaaraa so-ee kh asam hamaaraa.

lines.english: I have become fearless, attached to the Guru's feet; I take the Support of the Nameof the One Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay gur charn ee laagay ik raam naam aaDh aaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਭਇਆ  ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the Form of God is deathless; He is and shall always be.
lines.transliteration: safal darsan akaal moorat  parabh  hai bh ee hovanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He hugs His humble servants close, and protects and preserves them; their love forHim is sweet to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kanth lagaa-ay apunay jan raakh ay apunee pareet  pi-aaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Great is His glorious greatness, and wondrous is His magnificence; through Him, all affairs are resolved. pMnw 610
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee achraj sobhaa kaaraj aa-i-aa raasay.

lines.english: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; all his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||5|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (610-1) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur pooraa bhayti-o saglay d ookh binaasay. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: To the happy person, everyone seems happy; to the sick person, everyone seems sick.
lines.transliteration: sukhee-ay ka-o paykh ai sabh  sukh ee-aa rogee kai bh aanai sabh  rogee.

lines.english: The Lord and Master acts, and causes us to act; union is in His Hands. ||1|| mn myry ijin Apunw Brmu gvwqw ] iqs kY BwxY koie n BUlw ijin sglo bRhmu pCwqw ] rhwau ] (610-2, soriT, mÚ 5) man mayray jin apunaa bharam gavaat aa. tis kai bh aanai ko-ay na bh oolaa jin saglo barahm pachhaat aa. rahaa-o. O my mind, no one appears to be mistaken, to one who has dispelled his own doubts; he realizes that everyone is God. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar su-aamee aapan haath sanjogee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਕਉ ਪੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਰੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is comforted in the Society of the Saints, believes that all are joyful.
lines.transliteration: sant sang jaa kaa man seet al oh jaan ai saglee th aaNdhee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਪਨ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One whose mind is afflicted by the disease of egotism, cries out in birth and death.||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog jaa kaa man bi-aapat oh janam marai billaat ee. ||2||

lines.english: Everything is clear to one whose eyes are blessed with the ointment of spiritualwisdom.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan jaa kee naytree parh i-aa taa ka-o sarab pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭੂਲਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਗਲੋ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the darkness of spiritual ignorance, he sees nothing at all; he wanders around inreincarnation, over and over again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayrai soojh as naahee bahurh  bahurh  bharmaat aa. ||3||

lines.english: Hear my prayer, O Lord and Master; Nanak begs for this happiness:
lines.transliteration: sun baynant ee su-aamee apunay naanak ih sukh  maagai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਠਢੀ  ॥
lines.english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jah keertan t ayraa saaDh oo gaavahi t ah mayraa man laagai. ||4||6|| whereever Your Holy Saints sing the Kirtan of Your Praises, let my mind be attachedto that place. ||4||6|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (610-7) sorath mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਿਗ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਆਿਪਤ  ਓਹੁ ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰੈ ਿਬਲਲਾਤੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My body belongs to the Saints, my wealth belongs to the Saints, and my mind belongs to the Saints.
lines.transliteration: tan sant an kaa Dh an sant an kaa man sant an kaa kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨੇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਪਿੜਆ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord's Name, and then, all comfortscome to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa sarab kusal t ab thee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਿਨ  ਅੰਧੇਰੈ  ਸੂਝਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਭਰਮਾਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Saints, there are no other givers.
lines.transliteration: santan bin avar na d aataa bee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever takes to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, is carried across. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jo saran parai saaDh oo kee so paargaraamee kee-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਤਹ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Millions of sins are erased by serving the humble Saints, and singing the GloriousPraises of the Lord with love.
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh miteh jan sayvaa har keert an ras gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: One finds peace in this world, and one's face is radiant in the next world, by associating with the humble Saints, through great good fortune. ||2||
lines.transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai mukh  oojal jan kaa sang vadbh aagee paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have only one tongue, and the Lord's humble servant is filled with countless virtues;how can I sing his praises?
lines.transliteration: rasnaa ayk anayk gun pooran jan kee kayt ak upmaa kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਕੁਸਲ  ਤਬ ਥੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The inaccessible, unapproachable and eternally unchanging Lord is obtained in theSanctuary of the Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar sad abh inaasee saran  santan kee lahee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: I am worthless, lowly, without friends or support, and full of sins; I long for the Shelter of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: nirgun neech anaath apraaDhee ot sant an kee aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ  ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am drowning in the deep, dark pit of household attachments - please save me, Lord!||4||7|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 1 ] (610-13) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 1. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: boodat moh garih anDh  koop meh naanak layho nibaahee. ||4||7||

lines.english: O Creator Lord, You fulfill the desires of those, within whose heart You abide.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hirdai vasi-aa t oo kart ay taa kee t aiN aas pujaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਪਰਾਧ  ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਿਸ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Your slaves do not forget You; the dust of Your feet is pleasing to their minds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daas apunay ka-o t oo visrahi naahee charan  Dhoor man bh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਈਹਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ  ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your Unspoken Speech cannot be spoken.
lines.transliteration: tayree akath kathaa kathan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ  ਗੁਣ ਪੂਰਨ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O treasure of excellence, Giver of peace, Lord and Master, Your greatness is thehighest of all. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan sukh -daatay su-aamee sabh  tay ooch badaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਸਦ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਸਰਿਣ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The mortal does those deeds, and those alone, which You ordained by destiny.
lines.transliteration: so so karam karat hai paraan ee jaisee t um likh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਨੀਚ ਅਨਾਥ  ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਓਟ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਆਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Your servant, whom You bless with Your service, is satisfied and fulfilled, beholdingthe Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sayvak ka-o tum sayvaa d eenee d arsan d aykh aghaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡਤ  ਮੋਹ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਹੁ ਿਨਬਾਹੀ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: You are contained in all, but he alone realizes this, whom You bless with understanding.
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar t umeh samaanay jaa ka-o t uDh aap bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, his spiritual ignorance is dispelled, and he is respected everywhere.||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad miti-o agi-aanaa pargat bh a-ay sabh  thaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤੈਂ ਆਸ  ਪੁਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is spiritually enlightened, he alone is a meditator, and he alone is a man ofgood nature.
lines.transliteration: so-ee gi-aanee so-ee Dhi-aanee so-ee purakh  subh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਉ ਤੂ ਿਵਸਰਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਚਰਣ  ਧੂਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful, does not forget the Lordfrom his mind. ||4||8|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (610-19) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis bha-ay d a-i-aalaa t aa ka-o man t ay bisar na jaa-ee. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The whole creation is engrossed in emotional attachment; sometimes, one is high,and at other times, low.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree mohi vi-aapee kab oochay kab neechay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਬਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: No one can be purified by any rituals or devices; they cannot reach their goal. ||1|| pMnw 611
lines.transliteration: suDh na ho-ee-ai kaahoo jat naa orh ak ko na pahoochay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, emancipation is attained in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: mayray man saaDh saran  chhutkaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, births and deaths do not cease, and one comes and goes, over and over again. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin gur pooray janam maran na rah-ee fir aavat  baaro baaraa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਰਹਈ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਤ  ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The whole world is entangled in what is called the delusion of doubt.
lines.transliteration: oh jo bharam bh ulaavaa kahee-at  tin meh urjh i-o sagal sansaaraa.

lines.english: The perfect devotee of the Primal Lord God remains detached from everything. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pooran bhagat  purakh  su-aamee kaa sarab thok t ay ni-aaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਜੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਭੁਲਾਵਾ  ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਿਤਨ  ਮਿਹ ਉਰਿਝਓ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Don't indulge in slander for any reason, for everything is the creation of the Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: ninda-o naahee kaahoo baat ai ayhu kh asam kaa kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਾ ਸਰਬ  ਥੋਕ ਤੇ ਿਨਆਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the Mercy of my God, dwells on the Name in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o kirpaa karee parabh mayrai mil saaDh sangat  naa-o lee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਉ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਏਹੁ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the True Guru, saves all.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysur satgur sabh naa karat  uDhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਮੇਰੈ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਉ  ਲੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without the Guru, no one crosses over; this is the perfect essence of allcontemplation. ||4||9|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (611-6) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bin nahee taree-ai ih pooran t at beechaaraa. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਰਤ  ਉਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched and searched and searched, and found that the Lord's Name is themost sublime reality.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat khoj beechaari-o raam naam t at saaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਰੀਐ  ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: Contemplating it for even an instant, sins are erased; the Gurmukh is carried across and saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh kaatay nimakh  araaDh i-aa gurmukh  paar ut aaraa. ||1||

lines.english: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, O man of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: har ras peevhu purakh gi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਿਜ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listening to the Ambrosial Words of the Holy Saints, the mind finds absolutefulfillment and satisfaction. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sun sun  mahaa t aripat  man paavai saaDh oo amrit  baanee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Liberation, pleasures, and the true way of life are obtained from the Lord, the Giver ofall peace.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh ugat jugat  sach paa-ee-ai sarab sukh aa kaa d aataa.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, blesses His slave with the gift of devotionalworship. ||2||
lines.transliteration: apunay daas ka-o bh agat daan d ayvai pooran purakh  biDhaataa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਮਹਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Hear with your ears, and sing with your tongue, and meditate within your heart on Him.
lines.transliteration: sarvanee sun ee-ai rasnaa gaa-ee-ai hird ai Dhi-aa-ee-ai so-ee.

lines.english: The Lord and Master is all-powerful, the Cause of causes; without Him, there isnothing at all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath su-aamee jaa t ay baritha na ko-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭੁਗਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have obtained the jewel of human life; have mercy on me, OMerciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag rat an janam paa-i-aa karahu kirpaa kirpaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplates Him forever in meditation. ||4||10|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (611-11) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak gun  gaavai simrai sad aa gopaalaa. ||4||10||

lines.english: After taking your cleansing bath, remember your God in meditation, and your mindand body shall be free of disease.
lines.transliteration: kar isnaan simar parabh apnaa man t an bh a-ay arogaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਾ ਤੇ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Millions of obstacles are removed, in the Sanctuary of God, and good fortune dawns.||1||
lines.transliteration: kot bighan laathay parabh  sarnaa pargatay bh alay sanjogaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of God's Bani, and His Shabad, are the best utterances.
lines.transliteration: parabh ban ee sabad  subh aakhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਸਦਾ ਗਪਾਲਾ  ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: So constantly sing them, listen to them, and read them, O Siblings of Destiny, and thePerfect Guru shall save you. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gaavhu sunhu parh ahu nit  bhaa-ee gur poorai t oo raakh i-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The glorious greatness of the True Lord is immeasurable; the Merciful Lord is theLover of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib amit vadaa-ee bh agat vachh al da-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: He has preserved the honor of His Saints; from the very beginning of time, His Natureis to cherish them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: santaa kee paij rakh -daa aa-i-aa aad  birad  partipaalaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਿਬਘਨ  ਲਾਥੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: So eat the Ambrosial Name of the Lord as your food; put it into your mouth at all times.
lines.transliteration: har amrit naam bh ojan nit  bhunchahu sarab vaylaa mukh  paavhu.

lines.english: The pains of old age and death shall all depart, when you constantly sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaraa maraa taap sabh  naath aa gun  gobind  nit gaavhu. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and all my affairs have been resolved.
lines.transliteration: sunee ard aas su-aamee mayrai sarab kalaa ban  aa-ee.

lines.english: The glorious greatness of Guru Nanak is manifest, throughout all the ages. ||4||11|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 2 caupdy  (611-18) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 cha-upd ay Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (611-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-ee saglay jug ant ar gur naanak kee vadi-aa-ee. ||4||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਿਮਿਤ  ਵਡਾਈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The One God is our father; we are the children of the One God. You are our Guru.
lines.transliteration: ayk pitaa aykas kay ham baarik t oo mayraa gur haa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਆਿਦ  ਿਬਰਦੁ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Listen, friends: my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You; O Lord, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1|| pMnw 612
lines.transliteration: sun meet aa jee-o hamaaraa bal bal jaasee har d arsan d ayh d ikhaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, friends: I am a sacrifice to the dust of Your feet.
lines.transliteration: sun meet aa Dh ooree ka-o bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਮੀਤਾ  ਧੂਰੀ ਕਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih man tayraa bh aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I wash your feet, I massage and clean them; I give this mind to you.
lines.transliteration: paav malovaa mal mal Dhovaa ih man t ai koo d aysaa.

lines.english: Listen, friends: I have come to Your Sanctuary; teach me, that I might unite with God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sun meet aa ha-o t ayree sarn aa-ee aa-i-aa parabh  mila-o d ayh upd aysaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ  ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੋਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.english: Do not be proud; seek His Sanctuary, and accept as good all that He does.
lines.transliteration: maan na keejai saran pareejai karai so bh alaa manaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਮੀਤਾ  ਹਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਆਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਉ  ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Listen, friends: dedicate your soul, body and your whole being to Him; thus you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sun meet aa jee-o pind sabh  tan arpeejai i-o d arsan har jee-o paa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੀਜੈ  ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He has shown mercy to me, by the Grace of the Saints; the Lord's Name is sweet tome.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o anoograhu parsaad  santan kai har naamaa hai meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਮੀਤਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀਜੈ  ਇਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru has shown mercy to servant Nanak; I see the casteless, immaculate Lordeverywhere. ||4||1||12|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (612-5) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o gur kirpaa Dhaaree sabh  akul niranjan deeth aa. ||4||1||12||

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: God is the Lord and Master of millions of universes; He is the Giver of all beings.
lines.transliteration: kot barahmand ko thaakur su-aamee sarab jee-aa kaa d aataa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਸਭੁ ਅਕੁਲ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He ever cherishes and cares for all beings, but the fool does not appreciate any of His virtues. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paratipaalai nit  saar samaalai ik gun nahee moorakh  jaataa ray. ||1||

lines.english: I do not know how to worship the Lord in adoration.
lines.transliteration: har aaraaDh na jaanaa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I can only repeat, "Lord, Lord, Guru, Guru."
lines.transliteration: har har gur gur kartaa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲੈ  ਿਨਤ ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਲੈ  ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਿਖ ਜਾਤਾ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, I go by the name of the Lord's slave. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o naam pari-o raamdaas. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Compassionate Lord is Merciful to the meek, the ocean of peace; He fills allhearts.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaal sukh  saagar sarab gh ataa bh arpooree ray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He sees, hears, and is always with me; but I am a fool, and I think that He is far away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paykhat  sunat  sadaa hai sangay mai moorakh  jaani-aa d ooree ray. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord is limitless, but I can only describe Him within my limitations; what do Iknow, about what He is like?
lines.transliteration: har bi-ant ha-o mit  kar varna-o ki-aa jaanaa ho-ay kaiso ray.

lines.english: I offer my prayer to my True Guru; I am so foolish - please, teach me! ||3||
lines.transliteration: kara-o bayntee sat gur apunay mai moorakh  dayh upd ayso ray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਘਟਾ  ਭਰਪੂਰੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I am just a fool, but millions of sinners just like me have been saved.
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh kee kayt ak baat  hai kot paraaDh ee tari-aa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਖਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਦੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who have heard, and seen Guru Nanak, do not descend into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||2||13|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (612-11) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak jin suni-aa paykh i-aa say fir garbh aas na pari-aa ray. ||4||2||13||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਅੰਤੁ  ਹਉ ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਵਰਨਉ  ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੋ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those things, which caused me such anxiety, have all vanished.
lines.transliteration: jinaa baat ko bahut  andaysro t ay mitay sabh  ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੋ  ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Now, I sleep in peace and tranquility, and my mind is in a state of deep and profoundpeace; the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sahj sain ar sukhman naaree ooDh  kamal bigsa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ  ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਕੋਿਟ ਪਰਾਧੀ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Behold, a wondrous miracle has happened!
lines.transliteration: daykh hu achraj bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਨ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਪੇਿਖਆ  ਸੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਗਰਭਾਿਸ  ਨ ਪਿਰਆ  ਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
lines.english: That Lord and Master, whose wisdom is said to be unfathomable, has been enshrinedwithin my heart, by the Guru. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jih thaakur ka-o sunat  agaaDh  boDh  so rid ai gur d a-i-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The demons which tormented me so much, have themselves become terrified.
lines.transliteration: jo-ay doot  mohi bahut  santaavat  tay bh a-i-aanak bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ  ਤੇ ਿਮਟੇ ਸਿਭ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They pray: please, save us from your Lord Master; we seek your protection. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karahi bayntee raakh  thaakur t ay ham t ayree sarna-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੈਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨ  ਨਾਰੀ  ਊਧ ਕਮਲ  ਿਬਗਸਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the treasure of the Lord of the Universe is opened, those who are pre-destined, receive it.
lines.transliteration: jah bhandaar gobind  kaa kh uli-aa jih paraapat  tih la-i-aa.

lines.english: The Guru has given me the one jewel, and my mind and body have become peacefuland tranquil. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk ratan mo ka-o gur d eenaa mayraa man t an seet al thi-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru has blessed me with the one drop of Ambrosial Nectar, and so I havebecome stable, unmoving and immortal - I shall not die.
lines.transliteration: ayk boond gur amrit  deeno t aa atal amar na mu-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਉ ਸੁਨਤ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਿਧ ਸੋ ਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord blessed Guru Nanak with the treasure of devotional worship, and did not callhim to account again. ||4||3||14|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (612-17) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhandaar gur naanak ka-o sa-upay fir laykh aa mool na la-i-aa. ||4||3||14||

lines.english: Those whose minds are attached to the lotus feet of the Lord - those humble beingsare satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o jaa kaa man leenaa say jan taripat  aghaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਇ ਦੂਤ ਮੋਿਹ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਤ  ਤੇ ਭਇਆਨਕ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But those, within whose hearts the priceless virtue does not abide - those men remainthirsty and unsatisfied. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun amol jis rid ai na vasi-aa t ay nar t arisan t arikhaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਰਾਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੇ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Worshipping the Lord in adoration, one becomes happy, and free of disease.
lines.transliteration: har aaraaDhay arog and aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕਾ ਖੁਿਲਆ  ਿਜਹ ਪਰ੍ਾਪਿਤ  ਿਤਹ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But one who forgets my Dear Lord - know him to be afflicted with tens of thousands of illnesses. ||Pause|| pMnw 613
lines.transliteration: jis no visrai mayraa raam sanayhee tis laakh  bayd an jan  aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who hold tightly to Your Support, God, are happy in Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jih jan ot gahee parabh t ayree say sukh ee-ay parabh  sarnay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਜਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: But those humble beings who forget the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, are counted among the most miserable beings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jih nar bisri-aa purakh biDh aataa tay dukhee-aa meh gann ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਨਰ ਿਬਸਿਰਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਤੇ ਦੁਖੀਆ  ਮਿਹ ਗਨਣੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who has faith in the Guru, and who is lovingly attached to God, enjoys thedelights of supreme ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: jih gur maan parabhoo liv laa-ee t ih mahaa anand ras kari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਿਤਹ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਰਸੁ ਕਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who forgets God and forsakes the Guru, falls into the most horrible hell. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jih parabhoo bisaar gur t ay baymukh aa-ee t ay narak gh or meh pari-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਬਸਾਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਈ  ਤੇ ਨਰਕ  ਘੋਰ ਮਿਹ ਪਿਰਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As the Lord engages someone, so he is engaged, and so does he perform.
lines.transliteration: jit ko laa-i-aa t it hee laagaa t aiso hee vart aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਤ  ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ  ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has taken to the Shelter of the Saints; his heart is absorbed in the Lord's feet.||4||4||15|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (613-4) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sah pakree santan kee rid ai bha-ay magan charnaaraa. ||4||4||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹ ਪਕਰੀ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਿਰਦੈ ਭਏ ਮਗਨ  ਚਰਨਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.english: As the king is entangled in kingly affairs, and the egotist in his own egotism,
lines.transliteration: raajan meh raajaa urjhaa-i-o maanan meh abh imaanee.
lobhan meh lobh ee lobh aa-i-o t i-o har rang rachay gi-aanee. ||1|| and the greedy man is enticed by greed, so is the spiritually enlightened being absorbed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਨ  ਮਿਹ ਰਾਜਾ  ਉਰਝਾਇਓ  ਮਾਨਨ  ਮਿਹ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: This is what befits the Lord's servant.
lines.transliteration: har jan ka-o ihee suhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭਨ  ਮਿਹ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭਾਇਓ  ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਚੇ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Beholding the Lord near at hand, he serves the True Guru, and he is satisfied throughthe Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paykh nikat kar sayvaa sat gur har keert an hee t ariptaavai. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The addict is addicted to his drug, and the landlord is in love with his land.
lines.transliteration: amlan si-o amlee laptaa-i-o bhooman bh oom pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਿਨ  ਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: As the baby is attached to his milk, so the Saint is in love with God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kheer sang baarik hai leenaa parabh  sant aisay hit kaaree. ||2||

lines.english: The scholar is absorbed in scholarship, and the eyes are happy to see.
lines.transliteration: bidi-aa meh bid u-ansee rachi-aa nain d aykh sukh  paavahi.

lines.english: As the tongue savors the tastes, so does the humble servant of the Lord sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaisay rasnaa saad lubh aanee t i-o har jan har gun  gaavahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਖੀਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਾਿਰਕੁ  ਹੈ ਲੀਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਤ ਐਸੇ ਿਹਤਕਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: As is the hunger, so is the fulfiller; He is the Lord and Master of all hearts.
lines.transliteration: jaisee bhookh  taisee kaa poorak sagal gh ataa kaa su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਦਆ  ਮਿਹ ਿਬਦੁਅੰਸੀ  ਰਿਚਆ  ਨੈਨ ਦੇਿਖ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; he has met God, the Inner- knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||5||16|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (613-10) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pi-aas lagee darsan kee parabh  mili-aa ant arjaamee. ||4||5||16||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਾਿਦ ਲੁਭਾਨੀ  ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: We are filthy, and You are immaculate, O Creator Lord; we are worthless, and You arethe Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: ham mailay tum oojal kart ay ham nirgun t oo daataa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ  ਸਗਲ  ਘਟਾ  ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: We are fools, and You are wise and all-knowing. You are the knower of all things.||1||
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh t um chat ur si-aan ay too sarab kalaa kaa gi-aat aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਲਗੀ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.english: O Lord, this is what we are, and this is what You are.
lines.transliteration: maaDho ham aisay t oo aisaa.

lines.english: We are sinners, and You are the Destroyer of sins. Your abode is so beautiful, O Lordand Master. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham paapee tum paap kh andan neeko th aakur d aysaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਊਜਲ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਹਮ ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: You fashion all, and having fashioned them, You bless them. You bestow upon themsoul, body and the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: tum sabh  saajay saaj nivaajay jee-o pind d ay paraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਚਤੁਰ  ਿਸਆਣੇ  ਤੂ ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਕਾ ਿਗਆਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: We are worthless - we have no virtue at all; please, bless us with Your gift, O Merciful Lordand Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirgunee-aaray gun nahee ko-ee tum d aan d ayh miharvaanaa. ||2||

lines.english: You do good for us, but we do not see it as good; You are kind and compassionate,forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: tum karahu bh alaa ham bh alo na jaanah t um sad aa sad aa da-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਤੁਮ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ  ਨੀਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of peace, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny; please, save us,Your children! ||3||
lines.transliteration: tum sukh -daa-ee purakh  biDhaatay tum raakh o apunay baalaa. ||3||

lines.english: You are the treasure, eternal Lord King; all beings and creatures beg of You.
lines.transliteration: tum niDh aan atal sulit aan jee-a jant  sabh  jaachai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਾਿਜ ਿਨਵਾਜੇ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, such is our condition; please, Lord, keep us on the Path of the Saints.||4||6||17|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 2 ] (613-16) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 2. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ham ihai havaalaa raakh sant an kai paachh ai. ||4||6||17||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ  ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In our mother's womb, You blessed us with Your meditative remembrance, and Youpreserved us there.
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  meh aapan simran d ay tah tum raakh anhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਮ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ  ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the countless waves of the ocean of fire, please, carry us across and save us,O Savior Lord! ||1||
lines.transliteration: paavak saagar athaah lahar meh taarahu t aaranhaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਾਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, You are the Master above my head.
lines.transliteration: maaDhou t oo thaakur sir moraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਅਟਲ  ਸੁਿਲਤਾਨ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, You alone are my Support. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa tuhaaro Dh oraa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਮ ਇਹੈ ਹਵਾਲਾ  ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
lines.english: He looks upon the creation like a mountain of gold, and sees the Creator as a blade of grass.
lines.transliteration: keetay ka-o mayrai sammaanai karanhaar t arin jaanai.

lines.english: You are the Great Giver, and we are all mere beggars; O God, You give gifts accordingto Your Will. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too daataa maagan ka-o saglee d aan d eh parabh  bhaanai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ  ਮਿਹ ਆਪਨ  ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: In an instant, You are one thing, and in another instant, You are another. Wondrousare Your ways!
lines.transliteration: khin meh avar kh inai meh avraa achraj chalat  tumaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਕ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਅਥਾਹ  ਲਹਿਰ  ਮਿਹ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਰਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are beautiful, mysterious, profound, unfathomable, lofty, inaccessible and infinite. ||3|| pMnw 614
lines.transliteration: roorho goorh o gahir gambh eero oochou agam apaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੂੜੋ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੋ  ਊਚੌ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: When You brought me to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, then I heard the Bani of Your Word.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang ja-o t umeh milaa-i-o t a-o sunee t umaaree ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਜਉ ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਿਮਲਾਇਓ  ਤਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is in ecstasy, beholding the Glory of the Primal Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||4||7||18|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (614-2) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-i-aa paykh at hee naanak part aap purakh  nirbaan ee. ||4||7||18||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥੭॥੧੮॥
lines.english: I am the dust of the feet of the Beloved Saints; I seek the Protection of their Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ham santan kee rayn pi-aaray ham sant an kee sarn aa.

lines.english: The Saints are my all-powerful Support; the Saints are my ornament and decoration.||1||
lines.transliteration: sant hamaaree ot sat aanee sant  hamaaraa gahn aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am hand and glove with the Saints.
lines.transliteration: ham santan si-o ban  aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ  ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਗਹਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa paa-ee.

lines.english: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih man tayraa bh aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: My dealings are with the Saints, and my business is with the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santan si-o mayree layvaa d ayvee sant an si-o bi-uhaaraa.

lines.english: I have earned the profit with the Saints, and the treasure filled to over-flowing withdevotion to the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: santan si-o ham laahaa kh aati-aa har bh agat bharay bh andaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The Saints entrusted to me the capital, and my mind's delusion was dispelled.
lines.transliteration: santan mo ka-o poonjee sa-upee t a-o ut ri-aa man kaa Dh okhaa.

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay ab kahaa karaigo ja-o faati-o saglo laykh aa. ||3|| What can the Righteous Judge of Dharma do now? All my accounts have been torn up. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਿਸਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਹਾ  ਖਾਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have found the greatest bliss, and I am at peace, by the Grace of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand bha-ay sukh  paa-i-aa sant an kai parsaad ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਉਪੀ  ਤਉ ਉਤਿਰਆ  ਮਨ ਕਾ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my mind is reconciled with the Lord; it is imbued with the wondrous Loveof the Lord. ||4||8||19|| soriT mÚ 5 ] (614-8) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har si-o man maani-aa rang ratay bismaad ay. ||4||8||19||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈਗੋ  ਜਉ ਫਾਿਟਓ  ਸਗਲੋ  ਲੇਖਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All the things that you see, O man, you shall have to leave behind.
lines.transliteration: jaytee samagree d aykhhu ray nar t aytee hee chh ad jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: Let your dealings be with the Lord's Name, and you shall attain the state ofNirvaanaa. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam sang kar bi-uhaaraa paavahi pad nirbaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਿਬਸਮਾਦੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, You are the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: pi-aaray too mayro sukh -daata.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has given me these Teachings, and I am attuned to You. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai dee-aa upd aysaa t um hee sang paraat aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੀ  ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਤੇਤੀ  ਹੀ ਛਿਡ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: In sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit, peace is not tobe found.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh abh imaanaa t aa meh sukh  nahee paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਕਿਰ ਿਬਉਹਾਰਾ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So be the dust of the feet of all, O my mind, and then you shall find bliss, joy and peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hohu rayn too sagal kee mayray man t a-o anad  mangal sukh  paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: He knows the condition of your inner self, and He will not let your work go in vain -serve Him, O mind.
lines.transliteration: ghaal na bh aanai ant ar biDh  jaanai t aa kee kar man sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ  ਉਪਦੇਸਾ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ ਪਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Worship Him, and dedicate this mind unto Him, the Image of the Undying Lord, theDivine Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar poojaa hom ih manoo-aa akaal moorat gurd ayvaa. ||3||

lines.english: He is the Lord of the Universe, the Compassionate Lord, the Supreme Lord God, theFormless Lord.
lines.transliteration: gobid d aamod ar da-i-aal maaDh vay paarbarahm nirankaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ  ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is my merchandise, the Naam is my nourishment; the Naam, O Nanak, isthe Support of my breath of life. ||4||9||20|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (614-13) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam vartan  naamo vaalayvaa naam naanak paraan aDh aaraa. ||4||9||20||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਨ ਤੂ ਸਗਲ  ਕੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਉ ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He infuses the breath into the dead bodies, and he reunited the separated ones.
lines.transliteration: mirtak ka-o paa-i-o t an saasaa bichh urat aan milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਾਲ  ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ਅੰਤਰ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਰ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: Even beasts, demons and fools become attentive listeners, when He sings the Praisesof the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pasoo parayt mugaDh  bha-ay sarot ay har naamaa mukh  gaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਿਮ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Behold the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee daykh  vadaa-ee.

lines.english: His worth cannot be described. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤਿਣ  ਨਾਮੋ ਵਾਲੇਵਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੯॥੨੦॥
lines.english: He has demolished the abode of sorrow and disease, and brought bliss, joy and happiness.
lines.transliteration: dookh  sog kaa Dh aahi-o dayraa anad  mangal bisraamaa.

lines.english: He effortlessly awards the fruits of the mind's desire, and all works are brought toperfection. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man baaNchhat  fal milay achint aa pooran ho-ay kaamaa. ||2||

lines.english: He finds peace in this world, and his face is radiant in the world hereafter; his comingsand goings are finished.
lines.transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai mukh  oojal mit ga-ay aavan  jaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਭਏ ਸਰ੍ੋਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He becomes fearless, and his heart is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; hismind is pleasing to the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay hird ai naam vasi-aa apunay sat gur kai man bh aanay. ||3||

lines.english: Standing up and sitting down, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; his pain,sorrow and doubt are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at har gun  gaavai d ookh darad bharam bh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, his karma is perfect; his mind is attached to the Guru's feet.||4||10||21|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (614-19) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak taa kay poor karammaa jaa kaa gur charnee man laagaa. ||4||10||21||

lines.english: Forsaking the jewel, he is attached to the shell; nothing will come of it. pMnw 615
lines.transliteration: ratan chh aad ka-udee sang laagay jaa t ay kachh oo na paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O my mind, meditate forever on the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooran paarbarahm parmaysur mayray man sadaa Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal.
lines.transliteration: simrahu har har naam paraanee.

lines.english: Your frail body shall perish, you ignorant fool. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binsai kaachee dayh agi-aanee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Illusions and dream-objects possess nothing of greatness.
lines.transliteration: marig tarisnaa ar supan manorath t aa kee kachh  na vadaa-ee.

lines.english: Without meditating on the Lord, nothing succeeds, and nothing will go along with you.||2||
lines.transliteration: raam bhajan bin kaam na aavas sang na kaahoo jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Acting in egotism and pride, his life passes away, and he does nothing for his soul.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karat bihaa-ay avrad aa jee-a ko kaam na keenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ  ਿਬਨੁ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਿਸ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  Dhaavat  nah t ariptaasi-aa raam naam nahee cheenaa. ||3|| Wandering and wandering all around, he is never satisfied; he does not remember the Name of the Lord. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹਾਇ  ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਅ  ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Intoxicated with the taste of corruption, cruel pleasures and countless sins, he isconsigned to the cycle of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: saad bikaar bikh ai ras maat o asaNkh khatay kar fayray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਤ  ਧਾਵਤ  ਨਹ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਿਸਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak offers his prayer to God, to eradicate his demerits. ||4||11||22|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (615-6) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh paahi binant ee kaatahu avgun  mayray. ||4||11||22||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਦ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਿਬਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੋ ਅਸੰਖ  ਖਤੇ ਕਿਰ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Imperishable Lord, and the poison of sexualdesire and anger shall be burnt away.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavhu pooran abh inaasee kaam kroDh  bikh jaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਹ  ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਕਾਟਹੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੨॥
lines.english: You shall cross over the awesome, arduous ocean of fire, in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikham agan ko saagar saaDh oo sang uDh aaray. ||1||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness of doubt.
lines.transliteration: poorai gur mayti-o bharam anDh ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਿਬਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Remember God with love and devotion; He is near at hand. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhaj paraym bh agat parabh  nayraa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਕੋ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Drink in the sublime essence, the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, andyour mind and body shall remain satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har har naam niDhaan ras pee-aa man t an rahay agh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere; where would He come from, and where would He go? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jat kat  poor rahi-o parmaysar kat  aavai kat  jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: One whose mind is filled with the Lord, is a person of meditation, penance, self-restraint and spiritual wisdom, and a knower of reality.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam gi-aan t at baytaa jis man vasai gopaalaa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel of the Naam; his efforts come to perfect fruition. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam ratan jin gurmukh  paa-i-aa t aa kee pooran gh aalaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: All his struggles, sufferings and pains are dispelled, and the noose of death is cutaway from him.
lines.transliteration: kal kalays mitay dukh  saglay kaatee jam kee faasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ  ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, God has extended His Mercy, and so his mind and body blossom forth.||4||12||23|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (615-11) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh kirpaa Dh aaree man t an bh a-ay bigaasaa. ||4||12||23||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਤਤ ਬੇਤਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਗਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: God is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Great Giver; God is the Supreme Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan haar parabh  daataa paarbarahm parabh  su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਘਾਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord created all beings; God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.||1||
lines.transliteration: saglay jee-a kee-ay da-i-aalaa so parabh  antarjaamee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਿਮਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ  ਕਾਟੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: My Guru is Himself my friend and support.
lines.transliteration: mayraa gur ho-aa aap sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਿਬਗਾਸਾ  ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੩॥
lines.english: I am in celestial peace, bliss, joy, pleasure and wondrous glory. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  mangal ras achraj bh a-ee badaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, my fears have been dispelled, and I am acceptedin the Court of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kee saran pa-ay bh ai naasay saachee d argeh maanay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: Singing His Glorious Praises, and worshipping in adoration the Name of the Lord, Ihave reached my destination. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  aaraaDh  naam har aa-ay apunai thaanay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everyone applauds and congratulates me; the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly, is dear to me.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar karai sabh ust at sangat  saaDh  pi-aaree.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to my God, who has totally protected and preserved myhonor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sad balihaar jaa-o parabh  apunay jin pooran paij savaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਰਸ ਅਚਰਜ  ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They are saved, who receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they listen to thespiritual dialogue of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gosat gi-aan naam sun uDh ray jin jin d arsan paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak's God has become Merciful to him; he has arrived home in ecstasy.||4||13||24|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (615-17) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal naanak parabh  apunaa anad  saytee gh ar aa-i-aa. ||4||13||24||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਏ ਭੈ ਨਾਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੇ ॥
lines.english: In God's Sanctuary, all fears depart, suffering disappears, and peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee saran  sagal bh ai laathay d ukh binsay sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ  ਆਰਾਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਏ  ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਥਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the Supreme Lord God and Master becomes merciful, we meditate on the Perfect True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal ho-aa paarbarahm su-aamee pooraa sat gur Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭ ਉਸਤਿਤ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear God, You are my Lord Master and Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee-o t oo mayro saahib d aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By Your Mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek, imbue me with Your Love, that I mightsing Your Glorious Praises. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh d een d a-i-aalaa gun  gaava-o rang raat aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਸਿਟ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਉਧਰੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam within me, and all my anxieties have been dispelled. pMnw 616
lines.transliteration: satgur naam niDh aan drirh -aa-i-aa chint aa sagal binaasee.

lines.english: By His Mercy, He has made me His own, and the imperishable Lord has come to dwell within my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apuno kar leenaa man vasi-aa abhinaasee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਕਿਰ ਲੀਨਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: No misfortune afflicts one who is protected by the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o bigh an na ko-oo laagai jo sat gur apunai raakh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ  ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lotus Feet of God come to abide within his heart, and he savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basay rid ant ar amrit  har ras chaakh ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਬਸੇ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: So, as a servant, serve your God, who fulfills your mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa sayvak parabh apunay jin man kee ichh  pujaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Lord, who has protected and preserved hishonor. ||4||14||25|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (616-4) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t aa kai balihaarai jin pooran paij rakh aa-ee. ||4||14||25||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Infatuated with the darkness of emotional attachment to Maya, he does not know theLord, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh magan anDhi-aarai d ayvanhaar na jaanai.

lines.english: The Lord created his body and fashioned his soul, but he claims that his power is hisown. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind saaj jin rachi-aa bal apuno kar maanai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਅੰਿਧਆਰੈ  ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: O foolish mind, God, your Lord and Master is watching over you.
lines.transliteration: man moorhay d aykh rahi-o parabh  su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਾਿਜ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਿਚਆ  ਬਲੁ ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever you do, He knows; nothing can remain concealed from Him. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karahi so-ee so-ee jaan ai rahai na kachh oo-ai chh aanee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੂੜੇ ਦੇਿਖ ਰਿਹਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are intoxicated with the tastes of the tongue, with greed and pride; countless sinsspring from these.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa su-aad lobh  mad maat o upjay anik bikaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ  ਛਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: You wandered in pain through countless incarnations, weighed down by the chains of egotism. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bahut jon bh armat  dukh paa-i-aa ha-umai banDh an kay bh aaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Behind closed doors, hidden by many screens, the man takes his pleasure withanother man's wife.
lines.transliteration: day-ay kivaarh  anik parh -day meh par d aaraa sang faakai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਸੁਆਦ  ਲੋਭ ਮਿਦ ਮਾਤੋ ਉਪਜੇ  ਅਿਨਕ ਿਬਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: When Chitr and Gupt, the celestial accountants of the conscious and subconscious,call for your account, who will screen you then? ||3||
lines.transliteration: chitar gupat  jab laykh aa maageh t ab ka-un  parh-daa tayraa dh aakai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰਮਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕੇ ਭਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Perfect Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain, without You, I have no shelterat all.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal pooran d ukh bhanjan t um bin ot na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਇ ਿਕਵਾੜ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਪੜਦੇ ਮਿਹ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਫਾਕੈ ॥
lines.english: Please, lift me up out of the world-ocean; O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary.||4||15||26|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (616-10) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaadh layho sansaar saagar meh naanak parabh  sarnaa-ee. ||4||15||26||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਰ੍  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਤਬ ਕਉਣੁ  ਪੜਦਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਢਾਕੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has become my helper and friend; His sermon and the Kirtanof His Praises have brought me peace.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm ho-aa sahaa-ee kathaa keertan sukh -daa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਤੁਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਓਟ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani, and be ever in bliss, O mortal. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee banee jap anad  karahu nit  paraan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਮਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Remember the True Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har saachaa simrahu bhaa-ee.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, eternal peace is obtained, and the Lord is never forgotten. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang sad aa sukh  paa-ee-ai har bisar na kabhoo jaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Your Name, O Transcendent Lord, is Ambros ial Nectar; whoever meditates on it, lives.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam parmaysar t ayraa jo simrai so jeevai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਜਿਪ ਅਨਦੁ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with God's Grace - that humble servant becomes immaculate and pure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis no karam paraapat hovai so jan nirmal theevai. ||2||

lines.english: Obstacles are removed, and all pains are eliminated; my mind is attached to theGuru's feet.
lines.transliteration: bighan binaasan sabh  dukh naasan gur charn ee man laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਸਿਰ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the immovable and imperishable Lord, one remainsawake to the Lord's Love, day and night. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  achut  abhinaasee an-d in har rang jaagaa. ||3||

lines.english: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, listening to the comforting sermon of theLord.
lines.transliteration: man ichhay say-ee fal paa-ay har kee kathaa suhaylee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਸੋ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, God is Nanak's best friend.||4||16||27|| soriT mhlw 5 pMcpdw ] (616-15) sorath mehlaa 5 panchpad aa. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padas:
lines.transliteration: aad ant  maDh  naanak ka-o so parabh  ho-aa baylee. ||4||16||27||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਿਮ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਥੀਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: May my emotional attachment, my sense of mine and yours, and my self-conceit be dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binsai moh mayraa ar tayraa binsai apnee Dh aaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਘਨ  ਿਬਨਾਸਨ  ਸਿਭ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Saints, show me such a way,
lines.transliteration: santahu ihaa bat aavhu kaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ  ਅਚੁਤ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਜਾਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jit ha-umai garab nivaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o. by which my egotism and pride might be eliminated. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: I see the Supreme Lord God in all beings, and I am the dust of all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarab bhoot  paarbarahm kar maani-aa hovaaN sagal raynaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਮਿਧ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੋਆ  ਬੇਲੀ  ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
lines.english: I see God always with me, and the wall of doubt has been shattered. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paykhi-o parabh  jee-o apunai sangay chookai bh eet bharmaaree. ||3||

lines.english: The medicine of the Naam, and the Immaculate Water of Ambrosial Nectar, areobtained through the Guru's Gate. ||4||
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  naam nirmal jal amrit  paa-ee-ai guroo d u-aaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead,meets with the Guru, and his diseases are cured. ||5||17||28|| pMnw 617 soriT mhlw 5 Gru 2 dupdy  (617-1) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 d upday Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (617-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis mastak likh i-aa tis gur mil rog bid aaree. ||5||17||28||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Fire is contained in all firewood, and butter is contained in all milk.
lines.transliteration: sagal banaspat meh baisant ar sagal d ooDh meh gh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਬਨਸਪਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਗਲ  ਦੂਧ ਮਿਹ ਘੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: God's Light is contained in the high and the low; the Lord is in the hearts of all beings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ooch neech meh jot samaan ee gh at ghat maaDh a-o jee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Saints, He is pervading and permeating each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: santahu gh at ghat rahi-aa samaahi-o.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord is completely permeating everyone, everywhere; He is diffused in thewater and the land. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o sarab meh jal thal rama-ee-aa aahi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰਬ  ਮਿਹ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; the True Guru hasdispelled his doubt.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan naanak jas gaavai sat gur bh aram chukaa-i-o.

lines.english: The Lord is pervading everywhere, permeating all, and yet, He is unattached from all.||2||1||29|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (617-5) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab nivaasee sadaa alaypaa sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-i-o. ||2||1||29||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him, one is in ecstasy; the pains of birth and death and fear are removed.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran ho-ay anand aa binsai janam maran  bhai dukhee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੧॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The four cardinal blessings, and the nine treasures are received; you shall never feelhunger or thirst again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath nav niDh  paavahi bahur na t arisnaa bh ukhee. ||1||

lines.english: Chanting His Name, you shall be at peace.
lines.transliteration: jaa ko naam lait t oo sukh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰਿਣ  ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭੈ ਦੁਖੀ ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, meditate on the Lord and Master, O my soul, with mind,body and mouth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saas saas Dhi-aavahu th aakur ka-o man t an jee-aray mukh ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You shall find peace, and your mind shall be soothed and cooled; the fire of desireshall not burn within you.
lines.transliteration: saaNt paavahi hoveh man seet al agan na ant ar Dh ukhee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਤੂ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has revealed God to Nanak, in the three worlds, in the water, the earth andthe woods. ||2||2||30|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (617-9) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak ka-o parabhoo d ikhaa-i-aa jal thal t aribhavan rukhee. ||2||2||30||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅਰੇ  ਮੁਖੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander - please, save me from these, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  jhooth nindaa in t ay aap chh adaavahu.

lines.english: Please eradicate these from within me, and call me to come close to You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih bheet ar tay in ka-o daarahu aapan nikat bulaavhu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਪਾਵਿਹ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਧੁਖੀ ॥
lines.english: You alone teach me Your Ways.
lines.transliteration: apunee biDh aap janaavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਰੁਖੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
lines.english: With the Lord's humble servants, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jan mangal gaavhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: May I never forget the Lord within my heart; please, instill such understanding withinmy mind.
lines.transliteration: bisar naahee kabhoo hee-ay tay ih biDh  man meh paavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਝੂਠ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਇਨ ਤੇ ਆਿਪ  ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru, and now, he willnot go anywhere else. ||2||3||31|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (617-12) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa bhayti-o vadbh aagee jan naanak kat eh na Dh aavahu. ||2||3||31||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਭੀਤਰ  ਤੇ ਇਨ ਕਉ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all things are obtained, and one's efforts shall notbe in vain.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran sabh  kachh  paa-ee-ai birthee gh aal na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Forsaking God, why do you attach yourself to another? He is contained in everything.||1||
lines.transliteration: tis parabh  ti-aag avar kat  raachahu jo sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, meditate in remembrance on the World-Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har simrahu sant gopaalaa.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; your efforts shall be rewarded. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil naam Dh i-aavahu pooran hovai gh aalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਬਹੂਹੀਏ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He ever preserves and cherishes His servant; with Love, He hugs him close.
lines.transliteration: saar samaalai nit parat ipaalai paraym sahit  gal laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, forgetting You, O God, how can the world find life? ||2||4||32|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (617-16) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh t umray bisrat  jagat  jeevan kaisay paavai. ||2||4||32||

lines.english: He is imperishable, the Giver of all beings ; meditating on Him, all filth is removed.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee jee-an ko d aataa simrat  sabh  mal kh o-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰਿਣ  ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is the treasure of excellence, the object of His devotees, but rare are those who find Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan bh agtan ka-o bart an birlaa paavai ko-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਅਵਰ  ਕਤ ਰਾਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, and God, the Cherisher of the world.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap gur gopaal parabh so-ee.

lines.english: Seeking His Sanctuary, one finds peace, and he shall not suffer in pain again.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee saran pa-i-aaN sukh  paa-ee-ai baahurh  dookh na ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meeting them, evil-mindedness is eliminated. pMnw 618
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee saaDh sang paraapat  tin bhaytat durmat  kho-ee.

lines.english: Slave Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of those, who have woven the Lord's Name into their hearts. ||2||5||33|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (618-2) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin kee Dh oor naanak d aas baachh ai jin har naam rid ai paro-ee. ||2||5||33||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਪਰੋਈ  ॥੨॥੫॥੩੩॥
lines.english: He dispels the pains of countless incarnations, and lends support to the dry andshrivelled mind.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay dookh  nivaarai sookaa man saDh aarai.

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is enraptured, contemplating theName of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytat hot nihaalaa har kaa naam beechaarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੈ  ਸੂਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: mayraa baid guroo govind aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ  ਹੋਤ ਿਨਹਾਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He places the medicine of the Naam into my mouth, and cuts away the noose ofDeath. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam a-ukhaDh  mukh  dayvai kaatai jam kee fanDh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is the all-powerful, Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny; He Himself is the Doer ofdeeds.
lines.transliteration: samrath purakh pooran biDh aatay aapay karnaihaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself saves His slave; Nanak takes the Support of the Naam. ||2||6||34|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (618-5) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apunaa daas har aap ubaari-aa naanak naam aDh aaraa. ||2||6||34||

lines.english: Only You know the state of my innermost self; You alone can judge me.
lines.transliteration: antar kee gat  tum hee jaanee t ujh hee paahi nibayro.

lines.english: Please forgive me, O Lord God Master; I have committed thousands of sins and mistakes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bakhas laihu saahib parabh  apnay laakh  khatay kar fayro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਦਾਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਉਬਾਿਰਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥੬॥੩੪॥
lines.english: O my Dear Lord God Master, You are always near me.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee t oo mayro th aakur nayro.

lines.english: O Lord, please bless Your disciple with the shelter of Your feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har charan saran  mohi chayro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ  ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਿਹ  ਿਨਬੇਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Infinite and endless is my Lord and Master; He is lofty, virtuous and profoundly deep.
lines.transliteration: baysumaar bay-ant su-aamee oocho gunee gahayro.

lines.punjabi: ਬਖਿਸ ਲੈਹੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਲਾਖ  ਖਤੇ ਕਿਰ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Cutting away the noose of death, the Lord has made Nanak His slave, and now, whatdoes he owe to anyone else? ||2||7||35|| soriT mÚ 5 ] (618-8) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaat silak keeno apuno daasro t a-o naanak kahaa nihoro. ||2||7||35||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal guroo govind aa sagal manorath paa-ay.

lines.english: I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asthir bha-ay laag har charn ee govind  kay gun  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.
lines.transliteration: bhalo samoorat  pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਊਚੋ ਗੁਨੀ  ਗਹੇਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of theLord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj aanand  naam jap vaajay anhad  tooraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਟ  ਿਸਲਕ  ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਦਾਸਰੋ  ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਹਾ ਿਨਹੋਰੋ  ॥੨॥੭॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filledwith happiness.
lines.transliteration: milay su-aamee pareetam apunay gh ar mand ar sukh -daa-ee.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have beenfulfilled. ||2||8||36|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (618-11) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naam niDhaan naanak jan paa-i-aa saglee ichh  pujaa-ee. ||2||8||36||

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਗੁ ਰੂ ਗੋਿਵੰਦਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's feet abide within my heart; God has blessed me with good fortune.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan basay rid bh eetar subh  lakhan parabh  keenay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰ  ਭਏ ਲਾਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Transcendent Lord became merciful to me, and I found the treasure of the Naam within my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal pooran parmaysar naam niDh aan man cheenay. ||1||

lines.english: My Guru is my Saving Grace, my only best friend.
lines.transliteration: mayro gur rakhvaaro meet .

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ  ਤੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
