lines.english: Over and over again, He blesses me with double, even four-fold, greatness.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: doon cha-oon ee day vadi-aa-ee sobh aa neet aa neet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God saves all beings and creatures, giving them the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant parabh  sagal uDh aaray d arsan d aykhanhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Wondrous is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru; Nanak is forever a sacrifice toHim. ||2||9||37|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (618-15) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee achraj vadi-aa-ee naanak sad balihaaray. ||2||9||37||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥੮॥੩੬॥
lines.english: I gather in and collect the immaculate wealth of the Naam; this commodity isinaccessible and incomparable.
lines.transliteration: sanchan kara-o naam Dhan nirmal thaat ee agam apaar.

lines.english: Revel in it, delight in it, be happy and enjoy peace, and live long, O Sikhs andbrethren. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bilachh binod  aanand  sukh  maan hu kh aa-ay jeevhu sikh  parvaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਬਸੇ ਿਰਦ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸੁਭ ਲਖਣ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: I have the support of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan kamal aaDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਮਿਨ ਚੀਨੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found the boat of Truth; embarking on it, I sail across the ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  paa-i-o sach bohith charh  langh a-o bikh  sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The perfect, imperishable Lord has become merciful; He Himself has taken care of me.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal pooran abh inaasee aapeh keenee saar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਣ ਚਊਣੀ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸੋਭਾ ਨੀਤਾ  ਨੀਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Beholding, beholding His Vision, Nanak has blossomed forth in ecstasy. O Nanak, Heis beyond estimation. ||2||10||38|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (618-18) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paykh paykh  naanak bigsaano naanak naahee sumaar. ||2||10||38||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has revealed His power, and compassion has welled up in everyheart.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai apnee kal Dhaaree sabh  ghat upjee d a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Blending me with Himself, He has blessed me with glorious greatness, and I havefound pleasure and happiness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl vadaa-ee keenee kusal khaym sabh  bha-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੯॥੩੭॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru is always with me. pMnw 619
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa mayrai naal.

lines.english: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jap sadaa nihaal. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, in all places and interspaces, wherever I look, He is there.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar thaan thanant ar jat kat paykh a-o so-ee.

lines.english: Nanak has found the Guru, by great good fortune; no one else is as great as He. ||2||11||39|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (619-2) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur paa-i-o vadbhaagee t is jayvad avar na ko-ee. ||2||11||39||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current,gazing upon the feet of God.
lines.transliteration: sookh mangal kali-aan  sahj Dh un parabh  kay charan  nihaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੯॥
lines.english: The Savior has saved His child, and the True Guru has cured his fever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaarai raakh i-o baarik sat gur taap ut aari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;
lines.transliteration: ubray satgur kee sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਿਨਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayv na birthee jaa-ee. rahaa-o. service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ  ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਬਾਿਰਕੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well,when God becomes kind and compassionate.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh sookh  baahar fun sookh aa parabh  apunay bh a-ay d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful tome. ||2||12||40|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (619-6) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bighan na laagai ko-oo mayraa parabh  ho-aa kirpaalaa. ||2||12||40||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my mind became excited, and I sang the Praises of the jewel of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang bh a-i-aa man ud am naam rat an jas gaa-ee.

lines.english: My anxiety was dispelled, meditating in remembrance on the Infinite Lord; I havecrossed over the world ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mit ga-ee chintaa simar anant aa saagar t ari-aa bh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਫੁਿਨ ਸੂਖਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart.
lines.transliteration: hirdai har kay charan  vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕੋਊ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੋਆ  ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੦॥
lines.english: I have found peace, and the celestial sound current resounds within me; countlessdiseases have been eradicated. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-aa sahj Dh un upjee rogaa gh aan mitaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I speak and describe? Your worth cannot beestimated.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gun t ayray aakh  vakh aanaa keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਉਦਮੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees become imperishable and immortal; their God becomestheir friend and support. ||2||13||41|| soriT mÚ 5 ] (619-9) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  bha-ay abh inaasee apunaa parabh  bha-i-aa sahaa-ee. ||2||13||41||

lines.english: My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.
lines.transliteration: ga-ay kalays rog sabh naasay parabh  apunai kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.english: God has showered me with His Grace. Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore my Lord and Master; my efforts have come to fruition. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar aaraaDh ahu su-aamee pooran gh aal hamaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਜ ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੀ  ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਿਣ  ਿਮਟਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o too sukh  sampat  raas.

lines.english: Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raakh laihu bh aa-ee mayray ka-o parabh  aagai ard aas. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣਾ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.
lines.transliteration: jo maaga-o so-ee so-ee paava-o apnay khasam bh arosaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਭਏ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਭਇਆ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled.||2||14||42|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (619-13) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur pooraa bhayti-o miti-o sagal and aysaa. ||2||14||42||

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Guru, the True Guru, all pains havebeen eradicated.
lines.transliteration: simar simar gur satgur apnaa saglaa d ookh mitaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ਰੋਗ ਸਿਭ ਨਾਸੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The fever and the disease are gone, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and Ihave obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taap rog ga-ay gur bachnee man ichh ay fal paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਘਾਲ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: mayraa gur pooraa sukh-d aata.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੂ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath su-aamee pooran purakh  biDhaataa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੈਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਗੈ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in bliss, joy and ecstasy; Guru Nanak hasbecome kind and compassionate.
lines.transliteration: anand binod mangal gun  gaavhu gur naanak bh a-ay d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Shouts of cheers and congratulations ring out all over the world; the Supreme LordGod has become my Savior and Protector. ||2||15||43|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (619-16) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar bha-ay jag bh eetar ho-aa paarbarahm rakh vaalaa. ||2||15||43||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਖਸਮ  ਭਰੋਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: He did not take my accounts into account; such is His forgiving nature.
lines.transliteration: hamree ganat  na gan ee-aa kaa-ee apn aa birad  pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਿਮਿਟਓ  ਸਗਲ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: He gave me His hand, and saved me and made me His own; forever and ever, I enjoyHis Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ay kar apunay sad aa sad aa rang maan . ||1||

lines.english: The True Lord and Master is forever merciful and forgiving.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib sad miharvaan.

lines.english: My Perfect Guru has bound me to Him, and now, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: banDh paa-i-aa mayrai sat gur poorai ho-ee sarab kali-aan . rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One who fashioned the body and placed the soul within, who gives you clothingand nourishment
lines.transliteration: jee-o paa-ay pind jin saaji-aa dit aa painan  khaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਪ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: - He Himself preserves the honor of His slaves. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||44|| pMnw 620 soriT mhlw 5 ] (620-1) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apnay d aas kee aap paij raakh ee naanak sad  kurbaan . ||2||16||44||

lines.english: The Lord God Himself has rid the whole world of its sins, and saved it.
lines.transliteration: durat gavaa-i-aa har parabh  aapay sabh  sansaar ubaari-aa.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God extended His mercy, and confirmed His innate nature. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh kirpaa Dh aaree apn aa birad  samaari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਤੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪੇ  ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਬਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have attained the Protective Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.
lines.transliteration: ho-ee raajay raam kee rakhvaalee.

lines.english: In celestial peace and ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and my mind, body and being are at peace. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanad  gun gaavhu man t an dayh sukh aalee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: My True Guru is the Savior of sinners; I have placed my trust and faith in Him.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran  satgur mayraa mohi t is kaa bh arvaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord has heard Nanak's prayer, and He has forgiven everything.||2||17||45|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (620-5) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bakhas la-ay sabh  sachai saahib sun  naanak kee ard aasaa. ||2||17||45||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, has forgiven me, and all diseases have been cured.
lines.transliteration: bakhsi-aa paarbarahm parmaysar saglay rog bid aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru are saved, and all their affairs areresolved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee sarnee ubray kaaraj sagal savaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਸਿਭ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਿਹਿਬ  ਸੁਿਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਾ  ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੫॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant meditates in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of theLord; this is his only support.
lines.transliteration: har jan simri-aa naam aDhaar.

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru extended His Mercy, and the fever has been dispelled.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taap ut aari-aa sat gur poorai apn ee kirpaa Dh aar. rahaa-o.

lines.english: So celebrate and be happy, my beloveds - the Guru has saved Hargobind.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand karah mayray pi-aaray har govid  gur raakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ਉਬਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਗਲ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Great is the glorious greatness of the Creator, O Nanak; True is the Word of HisShabad, and True is the sermon of His Teachings. ||2||18||46|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (620-8) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee naanak kartay kee saach sabad  sat bhaakhi-aa. ||2||18||46||

lines.english: My Lord and Master has become Merciful, in His True Court.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal su-aamee mayray t it saachai d arbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਿਰਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has taken away the fever, and the whole world is at peace, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: satgur t aap gavaa-i-aa bh aa-ee th aaNdh pa-ee sansaar.

lines.english: The Lord Himself protects His beings and creatures, and the Messenger of Death isout of work. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnay jee-a jant  aapay raakh ay jameh kee-o hatt aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਕਰਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's feet within your heart.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan rid ai ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਿਤ ਭਾਿਖਆ  ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੬॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God, O Siblings of Destiny. He is theEradicator of suffering and sins. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa parabh  simree-ai bh aa-ee d ukh kilbikh  kaatan haar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He fashioned all beings, O Siblings of Destiny, and His Sanctuary saves them.
lines.transliteration: tis kee sarn ee oobrai bh aa-ee jin rachi-aa sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: He is the Almighty Creator, the Cause of causes, O Siblings of Destiny; He, the TrueLord, is True.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath so bh aa-ee sachai sachee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਠਿਢ  ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak: meditate on God, O Siblings of Destiny, and your mind and body shall be cooland calm. ||2||19||47|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (620-13) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabhoo Dh i-aa-ee-ai bh aa-ee man t an seet al ho-ay. ||2||19||47||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਆਪੇ  ਰਾਖੇ ਜਮਿਹ  ਕੀਓ  ਹਟਤਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: santahu har har naam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: Never forget God, the ocean of peace; thus you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar parabh  visra-o naahee man chind i-arhaa fal paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਸਮਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ  ਦੁਖ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Extending His Mercy, the Perfect True Guru has dispelled the fever.
lines.transliteration: satgur poorai t aap gavaa-i-aa apn ee kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has become kind and compassionate, and my whole family isnow free of pain and suffering. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh bh a-ay d a-i-aalaa d ukh miti-aa sabh  parvaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ਊਬਰੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਿਚਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Treasure of absolute joy, sublime elixir and beauty, the Name of the Lord is myonly Support.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan mangal ras roopaa har kaa naam aDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸੋ ਭਾਈ  ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord has preserved my honor, and saved the whole world.||2||20||48|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (620-17) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pat raakh ee parmaysar uDh ri-aa sabh  sansaaro. ||2||20||48||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੭॥
lines.english: My True Guru is my Savior and Protector.
lines.transliteration: mayraa satgur rakh vaalaa ho-aa.

lines.english: Dhaar kirpaa parabh  haath d ay raakh i-aa har govid  navaa niro-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. Showering us with His Mercy and Grace, God extended His Hand, and savedHargobind, who is now safe and secure. ||1||Pause||
The fever is gone - God Himself eradicated it, and preserved the honor of His servant.
lines.transliteration: taap ga-i-aa parabh  aap mitaa-i-aa jan kee laaj rakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਵਸਰਉ  ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਅੜਾ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have obtained all blessings from the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  tay sabh  fal paa-ay sat gur kai bal jaaN-ee. ||1||

lines.english: God has saved me, both here and hereafter.  He has not taken my merits and demerits into account. pMnw 621
lines.transliteration: halat palat  parabh  dovai savaaray hamraa gun  avgun  na beechaari-aa.

lines.english: Your Word is eternal, O Guru Nanak; You placed Your Hand of blessing upon my forehead. ||2||21||49|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (621-2) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: atal bachan naanak gur tayraa safal kar mast ak Dh aari-aa. ||2||21||49||

lines.punjabi: ਅਟਲ  ਬਚਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਫਲ  ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੯॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures were created by Him; He alone is the support and friend ofthe Saints.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jantar sabh  tis kay kee-ay so-ee sant  sahaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; their glorious greatness becomesperfect. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apunay sayvak kee aapay raakhai pooran bh a-ee badaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤਰ੍ ਸਿਭ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is always with me.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooraa mayrai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੀ ਆਪੇ  ਰਾਖੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has perfectly and totally protected me, and now everyone is kindand compassionate to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pooree sabh raakh ee ho-ay sarab d a-i-aal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Night and day, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the Giver of the soul, and the breath of life itself.
lines.transliteration: an-din naanak naam Dh i-aa-ay jee-a paraan kaa d aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ  ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ  ਦਇਆਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He hugs His slave close in His loving embrace, like the mother and father hug theirchild. ||2||22||50|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 3 caupdy  (621-6) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 3 cha-upd ay Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (621-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: apunay daas ka-o kanth  laa-ay raakh ai ji-o baarik pit  maat aa. ||2||22||50||

lines.english: Meeting with the council, my doubts were not dispelled.
lines.transliteration: mil panchahu nahee sahsaa chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The chiefs did not give me satisfaction.
lines.transliteration: sikdaarahu nah pat ee-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਰਾਖੈ ਿਜਉ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਿਪਤ ਮਾਤਾ  ॥੨॥੨੨॥੫੦॥
lines.english: I presented my dispute to the noblemen as well.
lines.transliteration: umraavahu aagai jhayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: But it was only settled by meeting with the King, my Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil raajan raam nibayraa. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I do not go searching anywhere else,
lines.transliteration: ab dhoodh an kat ahu na jaa-ee.
gobid bh aytay gur gosaa-ee. rahaa-o. because I have met the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

lines.english: When I came to God's Darbaar, His Holy Court,
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa parabh d arbaaraa.
taa saglee mitee pookaaraa. then all of my cries and complaints were settled.

lines.english: Now that I have attained what I had sought,
lines.transliteration: labaDh aapn ee paa-ee.
taa kat  aavai kat  jaa-ee. ||2|| where should I come and where should I go? ||2||

lines.english: There, true justice is administered.
lines.transliteration: tah saach ni-aa-ay nibayraa.

lines.english: There, the Lord Master and His disciple are one and the same.
lines.transliteration: oohaa sam thaakur sam chayraa.

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee jaanai.

lines.english: Without our speaking, He understands. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin bolat aap pachh aanai. ||3||

lines.english: He is the King of all places.
lines.transliteration: sarab thaan ko raajaa.

lines.english: There, the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds.
lines.transliteration: tah anhad  sabad  agaajaa.

lines.english: Of what use is cleverness when dealing with Him?
lines.transliteration: tis peh ki-aa chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: Meeting with Him, O Nanak, one loses his self-conceit. ||4||1||51|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (621-12) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mil naanak aap gavaa-ee. ||4||1||51||

lines.english: Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart;
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam vasaa-iho.
ghar baith ay guroo Dh i-aa-iho. sitting within your own home, meditate on the Guru.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has spoken the Truth;
lines.transliteration: gur poorai sach kahi-aa.
so sukh saachaa lahi-aa. ||1|| the True Peace is obtained only from the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: My Guru has become merciful.
lines.transliteration: apunaa ho-i-o gur miharvaanaa.

lines.english: In bliss, peace, pleasure and joy, I have returned to my own home, after my purifying bath. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anad sookh  kali-aan  mangal si-o gh ar aa-ay kar isnaanaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: True is the glorious greatness of the Guru;
lines.transliteration: saachee gur vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: His worth cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.english: He is the Supreme Overlord of kings.
lines.transliteration: sir saahaa paatisaahaa.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is enraptured. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur bhaytat  man omaahaa. ||2||

lines.english: All sins are washed away,
lines.transliteration: sagal paraachhat  laathay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਸੂਖ ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਿਸਉ ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ਕਿਰ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangat  kai saathay. meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the treasure of excellence;
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan har naamaa.
jap pooran ho-ay kaamaa. ||3|| chanting it, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has opened the door of liberation,
lines.transliteration: gur keeno mukat d u-aaraa.
sabh sarisat karai jaikaaraa. and the entire world applauds Him with cheers of victory.

lines.english: O Nanak, God is always with me;
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh mayrai saathay.

lines.english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: janam maran bh ai laathay. ||4||2||52|| my fears of birth and death are gone. ||4||2||52|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (621-18) sorath mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has granted His Grace,
lines.transliteration: gur poorai kirpaa Dhaaree.
parabh pooree loch hamaaree. and God has fulfilled my desire.

lines.english: After taking my bath of purification, I returned to my home,
lines.transliteration: kar isnaan garihi aa-ay.
anad mangal sukh  paa-ay. ||1|| and I found bliss, happiness and peace. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, salvation comes from the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: santahu raam naam nist aree-ai.

lines.english: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord's Name. Night and day, do good deeds. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 622
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at har har Dh i-aa-ee-ai an-d in sukarit  karee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The way of the Saints is the ladder of righteous living, found only by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: sant kaa maarag Dh aram kee pa-orh ee ko vadbh aagee paa-ay.

lines.english: The sins of millions of incarnations are washed away, by focusing your consciousnesson the Lord's feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay kilbikh naasay har charn ee chit  laa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਧਰਮ  ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ  ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: So sing the Praises of your God forever; His almighty power is perfect.
lines.transliteration: ustat karahu sad aa parabh  apnay jin pooree kal raakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਨਾਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures are purified, listening to the True Teachings of the True Guru.||3||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  bha-ay pavit araa sat gur kee sach saakh ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੂਰੀ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it is theEliminator of obstructions, the Destroyer of all pains.
lines.transliteration: bighan binaasan sabh  dukh naasan sat gur naam drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਭਏ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All of my sins were erased, and I have been purified; servant Nanak has returned tohis home of peace. ||4||3||53|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (622-5) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kho-ay paap bh a-ay sabh  paavan jan naanak sukh  ghar aa-i-aa. ||4||3||53||

lines.english: O Lord Master, You are the ocean of excellence.
lines.transliteration: saahib gunee gahayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਏ ਪਾਪ ਭਏ ਸਿਭ ਪਾਵਨ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ॥੪॥੩॥੫੩॥
lines.english: My home and all my possessions are Yours.
lines.transliteration: ghar laskar sabh  tayraa.

lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the world, is my Savior.
lines.transliteration: rakhvaalay gur gopaalaa.

lines.english: All beings have become kind and compassionate to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-a bh a-ay d a-i-aalaa. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating on the Guru's feet, I am in bliss.
lines.transliteration: jap anad raha-o gur charn aa.

lines.english: There is no fear at all, in God's Sanctuary. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-o kat eh nahee parabh  sarnaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: You dwell in the hearts of Your slaves, Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayri-aa d aasaa rid ai muraaree.

lines.english: God has laid the eternal foundation.
lines.transliteration: parabh abichal neev usaaree.

lines.english: You are my strength, wealth and support.
lines.transliteration: bal Dhan t akee-aa t ayraa.

lines.english: You are my Almighty Lord and Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too bh aaro th aakur mayraa. ||2||

lines.english: Whoever finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: jin jin saaDhsang paa-i-aa.
so parabh aap t araa-i-aa. is saved by God Himself.

lines.english: By His Grace, He has blessed me with the sublime essence of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naam ras dee-aa.

lines.english: All joy and pleasure then came to me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kusal khaym sabh  thee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: God became my helper and my best friend;
lines.transliteration: ho-ay parabhoo sahaa-ee.
sabh uth  laagee paa-ee. everyone rises up and bows down at my feet.

lines.english: With each and every breath, meditate on God;
lines.transliteration: saas saas parabh Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, sing the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||4||54|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (622-10) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har mangal naanak gaa-ee-ai. ||4||4||54||

lines.english: Celestial peace and bliss have come,
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand aa.
parabh mili-o man bh aavand aa. meeting God, who is so pleasing to my mind.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru showered me with His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: poorai gur kirpaa Dhaaree.
taa gat  bha-ee hamaaree. ||1|| and I attained salvation. ||1||

lines.english: My mind is absorbed in loving devotional worship of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: har kee paraym bhagat  man leenaa.

lines.english: ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nit baajay anhat  beenaa. rahaa-o. and the unstruck melody of the celestial sound current ever resounds within me.

lines.english: The Lord's feet are my all-powerful shelter and support;
lines.transliteration: har charan kee ot sat aanee.
sabh chookee kaan  lokaan ee. my dependence on other people is totally finished.

lines.english: I have found the Life of the world, the Great Giver;
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan daat aa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har rasak rasak gun gaa-i-aa. ||2|| in joyful rapture, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.english: God has cut away the noose of death.
lines.transliteration: parabh kaati-aa jam kaa faasaa.

lines.english: My mind's desires have been fulfilled;
lines.transliteration: man pooran ho-ee aasaa.
jah paykhaa t ah so-ee. wherever I look, He is there.

lines.english: Without the Lord God, there is no other at all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har parabh bin avar na ko-ee. ||3||

lines.english: In His Mercy, God has protected and preserved me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh raakh ay.

lines.english: I am rid of all the pains of countless incarnations.
lines.transliteration: sabh janam janam d ukh laathay.

lines.english: I have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord;
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, I have found eternal peace. ||4||5||55|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (622-15) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: atal sukh naanak paa-i-aa. ||4||5||55||

lines.english: The Creator has brought utter peace to my home;
lines.transliteration: thaadh  paa-ee kart aaray.
taap chh od ga-i-aa parvaaray. the fever has left my family.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has saved us.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai hai raakhee.

lines.english: I sought the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saran sachay kee t aakee. ||1||

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord Himself has become my Protector.
lines.transliteration: parmaysar aap ho-aa rakhvaalaa.

lines.english: Tranquility, intuitive peace and poise welled up in an instant, and my mind was comforted forever. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj sukh  khin meh upjay man ho-aa sad aa sukh aalaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, gave me the medicine of His Name,
lines.transliteration: har har naam dee-o d aaroo.
tin saglaa rog bid aaroo. which has cured all disease.

lines.english: He extended His Mercy to me,
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa Dh aaree.
tin saglee baat  savaaree. ||2|| and resolved all these affairs. ||2||

lines.english: God confirmed His loving nature;
lines.transliteration: parabh apnaa birad  samaari-aa.

lines.english: He did not take my merits or demerits into account.
lines.transliteration: hamraa gun avgun  na beechaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਉਪਜੇ  ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become manifest, pMnw 623
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad bh a-i-o saakh ee.
tin saglee laaj raakh ee. ||3|| and through it, my honor was totally preserved. ||3||

lines.english: I speak as You cause me to speak;
lines.transliteration: bolaa-i-aa bolee tayraa.

lines.english: O Lord and Master, You are the ocean of excellence.
lines.transliteration: too saahib gun ee gahayraa.

lines.english: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, according to the Teachings of Truth.
lines.transliteration: jap naanak naam sach saakhee.

lines.english: God preserves the honor of His slaves. ||4||6||56|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (623-2) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apunay daas kee paij raakh ee. ||4||6||56||

lines.english: The Creator Lord Himself stood between us,
lines.transliteration: vich kartaa purakh  khalo-aa.
vaal na vingaa ho-aa. and not a hair upon my head was touched.

lines.english: The Guru made my cleansing bath successful;
lines.transliteration: majan gur aaNdaa raasay.
jap har har kilvikh naasay. ||1|| meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, my sins were erased. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, the purifying pool of Ram Das is sublime.
lines.transliteration: santahu raamd aas sarovar neekaa.

lines.english: Whoever bathes in it, his family and ancestry are saved, and his soul is saved as well.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo naavai so kul taraavai uDh aar ho-aa hai jee kaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The world sings cheers of victory,
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar jag gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ  ਹੈ ਜੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man chindi-arh ay fal paavai. and the fruits of his mind's desires are obtained.

lines.english: Whoever comes and bathes here, and meditates on his God, is safe and sound. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahee salaamat naa-ay aa-ay. apn aa parabh oo Dh i-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One who bathes in the healing pool of the Saints,
lines.transliteration: sant sarovar naavai.
so jan param gat paavai. that humble being obtains the supreme status.

lines.english: He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation;
lines.transliteration: marai na aavai jaa-ee.
har har naam Dhi-aa-ee. ||3|| he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

lines.english: He alone knows this about God,
lines.transliteration: ih barahm bichaar so jaanai.
jis da-i-aal ho-ay bh agvaanai. whom God blesses with His kindness.

lines.english: Baba Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God;
lines.transliteration: baabaa naanak parabh sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh chint aa gan at mitaa-ee. ||4||7||57|| all his worries and anxieties are dispelled. ||4||7||57|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (623-8) sorath mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has stood by me and fulfilled me,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm nibaahee pooree.
kaa-ee baat na rahee-aa ooree. and nothing is left unfinished.

lines.english: Attached to the Guru's feet, I am saved;
lines.transliteration: gur charan laa-ay nistaaray.

lines.english: I contemplate and cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har naam samHaaray. ||1||

lines.english: He is forever the Savior of His slaves.
lines.transliteration: apnay daas kaa sad aa rakh vaalaa.

lines.english: Bestowing His Mercy, He made me His own and preserved me; like a mother orfather, He cherishes me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apunay kar raakhay maat  pitaa ji-o paalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I found the True Guru,
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee sat gur paa-i-aa.
jin jam kaa panth mitaa-i-aa. who obliterated the path of the Messenger of Death.

lines.english: My consciousness is focused on loving, devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  bhaa-ay chit  laagaa.

lines.english: One who lives in this meditation is very fortunate indeed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jap jeeveh say vadbhaagaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਿਜਉ ਪਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He sings the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani,
lines.transliteration: har amrit ban ee gaavai.
saaDhaa kee Dh ooree naavai. and bathes in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.english: He Himself bestows His Name.
lines.transliteration: apunaa naam aapay dee-aa.

lines.english: God, the Creator, saves us. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabh karanhaar rakh  lee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is the support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: har darsan paraan aDh aaraa.

lines.english: This is the perfect, pure wisdom.
lines.transliteration: ih pooran bimal beechaaraa.

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has granted His Mercy;
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa antarjaamee.

lines.english: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daas naanak saran  su-aamee. ||4||8||58|| slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master. ||4||8||58|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (623-14) sorath mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has attached me to His feet.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai charnee laa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have obtained the Lord as my companion, my support, my best friend.
lines.transliteration: har sang sahaa-ee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Wherever I go, I am happy there.
lines.transliteration: jah jaa-ee-ai tahaa suhaylay.

lines.english: By His Kind Mercy, God united me with Himself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh maylay. ||1||

lines.english: So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavhu sad aa subh aa-ee.

lines.english: You shall obtain all the fruits of your mind's desires, and the Lord shall become thecompanion and the support of your soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man chinday saglay fal paavhu jee-a kai sang sahaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is the support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: naaraa-in paraan  aDhaaraa.

lines.english: I am the dust of the feet of the Holy people.
lines.transliteration: ham sant janaaN raynaaraa.

lines.english: I am a sinner, but the Lord made me pure.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  kar leenay.

lines.english: By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blessed me with His Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har jas deenay. ||2||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God cherishes and nurtures me.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm karay partipaalaa.

lines.english: He is always with me, the Protector of my soul.
lines.transliteration: sad jee-a sang rakh vaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਦੇ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises day and night,
lines.transliteration: har din rain keert an gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: I shall not be consigned to reincarnation again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bahurh na jonee paa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: One who is blessed by the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny,
lines.transliteration: jis dayvai purakh  biDhaataa.
har ras tin hee jaat aa. realizes the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not come near him.
lines.transliteration: jamkankar nayrh na aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Lord's Sanctuary, Nanak has found peace. ||4||9||59|| pMnw 624 soriT mhlw 5 ] (624-1) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukh naanak sarn ee paa-i-aa. ||4||9||59||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has made me perfect.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai keetee pooree.

lines.english: God is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: parabh rav rahi-aa bh arpooree.

lines.english: With joy and pleasure, I take my purifying bath.
lines.transliteration: khaym kusal bh a-i-aa isnaanaa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm vitahu kurbaanaa. ||1||

lines.english: I enshrine the lotus feet of the Guru within my heart.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan kaval rid Dh aaray.

lines.english: Not even the tiniest obstacle blocks my way; all my affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bighan na laagai t il kaa ko-ee kaaraj sagal savaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meeting with the Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness was eradicated.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo d urmat  kho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਤਲ  ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਗਲ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the sinners are purified.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  sabh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Bathing in the sacred pool of Guru Ram Das,
lines.transliteration: raamdaas sarovar naat ay.
sabh laathay paap kamaat ay. ||2|| all the sins one has committed are washed away. ||2||

lines.english: So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe;
lines.transliteration: gun gobind nit  gaa-ee-ai.
saaDhsang mil Dh i-aa-ee-ai. joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him.

lines.english: The fruits of your mind's desires are obtained
lines.transliteration: man baaNchhat  fal paa-ay.
gur pooraa ridai Dh i-aa-ay. ||3|| by meditating on the Perfect Guru within your heart. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the World, is blissful;
lines.transliteration: gur gopaal aanandaa.
jap jap jeevai parmaanandaa. chanting, meditating on the Lord of supreme bliss, He lives.

lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: God has confirmed His innate nature. ||4||10||60|| rwgu soriT mhlw 5 ] (624-7) raag sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh apnaa birad  rakhaa-i-aa. ||4||10||60||

lines.english: In the ten directions, the clouds cover the sky like a canopy; through the dark clouds, lightning flashes, and I am terrified.
lines.transliteration: dah d is chh atar maygh  ghataa gh at daaman chamak daraa-i-o.

lines.english: By bed is empty, and my eyes are sleepless; my Husband Lord has gone far away.||1||
lines.transliteration: sayj ikaylee need nahu nainah pir pard ays siDh aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I receive no messages from Him, O mother!
lines.transliteration: hun nahee sand aysaro maa-i-o.

lines.english: When my Beloved used to go even a mile away, He would send me four letters.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk kosro siDh karat  laal t ab chat ur paat ro aa-i-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਛਤਰ੍ ਮੇਘ ਘਟਾ  ਘਟ ਦਾਮਿਨ  ਚਮਿਕ  ਡਰਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: How could I forget this Dear Beloved of mine? He is the Giver of peace, and allvirtues.
lines.transliteration: ki-o bisrai ih laal pi-aaro sarab gunaa sukh -daa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ  ਨੀਦ  ਨਹੁ ਨੈਨਹ  ਿਪਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਿਸ  ਿਸਧਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Ascending to His Mansion, I gaze upon His path, and my eyes are filled with tears.||2||
lines.transliteration: mandar char kai panth nihaara-o nain neer bh ar aa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: The wall of egotism and pride separates us, but I can hear Him nearby.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o bheet  bha-i-o hai beecho sunat  days niktaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਕੋਸਰੋ  ਿਸਿਧ ਕਰਤ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਤਬ ਚਤੁਰ  ਪਾਤਰੋ  ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: There is a veil between us, like the wings of a butterfly; without being able to seeHim, He seems so far away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaaNbheeree kay paat  pardo bin paykh ay dooraa-i-o. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord and Master of all has become merciful; He has dispelled all my sufferings.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal sarab ko th aakur sagro d ookh mitaa-i-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when the Guru tore down the wall of egotism, then, I found my Merciful Lord and Master. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ha-umai bheet  gur kh o-ee t a-o da-i-aar beeth lo paa-i-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਚਿਰ ਕੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਿਨਹਾਰਉ  ਨੈਨ ਨੀਿਰ  ਭਿਰ ਆਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All my fears have been dispelled, O mother!
lines.transliteration: sabh rahi-o and aysro maa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਭੀਿਤ  ਭਇਓ  ਹੈ ਬੀਚੋ ਸੁਨਤ  ਦੇਿਸ ਿਨਕਟਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever I seek, the Guru leads me to find.
lines.transliteration: jo chaahat so guroo milaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਭੀਰੀ  ਕੇ ਪਾਤ ਪਰਦੋ  ਿਬਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਦੂਰਾਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord, our King, is the treasure of all virtue. ||Second Pause||11||61|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (624-14) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab gunaa niDh raa-i-o. rahaa-o d oojaa. ||11||61||

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰਪਾਲੁ  ਸਰਬ  ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਗਰੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਿਮਟਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Restorer of what was taken away, the Liberator from captivity; the Formless Lord,the Destroyer of pain.
lines.transliteration: ga-ee bahorh band ee chh orh nirankaar d ukh-daaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਭੀਿਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਖੋਈ ਤਉ ਦਇਆਰੁ ਬੀਠਲੋ  ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: I do not know about karma and good deeds; I do not know about Dharma andrighteous living. I am so greedy, chasing after Maya.
lines.transliteration: karam na jaanaa Dh aram na jaan aa lobh ee maa-i-aaDh aaree.

lines.english: I go by the name of God's devotee; please, save this honor of Yours. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam pari-o bhagat  govind  kaa ih raakh o paij t umaaree. ||1||

lines.english: O Dear Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o nimaani-aa t oo maan .

lines.english: You make the unworthy ones worthy, O my Lord of the Universe; I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nicheeji-aa cheej karay mayraa govind t ayree kud rat ka-o kurbaan . rahaa-o.

lines.english: Like the child, innocently making thousands of mistakes
lines.transliteration: jaisaa baalak bhaa-ay subh aa-ee lakh  apraaDh  kamaavai.
kar updays jh irhkay baho bh aatee bahurh  pitaa gal laavai. - his father teaches him, and scolds him so many times, but still, he hugs him close inhis embrace.

lines.english: Please forgive my past actions, God, and place me on Your path for the future. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pichhlay a-ogun  bakh as la-ay parabh  aagai maarag paavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows all about my state ofmind; so who else should I go to and speak to?

lines.english: Your slaves, O Lord, focus on pure thoughts.
lines.transliteration: subh chit van d aas tumaaray.

lines.english: You preserve the honor of Your slaves, and You Yourself arrange their affairs.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raakhahi paij d aas apunay kee kaaraj aap savaaray. rahaa-o.

lines.english: My God is so benevolent.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh par-upkaaree.

lines.english: His Almighty Power is manifest.
lines.transliteration: pooran kal jin Dhaaree.

lines.english: Nanak has come to His Sanctuary.

lines.english: He has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||10||74|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (627-11) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har jaapay.

lines.english: God Himself has saved my child.
lines.transliteration: parabh baalak raakh ay aapay.

lines.english: He healed him from the smallpox.
lines.transliteration: seetlaa th aak rahaa-ee.

lines.english: My troubles have been removed through the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bighan ga-ay har naa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: My God is forever Merciful.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh ho-aa sad aa da-i-aalaa.

lines.english: God is Almighty, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: parabh karan  kaaran  samraathaa.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains and sorrows vanish.
lines.transliteration: har simrat sabh  dukh laathaa.

lines.english: He has heard the prayer of His slave.
lines.transliteration: apnay d aas kee sun ee baynant ee.

lines.english: I meditated on my Guru.
lines.transliteration: apnaa guroo Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: I met with Him, and returned home in joy.
lines.transliteration: mil kusal saytee gh ar aa-ay.

lines.english: This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naamai kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Its value cannot be estimated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: santahu har har har aaraaDh ahu.

lines.transliteration: har aaraaDh sabh o kichh  paa-ee-ai kaaraj saglay saaDh ahu. rahaa-o.

lines.english: He alone is attached in loving devotion to God,
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  parabh  laagee.
so paa-ay jis vadbhaagee. who realizes his great destiny.

lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He obtains the rewards of all joys and peace. ||2||12||76|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (627-19) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.transliteration: parmaysar dit aa bannaa.

lines.english: The men and women celebrate.
lines.transliteration: anad karahi nar naaree.

lines.transliteration: har har parabh kirpaa Dh aaree. ||1||

lines.transliteration: santahu sukh  ho-aa sabh  thaa-ee.

lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran parmaysar rav rahi-aa sabhnee jaa-ee. rahaa-o.

It eradicates all anxiety.
lines.transliteration: tin saglee chint  mitaa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord is merciful, kind and compassionate.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal purakh  miharvaanaa.

lines.english: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the True Lord. ||2||13||77|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (628-3) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naanak saach vakhaanaa. ||2||13||77||

lines.english: Here and hereafter, He is our Savior.
lines.transliteration: aithai othai rakhvaalaa.

lines.english: God, the True Guru, is Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: parabh sat gur deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: He Himself protects His slaves.
lines.transliteration: daas apnay aap raakh ay.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan oopar bal jaa-ee.

lines.english: Day and night, with each and every breath, I remember Him; He is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dinas rain saas saas samaalee pooran sabh nee thaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself has become my help and support.
lines.transliteration: aap sahaa-ee ho-aa.

lines.english: True is the support of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachay daa sachaa dh o-aa.

lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat vadi-aa-ee.

lines.transliteration: paa-ee naanak parabh sarn aa-ee. ||2||14||78||

lines.transliteration: satgur pooray bh aanaa.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe extended His Mercy to me,
lines.transliteration: gobind kirpaa Dh aaree.
parabh raakh ee paij hamaaree. ||1|| and God saved my honor. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's feet are forever peace-giving.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan sadaa sukh -daa-ee.

lines.english: Whatever fruit one desires, he receives; his hopes shall not go in vain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo ichheh so-ee fal paavahi birthee aas na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That Saint, unto whom the Lord of Life, the Great Giver, extends His Mercy - he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay jis paraanpat d aataa so-ee sant  gun gaavai.

lines.english: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the SupremeLord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  taa kaa man leen aa paarbarahm man bh aavai. ||2||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he chants the Praises of the Lord, and the bitter poison doesnot affect him.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har kaa jas ravn aa bikh ai thag-uree laathee.

lines.english: My Creator Lord has united me with Himself, and the Holy Saints have become mycompanions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sang milaa-ay lee-aa mayrai kartai sant  saaDh  bha-ay saathee. ||3||

lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay sarbas deenay aapeh aap milaa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sarab thok pooran pooraa satgur paa-i-aa. ||4||15||79||

lines.english: Humility is my spiked club.
lines.transliteration: gareebee gadaa hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥

lines.transliteration: khannaa sagal rayn chh aaree.

lines.transliteration: is aagai ko na tikai vaykaaree.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has given me this understanding. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray ayh gal saaree. ||1||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support and shelter of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: har har naam santan kee otaa.

lines.transliteration: jo simrai tis kee gat  hovai uDh rahi saglay kotaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, I sing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: sant sang jas gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have found this, the perfect wealth of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih pooran har Dhan paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have eradicated my self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak aap mitaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I see the Supreme Lord God everywhere. ||2||16||80|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (628-16) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh paarbarahm nad ree aa-i-aa. ||2||16||80||

lines.transliteration: nit anand sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Devotional worship to the Lord is what gives rewards.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  fal daatee.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru, by His Grace, gave it to me; how rare are those who know this.||Pause||

lines.english: Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.english: That is always rewarding and peace-giving.
lines.transliteration: oh safal sadaa sukh -daa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa paa-i-aa. ||2||17||81||

lines.english: All my affairs have been resolved.
lines.transliteration: kaaraj saglay saaDhay.

lines.english: All desires have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooray.

lines.english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baajay anhad t ooray. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, meditating on the Lord, we obtain peace.
lines.transliteration: santahu raam japat  sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee banee.

lines.transliteration: bhookh ay kh aavat  laaj na aavai.

lines.transliteration: ti-o har jan har gun  gaavai. ||1||

lines.english: Why are you so lazy in your own affairs?
lines.transliteration: apnay kaaj ka-o ki-o alkaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Just as the lustful man is enticed by lust,
lines.transliteration: ji-o kaamee kaam lubhaavai.

ti-o gi-aanee naam kamaavai. ||3|| so does the spiritual person cherish the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

lines.transliteration: sukh saaNd ghar aa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: poorai gur pehraa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: binsay dukh  sabaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.transliteration: santahu saachay kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: He has created such wonder and glory! ||1||Pause||

lines.english: O Nanak, God is the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sukh -daa-ee.

lines.transliteration: parabh apunaa rid ai Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.transliteration: ghar sahee salaamat  aa-ay.

lines.english: The world has become contented.
lines.transliteration: santokh  bha-i-aa sansaaray.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has saved me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai lai taaray. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, my God is forever merciful.
lines.transliteration: santahu parabh  mayraa sad aa da-i-aalaa.

lines.transliteration: har naam ridai ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru was pleased, and blessed me,
lines.transliteration: gur poorai tus d ee-aa.

lines.english: The Lord abides in my mind and body.

lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahee na jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your Name.
lines.transliteration: ha-o kurbaan jaa-ee tayray naavai.

lines.transliteration: jis no bakhas laihi mayray pi-aaray so jas t ayraa gaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.transliteration: jantaaN bharvaasaa t ayraa.

lines.english: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.

lines.transliteration: aagai sukh mayray meet aa.

lines.english: Your glorious greatness is wonderful and marvellous.
lines.transliteration: achraj tayree vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak ever meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||23||87|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (630-2) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nit naanak naam Dh i-aa-ee. ||2||23||87||

lines.english: The Lord is always with me.
lines.transliteration: naal naraa-in mayrai.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not approach me.
lines.transliteration: jamdoot  na aavai nayrai.

lines.english: God holds me close in His embrace, and protects me.
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay parabh  raakh ai.

lines.english: True are the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sach saakh ai. ||1||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pooree keetee.

lines.english: He has beaten and driven off my enemies, and given me, His slave, the sublime understanding of the neutral mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dusman maar vidaaray saglay d aas ka-o sumat  deetee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਮਨ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਵਡਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ  ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਦੀਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God has blessed all places with prosperity.
lines.transliteration: parabh saglay thaan vasaa-ay.

lines.english: I have returned again safe and sound.
lines.transliteration: sukh saaNd fir aa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aa-ay.

lines.english: It has eradicated all disease. ||2||24||88|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (630-5) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin saglay rog mitaa-ay. ||2||24||88||

lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of all peace and comfort - seek His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa kaa d aataa sat gur taa kee sarnee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, bliss ensues, pain is dispelled, and onesings the Lord's Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytat hot anand aa dookh ga-i-aa har gaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har ras peevhu bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam in adoration, and enter theSanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam japahu naamo aaraaDhahu gur pooray kee sarnaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ  ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ  ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Only one who has such pre-ordained destiny receives it; he alone becomes perfect, OSiblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  jis Dh ur likh i-aa so-ee pooran bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak's prayer, O Dear God, is to remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam. ||2||25||89|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (630-9) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee parabh  jee naam rahaa liv laa-ee. ||2||25||89||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Cause of Causes, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He preserves the honor of His servant.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan har antarjaamee jan apunay kee raakh ai.

lines.english: He is hailed and congratulated throughout the world, and he tastes the sublimeessence of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar hot jag bh eetar sabad  guroo ras chaakh ai. ||1||

lines.english: Dear God, Lord of the world, You are my only support.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee t ayree ot gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹਾ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥੨੫॥੮੯॥
lines.english: You are all-powerful, the Giver of Sanctuary; twenty-four hours a day, I meditate onYou. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: too samrath saran kaa d aataa aath  pahar t umH Dhi-aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: That humble being, who vibrates upon You, O God, is not afflicted by anxiety.
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhajan karay parabh  tayraa t isai and aysaa naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.english: Attached to the Feet of the True Guru, his fear is dispelled, and within his mind, hesings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur charan lagay bh a-o miti-aa har gun gaa-ay man maahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He abides in celestial peace and utter ecstasy; the True Guru has comforted him.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ghanayray sat gur dee-aa d ilaasaa.

lines.english: He has returned home victorious, with honor, and his hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin gh ar aa-ay sobh aa sayt ee pooran ho-ee aasaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਤੁਮ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; Perfect are the actions of God.
lines.transliteration: pooraa gur pooree mat jaa kee pooran parabh  kay kaamaa.

lines.english: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, Nanak has crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||26||90|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (630-14) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur charnee laag tari-o bh av saagar jap naanak har har naamaa. ||4||26||90||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਤਸੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Becoming merciful, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor has Himself devised alldevices.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal d een d ukh bhanjan aapay sabh  biDh thaatee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਨ  ਲਗੇ ਭਉ ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In an instant, He has saved His humble servant; the Perfect Guru has cut away hisbonds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khin meh raakh  lee-o jan apunaa gur poorai bayrh ee kaatee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਲਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate forever on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur govind sad  Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਣ ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All illness shall depart from this body, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind'sdesires. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal kalays miteh is tan t ay man chind i-aa fal paa-ee-ai. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: God created all beings and creatures; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant jaa kay sabh  keenay parabh  oochaa agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਤਿਰਓ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his face is radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||27||91|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (630-18) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak naam Dh i-aa-i-aa mukh  oojal bh a-ay d arbaaraa. ||2||27||91||

lines.english: I meditate in remembrance on my Lord.
lines.transliteration: simra-o apunaa saaN-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰਪਾਲੁ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਥਾਟੀ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, I ever meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: dinas rain sad  Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਓ  ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He gave me His hand, and protected me.
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay jin raakh ay.

lines.english: I drink in the most sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1|| pMnw 631
lines.transliteration: har naam mahaa ras chaakhay. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.
lines.transliteration: apnay gur oopar kurbaan.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਤੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਹੋਏ ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: God, the Great Giver, the Perfect One, has become merciful to me, and now, all arekind to me. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal pooran parabh  daatay jee-a ho-ay miharvaan. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: naanak jan sarnaa-ee.

lines.english: He has perfectly preserved his honor.
lines.transliteration: jin pooran paij rakhaa-ee.

lines.english: All suffering has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: saglay dookh  mitaa-ee.

lines.english: So enjoy peace, O my Siblings of Destiny! ||2||28||92|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (631-3) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukh bh unchahu mayray bh aa-ee. ||2||28||92||

lines.english: Hear my prayer, O my Lord and Master; all beings and creatures were created by You.
lines.transliteration: sunhu binantee th aakur mayray jee-a jant  tayray Dh aaray.

lines.english: You preserve the honor of Your Name, O Lord, Cause of causes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raakh paij naam apunay kee karan karaavanhaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Dear God, Beloved, please, make me Your own.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee-o kh asmaanaa kar pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whether good or bad, I am Yours. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: buray bhalay ham thaaray. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Almighty Lord and Master heard my prayer; cutting away my bonds, He has adorned me.
lines.transliteration: sunee pukaar samrath su-aamee banDh an kaat savaaray.

lines.english: He dressed me in robes of honor, and blended His servant with Himself; Nanak isrevealed in glory throughout the world. ||2||29||93|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (631-6) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pahir sirpaa-o sayvak jan maylay naanak pargat pahaaray. ||2||29||93||

lines.english: All beings and creatures are subservient to all those who serve in the Lord's Court.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  vas kar d eenay sayvak sabh  darbaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Their God made them His own, and carried them across the terrifying world-ocean.||1||
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-o parabh apunay bh av niDh  paar ut aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਿਰ  ਿਸਰਪਾਉ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਪਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He resolves all the affairs of His Saints.
lines.transliteration: santan kay kaaraj sagal savaaray.

lines.english: He is merciful to the meek, kind and compassionate, the ocean of kindness, myPerfect Lord and Master. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaal kirpaa niDh  pooran kh asam hamaaray. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am asked to come and be seated, everywhere I go, and I lack nothing.
lines.transliteration: aa-o baith aad ar sabh  thaa-ee oon na kat ahooN baataa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਵਿਸ ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਿਭ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord blesses His humble devotee with robes of honor; O Nanak, the Glory of Godis manifest. ||2||30||94|| soriT mhlw 9  (631-10) sorath mehlaa 9 Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (631-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sirpaa-o d ee-o jan apunay part aap naanak parabh  jaataa. ||2||30||94||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਭਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mind, love the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ray man raam si-o kar pareet.

lines.english: With your ears, hear the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and with your tongue, sing His song. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarvan gobind gun sun-o ar gaa-o rasnaa geet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate in remembrance onthe Lord; even a sinner like yourself will become pure.
lines.transliteration: kar saaDhsangat  simar maaDh o hohi pat it puneet .

lines.english: Death is on the prowl, with its mouth wide open, friend. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaal bi-aal ji-o pari-o dolai mukh pasaaray meet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਉ  ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in yourconsciousness.
lines.transliteration: aaj kaal fun tohi garas hai samajh  raakh a-o cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਸਰਪਾਉ  ਦੀਓ  ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥੨॥੩੦॥੯੪॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord; this opportunity is slipping away!||2||1|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (631-14) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak raam bhaj lai jaat  a-osar beet . ||2||1||

lines.english: The mind remains in the mind.
lines.transliteration: man kee man hee maahi rahee.

lines.english: He does not meditate on the Lord, nor does he perform service at sacred shrines, and so death seizes him by the hair. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naa har bhajay na t irath sayvay chotee kaal gahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ  ਅਰੁ ਗਾਉ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wife, friends, children, carriages, property, total wealth, the entire world
lines.transliteration: daaraa meet  poot rath sampat  Dhan pooran sabh  mahee.
avar sagal mithi-aa ay jaan-o bhajan raam ko sahee. ||1|| - know that all of these things are false. The Lord's meditation alone is true. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਸਮਰੁ ਮਾਧੋ ਹੋਿਹ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering, wandering around for so many ages, he has grown weary, and finally, heobtained this human body.
lines.transliteration: firat firat  bahut ay jug haari-o maanas d ayh lahee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਬਆਲੁ  ਿਜਉ ਪਿਰਓ  ਡੋਲੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ  ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this is the opportunity to meet the Lord; why don't you remember Him inmeditation? ||2||2|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (631-17) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat milan kee baree-aa simrat  kahaa nahee. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਫੁਿਨ ਤੋਿਹ ਗਰ੍ਿਸ  ਹੈ ਸਮਿਝ  ਰਾਖਉ  ਚੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, what evil-mindedness have you developed?
lines.transliteration: man ray ka-un kumat t ai leenee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਰਾਮੁ ਭਿਜ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ  ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: You are engrossed in the pleasures of other men's wives, and slander; you have notworshipped the Lord at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: par daaraa nind i-aa ras rachi-o raam bh agat neh keenee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You do not know the way to liberation, but you run all around chasing wealth. pMnw 632
lines.transliteration: mukat panth jaani-o t ai naahan Dh an joran ka-o Dh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the end, nothing shall go along with you; you have entrapped yourself in vain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ant sang kaahoo nahee d eenaa birthaa aap banDh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਸੰਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਨਾ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਬੰਧਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have not meditated or vibrated upon the Lord; you have not served the Guru, or His humble servants; spiritual wisdom has not welled up within you.
lines.transliteration: naa har bhaji-o na gur jan sayvi-o nah upji-o kachh  gi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਿਜਓ  ਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਨਹ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਕਛੁ ਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord is within your heart, and yet you search for Him in thewilderness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghat hee maahi niranjan t ayrai t ai khojat udi-aanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੈ ਖੋਜਤ  ਉਿਦਆਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You have wandered through many many births; you are exhausted but have still notfound a way out of this endless cycle.
lines.transliteration: bahut janam bh armat  tai haari-o asthir mat  nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ  ਤੈ ਹਾਿਰਓ  ਅਸਿਥਰ  ਮਿਤ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Now that you have obtained this human body, meditate on the Lord's Feet; Nanakadvises with this advice. ||3||3|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (632-4) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maanas dayh paa-ay pad  har bh aj naanak baat  bataa-ee. ||3||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸ  ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ  ਪਦ ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.english: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.
lines.transliteration: man ray parabh kee saran bichaaro.

lines.english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine HisPraises within your heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jih simrat gankaa see uDh ree taa ko jas ur Dh aaro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.
lines.transliteration: atal bha-i-o Dh aroo-a jaa kai simran ar nirbh ai pad  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਗਨਕਾ  ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him?||1||
lines.transliteration: dukh hartaa ih biDh  ko su-aamee t ai kaahay bisraa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean ofmercy, he escaped from the crocodile.
lines.transliteration: jab hee saran gahee kirpaa niDh gaj garaah t ay chh ootaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਟਲ  ਭਇਓ  ਧਰ੍ੂਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰਿਨ  ਅਰੁ ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants theLord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mahmaa naam kahaa la-o barna-o raam kahat banDh an tih tootaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਿਬਸਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.
lines.transliteration: ajaamal paapee jag jaanay nimakh maahi nist aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਗਹੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ  ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and youtoo shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (632-8) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat chayt  chint aaman t ai bhee utreh paaraa. ||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਮਾ  ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ  ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਿਤਹ ਤੂਟਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: What efforts should the mortal make,
lines.transliteration: paraanee ka-un upaa-o karai.
jaa tay bh agat raam kee paavai jam ko t araas harai. ||1|| rahaa-o. to attain devotional worship of the Lord, and eradicate the fear of death? ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਹਤ  ਚੇਤ ਿਚੰਤਾਮਿਨ  ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਿਹ  ਪਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: Which actions, what sort of knowledge, and what religion - what Dharma should one practice?
lines.transliteration: ka-un karam bidi-aa kaho kaisee Dh aram ka-un fun kar-ee.

lines.english: What Name of the Guru should one remember in meditation, to cross over theterrifying world-ocean? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ka-un naam gur jaa kai simrai bhav saagar ka-o t ar-ee. ||1||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the One Lord is the treasure of mercy;chanting it, one obtains salvation.
lines.transliteration: kal mai ayk naam kirpaa niDh jaahi japai gat  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤਰ੍ਾਸੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No other religion is comparable to this; so speak the Vedas. ||2||
lines.transliteration: a-or Dharam t aa kai sam naahan ih biDh  bayd  bataavai. ||2||

lines.english: He is beyond pain and pleasure, forever unattached; He is called the Lord of theworld.
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh rahat  sadaa nirlaypee jaa ka-o kahat  gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਿਬਿਦਆ  ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਉਨੁ ਫੁਿਨ ਕਰਈ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells deep within your inner self, O Nanak, like the image in a mirror. ||3||5|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (632-13) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so tum hee meh basai nirant ar naanak d arpan ni-aa-ee. ||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ  ਕਉ ਤਰਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mother, how can I see the Lord of the world?
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mai kihi biDh lakh a-o gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਜਪੈ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In the utter darkness of emotional attachment and spiritual ignorance, my mindremains entangled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mahaa moh agi-aan timar mo man rahi-o urjh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਰ  ਧਰਮ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਿਨ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, I have wasted my whole life; I have not obtained a stable intellect.
lines.transliteration: sagal janam bharam hee bh aram kh o-i-o nah asthir mat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹਤ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਲੇਪੀ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I remain under the influence of corrupting sins, night and day, and I have not renounced wickedness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aaskat  rahi-o nis baasur nah chh ootee aDh maa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਬਸੈ ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਪਿਨ  ਿਨਆਈ  ॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: I never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and I did not sing theKirtan of God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang kabhoo nahee keenaa nah keerat  parabh  gaa-ee.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (632-17) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mai naahi ko-oo gun raakh layho sarnaa-ee. ||2||6||

lines.english: O mother, my mind is out of control.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee man mayro bas naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅਿਗਆਿਨ  ਿਤਮਿਰ  ਮੋ ਮਨੁ ਰਿਹਓ  ਉਰਝਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, it runs after sin and corruption. How can I restrain it? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nis baasur bikhi-an ka-o Dh aavat  kihi biDh  roka-o t aahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He listens to the teachings of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, but he doesnot enshrine them in his heart, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  kay mat  sun nimakh  na hee-ay basaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜਨਮ  ਭਰਮ  ਹੀ ਭਰਮ  ਖੋਇਓ  ਨਹ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਮਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Engrossed in the wealth and women of others, his life passes away uselessly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: par Dhan par d aaraa si-o rachi-o birthaa janam siraavai. ||1||

lines.english: He has gone insane with the wine of Maya, and does not understand even a bit of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: mad maa-i-aa kai bh a-i-o baavro soojh at nah kachh  gi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ  ਨਹ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within his heart, the Immaculate Lord dwells, but he does not know this secret. ||2|| pMnw 633
lines.transliteration: ghat hee bh eetar basat  niranjan t aa ko maram na jaanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਬਸਤ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When I came to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, all my evil-mindedness was dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jab hee saran saaDh kee aa-i-o d urmat  sagal binaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਆਇਓ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਗਲ ਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Then, O Nanak, I remembered the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires,and the noose of Death was snapped. ||3||7|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (633-2) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tab naanak chayt i-o chint aaman kaatee jam kee faasee. ||3||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਨਾਨਕ  ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਿਚੰਤਾਮਿਨ  ਕਾਟੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.english: O man, grasp this Truth firmly in your soul.
lines.transliteration: ray nar ih saachee jee-a Dhaar.

lines.english: The whole world is just like a dream; it will pass away in an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal jagat hai jaisay supnaa binsat  lagat  na baar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ  ਜੀਅ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Like a wall of sand, built up and plastered with great care, which does not last even afew days,
lines.transliteration: baaroo bheet  banaa-ee rach pach rahat  nahee d in chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਿਬਨਸਤ  ਲਗਤ  ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taisay hee ih sukh  maa-i-aa kay urjh i-o kahaa gavaar. ||1|| just so are the pleasures of Maya. Why are you entangled in them, you ignorant fool?
