lines.english: Understand this today - it is not yet too late! Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ajhoo samajh kachh  bigri-o naahin bh aj lay naam muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰੂ ਭੀਿਤ ਬਨਾਈ  ਰਿਚ ਪਿਚ ਰਹਤ  ਨਹੀ ਿਦਨ  ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this is the subtle wisdom of the Holy Saints, which I proclaim out loud toyou. ||2||8|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (633-6) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nij mat saaDh an ka-o bh aakhi-o tohi pukaar. ||2||8||

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਉਰਿਝਓ  ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this world, I have not found any true friend.
lines.transliteration: ih jag meet na d aykhi-o ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਹੂ ਸਮਿਝ  ਕਛੁ ਿਬਗਿਰਓ  ਨਾਿਹਿਨ  ਭਿਜ ਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The whole world is attached to its own pleasures, and when trouble comes, no one iswith you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal jagat apnai sukh  laagi-o d ukh mai sang na ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਜ ਮਤੁ ਸਾਧਨ  ਕਉ ਭਾਿਖਓ ਤੋਿਹ ਪੁਕਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੮॥
lines.english: Wives, friends, children and relatives - all are attached to wealth.
lines.transliteration: daaraa meet  poot sanbanDh ee sagray Dh an si-o laagay.

lines.english: When they see a poor man, they all forsake his company and run away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jab hee nirDhan d aykhi-o nar ka-o sang chh aad sabh  bhaagay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਜਿਗ  ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: So what should I say to this crazy mind, which is affectionately attached to them?
lines.transliteration: kahooN kahaa yi-aa man ba-uray ka-o in si-o nayhu lagaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਅਪਨੈ  ਸੁਿਖ ਲਾਿਗਓ  ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Master of the meek, the Destroyer of all fears, and I have forgotten to praise Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath sakal bh ai bhanjan jas t aa ko bisraa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: Like a dog's tail, which will never straighten out, the mind will not change, no matterhow many things are tried.
lines.transliteration: su-aan poochh ji-o bh a-i-o na sooDh a-o bahut  jatan mai keen-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਰਾ  ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ  ਸਗਰੇ  ਧਨ ਿਸਉ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, please, Lord, uphold the honor of Your innate nature; I chant YourName. ||3||9|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (633-11) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laaj birad kee raakh o naam t uhaara-o leen-o. ||3||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਿਨਰਧਨ  ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਨਰ ਕਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਿਡ  ਸਭ ਭਾਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mind, you have not accepted the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: man ray gahi-o na gur updays.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਂਉ  ਕਹਾ ਿਯਆ  ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ  ਕਉ ਇਨ ਿਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: What is the use of shaving your head, and wearing saffron robes? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kahaa bha-i-o ja-o mood mud aa-i-o bh agva-o keeno bh ays. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਸਕਲ  ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ  ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਿਬਸਰਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Abandoning Truth, you cling to falsehood; your life is uselessly wasting away.
lines.transliteration: saach chhaad kai jh oothah laagi-o janam akaarath kh o-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਆਨ  ਪੂਛ ਿਜਉ  ਭਇਓ  ਨ ਸੂਧਉ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਨਉ  ॥
lines.english: Practicing hypocrisy, you fill your belly, and then sleep like an animal. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar parpanch udar nij pokh i-o pas kee ni-aa-ee so-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਾਜ  ਿਬਰਦ  ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਉ  ਲੀਨਉ  ॥੩॥੯॥
lines.english: You do not know the Way of the Lord's meditation; you have sold yourself into Maya'shands.
lines.transliteration: raam bhajan kee gat  nahee jaanee maa-i-aa haath bikaanaa.

lines.english: The madman remains entangled in vice and corruption; he has forgotten the jewel of the Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: urajh rahi-o bikh i-an sang ba-uraa naam rat an bisraanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗਿਹਓ  ਨ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: He remains thoughtless, not thinking of the Lord of the Universe; his life is uselesslypassing away.
lines.transliteration: rahi-o achayt na chayt i-o gobind  birthaa a-oDh  siraanee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ  ਜਉ ਮੂਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇਓ  ਭਗਵਉ  ਕੀਨੋ  ਭੇਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O Lord, please, confirm your innate nature; this mortal is continuallymaking mistakes. ||3||10|| soriT mhlw 9 ] (633-15) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har birad pachh aana-o bh oolay sad aa paraanee. ||3||10||

lines.english: That man, who in the midst of pain, does not feel pain,
lines.transliteration: jo nar dukh  mai d ukh nahee maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਛਾਿਡ  ਕੈ ਝੂਠਹ  ਲਾਿਗਓ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਕਾਰਥੁ  ਖੋਇਓ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sanayhu ar bh ai nahee jaa kai kanchan maatee maanai. ||1|| rahaa-o. who is not affected by pleasure, affection or fear, and who looks alike upon gold anddust;||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਪਰਪੰਚ  ਉਦਰ  ਿਨਜ ਪੋਿਖਓ ਪਸੁ ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਸੋਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Who is not swayed by either slander or praise, nor affected by greed, attachment orpride;
lines.transliteration: nah nindi-aa nah ust at jaa kai lobh  moh abh imaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਿਬਕਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog t ay rahai ni-aara-o naahi maan apmaanaa. ||1|| who remains unaffected by joy and sorrow, honor and dishonor;||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਿਝ  ਰਿਹਓ ਿਬਿਖਅਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਉਰਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਿਬਸਰਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa sagal ti-aagai jag t ay rahai niraasaa. who renounces all hopes and desires and remains desireless in the world;

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਹਓ  ਅਚੇਤੁ  ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਅਉਧ ਿਸਰਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh jih parsai naahan t ih ghat barahm nivaasaa. ||2|| who is not touched by sexual desire or anger - within his heart, God dwells. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਪਛਾਨਉ  ਭੂਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥੧੦॥
lines.english: That man, blessed by Guru's Grace, understands this way.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa jih nar ka-o keenee tih ih jugat  pachh aanee.

lines.english: O Nanak, he merges with the Lord of the Universe, like water with water. ||3||11|| pMnw 634 soriT mhlw 9 ] (634-1) sorath mehlaa 9. Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak leen bha-i-o gobind  si-o ji-o paanee sang paanee. ||3||11||

lines.english: O dear friend, know this in your mind.
lines.transliteration: pareetam jaan layho man maahee.

lines.english: The world is entangled in its own pleasures; no one is for anyone else. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: apnay sukh si-o hee jag faaNDhi-o ko kaahoo ko naahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In good times, many come and sit together, surrounding you on all four sides.
lines.transliteration: sukh mai aan bahut  mil baith at rahat  chahoo d is ghayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਸੁਖ ਿਸਉ ਹੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਧਓ  ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But when hard times come, they all leave, and no one comes near you. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bipat paree sabh  hee sang chh aadit ko-oo na aavat  nayrai. ||1||

lines.english: Your wife, whom you love so much, and who has remained ever attached to you,
lines.transliteration: ghar kee naar bahut  hit jaa si-o sad aa rahat  sang laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਆਿਨ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਰਹਤ  ਚਹੂ ਿਦਿਸ  ਘੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab hee hans tajee ih kaaN-i-aa parayt  parayt  kar bh aagee. ||2|| runs away crying, "Ghost! Ghost!", as soon as the swan-soul leaves this body. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਪਿਤ  ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਿਡਤ  ਕੋਊ ਨ ਆਵਤ  ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is the way they act - those whom we love so much.
lines.transliteration: ih biDh ko bi-uhaar bani-o hai jaa si-o nayhu lagaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਹਤੁ ਜਾ ਿਸਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਤ  ਸੰਗ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, O Nanak, no one is any use at all, except the Dear Lord. ||3||12||139|| soriT mhlw 1 Gru 1 AstpdIAw cauqukI  (634-7) sorath mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 asatpad ee-aa cha-ut ukee Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Ashtapadees, Chau-Tukas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (634-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ant baar naanak bin har jee ko-oo kaam na aa-i-o. ||3||12||139||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੰਸ ਤਜੀ  ਇਹ ਕਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ੇਤ ਪਰ੍ੇਤ ਕਿਰ ਭਾਗੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am not torn by duality, because I do not worship any other than the Lord; I do notvisit tombs or crematoriums.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa na parh a-o har bin hor na pooja-o marh ai masaan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੋ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਓ  ਹੈ ਜਾ  ਿਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: I do not enter the houses of strangers, engrossed in desire. The Naam, the Name ofthe Lord, has satisfied my desires.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa raach na par gh ar jaavaa t arisnaa naam bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੯॥
lines.english: Deep within my heart, the Guru has shown me the home of my being, and my mind isimbued with peace and poise, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: ghar bh eetar ghar guroo d ikhaa-i-aa sahj rat ay man bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਚਉਤੁਕੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are all-knowing, and You Yourself are all-seeing; You alone bestowintelligence, O Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too aapay d aanaa aapay beenaa t oo dayveh mat  saa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਨ ਪੜਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਉ  ਮੜੈ ਮਸਾਿਣ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is detached, imbued with detachment; the Word of the Shabad has pierced my mind, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: man bairaag rata-o bairaagee sabad  man bayDh i-aa mayree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਰਾਿਚ  ਨ ਪਰ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਵਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਨਾਿਮ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: God's Light shines continually within the nucleus of my deepest self; I am lovinglyattached to the Bani, the Word of the True Lord Master. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: antar jot  nirant ar ban ee saachay saahib si-o liv laa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਘਰੁ ਗੁ ਰੂ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Countless detached renunciates talk of detachment and renunciation, but he alone is atrue renunciate, who is pleasing to the Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh bairaagee kaheh bairaag so bairaagee je kh asmai bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਤੂ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਮਿਤ ਸਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is ever in his heart; he is absorbed in the Fear of God, andhe works to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: hirdai sabad  sadaa bh ai rachi-aa gur kee kaar kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਿਗ  ਰਤਉ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He remembers the One Lord, his mind does not waver, and he restrains itswanderings.
lines.transliteration: ayko chaytai manoo-aa na dolai Dh aavat  varaj rahaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and is ever imbued with the Lord's Love; he singsthe Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sehjay maataa sad aa rang raat aa saachay kay gun  gaavai. ||2||

lines.english: The mind is like the wind, but if it comes to rest in peace, even for an instant, then heshall abide in the peace of the Name, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa pa-un bind  sukh vaasee naam vasai sukh  bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸੰਖ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਕਹਿਹ  ਬੈਰਾਗ  ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਜ ਖਸਮੈ  ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: His tongue, eyes and ears are imbued with Truth; O Lord, You quench the fires ofdesire.
lines.transliteration: jihbaa naytar sot ar sach raat ay jal boojh ee tujheh bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਭੈ ਰਿਚਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: In hope, the renunciate remains free of hopes; in the home of his own inner self, he is absorbed in the trance of deep meditation.
lines.transliteration: aas niraas rahai bairaagee nij ghar t aarhee laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਵਰਿਜ ਰਹਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He remains content, satisfied with the charity of the Naam; he drinks in the AmbrosialAmrit with ease. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhikh i-aa naam rajay sant okhee amrit  sahj pee-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There is no renunciation in duality, as long as there is even a particle of duality.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa vich bairaag na hovee jab lag d oojee raa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਪਉਣੁ  ਿਬੰਦੁ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The whole world is Yours, Lord; You alone are the Giver. There is not any other, OSiblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag t ayraa t oo ayko d aataa avar na d oojaa bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਬਾ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਸੋਤਰ੍ ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਿਲ  ਬੂਝੀ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh dwells in misery forever, while the Lord bestows greatnessupon the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: manmukh jant  dukh sadaa nivaasee gurmukh  day vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਿਨਰਾਸ  ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: God is infinite, endless, inaccessible and unfathomable; His worth cannot bedescribed. ||4||
lines.transliteration: apar apaar agamm agochar kahnai keem na paa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਜੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਪੀਆਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The consciousness in deep Samaadhi, the Supreme Being, the Lord of the threeworlds - these are Your Names, Lord.
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh mahaa parmaarath t een bh avan pat naamaN.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੂਜੀ  ਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The creatures born into this world have their destiny inscribed upon their foreheads;they experience according to their destinies.
lines.transliteration: mastak laykh  jee-aa jag jonee sir sir laykh  sahaamaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself causes them to do good and bad deeds; He Himself makes them steadfast in devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: karam sukaram karaa-ay aapay aapay bhagat  darirh-aam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਜੰਤ ਦੁਿਖ ਸਦਾ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of their mind and mouth is washed off when they live in the Fear of God; theinaccessible Lord Himself blesses them with spiritual wisdom. ||5|| pMnw 635
lines.transliteration: man mukh jooth  lahai bh ai maanaN aapay gi-aan agaamaN. ||5||

lines.english: Only those who taste it know its sweet taste, like the mute, who eats the candy, and only smiles.
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhi-aa say-ee saad  jaanan ji-o gungay mith i-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥੈ  ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਥੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਚਾਲਉ  ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: How can I describe the indescribable, O Siblings of Destiny? I shall follow His Willforever.
lines.transliteration: akthai kaa ki-aa kathee-ai bhaa-ee chaala-o sad aa rajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਨਗੁਰੇ  ਮਿਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: If one meets with the Guru, the Generous Giver, then he understands; those whohave no Guru cannot understand this.
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa maylay t aa mat  hovai niguray mat  na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਚਲਾਏ  ਿਤਉ  ਚਾਲਹ  ਭਾਈ  ਹੋਰ ਿਕਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: As the Lord causes us to act, so do we act, O Siblings of Destiny. What other clevertricks can anyone try? ||6||
lines.transliteration: ji-o chalaa-ay ti-o chaalah bh aa-ee hor ki-aa ko karay chat uraa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਇਿਕ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some are deluded by doubt, while others are imbued with devotional worship; Yourplay is infinite and endless.
lines.transliteration: ik bharam bh ulaa-ay ik bh agtee raat ay tayraa kh ayl apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਤੁਧੁ ਲਾਏ  ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੂ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਚਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: As You engage them, they receive the fruits of their rewards; You alone are the One who issues Your Commands.
lines.transliteration: jit tuDh laa-ay t ayhaa fal paa-i-aa t oo hukam chalaavan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਅਪਣਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I would serve You, if anything were my own; my soul and body are Yours.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa karee jay kichh hovai apn aa jee-o pind t umaaraa.

lines.english: One who meets with the True Guru, by His Grace, takes the Support of the AmbrosialNaam. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai kirpaa keenee amrit  naam aDh aaraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗਗਨੰਤਿਰ  ਵਾਿਸਆ  ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells in the heavenly realms, and his virtues radiantly shine forth; meditation andspiritual wisdom are found in virtue.
lines.transliteration: gagnantar vaasi-aa gun  pargaasi-aa gun  meh gi-aan Dh i-aanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is pleasing to his mind; he speaks it, and causes others to speak it as well.He speaks the essential essence of wisdom.
lines.transliteration: naam man bhaavai kahai kahaavai t ato tat vakh aanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is his Guru and spiritual teacher, profound andunfathomable; without the Shabad, the world is insane.
lines.transliteration: sabad gur peeraa gahir gambh eeraa bin sabd ai jag ba-uraanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਗੀ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: He is a perfect renunciate, naturally at ease, O Nanak, whose mind is pleased with theTrue Lord. ||8||1|| soriT mhlw 1 iqqukI ] (635-7) sorath mehlaa 1 t itukee. Sorat'h, First Mehl, Ti-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: pooraa bairaagee sahj subhaagee sach naanak man maanaN. ||8||1||

lines.english: Hope and desire are entrapments, O Siblings of Destiny. Religious rituals and ceremonies are traps.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa banDhnee bh aa-ee karam Dh aram banDh kaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਬੰਧਨੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਬੰਧਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Because of good and bad deeds, one is born into the world, O Siblings of Destiny;forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is ruined.
lines.transliteration: paap punn jag jaa-i-aa bhaa-ee binsai naam visaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਿਪ  ਪੁੰਿਨ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਬਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: This Maya is the enticer of the world, O Siblings of Destiny; all such actions arecorrupt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih maa-i-aa jag mohnee bh aa-ee karam sabh ay vaykaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਿਗ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਕਰਮ  ਸਭੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listen, O ritualistic Pandit:
lines.transliteration: sun pandit  karmaa kaaree.
jit karam sukh  oopjai bh aa-ee so aat am tat beechaaree. rahaa-o. that religious ritual which produces happiness, O Siblings of Destiny, is contemplationof the essence of the soul. ||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਕਰਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੁ ਆਤਮ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You may stand and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny, butthese are just worldly actions.
lines.transliteration: saasat bayd  bakai kh arho bhaa-ee karam karahu sansaaree.

lines.english: Filth cannot be washed away by hypocrisy, O Siblings of Destiny; the filth ofcorruption and sin is within you.
lines.transliteration: pakhand mail na chook-ee bh aa-ee ant ar mail vikaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤੁ  ਬੇਦੁ ਬਕੈ ਖੜੋ ਭਾਈ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: This is how the spider is destroyed, O Siblings of Destiny, by falling head-long in itsown web. ||2||
lines.transliteration: in biDh doobee maakuree bh aa-ee ooNdee sir kai bh aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ  ਭਾਈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: So many are destroyed by their own evil-mindedness, O Siblings of Destiny; in the love of duality, they are ruined.
lines.transliteration: durmat  ghanee vigoot ee bh aa-ee d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਡੂਬੀ ਮਾਕੁਰੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਊਂਡੀ  ਿਸਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; without theName, doubt does not depart.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur naam na paa-ee-ai bh aa-ee bin naamai bh aram na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਘਣੀ  ਿਵਗੂਤੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: If one serves the True Guru, then he obtains peace, O Siblings of Destiny; his comingsand goings are ended. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa sukh  paa-ay bh aa-ee aavan  jaan rahaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਭਾਈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: True celestial peace comes from the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; the immaculate mindis absorbed into the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saach sahj gur tay oopjai bh aa-ee man nirmal saach samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਈ  ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਰਹਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who serves the Guru, understands, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Guru, theway is not found.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvay so boojhai bh aa-ee gur bin mag na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: What can anyone do, with greed within? O Siblings of Destiny, by telling lies, they eat poison. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jis antar lobh  ke karam kamaavai bh aa-ee koorh  bol bikh  khaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Pandit, by churning cream, butter is produced.
lines.transliteration: pandit d ahee vilo-ee-ai bh aa-ee vichahu niklai t ath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਿਕ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By churning water, you shall only see water, O Siblings of Destiny; this world is likethat.
lines.transliteration: jal mathee-ai jal daykh ee-ai bh aa-ee ih jag ayhaa vath.

lines.english: Without the Guru, he is ruined by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; the unseen Divine Lord is in each and every heart. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur bin bharam vigoochee-ai bh aa-ee gh at ghat day-o alakh . ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲੁ ਮਥੀਐ  ਜਲੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.english: This world is like a thread of cotton, O Siblings of Destiny, which Maya has tied on allten sides.
lines.transliteration: ih jag taago soot  ko bh aa-ee d ah dis baaDh o maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਿਵਗੂਚੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the knots cannot be untied, O Siblings of Destiny; I am so tired ofreligious rituals.
lines.transliteration: bin gur gaath na chh oot-ee bh aa-ee thaakay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਾਗੋ  ਸੂਤ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ  ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਬਾਧੋ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This world is deluded by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; no one can say anything aboutit. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ih jag bharam bh ulaa-i-aa bh aa-ee kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਿਠ  ਨ ਛੂਟਈ ਭਾਈ  ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the Fear of God comes to abide in the mind; to die in the Fearof God is one's true destiny.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai bha-o man vasai bh aa-ee bh ai marn aa sach laykh .

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, the Naam is far superior to ritualistic cleansing baths, charity and good deeds, O Siblings of Destiny. pMnw 636
lines.transliteration: majan daan chang-aa-ee-aa bh aa-ee d argeh naam visaykh .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਭੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: One who implants the Naam within himself, through the Guru's halter - O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord dwells in his mind, and he is free of hypocrisy. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur ankas jin naam drirh-aa-i-aa bh aa-ee man vasi-aa chookaa bh aykh. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਰਾਫ  ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: This body is the jeweller's shop, O Siblings of Destiny; the incomparable Naam is the merchandise.
lines.transliteration: ih tan haat saraaf ko bh aa-ee vakh ar naam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਸੋ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੈ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The merchant secures this merchandise, O Siblings of Destiny, by contemplating theWord of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ih vakhar vaapaaree so d arirhai bhaa-ee gur sabad  karay veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਾਈ  ਮੇਿਲ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhan vaapaaree naankaa bh aa-ee mayl karay vaapaar. ||8||2|| Blessed is the merchant, O Nanak, who meets the Guru, and engages in this trade.||8||2|| soriT mhlw 1 ] (636-3) sorath mehlaa 1. Sorat'h, First Mehl:
Those who serve the True Guru, O Beloved, their companions are saved as well.
lines.transliteration: jinHee satgur sayvi-aa pi-aaray t inH kay saath t aray.

lines.english: No one blocks their way, O Beloved, and the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is on theirtongue.
lines.transliteration: tinHaa thaak na paa-ee-ai pi-aaray amrit  rasan haray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸਨ  ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Fear of God, they are so heavy that they sink and drown, O Beloved; butthe Lord, casting His Glance of Grace, carries them across. ||1||
lines.transliteration: booday bhaaray bh ai binaa pi-aaray t aaray nad ar karay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਰੇ ਭੈ ਿਬਨਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤਾਰੇ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I ever praise You, O Beloved, I ever sing Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: bhee t oohai salaahn aa pi-aaray bh ee tayree saalaah.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: Without the boat, one is drowned in the sea of fear, O Beloved; how can I reach the distant shore? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vin bohith bh ai dubee-ai pi-aaray kanDh ee paa-ay kahaah. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਬੋਿਹਥ  ਭੈ ਡੁਬੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਇ  ਕਹਾਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, O Beloved; there is no other one to praise.
lines.transliteration: saalaahee salaahnaa pi-aaray d oojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: Those who praise my God are good, O Beloved; they are imbued with the Word of theShabad, and His Love.
lines.transliteration: mayray parabh saalaahan say bh alay pi-aaray sabad  ratay rang ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If I join them, O Beloved, I can churn the essence and so find joy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tis kee sangat  jay milai pi-aaray ras lai t at vilo-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਨ  ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਬਿਦ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The gateway to honor is Truth, O Beloved; it bears the Insignia of the True Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: pat parvaanaa saach kaa pi-aaray naam sachaa neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਿਵਲੋਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: We come into the world, and we depart, with our destiny written and pre-ordained, OBeloved; realize the Command of the Commander.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa likh lai jaavn aa pi-aaray hukmee hukam pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ  ਸਾਚ ਕਾ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, this Command is not understood, O Beloved; True is the Power ofthe True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur bin hukam na boojhee-ai pi-aaray saachay saachaa t aan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command, we are conceived, O Beloved, and by His Command, we grow in thewomb.
lines.transliteration: hukmai andar nimmi-aa pi-aaray hukmai ud ar majh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ  ਤਾਣੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By His Command, we are born, O Beloved, head-first, and upside-down.
lines.transliteration: hukmai andar jammi-aa pi-aaray ooDh a-o sir kai bh aar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord, O Beloved; he departs after resolving his affairs. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d argeh jaan ee-ai pi-aaray chalai kaaraj saar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਜੰਿਮਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਊਧਉ  ਿਸਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command, one comes into the world, O Beloved, and by His Will, he goes.
lines.transliteration: hukmai andar aa-i-aa pi-aaray hukmay jaad o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By His Will, some are bound and gagged and driven away, O Beloved; the self-willedmanmukhs suffer their punishment.
lines.transliteration: hukmay baneh chalaa-ee-ai pi-aaray manmukh lahai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਦੋ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command, the Word of the Shabad, is realized, O Beloved, and one goes to theCourt of the Lord robed in honor. ||5||
lines.transliteration: hukmay sabad pachh aanee-ai pi-aaray d argeh paiDh aa jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੰਿਨ ਚਲਾਈਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command, some accounts are accounted for, O Beloved; by His Command,some suffer in egotism and duality.
lines.transliteration: hukmay ganat  ganaa-ee-ai pi-aaray hukmay ha-umai d o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: By His Command, one wanders in reincarnation, O Beloved; deceived by sins anddemerits, he cries out in his suffering.
lines.transliteration: hukmay bhavai bh avaa-ee-ai pi-aaray avgan  muth ee ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਗਣਤ  ਗਣਾਈਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If he comes to realize the Command of the Lord's Will, O Beloved, then he is blessedwith Truth and Honor. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hukam sinjaapai saah kaa pi-aaray sach milai vadi-aa-ee ho-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: It is so difficult to speak it, O Beloved; how can we speak, and hear, the True Name?
lines.transliteration: aakhan  a-ukh aa aakh ee-ai pi-aaray ki-o sun ee-ai sach naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਿਸਞਾਪੈ  ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord, O Beloved.
lines.transliteration: jinHee so salaahi-aa pi-aaray ha-o tinH balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਿਣ  ਅਉਖਾ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Name, and I am satisfied, O Beloved; by His Grace, I am united in His Union. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naa-o milai santokh ee-aaN pi-aaray nad ree mayl milaa-o. ||7||

lines.english: If my body were to become the paper, O Beloved, and my mind the inkpot;
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kaagad jay thee-ai pi-aaray man masvaan ee Dh aar.
laltaa laykh an sach kee pi-aaray har gun  likhahu veechaar. and if my tongue became the pen, O Beloved, I would write, and contemplate, theGlorious Praises of the True Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਜੇ ਥੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan laykh aaree naankaa pi-aaray saach likh ai ur Dh aar. ||8||3|| Blessed is that scribe, O Nanak, who writes the True Name, and enshrines it within hisheart. ||8||3|| soriT mhlw 1 pihlw duqukI ] (636-17) sorath mehlaa 1 pahilaa d utukee. Sorat'h, First Mehl, Du-Tukas:

lines.punjabi: ਲਲਤਾ  ਲੇਖਿਣ  ਸਚ ਕੀ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਲਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord, but my mind is not immaculate, OSiblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: too gund aatou nirmalo bh aa-ee nirmal naa man ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਲਖੈ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a worthless sinner, O Siblings of Destiny; virtue is obtained from You alone,Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham apraaDhee nirgun ay bh aa-ee t ujh hee t ay gun  so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my Beloved Creator Lord, You create, and You behold.
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetamaa t oo kart aa kar vaykh .

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤੌ  ਿਨਰਮਲੋ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I am a hypocritical sinner, O Siblings of Destiny. Bless my mind and body with Your Name, O Lord. ||Pause|| pMnw 637
lines.transliteration: ha-o paapee paakhandee-aa bh aa-ee man t an naam visaykh . rahaa-o.

lines.english: The poisonous Maya has enticed the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny; through clever tricks, one loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: bikh maa-i-aa chit  mohi-aa bh aa-ee chat uraa-ee pat  kho-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord and Master abides in the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny, if theGuru's spiritual wisdom permeates it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chit meh th aakur sach vasai bh aa-ee jay gur gi-aan samo-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Beautiful, beautiful, the Lord is called, O Siblings of Destiny; beautiful, like the deepcrimson color of the poppy.
lines.transliteration: roorhou roorh ou aakh ee-ai bh aa-ee roorh ou laal chalool.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤ  ਮਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਿਚ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ  ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਮੋਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If man loves the Lord with detachment, O Siblings of Destiny, he is judged to be trueand infallible in the Lord's court and home. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay man har si-o bairaagee-ai bhaa-ee d ar ghar saach abh ool. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂੜੌ ਰੂੜੌ ਆਖੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਰੂੜੌ ਲਾਲ  ਚਲੂਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: You are pervading the realms of the underworld and the heavenly skies; Your wisdomand glories are in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: paataalee aakaas t oo bh aa-ee gh ar ghar too gun  gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਐ ਭਾਈ  ਦਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਸਾਚੁ ਅਭੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, one finds peace, O Siblings of Destiny, and pride is dispelled from the mind. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai sukh paa-i-aa bh aa-ee chookaa manhu gumaan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ  ਆਕਾਿਸ  ਤੂ ਭਾਈ  ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Scrubbing with water, the body can be cleaned, O Siblings of Destiny, but the bodybecomes dirty again.
lines.transliteration: jal mal kaa-i-aa maajee-ai bhaa-ee bh ee mailaa t an ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Bathing in the supreme essence of spiritual wisdom, O Siblings of Destiny, the mindand body become pure. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan mahaa ras naa-ee-ai bhaa-ee man t an nirmal ho-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਮਿਲ ਕਾਇਆ  ਮਾਜੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਭੀ ਮੈਲਾ  ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Why worship gods and goddesses, O Siblings of Destiny? What can we ask of them?What can they give us?
lines.transliteration: dayvee d ayvaa poojee-ai bh aa-ee ki-aa maaga-o ki-aa d eh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਮਹਾ ਰਿਸ ਨਾਈਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The stone gods are washed with water, O Siblings of Destiny, but they just sink in thewater. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paahan neer pakh aalee-ai bh aa-ee jal meh booDh eh tayhi. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਕਆ ਮਾਗਉ  ਿਕਆ  ਦੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the unseen Lord cannot be seen, O Siblings of Destiny; the world isdrowning, having lost its honor.
lines.transliteration: gur bin alakh na lakh ee-ai bh aa-ee jag boodai pat  kho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਹਣੁ  ਨੀਿਰ  ਪਖਾਲੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਬੂਡਿਹ  ਤੇਿਹ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Greatness is in the hands of my Lord and Master, O Siblings of Destiny; as He ispleased, He gives. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur haath vadaa-ee-aa bh aa-ee jai bh aavai t ai day-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਜਗੁ ਬੂਡੈ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: That soul-bride, who talks sweetly and speaks the Truth, O Siblings of Destiny,becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: ba-ee-ar bolai meethulee bh aa-ee saach kahai pir bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਵਡਾਈਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Pierced by His Love, she abides in Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, deeply imbued with the Lord's Name. ||8||
lines.transliteration: birhai bayDhee sach vasee bh aa-ee aDh ik rahee har naa-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਬਈਅਿਰ ਬੋਲੈ ਮੀਠੁਲੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone calls God his own, O Siblings of Destiny, but the all-knowing Lord is knownonly through the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aakh ai aapn aa bh aa-ee gur t ay bujh ai sujaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਹੈ  ਬੇਧੀ ਸਿਚ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਈ  ਅਿਧਕ  ਰਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Those who are pierced by His Love are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they bear theInsignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jo beeDhay say oobray bh aa-ee sabad  sachaa neesaan. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: A large pile of firewood, O Siblings of Destiny, will burn if a small fire is applied.
lines.transliteration: eeDhan aDh ik sakaylee-ai bh aa-ee paavak ranchak paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਬੀਧੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
lines.english: In the same way, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells in the heart for amoment, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny, then one meets the Lord withease, O Nanak. ||10||4|| soriT mhlw 3 Gru 1 iqqukI  (637-12) sorath mehlaa 3 gh ar 1 t itukee Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House, Ti-Tukas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (637-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: khin pal naam rid ai vasai bh aa-ee naanak milan  subh aa-ay. ||10||4||

lines.punjabi: ਈਧਨੁ ਅਿਧਕ  ਸਕੇਲੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਪਾਵਕੁ  ਰੰਚਕ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You always preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Dear Lord; You have protectedthem from the very beginning of time.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa dee sad aa too rakh -daa har jee-o Dh ur too rakh -daa aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੧੦॥੪॥
lines.english: You protected Your servant Prahlaad, O Dear Lord, and annihilated Harnaakhash.
lines.transliteration: par-hilaad jan t uDh raakh  la-ay har jee-o harn aakhas maar pachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs place their faith in the Dear Lord, but the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa no part eet hai har jee-o manmukh  bharam bh ulaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਧੁਿਰ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, this is Your Glory.
lines.transliteration: har jee ayh tayree vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦ  ਜਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲਏ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਪਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Lord Master; Your devotees seek YourSanctuary. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kee paij rakh  too su-aamee bh agat tayree sarn aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot touch Your devotees; death cannot even approachthem.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa no jam johi na saakai kaal na nayrh ai jaa-ee.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord alone abides in their minds; through the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord, they find liberation.
lines.transliteration: kayval raam naam man vasi-aa naamay hee mukat paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Wealth and all the spiritual powers of the Siddhis fall at the feet of the Lord'sdevotees; they obtain peace and poise from the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  sabh  bhagtaa charn ee laagee gur kai sahj subh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have no faith; they are filled with greed and self-interest.
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa no part eet na aavee ant ar lobh  su-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਨੋ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They are not Gurmukh - they do not understand the Word of the Shabad in their hearts; they do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hird ai sabad  na bayd i-o har naam na laagaa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਵਲ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Their masks of falsehood and hypocrisy shall fall off; the self-willed manmukhs speakwith insipid words. ||3||
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat paaj leh jaasee manmukh  feekaa alaa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ ਿਸਿਧ  ਸਭ ਭਗਤਾ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are pervading through Your devotees, O Dear God; through Your devotees, Youare known.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa vich aap varatd aa parabh  jee bh agtee hoo t oo jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ ਲੋਭ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: All the people are enticed by Maya; they are Yours, Lord - You alone are the Architect of Destiny. pMnw 638
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh lok hai t ayree t oo ayko purakh  biDhaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਕ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Overcoming my egotism and quieting the desires within my mind, I have come to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar mansaa maneh samaanee gur kai sabad  pachh aataa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: God automatically does the work of those who love the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: achint kamm karahi parabh  tin kay jin har kaa naam pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਕੰਮ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he ever dwells in their minds, and He resolves all their affairs.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad sad aa man vasi-aa sabh  kaaj savaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਿਭ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever challenges them is destroyed; they have the Lord God as their Savior. ||5||
lines.transliteration: onaa kee rees karay so viguchai jin har parabh hai rakh vaaraa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਿਵਗੁਚੈ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs die crying out in pain.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay kinai na paa-i-aa manmukh  bha-uk mu-ay billaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਭਉਿਕ  ਮੁਏ ਿਬਲਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They come and go, and find no place of rest; in pain and suffering, they perish.
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaaveh tha-ur na paavahi d ukh meh d ukh samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ਮਿਹ ਦੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: But one who becomes Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, and is easily absorbedin the True Name. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so amrit  peevai sehjay saach samaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, one cannot escape reincarnation, even by performingnumerous rituals.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay janam na chh odai jay anayk karam karai aDh ikaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ  ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who read the Vedas, and argue and debate without the Lord, lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: vayd parh eh tai vaad  vakaan eh bin har pat  gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਦ ਪੜਿਹ  ਤੈ ਵਾਦ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; in the Guru's Sanctuary, oneis saved. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sachaa satgur saachee jis ban ee bh aj chh ooteh gur sarn aa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਿਜ ਛੂਟਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord are judged as true in the Court of theLord; they are hailed as true in the True Court.
lines.transliteration: jin har man vasi-aa say dar saachay d ar saachai sachi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸੇ ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Their praises echo throughout the ages, and no one can erase them.
lines.transliteration: onaa dee sobh aa jug jug ho-ee ko-ay na maytan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਦੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਹੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||8||1|| soriT mhlw 3 duqukI ] (638-9) sorath mehlaa 3 d utukee. Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Du-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai sad  balihaarai jin har raakh i-aa ur Dh aaraa. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰਾ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself forgives the worthless, O Siblings of Destiny; He commits them to theservice of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: niguni-aa no aapay bakh as la-ay bh aa-ee sat gur kee sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.english: Service to the True Guru is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, one'sconsciousness is attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa oot am hai bh aa-ee raam naam chit  laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਗੁਿਣਆ  ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਭਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord forgives, and unites with Himself.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aapay bakhas milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ  ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, totally without virtue, O Siblin gs of Destiny; the Perfect True Guru has blended me. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gunheen  ham apraaDh ee bh aa-ee poorai sat gur la-ay ralaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: So many, so many sinners have been forgiven, O beloved one, by contemplating theTrue Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ka-un ka-un  apraaDh ee bakh si-an pi-aaray saachai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਹੀਣ  ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They got on board the boat of the True Guru, who carried them across the terrifyingworld-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bha-ojal paar ut aari-an bh aa-ee sat gur bayrh ai chaarh . ||2||

lines.english: I have been transformed from rusty iron into gold, O Siblings of Destiny, united in Union with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.
lines.transliteration: manoorai tay kanchan bh a-ay bh aa-ee gur paaras mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣ  ਕਉਣ  ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਖਿਸਅਨੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Eliminating my self-conceit, the Name has co me to dwell within my mind, O Siblings of Destiny; my light has merged in the Light. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap chhod naa-o man vasi-aa bh aa-ee jot ee jot  milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਿਰਅਨ ੁ ਭਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੇੜੈ ਚਾਿੜ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to myTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree ha-o vaarnai bh aa-ee sat gur ka-o sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਰੈ ਤੇ ਕੰਚਨ  ਭਏ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He has given me the treasure of the Naam; O Siblings of Destiny, through the Guru'sTeachings, I am absorbed in celestial bliss. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan jin d itaa bh aa-ee gurmat  sahj samaa-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨਾਉ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, celestial peace is not produced, O Siblings of Destiny; go and askthe spiritual teachers about this.
lines.transliteration: gur bin sahj na oopjai bhaa-ee poochh ahu gi-aanee-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the True Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny, and eradicate self-conceit fromwithin. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa sad aa kar bh aa-ee vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, the Fear of God is produced, O Siblings of Destiny; true andexcellent are the deeds done in the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee bh a-o oopjai bh aa-ee bh a-o karn ee sach saar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਪੂਛਹੁ ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Then, one is blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Love, O Siblings of Destiny, andthe Support of the True Name. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paraym padaarath paa-ee-ai bh aa-ee sach naam aaDh aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰ ਭਾਈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: jo satgur sayveh aapn aa bh aa-ee t in kai ha-o laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਭਉ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I have fulfilled my life, O Siblings of Destiny, and my family has been saved as well. ||7||
lines.transliteration: janam savaaree aapnaa bh aa-ee kul bh ee la-ee bakh saa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, O Siblings ofDestiny, are obtained only by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: sach banee sach sabad  hai bh aa-ee gur kirpaa t ay ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਭਾਈ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, with the Name of the Lord abiding in one's mind, no obstacles stand in one's way, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||2|| pMnw 639 soriT mhlw 3 ] (639-1) sorath mehlaa 3. Sorat'h, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam har man vasai bhaa-ee t is bigh an na laagai ko-ay. ||8||2||

lines.english: The Dear Lord is realized through the Word of His Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, which is found only by perfect destiny.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sabday jaapd aa bh aa-ee poorai bh aag milaa-ay.

lines.english: The happy soul-brides are forever in peace, O Siblings of Destiny; night and day, theyare attuned to the Lord's Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh  sohaagan ee bh aa-ee an-d in ratee-aa rang laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਜਾਪਦਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You Yourself color us in Your Love.
lines.transliteration: har jee too aapay rang charh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਤੀਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sing, continually sing His Praises, imbued w ith His Love, O Siblings of Destiny; be in love with the Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gaavhu gaavhu rang raatiho bh aa-ee har sayt ee rang laa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Work to serve the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; abandon self-conceit, and focus yourconsciousness.
lines.transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaavnee bh aa-ee aap chh od chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਿਤਹੋ  ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You shall be in peace forever, and you shall not suffer in pain any longer, O Siblings ofDestiny; the Lord Himself shall come and abide in your mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sahj fir d ukh na lag-ee bh aa-ee har aap vasai man aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: She who does not know the Will of her Husband Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, is an ill-mannered and bitter bride.
lines.transliteration: pir kaa hukam na jaan-ee bh aa-ee saa kulkh anee kunaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She does things with a stubborn mind, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, she isfalse. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manhath kaar kamaavn ee bh aa-ee vin  naavai koorh i-aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ  ਿਫਿਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They alone sing the Lord's Praises, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upontheir foreheads, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Love of the True Lord, they finddetachment.
lines.transliteration: say gaavahi jin mastak bh aag hai bh aa-ee bh aa-ay sachai bairaag.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਭਾਈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ  ਕੁਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are imbued with His Love; they utter His Glorious Praises, OSiblings of Destiny, and they lovingly focus their consciousness on the Fearless Guru.||4||
lines.transliteration: an-din raat ay gun  raveh bh aa-ee nirbh a-o gur liv laag. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂਿੜਆਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He kills and revives all, O Siblings of Destiny; serve Him, day and night.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa maar jeevaald aa bh aa-ee so sayvhu d in raat .

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਭਾਇ  ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: How can we forget Him from our minds, O Siblings of Destiny? His gifts are glorious and great. ||5||
lines.transliteration: so ki-o manhu visaaree-ai bhaa-ee jis d ee vadee hai d aat. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਿਹ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਗੁਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is filthy and double-minded, O Siblings of Destiny; the findsno place of rest in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mailee dummn ee bh aa-ee d argeh naahee thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: But if she becomes Gurmukh, then she chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, OSiblings of Destiny; the meets her True Beloved, and merges in Him. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai t a gun  ravai bh aa-ee mil pareet am saach samaa-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: In this life, she has not focused her consciousness on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny;how can she show her face when she leaves?
lines.transliteration: ayt janam har na chayt i-o bh aa-ee ki-aa muhu d aysee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮੈਲੀ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਭਾਈ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: In spite of the warning calls which were sounded, she has been plundered, O Siblingsof Destiny; she yearned only for corruption. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kirhee pavand ee muhaa-i-on bh aa-ee bikh i-aa no lobh aa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who dwell upon the Naam, O Siblings of Destiny, their bodies are ever peacefuland tranquil.
lines.transliteration: naam samaaleh sukh vaseh bh aa-ee sad aa sukh  saaNt sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੁ ਜਨਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਕਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, dwell upon the Naam; the Lord is infinite, virtuous and unfathomable, OSiblings of Destiny. ||8||3|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 1 AstpdIAw  (639-12) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 asatpad ee-aa Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (639-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too bh aa-ee aprampar gun ee gaheer. ||8||3||

lines.english: The One who created the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, is the Almighty Lord, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag jineh upaa-i-aa bh aa-ee karan  kaaran  samrath.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਹ  ਸੁਿਖ ਵਸਿਹ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਤ  ਸਰੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: He fashioned the soul and the body, O Siblings of Destiny, by His own power.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind jin saaji-aa bhaa-ee d ay kar apn ee vath.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂ ਭਾਈ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: How can He be described? How can He be seen, O Siblings of Destiny? The Creator isOne; He is indescribable.
lines.transliteration: kin kahee-ai ki-o daykh ee-ai bh aa-ee kart aa ayk akath.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Praise the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; through Him, theessence is known. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur govind salaahee-ai bh aa-ee jis t ay jaapai t ath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਜਨਿਹ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: mayray man japee-ai har bhagvant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਅਪਣੀ  ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.english: He blesses His servant with the gift of the Naam; He is the Destroyer of pain andsuffering. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam daan d ay-ay jan apnay d ookh darad kaa hant aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਿਨ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਕਉ  ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਅਕਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: Everything is in His home, O Siblings of Destiny; His warehouse is overflowing withthe nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ghar sabh  kichh  hai bh aa-ee na-o niDh  bharay bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਥੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: His worth cannot be estimated, O Siblings of Destiny; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: tis kee keemat  naa pavai bh aa-ee oochaa agam apaar.

lines.english: He cherishes all beings and creatures, O Siblings of Destiny; he continually takes careof them.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant part ipaald aa bh aa-ee nit  nit kardaa saar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ  ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ  ਕਾ ਹੰਤਾ ॥
lines.english: So meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and merge in the Word ofthe Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa bh aytee-ai bh aa-ee sabad  milaavan haar. ||2||

lines.english: Adoring the feet of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, doubt and fear are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sachay charan sarayvee-ah bh aa-ee bh aram bh a-o hovai naas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, cleanse your mind, O Siblings of Destiny, and dwellin the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil sant sabh aa man maaNjee-ai bh aa-ee har kai naam nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਭਾਈ  ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The darkness of ignorance shall be dispelled, O Siblings of Destiny, and the lotus ofyour heart shall blossom forth.
lines.transliteration: mitai anDhayraa agi-aant aa bh aa-ee kamal hovai pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਦਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਕਰਦਾ  ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: By the Guru's Word, peace wells up, O Siblings of Destiny; all fruits are with the True Guru. ||3|| pMnw 640
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee sukh oopjai bh aa-ee sabh  fal sat gur paas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਿਭ ਫਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Give up your sense of mine and yours, O Siblings of Destiny, and become the dust of the feet of all.
lines.transliteration: mayraa tayraa chh odee-ai bh aa-ee ho-ee-ai sabh  kee Dh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਹੋਈਐ  ਸਭ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, God is contained, O Siblings of Destiny; He sees, and hears,and is ever-present with us.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at barahm pasaari-aa bh aa-ee paykh ai sun ai hajoor.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਸਾਿਰਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: On that day when one forgets the Supreme Lord God, O Siblings of Destiny, on thatday, one ought to die crying out in pain.
lines.transliteration: jit din visrai paarbarahm bh aa-ee t it din maree-ai jh oor.

lines.english: He is the all-powerful Cause of Causes, O Siblings of Destiny; he is totally filled withall powers. ||4||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan samratho bhaa-ee sarab kalaa bh arpoor. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨ  ਸਮਰਥੋ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Love of the Name is the greatest treasure, O Siblings of Destiny; through it,emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: paraym padaarath naam hai bh aa-ee maa-i-aa moh binaas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਿਬਨਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: If it is pleasing to His Will, then He unites us in His Union, O Siblings of Destiny; theNaam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: tis bh aavai t aa mayl la-ay bh aa-ee hird ai naam nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, O Siblings of Destiny, and the heart isillumined.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kamal pargaasee-ai bh aa-ee rid ai hovai pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Glory of God has been revealed, O Siblings of Destiny, and the earth and sky have blossomed forth. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-i-aa part aap parabh  bhaa-ee ma-oli-aa Dh arat akaas. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਈ  ਮਉਿਲਆ  ਧਰਿਤ  ਅਕਾਸੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with contentment, O Siblings of Destiny; day andnight, I remain attached to the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai santokh i-aa bh aa-ee ahinis laagaa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੰਤੋਿਖਆ  ਭਾਈ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: My tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the truetaste, and the object of human life.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam ravai sadaa bh aa-ee saachaa saad  su-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਭਾਈ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਦੁ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Listening with my ears, I hear and so I live, O Siblings of Destiny; I have obtained theunchanging, unmoving state.
lines.transliteration: karnee sun sun  jeevi-aa bh aa-ee nihchal paa-i-aa thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨੀ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਜੀਿਵਆ ਭਾਈ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: That soul,which does not place its faith in the Lord shall burn, O Siblings of Destiny.||6||
lines.transliteration: jis parteet  na aavee bh aa-ee so jee-arh aa jal jaa-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੋ ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master has so many virtues, O Siblings of Destiny; I am a sacrifice toHim.
lines.transliteration: baho gun mayray saahibai bh aa-ee ha-o t is kai bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਹਉ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He nurtures even the most worthless, O Siblings of Destiny, and gives home to thehomeless.
lines.transliteration: oh nirgunee-aaray paald aa bh aa-ee d ay-ay nithaavay thaa-o.

lines.english: He gives us nourishment with each and every breath, O Siblings of Destiny; His Nameis everlasting.
lines.transliteration: rijak sambaahay saas saas bhaa-ee goorh aa jaa kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸੰਬਾਹੇ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਭਾਈ  ਗੂੜਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who meets with the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, does so only by perfect destiny. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jis gur saachaa bhaytee-ai bh aa-ee pooraa t is karmaa-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਪੂਰਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਰਮਾਉ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totallyfilled with all powers.
lines.transliteration: tis bin gh arhee na jeevee-ai bh aa-ee sarab kalaa bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: With every breath and morsel of food, I will not forget Him, O Siblings of Destiny; Ibehold Him ever-present.
lines.transliteration: saas giraas na visrai bhaa-ee paykh a-o sad aa hajoor.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਪੇਖਉ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meet Him, O Siblings of Destiny; Heis totally pervading and permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang milaa-i-aa bh aa-ee sarab rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਰਬ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not embrace love for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, always die cryingout in pain. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jinaa pareet na lagee-aa bh aa-ee say nit  nit mard ay jhoor. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਲਗੀਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੇ ਿਨਤ ਿਨਤ  ਮਰਦੇ  ਝੂਿਰ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Grasping hold of the hem of His robe, O Siblings of Destiny, we are carried across theworld-ocean of fear and pain.
lines.transliteration: anchal laa-ay taraa-i-aa bh aa-ee bh a-ojal d ukh sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਚਿਲ  ਲਾਇ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By His Glance of Grace, He has blessed us, O Siblings of Destiny; He shall be with us until the very end.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa nadar nihaali-aa bh aa-ee keet on ang apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਦਿਰ ਿਨਹਾਿਲਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਅੰਗੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are soothed and calmed, O Siblings of Destiny, nourished by thefood of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al ho-i-aa bh aa-ee bh ojan naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||9||1|| soriT mhlw 5 ] (640-14) sorath mehlaa 5. Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis sarn aagat ee bh aa-ee je kilbikh  kaatan haar. ||9||1||

lines.english: The womb of the mother is an ocean of pain, O Beloved; even there, the Lord causesHis Name to be chanted.
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  dukh saagro pi-aaray t ah apn aa naam japaa-i-aa.

lines.english: When he emerges, he finds corruption pervading everywhere, O Beloved, and hebecomes increasingly attached to Maya.
lines.transliteration: baahar kaadh bikh  pasree-aa pi-aaray maa-i-aa moh vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ  ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤਹ ਅਪਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord blesses with His kind favor, O Beloved, meets the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis no keeto karam aap pi-aaray t is pooraa guroo milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਿਬਖੁ ਪਸਰੀਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He worships the Lord in adoration with each and every breath, O Beloved; he is lovingly attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so aaraaDhay saas saas pi-aaray raam naam liv laa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਕੀਤੋ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the support of my mind and body, O Beloved; You are the support of mymind and body.
lines.transliteration: man tan t ayree tayk hai pi-aaray man t an tayree tayk.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no other Creator except for You, O Beloved; You alone are the Inner-knower,the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin avar na karanhaar pi-aaray ant arjaamee ayk. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: After wandering in doubt for millions of incarnations, he comes into the world, O Beloved; for uncounted lifetimes, he has suffered in pain.
lines.transliteration: kot janam bharam aa-i-aa pi-aaray anik jon d ukh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਏਕ ॥
lines.english: He has forgotten his True Lord and Master, O Beloved, and so he suffers terriblepunishment.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib visri-aa pi-aaray bahutee milai sajaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, are attached to the True Name. pMnw 641
lines.transliteration: jin bhaytai pooraa sat guroo pi-aaray say laagay saachai naa-ay.

lines.english: We are saved by following those, O Beloved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tinaa pichh ai chh utee-ai pi-aaray jo saachee sarn aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He thinks that his food is so sweet, O Beloved, but it makes his body ill.
lines.transliteration: mithaa kar kai kh aa-i-aa pi-aaray t in tan keet aa rog.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਠਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਤਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਤਾ  ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: It turns out to be bitter, O Beloved, and it produces only sadness.
lines.transliteration: ka-urhaa ho-ay pat isati-aa pi-aaray t is tay upji-aa sog.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉੜਾ  ਹੋਇ ਪਿਤਸਿਟਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਤਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord leads him astray in the enjoyment of pleasures, O Beloved, and so his senseof separation does not depart.
lines.transliteration: bhog bh unchaa-ay bh ulaa-i-an pi-aaray ut rai nahee vijog.

lines.english: Those who meet the Guru are saved, O Beloved; this is their pre-ordained destiny.||3||
lines.transliteration: jo gur mayl uDhaari-aa pi-aaray t in Dhuray pa-i-aa sanjog. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਉਧਾਿਰਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ  ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He is filled with longing for Maya, O Beloved, and so the Lord does not ever come into his mind.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa laalach ati-aa pi-aaray chit na aavahi mool.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਲਿਚ  ਅਿਟਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਮੂਿਲ ॥
lines.english: Those who forget You, O Supreme Lord Master, their bodies turn to dust.
lines.transliteration: jin too visrahi paarbarahm su-aamee say t an ho-ay Dh oorh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਤੂ ਿਵਸਰਿਹ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਧੂਿੜ ॥
lines.english: They cry out and scream horribly, O Beloved, but their torment does not end.
lines.transliteration: billaat karahi bahutayri-aa pi-aaray ut rai naahee sool.

lines.english: Those who meet the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their capital remainsintact. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo gur mayl savaari-aa pi-aaray tin kaa rahi-aa mool. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਿਹਆ  ਮੂਲੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: As far as possible, do not associate with the faithless cynics, O Beloved.
lines.transliteration: saakat sang na keej-ee pi-aaray jay kaa paar vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਿਰ  ਵਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with them, the Lord is forgotten, O Beloved, and you rise and depart with ablackened face.
lines.transliteration: jis mili-ai har visrai pi-aaray so muhi kaalai uth jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਿਵਸਰੈ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸ ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲੈ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh finds no rest or shelter, O Beloved; in the Court of the Lord,they are punished.
lines.transliteration: manmukh dh o-ee nah milai pi-aaray d argeh milai sajaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who meet with the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their affairs areresolved. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jo gur mayl savaari-aa pi-aaray tinaa pooree paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਪੂਰੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: One may have thousands of clever tricks and techniques of austere self-discipline, O Beloved, but not even one of them will go with him.
lines.transliteration: sanjam sahas si-aanpaa pi-aaray ik na chalee naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਜਮ  ਸਹਸ  ਿਸਆਣਪਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Those who turn their backs on the Lord of the Universe, O Beloved, their families arestained with disgrace.
lines.transliteration: jo baymukh gobind  tay pi-aaray t in kul laagai gaal.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਬੇਮੁਖ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਤੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕੁਿਲ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਗਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: They do not realize that they do have Him , O Beloved; falsehood will not go withthem.
lines.transliteration: hodee vasat  na jaat ee-aa pi-aaray koorh  na chalee naal.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਦੀ ਵਸਤੁ  ਨ ਜਾਤੀਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meet with the True Guru, O Beloved, dwell upon the True Name. ||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur jinaa milaa-i-on pi-aaray saachaa naam samaal. ||6||

lines.english: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Beloved, one is blessed with Truth,contentment, wisdom and meditation.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh gi-aan Dh i-aan pi-aaray jis no nad ar karay.

lines.english: Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, O Beloved, totally filled withAmbrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: an-din keert an gun  ravai pi-aaray amrit  poor bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He crosses over the sea of pain, O Beloved, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: dukh saagar t in langh i-aa pi-aaray bh avjal paar paray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਿਤਨ  ਲੰਿਘਆ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: One who is pleasing to His Will, He unites with Himself, O Beloved; he is forever true.||7||
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is mayl laihi pi-aaray say-ee sad aa kh aray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸੇਈ ਸਦਾ ਖਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The all-powerful Divine Lord is compassionate, O Beloved; He is the Support of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: samrath purakh d a-i-aal d ay-o pi-aaray bh agtaa tis kaa t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥ  ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਦੇਉ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I seek His Sanctuary, O Beloved; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: tis sarn aa-ee dh eh pa-ay pi-aaray je ant arjaamee jaan .

lines.english: He has adorned me in this world and the next, O Beloved; He has placed the Emblemof Truth upon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  savaari-aa pi-aaray mast ak sach neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never forget that God, O Beloved; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||8||2|| soriT mhlw 5 Gru 2 AstpdIAw  (641-16) sorath mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 asatpad ee-aa Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (641-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: so parabh kad ay na veesrai pi-aaray naanak sad  kurbaan . ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: They read scriptures, and contemplate the Vedas; they practice the inner cleansingtechniques of Yoga, and control of the breath.
lines.transliteration: paath parh i-o ar bayd  beechaari-o nival bh u-angam saaDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: But they cannot escape from the company of the five passions; they are increasinglybound to egotism. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panch janaa si-o sang na chhutki-o aDh ik ahaN-buDh  baaDh ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਠੁ ਪਿੜਓ  ਅਰੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਿਨਵਿਲ  ਭੁਅੰਗਮ  ਸਾਧੇ ॥
lines.english: O Beloved, this is not the way to meet the Lord; I have performed these rituals somany times.
lines.transliteration: pi-aaray in biDh milan  na jaa-ee mai kee-ay karam anaykaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਿਸਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਛੁਟਿਕਓ  ਅਿਧਕ ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have collapsed, exhausted, at the Door of my Lord Master; I pray that He may grant me a discerning intellect. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: haar pari-o su-aamee kai du-aarai d eejai buDh  bibaykaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਮਲਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਮ  ਅਨੇਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: One may remain silent and use his hands as begging bowls, and wander naked in theforest.
lines.transliteration: mon bha-i-o karpaat ee rahi-o nagan firi-o ban maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਿਰ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਬਬੇਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: He may make pilgrimages to river banks and sacred shrines all over the world, but his sense of duality will not leave him. ||2|| pMnw 642
lines.transliteration: tat tirath sabh  Dhartee bh armi-o d ubiDh aa chh utkai naahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮਓ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਛੁਟਕੈ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: His mind's desires may lead him to go and dwell at sacred places of pilgrimage, and offer his head to be sawn off;
lines.transliteration: man kaamnaa tirath jaa-ay basi-o sir karvat  Dharaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਜਾਇ  ਬਿਸਓ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਰਵਤ  ਧਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee mail na utrai ih biDh  jay lakh  jatan karaa-ay. ||3|| but this will not cause the filth of his mind to depart, even though he may makethousands of efforts. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜੇ ਲਖ ਜਤਨ  ਕਰਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He may give gifts of all sorts - gold, women, horses and elephants.
lines.transliteration: kanik kaaminee haivar gaivar baho biDh d aan d aataaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਨਕ  ਕਾਿਮਨੀ  ਹੈਵਰ  ਗੈਵਰ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He may make offerings of corn, clothes and land in abundance, but this will not leadhim to the Lord's Door. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ann bastar bh oom baho arpay nah milee-ai har d u-aaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨ ਬਸਤਰ੍  ਭੂਿਮ ਬਹੁ ਅਰਪੇ  ਨਹ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He may remain devoted to worship and adoration, bowing his forehead to the floor, practicing the six religious rituals.
lines.transliteration: poojaa archaa bandan dand-ut  khat karmaa rat  rahtaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ  ਬੰਦਨ  ਡੰਡਉਤ  ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਰਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He indulges in egotism and pride, and falls into entanglements, but he does not meetthe Lord by these devices. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karat banDh an meh pari-aa nah milee-ai ih jugt aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਮਿਹ ਪਿਰਆ  ਨਹ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He practices the eighty-four postures of Yoga, and acquires the supernatural powersof the Siddhas, but he gets tired of practicing these.
lines.transliteration: jog siDh aasan  cha-oraaseeh ay bh ee kar kar rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਿਸਧ ਆਸਣ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਏ ਭੀ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: He lives a long life, but is reincarnated again and again; he has not met with the Lord.||6||
lines.transliteration: vadee aarjaa fir fir janmai har si-o sang na gahi-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਜਨਮੈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਗਿਹਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He may enjoy princely pleasures, and regal pomp and ceremony, and issueunchallenged commands.
lines.transliteration: raaj leelaa raajan kee rachnaa kari-aa hukam afaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ  ਰਾਜਨ  ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ  ਕਿਰਆ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He may lie on beautiful beds, perfumed with  sandalwood oil, but this will led him only to the gates of the most horrible hell. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sayj sohnee chandan cho-aa narak gh or kaa d u-aaraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ  ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੋਆ  ਨਰਕ  ਘੋਰ ਕਾ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,is the highest of all actions.
lines.transliteration: har keerat saaDh sangat  hai sir karman kai karmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਰਮਨ  ਕੈ ਕਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, he alone obtains it, who is pre-destined to receive it. ||8||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis bh a-i-o paraapat  jis purab likh ay kaa lahnaa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭਇਓ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ  ਿਲਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਨਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Your slave is intoxicated with this Love of Yours.
lines.transliteration: tayro sayvak ih rang maat aa.

lines.english: ||1||3|| The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, and this mind isimbued with the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Second Pause||1||3|| rwgu soriT vwr mhly 4 kI  (642-10) raag sorath vaar mahlay 4 kee Vaar Of Raag Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (642-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku mÚ 1 ] (642-11) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) bha-i-o kirpaal d een d ukh bhanjan har har keert an ih man raat aa. rahaa-o d oojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਿਨ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Sorat'h is always beautiful, if it brings the True Lord to dwell in the mind of the soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: sorath sad aa suhaavan ee jay sachaa man ho-ay.

lines.english: Her teeth are clean and her mind is not split by duality; the Name of the True Lord ison her tongue.
lines.transliteration: dandee mail na kat  man jeebh ai sachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲੇ  ੪ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, she abides in the Fear of God, and serves the True Guru withouthesitation.
lines.transliteration: sasurai pay-ee-ai bhai vasee sat gur sayv nisang.

lines.english: Discarding worldly adornments, she meets her Husband Lord, and she celebrates joyfully with Him.
lines.transliteration: parhar kaparh jay pir milai kh usee raavai pir sang.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: She is adorned forever with the Name in her mind, and she does not have even aniota of filth.
lines.transliteration: sadaa seegaaree naa-o man kad ay na mail pat ang.

lines.punjabi: ਦੰਦੀ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਤੁ ਮਿਨ ਜੀਭੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Her husband's younger and elder brothers, the corrupt desires, have died, suffering inpain; and now, who fears Maya, the mother-in-law?
lines.transliteration: dayvar jayth  mu-ay d ukh sasoo kaa dar kis.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੁਰੈ  ਪੇਈਐ  ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਿਨਸੰਗ  ॥
lines.english: If she becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, O Nanak, she bears the jewel of goodkarma upon her forehead, and everything is Truth to her. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (642-14) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay pir bhaavai naankaa karam man ee sabh  sach. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਕਪੜੁ  ਜੇ ਿਪਰ ਿਮਲੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Sorat'h is beautiful only when it leads the soul-bride to seek the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sorath t aam suhaavan ee jaa har naam dh andholay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ  ਨਾਉ  ਮਿਨ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: She pleases her Guru and God; under Guru's Instruction, she speaks the Name of theLord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gur purakh manaavai aapn aa gurmat ee har har bolay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਰ  ਜੇਠ ਮੁਏ ਦੁਿਖ ਸਸੂ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਿਕਸੁ ॥
lines.english: She is attracted to the Lord's Name, day and night, and her body is drenched in thecolor of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har paraym kasaa-ee dinas raat  har rat ee har rang cholay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮ  ਮਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
