lines.english: No other being like the Lord God can be found; I have looked and searched over the whole world.
lines.transliteration: har jaisaa purakh na labh -ee sabh  daykhi-aa jagat  mai tolay.

lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within me; my mind does notwaver any more.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur naam drirh -aa-i-aa man anat  na kaahoo dolay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਤਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave, the slave of the slaves of the Guru, the True Guru.||2|| pauVI ] (642-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai gur sat gur kay gol golay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਮਨਾਵੈ ਆਪਣਾ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator, the Fashioner of the world.
lines.transliteration: too aapay sisat kart aa sirjan haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਕਸਾਈ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਚੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself have arranged the play, and You Yourself arrange it.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay kh ayl rachaa-ay t uDh aap savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੈਸਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਸਭੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਮੈ ਟੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; You Yourself are the Enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: daataa kart aa aap aap bh oganhaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading everywhere, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayraa sabad  vartai upaavan haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਗੋਲ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I ever praise the Lord; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||1|| pMnw 643 sloku mÚ 3 ] (643-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o gurmukh sad aa salaahee gur ka-o vaari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: In the flames of egotism, he is burnt to death; he wanders in doubt and the love ofduality.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jaltay jal mu-ay bh aram aa-ay d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਲਤੇ  ਜਿਲ  ਮੁਏ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਆਏ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru saves him, making him His own.
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur raakh  lee-ay aapn ai pannai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਏ ਆਪਣੈ  ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This world is burning; through the Sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad, this comes tobe seen.
lines.transliteration: ih jag jaltaa nad ree aa-i-aa gur kai sabad  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are cooled and soothed; O Nanak, they practiceTruth. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (643-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay say seet al bha-ay naanak sach kamaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੀਤਲ  ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; blessed and acceptable is such alife.
lines.transliteration: safli-o satgur sayvi-aa Dh an janam parvaan .

lines.english: Those who do not forget the True Guru, in life and in death, are truly wise people.
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur jeevd i-aa mu-i-aa na visrai say-ee purakh  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Their families are saved, and they are approved by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kul uDhaaray aapn aa so jan hovai parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੀਵਿਦਆ ਮੁਇਆ  ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ  ਸੁਜਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are approved in death as in life, while the self-willed manmukhs continue the cycle of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mu-ay jeevd ay parvaan  heh manmukh  janam maraahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are not described as dead, who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru'sShabad. ||2|| pauVI ] (643-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak mu-ay na aakhee-ahi je gur kai sabad  samaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹਿਹ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Immaculate Lord God, and meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har purakh niranjan sayv har naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੁਏ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਿਜ ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Join the Society of the Holy Saints, and be absorbed in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  saaDh oo lag har naam samaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Lord, glorious and great is service to You; I am so foolish
lines.transliteration: har tayree vadee kaar mai moorakh  laa-ee-ai.
ha-o golaa laalaa tuDh  mai hukam furmaa-ee-ai. - please, commit me to it. I am Your servant and slave; command me, according toYour Will.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧੂ ਲਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I shall serve You, as Guru has instructed me. ||2|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (643-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o gurmukh kaar kamaavaa je gur samjaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He acts according to pre-ordained destiny, written by the Creator Himself.
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa kamaavan aa je kart ai aap likh i-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਗੋਲਾ  ਲਾਲਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਮੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment has drugged him, and he has forgotten the Lord, the treasureof virtue.
lines.transliteration: moh thag-ulee paa-ee-an visri-aa gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ  ਿਜ ਗੁਿਰ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Don't think that he is alive in the world - he is dead, through the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: mat jaan hu jag jeevd aa doojai bh aa-ay mu-i-aas.

lines.english: Those who do not meditate on the Lord, as Gurmukh, are not permitted to sit nearthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee gurmukh naam na chayt i-o say bahan  na milnee paas.

lines.english: They suffer the most horrible pain and suffering, and neither their sons nor their wivesgo along with them.
lines.transliteration: dukh laagaa baho at  ghanaa put  kalat  na saath ko-ee jaas.

lines.english: Their faces are blackened among men, and they sigh in deep regret.
lines.transliteration: lokaa vich muhu kaalaa ho-aa andar ubh ay saas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵਦਾ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਮੁਇਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: No one places any reliance in the self-willed manmukhs; trust in them is lost.
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa no ko na vishee chuk ga-i-aa vaysaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਸੇ ਬਹਿਣ  ਨ ਿਮਲਨੀ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs live in absolute peace; the Naam, the Name of the Lord,abides within them. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (643-12) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukhaa no sukh  aglaa jinaa ant ar naam nivaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਬਹੁ ਅਿਤ  ਘਣਾ  ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ  ਨ ਸਾਿਥ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are relatives, and they alone are friends, who, as Gurmukh, join togetherin love.
lines.transliteration: say sain say sajn aa je gurmukh  mileh subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਕਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ  ਹੋਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਉਭੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they act according to the True Guru's Will; they remain absorbed in theTrue Name.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa an-d in karahi say sach rahay samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਿਵਸਹੀ  ਚੁਿਕ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਸਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are attached to the love of duality are not called friends; they practiceegotism and corruption.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay lagay sajan  na aakh ee-ahi je abh imaan karahi vaykaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are selfish; they cannot resolve anyone's affairs.
lines.transliteration: manmukh aap su-aarthee kaaraj na sakahi savaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||2|| pauVI ] (643-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhi-aa kamaavan aa ko-ay na maytan haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸੈਣ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself arranged the play of it.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay jagat  upaa-ay kai aap kh ayl rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੇ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the three qualities, and fostered emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  aap sirji-aa maa-i-aa moh vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਸਜਣ  ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਿਜ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਵੇਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He is called to account for his deeds done in egotism; he continues coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: vich ha-umai laykhaa mangee-ai fir aavai jaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਆਪ  ਸੁਆਰਥੀ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਨ ਸਕਿਹ  ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru instructs those whom the Lord Himself blesses with Grace.
lines.transliteration: jinaa har aap kirpaa karay say gur samjhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (643-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay sad aa sad aa gh umaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The love of Maya is enticing; without teeth, it has eaten up the world.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mamtaa mohn ee jin vin  dantaa jag kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਆਿਪ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are eaten away, while the Gurmukhs are saved; they focustheir consciousness on the True Name.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kh aaDhay gurmukh  ubray jinee sach naam chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਿਪ  ਿਸਰਿਜਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the world wanders around insane; the Gurmukhs come to see this. pMnw 644
lines.transliteration: bin naavai jag kamlaa firai gurmukh nad ree aa-i-aa.

lines.english: DhanDh aa kart i-aa nihfal janam gavaa-i-aa sukh -daata man na vasaa-i-aa. Involved in worldly affairs, he wastes his life in vain; the peace-giving Lord does not come to abide in his mind.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਿਨਹਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Name, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (644-2) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinaa ka-o mili-aa jin ka-o Dh ur likh  paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਨਾ ਕਉ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The home within is filled with Ambrosial Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not get to taste it.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee meh amrit  bharpoor hai manmukh aa saad  na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is like the deer, who does not recognize its own musk-scent; it wanders around,deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: ji-o kastooree mirag na jaan ai bharmad aa bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The manmukh forsakes the Ambrosial Nectar, and instead gathers poison; the CreatorHimself has fooled him.
lines.transliteration: amrit t aj bikh  sangrahai kart ai aap kh u-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਕਸਤੂਰੀ  ਿਮਰਗੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਭਰ੍ਮਦਾ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: How rare are the Gurmukhs, who obtain this understanding; they behold the Lord Godwithin themselves.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlay sojh ee pa-ee t inaa and ar barahm d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਤਿਜ ਿਬਖੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੈ ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed, and their tongues enjoy the sublimetaste of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al ho-i-aa rasnaa har saad  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Name wells up; through the Shabad, we areunited in the Lord's Union.
lines.transliteration: sabday hee naa-o oopjai sabd ay mayl milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, the whole world is insane, and it loses its life in vain.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai sabh  jag ba-uraanaa birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਹੀ ਨਾਉ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Shabad alone is Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||2|| pauVI ] (644-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: amrit ayko sabad  hai naanak gurmukh  paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God is inaccessible; tell me, how can we find Him?
lines.transliteration: so har purakh agamm hai kaho kit  biDh paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He has no form or feature, and He cannot be seen; tell me, how can we meditate on Him?
lines.transliteration: tis roop na raykh  adrist kaho jan ki-o Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The Lord is formless, immaculate and inaccessible; which of His Virtues should wespeak of and sing?
lines.transliteration: nirankaar niranjan har agam ki-aa kahi gun gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: They alone walk on the Lord's Path, whom the Lord Himself instructs.
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaa-ay aap so har maarag paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੁ ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਿਕਉ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has revealed Him to me; serving the Guru, He is found. ||4|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (644-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai vaykhaali-aa gur sayvaa paa-ee-ai. ||4||

lines.english: It is as if my body has been crushed in the oil-press, without yielding even a drop of blood;
lines.transliteration: ji-o tan koloo peerh ee-ai rat  na bh oree d ayhi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jee-o vanjai cha-o kh annee-ai sachay sand -rhai nayhi. it is as if my soul has been cut apart into pieces for the sake of the Love of the TrueLord;

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, still, night and day, my Union with the Lord is not broken. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (644-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl na chuk-ee raatee at ai dayh. ||1||

lines.english: My Friend is so full of joy and love; He colors my mind with the color of His Love,
lines.transliteration: sajan maidaa rangulaa rang laa-ay man lay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ  ਰਤੁ ਨ ਭੋਰੀ ਡੇਿਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ji-o maajeethai kaprh ay rangay bh ee paahayhi. like the fabric which is treated to retain the color of the dye.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਵੰਞੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦੜੈ  ਨੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this color does not depart, and no other color can be imparted to this fabric.||2|| pauVI ] (644-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak rang na utrai bi-aa na lagai kayh. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is pervading everywhere; the Lord Himself causes us to chant HisName.
lines.transliteration: har aap vartai aap har aap bulaa-id aa.

lines.english: The Lord Himself created the creation; He commits all to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: har aapay sarisat savaar sir DhanDh ai laa-id aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੈਡਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ  ਮਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He engages some in devotional worship, and others, He causes to stray.
lines.transliteration: iknaa bhagt ee laa-ay ik aap kh u-aa-id aa.

lines.english: He places some on the Path, while He leads others into the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: iknaa maarag paa-ay ik ujharh  paa-id aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਿਬਆ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੇਹ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (644-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay gurmukh  gun gaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding, if one performs it with his mindfocused on it.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa safal hai jay ko karay chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, and egotism departs from within.
lines.transliteration: man chindi-aa fal paavn aa ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.english: His bonds are broken, and he is liberated; he remains absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orhai mukat  ho-ay sachay rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਇ  ਇਿਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਇਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam in this world; it comes to dwell in the mind of theGurmukh.
lines.transliteration: is jag meh naam alabh hai gurmukh  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਮਾਰਿਗ ਪਾਇ  ਇਿਕ  ਉਝਿੜ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to one who serves his True Guru. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (644-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo gur sayveh aapnaa ha-o t in balihaarai jaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is so very stubborn; it is stuck in the love ofduality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh man ajit  hai d oojai lagai jaa-ay.

lines.english: He does not find peace, even in dreams; he passes his life in misery and suffering.
lines.transliteration: tis no sukh  supnai nahee d ukhay dukh vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits have grown weary of going door to door, reading and reciting theirscriptures; the Siddhas have gone into their trances of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar parh  parh pandit  thakay siDh  samaaDh  lagaa-ay.

lines.english: This mind cannot be controlled; they are tired of performing religious rituals.
lines.transliteration: ih man vas na aavee thakay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋੜੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The impersonators have grown weary of wearing false costumes, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines. pMnw 645
lines.transliteration: bhaykh -Dhaaree bh aykh kar thakay ath isath tirath naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They do not know the state of their own minds; they are deluded by doubt and egotism.
lines.transliteration: man kee saar na jaannee ha-umai bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਭਉ ਪਇਆ  ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Fear of God is obtained; by great good fortune, the Lord comes to abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bha-o pa-i-aa vadbh aag vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ  ਮਨੁ ਵਿਸ ਹੋਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Fear of God comes, the mind is restrained, and through the Word of theShabad, the ego is burnt away.
lines.transliteration: bhai pa-i-ai man vas ho-aa ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate; their light merges in the Light.
lines.transliteration: sach ratay say nirmalay jot ee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is absorbed in peace.||2|| pauVI ] (645-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai naa-o paa-i-aa naanak sukh  samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The pleasures of kings and emperors are pleasing, but they last for only a few days.
lines.transliteration: ayh bhoopat  raanay rang d in chaar suhaavan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਭੂਪਿਤ ਰਾਣੇ ਰੰਗ ਿਦਨ ਚਾਿਰ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: These pleasures of Maya are like the color of the safflower, which wears off in amoment.
lines.transliteration: ayhu maa-i-aa rang kasumbh kh in meh leh jaavn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: They do not go with him when he departs; instead, he carries the load of sins uponhis head.
lines.transliteration: chaldi-aa naal na chalai sir paap lai jaavn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਲੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਪਾਪ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: When death seizes him, and marches him away, then he looks absolutely hideous.
lines.transliteration: jaaN pakarh chalaa-i-aa kaal t aaN kharaa daraavan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਪਕਿੜ  ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਤ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: That lost opportunity will not come into his hands again, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||6|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (645-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: oh vaylaa hath na aavai fir pachhut aavnaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਫਿਰ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, suffer in sorrow and bondage.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay jo muh firay say baDh ay dukh sahaahi.

lines.english: Again and again, they are born only to die; they cannot meet their Lord.
lines.transliteration: fir fir milan na paa-inee jameh t ai mar jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਿਫਰੇ ਸੇ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The disease of doubt does not depart, and they find only pain and more pain.
lines.transliteration: sahsaa rog na chhod-ee d ukh hee meh d ukh paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਮਲਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਤੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the Gracious Lord forgives, then one is united in Union with the Word ofthe Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (645-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree bakh as layhi sabd ay mayl milaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸਾ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ  ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, shall find no place of rest orshelter.
lines.transliteration: jo satgur t ay muh firay t inaa th a-ur na th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੇਿਹ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They wander around from door to door, like a woman forsaken, with a bad characterand a bad reputation.
lines.transliteration: ji-o chhutarh  ghar ghar firai d uhchaaran  badnaa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are forgiven, and united in Union with the True Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (645-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh bakh see-ah say sat gur mayl milaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਮੁਹ ਿਫਰੇ ਿਤਨਾ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Lord, the Destroyer of ego, cross over the terrifying world- ocean.
lines.transliteration: jo sayveh sat muraar say bh avjal t ar ga-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are passed over by the Messengerof Death.
lines.transliteration: jo boleh har har naa-o tin jam chh ad ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਖਸੀਅਿਹ  ਸੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord, go to His Court in robes of honor.
lines.transliteration: say dargeh paiDh ay jaahi jinaa har jap la-i-aa.

lines.english: They alone serve You, O Lord, whom You bless with Grace.
lines.transliteration: har sayveh say-ee purakh jinaa har t uDh ma-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਿਤ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ਸੇ ਭਵਜਲ  ਤਿਰ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I sing continually Your Glorious Praises, O Beloved; as Gurmukh, my doubts and fearshave been dispelled. ||7|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (645-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa pi-aaray nit  gurmukh  bharam bh a-o ga-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ਿਤਨ ਜਮੁ ਛਿਡ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Upon the plate, three things have been placed; this is the sublime, ambrosial food ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: thaalai vich tai vast oo pa-ee-o har bh ojan amrit  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਿਹ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Eating this, the mind is satisfied, and the Door of Salvation is found.
lines.transliteration: jit khaaDhai man t aripat -ee-ai paa-ee-ai mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: It is so difficult to obtain this food, O Saints; it is obtained only by contemplating the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ih bhojan alabh  hai sant ahu labh ai gur veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਨਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Why should we cast this riddle out of our minds? We should keep it ever enshrined inour hearts.
lines.transliteration: ayh mudaavan ee ki-o vichahu kadh ee-ai sad aa rakh ee-ai ur Dh aar.

lines.english: The True Guru has posed this riddle. The Guru's Sikhs have found its solution.
lines.transliteration: ayh mudaavan ee sat guroo paa-ee gursikh aa laDh ee bh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਲੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਤੈ ਵਸਤੂ  ਪਈਓ  ਹਿਰ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone understands this, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Gurmukhs work hard, and find the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (645-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bujhaa-ay so bujh see har paa-i-aa gurmukh  ghaal. ||1||

lines.english: Those whom the Primal Lord unites, remain in Union with Him; they focus theirconsciousness on the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur maylay say mil rahay sat gur si-o chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅਲਭੁ  ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਲਭੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom the Lord Himself separates, remain separated; in the love of duality, theyare ruined.
lines.transliteration: aap vichhorh ayn say vichh urhay doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਰਖੀਐ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without good karma, what can anyone obtain? He earns what he is pre- destined to receive. ||2|| pauVI ] (645-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vin karmaa ki-aa paa-ee-ai poorab likh i-aa kamaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਲਧੀ  ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Sitting together, the companions sing the Songs of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: bahi sakhee-aa jas gaavahi gavan haaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਸੁ ਬੁਝਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਘਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They praise the Lord's Name continually; they are a sacrifice to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har naam salaahihu nit har ka-o balihaaree-aa.

lines.english: Those who hear, and believe in the Lord's Name, to them I am a sacrifice.
lines.transliteration: jinee sun mani-aa har naa-o t inaa ha-o vaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, let me unite with the Gurmukhs, who are united with You.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhee-aa har mayl milaavan haaree-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who, day and night, behold their Guru. ||8|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (645-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl: pMnw 646
lines.transliteration: ha-o bal jaavaa din raat  gur d aikhanhaaree-aa. ||8||

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, everyone wanders around the world, losing.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh  bharamd ay nit  jag totaa saisaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਿਭ ਭਰਮਦੇ  ਿਨਤ ਜਿਗ  ਤੋਟਾ  ਸੈਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in the pitch black darkness of egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam kamaavn ay ha-umai anDh  gubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (646-2) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh amrit  peevn aa naanak sabad  veechaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵਣਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He wakes in peace, and he sleeps in peace.
lines.transliteration: sehjay jaagai sehjay sovai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh praises the Lord night and day.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh an-d in ust at hovai.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh remains deluded by his doubts.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh armai sahsaa hovai.

lines.english: He is filled with anxiety, and he cannot even sleep.
lines.transliteration: antar chint aa need  na sovai.

lines.english: The spiritually wise wake and sleep in peace.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee jaageh saveh subhaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.||2|| pauVI ] (646-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rati-aa bal jaa-o. ||2||

lines.english: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, who are imbued with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say har naam Dhi-aavahi jo har rat i-aa.

lines.english: They meditate on the One Lord; the One and Only Lord is True.
lines.transliteration: har ik Dhi-aavahi ik iko har sat i-aa.

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; the One Lord created the Universe.
lines.transliteration: har iko vartai ik iko ut pati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, cast out their fears.
lines.transliteration: jo har naam Dhi-aavahi t in dar sat gh ati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself blesses them with Guru's Instruction; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||9|| slok mÚ 3 ] (646-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmatee d ayvai aap gurmukh  har japi-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ  ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਉਤਪਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom, which would bring understanding, does not enter into his mind.
lines.transliteration: antar gi-aan na aa-i-o jit  kichh  sojhee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ ਿਤਨ ਡਰੁ ਸਿਟ ਘਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without seeing, how can he praise the Lord? The blind act in blindness.
lines.transliteration: vin dith aa ki-aa salaahee-ai anDh aa anDh  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਦੇਵੈ ਆਿਪ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when one realizes the Word of the Shabad, then the Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (646-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad pachh aanee-ai naam vasai man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: There is One Bani; there is One Guru; there is one Shabad to contemplate.
lines.transliteration: ikaa banee ik gur iko sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: True is the merchandise, and true is the shop; the warehouses are overflowing withjewels.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sa-udaa hat sach rat nee bh aray bh andaar.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are obtained, if the Great Giver gives them.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay paa-ee-an jay d ayvai d ayvan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dealing in this true merchandise, one earns the profit of the incomparable Naam.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sa-udaa laabh  sadaa kh ati-aa naam apaar.

lines.english: In the midst of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is revealed; by His Mercy, one drinks itin.
lines.transliteration: vikh vich amrit  pargati-aa karam pee-aavan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the True Lord; blessed is the Creator, the Embellisher. ||2|| pauVI ] (646-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach salaahee-ai Dhan savaaran haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ  ਹਟੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਤਨੀ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are permeated by falsehood, do not love the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jinaa andar koorh  vartai sach na bh aav-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਪਾਈਅਿਨ  ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If someone speaks the Truth, falsehood is burnt away.
lines.transliteration: jay ko bolai sach koorhaa jal jaav-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ  ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਖਿਟਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The false are satisfied by falsehood, like the crows who eat manure.
lines.transliteration: khoorh i-aaree rajai koorh  ji-o vistaa kaag kh aav-ee.

lines.english: When the Lord grants His Grace, then one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis har ho-ay kirpaal so naam Dhi-aava-ee.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, worship the Lord's Name in adoration; fraud and sin shall disappear.||10|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (646-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har gurmukh naam araaDh  koorh  paap leh jaav-ee. ||10||

lines.english: O Shaykh, you wander in the four directions, blown by the four winds; bring yourmind back to the home of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: saykhaa cha-uchaki-aa cha-uvaa-i-aa ayhu man ikat  ghar aan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce your petty arguments, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ayharh t ayharh  chhad too gur kaa sabad  pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਜਿਲ ਜਾਵਈ  ॥
lines.english: Bow in humble respect before the True Guru; He is the Knower who knowseverything.
lines.transliteration: satgur agai dh eh pa-o sabh  kichh  jaanai jaan .

lines.english: Burn away your hopes and desires, and live like a guest in this world.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa jalaa-ay too ho-ay rahu mihmaan .

lines.english: If you walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai bhee chaleh t aa dargeh paavahi maan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧ  ਕੂੜੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਵਈ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who do not contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord - cursed aretheir clothes, and cursed is their food. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (646-16) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak je naam na chaytnee t in Dhig painan  Dhig khaan. ||1||

lines.english: There is no end to the Lord's Glorious Praises; His worth cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: har gun t ot na aavee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਖਾ ਚਉਚਿਕਆ  ਚਉਵਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they are absorbed inHis Glorious Virtues. ||2|| pauVI ] (646-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har gun  raveh gun  meh rahai samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੜ  ਤੇਹੜ  ਛਿਡ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has adorned the coat of the body; He has embroidered it with devotionalworship.
lines.transliteration: har cholee dayh savaaree kadh  paiDh ee bh agat kar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਗੈ ਢਿਹ ਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has woven His silk into it, in so many ways and fashions.
lines.transliteration: har paat lagaa aDhikaa-ee baho baho biDh  bhaat kar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਜਲਾਇ  ਤੂ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਿਮਹਮਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: How rare is that man of understanding, who understands, and deliberates within.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee boojhai boojh anhaaraa ant ar bibayk kar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀ ਚਲਿਹ  ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone understands these deliberations, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.
lines.transliteration: so boojhai ayhu bibayk jis bujh aa-ay aap har.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ  ਿਤਨ ਿਧਗੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਿਧਗੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Poor servant Nanak speaks: the Gurmukhs know the Lord, the Lord is True. ||11|| pMnw 647 sloku mÚ 3 ] (647-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kahai vichaaraa gurmukh har sat  har. ||11||

lines.english: Great men speak the teachings by relating them to individual situations, but the wholeworld shares in them.
lines.transliteration: parthaa-ay saakhee mahaa purakh  bolday saajh ee sagal jahaanai.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh knows the Fear of God, and realizes his own self.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay so bh a-o karay aapn aa aap pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਥਾਇ  ਸਾਖੀ  ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ  ਬੋਲਦੇ  ਸਾਝੀ  ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: If, by Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive, the mind becomes content initself.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jeevat marai t aa man hee t ay man maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਉ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have no faith in their own minds, O Nanak - how can they speak ofspiritual wisdom? ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (647-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o man kee parteet  naahee naanak say ki-aa katheh gi-aanai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not focus their consciousness on the Lord, as Gurmukh, suffer pain andgrief in the end.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chit  na laa-i-o ant  dukh pahut aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਿਕਆ  ਕਥਿਹ  ਿਗਆਨੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They are blind, inwardly and outwardly, and they do not understand anything.
lines.transliteration: andrahu baahrahu anDh i-aaN suDh  na kaa-ee paa-ay.

lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, the whole world is fed for the sake of those who areattuned to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: pandit t in kee barkat ee sabh  jagat  khaa-ay jo rat ay har naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਚਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who praise the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain blended with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin gur kai sabad sahaali-aa har si-o rahay samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਿਧਆਂ  ਸੁਿਧ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, no one is satisfied, and no one finds true wealth throughthe love of duality.
lines.transliteration: pandit d oojai bh aa-ay barkat  na hova-ee naa Dh an palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤੀ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਖਾਇ  ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They have grown weary of reading scriptures, but still, they do not find contentment,and they pass their lives burning, night and day.
lines.transliteration: parh thakay sant okh na aa-i-o an-d in jalat  vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਿਹਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their cries and complaints never end, and doubt does not depart from within them.
lines.transliteration: kook pookaar na chuk-ee naa sansaa vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਬਰਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they rise up and depart withblackened faces. ||2|| pauVI ] (647-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihooni-aa muhi kaalai uth  jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Beloved, lead me to meet my True Fr iend; meeting with Him, I shall ask Him to show me the Path.
lines.transliteration: har sajan mayl pi-aaray mil panth d asaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਕ ਪੂਕਾਰ  ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that Friend, who shows it to me.
lines.transliteration: jo har dasay mit  tis ha-o bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਿਣਆ  ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲੈ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I share His Virtues with Him, and meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gun saajh ee tin si-o karee har naam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: I serve my Beloved Lord forever; serving the Lord, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: har sayvee pi-aaraa nit sayv har sukh  paa-ee.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has imparted this understanding to me. ||12|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (647-10) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: balihaaree satgur t is jin sojh ee paa-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਦਸੇ ਿਮਤੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your filth shall not be erased, even if you read the Vedasfor four ages.
lines.transliteration: pandit mail na chuk-ee jay vayd  parhai jug chaar.

lines.english: The three qualities are the roots of Maya; in egotism, one forgets the Naam, theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa mool hai vich ha-umai naam visaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵੀ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਿਨਤ ਸੇਿਵ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits are deluded, attached to duality, and they deal only in Maya.
lines.transliteration: pandit bh oolay d oojai laagay maa-i-aa kai vaapaar.

lines.english: They are filled with thirst and hunger; the ignorant fools starve to death.
lines.transliteration: antar t arisnaa bh ukh hai moorakh  bhukhi-aa mu-ay gavaar.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai sukh  paa-i-aa sachai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਜੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Hunger and thirst have departed from within me; I am in love with the True Name.
lines.transliteration: andrahu t arisnaa bh ukh ga-ee sachai naa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, who keep the Lord clasped tightly totheir hearts, are automatically satisfied. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (647-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sehjay rajay jinaa har rakh i-aa ur Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਭੂਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਵਾਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh does not serve the Lord's Name, and so he suffers inhorrible pain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh har naam na sayvi-aa d ukh lagaa bahut aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਿਖਆ  ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He is filled with the darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand anything.
lines.transliteration: antar agi-aan anDh ayr hai suDh  na kaa-ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Because of his stubborn mind, he does not plant the seeds of intuitive peace; whatwill he eat in the world hereafter, to satisfy his hunger?
lines.transliteration: manhath sahj na beeji-o bh ukhaa ke agai kh aa-ay.

lines.english: He has forgotten the treasure of the Naam; he is caught in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan visaari-aa d oojai lagaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਜੇ ਿਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are honored with glory, when the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||2|| pauVI ] (647-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mileh vad i-aa-ee-aa jay aapay mayl milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The tongue which sings the Lord's Praises, is so very beautiful.
lines.transliteration: har rasnaa har jas gaavai kharee suhaavan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ  ਬਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who speaks the Lord's Name, with mind, body and mouth, is pleasing to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo man tan mukh  har bolai saa har bh aavnee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਿਧ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: That Gurmukh tastes the the sublime taste of the Lord, and is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: jo gurmukh chakh ai saad  saa t ariptaavnee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਨ ਬੀਿਜਓ  ਭੁਖਾ ਿਕ ਅਗੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She sings continually the Glorious Praises of her Beloved; singing His Glorious Praises,she is uplifted.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai pi-aaray nit  gun gaa-ay gun ee samjh aavan ee.

lines.english: She is blessed with the Lord's Mercy, and she chants the Words of the Guru, the TrueGuru. ||13|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (647-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis hovai aap da-i-aal saa sat guroo guroo bulaavan ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਜੇ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The elephant offers its head to the reins, and the anvil offers itself to the hammer;
lines.transliteration: hastee sir ji-o ankas hai ahran  ji-o sir d ay-ay.

lines.english: Him. pMnw 648
lines.transliteration: man tan aagai raakh  kai oobh ee sayv karay-i. just so, we offer our minds and bodies to our Guru; we stand before Him, and serve

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਕੈ ਊਭੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: This is how the Gurmukhs eliminate their self-conceit, and come to rule the whole world.
lines.transliteration: i-o gurmukh aap nivaaree-ai sabh  raaj sarisat kaa lay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (648-2) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh bujh ee-ai jaa aapay nad ar karay-i. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਜਾ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Blessed and approved is the coming into the world, of those Gurmukhs who meditateon the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-i-aa aa-ay t ay parvaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, they save their families, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (648-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kul uDhaareh aapn aa dargeh paavahi maan . ||2||

lines.english: The Guru unites His Sikhs, the Gurmukhs, with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sakh ee-aa sikh  guroo maylaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru keeps some of them with Himself, and engages others in His Service.
lines.transliteration: ik sayvak gur paas ik gur kaarai laa-ee-aa.

lines.english: Those who cherish their Beloved in their conscious minds, the Guru blesses them withHis Love.
lines.transliteration: jinaa gur pi-aaraa man chit t inaa bh aa-o guroo d ayvaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: The Guru loves all of His Gursikhs equally well, like friends, children and siblings.
lines.transliteration: gur sikhaa iko pi-aar gur mit aa put aa bh aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ਇਿਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: So chant the Name of the Guru, the True Guru, everyone! Chanting the Name of theGuru, Guru, you shall be rejuvenated. ||14|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (648-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur satgur bolhu sabh  gur aakh  guroo jeevaa-ee-aa. ||14||

lines.english: O Nanak, the blind, ignorant fools do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord;they involve themselves in other activities.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na chaytnee agi-aanee anDh ulay avray karam kamaahi.

lines.english: They are bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death; they arepunished, and in the end, they rot away in manure. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (648-7) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jam dar baDh ay maaree-ah fir vistaa maahi pachaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਿਭ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਿਖ  ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings are true and approved, who serve their True Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur sayveh aapn aa say jan sachay parvaan .

lines.english: They remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord, and their comings and goings cease. ||2|| pauVI ] (648-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har kai naa-ay samaa-ay rahay chookaa aavan jaan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਅਵਰੇ  ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan sampai maa-i-aa sanchee-ai ant ay dukh-daa-ee. Gathering the wealth and property of Maya, brings only pain in the end.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਪਚਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Homes, mansions and adorned palaces will not go with anyone.
lines.transliteration: ghar mand ar mahal savaaree-ah kichh  saath na jaa-ee.

lines.english: He may breed horses of various colors, but these will not be of any use to him.
lines.transliteration: har rangee turay nit  paalee-ah kit ai kaam na aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: O human, link your consciousness to the Lord's Name, and in the end, it shall be yourcompanion and helper.
lines.transliteration: jan laavhu chit har naam si-o ant  ho-ay sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ  ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh is blessedwith peace. ||15|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (648-11) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa gurmukh  sukh  paa-ee. ||15||

lines.english: Without the karma of good actions, the Name is not obtained; it can be obtained onlyby perfect good karma.
lines.transliteration: bin karmai naa-o na paa-ee-ai poorai karam paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੰਚੀਐ  ਅੰਤੇ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then under Guru's Instruction, one isunited in His Union. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (648-12) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar karay jay aapn ee taa gurmat  mayl milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮਹਲ  ਸਵਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Some are cremated, and some are buried; some are eaten by dogs.
lines.transliteration: ik dajh eh ik d abee-ah iknaa kut ay kh aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਿਨਤ  ਪਾਲੀਅਿਹ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Some are thrown into water, while others are thrown into wells.
lines.transliteration: ik paanee vich ustee-ah ik bh ee fir hasan  paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਿਚਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਅੰਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it is not known, where they go and into what they merge. ||2|| pauVI ] (648-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayv na jaap-ee kithai jaa-ay samaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The food and clothes, and all the worldly possessions of those who are attuned to theLord's Name are sacred. iqn ky Gr mMdr mhl srweI siB pivqu hih ijnI gurmuiK syvk isK AiBAwgq jwie vrswqy ] (648-15, soriT, mÚ 1) tin kay gh ar mand ar mahal saraa-ee sabh  pavit  heh jinee gurmukh  sayvak sikh  abhi- aagat jaa-ay varsaat ay. All the homes, temples, palaces and way-stations are sacred, where the Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, the Sikhs and the renouncers of the world, go and take theirrest.
lines.transliteration: tin kaa kh aaDhaa paiDh aa maa-i-aa sabh  pavit  hai jo naam har raat ay.

lines.english: 1) tin kay t uray jeen kh urgeer sabh  pavit  heh jinee gurmukh  sikh saaDh  sant charh jaatay. All the horses, saddles and horse blankets are sacred, upon which the Gurmukhs, the Sikhs, the Holy and the Saints, mount and ride.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਕਰਮੈ  ਨਾਉ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: 1) tin kay karam Dh aram kaaraj sabh  pavit  heh jo boleh har har raam naam har saat ay. All the rituals and Dharmic practices and deeds are sacred, for those who utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs, those Sikhs, who have purity as their treasure, go to their Guru.||16|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (648-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin kai potai punn hai say gurmukh  sikh guroo peh jaat ay. ||16||

lines.english: O Nanak, forsaking the Name, he loses everything, in this world and the next.
lines.transliteration: naanak naavhu ghuthi-aa halat  palat  sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਦਝਿਹ  ਇਕ ਦਬੀਅਿਹ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਕੁਤੇ ਖਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting, deep meditation and austere self-disciplined practices are all wasted; he isdeceived by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam sabh  hir la-i-aa muth ee doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਉਸਟੀਅਿਹ  ਇਿਕ  ਭੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਹਸਿਣ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He is bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death. He is beaten, and receives terrible punishment. ||1|| pMnw 649 mÚ 3 ] (649-1) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jam dar baDh ay maaree-ah bahut ee milai sajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: They inflict their hatred upon the Saints, and they love the wicked sinners.
lines.transliteration: santaa naal vair kamaavd ay dustaa naal moh pi-aar.

lines.english: They find no peace in either this world or the next; they are born only to die, againand again.
lines.transliteration: agai pichhai sukh  nahee mar jameh vaaro vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਿਲ  ਵੈਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਦੁਸਟਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਮੋਹੁ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Their hunger is never satisfied, and they are ruined by duality.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa kad ay na bujh -ee dubiDh aa ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The faces of these slanderers are blackened in the Court of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: muh kaalay tinaa nind kaa tit sachai d arbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, they find no shelter on either this shore, or the onebeyond. ||2|| pauVI ] (649-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihooni-aa naa urvaar na paar. ||2||

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, are imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their minds.
lines.transliteration: jo har naam Dhi-aa-id ay say har har naam rat ay man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਿਣਆ  ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: For those who worship the One Lord in their conscious minds, there is no other thanthe One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinaa man chit ik araaDh i-aa tinaa ikas bin d oojaa ko naahee.

lines.english: They alone serve the Lord, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny iswritten.
lines.transliteration: say-ee purakh har sayvd ay jin Dh ur mast ak laykh  likhaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: They continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and singing the Glories of theGlorious Lord, they are uplifted.
lines.transliteration: har kay gun nit  gaavd ay har gun  gaa-ay gun ee samjh aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਇਕਸ  ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Great is the greatness of the Gurmukhs, who, through the Perfect Guru, remainabsorbed in the Lord's Name. ||17|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (649-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadi-aa-ee vadee gurmukhaa gur poorai har naam samaahee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਿਜਨ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਖਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru; offer your head, and eradicate self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa gaakh -rhee sir d eejai aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਤ  ਗਾਵਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਝਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service istotally approved.
lines.transliteration: sabad mareh fir naa mareh t aa sayvaa pavai sabh  thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਵਡੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Touching the philosopher's stone, one becomes the philosopher's stone, whichtransforms lead into gold; remain lovingly attached to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: paaras parsi-ai paaras hovai sach rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes to meet the True Guru and God.
lines.transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhi-aa t is satgur milai parabh  aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ  ਿਸਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's servant does not meet Him because of his own account; he aloneis acceptable, whom the Lord forgives. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (649-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gantai sayvak naa milai jis bakh say so pavai thaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ ਨਾ ਮਰਿਹ  ਤਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The fools do not know the difference between good and bad; they are deceived bytheir self-interests.
lines.transliteration: mahal kumhal na jaannee moorakh  apnai su-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਸ  ਪਰਿਸਐ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But if they contemplate the Word of the Shabad, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence, and their light merges in the Light.
lines.transliteration: sabad cheeneh t aa mahal laheh jot ee jot  samaa-ay.

lines.english: The Fear of God is always on their minds, and so they come to understand everything.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sachay kaa bh a-o man vasai t aa sabh aa sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗਣਤੈ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਨਾ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ  ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru is pervading the homes within; He Himself blends them with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur apn ai ghar varatd aa aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they meet the True Guru, and all their desires are fulfilled, if the Lord grantsHis Grace and so wills. ||2|| pauVI ] (649-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai sabh  pooree pa-ee jis no kirpaa karay rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲੁ  ਕੁਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਪਣੈ  ਸੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an bh aag tinaa bh agat janaa jo har naamaa har mukh  kehti-aa. Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those devotees, who, with their mouths, utter the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੀਨਿਹ  ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਲਹਿਹ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an bh aag tinaa sant  janaa jo har jas sarvan ee sunt i-aa. Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Saints, who, with their ears, listen to theLord's Praises.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an bh aag tinaa saaDh  janaa har keert an gaa-ay gun ee jan bant i-aa. Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those holy people, who sing the Kirtan of theLord's Praises, and so become virtuous.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an bh aag tinaa gurmukh aa jo gursikh  lai man jint i-aa. Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who live as Gursikhs, andconquer their minds.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: But the greatest good fortune of all, is that of the Guru's Sikhs, who fall at the Guru'sfeet. ||18|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (649-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh d oo vaday bh aag gursikh aa kay jo gur charn ee sikh  parh-ti-aa. ||18||

lines.english: One who knows God, and who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Word of theShabad, keeps his spirituality intact.
lines.transliteration: barahm bindai t is daa barahmat  rahai ayk sabad  liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਿਤਨਾ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਕਹਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: The nine treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers of the Siddhas follow him, who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart.
lines.transliteration: nav niDhee ath aarah siDh ee pichh ai lagee-aa fireh jo har hird ai sad aa vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਿਤਨਾ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਸੁਣਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the Name is not found; understand this, and reflect upon it.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur naa-o na paa-ee-ai bujh ahu kar veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਿਤਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਜਨ ਬਣਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through perfect good destiny, one meets the True Guru, and finds peace,throughout the four ages. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (649-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorai bhaag sat gur milai sukh  paa-ay jug chaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਿਤਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਜੋ ਗੁ ਰਿਸਖ  ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਜਣਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Whether he is young or old, the self-willed manmukh cannot escape hunger andthirst.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gabhroo ki-aa biraDh  hai manmukh  tarisnaa bh ukh na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਸਖ ਪੜਿਤਆ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they are at peace, havinglost their self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabd ay rat i-aa seet al ho-ay aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: They are satisfied and satiated within; they never feel hungry again. pMnw 650
lines.transliteration: andar t aripat  santokhi-aa fir bh ukh na lagai aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, whatever the Gurmukhs do is acceptable; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (650-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak je gurmukh karahi so parvaan  hai jo naam rahay liv laa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tinn kaN-u jo gurmukh  sikhaa.

lines.english: I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jo har naam Dhi-aa-id ay tin darsan pikh aa.

lines.english: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.
lines.transliteration: sun keert an har gun  ravaa har jas man likh aa.

lines.english: I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.
lines.transliteration: har naam salaahee rang si-o sabh kilvikh  krikh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਿਲਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an suhaavaa so sareer thaan hai jithai mayraa gur Dh aray vikh aa. ||19|| Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places Hisfeet. ||19|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (650-4) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abidein the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur bin gi-aan na hova-ee naa sukh vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਸੋ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਿਵਖਾ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart,after having wasted their lives. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (650-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihoonay manmukh ee jaasan janam gavaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; they have grownweary of concentrating and focusing their attention.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik naavai no sabh  khojday thak rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; the Gurmukhs unite in Union with theLord.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kinai na paa-i-o gurmukh  milai milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ  ਜਾਸਿਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name, all food and clothes are worthless; cursed is such spirituality, andcursed are such miraculous powers.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai painan kh aan sabh  baad  hai Dh ig siDh ee Dh ig karmaat .

lines.english: That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lordspontaneously bestows.
lines.transliteration: saa siDh saa karmaat  hai achint  karay jis d aat.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਿਭ ਖੋਜਦੇ  ਥਿਕ ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; this is spirituality, andthis is miraculous power. ||2|| pauVI ] (650-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har naam man vasai ayhaa siDh  ayhaa karmaat . ||2||

lines.english: I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord'sGlorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: ham dhaadh ee har parabh  khasam kay nit  gaavah har gun  chhantaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ  ਸਭੁ ਬਾਿਦ  ਹੈ ਿਧਗੁ ਿਸਧੀ  ਿਧਗੁ ਕਰਮਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.
lines.transliteration: har keertan karah har jas sun ah tis kavlaa kant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਿਸਿਧ  ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਿਤ  ਹੈ ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures arebeggars.
lines.transliteration: har daat aa sabh  jagat  bhikhaaree-aa mangat  jan jant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਏਹਾ ਿਸਿਧ  ਏਹਾ ਕਰਮਾਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms andinsects among the rocks.
lines.transliteration: har dayvhu d aan d a-i-aal ho-ay vich paathar kiram jant aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he hasbecome truly wealthy. ||20|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (650-11) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa gurmukh  Dhanvant aa. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਢਾਢੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਖਸਮ  ਕੇ ਿਨਤ  ਗਾਵਹ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.
lines.transliteration: parh-n aa gurh -naa sansaar kee kaar hai and ar tarisnaa vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਹ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ  ਕੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they areruined.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich sabh parh  thakay d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਭਖਾਰੀਆ  ਮੰਗਤ  ਜਨ ਜੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word ofthe Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: so parhi-aa so pandit  beenaa gur sabad  karay veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਹੋਇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਾਥਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਮ ਜੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.
lines.transliteration: andar kh ojai tat lahai paa-ay mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan har paa-i-aa sahj karay veechaar.

lines.english: Dhan vaapaaree naankaa jis gurmukh  naam aDh aar. ||1|| Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (650-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਪੜਣਾ  ਗੁੜਣਾ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate onit.
lines.transliteration: vin man maaray ko-ay na sijh -ee vaykh hu ko liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਿਭ ਪਿੜ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; theyhave not been able to conquer their minds.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh -Dhaaree t eerthee bh av thakay naa ayhu man maari-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਿੜਆ  ਸੋ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਬੀਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ayhu man jeevat  marai sach rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burnsaway the ego. ||2|| pauVI ] (650-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak is man kee mal i-o utrai ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.
lines.transliteration: har har sant milhu mayray bh aa-ee har naam d arirhaavahu ik kinkaa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har;let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.
lines.transliteration: har har seegaar banaavahu har jan har kaaparh pahirahu kh im kaa.

lines.english: Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa seegaar mayray parabh bh aavai har laagai pi-aaraa parim kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਸਝਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins areeradicated.
lines.transliteration: har har naam bolhu din raat ee sabh  kilbikh  kaatai ik palkaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ  ਤੀਰਥੀ  ਭਿਵ ਥਕੇ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21|| pMnw 651 sloku mÚ 3 ] (651-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har da-i-aal hovai jis upar so gurmukh  har jap jin kaa. ||21||

lines.english: The filth of countless incarnations sticks to this mind; it has become pitch black.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee is man ka-o mal laagee kaalaa ho-aa si-aahu.

lines.english: The oily rag cannot be cleaned by merely washing it, even if it is washed a hundredtimes.
lines.transliteration: khanlee Dh otee ujlee na hova-ee jay sa-o Dh ovan paahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਕਾਲਾ  ਹੋਆ  ਿਸਆਹੁ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive; his intellect is transformed, and he becomes detached from the world.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jeevat marai ultee hovai mat  badlaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਨਲੀ  ਧੋਤੀ ਉਜਲੀ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਿਣ  ਪਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, no filth sticks to him, and he does not fall into the womb again. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (651-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mail na lag-ee naa fir jonee paahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਉਲਟੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮਿਤ ਬਦਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Kali Yuga is called the Dark Age, but the most sublime state is attained in this age.
lines.transliteration: chahu jugee kal kaalee kaaNdhee ik ut am pad vee is jug maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਨਾ ਿਫਿਰ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the fruit, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this is his destiny,ordained by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har keerat  fal paa-ee-ai jin ka-o har likh  paahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, he worships the Lord night and day; he chants the Lord'sName, and remains absorbed in the Lord's devotional worship. ||2|| pauVI ] (651-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur parsaadee an-din bh agat har uchrahi har bh agtee maahi samaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ  ਕਿਲ  ਕਾਲੀ  ਕਢੀ  ਇਕ ਉਤਮ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, so that with mymouth, I may speak the sublime Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: har har mayl saaDh jan sangat  mukh  bolee har har bh alee baan .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and constantly chant the Lord's Name; throughthe Guru's Teachings, I enjoy the Lord's Love constantly.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavaa har nit  chavaa gurmat ee har rang sad aa maan .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਉਚਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I take the medicine of meditation on the Lord's Name, which has cured all diseases and multitudes of sufferings.
lines.transliteration: har jap jap a-ukhaDh  khaaDhi-aa sabh  rog gavaat ay dukhaa gh aan.

lines.english: Those who do not forget the Lord, while breathing or eating - know them to be theperfect servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visrai say har jan pooray sahee jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Lord in adoration end their subservience to theMessenger of Death, and to the world. ||22|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (651-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo gurmukh har aaraaDh aday tin chookee jam kee jagat  kaan . ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਤ ਚਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: O man, you have been tormented by a nightmare, and you have passed your life insleep.
lines.transliteration: ray jan uthaarai dabi-ohu sut i-aa ga-ee vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਅਉਖਧ  ਖਾਿਧਆ  ਸਿਭ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਤੇ  ਦੁਖਾ ਘਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: You did not wake to hear the Word of the True Guru's Shabad; you have noinspiration within yourself.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa sabad  sun na jaagi-o ant ar na upji-o chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: That body burns, which has no virtue, and which does not serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sareer jala-o gun baahraa jo gur kaar na kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਚੂਕੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ  ਕਾਿਣ ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: I have seen that the world is burning, in egotism and the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: jagat jaland aa dith  mai ha-umai d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who seek the Guru's Sanctuary are saved; within their minds, they meditate on the True Word of the Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (651-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur sarnaa-ee ubray sach man sabad  Dhi-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਉਥਾਰੈ  ਦਿਬਓਹੁ ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਗਈ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the soul-bride is rid of egotism, and she isglorified.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay ha-umai ga-ee sobh aavant ee naar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਿਣ ਨ ਜਾਿਗਓ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: If she walks steadily in the way of His Will, then she is adorned with decorations.
lines.transliteration: pir kai bhaan ai sad aa chalai t aa bani-aa seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਲਉ  ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Her couch becomes beautiful, and she constantly enjoys her Husband Lord; sheobtains the Lord as her Husband.
lines.transliteration: sayj suhaavee sadaa pir raavai har var paa-i-aa naar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ  ਜਲੰਦਾ ਿਡਠੁ ਮੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord does not die, and she never suffers pain; she is a happy soul-bride forever.
lines.transliteration: naa har marai na kaday d ukh laagai sad aa suhaagan  naar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord God unites her with Himself; she enshrines love and affection forthe Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (651-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak har parabh mayl la-ee gur kai hayt  pi-aar. ||2||

lines.english: Those who conceal and deny their Guru, are the most evil people.
lines.transliteration: jinaa gur gopi-aa aapnaa t ay nar buri-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ ਰਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ  ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, let me not even see them; they are the worst sinners and murderers.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tin kaa d arsan naa karahu paapisat hat i-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਬਿਨਆ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They wander from house to house, with impure minds, like wicked, forsaken women.
lines.transliteration: ohi ghar gh ar fireh kusuDh  man ji-o Dh arkat naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸਦਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਹਿਰ  ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: But by great good fortune, they may meet the Company of the Holy; as Gurmukhs, they are reformed.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee sangat  milay gurmukh  savaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please be kind and let me meet the True Guru; I am a sacrifice to the Guru.||23|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (651-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har maylhu satgur d a-i-aa kar gur ka-o balihaaree. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਿਲ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, peace is produced, and then, one does not suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sukh  oopjai fir d ukh na lagai aa-ay.

lines.english: The cycle of birth and death is brought to an end, and death has no power over at all.
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa mit ga-i-aa kaalai kaa kichh  na basaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਿਪਆ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਤੇ ਨਰ ਬੁਿਰਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: His mind is imbued with the Lord, and he remains merged in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: har saytee man rav rahi-aa sachay rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਾਿਪਸਟ  ਹਿਤਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who walk in the Way of the True Guru's Will. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (651-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-o balihaaree tinn ka-o jo chalan sat gur bh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਹ ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਕੁਸੁਧ  ਮਿਨ ਿਜਉ  ਧਰਕਟ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, purity is not obtained, even though the soul-bridemay adorn herself with all sorts of decorations. pMnw 652
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai suDh  na hova-ee jay anayk karai seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: She does not know the value of her Husband Lord; she is attached to the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: pir kee saar na jaan-ee d oojai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਕੁਸੁਧ  ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਰੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕੁਨਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She is impure, and ill-mannered, O Nanak; among women, she is the most evilwoman. ||2|| pauVI ] (652-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: saa kusuDh saa kulkh anee naanak naaree vich kunaar. ||2||

lines.english: Be kind to me, Lord, that I might chant the Word of Your Bani.
lines.transliteration: har har apnee d a-i-aa kar har bolee bain ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਪਣੀ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲੀ  ਬੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: May I meditate on the Lord's Name, chant the Lord's Name, and obtain the profit ofthe Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aa-ee har uchraa har laahaa lain ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਉਚਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night.
lines.transliteration: jo japday har har d inas raat  tin ha-o kurbain ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਿਤਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: May I behold with my eyes those who worship and adore my Beloved True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur mayraa pi-aaraa araaDh i-aa tin jan d aykhaa nain ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਅਰਾਿਧਆ ਿਤਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has united me with my Lord, my friend, my very best friend. ||24|| sloku mÚ 4 ] (652-5) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaari-aa apnay guroo ka-o jin mayraa har sajan  mayli-aa sain ee. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਅਪਣੇ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਿਜਿਨ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਸੈਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: The Lord loves His slaves; the Lord is the friend of His slaves.
lines.transliteration: har daasan si-o pareet  hai har d aasan ko mit .

lines.english: The Lord is under the control of His slaves, like the musical instrument under thecontrol of the musician.
lines.transliteration: har daasan kai vas hai ji-o jant ee kai vas jant .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੋ ਿਮਤੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's slaves meditate on the Lord; they love their Beloved.
lines.transliteration: har kay daas har Dh i-aa-id ay kar pareet am si-o nayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਿਜਉ  ਜੰਤੀ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Please, hear me, O God - let Your Grace rain over the whole world.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kar kai sunhu parabh sabh  jag meh varsai mayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The praise of the Lord's slaves is the Glory of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo har daasan kee ust at hai saa har kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਸੈ  ਮੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord loves His Own Glory, and so His humble servant is celebrated and hailed.
lines.transliteration: har aapnee vadi-aa-ee bh aavdee jan kaa jaikaar karaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੀ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਹੈ ਸਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: That humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Lord, and the Lord's humble servant, are one and the same.
lines.transliteration: so har jan naam Dhi-aa-id aa har har jan ik samaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪਣੀ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਭਾਵਦੀ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; O Lord, O God, please, preserve his honor.||1|| mÚ 4 ] (652-9) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har paij rakh ahu bh agvaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak loves the True Lord; without Him, he cannot even survive.
lines.transliteration: naanak pareet laa-ee t in saachai t is bin rahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the Perfect Lord, and the tongue enjoys the sublimeessence of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (652-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a pooraa paa-ee-ai har ras rasan rasaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Night and day, morning and night, I sing to You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas parbh aat toohai hee gaavn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਈ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਾਚੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures meditate on Your Name.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sarbat  naa-o t ayraa Dh i-aavan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਈ  ॥੨॥
