lines.english: You are the Giver, the Great Giver; we eat whatever You give us.
lines.transliteration: too daataa daataar tayraa d itaa kh aavnaa.

lines.english: In the congregation of the devotees, sins are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kai sang paap gavaavn aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, O Lord. ||25|| sloku mÚ 4 ] (652-12) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaarai bal bal jaavn aa. ||25||

lines.english: He has spiritual ignorance within, and his intellect is dull and dim; he does not placehis faith in the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: antar agi-aan bh a-ee mat  maDh im sat gur kee part eet naahee.

lines.english: He has deceit within himself, and so he sees deception in all others; through hisdeceptions, he is totally ruined.
lines.transliteration: andar kapat sabh  kapto kar jaan ai kaptay kh apeh kh apaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru's Will does not enter into his consciousness, and so he wandersaround, pursuing his own interests.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa chit  na aavai aapn ai su-aa-ay firaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਵਣਾ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: If He grants His Grace, then Nanak is absorbed into the Word of the Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (652-15) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay jay aapnee t aa naanak sabad  samaahee. ||1||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; in the loveof duality, their minds are unsteady.
lines.transliteration: manmukh maa-i-aa mohi vi-aapay d oojai bh aa-ay manoo-aa thir naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਭਈ ਮਿਤ ਮਿਧਮ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are burning; day and night, they are totally ruined by their egotism.
lines.transliteration: an-din jalat  raheh d in raat ee ha-umai kh apeh kh apaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕਪਟੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਪਟੋ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕਪਟੇ ਖਪਿਹ  ਖਪਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Within them, is the total pitch darkness of greed, and no one even approaches them.
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  mahaa gubaaraa t in kai nikat na ko-ee jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਸੁਆਇ  ਿਫਰਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: They themselves are miserable, and they never find peace; they are born, only to die,and die again.
lines.transliteration: o-ay aap dukh ee sukh  kabhoo na paavahi janam mareh mar jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord God forgives those, who focus their consciousness on theGuru's feet. ||2|| pauVI ] (652-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhas la-ay parabh  saachaa je gur charnee chit  laahi. ||2||

lines.english: That Saint, that devotee, is acceptable, who is loved by God.
lines.transliteration: sant bh agat parvaan  jo parabh  bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਮਨੂਆ ਿਥਰੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those beings are wise, who meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say-ee bichkhan  jant jinee har Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਲਤ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਖਪਿਹ  ਖਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They eat the food, the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam niDh aan bh ojan kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ  ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to their foreheads. pMnw 653
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee Dh oor mast ak laa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are purified, bathing in the sacred shrine of the Lord. ||26|| sloku mÚ 4 ] (653-1) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bha-ay puneet  har t irath naa-i-aa. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਹਿਰ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਇਆ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Within the Gurmukh is peace and tranquility; his mind and body are absorbed in theNaam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar saaNt hai man t an naam samaa-ay.

lines.english: He contemplates the Naam, he studies the Naam, and he remains lovingly absorbed inthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: naamo chitvai naam parh ai naam rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He obtains the treasure of the Naam, and his anxiety is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paa-i-aa chint aa ga-ee bilaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam wells up, and his thirst and hunger are completelyrelieved.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai naam oopjai t isnaa bh ukh sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, he gathers in the Naam. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (653-4) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naamay rati-aa naamo palai paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who is cursed by the True Guru, abandons his home, and wanders around aimlessly.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  je maari-aa bh aram bh armi-aa gh ar chh od ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੇ ਰਿਤਆ  ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is jeered at, and his face is blackened in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: os pichhai vajai fakrh ee muhu kaalaa aagai bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: He babbles incoherently, and foaming at the mouth, he dies.
lines.transliteration: os aral baral muhhu niklai nit jh agoo sutd aa mu-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਿਜ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮਆ  ਘਰੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: What can anyone do? Such is his destiny, according to his past deeds.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa hovai kisai hee dai keet ai jaaN Dhur kirat  os daa ayho jayhaa pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸੁ ਿਪਛੈ ਵਜੈ ਫਕੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ  ਆਗੈ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever he goes, he is a liar, and by telling lies, he not liked by anyone.
lines.transliteration: jithai oh jaa-ay tithai oh jh oothaa koorh  bolay kisai na bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸੁ ਅਰਲੁ  ਬਰਲੁ  ਮੁਹਹੁ ਿਨਕਲੈ  ਿਨਤ  ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟਦਾ  ਮੁਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, behold this, the glorious greatness of our Lord and Master, OSaints; as one behaves, so does he receive.
lines.transliteration: vaykhhu bh aa-ee vadi-aa-ee har sant ahu su-aamee apunay kee jaisaa ko-ee karai taisaa ko-ee paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਕਸੈ ਹੀ ਦੈ ਕੀਤੈ  ਜ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਓਸ ਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This shall be God's determination in His True Court; servant Nanak predicts andproclaims this. ||2|| pauVI ] (653-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ayhu barahm beechaar hovai dar saachai ago d ay jan naanak aakh  sunaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ਿਤਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has established the village; the Guru has appointed its guards andprotectors.
lines.transliteration: gur sachai baDhaa thayhu rakh vaalay gur d itay.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕੀ ਜੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: My hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is imbued with the love of the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: pooran ho-ee aas gur charnee man rat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru is infinitely merciful; He has erased all my sins.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal bay-ant avgun  sabh  hatay.

lines.english: The Guru has showered me with His Mercy, and He has made me His own.
lines.transliteration: gur apnee kirpaa Dh aar apn ay kar lit ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਬਧਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਦਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has countless virtues. ||27|| slok mÚ 1 ] (653-11) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sad balihaar jis gur kay gun  itay. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਆਸ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨ ਰਤੇ ॥
lines.english: By His Command, we receive our pre-ordained rewards; so what can we do now, OPandit?
lines.transliteration: taa kee rajaa-ay laykh i-aa paa-ay ab ki-aa keejai paaNday.

lines.english: When His Command is received, then it is decided; all beings move and actaccordingly. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (653-12) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hukam ho-aa haasal tad ay ho-ay nibrh i-aa handh eh jee-a kamaaNday. ||1||

lines.english: The string through the nose is in the hands of the Lord Master; one's own actionsdrive him on.
lines.transliteration: nak nath khasam hath kirat  Dhakay d ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਇਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Wherever his food is, there he eats it; O Nanak, this is the Truth. ||2|| pauVI ] (653-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jahaa daan ay tahaaN khaanay naankaa sach hay. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord Himself puts everything in its proper place.
lines.transliteration: sabhay galaa aap thaat bahaalee-on.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ  ਲੇਿਖਆ  ਪਾਇ  ਅਬ ਿਕਆ  ਕੀਜੈ  ਪਡੇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself destroys it.
lines.transliteration: aapay rachan rachaa-ay aapay hee ghaali-on.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ  ਹਾਸਲੁ  ਤਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਿਨਬਿੜਆ  ਹੰਢਿਹ  ਜੀਅ  ਕਮਦੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself fashions His creatures, and He Himself nourishes them.
lines.transliteration: aapay jant upaa-ay aap part ipaali-on.

lines.english: He hugs His slaves close in His embrace, and blesses them with His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: daas rakh ay kanth  laa-ay nad ar nihaali-on.

lines.punjabi: ਨਿਕ ਨਥ ਖਸਮ  ਹਥ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਧਕੇ ਦੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, His devotees are forever in bliss; they have burnt away the love of duality. ||28|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (653-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt aa sad aa anand bh aa-o d oojaa jaali-on. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹਾ ਦਾਣੇ  ਤਹ ਖਾਣੇ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਚੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O mind, meditate on the Dear Lord, with single-minded conscious concentration.
lines.transliteration: ay man har jee Dhi-aa-ay t oo ik man ik chit  bhaa-ay.

lines.english: The glorious greatness of the Lord shall last forever and ever; He never regrets what He gives.
lines.transliteration: har kee-aa sadaa sad aa vad i-aa-ee-aa d ay-ay na pachh otaa-ay.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord; serving Him, peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: ha-o har kai sad balihaarn ai jit sayvi-ai sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਘਾਿਲਓਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains merged with the Lord; he burns away his ego throughthe Word of the Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (653-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mil rahai ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself enjoins us to serve Him, and He Himself blesses us with forgiveness.
lines.transliteration: aapay sayvaa laa-i-an aapay bakhas karay-i.

lines.english: He Himself is the father and mother of all; He Himself cares for us.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa maa pi-o aap hai aapay saar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ  ਜਾਿਲਓਨੁ ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abide in the home of their inner being; they are honored throughout the ages. ||2|| pauVI ] (653-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-in t in nij gh ar vaas hai jug jug sobh aa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: You are the Creator, all-powerful, able to do anything. Without You, there is no other at all. pMnw 654
lines.transliteration: too karan  kaaran  samrath heh kart ay mai t ujh bin avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਹ ਕਰਤੇ  ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself shall destroy it in the end.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay sisat sirjee-aa aapay fun go-ee.

lines.english: The Word of Your Shabad alone is pervading everywhere; whatever You do, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: sabh iko sabad  varatd aa jo karay so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: God blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness, and then, he finds the Lord. gurmuiK nwnk AwrwiDAw siB AwKhu DMnu  DMnu DMnu guru soeI ]29]1] suDu (654-2, soriT, mÚ 3) gurmukh naanak aaraaDh i-aa sabh  aakh ahu Dh an Dh an Dh an gur so-ee. ||29||1|| suDhu As Gurmukh, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; let everyone proclaim, "Blessed, blessed, blessed is He, the Guru!"||29||1||Sudh|| rwgu soriT bwxI Bgq kbIr jI kI Gru 1  (654-4) raag sorath ban ee bh agat kabeer jee kee gh ar 1 Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (654-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: vadi-aa-ee gurmukh d ay-ay parabh  har paavai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Worshipping their idols, the Hindus die; the Muslims die bowing their heads.
lines.transliteration: but pooj pooj hind oo moo-ay t urak moo-ay sir naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ ਸਿਭ ਆਖਹੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੯॥੧॥
lines.english: The Hindus cremate their dead, while the Muslims bury theirs; neither finds Your truestate, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: o-ay lay jaaray o-ay lay gaaday tayree gat  duhoo na paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, the world is a deep, dark pit.
lines.transliteration: man ray sansaar anDh gahayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਤ ਪੂਿਜ ਪੂਿਜ ਿਹੰਦੂ ਮੂਏ ਤੁਰਕ  ਮੂਏ ਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: On all four sides, Death has spread his net. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chahu dis pasri-o hai jam jayvraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਲੇ ਜਾਰੇ ਓਇ ਲੇ ਗਾਡੇ  ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਦੁਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Reciting their poems, the poets die; the mystical ascetics die while journeying to Kaydaar Naat'h.
lines.transliteration: kabit parh ay parh  kabit aa moo-ay kaparh  kayd aarai jaa-ee.

lines.english: The Yogis die, with their matted hair, but even they do not find Your state, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jataa Dhaar Dh aar jogee moo-ay t ayree gat  ineh na paa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The kings die, gathering and hoarding their money, burying great quantities of gold.
lines.transliteration: darab sanch sanch raajay moo-ay gad lay kanchan bh aaree.

lines.english: The Pandits die, reading and reciting the Vedas; women die, gazing at their ownbeauty. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bayd parh ay parh  pandit  moo-ay roop d aykh daykh naaree. ||3||

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, all come to ruin; behold, and know this, O body.
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin sabhai bigoot ay daykhhu nirakh  sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਬਤ  ਪੜੇ ਪਿੜ ਕਿਬਤਾ  ਮੂਏ ਕਪੜ  ਕੇਦਾਰੈ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, who can find salvation? Kabeer speaks the Teachings.||4||1||
lines.transliteration: har kay naam bin kin gat paa-ee kahi upd ays kabeeraa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਿਰ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਮੂਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਇਨਿਹ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the body is burnt, it turns to ashes; if it is not cremated, then it is eaten byarmies of worms.
lines.transliteration: jab jaree-ai tab ho-ay bh asam t an rahai kiram d al khaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਿਚ ਸੰਿਚ ਰਾਜੇ ਮੂਏ ਗਿਡ  ਲੇ ਕੰਚਨ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The unbaked clay pitcher dissolves, when water is poured into it; this is also the nature of the body. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaachee gaagar neer parat hai i-aa t an kee ihai badaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮੂਏ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਦੇਿਖ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Why, O Siblings of Destiny, do you strut around, all puffed up with pride?
lines.transliteration: kaahay bha-ee-aa firt ou fooli-aa fooli-aa.

lines.english: Have you forgotten those days, when you were hanging, face down, for ten months?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab das maas uraDh  mukh  rahtaa so d in kaisay bh ooli-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਿਨ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਕਿਹ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Like the bee which collects honey, the fool eagerly gathers and collects wealth.
lines.transliteration: ji-o maDh maakh ee ti-o sath or ras jor jor Dh an kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਜਰੀਐ  ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮ  ਤਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਿਕਰਮ  ਦਲ ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: At the time of death, they shout, "Take him away, take him away! Why leave a ghost lying around?"||2||
lines.transliteration: martee baar layho layho karee-ai bh oot rahan ki-o d ee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚੀ  ਗਾਗਿਰ  ਨੀਰੁ ਪਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: His wife accompanies him to the threshold, and his friends and companions beyond.
lines.transliteration: dayhuree la-o baree naar sang bh a-ee aagai sajan suhaylaa.

lines.english: All the people and relatives go as far as the cremation grounds, and then, the soul-swan goes on alone. ||3||
lines.transliteration: marghat la-o sabh  log kutamb bh a-i-o aagai hans akaylaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਉਰਧ  ਮੁਖ ਰਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਿਦਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਭੂਿਲਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal being: you have been seized by Death, and you havefallen into the deep, dark pit.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray paraanee paray kaal garas koo-aa.

lines.english: You have entangled yourself in the false wealth of Maya, like the parrot caught in the trap. ||4||2||
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee maa-i-aa aap banDh aa-i-aa ji-o nalnee bh aram soo-aa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ  ਿਤਉ  ਸਠੋਿਰ  ਰਸੁ ਜੋਿਰ ਜੋਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform thereligious rituals.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan sabh ai mat  sun kai karee karam kee aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਰੀਐ  ਭੂਤੁ ਰਹਨ  ਿਕਉ  ਦੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: But seeing all the wise men caught by Death, I arose and left the Pandits; now I amfree of this desire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaal garsat sabh  log si-aanay uth  pandit  pai chalay niraasaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਲਉ ਬਰੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਭਈ ਆਗੈ  ਸਜਨ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, you have not completed the only task you were given;
lines.transliteration: man ray sari-o na aykai kaajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਘਟ  ਲਉ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਆਗੈ  ਹੰਸੁ ਅਕੇਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhaji-o na ragh oopat  raajaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. you have not meditated on the Lord, your King. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਪਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਗਰ੍ਸ ਕੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: Going to the forests, they practice Yoga and deep, austere meditation; they live onroots and the fruits they gather.
lines.transliteration: ban khand jaa-ay jog t ap keeno kand  mool chun kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ਆਪੁ  ਬੰਧਾਇਆ  ਿਜਉ ਨਲਨੀ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਸੂਆ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The musicians, the Vedic scholars, the chanters of one word and the men of silence,all are listed on the Register of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naadee bayd ee sabd ee monee jam kay patai likh aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਿਨ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ  ਕੀ ਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Loving devotional worship does not enter into your heart; pampering and adorningyour body, you must still give it up.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  naard ee rid ai na aa-ee kaachh  koochh  tan deenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਗਰ੍ਸਤ  ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਿਸਆਨੇ  ਉਿਠ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੈ ਚਲੇ ਿਨਰਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You sit and play music, but you are still a hypocrite; what do you expect to receive from the Lord? ||3||
lines.transliteration: raag raagnee dinbh  ho-ay baith aa un har peh ki-aa leenaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਿਰਓ  ਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Death has fallen on the whole world; the doubting religious scholars are also listed on the Register of Death. pMnw 655
lines.transliteration: pari-o kaal sabhai jag oopar maahi likh ay bh aram gi-aanee.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, those humble people become pure - they become Khalsa - who know the Lord's loving devotional worship. ||4||3|| Gru 2 ] (655-2) ghar 2. Second House||
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jan bha-ay kh aalsay paraym bh agat jih jaanee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਨ ਭਏ ਖਾਲਸੇ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਜਹ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: With both of my eyes, I look around;
lines.transliteration: du-ay d u-ay lochan paykh aa.

lines.english: I don't see anything except the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o har bin a-or na daykh aa.

lines.english: My eyes gaze lovingly upon Him,
lines.transliteration: nain rahay rang laa-ee.
ab bay gal kahan na jaa-ee. ||1|| and now, I cannot speak of anything else. ||1||

lines.english: My doubts were removed, and my fear ran away,
lines.transliteration: hamraa bharam ga-i-aa bh a-o bh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਬੇ ਗਲ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jab raam naam chit laagaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. when my consciousness became attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: When the magician beats his tambourine,
lines.transliteration: baajeegar dank bajaa-ee.
sabh kh alak t amaasay aa-ee. everyone comes to see the show.

lines.english: When the magician winds up his show,
lines.transliteration: baajeegar savaaNg sakaylaa.
apnay rang ravai akaylaa. ||2|| then he enjoys its play all alone. ||2||

lines.english: By preaching sermons, one's doubt is not dispelled.
lines.transliteration: kathnee kahi bharam na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Everyone is tired of preaching and teaching.
lines.transliteration: sabh kath kath rahee lukaa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord causes the Gurmukh to understand;
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o gurmukh aap bujh aa-ee.
taa kay hird ai rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||3|| his heart remains permeated with the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: When the Guru grants even a bit of His Grace,
lines.transliteration: gur kichant kirpaa keenee.
sabh t an man d ayh har leenee. one's body, mind and entire being are absorbed into the Lord.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love;
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer rang raataa.

lines.english: I have met with the Life of the world, the Great Giver. ||4||4||
lines.transliteration: mili-o jagjeevan daat aa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਹਿਰ ਲੀਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Let the sacred scriptures be your milk and cream,
lines.transliteration: jaa kay nigam dooDh  kay th aataa.
samund bilovan ka-o maataa. and the ocean of the mind the churning vat.

lines.english: Be the butter-churner of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: taa kee hohu bilovanhaaree.
ki-o maytai go chhaachh  tuhaaree. ||1|| and your buttermilk shall not be wasted. ||1||

lines.english: O soul-bride slave, why don't you take the Lord as your Husband?
lines.transliteration: chayree too raam na karas bh ataaraa.

lines.english: He is the Life of the world, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan paraan aDhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The chain is around your neck, and the cuffs are on your feet.
lines.transliteration: tayray galeh t a-uk pag bayree.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਸ  ਭਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has sent you wandering around from house to house.
lines.transliteration: too gh ar ghar rama-ee-ai fayree.

lines.english: And still, you do not meditate on the Lord, O soul-bride, slave.
lines.transliteration: too ajahu na chayt as chayree.

lines.english: Death is watching you, O wretched woman. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too jam bapuree hai hayree. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord God is the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: parabh karan karaavanhaaree.

lines.english: What is in the hands of the poor soul-bride, the slave?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa chayree haath bichaaree.

lines.english: She awakens from her slumber,
lines.transliteration: so-ee so-ee jaagee.
jit laa-ee t it laagee. ||3|| and she becomes attached to whatever the Lord attaches her. ||3||

lines.english: O soul-bride, slave, where did you obtain that wisdom,
lines.transliteration: chayree tai sumat  kahaaN tay paa-ee.
jaa tay bh aram kee leek mitaa-ee. by which you erased your inscription of doubt?

lines.english: Kabeer has tasted that subtle essence;
lines.transliteration: so ras kabeerai jaani-aa.
mayro gur parsaad man maani-aa. ||4||5|| by Guru's Grace, his mind is reconciled with the Lord. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੈ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਕਹ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without Him, we cannot even live;
lines.transliteration: jih baajh na jee-aa jaa-ee.
ja-o milai ta gh aal agh aa-ee. when we meet Him, then our task is completed.

lines.english: People say it is good to live forever,
lines.transliteration: sad jeevan bh alo kahaaNhee.
moo-ay bin jeevan naahee. ||1|| but without dying, there is no life. ||1||

lines.english: So now, what sort wisdom should I contemplate and preach?
lines.transliteration: ab ki-aa kathee-ai gi-aan beechaaraa.

lines.english: As I watch, worldly things dissipate. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nij nirkhat  gat bi-uhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Saffron is ground up, and mixed with sandalwood;
lines.transliteration: ghas kuNkam chand an gaari-aa.
bin nainhu jagat nihaari-aa. without eyes, the world is seen.

lines.english: The son has given birth to his father;
lines.transliteration: poot pit aa ik jaa-i-aa.
bin thaahar nagar basaa-i-aa. ||2|| without a place, the city has been established. ||2||

lines.english: The humble beggar has found the Great Giver,
lines.transliteration: jaachak jan daat aa paa-i-aa.
so dee-aa na jaa-ee kh aa-i-aa. but he is unable to eat what he has been given.

lines.english: He cannot leave it alone, but it is never exhausted.
lines.transliteration: chhodi-aa jaa-ay na mookaa.

lines.english: He shall not go to beg from others any longer. ||3||
lines.transliteration: a-uran peh jaanaa chookaa. ||3||

lines.english: Those select few, who know how to die while yet alive, enjoy great peace.
lines.transliteration: jo jeevan marnaa jaanai. so panch sail sukh maanai.

lines.english: Kabeer has found that wealth;
lines.transliteration: kabeerai so Dhan paa-i-aa.
har bhaytat  aap mitaa-i-aa. ||4||6|| meeting with the Lord, he has erased his self-conceit. ||4||6||

lines.english: What use is it to read, and what use is it to study?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa parhee-ai ki-aa gunee-ai.

lines.english: What use is it to listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa bayd puraanaaN sunee-ai.

lines.english: What use is reading and listening,
lines.transliteration: parhay sunay ki-aa ho-ee.
ja-o sahj na mili-o so-ee. ||1|| if celestial peace is not attained? ||1||

lines.english: The fool does not chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam na japas gavaaraa.

lines.english: So what does he think of, over and over again? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa socheh baaraN baaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the darkness, we need a lamp pMnw 656
lines.transliteration: anDhi-aaray d eepak chahee-ai.
ik basat agochar lahee-ai. to find the incomprehensible thing.

lines.english: I have found this incomprehensible thing;
lines.transliteration: basat agochar paa-ee.
ghat d eepak rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||2|| my mind is illuminated and enlightened. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, now I know Him;
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ab jaani-aa.
jab jaani-aa ta-o man maani-aa. since I know Him, my mind is pleased and appeased.

lines.english: My mind is pleased and appeased, and yet, people do not believe it.
lines.transliteration: man maanay log na pateejai.

lines.english: They do not believe it, so what can I do? ||3||7||
lines.transliteration: na pateejai t a-o ki-aa keejai. ||3||7||

lines.english: In his heart there is deception, and yet in his mouth are words of wisdom.
lines.transliteration: hirdai kapat mukh  gi-aanee.

lines.english: You are false - why are you churning water? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhooth ay kahaa bilovas paanee. ||1||

lines.english: Why do you bother to wash your body?
lines.transliteration: kaaN-i-aa maaNjas ka-un gunaaN.

lines.english: Your heart is still full of filth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ja-o ghat bh eetar hai malnaaN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The gourd may be washed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines,
lines.transliteration: la-ukee athsath  tirath nHaa-ee.
ka-uraapan ta-oo na jaa-ee. ||2|| but even then, its bitterness is not removed. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer after deep contemplation,
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer beechaaree.

lines.english: Sorat'h: <> siqgur pRswid ] (656-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar t aar muraaree. ||3||8|| please help me cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Lord, O Destroyer of ego.||3||8|| soriT  (656-6) sorath

lines.english: Practicing great hypocrisy, he acquires the wealth of others.
lines.transliteration: baho parpanch kar par Dhan li-aavai.

lines.english: Returning home, he squanders it on his wife and children. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sut daaraa peh aan lutaavai. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, do not practice deception, even inadvertently.
lines.transliteration: man mayray bhoolay kapat na keejai.

lines.english: In the end, your own soul shall have to answer for its account. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ant nibayraa t ayray jee-a peh leejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Moment by moment, the body is wearing away, and old age is asserting itself.
lines.transliteration: chhin chh in tan chh eejai jaraa janaavai.

lines.english: And then, when you are old, no one shall pour water into your cup. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tab tayree ok ko-ee paanee-o na paavai. ||2||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, no one belongs to you.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer ko-ee nahee t ayraa.

lines.english: Why not chant the Lord's Name in your heart, when you are still young? ||3||9||
lines.transliteration: hirdai raam kee na jaapeh savayraa. ||3||9||

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਕ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਨੀਓ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Saints, my windy mind has now become peaceful and still.
lines.transliteration: santahu man pavnai sukh  bani-aa.

lines.english: It seems that I have learned something of the science of Yoga. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kichh jog paraapat  gani-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Guru has shown me the hole,
lines.transliteration: gur dikh laa-ee moree.
jit mirag parh at hai choree. through which the deer carefully enters.

lines.english: I have now closed off the doors,
lines.transliteration: moond lee-ay d arvaajay.
baajee-alay anhad baajay. ||1|| and the unstruck celestial sound current resounds. ||1||

lines.english: The pitcher of my heart-lotus is filled with water;
lines.transliteration: kumbh kamal jal bh ari-aa.

lines.english: I have spilled out the water, and set it upright.
lines.transliteration: jal mayti-aa oobhaa kari-aa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant, this I know.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jan jaani-aa.

lines.english: Now that I know this, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||10|| rwgu soriT ] (656-13) raag sorath. Raag Sorat'h:
lines.transliteration: ja-o jaani-aa ta-o man maani-aa. ||2||10||

lines.english: I am so hungry, I cannot perform devotional worship service.
lines.transliteration: bhookh ay bh agat na keejai.

lines.english: Here, Lord, take back Your mala.
lines.transliteration: yeh maalaa apnee leejai.

lines.english: I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: ha-o maaNga-o santan raynaa.

lines.english: I do not owe anyone anything. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mai naahee kisee kaa daynaa. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, how can I be with You?
lines.transliteration: maaDho kaisee banai t um sangay.

lines.english: If You do not give me Yourself, then I shall beg until I get You. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap na dayh t a layva-o mangay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I ask for two kilos of flour,
lines.transliteration: du-ay sayr maaNga-o choonaa.
paa-o ghee-o sang loonaa. and half a pound of ghee, and salt.

lines.english: I ask for a pound of beans,
lines.transliteration: aDh sayr maaNga-o d aalay.
mo ka-o don-o vakhat  jivaalay. ||2|| which I shall eat twice a day. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਵਉ  ਮੰਗੇ ॥
lines.english: I ask for a cot, with four legs,
lines.transliteration: khaat maaNga-o cha-upaa-ee.
sirhaanaa avar tulaa-ee. and a pillow and mattress.

lines.english: I ask for a quit to cover myself.
lines.transliteration: oopar ka-o maaNga-o kheeNDhaa.

lines.english: Your humble servant shall perform Your devotional worship service with love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat karai jan theeNDhaa. ||3||

lines.english: I have no greed;
lines.transliteration: mai naahee keetaa labo.

lines.english: Your Name is the only ornament I wish for.
lines.transliteration: ik naa-o tayraa mai fabo.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and appeased;
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer man maani-aa.

lines.english: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (656-19) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: man maani-aa ta-o har jaani-aa. ||4||11|| now that my mind is pleased and appeased, I have come to know the Lord. ||4||11|| rwgu soriT bwxI Bgq nwmdy jI kI Gru 2  (656-19) raag sorath ban ee bh agat naamd ay jee kee gh ar 2

lines.english: When I see Him, I sing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: jab daykh aa tab gaavaa.

lines.english: Then I, his humble servant, become patient. ||1|| pMnw 657
lines.transliteration: ta-o jan Dh eeraj paavaa. ||1||

lines.english: Meeting the Divine True Guru, I merge into the sound current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naad samaa-ilo ray sat gur bh aytilay d ayvaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇਲੋ  ਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਲੇ  ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where the dazzling white light is seen,
lines.transliteration: jah jhil mil kaar d isantaa.
tah anhad  sabad  bajant aa. there the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds.

lines.english: One's light merges in the Light;
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  samaanee.
mai gur parsaadee jaanee. ||2|| by Guru's Grace, I know this. ||2||

lines.english: The jewels are in the treasure chamber of the heart-lotus.
lines.transliteration: ratan kamal koth ree.

lines.english: They sparkle and glitter like lightning.
lines.transliteration: chamkaar beejul tahee.

lines.english: The Lord is near at hand, not far away.
lines.transliteration: nayrai naahee door.

lines.english: He is totally permeating and pervading in my soul. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nij aatmai rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||3||

lines.english: Where the light of the undying sun shines,
lines.transliteration: jah anhat soor uj-yaaraa.
tah deepak jalai chh anchh aaraa. the light of burning lamps seems insignificant.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I know this.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jaani-aa.

lines.english: Servant Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Celestial Lord. ||4||1|| Gru 4 soriT ] (657-5) ghar 4 sorath . Fourth House, Sorat'h:
lines.transliteration: jan naamaa sahj samaani-aa. ||4||1||

lines.english: The woman next door asked Naam Dayv, "Who built your house?
lines.transliteration: paarh parh osan poochh  lay naamaa kaa peh chh aan chh avaa-ee ho.

lines.english: I shall pay him double wages. Tell me, who is your carpenter?"||1||
lines.transliteration: to peh d ugnee majooree d aiha-o mo ka-o baydh ee dayh bat aa-ee ho. ||1||

lines.english: O sister, I cannot give this carpenter to you.
lines.transliteration: ree baa-ee baydhee d ayn na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾੜ ਪੜੋਸਿਣ  ਪੂਿਛ ਲੇ ਨਾਮਾ  ਕਾ ਪਿਹ ਛਾਿਨ  ਛਵਾਈ  ਹੋ ॥
lines.english: Behold, my carpenter is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: daykh  baydh ee rahi-o samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋ ਪਿਹ ਦੁਗਣੀ  ਮਜੂਰੀ  ਦੈਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਈ  ਹੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My carpenter is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hamaarai baydhee paraan aDh aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੀ ਬਾਈ  ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This carpenter demands the wages of love, if someone wants Him to build their house.
lines.transliteration: baydhee pareet  majooree maaNgai ja-o ko-oo chh aan chh avaavai ho.

lines.english: When one breaks his ties with all the people and relatives, then the carpenter comesof His own accord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: log kutamb sabhahu t ay torai ta-o aapan baydh ee aavai ho. ||2||

lines.english: I cannot describe such a carpenter, who is contained in everything, everywhere.
lines.transliteration: aiso baydhee baran na saaka-o sabh  antar sabh  thaaN-ee ho.

lines.english: The mute tastes the most sublime ambrosial nectar, but if you ask him to describe it, he cannot. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gooNgai mahaa amrit ras chaakh i-aa poochh ay kahan na jaa-ee ho. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਢੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮਜੂਰੀ  ਮਗੈ  ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਛਾਿਨ  ਛਵਾਵੈ  ਹੋ ॥
lines.english: Listen to the virtues of this carpenter, O sister; He stopped the oceans, andestablished Dhroo as the pole star.
lines.transliteration: baydhee kay gun  sun ree baa-ee jalaDh  baaNDh Dharoo thaapi-o ho.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਗ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸਭਹੁ ਤੇ ਤੋਰੈ ਤਉ ਆਪਨ  ਬੇਢੀ ਆਵੈ  ਹੋ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv's Lord Master brought Sita back, and gave Sri Lanka to Bhabheekhan.||4||2|| soriT Gru 3 ] (657-10) sorath gh ar 3. Sorat'h, Third House:
lines.transliteration: naamay kay su-aamee see-a bahoree lank bhabh eekhan aapi-o ho. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਬੇਢੀ ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰ  ਸਭ ਠਈ  ਹੋ ॥
lines.english: The skinless drum plays.
lines.transliteration: anmarh i-aa mand al baajai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਪੂਛੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਹੋ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the rainy season, the clouds shake with thunder.
lines.transliteration: bin saavan gh anhar gaajai.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਢੀ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਿਨ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ  ਜਲਿਧ  ਬਿਧ  ਧਰ੍ੂ ਥਾਿਪਓ ਹੋ ॥
lines.english: Without clouds, the rain falls,
lines.transliteration: baadal bin barkh aa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੀਅ  ਬਹੋਰੀ  ਲੰਕ ਭਭੀਖਣ  ਆਿਪਓ  ਹੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ja-o tat  bichaarai ko-ee. ||1|| if one contemplates the essence of reality. ||1||

lines.english: I have met my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o mili-o raam sanayhee.

lines.english: Meeting with Him, my body is made beauteous and sublime. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jih mili-ai dayh sud ayhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Touching the philosopher's stone, I have been transformed into gold.
lines.transliteration: mil paaras kanchan ho-i-aa.

lines.english: I have threaded the jewels into my mouth and mind.
lines.transliteration: mukh mansaa rat an paro-i-aa.

lines.english: I love Him as my own, and my doubt has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: nij bhaa-o bh a-i-aa bh aram bh aagaa.

lines.english: Seeking the Guru's guidance, my mind is content. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur poochhay man pat ee-aagaa. ||2||

lines.english: The water is contained within the pitcher;
lines.transliteration: jal bheet ar kumbh  samaani-aa.

lines.english: I know that the One Lord is contained in all.
lines.transliteration: sabh raam ayk kar jaani-aa.

lines.english: The mind of the disciple has faith in the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur chaylay hai man maani-aa.

lines.english: Servant Naam Dayv understands the essence of reality. ||3||3|| rwgu soriT bwxI Bgq rivdws jI kI  (657-16) raag sorath ban ee bh agat ravid aas jee kee Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (657-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naamai tat  pachh aani-aa. ||3||3||

lines.english: When I am in my ego, then You are not with me. Now that You are with me, there is no egotism within me.
lines.transliteration: jab ham hotay t ab too naahee ab t oohee mai naahee.

lines.english: The wind may raise up huge waves in the vast ocean, but they are just water inwater. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anal agam jaisay lahar ma-i odaDh  jal kayval jal maaNhee. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, what can I say about such an illusion?
lines.transliteration: maaDhvay ki-aa kahee-ai bh aram aisaa.

lines.english: Things are not as they seem. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa maanee-ai ho-ay na taisaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: It is like the king, who falls asleep upon his throne, and dreams that he is a beggar.
lines.transliteration: narpat ayk singh aasan so-i-aa supnay bh a-i-aa bh ikhaaree.

lines.english: His kingdom is intact, but separated from it, he suffers in sorrow. Such is my own condition. ||2|| pMnw 658
lines.transliteration: achhat  raaj bichh urat dukh paa-i-aa so gat  bha-ee hamaaree. ||2||

lines.english: Like the story of the rope mistaken for a snake, the mystery has now been explained to me.
lines.transliteration: raaj bhu-i-ang parsang jaisay heh ab kachh  maram janaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ  ਪਰ੍ਸੰਗ  ਜੈਸੇ ਹਿਹ ਅਬ ਕਛੁ ਮਰਮੁ  ਜਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anik katak jaisay bhool paray ab kaht ay kahan na aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਕਟਕ  ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਿਲ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The One Lord is pervading the many forms; He enjoys Himself in all hearts.
lines.transliteration: sarbay ayk anaykai su-aamee sabh gh at bhogvai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕੈ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭਗਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord is nearer than our own hands and feet. Whatever will be, willbe. ||4||1||
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas haath pai nayrai sehjay ho-ay so ho-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ ਹਾਥ ਪੈ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: If I am bound by the noose of emotional attachment, then I shall bind You, Lord, withthe bonds of love.
lines.transliteration: ja-o ham baaNDhay moh faas ham paraym baDh an tum baaDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਬਧੇ ਮੋਹ ਫਾਸ ਹਮ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਬਧਿਨ  ਤੁਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
lines.english: Go ahead and try to escape, Lord; I have escaped by worshipping and adoring You.||1||
lines.transliteration: apnay chhootan ko jat an karahu ham chh ootay t um aaraaDh ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ ਛੂਟਨ  ਕੋ ਜਤਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, You know my love for You.
lines.transliteration: maaDhvay jaanat  hahu jaisee t aisee.

lines.english: Now, what will You do? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ab kahaa karhugay aisee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: A fish is caught, cut up, and cooked it in many different ways.
lines.transliteration: meen pakar faaNki-o ar kaati-o raaNDh kee-o baho baanee.

lines.english: Bit by bit, it is eaten, but still, it does not forget the water. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khand kh and kar bh ojan keeno t a-oo na bisri-o paanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਨੁ ਪਕਿਰ  ਫਿਕਓ  ਅਰੁ ਕਾਿਟਓ  ਰਿਧ  ਕੀਓ  ਬਹੁ ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, our King, is father to no one, except those who love Him.
lines.transliteration: aapan baapai naahee kisee ko bhaavan ko har raajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਿਰ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ  ਤਊ ਨ ਿਬਸਿਰਓ  ਪਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The veil of emotional attachment has been cast over the entire world, but it does not bother the Lord's devotee. ||3||
lines.transliteration: moh patal sabh jagat  bi-aapi-o bh agat nahee sant aapaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਬਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਸੀ  ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ  ਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, my devotion to the One Lord is increasing; now, who can I tell thisto?
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas bh agat ik baadh ee ab ih kaa si-o kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਪਟਲ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਬਆਿਪਓ  ਭਗਤ  ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That which brought me to worship and adore You - I am still suffering that pain.||4||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kaaran ham tum aaraaDh ay so d ukh ajhoo sahee-ai. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਇਕ ਬਾਢੀ  ਅਬ ਇਹ ਕਾ ਿਸਉ ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I obtained this precious human life as a reward for my past actions, but withoutdiscriminating wisdom, it is wasted in vain.
lines.transliteration: dulabh  janam punn fal paa-i-o birthaa jaat  abibaykai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਿਨ  ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਸਹੀਐ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Tell me, without devotional worship of the Lord, of what use are mansions andthrones like those of King Indra? ||1||
lines.transliteration: raajay indar samsar garih aasan bin har bh agat kahhu kih laykh ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਲਭ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਤ  ਅਿਬਬੇਕੈ  ॥
lines.english: You have not considered the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, our King;
lines.transliteration: na beechaari-o raajaa raam ko ras.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੇ ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਆਸਨ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਹਹੁ ਿਕਹ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jih ras an ras beesar jaahee. ||1|| rahaa-o. this sublime essence shall cause you to forget all other essences. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ॥
lines.english: We do not know what we need to know, and we have become insane. We do not consider what we should consider; our days are passing away.
lines.transliteration: jaan ajaan bha-ay ham baavar soch asoch d ivas jaahee.

lines.english: Our passions are strong, and our discriminating intellect is weak; we have no accessto the supreme objective. ||2||
lines.transliteration: indree sabal nibal bibayk buDh  parmaarath parvays nahee. ||2||

lines.english: We say one thing, and do something else; entangled in endless Maya, we do notunderstand anything.
lines.transliteration: kahee-at aan achree-at  an kachh  samajh  na parai apar maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਨ  ਅਜਾਨ  ਭਏ ਹਮ ਬਾਵਰ  ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚ  ਿਦਵਸ  ਜਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, Your slave, O Lord, I am disillusioned and detached; please, spare meYour anger, and have mercy on my soul. ||3||3||
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas ud aas d aas mat  parhar kop karahu jee-a d a-i-aa. ||3||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਸਬਲ  ਿਨਬਲ  ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ  ਪਰਵੇਸ  ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the wish-fulfilling jewel, and theKaamadhayna, the cow which fulfills all desires, all are in His power.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar surt ar chint aaman kaamDh ayn bas jaa kay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਆਨ  ਅਚਰੀਅਤ  ਅਨ ਕਛੁ ਸਮਝ  ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The four great blessings, the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas,and the nine treasures, are all in the palm of His hand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat d asaa siDh  nav niDh  kar tal taa kay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਉਦਾਸ  ਦਾਸ ਮਿਤ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਕੋਪੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੀਅ  ਦਇਆ  ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.english: You do not chant with your tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har har na jaapeh rasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਰ  ਿਚੰਤਾਮਿਨ  ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਬਿਸ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: Abandon your involvement in all other words. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar sabh t i-aag bachan rachnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਅਸਟ  ਦਸਾ ਿਸਿਧ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The various Shaastras, Puranaas, and the Vedas of Brahma, are made up of thirty- four letters.
lines.transliteration: naanaa khi-aan puraan bayd  biDh cha-ut ees akh ar maaNhee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨ ਜਪਿਹ  ਰਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: After deep contemplation, Vyaas spoke of the supreme objective; there is nothingequal to the Lord's Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bi-aas bichaar kahi-o parmaarath raam naam sar naahee. ||2||

lines.english: Very fortunate are those who are absorbed in celestial bliss, and released from theirentanglements; they are lovingly attached to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sahj samaaDh upaaDh  rahat  fun badai bh aag liv laagee.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, enshrine the Lord's Light within your heart, and your fear of birth anddeath shall run away from you. ||3||4||
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas pargaas rid ai Dhar janam maran bh ai bhaagee. ||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਿਖਆਨ  ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਬੇਦ ਿਬਿਧ  ਚਉਤੀਸ  ਅਖਰ  ਮਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: If You are the mountain, Lord, then I am the peacock.
lines.transliteration: ja-o tum girivar t a-o ham moraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਆਸ ਿਬਚਾਿਰ  ਕਿਹਓ  ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If You are the moon, then I am the partridge in love with it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ja-o tum chand  ta-o ham bh a-ay hai chakoraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਉਪਾਿਧ  ਰਹਤ  ਫੁਿਨ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, if You will not break with me, then I will not break with You.
lines.transliteration: maaDhvay t um na t orahu t a-o ham nahee t oreh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਰ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ  ॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: For, if I were to break with You, with whom would I then join? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tum si-o t or kavan si-o joreh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If You are the lamp, then I am the wick.
lines.transliteration: ja-o tum d eevraa t a-o ham baat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If You are the sacred place of pilgrimage, then I am the pilgrim. ||2|| pMnw 659
lines.transliteration: ja-o tum t irath t a-o ham jaat ee. ||2||

lines.english: I am joined in true love with You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachee pareet ham t um si-o joree.

lines.english: I am joined with You, and I have broken with all others. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tum si-o jor avar sang t oree. ||3||

lines.english: Wherever I go, there I serve You.
lines.transliteration: jah jah jaa-o tahaa t ayree sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਜਾਉ  ਤਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: There is no other Lord Master than You, O Divine Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tum so th aakur a-or na d ayvaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Meditating, vibrating upon You, the noose of death is cut away.
lines.transliteration: tumray bh ajan kateh jam faaNsaa.

lines.english: To attain devotional worship, Ravi Daas sings to You, Lord. ||5||5||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  hayt gaavai ravid aasaa. ||5||5||

lines.english: The body is a wall of water, supported by the pillars of air; the egg and sperm are the mortar.
lines.transliteration: jal kee bheet  pavan kaa thambh aa rakat  bund  kaa gaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਭੀਿਤ  ਪਵਨ  ਕਾ ਥੰਭਾ ਰਕਤ  ਬੁੰਦ ਕਾ ਗਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The framework is made up of bones, flesh and veins; the poor soul-bird dwells withinit. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haad maas naarheeN ko pinjar pankh ee basai bichaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਡ ਮਾਸ ਨਾੜੀ ਕੋ ਿਪੰਜਰੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਿਬਚਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mortal, what is mine, and what is yours?
lines.transliteration: paraanee ki-aa mayraa ki-aa tayraa.

lines.english: The soul is like a bird perched upon a tree. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaisay tarvar pankh  basayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You lay the foundation and build the walls.
lines.transliteration: raakho kanDh  usaarahu neevaaN.

lines.english: But in the end, three and a half cubits will be your measured space. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saadhay t een haath t ayree seevaaN. ||2||

lines.english: You make your hair beautiful, and wear a stylish turban on your head.
lines.transliteration: bankay baal paag sir dayree.

lines.english: But in the end, this body shall be reduced to a pile of ashes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih tan ho-igo bh asam kee dh ayree. ||3||

lines.english: Your palaces are lofty, and your brides are beautiful.
lines.transliteration: oochay mandar sund ar naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ  ਭਸਮ  ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: But without the Lord's Name, you shall lose the game entirely. ||4||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin baajee haaree. ||4||

lines.english: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my life is wretched.
lines.transliteration: mayree jaat kameenee paaNt kameenee ochh aa janam hamaaraa.

lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Luminous Lord, my King; so says Ravi Daas, the shoemaker. ||5||6||
lines.transliteration: tum sarnaagat  raajaa raam chand  kahi ravid aas chamaaraa. ||5||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਿਤ  ਕਮੀਨੀ  ਪਿਤ  ਕਮੀਨੀ  ਓਛਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am a shoemaker, but I do not know how to mend shoes.
lines.transliteration: chamrataa gaaNth na jan-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਾਗਿਤ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦ ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: People come to me to mend their shoes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: log gathaavai panhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have no awl to stitch them;
lines.transliteration: aar nahee jih topa-o.

lines.english: I have no knife to patch them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nahee raaNbee thaa-o ropa-o. ||1||

lines.english: Mending, mending, people waste their lives and ruin themselves.
lines.transliteration: log ganth ganth  kharaa bigoochaa.

lines.english: Without wasting my time mending, I have found the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o bin gaaNthay jaa-ay pahoochaa. ||2||

lines.english: Ravi Daas chants the Lord's Name;
lines.transliteration: ravidaas japai raam naamaa.

lines.english: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Bheekhan Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (659-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mohi jam si-o naahee kaamaa. ||3||7|| he is not concerned with the Messenger of Death. ||3||7|| rwgu soriT bwxI Bgq BIKn kI  (659-11) raag sorath ban ee bh agat bheekhan kee

lines.english: Tears well up in my eyes, my body has become weak, and my hair has become milky- white.
lines.transliteration: nainhu neer bahai tan kh eenaa bh a-ay kays d uDh vaanee.

lines.english: My throat is tight, and I cannot utter even one word; what can I do now? I am a meremortal. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rooDhaa kanth  sabad  nahee uchrai ab ki-aa karahi paraanee. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, my King, Gardener of the world-garden, be my Physician,
lines.transliteration: raam raa-ay hohi baid banvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਭੀਖਨ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: apnay santeh layho ubaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o. and save me, Your Saint. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਾ  ਭਏ ਕੇਸ ਦੁਧ ਵਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: My head aches, my body is burning, and my heart is filled with anguish.
lines.transliteration: maathay peer sareer jalan hai karak karayjay maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਧਾ ਕੰਠੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨਹੀ ਉਚਰੈ  ਅਬ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Such is the disease that has struck me; there is no medicine to cure it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aisee baydan upaj kh aree bh a-ee vaa kaa a-ukh aDh naahee. ||2||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, the ambrosial, immaculate water, is the best medicine in theworld.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam amrit jal nirmal ih a-ukh aDh jag saaraa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, says servant Bheekhan, I have found the Door of Salvation. ||3||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad kahai jan bh eekhan paava-o mokh  du-aaraa. ||3||1||

lines.english: Such is the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the invaluable jewel, the most sublime wealth, which I have found through good deeds.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam ratan nirmolak punn pad aarath paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਥੇ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਿਰ ਜਲਿਨ  ਹੈ ਕਰਕ  ਕਰੇਜੇ  ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: By various efforts, I have enshrined it within my heart; this jewel cannot be hidden byhiding it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar hird ai raakh i-aa rat an na chh apai chh apaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਬੇਦਨ  ਉਪਿਜ  ਖਰੀ ਭਈ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord cannot be spoken by speaking.
lines.transliteration: har gun kahtay kahan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਜਲੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਇਹੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਜਿਗ  ਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: They are like the sweet candies given to a mute. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaisay goongay kee mithi-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਖਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.english: The tongue speaks, the ears listen, and the mind contemplates the Lord; they findpeace and comfort.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa ramat sunat  sukh  sarvanaa chit  chayt ay sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮੋਲਕੁ  ਪੁੰਿਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Bheekhan, my eyes are content; wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||2||2|| pMnw 660 DnwsrI mhlw 1 Gru 1 caupdy (660-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 cha-upd ay Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (660-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: kaho bheekh an du-ay nain sant okhay jah d aykhaaN tah so-ee. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My soul is afraid; to whom should I complain?
lines.transliteration: jee-o darat hai aapn aa kai si-o karee pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਡਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ  ਕੈ ਿਸਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I serve Him, who makes me forget my pains; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dookh  visaaran  sayvi-aa sad aa sad aa daataar. ||1||

lines.english: My Lord and Master is forever new; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saahib mayraa neet navaa sad aa sad aa daataar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੀਤ  ਨਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, I serve my Lord and Master; He shall save me in the end.
lines.transliteration: an-din saahib sayvee-ai ant  chhadaa-ay so-ay.

lines.english: Hearing and listening, O my dear sister, I have crossed over. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sun sun  mayree kaamn ee paar ut aaraa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਛਡਾਏ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Merciful Lord, Your Name carries me across.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal t ayrai naam t araa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sad kurbaan ai jaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In all the world, there is only the One True Lord; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: sarbaN saachaa ayk hai doojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: He alone serves the Lord, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa kee sayvaa so karay jaa ka-o nad ar karay. ||3||

lines.english: Without You, O Beloved, how could I even live?
lines.transliteration: tuDh baajh  pi-aaray kayv rahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੰ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Bless me with such greatness, that I may remain attached to Your Name.
lines.transliteration: saa vadi-aa-ee deh jit  naam t ayray laag rahaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: There is no other, O Beloved, to whom I can go and speak. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: doojaa naahee ko-ay jis aagai pi-aaray jaa-ay kahaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I serve my Lord and Master; I ask for no other.
lines.transliteration: sayvee saahib aapnaa avar na jaachaN-o ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੇਿਹ ਿਜਤੁ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is His slave; moment by moment, bit by bit, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kaa d aas hai bind  bind chukh  chukh  ho-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਜਾਇ  ਕਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord Master, I am a sacrifice to Your Name, moment by moment, bit by bit. ||1||Pause||4||1|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (660-11) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saahib tayray naam vitahu bind  bind chukh  chukh  ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. ||4||1||

lines.english: We are human beings of the briefest moment; we do not know the appointed time ofour departure.
lines.transliteration: ham aadmee haaN ik damee muhlat  muhat  na jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਚੰਉ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, serve the One, to whom our soul and breath of life belong. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak binvai tisai sarayvhu jaa kay jee-a paraan aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਿਬੰਦ ਿਬੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: You are blind - see and consider, how many days your life shall last. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anDhay jeevnaa veechaar d aykh kaytay kay d inaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਿਬੰਦ ਿਬੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My breath, my flesh and my soul are all Yours, Lord; You are so very dear to me.
lines.transliteration: saas maas sabh jee-o t umaaraa t oo mai kh araa pi-aaraa.

lines.english: Nanak, the poet, says this, O True Lord Cherisher. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa-ir ayv kahat hai sachay parvad gaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: If you gave nothing, O my Lord and Master, what could anyone pledge to You?
lines.transliteration: jay too kisai na d ayhee mayray saahibaa ki-aa ko kadh ai gahn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਆਦਮੀ  ਹ ਇਕ ਦਮੀ ਮੁਹਲਿਤ  ਮੁਹਤੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak prays, we receive that which we are pre-destined to receive. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak binvai so kichh paa-ee-ai purab likh ay kaa lahn aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਬਨਵੈ  ਿਤਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The deceitful person does not remember the Lord's Name; he practices only deceit.
lines.transliteration: naam khasam kaa chit  na kee-aa kaptee kapat kamaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇ ਿਦਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When he is marched in chains to Death's door, then, he regrets his actions. ||4|| pMnw 661
lines.transliteration: jam du-aar jaa pakarh  chalaa-i-aa t aa chald aa pachh utaanaa. ||4||

lines.english: As long as we are in this world, O Nanak, we should listen, and speak of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jab lag dunee-aa rahee-ai naanak kichh  sunee-ai kichh  kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched, but I have found no way to remain here; so, remain dead while yet alive. ||5||2|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 Gru dUjw  (661-3) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1 gh ar doojaa Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (661-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bhaal rahay ham rahan  na paa-i-aa jeevt i-aa mar rahee-ai. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੀਵਿਤਆ  ਮਿਰ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: How can I remember the Lord in meditation? I cannot meditate on Him inremembrance.
lines.transliteration: ki-o simree sivri-aa nahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My heart is burning, and my soul is crying out in pain.
lines.transliteration: tapai hi-aa-o jee-arh aa billaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord creates and adorns.
lines.transliteration: siraj savaaray saachaa so-ay.

lines.english: Forgetting Him, how can one be good? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis visri-ai changa ki-o ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: By clever tricks and commands, He cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: hikmat hukam na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: How am I to meet my True Lord, O my mother? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar saach mila-o mayree maa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How rare is the one who goes out, and searches for the merchandise of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: vakhar naam d aykhan ko-ee jaa-ay.

lines.english: No one tastes it, and no one eats it.
lines.transliteration: naa ko chaakhai naa ko kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Honor is not obtained by trying to please other people.
lines.transliteration: lok pateen ai naa pat  ho-ay.

lines.english: One's honor is preserved, only if the Lord preserves it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa pat  rahai raakh ai jaa so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see Him, pervading and permeating.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: Without You, I have no other place of rest.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojee naahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਪਿਤ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He may try, but what can anyone do by his own doing?
lines.transliteration: jay ko karay keetai ki-aa ho-ay.

lines.english: He alone is blessed, whom the True Lord forgives. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis no bakhsay saachaa so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Now, I shall have to get up and depart, in an instant, in the clapping of hands.
lines.transliteration: hun uth  chaln aa muhat  ke taal.

lines.english: What face will I show the Lord? I have no virtue at all.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa muhu daysaa gun  nahee naal.

lines.english: As is the Lord's Glance of Grace, so it is.
lines.transliteration: jaisee nadar karay t aisaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Without His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, no one is blessed. ||4||1||3|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (661-10) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vin nad ree naanak nahee ko-ay. ||4||1||3||

lines.english: If the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one remembers Him in meditation.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa simri-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: The soul is softened, and he remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: aatmaa d arvai rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: His soul and the Supreme Soul become one.
lines.transliteration: aatmaa paraat amaa ayko karai.

lines.english: The duality of the inner mind is overcome. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar kee d ubiDh aa ant ar marai. ||1||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, God is found.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: One's consciousness is attached to the Lord, and so Death does not devour him.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har si-o chit laagai fir kaal na kh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Remembering the True Lord in meditation, one is enlightened.
lines.transliteration: sach simri-ai hovai pargaas.

lines.english: Then, in the midst of Maya, he remains detached.
lines.transliteration: taa tay bikh i-aa meh rahai ud aas.

lines.english: Such is the Glory of the True Guru;
lines.transliteration: satgur kee aisee vadi-aa-ee.
putar kalt ar vichay gat  paa-ee. ||2|| in the midst of children and spouses, they attain emancipation. ||2||

lines.english: Such is the service which the Lord's servant performs,
lines.transliteration: aisee sayvak sayvaa karai.
jis kaa jee-o tis aagai Dh arai. that he dedicates his soul to the Lord, to whom it belongs.

lines.english: One who is pleasing to the Lord and Master is acceptable.
lines.transliteration: saahib bhaavai so parvaan .

lines.english: Such a servant obtains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so sayvak dargeh paavai maan . ||3||

lines.english: He enshrines the image of the True Guru in his heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee moorat  hirdai vasaa-ay.

lines.english: He obtains the rewards which he desires.
lines.transliteration: jo ichhai so-ee fal paa-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord and Master grants His Grace;
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib kirpaa karai.
so sayvak jam tay kaisaa darai. ||4|| how can such a servant be afraid of death? ||4||

lines.english: Prays Nanak, practice contemplation,
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak karay veechaar.
saachee banee si-o Dh aray pi-aar. and enshrine love for the True Word of His Bani.

lines.english: Then, you shall find the Gate of Salvation.
lines.transliteration: taa ko paavai mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: This Shabad is the most excellent of all chanting and austere meditations. ||5||2||4|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (661-17) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jap tap sabh  ih sabad  hai saar. ||5||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: My soul burns, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: jee-o tapat  hai baaro baar.

lines.english: Burning and burning, it is ruined, and it falls into evil.
lines.transliteration: tap tap kh apai bahut  baykaar.

lines.english: That body, which forgets the Word of the Guru's Bani,
lines.transliteration: jai tan ban ee visar jaa-ay.
ji-o pakaa rogee villaa-ay. ||1|| cries out in pain, like a chronic patient. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: To speak too much and babble is useless.
lines.transliteration: bahutaa bolan  jhakhan ho-ay.

lines.english: Even without our speaking, He knows everything. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vin bolay jaan ai sabh  so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He created our ears, eyes and nose.
lines.transliteration: jin kan keetay akh ee naak.

lines.english: He gave us our tongue to speak so fluently. pMnw 662
lines.transliteration: jin jihvaa dit ee bolay t aat.

lines.english: He preserved the mind in the fire of the womb;
lines.transliteration: jin man raakhi-aa agnee paa-ay.
vaajai pavan aakh ai sabh  jaa-ay. ||2|| at His Command, the wind blows everywhere. ||2||

lines.english: These worldly attachments, loves and pleasurable tastes,
lines.transliteration: jaytaa moh pareet  su-aad .
sabhaa kaalakh  daagaa d aag. all are just black stains.

lines.english: One who departs, with these black stains of sin on his face
lines.transliteration: daag d os muhi chali-aa laa-ay.
dargeh baisan  naahee jaa-ay. ||3|| shall find no place to sit in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: By Your Grace, we chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: karam milai aakhan  tayraa naa-o.

lines.english: Becoming attached to it, one is saved; there is no other way.
lines.transliteration: jit lag t arnaa hor nahee thaa-o.

lines.english: Even if one is drowning, still, he may be saved.
lines.transliteration: jay ko doobai fir hovai saar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Giver of all. ||4||3||5|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (662-4) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa sarab daat aar. ||4||3||5||

lines.english: If a thief praises someone, his mind is not pleased.
lines.transliteration: chor salaahay cheet na bh eejai.

lines.english: If a thief curses him, no damage is done.
lines.transliteration: jay badee karay t aa tasoo na chh eejai.

lines.english: No one will take responsibility for a thief.
lines.transliteration: chor kee haamaa bharay na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਬਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਤਸੂ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: How can a thief's actions be good? ||1||
lines.transliteration: chor kee-aa changa ki-o ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਮਾ  ਭਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Listen, O mind, you blind, false dog!
lines.transliteration: sun man anDh ay kut ay koorh i-aar.

lines.english: Even without your speaking, the Lord knows and understands. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin bolay boojhee-ai sachiaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: A thief may be handsome, and a thief may be wise,
lines.transliteration: chor su-aali-o chor si-aanaa.
khotay kaa mul ayk d ugaan aa. but he is still just a counterfeit coin, worth only a shell.

lines.english: If it is kept and mixed with other coins,
lines.transliteration: jay saath rakhee-ai d eejai ralaa-ay.
jaa parkhee-ai kh otaa ho-ay jaa-ay. ||2|| it will be found to be false, when the coins are inspected. ||2||

lines.english: As one acts, so does he receive.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa karay so taisaa paavai.

lines.english: As he plants, so does he eat.
lines.transliteration: aap beej aapay hee khaavai.

lines.english: He may praise himself gloriously,
lines.transliteration: jay vadi-aa-ee-aa aapay kh aa-ay.
jayhee surat t ayhai raahi jaa-ay. ||3|| but still, according to his understanding, so is the path he must follow. ||3||

lines.english: He may tell hundreds of lies to conceal his falsehood,
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o koorhee-aa koorh  kabaarh .
bhaavai sabh  aakh a-o sansaar. and all the world may call him good.

lines.english: If it pleases You, Lord, even the foolish are approved.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai aDh ee parvaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord is wise, knowing, all-knowing. ||4||4||6|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (662-10) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaanai jaan  sujaan . ||4||4||6||

lines.english: The body is the paper, and the mind is the inscription written upon it.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kaagad man parvaan aa.

lines.english: The ignorant fool does not read what is written on his forehead.
lines.transliteration: sir kay laykh na parh ai i-aan aa.

lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, three inscriptions are recorded.
lines.transliteration: dargeh gh arhee-ahi t eenay laykh .

lines.english: Behold, the counterfeit coin is worthless there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khotaa kaam na aavai vaykh . ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, if there is silver in it,
lines.transliteration: naanak jay vich rupaa ho-ay.
kharaa kh araa aakh ai sabh  ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. then everyone proclaims, "It is genuine, it is genuine."||1||Pause||

lines.english: The Qazi tells lies and eats filth;
lines.transliteration: kaadee koorh  bol mal kh aa-ay.
baraahman naavai jee-aa gh aa-ay. the Brahmin kills and then takes cleansing baths.

lines.english: The Yogi is blind, and does not know the Way.
lines.transliteration: jogee jugat na jaan ai anDh .

lines.english: The three of them devise their own destruction. ||2||
lines.transliteration: teenay ojaarh ay kaa banDh . ||2||

lines.english: He alone is a Yogi, who understands the Way.
lines.transliteration: so jogee jo jugat pachh aanai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he knows the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ayko jaanai.

lines.english: He alone is a Qazi, who turns away from the world,
lines.transliteration: kaajee so jo ultee karai.
gur parsaadee jeevat marai. and who, by Guru's Grace, remains dead while yet alive.

lines.english: He alone is a Brahmin, who contemplates God.
lines.transliteration: so baraahman jo barahm beechaarai.

lines.english: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap tarai saglay kul t aarai. ||3||

lines.english: One who cleanses his own mind is wise.
lines.transliteration: daanasband  so-ee d il Dhovai.

lines.english: One who cleanses himself of impurity is a Muslim.
lines.transliteration: musalmaan so-ee mal kh ovai.

lines.english: One who reads and understands is acceptable.
lines.transliteration: parhi-aa boojh ai so parvaan .

lines.english: Upon his forehead is the Insignia of the Court of the Lord. ||4||5||7|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 Gru 3  (662-17) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1 gh ar 3 Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (662-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jis sir dargeh kaa neesaan . ||4||5||7||

lines.english: No, no, this is not the time, when people know the way to Yoga and Truth.
lines.transliteration: kaal naahee jog naahee naahee sat kaa dh ab.

lines.english: The holy places of worship in the world are polluted, and so the world is drowning. ||1||
lines.transliteration: thaansat jag bharisat ho-ay doobt aa iv jag. ||1||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.
lines.transliteration: kal meh raam naam saar.

lines.english: Some people try to deceive the world by closing their eyes and holding their nostrilsclosed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: akhee t a meeteh naak pakrh eh thagan ka-o sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They close off their nostrils with their fingers, and claim to see the three worlds. pMnw 663
lines.transliteration: aaNt saytee naak pakrh eh soojh -tay tin lo-a.

lines.english: But they cannot even see what is behind them. What a strange lotus pose this is! ||2||
lines.transliteration: magar paachhai kachh  na soojh ai ayhu pad am alo-a. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਗਰ  ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਮੁ  ਅਲੋਅ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The K'shatriyas have abandoned their religion, and have adopted a foreign language.
lines.transliteration: khataree-aa t a Dharam chh odi-aa malaychh  bhaakhi-aa gahee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਤਰ੍ੀਆ  ਤ ਧਰਮੁ  ਛੋਿਡਆ ਮਲੇਛ  ਭਾਿਖਆ  ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The whole world has been reduced to the same social status; the state ofrighteousness and Dharma has been lost. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sarisat sabh ik varan ho-ee Dh aram kee gat  rahee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਧਰਮ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਰਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They analyze eight chapters of (Panini's) grammar and the Puraanas. They study theVedas,
lines.transliteration: asat saaj saaj puraan soDh eh karahi bayd  abhi-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਟ  ਸਾਜ ਸਾਿਜ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਸੋਧਿਹ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੇਦ ਅਿਭਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||1||6||8|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 AwrqI  (663-4) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1 aart ee Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Aartee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (663-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bin naam har kay mukat naahee kahai naanak d aas. ||4||1||6||8|| but without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated; so says Nanak, the Lord's slave.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
lines.english: In the bowl of the sky, the sun and moon are the lamps; the stars in theconstellations are the pearls.
lines.transliteration: gagan mai thaal rav chand d eepak banay t aarikaa mandal janak mot ee.

lines.english: Dhoop mal-aanlo pavan  chavro karay sagal banraa-ay foolant  jotee. ||1|| The fragrance of sandalwood is the incense, the wind is the fan, and all the vegetationare flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਗਨ  ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ  ਰਿਵ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ  ਬਨੇ ਤਾਿਰਕਾ  ਮੰਡਲ  ਜਨਕ  ਮੋਤੀ ॥
lines.english: What a beautiful lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of fear, this is YourAartee, Your worship service.
lines.transliteration: kaisee aartee ho-ay bh av kh andnaa t ayree aart ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ  ਪਵਣੁ  ਚਵਰੋ  ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ  ਬਨਰਾਇ  ਫੂਲੰਤ  ਜੋਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sound current of the Shabad is the sounding of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anhataa sabad  vaajant  bhayree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ  ਹੋਇ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Thousands are Your eyes, and yet You have no eyes. Thousands are Your forms, andyet You have not even one form.
lines.transliteration: sahas tav nain nan nain hai t ohi ka-o sahas moorat  nanaa ayk t ohee.

lines.english: Thousands are Your lotus feet, and yet You have no feet. Without a nose, thousands are Your noses. I am enchanted with Your play! ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahas pad bimal nan ayk pad  ganDh  bin sahas t av ganDh  iv chalat  mohee. ||2||

lines.english: The Divine Light is within everyone; You are that Light.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh jot  jot hai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹੈ ਤੋਿਹ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Yours is that Light which shines within everyone.
lines.transliteration: tis kai chaanan  sabh  meh chaanan  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਪਦ ਿਬਮਲ  ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਸ  ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ  ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Guru's Teachings, this Divine Light is revealed.
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee jot  pargat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ  ਜੋਿਤ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: That which pleases the Lord is the true worship service. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so aart ee ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਚਾਨਿਣ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: My soul is enticed by the honey-sweet lotus feet of the Lord; night and day, I thirst forthem.
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal makrand  lobhit mano and ino mohi aahee pi-aasaa.

lines.english: Bless Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, with the water of Your Mercy, that he may come todwell in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9|| DnwsrI mhlw 3 Gru 2 caupdy  (663-12) Dhanaasree mehlaa 3 gh ar 2 cha-upd ay Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (663-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kirpaa jal deh naanak saaring ka-o ho-ay jaa t ay tayrai naam vaasaa. ||4||1||7||9||
