lines.english: This wealth is inexhaustible. It shall neve r be exhausted, and it shall never be lost.
lines.transliteration: ih Dhan akh ut na nikh utai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਕਰੰਦ  ਲੋਿਭਤ  ਮਨੋ ਅਨਿਦਨੋ  ਮੋਿਹ ਆਹੀ  ਿਪਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has revealed it to me.
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur d ee-aa d ikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਜਲੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਿਰੰਗ  ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਾਸਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੯॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: apunay satgur ka-o sad  bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay har man vasaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨ ਿਨਖੁਟੈ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are wealthy, who lovingly attune themselves to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: say Dhanvant  har naam liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has revealed to me the Lord's treasure; by the Lord's Grace, it has come to abide in my mind. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har Dhan pargaasi-aa har kirpaa t ay vasai man aa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is rid of his demerits, and his heart is permeated with merit and virtue.
lines.transliteration: avgun kaat gun  ridai samaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he naturally dwells in celestial peace.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sahj subhaa-ay.

lines.english: True is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

lines.transliteration: ayk achraj jan daykh hu bh aa-ee.
dubiDh aa maar har man vasaa-ee. duality is overcome, and the Lord dwells within his mind.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless; it cannot be taken.
lines.transliteration: naam amolak na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it comes to abide in the mind. ||3||

lines.transliteration: har naam Dhan nirmal at  apaaraa.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is over-flowing with treasure.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bh aray bh andaaraa.

lines.english: Know that, except for the wealth of the Name, all other wealth is poison.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhan bin hor sabh  bikh jaan.

lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi jalai abhimaan. ||1||

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har ras chaakh ai ko-ay.

lines.english: He is always in bliss, day and night; through perfect good destiny, he obtains the Name. ||Pause||

lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is a lamp, illuminating the three worlds.

lines.english: One who tastes it, becomes immaculate.
lines.transliteration: jo chaakhai so nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: The immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, washes off the filth of ego.
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam ha-umai mal Dho-ay.

lines.english: True devotional worship brings lasting peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachee bhagat  sadaa sukh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord is the Lord's humble servant.
lines.transliteration: jin har ras chaakhi-aa so har jan log.

lines.english: He is forever happy; he is never sad.
lines.transliteration: tis sad aa harakh  naahee kad ay sog.

lines.english: He himself is liberated, and he liberates others as well.
lines.transliteration: aap mukat avraa mukat  karaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: He chants the Lord's Name, and through the Lord, he finds peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har naam japai har tay sukh  paavai. ||3||

lines.english: Without the True Guru, everyone dies, crying out in pain.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sabh  mu-ee billaa-ay.

lines.transliteration: an-din d aajheh saat  na paa-ay.

lines.transliteration: satgur milai sabh  tarisan bujh aa-ay.

lines.transliteration: naanak naam saaNt sukh  paa-ay. ||4||2||

lines.english: Gather in and cherish forever the wealth of the Lord's Name, deep within;
lines.transliteration: sadaa Dh an ant ar naam samaalay.

lines.english: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant jineh part ipaalay.

lines.english: They alone obtain the treasure of Liberation,
lines.transliteration: mukat pad aarath t in ka-o paa-ay.
har kai naam ratay liv laa-ay. ||1|| who are lovingly imbued with, and focused on the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.english: He is illumined and enlightened within, and he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

lines.transliteration: ih har rang goorhaa Dh an pir ho-ay.

lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich parabh ko-ay na paa-ay.

lines.english: Wandering away from the Primal Lord, the root of all, one wastes his life in vain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: moolhu bhulaa janam gavaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Tranquility, celestial peace, pleasure and the Word of His Bani come from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur tay saat  sahj sukh  banee.

lines.transliteration: sayvaa saachee naam samaanee.

lines.english: Blessed with the Word of the Shabad, he meditates forever on the Lord, the Beloved.
lines.transliteration: sabad milai pareet am sad aa Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saach naam vadi-aa-ee paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Creator Himself abides throughout the ages.

lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay sabh  paraj vigo-ee.

lines.transliteration: bhagat  karay jan vadi-aa-ee paa-ay.

lines.transliteration: saach ratay sukh  sahj samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.transliteration: saachay kaa gaahak virlaa ko jaan.

sehjay har naam man vasaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. and they naturally enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds. ||1||Pause||

lines.transliteration: koorh kusat  tarisnaa agan bujh aa-ay.

lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay t aa sukh  paa-ay.

lines.transliteration: ha-umai vichahu thaak rahaa-ay. ||3|| and the ego within is silenced. ||3||

lines.transliteration: man marai Dhaat  mar jaa-ay.

lines.transliteration: bin man moo-ay kaisay har paa-ay.

lines.transliteration: ih man marai daaroo jaan ai ko-ay.

lines.transliteration: man asaaDh saaDh ai jan ko-ee.

lines.transliteration: achar charai taa nirmal ho-ee.

lines.transliteration: gurmukh ih man la-i-aa savaar.

lines.transliteration: ha-umai vichahu tajai vikaar. ||3||

lines.transliteration: naa saath jaa-ay na paraapat ho-ay. ||1||

lines.transliteration: saach ratay ahinis bairaag. ||2|| imbued with the True Name, day and night, they remain detached from the world.||2||

lines.english: By perfect destiny, one is absorbed in the True Name.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag har naam samaan ee.

lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik tarseh sabh  lo-ay.

lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag paraapat  ho-ay. ||3||

lines.transliteration: ootam barahm pachh aanai ko-ay.

lines.transliteration: sach saachaa sach aap drirh-aa-ay.

lines.transliteration: ham bheekh ak bh aykhaaree t ayray t oo nij pat  hai d aataa.

lines.english: Be Merciful, and bless me, a humble beggar, with Your Name, so that I may forever remain imbued with Your Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hohu dai-aal naam d ayh mangat  jan kaN-u sad aa raha-o rang raat aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਿਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your Name, O True Lord.
lines.transliteration: haN-u balihaarai jaa-o saachay tayray naam vitahu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਭੀਖਕ  ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਿਨਜ ਪਿਤ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  sabh naa kaa ayko avar na d oojaa ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦੈਆਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੰਗਤ  ਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਉ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I was wretched; I wandered through so many cycles of reincarnation. Now, Lord,please bless me with Your Grace.
lines.transliteration: bahutay fayr pa-ay kirpan ka-o ab kichh  kirpaa keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਟਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please grant me such a gift. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hohu da-i-aal d arsan d ayh apunaa aisee bakh as kareejai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the shutters of doubt have been opened wide; by Guru's Grace, I havecome to know the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak bh aram pat kh oolHay gur parsaadee jaani-aa.

lines.english: I am filled to overflowing with true love; my mind is pleased and appeased by theTrue Guru. ||3||1||9|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 Gru 1 caupdy  (666-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 cha-upd ay Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (666-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saachee liv laagee hai bheet ar sat gur si-o man maani-aa. ||3||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਫੇਰ ਪਏ ਿਕਰਪਨ  ਕਉ ਅਬ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Those Saints and devotees who serve the Lord have all their sins washed away.
lines.transliteration: jo har sayveh sant bh agat tin kay sabh  paap nivaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਐਸੀ  ਬਖਸ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Have Mercy on me, O Lord and Master, and keep me in the Sangat, the Congregationthat You love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham oopar kirpaa kar su-aamee rakh sangat  tum jo pi-aaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਨਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰਮ  ਪਟ ਖੂਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot even speak the Praises of the Lord, the Gardener of the world.
lines.transliteration: har gun kahi na saka-o banvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਹੈ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
lines.english: We are sinners, sinking like stones in water; grant Your Grace, and carry us stonesacross. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham paapee paathar neer dubat kar kirpaa paakh an ham t aaree. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The rust of poison and corruption from countless incarnations sticks to us; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it is cleaned away.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay laagay bikh morchaa lag sangat  saaDh  savaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਪਾਪ ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: It is just like gold, which is heated in the fire, to remove the impurities from it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o kanchan baisantar t aa-i-o mal kaatee katit  utaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਰਖੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਜੁ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I chant the chant of the Name of the Lord, day and night; I chant the Name of theLord, Har, Har, Har, and enshrine it within my heart.
lines.transliteration: har har japan japa-o din raat ee jap har har har ur Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the most perfect medicine in this world;chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have conquered my ego. ||3|| pMnw 667
lines.transliteration: har har har a-ukhaDh  jag pooraa jap har har ha-umai maaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਿਧ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਪਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is unapproachable, of unfathomable wisdom, unlimited, all- powerful and infinite.
lines.transliteration: har har agam agaaDh boDh  aprampar purakh  apaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Show Mercy to Your humble servant, O Life of the world, and save the honor ofservant Nanak. ||4||1|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (667-2) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o kirpaa karahu jagjeevan jan naanak paij savaaree. ||4||1||

lines.english: The humble Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord; their pain, doubt and fear haverun away.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant janaa har japi-o t in kaa d ookh bharam bh a-o bh aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself inspires them to serve Him; they are awakened within to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnee sayvaa aap karaa-ee gurmat ant ar jaagee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Name, they are unattached to the world.
lines.transliteration: har kai naam rataa bairaagee.

lines.english: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds are pleased; through Guru'sInstruction, they enshrine love for the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa sunee man bh aa-ee gurmat  har liv laagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God, the Lord and Master, is the caste and social status of His humble Saints. You arethe Lord and Master; I am just Your puppet.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee jaat  har su-aamee t umH thaakur ham saaNgee.

lines.english: As is the understanding You bless us with, so are the words we speak. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaisee mat d ayvhu har su-aamee ham t aisay bulag bulaagee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੁਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: What are we? Tiny worms, and microscopic germs. You are our great and gloriousLord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ham kiram naanH nik keeray tumH vad purakh  vadaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਬੁਲਗ  ਬੁਲਾਗੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I cannot describe Your state and extent. O God, how can we unfortunate ones meetwith You? ||3||
lines.transliteration: tumHree gat  mit kahi na sakah parabh  ham ki-o kar milah abh aagee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹਮ ਿਕਰਮ  ਨਾਨ ਿਨਕ ਕੀਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਵਡਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: O God, my Lord and Master, shower me with Your Mercy, and commit me to Yourservice.
lines.transliteration: har parabh su-aamee kirpaa Dh aarahu ham har har sayvaa laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਿਹ ਨ  ਸਕਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਮ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਲਹ  ਅਭਾਗੀ  ॥੩ ॥
lines.english: Make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, God; I speak the speech of the Lord's sermon. ||4||2|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (667-8) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daasan d aas karahu parabh  ham har kathaa kathaagee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Lord's Saint, the True Being, who chants the Bani of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har kaa sant sat gur sat  purkh aa jo bolai har har baanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾਗੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Whoever chants it, and listens to it, is liberated; I am forever a sacrifice to him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jo kahai sunai so mukt aa ham t is kai sad  kurbaanee. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, listen to the Lord's Praises with your ears.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant sunhu jas kaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ  ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: 4) har har kathaa sunhu ik nimakh pal sabh  kilvikh  paap leh jaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o. Listen to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, for a moment, for even an instant, and all your sins and mistakes shall be erased. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਹਮ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who find such humble, Holy Saints, are the greatest of the great persons.
lines.transliteration: aisaa sant saaDh  jin paa-i-aa t ay vad purakh  vadaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I beg for the dust of their feet; I long for the longing for God, my Lord and Master.||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kee Dh oor mangah parabh  su-aamee ham har loch luchaanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਪਲ ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਪਾਪ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of God, the Lord and Master, Har, Har, is the fruit-bearing tree; those who meditate on it are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har har safli-o birakh parabh  su-aamee jin japi-o say t ariptaanee.

lines.english: Drinking in the ambrosia of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am satisfied; all myhunger and thirst is quenched. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har amrit pee t ariptaasay sabh  laathee bh ookh bhukhaanee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਿਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਵਡਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with the highest, loftiest destiny, chant and meditate on theLord.
lines.transliteration: jin kay vaday bhaag vad oochay t in har japi-o japaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਮੰਗਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਲੋਚ ਲੁਚਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let me join their congregation, O God, my Lord and Master; Nanak is the slave oftheir slaves. ||4||3|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (667-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin har sangat  mayl parabh  su-aamee jan naanak d aas d asaanee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਜਨ ਜਿਪਓ  ਸੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am blind, totally blind, entangled in corruption and poison. How can I walk on theGuru's Path?
lines.transliteration: ham anDhulay anDh  bikhai bikh  raatay ki-o chaalah gur chaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੇ  ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ  ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If the True Guru, the Giver of peace, shows His kindness, He attaches us to the hemof His robe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur d a-i-aa karay sukh -daata ham laavai aapan paalee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਜਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Sikhs of the Guru, O friends, walk on the Guru's Path.
lines.transliteration: gursikh meet  chalhu gur chaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਿਲ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Whatever the Guru says, accept that as good; the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is unique and wonderful. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo gur kahai so-ee bhal maanhu har har kathaa niraalee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: serve the Guru, quickly now!
lines.transliteration: har kay sant sun hu jan bh aa-ee gur sayvihu bayg baygaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਅੰਧ ਿਬਖੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਿਕਉ  ਚਾਲਹ  ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Let your service to the True Guru be your supplies on the Lord's Path; pack them up,and don't think of today or tomorrow. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv kh arach har baaDh hu mat  jaanhu aaj ke kaalHee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹਮ ਲਾਵੈ  ਆਪਨ  ਪਾਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, chant the chant of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Saints walk withthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant japahu har japn aa har sant  chalai har naalee.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord, become the Lord; the playful, wondrous Lord meetsthem. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin har japi-aa say har ho-ay har mili-aa kayl kaylaalee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਿਨਰਾਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: To chant the chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the longing I long for; have Mercyupon me, O Lord of the world-forest.
lines.transliteration: har har japan jap loch lochaanee har kirpaa kar banvaalee.

lines.english: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; make me the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||4|| pMnw 668 DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (668-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sangat saaDh  har maylhu ham saaDh  janaa pag raalee. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰਾਲੀ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the rain-drop; I am the song-bird, crying, crying out for it.
lines.transliteration: har har boond bh a-ay har su-aamee ham chaat rik bilal billaat ee.

lines.english: O Lord God, please bless me with Your Mercy, and pour Your Name into my mouth, even if for only an instant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karahu parabh apnee mukh  dayvhu har nimkh aatee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਬਲਲ  ਿਬਲਲਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, I cannot live for even a second.
lines.transliteration: har bin reh na saka-o ik raatee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੀ  ਮੁਿਖ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਮਖਾਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Like the addict who dies without his drug, I die without the Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bin amlai amlee mar jaa-ee hai ti-o har bin ham mar jaat ee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: You, Lord, are the deepest, most unfathomable ocean; I cannot find even a trace ofYour limits.
lines.transliteration: tum har sarvar at  agaah ham leh na sakahi ant  maat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ  ਅਮਲੀ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈ  ਹੈ ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਮ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are the most remote of the remote, limitless and transcendent; O Lord Master,You alone know Your state and extent. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too parai parai aprampar su-aamee mit  jaanhu aapan gaat ee. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord's humble Saints meditate on the Lord; they are imbued with the deepcrimson color of the Guru's Love.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant janaa har japi-o gur rang chaloolai raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਵਰ  ਅਿਤ  ਅਗਾਹ  ਹਮ ਲਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਿਹ  ਅੰਤੁ ਮਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, they attain great glory, and the most sublime honor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat  banee at  sobh aa har japi-o oot am paat ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਨ  ਗਾਤੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself createsHis environments.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaakur aapay sayvak aap banaavai bh aatee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਗੁਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੈ  ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord; protect and preserve the honor of Your devotee. ||4||5|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (668-7) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan tumree sarn aa-ee har raakh o laaj bh agaat ee. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਨੀ ਅਿਤ  ਸੋਭਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਊਤਮ  ਪਾਤੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Tell me, O Siblings of Destiny, the religion for this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. I seekemancipation - how can I be emancipated?
lines.transliteration: kalijug kaa Dharam kahhu t um bh aa-ee kiv chh ootah ham chh utkaakee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਬਨਾਵੈ  ਭਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, the raft; meditating on the Lord, theswimmer swims across. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har jap bayrhee har t ulhaa har japi-o t arai taraakee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ  ਭਗਾਤੀ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, protect and preserve the honor of Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: har jee laaj rakhahu har jan kee.

lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, please make me chant the chant of Your Name; I beg only for Yourdevotional worship. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har japan japaavhu apnaa ham maagee bhagat  ikaakee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ  ਿਕਵ ਛੂਟਹ  ਹਮ ਛੁਟਕਾਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's servants are very dear to the Lord; they chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.
lines.transliteration: har kay sayvak say har pi-aaray jin japi-o har bachnaakee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਿਰ ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਕੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The account of the recording angels, Chitr and Gupt, and the account with theMessenger of Death is totally erased. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laykhaa chit ar gupat  jo likh i-aa sabh  chhootee jam kee baakee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਲਾਜ  ਰਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: The Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord in their minds; they join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant japi-o man har har lag sangat  saaDh  janaa kee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਹਮ ਮਾਗੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਇਕਾਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: The piercing sun of desires has set, and the cool moon has risen. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dinee-ar soor t arisnaa agan bujh aanee siv chari-o chand  chand aakee. ||3||

lines.english: You are the Greatest Being, absolutely unapproachable and unfathomable; You created the Universe from Your Own Being.
lines.transliteration: tum vad purakh  vad agam agochar t um aapay aap apaakee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਜਨ ਜਿਪਓ  ਹਿਰ ਬਚਨਾਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: O God, take pity on servant Nanak, and make him the slave of the slave of Yourslaves. ||4||6|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 Gru 5 dupdy  (668-15) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4 gh ar 5 d upday Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (668-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o parabh kirpaa keejai kar d aasan d aas d asaakee. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ  ਿਚਤਰ੍  ਗੁਪਿਤ  ਜੋ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸਭ ਛੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Lord within your heart, and contemplate Him. Dwell upon Him, reflectupon Him, and chant the Name of the Lord, the Enticer of hearts.
lines.transliteration: ur Dhaar beechaar muraar ramo ram manmohan naam japeenay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਿਪਓ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲਿਗ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Master is unseen, unfathomable and unreachable; through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: adrist agochar aprampar su-aamee gur poorai pargat kar d eenay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੀਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਨੀ  ਿਸਵ ਚਿਰਓ  ਚੰਦੁ ਚੰਦਾਕੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord is the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold, and sandalwood, while I am just dry wood and iron.
lines.transliteration: raam paaras chandan ham kaasat losat.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਵਡ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਪਾਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: Associating with the Lord, and the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation, the Lordhas transformed me into gold and sandalwood. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har sang haree satsang bh a-ay har kanchan chand an keenay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ਕਿਰ ਦਾਸਿਨ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਕੀ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: One may repeat, verbatim, the nine grammars and the six Shaastras, but my LordGod is not pleased by this.
lines.transliteration: nav chhi-a kh at boleh mukh  aagar mayraa har parabh  iv na pat eenay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord in your heart; this is what pleases myLord God. ||2||1||7|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (668-19) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl: pMnw 669
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har hirdai sad  Dhi-aavahu i-o har parabh  mayraa bh eenay. ||2||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਲਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਇਵ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Chant His Praises, learn of the Lord, and serve the True Guru; in this way, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gun kaho har lahu kar sayvaa satgur iv har har naam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਜਨਿਮ ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, He shall be pleased with you, and you shall not have to enterthe cycle of reincarnation again; you shall merge in the Divine Light of the Lord, Har,Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har dargeh bh aaveh fir janam na aavahi har har har jot  samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਹੋਿਹ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖੀ ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and you shall be totally at peace.
lines.transliteration: jap man naam haree hohi sarab sukhee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਊਚ ਸਭਨਾ  ਤੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਿਵ ਛਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Praises are the most sublime, the most exalted; serving the Lord, Har, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jas ooch sabhnaa t ay oopar har har har sayv chh adaa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord, the treasure of mercy, blessed me, and so the Guru blessed me with theLord's devotional worship; I have come to be in love with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa niDh keenee gur bh agat har d eenee t ab har si-o pareet  ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਬ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: ||2||2||8|| I have forgotten my cares and anxieties, and enshrined the Lord's Name in my heart;O Nanak, the Lord has become my friend and companion. ||2||2||8|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (669-5) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: baho chint visaaree har naam ur Dh aaree naanak har bh a-ay hai sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਿਚੰਤ  ਿਵਸਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
lines.english: Read about the Lord, write about the Lord, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Lord'sPraises; the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: har parh har likh  har jap har gaa-o har bh a-ojal paar ut aaree.

lines.english: In your mind, by your words, and within your heart, meditate on the Lord, and He will be pleased. In this way, repeat the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man bachan ridai Dh i-aa-ay har ho-ay sant usat iv bh an har naam muraaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੜੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਖੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਉ  ਹਿਰ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ ਉਤਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: man japee-ai har jagdees.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਬਚਿਨ  ਿਰਦੈ ਿਧਆਇ  ਹਿਰ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਇਵ ਭਣੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O friend.
lines.transliteration: mil sangat saaDh oo meet .

lines.english: You shall be happy forever, day and night; sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand hovai d in raat ee har keerat  kar banvaaree. rahaa-o.

lines.english: When the Lord, Har, Har, casts His Glance of Grace, then I made the effort in mymind; meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been emancipated.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) har har karee darisat t ab bh a-i-o man ud am har har naam japi-o gat  bha-ee hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: 4) jan naanak kee pat raakh  mayray su-aamee har aa-ay pari-o hai saran  tumaaree. ||2||3||9|| Preserve the honor of servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I have come seekingYour Sanctuary. ||2||3||9|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (669-9) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
The eighty-four Siddhas, the spiritual masters, the Buddhas, the three hundred thirtymillion gods and the silent sages, all long for Your Name, O Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: cha-oraaseeh siDh buDh  taytees kot mun jan sabh  chaaheh har jee-o t ayro naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰੀ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਤਬ ਭਇਓ  ਮਿਨ ਉਦਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਓ  ਗਿਤ  ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few obtain it; upon their foreheads, the pre-ordained destinyof loving devotion is written. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ko virlaa paavai jin ka-o lilaat likh i-aa Dh ur bhaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਆਇ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord; singing the Lord's Praises is the most exalted activity.
lines.transliteration: jap man raamai naam har jas ootam kaam.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who sing, and hear Your Praises, O Lord and Master.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo gaavahi suneh t ayraa jas su-aamee ha-o t in kai sad  balihaarai jaa-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਿਸਧ ਬੁਧ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਕੋਿਟ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸਿਭ ਚਾਹਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Cherisher God, my Lord and Master; whatever You give me,I accept.
lines.transliteration: sarnaagat  partipaalak har su-aamee jo t um dayh so-ee ha-o paa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਲਲਾਿਟ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, give me this blessing; Nanak longs for the Lord'smeditative remembrance. ||2||4||10|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (669-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaa kar d eejai naanak har simran  kaa hai chaa-o. ||2||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ  ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.english: All the Sikhs and servants come to worship and adore You; they sing the sublime Baniof the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sikh poojan  sabh  aavahi sabh  gaavahi har har oot am baanee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਿਹ ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: DnwsrI, mÚ 4) gaavi-aa suni-aa t in kaa har thaa-ay paavai jin sat gur kee aagi-aa sat  sat kar maanee. ||1|| Their singing and listening is approved by the Lord; they accept the Order of the TrueGuru as True, totally True. ||1||
Chant the Lord's Praises, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the sacred shrine ofpilgrimage in the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bolhu bhaa-ee har keerat  har bh avjal t irath.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਉ ॥
lines.english: They alone are praised in the Court of the Lord, O Saints, who know and understand the Lord's sermon. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har dar t in kee oot am baat  hai sant ahu har kathaa jin janhu jaanee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਣ  ਕਾ ਹੈ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; the Lord God Himself plays Hiswondrous games.
lines.transliteration: aapay gur chaylaa hai aapay aapay har parabh choj vidaanee.

lines.english: DnwsrI, mÚ 4) jan naanak aap milaa-ay so-ee har milsee avar sabh t i-aag ohaa har bh aanee. ||2||5||11|| O servant Nanak, he alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself merges; allthe others are forsaken, but the Lord loves him. ||2||5||11|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (669-18) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਿਸਖ ਪੂਜਣ  ਸਿਭ ਆਵਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Fulfiller of desires, the Giver of total peace; the Kaamadhaynaa, thewish-fulfilling cow, is in His power.
lines.transliteration: ichhaa poorak sarab sukh -daata har jaa kai vas hai kaamDh aynaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਿਵਆ  ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਵੈ ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||1|| So meditate on such a Lord, O my soul. Then, you shall obtain total peace, O mymind. ||1|| pMnw 670
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har Dhi-aa-ee-ai mayray jee-arh ay taa sarab sukh  paavahi mayray manaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅੜੇ  ਤਾ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chant, O my mind, the True Name, Sat Naam, the True Name.
lines.transliteration: jap man sat naam sad aa sat  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: In this world, and in the world beyond, your face shall be radiant, by meditating continually on the immaculate Lord God. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  mukh  oojal ho-ee hai nit  Dhi-aa-ee-ai har purakh  niranjanaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਿਨਤ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever anyone remembers the Lord in meditation, disaster runs away from thatplace. By great good fortune, we meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jah har simran bha-i-aa t ah upaaDh  gat keenee vadbh aagee har japnaa.

lines.english: The Guru has blessed servant Nanak with this understanding, that by meditating onthe Lord, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||6||12|| DnwsrI mhlw 4 ] (670-4) Dhanaasree mehlaa 4. Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o gur ih mat d eenee jap har bh avjal t arnaa. ||2||6||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ਤਹ ਉਪਾਿਧ  ਗਤੁ ਕੀਨੀ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my King, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I am at peace.
lines.transliteration: mayray saahaa mai har darsan sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਇਹ ਮਿਤ ਦੀਨੀ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ  ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
lines.english: You alone know my inner pain, O King; what can anyone else know? ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hamree baydan t oo jaant aa saahaa avar ki-aa jaanai ko-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: O True Lord and Master, You are truly my King; whatever You do, all that is True.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib sach too mayray saahaa t ayraa kee-aa sach sabh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Who should I call a liar? There is no other than You, O King. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa kis ka-o aakh ee-ai saahaa d oojaa naahee ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੀ  ਬੇਦਿਨ  ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You are pervading and permeating in all; O King, everyone meditates on You, day andnight.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa vich t oo varatd aa saahaa sabh  tujheh Dh i-aavahi d in raat .

lines.english: Everyone begs of You, O my King; You alone give gifts to all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ujh hee thaavhu mangd ay mayray saahaa t oo sabh naa karahi ik d aat. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All are under Your Power, O my King; none at all are beyond You.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t ujh hee vich hai mayray saahaa t ujh tay baahar ko-ee naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠਾ ਿਕਸ ਕਉ ਆਖੀਐ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All beings are Yours-You belong to all, O my King. All shall merge and be absorbed in You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-a t ayray t oo sabh as daa mayray saahaa sabh  tujh hee maahi samaahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਸਿਭ ਤੁਝਿਹ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: You are the hope of all, O my Beloved; all meditate on You, O my King.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kee t oo aas hai mayray pi-aaray sabh  tujheh Dh i-aavahi mayray saah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ  ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਇਕ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, protect and preserve me, O my Beloved; You are the True King ofNanak. ||4||7||13|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 Gru 1 caupdy  (670-11) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 cha-upd ay Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (670-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh  too mayray pi-aaray sach naanak kay paat isaah. ||4||7||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ  ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕੋਈ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Destroyer of fear, Remover of suffering, Lord and Master, Lover of Your devotees,Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhav kh andan d ukh bhanjan savaamee bh agat vachh al nirankaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ  ਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ  ਸਿਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Millions of sins are eradicated in an instant when, as Gurmukh, one contemplates theNaam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh mitay kh in bheetar jaaN gurmukh  naam samaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ  ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਿਭ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
lines.english: My mind is attached to my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man laagaa hai raam pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
lines.english: God, Merciful to the meek, granted His Grace, and placed the five enemies under mycontrol. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal karee parabh  kirpaa vas keenay panch d ootaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Your place is so beautiful; Your form is so beautiful; Your devotees look so beautiful inYour Court.
lines.transliteration: tayraa thaan suhaavaa roop suhaavaa t ayray bh agat soheh d arbaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਸਾਮੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master, Giver of all beings, please, grant Your Grace, and save me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa kay daat ay su-aamee kar kirpaa layho ubaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਪਰਾਧ  ਿਮਟੇ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your color is not known, and Your form is not seen; who can contemplate Your Almighty Creative Power?
lines.transliteration: tayraa varan na jaapai roop na lakh ee-ai t ayree kud rat ka-un beechaaray.

lines.english: You are contained in the water, the land and the sky, everywhere, O Lord ofunfathomable form, Holder of the mountain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al ravi-aa sarab thaa-ee agam roop girDh aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਿਲ  ਕਰੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਵਿਸ ਕੀਨੇ  ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All beings sing Your Praises; You are the imperishable Primal Being, the Destroyer ofego.
lines.transliteration: keerat karahi sagal jan t ayree t oo abh inaasee purakh  muraaray.

lines.english: As it pleases You, please protect and preserve me; servant Nanak seeks Sanctuary atYour Door. ||4||1|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (670-17) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh o su-aamee jan naanak saran d u-aaray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਦਰਬਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The fish out of water loses its life; it is deeply in love with the water.
lines.transliteration: bin jal paraan tajay hai meenaa jin jal si-o hayt  badh aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The bumble bee, totally in love with the lotus flower, is lost in it; it cannot find the way to escape from it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kamal hayt binsi-o hai bh avraa un maarag nikas na paa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਉਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Now, my mind has nurtured love for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ab man aykas si-o moh keenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਠਾਈ  ਅਗਮ  ਰੂਪ ਿਗਰਧਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He does not die, and is not born; He is always with me. Through the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, I know Him. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 671
lines.transliteration: marai na jaavai sad hee sangay sat gur sabd ee cheenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Lured by sexual desire, the elephant is trapped; the poor beast falls into the power of another.
lines.transliteration: kaam hayt kunchar lai faaNki-o oh par vas bh a-i-o bichaaraa.

lines.english: Lured by the sound of the hunter's bell, the deer offers its head; because of thisenticement, it is killed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naad hayt  sir daari-o kurankaa us hee hayt  bidaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਹੇਿਤ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਲੈ ਫਿਕਓ  ਓਹੁ ਪਰ ਵਿਸ ਭਇਓ  ਿਬਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon his family, the mortal is enticed by greed; he clings in attachment toMaya.
lines.transliteration: daykh  kutamb lobh  mohi-o paraanee maa-i-aa ka-o laptaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਦ  ਹੇਿਤ ਿਸਰੁ ਡਾਿਰਓ  ਕੁਰੰਕਾ  ਉਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਤ ਿਬਦਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Totally engrossed in worldly things, he considers them to be his own; but in the end, he shall surely have to leave them behind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: at rachi-o kar leeno apunaa un chh od saraapar jaanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਲੋਿਭ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Know it well, that anyone who loves any other than God, shall be miserable forever.
lines.transliteration: bin gobind avar sang nayhaa oh jaan hu sad aa duhaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਰਿਚਓ  ਕਿਰ ਲੀਨੋ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਉਿਨ  ਛੋਿਡ ਸਰਾਪਰ  ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has explained this to me, that love for God brings lasting bliss.||4||2|| DnwsrI mÚ 5 ] (671-4) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur ihai bujhaa-i-o pareet  parabh oo sad  kaylaa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਅਵਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨੇਹਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with His Name, and released me of mybonds.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa dee-o mohi naamaa banDh an tay chh utkaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: I have forgotten all worldly entanglements, and I am attached to the Guru's feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tay bisri-o saglo Dh anDhaa gur kee charn ee laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have renounced my other cares andanxieties.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang chint  biraanee chh aadee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਦੀਓ  ਮੋਿਹ ਨਾਮਾ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I dug a deep pit, and buried my egotistical pride, emotional attachment and thedesires of my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh moh man baasan d ay kar gadhaa gaadee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਿਬਸਿਰਓ  ਸਗਲੋ  ਧੰਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one is my enemy, and I am no one's enemy.
lines.transliteration: naa ko mayraa dusman rahi-aa naa ham kis kay bairaa-ee.

lines.english: God, who expanded His expanse, is within a ll; I learned this from the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: barahm pasaar pasaari-o bheet ar sat gur tay sojh ee paa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਮੋਹ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ  ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਗਡਹਾ  ਗਾਡੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a friend to all; I am everyone's friend.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko meet  ham aapan keenaa ham sabh naa kay saajan.

lines.english: When the sense of separation was removed from my mind, then I was united with the Lord, my King. ||3||
lines.transliteration: door paraa-i-o man kaa birhaa t aa mayl kee-o mayrai raajan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਨਾ ਹਮ ਿਕਸ ਕੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My stubbornness is gone, Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and the Word of the Guru'sShabad seems so sweet to me.
lines.transliteration: binsi-o dheeth aa amrit  vooth aa sabad  lago gur meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਿਰਓ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is pervading everywhere, in the water, on the land and in the sky; Nanak beholdsthe all-pervading Lord. ||4||3|| DnwsrI mÚ 5 ] (671-10) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al sarab nivaasee naanak rama-ee-aa deethaa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮ ਆਪਨ  ਕੀਨਾ  ਹਮ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕੇ ਸਾਜਨ  ॥
lines.english: Ever since I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, my days havebeen blessed and prosperous.
lines.transliteration: jab tay d arsan bh aytay saaDh oo bh alay d inas o-ay aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਿਰ ਪਰਾਇਓ  ਮਨ ਕਾ ਿਬਰਹਾ  ਤਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ  ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਜਨ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have found lasting bliss, singing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Primal Lord, theArchitect of destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand sadaa kar keert an purakh  biDhaataa paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਿਸਓ  ਢੀਠਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਵੂਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Now, I sing the Praises of the Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi raam jaso man gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਮਈਆ  ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind has been illumined and enlightened, and it is always at peace; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o pargaas sad aa sukh  man meh sat gur pooraa paa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, abides deep within the heart, and so pain, doubt andfear have been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan rid  bheetar vasi-aa t aa dookh bharam bh a-o bh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਲੇ ਿਦਨਸ ਓਇ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the most incomprehensible thing, enshrining love for the Name of theLord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bha-ee paraapat  vasat  agochar raam naam rang laagaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I was anxious, and now I am free of anxiety; I was worried, and now I am free ofworry; my grief, greed and emotional attachments are gone.
lines.transliteration: chint achint aa soch asochaa sog lobh  moh thaakaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਰਾਮ ਜਸੋ ਮਿਨ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: By His Grace, I am cured of the disease of egotism, and the Messenger of Death nolonger terrifies me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog mitay kirpaa tay jam t ay bh a-ay bibaakaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Working for the Guru, serving the Guru and the Guru's Command, all are pleasing tome.
lines.transliteration: gur kee tahal guroo kee sayvaa gur kee aagi-aa bhaan ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, He has released me from the clutches of Death; I am a sacrifice to thatGuru. ||4||4|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (671-16) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin jam tay kaadh ay tis gur kai kurbaan ee. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਿਰਦ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਤਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Body, mind, wealth and everything belong to Him; He alone is all-wise and all- knowing.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa tan man Dh an sabh  tis kaa so-ee sugh arh sujaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He listens to my pains and pleasures, and then my condition improves. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin hee sun i-aa d ukh sukh  mayraa t a-o biDh  neekee kh ataanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤ  ਅਿਚੰਤਾ  ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚਾ  ਸੋਗੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਥਾਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: My soul is satisfied with the One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee aykai hee peh maanee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗ ਿਮਟੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਿਬਬਾਕਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: People make all sorts of other efforts, but they have no value at all. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar jatan kar rahay bahut ayray t in til nahee keemat  jaanee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel. The Guru has givenme this advice.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam nirmolak heeraa gur d eeno mant aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: It cannot be lost, and it cannot be shaken off; it remains steady, and I am perfectlysatisfied with it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: digai na dolai darirh  kar rahi-o pooran ho-ay t ariptaanee. ||2||

lines.english: Those things which tore me away from You, Lord, are now gone. pMnw 672
lines.transliteration: o-ay jo beech ham tum kachh  hotay tin kee baat  bilaanee.

lines.english: When golden ornaments are melted down into a lump, they are still said to be gold. ||3||
lines.transliteration: alankaar mil thailee ho-ee hai taa t ay kanik vakh aanee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਥੈਲੀ  ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਿਨਕ  ਵਖਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Divine Light has illuminated me, and I am filled with celestial peace and glory; the unstruck melody of the Lord's Bani resounds within me.
lines.transliteration: pargati-o jot sahj sukh  sobh aa baajay anhat  baanee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਓ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ  ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have built my eternal home; the Guru has constructed it for me.||4||5|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (672-3) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nihchal ghar baaDh i-o gur kee-o banDh aanee. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਘਰੁ ਬਾਿਧਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਓ  ਬੰਧਾਨੀ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: The desires of the greatest of the great kings and landlords cannot be satisfied.
lines.transliteration: vaday vaday raajan ar bhooman t aa kee t arisan na boojh ee.

lines.english: They remain engrossed in Maya, intoxicated with the pleasures of their wealth; theireyes see nothing else at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lapat rahay maa-i-aa rang maatay lochan kachh oo na soojh ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ  ਅਰੁ ਭੂਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
lines.english: No one has ever found satisfaction in sin and corruption.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa meh kin hee t aripat  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਪਿਟ  ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਮਾਤੇ ਲੋਚਨ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The flame is not satisfied by more fuel; how can one be satisfied without the Lord?||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o paavak eeDhan nahee Dh araapai bin har kahaa agh aa-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Day after day, he eats his meals with many different foods, but his hunger is noteradicated.
lines.transliteration: din din karat  bhojan baho binjan t aa kee mitai na bh ookhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਪਾਵਕੁ  ਈਧਿਨ  ਨਹੀ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਹਾ ਅਘਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He runs around like a dog, searching in the four directions. ||2||
lines.transliteration: udam karai su-aan kee ni-aa-ee chaaray kuntaa gh okhaa. ||2||

lines.english: The lustful, lecherous man desires many women, and he never stops peeking into the homes of others.
lines.transliteration: kaamvant kaamee baho naaree par garih joh na chookai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਕਰਤ  ਭੋਜਨ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬੰਜਨ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਿਮਟੈ ਨ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
lines.english: Day after day, he commits adultery again and again, and then he regrets his actions;he wastes away in misery and greed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: din parat  karai karai pachh utaapai sog lobh  meh sookai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰੈ ਸੁਆਨ  ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਘੋਖਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is incomparable and priceless; it is the treasure ofAmbrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: har har naam apaar amolaa amrit ayk niDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਵੰਤ  ਕਾਮੀ  ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ  ਪਰ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਜੋਹ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
lines.english: The Saints abide in peace, poise and bliss; O Nanak, through the Guru, this is known.||4||6|| DnwsrI mÚ 5 ] (672-8) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  santan kai naanak gur t ay jaanaa. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨ ਪਰ੍ਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ  ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮਿਹ ਸੂਕੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nothing which this mortal being runs after, can compare to it.
lines.transliteration: lavai na laagan ka-o hai kachhoo-ai jaa ka-o fir ih Dh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ  ਅਮੋਲਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਏਕੁ ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: He alone comes to have it, whom the Guru blesses with this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o gur deeno ih amrit  tis hee ka-o ban aavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: DnwsrI, mÚ 5) jaa ka-o aa-i-o ayk rasaa. khaan paan aan nahee kh uDhi-aa taa kai chit  na basaa. rahaa-o. The desire to eat, to wear new clothes, and all other desires, do not abide in the mindof one who comes to know the subtle essence of the One Lord. ||Pause||
The mind and body blossom forth in abundance, when one receives even a drop of this Nectar.
lines.transliteration: ma-uli-o man tan ho-i-o hari-aa ayk boond  jin paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ  ਕਉ ਹੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਫਿਰ  ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: I cannot express His glory; I cannot describe His worth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baran na saaka-o ustat  taa kee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਨੋ  ਇਹੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਿਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: We cannot meet the Lord by our own efforts, nor can we meet Him through service;He comes and meets us spontaneously.
lines.transliteration: ghaal na mili-o sayv na mili-o mili-o aa-ay achint aa.

lines.english: One who is blessed by my Lord Master's Grace, practices the Teachings of the Guru'sMantra. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o da-i-aa karee mayrai th aakur t in gureh kamaano mannt aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ  ਨਹੀ ਖੁਿਧਆ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਬਸਾ ॥
lines.english: He is merciful to the meek, always kind and compassionate; He cherishes andnurtures all beings.
lines.transliteration: deen d ai-aal sad aa kirpaalaa sarab jee-aa part ipaalaa.

lines.english: The Lord is mingled with Nanak, through and through; He cherishes him, like themother her child. ||4||7|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (672-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ot pot  naanak sang ravi-aa ji-o maat aa baal gopaalaa. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਉਿਲਓ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਓ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,within me.
lines.transliteration: baar jaa-o gur apunay oopar jin har har naam darirh -aa-yaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the utter darkness of the wilderness, He showed me the straight path. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa udi-aan anDh kaar meh jin seeDh aa maarag d ikhaa-yaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਾਲ  ਨ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਸੇਵ ਨ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਆਇ  ਅਿਚੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the universe, the Cherisher of the world, He is my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: hamray paraan gupaal gobind.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਿਤਿਨ ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਕਮਾਨੋ  ਮੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, he takes care of everything for me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa sarab thok kee jisahi hamaaree chind. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦੈਆਲ  ਸਦਾ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, I have found all treasures, respect, greatness and perfect honor.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran sarab niDhaanaa maan mahat  pat pooree.

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਜਉ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਬਾਲ  ਗਪਾਲਾ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: Remembering His Name, millions of sins are erased; all His devotees long for the dustof His feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam lait kot agh  naasay bh agat baachh eh sabh  Dhooree. ||2||

lines.english: If someone wishes for the fulfillment of all his hopes and desires, he should serve theone supreme treasure.
lines.transliteration: sarab manorath jay ko chaahai sayvai ayk niDhaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਊਪਿਰ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਯਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Supreme Lord God, infinite Lord and Master; meditating on Him inremembrance, one is carried across. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aprampar su-aamee simrat paar paraanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਅੰਧਕਾਰ  ਮਿਹ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸੀਧਾ  ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਿਦਖਾਯਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found total peace and tranquility in the Society of the Saints; my honor hasbeen preserved.
lines.transliteration: seetal saaNt mahaa sukh  paa-i-aa sat sang rahi-o olHaa.

lines.english: To gather in the Lord's wealth, and to taste the food of the Lord's Name - Nanak has made this his feast. ||4||8|| pMnw 673 DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (673-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har Dhan sanchan har naam bh ojan ih naanak keeno cholHaa. ||4||8||

lines.english: You have made it your habit to practice those deeds which will bring you shame.
lines.transliteration: jih karnee hoveh sarmind aa ihaa kamaanee reet .

lines.english: You slander the Saints, and you worship the faithless cynics; such are the corrupt ways you have adopted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant kee nind aa saakat  kee poojaa aisee d arirh-ee bipreet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਕਰਣੀ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਸਰਿਮੰਦਾ  ਇਹਾ  ਕਮਾਨੀ  ਰੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Deluded by your emotional attachment to Maya, you love other things,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh bhoolo avrai heet .

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ ਸਾਕਤ  ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਐਸੀ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜੀ  ਿਬਪਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: harichand-uree ban har paat  ray ihai t uhaaro beet . ||1|| rahaa-o. like the enchanted city of Hari-chandauree, or the green leaves of the forest - such isyour way of life. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Its body may be anointed with sandalwood oil, but the donkey still loves to roll in themud.
lines.transliteration: chandan layp hot  dayh ka-o sukh  garDh abh bhasam sangeet .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਚੰਦਉਰੀ  ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ਰੇ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ  ਬੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is not fond of the Ambrosial Nectar; instead, he loves the poisonous drug ofcorruption. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit sang naahi ruch aavat  bikhai thag-uree pareet . ||2||

lines.english: The Saints are noble and sublime; they are blessed with good fortune. They alone are pure and holy in this world.
lines.transliteration: utam sant  bhalay sanjogee is jug meh pavit  puneet .

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨ  ਲੇਪ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਗਰਧਭ  ਭਸਮ  ਸੰਗੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The jewel of this human life is passing away uselessly, lost in exchange for mereglass. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaat akaarath janam pad aarath kaach baad rai jeet . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਰੁਚ ਆਵਤ  ਿਬਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The sins and sorrows of uncounted incarnations run away, when the Guru applies thehealing ointment of spiritual wisdom to the eyes.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilvikh d ukh bhaagay gur gi-aan anjan nayt ar deet.

lines.punjabi: ਉਤਮ  ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਪਿਵਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have escaped from these troubles;Nanak loves the One Lord. ||4||9|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (673-6) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang in d ukh tay niksi-o naanak ayk pareet . ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਤ  ਅਕਾਰਥ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਕਾਚ  ਬਾਦਰੈ  ਜੀਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; I sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: paanee pakhaa peesa-o sant  aagai gun  govind  jas gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਗਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਦੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, my mind remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord; inthis way, it finds the treasure of peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saas saas man naam samHaarai ih bisraam niDh paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਇਨ ਦੁਖ ਤੇ ਿਨਕਿਸਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕ ਪਰੀਤ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: Have pity on me, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tumH karahu d a-i-aa mayray saa-ee.

lines.english: Bless me with such understanding, O my Lord and Master, that I may forever and ever meditate on You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aisee mat d eejai mayray th aakur sad aa sad aa tuDh Dhi-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਨੀ  ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ  ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, emotional attachment and egotism are eradicated, and doubt isdispelled.
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay moh maan chh ootai binas jaa-ay bh armaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੈ  ਇਹੁ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ਿਨਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is pervading and permeating in all; wherever I go,there I see Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anad roop ravi-o sabh  maDh ay jat  kat paykh a-o jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the Purifier of sinners, Lord ofthe world.
lines.transliteration: tumH da-i-aal kirpaal kirpaa niDh  patit paavan gosaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਮਿਤ ਦੀਜੈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I obtain millions of joys, comforts and kingdoms, if You inspire me to chant YourName with my mouth, even for an instant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kot sookh aanand  raaj paa-ay mukh  tay nimakh  bulaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: That alone is perfect chanting, meditation, penance and devotional worship service,which is pleasing to God's Mind.
lines.transliteration: jaap taap bh agat saa pooree jo parabh  kai man bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਭਰਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, all thirst and desire is satisfied; Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled.||4||10|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (673-12) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam japat t arisnaa sabh  bujhee hai naanak t aripat  aghaa-ee. ||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਰੂਪੁ ਰਿਵਓ  ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She controls the three qualities and the four directions of the world.
lines.transliteration: jin keenay vas apunai tarai gun  bhavan chatur sansaaraa.

lines.english: She destroys sacrificial feasts, cleansing baths, penances and sacred places of pilgrimage; what is this poor person to do? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jag isnaan taap thaan kh anday ki-aa ih jant  vichaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ  ਰਾਜ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਿਨਮਖ  ਬੁਲਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I grasped God's Support and Protection, and then I was emancipated.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee ot gahee t a-o chh ooto.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Holy Saints, I sang the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and mysins and afflictions were taken away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDh parsaad  har har har gaa-ay bikh ai bi-aaDh  tab hooto. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: She is not heard - she does not speak with a mouth; she is not seen enticing mortals.
lines.transliteration: nah sunee-ai nah mukh  tay bakee-ai nah mohai uh deeth ee.

lines.english: She administers her intoxicating drug, and so confuses them; thus she seems sweet toeveryone's mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aisee thag-uree paa-ay bh ulaavai man sabh  kai laagai meeth ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਵਿਸ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਵਣ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every home, she has implanted the sense of duality in mother, father,children, friends and siblings.
lines.transliteration: maa-ay baap poot hit  bharaataa un gh ar ghar mayli-o d oo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਇਸਨਾਨ  ਤਾਪ ਥਾਨ ਖੰਡੇ ਿਕਆ  ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਿਵਚਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some have more, and some have less; they fight and fight, to the death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kis hee vaaDh gh aat kis hee peh saglay lar lar moo-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੋ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has shown me this wondrous play.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur apunay jin ih chalat  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਏ  ਿਬਖੈ ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਤਬ ਹੂਟੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The world is being consumed by this hidden fire, but Maya does not cling to the Lord's devotees. ||4||
lines.transliteration: goojhee bh aahi jalai sansaaraa bh agat na bi-aapai maa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained supreme bliss, and all my bonds havebeen broken.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  mahaa sukh  paa-i-aa saglay banDh an kaatay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਨਹ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬਕੀਐ  ਨਹ ਮੋਹੈ ਉਹ ਡੀਠੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; having earned hisprofits, he has now returned home. ||5||11|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (673-19) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har naam naanak Dhan paa-i-aa apunai gh ar lai aa-i-aa kh aatay. ||5||11||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਪਾਇ  ਭੁਲਾਵੈ  ਮਿਨ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ  ਮੀਠੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Giver, O Lord, O Cherisher, my Master, my Husband Lord. pMnw 674
lines.transliteration: tum d aatay thaakur part ipaalak naa-ik kh asam hamaaray.

lines.english: Each and every moment, You cherish and nurture me; I am Your child, and I rely upon You alone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nimakh nimakh  tum hee part ipaalahu ham baarik t umray Dh aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਖ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਹ ੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have only one tongue - which of Your Glorious Virtues can I describe?
lines.transliteration: jihvaa ayk kavan gun kahee-ai.

lines.english: Unlimited, infinite Lord and Master - no one knows Your limits. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baysumaar bay-ant su-aamee t ayro ant  na kin hee lahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇਰੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You destroy millions of my sins, and teach me in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh hamaaray kh andahu anik biDh ee samjh aavhu.

lines.english: I am so ignorant - I understand nothing at all. Please honor Your innate nature, and save me! ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham agi-aan alap mat thoree t um aapan birad  rakhaavahu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਪਰਾਧ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਖੰਡਹੁ ਅਿਨਕ  ਿਬਧੀ  ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary - You are my only hope. You are my companion, and my bestfriend.
lines.transliteration: tumree saran  tumaaree aasaa t um hee sajan suhaylay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅਲਪ  ਮਿਤ ਥੋਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਆਪਨ  ਿਬਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Save me, O Merciful Saviour Lord; Nanak is the slave of Your home. ||3||12|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (674-5) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raakho raakh anhaar d a-i-aalaa naanak gh ar kay golay. ||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਆਸਾ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ  ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Worship, fasting, ceremonial marks on one's forehead, cleansing baths, generousdonations to charities and self-mortification
lines.transliteration: poojaa varat t ilak isnaanaa punn d aan baho d ain.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahoo-aN na bheejai sanjam su-aamee boleh meeth ay bain. ||1|| - the Lord Master is not pleased with any of these rituals, no matter how sweetly onemay speak. ||1||

lines.english: Chanting the Name of God, the mind is soothed and pacified.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee ko naam japat  man chain.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ  ਿਤਲਕ  ਇਸਨਾਨਾ  ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਬਹੁ ਦੈਨ ॥
lines.english: Everyone searches for Him in different ways, but the search is so difficult, and Hecannot be found. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baho parkaar khojeh sabh  taa ka-o bikh am na jaa-ee lain. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੰਜਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting, deep meditation and penance, wandering over the face of the earth, the performance of austerities with the arms stretched up to the sky
lines.transliteration: jaap taap bh arman basuDh aa kar uraDh  taap lai gain.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਮਨ ਚੈਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih biDh nah pat ee-aano th aakur jog jugat  kar jain. ||2|| - the Lord is not pleased by any of these means, though one may follow the path ofYogis and Jains. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰ  ਖੋਜਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਲੈਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Praises of the Lord are priceless;he alone obtains them, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam nirmolak har jas t in paa-i-o jis kirpain.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak lives in the Love of God;his life-night passes in peace. ||3||13|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (674-9) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang rang parabh  bhaytay naanak sukh  jan rain. ||3||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਰ੍ਮਨ  ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਕਿਰ ਉਰਧ  ਤਾਪ ਲੈ ਗੈਨ ॥
lines.english: Is there anyone who can release me from my bondage, unite me with God, recite theName of the Lord, Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: banDhan t ay chh utkaavai parabh oo milaavai har har naam sunaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨੋ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਜੈਨ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: asthir karay nihchal ih manoo-aa bahur na kathoo Dh aavai. ||1|| and make this mind steady and stable, so that it no longer wanders around? ||1||

lines.english: Do I have any such friend?
lines.transliteration: hai ko-oo aiso hamraa meet.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਰੰਿਗ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਜਨ ਰੈਨ ॥੩॥੧੩॥
lines.english: I would give him all my property, my soul and my heart; I would devote my consciousness to him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree jee-o hee-o day-o arpa-o apno cheet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Others' wealth, others' bodies, and the slander of others - do not attach your love tothem.
lines.transliteration: par Dhan par t an par kee nind aa in si-o pareet  na laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਵੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Associate with the Saints, speak with the Saints, and keep your mind awake to theKirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: santeh sang sant  sambh aakhan har keert an man jaagai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God is the treasure of virtue, kind and compassionate, the source of all comfort.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan d a-i-aal purakh  parabh  sarab sookh  da-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the gift of Your Name; O Lord of the world, love him, like the motherloves her child. ||3||14|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (674-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maagai daan naam t ayro naanak ji-o maat aa baal gupaalaa. ||3||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਹੀਉ ਦੇਉ ਅਰਪਉ  ਅਪਨੋ  ਚੀਤੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord saves His Saints.
lines.transliteration: har har leenay sant ubaar.

lines.english: One who wishes misfortune upon the Lord's slaves, shall be destroyed by the Lordeventually. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kay daas kee chit vai buri-aa-ee t is hee ka-o fir maar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਇਨ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the help and support of His humble servants; He defeats the slanderers, and chases them away.
lines.transliteration: jan kaa aap sahaa-ee ho-aa nindak bh aagay haar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹ  ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਿਨ  ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wandering around aimlessly, they die out there; they never return to their homesagain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bharmat  bharmat  oohaaN hee moo-ay baahurh  garihi na manjh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; he sings the Glorious Praises ofthe infinite Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pari-o d ukh bhanjan gun gaavai sad aa apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਗੈ  ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਉ ਮਾਤਾ  ਬਾਲ  ਗੁਪਾਲਾ  ॥੩॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The faces of the slanderers are blackened in the courts of this world, and the worldbeyond. ||2||15|| DnwisrI mhlw 5 ] (674-18) Dhanaasiree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nindak kaa mukh  kaalaa ho-aa d een d unee-aa kai d arbaar. ||2||15||

lines.english: Now, I contemplate and meditate on the Lord, the Saviour Lord.
lines.transliteration: ab har raakhanhaar chit aari-aa.

lines.english: He purifies sinners in an instant, and cures all diseases. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  kee-ay kh in bheetar saglaa rog bid aari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਬੁਿਰਆਈ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਿਫਿਰ ਮਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Talking with the Holy Saints, my sexual desire, anger and greed have been eradicated.
lines.transliteration: gosat bha-ee saaDh  kai sangam kaam kroDh  lobh maari-aa.

lines.english: Remembering, remembering the Perfect Lord in meditation, I have saved all my companions. ||1|| pMnw 675
lines.transliteration: simar simar pooran naaraa-in sangee saglay taari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Mul Mantra, the Root Mantra, is the only cure for the mind; I have installed faith in God in my mind.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  mant ar mool man aykai man bisvaas parabh  Dhaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਖਧ  ਮੰਤਰ੍ ਮੂਲ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਿਬਸਾਸੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak ever longs for the dust of the Lord's feet; again and again, he is a sacrifice tothe Lord. ||2||16|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (675-2) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan rayn baaNchhai nit  naanak punah punah balihaari-aa. ||2||16||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਬਛੈ ਿਨਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I have fallen in love with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayraa laago raam si-o hayt.

lines.english: My True Guru is always my help and support; He has torn down the banner of pain.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa sad aa sahaa-ee jin d ukh kaa kaati-aa kayt . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Giving me His hand, He has protected me as His own, and removed all my troubles.
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh i-o apunaa kar birthaa sagal mitaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਕੇਤੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has blackened the faces of the slanderers, and He Himself has become the helpand support of His humble servant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nindak kay mukh  kaalay keenay jan kaa aap sahaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The True Lord and Master has become my Saviour; hugging me close in His embrace,He has saved me.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib ho-aa rakhvaalaa raakh  lee-ay kanth  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਰ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਮਟਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has become fearless, and he enjoys eternal peace, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||17|| DnwisrI mhlw 5 ] (675-6) Dhanaasiree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay sad aa sukh  maan ay naanak har gun  gaa-ay. ||2||17||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਿਪ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is the medicine, O Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  tayro naam d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ ਹੋਆ  ਰਖਵਾਲਾ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਏ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am so miserable, I do not know Your state; You Yourself cherish me, Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi aatur t ayree gat  nahee jaanee t ooN aap karahi part ipaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Dhaar anoograhu su-aamee mayray d utee-aa bh aa-o nivaar. Take pity on me, O my Lord and Master, and remove the love of duality from withinme.
Break my bonds, and take me as Your own, so that I may never come to lose. ||1||
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaat layho apunay kar kabhoo na aavah haar. ||1||

lines.english: Seeking Your Sanctuary, I live, almighty and merciful Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tayree saran pa-i-aa ha-o jeevaaN tooN samrath purakh  miharvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਆਤੁਰ  ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||18|| rwgu DnwsrI mhlw 5  (675-10) raag Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 Raag Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (675-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  ka-o aaraaDh ee naanak sad  kurbaan. ||2||18||

lines.english: O God, please save me!
lines.transliteration: haa haa parabh raakh  layho.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਿਰ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਭਾਉ ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By myself, I cannot do anything, O my Lord and Master; by Your Grace, please blessme with Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham tay kichh oo na ho-ay mayray savaamee kar kirpaa apunaa naam d ayh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਿਟ  ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਿਰ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹ  ਹਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Family and worldly affairs are an ocean of fire.
lines.transliteration: agan kutamb saagar sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਇਆ  ਹਉ ਜੀਵ  ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥੁ  ਪੁਰਖੁ ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Through doubt, emotional attachment and ignorance, we are enveloped in darkness.||1||
lines.transliteration: bharam moh agi-aan anDh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
lines.english: High and low, pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: ooch neech sookh d ookh.

lines.english: Dharaapas naahee t arisnaa bh ookh. ||2|| Hunger and thirst are not satisfied. ||2||
The mind is engrossed in passion, and the disease of corruption.
lines.transliteration: man baasnaa rach bikhai bi-aaDh .

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਮੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The five thieves, the companions, are totally incorrigible. ||3||
lines.transliteration: panch doot  sang mahaa asaaDh . ||3||

lines.english: The beings and souls and wealth of the world are all Yours.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jahaan paraan Dhan t ayraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, know that the Lord is always near at hand. ||4||1||19|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (675-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaan sadaa har nayraa. ||4||1||19||

lines.english: The Lord and Master destroys the pain of the poor; He preserves and protects the honor of His servants.
lines.transliteration: deen d arad nivaar th aakur raakh ai jan kee aap.

lines.english: The Lord is the ship to carry us across; He is the treasure of virtue - pain cannot touchHim. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taran taaran  har niDh  dookh na sakai bi-aap. ||1||
