lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord of theworld.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang bh ajahu gupaal.

lines.english: I cannot think of any other way; make this effort, and make it in this Dark Age of KaliYuga. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan sanjam kichh na soojh ai ih jat an kaat kal kaal. rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the beginning, and in the end, there is none other than the perfect, merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: aad ant  da-i-aal pooran t is binaa nahee ko-ay.

lines.english: The cycle of birth and death is ended, chanting the Lord's Name, and rememberingthe Lord Master in meditation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: janam maran nivaar har jap simar su-aamee so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Vedas, the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Lord's devotees contemplate Him;
lines.transliteration: bayd simrit  kathai saasat  bhagat karahi beechaar.
mukat paa-ee-ai saaDh sangat  binas jaa-ay anDh aar. ||3|| liberation is attained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਰਦ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: The lotus feet of the Lord are the support of His humble servants. They are his only capital and investment. pMnw 676
lines.transliteration: charan kamal aDhaar jan kaa raas poonjee ayk.

lines.english: The True Lord is Nanak's strength, honor and support; He alone is his protection. ||4||2||20|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (676-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taan maan  deebaan  saachaa naanak kee parabh  tayk. ||4||2||20||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਣੁ  ਮਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Wandering and roaming around, I met the Holy Perfect Guru, who has taught me.
lines.transliteration: firat firat  bhaytay jan saaDh oo poorai gur samjh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: All other devices did not work, so I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aan sagal biDh kaaNm na aavai har har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਰਤ  ਿਫਰਤ  ਭੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: For this reason, I sought the Protection and Support of my Lord, the Cherisher of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: taa tay mohi Dh aaree ot gopaal.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਕਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and all my entanglementswere dissolved. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saran pari-o pooran parmaysur binsay sagal janjaal. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਿਹ ਧਾਰੀ  ਓਟ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Paradise, the earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the globe of the world -all are engrossed in Maya.
lines.transliteration: surag mirat pa-i-aal bh oo mandal sagal bi-aapay maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਜੰਜਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: To save your soul, and liberate all your ancestors, meditate on the Name of the Lord,Har, Har. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jee-a uDhaaran sabh  kul taaran har har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: O Nanak, singing the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, all treasures areobtained.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niranjan gaa-ee-ai paa-ee-ai sarab niDhaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਗ  ਿਮਰਤ  ਪਇਆਲ  ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਆਪੇ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Only that rare person, whom the Lord and Master blesses with His Grace, comes toknow this. ||3||3||21|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 Gru 2 caupdy  (676-7) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 cha-upd ay Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (676-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis day-ay su-aamee birlay kaahoo jaanaa. ||3||3||21||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You shall have to abandon the straw which you have collected.
lines.transliteration: chhod jaahi say karahi paraal.

lines.english: These entanglements shall be of no use to you.
lines.transliteration: kaam na aavahi say janjaal.

lines.english: You are in love with those things that will not go with you.
lines.transliteration: sang na chaaleh tin si-o heet .

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You think that your enemies are friends. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo bairaa-ee say-ee meet. ||1||

lines.english: In such confusion, the world has gone astray.
lines.transliteration: aisay bharam bh ulay sansaaraa.

lines.english: The foolish mortal wastes this precious human life. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath kh o-ay gavaaraa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: He does not like to see Truth and righteousness.
lines.transliteration: saach Dharam nahee bh aavai deeth aa.

lines.english: He is attached to falsehood and deception; they seem sweet to him.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  Dhoh si-o rachi-o meeth aa.

lines.english: He loves gifts, but he forgets the Giver.
lines.transliteration: daat pi-aaree visri-aa d aataaraa.

lines.english: The wretched creature does not even think of death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaanai naahee maran  vichaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: He cries for the possessions of others.
lines.transliteration: vasat paraa-ee ka-o uth  rovai.

lines.english: He forfeits all the merits of his good deeds and religion.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam saglaa ee kh ovai.

lines.english: He does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and so he continues coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: hukam na boojhai aavan  jaanay.

lines.english: He sins, and then regrets and repents. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paap karai taa pachh otaanay. ||3||

lines.english: Whatever pleases You, Lord, that alone is acceptable.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so parvaan .

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your Will.
lines.transliteration: tayray bh aanay no kurbaan .

lines.english: Poor Nanak is Your slave, Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: naanak gareeb bandaa jan t ayraa.

lines.english: Save me, O my Lord God Master! ||4||1||22|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (676-13) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raakh lay-ay saahib parabh  mayraa. ||4||1||22||

lines.english: I am meek and poor; the Name of God is my only Support.
lines.transliteration: mohi maskeen parabh naam aDh aar.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my occupation and earnings.
lines.transliteration: khaatan  ka-o har har rojgaar.

lines.english: I gather only the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sanchan ka-o har ayko naam.

lines.english: It is useful in both this world and the next. ||1||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  taa kai aavai kaam. ||1||

lines.english: Imbued with the Love of the Lord God's Infinite Name,
lines.transliteration: naam ratay parabh  rang apaar.
saaDh gaavahi gun  ayk nirankaar. rahaa-o. the Holy Saints sing the Glorious Praises of the One Lord, the Formless Lord. ||Pause||

lines.english: The Glory of the Holy Saints comes from their total humility.
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee sobh aa at maskeenee.

lines.english: The Saints realize that their greatness rests in the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant vadaa-ee har jas cheenee.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, the Saints are in bliss.
lines.transliteration: anad sant an kai bh agat govind .

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saints find peace, and their anxieties are dispelled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sookh sant an kai binsee chind . ||2||

lines.english: Wherever the Holy Saints gather,
lines.transliteration: jah saaDh sant an hoveh ikat ar.
tah har jas gaavahi naad  kavit . there they sing the Praises of the Lord, in music and poetry.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, there is bliss and peace.
lines.transliteration: saaDh sabh aa meh anad  bisraam.

lines.english: They alone obtain this Society, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||3||
lines.transliteration: un sang so paa-ay jis mastak karaam. ||3||

lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer.
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  karee ard aas.

lines.english: I wash their feet, and chant the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: charan pakhaar kahaaN guntaas.

lines.english: O God, merciful and compassionate, let me remain in Your Presence.
lines.transliteration: parabh d a-i-aal kirpaal hajoor.

lines.english: Nanak lives, in the dust of the Saints. ||4||2||23|| pMnw 677 DnwsrI mÚ 5 ] (677-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevai santaa Dh oor. ||4||2||23||

lines.english: One who contemplates his Lord and Master - why should he be afraid?
lines.transliteration: so kat darai je kh asam samHaarai.

lines.english: The wretched self-willed manmukhs are ruined through fear and dread. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dar dar pachay manmukh vaychaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Divine Guru, my mother and father, is over my head.
lines.transliteration: sir oopar maat pit aa gurd ayv.

lines.english: His image brings prosperity; serving Him, we become pure.
lines.transliteration: safal moorat jaa kee nirmal sayv.

lines.english: The One Lord, the Immaculate Lord, is our capital.
lines.transliteration: ayk niranjan jaa kee raas.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are illumined andenlightened. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangat  hovat  pargaas. ||1||

lines.english: The Giver of all beings is totally pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jee-an kaa daat aa pooran sabh  thaa-ay.

lines.english: Millions of pains are removed by the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: kot kalays miteh har naa-ay.

lines.english: All the pains of birth and death are taken away
lines.transliteration: janam maran saglaa dukh  naasai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅਨ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਭ ਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaa kai man t an baasai. ||2|| from the Gurmukh, within whose mind and body the Lord dwells. ||2||

lines.english: He alone, whom the Lord has attached to the hem of His robe,
lines.transliteration: jis no aap la-ay larh laa-ay.
dargeh milai t isai hee jaa-ay. obtains a place in the Court of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਬਾਸੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say-ee bhagat  je saachay bh aanay.

lines.english: They are freed from the Messenger of Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal tay bh a-ay nikaan ay. ||3||

lines.english: True is the Lord, and True is His Court.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib sach darbaar.

lines.english: Who can contemplate and describe His value?
lines.transliteration: keemat ka-un  kahai beechaar.

lines.english: He is within each and every heart, the Support of all.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar sagal aDh aar.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||3||24|| DnwsrI mhlw 5  (677-8) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (677-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai sant rayn aar. ||4||3||24||

lines.english: At home, and outside, I place my trust in You; You are always with Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar t ayraa bh arvaasaa t oo jan kai hai sang.

lines.english: Bestow Your Mercy, O my Beloved God, that I may chant the Lord's Name with love.||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa pareetam parabh  apunay naam japa-o har rang. ||1||

lines.english: God is the strength of His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o parabh apnay kaa t aan.

lines.english: Whatever You do, or cause to be done, O Lord and Master, that outcome isacceptable to me. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi karaaveh su-aamee saa maslat  parvaan . rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ਤੂ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: The Transcendent Lord is my honor; the Lord is my emancipation; the glorioussermon of the Lord is my wealth.
lines.transliteration: pat parmaysar gat  naaraa-in  Dhan gupaal gun  saakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's feet; from the Saints, he has learnedthis way of life. ||2||1||25|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (677-12) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan saran naanak daas har har sant ee ih biDh  jaatee. ||2||1||25||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: God has fulfilled all my desires. Holding me close in His embrace, the Guru has savedme.
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath parabh t ay paa-ay kanth  laa-ay gur raakh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਹ  ਕਰਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਾ ਮਸਲਿਤ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He has saved me from burning in the ocean of fire, and now, no one calls it impassible. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar meh jalan na deenay kinai na d utar bhaakhay. ||1||

lines.english: Those who have true faith in their minds,
lines.transliteration: jin kai man saachaa bisvaas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗਿਤ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਧਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: paykh paykh  su-aamee kee sobh aa aanad  sadaa ulaas. rahaa-o. continually behold the Glory of the Lord; they are forever happy and blissful. ||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸਰਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤੀ ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਤੀ  ॥੨॥੧॥੨੫॥
lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the feet of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, the Searcher ofhearts; I behold Him ever-present.
lines.transliteration: charan saran pooran parmaysur antarjaamee saakh i-o.

lines.english: In His wisdom, the Lord has made Nanak His own; He has preserved the roots of Hisdevotees. ||2||2||26|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (677-15) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaan boojh apnaa kee-o naanak bh agtan kaa ankur raakh i-o. ||2||2||26||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see Him present; He is never far away.
lines.transliteration: jah jah paykha-o t ah hajoor d oor kat ahu na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਮਿਹ ਜਲਿਨ  ਨ ਦੀਨੇ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is all-pervading, everywhere; O my mind, meditate on Him forever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa sarbatar mai man sad aa Dh i-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: He alone is called your companion, who will not be separated from you, here orhereafter.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  nahee beechh urhai so sangee ganee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖ ਪੇਿਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਨਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਉਲਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: That pleasure, which passes away in an instant, is trivial. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binas jaa-ay jo nimakh meh so alap sukh  bhanee-ai. rahaa-o.

lines.english: He cherishes us, and gives us sustenance; He does not lack anything.
lines.transliteration: paratipaalai api-aa-o d ay-ay kachh  oon na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸਾਿਖਓ  ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, my God takes care of His creatures. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saas saas sammaaltaa mayraa parabh  so-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਨ  ਬੂਿਝ ਅਪਨਾ  ਕੀਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ॥੨॥੨॥੨੬॥
lines.english: God is undeceiveable, impenetrable and infinite; His form is lofty and exalted.
lines.transliteration: achhal achh ayd apaar parabh  oochaa jaa kaa roop.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the embodiment of wonder and beauty, His humbleservants are in bliss. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jap jap karahi anand jan achraj aanoop. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ  ਤਹ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Bless me with such understanding, O Merciful Lord God, that I might remember You. pMnw 678
lines.transliteration: saa mat d ayh d a-i-aal parabh  jit tumeh araaDh aa.

lines.english: Nanak begs God for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||27|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (678-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai daan parabh  rayn pag saaDh aa. ||4||3||27||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰੇਨ ਪਗ ਸਾਧਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੨੭॥
lines.english: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: jin tum bh ayjay t ineh bulaa-ay sukh  sahj sayt ee gh ar aa-o.

lines.english: In bliss and ecstasy, sing His Glorious Praise s; by this celestial tune, you shall acquire your everlasting kingdom. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anad mangal gun gaa-o sahj Dh un nihchal raaj kamaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਿਤਨਿਹ  ਬੁਲਾਏ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Come back to your home, O my friend.
lines.transliteration: tum gh ar aavhu mayray meet .

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ  ਸਹਜ ਧੁਿਨ ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself has eliminated your enemies, and your misfortunes are past.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumray d okhee har aap nivaaray apd aa bh a-ee bit eet. rahaa-o.

lines.english: God, the Creator Lord, has glorified you, and your running and rushing around hasended.
lines.transliteration: pargat keenay parabh karnayhaaray naasan bh aajan thaakay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਦੋਖੀ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਅਪਦਾ ਭਈ ਿਬਤੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: In your home, there is rejoicing; the musical instruments continually play, and yourHusband Lord has exalted you. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghar mangal vaajeh nit  vaajay apunai kh asam nivaajay. ||2||

lines.english: Remain firm and steady, and do not ever waver; take the Guru's Word as yourSupport.
lines.transliteration: asthir rahhu dolahu mat kabhoo gur kai bachan aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਰਨੇਹਾਰੇ  ਨਾਸਨ  ਭਾਜਨ  ਥਾਕੇ ॥
lines.english: You shall be applauded and congratulated all over the world, and your face shall beradiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar sagal bhoo mandal mukh  oojal d arbaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਵਾਜਿਹ  ਿਨਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਖਸਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਜੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All beings belong to Him; He Himself transforms them, and He Himself becomes theirhelp and support.
lines.transliteration: jin kay jee-a tinai hee fayray aapay bh a-i-aa sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰ  ਰਹਹੁ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਮਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਅਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord has worked a wondrous miracle; O Nanak, His glorious greatness istrue. ||4||4||28|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 Gru 6  (678-8) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 6 Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (678-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: achraj kee-aa karnaihaarai naanak sach vadi-aa-ee. ||4||4||28||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ  ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਦਰਬਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen, O Dear Beloved Saints, to my prayer.
lines.transliteration: sunhu sant pi-aaray bin-o hamaaray jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਿਤਨੈ ਹੀ ਫੇਰੇ ਆਪੇ  ਭਇਆ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, no one is liberated. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bin mukat na kaahoo jee-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੪॥੪॥੨੮॥
lines.english: O mind, do only deeds of purity; the Lord is the only boat to carry you across. Otherentanglements shall be of no use to you.
lines.transliteration: man nirmal karam kar taaran t aran har avar janjaal t ayrai kaahoo na kaam jee-o.

lines.english: True living is serving the Divine, Supreme Lord God; the Guru has imparted thisteaching to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jeevan dayvaa paarbarahm sayvaa ih upd ays mo ka-o gur d eenaa jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: 5) tis si-o na laa-ee-ai heet  jaa ko kichh  naahee beet  ant kee baar oh sang na chaalai. Do not fall in love with trivial things; in the end, they shall not go along with you.
||2|| Worship and adore the Lord with your mind and body, O Beloved Saint of the Lord; inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be released from bondage.||2||
lines.transliteration: man tan t oo aaraaDh  har kay pareet am saaDh  jaa kai sang t ayray banDh an chh ootai.

lines.english: In your heart, hold fast to the Sanctuary of the lotus feet of the Supreme Lord God;do not place your hopes in any other support.
lines.transliteration: gahu paarbarahm saran hirdai kamal charan avar aas kachh  patal na keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰ ਤਾਰਨ  ਤਰਨ  ਹਿਰ ਅਵਿਰ  ਜੰਜਾਲ  ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: ||3||1||29|| He alone is a devotee, spiritually wise, a meditator, and a penitent, O Nanak, who isblessed by the Lord's Mercy. ||3||1||29|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (678-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so-ee bhagat  gi-aanee Dh i-aanee t apaa so-ee naanak jaa ka-o kirpaa keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਨਾ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my dear beloved, it is good, it is better, it is best, to ask for the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mayray laal bhalo ray bh alo ray bh alo har mangnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਸਉ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ  ਹੀਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਬੀਤੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਓਹੁ ਸੰਿਗ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: 5) daykh hu pasaar nain sunhu saaDh oo kay bain paraanpat  chit raakh  sagal hai marnaa. rahaa-o. Behold, with your eyes wide-open, and listen to the Words of the Holy Saints;enshrine in your consciousness the Lord of Life - remember that all must die.||Pause|| cMdn coAw rs Bog krq AnykY ibiKAw ibkwr dyKu sgl hY PIky eykY goibd ko nwmu nIko khq hY

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਆਰਾਧ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਛੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The application of sandalwood oil, the enjoyment of pleasures and the practice of many corrupt sins - look upon all of these as insipid and worthless. The Name of theLord of the Universe alone is sublime; so say the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: chandan cho-aa ras bh og karat  anaykai bikh i-aa bikaar d aykh sagal hai feekay aykai gobid ko naam neeko kahat  hai saaDh  jan.

lines.punjabi: ਗਹੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਸਰਨ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕਮਲ  ਚਰਨ  ਅਵਰ  ਆਸ  ਕਛੁ ਪਟਲੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: DnwsrI, mÚ 5) tan Dh an aapan thaapi-o har jap na nimakh  jaapi-o arath d arab d aykh kachh  sang naahee chalnaa. ||1|| You claim that your body and wealth are your own; you do not chant the Lord's Nameeven for an instant. Look and see, that none of your possessions or riches shall goalong with you. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਿਧਆਨੀ  ਤਪਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੯॥
lines.english: DnwsrI, mÚ 5) jaa ko ray karam bhalaa t in ot gahee sant  palaa t in naahee ray jam sant aavai saaDhoo kee sangnaa. One who has good karma, grasps the Protection of the hem of the Saint's robe; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot threatenhim.

DnwsrI, mÚ 5) paa-i-o ray param niDhaan miti-o hai abh imaan aykai nirankaar naanak man lagnaa. ||2||2||30|| I have obtained the supreme treasure, and my egotism has been eradicated; Nanak'smind is attached to the One Formless Lord. ||2||2||30|| pMnw 679 DnwsrI mhlw 5 Gru 7  (679-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 7 Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (679-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the OneLord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: har ayk simar ayk simar ayk simar pi-aaray.

lines.english: He shall save you from strife, suffering, greed, attachment, and the most terrifyingworld-ocean. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kal kalays lobh moh mahaa bh a-ojal t aaray. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, each and every instant, day and night, dwell upon Him.
lines.transliteration: saas saas nimakh nimakh  dinas rain chit aaray.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him fearlessly, andenshrine the treasure of His Name in your mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jap nisang man niDh aan Dh aaray. ||1||

lines.english: Worship His lotus feet, and contemplate the glorious virtues of the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal namaskaar gun gobid beechaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy shall bless you with pleasure and peace.||2||1||31|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 Gru 8 dupdy  (679-5) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 8 d upday Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (679-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kee rayn naanak mangal sookh  saDh aaray. ||2||1||31||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ  ਨਮਸਕਾਰ  ਗੁਨ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering, remembering, remembering Him in meditation, I find peace; with each and every breath, I dwell upon Him.
lines.transliteration: simra-o simar simar sukh paava-o saas saas samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਸੂਖ ਸਧਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.english: In this world, and in the world beyond, He is with me, as my help and support;wherever I go, He protects me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih lok parlok sang sahaa-ee jat kat  mohi rakh vaalay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word abides with my soul.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan basai jee-a naalay.

lines.english: It does not sink in water; thieves cannot steal it, and fire cannot burn it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jal nahee doobai taskar nahee layvai bh aahi na saakai jaalay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਲੋਿਕ  ਪਰਲੋਿਕ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੋਿਹ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is like wealth to the poor, a cane for the blind, and mother's milk for the infant.
lines.transliteration: nirDhan ka-o Dh an anDh ulay ka-o tik maat  dooDh jaisay baalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: In the ocean of the world, I have found the boat of the Lord; the Merciful Lord hasbestowed His Mercy upon Nanak. ||2||1||32|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (679-9) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saagar meh bohith paa-i-o har naanak karee kirpaa kirpaalay. ||2||1||32||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਵੈ ਭਾਿਹ  ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe has become kind and merciful; His Ambrosial Nectarpermeates my heart.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal d a-i-aal gobind aa amrit  ridai sinchaa-ee.

lines.english: The nine treasures, riches and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas cling tothe feet of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nav niDh riDh  siDh har laag rahee jan paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਧਨ  ਕਉ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਕਉ ਿਟਕ ਮਾਤ ਦੂਧੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints are in ecstasy everywhere.
lines.transliteration: santan ka-o anad  sagal hee jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰ  ਮਿਹ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰੀ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰਪਾਲੇ  ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
lines.english: Within the home, and outside as well, the Lord and Master of His devotees is totally pervading and permeating everywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: garihi baahar thaakur bh agtan kaa rav rahi-aa sarab th aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: No one can equal one who has the Lord of the Universe on his side.
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o ko-ay na pahuchanhaaraa jaa kai ang gusaa-ee.

lines.english: The fear of the Messenger of Death is eradicated, remembering Him in meditation;Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||2||33|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (679-13) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jam kee taraas mitai jis simrat  naanak naam Dh i-aa-ee. ||2||2||33||

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The rich man gazes upon his riches, and is proud of himself; the landlord takes pridein his lands.
lines.transliteration: darabvant  darab d aykh garbai bh oomvant  abhimaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ  ਸਗਲ  ਹੀ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The king believes that the whole kingdom belongs to him; in the same way, thehumble servant of the Lord looks upon the support of his Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raajaa jaanai sagal raaj hamraa ti-o har jan tayk su-aamee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਠਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When one considers the Lord to be his only support,
lines.transliteration: jay ko-oo apunee ot samaarai.
jaisaa bit t aisaa ho-ay vart ai apunaa bal nahee haarai. ||1|| rahaa-o. then the Lord uses His power to help him; this power cannot be defeated.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਗ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing all others, I have sought the Support of the One Lord; I have come to Him, pleading, "Save me, save me!"
lines.transliteration: aan ti-aag bh a-ay ik aasar saran  saran  kar aa-ay.

lines.english: By the kindness and the Grace of the Saints, my mind has been purified; Nanak singsthe Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||34|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (679-16) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant anugrah bh a-ay man nirmal naanak har gun gaa-ay. ||2||3||34||

lines.english: He alone is called a warrior, who is attached to the Lord's Love in this age.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o har rang laago is jug meh so kahee-at hai sooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਬਵੰਤੁ  ਦਰਬੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਗਰਬੈ  ਭੂਮਵੰਤੁ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect True Guru, he conquers his own soul, and then everything comes under his control. ||1|| pMnw 680
lines.transliteration: aatam jin ai sagal vas t aa kai jaa kaa sat gur pooraa. ||1||

lines.english: Sing the Praises of the Lord and Master, with the love of your soul.
lines.transliteration: thaakur gaa-ee-ai aat am rang.

lines.english: Those who seek His Sanctuary, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are blended with the Lord in celestial peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarnee paavan naam Dh i-aavan sahj samaavan sang. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਨਾਮ ਿਧਆਵਨ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The feet of the Lord's humble servant abide in my heart; with them, my body is madepure.
lines.transliteration: jan kay charan vaseh mayrai hee-arai sang puneetaa d ayhee.

lines.english: O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your humble servants; this alone brings peace. ||2||4||35|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (680-3) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan kee Dhoor d ayh kirpaa niDh  naanak kai sukh  ayhee. ||2||4||35||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਪੁਨੀਤਾ  ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.english: People try to deceive others, but the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knowseverything.
lines.transliteration: jatan karai maanukh  dehkaavai oh ant arjaamee jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਏਹੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੫॥
lines.english: They commit sins, and then deny them, while they pretend to be in Nirvaanaa. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paap karay kar mookar paavai bhaykh  karai nirbaanai. ||1||

lines.english: They believe that You are far away, but You, O God, are near at hand.
lines.transliteration: jaanat d oor tumeh parabh  nayr.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ  ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਵੈ  ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: Looking around, this way and that, the greedy people come and go. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ut taakai ut  tay ut paykh ai aavai lobh ee fayr. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਮੂਕਿਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਿਨਰਬਾਨੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As long as the doubts of the mind are not removed, liberation is not found.
lines.transliteration: jab lag tutai naahee man bh armaa t ab lag mukat  na ko-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, he alone is a Saint, a devotee, and a humble servant of the Lord, towhom the Lord and Master is merciful. ||2||5||36|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (680-7) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak da-i-aal su-aamee sant  bhagat jan so-ee. ||2||5||36||

lines.punjabi: ਉਤ ਤਾਕੈ  ਉਤ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਪੇਖੈ ਆਵੈ  ਲੋਭੀ ਫੇਿਰ ॥
lines.english: My Guru gives the Naam, the Name of the Lord, to those who have such karma written on their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: naam gur dee-o hai apunai jaa kai mast ak karmaa.

lines.english: He implants the Naam, and inspires us to chant the Naam; this is Dharma, truereligion, in this world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam darirh -aavai naam japaavai t aa kaa jug meh Dh armaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਨ ਭਰਮਾ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Naam is the glory and greatness of the Lord's humble servant.
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o naam vadaa-ee sobh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੰਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ  ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੬॥
lines.english: The Naam is his salvation, and the Naam is his honor; he accepts whatever comes topass. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naamo gat naamo pat  jan kee maanai jo jo hog. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That humble servant, who has the Naam as his wealth, is the perfect banker.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhan jis jan kai paalai so-ee pooraa saahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਓ  ਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਕਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is his occupation, O Nanak, and his only support; the Naam is the profit heearns. ||2||6||37|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (680-10) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam bi-uhaaraa naanak aaDhaaraa naam paraapat  laahaa. ||2||6||37||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਧਰਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My eyes have been purified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan,and touching my forehead to the dust of His feet.
lines.transliteration: naytar puneet  bha-ay d aras paykh ay maathai para-o ravaal.

lines.english: With joy and happiness, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master; the Lord of the World abides within my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ras ras gun gaava-o th aakur kay morai hird ai bashu gopaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਿਤ  ਨਾਮੋ ਪਿਤ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my Merciful Protector, Lord.
lines.transliteration: tum t a-o raakh anhaar d a-i-aal.

lines.english: O beautiful, wise, infinite Father God, be Merciful to me, God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sundar sugh ar bay-ant  pitaa parabh  hohu parabh oo kirpaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ  ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord of supreme ecstasy and blissful form, Your Word is so beautiful, so drenchedwith Nectar.
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand mangal roop tumray bachan anoop rasaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਬਉਹਾਰਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਧਾਰਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਲਾਹਾ  ॥੨॥੬॥੩੭॥
lines.english: With the Lord's lotus feet enshrined in his heart, Nanak has tied the Shabad, the Wordof the True Guru, to the hem of his robe. ||2||7||38|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (680-13) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hirdai charan  sabad  satgur ko naanak baaNDhi-o paal. ||2||7||38||

lines.english: In His own way, He provides us with our food; in His own way, He plays with us.
lines.transliteration: apnee ukat kh alaavai bh ojan apnee ukat  khaylaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਭਏ ਦਰਸ  ਪੇਖੇ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਰਉ  ਰਵਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: He blesses us with all comforts, enjoymen ts and delicacies, and he permeates our minds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh bh og ras d ayvai man hee naal samaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੇ ਮੋਰੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਬਸਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Our Father is the Lord of the World, the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: hamray pitaa gopaal d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Just as the mother protects her children, God nurtures and cares for us. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o raakhai meht aaree baarik ka-o t aisay hee parabh  paal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਸੁਘਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹੋਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my friend and companion, the Master of all excellences, O eternal and permanent Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sarab gun  naa-ik sad aa salaamat  dayvaa.

lines.english: Here, there and everywhere, You are pervading; please, bless Nanak to serve theSaints. ||2||8||39|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (680-17) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: eet oot  jat kat tat tum hee milai naanak sant  sayvaa. ||2||8||39||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਚਨ  ਅਨੂਪ ਰਸਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints are kind and compassionate; they burn away their sexual desire, anger andcorruption.
lines.transliteration: sant kirpaal d a-i-aal d amod ar kaam kroDh  bikh jaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਚਰਣ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਧਓ  ਪਾਲ  ॥੨॥੭॥੩੮॥
lines.english: My power, wealth, youth, body and soul are a sacrifice to them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raaj maal joban tan jee-araa in oopar lai baaray. ||1||

lines.english: With my mind and body, I love the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man tan raam naam hit kaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੀ  ਉਕਿਤ  ਖਲਾਵੈ  ਭੋਜਨ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਉਕਿਤ  ਖੇਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: With peace, poise, pleasure and joy, He has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause|| pMnw 681
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  mangal sahit  bhav niDh  paar ut aaray. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਧੰਿਨ ਓਇ ਭਵਨਾ  ਜਾ ਮਿਹ ਸੰਤ ਬਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so thaan Dh an o-ay bh avnaa jaa meh sant  basaaray. Blessed is that place, and blessed is that house, in which the Saints dwell.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਸਰਧਾ  ਪੂਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੯॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Fulfill this desire of servant Nanak, O Lord Master, that he may bow in reverence to Your devotees. ||2||9||40|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (681-2) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kee sarDhaa poorahu th aakur bh agat tayray namaskaaray. ||2||9||40||

lines.english: He has saved me from the awful power of Maya, by attaching me to His feet.
lines.transliteration: chhadaa-ay lee-o mahaa balee t ay apnay charan paraat .

lines.punjabi: ਛਡਾਇ  ਲੀਓ  ਮਹਾ ਬਲੀ  ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ  ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: He gave my mind the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, which shallnever perish or leave me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk naam dee-o man mannt aa binas na kat hoo jaat . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ  ਮਨ ਮੰਤਾ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has given this gift.
lines.transliteration: satgur poorai keenee d aat.

lines.english: He has blessed me with the Kirtan of the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,and I am emancipated. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam dee-o keert an ka-o bh a-ee hamaaree gaat . rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ  ਕੀਰਤਨ  ਕਉ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਗਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: My God has made me His own, and saved the honor of His devotee.
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-o parabh apunai bh agtan kee raakh ee paat .

lines.english: Nanak has grasped the feet of his God, and has found peace, day and night. ||2||10||41|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (681-5) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak charan gahay parabh apnay sukh  paa-i-o d in raat . ||2||10||41||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ  ਪਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Stealing the property of others, acting in greed, lying and slandering - in these ways,he passes his life.
lines.transliteration: par harnaa lobh jh ooth nind iv hee karat  gudaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਰਨ  ਗਹੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਿਦਨ  ਰਾਿਤ  ॥੨॥੧੦॥੪੧॥
lines.english: He places his hopes in false mirages, believing them to be sweet; this is the supporthe installs in his mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: marig tarisnaa aas mithi-aa meeth ee ih tayk maneh saaDh aaree. ||1||

lines.english: The faithless cynic passes his life uselessly.
lines.transliteration: saakat kee aavrad aa jaa-ay barithaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਹਰਨਾ  ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠ ਿਨੰਦ  ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਰਤ  ਗੁਦਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is like the mouse, gnawing away at the pile of paper, making it useless to the poorwretch. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaisay kaagad kay bh aar moosaa took gavaavat  kaam nahee gaavaaree. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਗ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਆਸ  ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਇਹ ਟੇਕ ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਾਧਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Have mercy on me, O Supreme Lord God, and release me from these bonds.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa paarbarahm su-aamee ih banDhan chh utkaaree.

lines.english: The blind are sinking, O Nanak; God saves them, uniting them with the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||42|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (681-9) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: boodat anDh  naanak parabh  kaadh at saaDh  janaa sangaaree. ||2||11||42||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗਦ  ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਮੂਸਾ ਟੂਿਕ ਗਵਾਵਤ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering, remembering God, the Lord Master in meditation, my body, mind and heart are cooled and soothed.
lines.transliteration: simar simar su-aamee parabh apnaa seet al tan man chh aatee.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is my beauty, pleasure, peace, wealth, soul and social status.||1||
lines.transliteration: roop rang sookh Dh an jee-a kaa paarbarahm morai jaat ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ  ਛੁਟਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My tongue is intoxicated with the Lord, the source of nectar.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam rasaa-in maatee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡਤ  ਅੰਧ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾਢਤ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੧੧॥੪੨॥
lines.english: I am in love, in love with the Lord's lotus feet, the treasure of riches. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rang rangee raam apnay kai charan kamal niDh thaat ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am His - He has saved me; this is God's perfect way.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh  lee-aa pooran parabh  kee bh aatee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਸੀਤਲ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਛਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Giver of peace has blended Nanak with Himself; the Lord has preserved hishonor. ||2||12||43|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (681-13) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mayl lee-o aapay sukh-d aatai naanak har raakh ee paat ee. ||2||12||43||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੂਖ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮੋਰੈ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All demons and enemies are eradicated by You, Lord; Your glory is manifest andradiant.
lines.transliteration: doot dusman sabh  tujh tay nivrahi pargat part aap tumaaraa.

lines.english: Whoever harms Your devotees, You destroy in an instant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jo tayray bh agat dukhaa-ay oh t atkaal t um maaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਪਨੇ  ਕੈ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਥਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: I look to You continually, Lord.
lines.transliteration: nirkha-o t umree or har neet .

lines.english: O Lord, Destroyer of ego, please, be the helper and companion of Your slaves; take my hand, and save me, O my Friend! ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: muraar sahaa-ay hohu daas ka-o kar geh uDh rahu meet . rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਰਿਖ ਲੀਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਭਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and given me His protection.
lines.transliteration: sunee baynt ee thaakur mayrai kh asmaanaa kar aap.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਿਲ ਲੀਓ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੀ  ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੩॥
lines.english: Nanak is in ecstasy, and his pains are gone; he meditates on the Lord, forever andever. ||2||13||44|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (681-16) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak anad bh a-ay d ukh bhaagay sad aa sad aa har jaap. ||2||13||44||

lines.english: He has extended His power in all four directions, and placed His hand upon my head.
lines.transliteration: chatur d isaa keeno bal apnaa sir oopar kar Dh aari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਨ  ਸਿਭ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਿਨਵਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon me with his Eye of Mercy, He has dispelled the pains of His slave. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kataakh-y avlokan keeno d aas kaa d ookh bidaari-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੇ  ਭਗਤ  ਦੁਖਾਏ  ਓਹੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ  ਤੁਮ ਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has saved the Lord's humble servant.
lines.transliteration: har jan raakhay gur govind .

lines.english: Hugging me close in His embrace, the merciful, forgiving Lord has erased all my sins.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay avgun  sabh  maytay d a-i-aal purakh  bakh sand. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ਸਹਾਇ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Whatever I ask for from my Lord and Master, he gives that to me.
lines.transliteration: jo maageh thaakur apunay t ay so-ee so-ee d ayvai.

lines.english: Whatever the Lord's slave Nanak utters with his mouth, proves to be true, here and hereafter. ||2||14||45|| pMnw 682 DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (682-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas mukh  tay jo bolai eehaa oohaa sach hovai. ||2||14||45||

lines.english: He does not let His devotees see the difficult times; this is His innate nature.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhee gh arhee na d aykhan day-ee apnaa birad  samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਖੀ  ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਦੇਖਣ  ਦੇਈ ਅਪਨਾ  ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Giving His hand, He protects His devotee; with each and every breath, He cherishes him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ai apnay ka-o saas saas part ipaalay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ  ਕਉ ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My consciousness remains attached to God.
lines.transliteration: parabh si-o laag rahi-o mayraa cheet .

lines.english: In the beginning, and in the end, God is always my helper and companion; blessed ismy friend. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aad ant  parabh  sadaa sahaa-ee Dh an hamaaraa meet . rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਧੰਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.english: My mind is delighted, gazing upon the marvellous, glorious greatness of the Lord andMaster.
lines.transliteration: man bilaas bha-ay saahib kay achraj d aykh badaa-ee.

lines.english: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak is in ecstasy; God, in His perfection, has protected and preserved his honor. ||2||15||46|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (682-4) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har simar simar aanad kar naanak parabh  pooran paij rakh aa-ee. ||2||15||46||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਿਬਲਾਸ  ਭਏ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜ  ਦੇਿਖ ਬਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who forgets the Lord of life, the Great Giver - know that he is most unfortunate.
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o bisrai paraanpat d aataa so-ee ganhu abh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਆਨਦ ਕਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੬॥
lines.english: One whose mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet, obtains the pool of ambrosialnectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jaa kaa man raagi-o ami-a sarovar paagaa. ||1||

lines.english: Your humble servant awakes in the Love of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: tayraa jan raam naam rang jaagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਉ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਿਤ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੋਈ ਗਨਹੁ ਅਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: All laziness has departed from his body, and his mind is attached to the Beloved Lord.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aalas chheej ga-i-aa sabh  tan tay pareet am si-o man laagaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਿਗਓ  ਅਿਮਅ  ਸਰੋਵਰ  ਪਾਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, the Lord is there; He is the string, upon which all hearts are strung.
lines.transliteration: jah jah paykha-o t ah naaraa-in  sagal gh ataa meh t aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਜਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking in the water of the Naam, servant Nanak has renounced all other loves.||2||16||47|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (682-8) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam udak peevat  jan naanak t i-aagay sabh  anuraagaa. ||2||16||47||

lines.punjabi: ਆਲਸੁ  ਛੀਿਜ  ਗਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: All the affairs of the Lord's humble servant are perfectly resolved.
lines.transliteration: jan kay pooran ho-ay kaam.

lines.english: In the utterly poisonous Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord preserves and protects hishonor. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal mahaa bikhi-aa meh lajaa raakh ee raam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ  ਤਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ਸਗਲ  ਘਟਾ  ਮਿਹ ਤਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering, remembering God, his Lord and Master in meditation, the Messenger ofDeath does not approach him.
lines.transliteration: simar simar su-aamee parabh apunaa nikat na aavai jaam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ  ਪੀਵਤ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਆਗੇ  ਸਿਭ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਾ  ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੭॥
lines.english: Liberation and heaven are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; hishumble servant finds the home of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukat baikunth  saaDh  kee sangat  jan paa-i-o har kaa Dh aam. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's lotus feet are the treasure of His humble servant; in them, he finds millionsof pleasures and comforts.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal har jan kee thaatee kot sookh  bisraam.

lines.english: He remembers the Lord God in meditation, day and night; Nanak is forever a sacrificeto him. ||2||17||48|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (682-12) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gobind d amod ar simra-o d in rain naanak sad  kurbaan. ||2||17||48||

lines.punjabi: ਕਲੀ  ਕਾਲ  ਮਹਾ ਿਬਿਖਆ ਮਿਹ ਲਜਾ  ਰਾਖੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I beg for one gift only from the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maaNga-o raam tay ik d aan.

lines.english: May all my desires be fulfilled, meditating on, and remembering Your Name, O Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooran hoveh simra-o tumraa naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਮ ॥
lines.english: May Your feet abide within my heart, and may I find the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: charan tumHaaray hird ai vaaseh sant an kaa sang paava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਜਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: May my mind not be afflicted by the fire of sorrow; may I sing Your Glorious Praises,twenty-four hours a day. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sog agan meh man na vi-aapai aath pahar gun  gaava-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਥਾਤੀ ਕੋਿਟ ਸੂਖ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: May I serve the Lord in my childhood and youth, and meditate on God in my middleand old age.
lines.transliteration: savast bivasthaa har kee sayvaa maDh -yaNt parabh  jaapan .

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਦਮੋਦਰ  ਿਸਮਰਉ  ਿਦਨ  ਰੈਿਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ  ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord, is notreincarnated again to die. ||2||18||49|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (682-15) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rang lagaa parmaysar baahurh janam na chh aapan . ||2||18||49||

lines.english: I beg only from the Lord for all things.
lines.transliteration: maaNga-o raam tay sabh  thok.

lines.english: I would hesitate to beg from other people. Remembering God in meditation, liberationis obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maanukh ka-o jaachat  saram paa-ee-ai parabh  kai simran mokh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਿਸਮਰਉ  ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have studied with the silent sages, and carefully read the Simritees, the Puraanas and the Vedas; they all proclaim that,
lines.transliteration: ghokh ay mun jan simrit  puraanaaN bayd  pukaareh gh okh.
kirpaa sinDh sayv sach paa-ee-ai d ovai suhaylay lok. ||1|| by serving the Lord, the ocean of mercy, Truth is obtained, and both this world andthe next are embellished. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਾਸਿਹ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: All other rituals and customs are useless, without remembering the Lord in meditation.
lines.transliteration: aan achaar bi-uhaar hai jaytay bin har simran fok.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਿਵਆਪੈ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the fear of birth and death has been removed; meeting the Holy Saint,sorrow is dispelled. ||2||19||50|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (682-19) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak janam maran bh ai kaatay mil saaDh oo binsay sok. ||2||19||50||

lines.punjabi: ਸਸਿਤ  ਿਬਵਸਥਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਪਣ  ॥
lines.english: Desire is quenched, through the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa bujh ai har kai naam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜਨਮ  ਨ ਛਾਪਣ  ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੯॥
lines.english: Great peace and contentment come through the Guru's Word, and one's meditation is perfectly focused upon God. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 683
lines.transliteration: mahaa santokh  hovai gur bachnee parabh  si-o laagai pooran Dh i-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, and permit me to ignore the great enticements of Maya, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: mahaa kalol bujheh maa-i-aa kay kar kirpaa mayray d een d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Give me Your Name - chanting it, I live; please bring the efforts of Your slave to fruition. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnaa naam d eh jap jeevaa pooran ho-ay d aas kee gh aal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਕਲੋਲ  ਬੁਝਿਹ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ॥
lines.english: All desires, power, pleasure, joy and lasting bliss, are found by chanting the Naam,the Name of the Lord, and singing the Kirtan of His Praises.
lines.transliteration: sarab manorath raaj sookh ras sad  khusee-aa keert an jap naam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That humble servant of the Lord, who has such karma pre-ordained by the CreatorLord, O Nanak - his efforts are brought to perfect fruition. ||2||20||51|| DnwsrI mÚ 5 ] (683-4) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis kai karam likhi-aa Dh ur kart ai naanak jan kay pooran kaam. ||2||20||51||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਰਾਜ ਸੂਖ ਰਸ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God takes care of His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: jan kee keenee paarbarahm saar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੫੧॥
lines.english: The slanderers are not allowed to stay; they are pulled out by their roots, like uselessweeds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nindak tikan na paavan moolay ood ga-ay baykaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master; no one can harm me.
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh -a-u t ah tah su-aamee ko-ay na pahuchanhaar.

lines.english: Whoever shows disrespect to the Lord's humble servant, is instantly reduced to ashes.||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jo karai avgi-aa jan kee ho-ay ga-i-aa tat  chhaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਿਟਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਨ  ਮੂਲੇ ਊਿਡ ਗਏ ਬੇਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord has become my protector; He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: karanhaar rakhvaalaa ho-aa jaa kaa ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, God has protected and saved His slaves; He has driven out and destroyed the slanderers. ||2||21||52|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 Gru 9 pVqwl  (683-8) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 9 parh -taal Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House, Partaal: <> siqgur pRswid ] (683-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas rakh ay parabh  apunai nind ak kaadh ay maar. ||2||21||52||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of Your feet; Lord of the Universe, Destroyer of pain,please bless Your slave with Your Name.
lines.transliteration: har charan saran gobind d ukh bhanjnaa d aas apunay ka-o naam d ayvhu.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਵਿਗਆ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ  ਤਤ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Be Merciful, God, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace; take my arm and save me- pull me up out of this pit! ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darisat parabh  Dhaarahu kirpaa kar t aarahu bh ujaa geh koop t ay kaadh  layvhu. rahaa- o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ  ਹੋਆ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He is blinded by sexual desire and anger, bound by Maya; his body and clothes arefilled with countless sins.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh kar anDh  maa-i-aa kay banDh  anik d okhaa tan chh aad pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਕਾਢੇ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੨੧॥੫੨॥
lines.english: Without God, there is no other protector; help me to chant Your Name, AlmightyWarrior, Sheltering Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh binaa aan na raakh anhaaraa naam simraavahu saran sooray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Redeemer of sinners, Saving Grace of all beings and creatures, even those who recitethe Vedas have not found Your limit.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran aa jee-a jant  taarnaa bayd  uchaar nahee ant  paa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਸਰਨ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ  ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: God is the ocean of virtue and peace, the source of jewels; Nanak sings the Praises of the Lover of His devotees. ||2||1||53|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (683-13) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gunah sukh  saagraa barahm rat naagaraa bh agat vachh al naanak gaa-i-o. ||2||1||53||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਿਹ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੇਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Peace in this world, peace in the next world and peace forever, remembering Him in meditation. Chant forever the Name of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: halat sukh  palat  sukh  nit sukh  simrano naam gobind  kaa sad aa leejai.

lines.english: The sins of past lives are erased, by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly; new life is infused into the dead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: miteh kamaanay paap chiraan ay saaDh sangat  mil mu-aa jeejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਕਿਰ ਅੰਧ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਅਿਨਕ  ਦੋਖਾ ਤਿਨ ਛਾਿਦ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: In power, youth and Maya, the Lord is forgotten; this is the greatest tragedy - so saythe spiritual sages.
lines.transliteration: raaj joban bisrant har maa-i-aa mahaa d ukh ayhu mahaaNt kahai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਨਾ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਰਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਿਨ  ਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hope and desire to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - this is the treasure of themost fortunate devotees. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aas raman har keert an ayhu pad aarath bh aagvant  lahai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣਾ  ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤਾਰਣਾ  ਬੇਦ ਉਚਾਰ  ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord of Sanctuary, all-powerful, imperceptible and unfathomable - Your Name is thePurifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: saran samrath akath agocharaa pat it uDhaaran  naam t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਹ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰਾ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਰਤਨਾਗਰਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੧॥੫੩॥
lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Lord and Master of Nanak is totally pervading and permeating everywhere; He is my Lord and Master. ||2||2||54|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 Gru 12  (683-18) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 12 Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Twelfth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (683-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee naanak kay su-aamee sarbat  pooran th aakur mayraa. ||2||2||54||

lines.english: I bow in reverence to the Lord, I bow in reverence. I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my King. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bandnaa har band naa gun  gaavhu gopaal raa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਿਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਿਨਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਿਸਮਰਨੋ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, one meets the Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag bh aytay gurd ayvaa.

lines.english: Millions of sins are erased by serving the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 684
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh mitay har sayvaa. ||1||

lines.english: One whose mind is imbued with the Lord's lotus feet
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jaa kaa man raapai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sog agan tis jan na bi-aapai. ||2|| is not afflicted by the fire of sorrow. ||2||

lines.english: He crosses over the world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saagar tari-aa saaDh oo sangay.

lines.english: He chants the Name of the Fearless Lord, and is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o naam japahu har rangay. ||3||

lines.english: One who does not steal the wealth of others, who does not commit evil deeds or sinful acts
lines.transliteration: par Dhan d okh kichh  paap na fayrh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਦੋਖ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਪ ਨ ਫੇੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam jandaar na aavai nayrh ay. ||4|| - the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||4||

lines.english: God Himself quenches the fires of desire.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa agan parabh  aap bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||5||1||55|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (684-3) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhray parabh  sarnaa-ee. ||5||1||55||

lines.english: I am satisfied and satiated, eating the food of Truth.
lines.transliteration: taripat  bha-ee sach bh ojan kh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: With my mind, body and tongue, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan rasnaa naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Life, spiritual life, is in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevnaa har jeevnaa.

lines.english: Spiritual life consists of chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Companyof the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeevan har jap saaDhsang. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is dressed in robes of all sorts,
lines.transliteration: anik parkaaree bastar odh aa-ay.
an-din keert an har gun gaa-ay. ||2|| if he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises, day and night. ||2||

lines.english: He rides upon elephants, chariots and horses,
lines.transliteration: hastee rath as asvaaree.
har kaa maarag ridai nihaaree. ||3|| if he sees the Lord's Path within his own heart. ||3||

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, deep within his mind and body,
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar charan Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (684-7) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har sukh niDh aan naanak d aas paa-i-aa. ||4||2||56|| slave Nanak has found the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||4||2||56||

lines.english: The Guru's feet emancipate the soul.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan jee-a kaa nistaaraa.

lines.english: They carry it across the world-ocean in an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: samund saagar jin kh in meh t aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some love rituals, and some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee ho-aa karam rat ko-ee t irath naa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord's slaves meditate on His Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daaseeN har kaa naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord Master is the Breaker of bonds.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaatanhaar su-aamee.

lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||2||3||57|| DnwsrI mhlw 5 ] (684-10) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5. Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak simrai antarjaamee. ||2||3||57||

lines.english: The lifestyle of Your slave is so pure, that nothing can break his love for You.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kitai parkaar na t oota-o pareet . daas tayray kee nirmal reet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਹੋਆ  ਕਰ੍ਮ ਰਤੁ ਕੋਈ ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is more dear to me than my soul, my breath of life, my mind and my wealth.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan man Dhan t ay pi-aaraa.

lines.english: The Lord is the Giver, the Restrainer of the ego. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai banDh har d ayvan haaraa. ||1||

lines.english: I am in love with the Lord's lotus feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laaga-o nayhu.

lines.english: This alone is Nanak's prayer. ||2||4||58|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (684-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: DnwsrI mhlw 9 ] (684-14) Dhanaasree mehlaa 9. Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee ayh. ||2||4||58||

lines.english: Why do you go looking for Him in the forest?
lines.transliteration: kaahay ray ban khojan jaa-ee.

lines.english: Although he is unattached, he dwells everywhere. He is always with you as your companion. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab nivaasee sadaa alaypaa t ohee sang samaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Like the fragrance which remains in the flower, and like the reflection in the mirror,
lines.transliteration: puhap maDh ji-o baas basat  hai mukar maahi jaisay chh aa-ee.
taisay hee har basay nirant ar ghat hee kh ojahu bh aa-ee. ||1|| the Lord dwells deep within; search for Him within your own heart, O Siblings ofDestiny. ||1||

lines.english: Outside and inside, know that there is only the One Lord; the Guru has imparted thiswisdom to me.
lines.transliteration: baahar bheet ar ayko jaanhu ih gur gi-aan bat aa-ee.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, without knowing one's own self, the moss of doubt is not removed.||2||1|| DnwsrI mhlw 9 ] (684-17) Dhanaasree mehlaa 9. Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bin aapaa cheenai mitai na bharam kee kaa-ee. ||2||1||

lines.english: O Holy people, this world is deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: saaDho ih jag bh aram bh ulaanaa.

lines.english: It has forsaken the meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name, and sold itself out to Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam kaa simran chhodi-aa maa-i-aa haath bikaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - he is entangled in their love. pMnw 685
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banit aa taa kai ras laptaanaa.

lines.english: In the pride of youth, wealth and glory, day and night, he remains intoxicated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: joban Dhan parabh -taa kai mad  mai ahinis rahai d ivaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭਤਾ  ਕੈ ਮਦ ਮੈ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਵਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God is merciful to the meek, and forever the Destroyer of pain, but the mortal does not center his mind on Him.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal sad aa dukh bhanjan t aa si-o man na lagaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, among millions, only a rare few, as Gurmukh, realize God. ||2||2|| DnwsrI mhlw 9 ] (685-3) Dhanaasree mehlaa 9. Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kotan mai kinhoo gurmukh ho-ay pachh aanaa. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋਟਨ  ਮੈ ਿਕਨਹੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਪਛਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: That Yogi does not know the way.
lines.transliteration: tih jogee ka-o jugat  na jaan-o.

lines.english: Understand that his heart is filled with greed, emotional attachment, Maya and egotism. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lobh moh maa-i-aa mamt aa fun jih gh at maahi pachh aana-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who does not slander or praise others, who looks upon gold and iron alike,
lines.transliteration: par nindaa ust at nah jaa kai kanchan loh samaano.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਫੁਿਨ ਿਜਹ ਘਿਟ  ਮਾਿਹ ਪਛਾਨਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog t ay rahai at eetaa jogee t aahi bakh aano. ||1|| who is free from pleasure and pain - he alone is called a true Yogi. ||1||

lines.english: The restless mind wanders in the ten directions - it needs to be pacified andrestrained.
lines.transliteration: chanchal man dah d is ka-o Dh aavat  achal jaahi th ehraano.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਨਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ  ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, whoever knows this technique is judged to be liberated. ||2||3|| DnwsrI mhlw 9 ] (685-6) Dhanaasree mehlaa 9. Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih biDh ko jo nar mukat  taahi t um maano. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਜੋਗੀ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਬਖਾਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now, what efforts should I make?
lines.transliteration: ab mai ka-un upaa-o kara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਚਲ  ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ  ਅਚਲ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਠਹਰਾਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: How can I dispel the anxieties of my mind? How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jih biDh man ko sansaa chookai bh a-o niDh  paar para-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੋ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: Obtaining this human incarnation, I have done no good deeds; this makes me veryafraid!
lines.transliteration: janam paa-ay kachh bh alo na keeno t aa tay aDh ik dara-o.

lines.english: In thought, word and deed, I have not sung the Lord's Praises; this thought worries my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man bach karam har gun nahee gaa-ay yeh jee-a soch Dhara-o. ||1||

lines.english: I listened to the Guru's Teachings, but spiritual wisdom did not well up within me; likea beast, I fill my belly.
lines.transliteration: gurmat sun kachh  gi-aan na upji-o pas ji-o ud ar bhara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਭਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93|| Says Nanak, O God, please confirm Your Law of Grace; for only then can I, the sinner,be saved. ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 Gru 2 AstpdIAw  (685-11) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1 gh ar 2 asatpad ee-aa Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Second House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (685-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 9) kaho naanak parabh birad  pachh aana-o t ab ha-o pat it tara-o.

lines.english: The Guru is the ocean, filled with pearls.
lines.transliteration: gur saagar ratnee bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਾਇ  ਕਛੁ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਿਧਕ  ਡਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints gather in the Ambrosial Nectar; they do not go far away from there.
lines.transliteration: amrit sant  chugeh nahee d ooray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰ੍ਮ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਏ  ਯਹ ਜੀਅ  ਸੋਚ ਧਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They taste the subtle essence of the Lord; they are loved by God.
lines.transliteration: har ras chog chugeh parabh bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸੁਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਪਸੁ ਿਜਉ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: Within this pool, the swans find their Lord, the Lord of their souls. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarvar meh hans paraanpat paavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਪਛਾਨਉ  ਤਬ ਹਉ ਪਿਤਤ  ਤਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: What can the poor crane accomplish by bathing in the mud puddle?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa bag bapurhaa chh aprhee naa-ay.

lines.english: It sinks into the mire, and its filth is not washed away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: keecharh doobai mail na jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: After careful deliberation, the thoughtful person takes a step.
lines.transliteration: rakh rakh  charan Dh aray veechaaree.

lines.english: Forsaking duality, he becomes a devotee of the Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa chh od bh a-ay nirankaaree.

lines.english: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mukat pad aarath har ras chaakh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: His comings and goings end, and the Guru protects him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay gur raakh ay. ||2||

lines.english: The swan do not leave this pool.
lines.transliteration: sarvar hansaa chhod na jaa-ay.

lines.english: In loving devotional worship, they merge in the Celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  kar sahj samaa-ay.

lines.english: The swans are in the pool, and the pool is in the swans.
lines.transliteration: sarvar meh hans hans meh saagar.

lines.english: They speak the Unspoken Speech, and they honor and revere the Guru's Word. ||3||
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa gur bachnee aadar. ||3||

lines.english: The Yogi, the Primal Lord, sits within the celestial sphere of deepest Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: sunn mandal ik jogee baisay.

lines.english: He is not male, and He is not female; how can anyone describe Him?
lines.transliteration: naar na purakh kahhu ko-oo kaisay.

lines.english: The three worlds continue to center their attention on His Light.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan jot rahay liv laa-ee.

lines.english: The silent sages and the Yogic masters seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sur nar naath sachay sarnaa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: The Lord is the source of bliss, the support of the helpless.
lines.transliteration: aanand mool anaath aDh aaree.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs worship and contemplate the Celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat sahj beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਵਰ  ਮਿਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੰਸ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.english: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al bhai kaatan haaray.

lines.english: Subduing ego, one meets the Lord, and places his feet on the Path. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar milay pag Dhaaray. ||5||

lines.english: He makes many efforts, but still, the Messenger of Death tortures him.
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar kaal sant aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Destined only to die, he comes into the world. pMnw 686
lines.transliteration: maran likh aa-ay mandal meh aa-ay.

lines.english: He wastes this precious human life through duality.
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath d ubiDh aa kh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨਿਸ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: He does not know his own self, and trapped by doubts, he cries out in pain. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aap na cheenas bharam bh aram rovai. ||6||

lines.english: Speak, read and hear of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: kahta-o parh -ta-o sunt a-o ayk.

lines.english: Dheeraj Dh aram Dh arneeDhar tayk. The Support of the earth shall bless you with courage, righteousness and protection.
Chastity, purity and self-restraint are infused into the heart,
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam rid ai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੇ  ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: cha-uthay pad ka-o jay man pat ee-aa-ay. ||7|| when one centers his mind in the fourth state. ||7||

lines.english: They are immaculate and true, and filth does not stick to them.
lines.transliteration: saachay nirmal mail na laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭਰਮ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, their doubt and fear depart.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bh aram bh a-o bh aagai.

lines.english: The form and personality of the Primal Lord are incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: soorat moorat  aad anoop.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the Lord, the Embodiment of Truth. ||8||1|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (686-4) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai saach saroop. ||8||1||

lines.english: That union with the Lord is acceptable, which is united in intuitive poise.
lines.transliteration: sahj milai mili-aa parvaan.

lines.english: Thereafter, one does not die, and does not come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: naa tis maran  na aavan  jaan.

lines.english: The Lord's slave is in the Lord, and the Lord is in His slave.
lines.transliteration: thaakur meh d aas d aas meh so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮਿਹ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਹ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see none other than the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah avar na ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and find His celestial home.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat sahj gh ar paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without meeting the Guru, they die, and come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhaytay mar aa-ee-ai jaa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So make Him your Guru, who implants the Truth within you,
lines.transliteration: so gur kara-o je saach darirh -aavai.
akath kathaavai sabad milaavai. who leads you to speak the Unspoken Speech, and who merges you in the Word of the Shabad.

lines.english: God's people have no other work to do;
lines.transliteration: har kay log avar nahee kaaraa.
saacha-o thaakur saach pi-aaraa. ||2|| they love the True Lord and Master, and they love the Truth. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਅਵਰ  ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The mind is in the body, and the True Lord is in the mind.
lines.transliteration: tan meh manoo-aa man meh saachaa.

lines.english: Merging into the True Lord, one is absorbed into Truth.
lines.transliteration: so saachaa mil saachay raachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: God's servant bows at His feet.
lines.transliteration: sayvak parabh kai laagai paa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one meets with the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa milai milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself watches over us, and He Himself makes us see.
lines.transliteration: aap dikh aavai aapay d aykhai.

lines.english: He is not pleased by stubborn-mindedness, nor by various religious robes.
lines.transliteration: hath na pat eejai naa baho bh aykhai.

lines.english: He fashioned the body-vessels, and infused the Ambrosial Nectar into them;
lines.transliteration: gharh  bhaaday jin amrit  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਠ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ  ਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: God's Mind is pleased only by loving devotional worship. ||4||
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  parabh  man pat ee-aa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Reading and studying, one becomes confused, and suffers punishment.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  bhooleh chotaa kh aahi.

lines.english: By great cleverness, one is consigned to coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: bahut si-aan ap aavahi jaahi.

lines.english: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and eats the food of the Fear of God
lines.transliteration: naam japai bha-o bh ojan kh aa-ay.
gurmukh sayvak rahay samaa-ay. ||5|| becomes Gurmukh, the Lord's servant, and remains absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

lines.english: He worships stones, dwells at sacred shrines of pilgrimage and in the jungles,
lines.transliteration: pooj silaa tirath ban vaasaa.
bharmat  dolat  bha-ay ud aasaa. wanders, roams around and becomes a renunciate.

lines.english: But his mind is still filthy - how can he become pure?
lines.transliteration: man mailai soochaa ki-o ho-ay.

lines.english: One who meets the True Lord obtains honor. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saach milai paavai pat so-ay. ||6||

lines.english: One who embodies good conduct and contemplative meditation,
lines.transliteration: aachaaraa veechaar sareer.
aad jugaad  sahj man Dh eer. his mind abides in intuitive poise and contentment, since the beginning of time, andthroughout the ages.

lines.english: In the twinkling of an eye, he saves millions.
lines.transliteration: pal pankaj meh kot uDhaaray.

lines.english: Have mercy on me, O my Beloved, and let me meet the Guru. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur mayl pi-aaray. ||7||

lines.english: Unto whom, O God, should I praise You?
lines.transliteration: kis aagai parabh t uDh saalaahee.

lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojaa mai ko naahee.

lines.english: As it pleases You, keep me under Your Will.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tuDh  bhaavai t i-o raakh  rajaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak, with intuitive poise and natural love, sings Your Glorious Praises. ||8||2|| DnwsrI mÚ 5 Gru 6 AstpdI  (686-16) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 gh ar 6 asatpad ee Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Ashtapadee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (686-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sahj bhaa-ay gun  gaa-ay. ||8||2||

lines.english: Whoever is born into the world, is entangled in it; human birth is obtained only by good destiny.
