lines.transliteration: jo jo joonee aa-i-o tih t ih urjh aa-i-o maan as janam sanjog paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I look to Your support, O Holy Saint; give me Your hand, and protect me. By YourGrace, let me meet the Lord, my King. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taakee hai ot saaDh  raakh o day kar haath kar kirpaa maylhu har raa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I wandered through countless incarnations, but I did not find stability anywhere.
lines.transliteration: anik janam bharam thit  nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਇਓ  ਿਤਹ ਿਤਹ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ  ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸੰਜੋਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I serve the Guru, and I fall at His feet, praying, "O Dear Lord of the Universe, please,show me the way."||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kara-o sayvaa gur laaga-o charan govind jee kaa maarag d ayh jee bat aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਕੀ  ਹੈ ਓਟ ਸਾਧ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਹਾਥ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have tried so many things to acquire the wealth of Maya, and to cherish it in mymind; I have passed my life constantly crying out, "Mine, mine!" pMnw 687
lines.transliteration: anik upaav kara-o maa-i-aa ka-o bachit Dh ara-o mayree mayree karat  sad hee vihaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਉ ਬਿਚਿਤ  ਧਰਉ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਿਵਹਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: ||2|| Is there any such Saint, who would meet with me, take away my anxiety, and lead meto enshrine love for my Lord and Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aiso ray bhaytai sant  mayree laahai sagal chint  thaakur si-o mayraa rang laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਿਚੰਤ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have read all the Vedas, and yet the sense of separation in my mind still has notbeen removed; the five thieves of my house are not quieted, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: parhay ray sagal bayd  nah chookai man bh ayd ik kh in na Dh eereh mayray gh ar kay panchaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੜੇ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ  ਬੇਦ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਭੇਦ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
lines.english: Is there any devotee, who is unattached to Maya, who may irrigate my mind with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the One Lord? ||3||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aiso ray bhagat  jo maa-i-aa t ay rahat  ik amrit  naam mayrai rid ai sinchaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭਗਤੁ  ਜੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਰਹਤੁ  ਇਕੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਿਰਦੈ ਿਸੰਚਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In spite of the many places of pilgrimage for people to bathe in, their minds are still stained by their stubborn ego; the Lord Master is not pleased by this at all.
lines.transliteration: jaytay ray t irath naa-ay ahaN-buDh  mail laa-ay gh ar ko th aakur ik t il na maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਰੇ ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਏ ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਏ  ਘਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: 5) kad paava-o saaDh sang har har sad aa aanand  gi-aan anjan mayraa man isnaanai. ||4|| When will I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy? There, I shall be alwaysin the ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har, and my mind shall take its cleansing bath in thehealing ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਦ  ਪਾਵਉ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਿਨ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: I have followed the four stages of life, but my mind is not satisfied; I wash my body,but it is totally lacking in understanding.
lines.transliteration: sagal asram keenay manoo-aa nah pateenay bibaykheen d ayhee Dh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਅਸਰ੍ਮ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਮਨੂਆ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਨੇ  ਿਬਬੇਕਹੀਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਏ ॥
lines.english: DnwsrI, mÚ 5) ko-ee paa-ee-ai ray purakh biDh aataa paarbarahm kai rang raat aa mayray man kee durmat  mal kh o-ay. ||5|| If only I could meet some devotee of the Supreme Lord God, imbued with the Lord's Love, who could eradicate the filthy evil-mindedness from my mind. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ  ਰੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਲੁ ਖੋਏ ॥੫॥
lines.english: One who is attached to religious rituals, does not love the Lord, even for an instant;he is filled with pride, and he is of no account.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam jugt aa nimakh  na hayt  kartaa garab garab parh ai kahee na laykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਜੁਗਤਾ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਪੜੈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: ||6|| One who meets with the rewarding personality of the Guru, continually sings theKirtan of the Lord's Praises. By Guru's Grace, such a rare one beholds the Lord withhis eyes. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jis bhaytee-ai safal moorat  karai sad aa keerat  gur parsaad  ko-oo nayt arahu paykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਸਫਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਕੋਊ ਨੇਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Dhaaree. One who acts through stubbornness is of no account at all; like a crane, he pretends to meditate, but he is still stuck in Maya.
lines.transliteration: manhath jo kamaavai t il na laykh ai paavai bagul ji-o Dh i-aan laavai maa-i-aa ray

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਗੁਲ  ਿਜਉ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੇ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Is there any such Giver of peace, who can recite to me the sermon of God? Meetinghim, I would be emancipated. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aiso ray sukhah d aa-ee parabh  kee kathaa sunaa-ee t is bhaytay gat  ho-ay hamaaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਸੁਖਹ  ਦਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: When the Lord, my King, is totally pleased with me, He will break the bonds of Maya for me; my mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: suparsan gopaal raa-ay kaatai ray banDhan maa-ay gur kai sabad  mayraa man raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਰਾਇ  ਕਾਟੈ ਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਮਾਇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am in ecstasy, forever and ever, meeting the Fearless Lord, the Lord of the Universe. Falling at the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found peace. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa aanand  bhayti-o nirbh ai gobind  sukh  naanak laaDh ay har charan paraataa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਾਧੇ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਪਰਾਤਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: My Yatra, my life pilgrimage, has become fruitful, fruitful, fruitful.
lines.transliteration: safal safal bha-ee safal jaat raa.

lines.english: My comings and goings have ended, since I met the Holy Saint. ||1||SecondPause||1||3|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 CMq  (687-13) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1 chh ant Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (687-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay milay saaDh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||1||3||.

lines.english: Why should I bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage? The Naam, the Name of the Lord,is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: tirath naavan  jaa-o t irath naam hai.

lines.english: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is spiritual wisdom within, and contemplation on theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tirath sabad  beechaar ant ar gi-aan hai.

lines.english: The spiritual wisdom given by the Guru is the True sacred shrine of pilgrimage, wherethe ten festivals are always observed.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan saachaa thaan tirath d as purab sad aa dasaahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਵਣ  ਜਾਉ  ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: I constantly beg for the Name of the Lord; grant it to me, O God, Sustainer of the world.
lines.transliteration: ha-o naam har kaa sadaa jaacha-o d ayh parabh  DharneeDharaa.

lines.english: The world is sick, and the Naam is the medicine to cure it; without the True Lord, filthsticks to it.
lines.transliteration: sansaar rogee naam daaroo mail laagai sach binaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਥਾਨੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬ  ਸਦਾ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word is immaculate and pure; it radiates a steady Light. Constantly bathein such a true shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur vaak nirmal sadaa chaanan  nit saach t irath majnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ  ਦੇਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Filth does not stick to the true ones; what filth do they have to wash off?
lines.transliteration: saach na laagai mail ki-aa mal Dho-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਚ ਿਬਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: If one strings a garland of virtues for oneself, what is there to cry for?
lines.transliteration: guneh haar paro-ay kis ka-o ro-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਵਾਕੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਾਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਮਜਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who conquers his own self through contemplation is saved, and saves others aswell; he does not come to be born again.
lines.transliteration: veechaar maarai tarai t aarai ulat jon na aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਿਕਆ  ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The supreme meditator is Himself the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead intogold. The true man is pleasing to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap paaras param Dhi-aanee saach saachay bh aav-ay.

lines.english: He is in ecstasy, truly happy, night and day; his sorrows and sins are taken away.
lines.transliteration: aanand an-d in harakh  saachaa d ookh kilvikh  parharay.

lines.punjabi: ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਮਾਰੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੈ ਉਲਿਟ  ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: He finds the True Name, and beholds the Guru; with the True Name in his mind, no filth sticks to him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach naam paa-i-aa gur dikh aa-i-aa mail naahee sach manay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਪਰਮ  ਿਧਆਨੀ  ਸਾਚੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: O friend, association with the Holy is the perfect cleansing bath. pMnw 688
lines.transliteration: sangat meet  milaap pooraa naavn o.

lines.english: The singer who sings the Lord's Praises is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gaavai gaavanhaar sabad  suhaavan o.

lines.english: Worship the True Lord, and believe in the True Guru; this brings the merit of making donations to charity, kindness and compassion.
lines.transliteration: saalaahi saachay man satgur punn d aan d a-i-aa mat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਸਾਚੇ ਮੰਿਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਦਇਆ  ਮਤੇ ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride who loves to be with her Husband Lord bathes at the Triveni, thesacred place where the Ganges, Jamuna and Saraswaati Rivers converge, the Truestof the True.
lines.transliteration: pir sang bhaavai sahj naavai bayn ee ta sangam sat  satay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਨਾਵੈ ਬੇਣੀ  ਤ ਸੰਗਮੁ  ਸਤ ਸਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the One Creator, the True Lord, who constantly gives, whose giftscontinually increase.
lines.transliteration: aaraaDh aykankaar saachaa nit  day-ay charh ai savaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਰਾਿਧ  ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਨਤ ਦੇਇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Salvation is attained by associating with the Society of the Saints, O friend; grantingHis Grace, God unites us in His Union. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gat sang meet aa sant sangat  kar nad ar mayl milaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੀਤਾ  ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਨਦਿਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Everyone speaks and talks; how great should I say He is?
lines.transliteration: kahan kahai sabh  ko-ay kayvad aakh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਣੁ  ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am foolish, lowly and ignorant; it is only through the Guru's Teachings that I understand.
lines.transliteration: ha-o moorakh neech ajaan  samjh aa saakh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ  ਸਮਝਾ  ਸਾਖੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: True are the Teachings of the Guru. His Words are Ambrosial Nectar; my mind ispleased and appeased by them.
lines.transliteration: sach gur kee saakhee amrit  bhaakhee tit man maani-aa mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭਾਖੀ ਿਤਤੁ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Loaded down with corruption and sin, people depart, and then come back again; theTrue Shabad is found through my Guru.
lines.transliteration: kooch karahi aavahi bikh laad ay sabad  sachai gur mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਚੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਿਬਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: There is no end to the treasure of devotion; the Lord is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  tot na bh agat bhandaaree bh aripur rahi-aa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਿਣ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਭਗਿਤ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ  ਭਿਰਪੁਿਰ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak utters this true prayer; one who purifies his mind is True. ||4||1|| DnwsrI mhlw 1 ] (688-6) Dhanaasree mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai baynantee man maaNjai sach so-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਜੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I live by Your Name; my mind is in ecstasy, Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevaa tayrai naa-ay man aanand  hai jee-o.

lines.english: True is the Name of the True Lord. Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: saacho saachaa naa-o gun govind  hai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਾ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ  ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Infinite is the spiritual wisdom imparted by the Guru. The Creator Lord who created,shall also destroy.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan apaaraa sirjanhaaraa jin sirjee t in go-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾਉ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The call of death is sent out by the Lord's Command; no one can challenge it.
lines.transliteration: parvaanaa aa-i-aa hukam path aa-i-aa fayr na sakai ko-ee.

lines.english: He Himself creates, and watches; His written command is above each and every head. He Himself imparts understanding and awareness.
lines.transliteration: aapay kar vaykhai sir sir laykh ai aapay surat  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਵਾਣਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਪਠਾਇਆ  ਫੇਿਰ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Master is inaccessible and unfathomable; I live by His True Name.||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib agam agochar jeevaa sachee naa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: No one can compare to You, Lord; all come and go.
lines.transliteration: tum sar avar na ko-ay aa-i-aa jaa-isee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Your Command, the account is settled, and doubt is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: hukmee ho-ay nibayrh bh aram chukaa-isee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਆਇਆ  ਜਾਇਸੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru dispels doubt, and makes us speak the Unspoken Speech; the true ones areabsorbed into Truth.
lines.transliteration: gur bharam chukaa-ay akath kahaa-ay sach meh saach samaan aa.

lines.english: He Himself creates, and He Himself destroys; I accept the Command of theCommander Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay aap samaa-ay hukmee hukam pachhaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਏ  ਅਕਥੁ  ਕਹਾਏ  ਸਚ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: True greatness comes from the Guru; You alone are the mind's companion in the end.
lines.transliteration: sachee vadi-aa-ee gur tay paa-ee t oo man ant  sakhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਮਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there is no other than the Lord and Master; greatness comes from YourName. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib avar na doojaa naam t ayrai vadi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ਤੂ ਮਿਨ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the True Creator Lord, the unknowable Maker.
lines.transliteration: too sachaa sirjan haar alakh  sirand i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਤੇਰੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There is only the One Lord and Master, but there are two paths, by which conflict increases.
lines.transliteration: ayk saahib du-ay raah vaad  vaDh andi-aa jee-o.

lines.english: All follow these two paths, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the world is born,only to die.
lines.transliteration: du-ay raah chalaa-ay hukam sabaa-ay janam mu-aa sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਵਾਦ ਵਧੰਿਦਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal has no friend at all; he carriesloads of sin on his head.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa naahee ko baylee bikh laad ee sir bh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਬਾਏ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮੁਆ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he comes, but he does not understand thisHukam; the Lord's Hukam is the Embellisher.
lines.transliteration: hukmee aa-i-aa hukam na boojhai hukam savaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਿਬਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਭਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord and Master, the True CreatorLord is realized. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib sabad sinj aapai saachaa sirjan haaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਇਆ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your devotees look beautiful in Your Court, embellished with the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  soheh d arvaar sabad  suhaa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.english: They chant the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, savoring it with their tongues.
lines.transliteration: boleh amrit baan  rasan rasaa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਦਰਵਾਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Savoring it with their tongues, they thirst for the Naam; they are a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: rasan rasaa-ay naam tisaa-ay gur kai sabad  vikaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਲਿਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਿਣ  ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Touching the philosopher's stone, they become the philosopher's stone, whichtransforms lead into gold; O Lord, they become pleasing to your mind.
lines.transliteration: paaras parsi-ai paaras ho-ay jaa tayrai man bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਏ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਤਸਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਵਕਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: They attain the immortal status and eradicate their self-conceit; how rare is thatperson, who contemplates spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: amraa pad paa-i-aa aap gavaa-i-aa virlaa gi-aan veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਿਸ ਪਰਿਸਐ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਹੋਏ ਜਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the True Lord; they are dealers inthe Truth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  sohan d ar saachai saachay kay vaapaaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰਾ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am hungry and thirsty for wealth; how will I be able to go to the Lord's Court? pMnw 689
lines.transliteration: bhookh  pi-aaso aath ki-o d ar jaa-isaa jee-o.

lines.english: I shall go and ask the True Guru, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur poochh a-o jaa-ay naam Dh i-aa-isaa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਸਾਚੁ ਚਵਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: I meditate on the True Name, chant the True Name, and as Gurmukh, I realize the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sach naam Dhi-aa-ee saach chavaa-ee gurmukh  saach pachh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I chant the Name of the merciful, immaculate Lord, the Master of thepoor.
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath d a-i-aal niranjan an-d in naam vakh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ  ਆਿਪ  ਮੁਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord has ordained the tasks to be done; self-conceit is overcome, and the mind is subdued.
lines.transliteration: karnee kaar Dh arahu furmaa-ee aap mu-aa man maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam is the sweetest essence; through the Naam, thirst and desire arestilled. ||5||2|| DnwsrI CMq mhlw 1 ] (689-3) Dhanaasree chh ant mehlaa 1. Dhanaasaree, Chhant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meethaa t arisnaa naam nivaaree. ||5||2||

lines.english: Your Husband Lord is with you, O deluded soul-bride, but you do are not aware ofHim.
lines.transliteration: pir sang mooth-rh ee-ay kh abar na paa-ee-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੂਠੜੀਏ  ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.english: Your destiny is written on your forehead, according to your past actions.
lines.transliteration: mastak likh i-arhaa laykh  purab kamaa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.english: This inscription of past deeds cannot be erased; what do I know about what willhappen?
lines.transliteration: laykh na mit-ee purab kamaa-i-aa ki-aa jaan aa ki-aa hosee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਸੀ ॥
lines.english: You have not adopted a virtuous lifestyle, and you are not attuned to the Lord's Love;you sit there, crying over your past misdeeds.
lines.transliteration: gunee achaar nahee rang raat ee avgun  bahi bahi rosee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣੀ  ਅਚਾਿਰ  ਨਹੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਬਿਹ ਬਿਹ ਰੋਸੀ ॥
lines.english: Dhan joban aak kee chh aa-i-aa biraDh  bha-ay d in punni-aa. Wealth and youth are like the shade of the bitter swallow-wort plant; you are growingold, and your days are coming to their end.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਆਕ  ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ  ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਭਏ ਿਦਨ ਪੁੰਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall end up as a discarded, divorced bride; your own falsehood shall separate you from the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam binaa dohaagan  chhootee jh ooth vichh unni-aa. ||1||

lines.english: You have drowned, and your house is ruined; walk in the Way of the Guru's Will.
lines.transliteration: boodee ghar gh aali-o gur kai bh aa-ay chalo.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡੀ ਘਰੁ ਘਾਿਲਓ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਚਲੋ ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the True Name, and you shall find peace in the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence.
lines.transliteration: saachaa naam Dhi-aa-ay paavahi sukh  mahlo.

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall find peace; your stay in this world shalllast only four days.
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aa-ay t aa sukh  paa-ay pay-ee-arh ai din chaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ  ਿਦਨ  ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Sit in the home of your own being, and you shall find Truth; night and day, be withyour Beloved.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar jaa-ay bahai sach paa-ay an-d in naal pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਇ  ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Without loving devotion, you cannot dwell in your own home - listen, everyone!
lines.transliteration: vin bh agtee gh ar vaas na hovee sun i-ahu lok sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੁਿਣਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she is happy, and she obtains her Husband Lord, if she is attuned to theTrue Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak sarsee taa pir paa-ay raat ee saachai naa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਸੀ  ਤਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: If the soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, then the Husband Lord will love Hisbride.
lines.transliteration: pir Dhan bh aavai t aa pir bh aavai naaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਧਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the love of her Beloved, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: rang pareetam raat ee gur kai sabad  veechaaree jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: She contemplates the Guru's Shabads, and her Husband Lord loves her; in deephumility, she worships Him in loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad veechaaree naah pi-aaree niv niv bh agat karay-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਨਾਹ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਿਨਿਵ  ਿਨਿਵ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇਈ  ॥
lines.english: She burns away her emotional attachment to Maya, and in love, she loves herBeloved.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh jalaa-ay pareetam ras meh rang karay-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਰਸ ਮਿਹ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ  ॥
lines.english: She is imbued and drenched with the Love of the True Lord; she has becomebeautiful, by conquering her mind.
lines.transliteration: parabh saachay sayt ee rang rangayt ee laal bh a-ee man maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗੇਤੀ  ਲਾਲ  ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride abides in Truth; she loves to love her Husband Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak saach vasee sohagan pir si-o pareet  pi-aaree. ||3||

lines.english: The soul-bride looks so beautiful in the home of her Husband Lord, if she is pleasingto Him.
lines.transliteration: pir ghar sohai naar jay pir bh aav-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਘਿਰ  ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਿਰ  ਜੇ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਵਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: It is of no use at all to speak false words.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ay vain  chavay kaam na aav-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੇ ਵੈਣ ਚਵੇ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: If she speaks false, it is of no use to her, and she does not see her Husband Lord withher eyes.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  alaavai kaam na aavai naa pir d aykhai nain ee.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੁ ਅਲਾਵੈ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Worthless, forgotten and abandoned by her Husband Lord, she passes her life-night without her Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: avguni-aaree kant  visaaree chh ootee viDh an rainee.

lines.english: Such a wife does not believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she is caught in thenet of the world, and does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad na maanai faahee faathee saa Dh an mahal na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਫਾਹੀ  ਫਾਥੀ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if she understands her own self, then, as Gurmukh, she merges in celestialpeace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay aap pachhaan ai gurmukh  sahj samaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Dhan sohagan  naar jin pir jaan i-aa jee-o. Blessed is that soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord.
Without the Naam, she is false, and her actions are false as well.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa koorhi-aar koorh  kamaan i-aa jee-o.

lines.english: Devotional worship of the Lord is beautiful; the True Lord loves it. So immerseyourself in loving devotional worship of God.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  suhaavee saachay bh aavee bh aa-ay bh agat parabh  raatee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੀ  ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord is playful and innocent; imbued with His Love, I enjoy Him.
lines.transliteration: pir ralee-aalaa joban baalaa tis raavay rang raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ  ਜੋਬਿਨ ਬਾਲਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: She blossoms forth through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she ravishes her HusbandLord, and obtains the most noble reward.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad vigaasee saho raavaasee fal paa-i-aa gun kaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਵਗਾਸੀ  ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਾਸੀ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in Truth, she obtains glory; in her Husband's home, the soul-bride looks beautiful. ||5||3|| pMnw 690 DnwsrI CMq mhlw 4 Gru 1  (690-1) Dhanaasree chh ant mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 Dhanaasaree, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (690-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach milai vadi-aa-ee pir ghar sohai naaree. ||5||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kirpaa karay taa naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, through loving faith and devotion, one intuitively sings theGlorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai subh aa-ay sahj gun  gaa-ee-ai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Singing His Glorious Praises continually, night and day, one blossoms forth, when it ispleasing to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay vigsai sad aa an-d in jaa aap saachay bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਸਦਾ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾ ਆਿਪ  ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Egotism, self-conceit and Maya are forsaken, and he is intuitively absorbed into theNaam.
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaar ha-umai tajai maa-i-aa sahj naam samaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself acts; when He gives, then we receive.
lines.transliteration: aap kartaa karay so-ee aap d ay-ay t a paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਆਿਪ  ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, we meditate on the Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kirpaa karay taa naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: andar saachaa nayhu pooray sat igurai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I serve Him day and night; I never forget Him.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis sayvee d in raat  mai kad ay na veesrai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I never forget Him; I remember Him night and day. When I chant the Naam, then I live.
lines.transliteration: kaday na visaaree an-d in samHaaree jaa naam la-ee t aa jeevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਵਸਾਰੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਮਾਰੀ  ਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: With my ears, I hear about Him, and my mind is satisfied. As Gurmukh, I drink in theAmbrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: sarvanee sun ee ta ih man t ariptai gurmukh  amrit  peevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਸੁਣੀ  ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet the True Guru; my discriminatingintellect would contemplate Him, night and day.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa sat gur maylay an-d in bibayk buDh  bichrai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਬਚਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: andar saachaa nayhu pooray sat igurai. ||2||

lines.english: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; then, onecomes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  milai vadbh aag taa har ras aav-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord; he merges in celestial peace.
lines.transliteration: an-din rahai liv laa-ay t a sahj samaav-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ਤ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Merging in celestial peace, he becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind; he remains forever unattached and untouched.
lines.transliteration: sahj samaavai taa har man bh aavai sad aa ateet bairaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: He receives honor in this world and the next, lovingly focused on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  sobh aa jag ant ar raam naam liv laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਸੋਭਾ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is liberated from both pleasure and pain; he is pleased by whatever God does.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog d uhaa t ay mukt aa jo parabh  karay so bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and then,one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  milai vadbh aag taa har ras aav-ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes theself-willed manmukhs.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay d ukh ho-ay manmukh  jam johi-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜਿਮ ਜੋਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: They cry and howl, day and night, caught by the pain of Maya.
lines.transliteration: haa-ay haa-ay karay din raat  maa-i-aa d ukh mohi-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਇ  ਹਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਦੁਿਖ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Caught by the pain of Maya, provoked by his ego, he passes his life crying out, "Mine,mine!".
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa dukh  mohi-aa ha-umai rohi-aa mayree mayree karat  vihaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਦੁਿਖ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਿਹਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਿਵਹਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: He does not remember God, the Giver, and in the end, he departs regretting andrepenting.
lines.transliteration: jo parabh d ay-ay t is chayt ai naahee ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਿਤਸੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, nothing shall go along with him; not his children, spouse or the enticements of Maya.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko saath na chaalai putar kalt ar maa-i-aa Dh ohi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਮਾਇਆ  ਧੋਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs. ||4||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay d ukh ho-ay manmukh  jam johi-aa jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਜਿਮ ਜੋਿਹਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansionof the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa layho milaa-ay mahal har paa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I remain standing with my palms pressed together; I have become pleasing to God'sMind.
lines.transliteration: sadaa rahai kar jorh  parabh  man bh aa-i-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: When one is pleasing to God's Mind, then he merges in the Hukam of the Lord'sCommand; surrendering to His Hukam, he finds peace.
lines.transliteration: parabh man bh aavai t aa hukam samaavai hukam man sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Name, day and night; intuitively, naturally, hemeditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din japat  rahai d in raat ee sehjay naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਪਤ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Naam, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained; the Naam ispleasing to Nanak's mind.
lines.transliteration: naamo naam milee vadi-aa-ee naanak naam man bhaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੀ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansionof the Lord's Presence. ||5||1|| pMnw 691 DnwsrI mhlw 5 CMq  (691-1) Dhanaasree mehlaa 5 chh ant Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (691-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa layho milaa-ay mahal har paav-ay jee-o. ||5||1||

lines.english: The True Guru is merciful to the meek; in His Presence, the Lord's Praises are sung.
lines.transliteration: satgur d een d a-i-aal jis sang har gaavee-ai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਵੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is chanted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naam saaDh sang raavee-ai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਵੀਐ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Vibrating, and worshipping the One Lord in the Company of the Holy, the pains ofbirth and death are removed.
lines.transliteration: bhaj sang saaDh oo ik araaDh oo janam maran d ukh naas-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਜੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧੂ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧੂ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਏ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur karam likh i-aa saach sikh i-aa katee jam kee faas-ay. Those who have such karma pre-ordained, study and learn the Truth; the noose ofDeath is removed from their necks.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਮੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਸਿਖਆ  ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਏ  ॥
lines.english: Their fears and doubts are dispelled, the knot of death is untied, and they never haveto walk on Death's path.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aram naath ay chh utee gaath ay jam panth mool na aavee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭਰਮ  ਨਾਠੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਗਾਠੇ  ਜਮ ਪੰਿਥ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਆਵੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; let me sing Your Glorious Praisesforever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak Dh aar kirpaa sad aa har gun  gaavee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the One, Immaculate Lord is the Support of the unsupported.
lines.transliteration: niDhri-aa Dh ar ayk naam niranjano jee-o.

lines.english: You are the Giver, the Great Giver, the Dispeller of all sorrow.
lines.transliteration: too daataa daataar sarab d ukh bhanjno jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Destroyer of pain, Creator Lord, Master of peace and bliss, I have come seeking the Sanctuary of the Holy;
lines.transliteration: dukh harat  kartaa sukh ah su-aamee saran  saaDh oo aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਸੁਖਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਾਧੂ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar mahaa bikh-rh aa pal ayk maahi t araa-i-aa. please, help me to cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean in an instant.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖੜਾ  ਪਲ ਏਕ ਮਾਿਹ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I saw the Lord pervading and permeating everywhere, when the healing ointment ofthe Guru's wisdom was applied to my eyes.
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-aa sarab thaa-ee gur gi-aan naytree anjno.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਥਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨੇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਅੰਜਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, remember Him forever in meditation, the Destroyer of all sorrow andfear. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sad aa simree sarab d ukh bhai bhanjno. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਿਸਮਰੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe; He has showered me with HisMercy.
lines.transliteration: aap lee-ay larh laa-ay kirpaa Dh aaree-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਲੀਏ ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਇ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am worthless, lowly and helpless; God is unfathomable and infinite.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun neech anaath parabh  agam aapaaree-aa jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਣੁ  ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੀਆ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is always merciful, kind and compassionate; He uplifts andestablishes the lowly.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal sad aa kirpaal su-aamee neech thaapan haari-aa.

lines.english: All beings and creatures are under Your power; You take care of all.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  vas t ayrai sagal t ayree saari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਵਿਸ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself is the Contemplator of all.
lines.transliteration: aap kartaa aap bh ugtaa aap sagal beechaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਆਿਪ ਸਗਲ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, singing Your Glorious Praises, I live, chanting the Chant of the Lord, theLord of the world-forest. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak gun  gaa-ay jeevaa har jap japa-o banvaaree-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਜੀਵਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ  ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is incomparable; Your Name is utterly priceless.
lines.transliteration: tayraa d aras apaar naam amola-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O my Incomputable Lord, Your humble servants ever meditate on You.
lines.transliteration: nit jaapeh t ayray d aas purakh  atola-ee jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਿਤ  ਜਪਿਹ  ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਤੋਲਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You dwell on the tongues of the Saints, by Your own pleasure; they are intoxicatedwith Your sublime essence, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant rasan vooth aa aap t oothaa har raseh say-ee maat i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ  ਵੂਠਾ ਆਿਪ  ਤੂਠਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਮਾਿਤਆ॥
lines.english: Those who are attached to Your feet are very blessed; night and day, they remainalways awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: gur charan laagay mahaa bhaagay sad aa an-d in jaagi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਮਹਾ ਭਾਗੇ  ਸਦਾ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਿਗਆ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master; with each andevery breath, speak His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sad sad aa simart ab-y su-aamee saas saas gun  bol-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਿਸੰਮਰ੍ਤਬਯ੍ਯ੍  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਈ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, let me become the dust of the feet of the Saints. God's Name is invaluable. ||4||1|| rwgu DnwsrI bwxI Bgq kbIr jI kI  (691-15) raag Dhanaasree ban ee bh agat kabeer jee kee Raag Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (691-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak Dh oor saaDh oo naam parabh oo amola-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਧੂਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਅਮੋਲਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Beings like Sanak, Sanand, Shiva and Shaysh-naaga - none of them know Yourmystery, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sanak sanand mahays samaanaaN. saykhnaag t ayro maram na jaanaaN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells within the heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: santsangat  raam rid ai basaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Beings like Hanumaan, Garura, Indra the King of the gods and the rulers of humans -none of them know Your Glories, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hanoomaan sar garurh samaanaaN. surpat  narpat  nahee gun jaanaaN. ||2||

lines.english: The four Vedas, the Simritees and the Puraanas, Vishnu the Lord of Lakshmi andLakshmi herself - none of them know the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chaar bayd ar simrit  puraanaaN. kamlaapat  kavlaa nahee jaanaaN. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, one who falls at the Lord's feet, and remains in His Sanctuary, does not wander around lost. ||4||1|| pMnw 692
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer so bharmai naahee. pag lag raam rahai sarnaaNhee. ||4||1||

lines.english: Day by day, hour by hour, life runs its course, and the body withers away.
lines.transliteration: din tay pahar pahar t ay gh aree-aaN aav gh atai tan chh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨ  ਤੇ ਪਹਰ  ਪਹਰ  ਤੇ ਘਰੀਆਂ  ਆਵ  ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Death, like a hunter, a butcher, is on the prowl; tell me, what can we do? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaal ahayree firai baDhik ji-o kahhu kavan biDh  keejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਅਹੇਰੀ  ਿਫਰੈ ਬਿਧਕ  ਿਜਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That day is rapidly approaching.
lines.transliteration: so din aavan laagaa.

lines.english: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - tell me, who belongs to whom? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banit aa kahhu ko-oo hai kaa kaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਕਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As long as the light remains in the body, the beast does not understand himself.
lines.transliteration: jab lag jot kaa-i-aa meh bart ai aapaa pasoo na boojh ai.

lines.english: He acts in greed to maintain his life and status, and sees nothing with his eyes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laalach karai jeevan pad kaaran lochan kachh oo na soojh ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਿਤ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਮਿਹ ਬਰਤੈ  ਆਪਾ  ਪਸੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal: Renounce the doubts of your mind.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray paraanee chh odahu man kay bh armaa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚ  ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chant only the One Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal, and seek the Sanctuary ofthe One Lord. ||3||2||
lines.transliteration: kayval naam japahu ray paraanee parahu ayk kee sarnaaN. ||3||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - whatsurprises are there for him?
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhaa-o bh agat kachh  jaanai t aa ka-o achraj kaaho.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਵਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: Like water, dripping into water, which cannot be separated out again, so is the weaver Kabeer, with softened heart, merged into the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal jal meh pais na niksai ti-o dh ur mili-o julaaho. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਕਾਹੋ ॥
lines.english: O people of the Lord, I am just a simple-minded fool.
lines.transliteration: har kay logaa mai ta-o mat  kaa bh oraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਜਲੁ ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਪੈਿਸ ਨ ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਿਤਉ  ਢੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਜੁਲਾਹੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If Kabeer were to leave his body at Benares, and so liberate himself, what obligationwould he have to the Lord? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ja-o tan kaasee t ajeh kabeeraa rama-ee-ai kahaa nihoraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ  ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮਿਤ ਕਾ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O people - do not be deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray lo-ee bh aram na bh oolahu ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਤਜਿਹ  ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਰਮਈਐ  ਕਹਾ ਿਨਹੋਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What is the difference between Benares and the barren land of Maghar, if the Lord iswithin one's heart? ||2||3||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kaasee ki-aa ookhar maghar raam rid ai ja-o ho-ee. ||2||3||

lines.english: Mortals may go to the Realm of Indra, or the Realm of Shiva,
lines.transliteration: indar lok siv lokeh jaibo.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ochhay t ap kar baahur aibo. ||1|| but because of their hypocrisy and false prayers, they must leave again. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਕਾਸੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਊਖਰੁ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਜਉ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: What should I ask for? Nothing lasts forever.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa maaNga-o kichh thir naahee.

lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam rakh man maahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Fame and glory, power, wealth and glorious greatness
lines.transliteration: sobhaa raaj bibh ai badi-aa-ee.
ant na kaahoo sang sahaa-ee. ||2|| - none of these will go with you or help you in the end. ||2||

lines.english: Children, spouse, wealth and Maya
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar lachh mee maa-i-aa.
in tay kaho kavnai sukh  paa-i-aa. ||3|| - who has ever obtained peace from these? ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, nothing else is of any use.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer avar nahee kaamaa.

lines.english: Within my mind is the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||4||
lines.transliteration: hamrai man Dhan raam ko naamaa. ||4||4||

lines.english: Remember the Lord, remember the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: raam simar raam simar raam simar bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, a great many are drowned.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam simran bin boodtay aDh ikaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your spouse, children, body, house and possessions - you think these will give youpeace.
lines.transliteration: banitaa sut  dayh garayh sampat  sukh -daa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ  ਮਨ ਧਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: But none of these shall be yours, when the time of death comes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: inH mai kachh naahi t ayro kaal avaDh  aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Ajaamal, the elephant, and the prostitute committed many sins,
lines.transliteration: ajaamal gaj ganikaa patit  karam keenay.
tay-oo ut ar paar paray raam naam leenay. ||2|| but still, they crossed over the world-ocean, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.english: You have wandered in reincarnation, as pigs and dogs - did you feel no shame?
lines.transliteration: sookar kookar jon bharamay t a-oo laaj na aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ਗਰ੍ੇਹ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Forsaking the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, why do you eat poison? ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam chhaad amrit  kaahay bikh  khaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ  ਅਵਧ  ਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Abandon your doubts about do's and dont's, and take to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: taj bh aram karam biDh  nikhayDh raam naam layhee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਾਮਲ  ਗਜ ਗਿਨਕਾ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਕਰਮ  ਕੀਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O servant Kabeer, love the Lord. ||4||5|| DnwsrI bwxI Bgq nwmdyv jI kI  (692-17) Dhanaasree ban ee bh agat naamd ayv jee kee Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (692-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jan kabeer raam kar sanayhee. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਊ ਉਤਿਰ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They dig deep foundations, and build lofty palaces.
lines.transliteration: gahree kar kai neev khud aa-ee oopar mandap chh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਕਰ  ਕੂਕਰ  ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਮੇ ਤਊ ਲਾਜ  ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Can anyone live longer than Markanda, who passed his days with only a handful of straw upon his head? ||1||
lines.transliteration: maarkanday tay ko aDh ikaa-ee jin t arin Dhar moond balaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਛਾਿਡ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਾਹੇ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord is our only friend.
lines.transliteration: hamro kartaa raam sanayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਭਰਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਨਖੇਧ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੀ ॥
lines.english: O man, why are you so proud? This body is only temporary - it shall pass away.||1||Pause|| pMnw 693
lines.transliteration: kaahay ray nar garab karat hahu binas jaa-ay jh oothee dayhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੈਰਉ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ  ਸੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Kaurvas, who had brothers like Duryodhan, used to proclaim, "This is ours! This is ours!"
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kaira-o kartay d urjoDh an say bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰਹ  ਜੋਜਨ  ਛਤਰ੍ੁ ਚਲੈ ਥਾ ਦੇਹੀ ਿਗਰਝਨ  ਖਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Their royal procession extended over sixty miles, and yet their bodies were eaten byvultures. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baarah jojan chhat ar chalai thaa d ayhee girjh an kh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ ਸਇਨ ਕੀ ਲੰਕਾ  ਹੋਤੀ ਰਾਵਨ  ਸੇ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Sri Lanka was totally rich with gold; was anyone greater than its ruler Raavan?
lines.transliteration: sarab so-in kee lankaa hotee raavan say aDh ikaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ  ਦਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਹਾਥੀ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What happened to the elephants, tethered at his gate? In an instant, it all belonged tosomeone else. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kahaa bha-i-o d ar baaNDhay haathee kh in meh bh a-ee paraa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ  ਿਸਉ ਕਰਤ  ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਜਾਦਵ  ਏ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Yaadvas deceived Durbaasaa, and received their rewards.
lines.transliteration: durbaasaa si-o karat  thag-uree jaad av ay fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਊਪਰ  ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord has shown mercy to His humble servant, and now Naam Dayv sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||1||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karee jan apunay oopar naamday-o har gun gaa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਬਿਸ ਕੀਨੀ  ਪੰਚਹੁ ਕਾ ਿਮਟ ਨਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have brought the ten sensory organs under my control, and erased every trace ofthe five thieves.
lines.transliteration: das bairaagan mohi bas keenHee panchahu kaa mit naava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਿਰ  ਦੋਇ ਭਰੇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਿਰ ਿਬਖੁ ਕਉ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have filled the seventy-two thousand nerve channels with Ambrosial Nectar, anddrained out the poison. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satar d o-ay bh aray amrit  sar bikh  ka-o maar kadh aava-o. ||1||

lines.english: I shall not come into the world again.
lines.transliteration: paachhai bahur na aavan paava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਘਟ ਤੇ ਉਚਰਉ  ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I chant the Ambrosial Bani of the Word from the depths of my heart, and I haveinstructed my soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee gh at tay uchara-o aat am ka-o samjh aava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I fell at the Guru's feet and begged of Him; with the mighty axe, I have chopped offemotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: bajar kuthaar mohi hai chh eenaaN kar minat  lag paava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਜਰ  ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਹੈ ਛੀਨ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮੰਨਿਤ  ਲਿਗ  ਪਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Turning away from the world, I have become the servant of the Saints; I fear no oneexcept the Lord's devotees. ||2||
lines.transliteration: santan kay ham ultay sayvak bh agtan tay darpaava-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੇ ਹਮ ਉਲਟੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਤੇ ਡਰਪਾਵਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I shall be released from this world, when I stop clinging to Maya.
lines.transliteration: ih sansaar tay t ab hee chh oota-o ja-o maa-i-aa nah laptaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਛੂਟਉ  ਜਉ ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਹ ਲਪਟਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Maya is the name of the power which causes us to be born; renouncing it, we obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa naam garabh jon kaa t ih taj darsan paava-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਕਾ ਿਤਹ ਤਿਜ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That humble being, who performs devotional worship in this way, is rid of all fear.
lines.transliteration: it kar bh agat karahi jo jan t in bha-o sagal chukh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਕਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜੋ ਜਨ ਿਤਨ  ਭਉ ਸਗਲ  ਚੁਕਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, why are you wandering around out there? This is the way to findthe Lord. ||4||2||
lines.transliteration: kahat naamd ay-o baahar ki-aa bh armahu ih sanjam har paa-ee-ai. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਆ  ਭਰਮਹੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: As water is very precious in the desert, and the creeper weeds are dear to the camel,
lines.transliteration: maarvaarh jaisay neer baalhaa bayl baalhaa karhalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਵਾਿੜ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਬੇਿਲ  ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਕਰਹਲਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ji-o kurank nis naad baalhaa t i-o mayrai man raam-ee-aa. ||1|| and the tune of the hunter's bell at night is enticing to the deer, so is the Lord to mymind. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ  ਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is so beautiful! Your form is so beautiful! Your Love is so very beautiful, O my Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayraa naam roorh o roop roorh o at rang roorh o mayro raam-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਅਿਤ  ਰੰਗ ਰੂੜੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As rain is dear to the earth, and the flower's fragrance is dear to the bumble bee,
lines.transliteration: ji-o Dharn ee ka-o ind ar baalhaa kusam baas jaisay bh avralaa.
ji-o kokil ka-o amb baalhaa ti-o mayrai man raam-ee-aa. ||2|| and the mango is dear to the cuckoo, so is the Lord to my mind. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਧਰਣੀ  ਕਉ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਕੁਸਮ  ਬਾਸੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਰਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: As the sun is dear to the chakvi duck, and the lake of Man Sarovar is dear to theswan,
lines.transliteration: chakvee ka-o jaisay soor baalhaa maan sarovar hansulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਕੋਿਕਲ  ਕਉ ਅੰਬੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਮਈਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ji-o tarun ee ka-o kant  baalhaa t i-o mayrai man raam-ee-aa. ||3|| and the husband is dear to his wife, so is the Lord to my mind. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਕਵੀ  ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ  ਹੰਸੁਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: As milk is dear to the baby, and the raindrop is dear to the mouth of the rainbird,
lines.transliteration: baarik ka-o jaisay kheer baalhaa chaat rik mukh  jaisay jalDh araa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤਰੁਣੀ ਕਉ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਮਈਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: machhulee ka-o jaisay neer baalhaa t i-o mayrai man raam-ee-aa. ||4|| and as water is dear to the fish, so is the Lord to my mind. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲਧਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: All the seekers, Siddhas and silent sages seek Him, but only a rare few behold Him.
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  sagal mun chaaheh birlay kaahoo deeth ulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਿਤਉ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਮਈਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Just as Your Name is dear to all the Universe, so is the Lord dear to Naam Dayv's mind. ||5||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan  tayro naam baalhaa t i-o naamay man beeth ulaa. ||5||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਸਗਲ  ਮੁਿਨ ਚਾਹਿਹ  ਿਬਰਲੇ  ਕਾਹੂ ਡੀਠੁਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: First of all, the lotuses bloomed in the woods;
lines.transliteration: pahil puree-ay pundrak vanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਨਾਮੇ ਮਿਨ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ  ॥੫॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taa chay hansaa saglay janaaN. from them, all the swan-souls came into being.

lines.english: Know that, through Krishna, the Lord, Har, Har, the dance of creation dances. ||1||
lines.transliteration: krisnaa tay jaan-oo har har naachant ee naachnaa. ||1||

lines.english: First of all, there was only the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: pahil pursaabiraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਸ੍ਨਾ  ਤੇ ਜਾਨਊ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਚੰਤੀ  ਨਾਚਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From that Primal Being, Maya was produced.
lines.transliteration: athon pursaadmaraa.

lines.english: All that is, is His.
lines.transliteration: asgaa as usgaa.

lines.english: In this Garden of the Lord, we all dance, like water in the pots of the Persian wheel.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kaa baagraa naachai pinDhee meh saagraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Women and men both dance.
lines.transliteration: naachantee gopee jannaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਬਾਗਰਾ  ਨਾਚੈ  ਿਪੰਧੀ  ਮਿਹ ਸਾਗਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: na-ee-aa tay bairay kanna.

lines.english: Don't dispute this,
lines.transliteration: tarak na chaa.
bharmee-aa chaa. and don't doubt this.

lines.english: The Lord says, "This creation and I are one and the same."||2|| pMnw 694
lines.transliteration: kaysvaa bach-unee a-ee-ay ma-ee-ay ayk aan jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Like the pots on the Persian wheel, sometimes the world is high, and sometimes it is low.
lines.transliteration: pinDhee ubh kalay sansaaraa.

lines.english: Wandering and roaming around, I have come at last to Your Door.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram aa-ay t um chay d u-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਆਏ  ਤੁਮ ਚੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: "Who are you?"
lines.transliteration: too kun ray.

lines.english: "I am Naam Dayv, Sir."
lines.transliteration: mai jee. naamaa. ho jee.

lines.english: O Lord, please save me from Maya, the cause of death. ||3||4||
lines.transliteration: aalaa tay nivaarn aa jam kaarn aa. ||3||4||

lines.english: O Lord, You are the Purifier of sinners - this is Your innate nature.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan maaDh a-o birad  tayraa.

lines.english: Dhan t ay vai mun jan jin Dh i-aa-i-o har parabh  mayraa. ||1|| Blessed are those silent sages and humble beings, who meditate on my Lord God.||1||
I have applied to my forehead the dust of the feet of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: mayrai maathai laagee lay Dhoor gobind  charnan kee.

lines.english: This is something which is far away from the gods, mortal men and silent sages.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sur nar mun jan tinhoo t ay door. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਤੇ ਵੈ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਿਜਨ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pride
lines.transliteration: deen kaa d a-i-aal maaDh ou garab parhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ  ਲੇ ਧੂਿਰ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਚਰਨਨ  ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: - Naam Dayv seeks the Sanctuary of Your feet; he is a sacrifice to You. ||2||5|| DnwsrI Bgq rivdws jI kI  (694-6) Dhanaasree bh agat ravid aas jee kee Dhanaasaree, Devotee Ravi Daas Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (694-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: charan saran naamaa bal tihaaree. ||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਿਤਨਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?
lines.transliteration: ham sar deen d a-i-aal na t um sar ab pat ee-aar ki-aa keejai.

lines.english: May my mind surrender to Your Word; please, bless Your humble servant with thisperfection. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bachnee tor mor man maanai jan ka-o pooran d eejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਕਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਮਾਧੌ ਗਰਬ  ਪਰਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bal bal jaa-o rama-ee-aa kaarnay.

lines.english: O Lord, why are You silent? ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaaran kavan abol. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: For so many incarnations, I have been separated from You, Lord; I dedicate this life toYou.
lines.transliteration: bahut janam bichh uray thay maaDh a-o ih janam t umHaaray laykh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਸਿਰ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas: placing my hopes in You, I live; it is so long since I have gazed uponthe Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||1||
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas aas lag jeeva-o chir bh a-i-o d arsan d aykhay. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਚਨੀ  ਤੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In my consciousness, I remember You in meditation; with my eyes, I behold You; I fill my ears with the Word of Your Bani, and Your Sublime Praise.
lines.transliteration: chit simran kara-o nain avilokano sarvan baanee sujas poor raakh a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ਰਮਈਆ  ਕਾਰਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: ||1|| My mind is the bumble bee; I enshrine Your feet within my heart, and with mytongue, I chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rivdws jI) man so maDhukar kara-o charan hird ay Dh ara-o rasan amrit  raam naam bh aakha-o.

lines.english: My love for the Lord of the Universe does not decrease.
lines.transliteration: mayree pareet gobind  si-o jin gh atai.

lines.english: I paid for it dearly, in exchange for my soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai ta-o mol mahgee la-ee jee-a satai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਿਬਛੁਰੇ  ਥੇ ਮਾਧਉ  ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਲੇਖੇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love for the Lord does not wellup; without this love, Your devotional worship cannot be performed.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  binaa bh aa-o nahee oopjai bh aav bin bh agat nahee ho-ay t ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਆਸ  ਲਿਗ  ਜੀਵਉ  ਿਚਰ ਭਇਓ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: Ravi Daas offers this one prayer unto the Lord: please preserve and protect my honor, O Lord, my King. ||2||2||
lines.transliteration: jI) kahai ravidaas ik baynt ee har si-o paij raakh o raajaa raam mayree. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤ  ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਉ  ਨੈਨ ਅਿਵਲੋਕਨੋ  ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਬਾਨੀ  ਸੁਜਸੁ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਾਖਉ  ॥
lines.english: Your Name, Lord, is my adoration and cleansing bath.
lines.transliteration: naam tayro aart ee majan muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਧੁਕਰੁ ਕਰਉ  ਚਰਨ  ਿਹਰਦੇ  ਧਰਉ  ਰਸਨ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਭਾਖਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, all ostentatious displays are useless. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kay naam bin jhooth ay sagal paasaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your Name is my prayer mat, and Your Name is the stone to grind the sandalwood. Your Name is the saffron which I take and sprinkle in offering to You.
lines.transliteration: naam tayro aasno naam t ayro ursaa naam t ayraa kaysro lay chh itkaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮੋਿਲ ਮਹਗੀ  ਲਈ ਜੀਅ  ਸਟੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is the water, and Your Name is the sandalwood. The chanting of YourName is the grinding of the sandalwood. I take it and offer all this to You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jI) naam tayraa ambh ulaa naam t ayro chand no gh as japay naam lay t ujheh ka-o chaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Your Name is the lamp, and Your Name is the wick. Your Name is the oil I pour into it.
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa d eevaa naam t ayro baat ee naam t ayro t ayl lay maahi pasaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਬਨਾ  ਭਾਉ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭਾਵ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Your Name is the light applied to this lamp, which enlightens and illuminates the entire world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam tayray kee jot  lagaa-ee bh a-i-o uji-aaro bh avan saglaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਰਿਵਦਾਸੁ  ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: Your Name is the thread, and Your Name is the garland of flowers. The eighteen loadsof vegetation are all too impure to offer to You.
lines.transliteration: naam tayro t aagaa naam fool maalaa bh aar ath aarah sagal jooth aaray.

lines.english: Why should I offer to You, that which You Yourself created? Your Name is the fan,which I wave over You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tayro kee-aa t ujheh ki-aa arpa-o naam t ayraa t uhee chavar dh olaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਗਲ  ਪਾਸਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The whole world is engrossed in the eighteen Puraanas, the sixty-eight sacred shrinesof pilgrimage, and the four sources of creation.
lines.transliteration: das ath aa ath sathay chaaray kh aanee ihai vart an hai sagal sansaaray.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, Your Name is my Aartee, my lamp-lit worship-service. The TrueName, Sat Naam, is the food which I offer to You. ||4||3|| pMnw 695 DnwsrI bwxI BgqW kI iqRlocn (695-1) Dhanaasree ban ee bh agtaaN kee t arilochan Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Trilochan Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (695-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahai ravidaas naam t ayro aart ee sat  naam hai har bh og tuhaaray. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਕੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Why do you slander the Lord? You are ignorant and deluded.
lines.transliteration: naaraa-in nind as kaa-ay bh oolee gavaaree.

lines.english: Pain and pleasure are the result of your own actions. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dukarit  sukarit  thaaro karam ree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The moon dwells in Shiva's forehead; it takes its cleansing bath in the Ganges.
lines.transliteration: sankraa mastak bast aa sursaree isnaan ray.

lines.english: Among the men of the moon's family, Krishna was born;
lines.transliteration: kul jan maDhay mili-yo saarag paan ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਕਰਾ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਬਸਤਾ  ਸੁਰਸਰੀ  ਇਸਨਾਨ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam kar kalank mafeetas ree. ||1|| even so, the stains from its past actions remain on the moon's face. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਲ ਜਨ ਮਧੇ ਿਮਿਲਯ੍ਯ੍  ੋ ਸਾਰਗ  ਪਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Aruna was a charioteer; his master was the sun, the lamp of the world. His brother was Garuda, the king of birds;
lines.transliteration: jI) bisav kaa deepak savaamee t aa chay ray su-aarthee pankh ee raa-ay garurh  taa chay baaDhvaa.
karam kar arun pingulaa ree. ||2|| and yet, Aruna was made a cripple, because of the karma of his past actions. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਸਾਮੀ  ਤਾ ਚੇ ਰੇ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ  ਪੰਖੀ ਰਾਇ  ਗਰੁੜ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਬਾਧਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Shiva, the destroyer of countless sins, the Lord and Master of the three worlds, wandered from sacred shrine to sacred shrine; he never found an end to them.
lines.transliteration: iqRlocn jI) anik paatik hart aa taribhavan naath ree t irath t irath bh armat aa lahai na paar ree.

lines.english: And yet, he could not erase the karma of cutting off Brahma's head. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karam kar kapaal mafeetas ree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਾਿਤਕ  ਹਰਤਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਨਾਥੁ ਰੀ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Through the nectar, the moon, the wish-fulfilling cow, Lakshmi, the miraculous tree oflife, Sikhar the sun's horse, and Dhanavantar the wise physician - all arose from theocean, the lord of rivers;
lines.transliteration: amrit sasee-a Dh ayn lachh imee kalpat ar sikh ar sunaagar nad ee chay naathaN.
karam kar khaar mafeetas ree. ||4|| and yet, because of its karma, its saltiness has not left it. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਸੀਅ  ਧੇਨ ਲਿਛਮੀ  ਕਲਪਤਰ  ਿਸਖਿਰ ਸੁਨਾਗਰ  ਨਦੀ  ਚੇ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
lines.english: Hanuman burnt the fortress of Sri Lanka, uprooted the garden of Raawan, andbrought healing herbs for the wounds of Lachhman, pleasing Lord Raamaa;
lines.transliteration: daaDh eelay lankaa garh  upaarh eelay raavan  ban sal bisal aan  tokheelay haree.
karam kar kachh-utee mafeetas ree. ||5|| and yet, because of his karma, he could not be rid of his loin cloth. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਧੀਲੇ  ਲੰਕਾ  ਗੜੁ ਉਪਾੜੀਲੇ  ਰਾਵਣ  ਬਣੁ ਸਿਲ ਿਬਸਿਲ  ਆਿਣ  ਤੋਖੀਲੇ  ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The karma of past actions cannot be erased, O wife of my house; this is why I chantthe Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: iqRlocn jI) poorbalo kirat karam na mitai ree gh ar gayhan  taa chay mohi jaapee-alay raam chay naamaN.

lines.english: So prays Trilochan, Dear Lord. ||6||1|| sRI sYxu ] (695-9) saree sain. Sri Sain:
lines.transliteration: badat  tarilochan raam jee. ||6||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਬਲੋ  ਿਕਰ੍ਤ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਨ ਿਮਟੈ ਰੀ ਘਰ ਗੇਹਿਣ  ਤਾ ਚੇ ਮੋਿਹ ਜਾਪੀਅਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ਚੇ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
lines.english: Dhoop d eep gh arit saaj aart ee. With incense, lamps and ghee, I offer this lamp-lit worship service.
I am a sacrifice to the Lord of Lakshmi. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vaarnay jaa-o kamlaa patee. ||1||

lines.english: Hail to You, Lord, hail to You! Again and again, hail to You, Lord King, Ruler of all! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: manglaa har manglaa. nit mangal raajaa raam raa-ay ko. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sublime is the lamp, and pure is the wick.
lines.transliteration: ootam d ee-araa nirmal baat ee.

lines.english: You are immaculate and pure, O Brilliant Lord of Wealth! ||2||
lines.transliteration: tuheeN niranjan kamlaa paat ee. ||2||

lines.english: Raamaanand knows the devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raamaa bhagat  raamaanand  jaanai.

lines.english: He says that the Lord is all-pervading, the embodiment of supreme joy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pooran parmaanand bakh aanai. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord of the world, of wondrous form, has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: madan moorat  bhai taar gobind ay.

lines.english: Says Sain, remember the Lord, the embodiment of supreme joy! ||4||2|| pIpw ] (695-13) peepaa. Peepaa:
lines.transliteration: sain bhan ai bhaj parmaanand ay. ||4||2||

lines.english: Within the body, the Divine Lord is embodied. The body is the temple, the place ofpilgrimage, and the pilgrim.
lines.transliteration: kaa-ya-o dayvaa kaa-i-a-o d ayval kaa-i-a-o jangam jaat ee.

lines.english: Within the body are incense, lamps and offerings. Within the body are the flowerofferings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-a-o Dhoop d eep na-eebayd aa kaa-i-a-o pooja-o paat ee. ||1||

lines.english: I searched throughout many realms, but I found the nine treasures within the body.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa baho khand kh ojtay nav niDh  paa-ee.

lines.english: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; I pray to the Lord for Mercy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naa kachh aa-ibo naa kachh  jaa-ibo raam kee d uhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One who pervades the Universe also dwells in the body; whoever seeks Him,finds Him there.
lines.transliteration: jo barahmanday so-ee pinday jo kh ojai so paavai.

lines.english: Peepaa prays, the Lord is the supreme essence; He reveals Himself through the TrueGuru. ||2||3|| DMnw ] (695-16) Dhannaa. Dhannaa:
lines.transliteration: peepaa paranvai param t at hai sat gur ho-ay lakh aavai. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਯਉ  ਦੇਵਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ  ਦੇਵਲ  ਕਾਇਅਉ  ਜੰਗਮ  ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord of the world, this is Your lamp-lit worship service.
lines.transliteration: gopaal tayraa aart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਅਉ  ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਾ  ਕਾਇਅਉ  ਪੂਜਉ  ਪਾਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Arranger of the affairs of those humble beings who perform Your devotional worship service. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jan tumree bh agat karant ay tin kay kaaj savaarat aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਬਹੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੋਜਤੇ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Lentils, flour and ghee - these things, I beg of You.
lines.transliteration: daal seeDh aa maaga-o gh ee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਆਇਬੋ  ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਇਬੋ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind shall ever be pleased.
lines.transliteration: hamraa khusee karai nit  jee-o.

lines.english: Shoes, fine clothes, and grain of seven kinds - I beg of You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panHee-aa chhaad an neekaa. anaaj maga-o sat  see kaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡੇ  ਸੋਈ ਿਪੰਡੇ ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: A milk cow, and a water buffalo, I beg of You,
lines.transliteration: ga-oo bhais maga-o laavayree.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਪਾ ਪਰ੍ਣਵੈ  ਪਰਮ  ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ik taajan t uree changayree. and a fine Turkestani horse.

lines.english: A good wife to care for my home
lines.transliteration: ghar kee geehan changee.

lines.english: - Your humble servant Dhanna begs for these things, Lord. ||2||4|| pMnw 696 jYqsrI mhlw 4 Gru 1 caupdy (696-1) jaitsaree mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 cha-upd ay Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (696-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan Dhannaa layvai mangee. ||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Jewel of the Lord's Name abides within my heart; the Guru has placed His hand on my forehead.
lines.transliteration: mayrai hee-arai ratan naam har basi-aa gur haath Dh ari-o mayrai maathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਬਿਸਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਹਾਥੁ ਧਿਰਓ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: The sins and pains of countless incarnations have been cast out. The Guru hasblessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and my debt has been paid off.||1||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilbikh d ukh utray gur naam d ee-o rin laathaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ  ਿਰਨੁ ਲਾਥਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate the Lord's Name, and all your affairs shall be resolved.
lines.transliteration: mayray man bhaj raam naam sabh  arthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਭ ਅਰਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me; without the Name, life isuseless. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam drirh-aa-i-aa bin naavai jeevan birthaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the self-willed manmukhs are foolish and ignorant; they are foreverentangled in emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: bin gur moorh bh a-ay hai manmukh  tay moh maa-i-aa nit  faathaa.

lines.english: They never serve the feet of the Holy; their lives are totally useless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin saaDh oo charan  na sayvay kabhoo t in sabh  janam akaathaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਫਾਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve at the feet of the Holy, the feet of the Holy, their lives are made fruitful, and they belong to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin saaDhoo charan  saaDh  pag sayvay t in safli-o janam sanaathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ  ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਿਤਨ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਕਾਥਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Make me the slave of the slave of the slaves of the Lord; bless me with Your Mercy, OLord of the Universe. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o keejai daas d aas d aasan ko har d a-i-aa Dh aar jagannaathaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ  ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵੇ ਿਤਨ ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਜਨਮੁ ਸਨਾਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am blind, ignorant and totally without wisdom; how can I walk on the Path?
lines.transliteration: ham anDhulay gi-aanheen agi-aanee ki-o chaalah maarag panthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਜਗੰਨਾਥਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am blind - O Guru, please let me grasp the hem of Your robe, so that servant Nanakmay walk in harmony with You. ||4||1|| jYqsrI mhlw 4 ] (696-9) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ham anDhulay ka-o gur anchal d eejai jan naanak chalah milanthaa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਿਗਆਨਹੀਨ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਚਾਲਹ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪੰਥਾ ॥
lines.english: A jewel or a diamond may be very valuable and heavy, but without a purchaser, it isworth only straw.
lines.transliteration: heeraa laal amolak hai bhaaree bin gaahak meekaa kaakh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਚਲੁ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਲਹ  ਿਮਲੰਥਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Holy Guru, the Purchaser, saw this jewel, He purchased it for hundreds ofthousands of dollars. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ratan gaahak gur saaDh oo daykhi-o tab rat an bikaano laakh aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord has kept this jewel hidden within my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man gupat heer har raakh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰਾ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਅਮੋਲਕੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗਾਹਕ  ਮੀਕਾ  ਕਾਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, merciful to the meek, led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Guru, I came to appreciate this jewel. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal milaa-i-o gur saaDh oo gur mili-ai heer paraakh aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਗਾਹਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਤਬ ਰਤਨੁ ਿਬਕਾਨੋ  ਲਾਖਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The rooms of the self-willed manmukhs are dark with ignorance; in their homes, thejewel is not visible.
lines.transliteration: manmukh koth ee agi-aan anDh ayraa t in ghar rat an na laakh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਗੁਪਤ  ਹੀਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those fools die, wandering in the wilderness, eating the poison of the snake, Maya. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tay oojh arh bharam mu-ay gaavaaree maa-i-aa bh u-ang bikh  chaakh aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਓ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹੀਰੁ ਪਰਾਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, let me meet the humble, holy beings; O Lord, keep me in theSanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har har saaDh maylhu jan neekay har saaDh oo saran  ham raakh aa.

lines.english: O Lord, make me Your own; O God, Lord and Master, I have hurried to Your side.||3||
lines.transliteration: har angeekaar karahu parabh su-aamee ham paray bh aag tum paakh aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕੋਠੀ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਘਿਰ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I speak and describe? You are great andunfathomable, the Greatest Being.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa ki-aa gun aakh  vakh aaneh tum vad agam vad purkh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਊਝਿੜ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਭੁਅੰਗ  ਿਬਖੁ ਚਾਖਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord has bestowed His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has saved the sinking stone. ||4||2|| pMnw 697 jYqsrI mÚ 4 ] (697-1) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kirpaa Dhaaree paakh aan dubat  har raakh aa. ||4||2||

lines.english: I am Your child; I know nothing about Your state and extent; I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik kachhoo-a na jaanah gat  mit tayray moorakh  mugaDh  i-aanaa.

lines.english: O Lord, shower me with Your Mercy; bless me with an enlightened intellect; I amfoolish - make me clever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa Dhaar d eejai mat  ootam kar leejai mugaDh  si-aanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਕਛੂਅ  ਨ ਜਾਨਹ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ  ਇਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is lazy and sleepy.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man aalsee-aa ughlaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਕਿਰ ਲੀਜੈ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਿਸਆਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, has led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Holy, the shuttershave been opened wide. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har aan milaa-i-o gur saaDhoo mil saaDh oo kapat kh ulaanaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Guru, each and every instant, fill my heart with love; the Name of my Beloved is my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: gur khin kh in pareet  lagaavahu mayrai hee-arai mayray pareet am naam paraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਨ  ਿਮਲਾਇਓ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਕਪਟ  ਖੁਲਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, I would die; the Name of my Lord and Master is to me like the drug to the addict. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai mar jaa-ee-ai mayray thaakur ji-o amlee amal lubh aanaa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who enshrine love for the Lord within their minds fulfill their pre-ordaineddestiny.
