lines.transliteration: jin man pareet lagee har kayree t in Dhur bhaag puraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I worship their feet, each and every instant; the Lord seems very sweet to them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin ham charan  sarayveh kh in khin jin har meeth  lagaanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈਐ  ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਿਜਉ ਅਮਲੀ  ਅਮਿਲ  ਲੁਭਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master, Har, Har, has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; separated for so long, he is now re-united with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa Dhaaree mayrai th aakur jan bichh uri-aa chiree milaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਿਤਨ  ਧੁਿਰ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat gur jin naam drirh -aa-i-aa jan naanak t is kurbaanaa. ||4||3|| Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has implanted the Naam, the Name of theLord within me; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||3|| jYqsrI mhlw 4 ] (697-8) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰੇਵਹ  ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have found the True Guru, my Friend, the Greatest Being. Love and affection for theLord has blossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: satgur saajan purakh  vad paa-i-aa har rasak rasak fal laagibaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਜਨੁ ਿਬਛੁਿਰਆ  ਿਚਰੀ  ਿਮਲਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Maya, the snake, has seized the mortal; through the Word of the Guru, the Lordneutralizes the venom. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa bhu-i-ang garsi-o hai paraan ee gur bachnee bis har kaadh ibaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind is attached to the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man raam naam ras laagibaa.

lines.english: The Lord has purified the sinners, uniting them with the Holy Guru; now, they tastethe Lord's Name, and the sublime essence of the Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kee-ay patit  pavit ar mil saaDh  gur har naamai har ras chaakh ibaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਵਡ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਫਲ ਲਾਿਗਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an vadbh aag mili-o gur saaDh oo mil saaDh oo liv unman laagibaa. Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those who meet the Holy Guru; meeting with the Holy, they lovingly center themselves in the state of absolute absorption.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਭੁਇਅੰਗ  ਗਰ੍ਿਸਓ  ਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਿਬਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾਿਢਬਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fire of desire within them is quenched, and they find peace; they sing the GloriousPraises of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa agan bujh ee saaNt paa-ee har nirmal nirmal gun gaa-ibaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਲਾਿਗਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, havemisfortune pre-ordained for them.
lines.transliteration: tin kay bh aag kh een Dh ur paa-ay jin sat gur daras na paa-ibaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਏ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, they are consigned to reincarnation through the womb, andthey pass their lives totally uselessly. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tay doojai bh aa-ay paveh garabh  jonee sabh  birthaa janam t in jaa-ibaa. ||3||

lines.english: O Lord, please, bless me with pure understanding, that I may serve the Feet of theHoly Guru; the Lord seems sweet to me.
lines.transliteration: har dayh bimal mat  gur saaDh  pag sayvah ham har meeth  lagaa-ibaa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ  ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਿਲਵ ਉਨਮਿਨ  ਲਾਿਗਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; O Lord, be Merciful, and blessme with it. ||4||4|| jYqsrI mhlw 4 ] (697-15) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak rayn saaDh  pag maagai har ho-ay d a-i-aal d ivaa-ibaa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਸਿਤ  ਪਾਈ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਬਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name does not abide within their hearts - their mothers should have beensterile.
lines.transliteration: jin har hirdai naam na basi-o t in maat  keejai har baaNjhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ਖੀਨ ਧੁਿਰ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: These bodies wander around, forlorn and abandoned, without the Name; their lives waste away, and they die, crying out in pain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin sunj ee dayh fireh bin naavai o-ay kh ap kh ap mu-ay karaaNjhaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਪਵਿਹ  ਗਰ੍ਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਾਇਬਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord within you.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap raam naam har maajhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਿਬਮਲ  ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵਹ  ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਇਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord God, Har, Har, has showered me with His Mercy; the Guru hasimparted spiritual wisdom to me, and my mind has been instructed. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaal kirpaa parabh Dh aaree gur gi-aan d ee-o man samjh aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਮਾਗੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਦਵਾਇਬਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise brings the most nobleand exalted status; the Lord is found through the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har keerat kaljug pad  ootam har paa-ee-ai sat gur maajh aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has revealed the Lord's hidden Name to me.||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur apunay jin gupat  naam pargaajh aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਓ  ਿਤਨ  ਮਾਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਬਝਾ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy; itremoves all stains of sin.
lines.transliteration: darsan saaDh  mili-o vadbh aagee sabh  kilbikh  ga-ay gavaajh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਖਿਪ ਖਿਪ ਮੁਏ ਕਰਝਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found the True Guru, the great, all-knowing King; He has shared with me the many Glorious Virtues of the Lord. ||3|| pMnw 698
lines.transliteration: satgur saahu paa-i-aa vad d aanaa har kee-ay baho gun  saajh aa. ||3||

lines.english: Those, unto whom the Lord, the Life of the world, has shown Mercy, enshrine Him within their hearts, and cherish Him in their minds.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o kirpaa karee jagjeevan har ur Dhaari-o man maajh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਮਨ ਮਾਝਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay d ar kaagad  faaray jan naanak laykh aa samjh aa. ||4||5|| The Righteous Judge of Dharma, in the Court of the Lord, has torn up my papers;servant Nanak's account has been settled. ||4||5|| jYqsrI mhlw 4 ] (698-2) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ ਦਿਰ ਕਾਗਦ  ਫਾਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਸਮਝਾ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I found the Holy, by great good fortune;my restless mind has been quieted.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  saaDh  paa-ee vadbh aagee man chalt ou bh a-i-o aroorh aa.

lines.english: The unstruck melody ever vibrates and resounds; I have taken in the sublime essenceof the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, showering down. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anhat Dh un vaajeh nit  vaajay har amrit  Dhaar ras leerh aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤੌ  ਭਇਓ  ਅਰੂੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the beauteous Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap raam naam har roorhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਤ  ਧੁਿਨ ਵਾਜਿਹ  ਿਨਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਧਾਰ ਰਿਸ ਲੀੜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru has drenched my mind and body with the Love of the Lord, who hasmet me and lovingly embraced me. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan pareet  lagaa-ee sat gur har mili-o laa-ay jh apeerh aa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged in the chains of Maya; they are activelyengaged, gathering in the poisonous wealth.
lines.transliteration: saakat banDh  bha-ay hai maa-i-aa bikh  saNcheh laa-ay jakeerh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਲਾਇ ਝਪੀੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: They cannot spend this in harmony with the Lord, and so they must endure the pain which the Messenger of Death inflicts upon their heads. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kai arath kharach nah saakeh jamkaal saheh sir peerh aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Holy Guru has dedicated His Being to the Lord's service; with great devotion,apply the dust of His feet to your face.
lines.transliteration: jin har arath sareer lagaa-i-aa gur saaDhoo baho sarDh aa laa-ay mukh  Dhoorhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਬੰਧ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਸੰਚਿਹ  ਲਾਇ  ਜਕੀੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: In this world and the next, you shall receive the Lord's honor, and your mind shall beimbued with the permanent color of the Lord's Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  har sobh aa paavahi har rang lagaa man goorh aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਅਰਿਥ  ਖਰਿਚ  ਨਹ ਸਾਕਿਹ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਸਹਿਹ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਪੀੜਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, please unite me with the Holy; compared to these Holy people, I amjust a worm.
lines.transliteration: har har mayl mayl jan saaDhoo ham saaDh  janaa kaa keerh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਅਰਿਥ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਲਗਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇ  ਮੁਿਖ ਧੂੜਾ ॥
lines.english: ||4||6|| Servant Nanak has enshrined love for the feet of the Holy Guru; meeting with thisHoly One, my foolish, stone-like mind has blossomed forth in lush profusion. ||4||6|| jYqsrI mhlw 4 Gru 2  (698-10) jaitsaree mehlaa 4 gh ar 2 Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (698-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak pareet lagee pag saaDh  gur mil saaDh oo paakh aan hari-o man moorh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ  ਮਿਨ ਗੂੜਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Remember in meditation the Lord, Har, Har, the unfathomable, infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har simrahu agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਮੇਿਲ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, pains are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat d ukh mitai hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਪਗ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਹਿਰਓ  ਮਨੁ ਮੂੜਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the Guru, I am at peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har satgur purakh  milaavhu gur mili-ai sukh  ho-ee raam. ||1||

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O my friend.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavhu meet  hamaaray.

lines.english: Cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your heart.
lines.transliteration: har har naam rakhahu ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: Read the Ambrosial Words of the Lord, Har, Har; meeting with the Guru, the Lord isrevealed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har amrit bachan sun avhu gur mili-ai pargat ho-ee raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Slayer of demons, is my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: maDhusood an har maaDh o paraanaa.

lines.english: His Ambrosial Amrit is so sweet to my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan amrit  meeth  lagaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, have mercy upon me, and lead me to meet the Guru, theimmaculate Primal Being. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har da-i-aa karahu gur maylhu purakh  niranjan so-ee raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਚਨ  ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: har har naam sadaa sukh -daata.

lines.english: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: har kai rang mayraa man raataa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord Har, Har, lead me to meet the Guru, the Greatest Being; through the Name of Guru Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||1||7|| jYqsrI mÚ 4 ] (698-16) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har mahaa purakh gur maylhu gur naanak naam sukh  ho-ee raam. ||4||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har har har naam japaahaa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, ever earn the profit of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam sad aa lai laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Implant within yourself devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; sincerely dedicateyourself to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har har har bhagat  darirhaavahu har har naam omaahaa raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam da-i-aal Dh i-aahaa.

lines.english: WIth love, forever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kai rang sadaa gun  gaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dance to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; meet with the Sat Sangat, the TrueCongregation, with sincerity. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har har jas ghoomar paavhu mil sat sang omaahaa raam. ||2||

lines.english: Come, O companions - let us unite in the Lord's Union.
lines.transliteration: aa-o sakhee har mayl milaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, earn the profit of the Naam. pMnw 699
lines.transliteration: sun har kathaa naam lai laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, be merciful to me, and lead me to meet the Guru; meeting the Guru, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up in me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa Dhaar gur maylhu gur mili-ai har omaahaa raam. ||3||

lines.english: Praise Him, the unfathomable and inaccessible Lord.
lines.transliteration: kar keerat jas agam athaahaa.

lines.english: Each and every moment, sing the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: khin kh in raam naam gaavaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥
lines.english: ||4||2||8|| Be merciful, and meet me, O Guru, Great Giver; Nanak yearns for the Lord'sdevotional worship. ||4||2||8|| jYqsrI mÚ 4 ] (699-3) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o Dhaar kirpaa milee-ai gur d aatay har naanak bh agat omaahaa raam.

lines.english: With love and energetic affection, praise the Lord, the storehouse of Nectar.
lines.transliteration: ras ras raam rasaal salaahaa.

lines.english: My mind is drenched with the Lord's Name, and so it earns this profit.
lines.transliteration: man raam naam bheenaa lai laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਭੀਨਾ  ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Each and every moment, worship Him in devotion, day and night; through the Guru's Teachings, sincere love and devotion well up. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khin kh in bhagat karah d in raat ee gurmat  bhagat omaahaa raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har gun govind  japaahaa.

lines.english: Conquering mind and body, I have earned the profit of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man tan jeet  sabad  lai laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਿਤ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the five demons are over-powered, and the mind andbody are filled with a sincere yearning for the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmat panch d oot vas aavahi man t an har omaahaa raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਿਸ ਆਵਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Name is a jewel - chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan har naam japaahaa.

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and forever earn this profit.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay sad aa lai laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, merciful to the meek, be kind to me, and bless me with sincere longing for theName of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaa kar maaDh o har har naam omaahaa raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord of the world - meditate within your mind.
lines.transliteration: jap jagdees japa-o man maahaa.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, is the only real profit in this world.
lines.transliteration: har har jagannaath jag laahaa.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an vaday th aakur parabh  mayray jap naanak bh agat omaahaa raam. ||4||3||9|| Blessed, blessed, is my Great Lord and Master God; O Nanak, meditate on Him,worship Him with sincere love and devotion. ||4||3||9|| jYqsrI mhlw 4 ] (699-8) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Yogi, and the way throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: aapay jogee jugat jugaahaa.

lines.english: The Fearless Lord Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: aapay nirbha-o t aarhee laahaa.

lines.english: He Himself, all by Himself, is all-pervading; He Himself blesses us with sincere love forthe Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay hee aap aap vartai aapay naam omaahaa raam. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself is the lamp, and the Light pervading all the worlds.
lines.transliteration: aapay deep lo-a d eepaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself churns the ocean.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur samund  mathaahaa.

lines.english: He Himself churns it, churning up the essence; meditating on the jewel of the Naam,sincere love comes to the surface. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay math math tat  kadh aa-ay jap naam rat an omaahaa raam. ||2||

lines.english: O my companions, let us meet and join together, and sing His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sakhee milhu mil gun  gaavaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਿਥ ਮਿਥ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਾਏ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam japahu har laahaa.

lines.english: Devotional worship of the Lord, Har, Har, has been implanted within me; it is pleasing to my mind. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, brings a sincere love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat  darirh-ee man bh aa-ee har har naam omaahaa raam. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself is supremely wise, the greatest King.
lines.transliteration: aapay vad daan aa vad saahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜੀ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, purchase the merchandise of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh poonjee naam visaahaa.

lines.english: O Lord God, Har, Har, bless me with such a gift, that Your Glorious Virtues seempleasing to me; Nanak is filled with sincere love and yearning for the Lord.||4||4||10|| jYqsrI mhlw 4 ] (699-14) jaitsaree mehlaa 4. Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har daat  karahu parabh  bhaavai gun  naanak naam omaahaa raam. ||4||4||10||

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and associating with the Guru,
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  sang guraahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: poonjee naam gurmukh vaysaahaa. the Gurmukh gathers in the merchandise of the Naam.

lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, Destroyer of demons, have mercy upon me; bless me with a sincere yearning to join the Sat Sangat. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa Dhaar maDh usood an mil sat sang omaahaa raam. ||1||

lines.english: Let me hear with my ears the Banis, the Hymns, in praise of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: har gun ban ee sarvan  sunaahaa.
kar kirpaa satguroo milaahaa. be merciful, and let me meet the True Guru.

lines.english: I sing His Glorious Praises, I speak the Bani of His Word; chanting His GloriousPraises, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavah gun  bolah ban ee har gun  jap omaahaa raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਤਸੰਿਗ  ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have tried visiting all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, fasting, ceremonial feasts andgiving to charities.
lines.transliteration: sabh t irath varat  jag punn t olaahaa.

lines.english: They do not measure up to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har naam na pujeh pujaahaa.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is unweighable, utterly heavy in weight; through the Guru'sTeachings, a sincere yearning to chant the Name has welled up in me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har atul t ol at bhaaree gurmat  jap omaahaa raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ  ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਜਿਪ ਓ ੁਮਾਹਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All good karma and righteous living are found in meditation on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sabh karam Dh aram har naam japaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੀਰਥ  ਵਰਤ  ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਲਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: It washes away the stains of sins and mistakes.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh mail paap Dh ovaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਿਹ  ਪੁਜਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Be merciful to meek, humble Nanak; bless him with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||5||11|| pMnw 700 jYqsrI mhlw 5 Gru 3  (700-1) jaitsaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 3 Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (700-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal hohu jan oopar d ayh naanak naam omaahaa raam. ||4||5||11||

lines.english: Does anyone know, who is our friend in this world?
lines.transliteration: ko-ee jaanai kavan eehaa jag meet.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਈਹਾ  ਜਿਗ  ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone understands this, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. Immaculate and unstained is his way of life. ||1||Pause|| mwq ipqw binqw suq bMDp iest mIq Aru BweI ] pUrb jnm ky imly sMjogI AMqih ko n shweI
lines.transliteration: jis ho-ay kirpaal so-ee biDh boojh ai taa kee nirmal reet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਸੋਈ ਿਬਿਧ  ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mother, father, spouse, children, relatives, lovers, friends and siblings meet, having been associated in previous lives; but none of them will be your companion andsupport in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa banit aa sut  banDh ap isat meet  ar bh aa-ee. poorab janam kay milay sanjogee anteh ko na sahaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Pearl necklaces, gold, rubies and diamonds please the mind, but they are only Maya.
lines.transliteration: mukat maal kanik laal heeraa man ranjan kee maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਇਸਟ  ਮੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Possessing them, one passes his life in agony; he obtains no contentment from them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: haa haa karat bihaanee avDh ahi taa meh sant okh na paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਬ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਅੰਤਿਹ  ਕੋ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Elephants, chariots, horses as fast as the wind, wealth, land, and armies of four kinds
lines.transliteration: hasat rath asav pavan t ayj Dh anee bh ooman chat uraaNgaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਮਾਲ  ਕਿਨਕ  ਲਾਲ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਮਨ ਰੰਜਨ  ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sang na chaali-o in meh kachhoo-ai ooth  siDhaa-i-o naaNgaa. ||3|| - none of these will go with him; he must get up and depart, naked. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹਾਨੀ  ਅਵਧਿਹ ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord's Saints are the beloved lovers of God; sing of the Lord, Har, Har, with them.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant pari-a pareet am parabh  kay t aa kai har har gaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਸਿਤ  ਰਥ ਅਸ ਪਵਨ  ਤੇਜ ਧਣੀ ਭੂਮਨ ਚਤੁਰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the Society of the Saints, you shall obtain peace in this world, and in the next world, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||4||1|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 Gru 3 dupdy  (700-8) jaitsaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 3 d upday Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (700-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak eehaa sukh aagai mukh  oojal sang sant an kai paa-ee-ai. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਿਲਓ ਇਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਛੂਐ  ਊਿਠ ਿਸਧਾਇਓ  ਨਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Give me a message from my Beloved - tell me, tell me!
lines.transliteration: dayh sand aysaro kahee-a-o pari-a kahee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am wonder-struck, hearing the many reports of Him; tell them to me, O my happysister soul-brides. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bisam bha-ee mai baho biDh  suntay kahhu suhaagan sahee-a-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਈਹਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ  ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Some say that He is beyond the world - totally beyond it, while others say that He is totally within it.
lines.transliteration: ko kahto sabh  baahar baahar ko kaht o sabh  mahee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: His color cannot be seen, and His pattern cannot be discerned. O happy soul-brides,tell me the truth! ||1||
lines.transliteration: baran na deesai chihan na lakh ee-ai suhaagan saat  boojh hee-a-o. ||1||

lines.english: He is pervading everywhere, and He dwells in  each and every heart; He is not stained - He is unstained.
lines.transliteration: sarab nivaasee ghat gh at vaasee layp nahee alaphee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਮੁ  ਭਈ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਸੁਨਤੇ  ਕਹਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਨ  ਸਹੀਅਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O people: He dwells upon the tongues of the Saints. ||2||1||2|| jYqsrI mÚ 5 ] (700-12) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat sunhu ray logaa sant  rasan ko bashee-a-o. ||2||1||2||

lines.english: Dheera-o sun Dh eera-o parabh  ka-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. I am calmed, calmed and soothed, hearing of God. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ  ਸਭ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ  ਸਭ ਮਹੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my soul, my breath of life, my mind, body and everything to Him: I behold God near, very near. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan man tan sabh  arpa-o neera-o paykh  parabh  ka-o neera-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਿਚਹਨੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਸੁਹਾਗਿਨ ਸਾਿਤ  ਬੁਝਹੀਅਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Beholding God, the inestimable, infinite and Great Giver, I cherish Him in my mind.||2||
lines.transliteration: baysumaar bay-ant bad d aataa maneh gaheera-o paykh  parabh  ka-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਵਾਸੀ  ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਅਲਪਹੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever I wish for, I receive; my hopes and desires are fulfilled, meditating on God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo chaaha-o so-ee so-ee paava-o aasaa mansaa poora-o jap parabh ka-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹਤ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਗਾ  ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ  ਕੋ ਬਸਹੀਅਉ  ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: ||4||2||3|| By Guru's Grace, God dwells in Nanak's mind; he never suffers or grieves, havingrealized God. ||4||2||3|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (700-15) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak man vasi-aa d ookh na kabhoo jh oora-o bujh  parabh  ka-o.

lines.english: I seek my Friend the Lord.
lines.transliteration: lorheed arhaa saajan mayraa.

lines.english: In each and every home, sing the sublime songs of rejoicing; He abides in each andevery heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar mangal gaavhu neekay gh at ghat tiseh basayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In good times, worship and adore Him; in bad times, worship and adore Him; do notever forget Him.
lines.transliteration: sookh araaDh an dookh araaDh an bisrai na kaahoo bayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ  ਨੀਰਉ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਨੀਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the light of millions of suns shines forth,and the darkness of doubt is dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japat kot soor ujaaraa binsai bh aram anDh ayraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਬਡ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮਨਿਹ ਗਹੀਰਉ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In all the spaces and interspaces, everywhere, whatever we see is Yours.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar sabh nee jaa-ee jo d eesai so t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਉ  ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ  ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਪੂਰਉ  ਜਿਪ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who finds the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, is not consigned to reincarnation again. ||2||3||4|| pMnw 701 jYqsrI mhlw 5 Gru 4 dupdy  (701-1) jaitsaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 4 d upday Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (701-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: satsang paavai jo naanak t is bahur na ho-ee hai fayraa. ||2||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Now, I have found peace, bowing before the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ab mai sukh paa-i-o gur aaga-y.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਗੁਰ ਆਿਗਯ੍ਯ੍ ॥
lines.english: I have abandoned cleverness, quieted my anxiety, and renounced my egotism. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tajee si-aanap chint  visaaree ahaN chhodi-o hai t i-aaga-y. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When I looked, I saw that everyone was enticed by emotional attachment; then, Ihurried to the Guru's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ja-o daykh -a-u t a-o sagal mohi mohee-a-o t a-o saran pari-o gur bh aag.

lines.english: In His Grace, the Guru engaged me in the Lord's service, and then, the Messenger ofDeath gave up pursuing me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa tahal har laa-i-o ta-o jam chh odee moree laag. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਉ ਸਗਲ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮੋਹੀਅਉ  ਤਉ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਗੁਰ ਭਾਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: I swam across the ocean of fire, when I met the Saints, through great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: tari-o saagar paavak ko ja-o sant  bhaytay vad bh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਟਹਲ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਜਿਮ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਲਾਿਗ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, I have found total peace; my consciousness is attached to the Lord's feet. ||2||1||5|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (701-5) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sarab sukh paa-ay moro har charnee chit  laag. ||2||1||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਰਓ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਵਕ  ਕੋ ਜਉ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Within my mind, I cherish and meditate on the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man meh satgur Dh i-aan Dh araa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਰੋ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਿਗ  ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: He has implanted within me spiritual wisdom and the Mantra of the Lord's Name; DearGod has shown mercy to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darirh hi-o gi-aan mant ar har naamaa parabh  jee-o ma-i-aa karaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Death's noose and its mighty entanglements have vanished, along with the fear ofdeath.
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal ar mahaa janjaalaa chhutkay jameh daraa.

lines.english: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord, the Destroyer of pain; I am holdingtight to the Support of His feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aa-i-o dukh  haran  saran  karun aapat  gahi-o charan  aasraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਿੜਓ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਮਇਆ  ਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has assumed the form of a boat, tocross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: naav roop bha-i-o saaDh sang bh av niDh  paar paraa.

lines.english: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and my doubts are shattered; says Nanak, I can bearthe unbearable. ||2||2||6|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (701-9) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: api-o pee-o gat thee-o bh armaa kaho naanak ajar jaraa. ||2||2||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਜਾਲ  ਅਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ  ਛੁਟਕੇ  ਜਮਿਹ  ਡਰਾ ॥
lines.english: One who has the Lord of the Universe as his help and support
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bha-ay govind  sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਓ  ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣ  ਸਰਣ  ਕਰੁਣਾਪਿਤ  ਗਿਹਓ  ਚਰਣ  ਆਸਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  sagal si-o vaa ka-o bi-aaDh  na kaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. is blessed with all peace, poise and bliss; no afflictions cling to him. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵ ਰੂਪ ਭਇਓ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਭਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾ ॥
lines.english: He appears to keep company with everyone, but he remains detached, and Maya does not cling to him.
lines.transliteration: deeseh sabh  sang raheh alaypaa nah vi-aapai un maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਪਉ  ਪੀਓ ਗਤੁ ਥੀਓ ਭਰਮਾ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: He is absorbed in love of the One Lord; he understands the essence of reality, and heis blessed with wisdom by the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aykai rang tat  kay bayt ay sat gur tay buDh  paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Those whom the Lord and Master blesses with His kindness, compassion and mercyare the sublime and sanctified Saints.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa ma-i-aa kirpaa th aakur kee say-ee sant  subh aa-ee.

lines.english: Associating with them, Nanak is saved; with love and exuberant joy, they sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||7|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (701-12) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin kai sang naanak nist aree-ai jin ras ras har gun gaa-ee. ||2||3||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਸਉ ਵਾ ਕਉ ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is my existence, my breath of life, wealth and beauty.
lines.transliteration: gobind jeevan paraan Dh an roop.

lines.english: The ignorant are totally intoxicated with emotional attachment; in this darkness, the Lord is the only lamp. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: agi-aan moh magan mahaa paraanee anDhi-aaray meh d eep. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਸਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਅਲੇਪਾ  ਨਹ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਉਨ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Beloved God; Your lotus feet areincomparably beautiful!
lines.transliteration: safal darsan t umraa parabh  pareet am charan kamal aanoop.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਤਤ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So many times, I bow in reverence to Him, offering my mind as incense to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik baar kara-o tih band an maneh charHaava-o Dh oop. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਮਇਆ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Exhausted, I have fallen at Your Door, O God; I am holding tight to Your Support.
lines.transliteration: haar pari-o tumHrai parabh  du-aarai d arirhHu kar gahee t umHaaree look.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਸਤਰੀਐ  ਿਜਨ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ  ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
lines.english: Please, lift Your humble servant Nanak up, out of the pit of fire of the world.||2||4||8|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (701-16) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaadh layho naanak apunay ka-o sansaar paavak kay koop. ||2||4||8||

lines.english: If only someone would unite me with the Lord!
lines.transliteration: ko-ee jan har si-o dayvai jor.

lines.english: I hold tight to His feet, and utter sweet words with my tongue; I make my breath oflife an offering to Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: charan gaha-o baka-o subh rasnaa d eejeh paraan akor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਮਹਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਅੰਿਧਆਰੇ  ਮਿਹ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I make my mind and body into pure little gardens, and irrigate them with the sublimeessence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal karat  ki-aaro har sinchai suDh aa sanjor.

lines.english: I am drenched with this sublime essence by His Grace, and the powerful hold of Maya's corruption has been broken. ||1||
lines.transliteration: i-aa ras meh magan hot kirpaa t ay mahaa bikh i-aa tay tor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਆਨੂਪ ॥
lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the suffering of the innocent; I keep my consciousness focused on You. pMnw 702
lines.transliteration: aa-i-o saran d een d ukh bhanjan chit va-o t umHree or.

lines.english: Bless me with the gifts of the state of fearlessness, and meditative remembrance, Lord and Master; O Nanak, God is the Breaker of bonds. ||2||5||9|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (702-2) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: abhai pad  daan simran su-aamee ko parabh  naanak banDh an chh or. ||2||5||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਛੋਿਰ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
lines.english: The rainbird longs for the rain to fall.
lines.transliteration: chaatrik chit vat barsat  mayNh.

lines.english: O God, ocean of mercy, shower Your mercy on me, that I may yearn for lovingdevotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa sinDh karun aa parabh  Dhaarahu har paraym bh agat ko nayNh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The chakvi duck does not desire many comforts, but it is filled with bliss upon seeingthe dawn.
lines.transliteration: anik sookh chakvee nahee chaahat  anad  pooran paykh  dayNh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਸੰਧੁ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕੋ ਨੇਂਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fish cannot survive any other way - without water, it dies. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aan upaav na jeevat meenaa bin jal marnaa t ayNh. ||1||

lines.english: I am a helpless orphan - I seek Your Sanctuary, O My Lord and Master; please bless me with Your mercy.
lines.transliteration: ham anaath naath har sarnee apunee kirpaa karayNh.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਸੂਖ ਚਕਵੀ  ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹਤ  ਅਨਦ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੇਿਖ ਦੇਂਹ ॥
lines.english: Nanak worships and adores the Lord's lotus feet; without Him, there is no other at all.||2||6||10|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (702-5) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak aaraaDh ai tis bin aan na kayNh. ||2||6||10||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ  ਨ ਜੀਵਤ  ਮੀਨਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਨਾ  ਤੇਂਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, my very breath of life, abides in my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: man tan bas rahay mayray paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਨਾਥ  ਨਾਥ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣੀ  ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇਂਹ  ॥
lines.english: Bless me with Your mercy, and unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly, O perfect, all-knowing Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa saaDhoo sang bh aytay pooran purakh  sujaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਰਾਧੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਆਨ  ਨ ਕੇਂਹ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Those, unto whom You give the intoxicating herb of Your Love, drink in the supremesublime essence.
lines.transliteration: paraym thag-uree jin ka-o paa-ee t in ras pee-a-o bh aaree.

lines.english: I cannot describe their value; what power do I have? ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee kud rat kavan hamHaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਬਿਸ ਰਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ॥
lines.english: The Lord attaches His humble servants to the hem of His robe, and they swim acrossthe world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: laa-ay la-ay larh d aas jan apunay uDh ray uDh aaranhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਸੁਜਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, peace is obtained; Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door. ||2||7||11|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (702-9) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh simar simar simar sukh  paa-i-o naanak saran  du-aaray. ||2||7||11||

lines.english: After wandering through so many incarnations, I have come to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay anik janam bharam sarn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ  ਿਤਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਉ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Save me - lift my body up out of the deep, dark pit of the world, and attach me toYour feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: uDhar d ayh anDh  koop t ay laavhu apunee charn ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਵਨ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not know anything about spiritual wisdom, meditation or karma, and my way oflife is not clean and pure.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan kichh  karam na jaanaa naahin nirmal karn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਇ  ਲਏ ਲਿੜ  ਦਾਸ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਉਧਰੇ  ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Please attach me to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly; help me to cross over the terrible river. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai anchal laavhu bikh am nad ee jaa-ay t arnee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਿਣ  ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Comforts, riches and the sweet pleasures of Maya - do not implant these within yourmind.
lines.transliteration: sukh sampat  maa-i-aa ras meeth ay ih nahee man meh Dh arnee.

lines.english: Slave Nanak is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; hisonly ornamentation is the love of the Lord's Name. ||2||8||12|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 ] (702-13) jaitsaree mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har darsan t aripat  naanak d aas paavat  har naam rang aabh arnee. ||2||8||12||

lines.english: O humble servants of the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation within your heart.
lines.transliteration: har jan simrahu hirdai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਉਧਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਚਰਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Misfortune does not even approach the Lord's humble servant; the works of His slave are perfectly fulfilled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jan ka-o apdaa nikat na aavai pooran d aas kay kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Millions of obstacles are removed, by serving the Lord, and one enters into the eternaldwelling of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: kot bighan binsahi har sayvaa nihchal govid  Dhaam.

lines.english: The Lord's devotee is very fortunate; he has absolutely no fear. Even the Messengerof Death pays homage to him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagvant  bhagat ka-o bh a-o kichh  naahee aad ar dayvat  jaam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਅੰਚਿਲ  ਲਾਵਹੁ ਿਬਖਮ  ਨਦੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਤਰਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forsaking the Lord of the world, he does other deeds, but these are temporary andtransitory.
lines.transliteration: taj gopaal aan jo karn ee so-ee so-ee binsat  khaam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਇਹ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਧਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Grasp the Lord's lotus feet, and hold them in your heart, O Nanak; you shall obtainabsolute peace and bliss. ||2||9||13|| jYqsrI mhlw 9  (702-17) jaitsaree mehlaa 9 Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl: One Universal Creator God. <> siqgur pRswid ] (702-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal hirdai gahu naanak sukh  samooh bisraam. ||2||9||13||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਪਾਵਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਆਭਰਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind is deluded, entangled in Maya.
lines.transliteration: bhooli-o man maa-i-aa urjh aa-i-o.

lines.english: Whatever I do, while engaged in greed, only serves to bind me down. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jo karam kee-o laalach lag tih t ih aap banDh aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have no understanding at all; I am engrossed in the pleasures of corruption, and I have forgotten the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: samajh na paree bikh ai ras rachi-o jas har ko bisraa-i-o.

lines.english: The Lord and Master is with me, but I do not know Him. Instead, I run into the forest, looking for Him. ||1|| pMnw 703
lines.transliteration: sang su-aamee so jaani-o naahin ban khojan ka-o Dh aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: The Jewel of the Lord is deep within my heart, but I do not have any knowledge of Him.
lines.transliteration: ratan raam gh at hee kay bh eetar taa ko gi-aan na paa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, without vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, human life isuselessly wasted and lost. ||2||1|| jYqsrI mhlw 9 ] (703-2) jaitsaree mehlaa 9. Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bhagvant  bhajan bin birthaa janam gavaa-i-o. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਭਜਨ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, please, save my honor!
lines.transliteration: har joo raakh layho pat  mayree.

lines.english: The fear of death has entered my heart; I cling to the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Lord, ocean of mercy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jam ko taraas bh a-i-o ur ant ar saran gahee kirpaa niDh  tayree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੂ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਪਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: I am a great sinner, foolish and greedy; but now, at last, I have grown weary ofcommitting sins.
lines.transliteration: mahaa patit  mugaDh  lobhee fun karat  paap ab haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਭਇਓ  ਉਰ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਗਹੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cannot forget the fear of dying; this anxiety is consuming my body. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhai marbay ko bisrat  naahin t ih chint aa tan jaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: I have been trying to liberate myself, running around in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: kee-ay upaav mukat kay kaaran d ah dis ka-o uth  Dhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਪਿਤਤ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਲੋਭੀ ਫੁਿਨ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਪ ਅਬ ਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The pure, immaculate Lord abides deep within my heart, but I do not understand thesecret of His mystery. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghat hee bh eetar basai niranjan t aa ko maram na paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਮਰਬੇ  ਕੋ ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਨਾਿਹਨ  ਿਤਹ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਤਨੁ ਜਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have no merit, and I know nothing about meditation or austerities; what should I donow?
lines.transliteration: naahin gun naahin kachh jap t ap ka-un karam ab keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਏ ਉਪਾਵ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕੇ ਕਾਰਿਨ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਕਉ ਉਿਠ ਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am exhausted; I seek the shelter of Your Sanctuary; O God, please blessme with the gift of fearlessness. ||3||2|| jYqsrI mhlw 9 ] (703-7) jaitsaree mehlaa 9. Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak haar pari-o sarnaagat abh ai daan parabh  deejai. ||3||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਬਸੈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O mind, embrace true contemplation.
lines.transliteration: man ray saachaa gaho bichaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਹਨ  ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਿਹਨ  ਕਛੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ  ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, know that this whole world is false. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mithi-aa maano sagro ih sansaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਾਿਰ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਸਰਨਾਗਿਤ  ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: The Yogis are tired of searching for Him, but they have not found His limit.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o jogee khojat  haaray paa-i-o naahi t ih paaraa.

lines.english: You must understand that the Lord and Master is near at hand, but He has no form orfeature. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so su-aamee tum nikat pachh aano roop raykh  tay ni-aaraa. ||1||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord is purifying in the world, and yet you neverremember it.
lines.transliteration: paavan naam jagat mai har ko kabhoo naahi sambh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਮਾਨੋ ਸਗਰੋ  ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the One, before whom the whole world bowsdown; please, preserve and protect me, by Your innate nature. ||2||3|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 CMq Gru 1  (703-11) jaitsaree mehlaa 5 chh ant ghar 1 Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (703-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok ] (703-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pari-o jag bandan raakh o birad  tuhaaraa. ||2||3||

lines.english: I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, day and night; I yearn forHim constantly, night and day.
lines.transliteration: darsan pi-aasee d inas raat  chitva-o an-d in neet .

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਹਾਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਿਤਹ ਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Opening the door, O Nanak, the Guru has led me to meet with the Lord, my Friend. ||1|| CMq ] (703-13) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: kholiH kapat gur maylee-aa naanak har sang meet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੁਮ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਪਛਾਨੋ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਤੇ ਿਨਆਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listen, O my intimate friend - I have just one prayer to make.
lines.transliteration: sun yaar hamaaray sajan  ik kara-o banant ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਾਿਹ  ਸੰਭਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have been wandering around, searching for that enticing, sweet Beloved.
lines.transliteration: tis mohan laal pi-aaray ha-o fira-o kh ojantee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ ਜਗ ਬੰਦਨ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਤੁਹਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: Whoever leads me to my Beloved - I would cut off my head and offer it to him, even ifI were granted the Blessed Vision of His Darshan for just an instant.
lines.transliteration: tis das pi-aaray sir Dh aree ut aaray ik bh oree d arsan d eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Beloved; without Him, I do not have evena moment's peace.
lines.transliteration: nain hamaaray pari-a rang rangaaray ik til bh ee naa Dh eereejai.

lines.english: My mind is attached to the Lord, like the fish to the water, and the rainbird, thirsty forthe raindrops.
lines.transliteration: parabh si-o man leenaa ji-o jal meenaa chaat rik jivai t isantee-aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru; his thirst is totally quenched. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur pooraa paa-i-aa saglee tikh aa bujh antee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਿਲ ਕਪਟ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O intimate friend, my Beloved has all these loving companions; I cannot compare to any of them.
lines.transliteration: yaar vay pari-a habhay sakh ee-aa moo kahee na jayhee-aa.

lines.english: O intimate friend, each of them is more beautiful than the others; who could consider me?
lines.transliteration: yaar vay hik dooN hik chaarhai ha-o kis chit ayhee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਯਾਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਸਜਣ  ਇਕ ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Each of them is more beautiful than the others; countless are His lovers, constantlyenjoying bliss with Him.
lines.transliteration: hik dooN hik chaarh ay anik pi-aaray nit  karday bh og bilaasaa.

lines.english: Beholding them, desire wells up in my mind; when will I obtain the Lord, the treasureof virtue?
lines.transliteration: tinaa d aykh man chaa-o uth andaa ha-o kad  paa-ee gunt aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਦਿਸ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਸਰੁ ਧਰੀ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਇਕ  ਭੋਰੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind to those who please and attract my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: jinee maidaa laal reejhaa-i-aa ha-o t is aagai man dayNhee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾਰੇ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, hear my prayer, O happy soul-brides; tell me, what does my HusbandLord look like? ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sun bin-o suhaagan  moo d as dikh aa pir kayhee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਜਵੈ ਿਤਸੰਤੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O intimate friend, my Husband Lord does whatever He pleases; He is not dependent on anyone. pMnw 704
lines.transliteration: yaar vay pir aapan bh aanaa kichh  neesee chh andaa.

lines.english: O intimate friend, you have enjoyed your Beloved; please, tell me about Him.
lines.transliteration: yaar vay tai raavi-aa laalan moo d as dasand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਤੈ ਰਾਿਵਆ  ਲਾਲਨੁਮੂ ਦਿਸ ਦਸੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: They alone find their Beloved, who eradicate self-conceit; such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: laalan tai paa-i-aa aap gavaa-i-aa jai Dh an bh aag mathaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਜੈ ਧਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: Taking me by the arm, the Lord and Master has made me His own; He has not considered my merits or demerits.
lines.transliteration: baaNh pakarh th aakur ha-o gh iDhee gun  avgan  na pachh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹ ਪਕਿੜ  ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਹਉ ਿਘਧੀ  ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: She, whom You have adorned with the necklace of virtue, and dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love - everything looks beautiful on her.
lines.transliteration: gun haar t ai paa-i-aa rang laal ban aa-i-aa t is habh o kichh  suhand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਬਣਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਹਭੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੁਹੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, blessed is that happy soul-bride, who dwells with her Husband Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak Dhan suhaagan  saa-ee jis sang bh ataar vasand aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਧੰਿਨ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਸਾਈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਭਤਾਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O intimate friend, I have found that peace which I sought.
lines.transliteration: yaar vay nit sukh  sukh aydee saa mai paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਿਨਤ  ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ  ਸਾ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My sought-after Husband Lord has come home, and now, congratulations are pouringin.
lines.transliteration: var lorheed aa aa-i-aa vajee vaaDh aa-ee.

lines.english: Great joy and happiness welled up, when my Husband Lord, of ever-fresh beauty,showed mercy to me.
lines.transliteration: mahaa mangal rahas thee-aa pir da-i-aal sad  nav rangee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਰਹਸੁ  ਥੀਆ  ਿਪਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਸਦ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found Him; the Guru has united me with Him, throughthe Saadh Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: vad bhaag paa-i-aa gur milaa-i-aa saaDh  kai sat sangee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡ ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸਤਸੰਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: My hopes and desires have all been fulfilled; my Beloved Husband Lord has huggedme close in His embrace.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa sagal pooree pari-a ank ank milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਪੂਰੀ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਅੰਿਕ  ਅੰਕੁ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have found that peace which I sought, meeting with the Guru. ||4||1|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 Gru 2 CMq (704-7) jaitsaree mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 chh ant Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (704-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku ] (704-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sukh  sukh aydee saa mai gur mil paa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ  ਸਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: God is lofty, unapproachable and infinite. He is indescribable - He cannot bedescribed.
lines.transliteration: oochaa agam apaar parabh kathan na jaa-ay akath.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, who is all-powerful to save us. ||1|| CMqu ] (704-9) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee raakh an ka-o samrath. ||1||

lines.english: Save me, any way You can; O Lord God, I am Yours.
lines.transliteration: ji-o jaanhu ti-o raakh  har parabh  tayri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਅਕਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: My demerits are uncountable; how many of them should I count?
lines.transliteration: kaytay gan-o asaNkh avgan  mayri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਰਾਖਨ  ਕਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sins and crimes I committed are countless; day by day, I continually make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: asaNkh avgan  khatay fayray nit parat sad bhoolee-ai.

lines.english: I am intoxicated by emotional attachment to Maya, the treacherous one; by YourGrace alone can I be saved.
lines.transliteration: moh magan bikraal maa-i-aa ta-o parsaadee gh oolee-ai.

lines.english: Secretly, I commit hideous sins of corruption, even though God is the nearest of thenear.
lines.transliteration: look karat bikaar bikh -rhay parabh  nayr hoo t ay nayri-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord, and lift me up, out of the whirlpool ofthe terrifying world-ocean. ||1|| sloku ] (704-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d a-i-aa Dh aarahu kaadh  bhavjal fayri-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸੰਖ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਖਤੇ ਫੇਰੇ ਿਨਤਪਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਦ ਭੂਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Countless are His virtues; they cannot be enumerated. God's Name is lofty andexalted.
lines.transliteration: nirat na pavai asaNkh gun oochaa parabh  kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਿਬਕਰਾਲ  ਮਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ  ਘੂਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's humble prayer, to bless the homeless with a home. ||2|| CMqu ] (704-13) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee banantee-aa milai nithaavay thaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲੂਕ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਿਬਖੜੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: There is no other place at all - where else should I go?
lines.transliteration: doosar naahee th aa-o kaa peh jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਾਿਢ  ਭਵਜਲ  ਫੇਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar kar jorh  so parabh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay so parabh  sadaa apunaa maneh chind i-aa paa-ee-ai. Meditating forever on my God, I receive the fruits of my mind's desires.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਿਤ  ਨ ਪਵੈ ਅਸੰਖ  ਗੁਣ ਊਚਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing pride, attachment, corruption and duality, I lovingly center my attention on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: taj maan moh vikaar d oojaa ayk si-o liv laa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Dedicate your mind and body to God; eradicate all your self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: arap man tan parabh oo aagai aap sagal mitaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your mercy, Lord, that I may be absorbed in Your TrueName. ||2|| sloku ] (704-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak Dh aar kirpaa saach naam samaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਸਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਾਉ  ਕਾ ਪਿਹ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, meditate on the One, who holds everything in His hands.
lines.transliteration: ray man taa ka-o Dh i-aa-ee-ai sabh  biDh jaa kai haath.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, it shall always be with You. ||3|| CMqu ] (704-17) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan sanchee-ai naanak nibhai saath. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਆਇ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: God is our only True Friend; there is not any other.
lines.transliteration: saathee-arhaa parabh  ayk d oosar naahi ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਏਕ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: In the places and interspaces, in the water and on the land, He Himself is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar aap jal thal poor so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਿਪ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਆਗੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਮਟਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He is totally permeating the water, the land and the sky; God is the Great Giver, theLord and Master of all.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poor rahi-aa sarab daat aa parabh  Dhanee.

lines.english: The Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe has no limit; His Glorious Virtues areunlimited - how can I count them?
lines.transliteration: gopaal gobind ant  naahee bay-ant  gun taa kay ki-aa ganee.

lines.english: I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord Master, the Bringer of peace; without Him,there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: bhaj saran  su-aamee sukh ah gaamee t is binaa an naahi ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, that being, unto whom the Lord shows mercy - he alone obtains the Naam. ||3|| pMnw 705 sloku ] (705-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d a-i-aa Dh aarahu t is paraapat  naam ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whatever I wish for, that I receive.
lines.transliteration: chit je chit vi-aa so mai paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak has found total peace. ||4|| CMqu ] (705-2) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay sukh  sabaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: My mind is now emancipated; I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: ab man chhoot ga-i-aa saaDh oo sang milay.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I chant the Naam, and my light has merged into the Light.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam la-i-aa jot ee jot  ralay.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, my sins have been erased; the fire hasbeen extinguished, and I am satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har naam simrat mitay kilbikh  bujhee tapat aghaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਿਟ ਗਇਆ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲੇ ॥
lines.english: He has taken me by the arm, and blessed me with His kind mercy; He has acceptedme His own.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa leenay d a-i-aa keenay aapnay kar maani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਰਲੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord has hugged me in His embrace, and merged me with Himself; the pains ofbirth and death have been burnt away.
lines.transliteration: lai ank laa-ay har milaa-ay janam marnaa d ukh jalay.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, He has blessed me with His kind  mercy; in an instant, He unites me with Himself. ||4||2|| jYqsrI CMq mÚ 5 ] (705-5) jaitsaree chh ant mehlaa 5. Jaitsree, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d a-i-aa Dh aaree mayl leenay ik palay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ  ਦਇਆ ਕੀਨੇ  ਆਪਨੇ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: The world is like a temporary way-station, but it is filled with pride.
lines.transliteration: paaDhaan oo sansaar gaarab ati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਲਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
lines.english: People commit countless sins; they are dyed in the color of the love of Maya.
lines.transliteration: kartay paap anayk maa-i-aa rang rati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੀਨੇ  ਇਕ ਪਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: In greed, emotional attachment and egotism, they are drowning; they do not even think of dying.
lines.transliteration: lobh mohi abh imaan booday maran  cheet  na aav-ay.

lines.english: Children, friends, worldly occupations and spouses - they talk of these things, whiletheir lives are passing away.
lines.transliteration: putar mit ar bi-uhaar banit aa ayh karat  bihaava-ay.

lines.english: When their pre-ordained days have run their course, O mother, they behold theMessengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and they suffer.
lines.transliteration: puj divas aa-ay likh ay maa-ay d ukh Dharam d ootah dith i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਰਿਟਆ  ॥
lines.english: The karma of their past deeds cannot be erased, O Nanak, if they have not earned thewealth of the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirat karam na mitai naanak har naam Dh an nahee kh ati-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਿਭ ਮੋਿਹ ਅਿਭਮਾਿਨ  ਬੂਡੇ ਮਰਣੁ  ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: He makes all sorts of efforts, but he does not sing the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: udam karahi anayk har naam na gaavhee.

lines.english: He wanders around in countless incarnations; he dies, only to be born again.
lines.transliteration: bharmeh jon asaNkh mar janmeh aavhee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਿਜ ਿਦਵਸ  ਆਏ  ਿਲਖੇ ਮਾਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧਰਮ  ਦੂਤਹ  ਿਡਿਠਆ  ॥
lines.english: As beasts, birds, stones and trees - their number cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: pasoo pankhee sail t arvar gan at kachh oo na aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਤ  ਕਰਮ  ਨ ਿਮਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਖਿਟਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As are the seeds he plants, so are the pleasures he enjoys; he receives the consequences of his own actions.
lines.transliteration: beej bovas bhog bh ogeh kee-aa apn aa paav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: He loses the jewel of this human life in the gamble, and God is not pleased with himat all.
lines.transliteration: ratan janam harant  joo-ai parabh oo aap na bh aavhee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮਿਹ  ਜੋਿਨ ਅਸੰਖ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਆਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, wandering in doubt, he does not find any rest, even for an instant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak bh armeh bh armaa-ay kh in ayk tikan  na paavhee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੈਲ ਤਰਵਰ  ਗਣਤ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Youth has passed, and old age has taken its place.
lines.transliteration: joban ga-i-aa biteet  jar mal baith ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਵਿਸ  ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਿਹ ਕੀਆ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਪਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The hands tremble, the head shakes, and the eyes do not see.
lines.transliteration: kar kampeh sir dol nain na deeth i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹਾਰੰਤ  ਜੂਐ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਭਾਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The eyes do not see, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord; he must leavebehind the attractions of Maya, and depart.
lines.transliteration: nah nain d eesai bin bh ajan eesai chh od maa-i-aa chaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰਮਿਹ  ਭਰ੍ਮਾਏ ਿਖਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਿਟਕਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He burnt his mind and body for his relatives, but now, they do not listen to him, andthey throw dust on his head.
lines.transliteration: kahi-aa na maaneh sir khaak chh aaneh jin sang man t an jaali-aa.

lines.english: Love for the infinite, Perfect Lord does not abide in his mind, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: sareeraam rang apaar pooran nah nimakh man meh vooth i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਕੰਪਿਹ  ਿਸਰੁ ਡੋਲ ਨੈਣ ਨ ਡੀਿਠਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the fort of paper is false - it is destroyed in an instant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak kot kaagar binas baar na jh oothi-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਨੈਣ ਦੀਸੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਜਨ  ਈਸੈ ਛੋਿਡ ਮਾਇਆ  ਚਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sarnaa-ay naanak aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਆ  ਨ ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself has carried Him across the impassable, terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: dutar bhai sansaar parabh  aap t araa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀਰਾਮ  ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਨਹ ਿਨਮਖ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਵੂਿਠਆ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I vibrate and meditate on the Lord; God has made me His own, and saved me.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangay bh ajay sareeDh ar kar ang parabh  jee taari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋਿਟ ਕਾਗਰ  ਿਬਨਸ  ਬਾਰ ਨ ਝੂਿਠਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord has approved of me, and blessed me with His Name; He did not takeanything else into consideration.
lines.transliteration: har maan lee-ay naam dee-ay avar kachh  na beechaari-aa.

lines.english: I have found the infinite Lord and Master, the treasure of virtue, which my mind hadyearned for.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan apaar th aakur man lorh eedaa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am satisfied forever; I have eaten the food of the Lord's Name.||4||2||3|| jYqsrI mhlw 5 vwr slokw nwil  (705-18) jaitsaree mehlaa 5 vaar salokaa naaial Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Vaar With Shaloks: <> siqgur pRswid ] (705-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok ] (705-19) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sad aa tariptai har naam bh ojan kh aa-i-aa. ||4||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ  ਭਜੇ ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਕਿਰ ਅੰਗੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਤਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the beginning, He was pervading; in the middle, He is pervading; in the end, He will be pervading. He is the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: aad pooran maDh  pooran ant  pooran parmaysureh.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮਾਿਨ  ਲੀਏ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints remember in meditation the all-pervading Lord God. O Nanak, He is the Destroyer of sins, the Lord of the universe. ||1|| pMnw 706
lines.transliteration: simrant sant  sarbat ar ramn aN naanak agh naasan jagd eesureh. ||1||

lines.english: See, hear, speak and implant the True Lord within your mind.
lines.transliteration: paykhan sunan sunaavano man meh d arirh-ee-ai saach.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਖਨ  ਸੁਨਨ  ਸੁਨਾਵਨੋ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੀਐ  ਸਾਚੁ ॥
lines.english: He is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; O Nanak, be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||2|| pauVI ] (706-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-o sarbatar mai naanak har rang raach. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਚੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Sing the Praise of the One, the Immaculate Lord; He is contained within all.
lines.transliteration: har ayk niranjan gaa-ee-ai sabh ant ar so-ee.

lines.english: The Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord God; whatever He wills, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath parabh  jo karay so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; without Him, there is no other.
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapad aa tis bin nahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He pervades the continents, solar systems, nether worlds, islands and all worlds.
lines.transliteration: khand barahmand paat aal deep ravi-aa sabh  lo-ee.

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself instructs; he alone is a pure and unstained being. ||1|| slok ] (706-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaa-ay so bujh see nirmal jan so-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਪਾਤਾਲ  ਦੀਪ ਰਿਵਆ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Creating the soul, the Lord places this creation in the womb of the mother.
lines.transliteration: rachant jee-a rachnaa maat  garabh  asthaapnaN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, it meditates in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak; it isnot consumed by the great fire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saas saas simrant naanak mahaa agan na binaasnaN. ||1||

lines.english: With its head down, and feet up, it dwells in that slimy place.
lines.transliteration: mukh t alai pair upray vasand o kuhtharh ai thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਚੰਿਤ  ਜੀਅ  ਰਚਨਾ  ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ  ਅਸਥਾਪਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, how could we forget the Master? Through His Name, we are saved. ||2|| pauVI ] (706-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak so Dhan ee ki-o visaar-i-o uDh rahi jis d ai naa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਸਮਰੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਹਾ ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਿਬਨਾਸਨੰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From egg and sperm, you were conceived, and placed in the fire of the womb.
lines.transliteration: rakat bind  kar nimmi-aa agan ud ar majh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖੁ ਤਲੈ ਪੈਰ ਉਪਰੇ ਵਸੰਦੋ  ਕੁਹਥੜੈ  ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Head downwards, you abided restlessly in that dark, dismal, terrible hell.
lines.transliteration: uraDh mukh  kucheel bikal narak gh or gubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਿਕਉ  ਿਵਸਾਿਰਓ  ਉਧਰਿਹ  ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you were not burnt; enshrine Him in your heart, mind and body.
lines.transliteration: har simrat t oo naa jaleh man t an ur Dh aar.

lines.english: In that treacherous place, He protected and preserved you; do not forget Him, evenfor an instant.
lines.transliteration: bikham thaanahu jin rakh i-aa tis til na visaar.

lines.english: Forgetting God, you shall never find peace; you shall forfeit your life, and depart. ||2|| slok ] (706-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: parabh bisrat  sukh  kaday naahi jaaseh janam haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਧ  ਮੁਖੁ ਕੁਚੀਲ  ਿਬਕਲੁ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਘੋਿਰ  ਗੁਬਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He grants our hearts' desires, and fulfills all our hopes.
lines.transliteration: man ichhaa d aan karn aN sarbat ar aasaa poornah.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਜਲਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He destroys pain and suffering; remember God in meditation, O Nanak - He is not faraway. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khaNdnaN kal kalayseh parabh  simar naanak nah poorn ah. ||1||

lines.english: Love Him, with whom you enjoy all pleasures.
lines.transliteration: habh rang maan eh jis sang t ai si-o laa-ee-ai nayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਸਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ਜਾਸਿਹ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Do not forget that Lord, even for an instant; O Nanak, He fashioned this beautifulbody. ||2|| pauVI ] (706-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: so saho bind na visra-o naanak jin sund ar rachi-aa d ayh. ||2||

lines.english: He gave you your soul, breath of life, body and wealth; He gave you pleasures to enjoy.
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan tan Dh an dee-aa d eenay ras bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਇਛਾ  ਦਾਨ  ਕਰਣੰ  ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਆਸਾ  ਪੂਰਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: He gave you households, mansions, chariots and horses; He ordained your gooddestiny.
lines.transliteration: garih mandar rath as d ee-ay rach bh alay sanjog.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡਣੰ ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਹ ਦੂਰਣਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He gave you your children, spouse, friends and servants; God is the all-powerful GreatGiver.
lines.transliteration: sut banit aa saajan sayvak d ee-ay parabh  dayvan jog.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੈ ਿਸਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the body and mind are rejuvenated, andsorrow departs.
lines.transliteration: har simrat t an man hari-aa leh jaahi vijog.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਿਬੰਦ ਨ ਿਵਸਰਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਰਿਚਆ  ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Praises of the Lord, and allyour sickness shall vanish. ||3|| slok ] (706-14) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har gun  ramhu binsay sabh  rog. ||3||

lines.english: For his family, he works very hard; for the sake of Maya, he makes countless efforts.
lines.transliteration: kutamb jatan karn aN maa-i-aa anayk ud mah.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਦੀਨੇ  ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.english: But without loving devotional worship of the Lord, O Nanak, he forgets God, and then, he is a mere ghost. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  bhaav heen aN naanak parabh  bisrat  tay parayt ah. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਮੰਦਰ  ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਦੀਏ ਰਿਚ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: That love shall break, which is established with any other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tutrhee-aa saa pareet  jo laa-ee bi-ann si-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਦੀਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੇਵਨ  ਜੋਗ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that way of life is true, which inspires love of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (706-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachee reet saaN-ee sayt ee rat i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਲਿਹ ਜਾਿਹ  ਿਵਜੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: Forgetting Him, one's body turns to dust, and everyone calls him a ghost.
lines.transliteration: jis bisrat t an bh asam ho-ay kaht ay sabh  parayt .

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਹੁ ਿਬਨਸੇ ਸਿਭ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
lines.english: And those, with whom he was so much in love - they do not let him stay in theirhome, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: khin garih meh basan na d ayvhee jin si-o so-ee hayt .

lines.english: Practicing exploitation, he gathers wealth, but what use will it be in the end?
lines.transliteration: kar anrath darab sanchi-aa so kaaraj kayt .

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਰਣੰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਉਦਮਹ  ॥
lines.english: As one plants, so does he harvest; the body is the field of actions.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejai so lunai karam ih kh ayt.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਵ ਹੀਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਤੇ ਪਰ੍ੇਤਤਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The ungrateful wretches forget the Lord, and wander in reincarnation. ||4|| slok ] (706-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: akirat-gh anaa har visri-aa jonee bh armayt . ||4||

lines.english: The benefits of millions of charitable donations and cleansing baths, and countlessceremonies of purification and piety,
lines.transliteration: kot daan isnaanaN anik soDh an pavit artah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੀ ਰੀਿਤ  ਸਈ  ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਤਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with one's tongue;all sins are washed away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: uchrant naanak har har rasnaa sarab paap bimucht ay. ||1||

lines.english: I gathered together a great stack of firewood, and applied a tiny flame to light it. pMnw 707
lines.transliteration: eeDhan  keetomoo gh anaa bh oree d iteem bh aahi.

lines.english: When the True Lord and Master abides in one's mind, O Nanak, all sins are dispelled. ||2|| pauVI ] (707-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: man vasand-rh o sach saho naanak habh ay dukh -rhay ulaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਵਸੰਦੜੋ  ਸਚੁ ਸਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖੜੇ ਉਲਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Millions of sins are totally erased, by meditating on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: kot aghaa sabh  naas hohi simrat  har naa-o.

lines.english: The fruits of one's heart's desires are obtained, by singing the Glorious Praises of theLord.
lines.transliteration: man chinday fal paa-ee-ah har kay gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਅਘਾ  ਸਿਭ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਿਹ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The fear of birth and death is eradicated, and one's eternal, unchanging true home is obtained.
lines.transliteration: janam maran bh ai katee-ah nihchal sach thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਦੇ  ਫਲ ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: If it is so pre-ordained, one is absorbed in the Lord's lotus feet.
lines.transliteration: poorab hovai likhi-aa har charan  samaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭੈ ਕਟੀਅਿਹ  ਿਨਹਚਲ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Bless me with Your mercy, God - please preserve and save me! Nanak is a sacrifice toYou. ||5|| slok ] (707-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh raakh  layho naanak bal jaa-o. ||5||

lines.english: They are involved in their beautiful houses, and the pleasures of the mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: garih rachnaa apaaraN man bilaas su-aadaN rasah.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
lines.english: They never remember the Lord in meditation; O Nanak, they are like maggots inmanure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kadaaNch nah simrant  naanak t ay jant  bistaa kirmeh. ||1||

lines.english: They are engrossed in ostentatious displays, lovingly attached to all their possessions.
lines.transliteration: much adambar habh kihu manjh  muhabat  nayh.

lines.english: That body which forgets the Lord, O Nanak, shall be reduced to ashes. ||2|| pauVI ] (707-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: so saaN-ee jaiN visrai naanak so tan kh ayh. ||2||

lines.english: He may enjoy a beautiful bed, countless pleasures and all sorts of enjoyments.
lines.transliteration: sundar sayj anayk sukh  ras bh ogan pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਚੁ ਅਡੰਬਰੁ ਹਭੁ ਿਕਹੁ ਮੰਿਝ ਮੁਹਬਿਤ  ਨੇਹ ॥
lines.english: He may possess mansions of gold, studded with pearls and rubies, plastered with fragrant sandalwood oil.
lines.transliteration: garih so-in chandan suganDh  laa-ay mot ee heeray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਈ  ਜੈਂ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He may relish in the pleasures of his mind's desires, and have no anxiety at all.
lines.transliteration: man ichhay sukh  maand aa kichh  naahi visooray.

lines.english: But if he does not remember God, he is like a maggot in manure.
lines.transliteration: so parabh chit  na aavee vistaa kay keeray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਸੇਜ ਅਨੇਕ  ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all. How can the mind be comforted?||6|| slok ] (707-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na saaNt ho-ay kit  biDh man Dh eeray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਸੋਇਨ  ਚੰਦਨ  ਸੁਗੰਧ  ਲਾਇ  ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰੇ ॥
lines.english: One who loves the Lord's lotus feet searches for Him in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal birahaN khojant  bairaagee d ah disah.

lines.english: He renounces the deceptive illusion of Maya, and joins the blissful form of the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ti-aagant  kapat roop maa-i-aa naanak aanand  roop saaDh  sangmah. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਕੇ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is in my mind, and with my mouth I chant His Name; I seek Him in all thelands of the world.
lines.transliteration: man saaN-ee mukh uchraa vat aa habh ay lo-a.
