lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, all ostentatious displays are false; hearing the Praises of the True Lord, I live. ||2|| pauVI ] (707-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak habh adambar koorh i-aa sun  jeevaa sachee so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He dwells in a broken-down shack, in tattered clothes,
lines.transliteration: bastaa t ootee jh umprh ee cheer sabh  chhinnaa.
jaat na pat  na aad ro udi-aan bh arminnaa. with no social status, no honor and no respect; he wanders in the wilderness,

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਗੰਤ ਕਪਟ  ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mitar na ith  Dhan roopheen  kichh  saak na sinnaa. with no friend or lover, without we alth, beauty, relatives or relations.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਸਈ  ਮੁਿਖ ਉਚਰਾ  ਵਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
lines.english: Even so, he is the king of the whole world, if his mind is imbued with the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raajaa saglee sarisat kaa har naam man bhinnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਭ ਅਡੰਬਰ  ਕੂਿੜਆ  ਸੁਿਣ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: With the dust of his feet, men are redeemed, because God is very pleased with him.||7|| slok ] (707-12) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: tis kee Dh oorh man uDh rai parabh  ho-ay suparsannaa. ||7||

lines.english: The various sorts of pleasures, powers, joys, beauty, canopies, cooling fans andthrones to sit on
lines.transliteration: anik leelaa raaj ras roopaN chhat ar chamar t akhat aasnaN.

lines.english: Maya is just a dream. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rachant moorh  agi-aan anDh ah naanak supan manorath maa-i-aa. ||1|| - the foolish, ignorant and blind are engrossed in these things. O Nanak, desire for

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਪਿਤ ਨ ਆਦਰੋ  ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮੰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: In a dream, he enjoys all sorts of pleasures, and emotional attachment seems sosweet.
lines.transliteration: supnai habh rang maan i-aa mith aa lagrh aa moh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਨ ਇਠ ਧਨ ਰੂਪਹੀਣ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਿਸੰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the beauty of Maya's illusion isfake. ||2|| pauVI ] (707-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihoonee-aa sund ar maa-i-aa Dh aroh. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਲੀ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਿਭੰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The fool attaches his consciousness to the dream.
lines.transliteration: supnay saytee chit  moorakh  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਿੜ ਮਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: When he awakes, he forgets the power, pleasures and enjoyments, and he is sad.
lines.transliteration: bisray raaj ras bhog jaagat  bhakhlaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He passes his life chasing after worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: aarjaa ga-ee vihaa-ay DhanDh ai Dhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਲੀਲਾ  ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਰੂਪੰ ਛਤਰ੍ ਚਮਰ  ਤਖਤ  ਆਸਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: His works are not completed, because he is enticed by Maya.
lines.transliteration: pooran bha-ay na kaam mohi-aa maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਚੰਿਤ  ਮੂੜ ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਧਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can the poor helpless creature do? The Lord Himself has deluded him. ||8|| slok ] (707-17) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: ki-aa vaychaaraa jant jaa aap bh ulaa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਹਿਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਿਣਆ  ਿਮਠਾ  ਲਗੜਾ  ਮੋਹੁ ॥
lines.english: They may live in heavenly realms, and conquer the nine regions of the world,
lines.transliteration: basant savarag lokah jitt ay parithvee nav kh andnah.
bisrant har gopaalah naanak t ay paraan ee ud i-aan bh aramn eh. ||1|| but if they forget the Lord of the world, O Nanak, they are just wanderers in thewilderness. ||1||

lines.english: In the midst of millions of games and entertainments, the Lord's Name does not cometo their minds.
lines.transliteration: ka-utak kod t amaasi-aa chit  na aavas naa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, their home is like a wilderness, in the depths of hell. ||2|| pauVI ] (707-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak korhee narak baraabaray ujarh  so-ee thaa-o. ||2||

lines.english: He sees the terrible, awful wilderness as a city.
lines.transliteration: mahaa bha-i-aan ud i-aan nagar kar maani-aa.

lines.english: Gazing upon the false objects, he believes them to be real. pMnw 708
lines.transliteration: jhooth  samagree paykh  sach kar jaani-aa.

lines.english: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he wanders around insane.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar fireh d ayvaani-aa.

lines.english: When the Messenger of Death hits him on the head with his club, then he regrets and repents.
lines.transliteration: sir lagaa jam dand taa pachh utaani-aa.

lines.english: Without the Perfect, Divine Guru, he roams around like Satan. ||9|| slok ] (708-2) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: bin pooray gurdayv firai sait aani-aa. ||9||

lines.english: Power is fraudulent, beauty is fraudulent, and wealth is fraudulent, as is pride of ancestry.
lines.transliteration: raaj kaptaN roop kaptaN Dhan kaptaN kul garabt eh.

lines.english: One may gather poison through deception and fraud, O Nanak, but without the Lord,nothing shall go along with him in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saNchant bikh i-aa chh alaN chhidaraN naanak bin har sang na chaalt ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਕਪਟੰ  ਰੂਪ ਕਪਟੰ  ਧਨ ਕਪਟੰ  ਕੁਲ ਗਰਬਤਹ  ॥
lines.english: Beholding the bitter melon, he is deceived, since it appears so pretty
lines.transliteration: paykhand -rho kee bh ul tummaa d isam sohn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਚੰਿਤ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਛਲੰ ਿਛਦਰ੍ੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਲਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But it is not worth even a shell, O Nanak; the riches of Maya will not go along withanyone. ||2|| pauVI ] (708-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: adh na lahand -rho mul naanak saath na jul-ee maa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: It shall not go along with you when you depart - why do you bother to collect it?
lines.transliteration: chaldi-aa naal na chalai so ki-o sanjee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੜੋ  ਮੁਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਜੁਲਈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Tell me, why do you try so hard to acquire that which you must leave behind in the end?
lines.transliteration: tis kaa kaho ki-aa jat an jis t ay vanjee-ai.

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, how can you be satisfied? Your mind cannot be pleased.
lines.transliteration: har bisri-ai ki-o taript aavai naa man ranjee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਸੰਜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who forsakes God, and attaches himself to another, shall be immersed in hell.
lines.transliteration: parabhoo chh od an laagai narak samanjee-ai.

lines.english: Be kind and compassionate to Nanak, O Lord, and dispel his fear. ||10|| slok ] (708-7) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal da-i-aal naanak bh a-o bh anjee-ai. ||10||

lines.english: Princely pleasures are not sweet; sensual enjoyments are not sweet; the pleasures ofMaya are not sweet.
lines.transliteration: nach raaj sukh mistaN nach bh og ras mistaN nach mistaN sukh  maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਛੋਿਡ ਅਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਸਮੰਜੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is sweet, O slave Nanak; the BlessedVision of God's Darshan is sweet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mistaN saaDhsang har naanak d aas mistaN parabh  darsanaN. ||1||

lines.english: I have enshrined that love which drenches my soul.
lines.transliteration: lagrhaa so nayhu man majh aahoo rat i-aa.

lines.english: I have been pierced by the Truth, O Nanak; the Master seems so sweet to me. ||2|| pauVI ] (708-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: viDh-rh o sach thok naanak mith -rhaa so Dh anee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਚ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਿਮਸਟੰ  ਨਚ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਿਮਸਟੰ  ਨਚ ਿਮਸਟੰ  ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing seems sweet to His devotees, except the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bin kachhoo na laag-ee bh agtan ka-o meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਸਟੰ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਿਮਸਟੰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸਨੰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All other tastes are bland and insipid; I have tested them and seen them.
lines.transliteration: aan su-aad sabh  feeki-aa kar nirna-o deeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਗੜਾ  ਸੋ ਨੇਹੁ ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਰਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: Ignorance, doubt and suffering are dispelled, when the Guru becomes one's advocate.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan bharam d ukh kati-aa gur bh a-ay baseeth aa.

lines.english: The Lord's lotus feet have pierced my mind, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man bayDhi-aa ji-o rang majeeth aa.

lines.english: My soul, breath of life, body and mind belong to God; all falsehood has left me. ||11|| slok ] (708-11) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan t an man parabh oo binsay sabh  jhoothaa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Leaving the water, the fish cannot live; the rainbird cannot live without the raindropsfrom the clouds.
lines.transliteration: ti-akat  jalaN nah jeev meenaN nah t i-aag chaat rik maygh  mandlah.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਸੁਆਦ  ਸਿਭ ਫੀਿਕਆ  ਕਿਰ ਿਨਰਨਉ  ਡੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: The deer is enticed by the sound of the hunter's bell, and shot through with thearrow; the bumble bee is entangled in the fragrance of the flowers.
lines.transliteration: baan bayDh anch kurank naad aN al banDh an kusam baasnah.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints are entranced by the Lord's lotus feet; O Nanak, they desire nothing else. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal rachant sant eh naanak aan na rucht ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ ਿਜਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Show me Your face, for even an instant, Lord, and I will not give my consciousness toany other.
lines.transliteration: mukh daykh aa-oo palak chh ad aan na day-oo chit .

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸਿਭ ਝੂਠਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: My life is with the Lord Master, O Nanak, the Friend of the Saints. ||2|| pauVI ] (708-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jeevan sangam t is Dhanee har naanak jant aaN mit. ||2||

lines.english: How can the fish live without water?
lines.transliteration: ji-o machhulee bin paan ee-ai ki-o jeevan  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਅਕਤ  ਜਲੰ ਨਹ ਜੀਵ ਮੀਨੰ ਨਹ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਮੇਘ ਮੰਡਲਹ  ॥
lines.english: Without the raindrops, how can the rainbird be satisfied?
lines.transliteration: boond vihoon aa chaat riko ki-o kar t ariptaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣ  ਬੇਧੰਚ  ਕੁਰੰਕ  ਨਾਦੰ  ਅਿਲ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕੁਸਮ  ਬਾਸਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: The deer, entranced by the sound of the hunter's bell, runs straight to him;
lines.transliteration: naad kuraNkeh bayDh i-aa sanmukh  uth Dhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ  ਰਚੰਿਤ  ਸੰਤਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਰੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhavar lobh ee kusam baas kaa mil aap banDh aavai. the bumble bee is greedy for the flower's fragrance; finding it, he traps himself in it.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖੁ ਡੇਖਾਊ  ਪਲਕ  ਛਿਡ ਆਨ  ਨ ਡੇਊ ਿਚਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: Just so, the humble Saints love the Lord; beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan,they are satisfied and satiated. ||12|| slok ] (708-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: ti-o sant  janaa har pareet  hai d aykh daras agh aavai. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਣ ਸੰਗਮੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਿਮਤੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They contemplate the Lord's lotus feet; they worship and adore Him with each andevery breath.
lines.transliteration: chitvant  charan kamlaN saas saas araaDh neh.

lines.english: They do not forget the Name of the imperishable Lord; O Nanak, the TranscendentLord fulfills their hopes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nah bisrant naam achut  naanak aas pooran parmaysureh. ||1||

lines.english: He is woven into the fabric of my mind; He is not outside of it, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: seet-rh aa man manjh aahi palak na theevai baahraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord and Master fulfills my hopes, and always watches over me.||2|| pauVI ] (708-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak aasrhee nibaahi sad aa paykh ando sach Dh anee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਦ  ਕੁਰੰਕਿਹ  ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਸਨਮੁਖ  ਉਿਠ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: My hopes rest in You, O Lord of the universe; please, fulfill them.
lines.transliteration: aasaavantee aas gusaa-ee pooree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਕਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਆਪੁ  ਬੰਧਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe, I shall never grieve.
lines.transliteration: mil gopaal gobind na kabhoo jh ooree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸੁ  ਅਘਾਵੈ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the desire of my mind, and my worries shall be over. pMnw 709
lines.transliteration: dayh d aras man chaa-o leh jaahi visooree-ai.

lines.english: By body is sanctified, by the dust of Your feet.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay pavitar sareer charnaa Dh ooree-ai.

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, Divine Guru, You are always with me, ever-present. ||13|| slok ] (709-1) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm gurdayv sad aa hajooree-ai. ||13||

lines.english: With my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name; with my ears, I listen to the AmbrosialWord of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa uchrant naamaN sarvan aN sunant  sabad  amrit ah.

lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin sad  balihaaraN jinaa Dh i-aan paarbrahman eh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਉਚਰੰਿਤ  ਨਾਮੰ ਸਰ੍ਵਣੰ  ਸੁਨੰਿਤ  ਸਬਦ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤਹ  ॥
lines.english: All concerns are false, except those of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: habh koorh aavay kamm ikas saa-ee baahray.

lines.english: O Nanak, blessed are those, who are in love with their True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (709-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak say-ee Dhan jinaa pirharh ee sach si-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਭ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ  ਕੰਮ ਇਕਸੁ  ਸਾਈ  ਬਾਹਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who listen to the sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaree t inaa je sunt ay har kathaa.

lines.english: Those who bow their heads before God are perfect and distinguished.
lines.transliteration: pooray tay parDh aan nivaaveh parabh  mathaa.

lines.english: Those hands, which write the Praises of the infinite Lord are beautiful.
lines.transliteration: har jas likheh bay-ant  soheh say hathaa.

lines.english: Those feet which walk on God's Path are pure and holy.
lines.transliteration: charan puneet pavit ar chaaleh parabh  pathaa.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, they are emancipated; all their sorrows depart. ||14|| sloku ] (709-6) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: jantaaN sang uDh aar saglaa d ukh lathaa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਿਲਖਿਹ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਸੇ ਹਥਾ ॥
lines.english: One's destiny is activated, when one chants the Lord's Name, through perfect goodfortune.
lines.transliteration: bhaavee ud ot karnaN har ramn aN sanjog poornah.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਚਾਲਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਥਾ ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is that moment, O Nanak, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Darshanof the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gopaal daras bh aytaN safal naanak so mahoort eh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Its value cannot be estimated; it brings peace beyond measure.
lines.transliteration: keem na sakaa paa-ay sukh mit ee hoo baahray.

lines.english: O Nanak, that time alone is approved, when my Beloved meets with me. ||2|| pauVI ] (709-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak saa vaylrhee parvaan  jit miland -rho maa piree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵੀ  ਉਦੋਤ  ਕਰਣੰ  ਹਿਰ ਰਮਣੰ  ਸੰਜੋਗ  ਪੂਰਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me, what is that time, when I shall find God?
lines.transliteration: saa vaylaa kaho ka-un hai jit  parabh  ka-o paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਦਰਸ  ਭੇਟੰ ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਮਹੂਰਤਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Blessed and auspicious is that moment, and that destiny, when I shall find the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: so moorat bh alaa sanjog hai jit  milai gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਪਾਇ  ਸੁਖ ਿਮਤੀ  ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, my mind's desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har Dh i-aa-ay kai man ichh  pujaa-ee.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the Society of the Saints; I bow and touch theirfeet.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag sat sang ho-ay niv laagaa paa-ee.

lines.english: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; Nanak is a sacrifice toHim. ||15|| slok ] (709-10) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: man darsan kee pi-aas hai naanak bal jaa-ee. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ  ਕਹੁ ਕਉਣੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Dispeller of all distress.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  gobind ah sarab d okh nivaarn eh.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God is Mighty, giving His Protective Sanctuary; Nanak chants the Name ofthe Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saran soor bh agvaaneh japant  naanak har har haray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ਕੈ ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing all self-conceit, I hold tight to the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: chhadi-o habh  aap lagrh o charn aa paas.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਤਸੰਗੁ  ਹੋਇ ਿਨਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My sorrows and troubles have departed, O Nanak, beholding God. ||2|| pauVI ] (709-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: nath-rh o dukh taap naanak parabh  paykh andi-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਿਪਆਸ  ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Unite with me, O Merciful Lord; I have fallen at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: mayl laihu da-i-aal dh eh pa-ay d u-aari-aa.

lines.english: O Merciful to the meek, save me. I have wandered enough; now I am tired.
lines.transliteration: rakh layvhu d een d a-i-aal bh armat  baho haari-aa.

lines.english: It is Your very nature to love Your devotees, and save sinners.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al tayraa birad  har pat it uDhaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੂਰ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ  ਜਪੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all; I offer this prayer to You.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin naahee ko-ay bin-o mohi saari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਛਿਡਓ  ਹਭੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਗੜੋ  ਚਰਣਾ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Take me by the hand, O Merciful Lord, and carry me across the world-ocean. ||16|| slok ] (709-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: kar geh layho da-i-aal saagar sansaari-aa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਨਠੜੋ  ਦੁਖ ਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੇਖੰਿਦਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord is the Savior of the Saints; their only support is to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: sant uDh ran da-i-aalaN aasraN gopaal keerat neh.

lines.english: One becomes immaculate and pure, by associating with the Saints, O Nanak, andtaking the Protection of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nirmalaN sant sangayn  ot naanak parmaysureh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਢਿਹ ਪਏ ਦੁਆਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The burning of the heart is not dispelled at all, by sandalwood paste, the moon, or thecold season.
lines.transliteration: chandan chand  na sarad  rut mool na mit-ee gh aaNm.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਬਹੁ ਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: It only becomes cool, O Nanak, by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (709-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: seetal theevai naankaa japand -rho har naam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਤਤ ਉਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Protection and Support of the Lord's lotus feet, all beings are saved.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kee ot uDhray sagal jan.

lines.english: Hearing of the Glory of the Lord of the Universe, the mind becomes fearless.
lines.transliteration: sun part aap govind  nirbh a-o bh a-ay man.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰਆ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Nothing at all is lacking, when one gathers the wealth of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai mool sanchi-aa naam Dh an.

lines.english: The Society of the Saints is obtained, by very good deeds.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa si-o sang paa-ee-ai vadai pun.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਉਧਰਣ  ਦਇਆਲੰ  ਆਸਰੰ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਕੀਰਤਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Lord, and listen continually to the Lord's Praises. ||17|| slok ] (709-19) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har Dh i-aa-ay har jas nit  sun. ||17||

lines.english: The Lord grants His Grace, and dispels the pains of those who sing the Kirtan of thePraises of His Name.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karn aN dukh harnaN ucharn aN naam keerat neh.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨ  ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸਰਦ  ਰੁਿਤ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਘਮ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord God shows His Kindness, O Nanak, one is no longer engrossed in Maya. ||1|| pMnw 710
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal purakh  bhagvaaneh naanak lipat  na maa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The burning fire has been put out; God Himself has saved me.
lines.transliteration: bhaahi baland -rhee bujh  ga-ee rakh and-rho parabh  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਿਹ  ਬਲੰਦੜੀ  ਬੁਿਝ ਗਈ ਰਖੰਦੜੋ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on that God, O Nanak, who created the universe. ||2|| pauVI ] (710-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jin upaa-ee maydnee naanak so parabh  jaap. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ ਉਪਾਈ  ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When God becomes merciful, Maya does not cling.
lines.transliteration: jaa parabh bh a-ay d a-i-aal na bi-aapai maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Millions of sins are eliminated, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot aghaa ga-ay naas har ik Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ  ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The body is made immaculate and pure, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servants.
lines.transliteration: nirmal bha-ay sareer jan Dh ooree naa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਅਘਾ  ਗਏ ਨਾਸ ਹਿਰ ਇਕੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mind and body become contented, finding the Perfect Lord God.
lines.transliteration: man tan bh a-ay sant okh pooran parabh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: One is saved, along with his family, and all his ancestors. ||18|| slok ] (710-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: taray kutamb sang log kul sabaa-i-aa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Lord of the Universe; the Guru is the Lord of the world; the Guru isthe Perfect Pervading Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gur gobind gopaal gur gur pooran naaraa-in eh.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਲੋਗ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The Guru is compassionate; the Guru is all-powerful; the Guru, O Nanak, is the SavingGrace of sinners. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur da-i-aal samrath gur gur naanak pat it uDhaarneh. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru is the boat, to cross over the dangerous, treacherous, unfathomable world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bha-ojal bikh am asgaahu gur bohithai t aari-am.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, one is attached to the feet of the True Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (710-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak poor karamm satgur charn ee lagi-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an gurd ayv jis sang har japay. Blessed, blessed is the Divine Guru; associating with Him, one meditates on the Lord.
When the Guru becomes merciful, then all one's demerits are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal jab bha-ay t a avgun  sabh  chhapay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਿਗਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Divine Guru, uplifts and exalts the lowly.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm gurdayv neechahu uch thapay.

lines.english: Cutting away the painful noose of Maya, He makes us His own slaves.
lines.transliteration: kaat silak dukh  maa-i-aa kar leenay ap d asay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੇ ॥
lines.english: With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord God. ||19|| slok ] (710-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay bay-ant  rasnaa har jasay. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਜਬ ਭਏ ਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਸਿਭ ਛਪੇ ॥
lines.english: I see only the One Lord; I hear only the One Lord; the One Lord is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: daristaNt ayko sunee-ant  ayko vart ant ayko narhareh.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the gift of the Naam; O Merciful Lord God, please grant Your Grace.||1||
lines.transliteration: naam daan jaachant  naanak d a-i-aal purakh  kirpaa karah. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਟ  ਿਸਲਕ  ਦੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਲੀਨੇ  ਅਪ ਦਸੇ ॥
lines.english: I serve the One Lord, I contemplate the One Lord, and to the One Lord, I offer my prayer.
lines.transliteration: hik sayvee hik sammlaa har ikas peh ardaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੇ ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Nanak has gathered in the wealth, the merchandise of the Naam; this is the truecapital. ||2|| pauVI ] (710-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naam vakhar Dh an sanchi-aa naanak sachee raas. ||2||

lines.english: God is merciful and infinite. The One and Only is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: parabh d a-i-aal bay-ant  pooran ik ayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੰਤ  ਏਕੋ ਸੁਨੀਅੰਤ  ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੰਤ  ਏਕੋ ਨਰਹਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is all-in-all. Who else can we speak of?
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap d oojaa kahaa kayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God Himself grants His gifts, and He Himself receives them.
lines.transliteration: aap karahu parabh d aan aapay aap layho.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਕੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਿਹਕੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਇਕਸੁ  ਪਿਹ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going are all by the Hukam of Your Will; Your place is steady andunchanging.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa hukam sabh  nihchal t uDh thayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for this gift; by Your Grace, Lord, please grant me Your Name. ||20||1|| jYqsrI bwxI Bgqw kI  (710-14) jaitsaree ban ee bh agtaa kee Jaitsree, The Word Of The Devotees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (710-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak mangai daan kar kirpaa naam d ayh. ||20||1||

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, I know nothing.
lines.transliteration: naath kachhoo-a na jaan-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਇਆਲ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਇਕੁ ਏਹੁ ॥
lines.english: My mind has sold out, and is in Maya's hands. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man maa-i-aa kai haath bikaana-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕਹਾ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: You are called the Lord and Master, the Guru of the World.
lines.transliteration: tum kahee-at  hou jagat  gur su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: I am called a lustful being of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham kahee-at kalijug kay kaamee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਤੁਧੁ ਥੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The five vices have corrupted my mind.
lines.transliteration: in panchan mayro man jo bigaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
lines.english: Moment by moment, they lead me further away from the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pal pal har jee tay ant ar paari-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see loads of pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: jat daykh-a-u t at dukh kee raasee.

lines.english: I do not have faith, even though the Vedas bear witness to the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ajouN na pat-yaa-ay nigam bh a-ay saakh ee. ||3||

lines.english: Shiva cut off Brahma's head, and Gautam's wife and the Lord Indra mated; Brahma's head got stuck to Shiva's hand, and Indra came to bear the marks of a thousandfemale organs. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gotam naar umaapat  savaamee. sees Dh aran sahas bh ag gaaNmee. ||4||

lines.english: These demons have fooled, bound and destroyed me.
lines.transliteration: in doot an kh al baDh  kar maari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਹੌ ਜਗਤ  ਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am very shameless - even now, I am not tired of them. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bado nilaaj ajhoo nahee haari-o. ||5||

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, what am I to do now?
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas kahaa kaisay keejai.

lines.english: Without the Sanctuary of the Lord's Protection, who else's should I seek? ||6||1|| pMnw 711 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (711-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu tofI mhlw 4 Gru 1 ] (711-3) raag todee mehlaa 4 ghar 1. Raag Todee, Chau-Padas, Fourth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: bin raghunaath saran kaa kee leejai. ||6||1||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, my mind cannot survive.
lines.transliteration: har bin reh na sakai man mayraa.

lines.english: If the Guru unites me with my Beloved Lord God, my breath of life, then I shall nothave to face the wheel of reincarnation again in the terrifying world-ocean.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetam paraan har parabh  gur maylay bahur na bh avjal fayraa. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: My heart is gripped by a yearning for my Lord God, and with my eyes, I behold myLord God.
lines.transliteration: mayrai hee-arai loch lagee parabh kayree har nainhu har parabh  hayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਭਵਜਿਲ  ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The merciful True Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me; this is thePath leading to my Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur d a-i-aal har naam drirh -aa-i-aa har paaDh ar har parabh  kayraa. ||1||

lines.english: Through the Lord's Love, I have found the Naam, the Name of my Lord God, the Lordof the Universe, the Lord my God.
lines.transliteration: har rangee har naam parabh paa-i-aa har govind  har parabh  kayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord seems so very sweet to my heart, mind and body; upon my face, upon myforehead, my good destiny is inscribed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har hirdai man t an meeth aa laagaa mukh  mast ak bh aag changayraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦਇਆਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those whose minds are attached to greed and corruption forget the Lord, the goodLord God.
lines.transliteration: lobh vikaar jinaa man laagaa har visri-aa purakh  changayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Those self-willed manmukhs are called foolish and ignorant; misfortune and baddestiny are written on their foreheads. ||3||
lines.transliteration: o-ay manmukh moorh  agi-aanee kahee-ahi t in mast ak bh aag mand ayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: From the True Guru, I have obtained a discriminating intellect; the Guru has revealed the spiritual wisdom of God.
lines.transliteration: bibayk buDh sat gur tay paa-ee gur gi-aan guroo parabh  kayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਿਜਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਵਸਿਰਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਚੰਗੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has obtained the Naam from the Guru; such is the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||4||1|| tofI mhlw 5 Gru 1 dupdy  (711-11) todee mehlaa 5 ghar 1 d upday Todee, Fifth Mehl, First House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (711-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam guroo tay paa-i-aa Dh ur mast ak bh aag likh ayraa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂੜ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Saints do not know any other.
lines.transliteration: santan avar na kaahoo jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁਗੁਰੂ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: They are carefree, ever in the Lord's Love; the Lord and Master is on their side.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bayparvaah sadaa rang har kai jaa ko paakh  su-aamee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਿਲਖੇਰਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Your canopy is so high, O Lord and Master; no one else has any power.
lines.transliteration: ooch samaanaa thaakur t ayro avar na kaahoo t aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the immortal Lord and Master the devotees have found; the spiritually wiseremain absorbed in His Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aiso amar mili-o bhagt an ka-o raach rahay rang gi-aanee. ||1||

lines.english: Disease, sorrow, pain, old age and death do not even approach the humble servant ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: rog sog dukh  jaraa maraa har janeh nahee niktaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: They remain fearless, in the Love of the One Lord; O Nanak, they have surrendered their minds to the Lord. ||2||1|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (711-15) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o ho-ay rahay liv aykai naanak har man maanee. ||2||1||

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, one is ruined forever.
lines.transliteration: har bisrat sad aa kh u-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੇਰੋ ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: How can anyone be deceived, who has Your Support, O Lord? ||Pause|| pMnw 712
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o Dh okhaa kahaa bi-aapai jaa ka-o ot t uhaaree. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, life is like a burning fire, even if onelives long, like a snake.
lines.transliteration: bin simran jo jeevan balnaa sarap jaisay arjaaree.

lines.english: One may rule over the nine regions of the earth, but in the end, he shall have todepart, losing the game of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nav khandan ko raaj kamaavai ant  chalaigo haaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਿਸਮਰਨ  ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਲਨਾ  ਸਰਪ  ਜੈਸੇ ਅਰਜਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, upon whom theLord showers His Grace.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan gun  tin hee gaa-ay jaa ka-o kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡਨ  ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਚਲੈਗੋ  ਹਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is at peace, and his birth is blessed; Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||2||2|| tofI mhlw 5 Gru 2 caupdy  (712-4) todee mehlaa 5 ghar 2 cha-upd ay Todee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (712-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: so sukhee-aa Dh an us janmaa naanak t is balihaaree. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਗੁਣ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਗਾਏ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaa-i-o ray man d ah dis Dhaa-i-o. The mind wanders, wandering in the ten directions.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਧੰਨੁ ਉਸੁ ਜਨਮਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: It is intoxicated by Maya, enticed by the taste of greed. God Himself has deluded it. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa magan su-aad lobh  mohi-o t in parabh  aap bh ulaa-i-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He does not focus his mind, even for a moment, on the Lord's sermon, or the Lord'sPraises, or the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har kathaa har jas saaDhsangat  si-o ik muhat  na ih man laa-i-o.

lines.english: He is excited, gazing on the transitory color of the safflower, and looking at othermen's wives. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bigsi-o paykh rang kasumbh  ko par garih johan jaa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਗਨ  ਸੁਆਿਦ  ਲੋਿਭ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: He does not love the Lord's lotus feet, and he does not please the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o bhaa-o na keeno nah sat  purakh  manaa-i-o.

lines.english: Dhaavat  ka-o Dh aaveh baho bh aatee ji-o t aylee balad  bharmaa-i-o. ||2|| He runs around chasing the fleeting objects of the world, in all directions, like the oxaround the oil press. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਸ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਸਉ ਇਕੁ ਮੁਹਤੁ  ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: He does not practice the Naam, the Name of the Lord; nor does he practice charity orinner cleansing.
lines.transliteration: naam daan isnaan na kee-o ik nimakh  na keerat  gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਗਿਸਓ  ਪੇਿਖ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਕੋ ਪਰ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਜੋਹਿਨ  ਜਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, even for an instant. Clinging to his many falsehoods, he does not please his own mind, and he does not understand hisown self. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanaa jhooth  laa-ay man t okhi-o nah boojh i-o apnaa-i-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਸਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਹ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਮਨਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: He never does good deeds for others; he does not serve or meditate on the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: par-upkaar na kabhoo kee-ay nahee satgur sayv Dh i-aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਤ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ  ਿਜਉ ਤੇਲੀ  ਬਲਦੁ  ਭਰ੍ਮਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is entangled in the company and the advice of the five demons, intoxicated by thewine of Maya. ||4||
lines.transliteration: panch doot  rach sangat  gosat mat vaaro mad  maa-i-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: I offer my prayer in the Saadh Sangat; hearing that the Lord is the Lover of Hisdevotees, I have come.
lines.transliteration: kara-o bayntee saaDh sangat  har bh agat vachh al sun  aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਝੂਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਮਨੁ ਤੋਿਖਓ  ਨਹ ਬੂਿਝਓ  ਅਪਨਾਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak runs after the Lord, and pleads, "Protect my honor, Lord, and make me Yourown."||5||1||3|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (712-12) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaag pari-o har paachh ai raakh  laaj apunaa-i-o. ||5||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Without understanding, his coming into the world is useless.
lines.transliteration: maanukh bin boojh ay birthaa aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਰਿਚ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੋਸਿਟ  ਮਤਵਾਰੋ  ਮਦ ਮਾਇਓ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He puts on various ornaments and many decorations, but it is like dressing a corpse.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik saaj seegaar baho kartaa ji-o mirt ak odh aa-i-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਸੁਿਣ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaa-ay Dh aa-ay kirpan saram keeno ikat ar karee hai maa-i-aa. With great effort and exertion, the miser works to gather in the riches of Maya.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪੁਨਾਇਓ  ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: He does not give anything in charity or generosity, and he does not serve the Saints; his wealth does not do him any good at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daan punn nahee sant an sayvaa kit  hee kaaj na aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The soul-bride puts on her ornaments, embellishes her bed, and fashions decorations.
lines.transliteration: kar aabhran  savaaree sayjaa kaaman thaat banaa-i-aa.

lines.english: But if she does not obtain the company of her Husband Lord, the sight of thesedecorations only brings her pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sang na paa-i-o apunay bhart ay paykh  paykh  dukh paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਜਉ ਿਮਰਤਕੁ  ਓਢਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The man works all day long, threshing the husks with the pestle.
lines.transliteration: saaro dinas majooree kart aa tuhu mooslahi chh araa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is depressed, like a forced laborer, and so he is of no use to his own home. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khayd  bha-i-o baygaaree ni-aa-ee gh ar kai kaam na aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਇ  ਧਾਇ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਨ  ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਕੀਨੋ  ਇਕਤਰ੍  ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But when God shows His Mercy and Grace, He implants the Naam, the Name of theLord, within the heart.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o anoograhu jaa ka-o parabh  ko tis hird ai naam vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਨ  ਸੇਵਾ ਿਕਤ  ਹੀ ਕਾਿਜ  ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Search the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and find the sublimeessence of the Lord. ||4||2||4|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (712-18) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai paachh ai pari-a-o jan naanak har ras paa-i-aa. ||4||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਆਭਰਣ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ਸੇਜਾ ਕਾਮਿਨ  ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, ocean of mercy, please abide forever in my heart.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDh bashu rid ai har neet .

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਭਰਤੇ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪੇਿਖ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please awaken such understanding within me, that I may be in love with You, God. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taisee buDh  karahu pargaasaa laagai parabh  sang pareet . rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰੋ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਮਜੂਰੀ  ਕਰਤਾ ਤੁਹੁ ਮੂਸਲਿਹ  ਛਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please, bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; I touch it to my forehead.
lines.transliteration: daas t umaaray kee paava-o Dh ooraa mast ak lay lay laava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਦੁ ਭਇਓ  ਬੇਗਾਰੀ  ਿਨਆਈ  ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I was a great sinner, but I have been made pure, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1|| pMnw 713
lines.transliteration: mahaa patit  tay hot  puneet aa har keert an gun gaava-o. ||1||

lines.english: Your Will seems so sweet to me; whatever You do, is pleasing to me.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa tumree meeth ee laaga-o kee-o t uhaaro bh aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਗਆ  ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਲਾਗਉ  ਕੀਓ  ਤੁਹਾਰੋ  ਭਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever You give me, with that I am satisfied; I shall chase after no one else. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo too d eh tahee ih t ariptai aan na kat hoo Dh aava-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਤਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I know that my Lord and Master God is always with me; I am the dust of all men's feet.
lines.transliteration: sad hee nikat jaan-o parabh  su-aamee sagal rayn  ho-ay rahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਜਾਨਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਰੇਣ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: If I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall obtain God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  ho-ay paraapat  taa parabh  apunaa lahee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਤਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, I am Your child; You are my God, my King.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa ham chh ohray t umray t oo parabh  hamro meeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਮ ਛੋਹਰੇ  ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਤੂ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਮਰੋ  ਮੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is Your child; You are my mother and father; please, give me Your Name, like milk in my mouth. ||4||3||5|| tofI mhlw 5 Gru 2 dupdy  (713-5) todee mehlaa 5 ghar 2 d upday Todee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (713-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak baarik tum maat  pitaa mukh  naam t umaaro kh eeraa. ||4||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰੋ  ਖੀਰਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: I beg for the Gift of Your Name, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: maaga-o daan th aakur naam.

lines.punjabi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing else shall go along with me in the end; by Your Grace, please allow me tosing Your Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar kachhoo mayrai sang na chaalai milai kirpaa gun  gaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Power, wealth, various pleasures and enjoyments, all are just like the shadow of atree.
lines.transliteration: raaj maal anayk bhog ras sagal t arvar kee chh aam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਿਮਲੈ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhaa-ay Dh aa-ay baho biDh  ka-o Dh aavai sagal niraarath kaam. ||1|| He runs, runs, runs around in many directions, but all of his pursuits are useless. ||1||
Except for the Lord of the Universe, everything he desires appears transitory.
lines.transliteration: bin govind avar jay chaaha-o d eesai sagal baat  hai kh aam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਸਗਲ  ਤਰਵਰ  ਕੀ ਛਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints, so that my mind may find peace and tranquility. ||2||1||6|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (713-9) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sant rayn maaga-o mayro man paavai bisraam. ||2||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਇ  ਧਾਇ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਸਗਲ  ਿਨਰਾਰਥ  ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Dear Lord, is the Support of my mind.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee ko naam maneh saDh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਅਵਰੁ ਜੇ ਚਾਹਉ  ਦੀਸੈ ਸਗਲ  ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਖਾਮ ॥
lines.english: It is my life, my breath of life, my peace of mind; for me, it is an article of daily use.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan sookh is man ka-o bart an ayh hamaarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਮਾਗਉ  ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: The Naam is my social status, the Naam is my honor; the Naam is my family.
lines.transliteration: naam jaat naam mayree pat  hai naam mayrai parvaarai.

lines.english: The Naam is my companion; it is always with me. The Lord's Name is myemancipation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam sakhaa-ee sad aa mayrai sang har naam mo ka-o nist aarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਾਧਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Sensual pleasures are talked about a lot, but none of them goes along with anyone inthe end.
lines.transliteration: bikhai bilaas kahee-at  bahut ayray chalat  na kachh oo sangaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਿਨ  ਏਹ ਹਮਾਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Naam is Nanak's dearest friend; the Lord's Name is my treasure. ||2||2||7|| tofI mÚ 5 ] (713-12) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: isat meet naam naanak ko har naam mayrai bh andaarai. ||2||2||7||

lines.english: Sing the sublime Praises of the Lord, and your disease shall be eradicated.
lines.transliteration: neekay gun gaa-o mithee rog.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਤ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Your face shall become radiant and bright, and your mind shall be immaculately pure. You shall be saved here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal man nirmal ho-ee hai t ayro rahai eehaa oohaa log. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I wash the Guru's feet and serve Him; I dedicate my mind as an offering to Him.
lines.transliteration: charan pakhaar kara-o gur sayvaa maneh charaava-o bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੈ ਿਬਲਾਸ  ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਚਲਤ  ਨ ਕਛੂ ਸੰਗਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce self-conceit, negativity and egotism, and accept what comes to pass. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chhod aapat  baad  ahaNkaaraa maan so-ee jo hog. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ  ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
lines.english: He alone commits himself to the service of the Saints, upon whose forehead suchdestiny is inscribed.
lines.transliteration: sant tahal so-ee hai laagaa jis mast ak likh i-aa likh og.

lines.english: Says Nanak, other than the One Lord, there is not any other able to act. ||2||3||8|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (713-16) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ayk bin doojaa avar na karn ai jog. ||2||3||8||

lines.english: O True Guru, I have come to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: satgur aa-i-o saran  tuhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਰਹੈ ਈਹਾ  ਊਹਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Grant me the peace and glory of the Lord's Name, and remove my anxiety.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: milai sookh naam har sobh aa chint aa laahi hamaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I cannot see any other place of shelter; I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.
lines.transliteration: avar na soojhai d oojee th aahar haar pari-o t a-o du-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਪਖਾਿਰ  ਕਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਨਿਹ  ਚਰਾਵਉ  ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.english: Please ignore my account; only then may I be saved. I am worthless - please, saveme! ||1||
lines.transliteration: laykhaa chh od alaykh ai chh ootah ham nirgun layho ubaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਆਪਤੁ  ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are always forgiving, and always merciful; You give support to all.
lines.transliteration: sad bakh sind sadaa miharvaanaa sabh naa d ay-ay aDh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ  ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਲਖੋਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak follows the Path of the Saints; save him, O Lord, this time. ||2||4||9|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (713-19) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sant  paachh ai pari-o raakh  layho ih baaree. ||2||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥
lines.english: My tongue sings the Praises of the Lord of the world, the ocean of virtue.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa gun gopaal niDh  gaa-in .

lines.english: Peace, tranquility, poise and delight well up in my mind, and all sorrows run away. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 714
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj rahas man upji-o saglay d ookh palaa-in . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਪਲਾਇਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I serve at the Lord's feet, the source of nectar.
lines.transliteration: jo maageh so-ee so-ee paavahi sayv har kay charan rasaa-in .

lines.english: I am released from the bondage of birth and death, and so I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam maran d uhhoo t ay chh ooteh bh avjal jagat  taraa-in . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸੇਿਵ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਸਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: Searching and seeking, I have come to understand the essence of reality; the slave ofthe Lord of the Universe is dedicated to Him.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat tat beechaari-o d aas govind  paraa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਹਹੂ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿਹ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਰਾਇਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If you desire eternal bliss, O Nanak, ever remember the Lord in meditation.||2||5||10|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (714-4) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee kh aym chaaheh jay naanak sad aa simar naaraa-in . ||2||5||10||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਪਰਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderer, by Guru's Grace, has been turned away.
lines.transliteration: nindak gur kirpaa t ay haati-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਖੇਮ ਚਾਹਿਹ  ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ॥੨॥੫॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful; with Shiva's arrow, He shot his head off.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh bh a-ay d a-i-aalaa siv kai baan  sir kaati-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Death, and the noose of death, cannot see me; I have adopted the Path of Truth.
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai sach kaa panthaa thaati-o.

lines.english: I have earned the wealth, the jewel of the Lord's Name; eating and spending, it isnever used up. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khaat  kharchat  kichh  nikhutat naahee raam rat an Dh an kh aati-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਿਸਵ ਕੈ ਬਾਿਣ  ਿਸਰੁ ਕਾਿਟਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, the slanderer was reduced to ashes; he received the rewards of his own actions.
lines.transliteration: bhasmaa bh oot ho-aa kh in bheetar apnaa kee-aa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak speaks the truth of the scriptures; the whole world is witness to it.||2||6||11|| tofI mÚ 5 ] (714-7) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aagam nigam kahai jan naanak sabh d aykhai lok sabaa-i-aa. ||2||6||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪੰਥਾ ਥਾਿਟਓ  ॥
lines.english: O miser, your body and mind are full of sin.
lines.transliteration: kirpan tan man kilvikh  bharay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਨਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਿਟਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate, meditate on the Lord andMaster; He alone can cover your sins. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh ajan kar su-aamee dh aakan ka-o ik haray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਸਮਾ  ਭੂਤ ਹੋਆ  ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When many holes appear in your boat, you cannot plug them with your hands.
lines.transliteration: anik chhid ar bohith kay chh utkat thaam na jaahee karay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਗਮ ਿਨਗਮੁ  ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥੬॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the One, to whom your boat belongs; He saves the counterfeitalong with the genuine. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis kaa bohith tis aaraaDh ay kh otay sang kh aray. ||1||

lines.english: People want to lift up the mountain with mere words, but it just stays there.
lines.transliteration: galee sail uthaavat  chaahai o-ay oohaa hee hai Dh aray.

lines.english: Nanak has no strength or power at all; O God, please protect me - I seek YourSanctuary. ||2||7||12|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (714-11) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jor sakat naanak kichh  naahee parabh  raakh o saran  paray. ||2||7||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਭਜਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਢਾਕਨ  ਕਉ ਇਕੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate on the lotus feet of the Lord within your mind.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan kamal man Dhi-aa-o.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine; it is like an axe, which destroys the diseasescaused by anger and egotism. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaadh kuth aar pit  baat hantaa a-ukh aDh har ko naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਿਛਦਰ੍  ਬੋਿਹਥ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ  ਥਾਮ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the One who removes the three fevers; He is the Destroyer of pain, thewarehouse of peace.
lines.transliteration: teenay t aap nivaaran haaraa d ukh hantaa sukh  raas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਖਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No obstacles block the path of one who prays before God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o bigh an na ko-oo laagai jaa kee parabh  aagai ard aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਲੀ  ਸੈਲ ਉਠਾਵਤ ਚਾਹੈ ਓਇ ਊਹਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has become my physician; God alone is the Doer,the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  baid naaraa-in  karan  kaaran  parabh  ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਰੁ ਸਕਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He is the Giver of perfect peace to the innocent-minded people; O Nanak, the Lord,Har, Har, is my support. ||2||8||13|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (714-14) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: baal buDh pooran sukh -daata naanak har har tayk. ||2||8||13||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: har har naam sadaa sad  jaap.

lines.english: Dhaar anoograhu paarbarahm su-aamee vasd ee keenee aap. ||1|| rahaa-o. Showering His Kind Mercy, the Supreme Lord God Himself has blessed the town. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਢ  ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਿਪਤ ਬਾਤ ਹੰਤਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One who owns me, has again taken care of me; my sorrow and suffering is past.
lines.transliteration: jis kay say fir tin hee samHaalay binsay sog sant aap.

lines.english: He gave me His hand, and saved me, His humble servant; the Lord is my mother andfather. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ay jan apnay har ho-ay maa-ee baap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਨੇ  ਤਾਪ ਿਨਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ਦੁਖ ਹੰਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures have become kind to me; my Lord and Master blessed mewith His Kind Mercy.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant ho-ay miharvaanaa d a-yaa Dh aaree har naath.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਗੈ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Destroyer of pain; His glory is so great!||2||9||14|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (714-17) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran paray dukh  bhanjan jaa kaa bad part aap. ||2||9||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਬੈਦ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਏਕ ॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Court.
lines.transliteration: savaamee saran pari-o darbaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਲ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Destroyer of millions of sins, O Great Giver, other than You, who else can save me?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot apraaDh kh andan kay d aatay tujh bin ka-un uDh aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Searching, searching in so many ways, I have contemplated all the objects of life.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat baho parkaaray sarab arath beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the supreme state is attained. But those who are engrossed in the bondage of Maya, lose the game of life. ||1|| pMnw 715
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang param gat  paa-ee-ai maa-i-aa rach banDh  haaray. ||1||

lines.english: My mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet; I have met the Beloved Guru, the noble, heroic being.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sang pareet man laagee sur jan milay pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ਸੁਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਮਲੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak celebrates in bliss; chanting and meditating on the Lord, all sickness has beencured. ||2||10||15|| tofI mhlw 5 Gru 3 caupdy  (715-3) todee mehlaa 5 ghar 3 cha-upd ay Todee, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (715-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak anad karay har jap jap saglay rog nivaaray. ||2||10||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਦ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਸਗਲੇ  ਰੋਗ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Oh! Oh! You cling to Maya, you fool; this is not a trivial matter.
lines.transliteration: haaN haaN lapti-o ray moorhHay kachh oo na thoree.

lines.punjabi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: That which you consider to be yours, is not yours. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayro nahee so jaanee moree. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹ ਹ ਲਪਿਟਓ  ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: You do not remember your Lord, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: aapan raam na cheeno khinoo-aa.

lines.english: That which belongs to others, you believe to be your own. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo paraa-ee so apnee manoo-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is always with you, but you do not enshrine it withinyour mind.
lines.transliteration: naam sangee so man na basaa-i-o.

lines.english: You have attached your consciousness to that which you must eventually abandon.||2||
lines.transliteration: chhod jaahi vaahoo chit  laa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: You collect that which will bring you only hunger and thirst.
lines.transliteration: so sanchi-o jit bh ookh tisaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ  ਸੋ ਮਿਨ ਨ ਬਸਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: You have not obtained the supplies of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam t osaa nahee paa-i-o. ||3||

lines.english: You have fallen into the pit of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh moh koop pari-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, a rare few are saved. ||4||1||16|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (715-7) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak ko t ari-aa. ||4||1||16||

lines.english: I have only the One Lord, my God.
lines.transliteration: hamaarai aykai haree haree.

lines.english: I do not recognize any other. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan avar sinjaan  na karee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found my Guru.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag gur apunaa paa-i-o.

lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur mo ka-o har naam darirh aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my meditation, austerity, fasting and daily religious practice.
lines.transliteration: har har jaap taap barat  naymaa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found total joy and bliss. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har Dhi-aa-ay kusal sabh  khaymaa. ||2||

lines.english: The Praises of the Lord are my good conduct, occupation and social class.
lines.transliteration: aachaar bi-uhaar jaat har gunee-aa.

lines.english: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand keertan har sunee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: 5) kaho naanak jin thaakur paa-i-aa. sabh  kichh  tis kay garih meh aa-i-aa. ||4||2||17|| Says Nanak, everything comes to the homes of those who have found their Lord and Master. ||4||2||17|| tofI mhlw 5 Gru 4 dupdy  (715-12) todee mehlaa 5 ghar 4 d upday Todee, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (715-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਬਰ੍ਤ ਨੇਮਾ ॥
lines.english: My beautiful mind longs for the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: roorho man har rango lorh ai.

lines.english: By mere words, the Lord's Love does not come. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gaalee har neehu na ho-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have searched for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, looking in each and everystreet.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhoodh aydee darsan kaaran  beethee beethee paykh aa.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur mil bharam gavaa-i-aa hay. ||1||

lines.english: I have obtained this wisdom from the Holy Saints, according to the pre-ordaineddestiny inscribed upon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: ih buDh paa-ee mai saaDh oo kannahu laykh  likhi-o Dh ur maathai.

lines.english: In this way, Nanak has seen the Lord with his eyes. ||2||1||18|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (715-15) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ih biDh naanak har nain  alo-ay. ||2||1||18||

lines.punjabi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My foolish heart is in the grip of pride.
lines.transliteration: garab gahilarho moorh -rho hee-o ray.

lines.english: By the Will of my Lord God, Maya, like a witch, has swallowed my soul. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hee-o mahraaj ree maa-i-o. deehar ni-aa-ee mohi faaki-o ray. rahaa-o.

lines.english: More and more, he continually yearns for more; but unless he is destined to receive,how can he obtain it?
lines.transliteration: ghano ghano ghano sad  lorhai bin lahn ay kaith ai paa-i-o ray.

lines.english: He is entangled in wealth, bestowed by the Lord God; the unfortunate one attacheshimself to the fire of desires. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahraaj ro gaath vaahoo si-o lubh-rh i-o nihbh aagrh o bhaahi sanjo-i-o ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਬੀਥੀ  ਬੀਥੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
lines.english: Listen, O mind, to the Teachings of the Holy Saints, and all your sins shall be totallywashed away.
lines.transliteration: sun man seekh  saaDh oo jan saglo thaaray saglay paraachh at miti-o ray.

lines.english: ||2||2||19|| One who is destined to receive from the Lord, O servant Nanak, shall not be cast intothe womb of reincarnation again. ||2||2||19|| pMnw 716 tofI mhlw 5 Gru 5 dupdy (716-1) todee mehlaa 5 ghar 5 d upday Todee, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (716-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jaa ko lahno mahraaj ree gaath -rhee-o jan naanak garbh aas na pa-orh i-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the blessing my God has bestowed upon me.
lines.transliteration: aiso gun mayro parabh jee keen.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਗੁਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਕੀਨ ॥
lines.english: He has totally banished the five evils and the illness of egotism from my body. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: panch dokh  ar ahaN rog ih t an tay sagal d oor keen. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗ ਇਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕੀਨ  ॥
lines.english: Breaking my bonds, and releasing me from vice and corruption, He has enshrined theWord of the Guru's Shabad within my heart.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t or chh or bikh i-aa tay gur ko sabad  mayrai hee-arai d een.

lines.english: The Lord has not considered my beauty or ugliness; instead, He has held me withlove. I am drenched with His Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: roop anroop moro kachh na beechaari-o paraym gahi-o mohi har rang bh een. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋਿਰ ਛੋਿਰ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਦੀਨ  ॥
lines.english: I behold my Beloved, now that the curtain has been torn away. My mind is happy,pleased and satisfied.
lines.transliteration: paykhi-o laalan paat beech kh o-ay anad  chitaa harkh ay pat een.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਰੂਪੁ  ਮੋਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਗਿਹਓ  ਮੋਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਭੀਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My house is His; He is my God. Nanak is obedient to His Lord and Master. ||2||1||20|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (716-5) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis hee ko garihu so-ee parabh  naanak so th aakur t is hee ko Dh een. ||2||1||20||

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਟ ਬੀਚ ਖੋਏ ਅਨਦ  ਿਚਤਾ  ਹਰਖੇ ਪਤੀਨ  ॥
lines.english: O my mother, my mind is in love.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mayray man kee pareet.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਧੀਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
lines.english: This is my karma and my Dharma; this is my meditation. The Lord's Name is myimmaculate, unstained way of life. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayhee karam Dharam jap ayhee raam naam nirmal hai reet . rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Support of my breath of life, the wealth of my life, is to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: paraan aDhaar jeevan Dh an morai d aykhan ka-o d arsan parabh  neet.

lines.english: On the road, and on the river, these supplies are always with me. I have made mymind the Lord's companion. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baat ghaat t osaa sang morai man apunay ka-o mai har sakh aa keet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੀ ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਜਪ ਏਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੈ ਰੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, my mind has become immaculate and pure. In His mercy,He has made me His own.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  bha-ay man nirmal kar kirpaa apunay kar leet .

lines.english: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, Nanak has found peace. From thevery beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the friend of His devotees.||2||2||21|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (716-9) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar simar naanak sukh paa-i-aa aad  jugaad  bhagtan kay meet . ||2||2||21||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਧਨ ਮੋਰੈ ਦੇਖਨ  ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Dear God, please meet me; You are my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee mil mayray paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟ  ਤੋਸਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੋਰੈ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਉ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਖਾ ਕੀਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Do not let me forget You from my heart, even for an instant; please, bless Yourdevotee with Your gift of perfection. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bisar nahee nimakh hee-aray t ay apnay bh agat ka-o pooran d aan. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਭਏ ਮਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਿਰ ਲੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: Dispel my doubt, and save me, O my Beloved, all-knowing Lord, O Inner-knower, OSearcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: khovhu bh aram raakh  mayray pareet am ant arjaamee sugh arh sujaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Naam is worth millions of kingdoms to me; O God, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot raaj naam Dhan mayrai amrit  darisat Dh aarahu parabh  maan. ||1||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. They totally satisfy my ears, Omy all-powerful Lord.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar rasnaa gun gaavai jas poor agh aaveh samrath kaan.

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Giver of life to the soul; forever and ever, Nanak is asacrifice to You. ||2||3||22|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (716-13) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  jee-an kay d aatay sad aa sad aa naanak kurbaan. ||2||3||22||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਿਨਮਖ  ਹੀਅਰੇ  ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ  ਭਗਤ  ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨ  ਦਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: O God, I am the dust of Your feet.
lines.transliteration: parabh t ayray pag kee Dh oor.

lines.english: O merciful to the meek, Beloved mind-enticing Lord, by Your Kind Mercy, please fulfillmy yearning. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal pareet am manmohan kar kirpaa mayree lochaa poor. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਵਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸੁਘੜ  ਸੁਜਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: In the ten directions, Your Praises are permeating and pervading, O Inner-knower,Searcher of hearts, O Lord ever-present.
lines.transliteration: dah d is rav rahi-aa jas t umraa ant arjaamee sad aa hajoor.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਰਾਜ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who sing Your Praises, O Creator Lord, those humble beings never die orgrieve. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo tumraa jas gaavahi kart ay say jan kabahu na mart ay jhoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ਜਸੁ ਪੂਿਰ ਅਘਾਵਿਹ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਕਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: DhanDh  banDh  binsay maa-i-aa kay saaDh oo sangat  mitay bisoor. The worldly affairs and entanglements of Maya disappear, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; all sorrows are taken away.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਜੀਅਨ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ  ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
lines.english: The comforts of wealth and the enjoyments of the soul - O Nanak, without the Lord, know them to be false. ||2||4||23|| tofI mÚ 5 ] (716-16) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukh sampat  bhog is jee-a kay bin har naanak jaanay koor. ||2||4||23||

lines.english: O my mother, my mind is so thirsty.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mayray man kee pi-aas.

lines.english: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without my Beloved. My mind is filled with thedesire to behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ik khin reh na saka-o bin pareet am darsan d aykhan ka-o Dh aaree man aas. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਰੀ ਲੋਚਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: I meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the immaculate Creator Lord;all the sins and errors of my mind and body are washed away.
lines.transliteration: simra-o naam niranjan kartay man t an tay sabh  kilvikh  naas.

lines.english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God, the eternal, imperishable Giver of peace - spotlessand pure are His Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooran paarbarahm sukh-d aatay abh inaasee bimal jaa ko jaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, my desires have been fulfilled; in His Mercy, the Lord, thetreasure of virtue, has met me. pMnw 717
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  mayray poor manorath kar kirpaa bh aytay gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੂਖ ਮਿਨ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਕੋਿਟ ਸੂਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰਗਾਸ  ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Peace and tranquility, poise and pleasure, have welled up within my mind; millions of suns, O Nanak, illuminate me. ||2||5||24|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (717-1) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj sookh  man upji-o kot soor naanak pargaas. ||2||5||24||

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the Purifier of sinners;
lines.transliteration: har har patit  paavan.

lines.english: He is the soul, the breath of life, the Giver of peace and honor, the Inner-knower, theSearcher of hearts; He is pleasing to my mind. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan maan sukh-d aata antarjaamee man ko bh aavan. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: He is beautiful and wise, clever and all-know ing. He dwells within the hearts of His slaves; His devotees sing His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sundar sugh arh chatur sabh  baytaa rid  daas nivaas bh agat gun gaavan.

lines.english: His form is immaculate and pure; He is the incomparable Lord and Master. Upon thefield of actions and karma, whatever one plants, one eats. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nirmal roop anoop su-aamee karam bhoom beejan so kh aavan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬੇਤਾ ਿਰਦ ਦਾਸ ਿਨਵਾਸ  ਭਗਤ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: I am amazed, and wonder-struck by His wonder. There is none other than Him.
lines.transliteration: bisman bisam bha-ay bismaad aa aan na bee-o d oosar laavan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਭੂਿਮ ਬੀਜਨ  ਸੋ ਖਾਵਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on His Praises with my tongue, I live; slave Nanak isforever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||6||25|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (717-5) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: rasnaa simar simar jas jeevaa naanak daas sad aa bal jaavan. ||2||6||25||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਮਨ  ਿਬਸਮ  ਭਏ ਿਬਸਮਾਦਾ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਬੀਓ ਦੂਸਰ  ਲਾਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: O my mother, Maya is so misleading and deceptive.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee maa-i-aa chhal.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਜਸੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਵਨ  ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, it is like straw on fire, or the shadowof a cloud, or the running of the flood-waters. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tarin kee agan maygh  kee chh aa-i-aa gobid  bhajan bin harh  kaa jal. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Renounce your cleverness and all your mental tricks; with your palms pressedtogether, walk on the Path of the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: chhod si-aanap baho chat uraa-ee d u-ay kar jorh  saaDh  mag chal.

lines.english: Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; this is the most sublime reward of this human incarnation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: simar su-aamee antarjaamee maanukh  dayh kaa ih oot am fal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਣ  ਕੀ ਅਗਿਨ ਮੇਘ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਭਜਨ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹੜ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ॥
lines.english: The Holy Saints preach the teachings of the Vedas, but the unfortunate fools do notunderstand them.
lines.transliteration: bayd bakh i-aan karat  saaDh oo jan bh aagheen samjh at nahee kh al.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is absorbed in loving devotional worship; meditating in remembranceon the Lord, one's dirt is burnt away. ||2||7||26|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (717-9) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  raachay jan naanak har simran d ahan bh a-ay mal. ||2||7||26||

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਗ ਚਲੁ ॥
lines.english: O mother, the Guru's feet are so sweet.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee charan gur meethay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਊਤਮ  ਫਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the Transcendent Lord has blessed me with them. Millions of rewards come from the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag d ayvai parmaysar kot falaa d arsan gur deeth ay. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਬਿਖਆਨ ਕਰਤ  ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ  ਸਮਝਤ  ਨਹੀ ਖਲੁ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the imperish able, indestructible Lord, sexual desire, anger and stubborn pride vanish.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat achut  abhinaasee kaam kroDh  binsay mad  dheethay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਾਚੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਿਨ  ਦਹਨ  ਭਏ ਮਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the True Lord become permanent andeternal; birth and death do not grind them down any more. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asthir bha-ay saach rang raat ay janam maran baahur nahee peeth ay. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Lord's meditation, all joys and pleasures are totally false and worthless;by the Kind Mercy of the Saints, I know this.
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan rang ras jayt ay sant  da-i-aal jaanay sabh  jhoothay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the jewel of the Naam; without the Naam, all must depart,cheated and plundered. ||2||8||27|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (717-12) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam ratan paa-i-o jan naanak naam bihoon chalay sabh  mooth ay. ||2||8||27||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕੋਿਟ ਫਲਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਡੀਠੇ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I contemplate the Name of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har har naam chit aaraa.

lines.english: I am in peaceful poise and bliss, day and night; the seed of my destiny has sprouted.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sahj anand hovai din raat ee ankur bh alo hamaaraa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ਅਚੁਤ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਮਦ ਢੀਠੇ ॥
lines.english: I have met the True Guru, by great good fortune; He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa bhayti-o badbh aagee jaa ko ant  na paaraavaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰ  ਭਏ ਸਾਚ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਬਾਹੁਿਰ ਨਹੀ ਪੀਠੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Taking His humble servant by the hand, He pulls him out of the poisonous world- ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar geh kaadh lee-o jan apunaa bikh  saagar sansaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨ  ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ  ਜਾਨੇ ਸਿਭ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
lines.english: Birth and death are ended for me, by the Word of the Guru's Teachings; I shall nolonger pass through the door of pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaatay gur bachnee bahurh na sankat d u-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਬਹੂਨ ਚਲੇ ਸਿਭ ਮੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Nanak holds tight to the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; again and again, he bowsin humility and reverence to Him. ||2||9||28|| tofI mhlw 5 ] (717-16) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran gahee su-aamee kee punah punah namaskaaraa. ||2||9||28||

lines.english: O my mother, my mind is at peace.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mayray man ko sukh.

lines.english: I enjoy the ecstasy of millions of princely pleasures; remembering the Lord inmeditation, all pains have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot anand raaj sukh bh ugvai har simrat  binsai sabh  dukh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਭਲੋ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The sins of millions of lifetimes are erased, by meditating on the Lord; becoming pure,my mind and body have found peace.
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay kilbikh naaseh simrat  paavan t an man sukh .

lines.english: Gazing upon the Lord's form of perfect beauty, my hopes have been fulfilled; attaining the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my hunger has been appeased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daykh  saroop pooran bh a-ee aasaa d arsan bh aytat utree bh ukh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਬਡਭਾਗੀ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The four great blessings, the eight supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, thewish-fulfilling Elysian cow, and the wish-fulfilling tree of life - all these come from theLord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat mahaa siDh  kaamDh ayn paarjaat  har har rukh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਓ  ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਿਬਖੁ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, holding tight to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace, you shall not suffer the pains of birth and death, or fall into the womb of reincarnation again.||2||10||29|| pMnw 718 tofI mhlw 5 ] (718-1) todee mehlaa 5. Todee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran gahee sukh saagar janam maran fir garabh  na Dh ukh. ||2||10||29||

lines.english: I have enshrined the Lord's Feet within my heart.
lines.transliteration: har har charan ridai ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: Contemplating my Lord and Master, my True Guru, all my affairs have been resolved.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simar su-aamee satgur apunaa kaaraj safal hamaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.
