lines.english: The merits of giving donations to charity and devotional worship come from the Kirtanof the Praises of the Transcendent Lord; this is the true essence of wisdom.
lines.transliteration: punn daan poojaa parmaysur har keerat  tat beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਫਲ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Singing the Praises of the unapproachable, infinite Lord and Master, I have found immeasurable peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat at ul sukh  paa-i-aa th aakur agam apaaray. ||1||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God does not consider the merits and demerits of those humblebeings whom He makes His own.
lines.transliteration: jo jan paarbarahm apnay keenay tin kaa baahur kachh  na beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing, chanting and meditating on the jewel of the Naam, I live; Nanak wears theLord as his necklace. ||2||11||30|| tofI mhlw 9 (718-5) todee mehlaa 9 Todee, Ninth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (718-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naam ratan sun jap jap jeevaa har naanak kanth  majh aaray. ||2||11||30||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਤੁਲ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can I say about my base nature?
lines.transliteration: kaha-o kahaa apnee aDhmaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਕੀਨੇ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਬਾਹੁਿਰ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am entangled in the love of gold and women, and I have not sung the Kirtan ofGod's Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: urjhi-o kanak kaamnee kay ras nah keerat  parabh  gaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਿਨ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੰਠ ਮਝਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
lines.english: I judge the false world to be true, and I have fallen in love with it.
lines.transliteration: jag jhooth ay ka-o saach jaan kai t aa si-o ruch upjaa-ee.

lines.english: I have never contemplated the friend of the poor, who shall be my companion andhelper in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deen banDh  simri-o nahee kabhoo hot  jo sang sahaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I remain intoxicated by Maya, night and day, and the filth of my mind will not depart.
lines.transliteration: magan rahi-o maa-i-aa mai nis din chh utee na man kee kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਿਝਓ  ਕਨਕ  ਕਾਮਨੀ  ਕੇ ਰਸ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, now, without the Lord's Sanctuary, I cannot find salvation in any other way. ||2||1||31|| tofI bwxI BgqW kI  (718-10) todee banee bh agtaaN kee Todee, The Word Of The Devotees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (718-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi naanak ab naahi anat gat  bin har kee sarnaa-ee. ||2||1||31||

lines.english: Some say that He is near, and others say that He is far away.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee bolai nirvaa ko-ee bolai door.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਾਿਨ  ਕੈ ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: We might just as well say that the fish climbs out of the water, up the tree. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jal kee maachhulee charai kh ajoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਬੰਧ ਿਸਮਿਰਓ  ਨਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਤ ਜੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Why do you speak such nonsense?
lines.transliteration: kaaN-ay ray bakbaad laa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਗਨ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੈ ਿਨਸ ਿਦਿਨ  ਛੁਟੀ ਨ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who has found the Lord, keeps quiet about it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin har paa-i-o tineh chh apaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਬ ਨਾਿਹ  ਅਨਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ  ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.english: Those who become Pandits, religious scholars, recite the Vedas,
lines.transliteration: pandit ho-ay kai bayd  bakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਟੋਡੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh naamd ay-o raameh jaanai. ||2||1|| but foolish Naam Dayv knows only the Lord. ||2||1||

lines.english: Whose blemishes remain, when one chants the Lord's Name?
lines.transliteration: ka-un ko kalank rahi-o raam naam layt hee.

lines.english: Sinners become pure, chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: patit pavit  bha-ay raam kahat  hee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With the Lord, servant Naam Dayv has come to have faith.
lines.transliteration: raam sang naamdayv jan ka-o part agi-aa aa-ee.

lines.english: I have stopped fasting on the eleventh day of each month; why should I bother to go on pilgrimages to sacred shrines? ||1||
lines.transliteration: aykaadasee barat  rahai kaahay ka-o t irath jaa-eeN. ||1||

lines.english: Prays Naam Dayv, I have become a man of good deeds and good thoughts.
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naamd ay-o sukarit  sumat  bha-ay.

lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions, who has not gone to heaven?||2||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmat raam kahi ko ko na baikunth  ga-ay. ||2||2||

lines.english: Here is a verse with a three-fold play on words. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: teen chh anday kh ayl aachh ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨ  ਕੋ ਕਲੰਕੁ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਤ ਹੀ ॥
lines.english: In the potter's home there are pots, and in the king's home there are camels.
lines.transliteration: kumbhaar kay gh ar haaNdee aachh ai raajaa kay gh ar saaNdee go.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਿਵਤ  ਭਏ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ  ਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Brahmin's home there are widows. So here they are: haandee, saandee, raandee. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baaman kay ghar raaNdee aachh ai raaNdee saaNdee haaNdee go. ||1||

lines.english: In the home of the grocer there is asafoetida; on the forehead of the buffalo there arehorns.
lines.transliteration: baanee-ay kay gh ar heeNg aachh ai bhaisar maathai seeNg go.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਮਦੇਵ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਤਿਗਆ  ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: In the temple of Shiva there are lingams. So here they are: heeng, seeng, leeng. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dayval maDh ay leeg aachh ai leeg seeg heeg go. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ  ਬਰ੍ਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ  ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the house of the oil-presser there is oil; in the forest there are vines.
lines.transliteration: taylee kai gh ar tayl aachh ai jangal maDh ay bayl go.

lines.english: In the gardener's home there are bananas. So here they are: tayl, bayl, kayl. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maalee kay ghar kayl aachh ai kayl bayl t ayl go. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਾਮੁ ਕਿਹ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਿਠ  ਗਏ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, Govind, is within His Saints; Krishna, Shyaam, is in Gokal.
lines.transliteration: jantaaN maDh ay gobind  aachh ai gokal maDh ay si-aam go.

lines.english: The Lord, Raam, is in Naam Dayv. So here they are: Raam, Shyaam, Govind. ||4||3|| pMnw 719 rwgu bYrwVI mhlw 4 Gru 1 dupdy (719-1) raag bairaarhee mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 d upday Raag Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (719-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naamay maDhay raam aachh ai raam si-aam gobind  go. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O mind, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sun man akath kathaa har naam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਮਨ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Riches, wisdom, supernatural spiritual powers and peace are obtained, by vibrating,meditating on the Lord God, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: riDh buDh  siDh sukh  paavahi bh aj gurmat  har raam raam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਸਿਧ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Numerous legends, the Puraanas, and the six Shaastras, sing the sublime Praises ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanaa khi-aan puraan jas oot am kh at darsan gaavahi raam.

lines.english: Shiva and the three hundred thirty million gods meditate on the Lord, but they do notknow the secret of His mystery. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sankar krorh t aytees Dh i-aa-i-o nahee jaani-o har marmaam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਿਖਆਨ  ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ  ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The angelic and divine beings, and the celestial singers sing His Praises; all Creationsings of Him.
lines.transliteration: sur nar gan ganDh arab jas gaavahi sabh  gaavat  jayt upaam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਕਰ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿੜ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਿਧਆਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ਹਿਰ ਮਰਮਾਮ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those whom the Lord blesses with His Kind Mercy, become the good Saintsof the Lord God. ||2||1|| bYrwVI mhlw 4 ] (719-6) bairaarhee mehlaa 4. Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa karee har jin ka-o tay sant  bhalay har raam. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰ੍ਬ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਭ ਗਾਵਤ  ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, those who meet the Lord's humble servants, sing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: man mil sant janaa jas gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: They are blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Lord, Har, Har, the sublime jewel of the Lord, by the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har ratan rat an har neeko gur sat gur daan divaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I offer my mind, body and everything to that humble being who recites the Name ofthe Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: tis jan ka-o man t an sabh  dayva-o jin har har naam sunaa-i-o.

lines.english: Dhan maa-i-aa sampai t is dayva-o jin har meet  milaa-i-o. ||1|| I offer my wealth, the riches of Maya and my property to that one who leads me tomeet the Lord, my friend. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨੀਕੋ  ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦਾਨੁ ਿਦਵਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Lord of the world bestowed just a tiny bit of His Mercy, for just an instant,then I meditated on the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: khin kichint  kirpaa karee jagd eesar t ab har har har jas Dh i-aa-i-o.

lines.english: The Lord and Master has met servant Nanak, and the pain of the sickness of egotism has been eliminated. ||2||2|| bYrwVI mhlw 4 ] (719-10) bairaarhee mehlaa 4. Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har bhaytay su-aamee d ukh ha-umai rog gavaa-i-o. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਉ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har jan raam naam gun gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੰਪੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਮੀਤੁ ਿਮਲਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even if someone slanders the Lord's humble servant, he does not give up his owngoodness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay ko-ee nind karay har jan kee apunaa gun na gavaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਿਕੰਿਚਤ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਿਰ  ਤਬ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord and Master does, He does by Himself; the Lord Himself does the deeds.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so aapay su-aamee har aapay kaar kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master Himself imparts understanding; the Lord Himself inspires us to speak. ||1|| pMnw 720
lines.transliteration: har aapay hee mat d ayvai su-aamee har aapay bol bulaavai. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord Himself directs the evolution of the world of the five elements; He Himself infuses the five senses into it.
lines.transliteration: har aapay panch tat  bisthaaraa vich Dh aatoo panch aap paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਿਬਸਥਾਰਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਧਾਤੂ ਪੰਚ ਆਿਪ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Lord Himself unites us with the True Guru; He Himself resolvesthe conflicts. ||2||3|| bYrwVI mhlw 4 ] (720-2) bairaarhee mehlaa 4. Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak satgur maylay aapay har aapay jh agar chukh aavai. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and you shall be emancipated.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam nistaaraa.

lines.english: The Lord shall destroy all the sins of millions upon millions of incarnations, and carryyou across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot kotantar kay paap sabh  khovai har bh avjal paar ut aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the body-village, the Lord Master abides; the Lord is without fear, withoutvengeance, and without form.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar basat har su-aamee har nirbh a-o nirvair nirankaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ  ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਸਿਭ ਖੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is dwelling near at hand, but He cannot be seen. By the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har nikat basat kachh  nadar na aavai har laaDh aa gur veechaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord Himself is the banker, the jeweller, the jewel, the gem; the Lord Himselfcreated the entire expanse of the creation.
lines.transliteration: har aapay saahu saraaf ratan heeraa har aap kee-aa paasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਿਰ  ਬਸਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Kind Mercy, trades in the Lord's Name; He alone is the true banker, the true trader. ||2||4|| bYrwVI mhlw 4 ] (720-6) bairaarhee mehlaa 4. Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis kirpaa karay so har naam vihaajhay so saahu sachaa van jaaraa. ||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਬਸਤ  ਕਛੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਧਾ  ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate, O mind, on the immaculate, formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: jap man har niranjan nirankaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਹੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ  ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace; He has no end orlimitation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har Dh i-aa-ee-ai sukh -daata jaa kaa ant  na paaraavaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਹਾਝੇ  ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: In the fiery pit of the womb, when you were hanging upside-down, the Lord absorbedYou in His Love, and preserved You.
lines.transliteration: agan kunt meh uraDh liv laagaa har raakh ai udar manjh aaraa.

lines.english: So serve such a Lord, O my mind; the Lord shall deliver you in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har sayvhu mayray man har ant chh adaavan haaraa. ||1||

lines.english: Bow down in reverence to that humble being, within whose heart the Lord, Har, Har, abides.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hirdai basi-aa mayraa har har t is jan ka-o karahu namaskaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Kind Mercy, O Nanak, one obtains the Lord's meditation, and thesupport of the Naam. ||2||5|| bYrwVI mhlw 4 ] (720-10) bairaarhee mehlaa 4. Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa tay paa-ee-ai har jap naanak naam aDh aaraa. ||2||5||

lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; meditate on it continually.
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam nit Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਕੁੰਟ ਮਿਹ ਉਰਧ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਦਰ  ਮੰਝਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires, and pain shall never touch youagain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo ichheh so-ee fal paavahi fir d ookh na laagai aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਤ  ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That is chanting, that is deep meditation and austerity, that is fasting and worship,which inspires love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so jap so tap saa barat  poojaa jit  har si-o pareet  lagaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਬਿਸਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Love, every other love is false; in an instant, it is all forgotten. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin har pareet hor pareet  sabh  jhoothee ik kh in meh bisar sabh  jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: You are infinite, the Master of all power; Your value cannot be described at all.
lines.transliteration: too bay-ant  sarab kal pooraa kichh  keemat  kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; as it pleases You, save him. ||2||6|| rwgu bYrwVI mhlw 5 Gru 1  (720-15) raag bairaarhee mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 Raag Bairaaree, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (720-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran t umHaaree har jee-o bh aavai t ivai chh adaa-ay. ||2||6||

lines.english: Meeting with the humble Saints, sing the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil har jas gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The pains of millions of incarnations shall be eradicated. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay dookh  gavaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever your mind desires, that you shall obtain.
lines.transliteration: jo chaahat so-ee man paa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਸਾ ਬਰ੍ਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blesses us with His Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har naam divaa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੋਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਭ ਝੂਠੀ ਇਕ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਬਸਿਰ  ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All happiness and greatness are in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh har naam vadaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਮਿਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak has gained this understanding. ||2||1||7|| pMnw 721 rwgu iqlµg mhlw 1 Gru 1 (721-1) raag tilang mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Raag Tilang, First Mehl, First House: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (721-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak mat  paa-ee. ||2||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਤਲੰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I offer this one prayer to You; please listen to it, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: yak araj guftam pays t o dar gos kun kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਯਕ ਅਰਜ  ਗੁਫਤਮ  ਪੇਿਸ ਤੋ ਦਰ ਗੋਸ ਕੁਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: You are true, great, merciful and spotless, O Cherisher Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hakaa kabeer kareem too bay-aib parvard agaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਕਾ ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਰੀਮ  ਤੂ ਬੇਐਬ  ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The world is a transitory place of mortality - know this for certain in your mind.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa mukaamay faanee t ehkeek d il daanee.

lines.english: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, has caught me by the hair on my head, and yet, Ido not know it at all in my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mam sar moo-ay ajraa-eel girafteh d il haych na d aanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਮ ਸਰ ਮੂਇ ਅਜਰਾਈਲ  ਿਗਰਫਤਹ  ਿਦਲ  ਹੇਿਚ ਨ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Spouse, children, parents and siblings - none of them will be there to hold your hand.
lines.transliteration: jan pisar padar biraad araaN kas nays d astaNgeer.

lines.english: And when at last I fall, and the time of my last prayer has come, there shall be no oneto rescue me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aakhir bi-aft am kas na d aarad  chooN savad  takbeer. ||2||

lines.english: Night and day, I wandered around in greed, contemplating evil schemes.
lines.transliteration: sab roj gastam d ar havaa kard aym bad ee kh i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਖਰ  ਿਬਅਫਤਮ  ਕਸ ਨ ਦਾਰਦ  ਚੂੰ ਸਵਦ  ਤਕਬੀਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I never did good deeds; this is my condition. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gaahay na naykee kaar kardam mam eeN chinee ahvaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬ ਰੋਜ ਗਸਤਮ  ਦਰ ਹਵਾ ਕਰਦੇਮ  ਬਦੀ ਿਖਆਲ  ॥
lines.english: I am unfortunate, miserly, negligent, shameless and without the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: badbakh at ham cho bakh eel gaafil baynajar baybaak.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਹੇ ਨ ਨੇਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਮ ਮਮ ਈ ਿਚਨੀ  ਅਹਵਾਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am Your humble servant, the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||1|| iqlµg mhlw 1 Gru 2  (721-10) tilang mehlaa 1 gh ar 2 Tilang, First Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (721-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak bugoyad jan t uraa t ayray chaakraaN paa kh aak. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਦਬਖਤ  ਹਮ ਚੁ ਬਖੀਲ  ਗਾਿਫਲ  ਬੇਨਜਰ  ਬੇਬਾਕ  ॥
lines.english: The Fear of You, O Lord God, is my marijuana; my consciousness is the pouch which holds it.
lines.transliteration: bha-o t ayraa bh aaNg khalrhee mayraa cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੁਗੋਯਦ  ਜਨੁ ਤੁਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਾਕਰ  ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I have become an intoxicated hermit.
lines.transliteration: mai dayvaanaa bh a-i-aa at eet.

lines.english: My hands are my begging bowl; I am so hungry for the Blessed Vision of YourDarshan.
lines.transliteration: kar kaasaa darsan kee bh ookh.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗ ਖਲੜੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: I beg at Your Door, day after day. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mai dar maaga-o neet aa neet . ||1||

lines.english: I long for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: ta-o d arsan kee kara-o samaa-ay.

lines.english: I am a beggar at Your Door - please bless me with Your charity. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai dar maagat  bheekhi-aa paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Saffron, flowers, musk oil and gold embellish the bodies of all.
lines.transliteration: kaysar kusam mirgamai harnaa sarab sareeree charhHnaa.

lines.english: The Lord's devotees are like sandalwood, which imparts its fragrance to everyone. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chandan bh agtaa jot  inayhee sarbay parmal karn aa. ||2||

lines.english: No one says that ghee or silk are polluted.
lines.transliteration: ghi-a pat bh aaNdaa kahai na ko-ay.

lines.english: Such is the Lord's devotee, no matter what his social status is.
lines.transliteration: aisaa bhagat  varan meh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸਿਰ  ਕੁਸਮ  ਿਮਰਗਮੈ  ਹਰਣਾ  ਸਰਬ ਸਰੀਰੀ  ਚੜਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who bow in reverence to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain absorbed inYour Love.
lines.transliteration: tayrai naam nivay rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਜੋਿਤ ਇਨੇਹੀ  ਸਰਬੇ  ਪਰਮਲੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for charity at their door. ||3||1||2|| iqlµg mhlw 1 Gru 3  (721-16) tilang mehlaa 1 gh ar 3 Tilang, First Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (721-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin d ar bheekhi-aa paa-ay. ||3||1||2||

lines.english: This body fabric is conditioned by Maya, O beloved; this cloth is dyed in greed. pMnw 722
lines.transliteration: ih tan maa-i-aa paahi-aa pi-aaray leet -rhaa lab rangaa-ay.

lines.english: My Husband Lord is not pleased by these clothes, O Beloved; how can the soul-bride go to His bed? ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayrai kant na bh aavai cholrh aa pi-aaray ki-o Dh an sayjai jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਕਉ  ਧਨ ਸੇਜੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, O Dear Merciful Lord; I am a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: haN-u kurbaanai jaa-o miharvaanaa haN-u kurbaanai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ  ਜਾਉ  ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨਾ  ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who take to Your Name.
lines.transliteration: haN-u kurbaanai jaa-o tinaa kai lain jo t ayraa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ  ਜਾਉ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੈ ਲੈਿਨ  ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Unto those who take to Your Name, I am forever a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lain jo tayraa naa-o t inaa kai haN-u sad  kurbaanai jaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲੈਿਨ  ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If the body becomes the dyer's vat, O Beloved, and the Name is placed within it asthe dye,
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa ranyan  jay thee-ai pi-aaray paa-ee-ai naa-o majeeth .
ranyan  vaalaa jay rany ai saahib aisaa rang na deeth . ||2|| and if the Dyer who dyes this cloth is the Lord Master - O, such a color has neverbeen seen before! ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਰੰਙਿਣ  ਜੇ ਥੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਉ  ਮਜੀਠ  ॥
lines.english: Those whose shawls are so dyed, O Beloved, their Husband Lord is always with them.
lines.transliteration: jin kay cholay rat-rh ay pi-aaray kant  tinaa kai paas.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਙਣ  ਵਾਲਾ  ਜੇ ਰੰਙੈ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਐਸਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhoorh  tinaa kee jay milai jee kaho naanak kee ard aas. ||3|| Bless me with the dust of those humble beings, O Dear Lord. Says Nanak, this is my prayer. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਚੋਲੇ ਰਤੜੇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਕੰਤੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੈ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself creates, and He Himself imbues us. He Himself bestows His Glance ofGrace.
lines.transliteration: aapay saajay aapay rangay aapay nadar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਿੜ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੀ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਜੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the soul-bride becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, He Himself enjoysher. ||4||1||3|| iqlµg mÚ 1 ] (722-6) tilang mehlaa 1. Tilang, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman kant ai bhaavai aapay hee raavay-ay. ||4||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ  ਰੰਗੇ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: O foolish and ignorant soul-bride, why are you so proud?
lines.transliteration: i-aanrhee-ay maanrh aa kaa-ay karayhi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਰਾਵੇਇ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: Within the home of your own self, why do you not enjoy the Love of your Lord?
lines.transliteration: aapnarhai gh ar har rango kee na maan eh.

lines.english: Your Husband Lord is so very near, O foolish bride; why do you search for Himoutside?
lines.transliteration: saho nayrhai Dh an kammlee-ay baahar ki-aa dh oodhayhi.

lines.english: Apply the Fear of God as the maascara to adorn your eyes, and make the Love of theLord your ornament.
lines.transliteration: bhai kee-aa d eh salaa-ee-aa nain ee bh aav kaa kar seegaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨੜੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੋ ਕੀ ਨ ਮਾਣੇਿਹ॥
lines.english: Then, you shall be known as a devoted and committed soul-bride, when you enshrine love for your Husband Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa sohagan  jaanee-ai laagee jaa saho Dh aray pi-aaro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਮਲੀਏ  ਬਾਹਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਢੂਢੇਿਹ॥
lines.english: What can the silly young bride do, if she is not pleasing to her Husband Lord?
lines.transliteration: i-aanee baalee ki-aa karay jaa Dh an kant  na bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਕੀਆ  ਦੇਿਹ ਸਲਾਈਆ  ਨੈਣੀ  ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਿਰ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: She may plead and implore so many times, but still, such a bride shall not obtain theMansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: karan palaah karay bahut ayray saa Dh an mahal na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the karma of good deeds, nothing is obtained, although she may run aroundfrantically.
lines.transliteration: vin karmaa kichh  paa-ee-ai naahee jay bahut ayraa Dh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਆਣੀ  ਬਾਲੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: She is intoxicated with greed, pride and egotism, and engrossed in Maya.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh ahaNkaar kee maat ee maa-i-aa maahi samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਹ  ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: She cannot obtain her Husband Lord in these ways; the young bride is so foolish!||2||
lines.transliteration: inee baatee saho paa-ee-ai naahee bh a-ee kaaman  i-aan ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Go and ask the happy, pure soul-brides, how did they obtain their Husband Lord?
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay puchhahu sohaagan ee vaahai kinee baat ee saho paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ  ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord does, accept that as good; do away with your own cleverness andself-will.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so bh alaa kar maanee-ai hikmat  hukam chukh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਨੀ  ਬਾਤੀ  ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਭਈ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਇਆਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By His Love, true wealth is obtained; link your consciousness to His lotus feet.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai paraym padaarath paa-ee-ai t a-o charn ee chit  laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਵਾਹੈ ਿਕਨੀ  ਬਾਤੀ  ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: As your Husband Lord directs, so you must act; surrender your body and mind to Him, and apply this perfume to yourself.
lines.transliteration: saho kahai so keejai tan mano d eejai aisaa parmal laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੀਐ  ਿਹਕਮਿਤ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks the happy soul-bride, O sister; in this way, the Husband Lord is obtained.||3||
lines.transliteration: ayv kaheh sohaaganee bh ainay inee baat ee saho paa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਤਉ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Give up your selfhood, and so obtain your Husband Lord; what other clever tricks areof any use?
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-ee-ai taa saho paa-ee-ai a-or kaisee chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਕੀਜੈ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ  ਐਸਾ ਪਰਮਲੁ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: When the Husband Lord looks upon the soul-bride with His Gracious Glance, that dayis historic - the bride obtains the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: saho nadar kar d aykhai so d in laykh ai kaaman  na-o niDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਵ ਕਹਿਹ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਭੈਣੇ ਇਨੀ  ਬਾਤੀ  ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: She who is loved by her Husband Lord, is the true soul-bride; O Nanak, she is thequeen of all.
lines.transliteration: aapnay kant  pi-aaree saa sohagan  naanak saa sabh raa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈਐ  ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ॥
lines.english: Thus she is imbued with His Love, intoxicated with delight; day and night, she isabsorbed in His Love.
lines.transliteration: aisay rang raatee sahj kee maat ee ahinis bh aa-ay samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋ ਿਦਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: She is beautiful, glorious and brilliant; she is known as truly wise. ||4||2||4|| iqlµg mhlw 1 ] (722-16) tilang mehlaa 1. Tilang, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sundar saa-ay saroop bichkh an kahee-ai saa si-aan ee. ||4||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੇ  ਕੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: As the Word of the Forgiving Lord comes to me, so do I express it, O Lalo.
lines.transliteration: jaisee mai aavai khasam kee ban ee taisrhaa karee gi-aan vay laalo.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜ  ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਭਾਇ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Bringing the marriage party of sin, Babar has invaded from Kaabul, demanding our land as his wedding gift, O Lalo.
lines.transliteration: paap kee janj lai kaablahu Dh aa-i-aa joree mangai d aan vay laalo.

lines.english: Modesty and righteousness both have vanished, and falsehood struts around like aleader, O Lalo.
lines.transliteration: saram Dharam d u-ay chh ap kh alo-ay koorh  firai parDh aan vay laalo.

lines.english: The Qazis and the Brahmins have lost their roles, and Satan now conducts themarriage rites, O Lalo.
lines.transliteration: kaajee-aa baamnaa kee gal thakee agad  parhai sait aan vay laalo.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮੈ ਆਵੈ  ਖਸਮ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਤੈਸੜਾ ਕਰੀ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Muslim women read the Koran, and in their misery, they call upon God, O Lalo.
lines.transliteration: musalmaanee-aa parheh kat aybaa kasat meh karahi kh udaa-ay vay laalo.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਕੀ ਜੰਞ ਲੈ ਕਾਬਲਹੁ ਧਾਇਆ  ਜੋਰੀ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Hindu women of high social status, and others of lowly status as well, are put into the same category, O Lalo. pMnw 723
lines.transliteration: jaat sanaat ee hor hid vaanee-aa ayhi bh ee laykh ai laa-ay vay laalo.

lines.english: The wedding songs of murder are sung, O Nanak, and blood is sprinkled instead of saffron, O Lalo. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khoon kay sohilay gavee-ah naanak rat  kaa kungoo paa-ay vay laalo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਖੂਨ ਕੇ ਸੋਿਹਲੇ  ਗਾਵੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਤੁ ਕਾ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਪਾਇ  ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord and Master in the city of corpses, andvoices this account.
lines.transliteration: saahib kay gun naanak gaavai maas puree vich aakh  masolaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਮਾਸ ਪੁਰੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਖੁ  ਮਸੋਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created, and attached the mortals to pleasures, sits alone, and watches this.
lines.transliteration: jin upaa-ee rang ravaa-ee baithaa vaykh ai vakh  ikaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਪਾਈ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਵਾਈ  ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਖ ਇਕੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master is True, and True is His justice. He issues His Commandsaccording to His judgement.
lines.transliteration: sachaa so saahib sach tapaavas sachrh aa ni-aa-o karayg masolaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ  ਸਚੜਾ  ਿਨਆਉ  ਕਰੇਗੁ  ਮਸੋਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The body-fabric will be torn apart into shreds, and then India will remember these words.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kaparh tuk tuk hosee hind usataan samaalsee bolaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਪੜੁ  ਟੁਕੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਿਹਦੁਸਤਾਨ ੁ ਸਮਾਲਸੀ ਬੋਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Coming in seventy-eight (1521 A.D.), they will depart in ninety-seven (1540 A.D.), andthen another disciple of man will rise up.
lines.transliteration: aavan ath-t arai jaan sat aanvai hor bh ee uth see marad  kaa chaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਨ  ਅਠਤਰੈ  ਜਾਿਨ  ਸਤਾਨਵੈ  ਹੋਰੁ ਭੀ ਉਠਸੀ  ਮਰਦ  ਕਾ ਚੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the Word of Truth; he proclaims the Truth at this, the right time.||2||3||5|| iqlµg mhlw 4 Gru 2  (723-6) tilang mehlaa 4 gh ar 2 Tilang, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (723-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sach kee banee naanak aakh ai sach sun aa-isee sach kee baylaa. ||2||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਖੈ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ  ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ  ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: Everyone comes by Command of the Lord and Master. The Hukam of His Commandextends to all.
lines.transliteration: sabh aa-ay hukam kh asmaahu hukam sabh  vartanee.

lines.english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His play. The Lord is the Master of all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach saahib saachaa khayl sabh  har Dh anee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਆਏ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਖਸਮਾਹੁ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਭ ਵਰਤਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: So praise the True Lord; the Lord is the Master over all.
lines.transliteration: saalaahihu sach sabh oopar har Dh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਖੇਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one is equal to Him; am I of any account? ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis naahee ko-ay sareek kis laykhai ha-o ganee. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲਾਿਹਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੀ ॥
lines.english: Air, water, earth and sky - the Lord has made these His home and temple.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee Dh artee aakaas gh ar mand ar har banee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਿਕਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਗਨੀ॥
lines.english: He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Nanak. Tell me: what can be counted as false? ||2||1|| iqlµg mhlw 4 ] (723-9) tilang mehlaa 4. Tilang, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vich vartai naanak aap jh ooth kaho ki-aa ganee. ||2||1||

lines.english: The evil-minded person continually does fruitless deeds, all puffed up with pride.
lines.transliteration: nit nihfal karam kamaa-ay bafaavai d urmat ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਆਕਾਸੁ  ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਹਿਰ ਬਨੀ॥
lines.english: When he brings home what he has acquired, by practicing deception and falsehood,he thinks that he has conquered the world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jab aanai valvanch kar jh ooth tab jaan ai jag jit ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਨਾਨਕ ਆਿਪ  ਝੂਠੁ ਕਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਗਨੀ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: Such is the drama of the world, that he does not contemplate the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: aisaa baajee saisaar na chaytai har naamaa.

lines.english: In an instant, all this false play shall perish; O my mind, meditate on the Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khin meh binsai sabh  jhooth mayray man Dh i-aa-ay raamaa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: He does not think of that time, when Death, the Torturer, shall come and seize him.
lines.transliteration: saa vaylaa chit na aavai jit  aa-ay kantak kaal garsai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਆਣੈ  ਵਲਵੰਚ  ਕਿਰ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਬ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਗੁ ਿਜਤੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord saves that one, within whose heart the Lord, in His Kind Mercy,dwells. ||2||2|| iqlµg mhlw 5 Gru 1  (723-13) tilang mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 Tilang, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (723-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: tis naanak la-ay chh adaa-ay jis kirpaa kar hird ai vasai. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord infused His Light into the dust, and created the world, the universe.
lines.transliteration: khaak noor kard aN aalam d unee-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਿਧਆਇ  ਰਾਮਾ॥
lines.english: The sky, the earth, the trees, and the water - all are the Creation of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asmaan jimee darkh at aab paid aa-is kh udaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O human being, whatever you can see with your eyes, shall perish.
lines.transliteration: banday chasam d eedaN fanaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਜਤੁ ਆਇ  ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਗਰ੍ਸੈ ॥
lines.english: The world eats dead carcasses, living by neglect and greed. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: duneeN-aa murd aar kh urdanee gaafal havaa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Like a goblin, or a beast, they kill and eat the forbidden carcasses of meat.
lines.transliteration: gaibaan haivaan haraam kustanee murd aar bakh oraa-ay.

lines.english: So control your urges, or else you will be seized by the Lord, and thrown into the tortures of hell. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dil kabaj kabjaa kaad ro dojak sajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Your benefactors, presents, companions, courts, lands and homes
lines.transliteration: valee ni-aamat biraad araa d arbaar milak kh aanaa-ay.
jab ajraa-eel bastanee t ab chay kaaray bid aa-ay. ||3|| - when Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death seizes you, what good will these be to youthen? ||3||

lines.english: The Pure Lord God knows your condition.
lines.transliteration: havaal maaloom kardaN paak alaah.

lines.english: O Nanak, recite your prayer to the holy people. ||4||1|| iqlµg Gru 2 mhlw 5 ] (723-18) tilang gh ar 2 mehlaa 5. Tilang, Second House, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bugo naanak ardaas pays d arvays band aah. ||4||1||

lines.english: There is no other than You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੈਬਾਨ  ਹੈਵਾਨ  ਹਰਾਮ  ਕੁਸਤਨੀ  ਮੁਰਦਾਰ  ਬਖੋਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Creator; whatever You do, that alone happens.
lines.transliteration: too kart aar karahi so ho-ay.

lines.english: You are the strength, and You are the support of the mind.
lines.transliteration: tayraa jor t ayree man tayk.

lines.english: Forever and ever, meditate, O Nanak, on the One. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa jap naanak ayk. ||1||

lines.english: The Great Giver is the Supreme Lord God over all.
lines.transliteration: sabh oopar paarbarahm d aataar.

lines.english: You are our support, You are our sustainer. ||Pause|| pMnw 724
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk t ayraa aaDh aar. rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are, You are, and You shall ever be, O inaccessible, unfathomable, lofty and infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: hai toohai t oo hovanhaar. agam agaaDh  ooch aapaar.

lines.english: Those who serve You, are not touched by fear or suffering.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  sayveh t in bha-o dukh naahi.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak gun  gaahi. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever is seen, is Your form, O treasure of virtue, O Lord of the Universe, O Lord ofincomparable beauty.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so t ayraa roop. gun  niDhaan govind  anoop.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਭਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering, remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, His humble servantbecomes like Him.
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar jan so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, we obtain Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak karam paraapat ho-ay. ||3||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin japi-aa tis ka-o balihaar.

lines.english: Associating with them, the whole world is saved.
lines.transliteration: tis kai sang t arai sansaar.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God fulfills our hopes and aspirations.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh lochaa poor.

lines.english: I long for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||2|| iqlµg mhlw 5 Gru 3 ] (724-4) tilang mehlaa 5 gh ar 3. Tilang, Fifth Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee baachh a-o Dh oor. ||4||2||

lines.english: Merciful, the Lord Master is Merciful.
lines.transliteration: miharvaan saahib miharvaan.

lines.english: My Lord Master is Merciful.
lines.transliteration: saahib mayraa miharvaan.

lines.english: He gives His gifts to all beings. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a sagal ka-o day-ay d aan. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Why do you waver, O mortal being? The Creator Lord Himself shall protect you.
lines.transliteration: too kaahay doleh paraan ee-aa t uDh raakh aigaa sirjan haar.

lines.english: He who created you, will also give you nourishment. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin paidaa-is t oo kee-aa so-ee d ay-ay aaDh aar. ||1||

lines.english: The One who created the world, takes care of it.
lines.transliteration: jin upaa-ee maydnee so-ee kard aa saar.

lines.english: In each and every heart and mind, the Lord is the True Cherisher. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at maalak d ilaa kaa sachaa parvard agaar. ||2||

lines.english: His creative potency and His value cannot be known; He is the Great and carefree Lord.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  keem na jaan ee-ai vadaa vayparvaahu.

lines.english: O human being, meditate on the Lord, as long as there is breath in your body. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar banday t oo band agee jichar gh at meh saahu. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਾਹੇ ਡੋਲਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖੈਗਾ  ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: O God, You are all-powerful, inexpressible and imperceptible; my soul and body areYour capital.
lines.transliteration: too samrath akath agochar jee-o pind t ayree raas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੈਦਾਇਿਸ  ਤੂ ਕੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Your Mercy, may I find peace; this is Nanak's lasting prayer. ||4||3|| iqlµg mhlw 5 Gru 3 ] (724-10) tilang mehlaa 5 gh ar 3. Tilang, Fifth Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: raham tayree sukh  paa-i-aa sad aa naanak kee ard aas. ||4||3||

lines.english: O Creator, through Your creative potency, I am in love with You.
lines.transliteration: kartay kud ratee must aak.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਮਾਲਕੁ  ਿਦਲਾ  ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You alone are my spiritual and temporal Lord; and yet, You are detached from all Your creation. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d unee-aa ayk t oohee sabh  khalak hee t ay paak. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. Wondrous is Your form!
lines.transliteration: khin maahi thaap uthaapad aa aacharaj t ayray roop.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੂ ਬੰਦਗੀ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Who can know Your play? You are the Light in the darkness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ka-un jaan ai chalat  tayray anDh i-aaray meh d eep. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਅਕਥੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Master of Your creation, the Lord of all the world, O Merciful Lord God.
lines.transliteration: khud khasam kh alak jahaan alah miharvaan kh udaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਮ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: One who worships You day and night - why should he have to go to hell? ||2||
lines.transliteration: dinas rain  je tuDh araaDh ay so ki-o d ojak jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, is the friend of the human being who has Yoursupport, Lord.
lines.transliteration: ajraa-eel yaar banday jis t ayraa aaDh aar.

lines.english: His sins are all forgiven; Your humble servant gazes upon Your Vision. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gunah us kay sagal aafoo tayray jan d aykheh deedaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਲਕ  ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: All worldly considerations are for the present only. True peace comes only from Your Name.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa cheej filhaal saglay sach sukh  tayraa naa-o.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, Nanak understands; He sings only Your Praises forever, O Lord.||4||4|| iqlµg mhlw 5 ] (724-15) tilang mehlaa 5. Tilang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur mil naanak boojhi-aa sad aa aykas gaa-o. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪਦਾ  ਆਚਰਜ  ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ॥
lines.english: Think of the Lord in your mind, O wise one.
lines.transliteration: meeraaN daanaaN dil soch.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਚਲਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਅੰਿਧਆਰੇ  ਮਿਹ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Enshrine love for the True Lord in your mind and body; He is the Liberator frombondage. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: muhabtay man t an basai sach saah band ee moch. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਿਦ ਖਸਮ  ਖਲਕ  ਜਹਾਨ  ਅਲਹ  ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The value of seeing the Vision of the Lord Master cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: deednay d eedaar saahib kachh  nahee is kaa mol.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਜ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ  ਸੋ ਿਕਉ ਦੋਜਿਕ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Pure Cherisher; You Yourself are the great and immeasurable Lord andMaster. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paak parvardagaar t oo kh ud khasam vadaa at ol. ||1||

lines.english: Give me Your help, O brave and generous Lord; You are the One, You are the OnlyLord.
lines.transliteration: dastgeeree d eh dilaavar t oohee t oohee ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨਹ  ਉਸ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ  ਆਫੂ  ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਿਹ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Creator Lord, by Your creative potency, You created the world; Nanak holds tight to Your support. ||2||5|| iqlµg mhlw 1 Gru 2  (724-19) tilang mehlaa 1 gh ar 2 Tilang, First Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (724-19) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kartaar kud rat karan  khaalak naanak t ayree tayk. ||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਚੀਜ ਿਫਲਹਾਲ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created the world watches over it; what more can we say, O Siblings ofDestiny? pMnw 725
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tin d aykhi-aa ki-aa kahee-ai ray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਵਾੜੀ  ਹੈ ਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself knows, and He Himself acts; He laid out the garden of the world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai karay aap jin vaarh ee hai laa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਇਸਾ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਕਾ ਰਾਇਸਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Savor the story, the story of the Beloved Lord, which brings a lasting peace. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raa-isaa pi-aaray kaa raa-isaa jit sad aa sukh  ho-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: She who does not enjoy the Love of her Husband Lord, shall come to regret and repent in the end.
lines.transliteration: jin rang kant na raavi-aa saa pachh o ray t aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਰੰਿਗ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਿਵਆ  ਸਾ ਪਛੋ ਰੇ ਤਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: She wrings her hands, and bangs her head, when the night of her life has passedaway. ||2||
lines.transliteration: haath pachhorh ay sir Dh unai jab rain  vihaan ee. ||2||

lines.english: Nothing comes from repentance, when the game is already finished.
lines.transliteration: pachhot aavaa naa milai jab chookaigee saaree.

lines.english: She shall have the opportunity to enjoy her Beloved, only when her turn comes again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa fir pi-aaraa raavee-ai jab aavaigee vaaree. ||3||

lines.english: The happy soul-bride attains her Husband Lord - she is so much better than I am.
lines.transliteration: kant lee-aa sohaagan ee mai t ay vaDh vee ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਤੁ ਲੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਮੈ ਤੇ ਵਧਵੀ  ਏਹ ॥
lines.english: I have none of her merits or virtues; whom should I blame? ||4||
lines.transliteration: say gun mujh ai na aavnee kai jee d os Dh arayh. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ  ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇਹ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: I shall go and ask those sisters who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee sakhee saho raavi-aa t in poochh -ugee jaa-ay.

lines.english: I touch their feet, and ask them to show me the Path. ||5||
lines.transliteration: paa-ay laga-o bayntee kara-o lay-ugee panth bat aa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇ  ਲਗਉ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਕਰਉ  ਲੇਉਗੀ  ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਏ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: She who understands the Hukam of His Command, O Nanak, applies the Fear of God as her sandalwood oil;
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan ai naankaa bh a-o chand an laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਭਉ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gun kaaman  kaaman  karai t a-o pi-aaray ka-o paavai. ||6|| she charms her Beloved with her virtue, and so obtains Him. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: She who meets her Beloved in her heart, remains united with Him; this is truly calledunion.
lines.transliteration: jo dil mili-aa so mil rahi-aa mili-aa kahee-ai ray so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਦਿਲ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਮਿਲਆ ਕਹੀਐ  ਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: As much as she may long for Him, she shall not meet Him through mere words. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jay bahutayraa lochee-ai baat ee mayl na ho-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ  ਬਾਤੀ  ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Dhaat  milai fun Dh aat ka-o liv livai ka-o Dh aavai. As metal melts into metal again, so does love melt into love.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਫੁਿਨ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਿਲਵ ਿਲਵੈ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained, and then, one obtains the Fearless Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jaanee-ai t a-o anbh a-o paavai. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਤਉ ਅਨਭਉ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
lines.english: There may be an orchard of betel nut trees in the garden, but the donkey does notappreciate its value.
lines.transliteration: paanaa vaarhee ho-ay gh ar khar saar na jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਨਾ  ਵਾੜੀ  ਹੋਇ ਘਿਰ  ਖਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: If someone savors a fragrance, then he can truly appreciate its flower. ||9||
lines.transliteration: rasee-aa hovai musak kaa tab fool pachh aanai. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਸਕ  ਕਾ ਤਬ ਫੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: One who drinks in the ambrosia, O Nanak, abandons his doubts and wanderings.
lines.transliteration: api-o peevai jo naankaa bharam bh aram samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਪਉ  ਪੀਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Easily and intuitively, he remains blended with the Lord, and obtains the immortalstatus. ||10||1|| iqlµg mhlw 4 ] (725-10) tilang mehlaa 4. Tilang, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sehjay sehjay mil rahai amraa pad paavai. ||10||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਅਮਰਾ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru, my friend, has told me the stories and the sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kee-aa kathaa kahaanee-aa gur meet  sunaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; to the Guru, I am a sacrifice. ||1||
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay gur ka-o bal jaa-ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੀਿਤ  ਸੁਣਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Come, join with me, O Sikh of the Guru, come and join with me. You are my Guru's Beloved. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay mil gursikh aa-ay mil t oo mayray guroo kay pi-aaray. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are pleasing to the Lord; I have obtained them fromthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kay gun har bh aavday say guroo t ay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who surrender to, and obey the Guru's Will. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin gur kaa bhaan aa mani-aa t in ghum gh um jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I am dedicated and devoted to those who gaze upon the Beloved True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin satgur pi-aaraa d aykhi-aa tin ka-o ha-o vaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵਦੇ  ਸੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who perform service for the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin gur kee keetee chaakree t in sad  balihaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਿਤਨ ਘੁਿਮ ਘੁਿਮ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of sorrow.
lines.transliteration: har har tayraa naam hai d ukh maytan haaraa.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, it is obtained, and as Gurmukh, one is emancipated. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay paa-ee-ai gurmukh  nistaaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ  ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਤਨ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name, are celebrated andacclaimed.
lines.transliteration: jo har naam Dhi-aa-id ay tay jan parvaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to them, forever and ever a devoted sacrifice. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tin vitahu naanak vaari-aa sad aa sad aa kurbaanaa. ||5||

lines.english: O Lord, that alone is Praise to You, which is pleasing to Your Will, O Lord God.
lines.transliteration: saa har tayree ust at hai jo har parabh  bhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs, who serve their Beloved Lord, obtain Him as their reward. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jo gurmukh pi-aaraa sayvd ay tin har fal paavai. ||6||

lines.english: Those who cherish love for the Lord, their souls are always with God.
lines.transliteration: jinaa har saytee pirharh ee tinaa jee-a parabh  naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Chanting and meditating on their Beloved, they live in, and gather in, the Lord's Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: o-ay jap jap pi-aaraa jeevday har naam samaalay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who serve their Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh pi-aaraa sayvi-aa t in ka-o gh um jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They themselves are saved, along with their families, and through them, all the worldis saved. ||8||
lines.transliteration: o-ay aap chhutay parvaar si-o sabh  jagat  chhadaa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਜੀਵਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: My Beloved Guru serves the Lord. Blessed is the Guru, Blessed is the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur pi-aarai har sayvi-aa gur Dhan gur Dh anno.

lines.english: The Guru has shown me the Lord's Path; the Guru has done the greatest good deed. ||9|| pMnw 726
lines.transliteration: gur har maarag dasi-aa gur punn vad punno. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who serve the Guru, are the most blessed beings.
lines.transliteration: jo gursikh gur sayvd ay say punn paraan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them; He is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin ka-o vaari-aa sad aa sad aa kurbaan ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ  ਸੇ ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is pleased with the Gurmukhs, the fellowship of the companions.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sakh ee sahaylee-aa say aap har bh aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਨਾਈਆ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Court, they are given robes of honor, and the Lord Himself hugs them close in His embrace. ||11||
lines.transliteration: har dargeh painaa-ee-aa har aap gal laa-ee-aa. ||11||

lines.english: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Gurmukhs, whomeditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-id ay tin darsan d eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਪਖਾਲਦੇ  ਧੂਿੜ ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੋਿਲ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: I wash their feet, and drink in the dust of their feet, dissolved in the wash water.||12||
lines.transliteration: ham tin kay charan  pakh aalday Dh oorh ghol ghol peejai. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ  ਖਾਤੀਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੀੜੀਆ  ਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who eat betel nuts and betel leaf and apply lipstick,
lines.transliteration: paan supaaree khaat ee-aa mukh  beerh ee-aa laa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਜਿਮ ਪਕਿੜ ਚਲਾਈਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who contemplate the Name ofthe Lord, Har, Har, and keep Him enshrined in their hearts. The Guru's Sikhs are theGuru's Beloveds. ||14||
lines.transliteration: har har kaday na chayt i-o jam pakarh  chalaa-ee-aa. ||13|| but do not contemplate the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death will seize themand take them away. ||13|| ijn hir nwmw hir cyiqAw ihrdY auir Dwry ] iqn jmu nyiV n AwveI gurisK gur ipAwry ]14] (726-5, iqlµg, mÚ 4) jin har naamaa har chayti-aa hird ai ur Dh aaray. t in jam nayrh  na aavee gursikh  gur pi- aaray. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤਆ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is a treasure, known only to the few Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam niDhaan hai ko-ee gurmukh  jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖ ਗੁਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru, enjoy peace and pleasure. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak jin satgur bh ayti-aa rang ralee-aa maan ai. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is called the Giver; in His Mercy, He grants His Grace.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa aakh ee-ai t us karay pasaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਲੀਆ  ਮਾਣੈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has blessed me with the Lord's Name. ||16||
lines.transliteration: ha-o gur vitahu sad vaari-aa jin d it-rhaa naa-o. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਤੁਿਸ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਓ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed, very blessed is the Guru, who brings the Lord's message.
lines.transliteration: so Dhan guroo saabaas hai har d ay-ay sanayhaa.

lines.english: I gaze upon the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru embodied, and I blossom forth in bliss.||17||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaykh vaykh  guroo vigsi-aa gur sat gur dayhaa. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru's tongue recites Words of Ambrosial Nectar; He is adorned with the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: gur rasnaa amrit bold ee har naam suhaavee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵੇਿਖ ਵੇਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਵਗਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those Sikhs who hear and obey the Guru - all their desires depart. ||18||
lines.transliteration: jin sun sikh aa gur mani-aa t inaa bh ukh sabh  jaavee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਬੋਲਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ॥
lines.english: Some speak of the Lord's Path; tell me, how can I walk on it?
lines.transliteration: har kaa maarag aakhee-ai kaho kit  biDh jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸੁਿਣ ਿਸਖਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਿਨਆ ਿਤਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਵੀ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Name is my supplies; I will take it with me and set out. ||19||
lines.transliteration: har har tayraa naam hai har kh arach lai jaa-ee-ai. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਕਹੁ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord, are wealthy and very wise.
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh har aaraaDh i-aa say saah vad d aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਖਰਚੁ  ਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru; I am absorbed in the Words of the Guru's Teachings. ||20||
lines.transliteration: ha-o satgur ka-o sad  vaari-aa gur bachan samaan ay. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡ ਦਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Master, my Lord and Master; You are my Ruler and King.
lines.transliteration: too th aakur t oo saahibo t oohai mayraa meeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: If it is pleasing to Your Will, then I worship and serve You; You are the treasure ofvirtue. ||21||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t ayree band agee t oo gun ee gaheeraa. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਿਹਬੋ  ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is absolute; He is The One and Only; but He Himself is alsomanifested in many forms.
lines.transliteration: aapay har ik rang hai aapay baho rangee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰਾ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak, that alone is good. ||22||2|| iqlµg mhlw 9 kwPI (726-14) tilang mehlaa 9 kaafee Tilang, Ninth Mehl, Kaafee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (726-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai naankaa saa-ee gal changee. ||22||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
lines.english: If you are conscious, then be conscious of Him night and day, O mortal.
lines.transliteration: chaytnaa hai t a-o chayt  lai nis d in mai paraanee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਾਈ  ਗਲ ਚੰਗੀ ॥੨੨॥੨॥
lines.english: Each and every moment, your life is passing away, like water from a cracked pitcher. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhin chh in a-oDh  bihaat  hai footai gh at ji-o paanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Why do you not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you ignorant fool?
lines.transliteration: har gun kaahi na gaavhee moorakh agi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਤਨਾ  ਹੈ ਤਉ ਚੇਤ ਲੈ ਿਨਿਸ  ਿਦਿਨ  ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are attached to false greed, and you do not even consider death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhooth ai laalach laag kai neh maran pachh aanaa. ||1||

lines.english: Even now, no harm has been done, if you will only sing God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: ajhoo kachh bigri-o nahee jo parabh  gun gaavai.

lines.english: Says Nanak, by meditating and vibrating upon Him, you shall obtain the state offearlessness. ||2||1|| iqlµg mhlw 9 ] (726-18) tilang mehlaa 9. Tilang, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tih bh ajan t ay nirbh ai pad  paavai. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਿਹ  ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ  ਮੂਰਖ ਅਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wake up, O mind! Wake up! Why are you sleeping unaware?
lines.transliteration: jaag layho ray manaa jaag layho kahaa gaafal so-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਿਚ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਕੈ ਨਿਹ ਮਰਨੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ॥੧॥ਅਜਹ ੂ ਕਛੁ ਿਬਗਿਰਓ  ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ॥
lines.english: That body, which you were born with, shall not go along with you in the end.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo tan upji-aa sang hee so bh ee sang na ho-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਹ ਭਜਨ  ਤੇ ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ॥
lines.english: Mother, father, children and relatives whom you love,
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  banDh  jan hit  jaa si-o keenaa.
jee-o chhooti-o jab d ayh tay daar agan mai d eenaa. ||1|| will throw your body into the fire, when your soul departs from it. ||1|| pMnw 727

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਤੇ ਡਾਿਰ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਮੈ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your worldly affairs exist only as long as you are alive; know this well.
lines.transliteration: jeevat la-o bi-uhaar hai jag ka-o t um jaan-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਲਉ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; everything is like a dream. ||2||2|| iqlµg mhlw 9 ] (727-2) tilang mehlaa 9. Tilang, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har gun gaa-ay lai sabh sufan samaana-o. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਲੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਫਨ  ਸਮਾਨਉ  ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: Sing the Lord's Praises, O mind; He is your only true companion.
lines.transliteration: har jas ray manaa gaa-ay lai jo sangee hai tayro.

lines.english: Your time is passing away; listen carefully to what I say. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: a-osar beeti-o jaat  hai kahi-o maan lai mayro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗਾਇ  ਲੈ ਜੋ ਸੰਗੀ  ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
lines.english: You are so in love with property, chariots, wealth and power.
lines.transliteration: sampat rath Dh an raaj si-o at  nayhu lagaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਿਤਓ  ਜਾਤੁ  ਹੈ ਕਿਹਓ  ਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the noose of death tightens around your neck, they will all belong to others. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaal faas jab gal paree sabh bh a-i-o paraa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: Know this well, O madman - you have ruined your affairs.
lines.transliteration: jaan boojh kai baavray t ai kaaj bigaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਰਥ ਧਨ ਰਾਜ ਿਸਉ ਅਿਤ  ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: You did not restrain yourself from committing sins, and you did not eradicate yourego. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paap karat sukchi-o nahee nah garab nivaari-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਿਲ  ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਭਇਓ  ਪਰਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So listen to the Teachings imparted by the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: jih biDh gur upd aysi-aa so sun ray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਨ  ਬੂਝ ਕੈ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਤੈ ਕਾਜੁ  ਿਬਗਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak proclaims: hold tight to the Protection and the Sanctuary of God. ||3||3|| iqlµg bwxI Bgqw kI kbIr jI  (727-7) tilang ban ee bh agtaa kee kabeer jee Tilang, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (727-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat pukaar kai gahu parabh  sarnaa-ee. ||3||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ  ਸੁਕਿਚਓ  ਨਹੀ ਨਹ ਗਰਬੁ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Vedas and the Scriptures are only make-believe, O Siblings of Destiny; they donot relieve the anxiety of the heart.
lines.transliteration: bayd kat ayb ift araa bh aa-ee d il kaa fikar na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ  ਸੋ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: If you will only center yourself on the Lord, even for just a breath, then you shall see the Lord face-to-face, present before you. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuk dam karaaree ja-o karahu haajir hajoor kh udaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਹਤ ਪੁਕਾਿਰ  ਕੈ ਗਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਨਾਈ  ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.english: O human being, search your own heart every day, and do not wander around inconfusion.
lines.transliteration: banday kh oj dil har roj naa fir paraysaanee maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਲੰਗ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: This world is just a magic-show; no one will be holding your hand. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih jo dunee-aa sihar maylaa d asatgeeree naahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ  ਇਫਤਰਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਦਲ  ਕਾ ਿਫਕਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Reading and studying falsehood, people are happy; in their ignorance, they speaknonsense.
lines.transliteration: darog parh  parh khusee ho-ay baykh abar baad  bakaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਟੁਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਕਰਾਰੀ  ਜਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਾਿਜਰ  ਹਜੂਿਰ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Creator Lord is diffused into His creation; He is not just the dark-skinnedKrishna of legends. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hak sach khaalak kh alak mi-aanay si-aam moorat  naahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਦੇ ਖੋਜੁ ਿਦਲ  ਹਰ ਰੋਜ ਨਾ ਿਫਰੁ ਪਰੇਸਾਨੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Tenth Gate, the stream of nectar flows; take your bath in this.
lines.transliteration: asmaan mi-yaanay lahang daree-aa gusal kard an bood .

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਜੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਿਸਹਰੁ ਮੇਲਾ  ਦਸਤਗੀਰੀ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serve the Lord forever; use your eyes, and see Him ever-present everywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar fakar daa-im laa-ay chasmay jah t ahaa ma-ujood . ||3||

lines.english: The Lord is the purest of the pure; only through doubt could there be another.
lines.transliteration: alaah paakaN paak hai sak kara-o jay doosar ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰੋਗੁ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਖੁਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਖਬਰ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਕਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Kabeer, mercy flows from the Merciful Lord; He alone knows who acts. ||4||1|| nwmdyv jI ] (727-12) naamdayv jee. Naam Dayv Jee:
lines.transliteration: kabeer karam kareem kaa uho karai jaanai so-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ  ਖਲਕ  ਿਮਆਨੇ  ਿਸਆਮ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am blind; Your Name, O Creator Lord, is my only anchor and support.
lines.transliteration: mai anDhulay kee tayk t ayraa naam kh undkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਮਾਨ   ਿਮਯ੍ਯ੍ਨੇ ਲਹੰਗ  ਦਰੀਆ ਗੁਸਲ  ਕਰਦਨ  ਬੂਦ॥
lines.english: I am poor, and I am meek. Your Name is my only support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai gareeb mai maskeen tayraa naam hai aDh aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਫਕਰੁ ਦਾਇਮ  ਲਾਇ  ਚਸਮੇ  ਜਹ ਤਹਾ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ॥੩॥
lines.english: O beautiful Lord, benevolent and merciful Lord, You are so wealthy and generous.
lines.transliteration: kareemaaN raheemaaN alaah too ganeeN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਾਹ  ਪਾਕੰ ਪਾਕ ਹੈ ਸਕ ਕਰਉ ਜੇ ਦੂਸਰ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You are ever-present in every presence, within and before me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haajraa hajoor dar pays t ooN maneeN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਕਰੀਮ  ਕਾ ਉਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the river of life, You are the Giver of all; You are so very wealthy.
lines.transliteration: daree-aa-o t oo dihand  too bisee-aar t oo Dh anee.

lines.english: You alone give, and You alone take away; there is no other at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: deh layhi ayk t ooN digar ko nahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are wise, You are the supreme seer; how could I make You an object of thought?
lines.transliteration: tooN daanaaN tooN beenaaN mai beechaar ki-aa karee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ  ਮੈ ਮਸਕੀਨ  ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, You are the merciful Lord of forgiveness. ||3||1||2||
lines.transliteration: naamay chay su-aamee bakhsand  tooN haree. ||3||1||2||

lines.english: Hello, my friend, hello my friend. Is there any good news?
lines.transliteration: halay yaaraaN halay yaaraaN khusikh abree.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, a dedicated and devoted sacrifice, to You.
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaaN-o ha-o bal bal jaaN-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਜਰਾ  ਹਜੂਿਰ  ਦਿਰ ਪੇਿਸ ਤੂੰ ਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slavery to You is so sublime; Your Name is noble and exalted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: neekee tayree bigaaree aalay t ayraa naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Where did you come from? Where have You been? And where are You going?
lines.transliteration: kujaa aamad kujaa raft ee kujaa may ravee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਹ ਲੇਿਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਿਦਗਰ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Tell me the truth, in the holy city of Dwaarikaa. ||1||
lines.transliteration: davaarikaa nagree raas bugo-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨ  ਤੂੰ ਬੀਨ  ਮੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.english: How handsome is your turban! And how sweet is your speech.
lines.transliteration: khoob t ayree pagree meeth ay tayray bol.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਬਖਸੰਦ  ਤੂੰ ਹਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: Why are there Moghals in the holy city of Dwaarikaa? ||2||
lines.transliteration: davaarikaa nagree kaahay kay magol. ||2||

lines.english: You alone are the Lord of so many thousands of worlds.
lines.transliteration: chandeeN hajaar aalam aykal kh aanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਜਉ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Lord King, like the dark-skinned Krishna. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham chinee paatisaah saaNvlay barnaaN. ||3||

lines.english: You are the Lord of the sun, Lord Indra and Lord Brahma, the King of men.
lines.transliteration: aspat gajpat  narah narind .

lines.english: You are the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, the King, the Liberator of all. ||4||2||3|| pMnw 728 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (728-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu sUhI mhlw 1 caupdy Gru 1 (728-3) raag soohee mehlaa 1 cha-upday gh ar 1 Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House:
lines.transliteration: naamay kay savaamee meer mukand. ||4||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Wash the vessel, sit down and anoint it with fragrance; then, go out and get the milk.
lines.transliteration: bhaaNdaa Dh o-ay bais Dh oop d ayvhu t a-o dooDhai ka-o jaavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ਭਡਾ  ਧੋਇ ਬੈਿਸ ਧੂਪੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਦੂਧੈ ਕਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Add the rennet of clear consciousness to the milk of good deeds, and then, free ofdesire, let it curdle. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dooDh  karam fun surat  samaa-in  ho-ay niraas jamaavahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮ  ਫੁਿਨ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ਿਨਰਾਸ ਜਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: japahu ta ayko naamaa.

lines.english: All other actions are fruitless. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar niraafal kaamaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Let your mind be the handles, and then churn it, without sleeping.
lines.transliteration: ih man eetee haath karahu fun naytara-o need  na aavai.

lines.english: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord ,with your tongue, then the curd will be churned. In this way, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa naam japahu tab mathee-ai in biDh  amrit  paavhu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਈਟੀ  ਹਾਿਥ ਕਰਹੁ ਫੁਿਨ ਨੇਤਰ੍ਉ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Wash your mind in the pool of Truth, and let it be the vessel of the Lord; let this beyour offering to please Him.
lines.transliteration: man sampat jit sat  sar naavan  bhaavan paat ee taripat  karay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਬ ਮਥੀਐ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: That humble servant who dedicates and offers his life, and who serves in this way,remains absorbed in his Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: poojaa paraan sayvak jay sayvay inH biDh saahib ravat  rahai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਭਾਵਨ  ਪਾਤੀ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The speakers speak and speak and speak, and then they depart. There is no other tocompare to You.
lines.transliteration: kahday kaheh kahay kahi jaaveh t um sar avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਰਵਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak, lacking devotion, humbly prays: may I sing the Praises of the TrueLord. ||4||1|| sUhI mhlw 1 Gru 2  (728-10) soohee mehlaa 1 ghar 2 Soohee, First Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (728-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  heen  naanak jan jampai ha-o saalaahee sachaa so-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਦੇ  ਕਹਿਹ  ਕਹੇ ਕਿਹ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Deep within the self, the Lord abides; do not go outside looking for Him.
lines.transliteration: antar vasai na baahar jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਹਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: You have renounced the Ambrosial Nectar - why are you eating poison? ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit chh od kaahay bikh  khaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my mind,
lines.transliteration: aisaa gi-aan japahu man mayray.
hovhu chaakar saachay kayray. ||1|| rahaa-o. and become the slave of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Everyone speaks of wisdom and meditation;
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan sabh  ko-ee ravai.
baaNDhan baaNDhi-aa sabh  jag bh avai. ||2|| but bound in bondage, the whole world is wandering around in confusion. ||2||

lines.english: One who serves the Lord is His servant.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa karay so chaakar ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al rav rahi-aa so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: I am not good; no one is bad.
lines.transliteration: ham nahee changay buraa nahee ko-ay.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, He alone saves us! ||4||1||2|| pMnw 729 sUhI mhlw 1 Gru 6  (729-1) soohee mehlaa 1 ghar 6 Soohee, First Mehl, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (729-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak t aaray so-ay. ||4||1||2||

lines.english: Bronze is bright and shiny, but when it is rubbed, its blackness appears.
lines.transliteration: ujal kaihaa chilkanaa gh otim kaalrh ee mas.

lines.english: Dhoti-aa jooth  na ut rai jay sa-o Dh ovaa t is. ||1|| Washing it, its impurity is not removed, even if it is washed a hundred times. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੋਿਤਆ  ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਾ ਿਤਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They alone are my friends, who travel along with me;
lines.transliteration: sajan say-ee naal mai chald i-aa naal chalaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣ  ਸੇਈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਮੈ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਚਲੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jithai laykhaa mangee-ai t ithai kh arhay disann. ||1|| rahaa-o. and in that place, where the accounts are called for, they appear standing with me.

lines.english: There are houses, mansions and tall buildings, painted on all sides;
lines.transliteration: kothay mandap maarh ee-aa paashu chit vee-aahaa.
dhath ee-aa kamm na aavnHee vichahu sakh -nee-aahaa. ||2|| but they are empty within, and they crumble like useless ruins. ||2||

lines.english: The herons in their white feathers dwell in the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: bagaa bagay kaprhay t irath manjh  vasaNniH.

lines.english: They tear apart and eat the living beings, and so they are not called white. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ghut gh ut jee-aa kh aavnay bagay naa kahee-aniH. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਗਾ  ਬਗੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਤੀਰਥ  ਮੰਿਝ ਵਸੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: My body is like the simmal tree; seeing me, other people are fooled.
lines.transliteration: simmal rukh sareer mai maijan d aykh bhulaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਘੁਿਟ ਘੁਿਟ ਜੀਆ  ਖਾਵਣੇ  ਬਗੇ ਨਾ ਕਹੀਅਿਨ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Its fruits are useless - just like the qualities of my body. ||4||
lines.transliteration: say fal kamm na aavnHee tay gun  mai t an haNniH. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸੰਮਲ  ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮੈ ਮੈਜਨ ਦੇਿਖ ਭੁਲੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: The blind man is carrying such a heavy load, and his journey through the mountains is so long.
lines.transliteration: anDhulai bh aar uth aa-i-aa doogar vaat bahut .

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਫਲ ਕੰਿਮ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ  ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਤਿਨ ਹੰਿਨ ॥੪॥
lines.english: My eyes can see, but I cannot find the Way. How can I climb up and cross over themountain? ||5||
lines.transliteration: akhee lorh ee naa lahaa ha-o charh  langh aa kit . ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ  ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ  ਡੂਗਰ  ਵਾਟ ਬਹੁਤੁ ॥
lines.english: What good does it do to serve, and be good, and be clever?
lines.transliteration: chaakree-aa chang-aa-ee-aa avar si-aanap kit .

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਲੋੜੀ  ਨਾ ਲਹਾ ਹਉ ਚਿੜ ਲੰਘਾ  ਿਕਤੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be releasedfrom bondage. ||6||1||3|| sUhI mhlw 1 ] (729-8) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal tooN baDh aa chh uteh jit . ||6||1||3||

lines.english: Build the raft of meditation and self-discipline, to carry you across the river.
lines.transliteration: jap tap kaa banDh  bayrh ulaa jit  langh eh vahaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂੰ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਿਹ  ਿਜਤੁ  ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: There will be no ocean, and no rising tides to stop you; this is how comfortable yourpath shall be. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa sarvar naa oochhlai aisaa panth suhaylaa. ||1||
