lines.english: Your Name alone is the color, in which the robe of my body is dyed. This color is permanent, O my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayraa ayko naam manjeeth -rhaa rat aa mayraa cholaa sad  rang dh olaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਬੇੜੁਲਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਲੰਘਿਹ  ਵਹੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: My beloved friends have departed; how will they meet the Lord?
lines.transliteration: saajan chalay pi-aari-aa ki-o maylaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਨਾ ਊਛਲੈ  ਐਸਾ  ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If they have virtue in their pack, the Lord will unite them with Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jay gun hoveh ganth -rhee-ai maylaygaa so-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਜੀਠੜਾ  ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਸਦ ਰੰਗ ਢੋਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Once united with Him, they will not be separated again, if they are truly united.
lines.transliteration: mili-aa ho-ay na veechhurh ai jay mili-aa ho-ee.

lines.english: The True Lord brings their comings and goings to an end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on nivaari-aa hai saachaa so-ee. ||3||

lines.english: One who subdues and eradicates egotism, sews the robe of devotion.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar nivaari-aa seetaa hai cholaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਗੰਠੜੀਐ  ਮੇਲੇਗਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Following the Word of the Guru's Teachings, she receives the fruits of her reward, theAmbrosial Words of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee fal paa-i-aa sah kay amrit bolaa. ||4||

lines.english: Says Nanak, O soul-brides, our Husband Lord is so dear!
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sahayleeho saho kharaa pi-aaraa.

lines.english: We are the servants, the hand-maidens of the Lord; He is our True Lord and Master.||5||2||4|| sUhI mhlw 1 ] (729-14) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ham sah kayree-aa daasee-aa saachaa kh asam hamaaraa. ||5||2||4||

lines.english: Those whose minds are filled with love of the Lord, are blessed and exalted.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o bhaaNdai bh aa-o t inaa savaarasee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹ ਕੇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬੋਲਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They are blessed with peace, and their pains are forgotten.
lines.transliteration: sookhee karai pasaa-o d ookh visaarasee.

lines.english: He will undoubtedly, certainly save them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sahsaa moolay naahi sarpar taarsee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੀਆ  ਦਾਸੀਆ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: The Guru comes to meet those whose destiny is so pre-ordained.
lines.transliteration: tinHaa mili-aa gur aa-ay jin ka-o leekh i-aa.

lines.english: He blesses them with the Teachings of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naa-o d ayvai d eekhi-aa.

lines.english: Those who walk in the Will of the True Guru, never wander begging. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chaaleh satgur bh aa-ay bh aveh na bh eekhi-aa. ||2||

lines.english: And one who lives in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, why should he bow down toany other?
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o mahal hajoor doojay nivai kis.

lines.english: The gate-keeper at the Lord's Gate shall not stop him to ask any questions.
lines.transliteration: dar darvaan ee naahi moolay puchh  tis.

lines.english: And one who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace - by his words, others are emancipated as well. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhutai t aa kai bol saahib nad ar jis. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਦੇਵੈ ਦੀਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself sends out, and recalls the mortal beings; no one else gives Himadvice.
lines.transliteration: ghalay aan ay aap jis naahee d oojaa mat ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ਭਵਿਹ  ਨ ਭੀਿਖਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself demolishes, constructs and creates; He knows everything.
lines.transliteration: dhaahi usaaray saaj jaan ai sabh  so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord is the blessing, given to those who receiveHis Mercy, and His Grace. ||4||3||5|| pMnw 730 sUhI mhlw 1 ] (730-1) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naa-o naanak bakhsees nad ree karam ho-ay. ||4||3||5||

lines.english: That vessel alone is pure, which is pleasing to Him.
lines.transliteration: bhaaNdaa hachh aa so-ay jo t is bhaavsee.

lines.english: The filthiest vessel does not become pure, simply by being washed.
lines.transliteration: bhaaNdaa at  maleen  Dhotaa hachh aa na ho-isee.

lines.english: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, one obtains understanding.
lines.transliteration: guroo du-aarai ho-ay sojh ee paa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਡਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਮਲੀਣੁ  ਧੋਤਾ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: By being washed through this Gate, it becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: ayt du-aarai Dh o-ay hachh aa ho-isee.

lines.english: The Lord Himself sets the standards to differentiate between the dirty and the pure.
lines.transliteration: mailay hachhay kaa veechaar aap vart aa-isee.

lines.english: Do not think that you will automatically find a place of rest hereafter.
lines.transliteration: mat ko jaan ai jaa-ay agai paa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲੇ ਹਛੇ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: According to the actions one has committed, so does the mortal become.
lines.transliteration: jayhay karam kamaa-ay tayhaa ho-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਅਗੈ ਪਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naa-o aap vart aa-isee.

lines.english: Such a mortal departs with honor and renown; his life is embellished and redeemed, and the trumpets resound with his glory.
lines.transliteration: chali-aa pat si-o janam savaar vaajaa vaa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਆਿਪ ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Why speak of poor mortals? His glory shall echo throughout the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: maanas ki-aa vaychaaraa t ihu lok sun aa-isee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਿਲਆ  ਪਿਤ ਿਸਉ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਜਾ  ਵਾਇਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he himself shall be enraptured, and he shall save his entire ancestry.||1||4||6|| sUhI mhlw 1 ] (730-5) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap nihaal sabh kul t aarsee. ||1||4||6||

lines.english: The Yogi practices yoga, and the pleasure-seeker practices eating.
lines.transliteration: jogee hovai jogvai bhogee hovai kh aa-ay.

lines.english: The austere practice austerities, bathing and rubbing themselves at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tapee-aa hovai t ap karay t irath mal mal naa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Let me hear some news of You, O Beloved; if only someone would come and sit withme, and tell me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayraa sad -rhaa sun eejai bh aa-ee jay ko bahai alaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗਵੈ  ਭੋਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: As one plants, so does he harvest; whatever he earns, he eats.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejai so lunay jo kh atay so kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਪੀਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਨਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the world hereafter, his account is not called for, if he goes with the insignia of theLord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agai puchh na hova-ee jay san  neesaan ai jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦੜਾ  ਸੁਣੀਜੈ  ਭਾਈ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਹੈ ਅਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: According to the actions the mortal commits, so is he proclaimed.
lines.transliteration: taiso jaisaa kaadh ee-ai jaisee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: And that breath which is drawn without thinking of the Lord, that breath goes in vain.||3||
lines.transliteration: jo dam chit  na aavee so d am birthaa jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੇ ਜੋ ਖਟੇ ਸ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I would sell this body, if someone would only purchase it.
lines.transliteration: ih tan vaychee bai karee jay ko la-ay vikaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ  ਪੁਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜੇ ਸਣੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ  ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that body is of no use at all, if it does not enshrine the Name of the TrueLord. ||4||5||7|| sUhI mhlw 1 Gru 7 (730-10) soohee mehlaa 1 ghar 7 Soohee, First Mehl, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (730-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kamm na aavee jit t an naahee sachaa naa-o. ||4||5||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਸੋ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਾਢੀਐ  ਜੈਸੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Yoga is not the patched coat, Yoga is not the walking stick. Yoga is not smearing the body with ashes.
lines.transliteration: jog na khinthaa jog na dandai jog na bh asam charh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦਮੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਸੋ ਦਮੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Yoga is not the ear-rings, and not the shaven head. Yoga is not the blowing of thehorn.
lines.transliteration: jog na mundee moond mudaa-i-ai jog na siny ee vaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਬੈ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਿਵਕਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attainYoga. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anjan maahi niranjan rahee-ai jog jugat iv paa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੰਿਮ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਜਤੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
lines.english: By mere words, Yoga is not attained.
lines.transliteration: galee jog na ho-ee.

lines.english: One who looks upon all with a single eye, and knows them to be one and the same -he alone is known as a Yogi. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk darisat kar samsar jaan ai jogee kahee-ai so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਡੰਡੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਸਮ  ਚੜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Yoga is not wandering to the tombs of the dead; Yoga is not sitting in trances.
lines.transliteration: jog na baahar marhee masaan ee jog na t aarhee laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਮੁੰਦੀ ਮੂੰਿਡ ਮੁਡਾਇਐ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਸੰਙੀ  ਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Yoga is not wandering through foreign lands; Yoga is not bathing at sacred shrines ofpilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: jog na days disant ar bhavi-ai jog na t irath naa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਜਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਰੰਜਿਨ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anjan maahi niranjan rahee-ai jog jugat iv paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, doubt is dispelled, and the wandering mind is restrained.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai t aa sahsaa t ootai Dh aavat  varaj rahaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਿਰ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nectar rains down, celestial music resounds, and deep within, wisdom is obtained.
lines.transliteration: nijhar jh arai sahj Dh un laagai gh ar hee parchaa paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attainYoga. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anjan maahi niranjan rahee-ai jog jugat iv paa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ  ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, remain dead while yet alive - practice such a Yoga.
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevti-aa mar rahee-ai aisaa jog kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਦੇਿਸ ਿਦਸੰਤਿਰ  ਭਿਵਐ  ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: When the horn is blown without being blown, then you shall attain the state offearless dignity.
lines.transliteration: vaajay baajhahu siny ee vaajai t a-o nirbh a-o pad  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਜਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਰੰਜਿਨ  ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attainYoga. ||4||1||8|| sUhI mhlw 1 ] (730-18) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anjan maahi niranjan rahee-ai jog jugat t a-o paa-ee-ai. ||4||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ  ਤੂਟੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਵਰਿਜ  ਰਹਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: What scale, what weights, and what assayer shall I call for You, Lord?
lines.transliteration: ka-un t araajee kavan  tulaa t ayraa kavan  saraaf bulaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਿਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: From what guru should I receive instruction? By whom should I have Your value appraised? ||1|| pMnw 731
lines.transliteration: ka-un guroo kai peh d eekhi-aa layvaa kai peh mul karaavaa. ||1||

lines.english: O my Dear Beloved Lord, Your limits are not known.
lines.transliteration: mayray laal jee-o tayraa ant  na jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You pervade the water, the land, and the sky; You Yourself are All-pervading. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tooN jal thal mahee-al bh aripur leen aa tooN aapay sarab samaan aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਭਿਰਪੁਿਰ  ਲੀਣਾ  ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mind is the scale, consciousness the weights, and the performance of Your service isthe appraiser.
lines.transliteration: man taaraajee chit  tulaa t ayree sayv saraaf kamaavaa.

lines.english: Deep within my heart, I weigh my Husband Lord; in this way I focus myconsciousness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghat hee bh eetar so saho t olee in biDh  chit rahaavaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਤੁਲਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਰਾਫੁ  ਕਮਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the balance, the weights and the scale; You Yourself are theweigher.
lines.transliteration: aapay kandaa tol t araajee aapay t olanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਰਹਾਵਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself see, and You Yourself understand; You Yourself are the trader. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay daykh ai aapay boojh ai aapay hai van jaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕੰਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The blind, low class wandering soul, comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.
lines.transliteration: anDhulaa neech jaat  pardaysee kh in aavai t il jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ  ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In its company, Nanak dwells; how can the fool attain the Lord? ||4||2||9|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 4 Gru 1  (731-6) raag soohee mehlaa 4 ghar 1 Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (731-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: taa kee sangat  naanak rahd aa ki-o kar moorh aa paavai. ||4||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੁਲਾ  ਨੀਚ ਜਾਿਤ  ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਿਖਨੁ ਆਵੈ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: My mind worships and adores the Lord's Name, through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man raam naam aaraaDhi-aa gur sabad  guroo gur kay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਰਹਦਾ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਮੂੜਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
lines.english: All the desires of my mind and body have been fulfilled; all fear of death has beendispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh ichh aa man t an pooree-aa sabh  chookaa dar jam kay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gun gaavhu raam naam har kay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: And when the Guru is pleased and satisfied, the mind is instructed; it then joyfullydrinks in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai man parboDh i-aa har pee-aa ras gatkay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਇਛਾ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕਾ  ਡਰੁ ਜਮ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru, is sublime and exalted. Theysing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  ootam sat gur kayree gun gaavai har parabh  kay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: Bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat; I wash the feet ofYour humble servants. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa Dhaar maylhu sat sangat  ham Dh ovah pag jan kay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਿਧਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪੀਆ  ਰਸੁ ਗਟਕੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is all. The Lord's Name is the essence of the Guru's Teachings, the juice, the sweetness of it.
lines.transliteration: raam naam sabh hai raam naamaa ras gurmat  ras raskay.

lines.english: I have found the Ambrosial Nectar, the Divine Water of the Lord's Name, and all mythirst for it is quenched. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har amrit har jal paa-i-aa sabh  laathee t is tis kay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਊਤਮ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, is my social status and honor; I have sold my head to theGuru.
lines.transliteration: hamree jaat paat  gur sat gur ham vaychi-o sir gur kay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਹਮ ਧੋਵਹ  ਪਗ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is called the chaylaa, the disciple of the Guru; O Guru, save the honorof Your servant. ||4||1|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (731-12) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam pari-o gur chaylaa gur raakho laaj jan kay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ  ਰਸੁ ਗੁ ਰਮਿਤ  ਰਸੁ ਰਸਕੇ  ॥
lines.english: I chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord God, the Supreme Being, Har, Har; mypoverty and problems have all been eradicated.
lines.transliteration: har har naam bhaji-o purkh otam sabh  binsay d aalad  dalghaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ  ਿਤਸ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The fear of birth and death has been erased, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad;serving the Unmoving, Unchanging Lord, I am absorbed in peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-o janam marn aa mayti-o gur sabd ee har asthir sayv sukh  samgh aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੀ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਪਾਿਤ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਵੇਿਚਓ  ਿਸਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the most Beloved, Darling Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man bhaj raam naam at  pirgh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਰਓ  ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ  ਗੁਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ  ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I have dedicated my mind and body, and placed them in offering before the Guru; I have sold my head to the Guru, for a very dear price. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai man tan arap Dh ari-o gur aagai sir vaych lee-o mul mahgh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The kings and the rulers of men enjoy pleasures and delights, but without the Nameof the Lord, death seizes and dispatches them all.
lines.transliteration: narpat raajay rang ras maan eh bin naavai pakarh  kharhay sabh  kalgh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਿਜਓ  ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ  ਸਿਭ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਦਾਲਦ  ਦਲਘਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay sir dand lagaanaa fir pachh utaanay hath falgh aa. ||2|| The Righteous Judge of Dharma strikes them over the heads with his staff, and whenthe fruits of their actions come into their hands, then they regret and repent. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਮੇਿਟਓ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਿਖ ਸਮਘਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Save me, save me, Lord; I am Your humble servant, a mere worm. I seek theProtection of Your Sanctuary, O Primal Lord, Cherisher and Nourisher.
lines.transliteration: har raakh raakh  jan kiram t umaaray sarn aagat  purakh  partipalagh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਰਘਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Saint's Darshan, that I may find peace. O God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: darsan sant  dayh sukh  paavai parabh  loch poor jan t umgh aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਿਰਓ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਿਸਰੁ ਵੇਿਚ ਲੀਓ  ਮੁਿਲ ਮਹਘਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the All-powerful, Great, Primal God, my Lord and Master. O Lord, please blessme with the gift of humility.
lines.transliteration: tum samrath purakh  vaday parabh  su-aamee mo ka-o keejai d aan har nimgh aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and is at peace; I amforever a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (731-19) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam milai sukh paavai ham naam vitahu sad  ghumgh aa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਪਿਤ  ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਕਿੜ  ਖੜੇ ਸਿਭ ਕਲਘਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Love of the Lord. The Lord's Love is the permanent color.
lines.transliteration: har naamaa har rany hai har rany  majeeth ai rany .

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ਿਫਿਰ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ  ਹਥ ਫਲਘਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the Guru is totally satisfied and pleased, He colors us with the Lord's Love; this color shall never fade away. ||1|| pMnw 732
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai har rang chaarh i-aa fir bahurh  na hovee bh any. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har raam naam kar rany.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਕਿਰ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
lines.english: The Guru, satisfied and pleased, taught me about the Lord, and my Sovereign Lord King met with me at once. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai har upd aysi-aa har bh ayti-aa raa-o nisany . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ ਹਿਰ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਰਾਉ ਿਨਸੰਙੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is like the ignorant bride, who comes and goes again andagain in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: munDh i-aan ee manmukh ee fir aavan  jaanaa any .

lines.english: The Lord God does not come into her consciousness, and her mind is stuck in the loveof duality. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har parabh chit  na aa-i-o man d oojaa bh aa-o sahlanny . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਅੰਙੁ ॥
lines.english: I am full of filth, and I practice evil deeds; O Lord, save me, be with me, merge meinto Your Being!
lines.transliteration: ham mail bharay d uhchaaree-aa har raakh o angee any .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਮਿਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਸਹਲੰਙੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar, and all my dirty sins andmistakes have been washed away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur amrit sar navlaa-i-aa sabh  laathay kilvikh  pany . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਗੀ  ਅੰਙੁ ॥
lines.english: O Lord God, Merciful to the meek and the poor, please unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: har deenaa d een d a-i-aal parabh  satsangat  maylhu sany .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਿਰ ਨਵਲਾਇਆ  ਸਿਭ ਲਾਥੇ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਪੰਙੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Joining the Sangat, servant Nanak has obtained the Lord's Love; my mind and bodyare drenched in it. ||4||3|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (732-5) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mil sangat har rang paa-i-aa jan naanak man t an rany . ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੀਨਾ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਙੁ ॥
lines.english: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, while constantly practicingdeception, shall never become pure of heart.
lines.transliteration: har har karahi nit kapat kamaaveh hird aa suDh  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਰੰਙੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: He may perform all sorts of rituals, night and day, but he shall not find peace, even indreams. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din karam karahi bahut ayray supnai sukh  na ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O wise ones, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee gur bin bhagat  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The untreated cloth does not take up the dye, no matter how much everyone maywish it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: korai rang kaday na charh ai jay lochai sabh  ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh may perform chants, meditations, austere self-discipline,fasts and devotional worship, but his sickness does not go away.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam varat  karay poojaa manmukh  rog na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Deep within him is the sickness of excessive egotism; in the love of duality he is ruined. ||2||
lines.transliteration: antar rog mahaa abh imaanaa d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Outwardly, he wears religious robes and he is very clever, but his mind wanders in theten directions.
lines.transliteration: baahar bhaykh  bahut  chaturaa-ee manoo-aa d ah dis Dhaavai.

lines.english: Engrossed in ego, he does not remember the Word of the Shabad; over and overagain, he is reincarnated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai bi-aapi-aa sabad na cheenHai fir fir joonee aavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਵਰਤ  ਕਰੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that mortal who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, understandsHim; that humble servant meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar karay so boojh ai so jan naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he understands the One Lord, and is absorbed into the One Lord.||4||4|| sUhI mhlw 4 Gru 2  (732-12) soohee mehlaa 4 ghar 2 Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (732-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ayko boojhai aykas maahi samaa-ay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I searched and searched the body-village;
lines.transliteration: gurmat nagree kh oj khojaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਆਿਪਆ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I found the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har naam padaarath paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined peace within my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man har har saaNt vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The fire of desire was extinguished in an instant, when I met the Guru; all my hunger has been satisfied. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tisnaa agan bujh ee kh in ant ar gur mili-ai sabh  bhukh gavaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavaa jeevaa mayree maa-ee.

lines.english: The Merciful True Guru implanted the Glor ious Praises of the Naam within me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur d a-i-aal gun  naam d arirhaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: I search for and seek out my Beloved Lord God, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: ha-o har parabh pi-aaraa dh oodh dhoodhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ  ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  mil har ras paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਿਖਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhur mast ak laykh  likhay har paa-ee. By the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I have found the Lord.
Guru Nanak, pleased and satisfied, has united me with the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.||4||1||5|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (732-17) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuth aa maylai har bh aa-ee. ||4||1||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Showering His Mercy, the Lord imbues the mind with His Love.
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa karay man har rang laa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har har naam samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mortal enjoys the pleasure of His Love.
lines.transliteration: har rang raataa man rang maan ay.

lines.english: He remains always blissful, day and night, and he merges into the Shabad, the Wordof the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee pooray gur kai sabad  samaan ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Everyone longs for the Lord's Love;
lines.transliteration: har rang ka-o lochai sabh ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rang chaloolaa ho-ee. ||2|| the Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of His Love. ||2||

lines.english: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is left pale and uncolored. pMnw 733
lines.transliteration: manmukh mugaDh  nar koraa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Even if he wishes it a hundred times, he does not obtain the Lord's Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o lochai rang na hovai ko-ay. ||3||

lines.english: But if the Lord blesses him with His Glance of Grace, then he meets the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa sat gur paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: Nanak is absorbed into the subtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||4||2||6|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (733-2) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har ras har rang samaavai. ||4||2||6||

lines.english: My tongue remains satisfied with the subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa har ras rahee aghaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh drinks it in, and merges in celestial peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh peevai sahj samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: If you taste the subtle essence of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny,
lines.transliteration: har ras jan chaakhahu jay bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਜਨ ਚਾਖਹੁ ਜੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ta-o kat  anat saad  lobhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. then how can you be enticed by other flavors? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Under Guru's Instructions, keep this subtle essence enshrined in your heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmat ras raakh o ur Dh aar.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the subtle essence of the Lord, are immersed in celestialbliss. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har ras raatay rang muraar. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh cannot even taste the subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manmukh har ras chaakh i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: He acts out in ego, and suffers terrible punishment. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karai bahutee milai sajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But if he is blessed with the Lord's Kind Mercy, then he obtains the subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa har ras paavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, absorbed in this subtle essence of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of theLord. ||4||3||7|| sUhI mhlw 4 Gru 6  (733-6) soohee mehlaa 4 ghar 6 Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (733-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak har ras har gun gaavai. ||4||3||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: When someone of low social class chants the Lord's Name, he obtains the state ofhighest dignity.
lines.transliteration: neech jaat har japt i-aa ut am pad vee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
lines.english: Go and ask Bidar, the son of a maid; Krishna himself stayed in his house. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poochhahu bid ar daasee sut ai kisan ut ri-aa gh ar jis jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: 4) har kee akath kathaa sunhu jan bhaa-ee jit  sahsaa d ookh bhookh sabh  leh jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. Listen, O humble Siblings of Destiny, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; it removesall anxiety, pain and hunger. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚ ਜਾਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪਿਤਆ  ਉਤਮ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, praised the Lord, and sang the Kirtan of His Praises each and every instant.
lines.transliteration: ravidaas chamaar ust at karay har keerat  nimakh  ik gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਿਬਦਰ  ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੁਤੈ ਿਕਸਨੁ ਉਤਿਰਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Although he was of low social status, he was exalted and elevated, and people of allfour castes came and bowed at his feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: patit jaat utam bh a-i-aa chaar varan pa-ay pag aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv loved the Lord; the people called him a fabric dyer.
lines.transliteration: naamday-a pareet  lagee har sayt ee lok chh eepaa kahai bulaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord turned His back on the high-class Kh'shaatriyas and Brahmins, and showed His face to Naam Dayv. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khatree baraahman  pith day chh oday har naamd ay-o lee-aa mukh  laa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵਦਾਸੁ  ਚਮਾਰੁ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਇਕ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: All of the devotees and servants of the Lord have the tilak, the ceremonial mark,applied to their foreheads at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: jitnay bh agat har sayvkaa mukh  athsath tirath t in tilak kadh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਉਤਮੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਵਰਨ ਪਏ ਪਿਗ  ਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak shall touch their feet night and day, if the Lord, the King, grants HisGrace. ||4||1||8|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (733-12) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin ka-o an-d in parsay jay kirpaa karay har raa-ay. ||4||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਦੇਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਛੀਪਾ  ਕਹੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone worship and adore the Lord deep within, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny from the very beginning of time.
lines.transliteration: tinHee ant ar har aaraaDh i-aa jin ka-o Dh ur likh i-aa likh at lilaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣ  ਿਪਿਠ  ਦੇ ਛੋਡੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਲੀਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What can anyone do to undermine them? My Creator Lord is on their side. ||1|| hir hir iDAwie mn myry mn iDAwie hir jnm jnm ky siB dUK invwrxhwrw ]1] rhwau ] (733- 14, sUhI, mÚ 4) har har Dhi-aa-ay man mayray man Dh i-aa-ay har janam janam kay sabh  dookh nivaaranhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o. So meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. Meditate on the Lord, O mind; He is the Eliminator of all the pains of reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tin kee bakh eelee ko-ee ki-aa karay jin kaa ang karay mayraa har kart aaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਕਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਤਲਕੁ ਕਢਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur bh agat janaa ka-o bakh si-aa har amrit  bhagat bhandaaraa. In the very beginning, the Lord blessed His devotees with the Ambrosial Nectar, thetreasure of devotion.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ  ਜੇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
lines.english: Anyone who tries to compete with them is a fool; his face shall be blackened here andhereafter. ||2||
lines.transliteration: moorakh hovai so un kee rees karay t is halat  palat  muhu kaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: They alone are devotees, and they alone are selfless servants, who love the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  say sayvkaa jinaa har naam pi-aaraa.

lines.english: By their selfless service, they find the Lord, while ashes fall on the heads of theslanderers. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin kee sayvaa t ay har paa-ee-ai sir nind ak kai pavai chh aaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ  ਕੋਈ ਿਕਆ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone knows this, who experiences it within the home of his own self. Ask GuruNanak, the Guru of the world, and reflect upon it.
lines.transliteration: jis ghar virt ee so-ee jaan ai jagat  gur naanak poochh  karahu beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਿਧਆਇ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: 4) chahu peerhee aad  jugaad  bakh eelee kinai na paa-i-o har sayvak bh aa-ay nist aaraa. ||4||2||9|| Throughout the four generations of the Gurus, from the beginning of time andthroughout the ages, no one has ever found the Lord by back-biting and undermining.Only by serving the Lord with love, is one emancipated. ||4||2||9|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (733-19) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
Wherever the Lord is worshipped in adoration, there the Lord becomes one's friend and helper. pMnw 734
lines.transliteration: jithai har aaraaDhee-ai t ithai har mit  sahaa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind; He cannot be obtained in any other way. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay har man vasai horat  biDh la-i-aa na jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਲਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So gather in the wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny,
lines.transliteration: har Dhan sanchee-ai bh aa-ee.
je halat palat  har ho-ay sakh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. so that in this world and the next, the Lord shall be your friend and companion.||1||Pause||

lines.english: In the company of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall earn the wealthof the Lord; this wealth of the Lord is not obtained anywhere else, by any othermeans, at all. hir rqnY kw vwpwrIAw hir rqn Dnu ivhwJy kcY ky vwpwrIey vwik hir Dnu lieAw n jweI ]2] (734-3, sUhI, mÚ 4) har ratnai kaa vapaaree-aa har rat an Dh an vihaajh ay kachai kay vaapaaree-ay vaak har Dhan la-i-aa na jaa-ee. ||2|| The dealer in the Lord's Jewels purchases the wealth of the Lord's jewels; the dealer in cheap glass jewels cannot acquire the Lord's wealth by empty words. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satsangt ee sang har Dh an kh atee-ai hor thai horat  upaa-ay har Dh an kit ai na paa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord's wealth is like jewels, gems and rubies. At the appointed time in the AmritVaylaa, the ambrosial hours of the morning, the Lord's devotees lovingly center theirattention on the Lord, and the wealth of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) har Dhan rat an javayhar maan ak har Dh anai naal amrit  vaylai vat ai har bh agtee har liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀਐ  ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The devotees of the Lord plant the seed of the Lord's wealth in the ambrosial hours ofthe Amrit Vaylaa; they eat it, and spend it, but it is never exhausted.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan amrit  vaylai vat ai kaa beeji-aa bh agat khaa-ay kh arach rahay nikh utai naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨੈ  ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨ  ਧਨੁ ਿਵਹਾਝੇ  ਕਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਵਾਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਲਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In this world and the next, the devotees are blessed with glorious greatness, thewealth of the Lord. ||3|| hir Dnu inrBau sdw sdw AsiQru hY swcw iehu hir Dnu AgnI qskrY pwxIAY jmdUqY iksY kw
lines.transliteration: halat palat  har Dh anai kee bh agtaa ka-o milee vadi-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Fearless Lord is permanent, forever and ever, and true. This wealth of the Lord cannot be destroyed by fire or water; neither thieves nor the Messenger ofDeath can take it away.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan nirbh a-o sad aa sad aa asthir hai saachaa ih har Dh an agnee t askarai paan ee- ai jamdoot ai kisai kaa gavaa-i-aa na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਕਾ ਬੀਿਜਆ  ਭਗਤ  ਖਾਇ  ਖਰਿਚ  ਰਹੇ ਿਨਖੁਟੈ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Thieves cannot even approach the Lord's wealth; Death, the tax collector cannot taxit. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har Dhan ka-o uchkaa nayrh  na aavee jam jaagaat ee dand na lagaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੈ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਉ ਿਮਲੀ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics commit sins and gather in their poisonous wealth, but it shall not go along with them for even a single step. hlqY ivic swkq duhyly Bey hQhu CuVik gieAw AgY pliq swkqu hir drgh FoeI n pweI ]5] (734-8, sUhI, mÚ 4) haltai vich saakat  duhaylay bh a-ay hathahu chh urhak ga-i-aa agai palat  saakat  har dargeh dh o-ee na paa-ee. ||5|| In this world, the faithless cynics become miserable, as it slips away through theirhands. In the world hereafter, the faithless cynics find no shelter in the Court of theLord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saaktee paap kar kai bikh i-aa Dh an sanchi-aa t inaa ik vikh  naal na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਿਨਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ  ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਅਗਨੀ  ਤਸਕਰੈ  ਪਾਣੀਐ  ਜਮਦੂਤੈ  ਿਕਸੈ ਕਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the Banker of this wealth, O Saints; when the Lord gives it, the mortal loads it and takes it away.
lines.transliteration: is har Dhan kaa saahu har aap hai sant ahu jis no d ay-ay so har Dh an lad  chalaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਉਚਕਾ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ  ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: ||6||3||10|| This wealth of the Lord is never exhausted; the Guru has given this understanding toservant Nanak. ||6||3||10|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (734-11) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: is har Dhanai kaa t otaa kad ay na aavee jan naanak ka-o gur sojh ee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤੀ  ਪਾਪ ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਇਕ ਿਵਖ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That mortal, with whom the Lord is pleased, repeats the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he alone is a devotee, and he alone is approved.
lines.transliteration: jis no har suparsan ho-ay so har gunaa ravai so bh agat so parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਤੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਦੁਹੇਲੇ  ਭਏ ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਿਕ ਗਇਆ  ਅਗੈ ਪਲਿਤ  ਸਾਕਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਢੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: How can his glory be described? Within his heart, the Primal Lord, the Lord God,abides. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis kee mahimaa ki-aa varnee-ai jis kai hird ai vasi-aa har purakh  bhagvaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ  ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਲਿਦ  ਚਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; focus your meditation on the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: govind gun  gaa-ee-ai jee-o laa-ay sat guroo naal Dh i-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੈ ਕਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥੬॥੩॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He is the True Guru - service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding. By thisservice, the greatest treasure is obtained.
lines.transliteration: so satguroo saa sayvaa sat gur kee safal hai jis t ay paa-ee-ai param niDh aan.

lines.english: ||2|| The faithless cynics in their love of duality and sensual desires, harbor foul-smellingurges. They are totally useless and ignorant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo doojai bh aa-ay saakat  kaamnaa arath d urganDh  sarayvd ay so nihfal sabh  agi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣਾ  ਰਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: One who has faith - his singing is approved. He is honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis no parteet  hovai t is kaa gaavi-aa thaa-ay pavai so paavai d argeh maan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਵਰਨੀਐ  ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: 4) jo bin parteet ee kaptee koorh ee koorh ee akh ee meetd ay un kaa ut ar jaa-igaa jh ooth gumaan. ||3|| Those who lack faith may close their eyes, hypocritically pretending and fakingdevotion, but their false pretenses shall soon wear off. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ  ਜੀਉ  ਲਾਇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My soul and body are totally Yours, Lord; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher ofhearts, my Primal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa jee-o pind sabh  tayraa t ooN antarjaamee purakh  bhagvaan.

lines.english: ||4||4||11|| So speaks servant Nanak, the slave of Your slaves; as You make me speak, so do Ispeak. ||4||4||11|| pMnw 735 sUhI mhlw 4 Gru 7  (735-1) soohee mehlaa 4 ghar 7 Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (735-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: daasan d aas kahai jan naanak jayhaa t ooN karaa-ihi t ayhaa ha-o karee vakh i-aan.

lines.english: Which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing and recount, Lord? You are my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.
lines.transliteration: tayray kavan kavan gun  kahi kahi gaavaa t oo saahib gun ee niDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਵਨ  ਕਵਨ  ਗੁਣ ਕਿਹ ਕਿਹ ਗਾਵਾ  ਤੂ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot express Your Glorious Praises. You are my Lord and Master, lofty andbenevolent. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumree mahimaa baran na saaka-o t ooN thaakur ooch bh agvaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਊਚ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my only support.
lines.transliteration: mai har har naam Dhar so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: If it pleases You, please save me, O my Lord and Master; without You, I have no other at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh  mayray saahib mai t ujh bin avar na ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You alone are my strength, and my Court, O my Lord and Master; unto You alone I pray.
lines.transliteration: mai taan  deebaan  toohai mayray su-aamee mai t uDh aagai ard aas.

lines.english: ||2|| There is no other place where I can offer my prayers; I can tell my pains andpleasures only to You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mai hor thaa-o naahee jis peh kara-o baynantee mayraa d ukh sukh  tujh hee paas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Water is locked up in the earth, and fire is locked up in wood.
lines.transliteration: vichay Dhart ee vichay paan ee vich kaasat agan Dh areejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The sheep and the lions are kept in one place; O mortal, meditate on the Lord, and your doubts and fears shall be removed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bakree singh ikt ai thaa-ay raakh ay man har jap bh aram bh a-o door keejai. ||3||

lines.english: So behold the glorious greatness of the Lord, O Saints; the Lord blesses thedishonored with honor. ijau DrqI crx qly qy aUpir AwvY iqau nwnk swD jnw jgqu Awix sBu pYrI pwey ]4]1]12] (735-7, sUhI, mÚ 4) ji-o Dhart ee charan  talay t ay oopar aavai t i-o naanak saaDh  janaa jagat  aan sabh pairee paa-ay. ||4||1||12|| As dust rises from underfoot, O Nanak, so does the Lord make all people fall at thefeet of the Holy. ||4||1||12|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (735-8) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kee vadi-aa-ee daykh hu sant ahu har nimaan i-aa maan  dayvaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਕਰੀ  ਿਸੰਘੁ ਇਕਤੈ  ਥਾਇ  ਰਾਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਿਰ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You Yourself, O Creator, know everything; what can I possibly tell You?
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa sabh  kichh  aapay jaan eh ki-aa t uDh peh aakh  sunaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਮਾਿਣਆ  ਮਾਣੁ  ਦੇਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: You know all the bad and the good; as we act, so are we rewarded. ||1||
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa t uDh sabh  kichh  soojh ai jayhaa ko karay t ayhaa ko paa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਚਰਣ  ਤਲੇ ਤੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਿਤਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ  ਆਿਣ  ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You alone know the state of my inner being.
lines.transliteration: mayray saahib tooN antar kee biDh  jaaneh.

lines.english: You know all the bad and the good; as it pleases You, so You make us speak. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa t uDh sabh  kichh  soojh ai tuDh bhaavai t ivai bulaaveh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਪਿਹ ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has infused the love of Maya into all bodies; through this human body, therecomes the opportunity to worship the Lord with devotion.
lines.transliteration: sabh moh maa-i-aa sareer har kee-aa vich d ayhee maanukh  bhagat karaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You unite some with the True Guru, and ble ss them with peace; while others, the self- willed manmukhs, are engrossed in worldly affairs. ||2||
lines.transliteration: iknaa satgur mayl sukh  dayveh ik manmukh  DhanDh pitaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: All belong to You, and You belong to all, O my Creator Lord; You wrote the words ofdestiny on the forehead of everyone.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t ayraa t ooN sabh naa kaa mayray kart ay tuDh sabh naa sir likh i-aa laykh .

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਬੁਲਾਵਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As You bestow Your Glance of Grace, so are mortals made; without Your GraciousGlance, no one assumes any form. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jayhee tooN nadar karahi t ayhaa ko hovai bin nad ree naahee ko bh aykh. ||3||

lines.english: You alone know Your Glorious Greatness; everyone constantly meditates on You.
lines.transliteration: tayree vadi-aa-ee t ooNhai jaan eh sabh  tuDhno nit  Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That being, with whom You are pleased, is united with You; O servant Nanak, onlysuch a mortal is accepted. ||4||2||13|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (735-14) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no tuDh  bhaavai t is no t ooN mayleh jan naanak so thaa-ay paa-ay. ||4||2||13||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਇਿਕ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਧੰਧੁ ਿਪਟਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those beings, within whose inner selves my Lord, Har, Har, dwells - all their diseases are cured.
lines.transliteration: jin kai antar vasi-aa mayraa har har t in kay sabh  rog gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਲੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: They alone become liberated, who meditate on the Name of the Lord; they obtain thesupreme status. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tay mukat  bha-ay jin har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa t in pavit  param pad  paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Lord, the Lord's humble servants become healthy.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam har jan aarog bha-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਿਨਤ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings,are rid of the disease of ego. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee jinaa japi-aa mayraa har har tin kay ha-umai rog ga-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva suffer from the disease of the three gunas - the threequalities; they do their deeds in egotism.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahaaday-o t arai gun  rogee vich ha-umai kaar kamaa-ee.

lines.english: The poor fools do not remember the One who created them; this understanding of theLord is only obtained by those who become Gurmukh. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin kee-ay tiseh na cheet eh bapurh ay har gurmukh  sojhee paa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The entire world is afflicted by the disease of egotism. They suffer the terrible pains of birth and death. pMnw 736
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog sabh jagat  bi-aapi-aa t in ka-o janam maran  dukh bhaaree.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a few rare ones are saved; I am a sacrifice to those humble beings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ko virlaa chhootai t is jan ka-o ha-o balihaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਛੂਟੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The One who created the Universe, that Lord alone knows. His beauty isincomparable.
lines.transliteration: jin sisat saajee so-ee har jaanai t aa kaa roop apaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਸਸਿਟ  ਸਾਜੀ  ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself gazes upon it, and is pleased. The Gurmukh contemplatesGod. ||4||3||14|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (736-3) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay vaykh har bigsai gurmukh  barahm beechaaro. ||4||3||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਗਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
lines.english: All that happens, and all that will happen, is by His Will. If we could do something byourselves, we would.
lines.transliteration: keetaa karn aa sarab rajaa-ee kichh  keechai jay kar sakee-ai.

lines.english: By ourselves, we cannot do anything at all. As it pleases the Lord, He preserves us.||1||
lines.transliteration: aapnaa keet aa kichh oo na hovai ji-o har bh aavai t i-o rakh ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਰਜਾਈ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਚੈ  ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਸਕੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O my Dear Lord, everything is in Your power.
lines.transliteration: mayray har jee-o sabh ko t ayrai vas.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਜਉ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਖੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have no power to do anything at all. As it pleases You, You forgive us. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: asaa jor naahee jay kichh kar ham saakah ji-o bh aavai t ivai bakh as. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਿਸ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself bless us with soul, body and everything. You Yourself cause us to act.
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-o pind d ee-aa t uDh aapay t uDh aapay kaarai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਾ  ਜੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਿਰ ਹਮ ਸਾਕਹ  ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਬਖਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||2|| As You issue Your Commands, so do we act, according to our pre-ordained destiny.||2||
lines.transliteration: jayhaa tooN hukam karahi t ayhay ko karam kamaavai jayhaa t uDh Dhur likh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: You created the entire Universe out of the five elements; if anyone can create a sixth, let him.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  kar tuDh sarisat sabh  saajee ko-ee chh ayvaa kari-o jay kichh  keetaa hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You unite some with the True Guru, and cause them to understand, while others, theself-willed manmukhs, do their deeds and cry out in pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: iknaa satgur mayl t ooN bujhaaveh ik manmukh  karahi se rovai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੇਹੇ ਕੋ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਜੇਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I cannot describe the glorious greatness of the Lord; I am foolish, thoughtless, idioticand lowly.
lines.transliteration: har kee vadi-aa-ee ha-o aakh na saakaa ha-o moorakh  mugaDh  neechaan .

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਿਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ  ਕੋਈ ਛੇਵਾ ਕਿਰਉ  ਜੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: 4) jan naanak ka-o har bakhas lai mayray su-aamee sarn aagat  pa-i-aa ajaan . ||4||4||15||24|| Please, forgive servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I am ignorant, but I haveentered Your Sanctuary. ||4||4||15||24|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 1  (736-10) raag soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 1 Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (736-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਤੂੰ ਬੁਝਾਵਿਹ  ਇਿਕ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਸ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The actor stages the play,
lines.transliteration: baajeegar jaisay baajee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਉ ਆਿਖ  ਨ ਸਾਕਾ  ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਨੀਚਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop bhaykh  dikhlaa-ee. playing the many characters in different costumes;

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ  ਪਇਆ  ਅਜਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: saaNg utaar thamiHa-o paasaaraa. but when the play ends, he takes off the costumes,

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tab ayko aykankaaraa. ||1|| and then he is one, and only one. ||1||

lines.english: How many forms and images appeared and disappeared?
lines.transliteration: kavan roop daristi-o binsaa-i-o.

lines.english: Where have they gone? Where did they come from? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kateh ga-i-o uho kat  tay aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Countless waves rise up from the water.
lines.transliteration: jal tay ooth eh anik t arangaa.

lines.english: Jewels and ornaments of many different forms are fashioned from gold.
lines.transliteration: kanik bhookh an keenay baho rangaa.

lines.english: I have seen seeds of all kinds being planted
lines.transliteration: beej beej daykh i-o baho parkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਤਿਹ  ਗਇਓ  ਉਹੁ ਕਤ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: fal paakay tay aykankaaraa. ||2|| - when the fruit ripens, the seeds appear in the same form as the original. ||2||

lines.english: The one sky is reflected in thousands of water jugs,
lines.transliteration: sahas ghataa meh ayk aakaas.
ghat footay t ay ohee pargaas. but when the jugs are broken, only the sky remains.

lines.english: Doubt comes from greed, emotional attachment and the corruption of Maya.
lines.transliteration: bharam lobh  moh maa-i-aa vikaar.

lines.english: Freed from doubt, one realizes the One Lord alone. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bharam chh ootay t ay aykankaar. ||3||

lines.english: He is imperishable; He will never pass away.
lines.transliteration: oh abhinaasee binsat  naahee.

lines.english: He does not come, and He does not go.
lines.transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaahee.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has washed away the filth of ego.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai ha-umai mal Dho-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have obtained the supreme status. ||4||1|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (736-16) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayree param gat ho-ee. ||4||1||

lines.english: Whatever God wills, that alone happens.
lines.transliteration: keetaa lorh eh so parabh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The humble being serves Him, and so all his works are perfectly successful.
lines.transliteration: jo jan sayvay tis pooran kaaj.

lines.english: O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slaves. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daas apunay kee raakh o laaj. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੀ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  pooran d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Without You, who would cherish and love me? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin kavan karay part ipaalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al rahi-aa bharpoor.

lines.english: God dwells near at hand; He is not far away.
lines.transliteration: nikat vasai naahee parabh d oor.

lines.english: By trying to please other people, nothing is accomplished.
lines.transliteration: lok patee-aarai kachh oo na paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: When someone is attached to the True Lord, his ego is taken away. ||2|| pMnw 737
lines.transliteration: saach lagai taa ha-umai jaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: He alone is attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches.
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay la-ay so laagai.

lines.english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is awakened deep within.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan ratan ant ar tis jaagai.

lines.english: Evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the supreme status is attained.
lines.transliteration: durmat  jaa-ay param pad  paa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee naam Dhi-aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Pressing my palms together, I offer my prayer;
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  kara-o ard aas.
tuDh bhaavai t aa aan eh raas. if it pleases You, Lord, please bless me and fulfill me.

lines.english: Grant Your Mercy, Lord, and bless me with devotion.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnee bhagt ee laa-ay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on God forever. ||4||2|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (737-4) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak parabh sad aa Dh i-aa-ay. ||4||2||

lines.english: Dhan sohaagan jo parabh oo pachh aanai. Blessed is that soul-bride, who realizes God.
She obeys the Hukam of His Order, and abandons her self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: maanai hukam tajai abh imaanai.

lines.english: Imbued with her Beloved, she celebrates in delight. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pari-a si-o raatee ralee-aa maanai. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O my companions - these are the signs on the Path to meet God.
lines.transliteration: sun sakhee-ay parabh  milan  neesaanee.

lines.english: Dedicate your mind and body to Him; stop living to please others. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan arap t aj laaj lokaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One soul-bride counsels another,
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahaylee ka-o samjh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਤਿਜ ਲਾਜ  ਲੋਕਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so-ee kamaavai jo parabh bh aavai. to do only that which pleases God.

lines.english: Such a soul-bride merges into the Being of God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saa sohagan ank samaavai. ||2||

lines.english: One who is in the grip of pride does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: garab gahaylee mahal na paavai.

lines.english: She regrets and repents, when her life-night passes away.
lines.transliteration: fir pachhut aavai jab rain  bihaavai.

lines.english: The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karamheen manmukh  dukh paavai. ||3||

lines.english: I pray to God, but I think that He is far away.
lines.transliteration: bin-o karee jay jaanaa d oor.

lines.english: God is imperishable and eternal; He is pervading and permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: parabh abh inaasee rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: Servant Nanak sings of Him; I see Him Ever-present everywhere. ||4||3|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (737-9) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gaavai daykh  hadoor. ||4||3||

lines.english: The Giver has put this household of my being under my own control. I am now themistress of the Lord's Home.
lines.transliteration: garihu vas gur keenaa ha-o ghar kee naar.

lines.english: My Husband Lord has made the ten senses and organs of actions my slaves.
lines.transliteration: das d aasee kar d eenee bh ataar.

lines.english: I have gathered together all the faculties and facilities of this house.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree mai ghar kee jorh ee.

lines.english: I am thirsty with desire and longing for my Husband Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aasee pir ka-o lorhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਵਿਸ ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਨਾ  ਹਉ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of my Beloved Husband Lord should I describe?
lines.transliteration: kavan kahaa gun kant pi-aaray.

lines.english: He is All-knowing, totally beautiful and merciful; He is the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sugharh  saroop d a-i-aal muraaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਮੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋੜੀ ॥
lines.english: I am adorned with Truth, and I have applied the mascara of the Fear of God to myeyes.
lines.transliteration: sat seegaar bh a-o anjan paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have chewed the betel-leaf of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam t ambol mukh  khaa-i-aa.

lines.english: My bracelets, robes and ornaments beautifully adorn me.
lines.transliteration: kangan bastar gahnay banay suhaavay.

lines.english: Dhan sabh  sukh  paavai jaaN pir gh ar aavai. ||2|| The soul-bride becomes totally happy, when her Husband Lord comes to her home.||2||
By the charms of virtue, I have enticed and fascinated my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: gun kaaman  kar kant  reejh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is under my power - the Guru has dispelled my doubts.
lines.transliteration: vas kar leenaa gur bharam chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: My mansion is lofty and elevated.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay oochaa mand ar mayraa.

lines.english: Renouncing all other brides, my Beloved has become my lover. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaman  ti-aagee pari-o pareet am mayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਜ ਿਪਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The sun has risen, and its light shines brightly.
lines.transliteration: pargati-aa soor jot ujee-aaraa.

lines.english: I have prepared my bed with infinite care and faith.
lines.transliteration: sayj vichhaa-ee saraDh  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਸ ਕਿਰ ਲੀਨਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My Darling Beloved is new and fresh; He has come to my bed to enjoy me.
lines.transliteration: nav rang laal sayj raavan aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Servant Nanak, my Husband Lord has come; the soul-bride has found peace. ||4||4|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (737-15) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak pir Dhan mil sukh  paa-i-aa. ||4||4||

lines.english: An intense yearning to meet God has welled up in my heart.
lines.transliteration: umki-o hee-o milan parabh t aa-ee.

lines.english: I have gone out searching to find my Beloved Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: khojat  chari-o d aykh-a-u pari-a jaa-ee.

lines.english: Hearing news of my Beloved, I have laid out my bed in my home.
lines.transliteration: sunat sad aysro pari-a garihi sayj vichh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲੁ  ਸੇਜ ਰਾਵਣ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering, wandering all around, I came, but I did not even see Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram aa-i-o t a-o nad ar na paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: How can this poor heart be comforted?
lines.transliteration: kin biDh hee-aro Dh eerai nimaano.

lines.english: Come and meet me, O Friend; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil saajan ha-o tujh  kurbaano. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One bed is spread out for the bride and her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykaa sayj vichhee Dh an kant aa.

lines.english: Dhan soot ee pir sad  jaagant aa. The bride is asleep, while her Husband Lord is always awake.
The bride is intoxicated, as if she has drunk wine.
lines.transliteration: pee-o madro Dh an mat vantaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਆਇਓ  ਤਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan jaagai jay pir bolant aa. ||2|| The soul-bride only awakens when her Husband Lord calls to her. ||2||
She has lost hope - so many days have passed.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee niraasee bahut  din laagay.

lines.english: I have travelled through all the lands and the countries. pMnw 738
lines.transliteration: days disant ar mai saglay jh aagay.

lines.english: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without the feet of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: khin rahan na paava-o bin pag paagay.

lines.english: When God becomes Merciful, I become fortunate, and then I meet Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay kirpaal parabh milah sabh aagay. ||3||

lines.english: Becoming Merciful, He has united me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal sat sang milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The fire has been quenched, and I have found my Husband Lord within my own home.
lines.transliteration: boojhee t apat ghareh pir paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I am now adorned with all sorts of decorations.
lines.transliteration: sagal seegaar hun mujh eh suhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bharam chukaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see my Husband Lord there, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah pir hai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: When the door is opened, then the mind is restrained. ||1||Second Pause||5|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (738-4) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kholHi-o kapaat t aa man th ahraa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਿਲਓ  ਕਪਾਟੁ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਈ  ॥੧॥ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: What virtues and excellences of Yours should I cherish and contemplate? I am worthless, while You are the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gun t ayray saar samHaalee mohi nirgun kay d aataaray.

lines.english: I am Your slave - what clever tricks could I ever try? This soul and body are totallyYours||1||
lines.transliteration: bai khareed  ki-aa karay chat uraa-ee ih jee-o pind sabh  thaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਲੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O my Darling, Blissful Beloved, who fascinates my mind - I am a sacrifice to theBlessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laal rangeelay pareetam manmohan t ayray d arsan ka-o ham baaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O God, You are the Great Giver, and I am just a poor beggar; You are forever andever benevolent.
lines.transliteration: parabh d aataa mohi d een bh aykhaaree t umH sadaa sad aa upkaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਰੰਗੀਲੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮਨਮੋਹਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cannot accomplish anything by myself, O my Unapproachable and Infinite Lord andMaster. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so kichh naahee je mai t ay hovai mayray th aakur agam apaaray. ||2||

lines.english: What service can I perform? What should I say to please You? How can I gain theBlessed Vision of Your Darshan?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa sayv kamaava-o ki-aa kahi reejhaava-o biDh  kit paava-o d arsaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਨੁ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Your extent cannot be found - Your limits cannot be found. My mind longs for YourFeet. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mit nahee paa-ee-ai ant  na lahee-ai man t arsai charnaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਜ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I beg with persistence to receive this gift, that the dust of the Saints might touch myface.
lines.transliteration: paava-o daan dh eeth ho-ay maaga-o mukh  laagai sant  raynaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਉ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਿਹ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਕਤੁ  ਪਾਵਉ  ਦਰਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; reaching out with His Hand, God has delivered him. ||4||6|| sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 3  (738-10) soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 3 Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (738-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o gur kirpaa Dhaaree parabh  haath d ay-ay nist aaray. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ  ਮਨੁ ਤਰਸੈ  ਚਰਨਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: His service is insignificant, but his demands are very great.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa thoree maagan bahutaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਉ  ਦਾਨੁ ਢੀਠੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਗਉ  ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he says that he hasarrived there||1||
lines.transliteration: mahal na paavai kahto pahut aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: He competes with those who have been accepted by the Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo pari-a maanay tin kee reesaa.

lines.english: This is how stubborn the false fool is! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: koorhay moorakh  kee haath eesaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He wears religious robes, but he does not practice Truth.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh  dikhaavai sach na kamaavai.

lines.english: He says that he has found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he cannot even getnear it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kahto mahlee nikat na aavai. ||2||

lines.english: He says that he is unattached, but he is intoxicated with Maya.
lines.transliteration: ateet sadaa-ay maa-i-aa kaa maat aa.

lines.english: There is no love in his mind, and yet he says that he is imbued with the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man nahee pareet kahai mukh  raataa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, hear my prayer, God:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh bin-o suneejai.

lines.english: I am silly, stubborn and filled with sexual desire - please, liberate me! ||4||
lines.transliteration: kuchal kathor kaamee mukat  keejai. ||4||

lines.english: I gaze upon the glorious greatness of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykhay kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: You are the Giver of Peace, the Loving Primal Being. ||1||Second Pause||1||7|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (738-15) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tumH sukh -daatay purakh  subh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਹੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He gets up early, to do his evil deeds,
lines.transliteration: buray kaam ka-o ooth kh alo-i-aa.
naam kee baylaa pai pai so-i-aa. ||1|| but when it is time to meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then he sleeps.||1||

lines.english: The ignorant person does not take advantage of the opportunity.
lines.transliteration: a-osar apnaa boojhai na i-aanaa.

lines.english: He is attached to Maya, and engrossed in worldly delights. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh rang laptaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He rides the waves of greed, puffed up with joy.
lines.transliteration: lobh lahar ka-o bigas fool baith aa.

lines.english: He does not see the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kaa d aras na deeth aa. ||2||

lines.english: The ignorant clown will never understand.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo na samjhai agi-aan gavaaraa.

lines.english: Again and again, he becomes engrossed in entanglements. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bahur bahur lapti-o janjaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ  ਪੈ ਪੈ ਸੋਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He listens to the sounds of sin and the music of corruption, and he is pleased.
lines.transliteration: bikhai naad  karan sun  bheenaa.

lines.english: His mind is too lazy to listen to the Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har jas sunat aalas man keenaa. ||3||

lines.english: You do not see with your eyes - you are so blind!
lines.transliteration: darisat naahee ray paykh at anDh ay.

lines.english: You shall have to leave all these false affairs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhod jaahi jh oothay sabh  DhanDhay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, please forgive me, God. pMnw 739
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh bakh as kareejai.

lines.english: Have Mercy upon me, and bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi saaDhsang d eejai. ||4||

lines.english: He alone obtains something, who becomes the dust under the feet of all.
lines.transliteration: ta-o kichh  paa-ee-ai ja-o ho-ee-ai raynaa.

lines.english: And he alone repeats the Naam, whom God causes to understand. ||1||Pause||2||8|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (739-2) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaa-ay t is naam lainaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. ||2||8||

lines.english: Within the home of his own self, he does not even come to see his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh th aakur nad ar na aavai.

lines.english: And yet, around his neck, he hangs a stone god. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gal meh paahan lai latkaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic wanders around, deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa saakat  firtaa.

lines.english: He churns water, and after wasting his life away, he dies. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: neer birolai khap kh ap mart aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That stone, which he calls his god,
lines.transliteration: jis paahan ka-o th aakur kaht aa.
oh paahan lai us ka-o dubt aa. ||2|| that stone pulls him down and drowns him. ||2||

lines.english: O sinner, you are untrue to your own self;
lines.transliteration: gunahgaar loon haraamee.
paahan naav na paargiramee. ||3|| a boat of stone will not carry you across. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਪਾਹਣੁ  ਲੈ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਡੁਬਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I know my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: gur mil naanak thaakur jaat aa.

lines.english: The Perfect Architect of Destiny is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky. ||4||3||9|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (739-6) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al pooran biDhaat aa. ||4||3||9||

lines.english: How have you enjoyed your Dear Beloved?
lines.transliteration: laalan raavi-aa kavan gatee ree.

lines.english: O sister, please teach me, please show me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sakhee bat aavhu mujh eh mat ee ree. ||1||

lines.english: Crimson, crimson, crimson - this is the color of the soul-bride who is imbued with the Love of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: soohab soohab soohvee. apnay pareetam kai rang rat ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I wash Your Feet with my eye-lashes.
lines.transliteration: paav malova-o sang nain bhat eeree.

lines.english: Wherever You send me, there I will go. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jahaa pathaavhu jaaN-o tatee ree. ||2||

lines.english: I would trade meditation, austerity, self-discipline and celibacy,
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam d ay-o jat ee ree.
ik nimakh milaavhu mohi paraanpat ee ree. ||3|| if I could only meet the Lord of my life, for even an instant. ||3||

lines.english: She who eradicates her self-conceit, power and arrogant intellect,
lines.transliteration: maan t aan ahaN-buDh  hatee ree.

lines.english: O Nanak, is the true soul-bride. ||4||4||10|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (739-9) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saa naanak sohaagvatee ree. ||4||4||10||

lines.english: You are my Life, the very Support of my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: tooN jeevan t ooN paraan aDh aaraa.

lines.english: Gazing upon You, beholding You, my mind is soothed and comforted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tujh hee paykh  paykh  man saaDh aaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਦੇਉ ਜਤੀ  ਰੀ ॥
lines.english: You are my Friend, You are my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: tooN saajan t ooN pareet am mayraa.

lines.english: I shall never forget You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chiteh na bisrahi kaahoo bayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am Your indentured servant; I am Your slave.
lines.transliteration: bai khareed  ha-o d aasro t ayraa.

lines.english: You are my Great Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tooN bhaaro th aakur gun ee gahayraa. ||2||

lines.english: There are millions of servants in Your Court - Your Royal Darbaar.
lines.transliteration: kot daas jaa kai d arbaaray.

lines.english: Each and every instant, You dwell with them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nimakh nimakh  vasai t inH naalay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪੇਿਖ ਪੇਿਖ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am nothing; everything is Yours.
lines.transliteration: ha-o kichh naahee sabh  kichh  tayraa.

lines.english: Through and through, You abide with Nanak. ||4||5||11|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (739-13) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ot pot  naanak sang basayraa. ||4||5||11||

lines.english: His Mansions are so comfortable, and His gates are so lofty.
lines.transliteration: sookh mahal jaa kay ooch d u-aaray.

lines.english: Within them, His beloved devotees dwell. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa meh vaaseh bh agat pi-aaray. ||1||

lines.english: The Natural Speech of God is so very sweet.
lines.transliteration: sahj kathaa parabh kee at  meeth ee.

lines.english: How rare is that person, who sees it with his eyes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: virlai kaahoo naytarahu deeth ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There, in the arena of the congregation, the divine music of the Naad, the sound current, is sung.
lines.transliteration: tah geet  naad  akhaaray sangaa.

lines.english: There, the Saints celebrate with their Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oohaa sant karahi har rangaa. ||2||

lines.english: Neither birth nor death is there, neither pain nor pleasure.
lines.transliteration: tah maran  na jeevan  sog na harkh aa.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name rains down there. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saach naam kee amrit varkh aa. ||3||

lines.english: From the Guru, I have come to know the mystery of this speech.
lines.transliteration: guhaj kathaa ih gur tay jaan ee.

lines.english: Nanak speaks the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||12|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (739-16) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai har har banee. ||4||6||12||
