lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਮਹਲ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਊਚ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: By the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, millions of sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai daras paap kot ut aaray.

lines.english: Meeting with them, this terrifying world-ocean is crossed over||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaytat  sang ih bh avjal t aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਕਥਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਅਿਤ  ਮੀਠੀ  ॥
lines.english: They are my companions, and they are my dear friends,
lines.transliteration: o-ay saajan o-ay meet pi-aaray.
jo ham ka-o har naam chitaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o. who inspire me to remember the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Hearing the Word of His Shabad, I am totally at peace.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa sabad sunat  sukh  saaray.

lines.english: When I serve Him, the Messenger of Death is chased away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee tahal jamdoot  bidaaray. ||2||

lines.english: His comfort and consolation soothes and supports my mind.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee Dheerak is maneh saDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹਰਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, my face is radiant and bright. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran mukh  ujlaaray. ||3||

lines.english: God embellishes and supports His servants.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak parabh  aap savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Protection of their Sanctuary; he is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||7||13|| pMnw 740 sUhI mhlw 5 ] (740-1) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran naanak t inH sad balihaaray. ||4||7||13||

lines.english: The angelic beings and demi-gods are not permitted to remain here.
lines.transliteration: rahan na paavahi sur nar d ayvaa.

lines.english: The silent sages and humble servants also must arise and depart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ooth siDh aaray kar mun jan sayvaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: Only those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, are seen to live on.
lines.transliteration: jeevat paykh ay jinHee har har Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they obtain the Blessed Vision of theLord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang t inHee darsan paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Kings, emperors and merchants must die.
lines.transliteration: baadisaah saah vaapaaree marnaa.

lines.english: Whoever is seen shall be consumed by death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so kaaleh kh arnaa. ||2||

lines.english: Mortal beings are entangled, clinging to false worldly attachments.
lines.transliteration: koorhai mohi lapat laptaanaa.

lines.english: And when they must leave them behind, then they regret and grieve. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhod chali-aa t aa fir pachh utaanaa. ||3||

lines.english: O Lord, O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with this gift,
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan naanak ka-o karahu d aat.

lines.english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa japee d in raat . ||4||8||14|| that he may chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||8||14|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (740-5) soohee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: You dwell deep within the heart of each and every being.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar tumeh basaaray.

lines.english: The entire universe is strung on Your Thread. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree soot t umaaray. ||1||

lines.english: You are my Beloved, the Support of my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: tooN pareet am tooN paraan aDh aaray.

lines.english: Beholding You, gazing upon You, my mind blossoms forth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tum hee paykh  paykh  man bigsaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Wandering, wandering, wandering through countless incarnations, I have grown so weary.
lines.transliteration: anik jon bharam bh aram bh aram haaray.

lines.english: Now, I hold tight to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ot gahee ab saaDh sangaaray. ||2||

lines.english: You are inaccessible, incomprehensible, invisible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaray.

lines.english: Nanak remembers You in meditation, day and night. ||3||9||15|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (740-8) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak simrai din rainaaray. ||3||9||15||

lines.english: What is the use of the glory of Maya?
lines.transliteration: kavan kaaj maa-i-aa vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: It disappears in no time at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o binsat baar na kaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: This is a dream, but the sleeper does not know it.
lines.transliteration: ih supnaa sovat nahee jaanai.

lines.english: In his unconscious state, he clings to it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: achayt bivasthaa meh laptaanai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The poor fool is enticed by the great attachments of the world.
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohi mohi-o gaavaaraa.

lines.english: Gazing upon them, watching them, he must still arise and depart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paykhat  paykh at ooth siDhaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The Royal Court of His Darbaar is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: ooch tay ooch t aa kaa d arbaaraa.

lines.english: He creates and destroys countless beings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ka-ee jant binaahi upaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: There has never been any other, and there shall never be.
lines.transliteration: doosar ho-aa naa ko ho-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the One God. ||4||10||16|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (740-11) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jap naanak parabh ayko so-ee. ||4||10||16||

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live.
lines.transliteration: simar simar taa ka-o ha-o jeevaa.

lines.english: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in the wash water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal t ayray Dh o-ay Dh o-ay peevaa. ||1||

lines.english: He is my Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: so har mayraa antarjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master abides with His humble devotees. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kai sang su-aamee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Hearing, hearing Your Ambrosial Naam, I meditate on it.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  amrit  naam Dh i-aavaa.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar t ayray gun  gaavaa. ||2||

lines.english: Beholding, beholding Your divine play, my mind is in bliss.
lines.transliteration: paykh paykh  leelaa man aanand aa.

lines.english: Your Glorious Virtues are infinite, O God, O Lord of supreme bliss. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun apaar parabh  parmaanand aa. ||3||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, fear cannot touch me.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran kachh bh a-o na bi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, Nanak meditates on the Lord. ||4||11||17|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (740-15) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa naanak har jaapai. ||4||11||17||

lines.english: Within my heart, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan ridai Dh i-aan Dh aaree.

lines.english: With my tongue, I chant the Chant of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa jaap japa-o banvaaree. ||1||

lines.english: The image of His vision is fruitful; I am a sacrifice to it.
lines.transliteration: safal moorat d arsan balihaaree.

lines.english: His Lotus Feet are the Support of the mind, the Support of the very breath of life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man paraan  aDhaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the cycle of birth and death is ended.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang janam maran  nivaaree.

lines.english: To hear the Ambrosial Sermon is the support of my ears. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit kathaa sun  karan aDh aaree. ||2||

lines.english: I have renounced sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh t ajaaree.

lines.english: I have enshrined the Naam within myself, with charity, true cleansing and righteousconduct. ||3||
lines.transliteration: darirh  naam d aan isnaan suchaaree. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have contemplated this essence of reality;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih tat  beechaaree.

lines.english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap paar utaaree. ||4||12||18|| chanting the Name of the Lord, I am carried across. ||4||12||18|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (740-19) soohee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The sinner is absorbed in greed and emotional attachment. pMnw 741
lines.transliteration: lobh mohi magan apraaDh ee.

lines.english: He has not performed any service to the Creator Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karanhaar kee sayv na saaDhee. ||1||

lines.english: O God, Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan parabh  naam t umaaray.

lines.english: I am worthless - please save me! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raakh layho mohi nirgunee-aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O God, You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: tooN daataa parabh  antarjaamee.

lines.english: The body of the egotistical human is perishable. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaachee dayh maanukh  abhimaanee. ||2||

lines.english: Tastes and pleasures, conflicts and jealousy, and intoxication with Maya
lines.transliteration: su-aad baad  eerakh  mad maa-i-aa.
in sang laag ratan janam gavaa-i-aa. ||3|| - attached to these, the jewel of human life is wasted. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of pain, the Life of the world.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhanjan jagjeevan har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: Forsaking everything, Nanak has entered His Sanctuary. ||4||13||19|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (741-4) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag naanak sarn aa-i-aa. ||4||13||19||

lines.english: He sees with his eyes, but he is called blind; he hears, but he does not hear.
lines.transliteration: paykhat  chaakh at kahee-at  anDh aa sunee-at  sunee-ai naahee.

lines.english: And the One who dwells near at hand, he thinks that He is far away; the sinner iscommitting sins. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nikat vasat ka-o jaan ai dooray paapee paap kamaahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਖਤ  ਚਾਖਤ  ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਸੁਨੀਅਤ  ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Do only those deeds which will save you, O mortal being.
lines.transliteration: so kichh kar jit  chhuteh paraanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ  ਦੂਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ  ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam jap amrit baanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are forever imbued with the love of horses and mansions.
lines.transliteration: ghor mahal sad aa rang raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nothing shall go along with you. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sang tumHaarai kachh oo na jaat aa. ||2||

lines.english: You may clean and decorate the vessel of clay,
lines.transliteration: rakheh pochaar maatee kaa bh aaNdaa.
at kucheel milai jam daaNdaa. ||3|| but it is so very filthy; it shall receive its punishment from the Messenger of Death.

lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai sant ravaalaa. ||4||28||34||

lines.english: The beautiful one does not know the work of his own home.
lines.transliteration: ghar kaa kaaj na jaan ee roorh aa.

lines.english: The fool is engrossed in false attachments. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhooth ai DhanDhai rachi-o moorh aa. ||1||

lines.english: As You attach us, so we are attached.
lines.transliteration: jit tooN laaveh t it tit lagnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਕਾਜੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ਰੂੜਾ ॥
lines.english: When You bless us with Your Name, we chant it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa tooN deh tayraa naa-o japnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord's slaves are imbued with the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay daas har sayt ee raat ay.

lines.english: They are intoxicated with the Lord, night and day. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in an-d in maat ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ਜਪਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Reaching out to grasp hold of our arms, God lifts us up.
lines.transliteration: baah pakar parabh aapay kaadh ay.

lines.english: Separated for countless incarnations, we are united with Him again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay tootay gaadhay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Save me, O God, O my Lord and Master - shower me with Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: uDhar su-aamee parabh  kirpaa Dh aaray.

lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door, O Lord. ||4||29||35|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (744-9) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas har saran  du-aaray. ||4||29||35||

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found my eternal home.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  nihchal gh ar paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have found total peace, and I shall not waver again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh fir nahee dolaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I meditate on the Guru, and the Lord's Feet, within my mind.
lines.transliteration: guroo Dhi-aa-ay har charan man cheenHay.

lines.english: In this way, the Creator Lord has made me steady and stable. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taa tay kart ai asthir keenHay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the unchanging, eternal Lord God,
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  achut  abhinaasee.
taa tay kaatee jam kee faasee. ||2|| and the noose of death is snapped. ||2||

lines.english: Showering His Mercy, he has attached me to the hem of His robe.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa leenay larh laa-ay.

lines.english: In constant bliss, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||3||30||36|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (744-13) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa anad  naanak gun  gaa-ay. ||3||30||36||

lines.english: The Words, the Teachings of the Holy Saints, are Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit bachan saaDh  kee ban ee.

lines.english: Whoever meditates on the Lord's Name is emancipated; he chants the Name of theLord, Har, Har, with his tongue. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jo japai tis kee gat  hovai har har naam nit  rasan bakh aanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The pains and sufferings of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga are eradicated,
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal kay mitay kalaysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਟੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ayko naam man meh parvaysaa. ||1|| when the One Name abides within the mind. ||1||

lines.english: I apply the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo Dh oor mukh  mast ak laa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak has been saved, in the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord. ||2||31||37|| sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 3 ] (744-15) soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 3. Soohee, Fifth Mehl: Third House:
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhray har gur sarn aa-ee. ||2||31||37||

lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: gobindaa gun  gaa-o d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Please, bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darsan d ayh pooran kirpaalaa. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਤ  ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please, grant Your Grace, and cherish me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa tum hee part ipaalaa.

lines.english: My soul and body are all Your property. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t umraa maalaa. ||1||

lines.english: Only meditation on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, will go along with you.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam chalai jap naalaa.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||2||32||38|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (744-18) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai sant ravaalaa. ||2||32||38||

lines.english: Without Him, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: The True Lord Himself is our anchor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay thammai sachaa so-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is our only support.
lines.transliteration: har har naam mayraa aaDhaar.

lines.english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful and Infinite. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath apaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He has eradicated all illness, and healed me.
lines.transliteration: sabh rog mitaavay navaa niro-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself has become my Savior. ||2||33||39|| pMnw 745 sUhI mhlw 5 ] (745-1) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rakhaa aapay ho-aa. ||2||33||39||

lines.english: Everyone longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan ka-o lochai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.english: By perfect destiny, it is obtained. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag paraapat  ho-ee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Forsaking the Beautiful Lord, how can they go to sleep?
lines.transliteration: si-aam sundar t aj need  ki-o aa-ee.

lines.english: The great enticer Maya has led them down the path of sin. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohnee doot aa laa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: This butcher has separated them from the Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraym bichhohaa karat  kasaa-ee.

lines.english: This merciless one shows no mercy at all to the poor beings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirdai jant  tis da-i-aa na paa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Countless lifetimes have passed away, wandering aimlessly.
lines.transliteration: anik janam beetee-an bh armaa-ee.

lines.english: The terrible, treacherous Maya does not even allow them to dwell in their own home. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ghar vaas na d ayvai d utar maa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Day and night, they receive the rewards of their own actions.
lines.transliteration: din rain apnaa kee-aa paa-ee.

lines.english: Don't blame anyone else; your own actions lead you astray. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kis dos na d eejai kirat  bhavaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੁਤਰ  ਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen, O Friend, O Saint, O humble Sibling of Destiny:
lines.transliteration: sun saajan sant  jan bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (745-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: charan saran  naanak gat  paa-ee. ||5||34||40|| in the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found Salvation. ||5||34||40|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 4  (745-6) raag soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 4

lines.english: Even a crude hut is sublime and beautiful, if the Lord's Praises are sung within it.
lines.transliteration: bhalee suhaavee chh aapree jaa meh gun gaa-ay.

lines.english: Those mansions where the Lord is forgotten are useless. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kit hee kaam na Dh a-ulhar jit  har bisraa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Even poverty is bliss, if God comes to mind in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: anad gareebee saaDh sang jit  parabh  chit aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: This worldly glory might just as well burn; it only traps the mortals in Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jal jaa-o ayhu badpanaa maa-i-aa laptaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਛਾਪਰੀ  ਜਾ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: One may have to grind corn, and wear a coarse blanket, but still, one can find peaceof mind and contentment.
lines.transliteration: peesan pees odh kaamree sukh  man sant okhaa-ay.

lines.english: Even empires are of no use at all, if they do not bring satisfaction. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aiso raaj na kitai kaaj jit  nah t ariptaa-ai. ||2||

lines.english: Someone may wander around naked, but if he loves the One Lord, he receives honorand respect.
lines.transliteration: nagan firat rang ayk kai oh sobh aa paa-ay.

lines.english: Silk and satin clothes are worthless, if they lead to greed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paat patambar birthi-aa jih rach lobhaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ਏਹੁ ਬਡਪਨਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਲਪਟਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everything is in Your Hands, God. You Yourself are the Doer, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tumHrai haath parabh  aap karay karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਸਨੁ ਪੀਿਸ  ਓਿਢ  ਕਾਮਰੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, may I continue to remember You. Please, bless Nanak with this gift. ||4||1||41|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (745-11) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas saas simrat rahaa naanak d aan paa-ay. ||4||1||41||

lines.english: The Lord's Saint is my life and wealth. I am his water-carrier.
lines.transliteration: har kaa sant paraan Dh an tis kaa panihaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਗਨ ਿਫਰਤ  ਰੰਿਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He is dearer to me than all my siblings, friends and children. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee meet  sut sagal t ay jee-a hooN tay pi-aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over the Saint.
lines.transliteration: kaysaa kaa kar beejnaa sant cha-ur dh ulaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I bow my head low, to touch his feet, and apply his dust to my face. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sees nihaara-o charan t al Dhoor mukh  laava-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਰਹਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੧॥
lines.english: I offer my prayer with sweet words, in sincere humility.
lines.transliteration: misat bachan bayntee kara-o d een kee ni-aa-ee.

lines.english: Renouncing egotism, I enter His Sanctuary. I have found the Lord, the treasure ofvirtue. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan sarn ee para-o har gun  niDh paa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਰਾਨ  ਧਨ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਪਿਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant, again and again.
lines.transliteration: avlokan punah punah kara-o jan kaa darsaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਈ  ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਸਗਲ  ਤੇ ਜੀਅ  ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਿਪਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cherish and gather in His Ambrosial Words within my mind; time and time again, I bow to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit bachan man meh sincha-o band a-o baar baar. ||3||

lines.english: In my mind, I wish, hope and beg for the Society of the Lord's humble servants.
lines.transliteration: chitva-o man aasaa kara-o jan kaa sang maaga-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਰ ਬੀਜਨਾ  ਸੰਤ ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Be Merciful to Nanak, O God, and lead him to the feet of Your slaves. ||4||2||42|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (745-17) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh d a-i-aa kar d aas charn ee laaga-o. ||4||2||42||

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਸੁ ਿਨਹਾਰਉ  ਚਰਣ  ਤਿਲ  ਧੂਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: She has enticed the worlds and solar systems; I have fallen into her clutches.
lines.transliteration: jin mohay barahmand khand t aahoo meh paa-o.

lines.english: O Lord, please save this corrupt soul of mine; please bless me with Your Name.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raakh layho ih bikh -ee jee-o d ayh apunaa naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਰਉ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She has not brought anyone peace, but still, I chase after her.
lines.transliteration: jaa tay naahee ko sukh ee taa kai paachh ai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਲੋਕਨ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਕਰਉ  ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: She forsakes everyone, but still, I cling to her, again and again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chhod jaahi jo sagal ka-o fir fir laptaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਚਨ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਸੰਚਉ ਬੰਦਉ  ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Have Mercy on me, O Lord of Compassion; please let me sing Your Glorious Praises, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa karunaapat ay tayray har gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਮਿਨ ਆਸਾ  ਕਰਉ  ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗਉ  ॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord, that he may join and merge with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||43|| pMnw 746 rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 5 pVqwl  (746-2) raag soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 5 parh -taal Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Partaal: <> siqgur pRswid ] (746-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh baynt ee saaDh sang samaa-o. ||2||3||43||

lines.english: Love of the enticing Beloved Lord is the most glorious love.
lines.transliteration: pareet pareet  guree-aa mohan laalnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate, O mind, on the One Lord of the Universe - nothing else is of any account.Attach your mind to the Saints, and abandon the path of duality. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sUhI, mÚ 5) jap man gobind aykai avar nahee ko laykh ai sant  laag maneh chh aad d ubiDh aa kee kuree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is absolute and unmanifest; He has assumed the most sublimemanifestation. He has fashioned countless body chambers of many, varied, different,myriad forms.
lines.transliteration: nirgun haree-aa sargun Dharee-aa anik kh othree-aa bh inn bh inn bh inn bh in karee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਏਕੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੰਤ ਲਾਗੁ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਛਾਡੁ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਕੀ ਕੁਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within them, the mind is the policeman;
lines.transliteration: vich man kotvaree-aa.
nij mandar piree-aa. my Beloved lives in the temple of my inner self.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਹਰੀਆ  ਸਰਗੁਨ  ਧਰੀਆ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਕੋਠਰੀਆ  ਿਭੰਨ ਿਭੰਨ ਿਭੰਨ ਿਭਨ ਕਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He plays there in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: tahaa aanad  karee-aa.

lines.english: He does not die, and he never grows old. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nah maree-aa nah jaree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: He is engrossed in worldly activities, wandering around in various ways. He steals theproperty of others,
lines.transliteration: kirtan juree-aa baho biDh  firee-aa par ka-o hiree-aa.
bikhnaa gh iree-aa. and is surrounded by corruption and sin.

lines.english: But now, he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: ab saaDhoo sang paree-aa.
har du-aarai kh aree-aa. and stands before the Lord's Gate.

lines.english: He obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan karee-aa.

lines.english: Nanak has met the Guru;
lines.transliteration: naanak gur miree-aa.

lines.english: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bahur na firee-aa. ||2||1||44|| he shall not be reincarnated again. ||2||1||44|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (746-8) soohee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Lord has made this world a stage;
lines.transliteration: raas mandal keeno aakhaaraa.

lines.english: He fashioned the expanse of the entire creation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saglo saaj rakhi-o paasaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He fashioned it in various ways, with limitless colors and forms.
lines.transliteration: baho biDh roop rang aapaaraa.

lines.english: He watches over it with joy, and He never tires of enjoying it.
lines.transliteration: paykhai kh usee bh og nahee haaraa.

lines.english: He enjoys all the delights, and yet He remains unattached. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh ras lait  basat  niraaraa. ||1||

lines.english: He has no color, no sign, no mouth and no beard.
lines.transliteration: baran chihan naahee mukh na maasaaraa.

lines.english: I cannot describe Your play.
lines.transliteration: kahan na jaa-ee khayl t uhaaraa.

lines.english: Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||45|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (746-11) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rayn sant  charnaaraa. ||2||2||45||

lines.english: I have come to You. I have come to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ta-o mai aa-i-aa sarnee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have come to place my faith in You. I have come seeking Mercy.
lines.transliteration: bharosai aa-i-aa kirpaa aa-i-aa.

lines.english: If it pleases You, save me, O my Lord and Master. The Guru has placed me upon thePath. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh o su-aamee maarag gureh path aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Maya is very treacherous and difficult to pass through. It is like a violent wind-storm.||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa dut ar maa-i-aa. jaisay pavan jh ulaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am so afraid to hear
lines.transliteration: sun sun hee daraa-i-aa.
karro Dharamraa-i-aa. ||2|| that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is so strict and stern. ||2||

lines.english: The world is a deep, dark pit;
lines.transliteration: garih anDh koopaa-i-aa.
paavak sagraa-i-aa. ||3|| it is all on fire. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਪਠਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have grasped the Support of the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: gahee ot saDhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak meditates on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak har Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Now, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||4||3||46|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 6  (746-16) raag soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 6 Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (746-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ab mai pooraa paa-i-aa. ||4||3||46||

lines.english: I offer this prayer to the True Guru, to bless me with the sustenance of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: satgur paas banant ee-aa milai naam aaDh aaraa.

lines.english: When the True King is pleased, the world is rid of its diseases. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuthaa sachaa paat isaahu t aap ga-i-aa sansaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Support of Your devotees, and the Shelter of the Saints, O True CreatorLord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kee tayk t ooN santaa kee ot t ooN sachaa sirjanhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: True are Your devices, and True is Your Court.
lines.transliteration: sach tayree saamagree sach t ayraa d arbaaraa.

lines.english: True are Your treasures, and True is Your expanse. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach tayray kh aajni-aa sach t ayraa paasaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Your Form is inaccessible, and Your Vision is incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: tayraa roop agamm hai anoop t ayraa d arsaaraa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your servants; they love Your Name, O Lord. ||3|| pMnw 747
lines.transliteration: ha-o kurbaanee t ayri-aa sayvkaa jinH har naam pi-aaraa. ||3||

lines.english: All desires are fulfilled, when the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sabhay ichh aa pooree-aa jaa paa-i-aa agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ  ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak has met the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to Your Feet. ||4||1||47|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 7  (747-3) raag soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 7 Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (747-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak mili-aa paarbarahm tayri-aa charn aa ka-o balihaaraa. ||4||1||47||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਤੇਿਰਆ  ਚਰਣਾ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੪੭॥
lines.english: He alone obeys Your Will, O Lord, unto whom You are Merciful.
lines.transliteration: tayraa bh aanaa toohai manaa-ihi jis no hohi d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: That alone is devotional worship, which is pleasing to Your Will. You are the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saa-ee bhagat  jo tuDh bhaavai t ooN sarab jee-aa part ipaalaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਾਇਿਹ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਿਹ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my Sovereign Lord, You are the Support of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam raa-ay santaa tayk t umHaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases You, they accept. You are the sustenance of their minds and bodies.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so parvaan  man t an toohai aDh aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the fulfiller of our hopes.
lines.transliteration: tooN da-i-aal kirpaal kirpaa niDh  mansaa pooran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਤੂਹੈ ਅਧਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Beloved Lord of life of all Your devotees; You are the Beloved of Yourdevotees. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  tayray sabh  faraan pat pareet am tooN bhagtan kaa pi-aaraa. ||2||

lines.english: You are unfathomable, infinite, lofty and exalted. There is no one else like You.
lines.transliteration: too athaahu apaar at  oochaa ko-ee avar na t ayree bh aatay.

lines.english: This is my prayer, O my Lord and Master; may I never forget You, O Peace-givingLord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih ardaas hamaaree su-aamee visar naahee sukh -daatay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਪਰ੍ਾਣਪਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਤੂੰ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Day and night, with each and every breath, I sing Your Glorious Praises, if it ispleasing to Your Will.
lines.transliteration: din rain  saas saas gun  gaavaa jay su-aamee t uDh bhaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਿਤ  ਊਚਾ  ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for the peace of Your Name, O Lord and Master; as it is pleasing to Your Will, I shall attain it. ||4||1||48|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (747-9) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa sukh  naanak maagai saahib t uthai paavaa. ||4||1||48||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਿਵਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Where is that place, where You are never forgotten, Lord?
lines.transliteration: visrahi naahee jit t oo kabhoo so thaan t ayraa kayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਜੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate on You, and their bodies become spotless andpure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar jit  tuDh Dhi-aa-ee nirmal hovai d ayhaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮਾਗੈ  ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੪੮॥
lines.english: O my Lord, I have come searching for that place.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam ha-o so thaan bhaalan  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: After seeking and searching, I found Sanctuary in the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat bha-i-aa saaDh sang t inH sarnaa-ee paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਸਰਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਜਤੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
lines.english: Reading and reciting the Vedas, Brahma grew weary, but he did not find even a tinybit of God's worth.
lines.transliteration: bayd parh ay parh  barahmay haaray ik t il nahee keemat  paa-ee.

lines.english: The seekers and Siddhas wander around bewailing; they too are enticed by Maya.||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  fireh billaat ay tay bh ee mohay maa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There were ten regal incarnations of Vishnu; and then there was Shiva, the renunciate.
lines.transliteration: das a-ut aar raajay ho-ay vart ay mahaad ayv a-uDh ootaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਭਇਆ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਿਤਨ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He did not find Your limits either, although  he grew weary of smearing his body with ashes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tinH bhee ant  na paa-i-o t ayraa laa-ay thakay bibh ootaa. ||3||

lines.english: Peace, poise and bliss are found in the subtle essence of the Naam. The Lord's Saintssing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: sahj sookh aanand  naam ras har sant ee mangal gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪਿੜ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Fruitful Vision of Guru Nanak's Darshan, and with my mind andbody I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||49|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (747-15) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: safal darsan bh ayti-o gur naanak t aa man t an har har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||4||2||49||

lines.english: The religious rites, rituals and hypocrisies which are seen, are plundered by theMessenger of Death, the ultimate tax collector.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam pakh and jo d eeseh t in jam jaagaat ee lootai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੇ  ਮਹਾਦੇਵ  ਅਉਧੂਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the state of Nirvaanaa, sing the Kirtan of the Creator's Praises; contemplating Himin meditation, even for an instant, one is saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nirbaan keert an gaavhu kart ay kaa nimakh  simrat  jit chhootai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਤੇਰਾ ਲਾਇ  ਥਕੇ ਿਬਭੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Saints, cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: santahu saagar paar ut ree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ  ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who practices the Teachings of the Saints, by Guru's Grace, is carried across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jay ko bachan kamaavai santan kaa so gur parsaadee t aree-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥੪॥੨॥੪੯॥
lines.english: Millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage only fill the mortal with filthin this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: kot tirath majan isnaanaa is kal meh mail bh areejai.

lines.english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy, becomes spotlessly pure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jo har gun  gaavai so nirmal kar leejai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਪਾਖੰਡ  ਜੋ ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ  ਲੂਟੈ ॥
lines.english: One may read all the books of the Vedas, the Bible, the Simritees and the Shaastras,but they will not bring liberation.
lines.transliteration: bayd kat ayb simrit  sabh  saasat  inH parhi-aa mukat  na ho-ee.

lines.english: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the One Word, acquires a spotlessly pure reputation.||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk akhar jo gurmukh  jaapai t is kee nirmal so-ee. ||3||

lines.english: The four castes - the Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas - are equal in respect to the teachings. pMnw 748
lines.transliteration: khatree baraahman  sood  vais upd ays chahu varnaa ka-o saajh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ  ਕਉ ਸਾਝਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is saved. In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, God is permeating the hearts of each and every being.||4||3||50|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (748-2) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam japai uDh rai so kal meh gh at ghat naanak maajh aa. ||4||3||50||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਉਧਰੈ  ਸੋ ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਝਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੫੦॥
lines.english: Whatever God causes to happen is accepted, by those who are attuned to the Love ofthe Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so-ee parabh  maaneh o-ay raam naam rang raat ay.

lines.english: Those who fall at the Feet of God are respected everywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tinH kee sobh aa sabh nee thaa-ee jinH parabh  kay charan  paraat ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਓਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: O my Lord, no one is as great as the Lord's Saints.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam har santaa jayvad na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭਨੀ  ਥਾਈ  ਿਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਪਰਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The devotees are in harmony with their God; He is in the water, the land, and the sky.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa ban  aa-ee parabh  apnay si-o jal thal mahee-al so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਾ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Millions of sinners have been saved in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.
lines.transliteration: kot apraaDhee sat sang uDh rai jam t aa kai nayrh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਿਸਉ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who have been separated from the Lord, for countless incarnations, arereunited with the Lord again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa bichhurh i-aa hovai t inH har si-o aan  milaavai. ||2||

lines.english: Attachment to Maya, doubt and fear are eradicated, when one enters the Sanctuary ofthe Saints.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh bharam bh a-o kaatai sant  saran  jo aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਅਪਰ੍ਾਧੀ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever wishes one harbors, are obtained from the Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jayhaa manorath kar aaraaDhay so sant an tay paavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕਾ ਿਬਛੁਿੜਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can I describe the glory of the Lord's humble servants? They are pleasing to their God.
lines.transliteration: jan kee mahimaa kaytak barna-o jo parabh  apnay bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਿਣ  ਜੋ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, become independent of all obligations.||4||4||51|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (748-8) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin satgur bh ayti-aa say sabh  tay bh a-ay nikaan ay. ||4||4||51||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ  ਕਿਰ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਸੋ ਸੰਤਨ  ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Giving me Your Hand, You saved me from the terrible fire, when I sought YourSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: mahaa agan tay t uDh haath d ay raakh ay pa-ay t ayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਕੇਤਕ  ਬਰਨਉ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: Deep within my heart, I respect Your strength; I have abandoned all other hopes.||1||
lines.transliteration: tayraa maan  taan rid antar hor d oojee aas chukaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਸੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਿਨਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੧॥
lines.english: O my Sovereign Lord, when You enter my consciousness, I am saved.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam raa-ay tuDh  chit aa-i-ai ubray.

lines.english: You are my support. I count on You. Meditating on You, I am saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk bh arvaasaa t umHraa jap naam t umHaaraa uDh ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਿਨ  ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You pulled me up out of the deep, dark pit. You have become merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay kaadh  lee-ay t umH aap bh a-ay kirpaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ  ਆਸ  ਚੁਕਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You care for me, and bless me with total peace; You Yourself cherish me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saar samHaal sarab sukh d ee-ay aap karay part ipaalaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਇਐ  ਉਬਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Transcendent Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace; breaking my bonds, He has delivered me.
lines.transliteration: aapnee nad ar karay parmaysar banDh an kaat chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਉਧਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God Himself inspires me to worship Him; He Himself inspires me to serve Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapnee bh agat parabh  aap karaa-ee aapay sayvaa laa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: My doubts have gone, my fears and infatuations have been dispelled, and all mysorrows are gone.
lines.transliteration: bharam ga-i-aa bh ai moh binaasay miti-aa sagal visooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਏ  ਤੁਮ ਆਿਪ  ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord, the Giver of peace has been merciful to me. I have met thePerfect True Guru. ||4||5||52|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (748-14) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak da-i-aa karee sukh -daatai bhayti-aa sat gur pooraa. ||4||5||52||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When nothing existed, what deeds were being done? And what karma caused anyoneto be born at all?
lines.transliteration: jab kachh na see-o t ab ki-aa kart aa kavan karam kar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਿਟ ਛਡਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself set His play in motion, and He Himself beholds it. He created theCreation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnaa khayl aap kar d aykhai thaakur rachan rachaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਈ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Sovereign Lord, I cannot do anything at all by myself.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam raa-ay mujh t ay kachh oo na ho-ee.

lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, He Himself is the Cause. He is pervading deep within all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa aap karaa-ay sarab nirant ar so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ  ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੨॥
lines.english: If my account were to be judged, I would never be saved. My body is transitory andignorant.
lines.transliteration: gantee gan ee na chh ootai kat hoo kaachee d ayh i-aan ee.

lines.english: Take pity upon me, O Creator Lord God; Your Forgiving Grace is singular and unique.||2||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahu parabh karn aihaaray t ayree bakh as niraalee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਤਬ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਵਨ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਿਰ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You created all beings and creatures. Each and every heart meditates on You.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tayray keet ay gh at ghat tuhee Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਖੇਲੁ ਆਿਪ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your condition and expanse are known only to You; the value of Your creativeomnipotence cannot be estimated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tayree gat  mit toohai jaan eh kud rat keem na paa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: I am worthless, foolish, thoughtless and ignorant. I know nothing about good actionsand righteous living.
lines.transliteration: nirgun mugaDh  ajaan  agi-aanee karam Dh aram nahee jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ ਕਰਾਏ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Take pity on Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; and that Your Will mayseem sweet to him. ||4||6||53|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (748-19) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 749
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu naanak gun  gaavai mith aa lagai t ayraa bh aanaa. ||4||6||53||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਗਠੜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਿਜਨ ਘਿਰ  ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your Saints are very fortunate; their homes are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bhaagth arhay har sant  tumHaaray jinH ghar Dh an har naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਗਣੀ  ਸੇਈ ਇਹ ਆਏ  ਸਫਲ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Their birth is approved, and their actions are fruitful. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parvaan gan ee say-ee ih aa-ay safal t inaa kay kaamaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord, I am a sacrifice to the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam har jan kai ha-o bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਰ ਚਵਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਾ  ਚਰਣ  ਧੂਿੜ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over them; I apply the dust of their feet to myface. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaysaa kaa kar chavar dhulaavaa charan  Dhoorh mukh  laa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those generous, humble beings are above both birth and death.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d uhhoo meh naahee jan par-upkaaree aa-ay.

lines.english: They give the gift of the soul, and practice devotional worship; they inspire others tomeet the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jee-a daan d ay bh agtee laa-in har si-o lain milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ  ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: True are their commands, and true are their empires; they are attuned to the Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar sachee paatisaahee sachay sayt ee raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਇਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਲੈਿਨ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: True is their happiness, and true is their greatness. They know the Lord, to whomthey belong. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sachaa sukh sachee vadi-aa-ee jis kay say t in jaat ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੀ  ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: I wave the fan over them, carry water for them, and grind corn for the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: pakhaa fayree paan ee dh ovaa har jan kai peesan  pees kamaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਜਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਾਤੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer to God - please, grant me the sight of Your humble servants.||4||7||54|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (749-6) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh paas baynant ee tayray jan d aykhan paavaa. ||4||7||54||

lines.punjabi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ  ਢੋਵਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣੁ  ਪੀਿਸ  ਕਮਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is theCreator Lord.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysar satgur aapay karnaihaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਸ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ  ਪਾਵਾ  ॥੪॥੭॥੫੪॥
lines.english: Your servant begs for the dust of Your feet. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision ofYour Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan Dh oorh tayree sayvak maagai t ayray d arsan ka-o balihaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: O my Sovereign Lord, as You keep me, so do I remain.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam raa-ay ji-o raakhahi t i-o rahee-ai.

lines.english: When it pleases You, I chant Your Name. You alone can grant me peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t aa naam japaaveh sukh  tayraa d itaa lahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਧੂਿੜ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਮਾਗੈ  ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Liberation, comfort and proper lifestyle come from serving You; You alone cause us toserve You.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh ugat jugat  tayree sayvaa jis t ooN aap karaa-ihi.

lines.english: That place is heaven, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung. You Yourself instill faith into us. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tahaa baikunth  jah keert an tayraa t ooN aapay sarDh aa laa-ihi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਦਤਾ  ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I live; my mind andbody are enraptured.
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar naam jeevaa tan man ho-ay nihaalaa.

lines.english: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in this water, O my True Guru, O Merciful to themeek. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal t ayray Dh o-ay Dh o-ay peevaa mayray sat gur deen d a-i-aalaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭੁਗਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਇਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that most wonderful time when I came to Your Door.
lines.transliteration: kurbaan jaa-ee us vaylaa suhaavee jit  tumrai d u-aarai aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ  ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਰਧਾ  ਲਾਇਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: God has become compassionate to Nanak; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||8||55|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (749-12) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh bh a-ay kirpaalaa sat gur pooraa paa-i-aa. ||4||8||55||

lines.english: When You come to mind, I am totally in bliss. One who forgets You might just as wellbe dead.
lines.transliteration: tuDh chit aa-ay mahaa anand aa jis visrahi so mar jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That being, whom You bless with Your Mercy, O Creator Lord, constantly meditates onYou. ||1||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal hoveh jis oopar kart ay so t uDh sadaa Dh i-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ਜਾਈ  ਉਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਤੁਮਰੈ  ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You are the honor of the dishonored such as me.
lines.transliteration: mayray saahib tooN mai maan  nimaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੮॥੫੫॥
lines.english: I offer my prayer to You, God; listening, listening to the Word of Your Bani, I live. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ardaas karee parabh  apnay aagai sun  sun jeevaa t ayree ban ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: May I become the dust of the feet of Your humble servants. I am a sacrifice to theBlessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: charan Dh oorh tayray jan kee hovaa t ayray d arsan ka-o bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਏ  ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਵਸਰਿਹ  ਸੋ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I enshrine Your Ambrosial Word within my heart. By Your Grace, I have found theCompany of the Holy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit bachan rid ai ur Dh aaree t a-o kirpaa t ay sang paa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਿਜਸੁ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I place the state of my inner being before You; there is no other as great as You.
lines.transliteration: antar kee gat  tuDh peh saaree t uDh jayvad avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: He alone is attached, whom You attach; he alone is Your devotee. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay laihi so laagai bhagat  tuhaaraa so-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਰੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੇ  ਆਗੈ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਜੀਵਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I beg for this one gift; O my Lord and Master, if itpleases You, I shall obtain it.
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  maaga-o ik d aanaa saahib t uthai paavaa.

lines.english: With each and every breath, Nanak adores You; twenty-four hours a day, I sing YourGlorious Praises. ||4||9||56|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (749-18) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas saas naanak aaraaDhay aath  pahar gun  gaavaa. ||4||9||56||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ ਧੂਿੜ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When You stand over our heads, O Lord and Master, how can we suffer in pain?
lines.transliteration: jis kay sir oopar tooN su-aamee so d ukh kaisaa paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਚਨ  ਿਰਦੈ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ਤਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The mortal being does not know how to chant Your Name - he is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, and the thought of death does not even enter his mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bol na jaanai maa-i-aa mad  maat aa marn aa cheet  na aavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਤੁਧੁ ਪਿਹ ਸਾਰੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O my Sovereign Lord, You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You. pMnw 750
lines.transliteration: mayray raam raa-ay tooN santaa kaa sant  tayray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਉ ਭਉ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ  ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your servant is not afraid of anything; the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray sayvak ka-o bh a-o kichh  naahee jam nahee aavai nayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to Your Love, O my Lord and Master, are released from thepains of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: jo tayrai rang raat ay su-aamee t inH kaa janam maran  dukh naasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: No one can erase Your Blessings; the True Guru has given me this assurance. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayree bakh as na maytai ko-ee sat gur kaa d ilaasaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਿਦਲਾਸਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtain the fruits of peace.Twenty-four hours a day, they worship and adore You.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-in sukh  fal paa-in aath  pahar aaraaDh eh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਿਨ  ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਆਰਾਧਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: In Your Sanctuary, with Your Support, they subdue the five villains. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  tayrai bh arvaasai panch d usat lai saaDh eh. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ  ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ  ਲੈ ਸਾਧਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I know nothing about wisdom, meditation and good deeds; I know nothing about Your excellence.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan kichh  karam na jaan aa saar na jaan aa tayree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak is the greatest of all; He saved my honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.||4||10||57|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (750-5) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay vadaa sat gur naanak jin kal raakh ee mayree. ||4||10||57||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary; save me, O my SaviorLord!
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag gur sarn ee aa-i-aa raakh o raakh anhaaray.

lines.english: Whatever You link me to, to that I am linked; what can this poor creature do? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit too laaveh t it ham laagah ki-aa ayhi jant  vichaaray. ||1||

lines.english: O my Dear Lord God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam jee tooN parabh  antarjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Be Merciful to me, O Divine, Compassionate Guru, that I may constantly sing theGlorious Praises of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gurdayv d a-i-aalaa gun  gaavaa nit  su-aamee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਵਿਹ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਏਿਹ ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my God; by Guru's Grace, I cross over theterrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  apnaa Dh i-aa-ee-ai gur parsaad  bha-o taree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing self-conceit, I have become the dust of all men's feet; in this way, I die, while I am still alive. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap ti-aag ho-ee-ai sabh  raynaa jeevt i-aa i-o maree-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How fruitful is the life of that being in this world, who chants the Name in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: safal janam tis kaa jag bh eetar saaDh sang naa-o jaapay.

lines.english: All desires are fulfilled, for the one who is blessed with God's Kindness and Mercy.||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath tis kay pooran jis d a-i-aa karay parabh  aapay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਿਧਆਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਭਉ ਤਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Merciful to the meek, Kind and Compassionate Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaal parabh  su-aamee t ayree saran  da-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਹੋਈਐ  ਸਭ ਰੇਣਾ ਜੀਵਿਤਆ  ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Take pity upon me, and bless me with Your Name. Nanak is the dust of the feet of theHoly. ||4||11||58|| rwgu sUhI AstpdIAw mhlw 1 Gru 1  (750-12) raag soohee asatpadee-aa mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Raag Soohee, Ashtapadee, First Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (750-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnaa naam deejai naanak saaDh  ravaalaa. ||4||11||58||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਉ  ਜਾਪੇ ॥
lines.english: I am totally without virtue; I have no virtue at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh avgan  mai gun  nahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: How can I meet my Husband Lord? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar kant milaavaa ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have no beauty, no enticing eyes.
lines.transliteration: naa mai roop na bankay nainaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੮॥
lines.english: I do not have a noble family, good manners or a sweet voice. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naa kul dhang na meeth ay bain aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride adorns herself with peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: sahj seegaar kaaman kar aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਅਵਗਣ  ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: But she is a happy soul-bride, only if her Husband Lord is pleased with her. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa sohagan  jaa kant ai bhaavai. ||2||

lines.english: He has no form or feature;
lines.transliteration: naa tis roop na raykh -i-aa kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਬੰਕੇ ਨੈਣਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ant na saahib simri-aa jaa-ee. ||3|| at the very last instant, he cannot suddenly be contemplated. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੁਲ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have no understanding, intellect or cleverness.
lines.transliteration: surat mat  naahee chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: Have Mercy upon me, God, and attach me to Your Feet. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh laavhu paa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: She may be very clever, but this does not please her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: kharee si-aan ee kant  na bh aanee.

lines.english: Attached to Maya, she is deluded by doubt. ||5||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa laagee bharam bh ulaan ee. ||5||

lines.english: But if she gets rid of her ego, then she merges in her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jaa-ee taa kant  samaa-ee.

lines.english: Only then can the soul-bride obtain the nine treasures of her Beloved. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ta-o kaaman  pi-aaray nav niDh  paa-ee. ||6||

lines.english: Separated from You for countless incarnations, I have suffered in pain.
lines.transliteration: anik janam bichhurat  dukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Please take my hand, O my Beloved Sovereign Lord God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kar geh layho pareetam parabh  raa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: Prays Nanak, the Lord is, and shall always be.
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak saho hai bh ee hosee.

lines.english: She alone is ravished and enjoyed, with whom the Beloved Lord is pleased. ||8||1|| pMnw 751 sUhI mhlw 1 Gru 9  (751-1) soohee mehlaa 1 ghar 9 Soohee, First Mehl, Ninth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (751-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jai bhaavai pi-aaraa t ai raavaysee. ||8||1||

lines.english: The color of safflower is transitory; it lasts for only a few days.
lines.transliteration: kachaa rang kasumbh kaa thorh -rhi-aa d in chaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਚਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਕਾ ਥੋੜਿੜਆ  ਿਦਨ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the false woman is deluded by doubt and plundered by thieves.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai bh aram bh ulee-aa th ag muth ee koorh i-aar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੁਲੀਆ  ਠਿਗ  ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂਿੜਆਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: But those who are attuned to the True Lord, are not reincarnated again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachay saytee rat i-aa janam na d oojee vaar jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਤਆ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can one who is already dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, be colored any other color?
lines.transliteration: rangay kaa ki-aa rangee-ai jo ratay rang laa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੇ ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਰੰਗੀਐ  ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: So serve God the Dyer, and focus your consciousness on the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rangan vaalaa sayvee-ai sachay si-o chit  laa-ay jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You wander around in the four directions, but without the good fortune of destiny,you shall never obtain wealth.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa jay bhaveh bin bh aagaa Dh an naahi jee-o.

lines.english: If you are plundered by corruption and vice, you shall wander around, but like afugitive, you shall find no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: avgan muth ee jay fireh baDh ik thaa-ay na paahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਧਨੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Only those who are protected by the Guru are saved; their minds are attuned to theWord of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray sabad  ratay man maahi jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਮੁਠੀ ਜੇ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਬਿਧਕ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who wear white clothes, but have filthy and stone-hearted minds,
lines.transliteration: chitay jin kay kaprhay mailay chit  kathor jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tin mukh  naam na oopjai d oojai vi-aapay chor jee-o. may chant the Lord's Name with their mouths, but they are engrossed in duality; theyare thieves.

lines.english: They do not understand their own roots; they are beasts. They are just animals! ||3||
lines.transliteration: mool na boojheh aapn aa say pasoo-aa say dh or jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਚੋਰ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Constantly, continually, the mortal seeks pleasures. Constantly, continually, he begs for peace.
lines.transliteration: nit nit  khusee-aa man karay nit  nit mangai sukh  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੇ ਪਸੂਆ  ਸੇ ਢੋਰ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: But he does not think of the Creator Lord, and so he is overtaken by pain, again andagain.
lines.transliteration: kartaa chit  na aavee fir fir lageh d ukh jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਮੰਗੈ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: But one, within whose mind the Giver of pleasure and pain dwells - how can his body feel any need? ||4||
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh daataa man vasai t it tan kaisee bh ukh jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਲਗਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who has a karmic debt to pay off is summoned, and the Messenger of Deathsmashes his head.
lines.transliteration: baakee vaalaa talbee-ai sir maaray jand aar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਕੈਸੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: When his account is called for, it has to be given. After it is reviewed, payment isdemanded.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa mangai d ayvnaa puchh ai kar beechaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਕੀ  ਵਾਲਾ  ਤਲਬੀਐ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਮਾਰੇ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Only love for the True One will save you; the Forgiver forgives. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachay kee liv ubrai bakhsay bakh sanhaar jee-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦੇਵਣਾ  ਪੁਛੈ ਕਿਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: If you make any friend other than God, you shall die and mingle with the dust.
lines.transliteration: an ko keejai mit-rh aa kh aak ralai mar jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਿਲਵ  ਉਬਰੈ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the many games of love, you are beguiled and bewildered; you come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: baho rang daykh  bhulaa-i-aa bh ul bhul aavai jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਿਮਤੜਾ  ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Only by God's Grace can you be saved. By His Grace, He unites in His Union. ||6||
lines.transliteration: nadar parabh oo tay chh utee-ai nad ree mayl milaa-ay jee-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਿਖ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਭੁਿਲ ਭੁਿਲ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O careless one, you are totally lacking any wisdom; do not seek wisdom without theGuru.
lines.transliteration: gaafal gi-aan vihooni-aa gur bin gi-aan na bh aal jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: By indecision and inner conflict, you shall come to ruin. Good and bad both pull atyou.
lines.transliteration: khinchot aan viguchee-ai buraa bh alaa d u-ay naal jee-o.

lines.english: Without being attuned to the Word of the Shabad and the Fear of God, all come underthe gaze of the Messenger of Death. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai bh ai rati-aa sabh  johee jamkaal jee-o. ||7||

lines.english: He who created the creation and sustains it, gives sustenance to all.
lines.transliteration: jin kar kaaran Dh aari-aa sabh sai day-ay aaDh aar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਭੈ ਰਿਤਆ  ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: How can you forget Him from your mind? He is the Great Giver, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: so ki-o manhu visaaree-ai sadaa sad aa daataar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਿਰ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ਸਭਸੈ  ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak shall never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of theunsupported. ||8||1||2|| sUhI mhlw 1 kwPI Gru 10  (751-16) soohee mehlaa 1 kaafee ghar 10 Soohee, First Mehl, Kaafee, Tenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (751-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai niDhaaraa aaDh aar jee-o. ||8||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: This human birth is so difficult to obtain; the Gurmukh obtains it.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam d ulambh  gurmukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਿਨਧਾਰਾ  ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: The mind and body are dyed in the deep red color of devotional love, if it pleases the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan ho-ay chulambh  jay sat gur bh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਕਾਫੀ  ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He departs with his life embellished and successful, taking the merchandise of theTrue Name.
lines.transliteration: chalai janam savaar vakhar sach lai.

lines.english: He is honored in the Darbaar, the Royal Court, of the Lord, through the Shabad, theWord of the True Guru, and the Fear of God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pat paa-ay d arbaar sat gur sabad  bhai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਲੰਭੁ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who praises the True Lord with his mind and body, pleases the Mind of the True Lord. pMnw 752
lines.transliteration: man tan sach salaahi saachay man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Attuned to the Beloved Lord, the mind is appeased, and finds the Perfect Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laal rataa man maani-aa gur pooraa paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਲ  ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I live, by cherishing Your Glorious Virtues; You dwell deep within me.
lines.transliteration: ha-o jeevaa gun saar ant ar too vasai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ਅੰਤਿਰ ਤੂ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: You dwell within my mind, and so it naturally celebrates in joyful delight. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tooN vaseh man maahi sehjay ras rasai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਵਸਿਹ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਿਸ ਰਸੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my foolish mind, how can I teach and instruct you?
lines.transliteration: moorakh man samjh aa-ay aakh a-o kayt -rhaa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and so become attuned to His Love. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har gun  gaa-ay rang rangayt -rhaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗੇਤੜਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Continually, continuously, remember and cherish your Beloved Lord in your heart.
lines.transliteration: nit nit  ridai samaal pareet am aapn aa.

lines.english: For if you depart with virtue, then pain shall never afflict you. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jay chaleh gun naal naahee d ukh santaapan aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਨਾਿਲ ਨਾਹੀ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪਣਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, deluded by doubt; he does not enshrinelove for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aram bh ulaan aa naa t is rang hai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਣਾ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He dies as a stranger to his own self, and his mind and body are spoiled. ||6||
lines.transliteration: marsee ho-ay vidaanaa man t an bh ang hai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਸੀ  ਹੋਇ ਿਵਡਾਣਾ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਭੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Performing service to the Guru, you shall go home with the profit.
lines.transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaa-ay laahaa ghar aan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad, the Word of God, the state ofNirvaanaa is attained. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee nirbaan  sabad  pachh aani-aa. ||7||

lines.english: Nanak makes this one prayer: if it pleases Your Will,
lines.transliteration: ik naanak kee ardaas jay t uDh bhaavsee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: ||8||1||3|| sUhI mhlw 1 ] (752-7) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mai deejai naam nivaas har gun  gaavsee. ||8||1||3|| bless me with a home in Your Name, Lord, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਸੀ  ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: As iron is melted in the forge and re-shaped,
lines.transliteration: ji-o aaran lohaa paa-ay bh ann gh arhaa-ee-ai.
ti-o saakat  jonee paa-ay bh avai bh avaa-ee-ai. ||1|| so is the godless materialist reincarnated, and forced to wander aimlessly. ||1||

lines.english: Without understanding, everything is suffering, earning only more suffering.
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay sabh  dukh dukh kamaavan aa.

lines.english: In his ego, he comes and goes, wandering in confusion, deluded by doubt.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai aavai jaa-ay bharam bh ulaavan aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You save those who are Gurmukh, O Lord, through meditation on Your Naam.
lines.transliteration: tooN gurmukh  rakhanhaar har naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: You blend with Yourself, by Your Will, those who practice the Word of the Shabad.||2||
lines.transliteration: mayleh tujh eh rajaa-ay sabad  kamaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: You created the Creation, and You Yourself gaze upon it; whatever You give, is received.
lines.transliteration: tooN kar kar vaykh eh aap d eh so paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: You watch, establish and disestablish; You keep all in Your vision at Your Door. ||3||
lines.transliteration: too daykheh thaap uthaap d ar beenaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: The body shall turn to dust, and the soul shall fly away.
lines.transliteration: dayhee hovag kh aak pavan  udaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖਿਹ ਆਿਪ  ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: So where are their homes and resting places now? They do not find the Mansion ofthe Lord's Presence, either. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ih kithai ghar a-ut aak mahal na paa-ee-ai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਿਪ  ਦਿਰ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the pitch darkness of broad daylight, their wealth is being plundered.
lines.transliteration: dihu d eevee anDh  ghor ghab muhaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Pride is looting their homes like a thief; where can they file their complaint? ||5||
lines.transliteration: garab musai ghar chor kis roo-aa-ee-ai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਿਕਥੈ ਘਰੁ ਅਉਤਾਕੁ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The thief does not break into the home of the Gurmukh; he is awake in the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chor na laag har naam jagaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The Word of the Shabad puts out the fire of desire; God's Light illuminates andenlightens. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sabad nivaaree aag jot  deepaa-ee-ai. ||6||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby; the Guru has taught me theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: laal ratan har naam gur surat  bujhaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਜਗਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who follows the Guru's Teachings remains forever free of desire. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sadaa rahai nihkaam jay gurmat  paa-ee-ai. ||7||

lines.english: Night and day, enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind.
lines.transliteration: raat d ihai har naa-o man vasaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੁ  ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਬੁਝਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Please unite Nanak in Union, O Lord, if it is pleasing to Your Will. ||8||2||4|| sUhI mhlw 1 ] (752-15) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl milaa-ay jay tuDh  bhaa-ee-ai. ||8||2||4||

lines.english: Never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from your mind; night and day,meditate on it.
lines.transliteration: manhu na naam visaar ahinis Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: As You keep me, in Your Merciful Grace, so do I find peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o raakhahi kirpaa Dh aar tivai sukh  paa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: I am blind, and the Lord's Name is my cane.
lines.transliteration: mai anDhulay har naam lakutee tohn ee.

lines.english: I remain under the Sheltering Support of my Lord and Master; I am not enticed byMaya the enticer. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raha-o saahib kee tayk na mohai mohnee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there the Guru has shown me that God is always with me.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah naal gur d aykhaali-aa.

lines.english: Searching inwardly and outwardly as well, I came to see Him, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: antar baahar bh aal sabad  nihaali-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਕੁਟੀ  ਟੋਹਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: So serve the True Guru with love, through the Immaculate Naam, the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: sayvee satgur bh aa-ay naam niranjanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਉ  ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਮੋਹੈ ਮੋਹਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, so by Your Will, You destroy my doubts and fears. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t ivai rajaa-ay bh aram bh a-o bh anjnaa. ||3||

lines.english: At the very moment of birth, he is afflicted with pain, and in the end, he comes onlyto die.
lines.transliteration: janmat hee d ukh laagai marn aa aa-ay kai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਹ ਨਾਿਲ  ਗੁਿਰ ਦੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death are validated and approved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.||4||
lines.transliteration: janam maran parvaan  har gun  gaa-ay kai. ||4||

lines.english: When there is no ego, there You are; You fashioned all of this. pMnw 753
lines.transliteration: ha-o naahee too hoveh t uDh hee saaji-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself establish and disestablish; through the Word of Your Shabad, You elevate and exalt. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaap sabad nivaaji-aa. ||5||

lines.english: When the body rolls in the dust, it is not known where the soul has gone.
lines.transliteration: dayhee bh asam rulaa-ay na jaapee kah ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਭਸਮ  ਰੁਲਾਇ  ਨ ਜਾਪੀ  ਕਹ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is permeating and pervading; this is wonderful and amazing! ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapay rahi-aa samaa-ay so vismaad bh a-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: You are not far away, God; You know everything.
lines.transliteration: tooN naahee parabh  door jaan eh sabh  too hai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੂਿਰ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸਭ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh sees You ever-present; You are deep within the nucleus of our inner self. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vaykh  hadoor ant ar bhee too hai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਵੇਿਖ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਭੀ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Please, bless me with a home in Your Name; may my inner self be at peace.
lines.transliteration: mai deejai naam nivaas ant ar saaNt ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: May slave Nanak sing Your Glorious Praises; O True Guru, please share the Teachingswith me. ||8||3||5|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 3 Gru 1 AstpdIAw  (753-5) raag soohee mehlaa 3 ghar 1 asatpad ee-aa Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (753-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai naanak d aas sat gur mat  day-ay. ||8||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: Everything comes from the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the True Guru, theNaam is not experienced.
lines.transliteration: naamai hee tay sabh  kichh  ho-aa bin sat gur naam na jaapai.
