lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sweetest and most sublime essence, butwithout tasting it, its flavor cannot be experienced.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meeth aa bin chaakh ay saad  na jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: He wastes this human life in exchange for a mere shell; he does not understand his own self.
lines.transliteration: ka-udee badlai janam gavaa-i-aa cheenas naahee aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: But, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to know the One Lord, and the diseaseof egotism does not afflict him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai t aa ayko jaan ai ha-umai d ukh na sant aapai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਡੀ  ਬਦਲੈ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਚੀਨਿਸ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has lovingly attached me to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur apnay vitahu jin saachay si-o liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Concentrating on the Word of the Shabad, the soul is illumined and enlightened. Iremain absorbed in celestial ecstasy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabad cheeneh aat am pargaasi-aa sehjay rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukh sings the Praises of the Lord; the Gurmukh understands. The Gurmukhcontemplates the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gaavai gurmukh  boojh ai gurmukh  sabad  beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਆਤਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Body and soul are totally rejuvenated through the Guru; the Gurmukh's affairs areresolved in his favor.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh gur t ay upjai gurmukh  kaaraj savaaray.

lines.english: The blind self-willed manmukh acts blindly, and earns only poison in this world.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa anDh  kamaavai bikh  khatay sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Enticed by Maya, he suffers in constant pain, without the most Beloved Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi sadaa d ukh paa-ay bin gur at  pi-aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a selfless servant, who serves the True Guru, and walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.
lines.transliteration: so-ee sayvak jay satgur sayvay chaalai sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Shabad, the Word of God, is the True Praise of God; enshrine the True Lordwithin your mind.
lines.transliteration: saachaa sabad sifat  hai saachee saachaa man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh speaks the True Word of Gurbani, and egotism departs from within.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee gurmukh  aakh ai ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਚਾਲੈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Giver, and True are His actions. He proclaims the True Word of theShabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay daat aa karam hai saachaa saachaa sabad  sunaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh works, and the Gurmukh earns; the Gurmukh inspires others to chantthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gh aalay gurmukh  khatay gurmukh  naam japaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਖੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He is forever unattached, imbued with the Love of the True Lord, intuitively inharmony with the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sadaa alipat  saachai rang raat aa gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh always tells lies; he plants the seeds of poison, and eats onlypoison.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sad  hee koorh o bolai bikh  beejai bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਘਾਲੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death, and burnt in the fire of desire;who can save him, except the Guru? ||4||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal baaDhaa t arisnaa d aaDhaa bin gur kavan  chhadaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: True is that place of pilgrimage, where one bathes in the pool of Truth, and achieves self-realization as Gurmukh. The Gurmukh understands his own self.
lines.transliteration: sachaa tirath jit  sat sar naavan  gurmukh  aap bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਕੂੜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Lord has shown that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sixty-eight sacredshrines of pilgrimage; bathing in it, filth is washed away.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath gur sabad  dikhaa-ay t it naatai mal jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ਬਾਧਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਦਾਧਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਵਣੁ  ਛਡਾਏ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: True and Immaculate is the True Word of His Shabad; no filth touches or clings toHim.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad sachaa hai nirmal naa mal lagai na laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਿਜਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: True Praise, True Devotional Praise, is  obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachee sifat sachee saalaah pooray gur t ay paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਦਖਾਏ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਨਾਤੈ  ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Body, mind, everything belongs to the Lord; but the evil-minded ones cannot even say this.
lines.transliteration: tan man sabh  kichh  har t is kayraa d urmat  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: If such is the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then one becomes pure and spotless,and the ego is taken away from within.
lines.transliteration: hukam hovai taa nirmal hovai ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.english: I have intuitively tasted the Guru's Teachings, and the fire of my desire has beenquenched.
lines.transliteration: gur kee saakhee sehjay chaakh ee tarisnaa agan bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is naturally intoxicated, merging imperceptibly into the Lord. ||6|| pMnw 754
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad raat aa sehjay maat aa sehjay rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is known as True, through the Love of the Beloved Guru.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sat kar jaan ai gur kai bh aa-ay pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: True Glorious Greatness is obtained from the Guru, through the Beloved True Name.
lines.transliteration: sachee vadi-aa-ee gur tay paa-ee sachai naa-ay pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The One True Lord is permeating and pervading among all; how rare is the one who contemplates this.
lines.transliteration: ayko sachaa sabh meh vart ai virlaa ko veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself unites us in Union, and forgives us; He embellishes us with truedevotional worship. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl la-ay taa bakh say sachee bh agat savaaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਬਖਸੇ  ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: All is Truth; Truth, and Truth alone is pervading; how rare is the Gurmukh who knowsthis.
lines.transliteration: sabho sach sach sach vart ai gurmukh  ko-ee jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death occur by the Hukam of His Command; the Gurmukh understands hisown self.
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa hukmo vart ai gurmukh  aap pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: He meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and so pleases the True Guru. Hereceives whatever rewards he desires.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ay t aa sat gur bh aa-ay jo ichh ai so fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਏ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who eradicates self-conceit from within, has everything. ||8||1|| sUhI mhlw 3 ] (754-5) soohee mehlaa 3. Soohee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis d aa sabh  kichh  hovai je vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਜ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: The body-bride is very beautiful; she dwells with her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kaaman at  su-aaliha-o pir vasai jis naalay.

lines.english: She becomes the happy soul-bride of her True Husband Lord, contemplating the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: pir sachay tay sad aa suhaagan  gur kaa sabad  samHaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਅਿਤ  ਸੁਆਿਲਉ  ਿਪਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's devotee is forever attuned to the Lord's Love; her ego is burnt away fromwithin. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  sadaa rang raat aa ha-umai vichahu jaalay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਸਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed, blessed is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu pooray gur kee banee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It wells up and springs forth from the Perfect Guru, and merges into Truth.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay upjee saach samaan ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Everything is within the Lord - the continents, worlds and nether regions.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar sabh  kichh  vasai kh and mandal paat aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, dwells within the body; He is the Cherisher ofall.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar jagjeevan d aataa vasai sabh naa karay part ipaalaa.

lines.english: The body-bride is eternally beautiful; the Gurmukh contemplates the Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kaaman sad aa suhaylee gurmukh  naam samHaalaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਵਸੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ  ਪਾਤਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He is invisible and cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar aapay vasai alakh  na lakh i-aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand; he goes out searching for the Lord externally.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mugaDh  boojh ai naahee baahar bh aalan  jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who serves the True Guru is always at peace; the True Guru has shown me theInvisible Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay sad aa sukh  paa-ay sat gur alakh  ditaa lakh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਵਸੈ ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਿਖਆ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Within the body there are jewels and precious treasures, the over-flowing treasure ofdevotion.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar rat an pad aarath bh agat bharay bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭਾਲਿਣ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Within this body are the nine continents of the earth, its markets, cities and streets.
lines.transliteration: is kaa-i-aa andar na-ukh and parithmee haat patan  baajaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਅਲਖੁ ਿਦਤਾ  ਲਖਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Within this body are the nine treasures of the Naam; contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is obtained. ||4||
lines.transliteration: is kaa-i-aa andar naam na-o niDh  paa-ee-ai gur kai sabad  veechaaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Within the body, the Lord estimates the weight; He Himself is the weigher.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar t ol tulaavai aapay t olanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਿਪਰ੍ਥਮੀ  ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ  ਬਾਜਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: This mind is the jewel, the gem, the diamond; it is absolutely priceless.
lines.transliteration: ih man ratan javaahar maan ak tis kaa mol afaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be purchased at any price; the Naam isobtained by contemplating the Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: mol kit hee naam paa-ee-ai naahee naam paa-ee-ai gur beechaaraa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਤੋਿਲ  ਤੁਲਾਵੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh searches this body; all others just wander around in confusion.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so kaa-i-aa kh ojai hor sabh  bharam bh ulaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵਾਹਰ  ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord bestows it. What other clevertricks can anyone try?
lines.transliteration: jis no day-ay so-ee jan paavai hor ki-aa ko karay chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਲ ਿਕਤ  ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Within the body, the Fear of God and Love for Him abides; by Guru's Grace, they areobtained. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar bh a-o bh aa-o vasai gur parsaadee paa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਖੋਜੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Within the body, are Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, from whom the whole worldemanated.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar barahmaa bisan mahaysaa sabh  opat jit sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord has staged and contrived His own play; the expanse of the Universecomes and goes.
lines.transliteration: sachai aapnaa kh ayl rachaa-i-aa aavaa ga-on  paasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru Himself has made it clear, that emancipation comes throughthe True Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur aap d ikhaa-i-aa sach naam nist aaraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ  ਸਭ ਓਪਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: That body, which serves the True Guru, is embellished by the True Lord Himself.
lines.transliteration: saa kaa-i-aa jo satgur sayvai sachai aap savaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਣਾ  ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਆਵਾ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਪਾਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the mortal finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord; he shallbe tortured by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai d ar dho-ee naahee t aa jam karay kh u-aaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, true glory is bestowed, when the Lord showers His Mercy. ||8||2|| pMnw 755 rwgu sUhI mhlw 3 Gru 10  (755-1) raag soohee mehlaa 3 ghar 10 Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Tenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (755-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach vadi-aa-ee paa-ay jis no har kirpaa Dhaaree. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Do not praise the world; it shall simply pass away.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa na saalaahi jo mar vanj see.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਨ ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਜੋ ਮਿਰ ਵੰਞਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Do not praise other people; they shall die and turn to dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lokaa na saalaahi jo mar khaak thee-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਕਾ  ਨ ਸਾਲਾਿਹ  ਜੋ ਮਿਰ ਖਾਕੁ ਥੀਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail to my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: vaahu mayray saahibaa vaahu.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, forever praise the One who is forever True, Independent and Carefree.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa salaahee-ai sachaa vayparvaahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Making worldly friendships, the self-willed manmukhs burn and die.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kayree d ostee manmukh  dajh marann.

lines.english: In the City of Death, they are bound and gagged and beaten; this opportunity shallnever come again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jam pur baDhay maaree-ah vaylaa na lahann. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦਿਝ ਮਰੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: The lives of the Gurmukhs are fruitful and blessed; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh janam sakaarthaa sachai sabad  lagann.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਵੇਲਾ  ਨ ਲਾਹੰਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Their souls are illuminated by the Lord, and they dwell in peace and pleasure. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aatam raam pargaasi-aa sehjay sukh  rahann. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਕਾਰਥਾ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਗੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Word of the Guru's Shabad are engrossed in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad visaari-aa d oojai bh aa-ay rachann.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੁਿਖ ਰਹੰਿਨ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Their hunger and thirst never leave them, and night and day, they wander aroundburning. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tisnaa bh ukh na ut rai an-d in jalat  firann. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਰਚੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those who make friendships with the wicked, and harbor animosity to the Saints,
lines.transliteration: dustaa naal d ostee naal sant aa vair karann.
aap dubay kutamb si-o saglay kul dobann. ||5|| shall drown with their families, and thei r entire lineage shall be obliterated. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਟਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਸੰਤਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: It is not good to slander anyone, but the foolish, self-willed manmukhs still do it.
lines.transliteration: nindaa bh alee kisai kee naahee manmukh  mugaDh  karann.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਡੁਬੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਿਸਉ ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੰਿਨ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The faces of the slanderers turn black, and they fall into the most horrible hell. ||6||
lines.transliteration: muh kaalay tin nind kaa narkay gh or pavann. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਭਲੀ ਿਕਸੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਕਰੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, as you serve, so do you become, and so are the deeds that you do.
lines.transliteration: ay man jaisaa sayveh taisaa hoveh t ayhay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever you yourself plant, that is what you shall have to eat; nothing else can be said about this. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aap beej aapay hee khaavn aa kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਜੈਸਾ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The speech of the great spiritual beings has a higher purpose.
lines.transliteration: mahaa purkhaa kaa boln aa hovai kit ai parthaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਬੀਿਜ  ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵਣਾ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: They are filled to over-flowing with Ambrosial Nectar, and they have absolutely nogreed at all. ||8||
lines.transliteration: o-ay amrit bh aray bh arpoor heh onaa t il na t amaa-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ  ਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਕਤੈ  ਪਰਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous accumulate virtue, and teach others.
lines.transliteration: gunkaaree gun  sangh rai avraa upd aysayn.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭਰਪੂਰ  ਹਿਹ ਓਨਾ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Those who meet with them are so very fortunate; night and day, they chant theNaam, the Name of the Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee je onaa mil rahay an-d in naam la-ayn. ||9||

lines.english: He who created the Universe, gives sustenance to it.
lines.transliteration: daysee rijak sambaahi jin upaa-ee mayd nee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜ ਓਨਾ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਿਨ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The One Lord alone is the Great Giver. He Himself is the True Master. ||10||
lines.transliteration: ayko hai daat aar sachaa aap Dh anee. ||10||

lines.english: That True Lord is always with you; the Gurmukh is blessed with His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: so sach tayrai naal hai gurmukh  nadar nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਿਪ  ਧਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He Himself shall forgive you, and merge you into Himself; forever cherish andcontemplate God. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay mayl la-ay so parabh  sadaa samaal. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The mind is impure; only the True Lord is pure. So how can it merge into Him?
lines.transliteration: man mailaa sach nirmalaa ki-o kar mili-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: God merges it into Himself, and then it remains merged; through the Word of HisShabad, the ego is burnt away. ||12||
lines.transliteration: parabh maylay t aa mil rahai ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay. ||12||

lines.english: Cursed is the life in this world, of one who forgets her True Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: so saho sachaa veesrai Dharig jeevan  sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Lord grants His Mercy, and she does not forget Him, if she contemplates theGuru's Teachings. ||13||
lines.transliteration: nadar karay naa veesrai gurmat ee veechaar. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru unites her, and so she remains united with Him, with the True Lordenshrined within her heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur maylay t aa mil rahaa saach rakh aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: And so united, she will not be separated again; she remains in the love and affectionof the Guru. ||14||
lines.transliteration: mili-aa ho-ay na veechhurh ai gur kai hayt  pi-aar. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I praise my Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: pir saalaahee aapnaa gur kai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; I am His most beautiful and happysoul-bride. ||15||
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam sukh  paa-i-aa sobh aavant ee naar. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is not softened; his consciousness is totally polluted and stone-hearted.
lines.transliteration: manmukh man na bh ij-ee at  mailay chit  kathor.

lines.english: Even if the venomous snake is fed on milk, it shall still be filled with poison. ||16||
lines.transliteration: sapai duDh  pee-aa-ee-ai and ar vis nikor. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਨੁ ਨ ਿਭਜਈ  ਅਿਤ  ਮੈਲੇ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਠੋਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself does - who else should I ask? He Himself is the Forgiving Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhee-ai aapay bakh sanhaar.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, filth is washed away, and then, one is embellished with the ornament of Truth. ||17|| pMnw 756
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee mail ut rai taa sach ban i-aa seegaar. ||17||

lines.english: True is the Banker, and True are His traders. The false ones cannot remain there.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu sachay vanjaaray othai koorh ay na tikann.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ਓਥੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਨਾ ਿਟਕੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They do not love the Truth - they are consumed by their pain. ||18||
lines.transliteration: onaa sach na bhaav-ee d ukh hee maahi pachann. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਪਚੰਿਨ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The world wanders around in the filth of egotism; it dies, and is re-born, over andagain.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mailaa jag firai mar jammai vaaro vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਿਫਰੈ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase.||19||
lines.transliteration: pa-i-ai kirat kamaavan aa ko-ay na maytan haar. ||19||

lines.english: But if he joins the Society of the Saints, then he comes to embrace love for the Truth.
lines.transliteration: santaa sangat  mil rahai t aa sach lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਚ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Praising the True Lord with a truthful mind, he becomes true in the Court of the True Lord. ||20||
lines.transliteration: sach salaahee sach man dar sachai sachiaar. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸਿਚਆਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The Teachings of the Perfect Guru are perfect; meditate on the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray pooree mat hai ahinis naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਤ ਹੈ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Egotism and self-conceit are terrible diseases; tranquility and stillness come fromwithin. ||21||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa vad rog hai vichahu thaak rahaa-ay. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਹਾਇ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: I praise my Guru; bowing down to Him again and again, I fall at His Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur saalaahee aapnaa niv niv laagaa paa-ay.

lines.english: I place my body and mind in offering unto Him, eradicating self-conceit from within.||22||
lines.transliteration: tan man sa-upee aagai Dh aree vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੀ  ਆਗੈ  ਧਰੀ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Indecision leads to ruin; focus your attention on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: khinchot aan viguchee-ai aykas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Renounce egotism and self-conceit, and remain merged in Truth. ||23||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa chhad t oo taa sach rahai samaa-ay. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਛਿਡ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Those who meet with the True Guru are my Siblings of Destiny; they are committed tothe True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur no milay se bh aa-iraa sachai sabad  lagann.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਿਮਲੇ ਿਸ ਭਾਇਰਾ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਗੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those who merge with the True Lord shall not be separated again; they are judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||24||
lines.transliteration: sach milay say na vichhurh eh dar sachai d isann. ||24||

lines.english: They are my Siblings of Destiny, and they are my friends, who serve the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say bhaa-ee say sajn aa jo sachaa sayvann.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ  ਜੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They sell off their sins and demerits like straw, and enter into the partnership ofvirtue. ||25||
lines.transliteration: avgan vikan  pulHran gun  kee saajh  karaNniH. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਿਵਕਿਣ  ਪਲਰਿਨ  ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੰਿਨ ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: In the partnership of virtue, peace wells up, and they perform true devotional worshipservice.
lines.transliteration: gun kee saajh  sukh  oopjai sachee bh agat karayn.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They deal in Truth, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and they earn the profitof the Naam. ||26||
lines.transliteration: sach vanaNjahi gur sabad  si-o laahaa naam la-ayn. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਿਸਉ ਲਾਹਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਿਨ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Gold and silver may be earned by committing sins, but they will not go with you whenyou die.
lines.transliteration: su-inaa rupaa paap kar kar sanchee-ai chalai na chaldi-aa naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਸੰਚੀਐ  ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing will go with you in the end, except the Name; all are plundered by theMessenger of Death. ||27||
lines.transliteration: vin naavai naal na chalsee sabh  muth ee jamkaal. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਲਸੀ  ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the nourishment of the mind; cherish it, and preserve it carefullywithin your heart.
lines.transliteration: man kaa tosaa har naam hai hird ai rakh ahu samHaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਖਹੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: This nourishment is inexhaustible; it is always with the Gurmukhs. ||28||
lines.transliteration: ayhu kharach akh ut hai gurmukh  nibhai naal. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਖਰਚੁ  ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਨਬਹੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: O mind, if you forget the Primal Lord, you shall depart, having lost your honor.
lines.transliteration: ay man moolhu bhuli-aa jaaseh pat  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਿਲਆ  ਜਾਸਿਹ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This world is engrossed in the love of duality; follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the True Lord. ||29||
lines.transliteration: ih jagat mohi d oojai vi-aapi-aa gurmat ee sach Dh i-aa-ay. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਦੂਜੈ ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇ ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; the Lord's Praises cannot be written down.
lines.transliteration: har kee keemat na pavai har jas likh an na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਿਲਖਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When one's mind and body are attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, oneremains merged in the Lord. ||30||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man t an rapai har si-o rahai samaa-ay. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਪੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord is playful; He has imbued me with His Love, with natural ease.
lines.transliteration: so saho mayraa rangulaa rangay sahj subhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ  ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is imbued with His Love, when her Husband Lord merges her into HisBeing. ||31||
lines.transliteration: kaaman rang t aa charh ai jaa pir kai ank samaa-ay. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਰੰਗੁ ਤਾ ਚੜੈ ਜਾ ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: Even those who have been separated for so very long, are reunited with Him, whenthey serve the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: chiree vichhunay bh ee milan jo sat gur sayvann.

lines.english: The nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deep within the nucleus of the self; consuming them, they are still never exhausted. Chant the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord, with natural ease. ||32||
lines.transliteration: antar nav niDh  naam hai kh aan kh archan na nikh uta-ee har gun  sahj ravann. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਖਾਿਨ  ਖਰਚਿਨ  ਨ ਿਨਖੁਟਈ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਵੰਿਨ  ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: They are not born, and they do not die; they do not suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: naa o-ay janmeh naa mareh naa o-ay dukh  sahann.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਨਾ ਮਰਿਹ  ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They celebrate with the Lord. ||33||
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray har si-o kayl karann. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਿਨ  ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Those who are united with the Lord, the True Friend, are not separated again; nightand day, they remain blended with Him.
lines.transliteration: sajan milay na vichh urheh je an-d in milay rahann.

lines.english: In this world, only a rare few are known, O Nanak, to have obtained the True Lord.||34||1||3|| sUhI mhlw 3 ] (756-18) soohee mehlaa 3. Soohee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: is jag meh virlay jaanee-ahi naanak sach lahann. ||34||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਲਹੰਿਨ  ॥੩੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is subtle and inaccessible; how can we ever meet Him?
lines.transliteration: har jee sookham agam hai kit  biDh mili-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt is dispelled, and the Carefree Lordcomes to abide in the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bh aram katee-ai achint  vasai man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਸੂਖਮੁ  ਅਗਮੁ  ਹੈ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. pMnw 757
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har har naam japann.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord in their minds forever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin kai balihaarn ai man har gun  sadaa ravann. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੰਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru is like the Mansarovar Lake; only the very fortunate beings find Him.
lines.transliteration: gur sarvar maan sarovar hai vadbhaagee purakh  lahaNniH.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, seek out the Guru; the swan-souls feed there onthe Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sayvak gurmukh kh oji-aa say hansulay naam lahann. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਲਹੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and remain linked to the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-eeniH rang si-o gurmukh  naam lagaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੋਿਜਆ  ਸੇ ਹੰਸੁਲੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹੰਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhur poorab hovai likh i-aa gur bh aanaa man la-ayniH. ||3|| Whatever is pre-ordained, accept it as the Will of the Guru. ||3||
By great good fortune, I searched my home, and found the treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gh ar khoji-aa paa-i-aa naam niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਲਏਿਨ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has shown God to me; I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul.||4||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai vaykhaali-aa parabh  aatam raam pachh aan. ||4||

lines.english: There is One God of all; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa parabh  ayk hai d oojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind; in the heart of such a one, He is revealed. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasai tit  ghat pargat ho-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: God is the Inner-knower of all hearts; God dwells in every place.
lines.transliteration: sabh ant arjaamee barahm hai barahm vasai sabh  thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਘਿਟ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: So who should we call evil? Behold the Word of the Shabad, and lovingly dwell uponit. ||6||
lines.transliteration: mandaa kis no aakh ee-ai sabad  vaykh hu liv laa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹੈ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He calls others bad and good, as long as he is in duality.
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa t ichar aakh -daa jichar hai d uhu maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh understands the One and Only Lord; He is absorbed in the One Lord.||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ayko bujh i-aa aykas maahi samaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਿਤਚਰੁ ਆਖਦਾ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: That is selfless service, which pleases God, and which is approved by God.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa saa parabh bh aavsee jo parabh  paa-ay thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਬੁਿਝਆ  ਏਕਸੁ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak worships the Lord in adoration; he focuses his consciousness on theGuru's Feet. ||8||2||4||9|| rwgu sUhI AstpdIAw mhlw 4 Gru 2  (757-9) raag soohee asatpadee-aa mehlaa 4 gh ar 2 Raag Soohee, Ashtapadees, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (757-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har aaraaDhi-aa gur charn ee chit  laa-ay. ||8||2||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਸੀ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Darling Beloved; I would sell myself to him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aan milaavai mayraa pareet am pi-aaraa ha-o t is peh aap vaychaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: I long for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan har d aykhan kai taa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord shows Mercy unto me, then I meet the True Guru; I meditate on theName of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahi taa sat gur mayleh har har naam Dh i-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਆਪੁ  ਵੇਚਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If You will bless me with happiness, then I will worship and adore You. Even in pain, I will meditate on You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jay sukh d eh ta tujheh araaDh ee dukh bhee tujhai Dhi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Even if You give me hunger, I will still feel satisfied; I am joyful, even in the midst ofsorrow. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay bhukh  deh ta it hee raajaa d ukh vich sookh  manaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I would cut my mind and body apart into pieces, and offer them all to You; I wouldburn myself in fire. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tan man kaat kaat sabh  arpee vich agnee aap jalaa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: I wave the fan over You, and carry water for You; whatever You give me, I take. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pakhaa fayree paan ee dh ovaa jo d ayveh so kh aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਤੁਝਿਹ ਅਰਾਧੀ  ਦੁਿਖ ਭੀ ਤੁਝੈ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Poor Nanak has fallen at the Lord's Door; please, O Lord, unite me with Yourself, byYour Glorious Greatness. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak gareeb dheh pa-i-aa d u-aarai har mayl laihu vadi-aa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਭੁਖ ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਇਤ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ  ਦੁਖ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੂਖ ਮਨਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Taking out my eyes, I place them at Your Feet; after travelling over the entire earth, I have come to understand this. ||7||
lines.transliteration: akhee kaadh  Dharee charn aa tal sabh  Dhartee fir mat  paa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁਮਨੁ ਕਾਿਟ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਅਗਨੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਜਲਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: If You seat me near You, then I worship and adore You. Even if You beat me anddrive me out, I will still meditate on You. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jay paas bahaaleh taa t ujheh araaDh ee jay maar kadh eh bh ee Dh i-aa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ  ਢੋਵਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਸੋ ਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: If people praise me, the praise is Yours. Even if they slander me, I will not leave You. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jay lok salaahay taa t ayree upmaa jay nind ai ta chh od na jaa-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗਰੀਬੁ  ਢਿਹ ਪਇਆ  ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਹੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: If You are on my side, then anyone can say anything. But if I were to forget You, then I would die. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jay tuDh  val rahai t aa ko-ee kihu aakh a-o tuDh visri-ai mar jaa-ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਧਰੀ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਿਲ  ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਮਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Guru; falling at His Feet, I surrender to the SaintlyGuru. ||11||
lines.transliteration: vaar vaar jaa-ee gur oopar pai pairee sant manaa-ee. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਪਾਿਸ  ਬਹਾਲਿਹ  ਤਾ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਅਰਾਧੀ  ਜੇ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢਿਹ  ਭੀ ਿਧਆਈ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Poor Nanak has gone insane, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.||12||
lines.transliteration: naanak vichaaraa bha-i-aa d ivaanaa har t a-o darsan kai t aa-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਜੇ ਿਨੰਦੈ  ਤ ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Even in violent storms and torrential rain, I go out to catch a glimpse of my Guru.||13||
lines.transliteration: jhakh arh jhaagee meehu varsai bh ee gur d aykhan jaa-ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਲ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਿਕਹੁ ਆਖਉ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਵਸਿਰਐ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Even though the oceans and the salty seas are very vast, the GurSikh will cross over itto get to his Guru. ||14||
lines.transliteration: samund saagar hovai baho kh aaraa gursikh  langh  gur peh jaa-ee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਜਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਪੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਈ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Just as the mortal dies without water, so does the Sikh die without the Guru. ||15|| pMnw 758
lines.transliteration: ji-o paraanee jal bin hai mart aa ti-o sikh  gur bin mar jaa-ee. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਤਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਿਸਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Just as the earth looks beautiful when the rain falls, so does the Sikh blossom forth meeting the Guru. ||16||
lines.transliteration: ji-o Dhart ee sobh  karay jal barsai t i-o sikh  gur mil bigsaa-ee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਧਰਤੀ  ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਸੈ  ਿਤਉ  ਿਸਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਬਗਸਾਈ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I long to be the servant of Your servants; I call upon You reverently in prayer. ||17||
lines.transliteration: sayvak kaa ho-ay sayvak vartaa kar kar bin-o bulaa-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਵਰਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਿਬਨਉ  ਬੁਲਾਈ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may meet the Guru, and find peace.||18||
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee har peh gur mil gur sukh  paa-ee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the disciple; through the Guru, I meditate on You. ||19||
lines.transliteration: too aapay gur chaylaa hai aapay gur vich d ay tujheh Dh i-aa-ee. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰ ਿਵਚੁ ਦੇ ਤੁਝਿਹ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Those who serve You, become You. You preserve the honor of Your servants. ||20||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  sayveh so t oohai hoveh t uDh sayvak paij rakh aa-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਕ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: O Lord, Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. One who loves You, is blessed with it. ||21||
lines.transliteration: bhandaar bh aray bh agtee har t ayray jis bh aavai t is dayvaa-ee. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਭਰੇ ਭਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਵਾਈ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: That humble being alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it. All other clever tricksare fruitless. ||22||
lines.transliteration: jis tooN deh so-ee jan paa-ay hor nihfal sabh  chaturaa-ee. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਰ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Remembering, remembering, remembering my Guru in meditation, my sleeping mindis awakened. ||23||
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar gur apunaa so-i-aa man jaagaa-ee. ||23||

lines.english: Poor Nanak begs for this one blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves ofthe Lord. ||24||
lines.transliteration: ik daan mangai naanak vaychaaraa har d aasan d aas karaa-ee. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵੇਚਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਾਈ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Even if the Guru rebukes me, He still seems very sweet to me. And if He actuallyforgives me, that is the Guru's greatness. ||25||
lines.transliteration: jay gur jhirh kay ta meeth aa laagai jay bakh say ta gur vadi-aa-ee. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਝੜਕੇ  ਤ ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਜੇ ਬਖਸੇ  ਤ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: That which Gurmukh speaks is certified and approved. Whatever the self-willedmanmukh says is not accepted. ||26||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boleh so thaa-ay paa-ay manmukh  kichh  thaa-ay na paa-ee. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਸੋ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Even in the cold, the frost and the snow, the GurSikh still goes out to see his Guru.||27||
lines.transliteration: paalaa kakar varaf varsai gursikh gur d aykhan jaa-ee. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਲਾ  ਕਕਰੁ ਵਰਫ  ਵਰਸੈ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖੁ  ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: All day and night, I gaze upon my Guru; I install the Guru's Feet in my eyes. ||28||
lines.transliteration: sabh d inas rain  daykh-a-u gur apunaa vich akh ee gur pair Dh araa-ee. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਦੇਖਉ  ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਅਖੀ  ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਾਈ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: I make so many efforts for the sake of the Guru; only that which pleases the Guru isaccepted and approved. ||29||
lines.transliteration: anayk upaav karee gur kaaran gur bh aavai so thaa-ay paa-ee. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Night and day, I worship the Guru's Feet in adoration; have Mercy upon me, O myLord and Master. ||30||
lines.transliteration: rain d inas gur charan  araaDh ee da-i-aa karahu mayray saa-ee. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ  ਅਰਾਧੀ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: The Guru is Nanak's body and soul; meeting the Guru, he is satisfied and satiated. ||31||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa jee-o pind guroo hai gur mil taripat  aghaa-ee. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਈ  ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: Nanak's God is perfectly permeating and all-pervading. Here and there andeverywhere, the Lord of the Universe. ||32||1|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 4 AstpdIAw Gru 10  (758-13) raag soohee mehlaa 4 asatpadee-aa gh ar 10 Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Ashtapadees, Tenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (758-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa parabh poor rahi-o hai jat  kat tat gosaa-ee. ||32||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਹੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਗੋਸਾਈ  ॥੩੨॥੧॥
lines.english: Deep within myself, I have enshrined true love for my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: andar sachaa nayhu laa-i-aa pareet am aapn ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My body and soul are in ecstasy; I see my Guru before me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tan man ho-ay nihaal jaa gur d aykhaa saamHnay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਆਪਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: I have purchased the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mai har har naam visaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਾਮਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Ambrosial Nectar from the PerfectGuru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay paa-i-aa amrit  agam athaahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Gazing upon the True Guru, I blossom forth in ecstasy; I am in love with the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o satgur vaykh  vigsee-aa har naamay lagaa pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through His Mercy, the Lord has united me with Himself, and I have found the Door of Salvation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kar kai mayli-an paa-i-aa mokh d u-aar. ||2||

lines.english: The True Guru is the Lover of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Meeting Him, Idedicate my body and mind to Him.
lines.transliteration: satgur birhee naam kaa jay milai t a tan man d ay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਸੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: And if it is so pre-ordained, then I shall automatically drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.||3||
lines.transliteration: jay poorab hovai likhi-aa t aa amrit  sahj pee-ay-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਮੇਿਲਅਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Praise the Guru while you are asleep, and call on the Guru while you are up.
lines.transliteration: suti-aa gur salaahee-ai uth -di-aa bh ee gur aalaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਬਰਹੀ  ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
lines.english: If only I could meet such a Gurmukh; I would wash His Feet. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aisaa gurmukh jay milai ha-o t aa kay Dh ovaa paa-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਤਾ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਪੀਏਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I long for such a Friend, to unite me with my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aisaa sajan lorh  lahu mai pareet am day-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਉਠਿਦਆ  ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, I have found the Lord. He has met me, easily and effortlessly. ||5|| pMnw 759
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai har paa-i-aa mili-aa sahj subh aa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: The True Guru is the Ocean of Virtue of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have such a yearning to see Him!
lines.transliteration: satgur saagar gun  naam kaa mai t is daykhan kaa chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਖਣ  ਕਾ ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant. If I do not see Him, I die. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis bin gh arhee na jeev-oo bin d aykhay mar jaa-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵਊ  ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: As the fish cannot survive at all without water,
lines.transliteration: ji-o machhulee vin  paan ee-ai rahai na kit ai upaa-ay.
ti-o har bin sant  na jeev-ee bin har naamai mar jaa-ay. ||7|| the Saint cannot live without the Lord. Without the Lord's Name, he dies. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I am so much in love with my True Guru! How could I even live without the Guru, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: mai satgur sayt ee pirharh ee ki-o gur bin jeevaa maa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਤੀ ਿਪਰਹੜੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਉ ॥
lines.english: I have the Support of the Word of the Guru's Bani. Attached to Gurbani, I survive.||8||
lines.transliteration: mai gurbaanee aaDh aar hai gurbaan ee laag rahaa-o. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁ ਰਬਾਣੀ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹਾਉ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel; by the Pleasure of His Will, the Guru hasgiven it, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: har har naam ratann hai gur t uthaa dayvai maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ  ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Name is my only Support. I remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name.||9||
lines.transliteration: mai Dhar sachay naam kee har naam rahaa liv laa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹਾ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The wisdom of the Guru is the treasure of the Naam. The Guru implants andenshrines the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan padaarath naam hai har naamo d ay-ay drirh -aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He alone receives it, he alone gets it, who comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jis paraapat so lahai gur charn ee laagai aa-ay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਇ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: If only someone would come and tell me the Unspoken Speech of the Love of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: akath kahaanee paraym kee ko pareet am aakh ai aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ ਆਖੈ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: I would dedicate my mind to him; I would bow down in humble respect, and fall at hisfeet. ||11||
lines.transliteration: tis dayvaa man aapn aa niv niv laagaa paa-ay. ||11||

lines.english: You are my only Friend, O my All-knowing, All-powerful Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sajan mayraa ayk t ooN kartaa purakh  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: You have brought me to meet with my True Guru. Forever and ever, You are my onlystrength. ||12||
lines.transliteration: satgur meet  milaa-i-aa mai sad aa sad aa tayraa t aan. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੀਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: My True Guru, forever and ever, does not come and go.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa sad aa sad aa naa aavai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Imperishable Creator Lord; He is permeating and pervading among all.||13||
lines.transliteration: oh abhinaasee purakh  hai sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: I have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name. My facilities and faculties are intact,safe and sound.
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan sanchi-aa saabat  poonjee raas.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ  ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am approved and respected in the Court of the Lord; the Perfect Guru hasblessed me! ||14||1||2||11|| rwgu sUhI AstpdIAw mhlw 5 Gru 1  (759-11) raag soohee asatpadee-aa mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 Raag Soohee, Ashtapadees, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (759-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak dargeh mani-aa gur pooray saabaas. ||14||1||2||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥੧੪॥੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He is entangled in sinful associations;
lines.transliteration: urajh rahi-o bikh i-aa kai sangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: maneh bi-aapat anik t arangaa. ||1|| his mind is troubled by so very many waves. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, how can the Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord be found? He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayray man agam agochar. kat paa-ee-ai pooran parmaysar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He remains entangled in the intoxication of worldly love.
lines.transliteration: moh magan meh rahi-aa bi-aapay.

lines.english: His excessive thirst is never quenched. ||2||
lines.transliteration: at tarisnaa kabhoo nahee Dh araapay. ||2||

lines.english: Anger is the outcaste which hides within his body;
lines.transliteration: bas-i karoDh sareer chandaaraa.
agi-aan na soojhai mahaa gubaaraa. ||3|| he is in the utter darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand. ||3||

lines.english: Afflicted by doubt, the shutters are shut tight;
lines.transliteration: bharmat  bi-aapat  jaray kivaaraa.
jaan na paa-ee-ai parabh  darbaaraa. ||4|| he cannot go to God's Court. ||4||

lines.english: The mortal is bound and gagged by hope and fear;
lines.transliteration: aasaa andaysaa banDh  paraanaa.
mahal na paavai firat bigaanaa. ||5|| he cannot find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and so he wanders around like a stranger. ||5||

lines.english: He falls under the power of all negative influences;
lines.transliteration: sagal bi-aaDh kai vas kar d eenaa.
firat pi-aas ji-o jal bin meenaa. ||6|| he wanders around thirsty like a fish out of water. ||6||

lines.english: I have no clever tricks or techniques;
lines.transliteration: kachhoo si-aanap ukat  na moree.

lines.english: You are my only hope, O my Lord God Master. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ayk aas thaakur parabh  toree. ||7||

lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer to the Saints
lines.transliteration: kara-o bayntee sant an paasay.
mayl laihu naanak ardaasay. ||8|| - please let me merge and blend with You. ||8||

lines.english: God has shown Mercy, and I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal saaDh sang paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak is satisfied, finding the Perfect Lord. ||1||Second Pause||1|| pMnw 760 rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 Gru 3  (760-1) raag soohee mehlaa 5 ghar 3 Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (760-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak taript ai pooraa paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Attachment to sex is an ocean of fire and pain.
lines.transliteration: mithan moh agan sok saagar.

lines.english: By Your Grace, O Sublime Lord, please save me from it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa uDhar har naagar. ||1||

lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sarn aa-ay naraa-in .

lines.english: He is the Master of the meek, the Support of His devotees. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath bh agat paraa-in . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Master of the masterless, Patron of the forlorn, Eradicator of fear of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: anaathaa naath bhagat  bhai maytan.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jamd oot na bh aytan. ||2||

lines.english: The Merciful, Incomparably Beautiful, Embodiment of Life.
lines.transliteration: jeevan roop anoop da-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Vibrating the Glorious Virtues of the Lord, the noose of the Messenger of Death is cutaway. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ravan gun aa katee-ai jam jaalaa. ||3||

lines.english: One who constantly chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam with his tongue,
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rasan nit  jaapai.
rog roop maa-i-aa na bi-aapai. ||4|| is not touched or affected by Maya, the embodiment of disease. ||4||

lines.english: Chant and meditate on God, the Lord of the Universe, and all of your companionsshall be carried across;
lines.transliteration: jap gobind sangee sabh  taaray.
pohat naahee panch batvaaray. ||5|| the five thieves will not even approach. ||5||

lines.english: One who meditates on the One God in thought, word and deed
lines.transliteration: man bach karam parabh ayk Dh i-aa-ay.
sarab falaa so-ee jan paa-ay. ||6|| - that humble being receives the fruits of all rewards. ||6||

lines.english: Dhaar anoograhu apnaa parabh  keenaa. Showering His Mercy, God has made me His own;
He has blessed me with the unique and singular Naam, and the sublime essence ofdevotion. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kayval naam bhagat  ras d eenaa. ||7||

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is God.
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant parabh  so-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, without Him, there is no other at all. ||8||1||2|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 AstpdIAw Gru 9  (760-9) raag soohee mehlaa 5 asatpadee-aa gh ar 9 Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees, Ninth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (760-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis bin avar na ko-ee. ||8||1||2||

lines.english: Gazing upon them, my mind is enraptured. How can I join them and be with them?
lines.transliteration: jin dithi-aa man rehsee-ai ki-o paa-ee-ai t inH sang jee-o.

lines.english: They are Saints and friends, good friends of my mind, who inspire me and help metune in to God's Love.
lines.transliteration: sant sajan man mit ar say laa-in parabh  si-o rang jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੯ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: My love for them shall never die; it shall never, ever be broken. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tinH si-o pareet  na tut-ee kabahu na hovai bh ang jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, please grant me Your Grace, that I might constantly sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh kar d a-i-aa gun  gaavaa t ayray nit  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ  ਮਨ ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਸੇ ਲਾਇਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Come, and meet with me, O Saints, and good friends; let us chant and meditate onthe Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Best Friend of my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay milhu sant sajn aa naam japah man mit  jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਤੁਟਈ  ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not see, he does not hear, and he does not understand; he is blind, enticedand bewitched by Maya.
lines.transliteration: daykh ai sun ay na jaan -ee maa-i-aa mohi-aa anDh  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਤੇਰੇ ਿਨਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: His body is false and transitory; it shall perish. And still, he entangles himself in falsepursuits.
lines.transliteration: kaachee dayhaa vin sanee koorh  kamaavai Dh anDh jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹ  ਮਨ ਿਮਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They alone depart victorious, who have meditated on the Naam; they stick with thePerfect Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aavahi say jin  chalay gur pooray san-banDh  jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: By the Hukam of God's Will, they come into this world, and they leave upon receipt ofHis Hukam.
lines.transliteration: hukmay jug meh aa-i-aa chalan hukam sanjog jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By His Hukam, the Expanse of the Universe is expanded. By His Hukam, they enjoypleasures.
lines.transliteration: hukmay parpanch pasri-aa hukam karay ras bhog jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚੀ  ਦੇਹਾ ਿਵਣਸਣੀ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਧੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who forgets the Creator Lord, suffers sorrow and separation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis no kartaa visrai t iseh vichh orhaa sog jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਿਜਿਣ  ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who is pleasing to his God, goes to His Court dressed in robes of honor.
lines.transliteration: aapnarhay parabh  bhaani-aa d argeh paiDh aa jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ਚਲਣੁ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸੰਜੋਿਗ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who meditates on the Naam, the One Name, finds peace in this world; his face is radiant and bright.
lines.transliteration: aithai sukh mukh  ujlaa iko naam Dh i-aa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਕਰੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord confers honor and respect on those who serve the Guru with truelove. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aadar d itaa paarbarahm gur sayvi-aa sat  bhaa-ay jee-o. ||4||

lines.english: He is pervading and permeating the spaces and interspaces; He loves and cherishesall beings.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahi-aa sarab jee-aa part ipaal jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨੜੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਿਣਆ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have accumulated the true treasure, the wealth and riches of the One Name.
lines.transliteration: sach khajaanaa sanchi-aa ayk naam Dh an maal jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ  ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never forget Him from my mind, since He has been so merciful to me. ||5|| pMnw 761
lines.transliteration: man tay kabahu na veesrai jaa aapay ho-ay d a-i-aal jee-o. ||5||

lines.english: My comings and goings have ended; the Formless Lord now dwells within my mind.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa reh ga-ay man vuth aa nirankaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਰਿਹ ਗਏ ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: His limits cannot be found; He is lofty and exalted, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: taa kaa ant  na paa-ee-ai oochaa agam apaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who forgets His God, shall die and be reincarnated, hundreds of thousands of times. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jis parabh apn aa visrai so mar jammai lakh  vaar jee-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸੋ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: They alone bear true love for their God, within whose minds He Himself dwells.
lines.transliteration: saach nayhu tin pareet amaa jin man vuth aa aap jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਿਤਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮਾ ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਿਪ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: So dwell only with those who share their virtues; chant and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: gun saajh ee tin sang basay aath  pahar parabh  jaap jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸੇ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਿਪ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: They are attuned to the Love of the Transcendent Lord; all their sorrows andafflictions are dispelled. ||7||
lines.transliteration: rang ratay parmaysrai binsay sagal sant aap jee-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਤਾਪ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You are the Creator, You are the Cause of causes; You are the One and the many.
lines.transliteration: tooN kartaa tooN karanhaar t oohai ayk anayk jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are All-powerful, You are present everywhere; You are the subtle intellect, the clear wisdom.
lines.transliteration: too samrath t oo sarab mai t oohai buDh  bibayk jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਤੂ ਸਰਬ  ਮੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਬੁਿਧ ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak chants and meditates forever on the Naam, the Support of the humbledevotees. ||8||1||3|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 AstpdIAw Gru 10 kwPI  (761-6) raag soohee mehlaa 5 asatpadee-aa gh ar 10 kaafee Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees, Tenth House, Kaafee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (761-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam sadaa japee bh agat janaa kee tayk jee-o. ||8||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਜੀਉ  ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: Even though I have made mistakes, and even though I have been wrong, I am still called Yours, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: jay bhulee jay chukee saa-eeN bhee tahinjee kaadh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਕਾਫੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Those who enshrine love for another, die regretting and repenting. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jinHaa nayhu doojaan ay lagaa jh oor marahu say vaadh ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੇ ਚੁਕੀ  ਸਾਈ ਭੀ ਤਿਹੰਜੀ  ਕਾਢੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never leave my Husband Lord's side.
lines.transliteration: ha-o naa chhoda-o kant  paasraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਨੇਹੁ ਦੂਜਾਣੇ  ਲਗਾ  ਝੂਿਰ ਮਰਹੁ ਸੇ ਵਾਢੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Beloved Lover is always and forever beautiful. He is my hope and inspiration.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa rangeelaa laal pi-aaraa ayhu mahinjaa aasraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are my Best Friend; You are my relative. I am so proud of You.
lines.transliteration: sajan t oohai sain  too mai t ujh upar baho maan ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਏਹੁ ਮਿਹੰਜਾ  ਆਸਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: And when You dwell within me, I am at peace. I am without honor - You are myhonor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa too and ar taa sukh ay tooN nimaan ee maan ee-aa. ||2||

lines.english: And when You are pleased with me, O treasure of mercy, then I do not see any other.
lines.transliteration: jay too t uthaa kirpaa niDh aan naa d oojaa vaykh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣੁ  ਤੂਹੈ ਸੈਣੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਉਪਿਰ  ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please grant me this blessing, that that I may forever dwell upon You and cherish Youwithin my heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayhaa paa-ee moo daat -rhee nit  hirdai rakh aa samaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਤੂੰ ਿਨਮਾਣੀ  ਮਾਣੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let my feet walk on Your Path, and let my eyes behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: paav julaa-ee panDh t a-o nain ee daras d ikhaal.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਤੁਠਾ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ  ਵੇਖਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: With my ears, I will listen to Your Sermon, if the Guru becomes merciful to me. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sarvanee sun ee kahaan ee-aa jay gur theevai kirpaal. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹਾ ਪਾਈ  ਮੂ ਦਾਤੜੀ  ਿਨਤ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Hundreds of thousands and millions do not equal even one hair of Yours, O myBeloved.
lines.transliteration: kitee lakh  karorh  piree-ay rom na pujan t ayri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵ ਜੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਤਉ ਨੈਣੀ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਦਖਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: You are the King of kings; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Praises. ||5||
lines.transliteration: too saahee hoo saahu ha-o kahi na sakaa gun  tayri-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ  ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਿਕਰਪਾਿਲ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Your brides are countless; they are all greater than I am.
lines.transliteration: sahee-aa ta-oo asaNkh manj ahu habh  vaDh aanee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਤੀ  ਲਖ ਕਰੋਿੜ ਿਪਰੀਏ  ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਿਨ  ਤੇਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with Your Glance of Grace, even for an instant; please bless me withYour Darshan, that I may revel in Your Love. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hik bhoree nad ar nihaal d eh daras rang maan ee-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹੀ  ਹੂ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਉ ਕਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਿਰਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Seeing Him, my mind is comforted and consoled, and my sins and mistakes are farremoved.
lines.transliteration: jai dithay man Dh eeree-ai kilvikh  vaNnjniH dooray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੀਆ  ਤਊ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੰਞਹੁ ਹਿਭ ਵਧਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: How could I ever forget Him, O my mother? He is permeating and pervadingeverywhere. ||7||
lines.transliteration: so ki-o visrai maa-o mai jo rahi-aa bharpooray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ਦੇਿਹ ਦਰਸੁ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: In humility, I bowed down in surrender to Him, and He naturally met me.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay nimaanee dh eh pa-ee mili-aa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: I have received what was pre-ordained for me, O Nanak, with the help and assistance of the Saints. ||8||1||4|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (761-15) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa paa-i-aa naanak sant  sahaa-ay. ||8||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਮਾਉ ਮੈ ਜੋ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Simritees, the Vedas, the Puraanas and the other holy scriptures proclaim
lines.transliteration: simrit bayd  puraan  pukaaran pothee-aa.
naam binaa sabh koorh  gaalHee hochh ee-aa. ||1|| that without the Naam, everything is false and worthless. ||1||

lines.english: The infinite treasure of the Naam abides within the minds of the devotees.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan apaar bh agtaa man vasai.

lines.english: Birth and death, attachment and suffering, are erased in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam maran moh d ukh saaDh oo sang nasai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who indulge in attachment, conflict and egotism shall surely weep and cry.
lines.transliteration: mohi baad ahaNkaar sarpar runni-aa.

lines.english: Those who are separated from the Naam shall never find any peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sukh na paa-iniH mool naam vichh unni-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Crying out, "Mine! Mine!", he is bound in bondage.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree Dhaar banDh an banDh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Entangled in Maya, he is reincarnated in heaven and hell. ||3||
lines.transliteration: narak surag avtaar maa-i-aa Dh anDhi-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Searching, searching, searching, I have come to understand the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: soDhat  soDh at soDh  tat beechaari-aa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, there is no peace at all, and the mortal will surely fail. ||4|| pMnw 762
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sukh naahi sarpar haari-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Many come and go; they die, and die again, and are reincarnated.
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaahi anayk mar mar janmatay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Without understanding, they are totally useless, and they wander in reincarnation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay sabh  vaad  jonee bh armat ay. ||5||

lines.english: They alone join the Saadh Sangat, unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful.
lines.transliteration: jinH ka-o bha-ay d a-i-aal t inH saaDh oo sang bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਤਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They chant and meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naam t inHee janee jap la-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਨੀ  ਜਨੀ ਜਿਪ ਲਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Uncounted millions, so many they are endless, search for Him.
lines.transliteration: khojeh kot asaNkh bahut  anant  kay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਿਹ  ਕੋਿਟ ਅਸੰਖ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤ  ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: But only that one, who understands his own self, sees God near at hand. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaa-ay aap nayrh aa tis hay. ||7||

lines.english: Never forget me, O Great Giver - please bless me with Your Naam.
lines.transliteration: visar naahee daat aar aapn aa naam d ayh.

lines.english: To sing Your Glorious Praises day and night - O Nanak, this is my heart-felt desire. ||8||2||5||16|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 1 kucjI  (762-5) raag soohee mehlaa 1 kuchjee Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Kuchajee ~ The Ungraceful Bride: <> siqgur pRswid ] (762-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa d in raat  naanak chaa-o ayhu. ||8||2||5||16||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਾਉ  ਏਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I am ungraceful and ill-mannered, full of endless faults. How can I go to enjoy myHusband Lord?
lines.transliteration: manj kuchjee ammaavan  dosrh ay ha-o ki-o saho raavan  jaa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਕੁਚਜੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Each of His soul-brides is better than the rest - who even knows my name?
lines.transliteration: ik doo ik charh andee-aa ka-un  jaanai mayraa naa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਞੁ ਕੁਚਜੀ  ਅੰਮਾਵਿਣ  ਡੋਸੜੇ  ਹਉ ਿਕਉ  ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਣ  ਜਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those brides who enjoy their Husband Lord are very blessed, resting in the shade ofthe mango tree.
lines.transliteration: jinHee sakhee saho raavi-aa say ambee chh aavrh ee-ayhi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਿਕ  ਚੜੰਦੀਆ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I do not have their virtue - who can I blame for this?
lines.transliteration: say gun manj  na aavnee ha-o kai jee d os Dh aray-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਿਵਆ  ਸੇ ਅੰਬੀ  ਛਾਵੜੀਏਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Which of Your Virtues, O Lord, should I speak of? Which of Your Names should Ichant?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gun t ayray vithraa ha-o ki-aa ki-aa gh inaa t ayraa naa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਞੁ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ  ਹਉ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸ ਧਰੇਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot even reach one of Your Virtues. I am forever a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: ikat tol na ambrh aa ha-o sad  kurbaan ai tayrai jaa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਵਥਰਾ  ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਿਘਨਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Gold, silver, pearls and rubies are pleasing.
lines.transliteration: su-inaa rupaa rangulaa motee t ai maan ik jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਤੁ  ਟੋਿਲ  ਨ ਅੰਬੜਾ  ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ  ਤੇਰੈ ਜਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord has blessed me with these things, and I have focused my thoughts on them.
lines.transliteration: say vastoo seh d itee-aa mai t inH si-o laa-i-aa chit  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ  ਮੋਤੀ ਤੈ ਮਾਿਣਕੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Palaces of brick and mud are built and decorated with stones;
lines.transliteration: mandar mitee sand -rhay pathar keet ay raas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਵਸਤੂ  ਸਿਹ ਿਦਤੀਆ  ਮੈ ਿਤਨ ਿਸਉ ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have been fooled by these decorations, and I do not sit near my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o aynee tolee bhulee-as t is kant  na baith ee paas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਰ  ਿਮਟੀ  ਸੰਦੜੇ  ਪਥਰ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The cranes shriek overhead in the sky, and the herons have come to rest.
lines.transliteration: ambar koonjaa kurlee-aa bag bahithay aa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਏਨੀ ਟੋਲੀ ਭੁਲੀਅਸੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The bride has gone to her father-in-law's house; in the world hereafter, what face willshe show?
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan chalee saahurai ki-aa muhu d aysee agai jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਬਿਰ  ਕੂੰਜਾ  ਕੁਰਲੀਆ  ਬਗ ਬਿਹਠੇ  ਆਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: She kept sleeping as the day dawned; she forgot all about her journey.
lines.transliteration: sutee sut ee jhaal thee-aa bh ulee vaatrh ee-aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਚਲੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਿਕਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: She separated herself from her Husband Lord, and now she suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: tai sah naalahu mut ee-as d ukhaa kooN Dharee-aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਝਾਲੁ  ਥੀਆ  ਭੁਲੀ ਵਾਟੜੀਆਸੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Virtue is in You, O Lord; I am totally without virtue. This is Nanak's only prayer:
lines.transliteration: tuDh gun mai sabh  avgan aa ik naanak kee ard aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਮੁਤੀਅਸੁ  ਦੁਖਾ ਕੂੰ ਧਰੀਆਸੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You give all Your nights to the virtuous soul-brides. I know I am unworthy, but isn't there a night for me as well? ||1|| sUhI mhlw 1 sucjI ] (762-14) soohee mehlaa 1 suchjee. Soohee, First Mehl, Suchajee ~ The Noble And Graceful Bride:
lines.transliteration: sabh raat ee sohaagan ee mai dohaagan  kaa-ee raat  jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਸਿਭ ਅਵਗਣਾ  ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: When I have You, then I have everything. O my Lord and Master, You are my wealthand capital.
lines.transliteration: jaa too t aa mai sabh  ko too saahib mayree raas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਮੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਕਾਈ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within You, I abide in peace; within You, I am congratulated.
lines.transliteration: tuDh antar ha-o sukh  vasaa t ooN antar saabaas jee-o.

lines.english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You bestow thrones and greatness. And by the Pleasureof Your Will, You make us beggars and wanderers.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai takhat vadaa-ee-aa bh aanai bheekh udaas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੂ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, the ocean flows in the desert, and the lotus blossoms inthe sky.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai thal sir sar vahai kamal fulai aakaas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਉ ਸੁਿਖ ਵਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; by thePleasure of Your Will, he sinks down into it.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai bhavjal langh ee-ai bh aanai manjh  bharee-aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਤਖਿਤ  ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀਖ ਉਦਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of His Will, that Lord becomes my Husband, and I am imbued with the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai so saho rangulaa sifat  rataa gunt aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਥਲ ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਰੁ ਵਹੈ ਕਮਲੁ  ਫੁਲੈ ਆਕਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, O my Husband Lord, I am afraid of You, and I come andgo, and die.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai saho bh eehaavalaa ha-o aavan  jaan mu-ee-aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਲੰਘੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਿਝ ਭਰੀਆਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You, O my Husband Lord, are inaccessible and immeasurable; talking and speaking ofYou, I have fallen at Your Feet.
lines.transliteration: too saho agam at olvaa ha-o kahi kahi dh eh pa-ee-aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: What should I beg for? What should I say and hear? I am hungry and thirsty for theBlessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa maaga-o ki-aa kahi sunee mai d arsan bh ookh pi-aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਸਹੁ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਹਉ ਆਵਿਣ  ਜਾਿਣ  ਮੁਈਆਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have found my Husband Lord. This is Nanak's true prayer. ||2|| pMnw 763 sUhI mhlw 5 guxvMqI ] (763-1) soohee mehlaa 5 gunvant ee. Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Gunvantee ~ The Worthy And Virtuous Bride:
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee saho paa-i-aa sach naanak kee ard aas jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai gursikh -rhaa tis niv niv laaga-o paa-ay jee-o.

lines.english: I tell to him the pain of my soul, and beg him to unite me with the Guru, my Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: aakhaa birthaa jee-a kee gur sajan  deh milaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਗੁਰਿਸਖੜਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਨਿਵ  ਿਨਿਵ  ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I ask that he impart to me such an understanding, that my mind will not go out wandering anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: so-ee das upd aysrh aa mayraa man anat  na kaahoo jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਾ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਦੇਿਹ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate this mind to you. Please, show me the Path to God.
lines.transliteration: ih man tai kooN dayvsaa mai maarag d ayh bat aa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਦਿਸ ਉਪਦੇਸੜਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have come so far, seeking the Protection of Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: ha-o aa-i-aa Dhoorahu chal kai mai t akee t a-o sarn aa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂੰ ਡੇਵਸਾ  ਮੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Within my mind, I place my hopes in You; please, take my pain and suffering away!
lines.transliteration: mai aasaa rakhee chit  meh mayraa sabh o dukh gavaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਆਇਆ  ਦੂਰਹੁ ਚਿਲ  ਕੈ ਮੈ ਤਕੀ  ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: So walk on this Path, O sister soul-brides; do that work which the Guru tells you to do.
lines.transliteration: it maarag chalay bh aa-ee-arh ay gur kahai so kaar kamaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਆਸਾ  ਰਖੀ ਿਚਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
