lines.english: Abandon the intellectual pursuits of the mind, and forget the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: ti-aagayN man kee mat -rhee visaarayN doojaa bh aa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਲੇ ਭਾਈਅੜੇ  ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: In this way, you shall obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; the hot windsshall not even touch you.
lines.transliteration: i-o paavahi har darsaavarh aa nah lagai t atee vaa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਗੇਂ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤੜੀ  ਿਵਸਾਰੇਂ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: By myself, I do not even know how to speak; I speak all that the Lord commands.
lines.transliteration: ha-o aaphu bol na jaandaa mai kahi-aa sabh  hukmaa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਉ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਾਵੜਾ  ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਤਤੀ  ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am blessed with the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship; Guru Nanak has beenkind and compassionate to me.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  khajaanaa bakh si-aa gur naanak kee-aa pasaa-o jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਆਪਹੁ ਬੋਿਲ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਮੈ ਕਿਹਆ  ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮਾਉ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never again feel hunger or thirst; I am satisfied, satiated and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: mai bahurh na t arisnaa bh ukh-rhee ha-o rajaa t aripat  aghaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਬਖਿਸਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਕੀਆ  ਪਸਾਉ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet. ||3|| rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 1 Gru 1  (763-9) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (763-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jo gur deesai sikh -rhaa tis niv niv laaga-o paa-ay jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖੜੀ ਹਉ ਰਜਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Intoxicated with the wine of youth, I did not realize that I was only a guest at my parents' home (in this world).
lines.transliteration: bhar joban mai mat  pay-ee-arh ai ghar paahun ee bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਿਸਖੜਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਨਿਵ  ਿਨਿਵ  ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My consciousness is polluted with faults and mistakes; without the Guru, virtue doesnot even enter into me.
lines.transliteration: mailee avgan chit  bin gur gun  na samaavanee bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I have not known the value of virtue; I have been deluded by doubt. I have wastedaway my youth in vain.
lines.transliteration: gun saar na jaan ee bh aram bh ulaan ee joban baad  gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਿਰ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਮੈ ਮਤ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਹੁਣੀ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have not known my Husband Lord, His celestial home and gate, or the BlessedVision of His Darshan. I have not had the pleasure of my Husband Lord's celestialpeace.
lines.transliteration: var ghar d ar darsan nahee jaat aa pir kaa sahj na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲੀ ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਨੀ  ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: After consulting the True Guru, I have not walked on the Path; the night of my life is passing away in sleep.
lines.transliteration: satgur poochh  na maarag chaalee soot ee rain  vihaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਣੀ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਿਦ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the prime of my youth, I am a widow; without my Husband Lord, thesoul-bride is wasting away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak baaltan  raadaypaa bin pir Dh an kumlaan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ  ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O father, give me in marriage to the Lord; I am pleased with Him as my Husband. Ibelong to Him.
lines.transliteration: baabaa mai var deh mai har var bh aavai t is kee bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਿਛ ਨ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਾਲੀ  ਸੂਤੀ ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is pervading throughout the four ages, and the Word of His Bani permeates thethree worlds.
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa jug chaar taribh avan banee jis kee bal raam jee-o.

lines.english: The Husband Lord of the three worlds ravishes and enjoys His virtuous brides, but Hekeeps the ungraceful and unvirtuous ones far away.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan kant ravai sohagan  avgan vantee dooray.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: As are our hopes, so are our minds' desires, which the All-pervading Lord brings tofulfillment.
lines.transliteration: jaisee aasaa taisee mansaa poor rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਿਰ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਬਾਣੀ ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The bride of the Lord is forever happy and virtuous; she shall never be a widow, andshe shall never have to wear dirty clothes.
lines.transliteration: har kee naar so sarab suhaagan raaNd na mailai vaysay.

lines.english: O Nanak, I love my True Husband Lord; my Beloved is the same, age after age. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak mai var saachaa bhaavai jug jug pareet am taisay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਸਾ  ਤੈਸੀ ਮਨਸਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, calculate that auspicious moment, when I too shall be going to my in-laws' house.
lines.transliteration: baabaa lagan ganaa-ay haN bhee vanj aa saahurai bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ਸੁ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਰਡ ਨ ਮੈਲੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
lines.english: The moment of that marriage will be set by the Hukam of God's Command; His Willcannot be changed.
lines.transliteration: saahaa hukam rajaa-ay so na talai jo parabh karai bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਭਾਵੈ ਜੁਿਗ ਜੁਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਤੈਸੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The karmic record of past deeds, written by the Creator Lord, cannot be erased byanyone.
lines.transliteration: kirat pa-i-aa kart ai kar paa-i-aa mayt na sakai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ  ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The most respected member of the marriage party, my Husband, is the independentLord of all beings, pervading and permeating the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: jaanjee naa-o narah nihkayval rav rahi-aa t ihu lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹਾ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ  ਸੋ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Maya, crying out in pain, leaves, seeing that the bride and the groom are in love.
lines.transliteration: maa-ay niraasee ro-ay vichhunnee baalee baalai hayt ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਪਇਆ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਕਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the peace of the Mansion of God's Presence comes through the True Word of the Shabad; the bride keeps the Guru's Feet enshrined in her mind. ||3|| pMnw 764
lines.transliteration: naanak saach sabad sukh  mahlee gur charn ee parabh  chayt ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਖ ਮਹਲੀ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਚੇਤੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My father has given me in marriage far away, and I shall not return to my parents' home.
lines.transliteration: baabul dit -rhee door naa aavai gh ar pay-ee-ai bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੁਿਲ  ਿਦਤੜੀ  ਦੂਿਰ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਪੇਈਐ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am delighted to see my Husband Lord near at hand; in His Home, I am so beautiful.
lines.transliteration: rahsee vaykh had oor pir raavee gh ar sohee-ai bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਸੀ  ਵੇਿਖ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਿਪਿਰ  ਰਾਵੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਸੋਹੀਐ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My True Beloved Husband Lord desires me; He has joined me to Himself, and made my intellect pure and sublime.
lines.transliteration: saachay pir lorhee pareet am jorh ee mat  pooree parDh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਿਪਰ ਲੋੜੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਜੋੜੀ ਮਿਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: By good destiny I met Him, and was given a place of rest; through the Guru'sWisdom, I have become virtuous.
lines.transliteration: sanjogee maylaa thaan suhaylaa gunvant ee gur gi-aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਮੇਲਾ  ਥਾਿਨ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: I gather lasting Truth and contentment in my lap, and my Beloved is pleased with mytruthful speech.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh sadaa sach palai sach bolai pir bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I shall not suffer the pain of separation; through the Guru's Teachings, Imerge into the loving embrace of the Lord's Being. ||4||1|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 1 CMqu Gru 2  (764-5) raag soohee mehlaa 1 chhant  ghar 2 Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (764-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak vichhurh  naa d ukh paa-ay gurmat  ank samaa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: My friends have come into my home.
lines.transliteration: ham ghar saajan aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਛੰਤੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord has united me with them.
lines.transliteration: saachai mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord automatically united me with them when it pleased Him; uniting with thechosen ones, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: sahj milaa-ay har man bhaa-ay panch milay sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have obtained that thing, which my mind desired.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee vasat paraapat  ho-ee jis sayt ee man laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with them, night and day, my mind is pleased; my home and mansion are beautified.
lines.transliteration: an-din mayl bh a-i-aa man maani-aa gh ar mand ar sohaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ਿਜਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The unstruck sound current of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibratesand resounds; my friends have come into my home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panch sabad Dh un anhad  vaajay ham gh ar saajan aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: So come, my beloved friends, and sing the songs of joy, O sisters.
lines.transliteration: aavhu meet pi-aaray. mangal gaavhu naaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਅਨਹਦ  ਵਾਜੇ ਹਮ ਘਿਰ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sing the true songs of joy and God will be pleased. You shall be celebrated throughoutthe four ages.
lines.transliteration: sach mangal gaavhu taa parabh  bhaavahu sohilrh aa jug chaaray.

lines.english: My Husband Lord has come into my home, and my place is adorned and decorated.Through the Shabad, my affairs have been resolved.
lines.transliteration: apnai ghar aa-i-aa thaan suhaa-i-aa kaaraj sabad  savaaray.

lines.english: Applying the ointment, the supreme essence, of divine wisdom to my eyes, I see theLord's form throughout the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan mahaa ras naytree anjan t aribhavan roop d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of joy and delight; my friends havecome into my home. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sakhee milhu ras mangal gaavhu ham gh ar saajan aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ਥਾਿਨ  ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar;
lines.transliteration: man tan amrit  bhinnaa.
antar paraym rat annaa. deep within the nucleus of my self, is the jewel of the Lord's Love.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਰਿਸ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਘਿਰ  ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This invaluable jewel is deep within me; I contemplate the supreme essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: antar rat an pad aarath mayrai param t at veechaaro.

lines.english: Living beings are mere beggars; You are the Giver of rewards; You are the Giver to each and every being.
lines.transliteration: jant bh aykh too safli-o d aataa sir sir d ayvan haaro.

lines.english: You are Wise and All-knowing, the Inner-knower; You Yourself created the creation.
lines.transliteration: too jaan gi-aanee ant arjaamee aapay kaaran  keenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਮ  ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: So listen, O my sisters - the Enticer has enticed my mind. My body and mind aredrenched with Nectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sunhu sakhee man mohan mohi-aa t an man amrit  bheenaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖ ਤੂ ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Supreme Soul of the World,
lines.transliteration: aatam raam sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਜਾਨੁ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your play is true.
lines.transliteration: saachaa khayl t umHaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਭੀਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your play is true, O Inaccessible and Infinite Lord; without You, who can make meunderstand?
lines.transliteration: sach khayl t umHaaraa agam apaaraa t uDh bin ka-un  bujhaa-ay.

lines.english: There are millions of Siddhas and enlightened seekers, but without You, who can call himself one?
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik si-aan ay kayt ay tujh bin kavan  kahaa-ay.

lines.english: Death and rebirth drive the mind insane; only the Guru can hold it in its place.
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal bha-ay d ayvaanay man raakh i-aa gur th aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਉਣੁ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who burns away his demerits and faults with the Shabad, accumulatesvirtue, and finds God. ||4||1||2|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 1 Gru 3  (764-17) raag soohee mehlaa 1 ghar 3 Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (764-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak avgan sabad  jalaa-ay gun  sangam parabh  paa-ay. ||4||1||2||

lines.english: Come, my friend, so that I may behold the blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sajnaa ha-o d aykhaa darsan t ayraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਬਕਾਲੁ  ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ  ਮਨੁ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਠਾਏ ॥
lines.english: I stand in my doorway, watching for You; my mind is filled with such a great yearning.
lines.transliteration: ghar aapnarh ai kharhee takaa mai man chaa-o gh anayraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਏ  ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind is filled with such a great yearning; hear me, O God - I place my faith in You.
lines.transliteration: man chaa-o ghanayraa sun  parabh  mayraa mai t ayraa bh arvaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have become free of desire; thepains of birth and death are taken away. pMnw 765
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykh bha-ee nihkayval janam maran  dukh naasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਜਾਤਾ  ਤੂ ਸੋਈ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Your Light is in everyone; through it, You are known. Through love, You are easily met.
lines.transliteration: saglee jot jaat aa too so-ee mili-aa bh aa-ay subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਮਲੇ ਘਿਰ ਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Friend; He has come home to meet with those whoare true. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saajan ka-o bal jaa-ee-ai saach milay ghar aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਅੜੇ  ਸਾਜਨਾ  ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: When her Friend comes to her home, the bride is very pleased.
lines.transliteration: ghar aa-i-arh ay saajnaa t aa Dh an kh aree sarsee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੋਿਹਅੜੀ  ਸਾਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਿਖ ਰਹੰਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: She is fascinated with the True Word of the Lord's Shabad; gazing upon her Lord andMaster, she is filled with joy.
lines.transliteration: har mohi-arhee saach sabad  thaakur d aykh rahansee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹੰਸੀ  ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ  ਜਾ ਰਾਵੀ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੈ ॥
lines.english: She is filled with virtuous joy, and is totally pleased, when she is ravished and enjoyedby her Lord, and imbued with His Love.
lines.transliteration: gun sang rahansee kh aree sarsee jaa raavee rang raat ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ  ਪੂਰੈ ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੈ  ॥
lines.english: Her faults and demerits are eradicated, and she roofs her home with virtue, throughthe Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: avgan maar gun ee gh ar chh aa-i-aa poorai purakh  biDhaatai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਸਕਰ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਵਸੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਿਣ  ਅਦਲੁ  ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Conquering the thieves, she dwells as the mistress of her home, and administersjustice wisely.
lines.transliteration: taskar maar vasee panchaa-in  adal karay veechaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, she is emancipated; through the Guru'sTeachings, she meets her Beloved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam nistaaraa gurmat  mileh pi-aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ  ਬਾਲੜੀਏ  ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਪੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The young bride has found her Husband Lord; her hopes and desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: var paa-i-arhaa baalrh ee-ay aasaa mansaa pooree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਿਰ ਰਾਿਵਅੜੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਲੀ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਨਹ ਦੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: She enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord, and blends into the Word of the Shabad, pervading and permeating everywhere; the Lord is not far away.
lines.transliteration: pir raavi-arhee sabad  ralee rav rahi-aa nah d ooree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸੋਈ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ ਸਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: God is not far away; He is in each and every heart. All are His brides.
lines.transliteration: parabh d oor na ho-ee gh at ghat so-ee t is kee naar sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਰਸੀਆ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਾਵੇ ਿਜਉ  ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Enjoyer, He Himself ravishes and enjoys; this is His gloriousgreatness.
lines.transliteration: aapay rasee-aa aapay raavay ji-o tis d ee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰ  ਅਡੋਲੁ  ਅਮੋਲੁ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: He is imperishable, immovable, invaluable and infinite. The True Lord is obtainedthrough the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: amar adol amol apaaraa gur poorai sach paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਜੋਗ ਸਜੋਗੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself unites in Union; by His Glance of Grace, He lovingly attunesthem to Himself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay jog sajogee nadar karay liv laa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: My Husband Lord dwells in the loftiest balcony; He is the Supreme Lord of the threeworlds.
lines.transliteration: pir uchrhee-ai maarh -rhee-ai t ihu lo-aa sirt aajaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਬਸਮ  ਭਈ ਦੇਿਖ ਗੁਣਾ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਅਗਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am amazed, gazing upon His glorious excellence; the unstruck sound current of theShabad vibrates and resonates.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bisam bha-ee d aykh gunaa anhad  sabad  agaajaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: I contemplate the Shabad, and perform sublime deeds; I am blessed with the insignia, the banner of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sabad veechaaree karn ee saaree raam naam neesaan o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਖੋਟੇ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਹਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the false find no place of rest; only thejewel of the Naam brings acceptance and renown.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa khotay nahee th aahar naam rat an parvaan o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਮਿਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ  ਨਾ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Perfect is my honor, perfect is my intellect and password. I shall not have to come orgo.
lines.transliteration: pat mat  pooree pooraa parvaanaa naa aavai naa jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands her own self; she becomes like her ImperishableLord God. ||4||1||3|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (765-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 1 Gru 4 ] (765-12) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 1 gh ar 4. Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehl, Fourth House:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh aap pachh aanai parabh  jaisay avinaasee. ||4||1||3||

lines.english: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the worldto their tasks.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tin d aykhi-aa jag Dh anDh-rhai laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Your gifts, O Lord, illuminate the heart, and the moon casts its light on the body.
lines.transliteration: daan t ayrai gh at chaann aa tan chand  deepaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The moon glows, by the Lord's gift, and the darkness of suffering is taken away.
lines.transliteration: chando d eepaa-i-aa d aan har kai d ukh anDh ayraa uth  ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਿਨ  ਤੇਰੈ ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਤਿਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The marriage party of virtue looks beautiful with the Groom; He chooses His enticing bride with care.
lines.transliteration: gun janj  laarh ay naal sohai parakh  mohn ee-ai la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦੋ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ  ਦਾਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਉਿਠ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The wedding is performed with glorious splendor; He has arrived, accompanied by thevibrations of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds.
lines.transliteration: veevaahu ho-aa sobh sayt ee panch sabd ee aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਜੰਞ ਲਾੜੇ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਸੋਹੈ ਪਰਿਖ  ਮੋਹਣੀਐ  ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the worldto their tasks. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tin d aykhi-aa jag Dh anDh-rhai laa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵੀਵਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ  ਸੋਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree saajnaa meetaa avreet aa.

lines.english: This body is attached to them, and we have shared our minds.
lines.transliteration: ih tan jin si-o gaadi-aa man lee-arh aa deetaa.

lines.english: We have shared our minds - how could I forget those friends?
lines.transliteration: lee-aa ta d ee-aa maan jinH si-o say sajan ki-o veesrahi.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਗਾਿਡਆ  ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ  ਦੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing them brings joy to my heart; I keep them clasped to my soul.
lines.transliteration: jinH dis aa-i-aa hohi ralee-aa jee-a sayt ee geh raheh.

lines.punjabi: ਲੀਆ  ਤ ਦੀਆ  ਮਾਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਸੇ ਸਜਨ  ਿਕਉ  ਵੀਸਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They have all virtues and merits, forever and ever; they have no demerits or faults atall.
lines.transliteration: sagal gun avgan  na ko-ee hohi neet aa neet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਿਦਿਸ  ਆਇਆ  ਹੋਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ  ਜੀਅ  ਸੇਤੀ ਗਿਹ ਰਹਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree saajnaa meetaa avreet aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣੁ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਿਹ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance.
lines.transliteration: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadh  vaas la-eejai.

lines.english: If my friends have virtues, I will share in them. pMnw 766
lines.transliteration: jay gun hovniH saajnaa mil saajh  kareejai.

lines.english: Let us form a partnership, and share our virtues; let us abandon our faults, and walk on the Path.
lines.transliteration: saajh kareejai gun ah kayree chh od avgan  chalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ਗੁਣਹ  ਕੇਰੀ ਛੋਿਡ ਅਵਗਣ  ਚਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Let us wear our virtues like silk clothes; let us decorate ourselves, and enter thearena.
lines.transliteration: pahiray patambar kar adambar aapnaa pirh  malee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਰੇ  ਪਟੰਬਰ  ਕਿਰ ਅਡੰਬਰ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਪੜੁ ਮਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Let us speak of goodness, wherever we go and sit; let us skim off the AmbrosialNectar, and drink it in.
lines.transliteration: jithai jaa-ay bahee-ai bhalaa kahee-ai jh ol amrit  peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਜਾਇ  ਬਹੀਐ  ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ  ਝੋਿਲ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadh  vaas la-eejai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਾ  ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ  ਕਿਢ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything.
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhee-ai hor karay na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Go ahead and complain to Him, if He makes a mistake.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  taa ka-o jaa-ee-ai jay bh oolrhaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਣ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲੜਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: If He makes a mistake, go ahead and complain to Him; but how can the Creator Himself make a mistake?
lines.transliteration: jay ho-ay bhoolaa jaa-ay kahee-ai aap kart aa ki-o bh ulai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਇ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਭੁਲੈ ॥
lines.english: He sees, He hears, and without our asking, without our begging, He gives His gifts.
lines.transliteration: sunay d aykhay baajh  kahi-ai d aan an mangi-aa d ivai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਣੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਕਿਹਐ  ਦਾਨੁ ਅਣਮੰਿਗਆ  ਿਦਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver, the Architect of the Universe, gives His gifts. O Nanak, He is the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: daan d ay-ay d aataa jag biDh aataa naankaa sach so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜਿਗ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything.||4||1||4|| sUhI mhlw 1 ] (766-6) soohee mehlaa 1. Soohee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhee-ai hor karay na ko-ee. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to mymind.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man raataa gun  ravai man bh aavai so-ee.

lines.english: Truth is the ladder to the Guru; climbing up to the True Lord, peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur kee pa-orhee saach kee saachaa sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Celestial peace comes; the Truth pleases me. How could these True Teachings everbe erased?
lines.transliteration: sukh sahj aavai saach bh aavai saach kee mat  ki-o talai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is Undeceivable; how could He ever be deceived by cleansing baths, charity, spiritual wisdom or ritual bathings?
lines.transliteration: isnaan daan sugi-aan majan aap achh li-o ki-o chh alai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਆਵੈ  ਸਾਚ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਿਕਉ  ਟਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Fraud, attachment and corruption are taken away, as are falsehood, hypocrisy andduality.
lines.transliteration: parpanch moh bikaar thaakay koorh kapat na d o-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਿਗਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਆਿਪ  ਅਛਿਲਓ  ਿਕਉ  ਛਲੈ ॥
lines.english: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to mymind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayraa man raataa gun  ravai man bh aavai so-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਪੰਚ  ਮੋਹ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਥਾਕੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਦੋਈ ॥
lines.english: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation.
lines.transliteration: saahib so salaahee-ai jin kaaran kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Filth sticks to the polluted mind; how rare are those who drink in the AmbrosialNectar.
lines.transliteration: mail laagee man maili-ai kinai amrit pee-aa.

lines.english: Churn this Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in; dedicate this mind to the Guru, and Hewill value it highly.
lines.transliteration: math amrit pee-aa ih man d ee-aa gur peh mol karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਮਿਨ ਮੈਿਲਐ  ਿਕਨੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I intuitively realized my God, when I linked my mind to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapnarhaa parabh  sahj pachh aataa jaa man saachai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਥ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I will sing the Lord's Glorious Praises with Him, if it pleases Him; how could I meetHim by being a stranger to Him?
lines.transliteration: tis naal gun  gaavaa jay t is bhaavaa ki-o milai ho-ay paraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saahib so salaahee-ai jin jagat upaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਿਮਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When He comes, what else remains behind? How can there be any coming or going then?
lines.transliteration: aa-ay ga-i-aa kee na aa-i-o ki-o aavai jaataa.

lines.english: When the mind is reconciled with its Beloved Lord, it is blended with Him.
lines.transliteration: pareetam si-o man maani-aa har sayt ee raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਗਇਆ  ਕੀ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਿਕਉ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: True is the speech of one who is imbued with the Love of his Lord and Master, whofashioned the body fortress from a mere bubble.
lines.transliteration: saahib rang raataa sach kee baat aa jin bimb kaa kot usaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Master of the five elements; He Himself is the Creator Lord. He embellishedthe body with Truth.
lines.transliteration: panch bhoo naa-iko aap sirand aa jin sach kaa pind savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਬੰਬ ਕਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਉਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am worthless; please hear me, O my Beloved! Whatever pleases You is True.
lines.transliteration: ham avgani-aaray t oo sun  pi-aaray t uDh bhaavai sach so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਨਾਇਕੋ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਸਰੰਦਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਚ ਕਾ ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with true understanding, does not come and go. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa naa thee-ai saachee mat  ho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਿਣਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੁਿਣ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Apply such an ointment to your eyes, which is pleasing to your Beloved.
lines.transliteration: anjan taisaa anjee-ai jaisaa pir bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਨਾ ਥੀਐ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਮਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I realize, understand and know Him, only if He Himself causes me to know Him.
lines.transliteration: samjhai soojh ai jaan ee-ai jay aap jaan aavai.

lines.english: He Himself shows me the Way, and He Himself leads me to it, attracting my mind.
lines.transliteration: aap jaanaavai maarag paavai aapay manoo-aa layv-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਮਝੈ  ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜੇ ਆਿਪ  ਜਾਣਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself causes us to do good and bad deeds; who can know the value of the Mysterious Lord?
lines.transliteration: karam sukaram karaa-ay aapay keemat ka-un  abhayva-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਜਾਣਾਵੈ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਮਨੂਆ ਲੇਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: I know nothing of Tantric spells, magical mantras and hypocritical rituals; enshriningthe Lord within my heart, my mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: tant mant  pakh and na jaan aa raam rid ai man maani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਸੁਕਰਮ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਉਣ  ਅਭੇਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The ointment of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is only understood by one whorealizes the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: anjan naam tisai t ay soojh ai gur sabd ee sach jaani-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have my own friends; why should I go to the home of a stranger?
lines.transliteration: saajan hovan aapnay ki-o par gh ar jaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਤੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: My friends are imbued with the True Lord; He is with them, in their minds. mn mwih swjn krih rlIAw krm Drm sbwieAw ] ATsiT qIrQ puMn pUjw nwmu swcw BwieAw ] (766-19, sUhI, mÚ 1) man maahi saajan karahi ralee-aa karam Dharam sabaa-i-aa. ath sath tirath punn poojaa naam saachaa bhaa-i-aa. In their minds, these friends celebrate in happiness; all good karma, righteousnessand Dharma, the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, charity and worship, are foundin the love of the True Name. pMnw 767
lines.transliteration: saajan raatay sach kay sangay man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਪੁੰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself creates, establishes and beholds all, by the Pleasure of His Will.
lines.transliteration: aap saajay thaap vaykhai t isai bh aanaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਸਾਜੇ ਥਾਿਪ  ਵੇਖੈ ਿਤਸੈ ਭਾਣਾ  ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My friends are happy in the Love of the Lord; they nurture love for their Beloved. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saajan raaNg rangeelrhay rang laal ban aa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਿਗ  ਰੰਗੀਲੜੇ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਬਣਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: If a blind man is made the leader, how will he know the way?
lines.transliteration: anDhaa aagoo jay thee-ai ki-o paaDh ar jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਾ  ਆਗੂ  ਜੇ ਥੀਐ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is impaired, and his understanding is inadequate; how will he know the way?
lines.transliteration: aap musai mat hochh ee-ai ki-o raahu pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਮੁਸੈ ਮਿਤ ਹੋਛੀਐ  ਿਕਉ  ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: How can he follow the path and reach the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? Blind is the understanding of the blind.
lines.transliteration: ki-o raahi jaavai mahal paavai anDh kee mat  anDh lee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਰਾਿਹ  ਜਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਧ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਅੰਧਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, they cannot see anything; the blind are drowned in worldlyentanglements.
lines.transliteration: vin naam har kay kachh  na soojh ai anDh  boodou Dh anDhlee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੂਡੌ ਧੰਧਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, the Divine Light shines forth and joy wells up, when the Word of theGuru's Shabad abides in the mind.
lines.transliteration: din raat  chaanan  chaa-o upjai sabad  gur kaa man vasai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਚਾਉ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: With your palms pressed together, pray to the Guru to show you the way. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kar jorh gur peh kar binant ee raahu paaDh ar gur d asai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਕਿਰ ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਰਾਹੁ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: If the man becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him.
lines.transliteration: man pardaysee jay thee-ai sabh  days paraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਜੇ ਥੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Unto whom should I tie up and give the bundle of my pains?
lines.transliteration: kis peh kholHa-o ganth -rhee dookhee bh ar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਖੋਲਉ ਗੰਠੜੀ  ਦੂਖੀ ਭਿਰ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The whole world is overflowing with pain and suffering; who can know the state of my inner self?
lines.transliteration: dookh ee bh ar aa-i-aa jagat  sabaa-i-aa ka-un  jaanai biDh  mayree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੀ ਭਿਰ ਆਇਆ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਮੇਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Comings and goings are terrible and dreadful; there is no end to the rounds ofreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aavnay jaavn ay kh aray daraavan ay tot na aavai fayree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੇ ਜਾਵਣੇ  ਖਰੇ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਫੇਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, he is vacant and sad; he does not listen to the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: naam vihoonay oon ay jhoonay naa gur sabad  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਣੇ ਊਣੇ ਝੂਣੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If the mind becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him.||7||
lines.transliteration: man pardaysee jay thee-ai sabh  days paraa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਜੇ ਥੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in theAll-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur mahlee ghar aapn ai so bh arpur leen aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਸੋ ਭਰਪੁਿਰ  ਲੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The sevadar performs selfless service when he is pleased, and confirmed in the TrueWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayvaa taaN karay sach sabad  pateenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੇਵਾ ਤ ਕਰੇ ਸਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਤੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Confirmed in the Shabad, with her being softened by devotion, the bride dwells in theMansion of the Lord's Presence, deep within her being.
lines.transliteration: sabday pat eejai ank bh eejai so mahal mehlaa ant ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਪਤੀਜੈ  ਅੰਕੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ਅੰਤਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself creates; God Himself, in the end, is endless.
lines.transliteration: aap kartaa karay so-ee parabh  aap ant  nirant ray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਿਨਰੰਤਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is united, and then embellished; the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad maylaa t aaN suhaylaa baajant  anhad  been aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੇਲਾ  ਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਬਾਜੰਤ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਬੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in theAll-pervading Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur mahlee ghar aapn ai so bh aripur leen aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਿਰਪੁਿਰ  ਲੀਣਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Why praise that which is created? Praise instead the One who created it and watchesover it.
lines.transliteration: keetaa ki-aa salaahee-ai kar vaykh ai so-ee.

lines.english: His value cannot be estimated, no matter how much one may wish.
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  na pavai jay lochai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He alone can estimate the Lord's value, whom the Lord Himself causes to know. He isnot mistaken; He does not make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: keemat so paavai aap jaan aavai aap abh ul na bh ul-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਿਪ  ਜਾਣਾਵੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਭੁਲੁ  ਨ ਭੁਲਏ  ॥
lines.english: He alone celebrates victory, who is pleasing to You, through the Invaluable Word ofthe Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar karahi tuDh  bhaaveh gur kai sabad  amula-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਅਮੁਲਏ  ॥
lines.english: I am lowly and abject - I offer my prayer; may I never forsake the True Name, OSibling of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: heena-o neech kara-o baynant ee saach na chh oda-o bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਣਉ  ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One who created the creation, watches over it; He alone bestows understanding. ||9||2||5|| rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 3 Gru 2  (767-15) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 3 gh ar 2 Raag Soohee, Chhant, Third Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (767-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin kar daykh i-aa d ayvai mat  saa-ee. ||9||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਦੇਵੈ ਮਿਤ ਸਾਈ  ॥੯॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: sukh sohilrh aa har Dh i-aavahu.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, obtain the Lord's fruitful rewards.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har fal paavhu.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, obtain the fruit of the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name; the painsof countless lifetimes shall be erased.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh fal paavhu har naam Dh i-aavahu janam janam kay d ookh nivaaray.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has arranged and resolved all my affairs.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur apnay vitahu jin kaaraj sabh  savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God will bestow His Grace, if you meditate on the Lord; O humble servant ofthe Lord, you shall obtain the fruit of peace.
lines.transliteration: har parabh kirpaa karay har jaapahu sukh  fal har jan paavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁ ਰ ਅਪਣੇ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਿਭ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen O humble Sibling of Destiny: meditate on the Lord, and find peaceand pleasure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sunhu jan bh aa-ee sukh  sohilrh aa har Dh i-aavahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love.
lines.transliteration: sun har gun  bheenay sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਖ ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, I meditate intuitively on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmat sehjay naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meet the Guru, and their fears of birth and death leave them. pMnw 768
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o Dhur likh i-aa tin gur mili-aa t in janam maran  bha-o bh aagaa.

lines.english: One who eliminates evil-mindedness and duality from within himself, that humble being lovingly focuses his mind on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: andrahu d urmat  doojee kh o-ee so jan har liv laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਖੋਈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those, upon whom my Lord and Master bestows His Grace, sing the Glorious Praisesof the Lord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o kirpaa keenee mayrai su-aamee tin an-d in har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਮੇਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sun man bh eenay sahj subh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jug meh raam naam nistaaraa.

lines.english: Contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad emanates from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur tay upjai sabad  veechaaraa.

lines.english: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, one comes to love the Lord's Name; he alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad veechaaraa raam naam pi-aaraa jis kirpaa karay so paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: In peace and poise, he sings the Lord's Praises day and night, and all sins areeradicated.
lines.transliteration: sehjay gun gaavai d in raat ee kilvikh  sabh  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਸਿਭ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: All are Yours, and You belong to all. I am Yours, and You are mine.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t ayraa t oo sabh naa kaa ha-o t ayraa t oo hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jug meh raam naam nistaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart;
lines.transliteration: saajan aa-ay vuthay gh ar maahee.
har gun gaavahi t aripat  aghaahee. singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied and fulfilled.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied forever, never to feel hungeragain.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay sad aa tariptaasee fir bh ookh na laagai aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਸਦਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: That humble servant of the Lord, who meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, isworshipped in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: dah d is pooj hovai har jan kee jo har har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਪੂਜ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself joins and separates; there is no other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak har aapay jorh vichh orhay har bin ko d oojaa naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਜੋਿੜ ਿਵਛੋੜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart. ||4||1|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (768-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu sUhI mhlw 3 Gru 3 ] (768-9) raag soohee mehlaa 3 ghar 3. Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Third House:
lines.transliteration: saajan aa-ay vuthay gh ar maahee. ||4||1||

lines.english: The Dear Lord protects His humble devotees; throughout the ages, He has protected them.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kee har jee-o raakh ai jug jug rakh -daa aa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: Those devotees who become Gurmukh burn away their ego, through the Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: so bhagat  jo gurmukh  hovai ha-umai sabad  jalaa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: Those who burn away their ego through the Shabad, become pleasing to my Lord;their speech becomes True.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai sabad jalaa-i-aa mayray har bh aa-i-aa jis d ee saachee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਰਾਖੈ ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਰਖਦਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They perform the Lord's true devotional service, day and night, as the Guru hasinstructed them.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat  karahi d in raat ee gurmukh  aakh  vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The devotees' lifestyle is true, and absolutely pure; the True Name is pleasing to theirminds.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kee chaal sachee at  nirmal naam sachaa man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ਿਜਸ ਦੀ ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the those devotees, who practice Truth, and only Truth, look beauteous in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  soheh d ar saachai jinee sacho sach kamaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the social class and honor of His devotees; the Lord's devotees merge inthe Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa kee jaat  pat hai bh agat har kai naam samaan ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਚਾਲ  ਸਚੀ ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They worship the Lord in devotion, and eradicate self-conceit from within themselves;they understand merits and demerits.
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  karahi vichahu aap gavaaveh jin gun  avgan  pachh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They understand merits and demerits, and chant the Lord's Name; devotional worshipis sweet to them.
lines.transliteration: gun a-ugan  pachh aanai har naam vakh aanai bhai bhagat meeth ee laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਜਾਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਹੈ ਭਗਤ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night, and in the home ofthe self, they remain detached.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahi d in raat ee gh ar hee meh bairaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਵਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ  ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with devotion, their minds remain forever immaculate and pure; they seetheir Dear Lord always with them.
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee raat ay sad aa man nirmal har jee-o vaykh eh sad aa naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਭੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those devotees are True in the Court of the Lord; night and day, they dwellupon the Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak say bhagat  har kai d ar saachay an-d in naam samHaalay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs practice devotional rituals without the True Guru, butwithout the True Guru, there is no devotion.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh agat karahi bin sat gur vin  satgur bh agat na ho-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਵੇਖਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They are afflicted with the diseases of egotism and Maya, and they suffer the pains of death and rebirth.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa rog vi-aapay mar janmeh dukh  ho-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The world suffers the pains of death and rebirth, and through the love of duality, it is ruined; without the Guru, the essence of reality is not known.
lines.transliteration: mar janmeh dukh  ho-ee d oojai bh aa-ay paraj vigo-ee vin  gur t at na jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship, everyone in the world is deluded and confused, and in the end, they depart with regrets. pMnw 769
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vihoon aa sabh  jag bh armi-aa ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaani-aa.

lines.english: Among millions, there is scarcely one who realizes the Name of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay kinai pachh aani-aa har naamaa sach so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਿਕਨੈ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; in the love of duality, all honor is lost. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee doojai bh aa-ay pat  kho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the home of the devotees, is the joy of true marriage; they chant the GloriousPraises of the Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kai gh ar kaaraj saachaa har gun  sadaa vakh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He Himself blesses them with the treasure of devotion; conquering the thorny pain ofdeath, they merge in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  khajaanaa aapay d ee-aa kaal kantak maar samaan ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੀਆ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Conquering the thorny pain of death, they merge in the Lord; they are pleasing to the Lord's Mind, and they obtain the true treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: kaal kantak maar samaanay har man bh aanay naam niDh aan sach paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This treasure is inexhaustible; it will ne ver be exhausted. The Lord automatically blesses them with it.
lines.transliteration: sadaa akh ut kad ay na nikh utai har d ee-aa sahj subh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਨਖੁਟੈ  ਹਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted and elevated, forever on high; they areadorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har jan oochay sad hee oochay gur kai sabad  suhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਊਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself forgives them, and merges them with Himself; throughout theages, they are glorified. ||4||1||2|| sUhI mhlw 3 ] (769-6) soohee mehlaa 3. Soohee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay bakhas milaa-ay jug jug sobh aa paa-i-aa. ||4||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, true happiness prevails, there where the TrueLord is contemplated.
lines.transliteration: sabad sachai sach sohilaa jithai sachay kaa ho-ay veechaaro raam.

lines.english: Egotism and all sins are eradicated, when one keeps the True Lord enshrined in theheart.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai sabh kilvikh  kaatay saach rakh i-aa ur Dh aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਿਜਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One who keeps the True Lord enshrined in the heart, crosses over the terrible anddreadful world-ocean; he shall not have to cross over it again.
lines.transliteration: sach rakhi-aa ur Dh aaray d utar taaray fir bh avjal t aran na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਕਾਟੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; through it, the True Lord is seen.
lines.transliteration: sachaa satgur sachee ban ee jin sach vikh aali-aa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਿਫਿਰ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਰਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord merges in Truth; he beholds theTrue Lord everywhere.
lines.transliteration: saachay gun gaavai sach samaavai sach vaykh ai sabh  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਚੁ ਿਵਖਾਿਲਆ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; through Truth, comesemancipation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa saahib saachee naa-ee sach nistaaraa ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru reveals the True Lord; the True Lord preserves our honor.
lines.transliteration: saachai satgur saach bujh aa-i-aa pat  raakh ai sach so-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਨਾਈ  ਸਚੁ ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The true food is love for the True Lord; through the True Name, peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sachaa bhojan bh aa-o sachaa hai sachai naam sukh  ho-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through the True Name, the mortal finds peace; he shall never die, and never againenter the womb of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: saachai naam sukh ho-ee marai na ko-ee garabh  na joonee vaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: His light blends with the Light, and he merges into the True Lord; he is illuminatedand enlightened with the True Name.
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milaa-ee sach samaa-ee sach naa-ay pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗਰਿਭ  ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who know the Truth are True; night and day, they meditate on Truth.
lines.transliteration: jinee sach jaataa say sachay ho-ay an-d in sach Dh i-aa-in.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਇ  ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those whose hearts are filled with the True Name, never suffer the pains of separation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak sach naam jin hirdai vasi-aa naa veechh urh dukh paa-in. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਏ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: In that home, and in that heart, where the True Bani of the Lord's True Praises aresung, the songs of joy resound.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sachay gun  gaavahi t it ghar sohilaa ho-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁਿੜ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the immaculate virtues of the True Lord, the body and mind are renderedTrue, and God, the True Primal Being, dwells within.
lines.transliteration: nirmal gun saachay t an man saachaa vich saachaa purakh  parabh  so-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Such a person practices only Truth, and speaks only Truth; whatever the True Lorddoes, that alone comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: sabh sach vart ai sacho bolai jo sach karai so ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see the True Lord pervading; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah sach pasri-aa avar na d oojaa ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਚੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: From the True Lord, we emanate, and into the True Lord, we shall merge; death andbirth come from duality.
lines.transliteration: sachay upjai sach samaavai mar janmai doojaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself does everything; He Himself is the Cause. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh  aapay kart aa aap karaavai so-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਉਪਜੈ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The true devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar of the Lord's Court. They speak Truth,and only Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachay bhagat  soheh d arvaaray sacho sach vakh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਵੈ  ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Deep within the nucleus of their heart, is the True Word of the Lord's Bani. Through the Truth, they understand themselves.
lines.transliteration: ghat ant ray saachee ban ee saacho aap pachh aanay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਦਰਵਾਰੇ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They understand themselves, and so know the True Lord, through their true intuition.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan eh taa sach jaan eh saachay sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰੇ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੋ ਆਿਪ  ਪਛਾਣੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: True is the Shabad, and True is its Glory; peace comes only from Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai sobh aa saachay hee sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with Truth, the devotees love the One Lord; they do not love any other.
lines.transliteration: saach ratay bh agat ik rangee d oojaa rang na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone obtains the True Lord, who has such pre-ordained destiny writtenupon his forehead. ||4||2||3|| sUhI mhlw 3 ] (769-19) soohee mehlaa 3. Soohee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis ka-o mastak likh i-aa tis sach paraapat  ho-ee. ||4||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਤੇ ਭਗਤ  ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਦੂਜਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride may wander throughout the four ages, but still, without the True Guru, she will not find her True Husband Lord. pMnw 770
lines.transliteration: jug chaaray Dhan jay bh avai bin sat gur sohaag na ho-ee raam.

lines.english: The Kingdom of the Lord is permanent, and forever unchanging; there is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: nihchal raaj sadaa har kayraa t is bin avar na ko-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਰਾਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: There is no other than Him - He is True forever; the Gurmukh knows the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis bin avar na ko-ee sad aa sach so-ee gurmukh  ayko jaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan pir maylaavaa ho-aa gurmat ee man maani-aa. That soul-bride, whose mind accepts the Guru's Teachings, meets her Husband Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਿਪਰ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, she finds the Lord; without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-aa t aa har paa-i-aa bin har naavai mukat  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; her mind accepts Him,and she finds peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman kant ai raavay man maanee-ai sukh  ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਕੰਤੈ ਰਾਵੇ ਮਿਨ ਮਾਿਨਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serve the True Guru, O young and innocent bride; thus you shall obtain the Lord asyour Husband.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv Dh an baalrh ee-ay har var paavahi so-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: You shall be the virtuous and happy bride of the True Lord forever; and you shallnever again wear soiled clothes.
lines.transliteration: sadaa hoveh sohaagan ee fir mailaa vays na ho-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਮੈਲਾ  ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Your clothes shall never again be soiled; how rare are those few, who, as Gurmukh,recognize this, and conquer their ego.
lines.transliteration: fir mailaa vays na ho-ee gurmukh boojh ai ko-ee ha-umai maar pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ  ਮੈਲਾ  ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: So make your practice the practice of good deeds; merge into the Word of theShabad, and deep within, come to know the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: karnee kaar kamaavai sabad  samaavai ant ar ayko jaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh enjoys God, day and night, and so obtains true glory.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parabh  raavay d in raat ee aapn aa saachee sobh aa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Beloved; God is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman pir raavay aapn aa rav rahi-aa parabh  so-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਮਿਣ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serve the Guru, O young and innocent soul-bride, and he will lead to you meet yourHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kee kaar karay Dhan baalrh ee-ay har var d ay-ay milaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਿਮਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The bride is imbued with the Love of her Lord; meeting with her Beloved, she findspeace.
lines.transliteration: har kai rang ratee hai kaaman  mil pareet am sukh  paa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meeting her Beloved, she finds peace, and merges in the True Lord; the True Lord ispervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam sukh  paa-ay sach samaa-ay sach vart ai sabh  thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The bride makes Truth her decorations, day and night, and remains absorbed in theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachaa seegaar karay din raat ee kaaman  sach samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is realized through His Shabad; He hugs His bride closein His embrace.
lines.transliteration: har sukh-d aata sabad  pachh aataa kaaman  la-i-aa kanth  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਬਿਦ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਲਇਆ  ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the bride obtains the Mansion of His Presence; through the Guru'sTeachings, she finds her Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak mahlee mahal pachhaan ai gurmat ee har paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਹਲੀ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਗੁ ਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord, my God, has united His young and innocent bride with Himself.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan baalee Dh ur maylee mayrai parabh  aap milaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਧੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੀ  ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, her heart is illumined and enlightened; God is permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee gh at chaanan  ho-aa parabh  rav rahi-aa sabh  thaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God is permeating and pervading everywhere; He dwells in her mind, and she realizesher pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: parabh rav rahi-aa sabh  thaa-ee man vasaa-ee poorab likh i-aa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: On his cozy bed, she is pleasing to my God; she fashions her decorations of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sayj sukhaalee mayray parabh  bhaanee sach seegaar ban aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The bride is immaculate and pure; she washes away the filth of egotism, and throughthe Guru's Teachings, she merges in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaaman nirmal ha-umai mal kh o-ee gurmat  sach samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends her into Himself, and she obtains the nine treasureof the Naam. ||4||3||4|| sUhI mhlw 3 ] (770-14) soohee mehlaa 3. Soohee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap milaa-ee kartai naam navai niDh  paa-ee. ||4||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਈ ਕਰਤੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; the Gurmukh obtains the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har haray har gun gaavhu har gurmukh ay paa-ay raam.

lines.english: Night and day, chant the Word of the Shabad; night and day, the Shabad shall vibrateand resound.
lines.transliteration: andino sabad  ravhu anhad  sabad  vajaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates, and the Dear Lord comes into the home of my heart; O ladies, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  vajaa-ay har jee-o gh ar aa-ay har gun  gaavhu naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੋ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਵਹੁ ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: That soul-bride, who performs devotional worship service to the Guru night and day,becomes the Beloved bride of her Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahi gur aagai saa Dh an kant  pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings, whose hearts are filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, areadorned with the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasi-aa gh at ant ar say jan sabad  suhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਗੁ ਰ ਆਗੈ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, their hearts are forever filled with happiness; the Lord, in His Mercy, entersinto their hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin gh ar sad  hee sohilaa har kar kirpaa gh ar aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The minds of the devotees are filled with bliss; they remain lovingly absorbed in theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa man aanand  bha-i-aa har naam rahay liv laa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਘਿਰ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh is immaculate and pure; she sings the Immaculate Praisesof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhay man nirmal ho-aa nirmal har gun  gaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Singing His Immaculate Praises, she enshrines in her mind the Naam, the Name of theLord, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: nirmal gun gaa-ay naam man vasaa-ay har kee amrit  banee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings, within whose minds it abides, are emancipated; the Shabad permeates each and every heart. pMnw 771
lines.transliteration: jinH man vasi-aa say-ee jan nistaray gh at ghat sabad  samaan ee.

lines.english: Singing Your Glorious Praises, they merge naturally into You, O Lord; through the Shabad, they are united in Union with You.
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  gaavahi sahj samaaveh sabd ay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, their lives are fruitful; the True Guru places them on the Lord's Path. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak safal janam tin kayraa je sat gur har maarag paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇਰਾ ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who join the Society of the Saints are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: santsangat  si-o mayl bh a-i-aa har har naam samaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਸਉ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are forever 'jivan mukta' - liberatedwhile yet alive; they are lovingly absorbed in the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad  jeevan mukat  bha-ay har kai naam liv laa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਤ  ਭਏ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They center their consciousness on the Lord's Name; through the Guru, they areunited in His Union. Their minds are imbued with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: har naam chit laa-ay gur mayl milaa-ay manoo-aa rat aa har naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਮਨੂਆ ਰਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They find the Lord, the Giver of peace, and they eradicate attachments; night andday, they contemplate the Naam.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata paa-i-aa moh chukaa-i-aa an-d in naam samHaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and intoxicated with celestialpeace; the Naam abides in their minds.
lines.transliteration: gur sabday raat aa sehjay maat aa naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the homes of their hearts are filled with happiness, forever and always; theyare absorbed in serving the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin gh ar sad  hee sohilaa je sat gur sayv samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਘਿਰ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the world is deluded by doubt; it does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur jag bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa har kaa mahal na paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਜਗੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, some are united in the Lord's Union, and their pains are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhay ik mayl milaa-i-aa t in kay d ookh gavaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਇਿਕ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Their pains are dispelled, when it is pleasing to the Lord's Mind; imbued with His Love,they sing His Praises forever.
lines.transliteration: tin kay d ookh gavaa-i-aa jaa har man bh aa-i-aa sad aa gaavahi rang raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's devotees are pure and humble forever; throughout the ages, they areforever respected.
lines.transliteration: har kay bhagat  sadaa jan nirmal jug jug sad  hee jaat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: They perform true devotional worship service, and are honored in the Lord's Court;the True Lord is their hearth and home.
lines.transliteration: saachee bhagat  karahi d ar jaapeh gh ar dar sachaa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਦਿਰ ਜਾਪਿਹ  ਘਿਰ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, true are their songs of joy, and true is their word; through the Word of theShabad, they find peace. ||4||4||5|| sUhI mhlw 3 ] (771-10) soohee mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sohilaa sachee sach banee sabd ay hee sukh  ho-ee. ||4||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: If you long for your Husband Lord, O young and innocent bride, then focus yourconsciousness on the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: jay lorheh var baalrh ee-ay t aa gur charn ee chit  laa-ay raam.

lines.english: You shall be a happy soul bride of your Dear Lord forever; He does not die or leave.
lines.transliteration: sadaa hoveh sohaagan ee har jee-o marai na jaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਵਰੁ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ  ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord does not die, and He does not leave; through the peaceful poise of the Guru, the soul bride becomes the lover of her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o marai na jaa-ay gur kai sahj subhaa-ay saa Dh an kant  pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through truth and self-control, she is forever immaculate and pure; she is embellishedwith the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam sadaa hai nirmal gur kai sabad  seegaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My God is True, forever and ever; He Himself created Himself.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa sad  hee saachaa jin aapay aap upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਸੰਜਿਮ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she who focuses her consciousness on the Guru's feet, enjoys her HusbandLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa pir raavay aapn aa jin gur charn ee chit  laa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the young, innocent bride finds her Husband Lord, she is automaticallyintoxicated with Him, night and day.
lines.transliteration: pir paa-i-arhaa baalrh ee-ay an-d in sehjay maat ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes blissful, and her bodyis not tinged with filth at all.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee man anad  bha-i-aa t it tan mail na raat ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ  ਬਾਲੜੀਏ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Her body is not tinged with filth at all, and she is imbued with her Lord God; my Godunites her in Union.
lines.transliteration: tit tan mail na raat ee har parabh  raatee mayraa parabh  mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਿਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, she enjoys her Lord God; her egotism is banished from within.
lines.transliteration: an-din raavay har parabh  apnaa vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, she easily finds and meets Him. She is imbued with her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: gurmat paa-i-aa sahj milaa-i-aa apn ay pareet am raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, she obtains glorious greatness.She ravishes and enjoys her God; she is imbued with His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee parabh raavay rang raat ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਅਪਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Ravishing her Husband Lord, she is imbued with His Love; she obtains the Mansion ofHis Presence.
lines.transliteration: pir raavay rang raat-rh ee-ay pir kaa mahal t in paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: She is utterly immaculate and pure; the Great Giver banishes self-conceit from withinher.
lines.transliteration: so saho at nirmal d aataa jin vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੜੀਏ  ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਤਨ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord drives out attachment from within her, when it pleases Him. The soul bridebecomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind.
lines.transliteration: vichahu moh chukaa-i-aa jaa har bhaa-i-aa har kaaman  man bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਹੋ ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਿਜਿਨ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, she continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; she speaksthe Unspoken Speech.
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavai nit  saachay kathay akath kahaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Throughout the four ages, the One True Lord is permeating and pervading; without the Guru, no one finds Him. pMnw 772
lines.transliteration: jug chaaray saachaa ayko vartai bin gur kinai na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, she revels in joy, imbued with His Love; she focuses her consciousness on the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak rang ravai rang raatee jin har sayt ee chit  laa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਵੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The mind of the soul bride is very happy, when she meets her Friend, her BelovedLord.
lines.transliteration: kaaman man sohilrh aa saajan milay pi-aaray raam.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes immaculate; she enshrines the Lordwithin her heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee man nirmal ho-aa har raakh i-aa ur Dh aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Keeping the Lord enshrined within her heart, her affairs are arranged and resolved;through the Guru's Teachings, she knows her Lord.
lines.transliteration: har raakhi-aa ur Dh aaray apnaa kaaraj savaaray gurmat ee har jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: My Beloved has enticed my mind; I have obtained the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: pareetam mohi la-i-aa man mayraa paa-i-aa karam biDh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਿਮ  ਮੋਿਹ ਲਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਰਮ ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, she finds lasting peace; the Lord, the Destroyer of pride,dwells in her mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa har vasi-aa man muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮੰਿਨ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she merges with her Guru, embellished and adorned with the Word of theGuru's Shabad. ||4||5||6|| sUhI mhlw 3 ] (772-5) soohee mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl la-ee gur apunai gur kai sabad savaaray. ||4||5||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਈ ਗੁਿਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; contemplate it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sohilrhaa har raam naam gur sabd ee veechaaray raam.

lines.english: The mind and body of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord, the Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: har man tano gurmukh  bheejai raam naam pi-aaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through the Name of the Beloved Lord, all one's ancestors and generations areredeemed; chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.
lines.transliteration: raam naam pi-aaray sabh kul uDh aaray raam naam mukh  banee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Comings and goings cease, peace is obtained, and in the home of the heart, one'sawareness is absorbed in the unstruck melody of the sound current.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay sukh  paa-i-aa gh ar anhad  surat  samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਿਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the One and only Lord, Har, Har. The Lord God has showered His Mercyupon Nanak.
lines.transliteration: har har ayko paa-i-aa har parabh naanak kirpaa Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣ  ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, contemplate it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sohilrhaa har raam naam gur sabd ee veechaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him?
lines.transliteration: ham neevee parabh at  oochaa ki-o kar mili-aa jaa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has very mercifully blessed me and united me with the Lord; through theShabad, the Word of the Lord, I am lovingly embellished.
lines.transliteration: gur maylee baho kirpaa Dhaaree har kai sabad  subh aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਤ  ਊਚਾ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly embellished; my ego is eradicated, and I revel in joyous love.
lines.transliteration: mil sabad subh aa-ay aap gavaa-ay rang si-o ralee-aa maan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੀ  ਬਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My bed is so comfortable, since I became pleasing to God; I am absorbed in the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sayj sukhaalee jaa parabh  bhaa-i-aa har har naam samaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੁ ਸਬਿਦ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਰਲੀਆ  ਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul bride is so very blessed, who walks in harmony with the TrueGuru's Will.
lines.transliteration: naanak sohagan saa vadbh aagee jay chalai sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him? ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham neevee parabh at  oochaa ki-o kar mili-aa jaa-ay raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh atay sabh naa vich ayko ayko raam bh ataaro raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਤ  ਊਚਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: God dwells far away from some, while for others, He is the Support of the mind.
lines.transliteration: iknaa parabh d oor vasai iknaa man aaDh aaro raam.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: For some, the Creator Lord is the Support of the mind; He is obtained by great goodfortune, through the Guru.
lines.transliteration: iknaa man aaDhaaro sirjan haaro vadbh aagee gur paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਇਕਨਾ  ਮਿਨ ਆਧਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
