lines.english: The One Lord God, the Master, is in each and every heart; the Gurmukh sees theunseen.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at har parabh  ayko su-aamee gurmukh  alakh  lakhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਮਨ ਆਧਾਰੋ  ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mind is satisfied, in natural ecstasy, O Nanak, contemplating God.
lines.transliteration: sehjay anad ho-aa man maani-aa naanak barahm beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh atay sabh naa vich ayko ayko raam bh ataaro raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਅਨਦੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvan satgur d aataa har har naam samaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, please bless me with the dust of the feet of the Perfect Guru, so that I, asinner, may be liberated.
lines.transliteration: har Dhoorh  dayvhu mai pooray gur kee ham paapee mukat  karaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Even sinners are liberated, by eradicating their egotism; they obtain a home withintheir own heart.
lines.transliteration: paapee mukat karaa-ay aap gavaa-ay nij gh ar paa-i-aa vaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧੂਿੜ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਕਰਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: With clear unerstanding, the night of their lives passes peacefully; through the Guru'sTeachings, the Naam is revealed to them.
lines.transliteration: bibayk buDhee sukh  rain vihaan ee gurmat  naam pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੀ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Lord, Har, Har, I am in ecstasy, day and night. O Nanak, the Lord seemssweet.
lines.transliteration: har har anad bh a-i-aa d in raat ee naanak har meeth  lagaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਿਖ ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ਗੁ ਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord,Har, Har. ||4||6||7||5||7||12|| pMnw 773 rwgu sUhI mhlw 4 CMq Gru 1  (773-1) raag soohee mehlaa 4 chhant  ghar 1 Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (773-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur sayvan satgur d aataa har har naam samaa-ay. ||4||6||7||5||7||12||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: If only I could meet the True Guru, the Primal Being. Discarding my faults and sins, I would chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  milaa-ay avgan  viknaa gun  ravaa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਿਵਕਣਾ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Continuously, continually, Ichant the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ay gurbaan ee nit  nit chavaa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਚਵਾ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Gurbani always seems so sweet; I have eradicated the sins from within.
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee sad  meeth ee laagee paap vikaar gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਸਦ ਮੀਠੀ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਪਾਪ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The disease of egotism is gone, fear has left, and I am absorbed in celestial peace.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog ga-i-aa bha-o bh aagaa sehjay sahj milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the bed of my body has become cozy andbeautiful, and I enjoy the essence of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa sayj gur sabad sukh aalee gi-aan t at kar bh ogo.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਸੇਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਖਾਲੀ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਤਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I continually enjoy peace and pleasure. O Nanak, this is my pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din sukh  maan ay nit  ralee-aa naanak Dh ur sanjogo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੁਿਖ ਮਾਣੇ ਿਨਤ ਰਲੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਧੁਿਰ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is lovingly embellished with truth and contentment; her Father, the Guru, has come to engage her in marriage to her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh kar bh aa-o kurh am kurh maa-ee aa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਕਿਰ ਭਾਉ ਕੁੜਮੁ  ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਆਇਆ  ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Joining with the humble Saints, I sing Gurbani.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kar mayl gurbaan ee gaavaa-ee-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਿਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਗਾਵਾਈਆ  ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Guru's Bani, I have obtained the supreme status; meeting with the Saints,the self-elect, I am blessed and adorned.
lines.transliteration: banee gur gaa-ee param gat  paa-ee panch milay sohaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਗਾਈ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਪੰਚ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Anger and attachment have left my body and run away; I have eradicated hypocrisyand doubt.
lines.transliteration: ga-i-aa karoDh mamt aa tan naath ee pakh and bh aram gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਇਆ  ਕਰੋਧੁ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਤਿਨ ਨਾਠੀ  ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The pain of egotism is gone, and I have found peace; my body has become healthyand free of disease.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai peer ga-ee sukh paa-i-aa aarogat  bha-ay sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਰੋਗਤ  ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I have realized God, the ocean of virtue. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee barahm pachhaat aa naanak gun ee gaheeraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is separated, far away from God; she does not obtain theMansion of His Presence, and she burns.
lines.transliteration: manmukh vichh urhee door mahal na paa-ay bal ga-ee bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਿਵਛੁੜੀ  ਦੂਿਰ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਲ ਗਈ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Egotism and falsehood are deep within her; deluded by falsehood, she deals only in falsehood.
lines.transliteration: antar mamt aa koor koorh  vihaajh ay koorh  la-ee bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਕੂਿਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਿਵਹਾਝੇ ਕੂਿੜ ਲਈ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Practicing fraud and falsehood, she suffers terrible pain; without the True Guru, she does not find the way.
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat kamaavai mahaa d ukh paavai vin  satgur mag na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The foolish soul-bride wanders along dismal pathways; each and every moment, sheis bumped and pushed.
lines.transliteration: ujharh  panth bh armai gaavaaree kh in khin Dhakay kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਝੜ ਪੰਿਥ ਭਰ੍ਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: God, the Great Giver, shows His Mercy, and leads her to meet the True Guru, thePrimal Being.
lines.transliteration: aapay da-i-aa karay parabh  daataa sat gur purakh  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those beings who have been separated for countless incarnations, O Nanak, arereunited with the Lord, with intuitive ease. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay vichhurh ay jan maylay naanak sahj subh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਵਛੁੜੇ  ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Calculating the most auspicious moment, the Lord comes into the bride's home; herheart is filled with ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa lagan ganaa-ay hird ai Dhan omaahee-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੀਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits and astrologers have come, to sit and consult the almanacs.
lines.transliteration: pandit paaDh ay aan  patee bahi vaachaa-ee-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪਾਧੇ ਆਿਣ  ਪਤੀ ਬਿਹ ਵਾਚਾਈਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: They have consulted the almanacs, and the bride's mind vibrates with bliss, when shehears that her Friend is coming into the home of her heart.
lines.transliteration: patee vaachaa-ee man vajee vaDh aa-ee jab saajan sun ay gh ar aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਤੀ ਵਾਚਾਈ ਮਿਨ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ  ਜਬ ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੁਣੇ ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous and wise men sat down and decided to perform the marriageimmediately.
lines.transliteration: gunee gi-aanee bahi mat aa pakaa-i-aa fayray t at divaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਬਿਹ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ  ਫੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਿਦਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: She has found her Husband, the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Primal Lord, who is forever young; He is her Best Friend from her earliest childhood.
lines.transliteration: var paa-i-aa purakh agamm agochar sad  navtan baal sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਬਾਲ  ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he has mercifully united the bride with Himself. She shall never beseparated again. ||4||1|| sUhI mhlw 4 ] (773-16) soohee mehlaa 4. Soohee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa kar kai maylay vichhurh  kaday na jaa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: In the first round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord sets out His Instructions forperforming the daily duties of married life.
lines.transliteration: har pahilarhee laav parvirt ee karam drirh -aa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.english: Instead of the hymns of the Vedas to Brahma, embrace the righteous conduct ofDharma, and renounce sinful actions.
lines.transliteration: banee barahmaa vayd  Dharam d arirhHu paap t ajaa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹਲੜੀ  ਲਾਵ  ਪਰਿਵਰਤੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam d arirhHu har naam Dh i-aavahu simrit  naam drirh -aa-i-aa. Meditate on the Lord's Name; embrace and enshrine the contemplative remembranceof the Naam.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਵੇਦੁ ਧਰਮੁ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, and all your sins shall bedispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur gur pooraa aaraaDh ahu sabh  kilvikh  paap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By great good fortune, celestial bliss is attained, and the Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the mind. pMnw 774
lines.transliteration: sahj anand ho-aa vadbhaagee man har har meeth aa laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the first round of the marriage ceremony, the marriage ceremony has begun. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan kahai naanak laav pahilee aarambh kaaj rachaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਲਾਵ  ਪਿਹਲੀ  ਆਰੰਭੁ  ਕਾਜੁ  ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the second round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord leads you to meet the TrueGuru, the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: har doojrh ee laav sat gur purakh  milaa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੂਜੜੀ  ਲਾਵ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: With the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord in the mind, the filth of egotism is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh ai man ho-ay ha-umai mail gavaa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭੈ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God, the Immaculate Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, andbehold the Lord's Presence before you.
lines.transliteration: nirmal bha-o paa-i-aa har gun  gaa-i-aa har vaykh ai raam had ooray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is the Lord and Master of the Universe; He is pervadingand permeating everywhere, fully filling all spaces.
lines.transliteration: har aatam raam pasaari-aa su-aamee sarab rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਿਰਆ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within, and outside as well, there is only the One Lord God. Meeting together,the humble servants of the Lord sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar har parabh  ayko mil har jan mangal gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ  ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the second round of the marriage ceremony,the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak doojee laav chalaa-ee anhad  sabad  vajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਲਾਵ  ਚਲਾਈ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਜਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love.
lines.transliteration: har teejrh ee laav man chaa-o bh a-i-aa bairaagee-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੀਜੜੀ  ਲਾਵ  ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the humble Saints of the Lord, I have found the Lord, by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa har mayl har paa-i-aa vadbh aagee-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the Immaculate Lord, and I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. I speakthe Word of the Lord's Bani.
lines.transliteration: nirmal har paa-i-aa har gun gaa-i-aa mukh  bolee har ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੀ  ਹਿਰ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the humble Saints, and I speak the UnspokenSpeech of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa vadbh aagee paa-i-aa har kathee-ai akath kahaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕਥੀਐ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, vibrates and resounds within my heart;meditating on the Lord, I have realized the destiny inscribed upon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: hirdai har har har Dh un upjee har japee-ai mast ak bh aag jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the third round of the marriage ceremony, themind is filled with Divine Love for the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bolay teejee laavai har upjai man bairaag jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਤੀਜੀ  ਲਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਉਪਜੈ  ਮਿਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, my mind has become peaceful; I havefound the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har cha-utharhee laav man sahj bh a-i-aa har paa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਉਥੜੀ  ਲਾਵ  ਮਿਨ ਸਹਜੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have met Him, with intuitive ease; the Lord seems so sweet to mymind and body.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mili-aa subh aa-ay har man t an meeth aa laa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord seems so sweet; I am pleasing to my God. Night and day, I lovingly focusmy consciousness on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har meethaa laa-i-aa mayray parabh  bhaa-i-aa an-d in har liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਇਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained my Lord and Master, the fruit of my mind's desires. The Lord's Name resounds and resonates.
lines.transliteration: man chindi-aa fal paa-i-aa su-aamee har naam vajee vaaDh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God, my Lord and Master, blends with His bride, and her heart blossomsforth in the Naam.
lines.transliteration: har parabh th aakur kaaj rachaa-i-aa Dh an hird ai naam vigaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਕਾਜੁ  ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਧਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਵਗਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, wehave found the Eternal Lord God. ||4||2|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (774-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 4 Gru 2 ] (774-15) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 4 gh ar 2. Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bolay cha-uthee laavai har paa-i-aa parabh avinaasee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬੋਲੇ ਚਉਥੀ ਲਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har gun  gaa-ay.
hirdai rasan rasaa-ay. in their hearts, and on their tongues, they enjoy and savor His taste.

lines.english: They enjoy and savor His taste, and are pleasing to my God, who meets them withnatural ease.
lines.transliteration: har rasan rasaa-ay mayray parabh bh aa-ay mili-aa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, they enjoy enjoyments, and they sleep in peace; they remain lovinglyabsorbed in the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh og bh ogay sukh  sovai sabad  rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one obtains the Perfect Guru; night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag gur pooraa paa-ee-ai an-d in naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਏ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: In absolute ease and poise, one meets the Life of the World. O Nanak, one isabsorbed in the state of absolute absorption. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sehjay sahj mili-aa jagjeevan naanak sunn samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਸੁਿਖ ਸੋਵੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I bathe in the Immaculate Pool of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sangat sant  milaa-ay. har sar nirmal naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Bathing in these Immaculate Waters, my filth is removed, and my body is purified andsanctified.
lines.transliteration: nirmal jal naa-ay mail gavaa-ay bha-ay pavit  sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁੰਿਨ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The filth of intellectual evil-mindedness is removed, doubt is gone, and the pain ofegotism is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: durmat  mail ga-ee bh aram bh aagaa ha-umai binth ee peeraa.

lines.english: By God's Grace, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. I dwell in the home of my own inner being. pMnw 775
lines.transliteration: nadar parabh oo sat sangat  paa-ee nij gh ar ho-aa vaasaa.

lines.english: My tongue tastes the taste of the Lord's joyous song; O Nanak, the Naam shines forthbrightly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har mangal ras rasan rasaa-ay naanak naam pargaasaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਗਲ  ਰਿਸ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਏ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh loves the Name of the Lord; deep within, she contemplates the jewel of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: antar rat an beechaaray. gurmukh  naam pi-aaray.

lines.english: Those who love the Lord's Name are emancipated through the Word of the Shabad.The darkness of ignorance is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: har naam pi-aaray sabad nist aaray agi-aan aDh ayr gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom burns brilliantly, illuminating the heart; their homes and temples areembellished and blessed.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan parchand bali-aa ghat chaanan  ghar mand ar sohaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have made my body and mind into adornments, and dedicated them to the TrueLord God, pleasing Him.
lines.transliteration: tan man arap seegaar ban aa-ay har parabh  saachay bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਚੰਡੁ ਬਿਲਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਸੋਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever God says, I gladly do. O Nanak, I have merged into the fiber of His Being.||3||
lines.transliteration: jo parabh kahai so-ee par keejai naanak ank samaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਬਣਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God has arranged the marriage ceremony;
lines.transliteration: har parabh kaaj rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He has come to marry the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vee-aahan  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He has come to marry the Gurmukh, who has found the Lord. That bride is very dearto her Lord.
lines.transliteration: vee-aahan aa-i-aa gurmukh  har paa-i-aa saa Dh an kant  pi-aaree.

lines.english: The humble Saints join together and sing the songs of joy; the Dear Lord Himself has adorned the soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil mangal gaa-ay har jee-o aap savaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਵੀਆਹਿਣ  ਆਇਆ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The angels and mortal beings, the heavenly heralds and celestial singers, have cometogether and formed a wondrous wedding party.
lines.transliteration: sur nar gan ganDh arab mil aa-ay apoorab janj  banaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I have found my True Lord God, who never dies, and is not born. ||4||1||3|| rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 4 Gru 3  (775-8) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 4 gh ar 3 Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (775-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh paa-i-aa mai saachaa naa kad ay marai na jaa-ee. ||4||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਆਏ  ਅਪੂਰਬ  ਜੰਞ ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Come, humble Saints, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aavho sant janhu gun  gaavah govind  kayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੈ ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: Let us gather together as Gurmukh; within the home of our own heart, the Shabadvibrates and resonates.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mil rahee-ai gh ar vaajeh sabad  ghanayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The many melodies of the Shabad are Yours, O Lord God; O Creator Lord, You areeverywhere.
lines.transliteration: sabad gh anayray har parabh  tayray t oo kart aa sabh  thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੋ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Day and night, I chant His Praises forever, lovingly focusing on the True Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: ahinis japee sadaa saalaahee saach sabad  liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਜਿਹ  ਸਬਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I remain intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love; in my heart, I worship the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: an-din sahj rahai rang raat aa raam naam rid  poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I have realized the One Lord; I do not know any other. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ayk pachh aanai avar na jaan ai doojaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਜਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਾਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He is contained amongst all; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh rav rahi-aa so parabh  antarjaamee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.english: One who meditates and dwells upon God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad,knows that God, my Lord and Master, is pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad ravai rav rahi-aa so parabh  mayraa su-aamee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God, my Lord and Master, is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He pervadesand permeates each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayraa su-aamee ant arjaamee gh at ghat ravi-aa so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, Truth is obtained, and then, one merges in celestialbliss. There is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmat sach paa-ee-ai sahj samaa-ee-ai t is bin avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਵੈ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I sing His Praises with intuitive ease. If it pl eases God, He shall unite me with Himself.
lines.transliteration: sehjay gun gaavaa jay parabh  bhaavaa aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Shabad, God is known; meditate on the Naam, day and night. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak so parabh sabd ay jaapai ahinis naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਈਐ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: This world is treacherous and impassable; the self-willed manmukh cannot cross over.
lines.transliteration: ih jago dut ar manmukh  paar na paa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਜੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Within him is egotism, self-conceit, sexual desire, anger and cleverness.
lines.transliteration: antray ha-umai mamt aa kaam kroDh  chaturaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਬਦੇ  ਜਾਪੈ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Within him is cleverness; he is not approved, and his life is uselessly wasted and lost.
lines.transliteration: antar chat uraa-ee thaa-ay na paa-ee birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੋ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: On the Path of Death, he suffers in pain, and must endure abuse; in the end, he departs regretfully.
lines.transliteration: jam mag dukh  paavai chotaa kh aavai ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, he has no friends, no children, family or relatives.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko baylee naahee put kutamb sut  bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the wealth of Maya, attachment and ostentatious shows - none of themshall go along with him to the world hereafter. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak maa-i-aa moh pasaaraa aagai saath na jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਮਿਗ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I ask my True Guru, the Giver, how to cross over the treacherous and difficult world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: ha-o poochha-o apnaa sat gur daataa kin biDh  dutar taree-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਪੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਸੁਤੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, and remain dead while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aa-ay chalhu jeevt i-aa iv maree-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ਆਗੈ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Remaining dead while yet alive, cross over the terrifying world-ocean; as Gurmukh, merge in the Naam. pMnw 776
lines.transliteration: jeevti-aa maree-ai bh a-ojal t aree-ai gurmukh  naam samaavai.

lines.english: One obtains the Perfect Primal Lord, by great good fortune, lovingly focusing on the True Name.
lines.transliteration: pooraa purakh paa-i-aa vadbh aagee sach naam liv laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The intellect is enlightened, and the mind is satisfied, through the glory of the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: mat pargaas bh a-ee man maani-aa raam naam vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God is found, merging in the Shabad, and one's light blends into the Light.||4||1||4|| sUhI mhlw 4 Gru 5  (776-4) soohee mehlaa 4 ghar 5 Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (776-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh paa-i-aa sabad  milaa-i-aa jot ee jot  milaa-ee. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: O humble Saints, I have met my Beloved Guru; the fire of my desire is quenched, andmy yearning is gone.
lines.transliteration: gur sant jano pi-aaraa mai mili-aa mayree t arisnaa bujh  ga-ee-aasay.

lines.english: I dedicate my mind and body to the True Guru; I pray that may He unite me withGod, the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: ha-o man tan d ayvaa sat igurai mai maylay parabh  guntaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਮੈ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਬੁਿਝ ਗਈਆਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo vad purakh  hai mai d asay har saabaasay. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Supreme Being, who tells me of the most blessedLord.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੈ  ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has found the Lord; he blossoms forth in the Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har paa-i-aa jan naanak naam vigaasay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: I have met my Beloved Friend, the Guru, who has shown me the Path to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sajan pi-aaraa mai mili-aa har maarag panth d asaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਵਗਾਸੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Come home - I have been separated from You for so long! Please, let me merge withYou, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ghar aavhu chiree vichh unni-aa mil sabad  guroo parabh  naahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਮੈ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, I am so sad; like a fish out of water, I shall die.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tujh  baajh ahu kh aree udeen ee-aa ji-o jal bin meen maraahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਆਵਹੁ ਿਚਰੀ ਿਵਛੁੰਿਨਆ  ਿਮਲੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The very fortunate ones meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak merges into the Naam.||2||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har Dh i-aa-i-aa jan naanak naam samaahaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ  ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the self-willed manmukh wanders around,deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: man dah d is chal chal bh armi-aa manmukh  bharam bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਹਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In his mind, he continually conjures up hopes; his mind is gripped by hunger andthirst.
lines.transliteration: nit aasaa man chit vai man t arisnaa bh ukh lagaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਚਿਲ  ਚਿਲ  ਭਰਿਮਆ  ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There is an infinite treasure buried within the mind, but still, he goes out, searchingfor poison.
lines.transliteration: antaa Dh an Dh ar dabi-aa fir bikh  bhaalan  ga-i-aa.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Name, he rots away, and wastes away to death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too bin naavai pach pach mu-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਤਾ  ਧਨੁ ਧਿਰ ਦਿਬਆ ਿਫਿਰ ਿਬਖੁ ਭਾਲਣ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Finding the beautiful and fascinating Guru, I have conquered my mind, through theBani, the Word of my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sundar mohan paa-ay karay har paraym ban ee man maari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿਚ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My heart has forgotten its common sense and wisdom; my mind has forgotten itshopes and cares.
lines.transliteration: mayrai hirdai suDh  buDh  visar ga-ee man aasaa chint  visaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਪਾਇ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within my self, I feel the pains of divine love. Beholding the Guru, my mind iscomforted and consoled.
lines.transliteration: mai antar vayd an paraym kee gur d aykhat man saaDh aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸੁਿਧ ਬੁਿਧ ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਗਈ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ  ਿਚੰਤ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Awaken my good destiny, O God - please, come and meet me! Each and everyinstant, servant Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||5|| sUhI CMq mhlw 4 ] (776-14) soohee chhant  mehlaa 4. Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee parabh  aa-ay mil jan naanak kh in khin vaari-aa. ||4||1||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵੇਦਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਤ  ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Eradicate the poison of egotism, O human being; it is holding you back from meetingyour Lord God.
lines.transliteration: maarayhis vay jan ha-umai bikhi-aa jin har parabh  milan  na ditee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੁ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: This golden-colored body has been disfigured and ruined by egotism.
lines.transliteration: dayh kanchan vay vannee-aa in ha-umai maar vigut ee-aa.

lines.english: Attachment to Maya is total darkness; this foolish, self-willed manmukh is attached to it.
lines.transliteration: moh maa-i-aa vay sabh kaalkh aa in manmukh  moorh  sajut ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੇਿਹਸੁ  ਵੇ ਜਨ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਣ  ਨ ਿਦਤੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, heis released from egotism. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh ubray gur sabd ee ha-umai chh utee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਕੰਚਨ  ਵੇ ਵੰਨੀਆ  ਇਿਨ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਵਗੁਤੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Overcome and subdue this mind; your mind wanders around continually, like a falcon.
lines.transliteration: vas aanihu vay jan is man ka-o man baasay ji-o nit  bha-udi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਵੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਖਾ ਇਿਨ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮੂਿੜ ਸਜੁਤੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal's life-night passes painfully, in constant hope and desire.
lines.transliteration: dukh rain vay vihaan ee-aa nit  aasaa aas karayd i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਛੁਟੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found the Guru, O humble Saints; my mind's hopes are fulfilled, chanting theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur paa-i-aa vay sant jano man aas pooree har cha-ud i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਸ ਆਿਣਹੁ ਵੇ ਜਨ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸੇ ਿਜਉ ਿਨਤ ਭਉਿਦਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless servant Nanak, O God, with such understanding, that abandoning falsehopes, he may always sleep in peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak parabh d ayh mat ee chh ad aasaa nit  sukh  sa-ud i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਖ ਰੈਿਣ ਵੇ ਿਵਹਾਣੀਆ  ਿਨਤ ਆਸਾ  ਆਸ  ਕਰੇਿਦਆ  ॥
lines.english: The bride hopes in her mind, that her Sovereign Lord God will come to her bed.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan aasaa chit  karay raam raaji-aa har parabh  sayjrh ee-ai aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਵੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ ਮਿਨ ਆਸ  ਪੂਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਚਉਿਦਆ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is infinitely compassionate; O Sovereign Lord, be merciful, and merge me into Yourself. pMnw 777
lines.transliteration: mayraa thaakur agam d a-i-aal hai raam raaji-aa kar kirpaa layho milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਿਜਆ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body long to behold the Guru's face. O Sovereign Lord, I have spread out my bed of loving faith.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan lochaa gurmukh ay raam raaji-aa har sarDh aa sayj vichh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਲੋਚਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਿਜਆ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਧਾ  ਸੇਜ ਿਵਛਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, when the bride pleases her Lord God, her Sovereign Lord meets herwith natural ease. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har parabh bh aanee-aa raam raaji-aa mili-aa sahj subh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਿਜਆ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Lord God, my Sovereign Lord, is on the one bed. The Guru has shown me how tomeet my Lord.
lines.transliteration: ikat sayjai har parabh o raam raaji-aa gur d asay har maylay-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਤੁ  ਸੇਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਿਜਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇਈ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are filled with love and affection for my Sovereign Lord. In HisMercy, the Guru has united me with Him.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan paraym bairaag hai raam raaji-aa gur maylay kirpaa karay-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਿਜਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, O my Sovereign Lord; I surrender my soul to the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o gur vitahu ghol gh umaa-i-aa raam raaji-aa jee-o sat gur aagai d ay-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਿਜਆ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਗੈ  ਦੇਈ ॥
lines.english: When the Guru is totally pleased, O servant Nanak, he unites the soul with the Lord, the Sovereign Lord. ||4||2||6||5||7||6||18|| rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 5 Gru 1  (777-6) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (777-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur tuth aa jee-o raam raaji-aa jan naanak har maylay-ee. ||4||2||6||5||7||6||18||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਜੀਉ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਿਜਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥੫॥੭॥੬॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: gazing upon the world, why have you gone crazy?
lines.transliteration: sun baavray t oo kaa-ay d aykh bhulaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: you have been trapped by false love, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.
lines.transliteration: sun baavray nayhu koorh aa laa-i-o kusambh  rangaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਤੂ ਕਾਏ ਦੇਿਖ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the false world, you are fooled. It is not worth even half a shell. Only theName of the Lord of the Universe is permanent.
lines.transliteration: koorhee daykh  bhulo adh  lahai na mulo govid  naam majeeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਨੇਹੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਇਓ  ਕੁਸੰਭ  ਰੰਗਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: You shall take on the deep and lasting red color of the poppy, contemplating thesweet Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: theeveh laalaa at gulaalaa sabad  cheen gur meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੀ ਡੇਿਖ ਭੁਲੋ ਅਢੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਮੁਲੋ ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: You remain intoxicated with false emotional attachment; you are attached tofalsehood.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa mohi magan thee rahi-aa jhooth  sang laptaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਥੀਵਿਹ  ਲਾਲਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਗੁਲਾਲਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak, meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the treasure of mercy. Hepreserves the honor of His devotees. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak deen saran  kirpaa niDh  raakh  laaj bh agtaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਥੀ ਰਿਹਆ  ਝੂਠ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਪਟਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: serve your Lord, the Master of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: sun baavray sayv th aakur naath paraan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ  ਭਗਤਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: whoever comes, shall go.
lines.transliteration: sun baavray jo aa-i-aa t is jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਸੇਿਵ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O wandering stranger: that which you believe to be permanent, shall all pass away; so remain in the Saints' Congregation.
lines.transliteration: nihchal habh vaisee sun  pardaysee sat sang mil rahee-ai.

lines.english: Listen, renunciate: by your good destiny, obtain the Lord, and remain attached toGod's Feet.
lines.transliteration: har paa-ee-ai bhaagee sun  bairaagee charan  parabh oo geh rahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹਭ ਵੈਸੀ ਸੁਿਣ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Dedicate and surrender this mind to the Lord, and have no doubts; as Gurmukh,renounce your great pride.
lines.transliteration: ayhu man deejai sank na keejai gurmukh  taj baho maan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਭਾਗੀ  ਸੁਿਣ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਚਰਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਗਿਹ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord carries the meek and humble devotees across the terrifying world-ocean. What Glorious Virtues of Your should I chant and recite? ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak deen bh agat bhav taaran  tayray ki-aa gun  aakh  vakh aanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਸੰਕ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਿਜ  ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: why do you harbor false pride?
lines.transliteration: sun baavray ki-aa keechai koorh aa maano.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਭਗਤ  ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣ  ਤੇਰੇ ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: all your egotism and pride shall be overcome.
lines.transliteration: sun baavray habh  vaisee garab gumaano.

lines.english: What you think is permanent, shall all pass away. Pride is false, so become the slaveof God's Saints.
lines.transliteration: nihchal habh jaan aa mithi-aa maan aa sant  parabh oo ho-ay d aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਹਭੁ ਵੈਸੀ ਗਰਬੁ  ਗੁਮਾਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Remain dead while still alive, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, if itis your pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: jeevat maree-ai bh a-ojal t aree-ai jay theevai karam likh i-aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹਭ ਜਾਣਾ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਮਾਣਾ  ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord causes to meditate intuitively, serves the Guru, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gur sayveejai amrit peejai jis laaveh sahj Dh i-aano.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਮਰੀਐ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਜੇ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਲਿਖਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice,forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pa-i-aa har d u-aarai ha-o bal bal sad  kurbaano. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਜੈ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਲਾਵਿਹ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: do not think that you have found God.
lines.transliteration: sun baavray mat  jaaneh parabh  mai paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen, madman: be the dust under the feet of those who meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: sun baavray thee-o rayn  jinee parabh  Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on God find peace. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision oftheir Darshan is obtained.
lines.transliteration: jin parabh Dh i-aa-i-aa t in sukh  paa-i-aa vadbh aagee d arsan paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Be humble, and be forever a sacrifice, and yo ur self-conceit shall be totally eradicated.
lines.transliteration: thee-o nimaanaa sad  kurbaan aa saglaa aap mitaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who has found God is pure, with blessed destiny. I would sell myself to him.
lines.transliteration: oh Dhan bh aag suDh aa jin parabh  laDhaa ham t is peh aap vaychaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak, the meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace. Make him Your own, and preserve his honor. ||4||1|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (777-19) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak deen saran  sukh  saagar raakh  laaj apnaa-i-aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਸੁਧਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਧਾ  ਹਮ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਆਪੁ  ਵੇਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru was satisfied with me, and blessed me with the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet. I am a sacrifice to the Lord. pMnw 778
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal kee tayk sat gur ditee tus kai bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਦਤੀ  ਤੁਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is an overflowing treasure; everything is in His Home. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har amrit bh aray bh andaar sabh  kichh  hai gh ar tis kai bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਘਿਰ  ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My Father is absolutely all-powerful. God is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: baabul mayraa vad samrathaa karan kaaran  parabh  haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੁਲੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥਾ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, pain does not touch me; thus I cross over theterrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat d ukh ko-ee na laagai bh a-ojal paar ut aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Protector of His devotees.Praising Him continually, I live.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  bhagtan kaa raakh aa ust at kar kar jeevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਜੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sweetest and most sublime essence.Night and day, I drink it in with my mind and body. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meethaa an-d in man t an peevaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪੀਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord unites me with Himself; how could I feel any separation? I am a sacrifice tothe Lord.
lines.transliteration: har aapay la-ay milaa-ay ki-o vaychhorh aa theev-ee bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਿਕਉ  ਵੇਛੋੜਾ  ਥੀਵਈ  ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who has Your Support lives forever and ever. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayree tayk so sad aa sad  jeev-ee bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਈ  ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I take my support from You alone, O True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk t ujhai tay paa-ee saachay sirjan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ਸਾਚੇ ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: No one lacks this Support; such is my God.
lines.transliteration: jis tay kh aalee ko-ee naahee aisaa parabh oo hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ  ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਐਸਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the humble Saints, I sing the songs of joy; day and night, I place my hopes in You.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil mangal gaa-i-aa d in rain aas t umHaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਆ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਆਸ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Perfect Guru. Nanak is forevera sacrifice. ||2||
lines.transliteration: safal daras bh ayti-aa gur pooraa naanak sad  balihaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲੁ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Contemplating, dwelling upon the Lord's true home, I receive honor, greatness andtruth. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sammHli-aa sach thaan maan mahat sach paa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਮਿਲਆ  ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Merciful True Guru, I sing the Praises of the Imperishable Lord. I am asacrifice to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-aa d a-i-aal gun  abhinaasee gaa-i-aa bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਗੁਣ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਗਾਇਆ  ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, continually, continuously; He isthe Beloved Master of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: gun govind  gaa-o nit  nit paraan  pareet am su-aamee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ ਗਾਉ  ਿਨਤ ਿਨਤ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Good times have come; the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has met me, andhugged me close in His Embrace.
lines.transliteration: subh d ivas aa-ay geh kanth  laa-ay milay ant arjaamee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭ ਿਦਵਸ  ਆਏ  ਗਿਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਏ ਿਮਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The musical instruments of truth and contentment vibrate, and the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh vajeh vaajay anhad aa jhunkaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਵਜਿਹ  ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦਾ  ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing this, all my fears have been dispelled; O Nanak, God is the Primal Being, theCreator Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sun bh ai binaasay sagal naanak parabh  purakh  karnaihaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਭੈ ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The essence of spiritual wisdom has welled up; in this world, and the next, the One Lord is pervading. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: upji-aa tat  gi-aan saahurai pay-ee-ai ik har bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਿਜਆ ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ  ਇਕੁ ਹਿਰ ਬਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: When God meets the God within the self, no one can separate them. I am a sacrificeto the Lord.
lines.transliteration: barahmai barahm mili-aa ko-ay na saakai bhinn kar bal raam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੈ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਿਭੰਨ ਕਿਰ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I gaze upon the Wondrous Lord, and listen to the Wondrous Lord; the Wondrous Lordhas come into my vision.
lines.transliteration: bisam paykhai bisam sun ee-ai bismaad  nadree aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky, in each andevery heart.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al pooran su-aamee ghat gh at rahi-aa samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have merged again into the One from whom I originated. The value of this cannotbe described.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upji-aa t is maahi samaa-i-aa keemat  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Nanak meditates on Him. ||4||2|| rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 5 Gru 2  (778-15) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (778-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jis kay chalat na jaahee lakh -nay naanak t iseh Dh i-aa-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੇ ਚਲਤ  ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਲਖਣੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਧਆਏ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gobind gun  gaavan  laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I am awake, night and day, in the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: har rang an-din jaagay.

lines.english: Awake to the Lord's Love, my sins have left me. I meet with the Beloved Saints.
lines.transliteration: har rang jaagay paap bhaagay milay sant  pi-aari-aa.

lines.english: Attached to the Guru's Feet, my doubts are dispelled, and all my affairs are resolved.
lines.transliteration: gur charan laagay bh aram bh aagay kaaj sagal savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਜਾਗੇ  ਪਾਪ ਭਾਗੇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Listening to the Word of the Guru's Bani with my ears, I know celestial peace. By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sun sarvan  banee sahj jaan ee har naam jap vadbh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਭਰਮ  ਭਾਗੇ  ਕਾਜ  ਸਗਲ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have entered my Lord and Master's Sanctuary. I dedicate my body andsoul to God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  su-aamee jee-o pind parabh  aagai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਰ੍ਵਣ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਜਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਵਡਭਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody of the Shabad, the Word of God is so very beautiful.
lines.transliteration: anhat sabad  suhaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਗੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True joy comes from singing the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: sach mangal har jas gaavaa.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, pain is dispelled, and my mind isfilled with tremendous joy.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay har har d ookh naasay rahas upjai man gh anaa.

lines.english: My mind and body have become immaculate and pure, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; I chant the Name of God. pMnw 779
lines.transliteration: man tann nirmal d aykh darsan naam parabh  kaa mukh  bhanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.english: I am the dust of the feet of the Holy. Worshipping God in adoration, my God is pleased with me.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay rayn saaDh oo parabh  araaDh oo aapn ay parabh  bhaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਰਾਧੂ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your Glorious Praisesforever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d a-i-aa Dh aarahu sad aa har gun  gaavaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, I cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: gur mil saagar tari-aa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, I am emancipated.
lines.transliteration: har charan japat  nistari-aa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, I have obtained the fruits of all rewards, and mycomings and goings have ceased.
lines.transliteration: har charan Dh i-aa-ay sabh  fal paa-ay mitay aavan  jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਿਧਆਏ  ਸਿਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਿਮਟੇ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: With loving devotional worship, I meditate intuitively on the Lord, and my God is pleased.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay bh agat subh aa-ay har jap aapn ay parabh  bhaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the One, Unseen, Infinite, Perfect Lord; there is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: jap ayk alakh apaar pooran t is binaa nahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the Guru has erased my doubts; wherever I look, there I see Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak gur bh aram kh o-i-aa jat  daykhaa tat so-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਭਰਮੁ  ਖੋਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Purifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan har naamaa.

lines.english: It resolves the affairs of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: pooran sant janaa kay kaamaa.

lines.english: I have found the Saintly Guru, meditating on God. All my desires have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gur sant paa-i-aa parabh  Dhi-aa-i-aa sagal ichh aa punnee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਇਛਾ  ਪੁੰਨੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The fever of egotism has been dispelled, and I am always happy. I have met God,from whom I was separated for so long.
lines.transliteration: ha-o taap binsay sad aa sarsay parabh  milay chiree vichh unni-aa.

lines.english: My mind has found peace and tranquility; congratulations are pouring in. I shall neverforget Him from my mind.
lines.transliteration: man saat aa-ee vajee vaDh aa-ee manhu kad ay na veesrai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਸਾਿਤ  ਆਈ  ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ  ਮਨਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the True Guru has taught me this, to vibrate and meditate forever onthe Lord of the Universe. ||4||1||3|| rwgu sUhI CMq mhlw 5 Gru 3  (779-9) raag soohee chhant  mehlaa 5 gh ar 3 Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (779-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sat gur drirh -aa-i-aa sad aa bh aj jagd eesrai. ||4||1||3||

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You are unattached; You have so many hand-maidens like me, Lord.
lines.transliteration: too th aakuro bairaagro mai jayhee gh an chayree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You are the ocean, the source of jewels; I do not know Your value, Lord.
lines.transliteration: tooN saagro rat naagro ha-o saar na jaan aa tayree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ  ਬੈਰਾਗਰੋ  ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I do not know Your value; You are the wisest of all; please show Mercy unto me, OLord.
lines.transliteration: saar na jaanaa t oo vad d aanaa kar mihramat  saaN-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਗਰੋ  ਰਤਨਾਗਰੋ  ਹਉ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Show Your Mercy, and bless me with such understanding, that I may meditate onYou, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa keejai saa mat d eejai aath  pahar t uDh Dhi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਹਰੰਮਿਤ  ਸਈ  ॥
lines.english: O soul, don't be so arrogant - become the dust of all, and you shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: garab na keejai rayn hoveejai t aa gat  jee-aray t ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ  ਸਾ ਮਿਤ ਦੀਜੈ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak's Lord is the Master of all; He has so many hand-maidens like me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh oopar naanak kaa th aakur mai jayhee gh an chayree raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਵੀਜੈ  ਤਾ ਗਿਤ  ਜੀਅਰੇ  ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Your depth is profound and utterly unfathomable; You are my Husband Lord, and Iam Your bride.
lines.transliteration: tumH ga-uhar at  gahir gambh eeraa t um pir ham bahuree-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the greatest of the great, exalted and lofty on high; I am infinitesimally small.
lines.transliteration: tum vaday vaday vad oochay ha-o it neek lahuree-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਗਉਹਰ  ਅਿਤ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰਾ  ਤੁਮ ਿਪਰ ਹਮ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am nothing; You are the One and only. You Yourself are All-knowing.
lines.transliteration: ha-o kichh naahee ayko t oohai aapay aap sujaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਹਉ ਇਤਨੀਕ  ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: With just a momentary Glance of Your Grace, God, I live; I enjoy all pleasures and delights.
lines.transliteration: amrit d arisat nimakh  parabh  jeevaa sarab rang ras maanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਏਕੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet; I am the slave of Your slaves. My mind hasblossomed forth, and my body is rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: charnah sarnee d aasah d aasee man ma-ulai t an haree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is contained amongst all; He does just as He pleases.||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak thaakur sarab samaan aa aapan bh aavan karee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣਹ  ਸਰਨੀ  ਦਾਸਹ  ਦਾਸੀ  ਮਿਨ ਮਉਲੈ  ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I take pride in You; You are my only Strength, Lord.
lines.transliteration: tujh oopar mayraa hai maan aa toohai mayraa t aanaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਆਪਨ ਭਾਵਨ  ਕਰੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are my understanding, intellect and knowledge. I know only what You cause meto know, Lord.
lines.transliteration: surat mat  chaturaa-ee t ayree t oo jaan aa-ihi jaan aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝੁ ਊਪਿਰ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਮਾਣਾ  ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He alone knows, and he alone understands, upon whom the Creator Lord bestows HisGrace.
lines.transliteration: so-ee jaanai so-ee pachh aanai jaa ka-o nad ar sirand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਿਹ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wanders along many paths, and is trapped in the net of Maya.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolee bahut ee raahee faathee maa-i-aa fand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੋਈ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਸਰੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: She alone is virtuous, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master. She alone enjoys all thepleasures.
lines.transliteration: thaakur bh aanee saa gun vantee tin hee sabh  rang maan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਭੂਲੀ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ  ਫਾਥੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ਫੰਦੇ ॥
lines.english: You, O Lord, are Nanak's only support. You are Nanak's only pride. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak kee Dhar t oohai th aakur t oo naanak kaa maan aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਭਾਣੀ  ਸਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ  ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, devoted and dedicated to You; You are my sheltering mountain, Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaaree vanjaa gh olee vanj aa too parbat  mayraa olHaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, thousands, hundreds of thousands of times, to the Lord. He has torn away the veil of doubt; pMnw 780
lines.transliteration: ha-o bal jaa-ee lakh lakh  lakh baree-aa jin bh aram pard aa kh olHaa raam.
mitay anDhaaray t ajay bikaaray th aakur si-o man maanaa. darkness has been eliminated, and I have renounced corruption and sin. My mind is reconciled with my Lord and Master.

lines.english: I have become pleasing to my Dear God, and I have become carefree. My life isfulfilled and approved.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee bh aanee bh a-ee nikaan ee safal janam parvaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਭਾਣੀ ਭਈ ਿਨਕਾਣੀ  ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਰਵਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have become invaluable, of tremendous weight and value. The Door, and the Path ofliberation are open to me now.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee amolee bh aaraa t olee mukat  jugat  dar kholHaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਈ ਅਮੋਲੀ  ਭਾਰਾ  ਤੋਲੀ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਦਰੁ ਖੋਲਾ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am fearless; God has become my Shelter and Shield. ||4||1||4|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (780-3) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ha-o nirbha-o ho-ee so parabh  mayraa olHaa. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਹੋਈ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: My Perfect True Guru is my Best Friend, the Primal Being. I do not know any other than Him, Lord.
lines.transliteration: saajan purakh sat gur mayraa pooraa t is bin avar na jaan aa raam.

lines.english: He is my mother, father, sibling, child, relative, soul and breath of life. He is sopleasing to my mind, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banDh ap jee-a paraan  man bh aanaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My body and soul are all His blessings. He is overflowing with every quality of virtue.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is kaa d ee-aa sarab gun aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. He is totally permeating andpervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee so parabh  mayraa sarab rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: In His Sanctuary, I receive every comfort and pleasure. I am totally, completelyhappy.
lines.transliteration: taa kee saran  sarab sukh  paa-ay ho-ay sarab kali-aan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਰਬ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to God, forever, a devoted sacrifice. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa parabh  ka-o balihaarai naanak sad  kurbaan aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ  ਕਿਲਆਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, one finds such a Guru, meeting whom, the Lord God is known.
lines.transliteration: aisaa gur vadbhaagee paa-ee-ai jit  mili-ai parabh  jaapai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, bathing continually in the dust of the feet of God's Saints.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilvikh ut reh har sant  Dhoorhee nit  naapai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord, and meditating on God, you shall not haveto enter into the womb of reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: har Dhoorh ee naa-ee-ai parabh oo Dh i-aa-ee-ai baahurh  jon na aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਉਤਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਧੂੜੀ ਿਨਤ  ਨਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Grasping hold of the Guru's Feet, doubt and fear are dispelled, and you receive thefruits of your mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: gur charnee laagay bh aram bh a-o bh aagay man chind i-aa fal paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Continually singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and meditating on the Naam, theName of the Lord, you shall no longer suffer in pain and sorrow.
lines.transliteration: har gun nit  gaa-ay naam Dh i-aa-ay fir sog naahee sant aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God is the Giver of all souls; His radiant glory is perfect! ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak so parabh jee-a kaa d aataa pooraa jis part aapai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਤ  ਗਾਏ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੰਤਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue; the Lord is under the power of His Saints.
lines.transliteration: har haray har gun niDh ay har sant an kai vas aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਪੂਰਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are dedicated to the feet of the Saints, and to serving the Guru, obtain thesupreme status, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant charan  gur sayvaa laagay t inee param pad  paa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧੇ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They obtain the supreme status, and eradicate self-conceit; the Perfect Lord showersHis Grace upon them.
lines.transliteration: param pad paa-i-aa aap mitaa-i-aa har pooran kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Their lives are fruitful, their fears are dispelled, and they meet the One Lord, the Destroyer of ego.
lines.transliteration: safal janam ho-aa bha-o bh aagaa har bh ayti-aa ayk muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He blends into the One, to whom he belongs; his light merges into the Light.
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee mayl lee-aa jot ee jot  samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord; meeting the True Guru,peace is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niranjan japee-ai mil satgur sukh  paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੀਆ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sing continually the songs of joy, O humble beings of the Lord; all your desires shallbe fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gaa-o manglo nit har janhu punnee ichh  sabaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Love of their Lord and Master do not die, or come orgo in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: rang ratay apunay su-aamee sayt ee marai na aavai jaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ  ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨਹੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਇਛ ਸਬਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Imperishable Lord is obtained, meditating on the Naam, and all one's wishes arefulfilled.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee paa-i-aa naam Dh i-aa-i-aa sagal manorath paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੇਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Peace, poise, and all ecstasy are obtained, attaching one's mind to the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj aanand  ghanayray gur charn ee man laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Imperishable Lord is permeating and pervading each and every heart; He is in allplaces and interspaces.
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-aa ghat gh at abh inaasee thaan thanant ar saa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, all affairs are perfectly resolved, focusing one's mind on the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||5|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (780-17) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kaaraj saglay pooray gur charnee man laa-ee. ||4||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Be Merciful, O my Beloved Lord and Master, that I may behold the Blessed Vision ofYour Darshan with my eyes.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mayray pareetam su-aamee nayt ar daykheh daras t ayraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Please bless me, O my Beloved, with thousands of tongues, to worship and adore Youwith my mouth, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: laakh jihvaa d ayh mayray pi-aaray mukh  har aaraaDh ay mayraa raam.

lines.english: Worshipping the Lord in adoration, the Path of Death is overcome, and no pain orsuffering will afflict you.
lines.transliteration: har aaraaDhay jam panth saaDh ay dookh na vi-aapai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky;wherever I look, there He is.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al pooran su-aamee jat d aykhaa tat so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਖ  ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਦੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮੁਖੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Doubt, attachment and corruption are gone. God is the nearest of the near. pMnw 781
lines.transliteration: bharam moh bikaar naath ay parabh  nayr hoo t ay nayraa.

lines.english: Please bless Nanak with Your Merciful Grace, O God, that his eyes may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh kirpaa keejai nayt ar daykheh daras t ayraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please bless me, O Beloved God, with millions of ears, with which I may hear the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot karan deejeh parabh  pareet am har gun  sunee-ah abh inaasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਕਰਨ  ਦੀਜਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਿਹ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Listening, listening to these, this mind becomes spotless and pure, and the noose of Death is cut.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  ih man nirmal hovai katee-ai kaal kee faasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਕਟੀਐ  ਕਾਲ  ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The noose of Death is cut, meditating on the Imperishable Lord, and all happiness andwisdom are obtained.
lines.transliteration: katee-ai jam faasee simar abhinaasee sagal mangal sugi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਟੀਐ  ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਸੁਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Chant, and meditate, day and night, on the Lord, Har, Har. Focus your meditation onthe Celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har jap japee-ai din raat ee laagai sahj Dh i-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੀਐ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The painful sins are burnt away, by keeping God in one's thoughts; evil-mindedness iserased.
lines.transliteration: kalmal dukh  jaaray parabh oo chit aaray man kee d urmat  naasee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਮਲ  ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਚਤਾਰੇ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O God, please be Merciful to me, that I may listen to Your GloriousPraises, O Imperishable Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh kirpaa keejai har gun  sunee-ah avinaasee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਿਹ  ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please give me millions of hands to serve You, God, and let my feet walk on YourPath.
lines.transliteration: karorh hasat  tayree tahal kamaaveh charan  chaleh parabh  maarag raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੋਿੜ  ਹਸਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਟਹਲ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਚਰਣ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Service to the Lord is the boat to carry us across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar naav har sayvaa jo charh ai tis taarag raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ  ਨਾਵ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਚੜੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਤਾਰਿਗ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: So cross over the terrifying world-ocean, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har; all wishes shall be fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: bhavjal t ari-aa har har simri-aa sagal manorath pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਿਰਆ  ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Even the worst corruption is taken away; peace wells up, and the unstruck celestialharmony vibrates and resounds.
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikaar ga-ay sukh upjay baajay anhad  tooray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਗਏ ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ  ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ  ਤੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: All the fruits of the mind's desires are obtained; His creative power is infinitelyvaluable.
lines.transliteration: man baaNchhat  fal paa-ay saglay kud rat keem apaarag.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਛਤ  ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕੀਮ ਅਪਾਰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, please be Merciful to me, God, that my mind may follow Your Pathforever. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh kirpaa keejai man sad aa chalai t ayrai maarag. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: This opportunity, this glorious greatness, this blessing and wealth, come by greatgood fortune.
lines.transliteration: ayho var ayhaa vadi-aa-ee ih Dhan ho-ay vadbh aagaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੋ ਵਰੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: These pleasures, these delightful enjoyments, come when my mind is attached to theLord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: ayho rang ayho ras bhogaa har charn ee man laagaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਏਹੋ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਾ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My mind is attached to God's Feet; I seek His Sanctuary. He is the Creator, the Causeof causes, the Cherisher of the world.
lines.transliteration: man laagaa charnay parabh  kee sarn ay karan  kaaran  gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਚਰਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੇ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Everything is Yours; You are my God, O my Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tayraa t oo parabh  mayraa mayray th aakur d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am worthless, O my Beloved, ocean of peace. In the Saints' Congregation, my mind is awakened.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun pareet am sukh  saagar sat sang man jaagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, God has been Merciful to me; my mind is attached to His Lotus Feet.||4||3||6|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (781-12) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh kirpaa keenHee charan  kamal man laagaa. ||4||3||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's Temple has been built; the Saints and devoteessing the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: har japay har mandar saaji-aa sant  bhagat gun gaavahi raam.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of God, their Lord and Master, they discardand renounce all their sins.
lines.transliteration: simar simar su-aamee parabh apnaa saglay paap t ajaaveh raam.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme status is obtained. The Word ofGod's Bani is sublime and exalted.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay param pad  paa-i-aa parabh  kee oot am ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਪੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God's Sermon is so very sweet. It brings celestial peace. It is to speak the UnspokenSpeech.
lines.transliteration: sahj kathaa parabh kee at  meeth ee kathee akath kahaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਵਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The time and the moment were auspicious, blessed and true, when the eternalfoundation of this Temple was placed.
lines.transliteration: bhalaa sanjog moorat  pal saachaa abichal neev rakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; with all His powers, He has blessed me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak parabh bh a-ay d a-i-aalaa sarab kalaa ban  aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਕਥਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਅਿਤ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਕਥੀ ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The sounds of ecstasy vibrate through me continuously. I have enshrined theSupreme Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: aanandaa vajeh nit  vaajay paarbarahm man vooth aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਅਿਬਚਲ  ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, my lifestyle is excellent and true; my false hopes and doubts aredispelled.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhay sach karn ee saaree binsay bh aram bh ai jhoothaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh chants the Bani of the unstruck melody; hearing it, listening to it, mymind and body are rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: anhad ban ee gurmukh  vakh aanee jas sun  sun man t an hari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦਾ  ਵਜਿਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਵਾਜੇ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: All pleasures are obtained, by that one whom God makes His Own.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa t is hee ban  aa-ay jo parabh  apnaa kari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ  ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰੀ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੈ ਝੂਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Within the home of the heart are the nine treasures, filled to overflowing. He hasfallen in love with the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh nav niDh  bharay bh andaaraa raam naam rang laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ਜਸੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak shall never forget God; his destiny is perfectly fulfilled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak jan parabh kad ay na visrai pooran jaa kay bh aagaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਬਿਣ ਆਏ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪਨਾ  ਕਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: God, the King, has given me shade under His canopy, and the fire of desire has beentotally extinguished.
lines.transliteration: chhaa-i-aa parabh  chhatarpat keenHee saglee t apat binaasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: The home of sorrow and sin has been demolished, and all affairs have been resolved.
lines.transliteration: dookh  paap kaa dayraa dh aathaa kaaraj aa-i-aa raasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the Lord God so commands, misfortune is averted; true righteousness, Dharma and charity flourish. pMnw 782
lines.transliteration: har parabh furmaa-i-aa mitee balaa-i-aa saach Dh aram punn fali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ਿਮਟੀ  ਬਲਾਇਆ  ਸਾਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ  ਪੁੰਨੁ ਫਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate forever on your God, when you sleep and sit and stand.
lines.transliteration: so parabh apunaa sad aa Dh i-aa-ee-ai sovat  baisat  khali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸੋਵਤ  ਬੈਸਤ ਖਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master is the treasure of virtue, the ocean of peace; He pervades the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan sukh  saagar su-aamee jal thal mahee-al so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary; there is no other than Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak parabh kee sarn aa-ee t is bin avar na ko-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My home is made, the garden and pool are made, and my Sovereign Lord God hasmet me.
lines.transliteration: mayraa ghar bani-aa ban t aal bani-aa parabh  parsay har raa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਬਿਨਆ  ਬਨੁ ਤਾਲੁ  ਬਿਨਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰਸੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My mind is adorned, and my friends rejoice; I sing the songs of joy, and the GloriousPraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man sohi-aa meet saajan sarsay gun  mangal har gaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਿਹਆ  ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ  ਸਰਸੇ  ਗੁਣ ਮੰਗਲ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord God, all desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay parabh oo Dh i-aa-ay saachaa sagal ichh aa paa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਧਆਇ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ  ਪਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are attached to the Guru's Feet are always awake and aware; His Praises resound and resonate through their minds.
lines.transliteration: gur charan laagay sad aa jaagay man vajee-aa vaaDh aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ  ਮਿਨ ਵਜੀਆ  ਵਾਧਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master, the bringer of peace, has blessed me with His Grace; He hasarranged this world, and the world hereafter for me.
lines.transliteration: karee nadar su-aamee sukh ah gaamee halat  palat  savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਖਹ  ਗਾਮੀ ਹਲਤੁ  ਪਲਤੁ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever; He is the Support of thebody and soul. ||4||4||7|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (782-7) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak nit  naam japee-ai jee-o pind jin Dh aari-aa. ||4||4||7||

lines.english: The terrifying world-ocean, the terrifying world-ocean - I have crossed over it,meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: bhai saagro bh ai saagar t ari-aa har har naam Dh i-aa-ay raam.

lines.english: I worship and adore the Lord's Feet, the boat to carry me across. Meeting the TrueGuru, I am carried over.
lines.transliteration: bohithrhaa har charan  araaDh ay mil sat gur paar lagh aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੋ  ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I cross over, and I shall not die again; mycomings and goings are ended.
