lines.transliteration: gur sabdee t aree-ai bahurh  na maree-ai chookai aavan  jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਿਹਥੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਅਰਾਧੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲਘਾਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Whatever He does, I accept as good, and my mind merges in celestial peace.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so-ee bh al maan-o t aa man sahj samaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਮਰੀਐ  ਚੂਕੈ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Neither pain, nor hunger, nor disease afflicts me. I have found the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace.
lines.transliteration: dookh  na bh ookh na rog na bi-aapai sukh  saagar sarn ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ  ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Nanak is imbued with His Love;his mind's anxieties are dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har simar simar naanak rang raataa man kee chint  mitaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The humble Saints have implanted the Lord's Mantra within me, and the Lord, myBest Friend, has come under my power.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa har mant ar drirh -aa-i-aa har saajan vasgat  keenay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਚੰਤ  ਿਮਟਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have dedicated my mind to my Lord and Master, and offered it to Him, and He hasblessed me with everything.
lines.transliteration: aapnarhaa man aagai Dh ari-aa sarbas th aakur d eenay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਜਨ  ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He has made me His hand-maiden and slave; my sadness is dispelled, and in theLord's Temple, I have found stability.
lines.transliteration: kar apunee daasee mitee ud aasee har mand ar thit  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨੜਾ  ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਧਿਰਆ  ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਦੀਨੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My joy and bliss are in meditating on my True God; I shall never be separated fromHim again.
lines.transliteration: anad binod  simrahu parabh  saachaa vichh urh kabhoo na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਦਾਸੀ ਿਮਟੀ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਿਥਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: She alone is very fortunate, and a true soul-bride, who contemplates the GloriousVision of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: saa vadbhaagan  sadaa sohagan  raam naam gun  cheenHay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am imbued with His Love, drenched in the supreme, sublime essence ofHis Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak raveh rang raatay paraym mahaa ras bh eenay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਿਣ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨੇ ॥
lines.english: I am in continual bliss and ecstasy, O my companions; I sing the songs of joy forever.
lines.transliteration: anad binod  bha-ay nit  sakhee-ay mangal sad aa hamaarai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਵਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਿਸ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: God Himself has embellished her, and she has become His virtuous soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: aapnarhai parabh  aap seegaaree sobh aavant ee naaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਭਏ ਿਨਤ ਸਖੀਏ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਸਦਾ ਹਮਾਰੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: With natural ease, He has become Merciful to her. He does not consider her merits or demerits.
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay bh a-ay kirpaalaa gun  avgan  na beechaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨੜੈ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਸੀਗਾਰੀ  ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ  ਨਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He hugs His humble servants close in His Loving Embrace; they enshrine the Lord'sName in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: kanth lagaa-ay lee-ay jan apunay raam naam ur Dh aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ  ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone is engrossed in arrogant pride, attachment and intoxication; in His Mercy,He has freed me of them.
lines.transliteration: maan moh mad sagal bi-aapee kar kirpaa aap nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਿਠ ਲਗਾਇ  ਲੀਏ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, and all my affairs areperfectly resolved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhai saagar t ari-aa pooran kaaj hamaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਆਪੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the World-Lord, O my companions; all yourwishes shall be granted.
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal gaavhu nit  sakheeho sagal manorath paa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਜ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Life becomes fruitful, meeting with the Holy Saints, and meditating on the One God,the Creator of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: safal janam ho-aa mil saaDhoo aykankaar Dh i-aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗਾਵਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਸਖੀਹੋ  ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Chant, and meditate on the One God, who permeates and pervades the many beings of the whole Universe.
lines.transliteration: jap ayk parabhoo anayk ravi-aa sarab mandal chh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God created it, and God spreads through it everywhere. Everywhere I look, I see God.
lines.transliteration: barahmo pasaaraa barahm pasri-aa sabh barahm d aristee aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਏਕ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਅਨੇਕ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਮੰਡਿਲ  ਛਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no place without Him. pMnw 783
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poor pooran tis binaa nahee jaa-ay.

lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, Nanak has blossomed forth; the Lord has united him in Union. ||4||5||8|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (783-1) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paykh d arsan naanak bigsay aap la-ay milaa-ay. ||4||5||8||

lines.english: Eternal and immovable is the City of God and Guru; chanting His Name, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: abichal nagar gobind guroo kaa naam japat  sukh  paa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires; the Creator Himself established it.
lines.transliteration: man ichhay say-ee fal paa-ay kart ai aap vasaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਚਲ  ਨਗਰੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself established it. I have found total peace; my children, siblings andSikhs have all blossomed forth in bliss.
lines.transliteration: kartai aap vasaa-i-aa sarab sukh  paa-i-aa put  bhaa-ee sikh  bigaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਸਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, my affairs have come to be resolved.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi pooran parmaysur kaaraj aa-i-aa raasay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਸਾਇਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਿਸਖ ਿਬਗਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself is my Lord and Master. He Himself is my Saving Grace; He Himself is myfather and mother.
lines.transliteration: parabh aap su-aamee aapay rakh aa aap pit aa aap maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ  ਰਾਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has embellished and adorned thisplace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak satgur balihaaree jin ayhu thaan suhaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਖਾ ਆਿਪ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Homes, mansions, stores and markets are beautiful, when the Lord's Name abideswithin.
lines.transliteration: ghar mand ar hatnaalay sohay jis vich naam nivaasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saints and devotees worship the Lord's Name in adoration, and the noose ofDeath is cut away.
lines.transliteration: sant bh agat har naam araaDh eh katee-ai jam kee faasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਹਟਨਾਲੇ  ਸੋਹੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The noose of Death is cut away, meditating on the Name of the Eternal, UnchangingLord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: kaatee jam faasee parabh abh inaasee har har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਹ  ਕਟੀਐ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Everything is perfect for them, and they obtain the fruits of their mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree pooran ho-ee man ichhay fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਟੀ  ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints and friends enjoy peace and pleasure; their pain, suffering and doubts aredispelled.
lines.transliteration: sant sajan sukh  maan eh ralee-aa d ookh darad bharam naasee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has embellished them with the Word of the Shabad; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabad savaaray sat gur poorai naanak sad  bal jaasee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ  ਸੁਿਖ ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਰਲੀਆ  ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The gift of our Lord and Master is perfect; it increases day by day.
lines.transliteration: daat khasam kee pooree ho-ee nit  nit charh ai savaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਸੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has made me His own; His Glorious Greatness is so great!
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm khasmaanaa kee-aa jis d ee vadee vadi-aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਿਤ  ਖਸਮ  ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਿਨਤ ਿਨਤ  ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Protector of Hisdevotees; God has become merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  bhagtan kaa raakh aa so parabh  bha-i-aa d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਖਸਮਾਨਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਿਜਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures now dwell in peace; God Himself cherishes and cares forthem.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  sukh ee vasaa-ay parabh  aapay kar part ipaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਭਇਆ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Praises of the Lord and Master are totally pervading in the ten directions; I cannotexpress His worth.
lines.transliteration: dah d is poor rahi-aa jas su-aamee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਏ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has laid this eternal foundation.||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak satgur balihaaree jin abichal neev rakh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The spiritual wisdom and meditation of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and theSermon of the Lord, Har, Har, are continually heard there.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan pooran parmaysur har har kathaa nit  sunee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਜਿਨ ਅਿਬਚਲ  ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The devotees of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, play endlessly there, and the unstruck melody resounds and vibrates there.
lines.transliteration: anhad choj bh agat bhav bh anjan anhad  vaajay Dh unee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਿਨਤ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The unstruck melody resounds and resonates, and the Saints contemplate the essenceof reality; this discourse is their daily routine.
lines.transliteration: anhad jh unkaaray t at beechaaray sant  gosat nit  hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ ਚੋਜ ਭਗਤ  ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They worship the Lord's Name, and all their filth is washed away; they rid themselvesof all sins.
lines.transliteration: har naam araaDheh mail sabh  kaateh kilvikh  saglay kh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ਸੰਤ ਗੋਸਿਟ  ਿਨਤ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going, and no entering into the wombof reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: tah janam na marn aa aavan  jaanaa bahurh  na paa-ee-ai jonee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਹ  ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਟਿਹ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the Guru, the Transcendent Lord; by His Grace, desires are fulfilled.||4||6||9|| sUhI mhlw 5 ] (783-15) soohee mehlaa 5. Soohee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur parmaysar paa-i-aa jis parsaad ichh  punee-ai. ||4||6||9||

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ  ਨ ਮਰਣਾ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਨੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself has stood up to resolve the affairs of the Saints; He has come tocomplete their tasks.
lines.transliteration: santaa kay kaaraj aap kh alo-i-aa har kamm karaavan  aa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀਐ  ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
lines.english: Dharat  suhaavee t aal suhaavaa vich amrit  jal chh aa-i-aa raam. The land is beautiful, and the pool is beautiful; within it is contained the AmbrosialWater.
The Ambrosial Water is filling it, and my job is perfectly complete; all my desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: amrit jal chh aa-i-aa pooran saaj karaa-i-aa sagal manorath pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਿਜ  ਆਿਪ  ਖਲੋਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਵਿਣ  ਆਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Congratulations are pouring in from all over the world; all my sorrows are eliminated.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar bha-i-aa jag ant ar laathay sagal visooray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਤਾਲੁ  ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਿਵਿਚ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing the Praises of the Perfect, Unchanging,Imperishable Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: pooran purakh achut  abhinaasee jas vayd  puraan ee gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Transcendent Lord has kept His promise, and confirmed His nature; Nanakmeditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnaa birad rakh i-aa parmaysar naanak naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਭਇਆ  ਜਗ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲਾਥੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਵਸੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator has given me the nine treasures, wealth and spiritual powers, and I do not lack anything. pMnw 784
lines.transliteration: nav niDh siDh  riDh deenay kart ay tot na aavai kaa-ee raam.

lines.english: Eating, spending and enjoying, I have found peace; the gifts of the Creator Lord continually increase.
lines.transliteration: khaat  kharchat  bilchh at sukh  paa-i-aa kart ay kee d aat savaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ  ਿਬਲਛਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਸਵਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: His gifts increase and shall never be exhausted; I have found the Inner-knower, theSearcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: daat savaa-ee nikh ut na jaa-ee ant arjaamee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਿਤ  ਸਵਾਈ ਿਨਖੁਿਟ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of obstacles have all been removed, and pain does not even approach me.
lines.transliteration: kot bighan saglay uth  naath ay dookh na nayrh ai aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਿਬਘਨ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਉਿਠ ਨਾਠੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Tranquility, peace, poise and bliss in abundance prevail, and all my hunger is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj aanand  ghanayray binsee bh ookh sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਿਬਨਸੀ  ਭੂਖ ਸਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master, whose Glorious Greatness is wonderful and amazing. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak gun gaavahi su-aamee kay achraj jis vadi-aa-ee raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਿਜਸੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: It was His job, and He has done it; what can the mere mortal being do?
lines.transliteration: jis kaa kaaraj tin hee kee-aa maan as ki-aa vaychaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ  ਮਾਣਸੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਵੇਚਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The devotees are adorned, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they proclaim Hiseternal victory.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sohan har kay gun  gaavahi sad aa karahi jaikaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਜੈਕਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, bliss wells up, and we arefriends with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay gobind  anad  upjay saaDh sangat  sang banee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਅਨਦ  ਉਪਜੇ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.english: He who made the effort to construct this sacred pool - how can his praises berecounted?
lines.transliteration: jin udam kee-aa t aal kayraa t is kee upmaa ki-aa ganee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਦਮੁ  ਕੀਆ ਤਾਲ  ਕੇਰਾ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The merits of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, charity, good deeds andimmaculate lifestyle, are found in this sacred pool.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath punn kiri-aa mahaa nirmal chaaraa.

lines.english: It is the natural way of the Lord and Master to purify sinners; Nanak takes theSupport of the Word of the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: patit paavan birad  su-aamee naanak sabad  aDhaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦ  ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The treasure of virtue is my God, the Creator Lord; what Praises of Yours should I sing, O Lord?
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan mayraa parabh  kartaa ust at ka-un kareejai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The prayer of the Saints is, "O Lord and Master, please bless us with the supreme,sublime essence of Your Name."
lines.transliteration: santaa kee baynant ee su-aamee naam mahaa ras d eejai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Please, grant us Your Name, grant us this blessing, and do not forget us, even for aninstant.
lines.transliteration: naam deejai d aan keejai bisar naahee ik kh ino.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਿਬਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਇਕ ਿਖਨੋ ॥
lines.english: Chant the Glorious Praises of the World-Lord, O my tongue; sing them forever, nightand day.
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal uchar rasnaa sad aa gaa-ee-ai and ino.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਉਚਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਦਾ ਗਾਈਐ  ਅਨਿਦਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: One who enshrines love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord, his mind and body aredrenched with Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: jis pareet laagee naam sayt ee man t an amrit  bheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਨਾਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, my desires have been fulfilled; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of theLord, I live. ||4||7||10|| rwgu sUhI mhlw 5 CMq  (784-11) raag soohee mehlaa 5 chhant Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (784-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak ichh  punnee paykh  darsan jeejai. ||4||7||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਪੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦॥
lines.english: My Dear Lord and Master, my Friend, speaks so sweetly.
lines.transliteration: mith bolrh aa jee har sajan  su-aamee moraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਛੰਤ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I have grown weary of testing Him, but still, He never speaks harshly to me.
lines.transliteration: ha-o sammal thakee jee oh kaday na bolai ka-uraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਠ ਬੋਲੜਾ  ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: He does not know any bitter words; the Perfect Lord God does not even consider my faults and demerits.
lines.transliteration: ka-urhaa bol na jaanai pooran bh agvaanai a-ugan  ko na chit aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸੰਮਿਲ  ਥਕੀ ਜੀ ਓਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਉਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: It is the Lord's natural way to purify sinners; He does not overlook even an iota ofservice.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan har birad  sadaa-ay ik t il nahee bh annai gh aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉੜਾ  ਬੋਿਲ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਗਵਾਨੈ  ਅਉਗਣੁ  ਕੋ ਨ ਿਚਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells in each and every heart, pervading everywhere; He is the nearest of thenear.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at vaasee sarab nivaasee nayrai hee t ay nayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਸਦਾਏ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਭੰਨੈ ਘਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks His Sanctuary forever; the Lord is my Ambrosial Friend. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa sarn aagat  har amrit  sajan  mayraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਨੇਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the incomparable Blessed Vision of the Lord'sDarshan.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bisam bha-ee jee har d arsan d aykh apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Dear Lord and Master is so beautiful; I am the dust of His Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: mayraa sundar su-aamee jee ha-o charan kamal pag chh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਬਸਮੁ  ਭਈ ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon God, I live, and I am at peace; no one else is as great as He is.
lines.transliteration: parabh paykh at jeevaa th adhee theevaa t is jayvad avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜੀ ਹਉ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਪਗ ਛਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Present at the beginning, end and middle of time, He pervades the sea, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: aad ant  maDh  parabh  ravi-aa jal thal mahee-al so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੇਖਤ  ਜੀਵਾ  ਠੰਢੀ ਥੀਵਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on His Lotus Feet, I have crossed over the sea, the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jap saagar tari-aa bh avjal ut ray paaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਮਿਧ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਜਿਲ ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord; You have no end orlimitation, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pooran parmaysur t ayraa ant  na paaraavaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਜਿਪ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਭਵਜਲ  ਉਤਰੇ  ਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I shall not forsake, even for an instant, my Dear Beloved Lord, the Support of thebreath of life.
lines.transliteration: ha-o nimakh na chh odaa jee har pareet am paraan aDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, has instructed me in the contemplation of the True,Inaccessible Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur kahi-aa jee saachaa agam beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the humble, Holy Saint, I obtained the Naam, the Name of the Lord, andthe pains of birth and death left me.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo d eenaa t aa naam leenaa janam maran  dukh naath ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਕਿਹਆ  ਜੀ ਸਾਚਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: I have been blessed with peace, poise and abundant bliss, and the knot of egotism has been untied. pMnw 785
lines.transliteration: sahj sookh aanand  ghanayray ha-umai binth ee gaath ay.

lines.english: He is inside all, and outside of all; He is untouched by love or hate.
lines.transliteration: sabh kai maDh  sabh  hoo t ay baahar raag d okh tay ni-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਿਧ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਿਨਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe; the Beloved Lord is the Support of the mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak daas gobind  sarnaa-ee har pareet am maneh saDh aaro. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਧਾਰੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I searched and searched, and found the immovable, unchanging home of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai khojat  khojat jee har nihchal so gh ar paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਜੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen that everything is transitory and perishable, and so I have linked myconsciousness to the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh aDh ruv dith ay jee-o t aa charan kamal chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਅਧਰ੍ੁਵ  ਿਡਠੇ ਜੀਉ  ਤਾ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: God is eternal and unchanging, and I am just His hand-maiden; He does not die, orcome and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: parabh abh inaasee ha-o t is kee d aasee marai na aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਹਉ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Dharam arath kaam sabh  pooran man chind ee ichh  pujaa-ay. He is overflowing with Dharmic faith, wealth  and success; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਅਰਥ  ਕਾਮ ਸਿਭ ਪੂਰਨ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਦੀ  ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Vedas and the Simritees sing the Praises of the Creator, while the Siddhas,seekers and silent sages meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: sarut simrit  gun gaavahi kart ay siDh  saaDh ik mun jan Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੁਿਤ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, the treasure of mercy; bygreat good fortune, he sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||11|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (785-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: vwr sUhI kI slokw nwil mhlw 3 ] (785-6) vaar soohee kee salokaa naal mehlaa 3. Vaar Of Soohee, With Shaloks Of The Third Mehl: sloku mÚ 3 ] (785-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran kirpaa niDh su-aamee vadbh aagee har har gaa-i-aa. ||4||1||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
lines.english: In her red robes, the discarded bride goes out, seeking enjoyment with another'shusband.
lines.transliteration: soohai vays duhaagan ee par pir raavan  jaa-ay.

lines.english: She leaves the husband of her own home, enticed by her love of duality.
lines.transliteration: pir chhodi-aa gh ar aapn ai mohee d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰ ਸੂਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਲੋਕਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ॥
lines.english: She finds it sweet, and eats it up; her excessive sensuality only makes her diseaseworse.
lines.transliteration: mithaa kar kai kh aa-i-aa baho saad ahu vaDh i-aa rog.

lines.english: She forsakes the Lord, her sublime Husband, and then later, she suffers the pain ofseparation from Him.
lines.transliteration: suDh bh ataar har chh odi-aa fir lagaa jaa-ay vijog.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਿਸ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਰ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵਣ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But she who becomes Gurmukh, turns away from corruption and adorns herself,attuned to the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so palti-aa har raat ee saaj seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She enjoys her celestial Husband Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within herheart.
lines.transliteration: sahj sach pir raavi-aa har naamaa ur Dhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਠਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ  ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਵਿਧਆ  ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: She is humble and obedient; she is His virtuous bride forever; the Creator unites her with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aakaaree sadaa sohagan  aap maylee kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਲਗਾ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she who has obtained the True Lord as her husband, is a happy soul-brideforever. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (785-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pir paa-i-aa har saachaa sadaa sohagan  naar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਲਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਿਜ  ਸੀਗਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O meek, red-robed bride, keep your Husband Lord always in your thoughts.
lines.transliteration: soohvee-ay nimaanee-ay so saho sad aa samHaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਚੁ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਿਵਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, your life shall be embellished, and your generations shall be saved alongwith you. ||2|| pauVI ] (785-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak janam savaareh aapnaa kul bh ee chh utee naal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਗਆਕਾਰੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਗਿਣ ਆਿਪ  ਮੇਲੀ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself established His throne, in the Akaashic ethers and the nether worlds.
lines.transliteration: aapay takh at rachaa-i-on aakaas pat aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the earth, the true home of Dharma.
lines.transliteration: hukmay Dhart ee saajee-an sachee Dh aram saalaa.

lines.english: He Himself created and destroys; He is the True Lord, merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay khapaa-id aa sachay d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: You give sustenance to all; how wonderful and unique is the Hukam of Your Command!
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa rijak sambaahid aa tayraa hukam niraalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਰਿਹ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself are permeating and pervading; You Yourself are the Cherisher. ||1|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (785-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay aap varatdaa aapay part ipaalaa. ||1||

lines.english: The red-robed woman becomes a happy soul-bride, only when she accepts the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: soohab taa sohaagan ee jaa man laihi sach naa-o.

lines.english: Become pleasing to your True Guru, and you shall be totally beautified; otherwise,there is no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: satgur apn aa manaa-ay lai roop charh ee taa aglaa d oojaa naahee thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮ  ਸਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: So decorate yourself with the decorations that will never stain, and love the Lord dayand night.
lines.transliteration: aisaa seegaar banaa-ay t oo mailaa kad ay na hova-ee ahinis laagai bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ  ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, what is the character of the happy soul-bride? Within her, is Truth; her faceis bright and radiant, and she is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (785-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sohagan kaa ki-aa chihan hai and ar sach mukh  ujlaa kh asmai maahi samaa- ay. ||1||

lines.english: O people: I am in red, dressed in a red robe.
lines.transliteration: lokaa vay ha-o soohvee soohaa vays karee.

lines.english: But my Husband Lord is not obtained by any robes; I have tried and tried, and givenup wearing robes.
lines.transliteration: vaysee saho na paa-ee-ai kar kar vays rahee.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone obtain their Husband Lord, who listen to the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: naanak tinee saho paa-i-aa jinee gur kee sikh  sunee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹਬ  ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਜਾ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈਿਹ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, happens. In this way, the Husband Lord is met. ||2|| pMnw 786 pauVI ] (786-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai in biDh  kant milee. ||2||

lines.english: By His Command, He created the creation, the world with its many species of beings.
lines.transliteration: hukmee sarisat saajee-an baho bhit  sansaaraa.

lines.english: I do not know how great Your Command is, O Unseen and Infinite True Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayraa hukam na jaapee kayt -rhaa sachay alakh  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ  ਕੇਤੜਾ  ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You join some with Yourself; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: iknaa no too mayl laihi gur sabad  beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are immaculate and pure; they conquer egotism and corruption.
lines.transliteration: sach ratay say nirmalay ha-umai t aj vikaaraa.

lines.english: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself; he alone is true. ||2|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (786-3) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis too mayleh so t uDh milai so-ee sachi-aaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਚਆਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O red-robed woman, the whole world is red, engrossed in evil-mindedness and thelove of duality.
lines.transliteration: soohvee-ay soohaa sabh sansaar hai jin d urmat  doojaa bh aa-o.

lines.english: In an instant, this falsehood totally vanishes; like the shade of a tree, it is gone.
lines.transliteration: khin meh jh ooth sabh  binas jaa-ay ji-o tikai na birakh  kee chh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ  ਸੂਹਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is the deepest crimson of crimson, dyed in the permanent color of theLord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh laalo laal hai ji-o rang majeeth  sachrh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਜਉ  ਿਟਕੈ ਨ ਿਬਰਖ  ਕੀ ਛਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: She turns away from Maya, and enters the celestial home of the Lord; the AmbrosialName of the Lord dwells within her mind.
lines.transliteration: ultee sakat sivai gh ar aa-ee man vasi-aa har amrit  naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਾਲੋ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਉ ਰੰਿਗ ਮਜੀਠ  ਸਚੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; meeting Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of theLord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (786-6) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak balihaaree gur aapnay jit  mili-ai har gun  gaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਲਟੀ  ਸਕਿਤ  ਿਸਵੈ ਘਿਰ  ਆਈ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The red color is vain and useless; it cannot help you obtain your Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: soohaa rang vikaar hai kant na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This color does not take long to fade; she who loves duality, ends up a widow.
lines.transliteration: is lahday bilam na hova-ee rand baith ee doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: She who loves to wear her red dress is foolish and double-minded.
lines.transliteration: munDh i-aan ee dummn ee soohai vays lobh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: So make the True Word of the Shabad your red dress, and let the Fear of God, and the Love of God, be your ornaments and decorations.
lines.transliteration: sabad sachai rang laal kar bh ai bhaa-ay seegaar ban aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਲਹਦੇ  ਿਬਲਮ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever, who walks in harmony with the Will of theTrue Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (786-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaagan ee je chalan sat gur bh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ  ਦੁੰਮਣੀ  ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਿਸ ਲਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself created Himself, and He Himself evaluates Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap upaa-i-an aap keemat paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਕਿਰ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His limits cannot be known; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He isunderstood.
lines.transliteration: tis daa ant  na jaap-ee gur sabad  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜ ਚਲਿਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the darkness of attachment to Maya, the world wanders in duality.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh gubaar hai doojai bh armaa-ee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest; they continue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: manmukh th a-ur na paa-inHee fir aavai jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਆਿਪ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, that alone happens. All walk according to His Will. ||3|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (786-11) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai sabh  chalai rajaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The red-robed bride is vicious; she forsakes God, and cultivates love for another man.
lines.transliteration: soohai vays kaaman kulkh anee jo parabh  chhod par purakh  Dharay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: She has neither modesty or self-discipline; the self-willed manmukh constantly tells lies, and is ruined by the bad karma of evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: os seel na sanjam sadaa jh ooth bolai manmukh  karam kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: She who has such pre-ordained destiny, obtains the True Guru has her Husband.
lines.transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhi-aa t is satgur milai bh ataar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: She discards all her red dresses, and wears the ornaments of mercy and forgivenessaround her neck.
lines.transliteration: soohaa vays sabh ut aar Dh aray gal pahirai kh imaa seegaar.

lines.english: In this world and the next, she receives great honor, and the whole world worshipsher.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-ai saahurai baho sobhaa paa-ay t is pooj karay sabh  saisaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਿਸ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਕੁਲਖਣੀ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਛੋਿਡ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ  ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: She who is enjoyed by her Creator Lord stands out, and does not blend in with thecrowd.
lines.transliteration: oh ralaa-ee kisai dee naa ralai jis raavay sirjanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸੁ ਸੀਲੁ  ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਦਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is the happy soul-bride forever; she has the Imperishable LordGod as her Husband. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (786-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sad aa suhaagan ee jis avinaasee purakh  bhartaar. ||1||

lines.english: The red color is like a dream in the night; it is like a necklace without a string.
lines.transliteration: soohaa rang supnai nisee bin taagay gal haar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਤਾਿਰ  ਧਰੇ ਗਿਲ  ਪਿਹਰੈ  ਿਖਮਾ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs take on the permanent color, contemplating the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sachaa rang majeeth kaa gurmukh  barahm beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਈਐ  ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਿਤਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, with the supreme sublime essence of the Lord's Love, all sins and evil deedsare turned to ashes. ||2|| pauVI ] (786-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak paraym mahaa rasee sabh buri-aa-ee-aa chh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਰਲਾਈ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਿਸਰਜਨਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created this world, and staged this wondrous play.
lines.transliteration: ih jag aap upaa-i-on kar choj vidaan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਭਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Into the body of the five elements, He infused attachment, falsehood and self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: panch Dhaat  vich paa-ee-an moh jh ooth gumaan.

lines.english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh comes and goes, wandering in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aavai jaa-ay bhavaa-ee-ai manmukh  agi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਿਨਸੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ  ਗਿਲ  ਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself teaches some to become Gurmukh, through the spiritual wisdom of theLord.
lines.transliteration: iknaa aap bujhaa-i-on gurmukh  har gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ  ਕਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (786-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  khajaanaa bakh si-on har naam niDh aan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੀ ਸਿਭ ਬੁਿਰਆਈਆ  ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O red-robed woman, discard your red dress, and then, you shall come to love your Husband Lord. pMnw 787
lines.transliteration: soohvee-ay soohaa vays chhad t oo taa pir lagee pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਛਿਡ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਿਪਰ ਲਗੀ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By wearing her red dress, no one has found her Husband Lord; the self-willed manmukh is burnt to death.
lines.transliteration: soohai vays pir kinai na paa-i-o manmukh d ajh mu-ee gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਿਸ ਿਪਰੁ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਦਿਝ ਮੁਈ ਗਾਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, she discards her red dress, and eradicates egotism fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai soohaa vays ga-i-aa ha-umai vichahu maar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਗਇਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Her mind and body are imbued with the deep red color of His Love, and her tongue isimbued, singing His Praises and excellences.
lines.transliteration: man tan rat aa laal ho-aa rasnaa rat ee gun  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਲਾਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਤੀ ਗੁ ਣ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: She becomes His soul-bride forever, with the Word of the Shabad in her mind; shemakes the Fear of God and the Love of God her ornaments and decorations.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sohagan  sabad  man bh ai bhaa-ay karay seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Merciful Grace, she obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and keeps Him enshrined in her heart. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (787-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak karmee mahal paa-i-aa pir raakhi-aa ur Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਿਖਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O bride, forsake your red dress, and decorate yourself with the crimson color of HisLove.
lines.transliteration: munDhay soohaa parahrahu laal karahu seegaar.

lines.english: Your comings and goings shall be forgotten, contemplating the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa veesrai gur sabd ee veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸੂਹਾ ਪਰਹਰਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਕਰਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride is adorned and beautiful; the Celestial Lord, her Husband, abides in herhome.
lines.transliteration: munDh suhaavee sohn ee jis gh ar sahj bh ataar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the bride ravishes and enjoys Him; and He, the Ravisher, ravishes andenjoys her. ||2|| pauVI ] (787-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan raavee-ai raavay ravan haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸੋਹਣੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਘਿਰ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is engrossed in false attachment to family.
lines.transliteration: moh koorh kutamb hai manmukh  mugaDh  rataa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਐ  ਰਾਵੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Practicing egotism and self-conceit, he dies and departs, taking nothing along with him.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa kar mu-ay kichh saath na lit aa.

lines.english: He does not understand that the Messenger of Death is hovering over his head; he isdeluded by duality.
lines.transliteration: sir upar jamkaal na sujh-ee d oojai bh armitaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਰਤਾ ॥
lines.english: This opportunity will not come into his hands again; the Messenger of Death will seizehim.
lines.transliteration: fir vaylaa hath na aavee jamkaal vas kitaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਮੁਏ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਿਲਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||5|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (787-8) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jayhaa Dhur likh  paa-i-on say karam kamit aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰ ਉਪਿਰ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Do not call them 'satee', who burn themselves along with their husbands' corpses.
lines.transliteration: satee-aa ayhi na aakh ee-an jo marh i-aa lag jalaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ ਵੇਲਾ  ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ਵਿਸ ਿਕਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they alone are known as 'satee', who die from the shock of separation. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (787-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satee-aa jaan ee-aniH je birhay chot maraNniH. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹਾ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਿਮਤਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They are also known as 'satee', who abide in modesty and contentment.
lines.transliteration: bhee so sat ee-aa jaan ee-an seel sant okh rahaNniH.

lines.english: They serve their Lord, and rise in the early hours to contemplate Him. ||2|| mÚ 3 ] (787-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sayvan saa-ee aapnaa nit  uth samHaalaNniH. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੀਆ  ਏਿਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਨ  ਜੋ ਮਿੜਆ  ਲਿਗ  ਜਲੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: The widows burn themselves in the fire, along with their husbands' corpses.
lines.transliteration: kantaa naal mahaylee-aa sayt ee ag jalaahi.

lines.english: If they truly knew their husbands, then they suffer terrible bodily pain.
lines.transliteration: jay jaaneh pir aapn aa taa tan dukh sahaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, if they did not truly know their husbands, why should they burn themselvesin the fire?
lines.transliteration: naanak kant na jaan nee say ki-o ag jalaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੀਆ  ਜਾਣੀਅਿਨ  ਸੀਲ  ਸੰਤੋਿਖ ਰਹੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Whether their husbands are alive or dead, those wives remain far away from them.||3|| pauVI ] (787-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhaavai jeeva-o kai mara-o Dh oorahu hee bh aj jaahi. ||3||

lines.english: You created pain along with pleasure; O Creator, such is the writ You have written.
lines.transliteration: tuDh dukh sukh  naal upaa-i-aa laykh  kartai likh i-aa.

lines.english: There is no other gift as great as the Name; it has no form or sign.
lines.transliteration: naavai jayvad hor daat  naahee t is roop na rikh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਤਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਮਹੇਲੀਆ  ਸੇਤੀ ਅਿਗ ਜਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an inexhaustible treasure; it abides in the mind of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: naam akhut niDh aan hai gurmukh  man vasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਪਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: In His Mercy, He blesses us with the Naam, and then, the writ of pain and pleasure isnot written.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naam dayvsee fir laykh  na likh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਸੇ ਿਕਉ  ਅਿਗ  ਜਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble servants who serve with love, meet the Lord, chanting the Chant of theLord. ||6|| sloku mÚ 2 ] (787-15) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sayvak bhaa-ay say jan milay jin har jap japi-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਉ  ਕੈ ਮਰਉ  ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਭਿਜ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They know that they will have to depart, so why do they make such ostentatiousdisplays?
lines.transliteration: jinee chalan jaan i-aa say ki-o karahi vithaar.

lines.english: Those who do not know that they will have to depart, continue to arrange theiraffairs. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (787-16) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chalan saar na jaan nee kaaj savaaran haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਲੇਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: He accumulates wealth during the night of his life, but in the morning, he mustdepart.
lines.transliteration: raat kaaran  Dhan sanchee-ai bh alkay chalan  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡ  ਹੋਰ ਦਾਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਿਰਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it shall not go along with him, and so he regrets. ||2|| mÚ 2 ] (787-17) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naal na chal-ee fir pachhut aavaa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: Paying a fine under pressure, does not bring either merit or goodness.
lines.transliteration: baDhaa chatee jo bh aray naa gun  naa upkaar.

lines.english: That alone is a good deed, O Nanak, which is done by one's own free will. ||3|| mÚ 2 ] (787-18) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saytee kh usee savaaree-ai naanak kaaraj saar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਮਲੇ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਿਪਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Stubborn-mindedness will not win the Lord to one's side, no matter how much it istried.
lines.transliteration: manhath t araf na jip-ee jay bahut aa gh aalay.

lines.english: The Lord is won over to your side, by offering Him your true love, O servant Nanak,and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||4|| pauVI ] (787-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: taraf jin ai sat  bhaa-o d ay jan naanak sabad  veechaaray. ||4||

lines.english: The Creator created the world; He alone understands it.
lines.transliteration: kartai kaaran  jin kee-aa so jaan ai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਣ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself shall destroy it afterwards. pMnw 788
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat upaa-ee-an aapay fun go-ee.

lines.english: All have grown weary of wandering throughout the four ages, but none know the Lord's worth.
lines.transliteration: jug chaaray sabh bh av thakee kin keemat  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਭਿਵ ਥਕੀ ਿਕਿਨ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has shown me the One Lord, and my mind and body are at peace.
lines.transliteration: satgur ayk vikh aali-aa man t an sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਿਵਖਾਿਲਆ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh praises the Lord forever; that alone happens, which the Creator Lorddoes. ||7|| slok mhlw 2 ] (788-2) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa salaahee-ai kart aa karay so ho-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who have the Fear of God, have no other fears; those who do not have theFear of God, are very afraid.
lines.transliteration: jinaa bha-o t inH naahi bh a-o much bh a-o nibh vi-aah.

lines.english: O Nanak, this mystery is revealed at the Court of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (788-3) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayhu patantaraa t it deebaan  ga-i-aah. ||1||

lines.english: That which flows, mingles with that which flows; that which blows, mingles with that which blows.
lines.transliteration: turday ka-o t urdaa milai udt ay ka-o udt aa.

lines.english: The living mingle with the living, and the dead mingle with the dead.
lines.transliteration: jeevtay ka-o jeevt aa milai moo-ay ka-o moo-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, praise the One who created the creation. ||2|| pauVI ] (788-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak so salaahee-ai jin kaaran kee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਰਦੇ  ਕਉ ਤੁਰਦਾ  ਿਮਲੈ ਉਡਤੇ  ਕਉ ਉਡਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the True Lord are true; they contemplate the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sach Dhi-aa-in say sachay gur sabad  veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤੇ  ਕਉ ਜੀਵਤਾ  ਿਮਲੈ ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ॥
lines.english: They subdue their ego, purify their minds, and enshrine the Lord's Name within theirhearts.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar man nirmalaa har naam ur Dhaaree.

lines.english: The fools are attached to their homes, mansions and balconies.
lines.transliteration: kothay mandap maarh ee-aa lag pa-ay gaavaaree.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are caught in darkness; they do not know the One whocreated them.
lines.transliteration: jiniH kee-ay tiseh na jaan nee manmukh  gubaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇਿਨ  ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He alone understands, whom the True Lord causes to understand; what can thehelpless creatures do? ||8|| slok mÚ 3 ] (788-7) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaa-ihi so bujh see sachi-aa ki-aa jant  vichaaree. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O bride, decorate yourself, after you surrender and accept your Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaaman t a-o seegaar kar jaa pahilaaN kant manaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ  ਮਾੜੀਆ  ਲਿਗ  ਪਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Otherwise, your Husband Lord will not come to your bed, and your ornaments will beuseless.
lines.transliteration: mat sayjai kant  na aavee ayvai birthaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: O bride, your decorations will adorn you, only when your Husband Lord's Mind ispleased.
lines.transliteration: kaaman pir man maani-aa t a-o ban i-aa seegaar.

lines.english: Your ornaments will be acceptable and approved, only when your Husband Lord lovesyou.
lines.transliteration: kee-aa ta-o parvaan  hai jaa saho Dh aray pi-aar.

lines.english: So make the Fear of God your ornaments, joy your betel nuts to chew, and love yourfood.
lines.transliteration: bha-o seegaar t abol ras bh ojan bh aa-o karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ ਤਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਜਾ ਪਿਹਲ  ਕੰਤੁ ਮਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Surrender your body and mind to your Husband Lord, and then, O Nanak, He willenjoy you. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (788-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tan man sa-upay kant  ka-o t a-o naanak bh og karay-i. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਏਵੈ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The wife takes flowers, and fragrance of betel, and decorates herself.
lines.transliteration: kaajal fool tambol ras lay Dh an kee-aa seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਪਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਤਉ ਬਿਣਆ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: But her Husband Lord does not come to her bed, and so these efforts are useless. ||2|| mÚ 3 ] (788-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sayjai kant na aa-i-o ayvai bh a-i-aa vikaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਆ  ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhan pir ayhi na aakh ee-an bahan ikth ay ho-ay. They are not said to be husband and wife, who merely sit together.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਤਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are called husband and wife, who have one light in two bodies. ||3|| pauVI ] (788-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ayk jot d u-ay moort ee Dh an pir kahee-ai so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ  ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship, and no love for the Naam,the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhai bin bh agat na hova-ee naam na lagai pi-aar.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, the Fear of Go d wells up, and one is embellished with the Fear and the Love of God.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai bh a-o oopjai bh ai bhaa-ay rang savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਜਲ  ਫੂਲ ਤੰਬੋਲ  ਰਸੁ ਲੇ ਧਨ ਕੀਆ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: When the body and mind are imbued with the Lord's Love, egotism and desire areconquered and subdued.
lines.transliteration: tan man rat aa rang si-o ha-umai t arisnaa maar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਏਵੈ ਭਇਆ  ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The mind and body become immaculately pure and very beautiful, when one meetsthe Lord, the Destroyer of ego.
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal at  sohn aa bh ayti-aa krisan muraar.

lines.english: Fear and love all belong to Him; He is the True Lord, permeating and pervading the Universe. ||9|| slok mÚ 1 ] (788-15) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bha-o bh aa-o sabh  tis daa so sach vart ai sansaar. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਿਪਰੁ ਏਿਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਨ  ਬਹਿਨ  ਇਕਠੇ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! You are wonderful and great, O Lord and Master; You created thecreation, and made us.
lines.transliteration: vaahu khasam t oo vaahu jin rach rachnaa ham kee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਜੋਿਤ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਧਨ ਿਪਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You made the waters, waves, oceans, pools, plants, clouds and mountains.
lines.transliteration: saagar lahar samund sar vayl varas varaahu.

lines.english: You Yourself stand in the midst of what You Yourself created.
lines.transliteration: aap kharh oveh aap kar aapeen ai aapaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The selfless service of the Gurmukhs is approved; in celestial peace, they live theessence of reality.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa thaa-ay pavai unman t at kamaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ  ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਰੰਗੁ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They receive the wages of their labor, begging at the Door of their Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: maskat lahhu majooree-aa mang mang kh asam d araahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Court of the Lord is overflowing and carefree; O my True Carefree Lord,no one returns empty-handed from Your Court. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (788-19) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pur dar vayparvaah t a-o dar oon aa naahi ko sachaa vayparvaahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਅਿਤ  ਸੋਹਣਾ  ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The teeth are like brilliant, beautiful pearls, and the eyes are like sparkling jewels.
lines.transliteration: ujal motee sohn ay rat naa naal jurh ann.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Old age is their enemy, O Nanak; when they grow old, they waste away. ||2|| pMnw 789 pauVI ] (789-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: tin jar vairee naankaa je budh ay thee-ay marann. ||2||

lines.english: Praise the Lord, forever and ever; dedicate your body and mind to Him.
lines.transliteration: har saalaahee sadaa sad aa tan man sa-up sareer.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the True, Profound and Unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee sach paa-i-aa sachaa gahir gambh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਿਪ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the jewel of jewels, is permeating my mind, body and heart.
lines.transliteration: man tan hird ai rav rahi-aa har heeraa heer.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚਾ ਗਿਹਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death are gone, and I shall never again be consigned to thecycle of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa d ukh ga-i-aa fir pavai na feer.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹੀਰਾ  ਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the ocean of excellence. ||10|| slok mÚ 1 ] (789-3) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too har gun ee gaheer. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਪਵੈ ਨ ਫੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, burn this body; this burnt body has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak ih tan jaal jin jali-ai naam visaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The dirt is piling up, and in the world hereafter, your hand shall not be able to reachdown into this stagnant pond to clean it out. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (789-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pa-udee jaa-ay paraal pichh ai hath na ambrh ai tit nivanDh ai taal. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, wicked are the uncountable actions of the mind.
lines.transliteration: naanak man kay kamm fiti-aa ganat  na aavhee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਿਲ  ਿਜਿਨ ਜਿਲਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: They bring terrible and painful retributions, but if the Lord forgives me, then I will bespared this punishment. ||2|| pauVI ] (789-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kitee lahaa sahamm jaa bakh say taa Dh akaa nahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਦੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਪਰਾਿਲ  ਿਪਛੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਿਨਵੰਧੈ  ਤਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True is the Command He sends forth, and True are the Orders He issues.
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar chalaa-i-on kar sach furmaan.

lines.english: Forever unmoving and unchanging, permeating and pervading everywhere, He is theAll-knowing Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa nihchal rav rahi-aa so purakh  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ ਿਫਿਟਆ  ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਆਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, serve Him, through the True Insignia of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sayvee-ai sach sabad neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਤੀ  ਲਹਾ ਸਹੰਮ  ਜਾ ਬਖਸੇ  ਤਾ ਧਕਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: That which He makes is perfect; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.
lines.transliteration: pooraa thaat banaa-i-aa rang gurmat  maan .

lines.english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and unseen; as Gurmukh, know the Lord. ||11|| slok mÚ 1 ] (789-8) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: agam agochar alakh hai gurmukh  har jaan . ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਕਿਰ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the bags of coins are brought in
lines.transliteration: naanak badraa maal kaa bh eetar Dh ari-aa aan .

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: khotay kh aray parkh ee-an saahib kai d eebaan . ||1|| and placed in the Court of our Lord and Master, and there, the genuine and thecounterfeit are separated. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (789-9) mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: They go and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but their minds are still evil, andtheir bodies are thieves.
lines.transliteration: naavan chalay t eerthee man kh otai tan chor.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: Some of their filth is washed off by these baths, but they only accumulate twice asmuch.
lines.transliteration: ik bhaa-o lathee naat i-aa d u-ay bh aa charh ee-as hor.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Like a gourd, they may be washed off on the outside, but on the inside, they are stillfilled with poison.
lines.transliteration: baahar Dhot ee toomrh ee and ar vis nikor.

lines.english: The holy man is blessed, even without such bathing, while a thief is a thief, no matter how much he bathes. ||2|| pauVI ] (789-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: saaDh bh alay an naati-aa chor se choraa chor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਦਰਾ  ਮਾਲ  ਕਾ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਧਿਰਆ  ਆਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself issues His Commands, and links the people of the world to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: aapay hukam chalaa-idaa jag Dh anDhai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਿਨ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਿਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself joins some to Himself, and through the Guru, they find peace.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay hee aap laa-i-an gur tay sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the Guru holds it still.
lines.transliteration: dah d is ih man Dh aavdaa gur th aak rahaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵਣ  ਚਲੇ ਤੀਰਥੀ  ਮਿਨ ਖੋਟੈ ਤਿਨ  ਚੋਰ ॥
lines.english: Everyone longs for the Name, but it is only found through the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: naavai no sabh lochd ee gurmat ee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਭਾਉ ਲਥੀ  ਨਾਿਤਆ ਦੁਇ ਭਾ ਚੜੀਅਸੁ  ਹੋਰ ॥
lines.english: Dhur likh i-aa mayt na sakee-ai jo har likh  paa-i-aa. ||12|| Your pre-ordained destiny, written by the Lord in the very beginning, cannot beerased. ||12|| slok mÚ 1 ] (789-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
The two lamps light the fourteen markets.
lines.transliteration: du-ay d eevay cha-od ah hatnaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ਅਣਨਾਿਤਆ  ਚੋਰ ਿਸ ਚੋਰਾ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: There are just as many traders as there are living beings.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a t aytay van jaaray.

lines.english: The shops are open, and trading is going on;
lines.transliteration: khulHay hat ho-aa vaapaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ  ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jo pahuchai so chalanhaar. whoever comes there, is bound to depart.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁ ਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam d alaal paa-ay neesaan . The Righteous Judge of Dharma is the broker, who gives his sign of approval.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਦਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who earn the profit of the Naam are accepted and approved.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam laahaa parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: And when they return home, they are greeted with cheers;
lines.transliteration: ghar aa-ay vajee vaaDh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sach naam kee milee vadi-aa-ee. ||1|| they obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (789-16) mehlaa 1.

lines.english: Even when the night is dark, whatever is white retains its white color.
lines.transliteration: raatee hovan kaalee-aa supayd aa say vann.

lines.english: And even when the light of day is dazzlingly bright, whatever is black retains its black color.
lines.transliteration: dihu bagaa t apai gh anaa kaali-aa kaalay vann.

lines.english: The blind fools have no wisdom at all; their understanding is blind.
lines.transliteration: anDhay aklee baahray moorakh  anDh  gi-aan.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the Lord's Grace, they will never receive honor. ||2|| pauVI ] (789-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree baahray kabeh na paavahi maan. ||2||

lines.english: The True Lord Himself created the body-fortress.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kot rachaa-i-aa har sachai aapay.

lines.english: Some are ruined through the love of duality, engrossed in egotism.
lines.transliteration: ik doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-i-an ha-umai vich vi-aapay.

lines.english: This human body is so difficult to obtain; the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: ih maanas janam dulambh  saa manmukh  santaapay.

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand; he is blessed bythe True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaa-ay so bujh see jis sat gur thaapay.

lines.english: He created the entire world for His play; He is pervading amongst all. ||13|| pMnw 790 slok mÚ 1 ] (790-1) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh jag kh ayl rachaa-i-on sabh  vartai aapay. ||13||

lines.english: Thieves, adulterers, prostitutes and pimps, make friendships with the unrighteous, and eat with the unrighteous.
lines.transliteration: choraa jaaraa randee-aa kutnee-aa d eebaan . vayd eenaa kee d ostee vayd eenaa kaa khaan .

lines.english: They do not know the value of the Lord's Praises, and Satan is always with them.
lines.transliteration: siftee saar na jaan nee sad aa vasai sait aan.

lines.english: If a donkey is anointed with sandalwood paste, he still loves to roll in the dirt.
lines.transliteration: gadahu chand an kh a-ulee-ai bh ee saahoo si-o paan .

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਵੇਦੀਨਾ  ਕਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by spinning falsehood, a fabric of falsehood is woven.
lines.transliteration: naanak koorhai kati-ai koorh aa tanee-ai t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਫਤੀ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: False is the cloth and its measurement, and false is pride in such a garment. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (790-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: koorhaa kaparh  kachh ee-ai koorh aa painan  maan . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਦਹੁ ਚੰਦਿਨ  ਖਉਲੀਐ  ਭੀ ਸਾਹੂ ਿਸਉ ਪਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The callers to prayer, the flute-players, the horn-blowers, and also the singers
lines.transliteration: baaNgaa burgoo sinyee-aa naalay milee kalaan .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੂੜੈ ਕਿਤਐ  ਕੂੜਾ ਤਣੀਐ  ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ik daat ay ik mangt ay naam t ayraa parvaan . - some are givers, and some are beggars; they become acceptable only through YourName, Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜਾ ਕਪੜੁ  ਕਛੀਐ  ਕੂੜਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who hear and accept the Name. ||2|| pauVI ] (790-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jinHee sun kai mani-aa ha-o t inaa vitahu kurbaan . ||2||

lines.english: Attachment to Maya is totally false, and false are those who go that way.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh koorh  hai koorh o ho-ay ga-i-aa.

lines.english: Through egotism, the world is caught in conflict and strife, and it dies.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jhagrh aa paa-i-on jh agrhai jag mu-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਇਿਕ  ਮੰਗਤੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is free of conflict and strife, and sees the One Lord, pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jh agarh  chukaa-i-on iko rav rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਸੁਿਣ ਕੈ ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Recognizing that the Supreme Soul is everywhere, he crosses over the terrifyingworld-ocean.
lines.transliteration: sabh aat am raam pachh aani-aa bh a-ojal t ar ga-i-aa.

lines.english: His light merges into the Light, and he is absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||14|| slok mÚ 1 ] (790-8) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jot samaan ee jot  vich har naam sam-i-aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O True Guru, bless me with Your charity; You are the All-powerful Giver.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh eekhi-aa d eh mai t ooN samrath d aataar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਝਗੜਾ  ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਝਗੜੈ  ਜਗੁ ਮੁਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: May I subdue and quiet my egotism, pride, sexual desire, anger and self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai garab nivaaree-ai kaam kroDh ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਝਗੜੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਇਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Burn away all my greed, and give me the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh parjaalee-ai naam milai aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਿਰ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, keep me ever-fresh and new, spotless and pure; let me never be soiled by sin.
lines.transliteration: ahinis navtan nirmalaa mailaa kabahooN na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਇਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in this way I am saved; by Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (790-10) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ih biDh chh utee-ai nad ar tayree sukh  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: There is only the one Husband Lord, for all who stand at His Door.
lines.transliteration: iko kant sabaa-ee-aa jit ee dar kharhee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੀਿਖਆ  ਦੇਿਹ ਮੈ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥੁ  ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they ask for news of their Husband Lord, from those who are imbued withHis Love. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (790-11) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kantai rat ee-aa puchh eh baat -rhee-aah. ||2||

lines.english: All are imbued with love for their Husband Lord; I am a discarded bride - what goodam I?
lines.transliteration: sabhay kant ai ratee-aa mai d ohaagan  kit.

lines.english: My body is filled with so many faults; my Lord and Master does not even turn His thoughts to me. ||3|| mÚ 1 ] (790-12) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mai tan avgan  -ayt-rhay kh asam na fayray chit . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਵਤਨ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਮੈਲਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord with their mouths.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin ka-o sifat  jinaa d ai vaat .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the nights are for the happy soul-brides; I am a discarded bride - if only I couldhave even one night with Him! ||4|| pauVI ] (790-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sabh raat ee sohaagan ee ik mai d ohaagan  raat. ||4||

lines.english: I am a beggar at Your Door, begging for charity; O Lord, please grant me Your Mercy,and give to me.
lines.transliteration: dar mangat  jaachai d aan har d eejai kirpaa kar.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, unite me, your humble servant, with You, that I may receive Your Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh layho milaa-ay jan paavai naam har.

lines.english: Then, the unstruck melody of the Shabad will vibrate and resound, and my light willblend with the Light.
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  vajaa-ay jot ee jot  Dhar.

lines.english: Within my heart, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and celebrate the Word of theLord's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: hirdai har gun  gaa-ay jai jai sabad  har.

lines.english: The Lord Himself is pervading and permeating the world; so fall in love with Him! ||15|| slok mÚ 1 ] (790-16) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jag meh vartai aap har sayt ee pareet  kar. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤਿਨ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਏਤੜੇ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਨ ਫੇਰੇ ਿਚਤੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who do not obtain the sublime essence, the love and delight of their HusbandLord,
lines.transliteration: jinee na paa-i-o paraym ras kant na paa-i-o saa-o.

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sunjay gh ar kaa paahun aa ji-o aa-i-aa t i-o jaa-o. ||1|| are like guests in a deserted house; they leave just as they have come, empty-handed. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (790-17) mehlaa 1.

lines.english: He receives hundreds and thousands of reprimands, day and night;
lines.transliteration: sa-o olaamHay dinai kay raat ee milniH sahaNs.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਇਕ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਰਾਿਤ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sifat salaahan  chhad kai karangee lagaa hans. the swan-soul has renounced the Lord's Praises, and attached itself to a rottingcarcass.

lines.english: Cursed is that life, in which one only eats to fill his belly.
lines.transliteration: fit ivayhaa jeevi-aa jit kh aa-ay vaDh aa-i-aa payt.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਮੰਗਤੁ  ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, all one's friends turn to enemies. ||2|| pauVI ] (790-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam vin sabh o dusman hayt . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The minstrel continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, to embellish his life.
lines.transliteration: dhaadh ee gun  gaavai nit  janam savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਧਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh serves and praises the True Lord, enshrining Him within his heart. pMnw 791
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayv salaahi sachaa ur Dh aari-aa.

lines.english: He obtains his own home and mansion, by loving the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar paavai mahal naam pi-aari-aa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the Naam; I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-i-aa naam ha-o gur ka-o vaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself embellish and adorn us, O Creator Lord. ||16|| slok mÚ 1 ] (791-2) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too aap savaareh aap sirjanhaari-aa. ||16||

lines.english: When the lamp is lit, the darkness is dispelled;
lines.transliteration: deevaa balai anDh ayraa jaa-ay.
bayd paath  mat paapaa kh aa-ay. reading the Vedas, sinful intellect is destroyed.

lines.english: When the sun rises, the moon is not visible.
lines.transliteration: ugvai soor na jaapai chand.

lines.english: Wherever spiritual wisdom appears, ignorance is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jah gi-aan pargaas agi-aan mitant.

lines.english: Reading the Vedas is the world's occupation;
lines.transliteration: bayd paath  sansaar kee kaar.
parhH parhH pandit  karahi beechaar. the Pandits read them, study them and contemplate them.

lines.english: Without understanding, all are ruined.
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay sabh  ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (791-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ut ras paar. ||1||

lines.english: Those who do not savor the Word of the Shabad, do not love the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  na aa-i-o naam na lago pi-aar.

lines.english: They speak insipidly with their tongues, and are continually disgraced.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa fikaa bolnaa nit  nit ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, they act according to the karma of their past actions, which no one can erase. ||2|| pauVI ] (791-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ai kirat kamaavan aa ko-ay na maytan haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੋ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: One who praises his God, receives honor.
lines.transliteration: je parabh saalaahay aapn aa so sobh aa paa-ay.

lines.english: He drives out egotism from within himself, and enshrines the True Name within hismind.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vichahu door kar sach man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਇਐ  ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord,and finds true peace.
lines.transliteration: sach banee gun  uchrai sachaa sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: He is united with the Lord, after being separated for so long; the Guru, the PrimalBeing, unites him with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayl bha-i-aa chiree vichh unni-aa gur purakh  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਆਪਣਾ  ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: In this way, his filthy mind is cleansed and purified, and he meditates on the Name ofthe Lord. ||17|| slok mÚ 1 ] (791-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man mailaa iv suDh hai har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: With the fresh leaves of the body, and the flowers of virtue, Nanak has weaved his garland.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa koomal ful gun naanak gupas maal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ  ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is pleased with such garlands, so why pick any other flowers? ||1|| mhlw 2 ] (791-10) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aynee fulee ra-o karay avar ke chunee-ah daal. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, it is the spring season for those, within whose homes their Husband Lordabides.
lines.transliteration: naanak tinaa basant  hai jinH ghar vasi-aa kant .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਵ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: But those, whose Husband Lord is far away in distant lands, continue burning, dayand night. ||2|| pauVI ] (791-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jin kay kant d isaapuree say ahinis fireh jalant . ||2||

lines.english: The Merciful Lord Himself forgives those who dwell upon the Word of the Guru, theTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay d a-i-aa kar gur sat gur bachnee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੂਮਲ  ਫੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਪਿਸ  ਮਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I serve the True Lord, and chant His Glorious Praises; my mind mergesinto Him.
lines.transliteration: an-din sayvee gun  ravaa man sachai rachnee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨੀ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਉ ਕਰੇ ਅਵਰ  ਿਕ ਚੁਣੀਅਿਹ  ਡਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My God is infinite; no one knows His limit.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayraa bay-ant  hai ant  kinai na lakh nee.

lines.english: Grasping hold of the feet of the True Guru, meditate continually on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: satgur charn ee lagi-aa har naam nit  japnee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਘਿਰ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਕੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Thus you shall obtain the fruits of your desires, and all wishes shall be fulfilled within your home. ||18|| slok mÚ 1 ] (791-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo ichhai so fal paa-isee sabh  gharai vich jachnee. ||18||

lines.english: Spring brings forth the first blossoms, but the Lord blossoms earlier still.
lines.transliteration: pahil basantai aagman pahilaa ma-uli-o so-ay.

lines.english: By His blossoming, everything blossoms; no one else causes Him to blossom forth.||1|| mÚ 2 ] (791-15) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jit ma-uli-ai sabh  ma-ulee-ai t iseh na ma-ulihu ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: He blossoms forth even earlier than the spring; reflect upon Him.
lines.transliteration: pahil basantai aagman t is kaa karahu beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਚਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the One who gives Support to all. ||2|| mÚ 2 ] (791-16) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so salaahee-ai je sabhsai d ay aaDh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਲਖਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: By uniting, the united one is not united; he unites, only if he is united.
lines.transliteration: mili-ai mili-aa naa milai milai mili-aa jay ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਿਗਆ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਤ  ਜਪਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: But if he unites deep within his soul, then he is said to be united. ||3|| pauVI ] (791-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: antar aat mai jo milai mili-aa kahee-ai so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ  ਸਿਭ ਘਰੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਚਨੀ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Praise the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and practice truthful deeds.
lines.transliteration: har har naam salaahee-ai sach kaar kamaavai.

lines.english: Attached to other deeds, one is consigned to wander in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: doojee kaarai lagi-aa fir jonee paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ  ਆਗਮਿਨ  ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਮਉਿਲਓ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Name, one obtains the Name, and through the Name, sings the Lord'sPraises.
lines.transliteration: naam rati-aa naam paa-ee-ai naamay gun  gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਮਉਿਲਐ  ਸਭ ਮਉਲੀਐ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਨ ਮਉਿਲਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Praising the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad salaahee-ai har naam samaavai.

lines.english: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; serving Him, the fruits areobtained. ||19|| slok mÚ 2 ] (791-19) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa safal hai sayvi-ai fal paavai. ||19||

lines.english: Some people have others, but I am forlorn and dishonored; I have only You, Lord. pMnw 792
lines.transliteration: kis hee ko-ee ko-ay manj nimaan ee ik t oo.

lines.english: I might as well just die crying, if You will not come into my mind. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (792-1) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ki-o na mareejai ro-ay jaa lag chit na aavhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ  ਰੋਇ ਜਾ ਲਗੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਹੀ  ॥੧॥
