lines.english: When there is peace and pleasure, that is the time to remember your Husband Lord.In times of suffering and pain, remember Him then as well.
lines.transliteration: jaaN sukh t aa saho raavi-o d ukh bhee sammHaali-o-i.

lines.english: Says Nanak, O wise bride, this is the way to meet your Husband Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (792-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai si-aanee-ay i-o kant  milaavaa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਿਵਓ  ਦੁਿਖ ਭੀ ਸੰਮਾਿਲਓਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a worm - how can I praise You, O Lord; Your glorious greatness is so great!
lines.transliteration: ha-o ki-aa saalaahee kiram jant vadee t ayree vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: You are inaccessible, merciful and unapproachable; You Yourself unite us withYourself.
lines.transliteration: too agam d a-i-aal agamm hai aap laihi milaa-ee.

lines.english: I have no other friend except You; in the end, You alone will be my Companion and Support.
lines.transliteration: mai tujh  bin baylee ko nahee t oo ant  sakhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਿਕਰਮ  ਜੰਤੁ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: You save those who enter Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jo tayree sarn aagat ee tin laihi chh adaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਆਿਪ  ਲੈਿਹ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He is care-free; He has no greed at all. ||20||1|| rwgu sUhI bwxI sRI kbIr jIau qQw sBnw Bgqw kI ] (792-6) raag soohee banee saree kabeer jee-o t athaa sabh naa bh agtaa kee. Raag Soohee, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, And Other Devotees. kbIr ky  (792-6) kabeer kay Of Kabeer <> siqgur pRswid ] (792-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak vayparvaahu hai tis t il na t amaa-ee. ||20||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਬੇਲੀ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Since your birth, what have you done?
lines.transliteration: avtar aa-ay kahaa t um keenaa.

lines.english: You have never even chanted the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam ko naam na kabhoo leenaa. ||1||

lines.english: You have not meditated on the Lord; what thoughts are you attached to?
lines.transliteration: raam na japahu kavan mat laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਤਥਾ ਸਭਨਾ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: What preparations are you making for your death, O unfortunate one? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mar ja-ibay ka-o ki-aa karahu abhaagay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through pain and pleasure, you have taken care of your family.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  kar kai kutamb jeevaa-i-aa.

lines.english: But at the time of death, you shall have to endure the agony all alone. ||2||
lines.transliteration: martee baar iksar d ukh paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲੀਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When you are seized by the neck, then you shall cry out.
lines.transliteration: kanth gahan t ab karan pukaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ  ਮਿਤ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, why didn't you remember the Lord before this? ||3||1|| sUhI kbIr jI ] (792-10) soohee kabeer jee. Soohee, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer aagay tay na samHaaraa. ||3||1||

lines.english: My innocent soul trembles and shakes.
lines.transliteration: tharhar kampai baalaa jee-o.

lines.english: I do not know how my Husband Lord will deal with me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa jaan-o ki-aa karsee pee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਜੀਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The night of my youth has passed away; will the day of old age also pass away?
lines.transliteration: rain ga-ee mat d in bhee jaa-ay.

lines.english: My dark hairs, like bumble bees, have gone away, and grey hairs, like cranes, have settled upon my head. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhavar ga-ay bag baith ay aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Water does not remain in the unbaked clay pot;
lines.transliteration: kaachai karvai rahai na paanee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਆਗੇ  ਤੇ ਨ ਸੰਮਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hans chali-aa kaa-i-aa kumlaanee. ||2|| when the soul-swan departs, the body withers away. ||2||

lines.english: I decorate myself like a young virgin;
lines.transliteration: ku-aar kanniaa jaisay karat seegaaraa.
ki-o ralee-aa maanai baajh bh ataaraa. ||3|| but how can I enjoy pleasures, without my Husband Lord? ||3||

lines.english: My arm is tired, driving away the crows.
lines.transliteration: kaag udaavat bh ujaa piraanee.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, this is the way the story of my life ends. ||4||2|| sUhI kbIr jIau ] (792-13) soohee kabeer jee-o. Soohee, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ih kathaa siraanee. ||4||2||

lines.english: Your time of service is at its end, and you will have to give your account.
lines.transliteration: amal siraano laykhaa d aynaa.

lines.english: The hard-hearted Messenger of Death has come to take you away.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay kathin d oot jam laynaa.

lines.english: What have you earned, and what have you lost?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa tai kh ati-aa kahaa gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Come immediately! You are summoned to His Court! ||1||
lines.transliteration: chalhu sitaab d eebaan bulaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Get going! Come just as you are! You have been summoned to His Court.
lines.transliteration: chal darhaal d eevaan bulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Order has come from the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har furmaan dargeh kaa aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I pray to the Messenger of Death: please, I still have some outstanding debts to collect in the village.
lines.transliteration: kara-o ardaas gaav kichh  baakee.

lines.english: I will collect them tonight;
lines.transliteration: lay-o nibayr aaj kee raatee.

lines.english: I will also pay you something for your expenses,
lines.transliteration: kichh bh ee kh arach t umHaaraa saara-o.
subah nivaaj saraa-ay gujaara-o. ||2|| and I will recite my morning prayers on the way. ||2||

lines.english: Blessed, blessed is the most fortunate servant of the Lord, who is imbued with the Lord's Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jaa ka-o har rang laagaa. Dh an Dh an so jan purakh  sabh aagaa.

lines.english: Here and there, the humble servants of the Lord are always happy.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  jan sad aa suhaylay.

lines.english: They win the priceless treasure of this human life. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath jeet  amolay. ||3||

lines.english: When he is awake, he is sleeping, and so he loses this life.
lines.transliteration: jaagat so-i-aa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The property and wealth he has accumulated passes on to someone else.
lines.transliteration: maal Dhan jori-aa bh a-i-aa paraa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, those people are deluded,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer tay-ee nar bh oolay.

lines.english: Soohee, Kabeer Jee, Lallit:
lines.transliteration: khasam bisaar maatee sang roolay. ||4||3|| who forget their Lord and Master, and roll in the dust. ||4||3|| pMnw 793 sUhI kbIr jIau lilq ] (793-1) soohee kabeer jee-o lalit.

lines.english: My eyes are exhausted, and my ears are tired of hearing; my beautiful body is exhausted.
lines.transliteration: thaakay nain sarvan sun thaakay thaakee sundar kaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Driven forward by old age, all my senses are exhausted; only my attachment to Maya is not exhausted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaraa haak dee sabh  mat thaakee ayk na thaakas maa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਸੁਿਨ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਾਕੀ  ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O mad man, you have not obtained spiritual wisdom and meditation.
lines.transliteration: baavray tai gi-aan beechaar na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਰਾ ਹਾਕ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਤ ਥਾਕੀ  ਏਕ ਨ ਥਾਕਿਸ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have wasted this human life, and lost. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O mortal, serve the Lord, as long as the breath of life remains in the body.
lines.transliteration: tab lag paraanee t isai sarayvhu jab lag gh at meh saasaa.

lines.english: And even when your body dies, your love for the Lord shall not die; you shall dwell atthe Feet of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jay ghat jaa-ay t a bhaa-o na jaasee har kay charan nivaasaa. ||2||

lines.english: When the Word of the Shabad abides deep within, thirst and desire are quenched.
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o sabad basaavai ant ar chookai t iseh pi-aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਿਤਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: When one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he plays the game ofchess with the Lord; throwing the dice, he conquers his own mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhai cha-uparh  khaylai man jin  dhaalay paasaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਘਟੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਿਨਵਾਸਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those humble beings, who know the Imperishable Lord and meditate on Him, are notdestroyed at all.
lines.transliteration: jo jan jaan bhajeh abigat  ka-o t in kaa kachh oo na naasaa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, those humble beings who know how to throw these dice, never lose thegame of life. ||4||4|| sUhI lilq kbIr jIau ] (793-6) soohee lalit kabeer jee-o. Soohee, Lalit, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer tay jan kabahu na haareh dh aal jo jaaneh paasaa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਪਿੜ  ਖੇਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਜਿਣ  ਢਾਲੇ  ਪਾਸਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the one fortress of the body, there are five rulers, and all five demand payment of taxes.
lines.transliteration: ayk kot panch sikdaaraa panchay maageh haalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਿਨ  ਭਜਿਹ  ਅਿਬਗਤ  ਕਉ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਨਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have not farmed anyone's land, so such payment is difficult for me to pay. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jimee naahee mai kisee kee bo-ee aisaa dayn d ukhaalaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਿਹ  ਢਾਿਲ  ਜੁ ਜਾਨਿਹ  ਪਾਸਾ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: O people of the Lord, the tax-collector is constantly torturing me!
lines.transliteration: har kay logaa mo ka-o neet dasai patvaaree.

lines.english: Raising my arms up, I complained to my Guru, and He has saved me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kbIr jI) oopar bhujaa kar mai gur peh pukaari-aa t in ha-o lee-aa ubaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਪੰਚ ਿਸਕਦਾਰਾ  ਪੰਚੇ ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਹਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The nine tax-assessors and the ten magistrates go out; they do not allow their subjects to live in peace.
lines.transliteration: na-o daadee das munsaf Dh aaveh ra-ee-at  basan na d ayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਮੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੈ ਿਕਸੀ  ਕੀ ਬੋਈ ਐਸਾ  ਦੇਨੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They do not measure with a full tape, and they take huge amounts in bribes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: doree pooree maapeh naahee baho bistaalaa layhee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨੀਿਤ  ਡਸੈ ਪਟਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is contained in the seventy-two chambers of the body, and He haswritten off my account.
lines.transliteration: bahtar gh ar ik purakh  samaa-i-aa un d ee-aa naam likh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਊਪਿਰ  ਭੁਜਾ ਕਿਰ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਪੁਕਾਿਰਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay kaa d aftar soDh i-aa baakee rijam na kaa-ee. ||3|| The records of the Righteous Judge of Dharma have been searched, and I oweabsolutely nothing. ||3||
Let no one slander the Saints, because the Saints and the Lord are as one.
lines.transliteration: santaa ka-o mat  ko-ee nind ahu sant  raam hai ayko.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਡਾਡੀ  ਦਸ ਮੁੰਸਫ  ਧਾਵਿਹ  ਰਈਅਿਤ  ਬਸਨ  ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have found that Guru, whose Name is Clear Understanding. ||4||5|| rwgu sUhI bwxI sRI rivdws jIau kI  (793-13) raag soohee banee saree ravid aas jee-o kee Raag Soohee, The Word Of Sree Ravi Daas Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (793-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer mai so gur paa-i-aa jaa kaa naa-o bibayko. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਡੋਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਾਪਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਸਟਾਲਾ  ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The happy soul-bride knows the worth of her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sah kee saar suhaagan jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹਤਿਰ  ਘਰ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ਉਿਨ  ਦੀਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਲਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Renouncing pride, she enjoys peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan sukh  ralee-aa maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਫਤਰੁ ਸੋਿਧਆ  ਬਾਕੀ  ਿਰਜਮ  ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: She surrenders her body and mind to Him, and does not remain separate from Him.
lines.transliteration: tan man d ay-ay na ant ar raakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਤ ਕੋਈ ਿਨੰਦਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਏਕ ॥
lines.english: She does not see or hear, or speak to another. ||1||
lines.transliteration: avraa daykh  na sunai abh aakhai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁ ਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਿਬਬੇਕ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: How can anyone know the pain of another,
lines.transliteration: so kat jaanai peer paraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai antar d arad na paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. if there is no compassion and sympathy within? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The discarded bride is miserable, and loses both worlds;
lines.transliteration: dukhee duhaagan d u-ay pakh  heenee.
jin naah nirantar bh agat na keenee. she does not worship her Husband Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.english: The bridge over the fire of hell is difficult and treacherous.
lines.transliteration: pur salaat kaa panth d uhaylaa.

lines.english: No one will accompany you there; you will have to go all alone. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sang na saathee gavan ikaylaa. ||2||

lines.english: Suffering in pain, I have come to Your Door, O Compassionate Lord.
lines.transliteration: dukhee-aa d aradvand dar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਦਰਦੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am so thirsty for You, but You do not answer me.
lines.transliteration: bahut pi-aas jabaab na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, I seek Your Sanctuary, God;
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas saran parabh  tayree.

lines.english: Soohee:
lines.transliteration: ji-o jaanhu ti-o kar gat  mayree. ||3||1|| as You know me, so will You save me. ||3||1|| sUhI ] (793-18) soohee.

lines.english: That day which comes, that day shall go.
lines.transliteration: jo din aavahi so d in jaahee.

lines.english: You must march on; nothing remains stable.
lines.transliteration: karnaa kooch rahan thir naahee.

lines.english: Our companions are leaving, and we must leave as well.
lines.transliteration: sang chalat hai ham bh ee chalnaa.

lines.english: We must go far away. Death is hovering over our heads. ||1|| pMnw 794
lines.transliteration: door gavan sir oopar marnaa. ||1||

lines.english: Why are you asleep? Wake up, you ignorant fool!
lines.transliteration: ki-aa too so-i-aa jaag i-aanaa.

lines.english: You believe that your life in the world is true. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tai jeevan jag sach kar jaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਿਗ  ਸਚੁ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One who gave you life shall also provide you with nourishment.
lines.transliteration: jin jee-o dee-aa so rijak ambraavai.

lines.english: In each and every heart, He runs His shop.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at bheetar haat chalaavai.

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, and renounce your egotism and self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: kar bandigee chh aad mai mayraa.

lines.english: Within your heart, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sometime. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam samHaar savayraa. ||2||

lines.english: Your life has passed away, but you have not arranged your path.
lines.transliteration: janam siraano panth na savaaraa.

lines.english: Evening has set in, and soon there will be darkness on all sides.
lines.transliteration: saaNjh paree d ah dis anDh i-aaraa.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, O ignorant mad-man,
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas nid aan d ivaanay.

lines.english: Soohee:
lines.transliteration: chaytas naahee d unee-aa fan kh aanay. ||3||2|| don't you realize, that this world is the house of death?! ||3||2|| sUhI ] (794-4) soohee.

lines.english: You may have lofty mansions, halls and kitchens.
lines.transliteration: oochay mandar saal raso-ee.

lines.english: But you cannot stay in them, even for an instant, after death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk gharee fun rahan na ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: This body is like a house of straw.
lines.transliteration: ih tan aisaa jaisay gh aas kee taatee.

lines.english: When it is burnt, it mixes with dust. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jal ga-i-o ghaas ral ga-i-o maatee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਘਰੀ  ਫੁਿਨ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even relatives, family and friends begin to say, "Take his body out, immediately!"||2||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee banDh  kutamb sahayraa. o-ay bh ee laagay kaadh  savayraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਐਸਾ  ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ  ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ  ॥
lines.english: And the wife of his house, who was so attached to his body and heart,
lines.transliteration: ghar kee naar ureh t an laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਗਇਓ  ਘਾਸੁ  ਰਿਲ ਗਇਓ  ਮਾਟੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: uh ta-o bh oot bhoot kar bh aagee. ||3|| runs away, crying out, "Ghost! Ghost!"||3||

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, the whole world has been plundered,
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas sabh ai jag looti-aa.

lines.english: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu sUhI bwxI syK PrId jI kI ] (794-10) raag soohee banee saykh  fareed  jee kee. Raag Soohee, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:
lines.transliteration: ham ta-o ayk raam kahi chh ooti-aa. ||4||3|| but I have escaped, chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||4||3|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (794-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad .

lines.english: Burning and burning, writhing in pain, I wring my hands.
lines.transliteration: tap tap luhi luhi haath marora-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ ਉਰਿਹ  ਤਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have gone insane, seeking my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: baaval ho-ee so saho lora-o.

lines.punjabi: ਉਹ ਤਉ ਭੂਤੁ ਭੂਤੁ ਕਿਰ ਭਾਗੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Husband Lord, You are angry with me in Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: tai seh man meh kee-aa ros.

lines.english: The fault is with me, and not with my Husband Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mujh avgan sah naahee d os. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਿਹ ਛੂਿਟਆ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, I do not know Your excellence and worth.
lines.transliteration: tai saahib kee mai saar na jaanee.

lines.english: Having wasted my youth, now I come to regret and repent. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: joban kho-ay paachh ai pachh utaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: O black bird, what qualities have made you black?
lines.transliteration: kaalee ko-il too kit  gun kaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਪ ਤਿਪ ਲੁਿਹ ਲੁਿਹ ਹਾਥ ਮਰੋਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: "I have been burnt by separation from my Beloved."
lines.transliteration: apnay pareetam kay ha-o birhai jaalee.

lines.english: Without her Husband Lord, how can the soul-bride ever find peace?
lines.transliteration: pireh bihoon kateh sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਿਹ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਕੀਆ  ਰੋਸੁ ॥
lines.english: When He becomes merciful, then God unites us with Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa ho-ay kirpaal taa parabh oo milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The lonely soul-bride suffers in the pit of the world.
lines.transliteration: viDhan  khoohee munDh  ikaylee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: She has no companions, and no friends.
lines.transliteration: naa ko saathee naa ko baylee.

lines.english: In His Mercy, God has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh saaDh sang maylee.

lines.english: And when I look again, then I find God as my Helper. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa fir daykh aa taa mayraa alhu baylee. ||3||

lines.english: The path upon which I must walk is very depressing.
lines.transliteration: vaat hamaaree kharee udeen ee.

lines.english: It is sharper than a two-edged sword, and very narrow.
lines.transliteration: khanni-ahu t ikhee bahut  pi-een ee.

lines.english: That is where my path lies.
lines.transliteration: us oopar hai maarag mayraa.

lines.english: O Shaykh Fareed, think of that path early on. ||4||1|| sUhI lilq ] (794-16) soohee lalit. Soohee, Lalit:
lines.transliteration: saykh fareed aa panth samHaar savayraa. ||4||1||

lines.english: You were not able to make yourself a raft when you should have.
lines.transliteration: bayrhaa banDh  na saki-o banDh an kee vaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਥੀ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: When the ocean is churning and over-flowing, then it is very difficult to cross over it.||1||
lines.transliteration: bhar sarvar jab oochh lai tab taran duhaylaa. ||1||

lines.english: Do not touch the safflower with your hands; its color will fade away, my dear.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hath na laa-ay kasumbh-rh ai jal jaasee dh olaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਫਿਰ  ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਬੇਲੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: First, the bride herself is weak, and then, her Husband Lord's Order is hard to bear.
lines.transliteration: ik aapeenHai patlee sah kayray bolaa.

lines.english: Milk does not return to the breast; it will not be collected again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: duDhaa than ee na aavee fir ho-ay na maylaa. ||2||

lines.english: Says Fareed, O my companions, when our Husband Lord calls,
lines.transliteration: kahai fareed sahayleeho saho alaa-aysee.

lines.english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 1 caupdy Gru 1 ] (795-3) raag bilaaval mehlaa 1 cha-upday gh ar 1. Raag Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House:
lines.transliteration: hans chalsee dummnaa ah t an dh ayree theesee. ||3||2|| the soul departs, sad at heart, and this body returns to dust. ||3||2|| pMnw 795 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (795-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad.

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Emperor, and I call You a chief - how does this add to Your greatness?
lines.transliteration: too sult aan kahaa ha-o mee-aa t ayree kavan vadaa-ee.

lines.english: As You permit me, I praise You, O Lord and Master; I am ignorant, and I cannot chantYour Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo too d eh so kahaa su-aamee mai moorakh  kahan  na jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਹਉ ਮੀਆ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ  ਵਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  gaavaa d eh bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: May I dwell in Truth, according to Your Will. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaisay sach meh raha-o rajaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever has happened, has all come from You. You are All-knowing.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh ho-aa sabh  kichh  tujh tay tayree sabh  asnaa-ee.

lines.english: Your limits cannot be known, O my Lord and Master; I am blind - what wisdom do Ihave? ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayraa ant  na jaan aa mayray saahib mai anDh ulay ki-aa chat uraa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: What should I say? While talking, I talk of seeing, but I cannot describe theindescribable.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ha-o kathee kathay kath daykh aa mai akath na kathnaa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਅਸਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: As it pleases Your Will, I speak; it is just the tiniest bit of Your greatness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so-ee aakh aa til tayree vadi-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Among so many dogs, I am an outcast; I bark for my body's belly.
lines.transliteration: aytay kookar ha-o baygaanaa bh a-ukaa is t an taa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹਉ ਕਥੀ ਕਥੇ ਕਿਥ ਦੇਖਾ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ  ਨ ਕਥਨਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship, O Nanak, even so, still, my Master's Name does not leaveme. ||4||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 1 ] (795-9) bilaaval mehlaa 1. Bilaawal, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  heen  naanak jay ho-igaa t aa kh asmai naa-o na jaa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਖਾ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind is the temple, and my body is the simple cloth of the humble seeker; deepwithin my heart, I bathe at the sacred shrine.
lines.transliteration: man mandar t an vays kaland ar ghat hee t irath naavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੇ ਕੂਕਰ  ਹਉ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ  ਭਉਕਾ  ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The One Word of the Shabad abides within my mind; I shall not come to be born again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad mayrai paraan basat  hai baahurh  janam na aavaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ  ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ  ਨਾਉ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the Merciful Lord, O my mother!
lines.transliteration: man bayDhi-aa d a-i-aal sayt ee mayree maa-ee.

lines.english: Who can know the pain of another?
lines.transliteration: ka-un jaan ai peer paraa-ee.

lines.english: I think of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham naahee chint paraa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਲੰਦਰੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite: please, take care of me!
lines.transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaraa chint aa karahu hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਿਨ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the water, on the land and in sky, You are totally pervading. Your Light is in eachand every heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al bharipur leen aa gh at ghat jot tumHaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: All teachings, instructions and understandings are Yours; the mansions andsanctuaries are Yours as well.
lines.transliteration: sikh mat  sabh  buDh  tumHaaree mand ir chh aavaa t ayray.

lines.english: Without You, I know no other, O my Lord and Master; I continually sing Your GloriousPraises. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na jaan aa mayray saahibaa gun  gaavaa nit  tayray. ||3||

lines.english: All beings and creatures seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; all thought of theircare rests with You.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  saran  tumHaaree sarab chint  tuDh paasay.

lines.english: That which pleases Your Will is good; this alone is Nanak's prayer. ||4||2|| iblwvlu mhlw 1 ] (795-14) bilaaval mehlaa 1. Bilaawal, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so-ee changa ik naanak kee ard aasay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Word of the Shabad, and He Himself is the Insignia.
lines.transliteration: aapay sabad aapay neesaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਭਿਰਪੁਿਰ  ਲੀਣਾ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Listener, and He Himself is the Knower.
lines.transliteration: aapay surtaa aapay jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਖ ਮਿਤ ਸਭ ਬੁਿਧ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਮੰਿਦਰ ਛਾਵਾ  ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself beholds His almighty power.
lines.transliteration: aapay kar kar vaykhai t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਿਨਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are the Great Giver; Your Name alone is approved. ||1|| pMnw 796
lines.transliteration: too daataa naam parvaan . ||1||

lines.english: Such is the Name of the Immaculate, Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan day-o.

lines.english: I am just a beggar; You are invisible and unknowable. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o jaachik too alakh  abhay-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Love of Maya is like a cursed woman, ugly, dirty and promiscuous.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh Dharkatee naar. bh ooNdee kaaman  kaaman i-aar.

lines.english: Power and beauty are false, and last for only a few days.
lines.transliteration: raaj roop jhooth aa din chaar.

lines.english: But when one is blessed with the Naam, the darkness within is illuminated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam milai chaanan anDh i-aar. ||2||

lines.english: I tasted Maya and renounced it, and now, I have no doubts.
lines.transliteration: chakh chh odee sahsaa nahee ko-ay.

lines.english: One whose father is known, cannot be illegitimate.
lines.transliteration: baap disai vayjaat  na ho-ay.

lines.english: One who belongs to the One Lord, has no fear.
lines.transliteration: aykay ka-o naahee bha-o ko-ay.

lines.english: The Creator acts, and causes all to act. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kartaa karay karaavai so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers his mind, through his mind.
lines.transliteration: sabad mu-ay man man t ay maari-aa.

lines.english: Keeping his mind restrained, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart.
lines.transliteration: thaak rahay man saachai Dh aari-aa.

lines.english: He does not know any other, and he is a sacrifice to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: avar na soojhai gur ka-o vaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, he is emancipated. ||4||3|| iblwvlu mhlw 1 ] (796-5) bilaaval mehlaa 1. Bilaaval, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay nist aari-aa. ||4||3||

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the mind intuitively meditates on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee man sahj Dhi-aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har kai rang rataa man maanay.

lines.english: The insane, self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aram bh ulay ba-uraanay.

lines.english: Without the Lord, how can anyone survive? Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad,He is realized. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har bin ki-o rahee-ai gur sabad pachh aanay. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I live, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: bin darsan kaisay jeeva-o mayree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, even for an instant; the True Guru hashelped me understand this. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bin jee-araa reh na sakai khin sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Forgetting my God, I die in pain.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh bisrai ha-o mara-o d ukhaalee.

lines.english: With each breath and morsel of food, I meditate on my Lord, and seek Him.
lines.transliteration: saas giraas japa-o apunay har bhaalee.

lines.english: I remain always detached, but I am enraptured with the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sad bairaagan har naam nihaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ  ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਿਖਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now, as Gurmukh, I know that the Lord is always with me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ab jaanay gurmukh har naalee. ||2||

lines.english: The Unspoken Speech is spoken, by the Will of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa kahee-ai gur bhaa-ay.

lines.english: He shows us that God is unapproachable and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: parabh agam agochar d ay-ay d ikhaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, what lifestyle could we practice, and what work could we do?
lines.transliteration: bin gur karnee ki-aa kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Eradicating egotism, and walking in harmony with the Guru's Will, I am absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayt chalai gur sabad samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are separated from the Lord, gathering false wealth.
lines.transliteration: manmukh vichh urhai khotee raas.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are celebrated with the glory of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam milai saabaas.

lines.english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon me, and made me the slave of His slaves.
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa Dhaaree d aasan d aas.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the wealth and capital of servant Nanak. ||4||4|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 Gru 1  (796-13) bilaaval mehlaa 3 ghar 1 Bilaaval, Third Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (796-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har naam Dhan raas. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਿਟ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dharig Dh arig kh aa-i-aa Dh arig Dh arig so-i-aa Dh arig Dh arig kaaparh  ang charh aa-i- aa. Cursed, cursed is the food; cursed, cursed is the sleep; cursed, cursed are the clothesworn on the body.
Dharig sareer kutamb sahit  si-o jit  hun khasam na paa-i-aa. Cursed is the body, along with family and friends, when one does not find his Lordand Master in this life.
He misses the step of the ladder, and this opportunity will not come into his handsagain; his life is wasted, uselessly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pa-orhee chh urhkee fir haath na aavai ahilaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The love of duality does not allow him to lovingly focus his attention on the Lord; heforgets the Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aa-o na d ay-ee liv laagan  jin har kay charan  visaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: O Life of the World, O Great Giver, you eradicate the sorrows of your humbleservants. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan daat aa jan sayvak t ayray t in kay t ai dookh nivaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are Merciful, O Great Giver of Mercy; what are these poor beings?
lines.transliteration: too da-i-aal d a-i-aapat  daataa ki-aa ayhi jant  vichaaray.

lines.english: All are liberated or placed into bondage by You; this is all one can say.
lines.transliteration: mukat banDh  sabh  tujh tay ho-ay aisaa aakh  vakh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਹਤ  ਿਸਉ ਿਜਤੁ  ਹੁਿਣ ਖਸਮੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so mukat  kahee-ai manmukh  banDh  vichaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਉੜੀ  ਛੁੜਕੀ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਅਿਹਲਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, alwaysdwelling with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so jan mukat jis ayk liv laagee sad aa rahai har naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗਿਣ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਿਵਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him. pMnw 797
lines.transliteration: tin kee gahan  gat kahee na jaa-ee sachai aap savaaray.

lines.english: Those who wander around, deluded by doubt, are called manmukhs; they are neither on this side, nor on the other side. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaan ay se manmukh  kahee-ahi naa urvaar na paaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਣੇ  ਿਸ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: That humble being, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains Him, andcontemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so-ee jan paa-ay gur kaa sabad  samHaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: In the midst of Maya, the Lord's servant is emancipated.
lines.transliteration: har jan maa-i-aa maahi nistaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead, conquers and destroys death. ||4||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 ] (797-3) bilaaval mehlaa 3. Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaag hovai jis mast ak kaaleh maar bid aaray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਕਾਲਿਹ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: How can the unweighable be weighed?
lines.transliteration: atul ki-o t oli-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: If there is anyone else as great, then he alone could understand the Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojaa ho-ay t a sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.english: There is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: tis tay doojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: How can His value be estimated? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis dee keemat  kikoo ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: One comes to know Him, when duality departs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taa ko jaan ai dubiDh aa jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is the Assayer, applying the touch-stone to test it.
lines.transliteration: aap saraaf kasvatee laa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself analyzes the coin, and He Himself approves it as currency.
lines.transliteration: aapay parkhay aap chalaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself weights it perfectly.
lines.transliteration: aapay tolay pooraa ho-ay.

lines.english: He alone knows; He is the One and Only Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai ayko so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: All the forms of Maya emanate from Him.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaa roop sabh t is tay ho-ay.

lines.english: He alone becomes pure and immaculate, who is united with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis no maylay so nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: He alone is attached, whom the Lord attaches.
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay lagai tis aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All Truth is revealed to him, and then, he merges in the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh sach d ikhaalay t aa sach samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself leads the mortals to focus on Him, and He Himself causes them to chaseafter Maya.
lines.transliteration: aapay liv Dhaat  hai aapay.

lines.english: He Himself imparts understanding, and He reveals Himself.
lines.transliteration: aap bujhaa-ay aapay jaapay.

lines.english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur sabad  hai aapay.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself speaks and teaches. ||4||2|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 ] (797-9) bilaaval mehlaa 3. Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakh sun aa-ay aapay. ||4||2||

lines.english: My Lord and Master has made me His servant, and blessed me with His service; howcan anyone argue about this?
lines.transliteration: saahib tay sayvak sayv saahib t ay ki-aa ko kahai bahaanaa.

lines.english: Such is Your play, One and Only Lord; You are the One, contained among all. ||1|| siqguir prcY hir nwim smwnw ] ijsu krmu hovY  so siqguru pwey Anidnu lwgY shj iDAwnw ]1]
lines.transliteration: aisaa ik tayraa kh ayl bani-aa hai sabh  meh ayk samaanaa. ||1||

lines.english: When the True Guru is pleased and appeased, one is absorbed in the Lord's Name. One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy, finds the True Guru; night and day, heautomatically remains focused on the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur parchai har naam samaanaa. jis karam hovai so sat gur paa-ay an-d in laagai sahj Dhi-aanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How can I serve You? How can I be proud of this?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ko-ee tayree sayvaa karay ki-aa ko karay abh imaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੇਵ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੇ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਹਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: When You withdraw Your Light, O Lord and Master, then who can speak and teach?||2||
lines.transliteration: jab apunee jot kh incheh t oo su-aamee t ab ko-ee kara-o d ikhaa vakh i-aanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਇਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਿਨਆ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the humble disciple; You Yourself are the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: aapay gur chaylaa hai aapay aapay gunee niDh aanaa.

lines.english: As You cause us to move, so do we move, according to the Pleasure of Your Will, OLord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o aap chalaa-ay tivai ko-ee chaalai ji-o har bh aavai bh agvaanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਹਜ  ਿਧਆਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, You are the True Lord and Master; who can know Your actions?
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak t oo saachaa saahib ka-un  jaanai tayray kaamaaN.

lines.english: Some are blessed with glory in their own homes, while others wander in doubt andpride. ||4||3|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 ] (797-15) bilaaval mehlaa 3. Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: iknaa ghar meh d ay vadi-aa-ee ik bh aram bh aveh abh imaanaa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The perfect Lord has fashioned the Perfect Creation. Behold the Lord pervadingeverywhere.
lines.transliteration: pooraa thaat banaa-i-aa poorai vaykh hu ayk samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਖੰਚਿਹ  ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਬ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਉ  ਿਦਖਾ  ਵਿਖਆਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In this play of the world, is the glorious greatness of the True Name. No one should take pride in himself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: is parpanch meh saachay naam kee vadi-aa-ee mat ko Dh arahu gumaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who accepts the wisdom of the True Guru's Teachings, is absorbed into the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee jis no mat  aavai so sat gur maahi samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਆਿਪ  ਚਲਾਏ  ਿਤਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਚਾਲੈ  ਿਜਉ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name abides deep within the nucleus of one who realizes the Bani of the Guru's Word within his soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih banee jo jee-ahu jaan ai tis ant ar ravai har naamaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Now, this is the essence of the teachings of the four ages: for the human race, theName of the One Lord is the greatest treasure.
lines.transliteration: chahu jugaa kaa hun nibayrh aa nar manukh aa no ayk niDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਇਿਕ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਵਿਹ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Celibacy, self-discipline and pilgrimages were the essence of Dharma in those pastages; but in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Praise of the Lord's Name is the essenceof Dharma. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jat sanjam t irath onaa jugaa kaa Dh aram hai kal meh keerat  har naamaa. ||2||

lines.english: Each and every age has its own essence of Dharma; study the Vedas and thePuraanas, and see this as true.
lines.transliteration: jug jug aapo aapnaa Dh aram hai soDh  daykhhu bayd  puraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ  ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: They are Gurmukh, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; in this world, they are perfect and approved. ||3|| pMnw 798
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinee Dh i-aa-i-aa har har jag t ay pooray parvaanaa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, loving the True Lord, the mind's egotism and self-conceit is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak sachay si-o pareet  laa-ay chookai man abh imaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਏ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who speak and listen to the Lord's Name, all find peace. Those who believe in it, obtain the supreme treasure. ||4||4|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 ] (798-2) bilaaval mehlaa 3. Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahat sun at sabh ay sukh  paavahi maanat  paahi niDh aanaa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਸੁਣਤ  ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਾਨਤ  ਪਾਿਹ  ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself attaches the Gurmukh to His Love;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pareet  jis no aapay laa-ay.
tit ghar bilaaval gur sabad  suhaa-ay. joyful melodies permeate his home, and he is embellished with the Word of the Guru'sShabad.

lines.english: The women come and sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: mangal naaree gaavahi aa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with their Beloved, lasting peace is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam sad aa sukh  paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those, whose minds are filled with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin balihaarai jinH har man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the humble servant of the Lord, peace is obtained, and one intuitivelysings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jan ka-o mili-aa sukh paa-ee-ai har gun  gaavai sahj subh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They are always imbued with Your Joyful Love;
lines.transliteration: sadaa rang raat ay tayrai chaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You Yourself come to dwell in their minds.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aap vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: They obtain eternal glory.
lines.transliteration: aapay sobhaa sad  hee paa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh maylai mayl milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the love of the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raat ay sabad  rangaa-ay.

lines.english: They abide in the home of their own being, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: They are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they look so beautiful.
lines.transliteration: rang chaloolai har ras bhaa-ay.

lines.english: This dye never fades away; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih rang kaday na ut rai saach samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Shabad deep within the nucleus of the self dispels the darkness of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  miti-aa agi-aan anDh ayraa.

lines.english: Meeting with my Friend, the True Guru, I have obtained spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: satgur gi-aan mili-aa pareet am mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the True Lord, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.
lines.transliteration: jo sach raatay t in bahurh  na fayraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, my Perfect Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within. ||4||5|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 ] (798-9) bilaaval mehlaa 3. Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam drirh-aa-ay pooraa gur mayraa. ||4||5||

lines.english: From the Perfect Guru, I have obtained glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay vadi-aa-ee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਿਤਨ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has spontaneously come to abide in my mind.
lines.transliteration: achint naam vasi-aa man aa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away egotism and Maya.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa sabad jalaa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Guru, I have obtained honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dar saachai gur t ay sobh aa paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I serve the Lord of the Universe; I have no other work to do.
lines.transliteration: jagdees sayva-o mai avar na kaajaa.

lines.english: Night and day, my mind is in ecstasy; as Gurmukh, I beg for the bliss-giving Naam.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an-din anad  hovai man mayrai gurmukh  maaga-o t ayraa naam nivaajaa. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: From the mind itself, mental faith is obtained.
lines.transliteration: man kee parteet  man t ay paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, I have realized the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay sabad  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਸੇਵਉ  ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: How rare is that person, who looks upon life and death alike.
lines.transliteration: jeevan maran  ko samsar vaykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮਿਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਾਗਉ  ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਵਾਜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: She shall never die again, and shall not have to see the Messenger of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bahurh na marai naa jam paykh ai. ||2||

lines.english: Within the home of the self are all the millions of treasures.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee meh sabh  kot niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has revealed them, and my egotistical pride is gone.
lines.transliteration: satgur d ikhaa-ay ga-i-aa abh imaan.

lines.english: I keep my meditation always focused on the Cosmic Lord.
lines.transliteration: sad hee laagaa sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Night and day, I sing the One Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din gaavai ayko naam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਜਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have obtained glorious greatness in this age,
lines.transliteration: is jug meh vadi-aa-ee paa-ee.
pooray gur tay naam Dh i-aa-ee. from the Perfect Guru, meditating on the Naam.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: He is forever the Giver of peace; His worth cannot be estimated. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh -daata keemat  nahee paa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: By perfect destiny, I have found the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag gur pooraa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: He has revealed to me the treasure of the Naam, deep within the nucleus of my self.
lines.transliteration: antar naam niDh aan d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is so very sweet.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad at  meeth aa laa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, my thirst is quenched, and my mind and body have found peace. ||5||6||4||6||10|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 4 Gru 3  (798-18) raag bilaaval mehlaa 4 ghar 3 Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (798-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tarisan bujh ee man t an sukh  paa-i-aa. ||5||6||4||6||10||

lines.english: Effort and intelligence come from God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; asHe wills, they act.
lines.transliteration: udam mat  parabh  antarjaamee ji-o parayray t i-o karnaa.

lines.english: As the violinist plays upon the strings of the violin, so does the Lord play the living beings. ||1|| pMnw 799
lines.transliteration: ji-o natoo-aa tant  vajaa-ay t antee ti-o vaajeh jant  janaa. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, O mind.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam rasnaa.

lines.english: According to the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead, I have found theGuru, and the Lord abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mastak likh at likhay gur paa-i-aa har hird ai har basnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਖਤ  ਿਲਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Entangled in Maya, the mortal wanders around. Save Your humble servant, O Lord,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa girsat bh armat  hai paraanee rakh  layvhu jan apnaa.
ji-o par-hilaad harn aakhas garsi-o har raakh i-o har sarnaa. ||2|| as you saved Prahlaad from the clutches of Harnaakash; keep him in Your Sanctuary,Lord. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਗਰਸਿਤ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤੁ  ਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: How can I describe the state and the condition, O Lord, of those many sinners youhave purified?
lines.transliteration: kavan kavan kee gat mit  kahee-ai har kee-ay pat it pavannaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦੁ  ਹਰਣਾਖਿਸ ਗਰ੍ਿਸਓ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, who worked with hides and carried dead animals wassaved, by entering the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oh dhovai dh or haath cham chamray har uDh aari-o pari-o sarnaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਕਵਨ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਏ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਵੰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O God, Merciful to the meek, carry Your devotees across the world-ocean; I am asinner - save me from sin!
lines.transliteration: parabh d een d a-i-aal bh agat bhav taaran ham paapee raakh  papnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਢੋਵੈ ਢੋਰ ਹਾਿਥ  ਚਮੁ ਚਮਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਉਧਿਰਓ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਸਰਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak is the slave ofYour slaves. ||4||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (799-5) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har daasan d aas d aas ham karee-ahu jan naanak d aas d aasannaa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਗਤ  ਭਵ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਰਾਖੁ ਪਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Primal Being, O Lordbeyond birth.
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh mugaDh  agi-aan mat ee sarn aagat  purakh  ajnamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੰਨਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Have Mercy upon me, and save me, O my Lord and Master; I am a lowly stone, withno good karma at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa rakh layvhu mayray th aakur ham paathar heen akarmaa. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man bhaj raam naamai raamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਮਤੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਜਨਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instructions, obtain the sublime, subtle essence of the Lord; renounceother fruitless actions. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmat har ras paa-ee-ai hor t i-aagahu nihfal kaamaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ  ਹੀਨ ਅਕਰਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord are saved by the Lord; I am worthless - it is Yourglory to save me.
lines.transliteration: har jan sayvak say har taaray ham nirgun raakh  upmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have no other than You, O my Lord and Master; I meditate on the Lord, by my goodkarma. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na ko-ee mayray th aakur har japee-ai vaday karammaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹੋਿਰ ਿਤਆਗਹੁ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਕਾਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, their lives are cursed, and they mustendure terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: naamheen Dharig jeevt ay tin vad d ookh sahammaa.

lines.english: They are consigned to reincarnation over and over again; they are the most unfortunate fools, with no good karma at all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: o-ay fir fir jon bhavaa-ee-ah mand -bhaagee moorh  akarmaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਰਾਖੁ ਉਪਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is the Support of the Lord's humble servants; their good karma is pre-ordained.
lines.transliteration: har jan naam aDhaar hai Dh ur poorab likh ay vad karmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਵਡੇ ਕਰੰਮਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within servant Nanak, and his lifeis fruitful. ||4||2|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (799-11) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur satgur naam drirh -aa-i-aa jan naanak safal jannamaa. ||4||2||

lines.english: My consciousness is lured by emotional attachment and corruption; is is filled withevil-minded filth.
lines.transliteration: hamraa chit lubh at mohi bikh i-aa baho d urmat  mail bh araa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਵਾਈਅਿਹ  ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ  ਮੂੜ ਅਕਰਮਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I cannot serve You, O God; I am ignorant - how can I cross over? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumHree sayvaa kar na sakah parabh  ham ki-o kar mugaDh  taraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਧੁਿਰ ਪੂਰਿਬ ਿਲਖੇ ਵਡ ਕਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord of man.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap narhar naam narharaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨੰਮਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: God has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; meeting with the True Guru,he is carried across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jan oopar kirpaa parabh Dh aaree mil sat gur paar paraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O my Father, my Lord and Master, Lord God, please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: hamray pitaa th aakur parabh  su-aamee har d ayh mat ee jas karaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲੁਭਤ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Those who are attached to You are saved, like iron which is carried across with wood.||2||
lines.transliteration: tumHrai sang lagay say uDh ray ji-o sang kaasat loh t araa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਰ ਨ ਸਕਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਮ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਮੁਗਧ  ਤਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics have little or no understanding; they do not serve the Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: saakat nar hochh ee mat  maDh im jinH har har sayv na karaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਨਰਹਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those beings are unfortunate and vicious; they die, and are consigned toreincarnation, over and over again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tay nar bh aagheen d uhchaaree o-ay janam mu-ay fir maraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਧਾਰੀ  ਿਮਿਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O Lord and Master, bathe in the Guru'scleansing pool of contentment.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o tumH har maylhu su-aamee t ay nHaa-ay sant okh gur saraa.

lines.english: Vibrating upon the Lord, the filth of their evil-mindedness is washed away; servantNanak is carried across. ||4||3|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (799-17) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: durmat  mail ga-ee har bh aji-aa jan naanak paar paraa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Come, O Saints, and join together, O my Sib lings of Destiny; let us tell the Stories of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sant milhu mayray bh aa-ee mil har har kathaa karahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ  ਿਜਉ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਲੋਹ ਤਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman to ferry us across. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har naam bohith hai kaljug khayvat gur sabad  tarahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਿਤ ਮਿਧਮ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕਰਾ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har gun har uchrahu.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ  ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀ  ਓਇ ਜਨਿਮ  ਮੁਏ ਿਫਿਰ  ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: According to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon your forehead, sing the Praises of the Lord; join the Holy Congregation, and cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 800
lines.transliteration: mastak likh at likhay gun gaa-ay mil sangat  paar parahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Within the body-village is the Lord's supreme, sublime essence. How can I obtain it? Teach me, O humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar meh raam ras ootam ki-o paa-ee-ai upd ays jan karahu.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, you shall obtain the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan;meeting Him, drink in the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Nectar. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv safal har d arsan mil amrit  har ras pee-ahu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰ  ਮਿਹ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so sweet; O Saints of the Lord, taste it,and see.
lines.transliteration: har har naam amrit har meeth aa har sant ahu chaakh  dikhahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਫਲ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Under Guru's Instruction, the Lord's essence seems so sweet; through it, all corruptsensual pleasures are forgotten. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmat har ras meeth aa laagaa t in bisray sabh  bikh rasahu. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਚਾਿਖ  ਿਦਖਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all diseases; so serve the Lord, O humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ras raam rasaa-in har sayvhu sant  janhu.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਬਸਰੇ  ਸਿਭ ਿਬਖ ਰਸਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The four great blessings are obtained, O Nanak, by vibrating upon the Lord, underGuru's Instruction. ||4||4|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (800-5) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath chaaray paa-ay gurmat  naanak har bh ajahu. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Anyone, from any class - Kh'shaatriya, Brahman, Soodra or Vaishya - can chant, andmeditate on the Mantra of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: khatree baraahman  sood  vais ko jaapai har mant ar japainee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਹੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Worship the Guru, the True Guru, as the Supreme Lord God; serve Him constantly, allday and night. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur satgur paarbarahm kar poojahu nit  sayvhu d inas sabh  rainee. ||1||

lines.english: O humble servants of the Lord, behold the True Guru with your eyes.
lines.transliteration: har jan daykh hu sat gur nainee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ  ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਜਪੈਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever you wish for, you shall receive, chanting the Word of the Lord's Name,under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo ichhahu so-ee fal paavhu har bolhu gurmat  bainee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਸੇਵਹੁ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਸਭ ਰੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: People think of many and various efforts, but that alone happens, which is to happen.
lines.transliteration: anik upaav chitvee-ah bahut ayray saa hovai je baat  hovainee.

lines.english: All beings seek goodness for themselves, but what the Lord does - that may not be what we think and expect. ||2||
lines.transliteration: apnaa bhalaa sabh  ko-ee baachh ai so karay je mayrai chit  na chit ainee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਬੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: So renounce the clever intellect of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord, nomatter how hard this may be.
lines.transliteration: man kee mat t i-aagahu har jan ayhaa baat  kathainee.

lines.english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; accept thewisdom of the Guru, the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din har har naam Dh i-aavahu gur sat gur kee mat  lainee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਿਚਤਵੀਅਿਹ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਜ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Wisdom, balanced wisdom is in Your power, O Lord and Master; I am the instrument, and You are the player, O Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: mat sumat  tayrai vas su-aamee ham jant  too purakh  jantainee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜ ਮੇਰੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਿਚਤੈਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O God, O Creator, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, as You wish, so do I speak.||4||5|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (800-11) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay parabh kart ay su-aamee ji-o bh aavai t ivai bulainee. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਿਤਆਗਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਏਹਾ ਬਾਤ ਕਠੈਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I meditate on the source of bliss, the Sublime Primal Being; night and day, I am inecstasy and bliss.
lines.transliteration: anad mool Dh i-aa-i-o purkh otam an-d in anad  anand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਲੈਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay kee kaan  chukaa-ee sabh  chookay jam kay chh anday. ||1|| The Righteous Judge of Dharma has no power over me; I have cast off allsubservience to the Messenger of Death. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਤੇਰੈ ਵਿਸ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਜੰਤੈਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate, O mind, on the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam gobinday.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਰਤੇ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਬੁਲੈਨੀ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur sat gur paa-i-aa gun  gaa-ay parmaanand ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The foolish faithless cynics are held captive by Maya; in Maya, they continuewandering, wandering around.
lines.transliteration: saakat moorh  maa-i-aa kay baDh ik vich maa-i-aa fireh firand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਮੂਲੁ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਅਨਦ  ਅਨੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: Burnt by desire, and bound by the karma of their past actions, they go round andround, like the ox at the mill press. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa jalat  kirat kay baaDh ay ji-o t aylee balad  bhavand ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੀ ਕਾਿਣ  ਚੁਕਾਈ  ਸਿਭ ਚੂਕੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਛੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs, who focus on serving the Guru, are saved; by great good fortune,they perform service.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayv lagay say uDh ray vadbh aagee sayv karand ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਿਬੰਦੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord obtain the fruits of their rewards, and the bonds ofMaya are all broken. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin har japi-aa tin fal paa-i-aa sabh  tootay maa-i-aa fand ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant. The Lord of theUniverse Himself is all by Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaakur aapay sayvak sabh  aapay aap govind ay.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, He Himself is All-pervading; as He keeps us, we remain. ||4||6|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (800-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 4 pVqwl Gru 13 ] (800-19) raag bilaaval mehlaa 4 parh-t aal gh ar 13. Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Thirteenth House:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aapay aap sabh vart ai ji-o raakh ai tivai rahand ay. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਧਕ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਿਫਰੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: bolhu bha-ee-aa raam naam pat it paavno.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਜਲਤ  ਿਕਰਤ  ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਿਜਉ  ਤੇਲੀ  ਬਲਦ  ਭਵੰਦੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord emancipates his Saints and devotees. pMnw 801
lines.transliteration: har sant bh agat taarno.

lines.english: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere;
lines.transliteration: har bharipuray rahi-aa.
jal thalay raam naam. the Name of the Lord is pervading the water and the land.

lines.english: So sing continuously of the Lord, the Dispeller of pain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nit gaa-ee-ai har d ookh bisaarno. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord has made my life fruitful and rewarding.
lines.transliteration: har kee-aa hai safal janam hamaaraa.

lines.english: I meditate on the Lord, the Dispeller of pain.
lines.transliteration: har japi-aa har dookh  bisaaranhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਹੈ ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have met the Guru, the Giver of liberation.
lines.transliteration: gur bhayti-aa hai mukat  daataa.

lines.english: The Lord has made my life's journey fruitful and rewarding.
lines.transliteration: har kee-ee hamaaree safal jaataa.

lines.english: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil sangtee gun gaavno. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, place your hopes in the Name of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: man raam naam kar aasaa.
bhaa-o d oojaa binas binaasaa. and your love of duality shall simply vanish.

lines.english: One who, in hope, remains unattached to hope,
lines.transliteration: vich aasaa ho-ay niraasee.
so jan mili-aa har paasee. such a humble being meets with his Lord.

lines.english: And one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name
lines.transliteration: ko-ee raam naam gun gaavno.

lines.english: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (801-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tis pag laavno. ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17|| - servant Nanak falls at his feet. ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 1  (801-6) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 1

lines.english: He is attached to what he sees.
lines.transliteration: nadree aavai t is si-o moh.

lines.english: How can I meet You, O Imperishable God?
lines.transliteration: ki-o milee-ai parabh abh inaasee t ohi.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Have Mercy upon me, and place me upon the Path;
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi maarag paavhu.
saaDhsangat  kai anchal laavhu. ||1|| let me be attached to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly. ||1||

lines.english: How can I cross over the poisonous world-ocean?
lines.transliteration: ki-o taree-ai bikh i-aa sansaar.

lines.english: The True Guru is the boat to carry us across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur bohith paavai paar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The wind of Maya blows and shakes us,
lines.transliteration: pavan jhulaaray maa-i-aa d ay-ay.
har kay bhagat  sadaa thir say-ay. but the Lord's devotees remain ever-stable.

lines.english: They remain unaffected by pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog t ay raheh niraaraa.

lines.english: The Guru Himself is the Savior above their heads. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sir oopar aap guroo rakhvaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Maya, the snake, holds all in her coils.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa vayrh maa-i-aa sarab bh u-i-angaa.

lines.english: They burn to death in egotism, like the moth lured by seeing the flame.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai pachay deepak d aykh patangaa.

lines.english: They make all sorts of decorations, but they do not find the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sagal seegaar karay nahee paavai.

lines.english: When the Guru becomes Merciful, He leads them to meet the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ho-ay kirpaal taa guroo milaavai. ||3||

lines.english: I wander around, sad and depressed, seeking the jewel of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o fira-o udaasee mai ik rat an dasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: This priceless jewel is not obtained by any efforts.
lines.transliteration: nirmolak heeraa milai na upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: That jewel is within the body, the Temple of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa mandar t is meh laal.

lines.english: The Guru has torn away the veil of illusion, and beholding the jewel, I am delighted. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur kholi-aa parh -daa daykh bha-ee nihaal. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਫਰਉ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਦਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who has tasted it, comes to know its flavor;
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhi-aa t is aa-i-aa saad .
ji-o goongaa man meh bismaad. he is like the mute, whose mind is filled with wonder.

lines.english: I see the Lord, the source of bliss, everywhere.
lines.transliteration: aanad roop sabh  nadree aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merges in Him. ||5||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (801-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har gun aakh  samaa-i-aa. ||5||1||

lines.english: The Divine Guru has blessed me with total happiness.
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aan kee-ay gurd ayv.

lines.english: He has linked His servant to His service.
lines.transliteration: sayvak apnee laa-i-o sayv.

lines.english: No obstacles block my path, meditating on the incomprehensible, inscrutable Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: bighan na laagai jap alakh  abhayv. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਆਿਖ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharat  puneet  bha-ee gun gaa-ay. The soil has been sanctified, singing the Glories of His Praises.
The sins are eradicated, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: durat ga-i-aa har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is pervading everywhere;
lines.transliteration: sabhnee thaaN-ee ravi-aa aap.
aad jugaad  jaa kaa vad part aap. from the very beginning, and throughout the ages, His Glory has been radiantly manifest.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, sorrow does not touch me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad na ho-ay sant aap. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru's Feet seem so sweet to my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan lagay man meethay.

lines.english: He is unobstructed, dwelling everywhere.
lines.transliteration: nirbighan ho-ay sabh  thaaN-ee vooth ay.

lines.english: I found total peace, when the Guru was pleased. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  paa-ay sat gur toothay. ||3||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has become my Savior.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh bh a-ay rakh vaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see Him there with me.
lines.transliteration: jithai kithai deeseh naalay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master protects and cherishes His slaves. ||4||2|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (801-19) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kh asam part ipaalay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਲਗੇ ਮਿਨ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
lines.english: You are the treasure of peace, O my Beloved God. pMnw 802
lines.transliteration: sukh niDh aan pareet am parabh  mayray.

lines.english: Your Glories are uncounted, O God, my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: agnat gun  thaakur parabh  tayray.

lines.english: I am an orphan, entering Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: mohi anaath tumree sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: Have Mercy on me, O Lord, that I may meditate on Your Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har charan Dhi-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Take pity upon me, and abide within my mind;
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu bashu man aa-ay.

lines.english: I am worthless - please let me grasp hold of the hem of Your robe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun leejai larh laa-ay. rahaa-o.

lines.english: When God comes into my consciousness, what misfortune can strike me?
lines.transliteration: parabh chit  aavai t aa kaisee bh eerh.

lines.english: The Lord's servant does not suffer pain from the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: har sayvak naahee jam peerh.

lines.english: All pains are dispelled, when one remembers the Lord in meditation;
lines.transliteration: sarab dookh  har simrat  nasay.

lines.english: God abides with him forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sang sadaa parabh  basai. ||2||

lines.english: The Name of God is the Support of my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: parabh kaa naam man t an aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body is reduced to ashes.
lines.transliteration: bisrat naam hovat  tan chh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: When God comes into my consciousness, all my affairs are resolved.
lines.transliteration: parabh chit  aa-ay pooran sabh  kaaj.

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, one becomes subservient to all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har bisrat sabh  kaa muht aaj. ||3||

lines.english: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sang laagee pareet.

lines.english: I am rid of all evil-minded ways.
lines.transliteration: bisar ga-ee sabh d urmat  reet.

lines.english: The Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is deep within my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar har har mant .

lines.english: O Nanak, eternal bliss fills the home of the Lord's devotees. ||4||3|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 Gru 2 XwnVIey kY Gir gwvxw  (802-7) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 ghar 2 yaanrh ee-ay kai gh ar gaavn aa Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Second House, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Yaan-Ree-Ay: <> siqgur pRswid ] (802-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt an kai gh ar sad aa anand. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
lines.english: You are the Support of my mind, O my Beloved, You are the Support of my mind.
lines.transliteration: mai man tayree tayk mayray pi-aaray mai man t ayree tayk.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: All other clever tricks are useless, O Beloved; You alone are my Protector. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar si-aanpaa birthee-aa pi-aaray raakh an ka-o t um ayk. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਯਾਨੜੀਏ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਗਾਵਣਾ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: One who meets with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, that humble person isenraptured.
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa jay milai pi-aaray so jan hot  nihaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: He alone serves the Guru, O Beloved, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa so karay pi-aaray jis no ho-ay da-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Fruitful is the form of the Divine Guru, O Lord and Master; He is overflowing with allpowers.
lines.transliteration: safal moorat gurd ay-o su-aamee sarab kalaa bh arpooray.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; He is ever- present, forever and ever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak gur paarbarahm parmaysar sadaa sad aa hajooray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਿਨਹਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I live by hearing, hearing of those who know their God.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  jeevaa so-ay t inaa kee jinH apunaa parabh  jaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: They contemplate the Lord's Name, they chant the Lord's Name, and their minds areimbued with the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har naam araaDheh naam vakaan eh har naamay hee man raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am Your servant; I beg to serve Your humble servants. By the karma of perfectdestiny, I do this.
lines.transliteration: sayvak jan kee sayvaa maagai poorai karam kamaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer: O my Lord and Master, may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Yourhumble servants. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee su-aamee t ayray jan d aykhan paavaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸੋਇ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੀ ਿਜਨ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: They are said to be very fortunate, O Beloved, who who dwell in the Society of theSaints.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee say kaadh ee-ah pi-aaray sant sangat  jinaa vaaso.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: They contemplate the Immaculate, Ambrosial Naam, and their minds are illuminated.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam araaDh ee-ai nirmal manai hovai pargaaso.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਾਗੈ  ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ ਕਮਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, O Beloved, and the fear of the Messengerof Death is ended.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh kaatee-ai pi-aaray chookai jam kee kaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ  ਪਾਵਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They alone obtain the Blessed Vision of this Darshan, O Nanak, who are pleasing to their God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tinaa paraapat  darsan naanak jo parabh  apnay bh aanay. ||3||

lines.english: O my lofty, incomparable and infinite Lord and Master, who can know Your GloriousVirtues?
lines.transliteration: ooch apaar bay-ant su-aamee ka-un  jaanai gun  tayray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਮਨੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ  ॥
lines.english: Those who sing them are saved, and those who listen to them are saved; all their sinsare erased.
