lines.transliteration: gaavtay uDh rahi sunt ay uDh rahi binsahi paap gh anayray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: You save the beasts, demons and fools, and even stones are carried across.
lines.transliteration: pasoo parayt mugaDh  ka-o t aaray paahan paar ut aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਣੇ  ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to You.||4||1||4|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (802-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ee sad aa sad aa balihaarai. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Renounce the tasteless water of corruption, O my companion, and drink in thesupreme nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bikhai ban feekaa t i-aag ree sakh ee-ay naam mahaa ras pee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਤੇ  ਉਧਰਿਹ  ਸੁਣਤੇ  ਉਧਰਿਹ  ਿਬਨਸਿਹ  ਪਾਪ ਘਨੇਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the taste of this nectar, all have drowned, and their souls have not foundhappiness.
lines.transliteration: bin ras chaakhay bud ga-ee saglee sukh ee na hovat  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਕਉ ਤਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: You have no honor, glory or power - become the slave of the Holy Saints. pMnw 803
lines.transliteration: maan mahat na sakat  hee kaa-ee saaDh aa daasee thee-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone look beautiful in the Court of the Lord, whom the Lord has made His Own. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak say dar sobh aavant ay jo parabh  apunai kee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਕੀਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Maya is a mirage, which deludes the mind, O my companion, like the scent-crazeddeer, or the transitory shade of a tree.
lines.transliteration: harichand-uree chit  bharam sakh ee-ay marig t arisnaa d arum chh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Maya is fickle, and does not go with you, O my companion; in the end, it will leaveyou.
lines.transliteration: chanchal sang na chaaltee sakh ee-ay ant  taj jaavat  maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਚਿਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਲਤੀ  ਸਖੀਏ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਤਿਜ ਜਾਵਤ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He may enjoy pleasures and sensual delights with supremely beautiful women, but noone finds peace in this way.
lines.transliteration: ras bhogan  at roop ras maat ay in sang sookh  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਸ ਭੋਗਣ  ਅਿਤ  ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an har saaDh  jan sakh ee-ay naanak jinee naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||2|| Blessed, blessed are the humble, Holy Saints of the Lord, O my companion. O Nanak,they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸਖੀਏ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Go, O my very fortunate companion: dwell in the Company of the Saints, and mergewith the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay bashu vadbhaagn ee sakh ee-ay sant aa sang samaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਬਸਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ  ਸਖੀਏ  ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: There, neither pain nor hunger nor disease will afflict you; enshrine love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: tah dookh na bh ookh na rog bi-aapai charan kamal liv laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going in reincarnation, when you enterthe Sanctuary of the Eternal Lord.
lines.transliteration: tah janam na maran  na aavan  jaanaa nihchal sarn ee paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ  ਨ ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Love does not end, and attachment does not grip you, O Nanak, when you meditateon the One Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paraym bichhohu na moh bi-aapai naanak har ayk Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਬਛੋਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, my Beloved has pierced my mind, and I am intuitivelyattuned to His Love.
lines.transliteration: darisat Dh aar man bayDh i-aa pi-aaray rat -rhay sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਾਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਰਤੜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: My bed is embellished, meeting with my Beloved; in ecstasy and bliss, I sing HisGlorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sayj suhaavee sang mil pareetam anad  mangal gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O my friends and companions, I am imbued with the Lord's Love; the desires of mymind and body are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahaylee raam rang raat ee man t an ichh  pujaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਰਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the wonder-struck soul blends with the Wonderful Lord; this state cannot bedescribed. ||4||2||5|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 Gru 4  (803-10) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 ghar 4 Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (803-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak achraj achraj si-o mili-aa kahnaa kachh oo na jaa-ay. ||4||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਅਚਰਜ  ਿਸਉ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: The entire Universe is the form of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayk roop saglo paasaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself is the trade, and He Himself is the trader. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay banaj aap bi-uhaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: How rare is that one who is blessed with such spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: aiso gi-aan birlo ee paa-ay.

lines.english: Wherever I go, there I see Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jat jat  jaa-ee-ai t at daristaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He manifests many forms, while still unmanifest and absolute, and yet He has OneForm.
lines.transliteration: anik rang nirgun ik rangaa.

lines.english: He Himself is the water, and He Himself is the waves. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay jal aap hee tarangaa. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is the temple, and He Himself is selfless service.
lines.transliteration: aap hee mandar aapeh sayvaa.

lines.english: He Himself is the worshipper, and He Himself is the idol. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap hee poojaaree aap hee dayvaa. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself is the Yoga; He Himself is the Way.
lines.transliteration: aapeh jog aap hee jugtaa.

lines.english: Nanak's God is forever liberated. ||4||1||6|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (803-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay parabh sad  hee mukt aa. ||4||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ  ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself creates, and He Himself supports.
lines.transliteration: aap upaavan aap saDharnaa.

lines.english: He Himself causes all to act; He takes no blame Himself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap karaavan dos na lainaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: He Himself is the teaching, and He Himself is the teacher.
lines.transliteration: aapan bachan aap hee karnaa.

lines.english: He Himself is the splendor, and He Himself is the experiencer of it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapan bibha-o aap hee jarnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is silent, and He Himself is the speaker.
lines.transliteration: aap hee masat aap hee bulnaa.

lines.english: He Himself is undeceivable; He cannot be deceived. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap hee achhal na jaa-ee chh alnaa. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is manifest.
lines.transliteration: aap hee gupat aap pargatnaa.

lines.english: He Himself is in each and every heart; He Himself is unattached. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap hee ghat gh at aap alipanaa. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself is absolute, and He Himself is with the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aapay avigat aap sang rachnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਮਸਿਟ  ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਬੁਲਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, all are beggars of God. ||4||2||7|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (803-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh kay sabh  jachnaa. ||4||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਅਛਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਛਲਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He places the one who strays back on the Path;
lines.transliteration: bhoolay maarag jineh bat aa-i-aa.
aisaa gur vadbhaagee paa-i-aa. ||1|| such a Guru is found by great good fortune. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਿਲਪਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditate, contemplate the Name of the Lord, O mind.
lines.transliteration: simar manaa raam naam chitaaray.

lines.english: The Beloved Feet of the Guru abide within my heart. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 804
lines.transliteration: bas rahay hirdai gur charan pi-aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mohi man leenaa.

lines.english: Breaking my bonds, the Guru has liberated me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaat mukat  gur keenaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਲੋਿਭ ਮੋਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Experiencing pain and pleasure, one is born, only to die again.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  karat  janam fun moo-aa.

lines.english: The Lotus Feet of the Guru bring peace and shelter. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gur aasram dee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਫੁਿਨ ਮੂਆ ॥
lines.english: The world is drowning in the ocean of fire.
lines.transliteration: agan saagar boodat sansaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, holding me by the arm, the True Guru has saved me. ||4||3||8|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (804-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak baah pakar satgur nist aaraa. ||4||3||8||

lines.english: Body, mind, wealth and everything, I surrender to my Lord.
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an arpa-o sabh  apnaa.

lines.english: What is that wisdom, by which I may come to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har?||1||
lines.transliteration: kavan so mat jit  har har japnaa. ||1||

lines.english: Nurturing hope, I have come to beg from God.
lines.transliteration: kar aasaa aa-i-o parabh maagan.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ  ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon You, the courtyard of my heart is embellished. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumH paykh at sobh aa mayrai aagan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਸੁ ਮਿਤ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Trying several methods, I reflect deeply upon the Lord.
lines.transliteration: anik jugat kar bahut  beechaara-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this mind is saved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang is maneh uDh aara-o. ||2||

lines.english: I have neither intelligence, wisdom, common sense nor cleverness.
lines.transliteration: mat buDh  surat  naahee chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: I meet You, only if You lead me to meet You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa milee-ai jaa la-ay milaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: nain santokh ay parabh  darsan paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, such a life is fruitful and rewarding. ||4||4||9|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (804-7) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak safal so aa-i-aa. ||4||4||9||

lines.english: Mother, father, children and the wealth of Maya, will not go along with you.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  saath na maa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pain is dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang sabh  dookh mitaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: God Himself is pervading, and permeating all.
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa parabh sabh  meh aapay.

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, and pain will not afflict you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jap rasnaa dukh  na vi-aapay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who is afflicted by the terrible fire of thirst and desire,
lines.transliteration: tikhaa bh ookh baho t apat vi-aapi-aa.
seetal bh a-ay har har jas jaapi-aa. ||2|| becomes cool, chanting the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

lines.english: By millions of efforts, peace is not obtained;
lines.transliteration: kot jatan sant okh na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਆਪੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: man taript aanaa har gun  gaa-i-aa. ||3|| the mind is satisfied only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Please bless me with devotion, O God, O Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: dayh bh agat parabh  antarjaamee.

lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord and Master. ||4||5||10|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (804-11) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee su-aamee. ||4||5||10||

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Perfect Guru is found.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa vadbhaagee paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲ  ਭਏ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਿਪਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Holy Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo har naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh t ayree sarnaa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Guru's Feet, sinful mistakes are erased. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh kaatai bh aj gur kay charnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All other rituals are just worldly affairs;
lines.transliteration: avar karam sabh lokaachaar.
mil saaDhoo sang ho-ay uDh aar. ||2|| joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||

lines.english: One may contemplate the Simritees, Shaastras and Vedas,
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  bayd  beechaaray.
japee-ai naam jit paar ut aaray. ||3|| but only by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is one saved and carried across. ||3||

lines.english: Have Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God,
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o parabh kirpaa karee-ai.

lines.english: ||4||6||11|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (804-15) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo Dh oor milai nist aree-ai. ||4||6||11|| and bless him with the dust of the feet of the Holy, that he may be emancipated.

lines.english: I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart;
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad rid ay meh cheenaa.
sagal manorath pooran aaseenaa. ||1|| all my hopes and desires are fulfilled. ||1||

lines.english: The faces of the humble Saints are radiant and bright;
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kaa mukh  oojal keenaa.
kar kirpaa apunaa naam deenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. the Lord has mercifully blessed them with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.||1||Pause||

lines.english: Holding them by the hand, He has lifted them up out of the deep, dark pit,
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay kar geh leenaa.
jai jai kaar jagat pargateenaa. ||2|| and their victory is celebrated throughout the world. ||2||

lines.english: He elevates and exalts the lowly, and fills the empty.
lines.transliteration: neechaa tay ooch oon pooreenaa.

lines.english: They receive the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam mahaa ras leenaa. ||3||

lines.english: The mind and body are made immaculate and pure, and sins are burnt to ashes.
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal paap jal kh eenaa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God is pleased with me. ||4||7||12|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (804-19) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh bh a-ay parseenaa. ||4||7||12||

lines.english: All desires are fulfilled, O my friend, pMnw 805
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath paa-ee-ah meetaa.
charan kamal si-o laa-ee-ai cheetaa. ||1|| lovingly centering your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree jo parabhoo Dh i-aavat .

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਿਨ  ਬੁਝੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fire of desire is quenched, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhai har har gun gaavat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One's life become fruitful and rewarding, by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: safal janam hovat vadbh aagee.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, enshrine love for the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang raameh liv laagee. ||2||

lines.english: Wisdom, honor, wealth, peace and celestial bliss are attained, if one does not forget the Lord of supreme bliss, even for an instant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mat pat  Dhan sukh  sahj anand aa. ik nimakh  na visrahu parmaanand aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਪਿਤ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਅਨੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is so very thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: har darsan kee man pi-aas gh anayree.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, O God, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||4||8||13|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (805-4) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak saran  parabh  tayree. ||4||8||13||

lines.english: I am worthless, totally lacking all virtues.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun sabh gun ah bihoonaa.

lines.english: Bless me with Your Mercy, and make me Your Own. ||1||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aar apunaa kar leenaa. ||1||

lines.english: My mind and body are embellished by the Lord, the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man tan har gopaal suhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Granting His Mercy, God has come into the home of my heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh gh ar meh aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is the Lover and Protector of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al bhai kaatanhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੋਪਾਿਲ  ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Now, I have been carried across the world-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar ab utray paaray. ||2||

lines.english: It is God's Way to purify sinners, say the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan parabh  birad  bayd  laykh i-aa.

lines.english: I have seen the Supreme Lord with my eyes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm so nainhu paykhi-aa. ||3||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord becomes manifest.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang pargatay naaraa-in .

lines.english: O slave Nanak, all pains are relieved. ||4||9||14|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (805-8) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sabh  dookh palaa-in . ||4||9||14||

lines.english: Who can know the value of serving You, God?
lines.transliteration: kavan jaanai parabh t umHree sayvaa.

lines.english: God is imperishable, invisible and incomprehensible. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh avinaasee alakh  abhayvaa. ||1||

lines.english: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; God is profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: gun bay-ant  parabh  gahir gambh eeray.

lines.english: The Mansion of God, my Lord and Master, is lofty and high.
lines.transliteration: ooch mahal su-aamee parabh mayray.

lines.english: You are unlimited, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: too aprampar th aakur mayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There is no other than the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykas bin naahee ko doojaa.

lines.english: You alone know Your worship and adoration. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tumH hee jaanhu apnee poojaa. ||2||

lines.english: No one can do anything by himself, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: aaphu kachhoo na hovat  bhaa-ee.

lines.english: He alone obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God bestows it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis parabh d ayvai so naam paa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, that humble being who pleases God,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo jan parabh bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan parabh  tin hee paa-i-aa. ||4||10||15|| he alone finds God, the treasure of virtue. ||4||10||15|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (805-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Extending His Hand, the Lord protected you in your mother's womb.
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  meh haath d ay raakh i-aa.

lines.english: Renouncing the sublime essence of the Lord, you have tasted the fruit of poison. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har ras chhod bikh i-aa fal chaakh i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and renounce all entanglements.
lines.transliteration: bhaj gobid  sabh  chhod janjaal.

lines.english: When the Messenger of Death comes to murder you, O fool, then your body will be shattered and helplessly crumble. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab jam aa-ay sanghaarai moorh ay tab tan binas jaa-ay bayhaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You hold onto your body, mind and wealth as your own,
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an apnaa kar thaapi-aa.
karanhaar ik nimakh na jaapi-aa. ||2|| and you do not meditate on the Creator Lord, even for an instant. ||2||

lines.english: You have fallen into the deep, dark pit of great attachment.
lines.transliteration: mahaa moh anDh koop pari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ  ਮਿਹ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: Caught in the illusion of Maya, you have forgotten the Supreme Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm maa-i-aa patal bisri-aa. ||3||

lines.english: By great good fortune, one sings the Kirtan of God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag parabh  keert an gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, Nanak has found God. ||4||11||16|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (805-17) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satsang naanak parabh  paa-i-aa. ||4||11||16||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ  ਸੰਘਾਰੈ  ਮੂੜੇ ਤਬ ਤਨੁ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਬੇਹਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Mother, father, children, relatives and siblings
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  banDh ap bh aa-ee.

lines.english: - O Nanak, the Supreme Lord is our help and support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak ho-aa paarbarahm sahaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਿਪਆ  ॥
lines.english: He blesses us with peace, and abundant celestial bliss.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ghanay.

lines.english: Perfect is the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. His Virtues are so many, theycannot be counted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa pooree jaa kee banee anik gun aa jaa kay jaahi na gan ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God Himself makes all arrangements.
lines.transliteration: sagal saraNjaam karay parabh aapay.

lines.english: Meditating on God, desires are fulfilled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay manorath so parabh  jaapay. ||2||

lines.english: He is the Giver of wealth, Dharmic faith, pleasure and liberation. pMnw 806
lines.transliteration: arath Dharam kaam mokh  kaa d aataa.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, I am fulfilled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pooree bha-ee simar simar biDh aataa. ||3||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak rang maan i-aa.

lines.english: He has returned home, with the Perfect Guru. ||4||12||17|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (806-2) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ghar aa-i-aa poorai gur aan i-aa. ||4||12||17||

lines.english: All treasures come from the Perfect Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan pooran gurd ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the man lives.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japat nar jeevay.

lines.english: The faithless cynic dies in shame and misery. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mar khu-aar saakat  nar theevay. ||1||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord has become my Protector.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ho-aa rakhvaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਨਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
lines.english: The wretched, faithless cynic makes only useless efforts. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jhakh  maara-o saakat  vaychaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Spreading slander, many have been ruined.
lines.transliteration: nindaa kar kar pacheh gh anayray.

lines.english: Their necks, heads and feet are tied by death's noose. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mirtak faas galai sir pairay. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, the humble devotees chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaapeh jan naam.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||4||13||18|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 Gru 4 dupdy  (806-6) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 ghar 4 d upday Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (806-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: taa kay nikat na aavai jaam. ||4||13||18||

lines.english: What blessed destiny will lead me to meet my God?
lines.transliteration: kavan sanjog mila-o parabh apnay.

lines.english: Each and every moment and instant, I continually meditate on the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pal pal nimakh sad aa har japnay. ||1||

lines.english: I meditate continually on the Lotus Feet of God.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal parabh kay nit  Dhi-aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: What wisdom will lead me to attain my Beloved? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kavan so mat jit  pareet am paava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Please, bless me with such Mercy, O my God,
lines.transliteration: aisee kirpaa karahu parabh mayray.

lines.english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naanak bisar na kaahoo bayray. ||2||1||19|| that Nanak may never, ever forget You. ||2||1||19|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (806-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Within my heart, I meditate on the Lotus Feet of God.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal parabh hird ai Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: Disease is gone, and I have found total peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rog ga-ay saglay sukh paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru relieved my sufferings, and blessed me with the gift.
lines.transliteration: gur dukh  kaati-aa d eeno d aan.

lines.english: My birth has been rendered fruitful, and my life is approved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: safal janam jeevan parvaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Bani of God's Word is the Unspoken Speech.
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa amrit parabh  baanee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the spiritually wise live by meditating on God. ||2||2||20|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (806-11) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jap jeevay gi-aanee. ||2||2||20||

lines.english: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, has blessed me with peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: saaNt paa-ee gur sat gur pooray.

lines.english: Peace and joy have welled up, and the mystical trumpets of the unstruck sound current vibrate. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh upjay baajay anhad  tooray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sufferings, sins and afflictions have been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: taap paap sant aap binaasay.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all sinful mistakes have been erased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har simrat kilvikh  sabh  naasay. ||1||

lines.english: Joining together, O beautiful soul-brides, celebrate and make merry.
lines.transliteration: anad karahu mil sund ar naaree.

lines.english: Guru Nanak has saved my honor. ||2||3||21|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (806-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak mayree paij savaaree. ||2||3||21||

lines.english: Intoxicated with the wine of attachment, love of worldly possessions and deceit, andbound in bondage, he is wild and hideous.
lines.transliteration: mamtaa moh Dh aroh mad  maat aa banDh an baaDh i-aa at  bikraal.

lines.english: Day by day, his life is winding down; practicing sin and corruption, he is trapped bythe noose of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: din din chh ijat bikaar karat  a-oDh  faahee faathaa jam kai jaal. ||1||

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  parabh  deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: I have crossed over the terrible, treacherous, enormous world-ocean, with the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikham saagar at  bhaaree uDh rahu saaDh oo sang ravaalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O God, Giver of peace, All-powerful Lord and Master, my soul, body and all wealth areYours.
lines.transliteration: parabh sukh -daatay samrath su-aamee jee-o pind sabh  tumraa maal.

lines.english: ||2||4||22|| Please, break my bonds of doubt, O Transcendent Lord, forever Merciful God ofNanak. ||2||4||22|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (806-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bharam kay banDh an kaatahu parmaysar naanak kay parabh  sadaa kirpaal.

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord has brought bliss to all; He has confirmed His Natural Way.
lines.transliteration: sagal anand kee-aa parmaysar apnaa birad  samHaari-a.

lines.english: He has become Merciful to the humble, holy Saints, and all my relatives blossom forthin joy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa ho-ay kirpaalaa bigsay sabh  parvaari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The True Guru Himself has resolved my affairs. pMnw 807
lines.transliteration: kaaraj satgur aap savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕੀ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has blessed Hargobind with long life, and taken care of my comfort, happiness and well-being. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vadee aarjaa har gobind kee sookh  mangal kali-aan  beechaari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The forests, meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in greenery; He gives His Support to all beings.
lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan hari-aa ho-ay saglay jee-a saaDh aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਣ ਿਤਰ੍ਣ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਸਾਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires; his desires are totally fulfilled.||2||5||23|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (807-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man ichhay naanak fal paa-ay pooran ichh  pujaari-aa. ||2||5||23||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ  ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥੫॥੨੩॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy,
lines.transliteration: jis oopar hovat d a-i-aal.
har simrat kaatai so kaal. ||1|| rahaa-o. passes his time in contemplative meditation. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lordof the Universe.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh ajee-ai gopaal.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the noose of death is cut away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat t ootai jam jaal. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Cherisher.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur aapay part ipaal.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||2||6||24|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (807-5) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai saaDh ravaal. ||2||6||24||

lines.english: Irrigate your mind with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man meh sinchahu har har naam.

lines.english: Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din keert an har gun  gaam. ||1||

lines.english: Enshrine such love, O my mind,
lines.transliteration: aisee pareet karahu man mayray.
aath pahar parabh  jaanhu nayray. ||1|| rahaa-o. that twenty-four hours a day, God will seem near to you. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one who has such immaculate destiny
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa kay nirmal bhaag.

lines.english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har charnee taa kaa man laag. ||2||7||25|| - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (807-7) bilaaval mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The disease is gone; God Himself took it away.
lines.transliteration: rog ga-i-aa parabh aap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I sleep in peace; peaceful poise has come to my home. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: need pa-ee sukh  sahj gh ar aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Eat to your fill, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: raj raj bhojan kaavahu mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rid  maahi Dh i-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ  ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru,
lines.transliteration: naanak gur pooray sarnaa-ee.

lines.english: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin apnay naam kee paij rakhaa-ee. ||2||8||26|| who has preserved the honor of His Name. ||2||8||26|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (807-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The True Guru has protected my hearth and home, and made them permanent.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur kar d eenay asthir gh ar baar. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਦ  ਪਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever slanders these homes, is pre-destined by the Creator Lord to be destroyed.||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jo nind karai in garihan kee t is aagai hee maarai kart aar. ||1||

lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; the Word of His Shabad is unbreakable andinfinite. ||2||9||27|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (807-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t aa kee sarnaa-ee jaa ko sabad  akhand apaar. ||2||9||27||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਜ ਰਿਜ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The fever and sickness are gone, and the diseases are all dispelled.
lines.transliteration: taap sant aap saglay ga-ay binsay t ay rog.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has forgiven you, so enjoy the happiness of the Saints. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm too bakh si-aa sant an ras bh og. rahaa-o.

lines.english: All joys have entered your world, and your mind and body are free of disease.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa t ayree mandlee t ayraa man t an aarog.

lines.english: So chant continuously the Glorious Praises of the Lord; this is the only potentmedicine. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavhu nit raam kay ih avkh ad jog. ||1||

lines.english: So come, and dwell in your home and native land; this is such a blessed andauspicious occasion.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay bashu ghar d ays meh ih bh alay sanjog.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨੇ  ਅਸਿਥਰ  ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with you; your time of separation has come to an end.||2||10||28|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (807-15) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh suparsan bh a-ay leh ga-ay bi-og. ||2||10||28||

lines.english: The entanglements of Maya do not go along with anyone.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo sang na chaalhee maa-i-aa janjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਿਨੰਦ  ਕਰੈ ਇਨ ਿਗਰ੍ਹਨ  ਕੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਹੀ ਮਾਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even kings and rulers must arise and depart, according to the wisdom of the Saints.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ooth siDh aaray chh atarpat santan kai kh i-aal. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਖੰਡ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੨॥੯॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Pride goes before the fall - this is a primal law.
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh ka-o binsanaa ih Dh ur kee dh aal.

lines.english: Those who practice corruption and sin, are born into countless incarnations, only to die again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baho jonee janmeh mareh bikhi-aa bikraal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਗਏ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
lines.english: The Holy Saints chant Words of Truth; they meditate continually on the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: sat bachan saaDh oo kaheh nit  jaapeh gupaal.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਤੂ ਬਖਿਸਆ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, those who are imbued with thecolor of the Lord's Love are carried across. ||2||11||29|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (807-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar simar naanak taray har kay rang laal. ||2||11||29||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with celestial Samaadhi, bliss and peace.
lines.transliteration: sahj samaaDh anand sookh  pooray gur d een.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੰਡਲੀ  ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਰੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: God is always my Helper and Companion; I contemplate His Ambrosial Virtues.||Pause|| pMnw 808
lines.transliteration: sadaa sahaa-ee sang parabh  amrit  gun cheen. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਮਿਹ ਲੋਚਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Triumphant cheers greet me all across the world, and all beings yearn for me.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar jagtar meh locheh sabh  jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਭਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕਛੁ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru and God are totally pleased with me; no obstacle blocks my way. ||1||
lines.transliteration: suparsan bha-ay sat gur parabh oo kachh  bighan na thee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
lines.english: One who has the Merciful Lord God on his side - everyone becomes his slave.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa ang da-i-aal parabh  taa kay sabh  daas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, O Nanak, glorious greatness rests with the Guru. ||2||12||30|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 Gru 5 caupdy  (808-3) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 ghar 5 cha-upd ay Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (808-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa vad i-aa-ee-aa naanak gur paas. ||2||12||30||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: This perishable realm and world has been made like a house of sand.
lines.transliteration: mitar mandal jag saaji-aa ji-o baaloo gh ar baar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਜਗੁ ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਲੂ  ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.english: In no time at all, it is destroyed, like the paper drenched with water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binsat baar na laag-ee ji-o kaagad  booNdaar. ||1||

lines.english: Listen to me, people: behold, and consider this within your mind.
lines.transliteration: sun mayree mansaa manai maahi sat d aykh beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਿਤ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas, the seekers, house-holders and Yogis have forsaken their homes and left. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik girhee jogee t aj ga-ay gh ar baar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਤਿਜ ਗਏ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: This world is like a dream in the night.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa supnaa rain kaa taisaa sansaar.

lines.english: All that is seen shall perish. Why are you attached to it, you fool? ||2||
lines.transliteration: daristimaan sabh  binsee-ai ki-aa lageh gavaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਰੈਿਨ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Where are your brothers and friends? Open your eyes and see!
lines.transliteration: kahaa so bhaa-ee meet  hai d aykh nain pasaar.

lines.english: Some have gone, and some will go; everyone must take his turn. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ik chaalay ik chaalsahi sabh apnee vaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਭਾਈ  ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਨੈਨ ਪਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the Perfect True Guru, remain ever-stable at the Door of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin pooraa satgur sayvi-aa say asthir har d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਚਾਲੇ  ਇਿਕ  ਚਾਲਸਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਅਪਨੀ  ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; preserve his honor, O Lord, Destroyer of ego. ||4||1||31|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (808-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai raakh  paij muraar. ||4||1||31||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਸੇ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The glories of the world, I cast into the fire.
lines.transliteration: lokan kee-aa vadi-aa-ee-aa baisant ar paaga-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.english: I chant those words, by which I may meet my Beloved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o milai pi-aaraa aapnaa tay bol karaaga-o. ||1||

lines.english: When God becomes Merciful, then He enjoins me to His devotional service.
lines.transliteration: ja-o parabh jee-o d a-i-aal ho-ay t a-o bh agtee laaga-o.

lines.english: My mind clings to worldly desires; meeting with the Guru, I have renounced them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lapat rahi-o man baasnaa gur mil ih ti-aaga-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I pray with intense devotion, and offer this soul to Him.
lines.transliteration: kara-o bayntee at  ghanee ih jee-o homaaga-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਹੋਇ ਤਉ ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਗਉ  ॥
lines.english: I would sacrifice all other riches, for a moment's union with my Beloved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: arath aan sabh vaari-aa pari-a nimakh  sohaaga-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲਪਿਟ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਇਹ ਿਤਆਗਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, I am rid of the five villains, as well as emotional love and hate.
lines.transliteration: panch sang gur tay chh utay d okh ar raaga-o.

lines.english: My heart is illumined, and the Lord has become manifest; night and day, I remainawake and aware. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ridai pargaas pargat bh a-i-aa nis baasur jaaga-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਅਿਤ  ਘਨੀ  ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਹੋਮਾਗਉ  ॥
lines.english: The blessed soul-bride seeks His Sanctuary; her destiny is recorded on her forehead.
lines.transliteration: saran sohaagan aa-i-aa jis mast ak bh aaga-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, she obtains her Husband Lord; her body and mind are cooled andsoothed. ||4||2||32|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (808-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tin paa-i-aa t an man seet laaga-o. ||4||2||32||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਗਉ  ॥
lines.english: One is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: laal rang tis ka-o lagaa jis kay vadbh aagaa.

lines.english: This color is never muddied; no stain ever sticks to it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mailaa kaday na hova-ee nah laagai d aagaa. ||1||

lines.english: He finds God, the Giver of peace, with feelings of joy.
lines.transliteration: parabh paa-i-aa sukh -daa-ee-aa mili-aa sukh  bhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਉ  ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.english: The Celestial Lord blends into his soul, and he can never leave Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sahj samaanaa bheet ray chh odi-aa nah jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Old age and death cannot touch him, and he shall not suffer pain again.
lines.transliteration: jaraa maraa nah vi-aapa-ee fir dookh  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਰੰਗੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਾ  ਿਜਸ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is satisfied; the Guru makes him immortal. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pee amrit aagh aani-aa gur amar karaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ  ਦਾਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone knows its taste, who tastes the Priceless Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so jaanai jin chaakhi-aa har naam amolaa.

lines.english: Its value cannot be estimated; what can I say with my mouth? ||3||
lines.transliteration: keemat kahee na jaa-ee-ai ki-aa kahi mukh  bolaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਨਾ  ਭੀਤਰੇ  ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਨਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Supreme Lord God. The Word of Your Bani is the treasure of virtue. pMnw 809
lines.transliteration: safal daras t ayraa paarbarahm gun  niDh tayree ban ee.

lines.english: Please bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||4||3||33|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (809-1) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paava-o Dhoor t ayray d aas kee naanak kurbaan ee. ||4||3||33||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਉ  ਧੂਿਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Keep me under Your Protection, God; shower me with Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: raakho apnee saran  parabh  mohi kirpaa Dh aaray.

lines.english: I do not know how to serve You; I am just a low-life fool. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sayvaa kachhoo na jaan-oo neech moorkh aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I take pride in You, O my Darling Beloved.
lines.transliteration: maan kara-o tuDh  oopray mayray pareet am pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਊ  ਨੀਚੁ ਮੂਰਖਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, continuously making mistakes; You are the Forgiving Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham apraaDhee sad  bhooltay tumH bakh sanhaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ  ਤੁਧੁ ਊਪਰੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I make mistakes each and every day. You are the Great Giver;
lines.transliteration: ham avgan karah asaNkh neet  tumH nirgun d aataaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਸਦ ਭੂਲਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am worthless. I associate with Maya, your hand-maiden, and I renounce You, God;such are my actions. ||2||
lines.transliteration: daasee sangat  parabh oo ti-aag ay karam hamaaray. ||2||

lines.english: You bless me with everything, showering me with Mercy; And I am such an ungratefulwretch!
lines.transliteration: tumH dayvhu sabh  kichh  da-i-aa Dh aar ham akirat -ghanaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਨ  ਕਰਹ ਅਸੰਖ  ਨੀਿਤ  ਤੁਮ ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਦਾਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am attached to Your gifts, but I do not even think of You, O my Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: laag paray tayray d aan si-o nah chit  khasmaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਏ ਕਰਮ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There is none other than You, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar kichh  nahee bh av kaatanhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਹਮ ਅਿਕਰਤਘਨਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Guru; I am so foolish - please,save me! ||4||4||34|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (809-7) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak saran d a-i-aal gur layho mugaDh  uDhaaray. ||4||4||34||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਗ  ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨ  ਿਸਉ ਨਹ ਿਚਿਤ  ਖਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Don't blame anyone else; meditate on your God.
lines.transliteration: dos na kaahoo d eejee-ai parabh  apnaa Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Serving Him, great peace is obtained; O mind, sing His Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jit sayvi-ai sukh  ho-ay gh anaa man so-ee gaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਗੁਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੪॥੩੪॥
lines.english: O Beloved, other than You, who else should I ask?
lines.transliteration: kahee-ai kaa-ay pi-aaray tujh  binaa.

lines.english: You are my Merciful Lord and Master; I am filled with all faults. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumH da-i-aal su-aamee sabh  avgan hamaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਜੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: As You keep me, I remain; there is no other way.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tumH raakh o ti-o rahaa avar nahee chaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਨਾ  ਮਨ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Support of the unsupported; You Name is my only Support. ||2||
lines.transliteration: neeDhri-aa Dh ar tayree-aa ik naam aDh aaraa. ||2||

lines.english: One who accepts whatever You do as good - that mind is liberated.
lines.transliteration: jo tumH karahu so-ee bh alaa man layt aa mukt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਭ ਅਵਗਨ  ਹਮਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The entire creation is Yours; all are subject to Your Ways. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree tayree-aa sabh  tayree jugt aa. ||3||

lines.english: I wash Your Feet and serve You, if it pleases You, O Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: charan pakhaara-o kar sayvaa jay th aakur bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਿਤਉ  ਰਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Be Merciful, O God of Compassion, that Nanak may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||5||35|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (809-11) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal da-i-aal parabh  naanak gun  gaavai. ||4||5||35||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਧਿਰਆ  ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀਆ  ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Death hovers over his head, laughing, but the beast does not understand.
lines.transliteration: mirat hasai sir oopray pasoo-aa nahee boojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਮਿਨ ਲੇਤਾ  ਮੁਕਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Entangled in conflict, pleasure and egotism, he does not even think of death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baad saad  ahaNkaar meh marn aa nahee soojh ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਤੇਰੀਆ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: So serve your True Guru; why wander around miserable and unfortunate?
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvhu aapnaa kaahay firahu abh aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਪਖਾਰਉ ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: You gaze upon the transitory, beautiful safflower, but why do you get attached to it? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daykh  kasumbh aa rangulaa kaahay bh ool laagay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥੫॥੩੫॥
lines.english: You commit sins again and again, to gather wealth to spend.
lines.transliteration: kar kar paap darab kee-aa vart an kai taa-ee.

lines.english: But your dust shall mix with dust; you shall arise and depart naked. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maatee si-o maatee ralee naagaa uth jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Those for whom you work, will become your spiteful enemies.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kee-ai saram karai tay bair biroDh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ  ਮਿਹ ਮਰਣਾ  ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the end, they will run away from you; why do you burn for them in anger? ||3||
lines.transliteration: ant kaal bh aj jaahigay kaahay jalahu karoDh ee. ||3||

lines.english: He alone becomes the dust of the Lord's slaves, who has such good karma upon hisforehead.
lines.transliteration: daas rayn  so-ee ho-aa jis mast ak karmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ  ਰੰਗੁਲਾ  ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਿਲ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, he is released from bondage, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru.||4||6||36|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (809-16) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak banDhan chh utay sat gur kee sarnaa. ||4||6||36||

lines.english: The cripple crosses over the mountain, the fool becomes a wise man,
lines.transliteration: pingul parbat paar paray kh al chat ur bakeet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਪਾਪ ਦਰਬੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਵਰਤਣ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: anDhulay t aribhavan soojh i-aa gur bh ayt puneet aa. ||1|| and the blind man sees the three worlds, by meeting with the True Guru and being purified. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਟੀ  ਿਸਉ ਮਾਟੀ  ਰਲੀ ਨਾਗਾ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This is the Glory of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; listen, O my friends.
lines.transliteration: mahimaa saaDhoo sang kee sunhu mayray meet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਐ ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ਿਬਰੋਧੀ  ॥
lines.english: Filth is washed away, millions of sins are dispelled, and the consciousness becomesimmaculate and pure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mail kho-ee kot agh  haray nirmal bh a-ay cheet aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਿਲ  ਭਿਜ ਜਾਿਹਗੇ  ਕਾਹੇ ਜਲਹੁ ਕਰੋਧੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Such is devotional worship of the Lord of the Universe, that the ant can overpower theelephant.
lines.transliteration: aisee bhagat  govind  kee keet hast ee jeet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਕਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever the Lord makes His own, is blessed with the gift of fearlessness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo jo keeno aapno tis abh ai daan d eetaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਛੁਟੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥੩੬॥
lines.english: The lion becomes a cat, and the mountain looks like a blade of grass. pMnw 810
lines.transliteration: singh bilaa-ee ho-ay ga-i-o t arin mayr d ikheetaa.

lines.english: Those who worked for half a shell, will be judged very wealthy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saram kartay d am aadh  ka-o t ay ganee Dh aneet aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਦਮ ਆਢ  ਕਉ ਤੇ ਗਨੀ  ਧਨੀਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What glorious greatness of Yours can I describe, O Lord of infinite excellences?
lines.transliteration: kavan vadaa-ee kahi saka-o bay-ant guneet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਵਡਾਈ  ਕਿਹ ਸਕਉ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਗੁਨੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and grant me Your Name; O Nanak, I am lost without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||7||37|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (810-2) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi naam dayh naanak d ar sareet aa. ||4||7||37||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੋਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰ ਸਰੀਤਾ  ॥੪॥੭॥੩੭॥
lines.english: He is constantly entangled in pride, conflict, greed and tasty flavors.
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh parbaad  neet lobh rasnaa saad .

lines.english: He is involved in deception, fraud, household affairs and corruption. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lapat kapat garihi bayDhi-aa mithi-aa bikh i-aad. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਪਰਬਾਦ  ਨੀਤ  ਲੋਭ ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen this with my eyes, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: aisee paykhee nayt ar meh pooray gur parsaad .

lines.english: Power, property, wealth and youth are useless, without the Naam, the Name of theLord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raaj milakh Dh an jobnaa naamai bin baad . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਪੇਖੀ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਮਿਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Beauty, incense, scented oils, beautiful clothes and foods
lines.transliteration: roop Dhoop soganDh -taa kaapar bh ogaad .
milat sang paapisat t an ho-ay d urgaad . ||2|| - when they come into contact with the body of the sinner, they stink. ||2||

lines.english: Wandering, wandering around, the soul is reincarnated as a human, but this bodylasts only for an instant.
lines.transliteration: firat firat  maanukh  bha-i-aa kh in bhangan d ayhaad .

lines.english: Losing this opportunity, he must wander again through countless incarnations. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih a-osar tay chooki-aa baho jon bh armaad . ||3||

lines.english: By God's Grace, he meets the Guru; contemplating the Lord, Har, Har, he is wonderstruck.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay gur milay har har bismaad .

lines.english: He is blessed with peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak, through the perfect sound currentof the Naad. ||4||8||38|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (810-8) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj naanak anand t aa kai pooran naad . ||4||8||38||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਅਉਸਰ  ਤੇ ਚੂਿਕਆ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਮਾਿਦ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The feet of the Saints are the boat, to cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: charan bha-ay sant  bohithaa t aray saagar jayt .

lines.english: In the wilderness, the Guru places them on the Path, and reveals the secrets of theLord's Mystery. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maarag paa-ay udi-aan meh gur d asay bh ayt. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨੰਦ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਨਾਦ  ॥੪॥੮॥੩੮॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har Har Har, Har Har Haray, Har Har Har, I love You.
lines.transliteration: har har har har har haray har har har hayt.

lines.english: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, think of the Lord, Har Har Har.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sovtay har har har chayt . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜੇਤ ॥
lines.english: The five thieves run away, when one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly.
lines.transliteration: panch chor aagai bhagay jab saaDh sangayt .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਗ  ਪਾਏ ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਮਿਹ ਗੁਿਰ ਦਸੇ ਭੇਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: His investment is intact, and he earns great profits; his household is blessed with honor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: poonjee saabat gh ano laabh  garihi sobh aa sayt . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.english: His position is unmoving and eternal, his anxiety is ended, and he wavers no more.
lines.transliteration: nihchal aasan mitee chint  naahee dolayt .

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਸੋਵਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚੇਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: His doubts and misgivings are dispelled, and he sees God everywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaavaa mit ga-i-aa parabh  paykh at nayt. ||3||

lines.english: The Virtues of our Virtuous Lord and Master are so profound; how many of HisGlorious Virtues should I speak?
lines.transliteration: gun gabh eer gun naa-ikaa gun  kahee-ahi kayt .

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਆਗੈ  ਭਗੇ ਜਬ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਤ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of theHoly. ||4||9||39|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (810-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paa-i-aa saaDhsang har har amrayt . ||4||9||39||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ  ਘਣੋ ਲਾਭੁ ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੨॥
lines.english: That life, which has no contact with the Holy, is useless.
lines.transliteration: bin saaDhoo jo jeevnaa t ayto birthaaree.

lines.english: Joining their congregation, all doubts are dispelled, and I am emancipated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: milat sang sabh  bharam mitay gat  bha-ee hamaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਭੁਲਾਵਾ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੇਖਤ  ਨੇਤ ॥੩॥
lines.english: That day, when I meet with the Holy - I am a sacrifice to that day.
lines.transliteration: jaa din bh aytay saaDh  mohi u-aa d in balihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਭੀਰ  ਗੁਨ ਨਾਇਕਾ  ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਕੇਤ ॥
lines.english: Again and again, I sacrifice my body, mind and soul to them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan man apno jee-araa fir fir ha-o vaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਮਰ੍ੇਤ  ॥੪॥੯॥੩੯॥
lines.english: They have helped me renounce this ego, and implant this humility within myself.
lines.transliteration: ayt chh adaa-ee mohi t ay itnee d arirh-taaree.

lines.english: This mind has become the dust of all men's feet, and my self-conceit has been dispelled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sagal rayn ih man bha-i-aa binsee apDh aaree. ||2||

lines.english: In an instant, I burnt away the ideas of slander and ill-will towards others.
lines.transliteration: nind chind  par d ookhnaa ay kh in meh jaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਿਭ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਿਮਟੇ ਗਿਤ  ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I see close at hand, the Lord of mercy and compassion; He is not far away at all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa ma-i-aa ar nikat paykh  naahee d ooraaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਦਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਮੋਿਹ ਉਆ  ਿਦਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, and now, I am liberated from the world.
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al bha-ay ab mukt ay sansaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨੋ  ਜੀਅਰਾ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Love, consciousness, the breath of life, wealth and everything, O Nanak, are in theBlessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||10||40|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (810-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: heet cheet  sabh  paraan Dh an naanak d arsaaree. ||4||10||40||

lines.english: I perform service for Your slave, O Lord, and wipe his feet with my hair.
lines.transliteration: tahal kara-o tayray d aas kee pag jh aara-o baal.

lines.english: I offer my head to him, and listen to the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the source of bliss. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mastak apnaa bh ayt day-o gun sun-o rasaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਰੇਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ਿਬਨਸੀ  ਅਪਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting You, my mind is rejuvenated, so please meet me, O Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: tumH miltay mayraa man jee-o t umH milhu d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Night and day, my mind enjoys bliss, contemplating the Lord of Compassion. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 811
lines.transliteration: nis baasur man anad hot  chitvat kirpaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God's Holy people are the saviors of the world; I grab hold of the hem of their robes.
lines.transliteration: jagat uDh aaran saaDh  parabh  tinH laagahu paal.

lines.english: Bless me, O God, with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o deejai d aan parabh  santan pag raal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤ  ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਸਾਧ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਤਨ  ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: I have no skill or wisdom at all, nor any work to my credit.
lines.transliteration: ukat si-aanap kachh  nahee naahee kachh  ghaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ  ਦਾਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਤਨ  ਪਗ ਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please, protect me from doubt, fear and emotional attachment, and cut away the noose of Death from my neck. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ai raakh o moh t ay kaatahu jam jaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਕਿਤ  ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: I beg of You, O Lord of Mercy, O my Father, please cherish me!
lines.transliteration: bin-o kara-o karunaapat ay pit aa part ipaal.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਤੇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I sing Your Glorious Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Lord, Home of peace. ||4||11||41|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (811-4) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun gaava-o t ayray saaDh sang naanak sukh  saal. ||4||11||41||

lines.english: Whatever You wish, You do. Without You, there is nothing.
lines.transliteration: keetaa lorh eh so karahi t ujh bin kachh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ  ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਲ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon Your Glory, the Messenger of Death leaves and goes away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: partaap t umHaaraa d aykh kai jamd oot chhad jaahi. ||1||

lines.english: By Your Grace, one is emancipated, and egotism is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay chh ootee-ai binsai ahaNmayv.

lines.english: God is omnipotent, possessing all powers; He is obtained through the Perfect, DivineGuru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa samrath parabh pooray gurd ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਸੋ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Searching, searching, searching - without the Naam, everything is false.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat khoji-aa naamai bin koor.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਜਮਦੂਤ  ਛਿਡ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the comforts of life are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; Godis the Fulfiller of desires. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jeevan sukh sabh  saaDh sang parabh  mansaa poor. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; I have burnt away all mycleverness.
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavhu t it tit lageh si-aanap sabh  jaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are permeating and pervading everywhere, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jat kat  tumH bharpoor hahu mayray d een d a-i-aalee. ||3||

lines.english: I ask for everything from You, but only the very fortunate ones obtain it.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tum tay maagnaa vadbh aagee paa-ay.

lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer, O God, I live by singing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||12||42|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (811-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee ardaas parabh  jeevaa gun gaa-ay. ||4||12||42||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਨਸਾ  ਪੂਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dwelling in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai baasbai kalmal sabh  nasnaa.

lines.english: One who is attuned to the Love of God, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation.||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh sayt ee rang raat i-aa taa tay garabh  na garsanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਮ ਭਰਪੂਰ  ਹਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, the tongue becomes holy.
lines.transliteration: naam kahat govind  kaa soochee bh a-ee rasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The mind and body become immaculate and pure, chanting the Chant of the Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal ho-ee hai gur kaa jap japnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਵਾ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੨॥
lines.english: Tasting the subtle essence of the Lord, one is satisfied; receiving this essence, themind becomes happy.
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhat  Dharaapi-aa man ras lai hasnaa.

lines.english: The intellect is brightened and illuminated; turning away from the world, the heart- lotus blossoms forth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: buDh pargaas pargat bh a-ee ulat kamal bigsanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਬਾਸਬੈ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਸਿਭ ਨਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is cooled and soothed, peaceful and content; all his thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: seetal saaNt santokh ho-ay sabh  boojh ee tarisnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਿਤਆ  ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਰਿਭ  ਨ ਗਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mind's wandering in the ten directions is stopped, and one dwells in theimmaculate place. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dah d is Dhaavat  mit ga-ay nirmal thaan basnaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਭਈ ਰਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Savior Lord saves him, and his doubts are burnt to ashes.
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaarai raakh i-aa bh a-ay bh aram bh asnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He findspeace, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan. ||4||13||43|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (811-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan naanak sukh ee paykh  saaDh  darsanaa. ||4||13||43||

lines.english: Carry water for the Lord's slave, wave the fan over him, and grind his corn; then, youshall be happy.
lines.transliteration: paanee pakh aa pees d aas kai t ab hohi nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਤ  ਧਰ੍ਾਿਪਆ  ਮਿਨ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਹਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Burn in the fire your power, property and authority. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raaj milakh sikd aaree-aa agnee meh jaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਿਧ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ ਭਈ ਉਲਿਟ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਬਗਸਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Grasp hold of the feet of the servant of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kaa chh ohraa t is charn ee laag.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲ  ਸਿਤ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce and abandon the wealthy, the regal overlords and kings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aaDhaaree chh atarpat tinH chhoda-o t i-aag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The dry bread of the Saints is equal to all treasures.
lines.transliteration: santan kaa d aanaa rookh aa so sarab niDh aan.

lines.english: The thirty-six tasty dishes of the faithless cynic, are just like poison. ||2||
lines.transliteration: garihi saakat chh ateeh parkaar t ay bikh oo samaan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖੀ ਪੇਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਨਾ  ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੩॥
lines.english: Wearing the old blankets of the humble devotees, one is not naked.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kaa loograa odh  nagan na ho-ee.

lines.english: But by putting on the silk clothes of the faithless cynic, one loses one's honor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saakat sirpaa-o raysmee pahirat  pat kho-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਣੀ  ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਿਹ ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Friendship with the faithless cynic breaks down mid-way.
lines.transliteration: saakat si-o mukh  jori-ai aDh  veechahu tootai.

lines.english: But whoever serves the humble servants of the Lord, is emancipated here and hereafter. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har jan kee sayvaa jo karay it oot eh chh ootai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਛੋਹਰਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Everything comes from You, O Lord; You Yourself created the creation.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tumH hee t ay ho-aa aap ban at banaa-ee.

lines.english: Blessed with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||14||44|| pMnw 812 iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (812-1) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytat saaDh  kaa naanak gun  gaa-ee. ||5||14||44||

lines.english: With my ears, I listen to the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Praises of my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sarvanee sun-o har har haray thaakur jas gaava-o.

lines.english: I place my hands and my head upon the feet of the Saints, and meditate on the Lord'sName. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant charan  kar sees Dh ar har naam Dh i-aava-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਨੀ  ਸੁਨਉ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Be kind to me, O Merciful God, and bless me with this wealth and success.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa da-i-aal parabh  ih niDh  siDh paava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ  ਕਰ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Obtaining the dust of the feet of the Saints, I apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee rayn ukaa lai maathai laava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am the lowest of the low, absolutely the lowest; I offer my humble prayer.
lines.transliteration: neech tay neech at  neech ho-ay kar bin-o bulaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ  ਲੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I wash their feet, and renounce my self-conceit; I merge in the Saints' Congregation.||2||
lines.transliteration: paav malovaa aap ti-aag sat sang samaava-o. ||2||

lines.english: With each and every breath, I never forget the Lord; I never go to another.
lines.transliteration: saas saas nah veesrai an kateh na Dh aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ  ਅਿਤ  ਨੀਚੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰ ਿਬਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Obtaining the Fruitful Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I discard my pride andattachment. ||3||
lines.transliteration: safal darsan gur bh aytee-ai maan moh mitaava-o. ||3||

lines.english: I am embellished with truth, contentment, compassion and Dharmic faith.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh da-i-aa Dh aram seegaar banaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਅਨ ਕਤਿਹ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: My spiritual marriage is fruitful, O Nanak; I am pleasing to my God. ||4||15||45|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (812-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: safal suhaagan naankaa apunay parabh  bhaava-o. ||4||15||45||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਮਟਾਵਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The words of the Holy are eternal and unchanging; this is apparent to everyone.
lines.transliteration: atal bachan saaDhoo janaa sabh  meh paragtaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being, who joins the Saadh Sangat, meets the Sovereign Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis jan ho-aa saaDhsang t is bhaytai har raa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਉ  ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੫॥
lines.english: This faith in the Lord of the Universe, and peace, are found by meditating on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih parteet  govind  kee jap har sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Everyone is speaking in various ways, but the Guru has brought the Lord into thehome of my self. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik baataa sabh  kar rahay gur gh ar lai aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਟਲ  ਬਚਨ  ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨਾ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਗਟਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; there is no doubt about thisat all.
lines.transliteration: saran paray kee raakh -taa naahee sehsaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਆ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the field of actions and karma, plant the Lord's Name; this opportunity is so difficultto obtain! ||2||
lines.transliteration: karam bhoom har naam bo-ay a-osar d ulbhaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕੀ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He does, and causes everything to be done.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee aap parabh  sabh  karay karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਾਤਾ  ਸਿਭ ਕਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਲੈ ਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He purifies so many sinners; this is the natural way of our Lord and Master. ||3||
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  ghanay karay th aakur bird aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Don't be fooled, O mortal being, by the illusion of Maya.
lines.transliteration: mat bh oolahu maanukh  jan maa-i-aa bh armaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਤਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਹਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God saves the honor of those of whom He approves. ||4||16||46|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (812-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis pat  raakh see jo parabh  pehraa-i-aa. ||4||16||46||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਭੂਿਮ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਇ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He fashioned you from clay, and made your priceless body.
lines.transliteration: maatee tay jin saaji-aa kar d urlabh  dayh.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He covers the many faults in your mind, and makes you look immaculate and pure.||1||
lines.transliteration: anik chhid ar man meh dh akay nirmal d aristayh. ||1||

lines.english: So why do you forget God from your mind? He has done so many good things for you.
lines.transliteration: ki-o bisrai parabh manai t ay jis kay gun  ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਭਰਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who forsakes God, and blends himself with another, in the end is blended withdust. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh t aj rachay je aan si-o so ralee-ai kh ayh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖਸੀ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਪਿਹਰਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੬॥
lines.english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance with each and every breath - do not delay!
lines.transliteration: simrahu simrahu saas saas mat bilam karayh.

lines.english: Renounce worldly affairs, and merge yourself into God; forsake false loves. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chhod parpanch parabh  si-o rachahu t aj koorh ay nayh. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਟੀ  ਤੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਕਿਰ ਦੁਰਲਭ  ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: He is many, and He is One; He takes part in the many plays. This is as He is, and shallbe.
lines.transliteration: jin anik ayk baho rang kee-ay hai hosee ayh.

lines.english: So serve that Supreme Lord God, and accept the Guru's Teachings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa tis paarbarahm gur t ay mat  layh. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਨੈ ਤੇ ਿਜਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਹ ॥
lines.english: God is said to be the highest of the high, the greatest of all, our companion.
lines.transliteration: oochay tay oochaa vadaa sabh  sang barnayh.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤਿਜ ਰਚੇ ਿਜ ਆਨ  ਿਸਉ ਸੋ ਰਲੀਐ  ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please, let Nanak be the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||17||47|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (812-17) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daas d aas ko d aasraa naanak kar layh. ||4||17||47||

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is my only Support. I have renounced all other hopes.
lines.transliteration: ayk tayk govind kee t i-aagee an aas.

lines.english: God is All-powerful, above all; He is the perfect treasure of virtue. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh oopar samrath parabh  pooran gunt aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਪਰ੍ਪੰਚੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਉ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਿਜ ਕੂੜੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the humble servant who seeks God's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jan kaa naam aDhaar hai parabh  sarnee paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਏਕ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਏ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਏਹ ॥
lines.english: In their minds, the Saints take the Support of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parmaysar kaa aasraa santan man maahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਿਤ ਲੇਹ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself preserves, and He Himself gives. He Himself cherishes. pMnw 813
lines.transliteration: aap rakhai aap d ayvsee aapay part ipaarai.

lines.english: Merciful to the meek, the treasure of mercy, He remembers and protects us with each and every breath. ||2||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaa niDh ay saas saas samHaarai. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever the Creator Lord does is glorious and great.
lines.transliteration: karanhaar jo kar rahi-aa saa-ee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਾਈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, that peace comes by the Will of our Lord andMaster. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai updaysi-aa sukh  khasam rajaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮ  ਰਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Anxieties, worries and calculations are dismissed; the Lord's humble servant acceptsthe Hukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: chint and aysaa gan at taj jan hukam pachh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਗਣਤ  ਤਿਜ ਜਿਨ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He does not die, and He does not leave; Nanak is attuned to His Love. ||4||18||48|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (813-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nah binsai nah chhod jaa-ay naanak rang raat aa. ||4||18||48||

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਨਹ ਛੋਿਡ ਜਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥੪॥੧੮॥੪੮॥
lines.english: The great fire is put out and cooled; meeting with the Guru, sins run away.
lines.transliteration: mahaa tapat  tay bh a-ee saaNt parsat  paap naath ay.

lines.english: I fell into the deep dark pit; giving me His Hand, He pulled me out. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anDh koop meh galat  thay kaadh ay day haathay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਤਪਿਤ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸਿਤ  ਪਰਸਤ  ਪਾਪ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
lines.english: He is my friend; I am the dust of His Feet.
lines.transliteration: o-ay hamaaray saajnaa ham un kee rayn.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਗਲਤ  ਥੇ ਕਾਢੇ  ਦੇ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting with Him, I am at peace; He blesse s me with the gift of the soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin bhaytat  hovat  sukh ee jee-a d aan d ayn. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਸਾਜਨਾ  ਹਮ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
lines.english: I have now received my pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: paraa poorbalaa leekhi-aa mili-aa ab aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਭੇਟਤ  ਹੋਵਤ  ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dwelling with the Lord's Holy Saints, my hopes are fulfilled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: basat sang har saaDh  kai pooran aasaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The fear of the three worlds is dispelled, and I have found my place of rest and peace.
lines.transliteration: bhai binsay t ihu lok kay paa-ay sukh  thaan.

lines.english: The all-powerful Guru has taken pity upon me, and the Naam has come to dwell in my mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karee samrath gur basi-aa man naam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਸਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O God, You are the Anchor and Support of Nanak.
lines.transliteration: naanak kee too tayk parabh  tayraa aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਿਤਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨ ॥
lines.english: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes; the All-powerful Lord God is inaccessible and infinite. ||4||19||49|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (813-8) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath parabh  har agam apaar. ||4||19||49||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੀ ਸਮਰਥ  ਗੁਿਰ ਬਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who forgets God is filthy, poor and low.
lines.transliteration: so-ee maleen deen heen jis parabh  bisraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਤੂ ਟੇਕ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The fool does not understand the Creator Lord; instead, he thinks that he himself isthe doer. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karnaihaar na boojh-ee aap ganai bigaanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੪॥੧੯॥੪੯॥
lines.english: Pain comes, when one forgets Him. Peace comes when one remembers God.
lines.transliteration: dookh  taday jad  veesrai sukh  parabh  chit aa-ay.

lines.english: This is the way the Saints are in bliss - they continually sing the Glorious Praises of theLord. ||1||Pause||
