lines.transliteration: santan kai aanand  ayhu nit  har gun  gaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The high, He makes low, and the low, he elevates in an instant.
lines.transliteration: oochay tay neechaa karai neech kh in meh thaapai.

lines.english: The value of the glory of our Lord and Master cannot be estimated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: keemat kahee na jaa-ee-ai th aakur part aapai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਜਿਦ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਚਿਤ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: While he gazes upon beautiful dramas and plays, the day of his departure dawns.
lines.transliteration: paykhat  leelaa rang roop chalnai d in aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਏਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The dream becomes the dream, and his actions do not go along with him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: supnay kaa supnaa bha-i-aa sang chali-aa kamaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: God is All-powerful, the Cause of causes; I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath parabh  tayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ  ਕਰੈ ਨੀਚ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Lord; forever and ever he is a sacrifice. ||4||20||50|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (813-13) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har dinas rain  naanak japai sad  sad bal jaa-ee. ||4||20||50||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਪਰਤਾਪੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I carry water on my head, and with my hands I wash their feet.
lines.transliteration: jal dhova-o ih sees kar kar pag pakh laava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਖਤ  ਲੀਲਾ  ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਚਲਨੈ  ਿਦਨੁ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Tens of thousands of times, I am a sacrifice to them; gazing upon the Blessed Visionof their Darshan, I live. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baar jaa-o lakh bayree-aa d aras paykh  jeevaava-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੇ  ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਭਇਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਚਿਲਆ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The hopes which I cherish in my mind - my God fulfills them all.
lines.transliteration: kara-o manorath manai maahi apnay parabh t ay paava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: With my broom, I sweep the homes of the Holy Saints, and wave the fan over them.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: day-o soohnee saaDh  kai beejan dh olaava-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਪੈ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨੦॥੫੦॥
lines.english: The Saints chant the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord; I listen, and my mind drinks it in.
lines.transliteration: amrit gun  sant boltay sun  maneh peelaava-o.

lines.english: That sublime essence calms and soothes me, and quenches the fire of sin and corruption. ||2||
lines.transliteration: u-aa ras meh saaNt taripat  ho-ay bikh ai jalan bujh aava-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲੁ ਢੋਵਉ ਇਹ ਸੀਸ ਕਿਰ ਕਰ ਪਗ ਪਖਲਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: When the galaxy of Saints worship the Lord in devotion, I join them, singing theGlorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jab bhagat  karahi sant  mandlee t inH mil har gaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪੇਿਖ ਜੀਵਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I bow in reverence to the humble devotees, and apply the dust of their feet to myface. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kara-o namaskaar bhagat  jan Dh oor mukh  laava-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ  ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: Sitting down and standing up, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is what Ido.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at japa-o naam ih karam kamaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਉ ਸੂਹਨੀ  ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਬੀਜਨੁ ਢੋਲਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer to God, that he may merge in the Lord's Sanctuary.||4||21||51|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (813-19) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh baynt ee har saran samaava-o. ||4||21||51||

lines.english: He alone crosses over this world-ocean, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih saagar so-ee tarai jo har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਗੁਣ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਲਤੇ  ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨਿਹ  ਪੀਲਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; by great good fortune, he finds the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 814
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai sang vasai vadbh aagee paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Your slave lives by hearing, hearing the Word of Your Bani, chanted by Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  jeevai d aas tumH banee jan aakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਣੀ  ਜਨ ਆਖੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is revealed in all the worlds; He saves the honor of His servant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-ee sabh  lo-a meh sayvak kee raakh ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਭਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਿਹ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God has pulled me out of the ocean of fire, and quenched my burning thirst.
lines.transliteration: agan saagar tay kaadh i-aa parabh  jalan bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Guru has sprinkled the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; Hehas become my Helper. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam jal sanchi-aa gur bh a-ay sahaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਤੇ ਕਾਿਢਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਜਲਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death are removed, and I have obtained a resting place ofpeace.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh kaati-aa sukh  kaa thaan paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਲੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The noose of doubt and emotional attachment has been snapped; I have becomepleasing to my God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaatee silak bharam moh kee apnay parabh  bhaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Let no one think that there is any other at all; everything is in the Hands of God.
lines.transliteration: mat ko-ee jaan hu avar kachh  sabh  parabh  kai haath.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਟੀ  ਿਸਲਕ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਅਪਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak has found total peace, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||22||52|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (814-5) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh naanak paa-ay sang sant an saath. ||4||22||52||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਸਭ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: My bonds have been snapped; God Himself has become compassionate.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaatay aap parabh  ho-aa kirpaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਏ ਸੰਿਗ ਸੰਤਨ  ਸਾਿਥ  ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੨॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; by His Glance of Grace, I am inecstasy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal parabh  paarbarahm t aa kee nad ar nihaal. ||1||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has shown mercy to me, and eradicated my pains and illnesses.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai kirpaa karee kaati-aa dukh  rog.

lines.english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, meditating on God, most worthy ofmeditation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al sukh ee bh a-i-aa parabh  Dhi-aavan jog. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all disease; with it, no disease afflictsme.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  har kaa naam hai jit  rog na vi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind and body are tinged with theLord's Love, and I do not suffer pain any longer. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang man t an hit ai fir d ookh na jaapai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸੁਖੀ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਧਆਵਨ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, lovingly centering my inner being onHim.
lines.transliteration: har har har har jaapee-ai antar liv laa-ee.

lines.english: Sinful mistakes are erased and I am sanctified, in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kilvikh ut reh suDh  ho-ay saaDh oo sarn aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Misfortune is kept far away from those who hear and chant the Praises of the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: sunat japat  har naam jas t aa kee d oor balaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਿਹਤੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak chants the Mahaa Mantra, the Great Mantra, singing the Glorious Praises of theLord. ||4||23||53|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (814-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mahaa mantar naanak kathai har kay gun  gaa-ee. ||4||23||53||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੀਐ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: From the Fear of God, devotion wells up, and deep within, there is peace.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay upjai bh agat parabh  antar ho-ay saaNt.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, doubt and delusions are dispelled.||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japat govind  kaa binsai bh aram bh araaNt. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨਤ  ਜਪਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੂਿਰ ਬਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, is blessed with peace.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa jis bhayti-aa t aa kai sukh  parvays.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਥੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੩॥
lines.english: So renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, and listen to the Teachings.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man kee mat t i-aagee-ai sun ee-ai upd ays. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: simrat simrat  simree-ai so purakh  daataar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਸਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: May I never forget that Primal, Infinite Lord from my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man tay kabahu na veesrai so purakh  apaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕਾ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have enshrined love for the Lotus Feet of the Wondrous Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o rang lagaa achraj gurdayv.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਿਖ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by Your Mercy, God, is committed to Your service. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o kirpaa karahu parabh t aa ka-o laavhu sayv. ||3||

lines.english: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of wealth, and my mind and body are in bliss.
lines.transliteration: niDh niDh aan amrit  pee-aa man t an aanand .

lines.english: Nanak never forgets God, the Lord of supreme bliss. ||4||24||54|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (814-15) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kabahu na veesrai parabh parmaanand . ||4||24||54||

lines.english: Desire is stilled, and egotism is gone; fear and doubt have run away.
lines.transliteration: tarisan bujh ee mamt aa ga-ee naath ay bh ai bharmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have found stability, and I am in ecstasy; the Guru has blessed me with Dharmicfaith. ||1||
lines.transliteration: thit paa-ee aanad  bha-i-aa gur keenay Dh armaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਸਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ  ਅਚਰਜ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ॥
lines.english: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, my anguish is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraaDhi-aa binsee mayree peer.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My body and mind are totally cooled and soothed; I have found peace, O my brother. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan man sabh  seetal bha-i-aa paa-i-aa sukh  beer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have awakened from sleep, chanting the Name of the Lord; gazing upon Him, I amfilled with wonder.
lines.transliteration: sovat har jap jaagi-aa paykh i-aa bismaad .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੪॥
lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I am satisfied. How wondrous is its taste! ||2||
lines.transliteration: pee amrit t ariptaasi-aa t aa kaa achraj su-aad . ||2||

lines.english: I myself am liberated, and my companions swim across; my family and ancestors arealso saved.
lines.transliteration: aap mukat sangee t aray kul kutamb uDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗਈ ਨਾਠੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful; it has made me pure in the Court of the Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: safal sayvaa gurdayv kee nirmal d arbaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਆਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਨੇ  ਧਰਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am lowly, without a master, ignorant, worthless and without virtue. pMnw 815
lines.transliteration: neech anaath ajaan mai nirgun gunheen.

lines.english: Nanak has been blessed with God's Mercy; God has made him His Slave. ||4||25||55|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (815-1) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o kirpaa bha-ee d aas apnaa keen. ||4||25||55||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਕੀਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੫॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Hope and Support of His devotees; there is nowhere else for them to go.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa kaa aasraa an naahee th aa-o.

lines.english: O God, Your Name is my power, realm, relatives and riches. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taan deebaan  parvaar Dh an parabh  tayraa naa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ  ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: God has granted His Mercy, and saved His slaves.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aapn ee apnay d aas rakh  lee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਣੁ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਪਰਵਾਰ  ਧਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The slanderers rot in their slander; they are seized by the Messenger of Death.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nindak nind aa kar pachay jamkaal garsee-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪਣੀ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਦਾਸ ਰਿਖ ਲੀਏ ॥
lines.english: The Saints meditate on the One Lord, and no other.
lines.transliteration: santaa ayk Dh i-aavanaa d oosar ko naahi.

lines.english: They offer their prayers to the One Lord, who is pervading and permeating all places.||2||
lines.transliteration: aykas aagai bayntee ravi-aa sarab thaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I have heard this old story, spoken by the devotees,
lines.transliteration: kathaa puraatan i-o sun ee bh agtan kee baanee.
sagal dusat kh and kh and kee-ay jan lee-ay maanee. ||3|| that all the wicked are cut apart into pieces, while His humble servants are blessedwith honor. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਆਗੈ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਥਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the true words, which are obvious to all.
lines.transliteration: sat bachan naanak kahai pargat sabh  maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਾ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ  ਇਉ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: God's servants are under God's Protection; they have absolutely no fear. ||4||26||56|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (815-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak saran  parabh  tin ka-o bh a-o naahi. ||4||26||56||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਏ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: God breaks the bonds which hold us; He holds all power in His hands.
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaatai so parabh oo jaa kai kal haath.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਬਚਨ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹੈ ਪਰਗਟ ਸਭ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: No other actions will bring release; save me, O my Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: avar karam nahee chhootee-ai raakh o har naath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੬॥
lines.english: I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord of Mercy.
lines.transliteration: ta-o sarn aagat  maaDh vay pooran d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Those whom You preserve and protect, O Lord of the Universe, are saved from thetrap of the world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhoot jaa-ay sansaar t ay raakh ai gopaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਲ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Hope, doubt, corruption and emotional attachment - in these, he is engrossed.
lines.transliteration: aasaa bharam bikaar moh in meh lobh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰ  ਕਰਮ  ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The false material world abides in his mind, and he does not understand the SupremeLord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jhooth  samagree man vasee paarbarahm na jaanaa. ||2||

lines.english: O Perfect Lord of Supreme Light, all beings belong to You.
lines.transliteration: param jot pooran purakh  sabh  jee-a t umHaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਛੂਿਟ ਜਾਇ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As You keep us, we live, O infinite, inaccessible God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o too raakh ahi ti-o rahaa parabh  agam apaaray. ||3||

lines.english: Cause of causes, All-powerful Lord God, please bless me with Your Name.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath parabh  deh apnaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਭਰਮ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮੋਹ ਇਨ ਮਿਹ ਲੋਭਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||27||57|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (815-11) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak taree-ai saaDh sang har har gun  gaa-o. ||4||27||57||

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੁ ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੀ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Who? Who has not fallen, by placing their hopes in you?
lines.transliteration: kavan kavan nahee patri-aa t umHree part eet.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are enticed by the great enticer - this is the way to hell! ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohnee mohi-aa narak kee reet. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਰਹਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O vicious mind, no faith can be placed in you; you are totally intoxicated.
lines.transliteration: man khuthar t ayraa nahee bisaas t oo mahaa ud maad aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੇਿਹ ਅਪਨਾ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The donkey's leash is only removed, after the load is placed on his back. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khar kaa paikh ar ta-o chh utai ja-o oopar laad aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੪॥੨੭॥੫੭॥
lines.english: You destroy the value of chanting, intensive meditation and self-discipline; you shallsuffer in pain, beaten by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam t umH khanday jam kay d ukh daaNd.

lines.english: You do not meditate, so you shall suffer the pains of reincarnation, you shameless buffoon! ||2||
lines.transliteration: simrahi naahee jon dukh  nirlajay bh aaNd. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਤਿਰਆ  ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is your Companion, your Helper, your Best Friend; but you disagree withHim.
lines.transliteration: har sang sahaa-ee mahaa meet t is si-o t ayraa bh ayd.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਨਰਕ  ਕੀ ਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are in love with the five thieves; this brings terrible pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: beeDhaa panch batvaara-ee upji-o mahaa kh ayd. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਖੁਟਹਰ  ਤੇਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਿਬਸਾਸੁ  ਤੂ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਮਾਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints, who have conquered their minds.
lines.transliteration: naanak tin sant an sarn aagat ee jin man vas keenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਰ ਕਾ ਪੈਖਰੁ ਤਉ ਛੁਟੈ ਜਉ ਊਪਿਰ  ਲਾਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He gives body, wealth and everything to the slaves of God. ||4||28||58|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (815-16) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an sarbas aapn aa parabh  jan ka-o d eenHaa. ||4||28||58||

lines.english: Try to meditate, and contemplate the source of peace, and bliss will come to you.
lines.transliteration: udam karat  aanad  bha-i-aa simrat  sukh  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੁਮ ਖੰਡੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਡਡ ॥
lines.english: Chanting, and meditating on the Name of the Lord of the Universe, perfectunderstanding is achieved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jap jap naam gobind kaa pooran beechaar. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Guru, and chanting the Name of the Lord, I live.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gur kay japat har jap ha-o jeevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਮਹਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਿਤਸ ਿਸਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
lines.english: Worshipping the Supreme Lord God in adoration, my mouth drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aaraaDh-t ay mukh  amrit  peevaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਧਾ  ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰਈ  ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਮਹਾ ਖੇਦੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures dwell in peace; the minds of all yearn for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  sukh  basay sabh  kai man loch.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਿਜਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਸ ਕੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who continually remember the Lord, do good deeds for others; they harbor noill will towards anyone. ||2|| pMnw 816
lines.transliteration: par-upkaar nit chit vatay naahee kachh  poch. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਬਸੰਤ  ਧੰਨੁ ਜਹ ਜਪੀਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhan so thaan basant  Dhan jah japee-ai naam. Blessed is that place, and blessed are those who dwell there, where they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਅਿਤ  ਘਨਾ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Sermon and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung there very often; there ispeace, poise and tranquility. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kathaa keertan har at  ghanaa sukh  sahj bisraam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਅਨਾਥ  ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.english: In my mind, I never forget the Lord; He is the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: man tay kad ay na veesrai anaath ko naath.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੫੯॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; everything is in His hands. ||4||29||59|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (816-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee jaa kai sabh  kichh  haath. ||4||29||59||

lines.english: The One who bound you in the womb and then released you, placed you in the world of joy.
lines.transliteration: jin too banDh  kar chh odi-aa fun sukh  meh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਤੂ ਬੰਿਧ ਕਿਰ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਫੁਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplate His Lotus Feet forever, and you shall be cooled and soothed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa simar charn aarbind  seetal hot aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: In life and in death, this Maya is of no use.
lines.transliteration: jeevti-aa athvaa mu-i-aa kichh  kaam na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਿਤਆ  ਅਥਵਾ  ਮੁਇਆ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He created this creation, but rare are those who enshrine love for Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin ayhu rachan rachaa-i-aa ko-oo tis si-o rang laavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਕੋਊ ਿਤਸ ਿਸਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mortal, the Creator Lord made summer and winter; He saves you from the heat.
lines.transliteration: ray paraanee usan seet  kartaa karai gh aam t ay kaadh ai.

lines.english: From the ant, He makes an elephant; He reunites those who have been separated.||2||
lines.transliteration: keeree tay hast ee karai tootaa lay gaadh ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਉਸਨ  ਸੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੈ ਘਾਮ  ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ  ॥
lines.english: Eggs, wombs, sweat and earth - these are God's workshops of creation.
lines.transliteration: andaj jayraj saytaj ut -bhujaa parabh  kee ih kirat .

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਰੀ  ਤੇ ਹਸਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਟੂਟਾ ਲੇ ਗਾਢੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: It is fruitful for all to practice contemplation of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kirat kamaavan sarab fal ravee-ai har nirat . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਡਜ  ਜੇਰਜ  ਸੇਤਜ  ਉਤਭੁਜਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਿਕਰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot do anything; O God, I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: ham tay kachh oo na hovnaa saran  parabh  saaDh .

lines.english: Guru Nanak pulled me up, out of the deep, dark pit, the intoxication of attachment. ||4||30||60|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (816-8) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: moh magan koop anDh t ay naanak gur kaadh . ||4||30||60||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਾ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਧ ॥
lines.english: Searching, searching, I wander around searching, in the woods and other places.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat mai firaa kh oja-o ban thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਕੂਪ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾਢ  ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੦॥
lines.english: He is undeceivable, imperishable, inscrutable; such is my Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: achhal achh ayd abhayd parabh  aisay bh agvaan. ||1||

lines.english: When shall I behold my God, and delight my soul?
lines.transliteration: kab daykh -a-u parabh  aapnaa aat am kai rang.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਮੈ ਿਫਰਾ  ਖੋਜਉ  ਬਨ ਥਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Even better than being awake, is the dream in which I dwell with God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaagan tay supnaa bh alaa basee-ai parabh  sang. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਛਲ  ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਐਸੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Listening to the Shaastras teaching about the four social classes and the four stagesof life, I grow thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: baran aasram saastar sun-o d arsan kee pi-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ  ਆਤਮ  ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: He has no form or outline, and He is not made of the five elements; our Lord andMaster is imperishable. ||2||
lines.transliteration: roop na raykh na panch t at thaakur abinaas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਗਨ  ਤੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਭਲਾ ਬਸੀਐ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How rare are those Saints and great Yogis, who describe the beautiful form of theLord.
lines.transliteration: oh saroop santan kaheh virlay jogeesur.

lines.english: Blessed, blessed are they, whom the Lord meets in His Mercy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jaa ka-o milay Dhan Dh an tay eesur. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਨ  ਆਸਰ੍ਮ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਸੁਨਉ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਿਪਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: They know that He is deep within, and outside as well; their doubts are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: so antar so baahray binsay t ah bh armaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God meets those, whose karma is perfect. ||4||31||61|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (816-13) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis parabh  bhayti-aa jaa kay pooran karmaa. ||4||31||61||

lines.english: All beings and creatures are totally pleased, gazing on God's glorious radiance.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant suparsan bh a-ay d aykh parabh  partaap.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਮਲੇ ਧਿਨ ਧਿਨ ਤੇ ਈਸੁਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru has paid off my debt; He Himself did it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karaj utaari-aa sat guroo kar aahar aap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰੇ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਤਹ ਭਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Eating and expending it, it is always available; the Word of the Guru's Shabad isinexhaustible.
lines.transliteration: khaat  kharchat  nibhat  rahai gur sabad  akhoot.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ  ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੧॥
lines.english: Everything is perfectly arranged; it is never exhausted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooran bha-ee samagree kabhoo nahee t oot. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I worship and adore the Lord, theinfinite treasure.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang aaraaDh naa har niDh  aapaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਭਏ ਦੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰਤਾਪ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam arath ar kaam mokh  daytay nahee baar. ||2|| He does not hesitate to bless me with Dharmic faith, wealth, sexual success and liberation. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਜੁ ਉਤਾਿਰਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਿਰ ਆਹਰੁ ਆਪ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The devotees worship and adore the Lord of the Universe with single-minded love.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  araaDh eh ayk rang gobind  gupaal.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ  ਿਨਬਹਤ  ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਖੂਟ  ॥
lines.english: They gather in the wealth of the Lord's Name, which cannot be estimated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan sanchi-aa jaa kaa nahee sumaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਈ ਸਮਗਰੀ  ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, the glorious greatness of God. Nanak:
lines.transliteration: saran paray parabh t ayree-aa parabh  kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Your end or limitation cannot be found, O Infinite World-Lord. ||4||32||62|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (816-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ant na paa-ee-ai bay-ant  gusaa-ee. ||4||32||62||

lines.english: Meditate, meditate in remembrance of the Perfect Lord God, and your affairs shall beperfectly resolved.
lines.transliteration: simar simar pooran parabhoo kaaraj bh a-ay raas.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਅਰਥ  ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਦੇਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In Kartaarpur, the City of the Creator Lord, the Saints dwell with the Creator.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kartaar pur kart aa vasai sant an kai paas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਅਰਾਧਿਹ  ਏਕ ਰੰਿਗ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: No obstacles will block your way, when you offer your prayers to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: bighan na ko-oo laagt aa gur peh ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is the Saving Grace, the Protector of the capital of His devotees. ||1|| pMnw 817
lines.transliteration: rakhvaalaa gobind  raa-ay bh agtan kee raas. ||1||

lines.english: There is never any deficiency at all; the Lord's treasures are over-flowing.
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai kad ay mool pooran bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਕਦੇ ਮੂਿਲ ਪੂਰਨ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: His Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind and body; God is inaccessible and infinite. ||2||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man tan basay parabh  agam apaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਬਸੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All those who work for Him dwell in peace; you can see that they lack nothing.
lines.transliteration: basat kamaavat  sabh  sukh ee kichh  oon na d eesai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਸਤ  ਕਮਾਵਤ  ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖੀ ਿਕਛੁ  ਊਨ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met God, the Perfect Lord of the Universe. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  bhaytay parabh oo pooran jagd eesai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਭੇਟੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Everyone congratulates me, and celebrates my victory; the home of the True Lord isso beautiful!
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar sabhai karahi sach thaan suhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of peace; I have foundthe Perfect Guru. ||4||33||63|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (817-4) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jap naanak naam niDhaan sukh  pooraa gur paa-i-aa. ||4||33||63||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੩੩॥੬੩॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and you shall be free of disease.
lines.transliteration: har har har aaraaDhee-ai ho-ee-ai aarog.

lines.english: This is the Lord's healing rod, which eradicates all disease. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raamchand kee lastikaa jin maari-aa rog. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ  ਹੋਈਐ  ਆਰੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, through the Perfect Guru, he constantly enjoys pleasure.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa har jaapee-ai nit keechai bh og.

lines.english: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have been united with my Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai vaarn ai mili-aa sanjog. ||1||

lines.english: Contemplating Him, peace is obtained, and separation is ended.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat sukh  paa-ee-ai binsai bi-og.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੀਐ  ਿਨਤ  ਕੀਚੈ  ਭੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.||2||34||64|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 dupdy Gru 5  (817-8) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 dupd ay gh ar 5 Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (817-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee karan  kaaran  jog. ||2||34||64||

lines.english: I have given up all other efforts, and have taken the medicine of the Naam, the Nameof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: avar upaav sabh t i-aagi-aa d aaroo naam la-i-aa.

lines.english: Fevers, sins and all diseases are eradicated, and my mind is cooled and soothed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taap paap sabh  mitay rog seet al man bh a-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੬੪॥
lines.english: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, all pains are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraaDhi-aa saglaa d ukh ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Savior Lord has saved me; He has blessed me with His Kind Mercy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaarai raakh i-aa apnee kar ma-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਿਰ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਸਿਭ ਿਤਆਿਗਆ  ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Grabbing hold of my arm, God has pulled me up and out; He has made me His own.
lines.transliteration: baah pakarh parabh  kaadh i-aa keenaa apna-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸਿਭ ਿਮਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਸੀਤਲ  ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, my mind and body are at peace; Nanak has become fearless. ||2||1||65|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (817-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar simar man tan sukh ee naanak nirbh a-i-aa. ||2||1||65||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਸਗਲਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, God has given me the gift of His Name.
lines.transliteration: kar Dhar mast ak thaapi-aa naam d eeno d aan.

lines.english: One who performs fruitful service for the Supreme Lord God, never suffers any loss.||1||
lines.transliteration: safal sayvaa paarbarahm kee taa kee nahee haan. ||1||

lines.english: God Himself saves the honor of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee parabh raakh -taa bh agtan kee aan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿੜ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਾਿਢਆ  ਕੀਨਾ  ਅਪਨਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever God's Holy servants wish for, He grants to them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jo chitvahi saaDh  jan so layt aa maan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God's humble servants seek the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet; they are God's very breath of life.
lines.transliteration: saran paray charn aarbind  jan parabh  kay paraan.

lines.english: O Nanak, they automatically, intuitively meet God; their light merges into the Light.||2||2||66|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (817-15) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay naanak milay jot ee jot  samaan. ||2||2||66||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਧਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਥਾਿਪਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ  ਦਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasraa d eeno parabh  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God's humble servants seek His Sanctuary; they are respected and famous forever.||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh sarn aagat  jan paray t aa kaa sad  partaap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਾਖਤਾ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੀ ਆਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: God is the unparalleled Savior and Protector; service to Him is immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaar apaar parabh  taa kee nirmal sayv.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਿਚਤਵਿਹ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਲੇਤਾ  ਮਾਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Divine Guru has built the City of Ramdaspur, the royal domain of the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam raaj raamdaas pur keenHay gurd ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, and no obstacles will obstruct you.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har Dh i-aa-ee-ai kichh  bighan na laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਚਰਣਾਰਿਬੰਦ  ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the fear of enemies runs away. ||2||3||67|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (817-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahee-ai bha-ay d usman bh aagai. ||2||3||67||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਨ  ॥੨॥੨॥੬੬॥
lines.english: Worship and adore God in your mind and body; join the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: man tan parabh  aaraaDh ee-ai mil saaDh  samaagai.

lines.english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Messenger of Deathruns far away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: uchrat gun gopaal jas d oor tay jam bh aagai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੀਨੋ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being who chants the Lord's Name, remains always awake and aware, night and day. pMnw 818
lines.transliteration: raam naam jo jan japai an-din sad  jaagai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is not affected by charms and spells, nor is he harmed by the evil eye. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tant mant  nah joh-ee t it chaakh  na laagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਹ ਜੋਹਈ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਚਾਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, the intoxication of egotism and emotional attachment are dispelled, by loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh mad  maan moh binsay anraagai.

lines.english: One who enters the Lord's Sanctuary, O Nanak, remains merged in ecstasy in thesubtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||2||4||68|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (818-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aanand magan ras raam rang naanak sarnaagai. ||2||4||68||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਅਨਰਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: The living creatures and their ways are in God's power. Whatever He says, they do.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jugat vas parabh oo kai jo kahai so karnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦ  ਮਗਨ  ਰਿਸ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਨਾਗੈ  ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
lines.english: When the Sovereign Lord of the Universe is pleased, there is nothing at all to fear.||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay parsann gopaal raa-ay bh a-o kichh  nahee karnaa. ||1||

lines.english: Pain shall never afflict you, if you remember the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: dookh  na laagai kad ay tuDh paarbarahm chit aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਵਿਸ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the beloved Sikhs of the Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jamkankar nayrh na aavee gursikh  pi-aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਰਾਇ  ਭਉ ਿਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The All-powerful Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath hai t is bin nahee hor.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕਦੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਚਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; the True Lord has given strength to themind. ||2||5||69|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (818-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee saachaa man jor. ||2||5||69||

lines.english: Remembering, remembering my God in meditation, the house of pain is removed.
lines.transliteration: simar simar parabh aapnaa naath aa dukh thaa-o.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have found peace and tranquility; I shall not wander away from there again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bisraam paa-ay mil saaDhsang t aa tay bahurh  na Dh aa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਹੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I am devoted to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to His Feet.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay charnanH bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਿਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I am blessed with ecstasy, peace and happiness, gazing upon the Guru, and singingthe Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anad sookh  mangal banay paykh at gun gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This is my life's purpose, to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and listen to thevibrations of the sound current of the Naad.
lines.transliteration: kathaa keertan raag naad  Dhun ih bani-o su-aa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with me; I have obtained the fruits of my desires.||2||6||70|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (818-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh suparsan bh a-ay baaNchhat fal paa-o. ||2||6||70||

lines.english: This is the prayer of Your slave: please elighten my heart.
lines.transliteration: daas t ayray kee baynt ee rid  kar pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ਪਾਏ ਿਮਿਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਧਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, please erase my sins. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay paarbarahm d okhan ko naas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ  ਚਰਨਨ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet, O God, Primal Lord, treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasraa parabh purakh  guntaas.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਨੇ ਪੇਖਤ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I shall meditate in remembrance on the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as long as there is breath in my body. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: keertan naam simrat  raha-o jab lag gh at saas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are my mother, father and relative; You are abiding within all.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa banDh ap toohai t oo sarab nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਨਓ  ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; His Praise is immaculate and pure. ||2||7||71|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (818-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee jaa ko nirmal jaas. ||2||7||71||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਭਏ ਬਛਤ  ਫਲ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
lines.english: All perfect spiritual powers are obtained, when one sings the Lord's Praises; everyonewishes him well.
lines.transliteration: sarab siDh har gaa-ee-ai sabh  bhalaa manaaveh.

lines.english: Everyone calls him holy and spiritual; hearing of him, the Lord's slaves come to meethim. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDh saaDh  mukh  tay kaheh sun  daas milaaveh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਿਰਦ ਕਿਰ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru blesses him with peace, poise, salvation and happiness.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj kali-aan  ras poorai gur keenH.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਦੋਖਨ  ਕੋ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All living beings become compassionate to him; he remembers the Name of the Lord,Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a sagal da-i-aal bh a-ay har har naam cheenH. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੁਰਖ  ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: He is permeating and pervading everywhere; God is the ocean of virtue.
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-o sarbatar meh parabh  gunee gaheer.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਰਹਉ  ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਿਟ  ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees are in bliss, gazing upon God's abiding stability. ||2||8||72|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (818-15) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  aanand  mai paykh  parabh  kee Dh eer. ||2||8||72||

lines.english: God, the Great Giver, has become merciful; He has listened to my prayer.
lines.transliteration: ardaas sun ee daataar parabh  ho-ay kirpaal.

lines.english: He has saved His servant, and put ashes into the mouth of the slanderer. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-aa apnaa sayvko mukh  nindak chh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜਾਸੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
lines.english: No one can threaten you now, O my humble friend, for you are the slave of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: tujheh na johai ko meet  jan tooN gur kaa d aas.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God reached out with His Hand and saved you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm too raakh i-aa d ay apnay haath. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਿਭ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Giver of all beings; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: jee-an kaa daat aa ayk hai bee-aa nahee hor.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਿਹ  ਸੁਿਣ ਦਾਸ ਿਮਲਾਵਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak prays, You are my only strength, God. ||2||9||73|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (818-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee banantee-aa mai t ayraa jor. ||2||9||73||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਰਸ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਨ ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe has saved my friends and companions.
lines.transliteration: meet hamaaray saajnaa raakh ay govind .

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਸਗਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੀਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The slanderers have died, so do not worry. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nindak mirt ak ho-ay ga-ay t umH hohu nichind . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God has fulfilled all hopes and desires; I have met the Divine Guru. pMnw 819
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath parabh kee-ay bh aytay gurd ayv.

lines.english: God is celebrated and acclaimed all over the world; it is fruitful and rewarding to serve Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar jagat meh safal jaa kee sayv. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ  ਮਿਹ ਸਫਲ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Lofty, infinite and immeasurable is the Lord; all beings are in His Hands.
lines.transliteration: ooch apaar agnat har sabh  jee-a jis haath.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ  ਅਗਨਤ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; He is with me everywhere. ||2||10||74|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (819-2) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee jat  kat mayrai saath. ||2||10||74||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
lines.english: I worship the Perfect Guru in adoration; He has become merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraaDhi-aa ho-ay kirpaal.

lines.english: The Saint has shown me the Way, and the noose of Death has been cut away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maarag sant bat aa-i-aa t ootay jam jaal. ||1||

lines.english: Pain, hunger and scepticism have been dispelled, singing the Name of God.
lines.transliteration: dookh  bhookh sansaa miti-aa gaavat  parabh  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਸੰਿਤ ਬਤਾਇਆ  ਤੂਟੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am blessed with celestial peace, poise, bliss and pleasure, and all my affairs have been perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sahj sookh aanand  ras pooran sabh  kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾ ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਗਾਵਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The fire of desire has been quenched, and I am cooled and soothed; God Himselfsaved me.
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhee seet al bha-ay raakh ay parabh  aap.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ  ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਿਭ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His glorious radiance is so great!||2||11||75|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (819-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee jaa kaa vad part aap. ||2||11||75||

lines.english: Dharat  suhaavee safal thaan pooran bh a-ay kaam. The earth is beautified, all places are fruitful, and my affairs are perfectly resolved.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਿਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ  ਭਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪ  ॥
lines.english: Fear runs away, and doubt is dispelled, dwelling constantly upon the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-o naath aa bh aram mit ga-i-aa ravi-aa nit  raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ  ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
lines.english: Dwelling with the humble Holy people, one finds peace, poise and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kai sang basat  sukh  sahj bisraam.

lines.english: Blessed and auspicious is that time, when one meditates in remembrance on theLord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saa-ee gharh ee sulakh -nee simrat  har naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸਫਲ  ਥਾਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.english: They have become famous throughout the world; before this, no one even knew theirnames.
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-ay sansaar meh firt ay pehnaam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਇਆ ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the One who knows each and every heart. ||2||12||76|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (819-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis sarn aagat ee gh at ghat sabh  jaan. ||2||12||76||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸਤ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself eradicated the disease; peace and tranquility have welled up.
lines.transliteration: rog mitaa-i-aa aap parabh upji-aa sukh  saaNt.

lines.english: The Lord blessed me with the gifts of great, glorious radiance and wondrous form.||1||
lines.transliteration: vad partaap achraj roop har keenHee daat. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has shown mercy to me, and saved my brother.
lines.transliteration: gur govind kirpaa karee raakh i-aa mayraa bh aa-ee.

lines.english: I am under His Protection; He is always my help and support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham tis kee sarn aagat ee jo sad aa sahaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸਭ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
lines.english: The prayer of the Lord's humble servant is never offered in vain.
lines.transliteration: birthee kaday na hova-ee jan kee ard aas.

lines.english: Nanak takes the strength of the Perfect Lord of the Universe, the treasure ofexcellence. ||2||13||77|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (819-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jor govind kaa pooran gunt aas. ||2||13||77||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗੁ ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Giver of life, die, over and over again, only to be reborn and die.
lines.transliteration: mar mar janmay jin bisri-aa jeevan kaa daat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ਅਚਰਜ  ਰੂਪੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਨੀ  ਦਾਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Supreme Lord God serves Him; night and day, he remainsimbued with His Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jan sayvi-aa an-din rang raat aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਗੋਿਵੰਿਦ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have found peace, tranquility and great ecstasy; my hopes have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj aanad  ghanaa pooran bh a-ee aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਜੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I meditate inremembrance on the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-aa har saaDh sang simrat  guntaas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your humble servant; You arethe Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: sun su-aamee ard aas jan t umH antarjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਥੀ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak's Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places and interspaces.||2||14||78|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (819-15) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahay naanak kay su-aamee. ||2||14||78||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ  ਗੁ ਣਤਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
lines.english: The hot wind does not even touch one who is under the Protection of the SupremeLord God.
lines.transliteration: taatee vaa-o na lag-ee paarbarahm sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: On all four sides I am surrounded by the Lord's Circle of Protection; pain does not afflict me, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: cha-ugirad hamaarai raam kaar d ukh lagai na bh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੇ  ਿਜਨ ਿਬਸਿਰਆ ਜੀਵਨ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have met the Perfect True Guru, who has done this deed.
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa bh ayti-aa jin ban at banaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਜਿਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has given me the medicine of the Lord's Name, and I enshrine love for the OneLord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam a-ukhaDh  dee-aa aykaa liv laa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਆਨਦੁ  ਘਨਾ  ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Savior Lord has saved me, and eradicated all my sickness.
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay t in rakh anhaar sabh  bi-aaDh  mitaa-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God has showered me with His Mercy; He has become my help andsupport. ||2||15||79|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (819-19) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kirpaa bha-ee parabh  bha-ay sahaa-ee. ||2||15||79||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, through the Divine Guru, has Himself protected andpreserved His children.
lines.transliteration: apnay baalak aap rakh i-an paarbarahm gurd ayv.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: Celestial peace, tranquility and bliss have come to pass; my service has been perfect. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 820
lines.transliteration: sukh saaNt sahj aanad  bha-ay pooran bh a-ee sayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਆਨਦ  ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God Himself has heard the prayers of His humble devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kee baynt ee sun ee parabh  aap.

lines.english: He dispelled my disease, and rejuvenated me ; His glorious radiance is so great! ||1||
lines.transliteration: rog mitaa-ay jeevaali-an jaa kaa vad partaap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਸੁਣੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: He has forgiven me for my sins, and interceded with His power.
lines.transliteration: dokh hamaaray bakh si-an apn ee kal Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗ ਿਮਟਾਇ  ਜੀਵਾਿਲਅਨ ੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have been blessed with the fruits of my mind's desires; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||80|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 caupdy dupdy Gru 6  (820-4) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 cha-upday d upday gh ar 6 Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas And Du-Padas, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (820-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: man baaNchhat  fal diti-an naanak balihaaree. ||2||16||80||

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਖ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਬਖਿਸਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ  ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O my fascinating Lord, let me not listen to the faithless cynic, singing his songs andtunes, and chanting his useless words. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: iblwvlu, mÚ 5) mayray mohan sarvanee ih na sunaa-ay. saakat geet  naad  Dhun gaavat  bolat  bol ajaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I serve, serve, serve, serve the Holy Saints; forever and ever, I do this.
lines.transliteration: sayvat sayv sayv saaDh  sayva-o sad aa kara-o kirt aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਦੁਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੬ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord, the Great Giver, has blessed me with the gift of fearlessness. Joining the Company of the Holy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: abhai d aan paava-o purakh  daatay mil sangat  har gun  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਨ  ਸਰ੍ਵਨੀ  ਇਹ ਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: My tongue is imbued with the Praises of the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, andmy eyes are drenched with the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa agah agah gun raatee nain d aras rang laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਗੀਤ  ਨਾਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ਬੋਲਤ  ਬੋਲ ਅਜਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek, that I may enshrine YourLotus Feet within my heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal deen d ukh bhanjan mohi charan  ridai vasaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Beneath all, and above all; this is the vision I saw.
lines.transliteration: sabhhoo t alai talai sabh  oopar ayh d arisat d aristaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਤ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਉ  ਸਦਾ ਕਰਉ  ਿਕਰਤਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have destroyed, destroyed, destroyed my pride, since the True Guru implanted HisMantra within me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: abhimaan kh o-ay kh o-ay kh o-ay kh o-ee ha-o mo ka-o sat gur mant ar drirh -aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Immeasurable, immeasurable, immeasurable is the Merciful Lord; he cannot beweighed. He is the Lover of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: atul at ul atul nah t ulee-ai bh agat vachh al kirpaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਅਗਹ  ਅਗਹ  ਗੁਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of Guru Nanak, is blessed with the gifts of fearlessness and peace. ||4||||1||81|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (820-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo jo saran pari-o gur naanak abh ai daan sukh  paa-ay. ||4||1||81||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਚਰਣ  ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Dear God, You are the Support of my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee t oo mayray paraan aDh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਹੂ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਏਹ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I how in humility and reverence to You; so many times, I am a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: namaskaar dand-ut band naa anik baar jaa-o baarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਈ ਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, this mind thinks of You.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sovat  jaagat  ih man t ujheh chit aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਨਹ ਤੁਲੀਐ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਿਕਰਪਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I describe to You my pleasure and pain, and the state of this mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sookh d ookh is man kee birthaa t ujh hee aagai saarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੧॥
lines.english: You are my shelter and support, power, intellect and wealth; You are my family.
lines.transliteration: too mayree ot bal buDh  Dhan tum hee t umeh mayrai parvaarai.

lines.english: Whatever You do, I know that is good. Gazing upon Your Lotus Feet, Nanak is at peace. ||2||2||82|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (820-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tum karahu so-ee bh al hamrai paykh  naanak sukh  charnaarai. ||2||2||82||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: I have heard that God is the Savior of all.
lines.transliteration: sunee-at parabh  ta-o sagal uDh aaran.

lines.punjabi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ  ਡੰਡਉਿਤ  ਬੰਦਨਾ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਾਰ ਜਾਉ  ਬਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Intoxicated by attachment, in the company of sinners, the mortal has forgotten such aLord from his mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: moh magan patit  sang paraanee aisay maneh bisaaran. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He has collected poison, and grasped it firmly. But he has cast out the Ambrosial Nectar from his mind.
lines.transliteration: sanch bikhi-aa lay garaahaj keenee amrit  man t ay daaran.

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ  ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਿਚਤਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is imbued with sexual desire, anger, greed and slander; he has abandoned truthand contentment. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  rat nindaa sat  santokh bidaaran. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ  ਸਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Lift me up, and pull me out of these, O my Lord and Master. I have entered YourSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: in tay kaadh  layho mayray su-aamee haar paray t umH saaran.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਬਲ ਬੁਿਧ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak prays to God: I am a poor beggar; carry me across, in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy. ||2||3||83|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (820-17) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee parabh  peh saaDh sang rank t aaran. ||2||3||83||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹਮਰੈ  ਪੇਿਖ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ  ॥੨॥੨॥੮੨॥
lines.english: I listen to God's Teachings from the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santan kai sunee-at  parabh  kee baat .

lines.english: The Lord's Sermon, the Kirtan of His Praises and the songs of bliss perfectly resonate,day and night. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kathaa keertan aanand  mangal Dh un poor rahee d inas ar raat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In His Mercy, God has made them His own, and blessed them with the gift of HisName.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnay parabh keenay naam apunay kee keenee d aat.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਪਿਤਤ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਐਸੇ ਮਨਿਹ  ਿਬਸਾਰਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of God. Sexual desire and anger have left this body. ||1|| pMnw 821
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaavat  parabh  kay kaam kroDh  is tan tay jaat . ||1||

lines.english: I am satisfied and satiated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. I eat the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime food.
lines.transliteration: taripat  aghaa-ay paykh  parabh  darsan amrit  har ras bh ojan kh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਏ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O God; in Your Mercy, unite him with theSociety of the Saints. ||2||4||84|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (821-2) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan saran naanak parabh t ayree kar kirpaa sat sang milaat . ||2||4||84||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਤ  ॥੨॥੪॥੮੪॥
lines.english: He Himself has saved His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay apnay jan aap.

lines.english: In His Mercy, the Lord, Har, Har, has blessed me with His Name, and all my pains andafflictions have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har har naam deeno binas ga-ay sabh  sog sant aap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all you humble servants of theLord; chant the jewels, the songs of the Lord with your tongue.
lines.transliteration: gun govind  gaavhu sabh  har jan raag rat an rasnaa aalaap.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ  ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The desires of millions of incarnations shall be quenched, and your soul shall besatisfied with the sweet, sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot janam kee tarisnaa nivree raam rasaa-in  aatam Dh araap. ||1||

lines.english: I have grasped the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet; He is the Giver of peace; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I meditate and chant the Chant of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: charan gahay saran  sukh -daatay gur kai bachan japay har jaap.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਭ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਆਲਾਪ  ॥
lines.english: I have crossed over the world-ocean, and my doubt and fear are dispelled, saysNanak, through the glorious granduer of our Lord and Master. ||2||5||85|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (821-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saagar taray bh aram bh ai binsay kaho naanak th aakur part aap. ||2||5||85||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਿਨਵਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਿਣ ਆਤਮ  ਧਰ੍ਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, the Creator Lord has subdued the fever.
lines.transliteration: taap laahi-aa gur sirjanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਗਹੇ ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਨ  ਜਪੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has saved the honor of the whole world.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur apnay ka-o bal jaa-ee jin paij rakh ee saarai sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰ  ਤਰੇ ਭਰਮ  ਭੈ ਿਬਨਸੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਪਰਤਾਪ  ॥੨॥੫॥੮੫॥
lines.english: Placing His Hand on the child's forehead, He saved him.
lines.transliteration: kar mastak Dh aar baalik rakh  leeno.

lines.english: God blessed me with the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh amrit  naam mahaa ras d eeno. ||1||

lines.english: The Merciful Lord saves the honor of His slave.
lines.transliteration: daas kee laaj rakh ai miharvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀ ਸਾਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak speaks - it is confirmed in the Court of the Lord. ||2||6||86|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 caupdy dupdy Gru 7  (821-10) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 cha-upday d upday gh ar 7 Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas And Du-Padas, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (821-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak bolai dargeh parvaan. ||2||6||86||

lines.english: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, is the light of the lamp.
lines.transliteration: satgur sabad  ujaaro d eepaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਬਾਿਲਕੁ ਰਿਖ ਲੀਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: It dispels the darkness from the body-mansion, and opens the beautiful chamber of jewels. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binsi-o anDhkaar t ih mand ar rat an koth -rhee kh ulHee anoopaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I was wonderstruck and astonished, when I looked inside; I cannot even describe itsglory and grandeur.
lines.transliteration: bisman bisam bha-ay ja-o paykh i-o kahan na jaa-ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: I am intoxicated and enraptured with it, and I am wrapped in it, through and through.||1||
lines.transliteration: magan bha-ay oohaa sang maat ay ot pot laptaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: No worldly entanglements or snares can trap me, and no trace of egotistical prideremains.
lines.transliteration: aal jaal nahee kachhoo janjaaraa ahaN-buDh  nahee bh oraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਦੁਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੭ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You are the highest of the high, and no curtain separates us; I am Yours, and You aremine. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oochan oochaa beech na kheechaa ha-o t ayraa t ooN moraa. ||2||

lines.english: The One Creator Lord created the expanse of the one universe; the One Lord isunlimited and infinite.
lines.transliteration: aykankaar ayk paasaaraa aykai apar apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਿਸਓ  ਅੰਧਕਾਰ  ਿਤਹ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਰਤਨ  ਕੋਠੜੀ  ਖੁਲੀ ਅਨੂਪਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One Lord pervades the one universe; the One Lord is totally permeatingeverywhere; the One Lord is the Support of the breath of life. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk bistheeran ayk sampooran aykai paraan aDhaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: He is the most immaculate of the immaculate, the purest of the pure, so pure, sopure.
lines.transliteration: nirmal nirmal soochaa soocho soochaa soocho soochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਮਨ  ਿਬਸਮ  ਭਏ ਜਉ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: He has no end or limitation; He is forever unlimited. Says Nanak, He is the highest ofthe high. ||4||1||87|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (821-16) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ant na ant aa sad aa bay-ant aa kaho naanak oocho oochaa. ||4||1||87||

lines.punjabi: ਮਗਨ  ਭਏ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਾਤੇ ਓਿਤ ਪੋਿਤ ਲਪਟਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, nothing is of any use.
lines.transliteration: bin har kaam na aavat hay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਲ  ਜਾਲ  ਨਹੀ ਕਛੂ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ  ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਨਹੀ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: You are totally attached to that Enticer Maya; she is enticing you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa si-o raach maach tumH laagay oh mohnee mohaavat  hay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਨ  ਊਚਾ  ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਖੀਚਾ  ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You shall have to leave behind your gold, your woman and your beautiful bed; youshall have to depart in an instant.
lines.transliteration: kanik kaaminee sayj sohnee chhod kh inai meh jaavat  hay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ  ਏਕੈ ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are entangled in the lures of sexual pleasures, and you are eating poisonous drugs. ||1||
lines.transliteration: urajh rahi-o ind ree ras parayri-o bikh ai thag-uree kh aavat  hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਿਬਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You have built and adorned a palace of straw, and under it, you light a fire.
lines.transliteration: tarin ko mand ar saaj savaari-o paavak t alai jaraavat  hay.

lines.english: Sitting all puffed-up in such a castle, you stubborn-minded fool, what do you think youwill gain? ||2||
lines.transliteration: aisay garh meh aith  hatheelo fool fool ki-aa paavat  hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤਾ  ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੮੭॥
lines.english: The five thieves stand over your head and seize you. Grabbing you by your hair, they will drive you on. pMnw 822
lines.transliteration: panch doot  mood par th aadhay kays gahay fayraavat  hay.

lines.english: You do not see them, you blind and ignorant fool; intoxicated with ego, you just keep sleeping. ||3||
lines.transliteration: darisat na aavahi anDh  agi-aanee so-ay rahi-o mad  maavat  hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਅੰਧ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਸੋਇ ਰਿਹਓ  ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The net has been spread out, and the bait has been scattered; like a bird, you arebeing trapped.
lines.transliteration: jaal pasaar chog bisthaaree pankhee ji-o faahaavat  hay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਲੁ  ਪਸਾਿਰ  ਚੋਗ ਿਬਸਥਾਰੀ  ਪੰਖੀ ਿਜਉ  ਫਾਹਾਵਤ  ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my bonds have been broken; I meditate on the True Guru, the PrimalBeing. ||4||2||88|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (822-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak banDhan kaatan ka-o mai sat gur purakh  Dhi-aavat  hay. ||4||2||88||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟਨ  ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਧਆਵਤ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੮੮॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is infinite and priceless.
lines.transliteration: har har naam apaar amolee.

lines.english: It is the Beloved of my breath of life, and the Support of my mind; I remember it, asthe betel leaf chewer remembers the betel leaf. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraan pi-aaro maneh aDhaaro cheet  chitva-o jaisay paan t ambolee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have been absorbed in celestial bliss, following the Guru's Teachings; my body-garment is imbued with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: sahj samaa-i-o gureh bataa-i-o rang rangee mayray t an kee cholee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਅਧਾਰੋ  ਚੀਿਤ ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I come face to face with my Beloved, by great good fortune; my Husband Lord neverwavers. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pari-a mukh laago ja-o vadbh aago suhaag hamaaro kat ahu na dolee. ||1||

lines.english: I do not need any image, or incense, or perfume, or lamps; through and through, Heis blossoming forth, with me, life and limb.
lines.transliteration: roop na Dhoop na ganDh  na deepaa ot  pot ang ang sang ma-ulee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਓ  ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਬਤਾਇਓ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਚੋਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my Husband Lord has ravished and enjoyed His soul-bride; my bed hasbecome very beautiful and sublime. ||2||3||89|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (822-7) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak pari-a ravee suhaagan at neekee mayree banee kh atolee. ||2||3||89||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੋ  ਜਉ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ  ਸੁਹਾਗੁ  ਹਮਾਰੋ  ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind, we becomelike Him.
lines.transliteration: gobind gobind  gobind  ma-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪ ਨ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਗੰਧ ਨ ਦੀਪਾ ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਅੰਗ  ਅੰਗ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਉਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Since I met the compassionate, Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness has been driven far away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab tay bh aytay saaDh  da-i-aaraa t ab tay durmat  door bh a-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਰਵੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਨ  ਅਿਤ  ਨੀਕੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਟੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੯॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading everywhere. He is cool and calm, peaceful andcompassionate.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o sampooran seetal saaNt da-i-aal d a-ee.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and egotistical desires have all been eliminated from my body.||1||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh t arisnaa ahaNkaaraa t an tay ho-ay sagal kh a-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Truth, contentment, compassion, Dharmic faith and purity - I have received these from the Teachings of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh da-i-aa Dh aram such sant an tay ih mant  la-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਰਾ  ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਦੂਿਰ ਭਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one who realizes this in his mind, achieves total understanding.||2||4||90|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (822-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin manhu pachhaani-aa t in ka-o saglee sojh  pa-ee. ||2||4||90||

lines.english: What am I? Just a poor living being. I cannot even describe one of Your hairs, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ham jee-a jant baychaaray baran na saakah ayk romaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸੰਪੂਰਨ  ਸੀਤਲ  ਸਿਤ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਦਈ ॥
lines.english: Even Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas and the silent sages do not know Your State, OInfinite Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: barahm mahays siDh mun ind raa bay-ant  thaakur t ayree gat  nahee paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ਤਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ  ਖਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can I say? I cannot say anything.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kathee-ai kichh kathan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਸੁਿਚ ਸੰਤਨ  ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਲਈ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਨਹੁ ਪਛਾਿਨਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ  ਸੋਝ ਪਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੯੦॥
lines.english: And there, where the most terrible tortures are heard to be inflicted by the Messenger of Death, You are my only help and support, O my God.
lines.transliteration: jah mahaa bha-i-aan d ookh jam sunee-ai t ah mayray parabh  toohai sahaa-ee.

lines.english: I have sought His Sanctuary, and grasped hold of the Lord's Lotus Feet; God hashelped Guru Nanak to understand this understanding. ||2||5||91|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (822-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran pari-o har charan gahay parabh gur naanak ka-o boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||2||5||91||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹਮ ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ  ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਹ  ਏਕ ਰੋਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Inaccessible, Beautiful, Imperishable Creator Lord, Purifier of sinners, let memeditate on You, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: agam roop abhinaasee kart aa pat it pavit  ik nimakh  japaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮਹੇਸ  ਿਸਧ ਮੁਿਨ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Wondrous Lord, I have heard that You are found by meeting the Saints, andfocusing the mind on their feet, their holy feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: achraj suni-o paraapat bh aytulay sant  charan charan man laa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: In what way, and by what discipline, is He obtained?
lines.transliteration: kit biDh ee-ai kit  sanjam paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tell me, O good man, by what means can we meditate on Him? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaho surjan kit jugt ee Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: If one human being serves another human being, the one served stands by him.
lines.transliteration: jo maanukh maanukh  kee sayvaa oh t is kee la-ee la-ee fun jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ  ਦੂਖ ਜਮ ਸੁਨੀਐ  ਤਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary and Protection, O Lord, ocean of peace; He takes the Support of Your Name alone. ||2||6||92|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (822-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran saran sukh  saagar mohi tayk t ayro ik naa-ee-ai. ||2||6||92||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੨॥੫॥੯੧॥
lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and I serve the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant saran  sant tahal karee.

lines.english: DhanDh  banDh  ar sagal janjaaro avar kaaj t ay chh oot paree. ||1|| rahaa-o. I am rid of all worldly concerns, bonds, entanglements and other affairs. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਰੂਪ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਿਵਤ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਜਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained peace, poise and great bliss from the Guru, through the Lord's Name. pMnw 823
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj ar gh ano anand aa gur t ay paa-i-o naam haree.

lines.english: Such is the sublime essence of the Lord, that I cannot describe it. The Perfect Guru has turned me away from the world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aiso har ras baran na saaka-o gur poorai mayree ulat Dharee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਉਲਿਟ  ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I behold the Fascinating Lord with everyone. No one is without Him - He is pervadingeverywhere.
lines.transliteration: paykhi-o mohan sabh  kai sangay oon na kaahoo sagal bh aree.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਗਲ  ਭਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord, the treasure of mercy, is permeating everywhere. Says Nanak, I am fully fulfilled. ||2||7||93|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (823-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o kirpaa niDh kaho naanak mayree pooree paree. ||2||7||93||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੯੩॥
lines.english: What does the mind say? What can I say?
lines.transliteration: man ki-aa kahtaa ha-o ki-aa kaht aa.

lines.english: You are wise and all-knowing, O God, my Lord and Master; what can I say to You?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaan parbeen thaakur parabh  mayray t is aagai ki-aa kaht aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You know even what is not said, whatever is in the soul.
lines.transliteration: anbolay ka-o tuhee pachh aaneh jo jee-an meh hot aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਨ ਪਰ੍ਬੀਨ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mind, why do you deceive others? How long will you do this? The Lord is with you;He hears and sees everything. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ray man kaa-ay kahaa la-o dehkahi ja-o paykhat  hee sang sunt aa. ||1||

lines.english: Knowing this, my mind has become blissful; there is no other Creator.
lines.transliteration: aiso jaan bha-ay man aanad  aan na bee-o kart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਬੋਲੇ  ਕਉ ਤੁਹੀ ਪਛਾਨਿਹ  ਜੋ ਜੀਅਨ  ਮਿਹ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has become kind to me; my love for the Lord shall never wearoff. ||2||8||94|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (823-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bha-ay d a-i-aaraa har rang na kabhoo laht aa. ||2||8||94||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇ  ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਡਹਕਿਹ  ਜਉ ਪੇਖਤ  ਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੁਨਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Thus, the slanderer crumbles away.
lines.transliteration: nindak aisay hee jh ar paree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਜਾਿਨ  ਭਏ ਮਿਨ ਆਨਦ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਬੀਓ ਕਰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: This is the distinctive sign - listen, O Siblings of Destiny: he collapses like a wall of sand. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih neesaanee sunhu tum bh aa-ee ji-o kaalar bh eet giree-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲਹਤਾ  ॥੨॥੮॥੯੪॥
lines.english: When the slanderer sees a fault in someone else, he is pleased. Seeing goodness, heis depressed.
lines.transliteration: ja-o daykh ai chh idar ta-o nind ak umaahai bh alo daykh dukh bharee-ai.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he plots, but nothing works. The evil man dies, constantlythinking up evil plans. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar chit vai nahee pahuchai buraa chit vat chitvat maree-ai. ||1||

lines.english: The slanderer forgets God, death approaches him, and he starts to argue with the humble servant of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nindak parabh oo bh ulaa-i-aa kaal nayrai aa-i-aa har jan si-o baad  uthree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਉ  ਕਾਲਰ  ਭੀਿਤ  ਿਗਰੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||2||9||95|| God Himself, the Lord and Master, is Nanak's protector. What can any wretchedperson do to him? ||2||9||95|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (823-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa raakhaa aap parabh  su-aamee ki-aa maanas bapuray karee-ai.

lines.english: Why do you wander in delusion like this?
lines.transliteration: aisay kaahay bhool paray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਿਛਦਰ੍ੁ  ਤਉ ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਉਮਾਹੈ  ਭਲੋ ਦੇਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: You act, and incite others to act, and then deny it. The Lord is always with you; He sees and hears everything. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karahi karaaveh mookar paavahi paykhat  sunat  sadaa sang haray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਨਹੀ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਿਚਤਵਤ ਿਚਤਵਤ  ਮਰੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You purchase glass, and discard gold; you are in love with your enemy, while yourenounce your true friend.
lines.transliteration: kaach bihaajhan kanchan chh aadan bairee sang hayt  saajan t i-aag kh aray.
