lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨੇਰੈ ਆਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਉਠਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: That which exists, seems bitter; that which does not exist, seems sweet to you.Engrossed in corruption, you are burning away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hovan ka-uraa anhovan meethaa bikh i-aa meh laptaa-ay jaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਮਾਨਸ  ਬਪੁਰੇ  ਕਰੀਐ  ॥੨॥੯॥੯੫॥
lines.english: The mortal has fallen into the deep, dark pit, and is entangled in the darkness ofdoubt, and the bondage of emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop meh pari-o paraanee bh aram gubaar moh banDh  paray.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when God becomes merciful, one meets with the Guru, who takes him bythe arm, and lifts him out. ||2||10||96|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (823-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh hot  da-i-aaraa gur bh aytai kaadh ai baah faray. ||2||10||96||

lines.english: With my mind, body and tongue, I remember the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan rasnaa har cheenHaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਹ  ਕਰਾਵਿਹ  ਮੂਕਿਰ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am in ecstasy, and my anxieties are dispelled; the Guru has blessed me with totalpeace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay anand aa mitay and aysay sarab sookh  mo ka-o gur d eenHaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My ignorance has been totally transformed into wisdom. My God is wise and all- knowing.
lines.transliteration: i-aanap tay sabh  bha-ee si-aanap parabh  mayraa d aanaa beenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚ ਿਬਹਾਝਨ  ਕੰਚਨ  ਛਾਡਨ  ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹੇਤੁ ਸਾਜਨ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Giving me His Hand, He saved me, and now no one can harm me at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ai apnay ka-o kaahoo na kart ay kachh  kheenaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵਨੁ ਕਉਰਾ  ਅਨਹੋਵਨੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਬਿਖਆ ਮਿਹ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ਜਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Holy; by their Grace, I contemplate theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bal jaava-o darsan saaDh oo kai jih parsaad  har naam leenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਪਿਰਓ  ਪਰਾਨੀ  ਭਰਮ  ਗੁਬਾਰ  ਮੋਹ ਬੰਿਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I place my faith in my Lord and Master; within my mind, I do not believein any other, even for an instant. ||2||11||97|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (823-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak thaakur bh aarosai kahoo na maani-o man chh eenaa. ||2||11||97||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਰਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਕਾਢੈ  ਬਾਹ ਫਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੯੬॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has has saved me.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai mayree raakh la-ee.

lines.english: He has enshrined the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within my heart, and the filth ofcountless incarnations has been washed away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rid ay meh d eeno janam janam kee mail ga-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The demons and wicked enemies are driven out, by meditating, and chanting the Chant of the Perfect Guru. pMnw 824
lines.transliteration: nivray doot  dusat bairaa-ee gur pooray kaa japi-aa jaap.

lines.english: What can any wretched creature do to me? The radiance of my God is gloriously great. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahaa karai ko-ee baychaaraa parabh mayray kaa bad part aap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace; I haveenshrined His Lotus Feet within my mind.
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paa-i-aa charan kamal rakh  man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; there is none above Him. ||2||12||98|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (824-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taa kee saran pari-o naanak d aas jaa t ay oopar ko naahee. ||2||12||98||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥੧੨॥੯੮॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, chant the Name of God.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa japee-ai parabh  naam.

lines.english: The pains of old age and death shall not afflict you, and in the Court of the Lordhereafter, your affairs shall be perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaraa maraa kachh d ookh na bi-aapai aagai d argeh pooran kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So forsake your self-conceit, and ever seek Sanctuary. This treasure is obtained onlyfrom the Guru.
lines.transliteration: aap ti-aag paree-ai nit  sarnee gur t ay paa-ee-ai ayhu niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਆਗੈ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The noose of birth and death is snapped; this is the insignia, the hallmark, of theCourt of the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee katee-ai faasee saachee d argeh kaa neesaan. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever You do, I accept as good. I have eradicated all egotistical pride from my mind.
lines.transliteration: jo tumH karahu so-ee bh al maan-o man t ay chh ootai sagal gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਪਰੀਐ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਰਨੀ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਏਹੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am under His protection; He created the entire Universe. ||2||13||99|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (824-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak taa kee sarn aa-ee jaa kaa kee-aa sagal jahaan. ||2||13||99||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ  ਫਾਸੀ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Deep within the nucleus of his mind and body, is God.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar parabh  aahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਗਲ  ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and always does good forothers; his tongue is priceless. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavat par-upkaar nit  tis rasnaa kaa mol kichh  naahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੯੯॥
lines.english: All his generations are redeemed and saved in an instant, and the filth of countlessincarnations is washed away.
lines.transliteration: kul samooh uDhray kh in bheetar janam janam kee mal laahee.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, his Lord and Master, he passesblissfully through the forest of poison. ||1||
lines.transliteration: simar simar su-aamee parabh apnaa anad  saytee bikh i-aa ban gaahee. ||1||

lines.english: I have obtained the boat of God's Feet, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: charan parabhoo kay bohith paa-ay bh av saagar paar paraahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ  ਿਨਤ ਿਤਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saints, servants and devotees belong to the Lord; Nanak's mind is attached toHim. ||2||14||100|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (824-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant sayvak bh agat har t aa kay naanak man laagaa hai t aahee. ||2||14||100||

lines.english: Dheera-o d aykh tumHaarai rangaa. I am reassured, gazing upon Your wondrous play.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਰੇ  ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; You dwellwith the Holy Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tuhee su-aamee ant arjaamee t oohee vaseh saaDh  kai sangaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਅਨਦ  ਸੇਤੀ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, our Lord and Master establishes and exalts. From a lowly worm, Hecreates a king. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap nivaajay th aakur neech keet t ay karahi raajangaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕੇ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਪਾਏ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: May I never forget You from my heart; slave Nanak prays for this blessing. ||2||15||101|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (824-13) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kabhoo na bisrai hee-ay moray tay naanak d aas ihee d aan mangaa. ||2||15||101||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਹੈ ਤਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੦੦॥
lines.english: The imperishable Lord God is worthy of worship and adoration.
lines.transliteration: achut poojaa jog gopaal.

lines.english: Dedicating my mind and body, I place them before the Lord, the Cherisher of allbeings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan arap rakh a-o har aagai sarab jee-aa kaa hai part ipaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: His Sanctuary is All-powerful; He cannot be described; He is the Giver of peace, theocean of mercy, supremely compassionate.
lines.transliteration: saran samrath akath sukh-d aata kirpaa sinDh  bado d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਤੂਹੀ ਵਸਿਹ  ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Holding him close in His embrace, the Lord protects and saves him, and then even the hot wind cannot touch him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay raakh ai apnay ka-o t is no lagai na t aatee baal. ||1||

lines.english: Our Merciful Lord and Master is wealth, property and everything to His humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: daamod ar da-i-aal su-aamee sarbas sant  janaa Dh an maal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਿਪ  ਿਨਵਾਜੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਕਰਿਹ  ਰਾਜੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak, a beggar, asks for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; please, bless him withthe dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||16||102|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (824-17) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachik daras parabh  maagai sant  janaa kee milai ravaal. ||2||16||102||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਇਹੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਾ  ॥੨॥੧੫॥੧੦੧॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of efforts.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam kot jat an bh a-ay.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of theLord, and the Messenger of Death will be frightened away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil har gun gaa-ay jamd ootan ka-o t araas ahay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: To enshrine the Feet of God in one's mind and body, is to perform all sorts of acts ofatonement.
lines.transliteration: jaytay punahcharan say keenHay man t an parabh  kay charan  gahay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਰਖਉ ਹਿਰ ਆਗੈ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Coming and going, doubt and fear have run away, and the sins of countlessincarnations are burnt away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  bharam bh a-o naath aa janam janam kay kilvikh  dahay. ||1||

lines.english: So become fearless, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. This is true wealth, obtained only by great good fortune. pMnw 825
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o ho-ay bh ajahu jagd eesai ayhu pad aarath vadbh aag lahay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਤੇ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੧੦੩॥
lines.english: Be merciful, O Perfect God, Great Giver, that slave Nanak may chant Your immaculate Praises. ||2||17||103|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (825-1) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa pooran parabh d aatay nirmal jas naanak d aas kahay. ||2||17||103||

lines.english: The Lord saved me from Sulhi Khan.
lines.transliteration: sulhee tay naaraa-in  raakh .

lines.english: The emperor did not succeed in his plot, and he died in disgrace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sulhee kaa haath kahee na pahuchai sulhee ho-ay moo-aa naapaak. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਲਹੀ  ਕਾ ਹਾਥੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੁਲਹੀ  ਹੋਇ ਮੂਆ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master raised His axe, and chopped off his head; in an instant, he wasreduced to dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaadh kuth aar kh asam sir kaati-aa kh in meh ho-ay ga-i-aa hai kh aak.

lines.english: Plotting and planning evil, he was destroyed. The One who created him, gave him apush.
lines.transliteration: mandaa chit vat chitvat pachi-aa jin rachi-aa t in deenaa Dh aak. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਢ  ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਖਸਿਮ  ਿਸਰੁ ਕਾਿਟਆ  ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ  ਹੈ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: Of his sons, friends and wealth, nothing remains; he departed, leaving behind all hisbrothers and relatives.
lines.transliteration: putar meet  Dhan kichh oo na rahi-o so chh od ga-i-aa sabh  bhaa-ee saak.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to God, who fulfilled the word of His slave. ||2||18||104|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (825-5) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis parabh  balihaaree jin jan kaa keeno pooran vaak. ||2||18||104||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਮੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਗਇਆ  ਸਭ ਭਾਈ  ਸਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: Perfect is service to the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee pooree sayv.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ  ਵਾਕੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੧੦੪॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master Himself is Himself all-pervading. The Divine Guru has resolved allmy affairs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aapay aap vartai su-aamee kaaraj raas kee-aa gurd ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God is our only Lord and Master. HeHimself fashioned His Creation.
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  parabh  ant su-aamee apnaa thaat banaa-i-o aap.

lines.english: He Himself saves His servant. Great is the glorious grandeur of my God! ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak kee aapay raakhai parabh  mayray ko vad part aap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਕੀਆ  ਗੁਰਦੇਵ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord is the True Guru; all beings are in Hispower.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysur satgur vas keenHay jin saglay jant .

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet, chanting the Lord's Name, theimmaculate Mantra. ||2||19||105|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (825-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak sarnaa-ee raam naam jap nirmal mant . ||2||19||105||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ ਮਿਧ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਓ  ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself protects me from suffering and sin.
lines.transliteration: taap paap t ay raakh ay aap.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੀ ਆਪੇ  ਰਾਖੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Falling at the Guru's Feet, I am cooled and soothed; I meditate on the Lord's Name within my heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: seetal bh a-ay gur charnee laagay raam naam hird ay meh jaap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਵਿਸ ਕੀਨੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਜੰਤ ॥
lines.english: Granting His Mercy, God has extended His Hands. He is the Emancipator of the World;His glorious radiance pervades the nine continents.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa hasat parabh  deenay jagat  uDhaar nav kh and part aap.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਿਪ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੧੦੫॥
lines.english: My pain has been dispelled, and peace and pleasure have come; my desire isquenched, and my mind and body are truly satisfied. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dukh binsay sukh  anad  parvaysaa t arisan bujh ee man t an sach Dh araap. ||1||

lines.english: He is the Master of the masterless, All-powerful to give Sanctuary. He is the Motherand Father of the whole Universe.
lines.transliteration: anaath ko naath saran samrathaa sagal sarisat ko maa-ee baap.

lines.english: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; Nanak sings and chants theGlorious Praises of his Lord and Master. ||2||20||106|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (825-13) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al bhai bhanjan su-aamee gun  gaavat  naanak aalaap. ||2||20||106||

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਲ  ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਹਰਦੇ  ਮਿਹ ਜਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Acknowledge the One, from whom You originated.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upji-aa t iseh pachh aan.

lines.english: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, I have found peace, pleasure and salvation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysar Dhi-aa-i-aa kusal kh aym ho-ay kali-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਹਸਤ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਦੀਨੇ ਜਗਤ  ਉਧਾਰ  ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪ  ॥
lines.english: I met the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, and so found the wise and all-knowingLord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa bhayti-o bad bh aagee ant arjaamee sugh arh sujaan.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ  ਪਰ੍ਵੇਸਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਧਰ੍ਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He gave me His Hand, and making me His own, He saved me; He is absolutely all- powerful, the honor of the dishonored. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ay kar apnay bad samrath nimaan i-aa ko maan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥ  ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਮਰਥਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕੋ ਮਾਈ  ਬਾਪੁ ॥
lines.english: Doubt and fear have been dispelled in an instant, and in the darkness, the DivineLight shines forth.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ai binas ga-ay kh in bheetar anDh kaar pargatay chaanaan .

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਲਾਪ  ॥੨॥੨੦॥੧੦੬॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; forever and ever, Iam a sacrifice to Him. ||2||21||107|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (825-17) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas saas aaraaDhai naanak sad aa sad aa jaa-ee-ai kurbaan . ||2||21||107||

lines.english: Both here and hereafter, the Mighty Guru protects me.
lines.transliteration: dovai thaav rakh ay gur sooray.

lines.english: God has embellished this world and the next for me, and all my affairs are perfectlyresolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  paarbarahm savaaray kaaraj ho-ay saglay pooray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਕੁਸਲ  ਖੇਮ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਲਆਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace and poise, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japat sukh  sehjay majan hovat  saaDh oo Dh ooray.

lines.english: Comings and goings have ceased, and I have found stability; the pains of birth anddeath are eradicated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay thit  paa-ee janam maran  kay mitay bisooray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: I cross over the ocean of doubt and fear, and the fear of death is gone; the One Lord is permeating and pervading in each and every heart. pMnw 826
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ai taray chh utay bh ai jam kay gh at ghat ayk rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; I behold His Presence deep within, and all around as well. ||2||22||108|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (826-2) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pari-o d ukh bhanjan ant ar baahar paykh  hajooray. ||2||22||108||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਪੇਿਖ ਹਜੂਰੇ  ॥੨॥੨੨॥੧੦੮॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all pains run away.
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykhat dokh nasay.

lines.english: Please, never leave my vision, O Lord; please abide with my soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kabahu na hovhu darisat agochar jee-a kai sang basay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My Beloved Lord and Master is the Support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: pareetam paraan aDh aar su-aamee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God, the Inner-knower, is all-pervading. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poor rahay parabh ant arjaamee. ||1||

lines.english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I contemplate and remember?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gun t ayray saar samHaaree.

lines.english: With each and every breath, O God, I remember You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saas saas parabh t ujheh chit aaree. ||2||

lines.english: God is the ocean of mercy, merciful to the meek;
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDh parabh  deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: He cherishes all beings and creatures. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant kee karahu part ipaalaa. ||3||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, Your humble servant chants Your Name.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar t ayraa naam jan jaapay.

lines.english: You Yourself, O God, have inspired Nanak to love You. ||4||23||109|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (826-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pareet laa-ee parabh  aapay. ||4||23||109||

lines.english: Body, wealth and youth pass away.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an joban chalat  ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
lines.english: You have not meditated and vibrated upon the Lord's Name; while you commit your sins of corruption in the night, the light of day dawns upon you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam kaa bhajan na keeno karat  bikaar nis bh or bha-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Continually eating all sorts of foods, the teeth in your mouth crumble, decay and fallout.
lines.transliteration: anik parkaar bhojan nit  khaatay mukh  dantaa gh as kheen kh a-i-aa.

lines.english: Living in egotism and possessiveness, you are deluded; committing sins, you have nokindness for others. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kar kar mooth-o paap karat  nah paree d a-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The great sins are the terrible ocean of pain; the mortal is engrossed in them.
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikaar ghor d ukh saagar t is meh paraan ee galat  pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ  ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਕਾਰ ਿਨਿਸ  ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; taking him by the arm, God haslifted him up and out. ||2||24||110|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (826-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran paray naanak su-aamee kee baah pakar parabh kaadh  la-i-aa. ||2||24||110||

lines.english: God Himself has come into my consciousness.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa parabh aa-i-aa cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰ  ਭੋਜਨ  ਿਨਤ ਖਾਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤਾ  ਘਿਸ  ਖੀਨ ਖਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My enemies and opponents have grown weary of attacking me, and now, I havebecome happy, O my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dusman d usat rahay jh akh maarat  kusal bh a-i-aa mayray bh aa-ee meet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਮੂਠਉ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ  ਨਹ ਪਰੀ ਦਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The disease is gone, and all misfortunes have been averted; the Creator Lord has made me His own.
lines.transliteration: ga-ee bi-aaDh upaaDh  sabh  naasee angeekaar kee-o kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਗਲਤੁ  ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have found peace, tranquility and total bliss, enshrining the Name of my BelovedLord within my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaNt sookh  ar anad  ghanayray pareet am naam rid ai ur haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੧੧੦॥
lines.english: My soul, body and wealth are all Your capital; O God, You are my All-powerful Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind Dhan raas parabh  tayree t ooN samrath su-aamee mayraa.

lines.english: You are the Saving Grace of Your slaves; slave Nanak is forever Your slave.||2||25||111|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (826-14) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daas apunay ka-o raakh anhaaraa naanak d aas sad aa hai chayraa. ||2||25||111||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I am emancipated.
lines.transliteration: gobid simar ho-aa kali-aan .

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਮਨ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਰਹੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਤ ਕੁਸਲੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Suffering is eradicated, and true peace has come, meditating on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mitee upaaDh bh a-i-aa sukh  saachaa ant arjaamee simri-aa jaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All beings belong to Him - He makes them happy. He is the true power of His humbledevotees.
lines.transliteration: jis kay jee-a tin kee-ay sukh aalay bh agat janaa ka-o saachaa t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗਈ ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਉਪਾਿਧ  ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ  ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself saves and protects His slaves, who believe in their Creator, the Destroyer of fear. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daas apunay kee aapay raakh ee bh ai bhanjan oopar kart ay maan . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਨਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਹਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found friendship, and hatred has been eradicated; the Lord has rooted out theenemies and villains.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee mit raa-ee mitee buraa-ee d arusat d oot har kaadh ay chh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Nanak has been blessed with celestial peace and poise and total bliss; chanting theGlorious Praises of the Lord, he lives. ||2||26||112|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (826-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ghanayray naanak jeevai har gun ah vakh aan. ||2||26||112||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੧੧੧॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has become Merciful.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh bh a-ay kirpaal.

lines.english: The True Guru has arranged all my affairs; chanting and meditating with the HolySaints, I have become happy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaaraj sagal savaaray satgur jap jap saaDh oo bh a-ay nihaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God has made me His own, and all my enemies have been reduced to dust.
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-aa parabh apnai d okhee saglay bh a-ay ravaal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਟੀ  ਉਪਾਿਧ  ਭਇਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਿਸਮਿਰਆ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He hugs us close in His embrace, and protects His humble servants; attaching us to the hem of His robe, he saves us. ||1|| pMnw 827
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay raakh ay jan apnay uDh ar lee-ay laa-ay apnai paal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ  ਉਧਿਰ  ਲੀਏ ਲਾਇ  ਅਪਨੈ  ਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Safe and sound, we have returned home, while the slanderer's face is blackened.
lines.transliteration: sahee salaamat mil gh ar aa-ay nind ak kay mukh  ho-ay kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਏ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect; by the Grace of God and Guru, I am so happy. ||2||27||113|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (827-3) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayraa satgur pooraa gur parsaad  parabh  bha-ay nihaal. ||2||27||113||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਏ ਿਨਹਾਲ  ॥੨॥੨੭॥੧੧੩॥
lines.english: I have fallen in love with my Beloved Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: moo laalan si-o pareet banee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Cutting it, it does not break, and releasing it, it does not let go. Such is the string theLord has tied me with. ||1||
lines.transliteration: toree na t ootai chh oree na chh ootai aisee maaDh o khinch t anee. ||1||

lines.english: Day and night, He dwells within my mind; please bless me with Your Mercy, O myGod. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dinas rain man maahi basat  hai too kar kirpaa parabh  apnee. ||2||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my beauteous Lord; I have heard his Unspoken Speechand Story. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaa-o si-aam sundar ka-o akath kathaa jaa kee baat  sunee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਰੀ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਛੋਰੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਐਸੀ  ਮਾਧੋ ਿਖੰਚ ਤਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: 5) jan naanak daasan d aas kahee-at  hai mohi karahu kirpaa th aakur apunee. ||4||28||114|| Servant Nanak is said to be the slave of His slaves; O my Lord and Master, pleasebless me with Your Mercy. ||4||28||114|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (827-6) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Lord's Feet; I am a sacrifice to Them.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan jap jaaN-o kurbaan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ਿਸਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਕਉ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; I enshrine Him within myheart, and meditate on Him within my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur mayraa paarbarahm parmaysur taa kaa hird ai Dhar man Dh i-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਹੈ ਮੋਿਹ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਪੁਨੀ  ॥੪॥੨੮॥੧੧੪॥
lines.english: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Giver of peace, who created thewhole Universe.
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar sukh-d aata jaa kaa kee-aa sagal jahaan.

lines.english: With your tongue, savor the One Lord, and you shall be honored in the Court of theTrue Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa ravhu ayk naaraa-in saachee d argeh paavhu maan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਜਿਪ ਜਉ  ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone obtains this treasure, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang paraapat  jaa ka-o t in hee paa-i-aa ayhu niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਧਿਰ ਮਨ ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master, mercifully bless Nanak with this gift, that he may ever sing the Glorious Praises of Your Kirtan. ||2||29||115|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (827-10) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gaava-o gun keert an nit  su-aamee kar kirpaa naanak d eejai d aan. ||2||29||115||

lines.english: I have been saved, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay sat gur kee saran .

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: I am cheered and applauded throughout the world; my Supreme Lord God carries me across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar ho-aa jag antar paarbarahm mayro t aaran  taran. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਵਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord fills the Universe; He is the Giver of peace; He cherishes and fulfillsthe whole Universe.
lines.transliteration: bisamvbhar pooran sukh -daata sagal samagree pokh an bharan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ਏਹੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He is completely filling all places and inte rspaces; I am a devoted sacrifice to the Lord's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar sarab nirant ar bal bal jaaN-ee har kay charan . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਉ  ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਿਨਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੧੧੫॥
lines.english: The ways of all beings are in Your Power, O my Lord and Master. All supernaturalspiritual powers are Yours; You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jugat vas mayray su-aamee sarab siDh  tum kaaran  karan .

lines.english: 5) aad jugaad  parabh  rakh-daa aa-i-aa har simrat  naanak nahee daran . ||2||30||116|| In the beginning, and throughout the ages, God is our Savior and Protector; remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, fear is eliminated. ||2||30||116|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 dupdy Gru 8  (827-15) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 dupd ay gh ar 8 Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas, Eighth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (827-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I am nothing, God; everything is Yours.
lines.transliteration: mai naahee parabh sabh  kichh  tayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ  ਜਗ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਮੇਰੋ ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this world, You are the absolute, formless Lord; in the world hereafter, You are the related Lord of form. You play it both ways, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: eeghai nirgun oogh ai sargun kayl karat  bich su-aamee mayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You exist within the city, and beyond it as well; O my God, You are everywhere.
lines.transliteration: nagar meh aap baahar fun aapan parabh mayray ko sagal basayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸੰਭਰ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ ਪੋਖਣ  ਭਰਣ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the King, and You Yourself are the subject. In one place, You are the Lord and Master, and in another place, You are the slave. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay hee raajan aapay hee raa-i-aa kah kah thaakur kah kah chayraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From whom should I hide? Whom should I try to deceive? Wherever I look, I see Himnear at hand.
lines.transliteration: kaa ka-o duraa-o kaa si-o balbanchaa jah jah paykh a-o tah tah nayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਵਿਸ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਤੁਮ ਕਾਰਣ  ਕਰਣ  ॥
lines.english: I have met with Guru Nanak, the Embodiment of the Holy Saints. When the drop ofwater merges into the ocean, it cannot be distinguished as separate again.||2||1||117|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (827-19) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 828
lines.transliteration: saaDh moorat  gur bh ayti-o naanak mil saagar boond  nahee an hayraa. ||2||1||117||

lines.english: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: tumH samrathaa kaaran karan.

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਕਨ  ਢਾਿਕ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਿਹ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਸਰਨ  ਚਰਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please cover my faults, Lord of the Universe, O my Guru; I am a sinner - I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dhaakan dh aak gobid  gur mayray mohi apraaDh ee saran charan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever we do, You see and know; there is no way anyone can stubbornly deny this.
lines.transliteration: jo jo keeno so tumH jaani-o paykh i-o tha-ur naahee kachh  dheeth mukran.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ  ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਠਉਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਛੁ ਢੀਠ ਮੁਕਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: Your glorious radiance is great! So I have heard, O God. Millions of sins are destroyed by Your Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bad partaap suni-o parabh  tumHro kot agh aa tayro naam haran. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ਸੁਿਨਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਰੋ  ਕੋਿਟ ਅਘਾ  ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is my nature to make mistakes, forever and ever; it is Your Natural Way to savesinners.
lines.transliteration: hamro sahaa-o sadaa sad  bhoolan t umHro birad  patit uDhran.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੋ  ਸਹਾਉ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਨ ਤੁਮਰੋ  ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: You are the embodiment of kindness, and the treasure of compassion, O MercifulLord; through the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Nanak has found the state ofredemption in life. ||2||2||118|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (828-4) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karunaa mai kirpaal kirpaa niDh  jeevan pad  naanak har d arsan. ||2||2||118||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੮॥
lines.english: Bless me with such mercy, Lord,
lines.transliteration: aisee kirpaa mohi karahu.

santeh charan  hamaaro maathaa nain d aras t an Dh oor parahu. ||1|| rahaa-o. that my forehead may touch the feet of the Saints, and my eyes may behold theBlessed Vision of their Darshan, and my body may fall at the dust of their feet.||1||Pause||

lines.english: May the Word of the Guru's Shabad abide within my heart, and the Lord's Name beenshrined within my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur ko sabad mayrai hee-arai baasai har naamaa man sang Dh arahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹ  ਚਰਣ  ਹਮਾਰੋ  ਮਾਥਾ  ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ  ਤਿਨ  ਧੂਿਰ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Drive out the five thieves, O my Lord and Master, and let my doubts all burn like incense. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taskar panch nivaarahu th aakur saglo bh armaa hom jarahu. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever You do, I accept as good; I have driven out the sense of duality.
lines.transliteration: jo tumH karahu so-ee bh al maanai bh aavan d ubiDh aa door tarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਬਾਸੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਮਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਧਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: You are Nanak's God, the Great Giver; in the Congregation of the Saints, emancipateme. ||2||3||119|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (828-8) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay parabh t um hee d aatay sat sang lay mohi uDh rahu. ||2||3||119||

lines.punjabi: ਤਸਕਰ  ਪੰਚ ਿਨਵਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਗਲੋ  ਭਰਮਾ  ਹੋਿਮ ਜਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I ask for such advice from Your humble servants,
lines.transliteration: aisee deekh i-aa jan si-o mangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਵਨੁ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਟਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumHro Dh i-aan t umHaaro rangaa. that I may meditate on You, and love You,

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦਾਤੇ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ ਲੇ ਮੋਿਹ ਉਧਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: tumHree sayvaa t umHaaray angaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. and serve You, and become part and parcel of Your Being. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: I serve His humble servants, and speak with them, and abide with them.
lines.transliteration: jan kee tahal sambhaakh an jan si-o ooth an baith an jan kai sangaa.

lines.english: I apply the dust of the feet of His humble servants to my face and forehead; myhopes, and the many waves of desire, are fulfilled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan char raj mukh maathai laagee aasaa pooran anant  tarangaa. ||1||

lines.english: Immaculate and pure are the praises of the humble servants of the Supreme Lord God; the feet of His humble servants are equal to millions of sacred shrines ofpilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: jan paarbarahm jaa kee nirmal mahimaa jan kay charan tirath kot gangaa.

lines.english: Nanak bathes in the dust of the feet of His humble servants; the sinful resides ofcountless incarnations have been washed away. ||2||4||120|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (828-12) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan kee Dhoor kee-o majan naanak janam janam kay haray kalangaa. ||2||4||120||

lines.english: If it pleases You, then cherish me.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o mohi part ipaal.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਊਠਨੁ ਬੈਠਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, O True Guru, I am Your child, and You aremy Merciful Father. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysar satgur ham baarik t umH pitaa kirpaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਚਰ ਰਜ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ  ਆਸਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਨੰਤ  ਤਰੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am worthless; I have no virtues at all. I cannot understand Your actions.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun gun  naahee ko-ee pahuch na saaka-o t umHree gh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਕੋਿਟ ਗੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: You alone know Your state and extent. My soul, body and property are all Yours. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumree gat  mit tum hee jaanhu jee-o pind sabh  tumro maal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਕੀਓ  ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕਲੰਗਾ  ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੦॥
lines.english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Primal Lord and Master; Youknow even what is unspoken.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee purakh  su-aamee anbolat  hee jaanhu haal.

lines.english: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, O Nanak, by God's Glance of Grace. ||2||5||121|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (828-16) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al ho-ay hamaaro naanak parabh  jee-o nad ar nihaal. ||2||5||121||

lines.english: Keep me with You forever, O God.
lines.transliteration: raakh sad aa parabh  apnai saath.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਤੁਮ ਿਪਤਾ  ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my Beloved, the Enticer of my mind; without You, my life is totally useless.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: too hamro pareet am manmohan t ujh bin jeevan sagal akaath. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In an instant, You transform the beggar into a king; O my God, You are the Master ofthe masterless.
lines.transliteration: rank tay raa-o karat  khin bheetar parabh  mayro anaath ko naath.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਈ ਪਹੁਿਚ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਘਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: You save Your humble servants from the burning fire; You make them Your own, andwith Your Hand, You protect them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jalat agan meh jan aap uDh aaray kar apunay d ay raakh ay haath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ  ਮਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found peace and cool tranquility, and my mind is satisfied; meditating inremembrance on the Lord, all struggles are ended.
lines.transliteration: seetal sukh  paa-i-o man t ariptai har simrat  saram saglay laath.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਨਬੋਲਤ  ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਾਲ ॥
lines.english: Service to the Lord, O Nanak, is the treasure of treasures; all other clever tricks areuseless. ||2||6||122|| pMnw 829 iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (829-1) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: niDh niDh aan naanak har sayvaa avar si-aanap sagal akaath.

lines.english: Never forget Your servant, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak ka-o kabahu na bisaarahu.

lines.english: Hug me close in Your embrace, O God, my Lord and Master; consider my primal lovefor You, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ur laagahu su-aamee parabh mayray poorab pareet  gobind  beechaarahu. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: It is Your Natural Way, God, to purify sinners; please do not keep my errors in YourHeart.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan parabh  birad  tumHaaro hamray d okh ridai mat  Dhaarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਉਿਰ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰਬ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my life, my breath of life, O Lord, my wealth and peace; be merciful to me,and burn away the curtain of egotism. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jeevan paraan har Dhan sukh  tum hee ha-umai patal kirpaa kar jaarahu. ||1||

lines.english: Without water, how can the fish survive? Without milk, how can the baby survive?
lines.transliteration: jal bihoon meen kat jeevan d ooDh binaa rahan kat  baaro.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰੋ  ਹਮਰੇ  ਦੋਖ ਿਰਦੈ ਮਤ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: ||2||7||123|| Servant Nanak thirsts for the Lord's Lotus Feet; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of hisLord and Master's Darshan, he finds the essence of peace. ||2||7||123|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (829-5) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak pi-aas charan kamlanH kee paykh d aras su-aamee sukh  saaro.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਟਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Here, and hereafter, there is happiness.
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai kusal bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਿਬਹੂਨ ਮੀਨ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ  ਦੂਧ ਿਬਨਾ  ਰਹਨੁ ਕਤ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has perfectly, totally saved me; the Supreme Lord God has been kind to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pooree sabh raakh ee paarbarahm parabh  keenee ma-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲਨ  ਕੀ ਪੇਿਖ ਦਰਸੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੩॥
lines.english: The Lord, my Beloved, is pervading and permeating my mind and body; all my painsand sufferings are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: man tan rav rahi-aa har pareet am dookh darad saglaa mit ga-i-aa.

lines.english: In celestial peace, tranquility and bliss, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; myenemies and adversaries have been totally destroyed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaNt sahj aanad  gun gaa-ay d oot dusat sabh  ho-ay kh a-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: God has not considered my merits and demerits; in His Mercy, He has made me Hisown.
lines.transliteration: gun avgun parabh kachh  na beechaari-o kar kirpaa apunaa kar la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਨੀ  ਮਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Unweighable is the greatness of the immovable and imperishable Lord; Nanakproclaims the victory of the Lord. ||2||8||124|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (829-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: atul badaa-ee achut  abhinaasee naanak uchrai har kee ja-i-aa. ||2||8||124||

lines.english: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, how can anyone cross over theworld-ocean?
lines.transliteration: bin bhai bh agtee taran kaisay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ  ਸਗਲਾ  ਿਮਿਟ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Be kind to me, O Saving Grace of sinners; preserve my faith in You, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karahu anoograhu patit  uDhaaran raakh  su-aamee aap bh arosay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਆਨਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ  ਸਿਭ ਹੋਏ ਖਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal does not remember the Lord in meditation; he wanders around intoxicatedby egotism; he is engrossed in corruption like a dog.
lines.transliteration: simran nahee aavat firat  mad maavat  bikhi-aa raat aa su-aan jaisay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕਿਰ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Utterly cheated, his life is slipping away; committing sins, he is sinking away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: a-oDh bihaavat  aDhik mohaavat  paap kamaavat  buday aisay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਤੁਲ  ਬਡਾਈ  ਅਚੁਤ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਉਚਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਜਇਆ  ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੪॥
lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Destroyer of pain; O Primal Immaculate Lord, may Idwell upon You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saran dukh  bhanjan purakh  niranjan saaDh oo sangat  ravan  jaisay.

lines.english: O Lord of beautiful hair, Destroyer of pain, Eradicator of sins, Nanak lives, gazingupon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||9||125|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 dupdy Gru 9  (829-14) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 dupd ay gh ar 9 Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas, Ninth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (829-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaysav kalays naas agh kh andan naanak jeevat  daras d isay. ||2||9||125||

lines.english: He Himself merges us with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapeh mayl la-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਪਿਤਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਪ  ਭਰੋਸੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When I came to Your Sanctuary, my sins vanished. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab tay saran t umaaree aa-ay t ab tay dokh ga-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Renouncing egotistical pride and other anxieties, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan ar chint  biraanee saaDh ah saran pa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਤ  ਿਫਰਤ  ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ  ਿਬਿਖਆ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸੁਆਨ  ਜੈਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, O my Beloved, disease is eradicated from mybody. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jap jap naam tumHaaro pareet am tan tay rog kh a-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਧ  ਿਬਹਾਵਤ  ਅਿਧਕ  ਮੋਹਾਵਤ  ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਤ  ਬੁਡੇ ਐਸੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even utterly foolish, ignorant and thoughtless persons have been saved by the KindLord.
lines.transliteration: mahaa mugaDh ajaan agi-aanee raakh ay Dh aar da-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਰਵਣੁ  ਜੈਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have met the Perfect Guru; my comings and goings have ended.||2||1||126|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (829-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur pooraa bhayti-o aavan jaan rahay. ||2||1||126||

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸਵ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਨਾਸ ਅਘ  ਖੰਡਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਵਤ  ਦਰਸ  ਿਦਸੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੨੫॥
lines.english: Hearing Your Name, I live.
lines.transliteration: jeeva-o naam sunee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੯ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When the Perfect Guru became pleased with me, then my hopes were fulfilled.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ja-o suparsan bha-ay gur pooray t ab mayree aas punee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Pain is gone, and my mind is comforted; the music of bliss fascinates me.
lines.transliteration: peer ga-ee baaDhee man Dh eeraa mohi-o anad  Dhunee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਰਿਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਆਏ  ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The yearning to meet my Beloved God has welled up within me. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. ||1|| pMnw 830
lines.transliteration: upji-o chaa-o milan parabh pareet am rahan na jaa-ay kh inee. ||1||

lines.english: You have saved so many devotees, so many humble servants; so many silent sages contemplate You.
lines.transliteration: anik bhagat  anik jan t aaray simrahi anik munee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਨ ਤਾਰੇ ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਮੁਨੀ ॥
lines.english: The support of the blind, the wealth of the poor; Nanak has found God, of endlessvirtues. ||2||2||127|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 5 Gru 13 pVqwl  (830-3) raag bilaaval mehlaa 5 ghar 13 parh -taal Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Thirteenth House, Partaal: <> siqgur pRswid ] (830-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: anDhulay tik nirDh an Dh an paa-i-o parabh  naanak anik gunee. ||2||2||127||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਿਟਕ ਿਨਰਧਨ  ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਗੁਨੀ  ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੭॥
lines.english: O Enticing Lord, I cannot sleep; I sigh. I am adorned with necklaces, gowns,ornaments and make-up.
lines.transliteration: mohan need na aavai haavai haar kajar bast ar abh ran keenay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I am sad, sad and depressed.
lines.transliteration: udeenee udeenee udeenee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਹਾਵੈ ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ  ਬਸਤਰ੍  ਅਭਰਨ  ਕੀਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: When will You come home? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kab ghar aavai ree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the happy soul-brides; I place my head upon their feet.
lines.transliteration: saran suhaagan charan sees Dhar.

lines.english: Unite me with my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: laalan mohi milaavhu.

lines.english: When will He come to my home? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kab ghar aavai ree. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, my companions: tell me how to meet Him. Eradicate all egotism, and then youshall find your Beloved Lord within the home of your heart.
lines.transliteration: sunhu sahayree milan baat kaha-o sagro ahaN mitaavhu t a-o gh ar hee laalan paavhu.

lines.english: Then, in delight, you shall sing the songs of joy and praise.
lines.transliteration: tab ras mangal gun gaavhu.

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of bliss.
lines.transliteration: aanad roop Dh i-aavahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਹੇਰੀ  ਿਮਲਨ  ਬਾਤ ਕਹਉ  ਸਗਰੋ  ਅਹੰ ਿਮਟਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I came to the Lord's Door,
lines.transliteration: naanak du-aarai aa-i-o.
ta-o mai laalan paa-i-o ree. ||2|| and then, I found my Beloved. ||2||

lines.english: The Enticing Lord has revealed His form to me,
lines.transliteration: mohan roop dikh aavai.
ab mohi need suhaavai. and now, sleep seems sweet to me.

lines.english: My thirst is totally quenched,
lines.transliteration: sabh mayree t ikhaa bujh aanee.
ab mai sahj samaanee. and now, I am absorbed in celestial bliss.

lines.english: How sweet is the story of my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: meethee pireh kahaanee.

lines.english: I have found my Beloved, Enticing Lord. ||Second Pause||1||128|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (830-9) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mohan laalan paa-i-o ree. rahaa-o doojaa. ||1||128||

lines.english: My ego is gone; I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: moree ahaN jaa-ay darsan paavat  hay.

lines.english: I am absorbed in my Lord and Master, the help and support of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: raachahu naath hee sahaa-ee santnaa.

lines.english: Now, I hold tight to His Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ab charan gahay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mind longs for Him, and does not love any other. I am totally absorbed, in love with His Lotus Feet, like the bumble bee attached to the honey of the lotus flower.
lines.transliteration: aahay man avar na bhaavai charnaavai charnaavai uljh i-o al makrand  kamal ji-o.

lines.english: I do not desire any other taste; I seek only the One Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an ras nahee chaahai aykai har laahai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਪਾਵਤ  ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: I have broken away from the others, and I have been released from the Messenger ofDeath.
lines.transliteration: an tay tootee-ai rikh  tay chh ootee-ai.

lines.english: O mind, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord; join the Saadh Sangat, the Companyof the Holy, and turn away from the world.
lines.transliteration: man har ras ghootee-ai sang saaDh oo ultee-ai.

lines.english: There is no other, none other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an naahee naahee ray.

lines.english: O Nanak, love the Feet, the Feet of the Lord. ||2||2||129|| rwgu iblwvlu mhlw 9 dupdy  (830-14) raag bilaaval mehlaa 9 dupd ay Raag Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (830-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak pareet charan charan hay. ||2||2||129||

lines.punjabi: ਆਹੇ  ਮਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ  ਚਰਨਾਵੈ  ਉਲਿਝਓ  ਅਿਲ  ਮਕਰੰਦ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਜਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Dispeller of sorrow - realize this.
lines.transliteration: dukh hartaa har naam pachh aano.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, even Ajaamal the robber and Ganikaa the prostitute were liberated; let your soul know this. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ajaamal ganikaa jih simrat mukat  bha-ay jee-a jaano. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The elephant's fear was taken away in an instant, as soon as he chanted the Lord'sName.
lines.transliteration: gaj kee taraas mitee chh inhoo meh jab hee raam bakh aano.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਘੂਟੀਐ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧੂ ਉਲਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Listening to Naarad's teachings, the child Dhroo was absorbed in deep meditation.||1||
lines.transliteration: naarad kahat  sunat  Dharoo-a baarik bh ajan maahi laptaano. ||1||

lines.english: He obtained the immovable, eternal state of fearlessness, and all the world wasamazed.
lines.transliteration: achal amar nirbhai pad  paa-i-o jagat  jaahi hairaano.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His devotees; believe it- He is close to you. ||2||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 9 ] (830-18) bilaaval mehlaa 9. Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat bh agat rachh ak har nikat t aahi t um maano. ||2||1||

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, you shall only find pain.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam binaa dukh  paavai.

lines.english: Without devotional worship, doubt is not dispelled; the Guru has revealed this secret.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  binaa sahsaa nah chookai gur ih bh ayd bataavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ  ਗਿਨਕਾ  ਿਜਹ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਮੁਕਤ  ਭਏ ਜੀਅ  ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Of what use are sacred shrines of pilgrimage, if one does not enter the Sanctuary of the Lord? pMnw 831
lines.transliteration: kahaa bha-i-o t irath barat  kee-ay raam saran nahee aavai.

lines.english: Know that Yoga and sacrificial feasts are fruitless, if one forgets the Praises of God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jog jag nihfal tih maan-o jo parabh  jas bisraavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਿਤਹ ਮਾਨਉ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਸੁ ਿਬਸਰਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who lays aside both pride and attachment, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lordof the Universe.
lines.transliteration: maan moh dono ka-o parhar gobind  kay gun gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਉ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the mortal who does this is said to be 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yetalive. ||2||2|| iblwvlu mhlw 9 ] (831-2) bilaaval mehlaa 9. Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih biDh ko paraanee jeevan mukat  kahaavai. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਹਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: There is no meditation on the Lord within him.
lines.transliteration: jaa mai bhajan raam ko naahee.

lines.english: That man wastes his life uselessly - keep this in mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tih nar janam akaarath kh o-i-aa yeh raakh o man maahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਮੈ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: He bathes at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and adheres to fasts, but he has no controlover his mind.
lines.transliteration: tirath karai barat  fun raakh ai nah manoo-aa bas jaa ko.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਹ ਨਰ ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਕਾਰਥੁ  ਖੋਇਆ  ਯਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Know that such religion is useless to him. I speak the Truth for his sake. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nihfal Dharam t aahi t um maanhu saach kahat  mai yaa ka-o. ||1||

lines.english: It's like a stone, kept immersed in water; still, the water does not penetrate it.
lines.transliteration: jaisay paahan jal meh raakhi-o bh aydai naahi t ih paanee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਬਰ੍ਤ ਫੁਿਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਿਸ ਜਾ ਕੋ ॥
lines.english: So, understand it: that mortal being who lacks devotional worship is just like that. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taisay hee t um taahi pachh aanahu bh agat heen jo paraanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਤ  ਮੈ ਯਾ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, liberation comes from the Naam. The Guru has revealedthis secret.
lines.transliteration: kal mai mukat naam t ay paavat  gur yeh bh ayd bataavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਭੇਦੈ ਨਾਿਹ  ਿਤਹ ਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, he alone is a great man, who sings the Praises of God. ||3||3|| iblwvlu AstpdIAw mhlw 1 Gru 10  (831-8) bilaaval asatpadee-aa mehlaa 1 gh ar 10 Bilaaval, Ashtapadees, First Mehl, Tenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (831-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak so-ee nar garoo-aa jo parabh kay gun gaavai. ||3||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਿਹ  ਪਛਾਨਹੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੀਨ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He dwells close at hand, and sees all,
lines.transliteration: nikat vasai daykh ai sabh  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਤ  ਗੁਰੁ ਯਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee. but how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਗਰੂਆ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: vin bh ai pa-i-ai bh agat na ho-ee.

lines.english: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, eternal peace is attained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay sad aa sukh  ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the spiritual wisdom, the treasure of the Naam;
lines.transliteration: aisaa gi-aan padaarath naam.
gurmukh paavas ras ras maan. ||1|| rahaa-o. obtaining it, the Gurmukhs enjoy the subtle essence of this nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Everyone talks about spiritual wisdom and spiritual knowledge.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan gi-aan kathai sabh ko-ee.

lines.english: Talking, talking, they argue, and suffer.
lines.transliteration: kath kath baad karay d ukh ho-ee.

lines.english: No one can stop talking and discussing it.
lines.transliteration: kath kahnai t ay rahai na ko-ee.

lines.english: Without being imbued with the subtle essence, there is no liberation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin ras raatay mukat  na ho-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation all come from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan sabh  gur t ay ho-ee.

lines.english: Through the lifestyle of Truth, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: saachee rahat saachaa man so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਥ ਕਿਥ ਬਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh talks about it, but does not practice it.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kathnee hai par rahat  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਥ ਕਹਣੈ  ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naavhu bhoolay thaa-o na ko-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Maya has caught the mind in the trap of the whirlpool.
lines.transliteration: man maa-i-aa banDhi-o sar jaal.

lines.english: Each and every heart is trapped by this bait of poison and sin.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at bi-aap rahi-o bikh  naal.

lines.english: See that whoever has come, is subject to death.
lines.transliteration: jo aaNjai so deesai kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਥਨੀ  ਹੈ ਪਰੁ ਰਹਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Your affairs shall be adjusted, if you contemplate the Lord in your heart. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaaraj seeDho rid ai samHaal. ||4||

lines.english: He alone is a spiritual teacher, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: so gi-aanee jin sabad liv laa-ee.

lines.english: The self-willed, egotistical manmukh loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ha-umai pat  gavaa-ee.

lines.english: The Creator Lord Himself inspires us to His devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartai bh agat karaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aapay d ay vadi-aa-ee. ||5||

lines.english: The life-night is dark, while the Divine Light is immaculate.
lines.transliteration: rain anDh aaree nirmal jot .

lines.english: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are false, filthy and untouchable.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa jhooth ay kuchal kachh ot.

lines.english: The Vedas preach sermons of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bayd pukaarai bh agat sarot .

lines.english: Listening, hearing and believing, one beholds the Divine Light. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sun sun  maanai vaykh ai jot. ||6||

lines.english: The Shaastras and Simritees implant the Naam within.
lines.transliteration: saastar simrit  naam d arirh-aam.

lines.english: The Gurmukh lives in peace and tranquility, doing deeds of sublime purity.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saaNt ootam karaamaN.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh suffers the pains of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: manmukh jonee d ookh sahaamaN.

lines.english: His bonds are broken, enshrining the Name of the One Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: banDhan t ootay ik naam vasaamaN. ||7||

lines.english: Believing in the Naam, one obtains true honor and adoration.
lines.transliteration: mannay naam sachee pat poojaa.

lines.english: Who should I see? There is none other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kis vaykhaa naahee ko d oojaa.

lines.english: I see, and I say, that He alone is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: daykh  kaha-o bh aavai man so-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||1|| pMnw 832 iblwvlu mhlw 1 ] (832-1) bilaaval mehlaa 1. Bilaaval, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai avar nahee ko-ay. ||8||1||

lines.english: The human acts according to the wishes of the mind.
lines.transliteration: man kaa kahi-aa mansaa karai.

lines.english: This mind feeds on virtue and vice.
lines.transliteration: ih man punn paap uchrai.

lines.english: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, satisfaction never comes.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mad maat ay taripat  na aavai.

lines.english: Satisfaction and liberation come, only to one whose mind is pleasing to the True Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: taripat  mukat  man saachaa bh aavai. ||1||

lines.english: Gazing upon his body, wealth, wife and all his possessions, he is proud.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an kalat  sabh  daykh abhimaanaa.

lines.english: But without the Name of the Lord, nothing shall go along with him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai kichh sang na jaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: He enjoys tastes, pleasures and joys in his mind.
lines.transliteration: keecheh ras bhog kh usee-aa man kayree.

lines.english: Dhan lokaaN tan bh asmai dh ayree. But his wealth will pass on to other people, and his body will be reduced to ashes.
The entire expanse, like dust, shall mix with dust.
lines.transliteration: khaakoo kh aak ralai sabh  fail.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਚਿਹ  ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, his filth is not removed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai nahee ut rai mail. ||2||

lines.english: The various songs, tunes and rhythms are false.
lines.transliteration: geet raag gh an taal se kooray.

lines.english: Trapped by the three qualities, people come and go, far from the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tarihu gun  upjai binsai d ooray.

lines.english: In duality, the pain of their evil-mindedness does not leave them.
lines.transliteration: doojee d urmat  darad na jaa-ay.

lines.english: But the Gurmukh is emancipated by taking the medicine, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhootai gurmukh  daaroo gun  gaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Dhotee oojal t ilak gal maalaa. He may wear a clean loin-cloth, apply the ceremonial mark to his forehead, and wear a mala around his neck;

lines.transliteration: antar kroDh  parheh naat saalaa. but if there is anger within him, he is merely reading his part, like an actor in a play.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he drinks in the wine of Maya.
lines.transliteration: naam visaar maa-i-aa mad pee-aa.

lines.english: Without devotional worship to the Guru, there is no peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhagat  naahee sukh  thee-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The human is a pig, a dog, a donkey, a cat,
lines.transliteration: sookar su-aan garDhabh  manjaaraa.
pasoo malaychh neech chandalaa. a beast, a filthy, lowly wretch, an outcast,
gur tay muhu fayray t inH jon bh avaa-ee-ai. if he turns his face away from the Guru. He shall wander in reincarnation.

lines.english: Bound in bondage, he comes and goes. ||5||
lines.transliteration: banDhan baaDh i-aa aa-ee-ai jaa-ee-ai. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the Guru, the treasure is found.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay lahai pad aarath.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਿਤਨ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: With the Naam in the heart, one always prospers.
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam sad aa kirt aarath.

lines.english: And in the Court of the True Lord, you shall not called to account.
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh poochh  na ho-ay.

lines.english: One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is approved at the Lord's Door. ||6||
lines.transliteration: maanay hukam seejhai d ar so-ay. ||6||

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one knows the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a tis ka-o jaan ai.

lines.english: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, one acts according to His Will.
lines.transliteration: rahai rajaa-ee hukam pachhaan ai.

lines.english: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, he dwells in the Court of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan  sachai d ar vaas.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, death and birth are ended. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal sabad bh a-ay naas. ||7||

lines.english: He remains detached, knowing that everything belongs to God.
lines.transliteration: rahai ateet  jaanai sabh  tis kaa.

lines.english: He dedicates his body and mind unto the One who owns them.
lines.transliteration: tan man arpai hai ih jis kaa.

lines.english: He does not come, and he does not go.
lines.transliteration: naa oh aavai naa oh jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, absorbed in Truth, he merges in the True Lord. ||8||2|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 AstpdI Gru 10  (832-13) bilaaval mehlaa 3 asatpadee gh ar 10 Bilaaval, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees, Tenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (832-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay saach samaa-ay. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ  ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ॥
lines.english: The world is like a crow; with its beak, it croaks spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: jag ka-oo-aa mukh chunch gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But deep within there is greed, falsehood and pride.
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  jhooth abhimaan.

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, your thin outer covering shall wear off, you fool. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai paaj lahag nidaan. ||1||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam shall dwell in your conscious mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv naam vasai man cheet .

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the Name of the Lord comes to mind. Without the Name, other loves are false. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur bhaytay har naam chayt aavai bin naavai hor jh ooth pareet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So do that work, which the Guru tells you to do.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa saa kaar kamaavahu.

lines.english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, you shall come to the home of celestial bliss.
lines.transliteration: sabad cheeneh sahj gh ar aavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਿਵ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Name, you shall obtain glorious greatness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachai naa-ay vadaa-ee paavhu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਵੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who does not understand his own self, but still tries to instruct others,
lines.transliteration: aap na boojhai lok bujh aavai.
man kaa anDhaa anDh  kamaavai. is mentally blind, and acts in blindness.

lines.english: How can he ever find a home and a place of rest, in the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence? ||3||
lines.transliteration: dar gh ar mahal th a-ur kaisay paavai. ||3||

lines.english: Serve the Dear Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sayvee-ai antarjaamee.
ghat gh at ant ar jis kee jot  samaanee. deep within each and every heart, His Light is shining forth.

lines.english: How can anyone hide anything from Him? ||4|| pMnw 833
lines.transliteration: tis naal ki-aa chalai pehnaamee. ||4||

lines.english: The True Name is known through the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saachaa naam saachai sabad jaanai.

lines.english: The Lord Himself meets that one who eradicates egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: aapai aap milai chookai abhimaanai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh chants the Naam, forever and ever. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam sad aa sad aa vakh aanai. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, duality and evil-mindedness are taken away.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai d oojee d urmat  jaa-ee.

lines.english: Guilty mistakes are erased, and the sinful intellect is cleansed.
lines.transliteration: a-ugan kaat paapaa mat  khaa-ee.

lines.english: One's body sparkles like gold, and one's light merges into the Light. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa jotee jot  samaa-ee. ||6||

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Pain is taken away, and the Naam comes to dwell within the heart.
lines.transliteration: dukh kaatai hird ai naam vasaa-ee.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, one finds eternal peace. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sad aa sukh  paa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: Obeying the Gur's instructions, one's actions are purified.
lines.transliteration: gurmat maani-aa karn ee saar.

lines.english: Obeying the Guru's Instructions, one finds the state of salvation.
lines.transliteration: gurmat maani-aa mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who follow the Guru's Teachings are saved, along with their families. ||8||1||3|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 AstpdIAw Gru 11  (833-6) bilaaval mehlaa 4 asatpadee-aa gh ar 11 Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Ashtapadees, Eleventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (833-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat maani-aa parvaarai saaDh aar. ||8||1||3||

lines.english: One who eliminates his self-centeredness, and eradicates his ego, night and day singsthe songs of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: aapai aap khaa-ay ha-o maytai an-d in har ras geet  gava-ee-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is inspired, his body is golden, and his light merges into the Light of theFearless Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parchai kanchan kaa-i-aa nirbh a-o jot ee jot  mila-ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਖਾਇ  ਹਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਗੀਤ  ਗਵਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I take the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mai har har naam aDhaar rama-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਚੈ  ਕੰਚਨ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਿਨਰਭਉ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cannot live, for a moment, even for an instant, without the Name of the Lord; theGurmukh reads the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khin pal reh na saka-o bin naavai gurmukh  har har paath  parha-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਮਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the one house of the body, there are ten gates; night and day, the five thieves break in.
lines.transliteration: ayk girahu das d u-aar hai jaa kay ahinis t askar panch chor laga-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharam arath sabh  hir lay jaaveh manmukh  anDh ulay kh abar na pa-ee-aa. ||2|| They steal the entire wealth of one's Dharmic faith, but the blind, self-willed manmukhdoes not know it. ||2||
The fortress of the body is overflowing with gold and jewels; when it is awakened byspiritual wisdom, one enshrines love for the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: kanchan kot baho maanak bh ari-aa jaagay gi-aan t at liv la-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਿਗਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ  ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਲਗਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The thieves and robbers hide out in the body; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, they are arrested and locked up. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taskar hayroo aa-ay lukaanay gur kai sabad  pakarh  banDh  pa-ee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮੁ  ਅਰਥੁ  ਸਭੁ ਿਹਿਰ  ਲੇ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਪਈਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad is theboatman, to carry us across.
lines.transliteration: har har naam pot bohithaa kh ayvat sabad  gur paar langh -ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਿਕ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਜਾਗੇ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਤਿਤ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even come close, and no thievesor robbers can plunder you. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jam jaagaatee nayrh  na aavai naa ko t askar chor laga-ee-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤਸਕਰ  ਹੇਰੂ ਆਇ  ਲੁਕਾਨੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਪਕਿੜ  ਬੰਿਧ ਪਈਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night; singing the Lord'sPraises, I cannot find His limits.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai sad aa din raat ee mai har jas kaht ay ant  na lahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh returns to its own home; it meets the Lord of the Universe,to the beat of the celestial drum. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh manoo-aa ikat  ghar aavai mila-o gopaal neesaan baja-ee-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਲਗਈਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with my eyes, my mind is satisfied; with my ears, I listen to the Guru's Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: nainee daykh  daras man t ariptai sarvan ban ee gur sabad  suna-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਦਾ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Listening, listening, my soul is softened, delighted by His subtle essence, chanting theName of the Lord of the Universe. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sun sun aatam d ayv hai bh eenay ras ras raam gopaal rava-ee-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਨੂਆ ਇਕਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਿਮਲਉ  ਗਪਾਲ  ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਈਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: In the grip of the three qualities, they are engrossed in love and attachment to Maya;only as Gurmukh do they find the absolute quality, absorption in bliss.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa mohi vi-aapay t uree-aa gun  hai gurmukh  lahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸੁ  ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: With a single, impartial eye, look upon all alike, and see God pervading all. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ayk darisat sabh  sam kar jaan ai nad ree aavai sabh  barahm pasra-ee-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਸੁਿਨ ਆਤਮ  ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਰਵਈਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Light of the Lord's Name permeates all; the Gurmukh knows the unknowable.
lines.transliteration: raam naam hai jot sabaa-ee gurmukh  aapay alakh  lakha-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਤੁਰੀਆ  ਗੁਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਹੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord has become merciful to the meek; through loving adoration, hemerges in the Lord's Name. ||8||1||4|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (833-19) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak deen d a-i-aal bh a-ay hai bh agat bhaa-ay har naam sama-ee-aa. ||8||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਸਭੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਸਰਈਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Meditate on the cool water of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Perfume yourself withthe fragrant scent of the Lord, the sandalwood tree. pMnw 834
lines.transliteration: har har naam seetal jal Dh i-aavahu har chand an vaas suganDh  ganDh -ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੈ ਿਹਰਡ  ਪਲਾਸ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਬੁਹੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. I am just a castor-oil tree, made fragrant by their association. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  param pad  paa-i-aa mai hirad palaas sang har buhee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the world, the Lord of creation.
lines.transliteration: jap jagannaath jagdees gus-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ  ਿਜਉ  ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦ  ਉਧਾਿਰ  ਸਮਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who seek the Lord's Sanctuary are saved, like Prahlaad; theyare emancipated and merge with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saran paray say-ee jan ubray ji-o par-hilaad  uDhaar sama-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Of all plants, the sandalwood tree is the most sublime. Everything near the sandalwood tree becomes fragrant like sandalwood.
lines.transliteration: bhaar ath aarah meh chand an oot am chand an nikat sabh  chand an hu-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਿਹ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਊਤਮ  ਚੰਦਨ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੁਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The stubborn, false faithless cynics are dried up; their egotistical pride separates themfar from the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saakat koorh ay oobh  suk hoo-ay man abh imaan vichh urh door ga-ee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਕੂੜੇ ਊਭ ਸੁਕ ਹੂਏ ਮਿਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਿਵਛੁਿੜ ਦੂਿਰ ਗਈਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Only the Creator Lord Himself knows the state and condition of everyone; the LordHimself makes all the arrangements.
lines.transliteration: har gat mit  kartaa aapay jaan ai sabh  biDh har har aap bana-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਬਨਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who meets the True Guru is transformed into gold. Whatever is pre-ordained, isnot erased by erasing. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis satgur bh aytay so kanchan hovai jo Dh ur likh i-aa so mitai na mita-ee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੁ ਿਮਟੈ ਨ ਿਮਟਈਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The treasure of jewels is found in the ocean of the Guru's Teachings. The treasure ofdevotional worship is opened to me.
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath gurmat  paavai saagar bh agat bhandaar kh ulH-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਗਰ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਖੁਲਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Focused on the Guru's Feet, faith wells up within me; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I hunger for more. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur charnee ik sarDh aa upjee mai har gun  kahtay taripat  na bh a-ee-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਇਕ ਸਰਧਾ  ਉਪਜੀ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਨ ਭਈਆ ॥੪॥
lines.english: I am totally detached, continually, continuously meditating on the Lord; chanting theGlorious Praises of the Lord, I express my love for Him.
lines.transliteration: param bairaag nit nit  har Dh i-aa-ay mai har gun  kahtay bh aavnee kahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਿਨਤ ਿਨਤ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਏ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਕਹਤੇ  ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਕਹੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Time and time again, each and every moment and instant, I express it. I cannot findthe Lord's limits; He is the farthest of the far. ||5||
