lines.transliteration: baar baar khin kh in pal kahee-ai har paar na paavai parai para-ee-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਈਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas advise righteous actions, and theperformance of the six religious rituals.
lines.transliteration: saasat bayd  puraan  pukaareh Dh aram karahu kh at karam d arirha-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤ  ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਪੁਕਾਰਿਹ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਰਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are ruined by doubt; in the waves of greed,their boat is heavily loaded, and it sinks. ||6||
lines.transliteration: manmukh pakh and bh aram vigoot ay lobh  lahar naav bh aar buda-ee-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਿਵਗੂਤੇ  ਲੋਭ ਲਹਿਰ  ਨਾਵ ਭਾਿਰ  ਬੁਡਈਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and through the Naam, find emancipation.The Simritees and Shaastras recommend the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam japahu naamay gat paavhu simrit  saast ar naam d arirh-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Eradicating egotism, one becomes pure. The Gurmukh is inspired, and obtains thesupreme status. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jaa-ay ta nirmal hovai gurmukh  parchai param pad  pa-ee-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਤ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਚੈ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਈਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: This world, with its colors and forms, is all Yours, O Lord; as You attach us, so do wedo our deeds.
lines.transliteration: ih jag varan roop sabh t ayraa jit  laaveh say karam kama-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਜਤੁ ਲਾਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, we are the instruments upon which He plays; as He wills, so is the path we take. ||8||2||5|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (834-12) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jant vajaa-ay vaajeh jit  bhaavai t it raahi chala-ee-aa. ||8||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੰਤ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਾਜਿਹ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਰਾਿਹ  ਚਲਈਆ  ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord. I am a sacrifice, asacrifice to the True Guru, the True Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh agam agochar Dh i-aa-i-aa ha-o bal bal sat gur sat  purkh a-ee-aa.

lines.english: He has brought the Lord's Name to dwell upon my breath of life; meeting with theTrue Guru, I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam mayrai paraan vasaa-ay sat gur paras har naam sama-ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the only Support of His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: jan kee tayk har naam tika-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਿਣ  ਵਸਾਏ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I shall live under the protection of the True Guru. By Guru's Grace, I shall attain theCourt of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur kee Dh ar laagaa jaavaa gur kirpaa t ay har d ar lahee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This body is the field of karma; the Gurmukhs plow and work it, and harvest theessence.
lines.transliteration: ih sareer karam kee Dhart ee gurmukh  math math t at kadh a-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਧਰ ਲਾਗਾ  ਜਾਵਾ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The priceless jewel of the Naam becomes manifest, and it pours into their vessels oflove. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laal javayhar naam pargaasi-aa bhaaNdai bh aa-o pavai t it a-ee-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Become the slave of the slave of the slave, of that humble being who has become the devotee of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aas d aas ho-ay rahee-ai jo jan raam bh agat nij bh a-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕੀ ਧਰਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਿਥ ਮਿਥ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind and intellect, and place them in offering before my Guru; by Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man buDh arap Dh ara-o gur aagai gur parsaadee mai akath katha-ee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੁ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸਆ  ਭਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਅਈਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in attachment to Maya; their minds arethirsty, burning with desire.
lines.transliteration: manmukh maa-i-aa mohi vi-aapay ih man t arisnaa jalat  tikha-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ  ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ  ਿਨਜ ਭਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, and the fire has been put out. The Word of the Guru's Shabad has put it out. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam amrit  jal paa-i-aa agan bujh ee gur sabad  bujha-ee-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਬੁਿਧ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਈਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: This mind dances before the True Guru. The unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds, vibrating the celestial melody. pMnw 835
lines.transliteration: ih man naachai satgur aagai anhad  sabad  Dhun toor vaja-ee-aa.

lines.english: I praise the Lord, day and night, moving my feet to the beat of the drum. ||5||
lines.transliteration: har har ustat  karai d in raat ee rakh  rakh charan  har t aal poora-ee-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਰਿਖ ਰਿਖ ਚਰਣ  ਹਿਰ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.
lines.transliteration: har kai rang rataa man gaavai ras rasaal ras sabad  rava-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰਿਸ ਰਸਾਲ  ਰਿਸ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਵਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar Dh aar chu-ai at  nirmal jin pee-aa t in hee sukh  lahee-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੀਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The stubborn-minded, egotistical, proud-minded person performs rituals, but theseare like sand castles built by children.
lines.transliteration: manhath karam karai abh imaanee ji-o baalak baaloo gh ar usra-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੈ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ਿਜਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੂ  ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the waves of the ocean come in, they crumble and dissolve in an instant. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aavai lahar samund saagar kee kh in meh bh inn bh inn dh eh pa-ee-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੈ  ਲਹਿਰ  ਸਮੁੰਦ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਕੀ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਭੰਨ ਿਭੰਨ ਢਿਹ ਪਈਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord is the pool, and the Lord Himself is the ocean; this world is all a play whichHe has staged.
lines.transliteration: har sar saagar har hai aapay ih jag hai sabh kh ayl kh ayla-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: As the waves of water merge into the water again, O Nanak, so does He merge intoHimself. ||8||3||6|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (835-6) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal tarang jal jaleh samaaveh naanak aapay aap rama-ee-aa. ||8||3||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ  ਜਲੁ ਜਲਿਹ  ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਰਮਈਆ  ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
lines.english: My mind wears the ear-rings of the True Guru's acquaintance; I apply the ashes of theWord of the Guru's Shabad to my body.
lines.transliteration: satgur parchai man mund raa paa-ee gur kaa sabad  tan bh asam d arirh-ee-aa.

lines.english: By body has become immortal, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Bothbirth and death have come to an end for me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amar pind bha-ay saaDh oo sang janam maran  do-oo mit ga-ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ  ਮਿਨ ਮੁੰਦਰ੍ਾ ਪਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਿਨ ਭਸਮ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, remain united with the Saadh Sangat.
lines.transliteration: mayray man saaDhsangat  mil rahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰ  ਿਪੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੋਊ ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Be merciful to me, O Lord; each and every instant, let me wash the Feet of the Holy.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahu maDhsood an maaDh a-o mai kh in khin saaDh oo charan  pakh a-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Forsaking family life, he wanders in the forest, but his mind does not remain at rest,even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: tajai girsat  bha-i-aa ban vaasee ik kh in manoo-aa tikai na tika-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ  ਮਾਧਉ  ਮੈ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ  ਪਖਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  Dhaa-ay t aday gh ar aavai har har saaDh oo saran  pava-ee-aa. ||2|| The wandering mind returns home, only when it seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord'sHoly people. ||2||
Dhee-aa poot  chhod sani-aasee aasaa aas man bahut  kara-ee-aa. The Sannyaasi renounces his daughters and sons, but his mind still conjures up allsorts of hopes and desires.

lines.punjabi: ਤਜੈ ਿਗਰਸਤੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀ  ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਿਟਕੈ ਨ ਿਟਕਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: With these hopes and desires, he still does not understand, that only through theWord of the Guru's Shabad does one become free of desires, and find peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aasaa aas karai nahee boojhai gur kai sabad  niraas sukh  lahee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਧਾਇ  ਤਦੇ ਘਿਰ ਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਵਈਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When detachment from the world wells up within, he become a naked hermit, butstill, his mind roams, wanders and rambles in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: upjee tarak d igambar ho-aa man d ah dis chal chal gavan kara-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੀਆ  ਪੂਤ ਛੋਿਡ ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਆਸਾ  ਆਸ  ਮਿਨ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||
lines.transliteration: parbhavan karai boojh ai nahee t arisnaa mil sang saaDh  da-i-aa gh ar lahee-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਆਸ  ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਨਰਾਸ  ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.
lines.transliteration: aasan siDh  sikheh bahut ayray man maageh riDh  siDh chaytak chaytka-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਜੀ  ਤਰਕ  ਿਦਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ  ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਚਿਲ  ਚਿਲ  ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: 4) taripat  santokh man saaNt na aavai mil saaDh oo taripat  har naam siDh  pa-ee-aa. ||5|| Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfectionis attained. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ  ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; Godcreated the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.
lines.transliteration: andaj jayraj saytaj ut -bhuj sabh  varan roop jee-a jant  upa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਣ  ਿਸਧ ਿਸਖਿਹ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਚੇਟਕ  ਚੇਟਕਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||6|| One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is saved, whether he is a Kh'shaatriya, aBrahmin, a Soodra, a Vaishya or the most untouchable of the untouchables. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo saran  parai so ubrai kh atree baraahman  sood  vais chandaal chand-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਪਈਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the low-caste leather-worker,
lines.transliteration: naamaa jaiday-o kambeer t arilochan a-ujaat  ravid aas chami-aar chama-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਡਜ  ਜੇਰਜ  ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ  ਸਿਭ ਵਰਨ  ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo milai saaDhoo jan sangat  Dhan Dh annaa jat sain  mili-aa har d a-ee-aa. ||7|| blessed Dhanna and Sain; all those who joined the humble Saadh Sangat, met theMerciful Lord. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ  ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ  ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Lord protects the honor of His humble servants; He is the Lover of His devotees -He makes them His own.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee har paij rakh aa-ee bh agat vachh al angeekaar kara-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਾ  ਜੈਦੇਉ  ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨੁ ਅਉਜਾਿਤ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸੁ  ਚਿਮਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Life of the world, who has showered His Mercy upon him, and saved him. ||8||||4||7|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (835-19) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran paray jagjeevan har har kirpaa Dh aar rakh a-ee-aa. ||8||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਸੈਣੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਦਈਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The thirst for God has welled up deep within me; hearing the Word of the Guru's Teachings, my mind is pierced by His arrow. pMnw 836
lines.transliteration: antar pi-aas uth ee parabh  kayree sun  gur bachan man t eer laga-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਮਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The pain of my mind is known only to my own mind; who can know the pain of another? ||1||
lines.transliteration: man kee birthaa man hee jaanai avar ke jaan ai ko peer para-ee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਿਰ ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਲਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Guru, the Enticer, has enticed my mind.
lines.transliteration: raam gur mohan mohi man la-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਆਕਲ  ਿਬਕਲ  ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੋਇ ਪਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am stunned and amazed, gazing upon my Guru; I have entered the realm of wonderand bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o aakal bikal bha-ee gur d aykhay ha-o lot pot ho-ay pa-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I wander around, exploring all lands and foreign countries; within my mind, I havesuch a great longing to see my God.
lines.transliteration: ha-o nirkhat  fira-o sabh  days disant ar mai parabh  daykhan ko bahut  man cha-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਨਰਖਤ ਿਫਰਉ  ਸਿਭ ਦੇਸ ਿਦਸੰਤਰ  ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੇਖਨ  ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਨ ਚਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I sacrifice my mind and body to the Guru, who has shown me the Way, the Path to my Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man tan kaat d ay-o gur aagai jin har parabh  maarag panth d ikha-ee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਿਟ  ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਿਜਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਿਦਖਈਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If only someone would bring me news of God; He seems so sweet to my heart, mind and body.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aan sad aysaa d ay-ay parabh  kayraa rid  antar man t an meeth  laga-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਸਦੇਸਾ  ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰਾ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਮੀਠ ਲਗਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meetand unite with my Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mastak kaat d ay-o charn aa tal jo har parabh  maylay mayl mila-ee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਤਕੁ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ  ਤਿਲ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਈਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let usobtain our Lord God.
lines.transliteration: chal chal sakhee ham parabh  parboDh eh gun  kaaman  kar har parabh  lahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ  ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||4|| He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seekGod's Sanctuary. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al u-aa ko naam kahee-at  hai saran  parabh oo tis paachh ai pa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਉਆ  ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਰਿਣ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, andher mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.
lines.transliteration: khimaa seegaar karay parabh  khusee-aa man d eepak gur gi-aan bala-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਮਾ  ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਮਿਨ ਦੀਪਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: With happiness and ecstasy, my God enjoys her; I offer each and every bit of my soulto Him. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ras ras bhog karay parabh  mayraa ham t is aagai jee-o kat kat pa-ee-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਕਿਟ ਕਿਟ ਪਈਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged withdevotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.
lines.transliteration: har har haar kanth hai bani-aa man mot eechoor vad gahan gehna-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਿਠ ਹੈ ਬਿਨਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀਚੂਰੁ ਵਡ ਗਹਨ  ਗਹਨਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - mymind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har har sarDhaa sayj vichh aa-ee parabh  chhod na sakai bahut  man bh a-ee-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਧਾ  ਸੇਜ ਿਵਛਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਈਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: If God says one thing, and the soul-bride does something else, then all her decorations are useless and false.
lines.transliteration: kahai parabh avar avar kichh  keejai sabh  baad  seegaar fokat fokta-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਜੈ  ਸਭੁ ਬਾਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਫੋਕਟ  ਫੋਕਟਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kee-o seegaar milan kai t aa-ee parabh  lee-o suhaagan thook mukh  pa-ee-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਓ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਿਮਲਣ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲੀਓ  ਸੁਹਾਗਿਨ  ਥੂਕ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਈਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do bymyself? I am under Your power.
lines.transliteration: ham chayree too agam gusaa-ee ki-aa ham karah t ayrai vas pa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਗਮ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਿਕਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ  ਤੇਰੈ ਵਿਸ ਪਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Be merciful, Lord, to the meek, and save them; Nanak has entered the Sanctuary ofthe Lord, and the Guru. ||8||5||8|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 ] (836-13) bilaaval mehlaa 4. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa d een karahu rakh  layvhu naanak har gur saran  sama-ee-aa. ||8||5||8||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਦੀਨ  ਕਰਹੁ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੮॥
lines.english: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each andevery instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan paraym agam th aakur kaa kh in khin sarDh aa man bahut  utha-ee-aa.

lines.english: ||1|| Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries andcries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur daykh ay sarDh aa man pooree ji-o chaat rik pari-o pari-o boond  mukh  pa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਅਗਮ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਾ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਸਰਧਾ  ਮਿਨ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Join with me, join with me, O my companions, and teach me the Sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil mil sakhee har kathaa suna-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ  ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਿਜਉ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਈਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: 4) satgur d a-i-aa karay parabh  maylay mai t is aagai sir kat kat pa-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. The True Guru has mercifully united me with God. Cutting off my head, and chopping it into pieces, I offer it to Him. ||1||Pause||
Each and every hair on my head, and my mind and body, suffer the pains ofseparation; without seeing my God, I cannot sleep.

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.
lines.transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujh aa-ay.

lines.english: One who overcomes the three qualities, dwells in the fourth state.
lines.transliteration: teen samaavai cha-uthai vaasaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am his slave. ||5||
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak ham t aa kay d aasaa. ||5||

lines.english: The Fifth Day: The five elements are demons.
lines.transliteration: panchmee panch bhoot  baytaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is unfathomable and detached.
lines.transliteration: aap agochar purakh niraalaa.

lines.english: Some are gripped by doubt, hunger, emotional attachment and desire.
lines.transliteration: ik bharam bh ookhay moh pi-aasay.

lines.english: Some taste the sublime essence of the Shabad, and are satisfied.
lines.transliteration: ik ras chaakh sabad  tariptaasay.

lines.english: Some are imbued with the Lord's Love, while some die, and are reduced to dust.
lines.transliteration: ik rang raatay ik mar Dh oor.

lines.english: Some attain the Court and the Mansion of the True Lord, and behold Him, ever- present. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ik dar gh ar saachai d aykh hadoor. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਿਕ  ਮਿਰ ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The false one has no honor or fame;
lines.transliteration: jhooth ay ka-o naahee pat  naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਦਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਸਾਚੈ ਦੇਿਖ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kabahu na soochaa kaalaa kaa-o. like the black crow, he never becomes pure.

lines.english: He is like the bird, imprisoned in a cage;
lines.transliteration: pinjar pankhee banDh i-aa ko-ay.
chhayreeN bharmai mukat  na ho-ay. he paces back and forth behind the bars, but he is not released.

lines.english: He alone is emancipated, whom the Lord and Master emancipates.
lines.transliteration: ta-o chh ootai jaa kh asam chh adaa-ay.

lines.english: He follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines devotional worship. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmat maylay bh agat drirh -aa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: The Sixth Day: God organized the six systems of Yoga.
lines.transliteration: khastee kh at darsan parabh  saajay.

lines.english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates of itself.
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  niraalaa vaajay.

lines.english: If God wills it so, then one is summoned to the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: jay parabh bh aavai t aa mahal bulaavai.

lines.english: One who is pierced through by the Shabad, obtains honor.
lines.transliteration: sabday bh ayday ta-o pat  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who wear religious robes burn, and are ruined.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vays khapeh jal jaaveh.

lines.english: Through Truth, the truthful ones merge into the True Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: saachai saachay saach samaaveh. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਸ ਖਪਿਹ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Seventh Day: When the body is imbued with Truth and contentment,
lines.transliteration: saptamee sat  santokh sareer.
saat samund  bharay nirmal neer. the seven seas within are filled with the Immaculate Water.

lines.english: Bathing in good conduct, and contemplating the True Lord within the heart,
lines.transliteration: majan seel sach ridai veechaar.
gur kai sabad paavai sabh  paar. one obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and carries everyone across.

lines.english: With the True Lord in the mind, and the True Lord lovingly on one's lips,
lines.transliteration: man saachaa mukh saacha-o bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਾਵੈ ਸਿਭ ਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sach neesaanai th aak na paa-ay. ||9|| one is blessed with the banner of Truth, and meets with no obstructions. ||9||

lines.english: The Eighth Day: The eight miraculous powers come when one subdues his own mind,
lines.transliteration: astamee asat siDh buDh  saaDh ai.
sach nihkayval karam araaDhai. and contemplates the True Lord through pure actions.

lines.english: Forget the three qualities of wind, water and fire,
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee agnee bisraa-o.
tahee niranjan saacho naa-o. and concentrate on the pure True Name.

lines.english: That human who remains lovingly focused on the Lord,
lines.transliteration: tis meh manoo-aa rahi-aa liv laa-ay.
paranvat  naanak kaal na kh aa-ay. ||10|| prays Nanak, shall not be consumed by death. ||10||

lines.english: The Ninth Day: The Name is the supreme almighty Master of the nine masters of Yoga, the nine realms of the earth, and each and every heart. pMnw 840
lines.transliteration: naa-o na-umee navay naath nav khanda. gh at ghat naath mahaa balvandaa.

lines.english: This whole world is the child of Maya.
lines.transliteration: aa-ee pootaa ih jag saaraa.

lines.english: I bow in submission to God, my Protector from the very beginning of time.
lines.transliteration: parabh aad ays aad  rakhvaaraa.

lines.english: He was in the beginning, He has been throughout the ages, He is now, and He shall always be.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee hai bh ee hog.

lines.english: He is unlimited, and capable of doing everything. ||11||
lines.transliteration: oh aprampar karnai jog. ||11||

lines.english: The Tenth Day: Meditate on the Naam, give to charity, and purify yourself.
lines.transliteration: dasmee naam d aan isnaan.

lines.english: Night and day, bathe in spiritual wisdom and the Glorious Virtues of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din majan sachaa gun  gi-aan.

lines.english: Truth cannot be polluted; doubt and fear run away from it.
lines.transliteration: sach mail na laagai bharam bh a-o bh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: The flimsy thread breaks in an instant.
lines.transliteration: bilam na tootas kaachai t aagai.

lines.english: Know that the world is just like this thread.
lines.transliteration: ji-o taagaa jag ayvai jaan hu.

lines.english: Your consciousness shall become steady and stable, enjoying the Love of the True Lord. ||12||
lines.transliteration: asthir cheet saach rang maan hu. ||12||

lines.english: The Eleventh Day: Enshrine the One Lord within your heart.
lines.transliteration: aykaadasee ik rid ai vasaavai.

lines.english: Eradicate cruelty, egotism and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: hinsaa mamtaa moh chukh aavai.

lines.english: Earn the fruitful rewards, by observing the fast of knowing your own self.
lines.transliteration: fal paavai barat aat am cheenai.

lines.english: One who is engrossed in hypocrisy, does not see the true essence.
lines.transliteration: pakhand raach t at nahee beenai.

lines.english: The Lord is immaculate, self-sustaining and unattached.
lines.transliteration: nirmal niraahaar nihkayval.

lines.english: The Pure, True Lord cannot be polluted. ||13||
lines.transliteration: soochai saachay naa laagai mal. ||13||

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord there.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah ayko aykaa.

lines.english: He created the other beings, of many and various kinds.
lines.transliteration: hor jee-a upaa-ay vayko vaykaa.

lines.english: Eating only fruits, one loses the fruits of life.
lines.transliteration: falohaar kee-ay fal jaa-ay.

lines.english: Eating only delicacies of various sorts, one loses the true taste.
lines.transliteration: ras kas khaa-ay saad  gavaa-ay.

lines.english: In fraud and greed, people are engrossed and entangled.
lines.transliteration: koorhai laalach laptai laptaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is emancipated, practicing Truth. ||14||
lines.transliteration: chhootai gurmukh  saach kamaa-ay. ||14||

lines.english: The Twelfth Day: One whose mind is not attached to the twelve signs,
lines.transliteration: du-aad as mud raa man a-uDh ootaa.
ahinis jaageh kabeh na sootaa. remains awake day and night, and never sleeps.

lines.english: He remains awake and aware, lovingly centered on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaagat jaag rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: With faith in the Guru, he is not consumed by death.
lines.transliteration: gur parchai tis kaal na kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Those who become detached, and conquer the five enemies
lines.transliteration: ateet bha-ay maaray bairaa-ee.
paranvat  naanak t ah liv laa-ee. ||15|| - prays Nanak, they are lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||15||

lines.english: The Twelfth Day: Know, and practice, compassion and charity.
lines.transliteration: du-aad asee d a-i-aa d aan kar jaan ai.

lines.english: Bring your out-going mind back home.
lines.transliteration: baahar jaato bh eetar aan ai.

lines.english: Observe the fast of remaining free of desire.
lines.transliteration: bartee barat  rahai nihkaam.

lines.english: Chant the unchanted Chant of the Naam with your mouth.
lines.transliteration: ajpaa jaap japai mukh naam.

lines.english: Know that the One Lord is contained in the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan meh ayko jaan ai.

lines.english: Purity and self-discipline are all contained in knowing the Truth. ||16||
lines.transliteration: sabh such sanjam saach pachh aanai. ||16||

lines.english: The Thirteenth Day: He is like a tree on the sea-shore.
lines.transliteration: tayras t arvar samud  kanaarai.

lines.english: But his roots can become immortal, if his mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: amrit mool sikh ar liv t aarai.

lines.english: Then, he will not die of fear or anxiety, and he will never drown.
lines.transliteration: dar dar marai na boodai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਡਰ ਡਿਰ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬੂਡੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Fear of God, he drowns and dies, and loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: nidar bood marai pat kh o-ay.

lines.english: With the Fear of God in his heart, and his heart in the Fear of God, he knows God.
lines.transliteration: dar meh ghar gh ar meh dar jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਡਰ ਮਿਹ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: He sits on the throne, and becomes pleasing to the Mind of the True Lord. ||17||
lines.transliteration: takhat nivaas sach man bh aanai. ||17||

lines.english: The Fourteenth Day: One who enters into the fourth state,
lines.transliteration: cha-udas cha-uthay thaaveh leh paavai.
raajas taamas sat  kaal samaavai. overcomes time, and the three qualities of raajas, taamas and satva.

lines.english: Then the sun enters into the house of the moon,
lines.transliteration: sasee-ar kai ghar soor samaavai.
jog jugat kee keemat  paavai. and one knows the value of the technology of Yoga.

lines.english: He remains lovingly focused on God, who is permeating the fourteen worlds, the nether regions of the underworld, the galaxies and solar systems. ||18||
lines.transliteration: cha-udas bh avan paat aal samaa-ay. kh and barahmand rahi-aa liv laa-ay. ||18||

lines.english: Amaavas - The Night of the New Moon: The moon is hidden in the sky.
lines.transliteration: amaavasi-aa chand gupat  gainaar.

lines.english: O wise one, understand and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: boojhhu gi-aanee sabad  beechaar.

lines.english: The moon in the sky illuminates the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: sasee-ar gagan jot t ihu lo-ee.

lines.english: Creating the creation, the Creator beholds it.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai kart aa so-ee.

lines.english: One who sees, through the Guru, merges into Him.
lines.transliteration: gur tay d eesai so t is hee maahi.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, coming and going in reincarnation. ||19||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay aavahi jaahi. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One who establishes his home within his own heart, obtains the most beautiful, permanent place.
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar thaap thir thaan suhaavai.

lines.english: One comes to understand his own self, when he finds the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai jaa sat gur paavai.

lines.english: Wherever there is hope, there is destruction and desolation.
lines.transliteration: jah aasaa tah binas binaasaa.

lines.english: The bowl of duality and selfishness breaks.
lines.transliteration: footai khapar d ubiDh aa mansaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of that one, who remains detached amidst the traps of attachment. ||20||1|| pMnw 841 iblwvlu mhlw 3 vwr sq Gru 10  (841-1) bilaaval mehlaa 3 vaar sat gh ar 10 Bilaaval, Third Mehl, The Seven Days, Tenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (841-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mamtaa jaal t ay rahai ud aasaa. paran vat naanak ham t aa kay d aasaa. ||20||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਵਾਰ ਸਤ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Sunday: He, the Lord, is the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: aadit vaar aad  purakh  hai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦਤ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Pervading Lord; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: aapay vartai avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: Through and through, He is woven into the fabric of the world.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  jag rahi-aa paro-ee.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator Himself does, that alone happens.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karai so ho-ee.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is forever in peace.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sad aa sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: But how rare is the one, who, as Gurmukh, understands this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Within my heart, I chant the Chant of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: hirdai japnee japa-o gunt aasaa.

lines.english: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is inaccessible, unfathomable and unlimited. Graspingthe feet of the Lord's humble servants, I meditate on Him, and become the slave ofHis slaves. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: iblwvlu, mÚ 3) har agam agochar aprampar su-aamee jan pag lag Dhi-aava-o ho-ay d aasan d aasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਨ ਪਿਗ  ਲਿਗ  ਿਧਆਵਉ  ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Monday: The True Lord is permeating and pervading.
lines.transliteration: somvaar sach rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: His value cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: tis kee keemat  kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Talking and speaking about Him, all keep themselves lovingly focused on Him.
lines.transliteration: aakh aakh  rahay sabh  liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Devotion falls into the laps of those whom He so blesses.
lines.transliteration: jis dayvai t is palai paa-ay.

lines.english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar lakhi-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen to be permeating andpervading everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Tuesday: The Lord created love and attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: mangal maa-i-aa moh upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself has enjoined each and every being to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: aapay sir sir DhanDh ai laa-i-aa.

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.
lines.transliteration: aap bujhaa-ay so-ee boojh ai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one understands his heart and home.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad d ar ghar soojh ai.

lines.english: He worships the Lord in loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  karay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: His egotism and self-conceit are burnt away by the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa sabad  jalaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Wednesday: He Himself bestows sublime understanding.
lines.transliteration: buDhvaar aapay buDh  saar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh does good deeds, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karn ee sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind become pure and immaculate.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay man nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: He sings the Glorious Glorious Praises of the Lord, and washes off the filth of egotism.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai ha-umai mal kh o-ay.

lines.english: In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains lasting glory.
lines.transliteration: dar sachai sad  sobh aa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay gur sabad  suhaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The profit of the Naam is obtained through the Door of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam paa-ay gur du-aar.

lines.english: The Great Giver Himself gives it.
lines.transliteration: aapay dayvai d ayvan haar.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the One who gives it.
lines.transliteration: jo dayvai t is ka-o bal jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aap gavaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rakhahu ur Dh aar.

lines.english: I celebrate the victory of the Lord, the Great Giver. ||5||
lines.transliteration: dayvan haaray ka-o jaikaar. ||5||

lines.english: Thursday: The fifty-two warriors were deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: veervaar veer bharam bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: All the goblins and demons are attached to duality.
lines.transliteration: parayt bh oot sabh  doojai laa-ay.

lines.english: God Himself created them, and sees each one distinct.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay kar vaykhai vaykaa.

lines.english: O Creator Lord, You are the Support of all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kart ay tayree taykaa.

lines.english: The beings and creatures are under Your protection.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant t ayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: He alone meets You, whom You Yourself meet. ||6||
lines.transliteration: so milai jis laihi milaa-ee. ||6||

lines.english: Friday: God is permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sukarvaar parabh rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself created all, and appraises the value of all.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay sabh keemat  paa-ee.

lines.english: One who become Gurmukh, contemplates the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so karai beechaar.

lines.english: He practices truth and self-restraint.
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam karnee hai kaar.

lines.english: Without genuine understanding, all fasts, religious rituals and daily worship services lead only to the love of duality. ||7||
lines.transliteration: varat naym nit aaparat  poojaa. bin boojh ay sabh  bhaa-o hai d oojaa. ||7||

lines.english: Saturday: Contemplating good omens and the Shaastras,
lines.transliteration: chhanichh arvaar sa-un  saasat  beechaar.
ha-umai mayraa bharmai sansaar. in egotism and self-conceit, the world wanders in delusion.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukh in engrossed in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: Bound and gagged at death's door, he is beaten and punished.
lines.transliteration: jam dar baaDh aa chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one finds lasting peace.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sadaa sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: He practices Truth, and lovingly focuses on the Truth. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sach karnee saach liv laa-ay. ||8||

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say vadbh aagee.

lines.english: Conquering their ego, they embrace love for the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar sach liv laagee.

lines.english: They are automatically imbued with Your Love, O Lord. pMnw 842
lines.transliteration: tayrai rang raat ay sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: You are the Giver of peace; You merge them into Yourself.
lines.transliteration: too sukh -daata laihi milaa-ay.

lines.english: Everything comes from the One and only Lord; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: aykas tay d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes this, and understands. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai sojh ee ho-ay. ||9||

lines.english: The fifteen lunar days, the seven days of the week,
lines.transliteration: pandreh thit eeN tai sat  vaar.
maahaa rutee aavahi vaar vaar. the months, seasons, days and nights, come over and over again;
dinas rain  tivai sansaar. so the world goes on.

lines.english: Coming and going were created by the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on kee-aa kart aar.

lines.english: The True Lord remains steady and stable, by His almighty power.
lines.transliteration: nihchal saach rahi-aa kal Dhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧੦॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, how rare is that Gurmukh who understands, and contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 3 ] (842-3) bilaaval mehlaa 3. Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh boojh ai ko sabad  veechaar. ||10||1||

lines.english: The Primal Lord Himself formed the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  aapay sarisat saajay.

lines.english: The beings and creatures are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant maa-i-aa mohi paajay.

lines.english: In the love of duality, they are attached to the illusory material world.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay parpanch laagay.

lines.english: The unfortunate ones die, and continue to come and go.
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaaveh mareh abhaagay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ayti-ai sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.english: Then, the illusion of the material world is shattered, and one merges in Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parpanch chookai sach samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead
lines.transliteration: jaa kai mastak likh i-aa laykh .
taa kai man vasi-aa parabh  ayk. ||1|| rahaa-o. - the One God abides within his mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He created the Universe, and He Himself beholds all.
lines.transliteration: sarisat upaa-ay aapay sabh vaykh ai.

lines.english: No one can erase Your record, Lord.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na maytai tayrai laykh ai.

lines.english: If someone calls himself a Siddha or a seeker,
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik jay ko kahai kahaa-ay.
bharmay bh oolaa aavai jaa-ay. he is deluded by doubt, and will continue coming and going.

lines.english: That humble being alone understands, who serves the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvai so jan boojh ai.

lines.english: Conquering his ego, he finds the Lord's Door. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maaray taa d ar soojh ai. ||2||

lines.english: From the One Lord, all others were formed.
lines.transliteration: aykas tay sabh  doojaa hoo-aa.

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayko vartai avar na bee-aa.

lines.english: Renouncing duality, one comes to know the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojay t ay jay ayko jaan ai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one knows the Lord's Door, and His Banner.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har d ar neesaan ai.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay t aa ayko paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Duality is subdued within. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vichahu doojaa th aak rahaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: One who belongs to the All-powerful Lord and Master
lines.transliteration: jis daa saahib daadh aa ho-ay.
tis no maar na saakai ko-ay. - no one can destroy him.

lines.english: The Lord's servant remains under His protection;
lines.transliteration: saahib kee sayvak rahai sarnaa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord Himself forgives him, and blesses him with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: There is none higher than Him.
lines.transliteration: tis tay oopar naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: Why should he be afraid? What should he ever fear? ||4||
lines.transliteration: ka-un darai dar kis kaa ho-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace and tranquility abide within the body.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee saaNt vasai sareer.

lines.english: Remember the Word of the Shabad, and you shall never suffer pain.
lines.transliteration: sabad cheeneh fir lagai na peer.

lines.english: You shall not have to come or go, or suffer in sorrow.
lines.transliteration: aavai na jaa-ay naa dukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall merge in celestial peace.
lines.transliteration: naamay raatay sahj samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੈ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present, close at hand.
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh vaykh ai had oor.

lines.english: My God is always fully pervading everywhere. ||5||
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh sad  rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||5||

lines.english: Some are selfless servants, while others wander, deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: ik sayvak ik bharam bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself does, and causes everything to be done.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay har aap karaa-ay.

lines.english: The One Lord is all-pervading; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayko vartai avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: The mortal might complain, if there were any other.
lines.transliteration: man ros keejai jay doojaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Serve the True Guru; this is the most excellent action.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay karn ee saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਰੋਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ  ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be judged true. ||6||
lines.transliteration: dar saachai saachay veechaaree. ||6||

lines.english: All the lunar days, and the days of the week are beautiful, when one contemplates the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: thitee vaar sabh  sabad  suhaa-ay.

lines.english: If one serves the True Guru, he obtains the fruits of his rewards.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa fal paa-ay.

lines.english: The omens and days all come and go.
lines.transliteration: thitee vaar sabh  aavahi jaahi.

lines.english: But the Word of the Guru's Shabad is eternal and unchanging. Through it, one mergesin the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad nihchal sad aa sach samaahi.

lines.english: The days are auspicious, when one is imbued with Truth.
lines.transliteration: thitee vaar t aa jaa sach raat ay.

lines.english: Without the Name, all the false ones wander deluded. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh bh armeh kaachay. ||7||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs die, and dead, they fall into the most evil state.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mareh mar bigt ee jaahi.

lines.english: They do not remember the One Lord; they are deluded by duality.
lines.transliteration: ayk na cheeteh d oojai lobh aahi.

lines.english: The human body is unconscious, ignorant and blind.
lines.transliteration: achayt pindee agi-aan anDh aar.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over?
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai ki-o paa-ay paar.

lines.english: The Creator Himself creates.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay upaavanhaar.

lines.english: He Himself contemplates the Guru's Word. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aapay keeton gur veechaar. ||8||

lines.english: The religious fanatics wear all sorts of religious robes.
lines.transliteration: bahutay bh aykh karahi bh aykh-Dhaaree.

lines.english: They roll around and wander around, like the false dice on the board.
lines.transliteration: bhav bh av bh armeh kaachee saaree.

lines.english: They find no peace, here or hereafter. pMnw 843
lines.transliteration: aithai sukh na aagai ho-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives, and die.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mu-ay apn aa janam kh o-ay.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, doubt is driven away.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay bh aram chukaa-ay.

lines.english: Deep within the home of the heart, one finds the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence. ||9||
lines.transliteration: ghar hee and ar sach mahal paa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਿਰ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Whatever the Perfect Lord does, that alone happens.
lines.transliteration: aapay pooraa karay so ho-ay.

lines.english: Concern with these omens and days leads only to duality.
lines.transliteration: ayhi thitee vaar d oojaa d o-ay.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu anDh  gubaar.

lines.english: Only idiots and fools worry about these omens and days.
lines.transliteration: thitee vaar sayveh mugaDh  gavaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains understanding and realization;
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh boojh ai sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.english: Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chhant, Dakhnee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (843-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ikat naam sad aa rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||10||2|| he remains forever merged in the Name of the One Lord. ||10||2|| iblwvlu mhlw 1 CMq dKxI  (843-5) bilaaval mehlaa 1 chhant  dakh-nee

lines.english: The young, innocent soul-bride has come to the pasture lands of the world.
lines.transliteration: munDh navaylrh ee-aa go-il aa-ee raam.

lines.english: Laying aside her pitcher of worldly concern, she lovingly attunes herself to her Lord.
lines.transliteration: matukee daar Dharee har liv laa-ee raam.

lines.english: She remains lovingly absorbed in the pasture of the Lord, automatically embellished with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: liv laa-ay har si-o rahee go-il sahj sabad seegaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਿਰ  ਧਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: With her palms pressed together, she prays to the Guru, to unite her with her TrueBeloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: kar jorh gur peh kar binant ee milhu saach pi-aaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਿਲ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan bh aa-ay bh agtee daykh pareet am kaam kroDh  nivaari-aa. Seeing His bride's loving devotion, the Beloved Lord eradicates unfulfilled sexualdesire and unresolved anger.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਕਿਰ ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਪਆਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the young, innocent bride is so beautiful; seeing her Husband Lord, she iscomforted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak munDh navayl sund ar daykh pir saaDh aari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਨਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Truthfully, O young soul-bride, your youth keeps you innocent.
lines.transliteration: sach navaylrhee-ay joban baalee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ  ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਦੇਿਖ ਿਪਰੁ ਸਾਧਾਿਰਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Do not come and go anywhere; stay with your Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: aa-o na jaa-o kahee apnay sah naalee raam.

lines.english: I will stay with my Husband Lord; I am His hand-maiden. Devotional worship to theLord is pleasing to me.
lines.transliteration: naah apnay sang daasee mai bh agat har kee bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਉ  ਨ ਜਾਉ  ਕਹੀ ਅਪਨੇ  ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I know the unknowable, and speak the unspoken; I sing the Glorious Praises of theCelestial Lord God.
lines.transliteration: agaaDh boDh  akath kathee-ai sahj parabh  gun gaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਦਾਸੀ  ਮੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: She who chants and savors the taste of the Lord's Name is loved by the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam naam rasaal rasee-aa ravai saach pi-aaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਿਧ ਅਕਥੁ  ਕਥੀਐ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru grants her the gift of the Shabad; O Nanak, she contemplates and reflectsupon it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur sabad d ee-aa d aan kee-aa naankaa veechaaree-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ  ਰਸੀਆ  ਰਵੈ ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਪਆਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: She who is fascinated by the Supreme Lord, sleeps with her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sareeDhar mohi-arh ee pir sang soot ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਦੀਆ  ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaa-ay chalo saach sangoot ee raam.

lines.english: Dhan saach sangoot ee har sang soot ee sang sakh ee sahaylee-aa. The soul-bride is attuned to the Truth, and sleeps with the Lord, along with hercompanions and sister soul-brides.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ਚਲੋ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸੰਗੂਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Loving the One Lord, with one-pointed mind, the Naam dwells within; I am unitedwith the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ik bhaa-ay ik man naam vasi-aa sat guroo ham maylee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸੰਗੂਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ ਸੂਤੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, with each and every breath, I do not forget the Immaculate Lord, for amoment, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: din rain  gharhee na chasaa visrai saas saas niranjano.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਭਾਇ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: So light the lamp of the Shabad, O Nanak, and burn away your fear. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad jot  jagaa-ay d eepak naankaa bh a-o bh anjno. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਚਸਾ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: O soul-bride, the Lord's Light pervades all the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: jot sabaa-irh ee-ay t aribhavan saaray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਜੋਿਤ ਜਗਾਇ  ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He is pervading each and every heart, the Invisible and Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rav rahi-aa alakh  apaaray raam.

lines.english: He is Invisible and Infinite, Infinite and True; subduing his self-conceit, one meets Him.
lines.transliteration: alakh apaar apaar saachaa aap maar milaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: So burn away your egotistical pride, attachment and greed, with the Word of theShabad; wash away your filth.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa lobh  jaalahu sabad  mail chukh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: When you go to the Lord's Door, you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan;by His Will, the Savior will carry you across and save you.
lines.transliteration: dar jaa-ay d arsan karee bh aanai taar taaran haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, the soul-bride is satisfied; O Nanak,she enshrines Him in her heart. ||4||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 1 ] (843-18) bilaaval mehlaa 1. Bilaaval, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naam amrit chaakh  tariptee naankaa ur Dh aari-aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾਿਰ  ਤਾਰਣਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is filled with such a great joy; I have blossomed forth in Truth.
lines.transliteration: mai man chaa-o ghan aa saach vigaasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਚਾਿਖ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I am enticed by the love of my Husband Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God.
lines.transliteration: mohee paraym piray parabh abh inaasee raam.

lines.english: The Lord is everlasting, the Master of masters. Whatever He wills, happens.
lines.transliteration: avigato har naath naathah t isai bh aavai so thee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ਘਣਾ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਵਗਾਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Great Giver, You are always kind and compassionate. You infuse life into all living beings. pMnw 844
lines.transliteration: kirpaal sadaa d a-i-aal d aataa jee-aa and ar tooN jee-ai.

lines.english: I have no other spiritual wisdom, meditation or worship; the Name of the Lord alone dwells deep within me.
lines.transliteration: mai avar gi-aan na Dhi-aan poojaa har naam ant ar vas rahay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਿਸ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.english: I know nothing about religious robes, pilgrimages or stubborn fanaticism; O Nanak, Ihold tight to the Truth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaykh  bhavnee hath  na jaanaa naankaa sach geh rahay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖੁ ਭਵਨੀ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਚੁ ਗਿਹ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The night is beautiful, drenched with dew, and the day is delightful,
lines.transliteration: bhinrh ee rain  bhalee d inas suhaa-ay raam.
nij ghar soot -rhee-ay piram jagaa-ay raam. when her Husband Lord wakes the sleeping soul-bride, in the home of the self.

lines.english: The young bride has awakened to the Word of the Shabad; she is pleasing to herHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: nav haan nav Dh an sabad  jaagee aapn ay pir bh aanee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਹਾਿਣ  ਨਵ ਧਨ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਾਗੀ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਪਰ ਭਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: So renounce falsehood, fraud, love of duality and working for people.
lines.transliteration: taj koorh  kapat subh aa-o d oojaa chaakree lokaan ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ  ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is my necklace, and I am anointed with the True Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mai naam har kaa haar kanthay saach sabad  neesaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨੀਸਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for the gift of the True Name; please, bless me with Your Grace, through the pleasure of Your Will. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar jorh naanak saach maagai nad ar kar t uDh bhaani-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਾਚੁ ਮਾਗੈ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਿਣਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Awake, O bride of splendored eyes, and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: jaag salonrhee-ay bolai gurbaan ee raam.

lines.english: Listen, and place your faith in the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin sun mani-arh ee akath kahaan ee raam.

lines.english: The Unspoken Speech, the state of Nirvaanaa - how rare is the Gurmukh whounderstands this.
lines.transliteration: akath kahaanee pad  nirbaan ee ko virlaa gurmukh  boojh -ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝਏ  ॥
lines.english: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, self-conceit is eradicated, and the three worldsare revealed to her understanding.
lines.transliteration: oh sabad samaa-ay aap gavaa-ay t aribhavan sojhee soojh -ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਏ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਸੋਝੀ ਸੂਝਏ  ॥
lines.english: Remaining detached, with infinity infusing, the true mind cherishes the virtues of theLord.
lines.transliteration: rahai ateet  aprampar raat aa saach man gun  saari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਿਰ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is fully pervading and permeating all places; Nanak has enshrined Him within hisheart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oh poor rahi-aa sarab thaa-ee naankaa ur Dh aari-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਠਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord is calling you to the Mansion of His Presence; O soul-bride, He is the Loverof His devotees.
lines.transliteration: mahal bulaa-irhee-ay bh agat sanayhee raam.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, your mind shall be delighted, and your body shall be fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gurmat man rahsee seejh as dayhee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਮਿਨ ਰਹਸੀ  ਸੀਝਿਸ  ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Conquer and subdue your mind, and love the Word of the Shabad; reform yourself,and realize the Lord of the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: man maar reejhai sabad  seejh ai tarai lok naath pachh aan-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਰੀਝੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਝੈ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ  ॥
lines.english: Her mind shall not waver or wander anywhere else, when she comes to know herHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: man deeg dol na jaa-ay kat hee aapn aa pir jaan -ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਿਗ  ਡੋਿਲ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਕਤ ਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਪਰੁ ਜਾਣਏ  ॥
lines.english: You are my only Support, You are my Lord and Master. You are my strength andanchor.
lines.transliteration: mai aaDhaar t ayraa t oo kh asam mayraa mai t aan takee-aa t ayra-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਸਮੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ  ਤਕੀਆ  ਤੇਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: She is forever truthful and pure, O Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad,conflicts are resolved. ||4||2|| CMq iblwvlu mhlw 4 mMgl  (844-12) chhant  bilaaval mehlaa 4 mangal Chhant, Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy: <> siqgur pRswid ] (844-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saach soochaa sadaa naanak gur sabad  jhagar nibayra-o. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ  ਸੂਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਝਗਰੁ ਿਨਬੇਰਓ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: My Lord God has come to my bed, and my mind is merged with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayraa har parabh sayjai aa-i-aa man sukh  samaan aa raam.

lines.english: As it pleases the Guru, I have found the Lord God, and I revel and delight in His Love.
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai har parabh  paa-i-aa rang ralee-aa maan aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਸੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Very fortunate are those happy soul-brides, who have the jewel of the Naam upon their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee-aa sohaagan ee har mast ak maan aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਲੀਆ  ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Lord God, is Nanak's Husband Lord, pleasing to his mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har parabh har sohaag hai naanak man bh aanaa raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਮਾਣਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the honor of the dishonored. The Lord, the Lord God is Himself byHimself.
lines.transliteration: nimaaniaa har maan  hai har parabh  har aapai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh eradicates self-conceit, and constantly chants the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap gavaa-i-aa nit  har har jaapai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਮਾਿਣਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My Lord God does whatever He pleases; the Lord imbues mortal beings with the colorof His Love.
lines.transliteration: mayray har parabh bh aavai so karai har rang har raapai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is easily merged into the Celestial Lord. He is satisfied with the sublimeessence of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sahj milaa-i-aa har ras har Dharaapai raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is found only through this human incarnation. This is the time tocontemplate the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam har paa-ee-ai har raavan  vayraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As Gurmukhs, the happy soul-brides meet Him, and their love for Him is abundant.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mil sohaagan ee rang ho-ay gh anayraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਵਣ  ਵੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who have not attained human incarnation, are cursed by evil destiny.
lines.transliteration: jin maanas janam na paa-i-aa t inH bhaag mand ayraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣੇਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, God, Har, Har, Har, Har, save Nanak; he is Your humble servant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har har har raakh parabh  naanak jan t ayraa raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has implanted within me the Name of the Inaccessible Lord God; my mind and body are drenched with the Lord's Love. pMnw 845
lines.transliteration: gur har parabh agam drirh -aa-i-aa man t an rang bh eenaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਲੀਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; the Gurmukhs attain the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al har naam hai gurmukh  har leenaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੇ  ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, they cannot even live, like the fish without water.
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na jeevday ji-o jal bin meenaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: Finding the Lord, my life has become fruitful; O Nanak, the Lord God has fulfilled me. ||4||1||3|| iblwvlu mhlw 4 sloku ] (845-2) bilaaval mehlaa 4 salok. Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Shalok:
lines.transliteration: safal janam har paa-i-aa naanak parabh keenaa raam. ||4||1||3||

lines.english: Seek out the Lord God, your only true Friend. He shall dwell in your mind, by greatgood fortune.
lines.transliteration: har parabh sajan  lorh lahu man vasai vadbh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਲੋਿੜ  ਲਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru shall reveal Him to you; O Nanak, lovingly focus yourself on the Lord.||1|| CMq ] (845-3) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai vaykhaali-aa naanak har liv laag. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The soul-bride has come to ravish and enjoy her Lord God, after eradicating the poison of egotism.
lines.transliteration: mayraa har parabh raavan  aa-ee-aa ha-umai bikh  jhaagay raam.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, she has eliminated her self-conceit; she is lovinglyattuned to her Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gurmat aap mitaa-i-aa har har liv laagay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਾਵਿਣ  ਆਈਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਝਾਗੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Her heart-lotus deep within has blossomed forth, and through the Guru, spiritualwisdom has been awakened within her.
lines.transliteration: antar kamal pargaasi-aa gur gi-aanee jaagay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the Lord God, by perfect, great good fortune. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har parabh paa-i-aa poorai vadbh aagay raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਜਾਗੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Lord God, is pleasing to her mind; the Lord's Name resounds within her.
lines.transliteration: har parabh har man bh aa-i-aa har naam vaDh aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, God is obtained; she is lovingly focused on the Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai parabh paa-i-aa har har liv laa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਧਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The darkness of ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light radiantly shines forth.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayraa kati-aa jot  pargati-aa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Nanak's only Support; he merges into the Lord'sName. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam aDhaar hai har naam samaa-ee raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਕਿਟਆ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਪਰਗਿਟਆਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Dhan har parabh  pi-aarai raavee-aa jaaN har parabh  bhaa-ee raam. The soul-bride is ravished and enjoyed by her Beloved Lord God, when the Lord God is pleased with her.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My eyes are drawn to His Love, like the cat to the mouse.
lines.transliteration: akhee paraym kasaa-ee-aa ji-o bilak masaa-ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਪਆਰੈ  ਰਾਵੀਆ  ਜ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord; I am satisfied by the subtle essence ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har mayli-aa har ras aaghaa-ee raam.

lines.english: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is lovinglyattuned to the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam vigsi-aa har har liv laa-ee raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਆਘਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am a fool and an idiot, but the Lord showered me with His Mercy, and united mewith Himself.
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh mugaDh  milaa-i-aa har kirpaa Dh aaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਿਵਗਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo saabaas hai jin ha-umai maaree raam. Blessed, blessed is the most wonderful Guru, who has conquered egotism.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Very fortunate, of blessed destiny are those, who enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, in theirhearts.
lines.transliteration: jinH vadbhaagee-aa vadbh aag hai har har ur Dh aaree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, and be a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||4|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 CMq  (845-13) bilaaval mehlaa 5 chhant Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (845-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too naamay balihaaree raam. ||4||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The time of rejoicing has come; I sing of my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: mangal saaj bha-i-aa parabh  apnaa gaa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: I have heard of my Imperishable Husband Lord, and happiness fills my mind.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee var sun i-aa man upji-aa chaa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: My mind is in love with Him; when shall I realize my great good fortune, and meet with my Perfect Husband?
lines.transliteration: man pareet laagai vadai bh aagai kab milee-ai pooran pat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਗਲ  ਸਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਗਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: If only I could meet the Lord of the Universe, and be automatically absorbed into Him;tell me how, O my companions!
lines.transliteration: sehjay samaa-ee-ai govind paa-ee-ai d ayh sakh ee-ay mohi mat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਵਰੁ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਮਿਨ ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਚਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Day and night, I stand and serve my God; how can I attain Him?
lines.transliteration: din rain  thaadhee kara-o sayvaa parabh  kavan jugt ee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਬ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, have mercy on me, and attach me to the hem of Your robe, O Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak karahu kirpaa laihu mohi larh  laa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਦੇਹੁ ਸਖੀਏ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Joy has come! I have purchased the jewel of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-aa samaahrh aa har rat an visaahaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਠਾਢੀ  ਕਰਉ  ਸੇਵਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਵਨ  ਜੁਗਤੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Searching, the seeker has found the Lord with the Saints.
lines.transliteration: khojee kh oj laDh aa har sant an paahaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੈਹੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have met the Beloved Saints, and they have blessed me with their kindness; I contemplate the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: milay sant pi-aaray d a-i-aa Dh aaray katheh akath beechaaro.

lines.english: With my consciousness centered, and my mind one-pointed, I meditate on my Lordand Master, with love and affection.
lines.transliteration: ik chit ik man Dh i-aa-ay su-aamee laa-ay pareet  pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਿਜ ਲਧਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਨ  ਪਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I pray unto God, to bless me with the profit of the Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: kar jorh parabh  peh kar binant ee milai har jas laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰੇ ਕਥਿਹ  ਅਕਥ  ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. My God is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||2|| pMnw 846
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak d aas tayraa mayraa parabh  agam athaahaa. ||2||

lines.english: The date for my wedding is set, and cannot be changed; my union with the Lord is perfect.
lines.transliteration: saahaa atal gani-aa pooran sanjogo raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹਾ  ਅਟਲੁ  ਗਿਣਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸੰਜੋਗੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am totally at peace, and my separation from Him has ended.
lines.transliteration: sukhah samooh bh a-i-aa ga-i-aa vijogo raam.

lines.english: The Saints meet and come together, and meditate on God; they form a wondrouswedding party.
lines.transliteration: mil sant aa-ay parabh  Dhi-aa-ay ban ay achraj jaanj ee-aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਆਏ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਧਆਏ  ਬਣੇ ਅਚਰਜ  ਜਾਞੀਆਂ ॥
lines.english: Gathering together, they arrive with poise and grace, and love fills the minds of thebride's family.
lines.transliteration: mil ikatar ho-ay sahj dh o-ay man pareet  upjee maanj ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਇਕਤਰ੍  ਹੋਏ ਸਹਿਜ  ਢੋਏ ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਉਪਜੀ  ਮਾਞੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Her light blends with His Light, through and through, and everyone enjoys the Nectar of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mil jot jot ee ot potee har naam sabh  ras bh ogo.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਭ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the Saints have totally united me with God, the All-powerful Cause ofcauses. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak sabh  sant maylee parabh  karan  kaaran  jogo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਸੰਿਤ ਮੇਲੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Beautiful is my home, and beauteous is the earth.
lines.transliteration: bhavan suhaavrh aa Dh arat sabh aagee raam.

lines.english: God has entered the home of my heart; I touch the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: parabh gh ar aa-i-arh aa gur charn ee laagee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਅੜਾ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Grasping the Guru's feet, I awake in peace and poise. All my desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gur charan laagee sahj jaagee sagal ichh aa punnee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਜਾਗੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਇਛਾ  ਪੁੰਨੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: My hopes are fulfilled, through the dust of the feet of the Saints. After such a longseparation, I have met my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayree aas pooree sant Dh ooree har milay kant  vichh unni-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ਪੂਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਕੰਤ ਿਵਛੁੰਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; I have forsaken mystubborn-minded intellect.
lines.transliteration: aanand an-d in vajeh vaajay ahaN mat man kee t i-aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਵਜਿਹ  ਵਾਜੇ ਅਹੰ ਮਿਤ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਤਆਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; in the Society of the Saints,I am lovingly attuned to Him. ||4||1|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (846-7) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  su-aamee sat sang liv laagee. ||4||1||

lines.english: By blessed destiny, I have found my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhaag sulakh -naa har kant  hamaaraa raam.

lines.english: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: anhad baajit raa tis Dhun darbaaraa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਗ ਸੁਲਖਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; day and night, I am enraptured.
lines.transliteration: aanand an-d in vajeh vaajay d inas rain  omaahaa.

lines.english: Disease, sorrow and suffering do not afflict anyone there; there is no birth or deaththere.
lines.transliteration: tah rog sog na d ookh bi-aapai janam maran  na taahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਵਜਿਹ  ਵਾਜੇ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਉਮਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: There are treasures overflowing there - wealth, miraculous powers, ambrosial nectarand devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  suDh aa ras amrit  bhagat bharay bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਤਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am a sacrifice, devoted to the Supreme Lord God, the Support of thebreath of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak balihaar vanj aa paarbarahm paraan aDh aaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O my companions, and sister soul-brides, let's join together and sing the songsof joy.
lines.transliteration: sun sakh ee-a sahaylrh eeho mil mangal gaavah raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ਵੰਞਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Loving our God with mind and body, let's ravish and enjoy Him.
lines.transliteration: man tan paraym karay t is parabh  ka-o raavah raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਖੀਅ  ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Lovingly enjoying Him, we become pleasing to Him; let's not reject Him, for a moment, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: kar paraym raavah tisai bh aavah ik nimakh  palak na t i-aagee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਰਾਵਹ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Let's hug Him close in our embrace, and not feel shy; let's bathe our minds in the dustof His feet.
lines.transliteration: geh kanth laa-ee-ai nah lajaa-ee-ai charan raj man paagee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਰਾਵਹ  ਿਤਸੈ ਭਾਵਹ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ ਪਲਕ  ਨ ਿਤਆਗੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: With the intoxicating drug of devotional worship, let's entice Him, and not wanderanywhere else.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  thag-uree paa-ay mohah anat  kathoo na Dh aavah.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਈਐ  ਨਹ ਲਜਾਈਐ  ਚਰਨ  ਰਜ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਗੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, meeting with our True Friend, we attain the immortal status. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak mil sang saajan amar pad vee paavah. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਪਾਇ ਮੋਹਹ  ਅਨਤ  ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵਹ  ॥
lines.english: I am wonder-struck and amazed, gazing upon the Glories of my Imperishable Lord.
lines.transliteration: bisman bisam bha-ee paykh  gun abhinaasee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਅਮਰ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਵਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He took my hand, and held my arm, and cut away the noose of Death.
lines.transliteration: kar geh bhujaa gahee kat jam kee faasee raam.

lines.english: Holding me by the arm, He made me His slave; the branch has sprouted inabundance.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa leenHee daas keenHee ankur ud ot janaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਟ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Pollution, attachment and corruption have run away; the immaculate day has dawned.
lines.transliteration: malan moh bikaar naathay d ivas nirmal aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੀ  ਦਾਿਸ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਅੰਕੁਿਰ  ਉਦੋਤੁ  ਜਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord loves me with His Mind; my immense evil-mindedness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: darisat Dh aaree man pi-aaree mahaa d urmat  naasee.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have become immaculate and pure; I have met the Imperishable Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak bh a-ee nirmal parabh  milay abh inaasee. ||3||

lines.english: The rays of light merge with the sun, and water merges with water.
lines.transliteration: sooraj kiran milay jal kaa jal hoo-aa raam.

lines.english: One's light blends with the Light, and one becomes totally perfect.
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  ralee sampooran thee-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰਜ  ਿਕਰਿਣ  ਿਮਲੇ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਹੂਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I see God, hear God, and speak of the One and only God.
lines.transliteration: barahm deesai barahm sun ee-ai ayk ayk vakh aanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਰਲੀ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਥੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The soul is the Creator of the expanse of creation. Without God, I know no other atall.
lines.transliteration: aatam pasaaraa karan haaraa parabh  binaa nahee jaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਦੀਸੈ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He created the Creation.
lines.transliteration: aap kartaa aap bh ugtaa aap kaaran  kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਪਸਾਰਾ  ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, they alone know this, who drink in the subtle essence of the Lord.||4||2|| pMnw 847 iblwvlu mhlw 5 CMq  (847-1) bilaaval mehlaa 5 chhant Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (847-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak say-ee jaan eh jinHee har ras pee-aa. ||4||2||

lines.english: Come, O my sisters, come, O my companions, and let us remain under the Lord's control. Let's sing the Songs of Bliss of our Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sakhee aa-o sakh ee vas aa-o sakh ee asee pir kaa mangal gaavah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਆਉ  ਸਖੀ ਵਿਸ ਆਉ  ਸਖੀ ਅਸੀ  ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਵਹ  ॥
