lines.english: Renounce your pride, O my companions, renounce your egotistical pride, O my sisters,so that you may become pleasing to your Beloved.
lines.transliteration: taj maan sakh ee taj maan sakh ee mat  aapn ay pareet am bh aavah.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਤਿਜ  ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਤੁ ਆਪਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਭਾਵਹ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce pride, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, and serve the OneImmaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: taj maan moh bikaar d oojaa sayv ayk niranjano.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਬਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਸੇਿਵ ਏਕੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Hold tight to the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Merciful Lord, your Beloved, theDestroyer of all sins.
lines.transliteration: lag charan saran  da-i-aal pareet am sagal d urat bikhandno.

lines.punjabi: ਲਗੁ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਣ  ਦਇਆਲ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸਗਲ  ਦੁਰਤ  ਿਬਖੰਡਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Be the slave of His slaves, forsake sorrow and sadness, and do not bother with otherdevices.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay daas d aasee t aj udaasee bahurh  biDhee na Dh aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ  ਤਿਜ ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਿਬਧੀ  ਨ ਧਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, O Lord, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your songs ofbliss. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai karahu kirpaa taam mangal gaavaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤਾਿਮ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of my Beloved, is like a cane to a blind man.
lines.transliteration: amrit pari-a kaa naam mai anDh ulay tohnee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਟੋਹਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Maya seduces in so many ways, like a beautiful enticing woman.
lines.transliteration: oh johai baho parkaar sundar mohnee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਮੋਹਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: This enticer is so incredibly beautiful and clever; she entices with countless suggestive gestures.
lines.transliteration: mohnee mahaa bachitar chanchal anik bh aav d ikhaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨੀ  ਮਹਾ ਬਿਚਿਤਰ੍  ਚੰਚਿਲ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਾਵ ਿਦਖਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Maya is stubborn and persistent; she seems so sweet to the mind, and then he doesnot chant the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay dheeth  meeth ee maneh laagai naam lain  na aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਢੀਠ ਮੀਠੀ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਣ ਨ ਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: At home, in the forest, on the banks of sacred rivers, fasting, worshipping, on theroads and on the shore, she is spying.
lines.transliteration: garih baneh teerai barat  poojaa baat gh aatai johnee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਬਨਿਹ  ਤੀਰੈ ਬਰਤ  ਪੂਜਾ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ  ਜੋਹਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Kindness, Lord; I am blind, and Your Name ismy cane. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai da-i-aa Dh aarahu mai naam anDh ulay tohnee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਟੋਹਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am helpless and masterless; You, O my Beloved, are my Lord and Master. As itpleases You, so do You protect me.
lines.transliteration: mohi anaath pari-a naath ji-o jaanhu ti-o rakh ahu.

lines.english: I have no wisdom or cleverness; what face should I put on to please You?
lines.transliteration: chaturaa-ee mohi naahi reejh aava-o kahi mukh ahu.

lines.punjabi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਮੋਿਹ ਨਾਿਹ  ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਕਿਹ ਮੁਖਹੁ ॥
lines.english: I am not clever, skillful or wise; I am worthless, without any virtue at all.
lines.transliteration: nah chatur sugh ar sujaan bayt ee mohi nirgun gun nahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਚਤੁਿਰ  ਸੁਘਿਰ  ਸੁਜਾਨ  ਬੇਤੀ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਿਨ  ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.english: I have no beauty or pleasing smell, no beautiful eyes. As it pleases You, please preserve me, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: nah roop Dhoop na nain  bankay jah bh aavai t ah rakh  tuhee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਣ ਬੰਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
lines.english: His victory is celebrated by all; how can I know the state of the Lord of Mercy?
lines.transliteration: jai jai ja-i-ampeh sagal jaa ka-o karunaapat  gat kin lakh ahu.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਇਅੰਪਿਹ  ਸਗਲ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਿਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਕਿਨ  ਲਖਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am the servant of Your servants; as it pleases You, please preserveme. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai sayv sayvak ji-o jaanhu ti-o mohi rakh ahu. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਿਜਉ  ਜਾਨਹੁ ਿਤਉ  ਮੋਿਹ ਰਖਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am the fish, and You are the water; without You, what can I do?
lines.transliteration: mohi machhulee t um neer t ujh bin ki-o sarai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਤੁਮ ਨੀਰ ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਉ  ਸਰੈ ॥
lines.english: I am the rainbird, and You are the rain-drop; when it falls into my mouth, I amsatisfied.
lines.transliteration: mohi chaatrik t umH boond  taripta-o mukh  parai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ ਤੁਮ ਬੂੰਦ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਉ  ਮੁਿਖ ਪਰੈ ॥
lines.english: When it falls into my mouth, my thirst is quenched; You are the Lord of my soul, myheart, my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: mukh parai harai pi-aas mayree jee-a hee-aa paranpat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਖ ਪਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਿਪਆਸ  ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਅ  ਹੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Touch me, and caress me, O Lord, You are in all; let me meet You, so that I may beemancipated.
lines.transliteration: laadilay laad ladaa-ay sabh meh mil hamaaree ho-ay gat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਡਲੇ  ਲਾਡ  ਲਡਾਇ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਿਮਲੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.english: In my consciousness I remember You, and the darkness is dispelled, like the chakviduck, which longs to see the dawn.
lines.transliteration: cheet chit va-o mit anDh aaray ji-o aas chakvee d in charai.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, O my Beloved, please unite me with Yourself; the fish never forgets the water. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai pari-a sang maylee machhulee neer na veesrai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੇਲੀ  ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an hamaaray bh aag gh ar aa-i-aa pir mayraa. Blessed, blessed is my destiny; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਭਾਗ ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ਿਪਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The gate of my mansion is so beautiful, and all my gardens are so green and alive.
lines.transliteration: sohay bank du-aar saglaa ban haraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ  ਸਗਲਾ  ਬਨੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
lines.english: My peace-giving Lord and Master has rejuvenated me, and blessed me with great joy,bliss and love.
lines.transliteration: har haraa su-aamee sukhah gaamee anad  mangal ras gh anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰ ਹਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਖਹ  ਗਾਮੀ  ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਰਸੁ ਘਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: My Young Husband Lord is eternally young, and His body is forever youthful; whattongue can I use to chant His Glorious Praises?
lines.transliteration: naval navtan naahu baalaa kavan rasnaa gun bh anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ  ਨਾਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ  ਕਵਨ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੁਨ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.english: My bed is beautiful; gazing upon Him, I am fascinated, and all my doubts and painsare dispelled.
lines.transliteration: mayree sayj sohee daykh  mohee sagal sahsaa d ukh haraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੀ ਦੇਿਖ ਮੋਹੀ ਸਗਲ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; my Lord and Master is unlimited. ||5||1||3|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 CMq mMgl  (847-18) bilaaval mehlaa 5 chhant  mangal Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy: <> siqgur pRswid ] (847-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku ] (847-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai mayree aas pooree milay su-aamee apramparaa. ||5||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ਪੂਰੀ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ  ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: God is beautiful, tranquil and merciful; He is the treasure of absolute peace, myHusband Lord. pMnw 848
lines.transliteration: sundar saaNt da-i-aal parabh  sarab sukh aa niDh  pee-o.

lines.english: Meeting with God, the Ocean of Peace, O Nanak, this soul becomes happy. ||1|| CMq ] (848-1) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar parabh  bhayti-ai naanak sukh ee hot  ih jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭੇਿਟਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਤ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One finds God, the Ocean of Peace, when destiny is activated.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar parabh  paa-ee-ai jab hovai bh aago raam.

lines.english: Abandoning the distinctions of honor and dishonor, grasp the Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maanan maan vanjaa-ee-ai har charn ee laago raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਬ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Renounce cleverness and trickery, and forsake your evil-minded intellect.
lines.transliteration: chhod si-aanap chaat uree d urmat  buDh  ti-aago raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਿਨ  ਮਾਨੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord, Your King, and your marriage will be permanent and stable. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-o sarnaa-ee raam raa-ay thir ho-ay suhaago raam. ||1||

lines.english: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another? Without the Lord, you cannot even live.
lines.transliteration: so parabh t aj kat  laagee-ai jis bin mar jaa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਿਥਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The ignorant fool does not feel any shame; the evil man wanders around deluded.
lines.transliteration: laaj na aavai agi-aan matee d urjan birmaa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਿਜ ਕਤ ਲਾਗੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God is the Purifier of sinners; if he forsakes God, tell me, where he can find a place ofrest?
lines.transliteration: patit paavan parabh  ti-aag karay kaho kat  thehraa-ee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਜ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਮਤੀ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਿਬਰਮਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by loving devotional worship of the Merciful Lord, he attains the state ofeternal life. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  bhaa-o kar d a-i-aal kee jeevan pad  paa-ee-ai raam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਕਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: May that vicious tongue that does not chant the Name of the Great Lord of the World,be burnt.
lines.transliteration: saree gopaal na uchrahi bal ga-ee-ay duhchaaran  rasnaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆਲ  ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who does not serve God, the Lover of His devotees, shall have his body eaten bycrows.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh agat vachh al nah sayvhee kaa-i-aa kaak garsanaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ  ਨ ਉਚਰਿਹ  ਬਿਲ ਗਈਏ  ਦੁਹਚਾਰਿਣ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Enticed by doubt, he does not understand the pain it brings; he wanders throughmillions of incarnations.
lines.transliteration: bharam mohee d ookh na jaan hee kot jonee basnaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਨਹ ਸੇਵਹੀ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਾਕ  ਗਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if you desire anything other than the Lord, you shall be consumed, like amaggot in manure. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin har avar je chaahnaa bistaa kiram bhasmaa raam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕੋਿਟ ਜੋਨੀ ਬਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Embrace love for the Lord God, and in detachment, unite with Him.
lines.transliteration: laa-ay birahu bhagvant  sangay ho-ay mil bairaagan raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਿਜ ਚਾਹਨਾ  ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਮ ਭਸਮਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Give up your sandalwood oil, expensive clothes, perfumes, tasty flavors and the poison of egotism.
lines.transliteration: chandan cheer suganDh  rasaa ha-umai bikh  ti-aagan raam.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਇ ਿਬਰਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਸੰਗੇ ਹੋਇ ਿਮਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਨ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Do not waver this way or that, but remain wakeful in the service of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  nah dolee-ai har sayvaa jaagan raam.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨ  ਚੀਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ  ਰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਿਤਆਗਿਨ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she who has obtained her God, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||4||1||4|| iblwvlu mhlw 5 ] (848-11) bilaaval mehlaa 5. Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin parabh paa-i-aa aapn aa saa atal suhaagan raam. ||4||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਗਿਨ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Seek the Lord, O fortunate ones, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly.
lines.transliteration: har khojahu vadbh aageeho mil saaDh oo sangay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਾ ਅਟਲ  ਸੁਹਾਗਿਨ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe forever, imbued with the Love ofthe Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gun govid sad  gaa-ee-ah paarbarahm kai rangay raam.

lines.english: Serving God forever, you shall obtain the fruitful rewards you desire.
lines.transliteration: so parabh sad  hee sayvee-ai paa-ee-ah fal mangay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of God; meditate on the Lord, and ride the many wavesof the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee jap anat  tarangay raam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਿਵਦ ਸਦ ਗਾਈਅਿਹ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I shall not forget God, even for an instant; He has blessed me with everything.
lines.transliteration: ik til parabh oo na veesrai jin sabh  kichh  deenaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ਫਲ ਮੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have met Him; as Gurmukh, I contemplate my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee maylaavarh aa gurmukh  pir cheenHaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਜਿਪ ਅਨਤ  ਤਰੰਗੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Holding me by the arm, He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the darkness, and made me His own.
lines.transliteration: baah pakarh t am tay kaadh i-aa kar apunaa leenaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਦੀਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak lives; his mind and heart are cooledand soothed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam japat naanak jeevai seet al man seenaa raam. ||2||

lines.english: What virtues of Yours can I speak, O God, O Searcher of hearts?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gun t ayray kahi saka-o parabh  antarjaamee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿੜ  ਤਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਿਢਆ  ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I have crossed over to the othershore.
lines.transliteration: simar simar naaraa-inai bh a-ay paargaraamee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਵੈ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਮਨੁ ਸੀਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all my desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat govind  kay sabh  ichh pujaamee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਹ ਸਕਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is saved, meditating on the Lord, the Lord and Master of all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhray jap haray sabh hoo kaa su-aamee raam. ||3||

lines.english: Sublime are those eyes, which are drenched with the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ras bhini-arh ay apunay raam sangay say lo-in  neekay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕੇ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਮੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon God, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Friend of my soul.
lines.transliteration: parabh paykh at ichhaa punnee-aa mil saajan jee kay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਧਰੇ  ਜਿਪ ਹਰੇ ਸਭਹੂ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Love, and now the taste of corruption is insipid and tasteless to me.
lines.transliteration: amrit ras har paa-i-aa bikh i-aa ras feekay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਿਭੰਿਨਅੜੇ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗੇ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ  ਨੀਕੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as water mingles with water, my light has merged into the Light.||4||2||5||9|| pMnw 849 iblwvlu kI vwr mhlw 4  (849-1) bilaaval kee vaar mehlaa 4 Vaar Of Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (849-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mÚ 4 ] (849-2) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jal jaleh samaa-i-aa jotee jot  meekay raam. ||4||2||5||9||

lines.english: I sing of the sublime Lord, the Lord God, in the melody of Raag Bilaaval.
lines.transliteration: har utam har parabh  gaavi-aa kar naad  bilaaval raag.

lines.english: Hearing the Guru's Teachings, I obey them; this is the pre-ordained destiny writtenupon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: updays guroo sun  mani-aa Dh ur mast ak pooraa bh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਉਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਗਾਿਵਆ  ਕਿਰ ਨਾਦੁ  ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਰਾਗੁ ॥
lines.english: All day and night, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; within my heart, I am lovingly attuned to Him.
lines.transliteration: sabh d inas rain  gun uchrai har har har ur liv laag.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਿਣ ਮੰਿਨਆ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
lines.english: My body and mind are totally rejuvenated, and the garden of my mind has blossomedforth in lush abundance.
lines.transliteration: sabh t an man hari-aa ho-i-aa man kh irhi-aa hari-aa baag.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, with the light of the lamp of the Guru'swisdom. Servant Nanak lives by beholding the Lord.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayraa mit ga-i-aa gur chaanan  gi-aan charaag.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਿਖਿੜਆ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਬਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Let me behold Your face, for a moment, even an instant! ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (849-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jeevai daykh  har ik nimakh  gharhee mukh  laag. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਇਆ  ਗੁ ਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Be happy and sing in Bilaaval, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in yourmouth.
lines.transliteration: bilaaval tab hee keejee-ai jab mukh  hovai naam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਘੜੀ  ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The melody and music, and the Word of the Shabad are beautiful, when one focuseshis meditation on the celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: raag naad sabad  sohn ay jaa laagai sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.english: So leave behind the melody and music, and serve the Lord; then, you shall obtainhonor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raag naad chh od har sayvee-ai t aa dargeh paa-ee-ai maan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਜਬ ਮੁਿਖ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, contemplate God, and rid your mind of egotistical pride. ||2|| pauVI ] (849-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh barahm beechaaree-ai chookai man abh imaan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਜਾ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Lord God, You Yourself are inaccessible; You formed everything.
lines.transliteration: too har parabh  aap agamm hai sabh  tuDh upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ  ਛੋਿਡ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are totally permeating and pervading the entire universe.
lines.transliteration: too aapay aap varatd aa sabh  jagat  sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਚੂਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself are absorbed in the state of deep meditation; You Yourself sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay t aarhee laa-ee-ai aapay gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, O devotees, day and night; He shall deliver you in the end.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aavahu bh agtahu d inas raat  ant la-ay chh adaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਸਿਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the Lord, find peace; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord.||1|| slok mÚ 3 ] (849-10) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa tin sukh  paa-i-aa har naam samaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, the happiness of Bilaaval does not come; the self-willedmanmukh finds no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bilaaval na hova-ee manmukh  thaa-ay na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈਐ  ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through hypocrisy, devotional worship does not come, and the Supreme Lord God is not found.
lines.transliteration: pakhand bh agat na hova-ee paarbarahm na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By stubborn-mindedly performing religious rituals, no one obtains the approval of theLord.
lines.transliteration: manhath karam kamaavn ay thaa-ay na ko-ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands himself, and eradicates self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh aap beechaaree-ai vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself is the Supreme Lord God; the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in hismind.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap paarbarahm hai paarbarahm vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death are erased, and his light blends with the Light. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (849-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa kati-aa jot ee jot  milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Be happy in Bilaaval, O my beloveds, and embrace love for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: bilaaval karihu tumH pi-aariho aykas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death shall be eradicated, and you shall remain absorbed in theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh katee-ai sachay rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You shall be blissful forever in Bilaaval, if you walk in harmony with the Will of theTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: sadaa bilaaval anand hai jay chaleh sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Sitting in the Saints' Congregation, sing with love the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: satsangt ee bahi bh aa-o kar sad aa har kay gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, are united in theLord's Union. ||2|| pauVI ] (849-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak say jan sohnay je gurmukh  mayl milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord Himself is within all beings. The Lord is the friend of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa jee-aa vich har aap so bh agtaa kaa mit  har.

lines.english: Everyone is under the Lord's control; in the home of the devotees there is bliss.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko-ee har kai vas bh agtaa kai anand gh ar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the friend and companion of His devotees; all His humble servants stretchout and sleep in peace.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa kaa maylee sarbat  sa-o nisul jan tang Dh ar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Lord and Master of all; O humble devotee, remember Him.
lines.transliteration: har sabhnaa kaa hai kh asam so bh agat jan chit  kar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ  ਬਿਹ ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: No one can equal You, Lord. Those who try, struggle and die in frustration. ||2|| pMnw 850 slok mÚ 3 ] (850-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tuDh aparh  ko-ay na sakai sabh  jhakh jhakh pavai jh arh. ||2||

lines.english: He alone knows God, and he alone is a Brahmin, who walks in harmony with the Willof the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: barahm bindeh t ay barahman aa jay chaleh sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, is freed of egotism and disease.
lines.transliteration: jin kai hirdai har vasai ha-umai rog gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਬੰਦਿਹ  ਤੇ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣਾ  ਜੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He chants the Lord's Praises, gathers virtue, and his light merges into the Light.
lines.transliteration: gun raveh gun  sangar-hahi jot ee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: How rare are those Brahmins who, in this age, come to know God, by lovinglyfocusing their consciousness on Him.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh virlay baraahman barahm bind eh chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਰਵਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹਿਹ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, remain lovinglyattuned to the Name of the True Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (850-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jinH ka-o nadar karay har sachaa say naam rahay liv laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਬੰਦਿਹ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of theShabad,
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayv na keet ee-aa sabad  na lago bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਸੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog kamaavanaa at  deeragh  baho su-aa-o. earns the very painful disease of egotism; he is so very selfish.

lines.english: Acting stubborn-mindedly, he is reincarnated over and over again.
lines.transliteration: manhath karam kamaavn ay fir fir jonee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: The birth of the Gurmukh is fruitful and auspicious. The Lord unites him with Himself.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh janam safal hai jis no aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਅਿਤ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Mercy, one obtains the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (850-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree nad ar karay t aa naam Dh an palai paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: All glorious greatness is in the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh vad i-aa-ee-aa har naam vich har gurmukh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One obtains all that he asks for, if he keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: je vasat mangee-ai saa-ee paa-ee-ai jay naam chit  laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If he tells the secrets of his soul to the True Guru, then he finds absolute peace.
lines.transliteration: guhaj gal jee-a kee keechai satguroo paas t aa sarab sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: When the Perfect Guru bestows the Lord's Teachings, then all hunger departs.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa har updays d ay-ay sabh  bhukh leh jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3|| slok mÚ 3 ] (850-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhi-aa so har gun  gaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਵਸਤੁ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਸਾਈ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: No one goes away empty-handed from the True Guru; He unites me in Union with myGod.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay kh aalee ko nahee mayrai parabh  mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਹਜ  ਗਲ ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਕੀਚੈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਤਾ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru; through it, one obtainswhatever fruitful rewards he desires.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa d arsan safal hai jayhaa ko ichh ay tayhaa fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਦੇਇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar. It banishes all hunger and thirst.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit  hai sabh  tarisnaa bh ukh gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord brings contentment; the True Lord comesto dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: har ras pee santokh  ho-aa sach vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the True Lord, the status of immortality is obtained; the Unstruck Wordof the Shabad vibrates and resounds.
lines.transliteration: sach Dhi-aa-ay amraa pad  paa-i-aa anhad  sabad  vajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is pervading in the ten directions; through the Guru, this is intuitivelyknown.
lines.transliteration: sacho dah d is pasri-aa gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings who have the Truth deep within, are never hidden, even if others try to hide them. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (850-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin andar sach hai say jan chh apeh na kisai d ay chh apaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, one finds the Lord, when the Lord blesses him with His Glance ofGrace.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay har paa-ee-ai jaa ka-o nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Human beings become angels, when the Lord blesses them with true devotionalworship.
lines.transliteration: maanas tay d ayvtay bh a-ay sachee bh agat jis day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਅਮਰਾ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Conquering egotism, they are blended with the Lord; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, they are purified.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar milaa-i-an gur kai sabad suchay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they remain merged with the Lord; they are blessed with the gloriousgreatness of the Naam. ||2|| pauVI ] (850-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay mil rahay naam vadi-aa-ee day-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਛਪਿਹ  ਨ ਿਕਸੈ ਦੇ ਛਪਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within the Guru, the True Guru, is the glorious greatness of the Name. The CreatorLord Himself has magnified it.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur vich naavai kee vadee vadi-aa-ee har kart ai aap vaDh aa-ee.

lines.english: All His servants and Sikhs live by gazing, gazing upon it. It is pleasing to their hearts deep within.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sikh sabh  vaykh  vaykh  jeevniH onHaa and ar hird ai bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderers and evil-doers cannot see this glorious greatness; they do notappreciate the goodness of others.
lines.transliteration: nindak d usat vadi-aa-ee vaykh  na sakan onHaa paraa-i-aa bh alaa na sukh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸ  ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ  ਭਏ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: What can be achieved by anyone babbling? The Guru is in love with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa hovai kis hee kee jhakh  maaree jaa sachay si-o ban  aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਚੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: ||4|| That which is pleasing to the Creator Lord, increases day by day, while all the peoplebabble uselessly. ||4|| slok mÚ 3 ] (850-19) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: je gal kartay bh aavai saa nit  nit charh ai savaa-ee sabh  jhakh jhakh marai lokaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dharig ayh aasaa d oojay bh aav kee jo mohi maa-i-aa chit  laa-ay. Cursed are the hopes in the love of duality; they tie the consciousness to love andattachment to Maya.
One who forsakes the peace of the Lord in exchange for straw, and forgets the Naam, suffers in pain. pMnw 851
lines.transliteration: har sukh palHar ti-aagi-aa naam visaar d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are blind. They are born, only to die again, and continue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: manmukh agi-aanee anDh ulay janam mareh fir aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Their affairs are not resolved, and in the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.
lines.transliteration: kaaraj siDh na hovnee ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਜ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Grace, meets the True Guru; he alone meditateson the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jis karam hovai tis sat gur milai so har har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the humble servants of the Lord find a lasting peace; servantNanak is a sacrifice to them. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (851-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam ratay jan sad aa sukh  paa-iniH jan naanak t in bal jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hope and desire entice the world; they entice the whole universe.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa jag mohnee jin mohi-aa sansaar.

lines.english: Everyone, and all that has been created, is under the domination of Death.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko jam kay cheeray vich hai jayt aa sabh  aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ ਜਿਗ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, Death seizes the mortal; he alone is saved,whom the Creator Lord forgives.
lines.transliteration: hukmee hee jam lagdaa so ubrai jis bakh sai kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਚੀਰੇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, this mortal swims across, if he abandons his ego.
lines.transliteration: naanak gur parsaadee ayhu man taaN tarai jaa chh odai ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਲਗਦਾ  ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੈ  ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Conquer hope and desire, and remain unattached; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2|| pauVI ] (851-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa maaray niraas ho-ay gur sabdee veechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ ਤਰੈ ਜਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I go in this world, I see the Lord there.
lines.transliteration: jithai jaa-ee-ai jagat meh t ithai har saa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਾਰੇ ਿਨਰਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the world hereafter as well, the Lord, the True Judge Himself, is pervading andpermeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: agai sabh aapay varatd aa har sachaa ni-aa-ee.

lines.english: The faces of the false are cursed, while the true devotees are blessed with gloriousgreatness.
lines.transliteration: koorhi-aaraa kay muh fitkee-ah sach bh agat vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: True is the Lord and Master, and true is His justice. The heads of the slanderers arecovered with ashes.
lines.transliteration: sach saahib sachaa ni-aa-o hai sir nindak chh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਿਨਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak worships the True Lord in adoration; as Gurmukh, he finds peace. ||5|| slok mÚ 3 ] (851-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sach araaDhi-aa gurmukh  sukh  paa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਿੜਆਰਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਿਫਟਕੀਅਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: By perfect destiny, one finds the True Guru, if the Lord God grants forgiveness.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sat gur paa-ee-ai jay har parabh  bakh as karay-i.

lines.english: Of all efforts, the best effort is to attain the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: opaavaa sir opaa-o hai naa-o paraapat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: It brings a cooling, soothing tranquility deep within the heart, and eternal peace.
lines.transliteration: andar seet al saaNt hai hird ai sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Then, one eats and wears the Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, through the Name, comes glorious greatness. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (851-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: amrit kh aanaa painHnaa naanak naa-ay vadi-aa-ee ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਹਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬਖਸ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, listening to the Guru's Teachings, you shall obtain the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: ay man gur kee sikh sun  paa-ihi gun ee niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਓਪਾਵਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਓਪਾਉ  ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Giver of peace shall dwell in your mind; you shall be rid of egotism and pride.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata tayrai man vasai ha-umai jaa-ay abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the treasure ofvirtue. ||2|| pauVI ] (851-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai amrit  gunee niDh aan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਖਾਣਾ  ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The kings, emperors, rulers, lords, nobles and chiefs, are all created by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jitnay paat isaah saah raajay kh aan umraav sikd aar heh t itnay sabh  har kay kee-ay.

lines.english: Whatever the Lord causes them to do, they do; they are all beggars, dependent on the Lord. so AYsw hir sBnw kw pRBu siqgur kY vil hY iqin siB vrn cwry KwxI sB isRsit goly kir siqgur
lines.transliteration: jo kichh har karaavai so o-ay karahi sabh  har kay arthee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਿਸਖ ਸੁਿਣ ਪਾਇਿਹ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Such is God, the Lord of all; He is on the True Guru's side. All castes and social classes, the four sources of creation, and the whole universe are slaves of the TrueGuru; God makes them work for Him. hir syvy kI AYsI vifAweI dyKhu hir sMqhu ij in ivchu kwieAw ngrI dusmn dUq siB mwir kFIey
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har sabhnaa kaa parabh  satgur kai val hai t in sabh  varan chaaray kh aanee sabh sarisat golay kar sat gur agai kaar kamaavan  ka-o d ee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: See the glorious greatness of serving the Lord, O Saints of the Lord; He has conquered and driven all the enemies and evil-doers out of the body-village.
lines.transliteration: har sayvay kee aisee vadi-aa-ee daykh hu har sant ahu jin vichahu kaa-i-aa nagree dusman d oot sabh  maar kadh ee-ay.

lines.english: ||6|| The Lord, Har, Har, is Merciful to His humble devotees; granting His Grace, the LordHimself protects and preserves them. ||6|| slok mÚ 3 ] (851-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: iblwvlu, mÚ 3) har har kirpaal ho-aa bhagat  janaa upar har aapn ee kirpaa kar har aap rakh  lee-ay.

lines.english: Fraud and hypocrisy within bring constant pain; the self-willed manmukh does not practice meditation.
lines.transliteration: andar kapat sad aa dukh hai manmukh  Dhi-aan na laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਉਮਰਾਵ  ਿਸਕਦਾਰ  ਹਿਹ ਿਤਤਨੇ  ਸਿਭ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: Suffering in pain, he does his deeds; he is immersed in pain, and he shall suffer in pain hereafter.
lines.transliteration: dukh vich kaar kamaavn ee dukh vartai dukh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਰਾਵੈ  ਸੁ ਓਇ ਕਰਿਹ ਸਿਭ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਅਰਥੀਏ  ॥
lines.english: By his karma, he meets the True Guru, and then, he is lovingly attuned to the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: karmee satgur bh aytee-ai t aa sach naam liv laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਵਿਲ ਹੈ ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਿਭ ਵਰਨ  ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਗੋਲੇ ਕਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਗੈ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣ  ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he is naturally at peace; doubt and fear run away and leave him. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (851-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay sukh ho-ay and rahu bh aram bh a-o bh aagai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰੀ  ਦੁਸਮਨ  ਦੂਤ ਸਿਭ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢੀਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is in love with the Lord forever. The Name of the Lord is pleasing to his mind. pMnw 852
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa har rang hai har kaa naa-o man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh beholds and speaks the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Naam, he finds peace.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vaykh an bolnaa naam japat  sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵੇਖਣੁ  ਬੋਲਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the spiritual wisdom of the Gurmukh shines forth; the black darkness ofignorance is dispelled. ||2|| mÚ 3 ] (852-2) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh gi-aan pargaasi-aa t imar agi-aan anDh ayr chukaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸਆ  ਿਤਮਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The filthy, foolish, self-willed manmukhs die.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mailay mareh gavaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nirmal har raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, listen, O Siblings of Destiny!
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak sun hu jan bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Serve the True Guru, and the filth of your ego shall be gone.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvihu ha-umai mal jaa-ee.

lines.english: Deep within, the pain of skepticism afflicts them; their heads are constantly assaultedby worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: andar sansaa d ookh vi-aapay sir Dh anDhaa nit  maar.

lines.english: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are attached to the love ofMaya.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay soot ay kabahu na jaageh maa-i-aa moh pi-aar.

lines.english: They do not remember the Name, and they do not contemplate the Word of theShabad; this is the view of the self-willed manmukhs.
lines.transliteration: naam na cheeteh sabad  na vichaareh ih manmukh  kaa beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਸੂਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਿਪਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: ||3|| They do not love the Lord's Name, and they lose their life uselessly. O Nanak, theMessenger of Death attacks them, and humiliates them. ||3|| pauVI ] (852-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: har naam na bhaa-i-aa birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa naanak jam maar karay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਹ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a true king, whom the Lord blesses with true devotion.
lines.transliteration: jis no har bhagat  sach bakh see-an so sachaa saahu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਮੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: People pledge their allegiance to him; no other store stocks this merchandise, nor deals in this trade.
lines.transliteration: tis kee muht aajee lok kadh -daa horat  hat na vath na vaysaahu.

lines.english: That humble devotee who turns his face towards the Guru and becomes sunmukh,receives the Lord's wealth; the faithless baymukh, who turns his face away from theGuru, gathers only ashes.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa ka-o sanmukh  hovai so har raas la-ay vaimukh  bhas paahu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਚੁ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's devotees are dealers in the Name of the Lord. The Messenger of Death,the tax-collector, does not even approach them.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kay vaapaaree har bhagat  heh jam jaagaat ee tinaa nayrh  na jaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ  ਲੋਕੁ ਕਢਦਾ  ਹੋਰਤੁ  ਹਿਟ ਨ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has loaded the wealth of the Name of the Lord, who is foreverindependent and care-free. ||7|| slok mÚ 3 ] (852-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har naam Dhan lad i-aa sad aa vayparvaahu. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਸ  ਲਏ ਵੇਮੁਖ  ਭਸੁ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: In this age, the devotee earns the wealth of the Lord; all the rest of the worldwanders deluded in doubt.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh bhagt ee har Dh an kh ati-aa hor sabh  jagat  bharam bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਹ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਿਤਨਾ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in his mind; night and day, he meditates on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee naam man vasi-aa an-din naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਿਦਆ  ਸਦਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: In the midst of corruption, he remains detached; through the Word of the Shabad, heburns away his ego.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa maahi ud aas hai ha-umai sabad  jalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He crosses over, and saves his relatives as well; blessed is the mother who gave birthto him.
lines.transliteration: aap tari-aa kul uDh ray Dh an jan aydee maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਭਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਆ  ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Peace and poise fill his mind forever, and he embraces love for the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sahj sukh  man vasi-aa sachay si-o liv laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva wander in the three qualities, while their egotism anddesire increase.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahaaday-o t arai gun  bhulay ha-umai moh vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਉਦਾਸ  ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and debate in confusion;their consciousness is centered on the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: pandit parh  parh monee bh ulay d oojai bh aa-ay chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰੇ  ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Yogis, wandering pilgrims and Sanyaasees are deluded; without the Guru, they donot find the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: jogee jangam sani-aasee bhulay vin  gur t at na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ  ਸੁਖੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The miserable self-willed manmukhs are forever deluded by doubt; they waste awaytheir lives uselessly.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d ukhee-ay sad aa bh aram bh ulay t inHee birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੁਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are balanced and poised; forgiving them, the Lord blends them with Himself. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (852-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say-ee jan samDh ay je aapay bakh as milaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਮੋਨੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise Him, who has control over everything.
lines.transliteration: naanak so salaahee-ai jis vas sabh kichh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੰਗਮ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਭੁਲੇ ਿਵਣੁ ਗੁ ਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Remember Him, O mortals - without Him, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tiseh sarayvhu paraan eeho t is bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦੁਖੀਏ  ਸਦਾ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੁਲੇ ਿਤਨੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells deep within those who are Gurmukh; forever and ever, they are at peace.||2|| pauVI ] (852-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar man vasai sad aa sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸਮਧੇ  ਿਜ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who do not become Gurmukh and earn the wealth of the Lord's Name, arebankrupt in this age.
lines.transliteration: jinee gurmukh har naam Dh an na kh ati-o say d ayvaalee-ay jug maahi.

lines.english: They wander around begging all over the world, but no one even spits in their faces.
lines.transliteration: o-ay mangday fireh sabh  jagat  meh ko-ee muhi thuk na t in ka-o paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਵਿਸ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They gossip about others, and lose their credit, and expose themselves as well.
lines.transliteration: paraa-ee bakheelee karahi aapn ee part eet khovan sagvaa bh ee aap lakh aahi.

lines.english: 3) jis Dhan kaaran  chuglee karahi so Dh an chuglee hath na aavai o-ay bh aavai t ithai jaahi. That wealth, for which they slander others, does not come into their hands, no matterwhere they go. pMnw 853 gurmuiK syvk Bwie hir Dnu imlY iqQhu krmhIx lY n skih hor QY dys idsMqir hir Dnu nwih

lines.punjabi: ਚੁਗਲੀ  ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਓਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਥੈ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through loving service, the Gurmukhs receive the wealth of the Naam, but the unfortunate ones cannot receive it. This wealth is not found anywhere else, in thiscountry or in any other. ||8|| slok mÚ 3 ] (853-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvak bh aa-ay har Dh an milai t ithhu karamheen  lai na sakahi hor thai d ays disantar har Dh an naahi. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਥਹੁ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ  ਲੈ ਨ ਸਕਿਹ  ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਦੇਸ ਿਦਸੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh does not have an iota of skepticism or doubt; worries depart fromwithin him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sansaa mool na hova-ee chint aa vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever he does, he does with grace and poise. Nothing else can be said about him.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh ho-ay so sehjay ho-ay kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੰਸਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਿਚੰਤਾ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself hears the speech of those whom He makes His own. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (853-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kaa aakh i-aa aap sun ay je la-i-an pannai paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He conquers death, and subdues the desires of his mind; the Immaculate Name abides deep within him.
lines.transliteration: kaal maar mansaa maneh samaanee ant ar nirmal naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਆਿਖਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਣੇ ਿਜ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps, and he intuitivelydrinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: an-din jaagai kad ay na sovai sehjay amrit  pi-aa-o.

lines.english: His speech is sweet, and his words are nectar; night and day, he sings the GloriousPraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: meethaa bolay amrit  banee an-d in har gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells in the home of his own self, and appears beautiful forever; meeting him,Nanak finds peace. ||2|| pauVI ] (853-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa sad aa sohd ay naanak t in mili-aa sukh  paa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਪਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord is a jewel, a gem; the Guru has caused the Lord to grant thatwealth of the Lord. jy iksY ikhu idis AwvY qw koeI ikhu mMig ley AkY koeI ikhu dyvwey eyhu hir Dnu joir kIqY iksY
lines.transliteration: har Dhan rat an javayharee so gur har Dh an har paashu d ayvaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਠਾ  ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan jor keet ai kisai naal na jaa-ay vandaa-i-aa. If someone sees something, he may ask for it; or, someone may cause it to be given to him. But no one can take a share of this wealth of the Lord by force. ijs no siqgur nwil hir srDw lwey iqsu hir Dn  kI vMf hiQ AwvY ijs no krqY Duir iliK pwieAw
lines.transliteration: jay kisai kihu dis aavai t aa ko-ee kihu mang la-ay akai ko-ee kihu d ayvaa-ay ayhu har

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਦੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhur likh  paa-i-aa. He alone obtains a share of the wealth of the Lord, who is blessed by the Creator with faith and devotion to the True Guru, according to his pre-ordained destiny. iesu hir Dn kw koeI srIku nwhI iksY kw Kqu nw hI iksY kY sIv bMnY rolu nwhI jy ko hir Dn kI
lines.transliteration: jis no satgur naal har sarDh aa laa-ay t is har Dh an kee vand hath aavai jis no kart ai

lines.english: No one is a share-holder in this wealth of the Lord, and no one owns any of it. It hasno boundaries or borders to be disputed. If anyone speaks ill of the wealth of theLord, his face will be blackened in the four directions.
lines.transliteration: is har Dhan kaa ko-ee sareek naahee kisai kaa kh at naahee kisai kai seev bannai rol naahee jay ko har Dhan kee bakh eelee karay t is kaa muhu har chahu kundaa vich kaalaa karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨ  ਜਵੇਹਰੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||9|| No one's power or slander can prevail against the gifts of the Lord; day by day theycontinually, continuously increase. ||9|| slok mÚ 3 ] (853-11) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 3) har kay dit ay naal kisai jor bakh eelee na chal-ee d ihu dihu nit  nit charh ai savaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਕਸੈ ਿਕਹੁ ਿਦਿਸ  ਆਵੈ  ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਿਕਹੁ ਮੰਿਗ ਲਏ ਅਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਿਕਹੁ ਦੇਵਾਏ  ਏਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਿਰ ਕੀਤੈ  ਿਕਸੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਵੰਡਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The world is going up in flames - shower it with Your Mercy, and save it!
lines.transliteration: jagat jaland aa rakh  lai aapn ee kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਏ ਿਤਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੰਡ ਹਿਥ ਆਵੈ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤੈ  ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Save it, and deliver it, by whatever method it takes.
lines.transliteration: jit du-aarai ubrai t itai laihu ubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਸੈ ਕਾ ਖਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਸੈ ਕੈ ਸੀਵ ਬੰਨੈ ਰੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ  ਕਰੇ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਾਲਾ  ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has shown the way to peace, contemplating the True Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur sukh  vaykh aali-aa sachaa sabad  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਿਦਤੇ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਕਸੈ ਜੋਰੁ ਬਖੀਲੀ  ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਿਦਹੁ ਿਦਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Nanak knows no other than the Lord, the Forgiving Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (853-13) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak avar na sujh-ee har bin bakh sanhaar. ||1||

lines.english: Through egotism, fascination with Maya has trapped them in duality.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa mohnee d oojai lagai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ  ਜਲੰਦਾ  ਰਿਖ ਲੈ ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: It cannot be killed, it does not die, and it cannot be sold in a store.
lines.transliteration: naa ih maaree na marai naa ih hat vikaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is burnt away, and then it departs fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad parjaalee-ai t aa ih vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਵੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The body and mind become pure, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes todwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: tan man hovai ujlaa naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Shabad is the killer of Maya; the Gurmukh obtains it. ||2|| pauVI ] (853-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak maa-i-aa kaa maaran sabad  hai gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The glorious greatness of the True Guru was bestowed by the True Guru; Heunderstood this as the Insignia, the Mark of the Primal Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee vadi-aa-ee sat gur ditee Dh arahu hukam bujh  neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: 3) putee bh aatee-ee jaavaa-ee sakee agahu pichh ahu tol dith aa laahi-on sabh naa kaa abhimaan. He tested His sons, nephews, sons-in-law and relatives, and subdued the egotistical pride of them all.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਇਹ ਮਾਰੀ  ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਇਹ ਹਿਟ ਿਵਕਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever anyone looks, my True Guru is there; the Lord blessed Him with the wholeworld.
lines.transliteration: jithai ko vaykhai t ithai mayraa sat guroo har bakh si-os sabh  jahaan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ  ਤਾ ਇਹ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who meets with, and believes in the True Guru, is embellished here and hereafter. Whoever turns his back on the Guru and becomes baymukh, shall wanderin cursed and evil places. pMnw 854
lines.transliteration: mÚ 3) je satgur no mil mannay so halat  palat  sijhai je vaimukh  hovai so firai bh arisat thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੈ ਵਿਲ  ਹੋਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is on the side of servant Nanak. The All-powerful and All-knowing Lord God is my Best Friend. paudI iBiq dyiK kY siB Awie pey siqgur kI pYrI lwihEnu sBnw ikAhu mnhu gumwnu ]10] (854- 1, iblwvlu, mÚ 3) pa-udee bh it daykh kai sabh  aa-ay pa-ay sat gur kee pairee laahi-on sabh naa ki-ahu manhu gumaan. ||10|| Seeing the food being distributed, everyone came and fell at the feet of the TrueGuru, who cleansed the minds of all of their egotistical pride. ||10|| slok mÚ 1 ] (854-2) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kai val ho-aa mayraa su-aamee har sajan purakh  sujaan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਦੀ  ਿਭਿਤ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਸਿਭ ਆਇ  ਪਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਲਾਿਹਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਕਅਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: One plants the seed, another harvests the crop, and still another beats the grain from the chaff.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee vaahay ko lunai ko paa-ay kh alihaan.

lines.english: O Nanak, it is not known, who will ultimately eat the grain. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (854-3) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayv na jaap-ee ko-ee khaa-ay nid aan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਵਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਖਿਲਹਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is carried across, within whose mind the Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: jis man vasi-aa tari-aa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ  ਕੋਈ ਖਾਇ  ਿਨਦਾਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that alone happens, which is pleasing to His Will. ||2|| pauVI ] (854-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo bhaavai so ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Merciful Supreme Lord God has carried me across the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm da-i-aal saagar t aari-aa.

lines.english: The compassionate perfect Guru has eradicated my doubts and fears.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai miharvaan bharam bh a-o maari-aa.

lines.english: Unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger, the horrible demons, have beentotally destroyed.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh bikraal d oot sabh  haari-aa.

lines.english: I have enshrined the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam within my throat and heart.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam niDh aan kanth  ur Dh aari-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my birth and death have been adorned and redeemed. ||11|| slok mÚ 3 ] (854-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDhoo sang janam maran  savaari-aa. ||11||

lines.english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are said to be false.
lines.transliteration: jinHee naam visaari-aa koorhay kahan  kahaNniH.

lines.english: The five thieves plunder their homes, and egotism breaks in.
lines.transliteration: panch chor tinaa gh ar muhniH ha-umai and ar saNniH.

lines.english: The faithless cynics are defrauded by their own evil-mindedness; they do not knowthe sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saakat muth ay durmat ee har ras na jaan aNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Those who lose the Ambrosial Nectar through doubt, remain engrossed and entangledin corruption.
lines.transliteration: jinHee amrit bh aram lutaa-i-aa bikh  si-o racheh rachaNniH.

lines.english: They make friends with the wicked, and argue with the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dustaa sayt ee pirharh ee jan si-o vaad  karaNniH.

lines.english: O Nanak, the faithless cynics are bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death, andsuffer agony in hell.
lines.transliteration: naanak saakat narak meh jam baDh ay dukh sahaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਿਤਨਾ  ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਿਨ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: They act according to the karma of the actions they committed before; as the Lord keeps them, so do they live. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (854-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pa-i-ai kirat kamaavd ay jiv raakh ahi tivai rahaNniH. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੁਠੇ ਦੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru, are transformed from powerless into powerful.
lines.transliteration: jinHee satgur sayvi-aa t aan nitaanay tis.

lines.english: With every breath and morsel of food, the Lord abides in their minds forever, and theMessenger of Death cannot even see them.
lines.transliteration: saas giraas sadaa man vasai jam johi na sakai t is.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, fills their hearts, and Maya is their servant.
lines.transliteration: hirdai har har naam ras kavlaa sayvak t is.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰਕ  ਮਿਹ ਜਿਮ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: One who becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves, obtains the greatest treasure.
lines.transliteration: har daasaa kaa d aas ho-ay param pad aarath t is.

lines.english: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to that one, within whose mind and body Goddwells.
lines.transliteration: naanak man tan jis parabh  vasai ha-o sad  kurbaan ai tis.

lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, he alone is in love with the humble Saints.||2|| pauVI ] (854-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jinH ka-o poorab likhi-aa ras sant  janaa si-o t is. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever the Perfect True Guru says, the Transcendent Lord hears.
lines.transliteration: jo bolay pooraa satguroo so parmaysar sun i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਿਤਸੁ ॥
lines.english: It pervades and permeates the whole world, and it is on the mouth of each and every being.
lines.transliteration: so-ee varti-aa jagat  meh gh at ghat mukh  bhani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ  ਸੇਵਿਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ॥
lines.english: So numerous are the great glories of the Lord, they cannot even be counted.
lines.transliteration: bahut vad i-aa-ee-aa saahibai nah jaahee gan ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਾ  ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਿਤਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Truth, poise and bliss rest in the True Guru; the Guru bestows the jewel of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach sahj anad sat guroo paas sachee gur man ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God embellishes the Saints, who become like the TrueLord. ||12|| slok mÚ 3 ] (854-15) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sant savaaray paarbarahm sachay ji-o ban i-aa. ||12||

lines.english: He does not understand himself; he believes the Lord God to be far away.
lines.transliteration: apnaa aap na pachh aan-ee har parabh  jaataa door.

lines.english: He forgets to serve the Guru; how can his mind remain in the Lord's Presence?
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa visree ki-o man rahai hajoor.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਬੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੋ ਪਰਮੇਸਿਰ  ਸੁਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wastes away his life in worthless greed and falsehood.
lines.transliteration: manmukh janam gavaa-i-aa jh oothai laalach koor.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਿਤਆ  ਜਗਤ  ਮਿਹ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਮੁਿਖ ਭਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord forgives, and blends them with Himself; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is ever-present. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (854-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhas milaa-i-an sachai sabad  hadoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਸਾਿਹਬੈ  ਨਹ ਜਾਹੀ  ਗਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: True is the Praise of the Lord God; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: har parabh sachaa sohilaa gurmukh  naam govind .

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਅਨਦੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਿਸ  ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Praising the Naam night and day, and meditating on the Lord, the mind becomesblissful.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam salaahn aa har japi-aa man aanand .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਸਚੇ ਿਜਉ ਬਿਣਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the Lord, the perfect embodiment of supremebliss.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har paa-i-aa pooran parmaanand .

lines.english: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; his mind and body shall never again be shattered.||2|| pMnw 855 pauVI ] (855-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam sahaali-aa bahurh na man t an bh ang. ||2||

lines.english: If someone slanders the True Guru, and then comes seeking the Guru's Protection,
lines.transliteration: ko-ee nindak hovai sat guroo kaa fir saran  gur aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਾ ਿਫਿਰ ਸਰਿਣ  ਗੁਰ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Congregation. ijau mIih vuTY glIAw nwilAw toiBAw kw jlu jw ie pvY ivic sursrI sursrI imlq pivqRü pwvnu
lines.transliteration: pichhlay gunah sat gur bakh as la-ay sat sangat  naal ralaavai. the True Guru forgives him for his past sins, and unites him with the Saints'

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਛਲੇ  ਗੁਨਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਰਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: When the rain falls, the water in the streams, rivers and ponds flows into the Ganges; flowing into the Ganges, it is made sacred and pure.
lines.transliteration: ji-o meehi vuthai galee-aa naali-aa tobh i-aa kaa jal jaa-ay pavai vich sursaree sursaree milat pavit ar paavan ho-ay jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਮੀਿਹ  ਵੁਠੈ ਗਲੀਆ  ਨਾਿਲਆ  ਟੋਿਭਆ  ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ  ਪਵੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ  ਿਮਲਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ੁ  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Such is the glorious greatness of the True Guru, who has no vengeance; meeting with Him, thirst and hunger are quenched, and instantly, one attains celestial peace. nwnk iehu Acrju dyKhu myry hir scy swh kw ij siqgurU no mMnY su sBnW BwvY ]13]1] suDu ] (855-4, iblwvlu, mÚ 3) naanak ih achraj daykh hu mayray har sachay saah kaa je sat guroo no mannai so sabhnaaN bhaavai. ||13||1|| suDh . O Nanak, behold this wonder of the Lord, my True King! Everyone is pleased with one who obeys and believes in the True Guru. ||13||1|| Sudh|| iblwvlu bwxI Bgqw kI ] (855-6) bilaaval banee bh agtaa kee. Bilaaval, The Word Of The Devotees. kbIr jIau kI  (855-6) kabeer jee-o kee Of Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: iblwvlu, mÚ 3) ayh vadi-aa-ee satgur nirvair vich jit  mili-ai t isnaa bh ukh utrai har saaNt tarh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਿਤਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਉਤਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ  ਤੜ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified By Guru'sGrace:
lines.transliteration: ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  gur parsaad .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨੋ ਮੰਨੈ ਸੁ ਸਭਨ  ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੩॥੧॥
lines.english: This world is a drama; no one can remain here.
lines.transliteration: aiso ih sansaar paykhnaa rahan na ko-oo pa-eehai ray.

lines.english: Walk the straight path; otherwise, you will be pushed around. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sooDhay sooDh ay rayg chalhu t um nat ar kuDh kaa d iva-eehai ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The children, the young and the old, O Siblings of Destiny, will be taken away by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: baaray boodhay t arunay bh a-ee-aa sabh hoo jam lai ja-eehai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has made the poor man a mouse, and the cat of Death is eating him up.||1||
lines.transliteration: maanas bapuraa moosaa keeno meech bila-ee-aa kha-eehai ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਪੇਖਨਾ  ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਈਹੈ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Dhanvant aa ar nirDh an man-ee t aa kee kachh oo na kaanee ray. It gives no special consideration to either the rich or the poor.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਧੇ ਸੂਧੇ ਰੇਿਗ ਚਲਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਨਤਰ  ਕੁਧਕਾ  ਿਦਵਈਹੈ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The king and his subjects are equally killed; such is the power of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raajaa parjaa sam kar maarai aiso kaal badaanee ray. ||2||

lines.english: Those who are pleasing to the Lord are the servants of the Lord; their story is uniqueand singular.
lines.transliteration: har kay sayvak jo har bhaa-ay t inH kee kathaa niraaree ray.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰੇ ਬੂਢੇ ਤਰੁਨੇ ਭਈਆ  ਸਭਹੂ ਜਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਈਹੈ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They do not come and go, and they never die; they remain with the Supreme LordGod. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aavahi na jaahi na kabhoo martay paarbarahm sangaaree ray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸੁ  ਬਪੁਰਾ  ਮੂਸਾ ਕੀਨੋ  ਮੀਚੁ ਿਬਲਈਆ  ਖਈਹੈ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Know this in your soul, that by renouncing your children, spouse, wealth and property
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar lachh imee maa-i-aa ihai t ajahu jee-a jaanee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ  ਅਰੁ ਿਨਰਧਨ  ਮਨਈ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਾਨੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: ||4||1|| iblwvlu ] (855-12) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu milihai saarigpaanee ray. ||4||1|| - says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - you shall be united with the Lord of the Universe.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਪਰਜਾ  ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਰੈ ਐਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ  ਬਡਾਨੀ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I do not read books of knowledge, and I do not understand the debates.
lines.transliteration: bidi-aa na para-o baad  nahee jaan-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਏ ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਿਨਰਾਰੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I have gone insane, chanting and hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har gun kathat sunat  ba-uraano. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਰਤੇ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੰਗਾਰੀ  ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my father, I have gone insane; the whole world is sane, and I am insane.
lines.transliteration: mayray baabaa mai ba-uraa sabh kh alak sai-aanee mai ba-uraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਲਿਛਮੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਇਹੈ ਤਜਹੁ ਜੀਅ  ਜਾਨੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I am spoiled; let no one else be spoiled like me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai bigri-o bigrai mat a-uraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਮਿਲਹੈ  ਸਾਿਰਗਪਾਨੀ  ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I have not made myself go insane - the Lord made me go insane.
lines.transliteration: aap na ba-uraa raam kee-o ba-uraa.

lines.english: The True Guru has burnt away my doubt. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur jaar ga-i-o bh aram moraa. ||2||

lines.english: I am spoiled; I have lost my intellect.
lines.transliteration: mai bigray apnee mat kh o-ee.

lines.english: Let no one go astray in doubt like me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mayray bharam bh oola-o mat  ko-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ  ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ  ਸਭ ਖਲਕ  ਸੈਆਨੀ  ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is insane, who does not understand himself.
lines.transliteration: so ba-uraa jo aap na pachhaanai.

lines.english: When he understands himself, then he knows the One Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaanai t a aykai jaanai. ||4||

lines.english: One who is not intoxicated with the Lord now, shall never be intoxicated.
lines.transliteration: abeh na maataa so kabahu na maat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਬਉਰਾ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀਓ  ਬਉਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love. ||5||2|| iblwvlu ] (855-17) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raamai rang raataa. ||5||2||

lines.english: Abandoning his household, he may go to the forest, and live by eating roots;
lines.transliteration: garihu taj ban kh and jaa-ee-ai chun kh aa-ee-ai kand aa.
ajahu bikaar na chhod-ee paapee man mand aa. ||1|| but even so, his sinful, evil mind does not renounce corruption. ||1||

lines.english: How can anyone be saved? How can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?
lines.transliteration: ki-o chhoota-o kaisay t ara-o bh avjal niDh  bhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਬਉਰਾ  ਜੋ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Save me, save me, O my Lord! Your humble servant seeks Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raakh raakh  mayray beeth ulaa jan saran t umHaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I cannot escape my desire for sin and corruption.
lines.transliteration: bikhai bikh ai kee baasnaa t ajee-a nah jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬਿਹ  ਨ ਮਾਤਾ  ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I make all sorts of efforts to hold back from this desire, but it clings to me, again and again. ||2|| pMnw 856
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar raakh ee-ai fir fir laptaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Youth and old age - my entire life has passed, but I haven't done any good.
lines.transliteration: jaraa jeevan joban ga-i-aa kichh kee-aa na neekaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਰਾ ਜੀਵਨ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਗਇਆ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਨ ਨੀਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: This priceless soul has been treated as if if were worth no more than a shell. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih jee-araa nirmolko ka-udee lag meekaa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, O my Lord, You are contained in all.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer mayray maaDhvaa t oo sarab bi-aapee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਵਾ  ਤੂ ਸਰਬ  ਿਬਆਪੀ  ॥
lines.english: There is none as merciful as You are, and none as sinful as I am. ||4||3|| iblwvlu ] (856-3) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: tum samsar naahee d a-i-aal mohi samsar paapee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਨਾਹੀ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਪਾਪੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Every day, he rises early, and brings a fresh clay pot; he passes his life embellishing and glazing it.
lines.transliteration: nit uth  koree gaagar aanai leepat  jee-o ga-i-o.

lines.english: He does not think at all of worldly weaving; he is absorbed in the subtle essence ofthe Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taanaa baanaa kachh oo na soojh ai har har ras lapti-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ ਉਿਠ ਕੋਰੀ ਗਾਗਿਰ  ਆਨੈ  ਲੀਪਤ  ਜੀਉ ਗਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Who in our family has ever chanted the Name of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: hamaaray kul ka-unay raam kahi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਨਾ  ਬਾਨਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਲਪਿਟਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Ever since this worthless son of mine began chanting with his mala, we have had nopeace at all! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab kee maalaa la-ee nipootay t ab tay sukh  na bh a-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Listen, O my sisters-in-law, a wondrous thing has happened!
lines.transliteration: sunhu jithaanee sunhu d iraanee achraj ayk bh a-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ  ਲਈ ਿਨਪੂਤੇ  ਤਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This boy has ruined our weaving business. Why didn't he simply die? ||2||
lines.transliteration: saat soot  in mudeeNay kh o-ay ih mudee-aa ki-o na mu-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: O mother, the One Lord, the Lord and Master, is the source of all peace. The Guru has blessed me with His Name.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa kaa ayk har su-aamee so gur naam da-i-o.

lines.english: He preserved the honor of Prahlaad, and destroyed Harnaakhash with his nails. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant parahlaad  kee paij jin raakh ee harnaakh as nakh  bidri-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਇਿਨ  ਮੁਡੀਂਏ  ਖੋਏ ਇਹੁ ਮੁਡੀਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਨ ਮੁਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have renounced the gods and ancestors of my house, for the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: ghar kay d ayv pit ar kee chh odee gur ko sabad  la-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੋ ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, God is the Destroyer of all sins; He is the Saving Grace of His Saints. ||4||4|| iblwvlu ] (856-9) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sagal paap kh andan sant eh lai uDh aari-o. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦ  ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਾਖੀ  ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ  ਨਖ ਿਬਦਿਰਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: There is no king equal to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ko-oo har samaan nahee raajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਿਪਤਰ  ਕੀ ਛੋਡੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਲਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: All these lords of the world last for only a few days, putting on their false displays.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ay bhoopat  sabh  divas chaar kay jh oothay karat  divaajaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਗਲ  ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੰਤਹ  ਲੈ ਉਧਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: How can Your humble servant waver? You spread Your shadow over the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: tayro jan ho-ay so-ay kat  dolai t een bh avan par chh aajaa.

lines.english: Who can raise his hand against Your humble servant? No one can describe the Lord'sexpanse. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath pasaar sakai ko jan ka-o bol sakai na andaajaa. ||1||

lines.english: Remember Him, O my thoughtless and foolish mind, and the unstruck melody of thesound current will resonate and resound.
lines.transliteration: chayt achayt  moorh  man mayray baajay anhad  baajaa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, my skepticism and doubt have been dispelled; the Lord has exalted me,as He did Dhroo and Prahlaad. ||2||5|| iblwvlu ] (856-12) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer sansaa bharam chooko Dh aroo par-hilaad  nivaajaa. ||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਭੂਪਿਤ ਸਭ ਿਦਵਸ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤ  ਿਦਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Save me! I have disobeyed You.
lines.transliteration: raakh layho ham t ay bigree.

lines.english: I have not practiced humility, righteousness or devotional worship; I am proud and egotistical, and I have taken a crooked path. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: seel Dharam jap bh agat na keenee ha-o abh imaan taydh  pagree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਇ ਕਤ ਡੋਲੈ ਤੀਿਨ  ਭਵਨ  ਪਰ ਛਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Believing this body to be immortal, I pampered it, but it is a fragile and perishablevessel.
lines.transliteration: amar jaan sanchee ih kaa-i-aa ih mithi-aa kaachee gagree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਿਰ  ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਬੋਿਲ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਅੰਦਾਜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Lord who formed, fashioned and embellished me, I have becomeattached to another. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jineh nivaaj saaj ham kee-ay tiseh bisaar avar lagree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਅਚੇਤ  ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ  ਬਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am Your thief; I cannot be called holy. I have fallen at Your feet, seeking YourSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: sanDhik t ohi saaDh  nahee kahee-a-o saran paray t umree pagree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਸਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਚੂਕੋ ਧਰ੍ੂ ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦ  ਿਨਵਾਜਾ  ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, please listen to this prayer of mine, O Lord; please do not send mesommons of the Messenger of Death. ||2||6|| iblwvlu ] (856-16) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ih bintee sunee-ahu mat  ghaalhu jam kee kh abree. ||2||6||

lines.english: I stand humbly at Your Court.
lines.transliteration: darmaad ay thaadhay darbaar.

lines.english: Who else can take care of me, other than You? Please open Your door, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin surat  karai ko mayree d arsan d eejai kh oliH kivaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਲੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਜਪੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਉ ਅਿਭਮਾਨ  ਟੇਢ ਪਗਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the richest of the rich, generous and unattached. With my ears, I listen toYour Praises.
lines.transliteration: tum Dh an Dh anee ud aar ti-aagee saravnanH sunee-at  sujas t umHaar.

lines.english: From whom should I beg? I see that all are beggars. My salvation comes only fromYou. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maaga-o kaahi rank sabh d aykh-a-u t umH hee t ay mayro nist aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰ  ਜਾਿਨ  ਸੰਚੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਇਆ  ਇਹ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਕਾਚੀ  ਗਗਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You blessed Jai Dayv, Naam Dayv and Sudaamaa the Brahmin with Your infinitemercy.
lines.transliteration: jaiday-o naamaa bip sud aamaa t in ka-o kirpaa bh a-ee hai apaar.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, You are the All-powerful Lord, the Great Giver; in an instant, You bestowthe four great blessings. ||2||7|| iblwvlu ] (856-19) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer tum samrath d aatay chaar pad aarath d ayt na baar. ||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਧਕ  ਤੋਿਹ ਸਾਧ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਪਗਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He has a walking stick, ear-rings, a patched coat and a begging bowl.
lines.transliteration: dandaa mundraa kh inthaa aaDh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਇਹ ਿਬਨਤੀ  ਸੁਨੀਅਹੁ ਮਤ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਖਬਰੀ  ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: Wearing the robes of a beggar, he wanders around, deluded by doubt. ||1|| pMnw 857
lines.transliteration: bharam kai bh aa-ay bh avai bh aykh-Dhaaree. ||1||

lines.english: Abandon your Yogic postures and breath control exercises, O madman.
lines.transliteration: aasan pavan door kar bavray.

lines.english: Renounce fraud and deception, and meditate continuously on the Lord, O madman. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhod kapat nit  har bh aj bavray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That which you beg for, has been enjoyed in the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: jih too jaacheh so t aribhavan bh ogee.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Lord is the only Yogi in the world. ||2||8|| iblwvlu ] (857-2) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer kaysou jag jogee. ||2||8||

lines.english: This Maya has made me forget Your feet, O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ayniH maa-i-aa jagdees gusaa-ee t umHray charan bisaaray.
