lines.english: Not even a bit of love wells up in Your humble servant; what can Your poor servantdo? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kichant pareet  na upjai jan ka-o jan kahaa karahi baychaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dharig t an Dh arig Dh an Dh arig ih maa-i-aa Dh arig Dh arig mat  buDh  fannee. Cursed is the body, cursed is the wealth, and cursed is this Maya; cursed, cursed isthe clever intellect and understanding.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਚਰਨ  ਿਬਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Restrain and hold back this Maya; overcome it, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: is maa-i-aa ka-o darirh  kar raakh o baaNDhay aap bachannee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕੰਚਤ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੇਚਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What good is farming, and what good is trading? Worldly entanglements and pride arefalse.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa khayt ee ki-aa layvaa d ay-ee parpanch jh ooth gumaanaa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, in the end, they are ruined; ultimately, Death will come for them.||2||9|| iblwvlu ] (857-6) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer tay ant  bigoot ay aa-i-aa kaal nid aanaa. ||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਤਨੁ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਧਨੁ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਮਿਤ ਬੁਿਧ ਫੰਨੀ ॥
lines.english: Within the pool of the body, there is an incomparably beautiful lotus flower.
lines.transliteration: sareer sarovar bheet ray aachh ai kamal anoop.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਉ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਧੇ ਆਪ  ਬਚੰਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within it, is the Supreme Light, the Supreme Soul, who has no feature or form. ||1||
lines.transliteration: param jot purkh otamo jaa kai raykh  na roop. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਖੇਤੀ ਿਕਆ  ਲੇਵਾ  ਦੇਈ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the Lord, and forsake your doubt. The Lord is theLife of the World. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ray man har bhaj bh aram t ajahu jagjeevan raam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਤੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਿਬਗੂਤੇ  ਆਇਆ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਨਦਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥੯॥
lines.english: Nothing is seen coming into the world, and nothing is seen leaving it.
lines.transliteration: aavat kachh oo na d ees-ee nah d eesai jaat .

lines.english: Where the body is born, there it dies, like the leaves of the water-lily. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jah upjai binsai tahee jaisay purivan paat . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰੀਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ  ਭੀਤਰੇ  ਆਛੈ  ਕਮਲ  ਅਨੂਪ ॥
lines.english: Maya is false and transitory; forsaking it, one obtains peaceful, celestial contemplation.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa kar maa-i-aa tajee sukh  sahj beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਜੋਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੋ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, serve Him within your mind; He is the Enemy of ego, the Destroyer ofdemons. ||3||10|| iblwvlu ] (857-10) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer sayvaa karahu man manjh muraar. ||3||10||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The illusion of birth and death is gone; I lovingly focus on the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa bharam ga-i-aa gobid  liv laagee.

lines.english: In my life, I am absorbed in deep silent meditation; the Guru's Teachings haveawakened me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeevat sunn samaani-aa gur saakh ee jaagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ  ਨਹ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਾਤ  ॥
lines.english: The sound made from bronze, that sound goes into the bronze again.
lines.transliteration: kaasee tay Dh un oopjai Dh un kaasee jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਉਪਜੈ  ਿਬਨਸੈ ਤਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਪੁਿਰਵਨ  ਪਾਤ ॥੨॥
lines.english: But when the bronze is broken, O Pandit, O religious scholar, where does the soundgo then? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaasee footee panditaa Dh un kahaaN samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਇਆ  ਤਜੀ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I gaze upon the world, the confluence of the three qualities; God is awake and awarein each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: tarikutee sanDh  mai paykh i-aa gh at hoo gh at jaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਿਝ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Such is the understanding revealed to me; within my heart, I have become a detached renunciate. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aisee buDh samaacharee gh at maahi t i-aagee. ||2||

lines.english: I have come to know my own self, and my light has merged in the Light.
lines.transliteration: aap aap tay jaani-aa t ayj tayj samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਕਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਗਇਆ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, now I know the Lord of the Universe, and my mind is satisfied. ||3||11|| iblwvlu ] (857-14) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ab jaani-aa gobid man maanaa. ||3||11||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਸੁੰਿਨ ਸਮਾਿਨਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ  ਜਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When Your Lotus Feet dwell within one's heart, why should that person waver, ODivine Lord?
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jaa kai ridai baseh so jan ki-o dolai d ayv.

lines.english: I know that all comforts, and the nine treasures, come to one who intuitively,naturally, chants the Praise of the Divine Lord. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maanou sabh sukh  na-o niDh  taa kai sahj sahj jas bolai d ayv. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਸੀ  ਤੇ ਧੁਿਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਧੁਿਨ ਕਾਸੀ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Such wisdom comes, only when one sees the Lord in all, and unties the knot ofhypocrisy.
lines.transliteration: tab ih mat  ja-o sabh  meh paykh ai kutil gaaNth jab kh olai d ayv.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਸੀ ਫੂਟੀ ਪੰਿਡਤਾ  ਧੁਿਨ ਕਹ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Time and time again, he must hold himself back from Maya; let him take the scale ofthe Lord, and weigh his mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baaraN baar maa-i-aa tay atkai lai narjaa man t olai d ayv. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਕੁਟੀ  ਸੰਿਧ ਮੈ ਪੇਿਖਆ  ਘਟ ਹੂ ਘਟ ਜਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Then wherever he goes, he will find peace, and Maya will not shake him.
lines.transliteration: jah uho jaa-ay tahee sukh  paavai maa-i-aa t aas na jh olai d ayv.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, my mind believes in the Lord; I am absorbed in the Love of the Divine Lord. ||2||12|| iblwvlu bwxI Bgq nwmdyv jI kI  (857-19) bilaaval banee bh agat naamd ayv jee kee Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (857-19) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer mayraa man maani-aa raam pareet kee-o lai d ayv. ||2||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਆਪ  ਤੇ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has made my life fruitful. pMnw 858
lines.transliteration: safal janam mo ka-o gur keenaa.

lines.english: My pain is forgotten, and I have found peace deep within myself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dukh bisaar sukh  antar leenaa. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru has blessed me with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan mo ka-o gur deenaa.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, life is mindless. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin jeevan man heenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance, Naam Dayv has come to know the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naamday-ay simran kar jaanaaN.

lines.english: His soul is blended with the Lord, the Life of the World. ||2||1|| iblwvlu bwxI rivdws Bgq kI  (858-3) bilaaval banee ravid aas bh agat kee Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (858-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan si-o jee-o samaanaaN. ||2||1||

lines.english: Seeing my poverty, everyone laughed. Such was my condition.
lines.transliteration: daarid  daykh sabh  ko hasai aisee d asaa hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਭਗਤ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Now, I hold the eighteen miraculous spiritual powers in the palm of my hand; everything is by Your Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asat dasaa siDh  kar talai sabh  kirpaa t umaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਿਰਦੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ਐਸੀ  ਦਸਾ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You know, and I am nothing, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: too jaanat  mai kichh  nahee bh av kh andan raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਟ  ਦਸਾ ਿਸਿਧ  ਕਰ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All beings seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Fu lfiller, Resolver of our affairs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal jee-a sarnaagatee parabh  pooran kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤ  ਮੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Whoever enters Your Sanctuary, is relieved of his burden of sin.
lines.transliteration: jo tayree sarnaagat aa tin naahee bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜੀਅ  ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have saved the high and the low from the shameless world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ooch neech tum t ay taray aalaj sansaar. ||2||

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, what more can be said about the Unspoken Speech?
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas akath kathaa baho kaa-ay kareejai.

lines.english: Whatever You are, You are, O Lord; how can anything compare with Your Praises? ||3||1|| iblwvlu ] (858-7) bilaaval. Bilaaval:
lines.transliteration: jaisaa too t aisaa t uhee ki-aa upmaa d eejai. ||3||1||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤਰੇ ਆਲਜੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: That family, into which a holy person is born,
lines.transliteration: jih kul saaDh baisnou ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਕਾਇ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jI) baran abran rank nahee eesur bimal baas jaanee-ai jag so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. whether of high or low social class, whether rich or poor, shall have its pure fragrancespread all over the world. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਤੈਸਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਿਕਆ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.english: Whether he is a Brahmin, a Vaishya, a Soodra, or a Kh'shaatriya; whether he is apoet, an outcaste, or a filthy-minded person,
lines.transliteration: barahman bais sood ar kh a-ytaree dom chandaar malaychh  man so-ay.
ho-ay puneet bh agvant  bhajan t ay aap t aar taaray kul d o-ay. ||1|| he becomes pure, by meditating on the Lord God. He saves himself, and the families of both his parents. ||1||

lines.english: Dhan so gaa-o Dh an so th aa-o Dh an puneet  kutamb sabh  lo-ay. Blessed is that village, and blessed is the place of his birth; blessed is his pure family, throughout all the worlds.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਨ  ਅਬਰਨ  ਰੰਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਈਸੁਰੁ ਿਬਮਲ  ਬਾਸੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ  ਜਿਗ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who drinks in the sublime essence abandons other tastes; intoxicated with this divine essence, he discards sin and corruption. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jI) jin pee-aa saar ras tajay aan ras ho-ay ras magan daaray bikh  kho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Among the religious scholars, warriors and kings, there is no other equal to the Lord's devotee.
lines.transliteration: pandit soor chh atarpat raajaa bh agat baraabar a-or na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਨ  ਬੈਸ ਸੂਦ ਅਰੁ ਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਤਰ੍ੀ ਡੋਮ ਚੰਡਾਰ  ਮਲੇਛ  ਮਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: As the leaves of the water lily float free in the water, says Ravi Daas, so is their life inthe world. ||3||2|| bwxI sDny kI rwgu iblwvlu  (858-13) banee saDh nay kee raag bilaaval The Word Of Sadhana, Raag Bilaaval: <> siqgur pRswid ] (858-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jaisay purain paat rahai jal sameep bh an ravid aas janmay jag o-ay. ||3||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਭਜਨ  ਤੇ ਆਪੁ  ਤਾਿਰ  ਤਾਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: For a king's daughter, a man disguised himself as Vishnu.
lines.transliteration: nrip kanniaa kay kaarnai ik bha-i-aa bh aykh-Dhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਸੁ ਗਾਉ  ਧੰਿਨ ਸੋ ਠਾਉ  ਧੰਿਨ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He did it for sexual exploitation, and for selfish motives, but the Lord protected hishonor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaamaarathee su-aarthee vaa kee paij savaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੀਆ  ਸਾਰ ਰਸੁ ਤਜੇ ਆਨ  ਰਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਮਗਨ  ਡਾਰੇ ਿਬਖੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: What is Your value, O Guru of the world, if You will not erase the karma of my pastactions?
lines.transliteration: tav gun kahaa jagat  guraa ja-o karam na naasai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਸੂਰ ਛਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਭਗਤ  ਬਰਾਬਿਰ  ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Why seek safety from a lion, if one is to be eaten by a jackal? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: singh saran kat  jaa-ee-ai ja-o jaNbuk garaasai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੁਰੈਨ ਪਾਤ ਰਹੈ ਜਲ ਸਮੀਪ  ਭਿਨ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜਨਮੇ  ਜਿਗ  ਓਇ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: For the sake of a single rain-drop, the rainbird suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: ayk boond jal kaarnay chaat rik dukh paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਧਨੇ  ਕੀ ਰਾਗੁ ਿਬਲਾਵਲੁ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When its breath of life is gone, even an ocean is of no use to it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paraan ga-ay saagar milai fun kaam na aavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰ੍ਪ ਕੰਿਨਆ  ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨੈ  ਇਕੁ ਭਇਆ  ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Now, my life has grown weary, and I shall not last much longer; how can I be patient?
lines.transliteration: paraan jo thaakay thir nahee kaisay birmaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮਾਰਥੀ  ਸੁਆਰਥੀ  ਵਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If I drown and die, and then a boat comes along, tell me, how shall I climb aboard?||3||
lines.transliteration: bood moo-ay na-ukaa milai kaho kaahi chadhaava-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਾ ਜਗਤ  ਗੁਰਾ ਜਉ ਕਰਮੁ  ਨ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
lines.english: I am nothing, I have nothing, and nothing belongs to me.
lines.transliteration: mai naahee kachh ha-o nahee kichh  aahi na moraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸੰਘ  ਸਰਨ  ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ  ਜਉ ਜੰਬੁਕੁ  ਗਰ੍ਾਸੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now, protect my honor; Sadhana is Your humble servant. ||4||1|| pMnw 859 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (859-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu goNf caupdy mhlw 4 Gru 1 ] (859-3) raag gond cha-upday mehlaa 4 gh ar 1. Raag Gond, Chau-Padas, Fourth Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: a-osar lajaa raakh layho saDh naa jan t oraa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: If, in his conscious mind, he places his hopes in the Lord, then he shall obtain thefruits of all the many desires of his mind.
lines.transliteration: jay man chit aas rakh eh har oopar t aa man chind ay anayk anayk fal paa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord knows everything which happens to the soul. Not even an iota of one's effort goes to waste.
lines.transliteration: har jaanai sabh  kichh  jo jee-ay vart ai parabh  ghaali-aa kisai kaa ik t il na gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਸ  ਰਖਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਤਾ ਮਨ ਿਚੰਦੇ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਫਲ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Place your hopes in the Lord, O my mind; the Lord and Master is pervading andpermeating all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har tis kee aas keejai man mayray jo sabh  meh su-aamee rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜੋ ਜੀਇ  ਵਰਤੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ  ਘਾਿਲਆ  ਿਕਸੈ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: mayray man aasaa kar jagdees gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: 4) jo bin har aas avar kaahoo kee keejai saa nihfal aas sabh birthee jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa- o. That hope which is placed in any other than the Lord - that hope is fruitless, andtotally useless. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ  ਕਿਰ ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: That which you can see, Maya, and all attachment to family - don't place your hopesin them, or your life will be wasted and lost.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai maa-i-aa moh kutamb sabh  mat tis kee aas lag janam gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਸ ਅਵਰ  ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਾ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਆਸ  ਸਭ ਿਬਰਥੀ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nothing is in their hands; what can these poor creatures do? By their actions, nothingcan be done.
lines.transliteration: inH kai kichh haath nahee kahaa karahi ihi bapurh ay inH kaa vaahi-aa kachh  na vasaa- ee.

lines.english: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord, your Beloved, who shall carry you across, and save your whole family as well. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayray man aas kar har pareetam apunay kee jo t ujh taarai t ayraa kutamb sabh chhadaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਸਭੁ ਮਤ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਲਿਗ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: If you place your hopes in any other, in any friend other than the Lord, then you shall come to know that it is of no use at all.
lines.transliteration: jay kichh aas avar karahi parmit ree mat  tooN jaaneh tayrai kit ai kamm aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਕੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਨਹੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਇਿਹ ਬਪੁੜੇ  ਇਨ ਕਾ ਵਾਿਹਆ  ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This hope placed in other friends comes from the love of duality. In an instant, it isgone; it is totally false.
lines.transliteration: ih aas parmitree bh aa-o d oojaa hai kh in meh jh ooth binas sabh  jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਤਾਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਸਭੁ ਛਡਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord, your True Beloved, who shall approve andreward you for all your efforts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mayray man aasaa kar har pareetam saachay kee jo t ayraa gh aali-aa sabh  thaa-ay paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਸ  ਅਵਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰਿਮਤਰ੍ੀ  ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਤੇਰੈ ਿਕਤੈ ਕੰਿਮ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Hope and desire are all Yours, O my Lord and Master. As You inspire hope, so are thehopes held. pMnw 860
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa sabh t ayree mayray su-aamee jaisee t oo aas karaaveh t aisee ko aas karaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ  ਕਰਾਵਿਹ  ਤੈਸੀ ਕੋ ਆਸ  ਕਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing is in the hands of anyone, O my Lord and Master; such is the understanding the True Guru has given me to understand.
lines.transliteration: kichh kisee kai hath naahee mayray su-aamee aisee mayrai sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਕਸੀ  ਕੈ ਹਿਥ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਐਸੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You alone know the hope of servant Nanak, O Lord; gazing upon the Blessed Vision ofthe Lord's Darshan, he is satisfied. ||4||1|| goNf mhlw 4 ] (860-3) gond mehlaa 4. Gond, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kee aas too jaan eh har d arsan d aykh har d arsan t ariptaa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਤੂ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਿਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Serve such a Lord, and ever meditate on Him, who in an instant erases all sins and mistakes.
lines.transliteration: aisaa har sayvee-ai nit Dh i-aa-ee-ai jo kh in meh kilvikh  sabh  karay binaasaa.

lines.english: If someone forsakes the Lord and places his hopes in another, then all his service tothe Lord is rendered fruitless.
lines.transliteration: jay har ti-aag avar kee aas keejai t aa har nihfal sabh  ghaal gavaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਜੋ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰੇ ਿਬਨਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve the Lord, the Giver of peace; serving Him, all your hunger shall depart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayray man har sayvihu sukh-d aata su-aamee jis sayvi-ai sabh  bhukh lahaasaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਅਵਰ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਕੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਸਭ ਘਾਲ  ਗਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, place your faith in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har oopar keejai bharvaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਿਵਹੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wherever I go, my Lord and Master is there with me. The Lord saves the honor of Hishumble servants and slaves. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jah jaa-ee-ai tah naal mayraa su-aamee har apnee paij rakh ai jan d aasaa. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕੀਜੈ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: If you tell your sorrows to another, then he, in return, will tell you of his greatersorrows.
lines.transliteration: jay apnee birthaa kahhu avraa peh taa aagai apnee birthaa baho bahut  kadh aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ  ਤਹ ਨਾਿਲ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਅਪਨੀ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So tell your sorrows to the Lord, your Lord and Master, who shall instantly dispel yourpain.
lines.transliteration: apnee birthaa kahhu har apunay su-aamee peh jo tumHray dookh tatkaal kataasaa.

lines.english: Forsaking such a Lord God, if you tell your sorrows to another, then you shall die ofshame. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) so aisaa parabh chh od apnee birthaa avraa peh kahee-ai avraa peh kahi man laaj maraasaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕਹਹੁ ਅਵਰਾ  ਪਿਹ ਤਾ ਆਗੈ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਢਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The relatives, friends and siblings of the world that you see, O my mind, all meet withyou for their own purposes.
lines.transliteration: jo sansaarai kay kutamb mitar bh aa-ee d eeseh man mayray t ay sabh  apnai su-aa-ay milaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕਹਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਿਹ ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਦੂਖ ਤਤਕਾਲ  ਕਟਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: And that day, when their self-interests are not served, on that day, they shall not come near you.
lines.transliteration: jit din unH kaa su-aa-o ho-ay na aavai t it din nayrh ai ko na dh ukaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਅਪਨੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਪਿਹ ਕਹੀਐ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਪਿਹ ਕਿਹ ਮਨ ਲਾਜ  ਮਰਾਸਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve your Lord, day and night; He shall help you in good times and bad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man mayray apnaa har sayv din raat ee jo t uDh upkarai d ookh sukh aasaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ  ਕੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਭਾਈ  ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਅਪਨੈ  ਸੁਆਇ  ਿਮਲਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Why place your faith in anyone, O my mind, who cannot come to your rescue at thelast instant?
lines.transliteration: tis kaa bh arvaasaa ki-o keejai man mayray jo ant ee a-osar rakh  na sakaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਿਦਿਨ  ਉਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ  ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਿਦਿਨ  ਨੇੜੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਢੁਕਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Lord's Mantra, take the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on Him. In the end,the Lord saves those who love Him in their consciousness.
lines.transliteration: har jap mant gur upd ays lai jaapahu t inH ant chhadaa-ay jinH har pareet  chitaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਿਵ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਕਰੈ  ਦੂਿਖ ਸੁਖਾਸਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: ||4||2|| Servant Nanak speaks: night and day, chant the Lord's Name, O Saints; this is theonly true hope for emancipation. ||4||2|| goNf mhlw 4 ] (860-14) gond mehlaa 4. Gond, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak an-din naam japahu har sant ahu ih chh ootan  kaa saachaa bh arvaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ਿਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ  ਅਉਸਿਰ  ਰਿਖ ਨ ਸਕਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall find bliss and peace forever deepwithin, and your mind will become tranquil and cool.
lines.transliteration: har simrat sad aa ho-ay anand sukh  antar saaNt seetal man apnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਲੈ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਿਤਨ ਅੰਿਤ ਛਡਾਏ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਚਤਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: It is like the harsh sun of Maya, with its burning heat; seeing the moon, the Guru, itsheat totally vanishes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaisay sakat soor baho jalt aa gur sas d aykhay leh jaa-ay sabh  tapnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਛੂਟਣ  ਕਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, night and day, meditate, and chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mayray man an-din Dh i-aa-ay naam har japnaa.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, He shall protect you, everywhere; serve such a God forever.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jahaa kahaa tujh  raakh ai sabh  thaa-ee so aisaa parabh  sayv sad aa too apnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਸੀਤਲ  ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, who contains all treasures, O my mind; as Gurmukh, search forthe jewel, the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaa meh sabh niDh aan so har jap man mayray gurmukh  khoj lahhu har rat naa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਕਿਤ  ਸੂਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਜਲਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਸ ਦੇਖੇ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ਸਭ ਤਪਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord, find the Lord, my Lord and Master; I wash the feet of those slaves of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) jin har Dhi-aa-i-aa t in har paa-i-aa mayraa su-aamee t in kay charan  malahu har dasnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who realizes the Word of the Shabad, obtains the sublime essence of the Lord;such a Saint is lofty and sublime, the greatest of the great. iqsu jn kI vifAweI hir Awip vDweI Ehu  GtY n iksY kI GtweI ieku iqlu iqlu iqlnw ]3] (860-19, goNf, mÚ 4) tis jan kee vadi-aa-ee har aap vaDh aa-ee oh gh atai na kisai kee gh ataa-ee ik t il til tilnaa. ||3|| The Lord Himself magnifies the glory of that humble servant. No one can lessen or decrease that glory, not even a bit. ||3|| pMnw 861
lines.transliteration: sabad pachh aan raam ras paavhu oh oot am sant  bha-i-o bad badnaa.

lines.english: He shall give you peace, O my mind; meditate forever, every day on Him, with your palms pressed together.
lines.transliteration: jis tay sukh  paavahi man mayray so sad aa Dh i-aa-ay nit  kar jurnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਇ ਿਨਤ  ਕਰ ਜੁਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless servant Nanak with this one gift, O Lord, that Your feet may dwell withinmy heart forever. ||4||3|| goNf mhlw 4 ] (861-3) gond mehlaa 4. Gond, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har daan ik d eejai nit  baseh rid ai haree mohi charnaa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਨਤ ਬਸਿਹ  ਿਰਦੈ ਹਰੀ ਮੋਿਹ ਚਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: All the kings, emperors, nobles, lords and chiefs are false and transitory, engrossed in duality - know this well.
lines.transliteration: jitnay saah paat isaah umraav sikd aar cha-uDh ree sabh  mithi-aa jh ooth bhaa-o d oojaa jaan.

lines.english: The eternal Lord is permanent and unchanging; meditate on Him, O my mind, andyou shall be approved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har abhinaasee sad aa thir nihchal t is mayray man bh aj parvaan . ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord's Name, which shall be your defenderforever.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam haree bhaj sad aa deebaan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਸਾਹ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ਉਮਰਾਵ  ਿਸਕਦਾਰ  ਚਉਧਰੀ  ਸਿਭ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਝੂਠੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: One who obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings - no one else's power is as great as his. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo har mahal paavai gur bachnee tis jayvad avar naahee kisai d aa taan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਸਦਾ ਿਥਰੁ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the wealthy, high class property owners which you see, O my mind, shall vanish, like the fading color of the safflower.
lines.transliteration: goNf, mÚ 4) jitnay Dh anvant  kulvant  milakh vant deeseh man mayray sabh  binas jaahi ji-o rang kasumbh kachaan .

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the True, Immaculate Lord forever, O my mind, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har sat niranjan sad aa sayv man mayray jit  har d argeh paavahi t oo maan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦਾ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There are four castes: Brahmin, Kh'shaatriya, Soodra and Vaishya, and there are fourstages of life. One who meditates on the Lord, is the most distinguished andrenowned.
lines.transliteration: baraahman kh atree sood  vais chaar varan chaar aasram heh jo har Dh i-aavai so parDhaan.

lines.english: The poor castor oil plant, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes fragrant; in thesame way, the sinner, associating with the Saints, becomes acceptable and approved.||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o chandan nikat vasai hirad bapurh aa ti-o sat sangat  mil pat it parvaan . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਧਨਵੰਤ  ਕੁਲਵੰਤ  ਿਮਲਖਵੰਤ  ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਿਜਉ  ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਚਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He, within whose heart the Lord abides, is the highest of all, and the purest of all.
lines.transliteration: oh sabh t ay oochaa sabh  tay soochaa jaa kai hird ai vasi-aa bh agvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਿਵ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak washes the feet of thM at humble servant of the Lord; he may be froma low class family, but he is now the Lord's servant. ||4||4|| goNf mhlw 4 ] (861-11) gond mehlaa 4. Gond, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tis kay charan pakh aalai jo har jan neech jaat  sayvkaan . ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਚਾਿਰ  ਵਰਨ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਆਸਰ੍ਮ  ਹਿਹ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is all-pervading. As the Lordcauses them to act, so do they act.
lines.transliteration: har antarjaamee sabh -tai vart ai jayhaa har karaa-ay t ayhaa ko kara-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਚੰਦਨ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਵਸੈ ਿਹਰਡੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: So serve forever such a Lord, O my mind, who will protect you from everything. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har sayv sadaa man mayray jo t uDhno sabh  doo rakh  la-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ਸਭ ਤੇ ਸੂਚਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ ਵਿਸਆ  ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, and read about the Lord every day.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har jap har nit parh a-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਪਖਾਲੈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਜਾਿਤ  ਸੇਵਕਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Other than the Lord, no one can kill you or save you; so why do you worry, O mymind? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bin ko maar jeevaal na saakai taa mayray man kaa-it  karha-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Creator created the entire universe, and infused His Light into it.
lines.transliteration: har parpanch kee-aa sabh kart ai vich aapay aapn ee jot  Dhara-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸਭਤੈ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਜੇਹਾ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਾਏ  ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord speaks, and the One Lord causes all to speak.The Perfect Guru has revealed the One Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har ayko bolai har ayk bulaa-ay gur poorai har ayk dikh a-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਸਭ ਦੂ ਰਿਖ ਲਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is with you, inside and out; tell me, O mind, how can You hide anything fromHim?
lines.transliteration: har antar naalay baahar naalay kaho t is paashu man ki-aa chora-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਤ ਪੜਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Serve the Lord open-heartedly, and then, O my mind, you shall find total peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nihakpat sayvaa keejai har kayree taaN mayray man sarab sukh  pa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋ ਮਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾਿਲ  ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇਤੁ  ਕੜਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everything is under His control; He is the greatest of all. O my mind, meditate forever on Him.
lines.transliteration: jis dai vas sabh  kichh  so sabh  doo vadaa so mayray man sad aa Dh i-a-ee-ai.

lines.english: ||4||5|| O Servant Nanak, that Lord is always with you. Meditate forever on your Lord, and Heshall emancipate you. ||4||5|| goNf mhlw 4 ] (861-18) gond mehlaa 4. Gond, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak so har naal hai tayrai har sad aa Dh i-aa-ay t oo tuDh la-ay chh ada-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਧਰਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: My mind yearns so deeply for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, like the thirstyman without water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har darsan ka-o mayraa man baho t aptai ji-o t arikhaavaNt bin neer. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਲਾਏ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਿਦਖਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the arrow of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man paraym lago har teer.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਲੇ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਨਾਲੇ  ਕਹੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮਨ ਿਕਆ  ਚੋਰਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God knows my anguish, and the pain deep within my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hamree baydan har parabh  jaanai mayray man ant ar kee peer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਕਪਟ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whoever tells me the Stories of my Beloved Lord is my Sibling of Destiny, and my friend. ||2|| pMnw 862
lines.transliteration: mayray har pareetam kee ko-ee baat  sunaavai so bh aa-ee so mayraa beer. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ਸੋ ਭਾਈ  ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Come, and join together, O my companions; let's sing the Glorious Praises of my God, and follow the comforting advice of the True Guru.. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mil mil sakhee gun  kaho mayray parabh  kay lay sat gur kee mat  Dheer. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੁ ਿਮਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਲੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਧੀਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Please fulfill the hopes of servant Nanak, O Lord; his body finds peace and tranquility in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||6|| Ckw 1] (862-2) chhakaa 1|| First set of six. || rwgu goNf mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 1  (862-3) raag gond mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 1 Raag Gond, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (862-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kee har aas pujaavahu har darsan saaNt sareer. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਆਸ  ਪੁਜਾਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਸਿਤ  ਸਰੀਰ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: He is the Creator of all, He is the Enjoyer of all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh kart aa sabh  bhugtaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Creator listens, and the Creator sees.
lines.transliteration: sunto kart aa paykh at kartaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator is unseen, and the Creator is seen.
lines.transliteration: adristo kart aa daristo kart aa.

lines.english: The Creator forms, and the Creator destroys.
lines.transliteration: opat kart aa parla-o kart aa.

lines.english: The Creator touches, and the Creator is detached. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bi-aapat kart aa alipat o kart aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Creator is the One who speaks, and the Creator is the One who understands.
lines.transliteration: bakto kart aa boojh at kartaa.

lines.english: The Creator comes, and the Creator also goes.
lines.transliteration: aavat kart aa jaat  bhee kart aa.

lines.english: The Creator is absolute and without qualities; the Creator is related, with the most excellent qualities.
lines.transliteration: nirgun kartaa sargun kart aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak looks upon all the same. ||2||1|| goNf mhlw 5 ] (862-7) gond mehlaa 5. Gond, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak samd ristaa. ||2||1||

lines.english: You are caught, like the fish and the monkey; you are entangled in the transitoryworld.
lines.transliteration: faaki-o meen kapik kee ni-aa-ee too urajh  rahi-o kasumbh aa-ilay.

lines.english: Your foot-steps and your breaths are numbered; only by singing the Glorious Praisesof the Lord will you be saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pag Dhaareh saas laykh ai lai t a-o uDh rahi har gun  gaa-ilay. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, reform yourself, and forsake your aimless wandering.
lines.transliteration: man samajh chh od aavaa-ilay.

lines.english: You have found no place of rest for yourself; so why do you try to teach others?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: apnay rahan ka-o tha-ur na paavahi kaa-ay par kai jaa-ilay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Like the elephant, driven by sexual desire, you are attached to your family.
lines.transliteration: ji-o maigal indree ras parayri-o t oo laag pari-o kutambaa-ilay.

lines.punjabi: ਫਾਿਕਓ  ਮੀਨ ਕਿਪਕ  ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਤੂ ਉਰਿਝ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਕੁਸੰਭਾਇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: People are like birds that come together, and fly apart again; you shall become stable and steady, only when you meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of theHoly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o pankhee ikat ar ho-ay fir bichh urai thir sangat  har har Dh i-aa-ilay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਗ ਧਾਰਿਹ  ਸਾਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈ ਤਉ ਉਧਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Like the fish, which perishes because of its desire to taste, the fool is ruined by hisgreed.
lines.transliteration: jaisay meen rasan saad binsi-o oh mooth ou moorh  lobhaa-ilay.

lines.english: You have fallen under the power of the five thieves; escape is only possible in theSanctuary of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: too ho-aa panch vaas vairee kai chh ooteh par sarnaa-ilay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ ਰਹਨ  ਕਉ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਕਾਏ ਪਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਇਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek; all beings and creatures belong to You.
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal deen d ukh bhanjan sabh  tumHray jee-a jant aa-ilay.

lines.english: May I obtain the gift of always seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; meetingwith You, Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||2|| rwgu goNf mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 2  (862-14) raag gond mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 2 Raag Gond, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (862-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: paava-o daan sad aa daras paykh aa mil naanak d aas d asaa-ilay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਮੈਗਲੁ  ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਰਿਸ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਰਓ  ਤੂ ਲਾਿਗ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਕੁਟੰਬਾਇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: He fashioned the soul and the breath of life,
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan kee-ay jin saaj.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਇਕਤਰ੍  ਹੋਇ ਿਫਿਰ ਿਬਛੁਰੈ  ਿਥਰੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maatee meh jot rakh ee nivaaj. and infused His Light into the dust;

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਸਨ  ਸਾਿਦ  ਿਬਨਿਸਓ  ਓਹੁ ਮੂਠੌ ਮੂੜ ਲੋਭਾਇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: He exalted you and gave you everything to use, and food to eat and enjoy
lines.transliteration: bartan ka-o sabh  kichh  bhojan bh ogaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਹੋਆ  ਪੰਚ ਵਾਿਸ  ਵੈਰੀ ਕੈ ਛੂਟਿਹ ਪਰੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਲੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: so parabh t aj moorh ay kat  jaa-ay. ||1|| - how can you forsake that God, you fool! Where else will you go? ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਸਿਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤਾਇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Commit yourself to the service of the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kee laaga-o sayv.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਉ  ਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪੇਖਾ ਿਮਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਲੇ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, one understands the Immaculate, Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur tay sujh ai niranjan d ayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He created plays and dramas of all sorts;
lines.transliteration: jin kee-ay rang anik parkaar.

lines.english: He creates and destroys in an instant;
lines.transliteration: opat parla-o nimakh  majh aar.

lines.english: His state and condition cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee gat mit  kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Meditate forever on that God, O my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so parabh man mayray sad aa Dh i-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਿਜ  ਮੂੜੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The unchanging Lord does not come or go.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaavai nihchal Dhanee.

lines.english: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; how many of them can I count? pMnw 863
lines.transliteration: bay-ant gunaa t aa kay kayt ak ganee.

lines.english: His treasure is overflowing with the rubies of the Name.
lines.transliteration: laal naam jaa kai bharay bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He gives Support to all hearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa d ayvai aaDh aar. ||3||

lines.english: The Name is the True Primal Being;
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  jaa ko hai naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: miteh kot agh nimakh  jas gaa-o. millions of sins are washed away in an instant, singing His Praises.

lines.english: The Lord God is your best friend, your playmate from earliest childhood.
lines.transliteration: baal sakhaa-ee bh agtan ko meet .

lines.english: He is the Support of the breath of life; O Nanak, He is love, He is consciousness. ||4||1||3|| goNf mhlw 5 ] (863-3) gond mehlaa 5. Gond, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paraan aDhaar naanak hit  cheet . ||4||1||3||

lines.english: I trade in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam sang keeno bi-uhaar.

lines.english: The Naam is the Support of the mind.
lines.transliteration: naamo hee is man kaa aDhaar.

lines.english: My consciousness takes to the Shelter of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naamo hee chit keenee ot.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, millions of sins are erased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japat miteh paap kot. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord has blessed me with the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: raas dee-ee har ayko naam.

lines.english: The wish of my mind is to meditate on the Naam, in association with the Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man kaa isat gur sang Dhi-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam is the wealth of my soul.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaaray jee-a kee raas.

lines.english: Wherever I go, the Naam is with me.
lines.transliteration: naamo sangee jat kat  jaat.

lines.english: The Naam is sweet to my mind.
lines.transliteration: naamo hee man laagaa meethaa.

lines.english: In the water, on the land, and everywhere, I see the Naam. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal thal sabh meh naamo deeth aa. ||2||

lines.english: Through the Naam, one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naamay dargeh mukh  ujlay.

lines.english: Through the Naam, all one's generations are saved.
lines.transliteration: naamay saglay kul uDhray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੋ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Naam, my affairs are resolved.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaaray kaaraj seeDh.

lines.english: My mind is accustomed to the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam sang ih manoo-aa geeDh. ||3||

lines.english: Through the Naam, I have become fearless.
lines.transliteration: naamay hee ham nirbha-o bh a-ay.

lines.english: Through the Naam, my comings and goings have ceased.
lines.transliteration: naamay aavan jaavan rahay.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai maylay guntaas.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I dwell in celestial peace. ||4||2||4|| goNf mhlw 5 ] (863-8) gond mehlaa 5. Gond, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sukh sahj nivaas. ||4||2||4||

lines.english: He grants honor to the dishonored,
lines.transliteration: nimaanay ka-o jo dayt o maan.
sagal bhookh ay ka-o kart aa daan. and gives gifts to all the hungry;
garabh gh or meh raakh anhaar. he protects those in the terrible womb.

lines.english: So humbly bow forever to that Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis thaakur ka-o sad aa namaskaar. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate on such a God in your mind.
lines.transliteration: aiso parabh man maahi Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: He shall be your help and support everywhere, in good times and bad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghat avgh at jat kateh sahaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The beggar and the king are all the same to Him.
lines.transliteration: rank raa-o jaa kai ayk samaan.

lines.english: He sustains and fulfills both the ant and the elephant.
lines.transliteration: keet hasat sagal pooraan.

lines.english: He does not consult or seek anyone's advice.
lines.transliteration: bee-o poochh na maslat  Dharai.

lines.english: Whatever He does, He does Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so aapeh karai. ||2||

lines.english: No one knows His limit.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa ant na jaanas ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਕੁ ਰਾਉ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap niranjan so-ay.

lines.english: He Himself is formed, and He Himself is formless.
lines.transliteration: aap akaar aap nirankaar.

lines.english: In the heart, in each and every heart, He is the Support of all hearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ghat sabh  ghat aaDh aar. ||3||

lines.english: Through the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the devotees become HisBeloveds.
lines.transliteration: naam rang bhagat  bha-ay laal.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਸ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Praises of the Creator, the Saints are forever in bliss.
lines.transliteration: jas kartay sant  sadaa nihaal.

lines.english: Through the Love of the Naam, the Lord's humble servants remain satisfied.
lines.transliteration: naam rang jan rahay aghaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak falls at the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||4||3||5|| goNf mhlw 5 ] (863-14) gond mehlaa 5. Gond, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin jan laagai paa-ay. ||4||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਿਟ  ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Associating with them, this mind becomes immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sang ih man nirmal.

lines.english: Associating with them, one meditates in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sang har har simran.

lines.english: Associating with them, all the sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sang kilbikh hohi naas.

lines.english: Associating with them, the heart is illumined. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sang ridai pargaas. ||1||

lines.english: Those Saints of the Lord are my friends.
lines.transliteration: say santan har kay mayray meet .

lines.english: It is their custom to sing only the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kayval naam gaa-ee-ai jaa kai neet. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By their mantra, the Lord, Har, Har, dwells in the mind.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai mantar har har man vasai.

lines.english: By their teachings, doubt and fear are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai updays bh aram bh a-o nasai.

lines.english: By their kirtan, they become immaculate and sublime.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai keerat nirmal saar.

lines.english: The world longs for the dust of their feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee rayn baaNchhai sansaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸੰਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Millions of sinners are saved by associating with them.
lines.transliteration: kot patit  jaa kai sang uDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਵਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਈਐ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨੀਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They have the Support of the Name of the One Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayk nirankaar jaa kai naam aDhaar.

lines.english: He knows the secrets of all beings;
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aaN kaa jaanai bhay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮੰਿਤਰ੍ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: He is the treasure of mercy, the divine immaculate Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan niranjan d ay-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥
lines.english: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jab bha-ay kirpaal.
tab bh aytay gur saaDh  da-i-aal. then one meets the Merciful Holy Guru. pMnw 864

lines.english: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: din rain  naanak naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Lord's Name, he is blessed with peace, poise and bliss. ||4||4||6|| goNf mhlw 5 ] (864-1) gond mehlaa 5. Gond, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  har naa-ay. ||4||4||6||

lines.english: Meditate on the image of the Guru within your mind;
lines.transliteration: gur kee moorat man meh Dh i-aan.
gur kai sabad mant ar man maan. let your mind accept the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and His Mantra.

lines.english: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan ridai lai Dh aara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Bow in humility forever before the Guru, the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur paarbarahm sadaa namaskaara-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਿਰਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਾਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: Let no one wander in doubt in the world.
lines.transliteration: mat ko bh aram bh ulai sansaar.

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one can cross over. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur bin ko-ay na utras paar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Guru shows the Path to those who have wandered off.
lines.transliteration: bhoolay ka-o gur maarag paa-i-aa.

lines.english: He leads them to renounce others, and attaches them to devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: avar ti-aag har bh agtee laa-i-aa.

lines.english: He obliterates the fear of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee taraas mitaa-ee.

lines.english: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is endless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee bay-ant vadaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the inverted heart-lotus blossoms forth,
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ooraDh  kamal bigaas.
anDhkaar meh bh a-i-aa pargaas. and the Light shines forth in the darkness.

lines.english: Through the Guru, know the One who created you.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa so gur tay jaani-aa.

lines.english: By the Guru's Mercy, the foolish mind comes to believe. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay mugaDh  man maani-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru is the Creator; the Guru has the power to do everything.
lines.transliteration: gur kartaa gur karn ai jog.

lines.english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord; He is, and always shall be.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar hai bhee hog.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God has inspired me to know this.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh ihai janaa-ee.

lines.english: O True Guru, You are the Support of the unsupported.
lines.transliteration: neeDhri-aa sat gur Dh ar tayree.

lines.english: Be merciful, and save Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakho jan kayree.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis gur balihaaree.

lines.english: Raag Gond, The Word Of The Devotees. kbIr jI Gru 1  (870-1) kabeer jee ghar 1 Kabeer Jee, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (870-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran paij savaaree. ||8||1||29|| remembering Him in meditation, my honor has been saved. ||8||1||29|| pMnw 870 rwgu goNf bwxI Bgqw kI ] (870-1) raag gond banee bh agtaa kee.

lines.english: When you meet a Saint, talk to him and listen.
lines.transliteration: sant milai kichh  sunee-ai kahee-ai.

lines.english: Meeting with an unsaintly person, just remain silent. ||1||
lines.transliteration: milai asant masat kar rahee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: O father, if I speak, what words should I utter?
lines.transliteration: baabaa bolnaa ki-aa kahee-ai.

lines.english: Speak such words, by which you may remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaisay raam naam rav rahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Speaking with the Saints, one becomes generous.
lines.transliteration: santan si-o bolay upkaaree.

lines.english: To speak with a fool is to babble uselessly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: moorakh si-o bolay jh akh maaree. ||2||

lines.english: By speaking and only speaking, corruption only increases.
lines.transliteration: bolat bolat  badh eh bikaaraa.

lines.english: If I do not speak, what can the poor wretch do? ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin bolay ki-aa karahi beechaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the empty pitcher makes noise,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer chhoochh aa gh at bolai.

lines.english: Gond:
lines.transliteration: bhari-aa ho-ay so kabahu na dolai. ||4||1|| but that which is full makes no sound. ||4||1|| goNf ] (870-5) gond.

lines.english: When a man dies, he is of no use to anyone.
lines.transliteration: naroo marai nar kaam na aavai.

lines.english: But when an animal dies, it is used in ten ways. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pasoo marai das kaaj savaarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: What do I know, about the state of my karma?
lines.transliteration: apnay karam kee gat mai ki-aa jaan-o.

lines.english: What do I know, O Baba? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai ki-aa jaan-o baabaa ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰੂ ਮਰੈ ਨਰੁ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: His bones burn, like a bundle of logs;
lines.transliteration: haad jalay jaisay lakree kaa toolaa.
kays jalay jaisay ghaas kaa poolaa. ||2|| his hair burns like a bale of hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਕਰਮ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਮੈ ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਨਉ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, the man wakes up,
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer tab hee nar jaagai.

lines.english: Gond:
lines.transliteration: jam kaa dand moond meh laagai. ||3||2|| only when the Messenger of Death hits him over the head with his club. ||3||2|| goNf ] (870-8) gond.

lines.english: The Celestial Lord is in the Akaashic ethers of the skies, the Celestial Lord is in thenether regions of the underworld; in the four directions, the Celestial Lord ispervading.
lines.transliteration: aakaas gagan paataal gagan hai chahu d is gagan rahaa-ilay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਡ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਕਰੀ  ਕਾ ਤੂਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is forever the source of bliss. When the vessel of the bodyperishes, the Celestial Lord does not perish. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aanad mool sad aa purkh otam gh at binsai gagan na jaa-ilay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ  ਕਾ ਪੂਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have become sad,
lines.transliteration: mohi bairaag bha-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ih jee-o aa-ay kahaa ga-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. wondering where the soul comes from, and where it goes. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਿਹ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: The body is formed from the union of the five tatvas; but where were the five tatvascreated?
lines.transliteration: panch tat  mil kaa-i-aa keenHee tat kahaa t ay keen ray.

lines.english: You say that the soul is tied to its karma, but who gave karma to the body? ||2||
lines.transliteration: karam baDh t um jee-o kahat  hou karmeh kin jee-o d een ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਕਾਿਸ  ਗਗਨੁ ਪਾਤਾਿਲ  ਗਗਨੁ ਹੈ ਚਹੁ ਿਦਿਸ  ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The body is contained in the Lord, and the Lord is contained in the body. He is permeating within all.
lines.transliteration: har meh tan hai t an meh har hai sarab nirant ar so-ay ray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ  ਘਟੁ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਗਗਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I shall not renounce the Lord's Name. I shall accept whatever happens.||3||3|| rwgu goNf bwxI kbIr jIau kI Gru 2  (870-13) raag gond banee kabeer jee-o kee gh ar 2 Raag Gond, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (870-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raam naam na chhoda-o sehjay ho-ay so ho-ay ray. ||3||3||

lines.english: They tied my arms, bundled me up, and threw me before an elephant.
lines.transliteration: bhujaa baaNDh bhilaa kar d aari-o.

lines.english: The elephant driver struck him on the head, and infuriated him.
lines.transliteration: hastee karop moond meh maari-o.

lines.english: But the elephant ran away, trumpeting,
lines.transliteration: hasat bh aag kai cheesaa maarai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਤਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: "I am a sacrifice to this image of the Lord."||1||
lines.transliteration: i-aa moorat kai ha-o balihaarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਬਧ ਤੁਮ ਜੀਉ ਕਹਤ  ਹੌ ਕਰਮਿਹ  ਿਕਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You are my strength.
lines.transliteration: aahi mayray thaakur t umraa jor.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮਿਹ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਹੈ ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋਇ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Qazi shouted at the driver to drive the elephant on. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaajee bakibo hastee t or. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.english: He yelled out, "O driver, I shall cut you into pieces.
lines.transliteration: ray mahaavat t ujh daara-o kaat.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Hit him, and drive him on!"
lines.transliteration: iseh turaavahu gh aalhu saat.

lines.english: But the elephant did not move; instead, he began to meditate.
lines.transliteration: hasat na t orai Dh arai Dh i-aan.

lines.english: The Lord God abides within his mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vaa kai ridai basai bh agvaan. ||2||

lines.english: What sin has this Saint committed,
lines.transliteration: ki-aa apraaDh sant  hai keenHaa.
baaNDh pot kunchar ka-o d eenHaa. that you have made him into a bundle and thrown him before the elephant?

lines.english: Lifting up the bundle, the elephant bows down before it.
lines.transliteration: kunchar pot lai lai namaskaarai.

lines.english: The Qazi could not understand it; he was blind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: boojhee nahee kaajee anDh i-aarai. ||3||

lines.english: Three times, he tried to do it. pMnw 871
lines.transliteration: teen baar pat ee-aa bh ar leenaa.

lines.english: Even then, his hardened mind was not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: man kathor ajhoo na pat eenaa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, such is my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer hamraa gobind.

lines.english: The soul of His humble servant dwells in the fourth state. ||4||1||4|| goNf ] (871-2) gond. Gond:
lines.transliteration: cha-uthay pad meh jan kee jind . ||4||1||4||

lines.english: It is not human, and it is not a god.
lines.transliteration: naa ih maanas naa ih day-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸੁ  ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
lines.english: It is not called celibate, or a worshipper of Shiva.
lines.transliteration: naa ih jatee kahaavai say-o.

lines.english: It is not a Yogi, and it is not a hermit.
lines.transliteration: naa ih jogee naa avDhoot aa.

lines.english: It is not a mother, or anyone's son. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa is maa-ay na kaahoo pootaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Then what is it, which dwells in this temple of the body?
lines.transliteration: i-aa mandar meh koun basaa-ee.

lines.english: No one can find its limits. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taa kaa ant  na ko-oo paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is not a house-holder, and it is not a renouncer of the world.
lines.transliteration: naa ih girhee naa odaasee.

lines.english: It is not a king, and it is not a beggar.
lines.transliteration: naa ih raaj na bheekh  mangaasee.

lines.english: It has no body, no drop of blood.
lines.transliteration: naa is pind na raktoo raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: It is not a Brahmin, and it is not a Kh'shaatriya. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naa ih barahman naa ih khaat ee. ||2||

lines.english: It is not called a man of austere self-discipline, or a Shaykh.
lines.transliteration: naa ih tapaa kahaavai saykh .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਨੁ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਖਾਤੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: It does not live, and it is not seen to die.
lines.transliteration: naa ih jeevai na martaa d aykh.

lines.english: If someone cries over its death,
lines.transliteration: is martay ka-o jay ko-oo rovai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨ ਮਰਤਾ  ਦੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo rovai so-ee pat kh ovai. ||3|| that person loses his honor. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਰਤੇ  ਕਉ ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Path.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad mai dagro paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Birth and death have both been erased.
lines.transliteration: jeevan maran do-oo mitvaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, this is formed of the same essence as the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ih raam kee aNs.

lines.english: It is like the ink on the paper which cannot be erased. ||4||2||5|| goNf ] (871-8) gond. Gond:
lines.transliteration: jas kaagad par mitai na mans. ||4||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਇਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The threads are broken, and the starch has run out.
lines.transliteration: tootay t aagay nikh utee paan.

lines.english: Bare reeds glisten at the front door.
lines.transliteration: du-aar oopar jh ilkaavahi kaan.

lines.english: The poor brushes are scattered in pieces.
lines.transliteration: kooch bichaaray foo-ay faal.

lines.english: Death has entered this shaven head. ||1||
lines.transliteration: i-aa mundee-aa sir chadhibo kaal. ||1||

lines.english: This shaven-headed mendicant has wasted all his wealth.
lines.transliteration: ih mundee-aa saglo darab kh o-ee.

lines.english: All this coming and going has irritated him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  naak sar ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He has given up all talk of his weaving equipment.
lines.transliteration: turee naar kee chh odee baat aa.

lines.english: His mind is attuned to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam naam vaa kaa man raataa.

lines.english: His daughters and sons have nothing to eat,
lines.transliteration: larikee larikan khaibo naahi.
mundee-aa an-din Dh aapay jaahi. ||2|| while the shaven-headed mendicants night and day eat their fill. ||2||

lines.english: One or two are in the house, and one or two more are on the way.
lines.transliteration: ik du-ay mand ar ik d u-ay baat.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: We sleep on the floor, while they sleep in the beds.
lines.transliteration: ham ka-o saathar un ka-o khaat.

lines.english: They rub their bare heads, and carry prayer-books in their waist-bands.
lines.transliteration: mood palos kamar baDh pothee.

lines.english: We get dry grains, while they get loaves of bread. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham ka-o chaaban un ka-o rotee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਟ ॥
lines.english: He will become one of these shaven-headed mendicants.
lines.transliteration: mundee-aa mundee-aa hoo-ay ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਥਰੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਖਾਟ ॥
lines.english: They are the support of the drowning.
lines.transliteration: ay mundee-aa boodat kee tayk.

lines.english: Listen, O blind and unguided Loi:
lines.transliteration: sun anDhlee lo-ee baypeer.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਚਾਬਨੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਰੋਟੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer has taken shelter with these shaven-headed mendicants. ||4||3||6|| goNf ] (871-14) gond. Gond:
lines.transliteration: inH mundee-an bhaj saran kabeer. ||4||3||6||

lines.english: When her husband dies, the woman does not cry.
lines.transliteration: khasam marai t a-o naar na rovai.

lines.english: Someone else becomes her protector.
lines.transliteration: us rakhvaaraa a-uro hovai.

lines.english: When this protector dies,
lines.transliteration: rakhvaaray kaa ho-ay binaas.
aagai narak eehaa bhog bilaas. ||1|| he falls into the world of hell hereafter, for the sexual pleasures he enjoyed in thisworld. ||1||

lines.english: The world loves only the one bride, Maya.
lines.transliteration: ayk suhaagan jagat pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੁ  ਮਰੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਿਰ  ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: She is the wife of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saglay jee-a jant kee naaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With her necklace around her neck, this bride looks beautiful.
lines.transliteration: sohaagan gal sohai haar.

lines.english: She is poison to the Saint, but the world is delighted with her.
lines.transliteration: sant ka-o bikh  bigsai sansaar.

lines.english: Adorning herself, she sits like a prostitute.
lines.transliteration: kar seegaar bahai pakhi-aaree.

lines.english: Cursed by the Saints, she wanders around like a wretch. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant kee th ithkee firai bichaaree. ||2||

lines.english: She runs around, chasing after the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant bh aag oh paachh ai parai.

lines.english: She is afraid of being beaten by those blessed with the Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee maarahu darai.

lines.english: She is the body, the breath of life, of the faithless cynics.
lines.transliteration: saakat kee oh pind paraa-in .

lines.english: She appears to me like a blood-thirsty witch. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham ka-o darisat parai t arakh  daa-in . ||3||

lines.english: I know her secrets well
lines.transliteration: ham tis kaa baho jaani-aa bh ay-o.
jab hoo-ay kirpaal milay gurday-o. - in His Mercy, the Divine Guru met me.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, now I have thrown her out.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ab baahar paree.

lines.english: She clings to the skirt of the world. ||4||4||7|| pMnw 872 goNf ] (872-1) gond. Gond:
lines.transliteration: sansaarai kai anchal laree. ||4||4||7||

lines.english: When someone's household has no glory,
lines.transliteration: garihi sobhaa jaa kai ray naahi.
aavat pahee-aa kh ooDhay jaahi. the guests who come there depart still hungry.

lines.english: Deep within, there is no contentment.
lines.transliteration: vaa kai antar nahee sant okh.

lines.english: Without his bride, the wealth of Maya, he suffers in pain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin sohaagan laagai dokh . ||1||

lines.english: Dhan sohaagan mahaa paveet . tapay t apeesar dolai cheet . ||1|| rahaa-o. So praise this bride, which can shake the consciousness of even the most dedicatedascetics and sages. ||1||Pause||
This bride is the daughter of a wretched miser.
lines.transliteration: sohaagan kirpan kee pootee.

lines.english: Abandoning the Lord's servant, she sleeps with the world.
lines.transliteration: sayvak taj jagat  si-o soot ee.

lines.english: Standing at the door of the holy man,
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo kai th aadhee darbaar.
saran tayree mo ka-o nist aar. ||2|| she says, "I have come to your sanctuary; now save me!"||2||

lines.english: This bride is so beautiful.
lines.transliteration: sohaagan hai at sund ree.

lines.english: The bells on her ankles make soft music.
lines.transliteration: pag nayvar chhanak chh anharee.

lines.english: As long as there is the breath of life in the man, she remains attached to him.
lines.transliteration: ja-o lag paraan ta-oo lag sangay.

lines.english: But when it is no more, she quickly gets up and departs, bare-footed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naahi ta chalee bayg uth  nangay. ||3||

lines.english: This bride has conquered the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: sohaagan bhavan t arai lee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਤਊ ਲਗੁ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
lines.english: The eighteen Puraanas and the sacred shrines of pilgrimage love her as well.
lines.transliteration: das ath  puraan  tirath ras kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਹ  ਤ ਚਲੀ  ਬੇਿਗ  ਉਿਠ ਨੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: She pierced the hearts of Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahaysar bayDhay.

lines.english: She destroyed the great emperors and kings of the world. ||4||
lines.transliteration: baday bhoopat  raajay hai chh ayDhay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਤੀਰਥ ਰਸ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: This bride has no restraint or limits.
lines.transliteration: sohaagan urvaar na paar.

lines.english: She is in collusion with the five thieving passions.
lines.transliteration: paaNch naarad kai sang biDh vaar.

lines.english: When the clay pot of these five passions bursts,
lines.transliteration: paaNch naarad kay mitvay footay.

lines.english: Gond:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer gur kirpaa chhootay. ||5||5||8|| then, says Kabeer, by Guru's Mercy, one is released. ||5||5||8|| goNf ] (872-8) gond.

lines.english: As the house will not stand when the supporting beams are removed from within it,
lines.transliteration: jaisay mandar meh balhar naa th aahrai.
naam binaa kaisay paar utrai. just so, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be carried across?

lines.english: Without the pitcher, the water is not contained;
lines.transliteration: kumbh binaa jal naa teekaavai.
saaDhoo bin aisay abgat  jaavai. ||1|| just so, without the Holy Saint, the mortal departs in misery. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮਿਹ ਬਲਹਰ  ਨਾ ਠਾਹਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: One who does not remember the Lord - let him burn;
lines.transliteration: jaara-o tisai jo raam na chayt ai.
tan man ramat  rahai meh kh aytai. ||1|| rahaa-o. his body and mind have remained absorbed in this field of the world. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Without a farmer, the land is not planted;
lines.transliteration: jaisay halhar binaa jimee nahee bo-ee-ai.
soot binaa kaisay man ee paroee-ai. without a thread, how can the beads be strung?

lines.english: Without a loop, how can the knot be tied?

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, now my thirst is quenched;
lines.transliteration: kaho ravidaas ab t arisnaa chookee.

lines.english: I meditate on Mukanday the Liberator, and I serve Him. ||4||1|| goNf ] (875-10) gond. Gond:
lines.transliteration: jap mukand sayvaa t aahoo kee. ||4||1||

lines.english: Someone may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage,
lines.transliteration: jay oh athsath  tirath nHaavai.
jay oh du-aad as silaa poojaavai. and worship the twelve Shiva-lingam stones,
jay oh koop tataa d ayvaavai. and dig wells and pools,
karai nind sabh  birthaa jaavai. ||1|| but if he indulges in slander, then all of this is useless. ||1||

lines.english: How can the slanderer of the Holy Saints be saved?
lines.transliteration: saaDh kaa nind ak kaisay t arai.

lines.english: Know for certain, that he shall go to hell. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarpar jaanhu narak hee parai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Someone may bathe at Kuruk-shaytra during a solar eclipse,
lines.transliteration: jay oh garahan karai kulkhayt .
arpai naar seegaar samayt. and give his decorated wife in offering,
saglee simrit sarvanee sunai. and listen to all the Simritees,
karai nind kavnai nahee gunai. ||2|| but if he indulges in slander, these are of no account. ||2||

lines.english: Someone may give countless feasts,
lines.transliteration: jay oh anik parsaad karaavai.
bhoom d aan sobh aa mandap paavai. and donate land, and build splendid buildings;
apnaa bigaar biraaNnaa saaNdhai. he may neglect his own affairs to work for others,
karai nind baho jonee haaNdhai. ||3|| but if he indulges in slander, he shall wander in countless incarnations. ||3||

lines.english: Why do you indulge in slander, O people of the world?
lines.transliteration: nindaa kahaa karahu sansaaraa.

lines.english: The emptiness of the slanderer is soon exposed.
lines.transliteration: nindak kaa pargat paahaaraa.

lines.english: I have thought, and determined the fate of the slanderer.
lines.transliteration: nindak soDh  saaDh  beechaari-aa.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, he is a sinner; he sha ll go to hell. ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| Total|| pMnw 876 rwmklI mhlw 1 Gru 1 caupdy (876-1) raamkalee mehlaa 1 ghar 1 cha-upd ay Raamkalee, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (876-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: kaho ravidaas paapee narak siDh aari-aa. ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| jorh .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Some read the Sanskrit scriptures, and some read the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee parh-t aa sehsaakirt aa ko-ee parh ai puraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਪੜਤਾ  ਸਹਸਾਿਕਰਤਾ  ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and chant it on their malas,focusing on it in meditation.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee naam japai japmaalee laagai tisai Dh i-aanaa.

lines.english: I know nothing, now or ever; I recognize only Your One Name, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ab hee kab hee kichhoo na jaanaa t ayraa ayko naam pachh aanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not know, Lord, what my condition shall be.
lines.transliteration: na jaanaa haray mayree kavan gat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਹਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ  ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.english: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Please, save my honor and myself-respect. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 1) ham moorakh agi-aan saran parabh  tayree kar kirpaa raakh o mayree laaj pat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਿਗਆਨ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ  ਪਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sometimes, the soul soars high in the heavens, and sometimes it falls to the depths ofthe nether regions.
lines.transliteration: kabhoo jee-arhaa oobh  charh at hai kabhoo jaa-ay pa-i-aalay.

lines.english: The greedy soul does not remain stable; it searches in the four directions. ||2||
lines.transliteration: lobhee jee-arh aa thir na rahat  hai chaaray kundaa bh aalay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੂ ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਊਿਭ ਚੜਤੁ  ਹੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ  ਪਇਆਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: With death pre-ordained, the soul comes into the world, gathering the riches of life.
lines.transliteration: maran likh aa-ay mandal meh aa-ay jeevan  saajeh maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਿਥਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਤੁ  ਹੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I see that some have already gone, O my Lord and Master; the burning fire is comingcloser! ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk chalay ham daykh ah su-aamee bh aahi balant ee aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣੁ  ਿਲਖਾਇ  ਮੰਡਲ ਮਿਹ ਆਏ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਸਾਜਿਹ  ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: No one has any friend, and no one has any brother; no one has any father or mother.
lines.transliteration: na kisee kaa meet na kisee kaa bh aa-ee naa kisai baap na maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਿਕ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭਾਿਹ  ਬਲੰਤੀ  ਆਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, if You bless me with Your Name, it shall be my help and support in theend. ||4||1|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (876-10) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak jay t oo dayveh ant ay ho-ay sakh aa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਿਕਸੀ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਿਕਸੀ  ਕਾ ਭਾਈ  ਨਾ ਿਕਸੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Your Light is prevailing everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sarab jot t ayree pasar rahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah narharee. ||1||

lines.english: Please rid me of the desire to live, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: jeevan talab nivaar su-aamee.

lines.english: My mind is entangled in the deep dark pit of Maya. How can I cross over, O Lord and Master? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anDh koop maa-i-aa man gaadi-aa ki-o kar ut ara-o paar su-aamee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He dwells deep within, inside the heart; how can He not be outside as well?
lines.transliteration: jah bheet ar ghat bheetar basi-aa baahar kaahay naahee.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master always takes care of us, and keeps us in His thoughts. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kee saar karay nit  saahib sad aa chint  man maahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਿਪ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਗਾਿਡਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਉਤਰਉ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is near at hand, and He is far away.
lines.transliteration: aapay nayrhai aapay d oor.

lines.english: He Himself is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarab rahi-aa bharpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਘਟ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਬਿਸਆ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled. pMnw 877
lines.transliteration: satgur milai anDh ayraa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: There is doubt within me, and Maya is outside; it hits me in the eyes like an arrow.
lines.transliteration: antar sahsaa baahar maa-i-aa nain ee laagas ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਨੈਣੀ  ਲਾਗਿਸ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slaves: such a mortal suffers terribly. ||4||2|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (877-2) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak d aasan d aasaa part aapehgaa paraan ee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ਪਰਤਾਪਿਹਗਾ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Where is that door, where You live, O Lord? What is that door called? Among alldoors, who can find that door?
lines.transliteration: jit dar vaseh kavan d ar kahee-ai d araa bh eetar dar kavan lahai.

lines.english: For the sake of that door, I wander around sadly, detached from the world; if onlysomeone would come and tell me about that door. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis dar kaaran  firaa ud aasee so d ar ko-ee aa-ay kahai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਦਿਰ ਵਸਿਹ  ਕਵਨੁ ਦਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਦਰਾ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਦਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: How can I cross over the world-ocean?
lines.transliteration: kin biDh saagar t aree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਦਰ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਿਫਰਾ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ  ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: While I am living, I cannot be dead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeevti-aa nah maree-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Pain is the door, and anger is the guard; hope and anxiety are the two shutters.
lines.transliteration: dukh darvaajaa rohu rakh vaalaa aasaa and aysaa d u-ay pat jarh ay.

lines.english: Maya is the water in the moat; in the middle of this moat, he has built his home. The Primal Lord sits in the Seat of Truth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa jal khaa-ee paan ee gh ar baaDh i-aa sat  kai aasan  purakh  rahai. ||2||

lines.english: You have so many Names, Lord, I do not know their limit. There is no other equal toYou.
lines.transliteration: kintay naamaa ant  na jaan i-aa tum sar naahee avar haray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ  ਰੋਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ  ਆਸਾ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਦੁਇ ਪਟ ਜੜੇ ॥
lines.english: Do not speak out loud - remain in your mind. The Lord Himself knows, and He Himselfacts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oochaa nahee kahnaa man meh rahn aa aapay jaan ai aap karay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਲੁ ਖਾਈ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਘਰੁ ਬਾਿਧਆ  ਸਤ ਕੈ ਆਸਿਣ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As long as there is hope, there is anxiety; so how can anyone speak of the One Lord?
lines.transliteration: jab aasaa andaysaa t ab hee ki-o kar ayk kahai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕੰਤੇ  ਨਾਮਾ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਵਰੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: In the midst of hope, remain untouched by hope; then, O Nanak, you shall meet theOne Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aasaa bheet ar rahai niraasaa t a-o naanak ayk milai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚਾ  ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਰਹਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In this way, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: in biDh saagar t aree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਆਸਾ  ਅੰਦੇਸਾ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.english: This is the way to remain dead while yet alive. ||1||Second Pause||3|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (877-9) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jeevti-aa i-o maree-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਰਹੈ ਿਨਰਾਸਾ  ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੁ ਿਮਲੈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Awareness of the Shabad and the Teachings is my horn; the people hear the sound of its vibrations.
lines.transliteration: surat sabad  saakh ee mayree siny ee baajai lok sun ay.

lines.english: Honor is my begging-bowl, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity Ireceive. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pat jh olee mangan  kai taa-ee bh eekhi-aa naam parh ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, Gorakh is the Lord of the Universe; He is always awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: baabaa gorakh jaagai.

lines.english: He alone is Gorakh, who sustains the earth; He created it in an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gorakh so jin go-ay uth aalee kart ay baar na laagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Binding together water and air, He infused the breath of life into the body, and madethe lamps of the sun and the moon.
