lines.transliteration: paanee paraan  pavan  banDh  raakh ay chand  sooraj mukh  dee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਾਖੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਿਸੰਙੀ  ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
lines.english: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan  ka-o Dh artee deenee ayt ay gun  visray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ  ਮੰਗਣ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ਭੀਿਖਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: There are so many Siddhas, seekers, Yogis, wandering pilgrims, spiritual teachers andgood people.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik ar jogee jangam peer puras bahut ayray.

lines.english: If I meet them, I chant the Lord's Praises, and then, my mind serves Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay tin milaa t a keerat  aakh aa taa man sayv karay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਰਖੁ  ਸੋ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ  ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Paper and salt, protected by ghee, remain untouched by water, as the lotus remainsunaffected in water.
lines.transliteration: kaagad loon  rahai gh arit sangay paan ee kamal rahai.

lines.english: Those who meet with such devotees, O servant Nanak - what can death do to them? ||4||4|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (877-14) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aisay bhagat  mileh jan naanak t in jam ki-aa karai. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਣੀ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਪਵਿਣ  ਬੰਿਧ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਦੀਏ ॥
lines.english: Listen, Machhindra, to what Nanak says.
lines.transliteration: sun maachh indaraa naanak bolai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣ  ਜੀਵਣ  ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ  ਦੀਨੀ  ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਿਵਸਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who subdues the five passions does not waver.
lines.transliteration: vasgat panch karay nah dolai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੰਗਮ  ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: One who practices Yoga in such a way,
lines.transliteration: aisee jugat jog ka-o paalay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਤਨ ਿਮਲਾ ਤ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਆਖਾ  ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarai saglay kul t aaray. ||1|| saves himself, and saves all his generations. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਿਘਰ੍ਤ  ਸੰਗੇ ਪਾਣੀ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone is a hermit, who attains such understanding.
lines.transliteration: so a-uDhoot  aisee mat  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਮੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Day and night, he remains absorbed in deepest Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ahinis sunn samaaDh samaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He begs for loving devotion to the Lord, and lives in the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: bhikh i-aa bh aa-ay bh agat bhai chalai.

lines.english: He is satisfied, with the priceless gift of contentment.
lines.transliteration: hovai so taripat  santokh amulai.

lines.english: Dhi-aan roop ho-ay aasan  paavai. Becoming the embodiment of meditation, he attains the true Yogic posture.
He focuses his consciousness in the deep trance of the True Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach naam taarh ee chit  laavai. ||2||

lines.english: Nanak chants the Ambrosial Bani.
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai amrit ban ee.

lines.english: Listen, O Machhindra: this is the insignia of the true hermit.
lines.transliteration: sun maachh indaraa a-oDh oo neesaan ee.

lines.english: One who, in the midst of hope, remains untouched by hope,
lines.transliteration: aasaa maahi niraas valaa-ay.
nihcha-o naanak kartay paa-ay. ||3|| shall truly find the Creator Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I share the mysterious secrets of God.
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak agam sun aa-ay.

lines.english: The Guru and His disciple are joined together!
lines.transliteration: gur chaylay kee sanDh milaa-ay.

lines.english: One who eats this food, this medicine of the Teachings, pMnw 878
lines.transliteration: deekh i-aa d aaroo bh ojan kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chhi-a d arsan kee sojh ee paa-ay. ||4||5|| has the wisdom of the six Shaastras. ||4||5|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (878-1) raamkalee mehlaa 1.

lines.english: My boat is wobbly and unsteady; it is filled with sins. The wind is rising - what if it tipsover?
lines.transliteration: ham dolat bayrh ee paap bh aree hai pavan  lagai mat  jaa-ee.

lines.english: As sunmukh, I have turned to the Guru; O my Perfect Master; please be sure to blessme with Your glorious greatness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sanmukh siDh  bhaytan  ka-o aa-ay nihcha-o d eh vadi-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਡੋਲਤ  ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਪ ਭਰੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ  ਲਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Guru, my Saving Grace, please carry me across the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: gur taar t aaran haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਨਮੁਖ  ਿਸਧ ਭੇਟਣ  ਕਉ ਆਏ  ਿਨਹਚਉ  ਦੇਿਹ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Bless me with devotion to the perfect, imperishable Lord God; I am a sacrifice to You.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deh bh agat pooran avinaasee ha-o t ujh ka-o balihaari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He alone is a Siddha, a seeker, a Yogi, a wandering pilgrim, who meditates on theOne Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik jogee ar jangam ayk siDh  jinee Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਹ ਭਗਿਤ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਿਵਨਾਸੀ  ਹਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Touching the feet of the Lord Master, they are emancipated; they come to receive theWord of the Teachings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parsat pair sijh at tay su-aamee akh ar jin ka-o aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: I know nothing of charity, meditation, self-dis cipline or religious rituals; I only chant Your Name, God.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam na jaanaa naam japee parabh  tayraa.

lines.english: Nanak has met the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God; through the True Word of HisShabad, he is set free. ||3||6|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (878-6) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar naanak bhayti-o saachai sabad  nibayraa. ||3||6||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਸਤ  ਪੈਰ ਿਸਝਤ  ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਖਰੁ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Focus your consciousness in deep absorption on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: surtee surat  ralaa-ee-ai ayt .

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Make your body a raft, to cross over.
lines.transliteration: tan kar t ulhaa langh eh jayt .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਿਨਬੇਰਾ  ॥੩॥੬॥
lines.english: Deep within is the fire of desire; keep it in check.
lines.transliteration: antar bh aahi t isai too rakh .

lines.english: Day and night, that lamp shall burn unceasingly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ahinis deevaa balai athak. ||1||

lines.english: Float such a lamp upon the water;
lines.transliteration: aisaa deevaa neer t araa-ay.
jit deevai sabh  sojhee paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. this lamp will bring total understanding. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: This understanding is good clay;
lines.transliteration: hachhee mitee sojh ee ho-ay.
taa kaa kee-aa maanai so-ay. a lamp made of such clay is acceptable to the Lord.

lines.english: So shape this lamp on the wheel of good actions.
lines.transliteration: karnee t ay kar chakahu dh aal.

lines.english: In this world and in the next, this lamp shall be with you. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aithai othai nibhee naal. ||2||

lines.english: When He Himself grants His Grace,
lines.transliteration: aapay nadar karay jaa so-ay.
gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ay. then, as Gurmukh, one may understand Him.

lines.english: Within the heart, this lamp is permanently lit.
lines.transliteration: tit ghat deevaa nihchal ho-ay.

lines.english: It is not extinguished by water or wind.
lines.transliteration: paanee marai na bujh aa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Such a lamp will carry you across the water. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aisaa deevaa neer t araa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Wind does not shake it, or put it out.
lines.transliteration: dolai vaa-o na vadaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Its light reveals the Divine Throne.
lines.transliteration: jaapai ji-o singhaasan  lo-ay.

lines.english: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas
lines.transliteration: khatree baraahman  sood  ke vais.
nirat na paa-ee-aa gan ee sahaNs. cannot find its value, even by thousands of calculations.

lines.english: If any of them lights such a lamp,
lines.transliteration: aisaa deevaa baalay ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, he is emancipated. ||4||7|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (878-12) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so paarangat ho-ay. ||4||7||

lines.english: To place one's faith in Your Name, Lord, is true worship.
lines.transliteration: tuDhno nivan  manan  tayraa naa-o.

lines.english: With an offering of Truth, one obtains a place to sit.
lines.transliteration: saach bhayt baisan  ka-o thaa-o.

lines.english: If a prayer is offered with truth and contentment,
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh hovai ard aas.
taa sun  sad bahaalay paas. ||1|| the Lord will hear it, and call him in to sit by Him. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, no one returns empty-handed;
lines.transliteration: naanak birthaa ko-ay na ho-ay.
aisee dargeh saachaa so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. such is the Court of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The treasure I seek is the gift of Your Grace.
lines.transliteration: paraapat pot aa karam pasaa-o.

lines.english: Please bless this humble beggar - this is what I seek.
lines.transliteration: too dayveh mangat  jan chaa-o.

lines.english: Please, pour Your Love into the cup of my heart.
lines.transliteration: bhaadai bh aa-o pavai t it aa-ay.

lines.english: Dhur t ai chh odee keemat  paa-ay. ||2|| This is Your pre-determined value. ||2||
The One who created everything, does everything.
lines.transliteration: jin kichh kee-aa so kichh  karai.

lines.english: He Himself appraises His own value.
lines.transliteration: apnee keemat aapay Dh arai.

lines.english: The Sovereign Lord King becomes manifest to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pargat ho-aa har raa-ay.

lines.english: He does not come, and He does not go. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: People curse at the beggar; by begging, he does not receive honor.
lines.transliteration: lok Dhikaar kahai mangat  jan maagat  maan na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Lord, You inspire me to speak Your Words, and tell the Story of Your Court. ||4||8|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (878-18) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sah kee-aa galaa dar kee-aa baat aa tai taa kahan  kahaa-i-aa. ||4||8||

lines.english: The drop is in the ocean, and the ocean is in the drop. Who understands, and knowsthis?
lines.transliteration: saagar meh boond boond  meh saagar kavan  bujhai biDh  jaanai.

lines.english: He Himself creates the wondrous play of the world. He Himself contemplates it, and understands its true essence. ||1|| pMnw 879
lines.transliteration: ut-bh uj chalat  aap kar cheenai aapay t at pachh aanai. ||1||

lines.english: How rare are those who contemplate this spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: aisaa gi-aan beechaarai ko-ee.

lines.english: Through this, the supreme state of liberation is attained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis tay mukat  param gat  ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The night is in the day, and the day is in the night. The same is true of hot and cold.
lines.transliteration: din meh rain  rain meh d inee-ar usan seet  biDh so-ee.

lines.english: No one else knows His state and extent; without the Guru, this is not understood. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa kee gat  mit avar na jaan ai gur bin samajh  na ho-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨ  ਮਿਹ ਰੈਿਣ ਰੈਿਣ ਮਿਹ ਿਦਨੀਅਰੁ ਉਸਨ  ਸੀਤ ਿਬਿਧ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The female is in the male, and the male is in the female. Understand this, O God-realized being!
lines.transliteration: purakh meh naar naar meh purkh aa boojh hu barahm gi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਮਝ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhun meh Dh i-aan Dh i-aan meh jaani-aa gurmukh  akath kahaanee. ||3|| The meditation is in the music, and knowledge is in meditation. Become Gurmukh,and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਖ  ਮਿਹ ਨਾਿਰ  ਨਾਿਰ  ਮਿਹ ਪੁਰਖਾ  ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Light is in the mind, and the mind is in the Light. The Guru brings the five sensestogether, like brothers.
lines.transliteration: man meh jot jot  meh manoo-aa panch milay gur bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨ ਮਿਹ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine love for the One Word of theShabad. ||4||9|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (879-5) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai sad  balihaaree jin ayk sabad  liv laa-ee. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ ਜੋਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੰਚ ਿਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord God showered His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: jaa har parabh kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਜਨ ਏਕ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: taa ha-umai vichahu maaree. egotism was eradicated from within me.

lines.english: That humble servant who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is very dear to the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so sayvak raam pi-aaree. jo gur sabdee beechaaree. ||1||

lines.english: That humble servant of the Lord is pleasing to his Lord God;
lines.transliteration: so har jan har parabh bh aavai.

ahinis bhagat  karay d in raat ee laaj chh od har kay gun  gaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o. day and night, he performs devotional worship, day and night. Disregarding his ownhonor, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Dhun vaajay anhad  ghoraa. The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds;

lines.transliteration: man maani-aa har ras moraa. my mind is appeased by the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, I am absorbed in Truth.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai sach samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਲਾਜ  ਛੋਿਡ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, I have found the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur aad purakh  har paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Gurbani is the sound current of the Naad, the Vedas, everything.
lines.transliteration: sabh naad  bayd  gurbaan ee.

lines.english: My mind is attuned to the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: man raataa saarigpaan ee.

lines.english: He is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage, fasting and austere self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: tah tirath varat  tap saaray.

lines.english: The Lord saves, and carries across, those who meet with the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur mili-aa har nistaaray. ||3||

lines.english: One whose self-conceit is gone, sees his fears run away.
lines.transliteration: jah aap ga-i-aa bha-o bh aagaa.

lines.english: That servant grasps the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: gur charnee sayvak laagaa.

lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, has expelled my doubts.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur bh aram chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have merged into the Word of the Shabad. ||4||10|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (879-12) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sabad milaa-i-aa. ||4||10||

lines.english: He runs around, begging for clothes and food.
lines.transliteration: chhaad an bh ojan maagat  bhaagai.

lines.english: He burns with hunger and corruption, and will suffer in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: khuDh i-aa d usat jalai d ukh aagai.

lines.english: He does not follow the Guru's Teachings; through his evil-mindedness, he loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: gurmat nahee leenee d urmat  pat kho-ee.

lines.english: Only through the Guru's Teachings will such a person become devoted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmat bh agat paavai jan ko-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The way of the Yogi is to dwell in the celestial home of bliss.
lines.transliteration: jogee jugat sahj gh ar vaasai.

lines.english: He looks impartially, equally upon all. He re ceives the charity of the Lord's Love, and the Word of the Shabad, and so he is satisfied. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk darisat ayko kar d aykhi-aa bh eekhi-aa bh aa-ay sabad  tariptaasai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The five bulls, the senses, pull the wagon of the body around.
lines.transliteration: panch bail gadee-aa dayh Dh aaree.

lines.english: By the Lord's power, one's honor is preserved.
lines.transliteration: raam kalaa nibhai pat saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Dhar t ootee gaado sir bh aar. But when the axle breaks, the wagon falls and crashes.
It falls apart, like a pile of logs. ||2||
lines.transliteration: lakree bikhar jaree manjh  bhaar. ||2||

lines.english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, Yogi.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad veechaar jogee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਏਕੋ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਭੀਿਖਆ  ਭਾਇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same, sorrow and separation.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  sam karn aa sog bi-ogee.

lines.english: Let your food be contemplative meditation upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bhugat  naam gur sabad  beechaaree.

lines.english: Your wall shall be permanent, by meditating on the Formless Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: asthir kanDh japai nirankaaree. ||3||

lines.english: Wear the loin-cloth of poise, and be free of entanglements.
lines.transliteration: sahj jagotaa banDhan t ay chh ootaa.

lines.english: The Guru's Word shall release you from sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh gur sabd ee lootaa.

lines.english: In your mind, let your ear-rings be the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man meh mundraa har gur sarn aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, worshipping the Lord in deep devotion, the humble are carried across.||4||11|| pMnw 880 <> siqgur pRswid ] (880-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwmklI mhlw 3 Gru 1 ] (880-1) raamkalee mehlaa 3 ghar 1. Raamkalee, Third Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam bhagat  jan tarnaa. ||4||11||

lines.english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone spoke the Truth.
lines.transliteration: satjug sach kahai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.english: In each and every home, devotional worship was performed by the people, according to the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar bhagat gurmukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: In that Golden Age, Dharma had four feet.
lines.transliteration: satjug Dh aram pair hai chaar.

lines.english: How rare are those people who, as Gurmukh, contemplate this and understand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai ko beechaar. ||1||

lines.english: In all four ages, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory and greatness.
lines.transliteration: jug chaaray naam vadi-aa-ee ho-ee.

lines.english: One who holds tight to the Naam is liberated; without the Guru, no one obtains theNaam. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: je naam laagai so mukat hovai gur bin naam na paavai ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, one leg was removed.
lines.transliteration: tarayt ai ik kal keenee d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਸੋ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hypocrisy became prevalent, and people thought that the Lord was far away.
lines.transliteration: pakhand vart i-aa har jaan an door.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs still understood and realized;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai sojh ee ho-ee.
antar naam vasai sukh  ho-ee. ||2|| the Naam abided deep within them, and they were at peace. ||2||

lines.english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, duality and double-mindedness arose.
lines.transliteration: du-aapur d oojai d ubiDh aa ho-ay.

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, they knew duality.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaanay jaan eh do-ay.

lines.english: In this Brass Age, Dharma was left with only two feet.
lines.transliteration: du-aapur Dh aram d u-ay pair rakh aa-ay.

lines.english: Those who became Gurmukh implanted the Naam deep within. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai t a naam drirh -aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, Dharma was left with only one power.
lines.transliteration: kaljug Dharam kalaa ik rahaa-ay.

lines.english: It walks on just one foot; love and emotional attachment to Maya have increased.
lines.transliteration: ik pair chalai maa-i-aa moh vaDhaa-ay.

lines.english: Love and emotional attachment to Maya bring total darkness.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh at gubaar.

lines.english: If someone meets the True Guru, he is saved, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai naam uDh aar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਪੈਿਰ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Throughout the ages, there is only the One True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh jug meh saachaa ayko so-ee.

lines.english: Among all, is the True Lord; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh sach d oojaa nahee ko-ee.

lines.english: Praising the True Lord, true peace is attained.
lines.transliteration: saachee keerat sach sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਚਾ  ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, chant the Naam. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam vakh aanai ko-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਸਚੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Throughout all the ages, the Naam is the ultimate, the most sublime.
lines.transliteration: sabh jug meh naam oot am ho-ee.

lines.english: How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, understand this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee.

lines.english: One who meditates on the Lord's Name is a humble devotee.
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aa-ay bh agat jan so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਤਮੁ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in each and every age, the Naam is glory and greatness. ||6||1|| rwmklI mhlw 4 Gru 1  (880-11) raamkalee mehlaa 4 ghar 1 Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (880-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jug jug naam vadi-aa-ee ho-ee. ||6||1||

lines.english: If someone is very fortunate, and is blessed with great high destiny, then he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jay vad bhaag hoveh vadbh aagee t aa har har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace, and merges in the Naam.||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japat naamay sukh  paavai har naamay naam samaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥੧॥
lines.english: O mortal, as Gurmukh, worship the Lord in devotion forever.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat karahu sad  paraan ee.

lines.english: Your heart shall be illumined; through the Guru's Teachings, lovingly attune yourselfto the Lord. You shall merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hirdai pargaas hovai liv laagai gurmat  har har naam samaan ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver is filled with diamonds, emeralds, rubies and pearls;
lines.transliteration: heeraa ratan javayhar maan ak baho saagar bh arpoor kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis vad bhaag hovai vad mast ak tin gurmat  kadh  kadh  lee-aa. ||2|| one who has good fortune and great destiny inscribed upon his forehead, digs themout, by following the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the jewel, the emerald, the ruby; digging it out, the Guru hasplaced it in your palm.
lines.transliteration: ratan javayhar laal har naamaa gur kaadh  talee d ikhlaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The unfortunate, self-willed manmukh does not obtain it; this priceless jewel remainshidden behind a curtain of straw. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaagheen  manmukh  nahee lee-aa t arin olai laakh  chhapaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: If such pre-ordained destiny is written upon one's forehead, then the True Guru enjoins him to serve Him.
lines.transliteration: mastak bh aag hovai Dh ur likh i-aa taa sat gur sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰਾ  ਰਤਨ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਮਾਣਕ  ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰ  ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, then he obtains the jewel, the gem; blessed, blessed is that one who followsthe Guru's Teachings, and finds the Lord. ||4||1|| rwmklI mhlw 4 ] (880-18) raamkalee mehlaa 4. Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ratan javayhar paavai Dh an Dh an gurmat  har paa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਿਢ  ਕਿਢ  ਲੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, I am in ecstasy; they preach thesublime sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam janaa mil bha-i-aa anand aa har neekee kathaa sunaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਿਢ  ਤਲੀ ਿਦਖਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, one is blessed with understanding. ||1|| pMnw 881
lines.transliteration: durmat  mail ga-ee sabh  neekal sat sangat  mil buDh  paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O humble servant of the Lord, follow the Guru's Teachings, and chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam jan gurmat raam bolaa-ay.

lines.english: Whoever hears and speaks it is liberated; chanting the Lord's Name, one isembellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jo sunai kahai so mukt aa raam japat  sohaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ  ਸੋਹਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If someone has supremely high destiny written on his forehead, the Lord leads him to meet the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jay vad bhaag hoveh mukh  mast ak har raam janaa bh aytaa-ay.

lines.english: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, which shall ridme of all poverty and pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: darsan sant  dayh kar kirpaa sabh  daalad  dukh leh jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਭੇਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's people are good and sublime; the unfortunate ones do not like them at all.
lines.transliteration: har kay log raam jan neekay bhaagheen  na sukh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The more the Lord's exalted servants speak of Him, the more the slanderers attackand sting them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o raam kaheh jan oochay nar nindak dans lagaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ  ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dharig Dh arig nar nind ak jin jan nahee bh aa-ay har kay sakh aa sakh aa-ay. Cursed, cursed are the slanderers who do not like the humble, the friends andcompanions of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਜਉ  ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿਹ  ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਰ ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਡੰਸੁ ਲਗਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who do not like the honor and glory of the Guru are faithless, black-faced thieves, who have turned their backs on the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: say har kay chor vaimukh mukh  kaalay jin gur kee paij na bh aa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਨਰ ਿਨੰਦਕ ਿਜਨ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਏ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Have mercy, have mercy, please save me, Dear Lord. I am meek and humble - I seekYour protection.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa d a-i-aa kar raakh o har jee-o ham d een tayree sarn aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚੋਰ ਵੇਮੁਖ  ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਨ ਭਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: I am Your child, and You are my father, God. Please forgive servant Nanak and mergehim with Yourself. ||5||2|| rwmklI mhlw 4 ] (881-7) raamkalee mehlaa 4. Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ham baarik tum pit aa parabh  mayray jan naanak bakh as milaa-ay. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਹਮ ਦੀਨ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The friends of the Lord, the humble, Holy Saints are sublime; the Lord spreads out Hisprotecting hands above them.
lines.transliteration: har kay sakhaa saaDh  jan neekay t in oopar haath vat aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਤੁਮ ਿਪਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are the Holy Saints, pleasing to God; in His mercy, He blends themwith Himself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saaDh  say-ee parabh  bhaa-ay kar kirpaa aap milaavai. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, my mind longs to meet with the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam mo ka-o har jan mayl man bhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਊਪਿਰ  ਹਾਥੁ ਵਤਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The sweet, subtle essence of the Lord is immortalizing ambrosia. Meeting the Saints, Idrink it in. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ami-o ami-o har ras hai meethaa mil sant  janaa mukh  paavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਧ ਸੇਈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਏ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's people are the most lofty and exalted. Meeting with them, the most exaltedstatus is obtained.
lines.transliteration: har kay log raam jan ootam mil oot am pad vee paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਮੇਿਲ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: I am the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves; my Lord and Master is pleased with me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ham hovat chayree d aas d aasan kee mayraa th aakur kh usee karaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਮਉ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servant serves; one who enshrines love for the Lord in his heart, mindand body is very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: sayvak jan sayveh say vadbhaagee rid  man t an pareet  lagaavai.

lines.english: One who talks too much without love, speaks falsely, and obtains only false rewards. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin pareetee karahi baho baat aa koorh  bol koorh o fal paavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਊਤਮ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Take pity on me, O Lord of the World, O Great Giver; let me fall at the feet of theSaints.
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o Dhaar kirpaa jagjeevan d aatay har sant  pagee lay paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਤ  ਚੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I would cut off my head, and cut it into pieces, O Nanak, and set it down for theSaints to walk upon. ||4||3|| rwmklI mhlw 4 ] (881-13) raamkalee mehlaa 4. Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o kaata-o kaat baadh sir raakh a-o jit  naanak sant  charh  aavai. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਜਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਰਦ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: If I am blessed with supreme high destiny, I will meet the humble servants of theLord, without delay.
lines.transliteration: jay vad bhaag hoveh vad mayray jan mild i-aaN dhil na laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤੀ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ ਕੂੜੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servants are pools of ambrosial nectar; by great good fortune, onebathes in them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jan amrit kunt sar neekay vadbh aagee t it naavaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਪਗੀ  ਲੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, let me work for the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam mo ka-o har jan kaarai laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਕਾਟਉ ਕਾਿਟ  ਬਾਿਢ  ਿਸਰੁ ਰਾਖਉ  ਿਜਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤੁ ਚਿੜ ਆਵੈ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: I carry water, wave the fan and grind the corn for them; I massage and wash theirfeet. I apply the dust of their feet to my forehead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o paanee pakh aa peesa-o sant  aagai pag mal mal Dh oor mukh  laa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord's humble servants are great, very great, the greatest and most exalted; they lead us to meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har jan vaday vaday vad oochay jo satgur mayl milaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਿਹ ਵਡ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਿਮਲਿਦਆ  ਿਢਲ  ਨ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: No one else is as great as the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on theLord, the Primal Being. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur jayvad avar na ko-ee mil sat gur purakh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰ ਨੀਕੇ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਨਾਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru find the Lord. My Lord and Mastersaves their honor.
lines.transliteration: satgur saran  paray t in paa-i-aa mayray th aakur laaj rakh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Some come for their own purposes, and sit before the Guru; they pretend to be in Samaadhi, like storks with their eyes closed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ik apnai su-aa-ay aa-ay baheh gur aagai ji-o bagul samaaDh  lagaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਪਾਣੀ  ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ  ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ  ਪਗ ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੂਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Associating with the wretched and the lowly, like the stork and the crow, is likefeeding on a carcass of poison.
lines.transliteration: bagulaa kaag neech kee sangat jaa-ay karang bikh oo mukh  laa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Nanak: O God, unite me with the Sangat, the Congregation. United with the Sangat, I will become a swan. ||4||4|| pMnw 882 rwmklI mhlw 4 ] (882-1) raamkalee mehlaa 4. Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl mayl parabh sangat  mil sangat  hans karaa-ee-ai. ||4||4||

lines.english: O True Guru, please be kind, and unite me with the Lord. My Sovereign Lord is the Beloved of my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: satgur d a-i-aa karahu har maylhu mayray pareet am paraan  har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: I am a slave; I fall at the Guru's feet. He has shown me the Path, the Way to my LordGod. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham chayree ho-ay lagah gur charnee jin har parabh  maarag panth d ikhaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of my Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: raam mai har har naam man bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਲਗਹ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have no friend except the Lord; the Lord is my father, my mother, my companion.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mai har bin avar na ko-ee baylee mayraa pitaa maat aa har sakh aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My breath of life will not survive for an instant, without my Beloved; unless I see Him, I will die, O my mother!
lines.transliteration: mayray ik khin paraan na raheh bin pareet am bin d aykhay mareh mayree maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਖਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an vad bh aag gur sarn ee aa-ay har gur mil d arsan paa-i-aa. ||2|| Blessed, blessed is my great, high destiny, that I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary.Meeting with the Guru, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||
I do not know or understand any other within my mind; I meditate and chant theLord's Chant.
lines.transliteration: mai avar na ko-ee soojhai boojh ai man har jap japa-o japaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਨ ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਿਹ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who lack the Naam, wander in shame; their noses are chopped off, bit by bit.||3||
lines.transliteration: naamheen fireh say naktay t in ghas gh as nak vaDh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Life of the World, rejuvenate me! O my Lord and Master, enshrine Your Name deep within my heart.
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o jagjeevan jeevaal lai su-aamee rid ant ar naam vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ  ਜਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, perfect is the Guru, the Guru. Meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam. ||4||5|| rwmklI mhlw 4 ] (882-8) raamkalee mehlaa 4. Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak guroo guroo hai pooraa mil satgur naam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਸੇ ਨਕਟੇ  ਿਤਨ ਘਿਸ  ਘਿਸ  ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is the Great, Primal Being; meeting Him, the Lord isenshrined within the heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa vadaa vad purakh  hai jit  mili-ai har ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਜੀਵਾਿਲ  ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has granted me the life of the soul; I meditate in remembrance on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-a daan gur poorai d ee-aa har amrit  naam samaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, the Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart.
lines.transliteration: raam gur har har naam kanth Dh aaray.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have heard His sermon, which pleases my mind; blessed, blessed is mygreat destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kathaa sun ee man bh aa-ee Dh an Dh an vad bh aag hamaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Millions, three hundred thirty millions of gods meditate on Him, but they cannot findHis end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: kot kot tayt ees Dh i-aavahi t aa kaa ant  na paavahi paaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: With sexual urges in their hearts, they beg for beautiful women; stretching out their hands, they beg for riches. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hirdai kaam kaamnee maageh riDh  maageh haath pasaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who chants the Praises of the Lord is the greatest of the great; the Gurmukhkeeps the Lord clasped to his heart.
lines.transliteration: har jas jap jap vadaa vadayraa gurmukh rakh a-o ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੰਿਠ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: If one is blessed with high destiny, he meditates on the Lord, who carries him acrossthe terrifying world-ocean. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay vad bhaag hoveh t aa japee-ai har bh a-ojal paar ut aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is close to His humble servant, and His humble servant is close to the Lord;He keeps His humble servant clasped to His Heart.
lines.transliteration: har jan nikat nikat har jan hai har raakhai kanth  jan Dh aaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord God is our father and mother. I am His child; the Lord cherishesme. ||4||6||18|| rwgu rwmklI mhlw 5 Gru 1  (882-15) raag raamkalee mehlaa 5 ghar 1 Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (882-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak pitaa maat aa hai har parabh  ham baarik har part ipaaray. ||4||6||18||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਿਟ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Have mercy on me, O Generous Giver, Lord of the meek; please do not consider mymerits and demerits.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahu deen kay d aatay mayraa gun  avgan  na beechaarahu ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮਨੀ  ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਿਰਿਧ  ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can dust be washed? O my Lord and Master, such is the state of mankind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maatee kaa ki-aa Dhopai su-aamee maan as kee gat  ayhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਜਿਪ ਜਪੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਖਉ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve the True Guru, and be at peace.
lines.transliteration: mayray man satgur sayv sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whatever you desire, you shall receive that reward, and you shall not be afflicted by pain any longer. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo ichhahu so-ee fal paavhu fir d ookh na vi-aapai ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਿਠ ਜਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He creates and adorns the earthen vessels; He infuses His Light within them.
lines.transliteration: kaachay bhaaday saaj nivaajay ant ar jot  samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥੬॥੧੮॥
lines.english: As is the destiny pre-ordained by the Creator, so are the deeds we do. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaisaa likhat  likhi-aa Dh ur kart ai ham t aisee kirat  kamaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He believes the mind and body are all his own; this is the cause of his coming andgoing.
lines.transliteration: man tan thaap kee-aa sabh  apnaa ayho aavan  jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਦੀਨ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ  ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He does not think of the One who gave him these; he is blind, entangled in emotional attachment. ||3|| pMnw 883
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa so chit  na aavai mohi anDh  laptaan aa. ||3||

lines.english: One who knows that God created him, reaches the Incomparable Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa so-ee parabh jaan ai har kaa mahal apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Worshipping the Lord, I sing His Glorious Praises. Nanak is Your slave. ||4||1|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (883-2) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karee har kay gun  gaavaa naanak d aas tumaaraa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ ਕਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Place yourself beneath all men's feet, and you will be uplifted; serve Him in this way.
lines.transliteration: pavahu charnaa t al oopar aavhu aisee sayv kamaavahu.

lines.english: Know that all are above you, and you shall find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapas tay oopar sabh  jaanhu ta-o dargeh sukh  paavhu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਹੁ ਚਰਣਾ  ਤਿਲ  ਊਪਿਰ ਆਵਹੁ ਐਸੀ  ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Saints, speak that speech which purifies the gods and sanctifies the divine beings. As Gurmukh, chant the Word of His Bani, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rwmklI, mÚ 5) santahu aisee kathahu kahaan ee. sur pavit ar nar d ayv pavit araa kh in bolhu gurmukh banee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਸ  ਤੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਸਭ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਉ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Renounce your fraudulent plans, and dwell in the celestial palace; do not call anyoneelse false.
lines.transliteration: parpanch chhod sahj gh ar baishu jh oothaa kahhu na ko-ee.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall receive the nine treasures; in this way, youshall find the essence of reality. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur milhu navai niDh  paavhu in biDh  tat bilo-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਖਨੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Eradicate doubt, and as Gurmukh, enshrine love for the Lord; understand your ownsoul, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: bharam chukaavahu gurmukh  liv laavhu aat am cheenahu bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Know that God is near at hand, and ever-present. How could you try to hurt anyone else? ||3||
lines.transliteration: nikat kar jaanhu sad aa parabh  haajar kis si-o karahu buraa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਸਹਜ  ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਸਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, your path shall be clear, and you shall easily meet yourLord and Master.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai maarag mukt aa sehjay milay su-aamee.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an say jan jinee kal meh har paa-i-aa jan naanak sad  kurbaanee. ||4||2|| Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, who, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, find theLord. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (883-8) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੁ  ਚੀਨਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Coming does not please me, and going does not bring me pain, and so my mind is notafflicted by disease.
lines.transliteration: aavat harakh  na jaavat  dookhaa nah bi-aapai man rognee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਿਕਸੁ ਿਸਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੁਰਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am in bliss forever, for I have found the Perfect Guru; my separation from the Lordis totally ended. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand gur pooraa paa-i-aa t a-o ut ree sagal bi-oganee. ||1||

lines.english: This is how I have joined my mind to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih biDh hai man jognee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਜਨੀ ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Attachment, sorrow, disease and public opinion do not affect me, and so, I enjoy thesubtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: moh sog rog log na bi-aapai tah har har har ras bh ognee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am pure in the heavenly realm, pure on this earth, and pure in the nether regions of the underworld. I remain apart from the people of the world.
lines.transliteration: surag pavitaraa mirat  pavit araa pa-i-aal pavit ar aloganee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਹਰਖ  ਨ ਜਾਵਤ  ਦੂਖਾ ਨਹ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਮਨ ਰੋਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Obedient to the Lord, I enjoy peace forever; wherever I look, I see the Lord ofglorious virtues. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aagi-aakaaree sadaa sukh  bhunchai jat  kat paykh a-o har gunee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਓਗਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no Shiva or Shakti, no energy or matter, no water or wind, no world of formthere,
lines.transliteration: nah siv saktee jal nahee pavnaa t ah akaar nahee mayd nee.
satgur jog kaa t ahaa nivaasaa jah avigat  naath agam Dh anee. ||3|| where the True Guru, the Yogi, dwells, where the Imperishable Lord God, theUnapproachable Master abides. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਤਹ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Body and mind belong to the Lord; all wealth belongs to the Lord; what gloriousvirtues of the Lord can I describe?
lines.transliteration: tan man har kaa Dh an sabh  har kaa har kay gun  ha-o ki-aa ganee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has destroyed my sense of 'mine and yours'. Like water withwater, I am blended with God. ||4||3|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (883-15) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ham tum gur kh o-ee hai ambh ai ambh  miloganee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਗ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਮਰਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ  ਪਇਆਲ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਅਲੋਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: It is beyond the three qualities; it remains untouched. The seekers and Siddhas do notknow it.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  rahat  rahai niraaree saaDh ik siDh  na jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਗਆਕਾਰੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There is a chamber filled with jewels, overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, in the Guru's Treasury. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ratan koth -rhee amrit  sampooran sat gur kai kh ajaanai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਿਸਵ ਸਕਤੀ  ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨਾ  ਤਹ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: This thing is wonderful and amazing! It cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: achraj kichh kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਕਾ ਤਹਾ ਿਨਵਾਸਾ  ਜਹ ਅਿਵਗਤ  ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗਮ  ਧਨੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: It is an unfathomable object, O Siblings of Destiny! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: basat agochar bh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਗਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Its value cannot be estimated at all; what can anyone say about it?
lines.transliteration: mol naahee kachh karn ai jogaa ki-aa ko kahai sun aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਿਰ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭੁ ਿਮਲੋਗਨੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: By speaking and describing it, it cannot be understood; only one who sees it realizesit. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kathan kahan ka-o sojh ee naahee jo paykh ai tis ban  aavai. ||2||

lines.english: Only the Creator Lord knows it; what can any poor creature do?
lines.transliteration: so-ee jaanai karnaihaaraa keet aa ki-aa baychaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਰਹਤ  ਰਹੈ ਿਨਰਾਰੀ  ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: Only He Himself knows His own state and extent. The Lord Himself is the treasureoverflowing. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapnee gat  mit aapay jaan ai har aapay poor bh andaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਕੋਠੜੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tasting such Ambrosial Nectar, the mind remains satisfied and satiated.
lines.transliteration: aisaa ras amrit man chaakh i-aa taripat  rahay aagh aa-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have found the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||4|| pMnw 884 rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (884-1) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayree aasaa pooree satgur kee sarn aa-ee. ||4||4||

lines.english: God has made me His own, and vanquished all my enemies.
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-aa parabh apnai bairee saglay saaDh ay.

lines.english: Those enemies who have plundered this world, have all been placed in bondage. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin bairee hai ih jag looti-aa tay bairee lai baaDh ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪਨੈ  ਬੈਰੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is my Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur parmaysar mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਬੈਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਿਟਆ  ਤੇ ਬੈਰੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I enjoy countless pleasures of power and tasty delights, chanting Your Name, andplacing my faith in You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik raaj bhog ras maan ee naa-o japee bh arvaasaa t ayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I do not think of any other at all. The Lord is my protector, above my head.
lines.transliteration: cheet na aavas d oojee baat aa sir oopar rakh vaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ  ਨਾਉ  ਜਪੀ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am carefree and independent, when I have the Support of Your Name, O my Lordand Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bayparvaahu rahat hai su-aamee ik naam kai aaDh aaraa. ||2||

lines.english: I have become perfect, meeting with the Giver of peace, and now, I lack nothing atall.
lines.transliteration: pooran ho-ay mili-o sukh-d aa-ee oon na kaa-ee baat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਿਸ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਬਾਤਾ  ਿਸਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਰਖਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the essence of excellence, the supreme status; I shall not forsake it to go anywhere else. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tat saar param pad  paa-i-aa chh od na kat hoo jaat aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਰਹਤ  ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I cannot describe how You are, O True Lord, unseen, infinite,
lines.transliteration: baran na saaka-o jaisaa too hai saachay alakh  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਇ ਿਮਿਲਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਬਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: atul athaah adol su-aamee naanak kh asam hamaaraa. ||4||5|| immeasurable, unfathomable and unmoving Lord. O Nanak, He is my Lord andMaster. ||4||5|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (884-7) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are wise; You are eternal and unchanging. You are my social class and honor.
lines.transliteration: too daanaa t oo abichal t oohee t oo jaat  mayree paat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are unmoving - You never move at all. How can I be worried? ||1||
lines.transliteration: too adol kad ay doleh naahee t aa ham kaisee t aatee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਤੁਲ  ਅਥਾਹ  ਅਡੋਲ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: You alone are the One and only Lord;
lines.transliteration: aykai aykai ayk toohee.

lines.english: You alone are the king.
lines.transliteration: aykai aykai too raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ  ਤੂ ਅਿਬਚਲੁ  ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਿਤ  ਮੇਰੀ ਪਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ta-o kirpaa t ay sukh  paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਡੋਲੁ  ਕਦੇ ਡੋਲਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੈਸੀ ਤਾਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the ocean, and I am Your swan; the pearls and rubies are in You.
lines.transliteration: too saagar ham hans t umaaray t um meh maan ak laalaa.

lines.english: You give, and You do not hesitate for an instant; I receive, forever enraptured. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tum d ayvhu t il sank na maanhu ham bh unchah sad aa nihaalaa. ||2||

lines.english: I am Your child, and You are my father; You place the milk in my mouth.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik tum pit aa hamaaray t um mukh  dayvhu kh eeraa.

lines.english: I play with You, and You caress me in every way. You are forever the ocean of excellence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham khaylah sabh  laad ladaaveh t um sad  gunee gaheeraa. ||3||

lines.english: You are perfect, perfectly all-pervading; I am fulfilled with You as well.
lines.transliteration: tum pooran poor rahay sampooran ham bh ee sang agh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਤੁਮ ਮਿਹ ਮਾਣਕ  ਲਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am merged, merged, merged and remain merged; O Nanak, I cannot describe it!||4||6|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (884-12) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: milat milat  milat  mil rahi-aa naanak kahan  na jaa-ay. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਸੰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਭੁੰਚਹ ਸਦਾ ਿਨਹਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Make your hands the cymbals, your eyes the tambourines, and your forehead theguitar you play.
lines.transliteration: kar kar taal pakh aavaj nainhu maathai vajeh rabaabaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਤੁਮ ਿਪਤਾ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਤੁਮ ਮੁਿਖ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਖੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let the sweet flute music resound in your ears, and with your tongue, vibrate thissong.
lines.transliteration: karnahu maDh baasuree baajai jihvaa Dh un aagaajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਖੇਲਹ  ਸਿਭ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਵਹ  ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Move your mind like the rhythmic hand-motions; do the dance, and shake your ankle bracelets. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nirat karay kar manoo-aa naachai aan ay gh ooghar saajaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ  ਹਮ ਭੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਅਘਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: This is the rhythmic dance of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam ko nirtikaaree.

lines.english: The Merciful Audience, the Lord, sees all your make-up and decorations. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paykhai paykh anhaar d a-i-aalaa jayt aa saaj seegaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The whole earth is the stage, with the canopy of the sky overhead.
lines.transliteration: aakhaar mandlee Dh aran sabaa-ee oopar gagan chand o-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਕਿਰ ਤਾਲ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ  ਨੈਨਹੁ ਮਾਥੈ ਵਜਿਹ  ਰਬਾਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: The wind is the director; people are born of water.
lines.transliteration: pavan vicholaa karat ikaylaa jal t ay opat  ho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ  ਬਾਜੈ ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਧੁਿਨ ਆਗਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: From the five elements, the puppet was created with its actions. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch tat  kar put raa keenaa kirat  milaavaa ho-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ  ਆਣੇ  ਘੂਘਰ  ਸਾਜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sun and the moon are the two lamps which shine, with the four corners of theworld placed between them.
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj d u-ay jaray charaagaa chahu kunt bh eetar raakh ay.

lines.english: The ten senses are the dancing girls, and the five passions are the chorus; they sittogether within the one body.
lines.transliteration: das paat a-o panch sangeet aa aykai bh eetar saathay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਖੈ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਜੇਤਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They all put on their own shows, and speak in different languages. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhinn bh inn ho-ay bh aav d ikhaaveh sabh ahu niraaree bh aakhay. ||3||

lines.english: In each and every home there is dancing, day and night; in each and every home, the bugles blow.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar nirat  hovai d in raat ee gh at ghat vaajai t ooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਾਰ  ਮੰਡਲੀ  ਧਰਿਣ  ਸਬਾਈ  ਊਪਿਰ  ਗਗਨੁ ਚੰਦੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Some are made to dance, and some are whirled around; some come and some go,and some are reduced to dust.
lines.transliteration: ayk nachaaveh ayk bhavaaveh ik aa-ay jaa-ay ho-ay Dh ooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਨੁ ਿਵਚੋਲਾ ਕਰਤ  ਇਕੇਲਾ  ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਿਤ  ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one who meets with the True Guru, does not have to dance the dance of reincarnation again. ||4||7|| pMnw 885 rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (885-1) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak so bahur na naachai jis gur bhaytai pooraa. ||4||7||

lines.english: He sings the song of the One Universal Creator; he sings the tune of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar ayk Dhun aykai aykai raag alaapai.

lines.english: He lives in the land of the One Lord, shows the way to the One Lord, and remainsattuned to the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykaa daysee ayk d ikhaavai ayko rahi-aa bi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਅੰਕਾਿਰ  ਏਕ ਧੁਿਨ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਰਾਗੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: He centers his consciousness on the One Lord, and serves only the One Lord, who isknown through the Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aykaa surat aykaa hee sayvaa ayko gur t ay jaapai. ||1||

lines.english: Blessed and good is such a kirtanee, who sings such Praises.
lines.transliteration: bhalo bh alo ray keerat nee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਏਕਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: raam ramaa raamaa gun gaa-o.
chhod maa-i-aa kay Dh anDh su-aa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. and renounces the entanglements and pursuits of Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: He makes the five virtues, like contentment, his musical instruments, and plays theseven notes of the love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: panch baajitar karay sant okhaa saat  suraa lai chaalai.

lines.english: The notes he plays are the renunciation of pride and power; his feet keep the beat onthe straight path.
lines.transliteration: baajaa maan t aan taj taanaa paa-o na beegaa gh aalai.

lines.english: He does not enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again; he keeps the One Word of the Shabad tied to the hem of his robe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: fayree fayr na hovai kab hee ayk sabad banDh  paalai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਜਤਰ੍  ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਸਾਤ ਸੁਰਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: To play like Naarad, is to know that the Lord is ever-present.
lines.transliteration: naardee narhar jaan  hadooray.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਜਾ  ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ  ਤਿਜ  ਤਾਨਾ  ਪਾਉ  ਨ ਬੀਗਾ  ਘਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: The tinkling of the ankle bells is the shedding of sorrows and worries.
lines.transliteration: ghoongar kh arhak ti-aag visooray.

lines.punjabi: ਫੇਰੀ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੰਿਧ ਪਾਲੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The dramatic gestures of acting are celestial bliss.
lines.transliteration: sahj anand dikh aavai bh aavai.

lines.english: Such a dancer is not reincarnated again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayhu nirtikaaree janam na aavai. ||3||

lines.english: If anyone, out of millions of people, becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master, he sings the Lord's Praises in this way.
lines.transliteration: jay ko apnay thaakur bh aavai. kot maDh  ayhu keert an gaavai.

lines.english: I have taken the Support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kee jaava-o tayk.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Kirtan of the One Lord's Praises are sung there. ||4||8|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (885-7) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis keert an ayk. ||4||8||

lines.english: Some call Him, 'Raam, Raam', and some call Him, 'Khudaa-i'.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee bolai raam raam ko-ee khud aa-ay.

lines.english: Some serve Him as 'Gusain', others as 'Allaah'. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee sayvai gus-ee-aa ko-ee alaahi. ||1||

lines.english: He is the Cause of causes, the Generous Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaaran karan  kareem.

lines.english: He showers His Grace and Mercy upon us. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa Dhaar raheem. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and some make the pilgrimage to Mecca.|
lines.transliteration: ko-ee naavai tirath ko-ee haj jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕੋਈ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some perform devotional worship services, and some bow their heads in prayer. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee karai poojaa ko-ee sir nivaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Some read the Vedas, and some the Koran.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee parhai bayd  ko-ee kat ayb.

lines.english: Some wear blue robes, and some wear white. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee odhai neel ko-ee supayd . ||3||

lines.english: Some call themselves Muslim, and some call themselves Hindu.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee kahai turak ko-ee kahai hind oo.

lines.english: Some yearn for paradise, and others long for heaven. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee baachhai bh isat ko-ee surgind oo. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਕੋਈ ਹਜ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of God's Will,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin hukam pachhaat aa.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh saahib kaa t in bhayd jaataa. ||5||9|| knows the secrets of his Lord and Master. ||5||9|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (885-12) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The wind merges into the wind.
lines.transliteration: pavnai meh pavan samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The light blends into the light.
lines.transliteration: jotee meh jot  ral jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The dust becomes one with the dust.
lines.transliteration: maatee maatee ho-ee ayk.

lines.english: What support is there for the one who is lamenting? ||1||
lines.transliteration: rovanhaaray kee kavan tayk. ||1||

lines.english: Who has died? O, who has died?
lines.transliteration: ka-un moo-aa ray ka-un moo-aa.

lines.english: O God-realized beings, meet together and consider this. What a wondrous thing hashappened! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: barahm gi-aanee mil karahu beechaaraa ih ta-o chalat  bha-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: No one knows what happens after death.
lines.transliteration: aglee kichh kh abar na paa-ee.

lines.english: The one who is lamenting will also arise and depart.
lines.transliteration: rovanhaar bhe ooth  siDhaa-ee.

lines.english: Mortal beings are bound by the bonds of doubt and attachment.
lines.transliteration: bharam moh kay baaNDhay banDh .

lines.english: When life becomes a dream, the blind man babbles and grieves in vain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: supan bha-i-aa bh akhlaa-ay anDh . ||2||

lines.english: The Creator Lord created this creation.
lines.transliteration: ih ta-o rachan rachi-aa kart aar.

lines.english: It comes and goes, subject to the Will of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavat jaavat  hukam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਚਲਤੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one dies; no one is capable of dying.
lines.transliteration: nah ko moo-aa na marnai jog.

lines.english: The soul does not perish; it is imperishable. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nah binsai abhinaasee hog. ||3||

lines.english: That which is known, does not exist.
lines.transliteration: jo ih jaanhu so ih naahi.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the one who knows this.
lines.transliteration: jaananhaaray ka-o bal jaa-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bharam chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: No one dies; no one comes or goes. ||4||10|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (885-18) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naa ko-ee marai na aavai jaa-i-aa. ||4||10||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: jap gobind gopaal laal.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, you shall live, and the Great Death shall not consume you ever again. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam simar too jeeveh fir na kh aa-ee mahaa kaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਨ ਮਰਣੈ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Through millions of incarnations, you have come, wandering, wandering, wandering. pMnw 886
lines.transliteration: kot janam bharam bh aram bh aram aa-i-o.

lines.english: By the highest destiny, you found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: badai bhaag saaDh sang paa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is saved.
lines.transliteration: bin gur pooray naahee uDhaar.

lines.english: This is what Baba Nanak says, after deep reflection. ||2||11|| rwgu rwmklI mhlw 5 Gru 2  (886-3) raag raamkalee mehlaa 5 ghar 2 Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (886-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: baabaa naanak aakhai ayhu beechaar. ||2||11||

lines.english: The four Vedas proclaim it, but you don't believe them.
lines.transliteration: chaar pukaareh naa too maaneh.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The six Shaastras also say one thing.
lines.transliteration: khat bh ee aykaa baat  vakh aaneh.

lines.english: The eighteen Puraanas all speak of the One God.
lines.transliteration: das astee mil ayko kahi-aa.

lines.english: Even so, Yogi, you do not understand this mystery. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa bh ee jogee bh ayd na lahi-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The celestial harp plays the incomparable melody,
lines.transliteration: kinkuree anoop vaajai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੋਗੀ  ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲਿਹਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jogee-aa matvaaro ray. ||1|| rahaa-o. but in your intoxication, you do not hear it, O Yogi. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: In the first age, the Golden Age, the village of truth was inhabited.
lines.transliteration: parathmay vasi-aa sat kaa kh ayrhaa.

lines.english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, things began to decline.
lines.transliteration: taritee-ay meh kichh  bha-i-aa d utayrhaa.

lines.english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, half of it was gone.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa arDh o araDh  samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Now, only one leg of Truth remains, and the One Lord is revealed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayk rahi-aa taa ayk d ikhaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The beads are strung upon the one thread.
lines.transliteration: aykai soot paro-ay man ee-ay.

lines.english: By means of many, various, diverse knots, they are tied, and kept separate on the string.
lines.transliteration: gaathee bh in bhin bhin bhin tanee-ay.

lines.english: The beads of the mala are lovingly chanted upon in many ways.
lines.transliteration: firtee maalaa baho biDh  bhaa-ay.

lines.english: When the thread is pulled out, the beads come together in one place. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khinchi-aa soot  ta aa-ee thaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Throughout the four ages, the One Lord made the body His temple.
lines.transliteration: chahu meh aykai mat hai kee-aa.

lines.english: It is a treacherous place, with several windows.
lines.transliteration: tah bikh -rhay thaan anik kh irhkee-aa.

lines.english: Searching and searching, one comes to the Lord's door.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat du-aaray aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਹੁ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੈ ਮਟੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Then, O Nanak, the Yogi attains a home in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||
lines.transliteration: taa naanak jogee mahal gh ar paa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Thus, the celestial harp plays the incomparable melody;
lines.transliteration: i-o kinkuree aanoop vaajai.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sun jogee kai man meeth ee laagai. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||1||12|| hearing it, the Yogi's mind finds it sweet. ||1||Second Pause||1||12|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (886-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The body is a patch-work of threads.
lines.transliteration: taagaa kar kai laa-ee thiglee.

lines.english: The muscles are stitched together with the needles of the bones.
lines.transliteration: la-o naarhee soo-aa hai ast ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਜੋਗੀ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਮੀਠੀ  ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord has erected a pillar of water.
lines.transliteration: ambhai kaa kar dandaa Dh ari-aa.

lines.english: O Yogi, why are you so proud? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa too jogee garbeh pari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate on your Lord Master, day and night.
lines.transliteration: jap naath din rainaa-ee.

lines.english: The patched coat of the body shall last for only a few days. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree kh inthaa d o dihaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Smearing ashes on your body, you sit in a deep meditative trance.
lines.transliteration: gahree bibhoot  laa-ay baith aa taarhee.

lines.english: You wear the ear-rings of 'mine and yours'.
lines.transliteration: mayree tayree mund raa Dh aaree.

lines.english: You beg for bread, but you are not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: maageh tookaa taripat  na paavai.

lines.english: Abandoning your Lord Master, you beg from others; you should feel ashamed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naath chhod jaacheh laaj na aavai. ||2||

lines.english: Your consciousness is restless, Yogi, as you sit in your Yogic postures.
lines.transliteration: chal chit jogee aasan  tayraa.

lines.english: You blow your horn, but still feel sad.
lines.transliteration: sinyee vaajai nit  udaasayraa.

lines.english: You do not understand Gorakh, your guru.
lines.transliteration: gur gorakh kee t ai boojh  na paa-ee.

lines.english: Again and again, Yogi, you come and go. ||3||
lines.transliteration: fir fir jogee aavai jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: He, unto whom the Master shows Mercy
lines.transliteration: jis no ho-aa naath kirpaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਥੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਲਾਜ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rahraas hamaaree gur gopaalaa. - unto Him, the Guru, the Lord of the World, I offer my prayer.

lines.english: One who has the Name as his patched coat, and the Name as his robe,
lines.transliteration: naamai khinthaa naamai bast ar.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, such a Yogi is steady and stable. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jogee ho-aa asthir. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਰਖ  ਕੀ ਤੈ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who meditates on the Master in this way, night and day,
lines.transliteration: i-o japi-aa naath din rainaa-ee.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hun paa-i-aa gur gosaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||2||13|| finds the Guru, the Lord of the World, in this life. ||1||Second Pause||2||13|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (886-17) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes;
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan so-ee.

lines.english: I do not see any other at all.
lines.transliteration: aan na deesai ko-ee.

lines.english: My Lord and Master is wise and all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: thaakur mayraa sugh arh sujaanaa.

lines.english: Meeting with the Gurmukh, I enjoy His Love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mili-aa rang maanaa. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the sweet, subtle essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aiso ray har ras meethaa.

lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, taste it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kinai virlai deeth aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Light of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord is immaculate and pure. pMnw 887
lines.transliteration: nirmal jot amrit  har naam.

lines.english: Drinking it in, one becomes immortal and free of desire.
lines.transliteration: peevat amar bh a-ay nihkaam.

lines.english: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, and the fire is extinguished.
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al agan nivaaree.

lines.english: Such a being is the embodiment of bliss, famous throughout the world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anad roop pargatay sansaaree. ||2||

lines.english: What can I offer You, Lord? Everything belongs to You.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa dayva-o jaa sabh  kichh  tayraa.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to You, hundreds of thousands of times.
lines.transliteration: sad balihaar jaa-o lakh  bayraa.

lines.english: You blessed me, and fashioned my body, mind and soul.
lines.transliteration: tan man jee-o pind d ay saaji-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, this lowly being was exalted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay neech nivaaji-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Opening the door, You summoned me to the Mansion of Your Presence.
lines.transliteration: khol kivaaraa mahal bulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: As You are, so You have revealed Yourself to me.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa d ikhlaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the screen is totally torn away;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sabh parh -daa tootaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
lines.english: I am Yours, and You are enshrined within my mind. ||4||3||14|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (887-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o tayraa t oo mai man vooth aa. ||4||3||14||

lines.english: He has linked His servant to His service.
lines.transliteration: sayvak laa-i-o apunee sayv.

lines.english: The Divine Guru has poured the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, into hismouth.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam d ee-o mukh  dayv.

lines.english: He has subdued all his anxiety.
lines.transliteration: saglee chintaa aap nivaaree.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o ha-o sad  balihaaree. ||1||

lines.english: The True Guru has perfectly resolved my affairs.
lines.transliteration: kaaj hamaaray pooray satgur.

lines.english: The True Guru vibrates the unstruck melody of the sound current. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baajay anhad t ooray sat gur. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: His Glory is profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: mahimaa jaa kee gahir gambheer.

lines.english: One whom He blesses with patience becomes blissful.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay nihaal day-ay jis Dh eer.

lines.english: One whose bonds are shattered by the Sovereign Lord
lines.transliteration: jaa kay banDhan kaatay raa-ay.
so nar bahur na jonee paa-ay. ||2|| is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||

lines.english: One who is illuminated by the Lord's radiance within,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai antar pargati-o aap.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o naahee d ookh santaap. is not touched by pain and sorrow.

lines.english: He holds in his robe the gems and jewels.
lines.transliteration: laal ratan t is paalai pari-aa.

lines.english: That humble being is saved, along with all his generations. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal kutamb oh jan lai tari-aa. ||3||

lines.english: He has no doubt, double-mindedness or duality at all.
lines.transliteration: naa kichh bh aram na d ubiDh aa doojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਓਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਤਿਰਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He worships and adores the One Immaculate Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk niranjan poojaa.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  daykh-a-u aap d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found God, the source of nectar. ||4||4||15|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (887-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh milay rasaal. ||4||4||15||

lines.english: My self-conceit has been eliminated from my body.
lines.transliteration: tan tay chh utkee apnee Dh aaree.

lines.english: The Will of God is dear to me.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee aagi-aa lagee pi-aaree.

lines.english: Whatever He does, seems sweet to my mind.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so man mayrai meeth aa.

lines.english: And then, these eyes behold the wondrous Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa ih achraj nainhu deeth aa. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I have become wise and my demons are gone.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi jaanee ray mayree ga-ee balaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: My thirst is quenched, and my attachment is dispelled. The Perfect Guru hasinstructed me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bujh ga-ee t arisan nivaaree mamt aa gur poorai lee-o samjh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In His Mercy, the Guru has kept me under His protection.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakhi-o gur sarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਜਾਨੀ  ਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has attached me to the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur pakraa-ay har kay charnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਿਝ ਗਈ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੀਓ  ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the mind is totally held in check,
lines.transliteration: bees bisu-ay jaa man thehraanay.
gur paarbarahm aykai hee jaanay. ||2|| one sees the Guru and the Supreme Lord God as one and the same. ||2||

lines.english: Whoever You have created, I am his slave.
lines.transliteration: jo jo keeno ham tis kay d aas.

lines.english: My God dwells in all.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayray ko sagal nivaas.

lines.english: I have no enemies, no adversaries.
lines.transliteration: naa ko doot  nahee bairaa-ee.

lines.english: I walk arm in arm, like brothers, with all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gal mil chaalay aykai bhaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ  ਹਮ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
lines.english: One whom the Guru, the Lord, blesses with peace,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o gur har dee-ay sookh aa.
taa ka-o bahur na laageh d ookhaa. does not suffer in pain any longer.

lines.english: He Himself cherishes all.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap sarab partipaal.

lines.english: Nanak is imbued with the love of the Lord of the World. ||4||5||16|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (887-17) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raata-o rang gopaal. ||4||5||16||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦੀਏ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
lines.english: You read the scriptures, and the commentaries,
lines.transliteration: mukh t ay parh -taa teekaa sahit .

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਹ  ਦੂਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hirdai raam nahee pooran rahat . but the Perfect Lord does not dwell in your heart.

lines.english: You preach to others to have faith,
lines.transliteration: updays karay kar lok d arirh-aavai.
apnaa kahi-aa aap na kamaavai. ||1|| but you do not practice what you preach. ||1||

lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: pandit bayd  beechaar pandit .

lines.english: Eradicate anger from your mind, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man kaa kroDh nivaar pandit . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You place your stone god before yourself, pMnw 888
lines.transliteration: aagai raakhi-o saal giraam.
man keeno dah d is bisraam. but your mind wanders in the ten directions.

lines.english: You apply a ceremonial tilak mark to its forehead, and fall at its feet.
lines.transliteration: tilak charaavai paa-ee paa-ay.

lines.english: You try to appease the people, and act blindly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: lok pachaaraa anDh kamaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: You perform the six religious rituals, and sit wearing your loin-cloth.
lines.transliteration: khat karmaa ar aasan  Dhotee.

lines.english: In the homes of the wealthy, you read the prayer book.
lines.transliteration: bhaagath  garihi parh ai nit pothee.

lines.english: You chant on your mala, and beg for money.
lines.transliteration: maalaa fayrai mangai bibhoot .

lines.english: No one has ever been saved in this way, friend. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih biDh ko-ay na t ari-o meet . ||3||

lines.english: He alone is a Pandit, who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: so pandit gur sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Maya, of the three qualities, leaves him.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  kee os ut ree maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਓਸੁ ਉਤਰੀ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The four Vedas are completely contained within the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: chatur bayd  pooran har naa-ay.
