lines.english: Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||6||17|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (888-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis kee sarn ee paa-ay. ||4||6||17||

lines.english: Millions of troubles do not come near him;
lines.transliteration: kot bighan nahee aavahi nayr.
anik maa-i-aa hai taa kee chayr. the many manifestations of Maya are his hand-maidens;
anik paap taa kay paaneehaar. countless sins are his water-carriers;

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਿਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o ma-i-aa bha-ee kart aar. ||1|| he is blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord. ||1||

lines.english: One who has the Lord God as his help and support
lines.transliteration: jisahi sahaa-ee ho-ay bhagvaan.
anik jatan u-aa kai saraNjaam. ||1|| rahaa-o. - all his efforts are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: He is protected by the Creator Lord; what harm can anyone do to him?
lines.transliteration: kartaa raakh ai keet aa ka-un.

lines.english: Even an ant can conquer the whole world.
lines.transliteration: keeree jeeto saglaa bh avan.

lines.english: His glory is endless; how can I describe it?
lines.transliteration: bay-ant mahimaa t aa kee kayt ak baran.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, to His feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaa-ee-ai taa kay charan. ||2||

lines.english: He alone performs worship, austerities and meditation;
lines.transliteration: tin hee kee-aa jap t ap Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ  ਬਰਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: anik parkaar kee-aa tin d aan. he alone is a giver to various charities;

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat  so-ee kal meh parvaan. he alone is approved in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga,
jaa ka-o thaakur d ee-aa maan. ||3|| whom the Lord Master blesses with honor. ||3||

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am enlightened.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil bh a-ay pargaas.

lines.english: I have found celestial peace, and my hopes are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sahj sookh aas nivaas.

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has blessed me with faith.
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur d ee-aa bisaas.

lines.english: Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||4||7||18|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (888-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ho-ay daasan d aas. ||4||7||18||

lines.english: Don't blame others, O people;
lines.transliteration: dos na d eejai kaahoo log.
jo kamaavan so-ee bhog. as you plant, so shall you harvest.

lines.english: By your actions, you have bound yourself.
lines.transliteration: aapan karam aapay hee banDh.

lines.english: You come and go, entangled in Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaavan maa-i-aa DhanDh . ||1||

lines.english: Such is the understanding of the Saintly people.
lines.transliteration: aisee jaanee sant janee.

lines.english: You shall be enlightened, through the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pargaas bha-i-aa pooray gur bachnee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Body, wealth, spouse and ostentatious displays are false.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an kalat  mithi-aa bisthaar.

lines.english: Horses and elephants will pass away.
lines.transliteration: haivar gaivar chaalanhaar.

lines.english: Power, pleasures and beauty are all false.
lines.transliteration: raaj rang roop sabh koor.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is reduced to dust. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa ho-ay jaasee Dhoor. ||2||

lines.english: The egotistical people are deluded by useless doubt.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh oolay baad  ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: Of all this expanse, nothing shall go along with you.
lines.transliteration: sang naahee ray sagal pasaaree.

lines.english: Through pleasure and pain, the body is growing old.
lines.transliteration: sog harakh meh d ayh birDh aanee.

lines.english: Doing these things, the faithless cynics are passing their lives. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saakat iv hee karat  bihaanee. ||3||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam amrit kal maahi.

lines.english: This treasure is obtained from the Holy.
lines.transliteration: ayhu niDhaanaa saaDh oo paahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, whoever pleases the Guru,
lines.transliteration: naanak gur govid jis t oothaa.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rama-ee-aa t in hee deeth aa. ||4||8||19|| the Lord of the Universe, beholds the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||8||19|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (888-16) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, echo the perfect sound current of theNaad.
lines.transliteration: panch sabad t ah pooran naad .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਕਿਲ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The wondrous, amazing unstruck melody vibrates.
lines.transliteration: anhad baajay achraj bismaad .

lines.english: The Saintly people play there with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kayl karahi sant har log.

lines.english: They remain totally detached, absorbed in the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran nirjog. ||1||

lines.english: It is the realm of celestial peace and bliss.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  bhavan.

lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sits and sings the Glorious Praises of theLord. There is no disease or sorrow there, no birth or death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bais gun  gaavahi t ah rog sog nahee janam maran. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There, they meditate only on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: oohaa simrahi kayval naam.

lines.english: How rare are those who find this place of rest.
lines.transliteration: birlay paavahi oh bisraam.

lines.english: The love of God is their food, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is their support. pMnw 889
lines.transliteration: bhojan bh aa-o keert an aaDh aar.

lines.english: They obtain a permanent seat in the infinite. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nihchal aasan baysumaar. ||2||

lines.english: No one falls there, or wavers, or goes anywhere.
lines.transliteration: dig na dolai kathoo na Dh aavai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some find this mansion.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ko ih mahal paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: They are not touched by doubt, fear, attachment or the traps of Maya.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ai moh na maa-i-aa jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: They enter the deepest state of Samaadhi, through the kind mercy of God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh parabh oo kirpaal. ||3||

lines.english: He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: taa kaa ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.english: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.
lines.transliteration: aapay gupat aapay paasaar.

lines.english: One who enjoys the taste of the Lord, Har, Har, deep within himself,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai antar har har su-aad .

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, his wondrous state cannot be described. ||4||9||20|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (889-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahan na jaa-ee naanak bismaad. ||4||9||20||

lines.english: Meeting with the Sangat, the Congregation, the Supreme Lord God has come into myconsciousness.
lines.transliteration: bhaytat  sang paarbarahm chit  aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the Sangat, my mind has found contentment.
lines.transliteration: sangat karat  santokh man paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santeh charan maathaa mayro pa-ut .

lines.english: Countless times, I humbly bow to the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik baar santeh dand-ut . ||1||

lines.english: This mind is a sacrifice to the Saints;
lines.transliteration: ih man santan kai balihaaree.
jaa kee ot gahee sukh paa-i-aa raakh ay kirpaa Dh aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o. holding tight to their support, I have found peace, and in their mercy, they haveprotected me. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: I wash the feet of the Saints, and drink in that water.
lines.transliteration: santeh charan  Dho-ay Dh o-ay peevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਾਖੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, I live.
lines.transliteration: santeh d aras paykh  paykh  jeevaa.

lines.english: My mind rests its hopes in the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santeh kee mayrai man aas.

lines.english: The Saints are my immaculate wealth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant hamaaree nirmal raas. ||2||

lines.english: The Saints have covered my faults.
lines.transliteration: sant hamaaraa raakh i-aa parh -daa.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I am no longer tormented.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  mohi kabhoo na karh -daa.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord has blessed me with the Saints' Congregation.
lines.transliteration: santeh sang d ee-aa kirpaal.

lines.english: The Compassionate Saints have become my help and support. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant sahaa-ee bh a-ay d a-i-aal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਮੋਿਹ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਕੜਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: My consciousness, intellect and wisdom have been enlightened.
lines.transliteration: surat mat  buDh  pargaas.

lines.english: The Lord is profound, unfathomable, infinite, the treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer apaar gunt aas.

lines.english: He cherishes all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant saglay part ipaal.

lines.english: Nanak is enraptured, seeing the Saints. ||4||10||21|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (889-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak santeh d aykh nihaal. ||4||10||21||

lines.english: Your home, power and wealth will be of no use to you.
lines.transliteration: tayrai kaaj na garihu raaj maal.

lines.english: Your corrupt worldly entanglements will be of no use to you.
lines.transliteration: tayrai kaaj na bikh ai janjaal.

lines.english: Know that all your dear friends are fake.
lines.transliteration: isat meet jaan  sabh  chhalai.

lines.english: Only the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, will go along with you. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har naam sang tayrai chalai. ||1||

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O friend; remembering the Lord inmeditation, your honor shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: raam naam gun gaa-ay lay meet aa har simrat  tayree laaj rahai.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord in meditation, the Messenger of Death will not touch you.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har simrat jam kachh  na kahai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without the Lord, all pursuits are useless.
lines.transliteration: bin har sagal niraarath kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gold, silver and wealth are just dust.
lines.transliteration: su-inaa rupaa maatee daam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, your mind shall be at peace.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad jaap man sukh aa.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||2||
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa tayro oojal mukh aa. ||2||

lines.english: Even the greatest of the great worked and worked until they were exhausted.
lines.transliteration: kar kar thaakay vaday vadayray.

lines.english: None of them ever accomplished the tasks of Maya.
lines.transliteration: kin hee na kee-ay kaaj maa-i-aa pooray.

lines.english: Any humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: har har naam japai jan ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਜਾਿਪ  ਮਨ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee aasaa pooran ho-ay. ||3|| will have all his hopes fulfilled. ||3||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the anchor and support of the Lord's devotees.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt an ko naam aDh aar.

lines.english: The Saints are victorious in this priceless human life.
lines.transliteration: santee jeet aa janam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਕੀਏ ਕਾਜ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord's Saint does, is approved and accepted.
lines.transliteration: har sant karay so-ee parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||4||11||22|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (889-16) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t aa kai kurbaan . ||4||11||22||

lines.english: You gather wealth by exploiting people.
lines.transliteration: sincheh darab d eh dukh log.

lines.english: It is of no use to you; it was meant for others.
lines.transliteration: tayrai kaaj na avraa jog.

lines.english: You practice egotism, and act like a blind man.
lines.transliteration: kar ahaNkaar ho-ay varteh anDh .

lines.english: In the world hereafter, you shall be tied to the leash of the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jam kee jayvrhee t oo aagai banDh . ||1||

lines.english: Give up your envy of others, you fool!
lines.transliteration: chhaad vidaan ee taat moorh ay.

lines.english: You only live here for a night, you fool!
lines.transliteration: eehaa basnaa raat moorh ay.

lines.english: You are intoxicated with Maya, but you must soon arise and depart.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kay maatay t ai uth  chalnaa.

lines.english: You are totally involved in the dream. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raach rahi-o too sang supnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In his childhood, the child is blind.
lines.transliteration: baal bivasthaa baarik anDh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ  ਤੂ ਆਗੈ  ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the fullness of youth, he is involved in foul-smelling sins. pMnw 890
lines.transliteration: bhar joban laagaa d urganDh .

lines.english: In the third stage of life, he gathers the wealth of Maya.
lines.transliteration: taritee-a bivasthaa sinchay maa-ay.

lines.english: And when he grows old, he must leave all this; he departs regretting and repenting. ||2||
lines.transliteration: biraDh bh a-i-aa chh od chali-o pachh utaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: After a very long time, one obtains this precious human body, so difficult to obtain.
lines.transliteration: chirankaal paa-ee darulabh  dayh.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it is reduced to dust.
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonee ho-ee kh ayh.

lines.english: Worse than a beast, a demon or an idiot,
lines.transliteration: pasoo parayt mugaDh  tay buree.
tiseh na boojh ai jin ayh siree. ||3|| is that one who does not understand who created him. ||3||

lines.english: Listen, O Creator Lord, Lord of the Universe, Lord of the World,
lines.transliteration: sun kart aar govind  gopaal.

lines.english: Merciful to the meek, forever compassionate
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal sad aa kirpaal.

lines.english: - If You emancipate the human, then his bonds are broken.
lines.transliteration: tumeh chh adaavahu chh utkahi banDh .

lines.english: O Nanak, the people of world are blind; please, Lord, forgive them, and unite them with Yourself. ||4||12||23|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (890-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bakhas milaavhu naanak jag anDh . ||4||12||23||

lines.english: Joining the elements together, the robe of the body is fashioned.
lines.transliteration: kar sanjog banaa-ee kaachh.

lines.english: The ignorant fool is engrossed in it.
lines.transliteration: tis sang rahi-o i-aanaa raach.

lines.english: He cherishes it, and constantly takes care of it.
lines.transliteration: partipaarai nit  saar samaarai.

lines.english: But at the very last moment, he must arise and depart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ant kee baar ooth  siDhaarai. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is false, O mortal.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh jh ooth paraanee.

lines.english: Those who do not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, but instead are imbued with other things, - all those mortals are plundered by Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: govid bh ajan bin avar sang raat ay tay sabh  maa-i-aa mooth  paraanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, filth is not washed off.
lines.transliteration: tirath naa-ay na ut ras mail.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਭਜਨ  ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Religious rituals are all just egotistical displays.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam sabh  ha-umai fail.

lines.english: By pleasing and appeasing people, no one is saved.
lines.transliteration: lok pachaarai gat nahee ho-ay.

lines.english: Without the Naam, they shall depart weeping. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonay chalsahi ro-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, the screen is not torn away.
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na tootas patal.

lines.english: I have studied all the Shaastras and Simritees.
lines.transliteration: soDhay saast ar simrit  sagal.

lines.english: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord Himself inspires to chant.
lines.transliteration: so naam japai jis aap japaa-ay.

lines.english: He obtains all fruits and rewards, and merges in peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sagal falaa say sookh samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: O Savior Lord, please save me!
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaaray raakh o aap.

lines.english: All peace and comforts are in Your Hand, God.
lines.transliteration: sagal sukhaa parabh  tumrai haath.

lines.english: Whatever you attach me to, to that I am attached, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: jit laaveh t it laagah su-aamee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||13||24|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (890-11) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib antarjaamee. ||4||13||24||

lines.english: Whatever He does makes me happy.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so-ee sukh  jaanaa.

lines.english: The ignorant mind is encouraged, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: man asmajh saaDh sang pat ee-aanaa.

lines.english: Now, it does not waver at all; it has become stable and steady.
lines.transliteration: dolan tay chookaa th ehraa-i-aa.

lines.english: Receiving Truth, it is merged in the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sat maahi lay sat  samaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Pain is gone, and all illness is gone.
lines.transliteration: dookh  ga-i-aa sabh  rog ga-i-aa.

lines.english: I have accepted the Will of God in my mind, associating with the Great Person, the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee aagi-aa man meh maanee mahaa purakh  kaa sang bh a-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All is pure; all is immaculate.
lines.transliteration: sagal pavitar sarab nirmalaa.

lines.english: Whatever exists is good.
lines.transliteration: jo vartaa-ay so-ee bh alaa.

lines.english: Wherever He keeps me, that is the place of liberation for me.
lines.transliteration: jah raakhai so-ee mukat  thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਆਿਗਆ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਾਨੀ  ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever He makes me chant, is His Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo japaa-ay so-ee naam. ||2||

lines.english: That is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the Holy place their feet,
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath jah saaDh  pag Dh areh.
tah baikunth  jah naam uchrahi. and that is heaven, where the Naam is chanted.

lines.english: All bliss comes, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: sarab anand jab darsan paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: I sing continuously, continually, the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam gunaa nit  nit har gaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord Himself is pervading in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: aapay ghat gh at rahi-aa bi-aap.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਧਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Merciful Lord is radiant and manifest.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal purakh  pargat part aap.

lines.english: The shutters are opened, and doubts have run away.
lines.transliteration: kapat khulaanay bh aram naath ay dooray.

lines.english: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru. ||4||14||25|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (890-17) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur bhaytay pooray. ||4||14||25||

lines.english: Millions of meditations and austerities rest in him,
lines.transliteration: kot jaap taap bisraam.
riDh buDh  siDh sur gi-aan. along with wealth, wisdom, miraculous spiritual powers and angelic spiritual insight.

lines.english: He enjoys the various shows and forms, pleasures and delicacies;
lines.transliteration: anik roop rang bhog rasai.
gurmukh naam nimakh  ridai vasai. ||1|| the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the heart of the Gurmukh. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Its value cannot be described. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: keemat kahan  na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He alone is brave, patient and perfectly wise; pMnw 891
lines.transliteration: soorbeer Dheeraj mat  pooraa.
sahj samaaDh Dh un gahir gambh eeraa. he is intuitively in Samaadhi, profound and unfathomable.

lines.english: He is liberated forever and all his affairs are perfectly resolved;
lines.transliteration: sadaa mukat  taa kay pooray kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai har naam. ||2|| the Lord's Name abides within his heart. ||2||

lines.english: He is totally peaceful, blissful and healthy;
lines.transliteration: sagal sookh aanand  arog.
samadrasee pooran nirjog. he looks upon all impartially, and is perfectly detached.

lines.english: He does not come and go, and he never wavers;
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaa-ay dolai kat naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai naam basai man maahee. ||3|| the Naam abides in his mind. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: God is Merciful to the meek; He is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal gopaal govind .

lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on Him, and his worries are gone.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh japee-ai ut rai chind .

lines.english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with the Naam;
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur dee-aa naam.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: santan kee tahal sant  kaa kaam. ||4||15||26|| he serves the Saints, and works for the Saints. ||4||15||26|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (891-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra.
lines.transliteration: beej mantar har keert an gaa-o.

lines.english: Even the homeless find a home in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: aagai milee nithaavay thaa-o.

lines.english: Fall at the feet of the Perfect Guru;
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee charnee laag.
janam janam kaa so-i-aa jaag. ||1|| you have slept for so many incarnations - wake up! ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har jaap japlaa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it shall be enshrined within your heart, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay hird ai vaasai bh a-ojal paar parlaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditate on the eternal treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mind,
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan Dh i-aa-ay man atal.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਾਸੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa chh ooteh maa-i-aa kay patal. and then, the screen of Maya shall be torn away.

lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Shabad,
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit  ras pee-o.
taa tayraa ho-ay nirmal jee-o. ||2|| and then your soul shall be rendered immaculate and pure. ||2||

lines.english: Searching, searching, searching, I have realized
lines.transliteration: soDhat  soDh at soDh  beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagat  nahee chh utkaaraa. that without devotional worship of the Lord, no one is saved.

lines.english: So vibrate, and meditate on that Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
lines.transliteration: so har bhajan saaDh  kai sang.
man tan raapai har kai rang. ||3|| your mind and body shall be imbued with love for the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Renounce all your cleverness and trickery.
lines.transliteration: chhod si-aan ap baho chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, without the Lord's Name, there is no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: man bin har naavai jaa-ay na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World, has taken pity on me.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aaree govid  gosaa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the protection and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||16||27|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (891-11) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har naanak tayk tikaa-ee. ||4||16||27||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saints' Congregation, play joyfully with the Lord,
lines.transliteration: sant kai sang raam rang kayl.
aagai jam si-o ho-ay na mayl. and you will not have to meet the Messenger of Death hereafter.

lines.english: Your egotistical intellect shall be dispelled,
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh kaa bh a-i-aa binaas.
durmat  ho-ee saglee naas. ||1|| and your evil-mindedness will be totally taken away. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਲ ॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Pandit.
lines.transliteration: raam naam gun gaa-ay pandit .

lines.english: Religious rituals and egotism are of no use at all. You shall go home with happiness, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karam kaaNd ahaNkaar na kaajai kusal saytee gh ar jaahi pandit . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have earned the profit, the wealth of the Lord's praise.
lines.transliteration: har kaa jas niDh lee-aa laabh .

lines.english: All my hopes have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: pooran bha-ay manorath saabh .

lines.english: Pain has left me, and peace has come to my home.
lines.transliteration: dukh naath aa sukh  ghar meh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਕਡ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜੈ ਕੁਸਲ  ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਪੰਿਡਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  kamal bigsaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: One who is blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Name,
lines.transliteration: naam ratan jin paa-i-aa d aan.
tis jan ho-ay sagal niDh aan. obtains all treasures.

lines.english: His mind becomes content, finding the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: santokh  aa-i-aa man pooraa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Why should he ever go begging again? ||3||
lines.transliteration: fir fir maagan kaahay jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Hearing the Lord's sermon, he becomes pure and holy.
lines.transliteration: har kee kathaa sunat pavit .

lines.english: Chanting it with his tongue, he finds the way to salvation.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa bakat paa-ee gat  mat.

lines.english: He alone is approved, who enshrines the Lord within his heart.
lines.transliteration: so parvaan jis rid ai vasaa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak: such a humble being is exalted, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||17||28|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (891-17) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan oot am bh aa-ee. ||4||17||28||

lines.english: No matter how hard you try to grab it, it does not come into your hands.
lines.transliteration: gahu kar pakree na aa-ee haath.

lines.english: No matter how much you may love it, it does not go along with you.
lines.transliteration: pareet karee chaalee nahee saath.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when you abandon it,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ja-o ti-aag d a-ee.
tab oh charn ee aa-ay pa-ee. ||1|| then it comes and falls at your feet. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O Saints: this is the pure philosophy.
lines.transliteration: sun sant ahu nirmal beechaar.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, there is no salvation. Meeting with the Perfect Guru, one is saved. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 892
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin gat nahee kaa-ee gur pooraa bh aytat uDhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When someone tries to appease her,
lines.transliteration: jab us ka-o ko-ee dayvai maan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab aapas oopar rakh ai gumaan. then she takes pride in herself.

lines.english: But when someone puts her out of his thoughts,
lines.transliteration: jab us ka-o ko-ee man parharai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਨ ਪਰਹਰੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tab oh sayvak sayvaa karai. ||2|| then she serves him like a slave. ||2||

lines.english: She seems to please, but in the end, she deceives.
lines.transliteration: mukh bayraavai ant  thagaavai.

lines.english: She does not remain in any one place.
lines.transliteration: ikat th a-ur oh kahee na samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਤੁ  ਠਉਰ  ਓਹ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: She has bewitched a great many worlds.
lines.transliteration: un mohay bahutay barahmand.

lines.english: The Lord's humble servants cut her apart into pieces. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam janee keenee khand kh and. ||3||

lines.english: Whoever begs from her remains hungry.
lines.transliteration: jo maagai so bhookh aa rahai.

lines.english: Whoever is infatuated with her obtains nothing.
lines.transliteration: is sang raachai so kachhoo na lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਚੈ ਸੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: But one who renounces her, and joins the Society of the Saints,
lines.transliteration: iseh ti-aag sat sangat  karai.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee naanak oh t arai. ||4||18||29|| by great good fortune, O Nanak, is saved. ||4||18||29|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (892-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: See the Lord, the Universal Soul, in all.
lines.transliteration: aatam raam sarab meh paykh .

lines.english: The One God is perfect, and all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-aa parabh ayk.

lines.english: Know that the priceless jewel is within your own heart.
lines.transliteration: ratan amol rid ay meh jaan.

lines.english: Realize that your essence is within your own self. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apnee vasat t oo aap pachh aan. ||1||

lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, by the Grace of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: pee amrit sant an parsaad .

lines.english: One who is blessed with high destiny, obtains it. Without a tongue, how can one know the taste? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vaday bhaag hoveh t a-o paa-ee-ai bin jihvaa ki-aa jaan ai su-aad . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How can a deaf person listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the Vedas?
lines.transliteration: ath das bayd  sunay kah doraa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੁਆਦੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The blind man cannot see even a million lights.
lines.transliteration: kot pargaas na disai anDh ayraa.

lines.english: The beast loves grass, and remains attached to it.
lines.transliteration: pasoo pareet gh aas sang rachai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠ ਦਸ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਹ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: One who has not been taught - how can he understand? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis nahee bujhaavai so kit  biDh bujhai. ||2||

lines.english: God, the Knower, knows all.
lines.transliteration: jaananhaar rahi-aa parabh  jaan.

lines.english: He is with His devotees, through and through.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  bhagtan sangaan.

lines.english: Those who sing God's Praises with joy and delight,
lines.transliteration: bigas bigas apunaa parabh gaavahi.

lines.english: O Nanak - the Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||3||19||30|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (892-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin jam nayrh  na aavahi. ||3||19||30||

lines.english: Blessing me with His Name, He has purified and sanctified me.
lines.transliteration: deeno naam kee-o pavit .

lines.english: The Lord's wealth is my capital. False hope has left me; this is my wealth.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan raas niraas ih bit .

lines.english: Breaking my bonds, the Lord has linked me to His service.
lines.transliteration: kaatee banDh har sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.english: I am a devotee of the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat  raam gun  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds.
lines.transliteration: baajay anhad baajaa.

lines.english: The Lord's humble servants sing His Glorious Praises with love and delight; they arehonored by the Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rasak rasak gun gaavahi har jan apnai gurd ayv nivaajaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My pre-ordained destiny has been activated;
lines.transliteration: aa-ay bani-o poorbalaa bhaag.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have awakened from the sleep of countless incarnations.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa so-i-aa jaag.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my aversion is gone.
lines.transliteration: ga-ee gilaan saaDh kai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੈ  ਗੁਰਦੇਿਵ  ਿਨਵਾਜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man tan raat o har kai rang. ||2||

lines.english: The Merciful Savior Lord has saved me.
lines.transliteration: raakhay raakh anhaar d a-i-aal.

lines.english: I have no service or work to my credit.
lines.transliteration: naa kichh sayvaa naa kichh  ghaal.

lines.english: In His Mercy, God has taken pity on me;
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh keenee d a-i-aa.

lines.english: He lifted me up and pulled me out, when I was suffering in pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: boodat d ukh meh kaadh  la-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Listening, listening to His Praises, joy has welled up within my mind.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  upji-o man meh chaa-o.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har kay gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: Singing, singing His Praises, I have obtained the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: gaavat gaavat  param gat  paa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||4||20||31|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (892-16) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak liv laa-ee. ||4||20||31||

lines.english: In exchange for a shell, he gives up a jewel.
lines.transliteration: ka-udee badlai t i-aagai rat an.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He tries to get what he must give up.
lines.transliteration: chhod jaa-ay t aahoo kaa jat an.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He collects those things which are worthless.
lines.transliteration: so sanchai jo hochhee baat .

lines.english: Enticed by Maya, he takes the crooked path. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi-aa taydha-o jaat . ||1||

lines.english: You unfortunate man - have you no shame?
lines.transliteration: abhaagay t ai laaj naahee.

lines.english: You do not remember in your mind the ocean of peace, the perfect Transcendent LordGod. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar pooran parmaysar har na chayt i-o man maahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Nectar seems bitter to you, and poison is sweet.
lines.transliteration: amrit ka-uraa bikh i-aa meeth ee.

lines.english: Such is your condition, you faithless cynic, which I have seen with my own eyes.
lines.transliteration: saakat kee biDh  nainhu deeth ee.

lines.english: You are fond of falsehood, fraud and egotism. pMnw 893
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat ahaNkaar reejh aanaa.

lines.english: If you hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you feel like you have been stung by a scorpion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam sunat jan bichh oo-a dasaanaa. ||2||

lines.english: You continually yearn for Maya,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran sad  hee jh oorai.
man mukh kabeh na ust at karai. and you never chant the Lord's Praises with your mouth.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is fearless and formless; He is the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar d aataar.

lines.english: But you do not love Him, you fool! ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis si-o pareet  na karai gavaar. ||3||

lines.english: God, the True King, is above the heads of all kings.
lines.transliteration: sabh saahaa sir saachaa saahu.

lines.english: He is the independent, perfect Lord King.
lines.transliteration: vaymuhtaaj pooraa paat isaahu.

lines.english: People are intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in doubt and family life.
lines.transliteration: moh magan lapti-o bharam girah.

lines.english: Nanak: they are saved only by Your Mercy, Lord. ||4||21||32|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (893-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak taree-ai t ayree mihar. ||4||21||32||

lines.english: Night and day, I chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas japa-o har naa-o.

lines.english: Hereafter, I shall obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aagai dargeh paava-o thaa-o.

lines.english: I am in bliss forever; I have no sorrow.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand na hovee sog.

lines.english: The disease of ego never afflicts me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kabhoo na bi-aapai ha-umai rog. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, seek out those who know God.
lines.transliteration: khojahu sant ahu har barahm gi-aanee.

lines.english: 5) bisman bisam bha-ay bismaad aa param gat  paavahi har simar paraanee. ||1|| rahaa- o. You shall be wonderstruck with wonder at the wonderful Lord; meditate inremembrance on the Lord, O mortal, and obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
Calculating, measuring, and thinking in every way,
lines.transliteration: gan min daykh hu sagal beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਮਨ ਿਬਸਮ  ਭਏ ਿਬਸਮਾਦਾ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਪਰਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa ko sakai na taar. see that without the Naam, no one can be carried across.

lines.english: Of all your efforts, none will go along with you.
lines.transliteration: sagal upaav na chaaleh sang.

lines.english: You can cross over the terrifying world-ocean only through the love of God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhavjal t aree-ai parabh  kai rang. ||2||

lines.english: By merely washing the body, one's filth is not removed.
lines.transliteration: dayhee Dh o-ay na ut rai mail.

lines.english: Afflicted by egotism, duality only increases.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai bi-aapai dubiDh aa fail.

lines.english: That humble being who takes the medicine of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har
lines.transliteration: har har a-ukhaDh  jo jan kh aa-ay.
taa kaa rog sagal mit jaa-ay. ||3|| - all his diseases are eradicated. ||3||

lines.english: Take pity on me, O merciful, Supreme Lord God;
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa paarbarahm da-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: man tay kabahu na bisar gopaal. let me never forget the Lord of the World from my mind.

lines.english: Let me be the dust of the feet of Your slaves;
lines.transliteration: tayray d aas kee hovaa Dh oor.

lines.english: O God, please fulfill Nanak's hope. ||4||22||33|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (893-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh sarDh aa poor. ||4||22||33||

lines.english: You are my Protection, O perfect Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  pooray gurd ayv.

lines.english: There is no other than You.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: You are all-powerful, O perfect Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: too samrath pooran paarbarahm.

lines.english: He alone meditates on You, whose karma is perfect. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so Dhi-aa-ay pooraa jis karam. ||1||

lines.english: You Name, God, is the boat to carry us across.
lines.transliteration: taran taaran  parabh  tayro naa-o.

lines.english: My mind has grasped Your protection alone. Other than You, I have no place of restat all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aykaa saran gahee man mayrai t uDh bin d oojaa naahee th aa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, I live,
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeevaa tayraa naa-o.
aagai dargeh paava-o th aa-o. and hereafter, I will obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.

lines.english: Pain and darkness are gone from my mind;
lines.transliteration: dookh  anDh ayraa man t ay jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਾ ਸਰਿਣ  ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: durmat  binsai raachai har naa-ay. ||2|| my evil-mindedness is dispelled, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.english: I have enshrined love for the Lord's lotus feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laagee pareet.

lines.english: The lifestyle of the Perfect Guru is immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee nirmal reet.

lines.english: My fear has run away, and the fearless Lord dwells within my mind.
lines.transliteration: bha-o bh aagaa nirbh a-o man basai.

lines.english: My tongue continually chants the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rasnaa nit  japai. ||3||

lines.english: The nooses of millions of incarnations are cut away.
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay kaatay faahay.

lines.english: I have obtained the profit of the true wealth.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa laabh sachaa Dh an laahay.

lines.english: This treasure is inexhaustible; it will never run out.
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai akh ut bhandaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||4||23||34|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (893-16) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat  soheh har d u-aar. ||4||23||34||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby.
lines.transliteration: ratan javayhar naam.

lines.english: It brings Truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh gi-aan.

lines.english: The Lord entrusts the treasures of peace, intuition and kindness to His devotees. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj d a-i-aa kaa pot aa. har bh agtaa havaalai hot aa. ||1||

lines.english: This is the treasure of my Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray raam ko bhandaar.

lines.english: Consuming and expending it, it is never used up. The Lord has no end or limitation.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khaat  kharach kachh  tot na aavai ant  nahee har paaraavaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a priceless diamond.
lines.transliteration: keertan nirmolak heeraa.

lines.english: It is the ocean of bliss and virtue.
lines.transliteration: aanand gun ee gaheeraa.

lines.english: In the Word of the Guru's Bani is the wealth of the unstruck sound current.
lines.transliteration: anhad ban ee poonjee.

lines.english: The Saints hold the key to it in their hands. ||2|| pMnw 894
lines.transliteration: santan hath raakh ee koonjee. ||2||

lines.english: They sit there, in the cave of deep Samaadhi;
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh gufaa t ah aasan.
kayval barahm pooran tah baasan. the unique, perfect Lord God dwells there.

lines.english: God holds conversations with His devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sang parabh  gosat karat .

lines.english: There is no pleasure or pain, no birth or death there. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tah harakh  na sog na janam na marat . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਹਰਖ  ਨ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਜਨਮ  ਨ ਮਰਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis aap divaa-i-aa.
saaDhsang t in har Dh an paa-i-aa. obtains the Lord's wealth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: Nanak prays to the merciful Primal Lord;
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal purakh  naanak ard aas.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har mayree vartan  har mayree raas. ||4||24||35|| the Lord is my merchandise, and the Lord is my capital. ||4||24||35|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (894-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਵਰਤਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਿਸ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੫॥
lines.english: The Vedas do not know His greatness.
lines.transliteration: mahimaa na jaaneh bayd.

lines.english: Brahma does not know His mystery.
lines.transliteration: barahmay nahee jaaneh bhayd .

lines.english: Incarnated beings do not know His limit.
lines.transliteration: avtaar na jaaneh ant .

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is infinite. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parmaysar paarbarahm bay-ant. ||1||

lines.english: Only He Himself knows His own state.
lines.transliteration: apnee gat aap jaanai.

lines.english: Others speak of Him only by hearsay. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sun sun  avar vakh aanai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Shiva does not know His mystery.
lines.transliteration: sankraa nahee jaaneh bhayv.

lines.english: The gods gave grown weary of searching for Him.
lines.transliteration: khojat  haaray d ayv.

lines.english: The goddesses do not know His mystery.
lines.transliteration: dayvee-aa nahee jaanai maram.

lines.english: Above all is the unseen, Supreme Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh oopar alakh  paarbarahm. ||2||

lines.english: The Creator Lord plays His own plays.
lines.transliteration: apnai rang kartaa kayl.

lines.english: He Himself separates, and He Himself unites.
lines.transliteration: aap bichhorai aapay mayl.

lines.english: Some wander around, while others are linked to His devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: ik bharmay ik bh agtee laa-ay.

lines.english: By His actions, He makes Himself known. ||3||
lines.transliteration: apnaa kee-aa aap jan aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Listen to the true story of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santan kee sun  saachee saakh ee.

lines.english: They speak only of what they see with their eyes.
lines.transliteration: so boleh jo paykheh aakh ee.

lines.english: He is not involved with virtue or vice.
lines.transliteration: nahee layp tis punn na paap.

lines.english: Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. ||4||25||36|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (894-9) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa parabh aapay aap. ||4||25||36||

lines.english: I have not tried to do anything through knowledge.
lines.transliteration: kichhahoo kaaj na kee-o jaan.

lines.english: I have no knowledge, intelligence or spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: surat mat  naahee kichh  gi-aan.

lines.english: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, humility or righteousness.
lines.transliteration: jaap taap seel nahee Dh aram.

lines.english: I know nothing of such good karma. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kichhoo na jaan-o kaisaa karam. ||1||

lines.english: O my Beloved God, my Lord and Master,
lines.transliteration: thaakur pareet am parabh  mayray.

lines.english: Yours, God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa avar na ko-ee bh oolah chookah parabh  tayray. ||1|| rahaa-o. there is none other than You. Even though I wander and make mistakes, I am still

lines.english: I have no wealth, no intelligence, no miraculous spiritual powers; I am notenlightened.
lines.transliteration: riDh na buDh  na siDh  pargaas.

lines.english: I dwell in the village of corruption and sickness.
lines.transliteration: bikhai bi-aaDh  kay gaav meh baas.

lines.english: O my One Creator Lord God,
lines.transliteration: karanhaar mayray parabh ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਭੂਲਹ ਚੂਕਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is the support of my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam tayray kee man meh tayk. ||2||

lines.english: Hearing, hearing Your Name, I live; this is my mind's consolation.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  jeeva-o man ih bisraam.

lines.english: Your Name, God, is the Destroyer of sins.
lines.transliteration: paap khandan parabh  tayro naam.

lines.english: You, O Limitless Lord, are the Giver of the soul.
lines.transliteration: too agnat  jee-a kaa d aataa.

lines.english: He alone knows You, unto whom You reveal Yourself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jisahi janaaveh t in too jaat aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whoever has been created, rests his hopes in You.
lines.transliteration: jo upaa-i-o tis t ayree aas.

lines.english: All worship and adore You, God, O treasure of excellence.
lines.transliteration: sagal araaDheh parabh  guntaas.

lines.english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayrai kurbaan .

lines.english: My merciful Lord and Master is infinite. ||4||26||37|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (894-16) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bay-ant saahib mayraa miharvaan. ||4||26||37||

lines.english: The Savior Lord is merciful.
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaar d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Millions of incarnations are eradicated in an instant, contemplating the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot bhav kh anday nimakh  khi-aal.

lines.english: All beings worship and adore Him.
lines.transliteration: sagal araaDheh jant .

lines.english: Receiving the Guru's Mantra, one meets God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: milee-ai parabh gur mil mant . ||1||

lines.english: My God is the Giver of souls.
lines.transliteration: jee-an ko daat aa mayraa parabh .

lines.english: The Perfect Transcendent Lord Master, my God, imbues each and every heart.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooran parmaysur su-aamee ghat gh at raat aa mayraa parabh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mind has grasped His Support.
lines.transliteration: taa kee gahee man ot.

lines.english: My bonds have been shattered.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t ay ho-ee chh ot.

lines.english: Within my heart, I meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: hirdai jap parmaanand .

lines.english: My mind is filled with ecstasy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man maahi bha-ay anand. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord's Sanctuary is the boat to carry us across.
lines.transliteration: taaran  taran har saran .

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's Feet are the embodiment of life itself. pMnw 895
lines.transliteration: jeevan roop har charan.

lines.english: They are the Support of the breath of life of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santan kay paraan  aDhaar.

lines.english: God is infinite, the highest of the high. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oochay tay ooch apaar. ||3||

lines.english: That mind is excellent and sublime, which meditates in remembrance on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so mat saar jit  har simreejai.

lines.english: In His Mercy, the Lord Himself bestows it.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis aapay deejai.

lines.english: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are found in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  har naa-o.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak chants the Name. ||4||27||38|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (895-3) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak japi-aa gur mil naa-o. ||4||27||38||

lines.english: Abandon all your clever tricks.
lines.transliteration: sagal si-aanap chhaad.

lines.english: Become His servant, and serve Him.
lines.transliteration: kar sayvaa sayvak saaj.

lines.english: Totally erase your self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: apnaa aap sagal mitaa-ay.

lines.english: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man chinday say-ee fal paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Be awake and aware with your Guru.
lines.transliteration: hohu saavDhaan apunay gur si-o.

lines.english: Your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled, an d you shall obtain all treasures from the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa pooran hovai paavahi sagal niDhaan gur si-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Let no one think that God and Guru are separate.
lines.transliteration: doojaa nahee jaanai ko-ay.

lines.transliteration: har kay sant sad aa parvaan .

lines.transliteration: jis bhaytat  mitai abh imaan.

lines.english: This is devotion to the Guru, to sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kee bhagat  sadaa gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar gur govind.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Great Giver, merciful and forgiving.
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa da-i-aal bakh sind.

lines.english: One whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet,
lines.transliteration: gur charnee jaa kaa man laagaa.

lines.english: O slave Nanak, is blessed with perfect destiny. ||4||36||47|| pMnw 898 rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (898-1) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t is pooran bh aagaa. ||4||36||47||

lines.english: What supports you in this world?
lines.transliteration: kis bharvaasai bichrahi bh avan.

lines.english: You ignorant fool, who is your companion?
lines.transliteration: moorh mugaDh  tayraa sangee kavan.

lines.english: The Lord is your only companion; no one knows His condition.
lines.transliteration: raam sangee tis gat  nahee jaaneh.

lines.english: You look upon the five thieves as your friends. ||1||
lines.transliteration: panch batvaaray say meet kar maaneh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ  ਸੇ ਮੀਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serve that home, which will save you, my friend.
lines.transliteration: so ghar sayv jit  uDhrahi meet .

lines.english: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love Him in your mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gun govind  ravee-ah d in raat ee saaDh sang kar man kee pareet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਰਵੀਅਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਕਿਰ ਮਨ ਕੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This human life is passing away in egotism and conflict.
lines.transliteration: janam bihaano ahaNkaar ar vaad.

lines.english: You are not satisfied; such is the flavor of sin.
lines.transliteration: taripat  na aavai bikh i-aa saad .

lines.english: Wandering and roaming around, you suffer terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: bharmat  bharmat  mahaa d ukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: You cannot cross over the impassable sea of Maya. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taree na jaa-ee d utar maa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: You do the deeds which do not help you at all.
lines.transliteration: kaam na aavai so kaar kamaavai.

lines.english: As you plant, so shall you harvest.
lines.transliteration: aap beej aapay hee khaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: There is none other than the Lord to save you.
lines.transliteration: raakhan ka-o d oosar nahee ko-ay.

lines.english: You will be saved, only if God grants His Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ta-o nist arai ja-o kirpaa ho-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  parabh  tayro naam.

lines.english: Please bless Your slave with that gift.
lines.transliteration: apnay daas ka-o keejai d aan.

lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, God, and emancipate me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh gat  kar mayree.

lines.english: Nanak has grasped Your Sanctuary, God. ||4||37||48|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (898-7) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran gahee naanak parabh  tayree. ||4||37||48||

lines.english: I have found peace in this world.
lines.transliteration: ih lokay sukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I will not have to appear before the Righteous Judge of Dharma to give my account.
lines.transliteration: nahee bhaytat  Dharam raa-i-aa.

lines.english: I will be respected in the Court of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: har dargeh sobh aavant .
fun garabh naahee basant . ||1|| and I will not have to enter the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I know the value of friendship with the Saints.
lines.transliteration: jaanee sant kee mit raa-ee.

lines.english: In His Mercy, the Lord has blessed me with His Name. My pre-ordained destiny has been fulfilled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa deeno har naamaa poorab sanjog milaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My consciousness is attached to the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: gur kai charan chit  laagaa.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an sanjog sabh aagaa. Blessed, blessed is this fortunate time of union.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਦੀਨੋ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਸੰਜੋਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have applied the dust of the Saints' feet to my forehead,
lines.transliteration: sant kee Dh oor laagee mayrai maathay.
kilvikh d ukh saglay mayray laathay. ||2|| and all my sins and pains have been eradicated. ||2||

lines.english: Performing true service to the Holy,
lines.transliteration: saaDh kee sach tahal kamaanee.
tab ho-ay man suDh  paraanee. the mortal's mind is purified.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਲਾਗੀ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
lines.english: I have seen the fruitful vision of the Lord's humble slave.
lines.transliteration: jan kaa safal daras deeth aa.

lines.english: God's Name dwells within each and every heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam parabhoo kaa gh at ghat vooth aa. ||3||

lines.english: All my troubles and sufferings have been taken away;
lines.transliteration: mitaanay sabh kal kalays.

lines.english: I have merged into the One, from whom I originated.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upjay t is meh parvays.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, incomparably beautiful, has become merciful.
lines.transliteration: pargatay aanoop govind.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕਾ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God is perfect and forgiving. ||4||38||49|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (898-13) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh pooray naanak bakh sind. ||4||38||49||

lines.english: The tiger leads the cow to the pasture,
lines.transliteration: ga-oo ka-o chaaray saardool.
ka-udee kaa lakh hoo-aa mool. the shell is worth thousands of dollars,
bakree ka-o hastee part ipaalay. and the elephant nurses the goat,
apnaa parabh nad ar nihaalay. ||1|| when God bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.english: You are the treasure of mercy, O my Beloved Lord God.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan pareet am parabh  mayray.

lines.english: I cannot even describe Your many Glorious Virtues. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baran na saaka-o baho gun tayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The cat sees the meat, but does not eat it,
lines.transliteration: deesat  maas na kh aa-ay bilaa-ee.
mahaa kasaab chhuree sat paa-ee. and the great butcher throws away his knife;
karanhaar parabh hird ai vooth aa. the Creator Lord God abides in the heart;
faathee machhulee kaa jaalaa t ootaa. ||2|| the net holding the fish breaks apart. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The dry wood blossoms forth in greenery and red flowers;
lines.transliteration: sookay kaasat haray chalool.
oochai thal foolay kamal anoop. in the high desert, the beautiful lotus flower blooms.

lines.english: The Divine True Guru puts out the fire.
lines.transliteration: agan nivaaree satgur d ayv.

lines.english: He links His servant to His service. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sayvak apnee laa-i-o sayv. ||3||

lines.english: He saves even the ungrateful;
lines.transliteration: akirat-gh anaa kaa karay uDh aar.
parabh mayraa hai sad aa da-i-aar. my God is forever merciful.

lines.english: He is forever the helper and support of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kaa sad aa sahaa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak has found the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||39||50|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (898-19) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 899
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak sarnaa-ee. ||4||39||50||

lines.english: God killed the five tigers.
lines.transliteration: panch singh raakh ay parabh  maar.

lines.english: He has driven out the ten wolves.
lines.transliteration: das bigi-aarh ee la-ee nivaar.

lines.english: The three whirl-pools have stopped spinning.
lines.transliteration: teen aavrat  kee chookee gh ayr.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the fear of reincarnation is gone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang chookay bh ai fayr. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I live.
lines.transliteration: simar simar jeevaa govind.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਖਿਸੰਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; the True Lord is forever and ever the forgiver. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakhi-o d aas apnaa sad aa sad aa saachaa bakh sind. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The mountain of sin is burnt down, like straw,
lines.transliteration: daajh  ga-ay t arin paap sumayr.
jap jap naam poojay parabh pair. by chanting and meditating on the Name, and worshipping God's feet.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੈਰ ॥
lines.english: God, the embodiment of bliss, becomes manifest everywhere.
lines.transliteration: anad roop pargati-o sabh  thaan.

lines.english: Linked to His loving devotional worship, I enjoy peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  joree sukh  maan. ||2||

lines.english: I have crossed over the world-ocean, as if it were no bigger than a calf's footprint onthe ground.
lines.transliteration: saagar tari-o baachh ar khoj.

lines.english: I shall never again have to endure suffering or grief.
lines.transliteration: khayd  na paa-i-o nah fun roj.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਨਹ ਫੁਿਨ ਰੋਜ ॥
lines.english: The ocean is contained in the pitcher.
lines.transliteration: sinDh samaa-i-o gh atukay maahi.

lines.english: This is not such an amazing thing for the Creator to do. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karanhaar ka-o kichh achraj naahi. ||3||

lines.english: When I am separated from Him, then I am consigned to the nether regions.
lines.transliteration: ja-o chhoota-o t a-o jaa-ay pa-i-aal.

lines.english: When He lifts me up and pulls me out, then I am enraptured by His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: ja-o kaadhi-o t a-o nad ar nihaal.

lines.english: Vice and virtue are not under my control.
lines.transliteration: paap punn hamrai vas naahi.

lines.english: With love and affection, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||40||51|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (899-7) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: rasak rasak naanak gun gaahi. ||4||40||51||

lines.english: Neither your body nor your mind belong to you.
lines.transliteration: naa tan t ayraa naa man t ohi.

lines.english: Attached to Maya, you are entangled in fraud.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi bi-aapi-aa Dhohi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਿਹ ॥
lines.english: You play like a baby lamb.
lines.transliteration: kudam karai gaadar ji-o chh ayl.

lines.english: But suddenly, Death will catch you in its noose. ||1||
lines.transliteration: achint jaal kaal chakaro payl. ||1||

lines.english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal sarnaa-ay manaa.

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, which will be your help and support. As Gurmukh, youshall obtain the true wealth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap sang sahaa-ee gurmukh paavahi saach Dh anaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your unfinished worldly affairs will never be resolved.
lines.transliteration: oonay kaaj na hovat pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸਾਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You shall always regret your sexual desire, anger and pride.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh mad  sad hee jh ooray.

lines.english: You act in corruption in order to survive,
lines.transliteration: karai bikaar jee-aray kai taa-ee.
gaafal sang na tasoo-aa jaa-ee. ||2|| but not even an iota will go along with you, you ignorant fool! ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਮਿਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Dharat  Dhoh anik chh al jaanai. You practice deception, and you know many tricks;

lines.transliteration: ka-udee ka-udee ka-o khaak sir chh aanai. for the sake of mere shells, you throw dust upon your head.

lines.english: You never even think of the One who gave you life.
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa t isai na chayt ai mool.

lines.english: The pain of false greed never leaves you. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa lobh na ut rai sool. ||3||

lines.english: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jab bha-ay d a-i-aal.
ih man ho-aa saaDh ravaal. this mind becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.english: With His lotus hands, He has attached us to the hem of His robe.
lines.transliteration: hasat kamal larh  leeno laa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||4||41||52|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (899-13) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachai saach samaa-ay. ||4||41||52||

lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord.
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam kee sarnaa-ay.

lines.english: I have become fearless, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. Inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my pains have been taken away.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay gobind  gun gaavat  saaDh sang d ukh jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That person, within whose mind the Lord abides,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai raam basai man maahee.
so jan dut ar paykh at naahee. does not see the impassible world-ocean.

lines.english: All one's affairs are resolved,
lines.transliteration: saglay kaaj savaaray apnay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam rasan nit japnay. ||1|| by chanting continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.english: Why should His slave feel any anxiety? The Guru places His hand upon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: jis kai mastak haath gur Dh arai. so d aas ad aysaa kaahay karai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The fear of birth and death is dispelled;
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee chookee kaan .

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: poorai gur oopar kurbaan. ||2||

lines.english: I am enraptured, meeting with the Guru, the Transcendent Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar bhayt nihaal.

lines.english: He alone obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, who is blessed by HisMercy.
lines.transliteration: so darsan paa-ay jis ho-ay d a-i-aal.

lines.english: One who is blessed by the Grace of the Supreme Lord God,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jis kirpaa karai.

lines.english: Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang so bh avjal t arai. ||3|| crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the

lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Holy people.
lines.transliteration: amrit peevhu saaDh  pi-aaray.

lines.english: Your face shall be radiant and bright in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal saachai d arbaaray.

lines.english: Celebrate and be blissful, and abandon all corruption.
lines.transliteration: anad karahu t aj sagal bikaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord and cross over. ||4||42||53|| pMnw 900 rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (900-1) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jap utarahu paar. ||4||42||53||

lines.english: The fire runs away from the fuel.
lines.transliteration: eeNDhan t ay baisant ar bhaagai.

lines.english: The water runs away from the dust in all directions.
lines.transliteration: maatee ka-o jal dah d is ti-aagai.

lines.english: The feet are above, and the sky is beneath.
lines.transliteration: oopar charan talai aakaas.

lines.english: The ocean appears in the cup. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghat meh sinDh  kee-o pargaas. ||1||

lines.english: Such is our all-powerful dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisaa samrath har jee-o aap.

lines.english: His devotees do not forget Him, even for an instant. Twenty-four hours a day, Omind, meditate on Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nimakh na bisrai jee-a bh agtan kai aath  pahar man t aa ka-o jaap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਜੀਅ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੈ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: First comes the butter, and then the milk.
lines.transliteration: parathmay maakhan paachh ai dooDh.

lines.english: The dirt cleans the soap.
lines.transliteration: mailoo keeno saabun sooDh.

lines.english: The fearless are afraid of fear.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay nirbh a-o dart aa firai.

lines.english: The living are killed by the dead. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hoNdee ka-o an hoNdee hirai. ||2||

lines.english: The visible body is hidden, and the etheric body is seen.
lines.transliteration: dayhee gupat  bidayhee d eesai.

lines.english: The Lord of the world does all these things.
lines.transliteration: saglay saaj karat jagd eesai.

lines.english: The one who is cheated, is not cheated by the cheat.
lines.transliteration: thagan haar an -thagdaa thaagai.

lines.english: With no merchandise, the trader trades again and again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin vakhar fir fir uth  laagai. ||3||

lines.english: So join the Society of the Saints, and chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa mil karahu bakh i-aan.

lines.english: So say the Simritees, Shaastras, Vedas and Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  bayd  puraan .

lines.english: Rare are those who contemplate and meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: barahm beechaar beechaaray ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||43||54|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (900-7) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kee param gat  ho-ay. ||4||43||54||

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him happens.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੪॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.There is none other than God.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har kee sarn aa-ee parabh  bin naahee aan bee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You look upon your children, spouse and wealth; none of these will go along with you.
lines.transliteration: put kalat ar lakh imee d eesai in meh kichh oo na sang lee-aa.

lines.english: Eating the poisonous potion, you have gone astray. You will have to go, and leave Maya and your mansions. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bikhai th ag-uree kh aa-ay bh ulaanaa maa-i-aa mand ar ti-aag ga-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਆਨ  ਬੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slandering others, you are totally ruined; because of your past actions, you shall beconsigned to the womb of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: nindaa kar kar bahut  vigoot aa garabh  jon meh kirat  pa-i-aa.

lines.english: Your past actions will not just go away; the most horrible Messenger of Death shallseize you. ||2||
lines.transliteration: purab kamaanay chh odeh naahee jamd oot garaasi-o mahaa bh a-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤਰ੍ੁ  ਲਿਖਮੀ  ਦੀਸੈ ਇਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: You tell lies, and do not practice what you preach. Your desires are not satisfied -what a shame.
lines.transliteration: bolai jhooth  kamaavai avraa t arisan na boojh ai bahut  ha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਖਾਇ  ਭੁਲਾਨਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੰਦਰੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਗਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have contracted an incurable disease; slandering the Saints, your body is wastingaway; you are utterly ruined. ||3||
lines.transliteration: asaaDh rog upji-aa sant  dookhan dayh binaasee mahaa kh a-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਾ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਵਗੂਤਾ  ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He embellishes those whom He has fashioned. He Himself gave life to the Saints.
lines.transliteration: jineh nivaajay tin hee saajay aapay keenay sant  ja-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਬ  ਕਮਾਣੇ  ਛੋਡਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਮਦੂਿਤ ਗਰ੍ਾਿਸਓ  ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He hugs His slaves close in His Embrace. Please grant Your Grace, OSupreme Lord God, and be kind to me as well. ||4||44||55|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (900-13) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kanth  laa-ay raakh ay kar kirpaa paarbarahm ma-i-aa. ||4||44||55||

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਲੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the Perfect Divine Guru, my help and support.
lines.transliteration: aisaa pooraa gurday-o sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਾਧ  ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਸੰਤ ਦੂਖਿਨ  ਦੇਹ ਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਮਹਾ ਖਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditation on Him is not wasted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa simran birthaa na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਿਹ  ਿਨਵਾਜੇ  ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਸੰਤ ਜਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured.
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh at ho-ay nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮਇਆ  ॥੪॥੪੪॥੫੫॥
lines.english: The dust of His feet snaps the noose of Death.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee Dhoor kaatai jam jaal.

lines.english: His lotus feet dwell within my mind,
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basay mayray man kay.
kaaraj savaaray saglay tan kay. ||1|| and so all the affairs of my body are arranged and resolved. ||1||

lines.english: One upon whom He places His Hand, is protected.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai mastak raakh ai haath.

lines.english: My God is the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayro anaath ko naath.

lines.english: He is the Savior of sinners, the treasure of mercy.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran  kirpaa niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa jaa-ee-ai kurbaan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਬਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: One whom He blesses with His Immaculate Mantra,
lines.transliteration: nirmal mant d ay-ay jis d aan.
tajeh bikaar binsai abh imaan. renounces corruption; his egotistical pride is dispelled.

lines.english: Meditate on the One Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: ayk Dhi-aa-ee-ai saaDh  kai sang.

lines.english: Sins are erased, through the love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paap binaasay naam kai rang. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru, the Transcendent Lord, dwells among all.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysur sagal nivaas.

lines.english: The treasure of virtue pervades and permeates each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rav rahi-aa gunt aas.

lines.english: Please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan;
lines.transliteration: daras d eh Dh aara-o parabh  aas.

lines.english: O God, I place my hopes in You. Nanak continually offers this true prayer.||4||45||56|| pMnw 901 rwgu rwmklI mhlw 5 Gru 2 dupdy  (901-1) raag raamkalee mehlaa 5 ghar 2 d upday Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (901-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: nit naanak chit vai sach ard aas. ||4||45||56||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the songs of Praise of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gaavhu raam kay gun geet .

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is obtained; coming and going is ended, my friend. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam japat param sukh  paa-ee-ai aavaa ga-on  mitai mayray meet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਪਰਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਆਵਾ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਿਮਟੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is enlightened,
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  hovat  pargaas.
charan kamal meh ho-ay nivaas. ||1|| and comes to dwell in His lotus feet. ||1||

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, one is saved.
lines.transliteration: santsangat  meh ho-ay uDh aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||57|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (901-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhavjal ut ras paar. ||2||1||57||

lines.english: My Guru is perfect, my Guru is perfect.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa mayraa gur pooraa.

lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, I am always at peace; all my illness and fraud is dispelled.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap sadaa suhaylay sagal binaasay rog kooraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Worship and adore that One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: ayk aaraaDhahu saachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁ ਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: In His Sanctuary, eternal peace is obtained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee saran sadaa sukh  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਰੋਗ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who feels hunger for the Naam sleeps in peace.
lines.transliteration: need suhaylee naam kee laagee bh ookh.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all pains are dispelled. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har simrat binsay sabh  dookh. ||2||

lines.english: Enjoy celestial bliss, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: sahj anand karahu mayray bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has eradicated all anxiety. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai sabh chint  mitaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਦ  ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ  ਭੂਖ ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, chant God's Chant.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  kaa jap jaap.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself shall save you. ||4||2||58|| rwgu rwmklI mhlw 5 pVqwl Gru 3  (901-9) raag raamkalee mehlaa 5 parh-t aal gh ar 3 Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (901-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak raakhaa ho-aa aap. ||4||2||58||

lines.english: I humbly bow to the Lord, the Supreme Being.
lines.transliteration: narnarah namaskaaraN.

lines.english: The One, the One and Only Creator Lord permeates the water, the land, the earth andthe sky. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jalan thalan basuDh gagan ayk aykaNkaaraN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: Over and over again, the Creator Lord destroys, sustains and creates.
lines.transliteration: haran Dharan pun punah karan.

lines.english: He has no home; He needs no nourishment. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nah girah niraNhaaraN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
