lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is deep and profound, strong, poised, lofty, exaltedand infinite.
lines.transliteration: gambheer Dh eer naam heer ooch mooch apaaraN.

lines.english: He stages His plays; His Virtues are priceless. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||59|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (901-12) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karan kayl gun amol naanak balihaaraN. ||2||1||59||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਨ  ਥਲਨ  ਬਸੁਧ  ਗਗਨ  ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You must abandon your beauty, pleasures, fragrances and enjoyments; beguiled bygold and sexual desire, you must still leave Maya behind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: roop rang suganDh bh og ti-aag chalay maa-i-aa chh alay kanik kaaminee. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: You gaze upon billions and trillions of treasures and riches, which delight and comfortyour mind,
lines.transliteration: bhandaar d arab arab kh arab paykh  leelaa man saDh aarai.
nah sang gaamnee. ||1|| but these will not go along with you. ||1||

lines.english: Entangled with children, spouse, siblings and friends, you are enticed and fooled;these pass like the shadow of a tree.
lines.transliteration: sut kalt ar bharaat meet  urajh  pari-o bh aram mohi-o ih birakh  chhaamnee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His lotus feet; He has found peace in the faith of theSaints. ||2||2||60|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (901-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu rwmklI mhlw 9 iqpdy ] (901-17) raag raamkalee mehlaa 9 tipd ay. Raag Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl, Ti-Padas:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal saran naanak sukh sant  bhaavnee. ||2||2||60||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕੇਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ  ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੰ  ॥੨॥੧॥੫੯॥
lines.english: O mind, take the sheltering support of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ray man ot layho har naamaa.

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, evil-mindedness is dispelled, and the state of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran durmat  naasai paavahi pad  nirbaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ  ਭੋਗ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਚਲੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਛਲੇ ਕਿਨਕ  ਕਾਿਮਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Know that one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: badbhaagee t ih jan ka-o jaanhu jo har kay gun gaavai.

lines.english: The sins of countless incarnations are washed off, and he attains the heavenly realm. ||1|| pMnw 902
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay paap kho-ay kai fun baikunth  siDhaavai. ||1||

lines.english: At the very last moment, Ajaamal became aware of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: ajaamal ka-o ant kaal meh naaraa-in suDh  aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਾਮਲ  ਕਉ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ  ਮਿਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ  ਸੁਿਧ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaaN gat ka-o jogeesur baachh at so gat  chhin meh paa-ee. ||2|| that state which even the supreme Yogis desire - he attained that state in an instant.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਗਿਤ  ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ  ਬਾਛਤ  ਸੋ ਗਿਤ  ਿਛਨ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The elephant had no virtue and no knowledge; what religious rituals has heperformed?
lines.transliteration: naahin gun naahin kachh bid i-aa Dh aram ka-un gaj keenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਹਨ  ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਿਹਨ  ਕਛੁ ਿਬਿਦਆ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਉਨੁ ਗਿਜ ਕੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, behold the way of the Lord, who bestowed the gift of fearlessness. ||3||1|| rwmklI mhlw 9 ] (902-3) raamkalee mehlaa 9. Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak birad raam kaa d aykhhu abh ai daan tih deenaa. ||3||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਿਤਹ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.english: Holy people: what way should I now adopt,
lines.transliteration: saaDho ka-un jugat  ab keejai.
jaa tay d urmat  sagal binaasai raam bh agat man bh eejai. ||1|| rahaa-o. by which all evil-mindedness may be dispelled, and the mind may vibrate in devotional worship to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

lines.english: My mind is entangled in Maya; it knows nothing at all of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: man maa-i-aa meh urajh rahi-o hai boojh ai nah kachh  gi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਨਾਸੈ  ਰਾਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What is that Name, by which the world, contemplating it, might attain the state ofNirvaanaa? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ka-un naam jag jaa kai simrai paavai pad nirbaanaa. ||1||

lines.english: When the Saints became kind and compassionate, they told me this.
lines.transliteration: bha-ay d a-i-aal kirpaal sant  jan tab ih baat  bataa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਿਹ ਉਰਿਝ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Understand, that whoever sings the Kirtan of God's Praises, has performed all religiousrituals. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarab Dharam maano t ih kee-ay jih parabh  keerat  gaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who enshrines the Lord's Name in his heart night and day - even for an instant
lines.transliteration: raam naam nar nis baasur meh nimakh ayk ur Dh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਤਬ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jam ko taraas mitai naanak t ih apuno janam savaarai. ||3||2|| - has his fear of Death eradicated. O Nanak, his life is approved and fulfilled. ||3||2|| rwmklI mhlw 9 ] (902-8) raamkalee mehlaa 9.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਧਰਮ  ਮਾਨੋ ਿਤਹ ਕੀਏ ਿਜਹ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O mortal, focus your thoughts on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraanee naaraa-in suDh layhi.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰੁ ਿਨਿਸ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਮਿਹ ਿਨਮਖ  ਏਕ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Moment by moment, your life is running out; night and day, your body is passing away in vain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhin chh in a-oDh  ghatai nis baasur baritha jaat  hai d ayh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤਰ੍ਾਸੁ ਿਮਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਿਤਹ ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਰੈ  ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: You have wasted your youth in corrupt pleasures, and your childhood in ignorance.
lines.transliteration: tarnaapo bikh i-an si-o kh o-i-o baalpan agi-aanaa.

lines.english: You have grown old, and even now, you do not understand, the evil-mindedness inwhich you are entangled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: biraDh bh a-i-o ajhoo nahee samjh ai ka-un kumat  urjhaanaa. ||1||

lines.english: Why have you forgotten your Lord and Master, who blessed you with this human life?
lines.transliteration: maanas janam dee-o jih th aakur so t ai ki-o bisraa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਛਨੁ ਿਛਨੁ ਅਉਧ  ਘਟੈ ਿਨਿਸ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਜਾਤੁ  ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, one is liberated. And yet, you do not sing HisPraises, even for an instant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mukat hot  nar jaa kai simrai nimakh  na taa ka-o gaa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: Why are you intoxicated with Maya? It will not go along with you.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa ko mad kahaa karat  hai sang na kaahoo jaa-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, think of Him, remember Him in your mind. He is the Fulfiller of desires,who will be your help and support in the end. ||3||3||81|| rwmklI mhlw 1 AstpdIAw  (902-14) raamkalee mehlaa 1 asatpadee-aa Raamkalee, First Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (902-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat chayt  chint aaman ho-ay hai ant  sahaa-ee. ||3||3||81||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਭਇਓ  ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝੈ  ਕਉਨ  ਕੁਮਿਤ  ਉਰਝਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The same moon rises, and the same stars; the same sun shines in the sky.
lines.transliteration: so-ee chand charh eh say t aaray so-ee d inee-ar t apat rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਦੀਓ  ਿਜਹ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਸੋ ਤੈ ਿਕਉ  ਿਬਸਰਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The earth is the same, and the same wind blows. The age in which we dwell affects living beings, but not these places. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saa Dhart ee so pa-un  jhulaaray jug jee-a kh aylay thaav kaisay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਹੋਤ ਨਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Give up your attachment to life.
lines.transliteration: jeevan talab nivaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦੁ  ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who act like tyrants are accepted and approved - recognize that this is the signof the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hovai parvaanaa karahi Dh inyaanaa kal lakh an veechaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹਤੁ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਿਚੰਤਾਮਿਨ  ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Kali Yuga has not been heard to have come to any country, or to be sitting at anysacred shrine.
lines.transliteration: kitai d ays na aa-i-aa sun ee-ai t irath paas na baith aa.

lines.english: It is not where the generous person gives to charities, nor seated in the mansion hehas built. ||2||
lines.transliteration: daataa daan karay t ah naahee mahal usaar na baith aa. ||2||

lines.english: If someone practices Truth, he is frustrated; prosperity does not come to the home ofthe sincere.
lines.transliteration: jay ko sat karay so chh eejai t ap gh ar tap na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਿਹ  ਸੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਿਦਨੀਅਰੁ ਤਪਤ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: If someone chants the Lord's Name, he is scorned. These are the signs of Kali Yuga. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay ko naa-o la-ay badnaavee kal kay lakh an ay-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ  ਸੋ ਪਉਣੁ  ਝੁਲਾਰੇ  ਜੁਗ ਜੀਅ  ਖੇਲੇ ਥਾਵ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever is in charge, is humiliated. Why should the servant be afraid,
lines.transliteration: jis sikdaaree t iseh kh u-aaree chaakar kayhay darn aa.
jaa sikdaarai pavai janjeeree t aa chaakar hathahu marn aa. ||4|| when the master is put in chains? He dies at the hands of his servant. ||4|| pMnw 903

lines.english: Chant the Praises of the Lord; Kali Yuga has come.
lines.transliteration: aakh gun aa kal aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The justice of the previous three ages is gone. One obtains virtue, only if the Lord bestows it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tihu jug kayraa rahi-aa t apaavas jay gun  deh ta paa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਿਹਆ  ਤਪਾਵਸੁ  ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In this turbulent age of Kali Yuga, Muslim law decides the cases, and the blue-robedQazi is the judge.
lines.transliteration: kal kalvaalee saraa nibayrhee kaajee krisanaa ho-aa.

lines.english: The Guru's Bani has taken the place of Brahma's Veda, and the singing of the Lord'sPraises are good deeds. ||5||
lines.transliteration: banee barahmaa bayd  atharban  karnee keerat  lahi-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Worship without faith; self-discipline without truthfulness; the ritual of the sacredthread without chastity - what good are these?
lines.transliteration: pat vin  poojaa sat  vin sanjam jat  vin kaahay janay-oo.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਕੀਰਿਤ ਲਿਹਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: You may bathe and wash, and apply a ritualistic tilak mark to your forehead, but without inner purity, there is no understanding. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naavhu Dhovahu t ilak charh aavahu such vin  soch na ho-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਿਵਣੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤ ਿਵਣੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਜਤ ਿਵਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨੇਊ  ॥
lines.english: In Kali Yuga, the Koran and the Bible have become famous.
lines.transliteration: kal parvaan kat ayb kuraan .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਿਤਲਕੁ  ਚੜਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਚ ਿਵਣੁ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Pandit's scriptures and the Puraanas are not respected.
lines.transliteration: pothee pandit rahay puraan .

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name now is Rehmaan, the Merciful.
lines.transliteration: naanak naa-o bha-i-aa rehmaan .

lines.english: Know that there is only One Creator of the creation. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kar kartaa t oo ayko jaan . ||7||

lines.english: Nanak has obtained the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Thereis no action higher than this.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee aydoo upar karam nahee.

lines.english: If someone goes out to beg for what is already in his own home, then he should bechastised. ||8||1|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (903-6) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay ghar hod ai mangan  jaa-ee-ai fir olaamaa milai t ahee. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਏਦੂ ਉਪਿਰ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.english: You preach to the world, and set up your house.
lines.transliteration: jag parboDheh marh ee baDh aaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਘਿਰ ਹੋਦੈ ਮੰਗਿਣ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਿਫਿਰ ਓਲਾਮਾ  ਿਮਲੈ ਤਹੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: Abandoning your Yogic postures, how will you find the True Lord?
lines.transliteration: aasan t i-aag kaahay sach paavahi.

lines.english: You are attached to possessiveness and the love of sexual pleasure.
lines.transliteration: mamtaa moh kaaman  hitkaaree.

lines.english: You are not a renunciate, nor a man of the world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa a-uDhoot ee naa sansaaree. ||1||

lines.english: Yogi, remain seated, and the pain of duality will run away from you.
lines.transliteration: jogee bais rahhu dubiDh aa dukh bhaagai.

lines.english: You beg from door to door, and you don't feel ashamed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar maagat  laaj na laagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You sing the songs, but you do not understand your own self.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi geet na cheeneh aap.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਬੈਿਸ ਰਹਹੁ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: How will the burning pain within be relieved?
lines.transliteration: ki-o laagee nivrai partaap.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਮਾਗਤ  ਲਾਜ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, let your mind be absorbed in the Lord's Love,
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rachai man bh aa-ay.
bhikh i-aa sahj veechaaree kh aa-ay. ||2|| and you will intuitively experience the charity of contemplation. ||2||

lines.english: You apply ashes to your body, while acting in hypocrisy.
lines.transliteration: bhasam charh aa-ay karahi pakh and.

lines.english: Attached to Maya, you will be beaten by Death's heavy club.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi saheh jam dand.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your begging bowl is broken; it will not hold the charity of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: footai khaapar bh eekh na bh aa-ay.

lines.english: Bound in bondage, you come and go. ||3||
lines.transliteration: banDhan baaDh i-aa aavai jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: You do not control your seed and semen, and yet you claim to practice abstinence.
lines.transliteration: bind na raakh ahi jat ee kahaaveh.

lines.english: You beg from Maya, lured by the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee maagat t arai lobh aaveh.

lines.english: You have no compassion; the Lord's Light does not shine in you.
lines.transliteration: nirda-i-aa nahee jot  ujaalaa.

lines.english: You are drowned, drowned in worldly entanglements. ||4||
lines.transliteration: boodat booday sarab janjaalaa. ||4||

lines.english: You wear religious robes, and your patched coat assumes many disguises.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh  karahi kh inthaa baho thatoo-aa.

lines.english: You play all sorts of false tricks, like a juggler.
lines.transliteration: jhooth o khayl kh aylai baho natoo-aa.

lines.english: The fire of anxiety burns brightly within you.
lines.transliteration: antar agan chint aa baho jaaray.

lines.english: Without the karma of good actions, how can you cross over? ||5||
lines.transliteration: vin karmaa kaisay ut ras paaray. ||5||

lines.english: You make ear-rings of glass to wear in your ears.
lines.transliteration: mundraa fatak banaa-ee kaan.

lines.english: But liberation does not come from learning without understanding.
lines.transliteration: mukat nahee bid i-aa bigi-aan.

lines.english: You are lured by the tastes of the tongue and sex organs.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa indree saad  lobhaanaa.

lines.english: You have become a beast; this sign cannot be erased. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pasoo bha-ay nahee mitai neesaanaa. ||6||

lines.english: The people of the world are entangled in the three modes; the Yogis are entangled in the three modes.
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  logaa t aribaDh  jogaa.

lines.english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, sorrows are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sabad veechaarai chookas sogaa.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, one becomes radiant, pure and truthful.
lines.transliteration: oojal saach so sabad ho-ay.

lines.english: One who contemplates the true lifestyle is a Yogi. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jogee jugat veechaaray so-ay. ||7||

lines.english: The nine treasures are with You, Lord; You are potent, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: tujh peh na-o niDh  too karn ai jog.

lines.english: You establish and disestablish; whatever You do, happens.
lines.transliteration: thaap uthaapay karay so hog.

lines.english: One who practices celibacy, chastity, self-control, truth and pure consciousness
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam sach sucheet .

lines.english: - O Nanak, that Yogi is the friend of the three worlds. ||8||2|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (903-17) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jogee taribh avan meet . ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਪਿਹ ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Above the six chakras of the body dwells the detached mind.
lines.transliteration: khat mat d ayhee man bairaagee.

lines.english: Awareness of the vibration of the Word of the Shabad has been awakened deepwithin.
lines.transliteration: surat sabad  Dhun ant ar jaagee.

lines.english: The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds within; my mind isattuned to it.
lines.transliteration: vaajai anhad mayraa man leen aa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, my faith is confirmed in the True Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee sach naam pateen aa. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, through devotion to the Lord, peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: paraanee raam bh agat sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the Gurmukh, who merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 904
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har har meeth aa laagai har har naam samaa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Eradicating attachment to Maya, one merges into the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh bivaraj samaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, we unite in His Union.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan nirmolak heeraa.

lines.english: Attuned to it, the mind is comforted and encouraged. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tit raataa mayraa man Dh eeraa. ||2||

lines.english: The diseases of egotism and possessiveness do not afflict
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa rog na laagai.
raam bhagat  jam kaa bh a-o bh aagai. one who worships the Lord. Fear of the Messenger of Death runs away.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death, the enemy of the soul, does not touch me at all.
lines.transliteration: jam jandaar na laagai mohi.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Name of the Lord illuminates my heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam ridai har sohi. ||3||

lines.english: Contemplating the Shabad, we become Nirankaari - we come to belong to the Formless Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sabad beechaar bh a-ay nirankaaree.

lines.english: Awakening to the Guru's Teachings, evil-mindedness is taken away.
lines.transliteration: gurmat jaagay d urmat  parhaaree.

lines.english: Remaining awake and aware night and day, lovingly focused on the Lord,
lines.transliteration: an-din jaag rahay liv laa-ee.
jeevan mukat gat  antar paa-ee. ||4|| one becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive. He finds this state deep withinhimself. ||4||

lines.english: In the secluded cave, I remain unattached.
lines.transliteration: alipat gufaa meh raheh niraaray.

lines.english: With the Word of the Shabad, I have killed the five thieves.
lines.transliteration: taskar panch sabad  sangh aaray.

lines.english: My mind does not waver or go to the home of any other.
lines.transliteration: par ghar jaa-ay na man dolaa-ay.

lines.english: I remain intuitively absorbed deep within. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sahj nirantar raha-o samaa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I remain awake and aware, unattached.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaag rahay a-uDh ootaa.

lines.english: Forever detached, I am woven into the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: sad bairaagee t at parot aa.

lines.english: The world is asleep; it dies, and comes and goes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: jag sootaa mar aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it does not understand. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad na sojh ee paa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates day and night.
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  vajai d in raat ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the state of the eternal, unchanging Lord God.
lines.transliteration: avigat kee gat  gurmukh  jaatee.

lines.english: When someone realizes the Shabad, then he truly knows.
lines.transliteration: ta-o jaanee jaa sabad  pachh aanee.

lines.english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere in Nirvaanaa. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ayko rav rahi-aa nirbaanee. ||7||

lines.english: My mind is intuitively absorbed in the state of deepest Samaadhi;
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh sahj man raat aa.
taj ha-o lobh aa ayko jaat aa. renouncing egotism and greed, I have come to know the One Lord.

lines.english: When the disciple's mind accepts the Guru,
lines.transliteration: gur chaylay apnaa man maani-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, duality is eradicated, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||3|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (904-10) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak doojaa mayt samaani-aa. ||8||3||

lines.english: You calculate the auspicious days, but you do not understand
lines.transliteration: saahaa ganeh na karahi beechaar.
saahay oopar aykankaar. that the One Creator Lord is above these auspicious days.

lines.english: He alone knows the way, who meets the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis gur milai so-ee biDh jaan ai.

lines.english: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, then he realizes the Hukam of God'sCommand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmat ho-ay t a hukam pachh aanai. ||1||

lines.english: Do not tell lies, O Pandit; O religious scholar, speak the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  na bol paaday sach kahee-ai.

lines.english: When egotism is eradicated through the Word of the Shabad, then one finds His home. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jaa-ay sabad gh ar lahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Calculating and counting, the astrologer draws the horoscope.
lines.transliteration: gan gan  jotak kaaNdee keenee.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਿਲ ਪਾਡੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He studies it and announces it, but he does not understand reality.
lines.transliteration: parhai sun aavai t at na cheenee.

lines.english: Understand, that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is above all.
lines.transliteration: sabhsai oopar gur sabad  beechaar.

lines.english: Do not speak of anything else; it is all just ashes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hor kathnee bada-o na saglee chh aar. ||2||

lines.english: You bathe, wash, and worship stones.
lines.transliteration: naaveh Dhoveh poojeh sailaa.

lines.english: But without being imbued with the Lord, you are the filthiest of the filthy.
lines.transliteration: bin har raatay mailo mailaa.

lines.english: Subduing your pride, you shall receive the supreme wealth of God.
lines.transliteration: garab nivaar milai parabh saarath.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰ ਕਥਨੀ  ਬਦਉ  ਨ ਸਗਲੀ  ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The mortal is liberated and emancipated, meditating on the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mukat paraan jap har kirt aarath. ||3||

lines.english: You study the arguments, but do not contemplate the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: vaachai vaad na bayd  beechaarai.

lines.english: You drown yourself - how will you save your ancestors?
lines.transliteration: aap dubai ki-o pitraa t aarai.

lines.english: How rare is that person who realizes that God is in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at barahm cheenai jan ko-ay.

lines.english: When one meets the True Guru, then he understands. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a sojh ee ho-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Making his calculations, cynicism and suffering afflict his soul.
lines.transliteration: ganat  ganee-ai sahsaa d ukh jee-ai.

lines.english: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found.
lines.transliteration: gur kee saran pavai sukh  thee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਚੀਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I sinned and made mistakes, but now I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: kar apraaDh saran  ham aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Guru led me to meet the Lord, according to my past actions. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur har bhaytay purab kamaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: If one does not enter the Guru's Sanctuary, God cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: gur saran na aa-ee-ai barahm na paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, one is born, only to die, and come back again.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaa-ee-ai janam mar aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Dying in corruption, he is bound and gagged at Death's door.
lines.transliteration: jam dar baaDh a-o marai bikaar.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not in his heart, and he does not act according to the Shabad. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naa ridai naam na sabad  achaar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਿਣ  ਨ ਆਈਐ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Some call themselves Pandits, religious scholars and spiritual teachers.
lines.transliteration: ik paaDhay pandit  misar kahaaveh.

lines.english: Tinged with double-mindedness, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. pMnw 905
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa raat ay mahal na paavahi.

lines.english: One who takes the Support of the Naam, by Guru's Grace,
lines.transliteration: jis gur parsaadee naam aDhaar.
kot maDhay ko jan aapaar. ||7|| is a rare person, one among millions, incomparable. ||7||

lines.english: One is bad, and another good, but the One True Lord is contained in all.
lines.transliteration: ayk buraa bhalaa sach aykai.

lines.english: Understand this, O spiritual teacher, through the support of the True Guru:
lines.transliteration: boojh gi-aanee sat gur kee taykai.
gurmukh virlee ayko jaan i-aa. rare indeed is that Gurmukh, who realizes the One Lord.

lines.english: His comings and goings cease, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa mayt samaan i-aa. ||8||

lines.english: Those who have the One Universal Creator Lord within their hearts,
lines.transliteration: jin kai hirdai aykankaar.
sarab gunee saachaa beechaar. possess all virtues; they contemplate the True Lord.

lines.english: One who acts in harmony with the Guru's Will,
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai karam kamaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||9||4|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (905-4) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay saach samaavai. ||9||4||

lines.english: Practicing restraint by Hatha Yoga, the body wears away.
lines.transliteration: hath nigarahu kar kaa-i-aa chh eejai.

lines.english: The mind is not softened by fasting or austerities.
lines.transliteration: varat t apan kar man nahee bh eejai.

lines.english: Nothing else is equal to worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam sar avar na poojai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਤੁ ਤਪਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Serve the Guru, O mind, and associate with the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sayv manaa har jan sang keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot touch you, and the serpent of Maya cannot sting you, when you drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jam jandaar johi nahee saakai sarpan das na sakai har kaa ras peejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਮਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The world reads the arguments, and is softened only by music.
lines.transliteration: vaad parh ai raagee jag bh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਰਪਿਨ  ਡਿਸ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the three modes and corruption, they are born and die.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  bikhi-aa janam mareejai.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, they endure suffering and pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin dookh  saheejai. ||2||

lines.english: The Yogi draws the breath upwards, and opens the Tenth Gate.
lines.transliteration: chaarhas pavan singh aasan bh eejai.

lines.english: He practices inner cleansing and the six rituals of purification.
lines.transliteration: ni-ulee karam khat karam kareejai.

lines.english: But without the Lord's Name, the breath he draws is useless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin birthaa saas leejai. ||3||

lines.english: The fire of the five passions burns within him; how can he be calm?
lines.transliteration: antar panch agan ki-o Dh eeraj Dh eejai.

lines.english: The thief is within him; how can he taste the taste?
lines.transliteration: antar chor ki-o saad  laheejai.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh conquers the body-fortress. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay kaa-i-aa garh  leejai. ||4||

lines.english: With filth within, he wanders around at places of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: antar mail t irath bh armeejai.

lines.english: His mind is not pure, so what is the use of performing ritual cleansings?
lines.transliteration: man nahee soochaa ki-aa soch kareejai.

lines.english: He carries the karma of his own past actions; who else can he blame? ||5||
lines.transliteration: kirat pa-i-aa d os kaa ka-o d eejai. ||5||

lines.english: He does not eat food; he tortures his body.
lines.transliteration: ann na khaahi d ayhee d ukh deejai.

lines.english: Without the Guru's wisdom, he is not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: bin gur gi-aan taripat  nahee theejai.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is born only to die, and be born again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: manmukh janmai janam mareejai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਿਹ  ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Go, and ask the True Guru, and associate with the Lord's humble servants.
lines.transliteration: satgur poochh  sangat  jan keejai.

lines.english: Your mind shall merge into the Lord, and you shall not be reincarnated to die again.
lines.transliteration: man har raachai nahee janam mareejai.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, what can anyone do? ||7||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin ki-aa karam keejai. ||7||

lines.english: Silence the mouse scurrying around within you.
lines.transliteration: ooNdar dooNdar paas Dh areejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur kee sayvaa raam raveejai. Serve the Primal Lord, by chanting the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, God blesses us with His Name, when He grants His Grace. ||8||5|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (905-14) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai kirpaa parabh keejai. ||8||5||

lines.english: The created Universe emanated from within You; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: antar ut -bhuj avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: Whatever is said to be, is from You, O God.
lines.transliteration: jo kahee-ai so parabh t ay ho-ee.

lines.english: He is the True Lord and Master, throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: jugah jugantar saahib sach so-ee.

lines.english: Creation and destruction do not come from anyone else. ||1||
lines.transliteration: utpat parla-o avar na ko-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Such is my Lord and Master, profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: aisaa mayraa thaakur gahir gambh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Whoever meditates on Him, finds peace. The arrow of the Messenger of Death does not strike one who has the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin japi-aa tin hee sukh  paa-i-aa har kai naam na lagai jam t eer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan heeraa nirmol.

lines.english: The True Lord Master is immortal and immeasurable.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib amar atol.

lines.english: That tongue which chants the True Name is pure.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa soochee saachaa bol.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਿਪਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Lord is in the home of the self; there is no doubt about it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar saachaa naahee rol. ||2||

lines.english: Some sit in the forests, and some make their home in the mountains.
lines.transliteration: ik ban meh baiseh doogar asthaan.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, they rot away in egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar pacheh abhimaan.

lines.english: Without the Naam, what is the use of spiritual wisdom and meditation?
lines.transliteration: naam binaa ki-aa gi-aan Dhi-aan.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paavahi d argahi maan. ||3||

lines.english: Acting stubbornly in egotism, one does not find the Lord.
lines.transliteration: hath ahaNkaar karai nahee paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਬਨ ਮਿਹ ਬੈਸਿਹ  ਡੂਗਿਰ  ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Studying the scriptures, reading them to other people, pMnw 906
lines.transliteration: paath parh ai lay lok sun aavai.
tirath bh armas bi-aaDh  na jaavai. and wandering around at places of pilgrimage, the disease is not taken away.

lines.english: Without the Naam, how can one find peace? ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kaisay sukh paavai. ||4||

lines.english: No matter how much he tries, he cannot control his semen and seed.
lines.transliteration: jatan karai bind  kivai na rahaa-ee.

lines.english: His mind wavers, and he falls into hell.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa dolai narkay paa-ee.

lines.english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, he is tortured.
lines.transliteration: jam pur baaDho lahai sajaa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Name, his soul cries out in agony. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai jee-o jal bal jaa-ee. ||5||

lines.english: The many Siddhas and seekers, silent sages and demi-gods
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik kayt ay mun d ayvaa.
hath nigrahi na t ariptaaveh bh ayvaa. cannot satisfy themselves by practicing restraint through Hatha Yoga.

lines.english: One who contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and serves the Guru
lines.transliteration: sabad veechaar gaheh gur sayvaa.
man tan nirmal abh imaan abh ayvaa. ||6|| - his mind and body become immaculate, and his egotistical pride is obliterated. ||6||

lines.english: Blessed with Your Grace, I obtain the True Name.
lines.transliteration: karam milai paavai sach naa-o.

lines.english: I remain in Your Sanctuary, in loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: tum sarn aagat  raha-o subh aa-o.

lines.english: Love for Your devotional worship has welled up within me.
lines.transliteration: tum t ay upji-o bh agtee bh aa-o.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jap jaapa-o gurmukh har naa-o. ||7||

lines.english: When one is rid of egotism and pride, his mind is drenched in the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai garab jaa-ay man bheenai.

lines.english: Practicing fraud and hypocrisy, he does not find God.
lines.transliteration: jhooth  na paavas pakh and keenai.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he cannot find the Lord's Door.
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad nahee gh ar baar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||6|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (906-7) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh t at beechaar. ||8||6||

lines.english: As you come, so will you leave, you fool; as you were born, so will you die.
lines.transliteration: ji-o aa-i-aa ti-o jaaveh ba-uray ji-o janmay t i-o maran  bha-i-aa.

lines.english: As you enjoy pleasures, so will you suffer pain. Forgetting the Naam, the Name of theLord, you will fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ras bhog kee-ay t aytaa dukh laagai naam visaar bh avjal pa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਆਇਆ  ਿਤਉ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਬਉਰੇ  ਿਜਉ ਜਨਮੇ  ਿਤਉ  ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon your body and wealth, you are so proud.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an daykhat garab ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ਭਵਜਿਲ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your love for gold and sexual pleasures increases; why have you forgotten the Naam,and why do you wander in doubt? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kanik kaamnee si-o hayt vaDh aa-ihi kee naam visaareh bh aram ga-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You do not practice truth, abstinence, self-discipline or humility; the ghost within yourskeleton has turned to dry wood.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam seel na raakh i-aa parayt  pinjar meh kaasat bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਨਕ  ਕਾਮਨੀ  ਿਸਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਿਹ  ਕੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਰਿਹ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਗਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have not practiced charity, donations, cleansing baths or austerities. Without theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, your life has gone in vain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: punn daan isnaan na sanjam saaDh sangat  bin baad  ja-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Attached to greed, you have forgotten the Naam. Coming and going, your life hasbeen ruined.
lines.transliteration: laalach laagai naam bisaari-o aavat jaavat  janam ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸੀਲੁ  ਨ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਪਰ੍ੇਤ ਿਪੰਜਰ  ਮਿਹ ਕਾਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the Messenger of Death grabs you by your hair, you will be punished. You are unconscious, and have fallen into Death's mouth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa jam Dhaa-ay kays geh maarai surat  nahee mukh  kaal ga-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬਾਿਦ  ਜਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Day and night, you jealously slander others; in your heart, you have neither theNaam, nor compassion for all.
lines.transliteration: ahinis nindaa t aat paraa-ee hird ai naam na sarab d a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਿਚ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਬਸਾਿਰਓ  ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਵਤ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you will not find salvation or honor. Withoutthe Lord's Name, you shall go to hell. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad na gat  pat paavahi raam naam bin narak ga-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ  ਕੇਸ ਗਿਹ ਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਮੁਿਖ ਕਾਲ  ਗਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In an instant, you change into various costumes, like a juggler; you are entangled inemotional attachment and sin.
lines.transliteration: khin meh vays karahi natoo-aa ji-o moh paap meh galat  ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਤਾਿਤ  ਪਰਾਈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਰਬ  ਦਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You gaze here and there upon the expanse of Maya; you are intoxicated withattachment to Maya. ||5||
lines.transliteration: it ut maa-i-aa d aykh pasaaree moh maa-i-aa kai magan bh a-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਨ ਗਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਵਿਹ ਰਾਮ  ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਰਿਕ  ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.english: You act in corruption, and put on ostentatious shows, but without awareness of theShabad, you have fallen into confusion.
lines.transliteration: karahi bikaar vithaar ghanayray surat  sabad  bin bh aram pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਿਹ  ਨਟੂਆ  ਿਜਉ  ਮੋਹ ਪਾਪ ਮਿਹ ਗਲਤੁ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You suffer great pain from the disease of egotism. Following the Guru's Teachings,you shall be rid of this disease. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog mahaa dukh  laagaa gurmat  layvhu rog ga-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਾਇਆ  ਦੇਿਖ ਪਸਾਰੀ  ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Seeing peace and wealth come to him, the faithless cynic become proud in his mind.
lines.transliteration: sukh sampat  ka-o aavat  daykhai saakat  man abh imaan bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਿਵਥਾਰ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਬਦ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭਰਿਮ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But He who owns this body and wealth, takes them back again, and then the mortal feels anxiety and pain deep within. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jis kaa ih tan Dh an so fir layvai ant ar sahsaa d ookh pa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲੇਵਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: At the very last instant, nothing goes along with you; all is visible only by His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: ant kaal kichh  saath na chaalai jo d eesai sabh  tiseh ma-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਕਉ ਆਵਤ  ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਕਤ  ਮਿਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: God is our Primal and Infinite Lord; enshrining the Lord's Name in the heart, onecrosses over. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  aprampar so parabh  har naam rid ai lai paar pa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਿਫਿਰ  ਲੇਵੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਦੂਖੁ ਪਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You weep for the dead, but who hears you weeping? The dead have fallen to theserpent in the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: moo-ay ka-o roveh kiseh sunaaveh bh ai saagar asraal pa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਮਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon his family, wealth, household and mansions, the faithless cynic is entangled in worthless worldly affairs. ||9|| pMnw 907
lines.transliteration: daykh  kutamb maa-i-aa garih mand ar saakat  janjaal paraal pa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ  ਜੰਜਾਿਲ  ਪਰਾਿਲ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: He comes when the Lord sends him; when the Lord calls him back, he goes.
lines.transliteration: jaa aa-ay taa t ineh path aa-ay chaalay t inai bulaa-ay la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਆਏ  ਤਾ ਿਤਨਿਹ  ਪਠਾਏ  ਚਾਲੇ ਿਤਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ  ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever he does, the Lord is doing. The Forgiving Lord forgives him. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karn aa so kar rahi-aa bakh sanhaarai bakh as la-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੋ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: I seek to be with those who have tasted this sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin ayhu chaakhi-aa raam rasaa-in  tin kee sangat  khoj bha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਹੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers, wisdom and spiritual knowledge, are obtained from the Guru. The treasure of liberation is obtained in His Sanctuary. ||11||
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  buDh  gi-aan guroo t ay paa-i-aa mukat  padaarath saran  pa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮੁਕਿਤ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same; he remainsuntouched by joy and sorrow.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  gurmukh  sam kar jaan aa harakh  sog t ay birkat  bha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣਾ  ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਿਬਰਕਤੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Conquering his self-conceit, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; O Nanak, he intuitivelymerges into the Lord. ||12||7|| rwmklI dKxI mhlw 1 ] (907-5) raamkalee dakh -nee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, Dakhanee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap maar gurmukh har paa-ay naanak sahj samaa-ay la-i-aa. ||12||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਲਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥੭॥
lines.english: Abstinence, chastity, self-control and truthf ulness have been implanted within me; I am imbued with the sublime essence of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam saach drirh -aa-i-aa saach sabad  ras leen aa. ||1||

lines.english: My Merciful Guru remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: mayraa gur da-i-aal sad aa rang leen aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਸਾਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਿਸ ਲੀਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Day and night, He remains lovingly focused on the One Lord; gazing upon the TrueLord, He is pleased. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ahinis rahai ayk liv laagee saachay daykh  pateenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਲੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He abides in the Tenth Gate, and looks equally upon all; He is imbued with theunstruck sound current of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rahai gagan pur darisat samaisar anhat  sabad  rangeen aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਿਖ ਪਤੀਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wearing the loin-cloth of chastity, He remains absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; His tongue enjoys the taste of God's Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sat banDh  kupeen bh aripur leen aa jihvaa rang raseen aa. ||3||

lines.english: The One who created the creation has met the True Guru; contemplating the Guru'slifestyle, He is pleased. ||4||
lines.transliteration: milai gur saachay jin rach raachay kirat veechaar pat eenaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ  ਪੁਿਰ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਮੈਸਿਰ ਅਨਹਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰੰਗੀਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All are in the One, and the One is in all. This is what the True Guru has shown me.||5||
lines.transliteration: ayk meh sarab sarab meh aykaa ayh satgur d aykh dikhaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਬੰਿਧ ਕੁਪੀਨ  ਭਿਰਪੁਿਰ  ਲੀਣਾ  ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਸੀਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He who created the worlds, solar systems and galaxies - that God cannot be known.||6||
lines.transliteration: jin kee-ay khand mandal barahmandaa so parabh  lakhan na jaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਪਤੀਣਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: From the lamp of God, the lamp within is lit; the Divine Light illuminates the threeworlds. ||7||
lines.transliteration: deepak t ay deepak pargaasi-aa t aribhavan jot dikhaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਮਿਹ ਸਰਬ  ਸਰਬ  ਮਿਹ ਏਕਾ ਏਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੇਿਖ ਿਦਖਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Guru sits on the true throne in the true mansion; He is attuned, absorbed in theFearless Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sachai takh at sach mahlee baith ay nirbh a-o taarhee laa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Guru, the detached Yogi, has enticed the hearts of all; He plays His harp in eachand every heart. ||9||
lines.transliteration: mohi ga-i-aa bairaagee jogee ghat gh at kinguree vaa-ee. ||9||

lines.english: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is emancipated; the True Guru becomes our truehelp and support. ||10||8|| rwmklI mhlw 1 ] (907-13) raamkalee mehlaa 1. Raamkalee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran parabh oo kee chh ootay sat gur sach sakh aa-ee. ||10||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਿਤ  ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ  ਬੈਠੇ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: He has made His home in the monastery of the heart; He has infused His power intothe earth and the sky. ||1||
lines.transliteration: a-uhath hasat  marh ee gh ar chh aa-i-aa Dh aran gagan kal Dh aaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਿਕੰਗੁਰੀ  ਵਾਈ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs have saved so very many, O Saints.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kayt ee sabad  uDhaaree sant ahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੧੦॥੮॥
lines.english: He conquers attachment, and eradicates egotism, and sees Your Divine Lightpervading the three worlds, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mamtaa maar ha-umai sokh ai taribhavan jot tumaaree. ||2||

lines.english: He conquers desire, and enshrines the Lord within his mind; he contemplates theWord of the True Guru's Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mansaa maar manai meh raakhai sat gur sabad  veechaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਹਿਠ  ਹਸਤ  ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ  ਧਰਿਣ  ਗਗਨ  ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The horn of consciousness vibrates the unstruck sound current; Your Light illuminateseach and every heart, Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sinyee surat  anaahad  vaajai gh at ghat jot tumaaree. ||4||

lines.english: He plays the flute of the universe in his mind, and lights the fire of God. ||5||
lines.transliteration: parpanch bayn t ahee man raakh i-aa barahm agan parjaaree. ||5||

lines.english: Bringing together the five elements, day and night, the Lord's lamp shines with theImmaculate Light of the Infinite. ||6||
lines.transliteration: panch tat  mil ahinis d eepak nirmal jot  apaaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਮਤਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸੋਖੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The right and left nostrils, the sun and the moon channels, are the strings of the body-harp; they vibrate the wondrous melody of the Shabad. ||7||
lines.transliteration: rav sas la-ukay ih tan kinguree vaajai sabad  niraaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਾਿਰ ਮਨੈ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The true hermit obtains a seat in the City of God, the invisible, inaccessible, infinite.||8||
lines.transliteration: siv nagree meh aasan a-oDh oo alakh  agamm apaaree. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸੰਙੀ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਅਨਾਹਿਦ  ਵਾਜੈ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਜੋਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The mind is the king of the city of the body; the five sources of knowledge dwellwithin it. ||9||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagree ih man raajaa panch vaseh veechaaree. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਪੰਚ  ਬੇਣੁ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਪਰਜਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Seated in his home, this king chants the Shabad; he administers justice and virtue.||10||
lines.transliteration: sabad ravai aasan  ghar raajaa ad al karay gun kaaree. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਿਨਰਮਲ ਜੋਿਤ ਅਪਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: What can poor death or birth say to him? Conquering his mind, he remains dead while yet alive. ||11|| pMnw 908
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal kahay kahi bapuray jeevat moo-aa man maaree. ||11||

lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are manifestations of the One God. He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||12||
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays ik moorat aapay kart aa kaaree. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ  ਇਕ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਾਰੀ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: One who purifies his body, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; he contemplatesthe essence of his own soul. ||13||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa soDh t arai bh av saagar aat am tat veechaaree. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਸੋਿਧ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਤਮ  ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, he finds everlasting peace; deep within, the Shabad permeates him, coloring him with virtue. ||14||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa ant ar sabad  ravi-aa gun kaaree. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The Giver of virtue unites with Himself, one who conquers egotism and desire. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl la-ay gundaat aa ha-umai t arisnaa maaree. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Eradicating the three qualities, dwell in the fourth state. This is the unparalleleddevotional worship. ||16||
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maytay cha-uthai vart ai ayhaa bh agat niraaree. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਏਹਾ ਭਗਿਤ ਿਨਰਾਰੀ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: This is the Yoga of the Gurmukh: Through the Shabad, he understands his own soul,and he enshrines within his heart the One Lord. ||17||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jog sabad  aatam cheenai hird ai ayk muraaree. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੋਗ ਸਬਿਦ  ਆਤਮੁ  ਚੀਨੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Shabad, his mind becomes steady and stable; this is the mostexcellent action. ||18||
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa asthir sabday raat aa ayhaa karn ee saaree. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ  ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰੀ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: This true hermit does not enter into religious debates or hypocrisy; the Gurmukhcontemplates the Shabad. ||19||
lines.transliteration: bayd baad  na pakh and a-oDh oo gurmukh  sabad  beechaaree. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਅਉਧੂ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh practices Yoga - he is the true hermit; he practices abstinence andtruth, and contemplates the Shabad. ||20||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jog kamaavai a-oDh oo jat  sat sabad  veechaaree. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਅਉਧੂ  ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind is the true hermit; he understandsthe Way of Yoga. ||21||
lines.transliteration: sabad marai man maaray a-oDh oo jog jugat  veechaaree. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ  ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Attachment to Maya is the terrifying world-ocean; through the Shabad, the true hermit saves himself, and his ancestors as well. ||22||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh bhavjal hai avDh oo sabad  tarai kul t aaree. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit;contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||
lines.transliteration: sabad soor jug chaaray a-oDh oo ban ee bh agat veechaaree. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੂਰ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ  ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: This mind is enticed by Maya, O hermit; contemplating the Shabad, you shall findrelease. ||24||
lines.transliteration: ayhu man maa-i-aa mohi-aa a-oDhoo niksai sabad  veechaaree. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਅਉਧੂ  ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: He Himself forgives, and unites in His Union; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord.||25||9|| rwmklI mhlw 3 AstpdIAw  (908-10) raamkalee mehlaa 3 asatpadee-aa Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (908-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay mayl milaa-ay naanak saran  tumaaree. ||25||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨੫॥੯॥
lines.english: Make humility your ear-rings, Yogi, and compassion your patched coat.
lines.transliteration: sarmai dee-aa mund raa kannee paa-ay jogee kh inthaa kar t oo da-i-aa.

lines.english: Let coming and going be the ashes you apply to your body, Yogi, and then you shallconquer the three worlds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  bibhoot laa-ay jogee t aa teen bh avan jin la-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਮੈ  ਦੀਆ  ਮੁੰਦਰ੍ਾ ਕੰਨੀ  ਪਾਇ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਕਿਰ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Play that harp, Yogi,
lines.transliteration: aisee kinguree vajaa-ay jogee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਿਬਭੂਿਤ ਲਾਇ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਤਾ ਤੀਿਨ ਭਵਣ  ਿਜਿਣ  ਲਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jit kinguree anhad  vaajai har si-o rahai liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. which vibrates the unstruck sound current, and remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

lines.english: Make truth and contentment your plate and pouch, Yogi; take the Ambrosial Naam asyour food.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh pat kar jh olee jogee amrit  naam bh ugat paa-ee.

lines.english: Dhi-aan kaa kar dandaa jogee siny ee surat  vajaa-ee. ||2|| Make meditation your walking stick, Yogi, and make higher consciousness the hornyou blow. ||2||
Make your stable mind the Yogic posture you sit in, Yogi, and then you shall be rid ofyour tormenting desires.
lines.transliteration: man darirh  kar aasan  bais jogee t aa tayree kalpan aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਪਤੁ ਕਿਰ ਝੋਲੀ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Go begging in the village of the body, Yogi, and then, you shall obtain the Naam inyour lap. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagree meh mangan charh eh jogee t aa naam palai paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਆਨ  ਕਾ ਕਿਰ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ  ਿਸੰਙੀ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਵਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This harp does not center you in meditation, Yogi, nor does it bring the True Nameinto your lap.
lines.transliteration: it kinguree Dh i-aan na laagai jogee naa sach palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਕਿਰ ਆਸਿਣ  ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This harp does not bring you peace, Yogi, nor eliminate egotism from within you. ||4||
lines.transliteration: it kinguree saaNt na aavai jogee abh imaan na vichahu jaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰੀ  ਮਿਹ ਮੰਗਿਣ  ਚੜਿਹ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Make the Fear of God, and the Love of God, the two gourds of your lute, Yogi, andmake this body its neck.
lines.transliteration: bha-o bh aa-o d u-ay pat  laa-ay jogee ih sareer kar dandee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਿਕੰਗੁਰੀ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ  ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Become Gurmukh, and then vibrate the strings; in this way, your desires shall depart. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hoveh t aa tantee vaajai in biDh  tarisnaa kh andee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਿਕੰਗੁਰੀ  ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command is called a Yogi; he links hisconsciousness to the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: hukam bujhai so jogee kahee-ai aykas si-o chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਪਤ ਲਾਇ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
lines.english: His cynicism is dispelled, and he becomes immaculately pure; this is how he finds theWay of Yoga. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sahsaa tootai nirmal hovai jog jugat  iv paa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ  ਵਾਜੈ ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Everything that comes into view shall be destroyed; focus your consciousness on theLord.
lines.transliteration: nadree aavd aa sabh  kichh  binsai har sayt ee chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਏਕਸ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Enshrine love for the True Guru, and then you shall obtain this understanding. ||7|| pMnw 909
lines.transliteration: satgur naal t ayree bh aavnee laagai t aa ih sojh ee paa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: This is not Yoga, O Yogi, to abandon your family and wander around.
lines.transliteration: ayhu jog na hovai jogee je kutamb chhod parbh avan karahi.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ  ਿਜ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਪਰਭਵਣੁ  ਕਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is within the household of the body. By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Lord God. ||8||
lines.transliteration: garih sareer meh har har naam gur parsaadee apnaa har parabh  laheh. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਸਰੀਰ  ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਹਿਹ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: This world is a puppet of clay, Yogi; the terrible disease, the desire for Maya is in it.
lines.transliteration: ih jagat mitee kaa put laa jogee is meh rog vadaa t arisnaa maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਮਟੀ  ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਇਸੁ ਮਿਹ  ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Making all sorts of efforts, and wearing religious robes, Yogi, this disease cannot be cured. ||9||
lines.transliteration: anayk jatan bh aykh karay jogee rog na jaa-ay gavaa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਜਤਨ  ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਗੀ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the medicine, Yogi; the Lord enshrines it in the mind.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam a-ukhaDh  hai jogee jis no man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh understands this; he alone finds the Way of Yoga. ||10||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so-ee boojh ai jog jugat  so paa-ay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Path of Yoga is very difficult, Yogi; he alone finds it, whom God blesses with HisGrace.
lines.transliteration: jogai kaa maarag bikham hai jogee jis no nad ar karay so paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Inside and outside, he sees the One Lord; he eliminates doubt from within himself.||11||
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayko vaykh ai vichahu bh aram chukaa-ay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: So play the harp which vibrates without being played, Yogi.
lines.transliteration: vin vajaa-ee kinguree vaajai jogee saa kinguree vajaa-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, thus you shall be liberated, Yogi, and remain merged in the True Lord.||12||1||10|| rwmklI mhlw 3 ] (909-7) raamkalee mehlaa 3. Raamkalee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak mukat hoveh jogee saachay raheh samaa-ay. ||12||1||10||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The treasure of devotional worship is revealed to the Gurmukh; the True Guru hasinspired me to understand this understanding. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  khajaanaa gurmukh  jaataa sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, the Gurmukh is blessed with glorious greatness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: santahu gurmukh  day-ay vadi-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਿਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dwelling always in Truth, celestial peace wells up; sexual desire and anger are eliminated from within. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach rahhu sadaa sahj sukh  upjai kaam kroDh  vichahu jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Eradicating self-conceit, remain lovingly focused on the Naam, the Name of the Lord;through the Word of the Shabad, burn away possessiveness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap chhod naam liv laagee mamt aa sabad  jalaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: By Him we are created, and by Him we are destroyed; in the end, the Naam will beour only help and support. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jis tay upjai t is tay binsai ant ay naam sakh aa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ  ਸੁਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is ever-present; don't think that He is far away. He created the creation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sadaa hajoor d oor nah d aykhhu rachnaa jin rachaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨਾਮ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Deep within your heart, chant the True Word of the Shabad; remain lovingly absorbedin the True Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad ravai gh at ant ar sachay si-o liv laa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ  ਿਤਸ ਤੇ ਿਬਨਸੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Priceless Naam is in the Society of the Saints; by great good fortune, it isobtained. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  meh naam nirmolak vadai bh aag paa-i-aa jaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ਦੂਿਰ ਨਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਚਨਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਚਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Do not be deluded by doubt; serve the True Guru, and keep your mind steady in oneplace. ||8||
lines.transliteration: bharam na bh oolahu sat gur sayvhu man raakh o ik th aa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without the Name, everyone wanders around in confusion; they waste away their lives in vain. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh bh oolee fird ee birthaa janam gavaa-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰਮੋਲਕੁ  ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Yogi, you have lost the Way; you wander around confused. Through hypocrisy, Yogais not attained. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jogee jugat gavaa-ee handh ai pakh and jog na paa-ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਿਮ  ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Sitting in Yogic postures in the City of God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad,you shall find Yoga. ||11||
lines.transliteration: siv nagree meh aasan baisai gur sabd ee jog paa-ee. ||11||

lines.english: Dhaat ur baajee sabad  nivaaray naam vasai man aa-ee. ||12|| Restrain your restless wanderings through the Shabad, and the Naam will come todwell in your mind. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਗਵਾਈ  ਹੰਢੈ ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: This body is a pool, O Saints; bathe in it, and enshrine love for the Lord. ||13||
lines.transliteration: ayhu sareer sarvar hai santahu isnaan karay liv laa-ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਨਗਰੀ  ਮਿਹ ਆਸਿਣ  ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Those who cleanse themselves through the Naam, are the most immaculate people;through the Shabad, they wash off their filth. ||14||
lines.transliteration: naam isnaan karahi say jan nirmal sabday mail gavaa-ee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਤੁਰ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Trapped by the three qualities, the unconscious person does not think of the Naam;without the Name, he wastes away. ||15||
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  achayt  naam cheet eh naahee bin naavai binas jaa-ee. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The three forms of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are trapped in the three qualities, lost inconfusion. ||16||
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays tarai moorat  tarigun  bharam bh ulaa-ee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, this triad is eradicated, and one is lovingly absorbed in the fourth state. ||17||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee tarikutee chh ootai cha-uthai pad  liv laa-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਚੇਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read, study and discuss the arguments; they donot understand. ||18||
lines.transliteration: pandit parh eh parh  vaad  vakaan eh tinnaa boojh  na paa-ee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਿਤਰ੍ਗੁਿਣ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਈ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Engrossed in corruption, they wander in confusion; who can they possibly instruct, OSiblings of Destiny? ||19||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa maat ay bh aram bh ulaa-ay upd ays kaheh kis bh aa-ee. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਤਰ੍ਕੁਟੀ  ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਿਦ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: The Bani, the Word of the humble devotee is the most sublime and exalted; it prevailsthroughout the ages. ||20||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kee oot am ban ee jug jug rahee samaa-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਪਿੜ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਿਤੰਨਾ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: One who is committed to this Bani is emancipated, and through the Shabad, merges in Truth. ||21|| pMnw 910
lines.transliteration: banee laagai so gat  paa-ay sabd ay sach samaa-ee. ||21||

lines.english: One who searches the village of the body, through the Shabad, obtains the nine treasures of the Naam. ||22||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagree sabday kh ojay naam navaN niDh paa-ee. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰੀ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Conquering desire, the mind is absorbed in intuitive ease, and then one chants theLord's Praises without speaking. ||23||
lines.transliteration: mansaa maar man sahj samaanaa bin rasnaa ust at karaa-ee. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰਾਈ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Let your eyes gaze upon the Wondrous Lord; let your consciousness be attached to the Unseen Lord. ||24||
lines.transliteration: lo-in d aykh rahay bismaad ee chit  adisat lagaa-ee. ||24||

lines.english: The Unseen Lord is forever absolute and immaculate; one's light merges into theLight. ||25||
lines.transliteration: adisat sad aa rahai niraalam jot ee jot  milaa-ee. ||25||

lines.english: I praise my Guru forever, who has inspired me to understand this true understanding.||26||
lines.transliteration: ha-o gur saalaahee sadaa aapn aa jin saachee boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Name, may I find salvation and honor.||27||2||11|| rwmklI mhlw 3 ] (910-5) raamkalee mehlaa 3. Raamkalee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayk kahai baynantee naavhu gat  pat paa-ee. ||27||2||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨੭॥੨॥
lines.english: It is so hard to obtain that devotional worship of the Lord, O Saints. It cannot bedescribed at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kee poojaa dulambh  hai sant ahu kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O Saints, as Gurmukh, find the Perfect Lord,
lines.transliteration: santahu gurmukh  pooraa paa-ee.
naamo pooj karaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. and worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੁਲੰਭ  ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, everything is filthy, O Saints; what offering should I place before Him? ||2||
lines.transliteration: har bin sabh kichh  mailaa sant ahu ki-aa ha-o pooj charh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever pleases the True Lord is devotional worship; His Will abides in the mind.||3||
lines.transliteration: har saachay bhaavai saa poojaa hovai bh aanaa man vasaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Everyone worships Him, O Saints, but the self-willed manmukh is not accepted orapproved. ||4||
lines.transliteration: poojaa karai sabh lok sant ahu manmukh  thaa-ay na paa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: If someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, his mind become immaculate, O Saints;such worship is accepted and approved. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabad marai man nirmal sant ahu ayh poojaa thaa-ay paa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੈਲਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Sanctified and pure are those true beings, who enshrine love for the Shabad. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pavit paavan say jan saachay ayk sabad  liv laa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: There is no worship of the Lord, other than the Name; the world wanders, deluded bydoubt. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai hor pooj na hovee bharam bh ulee lokaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh understands his own self, O Saints; he lolvingly centers his mind on theLord's Name. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap pachh aanai sant ahu raam naam liv laa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ਏਹ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord Himself inspires worship of Him; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, it is accepted and approved. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aapay nirmal pooj karaa-ay gur sabdee thaa-ay paa-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਵਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਕ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who worship Him, but do not know the Way, are polluted with the love of duality. ||10||
lines.transliteration: poojaa karahi par biDh nahee jaan eh doojai bh aa-ay mal laa-ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, knows what worship is; the Lord's Will abides within hismind. ||11||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so poojaa jaan ai bhaanaa man vasaa-ee. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: One who accepts the Lord's Will obtains total peace, O Saints; in the end, the Naamwill be our help and support. ||12||
lines.transliteration: bhaan ay tay sabh  sukh  paavai sant ahu ant ay naam sakh aa-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: One who does not understand his own self, O Saints, falsely flatters himself. ||13||
lines.transliteration: apnaa aap na pachh aaneh sant ahu koorh  karahi vadi-aa-ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not give up on those who practices hypocrisy; they aredragged away in disgrace. ||14||
lines.transliteration: pakhand keenai jam nahee chh odai lai jaasee pat  gavaa-ee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ  ਭਾਣਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Those who have the Shabad deep within, understand themselves; they find the wayof salvation. ||15||
lines.transliteration: jin antar sabad  aap pachh aaneh gat  mit tin hee paa-ee. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Their minds enter into the deepest state of Samaadhi, and their light is absorbed intothe Light. ||16||
lines.transliteration: ayhu manoo-aa sunn samaaDh lagaavai jot ee jot  milaa-ee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੂਿੜ ਕਰਿਹ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs listen constantly to the Naam, and chant it in the True Congregation.||17||
lines.transliteration: sun sun  gurmukh  naam vakaan eh sat sangat  maylaa-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਕੀਨੈ  ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ  ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs sing the Lord's Praises, and erase self-conceit; they obtain true honor in the Court of the Lord. ||18||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gaavai aap gavaavai d ar saachai sobh aa paa-ee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: True are their words; they speak only the Truth; they lovingly focus on the TrueName. ||19||
lines.transliteration: saachee banee sach vakh aanai sach naam liv laa-ee. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਵੈ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: My God is the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of sin; in the end, He is our only helpand support. ||20||
lines.transliteration: bhai bh anjan at  paap nikh anjan mayraa parabh  ant sakhaa-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਲਾਈ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: He Himself pervades and permeates everything; O Nanak, glorious greatness isobtained through the Naam. ||21||3||12|| rwmklI mhlw 3 ] (910-18) raamkalee mehlaa 3. Raamkalee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap vart ai naanak naam vadi-aa-ee. ||21||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: I am filthy and polluted, proud and egotistical; receiving the Word of the Shabad, myfilth is taken away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham kuchal kucheel at abh imaanee mil sabd ay mail ut aaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: O Saints, the Gurmukhs are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: santahu gurmukh  naam nist aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਿਤ  ਪਾਪ ਿਨਖੰਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The True Name abides deep within their hearts. The Creator Himself embellishes them. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 911
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam vasi-aa ghat ant ar kart ai aap savaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves become the philosopher's stone; the Dear Lord Himself blesses them with His Mercy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paaras parsay fir paaras ho-ay har jee-o apnee kirpaa Dh aaree. ||2||

lines.english: Some wear religious robes, and wander around in pride; they lose their life in thegamble. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ik bhaykh  karahi fireh abh imaanee t in joo-ai baajee haaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਸ  ਪਰਸੇ  ਿਫਿਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਹੋਏ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some worship the Lord in devotion, night and day; day and night, they keep theLord's Name enshrined in their hearts. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ik an-din bh agat karahi d in raat ee raam naam ur Dh aaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿਹ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ਿਤਨ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ  ਹਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with Him night and day, are spontaneously intoxicated withHim; they intuitively conquer their ego. ||5||
lines.transliteration: an-din raat ay sehjay maat ay sehjay ha-umai maaree. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without the Fear of God, devotional worship is never performed; through the Loveand the Fear of God, devotional worship is embellished. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bhai bin bh agat na ho-ee kab hee bh ai bhaa-ay bh agat savaaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Shabad burns away emotional attachment to Maya, and then one contemplatesthe essence of spiritual wisdom. ||7||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabad jalaa-i-aa gi-aan t at beechaaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself inspires us to act; He Himself blesses us with His treasure. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aapay aap karaa-ay kartaa aapay bakh as bh andaaree. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇਆ  ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਤਿਤ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The limits of His virtues cannot be found; I sing His Praises and contemplate the Wordof the Shabad. ||9||
lines.transliteration: tis ki-aa gun aa kaa ant  na paa-i-aa ha-o gaavaa sabad  veechaaree. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਭੰਡਾਰੀ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: I chant the Lord's Name, and praise my Dear Lord; egotism is eradicated from withinme. ||10||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o japee har jee-o saalaahee vichahu aap nivaaree. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਉ ਗਾਵਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam is obtained from the Guru; the treasures of the True Lordare inexhaustible. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath gur t ay paa-i-aa akh ut sachay bh andaaree. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਜਪੀ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He Himself is pleased with His devotees; by His Grace, He infuses His strength withinthem. ||12||
lines.transliteration: apni-aa bh agtaa no aapay t uthaa apn ee kirpaa kar kal Dh aaree. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਖੁਟ ਸਚੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: They always feel hunger for the True Name; they sing and contemplate the Shabad.||13||
lines.transliteration: tin saachay naam kee sad aa bh ukh laagee gaavan sabad  veechaaree. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਿਣਆ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਤੁਠਾ  ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Soul, body and everything are His; it is so difficult to speak of, and contemplate Him.||14||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh kichh  hai tis kaa aakh an bikham beechaaree. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਗੀ  ਗਾਵਿਨ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who are attached to the Shabad are saved; they cross over theterrifying world-ocean. ||15||
lines.transliteration: sabad lagay say-ee jan nist aray bh a-ojal paar ut aaree. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਆਖਣੁ  ਿਬਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Without the True Lord, no one can cross over; how rare are those who contemplateand understand this. ||16||
lines.transliteration: bin har saachay ko paar na paavai boojhai ko veechaaree. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਿਨਸਤਰੇ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੀ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: We obtain only that which is pre-ordained; receiving the Lord's Shabad, we areembellished. ||17||
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so-ee paa-i-aa mil har sabad  savaaree. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਿਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Shabad, the body becomes golden, and loves only the True Name. ||18||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kanchan sabday raat ee saachai naa-ay pi-aaree. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: The body is then filled to overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, obtained bycontemplating the Shabad. ||19||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa amrit rahee bh arpooray paa-ee-ai sabad  veechaaree. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Those who seek God, find Him; others burst and die from their own egotism. ||20||
lines.transliteration: jo parabh kh ojeh say-ee paavahi hor foot moo-ay ahaNkaaree. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The debaters waste away, while the servants serve, with love and affection for theGuru. ||21||
lines.transliteration: baadee binsahi sayvak sayveh gur kai hayt  pi-aaree. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਖੋਜਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਹੋਿਰ ਫੂਿਟ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: He alone is a Yogi, who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom, and conquersegotism and thirsty desire. ||22||
lines.transliteration: so jogee tat  gi-aan beechaaray ha-umai t arisnaa maaree. ||22||
