lines.punjabi: ਬਾਦੀ  ਿਬਨਸਿਹ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is revealed to those upon whom You bestow YourGrace, O Lord. ||23||
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa tinai pachh aataa jis no kirpaa t umaaree. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ  ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who are attached to Maya, are drowned;they die in their own egotism. ||24||
lines.transliteration: satgur na sayveh maa-i-aa laagay doob moo-ay ahaNkaaree. ||24||

lines.english: As long as there is breath within you, so long you should serve the Lord; then, youwill go and meet the Lord. ||25||
lines.transliteration: jichar andar saas t ichar sayvaa keechai jaa-ay milee-ai raam muraaree. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਡੂਿਬ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Night and day, she remains awake and aware, day and night; she is the darling bride of her Beloved Husband Lord. ||26||
lines.transliteration: an-din jaagat  rahai d in raat ee apnay pari-a pareet  pi-aaree. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਚਰੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਾਸੁ ਿਤਚਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਚੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: I offer my body and mind in sacrifice to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||27||
lines.transliteration: tan man vaaree vaar gh umaa-ee apnay gur vitahu balihaaree. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Attachment to Maya will end and go away; only by contemplating the Shabad will yoube saved. ||28||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh binas jaa-igaa ubray sabad veechaaree. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਰੀ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: They are awake and aware, whom the Lord Himself awakens; so contemplate theWord of the Guru's Shabad. ||29||
lines.transliteration: aap jagaa-ay say-ee jaagay gur kai sabad veechaaree. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇਗਾ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam are dead. The devotees live in contemplative meditation. ||30||4||13|| rwmklI mhlw 3 ] (911-19) raamkalee mehlaa 3. Raamkalee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak say-ee moo-ay je naam na cheeteh bh agat jeevay veechaaree. ||30||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਜਗਾਏ  ਸੇਈ ਜਾਗੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Receiving the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru, I remainsatisfied and fulfilled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam khajaanaa gur t ay paa-i-aa t aripat  rahay aagh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਈ ਮੂਏ ਿਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਭਗਤ  ਜੀਵੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੩੦॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: O Saints, the Gurmukhs attain the state of liberation. pMnw 912
lines.transliteration: santahu gurmukh  mukat  gat paa-ee.

lines.english: The One Name abides deep within my heart; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk naam vasi-aa ghat ant ar pooray kee vadi-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He Himself gives sustenanceto all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa aapay bh ugtaa daydaa rijak sabaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever He wants to do, He is doing; no one else can do anything. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karn aa so kar rahi-aa avar na karn aa jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ  ਦੇਦਾ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸਬਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself fashions and creates the creation; He links each and every person to theirtask. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay saajay sarisat upaa-ay sir sir DhanDh ai laa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੋ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If you serve Him, then you will find peace; the True Guru will unite you in His Union.||5||
lines.transliteration: tiseh sarayvhu t aa sukh  paavhu sat gur mayl milaa-ee. ||5||

lines.english: The Lord Himself creates Himself; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapnaa aap aap upaa-ay alakh  na lakh -naa jaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He Himself kills, and brings back to life; He does not have even an iota of greed. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aapay maar jeevaalay aapay tis no t il na t amaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Some are made givers, and some are made beggars; He Himself inspires us todevotional worship. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ik daat ay ik mangt ay keet ay aapay bh agat karaa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾਲੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee jinee ayko jaat aa sachay rahay samaa-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਇਿਕ  ਮੰਗਤੇ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: He Himself is beautiful, He Himself is wise and clever; His worth cannot be expressed.||10||
lines.transliteration: aap saroop si-aanaa aapay keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਸਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: He Himself infuses pain and pleasure; He Himself makes them wander around indoubt. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aapay dukh  sukh  paa-ay ant ar aapay bh aram bh ulaa-ee. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਿਸਆਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Great Giver is revealed to the Gurmukh; without the Guru, the world wanders indarkness. ||12||
lines.transliteration: vadaa daat aa gurmukh  jaataa niguree anDh  firai lokaa-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਈ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Those who taste, enjoy the flavor; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jinee chaakhi-aa t inaa saad  aa-i-aa sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਿਨਗੁਰੀ  ਅੰਧ ਿਫਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Some, the Lord causes to forget and lose the Name; others become Gurmukh, and aregranted this understanding. ||14||
lines.transliteration: iknaa naavhu aap bhulaa-ay iknaa gurmukh  day-ay bujh aa-ee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਚਾਿਖਆ ਿਤਨਾ  ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, praise the Lord, O Saints; how glorious is His greatness! ||15||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa saalaahihu sant ahu tis dee vadee vadi-aa-ee. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: There is no other King except Him; He administers justice, as He has made it. ||16||
lines.transliteration: tis bin avar na ko-ee raajaa kar t apaavas ban at banaa-ee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਿਹਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਤਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: His justice is always True; how rare are those who accept His Command. ||17||
lines.transliteration: ni-aa-o tisai kaa hai sad  saachaa virlay hukam manaa-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ  ਕਿਰ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: O mortal, meditate forever on the Lord, who has made the Gurmukh in His making. ||18||
lines.transliteration: tis no paraan ee sad aa Dh i-aavahu jin gurmukh  banat banaa-ee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਆਉ  ਿਤਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਈ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: That humble being who meets with the True Guru is fulfilled; the Naam abides in hisheart. ||19||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai so jan seejh ai jis hird ai naam vasaa-ee. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The True Lord is Himself forever True; He announces His Bani, the Word of HisShabad. ||20||
lines.transliteration: sachaa aap sadaa hai saachaa ban ee sabad  sunaa-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: ||21||5||14|| Nanak is wonderstruck, hearing and seeing His Lord; my God is all-pervading,everywhere. ||21||5||14|| rwmklI mhlw 5 AstpdIAw  (912-14) raamkalee mehlaa 5 asatpadee-aa Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (912-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sun vaykh  rahi-aa vismaad  mayraa parabh  ravi-aa sarab thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਆਿਪ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਣਾਈ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Some make a big show of their worldly influence.
lines.transliteration: kinhee kee-aa parvirat pasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਣ ਵੇਿਖ ਰਿਹਆ ਿਵਸਮਾਦੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਥਾਈ  ॥੨੧॥੫॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Some make a big show of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: kinhee kee-aa poojaa bisthaaraa.

lines.english: Some practice inner cleansing teahniques, and control the breath through Kundalini Yoga.
lines.transliteration: kinhee nival bhu-i-angam saaDh ay.

lines.english: I am meek; I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen har har aaraaDh ay. ||1||

lines.english: I place my faith in You alone, O Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayraa bh arosaa pi-aaray.

lines.english: I do not know any other way. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan na jaanaa vaysaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some abandon their homes, and live in the forests.
lines.transliteration: kinhee garihu taj van  khand paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Some put themselves on silence, and call themselves hermits.
lines.transliteration: kinhee mon a-uDhoot  sadaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Some claim that they are devotees of the One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee kahta-o annan bh ag-utee.

lines.english: I am meek; I seek the shelter and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen har har ot leet ee. ||2||

lines.english: Some say that they live at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: kinhee kahi-aa ha-o tirath vaasee.

lines.english: Some refuse food and become Udaasis, shaven-headed renunciates.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee ann taj bh a-i-aa ud aasee.

lines.english: Some have wandered all across the earth.
lines.transliteration: kinhee bhavan sabh  Dhartee kari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਓਟ ਲੀਤੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am meek; I have fallen at the door of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen har har d ar pari-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Some say that they belong to great and noble families. pMnw 913
lines.transliteration: kinhee kahi-aa mai kuleh vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Some say that they have the arms of their many brothers to protect them.
lines.transliteration: kinhee kahi-aa baah baho bhaa-ee.

lines.english: Some say that they have great expanses of wealth.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee kahai mai dhaneh pasaaraa.

lines.english: I am meek; I have the support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen har har aaDh aaraa. ||4||

lines.english: Some dance, wearing ankle bells.
lines.transliteration: kinhee ghoogh ar nirat  karaa-ee.

lines.english: Some fast and take vows, and wear malas.
lines.transliteration: kinhoo varat naym maalaa paa-ee.

lines.english: Some apply ceremonial tilak marks to their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: kinhee tilak gopee chand an laa-i-aa.

lines.english: I am meek; I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||5||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen har har har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Some work spells using the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas.
lines.transliteration: kinhee siDh baho chaytak laa-ay.

lines.english: Some wear various religious robes and establish their authority.
lines.transliteration: kinhee bhaykh  baho thaat banaa-ay.

lines.english: Some perform Tantric spells, and chant various mantras.
lines.transliteration: kinhee tant  mant  baho kh ayvaa.

lines.english: I am meek; I serve the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||6||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen har har har sayvaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: One calls himself a wise Pandit, a religious scholar.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee chatur kahaavai pandit .

lines.english: One performs the six rituals to appease Shiva.
lines.transliteration: ko khat karam sahit  si-o mandit .

lines.english: One maintains the rituals of pure lifestyle, and does good deeds.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee karai aachaar sukarnee.

lines.english: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen har har har sarn ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I have studied the religions and rituals of all the ages.
lines.transliteration: saglay karam Dharam jug soDh ay.

lines.english: Without the Name, this mind is not awakened.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ih man na parboDhay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ja-o saaDhsang paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: boojhee t arisnaa mahaa seet laa-i-aa. ||8||1|| my thirsty desires were satisfied, and I was totally cooled and soothed. ||8||1|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (913-7) raamkalee mehlaa 5.

lines.english: He created you out of this water.
lines.transliteration: is paanee tay jin t oo gh ari-aa.

lines.english: From clay, He fashioned your body.
lines.transliteration: maatee kaa lay dayhuraa kari-aa.

lines.english: He blessed you with the light of reason and clear consciousness.
lines.transliteration: ukat jot  lai surat  pareekh i-aa.

lines.english: In your mother's womb, He preserved you. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  meh jin t oo raakh i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Contemplate your Savior Lord.
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaar samHaar janaa.

lines.english: Give up all others thoughts, O mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saglay chhod beechaar manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He gave you your mother and father;
lines.transliteration: jin dee-ay t uDh baap meht aaree.
jin dee-ay bh araat put haaree. he gave you your charming children and siblings;
jin dee-ay t uDh banit aa ar meet aa. he gave you your spouse and friends;
tis thaakur ka-o rakh  layho cheet aa. ||2|| enshrine that Lord and Master in your consciousness. ||2||

lines.english: He gave you the invaluable air;
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa t uDh pavan amolaa.

lines.english: He gave you the priceless water;
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa t uDh neer nirmola.

lines.english: He gave you burning fire;
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa t uDh paavak balnaa.
tis thaakur kee rahu man sarnaa. ||3|| let your mind remain in the Sanctuary of that Lord and Master. ||3||

lines.english: He gave you the thirty-six varieties of tasty foods;
lines.transliteration: chhat eeh amrit  jin bh ojan d ee-ay.

lines.english: He gave you a place within to hold them;
lines.transliteration: antar thaan th ehraavan ka-o kee-ay.

lines.english: He gave you the earth, and things to use;
lines.transliteration: basuDhaa d ee-o bart an balnaa.
tis thaakur kay chit  rakh charnaa. ||4|| enshrine in your consciousness the feet of that Lord and Master. ||4||

lines.english: He gave you eyes to see, and ears to hear;
lines.transliteration: paykhan ka-o nayt ar sunan ka-o karnaa.

lines.english: He gave you hands to work with, and a nose and a tongue;
lines.transliteration: hasat kamaavan baasan rasnaa.

lines.english: He gave you feet to walk upon, and the crowning glory of your head;
lines.transliteration: charan chalan ka-o sir keeno mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਖਨ  ਕਉ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਸੁਨਨ  ਕਉ ਕਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, worship the Feet of that Lord and Master. ||5||
lines.transliteration: man tis th aakur kay poojahu pairaa. ||5||

lines.english: He transformed you from impure to pure;
lines.transliteration: apvitar pavit ar jin t oo kari-aa.

lines.english: He installed you above the heads of all creatures;
lines.transliteration: sagal jon meh too sir Dh ari-aa.
ab too seejh  bhaavai nahee seejh ai. now, you may fulfill your destiny or not;

lines.english: Your affairs shall be resolved, O mind, meditating on God. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kaaraj savrai man parabh Dh i-aa-eejai. ||6||

lines.english: Here and there, only the One God exists.
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa aykai ohee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਤੂ ਸੀਝੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there You are.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  daykhee-ai t at tat tohee.

lines.english: My mind is reluctant to serve Him;
lines.transliteration: tis sayvat  man aalas karai.
jis visri-ai ik nimakh na sarai. ||7|| forgetting Him, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, without any virtue at all.
lines.transliteration: ham apraaDhee nirgunee-aaray.

lines.english: I do not serve You, or do any good deeds.
lines.transliteration: naa kichh sayvaa naa karmaaray.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the boat - the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur bohith vadbhaagee mili-aa.

lines.english: Slave Nanak has crossed over, with Him. ||8||2|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (913-19) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sang paathar t ari-aa. ||8||2||

lines.english: Some pass their lives enjoying pleasures and beauty. pMnw 914
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai rang ras roop.

lines.english: Some pass their lives with their mothers, fathers and children.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai maa-ay baap poot.

lines.english: Some pass their lives in power, estates and trade.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai raaj milakh vaapaaraa.

lines.english: The Saints pass their lives with the support of the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant bihaavai har naam aDh aaraa. ||1||

lines.english: The world is the creation of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: rachnaa saach banee.

lines.english: He alone is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh kaa ayk Dh anee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some pass their lives in arguments and debates about scriptures.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai bayd ar baad .

lines.english: Some pass their lives tasting flavors.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai rasnaa saad.

lines.english: Some pass their lives attached to women.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai lapat sang naaree.

lines.english: The Saints are absorbed only in the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant rachay kayval naam muraaree. ||2||

lines.english: Some pass their lives gambling.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai khaylat  joo-aa.

lines.english: Some pass their lives getting drunk.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai amlee hoo-aa.

lines.english: Some pass their lives stealing the property of others.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai par darab choraa-ay.

lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord pass their lives meditating on the Naam. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har jan bihaavai naam Dhi-aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Some pass their lives in Yoga, strict meditation, worship and adoration.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai jog tap poojaa.

lines.english: Some, in sickness, sorrow and doubt.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo rog sog bharmeejaa.

lines.english: Some pass their lives practicing control of the breath.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo pavan Dhaar jaat  bihaa-ay.

lines.english: The Saints pass their lives singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sant bihaavai keert an gaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Some pass their lives walking day and night.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai din rain chaalat .

lines.english: Some pass their lives on the fields of battle.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai so pirh maalat .

lines.english: Some pass their lives teaching children.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai baal parhaavat .

lines.english: The Saints pass their lives singing the Lord's Praise. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sant bihaavai har jas gaavat . ||5||

lines.english: Some pass their lives as actors, acting and dancing.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai nat naatik nirtay.

lines.english: Some pass their lives taking the lives of others.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai jee-aa-ih hirtay.

lines.english: Some pass their lives ruling by intimidation.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai raaj meh dartay.

lines.english: The Saints pass their lives chanting the Lord's Praises. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sant bihaavai har jas kart ay. ||6||

lines.english: Some pass their lives counseling and giving advice.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai mataa masoorat .

lines.english: Some pass their lives forced to serve others.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai sayvaa jaroorat.

lines.english: Some pass their lives exploring life's mysteries.
lines.transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai soDhat  jeevat .

lines.english: The Saints pass their lives drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sant bihaavai har ras peevat . ||7||

lines.english: As the Lord attaches us, so we are attached.
lines.transliteration: jit ko laa-i-aa t it hee lagaanaa.

lines.english: No one is foolish, and no one is wise.
lines.transliteration: naa ko moorh nahee ko si-aanaa.

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who are blessed by His Grace to receive His Name. ||8||3|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (914-11) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis dayvai naa-o. naanak t aa kai bal bal jaa-o. ||8||3||

lines.english: Even in a forest fire, some trees remain green.
lines.transliteration: daavaa agan rahay har boot.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: The infant is released from the pain of the mother's womb.
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  sankat t ay chh oot.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, fear is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa naam simrat bh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: Just so, the Sovereign Lord protects and saves the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taisay sant  janaa raakh ai har raa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the Merciful Lord, my Protector.
lines.transliteration: aisay raakhanhaar d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see You cherishing and nurturing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jat kat  daykh-a-u t um part ipaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As thirst is quenched by drinking water;
lines.transliteration: jal peevat ji-o t ikhaa mitant .

lines.english: Dhan bigsai garihi aavat  kant. as the bride blossoms forth when her husband comes home;

lines.transliteration: lobhee kaa Dh an paraan  aDhaar. as wealth is the support of the greedy person
ti-o har jan har har naam pi-aar. ||2|| - just so, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

lines.english: As the farmer protects his fields;
lines.transliteration: kirsaanee ji-o raakhai rakh vaalaa.
maat pit aa da-i-aa ji-o baalaa. as the mother and father show compassion to their child;
pareetam d aykh pareet am mil jaa-ay. as the lover merges on seeing the beloved;
ti-o har jan raakh ai kanth  laa-ay. ||3|| just so does the Lord hug His humble servant close in His Embrace. ||3||

lines.english: As the blind man is in ecstasy, when he can see again;
lines.transliteration: ji-o anDhulay paykh at ho-ay anand.
goongaa bakat gaavai baho chh and. and the mute, when he is able to speak and sing songs;
pingul parbat part ay paar. and the cripple, being able to climb over the mountain
har kai naam sagal uDhaar. ||4|| - just so, the Name of the Lord saves all. ||4||

lines.english: As cold is dispelled by fire,
lines.transliteration: ji-o paavak sang seet ko naas.
aisay paraachhat  satsang binaas. sins are driven out in the Society of the Saints.

lines.english: As cloth is cleaned by soap,
lines.transliteration: ji-o saabun kaapar oojal hot.
naam japat sabh  bharam bh a-o kh ot. ||5|| just so, by chanting the Naam, all doubts and fears are dispelled. ||5||

lines.english: As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,
lines.transliteration: ji-o chakvee sooraj kee aas.
ji-o chaatrik boond  kee pi-aas. as the rainbird thirsts for the rain drop,
ji-o kurank naad karan samaanay. as the deer's ears are attuned to the sound of the bell,

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਜਪਤ  ਸਭੁ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਤ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ti-o har naam har jan maneh sukh aanay. ||6|| the Lord's Name is pleasing to the mind of the Lord's humble servant. ||6|| pMnw 915

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਮਨਿਹ  ਸੁਖਾਨੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, we love You.
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay laagee pareet .

lines.english: When You show Mercy, then You come into our minds.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal bh a-ay t aa aa-ay cheet .

lines.english: When the Support of the earth granted His Grace,
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aaree t in Dhaaran haar.
banDhan t ay ho-ee chh utkaar. ||7|| then I was released from my bonds. ||7||

lines.english: I have seen all places with my eyes wide open.
lines.transliteration: sabh thaan d aykhay nain  alo-ay.

lines.english: There is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: Doubt and fear are dispelled, by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ai chh ootay gur parsaad .

lines.english: Nanak sees the wondrous Lord everywhere. ||8||4|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (915-4) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paykhi-o sabh  bismaad . ||8||4||

lines.english: All beings and creatures that are seen, God, depend on Your Support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  paykh ee-ah parabh  sagal t umaaree Dh aarnaa. ||1||

lines.english: This mind is saved through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih man har kai naam uDhaarnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਪੇਖੀਅਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਗਲ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਧਾਰਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes, by His Creative Power. All is theCreation of the Creator. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapay kud rat sabh  kartay kay kaarnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਧਾਰਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander are banished in the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  jhooth nindaa saaDh oo sang bid aarnaa. ||3||

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and life ispassed in absolute peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam japat man nirmal hovai sookh ay sookh  gudaarnaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪੇ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That mortal who enters the Sanctuary of the devotees, does not lose out, here orhereafter. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  saran  jo aavai paraan ee tis eehaa oohaa na haarnaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਬਦਾਰਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Pleasure and pain, and the condition of this mind, I place before You, Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sookh d ookh is man kee birthaa t um hee aagai saarnaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਖੇ ਸੂਿਖ ਗੁਦਾਰਨਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of all beings; You cherish what You have made. ||7||
lines.transliteration: too daataa sabh naa jee-aa kaa aapan kee-aa paalnaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਜੋ ਆਵੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਈਹਾ  ਊਹਾ ਨ ਹਾਰਨਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: So many millions of times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Your humble servants. ||8||5|| rwmklI mhlw 5 AstpdI  (915-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5 asatpadee Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (915-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: anik baar kot jan oopar naanak vanjai vaarnaa. ||8||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ  ਸਾਰਨਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Receiving the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all sins are erased, and He unites me with the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytat paap sabh  naaseh har si-o d ay-ay milaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਆਪਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਪਾਲਨਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: My Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: mayraa gur parmaysar sukh-d aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਾਰ ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵੰਞੈ ਵਾਰਨਾ  ॥੮॥੫॥
lines.english: He implants the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God within us; in the end, Heis our help and support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kaa naam drirh-aa-ay ant ay ho-ay sakh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The source of all pain within is destroyed; I apply the dust of the feet of the Saints tomy forehead. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sagal dookh  kaa dayraa bh annaa sant  Dhoor mukh  laa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ  ਪਾਪ ਸਿਭ ਨਾਸਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਦੇਇ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, He purifies the sinners, and dispels the darkness of ignorance. ||3||
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  kee-ay kh in bheetar agi-aan anDh ayr vanj aa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord is all-powerful, the Cause of causes. Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath su-aamee naanak t is sarn aa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Shattering the bonds, the Guru implants the Lord's lotus feet within, and lovingly attunes us to the One Word of the Shabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orh charan kamal drirh -aa-ay ayk sabad  liv laa-ee. ||5||

lines.english: He has lifted me up, and pulled me out of the deep, dark pit of sin; I am attuned tothe True Shabad. ||6||
lines.transliteration: anDh koop bikh i-aa tay kaadh i-o saach sabad  ban aa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The fear of birth and death is taken away; I shall never wander again. ||7||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa sahsaa chookaa baahurh  katahu na Dh aa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਕੀਏ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਵੰਞਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: This mind is imbued with the sublime elixir of the Naam; drinking in the AmbrosialNectar, it is satisfied. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naam rasaa-in ih man raat aa amrit  pee t ariptaa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; I dwell in theeternal, unchanging place. ||9||
lines.transliteration: satsang mil keert an gaa-i-aa nihchal vasi-aa jaa-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋਿੜ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਏਕ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has given me the perfect teachings; there is nothing except theLord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||10||
lines.transliteration: poorai gur pooree mat d eenee har bin aan na bh aa-ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਤੇ ਕਾਿਢਓ  ਸਾਚ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam, by great good fortune; O Nanak, I shall notfall into hell. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan paa-i-aa vadbh aagee naanak narak na jaa-ee. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ  ਚੂਕਾ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਧਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Clever tricks have not worked for me; I shall act according to the Instructions of the Perfect Guru. ||12||
lines.transliteration: ghaal si-aan ap ukat  na mayree poorai guroo kamaa-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਿਣ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: He is chanting, intense meditation, austere self-discipline and purification. He Himselfacts, and causes us to act. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam such hai so-ee aapay karay karaa-ee. ||13||

lines.english: In the midst of children and spouse, and utter corruption, the True Guru has carried me across. ||14|| pMnw 916
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar mahaa bikh i-aa meh gur saachai laa-ay t araa-ee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਮਹਾ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਮਿਹ ਗੁਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇ  ਤਰਾਈ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: You Yourself take care of Your beings; You Yourself attach them to the hem of Your robe. ||15||
lines.transliteration: apnay jee-a t ai aap samHaalay aap lee-ay larh  laa-ee. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਤੈ ਆਿਪ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਲੀਏ ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: I have built the boat of true Dharmic faith, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.||16||
lines.transliteration: saach Dharam kaa bayrh aa baaNDhi-aa bh avjal paar pavaa-ee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ  ਕਾ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਿਧਆ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਵਾਈ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: The Lord Master is unlimited and endless; Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him.||17||
lines.transliteration: baysumaar bay-ant su-aamee naanak bal bal jaa-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Being of Immortal Manifestation, He is not born; He is self-existent; He is the Light inthe darkness of Kali Yuga. ||18||
lines.transliteration: akaal moorat ajoonee sambh a-o kal anDh kaar d eepaa-ee. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੰਭਉ  ਕਿਲ  ਅੰਧਕਾਰ  ਦੀਪਾਈ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Giver of souls; gazing upon Him, I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||19||
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee jee-an kaa d aataa daykhat taripat  aghaa-ee. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅਨ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦੇਖਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਈ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: He is the One Universal Creator Lord, immaculate and fearless; He is permeating andpervading all the water and the land. ||20||
lines.transliteration: aykankaar niranjan nirbha-o sabh  jal thal rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਸਭ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: He blesses His devotees with the Gift of devotional worship; Nanak longs for the Lord,O my mother. ||21||1||6|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (916-5) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, sloku ] (916-6) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  daan bh agtaa ka-o d eenaa har naanak jaachai maa-ee. ||21||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਾਚੈ ਮਾਈ  ॥੨੧॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: Study the Word of the Shabad, O beloveds. It is your anchoring support in life and indeath.
lines.transliteration: sikhahu sabad  pi-aariho janam maran kee tayk.

lines.english: Your face shall be radiant, and you will be at peace forever, O Nanak, meditating inremembrance on the One Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal sad aa sukh ee naanak simrat  ayk. ||1||

lines.english: My mind and body are imbued with my Beloved Lord; I have been blessed with lovingdevotion to the Lord, O Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan raat aa raam pi-aaray har paraym bh agat ban aa-ee sant ahu. ||1||

lines.english: The True Guru has approved my cargo, O Saints.
lines.transliteration: satgur kh ayp nibaahee sant ahu.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਏਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has blessed His slave with the profit of the Lord's Name; all my thirst is quenched, O Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har naam laahaa daas ka-o d ee-aa saglee t arisan ulaahee sant ahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Searching and searching, I have found the One Lord, the jewel; I cannot express Hisvalue, O Saints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat laal ik paa-i-aa har keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee sant ahu. ||2||

lines.english: I focus my meditation on His Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the True Vision of HisDarshan, O Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laago Dhi-aanaa saachai d aras samaa-ee sant ahu. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਉਲਾਹੀ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Singing, singing His Glorious Praises, I am enraptured; meditating in remembrance onthe Lord, I am satisfied and fulfilled, O Saints. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  gaavat  bha-ay nihaalaa har simrat  taripat  aghaa-ee sant ahu. ||4||

lines.english: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is permeating within all; what comes, and what goes, OSaints? ||5||
lines.transliteration: aatam raam ravi-aa sabh  antar kat  aavai kat  jaa-ee sant ahu. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: At the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He is, and He shall alwaysbe; He is the Giver of peace to all beings, O Saints. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee hai bh ee hosee sabh  jee-aa kaa sukh -daa-ee sant ahu. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਸਉ ਲਾਗੋ  ਿਧਆਨਾ  ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਿਸ  ਸਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself is endless; His end cannot be found. He is totally pervading andpermeating everywhere, O Saints. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aap bay-ant ant  nahee paa-ee-ai poor rahi-aa sabh  thaa-ee sant ahu. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ  ਗਾਵਤ  ਭਏ ਿਨਹਾਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਈ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Nanak: the Lord is my friend, companion, wealth, youth, son, father and mother, O Saints. ||8||2||7|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (916-13) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: meet saajan maal joban sut  har naanak baap mayree maa-ee sant ahu. ||8||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਤ ਆਵੈ  ਕਤ ਜਾਈ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: In thought, word and deed, I contemplate the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man bach karam raam naam chitaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The horrible world-ocean is very treacherous; O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghooman gh ayr mahaa at  bikh-rhee gurmukh  naanak paar ut aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਠਾਈ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Inwardly, peace, and outwardly, peace; meditating on the Lord, evil tendencies arecrushed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar sookh aa baahar sookh aa har jap malan bh a-ay d ustaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ  ਮਾਲੁ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੁਤ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥
lines.english: He has rid me of what was clinging to me; my Dear Lord God has blessed me with HisGrace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis tay laagay t ineh nivaaray parabh  jee-o apn ee kirpaa Dh aaree. ||2||

lines.english: The Saints are saved, in His Sanctuary; the very egotistical people rot away and die.||3||
lines.transliteration: uDhray sant  paray har sarnee pach binsay mahaa ahaNkaaree. ||3||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained this fruit, the Supportof the One Name alone. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  ih fal paa-i-aa ik kayval naam aDh aaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਘੂਮਨ  ਘੇਿਰ  ਮਹਾ ਅਿਤ  ਿਬਖੜੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one is strong, and no one is weak; all are manifestations of Your Light, Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: na ko-ee soor na ko-ee heenaa sabh  pargatee jot  tumHaaree. ||5||

lines.english: You are the all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable, all-pervading Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tumH samrath akath agochar ravi-aa ayk muraaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੂਖਾ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸੂਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਮਲਨ  ਭਏ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Who can estimate Your value, O Creator Lord? God has no end or limitation. ||7||
lines.transliteration: keemat ka-un  karay t ayree kart ay parabh  ant na paaraavaaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਤਨਿਹ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਅਪਣੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Please bless Nanak with the glorious greatness of the gift of the Naam, and the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||8||3||8||22|| pMnw 917 rwmklI mhlw 3 Anµdu  (917-1) raamkalee mehlaa 3 anand Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Anand ~ The Song Of Bliss: <> siqgur pRswid ] (917-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naam daan naanak vadi-aa-ee t ayri-aa sant  janaa rayn aaree. ||8||3||8||22||

lines.english: I am in ecstasy, O my mother, for I have found my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: anand bha-i-aa mayree maa-ay sat guroo mai paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the True Guru, with intuitive ease, and my mind vibrates with the music of bliss.
lines.transliteration: satgur t a paa-i-aa sahj sayt ee man vajee-aa vaaDh aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਤੀ ਮਿਨ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The jewelled melodies and their related celestial harmonies have come to sing the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: raag ratan parvaar paree-aa sabad  gaavan  aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ  ਪਰਵਾਰ  ਪਰੀਆ  ਸਬਦ  ਗਾਵਣ  ਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord dwells within the minds of those who sing the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabdo t a gaavhu haree kayraa man jinee vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੋ  ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਮਿਨ ਿਜਨੀ  ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am in ecstasy, for I have found my True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak anand ho-aa satguroo mai paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, remain always with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa too sad aa rahu har naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Remain always with the Lord, O my mind, and all sufferings will be forgotten.
lines.transliteration: har naal rahu too man mayray d ookh sabh  visaarn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਰਹੁ ਤੂ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਿਭ ਿਵਸਾਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He will accept You as His own, and all your affairs will be perfectly arranged.
lines.transliteration: angeekaar oh karay tayraa kaaraj sabh  savaarn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਿਭ ਸਵਾਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master is all-powerful to do all things, so why forget Him from yourmind?
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa galaa samrath su-aamee so ki-o manhu visaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਗਲਾ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O my mind, remain always with the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak man mayray sadaa rahu har naalay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your celestial home?
lines.transliteration: saachay saahibaa ki-aa naahee ghar t ayrai.

lines.english: Everything is in Your home; they receive, unto whom You give.
lines.transliteration: ghar t a tayrai sabh  kichh  hai jis d eh so paav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Constantly singing Your Praises and Glories, Your Name is enshrined in the mind.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sifat  salaah t ayree naam man vasaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The divine melody of the Shabad vibrates for those, within whose minds the Naam abides.
lines.transliteration: naam jin kai man vasi-aa vaajay sabad gh anayray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your home?||3||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sachay saahib ki-aa naahee ghar t ayrai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਚੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਿਕਆ ਨਾਹੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Name is my only support.
lines.transliteration: saachaa naam mayraa aaDhaaro.

lines.english: The True Name is my only support; it satisfies all hunger.
lines.transliteration: saach naam aDhaar mayraa jin bh ukhaa sabh  gavaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਭੁਖਾ ਸਿਭ ਗਵਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: It has brought peace and tranquility to my mind; it has fulfilled all my desires.
lines.transliteration: kar saaNt sukh  man aa-ay vasi-aa jin ichh aa sabh  pujaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸਿਤ  ਸੁਖ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਛਾ  ਸਿਭ ਪੁਜਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who possesses such glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: sadaa kurbaan  keetaa guroo vitahu jis d ee-aa ayhi vad i-aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਿਜਸ ਦੀਆ  ਏਿਹ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints; enshrine love for the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sunhu sant ahu sabad  Dharahu pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਧਰਹੁ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The True Name is my only support. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saachaa naam mayraa aaDhaaro. ||4||

lines.english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate in that blessed house.
lines.transliteration: vaajay panch sabad t it ghar sabh aagai.

lines.english: In that blessed house, the Shabad vibrates; He infuses His almighty power into it.
lines.transliteration: ghar sabh aagai sabad  vaajay kalaa jit  ghar Dh aaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਸਭਾਗੈ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਾਜੇ ਕਲਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਧਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through You, we subdue the five demons of desire, and slay Death, the torturer.
lines.transliteration: panch doot  tuDh vas keet ay kaal kantak maari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਸ ਕੀਤੇ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur karam paa-i-aa t uDh jin ka-o se naam har kai laagay. Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are attached to the Lord's Name.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਸ ਨਾਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, they are at peace, and the unstruck sound current vibrates within their homes. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak tah sukh  ho-aa t it ghar anhad  vaajay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Without the true love of devotion, the body is without honor.
lines.transliteration: saachee livai bin dayh nimaan ee.

lines.english: The body is dishonored without devotional love; what can the poor wretches do?
lines.transliteration: dayh nimaan ee livai baajh ahu ki-aa karay vaychaaree-aa.

lines.english: No one except You is all-powerful; please bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of all nature.
lines.transliteration: tuDh baajh  samrath ko-ay naahee kirpaa kar banvaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਮਰਥ  ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: There is no place of rest, other than the Name; attached to the Shabad, we are embellished with beauty.
lines.transliteration: ays na-o hor thaa-o naahee sabad laag savaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਸ ਨਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਸਵਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without devotional love, what can the poor wretches do? ||6||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak livai baajhahu ki-aa karay vaychaaree-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Bliss, bliss - everyone talks of bliss; bliss is known only through the Guru.
lines.transliteration: aanand aanand  sabh  ko kahai aanand  guroo t ay jaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Eternal bliss in known only through the Guru, when the Beloved Lord grants HisGrace.
lines.transliteration: jaani-aa aanand  sadaa gur t ay kirpaa karay pi-aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, He cuts away our sins; He blesses us with the healing ointment ofspiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa kilvikh katay gi-aan anjan saari-aa.

lines.english: Those who eradicate attachment from within themselves, are adorned with theShabad, the Word of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: andrahu jin kaa moh t utaa t in kaa sabad  sachai savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚੈ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this alone is bliss - bliss which is known through the Guru. ||7|| pMnw 918
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak ayhu anand hai aanand gur t ay jaan i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਹੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Baba, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it.
lines.transliteration: baabaa jis too d eh so-ee jan paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it; what can the other poor wretched beings do?
lines.transliteration: paavai ta so jan d eh jis no hor ki-aa karahi vaychaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵੈ ਤ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਿਰ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਵੇਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Some are deluded by doubt, wandering in the ten directions; some are adorned withattachment to the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ik bharam bh oolay fireh d ah dis ik naam laag savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੂਲੇ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਇਿਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਿਗ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes immaculate and pure, for those who follow God'sWill.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man bha-i-aa nirmal jinaa bh aanaa bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਭਾਣਾ  ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it, O Beloved Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jis deh pi-aaray so-ee jan paav-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਏ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Come, Beloved Saints, let us speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sant pi-aariho akath kee karah kahaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਿਰਹੋ  ਅਕਥ  ਕੀ ਕਰਹ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: How can we speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord? Through which door will we findHim?
lines.transliteration: karah kahaanee akath kayree kit  du-aarai paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ਅਕਥ  ਕੇਰੀ ਿਕਤੁ  ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Surrender body, mind, wealth, and everything to the Guru; obey the Order of His Will,and you will find Him.
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an sabh  sa-up gur ka-o hukam mani-ai paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਉਿਪ  ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Obey the Hukam of the Guru's Command, and sing the True Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: hukam mannihu guroo kayraa gaavhu sachee banee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਿਨਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints, and speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sunhu sant ahu kathihu akath kahaan ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: O fickle mind, through cleverness, no one has found the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ay man chanchlaa chaturaa-ee kinai na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲਾ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through cleverness, no one has found Him; listen, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: chaturaa-ee na paa-i-aa kinai t oo sun  man mayri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਕਨੈ ਤੂ ਸੁਿਣ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: This Maya is so fascinating; because of it, people wander in doubt.
lines.transliteration: ayh maa-i-aa mohnee jin ayt  bharam bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਤੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This fascinating Maya was created by the One who has administered this potion.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa ta mohn ee tinai keet ee jin th ag-ulee paa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਤ ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਿਤਨੈ ਕੀਤੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਠਗਉਲੀ  ਪਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the One who has made emotional attachment sweet.
lines.transliteration: kurbaan keet aa tisai vitahu jin moh meeth aa laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, O fickle mind, no one has found Him through cleverness. ||10||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak man chanchal chaturaa-ee kinai na paa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: ay man pi-aari-aa too sad aa sach samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: This family which you see shall not go along with you.
lines.transliteration: ayhu kutamb too je d aykh-daa chalai naahee t ayrai naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਤੂ ਿਜ ਦੇਖਦਾ  ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: They shall not go along with you, so why do you focus your attention on them?
lines.transliteration: saath tayrai chalai naahee t is naal ki-o chit  laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਥ  ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਕਉ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Don't do anything that you will regret in the end.
lines.transliteration: aisaa kamm moolay na keechai jit ant  pachh otaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਕੰਮੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਕੀਚੈ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to the Teachings of the True Guru - these shall go along with you.
lines.transliteration: satguroo kaa upd ays sun  too hovai t ayrai naalay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਤੂ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever. ||11||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak man pi-aaray too sad aa sach samaalay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮਨ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: O inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, Your limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: agam agocharaa tayraa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one has found Your limits; only You Yourself know.
lines.transliteration: anto na paa-i-aa kinai t ayraa aapn aa aap t oo jaan hay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੋ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਕਨੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: All living beings and creatures are Your play; how can anyone describe You?
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  khayl tayraa ki-aa ko aakh  vakh aana-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣਏ  ॥
lines.english: You speak, and You gaze upon all; You created the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi t a vaykh eh sabh  toohai jin jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਿਹ  ਤ ਵੇਖਿਹ  ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, You are forever inaccessible; Your limits cannot be found. ||12||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak too sad aa agamm hai t ayraa ant  na paa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The angelic beings and the silent sages sear ch for the Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit is obtained from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sur nar mun jan amrit kh ojday so amrit  gur t ay paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਖੋਜਦੇ  ਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This Amrit is obtained, when the Guru grants His Grace; He enshrines the True Lordwithin the mind.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa amrit gur kirpaa keenee sachaa man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਸਚਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All living beings and creatures were created by You; only some come to see the Guru, and seek His blessing.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tuDh upaa-ay ik vaykh  parsan  aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ  ਇਿਕ  ਵੇਿਖ ਪਰਸਿਣ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Their greed, avarice and egotism are dispelled, and the True Guru seems sweet.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh ahaNkaar chookaa sat guroo bh alaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੂਕਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, those with whom the Lord is pleased, obtain the Amrit, through the Guru.||13||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jis no aap tuth aa tin amrit  gur t ay paa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਤੁਠਾ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The lifestyle of the devotees is unique and distinct.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kee chaal niraalee.

lines.english: The devotees' lifestyle is unique and distinct; they follow the most difficult path.
lines.transliteration: chaalaa niraalee bhagt aah kayree bikh am maarag chaln aa.

lines.english: They renounce greed, avarice, egotism and desire; they do not talk too much.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh ahaNkaar t aj tarisnaa bahut  naahee boln aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਿਜ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਬੋਲਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The path they take is sharper than a two-edged sword, and finer than a hair. pMnw 919
lines.transliteration: khanni-ahu t ikhee vaalahu nikee ayt  maarag jaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਤਿਜਆ  ਹਿਰ ਵਾਸਨਾ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they shed their selfishness and conceit; their hopes are merged in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jinee aap taji-aa har vaasnaa samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਚਾਲ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਜੁਗਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਿਨਰਾਲੀ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the lifestyle of the devotees, in each and every age, is unique and distinct. ||14||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak chaal bhagt aa jugahu jug niraalee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਿਹ  ਿਤਵ ਚਲਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹੋਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: As You make me walk, so do I walk, O my Lord and Master; what else do I know ofYour Glorious Virtues?
lines.transliteration: ji-o too chalaa-ihi t iv chalah su-aamee hor ki-aa jaan aa gun  tayray.

lines.english: As You cause them to walk, they walk - You have placed them on the Path.
lines.transliteration: jiv too chalaa-ihi t ivai chalah jinaa maarag paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਜਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਇਿਹ  ਿਸ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: In Your Mercy, You attach them to the Naam; they meditate forever on the Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jin naam laa-ihi se har har sadaa Dh i-aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇਿਹ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਸ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom You cause to listen to Your sermon, find peace in the Gurdwara, theGuru's Gate.
lines.transliteration: jis no kathaa sunaa-ihi aapn ee se gurd u-aarai sukh  paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਚੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, you make us walk according to Your Will.||15||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sachay saahib ji-o bhaavai t ivai chalaavahay. ||15||

lines.english: This song of praise is the Shabad, the most beautiful Word of God.
lines.transliteration: ayhu sohilaa sabad suhaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੋ  ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This beauteous Shabad is the everlasting song of praise, spoken by the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sabdo suhaavaa sad aa sohilaa sat guroo sun aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਜਨ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This is enshrined in the minds of those who are so pre-destined by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayhu tin kai man vasi-aa jin Dh arahu likh i-aa aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਗਲਾ  ਗਲੀ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Some wander around, babbling on and on, but none obtain Him by babbling.
lines.transliteration: ik fireh ghanayray karahi galaa galee kinai na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Shabad, this song of praise, has been spoken by the True Guru. ||16||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sabad sohilaa sat guroo sun aa-i-aa. ||16||

lines.english: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord become pure.
lines.transliteration: pavit ho-ay say janaa jinee har Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, they become pure; as Gurmukh, they meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: har Dhi-aa-i-aa pavit  ho-ay gurmukh  jinee Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸਿਹਤ  ਿਸਉ ਪਿਵਤੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਬਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: They are pure, along with their mothers, fathers, family and friends; all theircompanions are pure as well.
lines.transliteration: pavit maat aa pit aa kutamb sahit  si-o pavit  sangat  sabaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਦੇ  ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਸੁਣਦੇ  ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਸੇ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Pure are those who speak, and pure are those who listen; those who enshrine itwithin their minds are pure.
lines.transliteration: kahday pavit  sund ay pavit  say pavit  jinee man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੇ ਪਿਵਤੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, pure and holy are those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord, Har,Har. ||17||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak say pavit jinee gurmukh  har har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੀ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਹਜੈ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By religious rituals, intuitive poise is not found; without intuitive poise, skepticism doesnot depart.
lines.transliteration: karmee sahj na oopjai vin sahjai sahsaa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਜਾਇ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਰਹੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Skepticism does not depart by contrived actions; everybody is tired of performing these rituals.
lines.transliteration: nah jaa-ay sahsaa kitai sanjam rahay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਮਲੀਣੁ  ਹੈ ਿਕਤੁ  ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਧੋਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The soul is polluted by skepticism; how can it be cleansed?
lines.transliteration: sahsai jee-o maleen hai kit  sanjam Dh otaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਨੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਾਗਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹਹੁ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Wash your mind by attaching it to the Shabad, and keep your consciousness focusedon the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man Dhovahu sabad  laagahu har si-o rahhu chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਇਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ  ਇਵ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, intuitive poise is produced, and this skepticism isdispelled. ||18||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak gur parsaadee sahj upjai ih sahsaa iv jaa-ay. ||18||

lines.english: Inwardly polluted, and outwardly pure.
lines.transliteration: jee-ahu mailay baahrahu nirmal.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੀਅਹੁ ਤ ਮੈਲੇ ਿਤਨੀ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਜੂਐ ਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are outwardly pure and yet polluted within, lose their lives in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: baahrahu nirmal jee-ahu ta mailay t inee janam joo-ai haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: They contract this terrible disease of desire, and in their minds, they forget aboutdying.
lines.transliteration: ayh tisnaa vadaa rog lagaa maran  manhu visaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਦਾ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ  ਸੋ ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਫਰਿਹ ਿਜਉ ਬੇਤਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the Vedas, the ultimate objective is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; but they do not hear this, and they wander around like demons.
lines.transliteration: vaydaa meh naam ut am so sun eh naahee fireh ji-o bayt aali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਨ ਸਚੁ ਤਿਜਆ  ਕੂੜੇ ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਜੂਐ ਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, those who forsake Truth and cling to falsehood, lose their lives in the gamble. ||19||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jin sach taji-aa koorh ay laagay t inee janam joo-ai haari-aa. ||19||

lines.english: Inwardly pure, and outwardly pure.
lines.transliteration: jee-ahu nirmal baahrahu nirmal.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਤ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੀਅਹੁ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are outwardly pure and also pure within, through the Guru, perform gooddeeds.
lines.transliteration: baahrahu ta nirmal jee-ahu nirmal sat gur tay karn ee kamaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Not even an iota of falsehood touches them; their hopes are absorbed in the Truth.
lines.transliteration: koorh kee so-ay pahuchai naahee mansaa sach samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਰਤਨੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਖਿਟਆ  ਭਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who earn the jewel of this human life, are the most excellent of merchants.
lines.transliteration: janam ratan jinee kh ati-aa bh alay say van jaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਿਜਨ ਮੰਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, those whose minds are pure, abide with the Guru forever. ||20||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jin man nirmal sadaa raheh gur naalay. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਿਸਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: If a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh
lines.transliteration: jay ko sikh guroo sayt ee sanmukh  hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਿਸਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: hovai ta sanmukh  sikh ko-ee jee-ahu rahai gur naalay. - if a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh, his soul abides with theGuru.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਿਧਆਏ  ਅੰਤਰ  ਆਤਮੈ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Within his heart, he meditates on the lotus feet of the Guru; deep within his soul, hecontemplates Him.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan hirdai Dh i-aa-ay ant ar aat mai samaalay.

lines.english: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, he remains always on the side of the Guru; he does not know anyone except the Guru. pMnw 920
lines.transliteration: aap chhad sad aa rahai parn ai gur bin avar na jaan ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹੈ ਪਰਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਏ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints: such a Sikh turns toward the Guru with sincere faith, and becomes sunmukh. ||21||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sunhu sant ahu so sikh  sanmukh  ho-ay. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੋ ਿਸਖੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ  ਹੋਏ ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: One who turns away from the Guru, and becomes baymukh - without the True Guru, he shall not find liberation.
lines.transliteration: jay ko gur tay vaimukh  hovai bin sat gur mukat  na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He shall not find liberation anywhere else either; go and ask the wise ones about this.
lines.transliteration: paavai mukat na hor thai ko-ee puchh ahu bibaykee-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਕੋਈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਿਬਬੇਕੀਆ  ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He shall wander through countless incarnations; without the True Guru, he shall notfind liberation.
lines.transliteration: anayk joonee bharam aavai vin  satgur mukat  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਜੂਨੀ ਭਰਿਮ  ਆਵੈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: But liberation is attained, when one is attached to the feet of the True Guru, chantingthe Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: fir mukat paa-ay laag charn ee sat guroo sabad  sunaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਲਾਿਗ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, contemplate this and see, that without the True Guru, there is noliberation. ||22||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak veechaar daykh hu vin  satgur mukat  na paa-ay. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Come, O beloved Sikhs of the True Guru, and sing the True Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sikh sat guroo kay pi-aariho gaavhu sachee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੁ ਿਸਖ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੇ ਿਪਆਿਰਹੋ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the Guru's Bani, the supreme Word of Words.
lines.transliteration: banee t a gaavhu guroo kayree baan ee-aa sir ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace - their hearts are imbued with this Bani.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o nadar karam hovai hird ai tinaa samaan ee.

lines.english: Drink in this Ambrosial Nectar, and remain in the Lord's Love forever; meditate on theLord, the Sustainer of the world.
lines.transliteration: peevhu amrit sad aa rahhu har rang japihu saarigpaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਜਿਪਹੁ ਸਾਿਰਗਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, sing this True Bani forever. ||23||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sadaa gaavhu ayh sachee ban ee. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਏਹ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, other songs are false.
lines.transliteration: satguroo binaa hor kachee hai ban ee.

lines.english: The songs are false without the True Guru; all other songs are false.
lines.transliteration: banee t a kachee sat guroo baajh ahu hor kachee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਤ ਕਚੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The speakers are false, and the listeners are false; those who speak and recite arefalse.
lines.transliteration: kahday kachay sund ay kachay kacheeN aakh  vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਦੇ  ਕਚੇ ਸੁਣਦੇ  ਕਚੇ ਕਚੀ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: They may continually chant, 'Har, Har' with their tongues, but they do not know whatthey are saying.
lines.transliteration: har har nit karahi rasnaa kahi-aa kachh oo na jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Their consciousness is lured by Maya; they are just reciting mechanically.
lines.transliteration: chit jin kaa hir la-i-aa maa-i-aa bolan pa-ay ravaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤੁ  ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਿਹਿਰ  ਲਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਬੋਲਿਨ  ਪਏ ਰਵਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without the True Guru, other songs are false. ||24||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak satguroo baajh ahu hor kachee ban ee. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹ ੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad rat ann hai heeray jit  jarhaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਿਜਤੁ ਜੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The mind which is attached to this jewel, merges into the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat an jit man laagaa ayhu ho-aa samaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਤਨੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਮੰਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਏਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is attuned to the Shabad, enshrines love for the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad sayt ee man mili-aa sachai laa-i-aa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦ  ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the diamond, and He Himself is the jewel; one who is blessed, understands its value.
lines.transliteration: aapay heeraa ratan aapay jis no d ay-ay bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਰਤਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds. ||25||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sabad rat an hai heeraa jit  jarhaa-o. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਜੜਾਉ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: He Himself created Shiva and Shakti, mind and matter; the Creator subjects them toHis Command.
lines.transliteration: siv sakat aap upaa-ay kai kart aa aapay hukam vart aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਸਕਿਤ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Enforcing His Order, He Himself sees all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, cometo know Him.
lines.transliteration: hukam vartaa-ay aap vaykh ai gurmukh  kisai bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ  ਆਿਪ  ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They break their bonds, and attain liberation; they enshrine the Shabad within theirminds.
lines.transliteration: torhay banDh an hovai mukat  sabad  man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom the Lord Himself makes Gurmukh, lovingly focus their consciousness on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jis no aap karay so hovai aykas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਕਸ  ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, He Himself is the Creator; He Himself reveals the Hukam of HisCommand. ||26||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak aap kartaa aapay hukam bujh aa-ay. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: The Simritees and the Shaastras discriminate between good and evil, but they do notknow the true essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar punn paap beechaard ay tatai saar na jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਬੀਚਾਰਦੇ  ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: They do not know the true essence of reality without the Guru; they do not know thetrue essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: tatai saar na jaan ee guroo baajh ahu tatai saar na jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The world is asleep in the three modes and doubt; it passes the night of its lifesleeping.
lines.transliteration: tihee gun ee sansaar bh aram sut aa sut i-aa rain  vihaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਹੀ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings remain awake and aware, within whose minds, by Guru's Grace,the Lord abides; they chant the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay say jan jaagay jinaa har man vasi-aa boleh amrit  banee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ  ਿਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: 3) kahai naanak so tat  paa-ay jis no an-d in har liv laagai jaagat  rain vihaan ee. ||27|| Says Nanak, they alone obtain the essence of reality, who night and day remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord; they pass the night of their life awake and aware.||27||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੋ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਗਤ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: He nourished us in the mother's womb; why forget Him from the mind?
lines.transliteration: maataa kay ud ar meh part ipaal karay so ki-o manhu visaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤਾ  ਕੇ ਉਦਰ  ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Why forget from the mind such a Great Giver, who gave us sustenance in the fire of the womb?
lines.transliteration: manhu ki-o visaaree-ai ayvad daat aa je agan meh aahaar pahuchaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹੁ ਿਕਉ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਿਜ ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਿਹ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing can harm one, whom the Lord inspires to embrace His Love. pMnw 921
lines.transliteration: os no kihu pohi na sakee jis na-o aapnee liv laav-ay.

lines.english: He Himself is the love, and He Himself is the embrace; the Gurmukh contemplates Him forever.
lines.transliteration: aapnee liv aapay laa-ay gurmukh  sadaa samaalee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਲਵ ਆਪੇ  ਲਾਏ ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, why forget such a Great Giver from the mind? ||28||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak ayvad daat aa so ki-o manhu visaaree-ai. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੋ ਿਕਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: As is the fire within the womb, so is Maya outside.
lines.transliteration: jaisee agan udar meh t aisee baahar maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਅਗਿਨ  ਉਦਰ  ਮਿਹ ਤੈਸੀ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The fire of Maya is one and the same; the Creator has staged this play.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa agan sabh iko jayhee kart ai khayl rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਸਭ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਕਰਤੈ  ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: According to His Will, the child is born, and the family is very pleased.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aanaa taa jammi-aa parvaar bh alaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਤਾ ਜੰਿਮਆ  ਪਰਵਾਿਰ  ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Love for the Lord wears off, and the child becomes attached to desires; the script ofMaya runs its course.
lines.transliteration: liv chhurh kee lagee t arisnaa maa-i-aa amar vart aa-i-aa.

lines.english: This is Maya, by which the Lord is forgotten; emotional attachment and love of duality well up.
lines.transliteration: ayh maa-i-aa jit har visrai moh upjai bh aa-o d oojaa laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ  ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, those who enshrine love for the Lord find Him, in themidst of Maya. ||29||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak gur parsaadee jinaa liv laagee tinee vichay maa-i-aa paa-i-aa. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਿਵਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is priceless; His worth cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: har aap amulak hai mul na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His worth cannot be estimated, even though people have grown weary of trying.
lines.transliteration: mul na paa-i-aa jaa-ay kisai vitahu rahay lok villaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਕਸੈ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਰਹੇ ਲੋਕ ਿਵਲਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If you meet such a True Guru, offer your head to Him; your selfishness and conceitwill be eradicated from within.
lines.transliteration: aisaa satgur jay milai t is no sir sa-upee-ai vichahu aap jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਸਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your soul belongs to Him; remain united with Him, and the Lord will come to dwell inyour mind.
lines.transliteration: jis daa jee-o t is mil rahai har vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is priceless; very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who attain to theLord. ||30||
lines.transliteration: har aap amulak hai bhaag t inaa kay naankaa jin har palai paa-ay. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਅਮੁਲਕੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਗ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: The Lord is my capital; my mind is the merchant.
lines.transliteration: har raas mayree man vanjaaraa.

lines.english: The Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant; through the True Guru, I know my capital.
lines.transliteration: har raas mayree man vanjaaraa sat gur tay raas jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਸ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਰਾਿਸ  ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul, and you shall collect yourprofits daily.
lines.transliteration: har har nit japihu jee-ahu laahaa kh atihu d ihaarh ee.

lines.english: This wealth is obtained by those who are pleasing to the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: ayhu Dhan t inaa mili-aa jin har aapay bh aanaa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant. ||31||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak har raas mayree man ho-aa vanjaaraa. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਸ  ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: O my tongue, you are engrossed in other tastes, but your thirsty desire is notquenched.
lines.transliteration: ay rasnaa too an ras raach rahee t ayree pi-aas na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਰਸਨਾ  ਤੂ ਅਨ ਰਿਸ ਰਾਿਚ  ਰਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your thirst shall not be quenched by any means, until you attain the subtle essence ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: pi-aas na jaa-ay horat kit ai jichar har ras palai na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਹੋਰਤੁ  ਿਕਤੈ ਿਜਚਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If you do obtain the subtle essence of the Lord, and drink in this essence of the Lord,you shall not be troubled by desire again.
lines.transliteration: har ras paa-ay palai pee-ai har ras bahurh na t arisnaa laagai aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇ  ਪਲੈ ਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: This subtle essence of the Lord is obtained by good karma, when one comes to meetwith the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ayhu har ras karmee paa-ee-ai satgur milai jis aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਮੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, all other tastes and essences are forgotten, when the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||32||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak hor an ras sabh veesray jaa har vasai man aa-ay. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹੋਿਰ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਿਭ ਵੀਸਰੇ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: O my body, the Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.
lines.transliteration: ay sareeraa mayri-aa har tum meh jot  rakhee taa too jag meh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ  ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਤੁਮ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ ਰਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.
lines.transliteration: har jot rakh ee tuDh vich t aa too jag meh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੋਿਤ ਰਖੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is your mother, and He Himself is your father; He created thecreated beings, and revealed the world to them.
lines.transliteration: har aapay maataa aapay pit aa jin jee-o upaa-ay jagat  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜੀਉ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਜਗਤੁ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some understand, and then it's a show; it seems like just a show.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bujhi-aa t aa chalat  ho-aa chalat  nadree aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਬੁਿਝਆ  ਤਾ ਚਲਤੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਚਲਤੁ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, He laid the foundation of the Universe, and infused His Light, and thenyou came into the world. ||33||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sarisat kaa mool rachi-aa jot raakh ee taa too jag meh aa-i-aa. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਿਚਆ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਰਾਖੀ  ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: My mind has become joyful, hearing of God's coming.
lines.transliteration: man chaa-o bha-i-aa parabh  aagam sun i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਗਮੁ  ਸੁਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions; my household hasbecome the Lord's Mansion.
lines.transliteration: har mangal gaa-o sakhee garihu mand ar ban i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਉ  ਸਖੀ ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਬਿਣਆ  ॥
