lines.english: Sing continually the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions, and sorrowand suffering will not afflict you.
lines.transliteration: har gaa-o mangal nit sakh ee-ay sog d ookh na vi-aapa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗਾਉ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਖੀਏ  ਸੋਗੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਿਵਆਪਏ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed is that day, when I am attached to the Guru's feet and meditate on my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur charan laagay din sabh aagay aapn aa pir jaap-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਦਨ  ਸਭਾਗੇ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਪਰੁ ਜਾਪਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have come to know the unstruck sound current and the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, the Lord's Name. pMnw 922
lines.transliteration: anhat ban ee gur sabad  jaanee har naam har ras bh ogo.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God Himself has met me; He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||34||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak parabh aap mili-aa karan  kaaran  jogo. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: O my body, why have you come into this world? What actions have you committed?
lines.transliteration: ay sareeraa mayri-aa is jag meh aa-ay kai ki-aa tuDh  karam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ  ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇ  ਕੈ ਿਕਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: And what actions have you committed, O my body, since you came into this world?
lines.transliteration: ke karam kamaa-i-aa tuDh  sareeraa jaa t oo jag meh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ  ਜਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord who formed your form - you have not enshrined that Lord in your mind.
lines.transliteration: jin har tayraa rachan rachi-aa so har man na vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਿਚਆ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides within the mind, and one's pre-ordained destiny is fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har man vasi-aa poorab likhi-aa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this body is adorned and honored, when one's consciousness is focusedon the True Guru. ||35||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak ayhu sareer parvaan ho-aa jin sat gur si-o chit  laa-i-aa. ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੩੫॥
lines.english: O my eyes, the Lord has infused His Light into you; do not look upon any other than the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ay naytarahu mayriho har t um meh jot  Dharee har bin avar na d aykhhu ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਨੇਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਮੇਿਰਹੋ  ਹਿਰ ਤੁਮ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ  ਧਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Do not look upon any other than the Lord; the Lord alone is worthy of beholding.
lines.transliteration: har bin avar na daykh hu ko-ee nad ree har nihaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਹਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: This whole world which you see is the image of the Lord; only the image of the Lord is seen.
lines.transliteration: ayhu vis sansaar tum d aykh-day ayhu har kaa roop hai har roop nad ree aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਿਵਸੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਖਦੇ  ਏਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I see only the One Lord; there is no one except the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bujhi-aa jaa vaykh aa har ik hai har bin avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਬੁਿਝਆ  ਜਾ ਵੇਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, these eyes were blind; but meeting the True Guru, they became all-seeing. ||36||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak ayhi naytar anDh  say sat gur mili-ai d ib darisat ho-ee. ||36||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਿਹ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਅੰਧ ਸੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਿਦਬ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਹੋਈ ॥੩੬॥
lines.english: O my ears, you were created only to hear the Truth.
lines.transliteration: ay sarvanhu mayriho saachai sunn ai no path aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਸਰ੍ਵਣਹੁ ਮੇਿਰਹੋ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ  ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: To hear the Truth, you were created and attached to the body; listen to the TrueBani.
lines.transliteration: saachai sunnai no path aa-ay sareer laa-ay sun hu sat  banee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ  ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ  ਸਰੀਿਰ  ਲਾਏ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing it, the mind and body are rejuvenated, and the tongue is absorbed inAmbrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: jit sun ee man t an hari-aa ho-aa rasnaa ras samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੁਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਆ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਿਸ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is unseen and wondrous; His state cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: sach alakh vidaan ee taa kee gat  kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ  ਿਵਡਾਣੀ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen to the Ambrosial Naam and become holy; you were created only to hear the Truth. ||37||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak amrit naam sun hu pavit ar hovhu saachai sunn ai no path aa-ay. ||37||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ  ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ  ॥੩੭॥
lines.english: The Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath of life into themusical instrument of the body.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o gufaa andar rakh  kai vaajaa pavan  vajaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਿਖ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ  ਪਵਣੁ  ਵਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body, and revealed thenine doors; but He kept the Tenth Door hidden.
lines.transliteration: vajaa-i-aa vaajaa pa-un na-o d u-aaray pargat kee-ay d asvaa gupat  rakhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਜਾਇਆ  ਵਾਜਾ  ਪਉਣ ਨਉ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਏ ਦਸਵਾ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਰਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, some are blessed with loving faith, and theTenth Door is revealed to them.
lines.transliteration: gurdu-aarai laa-ay bh aavnee iknaa d asvaa d u-aar d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ  ਲਾਇ  ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਦਸਵਾ  ਦੁਆਰੁ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There are many images of the Lord, and the nine treasures of the Naam; His limitscannot be found.
lines.transliteration: tah anayk roop naa-o nav niDh  tis daa ant  na jaa-ee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ  ਰੂਪ ਨਾਉ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath oflife into the musical instrument of the body. ||38||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak har pi-aarai jee-o gufaa andar rakh  kai vaajaa pavan  vajaa-i-aa. ||38||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੈ ਜੀਉ  ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਿਖ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ  ਪਵਣੁ  ਵਜਾਇਆ  ॥੩੮॥
lines.english: Sing this true song of praise in the true home of your soul.
lines.transliteration: ayhu saachaa sohilaa saachai ghar gaavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਸਾਚੈ ਘਿਰ  ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Sing the song of praise in your true home; meditate there on the True Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: gaavhu ta sohilaa gh ar saachai jithai sad aa sach Dh i-aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਸਾਚੈ ਿਜਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone meditate on You, O True Lord, who are pleasing to Your Will; as Gurmukh, they understand.
lines.transliteration: sacho Dhi-aavahi jaa t uDh bhaaveh gurmukh  jinaa bujh aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: This Truth is the Lord and Master of all; whoever is blessed, obtains it.
lines.transliteration: ih sach sabhnaa kaa kh asam hai jis bakh say so jan paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, sing the true song of praise in the true home of your soul. ||39||
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sach sohilaa sachai ghar gaavhay. ||39||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਸਚੈ ਘਿਰ ਗਾਵਹੇ  ॥੩੯॥
lines.english: Listen to the song of bliss, O most fortunate ones; all your longings shall be fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: anad sun hu vadbh aageeho sagal manorath pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੁ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ  ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Supreme Lord God, and all sorrows have been forgotten.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh paa-i-aa ut ray sagal visooray.

lines.english: Pain, illness and suffering have departed, listening to the True Bani.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog sant aap ut ray sun ee sachee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ  ਉਤਰੇ  ਸੁਣੀ  ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints and their friends are in ecstasy, knowing the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: sant saajan bh a-ay sarsay pooray gur t ay jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ  ਭਏ ਸਰਸੇ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Pure are the listeners, and pure are the speakers; the True Guru is all-pervading andpermeating.
lines.transliteration: suntay puneet  kahtay pavit  satgur rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਣਤੇ  ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਹਤੇ  ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, touching the Guru's Feet, the unstruck sound current of the celestial bugles vibrates and resounds. ||40||1|| pMnw 923 rwmklI sdu  (923-1) raamkalee sadu Raamkalee, Sadd ~ The Call Of Death: <> siqgur pRswid ] (923-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak gur charan  laagay vaajay anhad  tooray. ||40||1||

lines.english: He is the Great Giver of the Universe, the Lover of His devotees, throughout the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: jag daat aa so-ay bh agat vachh al tihu lo-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਗ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੋਇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਿਤਹੁ ਲੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who is merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad does not know any other.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad samaav-ay avar na jaan ai ko-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਵਏ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dwelling upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not know any other; hemeditates on the One Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: avro na jaaneh sabad  gur kai ayk naam Dh i-aavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of Guru Nanak and Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das obtained the supremestatus.
lines.transliteration: parsaad naanak guroo angad  param pad vee paavhay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਵਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: And when the call came for Him to depart, He merged in the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa hakaaraa chalanvaaraa har raam naam samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਹਕਾਰਾ  ਚਲਣਵਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through devotional worship in this world, the imperishable, immovable, immeasurable Lord is found. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jag amar atal atol th aakur bh agat tay har paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਗ  ਅਮਰੁ ਅਟਲੁ  ਅਤੋਲੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and so the Guru easily reached the LordGod's Presence.
lines.transliteration: har bhaan aa gur bh aa-i-aa gur jaavai har parabh  paas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਾਣਾ  ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru prays to the Lord, "Please, save my honor. This is my prayer".
lines.transliteration: satgur karay har peh baynt ee mayree paij rakh ahu ard aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Please save the honor of Your humble servant, O Lord; please bless him with YourImmaculate Name.
lines.transliteration: paij raakho har janah kayree har d ayh naam niranjano.

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨਹ  ਕੇਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: At this time of final departure, it is our only help and support; it destroys death, andthe Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: ant chald i-aa ho-ay baylee jamd oot kaal nikh anjano.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਹੋਇ ਬੇਲੀ  ਜਮਦੂਤ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਨਖੰਜਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God heard the prayer of the True Guru, and granted His request.
lines.transliteration: satguroo kee baynt ee paa-ee har parabh  sunee ard aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord showered His Mercy, and blended the True Guru with Himself; He said,"Blessed! Blessed! Wonderful!"||2||
lines.transliteration: har Dhaar kirpaa sat gur milaa-i-aa Dh an Dh an kahai saabaas jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Listen O my Sikhs, my children and Siblings of Destiny; it is my Lord's Will that I mustnow go to Him.
lines.transliteration: mayray sikh sun hu put  bhaa-eeho mayrai har bh aanaa aa-o mai paas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਿਸਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਣਾ  ਆਉ  ਮੈ ਪਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and my Lord God applauded Him.
lines.transliteration: har bhaan aa gur bh aa-i-aa mayraa har parabh  karay saabaas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਾਣਾ  ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who is pleased with the Lord God's Will is a devotee, the True Guru, the Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  satgur purakh  so-ee jis har parabh  bhaanaa bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੋਈ ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣਾ  ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The unstruck sound current of bliss resounds and vibrates; the Lord hugs him close inHis embrace.
lines.transliteration: aanand anhad  vajeh vaajay har aap gal maylaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਵਜਿਹ  ਵਾਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਗਿਲ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: O my children, siblings and family, look carefully in your minds, and see.
lines.transliteration: tusee put  bhaa-ee parvaar mayraa man vaykh hu kar nirjaas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਸੀ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਨਰਜਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur likh i-aa parvaan aa firai naahee gur jaa-ay har parabh  paas jee-o. ||3|| The pre-ordained death warrant cannot be avoided; the Guru is going to be with theLord God. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਪਰਵਾਣਾ  ਿਫਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru, in His Own Sweet Will, sat up and summoned His family.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aanai aapn ai bahi parvaar sad aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ  ਬਿਹ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Let no one weep for me after I am gone. That would not please me at all.
lines.transliteration: mat mai pichh ai ko-ee rovsee so mai mool na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤ ਮੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਕੋਈ ਰੋਵਸੀ  ਸੋ ਮੈ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When a friend receives a robe of honor, then his friends are pleased with his honor.
lines.transliteration: mit paijh ai mit  bigsai jis mit  kee paij bh aav-ay.

lines.english: Consider this and see, O my children and siblings; the Lord has given the True Guruthe robe of supreme honor.
lines.transliteration: tusee veechaar d aykhhu put  bhaa-ee har sat guroo painaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਸੀ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਪੈਨਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru Himself sat up, and appointed the successor to the Throne of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of Meditation and Success.
lines.transliteration: satguroo part akh hodai bahi raaj aap tikaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਪਰਤਿਖ  ਹੋਦੈ ਬਿਹ ਰਾਜੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਟਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All the Sikhs, relatives, children and siblings have fallen at the Feet of Guru Ram Das.||4||
lines.transliteration: sabh sikh  banDh ap put  bhaa-ee raamd aas pairee paa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਸਖ ਬੰਧਪ  ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Finally, the True Guru said, "When I am gone, sing Kirtan in Praise of the Lord, inNirvaanaa."
lines.transliteration: antay sat gur boli-aa mai pichh ai keert an kari-ahu nirbaan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਮੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਿਰਅਹੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Call in the long-haired scholarly Saints of the Lord, to read the sermon of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: kayso gopaal pandit sad i-ahu har har kathaa parh eh puraan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸੋ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਸਿਦਅਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਪੜਿਹ  ਪੁਰਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Read the sermon of the Lord, and listen to the Lord's Name; the Guru is pleased withlove for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kathaa parhee-ai har naam sun ee-ai baybaan  har rang gur bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਪੜੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਬੇਬਾਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Do not bother with offering rice-balls on leaves, lighting lamps, and other rituals likefloating the body out on the Ganges; instead, let my remains be given up to the Lord'sPool.
lines.transliteration: pind patal kiri-aa d eevaa ful har sar paav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਤਿਲ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਦੀਵਾ  ਫੁਲ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਰ ਪਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord was pleased as the True Guru spoke; he was blended then with the all-knowing Primal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har bhaa-i-aa sat gur boli-aa har mili-aa purakh  sujaan  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru then blessed the Sodhi Ram Das with the ceremonial tilak mark, the insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||5|| pMnw 924
lines.transliteration: raamdaas sodh ee tilak d ee-aa gur sabad  sach neesaan  jee-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: And as the True Guru, the Primal Lord spoke, and the Gursikhs obeyed His Will.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  je boli-aa gursikh aa man la-ee rajaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਜ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਲਈ ਰਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: His son Mohri turned sunmukh, and become obedient to Him; he bowed, and touched Ram Das' feet.
lines.transliteration: mohree put sanmukh  ho-i-aa raamd aasai pairee paa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਰੀ  ਪੁਤੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਰਾਮਦਾਸੈ  ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Then, everyone bowed and touched the feet of Ram Das, into whom the Guru infusedHis essence.
lines.transliteration: sabh pavai pairee sat guroo kayree jithai guroo aap rakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਪਵੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੇਰੀ ਿਜਥੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਆਪੁ  ਰਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: And any that did not bow then because of envy - later, the True Guru brought themaround to bow in humility.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee kar bakheelee nivai naahee fir sat guroo aan  nivaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਕਿਰ ਬਖੀਲੀ  ਿਨਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਆਿਣ  ਿਨਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: It pleased the Guru, the Lord, to bestow glorious greatness upon Him; such was thepre-ordained destiny of the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: har gureh bhaan aa dee-ee vadi-aa-ee Dh ur likh i-aa laykh  rajaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਭਾਣਾ ਦੀਈ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Says Sundar, listen, O Saints: all the world fell at His feet. ||6||1|| rwmklI mhlw 5 CMq  (924-6) raamkalee mehlaa 5 chhant Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant: <> siqgur pRswid ] (924-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahai sundar sun hu sant ahu sabh  jagat  pairee paa-ay jee-o. ||6||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥੧॥
lines.english: Friend, my Friend - standing so near to me is my Friend!
lines.transliteration: saajanrhaa mayraa saajanrh aa nikat kh alo-i-arh aa mayraa saajanrh aa.

lines.english: Beloved, the Lord my Beloved - with my eyes, I have seen the Lord, my Beloved!
lines.transliteration: jaanee-arhaa har jaanee-arh aa nain  alo-i-arh aa har jaanee-arh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨੜਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਖਲੋਇਅੜਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: With my eyes I have seen Him, sleeping upon the bed within each and every heart; my Beloved is the sweetest ambrosial nectar.
lines.transliteration: nain alo-i-aa gh at ghat so-i-aa at  amrit  pari-a goorh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ  ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਅੜਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is with all, but he cannot be found; the fool does not know His taste.
lines.transliteration: naal hovandaa leh na sakand aa su-aa-o na jaan ai moorh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸੋਇਆ  ਅਿਤ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਗੂੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, the mortal babbles on about trivial affairs; giving into the illusion, he cannot meet the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mad maat aa hochh ee baat aa milan  na jaa-ee bh aram Dh arhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਲ  ਹੋਵੰਦਾ  ਲਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਉ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮੂੜਾ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without the Guru, he cannot understand the Lord, the Friend who isstanding near everyone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur bin naahee soojhai har saajan sabh  kai nikat kh arhaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਿਦ ਮਾਤਾ  ਹੋਛੀ ਬਾਤਾ  ਿਮਲਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਭਰਮ  ਧੜਾ ॥
lines.english: God, my God - the Support of the breath of life is my God.
lines.transliteration: gobindaa mayray gobind aa paraan  aDhaaraa mayray gobind aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੂਝੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਖੜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Merciful Lord, my Merciful Lord - the Giver of gifts is my Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: kirpaalaa mayray kirpaalaa daan d aataaraa mayray kirpaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਬੰਦਾ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਅਧਾਰਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਿਬੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Giver of gifts is infinite and unlimited; deep within each and every heart, He is sobeautiful!
lines.transliteration: daan d aataaraa apar apaaraa gh at ghat ant ar sohni-aa.

lines.english: He created Maya, His slave, so powerfully pervasive - she has enticed all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: ik daasee Dh aaree sabal pasaaree jee-a jant  lai mohni-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨ  ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਸੋਹਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord saves, chants the True Name, and contemplates the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jis no raakhai so sach bh aakhai gur kaa sabad  beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਦਾਸੀ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਸਬਲ  ਪਸਾਰੀ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਲੈ ਮੋਹਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one who is pleasing to God - God is very dear to him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo parabh ka-o bh aanaa tis hee ka-o parabh  pi-aaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I take pride, I take pride in God; I take pride in my God.
lines.transliteration: maano parabh  maan o mayray parabh  kaa maan o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਭਾਣਾ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wise, God is wise; my Lord and Master is all-wise, and all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: jaano parabh  jaano su-aamee sugh arh sujaan o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਣੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਮਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: All-wise and all-knowing, and forever supreme; the Name of the Lord is AmbrosialNectar.
lines.transliteration: sugharh  sujaanaa sad  parDh aanaa amrit  har kaa naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਣੋ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਣੋ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny recorded upon their foreheads, taste it,and are satisfied with the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: chaakh agh aanay saarigpaan ay jin kai bh aag mathaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਘੜ  ਸੁਜਾਨਾ  ਸਦ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: They meditate on Him, and find Him; they place all their pride in Him.
lines.transliteration: tin hee paa-i-aa t ineh Dh i-aa-i-aa sagal t isai kaa maan o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਖ  ਅਘਾਣੇ  ਸਾਿਰਗਪਾਣੇ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, He is seated on His eternal throne; True is His royal court. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak thir takh at nivaasee sach t isai deebaan o. ||3||

lines.english: The song of joy, the Lord's song of joy; listen to the song of joy of my God.
lines.transliteration: manglaa har manglaa mayray parabh kai sun ee-ai manglaa.

lines.english: The wedding song, God's wedding song; the unstruck sound current of His wedding song resounds.
lines.transliteration: sohilrhaa parabh  sohilrh aa anhad  Dhunee-ai sohilrh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਗਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਗਲਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਮੰਗਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The unstruck sound current vibrates, and the Word of the Shabad resounds; there iscontinuous, continual rejoicing.
lines.transliteration: anhad vaajay sabad  agaajay nit  nit jisahi vaDh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਨੀਐ  ਸੋਿਹਲੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on that God, everything is obtained; He does not die, or come or go.
lines.transliteration: so parabh Dh i-aa-ee-ai sabh  kichh  paa-ee-ai marai na aavai jaa-ee.

lines.english: Thirst is quenched, and hopes are fulfilled; the Gurmukh meets with the absolute,unmanifest Lord.
lines.transliteration: chookee pi-aasaa pooran aasaa gurmukh mil nirgunee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in the Home of my God, the songs of joy are continuously, continually heard. ||4||1|| pMnw 925 rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (925-1) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ghar parabh  mayray kai nit  nit mangal sunee-ai. ||4||1||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O mind; don't forget Him, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: har har Dhi-aa-ay manaa kh in na visaaree-ai.

lines.english: Enshrine the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, Raam, within your heart and throat.
lines.transliteration: raam raamaa raam ramaa kanth ur Dh aaree-ai.

lines.english: Enshrine within your heart the Primal Lord, Har, Har, the all-pervading, supreme, immaculate Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ur Dhaar har har purakh  pooran paarbarahm niranjano.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਮਾ ਕੰਿਠ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He sends fear far away; He is the Destroyer of sin; He eradicates the unbearablepains of the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhai d oor kart aa paap hart aa dusah d ukh bhav kh andno.

lines.punjabi: ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplate the Lord of the World, the Cherisher of the World, the Lord, the VirtuousLord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jagdees ees gopaal maaDh o gun  govind  veechaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ  ਦੁਸਹ  ਦੁਖ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, remember the Lord,day and night. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak mil sang saaDh oo dinas rain  chitaaree-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਈਸ ਗਪਾਲ  ਮਾਧੋ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: His lotus feet are the support and anchor of His humble servants.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal aaDhaar jan kaa aasraa.

lines.english: He takes the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, as his wealth, property andtreasure.
lines.transliteration: maal milakh bh andaar naam anant  Dharaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name, enjoy the taste of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam narhar niDhaan jin kai ras bh og ayk naraa-in aa.

lines.english: They meditate on the Infinite Lord with each and every breath, as their pleasure, joy and beauty.
lines.transliteration: ras roop rang anant beeth al saas saas Dh i-aa-in aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਏਕ ਨਰਾਇਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Destroyer of sins, the only deed ofredemption. The Naam drives out the fear of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh harn aa naam punehcharn aa naam jam kee t araas haraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੰਤ  ਬੀਠਲ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਧਆਇਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the support of His lotus feet is the capital of His humble servant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak raas jan kee charan kamlah aasraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਹਰਣਾ  ਨਾਮ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਹਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Your Glorious Virtues are endless, O my Lord and Master; no one knows them all.
lines.transliteration: gun bay-ant  su-aamee t ayray ko-ay na jaan-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲਹ  ਆਸਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Seeing and hearing of Your wondrous plays, O Merciful Lord, Your devotees narratethem.
lines.transliteration: daykh  chalat  da-i-aal sun  bhagat vakh aana-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ  ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures meditate on You, O Primal Transcendent Lord, Master ofmen.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tujh Dhi-aavahi purakh pat parmaysraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਚਲਤ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੁਿਣ ਭਗਤ  ਵਖਾਨਈ  ॥
lines.english: All beings are beggars; You are the One Giver, O Lord of the Universe, Embodiment ofmercy.
lines.transliteration: sarab jaachik ayk daat aa karun aa mai jagd eesraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਤੁਝੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਪੁਰਖਪਿਤ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is holy, a Saint, a truly wise person, who is accepted by the Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sant  sujaan  so-ee jisahi parabh  jee maana-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, they alone realize You, unto whom You show Mercy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak karahu kirpaa so-ay t ujheh pachh aana-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਸੋਈ ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਮਾਨਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am unworthy and without any master; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun anaath sarn ee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Divine Guru, who has implanted the Naam within me.
lines.transliteration: bal bal bal gurdayv jin naam drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Guru blessed me with the Naam; happiness came, and all my desires werefulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gur naam dee-aa kusal thee-aa sarab ichh aa punnee-aa.

lines.english: The fire of desire has been quenched, and peace and tranquility have come; aftersuch a long separation, I have met my Lord again.
lines.transliteration: jalnay bujhaa-ee saaNt aa-ee milay chiree vichh unni-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ  ਕੁਸਲੁ  ਥੀਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਇਛਾ  ਪੁੰਨੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have found ecstasy, pleasure and true intuitive poise, singing the great glories, thesong of bliss of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aanand harakh  sahj saachay mahaa mangal gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have obtained the Name of God from the Perfect Guru. ||4||2|| rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (925-13) raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak naam parabh  kaa gur pooray t ay paa-i-aa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦ  ਹਰਖ  ਸਹਜ  ਸਾਚੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Rise early each morning, and with the Saints, sing the melodious harmony, theunstruck sound current of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: run jh uno sabad  anaahad  nit uth gaa-ee-ai sant an kai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: All sins and sufferings are erased, chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh sabh  dokh binaasan har naam japee-ai gur mant an kai.

lines.english: Dwell upon the Lord's Name, and drink in the Nectar; day and night, worship andadore Him.
lines.transliteration: har naam leejai ami-o peejai rain d inas araaDh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਨਾਹਦੁ  ਿਨਤ ਉਿਠ ਗਾਈਐ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: The merits of Yoga, charity and religious rituals are obtained by grasping His lotusfeet.
lines.transliteration: jog daan anayk kiri-aa lag charan  kamlah saaDh ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਸਿਭ ਦੋਖ ਿਬਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: Loving devotion to the merciful, enticing Lord takes away all pain.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh agat da-i-aal mohan d ookh saglay parharai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਪੀਜੈ ਰੈਿਣ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਅਰਾਧੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, cross over the world-ocean, meditating on the Lord, your Lord andMaster. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak t arai saagar Dh i-aa-ay su-aamee narharai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਦਾਨ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਲਿਗ ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲਹ  ਸਾਧੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is an ocean of peace; Your devotees sing YourGlorious Praises, Lord.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar gobind  simran  bhagat gaavahi gun  tayray raam.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਮੋਹਨ  ਦੂਖ ਸਗਲੇ  ਪਰਹਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Ecstasy, bliss and great happiness are obtained by grasping hold of the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: anad mangal gur charn ee laagay paa-ay sookh  ghanayray raam.

lines.english: Meeting with the treasure of peace, their pains are taken away; granting His Grace,God protects them.
lines.transliteration: sukh niDh aan mili-aa d ookh hari-aa kirpaa kar parabh  raakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਿਸਮਰਣੁ  ਭਗਤ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who grasp the Lord's feet - their fears and doubts run away, and they chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har charan laagaa bh aram bh a-o bh aagaa har naam rasnaa bh aakhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਪਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: He thinks of the One Lord, and he sings of the One God; he gazes upon the One Lord alone. pMnw 926
lines.transliteration: har ayk chitvai parabh  ayk gaavai har ayk d aristee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, God has granted His Grace, and I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak parabh  karee kirpaa pooraa sat gur paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਰੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meet with the holy, humble servants of God; meeting with the Lord, listen to theKirtan of His Praises.
lines.transliteration: mil rahee-ai parabh saaDh  janaa mil har keert an sunee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: God is the Merciful Master, the Lord of wealth; there is no end to His Virtues.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal parabh oo daamod ar maaDh o ant na paa-ee-ai gunee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ  ਮਾਧੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਨੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord is the Dispeller of pain, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Eradicator of allevil.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal d ukh har saran  daataa sagal d okh nivaarn o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਿਣ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਦੋਖ ਿਨਵਾਰਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment, sorrow, corruption and pain - chanting the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord, one is saved from these.
lines.transliteration: moh sog vikaar bikh-rh ay japat  naam uDh aaran o.

lines.english: All beings are Yours, O my God; bless me with Your Mercy, that I may become the dust under the feet of all men.
lines.transliteration: sabh jee-a t ayray parabh oo mayray kar kirpaa sabh  rayn theevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸਭ ਰੇਣ ਥੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, O God, be kind to me, that I may chant Your Name, and live. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak parabh  ma-i-aa keejai naam t ayraa jap jeevaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਇਆ  ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਪ ਜੀਵਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: God saves His humble devotees, attaching them to His feet.
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay parabh  bhagat janaa apn ee charn ee laa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਏ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਅਪਣੀ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate in remembrance on their God; they meditaeon the One Name.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar apnaa parabh  simreh ayko naam Dh i-aa-ay raam.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਸਮਰਹ  ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay so parabh  taray bh avjal rahay aavan  jaanaa. Meditating on that God, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and their comingsand goings cease.

lines.punjabi: ਿਧਆਇ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲ  ਰਹੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: They enjoy eternal peace and pleasure, singing the Kirtan of God's Praises; His Willseems so sweet to them.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh  kali-aan  keert an parabh  lagaa meeth aa bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਲਗਾ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with the Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sabh ichh  punnee aas pooree milay sat gur poori-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਆਸ  ਪੂਰੀ ਿਮਲੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, God has blended me with Himself; I shall never suffer pain or sorrowagain. ||4||3|| rwmklI mhlw 5 CMq ] (926-8) raamkalee mehlaa 5 chhant . Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant. sloku ] (926-9) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak parabh  aap maylay fir naahee d ookh visoori-aa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਮੇਲੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਦੂਖ ਿਵਸੂਿਰਆ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of His lotus feet, I sing His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sarnaagat ee anad  mangal gun  gaam.

lines.english: O Nanak, worship God in adoration, the Eradicator of misfortune. ||1|| CMqu ] (926-10) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh aaraaDh ee-ai bipat  nivaaran  raam. ||1||

lines.english: God is the Eradicator of misfortune; there is none other than Him.
lines.transliteration: parabh bipat  nivaarn o tis bin avar na ko-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, remember the Lord in meditation; He is permeating the water, theland and the sky.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har simree-ai jal thal mahee-al so-ay jee-o.

lines.english: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; do not forget Himfrom your mind, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poor rahi-aa ik nimakh manhu na veesrai.

lines.english: Blessed was that day, when I grasped the Guru's feet; all virtues rest in the Lord ofthe Universe.
lines.transliteration: gur charan laagay din sabh aagay sarab gun  jagdeesrai.

lines.english: So serve Him day and night, O servant; whatever pleases Him, happens.
lines.transliteration: kar sayv sayvak dinas rain ee tis bhaavai so ho-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰੀਐ  ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Giver of peace; his mind and body are enlightened. ||1|| sloku ] (926-13) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: bal jaa-ay naanak sukhah d aatay pargaas man t an ho-ay jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the mind and body find peace; the thought ofduality is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: har simrat man t an sukh ee binsee d utee-aa soch.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਦਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ  ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak takes the support of the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, theDestroyer of troubles. ||1|| CMqu ] (926-14) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak tayk gopaal kee govind sankat moch. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਣੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord has eradicated my fears and troubles.
lines.transliteration: bhai sankat kaatay naaraa-in  da-i-aal jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਖਹ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; God is the Cherisher, the Master ofthe meek.
lines.transliteration: har gun aanand  gaa-ay parabh  deenaa naath part ipaal jee-o.

lines.english: The Cherishing Lord is imperishable, the One and only Primal Lord; I am imbued withHis Love.
lines.transliteration: partipaal achut  purakh  ayko t iseh si-o rang laagaa.

lines.english: When I placed my hands and forehead upon His Feet, He blended me with Himself; Ibecame awake and aware forever, night and day.
lines.transliteration: kar charan mastak mayl leenay sad aa an-d in jaagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਟੇਕ ਗਪਾਲ  ਕੀ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My soul, body, household and home belong to Him, along with my body, youth, wealth and property.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind garihu thaan tis kaa t an joban Dh an maal jee-o.

lines.english: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him, who cherishes and nurtures all beings.||2|| sloku ] (926-18) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: sad sad aa bal jaa-ay naanak sarab jee-aa part ipaal jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My tongue chants the Name of the Lord, and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lordof the Universe.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa uchrai har haray gun govind  vakh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਆਨੰਦ  ਗਾਏ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has grasped the sheltering support of the One Transcendent Lord, who shallsave him in the end. ||1|| CMqu ] (926-19) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak pakrhee tayk ayk parmaysar rakh ai nid aan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਏਕੋ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਸਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is God, our Lord and Master, our Saving Grace. Grab hold of the hem of His robe.
lines.transliteration: so su-aamee parabh rakh ko anchal t aa kai laag jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਚਰਨ  ਮਸਤਕੁ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੀਨੇ  ਸਦਾ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Vibrate, and meditate on the Merciful Divine Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; renounce your intellectual mind. pMnw 927
lines.transliteration: bhaj saaDh oo sang d a-i-aal d ayv man kee mat  ti-aag jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਿਤਆਗੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Seek the Support of the One Lord, and surrender your soul to Him; place your hopes only in the Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: ik ot keejai jee-o deejai aas ik Dh arneeDharai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਓਟ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਆਸ  ਇਕ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, cross over theterrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangay har naam rangay sansaar saagar sabh  tarai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The corrupting sins of birth and death are eradicated, and no stain ever sticks to themagain.
lines.transliteration: janam maran bikaar chh ootay fir na laagai d aag jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਛੂਟੇ ਿਫਿਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਦਾਗੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Primal Lord; His marriage is eternal. ||3|| sloku ] (927-3) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: bal jaa-ay naanak purakh pooran thir jaa kaa sohaag jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਥਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dharam arath ar kaam mokh  mukat  padaarath naath. Righteous faith, wealth, sexual success and salvation; the Lord bestows these fourblessings.
One who has such pre-ordained destiny upon his forehead, O Nanak, has all hisdesires fulfilled. ||1|| CMqu ] (927-4) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath poori-aa naanak likhi-aa maath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਅਰਥ  ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.english: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with my Immaculate, Sovereign Lord.
lines.transliteration: sagal ichh mayree punnee-aa mili-aa niranjan raa-ay jee-o.

lines.english: I am in ecstasy, O very fortunate ones; the Dear Lord has become manifest in my own home.
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-i-aa vadbh aageeho garihi pargatay parabh  aa-ay jee-o.

lines.english: My Beloved has come to my home, because of my past actions; how can I count HisGlories?
lines.transliteration: garihi laal aa-ay purab kamaa-ay taa kee upmaa ki-aa gan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ  ਿਮਿਲਆ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਰਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace and intuition, is infinite and perfect; with what tonguecan I describe His Glorious Virtues?
lines.transliteration: bay-ant pooran sukh  sahj d aataa kavan rasnaa gun  bhanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He hugs me close in His embrace, and merges me into Himself; there is no place ofrest other than Him.
lines.transliteration: aapay milaa-ay geh kanth laa-ay t is binaa nahee jaa-ay jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਲਾਲ  ਆਏ ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਕਮਾਏ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਗਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Creator, who is contained in, and permeating all.||4||4|| rwgu rwmklI mhlw 5 ] (927-8) raag raamkalee mehlaa 5. Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bal jaa-ay naanak sadaa kart ay sabh  meh rahi-aa samaa-ay jee-o. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਕਵਨ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੁਣ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.english: Sing the melodious harmonies, O my companions, and meditate on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ran jh unjhnarhaa gaa-o sakh ee har ayk Dh i-aavahu.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਗਿਹ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Serve your True Guru, O my companions, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. rwmklI mhlw 5 ruqI sloku  (927-10) raamkalee mehlaa 5 rutee salok Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ruti ~ The Seasons. Shalok: <> siqgur pRswid ] (927-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: satgur t um sayv sakh ee man chind i-arhaa fal paavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ ਸਮਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Bow to the Supreme Lord God, and seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kar bandan parabh  paarbarahm baachh a-o saaDh ah Dh oor.

lines.english: Cast out your self-conceit, and vibrate, meditate, on the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, Godis all-pervading. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap nivaar har har bhaja-o naanak parabh  bharpoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਣ ਝੁੰਝਨੜਾ  ਗਾਉ  ਸਖੀ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: He is the Eradicator of sins, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the SovereignLord King.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh kaatan  bhai haran  sukh  saagar har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਖੀ ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਅੜਾ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Merciful to the meek, the Destroyer of pain: O Nanak, always meditate on Him. ||2|| CMqu ] (927-13) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal d ukh bhanjno naanak neet  Dhi-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਲੋਕੁ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Sing His Praises, O very fortunate ones, and the Dear Lord God shall bless you withHis Mercy.
lines.transliteration: jas gaavhu vadbhaageeho kar kirpaa bh agvant  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਬੰਦਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬਾਛਉ  ਸਾਧਹ  ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Blessed and auspicious is that season, that month, that moment, that hour, when you chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: rutee maah moorat  gharhee gun  uchrat  sobh aavant  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਰਪੂਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Blessed are those humble beings, who are imbued with love for His Praises, and whomeditate single-mindedly on Him.
lines.transliteration: gun rang raat ay Dh an tay jan jinee ik man Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਕਾਟਣ  ਭੈ ਹਰਣ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their lives become fruitful, and they find that Lord God.
lines.transliteration: safal janam bha-i-aa t in kaa jinee so parabh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨੀਤ  ਿਧਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Donations to charities and religious rituals are not equal to meditation on the Lord,who destroys all sins.
lines.transliteration: punn daan na t ul kiri-aa har sarab paapaa hant  jee-o.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live; birth and death are finishedfor me. ||1|| slok ] (927-16) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak simar jeevaa janam maran  rahant  jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Strive for the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and bow in humility to His lotusfeet.
lines.transliteration: udam agam agocharo charan kamal namaskaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਮੂਰਤ ਘੜੀ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰਤ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that sermon alone is pleasing to You, Lord, which inspires us to take theSupport of the Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kathnee saa tuDh  bhaavsee naanak naam aDh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਧੰਿਨ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਿਜਨੀ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, O friends; meditate in remembrance on your infinite Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sant saran  saajan parahu su-aamee simar anant .

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਿਜਨੀ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The dried branch shall blossom forth in its greenery again, O Nanak, meditating onthe Lord God. ||2|| CMqu ] (927-18) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: sookay tay hari-aa thee-aa naanak jap bh agvant . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਨ ਤੁਿਲ  ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਬ  ਪਾਪਾ  ਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The season of spring is delightful; the months of Chayt and Baisaakhi are the mostpleasant months.
lines.transliteration: rut saras basant  maah chayt  vaisaakh  sukh  maas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਰਹੰਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have obtained the Dear Lord as my Husband, and my mind, body and breath have blossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o naahu mili-aa ma-oli-aa man tan saas jee-o.

lines.english: The eternal, unchanging Lord has come into my home as my Husband, O my companions; dwelling upon His lotus feet, I blossom forth in bliss. pMnw 928
lines.transliteration: ghar naahu nihchal anad  sakhee-ay charan kamal parfuli-aa.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is beautiful, proficient, wise and all-knowing;
lines.transliteration: sundar sugh arh sujaan  baytaa gun  govind  amuli-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਬੇਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਅਮੁਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: His Virtues are priceless. By great good fortune, I have found Him; my pain is dispelled, and my hopes are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaag paa-i-aa d ukh gavaa-i-aa bh a-ee pooran aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord, and my fear of death is eradicated. ||2|| slok ] (928-2) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  tayree mitee jam kee t araas jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੇਰੀ ਿਮਟੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one dies wandering around inconfusion, performing all sorts of rituals.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  bin bh aram mu-ee kart ee karam anayk.

lines.english: O Nanak, all are bound by the attractive bonds of Maya, and the karmic record of pastactions. ||1||
lines.transliteration: komal banDhan baaDh ee-aa naanak karmeh laykh . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਮੁਈ ਕਰਤੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਅਨੇਕ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to God are united with Him; He separates others fromHimself.
lines.transliteration: jo bhaan ay say mayli-aa vichh orhay bh ee aap.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਮਲ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਬਾਧੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮਿਹ  ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His greatness is glorious! ||2|| CMqu ] (928-4) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat ee jaa kaa vad part aap. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਿਵਛੋੜੇ  ਭੀ ਆਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: In the summer season, in the months of Jayt'h and Asaarh, the heat is terrible,intense and severe.
lines.transliteration: gareekham rut  at gaakh -rhee jayth  akhaarhai ghaam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The discarded bride is separated from His Love, and the Lord does not even look at her.
lines.transliteration: paraym bichhohu d uhaagan ee darisat na karee raam jee-o.

lines.english: She does not see her Lord, and she dies with an aching sigh; she is defrauded andplundered by her great pride.
lines.transliteration: nah darisat aavai marat  haavai mahaa gaarab muth ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰ੍ੀਖਮ ਰੁਿਤ ਅਿਤ  ਗਾਖੜੀ  ਜੇਠ ਅਖਾੜੈ  ਘਾਮ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: She flails around, like a fish out of water; attached to Maya, she is alienated from theLord.
lines.transliteration: jal baajh machh ulee t arhfarhaavai sang maa-i-aa ruth ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਬਛੋਹੁ ਦੁਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਨ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: She sins, and so she is fearful of reincarnation; the Messenger of Death will surelypunish her.
lines.transliteration: kar paap jonee bhai bh eet ho-ee d ay-ay saasan jaam jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਆਵੈ  ਮਰਤ  ਹਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਗਾਰਿਬ  ਮੁਠੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, take me under Your sheltering support, Lord, and protect me; You arethe Fulfiller of desire. ||3|| slok ] (928-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak ot t ayree raakh  pooran kaam jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਬਾਝੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਤੜਫੜਾਵੈ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੁਠੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: With loving faith, I am attached to my Beloved; I cannot survive without Him, even foran instant.
lines.transliteration: sarDhaa laagee sang pareet amai ik t il rahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਪਾਪ ਜੋਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਹੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਸਨ  ਜਾਮ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body, O Nanak, with intuitive ease.||1||
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar rav rahay naanak sahj subh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Friend has taken me by the hand; He has been my best friend, lifetime after lifetime.
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenee saajniH janam janam kay meet.

lines.english: He has made me the slave of His feet; O Nanak, my consciousness is filled with lovefor God. ||2|| CMqu ] (928-10) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: charnah daasee kar la-ee naanak parabh  hit cheet . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਧਾ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੈ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The rainy season is beautiful; the months of Saawan and Bhaadon bring bliss.
lines.transliteration: rut baras suhaylee-aa saavan  bhaadvay aanand  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The clouds are low, and heavy with rain; the waters and the lands are filled withhoney.
lines.transliteration: ghan unav vuth ay jal thal poori-aa makrand  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੀਨੀ  ਸਾਜਨਿਹ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: God is all-pervading everywhere; the nine treasures of the Lord's Name fill the homesof all hearts.
lines.transliteration: parabh poor rahi-aa sarab th aa-ee har naam nav niDh  garih bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨਹ  ਦਾਸੀ  ਕਿਰ ਲਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਹਤ ਚੀਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, the Searcher of hearts, all one'sancestry is saved.
lines.transliteration: simar su-aamee antarjaamee kul samoohaa sabh  taray.

lines.english: No blemish sticks to that being who remains awake and aware in the Love of theLord; the Merciful Lord is forever forgiving.
lines.transliteration: pari-a rang jaagay nah chhid ar laagay kirpaal sad  bakh sind jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਿਤ ਬਰਸੁ  ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ  ਸਾਵਣ  ਭਾਦਵੇ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord, who is forever pleasing to my mind. ||4|| slok ] (928-13) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak har kant  paa-i-aa sad aa man bh aavand  jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਘਣ ਉਨਿਵ  ਵੁਠੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪੂਿਰਆ  ਮਕਰੰਦ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Thirsty with desire, I wander around; when will I behold the Lord of the World?
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aasee mai fira-o kab paykha-o gopaal.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਠਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Is there any humble Saint, any friend, O Nanak, who can lead me to meet with God?||1||
lines.transliteration: hai ko-ee saajan sant jan naanak parabh  maylan haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਸਿਭ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Without meeting Him, I have no peace or tranquility; I cannot survive for a moment,even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: bin milbay saaNt na oopjai t il pal rahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਰੰਿਗ ਜਾਗੇ  ਨਹ ਿਛਦਰ੍  ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਸਦ ਬਖਿਸੰਦੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints, O Nanak, my desires are fulfilled.||2|| CMqu ] (928-15) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: har saaDhah sarn aagat ee naanak aas pujaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: In the cool, autumn season, in the months of Assu and Katik, I am thirsty for theLord.
lines.transliteration: rut sarad  adambaro asoo kat kay har pi-aas jee-o.

lines.english: Searching for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I wander around wondering, when will I meet my Lord, the treasure of virtue?
lines.transliteration: khojant ee darsan firat  kab milee-ai gunt aas jee-o.

lines.english: Without my Beloved Husband Lord, I find no peace, and all my necklaces andbracelets become cursed.
lines.transliteration: bin kant pi-aaray nah sookh  saaray haar kany an Dharig banaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So beautiful, so wise, so clever and knowing; still, without the breath, it is just a body.
lines.transliteration: sundar sujaan  chatur bayt ee saas bin jaisay t anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਿਮਲਬੇ  ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਤਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I look here and there, in the ten directions; my mind is so thirsty to meet God!
lines.transliteration: eet ut  dah dis alokan man milan kee parabh  pi-aas jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਧਹ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਸ  ਪੁਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me; unite me with Yourself, O God, O treasureof virtue. ||5|| slok ] (928-19) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak Dh aar kirpaa maylhu parabh  guntaas jee-o. ||5||

lines.english: The fire of desire is cooled and quenched; my mind and body are filled with peace andtranquility.
lines.transliteration: jalan bujh ee seet al bha-ay man t an upjee saaNt.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਿਤ ਸਰਦ  ਅਡੰਬਰੋ ਅਸੂ ਕਤਕੇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਸ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I have met my Perfect God; the illusion of duality is dispelled. ||1|| pMnw 929
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh pooran milay d utee-aa binsee bh araaNt. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord Himself sent His Holy Saints, to tell us that He is not far away.
lines.transliteration: saaDh path aa-ay aap har ham t um tay naahee d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਪਠਾਏ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, doubt and fear are dispelled, chanting the Name of the all-pervading Lord. ||2|| CMqu ] (929-2) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak bharam bh ai mit ga-ay raman  raam bh arpoor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੈ ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਏ ਰਮਣ  ਰਾਮ ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the cold season of Maghar and Poh, the Lord reveals Himself.
lines.transliteration: rut sisee-ar seet al har pargatay mangh ar pohi jee-o.

lines.english: My burning desires were quenched, when I obtained the Blessed Vision of HisDarshan; the fraudulent illusion of Maya is gone.
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhee d aras paa-i-aa binsay maa-i-aa Dh aroh jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਿਤ ਿਸਸੀਅਰ  ਸੀਤਲ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਮੰਘਰ  ਪੋਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: All my desires have been fulfilled, meeting the Lord face-to-face; I am His servant, Iserve at His feet.
lines.transliteration: sabh kaam pooray mil hajooray har charan  sayvak sayvi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਿਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਧਰ੍ੋਹ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: My necklaces, hair-ties, all decorations and adornments, are in singing the GloriousPraises of the unseen, mysterious Lord.
lines.transliteration: haar dor seegaar sabh ras gun  gaa-o alakh  abhayvi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਜੂਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਸੇਵਿਕ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: I long for loving devotion to the Lord of the Universe, and so the Messenger of Deathcannot even see me.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh agat govind  baaNchhat jam na saakai johi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਸਿਭ ਰਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, God has united me with Himself; I shall never suffer separation from my Beloved again. ||6|| slok ] (929-5) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak parabh  aap maylee t ah na paraym bichh oh jee-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਬਛਤ  ਜਮੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜੋਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The happy soul bride has found the wealth of the Lord; her consciousness does notwaver.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan paa-i-aa sohaagan ee dolat  naahee cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਮੇਲੀ  ਤਹ ਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਬਛੋਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Joining together with the Saints, O Nanak, God, my Friend, has revealed Himself in myhome. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant sanjogee naankaa garihi pargatay parabh  meet . ||1||

lines.english: With her Beloved Husband Lord, she enjoys millions of melodies, pleasures and joys.
lines.transliteration: naad binod  anand kod pari-a pareet am sang banay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਡੋਲਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਚੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, O Nanak, chanting the Lord's Name.||2|| CMqu ] (929-7) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: man baaNchhat  fal paa-i-aa har naanak naam bh anay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The snowy winter season, the months of Maagh and Phagun, are pleasing andennobling to the mind.
lines.transliteration: himkar rut man bh aavtee maagh  fagan  gunvant jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ  ਕੋਡ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਨੇ ॥
lines.english: O my friends and companions, sing the songs of joy; my Husband Lord has come into my home.
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahaylee gaa-o manglo garihi aa-ay har kant  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਛਤ  ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My Beloved has come into my home; I meditate on Him in my mind. The bed of myheart is beautifully adorned.
lines.transliteration: garihi laal aa-ay man Dhi-aa-ay sayj sund ar sohee-aa.

lines.english: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in theirgreenery; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am fascinated.
lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan bha-ay hari-aa d aykh darsan mohee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਮਕਰ ਰੁਿਤ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਤੀ  ਮਾਘੁ ਫਗਣੁ  ਗੁਣਵੰਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have met my Lord and Master, and my desires are fulfilled; my mind chants HisImmaculate Mantra.
lines.transliteration: milay su-aamee ichh punnee man japi-aa nirmal mant  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਗਾਉ  ਮੰਗਲੋ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਆਏ  ਹਿਰ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I celebrate continuously; I have met my Husband Lord, the Lord ofexcellence. ||7|| slok ] (929-11) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak nit  karahu ralee-aa har milay sareeDh ar kant  jee-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਲਾਲ  ਆਏ  ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਏ  ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਸੋਹੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints are the helpers, the support of the soul; they carry us cross the terrifyingworld-ocean.
lines.transliteration: sant sahaa-ee jee-a kay bh avjal t aaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਣੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਣੁ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਭਏ ਹਿਰਆ  ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੋਹੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Know that they are the highest of all; O Nanak, they love the Naam, the Name of theLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay oochay jaan ee-ahi naanak naam pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਿਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਮੰਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who know Him, cross over; they are the brave heroes, the heroic warriors.
lines.transliteration: jin jaani-aa say-ee taray say sooray say beer.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord, and cross over to the other shore. ||2|| CMqu ] (929-13) chhant . Chhant:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin balihaarn ai har jap ut ray teer. ||2||

lines.english: His feet are exalted above all. They eradicate all suffering.
lines.transliteration: charan biraajit  sabh  oopray miti-aa sagal kalays jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੇ ਭਵਜਲ  ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: They destroy the pains of coming and going. They bring loving devotion to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaavan  dukh haray har bh agat kee-aa parvays jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਪਆਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, anddoes not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: har rang raatay sahj maat ay til na man t ay beesrai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਸੇਈ ਤਰੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Shedding my self-conceit, I have entered the Sanctuary of His Feet; all virtues rest inthe Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: taj aap sarn ee paray charnee sarab gun  jagdeesrai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਉਤਰੇ  ਤੀਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I bow in humility to the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue, the Lord ofexcellence, our Primal Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: govind gun  niDh sareerang su-aamee aad  ka-o aad ays jee-o.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; throughout the ages, You take thesame form. ||8||1||6||8|| rwmklI mhlw 1 dKxI EAMkwru  (929-17) raamkalee mehlaa 1 dakh -nee o-ankaar Raamkalee, First Mehl, Dakhanee, Ongkaar: <> siqgur pRswid ] (929-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak ma-i-aa Dh aarahu jug jugo ik vays jee-o. ||8||1||6||8||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਿਬਰਾਿਜਤ  ਸਭ ਊਪਰੇ  ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਲੇਸੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: From Ongkaar, the One Universal Creator God, Brahma was created.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar barahmaa utpat .

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਵਣ  ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕੀਆ  ਪਰਵੇਸੁ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He kept Ongkaar in his consciousness.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar kee-aa jin chit.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਮਾਤੇ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: From Ongkaar, the mountains and the ages were created.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar sail jug bha-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਆਪੁ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਰੇ ਚਰਨੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Ongkaar created the Vedas. pMnw 930
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar bayd nirma-ay.

lines.english: Ongkaar saves the world through the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar sabad uDh ray.

lines.english: Ongkaar saves the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar gurmukh t aray.

lines.english: Listen to the Message of the Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: onam akhar sun hu beechaar.

lines.english: The Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord is the essence of the three worlds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: onam akhar t aribhavan saar. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O Pandit, O religious scholar, why are you writing about worldly debates?
lines.transliteration: sun paaday ki-aa likh ahu janjaalaa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, write only the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: likh raam naam gurmukh  gopaalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sassa: He created the entire universe with ease; His One Light pervades the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: sasai sabh jag sahj upaa-i-aa t een bh avan ik jot ee.

lines.english: Become Gurmukh, and obtain the real thing; gather the gems and pearls.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vasat  paraapat  hovai chun  lai maan ak mot ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਤੀਿਨ  ਭਵਨ  ਇਕ ਜੋਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: If one understands, realizes and comprehends what he reads and studies, in the endhe shall realize that the True Lord dwells deep within his nucleus.
lines.transliteration: samjhai soojh ai parh  parh boojh ai ant  nirant ar saachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਚੁਿਣ  ਲੈ ਮਾਣਕ  ਮੋਤੀ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh sees and contemplates the True Lord; without the True Lord, the worldis false. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d aykhai saach samaalay bin saachay jag kaachaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਮਝੈ  ਸੂਝੈ ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਸਾਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: DhaDh ai Dharam Dh aray Dh armaa pur gun kaaree man Dh eeraa. Dhadha: Those who enshrine Dharmic faith and dwell in the City of Dharma areworthy; their minds are steadfast and stable.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: DhaDh ai Dhool parh ai mukh  mast ak kanchan bh a-ay manooraa. Dhadha: If the dust of their feet touches one's face and forehead, he is transformedfrom iron into gold.

lines.punjabi: ਧਧੈ ਧਰਮੁ  ਧਰੇ ਧਰਮਾ  ਪੁਿਰ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ  ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh arneeDhar aap ajonee t ol bol sach pooraa. Blessed is the Support of the Earth; He Himself is not born; His measure and speech are perfect and True.

lines.punjabi: ਧਧੈ ਧੂਿਲ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਕੰਚਨ  ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Only the Creator Himself knows His own extent; He alone knows the Brave Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kartay kee mit  kartaa jaan ai kai jaan ai gur sooraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਅਜੋਨੀ  ਤੋਿਲ  ਬੋਿਲ  ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: In love with duality, spiritual wisdom is lost; the mortal rots away in pride, and eatspoison.
lines.transliteration: nyi-aan gavaa-i-aa d oojaa bh aa-i-aa garab galay bikh  khaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੀ ਿਮਿਤ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁ ਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He thinks that the sublime essence of the Guru's song is useless, and he does not liketo hear it. He loses the profound, unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur ras geet baad  nahee bh aavai sun ee-ai gahir gambh eer gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਙਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਇਆ  ਗਰਿਬ  ਗਲੇ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Words of Truth, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, and the mindand body find joy in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sach kahi-aa amrit lahi-aa man t an saach sukh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਸੁ ਗੀਤ  ਬਾਦ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himselfleads us to drink it in. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay gurmukh aapay d ayvai aapay amrit  pee-aa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਿਹਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਲਿਹਆ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone says that God is the One and only, but they are engrossed in egotism andpride.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk kahai sabh ko-ee ha-umai garab vi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Realize that the One God is inside and outside; understand this, that the Mansion ofHis Presence is within the home of your heart.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayk pachh aanai i-o gh ar mahal sinj aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਿਵਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: God is near at hand; do not think that God is far away. The One Lord permeates the entire universe.
lines.transliteration: parabh nayrh ai har d oor na jaan hu ayko sarisat sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਇਉ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਸਞਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: There in One Universal Creator Lord; there is no other at all. O Nanak, merge into theOne Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aykankaar avar nahee doojaa naanak ayk samaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਿਰ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਏਕੋ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: How can you keep the Creator under your control? He cannot be seized or measured.
lines.transliteration: is kartay ka-o ki-o geh raakh a-o afri-o t uli-o na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Maya has made the mortal insane; she has administered the poisonous drug offalsehood.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kay dayvaanay paraan ee jhooth thag-uree paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਉ ਿਕਉ  ਗਿਹ ਰਾਖਉ  ਅਫਿਰਓ ਤੁਿਲਓ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Addicted to greed and avarice, the mortal is ruined, and then later, he regrets andrepents.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh muht aaj vigoot ay ib t ab fir pachh utaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਝੂਿਠ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: So serve the One Lord, and attain the state of Salvation; your comings and goingsshall cease. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ayk sarayvai taa gat  mit paavai aavan  jaan rahaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਲਿਬ ਲੋਿਭ ਮੁਹਤਾਿਜ  ਿਵਗੂਤੇ  ਇਬ ਤਬ ਿਫਿਰ  ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is in all actions, colors and forms.
lines.transliteration: ayk achaar rang ik roop.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵੈ  ਤਾ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਪਾਵੈ ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਰਹਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He manifests in many shapes through wind, water and fire.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee agnee asroop.

lines.english: The One Soul wanders through the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: ayko bhavar bh avai t ihu lo-ay.

lines.english: One who understands and comprehends the One Lord is honored.
lines.transliteration: ayko boojhai soojh ai pat  ho-ay.

lines.english: One who gathers in spiritual wisdom and meditation, dwells in the state of balance.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan lay samsar rahai.

lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ayk virlaa ko lahai.

lines.english: They alone find peace, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis no day-ay kirpaa t ay sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: In the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, they speak and hear of the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: guroo du-aarai aakh  sunaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: His Light illuminates the ocean and the earth.
lines.transliteration: ooram Dhooram jot  ujaalaa.

lines.english: Throughout the three worlds, is the Guru, the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan meh gur gopaalaa.

lines.english: The Lord reveals His various forms;
lines.transliteration: oogvi-aa asroop dikh aavai.
kar kirpaa apunai ghar aavai. granting His Grace, He enters the home of the heart.

lines.english: The clouds hang low, and the rain is pouring down.
lines.transliteration: oonav barsai neejhar Dh aaraa.

lines.english: The Lord embellishes and exalts with the Sublime Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ootam sabad  savaaran haaraa.

lines.english: One who knows the mystery of the One God,
lines.transliteration: is aykay kaa jaanai bh ay-o.
aapay kartaa aapay d ay-o. ||8|| is Himself the Creator, Himself the Divine Lord. ||8||

lines.english: When the sun rises, the demons are slain;
lines.transliteration: ugvai soor asur sanghaarai.
oocha-o daykh  sabad  beechaarai. the mortal looks upwards, and contemplates the Shabad.

lines.english: The Lord is beyond the beginning and the end, beyond the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: oopar aad ant  tihu lo-ay.

lines.english: He Himself acts, speaks and listens. pMnw 931
lines.transliteration: aapay karai kathai sunai so-ay.

lines.english: He is the Architect of Destiny; He blesses us with mind and body.
lines.transliteration: oh biDhaat aa man t an day-ay.

lines.english: That Architect of Destiny is in my mind and mouth.
lines.transliteration: oh biDhaat aa man mukh  so-ay.

lines.english: God is the Life of the world; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: parabh jagjeevan avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is honored. ||9||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay pat  ho-ay. ||9||

lines.english: One who lovingly chants the Name of the Sovereign Lord King,
lines.transliteration: raajan raam ravai hitkaar.
ran meh loojh ai manoo-aa maar. fights the battle and conquers his own mind;
raat d inant rahai rang raat aa. day and night, he remains imbued with the Lord's Love.

lines.english: He is famous throughout the three worlds and the four ages.
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan jug chaaray jaat aa.

lines.english: One who knows the Lord, becomes like Him.
lines.transliteration: jin jaataa so t is hee jayhaa.

lines.english: He becomes absolutely immaculate, and his body is sanctified.
lines.transliteration: at nirmaa-il seejh as dayhaa.

lines.english: His heart is happy, in love with the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: rahsee raam ridai ik bh aa-ay.

lines.english: He lovingly centers his attention deep within upon the True Word of the Shabad. ||10||
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  saach liv laa-ay. ||10||

lines.english: Don't be angry - drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall not remain in this worldforever.
lines.transliteration: ros na keejai amrit peejai rahan  nahee sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The ruling kings and the paupers shall not remain; they come and go, throughout thefour ages.
lines.transliteration: raajay raa-ay rank nahee rahnaa aa-ay jaa-ay jug chaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਇ  ਰੰਕ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ  ਆਇ  ਜਾਇ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Everyone says that they will remain, but none of them remain; unto whom should Ioffer my prayer?
lines.transliteration: rahan kahan  tay rahai na ko-ee kis peh kara-o binant ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਣ  ਕਹਣ  ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਕਰਉ  ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: The One Shabad, the Name of the Lord, will never fail you; the Guru grants honor andunderstanding. ||11||
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad raam naam niroDh ar gur d ayvai pat  matee. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਨਰੋਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਿਤ ਮਤੀ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: My shyness and hesitation have died and gone, and I walk with my face unveiled.
lines.transliteration: laaj marantee mar ga-ee gh ooghat khol chalee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੰਤੀ  ਮਿਰ ਗਈ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਖੋਿਲ ਚਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: The confusion and doubt from my crazy, insane mother-in-law has been removedfrom over my head.
lines.transliteration: saas divaanee baavree sir t ay sank talee.

lines.english: My Beloved has summoned me with joyful caresses; my mind is filled with the bliss ofthe Shabad.
lines.transliteration: paraym bulaa-ee ralee si-o man meh sabad anand.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਬੁਲਾਈ  ਰਲੀ ਿਸਉ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Love of my Beloved, I have become Gurmukh, and carefree. ||12||
lines.transliteration: laal ratee laalee bh a-ee gurmukh  bha-ee nichind . ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਿਲ  ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲੀ  ਭਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਈ ਿਨਿਚੰਦੁ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Chant the jewel of the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam ratan jap saar.

lines.english: Greed, avarice, evil and egotism;
lines.transliteration: lab lobh buraa ahaNkaar.
laarhee chaarh ee laa-it baar. slander, inuendo and gossip;
manmukh anDh aa mugaDh  gavaar. the self-willed manmukh is blind, foolish and ignorant.

lines.english: For the sake of earning the profit of the Lord, the mortal comes into the world.
lines.transliteration: laahay kaaran aa-i-aa jag.

lines.english: But he becomes a mere slave laborer, and is mugged by the mugger, Maya.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay majoor ga-i-aa thagaa-ay th ag.

lines.english: One who earns the profit of the Naam, with the capital of faith,
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam poonjee vaysaahu.

lines.english: O Nanak, is truly honored by the True Supreme King. ||13||
lines.transliteration: naanak sachee pat sachaa paat isaahu. ||13||

lines.english: The world is ruined on the path of Death.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay vigootaa jag jam panth.

lines.english: No one has the power to erase Maya's influence.
lines.transliteration: aa-ee na maytan ko samrath.

lines.english: If wealth visits the home of the lowliest clown,
lines.transliteration: aath sail neech ghar ho-ay.
aath daykh  nivai jis d o-ay. seeing that wealth, all pay their respects to him.

lines.english: Even an idiot is thought of as clever, if he is rich.
lines.transliteration: aath ho-ay taa mugaDh  si-aanaa.

lines.english: Without devotional worship, the world is insane.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bihoonaa jag ba-uraanaa.

lines.english: The One Lord is contained among all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vart ai ayko so-ay.

lines.english: He reveals Himself, unto those whom He blesses with His Grace. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay tis pargat ho-ay. ||14||

lines.english: Throughout the ages, the Lord is eternally established; He has no vengeance.
lines.transliteration: jug jug thaap sadaa nirvair.

lines.english: He is not subject to birth and death; He is not entangled in worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: janam maran nahee Dh anDhaa Dh air.

lines.english: Whatever is seen, is the Lord Himself.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so aapay aap.

lines.english: Creating Himself, He establishes Himself in the heart.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay aapay ghat thaap.

lines.english: He Himself is unfathomable; He links people to their affairs.
lines.transliteration: aap agochar DhanDh ai lo-ee.

lines.english: He is the Way of Yoga, the Life of the World.
lines.transliteration: jog jugat jagjeevan so-ee.

lines.english: Living a righteous lifestyle, true peace is found.
lines.transliteration: kar aachaar sach sukh ho-ee.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone find liberation? ||15||
lines.transliteration: naam vihoonaa mukat  kiv ho-ee. ||15||

lines.english: Without the Name, even one's own body is an enemy.
