lines.transliteration: vin naavai vayroDh  sareer.

lines.english: Why not meet the Lord, and take away the pain of your mind?
lines.transliteration: ki-o na mileh kaateh man peer.

lines.english: The traveller comes and goes along the highway.
lines.transliteration: vaat vataa-oo aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: What did he bring when he came, and what will he take away when he goes?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa lay aa-i-aa ki-aa palai paa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Name, one loses everywhere.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai t otaa sabh  thaa-ay.

lines.english: The profit is earned, when the Lord grants understanding.
lines.transliteration: laahaa milai jaa day-ay bujh aa-ay.

lines.english: In merchandise and trade, the merchant is trading.
lines.transliteration: vanaj vaapaar van jai vaapaaree.

lines.english: Without the Name, how can one find honor and nobility? ||16||
lines.transliteration: vin naavai kaisee pat  saaree. ||16||

lines.english: One who contemplates the Lord's Virtues is spiritually wise.
lines.transliteration: gun veechaaray gi-aanee so-ay.

lines.english: Through His Virtues, one receives spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gun meh gi-aan paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.english: How rare in this world, is the Giver of virtue.
lines.transliteration: gundaat aa virlaa sansaar.

lines.english: The True way of life comes through contemplation of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: saachee karnee gur veechaar.

lines.english: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable. His worth cannot be estimated. pMnw 932
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paa-ay.

lines.english: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord causes to meet.
lines.transliteration: taa milee-ai jaa la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: The virtuous soul bride continually contemplates His Virtues.
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee gun  saaray neet .

lines.english: O Nanak, following the Guru's Teachings, one meets the Lord, the true friend. ||17||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat milee-ai meet . ||17||

lines.english: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger waste the body away,
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh kaa-i-aa ka-o gaalai.
ji-o kanchan sohaagaa dhaalai. as gold is dissolved by borax.

lines.english: The gold is touched to the touchstone, and tested by fire;
lines.transliteration: kas kasvatee sahai so taa-o.
nadar saraaf vannee sachrh aa-o. when its pure color shows through, it is pleasing to the eye of the assayer.

lines.english: The world is a beast, and arrogent Death is the butcher.
lines.transliteration: jagat pasoo ahaN kaal kasaa-ee.

lines.english: The created beings of the Creator receive the karma of their actions.
lines.transliteration: kar kartai karn ee kar paa-ee.

lines.english: He who created the world, knows its worth.
lines.transliteration: jin keetee t in keemat  paa-ee.

lines.english: What else can be said? There is nothing at all to say. ||18||
lines.transliteration: hor ki-aa kahee-ai kichh kahan  na jaa-ee. ||18||

lines.english: Searching, searching, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat amrit  pee-aa.

lines.english: I have adopted the way of tolerance, and given my mind to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: khimaa gahee man sat gur dee-aa.

lines.english: Everyone calls himself true and genuine.
lines.transliteration: kharaa kh araa aakh ai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: He alone is true, who obtains the jewel throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: kharaa rat an jug chaaray ho-ay.

lines.english: Eating and drinking, one dies, but still does not know.
lines.transliteration: khaat  pee-ant  moo-ay nahee jaani-aa.

lines.english: He dies in an instant, when he realizes the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: khin meh moo-ay jaa sabad  pachh aani-aa.

lines.english: His consciousness becomes permanently stable, and his mind accepts death.
lines.transliteration: asthir cheet maran man maani-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||19||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay naam pachh aani-aa. ||19||

lines.english: The Profound Lord dwells in the sky of the mind, the Tenth Gate;
lines.transliteration: gagan gambheer gagnant ar vaas.
gun gaavai sukh  sahj nivaas. singing His Glorious Praises, one dwells in intuitive poise and peace.

lines.english: He does not go to come, or come to go.
lines.transliteration: ga-i-aa na aavai aa-ay na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਇਆ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਆਇ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord of the mind-sky is inaccessible, independent and beyond birth.
lines.transliteration: gagan agamm anaath ajonee.

lines.english: The most worthy Samaadhi is to keep the consciousness stable, focused on Him.
lines.transliteration: asthir cheet samaaDh  sagonee.

lines.english: Remembering the Lord's Name, one is not subject to reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: har naam chayt fir paveh na joonee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਿਤ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਪਵਿਹ  ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Teachings are the most Excellent; all other ways lack the Naam, the Nameof the Lord. ||20||
lines.transliteration: gurmat saar hor naam bihoonee. ||20||

lines.english: Wandering to countless doorsteps and homes, I have grown weary.
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar fir thaakee bahut ayray.

lines.english: My incarnations are countless, without limit.
lines.transliteration: jaat asaNkh ant nahee mayray.

lines.english: I have had so many mothers and fathers, sons and daughters.
lines.transliteration: kaytay maat  pitaa sut  Dhee-aa.

lines.english: I have had so many gurus and disciples.
lines.transliteration: kaytay gur chaylay fun hoo-aa.

lines.english: Through a false guru, liberation is not found.
lines.transliteration: kaachay gur tay mukat  na hoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚੇ  ਗੁ ਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੂਆ ॥
lines.english: There are so many brides of the One Husband Lord - consider this.
lines.transliteration: kaytee naar var ayk samaal.

lines.english: The Gurmukh dies, and lives with God.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh maran  jeevan  parabh  naal.

lines.english: Searching in the ten directions, I found Him within my own home.
lines.transliteration: dah d is dhoodh gharai meh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have met Him; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||21||
lines.transliteration: mayl bha-i-aa sat guroo milaa-i-aa. ||21||

lines.english: The Gurmukh sings, and the Gurmukh speaks.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gaavai gurmukh  bolai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh evaluates the value of the Lord, and inspires others to evaluate Him as well.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t ol tolaavai t olai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh comes and goes without fear.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aavai jaa-ay nisang.

lines.english: His filth is taken away, and his stains are burnt off.
lines.transliteration: parhar mail jalaa-ay kalank.

lines.english: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad for his Vedas.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naad  bayd  beechaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh's cleansing bath is the performance of good deeds.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh majan chaj achaar.

lines.english: For the Gurmukh, the Shabad is the most excellent Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  amrit  hai saar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over. ||22||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paavai paar. ||22||

lines.english: The fickle consciousness does not remain stable.
lines.transliteration: chanchal cheet na rah-ee th aa-ay.

lines.english: The deer secretly nibbles at the green sprouts.
lines.transliteration: choree mirag angooree khaa-ay.

lines.english: One who enshrines the Lord's lotus feet in his heart and consciousness
lines.transliteration: charan kamal ur Dhaaray cheet .
chir jeevan chaytan nit  neet. lives long, always remembering the Lord.

lines.english: Everyone has worries and cares.
lines.transliteration: chintat  hee d eesai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: He alone finds peace, who thinks of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: cheeteh ayk t ahee sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: When the Lord dwells in the consciousness, and one is absorbed in the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: chit vasai raachai har naa-ay.
mukat bh a-i-aa pat  si-o gh ar jaa-ay. ||23|| one is liberated, and returns home with honor. ||23||

lines.english: The body falls apart, when one knot is untied.
lines.transliteration: chheejai d ayh kh ulai ik gandh .

lines.english: Behold, the world is on the decline; it will be totally destroyed.
lines.transliteration: chhay-aa nit  daykhhu jag handh .

lines.english: Dhoop chh aav jay sam kar jaan ai. Only one who looks alike upon sunshine and shade

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaat mukat  ghar aan ai. has his bonds shattered; he is liberated and returns home.

lines.english: Maya is empty and petty; she has defrauded the world.
lines.transliteration: chhaa-i-aa chh oochh ee jagat  bhulaanaa.

lines.english: Such destiny is pre-ordained by past actions.
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa kirat  Dhuray parvaanaa.

lines.english: Youth is wasting away; old age and death hover above the head. pMnw 933
lines.transliteration: chheejai joban jaroo-aa sir kaal.

lines.english: The body falls apart, like algae upon the water. ||24||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa chheejai bh a-ee sibaal. ||24||

lines.english: God Himself appears throughout the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: jaapai aap parabhoo t ihu lo-ay.

lines.english: Throughout the ages, He is the Great Giver; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: jug jug daat aa avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, You protect and preserve us.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh ahi raakh .

lines.english: I ask for the Lord's Praises, which bless me with honor and credit.
lines.transliteration: jas jaacha-o dayvai pat  saakh .

lines.english: Remaining awake and aware, I am pleasing to You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaagat jaag rahaa t uDh bhaavaa.

lines.english: When You unite me with Yourself, then I am merged in You.
lines.transliteration: jaa too mayleh t aa tujhai samaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I chant Your Victorious Praises, O Life of the World.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar japa-o jagdees.

lines.english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, one is sure to merge in the One Lord. ||25||
lines.transliteration: gurmat milee-ai bees ikees. ||25||

lines.english: Why do you speak such nonsense, and argue with the world?
lines.transliteration: jhakh  bolan  ki-aa jag si-o vaad .

lines.english: You shall die repenting, when you see your own insanity.
lines.transliteration: jhoor marai d aykhai parmaad .

lines.english: He is born, only to die, but he does not wish to live.
lines.transliteration: janam moo-ay nahee jeevan aasaa.

lines.english: He comes hopeful, and then goes, without hope.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay chalay bha-ay aas niraasaa.

lines.english: Regretting, repenting and grieving, he is dust mixing with dust.
lines.transliteration: jhur jh ur jhakh maatee ral jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਝੁਿਰ ਝੁਿਰ ਝਿਖ ਮਾਟੀ  ਰਿਲ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Death does not chew up one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaal na chaaNpai har gun gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਚਪੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The nine treasures are obtained through the Name of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: paa-ee nav niDh har kai naa-ay.
aapay dayvai sahj subh aa-ay. ||26|| the Lord bestows intuitive peace and poise. ||26||

lines.english: He speaks spiritual wisdom, and He Himself understands it.
lines.transliteration: nji-aano bolai aapay boojh ai.

lines.english: He Himself knows it, and He Himself comprehends it.
lines.transliteration: aapay samjhai aapay soojh ai.

lines.english: One who takes the Words of the Guru into his very fiber,
lines.transliteration: gur kaa kahi-aa ank samaavai.
nirmal soochay saacho bhaavai. is immaculate and holy, and is pleasing to the True Lord.

lines.english: In the ocean of the Guru, there is no shortage of pearls.
lines.transliteration: gur saagar ratnee nahee t ot.

lines.english: The treasure of jewels is truly inexhaustible.
lines.transliteration: laal padaarath saach akh ot.

lines.english: Do those deeds which the Guru has ordained.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa saa kaar kamaavahu.

lines.english: Why are you chasing after the Guru's actions?
lines.transliteration: gur kee karnee kaahay Dh aavahu.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, merge in the True Lord. ||27||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmat saach samaavahu. ||27||

lines.english: Love is broken, when one speaks in defiance.
lines.transliteration: tootai nayhu ke boleh sahee.

lines.english: The arm is broken, when it is pulled from both sides.
lines.transliteration: tootai baah duhoo d is gahee.

lines.english: Love breaks, when the speech goes sour.
lines.transliteration: toot pareet ga-ee bur bol.

lines.english: The Husband Lord abandons and leaves behind the evil-minded bride.
lines.transliteration: durmat  parhar chh aadee dh ol.

lines.english: The broken knot is tied again, through contemplation and meditation.
lines.transliteration: tootai ganth parh ai veechaar.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one's affairs are resolved in one's own home.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee gh ar kaaraj saar.

lines.english: One who earns the profit of the True Name, will not lose it again;
lines.transliteration: laahaa saach na aavai totaa.
taribh avan thaakur pareet am motaa. ||28|| the Lord and Master of the three worlds is your best friend. ||28||

lines.english: Control your mind, and keep it in its place.
lines.transliteration: thaakahu manoo-aa raakh o thaa-ay.

lines.english: The world is destroyed by conflict, regretting its sinful mistakes.
lines.transliteration: thahak mu-ee avgun  pachh utaa-ay.

lines.english: There is one Husband Lord, and all are His brides.
lines.transliteration: thaakur ayk sabaa-ee naar.

lines.english: The false bride wears many costumes.
lines.transliteration: bahutay vays karay koorh i-aar.

lines.english: He stops her from going into the homes of others;
lines.transliteration: par ghar jaat ee thaak rahaa-ee.

lines.english: He summons her to the Mansion of His Presence, and no obstacles block her path.
lines.transliteration: mahal bulaa-ee thaak na paa-ee.

lines.english: She is embellished with the Word of the Shabad, and is loved by the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad savaaree saach pi-aaree.

lines.english: She is the happy soul bride, who takes the Support of her Lord and Master. ||29||
lines.transliteration: saa-ee sohagan th aakur Dh aaree. ||29||

lines.english: Wandering and roaming around, O my companion, your beautiful robes are torn.
lines.transliteration: dolat dolat  hay sakh ee faatay cheer seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਡੋਲਤ  ਡੋਲਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: In jealousy, the body is not at peace; without the Fear of God, multitudes are ruined.
lines.transliteration: daahpan t an sukh  nahee bin dar bin athee daar.

lines.punjabi: ਡਾਹਪਿਣ  ਤਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਡਰ ਿਬਣਠੀ  ਡਾਰ ॥
lines.english: One who remains dead within her own home, through the Fear of God, is looked upon with favor by her all-knowing Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: darap mu-ee ghar aapn ai deeth ee kant  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਡਰਿਪ  ਮੁਈ ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ ਡੀਠੀ  ਕੰਿਤ  ਸੁਜਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: She maintains fear of her Guru, and chants the Name of the Fearless Lord.
lines.transliteration: dar raakhi-aa gur aapn ai nirbh a-o naam vakh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਡਰੁ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਆਪਣੈ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: Living on the mountain, I suffer such great thirst; when I see Him, I know that He isnot far away.
lines.transliteration: doogar vaas tikh aa gh anee jab d aykhaa nahee d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਡੂਗਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਿਤਖਾ  ਘਣੀ  ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: My thirst is quenched, and I have accepted the Word of the Shabad. I drink my fill ofthe Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: tikhaa nivaaree sabad  man amrit  pee-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: Everyone says, "Give! Give!" As He pleases, He gives.
lines.transliteration: deh d eh aakh ai sabh  ko-ee jai bh aavai t ai day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਹ ਦੇਿਹ ਆਖੈ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, He gives, and quenches the thirst. ||30||
lines.transliteration: guroo du-aarai d ayvsee t ikhaa nivaarai so-ay. ||30||

lines.english: Searching and seeking, I fell down and collapsed upon the bank of the river of life.
lines.transliteration: dhandh olat dhoodhat ha-o firee dh eh dh eh pavan karaar.

lines.punjabi: ਢੰਢੋਲਤ  ਢੂਢਤ  ਹਉ ਿਫਰੀ  ਢਿਹ ਢਿਹ ਪਵਿਨ ਕਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are heavy with sin sink down, but those who are light swim across.
lines.transliteration: bhaaray dh ahtay dh eh pa-ay ha-ulay niksay paar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਰੇ ਢਹਤੇ  ਢਿਹ ਪਏ ਹਉਲੇ  ਿਨਕਸੇ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who meet the immortal and immeasurable Lord.
lines.transliteration: amar ajaachee har milay tin kai ha-o bal jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰ  ਅਜਾਚੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in their company, we are united in the Lord's Union.
lines.transliteration: tin kee Dh oorh aghulee-ai sangat  mayl milaa-o.

lines.english: I gave my mind to my Guru, and received the Immaculate Name. pMnw 934
lines.transliteration: man dee-aa gur aapn ai paa-i-aa nirmal naa-o.

lines.english: I serve the One who gave me the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: jin naam dee-aa t is sayvsaa t is balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਉਸਾਰੇ  ਸੋ ਢਾਹਸੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He who builds, also demolishes; there is no other than Him.
lines.transliteration: jo usaaray so dhaahsee t is bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ  ਤਾ ਤਿਨ  ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I contemplate Him, and then my body does not suffer in pain. ||31||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee tis sammHlaa taa tan dookh na ho-ay. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਕਸੁ ਗਹੀ ਣਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ  ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: No one is mine - whose gown should I grasp and hold? No one ever was, and no one shall ever be mine.
lines.transliteration: naa ko mayraa kis gahee n aa ko ho-aa na hog.

lines.english: Coming and going, one is ruined, afflicted with the disease of dual-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  viguchee-ai d ubiDh aa vi-aapai rog.

lines.english: Those beings who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, collapse like pillars of salt.
lines.transliteration: naam vihoon ay aad mee kalar kanDh  girant .

lines.english: Without the Name, how can they find release? They fall into hell in the end.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai ki-o chh ootee-ai jaa-ay rasaat al ant .

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤ  ਗਣਾਵੈ  ਅਖਰੀ  ਅਗਣਤੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Using a limited number of words, we describe the unlimited True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ganat  ganaavai akh ree agn at saachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਮਿਤਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The ignorant lack understanding. Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee matiheen  hai gur bin gi-aan na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਰਬਾਬ  ਕੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਿਵਜੋਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: The separated soul is like the broken string of a guitar, which does not vibrate itssound.
lines.transliteration: tootee t ant rabaab kee vaajai nahee vijog.

lines.english: God unites the separated souls with Himself, awakening their destiny. ||32||
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa maylai parabh oo naanak kar sanjog. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਪੰਿਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਵਿਰ  ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ॥
lines.english: The body is the tree, and the mind is the bird; the birds in the tree are the five senses.
lines.transliteration: tarvar kaa-i-aa pankh  man t arvar pankh ee panch.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਚੁਗਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਏਕਸੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
lines.english: They peck at the essence of reality, and merge with the One Lord. They are nevertrapped at all.
lines.transliteration: tat chugeh mil ayksay t in ka-o faas na ranch.

lines.punjabi: ਉਡਿਹ  ਤ ਬੇਗੁਲ  ਬੇਗੁਲੇ  ਤਾਕਿਹ  ਚੋਗ ਘਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: But the others fly away in a hurry, when they see the food.
lines.transliteration: udeh t a baygul baygulay t akeh chog gh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਖ ਤੁਟੇ ਫਾਹੀ  ਪੜੀ ਅਵਗੁਿਣ  ਭੀੜ ਬਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Their feathers are clipped, and they are caught in the noose; through their mistakes,they are caught in disaster.
lines.transliteration: pankh t utay faahee parh ee avgun  bheerh banee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਿਕਉ  ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿਮ  ਮਣੀ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Lord, how can anyone find release? The jewel of the Lord's GloriousPraises comes by the karma of good actions.
lines.transliteration: bin saachay ki-o chhootee-ai har gun  karam man ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਛਡਾਏ  ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਵਡਾ ਆਿਪ  ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.english: When He Himself releases them, only then are they released. He Himself is the GreatMaster.
lines.transliteration: aap chhadaa-ay chh ootee-ai vadaa aap Dh anee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are released, when He Himself grants His Grace.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee chhootee-ai kirpaa aap karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣੈ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਵਡਾਈਆ  ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Glorious greatness rests in His Hands. He blesses those with whom He is pleased.||33||
lines.transliteration: apnai haath vadaa-ee-aa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਥਰ ਥਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਥਾਨ ਿਵਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The soul trembles and shakes, when it loses its mooring and support.
lines.transliteration: thar thar kampai jee-arhaa thaan vihoon aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਿਨ  ਮਾਿਨ  ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਜੁ  ਨ ਫੀਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Only the support of the True Lord brings honor and glory. Through it, one's works arenever in vain.
lines.transliteration: thaan maan sach ayk hai kaaj na feetai ko-ay.

lines.english: The Lord is eternal and forever stable; the Guru is stable, and contemplation upon the True Lord is stable.
lines.transliteration: thir naaraa-in thir guroo thir saachaa beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥਹ  ਨਾਥੁ ਤੂ ਿਨਧਾਰਾ  ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Lord and Master of angels, men and Yogic masters, You are the support of theunsupported.
lines.transliteration: sur nar naathah naath too niDh aaraa aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰੀ  ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In all places and interspaces, You are the Giver, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: sarbay thaan thanantaree t oo daataa daataar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see You, Lord; You have no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah ayk t oo ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: You are pervading and permeating the places and interspaces; reflecting upon theWord of the Guru's Shabad, You are found.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahi-aa gur sabd ee veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਣਮੰਿਗਆ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ  ਵਡਾ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: You give gifts even when they are not asked for; You are great, inaccessible andinfinite. ||34||
lines.transliteration: anmangi-aa d aan d ayvsee vadaa agam apaar. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤੂ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Merciful Lord, You are the embodiment of mercy; creating the Creation, You behold it.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa d aan d a-i-aal t oo kar kar d aykhanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਢਾਿਹ  ਉਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, O God, and unite me with Yourself. In an instant,You destroy and rebuild.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahi parabh  mayl laihi kh in meh dh aahi usaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨਾ  ਤੂ ਬੀਨਾ  ਤੁਹੀ ਦਾਨਾ  ਕੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You are the Greatest Giver of all givers.
lines.transliteration: daanaa t oo beenaa t uhee d aanaa kai sir d aan.

lines.english: He is the Eradicator of poverty, and the Destroyer of pain; the Gurmukh realizesspiritual wisdom and meditation. ||35||
lines.transliteration: daalad  bhanjan d ukh dalan gurmukh  gi-aan Dh i-aan. ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਨ ਗਇਐ  ਬਿਹ ਝੂਰੀਐ  ਧਨ ਮਿਹ ਚੀਤੁ  ਗਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan ga-i-ai bahi jh ooree-ai Dh an meh cheet  gavaar. Losing his wealth, he cries out in anguish; the fool's consciousness is engrossed inwealth.
Dhan virlee sach sanchi-aa nirmal naam pi-aar. How rare are those who gather the wealth of Truth, and love the Immaculate Naam,the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਗਇਆ  ਤਾ ਜਾਣ  ਦੇਿਹ ਜੇ ਰਾਚਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਏਕ ॥
lines.english: Dhan ga-i-aa t aa jaan  deh jay raacheh rang ayk. If by losing your wealth, you may become absorbed in the Love of the One Lord, thenjust let it go.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਿਸਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ  ਭੀ ਕਰਤੇ  ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: Dedicate your mind, and surrender your head; seek only the Support of the CreatorLord.
lines.transliteration: man deejai sir sa-upee-ai bh ee kart ay kee tayk.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ  ਰਿਹ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa Dh aavat  reh ga-ay man meh sabad  anand. Worldly affairs and wanderings cease, when the mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਜਨ  ਤੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: Even one's enemies become friends, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: durjan t ay saajan bh a-ay bh aytay gur govind .

lines.punjabi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਿਫਰਤੀ  ਢੂਢਤੀ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਰਹੀ ਘਿਰ  ਬਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering from forest to forest searching, you will find that those things are withinthe home of your own heart.
lines.transliteration: ban ban firtee dh oodh-tee basat  rahee gh ar baar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਲੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ॥੩੬॥
lines.english: United by the True Guru, you shall remain united, and the pains of birth and death willbe ended. ||36||
lines.transliteration: satgur maylee mil rahee janam maran  dukh nivaar. ||36||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਕਰਤ  ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through various rituals, one does not find release. Without virtue, one is sent to theCity of Death.
lines.transliteration: naanaa karat na chh ootee-ai vin  gun jam pur jaahi.

lines.english: One will not have this world or the next; committing sinful mistakes, one comes to regret and repent in the end. pMnw 935
lines.transliteration: naa tis ayhu na oh hai avgun  fir pachh utaahi.

lines.english: He has neither spiritual wisdom or meditation; neither Dharmic faith mor meditation.
lines.transliteration: naa tis gi-aan na Dh i-aan hai naa t is Dharam Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Without the Name, how can one be fearless? How can he understand egotistical pride?
lines.transliteration: vin naavai nirbh a-o kahaa ki-aa jaan aa abh imaan.

lines.english: I am so tired - how can I get there? This ocean has no bottom or end.
lines.transliteration: thaak rahee kiv aprhaa haath nahee naa paar.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਿਕ  ਰਹੀ ਿਕਵ ਅਪੜਾ  ਹਾਥ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I have no loving companions, whom I can ask for help.
lines.transliteration: naa saajan say rangulay kis peh karee pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, crying out, "Beloved, Beloved", we are united with the Uniter.
lines.transliteration: naanak pari-o pari-o jay karee maylay maylanhaar.

lines.english: He who separated me, unites me again; my love for the Guru is infinite. ||37||
lines.transliteration: jin vichhorh ee so maylsee gur kai hayt  apaar. ||37||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਛੋੜੀ  ਸੋ ਮੇਲਸੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Sin is bad, but it is dear to the sinner.
lines.transliteration: paap buraa paapee ka-o pi-aaraa.

lines.english: He loads himself with sin, and expands his world through sin.
lines.transliteration: paap laday paapay paasaaraa.

lines.english: Sin is far away from one who understands himself.
lines.transliteration: parhar paap pachhaan ai aap.

lines.english: He is not afflicted by sorrow or separation.
lines.transliteration: naa tis sog vijog sant aap.

lines.english: How can one avoid falling into hell? How can he cheat the Messenger of Death?
lines.transliteration: narak parhaNta-o ki-o rahai ki-o banchai jamkaal.

lines.english: How can coming and going be forgotten? Falsehood is bad, and death is cruel.
lines.transliteration: ki-o aavan jaan aa veesrai jh ooth buraa kh ai kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਝੂਠੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: The mind is enveloped by entanglements, and into entanglements it falls.
lines.transliteration: man janjaalee vayrhi-aa bh ee janjaalaa maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੀ  ਵੇਿੜਆ  ਭੀ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, how can anyone be saved? They rot away in sin. ||38||
lines.transliteration: vin naavai ki-o chh ootee-ai paapay pacheh pachaahi. ||38||

lines.english: Again and again, the crow falls into the trap.
lines.transliteration: fir fir faahee faasai ka-oo-aa.

lines.english: Then he regrets it, but what can he do now?
lines.transliteration: fir pachhut aanaa ab ki-aa hoo-aa.

lines.english: Even though he is trapped, he pecks at the food; he does not understand.
lines.transliteration: faathaa chog chugai nahee boojhai.

lines.english: If he meets the True Guru, then he sees with his eyes.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a aakh ee soojh ai.

lines.english: Like a fish, he is caught in the noose of death.
lines.transliteration: ji-o machhulee faathee jam jaal.

lines.english: Do not seek liberation from anyone else, except the Guru, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: vin gur d aatay mukat  na bh aal.

lines.english: Over and over again, he comes; over and over again, he goes.
lines.transliteration: fir fir aavai fir fir jaa-ay.

lines.english: Be absorbed in love for the One Lord, and remain lovingly focused on Him.
lines.transliteration: ik rang rachai rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: In this way you shall be saved, and you shall not fall into the trap again. ||39||
lines.transliteration: iv chhootai fir faas na paa-ay. ||39||

lines.english: She calls out, "Brother, O brother - stay, O brother!" But he becomes a stranger.
lines.transliteration: beeraa beeraa kar rahee beer bha-ay bairaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਰਾ  ਬੀਰਾ  ਕਿਰ ਰਹੀ ਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Her brother departs for his own home, and his sister burns with the pain of separation.
lines.transliteration: beer chalay ghar aapn ai bahin  bireh jal jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਰ ਚਲੇ ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਬਿਹਣ  ਿਬਰਿਹ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In this world, her father's home, the daughter, the innocent soul bride, loves herYoung Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: baabul kai ghar baytrh ee baalee baalai nayhi.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੁਲ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਬੇਟੜੀ  ਬਾਲੀ  ਬਾਲੈ  ਨੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul bride, then serve the True Guru with love.
lines.transliteration: jay lorheh var kaamn ee sat gur sayveh t ayhi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: How rare are the spiritually wise, who meet the True Guru, and truly understand.
lines.transliteration: birlo gi-aanee boojh-n a-o sat gur saach milay-ay.

lines.english: All glorious greatness rests in the Lord and Master's Hands. He grants them, when Heis pleased.
lines.transliteration: thaakur haath vadaa-ee-aa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਵਡਾਈਆ  ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani; they becomeGurmukh.
lines.transliteration: banee birla-o beechaarsee jay ko gurmukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਬਰਲਉ  ਬੀਚਾਰਸੀ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: This is the Bani of the Supreme Being; through it, one dwells within the home of hisinner being. ||40||
lines.transliteration: ih banee mahaa purakh  kee nij gh ar vaasaa ho-ay. ||40||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ  ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ  ਕੀ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Shattering and breaking apart, He creates and re-creates; creating, He shatters again. He builds up what He has demolished, and demolishes what He has built.
lines.transliteration: bhan bh an gh arhee-ai gh arh gharh bhajai dh aahi usaarai usray dh aahai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਿਨ ਭਿਨ ਘੜੀਐ  ਘਿੜ  ਘਿੜ ਭਜੈ ਢਾਿਹ  ਉਸਾਰੈ  ਉਸਰੇ  ਢਾਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He dries up the pools which are full, and fills the dried tanks again. He is all-powerfuland independent.
lines.transliteration: sar bhar sokh ai bhee bh ar pokh ai samrath vayparvaahai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ ਭਿਰ ਸੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਭਿਰ ਪੋਖੈ ਸਮਰਥ  ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੈ  ॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, they have gone insane; without destiny, what do they obtain?
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaanay bh a-ay d ivaanay vin  bhaagaa ki-aa paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs know that God holds the string; wherever He pulls it, they must go.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan doree parabh  pakrh ee jin kh inchai t in jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, are forever imbued with His Love;they never again feel regret.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay sad aa rang raat ay bahurh  na pachh otaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Bhabha: If someone seeks, and then becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to dwell inthe home of his own heart.
lines.transliteration: bhabh ai bhaaleh gurmukh  boojh eh taa nij gh ar vaasaa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਤਾ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Bhabha: The way of the terrifying world-ocean is treacherous. Remain free of hope, inthe midst of hope, and you shall cross over.
lines.transliteration: bhabh ai bha-ojal maarag vikh -rhaa aas niraasaa t aree-ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand himself; in this way, he remains dead whileyet alive. ||41||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aapo cheenHai jeevti-aa iv maree-ai. ||41||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਆਪੋ  ਚੀਨੈ ਜੀਵਿਤਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ  ॥੪੧॥
lines.english: Crying out for the wealth and riches of Maya, they die; but Maya does not go alongwith them.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa maa-i-aa kar mu-ay maa-i-aa kisai na saath.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਮੁਏ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-swan arises and departs, sad and depressed, leaving its wealth behind.
lines.transliteration: hans chalai uth dumn o maa-i-aa bh oolee aath.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲੈ ਉਿਠ ਡੁਮਣੋ ਮਾਇਆ  ਭੂਲੀ ਆਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: The false mind is hunted by the Messenger of Death; it carries its faults along when itgoes.
lines.transliteration: man jhooth aa jam johi-aa avgun  chaleh naal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਿਮ ਜੋਿਹਆ  ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The mind turns inward, and merges with mind, when it is with virtue. pMnw 936
lines.transliteration: man meh man ulto marai jay gun hoveh naal.

lines.english: Crying out, "Mine, mine!", they have died, but without the Name, they find only pain.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kar mu-ay vin naavai d ukh bhaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਮੁਏ ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: So where are their forts, mansions, palaces and courts? They are like a short story.
lines.transliteration: garh mand ar mehlaa kahaa ji-o baajee d eebaan .

lines.punjabi: ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ਕਹਾ ਿਜਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, the false just come and go.
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam vin jh oothaa aavan  jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਣੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is clever and so very beautiful; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||42||
lines.transliteration: aapay chatur saroop hai aapay jaan  sujaan . ||42||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥੪੨॥
lines.english: Those who come, must go in the end; they come and go, regretting and repenting.
lines.transliteration: jo aavahi say jaahi fun aa-ay ga-ay pachhut aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਆਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਾਿਹ  ਫੁਿਨ ਆਇ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They will pass through 8.4 millions species; this number does not decrease or rise.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh mayd nee gh atai na vaDh ai utaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਉਤਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are saved, who love the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say jan ubray jin har bhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: DhanDh aa mu-aa vigoot ee maa-i-aa. Their worldly entanglements are ended, and Maya is conquered.
Whoever is seen, shall depart; who should I make my friend?
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so chaalsee kis ka-o meet  karay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਾਲਸੀ  ਿਕਸ ਕਉ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੇਉ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my soul, and place my body and mind in offering before Him.
lines.transliteration: jee-o sampa-o aapnaa t an man aagai d ay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਸਮਪਉ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਦੇਉ ॥
lines.english: You are eternally stable, O Creator, Lord and Master; I lean on Your Support.
lines.transliteration: asthir kartaa t oo Dh anee tis hee kee mai ot.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਓਟ ॥
lines.english: Conquered by virtue, egotism is killed; imbued with the Word of the Shabad, the mind rejects the world. ||43||
lines.transliteration: gun kee maaree ha-o mu-ee sabad  ratee man chot. ||43||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੀ ਮਿਨ ਚੋਟ ॥੪੩॥
lines.english: Neither the kings nor the nobles will remain; neither the rich nor the poor will remain.
lines.transliteration: raanaa raa-o na ko rahai rang na t ung fakeer.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਣਾ  ਰਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੁੰਗੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: When one's turn comes, no one can stay here.
lines.transliteration: vaaree aapo aapnee ko-ay na banDh ai Dheer.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰੀ  ਆਪੋ  ਆਪਣੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
lines.english: The path is difficult and treacherous; the pools and mountains are impassable.
lines.transliteration: raahu buraa bheehaavalaa sar doogar asgaah.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ  ਸਰ ਡੂਗਰ  ਅਸਗਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: My body is filled with faults; I am dying of grief. Without virtue, how can I enter my home?
lines.transliteration: mai tan avgan  jhur mu-ee vin  gun ki-o gh ar jaah.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤਿਨ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਝੁਿਰ ਮੁਈ ਿਵਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਿਕਉ  ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਹ ॥
lines.english: The virtuous take virtue, and meet God; how can I meet them with love?
lines.transliteration: gunee-aa gun  lay parabh  milay ki-o t in mila-o pi-aar.

lines.english: If ony I could be like them, chanting and meditating within my heart on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tin hee jaisee thee rahaaN jap jap rid ai muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਿਰਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He is overflowing with faults and demer its, but virtue dwells within him as well.
lines.transliteration: avgunee bh arpoor hai gun  bhee vaseh naal.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗੁਣੀ  ਭਰਪੂਰ  ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੀ ਵਸਿਹ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, he does not see God's Virtues; he does not chant the Glorious Virtues of God. ||44||
lines.transliteration: vin sat gur gun  na jaapnee jichar sabad  na karay beechaar. ||44||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪੪॥
lines.english: God's soldiers take care of their homes; their pay is pre-ordained, before they comeinto the world.
lines.transliteration: laskaree-aa ghar sammlay aa-ay vajahu likh aa-ay.

lines.english: They serve their Supreme Lord and Master, and obtain the profit.
lines.transliteration: kaar kamaaveh sir Dhan ee laahaa palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਧਣੀ ਲਾਹਾ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They renounce greed, avarice and evil, and forget them from their minds.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh buri-aa-ee-aa chh oday manhu visaar.

lines.english: In the fortress of the body, they announce the victory of their Supreme King; they are never ever vanquished.
lines.transliteration: garh d ohee paat isaah kee kad ay na aavai haar.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿੜ  ਦੋਹੀ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who calls himself a servant of his Lord and Master, and yet speaks defiantly toHim,
lines.transliteration: chaakar kahee-ai khasam kaa sa-uhay ut ar day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਸਉਹੇ  ਉਤਰ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vajahu gavaa-ay aapnaa t akhat na baiseh say-ay. shall forfeit his pay, and not be seated upon the throne.

lines.punjabi: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਤਖਿਤ  ਨ ਬੈਸਿਹ  ਸੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Beloved; He gives, according to thePleasure of His Will.
lines.transliteration: pareetam hath vad i-aa-ee-aa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਹਿਥ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself does everything; who else should we address? No one else does anything.||45||
lines.transliteration: aap karay kis aakhee-ai avar na ko-ay karay-i. ||45||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੪੫॥
lines.english: I cannot conceive of any other, who could be seated upon the royal cushions.
lines.transliteration: beeja-o soojhai ko nahee bahai d uleechaa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਜਉ  ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹੈ ਦੁਲੀਚਾ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Man of men eradicates hell; He is True, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: narak nivaaran narah nar saacha-o saachai naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ  ਿਨਵਾਰਣੁ  ਨਰਹ  ਨਰੁ ਸਾਚਉ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I wandered around searching for Him in the forests and meadows; I contemplate Himwithin my mind.
lines.transliteration: van tarin dhoodhat fir rahee man meh kara-o beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਣੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਣੁ  ਢੂਢਤ ਿਫਿਰ ਰਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਰਉ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The treasures of myriads of pearls, jewels and emeralds are in the hands of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: laal ratan baho maan kee sat gur haath bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਰਤਨ  ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with God, I am exalted and elevated; I love the One Lord single-mindedly.
lines.transliteration: ootam hovaa parabh  milai ik man aykai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਊਤਮੁ  ਹੋਵਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who lovingly meets with his Beloved, earns profit in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: naanak pareetam ras milay laahaa lai parthaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਰਿਸ ਿਮਲੇ ਲਾਹਾ  ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He who created and formed the creation, made your form as well.
lines.transliteration: rachnaa raach jin rachee jin siri-aa aakaar.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Infinite Lord, who has no end or limitation. ||46||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bay-ant  Dhi-aa-ee-ai ant  na paaraavaar. ||46||

lines.english: Rharha: The Dear Lord is beautiful;
lines.transliteration: rhaarh ai roorh aa har jee-o so-ee.

lines.english: There is no other king, except Him.
lines.transliteration: tis bin raajaa avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: Rharha: Listen to the spell, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.
lines.transliteration: rhaarh ai gaarurh  tum sun hu har vasai man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ੜਾੜੈ ਗਾਰੁੜੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one finds the Lord; do not be deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har paa-ee-ai mat ko bh aram bh ulaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is the true banker, who has the capital of the wealth of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so saahu saachaa jis har Dhan raas.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is perfect - applaud him!
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pooraa t is saabaas.

lines.english: Through the beautiful Word of the Guru's Bani, the Lord is obtained; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. pMnw 937
lines.transliteration: roorhee ban ee har paa-i-aa gur sabd ee beechaar.

lines.english: Self-conceit is eliminated, and pain is eradicated; the soul bride obtains her Husband Lord. ||47||
lines.transliteration: aap ga-i-aa dukh  kati-aa har var paa-i-aa naar. ||47||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਿਰ  ॥੪੭॥
lines.english: He hoards gold and silver, but this wealth is false and poisonous, nothing more thanashes.
lines.transliteration: su-inaa rupaa sanchee-ai Dhan kaachaa bikh  chhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ  ਧਨੁ ਕਾਚਾ  ਿਬਖੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He calls himself a banker, gathering wealth, but he is ruined by his dual-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: saahu sadaa-ay sanch Dh an dubiDh aa ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁ ਸਦਾਏ  ਸੰਿਚ ਧਨੁ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The truthful ones gather Truth; the True Name is priceless.
lines.transliteration: sachi-aaree sach sanchi-aa saacha-o naam amol.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚਆਰੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ  ਸਾਚਉ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is immaculate and pure; through Him, their honor is true, and their speech istrue.
lines.transliteration: har nirmaa-il oojlo pat saachee sach bol.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਾਇਲੁ  ਊਜਲੋ  ਪਿਤ ਸਾਚੀ  ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
lines.english: You are my friend and companion, all-knowing Lord; You are the lake, and You are the swan.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sujaan  too too sarvar t oo hans.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਤੂ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that being, whose mind is filled with the True Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: saacha-o thaakur man vasai ha-o balihaaree t is.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਉ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Know the One who created love and attachment to Maya, the Enticer.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mamtaa mohn ee jin keet ee so jaan .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਮੋਹਣੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: One who realizes the all-knowing Primal Lord, looks alike upon poison and nectar.||48||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa amrit  ayk hai boojh ai purakh  sujaan . ||48||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥੪੮॥
lines.english: Without patience and forgiveness, countless hundreds of thousands have perished.
lines.transliteration: khimaa vihoon ay kh ap ga-ay kh oohan  lakh asaNkh.

lines.english: Their numbers cannot be counted; how could I count them? Bothered and bewildered,uncounted numbers have died.
lines.transliteration: ganat  na aavai ki-o gan ee kh ap kh ap mu-ay bisankh .

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਕਉ  ਗਣੀ  ਖਿਪ ਖਿਪ ਮੁਏ ਿਬਸੰਖ  ॥
lines.english: One who realizes his Lord and Master is set free, and not bound by chains.
lines.transliteration: khasam pachh aanai aapn aa kh oolai banDh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਖੂਲੈ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; you shallbe blessed with patience, forgiveness, truth and peace.
lines.transliteration: sabad mahlee kh araa t oo kh imaa sach sukh  bhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ ਮਹਲੀ  ਖਰਾ ਤੂ ਿਖਮਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Partake of the true wealth of meditation, and the Lord Himself shall abide within yourbody.
lines.transliteration: kharach kh araa Dh an Dh i-aan t oo aapay vaseh sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਖਰਚੁ  ਖਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਸਰੀਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: With mind, body and mouth, chant His Glorious Virtues forever; courage and composure shall enter deep within your mind.
lines.transliteration: man tan mukh  jaapai sad aa gun  antar man Dh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਿਨ ਧੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Through egotism, one is distracted and ruined; other than the Lord, all things arecorrupt.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai khapai kh apaa-isee beeja-o vath vikaar.

lines.english: Forming His creatures, He placed Himself within them; the Creator is unattached andinfinite. ||49||
lines.transliteration: jant upaa-ay vich paa-i-an kart aa alag apaar. ||49||

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਵਿਚ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਅਲਗੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੪੯॥
lines.english: No one knows the mystery of the Creator of the World.
lines.transliteration: saristay bhay-o na jaan ai ko-ay.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator of the World does, is certain to occur.
lines.transliteration: saristaa karai so nihcha-o ho-ay.

lines.english: For wealth, some meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sampai ka-o eesar Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By pre-ordained destiny, wealth is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sampai purab likhay kee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: For the sake of wealth, some become servants or thieves.
lines.transliteration: sampai kaaran chaakar chor.

lines.english: Wealth does not go along with them when they die; it passes into the hands ofothers.
lines.transliteration: sampai saath na chaalai hor.

lines.english: Without Truth, honor is not obtained in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin saachay nahee dargeh maan.

lines.english: Drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord, one is emancipated in the end. ||50||
lines.transliteration: har ras peevai chhutai nid aan. ||50||

lines.english: Seeing and perceiving, O my companions, I am wonder-struck and amazed.
lines.transliteration: hayrat hayrat  hay sakh ee ho-ay rahee hairaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇਰਤ  ਹੇਰਤ  ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: My egotism, which proclaimed itself in possessiveness and self-conceit, is dead. My mind chants the Word of the Shabad, and attains spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o kartee mai mu-ee sabad  ravai man gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ  ਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਵੈ ਮਿਨ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: I am so tired of wearing all these necklaces, hair-ties and bracelets, and decoratingmyself.
lines.transliteration: haar dor kankan ghan ay kar thaakee seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਕੰਕਨ  ਘਣੇ ਕਿਰ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; now, I wear the necklace of totalvirtue.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam sukh  paa-i-aa sagal gun aa gal haar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਗਿਲ  ਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the Lord, with love and affection.
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paa-ee-ai har si-o pareet  pi-aar.

lines.english: Without the Lord, who has found peace? Reflect upon this in your mind, and see.
lines.transliteration: har bin kin sukh paa-i-aa d aykhhu man beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Read about the Lord, understand the Lord, and enshrine love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har parh-n aa har bujh -naa har si-o rakh ahu pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੜਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਬੁਝਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on the Lord; hold tight to the Support of the Name of the Lord. ||51||
lines.transliteration: har japee-ai har Dhi-aa-ee-ai har kaa naam aDh aar. ||51||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੫੧॥
lines.english: The inscription inscribed by the Creator Lord cannot be erased, O my companions.
lines.transliteration: laykh na mit-ee hay sakh ee jo likh i-aa kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜੋ ਿਲਿਖਆ ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He who created the universe, in His Mercy, installs His Feet within us.
lines.transliteration: aapay kaaran jin kee-aa kar kirpaa pag Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪਗੁ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Glorious greatness rests in the Hands of the Creator; reflect upon the Guru, andunderstand this.
lines.transliteration: kartay hath vad i-aa-ee-aa boojh hu gur beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤੇ  ਹਿਥ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: This inscription cannot be challenged. As it pleases You, You care for me.
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa fayr na sakee-ai ji-o bh aavee t i-o saar.

lines.english: By Your Glance of Grace, I have found peace; O Nanak, reflect upon the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: nadar t ayree sukh  paa-i-aa naanak sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are confused; they rot away and die. Only by reflectingupon the Guru can they be saved.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay pach mu-ay ubray gur beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭੂਲੇ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਉਬਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: What can anyone say, about that Primal Lord, who cannot be seen?
lines.transliteration: je purakh nad ar na aavee t is kaa ki-aa kar kahi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਹਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has revealed Him to me, within my own heart. ||52||
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay jin hird ai ditaa dikhaa-ay. ||52||

lines.english: That Pandit, that religious scholar, is said to be well-educated, if he contemplates knowledge with intuitive ease. pMnw 938
lines.transliteration: paaDhaa parh i-aa aakh ee-ai bid i-aa bichrai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Considering his knowledge, he finds the essence of reality, and lovingly focuses his attention on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bidi-aa soDh ai tat lahai raam naam liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਦਆ  ਸੋਧੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh sells his knowledge; he earns poison, and eats poison.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bid i-aa bikard aa bikh  khatay bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.english: The fool does not think of the Word of the Shabad. He has no understanding, nocomprehension. ||53||
lines.transliteration: moorakh sabad  na cheen-ee soojh  boojh  nah kaa-ay. ||53||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨਈ  ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨਹ ਕਾਇ  ॥੫੩॥
lines.english: That Pandit is called Gurmukh, who imparts understanding to his students.
lines.transliteration: paaDhaa gurmukh  aakh ee-ai chaatrh i-aa mat  day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਧਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਖੀਐ  ਚਾਟਿੜਆ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; gather in the Naam, and earn the trueprofit in this world.
lines.transliteration: naam samaalahu naam sangrahu laahaa jag meh lay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਰਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: With the true notebook of the true mind, study the most sublime Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachee patee sach man parhee-ai sabad  so saar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਪਟੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਪੜੀਐ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is learned, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who wears the necklaceof the Lord's Name. ||54||1|| rwmklI mhlw 1 isD gosit  (938-5) raamkalee mehlaa 1 siDh gosat Raamkalee, First Mehl, Sidh Gosht ~ Conversations With The Siddhas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (938-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak so parhi-aa so pandit  beenaa jis raam naam gal haar. ||54||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਿੜਆ  ਸੋ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਿਲ  ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Siddhas formed an assembly; sitting in their Yogic postures, they shouted, "Salute this gathering of Saints."
lines.transliteration: siDh sabh aa kar aasan  baith ay sant  sabh aa jaikaaro.

lines.english: I offer my salutation to the One who is true, infinite and incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: tis aagai rahraas hamaaree saachaa apar apaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਭਾ ਕਿਰ ਆਸਿਣ  ਬੈਠੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: I cut off my head, and offer it to Him; I dedicate my body and mind to Him.
lines.transliteration: mastak kaat Dh aree t is aagai t an man aagai d ay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਰਹਰਾਿਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with the Saints, Truth is obtained, and one is spontaneouslyblessed with distinction. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sant milai sach paa-ee-ai sahj bh aa-ay jas lay-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਤਕੁ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਧਰੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਦੇਉ ॥
lines.english: What is the use of wandering around? Purity comes only through Truth.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa bhavee-ai sach soochaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਹਜ  ਭਾਇ  ਜਸੁ ਲੇਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one finds liberation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saach sabad bin mukat  na ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: "Who are you? What is your name? What is your way? What is your goal?
lines.transliteration: kavan tumay ki-aa naa-o t umaaraa ka-un maarag ka-un su-aa-o.

lines.english: We pray that you will answer us truthfully; we are a sacrifice to the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: saach kaha-o ardaas hamaaree ha-o sant  janaa bal jaa-o.

lines.english: Where is your seat? Where do you live, boy? Where did you come from, and whereare you going?
lines.transliteration: kah baishu kah rahee-ai baalay kah aavhu kah jaaho.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਤੁਮੇ ਿਕਆ ਨਾਉ  ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਆਓ  ॥
lines.english: Tell us, Nanak - the detached Siddhas wait to hear your reply. What is yourpath?"||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai sun bairaagee ki-aa t umaaraa raaho. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਉ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਹਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਓ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells deep within the nucleus of each and every heart. This is my seat and myhome. I walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at bais nirant ar rahee-ai chaaleh sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹ ਰਹੀਐ  ਬਾਲੇ  ਕਹ ਆਵਹੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਹੋ ॥
lines.english: I came from the Celestial Lord God; I go wherever He orders me to go. I am Nanak,forever under the Command of His Will.
lines.transliteration: sehjay aa-ay hukam siDhaa-ay naanak sad aa rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਿਣ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਰਾਹੋ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I sit in the posture of the eternal, imperishable Lord. These are the Teachings I havereceived from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: aasan baisan  thir naaraa-in  aisee gurmat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਬੈਿਸ ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਚਾਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have come to understand and realize myself; I merge in the Truest ofthe True. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai aap pachh aanai sachay sach samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਆਏ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਿਸਧਾਏ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: "The world-ocean is treacherous and impassable; how can one cross over?
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa saagar d utar kahee-ai ki-o kar paa-ee-ai paaro.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਿਣ  ਬੈਸਿਣ  ਿਥਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਐਸੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Charpat the Yogi says, O Nanak, think it over, and give us your true reply."
lines.transliteration: charpat bolai a-oDhoo naanak d ayh sachaa beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What answer can I give to someone, who claims to understand himself?
lines.transliteration: aapay aakhai aapay samjh ai tis ki-aa ut ar deejai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: I speak the Truth; if you have already crossed over, how can I argue with you? ||4||
lines.transliteration: saach kahhu tum paargaraamee t ujh ki-aa baisan  deejai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਪਟੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅਉਧੂ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੇਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The lotus flower floats untouched upon the surface of the water, and the duck swims through the stream;
lines.transliteration: jaisay jal meh kamal niraalam murgaa-ee nai saanay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਖੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਮਝੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਕਆ  ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: surat sabad  bhav saagar t aree-ai naanak naam vakh aanay. with one's consciousness focused on the Word of the Shabad, one crosses over theterrifying world-ocean. O Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ  ਤੁਝੁ ਿਕਆ  ਬੈਸਣੁ  ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: One who lives alone, as a hermit, enshrining the One Lord in his mind, remainingunaffected by hope in the midst of hope,
lines.transliteration: raheh ikaaNt ayko man vasi-aa aasaa maahi niraaso.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਮੁਰਗਾਈ  ਨੈ ਸਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar daykh  dikhaa-ay naanak t aa kaa d aaso. ||5|| sees and inspires others to see the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord. Nanak is hisslave. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: "Listen, Lord, to our prayer. We seek your true opinion.
lines.transliteration: sun su-aamee ard aas hamaaree poochh a-o saach beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਿਹ  ਇਕਿਤ  ਏਕੋ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਆਸਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਰਾਸੋ  ॥
lines.english: Don't be angry with us - please tell us: How can we find the Guru's Door?"
lines.transliteration: ros na keejai utar d eejai ki-o paa-ee-ai gur d u-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਿਦਖਾਏ  ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੫॥
lines.english: This fickle mind sits in its true home, O Nanak, through the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih man chalta-o sach gh ar baisai naanak naam aDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਪੂਛਉ  ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself unites us in Union, and inspires us to love the Truth. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaa-ay kartaa laagai saach pi-aaro. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ  ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਕਉ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: "Away from stores and highways, we live in the woods, among plants and trees.
lines.transliteration: haatee baatee raheh niraalay rookh birakh  udi-aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤਉ  ਸਚ ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: For food, we take fruits and roots. This is the spiritual wisdom spoken by the renunciates. pMnw 939
lines.transliteration: kand mool ahaaro kh aa-ee-ai a-oDh oo bolai gi-aanay.

lines.english: We bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and obtain the fruits of peace; not even an iota of filth sticks to us.
lines.transliteration: tirath naa-ee-ai sukh  fal paa-ee-ai mail na laagai kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਈਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Luhaareepaa, the disciple of Gorakh says, this is the Way of Yoga."||7||
lines.transliteration: gorakh poot  lohaareepaa bolai jog jugat  biDh saa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਰਖ  ਪੂਤੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੀਪਾ  ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਸਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: In the stores and on the road, do not sleep; do not let your consciousness covetanyone else's home.
lines.transliteration: haatee baatee need na aavai par gh ar chit  na dolaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਟੀ  ਬਾਟੀ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਪਰ ਘਿਰ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਨ ਡਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, the mind has no firm support; O Nanak, this hunger never departs.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai man tayk na tik-ee naanak bhookh  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਿਟਕਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has revealed the stores and the city within the home of my own heart, where I intuitively carry on the true trade.
lines.transliteration: haat patan gh ar guroo d ikhaa-i-aa sehjay sach vaapaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਟੁ ਪਟਣੁ  ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Sleep little, and eat little; O Nanak, this is the essence of wisdom. ||8||
lines.transliteration: khandit  nidraa alap ahaaraN naanak t at beechaaro. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਿਡਤ  ਿਨਦਰ੍ਾ  ਅਲਪ  ਅਹਾਰੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: "Wear the robes of the sect of Yogis who follow Gorakh; put on the ear-rings, beggingwallet and patched coat.
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aykh karahu jogind araa mund raa jh olee kh inthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋਿਗੰਦਰ੍ਾ  ਮੁੰਦਰ੍ਾ ਝੋਲੀ  ਿਖੰਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: Among the twelve schools of Yoga, ours is the highest; among the six schools ofphilosophy, ours is the best path.
lines.transliteration: baarah antar ayk sarayvhu kh at darsan ik panthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰਹ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ  ਇਕ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
lines.english: This is the way to instruct the mind, so you will never suffer beatings again."
lines.transliteration: in biDh man samjaa-ee-ai purkh aa baahurh  chot na kh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ  ਪੁਰਖਾ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks: the Gurmukh understands; this is the way that Yoga is attained. ||9||
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai gurmukh boojh ai jog jugat  iv paa-ee-ai. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Let constant absorption in the Word of the Shabad deep within be your ear-rings;eradicate egotism and attachment.
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  nirant ar mud raa ha-umai mamt aa door karee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਮੁਦਰ੍ਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Discard sexual desire, anger and egotism, and through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, attain true understanding.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar nivaarai gur kai sabad  so samajh  paree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਿਨਵਾਰੈ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁ ਸਮਝ  ਪਰੀ ॥
lines.english: For your patched coat and begging bowl, see the Lord God pervading and permeating everywhere; O Nanak, the One Lord will carry you across.
lines.transliteration: khinthaa jh olee bh aripur rahi-aa naanak t aarai ayk haree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਝੋਲੀ  ਭਿਰਪੁਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.english: True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Name. Analyze it, and you shall find theWord of the Guru to be True. ||10||
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib saachee naa-ee parkhai gur kee baat  kharee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਨਾਈ  ਪਰਖੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਖਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Let your mind turn away in detachment from the world, and let this be your beggingbowl. Let the lessons of the five elements be your cap.
lines.transliteration: ooNDha-o kh apar panch bh oo topee.

lines.english: Let the body be your meditation mat, and the mind your loin cloth.
lines.transliteration: kaaN-i-aa karhaasan  man jaagotee.

lines.english: Let truth, contentment and self-discipline be your companions.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh sanjam hai naal.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh dwells on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam samaal. ||11||

lines.english: "Who is hidden? Who is liberated?
lines.transliteration: kavan so guptaa kavan so mukt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਪਤਾ  ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Who is united, inwardly and outwardly?
lines.transliteration: kavan so antar baahar jugt aa.

lines.english: Who comes, and who goes?
lines.transliteration: kavan so aavai kavan so jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ  ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Who is permeating and pervading the three worlds?"||12||
lines.transliteration: kavan so taribh avan rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||12||

lines.english: He is hidden within each and every heart. The Gurmukh is liberated.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at gupt aa gurmukh  mukt aa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, one is united, inwardly and outwardly.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sabad  so jugt aa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh perishes, and comes and goes.
lines.transliteration: manmukh binsai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||13||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh saach samaa-ay. ||13||

lines.english: "How is one placed in bondage, and consumed by the serpent of Maya?
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar baaDhaa sarpan kh aaDhaa.

lines.english: How does one lose, and how does one gain?
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar kho-i-aa ki-o kar laaDh aa.

lines.english: How does one become immaculate and pure? How is the darkness of ignorance removed?
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar nirmal ki-o kar anDhi-aaraa.

lines.english: One who understands this essence of reality is our Guru."||14||
lines.transliteration: ih tat beechaarai so guroo hamaaraa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Man is bound by evil-mindedness, and consumed by Maya, the serpent.
lines.transliteration: durmat  baaDh aa sarpan kh aaDhaa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh loses, and the Gurmukh gains.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kh o-i-aa gurmukh  laaDh aa.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai anDh ayraa jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, eradicating egotism, one merges in the Lord. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai mayt samaa-ay. ||15||

lines.english: Focused deep within, in perfect absorption,
lines.transliteration: sunn nirantar d eejai banDh .
udai na hansaa parhai na kanDh . the soul-swan does not fly away, and the body-wall does not collapse.

lines.punjabi: ਉਡੈ ਨ ਹੰਸਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Then, one knows that his true home is in the cave of intuitive poise.
lines.transliteration: sahj gufaa ghar jaan ai saachaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord loves those who are truthful. ||16||
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay bhaavai saachaa. ||16||

lines.english: "Why have you left your house and become a wandering Udaasee?
lines.transliteration: kis kaaran garihu t aji-o ud aasee.

lines.english: Why have you adopted these religious robes?
lines.transliteration: kis kaaran ih bh aykh nivaasee.

lines.english: What merchandise do you trade?
lines.transliteration: kis vakhar kay t um van jaaray.

lines.english: How will you carry others across with you?"||17||
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar saath langhaavahu paaray. ||17||

lines.english: I became a wandering Udaasee, searching for the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kh ojat bha-ay ud aasee.

lines.english: I have adopted these robes seeking the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan kai t aa-ee bh aykh nivaasee.

lines.english: I trade in the merchandise of Truth.
lines.transliteration: saach vakhar kay ham van jaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I carry others across. ||18||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ut ras paaray. ||18||

lines.english: "How have you changed the course of your life?
lines.transliteration: kit biDh  purkh aa janam vataa-i-aa.

lines.english: With what have you linked your mind? pMnw 940
lines.transliteration: kaahay ka-o tujh  ih man laa-i-aa.

lines.english: How have you subdued your hopes and desires?
lines.transliteration: kit biDh  aasaa mansaa kh aa-ee.

lines.english: How have you found the Light deep within your nucleus?
lines.transliteration: kit biDh  jot nirant ar paa-ee.

lines.english: Without teeth, how can you eat iron?
lines.transliteration: bin dant aa ki-o kh aa-ee-ai saar.

lines.english: Give us your true opinion, Nanak."||19||
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa karahu beechaar. ||19||

lines.english: Born into the House of the True Guru, my wandering in reincarnation ended.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai janmay gavan mitaa-i-aa.

lines.english: My mind is attached and attuned to the unstruck sound current.
lines.transliteration: anhat raat ay ih man laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, my hopes and desires have been burnt away.
lines.transliteration: mansaa aasaa sabad jalaa-ee.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I found the Light deep within the nucleus of my self.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jot  nirant ar paa-ee.

lines.english: Eradicating the three qualities, one eats iron.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maytay kh aa-ee-ai saar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates. ||20||
lines.transliteration: naanak taaray t aaran haar. ||20||

lines.english: "What can you tell us about the beginning? In what home did the absolute dwell then?
lines.transliteration: aad ka-o kavan beechaar kathee-alay sunn kahaa gh ar vaaso.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਕਉ ਕਵਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ  ਸੁੰਨ ਕਹਾ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
lines.english: What are the ear-rings of spiritual wisdom? Who dwells in each and every heart?
lines.transliteration: gi-aan kee mudraa kavan kathee-alay gh at ghat kavan nivaaso.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਕੀ ਮੁਦਰ੍ਾ ਕਵਨ  ਕਥੀਅਲੇ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਕਵਨ  ਿਨਵਾਸੋ  ॥
lines.english: How can one avoid the attack of death? How can one enter the home of fearlessness?
lines.transliteration: kaal kaa theegaa ki-o jalaa-ee-alay ki-o nirbh a-o gh ar jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਕਾ ਠੀਗਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਜਲਾਈਅਲੇ  ਿਕਉ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: How can one know the posture of intuition and contentment, and overcome one'sadversaries?"
lines.transliteration: sahj santokh  kaa aasan  jaanai ki-o chh ayday bairaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਕਾ ਆਸਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਕਉ  ਛੇਦੇ ਬੈਰਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism and corruption are conquered, andthen one comes to dwell in the home of the self within.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ha-umai bikh  maarai t aa nij gh ar hovai vaaso.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
lines.english: One who realizes the Shabad of the One who created the creation - Nanak is hisslave. ||21||
lines.transliteration: jin rach rachi-aa tis sabad  pachh aanai naanak t aa kaa d aaso. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਿਚ ਰਿਚਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: "Where did we come from? Where are we going? Where will we be absorbed?
lines.transliteration: kahaa tay aavai kahaa ih jaavai kahaa ih rahai samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ  ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who reveals the meaning of this Shabad is the Guru, who has no greed at all.
lines.transliteration: ays sabad ka-o jo arthaavai t is gur t il na t amaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਸੁ ਸਬਦ  ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: How can one find the essence of the unmanifest reality? How does one becomeGurmukh, and enshrine love for the Lord?
lines.transliteration: ki-o tat ai avigat ai paavai gurmukh  lagai pi-aaro.

lines.english: He Himself is consciousness, He Himself is the Creator; share with us, Nanak, your wisdom."
lines.transliteration: aapay surtaa aapay kart aa kaho naanak beechaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: By His Command we come, and by His Command we go; by His Command, we mergein absorption.
lines.transliteration: hukmay aavai hukmay jaavai hukmay rahai samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, live the Truth; through the Word of the Shabad, the stateof dignity is attained. ||22||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay saach kamaavai gat  mit sabd ay paa-ee. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: We can only express a sense of wonder about the beginning. The absolute abidedendlessly deep within Himself then.
lines.transliteration: aad ka-o bismaad  beechaar kathee-alay sunn nirant ar vaas lee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਕਉ ਿਬਸਮਾਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ  ਸੁੰਨ ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Consider freedom from desire to be the ear-rings of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. TheTrue Lord, the Soul of all, dwells within each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: akalpat mud raa gur gi-aan beechaaree-alay gh at ghat saachaa sarab jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਲਪਤ  ਮੁਦਰ੍ਾ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਅਲੇ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, one merges in the absolute, and intuitively receives theimmaculate essence.
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee avigat samaa-ee-ai t at niranjan sahj lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਅਿਵਗਿਤ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ਤਤੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that Sikh who seeks and finds the Way does not serve any other.
lines.transliteration: naanak doojee kaar na karn ee sayvai sikh  so kh oj lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸੇਵੈ ਿਸਖੁ ਸੁ ਖੋਿਜ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Wonderful and amazing is His Command; He alone realizes His Command and knowsthe true way of life of His creatures.
lines.transliteration: hukam bismaad hukam pachh aanai jee-a jugat  sach jaan ai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਿਬਸਮਾਦੁ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੁਗਿਤ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: One who eradicates his self-conceit becomes free of desire; he alone is a Yogi, who enshrines the True Lord deep within. ||23||
lines.transliteration: aap mayt niraalam hovai antar saach jogee kahee-ai so-ee. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਮੇਿਟ ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਾਚੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਸੋਈ ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: From His state of absolute existence, He assumed the immaculate form; fromformless, He assumed the supreme form.
lines.transliteration: avigato nirmaa-il upjay nirgun  tay sargun  thee-aa.

lines.english: By pleasing the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained, and one is absorbed in theTrue Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur parchai param pad  paa-ee-ai saachai sabad  samaa-ay lee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰਚੈ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He knows the True Lord as the One and only; he sends his egotism and duality faraway.
lines.transliteration: aykay ka-o sach aykaa jaanai ha-umai d oojaa d oor kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਏਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a Yogi, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the lotus of the heartblossoms forth within.
lines.transliteration: so jogee gur sabad pachh aanai ant ar kamal pargaas thee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ ਥੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: If one remains dead while yet alive, then he understands everything; he knows theLord deep within himself, who is kind and compassionate to all.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai t aa sabh  kichh  soojh ai ant ar jaan ai sarab d a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਰਬ  ਦਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he realizes himself in all beings. ||24||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ka-o milai vadaa-ee aap pachh aanai sarab jee-aa. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: We emerge from Truth, and merge into Truth again. The pure being merges into theOne True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachou upjai saach samaavai saachay soochay ayk ma-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੌ ਉਪਜੈ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਏਕ ਮਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The false come, and find no place of rest; in duality, they come and go.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ay aavahi th avar na paavahi d oojai aavaa ga-on  bha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੇ ਆਵਿਹ  ਠਵਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਦੂਜੈ ਆਵਾ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This coming and going in reincarnation is ended through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Lord Himself analyzes and grants His forgiveness.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on mitai gur sabd ee aapay parkh ai bakh as la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਾ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਿਮਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਰਖੈ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who suffers from the disease of duality, forgets the Naam, the source of nectar. pMnw 941
lines.transliteration: aykaa baydan d oojai bi-aapee naam rasaa-in  veesri-aa.

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is liberated.
lines.transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujh aa-ay gur kai sabad  so mukat  bha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates one who drives out egotism and duality.||25||
lines.transliteration: naanak taaray t aaran haaraa ha-umai d oojaa parhari-aa. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਪਰਹਿਰਆ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, under the shadow of death.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolai jam kee kaan .

lines.english: They look into the homes of others, and lose.
lines.transliteration: par ghar johai haan ay haan .

lines.english: The manmukhs are confused by doubt, wandering in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aram bh avai baybaan .

lines.english: Having lost their way, they are plundered; they chant their mantras at cremation grounds.
lines.transliteration: vaymaarag moosai mantar masaan .

lines.english: They do not think of the Shabad; instead, they utter obscenities.
lines.transliteration: sabad na cheenai lavai kubaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth know peace. ||26||
lines.transliteration: naanak saach ratay sukh  jaan. ||26||

lines.english: The Gurmukh lives in the Fear of God, the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachay kaa bh a-o paavai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Gurmukh refines the unrefined.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ban ee agh arh gharhaavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh sings the immaculate, Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nirmal har gun  gaavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh attains the supreme, sanctified status.
