lines.transliteration: gurmukh pavit ar param pad  paavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord with every hair of his body.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rom rom har Dh i-aavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||27||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh saach samaavai. ||27||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is pleasing to the True Guru; this is contemplation on the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parchai bayd  beechaaree.

lines.english: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh is carried across.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parchai t aree-ai t aaree.

lines.english: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh receives the spiritual wisdom of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parchai so sabad  gi-aanee.

lines.english: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh comes to know the path within.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parchai ant ar biDh  jaanee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh attains the unseen and infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ee-ai alakh  apaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the door of liberation. ||28||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mukat  du-aar. ||28||

lines.english: The Gurmukh speaks the unspoken wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh akath kathai beechaar.

lines.english: In the midst of his family, the Gurmukh lives a spiritual life.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nibhai saparvaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh lovingly meditates deep within.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh japee-ai ant ar pi-aar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Shabad, and righteous conduct.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ee-ai sabad  achaar.

lines.english: He knows the mystery of the Shabad, and inspires others to know it.
lines.transliteration: sabad bh ayd jaanai jaan aa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, burning away his ego, he merges in the Lord. ||29||
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai jaal samaa-ee. ||29||

lines.english: The True Lord fashioned the earth for the sake of the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh Dh artee saachai saajee.

lines.english: There, he set in motion the play of creation and destruction.
lines.transliteration: tis meh opat  khapat so baajee.

lines.english: One who is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad enshrines love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rapai rang laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Truth, he goes to his home with honor.
lines.transliteration: saach rata-o pat  si-o gh ar jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one receives honor.
lines.transliteration: saach sabad bin pat  nahee paavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, how can one be absorbed in Truth? ||30||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai ki-o saach samaavai. ||30||

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the eight miraculous spiritual powers, and all wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh asat siDh ee sabh  buDh ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and obtains true understanding.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh avjal t aree-ai sach suDh ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the ways of truth and untruth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sar apsar biDh  jaanai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows worldliness and renunciation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parvirat  narvirat  pachh aanai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh crosses over, and carries others across as well.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t aaray paar ut aaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is emancipated through the Shabad. ||31||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sabad  nistaaray. ||31||

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, egotism is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: naamay raatay ha-umai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they remain absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sach rahay samaa-ay.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Way of Yoga.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay jog jugat  beechaar.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they find the door of liberation.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay paavahi mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they understand the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay t aribhavan sojhee ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, eternal peace is found. ||32||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they attain Sidh Gosht - conversation with the Siddhas.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay siDh  gosat ho-ay.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they practice intense meditation forever.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sad aa tap ho-ay.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they live the true and excellent lifestyle.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sach karn ee saar.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Lord's virtues and spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay gun  gi-aan beechaar.

lines.english: Without the Name, all that is spoken is useless.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai bolai sabh vaykaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, their victory is celebrated. ||33||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay t in ka-o jaikaar. ||33||

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay naam paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Way of Yoga is to remain absorbed in Truth.
lines.transliteration: jog jugat sach rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: The Yogis wander in the twelve schools of Yoga; the Sannyaasis in six and four.
lines.transliteration: baarah meh jogee bharmaa-ay sani-aasee chh i-a chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰਹ  ਮਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ  ਭਰਮਾਏ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਿਛਅ  ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who remains dead while yet alive, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, finds the door of liberation. pMnw 942
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad jo mar jeevai so paa-ay mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, all are attached to duality. Contemplate this in your heart, and see.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai sabh  doojai laagay d aykhhu rid ai beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਿਭ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed and very fortunate are those who keep the True Lord enshrined intheir hearts. ||34||
lines.transliteration: naanak vaday say vadbhaagee jinee sach rakh i-aa ur Dh aar. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਡੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel, lovingly focused on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh rat an lahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh intuitively recognizes the value of this jewel.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh parkh ai ratan subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh practices Truth in action.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachay man pat ee-aa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh sees the unseen, when it pleases the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh alakh  lakhaa-ay t is bhaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh does not have to endure punishment. ||35||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh chot na kh aavai. ||35||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is blessed with the Name, charity and purification.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam d aan isnaan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh centers his meditation on the celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh laagai sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paavai d argeh maan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Supreme Lord, the Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh a-o bh anjan parDh aan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh does good deeds, an inspires others to do so.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh karn ee kaar karaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh unites in the Lord's Union. ||36||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mayl milaa-ay. ||36||

lines.english: The Gurmukh understands the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saast ar simrit  bayd .

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the secrets of each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paavai gh at ghat bhayd.

lines.english: The Gurmukh eliminates hate and envy.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh vair viroDh  gavaavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh erases all accounting.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saglee gan at mitaavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is imbued with love for the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam rang raat aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes his Lord and Master. ||37||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh kh asam pachh aataa. ||37||

lines.english: Without the Guru, one wanders, coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: bin gur bharmai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, one's work is useless.
lines.transliteration: bin gur ghaal na pav-ee thaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, the mind is totally unsteady.
lines.transliteration: bin gur manoo-aa at dolaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, one is unsatisfied, and eats poison.
lines.transliteration: bin gur taripat  nahee bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, one is stung by the poisonous snake of Maya, and dies.
lines.transliteration: bin gur bisee-ar dasai mar vaat.

lines.english: O Nanak without the Guru, all is lost. ||38||
lines.transliteration: naanak gur bin ghaatay gh aat. ||38||

lines.english: One who meets the Guru is carried across.
lines.transliteration: jis gur milai tis paar ut aarai.

lines.english: His sins are erased, and he is emancipated through virtue.
lines.transliteration: avgan maytai gun  nistaarai.

lines.english: The supreme peace of liberation is attained, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mukat mahaa sukh  gur sabad  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is never defeated.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kad ay na aavai haar.

lines.english: In the store of the body, this mind is the merchant;
lines.transliteration: tan hatrh ee ih man van jaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, it deals intuitively in Truth. ||39||
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay sach vaapaaraa. ||39||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is the bridge, built by the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh baaNDhi-o sayt  biDhaatai.

lines.english: The demons of passion which plundered Sri Lanka - the body - have been conquered.
lines.transliteration: lankaa lootee dait  santaapai.

lines.english: Ram Chand - the mind - has slaughtered Raawan - pride;
lines.transliteration: raamchand maari-o ah raavan .
bhayd  babh eekhan gurmukh  parchaa-in . the Gurmukh understands the secret revealed by Babheekhan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh carries even stones across the ocean.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saa-ir paahan  taaray.

lines.english: The Gurmukh saves millions of people. ||40||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kot t aytees uDh aaray. ||40||

lines.english: The comings and goings in reincarnation are ended for the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chookai aavan  jaan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d argeh paavai maan .

lines.english: The Gurmukh distinguishes the true from the false.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kh otay kh aray pachh aan.

lines.english: The Gurmukh focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh laagai sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, the Gurmukh is absorbed in His Praises.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d argeh sifat  samaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is not bound by bonds. ||41||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh banDh  na paa-ay. ||41||

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam niranjan paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Gurmukh burns away his ego.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachay kay gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh remains absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachai rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the True Name, the Gurmukh is honored and exalted.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saach naam pat  ootam ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਪਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands all the worlds. ||42||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sagal bh avan kee sojh ee ho-ay. ||42||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਣ  ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੨॥
lines.english: "What is the root, the source of all? What teachings hold for these times?
lines.transliteration: kavan mool kavan  mat vaylaa.

lines.english: Who is your guru? Whose disciple are you?
lines.transliteration: tayraa kavan  guroo jis kaa t oo chaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ ਚੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: What is that speech, by which you remain unattached?
lines.transliteration: kavan kathaa lay rahhu niraalay.

lines.english: Listen to what we say, O Nanak, you little boy.
lines.transliteration: bolai naanak sunhu t um baalay.

lines.english: Give us your opinion on what we have said.
lines.transliteration: ays kathaa kaa day-ay beechaar.

lines.english: How can the Shabad carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?"||43|| pMnw 943
lines.transliteration: bhavjal sabad  langh aavan haar. ||43||

lines.english: From the air came the beginning. This is the age of the True Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: pavan arambh sat gur mat  vaylaa.

lines.english: The Shabad is the Guru, upon whom I lovingly focus my consciousness; I am the chaylaa, the disciple.
lines.transliteration: sabad guroo surat  Dhun chaylaa.

lines.english: Speaking the Unspoken Speech, I remain unattached.
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa lay raha-o niraalaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, throughout the ages, the Lord of the World is my Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak jug jug gur gopaalaa.

lines.english: I contemplate the sermon of the Shabad, the Word of the One God.
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad jit  kathaa veechaaree.

lines.english: The Gurmukh puts out the fire of egotism. ||44||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ha-umai agan nivaaree. ||44||

lines.english: "With teeth of wax, how can one chew iron?
lines.transliteration: main kay d ant ki-o kh aa-ee-ai saar.

lines.english: What is that food, which takes away pride?
lines.transliteration: jit garab jaa-ay so kavan  aahaar.

lines.english: How can one live in the palace, the home of snow, wearing robes of fire?
lines.transliteration: hivai kaa ghar mand ar agan piraahan.

lines.english: Where is that cave, within which one may remain unshaken?
lines.transliteration: kavan gufaa jit rahai avaahan.

lines.english: Who should we know to be pervading here and there?
lines.transliteration: it ut kis ka-o jaan  samaavai.

lines.english: What is that meditation, which leads the mind to be absorbed in itself?"||45||
lines.transliteration: kavan Dhi-aan man maneh samaavai. ||45||

lines.english: Eradicating egotism and individualism from within,
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o mai mai vichahu khovai.
doojaa maytai ayko hovai. and erasing duality, the mortal becomes one with God.

lines.english: The world is difficult for the foolish, self-willed manmukh;
lines.transliteration: jag karrhaa manmukh  gaavaar.
sabad kamaa-ee-ai kh aa-ee-ai saar. practicing the Shabad, one chews iron.

lines.english: Know the One Lord, inside and out.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayko jaan ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the fire is quenched, through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will. ||46||
lines.transliteration: naanak agan marai satgur kai bh aanai. ||46||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਗਿਨ ਮਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੪੬॥
lines.english: Imbued with the True Fear of God, pride is taken away;
lines.transliteration: sach bhai raat aa garab nivaarai.
ayko jaataa sabad  veechaarai. realize that He is One, and contemplate the Shabad.

lines.english: With the True Shabad abiding deep within the heart,
lines.transliteration: sabad vasai sach ant ar hee-aa.
tan man seet al rang rangee-aa. the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and colored with the Lord's Love.

lines.english: The fire of sexual desire, anger and corruption is quenched.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh bikh  agan nivaaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace. ||47||
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree nad ar pi-aaray. ||47||

lines.english: "The moon of the mind is cool and dark; how is it enlightened?
lines.transliteration: kavan mukh chand  hivai gh ar chh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: How does the sun blaze so brilliantly?
lines.transliteration: kavan mukh sooraj t apai t apaa-i-aa.

lines.english: How can the constant watchful gaze of Death be turned away?
lines.transliteration: kavan mukh kaal johat  nit rahai.

lines.english: By what understanding is the honor of the Gurmukh preserved?
lines.transliteration: kavan buDh gurmukh  pat rahai.

lines.english: Who is the warrior, who conquers Death?
lines.transliteration: kavan joDh jo kaal sangh aarai.

lines.english: Give us your thoughtful reply, O Nanak."||48||
lines.transliteration: bolai banee naanak beechaarai. ||48||

lines.english: Giving voice to the Shabad, the moon of the mind is illuminated with infinity.
lines.transliteration: sabad bh aakhat sas jot  apaaraa.

lines.english: When the sun dwells in the house of the moon, the darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sas ghar soor vasai mitai anDh i-aaraa.

lines.english: Pleasure and pain are just the same, when one takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh sam kar naam aDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself saves, and carries us across.
lines.transliteration: aapay paar utaaran haaraa.

lines.english: With faith in the Guru, the mind merges in Truth,
lines.transliteration: gur parchai man saach samaa-ay.
paranvat  naanak kaal na kh aa-ay. ||49|| and then, prays Nanak, one is not consumed by Death. ||49||

lines.english: The essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is known to be the most exalted andexcellent of all.
lines.transliteration: naam tat  sabh  hee sir jaapai.

lines.english: Without the Name, one is afflicted by pain and death.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai dukh  kaal sant aapai.

lines.english: When one's essence merges into the essence, the mind is satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: tato tat milai man maanai.

lines.english: Duality is gone, and one enters into the home of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojaa jaa-ay ikat  ghar aanai.

lines.english: The breath blows across the sky of the Tenth Gate and vibrates.
lines.transliteration: bolai pavnaa gagan garjai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the mortal then intuitively meets the eternal, unchanging Lord. ||50||
lines.transliteration: naanak nihchal milan sahjai. ||50||

lines.english: The absolute Lord is deep within; the absolute Lord is outside us as well. The absoluteLord totally fills the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: antar sunaN baahar sunaN taribhavan sunn masuNnaN.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੁੰਨੰ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸੁੰਨੰ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਸੁੰਨ ਮਸੁੰਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: One who knows the Lord in the fourth state, is not subject to virtue or vice.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthay sunnai jo nar jaanai t aa ka-o paap na puNnaN.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੇ  ਸੁੰਨੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪਾਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੰ ॥
lines.english: One who knows the mystery of God the Absolute, who pervades each and everyheart, knows the Primal Being, the Immaculate Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at sunn kaa jaan ai bhay-o. aad  purakh  niranjan d ay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ  ਭੇਉ ॥
lines.english: That humble being who is imbued with the Immaculate Naam,
lines.transliteration: jo jan naam niranjan raataa.

lines.english: O Nanak, is himself the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||51||
lines.transliteration: naanak so-ee purakh biDh aataa. ||51||

lines.english: "Everyone speaks of the Absolute Lord, the unmanifest void.
lines.transliteration: sunno sunn kahai sabh ko-ee.

lines.english: How can one find this absolute void?
lines.transliteration: anhat sunn kahaa t ay ho-ee.

lines.english: Who are they, who are attuned to this absolute void?"
lines.transliteration: anhat sunn rat ay say kaisay.

lines.english: They are like the Lord, from whom they originated.
lines.transliteration: jis tay upjay t is hee jaisay.

lines.english: They are not born, they do not die; they do not come and go.
lines.transliteration: o-ay janam na mareh na aavahi jaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs instruct their minds. ||52||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh man samjh aahi. ||52||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਮਰਿਹ  ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: By practicing control over the nine gates, one attains perfect control over the TenthGate.
lines.transliteration: na-o sar subhar d asvai pooray.

lines.english: There, the unstruck sound current of the absolute Lord vibrates and resounds.
lines.transliteration: tah anhat  sunn vajaavah t ooray.

lines.english: Behold the True Lord ever-present, and merge with Him.
lines.transliteration: saachai raachay daykh  hajooray.

lines.english: The True Lord is pervading and permeating each and every heart. pMnw 944
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at saach rahi-aa bh arpooray.

lines.english: The hidden Bani of the Word is revealed.
lines.transliteration: guptee ban ee pargat ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord is revealed and known. ||53||
lines.transliteration: naanak parakh la-ay sach so-ay. ||53||

lines.english: Meeting with the Lord through intuition and love, peace is found.
lines.transliteration: sahj bhaa-ay milee-ai sukh  hovai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh remains awake and aware; he does not fall sleep.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaagai need  na sovai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਗੈ  ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He enshrines the unlimited, absolute Shabad deep within.
lines.transliteration: sunn sabad aprampar Dh aarai.

lines.english: Chanting the Shabad, he is liberated, and saves others as well.
lines.transliteration: kahtay mukat  sabad  nistaarai.

lines.english: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings are attuned to the Truth.
lines.transliteration: gur kee deekh i-aa say sach raat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੀਿਖਆ  ਸੇ ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who eradicate their self-conceit meet with the Lord; they do not remain separated by doubt. ||54||
lines.transliteration: naanak aap gavaa-ay milan nahee bh araatay. ||54||

lines.english: "Where is that place, where evil thoughts are destroyed?
lines.transliteration: kubuDh chavaavai so kit  thaa-ay.

lines.english: The mortal does not understand the essence of reality; why must he suffer in pain?"
lines.transliteration: ki-o tat  na boojh ai chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: No one can save one who is tied up at Death's door.
lines.transliteration: jam dar baaDh ay ko-ay na raakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਬਾਧੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, no one has any credit or honor.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai naahee pat  saakh ai.

lines.english: "How can one obtain understanding and cross over?"
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar boojhai paavai paar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand. ||55||
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh na bujh ai gavaar. ||55||

lines.english: Evil thoughts are erased, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kubuDh mitai gur sabad  beechaar.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, the door of liberation is found.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh does not understand the essence of reality, and is burnt to ashes.
lines.transliteration: tat na cheenai manmukh  jal jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His evil-mindedness separates him from the Lord, and he suffers.
lines.transliteration: durmat  vichh urh chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Accepting the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he is blessed with all virtues and spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: maanai hukam sabhay gun  gi-aan.

lines.english: O Nanak, he is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||56||
lines.transliteration: naanak dargeh paavai maan. ||56||

lines.english: One who possesses the merchandise, the wealth of the True Name,
lines.transliteration: saach vakhar Dh an palai ho-ay.
aap tarai t aaray bh ee so-ay. crosses over, and carries others across with him as well.

lines.english: One who intuitively understands, and is attuned to the Lord, is honored.
lines.transliteration: sahj rataa boojh ai pat  ho-ay.

lines.english: No one can estimate his worth.
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  karai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Love of the True Lord, one crosses over. ||57||
lines.transliteration: naanak paar parai sach bhaa-ay. ||57||

lines.english: "Where is the Shabad said to dwell? What will carry us across the terrifying world- ocean?
lines.transliteration: so sabad kaa kahaa vaas kathee-alay jit  taree-ai bh avjal sansaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ  ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The breath, when exhaled, extends out ten finger lengths; what is the support of thebreath?
lines.transliteration: tarai sat  angul vaa-ee kahee-ai t is kaho kavan aDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ  ਵਾਈ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Speaking and playing, how can one be stable and steady? How can the unseen beseen?"
lines.transliteration: bolai khaylai asthir hovai ki-o kar alakh  lakhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਲੈ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Listen, O master; Nanak prays truly. Instruct your own mind.
lines.transliteration: sun su-aamee sach naanak paran vai apn ay man samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਰ੍ਣਵੈ  ਅਪਣੇ  ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the True Shabad. Bestowing His Glance of Grace,He unites us in His Union.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabd ay sach liv laagai kar nad ree mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਸਿਚ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਕਿਰ ਨਦਰੀ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is all-knowing and all-seeing. By perfect destiny, we merge in Him. ||58||
lines.transliteration: aapay daanaa aapay beenaa poorai bh aag samaa-ay. ||58||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੫੮॥
lines.english: That Shabad dwells deep within the nucleus of all beings. God is invisible; wherever Ilook, there I see Him.
lines.transliteration: so sabad ka-o nirant ar vaas alkh aN jah d aykhaa tah so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ  ਕਉ ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਅਲਖੰ  ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The air is the dwelling place of the absolute Lord. He has no qualities; He has allqualities.
lines.transliteration: pavan kaa vaasaa sunn nivaasaa akal kalaa Dhar so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਨ  ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ  ਸੁੰਨ ਿਨਵਾਸਾ  ਅਕਲ  ਕਲਾ  ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, the Shabad comes to abide within the heart, and doubt is eradicated from within.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay sabad  ghat meh vasai vichahu bh aram gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਘਟ ਮਿਹ ਵਸੈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Word of His Bani.Let His Name be enshrined in your mind.
lines.transliteration: tan man nirmal nirmal ban ee naamo man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਨਾਮ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Shabad is the Guru, to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. Know the OneLord alone, here and hereafter.
lines.transliteration: sabad guroo bh avsaagar t aree-ai it  ut ayko jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰੂ ਭਵਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ  ਇਤ ਉਤ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: He has no form or color, shadow or illusion; O Nanak, realize the Shabad. ||59||
lines.transliteration: chihan varan nahee chhaa-i-aa maa-i-aa naanak sabad  pachh aanai. ||59||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਹਨੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੫੯॥
lines.english: O reclusive hermit, the True, Absolute Lord is the support of the exhaled breath,which extends out ten finger lengths.
lines.transliteration: tarai sat  angul vaa-ee a-oDh oo sunn sach aahaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ  ਵਾਈ  ਅਉਧੂ  ਸੁੰਨ ਸਚੁ ਆਹਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh speaks and churns the essence of reality, and realizes the unseen,infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bolai t at birolai cheenai alakh  apaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੋਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਿਬਰੋਲੈ  ਚੀਨੈ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Eradicating the three qualities, he enshrines the Shabad within, and then, his mind isrid of egotism.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maytai sabad  vasaa-ay t aa man chookai ahankaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸਾਏ  ਤਾ ਮਿਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord alone; he is in love with the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayko jaan ai taa har naam lagai pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: He understands the Sushmana, Ida and Pingala, when the unseen Lord reveals Himself.
lines.transliteration: sukhmanaa irh aa pingulaa boojh ai jaa aapay alakh  lakhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਮਨਾ  ਇੜਾ  ਿਪੰਗੁਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord is above these three energy channels. Through the Word, theShabad of the True Guru, one merges with Him. ||60||
lines.transliteration: naanak tihu t ay oopar saachaa sat gur sabad  samaa-ay. ||60||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਹੁ ਤੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੬੦॥
lines.english: "The air is said to be the soul of the mind. But what does the air feed on?
lines.transliteration: man kaa jee-o pavan kathee-alay pavan kahaa ras khaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ  ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ  ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: What is the way of the spiritual teacher, and the reclusive hermit? What is the occupation of the Siddha?" pMnw 945
lines.transliteration: gi-aan kee mudraa kavan a-oDh oo siDh  kee kavan kamaa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, the essence does not come, O hermit, and the thirst of egotism does not depart.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai ras na aavai a-oDh oo ha-umai pi-aas na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਰਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਅਉਧੂ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Shabad, one finds the ambrosial essence, and remains fulfilled withthe True Name.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay amrit  ras paa-i-aa saachay rahay agh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: "What is that wisdom, by which one remains steady and stable? What food bringssatisfaction?"
lines.transliteration: kavan buDh jit  asthir rahee-ai kit  bhojan t ariptaasai.

lines.english: O Nanak, when one looks upon pain and pleasure alike, through the True Guru, then he is not consumed by Death. ||61||
lines.transliteration: naanak dukh  sukh  sam kar jaapai sat gur tay kaal na garaasai. ||61||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਗਰ੍ਾਸੈ  ॥੬੧॥
lines.english: If one is not imbued with the Lord's Love, nor intoxicated with His subtle essence,
lines.transliteration: rang na raataa ras nahee maat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਿਸ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabdai jal bal t aataa. without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is frustrated, and consumed by his owninner fire.

lines.english: He does not preserve his semen and seed, and does not chant the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bind na raakh i-aa sabad  na bh aakhi-aa.

lines.english: He does not control his breath; he does not worship and adore the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: pavan na saaDhi-aa sach na araaDh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਨੁ ਨ ਸਾਿਧਆ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: But one who speaks the Unspoken Speech, and remains balanced,
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa lay sam kar rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, attains the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||62||
lines.transliteration: ta-o naanak aat am raam ka-o lahai. ||62||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੬੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one is attuned to the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee rangay raataa.

lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is intoxicated with the Truth.
lines.transliteration: amrit pee-aa saachay maat aa.

lines.english: Contemplating the Guru, the fire within is put out.
lines.transliteration: gur veechaaree agan nivaaree.

lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, the soul settles in peace.
lines.transliteration: api-o pee-o aatam sukh  Dhaaree.

lines.english: Worshipping the True Lord in adoration, the Gurmukh crosses over the river of life.
lines.transliteration: sach araaDhi-aa gurmukh  tar taaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, after deep contemplation, this is understood. ||63||
lines.transliteration: naanak boojhai ko veechaaree. ||63||

lines.english: "Where does this mind-elephant live? Where does the breath reside?
lines.transliteration: ih man maigal kahaa basee-alay kahaa basai ih pavnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ  ਕਹਾ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ  ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਇਹੁ ਪਵਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Where should the Shabad reside, so that the wanderings of the mind may cease?"
lines.transliteration: kahaa basai so sabad a-oDh oo taa ka-o chookai man kaa bh avnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਉਧੂ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਵਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord blesses one with His Glance of Grace, he leads him to the True Guru.Then, this mind dwells in its own home within.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa sat gur maylay t aa nij gh ar vaasaa ih man paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: When the individual consumes his egotism, he becomes immaculate, and hiswandering mind is restrained.
lines.transliteration: aapai aap khaa-ay t aa nirmal hovai Dh aavat  varaj rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਖਾਇ  ਤਾ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਵਰਿਜ  ਰਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: "How can the root, the source of all be realized? How can the soul know itself? How can the sun enter into the house of the moon?"
lines.transliteration: ki-o mool pachhaan ai aat am jaan ai ki-o sas gh ar soor samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਆਤਮੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਕਉ  ਸਿਸ ਘਿਰ  ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh eliminates egotism from within; then, O Nanak, the sun naturally enters into the home of the moon. ||64||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ha-umai vichahu kh ovai t a-o naanak sahj samaavai. ||64||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬੪॥
lines.english: When the mind becomes steady and stable, it abides in the heart, and then the Gurmukh realizes the root, the source of all.
lines.transliteration: ih man nihchal hirdai vasee-alay gurmukh  mool pachh aan rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਸੀਅਲੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਿਣ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The breath is seated in the home of the navel; the Gurmukh searches, and finds theessence of reality.
lines.transliteration: naabh pavan gh ar aasan  baisai gurmukh  khojat tat lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਭ  ਪਵਨੁ ਘਿਰ  ਆਸਿਣ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: This Shabad permeates the nucleus of the self, deep within, in its own home; theLight of this Shabad pervades the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: so sabad nirant ar nij gh ar aachh ai taribhavan jot so sabad  lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਆਛੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Hunger for the True Lord shall consume your pain, and through the True Lord, youshall be satisfied.
lines.transliteration: khaavai d ookh bhookh saachay kee saachay hee t ariptaas rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਿਸ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the unstruck sound current of the Bani; how rare are those whounderstand.
lines.transliteration: anhad ban ee gurmukh  jaanee birlo ko arthaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਣੀ  ਿਬਰਲੋ  ਕੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, one who speaks the Truth is dyed in the color of Truth, which will neverfade away. ||65||
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai sach subh aakhai sach rapai rang kabhoo na jaavai. ||65||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੈ  ਸਿਚ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬੫॥
lines.english: "When this heart and body did not exist, where did the mind reside?
lines.transliteration: jaa ih hirdaa d ayh na hot ee ta-o man kaith ai raht aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਇਹੁ ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਕੈਠੈ ਰਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: When there was no support of the navel lotus, then in which home did the breath reside?
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal asthambh  na hot o taa pavan kavan gh ar saht aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਭ  ਕਮਲ  ਅਸਥੰਭੁ  ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ  ਘਿਰ  ਸਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: When there was no form or shape, then how could anyone lovingly focus on theShabad?
lines.transliteration: roop na hoto raykh  na kaa-ee t aa sabad  kahaa liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਤਾ ਸਬਿਦ  ਕਹਾ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When there was no dungeon formed from egg and sperm, who could measure theLord's value and extent?
lines.transliteration: rakat bind  kee marh ee na hot ee mit  keemat  nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਕਤੁ  ਿਬੰਦੁ ਕੀ ਮੜੀ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਿਮਿਤ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When color, dress and form could not be seen, how could the True Lord be known?"
lines.transliteration: varan bhaykh  asroop na jaapee ki-o kar jaapas saachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ  ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾਪਿਸ  ਸਾਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are detached.Then and now, they see the Truest of the True. ||66||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay bairaagee ib t ab saacho saachaa. ||66||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਇਬ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ  ॥੬੬॥
lines.english: When the heart and the body did not exist, O hermit, then the mind resided in theabsolute, detached Lord.
lines.transliteration: hirdaa d ayh na hot ee a-oDh oo ta-o man sunn rahai bairaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਅਉਧੂ  ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਿਨ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: When there was no support of the lotus of the navel, the breath remained in its ownhome, attuned to the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal asthambh  na hot o taa nij gh ar bast a-o pavan anraagee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਭ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਅਸਥੰਭੁ  ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਬਸਤਉ  ਪਵਨੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: When there was no form or shape or social class, then the Shabad, in its essence,resided in the unmanifest Lord.
lines.transliteration: roop na raykh-i-aa jaat  na hot ee ta-o akuleen  rahta-o sabad  so saar.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਅਕੁਲੀਿਣ  ਰਹਤਉ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: When the world and the sky did not even exist, the Light of the Formless Lord filled the three worlds. pMnw 946
lines.transliteration: ga-un gagan jab tabeh na hot a-o taribhavan jot aapay nirankaar.

lines.english: Color, dress and form were contained in the One Lord; the Shabad was contained in the One, Wondrous Lord.
lines.transliteration: varan bhaykh  asroop so ayko ayko sabad  vidaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ  ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਵਡਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Name, no one can become pure; O Nanak, this is the UnspokenSpeech. ||67||
lines.transliteration: saach binaa soochaa ko naahee naanak akath kahaanee. ||67||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਿਬਨਾ ਸੂਚਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥੬੭॥
lines.english: "How, in what way, was the world formed, O man? And what disaster will end it?"
lines.transliteration: kit kit  biDh jag upjai purkh aa kit  kit dukh binas jaa-ee.

lines.english: In egotism, the world was formed, O man; forgetting the Naam, it suffers and dies.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich jag upjai purkhaa naam visri-ai d ukh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ  ਪੁਰਖਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਵਸਿਰਐ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; throughthe Shabad, he burns away his egotism.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so gi-aan t at beechaarai ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: His body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Bani of the Word. Heremains absorbed in Truth.
lines.transliteration: tan man nirmal nirmal ban ee saachai rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he remains detached; he enshrines theTrue Name in his heart.
lines.transliteration: naamay naam rahai bairaagee saach rakhi-aa ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, Yoga is never attained; reflect upon this in your heart, and see. ||68||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai jog kaday na hovai d aykhhu rid ai beechaaray. ||68||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥੬੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is one who reflects upon the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saach sabad  beechaarai ko-ay.

lines.english: The True Bani is revealed to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach ban ee pargat ho-ay.

lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord's Love, but how rare are thosewho understand this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man bh eejai virlaa boojh ai ko-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh dwells in the home of the self, deep within.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nij gh ar vaasaa ho-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes the Way of Yoga.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jogee jugat  pachh aanai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord alone. ||69||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak ayko jaan ai. ||69||

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, Yoga is not attained;
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay jog na ho-ee.
bin satgur bh aytay mukat  na ko-ee. without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

lines.english: Without meeting the True Guru, the Naam cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay naam paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without meeting the True Guru, one suffers in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay mahaa d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: Without meeting the True Guru, there is only the deep darkness of egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay mahaa garab gubaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, one dies, having lost the opportunity of this life.||70||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin gur mu-aa janam haar. ||70||

lines.english: The Gurmukh conquers his mind by subduing his ego.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man jeet aa ha-umai maar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh enshrines Truth in his heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saach rakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh conquers the world; he knocks down the Messenger of Death, and killsit.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jag jeet aa jamkaal maar bid aar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh does not lose in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d argeh na aavai haar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is united in God's Union; he alone knows.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mayl milaa-ay so jaan ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad. ||71||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sabad  pachh aanai. ||71||

lines.english: This is the essence of the Shabad - listen, you hermits and Yogis. Without the Name, there is no Yoga.
lines.transliteration: sabdai kaa nibayrh aa sun  too a-oDh oo bin naavai jog na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਕਾ ਿਨਬੇੜਾ  ਸੁਿਣ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Name, remain intoxicated night and day; through theName, they find peace.
lines.transliteration: naamay raatay an-d in maat ay naamai t ay sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Name, everything is revealed; through the Name, understanding isobtained.
lines.transliteration: naamai hee tay sabh  pargat hovai naamay sojh ee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, people wear all sorts of religious robes; the True Lord Himself hasconfused them.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai bhaykh  karahi bahut ayray sachai aap kh u-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Name is obtained only from the True Guru, O hermit, and then, the Way of Yogais found.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay naam paa-ee-ai a-oDh oo jog jugat  taa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਉਧੂ  ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Reflect upon this in your mind, and see; O Nanak, without the Name, there is noliberation. ||72||
lines.transliteration: kar beechaar man daykh hu naanak bin naavai mukat  na ho-ee. ||72||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਿਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭੨॥
lines.english: You alone know Your state and extent, Lord; What can anyone say about it?
lines.transliteration: tayree gat  mit toohai jaan eh ki-aa ko aakh  vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are hidden, and You Yourself are revealed. You Yourself enjoy all pleasures.
lines.transliteration: too aapay gupt aa aapay pargat aapay sabh  rang maan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਪਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.english: The seekers, the Siddhas, the many gurus and disciples wander around searching forYou, according to Your Will.
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  guroo baho chaylay kh ojat fireh furmaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਖੋਜਤ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: They beg for Your Name, and You bless them with this charity. I am a sacrifice to theBlessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: maageh naam paa-ay ih bhikh i-aa tayray d arsan ka-o kurbaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਗਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ  ਇਹ ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: The eternal imperishable Lord God has staged this play; the Gurmukh understands it.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee parabh  khayl rachaa-i-aa gurmukh  sojhee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He extends Himself throughout the ages; there is no other than Him.||73||1|| pMnw 947 <> siqgur pRswid ] (947-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwmklI kI vwr mhlw 3 ] (947-2) raamkalee kee vaar mehlaa 3. Vaar Of Raamkalee, Third Mehl, joDY vIrY pUrbwxI kI DunI ] (947-2) joDhai veerai poorbaan ee kee Dh unee. To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Jodha And Veera Poorbaanee': sloku mÚ 3 ] (947-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh jug aapay vart ai doojaa avar na ko-ee. ||73||1||

lines.english: The True Guru is the field of intuitive wisdom. One who is inspired to love Him,
lines.transliteration: satgur sahjai d aa kh ayt hai jis no laa-ay bh aa-o.
naa-o beejay naa-o ugvai naamay rahai samaa-ay. plants the seed of the Name there. The Name sprouts up, and he remains absorbed inthe Name.

lines.english: But this egotism is the seed of skepticism; it has been uprooted.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai ayho beej hai sahsaa ga-i-aa vilaa-ay.

lines.english: It is not planted there, and it does not sprout; whatever God grants us, we eat.
lines.transliteration: naa kichh beejay na ugvai jo bakh say so kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੈ  ਦਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: When water mixes with water, it cannot be separated again.
lines.transliteration: ambhai sayt ee ambh  rali-aa bahurh  na niksi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਉ  ਉਗਵੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is wonderful; come, poeple, and see!
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh chalat  hai vaykh hu lokaa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਏਹੋ ਬੀਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ  ਗਇਆ ਿਵਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But what can the poor people see? They do not understand.
lines.transliteration: lok ke vaykhai bapurh aa jis no sojh ee naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਬੀਜੇ ਨ ਉਗਵੈ  ਜੋ ਬਖਸੇ  ਸੋ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He alone sees, whom the Lord causes to see; the Lord comes to dwell in his mind.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (947-6) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis vaykhaalay so vaykh ai jis vasi-aa man maahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਭੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਅੰਭੁ ਰਿਲਆ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਿਨਕਿਸਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is the field of sorrow and suffering. He plains sorrow, and eats sorrow.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d ukh kaa kh ayt hai d ukh beejay d ukh khaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਲਤੁ  ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: In sorrow he is born, and in sorrow he dies. Acting in egotism, his life passes away.
lines.transliteration: dukh vich jammai d ukh marai ha-umai karat  vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਕੁ ਿਕ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He does not understand the coming and going of reincarnation; the blind man acts inblindness.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  na sujh -ee anDh aa anDh  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ  ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not know the One who gives, but he is attached to what is given.
lines.transliteration: jo dayvai t isai na jaan -ee ditay ka-o laptaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. He cannot do anything else.||2|| mÚ 3 ] (947-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhi-aa kamaavan aa avar na karn aa jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, everlasting peace is obtained. He Himself leads us to meetHim.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai sad aa sukh  jis no aapay maylay so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਿਖ ਮਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਤ  ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This is the true meaning of peace, that one becomes immaculate within oneself.
lines.transliteration: sukhai ayhu bibayk hai ant ar nirmal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The doubt of ignorance is eradicated, and spiritual wisdom is obtained.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan kaa bharam katee-ai gi-aan paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਿਤਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਿਦਤੇ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak comes to gaze upon the One Lord alone; wherever he looks, there He is. ||3|| pauVI ] (947-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayko nadree aa-i-aa jah d aykhaa tah so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Lord created His throne, upon which He sits.
lines.transliteration: sachai takh at rachaa-i-aa baisan  ka-o jaaN-ee.

lines.english: He Himself is everything; this is what the Word of the Guru's Shabad says.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap hai gur sabad  sunaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through His almighty creative power, He created and fashioned the mansions and hotels.
lines.transliteration: aapay kudrat  saajee-an kar mahal saraa-ee.

lines.english: He made the two lamps, the sun and the moon; He formed the perfect form.
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj d u-ay chaann ay pooree ban at banaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਕਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਿਗਆਨ ੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai sun ay aap gur sabad  Dhi-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੋ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail, O True King! True is Your Name. ||1||Pause|| sloku ] (947-13) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu sachay paatisaah t oo sachee naa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Kabeer, I have ground myself into henna paste.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mahidee kar kai gh aali-aa aap peesaa-ay peesaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤੁ  ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਬੈਸਣ  ਕਉ ਜਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my Husband Lord, You took no notice of me; You never applied me to Your feet.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (947-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tai sah baat  na puchh ee-aa kabhoo na laa-ee paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my Husband Lord keeps me like henna paste; He blesses me with HisGlance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: naanak mahidee kar kai rakh i-aa so saho nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਹਲ  ਸਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself grinds me, and He Himself rubs me; He Himself applies me to His feet.
lines.transliteration: aapay peesai aapay ghasai aapay hee laa-ay la-ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਦੁਇ ਚਾਨਣੇ  ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This is the cup of love of my Lord and Master; He gives it as He chooses. ||2|| pauVI ] (947-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ih piram pi-aalaa khasam kaa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਿਪ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You created the world with its variety; by the Hukam of Your Command, it comes,goes, and merges again in You.
lines.transliteration: vaykee sarisat upaa-ee-an sabh hukam aavai jaa-ay samaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ਤੂ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself see, and blossom forth; there is no one else at all.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykh vigsad aa doojaa ko naahee.

lines.english: As it pleases You, You keep me. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I understand You.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh  too gur sabad  bujhaahee.

lines.english: You are the strength of all. As it pleases You, You lead us on.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa t ayraa jor hai ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਿਹਦੀ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਘਾਿਲਆ  ਆਪੁ  ਪੀਸਾਇ  ਪੀਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: There is no other as great as You; unto whom should I speak and talk? ||2|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (947-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad mai naahi ko kis aakh  sunaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ  ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਲਾਈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, I wandered over the whole world. Searching, I became frustrated. pMnw 948
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaa-ee sabh  jag firee faavee ho-ee bh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਲਾਈ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਫਰੀ  ਫਾਵੀ  ਹੋਈ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: My Husband Lord has not blessed me with peace and tranquility; what will work with Him?
lines.transliteration: so saho saaNt na d ayv-ee ki-aa chalai t is naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਦੇਵਈ  ਿਕਆ  ਚਲੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Lord; I enshrine Him deep within my heart.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har Dhi-aa-ee-ai ant ar rakh ee-ai ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਖੀਐ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, seated in his her own home, she finds her Husband Lord, when the Creator Lord grants His Grace. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (948-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ghar baith i-aa saho paa-i-aa jaa kirpaa keet ee kart aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਿਠਆ  ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਤੀ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa Dh aavat  din ga-i-aa rain  gavaa-ee so-ay. Chasing after worldly affairs, the day is wasted, and the night passes in sleep.
Speaking lies, one eats poison; the self-willed manmukh departs, crying out in pain.
lines.transliteration: koorh bol bikh  khaa-i-aa manmukh  chali-aa ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ  ਿਦਨੁ ਗਇਆ  ਰੈਿਣ ਗਵਾਈ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Mesenger of Death holds his club over the mortal's head; in the love of duality, heloses his honor.
lines.transliteration: sirai upar jam dand hai doojai bh aa-ay pat  kho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਚਿਲਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He never even thinks of the Name of the Lord; over and over again, he comes andgoes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: har naam kaday na chayt i-o fir aavan  jaanaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰੈ ਉਪਿਰ  ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: But if, by Guru's Grace, the Lord's Name comes to dwell in his mind, then theMessenger of Death will not strike him down with his club.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har man vasai jam dand na laagai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Then, O Nanak, he merges intuitively into the Lord, receiving His Grace. ||2|| pauVI ] (948-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay mil rahai karam paraapat ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Some are linked to His Praises, when the Lord blesses them with the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: ik aapnee sift ee laa-i-an d ay sat gur mat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some are blessed with the Name of the eternal, unchanging True Lord.
lines.transliteration: iknaa no naa-o bakhsi-on asthir har sat ee.

lines.english: Water, air and fire, by His Will, worship Him.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant aro hukam karahi bh agtee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਸਫਤੀ  ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਤੀ ॥
lines.english: They are held in the Fear of God; He has formed the perfect form.
lines.transliteration: aynaa no bha-o aglaa pooree ban at bantee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਨੋ ਨਾਉ  ਬਖਿਸਓਨੁ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਤੀ ॥
lines.english: The Hukam, the Command of the One Lord is all-pervasive; accepting it, peace isfound. ||3|| sloku ] (948-8) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: sabh iko hukam varatd aa mani-ai sukh  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਕਰਿਹ  ਭਗਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, such is the touchstone of the Lord; the false cannot even touch it.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kasa-utee raam kee jhooth aa tikai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨਾ ਨੋ ਭਉ ਅਗਲਾ  ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: He alone passes this test of the Lord, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (948-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam kasa-utee so sahai jo marjeevaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: How can this mind be conquered? How can it be killed?
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar ih man maaree-ai ki-o kar mirtak ho-ay.

lines.english: If one does not accept the Word of the Shabad, egotism does not depart.
lines.transliteration: kahi-aa sabad na maan-ee ha-umai chh adai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਸਉਟੀ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਿਟਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated, and then, one is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ha-umai chhutai jeevan mukat  so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ  ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one whom the Lord forgives is united with Him, and then no obstacles blockhis way. ||2|| mÚ 3 ] (948-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no bakhsay t is milai t is bigh an na laagai ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Everyone can say that they are dead while yet alive; how can they be liberated whileyet alive?
lines.transliteration: jeevat marn aa sabh  ko kahai jeevan mukat  ki-o ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਰਤਕੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If someone restrains himself through the Fear of God, and takes the medicine of theLove of God,
lines.transliteration: bhai kaa sanjam jay karay d aaroo bh aa-o laa-ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਆ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਮਾਨਈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਛਡੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavai sukh  sehjay bikh  bhavjal naam t aray-ay. night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. In celestial peace and poise,he crosses over the poisonous, terrifying world-ocean, through the Naam, the Nameof the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਛੁਟੈ ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; he is blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||3|| pauVI ] (948-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paa-ee-ai jaa ka-o nad ar karay-i. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: God created the love of duality, and the three modes which pervade the universe.
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aa-o rachaa-i-on t arai gun  vartaaraa.

lines.english: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, who act according to His Will.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays upaa-i-an hukam kamaavan kaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਿਕਉ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers study their books, but they donot understand contemplation.
lines.transliteration: pandit parh -day jot kee naa boojh eh beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everything is Your play, O True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tayraa kh ayl hai sach sirjan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਬਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, You bless us with forgiveness, and merge us in the True Word ofthe Shabad. ||4|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (948-16) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is bakh as laihi sach sabad  samaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The man of false mind practices falsehood.
lines.transliteration: man kaa jhooth aa jhooth kamaavai.

lines.english: He runs after Maya, and yet pretends to be a man of disciplined meditation.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa no firai tapaa sad aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਰਚਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, he visits all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa sabh  tirath gahai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ  ਉਪਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਕਮਾਵਿਨ  ਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: How can such a man of disciplined meditation attain the supreme status?
lines.transliteration: oh tapaa kaisay param gat  lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪੜਦੇ  ਜੋਤਕੀ  ਨਾ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one lives the Truth.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ko sach kamaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation attains liberation. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (948-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so tapaa mokh antar paavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈਿਹ ਸਿਚ ਸਬਿਦ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He alone is a man of disciplined meditation, who practices this self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: so tapaa je ih t ap gh aalay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, he contemplates the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur no milai sabad  samaalay.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru - this is the only acceptable disciplined meditation.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa ih t ap parvaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (948-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak so tapaa d argahi paavai maan . ||2||

lines.english: He created the night and the day, for the activities of the world. pMnw 949
lines.transliteration: raat d inas upaa-i-an sansaar kee vart an.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one's heart is illumined, and the darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee gh at chaann aa aanayr binaasan .

lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates everything; He pervades and permeates all the woods and meadows.
lines.transliteration: hukmay hee sabh saajee-an ravi-aa sabh  van tarin.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਭ ਵਿਣ ਿਤਰ੍ਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is everything; the Gurmukh constantly chants the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap hai gurmukh  sadaa har bh an.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਿਣ ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, understanding comes; the True Lord Himself inspires us tounderstand. ||5|| slok mÚ 3 ] (949-3) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabday hee sojh ee pa-ee sachai aap bujh aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He is not called a renunciate, whose consciousness is filled with doubt.
lines.transliteration: abhi-aagat  ayhi na aakh ee-an jin kay chit  meh bh aram.

lines.english: Donations to him bring proportionate rewards.
lines.transliteration: tis dai ditai naankaa t ayho jayhaa Dh aram.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਭਆਗਤ  ਏਿਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਨ  ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਿਚਤ  ਮਿਹ ਭਰਮੁ  ॥
lines.english: He hungers for the supreme status of the Fearless, Immaculate Lord;
lines.transliteration: abhai niranjan param pad  taa kaa bh ookhaa ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, how rare are those who offer him this food. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (949-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis kaa bh ojan naankaa virlaa paa-ay ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਭੈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੂਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They are not called renunciates, who take food in the homes of others.
lines.transliteration: abhi-aagat  ayhi na aakh ee-an je par gh ar bhojan karayn.

lines.english: For the sake of their bellies, they wear various religious robes.
lines.transliteration: udrai kaaran  aapn ay bahlay bh aykh karayn.

lines.english: They alone are renunciates, O Nanak, who enter into their own souls.
lines.transliteration: abhi-aagat  say-ee naankaa je aat am ga-on  karayn.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਭਆਗਤ  ਏਿਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਨ  ਿਜ ਪਰ ਘਿਰ  ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They seek and find their Husband Lord; they dwell within the home of their own innerself. ||2|| pauVI ] (949-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhaal lahan saho aapn aa nij gh ar rahan  karayn. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਰੈ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਆਪਣੇ  ਬਹਲੇ  ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They sky and the earth are separate, but the True Lord supports them from within.
lines.transliteration: ambar Dharat  vichh orhi-an vich sachaa asraa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਭਆਗਤ  ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜ ਆਤਮ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: True are all those homes and gates, within which the True Name is enshrined.
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar sabh o sach hai jis vich sachaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਿਲ  ਲਹਿਨ  ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ ਰਹਣੁ  ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Hukam of the True Lord's Command is effective everywhere. The Gurmukh merges in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh sachaa hukam varatd aa gurmukh  sach samaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is True, and True is His throne. Seated upon it, He administers true justice.
lines.transliteration: sachaa aap takh at sachaa bahi sachaa karay ni-aa-o.

lines.english: The Truest of the True is all-pervading everywhere; the Gurmukh sees the unseen.||6|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (949-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatd aa gurmukh  alakh  lakhaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: In the world-ocean, the Infinite Lord abides. The false come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: rainaa-ir maahi anant  hai koorh ee aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: One who walks according to his own will, suffers terrible punishment.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai chalai aapn ai bahut ee lahai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਆਿਪ  ਤਖਤੁ  ਸਚਾ ਬਿਹ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: All things are in the world-ocean, but they are obtained only by the karma of good actions.
lines.transliteration: rainaa-ir meh sabh  kichh  hai karmee palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone obtains the nine treasures, who walks in the Will of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (949-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak na-o niDh paa-ee-ai jay chalai t isai rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: One who intuitively serves the True Guru, loses his life in egotism.
lines.transliteration: sehjay satgur na sayvi-o vich ha-umai janam binaas.

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ  ਮਾਿਹ ਅਨੰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and his heart-lotus doesnot blossom forth.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har ras na chakhi-o kamal na ho-i-o pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਆਪਣੈ  ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh eats poison and dies; he is ruined by love and attachment toMaya.
lines.transliteration: bikh kh aaDhee manmukh  mu-aa maa-i-aa mohi vin aas.

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ  ਮਿਹ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the One Lord, his life is cursed, and his home is cursed as well.
lines.transliteration: ikas har kay naam vin Dh arig jeevan  Dharig vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਿਤਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then one becomes the slave of Hisslaves.
lines.transliteration: jaa aapay nadar karay parabh  sachaa t aa hovai d aasan d aas.

lines.english: And then, night and day, he serves the True Guru, and never leaves His side.
lines.transliteration: taa an-d in sayvaa karay sat guroo kee kabeh na chh odai paas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਿਬਨਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: As the lotus flower floats unaffected in the water, so does he remain detached in his own household.
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal meh kamal alipato vart ai ti-o vichay girah ud aas.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਿਖਓ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇਓ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Lord acts, and inspires everyone to act, according to thePleasure of His Will. He is the treasure of virtue. ||2|| pauVI ] (949-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak karay karaa-i-aa sabh ko ji-o bh aavai t iv har gunt aas. ||2||

lines.english: For thirty-six ages, there was utter darkness. Then, the Lord revealed Himself.
lines.transliteration: chhat eeh jug gubaar saa aapay gan at keenee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਣੁ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the entire universe. He Himself blessed it with understanding.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat sabh saajee-an aap mat  deenee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: He created the Simritees and the Shaastras; He calculates the accounts of virtue andvice.
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  saaji-an paap punn gan at ganeenee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੀ ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand and to be pleased withthe True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaa-ay so bujh see sachai sabad  pateenee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਕਮਲੁ  ਅਿਲਪਤੋ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਤਉ  ਿਵਚੇ ਿਗਰਹ  ਉਦਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself. ||7|| slok mÚ 3 ] (949-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay aap varatd aa aapay bakh as milaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This body is all blood; without blood, the body cannot exist.
lines.transliteration: ih tan sabh o rat hai rat  bin tann na ho-ay.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to their Lord - their bodies are not filled with the blood of greed.
lines.transliteration: jo seh ratay aapn ai tin tan lobh  rat na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਛਤੀਹ  ਜੁਗ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਆਪੇ  ਗਣਤ  ਕੀਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God, the body becomes thin, and the blood of greed passes out of the body. pMnw 950
lines.transliteration: bhai pa-i-ai t an kh een ho-ay lobh  rat vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: As fire purifies metal, so does the Fear of the Lord eradicate the filth of evil- mindedness.
lines.transliteration: ji-o baisantar Dh aat suDh  ho-ay t i-o har kaa bh a-o durmat  mail gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਬੈਸੰਤਿਰ  ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who are imbued with the Lord's Love.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (950-2) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan sohn ay jo rat ay har rang laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In Raamkalee, I have enshrined the Lord in my mind; thus I have been embellished.
lines.transliteration: raamkalee raam man vasi-aa taa bani-aa seegaar.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my heart-lotus has blossomed forth; theLord blessed me with the treasure of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal bigsi-aa t aa sa-upi-aa bh agat bhandaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਰਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਤਾ ਬਿਨਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: My doubt was dispelled, and I woke up; the darkness of ignorance was dispelled.
lines.transliteration: bharam ga-i-aa t aa jaagi-aa chookaa agi-aan anDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਬਗਿਸਆ  ਤਾ ਸਉਿਪਆ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: She who is in love with her Lord, is the most infinitely beautiful.
lines.transliteration: tis no roop at  aglaa jis har naal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਤਾ ਜਾਿਗਆ ਚੂਕਾ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Such a beautiful, happy soul-bride enjoys her Husband Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: sadaa ravai pir aapn aa sobh aavant ee naar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਿਤ  ਅਗਲਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know how to decorate themselves; wasting their whole lives, they depart.
lines.transliteration: manmukh seegaar na jaan nee jaasan janam sabh  haar.

lines.english: Those who decorate themselves without devotional worship to the Lord, arecontinually reincarnated to suffer.
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagt ee seegaar karahi nit  jameh ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਜਾਸਿਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਭੁ ਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They do not obtain respect in this world; the Creator Lord alone knows what willhappen to them in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: saisaarai vich sobh na paa-inee agai je karay so jaan ai kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਿਹ ਿਨਤ  ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord is the One and only; duality exists only in the world.
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa ayk hai duhu vich hai sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੈਸਾਰੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ  ਅਗੈ ਿਜ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself enjoins them to good and bad; they do only that which the Creator Lordcauses them to do. ||2|| mÚ 3 ] (950-7) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: changai mandai aap laa-i-an so karan je aap karaa-ay kart aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, tranquility is not obtained. It cannot be found anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay saaNt na aavee d oojee naahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਗੈ ਮੰਦੈ ਆਿਪ  ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਕਰਿਨ  ਿਜ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: No matter how much one may long for it, without the karma of good actions, it cannotbe found.
lines.transliteration: jay bahutayraa lochee-ai vin  karmaa paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Those whose inner beings are filled with greed and corruption, are ruined through thelove of duality.
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  vikaar hai d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The cycle of birth and death is not ended, and filled with egotism, they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: tin jaman  maran  na chuk-ee ha-umai vich d ukh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru, do not remain unfulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jinee satgur si-o chit  laa-i-aa so kh aalee ko-ee naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਿਵਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: tin jam kee t alab na hova-ee naa o-ay d ukh sahaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved, merging in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3|| pauVI ] (950-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ubray sachai sabad  samaahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਸੋ ਖਾਲੀ  ਕੋਈ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself remains unattached forever; all others run after worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: aap alipat sad aa rahai hor Dh anDhai sabh  Dhaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is eternal, unchanging and unmoving; the others continue coming andgoing in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aap nihchal achal hai hor aavahi jaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord forever and ever, the Gurmukh finds peace.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har Dh i-aa-ee-ai gurmukh  sukh  paavahi.

lines.english: He dwells in the home of his own inner being, absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paa-ee-ai sach sifat  samaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹੋਿਰ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਿਭ ਧਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is profound and unfathomable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad,He is understood. ||8|| slok mÚ 3 ] (950-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sachaa gahir gambheer hai gur sabad  bujhaa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਅਚਲੁ  ਹੈ ਹੋਿਰ ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam Dhi-aa-ay t oo sabh o vart ai sach.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, obtains the fruit ofTruth.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukmai jo bujhai so fal paa-ay sach.

lines.english: One who merely mouths the words, does not understand the Hukam of the TrueLord's Command.
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee kart aa firai hukam na boojh ai sach.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who accepts the Will of the Lord is His devotee. Without accepting it, heis the falsest of the false. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (950-16) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har kaa bhaan aa mannay so bh agat ho-ay vin  mannay kach nikach. ||1||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know what they are saying. They are filled withsexual desire, anger and egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bol na jaan nee onaa and ar kaam kroDh  ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.english: They do not understand right places and wrong places; they are filled with greed andcorruption.
lines.transliteration: o-ay thaa-o kuthaa-o na jaannee un ant ar lobh  vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.english: They come, and sit and talk for their own purposes. The Messenger of Death strikesthem down.
lines.transliteration: o-ay aapnai su-aa-ay aa-ay bahi galaa karahi onaa maaray jam jand aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਨੀ  ਬਦਨੀ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਫਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
lines.english: Hereafter, they are called to account in the Court of the Lord; the false ones arestruck down and humiliated.
lines.transliteration: agai dargeh laykh ai mangi-ai maar kh u-aar keecheh koorh i-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ  ਹੋਇ ਿਵਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕਚੁ ਿਨਕਚੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can this filth of falsehood be washed off? Can anyone think about this, and find the way?
lines.transliteration: ayh koorhai kee mal ki-o utrai ko-ee kadh ahu ih veechaar.
