lines.english: If one meets with the True Guru, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord within;all his sins are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t aa naam d irhaa-ay sabh  kilvikh  katan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੋਿਲ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਓਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Let all bow in humility to that humble being who chants the Naam, and worships the Naam in adoration. pMnw 951
lines.transliteration: naam japay naamo aaraaDhay t is jan ka-o karahu sabh  namaskaar.

lines.english: The Naam washes off the filth of falsehood; chanting the Naam, one becomes truthful.
lines.transliteration: mal koorhee naam ut aaree-an jap naam ho-aa sachiaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਤਾਰੀਅਨ ੁ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ  ਸਿਚਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, wondrous are the plays of the Lord, the Giver of life. ||2|| pauVI ] (951-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jis day ayhi chalat  heh so jeeva-o d ayvan haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸ ਦੇ ਏਿਹ ਚਲਤ  ਹਿਹ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਉ  ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Great Giver; no other is as great as You. Unto whom should I speak andtalk?
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad d aataa naahi kis aakh  sunaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I find You; You eradicate egotism from within.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-ay jithahu ha-umai jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: You are beyond sweet and salty flavors; True is Your glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: ras kas saadaa baahraa sachee vadi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: You bless those whom You forgive, and unite them with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: jis no bakhsay t is day-ay aap la-ay milaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਾਦਾ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: You have placed the Ambrosial Nectar deep within the heart; the Gurmukh drinks it in.||9|| slok mÚ 3 ] (951-5) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ghat ant ar amrit  rakhi-on gurmukh  kisai pi-aa-ee. ||9||

lines.english: The stories of one's ancestors make the children good children.
lines.transliteration: baabaanee-aa kahaan ee-aa put  saput  karayn.

lines.english: They accept what is pleasing to the Will of the True Guru, and act accordingly.
lines.transliteration: je satgur bh aavai so man lain say-ee karam karayn.

lines.english: Go and consult the Simritees, the Shaastras, the writings of Vyaas, Suk Dayv, Naarad, and all those who preach to the world.
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay puchhahu simrit  saasat  bi-aas suk naarad  bachan sabh  sarisat karayn.

lines.english: Those, whom the True Lord attaches, are attached to the Truth; they contemplate theTrue Name forever.
lines.transliteration: sachai laa-ay sach lagay sadaa sach samaalayn.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈਿਨ  ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved; they redeem all their ancestors.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (951-7) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aa-ay say parvaan bh a-ay je saglay kul t aarayn. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਪੁਛਹੁ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤ  ਿਬਆਸ  ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ  ਬਚਨ  ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: The disciples whose teacher is blind, act blindly as well.
lines.transliteration: guroo jinaa kaa anDhulaa sikh  bhee anDh ay karam karayn.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸਿਚ ਲਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They walk according to their own wills, and continually speak falsehood and lies.
lines.transliteration: o-ay bhaan ai chalan aapn ai nit jhootho jhooth bolayn.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਏ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਭਏ ਿਜ ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They practice falsehood and deception, and endlessly slander others.
lines.transliteration: koorh kusat  kamaavd ay par nind aa sad aa karayn.

lines.english: Slandering others, they drown themselves, and drown all their generations as well.
lines.transliteration: o-ay aap dubay par nindkaa saglay kul dobayn.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਿਜਨਾ  ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ  ਿਸਖ ਭੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whatever the Lord links them to, to that they are linked; what can the poor creatures do? ||2|| pauVI ] (951-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jit o-ay laa-ay t it lagay u-ay bapurh ay ki-aa karayn. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਿਨ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਿਨਤ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: He keeps all under His Gaze; He created the entire Universe.
lines.transliteration: sabh nad ree and ar rakh -daa jayt ee sisat sabh  keetee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: He has linked some to falsehood and deception; these self-willed manmukhs areplundered.
lines.transliteration: ik koorh kusat  laa-i-an manmukh  vigoot ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਆਿਪ  ਡੁਬੇ ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਕਾ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord forever; their inner beings are filled with love.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa Dh i-aa-ee-ai and ar har pareet ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਤੁ ਓਇ ਲਾਏ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਲਗੇ ਉਇ ਬਪੁੜੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who have the treasure of virtue, chant the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o potai punn hai t inH vaat sipeet ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, and the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||10|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (951-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai sach sifat  sanaa-ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਰਖਦਾ  ਜੇਤੀ  ਿਸਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Men of charity gather wealth by committing sins, and then give it away in donations to charity.
lines.transliteration: satee paap kar sat  kamaahi.

lines.english: Their spiritual teachers go to their homes to instruct them.
lines.transliteration: gur deekh i-aa gh ar dayvan  jaahi.

lines.english: The woman loves the man only for his wealth;
lines.transliteration: istaree purkh ai khati-ai bh aa-o.
bhaavai aava-o bh aavai jaa-o. they come and go as they please.

lines.english: No one obeys the Shaastras or the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: saasat bayd  na maanai ko-ay.

lines.english: Everyone worships himself.
lines.transliteration: aapo aapai poojaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Becoming judges, they sit and administer justice.
lines.transliteration: kaajee ho-ay kai bahai ni-aa-ay.

lines.english: They chant on their malas, and call upon God.
lines.transliteration: fayray tasbee karay kh udaa-ay.

lines.english: They accept bribes, and block justice.
lines.transliteration: vadhee lai kai hak gavaa-ay.

lines.english: If someone asks them, they read quotations from their books.
lines.transliteration: jay ko puchhai t aa parh  sunaa-ay.

lines.english: The Muslim scriptures are in their ears and in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: turak mant ar kan rid ai samaahi.

lines.english: They plunder the people, and engage in gossip and flattery.
lines.transliteration: lok muhaaveh chaarhee kh aahi.

lines.english: They anoint their kitchens to try to become pure.
lines.transliteration: cha-ukaa day kai suchaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Behold, such is the Hindu.
lines.transliteration: aisaa hindoo vaykh hu ko-ay.

lines.english: The Yogi, with matted hair and ashes on his body, has become a householder.
lines.transliteration: jogee girhee jataa bibhoot .

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪੁਛੈ ਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The children weep in front of him and behind him.
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai roveh poot .

lines.english: He does not attain Yoga - he has lost his way.
lines.transliteration: jog na paa-i-aa jugat gavaa-ee.

lines.english: Why does he apply ashes to his forehead?
lines.transliteration: kit kaaran  sir chh aa-ee paa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;
lines.transliteration: naanak kal kaa ayhu parvaan.

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay aakhan  aapay jaan . ||1|| everyone says that he himself knows. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (951-18) mehlaa 1.

lines.english: The Hindu comes to the house of a Hindu.
lines.transliteration: hindoo kai gh ar hind oo aavai.

lines.english: He puts the sacred thread around his neck and reads the scriptures.
lines.transliteration: soot janay-oo parh  gal paavai.

lines.english: He puts on the thread, but does evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: soot paa-ay karay buri-aa-ee.

lines.english: His cleansings and washings will not be approved.
lines.transliteration: naataa Dh otaa thaa-ay na paa-ee.

lines.english: The Muslim glorifies his own faith. pMnw 952
lines.transliteration: musalmaan karay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru or a spiritual teacher, no one is accepted.
lines.transliteration: vin gur peerai ko thaa-ay na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They may be shown the way, but only a few go there.
lines.transliteration: raahu dasaa-ay othai ko jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the karma of good actions, heaven is not attained.
lines.transliteration: karnee baajh ahu bh isat na paa-ay.

lines.english: The Way of Yoga is demonstrated in the Yogi's monastery.
lines.transliteration: jogee kai ghar jugat  dasaa-ee.

lines.english: They wear ear-rings to show the way.
lines.transliteration: tit kaaran  kan mund raa paa-ee.

lines.english: Wearing ear-rings, they wander around the world.
lines.transliteration: mundraa paa-ay firai sansaar.

lines.english: The Creator Lord is everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jithai kithai sirjanhaar.

lines.english: There are as many travellers as there are beings.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a t aytay vaataa-oo.

lines.english: When one's death warrant is issued, there is no delay.
lines.transliteration: cheeree aa-ee dhil na kaa-oo.

lines.english: One who knows the Lord here, realizes Him there as well.
lines.transliteration: aythai jaanai so jaa-ay sinj aanai.

lines.english: Others, whether Hindu or Muslim, are just babbling.
lines.transliteration: hor fakarh hind oo musalmaan ai.

lines.english: Everyone's account is read in the Court of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa d ar laykh aa ho-ay.
karnee baajh ahu tarai na ko-ay. without the karma of good actions, no one crosses over.

lines.english: One who speaks the True Name of the True Lord,
lines.transliteration: sacho sach vakhaan ai ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, is not called to account hereafter. ||2|| pauVI ] (952-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak agai puchh na ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The fortress of the body is called the Mansion of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa mandar aakh ee-ai kaa-i-aa kot garh .

lines.english: The rubies and gems are found within it; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: andar laal javayharee gurmukh  har naam parh .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੁ ॥
lines.english: The body, the Mansion of the Lord, is very beautiful, when the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is implanted deep within.
lines.transliteration: har kaa mandar sareer at  sohn aa har har naam d irh.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਲਾਲ  ਜਵੇਹਰੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs ruin themselves; they boil continuously in attachment toMaya.
lines.transliteration: manmukh aap kh u-aa-i-an maa-i-aa moh nit  karh.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਿਤ  ਸੋਹਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦੜੁ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Master of all. He is found only by perfect destiny. ||11|| slok mÚ 1 ] (952-8) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa saahib ayk hai poorai bh aag paa-i-aa jaa-ee. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਆਿਪ  ਖੁਆਇਅਨ ੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਿਨਤ  ਕੜੁ ॥
lines.english: There is no Truth in suffering, there is no Truth in comfort. There is no Truth inwandering like animals through the water.
lines.transliteration: naa sat d ukhee-aa naa sat  sukh ee-aa naa sat  paan ee jant  fireh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: There is no Truth in shaving one's head; there is no Truth is studying the scriptures orwandering in foreign lands.
lines.transliteration: naa sat moond mudaa-ee kaysee naa sat  parhi-aa d ays fireh.

lines.english: There is no Truth in trees, plants or stones, in mutilating oneself or suffering in pain.
lines.transliteration: naa sat rukh ee birkh ee pathar aap t achhaaveh d ukh saheh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਦੁਖੀਆ  ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਪਾਣੀ  ਜੰਤ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: There is no Truth in binding elephants in chains; there is no Truth in grazing cows.
lines.transliteration: naa sat hast ee baDh ay sangal naa sat  gaa-ee gh aahu chareh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਮੂੰਡ ਮੁਡਾਈ  ਕੇਸੀ ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਪਿੜਆ  ਦੇਸ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He alone grants it, whose hands hold spritual perfection; he alone receives it, unto whom it is given.
lines.transliteration: jis hath siDh d ayvai jay so-ee jis no d ay-ay t is aa-ay milai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਰੁਖੀ ਿਬਰਖੀ  ਪਥਰ  ਆਪੁ  ਤਛਾਵਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ਸਹਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with glorious greatness, whose heart is filled with theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ka-o milai vadaa-ee jis gh at bheetar sabad  ravai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਹਸਤੀ  ਬਧੇ ਸੰਗਲ  ਨਾ ਸਿਤ ਗਾਈ  ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: God says, all hearts are mine, and I am in all hearts. Who can explain this to one whois confused?
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at mayray ha-o sabh naa and ar jisahi kh u-aa-ee t is ka-un  kahai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਥ ਿਸਿਧ  ਦੇਵੈ ਜੇ ਸੋਈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Who can confuse that being, unto whom I have shown the Way?
lines.transliteration: jisahi dikh aalaa vaatrh ee tiseh bh ulaavai ka-un .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਵੈ ॥
lines.english: And who can show the Path to that being whom I have confused since the beginning of time? ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (952-13) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jisahi bhulaa-ee panDh  sir tiseh d ikhaavai ka-un . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਖੁਆਈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ  ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone is a householder, who restrains his passions
lines.transliteration: so girhee jo nigarahu karai.
jap tap sanjam bh eekhi-aa karai. and begs for meditation, austerity and self-discipline.

lines.english: He gives donations to charity with his body;
lines.transliteration: punn daan kaa karay sareer.
so girhee gangaa kaa neer. such a householder is as pure as the water of the Ganges.

lines.english: Says Eeshar, the Lord is the embodiment of Truth.
lines.transliteration: bolai eesar sat saroop.

lines.english: The supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (952-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: param tant  meh raykh  na roop. ||2||

lines.english: He alone is a detached hermit, who burns away his self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: so a-uDhoot ee jo Dh oopai aap.

lines.english: He begs for suffering as his food.
lines.transliteration: bhikh i-aa bh ojan karai sant aap.

lines.english: In the city of the heart, he begs for charity.
lines.transliteration: a-uhath patan  meh bh eekhi-aa karai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਿਹ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Such a renunciate ascends to the City of God.
lines.transliteration: so a-uDhoot ee siv pur charh ai.

lines.english: Says Gorakh, God is the embodiment of Truth;
lines.transliteration: bolai gorakh sat  saroop.

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: param tant  meh raykh  na roop. ||3|| the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||3|| mÚ 1 ] (952-17) mehlaa 1.

lines.english: He alone is an Udasi, a shaven-headed renunciate, who embraces renunciation.
lines.transliteration: so udaasee je paalay ud aas.

lines.english: He sees the Immaculate Lord dwelling in both the upper and lower regions.
lines.transliteration: araDh uraDh  karay niranjan vaas.

lines.english: He balances the sun and the moon energies.
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj kee paa-ay gandh .

lines.english: The body-wall of such an Udasi does not collapse.
lines.transliteration: tis ud aasee kaa parh ai na kanDh .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਤੰਤ ਮਿਹ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Gopi Chand, God is the embodiment of Truth;
lines.transliteration: bolai gopee chand sat  saroop.

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: param tant  meh raykh  na roop. ||4|| the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||4|| mÚ 1 ] (952-19) mehlaa 1.

lines.english: He alone is a Paakhandi, who cleanses his body of filth.
lines.transliteration: so paakhandee je kaa-i-aa pakh aalay.

lines.english: The fire of his body illuminates God within.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kee agan barahm parjaalay.

lines.english: He does not waste his energy in wet dreams. pMnw 953
lines.transliteration: supnai bind na d ay-ee jh arnaa.

lines.english: Such a Paakhandi does not grow old or die.
lines.transliteration: tis paakh andee jaraa na marn aa.

lines.english: Says Charpat, God is the embodiment of Truth;
lines.transliteration: bolai charpat sat saroop.

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: param tant  meh raykh  na roop. ||5|| the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||5|| mÚ 1 ] (953-2) mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਤੰਤ ਮਿਹ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: He alone is a Bairaagi, who turns himself toward God.
lines.transliteration: so bairaagee je ultay barahm.

lines.english: In the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, he erects his pillar.
lines.transliteration: gagan mandal meh ropai thamm.

lines.english: Night and day, he remains in deep inner meditation.
lines.transliteration: ahinis antar rahai Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Such a Bairaagi is just like the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: tay bairaagee sat  samaan.

lines.english: Says Bhart'har, God is the embodiment of Truth;
lines.transliteration: bolai bharthar sat  saroop.

lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: param tant  meh raykh  na roop. ||6|| the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||6|| mÚ 1 ] (953-3) mehlaa 1.

lines.english: How is evil eradicated? How can the true way of life be found?
lines.transliteration: ki-o marai mandaa ki-o jeevai jugat .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਤੰਤ ਮਿਹ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: What is the use of piercing the ears, or begging for food?
lines.transliteration: kann parhaa-ay ki-aa kh aajai bh ugat.

lines.english: Throughout existence and non-existence, there is only the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aasat naasat  ayko naa-o.

lines.english: What is that Word, which holds the heart in its place?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so akh ar jit rahai hi-aa-o.

lines.english: Dhoop chh aav jay sam kar sahai. When you look alike upon sunshine and shade,

lines.transliteration: taa naanak aakh ai gur ko kahai. says Nanak, then the Guru will speak to you.

lines.english: The students follow the six systems.
lines.transliteration: chhi-a vart aaray vart eh poot .

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਸਹੈ ॥
lines.english: They are neither worldly people, nor detached renunciates.
lines.transliteration: naa sansaaree naa a-uDhoot .

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਖੈ  ਗੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.english: One who remains absorbed in the Formless Lord
lines.transliteration: nirankaar jo rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kaahay bheekh i-aa mangan  jaa-ay. ||7|| - why should he go out begging? ||7|| pauVI ] (953-6) pa-orhee.

lines.english: That alone is said to be the Lord's temple, where the Lord is known.
lines.transliteration: har mandar so-ee aakh ee-ai jithahu har jaat aa.

lines.english: In the human body, the Guru's Word is found, when one understands that the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all.
lines.transliteration: maanas dayh gur bachnee paa-i-aa sabh  aatam raam pachh aataa.

lines.english: Don't look for Him outside your self. The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, is withinthe home of your own heart.
lines.transliteration: baahar mool na khojee-ai gh ar maahi biDh aataa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the value of the Lord's temple; theywaste away and lose their lives.
lines.transliteration: manmukh har mand ar kee saar na jaan nee tinee janam gavaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜਥਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is pervading in all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He can befound. ||12|| slok mÚ 3 ] (953-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ik varatd aa gur sabd ee paa-i-aa jaa-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸ  ਦੇਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Only a fool listens to the words of the fool.
lines.transliteration: moorakh hovai so sun ai moorakh  kaa kahn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਖੋਜੀਐ  ਘਰ ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: What are the signs of the fool? What does the fool do?
lines.transliteration: moorakh kay ki-aa lakh an hai ki-aa moorakh  kaa karn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: A fool is stupid; he dies of egotism.
lines.transliteration: moorakh oh je mugaDh  hai ahaNkaaray marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: His actions always bring him pain; he lives in pain.
lines.transliteration: ayt kamaan ai sad aa dukh dukh hee meh rahn aa.

lines.english: If someone's beloved friend falls into the pit, what can be used to pull him out?
lines.transliteration: at pi-aaraa pavai kh oohi kihu sanjam karn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord, and remains detached.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay so karay veechaar os alipat o rahn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਕੇ ਿਕਆ  ਲਖਣ  ਹੈ ਿਕਆ  ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, he saves himself, and he carries across those who are drowning as well.
lines.transliteration: har naam japai aap uDhrai os pichh ai dubd ay bh ee tarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਓਹੁ ਿਜ ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਹੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ  ਮਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he acts in accordance with the Will of God; he endures whatever he isgiven. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (953-13) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bh aavai so karay jo d ay-ay so sahn aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਰਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, O mind, to the True Teachings.
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai ray manaa sun ee-ai sikh  sahee.

lines.english: Opening His ledger, God will call you to account.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa rab mangaysee-aa baith aa kadh  vahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਓਸੁ ਅਿਲਪਤੋ  ਰਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those rebels who have unpaid accounts shall be called out.
lines.transliteration: talbaa pa-usan aakee-aa baakee jinaa rahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਆਿਪ  ਉਧਰੈ  ਓਸੁ ਿਪਛੈ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਭੀ ਤਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall be appointed to punish them.
lines.transliteration: ajraa-eel faraystaa hosee aa-ay t a-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They will find no way to escape coming and going in reincarnation; they are trapped in the narrow path.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  na sujh -ee bh eerhee galee fahee.

lines.english: Falsehood will come to an end, O Nanak, and Truth will prevail in the end. ||2|| pauVI ] (953-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: koorh nikh utay naankaa orh ak sach rahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਖੈ  ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਿਸਖ ਸਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The body and everything belongs to the Lord; the Lord Himself is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: har kaa sabh sareer hai har rav rahi-aa sabh  aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ  ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ  ਬੈਠਾ ਕਿਢ ਵਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about it.
lines.transliteration: har kee keemat na pavai kichh  kahan  na jaapai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one praises the Lord, imbued with feelings of devotion.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee salaahee-ai har bhagt ee raapai.

lines.english: The mind and body are totally rejuvenated, and egotism is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: sabh man t an hari-aa ho-i-aa ahaNkaar gavaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਭੀੜੀ  ਗਲੀ  ਫਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Everything is the play of the Lord. The Gurmukh understands this. ||13|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (953-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  har kaa kh ayl hai gurmukh  kisai bujh aa-ee. ||13||

lines.english: Branded with a thousand marks of disgrace, Indra cried in shame.
lines.transliteration: sahaNsar daan d ay ind ar ro-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Paras Raam returned home crying.
lines.transliteration: paras raam rovai ghar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭੁ ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Ajai cried and wept, when he was made to eat the manure he had given, pretending itwas charity.
lines.transliteration: ajai so rovai bheekh i-aa kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Such is the punishment received in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisee dargeh milai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Rama wept when he was sent into exile, pMnw 954
lines.transliteration: rovai raam nikaalaa bha-i-aa.
seetaa lakh man vichh urh ga-i-aa. and separated from Sita and Lakhshman.

lines.english: The ten-headed Raawan, who stole away Sita with the beat of his tambourine, wept when he lost Sri Lanka.
lines.transliteration: rovai dehsir lank gavaa-ay. jin seet aa aad ee da-uroo vaa-ay.

lines.english: The Paandavas once lived in the Presence of the Lord; they were made slaves, and wept.
lines.transliteration: roveh paaNdav bha-ay majoor. jin kai su-aamee rahat  hadoor.

lines.english: Janmayjaa wept, that he had lost his way.
lines.transliteration: rovai janmayjaa khu-ay ga-i-aa.

lines.english: One mistake, and he became a sinner.
lines.transliteration: aykee kaaran paapee bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: The Shaykhs, Pirs and spiritual teachers weep;
lines.transliteration: roveh saykh masaa-ik peer.
ant kaal mat  laagai bh eerh. at the very last instant, they suffer in agony.

lines.english: The kings weep - their ears are cut;
lines.transliteration: roveh raajay kann parhaa-ay.
ghar gh ar maageh bh eekhi-aa jaa-ay. they go begging from house to house.

lines.english: The miser weeps; he has to leave behind the wealth he has gathered.
lines.transliteration: roveh kirpan saNcheh Dhan jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, weeps when his learning is gone.
lines.transliteration: pandit roveh gi-aan gavaa-ay.

lines.english: The young woman weeps because she has no husband.
lines.transliteration: baalee rovai naahi bhat aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the whole world is suffering.
lines.transliteration: naanak dukh ee-aa sabh  sansaar.

lines.english: He alone is victorious, who believes in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mannay naa-o so-ee jin jaa-ay.

lines.english: No other action is of any account. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (954-6) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: a-uree karam na laykhai laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Meditation, austerity and everything come through belief in the Lord's Name. All otheractions are useless.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sabh  kichh  mani-ai avar kaaraa sabh  baad .

lines.english: O Nanak, believe in the One who is worth believing in. By Guru's Grace, he is realized.||2|| pauVI ] (954-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak mani-aa mannee-ai bujhee-ai gur parsaad . ||2||

lines.english: The union of the body and the soul-swan was pre-ordained by the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa hans Dhur mayl kart ai likh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is hidden, and yet pervading all. He is revealed to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh gupat  varatd aa gurmukh  paragtaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਅਵਿਰ  ਕਾਰਾ  ਸਿਭ ਬਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chanting His Praises, one merges in His Glories.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai gun  uchrai gun  maahi samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: True is the True Word of the Guru's Bani. One unites in Union with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sach hai sach mayl milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself is everything; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||14|| slok mÚ 2 ] (954-9) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap hai aapay d ay-ay vadi-aa-ee. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਹੰਸ ਧੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the blind man may go to appraise the jewels,
lines.transliteration: naanak anDhaa ho-ay kai rat naa parkh an jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ratnaa saar na jaan -ee aavai aap lakh aa-ay. ||1|| but he will not know their value; he will return home after exposing his ignorance.||1|| mÚ 2 ] (954-11) mehlaa 2.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ  ਗੁਣ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Jeweller has come, and opened up the bag of jewels.
lines.transliteration: ratnaa kayree guthlee rat nee kh olee aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The merchandise and the merchant are merged together.
lines.transliteration: vakhar t ai van jaari-aa d uhaa rahee samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: They alone purchase the gem, O Nanak, who have virtue in their purse.
lines.transliteration: jin gun palai naankaa maan ak van jahi say-ay.

lines.english: Those who do not appreciate the value of the jewels, wander like blind men in the world. ||2|| pauVI ] (954-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ratnaa saar na jaan nee anDh ay vat eh lo-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਤਨਾ  ਪਰਖਣ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The fortress of the body has nine gates; the tenth gate is kept hidden.
lines.transliteration: na-o darvaajay kaa-i-aa kot hai d asvai gupat  rakheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨਾ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਆਵੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਲਖਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The rigid door is not open; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad can it beopened.
lines.transliteration: bajar kapaat na khulnee gur sabad  khuleejai.

lines.english: The unstruck sound current resounds and vibrates there. The Word of the Guru'sShabad is heard.
lines.transliteration: anhad vaajay Dh un vajd ay gur sabad  suneejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨਾ  ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਥਲੀ  ਰਤਨੀ  ਖੋਲੀ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within the nucleus of the heart, the Divine Light shines forth. Throughdevotional worship, one meets the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tit ghat ant ar chaann aa kar bh agat mileejai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਖਰ  ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਦੁਹਾ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating all. He Himself created the creation. ||15|| slok mÚ 2 ] (954-15) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ayk varatd aa jin aapay rachan rachaa-ee. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਮਾਣਕ  ਵਣਜਿਹ  ਸੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He is truly blind, who follows the way shown by the blind man.
lines.transliteration: anDhay kai raahi d asi-ai anDh aa ho-ay so jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨਾ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਅੰਧੇ ਵਤਿਹ  ਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, why should the one who can see, get lost?
lines.transliteration: ho-ay sujaakhaa naankaa so ki-o ujh arh paa-ay.

lines.english: Do not call them blind, who have no eyes in their face.
lines.transliteration: anDhay ayhi na aakh ee-an jin mukh  lo-in naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਦਸਵੈ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਰਖੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are blind, O Nanak, who wander away from their Lord and Master. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (954-17) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anDhay say-ee naankaa kh asmahu gh uthay jaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਜਰ  ਕਪਾਟ  ਨ ਖੁਲਨੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਖੁਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord has made blind - the Lord can make him see again.
lines.transliteration: saahib anDhaa jo kee-aa karay sujaakh aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਿਨ ਵਜਦੇ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਣੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: He acts only as he knows, although he may be spoken to a hundred times.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa jaanai t ayho vart ai jay sa-o aakh ai ko-ay.

lines.english: Where the real thing is not seen, self-conceit prevails there - know this well.
lines.transliteration: jithai so vasat na jaap-ee aapay vart a-o jaan .

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਚਨ  ਰਚਾਈ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, how can the purshaser purchase the real thing, if he cannot recognize it? ||2|| mÚ 2 ] (954-19) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gaahak ki-o la-ay sakai na vasat pachh aan. ||2||

lines.english: How can someone be called blind, if he was made blind by the Lord's Command?
lines.transliteration: so ki-o anDhaa aakh ee-ai je hukmahu anDh aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਿਹ  ਦਿਸਐ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command should be called blind. ||3|| pMnw 955 pauVI ] (955-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na bujh-ee anDh aa kahee-ai so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Deep within the body is the fortress of the Lord, and all lands and countries.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar garh  kot hai sabh  disant ar daysaa.

lines.english: He Himself sits in primal, profound Samaadhi; He Himself is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: aapay taarh ee laa-ee-an sabh  meh parvaysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਗੜੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਭ ਿਦਸੰਤਰ  ਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself remains hidden within it.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat saajee-an aap gupat rakh aysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, the Lord is known, and the Truth is revealed.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay jaan i-aa sach pargatee-aysaa.

lines.english: He is True, the Truest of the True; the Guru has imparted this understanding. ||16|| slok mÚ 1 ] (955-3) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  sacho sach hai gur sojh ee paa-ee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਏਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Night is the summer season, and day is the winter season; sexual desire and angerare the two fields planted.
lines.transliteration: saavan raat  ahaarh  dihu kaam kroDh  du-ay kh ayt.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Greed prepares the soil, and the seed of falsehood is planted; attachment and loveare the farmer and hired hand.
lines.transliteration: lab vatar d arog bee-o haalee raahak hayt .

lines.english: Contemplation is the plow, and corruption is the harvest; this is what one earns andeats, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: hal beechaar vikaar man hukmee kh atay kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਣੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਅਹਾੜੁ  ਿਦਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਖੇਤ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when one is called to give his account, he will be barren and infertile. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (955-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laykhai mangi-ai a-ut  janaydaa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲਬੁ ਵਤਰ੍ ਦਰੋਗੁ  ਬੀਉ ਹਾਲੀ  ਰਾਹਕੁ  ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.english: Make the Fear of God the farm, purity the water, truth and contentment the cows andbulls,
lines.transliteration: bha-o bh u-ay pavit  paan ee sat  santokh balayd .

lines.punjabi: ਹਲੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਮਣ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਖਟੇ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: hal halaymee haalee chit chayt aa vat ar vakh at sanjog. humility the plow, consciousness the plowman, remembrance the preparation of thesoil, and union with the Lord the planting time.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਿਗਐ  ਅਉਤੁ  ਜਣੇਦਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, and His Forgiving Grace the harvest. Do this, and the whole world will seem false.
lines.transliteration: naa-o beej bakhsees bohal d unee-aa sagal d arog.

lines.english: O Nanak, if He bestows His Merciful Glance  of Grace, then all your separation will be ended. ||2|| pauVI ] (955-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree karam ho-ay jaaveh sagal vijog. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਭੁਇ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਬਲੇਦ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is trapped in the darkness of emotional attachment; in thelove of duality he speaks.
lines.transliteration: manmukh moh gubaar hai d oojai bh aa-ay bolai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲੁ ਹਲੇਮੀ  ਹਾਲੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਚੇਤਾ  ਵਤਰ੍ ਵਖਤ  ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: The love of duality brings pain forever; he churns the water endlessly.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay sad aa dukh hai nit  neer virolai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਬੀਜੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ  ਬੋਹਲ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਦਰੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he churns, and obtainsthe essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai math t at kadh olai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਵਜੋਗ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Divine Light illuminates his heart deep within; he seeks the Lord, and obtainsHim.
lines.transliteration: antar pargaas gh at chaann aa har laDh aa tolai.

lines.english: He Himself deludes in doubt; no one can comment on this. ||17|| slok mÚ 2 ] (955-9) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay bharam bh ulaa-id aa kichh  kahan  na jaa-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਬੋਲੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you.
lines.transliteration: naanak chintaa mat  karahu chint aa tis hee hay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਿਨਤ  ਨੀਰੁ ਿਵਰੋਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: He created the creatures in water, and He gives them their nourishment.
lines.transliteration: jal meh jant upaa-i-an t inaa bh e rojee d ay-ay.

lines.english: There are no stores open there, and no one farms there.
lines.transliteration: othai hat na chal-ee naa ko kiras karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਲਧਾ  ਟੋਲੈ ॥
lines.english: No business is ever transacted there, and no one buys or sells.
lines.transliteration: sa-udaa mool na hova-ee naa ko la-ay na d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Animals eat other animals; this is what the Lord has given them as food.
lines.transliteration: jee-aa kaa aahaar jee-a khaan aa ayhu karay-i.

lines.english: He created them in the oceans, and He provides for them as well.
lines.transliteration: vich upaa-ay saa-iraa tinaa bh e saar karay-i.

lines.english: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (955-13) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak chintaa mat  karahu chint aa tis hee hay-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਭ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this soul is the fish, and death is the hungry fisherman.
lines.transliteration: naanak ih jee-o machhulee jh eevar t arisnaa kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਿਕਰਸ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: The blind man does not even think of this. And suddenly, the net is cast.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa anDh na chayt -ee parh ai achint aa jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਉਦਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, his consciousness is unconscious, and he departs, bound by anxiety.
lines.transliteration: naanak chit achayt  hai chint aa baDh aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਖਾਣਾ  ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: But if the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites the soul with Himself. ||2|| pauVI ] (955-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: nadar karay jay aapn ee taa aapay la-ay milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: They are true, forever true, who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say jan saachay sadaa sad aa jinee har ras peet aa.

lines.english: The True Lord abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; He strikes the true bargain.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sachaa man vasai sach sa-ud aa keet aa.

lines.english: Everything is in the home of the self within; only the very fortunate obtain it.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  ghar hee maahi hai vadbh aagee leet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਮਛੁਲੀ  ਝੀਵਰੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਕਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: The hunger within is conquered and overcome, singing the Glorious Praises of theLord.
lines.transliteration: antar t arisnaa mar ga-ee har gun  gaaveet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ  ਪੜੈ ਅਿਚੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself blesses them with understanding. ||18|| slok mÚ 1 ] (955-17) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaa-i-an aapay day-ay bujh aa-ee. ||18||

lines.english: The cotton is ginned, woven and spun;
lines.transliteration: vayl pinjaa-i-aa kat  gunaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਤਾ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kat kut kar khumb charh aa-i-aa. the cloth is laid out, washed and bleached white.

lines.english: The tailor cuts it with his scissors, and sews it with his thread.
lines.transliteration: lohaa vadhay d arjee paarh ay soo-ee Dh aagaa seevai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Thus, the torn and tattered honor is sewn up again, through the Lord's Praise, O Nanak, and one lives the true life.
lines.transliteration: i-o pat paatee sift ee seepai naanak jeevat  jeevai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ  ਕੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Becoming worn, the cloth is torn; with needle and thread it is sewn up again.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay puraanaa kaparh  paatai soo-ee Dh aagaa gandh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਲੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: It will not last for a month, or even a week. It barely lasts for an hour, or even a moment. pMnw 956
lines.transliteration: maahu pakh kihu chalai naahee gh arhee muhat  kichh  handh ai.

lines.english: But the Truth does not grow old; and when it is stitched, it is never torn again.
lines.transliteration: sach puraanaa hovai naahee seet aa kad ay na paatai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੀਤਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਟੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is the Truest of the True. While we meditate on Him, we see Him. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (956-2) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib sacho sachaa tichar jaapee jaapai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਿਤਚਰੁ ਜਾਪੀ  ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The knife is Truth, and its steel is totally True.
lines.transliteration: sach kee kaatee sach sabh  saar.

lines.english: Its workmanship is incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: ghaarh at tis kee apar apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਕਾਤੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: It is sharpened on the grindstone of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabday saan  rakhaa-ee laa-ay.

lines.english: It is placed in the scabbard of virtue.
lines.transliteration: gun kee thaykai vich samaa-ay.

lines.english: If the Shaykh is killed with that,
lines.transliteration: tis daa kuth aa hovai saykh .
lohoo lab nikthaa vaykh. then the blood of greed will spill out.

lines.english: One who is slaughtered in this ritualistic way, will be attached to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay halaal lagai hak jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, at the Lord's door, he is absorbed into His Blessed Vision. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (956-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dar d eedaar samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: A beautiful dagger hangs by your waist, and you ride such a beautiful horse.
lines.transliteration: kamar kataaraa baNkurhaa bankay kaa asvaar.

lines.english: But don't be too proud; O Nanak, you may fall head first to the ground. ||3|| pauVI ] (956-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: garab na keejai naankaa mat sir aavai bh aar. ||3||

lines.english: They alone walk as Gurmukh, who receive the Shabad in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: so satsangat  sabad  milai jo gurmukh  chalai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਿਰ  ਕਟਾਰਾ  ਬੰਕੁੜਾ  ਬੰਕੇ ਕਾ ਅਸਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the True Lord, they become truthful; they carry in their robes thesupplies of the Lord's wealth.
lines.transliteration: sach Dhi-aa-in say sachay jin har kh arach Dh an palai.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਬੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਮਤੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The devotees look beautiful, singing the Praises of the Lord; following the Guru'sTeachings, they become stable and unchanging.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sohan gun  gaavd ay gurmat  achlai.

lines.english: They enshrine the jewel of contemplation within their minds, and the most sublimeWord of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ratan beechaar man vasi-aa gur kai sabad  bhalai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||19|| slok mÚ 3 ] (956-7) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaa-idaa aapay d ay-ay vadi-aa-ee. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਇਿਨ  ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਖਰਚੁ  ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Everyone is filled with hope; hardly anyone is free of hope.
lines.transliteration: aasaa andar sabh  ko ko-ay niraasaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਨ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦੇ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅਚਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed is the birth of one, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (956-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo mar jeevi-aa sahilaa aa-i-aa so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Nothing is in the hands of hope. How can one become free of hope?
lines.transliteration: naa kichh aasaa hath hai kay-o niraasaa ho-ay.

lines.english: What can this poor being do? The Lord Himself creates confusion. ||2|| pauVI ] (956-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ki-aa karay ayh bapurhee jaaN bholaa-ay so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Dharig jeevan  sansaar sachay naam bin. Cursed is the life in this world, without the True Name.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੋਇ ਿਨਰਾਸਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: God is the Great Giver of givers. His wealth is permanent and unchanging.
lines.transliteration: parabh d aataa daataar nihchal ayhu Dh an.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਮਿਰ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਸਿਹਲਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That humble being is immaculate, who worships the Lord with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: saas saas aaraaDhay nirmal so-ay jan.

lines.english: With your tongue, vibrate the One Inaccessible Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee agam rasnaa ayk bh an.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਸਾ  ਹਿਥ ਹੈ ਕੇਉ ਿਨਰਾਸਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He is all-pervading everywhere. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||20|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (956-12) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa sarbat naanak bal jaa-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ  ਜ ਭਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The union between the lake of the True Guru, and the swan of the soul, was pre-ordained from the very beginning, by the Pleasure of the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: sarvar hans Dhuray hee maylaa kh asmai ayvai bh aanaa.

lines.english: The diamonds are in this lake; they are the food of the swans.
lines.transliteration: sarvar andar heeraa mot ee so hansaa kaa kh aanaa.

lines.english: The cranes and the ravens may be very wise, but they do not remain in this lake.
lines.transliteration: bagulaa kaag na rah-ee sarvar jay hovai at si-aan aa.

lines.english: They do not find their food there; their food is different.
lines.transliteration: onaa rijak na pa-i-o othai onHaa horo khaan aa.

lines.english: Practicing Truth, the True Lord is found. False is the pride of the false.
lines.transliteration: sach kamaanai sacho paa-ee-ai koorhai koorh aa maan aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, who are so pre-destined by the Lord'sCommand. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (956-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kou sat gur mili-aa jinaa Dh uray paiyaa parvaan aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰਬਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is immaculate, as are those who think of Him.
lines.transliteration: saahib mayraa ujlaa jay ko chit karay-i.

lines.english: O Nanak, serve Him, who gives to you forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: naanak so-ee sayvee-ai sadaa sad aa jo d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਵਰ  ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰੇ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ  ਖਸਮੈ  ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, serve Him; by serving Him, sorrow is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: naanak so-ee sayvee-ai jit sayvi-ai d ukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਵਰ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋ ਹੰਸਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Faults and demerits vanish, and virtues take their place; peace comes to dwell in themind. ||2|| pauVI ] (956-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: avgun vanj an gun  raveh man sukh  vasai aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਗੁਲਾ  ਕਾਗੁ  ਨ ਰਹਈ  ਸਰਵਿਰ  ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਿਤ  ਿਸਆਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself is absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap varatdaa aap t aarhee laa-ee-an.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਨ ਪਇਓ ਓਥੈ ਓਨਾ  ਹੋਰੋ ਖਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself instructs; the Gurmukh is satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee updaysd aa gurmukh  patee-aa-ee-an.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਕਮਾਣੈ  ਸਚੋ ਪਾਈਐ  ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some, He causes to wander in the wilderness, while others are committed to Hisdevotional worship.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay ujharh  paa-i-an ik bh agtee laa-i-an.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੌ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਿਜਨਾ  ਧੁਰੇ ਪੈਯਾ  ਪਰਵਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; He Himself attaches mortals to His Name.
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaa-ay so bujh see aapay naa-ay laa-ee-an.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, true greatness is obtained.||21||1|| Sudh|| pMnw 957 rwmklI kI vwr mhlw 5  (957-1) raamkalee kee vaar mehlaa 5 Vaar Of Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (957-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mÚ 5 ] (957-2) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai sachee vadi-aa-ee. ||21||1|| suDh .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: As I have heard of the True Guru, so I have seen Him.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa satgur sun eedaa taiso hee mai deeth .

lines.english: He re-unites the separated ones with God; He is the Mediator at the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa maylay parabh oo har d argeh kaa baseeth .

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ  ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਡੀਠੁ ॥
lines.english: He implants the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and eradicates the illness of egotism.
lines.transliteration: har naamo mantar d arirhaa-idaa katay ha-umai rog.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ  ਮੇਲੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਕਾ ਬਸੀਠੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone meets the True Guru, who has such union pre-ordained. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (957-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur t inaa milaa-i-aa jinaa Dh uray pa-i-aa sanjog. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਦਾ  ਕਟੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: If the One Lord is my Friend, then all are my friends. If the One Lord is my enemy,then all fight with me.
lines.transliteration: ik sajan sabh  sajnaa ik vairee sabh  vaad .

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has shown me that, without the Name, everything is useless.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai daykh aali-aa vin  naavai sabh  baad .

lines.english: The faithless cynics and the evil people wander in reincarnation; they are attached toother tastes.
lines.transliteration: saakat d urjan bh armi-aa jo lagay d oojai saad .

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਸਿਭ ਸਜਣਾ  ਇਕੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਿਭ ਵਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has realized the Lord God, by the Grace of the Guru, the True Guru.||2|| pauVI ] (957-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har parabh bujh i-aa gur sat gur kai parsaad . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord created the Creation.
lines.transliteration: thatanhaarai thaat aapay hee thati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਦੁਰਜਨ  ਭਰਿਮਆ  ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the perfect Banker; He Himself earns His profit.
lines.transliteration: aapay pooraa saahu aapay hee khati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬੁਿਝਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself made the expansive Universe; He Himself is imbued with joy.
lines.transliteration: aapay kar paasaar aapay rang rati-aa.

lines.english: The value of God's almighty creative power cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  keem na paa-ay alakh  barahmati-aa.

lines.english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable, endless, the farthest of the far.
lines.transliteration: agam athaah bay-ant parai parti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਖਿਟਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the greatest Emperor; He Himself is His own Prime Minister.
lines.transliteration: aapay vad paatisaahu aap vajeerti-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਰੰਗ ਰਿਟਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one knows His worth, or the greatness of His resting place.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na jaanai keem kayvad mati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ਅਲਖ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਿਟਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is our True Lord and Master. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||1|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (957-9) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib aap gurmukh pargati-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O my beloved friend: please show me the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sun sajan  pareet am mayri-aa mai sat gur dayh d ikhaal.

lines.english: I dedicate my mind to Him; I keep Him continually enshrined within my heart.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis d ayvaa man aapn aa nit  hirdai rakh aa samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੀਮ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਿਟਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the One and Only True Guru, life in this world is cursed.
lines.transliteration: ikas satgur baahraa Dh arig jeevan  sansaar.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, with whom He constantly abides. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (957-11) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak satgur t inaa milaa-i-on jin sad  hee vart ai naal. ||1||

lines.english: Deep within me is the longing to meet You; how can I find You, God?
lines.transliteration: mayrai antar lochaa milan  kee ki-o paavaa parabh  tohi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਜਣ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਿਦਖਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: I will search for someone, some friend, who will unite me with my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aisaa sajan lorh  lahu jo maylay pareet am mohi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him; wherever I look, there He is.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai maylaa-i-aa jat d aykhaa tat so-ay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak serves that God; there is no other as great as He is. ||2|| pauVI ] (957-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak so parabh sayvi-aa t is jayvad avar na ko-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਮਲਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਿਜਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Great Giver, the Generous Lord; with what mouth can I praise Him?
lines.transliteration: dayvan haar d aataar kit  mukh  salaahee-ai.

lines.english: In His Mercy, He protects, preserves and sustains us.
lines.transliteration: jis rakhai kirpaa Dh aar rijak samaahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਚਾ  ਿਮਲਣ  ਕੀ ਿਕਉ ਪਾਵਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੋਿਹ ॥
lines.english: No one is under anyone else's control; He is the One Support of all.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na kis hee vas sabhnaa ik Dh ar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ  ਸਜਣੁ  ਲੋਿੜ  ਲਹੁ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ॥
lines.english: He cherishes all as His children, and reaches out with His hand.
lines.transliteration: paalay baalak vaag day kai aap kar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ  ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He stages His joyous plays, which no one understands at all.
lines.transliteration: kardaa anad  binod  kichh oo na jaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The all-powerful Lord gives His Support to all; I am a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: sarab Dhaar samrath ha-o t is kurbaan ee-ai.

lines.english: Night and day, sing the Praises of the One who is worthy of being praised.
lines.transliteration: gaa-ee-ai raat d inant gaavan  jogi-aa.

lines.english: Those who fall at the Guru's Feet, enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2|| slok mÚ 5 ] (957-17) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo gur kee pairee paahi tinee har ras bh ogi-aa. ||2||

lines.english: He has widened the narrow path for me, and preserved my integrity, along with thatof my family.
lines.transliteration: bheerh ahu moklaa-ee keet ee-an sabh  rakhay kutambi naal.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਵਿਸ ਸਭਨਾ  ਇਕ ਧਰ ॥
lines.english: He Himself has arranged and resolved my affairs. I dwell upon that God forever.
lines.transliteration: kaaraj aap savaari-an so parabh sad aa sabh aal.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਲੇ  ਬਾਲਕ  ਵਾਿਗ  ਦੇ ਕੈ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰ ॥
lines.english: God is my mother and father; He hugs me close in His embrace, and cherishes me, like His tiny baby.
lines.transliteration: parabh maat  pitaa kanth  laa-id aa lahurh ay baalak paal.

lines.english: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me. O Nanak, the Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||1|| pMnw 958 mÚ 5 ] (958-1) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal ho-ay sabh  jee-a jant ar har naanak nad ar nihaal. ||1||

lines.english: To ask for any other than You, Lord, is the most miserable of miseries.
lines.transliteration: vin tuDh hor je mangn aa sir d ukhaa kai d ukh.

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me content; may the hunger of my mindbe satisfied.
lines.transliteration: deh naam sant okhee-aa ut rai man kee bh ukh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਿਜ ਮੰਗਣਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਦੁਖਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has made the woods and meadows green again. O Nanak, is it any wonderthat He blesses human beings as well? ||2|| pauVI ] (958-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur van t in hari-aa keet i-aa naanak ki-aa manukh . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਉਤਰੈ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.english: Such is that Great Giver; may I never forget Him from my mind.
lines.transliteration: so aisaa daat aar manhu na veesrai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਵਣੁ ਿਤਣੁ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਕੀਿਤਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਆ  ਮਨੁਖ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I cannot survive without Him, for an instant, for a moment, for a second.
lines.transliteration: gharh ee na muhat  chasaa t is bin naa sarai.

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, He is with us; how can we hide anything from Him?
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sang ki-aa ko luk karai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: One whose honor He Himself has preserved, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jis pat rakh ai aap so bh avjal t arai.

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ  ਚਸਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾ ਸਰੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone is a devotee, a spiritual teacher, and a disciplined pratictioner of meditation, whom the Lord has so blessed.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  gi-aanee t apaa jis kirpaa karai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਲੁਿਕ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone is perfect and renowned as supreme, whom the Lord has blessed with Hispower.
lines.transliteration: so pooraa parDhaan jis no bal Dh arai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਿਤ ਰਖੈ ਆਿਪ  ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone endures the unendurable, whom the Lord inspires to endure it.
lines.transliteration: jisahi jaraa-ay aap so-ee ajar jarai.

lines.english: And he alone meets the True Lord, within whose mind the Guru's Mantra is implanted.||3|| sloku mÚ 5 ] (958-6) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis hee mili-aa sach mant ar gur man Dh arai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Dhan so raag surangrh ay aalaapat  sabh  tikh jaa-ay. Blessed are those beautiful Ragas which, when chanted, quench all thirst.
Dhan so jant  suhaavrh ay jo gurmukh  japday naa-o. Blessed are those beautiful people who, as Gurmukh, chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਨ ਧਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who single-mindedly worship and adore the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinee ik man ik araaDhi-aa t in sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.english: I yearn for the dust of their feet; by His Grace, it is obtained.
lines.transliteration: tin kee Dh oorh ham baachh -day karmee palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੜੇ  ਆਲਾਪਤ  ਸਭ ਿਤਖ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who are imbued with love for the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jo ratay rang govid  kai ha-o t in balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਜਪਦੇ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I tell them the state of my soul, and pray that I may be united with the Sovereign Lord King, my Friend.
lines.transliteration: aakhaa birthaa jee-a kee har sajan  maylhu raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him, and the pains of birth and death havedeparted.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai maylaa-i-aa janam maran d ukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਧੂਿੜ ਹਮ ਬਾਛਦੇ ਕਰਮੀ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the inaccessible, infinitely beautiful Lord, and he will not goanywhere else. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (958-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak paa-i-aa agam roop anat na kaahoo jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਕੈ ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so vaylaa gh arhee Dh an Dh an moorat  pal saar. Blessed is that time, blessed is that hour , blessed is that second, excellent is that instant;

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਾ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so d inas sanjogrh aa jit dithaa gur d arsaar. blessed is that day, and that opportunity, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The mind's desires are fulfilled, when the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord is obtained.
lines.transliteration: man kee-aa ichhaa pooree-aa har paa-i-aa agam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਗਮ  ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਤ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Egotism and emotional attachment are eradicated, and one leans only on the Supportof the True Name.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai tutaa mohrh aa ik sach naam aaDh aar.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, one who is committed to the Lord's service - the whole world issaved along with him. ||2|| pauVI ] (958-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak lagaa sayv har uDhri-aa sagal sansaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ  ਘੜੀ  ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: How rare are those who are blessed to praise the Lord, in devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: sifat salaahan  bhagat virlay d itee-an.

lines.english: Those who are blessed with the Lord's treasures are not called to give their accountagain.
lines.transliteration: sa-upay jis bhandaar fir puchh  na leet ee-an.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ  ਇਛਾ  ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with His Love are absorbed in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: jis no lagaa rang say rang rati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਤੁਟਾ ਮੋਹੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They take the Support of the One Name; the One Name is their only food.
lines.transliteration: onaa iko naam aDhaar ikaa un bh ati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਲਗਾ  ਸੇਵ ਹਿਰ ਉਧਿਰਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: For their sake, the world eats and enjoys.
lines.transliteration: onaa pichhai jag bh unchai bh og-ee.

lines.english: Their Beloved Lord belongs to them alone.
lines.transliteration: onaa pi-aaraa rab onaahaa jog-ee.

lines.english: The Guru comes and meets them; they alone know God.
lines.transliteration: jis mili-aa gur aa-ay tin parabh  jaani-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to their Lord and Master. ||4|| slok mÚ 5 ] (958-16) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin je kh asmai bh aani-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਸੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: My friendship is with the One Lord alone; I am in love with the One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: har iksai naal mai dost ee har iksai naal mai rang.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਇਕਾ  ਉਨ ਭਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is my only friend; my companionship is with the One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: har iko mayraa sajno har iksai naal mai sang.

lines.english: My conversation is with the One Lord alone; He never frowns, or turns His face away.
lines.transliteration: har iksai naal mai gostay muhu mailaa karai na bhang.

lines.english: He alone knows the state of my soul; He never ignores my love.
lines.transliteration: jaanai birthaa jee-a kee kad ay na morh ai rang.

lines.english: He is my only counselor, all-powerful to destroy and create.
lines.transliteration: har iko mayraa maslatee bh annan  gharhan samrath.

lines.english: The Lord is my only Giver. He places His hand upon the heads of the generous in the world.
lines.transliteration: har iko mayraa daat aar hai sir d aati-aa jag hath.

lines.english: I take the Support of the One Lord alone; He is all-powerful, over the heads of all.
lines.transliteration: har iksai dee mai tayk hai jo sir sabh naa samrath.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਇਕਸੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਇਕਸੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਮੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: The Saint, the True Guru, has united me with the Lord. He placed His hand on my forehead. pMnw 959
lines.transliteration: satgur sant  milaa-i-aa mast ak Dh ar kai hath.

lines.english: The Guru led me to meet the greatest Lord and Master; He saved the whole world.
lines.transliteration: vadaa saahib guroo milaa-i-aa jin taari-aa sagal jagat .

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਤਾਿਰਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਜਗਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: The desires of the mind are fulfilled; I have attained my pre-destined Union with God.
lines.transliteration: man kee-aa ichhaa pooree-aa paa-i-aa Dh ur sanjog.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ  ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਸੰਜੋਗ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the True Name; He enjoys the enjoyments forever. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (959-2) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paa-i-aa sach naam sad hee bh ogay bh og. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs is an alliance with Maya.
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa kayree d ostee maa-i-aa kaa san-banDh .

lines.english: As we watch, they run away; they never stand firm.
lines.transliteration: vaykh-d i-aa hee bh aj jaan kad ay na paa-in banDh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ  ॥
lines.english: As long as they get food and clothing, they stick around.
lines.transliteration: jichar painan khaavnHay tichar rakh an gandh .

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਖਿਦਆ  ਹੀ ਭਿਜ ਜਾਿਨ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: But on that day when they receive nothing, then they start to curse.
lines.transliteration: jit din kichh  na hova-ee t it din bolan ganDh .

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are ignorant and blind; they do not know the secrets of the soul.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee saar na jaannee manmukh  agi-aanee anDh .

lines.english: The false bond does not last; it is like stones joined with mud.
lines.transliteration: koorhaa gandh  na chal-ee chikarh  pathar banDh .

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: The blind do not understand themselves; they are engrossed in false worldlyentanglements.
lines.transliteration: anDhay aap na jaan nee fakarh  pitan Dh anDh.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਿਚਕਿੜ  ਪਥਰ  ਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Entangled in false attachments, they pass their lives in egotism and self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ai mohi laptaa-i-aa ha-o ha-o karat  bihanDh .

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਫਕੜੁ  ਿਪਟਿਨ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: But that being, whom the Lord has blessed with His Mercy from the very beginning,does perfect deeds, and accumulates good karma.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay jis aapnee Dh ur pooraa karam karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਿਹ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ  ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹੰਧੁ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, those humble beings alone are saved, who enter the Sanctuary ofthe True Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (959-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak say jan ubray jo satgur saran  paray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ  ਧੁਿਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision, speak the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jo ratay d eedaar say-ee sach haak.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ  ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can I obtain the dust of those who realize their Lord and Master?
lines.transliteration: jinee jaataa kh asam ki-o labh ai tinaa kh aak.

lines.english: The mind, stained by corruption, becomes pure by associating with them.
lines.transliteration: man mailaa vaykaar hovai sang paak.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ  ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: One sees the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, when the door of doubt is opened.
lines.transliteration: disai sachaa mahal kh ulai bh aram t aak.

lines.english: That one, unto whom the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed, is never pushedor shoved.
lines.transliteration: jisahi dikh aalay mahal t is na milai Dh aak.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ  ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are enraptured, when the Lord blesses me, even for an instant,with His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: man tan ho-ay nihaal bind ak nad ar jhaak.

lines.english: The nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam are obtained by commitment to theWord of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam niDh aan gur kai sabad  laag.

lines.english: He alone is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Saints, upon whose forehead suchpre-ordained desiny is inscribed. ||5|| slok mÚ 5 ] (959-10) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tisai milai sant  khaak mast ak jisai bh aag. ||5||

lines.english: O deer-eyed bride, I speak the Truth, which shall save you.
lines.transliteration: harnaakh ee koo sach vain  sunaa-ee jo t a-o karay uDh aaran .

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to these beautiful words, O beauteous bride; your Beloved Lord is your mind's only support.
lines.transliteration: sundar bachan t um sun hu chh abeelee pir t aidaa man saaDh aaran .

lines.english: You have fallen in love with an evil person; tell me - show me why!
lines.transliteration: durjan sayt ee nayhu rachaa-i-o d as vikh aa mai kaaran .

lines.english: I lack nothing, and I am not sad or depressed; I have no deficiency at all.
lines.transliteration: oonee naahee jh oonee naahee naahee kisai vihoon ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਣਾਖੀ  ਕੂ ਸਚੁ ਵੈਣੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ  ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I abandoned and lost my fascinating and beautiful Husband Lord; in this evil-mindedness, I have lost my good fortune.
lines.transliteration: pir chhail chh abeelaa chh ad gavaa-i-o d urmat  karam vihoon ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਬਚਨ  ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਛਬੀਲੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਤੈਡਾ  ਮਨ ਸਾਧਾਰਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: I am not mistaken, and I am not confused; I have no egotism, and commit nooffense.
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o bhulee naa ha-o chukee naa mai naahee d osaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਜਨ  ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ  ਦਿਸ ਿਵਖਾ  ਮੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: As You have linked me, so I am linked; listen to my true message.
lines.transliteration: jit ha-o laa-ee t it ha-o lagee t oo sun  sach sand aysaa.

lines.english: She alone is the blessed soul-bride, and she alone is fortunate, upon whom theHusband Lord has showered His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee sohagan saa-ee bh aagan  jai pir kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਛੈਲੁ ਛਬੀਲਾ  ਛਿਡ ਗਵਾਇਓ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਵਹੂਣੀ ॥
lines.english: Her Husband Lord takes away all her faults and mistakes; hugging her close in Hisembrace, He embellishes her.
lines.transliteration: pir a-ugan t is kay sabh  gavaa-ay gal sayt ee laa-ay savaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਚੁਕੀ  ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਦੋਸਾ ॥
lines.english: The unfortunate soul-bride makes this prayer: O Nanak, when will my turn come?
lines.transliteration: karamheen Dh an karai binant ee kad  naanak aavai vaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਉ ਲਾਈ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਹਉ ਲਗੀ  ਤੂ ਸੁਿਣ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: All the blessed soul-brides celebrate and make merry; bless me as well with a night of bliss, O Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (959-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh suhaagan  maan eh ralee-aa ik d ayvhu raat  muraaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਸਹਾਗਿਣ  ਸਾਈ  ਭਾਗਿਣ  ਜੈ ਿਪਿਰ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Why do you waver, O my mind? The Lord is the Fulfiller of hopes and desires.
lines.transliteration: kaahay man too dolt aa har mansaa pooran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਿਰ  ਅਉਗਣ  ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਗਵਾਏ  ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being; He is the Destroyer of all pains.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  Dhi-aa-ay t oo sabh  dukh visaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮਹੀਣ  ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਿਬਨੰਤੀ  ਕਿਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਵੈ  ਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the Lord's Name, O my mind; all sins and corruption shall bewashed away.
lines.transliteration: har naamaa aaraaDh man sabh  kilvikh  jaahi vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਰਲੀਆ  ਇਕ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, are in love with the FormlessLord.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in rang lagaa nirankaar.

lines.english: They abandon the tastes of Maya, and gather in the infinite wealth of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: onee chhadi-aa maa-i-aa su-aavarh aa Dh an sanchi-aa naam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਡੋਲਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮਨਸਾ  ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, they are lovingly absorbed in the One Lord; they surrender and accept the Will of the Infinite Lord. pMnw 960
lines.transliteration: athay pahar ikt ai livai mannayn hukam apaar.

lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for this one gift: please bless me, Lord, with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind is in love with You. ||2|| pauVI ] (960-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mangai daan ik d ayh d aras man pi-aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who is conscious of You finds everlasting peace.
lines.transliteration: jis too aavahi chit  tis no sad aa sukh .

lines.english: One who is conscious of You does not suffer at the hands of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jis too aavahi chit  tis jam naahi d ukh.

lines.english: One who is conscious of You is not anxious.
lines.transliteration: jis too aavahi chit  tis ke kaarh i-aa.

lines.english: One who has the Creator as his Friend - all his affairs are resolved.
lines.transliteration: jis daa kart aa mit ar sabh  kaaj savaari-aa.

lines.english: One who is conscious of You is renowned and respected.
lines.transliteration: jis too aavahi chit  so parvaan  jan.

lines.english: One who is conscious of You becomes very wealthy.
lines.transliteration: jis too aavahi chit  bahut aa tis Dhan.

lines.english: One who is conscious of You has a great family.
lines.transliteration: jis too aavahi chit  so vad parvaari-aa.

lines.english: One who is conscious of You saves his ancestors. ||6|| slok mÚ 5 ] (960-5) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis too aavahi chit  tin kul uDh aari-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Blind inwardly, and blind outwardly, he sings falsely, falsely.
lines.transliteration: andrahu annaa baahrahu annaa koorh ee koorh ee gaavai.

lines.english: He washes his body, and draws ritual marks on it, and totally runs after wealth.
lines.transliteration: dayhee Dh ovai chakar ban aa-ay maa-i-aa no baho Dh aavai.

lines.english: But the filth of his egotism is not removed from within, and over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: andar mail na ut rai ha-umai fir fir aavai jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ  ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ  ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Engulfed in sleep, and tormented by frustrated sexual desire, he chants the Lord'sName with his mouth.
lines.transliteration: neeNd vi-aapi-aa kaam santaapi-aa mukh ahu har har kahaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਚਕਰ੍ ਬਣਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ  ਨੋ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He is called a Vaishnav, but he is bound to deeds of egotism; by threshing only husks,what rewards can be obtained?
lines.transliteration: baisno naam karam ha-o jugtaa t uh kutay ki-aa fal paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Sitting among the swans, the crane does not become one of them; sitting there, hekeeps staring at the fish.
lines.transliteration: hansaa vich baithaa bag na ban -ee nit  baith aa machh ee no t aar laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਂਦ  ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਕਾਿਮ ਸੰਤਾਿਪਆ  ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: And when the gathering of swans looks and sees, they realize that they can neverform an alliance with the crane.
lines.transliteration: jaa hans sabhaa veechaar kar d aykhan taa bagaa naal jorh  kaday na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਸਨੋ  ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਮ  ਹਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ  ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟੇ ਿਕਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The swans peck at the diamonds and pearls, while the crane chases after frogs.
lines.transliteration: hansaa heeraa motee chugn aa bag dadaa bh aalan  jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸਾ ਿਵਿਚ ਬੈਠਾ ਬਗੁ ਨ ਬਣਈ  ਿਨਤ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਛੀ ਨੋ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The poor crane flies away, so that his secret will not be exposed.
lines.transliteration: udri-aa vaychaaraa bagulaa mat hovai manj  lakhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਹੰਸ ਸਭਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖਿਨ  ਤਾ ਬਗਾ  ਨਾਿਲ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord attaches one to, to that he is attached. Who is to blame, when the Lord wills it so?
lines.transliteration: jit ko laa-i-aa t it hee laagaa kis d os dichai jaa har ayvai bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸਾ ਹੀਰਾ  ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਣਾ  ਬਗੁ ਡਡਾ ਭਾਲਣ  ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the lake, overflowing with pearls. One who meets the True Guruobtains them.
lines.transliteration: satgur sarvar rat nee bh arpooray jis paraapat  so paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਡਿਰਆ  ਵੇਚਾਰਾ  ਬਗੁਲਾ  ਮਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੰਞੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Sikh-swans gather at the lake, according to the Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sikh hans sarvar ikth ay ho-ay sat gur kai hukmaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਤ  ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਕਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਿਦਚੈ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The lake is filled with the wealth of these jewels and pearls; they are spent andconsumed, but they never run out.
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath maan ak sarvar bh arpooray kh aa-ay kh arach rahay t ot na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਪਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The swan never leaves the lake; such is the Pleasure of the Creator's Will.
lines.transliteration: sarvar hans door na ho-ee kart ay ayvai bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਖ ਹੰਸ ਸਰਵਿਰ  ਇਕਠੇ  ਹੋਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead- that Sikh comes to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jis dai mast ak bh aag Dh ur likh i-aa so sikh  guroo peh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕ  ਸਰਵਿਰ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ਖਾਇ  ਖਰਿਚ  ਰਹੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well; he emancipates the wholeworld. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (960-14) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap tari-aa kutamb sabh  taaray sabh aa sarisat chh adaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਵਰ  ਹੰਸੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ  ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He is called a Pandit, a religious scholar, and yet he wanders along many pathways.He is as hard as uncooked beans.
lines.transliteration: pandit aakaa-ay bahut ee raahee korarh  moth  jinayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਿਸਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਹ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is filled with attachment, and constantly engrossed in doubt; his body cannot holdstill.
