lines.transliteration: andar moh nit  bharam vi-aapi-aa t istas naahee d ayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸਿਭ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਭਾ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਛਡਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: False is his coming, and false is his going; he is continually on the lookout for Maya.
lines.transliteration: koorhee aavai koorh ee jaavai maa-i-aa kee nit  johaa.

lines.english: If someone speaks the truth, then he is aggravated; he is totally filled with anger.
lines.transliteration: sach kahai taa chh oho aavai ant ar bahut aa rohaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਆਖਾਏ  ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ  ਕੋਰੜ  ਮੋਠ ਿਜਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The evil fool is engrossed in evil-mindedness and false intellectualizations; his mind isattached to emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: vi-aapi-aa durmat  kubuDh  kumoorh aa man laagaa t is mohaa.

lines.english: The deceiver abides with the five deceivers; it is a gathering of like minds.
lines.transliteration: thagai sayt ee thag ral aa-i-aa saath bh e iko jayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ  ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੀ ਿਨਤ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
lines.english: And when the Jeweller, the True Guru, appraises him, then he is exposed as mereiron.
lines.transliteration: satgur saraaf nad ree vichd o kadh ai taaN ugharh aa-i-aa lohaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਤਾ ਛੋਹੋ ਆਵੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਹਾ ॥
lines.english: Mixed and mingled with others, he was passed off as genuine in many places; butnow, the veil has been lifted, and he stands naked before all.
lines.transliteration: bahutayree thaa-ee ralaa-ay ralaa-ay d itaa ugh -rhi-aa parh -daa agai aa-ay kh alohaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕੁਬੁਿਧ  ਕੁਮੂੜਾ ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
lines.english: One who comes to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, shall be transformed from iron into gold.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee jay sarn ee aavai fir manoorahu kanchan hohaa.

lines.punjabi: ਠਗੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਠਗੁ ਰਿਲ ਆਇਆ  ਸਾਥੁ ਿਭ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has no anger or vengeance; He looks upon son and enemy alike.Removing faults and mistakes, He purifies the human body.
lines.transliteration: satgur nirvair put ar sat ar samaanay a-ugan  katay karay suDh  dayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਿਵਚਦੋ  ਕਢੈ ਤ ਉਘਿੜ  ਆਇਆ  ਲੋਹਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, is in love with the True Guru. pMnw 961
lines.transliteration: naanak jis Dhur mast ak hovai likh i-aa tis satgur naal sanayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਸਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Perfect True Guru's Bani is  Ambrosial Nectar; it dwells in the heart of one who is blessed by the Guru's Mercy.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee sat gur pooray kee jis kirpaal hovai t is ridai vasayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਕਰਪਾਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: His coming and going in reincarnation is ended; forever and ever, he is at peace. ||2|| pauVI ] (961-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa tis kaa katee-ai sad aa sad aa sukh  hohaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਕਟੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone understands You, Lord, with whom You are pleased.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaanaa jant  so tuDh bujh-ee.

lines.english: He alone is approved in the Court of the Lord, with whom You are pleased.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaanaa jant  so dargeh sijh -ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਜੰਤੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਬੁਝਈ  ॥
lines.english: Egotism is eradicated, when You bestow Your Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayree nad ar ha-umai t is ga-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਜੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ  ਿਸਝਈ  ॥
lines.english: Sins are erased, when You are thoroughly pleased.
lines.transliteration: jis no too sant usat kalmal t is kha-ee.

lines.english: One who has the Lord Master on his side, becomes fearless.
lines.transliteration: jis kai su-aamee val nirbha-o so bh a-ee.

lines.english: One who is blessed with Your Mercy, becomes truthful.
lines.transliteration: jis no too kirpaal sachaa so thi-a-ee.

lines.english: One who is blessed with Your Kindness, is not touched by fire.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayree ma-i-aa na pohai agna-ee.

lines.english: You are forever Merciful to those who are receptive to the Guru's Teachings. ||7|| slok mÚ 5 ] (961-6) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis no sad aa da-i-aal jin gur t ay mat  la-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ  ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਈ  ॥
lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, O Merciful Lord; please forgive me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa kirpaal aapay bakhas lai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਿਤ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, I chant Your Name; I fall at the feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa japee t ayraa naam sat gur paa-ay pai.

lines.english: Please, dwell within my mind and body, and end my sufferings.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar vas d ookhaa naas ho-ay.

lines.english: Please give me Your hand, and save me, that fear may not afflict me.
lines.transliteration: hath day-ay aap rakh  vi-aapai bh a-o na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਇ  ਪੈ ॥
lines.english: May I sing Your Glorious Praises day and night; please commit me to this task.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavaa d in rain  aytai kamm laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਸੁ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Associating with the humble Saints, the disease of egotism is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kai sang ha-umai rog jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਥ ਦੇਇ ਆਿਪ  ਰਖੁ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਭਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord and Master is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar kh asam ayko rav rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਣ ਏਤੈ ਕੰਿਮ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have truly found the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sach sacho sach lahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with Your Kindness, O Kind Lord, and bless me with Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu d a-i-aal apn ee sifat  dayh.

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I am in ecstasy; this is what Nanakloves. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (961-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykh nihaal naanak pareet  ayh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the One Lord within your mind, and enter the Sanctuary of the One Lordalone.
lines.transliteration: ayko japee-ai manai maahi ikas kee sarnaa-ay.

lines.english: Be in love with the One Lord; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ikas si-o kar pirharhee d oojee naahee jaa-ay.

lines.english: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you will be blessed with everything.
lines.transliteration: iko daat aa mangee-ai sabh  kichh  palai paa-ay.

lines.english: In your mind and body, with each breath and morsel of food, meditate on the One and only Lord God.
lines.transliteration: man tan saas giraas parabh  iko ik Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ  ਮਨੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਇਕਸ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the true treasure, the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam niDh aan sach gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Very fortunate are those humble Saints, within whose minds the Lord has come toabide.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee t ay sant  jan jin man vuth aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no other atall.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al rav rahi-aa doojaa ko-ee naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, and chanting the Naam, Nanak abides in the Will of his Lordand Master. ||2|| pauVI ] (961-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ee naam uchraa naanak kh asam rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who has You as his Saving Grace - who can kill him?
lines.transliteration: jis no too rakh vaalaa maaray t is ka-un .

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who has You as his Saving Grace conquers the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: jis no too rakh vaalaa jit aa tinai bh ain.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋਈ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One who has You on his side - his face is radiant and bright.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayraa ang t is mukh  ujlaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਾ  ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮ  ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who has You on his side, is the purest of the Pure.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayraa ang so nirmalee hooN nirmalaa.

lines.english: One who is blessed with Your Grace is not called to give his account.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayree nad ar na laykh aa puchh ee-ai.

lines.english: One with whom You are pleased, obtains the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayree kh usee t in na-o niDh  bhunchee-ai.

lines.english: One who has You on his side, God - unto whom is he subservient?
lines.transliteration: jis no too parabh  val tis ki-aa muhchh andgee.

lines.english: One who is blessed with Your Kind Mercy is dedicated to Your worship. ||8|| slok mhlw 5 ] (961-17) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no tayree mihar so t ayree band igee. ||8||

lines.english: Be Merciful, O my Lord and Master, that I may pass my life in the Society of theSaints.
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal su-aamee mayray jantaaN sang vihaavay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਲੇਖਾ  ਪੁਛੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Those who forget You are born only to die and be reincarnated again; their sufferings will never end. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (961-18) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tuDhhu bh ulay se jam jam mard ay tin kad ay na chukan haavay. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate in remembrance within your heart on the True Guru, whether you are on themost difficult path, on the mountain or by the river bank.
lines.transliteration: satgur simrahu aapn aa gh at avgh at ghat ghaat.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, no one shall block your way. ||2|| pauVI ] (961-19) pa-orhee. Pauree: pMnw 962
lines.transliteration: har har naam japanti-aa ko-ay na banDh ai vaat. ||2||

lines.english: Where You are, Almighty Lord, there is no one else.
lines.transliteration: tithai t oo samrath jithai ko-ay naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖ ਅਗਨੀ  ਉਦਰ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: There, in the fire of the mother's womb, You protected us.
lines.transliteration: othai tayree rakh  agnee ud ar maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨਾਇ  ਤੇਰੈ ਛਿਡ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing Your Name, the Messenger of Death runs away.
lines.transliteration: sun kai jam kay d oot naa-ay t ayrai chh ad jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The terrifying, treacherous, impassible world-ocean is crossed over, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bha-ojal bikh am asgaahu gur sabd ee paar paahi.

lines.english: Those who feel thirst for You, take in Your Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o lagee pi-aas amrit say-ay kh aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਏਹੋ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਗਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: This is the only act of goodness in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, to sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: kal meh ayho punn gun govind  gaahi.

lines.english: He is Merciful to all; He sustains us with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: sabhsai no kirpaal samHaalay saahi saahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਿਜ ਆਵੈ  ਤੁਧੁ ਆਿਹ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Those who come to You with love and faith are never turned away empty-handed.||9|| slok mÚ 5 ] (962-4) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: birthaa ko-ay na jaa-ay je aavai tuDh  aahi. ||9||

lines.english: Those whom You bless with the Support of Your Name, O Supreme Lord God, do not know any other.
lines.transliteration: doojaa t is na bujh aa-iho paarbarahm naam d ayh aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਹੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord and Master, All-powerful True Great Giver:
lines.transliteration: agam agochar saahibo samrath sach daat aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੋ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You are eternal and unchanging, without vengeance and True; True is the Darbaar ofYour Court.
lines.transliteration: too nihchal nirvair sach sachaa t uDh darbaar.

lines.english: Your worth cannot be described; You have no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: keemat kahan  na jaa-ee-ai ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: To forsake God, and ask for something else, is all corruption and ashes.
lines.transliteration: parabh chh od hor je mangn aa sabh  bikhi-aa ras chh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਹੋਰੁ ਿਜ ਮੰਗਣਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They alone find peace, and they are the true kings, whose dealings are true.
lines.transliteration: say sukhee-ay sach saah say jin sachaa bi-uhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਸੇ ਿਜਨ ਸਚਾ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who are in love with God's Name, intuitively enjoy the essence of peace.
lines.transliteration: jinaa lagee pareet parabh  naam sahj sukh  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਲਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਮ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak worships and adores the One Lord; he seeks the dust of the Saints. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (962-8) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ik aaraaDhay sant an rayn aar. ||1||

lines.english: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, bliss, peace and rest are obtained.
lines.transliteration: anad sookh  bisraam nit  har kaa keert an gaa-ay.

lines.english: Forsake other clever tricks, O Nanak; only through the Name will you be saved. ||2|| pauVI ] (962-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: avar si-aanap chh aad d eh naanak uDh ras naa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਸੂਖ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: No one can bring You under control, by despising the world.
lines.transliteration: naa too aavahi vas bahut  ghinaavan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਛਾਿਡ  ਦੇਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਧਰਿਸ  ਨਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: No one can bring You under control, by studying the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: naa too aavahi vas bayd  parhaavan ay.

lines.english: No one can bring You under control, by bathing at the holy places.
lines.transliteration: naa too aavahi vas t irath naa-ee-ai.

lines.english: No one can bring You under control, by wandering all over the world.
lines.transliteration: naa too aavahi vas Dh artee Dh aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਿਹ  ਵਿਸ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਾਵਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: No one can bring You under control, by any clever tricks.
lines.transliteration: naa too aavahi vas kit ai si-aan pai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਿਹ  ਵਿਸ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: No one can bring You under control, by giving huge donations to charities.
lines.transliteration: naa too aavahi vas bahut aa daan d ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਿਹ  ਵਿਸ ਧਰਤੀ  ਧਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone is under Your power, O inaccessible, unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko t ayrai vas agam agocharaa.

lines.english: You are under the control of Your devotees; You are the strength of Your devotees. ||10|| slok mÚ 5 ] (962-12) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too bh agtaa kai vas bh agtaa taan tayraa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਿਹ  ਵਿਸ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the true physician.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaid aap naaraa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਿਸ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: These physicians of the world only burden the soul with pain.
lines.transliteration: ayhi vaid jee-a kaa d ukh laa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਭਗਤਾ  ਤਾਣੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; it is so delicious to eat.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit  ras kh aa-in.

lines.english: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with this Nectar - all his pains are dispelled. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (962-14) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis man vasai tis kay sabh  dookh mitaa-in . ||1||

lines.english: By the Hukam of Lord's Command, they move about; by the Lord's Command, theyremain still.
lines.transliteration: hukam uchhlai hukmay rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਿਹ ਵੈਦ ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: By His Hukam, they endure pain and pleasure alike.
lines.transliteration: hukmay dukh  sukh  sam kar sahai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: By His Hukam, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: hukmay naam japai din raat .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਮਟਾਇਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone does so, who is blessed.
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no hovai daat .

lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they die; by the Hukam of His Command, theylive.
lines.transliteration: hukam marai hukmay hee jeevai.

lines.english: By His Hukam, they become tiny, and huge.
lines.transliteration: hukmay naanHaa vadaa theevai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਸਹੈ ॥
lines.english: By His Hukam, they receive pain, happiness and bliss.
lines.transliteration: hukmay sog harakh aanand .

lines.english: By His Hukam, they chant the Guru's Mantra, which always works.
lines.transliteration: hukmay japai niroDhar gurmant .

lines.english: By His Hukam, coming and going in reincarnation cease,
lines.transliteration: hukmay aavan jaan  rahaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, when He links them to His devotional worship. ||2|| pauVI ] (962-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa ka-o bhagt ee laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that musician who is Your servant, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis dh aadhee kurbaan  je tayraa sayvd aar.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that musician who sings the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis dh aadhee balihaar je gaavai gun  apaar.

lines.english: Blessed, blessed is that musician, for whom the Formless Lord Himself longs.
lines.transliteration: so dhaadh ee Dh an Dh an jis lorh ay nirankaar.

lines.english: Very fortunate is that musician who comes to the gate of the Court of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: so dhaadh ee bh aagath  jis sachaa d u-aar baar.

lines.english: That musician meditates on You, Lord, and praises You day and night.
lines.transliteration: oh dhaadh ee tuDh Dhi-aa-ay kalaan ay din rain aar.

lines.english: He begs for the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and will never be defeated.
lines.transliteration: mangai amrit naam na aavai kad ay haar.

lines.english: His clothes and his food are true, and he enshrines love for the Lord within.
lines.transliteration: kaparh bh ojan sach rahd aa livai Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ਿਜ ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Praiseworthy is that musician who loves God. ||11|| pMnw 963 slok mÚ 5 ] (963-1) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so dhaadh ee gun vant jis no parabh  pi-aar. ||11||

lines.english: The Bani of the Guru's Word is Ambrosial Nectar; its taste is sweet. The Name of theLord is Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee ami-o ras amrit  har kaa naa-o.

lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord in your mind, body and heart; twenty-fourhours a day, sing His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: man tan hird ai simar har aath  pahar gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to these Teachings, O Sikhs of the Guru. This is the true purpose of life.
lines.transliteration: updays sun hu tum gursikh ahu sachaa ihai su-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: This priceless human life will be made fruitful; embrace love for the Lord in your mind.
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath safal ho-ay man meh laa-ihu bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਿਸਖਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Celestial peace and absolute bliss come when one meditates on God - suffering is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanad  ghanaa parabh  japti-aa d ukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਲਾਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace wells up, and one obtainsa place in the Court of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (963-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japat sukh  oopjai d argeh paa-ee-ai thaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨਦੁ  ਘਣਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਪਿਤਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is the Teaching impartedby the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai gur pooraa mat  day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Will, they practice meditation, austerity and self-discipline; in the Lord'sWill, they are released.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai jap t ap sanjamo bh aanai hee kadh  lay-ay.

lines.english: In the Lord's Will, they are made to wander in reincarnation; in the Lord's Will, theyare forgiven.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai jon bh avaa-ee-ai bh aanai bakh as karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Will, pain and pleasure are experienced; in the Lord's Will, actions areperformed.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai dukh sukh  bhogee-ai bh aanai karam karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੋ  ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਕਿਢ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Will, clay is fashioned into form; in the Lord's Will, His Light is infusedinto it.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai mitee saaj kai bh aanai jot Dharay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਵਾਈਐ  ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Will, enjoyments are enjoyed; in the Lord's Will, these enjoyments are denied.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai bhog bh ogaa-id aa bh aanai maneh karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੋਗੀਐ  ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Will, they are incarnated in heaven and hell; in the Lord's Will, they fallto the ground.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai narak surag a-ut aaray bh aanai Dharan paray-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਿਮਟੀ  ਸਾਿਜ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਿਤ  ਧਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Will, they are committed to His devotional worship and Praise; O Nanak,how rare are these! ||2|| pauVI ] (963-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai hee jis bh agtee laa-ay naanak virlay hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ  ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿਹ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing, hearing of the glorious greatness of the True Name, I live.
lines.transliteration: vadi-aa-ee sachay naam kee ha-o jeevaa sun sun ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਨਰਿਕ  ਸੁਰਿਗ  ਅਉਤਾਰੇ  ਭਾਣੈ ਧਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Even ignorant beasts and goblins can be saved, in an instant.
lines.transliteration: pasoo parayt agi-aan uDh aaray ik kh anay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਿਜਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Day and night, chant the Name, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: dinas rain  tayraa naa-o sad aa sad  jaapee-ai.

lines.english: The most horrible thirst and hunger is satisfied through Your Name, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa bh ukh vikraal naa-ay t ayrai Dh araapee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
lines.english: Disease, sorrow and pain run away, when the Name dwells within the mind.
lines.transliteration: rog sog dukh  vanjai jis naa-o man vasai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਉਧਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਖਣੇ ॥
lines.english: He alone attains his Beloved, who loves the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  laal jo gur sabd ee rasai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਿਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The worlds and solar systems are saved by the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: khand barahmand bay-ant  uDhaaran haari-aa.

lines.english: Your glory is Yours alone, O my Beloved True Lord. ||12|| slok mÚ 5 ] (963-11) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tayree sobh aa tuDh sachay mayray pi-aari-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਉ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: I abandoned and lost my Beloved Friend, O Nanak; I was fooled by the transitorycolor of the safflower, which fades away.
lines.transliteration: mitar pi-aaraa naanak jee mai chh ad gavaa-i-aa rang kasumbh ai bhulee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਰਸੈ ॥
lines.english: I did not know Your value, O my Friend; without You, I am not worth even half ashell. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (963-13) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ta-o sajan  kee mai keem na pa-ud ee ha-o t uDh bin adh  na lahd ee. ||1||

lines.english: My mother-in-law is my enemy, O Nanak; my father-in-law is argumentative and mybrother-in-law burns me at every step.
lines.transliteration: sas viraa-in naanak jee-o sasuraa vaad ee jayth o pa-o pa-o loohai.

lines.english: They can all just play in the dust, when You are my Friend, O Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (963-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: habhay bh as pun ayday vat an jaa mai sajan  toohai. ||2||

lines.english: You relieve the pains of those, within whose consciousness You dwell, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis too vuth aa chit  tis darad nivaarn o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀ ਮੈ ਛਿਡ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਕਸੁੰਭੈ  ਭੁਲੀ ॥
lines.english: Those, within whose consciousness You dwell, never lose.
lines.transliteration: jis too vuth aa chit  tis kad ay na haarn o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਸਜਣ  ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਉਦੀ  ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹਦੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who meets the Perfect Guru will surely be saved.
lines.transliteration: jis mili-aa pooraa guroo so sarpar taarn o.

lines.english: One who is attached to Truth, contemplates Truth.
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay sach tis sach samHaalan o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੁ ਿਵਰਾਇਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਸੁਰਾ  ਵਾਦੀ  ਜੇਠੋ ਪਉ ਪਉ ਲੂਹੈ ॥
lines.english: One, into whose hands the treasure comes, stops searching.
lines.transliteration: jis aa-i-aa hath niDhaan so rahi-aa bh aalno.

lines.punjabi: ਹਭੇ ਭਸੁ ਪੁਣੇਦੇ  ਵਤਨੁ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਸਜਣੁ  ਤੂਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone is known as a devotee, who loves the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis no iko rang bhagat  so jaann o.

lines.english: He is the dust under the feet of all; he is the lover of the Lord's feet.
lines.transliteration: oh sabhnaa kee rayn  birhee chaarn o.

lines.english: Everything is Your wonderful play; the whole creation is Yours. ||13|| slok mÚ 5 ] (963-17) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayray choj vidaan  sabh  tayraa kaarn o. ||13||

lines.english: I have totally discarded praise and slander, O Nanak; I have forsaken and abandoned everything.
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa naanak jee mai habh  vanjaa-ee chh orhi-aa habh  kijh ti-aagee.

lines.english: I have seen that all relationships are false, and so I have grasped hold of the hem ofYour robe, Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (963-18) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: habhay saak koorh aavay dith ay ta-o palai t aidai laagee. ||1||

lines.english: I wandered and wandered and went crazy, O Nanak, in countless foreign lands andpathways.
lines.transliteration: firdee fird ee naanak jee-o ha-o faavee thee-ee bahut  disaavar panDh aa.

lines.english: But then, I slept in peace and comfort, when I met the Guru, and found my Friend. ||2|| pMnw 964 pauVI ] (964-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: taa ha-o sukh  sukh aalee sut ee jaa gur mil sajan  mai laDh aa. ||2||

lines.english: When I forget You, I endure all pains and afflictions.
lines.transliteration: sabhay d ukh santaap jaaN tuDhhu bh ulee-ai.

lines.english: Making thousands of efforts, they are still not eliminated.
lines.transliteration: jay keechan lakh upaav t aaN kahee na gh ulee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ  ਜ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who forgets the Name, is known as a poor person.
lines.transliteration: jis no visrai naa-o so nirDhan kaaNdhee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੀਚਿਨ  ਲਖ ਉਪਾਵ  ਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਘੁਲੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: One who forgets the Name, wanders in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: jis no visrai naa-o so jonee haaNdhee-ai.

lines.english: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is punished by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jis khasam na aavai chit  tis jam dand d ay.

lines.english: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is judged to be a sick person.
lines.transliteration: jis khasam na aavee chit  rogee say gan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇ ॥
lines.english: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is egotistical and proud.
lines.transliteration: jis khasam na aavee chit  so kh aro ahaNkaaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ  ਨ ਆਵੀ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਰੋਗੀ ਸੇ ਗਣੇ ॥
lines.english: One who forgets the Name is miserable in this world. ||14|| slok mÚ 5 ] (964-4) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so-ee duhaylaa jag jin naa-o visaaree-aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ  ਨ ਆਵੀ ਿਚਿਤ  ਸੁ ਖਰੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have not seen any other like You. You alone are pleasing to Nanak's mind.
lines.transliteration: taidee band as mai ko-ay na dith aa too naanak man bh aanaa.

lines.english: I am a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to that friend, that mediator, who leads me torecognize my Husband Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (964-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ghol gh umaa-ee t is mit ar vicholay jai mil kant  pachh aanaa. ||1||

lines.english: Beautiful are those feet which walk towards You; beautiful is that head which falls atYour Feet.
lines.transliteration: paav suhaavay jaaN ta-o Dh ir juld ay sees suhaavaa charn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਡੀ ਬੰਦਿਸ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਡਠਾ  ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Beautiful is that mouth which sings Your Praises; beautiful is that soul which seeksYour Sanctuary. ||2|| pauVI ] (964-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: mukh suhaavaa jaaN ta-o jas gaavai jee-o pa-i-aa t a-o sarn ee. ||2||

lines.english: Meeting the Lord's brides, in the True Congregation, I sing the songs of joy.
lines.transliteration: mil naaree satsang mangal gaavee-aa.

lines.english: The home of my heart is now held steady, and I shall not go out wandering again.
lines.transliteration: ghar kaa ho-aa banDh aan bahurh  na Dh aavee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ  ਜ ਤਉ ਿਧਿਰ  ਜੁਲਦੇ  ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਚਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Evil-mindedness has been dispelled, along with sin and my bad reputation.
lines.transliteration: binthee d urmat  durat so-ay koorh aavee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਜ ਤਉ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਜੀਉ ਪਇਆ  ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am well-known as being calm and good-natured; my heart is filled with Truth.
lines.transliteration: seelvant parDh aan rid ai sachaavee-aa.

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, the One and only Lord is my way.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ik ik reet aavee-aa.

lines.english: My mind is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I am a slave at His feet.
lines.transliteration: man darsan kee pi-aas charan  daasaavee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ  ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਧਾਵੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am glorified and embellished, when my Lord and Master enjoys me.
lines.transliteration: sobhaa ban ee seegaar kh asam jaaN raavee-aa.

lines.english: I meet Him through my blessed destiny, when it is pleasing to His Will. ||15|| slok mÚ 5 ] (964-10) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: milee-aa aa-ay sanjog jaaN tis bh aavee-aa. ||15||

lines.english: All virtues are Yours, Dear Lord; You bestow them upon us. I am unworthy - what canI achieve, O Nanak?
lines.transliteration: habh gun  taiday naanak jee-o mai koo thee-ay mai nirgun  tay ki-aa hovai.

lines.english: There is no other Giver as great as You. I am a beggar; I beg from You forever. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (964-11) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ta-o jayvad d aataar na ko-ee jaachak sad aa jaachovai. ||1||

lines.english: My body was wasting away, and I was depressed. The Guru, my Friend, hasencouraged and consoled me.
lines.transliteration: dayh chh ijand-rhee oon  majh oonaa gur sajan  jee-o Dh araa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਭਾ ਬਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖਸਿਮ  ਜ ਰਾਵੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I sleep in total peace and comfort; I have conquered the whole world. ||2|| pauVI ] (964-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: habhay sukh  suhaylrh aa sut aa jitaa jag sabaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The Darbaar of Your Court is glorious and great. Your holy throne is True.
lines.transliteration: vadaa tayraa d arbaar sachaa t uDh takhat.

lines.english: You are the Emperor over the heads of kings. Your canopy and chauree (fly-brush) are permanent and unchanging.
lines.transliteration: sir saahaa paatisaahu nihchal cha-ur chh at.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਭ ਗੁਣ ਤੈਡੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਉ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਥੀਏ ਮੈ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਤੇ ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: That alone is true justice, which is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jo bhaavai paarbarahm so-ee sach ni-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਕੁ  ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚੋਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even the homeless receive a home, when it is pleasing to the Will of the SupremeLord God.
lines.transliteration: jay bhaavai paarbarahm nithaavay milai thaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator Lord does, is a good thing.
lines.transliteration: jo keenHee kartaar saa-ee bh alee gal.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਿਛਜੰਦੜੀ  ਊਣ ਮਝੂਣਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਸਜਿਣ  ਜੀਉ  ਧਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who recognize their Lord and Master, are seated in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jinHee pachhaat aa kh asam say d argaah mal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ  ਸੁਤਾ ਿਜਤਾ  ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: True is Your Command; no one can challenge it.
lines.transliteration: sahee tayraa furmaan kinai na fayree-ai.

lines.english: O Merciful Lord, Cause of causes, Your creative power is all-powerful. ||16|| slok mÚ 5 ] (964-16) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaaran karan  kareem kud rat tayree-ai. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਤਖਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing of You, my body and mind have blossomed forth; chanting the Naam, theName of the Lord, I am flushed with life.
lines.transliteration: so-ay sunand -rhee mayraa t an man ma-ulaa naam japand -rhee laalee.

lines.english: Walking on the Path, I have found cool tranquility deep within; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am enraptured. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (964-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: panDh juland -rhee mayraa and ar thandhaa gur d arsan d aykh nihaalee. ||1||

lines.english: I have found the jewel within my heart.
lines.transliteration: hath manjh aahoo mai maan ak laDh aa.

lines.english: I was not charged for it; the True Guru gave it to me.
lines.transliteration: mul na ghiDh aa mai koo sat gur ditaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੀ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ਸਾਈ  ਭਲੀ ਗਲ ॥
lines.english: My search has ended, and I have become stable.
lines.transliteration: dhoondh  vanjaa-ee thee-aa thit aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, I have conquered this priceless human life. ||2|| pauVI ] (964-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath naanak jit aa. ||2||

lines.english: One who has such good karma inscribed upon his forehead, is committed to the Lord's service.
lines.transliteration: jis kai mastak karam ho-ay so sayvaa laagaa.

lines.english: One whose heart lotus blossoms forth upon meeting the Guru, remains awake andaware, night and day.
lines.transliteration: jis gur mil kamal pargaasi-aa so an-din jaagaa.

lines.english: All doubt and fear run away from one who is in love with the Lord's lotus feet. pMnw 965
lines.transliteration: lagaa rang charnaarbind  sabh  bharam bh a-o bh aagaa.

lines.english: He conquers his soul, following the Guru's Teachings, and attains the Imperishable Lord.
lines.transliteration: aatam jit aa gurmat ee aaganjat  paagaa.

lines.english: He alone keeps up in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, who meditates on the Supreme LordGod.
lines.transliteration: jisahi Dhi-aa-i-aa paarbarahm so kal meh t aagaa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he is immaculate, as if he has bathedat the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  nirmalaa ath sath majnaagaa.

lines.english: He alone is a man of good fortune, who has met with God.
lines.transliteration: jis parabh mili-aa aapn aa so purakh  sabh aagaa.

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice to such a one, whose destiny is so great! ||17|| slok mÚ 5 ] (965-3) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis balihaarn ai jis ayvad bh aagaa. ||17||

lines.english: When the Husband Lord is within the heart, then Maya, the bride, goes outside.
lines.transliteration: jaaN pir andar t aaN Dhan baahar.

lines.english: When one's Husband Lord is outside of oneself, then Maya, the bride, is supreme.
lines.transliteration: jaaN pir baahar taaN Dhan maahar.

lines.english: Without the Name, one wanders all around.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai baho fayr firaahar.

lines.english: The True Guru shows us that the Lord is with us.
lines.transliteration: satgur sang d ikhaa-i-aa jaahar.

lines.english: Servant Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (965-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sachay sach samaahar. ||1||

lines.english: Making all sorts of efforts, they wander around; but they do not make even one effort.
lines.transliteration: aahar sabh kard aa firai aahar ik na ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, how rare are those who understand the effort which saves the world. ||2|| pauVI ] (965-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jit aahar jag uDh rai virlaa boojh ai ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The greatest of the great, infinite is Your dignity.
lines.transliteration: vadee hoo vadaa apaar tayraa mart abaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਹਰ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਦਾ  ਿਫਰੈ ਆਹਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Your colors and hues are so numerous; no one can know Your actions.
lines.transliteration: rang parang anayk na jaapniH kartabaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਤੁ ਆਹਿਰ  ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੈ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Soul within all souls; You alone know everything.
lines.transliteration: jee-aa andar jee-o sabh  kichh  jaanlaa.

lines.english: Everything is under Your control; Your home is beautiful.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tayrai vas t ayraa gh ar bhalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੀ ਹੂ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਰਤਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your home is filled with bliss, which resonates and resounds throughout Your home.
lines.transliteration: tayrai gh ar aanand  vaDh aa-ee t uDh ghar.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਨ ਜਾਪਿਨ  ਕਰਤਬਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your honor, majesty and glory are Yours alone.
lines.transliteration: maan maht aa tayj aapn aa aap jar.

lines.english: You are overflowing with all powers; wherever we look, there You are.
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa bharpoor d isai jat  kataa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੇਰੈ ਵਿਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.english: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, prays to You alone. ||18|| slok mÚ 5 ] (965-9) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daasan d aas tuDh aagai binvat aa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਿਰ  ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਵਧਾਈ  ਤੁਧੁ ਘਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Your streets are covered with canopies; under them, the traders look beautiful.
lines.transliteration: chhat -rhay baajaar sohan vich vapaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤਾ  ਤੇਜੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਜਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is truly a banker, who buys the infinite commodity. ||1|| mhlw 5 ] (965-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vakhar hik apaar naanak kh atay so Dh anee. ||1||

lines.english: Kabeer, no one is mine, and I belong to no one.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa hamraa ko nahee ham kis hoo kay naahi.

lines.english: I am absorbed in the One, who created this creation. ||2|| pauVI ] (965-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jin ih rachan rachaa-i-aa tis hee maahi samaahi. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord is the most beautiful fruit tree, bearing fruits of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: safli-o birakh suhaavrh aa har safal amrit aa.

lines.english: My mind longs to meet Him; how can I ever find Him?
lines.transliteration: man lochai unH milan ka-o ki-o vanj ai ghitaa.

lines.punjabi: ਵਖਰੁ ਿਹਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਖਟੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has no color or form; He is inaccessible and unconquerable.
lines.transliteration: varnaa chihnaa baahraa oh agam ajitaa.

lines.english: I love Him with all my soul; He opens the door for me.
lines.transliteration: oh pi-aaraa jee-a kaa jo kholHai bhitaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਹਮਰਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਿਕਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I shall serve you forever, if you tell me of my Friend.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa karee tusaarh ee-aa mai d asihu mit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: kurbaanee vanj aa vaarn ai balay bal kit aa.

lines.english: The Beloved Saints tell us, to listen with our consciousness.
lines.transliteration: dasan sant  pi-aari-aa sun hu laa-ay chit aa.

lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, O slave Nanak, is blessed with the Ambrosial Name by the True Guru. ||19|| slok mhlw 5 ] (965-15) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis likhi-aa naanak d aas tis naa-o amrit  satgur ditaa. ||19||

lines.english: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but the thieves have come and now sit amongthem.
lines.transliteration: kabeer Dhart ee saaDh  kee t askar baiseh gaahi.

lines.english: Dhart ee bh aar na bi-aapa-ee un ka-o laahoo laahi. ||1|| The earth does not feel their weight; even they profit. ||1|| mhlw 5 ] (965-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
Kabeer, for the sake of the rice, the husks are beaten and threshed.
lines.transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarnay t ukh ka-o muhlee laa-ay.

lines.english: When one sits in the company of evil people, then he will be called to account by theRighteous Judge of Dharma. ||2|| pauVI ] (965-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sang kusangee baistay t ab poochh ay Dh aram raa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself has the greatest family; He Himself is all alone.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee vad parvaar aap ikaatee-aa.

lines.english: He alone knows His own worth.
lines.transliteration: aapnee keemat  aap aapay hee jaat ee-aa.

lines.english: He Himself, by Himself, created everything.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap aap upanni-aa.

lines.english: Only He Himself can describe His own creation.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa keet aa aap aap varanni-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ  ਬੈਸਿਹ  ਗਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so t ayraa thaan jithai t oo vuth aa. Blessed is Your place, where You dwell, Lord. pMnw 966

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਤੂੰ ਿਡਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so t ayray bh agat jinHee sach t ooN dithaa. Blessed are Your devotees, who see You, O True Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ  ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਸੋਇ ਤੁਧੁ ॥
lines.english: He alone praises You, who is blessed by Your Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis no tayree d a-i-aa salaahay so-ay t uDh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁ ਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸੋਈ ਸੁਧੁ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: One who meets the Guru, O Nanak, is immaculate and sanctified. ||20|| slok mÚ 5 ] (966-2) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis gur bhaytay naanak nirmal so-ee suDh . ||20||

lines.english: Fareed, this world is beautiful, but there is a thorny garden within it.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa bh oom rangaavalee manjh  visoolaa baag.

lines.english: Those who are blessed by their spiritual teacher are not even scratched. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (966-3) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo nar peer nivaaji-aa tinHaa anch na laag. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਪੀਿਰ ਿਨਵਾਿਜਆ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Fareed, blessed is the life, with such a beautiful body.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa umar suhaavarh ee sang suvannrh ee dayh.

lines.english: How rare are those who are found to love their Beloved Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (966-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: virlay kay-ee paa-ee-aniH jinHaa pi-aaray nayh. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਉਮਰ  ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ  ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: He alone obtains meditation, austerities, self-discipline, compassion and Dharmic faith,whom the Lord so blesses.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam d a-i-aa Dh aram jis d eh so paa-ay.

lines.english: He alone meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, whose fire the Lord puts out.
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaa-ihi agan aap so naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Inaccessible Primal Lord, inspires us to look upon all with an impartial eye.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee agam purakh  ik darisat d ikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: With the support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one falls in love withGod.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai aasrai parabh  si-o rang laa-ay.

lines.english: One's faults are eradicated, and one's face becomes radiant and bright; through theLord's Name, one crosses over.
lines.transliteration: a-ugan kat mukh  ujlaa har naam t araa-ay.

lines.english: The fear of birth and death is removed, and he is not reincarnated again.
lines.transliteration: janam maran bh a-o kati-on fir jon na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਆਸਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit, and attaches him to the hemof His robe.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay kaadh i-an larh  aap farh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗਣ  ਕਿਟ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God forgives him, and holds him close in His embrace. ||21|| slok mÚ 5 ] (966-8) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhas milaa-i-an rakh ay gal laa-ay. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭਉ ਕਿਟਓਨੁ ਿਫਿਰ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: One who loves God is imbued with the deep crimson color of His love.
lines.transliteration: muhabat jis kh udaa-ay d ee rat aa rang chalool.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਿਢਅਨੁ ਲੜੁ ਆਿਪ  ਫੜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, such a person is rarely found; the value of such a humble person can neverbe estimated. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (966-9) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak virlay paa-ee-ah tis jan keem na mool. ||1||

lines.english: The True Name has pierced the nucleus of my self deep within. Outside, I see theTrue Lord as well.
lines.transliteration: andar viDh aa sach naa-ay baahar bh ee sach dith om.

lines.english: O Nanak, He is pervading and permeating all places, the forests and the meadows,the three worlds, and every hair. ||2|| pauVI ] (966-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ravi-aa habh thaa-ay van  tarin taribhavan rom. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਹਬਿਤ  ਿਜਸੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਦੀ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself created the Universe; He Himself imbues it.
lines.transliteration: aapay keeto rachan aapay hee rat i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਪਾਈਅਿਹ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਮੂਿਲ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is One, and He Himself has numerous forms.
lines.transliteration: aapay ho-i-o ik aapay baho bhat i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself is within all, and He Himself is beyond them.
lines.transliteration: aapay sabhnaa manjh  aapay baahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਿਵਧਾ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਇ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਿਡਠੋਿਮ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is known to be far away, and He Himself is right here.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaaneh d oor aapay hee jaahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਿਵਆ ਹਭ ਥਾਇ  ਵਿਣ ਿਤਰ੍ਿਣ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਰੋਿਮ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed.
lines.transliteration: aapay hoveh gupat aapay pargatee-ai.

lines.english: No one can estimate the value of Your Creation, Lord.
lines.transliteration: keemat kisai na paa-ay t ayree thatee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਤੋ  ਰਚਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਰਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are deep and profound, unfathomable, infinite and invaluable.
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer athaahu apaar agn at tooN.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹੋਇਓ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ  ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One Lord is all-pervading. You are the One and only. ||22||1||2|| Sudh|| rwmklI kI vwr rwie blvMif qQw sqY fUim AwKI  (966-14) raamkalee kee vaar raa-ay balvand tathaa sat ai doom aakh ee Vaar Of Raamkalee, Uttered By Satta And Balwand The Drummer: <> siqgur pRswid ] (966-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak vartai ik iko ik t ooN. ||22||1||2|| suDh .

lines.english: One who chants the Name of the Almighty Creator - how can his words be judged?
lines.transliteration: naa-o kartaa kaad ar karay ki-o bol hovai jokh eevad ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਦੂਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: His divine virtues are the true sisters and brothers; through them, the gift of supreme status is obtained.
lines.transliteration: day gunaa sat  bhain bharaav hai paarangat  daan parh eevad ai.

lines.english: Nanak established the kingdom; He built the true fortress on the strongestfoundations.
lines.transliteration: naanak raaj chalaa-i-aa sach kot sataan ee neev d ai.

lines.english: He installed the royal canopy over Lehna's head; chanting the Lord's Praises, He drankin the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: lahnay Dh ari-on chh at sir kar sift ee amrit  peevd ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਗਣਤੁ  ਤੂੰ ॥
lines.english: The Guru implanted the almighty sword of the Teachings to illuminate his soul.
lines.transliteration: mat gur aat am dayv d ee kh arhag jor puraaku-ay jee-a d ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨੨॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru bowed down to His disciple, while Nanak was still alive.
lines.transliteration: gur chaylay rahraas kee-ee naanak salaamat theevd ai.

lines.english: The King, while still alive, applied the ceremonial mark to his forehead. ||1||
lines.transliteration: seh tikaa dit os jeevd ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਰਾਇ  ਬਲਵੰਿਡ  ਤਥਾ ਸਤੈ ਡੂਿਮ ਆਖੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak proclaimed Lehna's succession - he earned it.
lines.transliteration: lahnay d ee fayraa-ee-ai naankaa d ohee kh atee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਕਉ  ਬੋਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਖੀਵਦੈ  ॥
lines.english: They shared the One Light and the same way; the King just changed His body.
lines.transliteration: jot ohaa jugat  saa-ay seh kaa-i-aa fayr paltee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇ ਗੁਨਾ  ਸਿਤ ਭੈਣ ਭਰਾਵ  ਹੈ ਪਾਰੰਗਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਪੜੀਵਦੈ  ॥
lines.english: The immaculate canopy waves over Him, and He sits on the throne in the Guru's shop.
lines.transliteration: jhulai so chh at niranjanee mal t akhat baith aa gur hatee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਰਾਜੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਤਾਣੀ  ਨੀਵ ਦੈ ॥
lines.english: He does as the Guru commands; He tasted the tasteless stone of Yoga. pMnw 967
lines.transliteration: karahi je gur furmaa-i-aa sil jog aloonee chatee-ai.

lines.english: The Langar - the Kitchen of the Guru's Shabad has been opened, and its supplies never run short.
lines.transliteration: langar chalai gur sabad har t ot na aavee kh atee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੀ  ਖਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever His Master gave, He spent; He distributed it all to be eaten.
lines.transliteration: kharchay d it khasamm d ee aap kh ahdee kh air dabtee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਖਰਚੇ  ਿਦਿਤ  ਖਸੰਮ  ਦੀ ਆਪ  ਖਹਦੀ  ਖੈਿਰ ਦਬਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Praises of the Master were sung, and the Divine Light descended from the heavens to the earth.
lines.transliteration: hovai sifat kh asamm d ee noor arsahu kursahu jh atee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵੈ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਖਸੰਮ  ਦੀ ਨੂਰੁ ਅਰਸਹੁ ਕੁਰਸਹੁ ਝਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon You, O True King, the filth of countless past lives is washed away.
lines.transliteration: tuDh dithay sachay paat isaah mal janam janam d ee katee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਿਡਠੇ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਦੀ ਕਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru gave the True Command; why should we hesitate to proclaim this?
lines.transliteration: sach je gur furmaa-i-aa ki-o aydoo bolhu hatee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਜ ਗੁਿਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਏਦੂ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: His sons did not obey His Word; they turned their backs on Him as Guru.
lines.transliteration: putree ka-ul na paali-o kar peerahu kanH murtee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ੀ ਕਉਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਿਲਓ  ਕਿਰ ਪੀਰਹੁ ਕੰਨ ਮੁਰਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: These evil-hearted ones became rebellious; they carry loads of sin on their backs.
lines.transliteration: dil kh otai aakee firniH baneh bh aar uchaa-iniH chhatee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਿਲ  ਖੋਟੈ ਆਕੀ  ਿਫਰਿਨ  ਬੰਿਨ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਿਨ ਛਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Guru said, Lehna did, and so he was installed on the throne.
lines.transliteration: jin aakhee so-ee karay jin keet ee tinai thatee-ai.

lines.english: Who has lost, and who has won? ||2||
lines.transliteration: ka-un haaray kin uvtee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: He who did the work, is accepted as Guru; so which is better - the thistle or the rice?
lines.transliteration: jin keetee so mannn aa ko saal jivaahay saalee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਮੰਨਣਾ  ਕੋ ਸਾਲੁ  ਿਜਵਾਹੇ  ਸਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay hai d ayvtaa lai galaa karay d alaalee. The Righteous Judge of Dharma considered the arguments and made the decision.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਹੈ ਦੇਵਤਾ  ਲੈ ਗਲਾ  ਕਰੇ ਦਲਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the True Guru says, the True Lord does; it comes to pass instantaneously.
lines.transliteration: satgur aakh ai sachaa karay saa baat  hovai d arhaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ  ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਹਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Angad was proclaimed, and the True Creator confirmed it.
lines.transliteration: gur angad d ee dohee firee sach kart ai banDh  bahaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ  ਦੀ ਦੋਹੀ ਿਫਰੀ  ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੈ  ਬੰਿਧ ਬਹਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak merely changed his body; He still sits on the throne, with hundreds of branches reaching out.
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa-i-aa palat kar mal takh at baith aa sai daalee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਾਇਆ ਪਲਟੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਿਲ ਤਖਤੁ  ਬੈਠਾ ਸੈ ਡਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Standing at His door, His followers serve Him; by this service, their rust is scraped off.
lines.transliteration: dar sayvay umat  kharhee maskalai ho-ay jangaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਉਮਿਤ  ਖੜੀ ਮਸਕਲੈ  ਹੋਇ ਜੰਗਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Dervish - the Saint, at the door of His Lord and Master; He loves the TrueName, and the Bani of the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: dar darvays kh asamm d ai naa-ay sachai ban ee laalee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਖਸੰਮ  ਦੈ ਨਾਇ  ਸਚੈ ਬਾਣੀ  ਲਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Balwand says that Khivi, the Guru's wife, is a noble woman, who gives soothing, leafyshade to all.
lines.transliteration: balvand kheevee nayk jan jis bahut ee chh aa-o pat raalee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਲਵੰਡ  ਖੀਵੀ  ਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਿਜਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਛਾਉ  ਪਤਰ੍ਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: She distributes the bounty of the Guru's Langar; the kheer - the rice pudding andghee, is like sweet ambrosia.
lines.transliteration: langar da-ulat  vandee-ai ras amrit  kheer gh i-aalee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੰਗਿਰ  ਦਉਲਿਤ ਵੰਡੀਐ  ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਖੀਿਰ  ਿਘਆਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: The faces of the Guru's Sikhs are radiant and bright; the self-willed manmukhs arepale, like straw.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa kay mukh  ujlay manmukh  thee-ay paraalee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਥੀਏ ਪਰਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Master gave His approval, when Angad exerted Himself heroically.
lines.transliteration: pa-ay kabool khasamm naal jaaN ghaal mard ee gh aalee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਏ ਕਬੂਲੁ  ਖਸੰਮ ਨਾਿਲ  ਜ ਘਾਲ  ਮਰਦੀ  ਘਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the Husband of mother Khivi; He sustains the world. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maataa kh eevee saho so-ay jin go-ay uth aalee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤਾ  ਖੀਵੀ  ਸਹੁ ਸੋਇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: It is as if the Guru made the Ganges flow in the opposite direction, and the world wonders: what has he done?
lines.transliteration: horiN-o gang vahaa-ee-ai duni-aa-ee aakh ai ke ki-on.

lines.english: Nanak, the Lord, the Lord of the World, spoke the words out loud.
lines.transliteration: naanak eesar jagnaath uchhadee vain  viriki-on.

lines.english: Making the mountain his churning stick, and the snake-king his churning string, Hehas churned the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: maaDhaan aa parbat  kar nait ar baasak sabad  rirhki-on.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਧਾਣਾ  ਪਰਬਤੁ ਕਿਰ ਨੇਿਤਰ੍  ਬਾਸਕੁ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਰੜਿਕਓਨ ੁ ॥
lines.english: From it, He extracted the fourteen jewels, and illuminated the world.
lines.transliteration: cha-odah rat an nikaali-an kar aavaa ga-on  chilki-on.

lines.english: He revealed such creative power, and touched such greatness.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  ah vaykh aali-an jin  aivad pid th inki-on.

lines.english: He raised the royal canopy to wave over the head of Lehna, and raised His glory tothe skies.
lines.transliteration: lahnay Dh ari-on chh atar sir asmaan ki-aarh aa chh iki-on.

lines.english: His Light merged into the Light, and He blended Him into Himself.
lines.transliteration: jot samaan ee jot  maahi aap aapai sayt ee miki-on.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਮਾਿਹ  ਆਪੁ  ਆਪੈ  ਸੇਤੀ ਿਮਿਕਓਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak tested His Sikhs and His sons, and everyone saw what happened.
lines.transliteration: sikhaaN putraaN ghokh kai sabh  umat  vaykh hu je ki-on.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਖ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਘੋਿਖ  ਕੈ ਸਭ ਉਮਿਤ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਿਜ ਿਕਓਨੁ ॥
lines.english: When Lehna alone was found to be pure, then He was set on the throne. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jaaN suDhos t aaN lahnaa tiki-on. ||4||

lines.english: Then, the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor.
lines.transliteration: fayr vasaa-i-aa faru-aan sat gur kh aadoor.

lines.english: Meditation, austerities and self-discipline rest  with You, while the others are filled with excessive pride.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam naal t uDh hor much garoor.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Greed ruins mankind, like the green algae in the water.
lines.transliteration: lab vinaahay maan saa ji-o paan ee boor.

lines.english: In the Guru's Court, the Divine Light shines in its creative power.
lines.transliteration: varHi-ai dargeh guroo kee kud ratee noor.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਰਐ ਦਰਗਹ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ  ਨੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You are the cooling peace, whose depth cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: jit so haath na labh -ee tooN oh th aroor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਸੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਤੂੰ ਓਹੁ ਠਰੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You are overflowing with the nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam, the Nameof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam niDh aan hai t uDh vich bh arpoor.

lines.english: Whoever slanders You will be totally ruined and destroyed.
lines.transliteration: nindaa t ayree jo karay so vanj ai choor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੰਞੈ ਚੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: People of the world can see only what is near at hand, but You can see far beyond.
lines.transliteration: nayrhai d isai maat  lok tuDh sujhai door.

lines.punjabi: ਨੇੜੈ ਿਦਸੈ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Then the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor. ||5|| pMnw 968
lines.transliteration: fayr vasaa-i-aa faru-aan sat gur kh aadoor. ||5||

lines.english: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.
lines.transliteration: so tikaa so baihnaa so-ee d eebaan .

lines.english: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved.
lines.transliteration: piyoo daad ay jayvihaa pot aa parvaan .

lines.english: He took the thousand-headed serpent as his churning string, and with the force of devotional love, he churned the ocean of the world with his churning stick, theSumayr mountain.
lines.transliteration: blvMif qy sqw) jin baasak naytrai gh ati-aa kar nayhee t aan. jin samund  viroli-aa kar mayr maDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਬਾਸਕੁ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ੈ ਘਿਤਆ  ਕਿਰ ਨੇਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He extracted the fourteen jewels, and brought forth the Divine Light.
lines.transliteration: cha-odah rat an nikaali-an keet on chaanaan .

lines.english: He made intuition his horse, and chastity his saddle.
lines.transliteration: ghorh aa keet o sahj d aa jat  kee-o palaan .

lines.english: Dhanakh charh aa-i-o sat  daa jas hand aa baan . He placed the arrow of the Lord's Praise in the bow of Truth.

lines.punjabi: ਘੋੜਾ  ਕੀਤੋ  ਸਹਜ  ਦਾ ਜਤੁ ਕੀਓ  ਪਲਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there was only pitch darkness. Then, He rose like thesun to illuminate the darkness.
lines.transliteration: kal vich Dhoo anDh aar saa charh i-aa rai bh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਧਣਖੁ  ਚੜਾਇਓ  ਸਤ ਦਾ ਜਸ ਹੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He farms the field of Truth, and spreads out the canopy of Truth.
lines.transliteration: satahu kh ayt jamaa-i-o sat ahu chh aavaan .

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਧੂ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਚਿੜਆ  ਰੈ ਭਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: Your kitchen always has ghee and flour to eat.
lines.transliteration: nit raso-ee t ayree-ai gh i-o maid aa kh aan.

lines.english: You understand the four corners of the universe; in your mind, the Word of the Shabad is approved and supreme.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaaN sujhee-os man meh sabad  parvaan .

lines.english: You eliminate the comings and goings of reincarnation, and bestow the insignia ofYour Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on nivaari-o kar nad ar neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡ ਸੁਝੀਓਸੁ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Avataar, the Incarnation of the all-knowing Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: a-utri-aa a-ut aar lai so purakh  sujaan .

lines.english: You are not pushed or shaken by the storm and the wind; you are like the SumayrMountain.
lines.transliteration: jhakh arh vaa-o na dol-ee parbat  mayraan .

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਤਿਰਆ  ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: You know the inner state of the soul; You are the Knower of knowers.
lines.transliteration: jaanai birthaa jee-a kee jaan ee hoo jaan .

lines.punjabi: ਝਖਿੜ  ਵਾਉ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ  ਪਰਬਤੁ  ਮੇਰਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: How can I praise You, O True Supreme King, when You are so wise and all-knowing?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa saalaahee sachay paatisaah jaaN too sugh arh sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਜਾਣੀ  ਹੂ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Those blessings granted by the Pleasure of the True Guru - please bless Satta withthose gifts.
lines.transliteration: daan je sat gur bh aavsee so sat ay daan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਚੇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ਜ ਤੂ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing Nanak's canopy waving over Your head, everyone was astonished.
lines.transliteration: naanak handaa chh atar sir umat  hairaan .

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨੁ ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਵਸੀ  ਸੋ ਸਤੇ ਦਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.
lines.transliteration: so tikaa so baihnaa so-ee d eebaan .

lines.english: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved. ||6||
lines.transliteration: piyoo daad ay jayvihaa pot raa parvaan . ||6||

lines.english: Dhan Dh an raamd aas gur jin siri-aa t inai savaari-aa. Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.
Perfect is Your miracle; the Creator Lord Himself has installed You on the throne.
lines.transliteration: pooree ho-ee karaamaat aap sirjan haarai Dh aari-aa.

lines.english: The Sikhs and all the Congregation recognize You as the Supreme Lord God, and bow down to You.
lines.transliteration: sikhee at ai sangt ee paarbarahm kar namaskaari-aa.

lines.english: You are unchanging, unfathomable and immeasurable; You have no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: atal athaahu atol t oo tayraa ant  na paaraavaari-aa.

lines.english: Those who serve You with love - You carry them across.
lines.transliteration: jinHee tooN sayvi-aa bh aa-o kar say t uDh paar ut aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ  ਤੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Greed, envy, sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment - You have beaten themand driven them out.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh kaam kroDh  moh maar kadh ay tuDh saparvaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਤੂੰ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan so t ayraa thaan hai sach t ayraa paiskaari-aa. Blessed is Your place, and True is Your magnificent glory.

lines.punjabi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਢੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਪਰਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are Nanak, You are Angad, and You are Amar Daas; so do I recognize You.
lines.transliteration: naanak too lahn aa toohai gur amar t oo veechaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੈਸਕਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: When I saw the Guru, then my mind was comforted and consoled. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur dithaa t aaN man saaDh aari-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਲਹਣਾ  ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰੁਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form.
lines.transliteration: chaaray jaagay chahu jugee panchaa-in aapay ho-aa.

lines.english: He created Himself, and He Himself is the supporting pillar.
lines.transliteration: aapeenHai aap saaji-on aapay hee thamiH khalo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ  ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the paper, He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the writer.
lines.transliteration: aapay patee kalam aap aap likhan haaraa ho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੀਨੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਸਾਿਜਓਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਥੰਿਮ ਖਲੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: All His followers come and go; He alone is fresh and new.
lines.transliteration: sabh umat  aavan  jaavn ee aapay hee navaa niro-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਿਪ ਿਲਖਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Arjun sits on the throne; the royal canopy waves over the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: takhat baith aa arjan guroo sat gur kaa kh ivai chand o-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਉਮਿਤ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਵਣੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਨਵਾ ਿਨਰੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: From east to west, He illuminates the four directions.
lines.transliteration: ugavnahu t ai aathavn ahu chahu chakee kee-an lo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਖਿਤ  ਬੈਠਾ ਅਰਜਨ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਿਖਵੈ ਚੰਦੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those self-willed manmukhs who do not serve the Guru die in shame.
lines.transliteration: jinHee guroo na sayvi-o manmukhaa pa-i-aa mo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੈ ਆਥਵਣਹ ੁ ਚਹੁ ਚਕੀ  ਕੀਅਨੁ ਲੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Your miracles increase two-fold, even four-fold; this is the True Lord's true blessing.
lines.transliteration: doonee cha-un ee karaamaat  sachay kaa sachaa dh o-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਪਇਆ  ਮੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form. ||8||1|| rwmklI bwxI Bgqw kI ] (968-19) raamkalee banee bh agtaa kee. Raamkalee, The Word Of The Devotees. kbIr jIau  (968-19) kabeer jee-o Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (968-19) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: chaaray jaagay chahu jugee panchaa-in aapay ho-aa. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਣੀ  ਚਉਣੀ  ਕਰਾਮਾਿਤ  ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Make your body the vat, and mix in the yeast. Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad bethe molasses. pMnw 969
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kalaalan laahan mayla-o gur kaa sabad gurh  keen ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਲਉ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁੜੁ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Cut up desire, sexuality, anger, pride and envy, and let them be the fermenting bark. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa kaam kroDh  mad matsar kaat kaat kas d een ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਕਸੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Is there any Saint, with intuitive peace and poise deep within, unto whom I mightoffer my meditation and austerities as payment?
lines.transliteration: ko-ee hai ray sant sahj sukh  antar jaa ka-o jap t ap day-o d alaalee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਦੇਉ ਦਲਾਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my body and mind to whoever gives me even a drop of this wine from such a vat. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk boond bh ar tan man d ayva-o jo mad  day-ay kalaalee ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਿਰ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ  ਜੋ ਮਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਕਲਾਲੀ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have made the fourteen worlds the furnace, and I have burnt my body with the fireof God.
lines.transliteration: bhavan chat ur das bh aathee keenHee barahm agan t an jaaree ray.

lines.english: My mudra - my hand-gesture, is the pipe; tuning into the celestial sound currentwithin, the Shushmanaa - the central spinal channel, is my cooling pad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mudraa mad ak sahj Dh un laagee sukh man pochanhaaree ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਨ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਦਸ ਭਾਠੀ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਤਿਨ  ਜਾਰੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Pilgrimages, fasting, vows, purifications, self-discipline, austerities and breath controlthrough the sun and moon channels - all these I pledge.
lines.transliteration: tirath barat  naym such sanjam rav sas gahnai d ay-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਦਰ੍ਾ ਮਦਕ ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ਸੁਖਮਨ  ਪੋਚਨਹਾਰੀ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: My focused consciousness is the cup, and the Ambrosial Nectar is the pure juice. Idrink in the supreme, sublime essence of this juice. ||3||
lines.transliteration: surat pi-aal suDh aa ras amrit  ayhu mahaa ras pay-o ray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਬਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਸੁਿਚ ਸੰਜਮ  ਰਿਵ ਸਿਸ ਗਹਨੈ  ਦੇਉ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The pure stream constantly trickles forth, and my mind is intoxicated by this sublimeessence.
lines.transliteration: nijhar Dh aar chu-ai at  nirmal ih ras manoo-aa raat o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਿਪਆਲ  ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੇਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, all other wines are trivial and tasteless; this is the only true, sublimeessence. ||4||1||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer saglay mad chh oochh ay ihai mahaa ras saacho ray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਝਰ  ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਿਤ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਇਹ ਰਸ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਤੋ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Make spiritual wisdom the molasses, meditation the flowers, and the Fear of God thefire enshrined in your mind.
lines.transliteration: gurh kar gi-aan Dh i-aan kar mahoo-aa bh a-o bh aathee man Dh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਮਦ ਛੂਛੇ ਇਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Shushmanaa, the central spinal channel, is intuitively balanced, and the drinker drinks in this wine. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sukhman naaree sahj samaanee peevai peevanhaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਹੂਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਠੀ  ਮਨ ਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O hermit Yogi, my mind is intoxicated.
lines.transliteration: a-oDhoo mayraa man mat vaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਮਨ  ਨਾਰੀ  ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਨੀ  ਪੀਵੈ ਪੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When that wine rises up, one tastes the sublime essence of this juice, and sees acrossthe three worlds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: unmad chadh aa mad an ras chaakh i-aa taribhavan bh a-i-aa uji-aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Joining the two channels of the breath, I have lit the furnace, and I drink in thesupreme, sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: du-ay pur jor rasaa-ee bh aathee pee-o mahaa ras bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨਮਦ  ਚਢਾ  ਮਦਨ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਨ  ਭਇਆ  ਉਿਜਆਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have burnt both sexual desire and anger, and I have been emancipated from theworld. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh d u-ay kee-ay jalayt aa chh oot ga-ee sansaaree. ||2||

lines.english: The light of spiritual wisdom enlightens me; meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, Ihave obtained this understanding.
lines.transliteration: pargat pargaas gi-aan gur gammit sat gur tay suDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਪੁਰ ਜੋਿਰ ਰਸਾਈ  ਭਾਠੀ  ਪੀਉ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Kabeer is intoxicated with that wine, which never wears off. ||3||2||
lines.transliteration: daas kabeer t aas mad  maat aa uchak na kabhoo jaa-ee. ||3||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕੀਏ ਜਲੇਤਾ  ਛੂਿਟ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are my Sumayr Mountain, O my Lord and Master; I have grasped Your Support.
lines.transliteration: tooN mayro mayr parbat  su-aamee ot gahee mai t ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਗੁਰ ਗੰਿਮਤ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਸੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You do not shake, and I do not fall. You have preserved my honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa tum dolahu naa ham girt ay rakh  leenee har mayree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ  ਉਚਿਕ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: Now and then, here and there, You, only You.
lines.transliteration: ab tab jab kab t uhee t uhee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੁ ਪਰਬਤੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, I am forever in peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham tu-a parsaad  sukh ee sad  hee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਿਗਰਤੇ  ਰਿਖ ਲੀਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Relying upon You, I can live even in the cursed place of Magahar; You have put out the fire of my body.
lines.transliteration: toray bh arosay maghar basi-o mayray t an kee t apat bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਜਬ ਕਬ ਤੁਹੀ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
lines.english: First, I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan in Magahar; then, I came to dwellat Benares. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pahilay darsan maghar paa-i-o fun kaasee basay aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤੁਅ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਸੁਖੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As is Magahar, so is Benares; I see them as one and the same.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa maghar taisee kaasee ham aykai kar jaanee.

lines.english: I am poor, but I have obtained this wealth of the Lord; the proud are bursting withpride, and die. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham nirDhan ji-o ih Dh an paa-i-aa mart ay foot gumaanee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਰੇ ਭਰੋਸੇ  ਮਗਹਰ  ਬਿਸਓ  ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਪਿਤ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who takes pride in himself is stuck with thorns; no one can pull them out.
lines.transliteration: karai gumaan chubheh t is soolaa ko kaadh an ka-o naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੇ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਗਹਰ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਫੁਿਨ ਕਾਸੀ  ਬਸੇ ਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Here, he cries bitterly, and hereafter, he burns in the most hideous hell. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ajai so chobh ka-o bilal bilaat ay narkay gh or pachaahee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਸੀ  ਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: What is hell, and what is heaven? The Saints reject them both.
lines.transliteration: kavan narak ki-aa surag bichaaraa santan d o-oo raad ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਿਨਰਧਨ  ਿਜਉ  ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਰਤੇ ਫੂਿਟ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have no obligation to either of them, by the Grace of my Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ham kaahoo kee kaan na kadh -tay apnay gur parsaad ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਚੁਭਿਹ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੂਲਾ  ਕੋ ਕਾਢਨ  ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Now, I have mounted to the throne of the Lord; I have met the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.
lines.transliteration: ab ta-o jaa-ay chadh ay singh aasan milay hai saringpaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਚੋਭ ਕਉ ਿਬਲਲ ਿਬਲਾਤੇ  ਨਰਕੇ  ਘੋਰ ਪਚਾਹੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord and Kabeer have become one. No one can tell them apart. ||6||3||
lines.transliteration: raam kabeeraa ayk bha-ay hai ko-ay na sakai pachh aanee. ||6||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਨਰਕੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਸੁਰਗੁ  ਿਬਚਾਰਾ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਦੋਊ ਰਾਦੇ ॥
lines.english: I honor and obey the Saints, and punish the wicked; this is my duty as God's policeofficer.
lines.transliteration: santaa maan-o d ootaa daana-o ih kutvaaree mayree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਿਣ  ਨ ਕਢਤੇ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Day and night, I wash Your feet, Lord; I wave my hair as the chauree, to brush awaythe flies. ||1||
lines.transliteration: divas rain t ayray paa-o palosa-o kays chavar kar fayree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ  ਚਢੇ ਿਸੰਘਾਸਿਨ  ਿਮਲੇ ਹੈ ਸਾਿਰੰਗਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am a dog at Your Court, Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham kookar tayray d arbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀ  ॥੬॥੩॥
lines.english: I open my snout and bark before it. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 970
lines.transliteration: bha-ukahi aagai bad an pasaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In my past life, I was Your servant; now, I cannot leave You.
lines.transliteration: poorab janam ham tumHray sayvak ab t a-o miti-aa na jaa-ee.

lines.english: The celestial sound current resounds at Your Door. Your insignia is stamped upon my forehead. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayray d u-aarai Dh un sahj kee maathai mayray d agaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਬ  ਜਨਮ  ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਅਬ ਤਉ ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are branded with Your brand fight bravely in battle; those without Yourbrand run away.
lines.transliteration: daagay hohi so ran meh joojh eh bin d aagay bh ag jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੁਿਨ ਸਹਜ  ਕੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਗਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who becomes a Holy person, appreciates the value of devotional worship to theLord. The Lord places him in His treasury. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo ho-ay so bh agat pachh aanai har la-ay kh ajaanai paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਗੇ  ਹੋਿਹ ਸੁ ਰਨ ਮਿਹ ਜੂਝਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਦਾਗੇ  ਭਿਗ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In the fortress is the chamber; by contemplative meditation it becomes the supremechamber.
lines.transliteration: kothray meh koth ree param koth ee beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਛਾਨੈ  ਹਿਰ ਲਏ ਖਜਾਨੈ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru has blessed Kabeer with the commodity, saying, "Take this commodity;cherish it and keep it secure."||4||
lines.transliteration: gur deenee basat  kabeer ka-o layvhu basat  samHaar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਠਰੇ  ਮਿਹ ਕੋਠਰੀ  ਪਰਮ  ਕੋਠੀ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer gives it to the world, but he alone receives it, upon whose forehead suchdestiny is recorded.
lines.transliteration: kabeer dee-ee sansaar ka-o leenee jis mast ak bh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਉ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਬਸਤੁ  ਸਮਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Permanent is the marriage, of one who receives this ambrosial essence. ||5||4||
lines.transliteration: amrit ras jin paa-i-aa thir t aa kaa sohaag. ||5||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਿਰ  ਦੀਈ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਕਉ ਲੀਨੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
lines.english: O Brahmin, how can you forget the One, from whose mouth the Vedas and the Gayitriprayer issured forth?
lines.transliteration: jih mukh bayd  gaa-it aree niksai so ki-o barahman bisar karai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਥਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.english: The whole world falls at His feet; why don't you chant the Name of that Lord, O Pandit? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai paa-ay jagat sabh  laagai so ki-o pandit  har na kahai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਦੁ ਗਾਇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਸੋ ਿਕਉ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਨੁ ਿਬਸਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Why, O my Brahmin, do you not chant the Lord's Name?
lines.transliteration: kaahay mayray baamHan har na kaheh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: If you don't chant the Lord's Name, O Pandit, you will only suffer in hell. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam na boleh paaday dojak bh areh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਨ ਕਹਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: You think that you are high, but you take food from the houses of the lowly; you fillup your belly by forcibly practicing your rituals.
lines.transliteration: aapan ooch neech ghar bh ojan hath ay karam kar ud ar bhareh.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਪਾਡੇ ਦੋਜਕੁ  ਭਰਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: On the fourteenth day, and the night of the new moon, you go out begging; eventhough you hold the lamp in your hands, still, you fall into the pit. ||2||
lines.transliteration: cha-udas amaavas rach rach maaNgeh kar d eepak lai koop pareh. ||2||

lines.english: You are a Brahmin, and I am only a weaver from Benares. How can I compare to you?
lines.transliteration: tooN barahman mai kaaseek julhaa muhi t ohi baraabaree kaisay kai baneh.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਘਿਰ  ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, I have been saved; relying on the Vedas, O Brahmin, youshall drown and die. ||3||5||
lines.transliteration: hamray raam naam kahi ubray bayd bh arosay paaNday doob mareh. ||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਦਸ  ਅਮਾਵਸ  ਰਿਚ ਰਿਚ ਮਗਿਹ  ਕਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਲੈ ਕੂਿਪ ਪਰਿਹ  ॥੨॥
