lines.english: There is a single tree, with countless branches and twigs; its flowers and leaves arefilled with its juice.
lines.transliteration: tarvar ayk anant  daar saakh aa puhap pat ar ras bh aree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ  ਜੁਲਹਾ  ਮੁਿਹ ਤੋਿਹ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ  ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਨਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: This world is a garden of Ambrosial Nectar. The Perfect Lord created it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih amrit kee baarh ee hai ray t in har poorai karee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਿਹ ਉਬਰੇ  ਬੇਦ ਭਰੋਸੇ  ਪਡੇ ਡੂਿਬ ਮਰਿਹ  ॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: I have come to know the story of my Sovereign Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaanee jaanee ray raajaa raam kee kahaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤ  ਡਾਰ ਸਾਖਾ  ਪੁਹਪ  ਪਤਰ੍ ਰਸ ਭਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who knows, and whose inner being is illumined by theLord's Light. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: antar jot  raam pargaasaa gurmukh  birlai jaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕੀ ਬਾੜੀ  ਹੈ ਰੇ ਿਤਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The bumble bee, addicted to the nectar of the twelve-petalled flowers, enshrines it inthe heart.
lines.transliteration: bhavar ayk puhap ras beeDh aa baarah lay ur Dh ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਨੀ  ਜਾਨੀ  ਰੇ ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਹਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: He holds his breath suspended in the sixteen-petalled sky of the Akaashic Ethers, andbeats his wings in esctasy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sorah maDhay pavan jh akori-aa aakaasay far fari-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਬਰਲੈ  ਜਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the profound void of intuitive Samaadhi, the one tree rises up; it soaks up thewater of desire from the ground.
lines.transliteration: sahj sunn ik birvaa upji-aa Dhart ee jalhar sokh i-aa.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I am the servant of those who have seen this celestial tree. ||3||6||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ha-o taa kaa sayvak jin ih birvaa d aykhi-aa. ||3||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਹਪ  ਰਸ ਬੀਧਾ  ਬਾਰਹ  ਲੇ ਉਰ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Make silence your ear-rings, and compassion your wallet; let meditation be yourbegging bowl.
lines.transliteration: mundraa mon d a-i-aa kar jh olee pat ar kaa karahu beechaar ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਹ  ਮਧੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਿਰਆ  ਆਕਾਸੇ  ਫਰੁ ਫਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Sew this body as your patched coat, and take the Lord's Name as your support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khinthaa ih t an see-a-o apnaa naam kara-o aaDh aar ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੁੰਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਿਬਰਵਾ  ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਜਲਹਰੁ ਸੋਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: Practice such Yoga, O Yogi.
lines.transliteration: aisaa jog kamaavahu jogee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹੁ ਿਬਰਵਾ  ਦੇਿਖਆ  ॥੩॥੬॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, enjoy meditation, austerities and self-discipline. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam gurmukh  bhogee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਦਰ੍ਾ ਮੋਿਨ ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਝੋਲੀ ਪਤਰ੍ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Apply the ashes of wisdom to your body; let your horn be your focused consciousness.
lines.transliteration: buDh bibh oot chadh aava-o apunee singee surat  milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਅਉ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਉ  ਆਧਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Become detached, and wander through the city of your body; play the harp of your mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kar bairaag fira-o tan nagree man kee kinguree bajaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Enshrine the five tatvas - the five elements, within your heart; let your deepmeditative trance be undisturbed.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  lai hird ai raakh o rahai niraalam t aarhee.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: make righteousness and compassion your garden.||3||7||
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu Dh aram d a-i-aa kar baarh ee. ||3||7||

lines.english: For what purpose were you created and brought into the world? What rewards haveyou received in this life?
lines.transliteration: kavan kaaj sirjay jag bheet ar janam kavan fal paa-i-aa.

lines.english: God is the boat to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean; He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires. You have not centered your mind on Him, even for an instant. ||1|| pMnw 971
lines.transliteration: bhav niDh  taran t aaran chint aaman ik nimakh  na ih man laa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, I am such a sinner!
lines.transliteration: gobind ham aisay apraaDh ee.

lines.english: God gave me body and soul, but I have not practiced loving devotional worship toHim. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jI) jin parabh jee-o pind thaa d ee-aa t is kee bh aa-o bh agat nahee saaDh ee. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਥਾ ਦੀਆ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Others' wealth, others' bodies, others' wives, others' slander and others' fights - Ihave not given them up.
lines.transliteration: par Dhan par t an par t ee nind aa par apbaad  na chh ootai.

lines.english: For the sake of these, coming and going in reincarnation happens over and over again, and this story never ends. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aavaa gavan hot hai fun fun ih parsang na t ootai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਪਰ ਅਪਬਾਦੁ  ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
lines.english: That house, in which the Saints speak of the Lord - I have not visited it, even for aninstant.
lines.transliteration: jih ghar kathaa hot  har sant an ik nimakh  na keenHo mai fayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਾ  ਗਵਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੁਿਨ ਫੁਿਨ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸੰਗੁ  ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Drunkards, thieves, and evil-doers - I constantly dwell with them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: lampat chor doot  matvaaray t in sang sad aa basayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਘਿਰ  ਕਥਾ ਹੋਤ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਨ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਕੀਨੋ  ਮੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, the wine of Maya, and envy - these are what I collect withinmyself.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh maa-i-aa mad  matsar ay sampai mo maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੰਪਟ  ਚੋਰ ਦੂਤ ਮਤਵਾਰੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਦਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Compassion, righteousness, and service to the Guru - these do not visit me, even inmy dreams. ||4||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aram ar gur kee sayvaa ay supnant ar naahee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਸੰਪੈ ਮੋ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is merciful to the meek, compassionate and benevolent, the Lover of His devotees,the Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal kirpaal d amod ar bhagat bachh al bhai haaree.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, please protect Your humble servant from disaster; O Lord, I serve only You. ||5||8||
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer bh eer jan raakh o har sayvaa kara-o t umHaaree. ||5||8||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਛਲ  ਭੈ ਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, the door of liberation is found.
lines.transliteration: jih simran ho-ay mukat d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਭੀਰ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੫॥੮॥
lines.english: You shall go to heaven, and not return to this earth.
lines.transliteration: jaahi baikunth nahee sansaar.

lines.english: In the home of the Fearless Lord, the celestial trumpets resound.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o kai gh ar bajaaveh t oor.

lines.english: The unstruck sound current will vibrate and resonate forever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anhad bajeh sad aa bh arpoor. ||1||

lines.english: Practice such meditative remembrance in your mind.
lines.transliteration: aisaa simran kar man maahi.

lines.english: Without this meditative remembrance, liberation will never be found. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin simran mukat kat  naahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, you will meet with no obstruction.
lines.transliteration: jih simran naahee nankaar.

lines.english: You will be liberated, and the great load will be taken away.
lines.transliteration: mukat karai ut rai baho bh aar.

lines.english: Bow in humility within your heart,
lines.transliteration: namaskaar kar hirdai maahi.
fir fir tayraa aavan naahi. ||2|| and you will not have to be reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

lines.english: Remember Him in meditation, celebrate and be happy.
lines.transliteration: jih simran karahi too kayl.

lines.english: God has placed His lamp deep within you, which burns without any oil.
lines.transliteration: deepak baaNDh Dhari-o bin t ayl.

lines.english: That lamp makes the world immortal;
lines.transliteration: so deepak amrak sansaar.
kaam kroDh bikh  kaadh eelay maar. ||3|| it conquers and drives out the poisons of sexual desire and anger. ||3||

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain salvation.
lines.transliteration: jih simran tayree gat  ho-ay.

lines.english: Wear that meditative remembrance as your necklace.
lines.transliteration: so simran rakh kanth  paro-ay.

lines.english: Practice that meditative remembrance, and never let it go.
lines.transliteration: so simran kar nahee raakh ut aar.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, you shall cross over. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee utreh paar. ||4||

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be obligated to others.
lines.transliteration: jih simran naahee tuhi kaan.

lines.english: You shall sleep in your mansion, in blankets of silk.
lines.transliteration: mandar soveh patambar t aan.

lines.english: Your soul shall blossom forth in happiness, on this comfortable bed.

lines.transliteration: jab nakh sikh  ih man cheenHaa.
tab ant ar majan keenHaa. ||1|| then I took my cleansing bath, deep within my self. ||1||

lines.english: The mind, the master of the breath, abides in the state of supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: pavanpat unman rahan kh araa.

lines.transliteration: nahee mirat na janam jaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.transliteration: bayDhee-alay chakar bh uangaa.
bhaytee-alay raa-ay nisangaa. ||2|| and I have met my Sovereign Lord King without fear. ||2||

sas keeno soor giraasaa. the moon energy has devoured the sun energy.

tah baajay anhad  been aa. ||3|| then the unstruck sound current began to vibrate. ||3||

lines.transliteration: baktai bak sabad  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: suntai sun man basaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Chanting to the Creator, one crosses over.
lines.transliteration: kar kartaa ut ras paaraN.

lines.english: Gazing upon the diamond, I humbly salute this diamond.
lines.transliteration: heeraa daykh  heeray kara-o aad ays.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Immaculate Lord is indescribable. ||2||2||11||
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer niranjan alaykh. ||2||2||11||

lines.english: People of the world, remain awake and aware. Even though you are awake, you arebeing robbed, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa husee-aar bayd aar jaagat  musee-at  ha-o ray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਬੁ ਭਇਓ  ਆਂਬੁ  ਆਂਬੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਨੀਬਾ ਕੇਲਾ  ਪਾਕਾ  ਝਾਿਰ  ॥

lines.transliteration: man raam naamaa bayDhee-alay.

lines.english: Becoming detached, I sing the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: bairaagee raameh gaav-ogo.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਜਉ ਿਨਰਮਾਇਲੁ  ਕੀਜੈ ਆਪ  ਬਰਾਬਿਰ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਰ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: How can iron be transformed into gold, unless it touches the Philosopher's Stone?||1|| pMnw 974
lines.transliteration: lohaa kanchan hiran ho-ay kaisay ja-o paarseh na parsai. ||1||

lines.english: O Divine Lord, the knot of skepticism cannot be untied.
lines.transliteration: dayv sansai gaaNth na chh ootai.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, Maya, intoxication and jealousy - these five have combined to plunder the world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh maa-i-aa mad  matsar in panchahu mil lootay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ  ਇਨ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਲੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a great poet, of noble heritage; I am a Pandit, a religious scholar, a Yogi and a Sannyaasi;
lines.transliteration: ham bad kab kuleen ham pandit ham jogee sani-aasee.

lines.english: I am a spiritual teacher, a warrior and a giver - such thinking never ends. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee gunee soor ham daat ay ih buDh  kabeh na naasee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਡ ਕਿਬ ਕੁਲੀਨ  ਹਮ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਹਮ ਜੋਗੀ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, no one understands; they all run around, deluded like madmen.
lines.transliteration: kaho ravidaas sabh ai nahee samjh as bh ool paray jaisay ba-uray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਗੁਨੀ  ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ  ਇਹ ਬੁਿਧ ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਨਾਸੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is my only Support; He is my life, my breath of life, my wealth.||3||1|| rwmklI bwxI byxI jIau kI  (974-5) raamkalee banee bayn ee jee-o kee Raamkalee, The Word Of Baynee Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (974-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mohi aDhaar naam naaraa-in jeevan paraan Dh an moray. ||3||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਸਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝਿਸ  ਭੂਿਲ ਪਰੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਉਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa: these three dwell in oneplace.
lines.transliteration: irhaa pingulaa a-or sukh manaa t een baseh ik th aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.english: This is the true place of confluence of the three sacred rivers: this is where my mindtakes its cleansing bath. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baynee sangam t ah piraag man majan karay t ithaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਬੇਣੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Saints, the Immaculate Lord dwells there;
lines.transliteration: santahu t ahaa niranjan raam hai.

lines.punjabi: ਇੜਾ  ਿਪੰਗੁਲਾ  ਅਉਰ  ਸੁਖਮਨਾ  ਤੀਿਨ  ਬਸਿਹ  ਇਕ ਠਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gam cheenai birlaa ko-ay. how rare are those who go to the Guru, and understand this.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਣੀ  ਸੰਗਮੁ  ਤਹ ਿਪਰਾਗੁ  ਮਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਤਥਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The all-pervading immaculate Lord is there. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tahaaN niranjan rama-ee-aa ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: What is the insignia of the Divine Lord's dwelling?
lines.transliteration: dayv sathaanai ki-aa neesaan ee.

lines.english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates there.
lines.transliteration: tah baajay sabad  anaahad  banee.

lines.english: There is no moon or sun, no air or water there.
lines.transliteration: tah chand  na sooraj pa-un  na paan ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh becomes aware, and knows the Teachings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saakhee jaagee gurmukh  jaanee. ||2||

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom wells up, and evil-mindedness departs;
lines.transliteration: upjai gi-aan durmat  chheejai.
amrit ras gagnant ar bheejai. the nucleus of the mind sky is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who knows the secret of this device,
lines.transliteration: ays kalaa jo jaanai bh ay-o.
bhaytai t aas param gurd ay-o. ||3|| meets the Supreme Divine Guru. ||3||

lines.english: The Tenth Gate is the home of the inaccessible, infinite Supreme Lord.
lines.transliteration: dasam d u-aaraa agam apaaraa param purakh  kee gh aatee.

lines.english: Above the store is a niche, and within this niche is the commodity. ||4||
lines.transliteration: oopar haat haat par aalaa aalay bheet ar thaat ee. ||4||

lines.english: One who remains awake, never sleeps.
lines.transliteration: jaagat rahai so kabahu na sovai.

lines.english: The three qualities and the three worlds vanish, in the state of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: teen t ilok samaaDh  palovai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸਮ  ਦੁਆਰਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਪਰਮ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕੀ ਘਾਟੀ  ॥
lines.english: He takes the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, and keeps it in his heart.
lines.transliteration: beej mantar lai hird ai rahai.

lines.punjabi: ਊਪਿਰ  ਹਾਟੁ ਹਾਟ ਪਿਰ ਆਲਾ  ਆਲੇ  ਭੀਤਿਰ ਥਾਤੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Turning his mind away from the world, he focuses on the cosmic void of the absoluteLord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa ulat sunn meh gahai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਗਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: He remains awake, and he does not lie.
lines.transliteration: jaagat rahai na alee-aa bh aakhai.

lines.english: He keeps the five sensory organs under his control.
lines.transliteration: paacha-o indree bas kar raakh ai.

lines.english: He cherishes in his consciousness the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: gur kee saakhee raakh ai cheet .

lines.english: He dedicates his mind and body to the Lord's Love. ||6||
lines.transliteration: man tan arpai krisan pareet . ||6||

lines.english: He considers his hands to be the leaves and branches of the tree.
lines.transliteration: kar palav saakhaa beechaaray.

lines.english: He does not lose his life in the gamble.
lines.transliteration: apnaa janam na joo-ai haaray.

lines.english: He plugs up the source of the river of evil tendencies.
lines.transliteration: asur nadee kaa banDh ai mool.

lines.english: Turning away from the west, he makes the sun rise in the east.
lines.transliteration: pachhim fayr charh aavai soor.

lines.english: He bears the unbearable, and the drops trickle down within;
lines.transliteration: ajar jarai so nijhar jh arai.
jagannaath si-o gosat karai. ||7|| then, he speaks with the Lord of the world. ||7||

lines.english: The four-sided lamp illuminates the Tenth Gate.
lines.transliteration: cha-umukh d eevaa jot  du-aar.

lines.english: The Primal Lord is at the center of the countless leaves.
lines.transliteration: paloo anat mool bichkaar.

lines.english: He Himself abides there with all His powers.
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa lay aapay rahai.

lines.english: He weaves the jewels into the pearl of the mind. ||8||
lines.transliteration: man maanak rat naa meh guhai. ||8||

lines.english: The lotus is at the forehead, and the jewels surround it.
lines.transliteration: mastak pad am du-aalai man ee.

lines.english: Within it is the Immaculate Lord, the Master of the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: maahi niranjan taribh avan Dhanee.

lines.english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, resound and vibrate their in their purity.
lines.transliteration: panch sabad nirmaa-il baajay.

lines.english: The chauris - the fly brushes wave, and the conch shells blare like thunder.
lines.transliteration: dhulkay chavar sankh  ghan gaajay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh tramples the demons underfoot with his spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: dal mal d aatahu gurmukh  gi-aan.

lines.english: Baynee longs for Your Name, Lord. ||9||1|| pMnw 975 rwgu nt nwrwien mhlw 4 (975-1) raag nat naaraa-in mehlaa 4 Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehl: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (975-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear.No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: baynee jaachai t ayraa naam. ||9||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap ahinis naam haray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Millions and millions of sins and mistakes, committed through countless lifetimes, shallall be put aside and sent away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot kot dokh  baho keenay sabh  parhar paas Dh aray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਿਟ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ  ਸਭ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ਧਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and worship Him in adoration, andserve Him with love, are genuine.
lines.transliteration: har har naam jaapeh aaraaDheh sayvak bh aa-ay kh aray.

lines.english: All their sins are erased, just as water washes off the dirt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh d okh ga-ay sabh  neekar ji-o paanee mail haray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਹ  ਆਰਾਧਿਹ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਭਾਇ  ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.english: That being, who sings the Lord's Praises each and every instant, chants with hismouth the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: khin kh in nar naaraa-in gaavahi mukh  boleh nar narharay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਿਰ  ਿਜਉ  ਪਾਨੀ  ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In a moment, in an instant, the Lord rids him of the five incurable diseases of thebody-village. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch dokh  asaaDh  nagar meh ik kh in pal d oor karay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Very fortunate are those who meditate on the Lord's Name; they alone are the Lord'sdevotees.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har naam Dh i-aavahi har kay bh agat haray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ  ਨਗਰ  ਮਿਹ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I beg for the Sangat, the Congregation; O God, please bless me with them. I am afool, and an idiot - please save me! ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin kee sangat  deh parabh  jaacha-o mai moorh  mugaDh  nistaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ  ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Shower me with Your Mercy and Grace, O Life of the World; save me, I seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa Dhaar jagjeevan rakh  layvhu saran paray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ ਦੇਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਚਉ  ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਿਨਸਤਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; O Lord, please preserve my honor!||4||1|| nt mhlw 4 ] (975-9) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan tumree sarnaa-ee har raakh o laaj haray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servants are blended with the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam jap jan raamai naam ralay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਸਰਨਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ  ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord showers HisMercy upon them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam japi-o gur bachnee har Dhaaree har kiraplay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable. Meditating on Him,His humble servant merges with Him, like water with water.
lines.transliteration: har har agam agochar su-aamee jan jap mil salal sallay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਜਿਪ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਿਮ ਰਲੇ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I ama sacrifice, a sacrifice to His humble servants. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kay sant mil raam ras paa-i-aa ham jan kai bal ballay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਓ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Name of the Supreme, Primal Soul,and all poverty and pain are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: purkhot am har naam jan gaa-i-o sabh  daalad  dukh dallay.

lines.english: Within the body are the five evil and uncontrollable passions. The Lord destroys them in an instant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vich dayhee d okh asaaDh  panch Dh aatoo har kee-ay kh in parlay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਨ ਜਿਪ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਲਲ  ਸਲਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Saint loves the Lord in his mind, like the lotus flower gazing at the moon.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant man pareet  lagaa-ee ji-o d aykhai sas kamlay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ ਬਲਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The clouds hang low, the clouds tremble with thunder, and the mind dances joyfullylike the peacock. ||3||
lines.transliteration: unvai ghan gh an gh anihar garjai man bigsai mor murlay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਗਾਇਓ  ਸਿਭ ਦਾਲਦ  ਦੁਖ ਦਲਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master has placed this yearning within me; I live by seeing and meetingmy Lord.
lines.transliteration: hamrai su-aamee loch ham laa-ee ham jeeveh daykh  har milay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੇਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ  ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਏ ਿਖਨ ਪਰਲੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is addicted to the intoxication of the Lord; meeting with the Lord, hefinds sublime bliss. ||4||2|| nt mhlw 4 ] (975-15) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har amal har laa-ay har maylhu anad bh alay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਈ  ਿਜਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਿਸ ਕਮਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your only Friend. pMnw 976
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap har har naam sakhay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖੇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Name of the Lord; I wash the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har naam Dhi-aa-i-o ham sat gur charan pakh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਹਮ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਨ  ਪਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Exalted Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, keeps a sinner like me in His Sanctuary
lines.transliteration: ootam jagannaath jagd eesur ham paapee saran rakh ay.

lines.english: You are the Greatest Being, Lord, Destroyer of the pains of the meek; You have placed Your Name in my mouth, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tum vad purakh  deen d ukh bhanjan har d ee-o naam mukh ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਊਤਮ  ਜਗੰਨਾਥ  ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ  ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਰਖੇ ॥
lines.english: I am lowly, but I sing the Lofty Praises of the Lord, meeting with the Guru, the TrueGuru, my Friend.
lines.transliteration: har gun ooch neech ham gaa-ay gur satgur sang sakh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਹਿਰ ਦੀਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Like the bitter nimm tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, I am permeated withthe fragrance of sandalwood. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o chandan sang basai nimm birkh aa gun chand an kay baskh ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਹਮ ਗਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਖੇ ॥
lines.english: My faults and sins of corruption are countless; over and over again, I commit them.
lines.transliteration: hamray avgan bikhi-aa bikh ai kay baho baar baar nimkh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਚੰਦਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸੈ ਿਨੰਮੁ ਿਬਰਖਾ  ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ  ਕੇ ਬਸਖੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am unworthy, I am a heavy stone sinking down; but the Lord has carried me across,in association with His humble servants. ||3||
lines.transliteration: avgani-aaray paathar bhaaray har t aaray sang jankh ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਅਵਗਨ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਬਖੈ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਿਨਮਖੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom You save, Lord - all their sins are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o tum har raakh o su-aamee sabh  tin kay paap karikh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਿਨਆਰੇ  ਪਾਥਰ  ਭਾਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਨਖੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Merciful God, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, You have carried across even evilvillains like Harnaakhash. ||4||3|| nt mhlw 4 ] (976-7) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay da-i-aal parabh  su-aamee t um dusat t aaray harn akhay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਭ ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਿਕਰ੍ਖੇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with love.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap har har raam rangay.

lines.english: He alone meditates on You forever and ever, O Primal Lord, O Architect of Destiny, unto whom You grant Your Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahu jis purakh biDh aatay so sad aa sad aa tuDh Dhi-aavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: What sort of Yoga, what spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what virtues pleaseYou?
lines.transliteration: kavan jog kavan gi-aan Dhi-aanaa kavan gunee reejh aavai.

lines.english: He alone is a humble servant, and he alone is God's own devotee, with whom You arein love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so-ee jan so-ee nij bhagt aa jis oopar rang laavai. ||2||

lines.english: That alone is intelligence, that alone is wisdom and cleverness, which inspires one tonever forget God, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: saa-ee mat saa-ee buDh  si-aanap jit  nimakh  na parabh  bisraavai.

lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have found this peace, singing forever the GloriousPraises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsang lag ayhu sukh  paa-i-o har gun sad  hee gaavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਊਪਿਰ  ਰੁਚ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen the Wondrous Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, and now, I see nothing else at all.
lines.transliteration: daykh i-o achraj mahaa mangal roop kichh  aan nahee d istaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has rubbed sway the rust; now how could I ever enter thewomb of reincarnation again? ||4||1|| nt nwrwien mhlw 5 dupdy  (978-13) nat naaraa-in mehlaa 5 dupd ay Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (978-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak morchaa gur laahi-o tah garabh  jon kah aavai. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਜੋਗ ਕਵਨ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨਾ  ਕਵਨ  ਗੁ ਨੀ  ਰੀਝਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: I don't blame anyone else.
lines.transliteration: ulaahano mai kaahoo na dee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਿਨਜ ਭਗਤਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਊਪਿਰ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whatever You do is sweet to my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man meeth t uhaaro kee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਮਿਤ ਸਾਈ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਬਸਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Understanding and obeying Your Order, I have found peace; hearing, listening to YourName, I live.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa maan jaan sukh paa-i-aa sun sun naam t uhaaro jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ ਲਿਗ  ਏਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, O Lord, You, only You. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaaN oohaa har tum hee t um hee ih gur t ay mant ar darirh-ee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ  ਰੂਪ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਿਦਸਟਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Since I came to realize this, I have been blessed with total peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: jab tay jaan paa-ee ayh baat aa tab kusal kh aym sabh  thee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੋਰਚਾ  ਗੁ ਿਰ ਲਾਿਹਓ  ਤਹ ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਕਹ ਆਵੈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this has been revealed to Nanak, and now, there is no other for him at all. ||2||1||2|| nt mhlw 5 ] (978-17) nat mehlaa 5. Nat, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak pargaasi-o aan naahee ray bee-o. ||2||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever has You for support,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bha-ee t umaaree Dh eer.
jam kee taraas mitee sukh  paa-i-aa niksee ha-umai peer. ||1|| rahaa-o. has the fear of death removed; peace is found, and the disease of egotism is takenaway. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The fire within is quenched, and one is satisfied through the Ambrosial Word of theGuru's Bani, as the baby is satisfied by milk.
lines.transliteration: tapat bujhaanee amrit  baanee t ariptai ji-o baarik kh eer.

lines.english: The Saints are my mother, father and friends. The Saints are my help and support, and my brothers. ||1|| pMnw 979
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa saajan sant  mayray sant  sahaa-ee beer. ||1||

lines.english: The doors of doubt are thrown open, and I have met the Lord of the World; God's diamond has pierced the diamond of my mind.
lines.transliteration: khulay bh aram bh eet milay gopaalaa heerai bayDh ay heer.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਲੇ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੀਿਤ  ਿਮਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੇ ਹੀਰ ॥
lines.english: Nanak blossoms forth in ecstasy, singing the Lord's Praises; my Lord and Master is theocean of virtue. ||2||2||3|| nt mhlw 5 ] (979-2) nat mehlaa 5. Nat, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bisam bha-ay naanak jas gaavat  thaakur gunee gaheer. ||2||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਮ  ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਗੁਨੀ  ਗਹੀਰ  ॥੨॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself saves His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: apnaa jan aapeh aap uDhaari-o.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, He dwells with His humble servant; He never forgets himfrom His Mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar jan kai sang basi-o man t ay naahi bisaari-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord does not look at his color or form; He does not consider the ancestry of Hisslave.
lines.transliteration: baran chihan naahee kichh paykh i-o daas kaa kul na bichaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਿਸਓ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ਿਬਸਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Name, and embellishes him withintuitive ease. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naam har dee-o sahj subh aa-ay savaari-o. ||1||

lines.english: The ocean of fire is treacherous and difficult, but he is carried across.
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikham agan kaa saagar t is tay paar ut aari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਨੁਿਚਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਨ ਿਬਚਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing, seeing Him, Nanak blossoms forth, over and over again, a sacrifice to Him.||2||3||4|| nt mhlw 5 ] (979-6) nat mehlaa 5. Nat, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paykh paykh  naanak bigsaano punah punah balihaari-o. ||2||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਦੀਓ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਸਵਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within his mind
lines.transliteration: har har man meh naam kahi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਿਤਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kot apraaDh miteh kh in bheetar taa kaa d ukh na rahi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. - millions of sins are erased in an instant, and pain is relieved. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖ ਪੇਿਖ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਗਸਾਨੋ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰਓ  ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: Seeking and searching, I have become detached; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat bha-i-o bairaagee saaDh oo sang lahi-o.

lines.english: Renouncing everything, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord. I grab hold of the feetof the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag ayk liv laagee har har charan gahi-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਹਓ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever chants His Name is liberated; whoever listens to it is saved, as is anyonewho seeks His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: kahat mukat  suntay nist aaray jo jo saran pa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਅਪਰ੍ਾਧ  ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਰਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God the Lord and Master, says Nanak, Iam in ecstasy! ||2||4||5|| nt mhlw 5 ] (979-9) nat mehlaa 5. Nat, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar simar su-aamee parabh apunaa kaho naanak anad  bha-i-o. ||2||4||5||

lines.english: I am in love with Your Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sang laagee doree.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਭਇਓ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਿਹਓ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, ocean of peace, please bless me with the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar kar param gat  moree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਏਕ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਗਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has inspired His humble servant to grasp the hem of His robe; his mind is piercedthrough with the intoxication of divine love.
lines.transliteration: anchlaa gahaa-i-o jan apunay ka-o man beeDho paraym kee kh oree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਮੁਕਤ  ਸੁਨਤੇ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Singing His Praises, love wells up within the devotee, and the trap of Maya is broken. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jas gaavat bh agat ras upji-o maa-i-aa kee jaalee t oree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਓ  ॥੨॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; I do not seeany other at all.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahay kirpaa niDh aan na paykh a-o horee.

lines.english: He has united slave Nanak with Himself; His Love never diminishes. ||2||5||6|| nt mhlw 5 ] (979-12) nat mehlaa 5. Nat, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl lee-o daas apunaa pareet  na kabhoo thoree. ||2||5||6||

lines.english: O my mind, chant, and meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap jap har naaraa-in.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I shall never forget Him from my mind; twenty-four hours a day, I sing His GloriousPraises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kabhoo na bisrahu man mayray tay aath  pahar gun gaa-in . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I take my daily cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy, and I am rid of allmy sins.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo Dh oor kara-o nit  majan sabh  kilbikh  paap gavaa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਚਲਾ  ਗਹਾਇਓ  ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬੀਧੋ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; He is seen tobe contained in each and every heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahay kirpaa niDh gh at ghat disat samaa-in . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਸੁ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ  ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hundreds of thousands and millions of meditations, austerities and worships are not equal to remembering the Lord in meditation.
lines.transliteration: jaap taap kot lakh  poojaa har simran  tul na laa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ ਆਨ  ਨ ਪੇਖਉ  ਹੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing, that he may becomethe slave of the slaves of Your slaves. ||2||6||7|| nt mhlw 5 ] (979-16) nat mehlaa 5. Nat, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  naanak d aan maaNgai tayray d aasan d aas d asaa-in . ||2||6||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੀਓ  ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is everything for me.
lines.transliteration: mayrai sarbas naam niDhaan.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He has led me to join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly; the True Guru has granted this gift. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa saaDhoo sang mili-o sat gur deeno d aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord, the Giver of peace, the Destroyer of pain; Heshall bless you with perfect spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata dukh bhanjanhaaraa gaa-o keert an pooran gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੂਨ ਿਬਸਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and greed shall be shattered and destroyed, and your foolish egowill be dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  khand kh and keenHay binsi-o moorh  abhimaan. ||1||

lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant? O God, You are the Inner-knower, theSearcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa gun t ayray aakh  vakh aanaa parabh  antarjaamee jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਿਰ ਕਰਉ  ਿਨਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord, ocean of peace; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||7||8|| pMnw 980 nt mhlw 5 ] (980-1) nat mehlaa 5. Nat, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal saran sukh saagar naanak sad  kurbaan. ||2||7||8||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaar vaar jaa-o gur gopaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am unworthy; You are the Perfect Giver. You are the Merciful Master of the meek.||1||
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun tum pooran d aatay deenaa naath d a-i-aal. ||1||

lines.english: While standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, You are my soul, mybreath of life, my wealth and property. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at sovat  jaagat  jee-a paraan Dh an maal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਨਰਗੁਨ  ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ  ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within my mind there is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.Nanak is enraptured with Your Glance of Grace. ||3||8||9|| nt pVqwl mhlw 5  (980-4) nat parh-t aal mehlaa 5 Nat Partaal, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (980-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: darsan pi-aas bahut  man mayrai naanak d aras nihaal. ||3||8||9||

lines.punjabi: ਊਠਤ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਸੋਵਤ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Is there any friend or companion of mine,
lines.transliteration: ko-oo hai mayro saajan meet.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨ  ਿਪਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਸ  ਿਨਹਾਲ  ॥੩॥੮॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: har naam sunaavai neet. who will constantly share the Lord's Name with me?

lines.english: Will he rid me of my pains and evil tendencies?
lines.transliteration: binsai dukh  bipreet .

lines.english: I would surrender my mind, body, consciousness and everything. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh arpa-o man t an cheet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How rare is that one whom the Lord makes His own,
lines.transliteration: ko-ee virlaa aapan keet.
sang charan kamal man seet. and whose mind is sewn into the Lord's Lotus Feet.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Praise. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har jas deet . ||1||

lines.english: Vibrating, meditating on the Lord, he is victorious in this precious human life,
lines.transliteration: har bhaj janam pad aarath jeet .
kot patit  hohi puneet . and millions of sinners are sanctified.

lines.english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||10||19|| nt AstpdIAw mhlw 4  (980-9) nat asatpadee-aa mehlaa 4 Nat Ashtapadees, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (980-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas bal bal keet . ||2||1||10||19||

lines.english: O Lord, Your Name is the support of my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: raam mayray man tan naam aDh aaray.

lines.english: I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant, without serving You. Following the Guru's Teachings, I dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khin pal reh na saka-o bin sayvaa mai gurmat  naam samHaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Within my mind, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har. The Name of theLord, Har, Har, is so dear to me.
lines.transliteration: har har har har har man Dhi-aavahu mai har har naam pi-aaray.

lines.english: When God, my Lord and Master, became merciful to me the meek one, I was exaltedby the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal bh a-ay parabh  thaakur gur kai sabad  savaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Almighty Lord, Slayer of demons, Life of the World, my Lord and Master, inaccessibleand infinite:
lines.transliteration: maDhsood an jagjeevan maaDh o mayray th aakur agam apaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I offer this one prayer to the Guru, to bless me, that I may wash the feet of the Holy.||2||
lines.transliteration: ik bin-o bayntee kara-o gur aagai mai saaDh oo charan pakh aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The thousands of eyes are the eyes of God; the One God, the Primal Being, remains unattached.
lines.transliteration: sahas naytar nayt ar hai parabh  ka-o parabh  ayko purakh  niraaray.

lines.english: The One God, our Lord and Master, has thousands of forms; God alone, through theGuru's Teachings, saves us. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sahas moorat ayko parabh  thaakur parabh  ayko gurmat  taaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have been blessed with the Naam, the Name of theLord. I have enshrined within my heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam d amod ar paa-i-aa har har naam ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is so very sweet; like the mute, I taste itssweetness, but I cannot describe it at all. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa banee at meeth ee ji-o goongaa gatak samHaaray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਧਸੂਦਨ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਮਾਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The tongue savors the bland, insipid taste of the love of duality, greed and corruption.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa saad chakh ai bhaa-ay d oojai at  feekay lobh  bikaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਿਬਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਕਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ  ਪਖਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh tastes the flavor of the Lord's Name, and all other tastes and flavors areforgotten. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jo gurmukh saad  chakh eh raam naamaa sabh  an ras saad  bisaaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name;hearing it, and chanting it, sins are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: gurmat raam naam Dh an paa-i-aa sun  kehti-aa paap nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਏਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay jam nayrh  na aavai mayray th aakur kay jan pi-aaray. ||6|| The Messenger of Death and the Righteous Judge of Dharma do not even approachthe beloved servant of my Lord and Master. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: With as many breaths as I have, I chant the Naam, under Guru's Instructions.
lines.transliteration: saas saas saas hai jaytay mai gurmat  naam samHaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਬਨੀ ਅਿਤ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਿਜਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ  ਗਟਕ  ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Each and every breath which escapes me without the Naam - that breath is uselessand corrupt. ||7||
lines.transliteration: saas saas jaa-ay naamai bin so birthaa saas bikaaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਾਦ ਚਖੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਅਿਤ  ਫੀਕੇ ਲੋਭ ਿਬਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Please grant Your Grace; I am meek; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Unite me with Your beloved, humble servants. pMnw 981
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kar deen parabh  sarnee mo ka-o har jan mayl pi-aaray.

lines.english: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, says, I am the water-carrier of Your slaves. ||8||1|| nt mhlw 4 ] (981-1) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daasan d aas kahat  hai ham d aasan kay panihaaray. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ  ਹੈ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੇ ਪਿਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, I am an unworthy stone.
lines.transliteration: raam ham paathar nirgunee-aaray.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord, in His Mercy, has led me to meet the Guru; through the Word ofthe Guru's Shabad, this stone is carried across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kar guroo milaa-ay ham paahan sabad gur t aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The True Guru has implanted within me the exceedingly sweet Naam, the Name ofthe Lord; it is like the most fragrant sandalwood.
lines.transliteration: satgur naam drirh -aa-ay at  meeth aa mailaagar malgaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Name, my awareness extends in the ten directions; the fragrance of the fragrant Lord permeates the air. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naamai surat vajee hai d ah dis har muskee musak ganDh aaray. ||1||

lines.english: Your unlimited sermon is the most sweet sermon; I contemplate the most SublimeWord of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: tayree nirgun  kathaa kathaa hai meeth ee gur neekay bachan samaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਅਿਤ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਮੈਲਾਗਰੁ ਮਲਗਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Singing, singing, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; singing His Glorious Praises,the Guru saves me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gaavat gaavat  har gun gaa-ay gun gaavat  gur nist aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੈ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਵਜੀ ਹੈ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਮੁਸਕੀ  ਮੁਸਕ  ਗੰਧਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru is wise and clear; the Guru looks upon all alike. Meeting with Him, doubt and skepticism are removed.
lines.transliteration: bibayk guroo guroo samadrasee t is milee-ai sank ut aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਨੀਕੇ  ਬਚਨ  ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the supreme status. I am a sacrifice tothe True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai param pad  paa-i-aa ha-o sat gur kai balihaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਤ  ਗਾਵਤ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ਗੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Practicing hypocrisy and deception, people wander around in confusion. Greed andhypocrisy are evils in this world.
lines.transliteration: pakhand pakh and kar kar bh armay lobh  pakh and jag buri-aaray.

lines.english: In this world and the next, they are miserable; the Messenger of Death hovers overtheir heads, and strikes them down. ||4||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  dukh-daa-ee hoveh jamkaal kh arhaa sir maaray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: At the break of day, they take care of their affairs, and the poisonous entanglementsof Maya.
lines.transliteration: ugvai dinas aal jaal samHaalai bikh  maa-i-aa kay bisthaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਡ  ਪਾਖੰਡ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਭਰਮੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਜਿਗ  ਬੁਿਰਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: When night falls, they enter the land of dreams, and even in dreams, they take care of their corruptions and pains. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aa-ee rain bha-i-aa supnant ar bikh  supnai bh ee dukh saaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਦੁਖਦਾਈ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਖੜਾ ਿਸਿਰ  ਮਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Taking a barren field, they plant falsehood; they shall harvest only falsehood.
lines.transliteration: kalar khayt  lai koorh  jamaa-i-aa sabh  koorhai kay kh alvaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਉਗਵੈ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਆਲੁ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਸਮਾਲੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਿਬਸਥਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The materialistic people shall all remain hungry; the brutal Messenger of Death stands waiting at their door. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saakat nar sabh  bhookh bhukhaanay d ar thaadhay jam jand aaray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਆਈ  ਰੈਿਨ ਭਇਆ  ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਿਬਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਭੀ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh has accumulated a tremendous load of debt in sin; only bycontemplating the Word of the Shabad, can this debt be paid off.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karaj charh i-aa bikh  bhaaree ut rai sabad  veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਰੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ  ਸਭ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੇ ਖਲਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: As much debt and as many creditors as there are, the Lord makes them into servants,who fall at his feet. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jitnay karaj karaj kay mangee-ay kar sayvak pag lag vaaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰ ਸਿਭ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੇ  ਦਿਰ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: All the beings which the Lord of the Universe created - He puts the rings through theirnoses, and leads them all along.
lines.transliteration: jagannaath sabh jant ar upaa-ay nak kh eenee sabh  nathhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਰਜੁ  ਚਿੜਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ  ਉਤਰੈ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as God drives us on, so do we follow; it is all the Will of the Beloved Lord.||8||2|| nt mhlw 4 ] (981-12) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh kh inchai t iv chalee-ai ji-o bh aavai raam pi-aaray. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਕਰਜ  ਕਰਜ  ਕੇ ਮੰਗੀਏ  ਕਿਰ ਸੇਵਕ  ਪਿਗ  ਲਿਗ  ਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: raam har amrit sar naavaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ  ਸਿਭ ਜੰਤਰ੍ ਉਪਾਏ  ਨਿਕ ਖੀਨੀ  ਸਭ ਨਥਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is the most excellent cleansing bath; bathing in it, all the filthy sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur gi-aan majan hai neeko mil kalmal paap ut aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The virtues of the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, are so very great. Even theprostitute was saved, by teaching the parrot to speak the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sangat kaa gun bahut  aDhikaa-ee parh  soo-aa ganak uDh aaray.

lines.english: Krishna was pleased, and so he touched the hunch-back Kubija, and she wastransported to the heavens. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paras napras bha-ay kubijaa ka-o lai baikunth  siDhaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Ajaamal loved his son Naaraayan, and called out his name.
lines.transliteration: ajaamal pareet put ar parat  keenee kar naaraa-in  bolaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਪਾਪ ਉਤਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: His loving devotion pleased my Lord and Master, who struck down and drove off theMessengers of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur kai man bh aa-ay bh aavnee jamkankar maar bid aaray. ||2||

lines.english: The mortal speaks and by speaking, makes the people listen; but he does not reflectupon what he himself says.
lines.transliteration: maanukh kathai kath lok sunaavai jo bolai so na beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ਪਿੜ ਸੂਆ  ਗਨਕ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: But when he joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, he is confirmed in his faith,and he is saved by the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  milai t a dirh-taa aavai har raam naam nist aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਸ  ਨਪਰਸ  ਭਏ ਕੁਿਬਜਾ  ਕਉ ਲੈ ਬੈਕੁੰਿਠ  ਿਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As long as his soul and body are healthy and strong, he does not remember the Lord at all.
lines.transliteration: jab lag jee-o pind hai saabat t ab lag kichh  na samaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਾਮਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਪਰ੍ਿਤ ਕੀਨੀ  ਕਿਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ਬੋਲਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: But when his home and mansion catch fire, then, he wants to dig the well to drawwater. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jab ghar mand ar aag lagaanee kadh  koop kadh ai panihaaray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇ  ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O mind, do not join with the faithless cynic, who has forgotten the Name of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: saakat si-o man mayl na karee-ahu jin har har naam bisaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਿਥ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The word of the faithless cynic stings like a scorpion; leave the faithless cynic far, far behind. ||5|| pMnw 982
lines.transliteration: saakat bachan bichh oo-aa ji-o dasee-ai t aj saakat  parai paraaray. ||5||

lines.english: Fall in love, fall deeply in love with the Lord; clinging to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you will be exalted and embellished.
lines.transliteration: lag lag pareet baho pareet  lagaa-ee lag saaDh oo sang savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਲਿਗ  ਲਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਈ  ਲਿਗ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who accept the Word of the Guru as True, totally True, are very dear to myLord and Master. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur kay bachan sat sat  kar maanay mayray th aakur bahut  pi-aaray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ  ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Because of actions committed in past lives, one comes to love the Name of the Lord,Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: poorab janam parchoon kamaa-ay har har har naam pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਪਰਚੂਨ  ਕਮਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the ambrosial essence; sing of this essence, and reflect upon this essence. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad amrit  ras paa-i-aa ras gaavai ras veechaaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰਸੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, all forms and colors are Yours; O my Beloved, my deep crimsonruby.
lines.transliteration: har har roop rang sabh t ayray mayray laalan laal gulaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਲ  ਗੁਲਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Only that color which You impart, Lord, exists; O Nanak, what can the poor wretchedbeing do? ||8||3|| nt mhlw 4 ] (982-4) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaisaa rang deh so hovai ki-aa naanak jant  vichaaray. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਕਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰੇ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord God saves and protects us,
lines.transliteration: raam gur saran parabhoo rakh vaaray.

ji-o kunchar tad oo-ai pakar chalaa-i-o kar oopar kadh  nistaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o. as He protected the elephant, when the crocodile seized it and pulled it into thewater; He lifted him up and pulled him out. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁ ਰ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: God's servants are sublime and exalted; they enshrine faith for Him in their minds.
lines.transliteration: parabh kay sayvak bahut  at neekay man sarDh aa kar har Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ  ਪਕਿਰ  ਚਲਾਇਓ  ਕਿਰ ਊਪਰੁ ਕਿਢ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Faith and devotion are pleasing to my God's Mind; He saves the honor of His humbleservants. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayray parabh sarDh aa bh agat man bh aavai jan kee paij savaaray. ||1||

lines.english: The servant of the Lord, Har, Har, is committed to His service; He sees God pervading the entire expanse of the universe.
lines.transliteration: har har sayvak sayvaa laagai sabh d aykhai barahm pasaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਿਤ  ਨੀਕੇ  ਮਿਨ ਸਰਧਾ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He sees the One and only Primal Lord God, who blesses all with His Glance of Grace.||2||
lines.transliteration: ayk purakh ik nad ree aavai sabh  aykaa nad ar nihaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸਰਧਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God, our Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading all places; He takes care ofthe whole world as His slave.
lines.transliteration: har parabh th aakur ravi-aa sabh  thaa-ee sabh  chayree jagat  samaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord Himself mercifully gives His gifts, even to worms in stones. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aal d a-i-aa d aan d ayvai vich paathar keeray kaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Within the deer is the heavy fragrance of musk, but he is confused and deluded, andhe shakes his horns looking for it.
lines.transliteration: antar vaas bahut  muskaa-ee bh aram bh oolaa mirag siny haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਭ ਠਾਈ  ਸਭੁ ਚੇਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering, rambling and roaming through the forests and woods, I exhausted myself,and then in my own home, the Perfect Guru saved me. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ban ban dhoodh  dhoodh fir thaakee gur poorai gh ar nist aaray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਾਥਰ  ਕੀਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Word, the Bani is Guru, and Guru is the Bani. Within the Bani, the AmbrosialNectar is contained.
lines.transliteration: banee guroo guroo hai ban ee vich ban ee amrit  saaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੁਸਕਾਈ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੂਲਾ ਿਮਰਗੁ  ਿਸੰਙਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: If His humble servant believes, and acts according to the Words of the Guru's Bani,then the Guru, in person, emancipates him. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur banee kahai sayvak jan maanai part akh guroo nist aaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਢੂਿਢ  ਢੂਿਢ  ਿਫਿਰ ਥਾਕੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਘਿਰ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: All is God, and God is the whole expanse; man eats what he has planted.
lines.transliteration: sabh hai barahm barahm hai pasri-aa man beeji-aa kh aavaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: When Dhrishtabudhi tormented the humble devotee Chandrahaans, he only set his own house on fire. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jan chandar-haaNs dukhi-aa Dh aristbuDh ee apunaa gh ar lookee jaaray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਕਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਰਤਿਖ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: God's humble servant longs for Him within his heart; God watches over each breath ofHis humble servant.
lines.transliteration: parabh ka-o jan ant ar rid lochai parabh  jan kay saas nihaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਹੈ ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਮਿਨ ਬੀਿਜਆ  ਖਾਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Mercifully, mercifully, He implants devotio n within his humble servant; for his sake, God saves the whole world. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kar bhagat  drirh -aa-ay jan peechh ai jag nist aaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਜਨ ਚੰਦਰ੍ਹਸੁ  ਦੁਿਖਆ  ਿਧਰ੍ਸਟਬੁਧੀ  ਅਪੁਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਲੂਕੀ  ਜਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: God, our Lord and Master, is Himself by Himself; God Himself embellishes theuniverse.
lines.transliteration: aapan aap aap parabh th aakur parabh  aapay sarisat savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਰਦ ਲੋਚੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਿਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, He Himself is all-pervading; in His Mercy, He Himself emancipatesall. ||8||4|| nt mhlw 4 ] (982-15) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aapay aap sabh vart ai kar kirpaa aap nist aaray. ||8||4||

lines.english: Grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me,
lines.transliteration: raam kar kirpaa layho ubaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: ji-o pakar daropat ee dustaaN aanee har har laaj nivaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o. as You saved Dropadi from shame when she was seized and brought before the court by the evil villians. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.english: Bless me with Your Grace - I am just a humble beggar of Yours; I beg for a singleblessing, O my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jaachik jan tayray ik maaga-o d aan pi-aaray.

lines.english: I long constantly for the True Guru. Lead me to meet the Guru, O Lord, that I may beexalted and embellished. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur kee nit  sarDh aa laagee mo ka-o har gur mayl savaaray. ||1||

lines.english: The actions of the faithless cynic are like the churning of water; he churns, constantlychurning only water.
lines.transliteration: saakat karam paan ee ji-o mathee-ai nit  paan ee jhol jhulaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਪਕਿਰ  ਦਰ੍ੋਪਤੀ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਆਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਜ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the supreme status is obtained; thebutter is produced, and eaten with delight. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  param pad  paa-i-aa kadh  maakh an kay gatkaaray. ||2||

lines.english: He may constantly and continually wash his body; he may constantly rub, clean and polish his body. pMnw 983
lines.transliteration: nit nit  kaa-i-aa majan kee-aa nit  mal mal d ayh savaaray.

lines.english: But if the Word of my True Guru is not pleasing to his mind, then all his preparations and beautiful decorations are useless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mayray satgur kay man bachan na bh aa-ay sabh  fokat chaar seegaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਮਿਨ ਬਚਨ  ਨ ਭਾਏ ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ  ਚਾਰ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Walk playfully and carefree, O my friends and companions; cherish the Glorious Virtues of my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: matak matak chal sakhee sahaylee mayray th aakur kay gun saaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਟਿਕ  ਮਟਿਕ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: To serve, as Gurmukh, is pleasing to my God. Through the True Guru, the unknown isknown. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa mayray parabh  bhaa-ee mai sat gur alakh  lakhaaray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਈ  ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Women and men, all the men and women, all came from the One Primal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: naaree purakh purakh  sabh  naaree sabh  ayko purakh  muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਰੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ  ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the humble; the Lord emancipates those whomeet with the Lord's humble servants. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee rayn man bh aa-ee mil har jan har nist aaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਿਮਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: From village to village, throughout all the cities I wandered; and then, inspired by theLord's humble servants, I found Him deep within the nucleus of my heart.
lines.transliteration: garaam garaam nagar sabh firi-aa rid  antar har jan bh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰ੍ਾਮ  ਗਰ੍ਾਮ  ਨਗਰ  ਸਭ ਿਫਿਰਆ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Faith and longing have welled up within me, and I have been blended with the Lord;the Guru, the Guru, has saved me. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sarDhaa sarDh aa upaa-ay milaa-ay mo ka-o har gur gur nist aaray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਧਾ ਸਰਧਾ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The thread of my breath has been made totally sublime and pure; I contemplate theShabad, the Word of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: pavan soot sabh  neekaa kari-aa sat gur sabad  veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਨ  ਸੂਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨੀਕਾ  ਕਿਰਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I came back to the home of my own inner self; drinking in the ambrosial essence, Isee the world, without my eyes. ||7||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar jaa-ay amrit  ras pee-aa bin nainaa jagat  nihaaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨੈਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord; You are the temple, and I am just a tiny worm.
lines.transliteration: ta-o gun ees baran nahee saaka-o t um mand ar ham nik keeray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਗੁਨ ਈਸ ਬਰਿਨ  ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕਉ  ਤੁਮ ਮੰਦਰ  ਹਮ ਿਨਕ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Bless Nanak with Your Mercy, and unite him with the Guru; meditating on my Lord,my mind is comforted and consoled. ||8||5|| nt mhlw 4 ] (983-8) nat mehlaa 4. Nat, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa karahu gur maylhu mai raam japat man Dh eeray. ||8||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੮॥੫॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: mayray man bhaj th aakur agam apaaray.

lines.english: I am such a great sinner; I am so unworthy. And yet the Guru, in His Mercy, hassaved me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham paapee baho nirgunee-aaray kar kirpaa gur nist aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the Holy Person, the Holy and humble servant of the Lord; I offer aprayer to Him, my Beloved Guru.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo purakh  saaDh  jan paa-ay ik bin-o kara-o gur pi-aaray.

lines.english: Please, bless me with the wealth, the capital of the Lord's Name, and take away allmy hunger and thirst. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan poojee d ayvhu sabh  tisnaa bh ookh nivaaray. ||1||

lines.english: The moth, the deer, the bumble bee, the elephant and the fish are ruined, each bythe one passion that controls them.
lines.transliteration: pachai patang marig bh aring kunchar meen ik ind ree pakar sagh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰਉ  ਗੁਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The five powerful demons are in the body; the Guru, the True Guru turns out these sins. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch bhoot  sabal hai d ayhee gur sat gur paap nivaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਭੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I searched and searched through the Shaastras and the Vedas; Naarad the silent sageproclaimed these words as well.
lines.transliteration: saastar bayd  soDh  soDh  daykhay mun naarad  bachan pukaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਚੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ  ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਿਭਰ੍ੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ  ਮੀਨ ਇਕ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਪਕਿਰ  ਸਘਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, salvation is attained; the Guru saves those in the SatSangat, the True Congregation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam parhahu gat  paavhu sat sangat  gur nist aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਬਲ  ਹੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਪ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In love with the Beloved Lord God, one looks at Him as the lotus looks at the sun.
lines.transliteration: pareetam pareet  lagee parabh  kayree jiv sooraj kamal nihaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਬੇਦ ਸੋਿਧ ਸੋਿਧ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੁਿਨ ਨਾਰਦ  ਬਚਨ  ਪੁਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The peacock dances on the mountain, when the clouds hang low and heavy. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mayr sumayr mor baho naachai jab unvai ghan gh anhaaray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The faithless cyinc may be totally drenched with ambrosial nectar, but even so, all hisbranches and flowers are filled with venom.
lines.transliteration: saakat ka-o amrit  baho sinchahu sabh  daal fool bisukaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਿਜਵ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਕਮਲੁ ਿਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The more one bows down in humility before the faithless cyinc, the more he provokes,and stabs, and spits out his poison. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o niveh saakat nar sayt ee chh ayrh chhayrh kadh ai bikh  khaaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰ ਸੁਮੇਰ  ਮੋਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਚੈ  ਜਬ ਉਨਵੈ  ਘਨ ਘਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Remain with the Holy man, the Saint of the Saints, who chants the Lord's Praises forthe benefit of all.
lines.transliteration: santan sant  saaDh  mil rahee-ai gun  boleh par-upkaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਕਉ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਹੁ ਿਸੰਚਹੁ ਸਭ ਡਾਲ  ਫੂਲ ਿਬਸੁਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Saint of Saints, the mind blossoms forth, like the lotus, exalted by obtaining the water. ||6||
lines.transliteration: santai sant  milai man bigsai ji-o jal mil kamal savaaray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਜਉ  ਿਨਵਿਹ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਛੇਿੜ ਛੇਿੜ ਕਢੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The waves of greed are like mad dogs with rabies. Their madness ruins everything.
lines.transliteration: lobh lahar sabh  su-aan halak hai halki-o sabh eh bigaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: When the news reached the Court of my Lord and Master, the Guru took up the sword of spiritual wisdom, and killed them. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur kai d eebaan kh abar ho-ee gur gi-aan kh arhag lai maaray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਮਲ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Save me, save me, save me, O my God; shower me with Your Mercy, and save me!
lines.transliteration: raakh raakh  raakh  parabh  mayray mai raakh o kirpaa Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਹਲਕੁ  ਹੈ ਹਲਿਕਓ  ਸਭਿਹ  ਿਬਗਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I have no other support; the Guru, the True Guru, has saved me. ||8||6|| Ckw 1 ] (983-19) chhakaa 1. First Set of Six Hymns|| pMnw 984 rwgu mwlI gauVw mhlw 4 (984-1) raag maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 4 Raag Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (984-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: naanak mai Dhar avar na kaa-ee mai sat gur gur nist aaray. ||8||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਲੀ  ਗਉੜਾ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Countless have tried, but none have found the Lord's limit.
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar rahay har ant  naahee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable; I humbly bow to the Lord God, my King. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har agam agam agaaDh boDh  aadays har parabh  raa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਿਧ ਆਦੇਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment bring continual conflict andstrife.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh nit  jhagratay jhagraa-i-aa.

lines.english: Save me, save me, I am your humble creature, O Lord; I have come to YourSanctuary, O my Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham raakh raakh  deen tayray har saran har parabh  aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਝਗਰਤੇ  ਝਗਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You protect and preserve those who take to Your Sanctuary, God; You are called theLover of Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: sarnaagat ee parabh  paalt ay har bh agat vachh al naa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਦੀਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Prahlaad, Your humble servant, was caught by Harnaakhash; but You saved Him andcarried him across, Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: par-hilaad jan harnaakh  pakri-aa har raakh  lee-o t araa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਲਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Remember the Lord, O mind, and rise up to the Mansion of His Presence; theSovereign Lord is the Destroyer of pain.
lines.transliteration: har chayt ray man mahal paavan  sabh  dookh bhanjan raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਨਾਿਖ  ਪਕਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਓ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master takes away the fear of birth and death; following the Guru'sTeachings, the Lord God is found. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bha-o janam maran nivaar th aakur har gurmat ee parabh  paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤ  ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਵਣ  ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, our Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners; I sing of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fears of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: har patit  paavan naam su-aamee bh a-o bh agat bhanjan gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who wears the necklace of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his heart, Oservant Nanak, merges in the Naam. ||4||1|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 4 ] (984-10) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 4. Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har haar har ur Dhaari-o jan naanak naam samaa-i-aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਿਤਤ ਪਾਵਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭਉ ਭਗਤ  ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam sukh-d aata.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: One who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and enjoys the sublime taste ofthe Lord, as Gurmukh, comes to realize God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  mil har saad  aa-i-aa gurmukh  barahm pachh aataa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; meetingwith the Guru, the Lord God is known.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur d arsan paa-i-aa gur mili-ai har parabh  jaataa.

lines.english: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, bathing in the Lord's ambrosialpool of nectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: durmat  mail ga-ee sabh  neekar har amrit  har sar naat aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an saaDh  jinHee har parabh  paa-i-aa t inH poochh a-o har kee baat aa. Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who have found their Lord God; I ask them to tell methe stories of the Lord.
I fall at their feet, and always pray to them, to mercifully unite me with my Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paa-ay laga-o nit kara-o jud ree-aa har maylhu karam biDh aataa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the destiny written on my forehead, I have found the Holy Guru; my mind and body are imbued with the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: lilaat likhay paa-i-aa gur saaDh oo gur bachnee man t an raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸਿਰ ਨਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord God has come to meet me; I have found peace, and I am rid of all the sins.||3||
lines.transliteration: har parabh aa-ay milay sukh  paa-i-aa sabh  kilvikh  paap gavaat aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਿਜਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਪੂਛਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find the Lord, the source of nectar; theirwords are sublime and exalted.
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in jinH gurmat  paa-i-aa t inH kee oot am baat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇ  ਲਗਉ  ਿਨਤ ਕਰਉ  ਜੁਦਰੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, one is blessed with the dust of their feet; servant Nanak fallsat their feet. ||4||2|| pMnw 985 mwlI gauVw mhlw 4 ] (985-1) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 4. Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin kee pank paa-ee-ai vadbh aagee jan naanak charan paraat aa. ||4||2||

lines.english: All the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages, with their minds full of love, meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh siDh  saaDh ik mun janaa man bh aavnee har Dh i-aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, my Lord and Master, is limitless; the Guru has inspired me to know the unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aprampro paarbarahm su-aamee har alakh guroo lakh aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਅਲਖੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਲਖਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am low, and I commit evil actions; I have not remembered my Sovereign Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham neech maDhim karam kee-ay nahee chayt i-o har raa-i-o.

lines.english: The Lord has led me to meet the True Guru; in an instant, He liberated me frombondage. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har aan mayli-o satguroo kh in banDh  mukat  karaa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮਿਧਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the destiny God wrote on my forehead; following the Guru's Teachings, Ienshrine love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parabh mast akay Dh ur leekh i-aa gurmat ee har liv laa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਨ  ਮੇਿਲਓ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਖਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resound in the Court of theLord; meeting the Lord, I sing the songs of joy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch sabad d argeh baaji-aa har mili-o mangal gaa-i-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਮਸਤਕੇ  ਧੁਿਰ ਲੀਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; the unfortunate wretchesdo not like this.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan naam narhar mand -bhaagee-aaN nahee bh aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਬਾਿਜਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They rot away in the womb of reincarnation; they fall apart like salt in water. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tay garabh  jonee gaalee-ah ji-o lon jaleh galaa-i-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਿਰ  ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀਆਂ  ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with such understanding, O Inaccessible Lord God, my Lord andMaster, that my mind may remain attached to the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: mat d eh har parabh  agam th aakur gur charan man mai laa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਨੀ ਗਾਲੀਅਿਹ  ਿਜਉ  ਲੋਨੁ ਜਲਿਹ  ਗਲਾਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak remains attached to the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Naam.||4||3|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 4 ] (985-7) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 4. Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har raam naamai raha-o laago jan naanak naam samaa-i-o. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਦੇਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਗਮ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ  ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਲਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is addicted to the juice of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man raam naam ras laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹਉ  ਲਾਗੋ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਇਓ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: My heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and I have found the Guru. Meditating on theLord, my doubts and fears have run away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kamal pargaas bha-i-aa gur paa-i-aa har japi-o bh aram bh a-o bh aagaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Fear of God, my heart is committed in loving devotion to Him; following theGuru's Teachings, my sleeping mind has awakened.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aa-ay bh agat laago mayraa hee-araa man so-i-o gurmat  jaagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਿਸ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: All my sins have been erased, and I have found peace and tranquility; I haveenshrined the Lord within my heart, by great good fortune. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh kh een bh a-ay saaNt aa-ee har ur Dh aari-o vadbh aagaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਲ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ॥੧॥
