lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is like the false color of the safflower, which fades away; itscolor lasts for only a few days.
lines.transliteration: manmukh rang kasumbh  hai kachoo-aa ji-o kusam chaar d in chaagaa.

lines.english: He perishes in an instant; he is tormented, and punished by the Righteous Judge ofDharma. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khin meh binas jaa-ay part aapai dand Dh aram raa-ay kaa laagaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਲਾਗੋ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹੀਅਰਾ  ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Love, found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is absolutely permanent, and colorfast.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  pareet  saaDh  at goorh ee ji-o rang majeeth  baho laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਵਡਭਾਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The cloth of the body may be torn to shreds, but still, this beautiful color of the Lord'sLove does not fade away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kaapar cheer baho faaray har rang na lahai sabhaagaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਕਚੂਆ  ਿਜਉ  ਕੁਸਮ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਿਦਨ ਚਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Blessed Guru, one is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, imbuedwith this deep crimson color.
lines.transliteration: har chaarHi-o rang milai gur sobhaa har rang chaloolai raaNgaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਪਰਤਾਪੈ  ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble being, who is attached to the feet ofthe Lord. ||4||4|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 4 ] (985-13) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 4. Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin kay charan pakh aarai jo har charnee jan laagaa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਅਿਤ  ਗੂੜੀ  ਿਜਉ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ  ਬਹੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate, vibrate upon the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man bhaj har har naam gupaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਾਪਰੁ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਾਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਸਭਾਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: 4) mayraa man tan leen bh a-i-aa raam naamai mat  gurmat  raam rasaalaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. My mind and body are merged in the Lord's Name, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect is imbued with the Lord, the source of nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਾਿਰਓ  ਰੰਗੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੈ  ਰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har,Har. Chant, and meditate, on the beads of the mala of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai har har man japee-ai har japmaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਪਖਾਰੈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads, meet with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jinH kai mastak leekh i-aa har mili-aa har banmaalaa. ||1||

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord - all their entanglements are ended.
lines.transliteration: jinH har naam Dhi-aa-i-aa t inH chookay sarab janjaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Guru, the Savior Lord,saves them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tinH jam nayrh  na aavee gur raakh ay har rakh vaalaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a child; I know nothing at all. The Lord cherishes me, as my mother and father.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik kichhoo na jaan hoo har maat  pitaa part ipaalaa.

lines.english: I continually put my hands into the fire of Maya, but the Guru saves me; He ismerciful to the meek. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar maa-i-aa agan nit maylt ay gur raakh ay deen d a-i-aalaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਜਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪਮਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I was filthy, but I have become immaculate. Singing the Lord's Praises, all sins havebeen burnt to ashes.
lines.transliteration: baho mailay nirmal ho-i-aa sabh kilbikh  har jas jaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੀਿਖਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਹਿਰ ਬਨਮਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind is in esctasy, having found the Guru; servant Nanak is enraptured throughthe Word of the Shabad. ||4||5|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 4 ] (985-19) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 4. Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl: pMnw 986
lines.transliteration: man anad bh a-i-aa gur paa-i-aa jan naanak sabad  nihaalaa. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਭ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਕਾਟ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate, vibrate on the Lord, and all sins will be eradicated.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har bhaj sabh  kilbikh  kaat.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ  ਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has enshried the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; I place my head on the Guru's Path. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har ur Dhaari-o gur poorai mayraa sees keejai gur vaat. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whoever tells me the stories of my Lord God, I would cut my mind into slices, anddedicate it to him.
lines.transliteration: mayray har parabh kee mai baat  sunaavai t is man d ayva-o kat kaat.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ  ਕਿਟ ਕਾਟ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, my Friend; I have sold myself at eachand every store for the Guru's Word. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har saajan mayli-o gur poorai gur bachan bikaano hat haat. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਿਲਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਿਬਕਾਨੋ  ਹਿਟ ਹਾਟ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One may give donations in charity at Prayaag, and cut the body in two at Benares,
lines.transliteration: makar paraag daan baho kee-aa sareer d ee-o aDh  kaat.

lines.punjabi: ਮਕਰ  ਪਰ੍ਾਿਗ  ਦਾਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਦੀਓ  ਅਧ ਕਾਿਟ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har naam ko mukat na paavai baho kanchan d eejai kat kaat. ||2|| but without the Lord's Name, no one attains liberation, even though one may giveaway huge amounts of gold. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਕਿਟ ਕਾਟ ॥੨॥
lines.english: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, and sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, thedoors of the mind, held shut by deception, are thrown open again.
lines.transliteration: har keerat gurmat  jas gaa-i-o man ugh ray kapat kapaat.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ  ਮਿਨ ਉਘਰੇ  ਕਪਟ ਕਪਾਟ  ॥
lines.english: The three qualities are shattered, doubt and fear run away, and the clay pot of publicopinion is broken. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tarikutee for bh aram bh a-o bh aagaa laj bh aanee matukee maat. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਕੁਟੀ  ਫੋਿਰ ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ਲਜ ਭਾਨੀ  ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They alone find the Perfect Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed.
lines.transliteration: kaljug gur pooraa tin paa-i-aa jin Dh ur mast ak likh ay lilaat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਜੁਿਗ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਤਨ  ਪਾਇਆ ਿਜਨ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਖੇ ਿਲਲਾਟ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; all his hunger and thirst are quenched.||4||6|| Ckw 1 ] (986-6) chhakaa 1. Set of Six Hymns 1|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 (986-7) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5 Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (986-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ras amrit pee-aa sabh  laathee bh ookh tikhaat. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆ  ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ  ਭੂਖ ਿਤਖਾਟ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: O mind, true peace comes from serving the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ray man tahal har sukh saar.

lines.english: Other services are false, and as punishment for them, the Messenger of Death bashesin one's head. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar tahlaa jhooth ee-aa nit  karai jam sir maar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They alone join the Sangat, the Congregation, upon whose forehead such destiny isinscribed.
lines.transliteration: jinaa mastak leekh i-aa tay milay sangaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਟਹਲ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: They are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Saints of the Infinite, PrimalLord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sansaar bha-ojal t aari-aa har sant  purakh  apaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰ  ਟਹਲਾ  ਝੂਠੀਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਕਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serve forever at the feet of the Holy; renounce greed, emotional attachment and corruption.
lines.transliteration: nit charan sayvhu saaDh  kay t aj lobh  moh bikaar.

lines.english: Abandon all other hopes, and rest your hopes in the One Formless Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ajahu d oojee aasrh ee rakh  aas ik nirankaar. ||2||

lines.english: Some are faithless cynics, deluded by doubt; without the Guru, there is only pitchdarkness.
lines.transliteration: ik bharam bh oolay saakt aa bin gur anDh  anDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਾਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhur hovnaa so ho-i-aa ko na maytan haar. ||3|| Whatever is pre-ordained, comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਚਰਨ  ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਤਿਜ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The beauty of the Lord of the Universe is profound and unfathomable; the Names ofthe Infinite Lord are immunerable.
lines.transliteration: agam roop gobind kaa anik naam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤਜਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ  ਆਸੜੀ  ਰਖੁ ਆਸ  ਇਕ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an tay jan naankaa jin har naamaa ur Dh aar. ||4||1|| Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, O Nanak, who enshrine the Lord's Name intheir hearts. ||4||1|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 ] (986-13) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5. Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੂਲੇ ਸਾਕਤਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I humbly bow to the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ka-o namaskaar.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਹੋਵਨਾ  ਸੁ ਹੋਇਆ  ਕੋ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Chanting it, one is saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat hovat  uDhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਰੂਪੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕਾ ਅਿਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him in remembrance, conflicts are ended.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran miteh DhanDh .

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating on Him, one's bonds are untied.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran chhooteh banDh .

lines.english: Meditating on Him, the fool becomes wise.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran moorakh chat ur.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one's ancestors are saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran kulah uDhar. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating on Him, fear and pain are taken away.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran bha-o d ukh harai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, misfortune is avoided.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran apdaa tarai.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran muchat paap.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, agony is ended. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran nahee santaap. ||2||

lines.english: Meditating on Him, the heart blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran rid bigaas.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, Maya becomes one's slave.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran kavlaa daas.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one is blessed with the treasures of wealth.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran niDh niDh aan.

lines.english: Meditating on Him, one crosses over in the end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran taray nid aan. ||3||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan naam haree.

lines.english: It saves millions of devotees.
lines.transliteration: kot bhagat  uDhaar karee.

lines.english: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: har daas d aasaa d een saran.

lines.english: Nanak lays his forehead on the feet of the Saints. ||4||2|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 ] (986-18) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5. Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak maathaa sant charan. ||4||2||

lines.english: This is the sort of helper the Name of the Lord is.
lines.transliteration: aiso sahaa-ee har ko naam.

lines.english: Meditating in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one's affairs are perfectlyresolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  bhaj pooran kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: It is like a boat to a drowning man. pMnw 987
lines.transliteration: boodat ka-o jaisay bayrh ee milat .

lines.english: It is like oil to the lamp whose flame is dying out.
lines.transliteration: boojhat  deepak milat  tilat.

lines.english: It is like water poured on the burning fire.
lines.transliteration: jalat agnee milat  neer.

lines.english: It is like milk poured into the baby's mouth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaisay baarik mukheh kh eer. ||1||

lines.english: As one's brother becomes a helper on the field of battle;
lines.transliteration: jaisay ran meh sakh aa bh araat.
jaisay bhookh ay bh ojan maat . as one's hunger is satisfied by food;
jaisay kirkhahi baras maygh . as the cloudburst saves the crops;
jaisay paalan saran sayNgh. ||2|| as one is protected in the tiger's lair;||2||

lines.english: As with the magic spell of Garuda the eagle upon one's lips, one does not fear the snake;
lines.transliteration: garurh mukh  nahee sarap t araas.
soo-aa pinjar nahee khaa-ay bilaas. as the cat cannot eat the parrot in its cage;
jaiso aaNdo hirday maahi. as the bird cherishes her eggs in her heart;
jaiso daano chakee d araahi. ||3|| as the grains are spared, by sticking to the central post of the mill;||3||

lines.english: Your Glory is so great; I can describe only a tiny bit of it.
lines.transliteration: bahut opmaa thor kahee.

lines.english: O Lord, You are inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: har agam agam agaaDh t uhee.

lines.english: You are lofty and high, utterly great and infinite.
lines.transliteration: ooch moochou baho apaar.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak, one is carried across. ||4||3|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 ] (987-5) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5. Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simrat naanak t aray saar. ||4||3||

lines.english: Please let my works be rewarding and fruitful.
lines.transliteration: ihee hamaarai safal kaaj.

lines.english: Please cherish and exalt Your slave. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: apunay daas ka-o layho nivaaj. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I lay my forehead on the feet of the Saints,
lines.transliteration: charan santeh maath mor.
nain daras paykh a-o nis bh or. and with my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, day and night.

lines.english: With my hands, I work for the Saints.
lines.transliteration: hasat hamray sant  tahal.

lines.english: I dedicate my breath of life, my mind and wealth to the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paraan man Dhan sant  bahal. ||1||

lines.english: My mind loves the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: satsang mayray man kee pareet .

lines.english: The Virtues of the Saints abide within my consciousness.
lines.transliteration: sant gun baseh mayrai cheet .

lines.english: The Will of the Saints is sweet to my mind.
lines.transliteration: sant aagi-aa maneh meeth .

lines.english: Seeing the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayraa kamal bigsai sant deeth . ||2||

lines.english: I dwell in the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: satsang mayraa ho-ay nivaas.

lines.english: I have such a great thirst for the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santan kee mohi bahut  pi-aas.

lines.english: The Words of the Saints are the Mantras of my mind.
lines.transliteration: sant bachan mayray maneh mant .

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, my corruption is taken away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  mayray bikh ai hant . ||3||

lines.english: This way of liberation is my treasure.
lines.transliteration: mukat jugat  ayhaa niDh aan.

lines.english: O Merciful God, please bless me with this gift.
lines.transliteration: parabh d a-i-aal mohi d ayvhu d aan.

lines.english: O God, shower Your Mercy upon Nanak.
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh d a-i-aa Dh aar.

lines.english: I have enshrined the feet of the Saints within my heart. ||4||4|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 ] (987-11) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5. Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan santan kay mayray rid ay majh aar. ||4||4||

lines.english: He is with all; He is not far away.
lines.transliteration: sabh kai sangee naahee d oor.

lines.english: He is the Cause of causes, ever-present here and now. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan haajraa hajoor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Hearing His Name, one comes to life.
lines.transliteration: sunat jee-o jaas naam.

lines.english: Pain is dispelled; peace and tranquility come to dwell within.
lines.transliteration: dukh binsay sukh  kee-o bisraam.

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is all treasure.
lines.transliteration: sagal niDh har har haray.

lines.english: The silent sages serve Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mun jan taa kee sayv karay. ||1||

lines.english: Everything is contained in His home.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ghar saglay samaahi.

lines.english: No one is turned away empty-handed.
lines.transliteration: jis tay birthaa ko-ay naahi.

lines.english: He cherishes all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jantar karay part ipaal.

lines.english: Forever and ever, serve the Merciful Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sayvhu kirpaal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Righteous justice is dispensed in His Court forever.
lines.transliteration: sadaa Dh aram jaa kai d eebaan .

lines.english: He is carefree, and owes allegiance to no one.
lines.transliteration: baymuhtaaj nahee kichh  kaan .

lines.english: He Himself, by Himself, does everything.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  karnaa aapan aap.

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on Him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray too t aa ka-o jaap. ||3||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  ka-o ha-o balihaar.

lines.english: Joining them, I am saved.
lines.transliteration: jaas mil hovai uDhaar.

lines.english: My mind and body are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam sang man taneh raat .

lines.english: God has blessed Nanak with this gift. ||4||5|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 dupdy (987-17) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5 d upday Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (987-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh karee d aat. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the all-powerful Lord.
lines.transliteration: har samrath kee sarnaa.

lines.english: My soul, body, wealth and capital belong to the One God, the Cause of causes.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind Dhan raas mayree parabh  ayk kaaran karnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I have found everlasting peace. He is the source of life.
lines.transliteration: simar simar sadaa sukh  paa-ee-ai jeevn ai kaa mool.

lines.english: He is all-pervading, permeating all places; He is in subtle essence and manifest form. ||1|| pMnw 988
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa sarbat th aa-ee sookh mo asthool. ||1||

lines.english: Abandon all your entanglements and corruption; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: aal jaal bikaar taj sabh  har gunaa nit  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਲ  ਜਾਲ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਤਿਜ  ਸਿਭ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨਾ  ਿਨਿਤ  ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing; please bless me with YourName. ||2||1||6|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 ] (988-2) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5. Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar jorh naanak d aan maaNgai dayh apnaa naa-o. ||2||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਨੁ ਮਗੈ  ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: God is all-powerful, divine and infinite.
lines.transliteration: parabh samrath d ayv apaar.

lines.english: Who knows Your wondrous plays? You have no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ka-un jaanai chalit t ayray kichh  ant naahee paar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; You create and destroy, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: ik khineh thaap uthaapad aa gh arh bhann karnaihaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਚਿਲਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਿਕਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As many beings as You created, God, so many You bless with Your blessings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jayt keen upaarjanaa parabh  daan d ay-ay d aataar. ||1||

lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am Your slave, O Inaccessible Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har saran aa-i-o daas t ayraa parabh  ooch agam muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਿਖਨਿਹ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪਦਾ  ਘਿੜ  ਭੰਿਨ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Lift me up and pull me out of the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||2||7|| mwlI gauVw mhlw 5 ] (988-5) maalee ga-urhaa mehlaa 5. Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kadh layho bh a-ojal bikh am tay jan naanak sad  balihaar. ||2||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤ ਕੀਨ  ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord of the World abides in my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: man tan bas rahay gopaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਰਿਨ  ਆਇਓ  ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ  ਮੁਰਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Friend of the meek, Lover of His devotees, forever and ever merciful. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen baaNDhav bh agat vachh al sad aa sad aa kirpaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਢ  ਲੇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਿਬਖਮ  ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
lines.english: In the beginning, in the end and in the middle, You alone exist, God; there is noneother than You.
lines.transliteration: aad ant ay maDh  toohai parabh  binaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: He is totally permeating and pervading all worlds; He is the One and only Lord andMaster. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-aa sagal mandal ayk su-aamee so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: With my ears I hear God's Praises, and with my eyes I behold the Blessed Vision ofHis Darshan; with my tongue I sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: karan har jas naytar d arsan rasan har gun gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਬਧਵ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You; please, bless me with Your Name. ||2||3||8||6||14|| mwlI gauVw bwxI Bgq nwmdyv jI kI  (988-9) maalee ga-urhaa ban ee bh agat naamd ayv jee kee Maalee Gauraa, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (988-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: balihaar jaa-ay sadaa naanak d ayh apn aa naa-o. ||2||3||8||6||14||

lines.english: Dhan Dh an o raam bayn baajai. Blessed, blessed is that flute which the Lord plays.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਧ ਤੂਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The sweet, sweet unstruck sound current sings forth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maDhur maDh ur Dh un anhat  gaajai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਮੰਡਲ  ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an maygh aa romaavalee. Blessed, blessed is the wool of the sheep;

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਨੇਤਰ੍  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਰਸਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an krisan odh ai kaaNblee. ||1|| blessed, blessed is the blanket worn by Krishna. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥੬॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an too maat aa dayvkee. Blessed, blessed are you, O mother Dayvakee;

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਲੀ  ਗਉੜਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਨਾਮਦੇਵ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jih garih rama-ee-aa kavalaapatee. ||2|| into your home the Lord was born. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਓ ਰਾਮ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an ban kh and bind raabanaa. Blessed, blessed are the forests of Brindaaban;

lines.transliteration: jah khaylai saree naaraa-inaa. ||3|| the Supreme Lord plays there. ||3||

lines.english: He plays the flute, and herds the cows;
lines.transliteration: bayn bajaavai goDhan charai.

lines.english: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master plays happily. ||4||1||
lines.transliteration: naamay kaa su-aamee aanad karai. ||4||1||

lines.english: O my Father, Lord of wealth, blessed are You, long-haired, dark-skinned, my darling. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayro baap maaDha-o t oo Dh an kaysou saaNvlee-o beeth ulaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You hold the steel chakra in Your hand; You came down from Heaven, and saved thelife of the elephant.
lines.transliteration: kar Dharay chakar baikunth  tay aa-ay gaj hast ee kay paraan uDh aaree-alay.

lines.english: In the court of Duhsaasan, You saved the honor of Dropati, when her clothes werebeing removed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: duhsaasan kee sabh aa daropat ee ambar layt  ubaaree-alay. ||1||

lines.english: You saved Ahliyaa, the wife of Gautam; how many have You purified and carriedacross?
lines.transliteration: gotam naar ahli-aa t aaree paavan kayt ak taaree-alay.

lines.english: Such a lowly outcaste as Naam Dayv has come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||2||
lines.transliteration: aisaa aDham ajaat  naamd ay-o t a-o sarnaagat  aa-ee-alay. ||2||2||

lines.english: Within all hearts, the Lord speaks, the Lord speaks.
lines.transliteration: sabhai gh at raam bolai raamaa bolai.

lines.english: Who else speaks, other than the Lord? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam binaa ko bolai ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਮਾਧਉ  ਤੂ ਧਨੁ ਕੇਸੌ ਸਵਲੀਓ  ਬੀਠੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Out of the same clay, the elephant, the ant, and the many sorts of species areformed.
lines.transliteration: aykal maatee kunjar cheetee bhaajan haiN baho naanaa ray.

lines.english: In stationary life forms, moving beings, worms, moths and within each and everyheart, the Lord is contained. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asthaavar jangam keet patangam gh at ghat raam samaanaa ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਧਰੇ ਚਕਰ੍ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਤੇ ਆਏ  ਗਜ ਹਸਤੀ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਉਧਾਰੀਅਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Remember the One, Infinite Lord; abandon all other hopes.
lines.transliteration: aykal chintaa raakh  anant aa a-or t ajahu sabh  aasaa ray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਹਸਾਸਨ  ਕੀ ਸਭਾ ਦਰ੍ੋਪਤੀ  ਅੰਬਰ  ਲੇਤ ਉਬਾਰੀਅਲੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv prays, I have become dispassionate and detached; who is the Lord andMaster, and who is the slave? ||2||3|| pMnw 989 rwgu mwrU mhlw 1 Gru 1 caupdy (989-1) raag maaroo mehlaa 1 ghar 1 cha-upd ay Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (989-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: sloku ] (989-4) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: paranvai naamaa bh a-ay nihkaamaa ko th aakur ko d aasaa ray. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O my Friend, I shall forever remain the dust of Your feet.
lines.transliteration: saajan tayray charan kee ho-ay rahaa sad  Dhoor.

lines.english: Nanak seeks Your protection, and beholds You ever-present, here and now. ||1|| sbd ] (989-5) sabad. Shabad:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran t uhaaree-aa paykh a-o sad aa hajoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ  ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Those who receive the call in the last hours of the night, chant the Name of their Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: pichhahu raat ee sad -rhaa naam kh asam kaa layhi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ  ਪੇਖਉ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tents, canopies, pavilions and carriages are prepared and made ready for them.
lines.transliteration: khaymay chh atar saraa-ichay d isan rath peerh ay.

lines.english: You send out the call, Lord, to those who meditate on Your Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jinee tayraa naam Dh i-aa-i-aa t in ka-o sad  milay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਛਹੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਦੜਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਲੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: Father, I am unfortunate, a fraud.
lines.transliteration: baabaa mai karamheen koorh i-aar.

lines.english: I have not found Your Name; my mind is blind and deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam na paa-i-aa tayraa anDh aa bh aram bh oolaa man mayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have enjoyed the tastes, and now my pains have come to fruition; such is my pre- ordained destiny, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: saad keet ay dukh parfurh ay poorab likh ay maa-ay.

lines.english: Now my joys are few, and my pains are many. In utter agony, I pass my life. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sukh thorh ay dukh aglay d ookhay dookh vihaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਧਾ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What separation could be worse than separation from the Lord? For those who are united with Him, what other union can there be?
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa kaa ki-aa veechh urhai mili-aa kaa ki-aa mayl.

lines.english: Praise the Lord and Master, who, having created this play, beholds it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saahib so salaahee-ai jin kar daykh i-aa kh ayl. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਦ ਕੀਤੇ  ਦੁਖ ਪਰਫੁੜੇ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਖੇ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By good destiny, this union comes about; this body enjoys its pleasures.
lines.transliteration: sanjogee maylaavarhaa in t an keet ay bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਥੋੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਅਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖੇ ਦੂਿਖ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who have lost their destiny, suffer separation from this union. O Nanak, theymay still be united once again! ||4||1|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (989-10) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vijogee mil vichhurh ay naanak bh ee sanjog. ||4||1||

lines.english: The union of the mother and father brings the body into being.
lines.transliteration: mil maat pit aa pind kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਖੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Creator inscribes upon it the inscription of its destiny.
lines.transliteration: tin kart ai laykh  likhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ  ਇਿਨ  ਤਿਨ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.english: According to this inscription, gifts, light and glorious greatness are received.
lines.transliteration: likh d aat jot vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Joining with Maya, the spiritual consciousness is lost. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil maa-i-aa surat gavaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O foolish mind, why are you so proud?
lines.transliteration: moorakh man kaahay karseh maan aa.

lines.english: You shall have to arise and depart when it pleases your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: uth chaln aa kh asmai bh aanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Abandon the tastes of the world, and find intuitive peace.
lines.transliteration: taj saad  sahj sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: All must abandon their worldly homes; no one remains here forever.
lines.transliteration: ghar chh adnay rahai na ko-ee.

lines.english: Eat some, and save the rest,
lines.transliteration: kichh kh aajai kichh  Dhar jaa-ee-ai.
jay baahurh d unee-aa aa-ee-ai. ||2|| if you are destined to return to the world again. ||2||

lines.english: He adorns his body and ress in silk robes.
lines.transliteration: saj kaa-i-aa pat hadhaa-ay.

lines.english: He issues all sorts of commands.
lines.transliteration: furmaa-is bahut chalaa-ay.

lines.english: Preparing his comfortable bed, he sleeps.
lines.transliteration: kar sayj sukhaalee sovai.

lines.english: When he falls into the hands of the Messenger of Death, what good does it do to cry out? ||3||
lines.transliteration: hathee pa-udee kaahay rovai. ||3||

lines.english: Household affairs are whirlpools of entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny. pMnw 990
lines.transliteration: ghar gh umman vaanee bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Sin is a stone which does not float.
lines.transliteration: paap pathar taran  na jaa-ee.

lines.english: So let the Fear of God be the boat to carry your soul across.
lines.transliteration: bha-o bayrh aa jee-o charh aa-oo.

lines.english: Says Nanak, rare are those who are blessed with this Boat. ||4||2|| mwrU mhlw 1 Gru 1 ] (990-2) maaroo mehlaa 1 ghar 1. Maaroo, First Mehl, First House:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak dayvai kaahoo. ||4||2||

lines.english: Actions are the paper, and the mind is the ink; good and bad are both recorded upon it.
lines.transliteration: karnee kaagad  man masvaan ee buraa bh alaa d u-ay laykh  pa-ay.

lines.english: As their past actions drive them, so are mortals driven. There is no end to Your Glorious Virtues, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o kirat chalaa-ay t i-o chalee-ai t a-o gun  naahee ant  haray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ  ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਖ ਪਏ ॥
lines.english: Why do you not keep Him in your consciousness, you mad man?
lines.transliteration: chit chayt as kee nahee baavri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਜਉ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਚਲਾਏ  ਿਤਉ  ਚਲੀਐ  ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅੰਤੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, your own virtues shall rot away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bisrat t ayray gun  gali-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The night is a net, and the day is a net; there are as many traps as there aremoments.
lines.transliteration: jaalee rain jaal din hoo-aa jayt ee gh arhee faahee t aytee.

lines.english: With relish and delight, you continually bite at the bait; you are trapped, you fool -how will you ever escape? ||2||
lines.transliteration: ras ras chog chugeh nit faaseh chh ootas moorh ay kavan gun ee. ||2||

lines.english: The body is a furnace, and the mind is the iron within it; the five fires are heating it.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa aaran man vich lohaa panch agan t it laag rahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਲੀ  ਰੈਿਨ ਜਾਲੁ  ਿਦਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਜੇਤੀ  ਘੜੀ  ਫਾਹੀ  ਤੇਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Sin is the charcoal placed upon it, which burns the mind; the tongs are anxiety andworry. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ko-ilay paap parhay t is oopar man jali-aa sanHee chint  bha-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਸ ਰਿਸ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਿਹ  ਿਨਤ ਫਾਸਿਹ  ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਮੂੜੇ ਕਵਨ  ਗੁਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: What was turned to slag is again transformed into gold, if one meets with the Guru.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-aa manoor kanchan fir hovai jay gur milai t inayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਆਰਣੁ  ਮਨੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਲੋਹਾ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਿਨ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੀ ॥
lines.english: He blesses the mortal with the Ambrosial Name of the One Lord, and then, O Nanak,the body is held steady. ||4||3|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (990-8) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk naam amrit oh d ayvai t a-o naanak t aristas d ayhaa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇਲੇ  ਪਾਪ ਪੜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਊਪਿਰ  ਮਨੁ ਜਿਲਆ  ਸੰਨੀ ਿਚੰਤ  ਭਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the pure, immaculate waters, both the lotus and the slimy scum are found.
lines.transliteration: bimal majhaar basas nirmal jal pad man jaaval ray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਆ ਮਨੂਰੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਿਫਿਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਤਨੇਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The lotus flower is with the scum and the water, but it remains untouched by anypollution. ||1||
lines.transliteration: padman jaaval jal ras sangat  sang d okh nahee ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਓਹੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਟਿਸ  ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: You frog, you will never understand.
lines.transliteration: daadar too kabeh na jaanas ray.

lines.english: You eat the dirt, while you dwell in the immaculate waters. You know nothing of theambrosial nectar there. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhakh as sibaal basas nirmal jal amrit  na lakh as ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਮਲ  ਮਝਾਿਰ  ਬਸਿਸ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜਲ ਪਦਮਿਨ  ਜਾਵਲ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: You dwell continually in the water; the bumble bee does not dwell there, but it isintoxicated with its fragrance from afar.
lines.transliteration: bas jal nit na vasat  alee-al mayr chachaa gun ray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਦਮਿਨ  ਜਾਵਲ ਜਲ ਰਸ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਦੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Intuitively sensing the moon in the distance, the lotus bows its head. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chand kumud anee Dh oorahu nivsas anbh a-o kaaran ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਦਰ  ਤੂ ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਨਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The realms of nectar are irrigated with milk and honey; you think you are clever to live in the water.
lines.transliteration: amrit kh and d ooDh maDh  sanchas t oo ban chaat ur ray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਖਿਸ  ਿਸਬਾਲੁ  ਬਸਿਸ  ਿਨਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨ ਲਖਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the love of the flea for blood.||3||
lines.transliteration: apnaa aap too kabahu na chh odas pisan pareet  ji-o ray. ||3||

lines.english: The fool may live with the Pandit, the religious scholar, and listen to the Vedas and the Shaastras.
lines.transliteration: pandit sang vaseh jan moorakh  aagam saas sunay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੁ ਜਲ ਿਨਤ  ਨ ਵਸਤ  ਅਲੀਅਲ  ਮੇਰ ਚਚਾ  ਗੁਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the crooked tail of the dog.||4||
lines.transliteration: apnaa aap too kabahu na chh odas su-aan poochh  ji-o ray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ  ਦੂਰਹੁ ਿਨਵਸਿਸ  ਅਨਭਉ  ਕਾਰਿਨ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some are hypocrites; they do not merge with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Someare absorbed in the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: ik paakhandee naam na raacheh ik har har charn ee ray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਖੰਡੁ ਦੂਿਧ ਮਧੁ ਸੰਚਿਸ  ਤੂ ਬਨ ਚਾਤੁਰ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The mortals obtain what they are predestined to receive; O Nanak, with your tongue,chant the Naam. ||5||4|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (990-15) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl, sloku ] (990-15) salok. Shalok:
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa paavas naanak rasnaa naam jap ray. ||5||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਿਸ  ਿਪਸਨ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਜਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Countless sinners are sanctified, attaching their minds to the Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  asaNkh hohi har charnee man laag.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਜਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਗਮ ਸਾਸ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
lines.english: The merits of the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage are found in God's Name, O Nanak,when such destiny is inscribed upon one's forehead. ||1|| sbdu ] (990-16) sabad. Shabad:
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath naam parabh  naanak jis mast ak bh aag. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਿਸ  ਸੁਆਨ  ਪੂਿਛ ਿਜਉ ਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: O friends and companions, so puffed up with pride,
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahaylee garab gahaylee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਪਾਖੰਡੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਰਾਚਿਹ ਇਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sah kee ik baat  suhaylee. ||1|| listen to this one joyous story of your Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਪਾਵਿਸ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਰੇ ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.english: Who can I tell about my pain, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: jo mai baydan saa kis aakh aa maa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive; how can I comfort it, O my mother? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bin jee-o na rahai kaisay raakhaa maa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am a dejected, discarded bride, totally miserable.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dohaagan  kharee ranj aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਹੋਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ  ॥
lines.english: I have lost my youth; I regret and repent. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ga-i-aa so joban Dhan pachh utaanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my wise Lord and Master, above my head.
lines.transliteration: too daanaa saahib sir mayraa.

lines.english: I serve You as Your humble slave. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khijmat  karee jan band aa tayraa. ||3||

lines.english: Nanak humbly prays, this is my only concern:
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak and aysaa ayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bin darsan kaisay rava-o sanayhee. ||4||5|| without the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, how can I enjoy Him? ||4||5|| pMnw 991 mwrU mhlw 1 ] (991-1) maaroo mehlaa 1.

lines.english: I am Your slave, Your bonded servant, and so I am called fortunate.
lines.transliteration: mul khareed ee laalaa golaa mayraa naa-o sabh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਲ ਖਰੀਦੀ  ਲਾਲਾ  ਗੋਲਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ਸਭਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: I sold myself at Your store in exchange for the Guru's Word; whatever You link me to,to that I am linked. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kee bachnee haat bikaanaa jit laa-i-aa t it laagaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਚਨੀ  ਹਾਿਟ  ਿਬਕਾਨਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What cleverness can Your servant try with You?
lines.transliteration: tayray laalay ki-aa chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, I cannot carry out the Hukam of Your Command. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saahib kaa hukam na karnaa jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mother is Your slave, and my father is Your slave; I am the child of Your slaves.
lines.transliteration: maa laalee pi-o laalaa mayraa ha-o laalay kaa jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: My slave mother dances, and my slave father sings; I practice devotional worship toYou, O my Sovereign Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laalee naachai laalaa gaavai bhagat  kara-o t ayree raa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾ ਲਾਲੀ  ਿਪਉ ਲਾਲਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਲਾਲੇ  ਕਾ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If You wish to drink, then I shall get water for You; if You wish to eat, I shall grind the corn for You.
lines.transliteration: pee-ah ta paan ee aan ee meeraa kh aahi t a peesan  jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੀ  ਨਾਚੈ ਲਾਲਾ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I wave the fan over You, and wash Your feet, and continue to chant Your Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pakhaa fayree pair malovaa japat  rahaa t ayraa naa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਅਿਹ  ਤ ਪਾਣੀ  ਆਣੀ  ਮੀਰਾ  ਖਾਿਹ  ਤ ਪੀਸਣ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have been untrue to myself, but Nanak is Your slave; please forgive him, by Yourglorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: loon haraamee naanak laalaa bakh sihi tuDh vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪੈਰ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਜਪਤ  ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You have been themerciful and generous Lord. Without You, liberation cannot be attained. ||4||6|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (991-6) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  da-i-aapat  daataa tuDh vin mukat  na paa-ee. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਲਾਲਾ  ਬਖਿਸਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Some call him a ghost; some say that he is a demon.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aakhai bh ootnaa ko kahai bayt aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ ਦਇਆਪਿਤ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਵਣੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Some call him a mere mortal; O, poor Nanak! ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aakhai aad mee naanak vaychaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: Crazy Nanak has gone insane, after his Lord, the King.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-aa d ivaanaa saah kaa naanak ba-uraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ  ਭੂਤਨਾ  ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I know of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o har bin avar na jaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He alone is known to be insane, when he goes insane with the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: ta-o d ayvaanaa jaan ee-ai jaa bh ai dayvaanaa ho-ay.

lines.english: He recognizes none other than the One Lord and Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aykee saahib baahraa doojaa avar na jaan ai ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He alone is known to be insane, if he works for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ta-o d ayvaanaa jaan ee-ai jaa aykaa kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Recognizing the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, what other cleverness is there? ||3||
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan ai khasam kaa d oojee avar si-aan ap kaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਭੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He alone is known to be insane, when he falls in love with his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ta-o d ayvaanaa jaan ee-ai jaa saahib Dh aray pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੀ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He sees himself as bad, and all the rest of the world as good. ||4||7|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (991-11) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mandaa jaan ai aap ka-o avar bh alaa sansaar. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਏਕਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This wealth is all-pervading, permeating all.
lines.transliteration: ih Dhan sarab rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਦੂਜੀ  ਅਵਰ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਕਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, thinking that it is far away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manmukh fireh se jaan eh door. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜਾ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: That commodity, the wealth of the Naam, is within my heart.
lines.transliteration: so Dhan vakh ar naam rid ai hamaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਪ  ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: Whoever You bless with it, is emancipated. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis too d eh tisai nist aarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This wealth does not burn; it cannot be stolen by a thief.
lines.transliteration: na ih Dhan jalai na t askar lai jaa-ay.

lines.english: This wealth does not drown, and its owner is never punished. ||2||
lines.transliteration: na ih Dhan doobai na is Dh an ka-o milai sajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Gaze upon the glorious greatness of this wealth,
lines.transliteration: is Dhan kee d aykhhu vadi-aa-ee.
sehjay maatay an-d in jaa-ee. ||3|| and your nights and days will pass, imbued with celestial peace. ||3||

lines.english: Listen to this incomparably beautiful story, O my brothers, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: ik baat anoop sunhu nar bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Tell me, without this wealth, who has ever obtained the supreme status? ||4||
lines.transliteration: is Dhan bin kahhu kinai param gat  paa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak humbly prays, I proclaim the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak akath kee kathaa sun aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If one meets the True Guru, then this wealth is obtained. ||5||8|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (991-16) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a ih Dh an paa-ay. ||5||8||

lines.english: Heat up the sun energy of the right nostril, and cool down the moon energy of the leftnostril; practicing this breath-contr ol, bring them into perfect balance.
lines.transliteration: soor sar sos lai som sar pokh lai jugat  kar marat  so san-banDh  keejai.

lines.english: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall will not crumble. ||1||
lines.transliteration: meen kee chapal si-o jugat man raakh ee-ai udai nah hans nah kanDh  chheejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You fool, why are you deluded by doubt?
lines.transliteration: moorhay kaa-ichay bh aram bh ulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਿਕਨੈ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: You do not remember the detached Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nah cheeni-aa parmaanand bairaagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਣਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਅਕਥ  ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Seize and burn the unbearable; seize and kill the imperishable; leave behind yourdoubts, and then, you shall drink in the Nectar.
lines.transliteration: ajar gahu jaar lai amar gahu maar lai bharaat  taj chh od ta-o api-o peejai.

lines.english: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||2|| pMnw 992
lines.transliteration: meen kee chapal si-o jugat man raakh ee-ai udai nah hans nah kanDh  chheejai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ  ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak humbly prays, if the Lord's humble servant dwells upon Him, in his mind of minds, with his every breath, then he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak jano ravai jay har mano man pavan si-o amrit  peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਣਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਨੋ ਰਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਮਨੋ ਮਨ ਪਵਨ ਿਸਉ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: ||3||9|| In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not flyaway, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||3||9|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (992-3) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: meen kee chapal si-o jugat man raakh ee-ai udai nah hans nah kanDh  chheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ  ਿਸਉ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ  ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥੩॥੯॥
lines.english: Maya is not conquered, and the mind is not subdued; the waves of desire in theworld-ocean are intoxicating wine.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mu-ee na man mu-aa sar lahree mai mat.

lines.english: The boat crosses over the water, carrying the true merchandise.
lines.transliteration: bohith jal sir tar tikai saachaa vakh ar jit.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੁਈ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਆ  ਸਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ  ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ॥
lines.english: The jewel within the mind subdues the mind; attached to the Truth, it is not broken.
lines.transliteration: maanak man meh man maarsee sach na laagai kat .

lines.english: The king is seated upon the throne, imbued with the Fear of God and the fivequalities. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raajaa takh at tikai gun ee bh ai panchaa-in  rat. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ  ਸਿਚ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕਤੁ ॥
lines.english: O Baba, do not see your True Lord and Master as being far away.
lines.transliteration: baabaa saachaa saahib door na d aykh.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਤਖਿਤ  ਿਟਕੈ ਗੁਣੀ  ਭੈ ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਰਤੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Light of all, the Life of the world; The True Lord writes His Inscription oneach and every head. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab jot jagjeevanaa sir sir saachaa laykh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Brahma and Vishnu, the Rishis and the silent sages, Shiva and Indra, penitents and beggars
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan rikhee munee sankar ind  tapai bh aykhaaree.
maanai hukam sohai dar saachai aakee mareh afaaree. - whoever obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, looks beautiful in the Court ofthe True Lord, while the stubborn rebels die.

lines.english: The wandering beggars, warriors, celibates and Sannyaasee hermits - through thePerfect Guru, consider this:
lines.transliteration: jangam joDh jat ee sani-aasee gur poorai veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਿਰਖੀ  ਮੁਨੀ ਸੰਕਰੁ ਇੰਦੁ ਤਪੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sayvaa fal kabahu na paavas sayvaa karnee saaree. ||2|| without selfless service, no one ever receives the fruits of their rewards. Serving theLord is the most excellent action. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਕੀ  ਮਰਿਹ ਅਫਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are the wealth of the poor, the Guru of the guru-less, the honor of thedishonored.
lines.transliteration: niDhni-aa Dh an niguri-aa gur nimaan iaa too maan .

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਗਮ  ਜੋਧ ਜਤੀ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am blind; I have grasped hold of the jewel, the Guru. You are the strength of theweak.
lines.transliteration: anDhulai maan ak gur pakrh i-aa nit aani-aa too taan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਸ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is not known through burnt offerings and ritual chanting; the True Lord is knownthrough the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: hom japaa nahee jaani-aa gurmat ee saach pachh aan.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one finds shelter in the Court of theLord; the false come and go in reincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa naahee dar dh o-ee jh oothaa aavan  jaan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ  ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਕਿੜਆ ਿਨਤਾਿਣਆ  ਤੂ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: So praise the True Name, and through the True Name, you will find satisfaction.
lines.transliteration: saachaa naam salaahee-ai saachay tay t aripat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਮ ਜਪਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: When the mind is cleaned with the jewel of spiritual wisdom, it does not become dirty again.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan ratan man maajee-ai bahurh  na mailaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਦਿਰ ਢੋਈ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As long as the Lord and Master dwells in the mind, no obstacles are encountered.
lines.transliteration: jab lag saahib man vasai tab lag bigh an na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, giving one's head, one is emancipated, and the mind and body become true.||4||10|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (992-12) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sir day chh utee-ai man t an saachaa so-ay. ||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਰਤਿਨ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Yogi who is joined to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is pure; he is not stainedby even a particle of dirt.
lines.transliteration: jogee jugat naam nirmaa-il t aa kai mail na raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The True Lord, his Beloved, is always with him; the rounds of birth and death areended for him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pareetam naath sad aa sach sangay janam maran  gat beetee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, what is Your Name, and what is it like?
lines.transliteration: gusaa-ee tayraa kahaa naam kaisay jaat ee.

lines.english: If You summon me into the Mansion of Your Presence, I will ask You, how I canbecome one with You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa ta-o bh eetar mahal bulaaveh poochh a-o baat  nirant ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰਮਾਇਲੁ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a Brahmin, who takes his cleansing bath in the spiritual wisdom of God, and whose leaf-offerings in worship are the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: barahman barahm gi-aan isnaanee har gun  poojay paat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਨਾਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਗਿਤ  ਬੀਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One Name, the One Lord, and His One Light pervade the three worlds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayko naam ayk naaraa-in t aribhavan aykaa jot ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: My tongue is the balance of the scale, and this heart of mine is the pan of the scale; Iweigh the immeasurable Naam.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa dandee ih ghat chh aabaa t ola-o naam ajaachee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤਉ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਵਿਹ  ਪੂਛਉ  ਬਾਤ ਿਨਰੰਤੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is one store, and one banker above all; the merchants deal in the onecommodity. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayko haat saahu sabhnaa sir van jaaray ik bh aatee. ||3||

lines.english: The True Guru saves us at both ends; he alone understands, who is lovingly focusedon the One Lord; his inner being remains free of doubt.
lines.transliteration: dovai siray sat guroo nibayrh ay so boojh ai jis ayk liv laagee jee-ahu rahai nibh raatee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਣੁ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜੇ ਪਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad abides within, and doubt is ended, for those who constantlyserve, day and night. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabad vasaa-ay bh aram chukaa-ay sad aa sayvak d in raat ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Above is the sky of the mind, and beyond this sky is the Lord, the Protector of theWorld; the Inaccessible Lord God; the Guru abides there as well.
lines.transliteration: oopar gagan gagan par gorakh t aa kaa agam guroo pun vaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਡੰਡੀ ਇਹੁ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਬਾ  ਤੋਲਉ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ  ॥
lines.english: According to the Word of the Guru's Teachings, what is outside is the same as what isinside the home of the self. Nanak has become a detached renunciate. ||5||11|| pMnw 993 rwgu mwrU mhlw 1 Gru 5  (993-1) raag maaroo mehlaa 1 ghar 5 Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (993-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee baahar ghar ayko naanak bh a-i-aa ud aasee. ||5||11||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps or dreams.
lines.transliteration: ahinis jaagai need na sovai.

lines.english: He alone knows this, who feels the pain of separation from God.
lines.transliteration: so jaanai jis vayd an hovai.

lines.english: My body is pierced through with the arrow of love. How can any physician know the cure? ||1||
lines.transliteration: paraym kay kaan lagay tan bh eetar vaid  ke jaan ai kaaree jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਨ  ਲਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਵੈਦੁ ਿਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Rare is that one, who as Gurmukh, understands, and whom the True Lord links to HisPraise.
lines.transliteration: jis no saachaa siftee laa-ay. gurmukh  virlay kisai bujh aa-ay.

lines.english: He alone appreciates the value of the Ambsosial Nectar, who deals in this Ambrosia.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit kee saar so-ee jaan ai je amrit  kaa vaapaaree jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The soul-bride is in love with her Husband Lord;
lines.transliteration: pir saytee Dh an paraym rachaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਜ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad t athaa chit  laa-ay. the focuses her consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.english: The soul-bride is joyously embellished with intuitive ease; her hunger and thirst are taken away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahj saytee Dh an kh aree suhaylee t arisnaa t ikhaa nivaaree jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: Tear down skepticism and dispel your doubt;
lines.transliteration: sahsaa torh ay bh aram chukaa-ay.
sehjay siftee Dh anakh charh aa-ay. with your intuition, draw the bow of the Praise of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਿਤਖਾ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conquer and subdue your mind; take thesupport of Yoga - Union with the beautiful Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad marai man maaray sund ar jogaaDh aaree jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Burnt by egotism, one forgets the Lord from his mind.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jali-aa manhu visaaray.

lines.english: In the City of Death, he is attacked with massive swords.
lines.transliteration: jam pur vajeh kharh ag karaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਜੋਗਾਧਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Then, even if he asks for it, he will not receive the Lord's Name; O soul, you shallsuffer terrible punishment. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ab kai kahi-ai naam na mil-ee too saho jee-arh ay bh aaree jee-o. ||4||

lines.english: You are distracted by thoughts of Maya and worldly attachment.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mamtaa paveh kh i-aalee.

lines.english: In the City of Death, you will be caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: jam pur faashigaa jam jaalee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਕਿਹਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਮਲਈ  ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ  ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: You cannot break free from the bondage of loving attachment, and so the Messenger of Death will torture you. ||5||
lines.transliteration: hayt kay banDh an torh na saakeh t aa jam karay kh u-aaree jee-o. ||5||

lines.english: I have done nothing; I am doing nothing now.
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o kartaa naa mai kee-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru has blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sat gur dee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋਿੜ ਨ ਸਾਕਿਹ  ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: What other efforts can anyone make, when You bestow Your blessing? Nanak seeksYour Sanctuary. ||6||1||12|| mwrU mhlw 3 Gru 1  (993-11) maaroo mehlaa 3 ghar 1 Maaroo, Third Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (993-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jis too d eh tisai ki-aa chaaraa naanak saran  tumaaree jee-o. ||6||1||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਰਤਾ  ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever You seat me, there I sit, O my Lord and Master; wherever You send me,there I go.
lines.transliteration: jah baisaaleh tah baisaa su-aamee jah bh ayjeh t ah jaavaa.

lines.english: In the entire village, there is only One King; all places are sacred. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh nagree meh ayko raajaa sabh ay pavit  heh thaavaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਿਤਸੈ ਿਕਆ  ਚਾਰਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥੧॥੧੨॥
lines.english: O Baba, while I dwell in this body, let me sing Your True Praises,
lines.transliteration: baabaa deh vasaa sach gaavaa.
jaa tay sehjay sahj samaavaa. ||1|| rahaa-o. that I may intuitively merge with You. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਲਿਹ  ਤਹ ਬੈਸਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਹ ਭੇਜਿਹ  ਤਹ ਜਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: He thinks that good and bad deeds come from himself; this is the source of all evil.
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa kichh  aapas t ay jaani-aa ay-ee sagal vikaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਨਗਰੀ  ਮਿਹ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ  ਸਭੇ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹਿਹ ਥਾਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever happens in this world is only by the Order of our Lord and Master. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ih furmaa-i-aa khasam kaa ho-aa vart ai ih sansaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Sexual desires are so strong and compelling; where has this sexual desire come from?
lines.transliteration: indree Dh aat sabal kahee-at  hai ind ree kis t ay ho-ee.

lines.english: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; how rare are those who realize this. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay khayl karai sabh  kartaa aisaa boojh ai ko-ee. ||3||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one is lovingly focused on the One Lord, and then, duality is ended.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ayk liv laagee dubiDh aa taday binaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਿਕਛੁ ਆਪਸ  ਤੇ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਏਈ ਸਗਲ  ਿਵਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever is in harmony with His Will, he accepts as True; the noose of Death is loosened from around his neck. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aanaa so sat  kar maani-aa kaatee jam kee faasee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਹੋਆ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, who can call him to account, when the egotistical pride of his mind hasbeen silenced?
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak laykh aa maagai kavnaa jaa chookaa man abh imaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਧਾਤੁ ਸਬਲ  ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਹੈ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਿਕਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma is intimidated and afraid of him; he has enteredthe Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||5||1|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (993-18) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taas t aas Dh aram raa-ay japat  hai pa-ay sachay kee sarnaa. ||5||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਭ ਕਰਤਾ  ਐਸਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation no longer exist, when one dwells in the home ofthe self within.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa naa thee-ai nij gh ar vaasaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਏਕ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਤਦੇ ਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: He bestowed the Blessing of His treasure of truth; only He Himself knows. ||1|| pMnw 994
lines.transliteration: sach khajaanaa bakh si-aa aapay jaan ai so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, remember the Dear Lord, and abandon the corruption of your mind.
lines.transliteration: ay man har jee-o chayt t oo manhu t aj vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਤੂ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਿਜ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad; focus lovingly on the Truth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad Dh i-aa-ay t oo sach lagee pi-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਸਿਚ ਲਗੀ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who forgets the Name in this world, shall not find any place of rest anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: aithai naavhu bhuli-aa fir hath kithaa-oo na paa-ay.

lines.english: He shall wander in all sorts of reincarnations, and rot away in manure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jonee sabh bh avaa-ee-an bistaa maahi samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਿਲਆ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਹਥੁ ਿਕਥਾਊ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, according to my pre-ordained destiny,O my mother.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur paa-i-aa poorab likh i-aa maa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, I practice true devotional worship; I am united with the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din sachee bh agat kar sachaa la-ay milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself fashioned the entire universe; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat sabh saajee-an aapay nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious and great; as He pleases, Hebestows His Blessings. ||4||2|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (994-5) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vadi-aa-ee-aa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Please forgive my past mistakes, O my Dear Lord; now, please place me on the Path.
lines.transliteration: pichhlay gunah bakh saa-ay jee-o ab t oo maarag paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: I remain attached to the Lord's Feet, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kee charnee laag rahaa vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gurmukh naam har Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਛਲੇ  ਗੁਨਹ  ਬਖਸਾਇ  ਜੀਉ  ਅਬ ਤੂ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Remain attached forever to the Lord's Feet, single-mindedly, with love for the OneLord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sadaa har charn ee laag rahaa ik man aykai bh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹਾ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have no social status or honor; I have no place or home.
lines.transliteration: naa mai jaat na pat  hai naa mai thayhu na thaa-o.

lines.english: Pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, my doubts have been cut away. The Guru has inspired me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabad bh ayd bharam kati-aa gur naam d ee-aa samjh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹਾ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This mind wanders around, driven by greed, totally attached to greed.
lines.transliteration: ih man laalach kardaa firai laalach laagaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: DhanDh ai koorh  vi-aapi-aa jam pur chotaa kh aa-ay. ||3|| He is engrossed in false pursuits; he shall endure beatings in the City of Death. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਪਿਤ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਥੇਹੁ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God Himself Himself is all-in-all. There is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh  aapay aap hai d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਭੇਿਦ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ  ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He bestows the treasure of devotional worship, and the Gurmukhs abide in peace.||4||3|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (994-10) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  khajaanaa bakh si-on gurmukh aa sukh  ho-ay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਚ  ਕਰਦਾ ਿਫਰੈ ਲਾਲਿਚ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Seek and find those who are imbued with Truth; they are so rare in this world.
lines.transliteration: sach ratay say tol lahu say virlay sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧੈ ਕੂਿੜ ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting with them, one's face becomes radiant and bright, chanting the Name of theLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin mili-aa mukh  ujlaa jap naam muraar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Baba, contemplate and cherish the True Lord and Master within your heart.
lines.transliteration: baabaa saachaa saahib ridai samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਖਜਾਨਾ  ਬਖਿਸਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Seek out and see, and ask your True Guru, and obtain the true commodity. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur apnaa puchh  daykh layho vakh ar bhaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All serve the One True Lord; through pre-ordained destiny, they meet Him.
lines.transliteration: ik sachaa sabh sayvd ee Dh ur bhaag milaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਟੋਿਲ  ਲਹੁ ਸੇ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs merge with Him, and will not be separated from Him again; they attainthe True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh milay say na vichh urheh paavahi sach so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Some do not appreciate the value of devotional worship; the self-willed manmukhs aredeluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: ik bhagt ee saar na jaan nee manmukh  bharam bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: They are fillled with self-conceit; they cannot accomplish anything. ||3||
lines.transliteration: onaa vich aap varatdaa karn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਪੁਿਛ ਦੇਖੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Stand and offer your prayer, to the One who cannot be moved by force.
lines.transliteration: jis naal jor na chal-ee khalay keechai ard aas.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within the mind of the Gurmukh;hearing his prayer, the Lord applauds him. ||4||4|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (994-16) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam man vasai t aa sun  karay saabaas. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਦੀ ਧੁਿਰ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He transforms the burning desert into a c ool oasis; he transmutes rusted iron into gold.
lines.transliteration: maaroo tay seet al karay manoorahu kanchan ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: So praise the True Lord; there is none other as great as He is. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so saachaa salaahee-ai tis jayvad avar na ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, night and day, meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mayray man an-din Dh i-aa-ay har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bachan araaDh  too an-d in gun  gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਖਲੇ ਕੀਚੈ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, one comes to know the One Lord, when the True Guru instructs him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ayko jaan ee-ai jaa sat gur day-ay bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸੁਿਣ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Praise the True Guru, who imparts this understanding. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so satgur salaahee-ai jid oo ayh sojh ee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Those who forsake the True Guru, and attach themselves to duality - what will theydo when they go to the world hereafter?
lines.transliteration: satgur chh od doojai lagay ki-aa karan agai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਤੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਕਰੇ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they will be beaten. They will be punished severely. ||3|| pMnw 995
lines.transliteration: jam pur baDhay maaree-ah bahut ee milai sajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: My God is independent and self-sufficient; he does not have even an iota of greed.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh vayparvaahu hai naa t is til na t amaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, run to His Sanctuary; granting His forgiveness, He merges us into Himself. ||4||5|| mwrU mhlw 4 Gru 2  (995-3) maaroo mehlaa 4 ghar 2 Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (995-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis sarn aa-ee bh aj pa-o aapay bakh as milaa-ay. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਿਜ ਪਉ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Suk-deva and Janak meditated on the Naam; following the Guru's Teachings, theysought the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: japi-o naam suk janak gur bachnee har har saran paray.

lines.english: God met Sudama and removed his poverty; through loving devotional worship, hecrossed over.
lines.transliteration: daalad  bhanj sud aamay mili-o bh agtee bh aa-ay t aray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: God is the Lover of His devotees; the Lord's Name is fufilling; God showers His Mercyon the Gurmukhs. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al har naam kirt aarath gurmukh  kirpaa karay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਭੰਿਜ ਸੁਦਾਮੇ  ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਭਾਇ  ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will be saved.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam japat uDh ray.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਤਾਰਥੁ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharoo par-hilaad  bidar daasee sut  gurmukh  naam t aray. ||1|| rahaa-o. Dhroo, Prahlaad and Bidar the slave-girl's son, became Gurmukh, and through theNaam, crossed over. ||1||Pause||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Naam is the supreme wealth; it saves the humble devotees.
lines.transliteration: kaljug naam parDhaan pad aarath bh agat janaa uDh ray.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰ੍ੂਪ ਰ੍ ਿ ਹ ਲ ਾ ਦ ੁ ਿਬਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੁਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the faults of Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the leather-worker were covered.
lines.transliteration: naamaa jaiday-o kabeer t arilochan sabh  dokh ga-ay chamray.

lines.english: Those who become Gurmukh, and remain attached to the Naam, are saved; all theirsins are washed off. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam lagay say uDh ray sabh  kilbikh  paap taray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਜੁਿਗ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਧਾਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਉਧਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever chants the Naam, all his sins and mistakes are taken away.
lines.transliteration: jo jo naam japai apraaDhee sabh  tin kay d okh parharay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਾ  ਜੈਦੇਉ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨੁ ਸਿਭ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਚਮਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Ajaamal, who had sex with prostitites, was saved, by chanting the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: baysu-aa ravat ajaamal uDh aari-o mukh  bolai naaraa-in  narharay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ  ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, Ugar Sain obtained salvation; his bonds were broken, and he wasliberated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam japat ugarsain  gat paa-ee t orh banDh an mukat  karay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ  ਸਿਭ ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself takes pity on His humble servants, and makes them His own.
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o aap anoograhu kee-aa har angeekaar karay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਸੁਆ  ਰਵਤ  ਅਜਾਮਲੁ  ਉਧਿਰਓ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਨਰਹਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord of the Universe saves the honor of His servants; those who seek HisSanctuary are saved.
lines.transliteration: sayvak paij rakhai mayraa govid  saran  paray uDh ray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਉਗਰ੍ਸੈਿਣ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਤੋਿੜ ਬੰਧਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord has showered servant Nanak with His Mercy; he has enshrined the Lord's Name within his heart. ||4||1|| mwrU mhlw 4 ] (995-11) maaroo mehlaa 4. Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kirpaa Dhaaree ur Dh ari-o naam haray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਿਪ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi meditate on Him; they are lovingly focused on Him. Theseekers and the silent sages meditate on Him as well.
lines.transliteration: siDh samaaDh  japi-o liv laa-ee saaDh ik mun japi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਉਧਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The celibates, the true and contented beings meditate on Him; Indra and the othergods chant His Name with their mouths.
lines.transliteration: jatee sat ee sant okhee Dh i-aa-i-aa mukh  indraadik ravi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਉਰ ਧਿਰਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who seek His Sanctuary meditate on Him; they become Gurmukh and swimacross. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saran paray japi-o t ay bh aa-ay gurmukh  paar pa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and cross over.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam japat t ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਜਿਪਓ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਸਾਿਧਕ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhannaa jat baalmeek batvaaraa gurmukh  paar pa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. Dhanna the farmer, and Balmik the highway robber, became Gurmukh, and crossedover. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾਿਦਕ  ਰਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: Angels, men, heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on Him; even thehumble Rishis sing of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sur nar gan ganDh arbay japi-o rikh  bapurai har gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਜਿਪਓ  ਤੇ ਭਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Shiva, Brahma and the goddess Lakhshmi, meditate, and chant with their mouths the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sankar barahmai dayvee japi-o mukh  har har naam japi-aa.

lines.english: Those whose minds are drenched with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as Gurmukh,cross over. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har har naam jinaa man bheenaa t ay gurmukh  paar pa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ  ਬਟਵਾਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਿਰ ਪਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Millions and millions, three hundred thirty million gods meditate on Him; there is noend to those who meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot kot tayt ees Dh i-aa-i-o har japt i-aa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees meditate on the Lord; the Pandits, thereligious scholars, sing the Lord's Praises as well.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan  simrit  har japi-aa mukh  pandit  har gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬੇ  ਜਿਪਓ  ਿਰਿਖ  ਬਪੁਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam, the source of nectar - as Gurmukh, theycross over. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam rasaal jinaa man vasi-aa tay gurmukh  paar pa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਕਿਰ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੈ  ਦੇਵੀ ਜਿਪਓ  ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Naam in endless waves - I cannot even count their number.
lines.transliteration: anat t arangee naam jin japi-aa mai gan at na kar saki-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe bestows His Mercy, and those who are pleasing to the Mindof the Lord God, find their place.
lines.transliteration: gobid kirpaa karay thaa-ay paa-ay jo har parabh  man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਿਟ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪਿਤਆ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru, granting His Grace, implants the Lord's Name within; servant Nanak chantsthe Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2|| pMnw 996 mwrU mhlw 4 Gru 3  (996-1) maaroo mehlaa 4 ghar 3 Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (996-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur Dhaar kirpaa har naam d arirh-aa-i-o jan naanak naam la-i-aa. ||4||2||

lines.english: Take the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and the Lord shall bless you with honor.
lines.transliteration: har har naam niDhaan lai gurmat  har pat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, the Lord goes with you; in the end, He shall deliver you.
lines.transliteration: halat palat  naal chald aa har ant ay la-ay chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਚਲਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Where the path is difficult and the street is narrow, there the Lord shall liberate you.||1||
