lines.transliteration: jithai avghat galee-aa bh eerhee-aa t ithai har har mukat  karaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਅਵਘਟ  ਗਲੀਆ  ਭੀੜੀਆ  ਿਤਥੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my True Guru, implant within me the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray satiguraa mai har har naam drirh -aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰਾ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is my mother, father, child and relative; I have none other than the Lord, Omy mother. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayraa maat pit aa sut  banDh po mai har bin avar na maa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I feel the pains of love and yearning for the Lord, and the Name of the Lord. If onlysomeone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: mai har birhee har naam hai ko-ee aan milaavai maa-ay.

lines.english: I bow in humble devotion to one who inspires me to meet with my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: tis aagai mai jod -rhee mayraa pareet am day-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The almighty and merciful True Guru unites me with the Lord God instantaneously. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  da-i-aal parabh  har maylay dh il na paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਮੈ ਜੋਦੜੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਦੇਇ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate,and are slaughtered.
lines.transliteration: jin har har naam na chayti-o say bh aagheen  mar jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਿਢਲ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They wander in reincarnation, again and again; they die, and are re-born, andcontinue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: o-ay fir fir jon bhavaa-ee-ah mar jameh aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are cruelly beaten, and punished in theCourt of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: o-ay jam dar baDh ay maaree-ah har d argeh milai sajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਿਫਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਵਾਈਅਿਹ  ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary; O my Sovereign Lord King, please unite me withYourself.
lines.transliteration: too parabh  ham sarn aagat ee mo ka-o mayl laihu har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, Life of the World, please shower me with Your Mercy; grant me the Sanctuaryof the Guru, the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har Dhaar kirpaa jagjeevanaa gur sat gur kee sarn aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord, becoming merciful, has blended servant Nanak with Himself.||4||1||3|| mwrU mhlw 4 ] (996-10) maaroo mehlaa 4. Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aap da-i-aal ho-ay jan naanak har maylaa-ay. ||4||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I inquire about the commodity of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Is there anyonewho can show me the wealth, the capital of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: ha-o poonjee naam dasaa-id aa ko d asay har Dh an raas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: I cut myself into pieces, and make myself a sacrifice to that one who leads me tomeet my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tis vitahu kh an kh annee-ai mai maylay har parabh  paas.

lines.english: I am filled with the Love of my Beloved; how can I meet my Friend, and merge withHim? ||1||
lines.transliteration: mai antar paraym piramm kaa ki-o sajan  milai milaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਸਾਇਦਾ  ਕੋ ਦਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O my beloved friend, my mind, I take the wealth, the capital of the Name of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa mitraa mai har har naam Dh an raas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਖਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; the Lord is my support - Icelebrate the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai naam drirh-aa-i-aa har Dh eerak har saabaas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O my Guru, please unite me with the Lord, Har, Har; show me the wealth, the capitalof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har aap milaa-ay gur mai dasay har Dh an raas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, love does not well up; see this, and know it in your mind.
lines.transliteration: bin gur paraym na labh-ee jan vaykh hu man nirjaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਧੀਰਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord has installed Himself within the Guru; so praise the Guru, who unites us with the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har gur vich aap rakhi-aa har maylay gur saabaas. ||2||

lines.english: The ocean, the treasure of devotional worship of the Lord, rests with the Perfect TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: saagar bhagat  bhandaar har pooray sat gur paas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: When it pleases the True Guru, He opens the treasure, and and the Gurmukhs areilluminated by the Lord's Light.
lines.transliteration: satgur t uthaa kh ol day-ay mukh  gurmukh  har pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਜਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਿਨਰਜਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs die of thirst, on the very bank of the river. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aag vihoon i-aa tikh mu-ee-aa kanDh ee paas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਿਵਿਚ  ਆਪੁ  ਰਿਖਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Great Giver; I beg for this gift from the Guru,
lines.transliteration: gur daat aa daataar hai ha-o maaga-o d aan gur paas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.transliteration: chiree vichhunnaa mayl parabh  mai man t an vadrh ee aas. that He may unite me with God, from whom I was separated for so long! This is thegreat hope of my mind and body.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ  ਖੋਿਲ ਦੇਇ ਮੁਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰਗਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: If it pleases You, O my Guru, please listen to my prayer; this is servant Nanak'sprayer. ||4||2||4|| mwrU mhlw 4 ] (996-17) maaroo mehlaa 4. Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur bhaavai sun  baynt ee jan naanak kee ard aas. ||4||2||4||

lines.english: O Lord God, please preach Your sermon to me. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is merged into my heart.
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa sunaa-ay parabh  gurmat  har rid ai samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ  ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, O very fortunate ones; the Lord shall bless you with the most sublime status of Nirvaanaa. pMnw 997
lines.transliteration: jap har har kathaa vadbhaagee-aa har ut am pad  nirbaan ee.

lines.english: The minds of the Gurmukhs are filled with faith; through the Perfect Guru, they merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa man part eet hai gur poorai naam samaan ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਮਿਨ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: man mayray mai har har kathaa man bhaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Continually and forever, speak the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, speakthe Unspoken Speech. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa nit sad aa kar gurmukh  akath kahaan ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਿਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have searched through and through my mind and body; how can I attain thisUnspoken Speech?
lines.transliteration: mai man tan kh oj dhandholi-aa ki-o paa-ee-ai akath kahaan ee.

lines.english: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found it; listening to the Unspoken Speech,my mind is pleased.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa mil paa-i-aa sun  akath kathaa man bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਿਜ ਢੰਢੋਿਲਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Support of my mind and body; I am united with the all- knowing Primal Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayrai man tan naam aDh aar har mai maylay purakh  sujaan ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੁਿਣ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the Primal Being, has united me with the Primal Lord God. Myconsciousness has merged into the supreme consciousness.
lines.transliteration: gur purkhai purakh  milaa-ay parabh  mil surt ee surat  samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I serve the Guru, and I have found my Lord, all-wise and all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur sayvi-aa har paa-i-aa sugh arh sujaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are very unfortunate; they pass their life-night in miseryand pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aag vihoon i-aa tin dukhee rain  vihaan ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੁਘੜ  ਸੁਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am just a meek beggar at Your Door, God; please, place the Ambrosial Word of YourBani in my mouth.
lines.transliteration: ham jaachik deen parabh  tayri-aa mukh  deejai amrit  banee.

lines.english: The True Guru is my friend; He unites me with my all-wise, all-knowing Lord God.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa mit ar parabh  har maylhu sugh arh sujaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਿਰਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਦੀਜੈ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; grant Your Grace, and merge me intoYour Name. ||4||3||5|| mwrU mhlw 4 ] (997-8) maaroo mehlaa 4. Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sarnaagat ee kar kirpaa naam samaan ee. ||4||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਘੜ  ਸੁਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Detached from the world, I am in love with the Lord; by great good fortune, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: har bhaa-o lagaa bairaagee-aa vadbh aagee har man raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, faith has welled up within me; through theWord of the Guru's Shabad, I taste the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil sangat sarDh aa oopjai gur sabd ee har ras chaakh .

lines.english: My mind and body have totally blossomed forth; through the Word of the Guru's Bani,I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh man t an hari-aa ho-i-aa gurbaan ee har gun  bhaakh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਾਉ ਲਗਾ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: O my beloved mind, my friend, taste the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord,Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man pi-aari-aa mitraa har har naam ras chaakh .

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਰਧਾ  ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, I have found the Lord, who saves my honor, here andhereafter. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har paa-i-aa halat palat  pat raakh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, taste the Kirtan of theLord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai har keerat  gurmukh  chaakh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ਿਮਤਰ੍ਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Plant the seed of the Lord in the body-farm. The Lord God is enshrined within theSangat, the Holy Congregation.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh artee har beejee-ai vich sangat  har parabh  raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Through the Perfect Guru, tastethe sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit har har naam hai gur poorai har ras chaakh . ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are filled with hunger and thirst; their minds run around in the ten directions, hoping for great wealth.
lines.transliteration: manmukh t arisnaa bh ar rahay man aasaa d ah dis baho laakh .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, their life is cursed; the manmukhs are stuck in manure.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai Dharig jeevd ay vich bistaa manmukh  raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਬੀਜੀਐ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: They come and go, and are consigned to wander through uncounted incarnations,eating stinking rot. ||3||
lines.transliteration: o-ay aavahi jaahi bhavaa-ee-ah baho jonee d urganDh  bhaakh. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Begging, imploring, I seek Your Sanctuary; Lord, shower me with Your Mercy, andsave me, God.
lines.transliteration: taraahi t araahi sarn aagat ee har d a-i-aa Dh aar parabh  raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਨ ਆਸਾ  ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਖੁ  ॥
lines.english: Lead me to join the Society of the Saints, and bless me with the honor and glory ofthe Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: santsangat  maylaap kar har naam milai pat  saakh .

lines.english: I have obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; servant Nanak chantsthe Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||4||4||6|| mwrU mhlw 4 Gru 5  (997-17) maaroo mehlaa 4 ghar 5 Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (997-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhan paa-i-aa jan naanak gurmat  bhaakh. ||4||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਆਵਿਹ ਜਾਿਹ  ਭਵਾਈਅਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ  ਭਾਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Devotional worship to the Lord, Har, Har, is an overflowing treasure.
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat  bharay bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is emancipated by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam karay nist aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਲਾਪੁ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਪਿਤ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by the Mercy of my Lord and Master sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay mayraa su-aamee so har kay gun gaavai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, take pity on me,
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karay banvaalee.
har hirdai sad aa sad aa samaalee. that within my heart, I may dwell upon You, Lord, forever and ever.

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; chanting the Name of the Lord,Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 998
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu mayray jee-arhay jap har har naam chh adaavai jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the ocean of peace.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar amrit  har naa-o.

lines.english: The beggar begs for it; O Lord, please bless him, in Your kindness.
lines.transliteration: mangat jan jaachai har d ayh pasaa-o.

lines.english: True, True is the Lord; the Lord is forever True; the True Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har sat sat  sadaa har sat  har sat  mayrai man bh aavai jee-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਗਤ  ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਸਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The nine holes pour out filth.
lines.transliteration: navay chhid ar sarveh apvit raa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are all purified and sanctified.
lines.transliteration: bol har naam pavitar sabh  kitaa.

lines.english: When my Lord and Master is totally pleased, He leads the mortal to meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and then his filth is taken away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay har suparsan hovai mayraa su-aamee har simrat mal leh jaavai jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Attachment to Maya is terribly treacherous.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh bikham hai bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਮਲੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: How can one cross over the difficult world-ocean?
lines.transliteration: ki-o taree-ai d utar sansaaree.

lines.english: The True Lord bestows the boat of the True Guru; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har,one is carried across. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur bohith d ay-ay parabh  saachaa jap har har paar langh aavai jee-o. ||4||

lines.english: You are everywhere; all are Yours.
lines.transliteration: too sarbat ar tayraa sabh  ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਵੈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Whatever You do, God, that alone comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi so-ee parabh  ho-ee.

lines.english: Poor servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; as it pleases the Lord, Hebestows His approval. ||5||1||7|| mwrU mhlw 4 ] (998-7) maaroo mehlaa 4. Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai baychaaraa har bh aavai har thaa-ay paavai jee-o. ||5||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mayray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਬੇਚਾਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord shall eradicate all your sins.
lines.transliteration: sabh kilvikh  kaatai har t ayray.

lines.english: Treasure the Lord's wealth, and gather in the Lord's wealth; when you depart in theend, the Lord shall go along with you as your only friend and companion. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har Dhan raakh o har Dh an sanchahu har chald i-aa naal sakh aa-ee jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He alone meditates on the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay so Dhi-aavai.

lines.english: He continually chants the Lord's Chant; meditating on the Lord, one finds peace.
lines.transliteration: nit har jap jaapai jap har sukh  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਸਖਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meditating on the Lord,Har, Har, one is carried across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har ras aavai jap har har paar langhaa-ee jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The fearless, formless Lord - the Name is Truth.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar sat  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: To chant it is the most sublime and exalted activity in this world.
lines.transliteration: jag meh saraysat ootam kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Doing so, the Messenger of Death, the evil enemy, is killed. Death does not even approach the Lord's servant. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dusman d oot jamkaal th ayh maara-o har sayvak nayrh  na jaa-ee jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: One whose mind is satisfied with the Lord
lines.transliteration: jis upar har kaa man maani-aa.
so sayvak chahu jug chahu kunt jaani-aa. - that servant is known throughout the four ages, in all four directions.

lines.english: If some sinner speaks evil of him, the Messenger of Death chews him up. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jay us kaa buraa kahai ko-ee paapee tis jamkankar kh aa-ee jee-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਮਨ  ਦੂਤ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਠੇਹ ਮਾਰਉ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਕ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One Pure Creator Lord is in all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ayk niranjan kart aa.

lines.english: He stages all His wondrous plays, and watches them.
lines.transliteration: sabh kar kar vaykh ai apn ay chalt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Who can kill that person, whom the Lord has saved? The Creator Lord Himself delivers him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jis har raakhai t is ka-un  maarai jis kart aa aap chh adaa-ee jee-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਪੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਖਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I chant the Name of the Creator Lord, night and day.
lines.transliteration: ha-o an-din naam la-ee kart aaray.

lines.english: He saves all His servants and devotees.
lines.transliteration: jin sayvak bhagat  sabh ay nist aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ  ਚਲਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Consult the eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas; O servant Nanak, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, will deliver you. ||5||2||8|| mwrU mhlw 5 Gru 2  (998-16) maaroo mehlaa 5 ghar 2 Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (998-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: das ath  chaar vayd  sabh  poochh ahu jan naanak naam chh adaa-ee jee-o. ||5||2||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ  ਮਾਰੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਛਡਾਈ  ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The earth, the Akaashic ethers and the stars abide in the Fear of God. The almightyOrder of the Lord is over the heads of all.
lines.transliteration: darpai Dharat  akaas nakh -yataraa sir oopar amar karaaraa.

lines.english: Wind, water and fire abide in the Fear of God; poor Indra abides in the Fear of God aswell. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant ar darpai darpai ind ar bichaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: I have heard one thing, that the One Lord alone is fearless.
lines.transliteration: aykaa nirbha-o baat  sunee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਚਾਿਰ  ਵੇਦ ਸਿਭ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥੨॥੮॥
lines.english: He alone is at peace, and he alone is embellished forever, who meets with the Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so sukhee-aa so sad aa suhaylaa jo gur mil gaa-ay gunee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The embodied and the divine beings abide in the Fear of God. The Siddhas andseekers die in the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: dayhDh aar ar d ayvaa darpahi siDh  saaDh ik dar mu-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਡਰਪੈ  ਧਰਿਤ  ਅਕਾਸੁ  ਨਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਤਰ੍ਾ  ਿਸਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The 8.4 millions species of beings die, and die again, and are born over and over again. They are consigned to reincarnation. ||2|| pMnw 999
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh mar mar janmay fir fir jonee jo-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who embody the energies of sattva-white light, raajas-red passion, and taamas-black darkness, abide in the Fear of God, along with the many created forms.
lines.transliteration: raajas saatak t aamas darpahi kayt ay roop upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਸੁ  ਸਾਤਕੁ  ਤਾਮਸੁ  ਡਰਪਿਹ  ਕੇਤੇ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: This miserable deceiver Maya abides in the Fear of God; the Righteous Judge ofDharma is utterly afraid of Him as well. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhal bapuree ih ka-ulaa darpai at  darpai Dh aram raa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਛਲ ਬਪੁਰੀ  ਇਹ ਕਉਲਾ  ਡਰਪੈ  ਅਿਤ ਡਰਪੈ  ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The entire expanse of the Universe is in the Fear of God; only the Creator Lord iswithout this Fear.
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree dareh bi-aapee bin dar karnaihaaraa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God is the companion of His devotees; His devotees look beautiful in theCourt of the Lord. ||4||1|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (999-3) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhagt an kaa sangee bh agat soheh d arbaaraa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਦਰਬਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The five year old orphan boy Dhroo, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord,became stationary and permanent.
lines.transliteration: paaNch barakh ko anaath Dh aroo baarik har simrat  amar ataaray.

lines.english: For the sake of his son, Ajaamal called out, "O Lord, Naaraayan", who struck down and killed the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: putar hayt  naaraa-in  kahi-o jamkankar maar bid aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਚ ਬਰਖ  ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥੁ  ਧਰ੍ੂ ਬਾਿਰਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਅਮਰ ਅਟਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master has saved many, countless beings.
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur kayt ay agnat  uDhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਹੇਿਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ  ਕਿਹਓ  ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am meek, with little or no understanding, and unworthy; I seek protection at theLord's Door. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen alap mat  nirgun  pari-o saran  du-aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Baalmeek the outcaste was saved, and the poor hunter was saved as well.
lines.transliteration: baalmeek supchaaro tari-o baDh ik taray bichaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਨ  ਅਲਪ  ਮਿਤ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The elephant remembered the Lord in his mind for an instant, and so was carriedacross. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayk nimakh man maahi araaDh i-o gajpat  paar ut aaray. ||2||

lines.english: He saved His devotee Prahlaad, and tore Harnaakhash with his nails.
lines.transliteration: keenee rakhi-aa bh agat parhilaad ai harnaakh as nakh eh bid aaray.

lines.english: Bidar, the son of a slave-girl, was purified, and all his generations were redeemed.||3||
lines.transliteration: bidar d aasee sut  bha-i-o puneet aa saglay kul ujaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਅਰਾਿਧਓ  ਗਜਪਿਤ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: What sins of mine should I speak of? I am intoxicated with false emotionalattachment.
lines.transliteration: kavan paraaDh bat aava-o apunay mithi-aa moh magnaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਨੀ  ਰਿਖਆ  ਭਗਤ ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦੈ  ਹਰਨਾਖਸ  ਨਖਿਹ  ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord; please, reach out and take me into Your embrace. ||4||2|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (999-9) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aa-i-o saam naanak ot har kee leejai bhujaa pasaaray. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੁਤੁ ਭਇਓ  ਪੁਨੀਤਾ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੁਲ ਉਜਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: For the sake of riches, I wandered around in so many ways; I rushed around, makingall sorts of efforts.
lines.transliteration: vit navit  bharmi-o baho bh aatee anik jat an kar Dh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ ਪਰਾਧ  ਬਤਾਵਉ  ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The deeds I did in egotism and pride, have all been done in vain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jo karam kee-ay ha-o ha-umai tay t ay bh a-ay ajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਓ  ਸਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਟ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ  ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Other days are of no use to me;
lines.transliteration: avar din kaahoo kaaj na laa-ay.
so din mo ka-o d eejai parabh  jee-o jaa d in har jas gaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. please bless me with those days, O Dear God, on which I may sing the Lord's Praises.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਤ ਨਿਵਤ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮਓ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਧਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon children, spouse, household and possessions, one is entangled in these.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar garih d aykh pasaaraa is hee meh urjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ  ਕੀਏ ਹਉ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਜਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tasting the wine of Maya, one is intoxicated, and never sings of the Lord, Har, Har.||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mad chaakh  bha-ay ud maatay har har kabahu na gaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: In this way, I have examined lots of methods, but without the Saints, it is not found.
lines.transliteration: ih biDh kh ojee baho parkaaraa bin sant an nahee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਦਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਜਾ ਿਦਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Great Giver, the great and almighty God; I have come to beg a gift from You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tum d aataar vaday parabh  samrath maagan ka-o d aan aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Abandoning all pride and self-importance, I have sought the Sanctuary of the dust ofthe feet of the Lord's slave.
lines.transliteration: ti-aagi-o saglaa maan maht aa daas rayn  sarnaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਦੇਿਖ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਉਰਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, meeting with the Lord, I have become one with Him; I have foundsupreme bliss and peace. ||4||3|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (999-14) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har mil bha-ay aykai mahaa anand sukh  paa-ay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਦ ਚਾਿਖ  ਭਏ ਉਦਮਾਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In what place is the Name established? Where does egotism dwell?
lines.transliteration: kavan thaan Dheeri-o hai naamaa kavan basat  ahaNkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਖੋਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: What injury have you suffered, listening to abuse from someone else's mouth? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kavan chihan sun oopar chhohi-o mukh  tay sun kar gaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤਾਰ  ਵਡੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਮਰ੍ਥ  ਮਾਗਨ  ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen: who are you, and where did you come from?
lines.transliteration: sunhu ray too ka-un kahaa t ay aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਿਗਓ  ਸਗਲਾ  ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤਾ  ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣ ਸਰਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: You don't even know how long you will stay here; you have no hint of when you shallleave. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aytee na jaan-o kayt eek mud at chalt ay kh abar na paa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਭਏ ਏਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Wind and water have patience and tolerance; the earth has compassion andforgiveness, no doubt.
lines.transliteration: sahan seel pavan ar paanee basuDh aa kh imaa nibh raatay.

lines.english: The union of the five tattvas - the five elements - has brought you into being. Which of these is evil? ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch tat  mil bh a-i-o sanjogaa in meh kavan d uraatay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਥਾਨ ਧੀਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ਨਾਮਾ  ਕਵਨ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, formed your form; He also burdened youwith egotism.
lines.transliteration: jin rach rachi-aa purakh biDh aatai naalay ha-umai paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਿਚਹਨ  ਸੁਿਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਛੋਿਹਓ  ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸੁਿਨ ਕਿਰ ਗਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone is born and dies; He alone comes and goes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam maran us hee ka-o hai ray ohaa aavai jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing of the color and the form of the creation shall remain; the entire expanse istransitory.
lines.transliteration: baran chihan naahee kichh rachnaa mithi-aa sagal pasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ  ਕੇਤੀਕ  ਮੁਦਿਤ  ਚਲਤੇ  ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, when He brings His play to its close, then only the One, the One Lord remains. ||4||4|| pMnw 1000 mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1000-1) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak jab kh ayl ujh aarai t ab aykai aykankaaraa. ||4||4||

lines.english: Pride, emotional attachment, greed and corruption are gone; I have not placedanything else, other than the Lord, within my consciousness.
lines.transliteration: maan moh ar lobh vikaaraa bee-o cheet  na gh aali-o.

lines.english: I have purchased the jewel of the Naam and the Glorious Praises of the Lord; loadingthis merchandise, I have set out on my journey. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam ratan gun aa har ban jay laad  vakh ar lai chaali-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਿਵਕਾਰਾ  ਬੀਓ ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਘਾਿਲਓ  ॥
lines.english: The love which the Lord's servant feels for the Lord lasts forever.
lines.transliteration: sayvak kee orhak nibhee pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਬਣਜੇ  ਲਾਿਦ  ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਾਿਲਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In my life, I served my Lord and Master, and as I depart, I keep Him enshrined in my consciousness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeevat saahib sayvi-o apnaa chalt ay raakh i-o cheet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have not turned my face away from my Lord and Master's Command.
lines.transliteration: jaisee aagi-aa keenee thaakur t is tay mukh  nahee mori-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਚਲਤੇ  ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਚੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He fills my household with celestial peace and bliss; if He asks me to leave, I leave at once. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahj anand rakhi-o garih bh eetar uth  u-aahoo ka-o d a-ori-o. ||2||

lines.english: When I am under the Lord's Command, I find even hunger pleasurable; I know nodifference between sorrow and joy.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa meh bhookh  so-ee kar sookh aa sog harakh  nahee jaani-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਿਤਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Command of my Lord and Master is, I bow my forehead and accept it.||3||
lines.transliteration: jo jo hukam bha-i-o saahib kaa so maathai lay maani-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੁ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਰਿਖਓ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਉਿਠ ਉਆਹੂ ਕਉ ਦਉਿਰਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master has become merciful to His servant; He has embellished boththis world and the next.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal th aakur sayvak ka-o savray halat  palaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਗਆ  ਮਿਹ ਭੂਖ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਰ ਸੂਖਾ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan sayvak safal oh aa-i-aa jin naanak kh asam pachh aataa. ||4||5|| Blessed is that servant, and fruitful is his birth; O Nanak, he realizes his Lord andMaster. ||4||5|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1000-7) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਓ  ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕਾ ਸੋ ਮਾਥੈ ਲੇ ਮਾਿਨਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Good karma has dawned for me - my Lord and Master has become merciful. I sing theKirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: khuli-aa karam kirpaa bh a-ee th aakur keert an har har gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਉ ਸਵਰੇ  ਹਲਤ  ਪਲਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: My struggle is ended; I have found peace and tranquility. All my wanderings haveceased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saram thaakaa paa-ay bisraamaa mit ga-ee saglee Dhaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਓਹੁ ਆਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Now, I have obtained the state of eternal life.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi jeevan padvee paa-ee.

lines.english: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has come into my conscious mind; I seekthe Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: cheet aa-i-o man purakh  biDhaataa sant an kee sarn aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਿਲਆ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਭਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are eradicated; all my enemiesare eliminated.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh nivaaray nivray sagal bairaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਥਾਕਾ  ਪਾਏ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮਾ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ  ਧਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is always ever-present, here and now, watching over me; He is never far away.||2||
lines.transliteration: sad hajoor haajar hai naajar kat eh na bh a-i-o d ooraa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: In peace and cool tranquility, my faith has been totally fulfilled; the Saints are myHelpers and Support.
lines.transliteration: sukh seet al sarDh aa sabh  pooree ho-ay sant  sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਇਓ ਮਿਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has purified the sinners in an instant; I cannot express His Glorious Praises. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paavan patit  kee-ay kh in bheetar mahimaa kathan na jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: I have become fearless; all fear has departed. The feet of the Lord of the Universe are my only Shelter.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay sagal bh ai kho-ay gobid  charan  otaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਿਨਵਰੇ  ਸਗਲ ਬੈਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak sings the Praises of his Lord and Master; night and day, he is lovingly focusedon Him. ||4||6|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1000-12) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jas gaavai thaakur kaa rain  dinas liv laa-ee. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ਹਾਜਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਭਇਓ  ਦੂਰਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is all-powerful, the Master of all virtues, but you never sing of Him!
lines.transliteration: jo samrath sarab gun naa-ik t is ka-o kabahu na gaavas ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਤਲ  ਸਰਧਾ  ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You shall have to leave all this in an instant, but again and again, you chase after it.||1||
lines.transliteration: chhod jaa-ay kh in bheetar taa ka-o u-aa ka-o fir fir Dh aavas ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਨ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਕੀਏ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Why do you not contemplate your God?
lines.transliteration: apunay parabh ka-o ki-o na samaaras ray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਸਗਲ  ਭੈ ਖੋਏ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਚਰਣ  ਓਟਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You are entangled in association with your enemies, and the enjoyment of pleasures;your soul is burning up with them! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bairee sang rang ras rachi-aa tis si-o jee-araa jaaras ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਾ ਰੈਿਣ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Hearing His Name, the Messenger of Death will release you, and yet, you do not enterHis Sanctuary!
lines.transliteration: jaa kai naam suni-ai jam chhodai t aa kee saran  na paavas ray.

lines.english: Turn out this wretched jackal, and seek the Shelter of that God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaadh d ay-ay si-aal bapuray ka-o t aa kee ot tikaavas ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕੁ  ਿਤਸ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Praising Him, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and yet, you have not fallen in love with Him!
lines.transliteration: jis kaa jaas sunat bh av taree-ai t aa si-o rang na laavas ray.

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਜਾਇ  ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਉਆ  ਕਉ ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ  ਧਾਵਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: This meager, short-lived dream, this thing - you are engrossed in it, over and overagain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: thoree baat alap supnay kee bahur bahur atkaavas ray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਿਕਉ  ਨ ਸਮਾਰਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: When our Lord and Master, the ocean of mercy, grants His Grace, one finds honor inthe Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o parsaad  kirpaa niDh  thaakur sat sang pat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰੰਗ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਚਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਸਉ ਜੀਅਰਾ  ਜਾਰਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am rid of the illusion of the three-phased Maya, when God becomes myhelp and support. ||4||7|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1000-19) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tarai gun  bharam chh ootaa ja-o parabh  bha-ay sahaa-ee. ||4||7||

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; what can anyone hidefrom Him?
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee sabh  biDh jaanai t is tay kahaa d ulaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਿਨਐ  ਜਮੁ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਸ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Your hands and feet will fall off in an instant, when you are burnt in the fire. ||1|| pMnw 1001
lines.transliteration: hasat paav jh aray kh in bheetar agan sang lai jaari-o. ||1||

lines.english: You fool, you have forgotten the Lord from your mind!
lines.transliteration: moorhay t ai man t ay raam bisaari-o.

lines.english: You eat His salt, and then you are untrue to Him; before your very eyes, you shall be torn apart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: loon kh aa-ay karahi haraamkh oree paykh at nain bid aari-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲੂਣੁ ਖਾਇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੀ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਨੈਨ ਿਬਦਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The incurable disease has arisen in your body; it cannot be removed or overcome.
lines.transliteration: asaaDh rog upji-o t an bh eetar tarat  na kaahoo taari-o.

lines.english: Forgetting God, one endures utter agony; this is the essence of reality which Nanakhas realized. ||2||8|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1001-3) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh bisrat  mahaa d ukh paa-i-o ih naanak t at beechaari-o. ||2||8||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਾਧ  ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਤਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਟਰਤ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਟਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: I have enshrined the lotus feet of God within my consciousness.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal parabh raakh ay cheet .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ॥੨॥੮॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, continually, continuously.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavah neet aa neet .

lines.english: There is none other than Him at all.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa avar na ko-oo.

lines.english: He alone exists, in the beginning, in the middle, and in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant hai so-oo. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself is the Shelter of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: santan kee ot aapay aap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The entire universe is under His control.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai vas hai sagal sansaar.

lines.english: He Himself, the Formless Lord, is Himself by Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap aap nirankaar.

lines.english: Nanak holds tight to that True Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak gahi-o saachaa so-ay.

lines.english: He has found peace, and shall never suffer pain again. ||2||9|| mwrU mhlw 5 Gru 3  (1001-7) maaroo mehlaa 5 ghar 3 Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1001-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-aa fir d ookh na ho-ay. ||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is the Giver of peace to the breath of life, the Giver of life to the soul; how can youforget Him, you ignorant person?
lines.transliteration: paraan sukh-d aata jee-a sukh -daata tum kaahay bisaari-o agi-aanath.

lines.english: You taste the weak, insipid wine, and you have gone insane. You have uselesslywasted this precious human life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hochhaa mad  chaakh  ho-ay t um baavar d ulabh  janam akaarath. ||1||

lines.english: O man, such is the foolishness you practice.
lines.transliteration: ray nar aisee karahi i-aanath.

lines.english: Renouncing the Lord, the Support of the earth, you wander, deluded by doubt; youare engrossed in emotional attachment, associating with Maya, the slave-girl.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taj sarangDh ar bharam t oo bh oolaa mohi lapti-o d aasee sang saanath. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dharn eeDhar ti-aag neech kul sayveh ha-o ha-o karat  bihaavath. Abandoning the Lord, the Support of the earth, you serve her of lowly ancestry, andyou pass you life acting egotistically.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਿਬਸਾਿਰਓ  ਅਿਗਆਨਥ  ॥
lines.english: You do useless deeds, you ignorant person; this is why you are called a blind, self-willed manmukh. ||2||
lines.transliteration: fokat karam karahi agi-aanee manmukh anDh  kahaavath. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਛਾ ਮਦੁ ਚਾਿਖ  ਹੋਏ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਦੁਲਭ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਕਾਰਥ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That which is true, you believe to be untrue; what is transitory, you believe to bepermanent.
lines.transliteration: sat hot aa asat  kar maani-aa jo binsat  so nihchal jaanath.

lines.english: You grasp as your own, what belongs to others; in such delusions you are deluded.||3||
lines.transliteration: par kee ka-o apnee kar pakree aisay bhool bh ulaanath. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਸਾਰੰਗਧਰ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਤੂ ਭੂਲਾ ਮੋਿਹ ਲਪਿਟਓ ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਨਥ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas all cross over, through the Nameof the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: khatree baraahman  sood  vais sabh  aykai naam t araanath.

lines.english: Guru Nanak speaks the Teachings; whoever listens to them is carried across.||4||1||10|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1001-14) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak updays kahat  hai jo sunai so paar paraanath. ||4||1||10||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਹਾਵਥ  ॥
lines.english: You may act in secrecy, but God is still with you; you can only deceive other people.
lines.transliteration: gupat kart aa sang so parabh  dehkaava-ay manukh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਫੋਕਟ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਧ ਕਹਾਵਥ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Forgetting your Dear Lord, you enjoy corrupt pleasures, and so you shall have toembrace red-hot pillars. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bisaar har jee-o bikhai bh ogeh t apat thamm gal laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਹੋਤਾ ਅਸਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਜੋ ਿਬਨਸਤ ਸੋ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਜਾਨਥ  ॥
lines.english: O man, why do you go out to the households of others?
lines.transliteration: ray nar kaa-ay par garihi jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੀ  ਕਿਰ ਪਕਰੀ  ਐਸੇ ਭੂਲ ਭੁਲਾਨਥ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You filthy, heartless, lustful donkey! Haven't you heard of the Righteous Judge ofDharma? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kuchal kathor kaam garDh abh tum nahee suni-o Dh aram raa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣ  ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰਾਨਥ  ॥
lines.english: The stone of corruption is tied around your neck, and the load of slander is on yourhead.
lines.transliteration: bikaar paathar galeh baaDhay nind  pot siraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਕਹਤੁ  ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਨਥ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: You must cross over the vast open ocean, but you cannot cross over to the other side.||2||
lines.transliteration: mahaa saagar samud langh naa paar na parnaa jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: You are engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment; you haveturned your eyes away from the Truth.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mohi bi-aapi-o nayt ar rakh ay firaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਡਹਕਾਵਏ  ਮਨੁਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You cannot even raise your head above the water of the vast, impassable sea of Maya. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sees uthaavan na kabhoo mil-ee mahaa d utar maa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਾਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਬਖੈ ਭੋਗਿਹ  ਤਪਤ ਥੰਮ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sun is liberated, and the moon is liberated; the God-realized being is pure anduntouched.
lines.transliteration: soor muktaa sasee mukt aa barahm gi-aanee alipaa-ay.

lines.english: His inner nature is like that of fire, untouched and forever immaculate. ||4||
lines.transliteration: subhaavat  jaisay baisant ar alipat  sadaa niramlaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਚਲ  ਕਠੋਰ  ਕਾਿਮ  ਗਰਧਭ  ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਿਨਓ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When good karma dawns, the wall of doubt is torn down. He lovingly accepts the Guru's Will. pMnw 1002
lines.transliteration: jis karam khuli-aa t is lahi-aa parh -daa jin gur peh mani-aa subh aa-ay.

lines.english: One who is blessed with the medicine of the GurMantra, the Name of the Lord, O servant Nanak, does not suffer the agonies of reincarnation. ||5||2||
lines.transliteration: gur mantar avkh aDh naam d eenaa jan naanak sankat jon na paa-ay. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: O man, in this way, you shall cross over to the other side.
lines.transliteration: ray nar in biDh paar paraa-ay.

lines.english: Dhi-aa-ay har jee-o ho-ay mirt ak ti-aag d oojaa bh aa-o. rahaa-o d oojaa. ||2||11|| Meditate on your Dear Lord, and be dead to the world; renounce your love of duality.||Second Pause||2||11|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1002-3) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
I have quit searching outside; the Guru has shown me that God is within the home of my own heart.
lines.transliteration: baahar dhoodh an tay chh oot paray gur gh ar hee maahi d ikhaa-i-aa thaa.

lines.english: ||1|| I have seen God, fearless, of wondrous beauty; my mind shall never leave Him to goanywhere else. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anbha-o achraj roop parabh  paykh i-aa mayraa man chh od na kat hoo jaa-i-aa thaa.

lines.english: I have found the jewel; I have found the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: maanak paa-i-o ray paa-i-o har pooraa paa-i-aa thaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਢੂਢਨ  ਤੇ ਛੂਿਟ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥
lines.english: The invaluable value cannot be obtained; in His Mercy, the Guru bestows it.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mol amol na paa-i-aa jaa-ee kar kirpaa guroo divaa-i-aa thaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਭਉ  ਅਚਰਜ  ਰੂਪੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੇਿਖਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is imperceptible and unfathomable; meeting the Holy Saint, Ispeak the Unspoken Speech.
lines.transliteration: adisat agochar paarbarahm mil saaDh oo akath kathaa-i-aa thaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਕੁ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥
lines.english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Naam trickles down there. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  dasam d u-aar vaji-o t ah amrit  naam chu-aa-i-aa thaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਲ ਅਮੋਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਈ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਦਵਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I lack nothing; the thirsty desires of my mind are satisfied. The inexhaustible treasurehas entered into my being.
lines.transliteration: tot naahee man t arisnaa boojh ee akh ut bhandaar samaa-i-aa thaa.

lines.english: I serve the feet, the feet, the feet of the Guru, and manage the unmanageable. I havefound the juice, the sublime essence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan charan  charan  gur sayvay agh arh gharhi-o ras paa-i-aa thaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਦਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਅਕਥੁ  ਕਥਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥
lines.english: Intuitively I come, and intuively I go; my mind intuitively plays.
lines.transliteration: sehjay aavaa sehjay jaavaa sehjay man khaylaa-i-aa thaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਦਸਮ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਵਿਜਓ  ਤਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, when the Guru drives out doubt, then the soul-bride enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||3||12|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1002-9) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bharam gur kh o-i-aa t aa har mahlee mahal paa-i-aa thaa. ||4||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਿਟ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਿਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਬੂਝੀ ਅਖੁਟ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥
lines.english: You feel no love for the One who created and embellished you.
lines.transliteration: jisahi saaj nivaaji-aa tiseh si-o ruch naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਚਰਣ  ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਘੜੁ  ਘਿੜਓ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The seed, planted out season, does not germinate; it does not produce flower or fruit.||1||
lines.transliteration: aan rootee aan bo-ee-ai fal na foolai t aahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਆਵਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਜਾਵਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥
lines.english: O mind, this is the time to plant the seed of the Name.
lines.transliteration: ray man vatar beejan  naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਖੋਇਆ  ਤਾ ਹਿਰ ਮਹਲੀ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਥਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Focus your mind, and cultivate this crop; at the proper time, make this your purpose.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bo-ay khayt ee laa-ay manoo-aa bh alo sama-o su-aa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Eradicate the stubbornness and doubt of your mind, and go to the Sanctuary of theTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: kho-ay kh ahrhaa bh aram man kaa sat gur sarn ee jaa-ay.

lines.english: He alone does such deeds, who has such pre-ordained karma. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karam jis ka-o Dharahu likh i-aa so-ee kaar kamaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਰੂਤੀ ਆਨ  ਬੋਈਐ  ਫਲੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੈ ਤਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He falls in love with the Lord of the Universe, and his efforts are approved.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o laagaa gobid  si-o gh aal paa-ee thaa-ay.

lines.english: My crop has germinated, and it shall never be used up. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khayt  mayrai jammi-aa nikh ut na kabhoo jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਇ ਖੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ  ਮਨੂਆ ਭਲੋ ਸਮਉ  ਸੁਆਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have obtained the priceless wealth, which shall never leave me or go anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa amol padaaratho chh od na kat hoo jaa-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found peace; I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||4||13|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1002-15) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sukh paa-i-aa t aripat  rahay aagh aa-ay. ||4||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਇ ਖਹੜਾ ਭਰਮੁ  ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The egg of doubt has burst; my mind has been enlightened.
lines.transliteration: footo aaNdaa bharam kaa maneh bh a-i-o pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਿਜਸ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has shattered the shackles on my feet, and has set me free. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaatee bayree pagah tay gur keenee band  khalaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਉ ਲਾਗਾ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਿਸਉ ਘਾਲ  ਪਾਈ  ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਿਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੰਿਮਆ  ਿਨਖੁਿਟ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The boiling cauldron has cooled down; the Guru has blessed me with the cooling,soothing Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tapat karhaahaa bujh  ga-i-aa gur seet al naam d ee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮੋਲੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੋ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Since I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, those who were eyeing me have left.
lines.transliteration: jab tay saaDh oo sang bh a-i-aa t a-o chh od ga-ay nighaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The one who tied me up, has released me; what can the Watchman of Death do tome now? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis kee atak tis t ay chh utee t a-o kahaa karai kotvaar. ||2||

lines.english: The load of my karma has been removed, and I am now free of karma.
lines.transliteration: chookaa bhaaraa karam kaa ho-ay nihkarmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਫੂਟੋ ਆਂਡਾ  ਭਰਮ  ਕਾ ਮਨਿਹ  ਭਇਓ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: I have crossed the world-ocean, and reached the other shore; the Guru has blessedme with this Dharma. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saagar tay kandh ai charh ay gur keenay Dh armaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਟੀ  ਬੇਰੀ ਪਗਹ  ਤੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਨੀ  ਬੰਿਦ ਖਲਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True is my place, and True is my seat; I have made Truth my life's purpose.
lines.transliteration: sach thaan sach baithkaa sach su-aa-o ban aa-i-aa.

lines.english: True is my capital, and True is the merchandise, which Nanak has placed into thehome of the heart. ||4||5||14|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1002-19) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 1003
lines.transliteration: sach poonjee sach vakhro naanak gh ar paa-i-aa. ||4||5||14||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ  ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਤ  ਕਾਮਾਮਨ  ਕਾ ਮਾਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, proclaims the Vedas, but he is slow to act on them.
lines.transliteration: bayd pukaarai mukh  tay pandat  kaamaaman kaa maath aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਇਕਤੀ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕਲਪਨ  ਗਾਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Another person on silence sits alone, but his heart is tied in knots of desire.
lines.transliteration: monee ho-ay baithaa ikaaNtee hird ai kalpan gaath aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਤਿਜ  ਚਿਲਓ  ਛੁਟਕੈ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਠਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Another becomes an Udaasi, a renunciate; he abandons his home and walks out on his family, but his wandering impulses do not leave him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay udaasee garihu t aj chali-o chh utkai naahee naath aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਕੈ ਪਿਹ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਾ ॥
lines.english: Who can I tell about the state of my soul?
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee kai peh baat kahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਐਸੋ ਕਹਾ ਲਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where can I find such a person who is liberated, and who can unite me with my God?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap mukat mo ka-o parabh  maylay aiso kahaa lahaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Someone may practice intensive meditation, and discipline his body, but his mind stillruns around in ten directions.
lines.transliteration: tapsee kar kai d ayhee saaDh ee manoo-aa d ah dis Dhaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਪਸੀ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ  ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The celibate practices celibacy, but his heart is filled with pride.
lines.transliteration: barahmchaar barahmchaj keenaa hirdai bh a-i-aa gumaanaa.

lines.english: The Sannyaasi wanders around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but his mindless angeris still within him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sani-aasee ho-ay kai tirath bh armi-o us meh kroDh  bigaanaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮਓ  ਉਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਬਗਾਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The temple dancers tie bells around their ankles to earn their living.
lines.transliteration: ghoongar baaDh  bha-ay raamd aasaa rotee-an kay opaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘੂੰਘਰ  ਬਾਿਧ  ਭਏ ਰਾਮਦਾਸਾ  ਰੋਟੀਅਨ  ਕੇ ਓਪਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Others go on fasts, take vows, perform the six rituals and wear religious robes forshow.
lines.transliteration: barat naym karam kh at keenay baahar bh aykh dikhaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਕਰਮ  ਖਟ ਕੀਨੇ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭੇਖ ਿਦਖਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some sing songs and melodies and hymns, but their minds do not sing of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: geet naad  mukh  raag alaapay man nahee har har gaavaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ  ਮੁਿਖ ਰਾਗ ਅਲਾਪੇ  ਮਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਵਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's Saints are immaculately pure; they are beyond pleasure and pain, beyondgreed and attachment.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog lobh  moh rahat  heh nirmal har kay sant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ  ਹਿਹ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
lines.english: My mind obtains the dust of their feet, when the Lord God shows mercy.
lines.transliteration: tin kee Dh oorh paa-ay man mayraa jaa d a-i-aa karay bh agvant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਿੜ ਪਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I met the Perfect Guru, and then the anxiety of my mind was removed.||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur pooraa mili-aa taaN utree man kee chint aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਤ ਉਤਰੀ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: My Sovereign Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: mayraa antarjaamee har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: 5) sabh kichh  jaanai mayray jee-a kaa pareet am bisar ga-ay bakbaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o doojaa. ||6||15|| The Beloved of my soul knows everything; all trivial talk is forgotten. ||1||Second Pause||6||15|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1003-9) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਿਬਸਿਰ ਗਏ ਬਕਬਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who has Your Name in his heart is the king of all the hundreds of thousands andmillions of beings.
lines.transliteration: kot laakh sarab ko raajaa jis hird ai naam t umaaraa.

lines.english: Those, whom my True Guru has not blessed with Your Name, are poor idiots, who die and are reborn. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o naam na dee-aa mayrai sat gur say mar janmeh gaavaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: My True Guru protects and preserves my honor.
lines.transliteration: mayray satgur hee pat  raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਲਾਖ  ਸਰਬ  ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: When You come to mind, Lord, then I obtain perfect honor. Forgetting You, I roll inthe dust. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: cheet aavahi t ab hee pat  pooree bisrat  ralee-ai kh aak. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਦੀਆ  ਮੇਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੇ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਗਾਵਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mind's pleasures of love and beauty bring just as many blames and sins.
lines.transliteration: roop rang khusee-aa man bh ogan tay tay chh idar vikaaraa.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the treasure of Emancipation; it is absolute peace and poise.||2||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam niDhaan kali-aan aa sookh  sahj ih saaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਿਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਰਲੀਐ  ਖਾਕੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The pleasures of Maya fade away in an instant, like the shade of a passing cloud.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa rang birang khinai meh ji-o baad ar kee chh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: They alone are dyed in the deep crimson of the Lord's Love, who meet the Guru, andsing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say laal bha-ay goorh ai rang raat ay jin gur mil har har gaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਭੋਗਣ  ਤੇ ਤੇ ਿਛਦਰ੍  ਿਵਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is lofty and exalted, grand and infinite. The Darbaar of His Courtis inaccessible.
lines.transliteration: ooch mooch apaar su-aamee agam darbaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਕਿਲਆਣਾ  ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜੁ  ਇਹੁ ਸਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Naam, glorious greatness and respect are obtained; O Nanak, my Lord and Master is my Beloved. ||4||7||16|| mwrU mhlw 5 Gru 4  (1003-16) maaroo mehlaa 5 ghar 4 Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1003-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naamo vadi-aa-ee sobhaa naanak kh asam pi-aaraa. ||4||7||16||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਿਬਰੰਗ  ਿਖਨੈ ਮਿਹ ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਦਰ  ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The One Universal Creator Lord created the creation.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar utpaat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਲਾਲ  ਭਏ ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He made all the days and the nights.
lines.transliteration: kee-aa dinas sabh  raatee.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਗਮ  ਦਰਬਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The forests, meadows, three worlds, water,
lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan paan ee.
chaar bayd chaaray kh aanee. the four Vedas, the four sources of creation,
khand d eep sabh  lo-aa. the countries, the continents and all the worlds,
ayk kavaavai tay sabh  ho-aa. ||1|| have all come from the One Word of the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: Hey - understand the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: karnaihaaraa boojhhu ray.

lines.english: If you meet the True Guru, then you'll understand. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a soojh ai ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He formed the expanse of the entire universe from the three gunas, the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  kee-aa pasaaraa.

lines.english: People are incarnated in heaven and in hell.
lines.transliteration: narak surag avtaaraa.

lines.english: In egotism, they come and go.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai aavai jaa-ee.

lines.english: The mind cannot hold still, even for an instant. pMnw 1004
lines.transliteration: man tikan na paavai raa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo gubaaraa.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one is emancipated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mil satgur nist aaraa. ||2||

lines.english: All the deeds done in egotism,
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karam kamaanay.
tay tay banDh  galaan ay. are just chains around the neck.

lines.english: Harboring self-conceit and self-interest
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree Dhaaree.
ohaa pair lohaaree. is just like placing chains around one's ankles.

lines.english: He alone meets with the Guru, and realizes the One Lord,
lines.transliteration: so gur mil ayk pachhaan ai.
jis hovai bhaag mathaan ai. ||3|| who has such destiny written on his forehead. ||3||

lines.english: He alone meets the Lord, who is pleasing to His Mind.
lines.transliteration: so mili-aa je har man bhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He alone is deluded, who is deluded by God.
lines.transliteration: so bhoolaa je parabh oo bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: No one, by himself, is ignorant or wise.
lines.transliteration: nah aaphu moorakh gi-aanee.

lines.english: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord inspires to do so.
lines.transliteration: je karaavai so naam vakhaanee.

lines.english: You have no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: tayraa ant  na paaraavaaraa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||17|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1004-5) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaaraa. ||4||1||17||

lines.english: Maya, the enticer, has enticed the world of the three gunas, the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: mohnee mohi lee-ay tarai gunee-aa.

lines.english: The false world is engrossed in greed.
lines.transliteration: lobh vi-aapee jh oothee dunee-aa.

lines.english: Crying out, "Mine, mine!" they collect possessions, but in the end, they are alldeceived. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree kar kai sanchee ant kee baar sagal lay chh alee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord is fearless, formless and merciful.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o nirankaar d a-i-alee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਚੀ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਸਗਲ  ਲੇ ਛਲੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Cherisher of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant saglay part ipalee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some collect wealth, and bury it in the ground.
lines.transliteration: aykai saram kar gaadee gadhai.

lines.english: Some cannot abandon wealth, even in their dreams.
lines.transliteration: aykeh supnai daam na chh adhai.

lines.english: The king exercises his power, and fills his money-bags, but this fickle companion will not go along with him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raaj kamaa-ay karee jin thailee taa kai sang na chanchal chalee-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Some love this wealth even more than their body and breath of life.
lines.transliteration: aykeh paraan pind t ay pi-aaree.

lines.english: Some collect it, forsaking their fathers and mothers.
lines.transliteration: ayk sanchee taj baap meht aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ਕਰੀ ਿਜਿਨ ਥੈਲੀ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚੰਚਿਲ  ਚਲੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some hide it from their children, friends an d siblings, but it will not remain with them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sut meet  bharaat tay guhjee t aa kai nikat na ho-ee kh alee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Some become hermits, and sit in meditative trances.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay a-uDhoot  baith ay laa-ay t aaree.

lines.english: Some are Yogis, celibates, religious scholars and thinkers.
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee pandit  beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭਰ੍ਾਤ ਤੇ ਗੁਹਜੀ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਖਲੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Some dwell in homes, graveyards, cremation grounds and forests; but Maya still clingsto them there. ||4||
lines.transliteration: garihi marhee masaan ee ban meh bast ay ooth  tinaa kai laagee palee-aa. ||4||

lines.english: When the Lord and Master releases one from his bonds,
lines.transliteration: kaatay banDhan th aakur jaa kay.
har har naam basi-o jee-a taa kai. the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell in his soul.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ  ਬਨ ਮਿਹ ਬਸਤੇ  ਊਿਠ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੈ ਲਾਗੀ  ਪਲੀਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, His humble servants are liberated; O Nanak, they are redeemed and enraptured by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||5||2||18|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1004-12) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh a-ay jan mukt ay gat  paa-ee naanak nad ar nihlee-aa. ||5||2||18||

lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: simrahu ayk niranjan so-oo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਓ  ਜੀਅ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: No one is turned away from Him empty-handed.
lines.transliteration: jaa tay birthaa jaat  na ko-oo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਲੀਆ  ॥੫॥੨॥੧੮॥
lines.english: He cherished and preserved you in your mother's womb;
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  meh jin part ipaari-aa.

lines.english: He blessed you with body and soul, and embellished you.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind day saaj savaari-aa.

lines.english: Each and every instant, meditate on that Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: so-ee biDhaat aa kh in khin japee-ai.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all faults and mistakes are covered.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat avgun  sabh  dhakee-ai.

lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet deep within the nucleus of your self.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal ur ant ar Dh aarahu.

lines.english: Save your soul from the waters of corruption.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa ban t ay jee-o uDh aarahu.

lines.english: Your cries and shrieks shall be ended;
lines.transliteration: karan palaah miteh billaataa.
jap govid bh aram bh a-o faataa. meditating on the Lord of the Universe, your doubts and fears shall be dispelled.

lines.english: Rare is that being, who finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang virlaa ko paa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the support of my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: raam naam man tan aaDh aaraa.

lines.english: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo simrai tis kaa nist aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He believes that the false thing is true.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa vasat sat  kar maanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The ignorant fool falls in love with it.
lines.transliteration: hit laa-i-o sath  moorh  agi-aanee.

lines.english: He is intoxicated with the wine of sexual desire, anger and greed;
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mad maat aa.
ka-udee badlai janam gavaat aa. he loses this human life in exchance for a mere shell.

lines.english: He abandons his own, and loves that of others.
lines.transliteration: apnaa chhod paraa-i-ai raat aa.

lines.english: His mind and body are permeated with the intoxication of Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mad man t an sang jaat aa.

lines.english: His thirsty desires are not quenched, although he indulges in pleasures.
lines.transliteration: tarisan na boojh ai karat  kalolaa.

lines.english: His hopes are not fulfilled, and all his words are false.
lines.transliteration: oonee aas mithi-aa sabh  bolaa.

lines.english: He comes alone, and he goes alone. pMnw 1005
lines.transliteration: aavat ikaylaa jaat  ikaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਝੂਠੇ ਸਿਭ ਬੋਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: False is all his talk of me and you.
lines.transliteration: ham tum sang jh oothay sabh  bolaa.

lines.english: The Lord Himself administers the poisonous potion, to mislead and delude.
lines.transliteration: paa-ay thag-uree aap bh ulaa-i-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, the the karma of past actions cannot be erased. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak kirat na jaa-ay mitaa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: Beasts, birds, demons and ghosts
lines.transliteration: pas pankhee bh oot ar parayt aa.
baho biDh jonee firat  anayt aa. - in these many ways, the false wander in reincarnation.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Wherever they go, they cannot remain there.
lines.transliteration: jah jaano tah rahan na paavai.

lines.english: They have no place of rest; they rise up again and again and run around.
lines.transliteration: thaan bihoon uth uth  fir Dh aavai.

lines.english: Their minds and bodies are filled with immense, expansive desires.
lines.transliteration: man tan baasnaa bahut  bisthaaraa.

lines.english: The poor wretches are cheated by egotism.
lines.transliteration: ahaNmayv mootho baychaaraa.

lines.english: They are filled with countless sins, and are severely punished.
lines.transliteration: anik dokh  ar bahut  sajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The extent of this cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Forgetting God, they fall into hell.
lines.transliteration: parabh bisrat  narak meh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There are no mothers there, no siblings, no friends and no spouses.
lines.transliteration: tah maat  na banDh  na meet  na jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord and Master becomes Merciful,
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o hot kirpaal su-aamee.

lines.english: O Nanak, cross over. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so jan naanak paargaraamee. ||3||

lines.english: Rambling and roaming, wandering around, I came to seek the Sanctuary of God.
lines.transliteration: bharmat  bharmat  parabh  sarnee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is the Master of the meek, the father and mother of the world.
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath jagat  pit maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord God is the Destroyer of sorrow and suffering.
lines.transliteration: parabh d a-i-aal d ukh darad bidaaran .

lines.english: He emancipates whoever He pleases.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is hee nist aaran .

lines.english: He lifts them up and pulls him out of the deep dark pit.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay kaadh anhaaraa.

lines.english: Emancipation comes through loving devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  hovat  nistaaraa.

lines.english: The Holy Saint is the very embodiment of the Lord's form.
lines.transliteration: saaDh roop apnaa t an Dh aari-aa.

lines.english: He Himself saves us from the great fire.
lines.transliteration: mahaa agan tay aap ubaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਇਸ ਤੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: By myself, I cannot practice meditation, austerities, penance and self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam is t ay kichh  naahee.

lines.english: In the beginning and in the end, God is inaccessible and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: aad ant  parabh  agam agaahee.

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Name, Lord; Your slave begs only for this.
lines.transliteration: naam deh maagai d aas tayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਵਨ  ਪਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੯॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my Lord God is the Giver of the true state of life. ||4||3||19|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1005-10) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jeevan pad naanak parabh  mayraa. ||4||3||19||

lines.english: Why do you try to deceive others, O people of the world? The Fascinating Lord isMerciful to the meek. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kat ka-o dahkaavahu logaa mohan d een kirpaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਤ ਕਉ ਡਹਕਾਵਹੁ ਲੋਗਾ  ਮੋਹਨ  ਦੀਨ  ਿਕਰਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is what I have come to know.
lines.transliteration: aisee jaan paa-ee.

lines.english: The brave and heroic Guru, the Generous Giver, gives Sanctuary and preserves ourhonor. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saran sooro gur d aataa raakh ai aap vadaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੂਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਰਾਖੈ ਆਿਪ  ਵਡਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He submits to the Will of His devotees; He is forever and ever the Giver of peace.||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa aagi-aakaaree sad aa sad aa sukh -daa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may meditate on Your Name alone. ||3||
lines.transliteration: apnay ka-o kirpaa karee-ahu ik naam Dhi-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਾ ਆਿਗਆਕਾਰੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak, the meek and humble, begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it eradicates duality and doubt. ||4||4||20|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1005-13) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak deen naam maagai d utee-aa bh aram chukaa-ee. ||4||4||20||

lines.english: My Lord and Master is utterly powerful.
lines.transliteration: mayraa thaakur at  bhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦੀਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗੈ  ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੦॥
lines.english: I am just His poor servant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mohi sayvak baychaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: My Enticing Beloved is very dear to my mind and my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: mohan laal mayraa pareetam man paraanaa.

lines.english: He blesses me with His gift. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o dayh d aanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have seen and tested all.
lines.transliteration: saglay mai daykh ay jo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: There is none other than Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: beeja-o avar na ko-ee. ||2||

lines.english: He sustains and nurtures all beings.
lines.transliteration: jee-an partipaal samaahai.

lines.english: He was, and shall always be. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hai hosee aahay. ||3||

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, O Divine Lord,
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa mohi keejai d ayvaa.

lines.english: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laago sayvaa. ||4||5||21|| and link Nanak to Your service. ||4||5||21|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1005-16) maaroo mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Redeemer of sinners, who carries us across; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, asacrifice, a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran t aaran bal bal balay bal jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: If only I could meet with such a Saint, who would inspire me to meditate on the Lord,Har, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aisaa ko-ee bhaytai sant  jit har haray har Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: No one knows me; I am called Your slave.
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o ko-ay na jaanat kahee-at  daas tumaaraa.

lines.english: This is my support and sustenance. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayhaa ot aaDhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You support and cherish all; I am meek and humble - this is my only prayer.
lines.transliteration: sarab Dhaaran part ipaaran ik bin-o d eenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਤਾਰਨ  ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਬਲੇ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: You alone know Your Way; You are the water, and I am the fish. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tumree biDh  tum hee jaanhu t um jal ham meenaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਕੋਈ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Perfect and Expansive Lord and Master, I follow You in love.
lines.transliteration: pooran bistheeran su-aamee aahi aa-i-o paachhai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ  ਕਹੀਅਤ  ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O God, You are pervading all the worlds, solar systems and galaxies. ||3|| pMnw 1006
lines.transliteration: saglo bhoo mandal kh andal parabh  tum hee aachh ai. ||3||

lines.english: You are eternal and unchanging, imperishable, invisible and infinite, O divine fascinating Lord.
lines.transliteration: atal akhi-o d ayvaa mohan alakh  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਟਲ  ਅਖਇਓ  ਦੇਵਾ ਮੋਹਨ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Society of the Saints, and the dust of the feetof Your slaves. ||4||6||22|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1006-2) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daan paava-o sant aa sang naanak rayn d aasaaraa. ||4||6||22||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ  ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੇਨੁ ਦਾਸਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥੨੨॥
lines.english: The Saints are fulfilled and satisfied;
lines.transliteration: taripat  aagh aa-ay sant aa.
gur jaanay jin manntaa. they know the Guru's Mantra and the Teachings.

lines.english: They cannot even be described;
lines.transliteration: taa kee kichh  kahan na jaa-ee.
jaa ka-o naam badaa-ee. ||1|| they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: My Beloved is a priceless jewel.
lines.transliteration: laal amolaa laalo.

lines.english: His Name is unattainable and immeasurable. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: agah atolaa naamo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One whose mind is satisfied believing in the imperishable Lord God,
lines.transliteration: avigat si-o maani-aa maano.
gurmukh t at gi-aano. becomes Gurmukh and attains the essence of spiritual wisdom.

lines.english: He sees all in his meditation.
lines.transliteration: paykhat  sagal Dh i-aano.

lines.english: He banishes egotistical pride from his mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taji-o man t ay abh imaano. ||2||

lines.english: Permanent is the place of those
lines.transliteration: nihchal tin kaa th aanaa.
gur tay mahal pachh aanaa. who, through the Guru, realize the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, they remain awake and aware night and day;
lines.transliteration: an-din gur mil jaagay.
har kee sayvaa laagay. ||3|| they are committed to the Lord's service. ||3||

lines.english: They are perfectly fulfilled and satisfied,
lines.transliteration: pooran taripat  aghaa-ay.
sahj samaaDh subh aa-ay. intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi.

lines.english: The Lord's treasure comes into their hands;
lines.transliteration: har bhandaar haath aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Guru, they attain it. ||4||7||23|| mwrU mhlw 5 Gru 6 dupdy  (1006-8) maaroo mehlaa 5 ghar 6 d upday Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Du-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1006-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur tay paa-i-aa. ||4||7||23||
