lines.english: Abandon all your clever tricks; meet with the Holy, and renounce your egotisticalpride.
lines.transliteration: chhod sagal si-aan paa mil saaDh  ti-aag gumaan.

lines.english: Everything else is false; with your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: avar sabh kichh  mithi-aa rasnaa raam raam vakh aan. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, with your ears, listen to the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man karan sun har naam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The sins of your many past lifetimes shall be washed away; then, what can thewretched Messenger of Death do to you? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: miteh agh t ayray janam janam kay kavan bapuro jaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Pain, poverty and fear shall not afflict you, and you shall find peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: dookh  deen na bh a-o bi-aapai milai sukh  bisraam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak speaks; meditation on the Lord is the essence of spiritualwisdom. ||2||1||24|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1006-12) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak bakh aanai har bh ajan t at gi-aan. ||2||1||24||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਨ  ਸੁਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord - I have seen themreduced to dust.
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa say hot d aykhay kh ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਅਘ  ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਬਪੁਰੋ  ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The love of children and friends, and the pleasures of married life are torn apart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: putar mit ar bilaas banit aa toottay ay nayh. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, continually, continuously chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam nit nit  layh.

lines.english: You shall not burn in the ocean of fire, and your mind and body shall be blessed with peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jalat naahee agan saagar sookh  man t an dayh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Like the shade of a tree, these things shall pass away, like the clouds blown away bythe wind.
lines.transliteration: birakh chh aa-i-aa jaisay binsat  pavan jh oolat mayh.

lines.english: Meeting with the Holy, devotional worship to the Lord is implanted within; O Nanak,only this shall work for you. ||2||2||25|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1006-15) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  darirh mil saaDh  naanak t ayrai kaam aavat  ayh. ||2||2||25||

lines.english: The perfect, primal Lord is the Giver of peace; He is always with you.
lines.transliteration: purakh pooran sukh ah daataa sang bast o neet .

lines.english: He does not die, and he does not come or go in reincarnation. He does not perish,and He is not affected by heat or cold. ||1||
lines.transliteration: marai na aavai na jaa-ay binsai bi-aapat usan na seet . ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, be in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam si-o kar pareet.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੂਖੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within the mind, think of the Lord, Har, Har, the treasure. This is the purest way oflife. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chayt man meh har har niDh aanaa ayh nirmal reet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whoever meditates on the merciful compassionate Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is successful.
lines.transliteration: kirpaal da-i-aal gopaal gobid  jo japai t is seeDh .

lines.english: He is always new, fresh and young, clever and beautiful; Nanak's mind is piercedthrough with His Love. ||2||3||26|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1006-19) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naval navtan chat ur sund ar man naanak t is sang beeDh . ||2||3||26||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਿਮਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਿਮ  ਆਵਤ  ਏਹ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
lines.english: While walking and sitting, sleeping and waking, contemplate within your heart theGurMantra.
lines.transliteration: chalat baisat  sovat  jaagat  gur mant ar ridai chit aar.

lines.english: Run to the Lord's lotus feet, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other side. ||1|| pMnw 1007
lines.transliteration: charan saran  bhaj sang saaDh oo bh av saagar ut reh paar. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam hirdai Dh aar.

lines.english: Love the Lord, and commit your mind and body to Him; forget everything else. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar pareet man t an laa-ay har si-o avar sagal visaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਅਵਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Soul, mind, body and breath of life belong to God; eliminate your self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: jee-o man tan paraan  parabh  kay t oo aapan aap nivaar.

lines.english: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and all your desires shall be fulfilled; O Nanak, you shall never be defeated. ||2||4||27|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1007-3) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: govid bh aj sabh  su-aarath pooray naanak kabahu na haar. ||2||4||27||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Renounce your self-conceit, and the fever shall depart; become the dust of the feet ofthe Holy.
lines.transliteration: taj aap binsee t aap rayn  saaDh oo thee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵਦ  ਭਜੁ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਆਰਥ  ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
lines.english: He alone receives Your Name, Lord, whom You bless with Your Mercy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  naam t ayraa kar kirpaa jis d ee-o. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam amrit pee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਆਪੁ ਿਬਨਸੀ  ਤਾਪੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਥੀਉ ॥
lines.english: Abandon other bland, insipid tastes; become immortal, and live throughout the ages.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan saad bisaar hochh ay amar jug jug jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Savor the essence of the One and only Naam; love the Naam, focus and attuneyourself to the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam ik ras rang naamaa naam laagee lee-o.

lines.english: Nanak has made the One Lord his only friend, companion and relative. ||2||5||28|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1007-7) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sakh aa banDh ap har ayk naanak kee-o. ||2||5||28||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਸਾਦ ਿਬਸਾਿਰ  ਹੋਛੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He nourishes and preserves mortals in the womb of the mother, so that the fiery heat does not hurt them.
lines.transliteration: partipaal maat aa ud ar raakh ai lagan d ayt na sayk.

lines.english: That Lord and Master protects us here. Understand this in your mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so-ee su-aamee eehaa raakhai boojh  buDh  bibayk. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਲੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man naam kee kar tayk.

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀਉ  ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
lines.english: Understand the One who created you; the One God is the Cause of causes.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tiseh boojh  jin too kee-aa parabh  karan  kaaran  ayk. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Remember the One Lord in your mind, renounce your clever tricks, and give up allyour religious robes.
lines.transliteration: chayt man meh t aj si-aan ap chh od saglay bh aykh.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਿਲ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਉਦਿਰ  ਰਾਖੈ ਲਗਿਨ  ਦੇਤ ਨ ਸੇਕ ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O Nanak, countless beingshave been saved. ||2||6||29|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1007-10) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar har har sadaa naanak t aray ka-ee anayk. ||2||6||29||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਈਹਾ  ਰਾਖੈ ਬੂਝੁ ਬੁਿਧ ਿਬਬੇਕ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: His Name is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan naam jaa ko anaath ko hai naath.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਿਰ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.english: In the vast and terrifying world-ocean, he is the raft for those who have such destinyinscribed on their foreheads. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa bha-ojal maahi t ulho jaa ko likh i-o maath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਬੂਝੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਤੂ ਕੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਏਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, huge numbers of companions have drowned.
lines.transliteration: doobay naam bin ghan saath.

lines.english: Even if someone does not remember the Lord, the Cause of causes, still, the Lordreaches out with His hand, and saves him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  chit na aavai d ay kar raakh ai haath. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚੇਿਤ  ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਤਿਜ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਛੋਿਡ ਸਗਲੇ  ਭੇਖ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord,and take the Path of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  gun uchaaran  har naam amrit  paath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਰੇ ਕਈ ਅਨੇਕ  ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord; listening to Your sermon, Nanak lives.||2||7||30|| mwrU AMjulI mhlw 5 Gru 7  (1007-14) maaroo anjulee mehlaa 5 ghar 7 Maaroo, Anjulee ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1007-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa muraar maaDha-o sun  naanak jeevai gaath. ||2||7||30||

lines.english: Union and separation are ordained by the Primal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sanjog vijog Dharahu hee hoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥ  ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
lines.english: The puppet is made from the five elements.
lines.transliteration: panch Dhaat  kar put laa kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਤੁਲਹੋ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਿਲਿਖਓ  ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Command of the Dear Lord King, the soul came and entered into the body.||1||
lines.transliteration: saahai kai furmaa-i-arhai jee d ayhee vich jee-o aa-ay pa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: In that place, where the fire rages like an oven,
lines.transliteration: jithai agan bhakh ai bharhhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ooraDh mukh  mahaa gubaaray. in that darkness where the body lies face down
saas saas samaalay so-ee othai khasam chh adaa-ay la-i-aa. ||2|| - there, one remembers his Lord and Master with each and every breath, and then he is rescued. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਾਰਣ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਪਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Then, one comes out from within the womb,
lines.transliteration: vichahu garbhai nikal aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ਮਾਧਉ  ਸੁਿਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਥ  ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: khasam visaar d unee chit  laa-i-aa. and forgetting his Lord and Master, he attaches his consciousness to the world.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He comes and goes, and wanders in reincarnation; he cannot remain anywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aavai jaa-ay bhavaa-ee-ai jonee rahan  na kit hee thaa-ay bh a-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Merciful Lord Himself emancipates.
lines.transliteration: miharvaan rakh la-i-an aapay.

lines.english: He created and established all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tis kay thaapay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੈ ਕੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਅੜੈ  ਜੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੀਉ ਆਇ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who depart after having been victorious in this priceless human life - O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved. ||4||1||31|| pMnw 1008 mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1008-1) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath jin  chali-aa naanak aa-i-aa so parvaan  thi-aa. ||4||1||31||

lines.english: The One Lord alone is our help and support; neither physician nor friend, nor sisternor brother can be this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vaido na vaa-ee bh aino na bh aa-ee ayko sahaa-ee raam hay. ||1||

lines.english: His actions alone come to pass; He washes off the filth of sins. Meditate inremembrance on that Supreme Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: keetaa jiso hovai paapaaN malo Dh ovai so simrahu parDh aan hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵੈਦੋ ਨ ਵਾਈ  ਭੈਣੋ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ਏਕੋ ਸਹਾਈ  ਰਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He abides in each and every heart, and dwells in all; His seat and place are eternal.||3||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh atay vaasee sarab nivaasee asthir jaa kaa thaan hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਿਜਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪ  ਮਲੋ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He does not come or go, and He is always with us. His actions are perfect. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aavai na jaavai sangay samaavai pooran jaa kaa kaam hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਟੇ ਵਾਸੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He is the Savior and the Protector of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kaa raakh anhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੈ  ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Saints live by meditating on God, the support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: sant jeeveh jap paraan aDh aaraa.

lines.english: The Almighty Lord and Master is the Cause of causes; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him.||5||2||32|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (1008-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: mwrU mhlw 9 ] (1008-5) maaroo mehlaa 9. Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samrath su-aamee naanak tis kurbaan hay. ||5||2||32||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is forever the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: har ko naam sadaa sukh -daa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕਾਰਨ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on it, Ajaamal was saved, and Ganika the prostitute wasemancipated. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o simar ajaamal uDhaari-o ganikaa hoo gat  paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dropadi the princess of Panchaala remembered the Lord's Name in the royal court.
lines.transliteration: panchaalee ka-o raaj sabhaa meh raam naam suDh  aa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord, the embodiment of mercy, removed her suffering; thus His own glory wasincreased. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa ko d ookh hari-o karun aa mai apnee paij badh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: That man, who sings the Praise of the Lord, the treasure of mercy, has the help andsupport of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jih nar jas kirpaa niDh gaa-i-o t aa ka-o bh a-i-o sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਿਰਓ  ਗਿਨਕਾ  ਹੂ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have come to rely on this. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||1|| mwrU mhlw 9 ] (1008-8) maaroo mehlaa 9. Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai ihee bharosai gahee aan sarnaa-ee. ||2||1||

lines.english: What should I do now, O mother?
lines.transliteration: ab mai kahaa kara-o ree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚਾਲੀ  ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਿਧ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have wasted my whole life in sin and corruption; I never remembered the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal janam bikhi-an si-o kh o-i-aa simri-o naahi kanHaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਹਿਰਓ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅਪਨੀ  ਪੈਜ ਬਢਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When Death places the noose around my neck, then I lose all my senses.
lines.transliteration: kaal faas jab gar meh maylee tih suDh  sabh  bisraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਨਰ ਜਸੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਗਾਇਓ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Now, in this disaster, other than the Name of the Lord, who will be my help andsupport? ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin yaa sankat meh ko ab hot sahaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਇਹੀ  ਭਰੋਸੈ  ਗਹੀ ਆਿਨ  ਸਰਨਾਈ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: That wealth, which he believes to be his own, in an instant, belongs to another.
lines.transliteration: jo sampat apnee kar maanee chh in meh bh a-ee paraa-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, this still really bothers my mind - I never sang the Praises of the Lord.||2||2|| mwrU mhlw 9 ] (1008-12) maaroo mehlaa 9. Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak yeh soch rahee man har jas kabhoo na gaa-ee. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my mother, I have not renounced the pride of my mind.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mai man ko maan na ti-aagi-o.

lines.english: I have wasted my life intoxicated with Maya; I have not focused myself in meditationon the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kay mad janam siraa-i-o raam bh ajan nahee laagi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When Death's club falls on my head, then I will be wakened from my sleep.
lines.transliteration: jam ko dand pari-o sir oopar tab sovat  tai jaagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਰ ਮਿਹ ਮੇਲੀ ਿਤਹ ਸੁਿਧ ਸਭ ਿਬਸਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: But what good will it do to repent at that time? I cannot escape by running away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahaa hot ab kai pachh utaa-ay chh ootat naahin bh aagi-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਯਾ ਸੰਕਟ  ਮਿਹ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When this anxiety arises in the heart, then, one comes to love the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: ih chintaa upjee gh at meh jab gur charnan anuraagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੰਪਿਤ ਅਪਨੀ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੀ  ਿਛਨ ਮਿਹ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My life becomes fruitful, O Nanak, only when I am absorbed in the Praises of God.||2||3|| mwrU AstpdIAw mhlw 1 Gru 1  (1008-16) maaroo asatpadee-aa mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Maaroo, Ashtapadees, First Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1008-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sufal janam naanak tab hoo-aa ja-o parabh  jas meh paagi-o. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਯਹ ਸੋਚ ਰਹੀ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: Reciting and listening to the Vedas and the Puraanas, countless wise men have grownweary.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan  kathay sun ay haaray munee anaykaa.

lines.english: So many in their various religious robes have grown weary, wandering to the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath baho gh anaa bh aram thaakay bh aykhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਮੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਿਤਆਿਗਓ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord and Master is immaculate and pure. The mind is satisfied only by theOne Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saacho saahib nirmalo man maanai aykaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਮਿਦ ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਸਰਾਇਓ  ਰਾਮ ਭਜਿਨ  ਨਹੀ ਲਾਿਗਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are eternal; You do not grow old. All others pass away.
lines.transliteration: too ajraavar amar t oo sabh  chaalan haaree.

lines.english: One who lovingly focuses on the Naam, the source of nectar - his pains are taken away. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1009
lines.transliteration: naam rasaa-in bh aa-ay lai parhar d ukh bhaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Study the Lord's Name, and understand the Lord's Name; follow the Guru's Teachings, and through the Naam, you shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: har parhee-ai har bujh ee-ai gurmat ee naam uDh aaraa.

lines.english: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; contemplate the Perfect Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pooree mat hai poorai sabad  beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੜੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the Eradicator ofsins. ||2||
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath har naam hai kilvikh  kaatan haaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਤ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The blind ignorant mortal stirs the water and churns the water, wishing to obtainbutter.
lines.transliteration: jal bilovai jal mathai tat  lorhai anDh  agi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one churns the cream, and the treasure of theAmbrosial Naam is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee d aDh mathee-ai amrit  paa-ee-ai naam niDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲੁ ਿਬਲੋਵੈ  ਜਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਤਤੁ ਲੋੜੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is a beast; he does not know the essence of reality that is contained within himself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh t at na jaan nee pasoo maahi samaanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਦਿਧ ਮਥੀਐ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dying in egotism and self-conceit, one dies, and dies again, only to be reincarnatedover and over again.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa maree mar mar jammai vaaro vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਪਸੂ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: But when he dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, then he does not die, ever again.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday jay marai fir marai na d oojee vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰੀ ਮਰੁ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: When he follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines the Lord, the Life of the World,within his mind, he redeems all his generations. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee jagjeevan man vasai sabh  kul uDh aaran haar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ  ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the true object, the true commodity.
lines.transliteration: sachaa vakhar naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਿਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Naam is the only true profit in this world. Follow the Guru's Teachings, andcontemplate it.
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam sansaar hai gurmatee veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: To work in the love of duality, brings constant loss in this world. ||5||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay kaar kamaavn ee nit  totaa saisaaraa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: True is one's association, true is one's place, and true is one's hearth and home, whenone has the support of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: saachee sangat thaan sach sachay gh ar baaraa. sachaa bh ojan bh aa-o sach sach naam aDhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਿਨਤ  ਤੋਟਾ  ਸੈਸਾਰਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Contemplating the True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, one becomes content. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sant okhi-aa sachaa sabad  veechaaraa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Enjoying princely pleasures, one shall be destroyed in pain and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: ras bhogan  paatisaahee-aa d ukh sukh  sangh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Adopting a name of greatness, one strings heavy sins around his neck.
lines.transliteration: motaa naa-o Dharaa-ee-ai gal a-ugan  bhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸੰਤੋਿਖਆ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Mankind cannot give gifts; You alone are the Giver of everything. ||7||
lines.transliteration: maanas d aat na hova-ee t oo daataa saaraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੀਆ  ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਘਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; O Lord, You are imperishable and infinite.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar too Dh anee avigat  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਟਾ ਨਾਉ  ਧਰਾਈਐ  ਗਿਲ ਅਉਗਣ  ਭਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, seeking at the Lord's Door, one finds thetreasure of liberation.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee d ar jo-ee-ai mukt ay bh andaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਾਰਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this union is not broken, if one deals in the merchandise of Truth. ||8||1|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1009-11) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl na chook-ee saachay vaapaaraa. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਅਿਵਗਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The boat is loaded with sin and corruption, and launched into the sea.
lines.transliteration: bikh bohithaa laad i-aa d ee-aa samund  manjh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਦਰੁ ਜੋਈਐ  ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਭੰਡਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The shore cannot be seen on this side, nor on the shore beyond.
lines.transliteration: kanDhee d is na aavee naa urvaar na paar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ  ਸਾਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: There are no oars, nor any boatmen, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vanjhee haath na kh ayvtoo jal saagar asraal. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, the world is caught in the great noose.
lines.transliteration: baabaa jag faathaa mahaa jaal.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are saved, contemplating the True Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ubray sachaa naam samaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਧੀ ਿਦਿਸ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the boat; the Word of the Shabad will carry them across.
lines.transliteration: satguroo hai bohithaa sabad  langh aavan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਵੰਝੀ ਹਾਿਥ  ਨ ਖੇਵਟੂ  ਜਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is neither wind nor fire, neither water nor form there.
lines.transliteration: tithai pavan  na paavko naa jal naa aakaar.

lines.english: The True Name of the True Lord is there; it carries them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tithai sachaa sach naa-ay bh avjal t aaran haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs reach the shore beyond, lovingly focusing on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh langh ay say paar pa-ay sachay si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Their comings and goings are ended, and their light merges into the Light.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on nivaari-aa jot ee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, intuitive peace wells up within them, and they remain merged in the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee sahj oopjai sachay rahai samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਥੈ ਪਵਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵਕੋ  ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The snake may be locked in a basket, but it is still poisonous, and the anger within itsmind remains.
lines.transliteration: sap pirhaa-ee paa-ee-ai bikh  antar man ros.

lines.english: One obtains what is pre-ordained; why does he blame others?
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa paa-ee-ai kis no d eejai d os.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲੰਘੇ ਸੇ ਪਾਿਰ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If one, as Gurmukh, hears and believes in the Name, the charm against poison, hismind becomes content. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gaararh  jay sun ay mannay naa-o sant os. ||4||

lines.english: The crocodile is caught by the hook and line;
lines.transliteration: maagarmachh fahaa-ee-ai kundee jaal vat aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: durmat  faathaa faa-ee-ai fir fir pachh otaa-ay. caught in the trap of evil-mindedness, he regrets and repents, again and again.

lines.english: He does not understand birth and death; the inscription of one's past actions cannotbe erased. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  na sujh -ee kirat  na mayti-aa jaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: Injecting the poison of egotism, the world was created; with the Shabad enshrinedwithin, the poison is eliminated.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai bikh paa-ay jagat  upaa-i-aa sabad  vasai bikh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗਾਰੜੁ  ਜੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ  ਸੰਤੋਸੁ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Old age cannot torment one who remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaraa johi na sak-ee sach rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: He alone is called Jivan-Mikta, liberated while yet alive, from within whom egotism is eradicated. ||6|| pMnw 1010
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat so aakh ee-ai jis vichahu ha-umai jaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: DhanDh ai Dhaavat  jag baaDh i-aa naa boojh ai veechaar. The world is chasing after worldly affairs; caught and bound, it does not understand contemplative meditation.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ  ਜਗੁ ਬਾਿਧਆ  ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The foolish, ignorant, self-willed manmukh has forgotten birth and death.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  visaari-aa manmukh  mugaDh  gavaar.

lines.english: Those whom the Guru has protected are saved, contemplating the True Word of theShabad. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray sachaa sabad  veechaar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: In the cage of divine love, the parrot, speaks.
lines.transliteration: soohat pinjar paraym kai bolai bolanhaar.

lines.english: It pecks at the Truth, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; it flies away, only once.
lines.transliteration: sach chugai amrit pee-ai udai t a aykaa vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਐ  ਉਡੈ ਤ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, one recognizes his Lord and Master; says Nanak, he finds the gate of liberation. ||8||2|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1010-4) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai khasam pachh aanee-ai kaho naanak mokh  du-aar. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers death; otherwise, where can you run?
lines.transliteration: sabad marai t aa maar mar bh aago kis peh jaa-o.

lines.english: Through the Fear of God, fear runs away; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: jis kai dar bhai bh aagee-ai amrit  taa ko naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਰੁ ਭਾਗੋ ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: You alone kill and protect; except for You, there is no place at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maareh raakhahi ayk t oo beeja-o naahee thaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੈ ਡਿਰ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀਐ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, I am filthy, shallow and totally without understanding.
lines.transliteration: baabaa mai kucheel kaacha-o matiheen.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਿਹ  ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, no one is anything; the Perfect Guru has made my intellectperfect. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa ko kachh nahee gur poorai pooree mat  keen. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am full of faults, and I have no virtue at all. Without virtues, how can I go home?
lines.transliteration: avgan subh ar gun  nahee bin gun  ki-o gh ar jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਤ ਕੀਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace wells up; without good destiny, thewealth is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: sahj sabad sukh  oopjai bin bh aagaa Dh an naahi.

lines.english: Those whose minds are not filled with the Naam are bound and gagged, and suffer inpain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin kai naam na man vasai say baaDhay d ookh sahaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਸੁਭਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਿਕਉ  ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have forgotten the Naam - why have they even come into the world?
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa say kit aa-ay sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਧਨੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, they do not find any peace; they have loaded their carts with ashes.
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai sukh  nahee gaaday laad ay chh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are separated, do not meet with the Lord; they suffer in terrible pain atDeath's Door. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa maylaa nahee d ookh ghano jam d u-aar. ||3||

lines.english: I do not know what will happen in the world hereafter; I am so confused - pleaseteach me, Lord!
lines.transliteration: agai ki-aa jaanaa naahi mai bh oolay t oo samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ  ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਡੇ  ਲਾਦੇ  ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I am confused; I would fall at the feet of one who shows me the Way.
lines.transliteration: bhoolay maarag jo d asay t is kai laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ  ਮੇਲਾ  ਨਹੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, there is no giver at all; His value cannot be described. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur bin daat aa ko nahee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ  ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਮੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If I see my friend, then I will embrace Him; I have sent Him the letter of Truth.
lines.transliteration: saajan daykh aa taa gal milaa saach path aa-i-o laykh .

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਜੋ ਦਸੇ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His soul-bride stands waiting expectantly; as Gurmukh, I see Him with my eyes.
lines.transliteration: mukh Dh imaan ai Dhan kh arhee gurmukh  aakh ee daykh.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You abide in my mind, and bless me with Your Glance ofGrace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai t oo man vaseh nad ree karam visaykh . ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਗਿਲ  ਿਮਲਾ  ਸਾਚੁ ਪਠਾਇਓ  ਲੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: One who is wandering hungry and thirsty - what can he give, and what can anyoneask from him?
lines.transliteration: bhookh  pi-aaso jay bh avai ki-aa t is maaga-o d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਖ ਿਧਮਾਣੈ  ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਖੀ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: I cannot conceive of any other, who can bless my mind and body with perfection.
lines.transliteration: beeja-o soojhai ko nahee man t an pooran d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂ ਮਿਨ ਵਸਿਹ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਵਸੇਖੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The One who created me takes care of me; He Himself blesses me with glory. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tin d aykhi-aa aap vadaa-ee d ay-ay. ||6||

lines.english: In the body-village is my Lord and Master, whose body is ever-new, Innocent and child-like, incomparably playful.
lines.transliteration: nagree naa-ik navtano baalak leel anoop.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਜਉ  ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He is neither a woman, nor a man, nor a bird; the True Lord is so wise and beautiful.
lines.transliteration: naar na purakh na pankh -noo saacha-o chat ur saroop.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him, happens; You are the lamp, and You are the incense. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai t oo deepak t oo Dh oop. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਇਕੁ  ਨਵਤਨੋ  ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਲੀਲ  ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
lines.english: He hears the songs and tastes the flavors, but these flavors are useless and insipid,and bring only disease to the body.
lines.transliteration: geet saad  chaakh ay sun ay baad  saad  tan rog.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਪੰਖਣੂ  ਸਾਚਉ  ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ  ॥
lines.english: One who loves the Truth and speaks the Truth, escapes from the sorrow ofseparation.
lines.transliteration: sach bhaavai saacha-o chavai chh ootai sog vijog.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਤੂ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਤੂ ਧੂਪੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Nanak does not forget the Naam; whatever happens is by the Lord's Will. ||8||3|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1010-16) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai jo tis bh aavai so hog. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੀਤ  ਸਾਦ ਚਾਖੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਤਿਨ  ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Practice Truth - other greed and attachments are useless.
lines.transliteration: saachee kaar kamaavnee hor laalach baad .

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਉ  ਚਵੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸੋਗ ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord has fascinated this mind, and my tongue enjoys the taste of Truth.
lines.transliteration: ih man saachai mohi-aa jihvaa sach saad.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Name, there is no juice; the others depart, loaded with poison. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko ras nahee hor chaleh bikh laad . ||1||

lines.english: I am such a slave of Yours, O my Beloved Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: aisaa laalaa mayray laal ko sun kh asam hamaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਹੋਿਰ ਲਾਲਚ  ਬਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I walk in harmony with Your Command, O my True, Sweet Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o furmaaveh ti-o chalaa sach laal pi-aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਸਿਚ ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, the slave works for his overlord.
lines.transliteration: an-din laalay chaakree golay sir meeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਿਰ ਚਲਿਹ ਿਬਖੁ ਲਾਿਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have sold my mind for the Word of the Guru's Shabad; my mind is comforted and consoled by the Shabad. pMnw 1011
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee man vaychi-aa sabad man Dh eeraa.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru is honored and celebrated; He has taken away the pains of mymind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray saabaas hai kaatai man peeraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਨ ਪੀਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am the servant and slave of my Master; what glorious greatness of His can I describe?
lines.transliteration: laalaa golaa Dhan ee ko ki-aa kaha-o vadi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਾ  ਗੋਲਾ  ਧਣੀ ਕੋ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਉ  ਵਿਡਆਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, forgives, and then one practices Truth.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai bakh say pooraa Dh anee sach kaar kamaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸੇ  ਪੂਰਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who re-unites the separated ones. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa ka-o mayl la-ay gur ka-o bal jaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ  ਕਉ ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The intellect of His servant and slave is noble and true; it is made so by the Guru'sintellect.
lines.transliteration: laalay golay mat kh aree gur kee mat  neekee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੇ  ਗੋਲੇ ਮਿਤ ਖਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਨੀਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: The intuition of those who are true is be autiful; the intellect of the self-willed manmukh is insipid.
lines.transliteration: saachee surat suhaavan ee manmukh  mat feekee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਿਤ ਫੀਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body belong to You, God; from the very beginning, Truth has been myonly support. ||4||
lines.transliteration: man tan t ayraa t oo parabh oo sach Dh eerak Dh ur kee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਸਚੁ ਧੀਰਕ  ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ॥੪॥
lines.english: In Truth I sit and stand; I eat and speak the Truth.
lines.transliteration: saachai baisan uth -naa sach bh ojan bh aakhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਬੈਸਣੁ  ਉਠਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: With Truth in my consciousness, I gather the wealth of Truth, and drink in the sublimeessence of Truth.
lines.transliteration: chit sachai vit o sachaa saachaa ras chaakh i-aa.

lines.english: In the home of Truth, the True Lord protects me; I speak the Words of the Guru's Teachings with love. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saachai ghar saachai rakh ay gur bachan subh aakhi-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਘਿਰ  ਸਾਚੈ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਸੁਭਾਿਖਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is very lazy; he is trapped in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ka-o aalas gh ano faathay ojaarh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਉ ਆਲਸੁ  ਘਣੋ ਫਾਥੇ ਓਜਾੜੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is drawn to the bait, and continually pecking at it, he is trapped; his link to theLord is ruined.
lines.transliteration: faathaa chugai nit chogrh ee lag banDh  vigaarh ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one is liberated, absorbed in the primal trance of Truth. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee mukat ho-ay saachay nij t aarhee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚੇ ਿਨਜ ਤਾੜੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: His slave remains continually pierced through with love and affection for God.
lines.transliteration: anhat laalaa bayDh i-aa parabh  hayt pi-aaree.

lines.english: Without the True Lord, the soul of the false, corrupt person is burnt to ashes.
lines.transliteration: bin saachay jee-o jal bala-o jhooth ay vaykaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੀਉ  ਜਿਲ  ਬਲਉ  ਝੂਠੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Abandoning all evil actions, he crosses over in the boat of Truth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: baad kaaraa sabh  chhodee-aa saachee t ar taaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਦ  ਕਾਰਾ  ਸਿਭ ਛੋਡੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ  ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who have forgotten the Naam have no home, no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa tinaa th a-ur na th aa-o.

lines.english: The Lord's slave renounces greed and attachment, and obtains the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: laalai laalach ti-aagi-aa paa-i-aa har naa-o.

lines.english: If You forgive him, Lord, then He is united with You; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||8||4|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1011-9) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too bakh sahi t aa mayl laihi naanak bal jaa-o. ||8||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਬਖਸਿਹ  ਤਾ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord's slave renounces his egotistical pride, through the Guru's Fear, intuitivelyand easily.
lines.transliteration: laalai gaarab chhodi-aa gur kai bh ai sahj subh aa-ee.

lines.english: The slave realizes his Lord and Master; glorious is his greatness!
lines.transliteration: laalai khasam pachh aani-aa vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੈ  ਗਾਰਬੁ ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with his Lord and Master, he finds peace; His value cannot be desribed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khasam mili-ai sukh  paa-i-aa keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I am the slave and servant of my Lord and Master; all glory is to my Master.
lines.transliteration: laalaa golaa khasam kaa kh asmai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਿਮ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I am saved, in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ubray har kee sarnaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਾ  ਗੋਲਾ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਖਸਮੈ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The slave has been given the most excellent task, by the Primal Command of theMaster.
lines.transliteration: laalay no sir kaar hai Dhur kh asam furmaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਉਬਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The slave realizes the Hukam of His Command, and submits to His Will forever.
lines.transliteration: laalai hukam pachhaan i-aa sad aa rahai rajaa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord King Himself grants forgiveness; how glorious is His greatness! ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay meeraa bakhas la-ay vadee vadi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੇ  ਨੋ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਧੁਿਰ ਖਸਿਮ  ਫੁਰਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is True, and everything is True; this is revealed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aap sachaa sabh sach hai gur sabad  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੈ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He alone serves You, whom You have enjoined to do so.
lines.transliteration: tayree sayvaa so karay jis no laihi t oo laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੀਰਾ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without serving Him, no one finds Him; in duality and doubt, they are ruined. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin sayvaa kinai na paa-i-aa doojai bh aram kh u-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: How could we forget Him from our minds? The gifts which he bestows increase day byday.
lines.transliteration: so ki-o manhu visaaree-ai nit d ayvai charh ai savaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲੈਿਹ ਤੂ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Soul and body, all belong to Him; He infused the breath into us.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is daa saahu t inai vich paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਖੁਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: If he shows His Mercy, then we serve Him; serving Him, we merge in Truth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jaa kirpaa karay taa sayvee-ai sayv sach samaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive, and eradicates egotismfrom within.
lines.transliteration: laalaa so jeevat marai mar vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: His bonds are broken, the fire of his desire is quenched, and he is liberated.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t ooteh mukat  ho-ay t arisnaa agan bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within all, but how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtain it. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabh meh naam niDh aan hai gurmukh  ko paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਾ  ਸੋ ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਮਿਰ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Within the Lord's slave, there is no virtue at all; the Lord's slave is totally unworthy.
lines.transliteration: laalay vich gun kichh  nahee laalaa avgan i-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੂਟਿਹ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: There is no Giver as great as You, Lord; You alone are the Forgiver.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad d aataa ko nahee t oo bakh sanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Your slave obeys the Hukam of Your Command; this is the most excellent action. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tayraa hukam laalaa mannay ayh karn ee saar. ||6||

lines.english: The Guru is the pool of nectar in the world-ocean; whatever one desires, that fruit isobtained.
lines.transliteration: gur saagar amrit sar jo ichh ay so fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ  ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam brings immortality; enshrine it in your heart and mind. pMnw 1012
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath amar hai hird ai man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, eternal peace is obtained, by those whom the Lord inspires to obey the Hukam of His Command. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa sadaa sukh  hai jis no hukam manaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Gold and silver, and all metals, mix with dust in the end
lines.transliteration: su-inaa rupaa sabh Dh aat hai maatee ral jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਇਨਾ  ਰੁਪਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ  ਰਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, nothing goes along with you; the True Guru has imparted this understanding.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai naal na chal-ee satgur boojh  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; they remainmerged in the Truth. ||8||5|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1012-3) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say nirmalay saachai rahay samaa-ee. ||8||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੮॥੫॥
lines.english: The Order is issued, and he cannot remain; the permit to stay has been torn up.
lines.transliteration: hukam bha-i-aa rahn aa nahee Dh ur faatay cheerai.

lines.english: This mind is tied to its faults; it suffers terrible pain in its body.
lines.transliteration: ayhu man avgan baaDh i-aa saho d ayh sareerai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ  ਰਹਣਾ  ਨਹੀ ਧੁਿਰ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru forgives all the mistakes of the beggar at His Door. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poorai gur bakhsaa-ee-ah sabh  gunah fakeerai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਬਾਿਧਆ  ਸਹੁ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: How can he stay here? He must get up and depart. Contemplate the Word of theShabad, and understand this.
lines.transliteration: ki-o rahee-ai uth chaln aa bujh  sabad  beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਬਖਸਾਈਅਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਗੁਨਹ  ਫਕੀਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone is united, whom You, O Lord, unite. Such is the Primal Command of theInfinite Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis too mayleh so milai Dh ur hukam apaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਰਹੀਐ ਉਿਠ ਚਲਣਾ  ਬੁਝੁ ਸਬਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: As You keep me, I remain; whatever You give me, I eat.
lines.transliteration: ji-o too raakh ahi ti-o rahaa jo d eh so kh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਧੁਿਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As You lead me, I follow, with the Ambrosial Name in my mouth.
lines.transliteration: ji-o too chalaaveh t i-o chalaa mukh  amrit  naa-o.

lines.english: All glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Lord and Master; my mind yearns to unite with You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur hath vad i-aa-ee-aa mayleh man chaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਰਹਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Why should anyone praise any other created being? That Lord acts and sees.
lines.transliteration: keetaa ki-aa salaahee-ai kar d aykhai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਚਲਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created me, abides within my mind; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa so man vasai mai avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹਿਥ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: So praise that True Lord, and you shall be blessed with true honor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so saachaa salaahee-ai saachee pat ho-ee. ||3||

lines.english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads, but does not reach the Lord; he is totallyentangled in worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: pandit parh  na pahucha-ee baho aal janjaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He keeps the company of both virtue and vice, tormented by hunger and theMessenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: paap punn du-ay sangmay kh uDhi-aa jamkaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਪਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who is protected by the Perfect Lord, forgets separation and fear. ||4||
lines.transliteration: vichhorh aa bh a-o veesrai pooraa rakh vaalaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਪਿੜ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਈ ਬਹੁ ਆਲ  ਜੰਜਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are perfect, O Siblings of Destiny, whose honor is certified.
lines.transliteration: jin kee laykhai pat  pavai say pooray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਸੰਗਮੇ  ਖੁਿਧਆ  ਜਮਕਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Perfect is the intellect of the Perfect Lord. True is His glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: pooray pooree mat hai sachee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: His gifts never run short, although those who receive may grow weary of receiving. ||5||
lines.transliteration: dayday tot na aavee lai lai thak paa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਵੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Searching the salty sea, one finds the pearl.
lines.transliteration: khaar samud ar dhandholee-ai ik man ee-aa paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਤ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: It looks beautiful for a few days, but in the end, it is eaten away by dust.
lines.transliteration: du-ay d in chaar suhaavan aa maatee t is khaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਲੈ ਲੈ ਥਿਕ ਪਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: If one serves the Guru, the ocean of Truth, the gifts one receives never run short.||6||
lines.transliteration: gur saagar sat sayvee-ai d ay tot na aavai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁਦਰ੍ੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੀਐ  ਇਕੁ ਮਣੀਆ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: They alone are pure, who are pleasing to my God; all others are soiled with filth.
lines.transliteration: mayray parabh bh aavan say oojlay sabh  mail bh areejai.

lines.english: The filthy become pure, when they meet with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.
lines.transliteration: mailaa oojal taa thee-ai paaras sang bh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਿਤ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Who can estimate the value of the color of the true jewel? ||7||
lines.transliteration: vannee saachay laal kee kin keemat keejai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਿਨ  ਸੇ ਊਜਲੇ  ਸਭ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Wearing religious robes, the Lord is not obtained, nor is He obtained by givingdonations at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh ee haath na labh -ee tirath nahee d aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲਾ  ਊਜਲੁ  ਤਾ ਥੀਐ  ਪਾਰਸ ਸੰਿਗ  ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Go and ask the readers of the Vedas; without faith, the world is cheated.
lines.transliteration: poochha-o bayd  parhanti-aa mooth ee vin  maanay.

lines.punjabi: ਵੰਨੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਲ  ਕੀ ਿਕਿਨ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕੀਜੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone values the jewel, who is blessed with the spiritual wisdom of the Perfect Guru. ||8||6|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1012-14) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak keemat so karay pooraa gur gi-aanay. ||8||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਹੀ ਦਾਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh, in a fit of passion, abandons his home, and is ruined; then,he spies on the homes of others.
lines.transliteration: manmukh lahar gh ar taj vigoochai avraa kay gh ar hayrai.

lines.english: He neglects his household duties, and does not meet with the True Guru; he is caughtin the whirlpool of evil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: garih Dharam gavaa-ay sat gur na bh aytai d urmat  ghooman gh ayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਗਆਨੇ  ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.english: Wandering in foreign lands and reading scriptures, he grows weary, and his thirstydesires only increase.
lines.transliteration: disantar bh avai paath  parh thaakaa t arisnaa ho-ay vaDh ayrai.

lines.english: His perishable body does not remember the Word of the Shabad; like a beast, he fillshis belly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaachee pindee sabad na cheenai ud ar bharai jaisay dh orai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਲਹਿਰ  ਘਰੁ ਤਿਜ ਿਵਗੂਚੈ  ਅਵਰਾ  ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
lines.english: O Baba, this is the way of life of the Sannyaasi, the renunciate.
lines.transliteration: baabaa aisee ravat ravai sani-aasee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਧਰਮੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ ਘੂਮਨ  ਘੇਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is to enshrine love for the One Lord. Imbued with Your Name, Lord, he remains satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ayk liv laagee t ayrai naam rat ay tariptaasee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਪਾਠ ਪਿੜ ਥਾਕਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ਵਧੇਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: He dyes his robes with saffron dye, and wearing these robes, he goes out begging.
lines.transliteration: gholee gayroo rang charh aa-i-aa vast ar bhaykh bhaykhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚੀ  ਿਪੰਡੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Tearing his robes, he makes a patched coat, and puts the money in his wallet.
lines.transliteration: kaaparh faar banaa-ee kh inthaa jh olee maa-i-aaDh aaree.

lines.english: From house to house he goes begging, and tries to teach the world; but his mind isblind, and so he loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar maagai jag parboDh ai man anDh ai pat  haaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਏਕ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is deluded by doubt, and does not remember the Word of the Shabad. He loses his life in the gamble. ||2|| pMnw 1013
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ulaan aa sabad  na cheenai joo-ai baajee haaree. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Guru, the fire within is not quenched; and outside, the fire still burns.
lines.transliteration: antar agan na gur bin boojh ai baahar poo-ar t aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਨ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਪੂਅਰ  ਤਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship. How can anyone, by himself, know the Lord?
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa bin bhagat  na hovee ki-o kar cheenas aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਚੀਨਿਸ  ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Slandering others, one lives in hell; within him is hazy darkness.
lines.transliteration: nindaa kar kar narak nivaasee ant ar aat am jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਨਰਕ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਆਤਮ  ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Wandering to the eixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, he is ruined. How can the filth of sin be washed away? ||3||
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath bh aram vigoocheh ki-o mal Dh opai paapai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਿਮ  ਿਵਗੂਚਿਹ  ਿਕਉ  ਮਲੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਪਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He sifts through the dust, and applies ashes to his body, but he is searching for thepath of Maya's wealth.
lines.transliteration: chhaan ee kh aak bibh oot charh aa-ee maa-i-aa kaa mag johai.

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਣੀ  ਖਾਕੁ ਿਬਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, he does not know the One Lord; if someone tells him theTruth, he grows angry.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayk na jaan ai saach kahay t ay chh ohai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੇ ਤੇ ਛੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He reads the scriptures, but tells lies; such is the intellect of one who has no guru.
lines.transliteration: paath parh ai mukh  jhootho bolai niguray kee mat  ohai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਝੂਠੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਿਨਗੁਰੇ  ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਓਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Without chanting the Naam, how can he find peace? Without the Name, how can helook good? ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam na jap-ee ki-o sukh paavai bin naavai ki-o sohai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਕਉ  ਸੋਹੈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Some shave their heads, some keep their hair in matted tangles; some keep it inbraids, while some keep silent, filled with egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: moond mudaa-ay jataa sikh baaDh ee mon rahai abh imaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂੰਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇ  ਜਟਾ ਿਸਖ ਬਾਧੀ  ਮੋਿਨ ਰਹੈ ਅਿਭਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds waver and wander in ten directions, without loving devotion andenlightenment of the soul.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa dolai dah d is Dhaavai bin rat  aatam gi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਧਾਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਤ ਆਤਮ  ਿਗਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: They abandon the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink the deadly poison, driven mad byMaya.
lines.transliteration: amrit chh od mahaa bikh  peevai maa-i-aa kaa d ayvaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Past actions cannot be erased; without understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they become beasts. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kirat na mit-ee hukam na boojh ai pasoo-aa maahi samaanaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਸੂਆ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: With bowl in hand, wearing his patched coat, great desires well up in his mind.
lines.transliteration: haath kamandal kaaprhee-aa man t arisnaa upjee bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ  ਕਾਪੜੀਆ  ਮਿਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਉਪਜੀ ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Abandoning his own wife, he is engrossed in sexual desire; his thoughts are on thewives of others.
lines.transliteration: istaree t aj kar kaam vi-aapi-aa chit  laa-i-aa par naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਤਰ੍ੀ  ਤਿਜ ਕਿਰ ਕਾਿਮ  ਿਵਆਿਪਆ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He teaches and preaches, but does not contemplate the Shabad; he is bought andsold on the street.
lines.transliteration: sikh karay kar sabad  na cheenai lampat hai baajaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਖ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: With poison within, he pretends to be free of doubt; he is ruined and humiliated bythe Messenger of Death. ||6||
lines.transliteration: antar bikh  baahar nibh raatee taa jam karay kh u-aaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਬਖੁ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਨਭਰਾਤੀ  ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He alone is a Sannyaasi, who serves the True Guru, and removes his self-conceit fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: so sani-aasee jo satgur sayvai vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He does not ask for clothes or food; without asking, he accepts whatever he receives.
lines.transliteration: chhaad an bh ojan kee aas na kar-ee achint  milai so paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਦਨ  ਭੋਜਨ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ਨ ਕਰਈ  ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He does not speak empty words; he gathers in the wealth of tolerance, and burnsaway his anger with the Naam.
lines.transliteration: bakai na bolai khimaa Dh an sangrahai t aamas naam jalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਿਖਮਾ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੈ  ਤਾਮਸੁ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਜਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan girhee sani-aasee jogee je har charn ee chit  laa-ay. ||7|| Blessed is such a householder, Sannyaasi and Yogi, who focuses his consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਿਜ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Amidst hope, the Sannyaasi remains unmoved by hope; he remains lovingly focusedon the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aas niraas rahai sani-aasee aykas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.english: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord, and so finds peace and tranquility; inthe home of his own being, he remains absorbed in the deep trance of meditation.
lines.transliteration: har ras peevai taa saat  aavai nij gh ar taarhee laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਾਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: His mind does not waver; as Gurmukh, he understands. He restrains it fromwandering out.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa na dolai gurmukh boojh ai Dhaavat  varaj rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਵਰਿਜ  ਰਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, he searches the home of his body, and obtains thewealth of the Naam. ||8||
lines.transliteration: garihu sareer gurmatee kh ojay naam pad aarath paa-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are exalted, imbued with contemplative meditation on theNaam.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays saraysat naam ratay veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ  ਸਰੇਸਟ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The sources of creation, speech, the heavens and the underworld, all beings andcreatures, are infused with Your Light.
lines.transliteration: khaan ee ban ee gagan pat aalee jant aa jot  tumaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਣੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਗਗਨ  ਪਤਾਲੀ  ਜੰਤਾ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: All comforts and liberation are found in the Naam, and the vibrations of the Guru'sBani; I have enshrined the True Name within my heart.
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  mukat  naam Dh un ban ee sach naam ur Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਾਮ ਧੁਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, no one is saved; O Nanak, with the Truth, cross over to the other side. ||9||7|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1013-16) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam binaa nahee chhootas naanak saachee t ar too taaree. ||9||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੯॥੭॥
lines.english: Through the union of mother and father, the fetus is formed. The egg and sperm jointogether to make the body.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sanjog upaa-ay rakat  bind mil pind karay.

lines.english: Upside-down within the womb, it lovingly dwells on the Lord; God provides for it, andgives it nourishment there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar garabh  uraDh  liv laagee so parabh  saaray d aat karay. ||1||

lines.english: How can he cross over the terrifying world-ocean?
lines.transliteration: sansaar bhavjal ki-o t arai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗਰਭ  ਉਰਿਧ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unbearableload of sins is removed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam niranjan paa-ee-ai afri-o bh aar afaar tarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have forgotten Your Virtues, Lord; I am insane - what can I do now?
lines.transliteration: tay gun  visar ga-ay apraaDh ee mai ba-uraa ki-aa kara-o haray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਫਿਰਓ  ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Merciful Giver, above the heads of all. Day and night, You give gifts, andtake care of all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too daataa da-i-aal sabh ai sir ahinis d aat samaar karay. ||2||

lines.english: One is born to achieve the four great objectives of life. The spirit has taken up its home in the material world. pMnw 1014
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath lai jag janmi-aa siv sakt ee gh ar vaas Dh aray.

lines.english: Driven by hunger, it sees the path of Maya's riches; this emotional attachment takes away the treasure of liberation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: laagee bhookh  maa-i-aa mag johai mukat  padaarath mohi kh aray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਗੀ  ਭੂਖ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਖਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Weeping and wailing, he does not receive them; he searches here and there, andgrows weary.
lines.transliteration: karan palaav karay nahee paavai it  ut dhoodhat thaak paray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਢੂਢਤ  ਥਾਿਕ  ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he falls in love with his false relatives.||4||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar vi-aapay koorh  kutamb si-o pareet  karay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਕੂੜ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He eats and enjoys, listens and watches, and dresses up to show off in this house ofdeath.
lines.transliteration: khaavai bh ogai sun  sun daykhai pahir d ikhaavai kaal gh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਵੈ ਭੋਗੈ ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਿਹਿਰ  ਿਦਖਾਵੈ  ਕਾਲ  ਘਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not undersand himself. Without theLord's Name, death cannot be avoided. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad na aap pachh aanai bin har naam na kaal taray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਨ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ  ਟਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The more attachment and egotism delude and confuse him, the more he cries out,"Mine, mine!", and the more he loses out.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa moh ha-umai kar bh oolay mayree mayree kart ay chh een kh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤਾ  ਮੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਿਰ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ  ਛੀਿਨ  ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.english: His body and wealth pass away, and he is torn by skepticism and cynicism; in the end, he regrets and repents, when the dust falls on his face. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an binsai sahsai sahsaa fir pachh utaavai mukh  Dhoor paray. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਿਬਨਸੈ ਸਹਸੈ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ  ਮੁਿਖ ਧੂਿਰ ਪਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: He grows old, his body and youth waste away, and his throat is plugged with mucous;water flows from his eyes.
lines.transliteration: biraDh bh a-i-aa joban t an kh isi-aa kaf kanth  birooDh o nainhu neer dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਭਇਆ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਖਿਸਆ  ਕਫੁ ਕੰਠੁ ਿਬਰੂਧੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਢਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He feet fail him, and his hands shake and tremble; the faithless cynic does notenshrine the Lord in his heart. ||7||
lines.transliteration: charan rahay kar kampan  laagay saakat  raam na rid ai haray. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਣ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਰਦੈ ਹਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: His intellect fails him, his black hair turns white, and no one wants to keep him in theirhome.
lines.transliteration: surat ga-ee kaalee hoo Dh a-ulay kisai na bh aavai rakh i-o gh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਗਈ ਕਾਲੀ  ਹੂ ਧਉਲੇ  ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਿਖਓ  ਘਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, these are the stigmas which stick to him; the Messenger ofDeath beats him, and drags him to hell. ||8||
lines.transliteration: bisrat naam aisay d okh laageh jam maar samaaray narak kh aray. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਨਾਮ ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਲਾਗਿਹ  ਜਮੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਰੇ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਖਰੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The record of one's past actions cannot be erased; who else is to blame for one's birthand death?
lines.transliteration: poorab janam ko laykh na mit-ee janam marai kaa ka-o d os Dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਬ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੋ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰੈ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, life and death are pointless; without the Word of the Guru'sShabad, life just burns away. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bin gur baad jeevan  hor marn aa bin gur sabd ai janam jaray. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਿਦ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਣਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਜਰੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The pleasures enjoyed in happiness bring ruin; acting in corruption is uselessindulgence.
lines.transliteration: khusee kh u-aar bh a-ay ras bh ogan fokat karam vikaar karay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰ  ਭਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ  ਫੋਕਟ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, and caught by greed, he betrays his own source; the club of the Righteous Judge of Dharma will strike him over the head. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar lobh mool kh o-i-o sir Dh aram raa-ay kaa dand paray. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਬਸਾਿਰ  ਲੋਿਭ ਮੂਲੁ ਖੋਇਓ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name; the Lord God blessesthem with His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam gun  gaavahi jaa ka-o har parabh  nadar karay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those beings are pure, perfect unlimited and infinite; in this world, they are theembodiment of the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||11||
lines.transliteration: tay nirmal purakh  aprampar pooray t ay jag meh gur govind  haray. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਹਰੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord; meditate and contemplate the Guru's Word,and love to associate with the humble servants of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har simrahu gur bachan samaarahu sangat har jan bh aa-o karay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ  ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servants are the embodiment of the Guru; they are supreme andrespected in the Court of the Lord. Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those humbleservants of the Lord. ||12||8|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (1014-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: mwrU kwPI mhlw 1 Gru 2 ] (1014-15) maaroo kaafee mehlaa 1 ghar 2. Maaroo, Kaafee, First Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: har jan gur parDhaan d u-aarai naanak t in jan kee rayn  haray. ||12||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੨॥੮॥
lines.english: The double-minded person comes and goes, and has numerous friends.
lines.transliteration: aava-o vanja-o dummn ee kit ee mit ar karay-o.

lines.english: The soul-bride is separated from her Lord, and she has no place of rest; how can she be comforted? ||1||
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan dh o-ee na lahai vaadh ee ki-o Dh eeray-o. ||1||

lines.english: My mind is attuned to the Love of my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: maidaa man rataa aapnarh ay pir naal.

lines.english: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to the Lord; if only He would bless me with HisGlance of Grace, even for an instant! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o ghol gh umaa-ee kh annee-ai keet ee hik bh oree nad ar nihaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਾਢੀ ਿਕਉ  ਧੀਰੇਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a rejected bride, abandoned in my parents' home; how can I go to my in-lawsnow?
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai dohaagan ee saahurrh ai ki-o jaa-o.

lines.english: I wear my faults around my neck; without my Husband Lord, I am grieving, andwasting away to death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mai gal a-ugan muth -rhee bin pir jh oor maraa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਕੀਤੀ  ਿਹਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But if, in my parents' home, I remember my Husband Lord, then I will come to dwellin the home of my in-laws yet.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai pir sammlaa saahurrh ai ghar vaas.

lines.english: The happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they find their Husband Lord, the treasure ofvirtue. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sukh savanDh  sohaagan ee pir paa-i-aa gunt aas. ||3||

lines.english: Their blankets and mattresses are made of silk, and so are the clothes on their bodies.
lines.transliteration: layf nihaalee pat kee kaaparh ang ban aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਗਿਲ  ਅਉਗਣ  ਮੁਠੜੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਝੂਿਰ ਮਰਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord rejects the impure soul-brides. Their life-night passes in misery. ||4|| pMnw 1015
lines.transliteration: pir mutee dohaagan ee tin dukh ee rain  vihaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: I have tasted many flavors, and worn many robes,
lines.transliteration: kitee chakh a-o saadrh ay kit ee vays karay-o.
pir bin joban baad ga-i-am vaadh ee jhoorayd ee jhooray-o. ||5|| but without my Husband Lord, my youth is slipping away uselessly; I am separated from Him, and I cry out in pain. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਿਦ  ਗਇਅਮੁ  ਵਾਢੀ  ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: I have heard the True Lord's message, contemplating the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sachay sandaa sad -rhaa sun ee-ai gur veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਦੜਾ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: True is the home of the True Lord; by His Gracious Grace, I love Him. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sachay sachaa baihnaa nad ree nad ar pi-aar. ||6||

lines.english: The spiritual teacher applies the ointment of Truth to his eyes, and sees God, theSeer.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee anjan sach kaa daykhai daykh anhaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh comes to know and understand; ego and pride are subdued. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai jaan ee-ai ha-umai garab nivaar. ||7||

lines.english: O Lord, You are pleased with those who are like Yourself; there are many more likeme.
lines.transliteration: ta-o bh aavan t a-o jayhee-aa moo jayhee-aa kit ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਭਾਵਿਨ ਤਉ ਜੇਹੀਆ  ਮੂ ਜੇਹੀਆ  ਿਕਤੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Husband does not separate from those who are imbued with Truth. ||8||1||9|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1015-5) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naahu na veechhurh ai tin sachai rat -rhee-aah. ||8||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ  ਿਤਨ  ਸਚੈ ਰਤੜੀਆਹ  ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
lines.english: Neither the sisters, nor the sisters-in-law, nor the mothers-in-law, shall remain.
lines.transliteration: naa bhain aa bh arjaa-ee-aa naa say sasurh ee-aah.

lines.english: The true relationship with the Lord cannot be broken; it was established by the Lord,O sister soul-brides. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sachaa saak na tut-ee gur maylay sahee-aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਭੈਣਾ ਭਰਜਾਈਆ  ਨਾ ਸੇ ਸਸੁੜੀਆਹ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapnay sad  balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹੀਆਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wandering so far without the Guru, I grew weary; now, the Guru has united me in Union with my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur bin aytaa bh av thakee gur pir maylim d itam milaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Aunts, uncles, grandparents and sisters-in-law
lines.transliteration: fufee naanee maasee-aa dayr jayth aanrh ee-aah.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਏਤਾ ਭਿਵ ਥਕੀ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਪਰੁ ਮੇਿਲਮੁ  ਿਦਤਮੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aavan vanjan naa rahan poor bh aray pahee-aah. ||2|| - they all come and go; they cannot remain. They are like boatloads of passengersembarking. ||2||

lines.english: Uncles, aunts, and cousins of all sorts, cannot remain.
lines.transliteration: maamay tai maamaan ee-aa bh aa-ir baap na maa-o.

lines.english: The caravans are full, and great crowds of them are loading up at the riverbank. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saath laday tin naath ee-aa bh eerh ghanee daree-aa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਨ  ਵੰਞਿਨ  ਨਾ ਰਹਿਨ  ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਹੀਆਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O sister-friends, my Husband Lord is dyed in the color of Truth.
lines.transliteration: saacha-o rang rangaavlo sakhee hamaaro kant .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਮੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਮਾਣੀਆ  ਭਾਇਰ  ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਉ ॥
lines.english: She who lovingly remembers her True Husband Lord is not separated from Him again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sach vichhorh aa naa thee-ai so saho rang ravant . ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਥ ਲਡੇ ਿਤਨ ਨਾਠੀਆ  ਭੀੜ ਘਣੀ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All the seasons are good, in which the soul-bride falls in love with the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabhay rut ee changee-aa jit  sachay si-o nayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਉ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੋ  ਸਖੀ ਹਮਾਰੋ  ਕੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: That soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord, sleeps in peace, night and day. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan kant  pachh aani-aa sukh  sutee nis dayhu. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਿਵਛੋੜਾ  ਨਾ ਥੀਐ  ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਵੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: At the ferry, the ferryman announces, "O travellers, hurry up and cross over."
lines.transliteration: patan  kookay paat -nee vanj ahu Dh aruk vilaarh .

lines.english: I have seen them crossing over there, on the boat of the True Guru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paar pavand-rh ay dith  mai sat gur bohith chaarh . ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸੁਤੀ ਿਨਿਸ  ਡੇਹੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Some are getting on board, and some have already set out; some are weighed downwith their loads.
lines.transliteration: hiknee ladi-aa hik lad  ga-ay hik bh aaray bh ar naal.

lines.english: Those who deal in Truth, remain with their True Lord God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jinee sach vananji-aa say sachay parabh  naal. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਵੰਦੜੇ  ਿਡਠੁ ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੋਿਹਿਥ  ਚਾਿੜ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I am not called good, and I see none who are bad.
lines.transliteration: naa ham changay aakhee-aah buraa na d isai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਕਨੀ ਲਿਦਆ  ਿਹਿਕ  ਲਿਦ  ਗਏ ਿਹਿਕ  ਭਾਰੇ ਭਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who conquers and subdues his ego, becomes just like the True Lord. ||8||2||10|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1015-14) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai maaree-ai sachay jayhrhaa so-ay. ||8||2||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਿਜਆ  ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I do not believe that anyone is foolish; I do not believe that anyone is clever.
lines.transliteration: naa jaanaa moorakh  hai ko-ee naa jaan aa si-aan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਚੰਗੇ ਆਖੀਅਹ  ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਿਦਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Imbued forever with the Love of my Lord and Master, I chant His Name, night andday. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa saahib kai rangay raat aa an-d in naam vakh aanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀਐ  ਸਚੇ ਜੇਹੜਾ  ਸੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Baba, I am so foolish, but I am a sacrifice to the Name.
lines.transliteration: baabaa moorakh haa naavai bal jaa-o.

lines.english: You are the Creator, You are wise and all-seeing. Through Your Name, we are carriedacross. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: too kart aa too daanaa beenaa t ayrai naam t araa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ  ਿਸਆਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The same person is foolish and wise; the same light within has two names.
lines.transliteration: moorakh si-aan aa ayk hai ayk jot  du-ay naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The most foolish of the foolish are those who do not believe in the Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: moorkhaa sir moorakh  hai je mannay naahee naa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Gate, the Gurdwara, the Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, it is not received.
lines.transliteration: gur du-aarai naa-o paa-ee-ai bin sat gur palai na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will, the Name comes to dwell in the mind,and then, night and day, one remains lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai man vasai t aa ahinis rahai liv laa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: In power, pleasures, beauty, wealth and youth, one gambles his life away.
lines.transliteration: raajaN rangaN roopaN maalaN joban tay joo-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਿਸਆਣਾ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਜੋਿਤ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Bound by the Hukam of God's Command, the dice are thrown; he is just a piece in thegame of chess. ||4||
lines.transliteration: hukmee baaDhay paasai kh ayleh cha-uparh  aykaa saaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖਾ ਿਸਿਰ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਿਜ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The world is clever and wise, but it is deluded by doubt, and forgets the Name; thePandit, the religious scholar, studies the scriptures, but he is still a fool.
lines.transliteration: jag chatur si-aan aa bh aram bh ulaan aa naa-o pandit  parheh gaavaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Name, he dwells upon the Vedas; he writes, but he is confused by his poisonous corruption. ||5|| pMnw 1016
lines.transliteration: naa-o visaareh bayd samaaleh bikh  bhoolay laykh aaree. ||5||

lines.english: He is like the crop planted in the salty soil, or the tree growing on the river bank, or the white clothes sprinkled with dirt.
lines.transliteration: kalar khayt ee tarvar kanth ay baagaa pahirahi kajal jh arai.
