lines.punjabi: ਕਲਰ  ਖੇਤੀ ਤਰਵਰ  ਕੰਠੇ ਬਾਗਾ  ਪਿਹਰਿਹ  ਕਜਲੁ  ਝਰੈ ॥
lines.english: This world is the house of desire; whoever enters it, is burnt down by egotistical pride. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ayhu sansaar tisai kee koth ee jo paisai so garab jarai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਕੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਸੋ ਗਰਿਬ  ਜਰੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Where are all the kings and their subjects? Those who are immersed in duality aredestroyed.
lines.transliteration: ra-yat raajay kahaa sabaa-ay d uhu ant ar so jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਯਿਤ  ਰਾਜੇ ਕਹਾ ਸਬਾਏ  ਦੁਹੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, these are the steps of the ladder, of the Teachings of the True Guru; onlythe Unseen Lord shall remain. ||7||3||11|| mwrU mhlw 3 Gru 5 AstpdI  (1016-4) maaroo mehlaa 3 ghar 5 asatpad ee Maaroo, Third Mehl, Fifth House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1016-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak gur sachay kee pa-orh ee rahsee alakh  nivaasee. ||7||3||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ  ਰਹਸੀ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ॥੭॥੩॥੧੧॥
lines.english: One whose mind is filled with the Lord's Love,
lines.transliteration: jis no paraym man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad sahj subh aa-ay. is intuitively exalted by the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.english: He alone knows the pain of this love; what does anyone else know about its cure?||1||
lines.transliteration: ayhaa vaydan so-ee jaan ai avar ke jaan ai kaaree jee-o. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself unites in His Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay aap milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹਾ ਵੇਦਨ  ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਅਵਰੁ ਿਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself inspires us with His Love.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa pi-aar aapay laa-ay.

lines.english: He alone appreciates the value of Your Love, upon whom You shower Your Grace, O Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraym kee saar so-ee jaanai jis no nad ar tumaaree jee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One whose spiritual vision is awakened - his doubt is driven out.
lines.transliteration: dib darisat jaagai bh aram chukaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-ay.

lines.english: He alone is a Yogi, who understands this way, and contemplates the Word of theGuru's Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so jogee ih jugat pachh aanai gur kai sabad  beechaaree jee-o. ||2||

lines.english: By good destiny, the soul-bride is united with her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sanjogee Dhan pir maylaa hovai.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, she eradicates her evil-mindedness from within.
lines.transliteration: gurmat vichahu d urmat  khovai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ  ਇਹ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: With love, she continually enjoys pleasure with Him; she becomes the beloved of herHusband Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: rang si-o nit ralee-aa maan ai apn ay kant  pi-aaree jee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Other than the True Guru, there is no physician.
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu vaid  na ko-ee.

lines.english: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap niranjan so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਿਨਤ ਰਲੀਆ  ਮਾਣੈ ਅਪਣੇ  ਕੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, evil is conquered, and spiritual wisdom is contemplated.||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai marai mand aa hovai gi-aan beechaaree jee-o. ||4||

lines.english: One who is committed to this most sublime Shabad
lines.transliteration: ayhu sabad saar jis no laa-ay.
gurmukh t arisnaa bh ukh gavaa-ay. becomes Gurmukh, and is rid of thirst and hunger.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਗਆਨ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By one's own efforts, nothing can be accomplished; the Lord, in His Mercy, bestowspower. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapan lee-aa kichh oo na paa-ee-ai kar kirpaa kal Dh aaree jee-o. ||5||

lines.english: The True Guru has revealed the essence of the Shaastras and the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: agam nigam satguroo d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: In His Mercy, He has come into the home of my self.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnai ghar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣ  ਲੀਆ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: In the midst of Maya, the Immaculate Lord is known, by those upon whom Youbestow Your Grace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: anjan maahi niranjan jaataa jin ka-o nad ar tumaaree jee-o. ||6||

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, obtains the essence of reality;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so t at paa-ay.
aapnaa aap vichahu gavaa-ay. he eradictes his self-conceit from within.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਜਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, all are entangled in worldly affairs; consider this in your mind, and see. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu sabh  DhanDh kamaavai vaykh hu man veechaaree jee-o. ||7||

lines.english: Some are deluded by doubt; they strut around egotistically.
lines.transliteration: ik bharam bh oolay fireh ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: Some, as Gurmukh, subdue their egotism.
lines.transliteration: iknaa gurmukh ha-umai maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Attuned to the True Word of the Shabad, they remain detached from the world. Theother ignorant fools wander, confused and deluded by doubt. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad rat ay bairaagee hor bh aram bh ulay gaavaaree jee-o. ||8||

lines.english: Those who have not become Gurmukh, and who have not found the Naam, the Nameof the Lord
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinee naam na paa-i-aa.
manmukh birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. - those self-willed manmukhs waste their lives uselessly.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਹੋਿਰ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In the world hereafter, nothing except the Name will be of any assistance; this is understood by contemplating the Guru. ||9||
lines.transliteration: agai vin naavai ko baylee naahee boojh ai gur beechaaree jee-o. ||9||

lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam is the Giver of peace forever.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad aa sukh -daata.

lines.english: Throughout the four ages, it is known through the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai jug chaaray jaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: He alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||10||1|| pMnw 1017 mwrU mhlw 5 Gru 3 AstpdIAw  (1017-1) maaroo mehlaa 5 ghar 3 asatpad ee-aa Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1017-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jis too d ayveh so-ee paa-ay naanak t at beechaaree jee-o. ||10||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering and roaming through 8.4 million incarnations, you have now been given this human life, so difficult to obtain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh bh aramt ay bh aramt ay dulabh  janam ab paa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ਦੁਲਭ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਬ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You fool! You are attached and clinging to such trivial pleasures!
lines.transliteration: ray moorhay t oo hochh ai ras laptaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਤੂ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਿਸ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar abides with you, but you are engrossed in sin and corruption.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit sang basat  hai tayrai bikh i-aa si-o urjh aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਸਉ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have come to trade in gems and jewels, but you have loaded only barren soil.||2||
lines.transliteration: ratan javayhar banjan aa-i-o kaalar laad  chalaa-i-o. ||2||

lines.english: That home within which you live - you have not kept that home in your thoughts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jih ghar meh t uDh rahnaa basnaa so gh ar cheet  na aa-i-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਬਨਜਿਨ  ਆਇਓ  ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਿਦ  ਚਲਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is immovable, indestructible, the Giver of peace to the soul; and yet you do notsing His Praises, even for an instant. ||4||
lines.transliteration: atal akhand paraan  sukh -daa-ee ik nimakh  nahee t ujh gaa-i-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਹਨਾ  ਬਸਨਾ  ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਚੀਿਤ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You have forgotten that place where you must go; you have not attached your mindto the Lord, even for an instant. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jahaa jaanaa so thaan visaar-i-o ik nimakh  nahee man laa-i-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅਟਲ  ਅਖੰਡ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Gazing upon your children, spouse, household and paraphernalia, you are entangledin them. ||6||
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar garih d aykh samagree is hee meh urjh aa-i-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਣਾ  ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਓ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: As God links the mortals, so are they linked, and so are the deeds they do. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jit ko laa-i-o t it hee laagaa t aisay karam kamaa-i-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਦੇਿਖ ਸਮਗਰ੍ੀ  ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: When He becomes Merciful, then the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, isfound; servant Nanak meditates on God. ||8||1|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1017-8) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ja-o bha-i-o kirpaal t aa saaDh sang paa-i-aa jan naanak barahm Dh i-aa-i-o. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਓ  ਿਤਤ  ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ  ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇਓ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, He has protected me; I have found the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kar anoograhu raakh leeno bh a-i-o saaDh oo sang.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਤਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਧਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: My tongue lovingly chants the Lord's Name; this love is so sweet and intense! ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naam ras rasnaa uchaaray misat goorhaa rang. ||1||

lines.english: He is the place of rest for my mind,
lines.transliteration: mayray maan ko asthaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਨੋ  ਭਇਓ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sakh aa banDh ap ant arjaamee jaan. ||1|| rahaa-o. my friend, companion, associate and relative; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher ofhearts. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਉਚਾਰੈ ਿਮਸਟ  ਗੂੜਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He created the world-ocean; I seek the Sanctuary of that God.
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar jin upaa-i-o saran parabh  kee gahee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I worship and adore God; the Messenger of Death can't say anythingto me. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee parabh araaDh ay jamkankar kichh  na kahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ  ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Emancipation and liberation are at His Door; He is the treasure in the hearts of theSaints.
lines.transliteration: mokh mukat  du-aar jaa kai sant  ridaa bh andaar.

lines.english: The all-knowing Lord and Master shows us the true way of life; He is our Savior andProtector forever. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jugat sujaan  su-aamee sad aa raakh anhaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਪਾਇਓ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Pain, suffering and troubles are eradicated, when the Lord abides in the mind.
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad kalays binsahi jis basai man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ  ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Death, hell and the most horrible dwelling of sin and corruption cannot even touchsuch a person. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mirat narak asthaan bikh -rhay bikh  na pohai t aahi. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਿਰਦਾ  ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures come from the Lord, as do the streams of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  nav niDh  jaa kai amrit aa parvaah.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਦਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is perfect, lofty, unapproachableand unfathomable. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aad ant ay maDh  pooran ooch agam agaah. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਿਬਨਸਿਹ  ਿਜਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas, seekers, angelic beings, silent sages, and the Vedas speak of Him.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik dayv mun jan bayd  karahi uchaar.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, celestial peace is enjoyed; He hasno end or limitation. ||6||
lines.transliteration: simar su-aamee sukh sahj bh uNcheh nahee ant  paaraavaar. ||6||

lines.english: Countless sins are erased in an instant, meditating on the Benevolent Lord within theheart.
lines.transliteration: anik paraachhat  miteh kh in meh rid ai jap bh agvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਧ ਪੂਰਨ  ਊਚ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਹ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Such a person becomes the purest of the pure, and is blessed with the merits ofmillions of donations to charity and cleansing baths. ||7||
lines.transliteration: paavnaa tay mahaa paavan kot d aan isnaan. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਦੇਵ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਬੇਦ ਕਰਿਹ  ਉਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: God is power, intellect, understanding, the breath of life, wealth, and everything forthe Saints.
lines.transliteration: bal buDh suDh  paraan  sarbas sant naa kee raas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਭੁੰਚਿਹ  ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: May I never forget Him from my mind, even for an instant - this is Nanak's prayer.||8||2|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1017-17) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bisar naahee nimakh man t ay naanak kee ard aas. ||8||2||

lines.english: The sharp tool cuts down the tree, but it does not feel anger in its mind.
lines.transliteration: sastar t eekhan kaat d aari-o man na keeno ros.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਨਾ  ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਾਵਨ  ਕੋਿਟ ਦਾਨ  ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੭॥
lines.english: It serves the purpose of the cutter, and does not blame him at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaaj u-aa ko lay savaari-o til na d eeno d os. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਲ ਬੁਿਧ ਸੁਿਧ ਪਰਾਣ  ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਸੰਤਨਾ  ਕੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, continually, continuously, meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray raam ra-o nit neet .

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is merciful, divine and compassionate. Listen - this is the way of the Saints. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1018
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal d ayv kirpaal gobind  sun sant naa kee reet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He plants his feet in the boat, and then sits down in it; the fatigue of his body is relieved.
lines.transliteration: charan t alai ugaahi baisi-o saram na rahi-o sareer.

lines.english: The great ocean does not even affect him; in an instant, he arrives on the othershore. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mahaa saagar nah vi-aapai khineh ut ri-o teer. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਤਲੈ ਉਗਾਿਹ  ਬੈਿਸਓ  ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਨ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰੀਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Sandalwood, aloe, and camphor-paste - the earth does not love them.
lines.transliteration: chandan agar kapoor laypan t is sangay nahee pareet .

lines.english: But it doesn't mind, if someone digs it up bit by bit, and applies manure and urine to it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bistaa mootar kh od til til man na manee bipreet . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨ  ਅਗਰ  ਕਪੂਰ  ਲੇਪਨ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: High and low, bad and good - the comforting canopy of the sky stretches evenly overall.
lines.transliteration: ooch neech bikaar sukarit saNlgan sabh  sukh  chhatar.

lines.english: It knows nothing of friend and enemy; all beings are alike to it. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mitar sat ar na kachh oo jaanai sarab jee-a samat . ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤ  ਸੰਲਗਨ  ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਛਤਰ੍ ॥
lines.english: Blazing with its dazzling light, the sun rises, and dispels the darkness.
lines.transliteration: kar pargaas parchand pargati-o anDhkaar binaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਸਤਰ੍ੁ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਅ  ਸਮਤ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Touching both the pure and the impure, it harbors no hatred to any. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pavitar apvit reh kiran  laagay man na bh a-i-o bikh aad. ||5||

lines.english: The cool and fragrant wind gently blows upon all places alike.
lines.transliteration: seet mand  suganDh  chali-o sarab thaan samaan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਅਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਹ  ਿਕਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ  ਮਿਨ ਨ ਭਇਓ  ਿਬਖਾਦੁ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Wherever anything is, it touches it there, and does not hesitate a bit. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jahaa saa kichh t ahaa laagi-o t il na sankaa maan. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਸੁਗੰਧ  ਚਿਲਓ  ਸਰਬ  ਥਾਨ ਸਮਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Good or bad, whoever comes close to the fire - his cold is taken away.
lines.transliteration: subhaa-ay abh aa-ay jo nikat aavai seet  taa kaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹਾ ਸਾ ਿਕਛੁ ਤਹਾ ਲਾਿਗਓ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਸੰਕਾ ਮਾਨ ॥੬॥
lines.english: It knows nothing of its own or others'; it is constant in the same quality. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aap par kaa kachh na jaan ai sad aa sahj subh aa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਅਭਾਇ  ਜੁ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਆਵੈ  ਸੀਤੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever seeks the Sancuary of the feet of the Sublime Lord - his mind is attuned to the Love of the Beloved.
lines.transliteration: charan saran  sanaath ih man rang raat ay laal.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, O Nanak, Godbecomes merciful to us. ||8||3|| mwrU mhlw 5 Gru 4 AstpdIAw  (1018-9) maaroo mehlaa 5 ghar 4 asatpad ee-aa Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1018-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gopaal gun nit  gaa-o naanak bh a-ay parabh  kirpaal. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਣ  ਸਨਾਥ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਲਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Moonlight, moonlight - in the courtyard of the mind, let the moonlight of God shinedown. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chaadnaa chaad an aaNgan parabh  jee-o ant ar chaad naa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਤ ਗਾਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: Meditation, meditation - sublime is meditation on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.||2||
lines.transliteration: aaraaDhnaa araaDh an neekaa har har naam araaDh anaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Renunciation, renunciation - noble is the renunciation of sexual desire, anger andgreed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ti-aaganaa t i-aagan neekaa kaam kroDh  lobh ti-aaganaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਦਨਾ  ਚਾਦਨੁ ਆਂਗਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਚਾਦਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Begging, begging - it is noble to beg for the Lord's Praise from the Guru. ||4||
lines.transliteration: maagnaa maagan neekaa har jas gur tay maagnaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਰਾਧਨਾ  ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Vigils, vigils - sublime is the vigil spent singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jaagnaa jaagan neekaa har keertan meh jaagnaa. ||5||

lines.english: Attachment, attachment - sublime is the attachment of the mind to the Guru's Feet. ||6||
lines.transliteration: laagnaa laagan neekaa gur charnee man laagnaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਗਨਾ  ਮਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He alone is blessed with this way of life, upon whose forehead such destiny isrecorded. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ih biDh t iseh paraapat ay jaa kai mast ak bh aagnaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਗਨਾ  ਜਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨ  ਮਿਹ ਜਾਗਨਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, everything is sublime and noble, for one who enters the Sanctuary ofGod. ||8||1||4|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1018-14) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis sabh  kichh  neekaa jo parabh  kee sarnaaganaa. ||8||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਗਨਾ  ਲਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਨਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Please come, O please come into the home of my heart, that I may hear with my earsthe Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aa-o jee too aa-o hamaarai har jas sarvan sunaavanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪਰਾਪਤੇ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗਨਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: With your coming, my soul and body are rejuvenated, and I sing with you the Lord's Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDh aavat  mayraa man t an hari-aa har jas t um sang gaavnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨੀਕਾ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਗਨਾ  ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saint, the Lord dwells within the heart, and the love of duality iseradicated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant kirpaa t ay hird ai vaasai d oojaa bh aa-o mitaavanaa. ||2||

lines.english: By the kindness of the devotee, the intellect is enlightened, and pain and evil-mindedness are eradicated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  da-i-aa t ay buDh  pargaasai d urmat  dookh tajaavanaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਉ  ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਉ  ਹਮਾਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਸੁਨਾਵਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is sanctified, and is no longer consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||4||
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytat hot puneet aa punrap garabh  na paavnaa. ||4||

lines.english: The nine treasures, wealth and miraculous spiritual powers are obtained, by one whois pleasing to Your mind. ||5||
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh riDh  siDh paa-ee jo t umrai man bh aavnaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਤ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਗਾਵਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Saint, I have no place of rest at all; I cannot think of any other place togo. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sant binaa mai thaa-o na ko-ee avar na soojh ai jaavnaa. ||6||

lines.english: I am unworthy; no one gives me sanctuary. But in the Society of the Saints, I mergein God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mohi nirgun ka-o ko-ay na raakhai sant aa sang samaavanaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਦਇਆ  ਤੇ ਬੁਿਧ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਦੂਖ ਤਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed this miracle; within my mind, I enjoy the Lord,Har, Har. ||8||2||5|| pMnw 1019 mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1019-1) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur chalat d ikhaa-i-aa man maDh ay har har raavnaa. ||8||2||5||

lines.english: Fruitful is the life, the life of one who hears about the Lord, and chants and meditateson Him; he lives forever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeevnaa safal jeevan sun har jap jap sad jeevnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨਾ  ਸਫਲ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਸੁਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The real drink is that which satisfies the mind; this drink is the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: peevnaa jit man aagh aavai naam amrit  ras peevnaa. ||1||

lines.english: The real food is that which will never leave you hungry again; it will leave youcontented and satisfied forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khaavnaa jit  bhookh na laagai sant okh sadaa taripteevnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਵਨਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The real clothes are those which protect your honor before the Transcendent Lord,and do not leave you naked ever again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: painnaa rakh  pat parmaysur fir naagay nahee theevnaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਵਨਾ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸੰਤੋਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੀਵਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The real enjoyment within the mind is to be absorbed in the sublime essence of theLord, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bhognaa man maDh ay har ras sant sangat  meh leevnaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਰਖੁ ਪਿਤ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਨਾਗੇ  ਨਹੀ ਥੀਵਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Sew devotional worship to the Lord into the mind, without any needle or thread. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin taagay bin soo-ee aanee man har bh agtee sang seevnaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਭੋਗਨਾ  ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਲੀਵਨਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Imbued and intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, this experience will never wear off again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: maati-aa har ras meh raat ay tis bahurh  na kabhoo a-ukh eevanaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੂਈ ਆਨੀ  ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੀਵਨਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: One is blessed with all treasures, when God, in His Mercy, gives them. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mili-o tis sarab niDh aanaa parabh  kirpaal jis d eevnaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਤਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਤੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਅਉਖੀਵਨਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, service to the Saints beings peace; I drink in the wash water of the feet ofthe Saints. ||8||3||6|| mwrU mhlw 5 Gru 8 AMjulIAw  (1019-7) maaroo mehlaa 5 ghar 8 anjulee-aa Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Anjulees ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1019-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sukh naanak sant an kee sayvaa charan  sant Dho-ay peevnaa. ||8||3||6||

lines.english: The household which is filled with abundance - that household suffers anxiety.
lines.transliteration: jis garihi bahut t isai garihi chint aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣ  ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਨਾ  ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
lines.english: One whose household has little, wanders around searching for more.
lines.transliteration: jis garihi thoree so firai bharmant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅੰਜੁਲੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is happy and at peace, who is liberated from both conditions. ||1||
lines.transliteration: duhoo bivasthaa t ay jo mukt aa so-ee suhaylaa bh aalee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: Householders and kings fall into hell, along with renunciates and angry men,
lines.transliteration: garih raaj meh narak udaas karoDh aa.
baho biDh bayd  paath  sabh  soDh aa. and all those who study and recite the Vedas in so many ways.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਹੂ ਿਬਵਸਥਾ  ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਭਾਲੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Perfect is the work of that humble servant, who remains unattached while in the body. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dayhee meh jo rahai alipat aa tis jan kee pooran gh aalee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: The mortal sleeps, even while he is awake; he is being plundered by doubt.
lines.transliteration: jaagat soot aa bh aram vigoot aa.

lines.english: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, friend.
lines.transliteration: bin gur mukat na ho-ee-ai meet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਅਿਲਪਤਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਘਾਲੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the bonds of egotism are released, and one comes to behold the One and only Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang t uteh ha-o banDh an ayko ayk nihaalee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: Doing deeds, one is placed in bondage; but if he does not act, he is slandered.
lines.transliteration: karam karai ta banDh aa nah karai t a nind aa.

lines.english: Intoxicated with emotional attachment, the mind is afflicted with anxiety.
lines.transliteration: moh magan man vi-aapi-aa chindaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਟਿਹ  ਹਉ ਬੰਧਨ  ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਿਨਹਾਲੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who looks alike upon pleasure and pain, by Guru's Grace, sees the Lord in eachand every heart. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad sukh  dukh sam jaan ai ghat ghat raam hi-aalee-ai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੈ ਤ ਬੰਧਾ ਨਹ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Within the world, one is afflicted by skepticism;
lines.transliteration: sansaarai meh sahsaa bi-aapai.
akath kathaa agochar nahee jaapai. he does not know the imperceptible Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਜਾਣੈ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਹਆਲੀਐ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Lord cherishes himas His child. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaa-ay so-ee boojh ai oh baalak vaagee paalee-ai. ||5||

lines.english: He may try to abandon Maya, but he is not released.
lines.transliteration: chhod bahai t a-o chh ootai naahee.

lines.english: If he collects things, then his mind is afraid of losing them.
lines.transliteration: ja-o sanchai ta-o bh a-o man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਲਕ  ਵਾਗੀ  ਪਾਲੀਐ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: I wave the fly-brush over that holy person, whose honor is protected in the midst of Maya. ||6||
lines.transliteration: is hee meh jis kee pat raakh ai tis saaDh oo cha-ur dh aalee-ai. ||6||

lines.english: He alone is a warrior hero, who remains dead to the world.
lines.transliteration: jo sooraa tis hee ho-ay marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who runs away will wander in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: jo bhaagai t is jonee firn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਉਰੁ ਢਾਲੀਐ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Whatever happens, accept that as good. Realize the Hukam of His Command, andyour evil-mindedness will be burnt away. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jo vartaa-ay so-ee bh al maanai bujh  hukmai d urmat  jaalee-ai. ||7||

lines.english: Whatever He links us to, to that we are linked.
lines.transliteration: jit jit laaveh t it tit lagnaa.

lines.english: He acts, and does, and watches over His Creation.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai apn ay jachnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ  ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੁਿਝ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਾਲੀਐ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of peace, the Perfect Lord of Nanak; as You grant Your blessings, Idwell upon Your Name. ||8||1||7|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1019-18) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay pooran sukh-d aatay too deh ta naam samaalee-ai. ||8||1||7||

lines.english: Beneath the tree, all beings have gathered.
lines.transliteration: birkhai hayth  sabh  jant ikthay.

lines.english: Some are hot-headed, and some speak very sweetly.
lines.transliteration: ik tatay ik bolan mith ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ  ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
lines.english: Sunset has come, and they rise up and depart; their days have run their course and expired. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asat ud ot bha-i-aa uth  chalay ji-o ji-o a-oDh  vihaan ee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Those who committed sins are sure to be ruined.
lines.transliteration: paap karaydarh  sarpar muth ay.

lines.english: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, seizes and tortures them. pMnw 1020
lines.transliteration: ajraa-eel farhay farh  kuthay.

lines.english: They are consigned to hell by the Creator Lord, and the Accountant calls them to give their account. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dojak paa-ay sirjan haarai laykh aa mangai baan ee-aa. ||2||

lines.english: No brothers or sisters can go with them.
lines.transliteration: sang na ko-ee bha-ee-aa baybaa.

lines.english: Leaving behind their property, youth and wealth, they march off.
lines.transliteration: maal joban Dhan chh od vanj aysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਰੀਮ  ਨ ਜਾਤੋ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਤਲ  ਪੀੜੇ ਿਜਉ  ਘਾਣੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They do not know the kind and compassionate Lord; they shall be crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karan kareem na jaat o kart aa til peerh ay ji-o gh aanee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: You happily, cheerfully steal the possessions of others,
lines.transliteration: khus kh us laid aa vasat  paraa-ee.
vaykhai sun ay tayrai naal kh udaa-ee. but the Lord God is with you, watching and listening.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਲਿਬ  ਪਇਆ  ਖਾਤ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਅਗਲੀ  ਗਲ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Through worldly greed, you have fallen into the pit; you know nothing of the future.||4||
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa lab pa-i-aa kh aat andar aglee gal na jaan ee-aa. ||4||

lines.english: You shall be born and born again, and die and die again, only to be reincarnatedagain.
lines.transliteration: jam jam marai marai fir jammai.

lines.english: You shall suffer terrible punishment, on your way to the land beyond.
lines.transliteration: bahut sajaa-ay pa-i-aa d ays lammai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਿਤਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹੈ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The mortal does not know the One who created him; he is blind, and so he shallsuffer. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jin keetaa t isai na jaan ee anDh aa taa dukh sahai paraan ee-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Forgetting the Creator Lord, he is ruined.
lines.transliteration: khaalak thaavhu bh ulaa muth aa.

lines.english: The drama of the world is bad; it brings sadness and then happiness.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kh ayl buraa ruth  tuthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਦਕੁ  ਸਬੂਰੀ  ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਵਤੈ ਆਪਣ  ਭਾਣੀਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who does not meet the Saint does not have faith or contentment; he wanders just as he pleases. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sidak sabooree sant  na mili-o vat ai aapan  bhaanee-aa. ||6||

lines.english: The Lord Himself stages all this drama. Some, he lifts up, and some he throws intothe waves.
lines.transliteration: ma-ulaa khayl karay sabh  aapay. ik kadh ay ik lahar vi-aapay.

lines.english: As He makes them dance, so do they dance. Everyone lives their lives according totheir past actions. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ji-o nachaa-ay ti-o t i-o nachan sir sir kirat  vihaan ee-aa. ||7||

lines.english: When the Lord and Master grants His Grace, then we meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: mihar karay taa kh asam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, one is not consigned to hell.
lines.transliteration: santaa sangat  narak na paa-ee.

lines.english: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord; hecontinually sings the songs of Your Glories. ||8||2||8||12||20|| mwrU solhy mhlw 1  (1020-10) maaroo solhay mehlaa 1 Maaroo, Solahas, First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1020-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: amrit naam d aan naanak ka-o gun  geetaa nit  vakh aanee-aa. ||8||2||8||12||20||

lines.english: The True Lord is True; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: saachaa sach so-ee avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੀਤਾ  ਿਨਤ ਵਖਾਣੀਆ  ॥੮॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥੨੦॥
lines.english: He who created, shall in the end destroy.
lines.transliteration: jin sirjee tin hee fun go-ee.

lines.english: As it pleases You, so You keep me, and so I remain; what excuse could I offer to You? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh o rahn aa tum si-o ki-aa mukraa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay aap khapaa-ay.

lines.english: You yourself link each and every person to their tasks.
lines.transliteration: aapay sir sir DhanDh ai laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਿਸਉ ਿਕਆ  ਮੁਕਰਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You contemplate Yourself, You Yourself make us worthy; You Yourself place us on thePath. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay veechaaree gunkaaree aapay maarag laa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: You Yourself are all-wise, You Yourself are all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: aapay daanaa aapay beenaa.

lines.english: You Yourself created the Universe, and You are pleased.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap upaa-ay pateenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the air, water and fire; You Yourself unite in Union. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay pa-un paan ee baisant ar aapay mayl milaa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: You Yourself are the moon, the sun, the most perfect of the perfect.
lines.transliteration: aapay sas sooraa pooro pooraa.

lines.english: You Yourself are spiritual wisdom, meditation, and the Guru, the Warrior Hero.
lines.transliteration: aapay gi-aan Dhi-aan gur sooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death, and his noose of death, cannot touch one, who is lovinglyfocused on You, O True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai saachay si-o liv laa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.english: You Yourself are the male, and You Yourself are the female.
lines.transliteration: aapay purakh aapay hee naaree.

lines.english: You Yourself are the chess-board, and You Yourself are the chessman.
lines.transliteration: aapay paasaa aapay saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: You Yourself staged the drama in the arena of the world, and You Yourself evaluatethe players. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay pirh baaDh ee jag kh aylai aapay keemat  paa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.english: You Yourself are the bumble bee, the flower, the fruit and the tree.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhavar ful fal t arvar.

lines.english: You Yourself are the water, the desert, the ocean and the pool.
lines.transliteration: aapay jal thal saagar sarvar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਪੜ ਬਾਧੀ  ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the great fish, the tortoise, the Cause of causes; Your form cannotbe known. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapay machh kachh  karneekar t ayraa roop na lakh -naa jaa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.english: You Yourself are the day, and You Yourself are the night.
lines.transliteration: aapay dinas aapay hee rain ee.

lines.english: You Yourself are pleased by the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: aap pateejai gur kee bain ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀਕਰ ੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the unstruck sound current resounds, night and day; in each and every heart, the Word of the Shabad, echoesYour Will. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  anaahad  an-din ghat ghat sabad  rajaa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.english: You Yourself are the jewel, incomparably beautiful and priceless.
lines.transliteration: aapay ratan anoop amolo.

lines.english: You Yourself are the Assessor, the Perfect Weigher. pMnw 1021
lines.transliteration: aapay parkhay pooraa t olo.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਕਿਸ ਬਖਸੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇ ਲੈ ਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: You Yourself test and forgive. You Yourself give and take, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aapay kis hee kas bakhsay aapay d ay lai bh aa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.english: He Himself is the bow, and He Himself is the archer.
lines.transliteration: aapay Dhanakh  aapay sarbaan aa.

lines.english: He Himself is all-wise, beautiful and all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: aapay sugharh  saroop si-aan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤਾ  ਬਕਤਾ  ਸੁਣਤਾ  ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: He is the speaker, the orator and the listener. He Himself made what is made. ||9||
lines.transliteration: kahtaa bakt aa sunt aa so-ee aapay ban at banaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.english: Air is the Guru, and water is known to be the father.
lines.transliteration: pa-un guroo paan ee pit  jaataa.

lines.english: The womb of the great mother earth gives birth to all.
lines.transliteration: udar sanjogee Dh artee maat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ  ਦਾਇਆ  ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Night and day are the two nurses, male and female; the world plays in this play. ||10||
lines.transliteration: rain d inas d u-ay d aa-ee d aa-i-aa jag kh aylai kh aylaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.english: You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.
lines.transliteration: aapay machhulee aapay jaalaa.

lines.english: You Yourself are the cows, and You yourself are their keeper.
lines.transliteration: aapay ga-oo aapay rakhvaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਜਿਗ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਜੈਸੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Your Light fills all the beings of the world; they walk according to Your Command, OGod. ||11||
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa jag jot t umaaree jaisee parabh  furmaa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.english: You Yourself are the Yogi, and You Yourself are the enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: aapay jogee aapay bhogee.

lines.english: You Yourself are the reveller; You form the supreme Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay rasee-aa param sanjogee.

lines.english: You Yourself are speechless, formless and fearless, absorbed in the primal ecstasy ofdeep meditation. ||12||
lines.transliteration: aapay vaybaanee nirankaaree nirbh a-o taarhee laa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.english: The sources of creation and speech are contained within You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: khaan ee ban ee tujheh samaan ee.

lines.english: All that is seen, is coming and going.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai sabh  aavan  jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: They are the true bankers and traders, whom the True Guru has inspired to understand. ||13||
lines.transliteration: say-ee saah sachay vaapaaree satgur boojh  bujhaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is understood through the Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sabad bujh aa-ay sat gur pooraa.

lines.english: The True Lord is overflowing with all powers.
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa saachay bharpooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਫਿਰਓ  ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਤਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: You are beyond our grasp, and forever independent. You do not have even an iota ofgreed. ||14||
lines.transliteration: afri-o vayparvaahu sadaa t oo naa t is til na t amaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.english: Birth and death are meaningless, for those
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal bha-ay d ayvaanay.
sabad sahj ras ant ar maanay. who enjoy the sublime celestial essence of the Shabad within their minds.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੁਕਿਤ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਵਰਦਾਤਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Giver of liberation, satisfaction and blessings, to those devotees wholove Him in their minds. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aapay mukat t aripat  vardaataa bh agat bhaa-ay man bh aa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.english: He Himself is immaculate; by contact with the Guru, spiritual wisdom is obtained.
lines.transliteration: aap niraalam gur gam gi-aanaa.

lines.english: Whatever is seen, shall merge into You.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai t ujh maahi samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨੀਚੁ ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਦਿਰ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak, the lowly, begs for charity at Your Door; please, bless him with the glorious greatness of Your Name. ||16||1|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1021-10) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak neech bhikh i-aa d ar jaachai mai d eejai naam vadaa-ee hay. ||16||1||

lines.english: He Himself is the earth, the mythical bull which supports it and the Akaashic ethers.
lines.transliteration: aapay Dhart ee Dh a-ul akaasaN.

lines.english: The True Lord Himself reveals His Glorious Virtues.
lines.transliteration: aapay saachay gun pargaasaN.

lines.english: He Himself is celibate, chaste and contented; He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jatee sat ee sant okhee aapay aapay kaar kamaa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He who created the creation, beholds what He has created.
lines.transliteration: jis karnaa so kar kar vaykh ai.

lines.english: No one can erase the Inscription of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na maytai saachay laykhai.

lines.english: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes; He Himself is the One who bestowsglorious greatness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay aapay aapay day vadi-aa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The five thieves cause the fickle consciousness to waver.
lines.transliteration: panch chor chanchal chit chaaleh.

lines.english: It looks into the homes of others, but does not search its own home.
lines.transliteration: par ghar joheh gh ar nahee bh aaleh.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਹਿਹ  ਘਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The body-village crumbles into dust; without the Word of the Shabad, one's honor is lost. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar dhahai dh eh dh ayree bin sabd ai pat  jaa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ ਢਿਹ ਢੇਰੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਪਿਤ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who realizes the Lord through the Guru, comprehends the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: gur tay boojh ai taribhavan soojh ai.

lines.english: He subdues his desires, and struggles with his mind.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maar manai si-o loojhai.

lines.english: Those who serve You, become just like You; O Fearless Lord, You are their best friend from infancy. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  sayveh say t uDh hee jayhay nirbh a-o baal sakh aa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਜੇਹੇ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਬਾਲ  ਸਖਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the heavenly realms, this world and the nether regions of theunderworld.
lines.transliteration: aapay surag machh pa-i-aalaa.

lines.english: You Yourself are the embodiment of light, forever young.
lines.transliteration: aapay jot saroopee baalaa.

lines.english: With matted hair, and a horrible, dreadful form, still, You have no form or feature.||5||
lines.transliteration: jataa bikat bikraal saroopee roop na raykh-i-aa kaa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਟਾ ਿਬਕਟ  ਿਬਕਰਾਲ  ਸਰੂਪੀ  ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਕਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Vedas and the Bible do not know the mystery of God.
lines.transliteration: bayd kat aybee bh ayd na jaat aa.

lines.english: He has no mother, father, child or brother.
lines.transliteration: naa tis maat  pitaa sut  bharaataa.

lines.english: He created all the mountains, and levels them again; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saglay sail upaa-ay samaa-ay alakh na lakh -naa jaa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਸੈਲ ਉਪਾਇ  ਸਮਾਏ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: I have grown weary of making so many friends.
lines.transliteration: kar kar thaakee meet gh anayray.

lines.english: No one can rid me of my sins and mistakes.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na kaatai avgun mayray.

lines.english: God is the Supreme Lord and Master of all the angels and mortal beings; blessed withHis Love, their fear is dispelled. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sur nar naath saahib sabhnaa sir bh aa-ay milai bh a-o jaa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਭਾਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: He puts back on the Path those who have wandered and strayed.
lines.transliteration: bhoolay chookay maarag paavahi.

lines.english: You Yourself make them stray, and You teach them again.
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa-ay t oohai samjh aavahi.

lines.english: I cannot see anything except the Name. Through the Name comes salvation and merit. ||8|| pMnw 1022
lines.transliteration: bin naavai mai avar na deesai naavhu gat  mit paa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.english: The Ganges, the Jamunaa where Krishna played, Kaydar Naat'h,
lines.transliteration: gangaa jamunaa kayl kaydaaraa.

lines.english: Benares, Kanchivaram, Puri, Dwaarkaa,
lines.transliteration: kaasee kaaNtee puree d u-aaraa.

lines.english: Ganga Saagar where the Ganges empties into the ocean, Trivaynee where the three rivers come together, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, are all mergedin the Lord's Being. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gangaa saagar baynee sangam ath sath ank samaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੰਗਾ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਣੀ  ਸੰਗਮੁ  ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Siddha, the seeker, in meditative contemplation.
lines.transliteration: aapay siDh saaDh ik veechaaree.

lines.english: He Himself is the King and the Council.
lines.transliteration: aapay raajan panchaa kaaree.

lines.english: God Himself, the wise Judge, sits on the throne; He takes away doubt, duality andfear. ||10||
lines.transliteration: takhat bahai ad lee parabh  aapay bh aram bh ayd bha-o jaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਤਖਿਤ  ਬਹੈ ਅਦਲੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Qazi; He Himself is the Mullah.
lines.transliteration: aapay kaajee aapay mulaa.

lines.english: He Himself is infallible; He never makes mistakes.
lines.transliteration: aap abhul na kabhoo bh ulaa.

lines.english: He Himself is the Giver of Grace, compassion and honor; He is no one's enemy. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aapay mihar da-i-aapat  daataa naa kisai ko bairaa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਮਹਰ  ਦਇਆਪਿਤ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾ ਿਕਸੈ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Whoever He forgives, He blesses with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: jis bakhsay t is day vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: He is the Giver of all; He does not have even an iota of greed.
lines.transliteration: sabhsai d aataa til na t amaa-ee.

lines.english: The Immaculate Lord is all pervading, permeating everywhere, both hidden and manifest. ||12||
lines.transliteration: bharpur Dh aar rahi-aa nihkayval gupat  pargat sabh  thaa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਪੁਿਰ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲੁ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: How can I praise the inaccessible, infinite Lord?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa saalaahee agam apaarai.

lines.english: The True Creator Lord is the Enemy of ego.
lines.transliteration: saachay sirjanhaar muraarai.

lines.english: He unites those whom He blesses with His Gr ace; uniting them in His Union, they are united. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay t is maylay mayl milai maylaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva stand at His Door;
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays du-aarai.
oobhay sayveh alakh  apaarai. they serve the unseen, infinite Lord.

lines.english: Millions of others can be seen crying at His door; I cannot even estimate theirnumbers. ||14||
lines.transliteration: hor kaytee d ar deesai billaad ee mai gan at na aavai kaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ  ਦਿਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਿਬਲਲਾਦੀ  ਮੈ ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਕਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: True is the Kirtan of His Praise, and True is the Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: saachee keerat saachee ban ee.

lines.english: I can see no other in the Vedas and the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: hor na deesai bayd  puraan ee.

lines.english: Truth is my capital; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. I have no other support at all. ||15||
lines.transliteration: poonjee saach sachay gun gaavaa mai Dh ar hor na kaa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਮੈ ਧਰ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: In each and every age, the True Lord is, and shall always be.
lines.transliteration: jug jug saachaa hai bhee hosee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
lines.english: Who has not died? Who shall not die?
lines.transliteration: ka-un na moo-aa ka-un  na marsee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ  ਨ ਮਰਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak the lowly offers this prayer; see Him within your own self, and lovingly focus onthe Lord. ||16||2|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1022-10) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak neech kahai baynantee d ar daykhhu liv laa-ee hay. ||16||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਦਿਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
lines.english: In duality and evil-mindedness, the soul-bride is blind and deaf.
lines.transliteration: doojee d urmat  annee bolee.

lines.english: She wears the dress of sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh kee kachee cholee.

lines.english: Her Husband Lord is within the home of her own heart, but she does not know Him; without her Husband Lord, she cannot go to sleep. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghar var sahj na jaan ai chh ohar bin pir need  na paa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: The great fire of desire blazes within her.
lines.transliteration: antar agan jalai bh atkaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਛੋਹਿਰ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਨੀਦ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh looks around in the four directions.
lines.transliteration: manmukh t akay kundaa chaaray.

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, how can she find peace? Glorious greatness rests in the hands of the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay ki-o sukh  paa-ee-ai saachay haath vadaa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: Eradicating sexual desire, anger and egotism,
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਚੇ ਹਾਿਥ  ਵਡਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taskar panch sabad  sangh aaray. she destroys the five thieves through the Word of the Shabad.

lines.english: Taking up the sword of spiritual wisdom, she struggles with her mind, and hope anddesire are smoothed over in her mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan kharh ag lai man si-o loojh ai mansaa maneh samaa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: From the union of the mother's egg and the father's sperm,
lines.transliteration: maa kee rakat pit aa bid  Dhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ  ਲੈ ਮਨ ਿਸਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: moorat soorat  kar aapaaraa. the form of infinite beauty has been created.

lines.english: The blessings of light all come from You; You are the Creator Lord, pervading everywhere. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jot daat jaytee sabh  tayree t oo kart aa sabh  thaa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.english: You have created birth and death.
lines.transliteration: tujh hee kee-aa jaman  marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਜੇਤੀ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਠਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Why should anyone fear, if they come to understand through the Guru?
lines.transliteration: gur tay samajh  parhee ki-aa darn aa.

lines.english: When You, O Merciful Lord, look with Your kindness, then pain and suffering leave thebody. ||5||
lines.transliteration: too da-i-aal d a-i-aa kar d aykheh dukh darad sareerahu jaa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.english: One who sits in the home of his own self, eats his own fears.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar bais rahay bh a-o kh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ay thaak rahaa-i-aa. He quiets and holds his wandering mind still.
His heart-lotus blossoms forth in the overflowing green pool, and the Lord of his soulbecomes his companion and helper. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kamal bigaas haray sar subhar aat am raam sakh aa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.english: With their death already ordained, mortals come into this world.
lines.transliteration: maran likh aa-ay mandal meh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਲ  ਿਬਗਾਸ  ਹਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ  ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: How can they remain here? They have to go to the world beyond.
lines.transliteration: ki-o rahee-ai chalnaa parthaa-ay.

lines.english: True is the Lord's Command; the true ones dwell in the eternal city. The True Lordblesses them with glorious greatness. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar sachay amraa pur so sach milai vadaa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.english: He Himself created the whole world.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-i-aa jagat sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਮਰਾ  ਪੁਿਰ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The One who made it, assigns the tasks to it. pMnw 1023
lines.transliteration: jin siri-aa tin Dh anDhai laa-i-aa.

lines.english: I cannot see any other above the True Lord. The True Lord does the appraisal. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sachai oopar avar na deesai saachay keemat  paa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਊਪਿਰ  ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: In this green pasture, the mortal stays only a few days.
lines.transliteration: aithai go-ilrhaa d in chaaray.

lines.english: He plays and frolics in utter darkness.
lines.transliteration: khayl t amaasaa Dh unDh ookaaray.

lines.english: The jugglers have staged their show, and left, like people mumbling in a dream. ||9||
lines.transliteration: baajee khayl ga-ay baajeegar ji-o nis supnai bh akhlaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਜੀ  ਖੇਿਲ ਗਏ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ  ਿਜਉ ਿਨਿਸ  ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਭਖਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: They alone are blessed with glorious greatness at the Lord's throne,
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o t akhat milee vadi-aa-ee.
nirbha-o man vasi-aa liv laa-ee. who enshrine the fearless Lord in their minds, and lovingly center themselves on Him.

lines.english: In the galaxies and solar systems, nether regions, celestial realms and the three worlds, the Lord is in the primal void of deep absorption. ||10||
lines.transliteration: khandee barahmandee paat aalee puree-ee t aribhavan taarhee laa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡੀ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡੀ  ਪਾਤਾਲੀ  ਪੁਰੀਈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: True is the village, and true is the throne,
lines.transliteration: saachee nagree takh at sachaavaa.
gurmukh saach milai sukh  paavaa. of those Gurmukhs who meet with the True Lord, and find peace.

lines.english: In Truth, seated upon the true throne, they are blessed with glorious greatness; theiregotism is eradicated, along with the calculation of their account. ||11||
lines.transliteration: saachay saachai takh at vadaa-ee ha-umai gan at gavaa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਿਤ ਵਡਾਈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਣਤ  ਗਵਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Calculating its account, the soul becomes anxious.
lines.transliteration: ganat  ganee-ai sahsaa jee-ai.

lines.english: How can one find peace, through duality and the three gunas - the three qualities?
lines.transliteration: ki-o sukh paavai d oo-ai t ee-ai.

lines.english: The One Lord is immaculate and formless, the Great Giver; through the Perfect Guru,honor is obtained. ||12||
lines.transliteration: nirmal ayk niranjan daat aa gur pooray t ay pat  paa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਏਕੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: In each and every age, very rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jug jug virlee gurmukh jaat aa.

lines.english: Their minds are imbued with the True, all-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachaa rav rahi-aa man raataa.

lines.english: Seeking His Shelter, they find peace, and their minds and bodies are not stained with filth. ||13||
lines.transliteration: tis kee ot gahee sukh  paa-i-aa man t an mail na kaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Their tongues are imbued with the True Lord, the source of nectar;
lines.transliteration: jeebh rasaa-in  saachai raat ee.
har parabh sangee bh a-o na bh araatee. abiding with the Lord God, they have no fear or doubt.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੰਗੀ  ਭਉ ਨ ਭਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, their ears are satisfied, and their light mergesinto the Light. ||14||
lines.transliteration: sarvan sarot  rajay gurbaan ee jot ee jot  milaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਣ  ਸਰ੍ੋਤ ਰਜੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Carefully, carefully, I place my feet upon the ground.
lines.transliteration: rakh rakh  pair Dh aray pa-o Dh arnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਖ ਰਿਖ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੇ ਪਉ ਧਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I go, I behold Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  daykh-a-u t ayree sarn aa.

lines.english: Whether You grant me pain or pleasure, You are pleasing to my mind. I am in harmony with You. ||15||
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  deh toohai man bh aaveh t ujh hee si-o ban  aa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਿਹ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਿਸਉ ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: No one is anyone's companion or helper at the very last moment;
lines.transliteration: ant kaal ko baylee naahee.
gurmukh jaat aa tuDh saalaahee. as Gurmukh, I realize You and praise You.

lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, I am detached; in the home of my own self deep within, I am absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||16||3|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1023-11) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay bairaagee nij gh ar taarhee laa-ee hay. ||16||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
lines.english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You are infinite andincomparable.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee apar apaaray.

lines.english: You are my primal, immaculate Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: aad niranjan kh asam hamaaray.

lines.english: I contemplate the Way of Yoga, the Way of Union with the True Lord. I am trulyabsorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saachay jog jugat veechaaree saachay t aarhee laa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: For so many ages, there was only pitch darkness;
lines.transliteration: kayt-rh i-aa jug Dh unDh ookaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taarhee laa-ee sirjan haarai. the Creator Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

lines.english: There was the True Name, the glorious greatness of the Truth, and the glory of Histrue throne. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach naam sachee vadi-aa-ee saachai takh at vadaa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: In the Golden Age of Truth, Truth and contentment filled the bodies.
lines.transliteration: satjug sat  santokh sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਿਤ  ਵਡਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Truth was pervasive, Truth, deep, profound and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: sat sat  vartai gahir gambh eeraa.

lines.english: The True Lord appraises the mortals on the Touchstone of Truth, and issues His True Command. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sach parkhai saachai hukam chalaa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru is true and contented.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okhee sat gur pooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੈ  ਸਾਚੈ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਚਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He alone is a spiritual hero, who believes in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad manay so sooraa.

lines.english: He alone obtains a true seat in the True Court of the Lord, who surrenders to theCommand of the Commander. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh saach nivaasaa maanai hukam rajaa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.english: In the Golden Age of Truth, everyone spoke the Truth.
lines.transliteration: satjug saach kahai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਨਵਾਸਾ  ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Truth was pervasive - the Lord was Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach vartai saachaa so-ee.

lines.english: With Truth in their minds and mouths, mortals were rid of doubt and fear. Truth wasthe friend of the Gurmukhs. ||5||
lines.transliteration: man mukh saach bh aram bh a-o bh anjan gurmukh  saach sakh aa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yoga, one power of Dharma was lost.
lines.transliteration: tarayt ai Dharam kalaa ik chookee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਸਾਚੁ ਭਰਮ  ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Three feet remained; through duality, one was cut off.
lines.transliteration: teen charan  ik dubiDh aa sookee.

lines.english: Those who were Gurmukh spoke the Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs wasted away in vain. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so saach vakh aanai manmukh  pachai avaa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.english: The manmukh never succeeds in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kad ay na d argeh seejh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਪਚੈ ਅਵਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can one be pleased within?
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai ki-o ant ar reejh ai.

lines.english: In bondage they come, and in bondage they go; they understand and comprehendnothing. ||7||
lines.transliteration: baaDhay aavahi baaDh ay jaaveh sojh ee boojh  na kaa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, compassion was cut in half. pMnw 1024
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa d u-aapur aDh ee ho-ee.

lines.english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, remembered the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa cheenai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮੁ  ਧਰੇ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਤਥਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Dharmic faith, which upholds and supports the earth, had only two feet; Truth was revealed to the Gurmukhs. ||8||
lines.transliteration: du-ay pag Dh aram Dh aray Dh arneeDhar gurmukh  saach t ithaa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.english: The kings acted righteously only out of self-interest.
lines.transliteration: raajay Dharam karahi parthaa-ay.

lines.english: Tied to hopes of reward, they gave to charities.
lines.transliteration: aasaa banDhay d aan karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation did not come, although they grew weary of performing rituals. ||9||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na ho-ee thaakay karam kamaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.english: Practicing religious rituals, they sought liberation,
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam kar mukat  mangaa-ee.
mukat pad aarath sabad  salaahee. but the treasure of liberation comes only by praising the Shabad.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਕਿਰ ਭਰਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, liberation is not obtained; practicinghypocrisy, they wander around confused. ||10||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabdai mukat  na ho-ee parpanch kar bh armaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.english: Love and attachment to Maya cannot be abandoned.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mamtaa chh odee na jaa-ee.

lines.english: They alone find release, who practice deeds of Truth.
lines.transliteration: say chhootay sach kaar kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Day and night, the devotees remain imbued with contemplative meditation; theybecome just like their Lord and Master. ||11||
lines.transliteration: ahinis bhagat  ratay veechaaree th aakur si-o ban  aa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Some chant and practice intensive meditation, and take cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: ik jap tap kar kar t irath naaveh.

lines.english: They walk as You will them to walk.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tuDh  bhaavai t ivai chalaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਠ ਿਨਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਅਪਤੀਜੁ  ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਿਨ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: By stubborn rituals of self-suppression, the Lord is not pleased. No one has everobtained honor, without the Lord, without the Guru. ||12||
lines.transliteration: hath nigrahi apt eej na bh eejai bin har gur kin pat  paa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕਲੀ  ਕਾਲ  ਮਿਹ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only one power remains.
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal meh ik kal raakhee.

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one has even described it.
lines.transliteration: bin gur pooray kinai na bhaakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਵਰਤਾਰਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs have staged the show of falsehood. Without the True Guru,doubt does not depart. ||13||
lines.transliteration: manmukh koorh  vartai vart aaraa bin sat gur bh aram na jaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.english: The True Guru is the Creator Lord, independent and carefree.
lines.transliteration: satgur vayparvaahu sirand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਿਣ  ਨ ਛੰਦਾ  ਬੰਦਾ ॥
lines.english: He does not fear death, and He is not dependent on mortal men.
lines.transliteration: naa jam kaan na chh andaa band aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ  ਸੰਤਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Whoever serves Him becomes immortal and imperishable, and will not be tortured bydeath. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jo tis sayvay so abh inaasee naa t is kaal sant aa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.english: The Creator Lord has enshrined Himself within the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur meh aap rakhi-aa kart aaray.

lines.english: The Gurmukh saves countless millions.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kot asaNkh uDhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Life of the World is the Great Giver of all beings. The Fearless Lord has no filth at all. ||15||
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa jagjeevan daat aa nirbh a-o mail na kaa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.english: Everyone begs from the Guru, God's Treasurer.
lines.transliteration: saglay jaacheh gur bhandaaree.

lines.english: He Himself is the immaculate, unknowable, infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap niranjan alakh apaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਚੈ  ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ  ਸਾਚੁ ਰਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the Truth; he begs from God. Please bless me with the Truth, by YourWill. ||16||4|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1024-12) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai parabh jaachai mai d eejai saach rajaa-ee hay. ||16||4||

lines.english: The True Lord unites with those who are united with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saachai maylay sabad milaa-ay.

lines.english: When it pleases Him, we intuitively merge with Him.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aanaa sahj samaa-ay.

lines.english: The Light of the Transcendent Lord pervades the three worlds; there is no other at all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taribh avan jot Dharee parmaysar avar na d oojaa bh aa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: I am His servant; I serve Him.
lines.transliteration: jis kay chaakar tis kee sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਧਰੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਿਰ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is unknowable and mysterious; He is pleased by the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabad pat eejai alakh  abhayvaa.

lines.english: The Creator is the Benefactor of His devotees. He forgives them - such is Hisgreatness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa gun kaaree kart aa bakh as la-ay vadi-aa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: The True Lord gives and gives; His blessings never run short.
lines.transliteration: dayday tot na aavai saachay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The false ones receive, and then deny having received.
lines.transliteration: lai lai mukar pa-uday kaachay.

lines.english: They do not understand their origins, they are not pleased with the Truth, and so theywander in duality and doubt. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mool na boojheh saach na reejh eh doojai bh aram bh ulaa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware, day and night.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaag rahay d in raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਨ ਰੀਝਿਹ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, they know the Love of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachay kee liv gurmat jaat ee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs remain asleep, and are plundered. The Gurmukhs remain safe and sound, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||
lines.transliteration: manmukh so-ay rahay say lootay gurmukh  saabat  bhaa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.english: The false come, and the false go;
lines.transliteration: koorhay aavai koorh ay jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸੇ ਲੂਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਬਤੁ  ਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: koorhay raat ee koorh  kamaavai. imbued with falsehood, they practice only falsehood.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord;the Gurmukhs focus their consciousness on Him. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabad milay say d argeh paiDh ay gurmukh  surat  samaa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.english: The false are cheated, and robbed by the robbers.
lines.transliteration: koorh muth ee thagee th agvaarh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The garden is laid waste, like the rough wilderness.
lines.transliteration: ji-o vaarhee ojaarh  ujaarh ee.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing tastes sweet; forgetting the Lord,they suffer in sorrow. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kichh saad  na laagai har bisri-ai d ukh paa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.english: Receiving the food of Truth, one is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: bhojan saach milai aagh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਿਦ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਸਿਰਐ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: True is the glorious greatness of the jewel of the Name.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan saachee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: One who understands his own self, realizes the Lord. His light merges into the Light. ||7|| pMnw 1025
lines.transliteration: cheenai aap pachhaan ai so-ee jot ee jot  milaa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.english: Wandering from the Name, he endures beatings.
lines.transliteration: naavhu bhulee chotaa kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Even great cleverness does not dispel doubt.
lines.transliteration: bahut si-aan ap bh aram na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The unconscious fool does not remain conscious of the Lord; he putrifies and rots away to death, carrying his heavy load of sin. ||8||
lines.transliteration: pach pach mu-ay achayt na cheet eh ajgar bh aar lad aa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਚ ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਅਚੇਤ  ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਅਜਗਿਰ  ਭਾਿਰ  ਲਦਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: No one is free of conflict and strife.
lines.transliteration: bin baad biroDh eh ko-ee naahee.

lines.english: Show me anyone who is, and I will praise him.
lines.transliteration: mai daykh aalihu t is saalaahee.

lines.english: Dedicating mind and body to God, one meets the Lord, the Life of the World, andbecomes just like Him. ||9||
lines.transliteration: man tan arap milai jagjeevan har si-o ban at banaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਿਮਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: No one knows the state and extent of God.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee gat  mit ko-ay na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Whoever calls himself great, will be eaten by his greatness.
lines.transliteration: jay ko vadaa kahaa-ay vadaa-ee khaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ  ਵਡਾਈ  ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: There is no lack of gifts of our True Lord and Master. He created all. ||10||
lines.transliteration: saachay saahib tot na d aatee saglee t ineh upaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਦਾਤੀ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਿਤਨਿਹ  ਉਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Great is the glorious greatness of the independent Lord.
lines.transliteration: vadee vadi-aa-ee vayparvaahay.

lines.english: He Himself created, and gives sustanance to all.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay daan samaahay.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord is not far away; the Great Giver spontaneously unites with Himself,by His Will. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aal d oor nahee d aataa mili-aa sahj rajaa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਦੂਿਰ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਤਾ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਹਿਜ ਰਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Some are sad, and some are afflicted with disease.
lines.transliteration: ik sogee ik rog vi-aapay.

lines.english: Whatever God does, He does by Himself.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so aapay aapay.

lines.english: Through loving devotion, and the Perfect Teachings of the Guru, the unstruck soundcurrent of the Shabad is realized. ||12||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-o gur kee mat  pooree anhad  sabad  lakhaa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਉ ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਹਿਦ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਖਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Some wander and roam around, hungry and naked.
lines.transliteration: ik naagay bhookh ay bh aveh bh avaa-ay.

lines.english: Some act in stubbornness and die, but do not know the value of God.
lines.transliteration: ik hath kar mareh na keemat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਹਠੁ ਕਿਰ ਮਰਿਹ ਨ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: They do not know the difference between good and bad; this is understood only through the practice of the Word of the Shabad. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gat avigat  kee saar na jaan ai boojh ai sabad  kamaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ  ਅਿਵਗਤ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Some bathe at sacred shrines and refuse to eat.
lines.transliteration: ik tirath naaveh ann na kh aaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਵਿਹ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Some torment their bodies in burning fire.
lines.transliteration: ik agan jalaaveh dayh kh apaaveh.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained; how can anyone cross over?||14||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na ho-ee kit  biDh paar langh aa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Abandoning the Guru's Teachings, some wander in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: gurmat chh odeh ujh arh jaa-ee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are destitute; they do not meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manmukh raam na japai avaa-ee.

lines.english: They are ruined, destroyed and drowned from practicing falsehood; death is theenemy of the false. ||15||
lines.transliteration: pach pach booDheh koorh  kamaaveh koorh  kaal bairaa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਚ ਪਿਚ ਬੂਡਿਹ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਕੂਿੜ ਕਾਲੁ  ਬੈਰਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they come, and by the Hukam of HisCommand, they go.
lines.transliteration: hukmay aavai hukmay jaavai.

lines.english: One who realizes His Hukam, merges in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: boojhai hukam so saach samaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, he merges in the True Lord, and his mind is pleased with the Lord. The Gurmukhs do His work. ||16||5|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1025-12) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach milai man bhaavai gurmukh  kaar kamaa-ee hay. ||16||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa purakh  biDhaataa.

lines.english: He evaluates those whom He Himself has created.
lines.transliteration: jin aapay aap upaa-ay pachhaat aa.

lines.english: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself created theUniverse. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur aapay sayvak aapay sarisat upaa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: He is near at hand, not far away.
lines.transliteration: aapay nayrhai naahee d ooray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs understand Him; perfect are those humble beings.
lines.transliteration: boojheh gurmukh  say jan pooray.

lines.english: Associating with them night and day is profitable. This is the glorious greatness ofassociating with the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kee sangat  ahinis laahaa gur sangat  ayh vadaa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: Throughout the ages, Your Saints are holy and sublime, O God.
lines.transliteration: jug jug sant bh alay parabh  tayray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਏਹ ਵਡਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, savoring it with their tongues.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi rasan rasayray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They chant His Praises, and their pain and poverty are taken away; they are not afraid of anyone else. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ustat karahi parhar d ukh daalad  jin naahee chint  paraa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: They remain awake and aware, and do not appear to sleep.
lines.transliteration: o-ay jaagat raheh na soot ay deeseh.

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰਹਿਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਿਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਚੰਤ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They serve up Truth, and so save their companions and relatives.
lines.transliteration: sangat kul t aaray saach pareeseh.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਜਾਗਤ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਨ ਸੂਤੇ ਦੀਸਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They are not stained with the filth of sins; they are immaculate and pure, and remainabsorbed in loving devotional worship. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kalimal mail naahee tay nirmal o-ay raheh bh agat liv laa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.english: O humble servants of the Lord, understand the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: boojhhu har jan sat gur ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਮਲ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੇ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਓਇ ਰਹਿਹ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: This youth, breath and body shall pass away.
lines.transliteration: ayhu joban saas hai dayh puraan ee.
