lines.english: O mortal, you shall die today or tomorrow; chant, and meditate on the Lord withinyour heart. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aaj kaal mar jaa-ee-ai paraanee har jap jap rid ai Dhi-aa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, abandon falsehood and your worthless ways.
lines.transliteration: chhodahu paraan ee koorh  kabaarh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਿਪ ਿਰਦੈ ਿਧਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Death viciously kills the false beings.
lines.transliteration: koorh maaray kaal uchh aahaarh aa.

lines.english: The faithless cynic is ruined through falsehood and his egotistical mind.On the path of duality, he rots away and decomposes. ||6|| pMnw 1026
lines.transliteration: saakat koorh  pacheh man ha-umai d uhu maarag pachai pachaa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.english: Abandon slander and envy of others.
lines.transliteration: chhodihu nind aa taat paraa-ee.

lines.english: Reading and studying, they burn, and do not find tranquility.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  dajheh saat  na aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਦਝਿਹ  ਸਾਿਤ  ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, shall be your helper and companion. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  naam salaahahu aat am raam sakh aa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Abandon sexual desire, anger and wickedness.
lines.transliteration: chhodahu kaam kroDh  buri-aa-ee.

lines.english: Abandon your involvement in egotistical affairs and conflicts.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai DhanDh  chhodahu lamptaa-ee.

lines.english: If you seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, then you shall be saved. In this way you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||
lines.transliteration: satgur saran  parahu t aa ubrahu i-o t aree-ai bh avjal bh aa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹ ੁ ਇਉ ਤਰੀਐ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: In the hereafter, you shall have to cross over the fiery river of poisonous flames.
lines.transliteration: aagai bimal nadee agan bikh  jhaylaa.

lines.english: No one else will be there; your soul shall be all alone.
lines.transliteration: tithai avar na ko-ee jee-o ikaylaa.

lines.english: The ocean of fire spits out waves of searing flames; the self-willed manmukhs fall intoit, and are roasted there. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bharh  bharh agan saagar d ay lahree parh  dajheh manmukh  taa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਭੜ ਭੜ ਅਗਿਨ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇ ਲਹਰੀ  ਪਿੜ ਦਝਿਹ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਤਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Liberation comes from the Guru; He grants this blessing by the Pleasure of His Will.
lines.transliteration: gur peh mukat d aan d ay bh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone knows the way, who obtains it.
lines.transliteration: jin paa-i-aa so-ee biDh jaan ai.

lines.english: So ask one who has obtained it, O Siblings of Destiny. Serve the True Guru, and findpeace. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jin paa-i-aa tin poochh ahu bh aa-ee sukh  satgur sayv kamaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਿਤਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, he dies entangled in sin and corruption.
lines.transliteration: gur bin urajh mareh baykaaraa.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death smashes his head and humiliates him.
lines.transliteration: jam sir maaray karay khu-aaraa.

lines.english: The slanderous person is not freed of his bonds; he is drowned, slandering others. ||11||
lines.transliteration: baaDhay mukat  naahee nar nind ak doobeh nind  paraa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਰ ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਡੂਬਿਹ  ਿਨੰਦ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: So speak the Truth, and realize the Lord deep within.
lines.transliteration: bolhu saach pachhaan hu and ar.

lines.english: He is not far away; look, and see Him.
lines.transliteration: door naahee d aykhhu kar nand ar.

lines.english: No obstacles shall block your way; become Gurmukh, and cross over to the other side.This is the way to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||
lines.transliteration: bighan naahee gurmukh  tar taaree i-o bh avjal paar langh aa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ  ਇਉ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the body.
lines.transliteration: dayhee and ar naam nivaasee.

lines.english: The Creator Lord is eternal and imperishable.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa hai abh inaasee.

lines.english: The soul does not die, and it cannot be killed; God creates and watches over all.Through the Word of the Shabad, His Will is manifest. ||13||
lines.transliteration: naa jee-o marai na maari-aa jaa-ee kar daykh ai sabad  rajaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.english: He is immaculate, and has no darkness.
lines.transliteration: oh nirmal hai naahee anDhi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਜਾਈ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself sits upon His throne.
lines.transliteration: oh aapay takh at bahai sachi-aaraa.

lines.english: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged, and forced to wander in reincarnation. They die, and are reborn, and continue coming and going. ||14||
lines.transliteration: saakat koorh ay banDh  bhavaa-ee-ah mar janmeh aa-ee jaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.english: The Guru's servants are the Beloveds of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur kay sayvak satgur pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਕੂੜੇ ਬੰਿਧ ਭਵਾਈਅਿਹ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਿਹ  ਆਈ  ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Shabad, they sit upon His throne.
lines.transliteration: o-ay baiseh takh at so sabad  veechaaray.

lines.english: They realize the essence of reality, and know the state of their inner being. This is thetrue glorious greatness of those who join the Sat Sangat. ||15||
lines.transliteration: tat laheh ant argat jaaneh sat sangat  saach vadaa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਬੈਸਿਹ  ਤਖਿਤ  ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself saves His humble servant, and saves his ancestors as well.
lines.transliteration: aap tarai jan pit raa taaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਲਹਿਹ  ਅੰਤਰਗਿਤ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: His companions are liberated; He carries them across.
lines.transliteration: sangat mukat  so paar ut aaray.

lines.english: Nanak is the servant and slave of that Gurmukh who lovingly focuses hisconsciousness on the Lord. ||16||6|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1026-14) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis kaa laalaa golaa jin gurmukh  har liv laa-ee hay. ||16||6||

lines.english: For many ages, only darkness prevailed;
lines.transliteration: kaytay jug vart ay gubaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਲਾ  ਗੋਲਾ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: taarhee laa-ee apar apaarai. the infinite, endless Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

lines.english: DhunDh ookaar niraalam baith aa naa t ad DhanDh pasaaraa hay. ||1|| He sat alone and unaffected in absolute darkness; the world of conflict did not exist. ||1||
Thirty-six ages passed like this.
lines.transliteration: jug chhat eeh tinai vart aa-ay.

lines.english: He causes all to happen by the Pleasure of His Will.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tis bh aanaa tivai chalaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਿਰ  ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਦ  ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No rival of His can be seen. He Himself is infinite and endless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tiseh sareek na d eesai ko-ee aapay apar apaaraa hay. ||2||

lines.english: God is hidden throughout the four ages - understand this well.
lines.transliteration: guptay boojh hu jug chat u-aaray.

lines.english: He pervades each and every heart, and is contained within the belly.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at vart ai udar majh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਸਰੀਕੁ  ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ  ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One and Only Lord prevails throughout the ages. How rare are those who contemplate the Guru, and understand this. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jug jug aykaa aykee vartai ko-ee boojh ai gur veechaaraa hay. ||3||

lines.english: From the union of the sperm and the egg, the body was formed.
lines.transliteration: bind rakat  mil pind saree-aa.

lines.english: From the union of air, water and fire, the living being is made.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee agnee mil jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਵਰਤੈ  ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself plays joyfully in the mansion of the body; all the rest is just attachment toMaya's expanse. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay choj karay rang mahlee hor maa-i-aa moh pasaaraa hay. ||4||

lines.english: Within the mother's womb, upside-down, the mortal meditated on God.
lines.transliteration: garabh kundal meh uraDh  Dhi-aanee.

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai ant arjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਚੋਜ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, he contemplated the True Name, deep within himself, within the womb. ||5|| pMnw 1027
lines.transliteration: saas saas sach naam samaalay antar ud ar majh aaraa hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਉਦਰ  ਮਝਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: He came into the world to obtain the four great blessings.
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath lai jag aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He came to dwell in the home of the Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter.
lines.transliteration: siv saktee gh ar vaasaa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: But he forgot the One Lord, and he has lost the game. The blind person forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ayk visaaray taa pirh  haaray anDh ulai naam visaaraa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੇ  ਤਾ ਿਪੜ ਹਾਰੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The child dies in his childish games.
lines.transliteration: baalak marai baalak kee leelaa.

lines.english: They cry and mourn, saying that he was such a playful child.
lines.transliteration: kahi kahi roveh baal rangeelaa.

lines.english: The Lord who owns him has taken him back. Those who weep and mourn aremistaken. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa so tin hee lee-aa bh oolaa rovan haaraa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ  ਭੂਲਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: What can they do, if he dies in his youth?
lines.transliteration: bhar joban mar jaahi ke keejai.

lines.english: They cry out, "His is mine, he is mine!"
lines.transliteration: mayraa mayraa kar roveejai.

lines.english: They cry for the sake of Maya, and are ruined; their lives in this world are cursed.||8||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran ro-ay vigoocheh Dh arig jeevan  sansaaraa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਰੋਇ ਿਵਗੂਚਿਹ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Their black hair eventually turns grey.
lines.transliteration: kaalee hoo fun Dha-ulay aa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Name, they lose their wealth, and then leave.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai gath ga-i-aa gavaa-ay.

lines.english: They are evil-minded and blind - they are totally ruined; they are plundered, and cryout in pain. ||9||
lines.transliteration: durmat  anDh ulaa binas binaasai mooth ay ro-ay pookaaraa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅੰਧੁਲਾ  ਿਬਨਿਸ ਿਬਨਾਸੈ  ਮੂਠੇ ਰੋਇ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: One who understands himself, does not cry.
lines.transliteration: aap veechaar na rovai ko-ee.

lines.english: When he meets the True Guru, then he understands.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru, the heavy, hard doors are not opened. Obtaining the Word of theShabad, one is emancipated. ||10||
lines.transliteration: bin gur bajar kapaat na khooleh sabad  milai nist aaraa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਜਰ  ਕਪਾਟ  ਨ ਖੂਲਿਹ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੈ ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The body grows old, and is beaten out of shape.
lines.transliteration: biraDh bh a-i-aa t an chh eejai d ayhee.

lines.english: But he does not meditate on the Lord, His only friend, even at the end.
lines.transliteration: raam na jap-ee ant sanayhee.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he departs with his face blackened. Thefalse are humiliated in the Court of the Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chalai muhi kaalai dargeh jh ooth khu-aaraa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ਚਲੈ ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲੈ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the false ones depart.
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chalai koorhi-aaro.

lines.english: Coming and going, dust falls on their heads.
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  parhai sir chh aaro.

lines.english: The soul-bride finds no home in her in-laws' home, the world hereafter; she suffers inagony in this world of her parents' home. ||12||
lines.transliteration: saahurrhai gh ar vaas na paa-ay pay-ee-arh ai sir maaraa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਮਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: She eats, dresses and plays joyfully,
lines.transliteration: khaajai paijh ai ralee kareejai.
bin abh bh agtee baad  mareejai. but without loving devotional worship of the Lord, she dies uselessly.

lines.english: One who does not distinguish between good and evil, is beaten by the Messenger of Death; how can anyone escape this? ||13||
lines.transliteration: sar apsar kee saar na jaanai jam maaray ki-aa chaaraa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਿਕਆ ਚਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: One who realizes what he has to possess, and what he has to abandon,
lines.transliteration: parvirtee narvirat  pachh aanai.
gur kai sang sabad gh ar jaan ai. associating with the Guru, comes to know the Word of the Shabad, within the home ofhis own self.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Do not call anyone else bad; follow this way of life. Those who are true are judged tobe genuine by the True Lord. ||14||
lines.transliteration: kis hee mandaa aakh  na chalai sach kh araa sachi-aaraa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਿਖ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਚ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਚਆਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Without Truth, no one succeeds in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saach binaa dar sijh ai na ko-ee.

lines.english: Through the True Shabad, one is robed in honor.
lines.transliteration: saach sabad paijh ai pat  ho-ee.

lines.english: He forgives those with whom He is pleased; they silence their egotism and pride.||15||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas la-ay t is bhaavai ha-umai garab nivaaraa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਿਨਵਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command, by the Grace of the Guru,
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay hukam pachh aanai.
jugah jugantar kee biDh  jaanai. comes to know the lifestyle of the ages.

lines.english: O Nanak, chant the Naam, and cross over to the other side. The True Lord will carry you across. ||16||1||7|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1027-15) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam japahu tar t aaree sach t aaray t aaran haaraa hay. ||16||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ  ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੭॥
lines.english: I have no other friend like the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har saa meet naahee mai ko-ee.

lines.english: He gave me body and mind, and infused consciousness into my being.
lines.transliteration: jin tan man d ee-aa surat  samo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He cherishes and cares for all beings; He is deep within, the wise, all-knowing Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa partipaal samaalay so ant ar daanaa beenaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru is the sacred pool, and I am His beloved swan.
lines.transliteration: gur sarvar ham hans pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਿਲ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਸੋ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the ocean, there are so many jewels and rubies.
lines.transliteration: saagar meh ratan laal baho saaray.

lines.english: The Lord's Praises are pearls, gems and diamonds. Singing His Praises, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: motee maan ak heeraa har jas gaavat  man t an bh eenaa hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰ  ਮਿਹ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ  ਬਹੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is inaccessible, inscrutable, unfathomable and unattached.
lines.transliteration: har agam agaahu agaaDh niraalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord's limits cannot be found; the Guru is the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: har ant na paa-ee-ai gur gopaalaa.

lines.english: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Lord carries us across to the other side.He unites in His Union those who are colored by His Love. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur mat  taaray t aaran haaraa mayl la-ay rang leenaa hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, how can anyone be liberated?
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu mukat  kinayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਿਤ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਰੰਿਗ ਲੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He has been the Friend of the Lord, from the very beginning of time, and allthroughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: oh aad jugaad ee raam sanayhee.

lines.english: By His Grace, He grants liberation in His Court; He forgives them for their sins. ||4|| pMnw 1028
lines.transliteration: dargeh mukat  karay kar kirpaa bakh say avgun  keenaa hay. ||4||

lines.english: The True Guru, the Giver, grants liberation;
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa mukat  karaa-ay.
sabh rog gavaa-ay amrit  ras paa-ay. all diseases are eradicated, and one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Death, the tax collector, does not impose any tax on one whose inner fire has been put out, whose heart is cool and tranquil. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jam jaagaat naahee kar laagai jis agan bujh ee thar seenaa hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਠਰੁ ਸੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The body has developed a great love for the soul-swan.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa hans pareet baho Dh aaree.

lines.english: He is a Yogi, and she is a beautiful woman.
lines.transliteration: oh jogee purakh oh sund ar naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਿਰ  ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, he enjoys her with delight, and then he arises and departs withoutconsulting her. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ahinis bhogai choj binod ee uth  chalt ai mat aa na keenaa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਭੋਗੈ ਚੋਜ ਿਬਨੋਦੀ  ਉਿਠ ਚਲਤੈ  ਮਤਾ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Creating the Universe, God remains diffused throughout it.
lines.transliteration: sarisat upaa-ay rahay parabh chh aajai.

lines.english: In the wind, water and fire, He vibrates and resounds.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant ar gaajai.

lines.english: The mind wavers, keeping company with evil passions; one obtains the rewards of hisown actions. ||7||
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa dolai doot  sangat  mil so paa-ay jo kichh  keenaa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, one suffers the misery of his evil ways.
lines.transliteration: naam visaar dokh  dukh sahee-ai.

lines.english: When the order to depart is issued, how can he remain here?
lines.transliteration: hukam bha-i-aa chaln aa ki-o rahee-ai.

lines.english: He falls into the pit of hell, and suffers like a fish out of water. ||8||
lines.transliteration: narak koop meh gotay kh aavai ji-o jal t ay baahar meenaa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਵੈ ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਮੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic has to endure 8.4 million hellish incarnations.
lines.transliteration: cha-oraaseeh narak saakat bh ogaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: As he acts, so does he suffer.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa keechai taiso paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is no liberation. Bound and gagged by his own actions, he is helpless. ||9||
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu mukat  na ho-ee kirat  baaDh aa garas d eenaa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਬਾਧਾ  ਗਰ੍ਿਸ ਦੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: This path is very narrow, like the sharp edge of a sword.
lines.transliteration: khanday Dh aar galee at  bheerhee.

lines.english: When his account is read, he shall be crushed like the sesame seed in the mill.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa leejai t il ji-o peerh ee.

lines.english: Mother, father, spouse and child - none is anyone's friend in the end. Without the Lord's Love, no one is liberated. ||10||
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa kalt ar sut  baylee naahee bin har ras mukat  na keenaa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਸੁਤ ਬੇਲੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: You may have many friends and companions in the world,
lines.transliteration: meet sakh ay kayt ay jag maahee.
bin gur parmaysar ko-ee naahee. but without the Guru, the Transcendent Lord Incarnate, there is no one at all.

lines.english: Service to the Guru is the way to liberation. Night and day, sing the Kirtan of theLord's Praises. ||11||
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa mukat paraa-in  an-din keert an keenaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਰਾਇਿਣ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Abandon falsehood, and pursue the Truth,
lines.transliteration: koorh chh od saachay ka-o Dh aavahu.
jo ichhahu so-ee fal paavhu. and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

lines.english: Very few are those who trade in the merchandise of Truth. Those who deal in it,obtain the true profit. ||12||
lines.transliteration: saach vakhar kay vaapaaree virlay lai laahaa sa-ud aa keenaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ  ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ  ਸਉਦਾ  ਕੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Depart with the merchandise of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: har har naam vakhar lai chalhu.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: darsan paavhu sahj mahlahu. and you shall intuitively obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, in the Mansion ofHis Presence.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs search for Him and find Him; they are the perfect humble beings. Inthis way, they see Him, who looks upon all alike. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kh oj laheh jan pooray i-o samad rasee cheenaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੋਿਜ ਲਹਿਹ  ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ  ਚੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: God is endless; following the Guru's Teachings, some find Him.
lines.transliteration: parabh bay-ant  gurmat  ko paavahi.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they instruct their minds.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man ka-o samjh aavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Accept as True, Perfectly True, the Word of the True Guru's Bani. In this way, you shall merge in the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||14||
lines.transliteration: satgur kee ban ee sat  sat kar maanhu i-o aat am raamai leenaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਇਉ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੈ ਲੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Naarad and Saraswati are Your servants.
lines.transliteration: naarad saarad  sayvak t ayray.

lines.english: Your servants are the greatest of the great, throughout the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan sayvak vadahu vadayray.

lines.english: Your creative power permeates all; You are the Great Giver of all. You created thewhole creation. ||15||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree kud rat too sir sir d aataa sabh  tayro kaaran  keenaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਤੂ ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Some serve at Your Door, and their sufferings are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: ik dar sayveh d arad vanjaa-ay.

lines.english: They are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord, and emancipated by the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: o-ay dargeh paiDh ay sat guroo chh adaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru breaks the bonds of egotism, and restrains the fickle consciousness.||16||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai banDhan sat gur torhay chit  chanchal chalan  na deenaa hay. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਤੋੜੇ ਿਚਤੁ  ਚੰਚਲੁ  ਚਲਿਣ  ਨ ਦੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Meet the True Guru, and search for the way,
lines.transliteration: satgur milhu cheenahu biDh  saa-ee.
jit parabh  paavhu gan at na kaa-ee. by which you may find God, and not have to answer for your account.

lines.english: Subdue your egotism, and serve the Guru; O servant Nanak, you shall be drenched with the Lord's Love. ||17||2||8|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1028-18) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar karahu gur sayvaa jan naanak har rang bheenaa hay. ||17||2||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਭੀਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੨॥੮॥
lines.english: My Lord is the Destroyer of demons.
lines.transliteration: asur saghaaran  raam hamaaraa.

lines.english: My Beloved Lord is pervading each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rama-ee-aa raam pi-aaraa.

lines.english: The unseen Lord is always with us, but He is not seen at all. The Gurmukhcontemplates the record. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naalay alakh na lakh ee-ai moolay gurmukh  likh veechaaraa hay. ||1||

lines.english: The Holy Gurmukh seeks Your Sanctuary. pMnw 1029
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saaDh oo saran  tumaaree.

lines.english: God grants His Grace, and carries him across to the other side.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh paar ut aaree.

lines.english: The ocean is very deep, filled with fiery water; the Guru, the True Guru, carries us across to the other side. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agan paanee saagar at  gahraa gur sat gur paar ut aaraa hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਿਤ  ਗਹਰਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ulay sojh ee naahee.

lines.english: He comes and goes in reincarnation, dying, and dying again.
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaahi mareh mar jaahee.

lines.english: The primal inscription of destiny cannot be erased. The spiritually blind suffer terriblyat Death's door. ||3||
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa laykh  na mit-ee jam d ar anDh  khu-aaraa hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਅੰਧੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Some come and go, and do not find a home in their own heart.
lines.transliteration: ik aavahi jaaveh ghar vaas na paavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Bound by their past actions, they commit sins.
lines.transliteration: kirat kay baaDh ay paap kamaaveh.

lines.english: The blind ones have no understanding, no wisdom; they are trapped and ruined bygreed and egotism. ||4||
lines.transliteration: anDhulay sojh ee boojh  na kaa-ee lobh  buraa ahaNkaaraa hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without her Husband Lord, what good are the soul-bride's decorations?
lines.transliteration: pir bin ki-aa tis Dh an seegaaraa.

lines.english: She has forgotten her Lord and Master, and is infatuated with another's husband.
lines.transliteration: par pir raatee kh asam visaaraa.

lines.english: Just as no one knows who is the father of the prostitute's son, such are the worthless, useless deeds that are done. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ji-o baysu-aa poot baap ko kahee-ai t i-o fokat kaar vikaaraa hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਬੇਸੁਆ  ਪੂਤ ਬਾਪੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਤਉ  ਫੋਕਟ  ਕਾਰ ਿਵਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The ghost, in the body-cage, suffers all sorts of afflictions.
lines.transliteration: parayt pinjar meh d ookh ghanayray.

lines.english: Those who are blind to spiritual wisdom, putrefy in hell.
lines.transliteration: narak pacheh agi-aan anDhayray.

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay kee baakee leejai jin har kaa naam visaaraa hay. ||6|| The Righteous Judge of Dharma collects the balance due on the account, of thosewho forget the Name of the Lord. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ  ਲੀਜੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The scorching sun blazes with flames of poison.
lines.transliteration: sooraj tapai agan bikh  jhaalaa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is dishonored, a beast, a demon.
lines.transliteration: apat pasoo manmukh  baytaalaa.

lines.english: Trapped by hope and desire, he practices falsehood, and is afflicted by the terribledisease of corruption. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa koorh kamaaveh rog buraa buri-aaraa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਰੋਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਿਰਆਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: He carries the heavy load of sins on his forehead and head.
lines.transliteration: mastak bh aar kalar sir bh aaraa.

lines.english: How can he cross the terrifying world-ocean?
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar bhavjal langh as paaraa.

lines.english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the True Guru has been the boat; through the Lord's Name, He carries us across. ||8||
lines.transliteration: satgur bohith aad  jugaad ee raam naam nist aaraa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The love of one's children and spouse is so sweet in this world.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar jag hayt  pi-aaraa.

lines.english: The expansive expanse of the Universe is attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh pasri-aa paasaaraa.

lines.english: The True Guru snaps the noose of Death, for that Gurmukh who contemplates theessence of reality. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jam kay faahay satgur t orhay gurmukh  tat beechaaraa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਤੋੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Cheated by falsehood, the self-willed manmukh walks along many paths;
lines.transliteration: koorh muth ee chaalai baho raahee.
manmukh d aajhai parh  parh bhaahee. he may be highly educated, but he burns in the fire.

lines.english: The Guru is the Great Giver of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, sublime peace is obtained. ||10||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam guroo vad d aanaa naam japahu sukh  saaraa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The True Guru, in His Mercy, implants Truth within.
lines.transliteration: satgur t uthaa sach drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: All suffering is eradicated, and one is placed on the Path.
lines.transliteration: sabh d ukh maytay maarag paa-ay.

lines.english: Not even a thorn ever pierces the foot of one who has the True Guru as his Protector. ||11||
lines.transliteration: kandaa paa-ay na gad-ee moolay jis satgur raakh anhaaraa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਡਾ ਪਾਇ  ਨ ਗਡਈ  ਮੂਲੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Dust mixes with dust, when the body wastes away.
lines.transliteration: khayhoo kh ayh ralai t an chh eejai.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is like a stone slab, which is impervious to water.
lines.transliteration: manmukh paathar sail na bh eejai.

lines.english: He cries out and weeps and wails; he is reincarnated into heaven and then hell. ||12||
lines.transliteration: karan palaav karay bahut ayray narak surag avt aaraa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਵ  ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਨਰਿਕ  ਸੁਰਿਗ  ਅਵਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: They live with the poisonous snake of Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa bikh bh u-i-angam naalay.

lines.english: This duality has ruined so many homes.
lines.transliteration: in dubiDh aa gh ar bahut ay gaalay.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, love does not well up. Imbued with devotional worship, thesoul is satisfied. ||13||
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu pareet  na upjai bh agat ratay pat ee-aaraa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਤੇ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics chase after Maya.
lines.transliteration: saakat maa-i-aa ka-o baho Dh aaveh.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, how can they find peace?
lines.transliteration: naam visaar kahaa sukh paavahi.

lines.english: In the three qualities, they are destroyed; they cannot cross over to the other side. ||14||
lines.transliteration: tarihu gun  antar khapeh kh apaaveh naahee paar ut aaraa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਖਪਿਹ  ਖਪਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The false are called pigs and dogs.
lines.transliteration: kookar sookar kahee-ahi koorhi-aaraa.

lines.english: They bark themselves to death; they bark and bark and howl in fear.
lines.transliteration: bha-uk mareh bh a-o bh a-o bh a-o haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉਿਕ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਭਉ ਭਉ ਭਉ ਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: False in mind and body, they practice falsehood; through their evil-mindedness, theylose out in the Court of the Lord. ||15||
lines.transliteration: man tan jh oothay koorh  kamaaveh d urmat  dargeh haaraa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਝੂਠੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਹਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the mind is stabilized.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a manoo-aa taykai.

lines.english: One who seeks His Sanctuary is blessed with the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam naam day saran  paraykai.

lines.english: They are given the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name; singing His Praises, they areHis beloveds in His court. ||16|| pMnw 1030
lines.transliteration: har Dhan naam amolak d ayvai har jas d argeh pi-aaraa hay. ||16||

lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: raam naam saaDhoo sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: Through the True Guru's Teachings, one comes to know His state and extent.
lines.transliteration: satgur bachnee gat  mit paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੩॥੯॥
lines.english: Nanak: chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; the Lord, the Uniter, shall unite you with Himself. ||17||3||9|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1030-2) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jap har man mayray har maylay maylanhaaraa hay. ||17||3||9||

lines.english: Remain in your own home, O my foolish and ignorant mind.
lines.transliteration: ghar rahu ray man mugaDh  i-aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ  ਇਆਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord - concentrate deep within your being and meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: raam japahu antargat  Dhi-aanay.

lines.english: Renounce your greed, and merge with the infinite Lord. In this way, you shall find thedoor of liberation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: laalach chhod rachahu aprampar i-o paavhu mukat  du-aaraa hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚ  ਛੋਿਡ ਰਚਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਿਰ  ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: If you forget Him, the Messenger of Death will catch sight of you.
lines.transliteration: jis bisri-ai jam johan laagai.

lines.english: All peace will be gone, and you will suffer in pain in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  jaahi d ukhaa fun aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਿਹ  ਦੁਖਾ ਫੁਿਨ ਆਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord as Gurmukh, O my soul; this is the supreme essence ofcontemplation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap gurmukh jee-arh ay ayhu param t at veechaaraa hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੀਅੜੇ  ਏਹੁ ਪਰਮ  ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the sweetest essence.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu ras meethaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, see the essence of the Lord deep within.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har ras ant ar deeth aa.

lines.english: Day and night, remain imbued with the Lord's Love. This is the essence of all chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ahinis raam rahhu rang raatay ayhu jap t ap sanjam saaraa hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Speak the Guru's Word, and the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam naam gur bachnee bolhu.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, search for this essence.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa meh ih ras tolahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਹ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੋਲਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Follow the Guru's Teachings - seek and find the home of your own self, and you shallnever be consigned to the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmat kh oj lahhu gh ar apnaa bahurh  na garabh  majh aaraa hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਖੋਿਜ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਗਰਭ  ਮਝਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Bathe at the sacred shrine of Truth, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach tirath naavhu har gun  gaavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Reflect upon the essence of reality, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tat veechaarahu har liv laavhu.

lines.english: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if youchant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ant kaal jam johi na saakai har bolhu raam pi-aaraa hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਿਲ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, the Great Giver, is all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  daataa vad d aanaa.

lines.english: Whoever has Truth within himself, merges in the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jis antar saach so sabad  samaan aa.

lines.english: One whom the True Guru unites in Union, is rid of the overpowering fear of death. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o satgur mayl milaa-ay t is chookaa jam bh ai bhaaraa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਚੂਕਾ  ਜਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The body is formed from the union of the five elements.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  mil kaa-i-aa keenee.

lines.english: Know that the Lord's jewel is within it.
lines.transliteration: tis meh raam rat an lai cheenee.

lines.english: The soul is the Lord, and the Lord is the soul; contemplating the Shabad, the Lord isfound. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aatam raam raam hai aat am har paa-ee-ai sabad  veechaaraa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Abide in truth and contentment, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh rahhu jan bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Hold tight to compassion and the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: khimaa gahhu sat gur sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: Know your soul, and know the Supreme Soul; associating with the Guru, you shall be emancipated. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aatam cheen paraat am cheenahu gur sangat  ih nist aaraa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਪਰਾਤਮੁ  ਚੀਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਇਹੁ ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics are stuck in falsehood and deceit.
lines.transliteration: saakat koorh  kapat meh taykaa.

lines.english: Day and night, they slander many others.
lines.transliteration: ahinis nindaa karahi anaykaa.

lines.english: Without meditative remembrance, they come and then go, and are cast into the hellish womb of reincarnation. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bin simran aavahi fun jaaveh garabh jonee narak majh aaraa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਿਸਮਰਨ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਫੁਿਨ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਗਰ੍ਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਰਕ  ਮਝਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic is not rid of his fear of death.
lines.transliteration: saakat jam kee kaan  na chookai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਿਣ  ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death's club is never taken away.
lines.transliteration: jam kaa dand na kabhoo mookai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮੂਕੈ ॥
lines.english: He has to answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma for the account of his actions;the egotistical being carries the unbearable load. ||10||
lines.transliteration: baakee Dharam raa-ay kee leejai sir afri-o bh aar afaaraa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਕੀ  ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਅਫਿਰਓ  ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Tell me: without the Guru, what faithless cynic has been saved?
lines.transliteration: bin gur saakat kahhu ko t ari-aa.

lines.english: Acting egotistically, he falls into the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kartaa bh avjal pari-aa.

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one is saved; meditating on the Lord, they are carried across tothe other side. ||11||
lines.transliteration: bin gur paar na paavai ko-ee har japee-ai paar utaaraa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁ ਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: No one can erase the Guru's blessings.
lines.transliteration: gur kee daat  na maytai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord carries across those whom He forgives.
lines.transliteration: jis bakhsay t is taaray so-ee.

lines.english: The pains of birth and death do not even approach those whose minds are filled with God, the infinite and endless. ||12||
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ukh nayrh  na aavai man so parabh  apar apaaraa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਮਿਨ ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Guru come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: gur tay bh oolay aavhu jaavhu.

lines.english: They are born, only to die again, and continue committing sins.
lines.transliteration: janam marahu fun paap kamaavahu.

lines.english: The unconscious, foolish, faithless cynic does not remember the Lord; but when he isstricken with pain, then he cries out for the Lord. ||13||
lines.transliteration: saakat moorh  achayt  na cheet eh dukh laagai t aa raam pukaaraa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂੜ ਅਚੇਤ  ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Pleasure and pain are the consequences of the actions of past lives.
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh purab janam kay kee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: The Giver, who blesses us with these - He alone knows.
lines.transliteration: so jaanai jin d aatai dee-ay.

lines.english: So who can you blame, O mortal being? The hardships you suffer are from your own actions. ||14|| pMnw 1031
lines.transliteration: kis ka-o dos d eh too paraan ee saho apn aa kee-aa karaaraa hay. ||14||

lines.english: Practicing egotism and possessiveness, you have come into the world.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa kard aa aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Hope and desire bind you and lead you on.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa banDh chalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Indulging in egotism and self-conceit, what will you be able to carry with you, except the load of ashes from poison and corruption? ||15||
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree karat ki-aa lay chaalay bikh  laaday chh aar bikaaraa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ  ਿਕਆ  ਲੇ ਚਾਲੇ  ਿਬਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ  ਛਾਰ ਿਬਕਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Worship the Lord in devotion, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  karahu jan bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Speak the Unspoken Speech, and the mind will merge back into the Mind.
lines.transliteration: akath kathahu man maneh samaa-ee.

lines.english: Restrain your restless mind within its own home, and the Lord, the Destroyer, shalldestroy your pain. ||16||
lines.transliteration: uth chalt aa thaak rakh ahu gh ar apunai d ukh kaatay kaatan haaraa hay. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਉਿਠ ਚਲਤਾ  ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਖਹੁ ਘਿਰ  ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I seek the support of the Perfect Guru, the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har gur pooray kee ot paraatee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਪਰਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh loves the Lord; the Gurmukh realizes the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har liv gurmukh  jaatee.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, the intellect is exalted; granting His forgiveness,the Lord carries him across to the other side. ||17||4||10|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1031-5) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam mat oot am har bakh say paar ut aaraa hay. ||17||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਬਖਸੇ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Divine Guru, I have entered Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: saran paray gurd ayv tumaaree.

lines.english: You are the Almighty Lord, the Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: too samrath d a-i-aal muraaree.

lines.english: No one knows Your wondrous plays; You are the perfect Architect of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayray choj na jaan ai ko-ee t oo pooraa purakh  biDhaataa hay. ||1||

lines.english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You cherish and sustainYour beings.
lines.transliteration: too aad  jugaad  karahi part ipaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਈ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are in each and every heart, O Merciful Lord of incomparable beauty.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at roop anoop d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: As You will, You cause all to walk; everyone acts according to Your Command. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o tuDh  bhaavai t ivai chalaaveh sabh  tayro kee-aa kamaat aa hay. ||2||

lines.english: Deep within the nucleus of all, is the Light of the Life of the World.
lines.transliteration: antar jot  bhalee jagjeevan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਿਹ  ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord enjoys the hearts of all, and drinks in their essence.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at bhogai har ras peevan.

lines.english: He Himself gives, and He himself takes; He is the generous father of the beings of the three worlds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay layvai aapay dayvai t ihu lo-ee jagat  pit daataa hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨ  ॥
lines.english: Creating the world, He has set His play into motion.
lines.transliteration: jagat upaa-ay kh ayl rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵੈ ਿਤਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਜਗਤ  ਿਪਤ ਦਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He placed the soul in the body of air, water and fire.
lines.transliteration: pavnai paan ee agnee jee-o paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The body-village has nine gates; the Tenth Gate remains hidden. ||4||
lines.transliteration: dayhee nagree na-o d arvaajay so d asvaa gupat  rahaat aa hay. ||4||

lines.english: There are four horrible rivers of fire.
lines.transliteration: chaar nadee agnee asraalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ  ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ  ਸੋ ਦਸਵਾ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਰਹਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who understands this, and through the Word of theShabad, remains unattached.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee gurmukh boojh ai sabad  niraalaa.

lines.english: The faithless cynics are drowned and burnt through their evil-mindedness. The Gurusaves those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saakat d urmat  doobeh d aajheh gur raakh ay har liv raat aa hay. ||5||

lines.english: Water, fire, air, earth and ether
lines.transliteration: ap tayj vaa-ay parithmee aakaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਡੂਬਿਹ  ਦਾਝਿਹ  ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tin meh panch t at ghar vaasaa. - in that house of the five elements, they dwell.

lines.english: Those who remain imbued with the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, renounce Maya, egotism and doubt. ||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur sabad  raheh rang raat aa taj maa-i-aa ha-umai bh araataa hay. ||6||

lines.english: This mind is drenched with the Shabad, and satisfied.
lines.transliteration: ih man bheejai sabad  pateejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਤਿਜ ਮਾਇਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਭਰ੍ਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without the Name, what support can anyone have?
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ki-aa tayk tikeejai.

lines.english: The temple of the body is being plundered by the thieves within, but this faithlesscynic does not even recognize these demons. ||7||
lines.transliteration: antar chor muhai gh ar mand ar in saakat  doot na jaat aa hay. ||7||

lines.english: They are argumentative demons, terrifying goblins.
lines.transliteration: dundar doot bhoot bheehaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਇਿਨ  ਸਾਕਿਤ  ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: These demons stir up conflict and strife.
lines.transliteration: khinchot aan karahi bayt aalay.

lines.english: Without awareness of the Shabad, one comes and goes in reincarnation; he loses hishonor in this coming and going. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sabad surat  bin aavai jaavai pat  kho-ee aavat  jaataa hay. ||8||

lines.english: The body of the false person is just a pile of barren dirt.
lines.transliteration: koorh kalar t an bh asmai dh ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਵੈ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Without the Name, what honor can you have?
lines.transliteration: bin naavai kaisee pat t ayree.

lines.english: Bound and gagged throughout the four ages, there is no liberation; the Messenger of Death keeps such a person under his gaze. ||9||
lines.transliteration: baaDhay mukat  naahee jug chaaray jamkankar kaal paraat aa hay. ||9||

lines.english: At Death's door, he is tied up and punished;
lines.transliteration: jam dar baaDh ay mileh sajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਿਰ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਪਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: tis apraaDh ee gat  nahee kaa-ee. such a sinner does not obtain salvation.

lines.english: He cries out in pain, like the fish pierced by the hook. ||10||
lines.transliteration: karan palaav karay billaavai ji-o kundee meen paraat aa hay. ||10||

lines.english: The faithless cynic is caught in the noose all alone.
lines.transliteration: saakat faasee parh ai ikaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਵ  ਕਰੇ ਿਬਲਲਾਵੈ  ਿਜਉ  ਕੁੰਡੀ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The miserable spiritually blind person is caught in the power of Death.
lines.transliteration: jam vas kee-aa anDh d uhaylaa.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not known. He shall waste away, today ortomorrow. ||11||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na soojh ai aaj kaal pach jaat aa hay. ||11||

lines.english: Other than the True Guru, no one is your friend.
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh  na baylee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਪਿਚ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, God is the Savior.
lines.transliteration: aithai othai raakhaa parabh  so-ee.

lines.english: He grants His Grace, and bestows the Lord's Name. He merges with Him, like water with water. ||12|| pMnw 1032
lines.transliteration: raam naam dayvai kar kirpaa i-o sallai salal milaat aa hay. ||12||

lines.english: The Guru instructs His wandering Sikhs;
lines.transliteration: bhoolay sikh  guroo samjh aa-ay.
ujharh  jaaday maarag paa-ay. if they go astray, He sets them on the right path.

lines.english: So serve the Guru, forever, day and night; He is the Destroyer of pain - He is with you as your companion. ||13||
lines.transliteration: tis gur sayv sad aa din raat ee dukh bhanjan sang sakh aataa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਖਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: O mortal being, what devotional worship have you performed to the Guru?
lines.transliteration: gur kee bhagat  karahi ki-aa paraan ee.

lines.english: Even Brahma, Indra and Shiva do not know it.
lines.transliteration: barahmai in-dar mahays na jaan ee.

lines.english: Tell me, how can the unknowable True Guru be known? He alone attains thisrealization, whom the Lord forgives. ||14||
lines.transliteration: satgur alakh  kahhu ki-o lakh ee-ai jis bakh say tiseh pachh aataa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਕਹਹੁ ਿਕਉ  ਲਖੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: One who has love within, obtains the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: antar paraym paraapat  darsan.

lines.english: One who enshrines love for the Word of the Guru's Bani, meets with Him.
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee si-o pareet  so parsan.

lines.english: Day and night, the Gurmukh sees the immaculate Divine Light everywhere; this lamp illuminates his heart. ||15||
lines.transliteration: ahinis nirmal jot sabaa-ee gh at deepak gurmukh  jaataa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਬਾਈ ਘਿਟ  ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The food of spiritual wisdom is the supremely sweet essence.
lines.transliteration: bhojan gi-aan mahaa ras meeth aa.

lines.english: Whoever tastes it, sees the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhi-aa t in darsan deeth aa.

lines.english: Beholding His Darshan, the unattached one meets the Lord; subduing the mind'sdesires, he merges into the Lord. ||16||
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykh milay bairaagee man mansaa maar samaat aa hay. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਿਮਲੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are supreme and famous.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say parDh aanaa.

lines.english: Deep within each and every heart, they recognize God.
lines.transliteration: tin gh at ghat ant ar barahm pachh aanaa.

lines.english: ||17||5||11|| Please bless Nanak with the Lord's Praises, and the Sangat, the Congregation of theLord's humble servants; through the True Guru, they know their Lord God.||17||5||11|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1032-8) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 1) naanak har jas har jan kee sangat d eejai jin sat gur har parabh  jaataa hay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The True Lord is the Creator of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: saachay saahib sirjanhaaray.

lines.english: He established and contemplates the worldly sphere.
lines.transliteration: jin Dhar chakar Dh aray veechaaray.

lines.english: He Himself created the creation, and beholds it; He is True and independent. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa kar kar vaykh ai saachaa vayparvaahaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: He created the beings of different kinds.
lines.transliteration: vaykee vaykee jant upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ  ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The two travellers have set out in two directions.
lines.transliteration: du-ay pand ee du-ay raah chalaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is liberated. Chanting the True Name, one profits.||2||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray vin mukat  na ho-ee sach naam jap laahaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs read and study, but they do not know the way.
lines.transliteration: parheh manmukh  par biDh  nahee jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਿਵਣੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They do not understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they wander, deluded bydoubt.
lines.transliteration: naam na boojheh bh aram bh ulaanaa.

lines.english: They take bribes, and give false testimony; the noose of evil-mindedness is around their necks. ||3||
lines.transliteration: lai kai vadhee d ayn ugaahee d urmat  kaa gal faahaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: They read the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Puraanas;
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar parh eh puraan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਵਢੀ ਦੇਿਨ  ਉਗਾਹੀ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਾ ਗਿਲ  ਫਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vaad vakaan eh tat na jaan aa. they argue and debate, but do not know the essence of reality.

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, the essence of reality is not obtained. The true and purebeings walk the Path of Truth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: vin gur pooray t at na paa-ee-ai sach soochay sach raahaa hay. ||4||

lines.english: All praise God and listen, and listen and speak.
lines.transliteration: sabh saalaahay sun  sun aakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਚ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He Himself is wise, and He Himself judges the Truth.
lines.transliteration: aapay daanaa sach paraakh ai.

lines.english: Those whom God blesses with His Glance of Grace become Gurmukh, and praise theWord of the Shabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o nadar karay parabh  apnee gurmukh  sabad  salaahaa hay. ||5||

lines.english: Many listen and listen, and speak the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  aakh ai kayt ee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Listening and speaking, no one knows His limits.
lines.transliteration: sun kahee-ai ko ant  na jaan ee.

lines.english: He alone is wise, unto whom the unseen Lord reveals Himself; he speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o alakh lakh aa-ay aapay akath kathaa buDh  taahaa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਕਹੀਐ  ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: At birth, the congratulations pour in;
lines.transliteration: janmay ka-o vaajeh vaaDhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਬੁਿਧ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sohilrhay agi-aanee gaa-ay. the ignorant sing songs of joy.

lines.english: Whoever is born, is sure to die, according to the destiny of past deeds inscribed uponhis head by the Sovereign Lord King. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jo janmai tis sarpar marn aa kirat  pa-i-aa sir saahaa hay. ||7||

lines.english: Union and separation were created by my God.
lines.transliteration: sanjog vijog mayrai parabh kee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਪਇਆ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Creating the Universe, He gave it pain and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: sarisat upaa-ay dukh aa sukh  dee-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected by pain and pleasure; they wear the armor of humility. ||8||
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  hee t ay bh a-ay niraalay gurmukh  seel sanaahaa hay. ||8||

lines.english: The noble people are traders in Truth.
lines.transliteration: neekay saachay kay vaapaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਿਨਰਾਲੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੀਲੁ  ਸਨਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: They purchase the true merchandise, contemplating the Guru.
lines.transliteration: sach sa-udaa lai gur veechaaree.

lines.english: One who has the wealth of the true commodity in his lap, is blessed with the rapture of the True Shabad. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sachaa vakhar jis Dh an palai sabad  sachai omaahaa hay. ||9||

lines.english: The false dealings lead only to loss.
lines.transliteration: kaachee sa-udee t otaa aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The trades of the Gurmukh are pleasing to God.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh van aj karay parabh  bhaavai.

lines.english: His stock is safe, and his capital is safe and sound. The noose of Death is cut away from around his neck. ||10|| pMnw 1033
lines.transliteration: poonjee saabat raas salaamat  chookaa jam kaa faahaa hay. ||10||

lines.english: Everyone speaks as they please.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko bolai aapan  bhaanai.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh, in duality, does not know how to speak.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d oojai bol na jaan ai.

lines.english: The blind person has a blind and deaf intellect; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||11||
lines.transliteration: anDhulay kee mat  anDh lee bolee aa-ay ga-i-aa d ukh taahaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਅੰਧਲੀ  ਬੋਲੀ  ਆਇ  ਗਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: In pain he is born, and in pain he dies.
lines.transliteration: dukh meh janmai d ukh meh marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਮਿਹ ਜਨਮੈ  ਦੁਖ ਮਿਹ ਮਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: His pain is not relieved, without seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: dookh  na mitai bin gur kee sarn aa.

lines.english: In pain he is created, and in pain he perishes. What has he brought with himself? And what will he take away? ||12||
lines.transliteration: dookh ee upjai d ookhee binsai ki-aa lai aa-i-aa ki-aa lai jaahaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੀ ਉਪਜੈ  ਦੂਖੀ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਿਕਆ  ਲੈ ਆਇਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਲੈ ਜਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: True are the actions of those who are under the Guru's influence.
lines.transliteration: sachee karnee gur kee sirkaaraa.

lines.english: They do not come and go in reincarnation, and they are not subject to the laws ofDeath.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  nahee jam Dh aaraa.

lines.english: Whoever abandons the branches, and clings to the true root, enjoys true ecstasywithin his mind. ||13||
lines.transliteration: daal chhod t at mool paraat aa man saachaa omaahaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਡਾਲ  ਛੋਿਡ ਤਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ  ਮਿਨ ਸਾਚਾ  ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Death cannot strike down the people of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay log nahee jam maarai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: They do not see pain on the most difficult path.
lines.transliteration: naa dukh  daykheh panth karaarai.

lines.english: Deep within the nucleus of their hearts, they worship and adore the Lord's Name;there is nothing else at all for them. ||14||
lines.transliteration: raam naam ghat ant ar poojaa avar na d oojaa kaahaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: There is no end to the Lord's sermon and Praise.
lines.transliteration: orh na kathnai sifat  sajaa-ee.

lines.english: As it pleases You, I remain under Your Will.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tuDh  bhaaveh raheh rajaa-ee.

lines.english: I am embellished with robes of honor in the Court of the Lord, by the Order of the True King. ||15||
lines.transliteration: dargeh paiDh ay jaan suhaylay hukam sachay paat isaahaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਿਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: How can I chant Your uncounted glories?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kahee-ai gun katheh gh anayray.

lines.english: Even the greatest of the great do not know Your limits.
lines.transliteration: ant na paavahi vaday vadayray.

lines.english: Please bless Nanak with the Truth, and preserve his honor; You are the supremeemperor above the heads of kings. ||16||6||12|| mwrU mhlw 1 dKxI ] (1033-8) maaroo mehlaa 1 dakh -nee. Maaroo, First Mehl, Dakhanee:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach milai pat raakh o too sir saahaa paat isaahaa hay. ||16||6||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤੂ ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Deep within the body-village is the fortress.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar nagar garh and ar.

lines.english: The dwelling of the True Lord is within the city of the Tenth Gate.
lines.transliteration: saachaa vaasaa pur gagnandar.

lines.english: This place is permanent and forever immaculate. He Himself created it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asthir thaan sadaa nirmaa-il aapay aap upaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: Within the fortress are balconies and bazaars.
lines.transliteration: andar kot chh ajay hatnaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੁ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself takes care of His merchandise.
lines.transliteration: aapay layvai vasat samaalay.

lines.english: The hard and heavy doors of the Tenth Gate are closed and locked. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are thrown open. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bajar kapaat jarhay jarh  jaanai gur sabd ee kh olaa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: Within the fortress is the cave, the home of the self.
lines.transliteration: bheet ar kot gufaa gh ar jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਜਰ  ਕਪਾਟ  ਜੜੇ ਜਿੜ ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਖੋਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He established the nine gates of this house, by His Command and His Will.
lines.transliteration: na-o ghar thaapay hukam rajaa-ee.

lines.english: In the Tenth Gate, the Primal Lord, the unknowable and infinite dwells; the unseenLord reveals Himself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dasvai purakh  alaykh  apaaree aapay alakh  lakhaa-idaa. ||3||

lines.english: Within the body of air, water and fire, the One Lord dwells.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee agnee ik vaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਲੇਖੁ  ਅਪਾਰੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself stages His wondrous dramas and plays.
lines.transliteration: aapay keeto kh ayl tamaasaa.

lines.english: By His Grace, water puts out the burning fire; He Himself stores it up in the wateryocean. ||4||
lines.transliteration: baldee jal nivrai kirpaa t ay aapay jal niDh  paa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: Dharat  upaa-ay Dh aree Dh aram saalaa. Creating the earth, He established it as the home of Dharma.

lines.punjabi: ਬਲਦੀ  ਜਿਲ  ਿਨਵਰੈ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਆਪੇ  ਜਲ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Creating and destroying, He remains unattached.
lines.transliteration: utpat parla-o aap niraalaa.

lines.english: He stages the play of the breath everywhere. Withdrawing His power, He lets the beings crumble. ||5||
lines.transliteration: pavnai kh ayl kee-aa sabh  thaa-ee kalaa kh inch dh aahaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: Your gardener is the vast vegetation of nature.
lines.transliteration: bhaar ath aarah maalan  tayree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਣੈ  ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਕਲਾ  ਿਖੰਿਚ  ਢਾਹਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The wind blowing around is the chauree, the fly-brush, waving over You.
lines.transliteration: cha-ur dhulai pavn ai lai fayree.

lines.english: The Lord placed the two lamps, the sun and the moon; the sun merges in the house of the moon. ||6||
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj d u-ay d eepak raakh ay sas gh ar soor samaa-id aa. ||6||

lines.english: The five birds do not fly wild.
lines.transliteration: pankhee panch udar nahee Dh aaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਦੁਇ ਦੀਪਕ  ਰਾਖੇ ਸਿਸ ਘਿਰ  ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The tree of life is fruitful, bearing the fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: safli-o birakh amrit  fal paavahi.

lines.english: The Gurmukh intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he eats the food of theLord's sublime essence. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sahj ravai gun  gaavai har ras chog chugaa-id aa. ||7||

lines.english: The dazzling light glitters, although neither the moon nor the stars are shining;
lines.transliteration: jhilmil jh ilkai chand  na taaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj kiran na bijul gh ainaaraa. neither the sun's rays nor the lightning flashes across the sky.

lines.english: I describe the indescribable state, which has no sign, where the all-pervading Lord is still pleasing to the mind. ||8||
lines.transliteration: akthee katha-o chihan nahee ko-ee poor rahi-aa man bhaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: The rays of Divine Light have spread out their brilliant radiance.
lines.transliteration: pasree kiran jot  uji-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥੀ  ਕਥਉ  ਿਚਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Having created the creation, the Merciful Lord Himself gazes upon it.
lines.transliteration: kar kar daykh ai aap d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: The sweet, melodious, unstruck sound current vibrates continuously in the home of the fearless Lord. ||9|| pMnw 1034
lines.transliteration: anhad run  jhunkaar sad aa Dh un nirbh a-o kai gh ar vaa-id aa. ||9||

lines.english: When the unstruck sound current resounds, doubt and fear run away.
lines.transliteration: anhad vaajai bh aram bh a-o bh aajai.

lines.english: God is all-pervading, giving shade to all.
lines.transliteration: sagal bi-aap rahi-aa parabh chh aajai.

lines.english: All belong to You; to the Gurmukhs, You are known. Singing Your Praises, they look beautiful in Your Court. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree t oo gurmukh  jaataa dar sohai gun  gaa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਜਾਤਾ  ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He is the Primal Lord, immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: aad niranjan nirmal so-ee.

lines.english: I know of no other at all.
lines.transliteration: avar na jaanaa d oojaa ko-ee.

lines.english: The One Universal Creator Lord dwells within, and is pleasing to the mind of thosewho banishe egotism and pride. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aykankaar vasai man bhaavai ha-umai garab gavaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਗਵਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, given by the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: amrit pee-aa sat gur dee-aa.

lines.english: I do not know any other second or third.
lines.transliteration: avar na jaanaa d oo-aa t ee-aa.

lines.english: He is the One, Unique, Infinite and Endless Lord; He evaluates all beings and placessome in His treasury. ||12||
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk so apar parampar parakh kh ajaanai paa-id aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਸੁ ਅਪਰ  ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਰਿਖ  ਖਜਾਨੈ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the True Lord are deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan sach gahir gambh eeraa.

lines.english: No one knows Your expanse.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na jaanai t ayraa cheeraa.

lines.english: All that are, beg from You; You are attained only by Your Grace. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jaytee hai t aytee tuDh jaachai karam milai so paa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੀ  ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: You hold karma and Dharma in Your hands, O True Lord.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam sach haath t umaarai.

lines.english: O Independent Lord, Your treasures are inexhaustible.
lines.transliteration: vayparvaah akhut bh andaarai.

lines.english: You are forever kind and compassionate, God. You unite in Your Union. ||14||
lines.transliteration: too da-i-aal kirpaal sad aa parabh  aapay mayl milaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਕਰਪਾਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: You Yourself see, and cause Yourself to be seen.
lines.transliteration: aapay daykh  dikhaavai aapay.

lines.english: You Yourself establish, and You Yourself disestablish.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaapay aapay.

lines.english: The Creator Himself unites and separates; He Himself kills and rejuvenates. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aapay jorh vichh orhay kart aa aapay maar jeevaa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜੋਿੜ ਿਵਛੋੜੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਿਰ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: As much as there is, is contained within You.
lines.transliteration: jaytee hai t aytee tuDh andar.

lines.english: You gaze upon Your creation, sitting within Your royal palace.
lines.transliteration: daykh eh aap bais bij mand ar.

lines.english: Nanak offers this true prayer; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I have found peace. ||16||1||13|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1034-9) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai baynantee har d arsan sukh  paa-id aa. ||16||1||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
lines.english: If I am pleasing to You, Lord, then I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan paavaa jay t uDh bhaavaa.

lines.english: In loving devotional worship, O True Lord, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay bh agat saachay gun  gaavaa.

lines.english: By Your Will, O Creator Lord, You have become pleasing to me, and so sweet to mytongue. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaanay too bh aaveh kart ay aapay rasan rasaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: The devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar, the Court of God.
lines.transliteration: sohan bhagat  parabh oo darbaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your slaves, Lord, are liberated.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-ay har d aas tumaaray.

lines.english: Eradicating self-conceit, they are attuned to  Your Love; night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-ay tayrai rang raat ay an-d in naam Dh i-aa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: Shiva, Brahma, gods and goddesses,
lines.transliteration: eesar barahmaa dayvee d ayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Indra, ascetics and silent sages serve You.
lines.transliteration: indar t apay mun t ayree sayvaa.

lines.english: Celibates, givers of charity and the many forest-dwellers have not found the Lord's limits. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jatee sat ee kayt ay banvaasee ant  na ko-ee paa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: No one knows You, unless You let them know You.
lines.transliteration: vin jaan aa-ay ko-ay na jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whatever is done, is by Your Will.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so aapan  bhaanai.

lines.english: You created the 8.4 million species of beings; by Your Will, they draw their breath.||4||
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jee-a upaa-ay bh aanai saah lavaa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, undoubtedly comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so nihcha-o hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਜੀਅ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh shows off, and comes to grief.
lines.transliteration: manmukh aap gan aa-ay rovai.

lines.english: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest; coming and going in reincarnation, hesuffers in pain. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naavhu bhulaa th a-ur na paa-ay aa-ay jaa-ay d ukh paa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: Pure is the body, and immaculate is the swan-soul;
lines.transliteration: nirmal kaa-i-aa oojal hansaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ  ਜਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich naam niranjan ansaa. within it is the immaculate essence of the Naam.

lines.english: Such a being drinks in all his pains like Ambrosial Nectar; he never suffers sorrow again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saglay dookh  amrit  kar peevai baahurh  dookh na paa-id aa. ||6||

lines.english: For his excessive indulgences, he receives only pain;
lines.transliteration: baho saadahu d ookh paraapat  hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਕਿਰ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bhogahu rog so ant  vigovai. from his enjoyments, he contracts diseases, and in the end, he wastes away.

lines.english: His pleasure can never erase his pain; without accepting the Lord's Will, he wanderslost and confused. ||7||
lines.transliteration: harkhahu sog na mit-ee kabhoo vin  bhaanay bh armaa-id aa. ||7||

lines.english: Without spiritual wisdom, they all just wander around.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan vihoonee bh avai sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਕਬਹੂ ਿਵਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere, lovingly engaged.
lines.transliteration: saachaa rav rahi-aa liv laa-ee.

lines.english: The Fearless Lord is known through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; one'slight merges into the Light. ||8||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o sabad  guroo sach jaat aa jot ee jot  milaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: He is the eternal, unchanging, immeasurable Lord.
lines.transliteration: atal adol atol muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In an instant, He destroys, ang then reconstructs.
lines.transliteration: khin meh dh aahi fayr usaaray.

lines.english: He has no form or shape, no limit or value. Pierced by the Shabad, one is satisfied. ||9|| pMnw 1035
lines.transliteration: roop na raykh-i-aa mit  nahee keemat  sabad  bhayd patee-aa-id aa. ||9||

lines.english: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: ham daasan kay d aas pi-aaray.

lines.english: The seekers of Truth and goodness contemplate You.
lines.transliteration: saaDhik saach bh alay veechaaray.

lines.english: Whoever believes in the Name, wins; He Himself implants Truth within. ||10||
lines.transliteration: mannay naa-o so-ee jin jaasee aapay saach d arirhaa-idaa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ  ਸੋਈ ਿਜਿਣ  ਜਾਸੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Truest of the True has the Truth is His lap.
lines.transliteration: palai saach sachay sachi-aaraa.

lines.english: The True Lord is pleased with those who love the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saachay bhaavai sabad  pi-aaraa.

lines.english: Exerting His power, the Lord has established Truth throughout the three worlds; withTruth He is pleased. ||11||
lines.transliteration: taribh avan saach kalaa Dh ar thaapee saachay hee pat ee-aa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਲਾ  ਧਿਰ ਥਾਪੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Everyone calls Him the greatest of the great.
lines.transliteration: vadaa vadaa aakhai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one understands Him.
lines.transliteration: gur bin sojhee kinai na ho-ee.

lines.english: The True Lord is pleased with those who merge in Truth; they are not separated again, and they do not suffer. ||12||
lines.transliteration: saach milai so saachay bhaa-ay naa veechh urh dukh paa-id aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁਿੜ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Dharahu vichh unay Dh aahee runnay. Separated from the Primal Lord, they loudly weep and wail.
They die and die, only to be reborn, when their time has passed.
lines.transliteration: mar mar janmeh muhlat punnay.

lines.english: He blesses those whom He forgives with gl orious greatness; united with Him, they do not regret or repent. ||13 |
lines.transliteration: jis bakhsay t is day vadi-aa-ee mayl na pachh otaa-idaa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਮੇਿਲ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: | He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa aapay bh ugtaa.

lines.english: He Himself is satisfied, and He Himself is liberated.
lines.transliteration: aapay taript aa aapay mukt aa.

lines.english: The Lord of liberation Himself grants liberation; He eradicates possessiveness and attachment. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aapay mukat d aan mukt eesar mamt aa moh chukaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੀਸਰੁ ਮਮਤਾ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: I consider Your gifts to be the most wonderful gifts.
lines.transliteration: daanaa kai sir d aan veechaaraa.

lines.english: You are the Cause of causes, Almighty Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath apaaraa.

lines.english: Creating the creation, You gaze upon what You have created; You cause all to do their deeds. ||15||
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai keet aa apn aa karn ee kaar karaa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ  ਅਪਣਾ ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: They alone sing Your Glorious Praises, who are pleasing to You, O True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say gun gaavahi saachay bh aaveh.

lines.english: They issue forth from You, and merge again into You.
lines.transliteration: tujh tay upjahi t ujh maahi samaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਹ  ਤੁਝ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak offers this true prayer; meeting with the True Lord, peace is obtained.||16||2||14|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1035-9) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai baynantee mil saachay sukh  paa-id aa. ||16||2||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੪॥
lines.english: For endless eons, there was only utter darkness.
lines.transliteration: arbad narbad  DhunDh ookaaraa.

lines.english: Dharan  na gagnaa hukam apaaraa. There was no earth or sky; there was only the infinite Command of His Hukam.
There was no day or night, no moon or sun; God sat in primal, profound Samaadhi.||1||
lines.transliteration: naa din rain na chand  na sooraj sunn samaaDh  lagaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: There were no sources of creation or powers of speech, no air or water.
lines.transliteration: khaan ee na ban ee pa-un  na paan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: There was no creation or destruction, no coming or going.
lines.transliteration: opat kh apat na aavan  jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਣੀ  ਨ ਬਾਣੀ  ਪਉਣ  ਨ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: There were no continents, nether regions, seven seas, rivers or flowing water. ||2||
