lines.transliteration: khand pat aal sapat  nahee saagar nad ee na neer vahaa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: There were no heavenly realms, earth or nether regions of the underworld.
lines.transliteration: naa tad  surag machh  pa-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ  ਸਪਤ  ਨਹੀ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ  ਨ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: There was no heaven or hell, no death or time.
lines.transliteration: dojak bh isat nahee kh ai kaalaa.

lines.english: There was no hell or heaven, no birth or death, no coming or going in reincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: narak surag nahee jaman marn aa naa ko aa-ay na jaa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: There was no Brahma, Vishnu or Shiva.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ  ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਇ  ਨ ਜਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: No one was seen, except the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: avar na deesai ayko so-ee.

lines.english: There was no female or male, no social class or caste of birth; no one experiencedpain or pleasure. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naar purakh nahee jaat  na janmaa naa ko d ukh sukh  paa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: There were no people of celibacy or charity; no one lived in the forests.
lines.transliteration: naa tad  jatee sat ee banvaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਰ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਜਨਮਾ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: There were no Siddhas or seekers, no one living in peace.
lines.transliteration: naa tad  siDh saaDh ik sukh vaasee.

lines.english: There were no Yogis, no wandering pilgrims, no religious robes; no one called himself the master. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jogee jangam bhaykh  na ko-ee naa ko naath kahaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: There was no chanting or meditation, no self-discipline, fasting or worship.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam naa barat  poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੰਗਮ  ਭੇਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: No one spoke or talked in duality.
lines.transliteration: naa ko aakh vakh aanai doojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾ ਬਰ੍ਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.english: He created Himself, and rejoiced; He evaluates Himself. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapay aap upaa-ay vigsai aapay keemat paa-id aa. ||6||

lines.english: There was no purification, no self-restraint, no malas of basil seeds.
lines.transliteration: naa such sanjam tulsee maalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: There were no Gopis, no Krishna, no cows or cowherds.
lines.transliteration: gopee kaan na ga-oo go-aalaa.

lines.english: There were no tantras, no mantras and no hypocrisy; no one played the flute. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tant mant  pakh and na ko-ee naa ko vans vajaa-id aa. ||7||

lines.english: There was no karma, no Dharma, no buzzing fly of Maya.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam nahee maa-i-aa maakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Social class and birth were not seen with any eyes.
lines.transliteration: jaat janam nahee d eesai aakh ee.

lines.english: There was no noose of attachment, no death inscribed upon the forehead; no one meditated on anything. ||8||
lines.transliteration: mamtaa jaal kaal nahee maathai naa ko kisai Dh i-aa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: There was no slander, no seed, no soul and no life.
lines.transliteration: nind bind  nahee jee-o na jind o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਮਤਾ  ਜਾਲੁ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਿਕਸੈ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: There was no Gorakh and no Maachhindra.
lines.transliteration: naa tad  gorakh  naa maachh indo.

lines.english: There was no spiritual wisdom or meditation, no ancestry or creation, no reckoning of accounts. ||9|| pMnw 1036
lines.transliteration: naa tad  gi-aan Dh i-aan kul opat  naa ko gan at ganaa-idaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਕੁਲ ਓਪਿਤ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਗਣਤ  ਗਣਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: There were no castes or social classes, no religious robes, no Brahmin or Kh'shaatriya.
lines.transliteration: varan bhaykh  nahee barahman  khatree.

lines.english: There were no demi-gods or temples, no cows or Gaayatri prayer.
lines.transliteration: day-o na d ayhuraa ga-oo gaa-it aree.

lines.english: There were no burnt offerings, no ceremonial feasts, no cleansing rituals at sacred shrines of pilgrimage; no one worshipped in adoration. ||10||
lines.transliteration: hom jag nahee tirath naavan  naa ko poojaa laa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਹੀ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: There was no Mullah, there was no Qazi.
lines.transliteration: naa ko mulaa naa ko kaajee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਲਾ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੀ  ॥
lines.english: There was no Shaykh, or pilgrims to Mecca.
lines.transliteration: naa ko saykh masaa-ik haajee.

lines.english: There was no king or subjects, and no worldly egotism; no one spoke of himself.||11||
lines.transliteration: ra-ee-at raa-o na ha-umai d unee-aa naa ko kahan  kahaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਰਈਅਿਤ  ਰਾਉ ਨ ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਣੁ  ਕਹਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: There was no love or devotion, no Shiva or Shakti - no energy or matter.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o na bh agtee naa siv sakt ee.

lines.english: There were no friends or companions, no semen or blood.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet bind  nahee rakt ee.

lines.english: He Himself is the banker, and He Himself is the merchant. Such is the Pleasure of theWill of the True Lord. ||12||
lines.transliteration: aapay saahu aapay vanjaaraa saachay ayho bh aa-idaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ਸਾਚੇ ਏਹੋ ਭਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: There were no Vedas, Korans or Bibles, no Simritees or Shaastras.
lines.transliteration: bayd kat ayb na simrit  saasat .

lines.english: There was no recitation of the Puraanas, no sunrise or sunset.
lines.transliteration: paath puraan  udai nahee aasat .

lines.english: The Unfathomable Lord Himself was the speaker and the preacher; the unseen Lord Himself saw everything. ||13||
lines.transliteration: kahtaa bakt aa aap agochar aapay alakh  lakhaa-idaa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤਾ  ਬਕਤਾ  ਆਿਪ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: When He so willed, He created the world.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aanaa taa jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without any supporting power, He sustained the universe.
lines.transliteration: baajh kalaa aadaan  rahaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva; He fostered enticement and attachment toMaya. ||14||
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays upaa-ay maa-i-aa moh vaDhaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: How rare is that person who listens to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: virlay ka-o gur sabad sun aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He created the creation, and watches over it; the Hukam of His Command is over all.
lines.transliteration: kar kar daykh ai hukam sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He formed the planets, solar systems and nether regions, and brought what washidden to manifestation. ||15||
lines.transliteration: khand barahmand paat aal arambh ay gupt ahu pargatee aa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਪਾਤਾਲ  ਅਰੰਭੇ  ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ  ਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: No one knows His limits.
lines.transliteration: taa kaa ant  na jaan ai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: This understanding comes from the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth are wonderstruck; singing His Glorious Praises, they are filled with wonder. ||16||3||15|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1036-10) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach ratay bismaad ee bisam bh a-ay gun  gaa-id aa. ||16||3||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਤੇ ਿਬਸਮਾਦੀ  ਿਬਸਮ  ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He Himself created the creation, remaining unattached.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap upaa-ay niraalaa.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord has established His True Home.
lines.transliteration: saachaa thaan kee-o da-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Binding together air, water and fire, He created the fortress of the body. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee agnee kaa banDh an kaa-i-aa kot rachaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: The Creator established the nine gates.
lines.transliteration: na-o ghar thaapay thaapan haarai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਅਗਨੀ  ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Tenth Gate, is the dwelling of the infinite, unseen Lord.
lines.transliteration: dasvai vaasaa alakh  apaarai.

lines.english: The seven seas are overflowing with the Ambrosial Water; the Gurmukhs are notstained with filth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saa-ir sapat bh aray jal nirmal gurmukh  mail na laa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: The lamps of the sun and the moon fill all with light.
lines.transliteration: rav sas deepak jot  sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਇਰ  ਸਪਤ  ਭਰੇ ਜਿਲ  ਿਨਰਮਿਲ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Creating them, He beholds His own glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: aapay kar vaykhai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: The Giver of peace is forever the embodiment of Light; from the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jot saroop sad aa sukh -daata sachay sobh aa paa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: Within the fortress are the stores and markets; the business is transacted there.
lines.transliteration: garh meh haat patan  vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ ਸਰੂਪ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Supreme Merchant weighs with the perfect weights.
lines.transliteration: poorai tol t olai van jaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself buys the jewel, and He Himself appraises its value. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay ratan visaahay layvai aapay keemat  paa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: The Appraiser appraises its value.
lines.transliteration: keemat paa-ee paavan haarai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਰਤਨੁ ਿਵਸਾਹੇ  ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Independent Lord is overflowing with His treasures.
lines.transliteration: vayparvaah pooray bhandaarai.

lines.english: He holds all powers, He is all-pervading; how few are those who, as Gurmukh,understand this. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa lay aapay rahi-aa gurmukh kisai bujh aa-idaa. ||5||

lines.english: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay pooraa gur bh aytai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਲੇ ਆਪੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot strike him then.
lines.transliteration: jam jandaar na maarai faytai.

lines.english: He blossoms forth like the lotus flower in the water; he blossoms forth in joyful meditation. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal antar kamal bigaasee aapay bigas Dh i-aa-id aa. ||6||

lines.english: He Himself rains down the Ambrosial Stream of jewels, diamonds, and rubies ofpriceless value.
lines.transliteration: aapay varkhai amrit  Dhaaraa. rat an javayhar laal apaaraa.

lines.english: When they meet the True Guru, then they find the Perfect Lord; they obtain thetreasure of Love. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a pooraa paa-ee-ai paraym pad aarath paa-id aa. ||7||

lines.english: Whoever receives the priceless treasure of Love
lines.transliteration: paraym padaarath lahai amolo.
kab hee na ghaatas pooraa t olo. - his weight never decreases; he has perfect weight.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The trader of Truth becomes true, and obtains the merchandise. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sachay kaa vaapaaree hovai sacho sa-udaa paa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: How rare are those who obtain the true merchandise.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sa-udaa virlaa ko paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਘਾਟਿਸ  ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, one meets with the Lord. pMnw 1037
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur milai milaa-ay.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh realizes the Hukam of His command; surrendering to His Command, one merges in the Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay so hukam pachh aanai maanai hukam samaa-id aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: By His Command we come, and by His command we merge into Him again.
lines.transliteration: hukmay aa-i-aa hukam samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By His Command, the world was formed.
lines.transliteration: hukmay deesai jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By His Command, the heavens, this world and the nether regions were created; by HisCommand, His Power supports them. ||10||
lines.transliteration: hukmay surag machh pa-i-aalaa hukmay kalaa rahaa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ  ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਲਾ  ਰਹਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Hukam of His Command is the mythical bull which supports the burden of theearth on its head.
lines.transliteration: hukmay Dhart ee Dh a-ul sir bh aaraN.

lines.english: By His Hukam, air, water and fire came into being.
lines.transliteration: hukmay pa-un paan ee gain aaraN.

lines.english: By His Hukam, one dwells in the house of matter and energy - Shiva and Shakti. ByHis Hukam, He plays His plays. ||11||
lines.transliteration: hukmay siv saktee gh ar vaasaa hukmay kh ayl kh aylaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਿਸਵ ਸਕਤੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His command, the sky is spread above.
lines.transliteration: hukmay aadaanay aagaasee.

lines.english: By His Hukam, His creatures dwell in the water, on the land and throughout the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: hukmay jal thal taribh avan vaasee.

lines.english: By His Hukam, we draw our breath and receive our food; by His Hukam, He watchesover us, and inspires us to see. ||12||
lines.transliteration: hukmay saas giraas sadaa fun hukmay d aykh dikhaa-idaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਸ ਿਗਰਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਫੁਿਨ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੇਿਖ ਿਦਖਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: By His Hukam, He created His ten incarnations,
lines.transliteration: hukam upaa-ay das a-ut aaraa.
dayv d aanav agn at apaaraa. and the uncounted and infinite gods and devils.

lines.english: Whoever obeys the Hukam of His Command, is robed with honor in the Court of theLord; united with the Truth, He merges in the Lord. ||13||
lines.transliteration: maanai hukam so dargeh paijh ai saach milaa-ay samaa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਝੈ ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, the thirty-six ages passed.
lines.transliteration: hukmay jug chhat eeh gud aaray.

lines.english: By His Hukam, the Siddhas and seekers contemplate Him.
lines.transliteration: hukmay siDh saaDh ik veechaaray.

lines.english: The Lord Himself has brought all under His control. Whoever He forgives, is liberated.||14||
lines.transliteration: aap naath natheeN sabh jaa kee bakh say mukat  karaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨਾਥੁ ਨਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸੇ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: In the strong fortress of the body with its beautiful doors, is the king, with his specialassistants and ministers.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kot garhai meh raajaa. nayb kh avaas bh alaa d arvaajaa.

lines.english: Those gripped by falsehood and greed do not dwell in the celestial home; engrossed in greed and sin, they come to regret and repent. ||15||
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa lobh naahee gh ar vaasaa lab paap pachh utaa-idaa. ||15||

lines.english: Truth and contentment govern this body-village.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh nagar meh kaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਲੋਭੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਲਿਬ ਪਾਿਪ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Chastity, truth and self-control are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam saran  muraaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, one intuitively meets the Lord, the Life of the World; the Word of the Guru'sShabad brings honor. ||16||4||16|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1037-10) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sahj milai jagjeevan gur sabdee pat  paa-id aa. ||16||4||16||

lines.english: In the Primal Void, the Infinite Lord assumed His Power.
lines.transliteration: sunn kalaa aprampar Dhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੬॥
lines.english: He Himself is unattached, infinite and incomparable.
lines.transliteration: aap niraalam apar apaaree.

lines.english: He Himself exercised His Creative Power, and He gazes upon His creation; from thePrimal Void, He formed the Void. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay kudrat  kar kar d aykhai sunnahu sunn upaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: From this Primal Void, He fashioned air and water.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee sunnai t ay saajay.

lines.english: He created the universe, and the king in the fortress of the body.
lines.transliteration: sarisat upaa-ay kaa-i-aa garh raajay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Light pervades fire, water and souls; Your Power rests in the Primal Void. ||2||
lines.transliteration: agan paanee jee-o jot  tumaaree sunnay kalaa rahaa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: From this Primal Void, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva issued forth.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu barahmaa bisan mahays upaa-ay.

lines.english: This Primal Void is pervasive throughout all the ages.
lines.transliteration: sunnay vartay jug sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਸੁੰਨੇ ਕਲਾ  ਰਹਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That humble being who contemplates this state is perfect; meeting with him, doubt is dispelled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: is pad veechaaray so jan pooraa t is milee-ai bh aram chukaa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: From this Primal Void, the seven seas were established.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu sapat sarovar thaapay.

lines.english: The One who created them, Himself contemplates them.
lines.transliteration: jin saajay veechaaray aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That human being who becomes Gurmukh, who bathes in the pool of Truth, is notcast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tit sat sar manoo-aa gurmukh  naavai fir baahurh  jon na paa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: From this Primal Void, came the moon, the sun and the earth.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu chand sooraj gain aaray.

lines.english: His Light pervades all the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: tis kee jot  taribhavan saaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਤ ਸਿਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord of this Primal Void is unseen, infinite and immaculate; He is absorbed in the Primal Trance of Deep Meditation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sunnay alakh apaar niraalam sunnay t aarhee laa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: From this Primal Void, the earth and the Akaashic Ethers were created.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu Dharat  akaas upaa-ay.

lines.english: He supports them without any visible support, by exercising His True Power.
lines.transliteration: bin thammaa raakhay sach kal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਨੇ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਸੁੰਨੇ ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He fashioned the three worlds, and the rope of Maya; He Himself creates anddestroys. ||6||
lines.transliteration: taribh avan saaj maykh ulee maa-i-aa aap upaa-ay kh apaa-id aa. ||6||

lines.english: From this Primal Void, came the four sources of creation, and the power of speech.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu khaan ee sunnahu ban ee.

lines.english: They were created from the Void, and they will merge into the Void.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu upjee sunn samaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਸਾਿਜ  ਮੇਖੁਲੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਖਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Supreme Creator created the play of Nature; through the Word of His Shabad, Hestages His Wondrous Show. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ut-bh uj chalat  kee-aa sir kart ai bismaad  sabad  daykhaa-idaa. ||7||

lines.english: From this Primal Void, He made both night and day;
lines.transliteration: sunnahu raat d inas d u-ay kee-ay.
opat kh apat sukh aa dukh dee-ay. creation and destruction, pleasure and pain.

lines.punjabi: ਉਤਭੁਜੁ  ਚਲਤੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਬਸਮਾਦੁ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਦੇਖਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is immortal, untouched by pleasure and pain. He obtains the home of his own inner being. ||8|| pMnw 1038
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh hee t ay amar at eetaa gurmukh  nij gh ar paa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: The Saam Veda, the Rig Veda, the Jujar Veda and the At'harva Veda
lines.transliteration: saam vayd rig jujar atharban .

lines.english: Maya.
lines.transliteration: barahmay mukh maa-i-aa hai t arai gun . form the mouth of Brahma; they speak of the three gunas, the three qualities of

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੇ  ਮੁਿਖ ਮਾਇਆ  ਹੈ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ॥
lines.english: None of them can describe His worth. We speak as He inspires us to speak. ||9||
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahi na sakai ko t i-o bolay ji-o bolaa-id aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਿਤਉ  ਬੋਲੇ ਿਜਉ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: From the Primal Void, He created the seven nether regions.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu sapat paat aal upaa-ay.

lines.english: From the Primal Void, He established this world to lovingly dwell upon Him.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu bhavan  rakhay liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The Infinite Lord Himself created the creation. Everyone acts as You make them act,Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: aapay kaaran kee-aa aprampar sabh  tayro kee-aa kamaa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਅਪਰੰਪਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ  ਕਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Your Power is diffused through the three gunas: raajas, taamas and satva.
lines.transliteration: raj tam sat  kal tayree chh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through egotism, they suffer the pains of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: janam maran ha-umai d ukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those blessed by His Grace become Gurmukh; they attain the fourth state, and are liberated. ||11||
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay har gurmukh gun  cha-uthai mukat  karaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਿਣ  ਚਉਥੈ  ਮੁਕਿਤ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: From the Primal Void, the ten incarnations welled up.
lines.transliteration: sunnahu upjay das avt aaraa.

lines.english: Creating the Universe, He made the expanse.
lines.transliteration: sarisat upaa-ay kee-aa paasaaraa.

lines.english: He fashioned the demi-gods and demons, the heavenly heralds and celestialmusicians; everyone acts according to their past karma. ||12||
lines.transliteration: dayv d aanav gan  ganDh arab saajay sabh  likhi-aa karam kamaa-id aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ  ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਸਾਜੇ ਸਿਭ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh understands, and does not suffer the disease.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh samjh ai rog na ho-ee.

lines.english: How rare are those who understand this ladder of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ih gur kee pa-orhee jaan ai jan ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Throughout the ages, they are dedicated to liberation, and so they become liberated;thus they are honored. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jugah jugantar mukat  paraa-in  so mukat  bha-i-aa pat  paa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗਹ  ਜੁਗੰਤਿਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਰਾਇਣ  ਸੋ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਇਆ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: From the Primal Void, the five elements became manifest.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  sunnahu pargaasaa.

lines.english: They joined to form the body, which engages in actions.
lines.transliteration: dayh sanjogee karam abh i-aasaa.

lines.english: Both bad and good are written on the forehead, the seeds of vice and virtue. ||14||
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa d u-ay mast ak leekh ay paap punn beejaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੀਖੇ  ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is sublime and detached.
lines.transliteration: ootam sat gur purakh  niraalay.

lines.english: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, He is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay har ras mat vaalay.

lines.english: Riches, intellect, miraculous spiritual powers and spiritual wisdom are obtained from the Guru; through perfect destiny, they are received. ||15||
lines.transliteration: riDh buDh  siDh gi-aan guroo t ay paa-ee-ai poorai bh aag milaa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ  ਬੁਿਧ ਿਸਿਧ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: This mind is so in love with Maya.
lines.transliteration: is man maa-i-aa ka-o nayhu ghanayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Only a few are spiritually wise enough to understand and know this.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee boojhhu gi-aanee karahu nibayraa.

lines.english: In hope and desire, egotism and skepticism, the greedy man acts falsely. ||16||
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa ha-umai sahsaa nar lobhee koorh  kamaa-id aa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਨਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: From the True Guru, contemplative meditation is obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay paa-ay veechaaraa.

lines.english: And then, one dwells with the True Lord in His celestial home, the Primal State of Absorption in Deepest Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: sunn samaaDh sachay gh ar baaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the immaculate sound current of the Naad, and the Music of the Shabadresound; one merges into the True Name of the Lord. ||17||5||17|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1038-13) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nirmal naad sabad  Dhun sach raamai naam samaa-id aa. ||17||5||17||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਸਬਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: God is compassionate; He does not come or go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaa-ee parabh kirpaalaa.

lines.english: He pervades all beings in His mysterious way; the Sovereign Lord remains detached.||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-aa andar jugat  samaa-ee rahi-o niraalam raa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The world is a reflection of Him; He has no father or mother.
lines.transliteration: jag tis kee chh aa-i-aa jis baap na maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਜੁਗਿਤ ਸਮਾਈ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has not acquired any sister or brother.
lines.transliteration: naa tis bh ain na bh araa-o kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗੁ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ  ਿਜਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: There is no creation or destruction for Him; He has no ancestry or social status. The Ageless Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naa tis opat  khapat kul jaat ee oh ajraavar man bh aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: You are the Deathless Primal Being. Death does not hover over Your head.
lines.transliteration: too akaal purakh  naahee sir kaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਓਪਿਤ  ਖਪਿਤ  ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤੀ  ਓਹੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰ ੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the unseen inaccessible and detached Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: too purakh  alaykh  agamm niraalaa.

lines.english: You are true and content; the Word of Your Shabad is cool and soothing. Through it,we are lovingly, intuitively attuned to You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh sabad  at seetal sahj bh aa-ay liv laa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The three qualities are pervasive; the Lord dwells in His home, the fourth state.
lines.transliteration: tarai vart aa-ay cha-uthai gh ar vaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਿਤ  ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He has made death and birth into a bite of food.
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal kee-ay ik garasaa.

lines.english: The immaculate Light is the Life of the whole world. The Guru reveals the unstruckmelody of the Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: nirmal jot sarab jagjeevan gur anhad  sabad  dikhaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Sublime and good are those humble Saints, the Beloveds of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ootam jan sant  bhalay har pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ ਜੋਿਤ ਸਰਬ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and are carried across tothe other side.
lines.transliteration: har ras maatay paar ut aaray.

lines.english: Nanak is the dust of the Society of the Saints; by Guru's Grace, he finds the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak rayn sant  jan sangat  har gur parsaadee paa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. All beings belong to You. pMnw 1039
lines.transliteration: too ant arjaamee jee-a sabh  tayray.

lines.english: You are the Great Giver; I am Your slave.
lines.transliteration: too daataa ham sayvak t ayray.

lines.english: Please be merciful and bless me with Your Ambrosial Naam, and the jewel, the lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. ||6||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam kirpaa kar d eejai gur gi-aan rat an deepaa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਦੀਜੈ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਰਤਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.english: From the union of the five elements, this body was made.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  mil ih t an kee-aa.

lines.english: Finding the Lord, the Supreme Soul, peace is established.
lines.transliteration: aatam raam paa-ay sukh  thee-aa.

lines.english: The good karma of past actions brings fruitful rewards, and man is blessed with thejewel of the Lord's Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: karam kartoot  amrit  fal laagaa har naam rat an man paa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਤੂਿਤ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: His mind does not feel any hunger or thirst.
lines.transliteration: naa tis bh ookh pi-aas man maani-aa.

lines.english: He knows the Immaculate Lord to be everywhere, in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: sarab niranjan ghat gh at jaani-aa.

lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Ambrosial essence, he becomes a pure, detached renunciate; he is lovingly absorbed in the Guru's Teachings. ||8||
lines.transliteration: amrit ras raat aa kayval bairaagee gurmat  bhaa-ay subh aa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਿਸ ਰਾਤਾ  ਕੇਵਲ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Whoever does the deeds of the soul, day and night,
lines.transliteration: aDhi-aat am karam karay d in raat ee.
nirmal jot nirant ar jaat ee. sees the immaculate Divine Light deep within.

lines.english: Enraptured with the delightful essence of the Shabad, the source of nectar, my tongueplays the sweet music of the flute. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sabad rasaal rasan ras rasnaa bayn  rasaal vajaa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਸਾਲੁ  ਰਸਨ  ਰਿਸ ਰਸਨਾ  ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ  ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.english: He alone plays the sweet music of this flute,
lines.transliteration: bayn rasaal vajaavai so-ee.
jaa kee taribh avan sojhee ho-ee. who knows the three worlds.

lines.english: O Nanak, know this, through the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly focus yourself on theLord's Name. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak boojhhu ih biDh  gurmat  har raam naam liv laa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੂਝਹੁ ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Rare are those beings in this world,
lines.transliteration: aisay jan virlay sansaaray.
gur sabad vichaareh raheh niraaray. who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and remain detached.

lines.english: They save themselves, and save all their associates and ancestors; fruitful is their birth and coming into this world. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aap tareh sangat  kul taareh t in safal janam jag aa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਰਿਹ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਜਿਗ  ਆਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He alone knows the home of his own heart, and the door to the temple,
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar mand ar jaan ai so-ee.
jis pooray gur tay sojh ee ho-ee. who obtains perfect understanding from the Guru.

lines.english: In the body-fortress is the palace; God is the True Master of this Palace. The TrueLord established His True Throne there. ||12||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa garh mahal mahlee parabh  saachaa sach saachaa t akhat rachaa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਗੜ ਮਹਲ  ਮਹਲੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਤਖਤੁ  ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The fourteen realms and the two lamps are the witnesses.
lines.transliteration: chatur d as haat d eevay d u-ay saakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਤੁਰ  ਦਸ ਹਾਟ ਦੀਵੇ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's servants, the self-elect, do not taste the poison of corruption.
lines.transliteration: sayvak panch naahee bikh chaakh ee.

lines.english: Deep within, is the priceless, incomparable commodity; meeting with the Guru, thewealth of the Lord is obtained. ||13||
lines.transliteration: antar vasat  anoop nirmolak gur mili-ai har Dh an paa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਅਨੂਪ ਿਨਰਮੋਲਕ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: He alone sits on the throne, who is worthy of the throne.
lines.transliteration: takhat bahai t akh-tai kee laa-ik.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, he subdues the five demons, and becomes the Lord's foot soldier.
lines.transliteration: panch samaa-ay gurmat paa-ik.

lines.english: He has existed from the very beginning of time and throughout the ages; He existshere and now, and will always exist. Meditating on Him, skepticism and doubt aredispelled. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee hai bh ee hosee sahsaa bh aram chukaa-i-aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਹਸਾ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Throne is greeted and worshipped day and night.
lines.transliteration: takhat salaam hovai d in raat ee.

lines.english: This true glorious greatness comes to those who love the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: ih saach vadaa-ee gurmat liv jaat ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, and swim across the river; they find the Lord, theirbest friend, in the end. ||15||1||18|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1039-14) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam japahu tar t aaree har ant  sakhaa-ee paa-i-aa. ||15||1||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਖਾਈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥੧॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Gather in the wealth of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har Dhan sanchahu ray jan bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Serve the True Guru, and remain in His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv rahhu sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਰੇ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This wealth cannot be stolen; the celestial melody of the Shabad wells up and keepsus awake and aware. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taskar chor na laagai t aa ka-o Dh un upjai sabad  jagaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: You are the One Universal Creator, the Immaculate King.
lines.transliteration: too aykankaar niraalam raajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਗਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself arrange and resolve the affairs of Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: too aap savaareh jan kay kaajaa.

lines.english: You are immortal, immovable, infinite and priceless; O Lord, Your place is beautifuland eternal. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amar adol apaar amolak har asthir thaan suhaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰਿਹ  ਜਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the body-village, the most sublime place,
lines.transliteration: dayhee nagree oot am thaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਅਸਿਥਰ  ਥਾਿਨ  ਸੁਹਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: panch lok vaseh parDhaanaa. the supremely noble people dwell.

lines.english: Above them is the Immaculate Lord, the One Universal Creator; they are lovinglyabsorbed in the profound, primal state of Samaadhi. ||3||
lines.transliteration: oopar aykankaar niraalam sunn samaaDh lagaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: There are nine gates to the body-village;
lines.transliteration: dayhee nagree na-o d arvaajay.
sir sir karnaihaarai saajay. the Creator Lord fashioned them for each and every person.

lines.english: Within the Tenth Gate, dwells the Primal Lord, detached and unequalled. Theunknowable reveals Himself. ||4||
lines.transliteration: dasvai purakh  ateet niraalaa aapay alakh  lakhaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The Primal Lord cannot be held to account; True is His Celestial Court.
lines.transliteration: purakh alaykh  sachay d eevaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸਵੈ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਿਨਰਾਲਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Hukam of His Command is in effect; True is His Insignia.
lines.transliteration: hukam chalaa-ay sach neesaanaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, search and examine your own home, and you shall find the Supreme Soul, and the Name of the Lord. ||5|| pMnw 1040
lines.transliteration: naanak khoj lahhu gh ar apnaa har aat am raam naam paa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: The Primal Lord is everywhere, immaculate and all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: sarab niranjan purakh sujaanaa.

lines.english: He administers justice, and is absorbed in the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: adal karay gur gi-aan samaanaa.

lines.english: He seizes sexual desire and anger by their necks, and kills them; He eradicates egotism and greed. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lai gard an maaray ha-umai lobh  chukaa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਿਨ  ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: In the True Place, the Formless Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: sachai thaan vasai nirankaaraa.

lines.english: Whoever understands his own self, contemplates the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai sabad  veechaaraa.

lines.english: He comes to abide deep within the True Mansion of His Presence, and his comings and goings are ended. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sachai mahal nivaas nirantar aavan  jaan chukaa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: His mind does not waver, and he is not buffeted by the winds of desire.
lines.transliteration: naa man chalai na pa-un udaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਪਉਣੁ  ਉਡਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Such a Yogi vibrates the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jogee sabad anaahad  vaavai.

lines.english: God Himself plays the pure music of the Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds tohear. ||8||
lines.transliteration: panch sabad jh unkaar niraalam parabh  aapay vaa-ay sun aa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ  ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਿਨਰਾਲਮੁ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪੇ  ਵਾਇ  ਸੁਣਾਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God, in detachment, one intuitively merges into the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bha-o bairaagaa sahj samaat aa.

lines.english: Renouncing egotism, he is imbued with the unstruck sound current.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai ti-aagee anhad  raataa.

lines.english: With the ointment of enlightenment, the Immaculate Lord is known; the ImmaculateLord King is pervading everywhere. ||9||
lines.transliteration: anjan saar niranjan jaanai sarab niranjan raa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.english: God is eternal and imperishable; He is the Destroyer of pain and fear.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhai bhanjan parabh  abhinaasee.

lines.english: He cures the disease, and cuts away the noose of death.
lines.transliteration: rog katay kaatee jam faasee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord God is the Destroyer of fear; meeting the Guru, the Lord God is found. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak har parabh so bh a-o bh anjan gur mili-ai har parabh  paa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: One who knows the Immaculate Lord chews up death.
lines.transliteration: kaalai kaval niranjan jaanai.

lines.english: One who understands karma, realizes the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: boojhai karam so sabad  pachh aanai.

lines.english: He Himself knows, and He Himself realizes. This whole world is all His play. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai aap pachh aanai sabh  tis kaa choj sabaa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Banker, and He Himself is the Merchant.
lines.transliteration: aapay saahu aapay vanjaaraa.

lines.english: The Appraiser Himself appraises.
lines.transliteration: aapay parkhay parkh anhaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself tests upon His Touchstone, and He Himself estimates the value. ||12||
lines.transliteration: aapay kas kasvatee laa-ay aapay keemat paa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਸ ਕਸਵਟੀ  ਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: God Himself, the Merciful Lord, grants His Grace.
lines.transliteration: aap da-i-aal d a-i-aa parabh  Dhaaree.

lines.english: The Gardener pervades and permeates each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rav rahi-aa banvaaree.

lines.english: The pure, primal, detached Lord abides within all. The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, leads us to meet the Lord God. ||13||
lines.transliteration: purakh at eet vasai nihkayval gur purkh ai purakh  milaa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਵਸੈ ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: God is wise and all-knowing; He purges men of their pride.
lines.transliteration: parabh d aanaa beenaa garab gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Eradicating duality, the One Lord reveals Himself.
lines.transliteration: doojaa maytai ayk d ikhaa-ay.

lines.english: Such a being remains unattached amidst hope, singing the Praise of the ImmaculateLord, who has no ancestry. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aasaa maahi niraalam jonee akul niranjan gaa-i-aa. ||14||

lines.english: Eradicating egotism, he obtains the peace of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayt sabad sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: He alone is spiritually wise, who contemplates his own self.
lines.transliteration: aap veechaaray gi-aanee so-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the true profit is obtained; in theSat Sangat, the True Congregation, the fruit of Truth is obtained. ||15||2||19|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1040-13) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jas har gun laahaa sat sangat  sach fal paa-i-aa. ||15||2||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਲਾਹਾ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਚੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥੨॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Speak the Truth, and remain in the home of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach kahhu sachai ghar rahn aa.

lines.english: Remain dead while yet alive, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marahu bh avjal jag t arnaa.

lines.english: The Guru is the boat, the ship, the raft; meditating on the Lord in your mind, you shall be carried across to the other side. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur bohith gur bayrhee t ulhaa man har jap paar langh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Eliminating egotism, possessiveness and greed,
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa lobh  binaasan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: na-o dar mukt ay dasvai aasan. one is liberated from the nine gates, and obtains a place in the Tenth Gate.

lines.english: Lofty and high, the farthest of the far and infinite, He created Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: oopar parai parai aprampar jin aapay aap upaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Receiving the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly attuned to the Lord, one crosses over.
lines.transliteration: gurmat layvhu har liv t aree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਊਪਿਰ  ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਿਜਿਨ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Singing the Praises of the absolute Lord, why should anyone be afraid of death?
lines.transliteration: akal gaa-ay jam tay ki-aa daree-ai.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see only You; I do not sing of any other at all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jat jat  daykh-a-u t at tat tum hee avar na d utee-aa gaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: True is the Lord's Name, and True is His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: sach har naam sach hai sarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: True is the Word of the Guru's Shabad, grasping it, one is carries across.
lines.transliteration: sach gur sabad jit ai lag t arnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Speaking the Unspoken, one sees the Infinite Lord, and then, he does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: akath kathai daykh ai aprampar fun garabh  na jonee jaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Without the Truth, no one finds sincerity or contentment.
lines.transliteration: sach bin sat sant okh na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥੁ  ਕਥੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਫੁਿਨ ਗਰਿਭ  ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one is liberated; coming and going in reincarnation continue.
lines.transliteration: bin gur mukat na aavai jaavai.

lines.english: Chanting the Mool Mantra, and the Name of the Lord, the source of nectar, says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||5|| pMnw 1041
lines.transliteration: mool mantar har naam rasaa-in  kaho naanak pooraa paa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Without the Truth, the terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed.
lines.transliteration: sach bin bhavjal jaa-ay na t ari-aa.

lines.english: This ocean is vast and unfathomable; it is overflowing with the worst poison.
lines.transliteration: ayhu samund athaahu mahaa bikh  bhari-aa.

lines.english: One who receives the Guru's Teachings, and remains aloof and detached, obtains a place in the home of the Fearless Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: rahai ateet  gurmat  lay oopar har nirbh a-o kai gh ar paa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: False is the cleverness of loving attachment to the world.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee jag hit  kee chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: In no time at all, it comes and goes.
lines.transliteration: bilam na laagai aavai jaa-ee.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the proud egotistical people depart; increation and destruction they are wasted away. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chaleh abhimaanee upjai binas kh apaa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: In creation and destruction, they are bound in bondage.
lines.transliteration: upjahi binsahi banDhan banDh ay.

lines.english: The noose of egotism and Maya is around their necks.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa kay gal fanDhay.

lines.english: Whoever does not accept the Guru's Teachings, and does not dwell upon the Lord's Name, is bound and bagged, and dragged into the City of Death. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jis raam naam naahee mat gurmat  so jam pur banDh  chalaa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬੰਿਧ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, how can anyone be emancipated or liberated?
lines.transliteration: gur bin mokh mukat  ki-o paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Without the Guru, how can anyone meditate on the Lord's Name?
lines.transliteration: bin gur raam naam ki-o Dhi-aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over the arduous, terrifying world-ocean; you shall be emancipated, and find peace. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gurmat layho t arahu bh av dutar mukat  bha-ay sukh  paa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਭਵ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, Krishna lifted up the mountain of Govardhan.
lines.transliteration: gurmat krisan govarDh an Dh aaray.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, Rama floated stones across the ocean.
lines.transliteration: gurmat saa-ir paahan  taaray.

lines.english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, the supreme status is obtained; O Nanak, the Guru eradicates doubt. ||10||
lines.transliteration: gurmat layho param pad  paa-ee-ai naanak gur bh aram chukaa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over to the other side through Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmat layho t arahu sach t aaree.

lines.english: O soul, remember the Lord within your heart.
lines.transliteration: aatam cheenahu rid ai muraaree.

lines.english: The noose of death is cut away, meditating on the Lord; you shall obtain theImmaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||11||
lines.transliteration: jam kay faahay kaateh har jap akul niranjan paa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਅਕੁਲ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Holy become one's friends and Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: gurmat panch sakh ay gur bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the inner fire is subdued and extinguished.
lines.transliteration: gurmat agan nivaar samaa-ee.

lines.english: Chant the Naam with your mind and mouth; know the unknowable Lord, the Life ofthe World, deep within the nucleus of your heart. ||12||
lines.transliteration: man mukh naam japahu jagjeevan rid  antar alakh  lakhaa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh understands, and is pleased with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai sabad  pateejai.

lines.english: Who does he praise or slander?
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa kis kee keejai.

lines.english: Know yourself, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; let your mind be pleased with the Lord, the Master of the Universe. ||13||
lines.transliteration: cheenahu aap japahu jagdeesar har jagannaath man bh aa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਨਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰ ੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Know the One who pervades all the realms of the universe.
lines.transliteration: jo barahmand khand so jaan hu.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, understand and realize the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh hu sabad  pachh aanhu.

lines.english: The Enjoyer enjoys each and every heart, and yet He remains detached from all.||14||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at bhogay bh oganhaaraa rahai at eet sabaa-i-aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ  ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Pure Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat bolhu har jas soochaa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, behold the lofty Lord with your eyes.
lines.transliteration: gurmat aakh ee daykhhu oochaa.

lines.english: Whoever listens to the Lord's Name, and the Word of His Bani, O Nanak, is imbuedwith the color of the Lord's Love. ||15||3||20|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1041-14) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarvanee naam sun ai har ban ee naanak har rang rangaa-i-aa. ||15||3||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਿਰ ਬਾਣੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥੩॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Leave behind sexual desire, anger and the slander of others.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh parhar par nind aa.

lines.english: Renounce greed and possessiveness, and become carefree.
lines.transliteration: lab lobh t aj hohu nichind aa.

lines.english: Renounce greed and possessiveness, and become carefree.
lines.transliteration: bharam kaa sangal t orh niraalaa har ant ar har ras paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: As one sees the flash of lightning in the night,
lines.transliteration: nis daaman ji-o chamak chand aa-in daykhai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗਲੁ  ਤੋਿੜ ਿਨਰਾਲਾ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis jot nirant ar paykh ai. see the Divine Light deep within your nucleus, day and night.

lines.english: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful, reveals the Perfect Guru.||2||
lines.transliteration: aanand roop anoop saroopaa gur poorai d aykhaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: So meet with the True Guru, and God Himself will save you.
lines.transliteration: satgur milhu aapay parabh  taaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦ  ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਸਰੂਪਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He placed the lamps of the sun and the moon in the home of the sky.
lines.transliteration: sas ghar soor d eepak gain aaray.

lines.english: He placed the lamps of the sun and the moon in the home of the sky.
lines.transliteration: daykh  adisat rahhu liv laagee sabh  taribhavan barahm sabaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Obtaining the sublime ambrosial essence, desire and fear are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: amrit ras paa-ay t arisnaa bh a-o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਅਿਦਸਟੁ ਰਹਹੁ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Obtaining the sublime ambrosial essence, desire and fear are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: anbha-o pad  paavai aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: The lofty and exalted state, the highest of the high is obtained, practicing the immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: oochee padvee oocho oochaa nirmal sabad  kamaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: The lofty and exalted state, the highest of the high is obtained, practicing theimmaculate Word of the Shabad. ||4|| pMnw 1042
lines.transliteration: adrist agochar naam apaaraa.

lines.english: The sublime essence of the Beloved Naam is utterly sweet.
lines.transliteration: at ras meeth aa naam pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The sublime essence of the Beloved Naam is utterly sweet.
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o jug jug har jas deejai har japee-ai ant  na paa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: With the Naam deep within the nucleus of the self, the jewel is obtained.
lines.transliteration: antar naam paraapat  heeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਪਤੇ  ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: With the Naam deep within the nucleus of the self, the jewel is obtained.
lines.transliteration: har japtay man man t ay Dh eeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਘਟ  ਘਟ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: On that most difficult path, the Destroyer of fear is found, and one does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: dughat ghat bha-o bh anjan paa-ee-ai baahurh  janam na jaa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: On that most difficult path, the Destroyer of fear is found, and one does not have toenter the womb of reincarnation again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  hayt gur sabad  tarangaa.

lines.english: I beg for the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: har jas naam padaarath mangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁ ਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਹਿਰ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: I beg for the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: har bhaavai gur mayl milaa-ay har t aaray jagat  sabaa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਪੁ ਜਿਪਓ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਿਤ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: One who chants the Lord's Chant, attains the Wisdom of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin jap japi-o satgur mat  vaa kay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਪਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: One who chants the Lord's Chant, attains the Wisdom of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jamkankar kaal sayvak pag taa kay.

lines.punjabi: ਊਤਮ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਊਤਮ  ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In the noble congregation of the Sangat, one's state and way of life become noble aswell, and one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ootam sangat  gat mit ootam jag bh a-ojal paar t araa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰ ਤਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: ih bhavjal jagat  sabad  gur t aree-ai.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: antar kee d ubiDh aa ant ar jaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਣ  ਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ਗਗਨੰਤਿਰ  ਧਣਖੁ  ਚੜਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Taking up the five arrows of virtue, Death is killed, drawing the Bow of the Tenth Gate in the Mind's Sky. ||9||
lines.transliteration: panch baan lay jam ka-o maarai gagnant ar Dh anakh charh aa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.english: How can the faithless cynics attain enlightened awareness of the Shabad?
lines.transliteration: saakat nar sabad  surat  ki-o paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: How can the faithless cynics attain enlightened awareness of the Shabad?
lines.transliteration: sabad surat  bin aa-ee-ai jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਰਾਇਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the support of liberation; by perfect destiny, he meetsthe Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mukat  paraa-in  har poorai bh aag milaa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.english: The Fearless True Guru is our Savior and Protector.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o sat gur hai rakh vaalaa.

lines.english: Devotional worship is obtained through the Guru, the Lord of the world.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  paraapat  gur gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਨ ਅਨੰਦ  ਅਨਾਹਦੁ  ਵਾਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Dhun anand anaahad  vaajai gur sabad  niranjan paa-i-aa. ||11|| The blissful music of the unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds; through theWord of the Guru's Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is obtained. ||11||
He alone is fearless, who has no destiny written on His head.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o so sir naahee laykh aa.

lines.english: God Himself is unseen; He reveals Himself through His wondrous creative power.
lines.transliteration: aap alaykh kud rat hai d aykhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He Himself is unattached, unborn and self-existent. O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, He is found. ||12||
lines.transliteration: aap ateet  ajonee sambh a-o naanak gurmat  so paa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.english: The True Guru knows the state of one's inner being.
lines.transliteration: antar kee gat  satgur jaan ai.

lines.english: He alone is fearless, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: so nirbha-o gur sabad  pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਬੂਝੈ ਅਨਤ  ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: He looks within his own inner being, and realizes the Lord within all; his mind doesnot waver at all. ||13||
lines.transliteration: antar d aykh nirant ar boojh ai anat  na man dolaa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.english: He alone is fearless, within whose being the Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o so abh  antar vasi-aa.

lines.english: Day and night, he is delighted with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam niranjan rasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Lord's Praise is obtained, and oneeasily, intuitively meets the Lord. ||14||
lines.transliteration: naanak har jas sangat paa-ee-ai har sehjay sahj milaa-i-aa. ||14||

lines.english: One who knows God, within the self and beyond,
lines.transliteration: antar baahar so parabh  jaanai.
rahai alipat chalt ay gh ar aan ai. remains detached, and brings his wandering mind back to its home.

lines.punjabi: ਊਪਿਰ  ਆਿਦ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਤਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥੪॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The True Primal Lord is over all the three worlds; O Nanak, His Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||15||4||21|| mwrU mhlw 1 ] (1042-15) maaroo mehlaa 1. Maaroo, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: oopar aad sarab t ihu lo-ee sach naanak amrit  ras paa-i-aa. ||15||4||21||

lines.english: The Creator Lord is infinite; His creative power is wondrous.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  karnaihaar apaaraa.

lines.english: Created beings have no power over Him.
lines.transliteration: keetay kaa naahee kihu chaaraa.

lines.english: He formed the living beings, and He Himself sustains them; the Hukam of HisCommand controls each and every one. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jee-a upaa-ay rijak day aapay sir sir hukam chalaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਦੇ ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The all-pervading Lord orchestrates all through His Hukam.
lines.transliteration: hukam chalaa-ay rahi-aa bharpooray.

lines.english: Who is near, and who is far away?
lines.transliteration: kis nayrhai kis aakh aaN dooray.

lines.english: Behold the Lord, both hidden and manifest, in each and every heart; the unique Lordis permeating all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gupat pargat har gh at ghat daykhhu vart ai taak sabaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਹਿਰ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਤਾਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One whom the Lord unites with Himself, merges in conscious awareness.
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o maylay surat samaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: God is the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful and unfathomable; meeting with the Guru, doubt is dispelled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aanad roop anoop agochar gur mili-ai bh aram jaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨਦ  ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is more dear to me than my mind, body and wealth.
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an tay naam pi-aaraa.

lines.english: In the end, when I must depart, it shall be my only help and support. pMnw 1043
lines.transliteration: ant sakh aa-ee chalan vaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰ  ਨਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬੇਲੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: In this world of love and attachment, no one is anyone else's friend or companion; without the Lord, without the Guru, who has ever found peace? ||4||
lines.transliteration: moh pasaar nahee sang baylee bin har gur kin sukh paa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: He, unto whom the Perfect Guru grants His Grace,
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o nadar karay gur pooraa.
sabad milaa-ay gurmat  sooraa. is merged in the Word of the Shabad, through the Teachings of the brave, heroicGuru.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, dwell upon, and serve at the Guru's feet; He places those who wander backon the Path. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak gur kay charan sarayvhu jin bhoolaa maarag paa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Praise is very dear to the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaaN har Dh an jas pi-aaraa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained Your Name, Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat paa-i-aa naam t umaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਚਕੁ  ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The beggar serves at the Lord's door, and in the Court of the Lord, sings His Praises. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jaachik sayv karay dar har kai har d argeh jas gaa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: When one meets the True Guru, he is called into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a mahal bulaa-ay.

lines.english: In the True Court, he is blessed with salvation and honor.
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh gat  pat paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ ਠਉਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic has no place of rest in the Lord's palace; he suffers the pains ofbirth and death. ||7||
lines.transliteration: saakat th a-ur naahee har mand ar janam marai d ukh paa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.english: So serve the True Guru, the unfathomable ocean,
lines.transliteration: sayvhu satgur samund  athaahaa.
paavhu naam ratan Dh an laahaa. and you shall obtain the profit, the wealth, the jewel of the Naam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਿਰ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The filth of corruption is washed away, by bathing in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar. Inthe Guru's pool, contentment is obtained. ||8||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa mal jaa-ay amrit  sar naavhu gur sar sant okh paa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.english: So serve the Guru without hesitation.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvhu sank na keejai.

lines.english: And in the midst of hope, remain unmoved by hope.
lines.transliteration: aasaa maahi niraas raheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਿਬਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਿਫਿਰ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Serve the Eradicator of cynicism and suffering, and you shall never again be afflictedby the disease. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sansaa dookh  binaasan sayvhu fir baahurh  rog na laa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.english: One who is pleasing to the True Lord is blessed with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: saachay bhaavai t is vadee-aa-ay.

lines.english: Who else can teach him anything?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so doojaa t is samjh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਏਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Lord and the Guru are pervading in one form. O Nanak, the Lord loves the Guru.||10||
lines.transliteration: har gur moorat aykaa vart ai naanak har gur bh aa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.english: Some read scriptures, the Vedas and the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: vaacheh pustak vayd  puraanaaN.

lines.english: Some sit and listen, and read to others.
lines.transliteration: ik bahi suneh sunaaveh kaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਗਰ  ਕਪਟੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਿਕਉ  ਖੁਲੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Tell me, how can the heavy, rigid doors be opened? Without the True Guru, theessence of reality is not realized. ||11||
lines.transliteration: ajgar kapat kahhu ki-o khulHai bin sat gur tat na paa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.english: Some collect dust, and smear their bodies with ashes;
lines.transliteration: karahi bibhoot  lagaaveh bh asmai.
antar kroDh  chandaal so ha-umai. but deep within them are the outcasts of anger and egotism.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਡ  ਕੀਨੇ  ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Practicing hypocrisy, Yoga is not obtained; without the True Guru, the unseen Lord is not found. ||12||
lines.transliteration: pakhand keenay jog na paa-ee-ai bin sat gur alakh  na paa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.english: Some make vows to visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage, keep fasts and live in theforest.
lines.transliteration: tirath varat  naym karahi ud i-aanaa.

lines.english: Some practice chastity, charity and self-discipline, and speak of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam katheh gi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: But without the Lord's Name, how can anyone find peace? Without the True Guru, doubt is not dispelled. ||13||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin ki-o sukh paa-ee-ai bin sat gur bh aram na jaa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.english: Inner cleansing techniques, channeling the energy to raise the Kundalini to the TenthGate,
lines.transliteration: ni-ulee karam bhu-i-angam bh aathee.
raychak kumbhak poorak man haath ee. inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath by the force of the mind -

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਡ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਸਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: pakhand Dh aram pareet  nahee har sa-o gur sabad  mahaa ras paa-i-aa. ||14|| by empty hypocritical practices, Dharmic love for the Lord is not produced. Only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sublime, supreme essence obtained.||14||

lines.english: Seeing the Lord's creative power, my mind remains satisfied.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  daykh rahay man maani-aa.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Shabad, I have realized that all is God.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee sabh  barahm pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥੫॥੨੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all. The Guru, the True Guru, has inspiredme to see the unseen Lord. ||15||5||22|| mwrU solhy mhlw 3  (1043-17) maaroo solhay mehlaa 3 Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1043-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak aatam raam sabaa-i-aa gur sat gur alakh  lakhaa-i-aa. ||15||5||22||

lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He effortlessly created the Universe.
lines.transliteration: hukmee sehjay sarisat upaa-ee.

lines.english: Creating the creation, He gazes upon His own greatness.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai apn ee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; in His Will, He pervades and permeates all.||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay aapay hukmay rahi-aa samaa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The world is in the darkness of love and attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh jagat gubaaraa.

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who contemplates, and understands.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai ko veechaaraa.

lines.english: He alone attains the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace. He Himself unites in His Union. ||2|| pMnw 1044
lines.transliteration: aapay nadar karay so paa-ay aapay mayl milaa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: Uniting with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay day vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the Lord's worth.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee keemat paa-ee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wanders everywhere, weeping and wailing; he is utterly ruined by the love of duality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bahut  firai billaad ee doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਫਰੈ ਿਬਲਲਾਦੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Egotism was instilled into the illusion of Maya.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa vichay paa-ee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is deluded, and loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay pat  gavaa-ee.

lines.english: But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name; he remains immersed in the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so naa-ay raachai saachai rahi-aa samaa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ  ਰਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom is obtained from the Guru, along with the jewel of the Naam, theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur tay gi-aan naam rat an paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Desires are subdued, and one remains immersed in the mind.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maar man maahi samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Creator Himself stages all His plays; He Himself bestows understanding. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay khayl karay sabh  kartaa aapay d ay-ay bujh aa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: One who serves the True Guru eradicates self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mil pareetam sabad  sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: Deep within his inner being, he is imbued with loving devotion; intuitively, he becomesone with the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: antar pi-aar bh agtee raat aa sahj mat ay ban  aa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਮਤੇ ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Destroyer of pain is known through the Guru.
lines.transliteration: dookh  nivaaran  gur t ay jaat aa.

lines.english: The Great Giver, the Life of the world, Himself has met me.
lines.transliteration: aap mili-aa jagjeevan daat aa.

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord joins with Himself. Fear and doubt are taken away from his body. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay so-ee boojhai bh a-o bh aram sareerahu jaa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ  ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ  ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows His blessings.
lines.transliteration: aapay gurmukh aapay d ayvai.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, serve the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sat gur sayvai.

lines.english: Old age and death cannot even touch one who is in harmony with the True Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jaraa jam tis johi na saakai saachay si-o ban  aa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਜਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The world is burning up in the fire of desire.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa agan jalai sansaaraa.

lines.english: It burns and burns, and is destroyed in all its corruption.
lines.transliteration: jal jal khapai bahut  vikaaraa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest anywhere. The True Guru hasimparted this understanding. ||9||
lines.transliteration: manmukh th a-ur na paa-ay kabhoo sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕਬਹੂ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan say vadbh aagee.

lines.english: They remain lovingly focused on the True Name forever.
lines.transliteration: saachai naam sadaa liv laagee.

lines.english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, permeates the nucleus of their inner being; through the Shabad, their desires are quenched. ||10||
lines.transliteration: antar naam ravi-aa nihkayval t arisnaa sabad  bujhaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲੁ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: True is the Word of the Shabad, and True is the Bani of His Word.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai ban ee.

lines.english: How rare is that Gurmukh who realizes this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlai kinai pachh aanee.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the True Shabad are detached. Their comings and goingsin reincarnation are ended. ||11||
lines.transliteration: sachay sabad rat ay bairaagee aavan  jaan rahaa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਰਹਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: One who realizes the Shabad is cleansed of impurities.
lines.transliteration: sabad bujh ai so mail chukaa-ay.

lines.english: The Immaculate Naam abides within his mind.
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: He serves his True Guru forever, and egotism is eradicated from within. ||12||
lines.transliteration: satgur apn aa sad  hee sayveh ha-umai vichahu jaa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਿਹ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: If one comes to understand, through the Guru, then he comes to know the Lord'sDoor.
lines.transliteration: gur tay boojh ai taa dar soojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: But without the Naam, one babbles and argues in vain.
lines.transliteration: naam vihoonaa kath kath loojh ai.

lines.english: The glory of serving the True Guru is that it eradicates hunger and thirst. ||13||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay kee vadi-aa-ee t arisnaa bh ookh gavaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: When the Lord unites them with Himself, then they come to understand.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap milai taa boojh ai.

lines.english: Without spiritual wisdom, they understand nothing at all.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan vihoonaa kichh oo na soojh ai.

lines.english: One whose mind is filled with the Guru's gift forever - his inner being resounds with the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||14||
lines.transliteration: gur kee daat  sadaa man ant ar ban ee sabad  vajaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so karam kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: No one can erase the Command of the Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na maytai Dhur furmaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They alone dwell in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||15||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  meh t in hee vaasaa jin ka-o Dh ur likh  paa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He alone finds the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.
lines.transliteration: apnee nad ar karay so paa-ay.

lines.english: He links his consciousness to the deep meditative state of the True Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad t aarhee chit  laa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, offers this humble prayer; I stand at Your Door, begging for Your Name. ||16||1|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1044-18) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai baynant ee bh eekhi-aa naam d ar paa-ee hay. ||16||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਭੀਿਖਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਰ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
lines.english: The One and only Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk vartai sabh  so-ee.

lines.english: How rare is that person, who as Gurmukh, understands this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee.

lines.english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading, deep within the nucleus of all. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayko rav rahi-aa sabh ant ar tis bin avar na ko-ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: He created the 8.4 millions species of beings. pMnw 1045
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jee-a upaa-ay.

lines.english: The spiritual teachers and meditators proclaim this.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee Dhi-aanee aakh  sunaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself nourishes all; no one else can estimate His value. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa rijak samaahay aapay keemat  hor na ho-ee hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸਮਾਹੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਹੋਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Love and attachment to Maya are utter darkness.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh anDh anDh aaraa.

lines.english: Egotism and possessiveness have spread throughout the expanse of the universe.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa pasri-aa paasaaraa.

lines.english: Night and day, they burn, day and night; without the Guru, there is no peace ortranquility. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din jalat  rahai d in raat ee gur bin saaNt na ho-ee hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਲਤ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He Himself unites, and He Himself separates.
lines.transliteration: aapay jorh vichh orhay aapay.

lines.english: He Himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaapay aapay.

lines.english: True is the Hukam of His Command, and True is the expanse of His universe. No oneelse can issue any Command. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sachaa hukam sachaa paasaaraa horan hukam na ho-ee hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ  ਹੋਰਿਨ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He alone is attached to the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay laa-ay la-ay so laagai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the fear of death runs away.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jam kaa bha-o bh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: The Shabad, the Giver of peace, dwells forever deep within the nucleus of the self.One who is Gurmukh understands. ||5||
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  sadaa sukh -daata gurmukh  boojh ai ko-ee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: God Himself unites those united in His Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever is pre-ordained by destiny, cannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: purab likhi-aa so maytn aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, His devotees worship Him, day and night; one who becomes Gurmukh serves Him. ||6||
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karay d in raat ee gurmukh  sayvaa ho-ee hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ ਕਰੇ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is experienced.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  jaataa.

lines.english: He Himself, the Giver of all, has come and met me.
lines.transliteration: aapay aa-ay mili-aa sabhnaa kaa d aataa.

lines.english: Subduing egotism, the fire of thirst has been extinguished; contemplating the Word ofthe Shabad, peace is found. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar tarisnaa agan nivaaree sabad  cheen sukh  ho-ee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੀਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: One who is attached to his body and family, does not understand.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kutamb moh na boojhai.
