lines.english: But one who becomes Gurmukh, sees the Lord with his eyes.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai t a aakh ee soojh ai.

lines.english: Night and day, he chants the Naam, day and night; meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace. ||8||
lines.transliteration: an-din naam ravai d in raat ee mil pareet am sukh  ho-ee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wanders distracted, attached to duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh Dh aat doojai hai laagaa.

lines.english: That unfortunate wretch - why didn't he just die as soon as he was born?
lines.transliteration: janmat kee na moo-o aabh aagaa.

lines.english: Coming and going, he wastes away his life in vain. Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa bin gur mukat  na ho-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: That body which is stained with the filth of egotism is false and impure.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kusuDh ha-umai mal laa-ee.

lines.english: It may be washed a hundred times, but its filth is still not removed.
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o Dhoveh t aa mail na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: But if it is washed with the Word of the Shabad, then it is truly cleansed, and it shallnever be soiled again. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sabad Dh opai t aa hachh ee hovai fir mailee mool na ho-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਧੋਪੈ ਤਾ ਹਛੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਮੈਲੀ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The five demons destroy the body.
lines.transliteration: panch doot  kaa-i-aa sangh aareh.

lines.english: He dies and dies again, only to be reincarnated; he does not contemplate the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh sabad na vichaareh.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The darkness of emotional attachment to Maya is within his inner being; as if in adream, he does not understand. ||11||
lines.transliteration: antar maa-i-aa moh gubaaraa ji-o supnai suDh  na ho-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ  ਿਜਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸੁਿਧ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Some conquer the five demons, by being attached to the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ik panchaa maar sabad hai laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਪੰਚਾ ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਹੈ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: They are blessed and very fortunate; the True Guru comes to meet them.
lines.transliteration: satgur aa-ay mili-aa vadbh aagay.

lines.english: Within the nucleus of their inner being, they dwell upon the Truth; attuned to the Lord's Love, they intuitively merge in Him. ||12||
lines.transliteration: antar saach raveh rang raat ay sahj samaavai so-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਾਚੁ ਰਵਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Guru's Way is known through the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur kee chaal guroo tay jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ  ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: His perfect servant attains realization through the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: pooraa sayvak sabad sinj aapai.

lines.english: Deep within his heart, he dwells forever upon the Shabad; he tastes the sublimeessence of the True Lord with his tongue. ||13||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sabad  ravai gh at ant ar rasnaa ras chaakh ai sach so-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Egotism is conquered and subdued by the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maaray sabad nivaaray.

lines.english: I have enshrined the Name of the Lord within my heart.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Other than the One Lord, I know nothing at all. Whatever will be, will automaticallybe. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aykas bin ha-o hor na jaanaa sehjay ho-ay so ho-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sahj kinai nahee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh understands, and is immersed in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai sach samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He serves the True Lord, and is attuned to the True Shabad. The Shabad banishes egotism. ||15||
lines.transliteration: sachaa sayv sabad sach raat ay ha-umai sabd ay kh o-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਖੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Giver of virtue, the Contemplative Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapay gundaat aa beechaaree.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is given the winning dice.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d ayveh pakee saaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, immersed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one becomes true; from theTrue Lord, honor is obtained. ||16||2|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1045-19) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaaveh saachai saachay tay pat  ho-ee hay. ||16||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
lines.english: One One True Lord is the Life of the World, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan saachaa ayko daat aa.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, through the Word of the Shabad, He is realized. pMnw 1046
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sabad  pachh aataa.

lines.english: There is only One Command, and there is only One Supreme King. In each and every age, He links each to their tasks. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayko amar aykaa patisaahee jug jug sir kaar ban aa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਏਕਾ ਪਿਤਸਾਹੀ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That humble being is immaculate, who knows his own self.
lines.transliteration: so jan nirmal jin aap pachhaat aa.

lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, Himself comes and meets him.
lines.transliteration: aapay aa-ay mili-aa sukh-d aata.

lines.english: His tongue is imbued with the Shabad, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord;he is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa sabad rat ee gun  gaavai d ar saachai pat  paa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam milai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh, the slanderer, loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: manmukh nind ak pat  gavaa-ee.

lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, the supreme soul-swans remain detached; in the home of theself, they remain absorbed in deep meditative trance. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam ratay param hans bairaagee nij gh ar taarhee laa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮ  ਹੰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: That humble being who dies in the Shabad is perfect.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai so-ee jan pooraa.

lines.english: The brave, heroic True Guru chants and proclaims this.
lines.transliteration: satgur aakh  sunaa-ay sooraa.

lines.english: Deep within the body is the true pool of Ambrosial Nectar; the mind drinks it in with loving devotion. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa andar amrit  sar saachaa man peevai bh aa-ay subh aa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads and instructs others,
lines.transliteration: parh pandit  avraa samjh aa-ay.
ghar jalt ay kee kh abar na paa-ay. but he does not realize that his own home is on fire.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਜਲਤੇ  ਕੀ ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. You can read until you areexhausted, but you shall not find peace and tranquility. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay naam na paa-ee-ai parh  thaakay saaNt na aa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਿੜ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Some smear their bodies with ashes, and wander around in religious disguises.
lines.transliteration: ik bhasam lagaa-ay fireh bh aykh-Dhaaree.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, who has ever subdued egotism?
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai ha-umai kin maaree.

lines.english: Night and day, they continue burning, day and night; they are deluded and confusedby their doubt and religious costumes. ||6||
lines.transliteration: an-din jalat  raheh d in raat ee bh aram bh aykh bharmaa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਲਤ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੇਿਖ ਭਰਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Some, in the midst of their household and family, remain always unattached.
lines.transliteration: ik garih kutamb meh sadaa ud aasee.

lines.english: They die in the Shabad, and dwell in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sabad mu-ay har naam nivaasee.

lines.english: Night and day, they remain forever attuned to His Love; they focus their consciousness on loving devotion and the Fear of God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa raheh rang raat ay bh ai bhaa-ay bh agat chit laa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh indulges in slander, and is ruined.
lines.transliteration: manmukh nind aa kar kar vigut aa.

lines.english: The dog of greed barks within him.
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  bha-ukai jis kut aa.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death never leaves him, and in the end, he leaves, regretting andrepenting. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal tis kad ay na chh odai ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, true honor is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sachee pat  ho-ee.

lines.english: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai mukat na paavai ko-ee.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name. Such is the making which God hasmade. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur ko naa-o na paa-ay parabh  aisee ban at banaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਐਸੀ  ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Some are Siddhas and seekers, and great contemplators.
lines.transliteration: ik siDh saaDh ik bahut  veechaaree.

lines.english: Some remain imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: ik ahinis naam ratay nirankaaree.

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord unites with Himself; through loving devotional worship, fear is dispelled. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jis no aap milaa-ay so boojhai bh agat bhaa-ay bh a-o jaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਭਉ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Some take cleansing baths and give donations to charities, but they do notunderstand.
lines.transliteration: isnaan daan karahi nahee boojh eh.

lines.english: Some struggle with their minds, and conquer and subdue their minds.
lines.transliteration: ik manoo-aa maar manai si-o loojheh.

lines.english: Some are imbued with love for the True Word of the Shabad; they merge with theTrue Shabad. ||11||
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad rat ay ik rangee saachai sabad  milaa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He Himself creates and bestows glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: aapay sirjay day vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He bestows union.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhaan ai day-ay milaa-ee.

lines.english: Bestowing His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind; such is the Command ordainedby my God. ||12||
lines.transliteration: aapay nadar karay man vasi-aa mayrai parabh  i-o furmaa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ  ਇਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say jan saachay.

lines.english: The false, self-willed manmukhs do not know how to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sayv na jaan an kaachay.

lines.english: The Creator Himself creates the creation and watches over it; he attaches all according to the Pleasure of His Will. ||13||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa kar kar vaykh ai ji-o bh aavai t i-o laa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: In each and every age, the True Lord is the one and only Giver.
lines.transliteration: jug jug saachaa ayko daat aa.

lines.english: Through perfect destiny, one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sabad  pachh aataa.

lines.english: Those who are immersed in the Shabad are not separated again. By His Grace, theyare intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||14||
lines.transliteration: sabad milay say vichh urhay naahee nad ree sahj milaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਿਵਛੁੜੇ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Acting in egotism, they are stained with the filth of Maya.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa mail kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They die and die again, only to be reborn in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh doojaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation. O mind, tune into this, andsee. ||15||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay mukat  na ho-ee man d aykhhu liv laa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.english: He does whatever He pleases. pMnw 1047
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karsee.

lines.english: No one has done, or can do anything by himself.
lines.transliteration: aaphu ho-aa naa kichh hosee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Name, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and obtains honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||16||3|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1047-2) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee dar saachai pat  paa-ee hay. ||16||3||

lines.english: All who come shall have to depart.
lines.transliteration: jo aa-i-aa so sabh ko jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ  ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, they are caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay baaDh aa jam faasee.

lines.english: Those humble beings who are protected by the True Guru, are saved. They mergeinto the Truest of the True. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur raakh ay say jan ubray saachay saach samaa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself creates the creation, and watches over it.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa kar kar vaykh ai.

lines.english: Thay alone are acceptable, upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so-ee jan laykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and understands everything. The ignorant ones act blindly. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan t is sabh  kichh  soojh ai agi-aanee anDh  kamaa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is cynical; he doesn't understand.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sahsaa boojh  na paa-ee.

lines.english: He dies and dies again, only to be reborn, and loses his life uselessly again.
lines.transliteration: mar mar jammai janam gavaa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he find peace, and isintuitively immersed in the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam rat ay sukh  paa-i-aa sehjay saach samaa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਾਿਚ ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: DhanDh ai Dhaavat  man bh a-i-aa manooraa. Chasing after worldly affairs, the mind has become corroded and rusty.
But meeting with the Perfect Guru, it is transmuted into gold once again.
lines.transliteration: fir hovai kanchan bhaytai gur pooraa.

lines.english: When the Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then peace is obtained; through thePerfect Word of the Shabad, one is united with Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas la-ay sukh  paa-ay poorai sabad  milaa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The false and evil-minded are the most wicked of the wicked.
lines.transliteration: durmat  jhoothee buree buri-aar.

lines.english: They are the most unworthy of the unworthy.
lines.transliteration: a-ugani-aaree a-ugan i-aar.

lines.english: With false intellect, and insipid words of mouth, evil-minded, they do not obtain theNaam. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kachee mat feekaa mukh  bolai d urmat  naam na paa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਚੀ  ਮਿਤ ਫੀਕਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The unworthy soul-bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: a-ugani-aaree kant  na bh aavai.

lines.english: False-minded, her actions are false.
lines.transliteration: man kee joothee jooth  kamaavai.

lines.english: The foolish person does not know the excellence of her Husband Lord. Without the Guru, she does not understand at all. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pir kaa saa-o na jaanai moorakh  bin gur boojh  na paa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਮੂਰਿਖ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The evil-minded, wicked soul-bride practices wickedness.
lines.transliteration: durmat  khotee kh ot kamaavai.

lines.english: She decorates herself, but her Husband Lord is not pleased.
lines.transliteration: seegaar karay pir khasam na bh aavai.

lines.english: The virtuous soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord forever; the True Guruunites her in His Union. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee sad aa pir raavai sat gur mayl milaa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ  ਸਦਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: God Himself issues the Hukam of His Command, and beholds all.
lines.transliteration: aapay hukam karay sabh vaykh ai.

lines.english: Some are forgiven, according to their pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: iknaa bakhas la-ay Dh ur laykh ai.

lines.english: Night and day, they are imbued with the Naam, and they find the True Lord. HeHimself unites them in His Union. ||8||
lines.transliteration: an-din naam rat ay sach paa-i-aa aapay mayl milaa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Egotism attaches them to the juice of emotional attachment, and makes them run around.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai Dhaat  moh ras laa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is intuitively immersed in the True Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh liv saachee sahj samaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself unites, He Himself acts, and beholds. Without the True Guru,understanding is not obtained. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aapay maylai aapay kar vaykhai bin sat gur boojh  na paa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Some contemplate the Word of the Shabad; these humble beings remain alwaysawake and aware.
lines.transliteration: ik sabad veechaar sad aa jan jaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Some are attached to the love of Maya; these unfortunate ones remain asleep.
lines.transliteration: ik maa-i-aa mohi so-ay rahay abhaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; no one else can do anything. ||10||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay aapay hor karnaa kichh oo na jaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, death is conquered and killed.
lines.transliteration: kaal maar gur sabad nivaaray.

lines.english: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, and one merges in the Name of the Lord.||11||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa t ay sukh  paa-i-aa har kai naam samaa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, the world wanders around insane.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay firai d ayvaanee.

lines.english: Immersed in love and attachment to Maya, it suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi dukh  maahi samaanee.

lines.english: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, He is  not obtained. Without the True Guru, peace is not found. ||12||
lines.transliteration: bahutay bh aykh karai nah paa-ay bin sat gur sukh  na paa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਹ ਪਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Who is to blame, when He Himself does everything?
lines.transliteration: kis no kahee-ai jaa aap karaa-ay.

lines.english: As He wills, so is the path we take.
lines.transliteration: jit bhaavai t it raahi chalaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself is the Merciful Giver of peace; as He wills, so do we follow. ||13||
lines.transliteration: aapay miharvaan sukh-d aata ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa aapay bh ugtaa.

lines.english: He Himself is detached, and He Himself is attached.
lines.transliteration: aapay sanjam aapay jugtaa.

lines.english: He Himself is immaculate, compassionate, the lover of nectar; the Hukam of His Command cannot be erased. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aapay nirmal miharvaan maDhusood an jis d aa hukam na mayti-aa jaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਮਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਿਟਆ  ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate. pMnw 1048
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee jinee ayko jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਵਿਸ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He dwells in each and every heart, the Great Giver, the Life of the world.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at vas rahi-aa jagjeevan d aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: At the same time, He is both hidden and revealed. For the Gurmukh, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||15||
lines.transliteration: ik thai gupat pargat hai aapay gurmukh  bharam bh a-o jaa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the One, the Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har jee-o ayko jaat aa.

lines.english: Deep within the nucleus of his inner being, is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; herealizes the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: antar naam sabad  pachh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਡਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
lines.english: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it. O Nanak, the Naam is glorious greatness.||16||4|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1048-3) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis too d eh so-ee jan paa-ay naanak naam vadaa-ee hay. ||16||4||

lines.english: I praise the true, profound and unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach saalaahee gahir gambheerai.

lines.english: All the world is in His power.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag hai t is hee kai cheerai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
lines.english: He enjoys all hearts forever, day and night; He Himself dwells in peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at bhogvai sad aa din raat ee aapay sookh  nivaasee hay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ  ਸਦਾ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasaa-ee.

lines.english: He Himself has come to dwell deep within the nucleus of my heart; the noose of deathhas been snapped. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay aa-ay vasi-aa ghat ant ar tootee jam kee faasee hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਇ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whom should I serve, and whom should I praise?
lines.transliteration: kis sayvee tai kis saalaahee.

lines.english: I serve the True Guru, and praise the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvee sabad  saalaahee.

lines.english: Through the True Shabad, the intellect is exalted and ennobled forever, and the lotusdeep within blossoms forth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sad aa mat  ootam ant ar kamal pargaasee hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The body is frail and perishable, like paper.
lines.transliteration: dayhee kaachee kaagad  mikd aaraa.

lines.english: When the drop of water falls upon it, it crumbles and dissolves instantaneously.
lines.transliteration: boond pavai binsai dh ahat na laagai baaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਢਹਤ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਬਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: But the body of the Gurmukh, who understands, is like gold; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells deep within. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa gurmukh boojh ai jis ant ar naam nivaasee hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Pure is that kitchen, which is enclosed by spiritual awareness.
lines.transliteration: sachaa cha-ukaa surat kee kaaraa.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is my food, and Truth is my support.
lines.transliteration: har naam bhojan sach aaDh aaraa.

lines.english: Forever satisfied, sanctified and pure is that person, within whose heart the Lord'sName abides. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sadaa t aripat  pavit ar hai paavan jit  ghat har naam nivaasee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ੁ  ਹੈ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਘਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who are attached to the Truth.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin balihaaree jo saachai laagay.

lines.english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and remain awake and aware night andday.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi an-d in jaagay.

lines.english: True peace fills them forever, and their tongues savor the sublime essence of theLord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saachaa sookh sad aa tin ant ar rasnaa har ras raasee hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੂਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਤਨ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: I remember the Lord's Name, and no other at all.
lines.transliteration: har naam chaytaa avar na poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.english: I serve the One Lord, and no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayko sayvee avar na doojaa.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has revealed the whole Truth to me; I dwell in the True Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: poorai gur sabh sach d ikhaa-i-aa sachai naam nivaasee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Wandering, wandering in reincarnation, again and again, he comes into the world.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram jonee fir fir aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He is deluded and confused, when the Lord and Master confuses him.
lines.transliteration: aap bhoolaa jaa kh asam bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He meets with the Dear Lord, when, as Gurmukh, he understands; he remembers the Shabad, the Word of the immortal, eternal Lord God. ||8||
lines.transliteration: har jee-o milai taa gurmukh  boojh ai cheenai sabad  abhinaasee hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: I am a sinner, overflowing with sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh bh aray ham apraaDh ee.

lines.english: With what mouth should I speak? I have no virtue, and I have rendered no service.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa muhu lai bolah naa ham gun na sayvaa saaDh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ  ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sinking stone; please, Lord, unite me with Yourself. Your Name is eternal andimperishable. ||9||
lines.transliteration: dubday paathar mayl laihu t um aapay saach naam abh inaasee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: No one does anything; no one is able to do anything.
lines.transliteration: naa ko-ee karay na karnai jogaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ  ਜੋਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: That alone happens, which the Lord Himself does, and causes to be done.
lines.transliteration: aapay karahi karaaveh so ho-igaa.

lines.english: Those whom He Himself forgives, find peace; they dwell forever in the Naam, theName of the Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas laihi sukh  paa-ay sad  hee naam nivaasee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: This body is the earth, and the infinite Shabad is the seed.
lines.transliteration: ih tan Dh artee sabad  beej apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਿਜ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Deal and trade with the True Name alone.
lines.transliteration: har saachay saytee van aj vaapaaraa.

lines.english: The True wealth increases; it is never exhausted, when the Naam dwells deep within.||11||
lines.transliteration: sach Dhan jammi-aa t ot na aavai ant ar naam nivaasee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਿਮਆ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, please bless me, the worthless sinner, with virtue.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o avgani-aaray no gun  keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਅਵਗਿਣਆਰੇ  ਨੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Forgive me, and bless me with Your Name.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas laihi naam d eejai.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, is honored; he dwells in the Name of the One Lordalone. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so pat  paa-ay ikat  naam nivaasee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਏ ਇਕਤੁ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord is deep within one's inner being, but he does not realize it.
lines.transliteration: antar har Dh an samajh  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸਮਝ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee boojhai ko-ee.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh is blessed with this wealth; he lives forever in the Naam. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so Dh an paa-ay sad  hee naam nivaasee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Fire and wind lead him into delusions of doubt. pMnw 1049
lines.transliteration: anal vaa-o bharam bh ulaa-ee.

lines.english: In love and attachment to Maya, he has no understanding at all.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi suDh na kaa-ee.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukh sees nothing; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is gloriously revealed. ||14||
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay kichh oo na soojh ai gurmat  naam pargaasee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧੇ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The manmukhs are asleep in egotism and Maya.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ha-umai maa-i-aa soot ay.

lines.english: They do not watch over their own homes, and are ruined in the end.
lines.transliteration: apnaa gh ar na samaaleh ant  vigoot ay.

lines.english: They slander others, and burn in great anxiety; they dwell in pain and suffering.||15||
lines.transliteration: par nindaa karahi baho chint aa jaalai d ukhay dukh nivaasee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਜਾਲੈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਿਖ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself has created the creation.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartai kaar karaa-ee.

lines.english: He blesses the Gurmukh with understanding.
lines.transliteration: aapay gurmukh d ay-ay bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam - their minds become immaculate; they dwell in the Naam, and only the Naam. ||16||5|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1049-4) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay man nirmal naamay naam nivaasee hay. ||16||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
lines.english: I serve the One Lord, who is eternal, stable and True.
lines.transliteration: ayko sayvee sadaa thir saachaa.

lines.english: Attached to duality, the whole world is false.
lines.transliteration: doojai laagaa sabh  jag kaachaa.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I praise the True Lord forever, pleased with theTruest of the True. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee sad aa sach saalaahee saachay hee saach pat eejai hay. ||1||

lines.english: Your Glorious Virtues are so many, Lord; I do not know even one.
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  bahut ay mai ayk na jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਿਚ  ਪਤੀਜੈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Life of the world, the Great Giver, attaches us to himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay laa-ay la-ay jagjeevan daat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself forgives, and bestows glorious greatness. Following the Guru's Teachings, this mind is delighted. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay d ay vadi-aa-ee gurmat  ih man bh eejai hay. ||2||

lines.english: The Word of the Shabad has subdued the waves of Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa lahar sabad nivaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Egotism has been conquered, and this mind has become immaculate.
lines.transliteration: ih man nirmal ha-umai maaree.

lines.english: I intuitively sing His Glorious Praises, imbued with the Lord's Love. My tongue chantsand savors the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sehjay gun gaavai rang raat aa rasnaa raam raveejai hay. ||3||

lines.english: Crying out, "Mine, mine!" he spends his life.
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree karat vihaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh does not understand; he wanders around in ignorance.
lines.transliteration: manmukh na boojh ai firai i-aan ee.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death watches over him every moment, every instant; night andday, his life is wasting away. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal gharh ee muhat  nihaalay an-d in aarjaa chh eejai hay. ||4||

lines.english: He practices greed within, and does not understand.
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  karai nahee boojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਘੜੀ  ਮੁਹਤੁ  ਿਨਹਾਲੇ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ  ਛੀਜੈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He does not see the Messenger of Death hovering over his head.
lines.transliteration: sir oopar jamkaal na soojhai.

lines.english: Whatever one does in this world, will come to face him in the hereafter; what can he do at that very last moment? ||5||
lines.transliteration: aithai kamaanaa so agai aa-i-aa ant kaal ki-aa keejai hay. ||5||

lines.english: Those who are attached to the Truth are true.
lines.transliteration: jo sach laagay tin saachee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ  ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਇਆ  ਅੰਤਕਾਿਲ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, attached to duality, weep and wail.
lines.transliteration: doojai laagay manmukh  ro-ay.

lines.english: He is the Lord and Master of both worlds; He Himself delights in virtue. ||6||
lines.transliteration: duhaa siri-aa kaa kh asam hai aapay aapay gun  meh bh eejai hay. ||6||

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His humble servant is exalted forever.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad aa jan sohai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਹਾ ਿਸਿਰਆ  ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: This mind is enticed by the Naam, the source of nectar.
lines.transliteration: naam rasaa-in ih man mohai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਸਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: It is not stained at all by the dirt of attachment to Maya; through the Guru'sTeachings, it is pleased and saturated with the Lord's Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh mail patang na laagai gurmat ee har naam bh eejai hay. ||7||

lines.english: The One Lord is contained within all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa vich vart ai ik so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ  ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee pargat ho-ee.

lines.english: One who subdues his ego, finds lasting peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar sadaa sukh  paa-i-aa naa-ay saachai amrit  peejai hay. ||8||

lines.english: God is the Destroyer of sin and pain.
lines.transliteration: kilbikh d ookh nivaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਇ  ਸਾਚੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh serves Him, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvi-aa sabad  veechaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself is pervading everything. The Gurmukh's body and mind are saturated andpleased. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap vart ai gurmukh  tan man bh eejai hay. ||9||

lines.english: The world is burning in the fire of Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa agan jalai sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh extinguishes this fire, by contemplating the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nivaarai sabad  veechaaray.

lines.english: Deep within are peace and tranquility, and lasting peace is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: antar saaNt sadaa sukh  paa-i-aa gurmat ee naam leejai hay. ||10||

lines.english: Even Indra, seated upon his throne, is caught in the fear of death.
lines.transliteration: indar ind araasan  baith ay jam kaa bh a-o paavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death will not spare them, even though they try all sorts of things.
lines.transliteration: jam na chhodai baho karam kamaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾਸਿਣ  ਬੈਠੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When one meets with the True Guru, one is liberated, drinking in and savoring the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||11||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai t aa mukat  paa-ee-ai har har rasnaa peejai hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: There is no devotion within the self-willed manmukh.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ant ar bhagat na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Through devotional worship, the Gurmukh obtains peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat saaNt sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: Forever pure and sanctified is the Word of the Guru's Bani; following the Guru'sTeachings, one's inner being is drenched in it. ||12||
lines.transliteration: pavitar paavan sad aa hai ban ee gurmat  antar bheejai hay. ||12||

lines.english: I have considered Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays veechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਪਾਵਨ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: They are bound by the three qualities - the three gunas; they are far away from liberation. pMnw 1050
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  baDh ak mukat  niraaree.

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows the spiritual wisdom of the One Lord. Night and day, he chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan ayko hai jaat aa an-d in naam raveejai hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: He may read the Vedas, but he does not realize the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bayd parh eh har naam na boojh eh.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: For the sake of Maya, he reads and recites and argues.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran parh  parh loojh eh.

lines.english: The ignorant and blind person is filled with filth within. How can he cross over the impassable world-ocean? ||14||
lines.transliteration: antar mail agi-aanee anDh aa ki-o kar d utar tareejai hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਜੈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: He voices all the controversies of the Vedas,
lines.transliteration: bayd baad  sabh  aakh  vakaan eh.
na antar bh eejai na sabad  pachh aaneh. but his inner being is not saturated or satisfied, and he does not realize the Word ofthe Shabad.

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Vedas tell all about virtue and vice, but only the Gurmukh drinks in the AmbrosialNectar. ||15||
lines.transliteration: punn paap sabh bayd  drirh -aa-i-aa gurmukh  amrit  peejai hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਿਦ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The One True Lord is all by Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay saachaa ayko so-ee.

lines.english: There is no one else except Him.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, true is the mind of one who is attuned to the Naam; he speaks Truth, andnothing but Truth. ||16||6|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1050-5) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay man saachaa sacho sach raveejai hay. ||16||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
lines.english: The True Lord has established the Throne of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachai sachaa takh at rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He dwells in His own home deep within the self, where there is no emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vasi-aa t ithai moh na maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Lord dwells deep within the nucleus of the Gurmukh's heart forever; hisactions are excellent. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sad hee saach vasi-aa gh at ant ar gurmukh  karnee saaree hay. ||1||

lines.english: True is his merchandise, and true is his trade.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sa-udaa sach vaapaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no doubt within him, and no expanse of duality.
lines.transliteration: na tithai bh aram na d oojaa pasaaraa.

lines.english: He has earned the true wealth, which is never exhausted. How few are those whocontemplate this, and understand. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sachaa Dhan kh ati-aa kad ay tot na aavai boojh ai ko veechaaree hay. ||2||

lines.english: They alone are attached to the True Name, whom the Lord Himself attaches.
lines.transliteration: sachai laa-ay say jan laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਆ  ਕਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is deep within the nucleus of the self; good fortune isrecorded upon their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  mast ak vadbh aagay.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing the True Praises of the Lord; theyare attuned to contemplative meditation on the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sad aa gun  gaavahi sabad  ratay veechaaree hay. ||3||

lines.english: I praise the True Lord, the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa sach saalaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I see the One Lord, and no other.
lines.transliteration: ayko vaykhaa d oojaa naahee.

lines.english: The Guru's Teachings are the ladder to reach the highest of the high. the jewel ofspiritual wisdom conquers egotism. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmat oocho oochee pa-orh ee gi-aan rat an ha-umai maaree hay. ||4||

lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabad jalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਊਚੋ ਊਚੀ  ਪਉੜੀ  ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਰਤਿਨ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The True One comes to dwell in the mind, when it pleases You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach man vasi-aa jaa tuDh  bhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: True are all the actions of the truthful; the thirst of egotism is subdued. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachay kee sabh sachee karn ee ha-umai t ikhaa nivaaree hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All by Himself, God created emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh aapay keenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਖਾ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlai kin hee cheenaa.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh practices Truth; true and excellent are his actions. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so sach kamaavai saachee karn ee saaree hay. ||6||

lines.english: He does those deeds which are pleasing to my God;
lines.transliteration: kaar kamaa-ee jo mayray parabh bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ha-umai tarisnaa sabad  bujhaa-ee. through the Shabad, he burns away egotism and the thirst of desire.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ  ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, he remains forever cool and calm deep within; he conquers and subdues his ego. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gurmat sad  hee ant ar seet al ha-umai maar nivaaree hay. ||7||

lines.english: Those who are attached to the Truth are pleased with everything.
lines.transliteration: sach lagay tin sabh  kichh  bhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: They are embellished with the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabday sach suhaavai.

lines.english: Those who are true in this world, are true in the Court of the Lord. The Merciful Lordadorns them with His Mercy. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aithai saachay say dar saachay nad ree nad ar savaaree hay. ||8||

lines.english: Those who are attached to duality, and not the Truth,
lines.transliteration: bin saachay jo doojai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇ ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਦਰੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਸਵਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh dukh  sabaa-i-aa. are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya; they totally suffer in pain.

lines.english: Without the Guru, they do not understand pain and pleasure; attached to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bin gur dukh  sukh  jaapai naahee maa-i-aa moh d ukh bhaaree hay. ||9||

lines.english: Those whose minds are pleased with the True Word of the Shabad
lines.transliteration: saachaa sabad jinaa man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa t inee kamaa-i-aa. act according to pre-ordained destiny.

lines.english: They serve the True Lord, and meditate on the True Lord; they are imbued with contemplative meditation on the True Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sacho sayveh sach Dhi-aavahi sach rat ay veechaaree hay. ||10||

lines.english: Service to the Guru seems sweet to them.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa meethee laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are intuitively immersed in celestial peace.
lines.transliteration: an-din sookh  sahj samaaDh ee.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds become immaculate; they loveto serve the Guru. ||11||
lines.transliteration: har har karti-aa man nirmal ho-aa gur kee sayv pi-aaree hay. ||11||

lines.english: Those humble beings are at peace, whom the True Guru attaches to the Truth.
lines.transliteration: say jan sukhee-ay sat gur sachay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He Himself, in His Will, merges them into Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhaan ay aap milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਚੇ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings, whom the True Guru protects, are saved. The rest are ruined through emotional attachment to Maya. ||12|| pMnw 1051
lines.transliteration: satgur raakh ay say jan ubray hor maa-i-aa moh kh u-aaree hay. ||12||

lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachaa sabad  pachh aataa.

lines.english: He has no family, and he has no mother.
lines.transliteration: naa tis kutamb naa t is maat aa.

lines.english: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the nucleus of all. He is the Support of all beings. ||13||
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk ravi-aa sabh ant ar sabh naa jee-aa kaa aaDh aaree hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Egotism, possessiveness, and the love of duality
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa doojaa bh aa-i-aa.
kichh na chalai Dh ur khasam likh  paa-i-aa. - none of these shall go along with you; such is the pre-ordained will of our Lord andMaster.

lines.english: Through the True Guru, practice Truth, and the True Lord shall take away your pains.||14||
lines.transliteration: gur saachay tay saach kamaaveh saachai d ookh nivaaree hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਾਚੈ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: If You so bless me, then I shall find lasting peace.
lines.transliteration: jaa too d eh sad aa sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, I live the Truth.
lines.transliteration: saachai sabday saach kamaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord is within me, and my mind and body have become True. I am blessed with the overflowing treasure of devotional worship. ||15||
lines.transliteration: andar saachaa man t an saachaa bh agat bharay bh andaaree hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He Himself watches, and issues His Command.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai hukam chalaa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself inspires us to obey His Will.
lines.transliteration: apnaa bh aanaa aap karaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, only those who are attuned to the Naam are detached; their minds, bodiesand tongues are embellished with the Naam. ||16||7|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1051-6) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay bairaagee man t an rasnaa naam savaaree hay. ||16||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself created Himself, and came into being.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap upaa-ay upannaa.

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading in all, remaining hidden.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vart ai ayk parchh annaa.

lines.english: The Lord, the Life of the world, takes care of all. Whoever knows his own self, realizesGod. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa saar karay jagjeevan jin apn aa aap pachh aataa hay. ||1||

lines.english: He who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,
lines.transliteration: jin barahmaa bisan mahays upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sir sir DhanDh ai aapay laa-ay. links each and every being to its tasks.

lines.english: He merges into Himself, whoever is pleasing to His Will. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is aapay maylay jin gurmukh  ayko jaat aa hay. ||2||

lines.english: The world is coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on hai sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Attached to Maya, it dwells on its many sins.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh baho chitai bikaaraa.

lines.english: One who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praises forever the eternal,unchanging True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: thir saachaa saalaahee sad hee jin gur kaa sabad  pachh aataa hay. ||3||

lines.english: Some are attached to the root - they find peace.
lines.transliteration: ik mool lagay onee sukh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਥਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: But those who are attached to the branches, waste their lives away uselessly.
lines.transliteration: daalee laagay tinee janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਮੂਿਲ ਲਗੇ ਓਨੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings, who chant the Name of the Ambrosial Lord, produce theambrosial fruit. ||4||
lines.transliteration: amrit fal t in jan ka-o laagay jo boleh amrit  baataa hay. ||4||

lines.english: I have no virtues; what words should I speak?
lines.transliteration: ham gun naahee ki-aa bolah bol.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲ ਿਤਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੇ  ਜੋ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: You see all, and weigh them on Your scale.
lines.transliteration: too sabh naa d aykheh toleh t ol.

lines.english: By Your will, You preserve me, and so do I remain. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh ahi rahn aa gurmukh  ayko jaat aa hay. ||5||

lines.english: According to Your Will, You link me to my true tasks.
lines.transliteration: jaa tuDh  bhaanaa taa sachee kaarai laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਰਹਣਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Renouncing vice, I am immersed in virtue.
lines.transliteration: avgan chh od gun  maahi samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਤਾ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The One Immaculate True Lord abides in virtue; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, He is realized. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gun meh ayko nirmal saachaa gur kai sabad  pachh aataa hay. ||6||

lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see Him.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah ayko so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੋ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Duality and evil-mindedness are destroyed through the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: doojee d urmat  sabd ay kh o-ee.

lines.english: The One Lord God is immersed in His Oneness. He is attuned forever to His owndelight. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aykas meh parabh ayk samaan aa apn ai rang sad  raataa hay. ||7||

lines.english: The body-lotus is withering away,
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kamal hai kumlaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਅਪਣੈ  ਰੰਿਗ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: manmukh sabad  na bujh ai i-aan aa. but the ignorant, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he searches his body, and finds the Great Giver, the Life of the world. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee kaa-i-aa khojay paa-ay jagjeevan d aataa hay. ||8||

lines.english: The Lord frees up the body-fortress, which was seized by sins,
lines.transliteration: kot gahee kay paap nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੇ ਪਾਏ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa har jee-o raakh ai ur Dh aaray. when one keeps the Dear Lord enshrined forever in the heart.

lines.english: The fruits of his desires are obtained, and he is dyed in the permanent color of theLord's Love. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jo ichhay so-ee fal paa-ay ji-o rang majeeth ai raat aa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh speaks of spiritual wisdom, but does not understand.
lines.transliteration: manmukh gi-aan kathay na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਉ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Again and again, he comes into the world, but he finds no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: fir fir aavai tha-ur na ko-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is spiritually wise, and praises the Lord forever. Throughout each andevery age, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan sad aa saalaahay jug jug ayko jaat aa hay. ||10||

lines.english: All the deeds which the manmukh does bring pain - nothing but pain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kaar karay sabh  dukh sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is not within him; how can he go to the Court of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  naahee ki-o d ar jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The True Shabad dwells deep within the mind of the Gurmukh; he serves the Giver of peace forever. ||11|| pMnw 1052
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  vasai man saachaa sad  sayvay sukh -daata hay. ||11||

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see You, everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa too sabh nee thaa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, all this is known.
lines.transliteration: poorai gur sabh sojh ee paa-ee.

lines.english: I meditate forever and ever on the Naam; this mind is imbued with the Naam. ||12||
lines.transliteration: naamo naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai sad aa sad  ih man naamay raat aa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the body is sanctified.
lines.transliteration: naamay raataa pavit  sareeraa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, they are drowned and die without water.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai doob mu-ay bin neeraa.

lines.english: They come and go, but do not understand the Naam. Some, as Gurmukh, realize theWord of the Shabad. ||13||
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaaveh naam nahee boojheh iknaa gurmukh  sabad  pachh aataa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur boojh  bujhaa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai mukat  kinai na paa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he remains intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love. ||14||
lines.transliteration: naamay naam milai vadi-aa-ee sahj rahai rang raataa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The body-village crumbles and collapses into a pile of dust.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar dhahai dh eh dh ayree.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, the cycle of reincarnation is not brought to an end.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai chookai nahee fayree.

lines.english: One who knows the One Lord, through the True Guru, praises the True Lord, andremains immersed in the True Lord. ||15||
lines.transliteration: saach salaahay saach samaavai jin gurmukh ayko jaat aa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The True Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind, when the Lord bestows HisGlance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so paa-ay. saachaa sabad  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, realizethe True Lord in His True Court. ||16||8|| mwrU solhy 3 ] (1052-7) maaroo solhay 3. Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay nirankaaree d ar saachai saach pachh aataa hay. ||16||8||

lines.english: O Creator, it is You Yourself who does all.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa sabh  jis karn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੀ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੮॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures are under Your Protection.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tayree sarn aa.

lines.english: You are hidden, and yet permeating within all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are realized. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay gupat vart ai sabh  antar gur kai sabad  pachh aataa hay. ||1||

lines.english: Devotion to the Lord is a treasure overflowing.
lines.transliteration: har kay bhagat  bharay bh andaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself blesses us with contemplative meditation on the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay sabad  veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You do whatever You please; my mind is attuned to the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so-ee karseh sachay si-o man raat aa hay. ||2||

lines.english: You Yourself are the priceless diamond and jewel.
lines.transliteration: aapay heeraa ratan amolo.

lines.english: In Your Mercy, You weigh with Your scale.
lines.transliteration: aapay nadree t olay t olo.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸਿਹ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures are under Your protection. One who is blessed by Your Gracerealizes his own self. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  saran  tumaaree kar kirpaa aap pachh aataa hay. ||3||

lines.english: One who receives Your Mercy, O Primal Lord,
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar hovai Dh ur tayree.
marai na jammai chookai fayree. does not die, and is not reborn; he is released from the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, day and night, and, throughout theages, he knows the One Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saachay gun gaavai d in raat ee jug jug ayko jaat aa hay. ||4||

lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya wells up throughout the whole world,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi sabh jagat  upaa-i-aa.
barahmaa bisan dayv sabaa-i-aa. from Brahma, Vishnu and all the demi-gods.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to Your Will, are attached to the Naam; through spiritualwisdom and understanding, You are recognized. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaanay say naam laagay gi-aan mat ee pachh aataa hay. ||5||

lines.english: The world is engrossed in vice and virtue.
lines.transliteration: paap punn vartai sansaaraa.

lines.english: Happiness and misery are totally loaded with pain.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog sabh  dukh hai bh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਮਤੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh finds peace; such a Gurmukh recognizes the Naam. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so sukh  paa-ay jin gurmukh  naam pachh aataa hay. ||6||

lines.english: No one can erase the record of one's actions.
lines.transliteration: kirat na ko-ee maytan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖੁ  ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one finds the door of salvation.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday mokh  du-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who conquers self-conceit and recognizes the Lord, obtains the fruits of his pre- destined rewards. ||7||
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa so fal paa-i-aa jin aap maar pachh aataa hay. ||7||

lines.english: Emotionally attached to Maya, one's consciousness is not attached to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi har si-o chit na laagai.

lines.english: In the love of duality, he will suffer terrible agony in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay gh anaa dukh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਪੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt; at the very lastmoment, they regret and repent. ||8||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aram bh ulay bh aykh-Dhaaree ant  kaal pachh utaataa hay. ||8||

lines.english: In accordance with the Lord's Will, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: He is rid of all sins, and all suffering.
lines.transliteration: sabh kilbikh  kaatay d ookh sabaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ  ਅੰਤ ਕਾਿਲ  ਪਛੁਤਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Lord is immaculate, and immaculate is the Word of His Bani. My mind is imbuedwith the Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: har nirmal nirmal hai banee har sayt ee man raat aa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains the Lord, the treasure ofvirtue.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so gun  niDh paa-ay.

lines.english: Egotism and possessiveness are brought to an end.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa thaak rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the only Giver of virtue and vice, merits and demerits; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||10||
lines.transliteration: gun avgan  kaa ayko d aataa gurmukh  virlee jaat aa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: My God is immaculate, and utterly infinite.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh nirmal at  apaaraa.

lines.english: God unites with Himself, through contemplation of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. pMnw 1053
lines.transliteration: aapay maylai gur sabad veechaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself forgives, and implants the Truth. The mind and body are then attuned to the True Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay sach drirh -aa-ay man t an saachai raat aa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਸਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Within the polluted mind and body is the Light of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan mailaa vich jot  apaaraa.

lines.english: One who understands the Guru's Teachings, contemplates this.
lines.transliteration: gurmat boojh ai kar veechaaraa.

lines.english: Conquering egotism, the mind becomes immaculate forever; with his tongue, heserves the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||12||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar sadaa man nirmal rasnaa sayv sukh -daata hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: In the fortress of the body there are many shops and bazaars;
lines.transliteration: garh kaa-i-aa and ar baho hat baajaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੜ ਕਾਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਬਹੁ ਹਟ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich naam hai at  apaaraa. within them is the Naam, the Name of the utterly infinite Lord.

lines.english: In His Court, one is embellished forever with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; he conquers egotism and realizes the Lord. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad aa dar sohai ha-umai maar pachh aataa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The jewel is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: ratan amolak agam apaaraa.

lines.english: How can the poor wretch estimate its worth?
lines.transliteration: keemat kavan  karay vaychaaraa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is weighed, and so the Shabad is realizeddeep within. ||14||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday t ol tolaa-ay ant ar sabad  pachh aataa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ  ਤੋਿਲ  ਤੋਲਾਏ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The great volumes of the Simritees and the Shaastras only extend the extension ofattachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar bahut  bisthaaraa. maa-i-aa moh pasri-aa paasaaraa.

lines.english: The fools read them, but do not understand the Word of the Shabad. How rare arethose who, as Gurmukh, understand. ||15||
lines.transliteration: moorakh parh eh sabad  na boojh eh gurmukh  virlai jaat aa hay. ||15||

lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੜਿਹ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਵਰਲੈ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of His Bani, Truth is implanted deep within.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sach drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and throughout the ages, the One Lord is known. ||16||9|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1053-8) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee jug jug ayko jaataa hay. ||16||9||

lines.english: Serve the True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: so sach sayvihu sirjanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੯॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is the Destroyer of pain.
lines.transliteration: sabday d ookh nivaaran haaraa.

lines.english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be evaluated. He Himself isinaccessible and immeasurable. ||1||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paa-ee aapay agam athaahaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: The True Lord Himself makes Truth pervasive.
lines.transliteration: aapay sachaa sach vartaa-ay.

lines.english: He attaches some humble beings to the Truth.
lines.transliteration: ik jan saachai aapay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਿਤ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ਆਪੇ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਥਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They serve the True Lord and practice Truth; through the Name, they are absorbed inthe True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saacho sayveh saach kamaaveh naamay sach samaahaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: Dhur bh agtaa maylay aap milaa-ay. The Primal Lord unites His devotees in His Union.
He attaches them to true devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagt ee aapay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani, earns the profit of this life. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saachee banee sad aa gun  gaavai is janmai kaa laahaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: The Gurmukh trades, and understands his own self.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh van aj karahi par aap pachh aaneh.

lines.english: He knows no other than the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykas bin ko avar na jaaneh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਇਸੁ ਜਨਮੈ  ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: True is the banker, and True are His traders, who buy the merchandise of the Naam.||4||
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu sachay vanjaaray poonjee naam visaahaa hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਣਜੁ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself fashions and creates the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aapay saajay sarisat upaa-ay.

lines.english: He inspires a few to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: virlay ka-o gur sabad bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true. He snaps the noose of deathfrom around their necks. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say jan saachay kaatay jam kaa faahaa hay. ||5||

lines.english: He destroys, creates, embellishes and fashions all beings,
lines.transliteration: bhannai gh arhay savaaray saajay.
maa-i-aa mohi doojai jant  paajay. and attaches them to duality, attachment and Maya.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander around forever, acting blindly. Death has strung his noose around their necks. ||6||
lines.transliteration: manmukh fireh sad aa anDh  kamaaveh jam kaa jayvrh aa gal faahaa hay. ||6||

lines.english: He Himself forgives, and enjoins us to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay gur sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ  ਗਿਲ  ਫਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the True Lord, and earn the profitof the Naam in this world. ||7||
lines.transliteration: an-din naam Dh i-aa-ay saachaa is jag meh naamo laahaa hay. ||7||

lines.english: He Himself is True, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: aapay sachaa sachee naa-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh bestows it, and enshrines it within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d ayvai man vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Noble and exalted are those, within whose mind the Lord abides. Their heads are freeof strife. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jin man vasi-aa say jan soheh tin sir chookaa kaahaa hay. ||8||

lines.english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be appraised.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee man vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਕਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: No one calls that person to account, who praises the Word of the Shabad, the Giver ofvirtue. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sabad  saalaahee gund aataa laykh aa ko-ay na mangai t aahaa hay. ||9||

lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva serve Him.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan rudar t is kee sayvaa.

lines.english: Even they cannot find the limits of the unseen, unknowable Lord.
lines.transliteration: ant na paavahi alakh  abhayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed by Your Glance of Grace, become Gurmukh, and comprehend the incomprehensible. ||10|| pMnw 1054
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o nadar karahi t oo apn ee gurmukh  alakh  lakhaahaa hay. ||10||

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur sojh ee paa-ee.

lines.english: I have enshrined the Naam, the One Name, within my mind.
lines.transliteration: ayko naam man vasaa-ee.

lines.english: I chant the Naam, and meditate on the Naam. Singing His Glorious Praises, I enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naam japee tai naam Dh i-aa-ee mahal paa-ay gun  gaahaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The servant serves, and obeys the Command of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayveh man hukam apaaraa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the value of the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: manmukh hukam na jaan eh saaraa.

lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is exalted; by His Hukam, one is glorified;by His Hukam, one becomes carefree. ||12||
lines.transliteration: hukmay mannay hukmay vadi-aa-ee hukmay vayparvaahaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one recognizes the Lord's Hukam.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee hukam pachhaan ai.

lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ai ikat  ghar aan ai. The wandering mind is restrained, and brought back to the home of the One Lord.
Imbued with the Naam, one remains forever detached; the jewel of the Naam restswithin the mind. ||13||
lines.transliteration: naamay raataa sad aa bairaagee naam rat an man t aahaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The One Lord is pervasive throughout all the world.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag meh vart ai ayko so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਤੈ  ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee pargat ho-ee.

lines.english: Those humble beings who praise the Shabad are immaculate; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||14||
lines.transliteration: sabad salaaheh say jan nirmal nij gh ar vaasaa t aahaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਲਾਹਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The devotees abide forever in Your Sanctuary, Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa bh agat tayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paa-ee.

lines.english: As it pleases Your Will, You keep us; the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam. ||15||
lines.transliteration: ji-o tuDh  bhaaveh t i-o too raakh ahi gurmukh  naam Dh i-aahaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa tayray gun  gaavaa.

lines.english: O my True Lord and Master, may I become pleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: sachay saahib tayrai man bh aavaa.

lines.english: Nanak offers this true prayer: O Lord, please bless me with Truth, that I may merge in the Truth. ||16||1||10|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1054-8) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saach kahai baynantee sach d ayvhu sach samaahaa hay. ||16||1||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan say vadbh aagee.

lines.english: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the True Name.
lines.transliteration: an-din saach naam liv laagee.

lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever deep within their hearts; they delight in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh -daata ravi-aa gh at ant ar sabad  sachai omaahaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: When the Lord grants His Grace, one meets with the Guru.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa guroo milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is enshrined within the mind.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever within the mind; the mind is delightedwith the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har man vasi-aa sadaa sukh -daata sabd ay man omaahaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He unites in His Union.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay taa mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਮਿਨ ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Egotism and attachment are burned away by the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.english: In the Love of the One Lord, one remains liberated forever; he is not in conflict withanyone. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa mukat  rahai ik rangee naahee kisai naal kaahaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay gh or anDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਸੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਕਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, no one crosses over to the other side.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai ko-ay na paavai paaraa.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Shabad, are very detached. They earn the profit of the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo sabad raat ay mahaa bairaagee so sach sabd ay laahaa hay. ||4||

lines.english: Pain and pleasure are pre-ordained by the Creator.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  kartai Dhur likh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੇ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He Himself has caused the love of duality to be pervasive.
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aa-o aap vart aa-i-aa.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh remains detached; how can anyone trust the self-willed manmukh? ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so alipat o vart ai manmukh  kaa ki-aa vaysaahaa hay. ||5||

lines.english: Those who do not recognize the Shabad are manmukhs.
lines.transliteration: say manmukh jo sabad  na pachh aaneh.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਿਲਪਤੋ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਵੇਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: They do not know the essence of the Fear of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur kay bhai kee saar na jaan eh.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Without this Fear, how can anyone find the Fearless True Lord? The Messenger ofDeath will pull the breath out. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bhai bin ki-o nirbh a-o sach paa-ee-ai jam kaadh  la-aygaa saahaa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The invulnerable Messenger of Death cannot be killed.
lines.transliteration: afri-o jam maari-aa na jaa-ee.
