lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਉ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਮੁ ਕਾਿਢ ਲਏਗਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad prevents him from approaching.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday nayrh  na aa-ee.

lines.english: When he hears the Word of the Shabad, he runs far away. He is afraid that the self- sufficient Dear Lord will kill him. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sabad sun ay taa Dh oorahu bh aagai mat  maaray har jee-o vayparvaahaa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Ruler above all.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kee hai sabh sirkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣੇ ਤਾ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: What can this wretched Messenger of Death do?
lines.transliteration: ayhu jam ki-aa karay vichaaraa.

lines.english: As slave to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal acts according to HisHukam. According to His Hukam, he is deprived of his breath. ||8||
lines.transliteration: hukmee bandaa hukam kamaavai hukmay kadh -daa saahaa hay. ||8||

lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes that the True Lord created the creation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachai kee-aa akaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਢਦਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh knows that the Lord has expanded the entire expanse.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pasri-aa sabh  paasaaraa.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the True Lord. Through the True Word ofthe Shabad, he finds peace. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so sach boojh ai sabad  sachai sukh  taahaa hay. ||9||

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows that the Lord is the Architect of karma. pMnw 1055
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaat aa karam biDh aataa.

lines.english: Throughout the four ages, he recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jug chaaray gur sabad pachh aataa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh does not die, the Gurmukh is not reborn; the Gurmukh is immersed in the Shabad. ||10||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh marai na janmai gurmukh  gurmukh  sabad  samaahaa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam sabad  saalaahay.

lines.english: God is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sufficient.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar vayparvaahay.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the One Lord, saves and redeems throughout the four ages.Through the Shabad, one trades in the Naam. ||11||
lines.transliteration: ayk naam jug chaar uDhaaray sabd ay naam visaahaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਿਰ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਨਾਮ ਿਵਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains eternal peace and tranqulity.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saaNt sadaa sukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh enshrines the Naam within his heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hird ai naam vasaa-ay.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, and the noose of evil-mindednessis snapped. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so naam boojh ai kaatay d urmat  faahaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਫਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh wells up from, and then merges back into Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh upjai saach samaavai.

lines.english: He does not die and take birth, and is not consigned to reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: naa mar jammai na joonee paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. Night andday, he earns a profit. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa raheh rang raat ay an-d in laid ay laahaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਲੈਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs, the devotees, are exalted and beautified in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh agat soheh d arbaaray.

lines.english: They are embellished with the True Word of His Bani, and the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee sabad  savaaray.

lines.english: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, and theyintuitively go to their own home. ||14||
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavai d in raat ee sahj sayt ee gh ar jaahaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru proclaims the Shabad;
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa sabad  sunaa-ay.
an-din bh agat karahu liv laa-ay. night and day, remain lovingly attuned to devotional worship.

lines.english: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, becomes immaculate;Immaculate are the Glorious Praises of the Sovereign Lord . ||15||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi sad  hee nirmal nirmal gun  paatisaahaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਿਨਰਮਲ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਣ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The True Lord is the Giver of virtue.
lines.transliteration: gun kaa d aataa sachaa so-ee.

lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee.

lines.english: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; he blossoms forth in the ecstasy of the Name of theself-sufficient Lord. ||16||2||11|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1055-9) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan naam salaahay bigsai so naam bayparvaahaa hay. ||16||2||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Serve the Dear Lord, the inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sayvihu agam apaaraa.

lines.english: He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: tis daa ant  na paa-ee-ai paaraavaaraa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one who dwells upon the Lord deep within his heart - his heart isfilled with infinite wisdom. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ravi-aa gh at ant ar tit ghat mat  agaahaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: The One Lord is pervading and permeating amidst all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vart ai ayko so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਘਿਟ  ਮਿਤ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee pargat ho-ee.

lines.english: The Life of the world nurtures and cherishes all, giving sustenance to all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa part ipaal karay jagjeevan d aydaa rijak sambaahaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur boojh  bujhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਦੇਦਾ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸੰਬਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the entire Universe.
lines.transliteration: hukmay hee sabh jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Whoever submits to His Command, finds peace; His Command is above the heads of kings and emperors. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hukam mannay so-ee sukh paa-ay hukam sir saahaa paat isaahaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: True is the True Guru. Infinite is the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachaa satgur sabad  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Through His Shabad, the world is saved.
lines.transliteration: tis dai sabad  nistarai sansaaraa.

lines.english: The Creator Himself created the creation; He gazes upon it, and blesses it with breathand nourishment. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa kar kar vaykh ai daydaa saas giraahaa hay. ||4||

lines.english: Out of millions, only a few understand.
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay kiseh bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਦੇਦਾ  ਸਾਸ ਿਗਰਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are colored in His Love.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rat ay rang laa-ay.

lines.english: They praise the Lord, the Giver of peace forever; the Lord forgives His devotees, andblesses them with His Praise. ||5||
lines.transliteration: har saalaahahi sadaa sukh -daata har bakh say bh agat salaahaa hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say jan saachay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਬਖਸੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The falsest of the false die, only to be reborn.
lines.transliteration: jo mar jameh kaachan kaachay.

lines.english: The inaccessible, unfathomable, self-sufficient, incomprehensible Lord is the Lover ofHis devotees. ||6||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar vayparvaahaa bhagat  vachh al athaahaa hay. ||6||

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru implants Truth within.
lines.transliteration: satgur pooraa saach drirh -aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਅਥਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing His Glorious Praises forever.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sad aa gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: The Giver of virtue is pervading deep within the nucleus of all beings; He inscribes thetime of destiny upon each and every person's head. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gundaat aa vart ai sabh  antar sir sir likh -daa saahaa hay. ||7||

lines.english: The Gurmukh knows that God is always ever-present.
lines.transliteration: sadaa had oor gurmukh  jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਲਖਦਾ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: That humble being who serves the Shabad, is comforted and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sabday sayvai so jan Dh araapai.

lines.english: Night and day, he serves the True Word of the Guru's Bani; he delights in the TrueWord of the Shabad. ||8||
lines.transliteration: an-din sayveh sachee ban ee sabad  sachai omaahaa hay. ||8||

lines.english: The ignorant and blind cling to all sorts of rituals.
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee anDhaa baho karam drirh -aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: They stubborn-mindedly perform these rituals, and are consigned to reincarnation. pMnw 1056
lines.transliteration: manhath karam fir jonee paa-ay.

lines.english: For the sake of poison, they act in greed and possessiveness, and evil-minded duality. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa kaaran  lab lobh  kamaaveh d urmat  kaa d oraahaa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਾ ਦੋਰਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru implants devotional worship within.
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur bh agat drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he lovingly centers his consciousness on theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord pervades his mind, body and heart; deep within, his mind is drenched withdevotional worship and praise of the Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: man tan har ravi-aa gh at ant ar man bh eenai bh agat salaahaa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਵਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਿਨ ਭੀਨੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: My True Lord God is the Destroyer of demons.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa asur sangh aaran .

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His devotees are saved.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bh agat nistaaran .

lines.english: My True Lord God is forever True. He is the Emperor over the heads of kings. ||11||
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa sad  hee saachaa sir saahaa paat isaahaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: True are those devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  sachay t ayrai man bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: They sing the Kirtan of His Praises at His Door; they are embellished and exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: dar keert an karahi gur sabad  suhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਸੁਹਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they sing the True Word of His Bani. The Naam is the wealth of thepoor. ||12||
lines.transliteration: saachee banee an-d in gaavahi nirDh an kaa naam vaysaahaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਿਨਰਧਨ  ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Those whom You unite, Lord, are never separated again.
lines.transliteration: jin aapay mayl vichhorh eh naahee.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they praise You forever.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad aa saalaahee.

lines.english: You are the One Lord and Master over all. Through the Shabad, the Naam is praised.||13||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa sir t oo ayko saahib sabd ay naam salaahaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, no one knows You.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai t uDhuno ko-ee na jaan ee.

lines.english: You Yourself speak the Unspoken Speech.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay kathee akath kahaan ee.

lines.english: You Yourself are the Shabad forever, the Guru, the Great Giver; chanting the Lord's Name, You bestow Your treasure. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aapay sabad sad aa gur d aataa har naam jap sambaahaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: too aapay kart aa sirjan haaraa.

lines.english: No one can erase what You have written.
lines.transliteration: tayraa likh i-aa ko-ay na maytan haaraa.

lines.english: You Yourself bless the Gurmukh with the Naam, who is no longer skeptical, and is notheld to account. ||15||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam d ayveh t oo aapay sahsaa gan at na taahaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Your true devotees stand at the Door of Your Court.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sachay t ayrai d arvaaray.

lines.english: They serve the Shabad with love and affection.
lines.transliteration: sabday sayvan bh aa-ay pi-aaray.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain detached; through the Naam,their affairs are resolved. ||16||3||12|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1056-10) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay bairaagee naamay kaaraj sohaa hay. ||16||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.english: My True Lord God has staged a play.
lines.transliteration: mayrai parabh saachai ik kh ayl rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He has created no one like anyone else.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na kis hee jayhaa upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He made them different, and he gazes upon them with pleasure; he placed all theflavors in the body. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay farak karay vaykh vigsai sabh  ras d ayhee maahaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: You Yourself vibrate the beat of the breath.
lines.transliteration: vaajai pa-un t ai aap vajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਫਰਕੁ  ਕਰੇ ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਸਿਭ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter - You have placed them into the body.
lines.transliteration: siv saktee d ayhee meh paa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one turns away from the world, and attains the jewel of spiritualwisdom, and the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ultee hovai gi-aan ratan sabad  taahaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself created darkness and light.
lines.transliteration: anDhayraa chaanan  aapay kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਗਆਨ  ਰਤਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone is pervasive; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayko vartai avar na bee-aa.

lines.english: One who realizes his own self - by Guru's Grace, the lotus of his mind blossoms forth.||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aap pachhaan ai kamal bigsai buDh  taahaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: Only He Himself knows His depth and extent.
lines.transliteration: apnee gahan  gat aapay jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਬੁਿਧ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Other people can only listen and hear what is spoken and said.
lines.transliteration: hor lok sun sun  aakh  vakh aanai.

lines.english: One who is spiritually wise, understands himself as Gurmukh; he praises the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee hovai so gurmukh boojh ai saachee sifat  salaahaa hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within the body is the priceless object.
lines.transliteration: dayhee and ar vasat  apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੀ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He Himself opens the doors.
lines.transliteration: aapay kapat khulaavan haaraa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh intuitively drings in the Ambrosial Nectar, and the fire of desire isquenched. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sehjay amrit  peevai t arisnaa agan bujh aahaa hay. ||5||

lines.english: He placed all the flavors within the body.
lines.transliteration: sabh ras d ayhee and ar paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: How rare are those who understand, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: virlay ka-o gur sabad bujh aa-ay.

lines.english: So search within yourself, and praise the Shabad. Why run around outside your self?||6||
lines.transliteration: andar kh ojay sabad  saalaahay baahar kaahay jaahaa hay. ||6||

lines.english: Without tasting, no one enjoys the flavor.
lines.transliteration: vin chaakh ay saad  kisai na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਾਲਾਹੇ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad amrit  pee-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar is drunk, and the immoral status is obtained, when one obtains the sublime essence of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||
lines.transliteration: amrit pee amraa pad  ho-ay gur kai sabad  ras taahaa hay. ||7||

lines.english: One who realizes himself, knows all virtues. pMnw 1057
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai so sabh  gun jaanai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he chants the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, he remains imbued with the Naam, day and night; he is rid of emotional attachment to Maya. ||8||
lines.transliteration: an-din naam rat aa din raat ee maa-i-aa moh chukaahaa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤਾ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, all things are obtained;
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay sabh  kichh  paa-ay.
ha-umai mayraa aap gavaa-ay. egotism, possessiveness and self-conceit are taken away.

lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace Himself grants His Grace; He exalts and adorns with theWord of the Guru's Shabad. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aapay kirpaa karay sukh-d aata gur kai sabd ay sohaa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ  ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The Guru's Shabad is the Ambrosial Bani.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit  hai ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din har kaa naam vakh aanee.

lines.english: That heart becomes immaculate, which is filled with the True Lord, Har, Har. ||10||
lines.transliteration: har har sachaa vasai ghat ant ar so gh at nirmal t aahaa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: His servants serve, and praise His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayveh sabad salaaheh.

lines.english: Imbued forever with the color of His Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa rang raat ay har gun  gaavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself forgives, and unites them with the Shabad; the fragrance of sandalwood permeates their minds. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay sabad  milaa-ay parmal vaas man t aahaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਪਰਮਲ  ਵਾਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, they speak the Unspoken, and praise the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabday akath kathay saalaahay.

lines.english: My True Lord God is self-sufficient.
lines.transliteration: mayray parabh saachay vayparvaahay.

lines.english: The Giver of virtue Himself unites them with the Shabad; they enjoy the sublimeessence of the Shabad. ||12||
lines.transliteration: aapay gundaat aa sabad  milaa-ay sabd ai kaa ras t aahaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਸਬਦੈ  ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The confused, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolaa th a-ur na paa-ay.

lines.english: They do those deeds which they are pre-destined to do.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so karam kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with poison, they search out poison, and suffer the pains of death and rebirth. ||13||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa raat ay bikh i-aa kh ojai mar janmai d ukh taahaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਰਾਤੇ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਖੋਜੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: He Himself praises Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap aap saalaahay.

lines.english: Your Glorious Virtues are within You alone, God.
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  parabh  tujh hee maahay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are True, and True is the Word of Your Bani. You Yourself are invisibleand unknowable. ||14||
lines.transliteration: too aap sachaa t ayree ban ee sachee aapay alakh  athaahaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਿਪ  ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ  ਅਥਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord,
lines.transliteration: bin gur daat ay ko-ay na paa-ay.
lakh kotee jay karam kamaa-ay. though one may make hundreds of thousands and millions of attempts.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He dwells deep within the heart; through the Shabad, praise theTrue Lord. ||15||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay gh at ant ar vasi-aa sabd ay sach saalaahaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord unites with Himself.
lines.transliteration: say jan milay Dhur aap milaa-ay.

lines.english: They are adorned and exalted with the True Word of His Bani, and the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saachee banee sabad  suhaa-ay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; singing His Glories, he is immersed in the Glorious Lord of Virtue. ||16||4||13|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1057-11) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan gun gaavai nit  saachay gun  gaavah gun ee samaahaa hay. ||16||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The One Lord is eternal and unchanging, forever True.
lines.transliteration: nihchal ayk sadaa sach so-ee.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay sojh ee ho-ee.

lines.english: Those who are drenched with the sublime essence of the Lord, meditate forever onHim; following the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the armor of humility. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har ras bheenay sad aa Dh i-aa-in gurmat  seel sannaahaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: Deep within, they love the True Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: andar rang sad aa sachi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਇਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਨਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they love the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam pi-aaraa.

lines.english: The Naam, the embodiment of the nine treasures, abides within their hearts; they renounce the profit of Maya. ||2||
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh naam vasi-aa gh at ant ar chh odi-aa maa-i-aa kaa laahaa hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Both the king and his subjects are involved in evil-mindedness and duality.
lines.transliteration: ra-ee-at raajay d urmat  do-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਛੋਿਡਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, they do not become one with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay ayk na ho-ee.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the One Lord find eternal peace. Their power is eternal and unfailing. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk Dhi-aa-in sad aa sukh  paa-in nihchal raaj t inaahaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: No one can save them from coming and going.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa rakh ai na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਿਧਆਇਿਨ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਰਾਜੁ ਿਤਨਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Birth and death come from Him.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  tisai tay ho-ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the True Lord. Emancipation and liberation areobtained from Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachaa sad aa Dh i-aavahu gat  mukat  tisai tay paahaa hay. ||4||

lines.english: Truth and self-control are found through the Door of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam satguroo d u-aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਗਿਤ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਿਤਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Egotism and anger are silenced through the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kroDh sabad  nivaarai.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is found; humility and contentment all come from Him. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-ee-ai seel sant okh sabh  taahaa hay. ||5||

lines.english: Out of egotism and attachment, the Universe welled up.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai moh upjai sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸੀਲੁ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all the world perishes.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag binsai naam visaaraa.

lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. The Naam is the True profitin this world. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay naam na paa-ee-ai naam sachaa jag laahaa hay. ||6||

lines.english: True is His Will, beauteous and pleasing through the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachaa amar sabad suhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਗ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resonate. pMnw 1058
lines.transliteration: panch sabad mil vaajaa vaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the True Name, one's actions are forever embellished. Without the Shabad, what can anyone do? ||7||
lines.transliteration: sadaa kaaraj sach naam suhaylaa bin sabd ai kaaraj kayhaa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਕੇਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: One instant, he laughs, and the next instant, he cries.
lines.transliteration: khin meh hasai kh in meh rovai.

lines.english: Because of duality and evil-mindedness, his affairs are not resolved.
lines.transliteration: doojee d urmat  kaaraj na hovai.

lines.english: Union and separation are pre-ordained by the Creator. Actions already committed cannot be taken back. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sanjog vijog kartai likh  paa-ay kirat  na chalai chalaahaa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਏ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: One who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated whileyet alive.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat gur sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.english: He remains forever immersed in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har si-o sad hee rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with glorio us greatness; he is not afflicted by the disease of egotism. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay milai vadi-aa-ee ha-umai rog na t aahaa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Eating tasty delicacies, he fattens up his body
lines.transliteration: ras kas khaa-ay pind vaDh aa-ay.
bhaykh  karai gur sabad  na kamaa-ay. and wears religious robes, but he does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Deep with the nucleus of his being is the great disease; he suffers terrible pain, andeventually sinks into the manure. ||10||
lines.transliteration: antar rog mahaa d ukh bhaaree bistaa maahi samaahaa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ  ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He reads and studies the Vedas, and argues about them;
lines.transliteration: bayd parh eh parh  baad  vakaan eh.

lines.english: God is within his own heart, but he does not recognize the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ghat meh barahm t is sabad  na pachh aaneh.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਮਿਹ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh churns the essence of reality; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so t at bilovai rasnaa har ras t aahaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਿਬਲੋਵੈ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Those who forsake the object within their own hearts, wander outside.
lines.transliteration: ghar vath chh odeh baahar Dh aaveh.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not taste the flavor of God.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay saad  na paavahi.

lines.english: Imbued with the taste of another, their tongues speak tasteless, insipid words. Theynever taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||12||
lines.transliteration: an ras raatee rasnaa feekee bolay har ras mool na t aahaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਫੀਕੀ  ਬੋਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh has doubt as his spouse.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d ayhee bh aram bh ataaro.

lines.english: He dies of evil-mindedness, and suffers forever.
lines.transliteration: durmat  marai nit  ho-ay kh u-aaro.

lines.english: His mind is attached to sexual desire, anger and duality, and he does not find peace,even in dreams. ||13||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh man d oojai laa-i-aa supnai sukh  na taahaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The body becomes golden, with the Word of the Shabad as its spouse.
lines.transliteration: kanchan dayhee sabad  bhataaro.

lines.english: Night and day, enjoy the enjoyments, and be in love with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh og bh ogay har si-o pi-aaro.

lines.english: Deep within the mansion of the self, one finds the Lord, who transcends this mansion. Realizing His Will, we merge in Him. ||14||
lines.transliteration: mehlaa andar gair mahal paa-ay bh aanaa bujh  samaahaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣਾ  ਬੁਿਝ ਸਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The Great Giver Himself gives.
lines.transliteration: aapay dayvai d ayvan haaraa.

lines.english: No one has any power to stand against Him.
lines.transliteration: tis aagai nahee kisai kaa chaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself forgives, and unites us with the Shabad; The Word of His Shabad isunfathomable. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay sabad  milaa-ay t is daa sabad  athaahaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਥਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Body and soul, all belong to Him.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh hai t is kayraa.

lines.english: The True Lord is my only Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib thaakur mayraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I have found the Lord. Chanting theLord's Chant, I merge in Him. ||16||5||14|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1058-13) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurbaanee har paa-i-aa har jap jaap samaahaa hay. ||16||5||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਿਪ  ਸਮਾਹਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad instead of the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naad  bayd  beechaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh attains infinite spiritual wisdom and meditation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan Dh i-aan aapaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh acts in harmony with God's Will; the Gurmukh finds perfection. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kaar karay parabh  bhaavai gurmukh  pooraa paa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh turns away from the world.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh manoo-aa ulat paraavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh vibrates the Naad, the sound current of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ban ee naad  vajaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh, attuned to the Truth, remains detached, and dwells in the home of the self deep within. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach rat ay bairaagee nij gh ar vaasaa paa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: I speak the Ambrosial Teachings of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur kee saakhee amrit  bhaakhee.

lines.english: I lovingly chant the Truth, through the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabday sach subh aakhee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਿਚ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind remains forever imbued with the Love of the True Lord. I am immersed inthe Truest of the True. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach rang raat aa man mayraa sachay sach samaa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: Immaculate and pure is the mind of the Gurmukh, who bathes in the Pool of Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh man nirmal sat  sar naavai.

lines.english: No filth attaches to him; he merges in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: mail na laagai sach samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਚ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He truly practices Truth forever; true devotion is implanted within him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sacho sach kamaavai sad hee sachee bh agat darirhaa-idaa. ||4||

lines.english: True is the speech of the Gurmukh; true are the eyes of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach bain ee gurmukh  sach nain ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh practices and lives the Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach kamaavai karn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He speaks the Truth forever, day and night, and inspires others to speak the Truth. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sad hee sach kahai d in raat ee avraa sach kahaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਬੈਣੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਨੈਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: True and exalted is the speech of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sachee oot am ban ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukh speaks Truth, only Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sacho sach vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਅਵਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh serves the Truest of the True forever; the Gurmukh proclaims the Word of the Shabad. ||6|| pMnw 1059
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad  sayveh sacho sachaa gurmukh  sabad  sunaa-idaa. ||6||

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh understands.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.english: He rids himself of egotism, Maya and doubt.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa bharam gavaa-ay.

lines.english: He ascends the sublime, exalted ladder of the Guru, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord at His True Door. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur kee pa-orhee oot am oochee d ar sachai har gun  gaa-id aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ  ਊਤਮ  ਊਚੀ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh practices true self-control, and acts in excellence.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach sanjam karn ee saar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the gate of salvation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ay mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: Through loving devotion, he remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love; eradicatingself-conceit, he merges in the Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay bh agat sadaa rang raat aa aap gavaa-ay samaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh examines his own mind, and instructs others.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai man kh oj sun aa-ay.

lines.english: He is lovingly attuned to the True Name forever.
lines.transliteration: sachai naam sadaa liv laa-ay.

lines.english: They act in harmony with the Mind of the True Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so-ee karsee jo sachay man bh aa-idaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ  ਜੋ ਸਚੇ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: As it pleases His Will, He unites us with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavai sat guroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavai t aa man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases His Will, He imbues us with His Love; as it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell in the mind. ||10||
lines.transliteration: aapnai bh aanai sad aa rang raat aa bh aanai man vasaa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Those who act stubborn-mindedly are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: manhath karam karay so chh eejai.

lines.english: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, they do not please the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bahutay bh aykh karay nahee bh eejai.

lines.english: Tinged by corruption, they earn only pain; they are immersed in pain. ||11||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa raat ay dukh kamaaveh d ukhay dukh samaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਰਾਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਿਖ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh earns peace.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so sukh  kamaa-ay.

lines.english: He comes to understand death and birth.
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan  kee sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.english: One who looks alike upon death and birth, is pleasing to my God. ||12||
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan  jo sam kar jaan ai so mayray parabh  bhaa-idaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣੁ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਜੋ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh, while remaining dead, is respected and approved.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh mareh so heh parvaan .

lines.english: He realizes that coming and going are according to God's Will.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa sabad  pachh aan.

lines.english: He does not die, he is not reborn, and he does not suffer in pain; his mind merges in the Mind of God. ||13||
lines.transliteration: marai na jammai naa dukh  paa-ay man hee maneh samaa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Very fortunate are those who find the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee jinee sat gur paa-i-aa.

lines.english: They eradicate egotism and attachment from within.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vichahu moh chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Their minds are immaculate, and they are never again stained with filth. They arehonored at the Door of the True Court. ||14||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal fir mail na laagai dar sachai sobh aa paa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay aapay.

lines.english: He Himself watches over all; He establishes and disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai thaap uthaapay.

lines.english: The service of the Gurmukh is pleasing to my God; one who listens to the Truth isapproved. ||15||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa mayray parabh  bhaavai sach sun  laykh ai paa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and only Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sacho sach kamaavai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is immaculate; no filth attaches to him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh nirmal mail na laavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who contemplate the Naam are imbued with it. They merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||1||15|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1059-13) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay veechaaree naamay naam samaa-id aa. ||16||1||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He Himself fashioned the Universe, through the Hukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat hukam sabh saajee.

lines.english: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and embellishes with grace.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaap nivaajee.

lines.english: The True Lord Himself administers all justice; through Truth, we merge in the TrueLord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay ni-aa-o karay sabh saachaa saachay saach milaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: The body takes the form of a fortress.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kot hai aakaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਨਆਉ  ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਿਚ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya has expanded throughout its expanse.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh pasri-aa paasaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, the body is reduced to a pile of ashes; in the end, dust mingles with dust. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai bh asmai kee dh ayree kh ayhoo kh ayh ralaa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: The body is the infinite fortress of gold;
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kanchan kot apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਭਸਮੈ  ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis vich ravi-aa sabad apaaraa. it is permeated by the Infinite Word of the Shabad.

lines.english: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord forever; meeting hisBeloved, he finds peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gaavai sad aa gun  saachay mil pareet am sukh  paa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: The body is the temple of the Lord; the Lord Himself embellishes it.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa har mandar har aap savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord dwells within it.
lines.transliteration: tis vich har jee-o vasai muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the merchants trade, and in His Grace, theLord merges them with Himself. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad van jan vaapaaree nad ree aap milaa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: He alone is pure, who eradicates anger.
lines.transliteration: so soochaa je karoDh nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਵਣਜਿਨ  ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He realizes the Shabad, and reforms himself.
lines.transliteration: sabday boojh ai aap savaaray.

lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself abides in the mind. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa aapay man vasaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: Pure and unique is devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: nirmal bhagat  hai niraalee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The mind and body are washed clean, contemplating the Shabad. pMnw 1060
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh oveh sabad  veechaaree.

lines.english: One who remains forever imbued with His Love, night and day - in His Mercy, the Lord inspires him to perform devotional worship service. ||6||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa rahai rang raat aa kar kirpaa bh agat karaa-id aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: In this temple of the mind, the mind wanders around.
lines.transliteration: is man mandar meh manoo-aa Dh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਿਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Discarding joy like straw, it suffers in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: sukh palar t i-aag mahaa d ukh paavai.

lines.english: Without meeting the True Guru, it finds no place of rest; He Himself has staged thisplay. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay th a-ur na paavai aapay kh ayl karaa-id aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੇਟੇ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself is infinite; He contemplates Himself.
lines.transliteration: aap aprampar aap veechaaree.

lines.english: He Himself bestows Union through actions of excellence.
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay karnee saaree.

lines.english: What can the poor creatures do? Granting forgiveness, He unites them with Himself. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ko kaar karay vaychaaraa aapay bakhas milaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord Himself unites them with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur maylay pooraa.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he makes them brave spiritual heroes.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad mahaabal sooraa.

lines.english: Uniting them with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness; He inspires them to focustheir consciousness on the True Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay day vadi-aa-ee sachay si-o chit  laa-id aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The True Lord is deep within the heart.
lines.transliteration: ghar hee and ar saachaa so-ee.

lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa boojh ai ko-ee.

lines.english: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within their hearts; they meditate on the Naamwith their tongues. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan vasi-aa gh at ant ar rasnaa naam Dh i-aa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He wanders through foreign lands, but does not look within himself.
lines.transliteration: disantar bh avai ant ar nahee bh aalay.

lines.english: Attached to Maya, he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi baDhaa jamkaalay.

lines.english: The noose of death around his neck will never be untied; in the love of duality, he wanders in reincarnation. ||11||
lines.transliteration: jam kee faasee kabhoo na tootai d oojai bh aa-ay bh armaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: There is no real chanting, meditation, penance or self-control,
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam hor ko-ee naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag gur kaa sabad na kamaahee. as long as one does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਕਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Accepting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one obtains Truth; through Truth, onemerges in the True Lord. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad mili-aa sach paa-i-aa sachay sach samaa-id aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the world.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh sabal sansaaraa.

lines.english: They lead to all sorts of actions, but these only add to all the pain.
lines.transliteration: baho karam kamaaveh sabh d ukh kaa pasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are united with the True Shabad.||13||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say sukh  paavahi sachai sabad  milaa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Air, water and fire make up the body.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee hai baisant ar.

lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya rules deep within all.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh vartai sabh  antar.

lines.english: When one realizes the One who created him, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jin keetay jaa t isai pachh aaneh maa-i-aa moh chukaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਜਾ ਿਤਸੈ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Some are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya and pride.
lines.transliteration: ik maa-i-aa mohi garab vi-aapay.

lines.english: They are self-conceited and egotistical.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai ho-ay rahay hai aapay.

lines.english: They never think about the Messenger of Death; in the end, they leave, regretting andrepenting. ||15||
lines.transliteration: jamkaalai kee khabar na paa-ee ant  ga-i-aa pachh utaa-idaa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ  ਕੀ ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ਅੰਿਤ ਗਇਆ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He alone knows the Way, who created it.
lines.transliteration: jin upaa-ay so biDh jaan ai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh, who is blessed with the Shabad, realizes Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d ayvai sabad  pachh aanai.

lines.english: Slave Nanak offers ths prayer; O Lord, let my consciousness be attached to the TrueName. ||16||2||16|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1060-14) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai baynant ee sach naam chit  laa-id aa. ||16||2||16||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the Merciful Lord has beenthe Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  da-i-aapat  daataa.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad pachh aataa.

lines.english: Those who serve You are immersed in You. You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDhuno sayveh say t ujheh samaaveh t oo aapay mayl milaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ  ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਸਮਾਵਿਹ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant t ayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: As is pleases Your Will, You guide us along; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o tuDh  bhaavai t ivai chalaaveh t oo aapay maarag paa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: The True Lord is, and shall always be.
lines.transliteration: hai bhee saachaa hosee so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਿਹ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself creates - there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: aapay saajay avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: The Giver of peace takes care of all; He Himself sustains them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa saar karay sukh -daata aapay rijak pahuchaa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: You are inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite;
lines.transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਪਹੁਚਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na jaanai t ayraa parvaaraa. no one knows Your extent.

lines.english: You Yourself realize Yourself. Through the Guru's Teachings, You reveal Yourself. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapnaa aap pachh aaneh aapay gurmat ee aap bujh aa-idaa. ||4||

lines.english: Your Almighty Command prevails throughout the nether worlds, realms and worlds of form. pMnw 1061
lines.transliteration: paataal puree-aa lo-a aakaaraa. t is vich vart ai hukam karaaraa.

lines.english: By the Hukam of Your Command, You create, and by Your Command, You destroy. By Your Command, You unite in Union. ||5||
lines.transliteration: hukmay saajay hukmay dhaahay hukmay mayl milaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: One who realizes Your Command, praises Your Command.
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhai so hukam salaahay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਢਾਹੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: You are Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Self-Sufficient.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar vayparvaahay.

lines.english: As is the understanding You give, so do I become. You Yourself reveal the Shabad.||6||
lines.transliteration: jayhee mat d eh so hovai t oo aapay sabad  bujhaa-idaa. ||6||

lines.english: Night and day, the days of our lives wear away.
lines.transliteration: an-din aarjaa chh ijdee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਿਹ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Night and day both bear witness to this loss.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas d u-ay saakh ee aa-ay.

lines.english: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is not aware of this; death is hovering over his head. ||7||
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  na chayt ai moorh aa sir oopar kaal roo-aa-id aa. ||7||

lines.english: The mind and body are cooled and soothed, holding tight to the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al gur charn ee laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਿਸਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਰੂਆਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Doubt is eliminated from within, and fear runs away.
lines.transliteration: antar bh aram ga-i-aa bh a-o bh aagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: One is in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, and speaking theTrue Word of His Bani. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand sachay gun  gaavahi sach ban ee bolaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: One who knows You as the Architect of Karma,
lines.transliteration: jin too jaat aa karam biDh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sabad  pachh aataa. has the good fortune of perfect destiny, and recognizes the Word of the Guru'sShabad.

lines.english: The Lord, the Truest of the True, is his social class and honor. Conquering his ego, heis united with the Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jat pat  sach sachaa sach so-ee ha-umai maar milaa-id aa. ||9||

lines.english: The stubborn and insensitive mind is attached to the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: man kathor d oojai bh aa-ay laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਤ ਪਿਤ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, the unfortunate wander around in confusion.
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa firai abh aagaa.

lines.english: But if they are blessed by God's Grace, they serve the True Guru, and easily obtain peace. ||10||
lines.transliteration: karam hovai taa sat gur sayvay sehjay hee sukh  paa-id aa. ||10||

lines.english: He Himself created the 8.4 million species of beings.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh aap upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Only in this human life, is devotional worship to the Guru implanted within.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam gur bhagat  drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: Without devotion, one lives in manure; he falls into manure again and again. ||11||
lines.transliteration: bin bhagt ee bistaa vich vaasaa bistaa vich fir paa-id aa. ||11||

lines.english: If one is blessed with His Grace, devotional worship to the Guru is implanted within.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai gur bhagat  drirh -aa-ay.

lines.english: Without God's Grace, how can anyone find Him?
lines.transliteration: vin karmaa ki-o paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; as He wills, he leads us on. ||12||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaa-id aa. ||12||

lines.english: The Simritees and the Shaastras do not know His limits.
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  ant na jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਜਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The blind fool does not recognize the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: moorakh anDh aa tat na pachh aanai.

lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself deludes with doubt. ||13||
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa aapay bh aram bh ulaa-id aa. ||13||

lines.english: He Himself causes everything to be done.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  aapay aap karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: He Himself joins each and every person to his tasks.
lines.transliteration: aapay sir sir DhanDh ai laa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and watches over all; He reveals Himself tothe Gurmukh. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaapay vaykhai gurmukh  aap bujh aa-idaa. ||14||

lines.english: The True Lord and Master is profoundly deep and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib gahir gambheeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Praising Him forever, the mind is comforted and consoled.
lines.transliteration: sadaa salaahee t aa man Dh eeraa.

lines.english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated. He dwells in themind of the Gurmukh. ||15||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paa-ee gurmukh  man vasaa-id aa. ||15||

lines.english: He Himself is detached; all others are entangled in their affairs.
lines.transliteration: aap niraalam hor DhanDh ai lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand Him.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee boojhai ko-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell deep within the heart; through the Guru's Teachings, one is united in His Union. ||16||3||17|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1061-15) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat ant ar gurmat ee mayl milaa-id aa. ||16||3||17||

lines.english: For thirty-six ages, utter darkness prevailed.
lines.transliteration: jug chhat eeh kee-o gubaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Only You Yourself know this, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: too aapay jaan eh sirjan haaraa.

lines.english: What can anyone else say? What can anyone explain? Only You Yourself can estimateYour worth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hor ki-aa ko kahai ke aakh vakh aanai too aapay keemat  paa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: The One Universal Creator created the entire Universe.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar sabh sarisat upaa-ee.

lines.english: All the plays and dramas are to Your glory and greatness.
lines.transliteration: sabh kh ayl tamaasaa t ayree vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਿਕ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself makes all distinctions; He Himself breaks and builds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay vayk karay sabh saachaa aapay bh ann gh arhaa-idaa. ||2||

lines.english: The Juggler has staged His juggling show.
lines.transliteration: baajeegar ik baajee paa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to behold it.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay nad ree aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਸਾਚਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਭੰਿਨ ਘੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who remains forever detached in the Word of the Guru's Shabad - hisconsciousness is attuned to the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa alipat  rahai gur sabd ee saachay si-o chit  laa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: The musical instruments of the body vibrate and resound.
lines.transliteration: baajeh baajay Dhun aakaaraa.

lines.english: The Player Himself plays them.
lines.transliteration: aap vajaa-ay vajaavanhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਸਾਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The breath flows equally through the hearts of each and every being. Receiving the breath, all the instruments sing. ||4|| pMnw 1062
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at pa-un  vahai ik rangee mil pavn ai sabh  vajaa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: Whatever the Creator does, surely comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: kartaa karay so nihcha-o hovai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is consumed.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday ha-umai kh ovai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, some are blessed with glorious greatness; they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee kisai day vadi-aa-ee naamo naam Dh i-aa-id aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਕਸੈ ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: There is no other profit as great as service to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvay jayvad hor laahaa naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਲਾਹਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam abides within my mind, and I praise the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam man vasai naamo saalaahee.

lines.english: The Naam is forever the Giver of peace. Through the Naam, we earn the profit. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naamo naam sadaa sukh -daata naamo laahaa paa-id aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without the Name, all the world suffers in misery.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh d ukh sansaaraa.

lines.english: The more actions one does, the more the corruption increases.
lines.transliteration: baho karam kamaaveh vaDheh vikaaraa.

lines.english: Without serving the Naam, how can anyone find peace? Without the Naam, one suffers in pain. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam na sayveh ki-o sukh paa-ee-ai bin naavai d ukh paa-id aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
lines.transliteration: aap karay tai aap karaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He reveals Himself to a few.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee kisai bujhaa-ay.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh breaks his bonds, and attains the home of liberation. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hoveh say banDh an torheh mukt ee kai gh ar paa-id aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋੜਿਹ ਮੁਕਤੀ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: One who calculates his accounts, burns in the world.
lines.transliteration: ganat  ganai so jalai sansaaraa.

lines.english: His skepticism and corruption are never dispelled.
lines.transliteration: sahsaa mool na chukai vikaaraa.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh abandons his calculations; through Truth, we merge inthe True Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so gan at chukaa-ay sachay sach samaa-id aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਣਤ  ਚੁਕਾਏ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: If God grants Truth, then we may attain it.
lines.transliteration: jay sach day-ay t a paa-ay ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it is revealed.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee pargat ho-ee.

lines.english: One who praises the True Name, and remains imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru'sGrace, finds peace. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sach naam saalaahay rang raataa gur kirpaa t ay sukh  paa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is chanting, meditation, penance and self-control.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam naam pi-aaraa.

lines.english: God, the Destroyer, destroys sins.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh kaatay kaatan haaraa.

lines.english: Through the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and one is intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: har kai naam tan man seet al ho-aa sehjay sahj samaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: With greed within them, their minds are filthy, and they spread filth around.
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  man mailai mal laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਮਿਨ ਮੈਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They do filthy deeds, and suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: mailay karam karay dukh  paa-ay.

lines.english: They deal in falsehood, and nothing but falsehood; telling lies, they suffer in pain.||12||
lines.transliteration: koorho koorh  karay vaapaaraa koorh  bol d ukh paa-id aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Rare is that person who enshrines the Immaculate Bani of the Guru's Word within hismind.
lines.transliteration: nirmal banee ko man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, his skepticism is removed.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sahsaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: He walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, day and night; remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai chalai d in raat ee naam chayt  sukh  paa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਿਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself is the Creator.
lines.transliteration: aap sirandaa sachaa so-ee.

lines.english: He Himself creates and destroys.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay khapaa-ay so-ee.

lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord forever. Meeting the True Lord, he finds peace. ||14||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so sad aa salaahay mil saachay sukh  paa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Making countless efforts, sexual desire is not overcome.
lines.transliteration: anayk jatan karay ind ree vas na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਰੇ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਵਿਸ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Everyone is burning in the fires of sexuality and anger.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh jalai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one brings his mind under control; conquering his mind, hemerges in the Mind of God. ||15||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay man vas aavai man maaray maneh samaa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਸ ਆਵੈ  ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the sense of 'mine' and 'yours.'
lines.transliteration: mayraa tayraa t uDh aapay kee-aa.

lines.english: All creatures are Yours; You created all beings.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayray jant  tayray sabh  jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam forever; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lordabides in the mind. ||16||4||18|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1062-16) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal sadaa t oo gurmat ee man vasaa-id aa. ||16||4||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Giver, inaccessible and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o daat aa agam athaahaa.

lines.english: He does not have even an iota of greed; He is self-sufficient.
lines.transliteration: os til na t amaa-ay vayparvaahaa.

lines.english: No one can reach up to Him; He Himself unites in His Union. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis no aparh  na sakai ko-ee aapay mayl milaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so nihcha-o ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਅਪਿੜ  ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no other Giver, except for Him.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d aataa avar na ko-ee.

lines.english: Whoever the Lord blesses with His gift, obtains it. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He unites him with Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis no naam daan karay so paa-ay gur sabd ee maylaa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: The fourteen worlds are Your markets.
lines.transliteration: cha-odah bh avan tayray hatnaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮੇਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Guru reveals them, along with one's inner being.
lines.transliteration: satgur d ikhaa-ay ant ar naalay.

lines.english: One who deals in the Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, obtains it. ||3|| pMnw 1063
lines.transliteration: naavai kaa vaapaaree hovai gur sabdee ko paa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one obtains intuitive bliss.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvi-ai sahj anand aa.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe comes to dwell within the heart.
lines.transliteration: hirdai aa-ay vuth aa govind aa.

lines.english: He intuitively practices devotional worship day and night; God Himself practices devotional worship. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sehjay bhagat  karay d in raat ee aapay bh agat karaa-id aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who are separated from the True Guru, suffer in misery.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay vichh urhay tinee d ukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Night and day, they are punished, and they suffer in total agony.
lines.transliteration: an-din maaree-ah d ukh sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Their faces are blackened, and they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.They suffer in sorrow and agony. ||5||
lines.transliteration: mathay kaalay mahal na paavahi dukh  hee vich d ukh paa-id aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਥੇ ਕਾਲੇ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say vadbh aagee.

lines.english: They intuitively enshrine love for the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sahj bhaa-ay sachee liv laagee.

lines.english: They practice Truth, forever Truth; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sacho sach kamaaveh sad hee sachai mayl milaa-id aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He alone obtains the Truth, unto whom the True Lord gives it.
lines.transliteration: jis no sachaa day-ay so paa-ay.

lines.english: His inner being is filled with Truth, and his doubt is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: antar saach bh aram chukaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of Truth; he alone obtains the Truth, unto whom He gives it. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sach sachai kaa aapay daat aa jis d ayvai so sach paa-id aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਾ ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator of all.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa sabh naa kaa so-ee.

lines.english: Only one whom He instructs, understands Him.
lines.transliteration: jis no aap bujhaa-ay boojh ai ko-ee.

lines.english: He Himself forgives, and grants glorious greatness. He himself unites in His Union.||8||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay d ay vadi-aa-ee aapay mayl milaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Acting egotistically, one loses his life.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai kardi-aa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Even in the world hereafter, emotioal attachment to Maya does not leave him.
lines.transliteration: aagai moh na chookai maa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the world hereafter, the Messenger of Death calls him to account, and crushes himlike sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||9||
lines.transliteration: agai jamkaal laykhaa layvai ji-o t il ghaanee peerh aa-idaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਿਜਉ ਿਤਲ  ਘਾਣੀ  ਪੀੜਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: By perfect destiny, one serves the Guru.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sayvaa ho-ee.

lines.english: If God grants His Grace, then one serves.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aa sayvay ko-ee.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot even approach him, and in the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence, he finds peace. ||10||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal tis nayrh  na aavai mahal sachai sukh  paa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: They alone find peace, who are pleasing to Your Will.
lines.transliteration: tin sukh  paa-i-aa jo t uDh bhaa-ay.

lines.english: By perfect destiny, they are attached to the Guru's service.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.english: All glorious greatness rests in Your Hands; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it.||11||
lines.transliteration: tayrai hath hai sabh  vadi-aa-ee jis d ayveh so paa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਿਥ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru, one's inner being is enlightened and illumined.
lines.transliteration: andar pargaas guroo t ay paa-ay.

lines.english: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath man vasaa-ay.

lines.english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom ever illumines the heart, and the darkness of spiritualignorance is dispelled. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan ratan sad aa gh at chaanan  agi-aan anDh ayr gavaa-id aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The blind and ignorant are attached to duality.
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee anDhay d oojai laagay.

lines.english: The unfortunates are drowned without water, and die.
lines.transliteration: bin paanee dub moo-ay abh aagay.

lines.english: When they depart from the world, they do not find the Lord's door and home; bound and gagged at Death's door, they suffer in pain. ||13||
lines.transliteration: chaldi-aa gh ar dar nad ar na aavai jam d ar baaDh aa dukh paa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਿਦਆ  ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਬਾਧਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay mukat  na ho-ee.

lines.english: Go ask any spiritual teacher or meditator.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee Dhi-aanee poochh ahu ko-ee.

lines.english: Whoever serves the True Guru is blessed with glorious greatness, and honored in theCourt of the True Lord. ||14||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t is milai vadi-aa-ee d ar sachai sobh aa paa-id aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਦਿਰ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: One who serves the True Guru, the Lord merges into Himself.
lines.transliteration: satgur no sayvay t is aap milaa-ay.

lines.english: Cutting away attachment, one lovingly focuses on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: mamtaa kaat sach liv laa-ay.

lines.english: The merchants deal forever in Truth; they earn the profit of the Naam. ||15||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach van jahi vaapaaree naamo laahaa paa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਿਹ  ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa.

lines.english: He alone is liberated, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai so-ee jan mukt aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the mind; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||5||19|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1063-17) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar naamo naam Dh i-aa-id aa. ||16||5||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Whatever You do, is done.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  karnaa so kar paa-i-aa.

lines.english: How rare are those who walk in harmony with the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ay vich ko virlaa aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੋ ਕਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will finds peace; he finds peace in the Lord's Will.||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaan aa mannay so sukh  paa-ay bh aanay vich sukh  paa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: Your Will is pleasing to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t ayraa bh aanaa bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Practicing Truth, he intuitively finds peace.
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee sukh sach kamaavai.

lines.english: Many long to walk in harmony with the Lord's Will; He Himself inspires us to surrenderto His Will. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhaan ay no lochai bahut ayree aapn aa bh aanaa aap manaa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: One who surrenders to Your Will, meets with You, Lord. pMnw 1064
lines.transliteration: tayraa bh aanaa mannay so milai t uDh aa-ay.

lines.english: One who is pleased with Your Will is immersed in You.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaan aa bh aavai so t ujheh samaa-ay.

lines.english: Glorious greatness rests in God's Will; rare are those who accept it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaan ay vich vadee vadi-aa-ee bh aanaa kiseh karaa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: When it pleases His Will, He leads us to meet the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavai t aa guroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh finds the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam pad aarath paa-ay.

lines.english: By Your Will, You created the whole Universe; those whom You bless with Your favor are pleased with Your Will. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapn ai bhaanai sabh  sarisat upaa-ee jis no bh aanaa deh tis bhaa-idaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਣਾ  ਦੇਿਹ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs practice cleverness.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh  karay chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: They do not surrender to the Lord's Will, and suffer terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: bhaan aa na mannay bahut  dukh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣਾ  ਨ ਮੰਨੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Deluded by doubt, they come and go in reincarnation; they never find the Mansion ofthe Lord's Presence. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bharmay bh oolaa aavai jaa-ay gh ar mahal na kabhoo paa-id aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੇ  ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਏ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The True Guru brings Union, and grants glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: satgur maylay d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: The Primal Lord ordained service to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa Dh ur furmaa-ee.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is obtained. Through the Naam, one finds peace. ||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa naam paa-ay naamay hee sukh  paa-id aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Everything wells up from the Naam, and through the Naam, perishes.
lines.transliteration: sabh naavhu upjai naavhu chh eejai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the mind and body are pleased with the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay man t an bh eejai.

lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the tongue is drenched with the Lord's sublime essence.Through this essence, the Essence is obtained. ||7||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa naam Dhi-aa-ay ras bh eejai ras hee t ay ras paa-id aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਰਿਸ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਸ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Rare are those who find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the mansion oftheir own body.
lines.transliteration: mahlai andar mahal ko paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they lovingly focus their consciousness onthe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sach chit  laa-ay.

lines.english: Whoever the Lord blesses with Truth obtains Truth; he merges in Truth, and onlyTruth. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jis no sach day-ay so-ee sach paa-ay sachay sach milaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: naam visaar man tan d ukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Attached to the love of Maya, he earns nothing but disease.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabh rog kamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Name, his mind and body are afflicted with leprosy, and he obtains his home in hell. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai man tan hai kustee narkay vaasaa paa-id aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ  ਨਰਕੇ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Naam - their bodies are immaculate and pure.
