lines.transliteration: naam ratay t in nirmal d ayhaa.

lines.english: Their soul-swan is immaculate, and in the Lord's Love, they find eternal peace.
lines.transliteration: nirmal hansaa sadaa sukh  nayhaa.

lines.english: Praising the Naam, they find eternal peace, and dwell in the home of their own innerbeing. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naam salaahi sadaa sukh  paa-i-aa nij gh ar vaasaa paa-id aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Everyone deals and trades.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko van aj karay vaapaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Name, all the world loses.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh  totaa sansaaraa.

lines.english: Naked they come, and naked they go; without the Name, they suffer in pain. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naago aa-i-aa naago jaasee vin naavai d ukh paa-id aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਗੋ  ਆਇਆ  ਨਾਗੋ  ਜਾਸੀ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He alone obtains the Naam, unto whom the Lord gives it.
lines.transliteration: jis no naam day-ay so paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Naam dwells deep within the heart, and one meditates upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay naam vasi-aa gh at ant ar naamo naam Dh i-aa-id aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Everyone who comes into the world, longs for the Name.
lines.transliteration: naavai no lochai jaytee sabh  aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੇਤੀ  ਸਭ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are blessed with the Name, whose past actions were so ordained by thePrimal Lord.
lines.transliteration: naa-o tinaa milai Dh ur purab kamaa-ee.

lines.english: Those who obtain the Name are very fortunate. Through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, they are united with God. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jinee naa-o paa-i-aa say vadbhaagee gur kai sabad  milaa-id aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Utterly incomparable is the fortress of the body.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kot at apaaraa.

lines.english: Within it, God sits in contemplation.
lines.transliteration: tis vich bahi parabh  karay veechaaraa.

lines.english: He administers true justice, and trades in Truth; through Him, one finds the eternal,unchanging dwelling. ||14||
lines.transliteration: sachaa ni-aa-o sacho vaapaaraa nihchal vaasaa paa-idaa. ||14||

lines.english: Deep within the inner self are glorious homes and beautiful places.
lines.transliteration: antar gh ar bankay thaan suhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: But rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, finds these places.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlai kinai thaan paa-i-aa.

lines.english: If one stays in these places, and praises the True Lord, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||15||
lines.transliteration: it saath nibhai saalaahay sachay har sachaa man vasaa-id aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਸਾਿਥ  ਿਨਬਹੈ  ਸਾਲਾਹੇ  ਸਚੇ ਹਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: My Creator Lord has formed this formation.
lines.transliteration: mayrai kartai ik ban at banaa-ee.

lines.english: He has placed everything within this body.
lines.transliteration: is dayhee vich sabh  vath paa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who deal in the Naam are imbued with His Love. The Gurmukhobtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||6||20|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1064-18) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vanjahi rang raat ay gurmukh  ko naam paa-id aa. ||16||6||20||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜਿਹ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੬॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, the body becomes golden.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kanchan sabad veechaaraa.

lines.english: The Lord abides there; He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: tithai har vasai jis d aa ant  na paaraavaaraa.

lines.english: Night and day, serve the Lord, and chant the True Word of the Guru's Bani. Through the Shabad, meet the Dear Lord. ||1|| pMnw 1065
lines.transliteration: an-din har sayvihu sachee ban ee har jee-o sabad  milaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who remember the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har cheeteh t in balihaarai jaa-o.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I unite in Union with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad t in mayl milaa-o.

lines.english: I touch the dust of their feet to my face and forehead; sitting in the Society of the Saints, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kee Dh oor laa-ee mukh  mast ak sat sangat  bahi gun  gaa-id aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਲਾਈ  ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਬਿਹ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, as I am pleasing to the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har kay gun gaavaa jay har parabh  bhaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: With the Lord's Name deep within my inner being, I am adorned with the Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: antar har naam sabad  suhaavaa.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Bani is heard throughout the four corners of the world;through it, we merge in the True Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee chahu kundee sun ee-ai saachai naam samaa-id aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That humble being, who searches within himself, through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, sees the Lord with his eyes.
lines.transliteration: so jan saachaa je antar bh aalay. gur kai sabad  har nad ar nihaalay.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Shabad, he applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes; the Gracious Lord, in His Grace, unites him with Himself. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan paa-ay gur sabdee nad ree nad ar milaa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: By great good fortune, I obtained this body;
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag ih sareer paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam sabad  chit laa-i-aa. in this human life, I have focused my consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, everything is enveloped in utter darkness; only the Gurmukhunderstands. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai sabh  anDh  anDh ayraa gurmukh  kiseh bujh aa-idaa. ||5||

lines.english: Some merely waste away their lives - why have they even come into the world?
lines.transliteration: ik kit aa-ay janam gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਕਸਿਹ  ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh laagay d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: This opportunity shall not into their hands again; their foot slips, and they come toregret and repent. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ayh vaylaa fir haath na aavai pag khisi-ai pachh utaa-idaa. ||6||

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body is sanctified.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad pavit ar sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਪਿਗ  ਿਖਿਸਐ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The True Lord, the ocean of virtue, dwells within it.
lines.transliteration: tis vich vasai sach gun ee gaheeraa.

lines.english: One who sees the Truest of the True everywhere, hears the Truth, and enshrines it within his mind. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sacho sach vaykhai sabh  thaa-ee sach sun  man vasaa-id aa. ||7||

lines.english: Egotism and mental calculations are relieved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai ganat  gur sabad  nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਸਚੁ ਸੁਿਣ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Keep the Dear Lord close, and enshrine Him in your heart.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o hirdai rakh ahu ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: One who praises the Lord forever, through the Guru's Shabad, meets with the TrueLord, and finds peace. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad aa saalaahay mil saachay sukh  paa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: He alone remembers the Lord, whom the Lord inspires to remember.
lines.transliteration: so chaytay jis aap chayt aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: He Himself sees, and He Himself understands; He merges all into Himself. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai aapay boojh ai aapai aap samaa-id aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: He alone knows, who has placed the object within his mind.
lines.transliteration: jin man vich vath paa-ee so-ee jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ  ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday aap pachh aanai.

lines.english: That humble being who understands himself is immaculate. He proclaims the Guru's Bani, and the Word of the Shabad. ||10||
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai so-ee jan nirmal ban ee sabad  sunaa-idaa. ||10||

lines.english: This body is sanctified and purified;
lines.transliteration: ayh kaa-i-aa pavit hai sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee chayt ai gun ee gaheer. through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it contemplates the Lord, the ocean of virtue.

lines.english: One who chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord night and day, and remains attunedto His Love, chants His Glorious Virtues, immersed in the Glorious Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavai rang raat aa gun  kahi gun ee samaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.english: This body is the source of all Maya;
lines.transliteration: ayhu sareer sabh mool hai maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਗੁਣ ਕਿਹ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa. in love with duality, it is deluded by doubt.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: It does not remember the Lord, and suffers in eternal pain. Without remembering the Lord, it suffers in pain. ||12||
lines.transliteration: har na chaytai sad aa dukh paa-ay bin har chayt ay dukh paa-id aa. ||12||

lines.english: One who serves the True Guru is approved and respected.
lines.transliteration: je satgur sayvay so parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਚੇਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: His body and soul-swan are immaculate and pure; in the Court of the Lord, he isknown to be true.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa hans nirmal dar sachai jaan .

lines.english: He serves the Lord, and enshrines the Lord in his mind; he is exalted, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||13||
lines.transliteration: har sayvay har man vasaa-ay sohai har gun gaa-id aa. ||13||

lines.english: Without good destiny, no one can serve the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur sayvi-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ਸੋਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, and die weeping and wailing.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay mu-ay billaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who are blessed by the Guru's Glance of Grace - the Dear Lord unites themwith Himself. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o nadar hovai gur kayree har jee-o aap milaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.english: In the body fortress, are the solidly-constructed markets.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kot pakay hatnaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh purchases the object, and takes care of it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh layvai vasat  samaalay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, day and night, he attains the sublime, exaltedstatus. ||15||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam Dhi-aa-ay d in raat ee oot am pad vee paa-id aa. ||15||

lines.english: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: aapay sachaa hai sukh-d aata.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਊਤਮ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kai sabad pachh aataa.

lines.english: Nanak praises the Naam, the True Name of the Lord; through perfect destiny, He is found. ||16||7||21|| pMnw 1066 mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1066-1) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahay saachaa poorai bhaag ko paa-id aa. ||16||7||21||

lines.english: The Formless Lord created the universe of form.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar aakaar upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He created attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh hukam banaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; hearing of the True Lord, enshrine Him inyour mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay khayl karay sabh  kartaa sun  saachaa man vasaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: Maya, the mother, gave birth to the three gunas, the three qualities,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa maa-ee tarai gun  parsoot  jamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਭ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chaaray bayd barahmay no furmaa-i-aa. and proclaimed the four Vedas to Brahma.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਾਈ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਸੂਿਤ  ਜਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Creating the years, months, days and dates, He infused intelligence into the world.||2||
lines.transliteration: varHay maah vaar thitee kar is jag meh sojh ee paa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: Service to the Guru is the most excellent action.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay karn ee saar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰੇ ਮਾਹ ਵਾਰ ਿਥਤੀ  ਕਿਰ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.
lines.transliteration: raam naam raakho ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Bani prevails throughout the world; through this Bani, the Lord's Name is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee vart ee jag ant ar is ban ee tay har naam paa-id aa. ||3||

lines.english: He reads the Vedas, but he starts arguments night and day.
lines.transliteration: vayd parh ai an-d in vaad  samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਵਰਤੀ  ਜਗ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਇਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is bound and gagged bythe Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: naam na chaytai baDh aa jamkaalay.

lines.english: In the love of duality, he suffers in pain forever; he is deluded by doubt, and confusedby the three gunas. ||4||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay sad aa dukh paa-ay t arai gun  bharam bh ulaa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is in love with the One Lord alone;
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aykas si-o liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  mansaa maneh samaa-ay. he submerges in his mind the three-phased desire.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he is liberated forever; he renouncesemotional attachment to Maya. ||5||
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad sad aa hai mukt aa maa-i-aa moh chukaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: Those who are so pre-ordained to be imbued, are imbued with love for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur raat ay say hun  raatay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively intoxicated.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sehjay maatay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਿਣ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru forever, they find God; He Himself unites them with Himself. ||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa parabh  paa-i-aa aapai aap milaa-id aa. ||6||

lines.english: In attachment to Maya and doubt, the Lord is not found.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi bharam na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Attached to the love of duality, one suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay lagaa d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: The crimson color lasts for only a few days; all too soon, it fades away. ||7||
lines.transliteration: soohaa rang din thorh ay hovai is jaad ay bilam na laa-id aa. ||7||

lines.english: So color this mind in the Fear and the Love of God.
lines.transliteration: ayhu man bhai bh aa-ay rangaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਿਦਨ  ਥੋੜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ  ਿਬਲਮ  ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Dyed in this color, one merges in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: it rang saachay maahi samaa-ay.

lines.english: By perfect destiny, some may obtain this color. Through the Guru's Teachings, this color is applied. ||8||
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag ko ih rang paa-ay gurmat ee rang charh aa-idaa. ||8||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs take great pride in themselves.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bahut  karay abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In the Court of the Lord, they are never honored.
lines.transliteration: dargeh kab hee na paavai maan.

lines.english: Attached to duality, they waste their lives; without understanding, they suffer in pain. ||9||
lines.transliteration: doojai laagay janam gavaa-i-aa bin boojh ay dukh paa-id aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਗਹ  ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: My God has hidden Himself deep within the self.
lines.transliteration: mayrai parabh and ar aap lukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one is united in the Lord's Union.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har milai milaa-i-aa.

lines.english: God is True, and True is His trade, through which the priceless Naam is obtained.||10||
lines.transliteration: sachaa parabh sachaa vaapaaraa naam amolak paa-id aa. ||10||

lines.english: No one has found this body's value.
lines.transliteration: is kaa-i-aa kee keemat kinai na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master has worked His handiwork.
lines.transliteration: mayrai thaakur ih ban at banaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh purifies his body, and then the Lord unites him withHimself. ||11||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so kaa-i-aa soDh ai aapeh aap milaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.english: Within the body, one loses, and within the body, one wins.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa vich totaa kaa-i-aa vich laahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ  ਸੋਧੈ ਆਪਿਹ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh seeks the self-sustaining Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kh ojay vayparvaahaa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh trades, and finds peace forever; he intuitively merges in the Celestial Lord. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh van aj sad aa sukh  paa-ay sehjay sahj milaa-id aa. ||12||

lines.english: True is the Lord's Mansion, and True is His treasure.
lines.transliteration: sachaa mahal sachay bhandaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਣਿਜ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ ਿਮਲਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Great Giver Himself gives.
lines.transliteration: aapay dayvai d ayvan haaraa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh praises the Giver of peace; his mind is united with the Lord, and hecomes to know His worth. ||13||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saalaahay sukh -daatay man maylay keemat  paa-id aa. ||13||

lines.english: Within the body is the object; its value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa vich vasat keemat  nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਲਾਹੇ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਮਿਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aapay d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: He alone knows this object, to whom this store belongs; the Gurmukh is blessed withit, and does not come to regret. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jis daa hat so-ee vath jaan ai gurmukh  day-ay na pachh otaa-idaa. ||14||

lines.english: The Dear Lord is pervading and permeating all.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sabh meh rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is found.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-i-aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself unites in His Union; through the Word of the Shabad, one intuitivelymerges with Him. ||15|| pMnw 1067
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl milaa-ay aapay sabday sahj samaa-id aa. ||15||

lines.english: The True Lord Himself unites us in the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay sachaa sabad milaa-ay.

lines.english: Within the Shabad, doubt is driven out.
lines.transliteration: sabday vichahu bh aram chukaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੮॥੨੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He blesses us with His Naam, and throgh the Naam, peace is found. ||16||8||22|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1067-2) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee naamay hee sukh paa-id aa. ||16||8||22||

lines.english: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sustaining.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar vayparvaahay.

lines.english: He Himself is merciful, inaccessible and unlimited.
lines.transliteration: aapay miharvaan agam athaahay.

lines.english: No one can reach up to Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is met. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aparh ko-ay na sakai t is no gur sabd ee maylaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਿੜ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮੇਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone serves You, who pleases You.
lines.transliteration: tuDhuno sayveh jo t uDh bhaaveh.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday sach samaaveh.

lines.english: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Praises, day and night; his tongue savors and delights in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  raveh d in raat ee rasnaa har ras bh aa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who die in the Shabad - their death is exalted and glorified.
lines.transliteration: sabad mareh say maran  savaareh.

lines.english: They enshrine the Lord's Glories in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: har kay gun hird ai ur Dh aareh.

lines.english: Holding tight to the Guru's feet, their lives becomes prosperous, and they are rid ofthe love of duality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam safal har charnee laagay d oojaa bh aa-o chukaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord unites them in Union with Himself.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o maylay aap milaa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Shabad, self-conceit is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who remain attuned to devotional worship to the Lord, night and day, earn the profit in this world. ||4||
lines.transliteration: an-din sad aa har bh agtee raat ay is jag meh laahaa paa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਲਾਹਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I describe? I cannot describe them.
lines.transliteration: tayray gun  kahaa mai kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You have no end or limitation. Your value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: ant na paaraa keemat  nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When the Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, the virtuous are absorbed invirtue. ||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay da-i-aa karay sukh -daata gun  meh gun ee samaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: In this world, emotional attachment is spread all over.
lines.transliteration: is jag meh moh hai paasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh is immersed in utter darkness.
lines.transliteration: manmukh agi-aanee anDh  anDh aaraa.

lines.english: DhanDh ai Dhaavat  janam gavaa-i-aa bin naavai d ukh paa-i-aa. ||6|| Chasing after worldly affairs, he wastes away his life in vain; without the Name, hesuffers in pain. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: If God grants His Grace, then one finds the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai taa sat gur paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the filth of egotism is burned away.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mail sabad jalaa-ay.

lines.english: The mind becomes immaculate, and the jewel of spiritual wisdom brings enlightenment; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||7||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal gi-aan ratan chaanan  agi-aan anDh ayr gavaa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Your Names are countless; Your value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: tayray naam anayk keemat  nahee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I enshrine the Lord's True Name within my heart.
lines.transliteration: sach naam har hirdai vasaa-ee.

lines.english: Who can estimate Your value, God? You are immersed and absorbed in Yourself. ||8||
lines.transliteration: keemat ka-un  karay parabh  tayree t oo aapay sahj samaa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: naam amolak agam apaaraa.

lines.english: No one can weigh it.
lines.transliteration: naa ko ho-aa tolan haaraa.

lines.english: You Yourself weigh, and estimate all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, Youunite, when the weight is perfect. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aapay tolay t ol tolaa-ay gur sabd ee mayl t olaa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਿਲ  ਤੋਲਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮੇਿਲ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Your servant serves, and offers this prayer.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayveh karahi ardaas.

lines.english: Please, let me sit near You, and unite me with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: too aapay mayl bahaaleh paas.

lines.english: You are the Giver of peace to all beings; by perfect karma, we meditate on You. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa jee-aa kaa sukh -daata poorai karam Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Chastity, truth and self-control come by practicing and living the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  sanjam je sach kamaavai.

lines.english: This mind becomes immaculate and pure, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih man nirmal je har gun gaavai.

lines.english: In this world of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, if it pleases my Dear Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: is bikh meh amrit  paraapat  hovai har jee-o mayray bh aa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਿਬਖੁ ਮਿਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He alone understands, whom God inspires to understand.
lines.transliteration: jis no bujhaa-ay so-ee boojh ai.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one's inner being is awakened.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai and ar soojh ai.

lines.english: Egotism and possessiveness are silenced and subdued, and one intuitively finds theTrue Lord. ||12||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa thaak rahaa-ay sehjay hee sach paa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਹਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Without good karma, countless others wander around.
lines.transliteration: bin karmaa hor firai ghanayree.

lines.english: They die, and die again, only to be reborn; they cannot escape the cycle ofreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: mar mar jammai chukai na fayree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with poison, they practice poison and corruption, and they never find peace. ||13||
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa raat aa bikh  kamaavai sukh  na kabhoo paa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਕਾ ਰਾਤਾ ਿਬਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Many disguise themselves with religious robes.
lines.transliteration: bahutay bh aykh karay bh aykh-Dhaaree.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, no one has conquered egotism.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai ha-umai kinai na maaree.

lines.english: One who remains dead while yet alive is liberated, and merges in the True Name.||14||
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai t aa mukat  paa-ay sachai naa-ay samaa-i-aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਤੁ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Spiritual ignorance and desire burn this human body. pMnw 1068
lines.transliteration: agi-aan tarisnaa is t aneh jalaa-ay.

lines.english: He alone puts out this fire, who practices and lives the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tis dee boojh ai je gur sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: His body and mind are cooled and soothed, and his anger is silenced; conquering egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||15||
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al kroDh  nivaaray ha-umai maar samaa-i-aa. ||15||

lines.english: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few attain this.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee virlai paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, may I mergein the Lord. ||16||1||23|| mwrU mhlw 3 ] (1068-3) maaroo mehlaa 3. Maaroo, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayk kahai baynantee naamay naam samaa-i-aa. ||16||1||23||

lines.english: By Your Grace, please unite with Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: nadree bh agtaa laihu milaa-ay.

lines.english: Your devotees ever praise You, lovingly focusing on You.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  salaahan sad aa liv laa-ay.

lines.english: In Your Sanctuary, they are saved, O Creator Lord; You unite them in Union withYourself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ta-o sarn aa-ee ubrahi kart ay aapay mayl milaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਉਬਰਿਹ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sublime and exalted is devotion to the Perfect Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: poorai sabad bh agat suhaa-ee.

lines.english: Peace prevails within; they are pleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: antar sukh  tayrai man bh aa-ee.

lines.english: One whose mind and body are imbued with true devotion, focuses his consciousnesson the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man tan sachee bh agtee raat aa sachay si-o chit  laa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਚੇ ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In egotism, the body is forever burning.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich sad jalai sareeraa.

lines.english: When God grants His Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai bhaytay gur pooraa.

lines.english: The Shabad dispels the spiritual ignorance within, and through the True Guru, one finds peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: antar agi-aan sabad  bujhaa-ay sat gur tay sukh  paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukh acts blindly.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh aa anDh  kamaa-ay.

lines.english: He is in terrible trouble, and wanders in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: baho sankat jonee bharmaa-ay.

lines.english: He can never snap the noose of Death, and in the end, he suffers in horrible pain.||4||
lines.transliteration: jam kaa jayvrhaa kad ay na kaatai ant ay baho d ukh paa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa sabad  nivaaray.

lines.english: He keeps the True Name enshrined within his heart.
lines.transliteration: sach naam rakhai ur Dh aaray.

lines.english: He dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and conquers his mind; stilling his egotism,he merges in the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad marai man maaray ha-umai jaa-ay samaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Coming and going, the people of the world are wasting away.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan ai paraj vigo-ee.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one finds permanence and stability.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur thir ko-ay na ho-ee.

lines.english: The Shabad shines its Light deep within the self, and one dwells in peace; one's light merges into the Light. ||6||
lines.transliteration: antar jot  sabad  sukh  vasi-aa jot ee jot  milaa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ ਜੋਿਤ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The five demons think of evil and corruption.
lines.transliteration: panch doot  chitvahi vikaaraa.

lines.english: The expanse is the manifestation of emotional attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh kaa ayhu pasaaraa.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, one is liberated, and the five demons are put under hiscontrol. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa mukat  hovai panch d oot vas aa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਿਸ ਆਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, there is only the darkness of attachment.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo hai moh gubaaraa.

lines.english: Over and over, time and time again, they are drowned.
lines.transliteration: fir fir dubai vaaro vaaraa.

lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is implanted within, and the True Name becomespleasing to the mind. ||8||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay sach drirh -aa-ay sach naam man bh aa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੇਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: True is His Door, and True is His Court, His Royal Darbaar.
lines.transliteration: saachaa dar saachaa d arvaaraa.

lines.english: The true ones serve Him, through the Beloved Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachay sayveh sabad pi-aaraa.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, in the true melody, I am immersed and absorbed in Truth. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sachee Dhun sachay gun  gaavaa sachay maahi samaa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਧੁਿਨ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਸਚੇ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Deep within the home of the self, one finds the home of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gharai and ar ko gh ar paa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one easily, intuitively finds it.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: There, one is not afflicted with sorrow or separation; merge into the Celestial Lordwith intuitive ease. ||10||
lines.transliteration: othai sog vijog na vi-aapai sehjay sahj samaa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ਨ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The evil people live in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay d ustaa kaa vaasaa.

lines.english: They wander around, totally attached and thirsty.
lines.transliteration: bha-ud ay fireh baho moh pi-aasaa.

lines.english: They sit in evil gatherings, and suffer in pain forever; they earn pain, nothing butpain. ||11||
lines.transliteration: kusangat baheh sad aa dukh paavahi d ukho dukh kamaa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਸੰਗਿਤ  ਬਹਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is no Sangat, no Congregation.
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu sangat  na ho-ee.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, no one can cross over to the other side.
lines.transliteration: bin sabday paar na paa-ay ko-ee.

lines.english: One who intuitively chants God's Glorious Praises day and night - his light merges into the Light. ||12||
lines.transliteration: sehjay gun raveh d in raat ee jot ee jot  milaa-i-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The body is the tree; the bird of the soul dwells within it.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa birakh pankh ee vich vaasaa.

lines.english: It drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, resting in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: amrit chugeh gur sabad  nivaasaa.

lines.english: It never flies away, and it does not come or go; it dwells within the home of its ownself. ||13||
lines.transliteration: udeh na moolay na aavahi na jaahee nij gh ar vaasaa paa-i-aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਉਡਿਹ  ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Purify the body, and contemplate the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa soDheh sabad  vichaareh.

lines.english: Remove the poisonous drug of emotional attachment, and eradicate doubt.
lines.transliteration: moh thag-uree bh aram nivaareh.

lines.english: The Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, and unites us in Union with Himself. ||14|| pMnw 1069
lines.transliteration: aapay kirpaa karay sukh-d aata aapay mayl milaa-i-aa. ||14||

lines.english: He is always near at hand; He is never far away.
lines.transliteration: sad hee nayrh ai door na jaan hu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, realize that He is very near.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad najeek pachh aanhu.

lines.english: Your heart-lotus shall blossom forth, and the ray of God's Divine Light shall illuminate your heart; He shall be revealed to You. ||15||
lines.transliteration: bigsai kamal kiran pargaasai pargat kar d aykhaa-i-aa. ||15||

lines.english: The True Lord is Himself the Creator.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa sachaa so-ee.

lines.english: He Himself kills, and gives life; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: aapay maar jeevaalay avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਾਲੇ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, glorious greatness is obtained.Eradicating self-conceit, peace is found. ||16||2||24|| mwrU solhy mhlw 4  (1069-4) maaroo solhay mehlaa 4 Maaroo, Solahas, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1069-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee aap gavaa-ay sukh paa-i-aa. ||16||2||24||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੬॥੨॥੨੪॥
lines.english: The Lord Lord Himself is the One who exalts and embellishes.
lines.transliteration: sachaa aap savaaranhaaraa.

lines.english: Do not consider any other work.
lines.transliteration: avar na soojhas beejee kaaraa.

lines.english: The True Lord abides deep within the heart of the Gurmukh, who intuitively merges in the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach vasai gh at ant ar sehjay sach samaa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: The True Lord dwells within the minds of all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa sach vasai man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively absorbed in Him.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sahj samaahee.

lines.english: Calling out, "Guru, Guru", I have found eternal peace; my consciousness is focused on the Guru's feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur gur karat sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa gur charn ee chit  laa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: The True Guru is spiritual wisdom; the True Guru is worship and adoration.
lines.transliteration: satgur hai gi-aan sat gur hai poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I serve the True Guru, and no other.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvee avar na d oojaa.

lines.english: From the True Guru, I have obtained the wealth, the jewel of the Naam. Service tothe True Guru is pleasing to me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay naam rat an Dh an paa-i-aa sat gur kee sayvaa bh aa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: Without the True Guru, those who are attached to duality
lines.transliteration: bin satgur jo d oojai laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ  ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaahi bharam mareh abh aagay. come and go, and wander in reincarnation; these unfortunate ones die.

lines.english: O Nanak, even after they are emancipated, those who become Gurmukh remain in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kee fir gat  hovai je gurmukh  raheh sarn aa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.english: The love of the Gurmukh is forever true.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pareet  sadaa hai saachee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: I beg for the invaluable Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay maaga-o naam ajaachee.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, please be kind, and grant Your Grace; please keep me in the Guru'sSanctuary. ||5||
lines.transliteration: hohu da-i-aal kirpaa kar har jee-o rakh  layvhu gur sarn aa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.english: The True Guru trickles the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth.
lines.transliteration: amrit ras sat guroo chu-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: My Tenth Gate has been opened and revealed.
lines.transliteration: dasvai d u-aar pargat ho-ay aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds there, with themelody of the Guru's Bani; one is easily, intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tah anhad  sabad  vajeh Dh un ban ee sehjay sahj samaa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.english: Those who are so pre-ordained by the Creator,
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o kartai Dh ur likh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਵਜਿਹ  ਧੁਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: an-din gur gur karat  vihaa-ee. pass their nights and days calling on the Guru.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one understands; focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur ko seejh ai naahee gur charn ee chit  laa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.english: The Lord Himself blesses those with whom He is pleased.
lines.transliteration: jis bhaavai t is aapay d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੋ ਸੀਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh receives the wealth of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam pad aarath lay-ay.

lines.english: When the Lord grants His Grace, He bestows the Naam; Nanak is immersed andabsorbed in the Naam. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aapay kirpaa karay naam dayvai naanak naam samaa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed within the mind.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan ratan man pargat bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Naam is easily, intuitively received.
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath sehjay la-i-aa.

lines.english: This glorious greatness is obtained from the Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to the TrueGuru. ||9||
lines.transliteration: ayh vadi-aa-ee gur tay paa-ee sat gur ka-o sad  bal jaa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.english: With the rising of the sun, the darkness of the night is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: pargati-aa soor nis miti-aa anDhi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Spiritual ignorance is eradicated, by the priceless jewel of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan miti-aa gur ratan apaaraa.

lines.english: The True Guru is the fantastically valuable jewel of spiritual wisdom; blessed by God's Mercy, peace is found. ||10||
lines.transliteration: satgur gi-aan rat an at bhaaree karam milai sukh  paa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, and his good reputation increases.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam pargatee hai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: In all four ages he is considered to be pure and good.
lines.transliteration: chahu jug nirmal hachhaa lo-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. He remains lovinglyfocused on the Naam. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naamay naam ratay sukh  paa-i-aa naam rahi-aa liv laa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.english: The Gurmukh receives the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam paraapat  hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: In intuitive peace he wakes, and in intuitive peace he sleeps. pMnw 1070
lines.transliteration: sehjay jaagai sehjay sovai.

lines.english: The Gurmukh is immersed and absorbed in the Naam; Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam samaa-ay samaavai naanak naam Dh i-aa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Bani is in the mouth of the devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa mukh  amrit  hai ban ee.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs chant and repeat the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har naam aakh  vakh aanee.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds forever blossom forth; they focus their minds on the Lord's Feet. ||13||
lines.transliteration: har har karat sad aa man bigsai har charn ee man laa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਰਤ  ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: I am foolish and ignorant; I have no wisdom at all.
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh agi-aan gi-aan kichh  naahee.

lines.english: From the True Guru, I have obtained understanding in my mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay samajh  parhee man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਸਮਝ  ਪੜੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, please be kind to me, and grant Your Grace; let me be committed toserving the True Guru. ||14||
lines.transliteration: hohu da-i-aal kirpaa kar har jee-o sat gur kee sayvaa laa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Those who know the True Guru realize the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin satgur jaat aa tin ayk pachh aataa.

lines.english: The Giver of peace is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sarbay rav rahi-aa sukh-d aata.

lines.english: Understanding my own soul, I have obtained the Supreme Status; my awareness isimmersed in selfless service. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aatam cheen param pad  paa-i-aa sayvaa surat  samaa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with glorious greatness by the Primal Lord God
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o aad milee vadi-aa-ee.
satgur man vasi-aa liv laa-ee. are lovingly focused on the True Guru, who dwells within their minds.

lines.english: The Giver of life to the world Himself meets them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in His Being. ||16||1|| mwrU mhlw 4 ] (1070-7) maaroo mehlaa 4. Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap mili-aa jagjeevan daat aa naanak ank samaa-ee hay. ||16||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਕ ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable; He is eternal and imperishable.
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar sadaa abh inaasee.

lines.english: He dwells in the heart, and is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sarbay rav rahi-aa ghat vaasee.

lines.english: There is no other Giver except Him; worship the Lord, O mortals. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis bin avar na ko-ee d aataa har t iseh sarayvhu paraan ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: No one can kill anyone who is saved by the Savior Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o raakhai har raakh anhaaraa. t aa ka-o ko-ay na saakas maaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: So serve such a Lord, O Saints, whose Bani is exalted and sublime. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so aisaa har sayvhu santahu jaa kee oot am ban ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: When it seems that a place is empty and void,
lines.transliteration: jaa jaapai kichh kithaa-oo naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕਿਸ  ਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kart aa bh arpoor samaahee. there, the Creator Lord is permeating and pervading.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He causes the dried-up branch to blossom forth in greenery again; so meditate on the Lord - wondrous are His ways! ||3||
lines.transliteration: sookay tay fun hari-aa keet on har Dh i-aavahu choj vidaan ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: The One who knows the anguish of all beings
lines.transliteration: jo jee-aa kee vaydan jaan ai.
tis saahib kai ha-o kurbaan ai. - unto that Lord and Master, I am a sacrifice.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਿਨ ਹਿਰਆ  ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਚੋਜ ਿਵਡਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Offer your prayers to the One who is the Giver of all peace and joy. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tis aagai jan kar baynant ee jo sarab sukh aa kaa d aanee hay. ||4||

lines.english: But one who does not know the state of the soul
lines.transliteration: jo jee-ai kee saar na jaanai.
tis si-o kichh  na kahee-ai ajaan ai. - do not say anything to such an ignorant person.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜਨ ਕਿਰ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਜੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Do not argue with fools, O mortals. Meditate on the Lord, in the state of Nirvaanaa.||5||
lines.transliteration: moorakh si-o nah loojh  paraan ee har japee-ai pad  nirbaan ee hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੀਐ  ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Don't worry - let the Creator take care of it.
lines.transliteration: naa kar chint chint aa hai kart ay.

lines.english: The Lord gives to all creatures in the water and on the land.
lines.transliteration: har dayvai jal thal jant aa sabh -tai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਿਸਉ ਨਹ ਲੂਝੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: My God bestows His blessings without being asked, even to worms in soil and stones. ||6||
lines.transliteration: achint d aan d ay-ay parabh  mayraa vich paathar keet pakh aanee hay. ||6||

lines.english: Do not place your hopes in friends, children and siblings.
lines.transliteration: naa kar aas meet sut  bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਜੰਤਾ  ਸਭਤੈ  ॥
lines.english: Do not place your hopes in kings or the business of others.
lines.transliteration: naa kar aas kisai saah bi-uhaar kee paraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਵਿਚ  ਪਾਥਰ  ਕੀਟ ਪਖਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, no one will be your helper; so meditate on the Lord, theLord of the world. ||7||
lines.transliteration: bin har naavai ko baylee naahee har japee-ai saarangpaanee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕਿਰ ਆਸ  ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, chant the Naam.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam japahu banvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕਿਰ ਆਸ  ਿਕਸੈ ਸਾਹ ਿਬਉਹਾਰ  ਕੀ ਪਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: All your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sabh aasaa mansaa poorai thaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Destroyer of fear, and your life- night shall pass in intuitive peace and poise. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam japahu bhav kh andan sukh  sehjay rain  vihaan ee hay. ||8||

lines.english: Those who serve the Lord find peace.
lines.transliteration: jin har sayvi-aa tin sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: They are intuitively absorbed in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: sehjay hee har naam samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੁਿਖ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Lord preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; go and consult theVedas and the Puraanas. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jo saran parai t is kee pat  raakh ai jaa-ay poochh ahu vayd  puraan ee hay. ||9||

lines.english: That humble being is attached to the Lord's service, whom the Lord so attaches.
lines.transliteration: jis har sayvaa laa-ay so-ee jan laagai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt and fear are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bh aram bh a-o bh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੈ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾਇ  ਪੂਛਹੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: In his own home, he remains unattached, like the lotus flower in the water. ||10|| pMnw 1071
lines.transliteration: vichay garih sadaa rahai ud aasee ji-o kamal rahai vich paan ee hay. ||10||

lines.english: One who serves in egotism is not accepted or approved.
lines.transliteration: vich ha-umai sayvaa thaa-ay na paa-ay.

lines.english: Such a person is born, only to die again, and come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: janam marai fir aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Perfect is that penance and that service, which is pleasing to the Mind of my Lord.||11||
lines.transliteration: so tap pooraa saa-ee sayvaa jo har mayray man bh aanee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਈ  ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant, O my Lord and Master?
lines.transliteration: ha-o ki-aa gun t ayray aakh aa su-aamee.

lines.english: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all souls.
lines.transliteration: too sarab jee-aa kaa ant arjaamee.

lines.english: I beg for blessings from You, O Creator Lord; I repeat Your Name night and day. ||12||
lines.transliteration: ha-o maaga-o daan t ujhai peh kart ay har an-d in naam vakh aanee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ  ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਿਹ ਕਰਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Some speak in egotistical power.
lines.transliteration: kis hee jor ahaNkaar bolan kaa.

lines.english: Some have the power of authority and Maya.
lines.transliteration: kis hee jor deebaan maa-i-aa kaa.

lines.english: I have no other Support at all, except the Lord. O Creator Lord, please save me, meek and dishonored. ||13||
lines.transliteration: mai har bin tayk Dhar avar na kaa-ee t oo kart ay raakh  mai nimaan ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ  ਰਾਖੁ ਮੈ ਿਨਮਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: You bless the meek and dishonored with honor, as it pleases You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: nimaanay maan  karahi t uDh bhaavai.

lines.english: Many others argue in conflict, coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: hor kaytee jh akh jhakh aavai jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ  ਝਿਖ ਝਿਖ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Those people, whose side You take, O Lord and Master, are elevated and successful. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jin kaa pakh karahi t oo su-aamee t in kee oopar gal t uDh aanee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਪਖੁ ਕਰਿਹ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਊਪਿਰ  ਗਲ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Those who meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
lines.transliteration: har har naam jinee sadaa Dh i-aa-i-aa.
tinee gur parsaad  param pad  paa-i-aa. by Guru's Grace, obtain the supreme status.

lines.english: Those who serve the Lord find peace; without serving Him, they regret and repent. ||15||
lines.transliteration: jin har sayvi-aa tin sukh  paa-i-aa bin sayvaa pachh otaanee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: You are pervading all, O Lord of the world.
lines.transliteration: too sabh  meh vart eh har jagannaath.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਤਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: He alone meditates on the Lord, upon whose forehead the Guru places His hand.
lines.transliteration: so har japai jis gur mastak haath.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਾਥੁ ॥
lines.english: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord, I meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak is the slaveof His slaves. ||16||2|| mwrU solhy mhlw 5  (1071-10) maaroo solhay mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1071-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har kee saran pa-i-aa har jaapee jan naanak d aas d asaan ee hay. ||16||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ ਪਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੀ  ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸਾਣੀ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
lines.english: He infused His power into the earth.
lines.transliteration: kalaa upaa-ay Dharee jin Dh arnaa.

lines.english: He suspends the heavens upon the feet of His Command.
lines.transliteration: gagan rahaa-i-aa hukmay charnaa.

lines.english: He created fire and locked it into wood. That God protects all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: agan upaa-ay eeDhan meh baaDh ee so parabh  raakh ai bhaa-ee hay. ||1||

lines.english: He gives nourishment to all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant ka-o rijak sambaahay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਈਧਨ  ਮਿਹ ਬਾਧੀ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath aapaahay.

lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He is your help and support. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa so-ee t ayraa sahaa-ee hay. ||2||

lines.english: He cherished you in your mother's womb.
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  meh jin part ipaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਥਾਿਪ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ  ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: With every breath and morsel of food, He is with you, and takes care of you.
lines.transliteration: saas garaas ho-ay sang samaali-aa.

lines.english: Forever and ever, meditate on that Beloved; Great is His glorious greatness! ||3||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa japee-ai so pareet am vadee jis vadi-aa-ee hay. ||3||

lines.english: The sultans and nobles are reduced to dust in an instant.
lines.transliteration: sultaan kh aan karay kh in keeray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਵਡੀ ਿਜਸੁ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: God cherishes the poor, and makes them into rulers.
lines.transliteration: gareeb nivaaj karay parabh meeray.

lines.english: He is the Destroyer of egotistical pride, the Support of all. His value cannot be estimated. ||4||
lines.transliteration: garab nivaaran sarab saDh aaran  kichh  keemat  kahee na jaa-ee hay. ||4||

lines.english: He alone is honorable, and he alone is wealthy,
lines.transliteration: so pativant aa so Dh anvant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਬ  ਿਨਵਾਰਣ  ਸਰਬ  ਸਧਾਰਣ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis man vasi-aa har bhagvant aa. within whose mind the Lord God abides.

lines.english: He alone is my mother, father, child, relative and sibling, who created this Universe.||5||
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  banDh ap bh aa-ee jin ih sarisat upaa-ee hay. ||5||

lines.english: I have come to God's Sanctuary, and so I fear nothing.
lines.transliteration: parabh aa-ay sarn aa bh a-o nahee karn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am sure to be saved.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  nihcha-o hai t arnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਏ  ਸਰਣਾ  ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who adores the Creator in thought, word and deed, shall never be punished.||6||
lines.transliteration: man bach karam araaDhay kart aa tis naahee kad ay sajaa-ee hay. ||6||

lines.english: One whose mind and body are permeated with the Lord, the treasure of virtue,
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan man t an meh ravi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ  ਅਰਾਧੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਦੇ ਸਜਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee jon na bh avi-aa. does not wander in birth, death and reincarnation.

lines.english: Pain vanishes and peace prevails, when one is satisfied and fulfilled. ||7||
lines.transliteration: dookh  binaas kee-aa sukh  dayraa jaa t aripat  rahay aagh aa-ee hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਭਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is my best friend. pMnw 1072
lines.transliteration: meet hamaaraa so-ee su-aamee.

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is in all places and interspaces.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanantar ant arjaamee.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Transcendent Lord, I am rid of all anxieties and calculations. ||8||
lines.transliteration: simar simar pooran parmaysur chintaa gan at mitaa-ee hay. ||8||

lines.english: One who has the Name of the Lord has hundreds of thousands and millions of arms.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam kot lakh baahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਿਟ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is with him.
lines.transliteration: har jas keertan sang Dh an taahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਧਨੁ ਤਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: In His Mercy, God has blessed me with the sword of spiritual wisdom; I have attackedand killed the demons. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan kharh ag kar kirpaa d eenaa d oot maaray kar Dh aa-ee hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਖੜਗੁ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਦੀਨਾ ਦੂਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਧਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Chant the Chant of the Lord, the Chant of Chants.
lines.transliteration: har kaa jaap japahu jap japnay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Be a winner of the game of life and come to abide in your true home.
lines.transliteration: jeet aavhu vashu gh ar apnay.

lines.english: You shall not see the 8.4 million types of hell; sing His Glorious Praises and remain saturated with loving devotion||10||
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh narak na d aykhhu rasak rasak gun  gaa-ee hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਨਰਕ  ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He is the Savior of worlds and galaxies.
lines.transliteration: khand barahmand uDh aaran haaraa.

lines.english: He is lofty, unfathomable, inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: ooch athaah agamm apaaraa.

lines.english: That humble being, unto whom God grants His Grace, meditates on Him. ||11||
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay parabh apnee so jan t iseh Dh i-aa-ee hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਧਆਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: God has broken my bonds, and claimed me as His own.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orh lee-ay parabh  molay.

lines.english: In His Mercy, He has made me the slave of His home.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa keenay ghar golay.

lines.english: The unstruck celestial sound current resounds and vibrates, when one performs actsof true service. ||12||
lines.transliteration: anhad run  jhunkaar sahj Dh un saachee kaar kamaa-ee hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਹਦ  ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਸਾਚੀ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: O God, I have enshrined faith in You within my mind.
lines.transliteration: man parteet  banee parabh  tayree.

lines.english: My egotistical intellect has been driven out.
lines.transliteration: binas ga-ee ha-umai mat mayree.

lines.english: God has made me His own, and now I have a glorious reputation in this world. ||13||
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-aa parabh apnai jag meh sobh  suhaa-ee hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪਨੈ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Proclaim His Glorious Victory, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar japahu jagdeesai.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaa-ee parabh apunay eesai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਈਸੈ ॥
lines.english: I do not see any other except Him. The One Lord pervades the whole world. ||14||
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa avar na d eesai aykaa jagat  sabaa-ee hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕਾ ਜਗਿਤ  ਸਬਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: True, True, True is God.
lines.transliteration: sat sat  sat parabh  jaataa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attuned to Him forever.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad sad aa man raat aa.

lines.english: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on You, merging in You, O One Universal Creator. ||15||
lines.transliteration: simar simar jeeveh jan tayray aykankaar samaa-ee hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Beloved of His humble devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kaa pareet am pi-aaraa.

lines.english: My Lord and Master is the Savior of all.
lines.transliteration: sabhai uDh aaran  khasam hamaaraa.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all desires are fulfilled. He has saved the honor of servant Nanak. ||16||1|| mwrU solhy mhlw 5  (1072-12) maaroo solhay mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1072-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: simar naam punnee sabh ichh aa jan naanak paij rakh aa-ee hay. ||16||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
lines.english: The body-bride is attached to the Yogi, the husband-soul.
lines.transliteration: sangee jogee naar laptaanee.

lines.english: She is involved with him, enjoying pleasure and delights.
lines.transliteration: urajh rahee rang ras maan ee.

lines.english: As a consequence of past actions, they have come together, enjoying pleasurableplay. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirat sanjogee bh a-ay ikt araa kart ay bh og bilaasaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever the husband does, the bride willingly accepts.
lines.transliteration: jo pir karai so Dhan t at maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਤ  ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ਭਏ ਇਕਤਰ੍ਾ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਭੋਗ ਿਬਲਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The husband adorns his bride, and keeps her with himself.
lines.transliteration: pir dhaneh seegaar rakh ai sangaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਪਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਧਨ ਤਤੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: Joining together, they live in harmony day and night; the husband comforts his wife. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mil ayktar vaseh d in raat ee pari-o d ay dh aneh d ilaasaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: Dhan maagai pari-o baho biDh  Dhaavai. When the bride asks, the husband runs around in all sorts of ways.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਏਕਤਰ੍  ਵਸਿਹ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਦੇ ਧਨਿਹ  ਿਦਲਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whatever he finds, he brings to show his bride.
lines.transliteration: jo paavai so aan d ikhaavai.

lines.english: But there is one thing he cannot reach, and so his bride remains hungry and thirsty.||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk vasat ka-o pahuch na saakai Dh an raht ee bh ookh pi-aasaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: Dhan karai bin-o d o-oo kar jorai. With her palms pressed together, the bride offers her prayer,

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ  ਕਉ ਪਹੁਿਚ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਧਨ ਰਹਤੀ  ਭੂਖ ਿਪਆਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: "O my beloved, do not leave me and go to foreign lands; please stay here with me.
lines.transliteration: pari-a pardays na jaahu vashu gh ar morai.

lines.english: Do such business within our home, that my hunger and thirst may be relieved."||4||
lines.transliteration: aisaa banaj karahu garih bh eetar jit utrai bh ookh pi-aasaa hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ ਪਰਦੇਿਸ  ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਿਰ  ਮੋਰੈ ॥
lines.english: All sorts of religious rituals are performed in this age,
lines.transliteration: saglay karam Dharam jug saaDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਬਣਜੁ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਉਤਰੈ  ਭੂਖ ਿਪਆਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bin har ras sukh t il nahee laaDh aa. but without the sublime essence of the Lord, not an iota of peace is found.

lines.english: When the Lord becomes Merciful, O Nanak, then in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the bride and the husband enjoy ecstasy and bliss. ||5|| pMnw 1073
lines.transliteration: bha-ee kirpaa naanak sat sangay t a-o Dh an pir anand ulaasaa hay. ||5||

lines.english: Dhan anDh ee pir chapal si-aanaa. The body-bride is blind, and the groom is clever and wise.
The creation was created of the five elements.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  kaa rachan rachaanaa.

lines.english: That merchandise, for which you have come into the world, is received only from the True Guru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jis vakhar ka-o t um aa-ay hahu so paa-i-o sat gur paasaa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਵਖਰ  ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ  ਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Dhan kahai t oo vas mai naalay. The body-bride says, "Please live with me,

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਕਹੈ ਤੂ ਵਸੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: O my beloved, peaceful, young lord.
lines.transliteration: pari-a sukhvaasee baal gupaalay.

lines.english: Without you, I am of no account. Please give me your word, that you will not leaveme". ||7||
lines.transliteration: tujhai binaa ha-o kit  hee na laykh ai vachan d eh chh od na jaasaa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝੈ ਿਬਨਾ  ਹਉ ਿਕਤ  ਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਚਨੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਜਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The soul-husband says, "I am the slave of my Commander.
lines.transliteration: pir kahi-aa ha-o hukmee bandaa.

lines.english: He is my Great Lord and Master, who is fearless and independent.
lines.transliteration: oh bhaaro th aakur jis kaan  na chh andaa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਕਾਿਣ  ਨ ਛੰਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: As long as He wills, I will remain with you. When He summons me, I shall arise and depart."||8||
lines.transliteration: jichar raakhai t ichar t um sang rahn aa jaa sad ay ta ooth  siDhaasaa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਚਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਿਤਚਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹਣਾ  ਜਾ ਸਦੇ ਤ ਊਿਠ ਿਸਧਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The husband speaks words of Truth to the bride,
lines.transliteration: ja-o pari-a bachan kahay Dhan saachay.

lines.english: Dhan kachh oo na samjh ai chanchal kaachay. but the bride is restless and inexperienced, and she does not understand anything.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ  ਚੰਚਿਲ  ਕਾਚੇ  ॥
lines.english: Again and again, she begs her husband to stay; she thinks that he is just joking whenhe answers her. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bahur bahur pir hee sang maagai oh baat jaanai kar haasaa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਿਪਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗੈ  ਓਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਿਰ ਹਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: The Order comes, and the husband-soul is called.
lines.transliteration: aa-ee aagi-aa pirahu bulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He does not consult with his bride, and does not ask her opinion.
lines.transliteration: naa Dhan puchh ee na mat aa pakaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਧਨ ਪੁਛੀ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He gets up and marches off, and the discarded body-bride mingles with dust. ONanak, behold the illusion of emotional attachment and hope. ||10||
lines.transliteration: ooth siDh aa-i-o chh ootar maatee d aykh naanak mithan mohaasaa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਊਿਠ ਿਸਧਾਇਓ  ਛੂਟਿਰ  ਮਾਟੀ  ਦੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਥਨ  ਮੋਹਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O greedy mind - listen, O my mind!
lines.transliteration: ray man lobhee sun  man mayray.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਭੀ ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Serve the True Guru day and night forever.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv d in raat  sadayray.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, the faithless cynics rot away and die. The noose of Death is around the necks of those who have no guru. ||11||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur pach moo-ay saakat  niguray gal jam faasaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਿਚ ਮੂਏ ਸਾਕਤ  ਿਨਗੁਰੇ  ਗਿਲ  ਜਮ ਫਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh comes, and the self-willed manmukh goes.
lines.transliteration: manmukh aavai manmukh  jaavai.

lines.english: The manmukh suffers beatings again and again.
lines.transliteration: manmukh fir fir chotaa kh aavai.

lines.english: The manmukh endures as many hells as there are; the Gurmukh is not even touchedby them. ||12||
lines.transliteration: jitnay narak say manmukh  bhogai gurmukh  layp na maasaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਨਰਕ  ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਭੋਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He alone is Gurmukh, who is pleasing to the Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh so-ay je har jee-o bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Who can destroy anyone who is robed in honor by the Lord?
lines.transliteration: tis ka-un  mitaavai je parabh  pehraa-i-aa.

lines.english: The blissful one is forever in bliss; he is dressed in robes of honor. ||13||
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand karay aanand ee jis sirpaa-o pa-i-aa gal kh aasaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਕਰੇ ਆਨੰਦੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਰਪਾਉ  ਪਇਆ  ਗਿਲ  ਖਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur pooray.

lines.english: He is the Giver of Sanctuary, the Heroic Warrior who keeps His Word.
lines.transliteration: saran kay d aatay bachan kay sooray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਬਚਨ  ਕੇ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Such is the Lord God, the Giver of peace, whom I have met; He shall never leave me or go anywhere else. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aisaa parabh mili-aa sukh -daata vichh urh na kat  hee jaasaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: He is the treasure of virtue; His value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan kichh  keem na paa-ee.

lines.english: He is perfectly permeating each and every heart, prevailing everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at poor rahi-o sabh  thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਭ ਠਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; I am the dust ofthe feet of Your slaves. ||15||1||2|| mwrU solhy mhlw 5  (1073-15) maaroo solhay mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1073-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran d een d ukh bhanjan ha-o rayn  tayray jo d aasaa hay. ||15||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਿਣ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਹਉ ਰੇਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: My Blissful Lord is forever in bliss.
lines.transliteration: karai anand anandee mayraa.

lines.english: He fills each and every heart, and judges each and everyone.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at pooran sir sireh nibayraa.

lines.english: The True Lord and Master is above the heads of all kings; there is none other than Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sir saahaa kai sachaa saahib avar naahee ko doojaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: He is joyful, blissful and merciful.
lines.transliteration: harakhvant  aanant  da-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ  ਕੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God's Light is manifest everywhere.
lines.transliteration: pargat rahi-o parabh sarab ujaalaa.

lines.english: He creates forms, and gazing upon them, He enjoys them; He Himself worshipsHimself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: roop karay kar vaykhai vigsai aapay hee aap poojaa hay. ||2||

lines.english: He contemplates His own creative power.
lines.transliteration: aapay kudrat  karay veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਪੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself creates the expanse of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aapay hee sach karay pasaaraa.

lines.english: He Himself stages the play, day and night; He Himself listens, and hearing, rejoices. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay khayl kh ilaavai d in raat ee aapay sun  sun bheejaa hay. ||3||

lines.english: True is His throne, and True is His kingdom.
lines.transliteration: saachaa takh at sachee paat isaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਿਖਲਾਵੈ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਭੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: True is the treasure of the True Banker. pMnw 1074
lines.transliteration: sach khajeenaa saachaa saahee.

lines.english: He Himself is True, and true is all that He has established. True is the prevailing Order of the True Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay sach Dhaari-o sabh  saachaa sachay sach vart eejaa hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਚੁ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: True is the justice of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach tapaavas sachay kayraa.

lines.english: Your place is forever True, O God.
lines.transliteration: saachaa thaan sadaa parabh  tayraa.

lines.english: True is Your Creative Power, and True is the Word of Your Bani. True is the peacewhich You give, O my Lord and Master. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sachee kudrat  sachee ban ee sach saahib sukh  keejaa hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਸੁਖੁ ਕੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: You alone are the greatest king.
lines.transliteration: ayko aap toohai vad raajaa.

lines.english: By the Hukam of Your Command, O True Lord, our affairs are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: hukam sachay kai pooray kaajaa.

lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, You know everything; You Yourself are pleased with Yourself.||6||
lines.transliteration: antar baahar sabh  kichh  jaanai aapay hee aap pat eejaa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਆਿਪ  ਪਤੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: You are the great party-goer, You are the great enjoyer.
lines.transliteration: too vad rasee-aa t oo vad bh ogee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਰਸੀਆ  ਤੂ ਵਡ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.english: You are detached in Nirvaanaa, You are the Yogi.
lines.transliteration: too nirbaan  toohai hee jogee.

lines.english: All celestial comforts are in Your home; Your Glance of Grace rains Nectar. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh sahj gh ar tayrai ami-o t ayree d aristeejaa hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਘਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਅਿਮਉ  ਤੇਰੀ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: You alone give Your gifts.
lines.transliteration: tayree d aat tujhai tay hovai.

lines.english: You grant Your gifts unto all the beings of the world.
lines.transliteration: deh d aan sabh sai jant  loai.

lines.english: Your treasures are overflowing, and are never exhausted; through them, we remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||8||
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai poor bh andaarai t aripat  rahay aagh eejaa hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਰਹੇ ਆਘੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Siddhas, seekers and forest-dwellers beg from You.
lines.transliteration: jaacheh siDh saaDh ik banvaasee.

lines.english: The celibates and abstainers, and those who abide in peace beg from You.
lines.transliteration: jaacheh jatee sat ee sukh vaasee.

lines.english: You alone are the Great Giver; all are beggars of You. You bless all the world withYour gifts. ||9||
lines.transliteration: ik daat aar sagal hai jaachik d eh daan saristeejaa hay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ  ਹੈ ਜਾਿਚਕ ਦੇਿਹ ਦਾਨੁ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਟੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Your devotees worship You with infinite love.
lines.transliteration: karahi bhagat  ar rang apaaraa.

lines.english: In an instant, You establish and disestablish.
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa.

lines.english: Your weight is so heavy, O my infinite Lord and Master. Your devotees surrender to the Hukam of Your Command. ||10||
lines.transliteration: bhaaro t ol bay-ant  su-aamee hukam man bh agteejaa hay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਰੋ ਤੋਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਭਗਤੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: They alone know You, whom You bless with Your Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: jis deh d aras so-ee t uDh jaanai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy Your Love forever.
lines.transliteration: oh gur kai sabad sad aa rang maan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.english: They alone are clever, handsome and wise, who are pleasing to Your Mind. ||11||
lines.transliteration: chatur saroop si-aan aa so-ee jo man t ayrai bh aaveejaa hay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਿਸਆਣਾ  ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਮਿਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਵੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: One who keeps You in his consciousness, becomes carefree and independent.
lines.transliteration: jis cheet aavahi so vayparvaahaa.
