lines.english: One who keeps You in his consciousness, is the true king.
lines.transliteration: jis cheet aavahi so saachaa saahaa.

lines.english: One who keeps You in his consciousness - what does he have to fear? And what elsedoes he need to do? ||12||
lines.transliteration: jis cheet aavahi t is bha-o kayhaa avar kahaa kichh  keejaa hay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਿਕਛੁ ਕੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Thirst and desire are quenched, and one's inner being is cooled and soothed.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa boojh ee ant ar thandhaa.

lines.english: The True Guru has mended the broken one.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai lai tootaa gandh aa.

lines.english: Awareness of the Word of the Shabad has awakened within my heart. Shaking it and vibrating it, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||13||
lines.transliteration: surat sabad  rid antar jaagee ami-o jh ol jhol peejaa hay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾਗੀ ਅਿਮਉ  ਝੋਿਲ ਝੋਿਲ  ਪੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: I shall not die; I shall live forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: marai naahee sad sad  hee jeevai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.english: I have become immortal; I am eternal and imperishable.
lines.transliteration: amar bha-i-aa abh inaasee theevai.

lines.english: I do not come, and I do not go. The Guru has driven out my doubts. ||14||
lines.transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaavai gur door kee-aa bh armeejaa hay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਵੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੂਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਭਰਮੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Perfect is the Word of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee pooree banee.

lines.english: One who is attached to the Perfect Lord, is immersed in the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: poorai laagaa pooray maahi samaanee.

lines.english: His love increases day by day, and when it is weighed, it does not decrease. ||15||
lines.transliteration: charhai savaa-i-aa nit  nit rangaa gh atai naahee t oleejaa hay. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ ਰੰਗਾ  ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੋਲੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: When the gold is made one hundred percent pure,
lines.transliteration: baarhaa kanchan suDh karaa-i-aa.
nadar saraaf vannee sachrh aa-i-aa. its color is true to the jeweller's eye.

lines.english: Assaying it, it is placed in the treasury by God the Jeweller, and it is not melted down again. ||16||
lines.transliteration: parakh kh ajaanai paa-i-aa saraafee fir naahee t aa-eejaa hay. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਿਖ  ਖਜਾਨੈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਰਾਫੀ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤਾਈਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Your Naam is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam t umaaraa su-aamee.

lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa kurbaanee.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, I have found great peace; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, this mind is pleased and satisfied. ||17||1||3|| mwrU mhlw 5 solhy  (1074-18) maaroo mehlaa 5 solhay Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Solhas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1074-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: satsang mahaa sukh  paa-i-aa d aykh darsan ih man bh eejaa hay. ||17||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ  ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Guru is the Master of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gur gopaal gur govindaa.

lines.english: The Guru is merciful, and always forgiving.
lines.transliteration: gur da-i-aal sad aa bakh sindaa.

lines.english: The Guru is the Shaastras, the Simritees and the six rituals. The Guru is the Holy Shrine. ||1|| pMnw 1075
lines.transliteration: gur saasat simrit  khat karmaa gur pavit ar asthaanaa hay. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, all the sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: gur simrat sabh  kilvikh  naaseh.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, one is not strangled by the noose of Death.
lines.transliteration: gur simrat jam sang na faaseh.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, the mind becomes immaculate; the Guru eliminates egotistical pride. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur simrat man nirmal hovai gur kaatay apmaanaa hay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਟੇ  ਅਪਮਾਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru's servant is not consigned to hell.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sayvak narak na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's servant meditates on the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sayvak paarbarahm Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.english: The Guru's servant joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Guru evergives the life of the soul. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sayvak saaDhsang paa-ay gur kard aa nit  jee-a d aanaa hay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ  ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ  ਿਨਤ ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: At the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.
lines.transliteration: gur du-aarai har keert an sun ee-ai.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one chants the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ayt har jas mukh  bhanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਭਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru eradicates sorrow and suffering, and bestows honor in the Court of theLord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kal kalays mitaa-ay satgur har d argeh d ayvai maanaaN hay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਿਮਟਾਏ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨ  ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Guru has revealed the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar guroo dikh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru returns to the Path, those who have wandered away.
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa maarag sat gur paa-i-aa.

lines.english: No obstacles stand in the way of devotion to the Lord, for one who serves the Guru. The Guru implants perfect spiritual wisdom. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur sayvak ka-o bighan na bh agtee har poor d arirh-aa-i-aa gi-aanaaN hay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Guru has revealed the Lord everywhere.
lines.transliteration: gur daristaa-i-aa sabh nee th aaN-ee.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading the water and the land.
lines.transliteration: jal thal poor rahi-aa gosaa-ee.

lines.english: The high and the low are all the same to Him. Focus your mind's meditation intuitivelyon Him. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ooch oon sabh ayk samaanaaN man laagaa sahj Dh i-aanaa hay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਊਨ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨ  ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਨਾ  ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, all thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai sabh t arisan bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, one is not watched by Maya.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai nah johai maa-ee.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru bestows truth and contentment; I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh dee-aa gur poorai naam amrit  pee paanaaN hay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਦੀਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਪੀ ਪਾਨ  ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Bani is contained in all.
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee sabh  maahi samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਭ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself hears it, and He Himself repeats it.
lines.transliteration: aap sunee t ai aap vakh aanee.

lines.english: Those who meditate on it, are all emancipated; they attain the eternal and unchanging home. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jin jin japee tay-ee sabh  nistaray t in paa-i-aa nihchal thaanaaN hay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਪੀ ਤੇਈ ਸਿਭ ਿਨਸਤਰ੍ੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਥਾਨ  ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Glory of the True Guru is known only to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee mahimaa sat gur jaan ai.

lines.english: Whatever He does, is according to the Pleasure of His Will.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so aapan  bhaanai.

lines.english: Your humble servants beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy; Nanak is forever asacrifice to You. ||9||1||4|| mwrU solhy mhlw 5  (1075-12) maaroo solhay mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1075-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo Dh oor jaacheh jan t ayray naanak sad  kurbaanaaN hay. ||9||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਿਰ ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ  ਹੇ ॥੯॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: The Primal, Immaculate Lord God is formless.
lines.transliteration: aad niranjan parabh  nirankaaraa.

lines.english: The Detached Lord is Himself prevailing in all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vart ai aap niraaraa.

lines.english: He has no race or social class, no identifying mark. By the Hukam of His Will, He created the entire universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: varan jaat chihan nahee ko-ee sabh  hukmay sarisat upaa-id aa. ||1||

lines.english: Out of all the 8.4 million species of beings,
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jon sabaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਨੁ ਜਾਿਤ  ਿਚਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God blessed mankind with glory.
lines.transliteration: maanas ka-o parabh  dee-ee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: That human who misses this chance, shall suffer the pains of coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: is pa-orhee t ay jo nar chookai so aa-ay jaa-ay d ukh paa-id aa. ||2||

lines.english: What should I say, to one who has been created.
lines.transliteration: keetaa hovai t is ki-aa kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਪਉੜੀ  ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋ ਆਇ  ਜਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh receives the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam pad aarath lahee-ai.

lines.english: He alone is confused, whom the Lord Himself confuses. He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jis aap bhulaa-ay so-ee bh oolai so boojh ai jisahi bujh aa-idaa. ||3||

lines.english: This body has been made the village of joy and sorrow.
lines.transliteration: harakh sog kaa nagar ih kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਸੋਈ ਭੂਲੈ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They alone are emancipated, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: say ubray jo satgur sarn ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਨਗਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who remains untouched by the three qualities, the three gunas - such a Gurmukh is blessed with glory. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tarihaa gun aa tay rahai niraaraa so gurmukh  sobh aa paa-id aa. ||4||

lines.english: You can do anything, but whatever you do, only serves to tie your feet.
lines.transliteration: anik karam kee-ay bahutayray. jo keejai so banDh an pairay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਹਾ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਿਨਰਾਰਾ  ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The seed which is planted out of season does not sprout, and all one's capital andprofits are lost. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kurutaa beej beejay nahee jammai sabh  laahaa mool gavaa-id aa. ||5||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are most sublime andexalted.
lines.transliteration: kaljug meh keertan parDh aanaa.

lines.english: Become Gurmukh, chant and focus your meditation. pMnw 1076
lines.transliteration: gurmukh japee-ai laa-ay Dh i-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਿਤ ਿਸਉ ਜਾਇਦਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: You shall save yourself, and save all your generations as well. You shall go to the Court of the Lord with honor. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aap tarai saglay kul t aaray har d argeh pat  si-o jaa-id aa. ||6||

lines.english: All the continents, nether worlds, islands and worlds
lines.transliteration: khand pat aal deep sabh  lo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਕਾਲੈ  ਵਿਸ ਆਿਪ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: - God Himself has made them all subject to death.
lines.transliteration: sabh kaalai vas aap parabh  kee-aa.

lines.english: The One Imperishable Lord Himself is unmoving and unchanging. Meditating on Him, one becomes unchanging. ||7||
lines.transliteration: nihchal ayk aap abhinaasee so nihchal jo t iseh Dh i-aa-id aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's servant becomes like the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa sayvak so har jayhaa.

lines.english: Do not think that, because of his human body, he is different.
lines.transliteration: bhayd  na jaan hu maan as dayhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ  ਉਠਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਸਲਲੈ  ਸਲਲ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The waves of the water rise up in various ways, and then the water merges again inwater. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal tarang uth eh baho bh aatee fir sallai salal samaa-id aa. ||8||

lines.english: A beggar begs for charity at His Door.
lines.transliteration: ik jaachik mangai daan d u-aarai.

lines.english: When God pleases, He takes pity on him.
lines.transliteration: jaa parabh bh aavai t aa kirpaa Dh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਜਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੈ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਿਨ  ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਦਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, to satisfy my mind, O Lord. Through the Kirtan of Your Praises, my mind is held steady. ||9||
lines.transliteration: dayh d aras jit  man t ariptaasai har keert an man th ehraa-id aa. ||9||

lines.english: The Beauteous Lord and Master is not controlled in any way.
lines.transliteration: roorho th aakur kit ai vas na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੇ ਿਜ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਆ  ਸੰਤਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord does that which pleases the Saints of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har so kichh karay je har ki-aa sant aa bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਲੋੜਿਨ  ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇਿਨ  ਦਿਰ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He does whatever they wish to be done; nothing blocks their way at His Door. ||10||
lines.transliteration: keetaa lorh an so-ee karaa-in d ar fayr na ko-ee paa-id aa. ||10||

lines.english: Wherever the mortal is confronted with difficulty,
lines.transliteration: jithai a-ughat aa-ay banat  hai paraan ee.
tithai har Dh i-aa-ee-ai saaringpaan ee. there he should meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਪੁਤਰ੍ੁ ਕਲਤਰ੍ੁ  ਨ ਬੇਲੀ  ਕੋਈ ਿਤਥੈ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਛਡਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Where there are no children, spouse or friends, there the Lord Himself comes to the rescue. ||11||
lines.transliteration: jithai putar kalat ar na baylee ko-ee t ithai har aap chh adaa-id aa. ||11||

lines.english: The Great Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: vadaa saahib agam athaahaa.

lines.english: How can anyone meet with God, the self-suficient One?
lines.transliteration: ki-o milee-ai parabh vayparvaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਟ  ਿਸਲਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Those who have had the noose cut away from around their necks, whom God has setback upon the Path, obtain a place in the Sangat, the Congregation. ||12||
lines.transliteration: kaat silak jis maarag paa-ay so vich sangat vaasaa paa-id aa. ||12||

lines.english: One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command is said to be His servant.
lines.transliteration: hukam boojhai so sayvak kahee-ai.

lines.english: He endures both bad and good equally.
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa d u-ay samsar sahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਤ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: When egotism is silenced, then one comes to know the One Lord. Such a Gurmukh intuitively merges in the Lord. ||13||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai jaa-ay ta ayko boojh ai so gurmukh  sahj samaa-id aa. ||13||

lines.english: The devotees of the Lord dwell forever in peace.
lines.transliteration: har kay bhagat  sadaa sukh vaasee.

lines.english: With a child-like, innocent nature, they remain detached, turning away from theworld.
lines.transliteration: baal subhaa-ay at eet udaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਰੰਗ ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ  ਿਜਉ ਿਪਤਾ  ਪੂਤੁ ਲਾਡਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: They enjoy various pleasures in many ways; God caresses them, like a fathercaressing his son. ||14||
lines.transliteration: anik rang karahi baho bhaat ee ji-o pit aa poot  laadaa-id aa. ||14||

lines.english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paa-ee.

lines.english: We meet Him, only when He causes us to meet.
lines.transliteration: taa milee-ai jaa la-ay milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਜਨ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਖਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Lord is revealed to those humble Gurmukhs, who have such pre-ordained destinyinscribed upon their foreheads. ||15||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pargat bh a-i-aa t in jan ka-o jin Dh ur mast ak laykh  likhaa-idaa. ||15||

lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator Lord, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: too aapay kart aa kaaran  karnaa.

lines.english: You created the Universe, and You support the whole earth.
lines.transliteration: sarisat upaa-ay Dharee sabh  Dharnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਜ  ਰਖਾਇਦਾ  ॥੧੬॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door, O Lord; if it is Your Will, please preserve his honor. ||16||1||5|| mwrU solhy mhlw 5  (1076-16) maaroo solhay mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1076-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saran pa-i-aa har d u-aarai har bh aavai laaj rakh aa-idaa. ||16||1||5||

lines.english: Whatever is seen is You, O One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so ayko t oohai.

lines.english: What the ears hear is the Word of Your Bani.
lines.transliteration: banee t ayree sarvan  sunee-ai.

lines.english: There is nothing else to be seen at all. You give support to all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: doojee avar na jaapas kaa-ee sagal t umaaree Dh aarnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੀ  ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਜਾਪਿਸ  ਕਾਈ  ਸਗਲ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You Yourself are conscious of Your Creation.
lines.transliteration: aap chitaaray apn aa kee-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself established Yourself, O God.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap aap parabh thee-aa.

lines.english: Creating Yourself, You formed the expanse of the Universe; You Yourself cherish and sustain each and every heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay rachi-on pasaaraa aapay ghat gh at saarn aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਰਿਚਓਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਸਾਰਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You created some to hold great and royal courts.
lines.transliteration: ik upaa-ay vad darvaaree.

lines.english: Some turn away from the world in renunciation, and some maintain their households. pMnw 1077
lines.transliteration: ik udaasee ik gh ar baaree.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭੂਖੇ ਇਿਕ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਏ  ਸਭਸੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Some are hungry and some are satisfied and satiated, but all lean on Your Support. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ik bhookh ay ik t aripat  aghaa-ay sabh sai tayraa paarn aa. ||3||

lines.english: The True Lord Himself is True, True, True.
lines.transliteration: aapay sat sat  sat saachaa.

lines.english: He is woven into the essence of His devotees, through and through.
lines.transliteration: ot pot  bhagtan sang raachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਸਾਰਣਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed. He Himself spreads Himself out.||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay gupat aapay hai pargat apn aa aap pasaarn aa. ||4||

lines.english: Forever, forever and ever, He shall always exist.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sad  hovan haaraa.

lines.english: He is lofty, inaccessible, unfathomable and infinite.
lines.transliteration: oochaa agam athaahu apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਊਣੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਿਰ ਊਣੇ ਏਿਹ ਚਲਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੇ ਕਾਰਣਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He fills the empty, and empties out the filled; such are the plays and dramas of myLord and Master. ||5||
lines.transliteration: oonay bh aray bh aray bh ar oon ay ayhi chalat  su-aamee kay kaarn aa. ||5||

lines.english: With my mouth, I praise my True Lord King.
lines.transliteration: mukh saalaahee sachay saahaa.

lines.english: With my eyes, I behold the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: nainee paykh aa agam athaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨੀ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਸਗਲ  ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Listening, listening with my ears, my mind and body are rejuvenated; my Lord andMaster saves all. ||6||
lines.transliteration: karnee sun sun  man t an hari-aa mayray saahib sagal uDh aaran aa. ||6||

lines.english: He created the creation, and gazes upon what He has created.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykheh keet aa apn aa.

lines.english: All beings and creatures meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant so-ee hai japn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣੀ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਲਣਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself knows His creative power; He blesses with His Glance of Grace. ||7||
lines.transliteration: apnee kud rat aapay jaan ai nad ree nad ar nihaalan aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜਹ ਬੈਸਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
lines.english: Where the Saints gather together and sit, God dwells close at hand.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa jah baiseh parabh  paasay.

lines.english: They abide in bliss and joy, beholding the Lord's wondrous play.
lines.transliteration: anand mangal har chalat t amaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ  ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਿਚਤਾਰਣਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: They sing the Glories of the Lord, and the unstruck sound current of His Bani; O Nanak, His slaves remain conscious of Him. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi anhad  Dhun ban ee tah naanak d aas chit aaran aa. ||8||

lines.english: Coming and going is all Your wondrous play.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa sabh  chalat  tumaaraa.

lines.english: Creating the Creation, You gaze upon Your infinite play.
lines.transliteration: kar kar daykh ai khayl apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਪਾਲਣਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Creating the Creation, You Yourself cherish and nurture it. ||9||
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay upaavanhaaraa apn aa kee-aa paaln aa. ||9||

lines.english: Listening, listening to Your Glory, I live.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  jeevaa so-ay t umaaree.

lines.english: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa jaa-ee balihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਿਸਮਰਉ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I meditate in remembrance on You, day and night, O my inaccessible, infinite Lord and Master. ||10||
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  simra-o d in raat ee mayray su-aamee agam apaaran aa. ||10||

lines.english: Other than You, who else should I praise?
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojay kis saalaahee.

lines.english: I meditate on the One and Only Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk japee man maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਿਝ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਿਨਹਾਲਾ  ਇਹ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਘਾਲਣਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Realizing the Hukam of Your Will, Your humble servants are enraptured; this is theachievement of Your devotees. ||11||
lines.transliteration: hukam boojh jan bh a-ay nihaalaa ih bh agtaa kee gh aalnaa. ||11||

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the True Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur updays japee-ai man saachaa.

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I am immersed in the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gur updays raam rang raachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਤੁਟਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਬੰਧਨ  ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਾਲਣਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, all bonds are broken, and this doubt and emotionalattachment are burnt away. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gur updays t uteh sabh  banDh an ih bh aram moh parjaalan aa. ||12||

lines.english: Wherever He keeps me, is my place of rest.
lines.transliteration: jah raakhai so-ee sukh  thaanaa.

lines.english: Whatever naturally happens, I accept that as good.
lines.transliteration: sehjay ho-ay so-ee bhal maanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਬੈਰ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਲਣਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Hatred is gone - I have no hatred at all; I see the One Lord in all. ||13||
lines.transliteration: binsay bair naahee ko bairee sabh ayko hai bh aalnaa. ||13||

lines.english: Fear has been removed, and darkness has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: dar chookay binsay anDhi-aaray.

lines.english: The all-powerful, primal, detached Lord God has been revealed.
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-ay parabh  purakh  niraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਘਾਲਣਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Forsaking self-conceit, I have entered His Sanctuary, and I work for Him. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aap chhod pa-ay sarn aa-ee jis kaa saa t is ghaalnaa. ||14||

lines.english: Rare are those few, very blessed people, who come into the world,
lines.transliteration: aisaa ko vadbhaagee aa-i-aa.
aath pahar jin kh asam Dh i-aa-i-aa. and meditate on their Lord and Master, twenty-four hours a day.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰਣਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Associating with such humble people, all are saved, and their families are saved as well. ||15||
lines.transliteration: tis jan kai sang t arai sabh  ko-ee so parvaar saDh aaran aa. ||15||

lines.english: This is the blessing which I have received from my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ih bakhsees kh asam t ay paavaa.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar kar jorh  Dhi-aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਿਮ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੈ ਉਚਾਰਣਾ  ॥੧੬॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: I chant the Naam, and through the Naam, I intuitively merge into the Lord; O Nanak,may I be blessed with the Naam, and ever repeat it. ||16||1||6|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1077-17) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam japee naam sahj samaavaa naam naanak milai uchaaranaa. ||16||1||6||

lines.english: Do not be fooled by appearances, you fool.
lines.transliteration: soorat d aykh na bh ool gavaaraa.

lines.english: This is a false attachment to the expanse of an illusion.
lines.transliteration: mithan mohaaraa jhooth  pasaaraa.

lines.english: No one can remain in this world; only the One Lord is permanent and unchanging. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jag meh ko-ee rahan na paa-ay nihchal ayk naaraa-in aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਕੋਈ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਏ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seek the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee pa-o sarnaa-ee.

lines.english: He shall eradicate all emotional attachment, sorrow and doubt.
lines.transliteration: moh sog sabh bh aram mitaa-ee.

lines.english: He shall administer the medicine, the Mantra of the One Name. Sing the True Name within your heart. ||2|| pMnw 1078
lines.transliteration: ayko mantar drirh -aa-ay a-ukh aDh sach naam rid  gaa-in aa. ||2||

lines.english: So many gods yearn for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis naamai ka-o tarseh baho d ayvaa.

lines.english: All the devotees serve Him.
lines.transliteration: sagal bhagat  jaa kee kard ay sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਦੇ  ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. His Name is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anaathaa naath deen d ukh bhanjan so gur pooray t ay paa-in aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥਾ  ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I cannot conceive of any other door.
lines.transliteration: hor du-aaraa ko-ay na soojh ai.

lines.english: One who wanders through the three worlds, understands nothing.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan Dhaavai t aa kichh oo na boojh ai.

lines.english: The True Guru is the banker, with the treasure of the Naam. This jewel is obtained from Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur saahu bh andaar naam jis ih rat an tisai tay paa-in aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਿਜਸੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The dust of His feet purifies.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee Dhoor karay puneet aa.

lines.english: Even the angelic beings and gods cannot obtain it, O friend.
lines.transliteration: sur nar dayv na paavahi meet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the True Primal Being, the Transcendent Lord God; meeting withHim, one is carried across to the other side. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  satgur parmaysar jis bh aytat paar paraa-in aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰਾਇਣਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: O my beloved mind, if you wish for the 'tree of life';
lines.transliteration: paarjaat lorh eh man pi-aaray.
kaamDhayn sohee d arbaaray. if you wish for Kaamadhayna, the wish-fulfilling cow to adorn your court;
taripat  santokh sayvaa gur pooray naam kamaa-ay rasaa-in aa. ||6|| if you wish to be satisfied and contented, then serve the Perfect Guru, and practice the Naam, the source of nectar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ਰਸਾਇਣਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the five thieves of desire are conquered.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad mareh panch Dh aatoo.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ॥
lines.english: In the Fear of the Supreme Lord God, you shall become immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: bhai paarbarahm hoveh nirmalaa t oo.

lines.english: When one meets the Perfect Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, His touch reveals theLord, the Philosopher's Stone. ||7||
lines.transliteration: paaras jab bhaytai gur pooraa t aa paaras paras d ikhaa-inaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਿਸ  ਿਦਖਾਇਣਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Myriads of heavens do not equal the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ka-ee baikunth naahee lavai laagay.

lines.english: The spiritually wise forsake mere liberation.
lines.transliteration: mukat bapurh ee bh ee gi-aanee t i-aagay.

lines.english: The One Universal Creator Lord is found through the True Guru. I am a sacrifice, asacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aykankaar satgur t ay paa-ee-ai ha-o bal bal gur d arsaa-in aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਣਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: No one knows how to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayv na jaanai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the unfathomable, Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gur paarbarahm agochar so-ee.

lines.english: He alone is the Guru's servant, whom the Guru Himself links to His service, and upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay la-ay so sayvak jis vadbhaag mathaa-in aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ  ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਿਜਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ  ਮਥਾਇਣਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Even the Vedas do not know the Guru's Glory.
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa bayd na jaan eh.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They narrate only a tiny bit of what is heard.
lines.transliteration: tuchh  maat  sun sun vakaan eh.

lines.english: The True Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Incomparable One; meditating inremembrance on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed. ||10||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aprampar satgur jis simrat  man seet laa-in aa. ||10||

lines.english: Hearing of Him, the mind comes to life.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee so-ay sunee man jeevai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.english: When He dwells within the heart, one becomes peaceful and cool.
lines.transliteration: ridai vasai t aa thandhaa theevai.

lines.english: Chanting the Guru's Name with the mouth, one obtains glory, and does not have towalk on the Path of Death. ||11||
lines.transliteration: gur mukhahu alaa-ay t aa sobh aa paa-ay t is jam kai panth na paa-in aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ  ਤਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਿਥ ਨ ਪਾਇਣਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Saints,
lines.transliteration: santan kee sarn aa-ee parh i-aa.
jee-o paraan Dh an aagai Dh ari-aa. and placed before them my soul, my breath of life and wealth.

lines.english: I know nothing about service and awareness; please take pity upon this worm. ||12||
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat na jaan aa kaa-ee t um karahu d a-i-aa kirmaa-in aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਕਾਈ  ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ  ਿਕਰਮਾਇਣਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: I am unworthy; please merge me into Yourself.
lines.transliteration: nirgun ka-o sang layho ralaa-ay.

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Grace, and link me to Your service.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi tahlai laa-ay.

lines.english: I wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; washing their feet, I find peace.||13||
lines.transliteration: pakhaa fayra-o peesa-o sant  aagai charan  Dho-ay sukh  paa-in aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਉ  ਪੀਸਉ  ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ  ਚਰਣ  ਧੋਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਣਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: After wandering around at so many doors, I have come to Yours, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: bahut d u-aaray bh aram bh aram aa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Your Grace, I have entered Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay tum sarn aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Forever and ever, keep me in the Company of the Saints; please bless me with thisGift of Your Name. ||14||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sant eh sang raakh o ayhu naam d aan d ayvaa-in aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਤਹ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਣਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: My World-Lord has become merciful,
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal gusaa-ee mayray.
darsan paa-i-aa sat gur pooray. and I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Perfect True Guru.

lines.english: I have found eternal peace, poise and bliss; Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||15||2||7|| mwrU solhy mhlw 5  (1078-18) maaroo solhay mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1078-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj sad aa aanand aa naanak d aas d asaa-in aa. ||15||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣਾ  ॥੧੫॥੨॥੭॥
lines.english: The earth and the Akaashic ethers meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrai Dhart ee ar aakaasaa.

lines.english: The moon and the sun meditate in remembrance on You, O treasure of virtue.
lines.transliteration: simrahi chand sooraj gunt aasaa.

lines.english: Air, water and fire meditate in remembrance. All creation meditates in remembrance. ||1|| pMnw 1079
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant ar simrahi simrai sagal upaarjanaa. ||1||

lines.english: All the continents, islands and worlds meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrahi khand d eep sabh  lo-aa.

lines.english: The nether worlds and spheres meditate in remembrance on that True Lord.
lines.transliteration: simrahi paataal puree-aa sach so-aa.

lines.english: The sources of creation and speech meditate in remembrance; all the Lord's humble servants meditate in remembrance. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simrahi khaan ee simrahi ban ee simrahi saglay har janaa. ||2||

lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrahi barahmay bisan mahaysaa.

lines.english: The three hundred thirty million gods meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrahi dayvt ay korh  tayteesaa.

lines.english: The titans and demons all meditate in remembrance; Your Praises are uncountable -they cannot be counted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: simrahi jakh-y d ait sabh  simrahi agnat  na jaa-ee jas ganaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਜਿਖਯ੍ਯ੍ ਦੈਤ ਸਿਭ ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਅਗਨਤੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਜਸੁ ਗਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All the beasts, birds and demons meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrahi pas pankhee sabh  bhootaa.

lines.english: The forests, mountains and hermits meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrahi ban parbat a-uDh ootaa.

lines.english: All the vines and branches meditate in remembrance; O my Lord and Master, You arepermeating and pervading all minds. ||4||
lines.transliteration: lataa balee saakh  sabh  simrahi rav rahi-aa su-aamee sabh  manaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਲਤਾ  ਬਲੀ  ਸਾਖ ਸਭ ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਭ ਮਨਾ ॥੪॥
lines.english: All beings, both subtle and gross, meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrahi thool sookham sabh  jantaa.

lines.english: The Siddhas and seekers meditate in remembrance on the Lord's Mantra.
lines.transliteration: simrahi siDh saaDh ik har mannt aa.

lines.english: Both the visible and the invisible meditate in remembrance on my God; God is the Master of all worlds. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gupat pargat simrahi parabh  mayray sagal bh avan kaa parabh  Dhanaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਨ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਨਾ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Men and women, throughout the four stages of life, meditate in remembrance on You.
lines.transliteration: simrahi nar naaree aasramaa.

lines.english: All social classes and souls of all races meditate in remembrance on You.
lines.transliteration: simrahi jaat jot  sabh  varnaa.

lines.english: All the virtuous, clever and wise people meditate in remembrance; night and daymeditate in remembrance. ||6||
lines.transliteration: simrahi gunee chat ur sabh  baytay simrahi rain ee ar d inaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਸਿਭ ਬੇਤੇ ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਰੈਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਿਦਨਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Hours, minutes and seconds meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrahi gharh ee moorat  pal nimkh aa.

lines.english: Death and life, and thoughts of purification, meditate in remembrance.
lines.transliteration: simrai kaal akaal such sochaa.

lines.english: The Shaastras, with their lucky signs and joinings, meditate in remembrance; theinvisible cannot be seen, even for an instant. ||7||
lines.transliteration: simrahi sa-un saast ar sanjogaa alakh  na lakh ee-ai ik kh inaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਸਉਣ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਸੰਜੋਗਾ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar su-aamee.

lines.english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa kay ant arjaamee.

lines.english: That person, whom You bless with Your Grace, and link to Your devotional service, wins this invaluable human life. ||8||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis bhagt ee laavhu janam pad aarath so jinaa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਸੋ ਿਜਨਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: He, within whose mind God dwells,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man voothaa parabh  apnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai karam gur kaa jap japnaa. has perfect karma, and chants the Chant of the Guru.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who realizes God pervading deep within all, does not wander crying inreincarnation again. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar so parabh  jaataa bahurh  na jonee bh aram runaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਿਮ  ਰੁਨਾ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Pain, sorrow and doubt run away from that one, within whose mind the Word of theGuru's Shabad abides.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasai man jaa kai. d ookh darad bharam t aa kaa bh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: Intuitive peace, poise and bliss come from the sublime essence of the Naam; theunstruck sound current of the Guru's Bani intuitively vibrates and resounds. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  naam ras anhad  banee sahj Dh unaa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: He alone is wealthy, who meditates on God.
lines.transliteration: so Dhanvant aa jin parabh  Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He alone is honorable, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: so pativant aa jin saaDh sang paa-i-aa.

lines.english: That person, within whose mind the Supreme Lord God abides, has perfect karma,and becomes famous. ||11||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jaa kai man voothaa so poor karammaa naa chh inaa. ||11||

lines.english: The Lord and Master is pervading the water, land and sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al su-aamee so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਿਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੋ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ  ਨਾ ਿਛਨਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: There is no other said to be so.
lines.transliteration: avar na kahee-ai doojaa ko-ee.

lines.english: The ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom has eradicated all doubts; except the OneLord, I do not see any other at all. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan anjan kaati-o bharam saglaa avar na d eesai ayk binaa. ||12||

lines.english: The Lord's Court is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: oochay tay oochaa d arbaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਿਨ  ਕਾਿਟਓ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕ ਿਬਨਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: His limit and extent cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: kahan na jaa-ee ant  na paaraa.

lines.english: The Lord and Master is profoundly deep, unfathomable and unweighable; how can Hebe measured? ||13||
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer athaah su-aamee at ul na jaa-ee ki-aa minaa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Creator; all is created by You.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa tayraa sabh  kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਅਥਾਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਿਕਆ  ਿਮਨਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na ko-ee bee-aa.

lines.english: You alone, God, are in the beginning, the middle and the end. You are the root of theentire expanse. ||14||
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant parabh  toohai sagal pasaaraa t um tanaa. ||14||

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach that person
lines.transliteration: jamdoot  tis nikat na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਮਿਧ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਗਲ  ਪਸਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਤਨਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har keert an gaavai. who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the

lines.english: All desires are fulfilled, for one who listens with his ears to the Praises of God. ||15||
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath taa kay pooran jo sarvan ee parabh  kaa jas sunaa. ||15||

lines.english: You belong to all, and all belong to You, O my true, deep and profound Lord and Master. pMnw 1080
lines.transliteration: too sabh naa kaa sabh  ko tayraa. saachay saahib gahir gambh eeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ  ਜੋ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੁਮ ਮਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੮॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, those humble beings are exalted, who are pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master. ||16||1||8|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1080-1) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak say-ee jan ootam jo bh aaveh su-aamee t um manaa. ||16||1||8||

lines.english: God is the almighty Giver of all peace and joy.
lines.transliteration: parabh samrath sarab sukh  daanaa.

lines.english: Be merciful to me, that I may meditate in remembrance on Your Name.
lines.transliteration: simra-o naam hohu miharvaanaa.

lines.english: The Lord is the Great Giver; all beings and creatures are beggars; His humble servants yearn to beg from Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har daat aa jee-a jant  bhaykhaaree jan baaNchhai jaachangnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ਜਨੁ ਬਛੈ ਜਾਚੰਗਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I beg for the dust of the feet of the humble, that I may be blessed with the supremestatus,
lines.transliteration: maaga-o jan Dhoor param gat  paava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਗਉ  ਜਨ ਧੂਿਰ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee mail mitaava-o. and the filth of countless lifetimes may be erased.

lines.english: The chronic diseases are cured by the medicine of the Lord's Name; I beg to beimbued with the Immaculate Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: deeragh  rog miteh har a-ukh aDh har nirmal raapai mangnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਰਘ  ਰੋਗ ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਅਉਖਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਿਲ  ਰਾਪੈ ਮੰਗਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: With my ears, I listen to the Pure Praises of my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sarvanee sun a-o bimal jas su-aamee.

lines.english: With the Support of the One Lord, I have abandoned corruption, sexuality and desire.
lines.transliteration: aykaa ot taja-o bikh  kaamee.

lines.english: I humbly bow and fall at the feet of Your slaves; I do not hesitate to do good deeds.||3||
lines.transliteration: niv niv paa-ay laga-o daas t ayray kar sukarit  naahee sangnaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਿਵ  ਿਨਿਵ  ਪਾਇ  ਲਗਉ  ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਸੁਿਕਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੰਗਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, with my tongue I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa gun gaavai har t ayray.

lines.english: The sins which I have committed are erased.
lines.transliteration: miteh kamaatay avgun  mayray.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, my mind lives; I am rid of the five oppressive demons. ||4||
lines.transliteration: simar simar su-aamee man jeevai panch doot  taj tangnaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਜ ਤੰਗਨਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Meditating on Your lotus feet, I have come aboard Your boat.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jap bohith charee-ai.

lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: satsang mil saagar t aree-ai.

lines.english: My flower-offering and worship is to realize that the Lord is dwelling alike in all; I shallnot be reincarnated naked again. ||5||
lines.transliteration: archaa bandan har samat  nivaasee baahurh  jon na nangnaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਚਾ  ਬੰਦਨ ਹਿਰ ਸਮਤ  ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਨੰਗਨਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Please make me the slave of Your slaves, O Lord of the world.
lines.transliteration: daas d aasan ko kar layho gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੋ ਕਿਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਗਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the treasure of Grace, merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Meet with your companion and helper, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God; you shallnever be separated from Him again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sakhaa sahaa-ee pooran parmaysur mil kad ay na hovee bh angnaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਿਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਗਨਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind and body, and place them in offering before the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan arap Dh aree har aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਆਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Asleep for countless lifetimes, I have awakened.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa so-i-aa jaagai.

lines.english: He, to whom I belong, is my cherisher and nurturer. I have killed and discarded my murderous self-conceit. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa so-ee partipaalak hat  ti-aagee ha-umai hant naa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕੁ  ਹਿਤ ਿਤਆਗੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਹੰਤਨਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is pervading the water and the land.
lines.transliteration: jal thal pooran antarjaamee.

lines.english: The undeceivable Lord and Master is permeating each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ravi-aa achh al su-aamee.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has demolished the wall of doubt, and now I see the One Lordpervading everywhere. ||8||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh eet kho-ee gur poorai ayk ravi-aa sarbangnaa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮ  ਭੀਿਤ  ਖੋਈ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਰਬੰਗਨਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see God, the ocean of peace.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  paykh a-o parabh  sukh  saagar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's treasure is never exhausted; He is the storehouse of jewels.
lines.transliteration: har tot bh andaar naahee rat naagar.

lines.english: He cannot be seized; He is inaccessible, an d His limits cannot be found. He is realized when the Lord bestows His Grace. ||9||
lines.transliteration: agah agaah kichh mit  nahee paa-ee-ai so boojh ai jis kirpangnaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਹ  ਅਗਾਹ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਕਰਪੰਗਨਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: My heart is cooled, and my mind and body are calmed and soothed.
lines.transliteration: chhaat ee seet al man t an thandhaa.

lines.english: The craving for birth and death is quenched.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee mitvee danjh aa.

lines.english: Grasping hold of my hand, He has lifted me up and out; He has blessed me with His Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||10||
lines.transliteration: kar geh kaadh lee-ay parabh  apunai ami-o Dh aar daristangnaa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਏ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਅਿਮਓ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੰਗਨਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The One and Only Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk ravi-aa sabh th aa-ee.

lines.english: There is none other than Him at all.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa ko-ee naahee.

lines.english: God permeates the beginning, the middle and the end; He has subdued my desiresand doubts. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant parabh  ravi-aa t arisan bujh ee bh armangnaa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਮਿਧ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਬੁਝੀ ਭਰਮੰਗਨਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar gur gobind.

lines.english: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is forever forgiving.
lines.transliteration: gur kartaa gur sad  bakh sand.

lines.english: Meditating, chanting the Guru's Chant, I have obtained the fruits and rewards; in theCompany of the Saints, I have been blessed with the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gur jap jaap japat fal paa-i-aa gi-aan d eepak sant  sangnaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਿਪ ਜਪਤ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਨਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Whatever I see, is my Lord and Master God.
lines.transliteration: jo paykhaa so sabh  kichh  su-aamee.

lines.english: Whatever I hear, is the Bani of God's Word.
lines.transliteration: jo sunnaa so parabh  kee baanee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸੁਨਣਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever I do, You make me do; You are the Sanctuary, the help and support of the Saints, Your children. ||13||
lines.transliteration: jo keeno so tumeh karaa-i-o saran  sahaa-ee sant eh tanaa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ  ਸੋ ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਕਰਾਇਓ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਸੰਤਹ  ਤਨਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The beggar begs, and worships You in adoration.
lines.transliteration: jaachak jaachai tumeh araaDh ai.

lines.english: You are the Purifier of the sinners, O Perfectly Holy Lord God.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan pooran parabh  saaDh ai.

lines.english: Please bless me with this one gift, O treasure of all bliss and virtue; I do not ask foranything else. ||14|| pMnw 1081
lines.transliteration: ayko daan sarab sukh  gun niDh aan mangan nihkinchnaa. ||14||

lines.english: God is the Creator of the body-vessel.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa paatar parabh  karnaihaaraa.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, the dye is produced.
lines.transliteration: lagee laag sant sangaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸੋਇ ਬਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਬਾਣੀ  ਮਨੁ ਨਾਿਮ ਮਜੀਠੈ  ਰੰਗਨਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Lord's Bani, one's reputation becomes immaculate, and the mind is colored by the dye of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||15||
lines.transliteration: nirmal so-ay banee har ban ee man naam majeeth ai rangnaa. ||15||

lines.english: The sixteen powers, absolute perfection and fruitful rewards are obtained,
lines.transliteration: solah kalaa sampooran fali-aa.
anat kalaa ho-ay th aakur charh i-aa. when the Lord and Master of infinite power is revealed.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ  ॥੧੬॥੨॥੯॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is Nanak's bliss, play and peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord. ||16||2||9|| mwrU solhy mhlw 5  (1081-4) maaroo solhay mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Solhas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1081-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: anad binod  har naam sukh  naanak amrit  ras har bh unchanaa. ||16||2||9||

lines.english: You are my Lord and Master; You have made me Your servant.
lines.transliteration: too saahib ha-o sayvak keet aa.

lines.english: My soul and body are all gifts from You.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t ayraa d eetaa.

lines.english: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes; nothing belongs to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan sabh t oohai t oohai hai naahee kichh  asaarh aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨ  ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When You sent me, I came into the world.
lines.transliteration: tumeh path aa-ay t aa jag meh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਪਠਾਏ  ਤਾ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, I do.
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaanaa say karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਸੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, nothing is done, so I am not anxious at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar kichh oo na ho-aa t aa bh ee naahee kichh  kaarh aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਹੋਆ  ਤਾ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਾੜਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the world hereafter, the Hukam of Your Command is heard.
lines.transliteration: oohaa hukam tumaaraa sun ee-ai.

lines.english: In this world, I chant Your Praises, Lord.
lines.transliteration: eehaa har jas tayraa bh anee-ai.

lines.english: You Yourself write the account, and You Yourself erase it; no one can argue with You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay laykh alaykh ai aapay t um si-o naahee kichh  jhaarhaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਤੁਮ ਿਸਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਝਾੜਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are our father; we are all Your children.
lines.transliteration: too pit aa sabh  baarik thaaray.

lines.english: We play as You cause us to play.
lines.transliteration: ji-o khaylaaveh t i-o kh aylanhaaray.

lines.english: The wilderness and the path are all made by You. No one can take the wrong path.||4||
lines.transliteration: ujharh  maarag sabh  tum hee keenaa chalai naahee ko vaypaarh aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਉਝੜ  ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ  ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋ ਵੇਪਾੜਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Some remain seated within their homes.
lines.transliteration: ik baisaa-ay rakhay garih ant ar.

lines.english: Some wander across the country and through foreign lands.
lines.transliteration: ik pathaa-ay d ays disant ar.

lines.english: Some are grass-cutters, and some are kings. Who among these can be called false? ||5||
lines.transliteration: ik hee ka-o ghaas ik hee ka-o raajaa in meh kahee-ai ki-aa koorh aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਘਾਸੁ  ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜਾ  ਇਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੂੜਾ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Who is liberated, and who will land in hell?
lines.transliteration: kavan so muktee kavan so narkaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੀ  ਕਵਨ  ਸੁ ਨਰਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: Who is worldly, and who is a devotee?
lines.transliteration: kavan saisaaree kavan so bhagt aa.

lines.english: Who is wise, and who is shallow? Who is aware, and who is ignorant? ||6||
lines.transliteration: kavan so daanaa kavan so hochh aa kavan so surt aa kavan jarh aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਸੁ ਦਾਨਾ  ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਕਵਨ  ਸੁ ਸੁਰਤਾ  ਕਵਨੁ ਜੜਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is liberated, and by His Hukam, one fallsinto hell.
lines.transliteration: hukmay muktee hukmay narkaa.

lines.english: By His Hukam, one is worldly, and by His Hukam, one is a devotee.
lines.transliteration: hukam saisaaree hukmay bhagt aa.

lines.english: By His Hukam, one is shallow, and by His Hukam, one is wise. There is no other sideexcept His. ||7||
lines.transliteration: hukmay hochhaa hukmay d aanaa d oojaa naahee avar Dh arhaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਛਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਾਨਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਵਰੁ ਧੜਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: You made the ocean vast and huge.
lines.transliteration: saagar keenaa at t um bh aaraa.

lines.english: You made some into foolish self-willed manmukhs, and dragged them into hell.
lines.transliteration: ik kharh ay rasaat al kar manmukh  gaavaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਖੜੇ ਰਸਾਤਿਲ  ਕਿਰ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਗਾਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some are carried across, in the ship of Truth of the True Guru. ||8||
lines.transliteration: iknaa paar langhaaveh aapay sat gur jin kaa sach bayrh aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਵਿਹ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੇੜਾ ॥੮॥
lines.english: You issue Your Command for this amazing thing, death.
lines.transliteration: ka-utak kaal ih hukam path aa-i-aa.

lines.english: You create all beings and creatures, and absorb them back into Yourself.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant opaa-ay samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You gaze in delight upon the one arena of the world, and enjoy all the pleasures. ||9||
lines.transliteration: vaykhai vigsai sabh  rang maan ay rachan keenaa ik aakh aarhaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਖੈ ਿਵਗਸੈ  ਸਿਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ  ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ  ਇਕੁ ਆਖਾੜਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Great is the Lord and Master, and Great is His Name.
lines.transliteration: vadaa saahib vadee naa-ee.

lines.english: He is the Great Giver; Great is His place.
lines.transliteration: vad daat aar vadee jis jaa-ee.

lines.english: He is inaccessible and unfathomable, infinite and unweighable. He cannot bemeasureed. ||10||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar bay-ant at olaa hai naahee kichh  aahaarh aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਅਤੋਲਾ  ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਹਾੜਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: No one else knows His value.
lines.transliteration: keemat ko-ay na jaan ai doojaa.

lines.english: Only You Yourself, O Immaculate Lord, are equal to Yourself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap niranjan poojaa.

lines.english: You Yourself are the spiritual teacher, You Yourself are the One who meditates. You Yourself are the great and immense Being of Truth. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aap so gi-aanee aap Dhi-aanee aap sat vantaa at gaarh aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਸੁ ਿਗਆਨੀ ਆਿਪ  ਿਧਆਨੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਤਵੰਤਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਗਾੜਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: For so many days, You remained invisible.
lines.transliteration: kayt-rh i-aa d in gupat  kahaa-i-aa.

lines.english: For so many days, You were absorbed in silent absorption.
lines.transliteration: kayt-rh i-aa d in sunn samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: For so many days, there was only pitch darkness, and then the Creator revealedHimself. ||12||
lines.transliteration: kayt-rh i-aa d in DhunDh ookaaraa aapay kart aa pargatrh aa. ||12||

lines.english: You Yourself are called the God of Supreme Power. pMnw 1082
lines.transliteration: aapay saktee sabal kahaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself are the hero, exerting Your regal power.
lines.transliteration: aapay sooraa amar chalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself spread peace within; You are cool and icy calm. ||13||
lines.transliteration: aapay siv vartaa-ee-an ant ar aapay seet al thaar garh aa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਿਸਵ ਵਰਤਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਠਾਰੁ ਗੜਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: One whom You bless and make Gurmukh
lines.transliteration: jisahi nivaajay gurmukh saajay.
naam vasai tis anhad  vaajay. - the Naam abides within him, and the unstruck sound current vibrates for him.

lines.english: He is peaceful, and he is the master of all; the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||14||
lines.transliteration: tis hee sukh  tis hee th akuraa-ee t iseh na aavai jam nayrh aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: His value cannot be described on paper.
lines.transliteration: keemat kaagad  kahee na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord of the world is infinite.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bay-ant gusaa-ee.

lines.english: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God exists. Judgement is in His Handsalone. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant parabh  so-ee haath t isai kai naybayrh aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ ਮਿਧ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਾਿਥ  ਿਤਸੈ ਕੈ ਨੇਬੇੜਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: No one is equal to Him.
lines.transliteration: tiseh sareek naahee ray ko-ee.

lines.english: No one can stand up against Him by any means.
lines.transliteration: kis hee butai jabaab na ho-ee.

lines.english: Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. He creates and stages and watches His wondrousplays. ||16||1||10|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1082-5) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa parabh aapay aapay kar kar vaykh ai choj kh arhaa. ||16||1||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਚੋਜ ਖੜਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is imperishable, the Transcendent Lord, the Inner-knower, theSearcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: achut paarbarahm parmaysur ant arjaamee.

lines.english: He is the Slayer of demons, our Supreme Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: maDhusood an daamod ar su-aamee.

lines.english: The Supreme Rishi, the Master of the sensory organs, the uplifter of mountains, the joyful Lord playing His enticing flute. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rikheekays govarDh an Dh aaree murlee manohar har rangaa. ||1||

lines.english: The Enticer of Hearts, the Lord of wealth, Krishna, the Enemy of ego.
lines.transliteration: mohan maaDhav krisan muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਖੀਕੇਸ  ਗੋਵਰਧਨ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਮੁਰਲੀ ਮਨੋਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, the Dear Lord, the Destroyer of demons.
lines.transliteration: jagdeesur har jee-o asur sangh aaray.

lines.english: The Life of the World, our eternal and ever-stable Lord and Master dwells within eachand every heart, and is always with us. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan abhinaasee th aakur gh at ghat vaasee hai sangaa. ||2||

lines.english: Dharn eeDhar ees narsingh  naaraa-in . The Support of the Earth, the man-lion, the Supreme Lord God.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ  ਹੈ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Protector who tears apart demons with His teeth, the Upholder of the earth.
lines.transliteration: daarh aa agray paritham Dh araa-in .

lines.english: O Creator, You assumed the form of the pygmy to humble the demons; You are the Lord God of all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: baavan roop kee-aa tuDh  kartay sabh  hee sayt ee hai changa. ||3||

lines.english: You are the Great Raam Chand, who has no form or feature.
lines.transliteration: saree raamchand jis roop na raykh -i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਵਨ  ਰੂਪੁ ਕੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੰਗਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Adorned with flowers, holding the chakra in Your hand, Your form is incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: banvaalee chakarpaan d aras anoopi-aa.

lines.english: You have thousands of eyes, and thousands of forms. You alone are the Giver, and allare beggars of You. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sahas naytar moorat  hai sahsaa ik d aataa sabh  hai mangaa. ||4||

lines.english: You are the Lover of Your devotees, the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al anaathah naathay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ  ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭ ਹੈ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master of the milk-maids, You are the companion of all.
lines.transliteration: gopee naath sagal hai saathay.

lines.english: O Lord, Immacuate Great Giver, I cannot describe even an iota of Your GloriousVirtues. ||5||
lines.transliteration: baasudayv niranjan d aatay baran na saaka-o gun  angaa. ||5||

lines.english: Liberator, Enticing Lord, Lord of Lakshmi, Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: mukand manohar lakh mee naaraa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਗੁਣ ਅੰਗਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Savior of Dropadi's honor.
lines.transliteration: daropat ee lajaa nivaar uDh aaran .

lines.english: Lord of Maya, miracle-worker, absorbed in delightful play, unattached. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kamlaakant karahi kant oohal anad  binod ee nihsangaa. ||6||

lines.english: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; He is not born, He is self-existent.
lines.transliteration: amogh d arsan aajoonee sambh a-o.

lines.english: His form is undying; it is never destroyed.
lines.transliteration: akaal moorat jis kad ay naahee kh a-o.

lines.english: O imperishable, eternal, unfathomable Lord, everything is attached to You. ||7||
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee abigat  agochar sabh  kichh  tujh hee hai lagaa. ||7||

lines.english: The Lover of greatness, who dwells in heaven.
lines.transliteration: sareerang baikunth kay vaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਅਿਬਗਤ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਲਗਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He took incarnation as the great fish and the tortoise.
lines.transliteration: machh kachh  kooram aagi-aa a-ut raasee.

lines.english: The Lord of beauteous hair, the Worker of miraculous deeds, whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||8||
lines.transliteration: kaysav chalat karahi niraalay keet aa lorh eh so ho-igaa. ||8||

lines.english: He is beyond need of any sustenance, free of hate and all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: niraahaaree nirvair samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਸਵ  ਚਲਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਨਰਾਲੇ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਸੋ ਹੋਇਗਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Dhaar kh ayl chat urbhuj kahaa-i-aa. He has staged His play; He is called the four-armed Lord.
He assumed the beautiful form of the blue-skinned Krishna; hearing His flute, all arefascinated and enticed. ||9||
lines.transliteration: saaval sundar roop ban aaveh bayn  sunat  sabh  mohaigaa. ||9||

lines.english: He is adorned with garlands of flowers, with lotus eyes.
lines.transliteration: banmaalaa bibhookh an kamal nain.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਲ  ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਰੂਪ ਬਣਾਵਿਹ  ਬੇਣੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੈਗਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: His ear-rings, crown and flute are so beautiful.
lines.transliteration: sundar kundal mukat bain.

lines.english: He carries the conch, the chakra and the war club; He is the Great Charioteer, who stays with His Saints. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sankh chakar gad aa hai Dh aaree mahaa saarthee sat sangaa. ||10||

lines.english: The Lord of yellow robes, the Master of the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: peet peet ambar t aribhavan Dhanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕਰ੍ ਗਦਾ  ਹੈ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਰਥੀ  ਸਤਸੰਗਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the world; with my mouth, I chant His Name.
lines.transliteration: jagannaath gopaal mukh bh anee.

lines.english: The Archer who draws the bow, the Beloved Lord God; I cannot count all His limbs.||11||
lines.transliteration: saaringDhar bh agvaan beeth ulaa mai gan at na aavai sarbangaa. ||11||

lines.english: He is said to be free of anguish, and absolutely immaculate.
lines.transliteration: nihkantak nihkayval kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਰੰਗਧਰ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ਬੀਠੁਲਾ  ਮੈ ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਸਰਬੰਗਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Dhananjai jal thal hai mahee-ai. The Lord of prosperity, pervading the water, the land and the sky. pMnw 1083
He is near this world and the nether regions of the underworld; His Place is permanent, ever-stable and imperishable. ||12||
lines.transliteration: mirat lok pa-i-aal sameepat  asthir thaan jis hai abh gaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰਤ  ਲੋਕ ਪਇਆਲ  ਸਮੀਪਤ  ਅਸਿਥਰ  ਥਾਨੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਭਗਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Purifier of sinners, the Destroyer of pain and fear.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan d ukh bhai bhanjan.

lines.english: The Eliminator of egotism, the Eradicator of coming and going.
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaar nivaaran hai bh av kh andan.

lines.english: He is pleased with devotional worship, and merciful to the meek; He cannot be appeased by any other qualities. ||13||
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee tokhit deen kirpaalaa gun ay na kit  hee hai bh igaa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੀ  ਤੋਿਖਤ  ਦੀਨ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲਾ  ਗੁਣੇ ਨ ਿਕਤ  ਹੀ ਹੈ ਿਭਗਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The Formless Lord is undeceivable and unchanging.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar achhal adolo.

lines.english: He is the Embodiment of Light; through Him, the whole world blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: jot saroopee sabh  jag ma-ulo.

lines.english: He alone unites with Him, whom He unites with Himself. No one can attain the Lordby himself. ||14||
lines.transliteration: so milai jis aap milaa-ay aaphu ko-ay na paavaigaa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: He Himself is the milk-maid, and He Himself is Krishna.
lines.transliteration: aapay gopee aapay kaanaa.

lines.english: He Himself grazes the cows in the forest.
lines.transliteration: aapay ga-oo charaavai baanaa.

lines.english: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy. Not even a particle of filth attaches to You. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aap upaaveh aap khapaaveh t uDh layp nahee ik t il rangaa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਵਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਖਪਾਵਿਹ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I chant with my one tongue?
lines.transliteration: ayk jeeh gun kavan bakh aanai.

lines.english: Even the thousand-headed serpent does not know Your limit.
lines.transliteration: sahas fanee saykh ant  na jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਫਨੀ ਸੇਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: One may chant new names for You day and night, but even so, O God, no one can describe even one of Your Glorious Virtues. ||16||
lines.transliteration: navtan naam japai d in raat ee ik gun  naahee parabh  kahi sangaa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਨਵਤਨ  ਨਾਮ ਜਪੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਇਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਿਹ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I have grasped the Support, and entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Father of theworld.
lines.transliteration: ot gahee jagat pit  sarnaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death is terrifying and horrendous, and sea of Maya is impassable.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh a-i-aanak jamd oot dutar hai maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭਇਆਨਕ  ਜਮਦੂਤ  ਦੁਤਰ  ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please be merciful, Lord, and save me, if it is Your Will; please lead me to join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||17||
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal ichhaa kar raakh o saaDh  santan kai sang sangaa. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਇਛਾ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: All that is seen is an illusion.
lines.transliteration: daristimaan hai sagal mithaynaa.

lines.english: I beg for this one gift, for the dust of the feet of the Saints, O Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ik maaga-o daan gobid  sant raynaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ  ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Applying it to my forehead, I obtain the supreme status; he alone obtains it, untowhom You give it. ||18||
lines.transliteration: mastak laa-ay param pad  paava-o jis paraapat  so paavaigaa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲਾਇ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਉ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਪਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Those, unto whom the Lord, the Giver of peace, grants His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o kirpaa karee sukh-d aatay.
tin saaDh oo charan  lai rid ai paraat ay. grasp the feet of the Holy, and weave them into their hearts.

lines.english: They obtain all the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within their minds. ||19||
lines.transliteration: sagal naam niDhaan t in paa-i-aa anhad  sabad  man vaajangaa. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਨਾਮ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਿਤਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦ  ਮਿਨ ਵਾਜੰਗਾ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: With my tongue I chant the Names given to You.
lines.transliteration: kirtam naam kathay t ayray jihbaa.

lines.english: 'Sat Naam' is Your perfect, primal Name.
lines.transliteration: sat naam t ayraa paraa poorbalaa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, Your devotees have entered Your Sanctuary. Please bestow the BlessedVision of Your Darshan; their minds are filled with love for You. ||20||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhagat  pa-ay sarn aa-ee d ayh d aras man rang lagaa. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: You alone know Your state and extent.
lines.transliteration: tayree gat  mit toohai jaan eh.

lines.english: You Yourself speak, and You Yourself describe it.
lines.transliteration: too aapay katheh t ai aap vakaan eh.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਕਥਿਹ  ਤੈ ਆਿਪ  ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Please make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, O Lord; as it pleases Your Will, pleasekeep him with Your slaves. ||21||2||11|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1083-13) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas d aasan ko karee-ahu har bh aavai d aasaa raakh  sangaa. ||21||2||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਾਸਾ  ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਗਾ  ॥੨੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.english: O slave of the inaccessible Lord God Allah,
lines.transliteration: alah agam khud aa-ee band ay.
chhod kh i-aal d unee-aa kay Dh anDhay. forsake thoughts of worldly entanglements.

lines.english: Become the dust of the feet of the humble fakeers, and consider yourself a travelleron this journey. O saintly dervish, you shall be approved in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay pai khaak fakeer musaafar ih d arvays kabool d araa. ||1||

lines.english: Let Truth be your prayer, and faith your prayer-mat.
lines.transliteration: sach nivaaj yakeen muslaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਪੈ ਖਾਕ ਫਕੀਰ  ਮੁਸਾਫਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ  ਕਬੂਲੁ  ਦਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Subdue your desires, and overcome your hopes.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maar nivaarihu aasaa.

lines.english: Let your body be the mosque, and your mind the priest. Let true purity be God's Wordfor you. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dayh maseet  man ma-ulaan aa kalam kh udaa-ee paak kh araa. ||2||

lines.english: Let your practice be to live the spiritual life.
lines.transliteration: saraa saree-at lay kammaavahu.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਮਸੀਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਣਾ  ਕਲਮ  ਖੁਦਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ਖਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let your spiritual cleansing be to renounce the world and seek God.
lines.transliteration: tareekat  tarak kh oj tolaavahu.

lines.english: Let control of the mind be your spiritual wisdom, O holy man; meeting with God, you shall never die again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maarfat man maarahu abd aalaa milhu hakeekat  jit fir na maraa. ||3||

lines.english: Practice within your heart the teachings of the Koran and the Bible;
lines.transliteration: kuraan kat ayb d il maahi kamaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਫਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਅਬਦਾਲਾ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਹਕੀਕਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਫਿਰ  ਨ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: das a-uraat  rakhahu bad  raahee. restrain the ten sensory organs from straying into evil.

lines.english: Tie up the five demons of desire with faith, charity and contentment, and you shall beacceptable. ||4||
lines.transliteration: panch marad sid ak lay baaDh hu kh air sabooree kabool paraa. ||4||

lines.english: Let compassion be your Mecca, and the dust of the feet of the holy your fast.
lines.transliteration: makaa mihar rojaa pai khaakaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਮਰਦ  ਿਸਦਿਕ  ਲੇ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਖੈਿਰ ਸਬੂਰੀ  ਕਬੂਲ  ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Let Paradise be your practice of the Prophet's Word.
lines.transliteration: bhisat  peer lafaj kamaa-ay and aajaa.

lines.english: God is the beauty, the light and the fragrance. Meditation on Allah is the secludedmeditation chamber. ||5|| pMnw 1084
lines.transliteration: hoor noor musak khud aa-i-aa band agee alah aalaa hujraa. ||5||

lines.english: He alone is a Qazi, who practices the Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach kamaavai so-ee kaajee.

lines.english: He alone is a Haji, a pilgrim to Mecca, who purifies his heart.
lines.transliteration: jo dil soDh ai so-ee haajee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾ  ਮਲਊਨ  ਿਨਵਾਰੈ  ਸੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਧਰਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: He alone is a Mullah, who banishes evil; he alone is a saintly dervish, who takes the Support of the Lord's Praise. ||6||
lines.transliteration: so mulaa mala-oon nivaarai so darvays jis sifat  Dharaa. ||6||

lines.english: Always, at every moment, remember God, the Creator within your heart.
lines.transliteration: sabhay vakh at sabh ay kar vaylaa. kh aalak yaad  dilai meh ma-ulaa.

lines.english: Let your meditation beads be the subjugation of the ten senses. Let good conduct andself-restraint be your circumcision. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tasbee yaad  karahu d as mard an sunat  seel banDh aan baraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤਸਬੀ  ਯਾਿਦ  ਕਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿਤ  ਸੀਲੁ  ਬੰਧਾਿਨ  ਬਰਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: You must know in your heart that everything is temporary.
lines.transliteration: dil meh jaanhu sabh  filhaalaa.

lines.english: Family, household and siblings are all entanglements.
lines.transliteration: khilkh aanaa biraad ar hamoo janjaalaa.

lines.english: Kings, rulers and nobles are mortal and transitory; only God's Gate is the permanentplace. ||8||
lines.transliteration: meer malak umray faanaa-i-aa ayk mukaam khud aa-ay d araa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ  ਉਮਰੇ  ਫਾਨਾਇਆ  ਏਕ ਮੁਕਾਮ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਦਰਾ ॥੮॥
lines.english: First, is the Lord's Praise; second, contentment;
lines.transliteration: aval sifat d oojee saabooree.
teejai halaymee cha-uthai kh airee. third, humility, and fourth, giving to charities.

lines.english: Fifth is to hold one's desires in restraint. These are the five most sublime daily prayers. ||9||
lines.transliteration: punjvai panjay ikat mukaamai ayhi panj vakh at tayray aparparaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਜਵੈ  ਪੰਜੇ ਇਕਤੁ  ਮੁਕਾਮੈ  ਏਿਹ ਪੰਿਜ ਵਖਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Let your daily worship be the knowledge that God is everywhere.
lines.transliteration: saglee jaan karahu ma-udeefaa.

lines.english: Let renunciation of evil actions be the water-jug you carry.
lines.transliteration: bad amal chh od karahu hath koojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਦ ਅਮਲ  ਛੋਿਡ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਥ ਕੂਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let realization of the One Lord God be your call to prayer; be a good child of God - letthis be your trumpet. ||10||
lines.transliteration: khudaa-ay ayk bujh  dayvhu baaNgaaN burgoo barkh urdaar kh araa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਏਕੁ ਬੁਿਝ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਬਗ ਬੁਰਗੂ  ਬਰਖੁਰਦਾਰ  ਖਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Let what is earned righteously be your blessed food.
lines.transliteration: hak halaal bakhorahu kh aanaa.

lines.english: Wash away pollution with the river of your heart.
lines.transliteration: dil daree-aa-o Dh ovahu mailaan aa.

lines.english: One who realizes the Prophet attains heaven. Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death,does not cast him into hell. ||11||
lines.transliteration: peer pachhaan ai bhistee so-ee ajraa-eel na d oj tharaa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਿਭਸਤੀ  ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ  ਨ ਦੋਜ ਠਰਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Let good deeds be your body, and faith your bride.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa kirdaar a-urat  yakeenaa.

lines.english: Play and enjoy the Lord's love and delight.
lines.transliteration: rang tamaasay maan  hakeenaa.

lines.english: Purify what is impure, and let the Lord's Presence be your religious tradition. Let your total awareness be the turban on your head. ||12||
lines.transliteration: naapaak paak kar hadoor had eesaa saabat  soorat  dastaar siraa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਪਾਕ  ਪਾਕੁ ਕਿਰ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਹਦੀਸਾ  ਸਾਬਤ  ਸੂਰਿਤ  ਦਸਤਾਰ  ਿਸਰਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: To be Muslim is to be kind-hearted,
lines.transliteration: musalmaan mom d il hovai.
antar kee mal d il tay Dh ovai. and wash away pollution from within the heart.

lines.english: He does not even approach worldly pleasures; he is pure, like flowers, silk, ghee and the deer-skin. ||13||
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa rang na aavai nayrh ai ji-o kusam paat gh i-o paak haraa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਰੰਗ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨੇੜੈ ਿਜਉ ਕੁਸਮ  ਪਾਟੁ ਿਘਉ ਪਾਕੁ ਹਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the mercy and compassion of the Merciful Lord,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o mihar mihar miharvaanaa.
so-ee marad marad  mard aanaa. is the manliest man among men.

lines.english: He alone is a Shaykh, a preacher, a Haji, and he alone is God's slave, who is blessedwith God's Grace. ||14||
lines.transliteration: so-ee saykh masaa-ik haajee so band aa jis najar naraa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਖੁ ਮਸਾਇਕੁ ਹਾਜੀ  ਸੋ ਬੰਦਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਨਜਿਰ  ਨਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
