lines.english: The Creator Lord has Creative Power; the Merciful Lord has Mercy.
lines.transliteration: kudrat  kaad ar karan  kareemaa.

lines.english: The Praises and the Love of the Merciful Lord are unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: sifat muhabat  athaah raheemaa.

lines.english: Realize the True Hukam, the Command of the Lord, O Nanak; you shall be released from bondage, and carried across. ||15||3||12|| mwrU mhlw 5 ] (1084-13) maaroo mehlaa 5. Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hak hukam sach khud aa-i-aa bujh  naanak band  khalaas t araa. ||15||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ  ਬੁਿਝ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੰਿਦ ਖਲਾਸ  ਤਰਾ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Abode of the Supreme Lord God is above all.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm sabh ooch biraajay.

lines.english: He Himself establishes, establishes and creates.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaapay saajay.

lines.english: Holding tight to the Sanctuary of God, peace is found, and one is not afflicted by thefear of Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee saran  gahat  sukh  paa-ee-ai kichh  bha-o na vi-aapai baal kaa. ||1||

lines.english: He saved you from the fire of the womb,
lines.transliteration: garabh agan meh jineh ubaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਣ  ਗਹਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਭਉ ਨ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ਬਾਲ  ਕਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: rakat kiram meh nahee sangh aari-aa. and did not destroy you, when you were an egg in your mother's ovary.

lines.english: Blessing you with meditative remembrance upon Himself, He nurtured you andcherished you; He is the Master of all hearts. ||2||
lines.transliteration: apnaa simran day part ipaali-aa oh sagal gh ataa kaa maalkaa. ||2||

lines.english: I have come to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sarn aa-ee aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਿਲਆ  ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲ  ਘਟਾ  ਕਾ ਮਾਲਕਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang hai har jas gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have erased all the pains of birth and death; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have no fear of death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam maran sabh  dookh nivaaray jap har har bh a-o nahee kaal kaa. ||3||

lines.english: God is all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable and divine.
lines.transliteration: samrath akath agochar dayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਸਿਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲ  ਕਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures serve Him.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  taa kee sayvaa.

lines.english: In so many ways, He cherishes those born from eggs, from the womb, from sweatand from the earth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: andaj jayraj saytaj ut -bhuj baho parkaaree paalkaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: He alone obtains this wealth,
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  ho-ay niDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਡਜ  ਜੇਰਜ  ਸੇਤਜ  ਉਤਭੁਜ  ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਾਲਕਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ras antar maanaa. who savors and enjoys, deep within his mind, the Name of the Lord.

lines.english: Grasping hold of his arm, God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit. Such a devotee of the Lord is very rare. ||5|| pMnw 1085
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay anDh koop t ay virlay kay-ee saalkaa. ||5||

lines.english: God exists in the beginning, in the middle and in the end.
lines.transliteration: aad ant  maDh  parabh  so-ee.

lines.english: Whatever the Creator Lord Himself does, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay so ho-ee.

lines.english: Doubt and fear are erased, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and then one is not afflicted by deadly pain. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh a-o miti-aa saaDh sang t ay daalid na ko-ee gh aalkaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗ  ਤੇ ਦਾਿਲਦ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਘਾਲਕਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I sing the most Sublime Bani, the Word of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ootam ban ee gaa-o gopaalaa.

lines.english: I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kee mangahu ravaalaa.

lines.english: Eradicating desire, I have become free of desire; I have burnt away all my sins. ||7||
lines.transliteration: baasan mayt nibaasan ho-ee-ai kalmal saglay jaalkaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਸਨ  ਮੇਿਟ ਿਨਬਾਸਨ  ਹੋਈਐ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਜਾਲਕਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: This is the unique way of the Saints;
lines.transliteration: santaa kee ih reet  niraalee.
paarbarahm kar daykh eh naalee. they behold the Supreme Lord God with them.

lines.english: With each and every breath, they worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. How couldanyone be too lazy to meditate on Him? ||8||
lines.transliteration: saas saas aaraaDhan har har ki-o simrat  keejai aalkaa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਆਰਾਧਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਉ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਕੀਜੈ ਆਲਕਾ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah ant arjaamee.

lines.english: I never forget God, my Lord and Master, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: nimakh na visrahu parabh  mayray su-aamee.

lines.english: Your slaves live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord; You are permeating the woods, the water and the land. ||9||
lines.transliteration: simar simar jeeveh tayray d aasaa ban jal pooran thaalkaa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ  ਬਿਨ ਜਿਲ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਥਾਲਕਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Even the hot wind does not touch one
lines.transliteration: tatee vaa-o na t aa ka-o laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੀ  ਵਾਉ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: simrat naam an-d in jaagai. who remains awake in meditative remembrance, night and day.

lines.english: He delights and enjoys meditative remembrance on the Lord; he has no attachment toMaya. ||10||
lines.transliteration: anad binod  karay har simran t is maa-i-aa sang na t aalkaa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਤਾਲਕਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Disease, sorrow and pain do not affect him;
lines.transliteration: rog sog dookh  tis naahee.
saaDhsang har keert an gaahee. he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly.

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Name, O my Beloved Lord God; please listen to my prayer,O Creator. ||11||
lines.transliteration: aapnaa naam d eh parabh  pareet am sun  baynant ee kh aalkaa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸੁਿਣ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਖਾਲਕਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is a jewel, O my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan t ayraa hai pi-aaray.

lines.english: Your slaves are imbued with Your Infinite Love.
lines.transliteration: rang ratay t ayrai d aas apaaray.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with Your Love, become like You; it is so rare that they are found. ||12||
lines.transliteration: tayrai rang rat ay tuDh jayhay virlay kay-ee bh aalkaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹੇ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਕੇਈ ਭਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: My mind longs for the dust of the feet of those
lines.transliteration: tin kee Dh oorh maaNgai man mayraa.
jin visrahi naahee kaahoo bayraa. who never forget the Lord.

lines.english: Associating with them, I obtain the supreme status; the Lord, my Companion, isalways with me. ||13||
lines.transliteration: tin kai sang param pad  paa-ee sad aa sangee har naalkaa. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ  ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਲਕਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: He alone is my beloved friend and companion,
lines.transliteration: saajan meet pi-aaraa so-ee.
ayk drirh-aa-ay d urmat  kho-ee. who implants the Name of the One Lord within, and eradicates evil-mindedness.

lines.english: Immaculate are the teachings of that humble servant of the Lord, who casts outsexual desire, anger and egotism. ||14||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar t ajaa-ay t is jan ka-o upd ays nirmaalkaa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਾਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਿਨਰਮਾਲਕਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Other than You, O Lord, no one is mine.
lines.transliteration: tuDh vin naahee ko-ee mayraa.

lines.english: The Guru has led me to grasp the feet of God.
lines.transliteration: gur pakrhaa-ay parabh  kay pairaa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru, who has destroyed the illusion of duality. ||15||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree satgur pooray jin kh andi-aa bh aram anaalkaa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਰੇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਖੰਿਡਆ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਅਨਾਲਕਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: With each and every breath, I never forget God.
lines.transliteration: saas saas parabh bisrai naahee.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har har ka-o Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Saints are imbued with Your Love; You are the great and all-powerfulLord. ||16||4||13|| mwrU mhlw 5  (1085-16) maaroo mehlaa 5 Maaroo, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1085-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sant t ayrai rang raat ay too samrath vadaalkaa. ||16||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਵਡਾਲਕਾ  ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: I enshrine the Lord's lotus feet continually within my heart.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal hirdai nit  Dhaaree.

lines.english: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa khin kh in namaskaaree.

lines.english: I dedicate my body, mind and everything, and place it in offering before the Lord. His Name is the most beautiful in this world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tan man arap Dh aree sabh  aagai jag meh naam suhaavan aa. ||1||

lines.english: Why forget the Lord and Master from your mind?
lines.transliteration: so thaakur ki-o manhu visaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He blessed you with body and soul, creating and embellishing you.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind day saaj savaaray.

lines.english: With every breath and morsel of food, the Creator takes care of His beings, whoreceive according to what they have done. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saas garaas samaalay kartaa keet aa apn aa paavn aa. ||2||

lines.english: No one returns empty-handed from Him;
lines.transliteration: jaa tay birthaa ko-oo naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਸ  ਗਰਾਿਸ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਪਾਵਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har rakh  man maahee. twenty-four hours a day, keep the Lord in your mind. pMnw 1086

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਭਜੁ ਅਚੁਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate and vibrate upon your imperishable Lord and Master, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh aj achut  su-aamee d argeh sobh aa paavn aa. ||3||

lines.english: The four great blessings, and the eighteen miraculous spiritual powers,
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat d asaa siDh .
naam niDhaan sahj sukh  na-o niDh . are found in the treasure of the Naam, which brings celestial peace and poise, and the nine treasures.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਜੇ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਚਾਹਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਰਾਵਣਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: If you yearn in your mind for all joys, then join the Saadh Sangat, and dwell uponyour Lord and Master. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aan jay man meh chaaheh mil saaDh oo su-aamee raavn aa. ||4||

lines.english: The Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas proclaim
lines.transliteration: saasat simrit  bayd  vakh aanee.
janam padaarath jeet  paraan ee. that the mortal must be victorious in this priceless human life.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਪਰਹਰੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗਾਵਣਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Forsaking sexual desire, anger and slander, sing of the Lord with your tongue, ONanak. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh nind aa parharee-ai har rasnaa naanak gaavn aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: He has no form or shape, no ancestry or social class.
lines.transliteration: jis roop na raykh-i-aa kul nahee jaat ee.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading day and night.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-aa din raat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵਣਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Whoever meditates on Him is very fortunate; he is not consigned to reincarnationagain. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jo jo japai so-ee vadbhaagee bahurh  na jonee paavn aa. ||6||

lines.english: One who forgets the Primal Lord, the Architect of karma,
lines.transliteration: jis no bisrai purakh biDh aataa.
jaltaa firai rahai nit  taataa. wanders around burning, and remains tormented.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਕਰਤਘਣੈ  ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਰਕ  ਘੋਰ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਵਣਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: No one can save such an ungrateful person; he is thrown into the most horrible hell. ||7||
lines.transliteration: akirat-gh anai ka-o rakh ai na ko-ee narak gh or meh paavn aa. ||7||

lines.english: He blessed you with your soul, the breath of life, your body and wealth;
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan t an Dh an jin saaji-aa.

lines.english: He preserved and nurtured you in your mother's womb.
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  meh raakh  nivaaji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਛਾਿਡ  ਅਨ ਰਾਤਾ  ਕਾਹੂ ਿਸਰੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Forsaking His Love, you are imbued with another; you shall never achieve your goalslike this. ||8||
lines.transliteration: tis si-o pareet  chhaad an raat aa kaahoo sirai na laavn aa. ||8||

lines.english: Dhaar anoograhu su-aamee mayray. Please shower me with Your Merciful Grace, O my Lord and Master.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਸਭਨ  ਕੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: You dwell in each and every heart, and are near everyone.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at vaseh sabh an kai nayray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਿਥ  ਹਮਾਰੈ  ਕਛੂਐ  ਨਾਹੀ ਿਜਸੁ ਜਣਾਇਿਹ  ਿਤਸੈ ਜਣਾਵਣਾ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Nothing is in my hands; he alone knows, whom You inspire to know. ||9||
lines.transliteration: haath hamaarai kachhoo-ai naahee jis jan aa-ihi t isai jan aavan aa. ||9||

lines.english: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead,
lines.transliteration: jaa kai mastak Dh ur likh  paa-i-aa.
tis hee purakh  na vi-aapai maa-i-aa. that person is not afflicted by Maya.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਦੂਸਰ  ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary forever; there is no other equal to You. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sad aa sarn aa-ee d oosar lavai na laavn aa. ||10||

lines.english: In His Will, He made all pain and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: aagi-aa dookh  sookh  sabh  keenay.

lines.english: How rare are those who remember the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam birlai hee cheenay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: His value cannot be described. He is prevailing everywhere. ||11||
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee jat  kat ohee samaavn aa. ||11||

lines.english: He is the devotee; He is the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: so-ee bhagat  so-ee vad d aataa.

lines.english: He is the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of karma.
lines.transliteration: so-ee pooran purakh biDh aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਲ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵਣਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He is your help and support, since infancy; He fulfills your mind's desires. ||12||
lines.transliteration: baal sahaa-ee so-ee tayraa jo t ayrai man bh aavnaa. ||12||

lines.english: Death, pain and pleasure are ordained by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mirat d ookh sookh  likh paa-ay.

lines.english: They do not increase or decrease by anyone's efforts.
lines.transliteration: til nahee baDh eh gh ateh na gh ataa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਇ ਿਜ ਕਰਤੇ  ਭਾਵੈ ਕਿਹ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ  ਵਞਾਵਣਾ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: That alone happens, which is pleasing to the Creator; speaking of himself, the mortal ruins himself. ||13||
lines.transliteration: so-ee ho-ay je kartay bh aavai kahi kai aap vanj aavan aa. ||13||

lines.english: He lifts us up and pulls us out of the deep dark pit;
lines.transliteration: anDh koop t ay say-ee kaadh ay.

lines.english: He unites with Himself, those who were separated for so many incarnations.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay tootay gaaNdhay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਰਖੇ ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਿਧਆਵਣਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Showering them with His Mercy, He protec ts them with His own hands. Meeting with the Holy Saints, they meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||14||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa Dhaar rakh ay kar apunay mil saaDh oo gobind  Dhi-aavan aa. ||14||

lines.english: Your worth cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: tayree keemat  kahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Wondrous is Your form, and Your glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: achraj roop vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਵਣਾ  ॥੧੫॥੧॥
lines.english: ||15||1||14||22||24||2||14||62|| Your humble servant begs for the gift of devotional worship. Nanak is a sacrifice, asacrifice to You. ||15||1||14||22||24||2||14||62|| mwrU vwr mhlw 3  (1086-18) maaroo vaar mehlaa 3 Vaar Of Maaroo, Third Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1086-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: sloku mÚ 1 ] (1086-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) bhagat  daan mangai jan t ayraa naanak bal bal jaavn aa.

lines.english: If virtue is sold when there is no buyer, then it is sold very cheap.
lines.transliteration: vin gaahak gun  vaychee-ai t a-o gun  sahgh o jaa-ay.

lines.english: But if one meets a buyer of virtue, then virtue sells for hundreds of thousands. pMnw 1087
lines.transliteration: gun kaa gaahak jay milai t a-o gun  laakh  vikaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with a virtuous person, virtue is obtained, and one is immersed in the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gun tay gun  mil paa-ee-ai jay sat gur maahi samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਲ ਅਮਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਵਣਿਜ  ਨ ਲੀਜੈ  ਹਾਿਟ  ॥
lines.english: Priceless virtues are not obtained for any price; they cannot be purchased in a store.
lines.transliteration: mol amol na paa-ee-ai vanaj na leejai haat.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਿਟ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, their weight is full and perfect; it never decreases at all. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1087-2) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pooraa tol hai kabahu na hovai gh aat. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they wander around, continually comingand going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: naam vihoonay bh armaseh aavahi jaaveh neet .

lines.english: Some are in bondage, and some are set free; some are happy in the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ik baaNDhay ik dh eeli-aa ik sukh ee-ay har pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਬਧੇ ਇਿਕ  ਢੀਿਲਆ  ਇਿਕ  ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, believe in the True Lord, and practice Truth, through the lifestyle of Truth. ||2|| pauVI ] (1087-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa man lai sach karnee sach reet . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਰੀਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: From the Guru, I have obtained the supremely powerful sword of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: gur tay gi-aan paa-i-aa at  kharhag karaaraa.

lines.english: I have cut down the fortress of duality and doubt, attachment, greed and egotism.
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aram garh  kati-aa moh lobh  ahaNkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਿਤ  ਖੜਗੁ  ਕਰਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord abides within my mind; I contemplate the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasi-aa gur sabad veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਗੜੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through Truth, self-discipline and sublime understanding, the Lord has become verydear to me.
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam mat oot maa har lagaa pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Truly, truly, the True Creator Lord is all-pervading. ||1|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1087-6) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatd aa sach sirjan haaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚ ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਲਗਾ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Among the ragas, Kaydaaraa Raga is known as good, O Siblings of Destiny, if through it, one comes to love the Word of the Shabad,
lines.transliteration: kaydaaraa raagaa vich jaan ee-ai bh aa-ee sabd ay karay pi-aar.
satsangat  si-o mild o rahai sachay Dh aray pi-aar. and if one remains in the Soceity of the Saints, and enshrines love for the True Lord.

lines.english: Such a person washes away the pollution from within, and saves his generations aswell.
lines.transliteration: vichahu mal katay aapnee kulaa kaa karay uDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ  ਰਾਗਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਬਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He gathes in the capital of virtue, and destroys and drives out unvirtuous sins.
lines.transliteration: gunaa kee raas sangrahai avgan  kadh ai vidaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is known as united, who does not forsake his Guru, and who doesnot love duality. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1087-9) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mili-aa so jaanee-ai guroo na chh odai aapn aa doojai na Dh aray pi-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚਹੁ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਕੁਲਾ  ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the world-ocean, I am afraid of death; but if I live in the Fear of You,God, then I am not afraid.
lines.transliteration: saagar daykh -a-u dar mara-o bh ai tayrai dar naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣਾ  ਕੀ ਰਾਿਸ  ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੈ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਕਢੈ ਿਵਡਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am content; O Nanak, I blossom forth inthe Name. ||2|| mÚ 4 ] (1087-10) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sant okhee-aa naanak bigsaa naa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I get on board the boat and set out, but the ocean is churning with waves.
lines.transliteration: charh bohithai chaalsa-o saagar lahree d ay-ay.

lines.english: The boat of Truth encounters no obstruction, if the Guru gives encouragement.
lines.transliteration: thaak na sachai bohithai jay gur Dh eerak d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਉ  ਡਿਰ ਮਰਉ  ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He takes us across to the door on the other side, as the Guru keeps watch.
lines.transliteration: tit dar jaa-ay ut aaree-aa gur d isai saavDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਗਸਾ  ਨਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if I am blessed with His Grace, I shall go to His Court with honor. ||3|| pauVI ] (1087-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai d argeh chalai maan. ||3||

lines.english: Enjoy your kingdom of bliss; as Gurmukh, practice Truth.
lines.transliteration: nihkantak raaj bhunch t oo gurmukh  sach kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਿੜ ਬੋਿਹਥੈ  ਚਾਲਸਉ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Sitting upon the throne of Truth, the Lord administers justice; He unites us in Union with the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sachai takh at baith aa ni-aa-o kar sat sangat  mayl milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਸਚੈ ਬੋਿਹਥੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੀਰਕ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, through the True Teachings, we become just like the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachaa updays har jaapn aa har si-o ban  aa-ee.

lines.english: If the Lord, the Giver of peace, abides in the mind, in this world, then in the end, Hebecomes our help and support.
lines.transliteration: aithai sukh-d aata man vasai ant  ho-ay sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Love for the Lord wells up, when the Guru imparts understanding. ||2|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (1087-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har si-o pareet oopjee gur sojh ee paa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Confused and deluded, I wander around, but no one shows me the way.
lines.transliteration: bhoolee bh oolee mai firee paaDh ar kahai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਕੰਟਕ  ਰਾਜੁ ਭੁੰਿਚ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I go and ask the clever people, if there is there anyone who can rid me of my pain.
lines.transliteration: poochhahu jaa-ay si-aan i-aa d ukh kaatai mayraa ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਿਤ  ਬੈਠਾ ਿਨਆਉ ਕਿਰ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: If the True Guru abides within my mind, then I see the Lord, my best friend, there.
lines.transliteration: satgur saachaa man vasai saajan ut  hee th aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਬਿਣ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my mind is satisfied and fulfilled, contemplating the Praises of the TrueName. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1087-16) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak man taript aasee-ai sift ee saachai naa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Doer, and He is the deed; He Himself issues the Command.
lines.transliteration: aapay karnee kaar aap aapay karay rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਊਪਜੀ  ਗੁਿਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself forgives some, and He Himself does the deed.
lines.transliteration: aapay kis hee bakhas la-ay aapay kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, receiving the Divine Light from the Guru, suffering and corruption are burnt away, through the Name. ||2|| pauVI ] (1087-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak chaanan gur milay d ukh bikh jaalee naa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਮੈ ਿਫਰੀ  ਪਾਧਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Don't be fooled by gazing at the riches of Maya, you foolish self-willed manmukh.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa vaykh na bh ul too manmukh  moorkh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ਿਸਆਿਣਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: It shall not go along with you when you must depart; all the wealth you see is false.
lines.transliteration: chaldi-aa naal na chal-ee sabh  jhooth darab lakh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The blind and ignorant do not understand, that the sword of death is hanging overtheir heads.
lines.transliteration: agi-aanee anDh na boojh -ee sir oopar jam kh arhag kalkh aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are saved. pMnw 1088
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ubray jin har ras chakhaa.

lines.english: He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause; the Lord Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1088-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay karay aap aapay har rakhaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਖਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who do not meet with the Guru, who have no Fear of God at all,
lines.transliteration: jinaa gur nahee bhayti-aa bh ai kee naahee bind .
aavan jaavan  dukh ghanaa kad ay na chookai chind . continue coming and going in reincarnation, and suffer terrible pain; their anxiety is never relieved.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਭੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਬੰਦ ॥
lines.english: They are beaten like clothes being washed on the rocks, and struck every hour likechimes.
lines.transliteration: kaaparh jivai pachh orhee-ai gh arhee muhat  gharhee-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਵਣੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਿਚੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, these entanglements are not removed from hangingover one's head. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1088-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam bin sirahu na chukai janjaal. ||1||

lines.english: I have searched throughout the three worlds, O my friend; egotism is bad for theworld.
lines.transliteration: taribh avan dhoodhee sajn aa ha-umai buree jagat .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਸਰਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Don't worry, O my soul; speak the Truth, O Nanak, the Truth, and only the Truth.||2|| pauVI ] (1088-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naa jhur hee-arh ay sach cha-o naanak sacho sach. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord Himself forgives the Gurmukhs; they are absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aapay bakh si-on har naam samaan ay.

lines.english: He Himself links them to devotional worship; they bear the Insignia of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhagt ee laa-i-on gur sabad  neesaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਝੁਰੁ ਹੀਅੜੇ  ਸਚੁ ਚਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who turn towards the Guru, as sunmukh, are beautiful. They are famous in theCourt of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sanmukh sad aa sohn ay sachai d ar jaan ay.

lines.english: In this world, and in the world hereafter, they are liberated; they realize the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aithai othai mukat hai jin raam pachh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੇ ਬਖਿਸਓਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an say jan jin har sayvi-aa t in ha-o kurbaan ay. ||4|| Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who serve the Lord. I am a sacrifice tothem. ||4|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (1088-7) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਗਤੀ  ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨੀਸਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: The rude, ill-mannered bride is encased in the body-tomb; she is blackened, and hermind is impure.
lines.transliteration: mahal kuchjee marvarhee kaalee manhu kasuDh .

lines.punjabi: ਸਨਮੁਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਦਿਰ ਜਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: She can enjoy her Husband Lord, only if she is virtuous. O Nanak, the soul-bride isunworthy, and without virtue. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1088-8) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay gun hovan t aa pir ravai naanak avgun  munDh . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਪਛਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: She has good conduct, true self-discipline, and a perfect family.
lines.transliteration: saach seel sach sanjmee saa pooree parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, day and night, she is always good; she loves her Beloved Husband Lord.||2|| pauVI ] (1088-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ahinis sadaa bh alee pir kai hayt  pi-aar. ||2||

lines.english: One who realizes his own self, is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa aap pachh aani-aa naam niDh aan paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਲ  ਕੁਚਜੀ  ਮੜਵੜੀ  ਕਾਲੀ  ਮਨਹੁ ਕਸੁਧ  ॥
lines.english: Granting His Mercy, the Guru merges him in the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kar kai aapnee gur sabad  milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਿਨ  ਤਾ ਿਪਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਮੁੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Bani is immaculate and pure; through it, one drinks in thesublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee nirmalee har ras pee-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, forsake other flavors.
lines.transliteration: har ras jinee chaakhi-aa an ras th aak rahaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਲ  ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੀ  ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, they remain satisfied forever; theirhunger and thirst are quenched. ||5|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1088-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har ras pee sadaa t aripat  bha-ay fir t arisnaa bh ukh gavaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ ਸਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Her Husband Lord is pleased, and He enjoys His bride; the soul-bride adorns her heartwith the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: pir khusee-ay Dh an raavee-ay Dh an ur naam seegaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, that bride who stands before Him, is the most noble and respected woman.||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1088-13) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan aagai kh arhee sobh aavant ee naar. ||1||

lines.english: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, shebelongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is inaccessible and unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: sasurai pay-ee-ai kant kee kant  agamm athaahu.

lines.english: O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her carefree, independentLord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1088-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dhan sohaagan ee jo bh aaveh vayparvaah. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: That king sits upon the throne, who is worthy of that throne.
lines.transliteration: takhat raajaa so bahai je t akh-tai laa-ik ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਅਨ ਰਸ ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਹਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who realize the True Lord, they alone are the true kings.
lines.transliteration: jinee sach pachhaan i-aa sach raajay say-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਭਏ ਿਫਿਰ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: These mere earthly rulers are not called kings; in the love of duality, they suffer.
lines.transliteration: ayhi bhoopat  raajay na aakh ee-ahi d oojai bh aa-ay d ukh ho-ee.

lines.english: Why should someone praise someone else who is also created? They depart in no time at all.
lines.transliteration: keetaa ki-aa salaahee-ai jis jaad ay bilam na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ ਖੁਸੀਏ  ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਏ  ਧਨ ਉਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The One True Lord is eternal and imperishable. One who, as Gurmukh, understandsbecomes eternal as well. ||6|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1088-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nihchal sachaa ayk hai gurmukh boojh ai so nihchal ho-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਨ ਆਗੈ  ਖੜੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ  ਨਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Husband of all. No one is without the Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa pir ayk hai pir bin kh aalee naahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are the pure soul-brides, who merge in the True Guru. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1088-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak say sohaaganee je sat gur maahi samaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੁਰੈ  ਪੇਈਐ  ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The mind is churning with so many waves of desire. How can one be emancipated inthe Court of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: man kay aDhik t arang ki-o d ar saahib chh utee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧੰਨੁ ਸਹਾਗਣੀ  ਜੋ ਭਾਵਿਹ  ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Be absorbed in the Lord's True Love, and imbued with the deep color of the Lord'sInfinite Love.
lines.transliteration: jay raachai sach rang goorhai rang apaar kai.

lines.english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one is emancipated, if the consciousness is attached to the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1088-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur parsaadee chhutee-ai jay chit  lagai sach. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਖਿਤ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਸੋ ਬਹੈ ਿਜ ਤਖਤੈ  ਲਾਇਕ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is priceless. How can its value be estimated? pMnw 1089
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam amol hai ki-o keemat keejai.

lines.english: He Himself created the entire universe, and He Himself is pervading it.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat sabh saajee-an aapay vart eejai.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord forever, and through the Truth, they assess Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa salaahee-ai sach keemat  keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and in this way, one drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee kamal bigaasi-aa iv har ras peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਬਗਾਿਸਆ  ਇਵ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, and one sleeps in peace and poise. ||7|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (1089-3) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa thaaki-aa sukh  sahj saveejai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਠਾਿਕਆ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਹਿਜ ਸਵੀਜੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Neither dirty, nor dull, nor saffron, nor any color that fades.
lines.transliteration: naa mailaa naa DhunDh laa naa bh agvaa naa kach.

lines.english: O Nanak, crimson - deep crimson is the color of one who is imbued with the True Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1089-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laalo laal hai sachai rataa sach. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮੈਲਾ  ਨਾ ਧੁੰਧਲਾ  ਨਾ ਭਗਵਾ  ਨਾ ਕਚੁ ॥
lines.english: The bumble bee intuitively and fearlessly dwells among the vegetation, flowers andfruits.
lines.transliteration: sahj vanaspat  ful fal bh avar vasai bh ai khand.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਾਲੋ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there is only one tree, one flower, and one bumble bee. ||2|| pauVI ] (1089-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tarvar ayk hai ayko ful bh irang. ||2||

lines.english: Those humble beings who struggle with their minds are brave and distinguishedheroes.
lines.transliteration: jo jan loojheh manai si-o say sooray parDh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਵਣਸਪਿਤ  ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਖੰਿਡ ॥
lines.english: Those who realize their own selves, remain forever united with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har saytee sad aa mil rahay jinee aap pachh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਫੁਲੁ ਿਭਰੰਗੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: This is the glory of the spiritual teachers, that they remain absorbed in their mind.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee-aa kaa ih mahat hai man maahi samaanaa.

lines.english: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and focus their meditation on theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kaa mahal paa-i-aa sach laa-ay Dhi-aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੂਝਿਹ  ਮਨੈ ਿਸਉ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who conquer their own minds, by Guru's Grace, conquer the world. ||8|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1089-7) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin gur parsaadee man jeeti-aa jag t ineh jit aanaa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਿਜਨੀ  ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: If I were to become a Yogi, and wander around the world, begging from door to door,
lines.transliteration: jogee hovaa jag bhavaa gh ar ghar bheekhi-aa lay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਤੁ  ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: dargeh laykh aa mangee-ai kis kis ut ar day-o. then, when I am summoned to the Court of the Lord, what answer could I give?

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੁ ਲਾਇ ਿਧਆਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I beg for; contentment is my temple.The True Lord is always with me.
lines.transliteration: bhikh i-aa naam sant okh marh ee sad aa sach hai naal.

lines.english: Nothing is obtained by wearing religious ro bes; all will be seized by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh ee haath na laDh ee-aa sabh  baDh ee jamkaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, talk is false; contemplate the True Name. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1089-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak galaa jhooth ee-aa sachaa naam samaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਹੋਵਾ ਜਿਗ ਭਵਾ ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਭੀਿਖਆ  ਲੇਉ ॥
lines.english: Through that door, you will be called to account; do not serve at that door.
lines.transliteration: jit dar laykh aa mangee-ai so d ar sayvihu na ko-ay.

lines.english: Seek and find such a True Guru, who has no equal in His greatness.
lines.transliteration: aisaa satgur lorh  lahu jis jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਮੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: In His Sanctuary, one is released, and no one calls him to account.
lines.transliteration: tis sarn aa-ee chh ootee-ai laykh aa mangai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ  ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Truth is implanted within Him, and He impl ants Truth within others. He bestows the blessing of the True Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sach drirh-aa-ay sach d arirh sachaa oh sabad  day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗਲਾ  ਝੂਠੀਆ  ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who has Truth within his heart - his body and mind are also true.
lines.transliteration: hirdai jis d ai sach hai t an man bh ee sachaa ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, if one submits to the Hukam, the Command of the True Lord God, he isblessed with true glory and greatness.
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai hukam mani-ai sachee vadi-aa-ee day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਦਿਰ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He is immersed and merged in the True Lord, who blesses him with His Glance ofGrace. ||2|| pauVI ] (1089-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sachay maahi samaavasee jis no nadar karay-i. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਲੋਿੜ  ਲਹੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They are not called heroes, who die of egotism, suffering in pain.
lines.transliteration: sooray ayhi na aakhee-ahi ahaNkaar mareh d ukh paavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The blind ones do not realize their own selves; in the love of duality, they rot.
lines.transliteration: anDhay aap na pachh aannee d oojai pach jaaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਸਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਸਚਾ ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: They struggle with great anger; here and hereafter, they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: at karoDh  si-o loojh -day agai pichh ai dukh paavahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਿਜਸ ਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is not pleased by egotism; the Vedas proclaim this clearly.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o ahaNkaar na bhaav-ee vayd  kook sun aaveh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੈ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸਚੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who die of egotism, shall not find salvation. They die, and are reborn in reincarnation. ||9|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1089-16) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaar mu-ay say vigtee ga-ay mar janmeh fir aavahi. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੇ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਵਸੀ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The crow does not become white, and an iron boat does not float across.
lines.transliteration: kaaga-o ho-ay na oojlaa lohay naav na paar.

lines.english: One who puts his faith in the treasure of his Beloved Lord is blessed; he exalts andembellishes others as well.
lines.transliteration: piram padaarath man lai Dh an savaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰੇ ਏਿਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ ਮਰਿਹ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command - his face is radiant and bright; hefloats across, like iron upon wood.
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan ai oojlaa sir kaasat lohaa paar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣਨੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਪਿਚ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Forsake thirst and desire, and abide in the Fear of God; O Nanak, these are the mostexcellent actions. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1089-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa chh odai bh ai vasai naanak karn ee saar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਕਰੋਧ  ਿਸਉ ਲੂਝਦੇ  ਅਗੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The ignorant people who go to the desert to conquer their minds, are not able to conquer them.
lines.transliteration: maaroo maaran jo ga-ay maar na sakahi gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਵੇਦ ਕੂਿਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if this mind is to be conquered, one must contemplate the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: naanak jay ih maaree-ai gur sabdee veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ਮੁਏ ਸੇ ਿਵਗਤੀ  ਗਏ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮਿਹ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਿਹ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: This mind is not conquered by conquering it, even though everyone longs to do so.
lines.transliteration: ayhu man maari-aa naa marai jay lochai sabh ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the mind itself conquers the mind, if one meets with the True Guru. ||2|| pMnw 1090 pauVI ] (1090-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak man hee ka-o man maarsee jay satgur bh aytai so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He created both sides; Shiva dwells within Shakti (the soul dwells within the material universe).
lines.transliteration: dovai t arfaa opaa-ee-on vich sakat  siv vaasaa.

lines.english: Through the material universe of Shakti, no one has ever found the Lord; theycontinue to be born and die in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: saktee kinai na paa-i-o fir janam binaasaa.

lines.english: Serving the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Lord with every breath andmorsel of food.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvi-ai saat paa-ee-ai jap saas giraasaa.

lines.english: Searching and looking through the Simritees and the Shaastras, I have found that the most sublime person is the slave of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  soDh  daykh ootam har d aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸਾਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਿਪ ਸਾਸ ਿਗਰਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, nothing is permanent and stable; I am a sacrifice to theNaam, the Name of the Lord. ||10|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1090-3) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam binaa ko thir nahee naamay bal jaasaa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤ  ਸੋਿਧ ਦੇਖੁ ਊਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: I might become a Pandit, a religious scholar, or an astrologer, and recite the fourVedas with my mouth;
lines.transliteration: hovaa pandit jot kee vayd  parhaa mukh  chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਕੋ ਿਥਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਸਾ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: I might be worshipped throughout the nine regions of the earth for my wisdom andthought;
lines.transliteration: nav khand maDh ay poojee-aa apn ai chaj veechaar.
mat sachaa akh ar bhul jaa-ay cha-ukai bh itai na ko-ay. let me not forget the Word of Truth, that no one can touch my sacred cooking square.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Such cooking squares are false, O Nanak; only the One Lord is True. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1090-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jhooth ay cha-ukay naankaa sachaa ayko so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਧੇ ਪੂਜੀਆ  ਅਪਣੈ  ਚਿਜ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself creates and He Himself acts; He bestows His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay karay aap aapay nadar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਭੁਿਲ ਜਾਇ  ਚਉਕੈ ਿਭਟੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself grants glorious greatness; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1090-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aapay day vad i-aa-ee-aa kaho naanak sachaa so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੇ ਚਉਕੇ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Only death is painful; I cannot conceive of anything else as painful.
lines.transliteration: kantak kaal ayk hai hor kantak na soojhai.

lines.english: It is unstoppable; it stalks and pervades the world, and fights with the sinners.
lines.transliteration: afri-o jag meh varatdaa paapee si-o loojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is immersed in the Lord. Meditating on the Lord, one comes to realize the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har bh aydee-ai har jap har boojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone is emancipated in the Sanctuary of the Lord, who struggles with his ownmind.
lines.transliteration: so har sarnaa-ee chh utee-ai jo man si-o joojh ai.

lines.english: One who contemplates and meditates on the Lord in his mind, succeeds in the Courtof the Lord. ||11|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (1090-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man veechaar har jap karay har dargeh seejh ai. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: Submit to the Will of the Lord Commander; in His Court, only Truth is accepted.
lines.transliteration: hukam rajaa-ee saakh-t ee dargeh sach kabool.

lines.punjabi: ਅਫਿਰਓ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਿਸਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: Your Lord and Master shall call you to account; do not go astray on beholding the world.
lines.transliteration: saahib laykhaa mangsee d unee-aa d aykh na bh ool.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਭੇਦੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: One who keeps watch over his heart, and keeps his heart pure, is a dervish, a saintlydevotee.
lines.transliteration: dil darvaanee jo karay d arvaysee d il raas.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਜੋ ਮਨ ਿਸਉ ਜੂਝੈ ॥
lines.english: Love and affection, O Nanak, are in the accounts placed before the Creator. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1090-10) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: isak muhabat naankaa laykh aa kart ay paas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੀਝੈ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: One who is unattached like the bumble bee, sees the Lord of the world everywhere.
lines.transliteration: alga-o jo-ay maDhookarh a-o sarangpaan  sabaa-ay.

lines.english: The diamond of his mind is pierced through with the Diamond of the Lord's Name; ONanak, his neck is embellished with it. ||2|| pauVI ] (1090-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: heerai heeraa bayDhi-aa naanak kanth  subh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਿਮ ਰਜਾਈ  ਸਾਖਤੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted by death; they cling to Maya in emotionalattachment.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kaal vi-aapd aa mohi maa-i-aa laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗਸੀ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਦੇਿਖ ਨ ਭੂਲੁ ॥
lines.english: In an instant, they are thrown to the ground and killed; in the love of duality, they aredeluded.
lines.transliteration: khin meh maar pachh aarhsee bh aa-ay d oojai th aagay.

lines.english: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; they are beaten by theMessenger of Death with his stick.
lines.transliteration: fir vaylaa hath na aavee jam kaa dand laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਕ  ਮੁਹਬਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But Death's stick does not even strike those who remain awake and aware in the Loveof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tin jam dand na lag-ee jo har liv jaagay.

lines.english: All are Yours, and cling to You; only You can save them. ||12|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (1090-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree t uDh chhadaavan ee sabh  tuDhai laagay. ||12||

lines.english: See the imperishable Lord everywhere; attachment to wealth brings only great pain.
lines.transliteration: sarbay jo-ay agachhmee d ookh ghanayro aath.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ  ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੰਿਠ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Loaded with dust, you have to cross over the world-ocean; you are not carrying theprofit and capital of the Name with you. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1090-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaalar laadas sar laagh ana-o laabh  na poonjee saath. ||1||

lines.english: My capital is Your True Name, O Lord; th is wealth is inexhaustible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: poonjee saacha-o naam too akh uta-o d arab apaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, this merchandise is immaculate; blessed is the banker who trades in it. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (1090-16) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhar nirmalo Dh an saahu vaapaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਮਾਿਰ  ਪਛਾੜਸੀ  ਭਾਇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਠਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Know and enjoy the primal, eternal Love of the Great Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: poorab pareet piraan  lai mota-o th aakur maan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ  ਵੇਲਾ ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed with the Naam, O Nanak, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death, andpush his face to the ground. ||3|| pauVI ] (1090-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: maathai oobhai jam maarsee naanak maylan  naam. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਜਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself has embellished the body, and placed the nine treasures of the Naamwithin it.
lines.transliteration: aapay pind savaari-on vich nav niDh naam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਛਡਾਵਣੀ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He confuses some in doubt; fruitless are their actions.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay bharam bh ulaa-i-an t in nihfal kaam.

lines.english: Some, as Gurmukh, realize their Lord, the Supreme Soul.
lines.transliteration: iknee gurmukh bujh i-aa har aat am raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਜੋਇ ਅਗਛਮੀ  ਦੂਖੁ ਘਨੇਰੋ  ਆਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Some listen to the Lord, and obey Him; sublime and exalted are their actions.
lines.transliteration: iknee sun kai mani-aa har oot am kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਿਸ  ਸਰੁ ਲਾਘਣਉ  ਲਾਭੁ ਨ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Love for the Lord wells up deep within, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord'sName. ||13|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (1090-19) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl: pMnw 1091
lines.transliteration: antar har rang upji-aa gaa-i-aa har gun  naam. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਭੋਲਤਿਣ  ਭੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹੇਕੈ  ਪਾਧਰ  ਹੀਡੁ ॥
lines.english: The Fear of God abides in the mind of the innocent; this is the straight path to the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhogt an bhai man vasai haykai paaDh ar heed.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਡਾਹਪਿਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਤੀਨੇ  ਥਾਵ ਭਰੀਡੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Jealousy and envy bring terrible pain, and one is cursed throughout the three worlds.||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1091-1) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: at daahpan  dukh ghano teenay thaav bh areed. ||1||

lines.english: The drum of the Vedas vibrates, bringing dispute and divisiveness.
lines.transliteration: maaNdal bayd  se baajn o ghano Dharhee-ai jo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਦਲੁ ਬੇਿਦ ਿਸ ਬਾਜਣੋ  ਘਣੋ ਧੜੀਐ  ਜੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there is none except Him.||2|| mÚ 1 ] (1091-2) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too beeja-o avar na ko-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The world-ocean of the three qualities is unfathomably deep; how can its bottom beseen?
lines.transliteration: saagar gunee athaahu kin haathaalaa d aykhee-ai.

lines.english: If I meet with the great, self-sufficient True Guru, then I am carried across.
lines.transliteration: vadaa vayparvaahu satgur milai t a paar pavaa.

lines.english: This ocean is filled up with pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: majh bh ar dukh badukh.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਵਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's hunger is appeased. ||3|| pauVI ] (1091-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh . ||3||

lines.english: Those who search their inner beings, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are exalted and adorned.
lines.transliteration: jinee andar bh aali-aa gur sabad  suhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ  ਭੁਖ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They obtain what they wish for, meditating on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jo ichhan so paa-id ay har naam Dh i-aavai.

lines.english: One who is blessed by God's Grace, meets with the Guru; he sings the GloriousPraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karay tis gur milai so har gun  gaavai.

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay t in kaa mit  hai jam mag na paavai. The Righteous Judge of Dharma is his friend; he does not have to walk on the Path ofDeath.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛਿਨ  ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He meditates on the Lord's Name, day and night; he is absorbed and immersed in theLord's Name. ||14|| sloku mÚ 1 ] (1091-7) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aavahi d inas raat  har naam samaavai. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to and speak the Name of the One Lord, who permeates the heavens, thisworld and the nether regions of the underworld.
lines.transliteration: sunee-ai ayk vakh aanee-ai surag mirat  pa-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਿਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਮਿਗ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Hukam of His Command cannot be erased; whatever He has written, shall go withthe mortal.
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaa-ee mayti-aa jo likhi-aa so naal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Who has died, and who kills? Who comes and who goes?
lines.transliteration: ka-un moo-aa ka-un  maarsee ka-un  aavai ka-un  jaa-ay.

lines.english: Who is enraptured, O Nanak, and whose consciousness merges in the Lord? ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1091-9) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ka-un rahsee naankaa kis kee surat  samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: In egotism, he dies; possessiveness kills him, and the breath flows out like a river.
lines.transliteration: ha-o mu-aa mai maari-aa pa-un vahai d aree-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਮੇਿਟਆ  ਜੋ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Desire is exhausted, O Nanak, only when the mind is imbued with the Name.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa thakee naankaa jaa man rat aa naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ  ਮਾਰਸੀ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਆਵੈ  ਕਉਣੁ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: His eyes are imbued with the eyes of the Lord, and his ears ring with celestialconsciousness.
lines.transliteration: lo-in rat ay lo-in ee kannee surat  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਰਹਸੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਕਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: His tongue drinks in the sweet nectar, dyed crimson by chanting the Name of the Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeebh rasaa-in  choonrh ee rat ee laal lavaa-ay.

lines.english: His inner being is drenched with the Lord's fragrance; his worth cannot be described.||2|| pauVI ] (1091-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: andar musak jh akoli-aa keemat  kahee na jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਮੁਆ  ਮੈ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਵਹੈ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure. Only the Naam goesalong in the end.
lines.transliteration: is jug meh naam niDhaan hai naamo naal chalai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਥਕੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It is inexhaustible; it is never empty, no matter how much one may eat, consume orspend.
lines.transliteration: ayhu akhut kad ay na nikh uta-ee kh aa-ay kh archi-o palai.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਇਣ  ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣੀ  ਕੰਨੀ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jan nayrh na aavee jamkankar jamkalai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਿਣ  ਚੂਨੜੀ  ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲ  ਲਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are the true bankers and traders, who have the wealth of the Lord in theirlaps.
lines.transliteration: say saah sachay vanjaari-aa jin har Dh an palai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਮੁਸਿਕ  ਝਕੋਿਲਆ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Mercy, one finds the Lord, only when the Lord Himself sends for him.||15|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1091-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa tay har paa-ee-ai jaa aap har gh alai. ||15||

lines.english: 3) manmukh vaapaarai saar na jaan nee bikh  vihaajh eh bikh  sangar-hahi bikh  si-o Dh areh pi-aar. The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the excellence of trading in Truth. Hedeals in poison, collects poison, and is in love with poison.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਿਲ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Outwardly, they call themselves Pandits, religious scholars, but in their minds they arefoolish and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: baahrahu pandit sad aa-iday manhu moorakh  gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਨਖੁਟਈ  ਖਾਇ  ਖਰਿਚਉ  ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.english: They do not focus their consciousness on the Lord; they love to engage in arguments.
lines.transliteration: har si-o chit na laa-inee vaad ee Dh aran pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਜਮਕਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: They speak to cause arguments, and earn their living by telling lies.
lines.transliteration: vaadaa kee-aa karan kahaan ee-aa koorh  bol karahi aahaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਿਰਆ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.english: In this world, only the Lord's Name is immaculate and pure. All other objects ofcreation are polluted.
lines.transliteration: jag meh raam naam har nirmalaa hor mailaa sabh aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਾ ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਘਲੈ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are polluted;they die in ignorance. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1091-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na chaytnee ho-ay mailay mareh gavaar. ||1||

lines.english: Without serving the Lord, he suffers in pain; accepting the Hukam of God's Command, pain is gone.
lines.transliteration: dukh lagaa bin sayvi-ai hukam mannay d ukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਵਾਪਾਰੈ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਿਬਖੁ ਿਵਹਾਝਿਹ  ਿਬਖੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹਿਹ  ਿਬਖ ਿਸਉ ਧਰਿਹ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Giver of peace; He Himself awards punishment.
lines.transliteration: aapay daat aa sukh ai daa aapay d ay-ay sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਸਦਾਇਦੇ  ਮਨਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, know this well; all that happens is according to His Will. ||2|| pauVI ] (1091-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayvai jaanee-ai sabh  kichh  tisai rajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, the world is poor. Without the Name, no one is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: har naam binaa jagat hai nirDh an bin naavai t aripat  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਦਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਿਨ  ਕਹਾਣੀਆ  ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is deluded by duality and doubt. In egotism, he suffers in pain. pMnw 1092
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa ha-umai d ukh paahee.

lines.english: Without good karma, he does not obtain anything, no matter how much he may wish for it.
lines.transliteration: bin karmaa kichhoo na paa-ee-ai jay bahut  lochaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation, and birth and death are ended, through the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aavai jaa-ay jammai marai gur sabad chh utaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਛੁਟਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself acts, so unto whom should we complain? There is no other at all. ||16|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1092-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap karai kis aakhee-ai d oojaa ko naahee. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰੈ ਿਕਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: In this world, the Saints earn the wealth; they come to meet God through the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: is jag meh santee Dh an kh ati-aa jinaa sat gur mili-aa parabh  aa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru implants the Truth within; the value of this wealth cannot bedescribed.
lines.transliteration: satgur sach drirh -aa-i-aa is Dh an kee keemat  kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਸੰਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਆ ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Obtaining this wealth, hunger is relieved, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: it Dhan paa-i-ai bh ukh lathee sukh  vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to receive this.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa ka-o Dhur likh i-aa tinee paa-i-aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਧਿਨ ਪਾਇਐ  ਭੁਖ ਲਥੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The world of the self-willed manmukh is poor, crying out for Maya.
lines.transliteration: manmukh jagat  nirDh an hai maa-i-aa no billaa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, it wanders continually, and its hunger is never relieved.
lines.transliteration: an-din fird aa sad aa rahai bh ukh na kad ay jaa-ay.

lines.english: It never finds calm tranquility, and peace never comes to dwell in its mind.
lines.transliteration: saaNt na kad ay aavee nah sukh  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਿਫਰਦਾ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It is always plagued by anxiety, and its cynicism never departs.
lines.transliteration: sadaa chint  chitvadaa rahai sahsaa kad ay na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਆਵਈ  ਨਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the intellect is perverted; if one meets the True Guru, then one practices the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: naanak vin sat gur mat  bhavee sat gur no milai t aa sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਚੰਤ  ਿਚਤਵਦਾ  ਰਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, he dwells in peace, and merges in the True Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1092-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sukh  meh rahai sachay maahi samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਿਤ ਭਵੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The One who created the world, takes care of it.
lines.transliteration: jin upaa-ee maydnee so-ee saar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਹ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; there is none otherthan Him.
lines.transliteration: ayko simrahu bhaa-irahu t is bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: So eat the food of the Shabad and goodness; eating it, you shall remain satisfiedforever.
lines.transliteration: khaan aa sabad  chang-aa-ee-aa jit  khaaDhai sad aa taripat  ho-ay.

lines.english: Dress yourself in the Praise of the Lord. Forever and ever, it is radiant and bright; it isnever polluted.
lines.transliteration: painan sifat  sanaa-ay hai sad aa sad aa oh oojlaa mailaa kad ay na ho-ay.

lines.english: I have intuitively earned the true wealth, which never decreases.
lines.transliteration: sehjay sach Dhan kh ati-aa thorh aa kad ay na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਣਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ਿਜਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸਦਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The body is adorned with the Shabad, and is at peace forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: dayhee no sabad  seegaar hai jit  sadaa sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਨਾਇ  ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਊਜਲਾ  ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Lord, who reveals Himself. ||2|| pauVI ] (1092-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh bujh ee-ai jis no aap vikh aalay so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਆ  ਥੋੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Deep within the self are meditation and austere self-discipline, when one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: antar jap t ap sanjamo gur sabd ee jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, egotism and ignorance are eliminated.
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai ha-umai agi-aan gavaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਿਵਖਾਲੇ  ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One's inner being is overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar; tasting it, the flavor is known.
lines.transliteration: andar amrit  bharpoor hai chaakh i-aa saad  jaapai.

lines.english: Those who taste it become fearless; they are satisfied with the sublime essence of theLord.
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhi-aa say nirbh a-o bh a-ay say har ras Dh araapai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who drink it in, by the Grace of the Lord, are never again afflicted by death.||17|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1092-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa Dhaar pee-aa-i-aa fir kaal na vi-aapai. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: People tie up bundles of demerits; no one deals in virtue.
lines.transliteration: lok avganaa kee banHai ganth -rhee gun  na vihaajh ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Rare is that person, O Nanak, who purchases virtue.
lines.transliteration: gun kaa gaahak naankaa virlaa ko-ee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਸੇ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਧਰ੍ਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with virtue, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1092-16) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee gun paa-ee-aniH jis no nad ar karay-i. ||1||

lines.english: Merits and demerits are the same; they are both created by the Creator.
lines.transliteration: gun avgun  samaan heh je aap keet ay kart aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, finds peace, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2|| pauVI ] (1092-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam mani-ai sukh paa-ee-ai gur sabd ee veechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਕੁ ਅਵਗਣਾ  ਕੀ ਬੰਨੈ ਗੰਠੜੀ  ਗੁਣ ਨ ਿਵਹਾਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The King sits on the throne within the self; He Himself administers justice.
lines.transliteration: andar raajaa t akhat hai aapay karay ni-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord's Court is known; within the self isthe Sanctuary, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee d ar jaan ee-ai and ar mahal asraa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਗੁਣ ਪਾਈਅਿਨ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The coins are assayed, and the genuine coins are placed in His treasury, while the counterfeit ones find no place.
lines.transliteration: kharay parakh  khajaanai paa-ee-an kh oti-aa naahee thaa-o.

lines.english: The Truest of the True is all-pervading; His justice is forever True.
lines.transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatd aa sad aa sach ni-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ  ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਹਿਹ ਿਜ ਆਿਪ  ਕੀਤੇ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One comes to enjoy the Ambrosial essence, when the Name is enshrined in the mind.||18|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1092-19) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: amrit kaa ras aa-i-aa man vasi-aa naa-o. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When one acts in egotism, then You are not there, Lord. Wherever You are, there is no ego. pMnw 1093
lines.transliteration: ha-o mai karee taaN too naahee t oo hoveh ha-o naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਤ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੂ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਹਉ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O spiritual teachers, understand this: the Unspoken Speech is in the mind.
lines.transliteration: boojhhu gi-aanee boojh -naa ayh akath kathaa man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਬੂਝਣਾ  ਏਹ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the essence of reality is not found; the Invisible Lord dwells everywhere.
lines.transliteration: bin gur tat  na paa-ee-ai alakh  vasai sabh  maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: One meets the True Guru, and then the Lord is known, when the Word of the Shabadcomes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a jaan ee-ai jaaN sabad  vasai man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਜ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When self-conceit departs, doubt and fear also depart, and the pain of birth and death is removed.
lines.transliteration: aap ga-i-aa bharam bh a-o ga-i-aa janam maran d ukh jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੁਖ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Unseen Lord is seen; the intellect is exalted, andone is carried across.
lines.transliteration: gurmat alakh  lakhaa-ee-ai oot am mat  taraahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਈਐ  ਊਤਮ  ਮਿਤ ਤਰਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chant the chant of 'Sohang hansaa' - 'He is me, and I am Him.' The threeworlds are absorbed in Him. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1093-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sohaN hansaa jap jaapahu taribh avan tisai samaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਹੰ ਹੰਸਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਿਤਸੈ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some assay their mind-jewel, and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man maanak jin parkh i-aa gur sabd ee veechaar.

lines.english: Only a few of those humble beings are known in this world, in this Dark Age of KaliYuga.
lines.transliteration: say jan virlay jaanee-ahi kaljug vich sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰਿਖਆ  ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One's self remains blended with the Lord's Self, when egotism and duality areconquered.
lines.transliteration: aapai no aap mil rahi-aa ha-umai dubiDh aa maar.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam cross over the difficult, treacherousand terrifying world-ocean. ||2|| pauVI ] (1093-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay d utar taray bh a-ojal bikh am sansaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੈ  ਨੋ ਆਪੁ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not search within their own selves; they are deluded by their egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: manmukh and ar na bh aalnee muth ay ahamt ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wandering in the four directions, they grow weary, tormented by burning desirewithin.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaaN bhav thakay and ar tikh tatay.

lines.english: They do not study the Simritees and the Shaastras; the manmukhs waste away andare lost.
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat  na soDh nee manmukh  vigut ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਨੀ  ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਮਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one finds the Naam, the Name of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin gur kinai na paa-i-o har naam har satay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡ ਭਿਵ ਥਕੇ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਿਤਖ ਤਤੇ ॥
lines.english: One who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom and meditates on the Lord issaved. ||19|| slok mÚ 2 ] (1093-8) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tat gi-aan veechaari-aa har jap har gat ay. ||19||

lines.english: He Himself knows, He Himself acts, and He Himself does it right.
lines.transliteration: aapay jaanai karay aap aapay aan ai raas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਤੇ ॥
lines.english: So stand before Him, O Nanak, and offer your prayers. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1093-9) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tisai agai naankaa kh ali-ay keechai ard aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਗਤੇ ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: He who created the creation, watches over it; He Himself knows.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tin d aykhi-aa aapay jaan ai so-ay.

lines.english: Unto whom should I speak, O Nanak, when everything is contained within the homeof the heart? ||2|| pauVI ] (1093-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kis no kahee-ai naankaa jaa ghar vart ai sabh  ko-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਣੈ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Forget everything, and be friends with the One Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: sabhay thok visaar iko mit  kar.

lines.english: Your mind and body shall be enraptured, and the Lord shall burn away your sins.
lines.transliteration: man tan ho-ay nihaal paapaa d ahai har.

lines.english: Your comings and goings in reincarnation shall cease; you shall not be reborn and dieagain.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa chukai janam na jaahi mar.

lines.english: The True Name shall be your Support, and you shall not burn in sorrow andattachment.
lines.transliteration: sach naam aaDhaar sog na mohi jar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਜਾ ਘਿਰ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, gather in the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your mind.||20|| slok mÚ 5 ] (1093-13) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niDhaan man meh sanj Dh ar. ||20||

lines.english: You do not forget Maya from your mind; you beg for it with each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa manhu na veesrai maaNgai dammaa d amm.

lines.english: You do not even think of that God; O Nanak, it is not in your karma. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1093-14) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so parabh chit  na aavee naanak nahee karamm. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ਪਾਪਾ  ਦਹੈ ਹਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Maya and its wealth shall not go along with you, so why do you cling to it - are youblind?
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa saath na chal-ee ki-aa laptaavahi anDh.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਚੁਕੈ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਮਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Guru's Feet, and the bonds of Maya shall be cut away from you. ||2|| pauVI ] (1093-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan Dh i-aa-ay t oo tooteh maa-i-aa banDh . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਸੋਿਗ  ਨ ਮੋਿਹ ਜਿਰ ॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of His Will, the Lord inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command;by the Pleasure of His Will, we find peace.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai hukam manaa-i-on bh aanai sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਸੰਿਜ ਧਿਰ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of His Will, He leads us to meet the True Guru; by the Pleasure of HisWill, we meditate on the Truth.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai sat gur mayli-on bh aanai sach Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: There is no other gift as great as the Pleasure of His Will; this Truth is spoken and proclaimed.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ay jayvad hor d aat naahee sach aakh  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਮਗੈ  ਦੰਮਾ ਦੰਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, practice and live the Truth.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in sach kamaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਹੀ ਕਰੰਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; He created the world. ||21|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1093-17) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis sarn aagat ee jin jagat  upaa-i-aa. ||21||

lines.english: Those who do not have spiritual wisdom within, do not have even an iota of the Fearof God.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o andar gi-aan nahee bh ai kee naahee bind .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਿਕਆ  ਲਪਟਾਵਿਹ  ਅੰਧ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, why kill those who are already dead? The Lord of the Universe Himself haskilled them. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1093-18) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mu-i-aa kaa ki-aa maarnaa je aap maaray govind . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਤੂਟਿਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਬੰਧ ॥੨॥
lines.english: To read the horoscope of the mind, is the most sublime joyful peace.
lines.transliteration: man kee patree vaachn ee sukh ee hoo sukh  saar.

lines.english: He alone is called a good Brahmin, who understands God in contemplative meditation.
lines.transliteration: so baraahman bh alaa aakh ee-ai je boojh ai barahm beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He praises the Lord, and reads of the Lord, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. pMnw 1094
lines.transliteration: har saalaahay har parhai gur kai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪੜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Celebrated and approved is the coming into the world of such a person, who saves all his generations as well.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa oh parvaan hai je kul kaa karay uDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਓਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Hereafter, no one is questioned about social status; excellent and sublime is thepractice of the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: agai jaat na puchh ee-ai karn ee sabad  hai saar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Other study is false, and other actions are false; such people are in love with poison.
lines.transliteration: hor koorh parh -naa koorh  kamaavan aa bikh i-aa naal pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ  ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They do not find any peace within themselves; the self-willed manmukhs waste awaytheir lives.
lines.transliteration: andar sukh  na hova-ee manmukh  janam kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are saved; they have infinite love forthe Guru. ||2|| pauVI ] (1094-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say ubray gur kai hayt  apaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He Himself creates the creation, and gazes upon it; He Himself is totally True.
lines.transliteration: aapay kar kar vaykh-d aa aapay sabh  sachaa.

lines.english: One who does not understand the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, is false.
lines.transliteration: jo hukam na boojhai kh asam kaa so-ee nar kachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖਦਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of His Will, the True Lord joins the Gurmukh to Himself.
lines.transliteration: jit bhaavai t it laa-id aa gurmukh  har sachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਕਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is the One Lord and Master of all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we areblended with Him.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kaa saahib ayk hai gur sabd ee rachaa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs praise Him forever; all are beggars of Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sad aa salaahee-ai sabh  tis day jachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਰਚਾ ॥
