lines.english: O Nanak, as He Himself makes us dance, we dance. ||22||1|| Sudh|| mwrU vwr mhlw 5 fKxy mÚ 5  (1094-7) maaroo vaar mehlaa 5 dakh-n ay mehlaa 5 Vaar Of Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1094-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ji-o naanak aap nachaa-idaa t iv hee ko nachaa. ||22||1|| suDh .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ  ਸਿਭ ਿਤਸ ਦੇ ਜਚਾ ॥
lines.english: If You tell me to, O my Friend, I will cut off my head and give it to You.
lines.transliteration: too cha-o sajan  maidi-aa day-ee sis ut aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਨਚਾਇਦਾ  ਿਤਵ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਨਚਾ  ॥੨੨॥੧॥
lines.english: My eyes long for You; when will I see Your Vision? ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1094-8) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nain mahinjay t arasd ay kad  pasee d eedaar. ||1||

lines.english: I am in love with You; I have seen that other love is false.
lines.transliteration: neehu mahinjaa ta-oo naal bi-aa nayh koorh aavay daykh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰੂ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਡਖਣੇ  ਮਃ ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Even clothes and food are frightening to me, as long as I do not see my Beloved. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1094-9) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaparh bh og daraavan ay jichar piree na daykh . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਚਉ ਸਜਣ  ਮੈਿਡਆ  ਡੇਈ ਿਸਸੁ ਉਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I rise early, O my Husband Lord, to behold Your Vision.
lines.transliteration: uthee jh aaloo kant -rhay ha-o pasee t a-o deedaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਣ ਮਿਹੰਜੇ  ਤਰਸਦੇ  ਕਿਦ  ਪਸੀ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Eye make-up, garlands of flowers, and the flavor of betel leaf, are all nothing butdust, without seeing You. ||3|| pauVI ] (1094-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: kaajal haar tamol ras bin pasay habh  ras chh aar. ||3||

lines.english: You are True, O my True Lord and Master; You uphold all that is true.
lines.transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach sach sabh  Dhaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਹੁ ਮਿਹੰਜਾ  ਤਊ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਬਆ  ਨੇਹ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ  ਡੇਖੁ ॥
lines.english: You created the world, making a place for the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh keet o thaat siraj sansaari-aa.

lines.english: By the Will of the Lord, the Vedas came into being; they discriminate between sin and virtue.
lines.transliteration: har aagi-aa ho-ay bayd paap punn veechaari-aa.

lines.english: You created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, and the expanse of the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays tarai gun  bisthaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਠੀ ਝਾਲੂ  ਕੰਤੜੇ  ਹਉ ਪਸੀ ਤਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Creating the world of the nine regions, O Lord, You have embellished it with beauty.
lines.transliteration: nav khand parithmee saaj har rang savaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਜਲੁ  ਹਾਰੁ ਤਮੋਲ  ਰਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਸੇ ਹਿਭ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Creating the beings of various kinds, You infused Your power into them.
lines.transliteration: vaykee jant upaa-ay ant ar kal Dh aari-aa.

lines.english: No one knows Your limit, O True Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayraa ant  na jaan ai ko-ay sach sirjan haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself know all ways and means; You Yourself save the Gurmukhs. ||1|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1094-14) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too jaan eh sabh  biDh aap gurmukh  nistaari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: If You are my friend, then don't separate Yourself from me, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: jay too mit ar asaadrh aa hik bh oree naa vaychh orh.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਗਆ  ਹੋਏ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: My soul is fascinated and enticed by You; when will I see You, O my Love? ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1094-15) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jee-o mahinjaa ta-o mohi-aa kad  pasee jaanee t ohi. ||1||

lines.english: Burn in the fire, you evil person; O separation, be dead.
lines.transliteration: durjan t oo jal bh aahrh ee vichh orhay mar jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਿਪਰ੍ਥਮੀ  ਸਾਿਜ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my Husband Lord, please sleep upon my bed, that all my sufferings may be gone.||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1094-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kantaa t oo sa-o sayjrh ee maidaa habh o dukh ulaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਕੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਲ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The evil person is engrossed in the love of duality; through the disease of egotism, hesuffers separation.
lines.transliteration: durjan d oojaa bh aa-o hai vaychh orhaa ha-umai rog.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਇ ਸਚੁ ਿਸਰਜਣਹਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord King is my friend; meeting with Him, I am so happy. ||3|| pauVI ] (1094-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sajan sachaa paat isaahu jis mil keechai bh og. ||3||

lines.english: You are inaccessible, merciful and infinite; who can estimate Your worth?
lines.transliteration: too agam d a-i-aal bay-ant  tayree keemat  kahai ka-un .

lines.english: You created the entire universe; You are the Master of all the worlds.
lines.transliteration: tuDh sirji-aa sabh  sansaar t oo naa-ik sagal bh a-un.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਅਸਾਡੜਾ  ਿਹਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋਿੜ  ॥
lines.english: No one knows Your creative power, O my all-pervading Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tayree kud rat ko-ay na jaan ai mayray th aakur sagal ra-un .

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਮਿਹੰਜਾ  ਤਉ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਕਿਦ  ਪਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ  ਤੋਿਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one can equal You; You are imperishable and eternal, the Savior of the world. pMnw 1095
lines.transliteration: tuDh aparh  ko-ay na sakai t oo abh inaasee jag uDh ran.

lines.english: You established the four ages; You are the Creator of all worlds.
lines.transliteration: tuDh thaapay chaaray jug t oo kart aa sagal Dh aran.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਥਾਪੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਧਰਣ  ॥
lines.english: You created the comings and goings of reincarnation; not even a particle of filth sticks to You.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aavan  jaanaa kee-aa t uDh layp na lagai t arin.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਕੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਤਰ੍ਣ  ॥
lines.english: As you are merciful, You attach us to the Feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis hoveh aap da-i-aal t is laaveh sat gur charan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਲਾਵਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣ  ॥
lines.english: You cannot be found by any other efforts; You are the eternal, imperishable Creatorof the Universe. ||2|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1095-3) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too horat  upaa-ay na labh hee abh inaasee sarisat karan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਹੋਰਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਨ ਲਭਹੀ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਰਣ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If You come into my courtyard, all the earth becomes beautiful.
lines.transliteration: jay too vat eh any -nay habh  Dharat suhaavee ho-ay.

lines.english: Other than the One Lord, my Husband, no one else cares for me. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1095-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hikas kantai baahree maidee vaat  na puchh ai ko-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਵਤਿਹ  ਅੰਙਣੇ  ਹਭ ਧਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All my adornments become beautiful, when You, O Lord, sit in my courtyard and makeit Yours.
lines.transliteration: habhay tol suhaavan ay saho baith aa any an mal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਕਸੁ  ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਮੈਡੀ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Then no traveller who comes to my home shall leave empty-handed. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1095-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pahee na vanjai birtharh aa jo gh ar aavai chal. ||2||

lines.english: I have spread out my bed for You, O my Husband Lord, and applied all mydecorations.
lines.transliteration: sayj vichhaa-ee kant  koo kee-aa habh  seegaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ  ਸਹੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਅੰਙਣੁ  ਮਿਲ ॥
lines.english: But even this is not pleasing to me, to wear a garland around my neck. ||3|| pauVI ] (1095-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: itee manjh  na samaava-ee jay gal pahiraa haar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਹੀ ਨ ਵੰਞੈ ਿਬਰਥੜਾ ਜੋ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਚਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, O Transcendent Lord, You do not take birth.
lines.transliteration: too paarbarahm parmaysar jon na aavhee.

lines.english: By the Hukam of Your Command, You formed the Universe; forming it, You mergeinto it.
lines.transliteration: too hukmee saajeh sarisat saaj samaavahee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਿਵਛਾਈ  ਕੰਤ ਕੂ ਕੀਆ  ਹਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Your Form cannot be known; how can one meditate on You?
lines.transliteration: tayraa roop na jaa-ee lakh i-aa ki-o t ujheh Dh i-aavahee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੀ  ਮੰਿਝ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ  ਜੇ ਗਿਲ  ਪਿਹਰਾ  ਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You are pervading and permeating all; You Yourself reveal Your creative potency.
lines.transliteration: too sabh  meh vart eh aap kud rat daykhaavahee.

lines.english: Your treasures of devotional worship are overflowing; they never decrease.
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat bharay bh andaar t ot na aavhee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: These gems, jewels and diamonds - their value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: ayhi ratan javayhar laal keem na paavhee.

lines.english: As You Yourself become merciful, Lord, You link us to the service of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jis hoveh aap da-i-aal t is satgur sayvaa laavhee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਲਿਖਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਿਧਆਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, never suffers any deficiency. ||3|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1095-10) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis kad ay na aavai t ot jo har gun  gaavhee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਤਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ ਦੇਖਾਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: When I look within my being, I find that my Beloved is with me.
lines.transliteration: jaa moo pasee hath mai piree mahijai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: All pains are relieved, O Nanak, when He bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1095-11) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: habhay dukh  ulaahi-am naanak nad ar nihaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਿਹ ਰਤਨ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਲਾਲ  ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak sits, waiting for news of the Lord, and stands at the Lord's Door; serving Him for so long.
lines.transliteration: naanak baithaa bh akhay vaa-o lammay sayveh d ar kharhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, only You know my objective; I stand, waiting to see the Lord's face.||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1095-12) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: piree-ay too jaan  mahijaa saa-o jo-ee saa-ee muhu kh arhaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਤੋਿਟ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What should I say to you, you fool? Don't look at the vines of others - be a truehusband.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa galaa-i-o bhoochh  par vayl na johay kant  too.

lines.english: O Nanak, the entire world is blooming, like a garden of flowers. ||3|| pauVI ] (1095-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak fulaa sandee vaarh  khirhi-aa habh  sansaar ji-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਮੂ ਪਸੀ ਹਠ ਮੈ ਿਪਰੀ  ਮਿਹਜੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: You are Wise, all-knowing and beautiful; You are pervading and permeating all.
lines.transliteration: sugharh  sujaan  saroop t oo sabh  meh vart antaa.

lines.english: You Yourself are the Lord and Master, and the servant; You worship and adoreYourself.
lines.transliteration: too aapay th aakur sayvko aapay poojant aa.

lines.english: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You Yourself are true and pure.
lines.transliteration: daanaa beenaa aap t oo aapay sat vantaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੈਠਾ ਭਖੇ ਵਾਉ ਲੰਮੇ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਦਰੁ ਖੜਾ ॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Lord, my Lord God, is celibate and True.
lines.transliteration: jatee sat ee parabh  nirmalaa mayray har bh agvant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੀਏ  ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ  ਮਿਹਜਾ  ਸਾਉ ਜੋਈ ਸਾਈ  ਮੁਹੁ ਖੜਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: God spreads out the expanse of the entire universe, and He Himself plays in it.
lines.transliteration: sabh barahm pasaar pasaari-o aapay kh aylant aa.

lines.english: He created this coming and going of reincarnation; creating the wondrous play, He gazes upon it.
lines.transliteration: ih aavaa gavan rachaa-i-o kar choj d aykhantaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਗਾਲਾਇਓ  ਭੂਛ ਪਰ ਵੇਿਲ  ਨ ਜੋਹੇ ਕੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with the Guru's Teachings, is not consigned to the womb ofreincarnation, ever again.
lines.transliteration: tis baahurh  garabh  na paavhee jis d ayveh gur mannt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਦੀ ਵਾਿੜ  ਿਖਿੜਆ  ਹਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਿਜਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All walk as He makes them walk; nothing is under the control of the created beings.||4|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1095-16) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o aap chalaaveh ti-o chald ay kichh  vas na jant aa. ||4||

lines.english: You are walking along the river-bank, but the land is giving way beneath you.
lines.transliteration: kuree-ay kuree-ay vaidi-aa t al gaarh aa mehrayr.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਸਰੂਪੁ  ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Watch out! Your foot might slip, and you'll fall in and die. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1095-18) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vaykhay chh itarh theevd o jaam kh isando payr. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੋ  ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: You believe what is false and temporary to be true, and so you run on and on.
lines.transliteration: sach jaanai kach vaid i-o too aagh oo aagh ay salvay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨਾ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਸਤਵੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, like butter in the fire, it shall melt away; it shall fade away like the water-lily. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1095-19) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aatasrh ee manjh  nainoo bi-aa dh al paban  ji-o jummi-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੀ  ਸਤੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਨਰਮਲਾ  ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my foolish and silly soul, why are you too lazy to serve?
lines.transliteration: bhoray bh oray roohrh ay sayvayd ay aalak.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਿਰਓ  ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲੰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Such a long time has passed. When will this opportunity come again? ||3|| pMnw 1096 pauVI ] (1096-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: mudat  pa-ee chiraan ee-aa fir kadoo aavai rut . ||3||

lines.english: You have no form or shape, no social class or race.
lines.transliteration: tuDh roop na raykh -i-aa jaat  too varnaa baahraa.

lines.english: These humans believe that You are far away; but You are quite obviously apparent.
lines.transliteration: ay maanas jaan eh door too vart eh jaahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਿਖਆ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਤੂ ਵਰਨਾ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You enjoy Yourself in every heart, and no filth sticks to You.
lines.transliteration: too sabh  ghat bhogeh aap t uDh layp na laahraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਾਣਸ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਦੂਿਰ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਿਹ ਜਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are the blissful and infinite Primal Lord God; Your Light is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: too purakh  anandee anant  sabh  jot samaaharaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Among all divine beings, You are the most divine, O Creator-architect, Rejuvenator of all.
lines.transliteration: too sabh  dayvaa meh d ayv biDh aatay narharaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਨੰਦੀ  ਅਨੰਤ  ਸਭ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: How can my single tongue worship and adore You? You are the eternal, imperishable,infinite Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa aaraaDhay jihvaa ik t oo abh inaasee aparparaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਿਹ ਦੇਵ ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਨਰਹਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: One whom You Yourself unite with the True Guru - all his generations are saved.
lines.transliteration: jis mayleh satgur aap t is kay sabh  kul taraa.

lines.english: All Your servants serve You; Nanak is a humble servant at Your Door. ||5|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1096-5) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sayvak sabh kard ay sayv d ar naanak jan t ayraa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਭ ਕੁਲ ਤਰਾ ॥
lines.english: He builds a hut of straw, and the fool lights a fire in it.
lines.transliteration: gehdrharh aa tarin chhaa-i-aa gaafal jali-ohu bh aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਦੇ  ਸੇਵ ਦਿਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads, find Shelter withthe Master. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1096-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinaa bhaag mathaaharh ai tin ust aad panaahi. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, he grinds the corn, cooks it and places it before himself.
lines.transliteration: naanak peethaa pakaa saaji-aa Dh ari-aa aan  ma-ujood .

lines.english: But without his True Guru, he sits and waits for his food to be blessed. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1096-7) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: baajhahu sat gur aapn ay baith aa jhaak d arood . ||2||

lines.english: O Nanak, the loaves of bread are baked and placed on the plate.
lines.transliteration: naanak bhusree-aa pakaa-ee-aa paa-ee-aa thaalai maahi.

lines.english: Those who obey their Guru, eat and are totally satisfied. ||3|| pauVI ] (1096-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jinee guroo manaa-i-aa raj raj say-ee khaahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੀਠਾ  ਪਕਾ ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਧਿਰਆ  ਆਿਣ  ਮਉਜੂਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: You have staged this play in the world, and infused egotism into all beings.
lines.transliteration: tuDh jag meh kh ayl rachaa-i-aa vich ha-umai paa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਪਣੇ ਬੈਠਾ ਝਾਕੁ ਦਰੂਦ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the one temple of the body are the five thieves, who continually misbehave.
lines.transliteration: ayk mandar panch chor heh nit  karahi buri-aa-ee-aa.

lines.english: The ten brides, the sensory organs were created, and the one husband, the self; theten are engrossed in flavors and tastes.
lines.transliteration: das naaree ik purakh  kar d asay saad  lobhaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੁਸਰੀਆ  ਪਕਾਈਆ  ਪਾਈਆ  ਥਾਲੈ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: This Maya fascinates and entices them; they wander continually in doubt.
lines.transliteration: ayn maa-i-aa mohnee mohee-aa nit  fireh bh armaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਾਇਆ ਰਿਜ ਰਿਜ ਸੇਈ ਖਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You created both sides, spirit and matter, Shiva and Shakti.
lines.transliteration: haathaa d ovai keet ee-o siv sakat  vartaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: Matter loses out to spirit; this is pleasing to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: siv agai saktee haari-aa ayvai har bh aa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: You enshrined spirit within, which leads to merger with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: ik vichahu hee tuDh  rakhi-aa jo sat sang milaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਹਿਹ ਿਨਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੁਿਰਆਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Within the bubble, You formed the bubble, which shall once again merge into thewater. ||6|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1096-12) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jal vichahu bimb uthaali-o jal maahi samaa-ee-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ  ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਕਿਰ ਦਸੇ ਸਾਿਦ  ਲਭਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Look ahead; don't turn your face backwards.
lines.transliteration: aagaahaa koo taraagh  pichh aa fayr na muhadrh aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, be successful this time, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1096-13) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sijh ivayhaa vaar bahurh  na hovee janamrh aa. ||1||

lines.english: My joyful friend is called the friend of all.
lines.transliteration: sajan maidaa chaa-ee-aa habh  kahee d aa mit .

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਅਗੈ ਸਕਤੀ  ਹਾਿਰਆ  ਏਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: All think of Him as their own; He never breaks anyone's heart. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1096-14) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: habhay jaan an aapn aa kahee na th aahay chit . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਜੋ ਸਤਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: The hidden jewel has been found; it has appeared on my forehead.
lines.transliteration: gujh-rh aa laDh am laal mathai hee pargat thi-aa.

lines.english: Beautiful and exalted is that place, O Nanak, where You dwell, O my Dear Lord. ||3|| pauVI ] (1096-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: so-ee suhaavaa thaan jithai piree-ay naanak jee too vuth i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: When You are on my side, Lord, what do I need to worry about?
lines.transliteration: jaa too mayrai val hai t aa ki-aa muhchh andaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਗਾਹਾ  ਕੂ ਤਰ੍ਾਿਘ  ਿਪਛਾ  ਫੇਿਰ ਨ ਮੁਹਡੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: You entrusted everything to me, when I became Your slave.
lines.transliteration: tuDh sabh  kichh  maino sa-upi-aa jaa t ayraa band aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਿਝ  ਇਵੇਹਾ  ਵਾਰ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਨਮੜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My wealth is inexhaustible, no matter how much I spend and consume.
lines.transliteration: lakhmee t ot na aavee kh aa-ay kh arach rahand aa.

lines.english: The 8.4 million species of beings all work to serve me.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh mayd nee sabh  sayv karand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੈਡਾ ਚਾਈਆ  ਹਭ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ਿਮਤੁ ॥
lines.english: All these enemies have become my friends, and no one wishes me ill.
lines.transliteration: ayh vairee mitar sabh  keeti-aa nah mangeh mand aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਭੇ ਜਾਣਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਿਚਤੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: No one calls me to account, since God is my forgiver.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa ko-ay na puchh -ee jaa har bh akhsandaa.

lines.english: I have become blissful, and I have found peace, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: anand bha-i-aa sukh  paa-i-aa mil gur govind aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਝੜਾ  ਲਧਮੁ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਮਥੈ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਿਥਆ  ॥
lines.english: All my affairs have been resolved, since You are pleased with me. ||7|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1096-19) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabhay kaaj savaari-ai jaa t uDh bhaavand aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਥਾਨੁ ਿਜਥੈ ਿਪਰੀਏ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀ ਤੂ ਵੁਿਠਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am so eager to see You, O Lord; what does Your face look like?
lines.transliteration: daykhan  koo must aak mukh  kijayhaa t a-o Dh anee.

lines.english: I wandered around in such a miserable state, but when I saw You, my mind was comforted and consoled. ||1|| pMnw 1097 mÚ 5 ] (1097-1) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: firdaa kit ai haal jaa dith am taa man Dh araapi-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The miserable endure so much suffering and pain; You alone know their pain, Lord.
lines.transliteration: dukhee-aa d arad ghanay vayd an jaan ay too Dh anee.

lines.english: I may know hundreds of thousands of remedies, but I shall live only if I see my Husband Lord. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1097-2) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaanaa lakh  bhavay piree dikh ando taa jeevsaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੀਆ  ਦਰਦ  ਘਣੇ ਵੇਦਨ  ਜਾਣੇ  ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.english: I have seen the river-bank washed away by the raging waters of the river.
lines.transliteration: dhahd ee jaa-ay karaar vahan  vahand ay mai dith i-aa.

lines.english: They alone remain intact, who meet with the True Guru. ||3|| pauVI ] (1097-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: say-ee rahay amaan jinaa sat gur bh ayti-aa. ||3||

lines.english: No pain afflicts that humble being who hungers for You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis jan tayree bh ukh hai tis dukh na vi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਢਹਦੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਕਰਾਿਰ  ਵਹਿਣ  ਵਹੰਦੇ  ਮੈ ਿਡਿਠਆ  ॥
lines.english: That humble Gurmukh who understands, is celebrated in the four directions.
lines.transliteration: jin jan gurmukh bujh i-aa so chahu kundee jaapai.

lines.english: Sins run away from that man, who seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo nar us kee sarnee parai t is kambeh paapai.

lines.english: The filth of countless incarnations is washed away, bathing in the dust of the Guru'sfeet.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee mal utrai gur Dh oorhee naapai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਿਵਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever submits to the Lord's Will does not suffer in sorrow.
lines.transliteration: jin har bhaan aa mani-aa t is sog na sant aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੁਿਝਆ  ਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You are the friend of all; all believe that You are theirs.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o too sabh naa kaa mit  hai sabh  jaaneh aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਰੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਕੰਬਿਹ  ਪਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Lord's humble servant is as great as the Glorious Radiance of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisee sobhaa janai kee jayvad har part aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਗੁਰ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Among all, His humble servant is pre-eminent; through His humble servant, the Lordis known. ||8|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1097-7) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh ant ar jan vart aa-i-aa har jan t ay jaapai. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom I followed, now follow me.
lines.transliteration: jinaa pichhai ha-o ga-ee say mai pichh ai bhee ravi-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਿਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਭ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those in whom I placed my hopes, now place their hopes in me. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1097-8) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinaa kee mai aasrhee t inaa mahijee aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਸੋਭਾ ਜਨੈ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: The fly flies around, and comes to the wet lump of molasses.
lines.transliteration: gilee gilee rodrhee bh a-udee bh av bh av aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਨ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Whoever sits on it, is caught; they alone are saved, who have good destiny on their foreheads. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1097-9) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo baithay say faathi-aa ubray bh aag mathaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I see Him within all. No one is without Him.
lines.transliteration: dithaa habh  majh aahi kh aalee ko-ay na jaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਿਪਛੈ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਿਪਛੈ ਭੀ ਰਿਵਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Good destiny is inscribed on the forehead of that companion, who who enjoys theLord, my Friend. ||3|| pauVI ] (1097-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: tai sakh ee bh aag mathaahi jinee mayraa sajan  raavi-aa. ||3||

lines.english: I am a minstrel at His Door, singing His Glorious Praises, to please to my Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhaadh ee dar gun  gaavd aa jay har parabh  bhaavai.

lines.english: My God is permanent and stable; others continue coming and going.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayraa thir thaavree hor aavai jaavai.

lines.english: I beg for that gift from the Lord of the World, which will satisfy my hunger.
lines.transliteration: so mangaa daan gosaa-ee-aa jit  bhukh leh jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੇ ਫਾਿਥਆ  ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord God, please bless Your minstrel with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan,that I might be satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: parabh jee-o d ayvhu d arsan aapn aa jit dhaadhee tariptaavai.

lines.english: God, the Great Giver, hears the prayer, and summons the minstrel to the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: ardaas sun ee daataar parabh  dhaadhee ka-o mahal bulaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਡਠਾ  ਹਭ ਮਝਾਿਹ  ਖਾਲੀ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon God, the minstrel is rid of pain and hunger; he does not think to ask foranything else.
lines.transliteration: parabh d aykh-di-aa d ukh bhukh ga-ee dh aadhee ka-o mangan  chit na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਖੀ ਭਾਗ  ਮਥਾਿਹ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ  ਰਾਿਵਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All desires are fulfilled, touching the feet of God.
lines.transliteration: sabhay ichh aa pooree-aa lag parabh  kai paavai.

lines.english: I am His humble, unworthy minstrel; the Primal Lord God has forgiven me. ||9|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1097-14) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ha-o nirgun dh aadhee bakh si-on parabh  purakh  vaidaavai. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ  ਦਿਰ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ  ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: When the soul leaves, you shall become dust, O vacant body; why do you not realizeyour Husband Lord?
lines.transliteration: jaa chhutay t aa kh aak too sunj ee kant  na jaan hee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਥਰ ਥਾਵਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: You are in love with evil people; by what virtues will you enjoy the Lord's Love? ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1097-15) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: durjan sayt ee nayhu t oo kai gun  har rang maan hee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਮੰਗਾ  ਦਾਨੁ ਗਸਾਈਆ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਭੁਖ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without Him, you cannot survive, even for an instant; you cannot afford toforget Him, even for a moment.
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bin gharh ee na jeevn aa visray sarai na bind .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਢਾਢੀ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Why are you alienated from Him, O my mind? He takes care of you. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1097-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis si-o ki-o man roosee-ai jisahi hamaaree chind . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਢਾਢੀ  ਕਉ ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God, their minds andbodies are colored deep crimson.
lines.transliteration: ratay rang paarbarahm kai man t an at gulaal.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੇਖਿਦਆ  ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਢਾਢੀ  ਕਉ ਮੰਗਣੁ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, other thoughts are polluted and corrupt. ||3|| pvVI ] (1097-17) pavrhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai aalood i-aa jit ee hor kh i-aal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ  ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਲਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, when You are my friend, what sorrow can afflict me?
lines.transliteration: har jee-o jaa too mayraa mit ar hai t aa ki-aa mai kaarh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਨਰਗੁਣੁ  ਢਾਢੀ  ਬਖਿਸਓਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਵੇਦਾਵੈ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: You have beaten off and destroyed the cheats that cheat the world.
lines.transliteration: jinee thagee jag th agi-aa say t uDh maar nivaarh aa.

lines.english: The Guru has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean, and I have won the battle.
lines.transliteration: gur bha-ojal paar langh aa-i-aa jit aa paavaarh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਛੁਟੇ ਤਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਤੂ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy all the pleasures in the great world-arena.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee sabh  ras bh ogdaa vadaa aakh aarhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਜਨ  ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਤੂ ਕੈ ਗੁਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Lord has brought all my senses and organs under my control. pMnw 1098
lines.transliteration: sabh ind ree-aa vas kar d itee-o sat vantaa saarh aa.

lines.english: Wherever I join them, there they are joined; they do not struggle against me.
lines.transliteration: jit laa-ee-an t itai lagd ee-aa nah kh injotaarhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛੀ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵਾੜਾ  ॥
lines.english: I obtain the fruits of my desires; the Guru has directed me within.
lines.transliteration: jo ichhee so fal paa-id aa gur and ar vaarh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤੁਠਾ  ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਵਸਦਾ  ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: When Guru Nanak is pleased, O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord is seen to be dwelling near at hand. ||10|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1098-2) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuth aa bh aa-irahu har vasd aa nayrh aa. ||10||

lines.english: When You come into my consciousness, then I obtain all peace and comfort.
lines.transliteration: jaa mooN aavahi chit t oo taa habh ay sukh  lahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਮੂੰ ਆਵਿਹ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਤੂ ਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak: with Your Name within my mind, O my Husband Lord, I am filled with delight.||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1098-3) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak man hee manjh rangvaalaa piree t ahijaa naa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਿਝ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ  ਿਪਰੀ  ਤਿਹਜਾ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Enjoyment of clothes and corrupt pleasures - all these are nothing more than dust.
lines.transliteration: kaparh bh og vikaar ay habh ay hee chh aar.

lines.english: I long for the dust of the feet of those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1098-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: khaak lorh aydaa tann kh ay jo rat ay deedaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਪੜ  ਭੋਗ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਏ ਹਭੇ ਹੀ ਛਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Why do you look in other directions? O my heart, take the Support of the Lord alone.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa takeh bi-aa paas kar hee-arh ay hik aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਕੁ ਲੜੇਦਾ  ਤੰਿਨ  ਖੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Become the dust of the feet of the Saints, and find the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||3|| pauVI ] (1098-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: thee-o santan kee rayn  jit labhee sukh  daataar. ||3||

lines.english: Without good karma, the Dear Lord is not found; without the True Guru, the mind is not joined to Him.
lines.transliteration: vin karmaa har jee-o na paa-ee-ai bin sat gur manoo-aa na lagai.

lines.english: Dharam Dh eeraa kal and ray ih paapee mool na t agai. Only the Dharma remains stable in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; these sinners will notlast at all.

lines.punjabi: ਥੀਉ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਲਭੀ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whatever one does with this hand, he obtains with the other hand, without amoment's delay.
lines.transliteration: ah kar karay so ah kar paa-ay ik gharh ee muhat  na lagai.

lines.english: I have examined the four ages, and without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation,egotism does not depart.
lines.transliteration: chaaray jug mai soDhi-aa vin  sangat  ahaNkaar na bh agai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
lines.english: Egotism is never eradicated without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mool na chhut-ee vin  saaDh oo sat sangai.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮੁ  ਧੀਰਾ  ਕਿਲ  ਅੰਦਰੇ  ਇਹੁ ਪਾਪੀ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਤਗੈ ॥
lines.english: As long as one's mind is torn away from his Lord and Master, he finds no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: tichar thaah na paav-ee jichar saahib si-o man bh angai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹ  ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਿਹ  ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ  ਮੁਹਤੁ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
lines.english: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, has the Support of the Imperishable Lord in the home of his heart.
lines.transliteration: jin jan gurmukh sayvi-aa t is ghar deebaan  abhgai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਮੈ ਸੋਿਧਆ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਗੈ ॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Grace, peace is obtained, and one is attached to the feet of the Guru,the True Guru. ||11|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1098-9) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa tay sukh  paa-i-aa gur sat gur charn ee lagai. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਛੁਟਈ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਸੰਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched everywhere for the King over the heads of kings.
lines.transliteration: lorheed o habh  jaa-ay so meeraa meerann sir.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਚਰੁ ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨ ਭੰਗੈ ॥
lines.english: That Master is within my heart; I chant His Name with my mouth. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1098-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hath manjh aahoo so Dh anee cha-ud o mukh  alaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਘਿਰ  ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਅਭਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: O my mother, the Master has blessed me with the jewel.
lines.transliteration: maanikoo mohi maa-o dinnaa Dh anee apaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਗੈ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: My heart is cooled and soothed, chanting the True Name with my mouth. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1098-11) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hi-aa-o mahijaa thandh -rhaa mukh ahu sach alaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I have become the bed for my Beloved Husband Lord; my eyes have become thesheets.
lines.transliteration: moo thee-aa-oo sayj nainaa piree vichh aavnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋੜੀਦੋ  ਹਭ ਜਾਇ  ਸੋ ਮੀਰਾ  ਮੀਰੰਨ  ਿਸਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: If You look at me, even for an instant, then I obtain peace beyond all price. ||3|| pauVI ] (1098-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jay daykhai hik vaar t aa sukh  keemaa hoo baahray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਚਉਦੋ  ਮੁਿਖ ਅਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind longs to meet the Lord; how can I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan?
lines.transliteration: man lochai har milan ka-o ki-o d arsan paa-ee-aa.

lines.english: I obtain hundreds of thousands, if my Lord and Master speaks to me, even for aninstant.
lines.transliteration: mai lakh virh -tay saahibaa jay bind  bolaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: I have searched in four directions; there is no other as great as You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai chaaray kundaa bhaalee-aa t uDh jayvad na saa-ee-aa.

lines.english: Show me the Path, O Saints. How can I meet God?
lines.transliteration: mai dasihu maarag sant aho ki-o parabh oo milaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: I dedicate my mind to Him, and renounce my ego. This is the Path which I shall take.
lines.transliteration: man arpihu ha-umai tajahu it  panth julaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I serve my Lord and Master continually.
lines.transliteration: nit sayvihu saahib aapn aa sat sang milaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਡੇਖੈ ਿਹਕ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਮਾ  ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: All my hopes are fulfilled; the Guru has ushered me into the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence.
lines.transliteration: sabhay aasaa pooree-aa gur mahal bulaa-ee-aa.

lines.english: I cannot conceive of any other as great as You, O my Friend, O Lord of the World.||12|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1098-16) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad hor na sujh -ee mayray mit ar gosaa-ee-aa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲਣ ਕਉ ਿਕਉ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have become the throne for my Beloved Lord King.
lines.transliteration: moo thee-aa-oo takh at piree mahinjay paat isaah.

lines.english: If You place Your foot on me, I blossom forth like the lotus flower. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1098-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paav milaavay kol kaval jivai bigsaavdo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਸਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: If my Beloved becomes hungry, I will become food, and place myself before Him.
lines.transliteration: piree-aa sand-rh ee bh ukh moo laavan  thee vithraa.

lines.english: I may be crushed, again and again, but like sugarcane, I do not stop yielding sweet juice. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1098-18) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaan mith aa-ee ikh  bay-ee peerh ay naa hutai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਿਪਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਜਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਪੰਿਥ ਜੁਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: Break off your love with the cheaters; realize that it is a mirage.
lines.transliteration: thagaa neehu mat rorh jaan ganDh arbaa nagree.

lines.english: Your pleasure lasts for only two moments; this traveller wanders through countlesshomes. ||3|| pauVI ] (1098-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: sukh gh ataa-oo doo-ay is panDh aanoo gh ar ghanay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਆਸਾ  ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਲ ਬੁਲਾਈਆ  ॥
lines.english: God is not found by intellectual devices; He is unknowable and unseen. pMnw 1099
lines.transliteration: akal kalaa nah paa-ee-ai parabh alakh  alaykh aN.

lines.english: The followers of the six orders wander and roam around wearing religious robes, but they do not meet God.
lines.transliteration: khat d arsan bh aramt ay fireh nah milee-ai bh aykhaN.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਚੰਦਰ੍ਾਇਣਾ  ਸੇ ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
lines.english: They keep the lunar fasts, but they are of no account.
lines.transliteration: varat karahi chand raa-in aa say kit ai na laykh aN.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਿਹ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ  ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪੇਖੰ ॥
lines.english: Those who read the Vedas in their entirety, still do not see the sublime essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: bayd parh eh sampoornaa t at saar na paykh aN.

lines.english: They apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, and take cleansing baths, but theyare blackened within.
lines.transliteration: tilak kadh eh isnaan kar ant ar kaalaykh aN.

lines.english: They wear religious robes, but without the True Teachings, God is not found.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh ee parabh oo na labh -ee vin  sachee sikh aN.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੰ ॥
lines.english: One who had strayed, finds the Path again, if such pre-ordained destiny is written onhis forehead.
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa maarag so pavai jis Dh ur mast ak laykh aN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਿਰਆ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੰ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: One who sees the Guru with his eyes, embellishes and exalts his human life. ||13|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1099-4) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin janam savaari-aa aapn aa jin gur akh ee daykhaN. ||13||

lines.english: Focus on that which will not pass away.
lines.transliteration: so nivaahoo gad jo chalaa-oo na thee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਨਵਾਹੂ ਗਿਡ  ਜੋ ਚਲਾਊ  ਨ ਥੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Abandon your false actions, and meditate on the True Master. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1099-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaar koorhaavee chh ad sammal sach Dh anee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰ ਕੂੜਾਵੀ  ਛਿਡ ਸੰਮਲੁ  ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God's Light is permeating all, like the moon reflected in the water.
lines.transliteration: habh samaan ee jot  ji-o jal gh ataa-oo chand armaa.

lines.english: He Himself is revealed, O Nanak, to one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1099-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pargat thee-aa aap naanak mastak likh i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਭ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਘਟਾਊ  ਚੰਦਰ੍ਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: One's face becomes beautiful, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singingHis Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: mukh suhaavay naam cha-o aath  pahar gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, in the Court of the Lord, you shall be accepted; even the homeless find ahome there. ||3|| pauVI ] (1099-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak dargeh manee-ah milee nithaavay thaa-o. ||3||

lines.english: By wearing religious robes outwardly, God, the Inner-knower is not found.
lines.transliteration: baahar bhaykh  na paa-ee-ai parabh  antarjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਚਉ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Without the One Dear Lord, all wander around aimlessly.
lines.transliteration: ikas har jee-o baahree sabh firai nikaamee.

lines.english: Their minds are imbued with attachment to family, and so they continually wanderaround, puffed up with pride.
lines.transliteration: man rataa kutamb si-o nit  garab firaamee.

lines.english: The arrogant wander around the world; why are they so proud of their wealth?
lines.transliteration: fireh gumaanee jag meh ki-aa garbeh daamee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰ  ਭੇਿਖ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: Their wealth shall not go with them when they depart; in an instant, it is gone.
lines.transliteration: chaldi-aa naal na chal-ee kh in jaa-ay bilaamee.

lines.english: They wander around in the world, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: bicharday fireh sansaar meh har jee hukaamee.

lines.english: When one's karma is activated, one finds the Guru, and through Him, the Lord and Master is found.
lines.transliteration: karam khulaa gur paa-i-aa har mili-aa su-aamee.

lines.english: That humble being, who serves the Lord, has his affairs resolved by the Lord. ||14|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1099-11) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo jan har kaa sayvko har tis kee kaamee. ||14||

lines.english: All speak with their mouths, but rare are those one who realize death.
lines.transliteration: mukhahu alaa-ay habh  maran  pachh aanado ko-ay.

lines.english: Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who have faith in the One Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1099-12) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tinaa kh aak jinaa yakeenaa hik si-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਖੁਲਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: Know that He dwells within all; rare are those who realize this.
lines.transliteration: jaan vasand o manjh  pachh aanoo ko haykrh o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ  ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਮੀ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: There is no obscuring veil on the body of that one, O Nanak, who meets the Guru. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1099-13) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tai tan parh -daa naahi naanak jai gur bh ayti-aa. ||2||

lines.english: I drink in the water which has washed the feet of those who share the Teachings.
lines.transliteration: mat-rh ee kaaNdhak aah paav Dh ovand o peevsaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ  ਹਭ ਮਰਣੁ  ਪਛਾਣੰਦੋ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: My body is filled with infinite love to see my True Master. ||3|| pauVI ] (1099-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: moo tan paraym athaah pasan  koo sachaa Dh anee. ||3||

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord, he becomes attached to Maya.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o naam visaari-aa naal maa-i-aa rachaa.

lines.english: He comes and goes, and wanders, dancing in countless incarnations.
lines.transliteration: aavai jaa-ay bhavaa-ee-ai baho jonee nachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਣੁ  ਵਸੰਦੋ  ਮੰਿਝ ਪਛਾਣੂ  ਕੋ ਹੇਕੜੋ  ॥
lines.english: He gives his word, but then backs out. All that he says is false.
lines.transliteration: bachan karay tai kh isak jaa-ay bolay sabh  kachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਤਿਨ ਪੜਦਾ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੈ ਗੁ ਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The false person is hollow within; he is totally engrossed in falsehood.
lines.transliteration: andrahu thothaa koorh i-aar koorh ee sabh  khachaa.

lines.english: He tries to take vengeance upon the Lord, who bears no vengeance; such a person is trapped by falsehood and greed.
lines.transliteration: vair karay nirvair naal jhooth ay laalchaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੜੀ  ਕਢਕੁ  ਆਹ  ਪਾਵ ਧੋਵੰਦੋ  ਪੀਵਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The True King, the Primal Lord God, kills him when He sees what he has done.
lines.transliteration: maari-aa sachai paatisaah vaykh  Dhur karamchaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਅਥਾਹ  ਪਸਣ  ਕੂ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death sees him, and he rots away in pain.
lines.transliteration: jamdoot ee hai hayri-aa d ukh hee meh pachaa.

lines.english: Even-handed justice is administered, O Nanak, in the Court of the True Lord. ||15|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1099-17) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ho-aa tapaavas Dh aram kaa naanak d ar sachaa. ||15||

lines.english: In the early hours of the morning, chant the Name of God, and meditate on the Feetof the Guru.
lines.transliteration: parbhaat ay parabh  naam jap gur kay charan  Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਭਵਾਈਐ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of birth and death is erased, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1099-18) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: janam maran mal ut rai sachay kay gun  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਚਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਿਖਸਿਕ  ਜਾਇ  ਬੋਲੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਚਾ  ॥
lines.english: The body is dark, blind and empty, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dayh anDh aaree anDh  sunjee naam vihoon ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਥੋਥਾ ਕੂਿੜਆਰੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਸਭ ਖਚਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, fruitful is the birth of one, within whose heart the True Master dwells. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1099-19) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak safal jannam jai ghat vuth aa sach Dh anee. ||2||

lines.english: With my eyes, I have seen the Light; my great thirst for Him is not quenched. pMnw 1100
lines.transliteration: lo-in lo-ee dith  pi-aas na bujh ai moo gh anee.

lines.english: O Nanak, these are not the eyes which can see my Beloved Husband Lord. ||3|| pauVI ] (1100-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak say akh-rh ee-aa bi-ann jinee disand o maa piree. ||3||

lines.english: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, obtains all peace and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: jin jan gurmukh sayvi-aa t in sabh  sukh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਿਨ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is saved, along with his family, and all the world is saved as well.
lines.transliteration: oh aap tari-aa kutamb si-o sabh  jagat  taraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਤਿਰਆ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਿਸਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He collects the wealth of the Lord's Name, and all his thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: on har naamaa Dhan sanchi-aa sabh  tikhaa bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚਆ  ਸਭ ਿਤਖਾ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He renounces worldly greed, and his inner being is lovingly attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: on chhaday laalach d unee kay ant ar liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਨ ਛਡੇ ਲਾਲਚ  ਦੁਨੀ  ਕੇ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, the home of his heart is filled with bliss; the Lord is his companion, help and support.
lines.transliteration: os sadaa sad aa gh ar anand hai har sakh aa sahaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘਿਰ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He looks alike upon enemy and friend, and wishes well to all.
lines.transliteration: on vairee mitar sam keet i-aa sabh  naal subh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਨ ਵੈਰੀ ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਸਮ ਕੀਿਤਆ  ਸਭ ਨਾਿਲ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is fulfilled in this world, who meditates on the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ho-aa ohee al jag meh gur gi-aan japaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਆ  ਓਹੀ ਅਲੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਜਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He obtains what is pre-ordained for him, according to the Lord. ||16|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1100-5) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: poorab likhi-aa paa-i-aa har si-o ban  aa-ee. ||16||

lines.english: The true person is said to be beautiful; false is the reputation of the false.
lines.transliteration: sach suhaavaa kaadhee-ai koorhai koorh ee so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, rare are those who have Truth in their laps. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1100-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak virlay jaanee-ahi jin sach palai ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਕਾਢੀਐ  ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The face of my friend, the Lord, is incomparably beautiful; I would watch Him, twenty-four hours a day.
lines.transliteration: sajan mukh  anoop ath ay pahar nihaalsaa.

lines.english: In sleep, I saw my Husband Lord; I am a sacrifice to that dream. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1100-7) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sut-rh ee so saho dith  tai supnay ha-o kh annee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: O my friend, realize the True Lord. Just to talk about Him is useless.
lines.transliteration: sajan sach parakh  mukh  alaavan  thothraa.

lines.english: See Him within your mind; your Beloved is not far away. ||3|| pauVI ] (1100-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: man majhaahoo lakh  tuDhhu door na so piree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤੜੀ  ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਿਡਠੁ ਤੈ ਸੁਪਨੇ  ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dharat  aakaas paat aal hai chand  soor binaasee. The earth, the Akaashic ethers of the sky, the nether regions of the underworld, themoon and the sun shall pass away.
Emperors, bankers, rulers and leaders shall depart, and their homes shall bedemolished.
lines.transliteration: baadisaah saah umraav kh aan dh aahi dayray jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣ  ਸਚੁ ਪਰਿਖ  ਮੁਿਖ ਅਲਾਵਣੁ ਥੋਥਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The poor and the rich, the humble and the intoxicated, all these people shall passaway.
lines.transliteration: rang tung gareeb masat  sabh  lok siDh aasee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਲਿਖ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਸੁ ਿਪਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Qazis, Shaykhs and preachers shall all arise and depart.
lines.transliteration: kaajee saykh masaa-ikaa sabh ay uth  jaasee.

lines.english: The spiritual teachers, prophets and disciples - none of these shall remainpermanently.
lines.transliteration: peer paikaabar a-ulee-ay ko thir na rahaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਤ  ਆਕਾਸੁ  ਪਾਤਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Fasts, calls to prayer and sacred scriptures - without understanding, all these shallvanish.
lines.transliteration: rojaa baag nivaaj katayb vin  bujhay sabh  jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਦਸਾਹ  ਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਵ  ਖਾਨ ਢਾਿਹ  ਡੇਰੇ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The 8.4 million species of beings of the earth shall all continue coming and going inreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh mayd nee sabh  aavai jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਤੁੰਗ ਗਰੀਬ  ਮਸਤ  ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਿਸਧਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The One True Lord God is eternal and unchanging. The Lord's slave is also eternal.||17|| fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1100-12) dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nihchal sach khud aa-ay ayk kh udaa-ay band aa abh inaasee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਜੀ  ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ  ਸਭੇ ਉਿਠ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen and examined all; without the One Lord, there is none at all.
lines.transliteration: dithee habh  dhandhol hikas baajh  na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਬਰ  ਅਉਲੀਏ  ਕੋ ਿਥਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Come, and show me Your face, O my friend, so that my body and mind may be cooled and soothed. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1100-13) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aa-o sajan t oo mukh  lag mayraa t an man th andhaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਜਾ ਬਾਗ  ਿਨਵਾਜ ਕਤੇਬ  ਿਵਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਸਭ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The lover is without hope, but within my mind, there is great hope.
lines.transliteration: aasak aasaa baahraa moo man vadee aas.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਸਭ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the midst of hope, only You, O Lord, remain free of hope; I am a sacrifice, asacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1100-14) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aas niraasaa hik too ha-o bal bal bal ga-ee-aas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਬੰਦਾ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Even if I just hear of separation from You, I am in pain; without seeing You, O Lord, Idie.
lines.transliteration: vichhorh aa sun ay dukh  vin dithay mari-od .

lines.english: Without her Beloved, the separated lover takes no comfort. ||3|| pauVI ] (1100-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: baajh pi-aaray aapn ay birhee naa Dh eerod . ||3||

lines.english: River-banks, sacred shrines, idols, temples, and places of pilgrimage likeKaydarnaat'h, Mat'huraa and Benares,
lines.transliteration: tat tirath d ayv d ayvaali-aa kayd aar mathuraa kaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਉ  ਸਜਣ  ਤੂ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot tayt eesaa d ayvtay san  indrai jaasee. the three hundred thirty million gods, along with Indra, shall all pass away.

lines.english: The Simritees, Shaastras, the four Vedas and the six systems of philosophy shallvanish.
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar bayd  chaar kh at daras samaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਕੁ  ਆਸਾ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਮੂ ਮਿਨ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Prayer books, Pandits, religious scholars, songs, poems and poets shall also depart.
lines.transliteration: pothee pandit geet  kavit  kavtay bh ee jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਿਨਰਾਸਾ ਿਹਕੁ ਤੂ ਹਉ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਗਈਆਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are celibate, truthful and charitiable, and the Sannyaasee hermits are all subject to death.
lines.transliteration: jatee sat ee sanni-aasee-aa sabh  kaalai vaasee.

lines.english: The silent sages, the Yogis and the nudists, along with the Messengers of Death, shallpass away.
lines.transliteration: mun jogee digambraa jamai san  jaasee.

lines.english: Whatever is seen shall perish; all will dissolve and disappear.
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so vin sanaa sabh  binas binaasee.

lines.english: Only the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is permanent. His servantbecomes permanent as well. ||18|| slok fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1100-18) salok dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Shalok Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: thir paarbarahm parmaysaro sayvak thir hosee. ||18||

lines.english: Hundreds of times naked does not make the person naked; tens of thousands ofhungers do not make him hungry;
lines.transliteration: sai nangay nah nang bhukh ay lakh  na bh ukhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ  ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਿਲਆ  ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਕਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dukhay korh  na dukh  naanak piree pikh ando subh  disat. ||1|| millions of pains do not cause him pain. O Nanak, the Husband Lord blesses him with his Glance of Grace. ||1|| pMnw 1101 mÚ 5 ] (1101-1) mehlaa 5.

lines.english: Even if one were to enjoy all pleasures, and be master of the entire earth,
lines.transliteration: sukh samoohaa bh og bh oom sabaa-ee ko Dh anee.

lines.english: O Nanak, all of that is just a disease. Without the Naam, he is dead. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1101-2) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak habho rog mirt ak naam vihoon i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੂਿਮ ਸਬਾਈ  ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.english: Yearn for the One Lord, and make Him your friend.
lines.transliteration: hikas kooN too aahi pachh aanoo bh ee hik kar.

lines.english: O Nanak, He alone fulfills your hopes; you should feel embarrassed, visiting otherplaces. ||3|| pauVI ] (1101-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak aasrhee nibaahi maanukh  parthaa-ee lajeevd o. ||3||

lines.english: The One and only Lord is eternal, imperishable, inaccessible and incomprehensible.
lines.transliteration: nihchal ayk naaraa-ino har agam agaaDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਕਸ  ਕੂੰ ਤੂ ਆਿਹ  ਪਛਾਣੂ  ਭੀ ਿਹਕੁ ਕਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam is eternal and imperishable. Meditating in remembrance onHim, the Lord is attained.
lines.transliteration: nihchal naam niDhaan hai jis simrat  har laaDh aa.

lines.english: The Kirtan of His Praises is eternal and imperishable; the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: nihchal keertan gun  gobind  gurmukh  gaavaaDh aa.

lines.english: Truth, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal and imperishable.Day and night, worship the Lord in adoration.
lines.transliteration: sach Dharam t ap nihchalo d in rain araaDh aa.

lines.english: Compassion, righteousness, Dharma and intense meditation are eternal andimperishable; they alone obtain these, who have such pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa Dh aram t ap nihchalo jis karam likh aaDhaa.

lines.english: The inscription inscribed upon one's forehead is eternal and imperishable; it cannot beavoided by avoidance.
lines.transliteration: nihchal mastak laykh  likhi-aa so talai na talaaDh aa.

lines.english: The Congregation, the Company of the Holy, and the word of the humble, are eternaland imperishable. The Holy Guru is eternal and imperishable.
lines.transliteration: nihchal sangat saaDh  jan bachan nihchal gur saaDh aa.

lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny worship and adore the Lord, forever andever. ||19|| slok fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1101-7) salok dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Shalok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in sad aa sad aa aaraaDh aa. ||19||

lines.english: One who himself has drowned - how can he carry anyone else across?
lines.transliteration: jo dubando aap so t araa-ay kinH khay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਟਲੈ ਨ ਟਲਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who is imbued with the Love of the Husband Lord - O Nanak, he himself is saved, and he saves others as well. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1101-8) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taarayd arho bhee taar naanak pir si-o rat i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਬਚਨ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever someone speaks and hears the Name of my Beloved Lord,
lines.transliteration: jithai ko-ay kathann naa-o sunand o maa piree.

lines.english: Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mooN julaa-ooN tath naanak piree pasand o hari-o thee-os. ||2|| that is where I go, O Nanak, to see Him, and blossom forth in bliss. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1101-9) mehlaa 5.

lines.english: You are in love with your children and your wife; why do you keep calling them yourown?
lines.transliteration: mayree mayree ki-aa karahi putar kalt ar sanayh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਡੁਬੰਦੋ ਆਿਪ  ਸੋ ਤਰਾਏ  ਿਕਨ ਖੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the human body has nofoundation. ||3|| pauVI ] (1101-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihoonee-aa nimun ee-aad ee dayh. ||3||

lines.english: With my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; I touch myforehead to the Guru's feet.
lines.transliteration: nainee daykh -a-u gur d arsano gur charn ee mathaa.

lines.english: With my feet I walk on the Guru's Path; with my hands, I wave the fan over Him.
lines.transliteration: pairee maarag gur chaldaa pakh aa fayree hathaa.

lines.english: I meditate on Akaal Moorat, the undying form, within my heart; day and night, I meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: akaal moorat rid ai Dhi-aa-id aa din rain japanthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂੰ ਜੁਲਾਊਂ  ਤਿਥ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰੀ  ਪਸੰਦੋ  ਹਿਰਓ  ਥੀਓਿਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have renounced all possessiveness, and have placed my faith in the all-powerfulGuru.
lines.transliteration: mai chhadi-aa sagal apaa-in o bharvaasai gur samrathaa.

lines.english: The Guru has blessed me with the treasure of the Naam; I am rid of all sufferings.
lines.transliteration: gur bakhsi-aa naam niDh aan sabh o dukh lathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਸਨੇਹ  ॥
lines.english: Eat and enjoy the Naam, the Name of the indescribable Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: bhogahu bh unchahu bh aa-eeho palai naam agthaa.

lines.english: Confirm your faith in the Naam, charity and self-purification; chant the Guru's sermonforever.
lines.transliteration: naam daan isnaan d irh sadaa karahu gur kathaa.

lines.english: Blessed with intuitive poise, I have found God; I am rid of the fear of the Messengerof Death. ||20|| slok fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1101-14) salok dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Shalok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sahj bha-i-aa parabh  paa-i-aa jam kaa bh a-o lathaa. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਉ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੋ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਮਥਾ ॥
lines.english: I am centered and focused on my Beloved, but I am not satisfied, even by seeingHim.
lines.transliteration: lagrhee-aa piree-ann paykh andee-aa naa t ipee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਰੀ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਗੁਰ ਚਲਦਾ  ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਹਥਾ ॥
lines.english: The Lord and Master is within all; I do not see any other. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1101-15) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: habh majh aahoo so Dh anee bi-aa na dith o ko-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The sayings of the Saints are the paths of peace.
lines.transliteration: kathrhee-aa sant aah tay sukh aa-oo panDh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਛਿਡਆ ਸਗਲ  ਅਪਾਇਣੋ  ਭਰਵਾਸੈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they alone obtain them, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1101-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak laDh-rh ee-aa t innaah jinaa bh aag mathaaharh ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਬਖਿਸਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is totally permeating the mountains, oceans, deserts, lands, forests, orchards,caves,
lines.transliteration: doongar jalaa thalaa bhoom banaa fal kand raa.
paataalaa aakaas pooran habh  ghataa. the nether regions of the underworld, the Akaashic ethers of the skies, and all hearts.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਿਦੜੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.english: Nanak sees that they are all strung on the same thread. ||3|| pauVI ] (1101-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak paykh jee-o ikat  soot parot ee-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਲਥਾ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is my mother, the Dear Lord is my father; the Dear Lord cherishes and nurtures me.
lines.transliteration: har jee maataa har jee pit aa har jee-o part ipaalak.

lines.english: The Dear Lord takes care of me; I am the child of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jee mayree saar karay ham har kay baalak.

lines.english: Slowly and steadily, He feeds me; He never fails.
lines.transliteration: sehjay sahj khilaa-id aa nahee kard aa aalak.

lines.punjabi: ਹਭ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ  ਿਬਆ  ਨ ਿਡਠੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not remind me of my faults; He hugs me close in His embrace.
lines.transliteration: a-ugan ko na chit aardaa gal sayt ee laa-ik.

lines.english: Whatever I ask for, He give me; the Lord is my peace-giving father. pMnw 1102
lines.transliteration: muhi mangaaN so-ee dayvd aa har pit aa sukh -daa-ik.

lines.english: He has blessed me with the capital, the wealth of spiritual wisdom; He has made me worthy of this merchandise.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan raas naam Dhan sa-opi-on is sa-ud ay laa-ik.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਿਪਓਨੁ ਇਸੁ ਸਉਦੇ  ਲਾਇਕ  ॥
lines.english: He has made me a partner with the Guru; I have obtained all peace and comforts.
lines.transliteration: saajhee gur naal bahaali-aa sarab sukh  paa-ik.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਝੀ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਬਹਾਿਲਆ  ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਕ  ॥
lines.english: He is with me, and shall never separate from me; the Lord, my father, is potent to doeverything. ||21|| slok fKxy mÚ 5 ] (1102-2) salok dakh-n ay mehlaa 5. Shalok, Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mai naalahu kaday na vichh urhai har pit aa sabh naa galaa laa-ik. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਗਲਾ  ਲਾਇਕ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, break away from the false, and seek out the Saints, your true friends.
lines.transliteration: naanak kachrhi-aa si-o t orh dhoodh sajan  sant paki-aa.

lines.english: The false shall leave you, even while you are still alive; but the Saints shall not forsake you, even when you are dead. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1102-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: o-ay jeevanday vichhurh eh o-ay mu-i-aa na jaahee chh orh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਚਿੜਆ  ਿਸਉ ਤੋਿੜ ਢੂਿਢ  ਸਜਣ  ਸੰਤ ਪਿਕਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the lightning flashes, and thunder echoes in the dark black clouds.
lines.transliteration: naanak bijulee-aa chamkann ghurniH ghataa at  kaalee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ  ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਓਇ ਮੁਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਛੋਿੜ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The downpour from the clouds is heavy; O Nanak, the soul-brides are exalted andembellished with their Beloved. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1102-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: barsan maygh apaar naanak sangam piree suhand ee-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The ponds and the lands are overflowing with water, and the cold wind is blowing.
lines.transliteration: jal thal neer bharay seet al pavan  jhulaard ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਜੁਲੀਆ  ਚਮਕੰਿਨ  ਘੁਰਿਨ ਘਟਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਕਾਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Her bed is adorned with gold, diamonds and rubies;
lines.transliteration: sayjrhee-aa so-inn heeray laal jarh andee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਸਿਨ  ਮੇਘ ਅਪਾਰ  ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿਮ  ਿਪਰੀ  ਸੁਹੰਦੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: subhar kaparh  bhog naanak piree vihoon ee tatee-aa. ||3|| she is blessed with beautiful gowns and de licacies, O Nanak, but without her Beloved, she burns in agony. ||3|| pauVI ] (1102-6) pa-orhee.

lines.english: He does the dees which the Creator causes him to do.
lines.transliteration: kaaran kart ai jo kee-aa so-ee hai karn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਿਰ  ਭਰੇ ਸੀਤਲ  ਪਵਣ  ਝੁਲਾਰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: Even if you run in hundreds of directions, O mortal, you shall still receive what you arepre-destined to receive.
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o Dhaaveh paraan ee-aa paavahi Dh ur lahn aa.

lines.english: Without good karma, you shall obtain nothing, even if you wander across the wholeworld.
lines.transliteration: bin karmaa kichhoo na labh -ee jay fireh sabh  Dharnaa.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, you shall know the Fear of God, and other fears shall be takenaway.
lines.transliteration: gur mil bha-o govind  kaa bh ai dar d oor karn aa.

lines.english: Through the Fear of God, the attitude of detachment wells up, and one sets out insearch of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay bairaag oopjai har kh ojat firnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਕਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Searching and searching, intuitive wisdom wells up, and then, one is not born to dieagain.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat sahj upji-aa fir janam na marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧਾਵਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀਆ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਧੁਿਰ ਲਹਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Practicing meditation within my heart, I have found the Sanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: hi-aa-ay kamaa-ay Dhi-aa-i-aa paa-i-aa saaDh  sarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਜੇ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਸਭ ਧਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever the Lord places on the boat of Guru Nanak, is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||22|| slok mÚ 5 ] (1102-10) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Dakhanay Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bohith naanak day-o gur jis har charh aa-ay t is bha-ojal t arnaa. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਭਉ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਕਾ ਭੈ ਡਰੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: First, accept death, and give up any hope of life.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa maran kabool jeevan  kee chh ad aas.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਖੋਜਤ  ਿਫਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Become the dust of the feet of all, and then, you may come to me. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1102-11) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hohu sabhnaa kee rayn ukaa t a-o aa-o hamaarai paas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਉਪਿਜਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਮਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: See, that only one who has died, truly lives; one who is alive, consider him dead.
lines.transliteration: mu-aa jeevandaa paykh  jeevanday mar jaan.

lines.english: Those who are in love with the One Lord, are the supreme people. ||2|| mÚ 5 ] (1102-12) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinHaa muhabat ik si-o t ay maan as parDh aan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਚੜਾਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਰਣਾ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Pain does not even approach that person, within whose mind God abides.
lines.transliteration: jis man vasai paarbarahm nikat na aavai peer.

lines.english: Hunger and thirst do not affect him, and the Messenger of Death does not approachhim. ||3|| pauVI ] (1102-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bhukh  tikh tis na vi-aapa-ee jam nahee aavai neer. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਮਰਣੁ ਕਬੂਿਲ  ਜੀਵਣ  ਕੀ ਛਿਡ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Your worth cannot be estimated, O True, Unmoving Lord God.
lines.transliteration: keemat kahan  na jaa-ee-ai sach saah adolai.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ  ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ  ਤਉ ਆਉ  ਹਮਾਰੈ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Siddhas, seekers, spiritual teachers and meditators - who among them canmeasure You?
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik gi-aanee Dh i-aanee-aa ka-un  tuDhuno tolai.

lines.english: You are all-powerful, to form and break; You create and destroy all.
lines.transliteration: bhannan  gharhan samrath hai opat  sabh  parlai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਆ  ਜੀਵੰਦਾ ਪੇਖੁ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ  ਮਿਰ ਜਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: You are all-powerful to act, and inspire all to act; You speak through each and everyheart.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath hai gh at ghat sabh  bolai.

lines.english: You give sustanance to all; why should mankind waver?
lines.transliteration: rijak samaahay sabhsai ki-aa maan as dolai.

lines.english: You are deep, profound and unfathomable; Your virtuous spiritual wisdom is priceless.
lines.transliteration: gahir gabheer athaahu t oo gun  gi-aan amolai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.english: They do the deeds which they are pre-ordained to do.
lines.transliteration: so-ee kamm kamaavanaa kee-aa Dh ur ma-ulai.

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਖ ਿਤਖ ਿਤਸੁ ਨ ਿਵਆਪਈ  ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ  ਨੀਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without You, there is nothing at all; Nanak chants Your Glorious Praises. ||23||1||2|| rwgu mwrU bwxI kbIr jIau kI  (1102-18) raag maaroo banee kabeer jee-o kee Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1102-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: tuDhhu baahar kichh  nahee naanak gun  bolai. ||23||1||2||

lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, in what foul thoughts are you engaged?
lines.transliteration: padee-aa kavan kumat t um laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈਐ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਅਡੋਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: You shall be drowned, along with your family, if you do not meditate on the Lord, you unfortunate person. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bood-hugay parvaar sakal si-o raam na japahu abhaagay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: What is the use of reading the Vedas and the Puraanas? It is like loading a donkey with sandalwood. pMnw 1103
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan parh ay kaa ki-aa gun kh ar chand an jas bh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਪੜੇ ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਗੁਨੁ ਖਰ ਚੰਦਨ  ਜਸ ਭਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: You do not know the exalted state of the Lord's Name; how will you ever cross over? ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee kaisay ut ras paaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ  ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਿਸ  ਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You kill living beings, and call it a righteous action. Tell me, brother, what would you call an unrighteous action?
lines.transliteration: jee-a baDhahu so Dh aram kar thaapahu aDh ram kahhu kat  bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਬਧਹੁ ਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ  ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You call yourself the most excellent sage; then who would you call a butcher? ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o munivar kar thaapahu kaa ka-o kahhu kasaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਸ  ਕਉ ਮੁਿਨਵਰ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਸਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are blind in your mind, and do not understand your own self; how can you makeothers understand, O brother?
lines.transliteration: man kay anDhay aap na boojh hu kaahi bujh aavahu bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਅੰਧੇ ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਾਿਹ  ਬੁਝਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: For the sake of Maya and money, you sell knowledge; your life is totally worthless.||3||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran bidi-aa baychahu janam abirathaa jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਨ  ਿਬਿਦਆ ਬੇਚਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Naarad and Vyaasa say these things; go and ask Suk Dayv as well.
lines.transliteration: naarad bachan bi-aas kahat  hai suk ka-o poochh ahu jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਰਦ  ਬਚਨ  ਿਬਆਸੁ  ਕਹਤ  ਹੈ ਸੁਕ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, you shall be saved; otherwise, you shalldrown, brother. ||4||1||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raamai ram chhootahu naahi t a booday bh aa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਰਿਮ ਛੂਟਹੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ਤ ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Living in the forest, how will you find Him? Not until you remove corruption from yourmind.
lines.transliteration: baneh basay ki-o paa-ee-ai ja-o la-o manhu na tajeh bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਨਿਹ  ਬਸੇ ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਤਜਿਹ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who look alike upon home and forest, are the most perfect people in the world.||1||
lines.transliteration: jih ghar ban samsar kee-aa t ay pooray sansaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਘਰੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਕੀਆ  ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You shall find real peace in the Lord,
lines.transliteration: saar sukh paa-ee-ai raamaa.
rang ravhu aatmai raam. ||1|| rahaa-o. if you lovingly dwell on the Lord within your being. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: What is the use of wearing matted hair, smearing the body with ashes, and living in a cave?
lines.transliteration: jataa bhasam laypan kee-aa kahaa gufaa meh baas.

lines.english: Conquering the mind, one conquers the world, and then remains detached fromcorruption. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man jeetay jag jeet i-aa jaaN tay bikh i-aa tay ho-ay ud aas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਟਾ ਭਸਮ  ਲੇਪਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਹਾ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਿਹ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: They all apply make-up to their eyes; there is little difference between theirobjectives.
lines.transliteration: anjan day-ay sabh ai ko-ee tuk chaahan maahi bidaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੇ  ਜਗੁ ਜੀਿਤਆ  ਜ ਤੇ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: But those eyes, to which the ointment of spiritual wisdom is applied, are approved andsupreme. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan jih paa-i-aa tay lo-in parvaan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਭੈ ਕੋਈ ਟੁਕੁ ਚਾਹਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਬਡਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, now I know my Lord; the Guru has blessed me with spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ab jaani-aa gur gi-aan dee-aa samjh aa-ay.

lines.english: I have met the Lord, and I am emancipated within; now, my mind does not wander atall. ||4||2||
lines.transliteration: antargat  har bh ayti-aa ab mayraa man kat hoo na jaa-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਅਬ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਸਮਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You have riches and miraculous spiritual powers; so what business do you have with anyone else?
lines.transliteration: riDh siDh  jaa ka-o furee t ab kaahoo si-o ki-aa kaaj.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਭੇਿਟਆ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: What should I say about the reality of your talk? I am embarrassed even to speak toyou. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayray kahnay kee gat  ki-aa kaha-o mai bolat  hee bad laaj. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰੀ ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਿਸਉ ਿਕਆ  ਕਾਜ  ॥
lines.english: One who has found the Lord,
lines.transliteration: raam jih paa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਉ  ਮੈ ਬੋਲਤ  ਹੀ ਬਡ ਲਾਜ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tay bh aveh na baarai baar. ||1|| rahaa-o. does not wander from door to door. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: The false world wanders all around, in hopes of finding wealth to use for a few days.
lines.transliteration: jhooth aa jag dahkai gh anaa d in du-ay bart an kee aas.

lines.english: That humble being, who drinks in the Lord's water, never becomes thirsty again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam udak jih jan pee-aa t ihi bahur na bh a-ee pi-aas. ||2||

lines.english: Whoever understands, by Guru's Grace, becomes free of hope in the midst of hope.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jih boojh i-aa aasaa t ay bh a-i-aa niraas.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠਾ ਜਗੁ ਡਹਕੈ  ਘਨਾ  ਿਦਨ ਦੁਇ ਬਰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: One comes to see the Lord everywhere, when the soul becomes detached. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh sach nad ree aa-i-aa ja-o aat am bh a-i-aa ud aas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ  ਿਜਹ ਜਨ ਪੀਆ  ਿਤਿਹ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਭਈ ਿਪਆਸ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name carrieseveryone across.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ras chaakhi-aa har naamaa har t aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਿਜਹ ਬੂਿਝਆ  ਆਸਾ  ਤੇ ਭਇਆ  ਿਨਰਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have become like gold; doubt is dispelled, and I have crossed over the world-ocean. ||4||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer kanchan bha-i-aa bh aram ga-i-aa samud rai paar. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਇਆ  ਜਉ ਆਤਮ  ਭਇਆ  ਉਦਾਸੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Like drops of water in the water of the ocean, and like waves in the stream, I mergein the Lord.
lines.transliteration: udak samund  salal kee saakh i-aa nad ee tarang samaavhigay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਹਰ ਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Merging my being into the Absolute Being of God, I have become impartial andtransparent, like the air. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sunneh sunn mili-aa samadrasee pavan roop ho-ay jaavhigay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਗਇਆ  ਸਮੁਦਰ੍ੈ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Why should I come into the world again?
lines.transliteration: bahur ham kaahay aavhigay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਕ  ਸਮੁੰਦ  ਸਲਲ  ਕੀ ਸਾਿਖਆ  ਨਦੀ  ਤਰੰਗ  ਸਮਾਵਿਹਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going is by the Hukam of His Command; realizing His Hukam, I shallmerge in Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa hukam tisai kaa hukmai bujh  samaavhigay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਨਿਹ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਮਦਰਸੀ  ਪਵਨ  ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਿਹਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the body, formed of the five elements, perishes, then any such doubts shallend.
lines.transliteration: jab chookai panch Dhaat  kee rachnaa aisay bh aram chukaavhigay.

lines.english: Giving up the different schools of philosophy, I look upon all equally; I meditate onlyon the One Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: darsan chh od bh a-ay samad rasee ayko naam Dh i-aavhigay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਨ  ਜਾਨਾ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਿਤਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਿਝ ਸਮਾਵਿਹਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever I am attached to, to that I am attached; such are the deeds I do.
lines.transliteration: jit ham laa-ay t it hee laagay t aisay karam kamaavhigay.

lines.english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then I am merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har jee kirpaa karay ja-o apnee tou gur kay sabad  samaavhigay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ  ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਵਿਹਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Die while yet alive, and by so dying, be alive; thus you shall not be reborn again. pMnw 1104
lines.transliteration: jeevat marahu marahu fun jeevhu punrap janam na ho-ee.
