lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, whoever is absorbed in the Naam remains lovingly absorbed in thePrimal, Absolute Lord. ||4||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jo naam samaanay sunn rahi-aa liv so-ee. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੋ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਨੇ  ਸੁੰਨ ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਲਵ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: If You keep me far away from You, then tell me, what is liberation?
lines.transliteration: ja-o tumH mo ka-o d oor karat  ha-o t a-o tum mukat  bataavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਤ  ਹਉ ਤਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: The One has many forms, and is contained within all; how can I be fooled now? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk anayk ho-ay rahi-o sagal meh ab kaisay bharmaavahu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ  ਹੋਇ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਗਲ  ਮਿਹ ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਭਰਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, where will You take me, to save me?
lines.transliteration: raam mo ka-o taar kahaaN lai ja-ee hai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਿਰ  ਕਹ ਲੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Tell me where, and what sort of liberation shall You give me? By Your Grace, I havealready obtained it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: soDha-o mukat  kahaa d ay-o kaisee kar parsaad  mohi paa-ee hai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਧਉ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਹਾ ਦੇਉ ਕੈਸੀ ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਪਾਈ  ਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: People talk of salvation and being saved, as long as they do not understand theessence of reality.
lines.transliteration: taaran t aran t abai lag kahee-ai jab lag t at na jaani-aa.

lines.english: I have now become pure within my heart, says Kabeer, and my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||5||
lines.transliteration: ab ta-o bimal bh a-ay gh at hee meh kahi kabeer man maani-aa. ||2||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਰਨ  ਤਰਨੁ ਤਬੈ ਲਗੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Raawan made castles and fortresses of gold, but he had to abandon them when heleft. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin garh kot kee-ay kanchan kay chh od ga-i-aa so raavan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਿਬਮਲ  ਭਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Why do you act only to please your mind?
lines.transliteration: kaahay keejat hai man bh aavan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਕੀਏ ਕੰਚਨ  ਕੇ ਛੋਿਡ ਗਇਆ  ਸੋ ਰਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When Death comes and grabs you by the hair, then only the Name of the Lord willsave you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab jam aa-ay kays tay pakrai t ah har ko naam chh adaavan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Death, and deathlessness are the creations of our Lord and Master; this show, thisexpanse, is only an entanglement.
lines.transliteration: kaal akaal khasam kaa keenHaa ih parpanch baDh aavan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ  ਕੇਸ ਤੇ ਪਕਰੈ  ਤਹ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, those who have the sublime essence of the Lord in their hearts - in theend, they are liberated. ||2||6||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer tay ant ay mukt ay jinH hirdai raam rasaa-in. ||2||6||

lines.english: The body is a village, and the soul is the owner and farmer; the five farm-hands livethere.
lines.transliteration: dayhee gaavaa jee-o Dh ar maht a-o baseh panch kirsaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਅਕਾਲੁ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਕੀਨਾ  ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਬਧਾਵਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The eyes, nose, ears, tongue and sensory organs of touch do not obey any order.||1||
lines.transliteration: nainoo naktoo sarvanoo raspat ind ree kahi-aa na maanaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਤੇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਿਜਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: O father, now I shall not live in this village.
lines.transliteration: baabaa ab na basa-o ih gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ  ਜੀਉ  ਧਰ ਮਹਤਉ  ਬਸਿਹ  ਪੰਚ ਿਕਰਸਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The accountants summoned Chitar and Gupat, the recording scribes of the consciousand the unconscious, to ask for an account of each and every moment. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gharee gh aree kaa laykh aa maagai kaa-ith chayt oo naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨੂ ਨਕਟੂ  ਸਰ੍ਵਨੂ ਰਸਪਿਤ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਨ ਮਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay jab laykh aa maagai baakee niksee bh aaree. When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for my account, there shall be a veryheavy balance against me.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਅਬ ਨ ਬਸਉ  ਇਹ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The five farm-hands shall then run away, and the bailiff shall arrest the soul. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch kirsaanvaa bhaag ga-ay lai baaDh i-o jee-o d arbaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੀ  ਘਰੀ  ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮਾਗੈ  ਕਾਇਥੁ  ਚੇਤੂ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: settle your accounts in this farm.
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer sunhu ray santahu kh ayt hee karahu nibayraa.

lines.english: O Lord, please forgive Your slave now, in this life, so that he may not have to returnagain to this terrifying world-ocean. ||3||7|| rwgu mwrU bwxI kbIr jIau kI  (1104-13) raag maaroo banee kabeer jee-o kee Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1104-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ab kee baar bakhas band ay ka-o bahur na bh a-ojal fayraa. ||3||7||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮਾਗੈ  ਬਾਕੀ  ਿਨਕਸੀ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: No one has seen the Fearless Lord, O renunciate.
lines.transliteration: anbha-o kinai na d aykhi-aa bairaagee-arh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਿਕਰ੍ਸਾਨਵਾ  ਭਾਿਗ  ਗਏ ਲੈ ਬਾਿਧਓ  ਜੀਉ  ਦਰਬਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Fear of God, how can the Fearless Lord be obtained? ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin bhai anbh a-o ho-ay van aahambai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਖੇਤ ਹੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਨਬੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: If one sees the Presence of his Husband Lord near at hand, then he feels the Fear of God, O renunciate.
lines.transliteration: saho hadoor d aykhai taaN bha-o pavai bairaagee-arh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਬਖਿਸ ਬੰਦੇ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਭਉਜਿਲ  ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.english: If he realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he becomes fearless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhai t a nirbh a-o ho-ay van aahambai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Don't practice hypocrisy with the Lord, O renunciate!
lines.transliteration: har pakhand na keej-ee bairaagee-arh ay.

lines.english: The whole world is filled with hypocrisy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pakhand rat aa sabh  lok van aahambai. ||3||

lines.english: Thirst and desire do not just go away, O renunciate.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa paas na chh od-ee bairaagee-arh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹੁ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਦੇਖੈ ਤ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਅੜੇ  ॥
lines.english: The body is burning in the fire of worldly love and attachment. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mamtaa jaali-aa pind van aahambai. ||4||

lines.english: Anxiety is burned, and the body is burned, O renunciate,
lines.transliteration: chintaa jaal t an jaali-aa bairaagee-arh ay.
jay man mirtak ho-ay van aahambai. ||5|| only if one lets his mind become dead. ||5||

lines.english: Without the True Guru, there can be no renunciation,
lines.transliteration: satgur bin bairaag na hova-ee bairaagee-arh ay.
jay lochai sabh ko-ay van aahambai. ||6|| even though all the people may wish for it. ||6||

lines.english: When God grants His Grace, one meets the True Guru, O renunciate,
lines.transliteration: karam hovai satgur milai bairaagee-arh ay.
sehjay paavai so-ay vanaahambai. ||7|| and automatically, intuitively finds that Lord. ||7||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I offer this one prayer, O renunciate.
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ik bayntee bairaagee-arh ay.

lines.english: Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||1||8|| pMnw 1105
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o bha-ojal paar ut aar van aahambai. ||8||1||8||

lines.english: O king, who will come to you?
lines.transliteration: raajan ka-un tumaarai aavai.

lines.english: I have seen such love from Bidur, that the poor man is pleasing to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aiso bhaa-o bid ar ko d aykhi-o oh gareeb mohi bh aavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਿਬਦਰ  ਕੋ ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਓਹੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon your elephants, you have gone astray in doubt; you do not know the Great Lord God.
lines.transliteration: hastee d aykh bharam t ay bh oolaa saree bh agvaan na jaani-aa.

lines.english: I judge Bidur's water to be like ambrosial ne ctar, in comparison with your milk. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumro d ooDh bidar ko paanHo amrit  kar mai maani-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਸਤੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਭਰਮ  ਤੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: I find his rough vegetables to be like rice pudding; the night of my life passes singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kheer samaan saag mai paa-i-aa gun gaavat  rain bihaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੋ  ਦੂਧੁ ਿਬਦਰ  ਕੋ ਪਾਨੋ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਕਿਰ ਮੈ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer's Lord and Master is joyous and blissful; He does not care about anyone'ssocial class. ||2||9|| slok kbIr ] (1105-4) salok kabeer. Shalok, Kabeer:
lines.transliteration: kabeer ko thaakur anad  binod ee jaat  na kaahoo kee maanee. ||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਖੀਰ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਸਾਗੁ  ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ਰੈਿਨ ਿਬਹਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The battle-drum beats in the sky of the mind; aim is taken, and the wound is inflicted.
lines.transliteration: gagan damaamaa baaji-o pari-o neesaanai gh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦੀ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥੯॥
lines.english: The spiritual warriors enter the field of battle; now is the time to fight! ||1||
lines.transliteration: khayt  jo maaNdi-o soormaa ab joojh an ko d aa-o. ||1||

lines.english: He alone is known as a spiritual hero, who fights in defense of religion.
lines.transliteration: sooraa so pahichaanee-ai jo larai deen kay hayt .

lines.punjabi: ਗਗਨ  ਦਮਾਮਾ  ਬਾਿਜਓ  ਪਿਰਓ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ  ਘਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He may be cut apart, piece by piece, but he never leaves the field of battle. ||2||2|| kbIr kw sbdu rwgu mwrU bwxI nwmdyau jI kI  (1105-7) kabeer kaa sabad raag maaroo ban ee naamd ay-o jee kee Shabad Of Kabeer, Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1105-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: purjaa purjaa kat marai kabhoo na chhaadai kh ayt. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਿਡਓ  ਸੂਰਮਾ  ਅਬ ਜੂਝਨ  ਕੋ ਦਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have obtained the four kinds of liberation, and the four miraculous spiritual powers, in the Sanctuary of God, my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: chaar mukat chaarai siDh  mil kai d oolah parabh  kee saran pari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਿਹਚਾਨੀਐ  ਜੁ ਲਰੈ ਦੀਨ  ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.english: I am liberated, and famous throughout the four ages; the canopy of praise and famewaves over my head. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-i-o cha-uhoo-aN jug jaani-o jas keerat  maathai chh atar Dh ari-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਰਜਾ  ਪੁਰਜਾ  ਕਿਟ ਮਰੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਛਾਡੈ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Sovereign Lord God, who has not been saved?
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam japat ko ko na t ari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ  ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever follows the Guru's Teachings and joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy, is called the most devoted of the devotees. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur updays saaDh  kee sangat  bhagat bhagat taa ko naam pari-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਚਾਰੈ ਿਸਿਧ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਕੈ ਦੂਲਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: He is adorned with the conch, the chakra, the mala and the ceremonial tilak mark onhis forehead; gazing upon his radiant glory, the Messenger of Death is scared away.
lines.transliteration: sankh chakar maalaa t ilak biraajit  daykh partaap jam dari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਇਓ  ਚਉਹੂੰ ਜੁਗ ਜਾਿਨਓ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤਰ੍ੁ ਧਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He becomes fearless, and the power of the Lord thunders through him; the pains ofbirth and death are taken away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay raam bal garjit  janam maran sant aap hiri-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ  ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਤਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord blessed Ambreek with fearless dignity, and elevated Bhabhikhan to becomeking.
lines.transliteration: ambreek ka-o dee-o abh ai pad  raaj bh abheekhan aDh ik kari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sudama's Lord and Master blessed him with the nine treasures; he made Dhroo permanent and unmoving; as the north star, he still hasn't moved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: na-o niDh th aakur d a-ee sud aamai Dh aroo-a atal ajhoo na tari-o. ||3||

lines.english: For the sake of His devotee Prahlaad, God assumed the form of the man-lion, andkilled Harnaakhash.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  hayt maari-o harnaakh as narsingh  roop ho-ay d ayh Dh ari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕਰ੍ ਮਾਲਾ  ਿਤਲਕੁ  ਿਬਰਾਿਜਤ  ਦੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪੁ  ਜਮੁ ਡਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, the beautiful-haired Lord is in the power of His devotees; He isstanding at Balraja's door, even now! ||4||1|| mwrU kbIr jIau ] (1105-14) maaroo kabeer jee-o. Maaroo, Kabeer Jee:
lines.transliteration: naamaa kahai bhagat  bas kaysav ajahooN bal kay d u-aar kh aro. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਬਲ ਗਰਿਜਤ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਸੰਤਾਪ  ਿਹਿਰਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You have forgotten your religion, O madman; you have forgotten your religion.
lines.transliteration: deen bisaari-o ray d ivaanay d een bisaari-o ray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ  ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਭਭੀਖਨ  ਅਿਧਕ  ਕਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: You fill your belly, and sleep like an animal; you have wasted and lost this human life.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: payt bhari-o pasoo-aa ji-o so-i-o manukh  janam hai haari-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਦਈ ਸੁਦਾਮੈ  ਧਰ੍ੂਅ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਜਹ ੂ ਨ ਟਿਰਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. You are engrossed infalse pursuits.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kabhoo nahee keenee rachi-o Dh anDhai jhooth.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਹੇਿਤ ਮਾਿਰਓ  ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ  ਨਰਿਸੰਘ  ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹ ਧਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: You wander like a dog, a pig, a crow; soon, you shall have to get up and leave. ||1||
lines.transliteration: su-aan sookar baa-is jivai bhatkat  chaali-o ooth . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਾ  ਕਹੈ ਭਗਿਤ ਬਿਸ ਕੇਸਵ  ਅਜਹੂੰ ਬਿਲ  ਕੇ ਦੁਆਰ  ਖਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: You believe that you yourself are great, and that others are small.
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o deeragh  kar jaanai a-uran ka-o lag maat .

lines.english: Those who are false in thought, word and deed, I have seen them going to hell. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mansaa baachaa karmanaa mai daykh ay dojak jaat . ||2||

lines.english: The lustful, the angry, the clever, the deceitful and the lazy
lines.transliteration: kaamee kroDhee chaat uree baajeegar baykaam.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਟੁ ਭਿਰਓ  ਪਸੂਆ  ਿਜਉ ਸੋਇਓ  ਮਨੁਖੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਹੈ ਹਾਿਰਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nindaa kart ay janam siraano kabhoo na simri-o raam. ||3|| waste their lives in slander, and never remember their Lord in meditation. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, the fools, the idiots and the brutes do not remember the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer chaytai nahee moorakh  mugaDh  gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ  ਰਿਚਓ  ਧੰਧੈ ਝੂਠ ॥
lines.english: They do not know the Lord's Name; how can they be carried across? ||4||1|| pMnw 1106 rwgu mwrU bwxI jYdyau jIau kI (1106-1) raag maaroo banee jaid ay-o jee-o kee Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Jai Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1106-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: raam naam jaani-o nahee kaisay utras paar. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ  ਜੈਦੇਉ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The breath is drawn in through the left nostril; it is held in the central channel of the Sushmanaa, and exhaled through the right nostril, repeating the Lord's Name sixteentimes.
lines.transliteration: chand sat  bhaydi-aa naad  sat poori-aa soor sat  khorhsaa d at kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦ ਸਤ ਭੇਿਦਆ  ਨਾਦ  ਸਤ ਪੂਿਰਆ  ਸੂਰ ਸਤ ਖੋੜਸਾ  ਦਤੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am powerless; my power has been broken. My unstable mind has been stabliized, and my unadorned soul has been adorned. I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jI) abal bal torh i-aa achal chal thapi-aa agh arh gharhi-aa tahaa api-o pee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬਲ  ਬਲੁ ਤੋਿੜਆ  ਅਚਲ  ਚਲੁ ਥਿਪਆ  ਅਘੜੁ  ਘਿੜਆ  ਤਹਾ ਅਿਪਉ  ਪੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within my mind, I chant the Name of the Primal Lord God, the Source of virtue.
lines.transliteration: man aad gun  aad vakh aani-aa.

lines.english: My vision, that You are I are separate, has melted away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree d ubiDh aa darisat sammaani-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I worship the One who is worthy of being worshipped. I trust the One who is worthy of being trusted. Like water merging in water, I merge in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jI) araDh ka-o arDh i-aa saraDh  ka-o sarDh i-aa salal ka-o salal sammaan aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Jai Dayv, I meditate and contemplate the Luminous, Triumphant Lord. I amlovingly absorbed in the Nirvaanaa of God. ||2||1|| kbIru ] mwrU ] (1106-6) kabeer. maaroo. Kabeer, Maaroo:
lines.transliteration: badat  jaiday-o jaid ayv ka-o rammi-aa barahm nirbaan  liv leen  paa-i-aa. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਿਧ  ਕਉ ਅਰਿਧਆ  ਸਰਿਧ  ਕਉ ਸਰਿਧਆ  ਸਲਲ  ਕਉ ਸਲਿਲ  ਸੰਮਾਿਨ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, or else you will regret it in the end, O mind.
lines.transliteration: raam simar pachhut aahigaa man.

lines.punjabi: ਬਦਿਤ  ਜੈਦੇਉ  ਜੈਦੇਵ  ਕਉ ਰੰਿਮਆ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਨਰਬਾਣੁ  ਿਲਵ ਲੀਣੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: O sinful soul, you act in greed, but today or tomorrow, you will have to get up andleave. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paapee jee-araa lobh karat  hai aaj kaal uth  jaahigaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Clinging to greed, you have wasted your life, deluded in the doubt of Maya.
lines.transliteration: laalach laagay janam gavaa-i-aa maa-i-aa bharam bh ulaahigaa.

lines.english: Dhan joban kaa garab na keejai kaagad  ji-o gal jaahigaa. ||1|| Do not take pride in your wealth and youth; you shall crumble apart like dry paper. ||1||
When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by the hair, and knocks youdown, on that day, you shall be powerless.
lines.transliteration: ja-o jam aa-ay kays geh patkai taa d in kichh  na basaahigaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੀ  ਜੀਅਰਾ  ਲੋਭੁ ਕਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਉਿਠ ਜਾਿਹਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You do not remember the Lord, or vibrate upon Him in meditation, and you do notpractice compassion; you shall be beaten on your face. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simran bhajan d a-i-aa nahee keenee t a-o mukh  chotaa kh aahigaa. ||2||

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay jab laykh aa maagai ki-aa mukh  lai kai jaahigaa. When the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls for your account, what face will you showHim then?

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਭਰਮ  ਭੁਲਾਿਹਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, youshall be saved. ||3||1|| rwgu mwrU bwxI rivdws jIau kI  (1106-11) raag maaroo banee ravid aas jee-o kee Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1106-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu saaDh sangat  tar jaaNhigaa. ||3||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ  ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਗਦ  ਿਜਉ  ਗਿਲ  ਜਾਿਹਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Love, who else but You could do such a thing?
lines.transliteration: aisee laal tujh  bin ka-un karai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ  ਕੇਸ ਗਿਹ ਪਟਕੈ  ਤਾ ਿਦਨ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨ ਬਸਾਿਹਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Patron of the poor, Lord of the World, You have put the canopy of Your Grace over my head. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gareeb nivaaj gus-ee-aa mayraa maathai chhat ar Dh arai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਦਇਆ  ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ  ਤਉ ਮੁਿਖ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਿਹਗਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Only You can grant Mercy to that person whose touch pollutes the world.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee chhot  jagat  ka-o laagai t aa par t uheeN dharai.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮਾਗੈ  ਿਕਆ  ਮੁਖੁ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਿਹਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: You exalt and elevate the lowly, O my Lord of the Universe; You are not afraid ofanyone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: neechah ooch karai mayraa gobind kaahoo t ay na darai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਤਿਰ ਜਿਹਗਾ  ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan, Sadhana and Sain crossed over.
lines.transliteration: naamdayv kabeer t ilochan saDh naa sain t arai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, listen, O Saints, through the Dear Lord, all is accomplished. ||2||1|| mwrU ] (1106-15) maaroo. Maaroo:
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas sunhu ray sant ahu har jee-o t ay sabh ai sarai. ||2||1||

lines.english: The Lord is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the jewel of miracles andthe wish-fulfilling cow are all under His power.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar surit ar chint aaman kaamDh ayn bas jaa kay ray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰੀਬ  ਿਨਵਾਜੁ  ਗੁਸਈਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤਰ੍ੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The four great blessings, the eight great miraculous spiritual powers and the ninetreasures are in the palm of His hand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat mahaa siDh  nav niDh  kar tal taa kai. ||1||

lines.english: Why don't you chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har?
lines.transliteration: har har har na japas rasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਛੋਿਤ  ਜਗਤ  ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ  ਤਾ ਪਰ ਤੁਹੀ ਢਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Abandon all other devices of words. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar sabh chh aad bachan rachnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚਹ  ਊਚ ਕਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਕਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਨ ਡਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The many epics, the Puraanas and the Vedas are all composed out of the letters of the alphabet.
lines.transliteration: naanaa khi-aan puraan bayd  biDh cha-ut ees achh ar maahee.

lines.english: After careful thought, Vyaasa spoke the supreme truth, that there is nothing equal tothe Lord's Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bi-aas beechaar kahi-o parmaarath raam naam sar naahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਰਿਵਦਾਸੁ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਸਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: In intuitive Samaadhi, their troubles are eliminated; the very fortunate ones lovinglyfocus on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sahj samaaDh upaaDh  rahat  ho-ay baday bh aag liv laagee.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord's slave remains detached from the world; the fear of birthand death runs away from his mind. ||3||2||15|| pMnw 1107 quKwrI CMq mhlw 1 bwrh mwhw (1107-1) tukhaaree chh ant mehlaa 1 baarah maahaa Tukhaari Chhant, First Mehl, Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1107-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas ud aas d aas mat  janam maran bh ai bhaagee. ||3||2||15||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ  ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਬਾਰਹ  ਮਾਹਾ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Listen: according to the karma of their past actions, each and every person experiences happiness or sorrow; whatever You give, Lord, is good.
lines.transliteration: too sun  kirat karammaa purab kamaa-i-aa. sir sir sukh  sahammaa d eh so t oo bh alaa.

lines.english: O Lord, the Created Universe is Yours; what is my condition? Without the Lord, I cannot survive, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: har rachnaa tayree ki-aa gat  mayree har bin gh arhee na jeevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਰ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ  ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.english: Without my Beloved, I am miserable; I have no friend at all. As Gurmukh, I drink inthe Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: pari-a baajh d uhaylee ko-ay na baylee gurmukh  amrit  peevaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਚਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਕਆ  ਗਿਤ  ਮੇਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Formless Lord is contained in His Creation. To obey God is the best course ofaction.
lines.transliteration: rachnaa raach rahay nirankaaree parabh man karam sukarmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਬਾਝੁ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਪੀਵ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the soul-bride is gazing upon Your Path; please listen, O Supreme Soul.||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak panth nihaalay saa Dhan t oo sun  aatam raamaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਚਨਾ  ਰਾਿਚ  ਰਹੇ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਿਨ ਕਰਮ  ਸੁਕਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: The rainbird cries out, "Pri-o! Beloved!", and the song-bird sings the Lord's Bani.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa pari-o bolay kokil baanee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੰਥੁ ਿਨਹਾਲੇ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤੂ ਸੁਿਣ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The soul-bride enjoys all the pleasures, and merges in the Being of her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: saa Dhan sabh  ras cholai ank samaan ee-aa.

lines.english: She merges into the Being of her Beloved, when she becomes pleasing to God; she isthe happy, blessed soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: har ank samaanee jaa parabh  bhaanee saa sohagan  naaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਿਭ ਰਸ ਚੋਲੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਣੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Establishing the nine houses, and the Royal Mansion of the Tenth Gate above them,the Lord dwells in that home deep within the self.
lines.transliteration: nav ghar thaap mahal gh ar oocha-o nij gh ar vaas muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣੀ  ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: All are Yours, You are my Beloved; night and day, I celebrate Your Love.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree t oo mayraa pareet am nis baasur rang raavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਘਰ ਥਾਿਪ  ਮਹਲ  ਘਰੁ ਊਚਉ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the rainbird cries out, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" The song-bird is embellished with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak pari-o pari-o chavai babeehaa kokil sabad suhaavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਿਨਿਸ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Please listen, O my Beloved Lord - I am drenched with Your Love.
lines.transliteration: too sun  har ras bh innay pareet am aapn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਚਵੈ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਕੋਿਕਲ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind and body are absorbed in dwelling on You; I cannot forget You, even for aninstant.
lines.transliteration: man tan ravat  ravannay gh arhee na beesrai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸੁਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਿਭੰਨੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਆਪਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: How could I forget You, even for an instant? I am a sacrifice to You; singing YourGlorious Praises, I live.
lines.transliteration: ki-o gharh ee bisaaree ha-o balihaaree ha-o jeevaa gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਰਵਤ  ਰਵੰਨੇ  ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: No one is mine; unto whom do I belong? Without the Lord, I cannot survive.
lines.transliteration: naa ko-ee mayraa ha-o kis kayraa har bin rahan na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਘੜੀ  ਿਬਸਾਰੀ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have grasped the Support of the Lord's Feet; dwelling there, my body has becomeimmaculate.
lines.transliteration: ot gahee har charan nivaasay bh a-ay pavit ar sareeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਿਕਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I have obtained profound insight, and found peace; my mind is comfortedby the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak darisat d eeragh  sukh  paavai gur sabd ee man Dh eeraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਿਨਵਾਸੇ  ਭਏ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਸਰੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down on us! Its drops are so delightful!
lines.transliteration: barsai amrit Dh aar boond  suhaavan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਦੀਰਘ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, the Best Friend, with intuitive ease, the mortal falls in love with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saajan milay sahj subhaa-ay har si-o pareet  banee.

lines.english: The Lord comes into the temple of the body, when it pleases God's Will; the soul-briderises up, and sings His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: har mandar aavai jaa parabh  bhaavai Dh an oobh ee gun  saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every home, the Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; so why has He forgotten me?
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar kant  ravai sohagan  ha-o ki-o kant  visaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਧਨ ਊਭੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The sky is overcast with heavy, low-hanging clouds; the rain is delightful, and myBeloved's Love is pleasing to my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: unav ghan chh aa-ay baras subh aa-ay man t an paraym sukh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ ਘਿਰ  ਕੰਤੁ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਹਉ ਿਕਉ  ਕੰਿਤ  ਿਵਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar of Gurbani rains down; the Lord, in His Grace, hascome into the home of my heart. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak varsai amrit ban ee kar kirpaa gh ar aavai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਉਨਿਵ  ਘਨ ਛਾਏ ਬਰਸੁ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: In the month of Chayt, the lovely spring has come, and the bumble bees hum with joy. pMnw 1108
lines.transliteration: chayt basant  bhalaa bh avar suhaavrh ay.

lines.english: The forest is blossoming in front of my door; if only my Beloved would return to my home!
lines.transliteration: ban foolay manjh baar mai pir gh ar baahurh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਨ ਫੂਲੇ ਮੰਝ ਬਾਿਰ  ਮੈ ਿਪਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਬਾਹੁੜੈ ॥
lines.english: If her Husband Lord does not return home, how can the soul-bride find peace? Her body is wasting away with the sorrow of separation.
lines.transliteration: pir ghar nahee aavai Dh an ki-o sukh  paavai bireh biroDh  tan chh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ  ਧਨ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਬਰਿਹ ਿਬਰੋਧ  ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The beautiful song-bird sings, perched on the mango tree; but how can I endure thepain in the depths of my being?
lines.transliteration: kokil amb suhaavee bolai ki-o dukh  ank saheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਕਲ  ਅੰਿਬ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਬੋਲੈ ਿਕਉ  ਦੁਖੁ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਹੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The bumble bee is buzzing around the flowering branches; but how can I survive? Iam dying, O my mother!
lines.transliteration: bhavar bh avant aa foolee daalee ki-o jeevaa mar maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਰੁ ਭਵੰਤਾ  ਫੂਲੀ ਡਾਲੀ  ਿਕਉ ਜੀਵਾ  ਮਰੁ ਮਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in Chayt, peace is easily obtained, if the soul-bride obtains the Lord as herHusband, within the home of her own heart. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak chayt sahj sukh  paavai jay har var gh ar Dh an paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Baisakhi is so pleasant; the branches blossom with new leaves.
lines.transliteration: vaisaakh bh alaa saakh aa vays karay.

lines.english: Dhan d aykhai har d u-aar aavhu d a-i-aa karay. The soul-bride yearns to see the Lord at her door. Come, O Lord, and take pity on me!

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Please come home, O my Beloved; carry me across the treacherous world-ocean.Without You, I am not worth even a shell.
lines.transliteration: ghar aa-o pi-aaray d utar taaray t uDh bin adh  na molo.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਆਉ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਦੁਤਰ  ਤਾਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਮੋਲੋ ॥
lines.english: Who can estimate my worth, if I am pleasing to You? I see You, and inspire others tosee You, O my Love.
lines.transliteration: keemat ka-un  karay t uDh bhaavaaN daykh dikhaavai dh olo.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਉਣ  ਕਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵ  ਦੇਿਖ ਿਦਖਾਵੈ  ਢੋਲੋ ॥
lines.english: I know that You are not far away; I believe that You are deep within me, and I realize Your Presence.
lines.transliteration: door na jaanaa ant ar maanaa har kaa mahal pachh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਿਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਾਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, finding God in Baisakhi, the consciousness is filled with the Word of theShabad, and the mind comes to believe. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak vaisaakheeN parabh  paavai surat  sabad  man maanaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵੈਸਾਖੀਂ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The month of Jayt'h is so sublime. How could I forget my Beloved?
lines.transliteration: maahu jayth bh alaa pareet am ki-o bisrai.

lines.english: The earth burns like a furnace, and the soul-bride offers her prayer.
lines.transliteration: thal taapeh sar bh aar saa Dh an bin-o karai.

lines.punjabi: ਥਲ ਤਾਪਿਹ  ਸਰ ਭਾਰ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Dhan bin-o karayd ee gun  saarayd ee gun  saaree parabh  bhaavaa. The bride offers her prayer, and sings His Glorious Praises; singing His Praises, shebecomes pleasing to God.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਿਬਨਉ  ਕਰੇਦੀ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਦੀ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Unattached Lord dwells in His true mansion. If He allows me, then I will come toHim.
lines.transliteration: saachai mahal rahai bairaagee aavan d eh ta aavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਿਲ  ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਆਵਣ  ਦੇਿਹ ਤ ਆਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: The bride is dishonored and powerless; how will she find peace without her Lord?
lines.transliteration: nimaanee nit aanee har bin ki-o paavai sukh  mahlee.

lines.english: O Nanak, in Jayt'h, she who knows her Lord becomes just like Him; grasping virtue,she meets with the Merciful Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak jayth jaan ai tis jaisee karam milai gun  gahilee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੇਿਠ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਹਲੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The month of Aasaarh is good; the sun blazes in the sky.
lines.transliteration: aasaarh bh alaa sooraj gagan t apai.

lines.english: Dhart ee dookh sahai sokh ai agan bh akhai. The earth suffers in pain, parched and roasted in the fire.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤੀ  ਦੂਖ ਸਹੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਅਗਿਨ  ਭਖੈ ॥
lines.english: The fire dries up the moisture, and she dies in agony. But even then, the sun does not grow tired.
lines.transliteration: agan ras sokhai maree-ai Dh okhai bhee so kirat  na haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਰਸੁ ਸੋਖੈ ਮਰੀਐ  ਧੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: His chariot moves on, and the soul-bride seeks shade; the crickets are chirping in theforest.
lines.transliteration: rath firai chhaa-i-aa Dh an taakai teed lavai manjh  baaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਥੁ ਿਫਰੈ ਛਾਇਆ  ਧਨ ਤਾਕੈ  ਟੀਡੁ ਲਵੈ ਮੰਿਝ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: She ties up her bundle of faults and demerits, and suffers in the world hereafter. But dwelling on the True Lord, she finds peace.
lines.transliteration: avgan baaDh  chalee d ukh aagai sukh  tis saach samaalay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਬਾਿਧ  ਚਲੀ  ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I have given this mind to Him; death and life rest with God. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no ih man dee-aa maran  jeevan  parabh  naalay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਲੇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In Saawan, be happy, O my mind. The rainy season has come, and the clouds haveburst into showers.
lines.transliteration: saavan saras manaa gh an varseh rut  aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਿਣ  ਸਰਸ  ਮਨਾ ਘਣ ਵਰਸਿਹ  ਰੁਿਤ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are pleased by my Lord, but my Beloved has gone away.
lines.transliteration: mai man tan saho bh aavai pir pard ays siDh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਸਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਪਰ ਪਰਦੇਿਸ  ਿਸਧਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: My Beloved has not come home, and I am dying of the sorrow of separation. Thelightning flashes, and I am scared.
lines.transliteration: pir ghar nahee aavai maree-ai haavai d aaman chamak daraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਘਿਰ  ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ  ਮਰੀਐ  ਹਾਵੈ ਦਾਮਿਨ  ਚਮਿਕ ਡਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: My bed is lonely, and I am suffering in agony. I am dying in pain, O my mother!
lines.transliteration: sayj ikaylee kharee d uhaylee maran  bha-i-aa d ukh maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ  ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Tell me - without the Lord, how can I sleep, or feel hungry? My clothes give no comfort to my body.
lines.transliteration: har bin need bh ookh kaho kaisee kaaparh  tan na sukh aava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਨੀਦ  ਭੂਖ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਿਨ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she alone is a happy soul-bride, who merges in the Being of her BelovedHusband Lord. ||9||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa sohagan kant ee pir kai ank samaav-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਕੰਤੀ  ਿਪਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਵਏ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: In Bhaadon, the young woman is confused by doubt; later, she regrets and repents.
lines.transliteration: bhaad a-o bh aram bh ulee bh ar joban pachh utaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਦਉ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲੀ ਭਿਰ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The lakes and fields are overflowing with water; the rainy season has come - the timeto celebrate!
lines.transliteration: jal thal neer bharay baras rut ay rang maan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਿਰ  ਭਰੇ ਬਰਸ  ਰੁਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the dark of night it rains; how can the young bride find peace? The frogs andpeacocks send out their noisy calls.
lines.transliteration: barsai nis kaalee ki-o sukh baalee d aadar mor lavant ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਸੈ  ਿਨਿਸ  ਕਾਲੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਲੀ ਦਾਦਰ  ਮੋਰ ਲਵੰਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" cries the rainbird, while the snakes slither around,biting.
lines.transliteration: pari-o pari-o chavai babeehaa bolay bhu-i-angam fireh dasant ay.

lines.english: The mosquitoes bite and sting, and the ponds are filled to overflowing; without theLord, how can she find peace?
lines.transliteration: machhar dang saa-ir bh ar subh ar bin har ki-o sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਛਰ  ਡੰਗ ਸਾਇਰ  ਭਰ ਸੁਭਰ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I will go and ask my Guru; wherever God is, there I will go. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak poochh chala-o gur apunay jah parabh  tah hee jaa-ee-ai. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਿਛ ਚਲਉ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਜਹ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਹ ਹੀ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: In Assu, come, my Beloved; the soul-bride is grieving to death.
lines.transliteration: asun aa-o piraa saa Dhan jh oor mu-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸੁਿਨ  ਆਉ  ਿਪਰਾ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਝੂਿਰ ਮੁਈ ॥
lines.english: She can only meet Him, when God leads her to meet Him; she is ruined by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: taa milee-ai parabh  maylay d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਈ ॥
lines.english: If she is plundered by falsehood, then her Beloved forsakes her. Then, the white flowers of old age blossom in my hair. pMnw 1109
lines.transliteration: jhooth  vigut ee taa pir mut ee kukah kaah se fulay.

lines.english: Summer is now behind us, and the winter season is ahead. Gazing upon this play, my shaky mind wavers.
lines.transliteration: aagai ghaam pichh ai rut jaadaa d aykh chalat  man dolay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ  ਘਾਮ  ਿਪਛੈ ਰੁਿਤ ਜਾਡਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਚਲਤ  ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: In all ten directions, the branches are green and alive. That which ripens slowly, issweet.
lines.transliteration: dah d is saakh  haree haree-aaval sahj pakai so meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਸਾਖ ਹਰੀ ਹਰੀਆਵਲ ਸਹਿਜ  ਪਕੈ ਸੋ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in Assu, please meet me, my Beloved. The True Guru has become myAdvocate and Friend. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naanak asun milhu pi-aaray satgur bh a-ay baseeth aa. ||11||

lines.english: In Katak, that alone comes to pass, which is pleasing to the Will of God.
lines.transliteration: katak kirat  pa-i-aa jo parabh  bhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The lamp of intuition burns, lit by the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: deepak sahj balai t at jalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Love is the oil in the lamp, which unites the soul-bride with her Lord. The bride is delighted, in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: deepak ras t aylo Dh an pir maylo Dh an omaahai sarsee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਪਕ  ਰਸ ਤੇਲੋ ਧਨ ਿਪਰ ਮੇਲੋ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੈ  ਸਰਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who dies in faults and demerits - her death is not successful. But one who dies inglorious virtue, really truly dies.
lines.transliteration: avgan maaree marai na seejh ai gun  maaree t aa marsee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਮਾਰੀ  ਮਰੈ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ਗੁਿਣ  ਮਾਰੀ  ਤਾ ਮਰਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with devotional worship of the Naam, the Name of the Lord,sit in the home of their own inner being. They place their hopes in You.
lines.transliteration: naam bhagat  day nij gh ar baith ay ajahu t inaarh ee aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਦੇ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਠੇ ਅਜਹੁ ਿਤਨਾੜੀ  ਆਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak: please open the shutters of Your Door, O Lord, and meet me. A singlemoment is like six months to me. ||12||
lines.transliteration: naanak milhu kapat dar kh olahu ayk gh arhee kh at maasaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਕਪਟ  ਦਰ ਖੋਲਹੁ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ  ਖਟੁ ਮਾਸਾ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The month of Maghar is good, for those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,and merge in His Being.
lines.transliteration: manghar maahu bh alaa har gun  ank samaav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਘਰ  ਮਾਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The virtuous wife utters His Glorious Praises; my Beloved Husband Lord is Eternal andUnchanging.
lines.transliteration: gunvant ee gun  ravai mai pir nihchal bh aav-ay.

lines.english: The Primal Lord is Unmoving and Unchanging, Clever and Wise; all the world is fickle.
lines.transliteration: nihchal chatur sujaan  biDhaataa chanchal jagat  sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By virtue of spiritual wisdom and meditation, she merges in His Being; she is pleasingto God, and He is pleasing to her.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan gun  ank samaan ay parabh  bhaanay taa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣੇ ਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have heard the songs and the music, and the poems of the poets; but only the Name of the Lord takes away my pain.
lines.transliteration: geet naad  kavit  kavay sun  raam naam d ukh bhaagai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੀਤ  ਨਾਦ  ਕਿਵਤ  ਕਵੇ ਸੁਿਣ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who performs lovingdevotional worship before her Beloved. ||13||
lines.transliteration: naanak saa Dhan naah pi-aaree abh  bhagtee pir aagai. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਅਭ ਭਗਤੀ  ਿਪਰ ਆਗੈ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: In Poh, the snow falls, and the sap of the trees and the fields dries up.
lines.transliteration: pokh t ukhaar parh ai van  tarin ras sokh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੋਿਖ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਪੜੈ ਵਣੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਣੁ  ਰਸੁ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
lines.english: Why have You not come? I keep You in my mind, body and mouth.
lines.transliteration: aavat kee naahee man t an vaseh mukh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਮੁਖੇ ॥
lines.english: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body; He is the Life of the World.Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.
lines.transliteration: man tan rav rahi-aa jagjeevan gur sabd ee rang maan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: His Light fills all those born of eggs, born from the womb, born of sweat and born ofthe earth, each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: andaj jayraj saytaj ut -bhuj ghat ghat jot samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਡਜ  ਜੇਰਜ  ਸੇਤਜ  ਉਤਭੁਜ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Lord of Mercy and Compassion. OGreat Giver, grant me understanding, that I might find salvation.
lines.transliteration: darsan d ayh d a-i-aapat  daatay gat  paava-o mat  dayho.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਪਿਤ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਗਿਤ ਪਾਵਉ  ਮਿਤ ਦੇਹੋ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord enjoys, savors and ravishes the bride who is in love with Him.||14||
lines.transliteration: naanak rang ravai ras rasee-aa har si-o pareet sanayho. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਵੈ ਰਿਸ ਰਸੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਨੇਹੋ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: In Maagh, I become pure; I know that the sacred shrine of pilgrimage is within me.
lines.transliteration: maagh puneet  bha-ee t irath ant ar jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਘ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਭਈ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have met my Friend with intuitive ease; I grasp His Glorious Virtues, and merge in His Being.
lines.transliteration: saajan sahj milay gun geh ank samaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਹ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, Beauteous Lord God, please listen: I sing Your Glories, and merge inYour Being. If it is pleasing to Your Will, I bathe in the sacred pool within. gMg jmun qh byxI sMgm swq smuMd smwvw ] puMn  dwn pUjw prmysur juig juig eyko jwqw ] (1109- 13, quKwrI, mÚ 1) gang jamun tah bayn ee sangam saat  samund  samaavaa. punn d aan poojaa parmaysur jug jug ayko jaataa. The Ganges, Jamunaa, the sacred meeting place of the three rivers, the seven seas, charity, donations, adoration and worship all rest in the Transcendent Lord God;throughout the ages, I realize the One.
lines.transliteration: pareetam gun  ankay sun  parabh  bankay t uDh bhaavaa sar naavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕੇ ਸੁਿਣ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬੰਕੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ  ਸਿਰ ਨਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in Maagh, the most sublime essence is meditation on the Lord; this is thecleansing bath of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak maagh mahaa ras har jap ath sath tirath naat aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ  ਤਹ ਬੇਣੀ  ਸੰਗਮ  ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ  ਸਮਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: In Phalgun, her mind is enraptured, pleased by the Love of her Beloved.
lines.transliteration: falgun man rahsee paraym subhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, she is enraptured, and her selfishness is gone.
lines.transliteration: an-din rahas bh a-i-aa aap gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਾਿਘ  ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਨਾਤਾ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment is eradicated from her mind, when it pleases Him; in His Mercy,He comes to my home.
lines.transliteration: man moh chukaa-i-aa jaa tis bh aa-i-aa kar kirpaa gh ar aa-o.

lines.english: I dress in various clothes, but without my Beloved, I shall not find a place in the Mansion of His Presence.
lines.transliteration: bahutay vays karee pir baajh ahu mahlee lahaa na thaa-o.

lines.english: I have adorned myself with garlands of flow ers, pearl necklaces, scented oils and silk robes.
lines.transliteration: haar dor ras paat patambar pir lorhee seegaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਓ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru has united me with Him. The soul-bride has found her HusbandLord, within the home of her own heart. ||16||
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl la-ee gur apnai gh ar var paa-i-aa naaree. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੀ ਿਪਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮਹਲੀ  ਲਹਾ ਨ ਥਾਓ ॥
lines.english: The twelve months, the seasons, the weeks, the days, the hours, the minutes and theseconds are all sublime, when the True Lord comes and meets her with natural ease.
lines.transliteration: bay das maah rut ee thit ee vaar bh alay. gh arhee moorat  pal saachay aa-ay sahj milay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਰਸ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਿਪਿਰ  ਲੋੜੀ  ਸੀਗਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: God, my Beloved, has met me, and my affairs are all resolved. The Creator Lordknows all ways and means.
lines.transliteration: parabh milay pi-aaray kaaraj saaray kart aa sabh  biDh jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਈ ਗੁਿਰ ਅਪਣੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਰੀ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I am loved by the One who has embellished and exalted me; I have met Him, and Isavor His Love.
lines.transliteration: jin seegaaree tiseh pi-aaree mayl bh a-i-aa rang maan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇ ਦਸ ਮਾਹ ਰੁਤੀ ਿਥਤੀ  ਵਾਰ ਭਲੇ ॥
lines.english: The bed of my heart becomes beautiful, when my Husband Lord ravishes me. As Gurmukh, the destiny on my forehead has been awakened and activated. pMnw 1110
lines.transliteration: ghar sayj suhaavee jaa pir raavee gurmukh  mast ak bh aago.

lines.english: O Nanak, day and night, my Beloved enjoys me; with the Lord as my Husband, my Marriage is Eternal. ||17||1|| quKwrI mhlw 1 ] (1110-1) tukhaaree mehlaa 1. Tukhaari, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ahinis raavai pareetam har var thir sohaago. ||17||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਰਾਵੈ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਿਥਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ  ॥੧੭॥੧॥
lines.english: In the first watch of the dark night, O bride of splendored eyes,
lines.transliteration: pahilai pahrai nain salonrh ee-ay rain  anDh i-aaree raam.
vakhar raakh  mu-ee-ay aavai vaaree raam. protect your riches; your turn is coming soon.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਨੈਣ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ  ਰੈਿਣ ਅੰਿਧਆਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: When your turn comes, who will wake you? While you sleep, your juice shall besucked out by the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: vaaree aavai kavan jagaavai soot ee jam ras choos-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਖਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਈਏ  ਆਵੈ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The night is so dark; what will become of your honor? The thieves will break into yourhome and rob you.
lines.transliteration: rain anDh ayree ki-aa pat  tayree chor parh ai ghar moos-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਕਵਣੁ  ਜਗਾਵੈ  ਸੂਤੀ ਜਮ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਸਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Saviour Lord, Inaccessible and Infinite, please hear my prayer.
lines.transliteration: raakhan haaraa agam apaaraa sun  baynant ee mayree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਣ ਅੰਧੇਰੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਪਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਚੋਰੁ ਪੜੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the fool never remembers Him; what can he see in the dark of night? ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak moorakh kabeh na chayt ai ki-aa soojh ai rain  anDh ayree-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ਸੁਿਣ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਮੇਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The second watch has begun; wake up, you unconscious being!
lines.transliteration: doojaa pahar bh a-i-aa jaag achayt ee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਿਕਆ  ਸੂਝੈ ਰੈਿਣ ਅੰਧੇਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Protect your riches, O mortal; your farm is being eaten.
lines.transliteration: vakhar raakh  mu-ee-ay kh aajai kh aytee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਪਹਰੁ ਭਇਆ  ਜਾਗੁ  ਅਚੇਤੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Protect your crops, and love the Lord, the Guru. Stay awake and aware, and the thieves shall not rob you.
lines.transliteration: raakho kh aytee har gur hayt ee jaagat  chor na laagai.

lines.punjabi: ਵਖਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਈਏ  ਖਾਜੈ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: You shall not have to go on the path of Death, and you shall not suffer in pain; yourfear and terror of death shall run away.
lines.transliteration: jam mag na jaavhu naa dukh  paavhu jam kaa dar bh a-o bh aagai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਹੇਤੀ ਜਾਗਤ  ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: The lamps of the sun and the moon are lit by the Guru's Teachings, through His Door,meditating on the True Lord, in the mind and with the mouth.
lines.transliteration: rav sas deepak gurmat  du-aarai man saachaa mukh  Dhi-aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਮਿਗ ਨ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the fool still does not remember the Lord. How can he find peace in duality?||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak moorakh ajahu na chayt ai kiv d oojai sukh  paav-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਸਿਸ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਮਿਨ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਿਧਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: The third watch has begun, and sleep has set in.
lines.transliteration: teejaa pahar bh a-i-aa need  vi-aapee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਿਕਵ ਦੂਜੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The mortal suffers in pain, from attachment to Maya, children and spouse.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa sut d aaraa d ookh santaapee raam.

lines.english: Maya, his children, his wife and the world are so dear to him; he bites the bait, and iscaught.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa sut d aaraa jagat  pi-aaraa chog chugai nit  faasai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ  ਦੂਿਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he shall find peace; following the Guru's Teachings, he shall not be seized by death.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aavai t aa sukh  paavai gurmat  kaal na garaasai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ  ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਿਨਤ  ਫਾਸੈ ॥
lines.english: He cannot escape from birth, dying and death; without the Name, he suffers.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  kaal nahee chh odai vin  naavai sant aapee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਗਰ੍ਾਸੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in the third watch of the three-phased Maya, the world is engrossed inattachment to Maya. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak teejai t aribaDh  lokaa maa-i-aa mohi vi-aapee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ  ॥
lines.english: The fourth watch has begun, and the day is about to dawn.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthaa pahar bha-i-aa d a-ut bihaagai raam.

lines.english: Those who remain awake and aware, night and day, preserve and protect theirhomes.
lines.transliteration: tin gh ar raakh i-arhaa jo an-d in jaagai raam.

lines.english: The night is pleasant and peaceful, for those who remain awake; following the Guru'sadvice, they focus on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur poochh jaagay naam laagay t inaa rain  suhaylee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਿਖਅੜਾ  ਜ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Those who practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad are not reincarnated again; theLord God is their Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad kamaaveh janam na aavahi t inaa har parabh  baylee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਿਛ ਜਾਗੇ  ਨਾਿਮ ਲਾਗੇ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਰੈਿਣ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The hands shake, the feet and body totter, the vision goes dark, and the body turnsto dust.
lines.transliteration: kar kaNp charan sareer kampai nain  anDh ulay t an bh asam say.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਆਵਿਹ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬੇਲੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, people are miserable throughout the four ages, if the Name of the Lord does not abide in the mind. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak dukh ee-aa jug chaaray bin naam har kay man vasay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਕੰਿਪ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੰਪੈ ਨੈਣ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ  ਸੇ ॥
lines.english: The knot has been untied; rise up - the order has come!
lines.transliteration: khoolee ganth  utho likh i-aa aa-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਖੀਆ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Pleasures and comforts are gone; like a prisoner, you are driven on.
lines.transliteration: ras kas sukh th aakay banDh  chalaa-i-aa raam.

lines.english: You shall be bound and gagged, when it pleases God; you will not see or hear itcoming.
lines.transliteration: banDh chalaa-i-aa jaa parabh  bhaa-i-aa naa d eesai naa sun ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸੁਖ ਠਾਕੇ  ਬੰਿਧ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Everyone will have their turn; the crop ripens, and then it is cut down.
lines.transliteration: aapan vaaree sabh sai aavai pakee kh aytee lun ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਿਧ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਇਆ  ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The account is kept for every second, every instant; the soul suffers for the bad andthe good.
lines.transliteration: gharh ee chasay kaa laykh aa leejai buraa bh alaa saho jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣ  ਵਾਰੀ  ਸਭਸੈ  ਆਵੈ  ਪਕੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਲੁਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the angelic beings are united with the Word of the Shabad; this is the wayGod made it. ||5||2|| quKwrI mhlw 1 ] (1110-17) tukhaaree mehlaa 1. Tukhaari, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sur nar sabad milaa-ay t in parabh  kaaran  kee-aa. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀ ਚਸੇ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ  ਲੀਜੈ  ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The meteor shoots across the sky. How can it be seen with the eyes?
lines.transliteration: taaraa charh i-aa lammaa ki-o nad ar nihaali-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕੀਆ ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: The True Guru reveals the Word of the Shabad to His servant who has such perfect karma.
lines.transliteration: sayvak poor karammaa satgur sabad  dikhaali-aa raam.

lines.english: The Guru reveals the Shabad; dwelling on the True Lord, day and night, he beholdsand reflects on God.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad d ikhaali-aa sach samaali-aa ahinis d aykh beechaari-aa.

lines.english: Dhaavat  panch rahay gh ar jaan i-aa kaam kroDh  bikh maari-aa. The five restless desires are restrained, and he knows the home of his own heart. Heconquers sexual desire, anger and corruption.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਦਖਾਿਲਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: His inner being is illuminated, by the Guru's Teachings; He beholds the Lord's play ofkarma. pMnw 1111
lines.transliteration: antar jot  bha-ee gur saakh ee cheenay raam karammaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਪਤੀਣੇ  ਤਾਰਾ  ਚਿੜਆ  ਲੰਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, killing his ego, he is satisfied; the meteor has shot across the sky. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai maar pateen ay taaraa charh i-aa lammaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਿਗ  ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕੀ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware; their egotistical pride is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaag rahay chookee abh imaanee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਨੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, it is dawn for them; they merge in the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh or bha-i-aa saach samaanee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਨੀ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਬਤੁ  ਜਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are merged in the True Lord; they are pleasing to His Mind. The Gurmukhs are intact, safe and sound, awake and awake.
lines.transliteration: saach samaanee gurmukh man bh aanee gurmukh  saabat  jaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru blesses them with the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: saach naam amrit gur d ee-aa har charnee liv laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਜੋਿਤ ਮਿਹ ਜਾਤਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Light is revealed, and in that Li ght, they achieve realization; the self-willed manmukhs wander in doubt and confusion.
lines.transliteration: pargatee jot jot  meh jaat aa manmukh  bharam bh ulaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਜਾਗਤ  ਰੈਿਣ ਿਵਹਾਣੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the dawn breaks, their minds are satisfied; they pass their life-nightawake and aware. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhor bh a-i-aa man maani-aa jaagat  rain vihaan ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗਣ  ਵੀਸਿਰਆ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਘਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting faults and demerits, virtue and merit enter one's home.
lines.transliteration: a-ugan veesri-aa gun ee gh ar kee-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is permeating everywhere; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayko rav rahi-aa avar na bee-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is All-pervading; there is no other. The mind comes to believe, from the mind.
lines.transliteration: rav rahi-aa so-ee avar na ko-ee man hee tay man maani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਲ ਥਲ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਘਟੁ ਘਟੁ ਥਾਿਪਆ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: The One who established the water, the land, the three worlds, each and every heart- that God is known by the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: jin jal thal taribh avan ghat ghat thaapi-aa so parabh  gurmukh  jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਅਪਾਰਾ ਿਤਰ੍ਿਬਿਧ  ਮੇਿਟ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Infinite, All-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; erasing the three-phased Maya, we merge in Him.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath apaaraa t aribaDh  mayt samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਵਗਣ  ਗੁਣਹ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਐਸੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, then, demerits are dissolved by merits; such are the Guru's Teachings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak avgan gun ah samaan ay aisee gurmat  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣ  ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My coming and going in reincarnation have ended; doubt and hesitation are gone.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay chookaa bh olaa raam.

lines.english: Conquering my ego, I have met the True Lord, and now I wear the robe of Truth.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar milay saachaa cholaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਗੁਿਰ ਖੋਈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has rid me of egotism; my sorrow and suffering are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai gur kho-ee pargat ho-ee chookay sog sant aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਆਪੈ  ॥
lines.english: My might merges into the Light; I realize and understand my own self.
lines.transliteration: jotee and ar jot  samaan ee aap pachh aataa aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਤੀਣੀ  ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਿਪਰ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: In this world of my parents' home, I am satisfied with the Shabad; at my in-laws'home, in the world beyond, I shall be pleasing to my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: pay-ee-arhai gh ar sabad  pateenee saahurrh ai pir bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ਚੂਕੀ  ਕਾਿਣ  ਲੋਕਾਣੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the True Guru has united me in His Union; my dependence on people hasended. ||4||3|| quKwrI mhlw 1 ] (1111-10) tukhaaree mehlaa 1. Tukhaari, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mayl milaa-ee chookee kaan  lokaan ee. ||4||3||

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, misled and confused, the soul-bride later regrets and repents.
lines.transliteration: bholaavarh ai bhulee bh ul bhul pachh otaanee.

lines.english: Abandoning her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and does not appreciate His Worth.
lines.transliteration: pir chhodi-arh ee sut ee pir kee saar na jaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਿਰ  ਛੋਿਡਅੜੀ  ਸੁਤੀ ਿਪਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Leaving her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and is plundered by her faults and demerits. The night is so painful for this bride.
lines.transliteration: pir chhodee sut ee avgan  mutee tis Dhan viDh an raatay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਿਰ  ਛੋਡੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਅਵਗਿਣ  ਮੁਤੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਧਨ ਿਵਧਣ  ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and egotism destroy her. She burns in egotism.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar vigut ee ha-umai lagee t aatay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ਿਵਗੁਤੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਲਗੀ  ਤਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: When the soul-swan flies away, by the Command of the Lord, her dust mingles withdust.
lines.transliteration: udar hans chali-aa furmaa-i-aa bhasmai bh asam samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਉਡਿਰ  ਹੰਸੁ ਚਿਲਆ  ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ਭਸਮੈ ਭਸਮ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, she is confused and deluded, and so she regretsand repents. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam vihoonee bh ul bhul pachh otaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਹੂਣੀ ਭੁਿਲ ਭੁਿਲ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord, to my one prayer.
lines.transliteration: sun naah pi-aaray ik baynant ee mayree.

lines.english: You dwell in the home of the self deep within, while I roll around like a dust-ball.
lines.transliteration: too nij gh ar vasi-arh aa ha-o rul bh asmai dh ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਿਸਅੜਾ  ਹਉ ਰੁਿਲ ਭਸਮੈ  ਢੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Without my Husband Lord, no one likes me at all; what can I say or do now?
lines.transliteration: bin apnay naahai ko-ay na chaahai ki-aa kahee-ai ki-aa keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਅਪਨੇ  ਨਾਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਿਕਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sweetest nectar of nectars.Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with my tongue, I drink in this nectar.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam rasan ras rasnaa gur sabd ee ras peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, no one has any friend or companion; millions come and go inreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai ko sang na saathee aavai jaa-ay gh anayree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਸਾਥੀ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ ਘਨੇਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak: the profit is earned and the soul returns home. True, true are Your Teachings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak laahaa lai ghar jaa-ee-ai saachee sach mat  tayree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਲੈ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਸਚੁ ਮਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Friend, You have travelled so far from Your homeland; I send my message of loveto You.
lines.transliteration: saajan days vid aysee-arh ay saanayhrh ay daydee.

lines.english: I cherish and remember that Friend; the eyes of this soul-bride are filled with tears.
lines.transliteration: saar samaalay tin sajn aa munDh  nain bharayd ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਿਤਨ  ਸਜਣਾ  ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: The eyes of the soul-bride are filled with tears; I dwell upon Your Glorious Virtues.How can I meet my Beloved Lord God?
lines.transliteration: munDh nain  bharayd ee gun  saarayd ee ki-o parabh  milaa pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ  ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਦੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਾ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I do not know the treacherous path, the way to You. How can I find You and crossover, O my Husband Lord?
lines.transliteration: maarag panth na jaana-o vikh -rhaa ki-o paa-ee-ai pir paaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ  ਿਵਖੜਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the separated soul-bride meets withthe Lord; I place my body and mind before You.
lines.transliteration: satgur sabd ee milai vichh unnee t an man aagai raakh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਦੀ  ਿਮਲੈ ਿਵਛੁੰਨੀ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the ambrosial tree bears the most delicious fruits; meeting with my Beloved,I taste the sweet essence. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak amrit birakh  mahaa ras fali-aa mil pareet am ras chaakh ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਫਿਲਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord has called you to the Mansion of His Presence - do not delay! pMnw 1112
lines.transliteration: mahal bulaa-irhee-ay bilam na keejai.

lines.english: Night and day, imbued with His Love, you shall meet with Him with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: an-din rat -rhee-ay sahj mileejai.

lines.english: In celestial peace and poise, you shall meet Him; do not harbor anger - subdue your proud self!
lines.transliteration: sukh sahj mileejai ros na keejai garab nivaar samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਖ ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲੀਜੈ  ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗਰਬੁ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with Truth, I am united in His Union, while the self-willed manmukhs continuecoming and going.
lines.transliteration: saachai raatee milai milaa-ee manmukh  aavan  jaanee.

lines.english: When you dance, what veil covers you? Break the water pot, and be unattached.
lines.transliteration: jab naachee tab gh ooghat kaisaa matukee forh  niraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਨਾਚੀ  ਤਬ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਫੋਿੜ ਿਨਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, realize your own self; as Gurmukh, contemplate the essence of reality.||4||4|| quKwrI mhlw 1 ] (1112-3) tukhaaree mehlaa 1. Tukhaari, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapai aap pachhaan ai gurmukh  tat beechaaree. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੈ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: O my Dear Beloved, I am the slave of Your slaves.
lines.transliteration: mayray laal rangeelay ham laalan kay laalay.

lines.english: The Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord, and now, I do not seek any other.
lines.transliteration: gur alakh lakh aa-i-aa avar na d oojaa bh aalay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ  ਰੰਗੀਲੇ  ਹਮ ਲਾਲਨ  ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru showed me the Invisible Lord, when it pleased Him, and when God showered His Blessings.
lines.transliteration: gur alakh lakh aa-i-aa jaa t is bhaa-i-aa jaa parabh  kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਇਆ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਲੇ ॥
lines.english: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, theLord of the woods - I have met Him with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan daat aa purakh  biDhaataa sahj milay banvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ  ਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Bestow Your Glance of Grace and carry me across, to save me. Please bless me withthe Truth, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: nadar karahi t oo taareh t aree-ai sach d ayvhu d een d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of Your slaves. You are the Cherisher of all souls. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak d aasan d aasaa t oo sarab jee-aa part ipaalaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੂ ਤਾਰਿਹ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: My Dear Beloved is enshrined throughout the Universe.
lines.transliteration: bharipur Dh aar rahay at  pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Shabad is pervading, through the Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabday rav rahi-aa gur roop muraaray.

lines.english: The Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord, is enshrined throughout the three worlds; Hislimits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: gur roop muraaray taribh avan Dhaaray t aa kaa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਗੁਰ ਰੂਿਪ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He created the beings of various colors and kinds; His Blessings increase day by day.
lines.transliteration: rangee jinsee jant upaa-ay nit  dayvai charh ai savaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਧਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Infinite Lord Himself establishes and disestablishes; whatever pleases Him,happens.
lines.transliteration: aprampar aapay thaap uthaapay tis bh aavai so hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੀ ਿਜਨਸੀ  ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ  ਿਨਤ  ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the diamond of the mind is pierced through by the diamond of spiritual wisdom. The garland of virtue is strung. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak heeraa heerai bayDhi-aa gun  kai haar parovai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The virtuous person merges in the Virtuous Lord; his forehead bears the insignia ofthe Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gun gun eh samaan ay mast ak naam neesaan o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਗੁਣ ਕੈ ਹਾਿਰ ਪਰੋਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The true person merges in the True Lord; his comings and goings are over.
lines.transliteration: sach saach samaa-i-aa chookaa aavan jaan o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: The true person realizes the True Lord, and is imbued with Truth. He meets the TrueLord, and is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.
lines.transliteration: sach saach pachhaat aa saachai raat aa saach milai man bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: No one else is seen to be above the True Lord; the true person merges in the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: saachay oopar avar na deesai saachay saach samaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਚ  ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਾਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind; releasing me from bondage, He has setme free.
lines.transliteration: mohan mohi lee-aa man mayraa banDhan kh ol niraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my light merged into the Light, when I met my most Darling Beloved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak jotee jot  samaan ee jaa mili-aa at  pi-aaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਲੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਨ  ਖੋਿਲ ਿਨਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: By searching, the true home, the place of the True Guru is found.
lines.transliteration: sach ghar kh oj lahay saachaa gur thaano.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਜਾ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਅਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, while the self-willed manmukh does not.
lines.transliteration: manmukh nah paa-ee-ai gurmukh  gi-aano.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਿਜ ਲਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ  ਗੁਰ ਥਾਨੋ ॥
lines.english: Whoever the Lord has blessed with the gift of Truth is accepted; the Supremely Wise Lord is forever the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: dayvai sach d aano so parvaano sad  daataa vad d aanaa.

lines.english: He is known to be Immortal, Unborn and Permanent; the True Mansion of HisPresence is everlasting.
lines.transliteration: amar ajonee asthir jaapai saachaa mahal chiraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੋ  ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੋ  ਸਦ ਦਾਤਾ  ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The day-to-day account of deeds is not recorded for that person, who manifests theradiance of the Divine Light of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dot uchaapat  laykh  na likee-ai pargatee jot  muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ  ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਿਚਰਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the true person is absorbed in the True Lord; the Gurmukh crosses over tothe other side. ||4||5|| quKwrI mhlw 1 ] (1112-16) tukhaaree mehlaa 1. Tukhaari, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa saachai raachaa gurmukh t aree-ai t aaree. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਿਤ  ਉਚਾਪਿਤ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਿਲਖੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O my ignorant, unconscious mind, reform yourself.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa too samajh  achayt  i-aan i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਚਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਤਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: O my mind, leave behind your faults and demerits, and be absorbed in virtue.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa chhad avgan  gunee samaan i-aa raam.

lines.english: You are deluded by so many flavors and pleasures, and you act in such confusion. Youare separated, and you will not meet your Lord.
lines.transliteration: baho saad lubh aanay kirat  kamaan ay vichh urhi-aa nahee maylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਸਮਝੁ  ਅਚੇਤ  ਇਆਿਣਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: How can the impassible world-ocean be crossed? The fear of the Messenger of Death is deadly. The path of Death is agonizingly painful.
lines.transliteration: ki-o dut ar taree-ai jam dar maree-ai jam kaa panth d uhaylaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਛਿਡ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਾਿਣਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: The mortal does not know the Lord in the evening, or in the morning; trapped on thetreacherous path, what will he do then?
lines.transliteration: man raam nahee jaataa saajh  parbh ataa avgh at ruDh aa ki-aa karay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦ ਲੁਭਾਣੇ  ਿਕਰਤ  ਕਮਾਣੇ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜਆ  ਨਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
lines.english: Bound in bondage, he is released only by this method: as Gurmukh, serve the Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: banDhan baaDh i-aa in biDh  chhootai gurmukh  sayvai narharay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ  ਜਮ ਡਿਰ ਮਰੀਐ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, abandon your household entanglements.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa too chh od aal janjaalaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ  ਸਾਝ ਪਰ੍ਭਾਤਾ  ਅਵਘਿਟ  ਰੁਧਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, serve the Lord, the Primal, Detached Lord. pMnw 1113
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa har sayvhu purakh niraalaa raam.

lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the One Universal Creator; the True Lord created the entire Universe.
lines.transliteration: har simar aykankaar saachaa sabh jagat  jinn upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਜੰਿਨ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru controls the air, water and fire; He has staged the drama of the world.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee agan baaDh ay gur kh ayl jagat  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬਾਧੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਖੇਲੁ ਜਗਿਤ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Reflect on your own self, and so practice good conduct; chant the Name of the Lordas your self-discipline and meditation.
lines.transliteration: aachaar too veechaar aapay har naam sanjam jap t apo.

lines.punjabi: ਆਚਾਿਰ  ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪੋ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is your Companion, Friend and Dear Beloved; chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sakhaa sain pi-aar pareet am naam har kaa jap japo. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਖਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਿਪਆਰੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੋ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, remain steady and stable, and you will not have to endure beatings.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa too thir rahu chot na kh aavhee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਿਥਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵਹੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall merge into Him withintuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa gun gaavahi sahj samaavahee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਵਹੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, be happy. Apply the ointment of spiritualwisdom to your eyes.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay raam rasaa-ay rasee-ah gur gi-aan anjan saarhay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇ  ਰਸੀਅਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is the lamp which illuminates the three worlds; it slaughtersthe five demons.
lines.transliteration: tarai lok d eepak sabad  chaanan  panch d oot sangh aarahay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਲੋਕ ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Quieting your fears, become fearless, and you shall cross over the impassible worldocean. Meeting the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved.
lines.transliteration: bhai kaat nirbh a-o tareh d utar gur mili-ai kaaraj saar-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਕਾਿਟ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਤਰਿਹ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਾਰਏ  ॥
lines.english: You shall find the joy and the beauty of the Lord's Love and Affection; the LordHimself shall shower you with His Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: roop rang pi-aar har si-o har aap kirpaa Dhaar-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਿਪਆਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, why did you come into the world? What will you take with you when yougo?
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa too ki-aa lai aa-i-aa ki-aa lai jaa-isee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਤੂ ਿਕਆ  ਲੈ ਆਇਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਲੈ ਜਾਇਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, you shall be emancipated, when you eliminate your doubts.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa taa chh utsee jaa bh aram chukaa-isee raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਤਾ ਛੁਟਸੀ  ਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Dhan sanch har har naam vakh ar gur sabad  bhaa-o pachh aanahay. So gather the wealth and capital of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall realize its value.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਭਾਉ ਪਛਾਣਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Filth shall be taken away, through the Immaculate Word of the Shabad; you shallknow the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, your true home.
lines.transliteration: mail parhar sabad nirmal mahal gh ar sach jaan hay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਲੁ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਸਬਿਦ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਘਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਹੇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Naam, you shall obtain honor, and come home. Eagerly drink in theAmbrosial Amrit.
lines.transliteration: pat naam paavahi gh ar siDh aaveh jh ol amrit  pee raso.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਸਧਾਵਿਹ  ਝੋਿਲ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਪੀ ਰਸੋ ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall obtain the sublime essence of the Shabad;by great good fortune, chant the Praises of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aa-ee-ai sabad  ras paa-ee-ai vadbh aag japee-ai har jaso. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੋ ॥੪॥
lines.english: O my mind, without a ladder, how will you climb up to the Temple of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa bin pa-urhee-aa mand ar ki-o charh ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਪਉੜੀਆ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਿਕਉ  ਚੜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, without a boat, you shall not reach the other shore.
lines.transliteration: ay man mayri-aa bin bayrhee paar na ambrh ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਿਰਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਿਰ  ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: On that far shore is Your Beloved, Infinite Friend. Only your awareness of the Guru'sShabad will carry you across.
lines.transliteration: paar saajan apaar pareetam gur sabad  surat  langh aava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਿਰ  ਸਾਜਨੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਲੰਘਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall enjoy ecstasy; you shall not regret or repent later on.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangat  karahi ralee-aa fir na pachh otaava-ay.

lines.english: Be Merciful, O Merciful True Lord God: please give me the Blessing of the Lord'sName, and the Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kar da-i-aa d aan d a-i-aal saachaa har naam sangat  paava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਓ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak prays: please hear me, O my Beloved; instruct my mind through the Word ofthe Guru's Shabad. ||5||6|| quKwrI CMq mhlw 4  (1113-15) tukhaaree chh ant mehlaa 4 Tukhaari Chhant, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1113-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ampai sunhu pareet am gur sabad  man sanjh aava-o. ||5||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਪਇਅੰਪੈ  ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਓ  ॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: My inner being is filled with love for my Beloved Husband Lord. How can I live withoutHim?
lines.transliteration: antar piree pi-aar ki-o pir bin jeevee-ai raam.
