lines.english: As long as I do not have the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I drink in theAmbrosial Nectar?
lines.transliteration: jab lag daras na ho-ay ki-o amrit  peevee-ai raam.

lines.english: How can I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar without the Lord? I cannot survive without Him.
lines.transliteration: ki-o amrit peevee-ai har bin jeevee-ai t is bin rahan na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ਿਕਉ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I cry out, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!", day and night. Without my Husband Lord, my thirst is not quenched.
lines.transliteration: an-din pari-o pari-o karay d in raat ee pir bin pi-aas na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਵੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਜੀਵੀਐ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Please, bless me with Your Grace, O my Beloved Lord, that I may dwell on the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har, forever.
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa karahu har pi-aaray har har naam sad  saari-aa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have met my Beloved; I am a sacrifice tothe True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad mili-aa mai pareet am ha-o sat gur vitahu vaari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: When I see my Beloved Husband Lord, I chant the Lord's Glorious Praises with love. pMnw 1114
lines.transliteration: jab daykh aaN pir pi-aaraa har gun  ras ravaa raam.

lines.english: My inner being blossoms forth; I continually utter, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!"
lines.transliteration: mayrai antar ho-ay vigaas pari-o pari-o sach nit  chavaa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਿਵਗਾਸੁ  ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਸਚੁ ਿਨਤ  ਚਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I speak of my Dear Beloved, and through the Shabad, I am saved. Unless I can see Him, I am not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: pari-o chavaa pi-aaray sabad nist aaray bin d aykhay taripat  na aav-ay.

lines.english: That soul-bride who is ever adorned with the Shabad, meditates on the Name of theLord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sabad seegaar hovai nit  kaaman  har har naam Dh i-aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਨਤ  ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless this beggar, Your humble servant, with the Gift of Mercy; please unite mewith my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa d aan mangat  jan d eejai mai pareet am dayh milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ  ਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ  ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਦੇਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the World; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din gur gopaal Dh i-aa-ee ham sat gur vitahu gh umaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ  ਿਧਆਈ  ਹਮ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a stone in the Boat of the Guru. Please carry me across the terrifying ocean ofpoison.
lines.transliteration: ham paathar gur naav bikh bh avjal t aaree-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ  ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਵ ਿਬਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਾਰੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Guru, please, lovingly bless me with the Word of the Shabad. I am such a fool -please save me!
lines.transliteration: gur dayvhu sabad  subh aa-ay mai moorh  nistaaree-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਿਨਸਤਾਰੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I am a fool and an idiot; I know nothing of Your extent. You are known asInaccessible and Great.
lines.transliteration: ham moorh mugaDh  kichh  mit nahee paa-ee t oo agamm vad jaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ਤੂ ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਵਡ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are Merciful; please, mercifully bless me. I am unworthy and dishonored- please, unite me with Yourself!
lines.transliteration: too aap d a-i-aal d a-i-aa kar mayleh ham nirgun ee nimaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਹਮ ਿਨਰਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਮਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through countless lifetimes, I wandered in sin; now, I have come seeking YourSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: anayk janam paap kar bharmay hun  ta-o sarn aagat  aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਜਨਮ  ਪਾਪ ਕਿਰ ਭਰਮੇ  ਹੁਿਣ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਤ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Take pity on me and save me, Dear Lord; I have grasped the Feet of the True Guru.||3||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu rakh  layvhu har jee-o ham laagah sat gur paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Philosopher's Stone; by His touch, iron is transformed into gold.
lines.transliteration: gur paaras ham loh mil kanchan ho-i-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ  ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਿਮਿਲ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My light merges into the Light, and my body-fortress is so beautiful.
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milaa-ay kaa-i-aa garh  sohi-aa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਗੜੁ ਸੋਿਹਆ  ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.english: My body-fortress is so beautiful; I am fascinated by my God. How could I forget Him, for even a breath, or a morsel of food?
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa garh sohi-aa mayrai parabh  mohi-aa ki-o saas giraas visaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਗੜੁ ਸੋਿਹਆ  ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਿਵਸਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I have seized the Unseen and Unfathomable Lord, through the Word of the Guru'sShabad. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: adrist agochar pakrh i-aa gur sabd ee ha-o sat gur kai balihaaree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਕਿੜਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I place my head in offering before the True Guru, if it truly pleases the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur aagai sees bh ayt day-o jay sat gur saachay bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਆਗੈ  ਸੀਸੁ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Take pity on me, O God, Great Giver, that Nanak may merge in Your Being. ||4||1|| quKwrI mhlw 4 ] (1114-11) tukhaaree mehlaa 4. Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay da-i-aa karahu parabh  daatay naanak ank samaavai. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਤੇ  ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far.
lines.transliteration: har har agam agaaDh aprampar aparparaa.

lines.english: Those who meditate on You, O Lord of the Universe - those humble beings cross overthe terrifying, treacherous world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jo tum Dh i-aavahi jagd ees tay jan bh a-o bikh am taraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਅਪਰਪਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, easily cross over theterrifying, treacherous world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bikham bh a-o tin tari-aa suhaylaa jin har har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਉ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਤਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Those who lovingly walk in harmony with the Word of the Guru, the True Guru - the Lord, Har, Har, unites them with Himself.
lines.transliteration: gur vaak satgur jo bh aa-ay chalay t in har har aap milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖਮ  ਭਉ ਿਤਨ ਤਿਰਆ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal's light meets the Light of God, and blends with that Divine Light when theLord, the Support of the Earth, grants His Grace.
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  mil jot  samaan ee har kirpaa kar Dh arneeDharaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਿਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਜੋ ਭਾਇ  ਚਲੇ ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far.||1||
lines.transliteration: har har agam agaaDh aprampar aparparaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totallypervading and permeating each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: tum su-aamee agam athaah t oo gh at ghat poor rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਅਪਰਪਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are Unseen, Unknowable and Unfathomable; You are found through the Word ofthe Guru, the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: too alakh  abhay-o agamm gur sat gur bachan lahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ  ਅਥਾਹ  ਤੂ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an tay jan purakh  pooray jin gur sant sangat  mil gun  ravay. Blessed, blessed are those humble, powerful and perfect people, who join the Guru'sSangat, the Society of the Saints, and chant His Glorious Praises.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਉ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਿਨ  ਲਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: With clear and precise understanding, the Gurmukhs contemplate the Guru's Shabad;each and every instant, they continually speak of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bibayk buDh beechaar gurmukh  gur sabad  khin khin har nit  chavay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ  ਪੂਰੇ ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵੇ ॥
lines.english: When the Gurmukh sits down, he chants the Lord's Name. When the Gurmukh standsup, he chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jaa baheh gurmukh har naam boleh jaa kh arhay gurmukh  har har kahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਤ  ਚਵੇ ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totally pervading and permeating each and every heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tum su-aamee agam athaah t oo gh at ghat poor rahi-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਬਹਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਜਾ ਖੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They serve the Lord, and follow theGuru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: sayvak jan sayveh tay parvaan  jin sayvi-aa gurmat  haray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਥਾਹ  ਤੂ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All their millions of sins are taken away in an instant; the Lord takes them far away.
lines.transliteration: tin kay kot sabh  paap kh in parhar har d oor karay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਜਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਿਜਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: All their sin and blame is washed away. They worship and adore the One Lord with their conscious minds. pMnw 1115
lines.transliteration: tin kay paap d okh sabh  binsay jin man chit  ik araaDh i-aa.

lines.english: The Creator makes fruitful the lives of all those who, through the Guru's Word, chant the True Name.
lines.transliteration: tin kaa janam safli-o sabh  kee-aa kart ai jin gur bachnee sach bh aakhi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਭਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed are those humble beings, those great and perfect people, who follow theGuru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord; they cross over the terrifying andtreacherous world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: tay Dh an jan vad purakh  pooray jo gurmat  har jap bh a-o bikh am taray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਪੂਰੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਭਉ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They follow the Guru's Teachings,and serve the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sayvak jan sayveh tay parvaan  jin sayvi-aa gurmat  haray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਜਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਿਜਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk.
lines.transliteration: too ant arjaamee har aap ji-o t oo chalaaveh pi-aaray ha-o t ivai chalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਜਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਿਹ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਉ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing is in my hands; when You unite me, then I come to be united.
lines.transliteration: hamrai haath kichh naahi jaa t oo mayleh t aa ha-o aa-ay milaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਤਾ ਹਉ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O my Lord and Master - all their accounts aresettled.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o too har mayleh su-aamee sabh  tin kaa laykh aa chh utak ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਭੁ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ  ਛੁਟਿਕ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one can go through the accounts of those, O Siblings of Destiny, who through theWord of the Guru's Teachings are united with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tin kee gan at na kari-ahu ko bh aa-ee jo gur bachnee har mayl la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਕਿਰਅਹੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord shows Mercy to those who accept the Guru's Will as good.
lines.transliteration: naanak da-i-aal ho-aa t in oopar jin gur kaa bh aanaa mani-aa bh alaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk. ||4||2|| quKwrI mhlw 4 ] (1115-7) tukhaaree mehlaa 4. Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too ant arjaamee har aap ji-o t oo chalaaveh pi-aaray ha-o t ivai chalaa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਜਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਿਹ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਹਉ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, theCreator of all the Universe.
lines.transliteration: too jagjeevan jagd ees sabh  kartaa sarisat naath.

lines.english: They alone meditate on You, O my Lord, who have such destiny recorded on their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: tin too Dh i-aa-i-aa mayraa raam jin kai Dh ur laykh  maath.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ  ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਨਾਥੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who are so pre-destined by their Lord and Master, worship and adore the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o Dhur har likh i-aa su-aamee t in har har naam araaDh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਤੂ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਧੁਿਰ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਾਥੁ ॥
lines.english: All sins are erased in an instant, for those who meditate on the Lord, through theGuru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: tin kay paap ik nimakh  sabh  laathay jin gur bachnee har jaapi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an tay jan jin har naam japi-aa t in daykhay ha-o bh a-i-aa sanaath. Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name. Seeingthem, I am uplifted.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਸਿਭ ਲਾਥੇ  ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਿਪਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, theCreator of all the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too jagjeevan jagd ees sabh  kartaa sarisat naath. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਆ  ਿਤਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ  ਸਨਾਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are theMaster of all.
lines.transliteration: too jal thal mahee-al bh arpoor sabh  oopar saach Dh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ  ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਨਾਥੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord in their conscious minds - all those who chant andmeditate on the Lord are liberated.
lines.transliteration: jin japi-aa har man cheet har jap jap mukat  ghanee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.english: Those mortal beings who meditate on the Lord are liberated; their faces are radiant inthe Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin japi-aa har tay mukat  paraan ee tin kay oojal mukh  har d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਚੀਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਘਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings are exalted in this world and the next; the Savior Lord saves them.
lines.transliteration: o-ay halat palat  jan bh a-ay suhaylay har raakh  lee-ay rakh anhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ਹਿਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖ ਹਿਰ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to the Lord's Name in the Society of the Saints, O humble Siblings of Destiny.The Gurmukh's service to the Lord is fruitful.
lines.transliteration: har santsangat  jan sun hu bh aa-ee gurmukh  har sayvaa safal ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਏ ਰਖਨਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are theMaster of all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too jal thal mahee-al bh arpoor sabh  oopar saach Dh anee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਜਨ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ  ਬਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces.
lines.transliteration: too thaan thanant ar har ayk har ayko ayk ravi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The forests and fields, the three worlds and the entire Universe, chant the Name ofthe Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan sabh  sarisat mukh  har har naam chavi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: All chant the Name of the Creator Lord, Har, Har; countless, uncountable beingsmeditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh chaveh har har naam kart ay asaNkh agnat har Dh i-aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਣ ਿਤਰ੍ਿਣ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਿਣ  ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed are those Saints and Holy People of the Lord, who are pleasing to theCreator Lord God.
lines.transliteration: so Dhan Dh an har sant  saaDh oo jo har parabh  kartay bh aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਚਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਅਗਣਤ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Creator, please bless me with the Fruitful Vision, the Darshan, of those who chantthe Lord's Name in their hearts forever.
lines.transliteration: so safal darsan d ayh kart ay jis har hird ai naam sad  chavi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਰਤੇ  ਭਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||
lines.transliteration: too thaan thanant ar har ayk har ayko ayk ravi-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਫਲੁ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਚਿਵਆ  ॥
lines.english: The treasures of devotional worship to You are countless; he alone is blessed with them, O my Lord and Master, whom You bless.
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat bhandaar asaNkh jis too dayveh mayray su-aamee t is mileh.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਹਿਰ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord's Glorious Virtues abide within the heart of that person, whose forehead theGuru has touched.
lines.transliteration: jis kai mastak gur haath t is hird ai har gun  tikeh.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Glorious Virtues of the Lord dwell in the heart of that person, whose inner being is filled with the Fear of God, and His Love. pMnw 1116
lines.transliteration: har gun hird ai tikeh t is kai jis ant ar bha-o bh aavnee ho-ee.

lines.english: Without the Fear of God, His Love is not obtained. Without the Fear of God, no one is carried across to the other side.
lines.transliteration: bin bhai kinai na paraym paa-i-aa bin bh ai paar na ut ri-aa ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਭੈ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭੈ ਪਾਿਰ  ਨ ਉਤਿਰਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with the Fear of God, and God's Love and Affection,whom You, Lord, bless with Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: bha-o bh aa-o pareet  naanak t iseh laagai jis t oo aapn ee kirpaa karahi.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The treasures of devotional worship to You are countless; he alone is blessed with Them, O my Lord and Master, whom You bless. ||4||3|| quKwrI mhlw 4 ] (1116-3) tukhaaree mehlaa 4. Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat bhandaar asaNkh jis too dayveh mayray su-aamee t is mileh. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਅਸੰਖ ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਮਲਿਹ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: To receive the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, is to truly bathe at the Abhaijit festival.
lines.transliteration: naavan purab abh eech gur sat gur daras bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: The filth of evil-mindedness is washed off, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: durmat  mail haree agi-aan anDh ayr ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਪੁਰਬੁ  ਅਭੀਚੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed by the Guru's Darshan, spiritual ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Lightilluminates the inner being.
lines.transliteration: gur daras paa-i-aa agi-aan gavaa-i-aa ant ar jot  pargaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of birth and death vanish in an instant, and the Eternal, Imperishable LordGod is found.
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh  khin meh binsay har paa-i-aa parabh  abhinaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord God Himself created the festival, when the True Guru went to batheat the festival in Kuruk-shaytra.
lines.transliteration: har aap kartai purab kee-aa sat guroo kulkh ayt naavan  ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: To receive the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, is to trulybathe at the Abhaijit festival. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naavan purab abh eech gur sat gur daras bh a-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਪੁਰਬੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੁਲਖੇਿਤ  ਨਾਵਿਣ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Sikhs travelled with the Guru, the True Guru, on the path, along the road.
lines.transliteration: maarag panth chalay gur satgur sang sikh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਪੁਰਬੁ  ਅਭੀਚੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, devotional worship services were held, each and every instant, with each step.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat banee kh in khin nimakh  vikhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪੰਿਥ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਸਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: Devotional worship services to the Lord God were held, and all the people came to seethe Guru.
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat  banee parabh  kayree sabh  lok vaykh an aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Whoever was blessed with the Darshan of the Guru, the True Guru, the Lord unitedwith Himself.
lines.transliteration: jin daras sat gur guroo kee-aa t in aap har maylaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਣੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਵੇਖਿਣ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru made the pilgrimage to the sacred shrines, for the sake of saving allthe people.
lines.transliteration: tirath ud am sat guroo kee-aa sabh  lok uDh ran arthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਦਰਸੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Sikhs travelled with the Guru, the True Guru, on the path, along the road. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maarag panth chalay gur satgur sang sikh aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਉਦਮੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੀਆ  ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਉਧਰਣ  ਅਰਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the Guru, the True Guru, first arrived at Kuruk-shaytra, it was a very auspicioustime.
lines.transliteration: paratham aa-ay kulkhayt  gur sat gur purab ho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪੰਿਥ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਸਖਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The news spread throughout the world, and the beings of the three worlds came.
lines.transliteration: khabar bh a-ee sansaar aa-ay t arai lo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਥਮ  ਆਏ  ਕੁਲਖੇਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਬੁ  ਹੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: The angelic beings and silent sages from all the three worlds came to see Him.
lines.transliteration: daykh an aa-ay t een lok sur nar mun jan sabh  aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਬਿਰ  ਭਈ ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਆਏ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਲੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are touched by the Guru, the True Guru - all their sins and mistakes were erased and dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jin parsi-aa gur satguroo pooraa t in kay kilvikh  naas gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਿਣ  ਆਏ  ਤੀਿਨ  ਲੋਕ ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸਿਭ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Yogis, the nudists, the Sannyaasees and those of the six schools of philosophyspoke with Him, and then bowed and departed.
lines.transliteration: jogee digambar sani-aasee kh at darsan kar ga-ay gosat dh o-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਪਰਿਸਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਪੂਰਾ ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the Guru, the True Guru, first arrived at Kuruk-shaytra, it was a very auspicioustime. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paratham aa-ay kulkhayt  gur sat gur purab ho-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੀ  ਿਦਗੰਬਰ  ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਿਰ ਗਏ ਗੋਸਿਟ  ਢੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: Second, the Guru went to the river Jamunaa, where He chanted the Name of theLord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa jamun ga-ay gur har har japan kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਥਮ  ਆਏ  ਕੁਲਖੇਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਬੁ  ਹੋਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The tax collectors met the Guru and gave Him offerings; they did not impose the taxon His followers.
lines.transliteration: jaagaatee milay d ay bh ayt gur pichh ai langh aa-ay d ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਜਮੁਨ  ਗਏ ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: All the True Guru's followers were excused from the tax; they meditated on the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sabh chh utee sat guroo pichh ai jin har har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਗਾਤੀ  ਿਮਲੇ ਦੇ ਭੇਟ ਗੁਰ ਿਪਛੈ ਲੰਘਾਇ  ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who have walked on the path,and followed the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: gur bachan maarag jo panth chaalay tin jam jaagaat ee nayrh  na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਪਛੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All the world said, "Guru! Guru! Guru!" Uttering the Guru's Name, they were all emancipated.
lines.transliteration: sabh guroo guroo jagat  bolai gur kai naa-ay la-i-ai sabh  chhutak ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਜੋ ਪੰਿਥ ਚਾਲੇ  ਿਤਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Second, the Guru went to the river Jamunaa, where He chanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa jamun ga-ay gur har har japan kee-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ  ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ  ਲਇਐ  ਸਿਭ ਛੁਟਿਕ  ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Third, He went to the Ganges, and a wonderful drama was played out there.
lines.transliteration: taritee-aa aa-ay sursaree t ah ka-ut ak chalat  bha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਜਮੁਨ  ਗਏ ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: All were fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saintly Guru's Darshan; notax at all was imposed upon anyone.
lines.transliteration: sabh mohee d aykh darsan gur sant  kinai aadh  na daam la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਤੀਆ  ਆਏ  ਸੁਰਸਰੀ  ਤਹ ਕਉਤਕੁ  ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: No tax at all was collected, and the mouths of the tax collectors were sealed.
lines.transliteration: aadh d aam kichh  pa-i-aa na bolak jaagaat ee-aa mohan  mund an pa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਿਕਨੈ ਆਢੁ  ਨ ਦਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They said, "O brothers, what should we do? Who should we ask? Everyone is running after the True Guru." pMnw 1117
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee ham karah ki-aa kis paas maaNgah sabh  bhaag sat gur pichh ai pa-ee.

lines.english: The tax collectors were smart; they thought about it, and saw. They broke their cash- boxes and left.
lines.transliteration: jaagaatee-aa upaav si-aan ap kar veechaar dith aa bh ann bolkaa sabh  uth ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਗਾਤੀਆ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਕਿਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਿਡਠਾ  ਭੰਿਨ ਬੋਲਕਾ  ਸਿਭ ਉਿਠ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Third, He went to the Ganges, and a wonderful drama was played out there. ||5||
lines.transliteration: taritee-aa aa-ay sursaree t ah ka-ut ak chalat  bha-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਤੀਆ  ਆਏ  ਸੁਰਸਰੀ  ਤਹ ਕਉਤਕੁ  ਚਲਤੁ  ਭਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The important men of the city met together, and sought the Protection of the Guru,the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: mil aa-ay nagar mahaa janaa gur satgur ot gahee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਆਏ  ਨਗਰ  ਮਹਾ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe. Go ahead and consult the Simritees - they will confirm this.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur gur govid  puchh  simrit  keetaa sahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਪੁਿਛ ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਸਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The Simritees and the Shaastras all confirm that Suk Dayv and Prahlaad meditated onthe Guru, the Lord of the Universe, and knew Him as the Supreme Lord.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) simrit saast ar sabh nee sahee keet aa suk par-hilaad  sareeraam kar gur govid  Dhi-aa-i- aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਸਭਨੀ  ਸਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ  ਸੁਿਕ ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਿਦ  ਸਰ੍ੀਰਾਿਮ  ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The five thieves and the highway robbers dwell in the fortress of the body-village; theGuru has destroyed their home and place.
lines.transliteration: dayhee nagar kot panch chor vatvaaray t in kaa thaa-o thayhu gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਿਰ  ਕੋਿਟ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਟਵਾਰੇ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਥੇਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Puraanas continually praise the giving of charity, but devotional worship of theLord is only obtained through the Word of Guru Nanak.
lines.transliteration: keertan puraan  nit punn hoveh gur bachan naanak har bh agat lahee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਰਤਨ  ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਿਨਤ  ਪੁੰਨ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਲਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The important men of the city met together, and sought the Protection of the Guru,the True Guru. ||6||4||10|| quKwrI CMq mhlw 5  (1117-7) tukhaaree chh ant mehlaa 5 Tukhaari Chhant, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1117-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mil aa-ay nagar mahaa janaa gur satgur ot gahee. ||6||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਆਏ  ਨਗਰ  ਮਹਾ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥੬॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, I am a sacrifice to You. Through the Guru, I have dedicated my mindto You.
lines.transliteration: ghol gh umaa-ee laalnaa gur man d eenaa.

lines.english: Hearing the Word of Your Shabad, my mind is enraptured.
lines.transliteration: sun sabad  tumaaraa mayraa man bh eenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘੋਿਲ  ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਲਾਲਨਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: This mind is enraptured, like the fish in the water; it is lovingly attached to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ih man bheenaa ji-o jal meenaa laagaa rang muraaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸਬਦੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Your Worth cannot be described, O my Lord and Master; Your Mansion is Incomparable and Unrivalled.
lines.transliteration: keemat kahee na jaa-ee th aakur t ayraa mahal apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Giver of all Virtue, O my Lord and Master, please hear the prayer of this humbleperson.
lines.transliteration: sagal gunaa kay d aatay su-aamee bin-o sunhu ik d eenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless Nanak with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I am a sacrifice, my soulis a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dayh d aras naanak balihaaree jee-arh aa bal bal keenaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਗੁਣਾ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਬਨਉ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: This body and mind are Yours; all virtues are Yours.
lines.transliteration: ih tan man t ayraa sabh  gun tayray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਕੀਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, every little bit, to Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: khannee-ai vanj aa darsan t ayray.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਭ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Please hear me, O my Lord God; I live only by seeing Your Vision, even if only for aninstant.
lines.transliteration: darsan t ayray sun  parabh  mayray nimakh  darisat paykh  jeevaa.

lines.english: I have heard that Your Name is the most Ambrosial Nectar; please bless me with YourMercy, that I may drink it in.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam suneejai t ayraa kirpaa karahi t a peevaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨ  ਤੇਰੇ ਸੁਿਣ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਨਮਖ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ ਪੇਿਖ ਜੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: My hopes and desires rest in You, O my Husband Lord; like the rainbird, I long for the rain-drop.
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aasee pir kai taa-ee ji-o chaat rik booNdayray.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ  ਤੇਰਾ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤ ਪੀਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my soul is a sacrifice to You; please bless me with Your Darshan, O myLord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jee-arhaa balihaaree d ayh d aras parabh  mayray. ||2||

lines.english: You are my True Lord and Master, O Infinite King.
lines.transliteration: too saachaa saahib saahu amit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are my Dear Beloved, so dear to my life and consciousness.
lines.transliteration: too pareet am pi-aaraa paraan hit  chitaa.

lines.english: You bring peace to my soul; You are known to the Gurmukh. All are blessed by YourLove.
lines.transliteration: paraan sukh-d aata gurmukh  jaataa sagal rang ban aa-ay.

lines.english: The mortal does only those deeds which You ordain, Lord.
lines.transliteration: so-ee karam kamaavai paraanee jayhaa t oo furmaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਰੰਗ ਬਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed by Your Grace, O Lord of the Universe, conquers his mind in theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o kirpaa karee jagdeesur t in saaDh sang man jit aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਮੁ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my soul is a sacrifice to You; You gave me my soul and body. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jee-arhaa balihaaree jee-o pind t a-o ditaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਿਰ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨੁ ਿਜਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am unworthy, but He has saved me, for the sake of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: nirgun raakh  lee-aa sant an kaa sad kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਤਉ ਿਦਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru has covered by faults; I am such a sinner.
lines.transliteration: satgur dh aak lee-aa mohi paapee parh -daa.

lines.english: God has covered for me; He is the Giver of the soul, life and peace.
lines.transliteration: dhaakanhaaray parabh oo hamaaray jee-a paraan sukh -daatay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਢਾਿਕ  ਲੀਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਪਾਪੀ  ਪੜਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is Eternal and Unchanging, Ever-present; He is the Perfect Creator, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee abigat  su-aamee pooran purakh  biDhaatay.

lines.punjabi: ਢਾਕਨਹਾਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Your Praise cannot be described; who can say where You are?
lines.transliteration: ustat kahan na jaa-ay t umaaree ka-un  kahai t oo kad  kaa.

lines.english: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the one who blesses him with the Lord's Name, even foran instant. ||4||1||11|| pMnw 1118 kydwrw mhlw 4 Gru 1 (1118-1) kaydaaraa mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 Kaydaaraa, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1118-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t aa kai balihaaree milai naam har nimkaa. ||4||1||11||

lines.english: O my mind, sing continually the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man raam naam nit gaavee-ai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਨਤ  ਗਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be seen; meeting with the Perfect Guru, He is seen. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar na jaa-ee har lakhi-aa gur pooraa milai lakh aavee-ai ray. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਲਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਮਲੈ ਲਖਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: That person, upon whom my Lord and Master showers His Mercy - the Lord attunesthat one to Himself.
lines.transliteration: jis aapay kirpaa karay mayraa su-aamee tis jan ka-o har liv laavee-ai ray.

lines.english: Everyone worships the Lord, but only that person who is pleasing to the Lord isaccepted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh ko bh agat karay har kayree har bh aavai so thaa-ay paavee-ai ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਆਪੇ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless. It rests with the Lord. If the Lord bestows it, then we meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: har har naam amolak har peh har dayvai t aa naam Dh i-aavee-ai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਗਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ  ਪਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: That person, whom my Lord and Master blesses with His Name - his entire account is forgiven. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis no naam day-ay mayraa su-aamee t is laykh aa sabh  chhadaavee-ai ray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who worship and adore the Lord's Name, are said to be blessed. Such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: har naam araaDheh say Dh an jan kahee-ahi t in mast ak bh aag Dh ur likh  paavee-ai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ  ਸਭੁ ਛਡਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Gazing upon them, my mind blossoms forth, like the mother who meets with her son and hugs him close. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin daykhay mayraa man bigsai ji-o sut  mil maat  gal laavee-ai ray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਹ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: I am a child, and You, O my Lord God, are my Father; please bless me with suchunderstanding, that I may find the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik har pitaa parabh  mayray mo ka-o d ayh mat ee jit har paavee-ai ray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਿਜਉ ਸੁਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਮਾਤ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Like the cow, which is happy upon seeing her calf, O Lord, please hug Nanak close in Your Embrace. ||4||1|| kydwrw mhlw 4 Gru 1  (1118-10) kaydaaraa mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 Kaydaaraa, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1118-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bachhuraa d aykh ga-oo sukh  maanai t i-o naanak har gal laavee-ai ray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਪਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har har gun kaho ray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਬਛੁਰਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਗਊ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਿਤਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਵੀਐ  ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Wash the Feet of the True Guru, and worship them. In this way, you shall find myLord God. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satguroo kay charan Dh o-ay Dh o-ay poojahu in biDh  mayraa har parabh  lahu ray. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, attachment, egotism and corrupt pleasures - stay awayfrom these. imil sqsMgiq kIjY hir gosit swDU isau gosit hir pRym rswiexu rwm nwmu rswiexu hir rwm nwm
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh abh imaan bikh ai ras in sangat  tay too rahu ray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and speak with the Holy People about the Lord. The Love of the Lord is the healing remedy; the Name of the Lord is the healingremedy. Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1|| pMnw 1119
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  keejai har gosat saaDh oo si-o gosat har paraym rasaa-in  raam naam rasaa-in har raam naam raam ramhu ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰ  ਕਾ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੂ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਨਤਾ  ਇਹੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ  ਗਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So you think that the egotistical pride in power which you harbor deep within is everything. Let it go, and restrain your self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: antar kaa abh imaan jor t oo kichh  kichh  kichh  jaant aa ih d oor karahu aapan gahu ray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਦਇਆਲ  ਹੋਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
lines.english: 4) jan naanak ka-o har da-i-aal hohu su-aamee har sant an kee Dh oor kar haray. ||2||1||2|| Please be kind to servant Nanak, O Lord, my Lord and Master; please make him thedust of the Feet of the Saints. ||2||1||2|| kydwrw mhlw 5 Gru 2  (1119-3) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1119-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
O mother, I have awakened in the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee satsang jaagee.

lines.english: Seeing the Love of my Beloved, I chant His Name, the greatest treasure||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pari-a rang daykh ai japt ee naam niDh aanee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. my eyes are focused on Him;
lines.transliteration: darsan pi-aas lochan t aar laagee.

lines.english: I have forgotten other thirsts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bisree ti-aas bidaanee. ||1||

lines.english: Now, I have found my Peace-giving Guru with ease; seeing His Darshan, my mind clings to Him.
lines.transliteration: ab gur paa-i-o hai sahj sukh-d aa-ik d arsan paykh at man laptaanee.

lines.english: Seeing my Lord, joy has welled up in my mind; O Nanak, the speech of my Beloved is so sweet! ||2||1|| kydwrw mhlw 5 Gru 3  (1119-7) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5 gh ar 3 Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1119-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: daykh  damod ar rahas man upji-o naanak pari-a amrit  baanee. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹੈ ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ  ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Please listen to the prayers of the humble, O Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: deen bin-o sun d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਦਮੋਦਰ  ਰਹਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: The five thieves and the three dispositions torment my mind.
lines.transliteration: panch daas t een d okhee ayk man anaath naath.

lines.english: O Merciful Lord, Master of the masterless, please save me from them. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raakh ho kirpaal. rahaa-o.

lines.english: I make all sorts of efforts and go on pilgrimages;
lines.transliteration: anik jatan gavan kara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਦਾਸ ਤੀਿਨ  ਦੋਖੀ ਏਕ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ  ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.english: I perform the six rituals, and meditate in the right way.
lines.transliteration: khat karam jugat  Dhi-aan Dh ara-o.

lines.english: I am so tired of making all these efforts, but the horrible demons still do not leave me.||1||
lines.transliteration: upaav sagal kar haari-o nah nah huteh bikraal. ||1||

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, and bow to You, O Compassionate Lord.
lines.transliteration: saran band an karun aa pat ay.

lines.english: You are the Destroyer of fear, O Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: bhav haran  har har har haray.

lines.english: You alone are Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: ayk toohee d een d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਾਵ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਿਰ ਹਾਿਰਓ  ਨਹ ਨਹ ਹੁਟਿਹ ਿਬਕਰਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak takes the Support of God's Feet.
lines.transliteration: parabh charan naanak aasro.

lines.english: I have been rescued from the ocean of doubt,
lines.transliteration: uDhray bh aram moh saagar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਵ ਹਰਣ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1119-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: lag santnaa pag paal. ||2||1||2|| holding tight to the feet and the robes of the Saints. ||2||1||2|| kydwrw mhlw 5 Gru 4  (1119-13) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5 gh ar 4

lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Supreme Treasure.
lines.transliteration: sarnee aa-i-o naath niDhaan.

lines.english: Love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is enshrined within my mind; I beg for the gift of Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam pareet laagee man bh eetar maagan ka-o har d aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Pefect Transcendent Lord, Giver of Peace, please grant Your Grace and save myhonor.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aa-ee pooran parmaysur kar kirpaa raakh o maan.

lines.english: Please bless me with such love, O my Lord and Master, that in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, I may chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with my tongue.||1||
lines.transliteration: dayh pareet  saaDh oo sang su-aamee har gun rasan bakh aan. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord of the World, Merciful Lord of the Universe, Your sermon and spiritual wisdomare immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: gopaal da-i-aal gobid  damod ar nirmal kathaa gi-aan.

lines.english: Please attune Nanak to Your Love, O Lord, and focus his meditation on Your LotusFeet. ||2||1||3|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1119-17) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o har kai rang raagahu charan kamal sang Dhi-aan. ||2||1||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਮਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਮਾਗਨ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: har kay darsan ko man chaa-o.

lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, and unite me with the Society of the Saints; please bless me with Your Name. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa satsang milaavhu t um dayvhu apno naa-o. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
lines.english: I serve my True Beloved Lord. Wherever I hear His Praise, there my mind is in ecstasy. pMnw 1120
lines.transliteration: kara-o sayvaa sat purakh  pi-aaray jat  sunee-ai t at man rahsaa-o.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever devoted to You. Your place is incomparably beautiful! ||1||
lines.transliteration: vaaree fayree sadaa gh umaa-ee kavan anoop t ayro th aa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰੀ  ਫੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਈ  ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਠਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You cherish and nurture all; You take care of all, and Your shade covers all.
lines.transliteration: sarab paratpaalahi sagal samaaleh sagli-aa t ayree chh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਿਹ  ਸਗਲ  ਸਮਾਲਿਹ  ਸਗਿਲਆ  ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Primal Creator, the God of Nanak; I behold You in each and every heart.||2||2||4|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1120-3) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay parabh purakh  biDhaatay gh at ghat tujheh dikhaa-o. ||2||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਤੁਝਿਹ ਿਦਖਾਉ  ॥੨॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: I love the Love of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: pari-a kee pareet pi-aaree.

lines.english: My mind is intoxicated with delight, and my consciousness is filled with hope; my eyesare drenched with Your Love. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: magan manai meh chitva-o aasaa nainhu t aar tuhaaree. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Blessed is that day, that hour, minute and second when the heavy, rigid shutters are opened, and desire is quenched.
lines.transliteration: o-ay din pahar moorat  pal kaisay o-ay pal gh aree kihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਗਨ  ਮਨੈ ਮਿਹ ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਆਸਾ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਤਾਰ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khoolay kapat Dh apat bujh  tarisnaa jeeva-o paykh  darsaaree. ||1||

lines.english: What is the method, what is the effort, and what is the service, which inspires me tocontemplate You?
lines.transliteration: ka-un so jatan upaa-o kinayhaa sayvaa ka-un beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਿਦਨ ਪਹਰ  ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਕੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਪਲ ਘਰੀ  ਿਕਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Abandon your egotistical pride and attachment; O Nanak, you shall be saved in theSociety of the Saints. ||2||3||5|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1120-6) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan moh t aj naanak sant eh sang uDh aaree. ||2||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਖੂਲੇ ਕਪਟ ਧਪਟ  ਬੁਿਝ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਜੀਵਉ  ਪੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har har har gun gaavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ  ਿਕਨੇਹਾ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Have Mercy on me, O Life of the World, O Lord of the Universe, that I may chant YourName. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa gopaal gobiday apnaa naam japaavhu. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਜ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤਹ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: Please lift me up, God, out of vice and corruption, and attach my mind to the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kaadh lee-ay parabh  aan bikh ai tay saaDh sang man laavhu.

lines.english: Doubt, fear and attachment are eradicated from that person who follows the Guru's Teachings, and gazes on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh a-o moh kati-o gur bachnee apnaa d aras d ikhaavhu. ||1||

lines.english: Let my mind become the dust of all; may I abandon my egotistical intellect.
lines.transliteration: sabh kee rayn ho-ay man mayraa ahaN-buDh  tajaavahu.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬਦੇ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with Your devotional worship, O Merciful Lord; by great good fortune,O Nanak, I have found the Lord. ||2||4||6|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1120-10) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apnee bhagat  deh da-i-aalaa vadbh aagee naanak har paavhu. ||2||4||6||

lines.english: Without the Lord, life is useless.
lines.transliteration: har bin janam akaarath jaat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਨ  ਿਬਖੈ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who forsake the Lord, and become engrossed in other pleasures - false anduseless are the clothes they wear, and the food they eat. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taj gopaal aan rang raachat  mithi-aa pahirat  khaat. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਿਟਓ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਦਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan joban sampai sukh  bhogvai sang na nibhat  maat . The pleasures of wealth, youth, property and comforts will not stay with you, Omother.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਤਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Seeing the mirage, the madman is entangled in it; he is imbued with pleasures thatpass away, like the shade of a tree. ||1||
lines.transliteration: marig tarisnaa d aykh rachi-o baavar d arum chh aa-i-aa rang raat . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਦੇਿਹ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Totally intoxicated with the wine of pride and attachment, he has fallen into the pit of sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: maan moh mahaa mad mohat  kaam kroDh  kai kh aat.

lines.english: O Dear God, please be the Help and Support of servant Nanak; please take me by thehand, and uplift me. ||2||5||7|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1120-13) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar geh layho daas naanak ka-o parabh  jee-o ho-ay sahaat . ||2||5||7||

lines.english: Nothing goes along with the mortal, except for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bin ko-ay na chaalas saath.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਆਨ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਚਤ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਪਿਹਰਤ  ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.english: He is the Master of the meek, the Lord of Mercy, my Lord and Master, the Master ofthe masterless. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath karun aapat  su-aamee anaathaa kay naath. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Children, possessions and the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures do not go along withthe mortal on the path of Death.
lines.transliteration: sut sampat  bikhi-aa ras bh ogvat  nah nibhat  jam kai paath.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਗਵੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਿਨਬਹਤ  ਮਾਤ ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord of theUniverse, the mortal is carried across the deep ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan gaa-o gun gobind  uDhar saagar kay kh aat. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਦੇਿਖ ਰਿਚਓ  ਬਾਵਰ  ਦਰ੍ੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Indescribable, Unfathomable Lord, meditate inremembrance on Him, and your pains shall vanish.
lines.transliteration: saran samrath akath agochar har simrat d ukh laath.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਮੋਹਤ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਕੈ ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.english: Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant; he shall obtain it only if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead. ||2||6||8|| kydwrw mhlw 5 Gru 5  (1120-18) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5 gh ar 5 Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1120-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak deen Dh oor jan baaNchhat milai likh at Dhur maath. ||2||6||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਤ  ॥੨॥੫॥੭॥
lines.english: I do not forget the Lord in my mind.
lines.transliteration: bisrat naahi man t ay haree.

lines.english: This love has now become very strong; it has burnt away other corruption. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ab ih pareet mahaa parabal bh a-ee aan bikh ai jaree. rahaa-o.

lines.english: How can the rainbird forsake the rain-drop? The fish cannot survive without water, even for an instant. pMnw 1121
lines.transliteration: boond kahaa t i-aag chaat rik meen rahat  na gh aree.

lines.english: My tongue chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World; this has become partof my very nature. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal uchaar rasnaa tayv ayh paree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਉਚਾਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਟੇਵ ਏਹ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The deer is fascinated by the sound of the bell, and so it is shot with the sharp arrow.
lines.transliteration: mahaa naad kurank mohi-o bayDh  teekhan saree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕ  ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਬੇਿਧ ਤੀਖਨ  ਸਰੀ ॥
lines.english: God's Lotus Feet are the Source of Nectar; O Nanak, I am tied to them by a knot. ||2||1||9|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1121-3) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh charan kamal rasaal naanak gaath  baaDh  Dharee. ||2||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਰਸਾਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗਾਿਠ  ਬਾਿਧ  ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੯॥
lines.english: My Beloved dwells in the cave of my heart.
lines.transliteration: pareetam basat  rid meh kh or.

lines.english: Shatter the wall of doubt, O my Lord and Master; please grab hold of me, and lift meup towards Yourself. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh eet nivaar th aakur geh layho apnee or. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The world-ocean is so vast and deep; please be kind, lift me up and place me on theshore.
lines.transliteration: aDhik garat  sansaar saagar kar d a-i-aa chaarahu Dh or.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮ  ਭੀਿਤ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਗਿਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ  ਓਰ ॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord's Feet are the boat to carry us across. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsang har charan bohith uDh ratay lai mor. ||1||

lines.english: The One who placed you in the womb of your mother's belly - no one else shall saveyou in the wilderness of corruption.
lines.transliteration: garabh kunt meh jineh Dh aari-o nahee bikh ai ban meh hor.

lines.english: The power of the Lord's Sanctuary is all-powerful; Nanak does not rely on any other.||2||2||10|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1121-6) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har sakat saran samrath naanak aan nahee nihor. ||2||2||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਧਕ  ਗਰਤ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਚਾਰਹੁ ਧੋਰ ॥
lines.english: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam raam bakhaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਬੋਿਹਥ  ਉਧਰਤੇ ਲੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, your sins shall be eradicated. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal uchaar din rain bh a-ay kalmal haan. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਕੁੰਟ ਮਿਹ ਿਜਨਿਹ  ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਨਹੀ ਿਬਖੈ ਬਨ ਮਿਹ ਹੋਰ ॥
lines.english: You shall have to leave behind all your riches when you depart. Death is hanging overyour head - know this well!
lines.transliteration: ti-aag chalnaa sagal sampat  kaal sir par jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਕਤ  ਸਰਨ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ  ਨਹੀ ਿਨਹੋਰ  ॥੨॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Transitory attachments and evil hopes are false. Surely you must believe this! ||1||
lines.transliteration: mithan moh durant  aasaa jh ooth sarpar maan. ||1||

lines.english: Within your heart, focus your meditation on  the True Primal Being, Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form.
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  akaal moorat  ridai Dhaarahu Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Only this profitable merchandise, the treasure of the Naam, O Nanak, shall beaccepted. ||2||3||11|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1121-9) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan laabh  naanak basat  ih parvaan. ||2||3||11||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗਪਾਲ  ਉਚਾਰੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਭਏ ਕਲਮਲ  ਹਾਨ ॥
lines.english: I take only the Support of the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam ko aaDhaar.

lines.english: Suffering and conflict do not afflict me; I deal only with the Society of the Saints.||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kal kalays na kachh bi-aapai sat sang bi-uhaar. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਚਲਨਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਪਤ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਸਰ ਪਿਰ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Showering His Mercy on me, the Lord Himself has saved me, and no evil thoughts arise within me.
lines.transliteration: kar anoograhu aap raakhi-o nah upajt a-o baykaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਥਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਰੰਤ  ਆਸਾ  ਝੂਠੁ ਸਰਪਰ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever receives this Grace, contemplates Him in meditation; he is not burned by thefire of the world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis paraapat ho-ay simrai t is dahat nah sansaar. ||1||

lines.english: Peace, joy and bliss come from the Lord, Har, Har. God's Feet are sublime andexcellent.
lines.transliteration: sukh mangal aanand  har har parabh  charan amrit  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਇਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is the dust of the feet of Your Saints.||2||4||12|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1121-12) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sarnaagat ee tayray sant naa kee chh aar. ||2||4||12||

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, one's ears are cursed.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam bin Dharig sarot .

lines.english: Those who forget the Embodiment of Life - what is the point of their lives? ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jeevan roop bisaar jeeveh tih kat  jeevan hot . rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who eats and drinks countless delicacies is no more than a donkey, a beast ofburden.
lines.transliteration: khaat  peet anayk binjan jaisay bh aar baahak kh ot.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, he endures terrible suffering, like the bull, chained to the oil-press. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar mahaa saram paa-i-aa jaisay birakh  jantee jot . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਆਿਪ  ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਨਹ ਉਪਜਤਉ ਬੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Forsaking the Life of the World, and attached to another, they weep and wail in somany ways.
lines.transliteration: taj gopaal je aan laagay say baho parkaaree rot .

lines.english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this gift; O Lord, please keep mestrung around Your Neck. ||2||5||13|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1121-16) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar jor naanak daan maagai har rakh a-o kanth  parot . ||2||5||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਮੰਗਲ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਚਰਨ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I take the dust of the feet of the Saints and apply it to my face.
lines.transliteration: santeh Dh oor lay mukh  malee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ  ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨਾ  ਕੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Hearing of the Imperishable, Eternally Perfec t Lord, pain does not afflict me, even in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gunaa achut  sadaa pooran nah d okh bi-aapahi kalee. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, all affairs are resolved, and the mind is not tossed abouthere and there.
lines.transliteration: gur bachan kaaraj sarab pooran eet oot  na halee.

lines.english: Whoever sees the One God to be pervading in all the many beings, does not burn inthe fire of corruption. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh ayk anik sarbat  pooran bikh ai agan na jalee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਰੂਪ ਿਬਸਾਿਰ  ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਿਤਹ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ  ਹੋਤ ॥
lines.english: The Lord grasps His slave by the arm, and his light merges into the Light.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa leeno d aas apno jot  jotee ralee.

lines.english: Nanak, the orphan, has come seeking the Sanctuary of God's Feet; O Lord, he walks with You. ||2||6||14|| kydwrw mhlw 5 ] (1121-19) kaydaaraa mehlaa 5. Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 1122
lines.transliteration: parabh charan saran anaath aa-i-o naanak har sang chalee. ||2||6||14||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਰੁਚੈ ॥
lines.english: My mind is filled with yearning for the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kee man ruchai.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਸਿਤ  ਅਨੰਦ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਜਲਤ  ਛਾਤੀ  ਬੁਝੈ ॥
lines.english: I am totally filled with tranquility and bliss; the burning desire within has beenquenched. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot saaNt anand pooran jalat  chhaatee bujh ai. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Walking on the path of the Saints, millions of mortal sinners have been saved.
lines.transliteration: sant maarag chalat  paraanee pat it uDhray muchai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਲਤ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਰੇ  ਮੁਚੈ ॥
lines.english: One who applies the dust of the feet of the humble to his forehead, is purified, as ifhe has bathed at countless sacred shrines. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rayn jan kee lagee mastak anik t irath suchai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਗੀ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਸੁਚੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating on His Lotus Feet deep within, one realizes the Lord and Master in eachand every heart.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal Dhi-aan bh eetar ghat ghateh su-aamee sujh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਧਆਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਟਿਹ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਝੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Divine, Infinite Lord, Nanak shall never again be tortured by the Messenger of Death. ||2||7||15|| kydwrw CMq mhlw 5  (1122-4) kaydaaraa chh ant mehlaa 5 Kaydaaraa Chhant, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1122-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saran dayv apaar naanak bahur jam nahee lujh ai. ||2||7||15||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਦੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੁਝੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Please meet me, O my Dear Beloved. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil mayray pareetam pi-aari-aa. rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is All-pervading amongst all, the Architect of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-aa sarbatar mai so purakh  biDhaataa.

lines.english: The Lord God has created His Path, which is known in the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: maarag parabh kaa har kee-aa sant an sang jaat aa.

lines.english: The Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is known in the Society of the Saints; Youare seen in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: santan sang jaat aa purakh  biDhaataa gh at ghat nad ar nihaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who comes to His Sanctuary, finds absolute peace; not even a bit of his workgoes unnoticed.
lines.transliteration: jo sarnee aavai sarab sukh paavai t il nahee bh annai gh aali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue, is easily,naturally intoxicated with the supreme, sublime essence of divine love.
lines.transliteration: har gun niDh  gaa-ay sahj subh aa-ay paraym mahaa ras maat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; You are the Perfect Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ee t oo pooran purakh  biDhaataa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਵੈ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਭੰਨੈ ਘਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant is pierced through with loving devotion to Him; where elsecan he go?
lines.transliteration: har paraym bhagat  jan bayDh i-aa say aan kat  jaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਗਾਏ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁਭਾਏ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The fish cannot endure separation, and without water, it will die.
lines.transliteration: meen bichhohaa naa sahai jal bin mar paahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਤੂ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, how can I survive? How can I endure the pain? I am like therainbird, thirsty for the rain-drop.
lines.transliteration: har bin ki-o rahee-ai dookh  kin sahee-ai chaat rik boond  pi-aasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਜਨ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਸੇ ਆਨ  ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: "When will the night pass?," asks the chakvi bird. "I shall find peace only when therays of the sun shine on me."
lines.transliteration: kab rain bihaavai chakvee sukh paavai sooraj kiran  pargaasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਨੁ ਿਬਛੋਹਾ  ਨਾ ਸਹੈ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਿਰ ਪਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord. Blessed are the nights anddays, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
lines.transliteration: har daras man laagaa d inas sabh aagaa an-d in har gun  gaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਉ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਦੂਖ ਿਕਿਨ  ਸਹੀਐ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਿਪਆਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak utters this prayer; without the Lord, how can the breath of life continueto flow through me? ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak daas kahai baynant ee kat  har bin paraan  tikaahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬ ਰੈਿਨ ਿਬਹਾਵੈ  ਚਕਵੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੂਰਜ  ਿਕਰਿਣ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without the breath, how can the body obtain glory and fame?
lines.transliteration: saas binaa ji-o dayhuree kat  sobh aa paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਿਸ  ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਸਭਾਗਾ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, the humble, holy person does not find peace, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: daras bihoonaa saaDh  jan kh in tikan  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਕਤ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਿਟਕਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are without the Lord suffer in hell; my mind is pierced through with theLord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: har bin jo rahnaa narak so sahn aa charan kamal man bayDh i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord is both sensual and unattached; lovingly attune yourself to the Naam, theName of the Lord. No one can ever deny Him.
lines.transliteration: har rasik bairaagee naam liv laagee katahu na jaa-ay nikh ayDhi-aa.

lines.english: Go and meet with the Lord, and dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;no one can contain that peace within his being.
lines.transliteration: har si-o jaa-ay milnaa saaDh sang rahn aa so sukh  ank na maavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਜੋ ਰਹਣਾ  ਨਰਕੁ  ਸੋ ਸਹਣਾ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please be kind to me, O Lord and Master of Nanak, that I may merge in You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal naanak kay su-aamee har charnah sang samaavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸਕ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਿਨਖੇਿਧਆ  ॥
lines.english: Searching and searching, I have met with my Lord God, who has showered me withHis Mercy.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat parabh  milay har karun aa Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲਣਾ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹਣਾ  ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਿਕ  ਨ ਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: I am unworthy, a lowly orphan, but He does not even consider my faults.
lines.transliteration: nirgun neech anaath mai nahee d okh beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨਹ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He does not consider my faults; He has blessed me with Perfect Peace. It is said thatit is His Way to purify us.
lines.transliteration: nahee dokh  beechaaray pooran sukh  saaray paavan birad  bakh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Hearing that He is the Love of His devotees, I have grasped the hem of His robe. He is totally permeating each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al sun anchlo gahi-aa gh at ghat poor samaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਣੁ  ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ  ਮੈ ਨਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, with intuitive ease; the pains of birth anddeath are gone.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagro paa-i-aa sahj subh aa-i-aa janam maran d ukh haaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਵਨ  ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਬਖਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Taking him by the hand, the Lord has saved Nanak, His slave; He has woven thegarland of His Name into his heart. ||4||1|| pMnw 1123 rwgu kydwrw bwxI kbIr jIau kI  (1123-1) raag kaydaaraa ban ee kabeer jee-o kee Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1123-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay naanak daas apnay raam naam ur haaray. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Those who ignore both praise and slander, who reject egotistical pride and conceit,
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa do-oo bibarjit  tajahu maan abh imaanaa.
lohaa kanchan sam kar jaaneh tay moorat  bhagvaanaa. ||1|| who look alike upon iron and gold - they are the very image of the Lord God. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨਿਹ  ਤੇ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hardly anyone is a humble servant of Yours, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayraa jan ayk aaDh  ko-ee.

lines.english: Ignoring sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, such a person becomes aware of the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh bibarjit  har pad  cheenHai so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਬਬਰਿਜਤ  ਹਿਰ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Raajas, the quality of energy and activity; Taamas, the quality of darkness and inertia;and Satvas, the quality of purity and light, are all called the creations of Maya, Yourillusion.
lines.transliteration: raj gun t am gun  sat gun kahee-ai ih t ayree sabh  maa-i-aa.

lines.english: That man who realizes the fourth state - he alone obtains the supreme state. ||2||
lines.transliteration: cha-uthay pad ka-o jo nar cheenHai tinH hee param pad  paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਜ ਗੁਣ ਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਤ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ  ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Amidst pilgrimages, fasting, rituals, purification and self-discipline, he remains alwayswithout thought of reward.
lines.transliteration: tirath barat  naym such sanjam sad aa rahai nihkaamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੇ  ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਿਤਨ  ਹੀ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Thirst and desire for Maya and doubt depart, remembering the Lord, the SupremeSoul. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa ar maa-i-aa bh aram chookaa chit vat aatam raamaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਬਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਸੁਿਚ ਸੰਜਮ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਿਨਹਕਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: When the temple is illuminated by the lamp, its darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jih mandar d eepak pargaasi-aa anDh kaar t ah naasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ  ਿਚਤਵਤ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Fearless Lord is All-pervading. Doubt has run away, says Kabeer, the Lord'shumble slave. ||4||1||
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o poor rahay bh aram bh aagaa kahi kabeer jan d aasaa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some deal in bronze and copper, some in cloves and betel nuts.
lines.transliteration: kinhee banji-aa kaaNsee taaNbaa kinhee la-ug supaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saints deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. Such is my merchandise as well. ||1||
lines.transliteration: santahu banji-aa naam gobid  kaa aisee kh ayp hamaaree. ||1||

lines.english: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kay bi-aapaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਬਨਿਜਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਕਾ ਐਸੀ  ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The priceless diamond has come into my hands. I have left the world behind.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: heeraa haath charhi-aa nirmolak chh oot ga-ee sansaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When the True Lord attached me, then I was attached to Truth. I am a trader of theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachay laa-ay ta-o sach laagay saachay kay bi-uhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰਾ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਚਿੜਆ  ਿਨਰਮੋਲਕੁ  ਛੂਿਟ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have loaded the commodity of Truth; It has reached the Lord, the Treasurer. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachee basat kay bh aar chalaa-ay pahuchay jaa-ay bh andaaree. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is the pearl, the jewel, the ruby; He Himself is the jeweller.
lines.transliteration: aapeh ratan javaahar maanik aapai hai paasaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਏ  ਤਉ ਸਚ ਲਾਗੇ  ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself spreads out in the ten directions. The Merchant is Eternal and Unchanging.||3||
lines.transliteration: aapai dah d is aap chalaavai nihchal hai bi-aapaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਚਲਾਏ  ਪਹੁਚੇ ਜਾਇ  ਭੰਡਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind is the bull, and meditation is the road; I have filled my packs with spiritualwisdom, and loaded them on the bull.
lines.transliteration: man kar bail surat kar paidaa gi-aan gon bh ar daaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਿਹ  ਰਤਨ  ਜਵਾਹਰ  ਮਾਿਨਕ ਆਪੈ  ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: my merchandise has reached its destination! ||4||2||
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu ray sant ahu nibhee kh ayp hamaaree. ||4||2||

lines.english: You barbaric brute, with your primitive intellect - reverse your breath and turn it inward.
lines.transliteration: ree kalvaar gavaar moodh mat  ulto pavan firaava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਬੈਲੁ ਸੁਰਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਪੈਡਾ ਿਗਆਨ  ਗੋਿਨ  ਭਿਰ ਡਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Let your mind be intoxicated with the stre am of Ambrosial Nectar which trickles down from the furnace of the Tenth Gate. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man matvaar mayr sar bh aathee amrit  Dhaar chu-aava-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਿਨਬਹੀ  ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, call on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bolhu bha-ee-aa raam kee d uhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੀ ਕਲਵਾਿਰ  ਗਵਾਿਰ  ਮੂਢ ਮਿਤ ਉਲਟੋ  ਪਵਨੁ ਿਫਰਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Saints, drink in this wine forever; it is so difficult to obtain, and it quenches yourthirst so easily. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: peevhu sant sad aa mat  durlabh  sehjay pi-aas bujh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰ  ਮੇਰ ਸਰ ਭਾਠੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God, is the Love of God. Only those few who understand His Loveobtain the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: bhai bich bh aa-o bh aa-ay ko-oo boojh eh har ras paavai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: As many hearts as there are - in all of them, is His Ambrosial Nectar; as He pleases,He causes them to drink it in. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaytay gh at amrit  sabh  hee meh bh aavai t iseh pee-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਤ ਦੁਰਲਭ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: There are nine gates to the one city of the body; restrain your mind from escapingthrough them.
lines.transliteration: nagree aykai na-o darvaajay Dh aavat  baraj rahaa-ee.

lines.english: When the knot of the three qualities is untied, then the Tenth Gate opens up, and themind is intoxicated, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tarikutee chh ootai d asvaa d ar khoolHai taa man kh eevaa bh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਿਚ  ਭਾਉ ਭਾਇ  ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When the mortal fully realizes the state of fearless dignity, then his sufferings vanish; so says Kabeer after careful deliberation.
lines.transliteration: abhai pad  poor t aap tah naasay kahi kabeer beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਪੀਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Turning away from the world, I have obtained this wine, and I am intoxicated with it.||4||3||
lines.transliteration: ubat chalantay ih mad  paa-i-aa jaisay kh oNd khumaaree. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਗਰੀ  ਏਕੈ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ  ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਬਰਿਜ  ਰਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You are engrossed with unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger; you do notknow the State of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh t arisnaa kay leenay gat  nahee aykai jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਕੁਟੀ  ਛੂਟੈ ਦਸਵਾ  ਦਰੁ ਖੂਲੈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ  ਭਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your eyes are blinded, and you see nothing at all. You drown and die without water. ||1|| pMnw 1124
lines.transliteration: footee aakhai kachh oo na soojh ai bood moo-ay bin paanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਿਡ ਮੂਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Why do you walk in that crooked, zig-zag way?
lines.transliteration: chalat kat  taydh ay taydh ay taydh ay.

lines.english: You are nothing more than a bundle of bones, wrapped in skin, filled with manure; you give off such a rotten smell! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: asat charam bistaa kay moond ay durganDh  hee kay baydh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਤ  ਚਰਮ  ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਕੇ ਮੂੰਦੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ  ਹੀ ਕੇ ਬੇਢੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You do not meditate on the Lord. What doubts have confused and deluded you?Death is not far away from you!
lines.transliteration: raam na japahu kavan bharam bh oolay t um tay kaal na d ooray.

lines.english: Making all sorts of efforts, you manage to preserve this body, but it shall only survive until its time is up. ||2||
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar ih t an raakh o rahai avasthaa pooray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: By one's own efforts, nothing is done. What can the mere mortal accomplish?
lines.transliteration: aapan kee-aa kachhoo na hovai ki-aa ko karai paraanee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਸਥਾ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: When it pleases the Lord, the mortal meets the True Guru, and chants the Name ofthe One Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bh aavai sat gur bh aytai ayko naam bakh aanee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: You live in a house of sand, but you still puff up your body - you ignorant fool!
lines.transliteration: baloo-aa kay gharoo-aa meh bast ay fulvat  dayh a-i-aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, those who do not remember the Lord may be very clever, but they stilldrown. ||4||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer jih raam na chayti-o booday bahut  si-aanay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬਲੂਆ  ਕੇ ਘਰੂਆ  ਮਿਹ ਬਸਤੇ ਫੁਲਵਤ  ਦੇਹ ਅਇਆਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: Your turban is crooked, and you walk crooked; and now you have started chewingbetel leaves.
lines.transliteration: taydhee paag taydh ay chalay laagay beeray kh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਜਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਬੂਡੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਸਆਨੇ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: You have no use at all for loving devotional worship; you say you have business incourt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh agat si-o kaaj na kachh oo-ai mayro kaam d eevaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਟੇਢੀ ਪਾਗ  ਟੇਢੇ ਚਲੇ ਲਾਗੇ  ਬੀਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥
lines.english: In your egotistical pride, you have forgotten the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam bisaari-o hai abhimaan.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਸਉ ਕਾਜੁ  ਨ ਕਛੂਐ  ਮੇਰੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਦੀਵਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon your gold, and your very beautiful wife, you believe that they are permanent. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kanik kaamnee mahaa sundree paykh  paykh  sach maan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are engrossed in greed, falsehood, corruption and great arrogance. Your life ispassing away.
lines.transliteration: laalach jhooth  bikaar mahaa mad  ih biDh  a-oDh  bihaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਨਕ  ਕਾਮਨੀ  ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪੇਿਖ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, at the very last moment, death will come and seize you, you fool!||2||5||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ant kee bayr aa-ay laago kaal nid aan. ||2||5||

lines.english: The mortal beats the drum for a few days, and then he must depart.
lines.transliteration: chaar din apnee na-ubat  chalay bajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲਚ  ਝੂਠ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਅਉਧ  ਿਬਹਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: With so much wealth and cash and buried treasure, still, he cannot take anything withhim. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: itnak kh atee-aa gath ee-aa matee-aa sang na kachh  lai jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਰ ਆਇ ਲਾਗੋ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਨਦਾਿਨ  ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: Sitting on the threshhold, his wife weeps and wails; his mother accompanies him tothe outer gate.
lines.transliteration: dihree baith ee mihree rovai d u-aarai la-o sang maa-ay.

lines.english: All the people and relatives together go to the crematorium, but the swan-soul must go home all alone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: marhat lag sabh log kutamb mil hans ikaylaa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤਨਕੁ  ਖਟੀਆ ਗਠੀਆ  ਮਟੀਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕਛੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those children, that wealth, that city and town - he shall not come to see them again.
