lines.transliteration: vai sut vai bit  vai pur paatan bahur na d aykhai aa-ay.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, why do you not meditate on the Lord? Your life is uselessly slipping away! ||2||6|| rwgu kydwrw bwxI rivdws jIau kI  (1124-13) raag kaydaaraa ban ee ravid aas jee-o kee Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1124-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer raam kee na simrahu janam akaarath jaa-ay. ||2||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਹਰੀ  ਬੈਠੀ ਿਮਹਰੀ  ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਲਉ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who performs the six religious rituals and comes from a good family, but whodoes not have devotion to the Lord in his heart,
lines.transliteration: khat karam kul sanjugat  hai har bh agat hirdai naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਹਟ  ਲਿਗ  ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charnaarbind na kathaa bh aavai supach t ul samaan. ||1|| one who does not appreciate talk of the Lord's Lotus Feet, is just like an outcaste, apariah. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵੈ ਸੁਤ ਵੈ ਿਬਤ ਵੈ ਪੁਰ ਪਾਟਨ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Be conscious, be conscious, be conscious, O my unconscious mind.
lines.transliteration: ray chit chayt  chayt  achayt .

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਕਾਰਥੁ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: Why do you not look at Baalmeek?
lines.transliteration: kaahay na baalmeekahi daykh .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: From such a low social status, what a high status he obtained! Devotional worship tothe Lord is sublime! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kis jaat t ay kih pad eh amri-o raam bh agat bisaykh . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕੁਲ ਸੰਜੁਗਤੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The killer of dogs, the lowest of all, was lovingly embraced by Krishna.
lines.transliteration: su-aan satar ajaat  sabh  tay krisan laavai hayt .

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨਾਰਿਬੰਦ  ਨ ਕਥਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਪਚ  ਤੁਿਲ  ਸਮਾਿਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: See how the poor people praise him! His praise extends throughout the three worlds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: log bapuraa ki-aa saraahai teen lok parvays. ||2||

lines.english: Ajaamal, Pingulaa, Lodhia and the elephant went to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ajaamal pingulaa lubhat  kunchar ga-ay har kai paas.

lines.english: Even such evil-minded beings were emancipated. Why should you not also be saved,O Ravi Daas? ||3||1|| pMnw 1125 rwgu BYrau mhlw 1 Gru 1 caupdy (1125-1) raag bhairo mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 cha-upd ay Raag Bhairao, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1125-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: aisay durmat  nistaray t oo ki-o na t areh ravid aas. ||3||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Without You, nothing happens.
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar kichh oo na ho-ay.

lines.english: You create the creatures, and gazing on them, you know them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too kar kar d aykheh jaan eh so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can I say? I cannot say anything.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kahee-ai kichh kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever exists, is by Your Will. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh ahai sabh  tayree rajaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whatever is to be done, rests with You.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karn aa so t ayrai paas.

lines.english: Unto whom should I offer my prayer? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kis aagai keechai ardaas. ||2||

lines.english: I speak and hear the Bani of Your Word.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  sunn aa tayree ban ee.

lines.english: You Yourself know all Your Wondrous Play. ||3||
lines.transliteration: too aapay jaan eh sarab vidaan ee. ||3||

lines.english: You Yourself act, and inspire all to act; only You Yourself know.
lines.transliteration: karay karaa-ay jaanai aap.

lines.english: Says Nanak, You, Lord, see, establish and disestablish. ||4||1|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (1125-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu BYrau mhlw 1 Gru 2 ] (1125-9) raag bhairo mehlaa 1 gh ar 2. Raag Bhairao, First Mehl, Second House:
lines.transliteration: naanak daykh ai thaap uthaap. ||4||1||

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, so many silent sages have been saved; Indra and Brahma have also been saved.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad t aray mun kayt ay ind raadik barahmaad  taray.

lines.english: Sanak, Sanandan and many humble men of austerity, by Guru's Grace, have beencarried across to the other side. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sanak sanandan t apsee jan kayt ay gur parsaadee paar paray. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?
lines.transliteration: bhavjal bin sabd ai ki-o t aree-ai.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is entangled in the disease ofduality, and is drowned, drowned, and dies. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa jag rog bi-aapi-aa dubiDh aa dub dub maree-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਤਰੇ ਮੁਿਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾਿਦਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦ  ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is Divine; the Guru is Inscrutable and Mysterious. Serving the Guru, the three worlds are known and understood.
lines.transliteration: gur dayvaa gur alakh  abhayvaa t aribhavan sojhee gur kee sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਨਕ  ਸਨੰਦਨ ਤਪਸੀ  ਜਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru, the Giver, has Himself given me the Gift; I have obtained the Inscrutable,Mysterious Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay daat  karee gur d aatai paa-i-aa alakh  abhayvaa. ||2||

lines.english: The mind is the king; the mind is appeased and satisfied through the mind itself, anddesire is stilled in the mind.
lines.transliteration: man raajaa man man tay maani-aa mansaa maneh samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਜਗੁ ਰੋਿਗ ਿਬਆਿਪਆ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਡੁਿਬ ਡੁਿਬ ਮਰੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mind is the Yogi, the mind wastes away in separation from the Lord; singing theGlorious Praises of the Lord, the mind is instructed and reformed. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man jogee man binas bi-ogee man samjhai gun  gaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: How very rare are those in this world who, through the Guru, subdue their minds, and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur tay man maari-aa sabad  veechaari-aa t ay virlay sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is All-pervading; through the True Word of the Shabad,we are emancipated. ||4||1||2|| BYrau mhlw 1 ] (1125-15) bhairo mehlaa 1. Bhairao, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib bharipur leen aa saach sabad  nistaaraa. ||4||1||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੀ ਗੁਿਰ ਦਾਤੈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The eyes lose their sight, and the body withers away; old age overtakes the mortal,and death hangs over his head.
lines.transliteration: nainee darisat nahee t an heenaa jar jeet i-aa sir kaalo.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Beauty, loving attachment and the pleasures of life are not permanent. How cananyone escape from the noose of death? ||1||
lines.transliteration: roop rang rahas nahee saachaa ki-o chhodai jam jaalo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਿਬਓਗੀ  ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O mortal, meditate on the Lord - your life is passing away! pMnw 1126
lines.transliteration: paraanee har jap janam ga-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ  ਿਬਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਭਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the True Word of the Shabad, you shall never be released, and your life shall be totally useless. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saach sabad bin kabahu na chh ootas birthaa janam bh a-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Within the body are sexual desire, anger, egotism and attachment. This pain is sogreat, and so difficult to endure.
lines.transliteration: tan meh kaam kroDh  ha-o mamt aa kath in peer at  bhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਿਠਨ  ਪੀਰ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, chant the Lord's Name, and savor it with your tongue; in this way, you shall cross over to the other side. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam japahu ras rasnaa in biDh  tar too taaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your ears are deaf, and your intellect is worthless, and still, you do not intuitivelyunderstand the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bahray karan akal bha-ee hochh ee sabad  sahj nahee boojh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹਰੇ  ਕਰਨ ਅਕਿਲ  ਭਈ ਹੋਛੀ ਸਬਦ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਨਹੀ ਬੂਿਝਆ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wastes this priceless human life and loses it. Without the Guru, the blind person cannot see. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath manmukh  haari-aa bin gur anDh  na soojh i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਹਾਿਰਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਿਝਆ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whoever remains detached and free of desire in the midst of desire - and whoever,unattached, intuitively meditates on the Celestial Lord
lines.transliteration: rahai udaas aas niraasaa sahj Dh i-aan bairaagee.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 1 ] (1126-5) bhairo mehlaa 1. Bhairao, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak gurmukh  chhootas raam naam liv laagee. ||4||2||3|| - prays Nanak, as Gurmukh, he is released. He is lovingly attuned to the Naam, theName of the Lord. ||4||||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: His walk becomes weak and clumsy, his feet and hands shake, and the skin of hisbody is withered and wrinkled.
lines.transliteration: bhooNdee chaal charan  kar kh isray t uchaa d ayh kumlaanee.

lines.english: His eyes are dim, his ears are deaf, and yet, the self-willed manmukh does not knowthe Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naytree Dh unDh  karan bh a-ay bahray manmukh  naam na jaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭੂੰਡੀ ਚਾਲ  ਚਰਣ  ਕਰ ਿਖਸਰੇ  ਤੁਚਾ  ਦੇਹ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: O blind man, what have you obtained by coming into the world?
lines.transliteration: anDhulay ki-aa paa-i-aa jag aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨੇਤਰ੍ੀ ਧੁੰਿਧ ਕਰਨ  ਭਏ ਬਹਰੇ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is not in your heart, and you do not serve the Guru. After wasting your capital, you shall have to depart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam ridai nahee gur kee sayvaa chaalay mool gavaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your tongue is not imbued with the Love of the Lord; whatever you say is tastelessand insipid.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa rang nahee har raatee jab bolai t ab feekay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਲੇ  ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You indulge in slander of the Saints; becoming a beast, you shall never be noble. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee nind aa vi-aapas pasoo bh a-ay kad ay hohi na neekay. ||2||

lines.english: Only a few obtain the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Amrit, united in Union withthe True Guru.
lines.transliteration: amrit kaa ras virlee paa-i-aa sat gur mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਰੰਿਗ ਨਹੀ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਤੀ  ਜਬ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਬ ਫੀਕੇ ॥
lines.english: As long as the mortal does not come to understand the mystery of the Shabad, theWord of God, he shall continue to be tormented by death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jab lag sabad bh ayd nahee aa-i-aa t ab lag kaal sant aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਿਵਆਪਿਸ  ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਿਹ ਨ ਨੀਕੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whoever finds the door of the One True Lord, does not know any other house ordoor.
lines.transliteration: an ko dar gh ar kabhoo na jaanas ayko d ar sachi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਿਵਰਲੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; so says poor Nanak. ||4||3||4|| BYrau mhlw 1 ] (1126-11) bhairo mehlaa 1. Bhairao, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-i-aa naanak kahai vichaaraa. ||4||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦ  ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ  ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ  ਸੰਤਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He spends the entire night in sleep; the noose is tied around his neck. His day is wasted in worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: saglee rain sovat  gal faahee d inas janjaal gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਸ  ਏਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਸਿਚਆਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He does not know God, who created this world, for a moment, for even an instant.||1||
lines.transliteration: khin pal gh arhee nahee parabh  jaani-aa jin ih jagat  upaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹੈ ਿਵਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: O mortal, how will you escape this terrible disaster?
lines.transliteration: man ray ki-o chhootas d ukh bhaaree.

lines.english: What did you bring with you, and what will you take away? Meditate on the Lord, theMost Worthy and Generous Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa lay aavas ki-aa lay jaavas raam japahu gunkaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੀ  ਰੈਿਣ ਸੋਵਤ  ਗਿਲ  ਫਾਹੀ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਜੰਜਾਿਲ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus of the self-willed manmukh is upside-down; his intellect is shallow; hismind is blind, and his head is entangled in worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: ooNDha-o kaval manmukh  mat hochh ee man anDh ai sir Dh anDhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ  ਨਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Death and re-birth constantly hang over your head; without the Name, your neck shallbe caught in the noose. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal sadaa sir t ayrai bin naavai gal fanDh aa. ||2||

lines.english: Your steps are unsteady, and your eyes are blind; you are not aware of the Word ofthe Shabad, O Sibling of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: dagree chaal naytar fun anDh ulay sabad  surat  nahee bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਲੇ ਆਵਿਸ ਿਕਆ  ਲੇ ਜਾਵਿਸ  ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Shaastras and the Vedas keep the mortal bound to the three modes of Maya, andso he performs his deeds blindly. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saastar bayd  tarai gun  hai maa-i-aa anDh ula-o Dh anDh kamaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: He loses his capital - how can he earn any profit? The evil-minded person has no spiritual wisdom at all.
lines.transliteration: kho-i-o mool laabh  kah paavas d urmat  gi-aan vihoon ay.

lines.punjabi: ਊਂਧਉ  ਕਵਲੁ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮਿਤ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਿਨ ਅੰਧੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਧੰਧਾ ॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Shabad, he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; O Nanak, hisfaith is confirmed in the Truth. ||4||4||5|| BYrau mhlw 1 ] (1126-17) bhairo mehlaa 1. Bhairao, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabad beechaar raam ras chaakh i-aa naanak saach pat eenay. ||4||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਬਕਾਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਿਸਿਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗਿਲ  ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He remains with the Guru, day and night, and his tongue savors the savory taste ofthe Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sang rahai din raat ee raam rasan rang raat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਡਗਰੀ  ਚਾਲ  ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਫੁਿਨ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸਬਦ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He does not know any other; he realizes the Word of the Shabad. He knows andrealizes the Lord deep within his own being. ||1||
lines.transliteration: avar na jaanas sabad  pachh aanas ant ar jaan  pachh aataa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਬੇਦ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਅੰਧੁਲਉ  ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Such a humble person is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: so jan aisaa mai man bhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਇਓ  ਮੂਲੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹ ਪਾਵਿਸ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਵਹੂਣੇ ॥
lines.english: He conquers his self-conceit, and is imbued with the Infinite Lord. He serves the Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap maar aprampar raataa gur kee kaar kamaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਪਤੀਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Deep within my being, and outside as well, is the Immaculate Lord God. I bow humblybefore that Primal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar purakh  niranjan aad  purakh  aadayso.

lines.english: Deep within each and every heart, and amidst all, the Embodiment of Truth is permeating and pervading. ||2|| pMnw 1127
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar sarab nirant ar rav rahi-aa sach vayso. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸੋ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with Truth - their tongues are tinged with Truth; they do not have even an iota of the filth of falsehood.
lines.transliteration: saach ratay sach amrit  jihvaa mithi-aa mail na raa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They taste the sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of theLord; imbued with the Shabad, they are blessed with honor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam amrit ras chaakh i-aa sabad  ratay pat  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The virtuous meet with the virtuous, and earn the profit; as Gurmukh, they obtain theglorious greatness of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gunee gun ee mil laahaa paavas gurmukh  naam vadaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣੀ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵਿਸ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: All sorrows are erased, by serving the Guru; O Nanak, the Naam is our only Friendand Companion. ||4||5||6|| BYrau mhlw 1 ] (1127-3) bhairo mehlaa 1. Bhairao, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saglay dookh  miteh gur sayvaa naanak naam sakh aa-ee. ||4||5||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the wealth and support of all; It is enshrined inthe heart, by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam sarab Dh an Dh aaran  gur parsaadee paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: One who gathers this imperishable wealth is fulfilled, and through intuitive meditation, is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amar padaarath t ay kirt aarath sahj Dh i-aan liv laa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ  ਧਨੁ ਧਾਰਣੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, focus your consciousness on devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man ray raam bhagat  chit laa-ee-ai.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord in your heart, and you shall return toyour home with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam jap hird ai sahj sayt ee gh ar jaa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Doubt, separation and fear are never eradicated, and the mortal continues comingand going in reincarnation, as long as he does not know the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh ayd bha-o kabahu na chh ootas aavat  jaat na jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated; they drown and die without water.||2||
lines.transliteration: bin har naam ko mukat na paavas doob mu-ay bin paanee. ||2||

lines.english: DhanDh aa karat  saglee pat  khovas bh aram na mitas gavaaraa. Busy with his worldly affairs, all honor is lost; the ignorant one is not rid of his doubts.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮੁ  ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਨ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is never liberated; he remainsblindly entangled in the expanse of worldly affairs. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad mukat  nahee kab hee anDh ulay Dh anDh pasaaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਸ  ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My mind is pleased and appeased with the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry.Through the mind itself, the mind is subdued.
lines.transliteration: akul niranjan si-o man maani-aa man hee tay man moo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ  ਸਗਲੀ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਵਿਸ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਿਮਟਿਸ ਗਵਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Deep within my being, and outside as well, I know only the One Lord. O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||4||6||7|| BYrau mhlw 1 ] (1127-10) bhairo mehlaa 1. Bhairao, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ayko jaani-aa naanak avar na d oo-aa. ||4||6||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You may give feasts, make burnt offerings, donate to charity, perform austerepenance and worship, and endure pain and suffering in the body.
lines.transliteration: jagan hom punn tap poojaa d ayh d ukhee nit  dookh sahai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕੁਲ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
lines.english: But without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained. As Gurmukh, obtain the Naamand liberation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na paavas mukat  naam gurmukh  lahai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ  ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, birth into the world is useless.
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin birthay jag janmaa.

lines.english: Without the Name, the mortal eats poison and speaks poisonous words; he diesfruitlessly, and wanders in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bikh kh aavai bikh  bolee bolai bin naavai nihfal mar bh armanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਨ  ਹੋਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖੀ ਿਨਤ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The mortal may read scriptures, study grammar and say his prayers three times aday.
lines.transliteration: pustak paath  bi-aakaran  vakh aanai sanDh i-aa karam t ikaal karai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਸ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, where is liberation, O mortal? Without theLord's Name, the mortal is entangled and dies. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin gur sabad mukat  kahaa paraan ee raam naam bin urajh  marai. ||2||

lines.english: Walking sticks, begging bowls, hair tufts, sacred threads, loin cloths, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and wandering all around
lines.transliteration: dand kamandal sikhaa soot  Dhotee tirath gavan at  bharman karai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਬੋਲੀ  ਬੋਲੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਨਹਫਲੁ  ਮਿਰ ਭਰ੍ਮਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin saaNt na aavai jap har har naam so paar parai. ||3|| - without the Lord's Name, peace and tranquility are not obtained. One who chantsthe Name of the Lord, Har, Har, crosses over to the other side. ||3||

lines.english: The mortal's hair may be matted and tangled upon his head, and he may smear hisbody with ashes; he may take off his clothes and go naked.
lines.transliteration: jataa mukat tan bh asam lagaa-ee bast ar chh od tan nagan bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਸਤਕ  ਪਾਠ ਿਬਆਕਰਣ  ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਸੰਿਧਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਤਕਾਲ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: But without the Lord's Name, he is not satisfied; he wears religious robes, but he isbound by the karma of the actions he committed in past lives. ||4||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin taripat  na aavai kirat  kai baaNDhai bhaykh bha-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਹਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਉਰਿਝ  ਮਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: As many beings and creatures as there are in the water, on the land and in the sky -wherever they are, You are with them all, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a jant  jal thal mahee-al jat ar kat ar too sarab jee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਡੰਡ ਕਮੰਡਲ  ਿਸਖਾ  ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਗਵਨੁ ਅਿਤ  ਭਰ੍ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, please preserve Your humble servant; O Lord, Nanak stirs up thisjuice, and drinks it in. ||5||7||8|| rwgu BYrau mhlw 3 caupdy Gru 1  (1127-18) raag bhairo mehlaa 3 cha-upd ay gh ar 1 Raag Bhairao, Third Mehl, Chaupadas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1127-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad raakh  lay jan ka-o har ras naanak jh ol pee-aa. ||5||7||8||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: No one should be proud of his social class and status.
lines.transliteration: jaat kaa garab na karee-ahu ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਟਾ ਮੁਕਟੁ ਤਿਨ  ਭਸਮ  ਲਗਾਈ  ਬਸਤਰ੍  ਛੋਿਡ ਤਿਨ  ਨਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: barahm binday so baraahman  ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਕਰਤ ਕੈ ਬਧੈ ਭੇਖੁ ਭਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Do not be proud of your social class and status, you ignorant fool! pMnw 1128
lines.transliteration: jaat kaa garab na kar moorakh  gavaaraa.

lines.english: So much sin and corruption comes from this pride. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: is garab tay chaleh bahut  vikaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Everyone says that there are four castes, four social classes.
lines.transliteration: chaaray varan aakhai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.english: They all emanate from the drop of God's Seed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: barahm bind t ay sabh  opat ho-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The entire universe is made of the same clay.
lines.transliteration: maatee ayk sagal sansaaraa.

lines.english: The Potter has shaped it into all sorts of vessels. ||3||
lines.transliteration: baho biDh bh aaNday gh arhai kumHaaraa. ||3||

lines.english: The five elements join together, to make up the form of the human body.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  mil d ayhee kaa aakaaraa.

lines.english: Who can say which is less, and which is more? ||4||
lines.transliteration: ghat vaDh  ko karai beechaaraa. ||4||

lines.english: Says Nanak, this soul is bound by its actions.
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak ih jee-o karam banDh  ho-ee.

lines.english: Without meeting the True Guru, it is not liberated. ||5||1|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1128-4) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay mukat  na ho-ee. ||5||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਕਰਮ  ਬੰਧੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Yogis, the householders, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the beggars in religious robes
lines.transliteration: jogee garihee pandit bh aykh-Dhaaree.
ay sootay apn ai ahaNkaaree. ||1|| - they are all asleep in egotism. ||1||

lines.english: They are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mad maat aa rahi-aa so-ay.

lines.english: Only those who remain awake and aware are not robbed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaagat rahai na moosai ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who has met the True Guru, remains awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: so jaagai jis satgur milai.

lines.english: Such a person overpowers the five thieves. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch doot  oh vasgat  karai. ||2||

lines.english: One who contemplates the essence of reality remains awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: so jaagai jo tat  beechaarai.

lines.english: He kills his self-conceit, and does not kill anyone else. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aap marai avraa nah maarai. ||3||

lines.english: One who knows the One Lord remains awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: so jaagai jo ayko jaanai.

lines.english: He abandons the service of others, and realizes the essence of reality. ||4||
lines.transliteration: parkirat chh odai t at pachh aanai. ||4||

lines.english: Of the four castes, whoever remains awake and aware
lines.transliteration: chahu varnaa vich jaagai ko-ay.
jamai kaalai tay chh ootai so-ay. ||5|| is released from birth and death. ||5||

lines.english: Says Nanak, that humble being remains awake and aware,
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak jan jaagai so-ay.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1128-9) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan jaa kee naytree ho-ay. ||6||2|| who applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes. ||6||2||

lines.english: Whoever the Lord keeps in His Sanctuary,
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o raakhai apn ee sarn aa-ee.
saachay laagai saachaa fal paa-ee. ||1|| is attached to the Truth, and receives the fruit of Truth. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, unto whom will you complain?
lines.transliteration: ray jan kai si-o karahu pukaaraa.

lines.english: The Hukam of the Lord's Command is pervasive; by the Hukam of His Command, allthings happen. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hukmay ho-aa hukmay vartaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This Creation was established by You.
lines.transliteration: ayhu aakaar tayraa hai Dh aaraa.

lines.english: In an instant You destroy it, and You create it again without a moment's delay. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khin meh binsai karat  na laagai baaraa. ||2||

lines.english: By His Grace, He has staged this Play.
lines.transliteration: kar parsaad ik kh ayl dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: By the Guru's Merciful Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay param pad  paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, He alone kills and revives.
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak maar jeevaalay so-ay.

lines.english: Understand this well - do not be confused by doubt. ||4||3|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1128-12) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aisaa boojhhu bh aram na bh oolahu ko-ay. ||4||3||

lines.english: I am the bride; the Creator is my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: mai kaaman mayraa kant  kartaar.

lines.english: As He inspires me, I adorn myself. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jayhaa karaa-ay tayhaa karee seegaar. ||1||

lines.english: When it pleases Him, He enjoys me.
lines.transliteration: jaaN tis bh aavai t aaN karay bh og.

lines.english: I am joined, body and mind, to my True Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan man saachay saahib jog. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: How can anyone praise or slander anyone else?
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa karay ki-aa ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਬੂਝਹੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: The One Lord Himself is pervading and permeating all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaaN aapay vartai ayko so-ee. ||2||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I am attracted by His Love.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee piram kasaa-ee.

lines.english: I shall meet with my Merciful Lord, and vibrate the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mila-ugee da-i-aal panch sabad  vajaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Prays Nanak, what can anyone do?
lines.transliteration: bhanat  naanak karay ki-aa ko-ay.

lines.english: He alone meets with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself meets. ||4||4|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1128-16) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis no aap milaavai so-ay. ||4||4||

lines.english: He alone is a silent sage, who subdues his mind's duality.
lines.transliteration: so mun je man kee dubiDh aa maaray.

lines.english: Subduing his duality, he contemplates God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa maar barahm beechaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Let each person examine his own mind, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o ko-ee khojahu bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Examine your mind, and you shall obtain the nine treasures of the Naam. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man khojat  naam na-o niDh  paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Creator created the world, upon the foundation of worldly love and attachment.
lines.transliteration: mool moh kar kartai jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Attaching it to possessiveness, He has led it into confusion with doubt. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mamtaa laa-ay bh aram bh olaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: From this Mind come all bodies, and the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: is man tay sabh  pind paraan aa.

lines.english: By mental contemplation, the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merges in Him. ||3|| pMnw 1129
lines.transliteration: man kai veechaar hukam bujh samaan aa. ||3||

lines.english: When the mortal has good karma, the Guru grants His Grace.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai gur kirpaa karai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ  ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਰੈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Then this mind is awakened, and the duality of this mind is subdued. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ih man jaagai is man kee dubiDh aa marai. ||4||

lines.english: It is the innate nature of the mind to remain forever detached.
lines.transliteration: man kaa subhaa-o sad aa bairaagee.

lines.english: The Detached, Dispassionate Lord dwells within all. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabh meh vasai at eet anraagee. ||5||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one who understands this mystery,
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak jo jaan ai bhay-o.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1129-3) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  niranjan d ay-o. ||6||5|| becomes the embodiment of the Primal, Immaculate, Divine Lord God. ||6||5||

lines.english: The world is saved through Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam naam jagat nist aaraa.

lines.english: It carries the mortal across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhavjal paar ut aaran haaraa. ||1||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, dwell upon the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har naam samHaal.

lines.english: It shall stand by you forever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sad hee nibhai t ayrai naal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The foolish self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam na cheeteh manmukh  gaavaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Name, how will they cross over? ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai kaisay paavahi paaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord, the Great Giver, Himself gives His Gifts.
lines.transliteration: aapay daat  karay d aataar.

lines.english: Celebrate and praise the Great Giver! ||3||
lines.transliteration: dayvan haaray ka-o jaikaar. ||3||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord unites the mortals with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay sat guroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam is enshrined within the heart. ||4||6|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1129-6) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hirdai naam vasaa-ay. ||4||6||

lines.english: All people are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naamay uDhray sabh  jitnay lo-a.

lines.english: Those who become Gurmukh are blessed to receive It. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinaa paraapat  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: When the Dear Lord showers His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: har jee-o apnee kirpaa karay-i.

lines.english: He blesses the Gurmukh with the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam vadi-aa-ee d ay-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who love the Beloved Name of the Lord
lines.transliteration: raam naam jin pareet pi-aar.
aap uDhray sabh  kul uDh aaran haar. ||2|| save themselves, and save all their ancestors. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Name, the self-willed manmukhs go to the City of Death.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai manmukh jam pur jaahi.

lines.english: They suffer in pain and endure beatings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: a-ukhay hoveh chotaa kh aahi. ||3||

lines.english: When the Creator Himself gives,
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa d ayvai so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, then the mortals receive the Naam. ||4||7|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1129-10) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam paraapat ho-ay. ||4||7||

lines.english: Love of the Lord of the Universe saved Sanak and his brother, the sons of Brahma.
lines.transliteration: govind pareet  sankaad ik uDh aaray.

lines.english: They contemplated the Word of the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam sabad beechaaray. ||1||

lines.english: O Dear Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy,
lines.transliteration: har jee-o apnee kirpaa Dh aar.
gurmukh naamay lagai pi-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o. that as Gurmukh, I may embrace love for Your Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Whoever has true loving devotional worship deep within his being
lines.transliteration: antar pareet  bhagat saachee ho-ay.
poorai gur maylaavaa ho-ay. ||2|| meets the Lord, through the Perfect Guru. ||2||

lines.english: He naturally, intuitively dwells within the home of his own inner being.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vasai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The Naam abides within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam vasai man aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord, the Seer, Himself sees.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai vaykh anhaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart. ||4||8|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1129-14) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rakhahu ur Dh aar. ||4||8||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.
lines.transliteration: kaljug meh raam naam ur Dhaar.

lines.english: Without the Name, ashes will be blown in your face. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai maathai paavai chhaar. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: raam naam dulabh  hai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad vasai man aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That humble being who seeks the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: raam naam jan bhaaleh so-ay.
pooray gur tay paraapat  ho-ay. ||2|| receives it from the Perfect Guru. ||2||

lines.english: Those humble beings who accept the Will of the Lord, are approved and accepted.
lines.transliteration: har kaa bhaan aa maneh say jan parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਜੁਗ  ਮਿਹ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they bear the insignia of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad naam neesaan . ||3||

lines.english: So serve the One, whose power supports the Universe.
lines.transliteration: so sayvhu jo kal rahi-aa Dhaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh loves the Naam. ||4||9|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1129-17) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam pi-aar. ||4||9||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, many rituals are performed.
lines.transliteration: kaljug meh baho karam kamaahi.

lines.english: But it is not the time for them, and so they are of no use. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa rut na karam thaa-ay paahi. ||1||

lines.english: In Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.
lines.transliteration: kaljug meh raam naam hai saar.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, be lovingly attached to Truth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachaa lagai pi-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਨਿਹ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Searching my body and mind, I found Him within the home of my own heart.
lines.transliteration: tan man kh oj gharai meh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||2|| pMnw 1130
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam chit  laa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is obtained from the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan satgur t ay ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is pervading the three worlds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam rav rahi-aa tihu lo-ay. ||3||

lines.english: In Kali Yuga, it is the time for the One Dear Lord; it is not the time for anything else.
lines.transliteration: kalijug meh har jee-o ayk hor rut na kaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਏਕੁ ਹੋਰ ਰੁਿਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, let the Lord's Name grow within your heart. ||4||10|| BYrau mhlw 3 Gru 2 (1130-3) bhairo mehlaa 3 gh ar 2 Bhairao, Third Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1130-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh hird ai raam naam layho jamaa-ee. ||4||10||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with the disease of duality; they are burnt by the intense fire of desire.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa manmukh  rog vi-aapay t arisnaa jaleh aDh ikaa-ee.

lines.english: They die and die again, and are reborn; they find no place of rest. They waste their lives uselessly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh tha-ur na paavahi birthaa janam gavaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O my Beloved, grant Your Grace, and give me understanding.
lines.transliteration: mayray pareetam kar kirpaa d ayh bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The world was created in the disease of egotism; without the Word of the Shabad, thedisease is not cured. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rogee jagat upaa-i-aa bin sabd ai rog na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There are so many silent sages, who read the Simritees and the Shaastras; withoutthe Shabad, they have no clear awareness.
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar parh eh mun kayt ay bin sabd ai surat  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All those under the influence of the three qualities are afflicted with the disease;through possessiveness, they lose their awareness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  sabh ay rog vi-aapay mamt aa surat  gavaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: O God, you save some, and you enjoin others to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ik aapay kaadh la-ay parabh  aapay gur sayvaa parabh  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਪੜਿਹ  ਮੁਿਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਸੁਰਿਤ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They obtain the treasure of the Name of the Lord; peace comes to abide within theirminds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam niDhaano paa-i-aa sukh  vasi-aa man aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਿਗ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs dwell in the fourth state; they obtain a dwelling in the home of theirown inner being.
lines.transliteration: cha-uthee padvee gurmukh  varteh tin nij gh ar vaasaa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਲਏ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect True Guru shows His Mercy to them; they eradicate their self-conceit from within. ||4||
lines.transliteration: poorai satgur kirpaa keenee vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੋ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Everyone must serve the One Lord, who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
lines.transliteration: aykas kee sir kaar ayk jin barahmaa bisan rudar upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੀ  ਪਦਵੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਵਰਤਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One True Lord is permanent and stable. He does not die, and He is notborn. ||5||1||11|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1130-11) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nihchal saachaa ayko naa oh marai na jaa-i-aa. ||5||1||11||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is afflicted with the disease of duality forever; the entireuniverse is diseased.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d ubiDh aa sad aa hai rogee rogee sagal sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਕੀ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਾਰ ਏਕ ਿਜਿਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਰੁਦਰ੍ੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh understands, and is cured of the disease, contemplating the Word ofthe Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh eh rog gavaaveh gur sabd ee veechaaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਏਕੋ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, please let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o satsangat  maylaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord blesses with glorious greatness, those who focus theirconsciousness on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naanak tis no d ay-ay vadi-aa-ee jo raam naam chit  laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Death takes all those who are afflicted with the disease of possessiveness. They are subject to the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: mamtaa kaal sabh  rog vi-aapay t in jam kee hai sir kaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach that mortal who, as Gurmukh,enshrines the Lord within his heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paraan ee jam nayrh  na aavai jin har raakh i-aa ur Dh aaraa. ||2||

lines.english: One who does not know the Lord's Name, and who does not become Gurmukh - whydid he even come into the world?
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam na gurmukh jaat aa say jag meh kaahay aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He never serves the Guru; he wastes his life uselessly. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa kaday na keenee birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, those whom the True Guru enjoins to His service, have perfect goodfortune.
lines.transliteration: naanak say pooray vadbhaagee sat gur sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਮਤਾ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਸਿਭ ਰੋਿਗ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਿਤਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: They obtain the fruits of their desires, and find peace in the Word of the Guru's Bani.||4||2||12|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1130-17) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo ichheh so-ee fal paavahi gurbaan ee sukh  paa-ay. ||4||2||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In pain he is born, in pain he dies, and in pain he does his deeds.
lines.transliteration: dukh vich jammai d ukh marai d ukh vich kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ  ਸੇ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is never released from the womb of reincarnation; he rots away in manure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garabh jonee vich kad ay na niklai bistaa maahi samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dharig Dh arig manmukh  janam gavaa-i-aa. Cursed, cursed is the self-willed manmukh, who wastes his life away.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: He does not serve the Perfect Guru; he does not love the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee sayv na keenee har kaa naam na bhaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad cures all diseases; he alone is attached to it, whom the Dear Lord attaches. pMnw 1131
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad sabh  rog gavaa-ay jis no har jee-o laa-ay.

lines.english: Through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; he alone obtains it, whose mind isfilled with the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naamay naam milai vadi-aa-ee jis no man vasaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the fruitful rewards are obtained. This true lifestyle beingssublime peace.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai t aa fal paa-ay sach karn ee sukh  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who are attached to the Lord are immaculate; they enshrinelove for the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say jan nirmal jo har laagay har naamay Dhareh pi-aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਗੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰਿਹ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: If I obtain the dust of their feet, I apply it to my forehead. They meditate on thePerfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: tin kee rayn  milai t aaN mast ak laa-ee jin sat gur pooraa Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਿਕ ਲਾਈ  ਿਜਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||4||3||13|| O Nanak, this dust is obtained only by perfect destiny. They focus their consciousnesson the Lord's Name. ||4||3||13|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1131-4) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kee rayn  poorai bh aag paa-ee-ai jinee raam naam chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥
lines.english: That humble being who contemplates the Word of the Shabad is true; the True Lord iswithin his heart.
lines.transliteration: sabad beechaaray so jan saachaa jin kai hird ai saachaa so-ee.

lines.english: If someone performs true devotional worship day and night, then his body will not feelpain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saachee bhagat  karahi d in raat ee taaN tan dookh na ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Everyone calls him, "Devotee, devotee."
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhagat kahai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਤ ਤਿਨ  ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: But without serving the True Guru, devotional worship is not obtained. Only throughperfect destiny does one meet God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sayvay bh agat na paa-ee-ai poorai bh aag milai parabh  so-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs lose their capital, and still, they demand profits. How canthey earn any profit?
lines.transliteration: manmukh mool gavaaveh laabh  maageh laahaa laabh  kidoo ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਿਮਲੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death is always hovering above their heads. In the love of duality,they lose their honor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal sadaa hai sir oopar d oojai bh aa-ay pat  kho-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Trying on all sorts of religious robes, they wander around day and night, but the disease of their egotism is not cured.
lines.transliteration: bahlay bhaykh  bhaveh d in raat ee ha-umai rog na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਿਹ  ਲਾਭੁ ਮਾਗਿਹ ਲਾਹਾ  ਲਾਭੁ ਿਕਦੂ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Reading and studying, they argue and debate; attached to Maya, they lose theirawareness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parh parh  loojh eh baad  vakaan eh mil maa-i-aa surat  gavaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਿਸਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with the supreme status; through theNaam, they are blessed with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh param gat  paavahi naam milai vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹਲੇ  ਭੇਖ ਭਵਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Naam, are honored in the Court of theTrue Lord. ||4||4||14|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1131-10) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam jinaa man vasi-aa dar saachai pat  paa-ee. ||4||4||14||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਲੂਝਿਹ  ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh cannot escape false hope. In the love of duality, he isruined.
lines.transliteration: manmukh aasaa nahee ut rai doojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: His belly is like a river - it is never filled up. He is consumed by the fire of desire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: udar nai saan  na bh aree-ai kabhoo t arisnaa agan pachaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਜਨਾ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੪॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Eternally blissful are those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand raam ras raat ay.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, fills their hearts, and duality runs away from their minds. Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam d ubiDh aa man bh aagee har har amrit  pee t ariptaatay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਆਸਾ  ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God Himself created the Universe; He links each and every personto their tasks.
lines.transliteration: aapay paarbarahm sarisat jin saajee sir sir DhanDh ai laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਰੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੁ  ਨ ਭਰੀਐ  ਕਬਹੂ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਪਚਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself created love and attachment to Maya; He Himself attaches the mortals toduality. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh kee-aa jin aapay aapay doojai laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: If there were any other, then I would speak to him; all will be merged in You.
lines.transliteration: tis no kihu kahee-ai jay d oojaa hovai sabh  tuDhai maahi samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; his light merges into theLight. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh gi-aan t at beechaaraa jot ee jot  milaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: God is True, Forever True, and all His Creation is True.
lines.transliteration: so parabh saachaa sad  hee saachaa saachaa sabh  aakaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding; the True Name bringsemancipation. ||4||5||15|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1131-16) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur sojh ee paa-ee sach naam nist aaraa. ||4||5||15||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who do not realize the Lord are goblins. In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the supreme soul-swans contemplated the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kal meh parayt jinHee raam na pachh aataa sat jug param hans beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: In the Silver Age of Dwaapur Yuga, and the Brass Age of Traytaa Yuga, mankindprevailed, but only a rare few subdued their egos. ||1||
lines.transliteration: du-aapur t araytai maan as vart eh virlai ha-umai maaree. ||1||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness is obtained through the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: kal meh raam naam vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs know the One Lord; without the Name,liberation is not attained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jug jug gurmukh ayko jaat aa vin  naavai mukat  na paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੫॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is revealed in the heart of the True Lord's humbleservant. It dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam lakh ai jan saachaa gurmukh  man vasaa-ee.

lines.english: Those who are lovingly focused on the Lord's Name save themselves; they save alltheir ancestors as well. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap taray saglay kul t aaray jinee raam naam liv laa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ੇਤ ਿਜਨੀ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਸਤਜੁਿਗ  ਪਰਮ  ਹੰਸ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord God is the Giver of virtue. The Word of the Shabad burns away all faults and demerits. pMnw 1132
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh hai gun  kaa d aataa avgan  sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.english: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam are beautiful; they enshrine the Naam within their hearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin man vasi-aa say jan sohay hirdai naam vasaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹੇ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The True Guru has revealed to me the Lord's Home and His Court, and the Mansion ofHis Presence. I joyfully enjoy His Love.
lines.transliteration: ghar d ar mahal sat guroo d ikhaa-i-aa rang si-o ralee-aa maan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਿਸਉ ਰਲੀਆ  ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.english: Whatever He says, I accept as good; Nanak chants the Naam. ||4||6||16|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1132-3) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kahai so bh alaa kar maanai naanak naam vakh aanai. ||4||6||16||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬॥
lines.english: The desires of the mind are absorbed in the mind, contemplating the Word of theGuru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maneh samaa-ay lai gur sabdee veechaar.

lines.english: Understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru, and then the mortal does not dieover and over again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay sojh ee pavai fir marai na vaaro vaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: My mind takes the Support of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: man mayray raam naam aaDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਵੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; the Lord is the Fulfiller of alldesires. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-i-aa sabh  ichh pujaavan haar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading amongst all; without the Guru, this understanding is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ayko rav rahi-aa gur bin boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Lord God has been revealed to me, and I have become Gurmukh. Night and day, Ising the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pargat ho-aa mayraa har parabh  an-din har gun  gaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The One Lord is the Giver of peace; peace is not found anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata har ayk hai hor thai sukh  na paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not serve the Giver, the True Guru, depart regretfully in the end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur jinee na sayvi-aa d aataa say ant  ga-ay pachh utaahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is obtained, and the mortal does not suffer inpain any longer.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa fir d ukh na laagai Dh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has been blessed with devotional worship of the Lord; his light has merged intothe Light. ||4||7||17|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1132-8) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhagat  paraapat  ho-ee jot ee jot  samaa-ay. ||4||7||17||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੇ ਅੰਿਤ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the world is insane; confused and deluded, it is beaten, and itsuffers.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo jagat  ba-uraanaa bh oolaa chotaa kh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It dies and dies again, and is reborn, always in pain, but it is unaware of the Lord's Gate. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mar mar jammai sadaa d ukh paa-ay d ar kee kh abar na paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥੭॥੧੭॥
lines.english: O my mind, remain always in the Protection of the True Guru's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: mayray man sadaa rahhu sat gur kee sarn aa.

lines.english: Those people, to whose hearts the Lord's Name seems sweet, are carried across theterrifying world-ocean by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hirdai har naam meeth aa sad  laagaa gur sabd ay bh avjal t arnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ  ਬਉਰਾਨਾ  ਭੂਲਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal wears various religious robes, but his consciousness is unsteady; deepwithin, he is filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh  karai bahut  chit dolai ant ar kaam kroDh  ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਿਰ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Deep within is the great thirst and immense hunger; he wanders from door to door.||2||
lines.transliteration: antar t isaa bh ookh at bahut ee bh a-ukat  firai d ar baar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who die in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are reborn; they find the door ofliberation.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad mareh fir jeeveh t in ka-o mukat  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਸਦ ਲਾਗਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਰਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With constant peace and tranquility deep within, they enshrine the Lord within theirhearts. ||3||
lines.transliteration: antar saaNt sadaa sukh  hovai har raakh i-aa ur Dh aar. ||3||

lines.english: As it pleases Him, He inspires us to act. Nothing else can be done.
lines.transliteration: ji-o tis bh aavai t ivai chalaavai karn aa kichh oo na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਚਤੁ  ਡੋਲੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Lord's Name. ||4||8||18|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1132-15) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sabad  samHaalay raam naam vadi-aa-ee. ||4||8||18||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਤਸਾ ਭੂਖ ਅਿਤ  ਬਹੁਤੀ ਭਉਕਤ  ਿਫਰੈ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Lost in egotism, Maya and attachment, the mortal earns pain, and eats pain.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maa-i-aa mohi khu-aa-i-aa d ukh khatay d ukh khaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਜੀਵਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਮੁਕਿਤ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The great disease, the rabid disease of greed, is deep within him; he wanders around indiscriminately. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  halak d ukh bhaaree bin bibayk bh armaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The life of the self-willed manmukh in this world is cursed.
lines.transliteration: manmukh Dh arig jeevan  saisaar.

lines.english: He does not remember the Lord's Name, even in his dreams. He is never in love withthe Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam supnai nahee chayti-aa har si-o kad ay na laagai pi-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੪॥੮॥੧੮॥
lines.english: He acts like a beast, and does not understand anything. Practicing falsehood, hebecomes false.
lines.transliteration: pasoo-aa karam karai nahee boojhai koorh  kamaavai koorh o ho-ay.

lines.english: But when the mortal meets the True Guru, his way of looking at the world changes.How rare are those humble beings who seek and find the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a ultee hovai kh oj lahai jan ko-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਖੁਆਇਆ  ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: That person, whose heart is forever filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, obtains the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: har har naam ridai sad  vasi-aa paa-i-aa gun ee niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭ ਹਲਕੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਭਰਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he finds the Perfect Lord; the egotistical pride of his mind iseradicated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee pooraa paa-i-aa chookaa man abhimaan. ||3||

lines.english: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act. He Himself places us on the path. pMnw 1133
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay karaa-ay aapay maarag paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥੪॥੯॥੧੯॥
lines.english: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness; O Nanak, he merges in the Naam. ||4||9||19|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1133-1) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aapay gurmukh d ay vadi-aa-ee naanak naam samaa-ay. ||4||9||19||

lines.english: Upon my writing tablet, I write the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, theLord of the World.
lines.transliteration: mayree patee-aa likhahu har govind  gopaalaa.

lines.english: In the love of duality, the mortals are caught in the noose of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay faathay jam jaalaa.

lines.english: The True Guru nurtures and sustains me.
lines.transliteration: satgur karay mayree part ipaalaa.

lines.english: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is always with me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har sukh-d aata mayrai naalaa. ||1||

lines.english: Following his Guru's instructions, Prahlaad chanted the Lord's Name;
lines.transliteration: gur updays par-hilaad  har uchrai.
saasnaa tay baalak gam na karai. ||1|| rahaa-o. he was a child, but he was not afraid when his teacher yelled at him. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਨਾ  ਤੇ ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਗਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Prahlaad's mother gave her beloved son some advice:
lines.transliteration: maataa upd aysai par-hilaad  pi-aaray.

lines.english: "My son, you must abandon the Lord's Name, and save your life!"
lines.transliteration: putar raam naam chh odahu jee-o layho ubaaray.

lines.english: Prahlaad said: "Listen, O my mother;
lines.transliteration: par-hilaad kahai sunhu mayree maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I shall never give up the Lord's Name. My Guru has taught me this."||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam na chhodaa gur d ee-aa bujh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Sandaa and Markaa, his teachers, went to his father the king, and complained:
lines.transliteration: sandaa markaa sabh jaa-ay pukaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਆ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: "Prahlaad himself has gone astray, and he leads all the other pupils astray."
lines.transliteration: par-hilaad aap vigrh i-aa sabh  chaatrh ay vigaarh ay.

lines.english: In the court of the wicked king, a plan was hatched.
lines.transliteration: dusat sabh aa meh mant ar pakaa-i-aa.

lines.english: God is the Savior of Prahlaad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parahlaad kaa raakh aa ho-ay ragh uraa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: With sword in hand, and with great egotistical pride, Prahlaad's father ran up to him.
lines.transliteration: haath kharh ag kar Dh aa-i-aa at  ahaNkaar.

lines.english: "Where is your Lord, who will save you?"
lines.transliteration: har tayraa kahaa t ujh la-ay ubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਿਥ  ਖੜਗੁ  ਕਿਰ ਧਾਇਆ  ਅਿਤ  ਅਹੰਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: In an instant, the Lord appeared in a dreadful form, and shattered the pillar.
lines.transliteration: khin meh bh ai-aan roop niksi-aa thamH upaarh .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਝੁ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Harnaakhash was torn apart by His claws, and Prahlaad was saved. ||4||
lines.transliteration: harnaakh as nakh ee bid aari-aa parahlaad  lee-aa ubaar. ||4||

lines.english: The Dear Lord completes the tasks of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kay har jee-o kaaraj savaaray.

lines.english: He saved twenty-one generations of Prahlaad's descendents.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad jan kay ikeeh kul uDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the poison of egotism is neutralized.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ha-umai bikh  maaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦ  ਜਨ ਕੇ ਇਕੀਹ  ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Name of the Lord, the Saints are emancipated. ||5||10||20|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1133-10) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam sant nist aaray. ||5||10||20||

lines.english: The Lord Himself makes demons pursue the Saints, and He Himself saves them.
lines.transliteration: aapay dait  laa-ay d itay sant  janaa ka-o aapay raakh aa so-ee.

lines.english: Those who remain forever in Your Sanctuary, O Lord - their minds are never touched by sorrow. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo tayree sad aa sarn aa-ee t in man d ukh na ho-ee. ||1||

lines.english: In each and every age, the Lord saves the honor of His devotees.
lines.transliteration: jug jug bhagt aa kee rakh -daa aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦੈਤ ਲਾਇ ਿਦਤੇ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ  ਰਾਖਾ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: 3) dait putar parahlaad  gaa-it aree t arpan  kichh oo na jaan ai sabd ay mayl milaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. Prahlaad, the demon's son, knew nothing of the Hindu morning prayer, the Gayatri,and nothing about ceremonial water-offerings to his ancestors; but through the Wordof the Shabad, he was united in the Lord's Union. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਿਤਨ  ਮਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, he performed devotional worship service, day and night, and throughthe Shabad, his duality was eradicated.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahi d in raat ee dubiDh aa sabd ay kh o-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate and pure; the True Lord abideswithin their minds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa nirmal hai jo sach raat ay sach vasi-aa man so-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤਰ੍ੁ ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦੁ  ਗਾਇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਤਰਪਣੁ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The fools in duality read, but they do not understand anything; they waste their livesuselessly.
lines.transliteration: moorakh d ubiDh aa parh eh mool na pachh aaneh birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The wicked demon slandered the Saint, and stirred up trouble. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee nind aa karahi d usat d ait chirh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Prahlaad did not read in duality, and he did not abandon the Lord's Name; he was not afraid of any fear.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad d ubiDh aa na parh ai har naam na chh odai darai na kisai d aa daraa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord became the Savior of the Saint, and the demonic Death could not evenapproach him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kaa har jee-o raakh aa daitai kaal nayrh aa aa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself saved his honor, and blessed his devotee with glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: aapnee paij aapay raakh ai bhagtaaN day-ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੈਤੁ ਿਚੜਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord with His claws; the blind demonknew nothing of the Lord's Court. ||5||11||21|| rwgu BYrau mhlw 4 caupdy Gru 1  (1133-19) raag bhairo mehlaa 4 cha-upd ay gh ar 1 Raag Bhairao, Fourth Mehl, Chaupadas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1133-19) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak harnaakh as nakh ee bid aari-aa anDh ai dar kee kh abar na paa-ee. ||5||11||21||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦੁ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਨ ਪੜੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਡਰੈ ਨ ਿਕਸੈ ਦਾ ਡਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, in His Mercy, attaches mortals to the feet of the Saints. pMnw 1134
lines.transliteration: har jan sant kar kirpaa pag laa-in .

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, vibrate and meditate on the Lord; let your awareness be absorbed in Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har bh aj surat  samaa-in . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਾਇਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord and the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har bhaj naam naraa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of Peace, grants His Grace; the Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karay sukh-d aata gurmukh  bhavjal har naam t araa-in . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰਾਇਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sangat saaDh  mayl har gaa-in .

lines.english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmatee lay raam rasaa-in . ||2||

lines.english: Bathe in the pool of ambrosial nectar, the spiritual wisdom of the Holy Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur saaDhoo amrit  gi-aan sar naa-in .

lines.english: All sins will be eliminated and eradicated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh kilvikh  paap ga-ay gaavaa-in . ||3||

lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator, the Support of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: too aapay kart aa sarisat Dh araa-in .

lines.english: Please unite servant Nanak with Yourself; he is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1|| BYrau mhlw 4 ] (1134-5) bhairo mehlaa 4. Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mayl tayraa d aas d asaa-in . ||4||1||

lines.english: Fruitful is that moment when the Lord's Name is spoken.
lines.transliteration: bol har naam safal saa gharee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੇਿਲ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, all pains are taken away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur updays sabh  dukh parharee. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har bhaj naam narharee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਫਲ  ਸਾ ਘਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, be merciful, and unite me with the Perfect Guru. Joining with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa maylhu gur pooraa satsangat  sang sinDh  bha-o taree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditate on the Life of the World; remember the Lord in your mind.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan Dhi-aa-ay man har simree.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Millions upon millions of your sins shall be taken away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kot kotantar t ayray paap parharee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਸੰਧੁ ਭਉ ਤਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Sat Sangat, apply the dust of the feet of the holy to your face;
lines.transliteration: satsangat  saaDh  Dhoor mukh  paree.
isnaan kee-o athsath  sursaree. ||3|| this is how to bathe in the sixty-eight sacred shrines, and the Ganges. ||3||

lines.english: I am a fool; the Lord has shown mercy to me.
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh ka-o har kirpaa karee.

lines.english: The Savior Lord has saved servant Nanak. ||4||2|| BYrau mhlw 4 ] (1134-9) bhairo mehlaa 4. Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak taari-o t aaran  haree. ||4||2||

lines.english: To do good deeds is the best rosary.
lines.transliteration: sukarit karn ee saar japmaalee.

lines.english: Chant on the beads within your heart, and it shall go along with you. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hirdai fayr chalai t uDh naalee. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Lord of the forest.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu banvaalee.

lines.english: Have mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation,so that I may be released from Maya's noose of death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa maylhu satsangat  toot ga-ee maa-i-aa jam jaalee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whoever, as Gurmukh, serves and works hard,
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sayvaa gh aal jin gh aalee.
tis gh arhee-ai sabad  sachee taksaalee. ||2|| is molded and shaped in the true mint of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru has revealed to me the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar gur agam dikh aalee.

lines.english: Searching within the body-village, I have found the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vich kaa-i-aa nagar laDhaa har bh aalee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਤੂਿਟ ਗਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am just a child; the Lord is my Father, who nurtures and cherishes me.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik har pitaa part ipaalee.

lines.english: Please save servant Nanak, Lord; bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||3|| BYrau mhlw 4 ] (1134-13) bhairo mehlaa 4. Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak taarahu nad ar nihaalee. ||4||3||

lines.english: All hearts are Yours, Lord; You are in all.
lines.transliteration: sabh gh at tayray t oo sabh naa maahi.

lines.english: There is nothing at all except You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tujh tay baahar ko-ee naahi. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: har sukh-d aata mayray man jaap.

lines.english: I praise You, O Lord God, You are my Father. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tuDh  saalaahee t oo mayraa har parabh  baap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see only the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah har parabh  so-ay.

lines.english: All are under Your control; there is no other at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayrai vas d oojaa avar na ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: O Lord, when it is Your Will to save someone,
lines.transliteration: jis ka-o tum har raakh i-aa bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਘਟ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kai nayrh ai ko-ay na jaavai. ||3|| then nothing can threaten him. ||3||

lines.english: You are totally pervading and permeating the waters, the lands, the skies and all places.
lines.transliteration: too jal thal mahee-al sabh  tai bharpoor.

lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Ever-present Lord. ||4||4|| BYrau mhlw 4 Gru 2  (1134-18) bhairo mehlaa 4 gh ar 2 Bhairao, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1134-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har jap haajraa hajoor. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਬਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's Saint is the embodiment of the Lord; within his heart is the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa sant har kee har moorat  jis hird ai har naam muraar.

lines.english: One who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, follows the Guru's Teachings, and contemplates the Name of the Lord within his heart. ||1|| pMnw 1135
lines.transliteration: mastak bh aag hovai jis likh i-aa so gurmat  hirdai har naam samHaar. ||1||

lines.english: Enshrine Him in your heart, and meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maDhusood an japee-ai ur Dh aar.

lines.english: The five plundering thieves are in the body-village; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord has beaten them and driven them out. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dayhee nagar t askar panch Dh aatoo gur sabd ee har kaadh ay maar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਿਰ  ਤਸਕਰ  ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾਢੇ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those whose minds are satisfied with the Lord - the Lord Himself resolves theiraffairs.
lines.transliteration: jin kaa har saytee man maani-aa t in kaaraj har aap savaar.

lines.english: Their subservience and their dependence on other people is ended; the Creator Lord is on their side. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin chookee muht aajee lokan kee har angeekaar kee-aa kart aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾਰਜ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: If something were beyond the realm of the Lord's Power, only then would we haverecourse to consult someone else.
lines.transliteration: mataa masoorat  taaN kichh  keejai jay kichh  hovai har baahar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਚੂਕੀ  ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ  ਲੋਕਨ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord does is good. Meditate on the Name of the Lord, night and day.||3||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karai so-ee bh al hosee har Dh i-aavahu an-d in naam muraar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਿਤ  ਤ ਿਕਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Lord does, He does by Himself. He does not ask or consult anyone else.
lines.transliteration: har jo kichh karay so aapay aapay oh poochh  na kisai karay beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate forever on God; granting His Grace, He unites us with the TrueGuru. ||4||1||5|| BYrau mhlw 4 ] (1135-6) bhairo mehlaa 4. Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so parabh sad aa Dh i-aa-ee-ai jin mayli-aa sat gur kirpaa Dh aar. ||4||1||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਓਹੁ ਪੂਿਛ ਨ ਿਕਸੈ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with the Holy people; meditating on You, I am saved.
