lines.transliteration: tay saaDh oo har maylhu su-aamee jin japi-aa gat  ho-ay hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਿਜਿਨ ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, my mind blossoms forth. Each andevery moment, I am a sacrifice to them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin kaa d aras d aykh man bigsai kh in khin tin ka-o ha-o balihaaree. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate within your heart on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har hirdai jap naam muraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਜਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Show Mercy, Mercy to me, O Father of the World, O my Lord and Master; make methe water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kar jagat pit  su-aamee ham d aasan d aas keejai panihaaree. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Their intellect is sublime and exalted, and so is their honor; the Lord, the Lord of theforest, abides within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: tin mat  ootam tin pat  ootam jin hird ai vasi-aa banvaaree.

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, please link me to the service of those who meditate inremembrance on You, and are saved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kee sayvaa laa-ay har su-aamee t in simrat  gat ho-ay hamaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਜਗਤ  ਿਪਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਿਨਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru are beaten, and driven out of the Courtof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jin aisaa satgur saaDh  na paa-i-aa t ay har d argeh kaadh ay maaree.

lines.english: These slanderous people have no honor or reputation; their noses are cut by the Creator Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tay nar nind ak sobh  na paavahi t in nak kaatay sirjanhaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਿਤਨ ਪਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਿਜਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself speaks, and the Lord Himself inspires all to speak; He is Immaculateand Formless, and needs no sustenance.
lines.transliteration: har aap bulaavai aapay bolai har aap niranjan nirankaar niraahaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, he alone meets You, whom You cause to meet. Says servant Nanak, I am a wretched creature. What can I do? ||4||2||6|| BYrau mhlw 4 ] (1135-13) bhairo mehlaa 4. Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jis too mayleh so t uDh milsee jan naanak ki-aa ayhi jant  vichaaree. ||4||2||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਕਾਢੇ  ਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: That is Your True Congregation, Lord, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises areheard.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  saa-ee har t ayree jit  har keerat  har sunn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਨਕ ਕਾਟੇ ਿਸਰਜਨਹਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The minds of those who listen to the Lord's Name are drenched with bliss; I worshiptheir feet continually. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jin har naam suni-aa man bh eenaa t in ham sarayveh nit  charn ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਬੋਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਿਨਰਾਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, the Life of the World, the mortals cross over.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan har Dhi-aa-ay t arnay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਜਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਿਮਲਸੀ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਆ  ਏਿਹ ਜੰਤ ਿਵਚਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: Your Names are so many, they are countless, O Lord. This tongue of mine cannoteven count them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anayk asaNkh naam har t ayray na jaahee jihvaa it  gann ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Gursikhs, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Praises of the Lord. Take the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gursikh har bolhu har gaavhu lay gurmat  har japn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਨਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever listens to the Guru's Teachings - that humble being receives countlesscomforts and pleasures from the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo updays sun ay gur kayraa so jan paavai har sukh  ghanay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਹਮ ਸਰ੍ੇਵਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਚਰਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan so vans Dh an so pit aa Dh an so maat aa jin jan jan ay. Blessed is the ancestry, blessed is the father, and blessed is that mother who gave birth to this humble servant.
Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and morsel of food -those humble servants of the Lord look beautiful in the True Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin saas giraas Dhi-aa-i-aa mayraa har har say saachee d argeh har jan ban ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਅਸੰਖ  ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ  ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਇਤੁ ਗਨਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Names are profound and infinite; Your devotees cherish themdeep within.
lines.transliteration: har har agam naam har tayray vich bh agtaa har Dh arnay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has obained the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings; meditating on theLord, Har, Har, he crosses over to the other side. ||4||3||7|| pMnw 1136 BYrau mhlw 5 Gru 1  (1136-1) bhairo mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1136-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan paa-i-aa mat gurmat  jap har har paar pavn ay. ||4||3||7||

lines.english: Setting aside all other days, it is said that the Lord was born on the eighth lunar day. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saglee theet paas daar raakh ee. astam theet  govind  janmaa see. ||1||

lines.english: Deluded and confused by doubt, the mortal practices falsehood.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh oolay nar karat  kachraa-in .

lines.english: The Lord is beyond birth and death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam maran t ay rahat  naaraa-in . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You prepare sweet treats and feed them to your stone god.
lines.transliteration: kar panjeer khavaa-i-o chor.

lines.english: God is not born, and He does not die, you foolish, faithless cynic! ||2||
lines.transliteration: oh janam na marai ray saakat dh or. ||2||

lines.english: You sing lullabyes to your stone god - this is the source of all your mistakes.
lines.transliteration: sagal paraaDh d eh loronee.

lines.english: Let that mouth be burnt, which says that our Lord and Master is subject to birth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so mukh jala-o jit  kaheh th aakur jonee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਜਨਿਮ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ  ਢੋਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is not born, and He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: janam na marai na aavai na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The God of Nanak is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||4||1|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1136-5) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa parabh rahi-o samaa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਉ  ਿਜਤੁ ਕਹਿਹ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜੋਨੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Standing up, I am at peace; sitting down, I am at peace.
lines.transliteration: oothat  sukh ee-aa baith at sukh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I feel no fear, because this is what I understand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-o nahee laagai jaaN aisay bujh ee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The One Lord, my Lord and Master, is my Protector.
lines.transliteration: raakhaa ayk hamaaraa su-aamee.

lines.english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa kaa ant arjaamee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I sleep without worry, and I awake without worry.
lines.transliteration: so-ay achintaa jaag achint aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ  ਜ ਐਸੇ ਬੁਝੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You, O God, are pervading everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jahaa kahaaN parabh t ooN vartantaa. ||2||

lines.english: I dwell in peace in my home, and I am at peace outside.
lines.transliteration: ghar sukh  vasi-aa baahar sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||2|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1136-9) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur mantar drirh -aa-i-aa. ||3||2||

lines.english: I do not keep fasts, nor do I observe the month of Ramadaan.
lines.transliteration: varat na raha-o na mah ramd aanaa.

lines.english: I serve only the One, who will protect me in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis sayvee jo rakh ai nid aanaa. ||1||

lines.english: The One Lord, the Lord of the World, is my God Allah.
lines.transliteration: ayk gusaa-ee alhu mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਸੁਿਖ ਵਿਸਆ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He adminsters justice to both Hindus and Muslims. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hindoo t urak d uhaaN naybayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I do not make pilgrimages to Mecca, nor do I worship at Hindu sacred shrines.
lines.transliteration: haj kaabai jaa-o na tirath poojaa.

lines.english: I serve the One Lord, and not any other. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayko sayvee avar na doojaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਤ  ਨ ਰਹਉ  ਨ ਮਹ ਰਮਦਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I do not perform Hindu worship services, nor do I offer the Muslim prayers.
lines.transliteration: poojaa kara-o na nivaaj gujaara-o.

lines.english: I have taken the One Formless Lord into my heart; I humbly worship Him there. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk nirankaar lay ridai namaskaara-o. ||3||

lines.english: I am not a Hindu, nor am I a Muslim.
lines.transliteration: naa ham hindoo na musalmaan.

lines.english: My body and breath of life belong to Allah - to Raam - the God of both. ||4||
lines.transliteration: alah raam kay pind paraan. ||4||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, this is what I say:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer ih kee-aa vakhaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਉ  ਨ ਤੀਰਥ  ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.english: ||5||3|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1136-13) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur peer mil khud  khasam pachh aanaa. ||5||3|| meeting with the Guru, my Spiritual Teacher, I realize God, my Lord and Master.

lines.english: I easily tied up the deer - the ten sensory organs.
lines.transliteration: das mirgee sehjay banDh  aanee.

lines.english: I shot five of the desires with the Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paaNch mirag bayDhay siv kee baanee. ||1||

lines.english: I go out hunting with the Saints,
lines.transliteration: satsang lay charh i-o sikaar.
marig pakray bin ghor hathee-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o. and we capture the deer without horses or weapons. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: My mind used to run around outside hunting.
lines.transliteration: aakhayr birat  baahar aa-i-o Dh aa-ay.

lines.english: But now, I have found the game within the home of my body-village. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ahayraa paa-i-o ghar kai gaaN-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I caught the deer and brought them home.
lines.transliteration: marig pakray ghar aan ay haat.

lines.english: Dividing them up, I shared them, bit by bit. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chukh chukh  lay ga-ay baaNdhay baat. ||3||

lines.english: God has given this gift.
lines.transliteration: ayhu ahayraa keeno daan.

lines.english: Nanak's home is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||4|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1136-17) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kai ghar kayval naam. ||4||4||

lines.english: Even though he may be fed with hundreds of longings and yearnings,
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o loch loch khaavaa-i-aa.
saakat har har cheet  na aa-i-aa. ||1|| still the faithless cynic does not remember the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.english: Take in the teachings of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee layho mat ay.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang paavhu param gat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Stones may be kept under water for a long time.
lines.transliteration: paathar ka-o baho neer pavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Even so, they do not absorb the water; they remain hard and dry. ||2|| pMnw 1137
lines.transliteration: nah bheegai aDh ik sookaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: The six Shaastras may be read to a fool,
lines.transliteration: khat saast ar moorkh ai sunaa-i-aa.
jaisay dah d is pavan jh ulaa-i-aa. ||3|| but it is like the wind blowing in the ten directions. ||3||

lines.english: It is like threshing a crop without any corn - nothing is gained.
lines.transliteration: bin kan kh alhaan jaisay gaahan paa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the same way, no benefit comes from the faithless cynic. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ti-o saakat  tay ko na baraasaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: As the Lord attaches them, so are all attached.
lines.transliteration: tit hee laagaa jit  ko laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God has formed such a form. ||5||5|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1137-3) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh ban at banaa-i-aa. ||5||5||

lines.english: He created the soul, the breath of life and the body.
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan jin rachi-o sareer.

lines.english: He created all beings, and knows their pains. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jineh upaa-ay tis ka-o peer. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, is the Helper of the soul.
lines.transliteration: gur gobind jee-a kai kaam.

lines.english: Here and herafter, He always provides shade. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  jaa kee sad  chhaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Worship and adoration of God is the pure way of life.
lines.transliteration: parabh aaraaDh an nirmal reet .

lines.punjabi: ਹਲਿਤ  ਪਲਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਦ ਛਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of duality vanishes. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang binsee bipreet . ||2||

lines.english: Friends, well-wishers and wealth will not support you.
lines.transliteration: meet heet  Dhan nah paarn aa.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an mayray naaraa-in aa. ||3|| Blessed, blessed is my Lord. ||3||
Nanak utters the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai amrit ban ee.

lines.english: Except the One Lord, he does not know any other at all. ||4||6|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1137-7) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk binaa doojaa nahee jaan ee. ||4||6||

lines.english: The Lord is in front of me, and the Lord is behind me.
lines.transliteration: aagai da-yu paachh ai naaraa-in .

lines.english: My Beloved Lord, the Source of Nectar, is in the middle as well. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maDh bh aag har paraym rasaa-in . ||1||

lines.english: God is my Shaastra and my favorable omen.
lines.transliteration: parabhoo hamaarai saast ar sa-un .

lines.english: In His Home and Mansion, I find peace, poise and bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  garih bh a-un. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with my tongue, and hearing it with my ears, I live.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa naam karan sun jeevay.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I have become eternal, permanentand stable. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabh simar simar amar thir theevay. ||2||

lines.english: The pains of countless lifetimes have been erased.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay dookh  nivaaray.

lines.english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, vibrates in the Court ofthe Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  vajay d arbaaray. ||3||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, God has blended me with Himself.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh lee-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||4||7|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1137-10) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh sarn aagat  aa-ay. ||4||7||

lines.english: It brings millions of desires to fulfillment.
lines.transliteration: kot manorath aavahi haath.

lines.english: On the Path of Death, It will go with you and help you. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jam maarag kai sangee paaNth. ||1||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe, is the holy water of the Ganges.
lines.transliteration: gangaa jal gur gobind naam.

lines.english: Whoever meditates on it, is saved; drinking it in, the mortal does not wander inreincarnation again. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo simrai tis kee gat  hovai peevat  bahurh  na jon bh armaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: It is my worship, meditation, austerity and cleansing bath.
lines.transliteration: poojaa jaap taap isnaan.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I have become free of desire. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simrat naam bh a-ay nihkaam. ||2||

lines.english: It is my domain and empire, wealth, mansion and court.
lines.transliteration: raaj maal saadan d arbaar.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam brings perfect conduct. ||3||
lines.transliteration: simrat naam pooran aachaar. ||3||

lines.english: Slave Nanak has deliberated, and has come to this conclusion:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas ih kee-aa beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਪੀਵਤ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਮਾਮ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, everything is false and worthless, like ashes. ||4||8|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1137-14) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bin har naam mithi-aa sabh chh aar. ||4||8||

lines.english: The poison had absolutely no harmful effect.
lines.transliteration: layp na laago til kaa mool.

lines.english: But the wicked Brahmin died in pain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dusat baraahman  moo-aa ho-ay kai sool. ||1||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God Himself has saved His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: har jan raakhay paarbarahm aap.

lines.english: The sinner died through the Power of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paapee moo-aa gur partaap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord and Master meditates on Him.
lines.transliteration: apnaa kh asam jan aap Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself has destroyed the ignorant sinner. ||2||
lines.transliteration: i-aanaa paapee oh aap pachaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: God is the Mother, the Father and the Protector of His slave.
lines.transliteration: parabh maat  pitaa apn ay daas kaa rakh vaalaa.

lines.english: The face of the slanderer, here and hereafter, is blackened. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nindak kaa maathaa eehaaN oohaa kaalaa. ||3||

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord has heard the prayer of servant Nanak.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kee parmaysar sunee ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣੁ ਮ ੂਆ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੂਲ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The filthy sinner lost hope and died. ||4||9|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1137-19) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: malaychh paapee pachi-aa bh a-i-aa niraas. ||4||9||

lines.english: Excellent, excellent, excellent, exce llent, excellent is Your Name.
lines.transliteration: khoob kh oob kh oob kh oob kh oob tayro naam.

lines.english: False, false, false, false is pride in the world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jhooth  jhooth jhooth jhooth dunee gumaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The glorious vision of Your slaves, O Infinite Lord, is wonderful and beauteous. pMnw 1138
lines.transliteration: nagaj tayray band ay deedaar apaar.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is just ashes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh d unee-aa chh aar. ||1||

lines.english: Your Creative Power is marvellous, and Your Lotus Feet are admirable.
lines.transliteration: achraj tayree kud rat tayray kad am salaah.

lines.punjabi: ਅਚਰਜੁ  ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਤੇਰੇ ਕਦਮ  ਸਲਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: Your Praise is priceless, O True King. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ganeev tayree sifat  sachay paat isaah. ||2||

lines.english: God is the Support of the unsupported.
lines.transliteration: neeDhri-aa Dh ar panah kh udaa-ay.

lines.english: Meditate day and night on the Cherisher of the meek and humble. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gareeb nivaaj din rain  Dhi-aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: God has been merciful to Nanak.
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o khud  khasam miharvaan.

lines.english: May I never forget God; He is my heart, my soul, my breath of life. ||4||10|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1138-4) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: alhu na visrai dil jee-a paraan. ||4||10||

lines.english: As Gurmukh, obtain the true wealth.
lines.transliteration: saach padaarath gurmukh  lahhu.

lines.english: Accept the Will of God as True. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh kaa bh aanaa sat  kar sahhu. ||1||

lines.english: Live, live, live forever.
lines.transliteration: jeevat jeevat  jeevat  rahhu.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ  ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Rise early each day, and drink in the Nectar of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in nit  uth peevhu.

lines.english: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har har har rasnaa kahhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the One Name alone shall save you.
lines.transliteration: kalijug meh ik naam uDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak speaks the wisdom of God. ||2||11|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1138-6) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai barahm beechaar. ||2||11||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, all fruits and rewards are obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sarab fal paa-ay.

lines.english: The filth of so many lifetimes is washed away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee mail mitaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan parabh  tayro naa-o.

lines.english: Because of the karma of my past deeds, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: poorab karam likhay gun  gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am saved.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang hovai uDh aar.

lines.english: I am blessed with honor in God's Court. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sobhaa paavai parabh  kai d u-aar. ||2||

lines.english: Serving at God's Feet, all comforts are obtained.
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aan charan  parabh  sayvaa.

lines.english: Dhoor baachh eh sabh  sur nar d ayvaa. ||3|| All the angels and demi-gods long for the dust of the feet of such beings. ||3||
Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naanak paa-i-aa naam niDhaan.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the whole world is saved. ||4||12|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1138-10) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jap jap uDhri-aa sagal jahaan. ||4||12||

lines.english: God hugs His slave close in His Embrace.
lines.transliteration: apnay d aas ka-o kanth  lagaavai.

lines.english: He throws the slanderer into the fire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nindak ka-o agan meh paavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਿਰ ਬਾਛਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord saves His servants from the sinners.
lines.transliteration: paapee tay raakh ay naaraa-in .

lines.english: No one can save the sinner. The sinner is destroyed by his own actions. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paapee kee gat kat hoo naahee paapee pachi-aa aap kamaa-in . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਉਧਿਰਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The Lord's slave is in love with the Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: daas raam jee-o laagee pareet .

lines.english: The slanderer loves something else. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nindak kee ho-ee bipreet . ||2||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has revealed His Innate Nature.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm apnaa birad  paragtaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The evil-doer obtains the fruits of his own actions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dokhee apn aa keet aa paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: God does not come or go; He is All-pervading and permeating.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaa-ee rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੀ  ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਾਪੀ ਪਿਚਆ  ਆਪ  ਕਮਾਇਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||4||13|| rwgu BYrau mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 2  (1138-15) raag bhairo mehlaa 5 cha-upd ay gh ar 2 Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Chaupadas, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1138-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas har kee sarn aa-ee. ||4||13||

lines.english: The Fascinating Lord, the Creator of all, the Formless Lord, is the Giver of Peace.
lines.transliteration: sareeDhar mohan sagal upaavan nirankaar sukh -daata.

lines.english: You have abandoned this Lord, and you serve another. Why are you intoxicated with the pleasures of corruption? ||1||
lines.transliteration: aisaa parabh chh od karahi an sayvaa kavan bikh i-aa ras maat aa. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ray man mayray too govid  bhaaj.

lines.english: I have seen all other sorts of efforts; whatever you can think of, will only bring failure.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar upaav sagal mai daykh ay jo chit vee-ai t it bigras kaaj. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The blind, ignorant, self-willed manmukhs forsake their Lord and Master, and dwell onHis slave Maya.
lines.transliteration: thaakur chh od daasee ka-o simrahi manmukh  anDh  agi-aanaa.

lines.english: They slander those who worship their Lord; they are like beasts, without a Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  karahi t in nind eh niguray pasoo samaanaa. ||2||

lines.english: Soul, life, body and wealth all belong to God, but the faithless cynics claim that theyown them. pMnw 1139
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind tan Dh an sabh  parabh  kaa saakat  kahtay mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹੈ ਮੈਲੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਵਜਿਲ  ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They are proud and arrogant, evil-minded and filthy; without the Guru, they are reincarnated into the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh d urmat  hai mailee bin gur bh avjal fayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸਿਭ ਸੰਜਮ  ਤਿਟ ਤੀਰਿਥ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through burnt offerings, charitable feasts, ritualistic chants, penance, all sorts ofaustere self-discipline and pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, they do not findGod.
lines.transliteration: hom jag jap tap sabh  sanjam t at tirath nahee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਆਪੁ  ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Self-conceit is only erased when one seeks the Lord's Sanctuary and becomesGurmukh; O Nanak, he crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||1||14|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1139-2) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: miti-aa aap pa-ay sarnaa-ee gurmukh  naanak jagat  taraa-i-aa. ||4||1||14||

lines.english: I have seen Him in the woods, and I have seen Him in the fields. I have seen Him inthe household, and in renunciation.
lines.transliteration: ban meh paykhi-o t arin meh paykh i-o garihi paykh i-o ud aasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਨ ਮਿਹ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਿਤਰ੍ਣ  ਮਿਹ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਉਦਾਸਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen Him as a Yogi carrying His staff, as a Yogi with matted hair, fasting,making vows, and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dandDh aar jatDh aarai paykh i-o varat  naym t eerthaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੰਡਧਾਰ  ਜਟਧਾਰੈ  ਪੇਿਖਓ ਵਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have seen Him in the Society of the Saints, and within my own mind.
lines.transliteration: satsang paykh i-o man maa-ayN.

lines.english: In the sky, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in everything, He is pervadingand permeating. With love and joy, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: oobh pa-i-aal sarab meh pooran ras mangal gun  gaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲ  ਸਰਬ  ਮਿਹ ਪੂਰਨ  ਰਿਸ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have seen Him among the Yogis, the Sannyaasees, the celibates, the wandering hermits and the wearers of patched coats.
lines.transliteration: jog bhaykh  sanni-aasai paykh i-o jat  jangam kaaprh aa-ay.

lines.english: I have seen Him among the men of severe self-discipline, the silent sages, the actors,dramas and dances. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tapee t apeesur mun meh paykh i-o nat naatik nirt aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਭੇਖ ਸੰਿਨਆਸੈ  ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਜਿਤ ਜੰਗਮ  ਕਾਪੜਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have seen Him in the four Vedas, I have seen Him in the six Shaastras, in theeighteen Puraanas and the Simritees as well.
lines.transliteration: chahu meh paykhi-o kh at meh paykh i-o das astee simmrit aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਪੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ  ਮੁਿਨ ਮਿਹ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਨਟ ਨਾਿਟਕ  ਿਨਰਤਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All together, they declare that there is only  the One Lord. So tell me, from whom is He hidden? ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh mil ayko ayk vakh aaneh t a-o kis t ay kaha-o d uraa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚਹੁ ਮਿਹ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਖਟ ਮਿਹ ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ  ਿਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਤਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Unfathomable and Inaccessible, He is our Infinite Lord and Master; His Value isbeyond valuation.
lines.transliteration: agah agah bay-ant su-aamee nah keem keem keemaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਮਿਲ  ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਨਿਹ  ਤਉ ਿਕਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਉ  ਦੁਰਾਏ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, within whose heart He is revealed.||4||2||15|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1139-8) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin kai bal bal jaa-ee-ai jih gh at pargatee-aa-ay. ||4||2||15||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਹ  ਅਗਹ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਨਹ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: How can anyone do evil, if he realizes that the Lord is near?
lines.transliteration: nikat bujhai so buraa ki-o karai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਿਜਹ ਘਿਟ  ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੫॥
lines.english: One who gathers corruption, constantly feels fear.
lines.transliteration: bikh sanchai nit  dartaa firai.

lines.english: He is near, but this mystery is not understood.
lines.transliteration: hai niktay ar bhayd  na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, all are enticed by Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur sabh  mohee maa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Everyone says that He is near, near at hand.
lines.transliteration: nayrhai nayrh ai sabh  ko kahai.

lines.english: But rare is that person, who, as Gurmukh, understands this mystery. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh ayd virlaa ko lahai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The mortal does not see the Lord near at hand; instead, he goes to the homes of others.
lines.transliteration: nikat na daykh ai par garihi jaa-ay.

lines.english: He steals their wealth and lives in falsehood.
lines.transliteration: darab hirai mithi-aa kar kh aa-ay.

lines.english: Under the influence of the drug of illusion, he does not know that the Lord is withhim.
lines.transliteration: pa-ee thag-uree har sang na jaani-aa.

lines.english: Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo hai bh aram bh ulaani-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Not understanding that the Lord is near, he tells lies.
lines.transliteration: nikat na jaanai bolai koorh.

lines.english: In love and attachment to Maya, the fool is plundered.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi moothaa hai moorh .

lines.punjabi: ਪਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: That which he seeks is within his own self, but he looks for it outside.
lines.transliteration: antar vasat  disant ar jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||3||
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo hai bh aram bh ulaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: One whose good karma is recorded on his forehead
lines.transliteration: jis mastak karam likh i-aa lilaat.
satgur sayvay kh ulHay kapaat. serves the True Guru; thus the hard and heavy shutters of his mind are opened wide.

lines.english: Within his own being and beyond, he sees the Lord near at hand.
lines.transliteration: antar baahar niktay so-ay.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||4||3||16|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1139-15) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aavai na jaavai ko-ay. ||4||3||16||

lines.english: Who can kill that person whom You protect, O Lord?
lines.transliteration: jis too raakh ahi tis ka-un maarai.

lines.english: All beings, and the entire universe, is within You.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ujh hee ant ar sagal sansaarai.

lines.english: The mortal thinks up millions of plans,
lines.transliteration: kot upaav chitvat  hai paraan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਵੈ  ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: so hovai je karai choj vidaanee. ||1|| but that alone happens, which the Lord of wondrous plays does. ||1||

lines.english: Save me, save me, O Lord; shower me with Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: raakho raakh o kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, and Your Court. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  tayrai d arvaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever serves the Fearless Lord, the Giver of Peace,
lines.transliteration: jin sayvi-aa nirbha-o sukh -daata.
tin bh a-o door kee-aa ayk paraat aa. is rid of all his fears; he knows the One Lord.

lines.english: Whatever You do, that alone comes to pass in the end.
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi so-ee fun ho-ay.

lines.english: There is no other who can kill or protect us. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maarai na raakhai d oojaa ko-ay. ||2||

lines.english: What do you think, with your human understanding?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa too socheh maan as baan .

lines.english: The All-knowing Lord is the Searcher of Hearts.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee purakh  sujaan .

lines.english: The One and only Lord is my Support and Protection.
lines.transliteration: ayk tayk ayko aaDhaar.

lines.english: The Creator Lord knows everything. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  jaanai sirjan haar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਫੁਿਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: That person who is blessed by the Creator's Glance of Grace pMnw 1140
lines.transliteration: jis oopar nadar karay kart aar.
tis jan kay sabh  kaaj savaar. - all his affairs are resolved.

lines.english: The One Lord is his Protector.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa raakh aa ayko so-ay.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, no one can equal him. ||4||4||17|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1140-2) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aparh na saakai ko-ay. ||4||4||17||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਪਿੜ  ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭॥
lines.english: We should feel sad, if God were beyond us.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay hovai baahar.

lines.english: We should feel sad, if we forget the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay visrai narhar.

lines.english: We should feel sad, if we are in love with duality.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay d oojaa bh aa-ay.

lines.english: But why should we feel sad? The Lord is pervading everywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa karhee-ai jaaN rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: In love and attachment to Maya, the mortals are sad, and are consumed by sadness.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi karhay karh  pachi-aa.

lines.english: Without the Name, they wander and wander and wander, and waste away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai bharam bh aram bh aram kh api-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: We should feel sad, if there were another Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay d oojaa kart aa.

lines.english: We should feel sad, if someone dies by injustice.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay ani-aa-ay ko mart aa.

lines.english: We should feel sad, if something were not known to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay kichh  jaanai naahee.

lines.english: But why should we feel sad? The Lord is totally permeating everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa karhee-ai jaaN bharpoor samaahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ  ਜੇ ਅਿਨਆਇ  ਕੋ ਮਰਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: We should feel sad, if God were a tyrant.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay kichh  ho-ay Dh inyaanai.

lines.english: We should feel sad, if He made us suffer by mistake.
lines.transliteration: ta-o karh ee-ai jay bh ool ranj aanay.

lines.english: The Guru says that whatever happens is all by God's Will.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa jo ho-ay sabh parabh  tay.

lines.english: So I have abandoned sadness, and I now sleep without anxiety. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tab kaarh aa chh od achint  ham sot ay. ||3||

lines.english: O God, You alone are my Lord and Master; all belong to You.
lines.transliteration: parabh t oohai th aakur sabh  ko tayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਕਿਹਆ  ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇ ॥
lines.english: According to Your Will, You pass judgement.
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o karahi nibayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਕਾੜਾ  ਛੋਿਡ ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਹਮ ਸੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: There is no other at all; the One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa naasat  ik rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Please save Nanak's honor; I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||5||18|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1140-8) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raakho paij naanak sarn aa-ay. ||4||5||18||

lines.english: Without music, how is one to dance?
lines.transliteration: bin baajay kaiso nirtikaaree.

lines.english: Without a voice, how is one to sing?
lines.transliteration: bin kanthai kaisay gaavanhaaree.

lines.english: Without strings, how is a guitar to be played?
lines.transliteration: jeel binaa kaisay bajai rabaab.

lines.english: Without the Naam, all affairs are useless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa birthay sabh kaaj. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Naam - tell me: who has ever been saved?
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kahhu ko tari-aa.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, how can anyone cross over to the other side? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kaisay paar pari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without a tongue, how can anyone speak?
lines.transliteration: bin jihvaa kahaa ko baktaa.

lines.english: Without ears, how can anyone hear?
lines.transliteration: bin sarvanaa kahaa ko suntaa.

lines.english: Without eyes, how can anyone see?
lines.transliteration: bin naytaraa kahaa ko paykh ai.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal is of no account at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa nar kahee na laykhai. ||2||

lines.english: Without learning, how can one be a Pandit - a religious scholar?
lines.transliteration: bin bidi-aa kahaa ko-ee pandit .

lines.english: Without power, what is the glory of an empire?
lines.transliteration: bin amrai kaisay raaj mandit.

lines.english: Without understanding, how can the mind become steady?
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay kahaa man th ehraanaa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the whole world is insane. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag ba-uraanaa. ||3||

lines.english: Without detachment, how can one be a detached hermit?
lines.transliteration: bin bairaag kahaa bairaagee.

lines.english: Without renouncing egotism, how can anyone be a renunciate?
lines.transliteration: bin ha-o ti-aag kahaa ko-oo t i-aagee.

lines.english: Without overcoming the five thieves, how can the mind be subdued?
lines.transliteration: bin bas panch kahaa man chooray.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal regrets and repents forever and ever. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sad sad  hee jh ooray. ||4||

lines.english: Without the Guru's Teachings, how can anyone obtain spiritual wisdom?
lines.transliteration: bin gur deekh i-aa kaisay gi-aan.

lines.english: Without seeing - tell me: how can anyone visualize in meditation?
lines.transliteration: bin paykhay kaho kaiso Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Without the Fear of God, all speech in useless.
lines.transliteration: bin bhai kathnee sarab bikaar.

lines.english: Says Nanak, this is the wisdom of the Lord's Court. ||5||6||19|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1140-16) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak dar kaa beechaar. ||5||6||19||

lines.english: Mankind is afflicted with the disease of egotism.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog maanukh ka-o d eenaa.

lines.english: The disease of sexual desire overwhelms the elephant.
lines.transliteration: kaam rog maigal bas leenaa.

lines.english: Because of the disease of vision, the moth is burnt to death.
lines.transliteration: darisat rog pach mu-ay pat angaa.

lines.english: Because of the disease of the sound of the bell, the deer is lured to its death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naad rog kh ap ga-ay kurangaa. ||1||

lines.english: Whoever I see is diseased.
lines.transliteration: jo jo deesai so so rogee.

lines.english: Only my True Guru, the True Yogi, is free of disease. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rog rahit mayraa sat gur jogee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Because of the disease of taste, the fish is caught.
lines.transliteration: jihvaa rog meen garsi-aano.

lines.english: Because of the disease of smell, the bumble bee is destroyed.
lines.transliteration: baasan rog bhavar binsaano.

lines.english: The whole world is caught in the disease of attachment.
lines.transliteration: hayt rog kaa sagal sansaaraa.

lines.english: In the disease of the three qualities, corruption is multiplied. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  rog meh baDh ay bikaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
lines.english: In disease the mortals die, and in disease they are born.
lines.transliteration: rogay martaa rogay janmai.

lines.english: In disease they wander in reincarnation again and again. pMnw 1141
lines.transliteration: rogay fir fir jonee bharmai.

lines.english: Entangled in disease, they cannot stay still, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: rog banDh rahan rat ee na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗ ਬੰਧ ਰਹਨੁ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the disease is never cured. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur rog kat eh na jaavai. ||3||

lines.english: When the Supreme Lord God grants His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm jis keenee da-i-aa.

lines.english: He grabs hold of the mortal's arm, and pulls him up and out of the disease.
lines.transliteration: baah pakarh rogahu kadh  la-i-aa.

lines.english: Reaching the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mortal's bonds are broken.
lines.transliteration: tootay banDh an saaDh sang paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru cures him of the disease. ||4||7||20|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1141-3) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur rog mitaa-i-aa. ||4||7||20||

lines.english: When He comes to mind, then I am in supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN mahaa anand.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, then all my pains are shattered.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sabh  dukh bhanj.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, my hopes are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sarDh aa pooree.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵੈ ਤ ਸਿਭ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜ ॥
lines.english: When He comes to mind, I never feel sadness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN kabeh na jh ooree. ||1||

lines.english: Deep within my being, my Sovereign Lord King has revealed Himself to me.
lines.transliteration: antar raam raa-ay pargatay aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਤ ਕਬਿਹ  ਨ ਝੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has inspired me to love Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai dee-o rang laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, I am the king of all.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sarab ko raajaa.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, all my affairs are completed.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN pooray kaajaa.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, I am dyed in the deep crimson of His Love.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN rang gulaal.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਤ ਸਰਬ  ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: When He comes to mind, I am ecstatic forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sadaa nihaal. ||2||

lines.english: When He comes to mind, I am wealthy forever.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sad Dhanvant aa.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, I am free of doubt forever.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sad nibhrantaa.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, then I enjoy all pleasures.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sabh  rang maan ay.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, I am rid of fear. ||3||
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN chookee kaan ay. ||3||

lines.english: When He comes to mind, I find the home of peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sahj gh ar paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵੈ ਤ  ਸਿਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: When He comes to mind, I am absorbed in the Primal Void of God.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai t aaN sunn samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, I continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.
lines.transliteration: cheet aavai sad  keert an kart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਤ ਸਹਜ  ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak's mind is pleased and satisfied with the Lord God. ||4||8||21|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1141-9) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man maani-aa naanak bhagvant aa. ||4||8||21||

lines.english: My Father is Eternal, forever alive.
lines.transliteration: baap hamaaraa sad charanjeevee.

lines.english: My brothers live forever as well.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee hamaaray sad  hee jeevee.

lines.english: My friends are permanent and imperishable.
lines.transliteration: meet hamaaray sad aa abh inaasee.

lines.english: My family abides in the home of the self within. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kutamb hamaaraa nij ghar vaasee. ||1||

lines.english: I have found peace, and so all are at peace.
lines.transliteration: ham sukh paa-i-aa t aaN sabh eh suhaylay.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has united me with my Father. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pitaa sang maylay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mansions are the highest of all.
lines.transliteration: mandar mayray sabh  tay oochay.

lines.english: My countries are infinite and uncountable.
lines.transliteration: days mayray bay-ant  apoochh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤ ਸਭਿਹ  ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: My kingdom is eternally stable.
lines.transliteration: raaj hamaaraa sad hee nihchal.

lines.english: My wealth is inexhaustible and permanent. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maal hamaaraa akhoot abaychal. ||2||

lines.english: My glorious reputation resounds throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: sobhaa mayree sabh  jug ant ar.

lines.english: My fame has spread in all places and interspaces.
lines.transliteration: baaj hamaaree thaan thanantar.

lines.english: My praises echo in each and every house.
lines.transliteration: keerat hamree gh ar ghar ho-ee.

lines.english: My devotional worship is known to all people. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  hamaaree sabh nee lo-ee. ||3||

lines.english: My Father has revealed Himself within me.
lines.transliteration: pitaa hamaaray pargatay maajh .

lines.english: The Father and son have joined together in partnership.
lines.transliteration: pitaa poot  ral keenee saaNjh.

lines.english: Says Nanak, when my Father is pleased,
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ja-o pitaa pat eenay.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1141-15) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pitaa poot  aykai rang leenay. ||4||9||22|| then the Father and son are joined together in love, and become one. ||4||9||22||

lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is free of revenge and hate; He is God, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: nirvair purakh sat gur parabh  daatay.

lines.english: I am a sinner; You are my Forgiver.
lines.transliteration: ham apraaDhee t umH bakh saatay.

lines.english: That sinner, who finds no protection anywhere
lines.transliteration: jis paapee ka-o milai na dho-ee.
saran aavai t aaN nirmal ho-ee. ||1|| - if he comes seeking Your Sanctuary, then he becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||

lines.english: Pleasing the True Guru, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-aa sat guroo manaa-ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Guru, I have obtained all fruits and rewards. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh fal paa-ay guroo Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I humbly bow to the Supreme Lord God, the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm satgur aad ays.

lines.english: My mind and body are Yours; all the world is Yours.
lines.transliteration: man tan t ayraa sabh  tayraa d ays.

lines.english: When the veil of illusion is removed, then I come to see You.
lines.transliteration: chookaa parh-d aa taaN nadree aa-i-aa.

lines.english: You are my Lord and Master; You are the King of all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khasam t oohai sabh naa kay raa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: When it pleases Him, even dry wood becomes green.
lines.transliteration: tis bh aanaa sookay kaasat hari-aa.

lines.english: When it pleases Him, rivers flow across the desert sands.
lines.transliteration: tis bh aanaa taaN thal sir sari-aa.

lines.english: When it pleases Him, all fruits and rewards are obtained.
lines.transliteration: tis bh aanaa taaN sabh  fal paa-ay.

lines.english: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, my anxiety is dispelled. ||3|| pMnw 1142
lines.transliteration: chint ga-ee lag sat gur paa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: I am unworthy and ungrateful, but He has been merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: haraamkhor nirgun  ka-o t oothaa.

lines.english: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; the Ambrosial Nectar rains down in my mind.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al man amrit  vooth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਮਿਨ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਵੂਠਾ ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Guru, has become kind and compassionate to me.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm gur bha-ay d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Slave Nanak beholds the Lord, enraptured. ||4||10||23|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1142-2) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas d aykh bha-ay nihaalaa. ||4||10||23||

lines.english: My True Guru is totally independent.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa baymuht aaj.

lines.english: My True Guru is adorned with Truth.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayray sachaa saaj.

lines.english: My True Guru is the Giver of all.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa sabh as kaa d aataa.

lines.english: My True Guru is the Primal Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa purakh  biDhaataa. ||1||

lines.english: There is no deity equal to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur jaisaa naahee ko dayv.

lines.english: Whoever has good destiny inscribed on his forehead, applies himself to seva - selfless service. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis mastak bh aag so laagaa sayv. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My True Guru is the Sustainer and Cherisher of all.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa sarab parat ipaalai.

lines.english: My True Guru kills and revives.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa maar jeevaalai.

lines.english: The glorious greatness of my True Guru has become manifest everywhere. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur mayray kee vadi-aa-ee. pargat bh a-ee hai sabh nee thaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: My True Guru is the power of the powerless.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa t aan nitaan.

lines.english: My True Guru is my home and court.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa gh ar deebaan .

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai ha-o sad  bal jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He has shown me the path. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pargat maarag jin kar dikh laa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: One who serves the Guru is not afflicted with fear.
lines.transliteration: jin gur sayvi-aa tis bh a-o na bi-aapai.

lines.english: One who serves the Guru does not suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: jin gur sayvi-aa tis d ukh na sant aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has studied the Simritees and the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: naanak soDhay simrit  bayd .

lines.english: There is no difference between the Supreme Lord God and the Guru. ||4||11||24|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1142-9) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm gur naahee bhayd . ||4||11||24||

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal is exalted and glorified.
lines.transliteration: naam lait man pargat bh a-i-aa.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, sin is banished from the body.
lines.transliteration: naam lait paap t an tay ga-i-aa.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, all festivals are celebrated.
lines.transliteration: naam lait sagal purbaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, one is cleansed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam lait ath sath majnaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tirath hamraa har ko naam.

lines.english: The Guru has instructed me in the true essence of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur updaysi-aa t at gi-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪਾਪੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Repeating the Naam, the mortal's pains are taken away.
lines.transliteration: naam lait d ukh door paraanaa.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, the most ignorant people become spiritual teachers.
lines.transliteration: naam lait at  moorh  sugi-aanaa.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, the Divine Light blazes forth.
lines.transliteration: naam lait pargat ujee-aaraa.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, one's bonds are broken. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam lait chh utay janjaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, the Messenger of Death does not draw near.
lines.transliteration: naam lait jam nayrh  na aavai.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, one finds peace in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam lait d argeh sukh  paavai.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, God gives His Approval.
lines.transliteration: naam lait parabh  kahai saabaas.

lines.english: The Naam is my true wealth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam hamaaree saachee raas. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru has instructed me in these sublime teachings.
lines.transliteration: gur updays kahi-o ih saar.

lines.english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and the Naam are the Support of the mind.
lines.transliteration: har keerat man naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਜਮੁ ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is saved through the atonement of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhray naam punahchaar.

lines.english: Other actions are just to please and appease the people. ||4||12||25|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1142-15) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: avar karam lokah patee-aar. ||4||12||25||

lines.english: I bow in humble worship, tens of thousands of times.
lines.transliteration: namaskaar taa ka-o lakh  baar.

lines.english: I offer this mind as a sacrifice.
lines.transliteration: ih man deejai t aa ka-o vaar.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, sufferings are erased.
lines.transliteration: simran taa kai miteh sant aap.

lines.english: Bliss wells up, and no disease is contracted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay anand na vi-aapahi taap. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the diamond, the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aiso heeraa nirmal naam.

lines.english: Chanting it, all works are perfectly completed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaas japat pooran sabh  kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Beholding Him, the house of pain is demolished.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee darisat d ukh dayraa dh ahai.

lines.english: The mind seizes the cooling, soothing, Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam seet al man gahai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of devotees worship His Feet.
lines.transliteration: anik bhagat  jaa kay charan poojaaree.

lines.english: He is the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooranhaaree. ||2||

lines.english: In an instant, He fills the empty to over-flowing.
lines.transliteration: khin meh oon ay subh ar bhari-aa.

lines.english: In an instant, He transforms the dry into green.
lines.transliteration: khin meh sookay keenay hari-aa.

lines.english: In an instant, He gives the homeless a home.
lines.transliteration: khin meh nithaavay ka-o d eeno thaan.

lines.english: In an instant, He bestows honor on the dishonored. ||3|| pMnw 1143
lines.transliteration: khin meh nimaan ay ka-o d eeno maan. ||3||

lines.english: The One Lord is totally pervading and permeating all.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ayk rahi-aa bh arpooraa.

lines.english: He alone meditates on the Lord, whose True Guru is Perfect.
lines.transliteration: so jaapai jis satgur pooraa.

lines.english: Such a person has the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises for his Support.
lines.transliteration: har keertan t aa ko aaDh aar.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is merciful to him. ||4||13||26|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1143-2) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jis aap da-i-aar. ||4||13||26||

lines.english: I was discarded and abandoned, but He has embellished me.
lines.transliteration: mohi duhaagan aap seegaaree.

lines.english: He has blessed me with beauty and His Love; through His Name, I am exalted.
lines.transliteration: roop rang day naam savaaree.

lines.english: All my pains and sorrows have been eradicated.
lines.transliteration: miti-o dukh  ar sagal sant aap.

lines.english: The Guru has become my Mother and Father. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur ho-ay mayray maa-ee baap. ||1||

lines.english: O my friends and companions, my household is in bliss.
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahayree mayrai garsat  anand.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, my Husband Lord has met me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa bhaytay mohi kant . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The fire of desire has been extinguished, and all my desires have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: tapat bujhee pooran sabh  aasaa.

lines.english: The darkness has been dispelled, and the Divine Light blazes forth.
lines.transliteration: mitay anDhayr bh a-ay pargaasaa.

lines.english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, is wondrous andamazing!
lines.transliteration: anhad sabad  achraj bismaad .

lines.english: Perfect is the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa pooraa parsaad. ||2||

lines.english: That person, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o pargat bha-ay gopaal.
taa kai d arsan sad aa nihaal. - by the Blessed Vision of his Darshan, I am forever enraptured.

lines.english: He obtains all virtues and so many treasures.
lines.transliteration: sarab gunaa t aa kai bahut  niDhaan.

lines.english: The True Guru blesses him with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o satgur d ee-o naam. ||3||

lines.english: That person who meets with his Lord and Master
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bhayti-o th aakur apnaa.
man tan seet al har har japnaa. - his mind and body are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.english: Says Nanak, such a humble being is pleasing to God;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jo jan parabh bh aa-ay.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1143-8) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taa kee rayn birlaa ko paa-ay. ||4||14||27|| only a rare few are blessed with the dust of his feet. ||4||14||27||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal does not hesitate to think about sin.
lines.transliteration: chitvat  paap na aalak aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He is not ashamed to spend time with prostitutes.
lines.transliteration: baysu-aa bhajat  kichh  nah sarmaavai.

lines.english: He works all day long,
lines.transliteration: saaro dinas majooree karai.
har simran kee vaylaa bajar sir parai. ||1|| but when it is time to remember the Lord, then a heavy stone falls on his head. ||1||

lines.english: Attached to Maya, the world is deluded and confused.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa lag bhoolo sansaar.

lines.english: The Deluder Himself has deluded the mortal, and now he is engrossed in worthlessworldly affairs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa-i-aa bh ulaavan haarai raach rahi-aa birthaa bi-uhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Gazing on Maya's illusion, its pleasures pass away.
lines.transliteration: paykhat  maa-i-aa rang bihaa-ay.

lines.english: He loves the shell, and ruins his life.
lines.transliteration: garhbarh  karai ka-udee rang laa-ay.

lines.english: Bound to blind worldly affairs, his mind wavers and wanders.
lines.transliteration: anDh bi-uhaar banDh  man Dh aavai.

lines.english: The Creator Lord does not come into his mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karnaihaar na jee-a meh aavai. ||2||

lines.english: Working and working like this, he only obtains pain,
lines.transliteration: karat karat  iv hee d ukh paa-i-aa.
pooran hot na kaaraj maa-i-aa. and his affairs of Maya are never completed.

lines.english: His mind is saturated with sexual desire, anger and greed.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  man leenaa.

lines.english: Wiggling like a fish out of water, he dies. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tarhaf moo-aa ji-o jal bin meenaa. ||3||

lines.english: One who has the Lord Himself as his Protector,
lines.transliteration: jis kay raakhay ho-ay har aap.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤ  ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam sadaa jap jaap. chants and meditates forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang har kay gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, he has found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||28|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1143-15) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur pooraa paa-i-aa. ||4||15||28||

lines.english: He alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.
lines.transliteration: apnee d a-i-aa karay so paa-ay.

lines.english: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: With the True Word of the Shabad in his heart and mind,
lines.transliteration: saach sabad hird ay man maahi.
janam janam kay kilvikh jaahi. ||1|| the sins of countless incarnations vanish. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Support of the soul.
lines.transliteration: raam naam jee-a ko aaDhaar.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, chant the Name continually, O Siblings of Destiny; It shall carry youacross the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad japahu nit  bhaa-ee t aar la-ay saagar sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who have this treasure of the Lord's Name written in their destiny,
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o likhi-aa har ayhu niDh aan.
say jan dargeh paavahi maan. those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.english: Singing His Glorious Praises with peace, poise and bliss,
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  gun gaa-o.
aagai milai nithaavay thaa-o. ||2|| even the homeless obtain a home hereafter. ||2||

lines.english: Throughout the ages, this has been the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: jugah jugantar ih t at saar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਜਪਹੁ ਿਨਤ  ਭਾਈ  ਤਾਿਰ  ਲਏ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and contemplate the Truth. pMnw 1144
lines.transliteration: har simran saachaa beechaar.

lines.english: He alone is attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, whom the Lord Himself attaches.
lines.transliteration: jis larh laa-ay la-ay so laagai.

lines.english: Asleep for countless incarnations, he now awakens. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa so-i-aa jaagai. ||3||

lines.english: Your devotees belong to You, and You belong to Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: tayray bh agat bhagtan kaa aap.

lines.english: You Yourself inspire them to chant Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: apnee mahimaa aapay jaap.

lines.english: All beings and creatures are in Your Hands.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  tayrai haath.

lines.english: Nanak's God is always with him. ||4||16||29|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1144-3) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kay parabh sad  hee saath. ||4||16||29||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਿਥ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Inner-knower of my heart.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai antarjaamee.

lines.english: The Naam is so useful to me.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai aavai kaamee.

lines.english: The Lord's Name permeates each and every hair of mine.
lines.transliteration: rom rom ravi-aa har naam.

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur poorai keeno d aan. ||1||

lines.english: The Jewel of the Naam is my treasure.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan mayrai bh andaar.

lines.english: It is inaccessible, priceless, infinite and incomparable. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: agam amolaa apar apaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam is my unmoving, unchanging Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai nihchal Dhanee.

lines.english: The glory of the Naam spreads over the whole world.
lines.transliteration: naam kee mahimaa sabh meh banee.

lines.english: The Naam is my perfect master of wealth.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai pooraa saahu.

lines.english: The Naam is my independence. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai bayparvaahu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.english: The Naam is my food and love.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai bhojan bh aa-o.

lines.english: The Naam is the objective of my mind.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai man kaa su-aa-o.

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I never forget the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam na visrai sant parsaad .

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, the Unstruck Sound-current of the Naad resounds. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam lait anhad  pooray naad . ||3||

lines.english: By God's Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay naam na-o niDh  paa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I am tuned in to the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay naam si-o ban aa-ee.

lines.english: Dhanvant ay say-ee parDh aan. They alone are wealthy and supreme,
O Nanak, who have the treasure of the Naam. ||4||17||30|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1144-9) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaa kai naam niDhaan. ||4||17||30||

lines.english: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.
lines.transliteration: too mayraa pit aa toohai mayraa maat aa.

lines.english: You are my Soul, my Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace.
lines.transliteration: too mayray jee-a paraan sukh -daata.

lines.english: You are my Lord and Master; I am Your slave.
lines.transliteration: too mayraa th aakur ha-o d aas tayraa.

lines.english: Without You, I have no one at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar nahee ko mayraa. ||1||

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and give me this gift,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa karahu parabh d aat.
tumHree ust at kara-o d in raat . ||1|| rahaa-o. that I may sing Your Praises, day and night. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: I am Your musical instrument, and You are the Musician.
lines.transliteration: ham tayray jant  too bajaavanhaaraa.

lines.english: I am Your beggar; please bless me with Your charity, O Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: ham tayray bh ikhaaree d aan d eh daataaraa.

lines.english: By Your Grace, I enjoy love and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: ta-o parsaad  rang ras maan ay.

lines.english: You are deep within each and every heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar tumeh samaan ay. ||2||

lines.english: By Your Grace, I chant the Name.
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay japee-ai naa-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang t umray gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: In Your Mercy, You take away our pains.
lines.transliteration: tumHree da-i-aa t ay ho-ay d arad binaas.

lines.english: By Your Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tumree ma-i-aa t ay kamal bigaas. ||3||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaar jaa-o gurdayv.

lines.english: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His service is immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: safal darsan jaa kee nirmal sayv.

lines.english: Be Merciful to me, O my Lord God and Master,
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu th aakur parabh  mayray.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1144-15) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai naanak nit  tayray. ||4||18||31|| that Nanak may continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||18||31||

lines.english: His Regal Court is the highest of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch jaa kaa d arbaar.

lines.english: I humbly bow to Him, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa taa ka-o johaar.

lines.english: His place is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: oochay tay oochaa jaa kaa thaan.

lines.english: Millions of sins are erased by the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot aghaa miteh har naam. ||1||

lines.english: In His Sanctuary, we find eternal peace.
lines.transliteration: tis sarn aa-ee sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: He Mercifully unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jaa ka-o maylai so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: His wondrous actions cannot even be described.
lines.transliteration: jaa kay kartab lakh ay na jaahi.

lines.english: All hearts rest their faith and hope in Him.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa bharvaasaa sabh  ghat maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨ ॥
lines.english: He is manifest in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-i-aa saaDh oo kai sang.

lines.english: The devotees lovingly worship and adore Him night and day. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  araaDh eh an-d in rang. ||2||

lines.english: He gives, but His treasures are never exhausted.
lines.transliteration: dayday tot nahee bh andaar.

lines.english: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.
lines.transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanhaaraa.

lines.english: No one can erase the Hukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa hukam na maytai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ  ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is above the heads of kings. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sir paatisaahaa saachaa so-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ  ਸਭ ਘਟ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He is my Anchor and Support; I place my hopes in Him. pMnw 1145
lines.transliteration: jis kee ot tisai kee aasaa.

lines.english: I place my pain and pleasure before Him.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  hamraa t is hee paasaa.

lines.english: He covers the faults of His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: raakh leeno sabh  jan kaa parh -daa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਨੋ  ਸਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak sings His Praises. ||4||19||32|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1145-2) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis kee ust at kardaa. ||4||19||32||

lines.english: The whiner whines every day.
lines.transliteration: rovanhaaree roj banaa-i-aa.

lines.english: His attachment to his household and entanglements cloud his mind.
lines.transliteration: balan bartan ka-o san-banDh  chit aa-i-aa.

lines.english: If someone becomes detached through understanding,
lines.transliteration: boojh bairaag karay jay ko-ay.
janam maran fir sog na ho-ay. ||1|| he will not have to suffer in birth and death again. ||1||

lines.english: All of his conflicts are extensions of his corruption.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa kaa sabh  DhanDh pasaar.

lines.english: How rare is that person who takes the Naam as his Support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: virlai keeno naam aDhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The three-phased Maya infects all.
lines.transliteration: taribaDh  maa-i-aa rahee bi-aap.

lines.english: Whoever clings to it suffers pain and sorrow.
lines.transliteration: jo laptaano tis d ookh santaap.

lines.english: There is no peace without meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sukh naahee bin naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: By great good fortune, the treasure of the Naam is received. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan badbh aagee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: One who loves the actor in his mind,
lines.transliteration: savaaNgee si-o jo man reejhaavai.
savaag utaari-ai fir pachh utaavai. later regrets it when the actor takes off his costume.

lines.english: The shade from a cloud is transitory,
lines.transliteration: maygh kee chh aa-i-aa jaisay bart anhaar.
taiso parpanch moh bikaar. ||3|| like the worldly paraphernalia of attachment and corruption. ||3||

lines.english: If someone is blessed with the singular substance,
lines.transliteration: ayk vasat jay paavai ko-ay.
pooran kaaj taahee kaa ho-ay. then all of his tasks are accomplished to perfection.

lines.english: One who obtains the Naam, by Guru's Grace
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad jin paa-i-aa naam.

lines.english: - O Nanak, his coming into the world is certified and approved. ||4||20||33|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1145-8) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aa-i-aa so parvaan. ||4||20||33||

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, the mortal wanders in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: sant kee nind aa jonee bh avnaa.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, he is diseased.
lines.transliteration: sant kee nind aa rogee karnaa.

lines.english: Slandering the Saints, he suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: sant kee nind aa dookh sahaam.

lines.english: The slanderer is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daan dait  nindak ka-o jaam. ||1||

lines.english: Those who argue and fight with the Saints
lines.transliteration: satsang karahi jo baad .
tin nind ak naahee kichh  saad . ||1|| rahaa-o. - those slanderers find no happiness at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Slandering the devotees, the wall of the mortal's body is shattered.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kee nind aa kanDh  chhaydaavai.

lines.english: Slandering the devotees, he suffers in hell.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kee nind aa narak bh unchaavai.

lines.english: Slandering the devotees, he rots in the womb.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kee nind aa garabh  meh galai.

lines.english: Slandering the devotees, he loses his realm and power. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kee nind aa raaj t ay talai. ||2||

lines.english: The slanderer finds no salvation at all.
lines.transliteration: nindak kee gat  kathoo naahi.

lines.english: He eats only that which he himself has planted.
lines.transliteration: aap beej aapay hee khaahi.

lines.english: He is worse than a thief, a lecher, or a gambler.
lines.transliteration: chor jaar joo-aar tay buraa.

lines.english: The slanderer places an unbearable burden upon his head. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anhod aa bh aar nind ak sir Dh araa. ||3||

lines.english: The devotees of the Supreme Lord God are beyond hate and vengeance.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kay bhagat  nirvair.

lines.english: Whoever worships their feet is emancipated.
lines.transliteration: so nistarai jo poojai pair.

lines.english: The Primal Lord God has deluded and confused the slanderer.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  nindak bh olaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the record of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||4||21||34|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1145-14) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirat na jaa-ay mitaa-i-aa. ||4||21||34||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the Vedas and the Sound-current of the Naad.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai bayd ar naad .

lines.english: Through the Naam, my tasks are perfectly accomplished.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai pooray kaaj.

lines.english: The Naam is my worship of deities.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai poojaa dayv.

lines.english: The Naam is my service to the Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai gur kee sayv. ||1||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai darirh a-o har naam.

lines.english: The highest task of all is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay oot am har har kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam is my cleansing bath and purification.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai majan isnaan.

lines.english: The Naam is my perfect donation of charity.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai pooran daan.

lines.english: Those who repeat the Naam are totally purified.
lines.transliteration: naam lait t ay sagal paveet .

lines.english: Those who chant the Naam are my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam japat mayray bh aa-ee meet . ||2||

lines.english: The Naam is my auspicious omen and good fortune.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai sa-un sanjog.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Naam is the sublime food which satisfies me.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai taripat  subh og.

lines.english: The Naam is my good conduct.
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai sagal aachaar.

lines.english: The Naam is my immaculate occupation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam hamaarai nirmal bi-uhaar. ||3||

lines.english: All those humble beings whose minds are filled with the One God
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man vasi-aa parabh ayk.
sagal janaa kee har har tayk. have the Support of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with your mind and body.
lines.transliteration: man tan naanak har gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord bestows His Name. ||4||22||35|| pMnw 1146 BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1146-1) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jis d ayvai naa-o. ||4||22||35||

lines.english: You bless the poor with wealth, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: nirDhan ka-o t um dayvhu Dh anaa.

lines.english: Countless sins are taken away, and the mind becomes immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: anik paap jaahi nirmal manaa.

lines.english: All the mind's desires are fulfilled, and one's tasks are perfectly accomplished.
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooran kaam.

lines.english: You bestow Your Name upon Your devotee. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  apunay ka-o d ayvhu naam. ||1||

lines.english: Service to the Lord, our Sovereign King, is fruitful and rewarding.
lines.transliteration: safal sayvaa gopaal raa-ay.
