lines.english: Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes; no one is turned away fromHis Door empty-handed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar su-aamee taa t ay birthaa ko-ay na jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God eradicates the disease from the diseased person.
lines.transliteration: rogee kaa parabh kh andahu rog.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਾ ਤੇ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God takes away the sorrows of the suffering.
lines.transliteration: dukhee-ay kaa mitaavhu parabh  sog.

lines.english: And those who have no place at all - You seat them upon the place.
lines.transliteration: nithaavay ka-o tumH thaan baith aavahu.

lines.english: You link Your slave to devotional worship. ||2||
lines.transliteration: daas apnay ka-o bh agtee laavhu. ||2||

lines.english: God bestows honor on the dishonored.
lines.transliteration: nimaanay ka-o parabh  dayto maan.

lines.english: He makes the foolish and ignorant become clever and wise.
lines.transliteration: moorh mugaDh  ho-ay chat ur sugi-aan.

lines.english: The fear of all fear disappears.
lines.transliteration: sagal bha-i-aan kaa bh a-o nasai.

lines.english: The Lord dwells within the mind of His humble servant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan apnay kai har man basai. ||3||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is the Treasure of Peace.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh sookh  niDhaan.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: tat gi-aan har amrit  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ  ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਬਸੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, He enjoins the mortals to serve the Saints.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa sant tahlai laa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, such a person merges in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.||4||23||36|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1146-7) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saaDhoo sang samaa-ay. ||4||23||36||

lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh har man vasai.

lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, all sins run away.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh d urat sabh  nasai.

lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, one's lifestyle is immaculate.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh nirmal reet .

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, one comes to love the One Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsang ho-ay ayk pareet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.english: That alone is called the Realm of the Saints,
lines.transliteration: sant mandal t ahaa kaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਮਿਹ ਦੁਰਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kayval gun gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. where only the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God are sung. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, birth and death are ended.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh janam maran  rahai.

lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, the Messenger of Death cannot touch the mortal.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh jam kichh oo na kahai.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, one's speech becomes immaculate
lines.transliteration: satsang ho-ay nirmal ban ee.

lines.english: In the realm of the saints, the Lord's Name is chanted. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh naam vakh aanee. ||2||

lines.english: The Realm of the Saints is the eternal, ever-stable place.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal kaa nihchal aasan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਮਿਹ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, sins are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh paap binaasan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਮਿਹ ਜਮੁ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, the immaculate sermon is spoken.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh nirmal kathaa.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, the pain of egotism runs away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satsang ha-umai d ukh nasaa. ||3||

lines.english: The Realm of the Saints cannot be destroyed.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal kaa nahee binaas.

lines.english: In the Realm of the Saints, is the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal meh har gunt aas.

lines.english: The Realm of the Saints is the resting place of our Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sant mandal th aakur bisraam.

lines.english: O Nanak, He is woven into the fabric of His devotees, through and through. ||4||24||37|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1146-13) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ot pot  bhagvaan. ||4||24||37||

lines.english: Why worry about disease, when the Lord Himself protects us?
lines.transliteration: rog kavan jaaN raakhai aap.

lines.english: That person whom the Lord protects, does not suffer pain and sorrow.
lines.transliteration: tis jan ho-ay na d ookh santaap.

lines.english: That person, upon whom God showers His Mercy
lines.transliteration: jis oopar parabh kirpaa karai.

lines.english: - Death hovering above him is turned away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis oopar t ay kaal parharai. ||1||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever our Help and Support.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sakh aa-ee har har naam.

lines.english: When He comes to mind, the mortal finds lasting peace, and the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis cheet aavai t is sad aa sukh  hovai nikat na aavai t aa kai jaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When this being did not exist, who created him then?
lines.transliteration: jab ih na so tab kineh upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: What has been produced from the source?
lines.transliteration: kavan mool tay ki-aa paragtaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself kills, and He Himself rejuvenates.
lines.transliteration: aapeh maar aap jeevaalai.

lines.english: He cherishes His devotees forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: apnay bhagat  ka-o sad aa parat ipaalai. ||2||

lines.english: Know that everything is in His Hands.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  jaanhu tis kai haath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਚੀਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My God is the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayro anaath ko naath.

lines.english: His Name is the Destroyer of pain.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhanjan t aa kaa hai naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਨ ਸੋ ਤਬ ਿਕਨਿਹ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Singing His Glorious Praises, you shall find peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sukh paavahi t is kay gun  gaa-o. ||3||

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your Saint.
lines.transliteration: sun su-aamee sant an ard aas.

lines.english: I place my soul, my breath of life and wealth before You.
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan Dhan t umHrai paas.

lines.english: All this world is Yours; it meditates on You. pMnw 1147
lines.transliteration: ih jag tayraa sabh  tujheh Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Please shower Nanak with Your Mercy and bless him with peace. ||4||25||38|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1147-1) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa naanak sukh paa-ay. ||4||25||38||

lines.english: With Your Support, I survive in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk rahaa kal maahi.

lines.english: With Your Support, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk t ayray gun  gaahi.

lines.english: With Your Support, death cannot even touch me.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk na pohai kaal.

lines.english: With Your Support, my entanglements vanish. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk binsai janjaal. ||1||

lines.english: In this world and the next, I have Your Support.
lines.transliteration: deen d unee-aa t ayree tayk.

lines.english: The One Lord, our Lord and Master, is all-pervading. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ravi-aa saahib ayk. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With Your Support, I celebrate blissfully.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk kara-o aanand .

lines.english: With Your Support, I chant the Guru's Mantra.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk japa-o gur mant .

lines.english: With Your Support, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk t aree-ai bh a-o saagar.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord, our Protector and Savior, is the Ocean of Peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raakhan haar pooraa sukh  saagar. ||2||

lines.english: With Your Support, I have no fear.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk naahee bh a-o ko-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee saachaa so-ay.

lines.english: With Your Support, my mind is filled with Your Power.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk t ayraa man t aan.

lines.english: Here and there, You are my Court of Appeal. ||3||
lines.transliteration: eehaaN oohaaN too d eebaan . ||3||

lines.english: I take Your Support, and place my faith in You.
lines.transliteration: tayree tayk t ayraa bh arvaasaa.

lines.english: All meditate on God, the Treasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: sagal Dhi-aavahi parabh  guntaasaa.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating on You, Your slaves celebrate in bliss.
lines.transliteration: jap jap anad karahi t ayray d aasaa.

lines.english: Nanak meditates in remembrance on the True Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||26||39|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1147-7) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar naanak saachay guntaasaa. ||4||26||39||

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਅਨਦੁ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: First, I gave up slandering others.
lines.transliteration: parathmay chhodee paraa-ee nind aa.

lines.english: All the anxiety of my mind was dispelled.
lines.transliteration: utar ga-ee sabh  man kee chind aa.

lines.english: Greed and attachment were totally banished.
lines.transliteration: lobh moh sabh  keeno d oor.

lines.english: I see God ever-present, close at hand; I have become a great devotee. ||1||
lines.transliteration: param baisno parabh paykh  hajoor. ||1||

lines.english: Such a renunciate is very rare.
lines.transliteration: aiso ti-aagee virlaa ko-ay.

lines.english: Such a humble servant chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam japai jan so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have forsaken my egotistical intellect.
lines.transliteration: ahaN-buDh kaa chh odi-aa sang.

lines.english: The love of sexual desire and anger has vanished.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh kaa ut ri-aa rang.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-ay har har haray.

lines.english: In the Company of the Holy, I am emancipated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa kai sang nist aray. ||2||

lines.english: Enemy and friend are all the same to me.
lines.transliteration: bairee meet ho-ay sammaan.

lines.english: The Perfect Lord God is permeating all.
lines.transliteration: sarab meh pooran bhagvaan.

lines.english: Accepting the Will of God, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee aagi-aa maan sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam drirh-aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: That person, whom the Lord, in His Mercy, saves
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis raakhai aap.
so-ee bhagat  japai naam jaap. - that devotee chants and meditates on the Naam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਮਾਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: That person, whose mind is illumined, and who obtains understanding through the Guru
lines.transliteration: man pargaas gur tay mat  la-ee.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1147-13) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak taa kee pooree pa-ee. ||4||27||40|| - says Nanak, he is totally fulfilled. ||4||27||40||

lines.english: There is no peace in earning lots of money.
lines.transliteration: sukh naahee bahut ai Dhan kh aatay.

lines.english: There is no peace in watching dances and plays.
lines.transliteration: sukh naahee paykh ay nirat  naatay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਿਤ ਲਈ ॥
lines.english: There is no peace in conquering lots of countries.
lines.transliteration: sukh naahee baho d ays kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੪੦॥
lines.english: All peace comes from singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa har har gun  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: You shall obtain peace, poise and bliss,
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  lahhu.

lines.english: Gurmukh, utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  paa-ee-ai vadbh aagee gurmukh  har har naam kahhu. ||1|| rahaa-o. when you find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by great good fortune. As

lines.english: Mother, father, children and spouse - all place the mortal in bondage.
lines.transliteration: banDhan maat  pitaa sut  banit aa.

lines.english: Religious rituals and actions done in ego place the mortal in bondage.
lines.transliteration: banDhan karam Dh aram ha-o kart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If the Lord, the Shatterer of bonds, abides in the mind,
lines.transliteration: banDhan kaatanhaar man vasai.
ta-o sukh  paavai nij gh ar basai. ||2|| then peace is obtained, dwelling in the home of the self deep within. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everyone is a beggar; God is the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: sabh jaachik parabh  dayvanhaar.

lines.english: The Treasure of Virtue is the Infinite, Endless Lord.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan bay-ant  apaar.

lines.english: That person, unto whom God grants His Mercy
lines.transliteration: jis no karam karay parabh apnaa.
har har naam tinai jan japnaa. ||3|| - that humble being chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

lines.english: I offer my prayer to my Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur apnay aagai ardaas.

lines.english: O Primal Lord God, Treasure of Virtue, please bless me with Your Grace.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa purakh gunt aas.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tumree sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: If it pleases You, please protect me, O Lord of the World. ||4||28||41|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1147-19) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh ahu gusaa-ee. ||4||28||41||

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, I have forsaken the love of duality. pMnw 1148
lines.transliteration: gur mil ti-aagi-o d oojaa bh aa-o.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh japi-o har kaa naa-o.

lines.english: My anxiety is gone, and I am in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bisree chint naam rang laagaa.

lines.english: I was asleep for countless lifetimes, but I have now awakened. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa so-i-aa jaagaa. ||1||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He has linked me to His service.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnee sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pleasures are found. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang sarab sukh  paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has eradicated disease and evil.
lines.transliteration: rog dokh  gur sabad  nivaaray.

lines.english: My mind has absorbed the medicine of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: naam a-ukhaDh  man bh eetar saaray.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, my mind is in bliss.
lines.transliteration: gur bhaytat  man bh a-i-aa anand.

lines.english: All treasures are in the Name of the Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan naam bh agvant . ||2||

lines.english: My fear of birth and death and the Messenger of Death has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee mitee jam t araas.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  ooNDh kamal bigaas.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I have found eternal, abiding peace.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  nihchal bisraam.

lines.english: All my tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pooran ho-ay saglay kaam. ||3||

lines.english: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is approved by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dulabh  dayh aa-ee parvaan.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, it has become fruitful.
lines.transliteration: safal ho-ee jap har har naam.

lines.english: Says Nanak, God has blessed me with His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh kirpaa karee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਹੋਈ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: With every breath and morsel of food, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||29||42|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1148-6) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas giraas japa-o har haree. ||4||29||42||

lines.english: His Name is the Highest of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay oochaa jaa kaa naa-o.

lines.english: Sing His Glorious Praises, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa taa kay gun  gaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all pain is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat saglaa d ukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: All pleasures come to dwell in the mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh vaseh man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate in remembrance on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: simar manaa too saachaa so-ay.

lines.english: In this world and the next, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  tumree gat  ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Immaculate Lord God is the Creator of all.
lines.transliteration: purakh niranjan sirjanhaar.

lines.english: He gives sustenance to all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant d ayvai aahaar.

lines.english: He forgives millions of sins and mistakes in an instant.
lines.transliteration: kot khat ay kh in bakh sanhaar.

lines.english: Through loving devotional worship, one is emancipated forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-ay sad aa nist aar. ||2||

lines.english: True wealth and true glorious greatness,
lines.transliteration: saachaa Dhan saachee vadi-aa-ee.
gur pooray tay nihchal mat  paa-ee. and eternal, unchanging wisdom, are obtained from the Perfect Guru.

lines.english: When the Protector, the Savior Lord, bestows His Mercy,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis raakhanhaaraa.
taa kaa sagal mitai anDh i-aaraa. ||3|| all spiritual darkness is dispelled. ||3||

lines.english: I focus my meditation on the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm si-o laago Dhi-aan.

lines.english: The Lord of Nirvaanaa is totally pervading and permeating all.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o nirbaan.

lines.english: Eradicating doubt and fear, I have met the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh a-o mayt milay gopaal.

lines.english: The Guru has become merciful to Nanak. ||4||30||43|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1148-13) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur bha-ay d a-i-aal. ||4||30||43||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is illumined.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat man ho-ay pargaas.

lines.english: Suffering is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: miteh kalays sukh sahj nivaas.

lines.english: They alone receive it, unto whom God gives it.
lines.transliteration: tiseh paraapat  jis parabh  day-ay.

lines.english: They are blessed to serve the Perfect Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur kee paa-ay sayv. ||1||

lines.english: All peace and comfort are in Your Name, God.
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa parabh  tayro naa-o.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar mayray man gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You shall receive the fruits of your desires,
lines.transliteration: jo ichhai so-ee fal paa-ay.
har kaa naam man vasaa-ay. when the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਏ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, your comings and goings cease.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay har Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Through loving devotional worship, lovingly focus your attention on God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-ay parabh  kee liv laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and egotism are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: binsay kaam kroDh ahaNkaar.

lines.english: Love and attachment to Maya are broken.
lines.transliteration: tootay maa-i-aa moh pi-aar.

lines.english: Lean on God's Support, day and night.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee tayk rahai d in raat .

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has given this gift. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm karay jis daat . ||3||

lines.english: Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanhaar su-aamee.

lines.english: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa kay ant arjaamee.

lines.english: Bless me with Your Grace, Lord, and link me to Your service.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnee sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.english: Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||31||44|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1148-19) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ay. ||4||31||44||

lines.english: One who does not repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die of shame.
lines.transliteration: laaj marai jo naam na layvai.

lines.english: Without the Name, how can he ever sleep in peace?
lines.transliteration: naam bihoon sukhee ki-o sovai.

lines.english: The mortal abandons meditative remembrance of the Lord, and then wishes for the state of supreme salvation; pMnw 1149
lines.transliteration: har simran chhaad param gat  chaahai.
mool binaa saakhaa kat  aahai. ||1|| but without roots, how can there be any branches? ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gur govind mayray man Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: The filth of countless incarnations shall be washed away. Breaking your bonds, you shall be united with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee mail utaarai banDh an kaat har sang milaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can a stone be purified by bathing at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage?
lines.transliteration: tirath naa-ay kahaa such sail.

lines.english: The filth of egotism clings to the mind.
lines.transliteration: man ka-o vi-aapai ha-umai mail.

lines.english: Millions of rituals and actions taken are the root of entanglements.
lines.transliteration: kot karam banDhan kaa mool.

lines.english: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, the mortal gathers only worthless bundles of straw. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kay bhajan bin birthaa pool. ||2||

lines.english: Without eating, hunger is not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: bin khaa-ay boojh ai nahee bh ookh.

lines.english: When the disease is cured, then the pain goes away.
lines.transliteration: rog jaa-ay taaN utreh dookh.

lines.english: The mortal is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mohi bi-aapi-aa.

lines.english: He does not meditate on God, that God who created him. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin parabh keenaa so parabh  nahee jaapi-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Dhan Dh an saaDh  Dhan har naa-o. Blessed, blessed is the Holy Saint, and blessed is the Name of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕੀਨਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਿਪਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Kirtan, the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar keert an gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan har bh agat Dhan karn aihaar. Blessed is the devotee of the Lord, and blessed is the Creator Lord.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Primal, the Infinite. ||4||32||45|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1149-6) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saran naanak parabh  purakh  apaar. ||4||32||45||

lines.english: When the Guru was totally pleased, my fear was taken away.
lines.transliteration: gur suparsan ho-ay bha-o ga-ay.

lines.english: I enshrine the Name of the Immaculate Lord within my mind.
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan man meh la-ay.

lines.english: He is Merciful to the meek, forever Compassionate.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal sad aa kirpaal.

lines.english: All my entanglements are finished. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binas ga-ay saglay janjaal. ||1||

lines.english: I have found peace, poise, and myriads of pleasures.
lines.transliteration: sookh sahj aanand  ghanay.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt are dispelled. Mytongue chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mitay bh ai bharmaa amrit  har har rasan bh anay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have fallen in love with the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laago hayt.

lines.english: In an instant, the terrible demons are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: khin meh binsi-o mahaa parayt .

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨ  ਭਨੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har har jap jaap.

lines.english: The Guru is Himself the Savior Lord, the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaar govid  gur aap. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself cherishes His servant forever.
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak ka-o sadaa part ipaarai.

lines.english: He watches over every breath of His humble devotee.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kay saas nihaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me, what is the nature of human beings?
lines.transliteration: maanas kee kaho kaytak baat .

lines.english: The Lord extends His Hand, and saves them from the Messenger of Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jam tay raakh ai day kar haath. ||3||

lines.english: Immaculate is the Glory, and Immaculate is the way of life,
lines.transliteration: nirmal sobhaa nirmal reet .
paarbarahm aa-i-aa man cheet. of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their minds.

lines.english: The Guru, in His Mercy, has granted this Gift.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur deeno d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੇ ਕਿਰ ਹਾਥ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||33||46|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1149-13) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak paa-i-aa naam niDhaan. ||4||33||46||

lines.english: My Guru is the All-powerful Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath gur mayraa.

lines.english: He is the Soul, the Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace, always near.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan sukh -daata nayraa.

lines.english: He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eternal, Unchanging, Sovereign Lord King.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh anjan abh inaasee raa-ay.

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all fear is dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykhi-ai sabh  dukh jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Wherever I look, is the Protection of Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  paykh a-o tayree sarn aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaa-ee satgur charn aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My tasks are perfectly accomplished, meeting the Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: pooran kaam milay gurdayv.

lines.english: He is the Giver of all rewards. Serving Him, I am immaculate.
lines.transliteration: sabh fald aataa nirmal sayv.

lines.english: He reaches out with His Hand to His slaves.
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay apunay daas.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord abides in their hearts. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam rid d ee-o nivaas. ||2||

lines.english: They are forever in bliss, and do not suffer at all.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand naahee kichh  sog.

lines.english: No pain, sorrow or disease afflicts them.
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad nah bi-aapai rog.

lines.english: Everything is Yours, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tayraa t oo karn aihaar.

lines.english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Inaccessible and Infinite. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm gur agam apaar. ||3||

lines.english: His Glorious Grandeur is immaculate, and the Bani of His Word is wonderful!
lines.transliteration: nirmal sobhaa achraj ban ee.

lines.english: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm pooran man bhaan ee.

lines.english: He is permeating the waters, the lands and the skies.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al ravi-aa so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, everything comes from God. ||4||34||47|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1149-19) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh  parabh  tay ho-ay. ||4||34||47||

lines.english: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Feet. pMnw 1150
lines.transliteration: man tan raat aa raam rang charn ay.

lines.english: All the desires of my mind have been perfectly fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sarab manorath pooran karnay.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gaavat  bhagvant .

lines.english: The True Guru has imparted this perfect wisdom. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur d eeno pooraa mant . ||1||

lines.english: Very fortunate are those who love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so vadbhaagee jis naam pi-aar.

lines.english: Associating with them, we cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis kai sang t arai sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They are spiritual teachers, who meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: so-ee gi-aanee je simrai ayk.

lines.english: Wealthy are those who have a discriminating intellect.
lines.transliteration: so Dhanvant aa jis buDh  bibayk.

lines.english: Noble are those who remember their Lord and Master in meditation.
lines.transliteration: so kulvantaa je simrai su-aamee.

lines.english: Honorable are those who understand their own selves. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so pativant aa je aap pachh aanee. ||2||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Day and night I meditate on the Glories of God.
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal d in rain Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: My bonds are broken, and my hopes are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: tootay banDh an pooran aasaa.

lines.english: The Feet of the Lord now abide in my heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kay charan rid  maahi nivaasaa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa kay pooran karmaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਰਮਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: so jan aa-i-aa parabh kee sarnaa. - that humble being enters the Sanctuary of God.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: He himself is pure, and he sanctifies all.
lines.transliteration: aap pavit paavan sabh  keenay.

lines.english: His tongue chants the Name of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||4||35||48|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1150-6) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam rasaa-in rasnaa cheenHay. ||4||35||48||

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no obstacles block the way.
lines.transliteration: naam lait kichh  bighan na laagai.

lines.english: Listening to the Naam, the Messenger of Death runs far away.
lines.transliteration: naam sunat  jam Dh oorahu bh aagai.

lines.english: Repeating the Naam, all pains vanish.
lines.transliteration: naam lait sabh  dookhah naas.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Lord's Lotus Feet dwell within. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam japat har charan  nivaas. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating, vibrating the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is unobstructed devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: nirbighan bh agat bhaj har har naa-o.

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving affection and energy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rasak rasak har kay gun gaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Eye of Death cannot see you.
lines.transliteration: har simrat kichh  chaakh  na johai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, demons and ghosts shall not touch you.
lines.transliteration: har simrat d ait day-o na pohai.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, attachment and pride shall not bind you.
lines.transliteration: har simrat moh maan na baDh ai.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall not be consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har simrat garabh  jon na ruDh ai. ||2||

lines.english: Any time is a good time to meditate in remembrance on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har simran kee saglee baylaa.

lines.english: Among the masses, only a few meditate in remembrance on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har simran baho maahi ikaylaa.

lines.english: Social class or no social class, anyone may meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaat ajaat  japai jan ko-ay.

lines.english: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo jaapai tis kee gat  ho-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam japee-ai saaDhsang.

lines.english: Perfect is the Love of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kaa pooran rang.

lines.english: O God, shower Your Mercy on Nanak,
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1150-13) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas saas har dayh chit aar. ||4||36||49|| that he may think of you with each and every breath. ||4||36||49||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ  ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Shaastras, and He Himself is the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: aapay saasat aapay bayd .

lines.english: He knows the secrets of each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: aapay ghat gh at jaan ai bhayd.

lines.english: He is the Embodiment of Light; all beings belong to Him.
lines.transliteration: jot saroop jaa kee sabh  vath.

lines.english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the Perfect All-powerful Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  pooran samrath. ||1||

lines.english: Grab hold of the Support of God, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee ot gahhu man mayray.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, worship and adore His Lotus Feet; enemies and pains shall not even approach you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gurmukh aaraaDh ahu d usman d ookh na aavai nayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ ਸਰੂਪ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Essence of the forests and fields, and all the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: aapay van t arin taribhavan saar.

lines.english: The universe is strung on His Thread.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai soot paro-i-aa sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He is the Uniter of Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter.
lines.transliteration: aapay siv saktee sanjogee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself is in the detachment of Nirvaanaa, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap nirbaanee aapay bh ogee. ||2||

lines.english: Wherever I look, there He is.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  paykh a-o tat tat so-ay.

lines.english: Without Him, there is no one at all.
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oojaa naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: In the Love of the Naam, the world-ocean is crossed.
lines.transliteration: saagar taree-ai naam kai rang.

lines.english: Nanak sings His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai naanak saaDh sang. ||3||

lines.english: Liberation, the ways and means of enjoyment and union are under His Control.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh ugat jugat  vas jaa kai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: His humble servant lacks nothing.
lines.transliteration: oonaa naahee kichh  jan taa kai.

lines.english: That person, with whom the Lord, in His Mercy, is pleased
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jis ho-ay suparsan.

lines.english: - O slave Nanak, that humble servant is blessed. ||4||37||50|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1150-19) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas say-ee jan Dh an. ||4||37||50||

lines.english: The minds of the Lord's devotee are filled with bliss.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa man aanand  gobind .

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭੁਗਿਤ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਵਿਸ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: They become stable and permanent, and all their anxiety is gone. pMnw 1151
lines.transliteration: asthit bh a-ay binsee sabh  chind .

lines.english: Their fears and doubts are dispelled in an instant.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aram binas ga-ay kh in maahi.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm vasi-aa man aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord is forever the Help and Support of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: raam raam sant sad aa sahaa-ay.

lines.english: Inside the home of the heart, and outside as well, the Transcendent Lord is alwayswith us, permeating and pervading all places. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar naalay parmaysar rav rahi-aa pooran sabh  thaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਨਾਲੇ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਭ ਠਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan maal joban jugat  gopaal. The Lord of the World is my wealth, property, youth and ways and means.
He continually cherishes and brings peace to my soul and breath of life.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan nit  sukh  partipaal.

lines.english: He reaches out with His Hand and saves His slave.
lines.transliteration: apnay daas ka-o d ay raakh ai haath.

lines.english: He does not abandon us, even for an instant; He is always with us. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nimakh na chh odai sad  hee saath. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: There is no other Beloved like the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har saa pareetam avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: The True Lord takes care of all.
lines.transliteration: saar samHaalay saachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is our Mother, Father, Son and Relation.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  banDh  naraa-in .

lines.english: Since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages, His devotees sing His GloriousPraises. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  bhagat gun gaa-in . ||3||

lines.english: My mind is filled with the Support and the Power of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis kee Dh ar parabh  kaa man jor.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਭਗਤ  ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਇਣੁ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayk binaa doojaa nahee hor.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਮਿਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak's mind is encouraged by this hope,
lines.transliteration: naanak kai man ih purkhaarath.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1151-7) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabhoo hamaaraa saaray su-aarath. ||4||38||51|| that God will accomplish my objectives in life. ||4||38||51||

lines.english: Fear itself becomes afraid, when the mortal remembers the Lord's Name in meditation.
lines.transliteration: bhai ka-o bh a-o parh i-aa simrat  har naam.

lines.english: All the diseases of the three gunas - the three qualities - are cured, and tasks of theLord's slaves are perfectly accomplished. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal bi-aaDh mitee t arihu gun  kee d aas kay ho-ay pooran kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The people of the Lord always sing His Glorious Praises; they attain His PerfectMansion.
lines.transliteration: har kay lok sadaa gun  gaavahi t in ka-o mili-aa pooran Dh aam.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪਿੜਆ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma and the Messenger of Death yearn, day andnight, to be sanctified by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan kaa daras baaNchhai din raat ee ho-ay puneet  Dharam raa-ay jaam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਿਮਟੀ  ਿਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication, egotism, slander and egotistical pride are eradictedin the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mad nindaa saaDh sang miti-aa abh imaan.

lines.english: By great good fortune, such Saints are met. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them.||2||39||52|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1151-11) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aisay sant bh ayteh vadbh aagee naanak t in kai sad  kurbaan. ||2||39||52||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਧਾਮ ॥
lines.english: One who harbors the five thieves, becomes the embodiment of these five.
lines.transliteration: panch majmee jo panchan raakhai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ  ਬਛੈ ਿਦਨ ਰਾਤੀ  ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He gets up each day and tells lies.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa rasnaa nit uth  bhaakhai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਿਨੰਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: He applies ceremonial religious marks to his body, but practices hypocrisy.
lines.transliteration: chakar banaa-ay karai pakh and.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਹ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ  ॥੨॥੩੯॥੫੨॥
lines.english: He wastes away in sadness and pain, like a lonely widow. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jhur jh ur pachai jaisay t ari-a rand. ||1||

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, everything is false.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam binaa sabh jh ooth.

lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, liberation is not obtained. In the Court of the True Lord, the faithless cynic is plundered. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin gur pooray mukat na paa-ee-ai saachee d argahi saakat  mooth . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who does not know the Lord's Creative Power is polluted.
lines.transliteration: so-ee kucheel kudrat  nahee jaanai.

lines.english: Ritualistically plastering one's kitchen square does not make it pure in the Eyes of theLord.
lines.transliteration: leepi-ai thaa-ay na such har maanai.

lines.english: If a person is polluted within, he may wash himself everyday on the outside,
lines.transliteration: antar mailaa baahar nit  Dhovai.
saachee dargahi apnee pat  khovai. ||2|| but in the Court of the True Lord, he forfeits his honor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂਠੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He works for the sake of Maya,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran karai upaa-o.
kabeh na ghaalai seeDh aa paa-o. but he never places his feet on the right path.

lines.english: He never even remembers the One who created him.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tis cheet  na aan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਲੀਿਪਐ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਸੁਿਚ ਹਿਰ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: He speaks falsehood, only falsehood, with his mouth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: koorhee koorh ee mukh ahu vakh aanai. ||3||

lines.english: That person, unto whom the Creator Lord shows Mercy,
lines.transliteration: jis no karam karay kartaar.
saaDhsang ho-ay t is bi-uhaar. deals with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.english: One who lovingly worships the Lord's Name,
lines.transliteration: har naam bhagat  si-o laagaa rang.

lines.english: BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1151-18) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis jan nahee bh ang. ||4||40||53|| says Nanak - no obstacles ever block his way. ||4||40||53||

lines.english: The entire universe curses the slanderer.
lines.transliteration: nindak ka-o fitkay sansaar.

lines.english: False are the dealings of the slanderer.
lines.transliteration: nindak kaa jh oothaa bi-uhaar.

lines.english: The slanderer's lifestyle is filthy and polluted.
lines.transliteration: nindak kaa mailaa aachaar.

lines.english: The Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His slave. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daas apunay ka-o raakh anhaar. ||1||

lines.english: The slanderer dies with the rest of the slanderers.
lines.transliteration: nindak mu-aa nind ak kai naal.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, protects and saves His humble servant. Death roars and thunders over the head of the slanderer. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1152
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysar jan raakhay nind ak kai sir karh ki-o kaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: No one belives what the slanderer says.
lines.transliteration: nindak kaa kahi-aa ko-ay na maanai.

lines.english: The slanderer tells lies, and later regrets and repents.
lines.transliteration: nindak jh ooth bol pachh utaanay.

lines.english: He wrings his hands, and hits his head against the ground.
lines.transliteration: haath pachhoreh sir Dh aran lagaahi.

lines.english: The Lord does not forgive the slanderer. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nindak ka-o d a-ee chh odai naahi. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord's slave does not wish anyone ill.
lines.transliteration: har kaa daas kichh  buraa na maagai.

lines.english: The slanderer suffers, as if stabbed by a spear.
lines.transliteration: nindak ka-o laagai d ukh saaNgai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ  ॥
lines.english: Like a crane, he spreads his feathers, to look like a swan.
lines.transliteration: bagulay ji-o rahi-aa pankh pasaar.

lines.english: When he speaks with his mouth, then he is exposed and driven out. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mukh t ay boli-aa t aaN kadh i-aa beechaar. ||3||

lines.english: The Creator is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee kart aa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਤ ਕਿਢਆ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That person, whom the Lord makes His Own, becomes stable and steady.
lines.transliteration: har jan karai so nihchal ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord's slave is true in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa daas saachaa d arbaar.

lines.english: Servant Nanak speaks, after contemplating the essence of reality. ||4||41||54|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1152-6) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kahi-aa tat  beechaar. ||4||41||54||

lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jor kara-o ard aas.

lines.english: My soul, body and wealth are His property.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind Dhan t is kee raas.

lines.english: He is the Creator, my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: so-ee mayraa su-aamee karnaihaar.

lines.english: Millions of times, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot baar jaa-ee balihaar. ||1||

lines.english: The dust of the feet of the Holy brings purity.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo Dh oor puneet  karee.

lines.english: Remembering God in meditation, the mind's corruption is eradicated, and the filth ofcountless incarnations is washed away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man kay bikaar miteh parabh simrat  janam janam kee mail haree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All treasures are in His household.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai garih meh sagal niDhaan.

lines.english: Serving Him, the mortal attains honor.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayvaa paa-ee-ai maan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਿਬਕਾਰ ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooranhaar.

lines.english: He is the Support of the soul and the breath of life of His devotees. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan bhagt an aaDh aar. ||2||

lines.english: His Light shines in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar sagal pargaas.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating on God, the Treasure of Virtue, His devotees live.
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeeveh bhagat  guntaas.

lines.english: Service to Him does not go in vain.
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sayv na birthee jaa-ay.

lines.english: Deep within your mind and body, meditate on the One Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar ayk Dh i-aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, compassion and contentment are found.
lines.transliteration: gur updays d a-i-aa sant okh.

lines.english: This Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the immaculate object.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan nirmal ih thok.

lines.english: Please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa leejai larh laa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak meditates continually on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||4||42||55|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1152-13) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak nit Dh i-aa-ay. ||4||42||55||

lines.english: The True Guru has listened to my prayer.
lines.transliteration: satgur apunay sunee ard aas.

lines.english: All my affairs have been resolved.
lines.transliteration: kaaraj aa-i-aa saglaa raas.

lines.english: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar parabh oo Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has dispelled all my fears. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray dar sagal chukaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: The All-powerful Divine Guru is the Greatest of all.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay vad samrath gurd ayv.

lines.english: Serving Him, I obtain all comforts. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  paa-ee t is kee sayv. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Everything is done by Him.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa kee-aa sabh kichh  ho-ay.

lines.english: No one can erase His Eternal Decree.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa amar na maytai ko-ay.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysar anoop.

lines.english: The Guru is the Image of Fulfillment, the Embodiment of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: safal moorat gur t is kaa roop. ||2||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord abides deep within him.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai antar basai har naam.

lines.english: Wherever he looks, he sees the Wisdom of God.
lines.transliteration: jo jo paykhai so barahm gi-aan.

lines.english: His mind is totally enlightened and illuminated.
lines.transliteration: bees bisu-ay jaa kai man pargaas.

lines.english: Within that person, the Supreme Lord God abides. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis jan kai paarbarahm kaa nivaas. ||3||

lines.english: I humbly bow to that Guru forever.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o sad  karee namaskaar.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru.
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o sad  jaa-o balihaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਸੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: I wash the feet of the Guru, and drink in this water.
lines.transliteration: satgur kay charan Dh o-ay Dh o-ay peevaa.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating forever on Guru Nanak, I live. ||4||43||56|| pMnw 1153 rwgu BYrau mhlw 5 pVqwl Gru 3  (1153-1) raag bhairo mehlaa 5 parh -taal gh ar 3 Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1153-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak jap jap sad jeevaa. ||4||43||56||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: God is the Compassionate Cherisher. Who can count His Glorious Virtues?
lines.transliteration: partipaal parabh  kirpaal kavan gun ganee.

lines.english: Countless colors, and countless waves of joy; He is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik rang baho tarang sarab ko Dh anee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ  ਸਰਬ  ਕੋ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Endless spiritual wisdom, endless meditations, endless chants, intense meditations and austere self-disciplines.
lines.transliteration: anik gi-aan anik Dhi-aan anik jaap jaap t aap.

lines.english: Countless virtues, musical notes and playful sports; countless silent sages enshrineHim in their hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik gunit Dh unit lalit anik Dh aar munee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ  ॥
lines.english: BYrau, mÚ 5) anik naad anik baaj nimakh  nimakh  anik savaad  anik d okh anik rog miteh jas sunee. Countless melodies, countless instruments, countless tastes, each and every instant. Countless mistakes and countless diseases are removed by hearing His Praise. nwnk syv Apwr dyv qth Kth brq pUjw gvn Bvn jwqR krn sgl Pl punI

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਗੁਿਨਤ  ਧੁਿਨਤ  ਲਿਲਤ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਧਾਰ ਮੁਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, serving the Infinite, Divine Lord, one earns all the rewards and merits ofperforming the six rituals, fasts, worship services, pilgrimages to sacred rivers, andjourneys to sacred shrines. ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93|| BYrau AstpdIAw mhlw 1 Gru 2  (1153-7) bhairo asatpad ee-aa mehlaa 1 gh ar 2 Bhairao, Ashtapadees, First Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1153-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak sayv apaar dayv t atah kh atah barat  poojaa gavan bh avan jaat ar karan sagal fal punee. ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਨਾਦ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਾਜ ਿਨਮਖ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਸਾਦ ਅਿਨਕ  ਦੋਖ ਅਿਨਕ  ਰੋਗ ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਜਸ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is in the soul, and the soul is in the Lord. This is realized through the Guru'sTeachings.
lines.transliteration: aatam meh raam raam meh aat am cheenas gur beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ  ਦੇਵ ਤਟਹ  ਖਟਹ  ਬਰਤ  ਪੂਜਾ ਗਵਨ  ਭਵਨ  ਜਾਤਰ੍  ਕਰਨ  ਸਗਲ  ਫਲ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥੮॥੨੧॥੭॥੫੭॥੯੩॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani is realized through the Word of the Shabad.Sorrow is dispelled, and egotism is eliminated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee sabad  pachh aanee dukh kaatai ha-o maaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈਰਉ  ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the disease of egotism is so very deadly.
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai rog buray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਮਿਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮ ਮਿਹ ਆਤਮੁ  ਚੀਨਿਸ  ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the pain of the same disease. The Primal Lord Himself bestowsthe Shabad of His Word. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aaN tah aykaa bayd an aapay bakh sai sabad  Dhuray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਣੀ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Appraiser Himself appraises the mortal, then he is not tested again.
lines.transliteration: aapay parkhay parkh anhaarai bahur soolaak na ho-ee.

lines.english: Those who are blessed with His Grace meet with the Guru. They alone are true, who are pleasing to God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o nadar bh a-ee gur maylay parabh  bhaanaa sach so-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖ ਤਹ ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ  ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਧੁਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Air, water and fire are diseased; the world with its enjoyments is diseased.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee baisant ar rogee rogee Dh arat sabh ogee.

lines.english: Mother, father, Maya and the body are diseased; those united with their relatives arediseased. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa maa-i-aa d ayh se rogee rogee kutamb sanjogee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਰਖੇ  ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਸੂਲਾਕੁ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are diseased; the whole world is diseased.
lines.transliteration: rogee barahmaa bisan sarudraa rogee sagal sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਭਈ ਗੁਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who remember the Lord's Feet and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabadare liberated. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har pad cheen bh a-ay say mukt ay gur kaa sabad  veechaaraa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੁ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਧਰਿਤ  ਸਭੋਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The seven seas are diseased, along with the rivers; the continents and the netherregions of the underworlds are full of disease.
lines.transliteration: rogee saat samund  sand ee-aa kh and pat aal se rog bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਦੇਹ ਿਸ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸੰਜੋਗੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The people of the Lord dwell in Truth an d peace; He blesses them with His Grace everywhere. ||5||
lines.transliteration: har kay lok se saach suhaylay sarbee thaa-ee nadar karay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗੀ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਸਰੁਦਰ੍ਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The six Shaastras are diseased, as are the many who follow the different religiousorders.
lines.transliteration: rogee khat d arsan bh aykh-Dhaaree naanaa hath ee anaykaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਿਨ  ਭਏ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: What can the poor Vedas and Bibles do? People do not understand the One and Only Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bayd kat ayb karahi kah bapuray nah boojh eh ik aykaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗੀ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ  ਸਨਦੀਆ  ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ  ਿਸ ਰੋਿਗ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Eating sweet treats, the mortal is filled with disease; he finds no peace at all.
lines.transliteration: mith ras kh aa-ay so rog bh areejai kand  mool sukh  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਿਸ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਸਰਬੀ  ਥਾਈ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they walk on other paths, and at the verylast moment, they regret and repent. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam visaar chaleh an maarag ant kaal pachh utaahee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗੀ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ  ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ  ਨਾਨਾ  ਹਠੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the mortal is not cured of hisdisease. Reading scripture, he gets involved in useless arguments.
lines.transliteration: tirath bh armai rog na chh ootas parh i-aa baad  bibaad  bha-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਕਹ ਬਪੁਰੇ  ਨਹ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਇਕ ਏਕਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The disease of duality is so very deadly; it causes dependence on Maya. ||8||
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa rog so aDh ik vadayraa maa-i-aa kaa muht aaj bh a-i-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਠ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ  ਸੁ ਰੋਿਗ ਭਰੀਜੈ  ਕੰਦ ਮੂਿਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh and praises the True Shabad with the True Lord in hismind is cured of his disease.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saachaa sabad  salaahai man saachaa t is rog ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ਚਲਿਹ  ਅਨ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਅੰਤ ਕਾਿਲ  ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is immaculate, night and day; he bears the insignia of the Lord's Grace. ||9||1|| pMnw 1154 BYrau mhlw 3 Gru 2  (1154-2) bhairo mehlaa 3 gh ar 2 Bhairao, Third Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1154-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jan an-din nirmal jin ka-o karam neesaan  pa-i-aa. ||9||1||

lines.english: The Creator has staged His Wondrous Play.
lines.transliteration: tin kart ai ik chalat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: I listen to the Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, and the Bani of His Word.
lines.transliteration: anhad ban ee sabad  sunaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded and confused, while the Gurmukhs understand.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay gurmukh  bujhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Creator creates the Cause that causes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaaran kart aa kard aa aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Deep within my being, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad mayrai ant ar Dh i-aan.

lines.english: I shall never forsake the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o kabahu na chhoda-o har kaa naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Prahlaad's father sent him to school, to learn to read.
lines.transliteration: pitaa parahlaad  parhan pathaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He took his writing tablet and went to the teacher.
lines.transliteration: lai paatee paaDhay kai aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He said, "I shall not read anything except the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa nah parha-o achaar.

lines.english: Write the Lord's Name on my tablet."||2||
lines.transliteration: mayree patee-aa likh d ayh gobind  muraar. ||2||

lines.english: Prahlaad's mother said to her son,
lines.transliteration: putar par-hilaad  si-o kahi-aa maa-ay.

lines.english: "I advise you not to read anything except what you are taught."
lines.transliteration: parvirat na parh ahu rahee samjh aa-ay.

lines.english: He answered, "The Great Giver, my Fearless Lord God is always with me.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o d aataa har jee-o mayrai naal.

lines.english: If I were to forsake the Lord, then my family would be disgraced."||3||
lines.transliteration: jay har chhoda-o t a-o kul laagai gaal. ||3||

lines.english: "Prahlaad has corrupted all the other students.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad sabh  chaatrh ay vigaaray.

lines.english: He does not listen to what I say, and he does his own thing.
lines.transliteration: hamaaraa kahi-aa na sunai aapn ay kaaraj savaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹਿਰ ਛੋਡਉ  ਤਉ ਕੁਿਲ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਗਾਿਲ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He instigated devotional worship in the townspeople."
lines.transliteration: sabh nagree meh bh agat darirhaa-ee.

lines.english: The gathering of the wicked people could not do anything against him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: dusat sabh aa kaa kichh  na vasaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਾਰਜ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Sanda and Marka, his teachers, made the complaint.
lines.transliteration: sandai markai kee-ee pookaar.

lines.english: All the demons kept trying in vain.
lines.transliteration: sabhay d ait rahay jh akh maar.

lines.english: The Lord protected His humble devotee, and preserved his honor.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kee pat  raakh ai so-ee.

lines.english: What can be done by mere created beings? ||5||
lines.transliteration: keetay kai kahi-ai ki-aa ho-ee. ||5||

lines.english: Because of his past karma, the demon ruled over his kingdom.
lines.transliteration: kirat sanjogee d ait raaj chalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He did not realize the Lord; the Lord Himself confused him.
lines.transliteration: har na boojhai t in aap bh ulaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He started an argument with his son Prahlaad.
lines.transliteration: putar parahlaad  si-o vaad  rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The blind one did not understand that his death was approaching. ||6||
lines.transliteration: anDhaa na boojh ai kaal nayrh ai aa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: Prahlaad was placed in a cell, and the door was locked.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad koth ay vich raakh i-aa baar d ee-aa t aalaa.

lines.english: The fearless child was not afraid at all. He said, "Within my being, is the Guru, the Lord of the World."
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o baalak mool na dar-ee mayrai ant ar gur gopaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਾ  ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The created being tried to compete with his Creator, but he assumed this name in vain.
lines.transliteration: keetaa hovai sareekee karai anhod aa naa-o Dh araa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦੁ  ਕੋਠੇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਬਾਿਰ  ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: That which was predestined for him has come to pass; he started an argument withthe Lord's humble servant. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so aa-ay pahut aa jan si-o vaad  rachaa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਡਰਈ  ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The father raised the club to strike down Prahlaad, saying,
lines.transliteration: pitaa parahlaad  si-o guraj uth aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਕੀ  ਕਰੈ ਅਨਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ  ਧਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: "Where is your God, the Lord of the Universe, now?"
lines.transliteration: kahaaN tumHaaraa jagd ees gusaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸ ਆਇ  ਪਹੁਤਾ ਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He replied, "The Life of the World, the Great Giver, is my Help and Support in the end.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan daat aa ant  sakhaa-ee.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see Him permeating and prevailing."||8||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||8||

lines.english: Tearing down the pillars, the Lord Himself appeared.
lines.transliteration: thamh upaarh har aap d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The egotistical demon was killed and destroyed.
lines.transliteration: ahaNkaaree dait  maar pachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The minds of the devotees were filled with bliss, and congratulations poured in.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa man aanand  vajee vaDh aa-ee.

lines.english: He blessed His servant with glorious greatness. ||9||
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak ka-o day vadi-aa-ee. ||9||

lines.english: He created birth, death and attachment.
lines.transliteration: jaman marn aa moh upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Creator has ordained coming and going in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa kart ai likh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: For the sake of Prahlaad, the Lord Himself appeared.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad kai kaaraj har aap d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The word of the devotee came true. ||10||
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa bol aagai aa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.english: The gods proclaimed the victory of Lakshmi, and said,
lines.transliteration: dayv kulee lakh imee ka-o karahi jaikaar.

lines.english: "O mother, make this form of the Man-lion disappear!"
lines.transliteration: maataa narsingh  kaa roop nivaar.

lines.english: Lakshmi was afraid, and did not approach. pMnw 1155
lines.transliteration: lakhimee bh a-o karai na saakai jaa-ay.

lines.english: The humble servant Prahlaad came and fell at the Lord's Feet. ||11||
lines.transliteration: parahlaad jan charn ee laagaa aa-ay. ||11||

lines.english: The True Guru implanted the treasure of the Naam within.
lines.transliteration: satgur naam niDh aan drirh -aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Power, property and all Maya is false.
lines.transliteration: raaj maal jhooth ee sabh  maa-i-aa.

lines.english: But still, the greedy people continue clinging to them.
lines.transliteration: lobhee nar rahay laptaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortals are punished in His Court. ||12||
lines.transliteration: har kay naam bin dargeh milai sajaa-ay. ||12||

lines.english: Says Nanak, everyone acts as the Lord makes them act.
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sabh ko karay karaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are approved and accepted, who focus their consciousness on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say parvaan jinee har si-o chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.english: He has made His devotees His Own.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kaa angeekaar kard aa aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Creator has appeared in His Own Form. ||13||1||2|| BYrau mhlw 3 ] (1155-4) bhairo mehlaa 3. Bhairao, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kartai apn aa roop d ikhaa-i-aa. ||13||1||2||

lines.english: Serving the Guru, I obtain the Ambrosial Fruit; my egotism and desire have been quenched.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay amrit  fal paa-i-aa ha-umai t arisan bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord dwells within my heart and mind, and the desires of my mindare quieted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam hirdai man vasi-aa mansaa maneh samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, my Beloved, please bless me with Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kirpaa karahu mayray pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਹਰ੍ਦੈ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, Your humble servant begs for Your Glorious Praises; through the Wordof the Guru's Shabad, he is saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: an-din har gun  deen jan maaNgai gur kai sabad  uDhaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch the humble Saints; it does not cause themeven an iota of suffering or pain.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa ka-o jam johi na saakai rat ee anch d ookh na laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ  ਜਨੁ ਮਗੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Lord, save themselves, and save all their ancestorsas well. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap tareh saglay kul t aareh jo t ayree sarn aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: You Yourself save the honor of Your devotees; this is Your Glory, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa kee paij rakh eh too aapay ayh t ayree vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਰਤੀ ਅੰਚ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You cleanse them of the sins and the pains of countless incarnations; You love themwithout even an iota of duality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilvikh d ukh kaateh d ubiDh aa rat ee na raa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਤਰਿਹ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਿਹ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am foolish and ignorant, and understand nothing. You Yourself bless me with understanding.
lines.transliteration: ham moorh mugaDh  kichh  boojh eh naahee t oo aapay d eh bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਿਹ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: You do whatever You please; nothing else can be done at all. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo tuDh  bhaavai so-ee karsee avar na karn aa jaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਿਹ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਰਤੀ ਨ ਰਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Creating the world, You have linked all to their tasks - even the evil deeds which mendo.
lines.transliteration: jagat upaa-ay t uDh DhanDhai laa-i-aa bh ooNdee kaar kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਿਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They lose this precious human life in the gamble, and do not understand the Word ofthe Shabad. ||5||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath joo-ai haari-aa sabd ai surat  na paa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs die, understanding nothing; they are enveloped by thedarkness of evil-mindedness and ignorance.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mareh t in kichh oo na soojh ai durmat  agi-aan anDh aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਤੁਧੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They do not cross over the terrible world-ocean; without the Guru, they drown anddie. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bhavjal paar na paavahi kab hee doob mu-ay bin gur sir bh aaraa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਜੂਐ ਹਾਿਰਆ  ਸਬਦੈ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: True are those humble beings who are imbued with the True Shabad; the Lord Godunites them with Himself.
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad rat ay jan saachay har parabh  aap milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਧਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they come to understand the Shabad. Theyremain lovingly focused on the True Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee sabad  pachh aatee saach rahay liv laa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਕਬ ਹੀ ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਸਿਰ  ਭਾਰਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: You Yourself are Immaculate and Pure, and pure are Your humble servants who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: tooN aap nirmal t ayray jan hai nirmal gur kai sabad  veechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those, who enshrine the Lord's Name within theirhearts. ||8||2||3|| BYrau mhlw 5 AstpdIAw Gru 2  (1155-16) bhairo mehlaa 5 asatpad ee-aa gh ar 2 Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1155-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai sad  balihaarai raam naam ur Dh aaray. ||8||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਪਛਾਤੀ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He alone is a great king, who keeps the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within his heart.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so-ee vad raajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਿਪ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his tasks are perfectly accomplished.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is pooray kaajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, obtains millions of treasures.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t in kot Dh an paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈਰਉ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, life is useless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa janam birthaa jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: I praise that person, who has the capital of the Lord's Wealth.
lines.transliteration: tis saalaahee jis har Dh an raas.

lines.english: He is very fortunate, on whose forehead the Guru has placed His Hand. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so vadbhaagee jis gur mast ak haath. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, has many millions of armies on his side.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is kot ka-ee sainaa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, enjoys peace and poise. pMnw 1156
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is sahj sukh ainaa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart becomes cool and calm.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so seet al hoo-aa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, both life and death are cursed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa Dharig jeevan  moo-aa. ||2||

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so jeevan mukt aa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart knows all ways and means.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is sabh  hee jugt aa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart obtains the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t in na-o niDh  paa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal wanders, coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa bharam aavai jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is carefree and independent.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so vayparvaahaa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart always earns a profit.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is sad  hee laahaa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a large family.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is vad parvaaraa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal is just an ignorant, self-willed manmukh. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa manmukh gaavaaraa. ||4||

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a permanent position.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is nihchal aasan.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is seated on the throne.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is takhat nivaasan.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the true king.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so saachaa saahu.

lines.english: Without the Naam, no one has any honor or respect. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naamheen naahee pat  vaysaahu. ||5||

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is famous everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so sabh  meh jaat aa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the Embodiment of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so purakh  biDhaataa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the highest of all.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so sabh  tay oochaa.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal wanders in reincarnation. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa bharam jonee moochaa. ||6||

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart sees the Lord manifested in His Creation.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is pargat pahaaraa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai t is miti-aa anDh aaraa.

lines.english: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is approved and accepted.
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai so purakh  parvaan .

lines.english: Without the Naam, the mortal continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa fir aavan jaan . ||7||

lines.english: He alone receives the Naam, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy.
lines.transliteration: tin naam paa-i-aa jis bh a-i-o kirpaal.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World is understood.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  meh lakh ay gopaal.

lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation ends, and peace is found.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  rahay sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my essence has merged in the Essence of the Lord. ||8||1||4|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1156-10) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tat ai tat milaa-i-aa. ||8||1||4||

lines.english: He created millions of incarnations of Vishnu.
lines.transliteration: kot bisan keenay avtaar.

lines.english: He created millions of universes as places to practice righteousness.
lines.transliteration: kot barahmand jaa kay Dharamsaal.

lines.english: He created and destroyed millions of Shivas.
lines.transliteration: kot mahays upaa-ay samaa-ay.

lines.english: He employed millions of Brahmas to create the worlds. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot barahmay jag saajan laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Such is my Lord and Master, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aiso Dhan ee guvind  hamaaraa.

lines.english: I cannot even describe His Many Virtues. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baran na saaka-o gun bisthaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Millions of Mayas are His maid-servants.
lines.transliteration: kot maa-i-aa jaa kai sayvkaa-ay.

lines.english: Millions of souls are His beds.
lines.transliteration: kot jee-a jaa kee sihjaa-ay.

lines.english: Millions of universes are the limbs of His Being.
lines.transliteration: kot upaarjanaa tayrai ang.

lines.english: Millions of devotees abide with the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kot bhagat  basat  har sang. ||2||

lines.english: Millions of kings with their crowns and canopies bow before Him.
lines.transliteration: kot chhat arpat karat  namaskaar.

lines.english: Millions of Indras stand at His Door.
lines.transliteration: kot indar th aadhay hai d u-aar.

lines.english: Millions of heavenly paradises are within the scope of His Vision.
lines.transliteration: kot baikunth jaa kee d aristee maahi.

lines.english: Millions of His Names cannot even be appraised. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kot naam jaa kee keemat naahi. ||3||

lines.english: Millions of celestial sounds resound for Him.
lines.transliteration: kot pooree-at hai jaa kai naad .

lines.english: His Wondrous Plays are enacted on millions of stages.
lines.transliteration: kot akhaaray chalit  bismaad .
