lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Millions of Shaktis and Shivas are obedient to Him.
lines.transliteration: kot sakat siv aagi-aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਪੂਰੀਅਤ  ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਦ  ॥
lines.english: He gives sustenance and support to millions of beings. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kot jee-a dayvai aaDh aar. ||4||

lines.english: In His Feet are millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: kot tirath jaa kay charan majh aar.

lines.english: Millions chant His Sacred and Beautiful Name.
lines.transliteration: kot pavitar japat  naam chaar.

lines.english: Millions of worshippers worship Him.
lines.transliteration: kot poojaaree kartay poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਤੀਰਥ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਮਝਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of expanses are His; there is no other at all. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kot bisthaaran avar na doojaa. ||5||

lines.english: Millions of swan-souls sing His Immaculate Praises.
lines.transliteration: kot mahimaa jaa kee nirmal hans.

lines.english: Millions of Brahma's sons sing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: kot ustat  jaa kee karat  barahmans.

lines.english: He creates and destroys millions, in an instant.
lines.transliteration: kot parla-o opat nimakh  maahi.

lines.english: Millions are Your Virtues, Lord - they cannot even be counted. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kot gunaa t ayray gan ay na jaahi. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਤ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਸ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of spiritual teachers teach His spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: kot gi-aanee katheh gi-aan.

lines.english: Millions of meditators focus on His meditation.
lines.transliteration: kot Dhi-aanee Dh arat Dhi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Millions of austere penitents practice austerities. pMnw 1157
lines.transliteration: kot tapeesar t ap hee kart ay.

lines.english: Millions of silent sages dwell in silence. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kot muneesar mon meh rahtay. ||7||

lines.english: Our Eternal, Imperishable, Incomprehensible Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is permeating all hearts.
lines.transliteration: avigat naath agochar su-aamee. poor rahi-aa gh at ant arjaamee.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see Your Dwelling, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: jat kat  daykh-a-u t ayraa vaasaa.

lines.english: The Guru has blessed Nanak with enlightenment. ||8||2||5|| BYrau mhlw 5 ] (1157-3) bhairo mehlaa 5. Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o gur kee-o pargaasaa. ||8||2||5||

lines.english: The True Guru has blessed me with this gift.
lines.transliteration: satgur mo ka-o keeno d aan.

lines.english: He has given me the Priceless Jewel of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: amol ratan har d eeno naam.

lines.english: Now, I intuitively enjoy endless pleasures and wondrous play.
lines.transliteration: sahj binod choj aanant aa.

lines.english: God has spontaneously met with Nanak. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak ka-o parabh mili-o achint aa. ||1||

lines.english: Says Nanak, True is the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak keerat har saachee.

lines.english: Again and again, my mind remains immersed in it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bahur bahur tis sang man raachee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Spontaneously, I feed on the Love of God.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai bh ojan bh aa-o.

lines.english: Spontaneously, I take God's Name.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai leechai naa-o.

lines.english: Spontaneously, I am saved by the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai sabad  uDhaar.

lines.english: Spontaneously, my treasures are filled to overflowing. ||2||
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai bh aray bh andaar. ||2||

lines.english: Spontaneously, my works are perfectly accomplished.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai kaaraj pooray.

lines.english: Spontaneously, I am rid of sorrow.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai lathay visooray.

lines.english: Spontaneously, my enemies have become friends.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai bairee meet aa.

lines.english: Spontaneously, I have brought my mind under control. ||3||
lines.transliteration: achinto hee ih man vas keet aa. ||3||

lines.english: Spontaneously, God has comforted me.
lines.transliteration: achint parabh oo ham kee-aa d ilaasaa.

lines.english: Spontaneously, my hopes have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaaree pooran aasaa.

lines.english: Spontaneously, I have totally realized the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: achint hamHaa ka-o sagal siDh aaNt.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤੋ  ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਸ ਕੀਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Spontaneously, I have been blessed with the Guru's Mantra. ||4||
lines.transliteration: achint ham ka-o gur d eeno mant . ||4||

lines.english: Spontaneously, I am rid of hatred.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaaray binsay bair.

lines.english: Spontaneously, my darkness has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaaray mitay anDh ayr.

lines.english: Spontaneously, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise seems so sweet to my mind.
lines.transliteration: achinto hee man keert an meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਹਮ ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੀਨੋ  ਮੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: Spontaneously, I behold God in each and every heart. ||5||
lines.transliteration: achinto hee parabh  ghat ghat deeth aa. ||5||

lines.english: Spontaneously, all my doubts have been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: achint miti-o hai saglo bh armaa.

lines.english: Spontaneously, peace and celestial harmony fill my mind.
lines.transliteration: achint vasi-o man sukh  bisraamaa.

lines.english: Spontaneously, the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current resounds within me.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai anhat  vaajai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤੋ  ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Spontaneously, the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me. ||6||
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai gobind  gaajai. ||6||

lines.english: Spontaneously, my mind has been pleased and appeased.
lines.transliteration: achint hamaarai man pat ee-aanaa.

lines.english: I have spontaneously realized the Eternal, Unchanging Lord.
lines.transliteration: nihchal Dhanee achint  pachh aanaa.

lines.english: Spontaneously, all wisdom and knowledge has welled up within me.
lines.transliteration: achinto upji-o sagal bibaykaa.

lines.english: Spontaneously, the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, has come into my hands. ||7||
lines.transliteration: achint charee hath har har taykaa. ||7||

lines.english: Spontaneously, God has recorded my pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: achint parabh oo Dh ur likh i-aa laykh .

lines.english: Spontaneously, the One Lord and Master God has met me.
lines.transliteration: achint mili-o parabh  thaakur ayk.

lines.english: Spontaneously, all my cares and worries have been taken away.
lines.transliteration: chint achint aa saglee ga-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਚਰੀ ਹਿਥ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਟੇਕਾ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Nanak, Nanak, Nanak, has merged into the Image of God. ||8||3||6|| BYrau bwxI Bgqw kI ] kbIr jIau Gru 1 (1157-15) bhairo ban ee bh agtaa kee. kabeer jee-o gh ar 1 Bhairao, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1157-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: parabh naanak naanak naanak ma-ee. ||8||3||6||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord - this alone is my wealth.
lines.transliteration: ih Dhan mayray har ko naa-o.

lines.english: I do not tie it up to hide it, nor do I sell it to make my living. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gaaNth na baaDh a-o baych na kh aa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Name is my crop, and the Name is my field.
lines.transliteration: naa-o mayray khayt ee naa-o mayray baaree.

lines.english: As Your humble servant, I perform devotional worship to You; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kara-o jan saran t umHaaree. ||1||

lines.english: The Name is Maya and wealth for me; the Name is my capital.
lines.transliteration: naa-o mayray maa-i-aa naa-o mayray poonjee.

lines.english: I do not forsake You; I do not know any other at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tumeh chh od jaan-o nahee d oojee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Name is my family, the Name is my brother.
lines.transliteration: naa-o mayray banDhip naa-o mayray bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਠ  ਨ ਬਾਧਉ  ਬੇਿਚ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name is my companion, who will help me in the end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naa-o mayray sang ant ho-ay sakh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: One whom the Lord keeps detached from Maya
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa meh jis rakhai ud aas.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਮੇਰੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਨਾਉ  ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ha-o taa ko d aas. ||4||1|| - says Kabeer, I am his slave. ||4||1||

lines.english: Naked we come, and naked we go.
lines.transliteration: naaNgay aavan naaNgay jaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਾਉ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥
lines.english: No one, not even the kings and queens, shall remain. ||1|| pMnw 1158
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na rahihai raajaa raanaa. ||1||

lines.english: The Sovereign Lord is the nine treasures for me.
lines.transliteration: raam raajaa na-o niDh mayrai.

lines.english: The possessions and the spouse to which the mortal is lovingly attached, are Your wealth, O Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sampai hayt kalat  Dhan tayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They do not come with the mortal, and they do not go with him.
lines.transliteration: aavat sang na jaat  sangaat ee.

lines.english: What good does it do him, if he has elephants tied up at his doorway? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kahaa bha-i-o d ar baaNDhay haathee. ||2||

lines.english: The fortress of Sri Lanka was made out of gold,
lines.transliteration: lankaa gadh sonay kaa bh a-i-aa.
moorakh raavan ki-aa lay ga-i-aa. ||3|| but what could the foolish Raawan take with him when he left? ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, think of doing some good deeds.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer kichh gun beechaar.

lines.english: In the end, the gambler shall depart empty-handed. ||4||2||
lines.transliteration: chalay ju-aaree du-ay hath jh aar. ||4||2||

lines.english: Brahma is polluted, and Indra is polluted.
lines.transliteration: mailaa barahmaa mailaa ind.

lines.english: The sun is polluted, and the moon is polluted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: rav mailaa mailaa hai chand. ||1||

lines.english: This world is polluted with pollution.
lines.transliteration: mailaa maltaa ih sansaar.

lines.english: Only the One Lord is Immaculate; He has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ik har nirmal jaa kaa ant na paar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The rulers of kingdoms are polluted.
lines.transliteration: mailay barahmandaa-i kai ees.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nights and days, and the days of the month are polluted. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mailay nis baasur din t ees. ||2||

lines.english: The pearl is polluted, the diamond is polluted.
lines.transliteration: mailaa motee mailaa heer.

lines.english: Wind, fire and water are polluted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mailaa pa-un paavak ar neer. ||3||

lines.english: Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh are polluted.
lines.transliteration: mailay siv sankraa mahays.

lines.english: The Siddhas, seekers and strivers, and those who wear religious robes, are polluted.||4||
lines.transliteration: mailay siDh saaDh ik ar bh aykh. ||4||

lines.english: The Yogis and wandering hermits with their matted hair are polluted.
lines.transliteration: mailay jogee jangam jataa sahayt.

lines.english: The body, along with the swan-soul, is polluted. ||5||
lines.transliteration: mailee kaa-i-aa hans samayt. ||5||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, those humble beings are approved and pure, who know the Lord.||6||3||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer tay jan parvaan. nirmal t ay jo raameh jaan. ||6||3||

lines.english: Let your mind be Mecca, and your body the temple of worship.
lines.transliteration: man kar makaa kiblaa kar dayhee.

lines.english: Let the Supreme Guru be the One who speaks. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bolanhaar param gur ayhee. ||1||

lines.english: O Mullah, utter the call to prayer.
lines.transliteration: kaho ray mulaaN baaNg nivaaj.

lines.english: The one mosque has ten doors. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk maseet d asai d arvaaj. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So slaughter your evil nature, doubt and cruelty;
lines.transliteration: misimil taamas bh aram kad ooree.
bhaakh  lay panchai ho-ay sabooree. ||2|| consume the five demons and you shall be blessed with contentment. ||2||

lines.english: Hindus and Muslims have the same One Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: hindoo t urak kaa saahib ayk.

lines.english: What can the Mullah do, and what can the Shaykh do? ||3||
lines.transliteration: kah karai mulaaN kah karai saykh. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I have gone insane.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ha-o bha-i-aa d ivaanaa.

lines.english: Slaughtering, slaughtering my mind, I have merged into the Celestial Lord. ||4||4||
lines.transliteration: mus mus manoo-aa sahj samaanaa. ||4||4||

lines.english: When the stream flows into the Ganges, then it becomes the Ganges. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gangaa kai sang salitaa bigree. so salit aa gangaa ho-ay nibree. ||1||

lines.english: Just so, Kabeer has changed.
lines.transliteration: bigri-o kabeeraa raam duhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਮੁਲ ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਸੇਖ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He has become the Embodiment of Truth, and he does not go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saach bha-i-o an kat eh na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Associating with the sandalwood tree, the tree nearby is changed;
lines.transliteration: chandan kai sang t arvar bigri-o.
so tarvar chand an ho-ay nibri-o. ||2|| that tree begins to smell just like the sandalwood tree. ||2||

lines.english: Coming into contact with the philosophers' stone, copper is transformed;
lines.transliteration: paaras kai sang taaNbaa bigri-o.
so taaNbaa kanchan ho-ay nibri-o. ||3|| that copper is transformed into gold. ||3||

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, Kabeer is transformed;
lines.transliteration: santan sang kabeeraa bigri-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਭਇਓ  ਅਨ ਕਤਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so kabeer raamai ho-ay nibri-o. ||4||5|| that Kabeer is transformed into the Lord. ||4||5||

lines.english: Some apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, hold malas in their hands, and wearreligious robes.
lines.transliteration: maathay tilak hath maalaa baanaaN.

lines.english: Some people think that the Lord is a play-thing. ||1||
lines.transliteration: logan raam khil-a-unaa jaanaaN. ||1||

lines.english: If I am insane, then I am Yours, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: ja-o ha-o ba-uraa ta-o raam t oraa.

lines.english: How can people know my secret? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: log maram kah jaanai moraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I do not pick leaves as offerings, and I do not worship idols.
lines.transliteration: tora-o na paat ee pooja-o na d ayvaa.

lines.english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, service is useless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam bhagat  bin nihfal sayvaa. ||2||

lines.english: I worship the True Guru; forever and ever, I surrender to Him.
lines.transliteration: satgur pooja-o sad aa sad aa manaava-o.

lines.english: By such service, I find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aisee sayv dargeh sukh  paava-o. ||3||

lines.english: People say that Kabeer has gone insane.
lines.transliteration: log kahai kabeer ba-uraanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਹਉ ਬਉਰਾ  ਤਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
lines.english: Only the Lord realizes the secret of Kabeer. ||4||6||
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaa maram raam pahichaanaaN. ||4||6||

lines.english: Turning away from the world, I have forgotten both my social class and ancestry.
lines.transliteration: ulat jaat kul d o-oo bisaaree.

lines.english: My weaving now is in the most profound celestial stillness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sunn sahj meh bunat hamaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਰਉ  ਨ ਪਾਤੀ  ਪੂਜਉ  ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: I have no quarrel with anyone. pMnw 1159
lines.transliteration: hamraa jhagraa rahaa na ko-oo.

lines.english: I have abandoned both the Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, and the Mullahs, the Muslim priests. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pandit mulaaN chhaaday d o-oo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I weave and weave, and wear what I weave.
lines.transliteration: bun bun aap aap pahiraava-o.

lines.english: Where egotism does not exist, there I sing God's Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jah nahee aap tahaa ho-ay gaava-o. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever the Pandits and Mullahs have written,
lines.transliteration: pandit mulaaN jo likh  dee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਨਹੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I reject; I do not accept any of it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: chhaad chalay ham kachh oo na lee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: My heart is pure, and so I have seen the Lord within.
lines.transliteration: ridai ikh laas nirakh  lay meeraa.

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਿਡ  ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੀਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Searching, searching within the self, Kabeer has met the Lord. ||4||7||
lines.transliteration: aap khoj kh oj milay kabeeraa. ||4||7||

lines.english: No one respects the poor man.
lines.transliteration: nirDhan aad ar ko-ee na d ay-ay.

lines.english: He may make thousands of efforts, but no one pays any attention to him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laakh jat an karai oh chit  na Dh aray-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When the poor man goes to the rich man,
lines.transliteration: ja-o nirDhan sarDh an kai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਖ ਜਤਨ  ਕਰੈ ਓਹੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਧਰੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagay baithaa peeth  firaa-ay. ||1|| and sits right in front of him, the rich man turns his back on him. ||1||

lines.english: But when the rich man goes to the poor man,
lines.transliteration: ja-o sarDhan nirDh an kai jaa-ay.
dee-aa aad ar lee-aa bulaa-ay. ||2|| the poor man welcomes him with respect. ||2||

lines.english: The poor man and the rich man are both brothers.
lines.transliteration: nirDhan sarDh an don-o bh aa-ee.

lines.english: God's pre-ordained plan cannot be erased. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabh kee kalaa na maytee jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, he alone is poor,
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer nirDhan hai so-ee.
jaa kay hirdai naam na ho-ee. ||4||8|| who does not have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ  ਨ ਮੇਟੀ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, devotional worship is practiced.
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa tay bh agat kamaa-ee.

lines.english: Then, this human body is obtained.
lines.transliteration: tab ih maanas d ayhee paa-ee.

lines.english: Even the gods long for this human body.
lines.transliteration: is dayhee ka-o simrahi d ayv.

lines.english: So vibrate that human body, and think of serving the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so dayhee bh aj har kee sayv. ||1||

lines.english: Vibrate, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and never forget Him.
lines.transliteration: bhajahu gobind  bhool mat  jaahu.

lines.english: This is the blessed opportunity of this human incarnation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maanas janam kaa ayhee laahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਜੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As long as the disease of old age has not come to the body,
lines.transliteration: jab lag jaraa rog nahee aa-i-aa.
jab lag kaal garsee nahee kaa-i-aa. and as long as death has not come and seized the body,
jab lag bikal bha-ee nahee baanee. and as long as your voice has not lost its power,

lines.english: O mortal being, vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhaj layhi ray man saarigpaanee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਰਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If you do not vibrate and meditate on Him now, when will you, O Sibing of Destiny?
lines.transliteration: ab na bhajas bh ajas kab bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਿਲ  ਗਰ੍ਸੀ  ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When the end comes, you will not be able to vibrate and meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: aavai ant na bh aji-aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: Whatever you have to do - now is the best time to do it.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karahi so-ee ab saar.

lines.english: Otherwise, you shall regret and repent afterwards, and you shall not be carried across to the other side. ||3||
lines.transliteration: fir pathutaahu na paavhu paar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਨ ਭਜਿਸ  ਭਜਿਸ  ਕਬ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is a servant, whom the Lord enjoins to His service.
lines.transliteration: so sayvak jo laa-i-aa sayv.

lines.english: He alone attains the Immaculate Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: tin hee paa-ay niranjan d ayv.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, his doors are opened wide,
lines.transliteration: gur mil taa kay kh ulHay kapaat.
bahur na aavai jonee baat. ||4|| and he does not have to journey again on the path of reincarnation. ||4||

lines.english: This is your chance, and this is your time.
lines.transliteration: ihee tayraa a-osar ih t ayree baar.

lines.english: Look deep into your own heart, and reflect on this.
lines.transliteration: ghat bh eetar too daykh bichaar.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, you can win or lose.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer jeet  kai haar.

lines.english: In so many ways, I have proclaimed this out loud. ||5||1||9||
lines.transliteration: baho biDh kahi-o pukaar pukaar. ||5||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੀ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.english: In the City of God, sublime understanding prevails.
lines.transliteration: siv kee puree basai buDh saar.

lines.english: There, you shall meet with the Lord, and reflect on Him.
lines.transliteration: tah tumH mil kai karahu bichaar.

lines.english: Thus, you shall understand this world and the next.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  kee sojh ee parai.

lines.english: What is the use of claiming that you own everything, if you only die in the end? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ka-un karam mayraa kar kar marai. ||1||

lines.english: I focus my meditation on my inner self, deep within.
lines.transliteration: nij pad oopar laago Dh i-aan.

lines.english: The Name of the Sovereign Lord is my spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam naam moraa barahm gi-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: In the first chakra, the root chakra, I have grasped the reins and tied them.
lines.transliteration: mool du-aarai banDh i-aa banDh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ  ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have firmly placed the moon above the sun.
lines.transliteration: rav oopar geh raakhi-aa chand .

lines.english: The sun blazes forth at the western gate.
lines.transliteration: pachham d u-aarai sooraj t apai.

lines.english: Through the central channel of the Shushmanaa, it rises up above my head. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayr dand sir oopar basai. ||2||

lines.english: There is a stone at that western gate,
lines.transliteration: pascham du-aaray kee sil orh .
tih sil oopar kh irhkee a-or. and above that stone, is another window.

lines.english: Above that window is the Tenth Gate.
lines.transliteration: khirhkee oopar d asvaa d u-aar.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, it has no end or limitation. ||3||2||10||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer taa kaa ant  na paar. ||3||2||10||

lines.english: He alone is a Mullah, who struggles with his mind,
lines.transliteration: so mulaaN jo man si-o larai.
gur updays kaal si-o jurai. and through the Guru's Teachings, fights with death.

lines.english: He crushes the pride of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: kaal purakh kaa mard ai maan.

lines.english: Unto that Mullah, I ever offer greetings of respect. ||1|| pMnw 1160
lines.transliteration: tis mulaa ka-o sad aa salaam. ||1||

lines.english: God is present, right here at hand; why do you say that He is far away?
lines.transliteration: hai hajoor kat d oor bat aavhu.

lines.english: Tie up your disturbing passions, and find the Beauteous Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dundar baaDh hu sund ar paavhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He alone is a Qazi, who contemplates the human body,
lines.transliteration: kaajee so jo kaa-i-aa beechaarai.
kaa-i-aa kee agan barahm parjaarai. and through the fire of the body, is illumined by God.

lines.english: He does not lose his semen, even in his dreams;
lines.transliteration: supnai bind na d ay-ee jh arnaa.
tis kaajee ka-o jaraa na marnaa. ||2|| for such a Qazi, there is no old age or death. ||2||

lines.english: He alone is a sultan and a king, who shoots the two arrows,
lines.transliteration: so surtaan jo d u-ay sar t aanai.
baahar jaataa bh eetar aanai. gathers in his outgoing mind,

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਰ ਤਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: gagan mandal meh laskar karai. and assembles his army in the realm of the mind's sky, the Tenth Gate.

lines.english: The canopy of royalty waves over such a sultan. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so surtaan chh atar sir Dh arai. ||3||

lines.english: The Yogi cries out, "Gorakh, Gorakh".
lines.transliteration: jogee gorakh gorakh  karai.

lines.english: The Hindu utters the Name of Raam.
lines.transliteration: hindoo raam naam uchrai.

lines.english: The Muslim has only One God.
lines.transliteration: musalmaan kaa ayk khud aa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord and Master of Kabeer is all-pervading. ||4||3||11|| mhlw 5 ] (1160-5) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaa su-aamee rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||4||3||11||

lines.english: Those who call a stone their god
lines.transliteration: jo paathar ka-o kahtay d ayv.
taa kee birthaa hovai sayv. - their service is useless.

lines.english: Those who fall at the feet of a stone god
lines.transliteration: jo paathar kee paaN-ee paa-ay.
tis kee gh aal ajaaN-ee jaa-ay. ||1|| - their work is wasted in vain. ||1||

lines.english: My Lord and Master speaks forever.
lines.transliteration: thaakur hamraa sad  bolant aa.

lines.english: God gives His gifts to all living beings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-aa ka-o parabh d aan d aytaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Divine Lord is within the self, but the spiritually blind one does not know this.
lines.transliteration: antar d ay-o na jaanai anDh .

lines.english: Deluded by doubt, he is caught in the noose.
lines.transliteration: bharam kaa mohi-aa paavai fanDh .

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The stone does not speak; it does not give anything to anyone.
lines.transliteration: na paathar bolai naa kichh d ay-ay.

lines.english: Such religious rituals are useless; such service is fruitless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: fokat karam nihfal hai sayv. ||2||

lines.english: If a corpse is anointed with sandalwood oil,
lines.transliteration: jay mirtak ka-o chand an charh aavai.
us tay kahhu kavan fal paavai. what good does it do?

lines.english: If a corpse is rolled in manure,
lines.transliteration: jay mirtak ka-o bistaa maahi rulaa-ee.
taaN mirtak kaa ki-aa gh at jaa-ee. ||3|| what does it lose from this? ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, I proclaim this out loud
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer ha-o kaha-o pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ  ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: samajh d aykh saakat  gaavaar. - behold, and understand, you ignorant, faithless cynic.

lines.english: The love of duality has ruined countless homes.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bahut  ghar gaalay.

lines.english: The Lord's devotees are forever in bliss. ||4||4||12||
lines.transliteration: raam bhagat  hai sad aa sukh aalay. ||4||4||12||

lines.english: The fish in the water is attached to Maya.
lines.transliteration: jal meh meen maa-i-aa kay bayDhay.

lines.english: The moth fluttering around the lamp is pierced through by Maya.
lines.transliteration: deepak pat ang maa-i-aa kay chh ayday.

lines.english: The sexual desire of Maya afflicts the elephant.
lines.transliteration: kaam maa-i-aa kunchar ka-o bi-aapai.

lines.english: The snakes and bumble bees are destroyed through Maya. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhu-i-angam bh aring maa-i-aa meh kh aapay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਮੀਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
lines.english: Such are the enticements of Maya, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa aisee mohnee bhaa-ee.

lines.english: As many living beings are there are, have been deceived. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a t aytay dehkaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The birds and the deer are imbued with Maya.
lines.transliteration: pankhee marig maa-i-aa meh raat ay.

lines.english: Sugar is a deadly trap for the flies.
lines.transliteration: saakar maakhee aDh ik sant aapay.

lines.english: Horses and camels are absorbed in Maya.
lines.transliteration: turay usat maa-i-aa meh bh aylaa.

lines.english: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of miraculous spiritual powers, play in Maya. ||2||
lines.transliteration: siDh cha-oraaseeh maa-i-aa meh kh aylaa. ||2||

lines.english: The six celibates are slaves of Maya.
lines.transliteration: chhi-a jat ee maa-i-aa kay band aa.

lines.english: So are the nine masters of Yoga, and the sun and the moon.
lines.transliteration: navai naath sooraj ar chandaa.

lines.english: The austere disciplinarians and the Rishis are asleep in Maya.
lines.transliteration: tapay rakh eesar maa-i-aa meh soot aa.

lines.english: Death and the five demons are in Maya. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa meh kaal ar panch doot aa. ||3||

lines.english: Dogs and jackals are imbued with Maya.
lines.transliteration: su-aan si-aal maa-i-aa meh raataa.

lines.english: Monkeys, leopards and lions,
lines.transliteration: bantar cheet ay ar singh aataa.
maaNjaar gaadar ar loobraa. cats, sheep, foxes,
birakh mool maa-i-aa meh paraa. ||4|| trees and roots are planted in Maya. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਿਹ ਕਾਲੁ  ਅਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Even the gods are drenched with Maya,
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa antar bh eenay d ayv.
saagar indraa ar Dh artayv. as are the oceans, the sky and the earth.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, whoever has a belly to fill, is under the spell of Maya.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer jis udar t is maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The mortal is emancipated only when he meets the Holy Saint. ||5||5||13||
lines.transliteration: tab chh ootay jab saaDh oo paa-i-aa. ||5||5||13||

lines.english: As long as he cries out, "Mine! Mine!",
lines.transliteration: jab lag mayree mayree karai.
tab lag kaaj ayk nahee sarai. none of his tasks is accomplished.

lines.english: When such possessiveness is erased and removed, pMnw 1161
lines.transliteration: jab mayree mayree mit jaa-ay.
tab parabh  kaaj savaareh aa-ay. ||1|| then God comes and resolves his affairs. ||1||

lines.english: Contemplate such spiritual wisdom, O mortal man.
lines.transliteration: aisaa gi-aan bichaar manaa.

lines.english: Why not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Destroyer of pain? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kee na simrahu dukh  bhanjnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: As long as the tiger lives in the forest,
lines.transliteration: jab lag singh rahai ban maahi.
tab lag ban foolai hee naahi. the forest does not flower.

lines.english: But when the jackal eats the tiger,
lines.transliteration: jab hee si-aar singh ka-o kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਨੁ ਫੂਲੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: fool rahee saglee banraa-ay. ||2|| then the entire forest flowers. ||2||

lines.english: The victorious are drowned, while the defeated swim across.
lines.transliteration: jeeto boodai haaro t irai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one crosses over and is saved.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paar utrai.

lines.english: Slave Kabeer speaks and teaches:
lines.transliteration: daas kabeer kahai samjh aa-ay.
kayval raam rahhu liv laa-ay. ||3||6||14|| remain lovingly absorbed, attuned to the Lord alone. ||3||6||14||

lines.english: He has 7,000 commanders,
lines.transliteration: satar sai-ay salaar hai jaa kay.
savaa laakh paikaabar t aa kay. and hundreds of thousands of prophets;

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਿਰ  ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ  ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: He is said to have 88,000,000 shaykhs,
lines.transliteration: saykh jo kahee-ahi kot ath aasee.
chhapan kot jaa kay kh ayl kh aasee. ||1|| and 56,000,000 attendants. ||1||

lines.english: I am meek and poor - what chance do I have of being heard there?
lines.transliteration: mo gareeb kee ko gujraavai.

lines.punjabi: ਛਪਨ  ਕੋਿਟ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: His Court is so far away; only a rare few attain the Mansion of His Presence.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: majlas door mahal ko paavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He has 33,000,000 play-houses.
lines.transliteration: taytees karorh ee hai kh ayl kh aanaa.

lines.english: His beings wander insanely through 8.4 million incarnations.
lines.transliteration: cha-uraasee lakh firai d ivaanaaN.

lines.english: He bestowed His Grace on Adam, the father of mankind,
lines.transliteration: baabaa aadam ka-o kichh  nadar dikhaa-ee.
un bhee bh isat ghanayree paa-ee. ||2|| who then lived in paradise for a long time. ||2||

lines.english: Pale are the faces of those whose hearts are disturbed.
lines.transliteration: dil kh alhal jaa kai jarad  roo baanee.

lines.english: They have forsaken their Bible, and practice Satanic evil.
lines.transliteration: chhod kat ayb karai sait aanee.

lines.english: One who blames the world, and is angry with people,
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa d os ros hai lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਲ  ਖਲਹਲੁ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜਰਦ  ਰੂ ਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: apnaa kee-aa paavai so-ee. ||3|| shall receive the fruits of his own actions. ||3||

lines.english: You are the Great Giver, O Lord; I am forever a beggar at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: tum d aatay ham sad aa bh ikhaaree.

lines.english: If I were to deny You, then I would be a wretched sinner.
lines.transliteration: day-o jabaab ho-ay bajgaaree.

lines.english: Slave Kabeer has entered Your Shelter.
lines.transliteration: daas kabeer t ayree panah samaanaaN.

lines.english: Keep me near You, O Merciful Lord God - that is heaven for me. ||4||7||15||
lines.transliteration: bhisat  najeek raakh  rehmaanaa. ||4||7||15||

lines.english: Everyone speaks of going there,
lines.transliteration: sabh ko-ee chalan kahat  hai oohaaN.
naa jaan-o baikunth hai kahaaN. ||1|| rahaa-o. but I do not even know where heaven is. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: One who does not even know the mystery of his own self,
lines.transliteration: aap aap kaa maram na jaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ  ਕਹਤ  ਹੈ ਊਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: baatan hee baikunth  bakh aanaaN. ||1|| speaks of heaven, but it is only talk. ||1||

lines.english: As long as the mortal hopes for heaven,
lines.transliteration: jab lag man baikunth kee aas.
tab lag naahee charan nivaas. ||2|| he will not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਆਪ  ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Heaven is not a fort with moats and ramparts, and walls plastered with mud;
lines.transliteration: khaa-ee kot na paral pagaaraa.

lines.english: I do not know what heaven's gate is like. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naa jaan-o baikunth d u-aaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, now what more can I say?
lines.transliteration: kahi kameer ab kahee-ai kaahi.

lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven itself. ||4||8||16||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  baikunth ay aahi. ||4||8||16||

lines.english: How can the beautiful fortress be conquered, O Siblings of Destiny?
lines.transliteration: ki-o leejai gadh bankaa bh aa-ee.

lines.english: It has double walls and triple moats. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dovar kot ar t ayvar kh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: It is defended by the five elements, the twenty-five categories, attachment, pride, jealousy and the awesomely powerful Maya.
lines.transliteration: paaNch pachees moh mad mat sar aadee parbal maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The poor mortal being does not have the strength to conquer it; what should I donow, O Lord? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jan gareeb ko jor na pahuchai kahaa kara-o raghuraa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Sexual desire is the window, pain and pleasure are the gate-keepers, virtue and sinare the gates.
lines.transliteration: kaam kivaaree dukh  sukh  darvaanee paap punn d arvaajaa.

lines.english: Anger is the great supreme commander, full of argument and strife, and the mind isthe rebel king there. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kroDh parDh aan mahaa bad d undar tah man maavaasee raajaa. ||2||

lines.english: Their armor is the pleasure of tastes and flavors, their helmets are worldlyattachments; they take aim with their bows of corrupt intellect.
lines.transliteration: savaad sanaah top mamt aa ko kubuDh  kamaan chadh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਚ ਪਚੀਸ  ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਆਡੀ  ਪਰਬਲ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The greed that fills their hearts is the arrow; with these things, their fortress is impregnable. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tisnaa t eer rahay gh at bheetar i-o gadh  lee-o na jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਗਰੀਬ  ਕੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ  ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But I have made divine love the fuse, and deep meditation the bomb; I have launchedthe rocket of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: paraym paleetaa surat  havaa-ee golaa gi-aan chalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਿਕਵਾਰੀ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ  ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: The fire of God is lit by intuition, and with one shot, the fortress is taken. ||4||
lines.transliteration: barahm agan sehjay parjaalee aykeh chot sijhaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਪਰ੍ਧਾਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਦੁੰਦਰ  ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਵਾਸੀ  ਰਾਜਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Taking truth and contentment with me, I begin the battle and storm both the gates.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh lai larnay laagaa t oray d u-ay d arvaajaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਦ ਸਨਾਹ  ਟੋਪੁ ਮਮਤਾ  ਕੋ ਕੁਬੁਿਧ  ਕਮਾਨ  ਚਢਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and by Guru's Grace, I have captured the king of the fortress. ||5|| pMnw 1162
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  ar gur kee kirpaa t ay pakri-o gadh  ko raajaa. ||5||

lines.english: With the army of God's devotees, and Shakti, the power of meditation, I have snapped the noose of the fear of death.
lines.transliteration: bhagvat  bheer sakat  simran kee katee kaal bh ai faasee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਵਤ  ਭੀਿਰ  ਸਕਿਤ  ਿਸਮਰਨ  ਕੀ ਕਟੀ ਕਾਲ  ਭੈ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Kabeer has climbed to the top of the fortress; I have obtained the eternal,imperishable domain. ||6||9||17||
lines.transliteration: daas kameer charhHi-o garhH oopar raaj lee-o abh inaasee. ||6||9||17||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਮੀਰੁ ਚਿੜਓ  ਗੜ ਊਪਿਰ  ਰਾਜੁ ਲੀਓ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥੬॥੯॥੧੭॥
lines.english: The mother Ganges is deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: gang gusaa-in gahir gambheer.

lines.english: Tied up in chains, they took Kabeer there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janjeer baaNDh kar kh aray kabeer. ||1||

lines.english: My mind was not shaken; why should my body be afraid?
lines.transliteration: man na digai tan kaahay ka-o daraa-ay.

lines.english: Lightning blazes, and bliss prevails there,

jih pa-orhHay parabh  baal gobind . ||1|| where the Eternally Young Lord God abides. ||1||

ha-umai gaavan gaavahi geet. only sing songs and chants of egotism.

lines.english: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, resounds in that place,

jih pa-orhHay parabh  saree gopaal. ||2|| where the Supreme Lord God abides. ||2||

lines.english: He creates planets, solar systems and galaxies;

lines.transliteration: sunn mandal meh kar pargaas.

lines.transliteration: oohaaN sooraj naahee chand.
aad niranjan karai anand. ||5|| but the Primal Immaculate Lord celebrates there. ||5||

lines.english: Know that He is in the universe, and in the body as well.
lines.transliteration: so barahmand pind so jaan.

lines.english: Take your cleansing bath in the Mansarovar Lake.
lines.transliteration: maan sarovar kar isnaan.

lines.english: Chant "Sohang" - "He is me."
lines.transliteration: sohaN so jaa ka-o hai jaap.

lines.english: He is not affected by either virtue or vice. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o lipat na ho-ay punn ar paap. ||6||

lines.english: He is not affected by either high or low social class, sunshine or shade.
lines.transliteration: abran baran ghaam nahee chh aam.

lines.english: He is in the Guru's Sanctuary, and nowhere else.

lines.transliteration: sunn sahj meh rahi-o samaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: One who knows the Lord in the mind
lines.transliteration: man maDhay jaanai jay ko-ay.

lines.english: One who firmly implants the Lord's Divine Light, and His Mantra within the mind

Millions of winds blow around Him in the four directions.

lines.transliteration: hasat kh aylat tayray d ayhuray aa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: bhagat  karat  naamaa pakar uth aa-i-aa. ||1||

chheepay kay janam kaahay ka-o aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. why was I born into a family of fabric dyers? ||1||Pause||

dayhurai paachh ai baith aa jaa-ay. ||2|| to sit behind the temple. ||2||

lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o naamaa har gun uchrai.

lines.english: As the hungry person loves food,
lines.transliteration: jaisee bhookh ay pareet  anaaj.
tarikh aavaNt jal sayt ee kaaj. and the thirsty person is obsessed with water,
jaisee moorh kutamb paraa-in . and as the fool is attached to his family
aisee naamay pareet naraa-in . ||1|| - just so, the Lord is very dear to Naam Dayv. ||1||

aisee naamay pareet muraaree. ||2|| just so, Naam Dayv is in love with the Lord. ||2||

gur parsaadee dubiDh aa jaa-ay. by Guru's Grace, duality is eradicated.

lines.transliteration: naamay chit laa-i-aa sach naa-ay. ||3||

lines.transliteration: jaisee pareet baarik ar maat aa.
aisaa har saytee man raat aa. so is my mind imbued with the Lord.

lines.english: Prays Naam Dayv, I am in love with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: paranvai naamd ay-o laagee pareet .

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe abides within my consciousness. ||4||1||7||
lines.transliteration: gobid basai hamaarai cheet . ||4||1||7||

lines.english: The blind fool abandons the wife of his own home, pMnw 1165
lines.transliteration: ghar kee naar t i-aagai anDh aa.

lines.english: Plants blossom forth to produce fruit.
lines.transliteration: fal kaaran foolee banraa-ay.

lines.english: When the fruit is produced, the flowers wither away.
lines.transliteration: fal laagaa tab fool bilaa-ay.

lines.english: For the sake of spiritual wisdom, people act and practice rituals.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanai kaaran karam abhi-aas.

lines.english: When spiritual wisdom wells up, then actions are left behind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan bha-i-aa t ah karmah naas. ||3||

lines.english: For the sake of ghee, wise people churn milk.
lines.transliteration: gharit  kaaran d aDh mathai sa-i-aan.

lines.english: Those who are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive - are forever in the state ofNirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: jeevat mukat  sadaa nirbaan.

lines.english: Says Ravi Daas, O you unfortunate people,
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas param bairaag.

lines.english: Naam Dayv:
lines.transliteration: ridai raam kee na japas abh aag. ||4||1|| why not meditate on the Lord with love in your heart? ||4||1|| nwmdyv ] (1167-13) naamdayv.

lines.english: Come, O Lord of beautiful hair,
lines.transliteration: aa-o kalandar kaysvaa.
kar abdaalee bh aysvaa. rahaa-o. wearing the robes of a Sufi Saint. ||Pause||

lines.english: Your cap is the realm of the Akaashic ethers; the seven nether worlds are Your sandals.
lines.transliteration: jin aakaas kulah sir keenee ka-usai sapat pa-yaalaa.

lines.english: The body covered with skin is Your temple; You are so beautiful, O Lord of the World.||1||
lines.transliteration: chamar pos kaa mandar t ayraa ih biDh  banay gupaalaa. ||1||

lines.english: The fifty-six million clouds are Your gowns, the 16,000 milkmaids are your skirts.
lines.transliteration: chhapan kot kaa payhan t ayraa solah sahas ijaaraa.

lines.english: The eighteen loads of vegetation is Your stick, and all the world is Your plate. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bhaar ath aarah mud gar tayraa sahnak sabh  sansaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਆਕਾਸ  ਕੁਲਹ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਕਉਸੈ ਸਪਤ  ਪਯਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The human body is the mosque, and the mind is the priest, who peacefully leads theprayer.
lines.transliteration: dayhee mehjid  man ma-ulaanaa sahj nivaaj gujaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਚਮਰ  ਪੋਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਬਨੇ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are married to Maya, O Formless Lord, and so You have taken form. ||3||
lines.transliteration: beebee ka-ulaa sa-o kaa-in tayraa nirankaar aakaarai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਛਪਨ  ਕੋਿਟ ਕਾ ਪੇਹਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਲਹ  ਸਹਸ  ਇਜਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Performing devotional worship services to You, my cymbals were taken away; unto whom should I complain?
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karat  mayray t aal chh inaa-ay kih peh kara-o pukaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ  ਮੁਦਗਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਨਕ  ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, wanderseverywhere; He has no specific home. ||4||1|| pMnw 1168 rwgu bsMqu mhlw 1 Gru 1 caupdy duquky (1168-1) raag basant mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 cha-upd ay dutukay Raag Basant, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas, Du-Tukas: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1168-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: naamay kaa su-aamee antarjaamee firay sagal bayd aysvaa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Among the months, blessed is this month, when spring always comes.
lines.transliteration: maahaa maah mumaarkhee charh i-aa sad aa basant .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਹਾ  ਮਾਹ ਮੁਮਾਰਖੀ  ਚਿੜਆ  ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: Blossom forth, O my consciousness, contemplating the Lord of the Universe, foreverand ever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parfarh chit  samaal so-ay sad aa sad aa gobind . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਫੜੁ  ਿਚਤ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਸੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O ignorant one, forget your egotistical intellect.
lines.transliteration: bholi-aa ha-umai surat  visaar.

lines.english: Subdue your ego, and contemplate Him in your mind; gather in the virtues of theSublime, Virtuous Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar beechaar man gun vich gun  lai saar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਮਨ ਗੁਣ ਿਵਿਚ  ਗੁਣੁ ਲੈ ਸਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Karma is the tree, the Lord's Name the branches, Dharmic faith the flowers, and spiritual wisdom the fruit.
lines.transliteration: karam payd saakhaa haree Dh aram ful fal gi-aan.

lines.english: Realization of the Lord are the leaves, and eradication of the pride of the mind is theshade. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pat paraapat  chhaav gh anee chookaa man abh imaan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਪੇਡੁ ਸਾਖਾ  ਹਰੀ ਧਰਮੁ  ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Whoever sees the Lord's Creative Power with his eyes, and hears the Guru's Bani withhis ears, and utters the True Name with his mouth,
lines.transliteration: akhee kud rat kannee ban ee mukh  aakh an sach naam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਤ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਮਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pat kaa Dh an pooraa ho-aa laagaa sahj Dh i-aan. ||3|| attains the perfect wealth of honor, and intuitively focuses his meditation on the Lord.||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕੰਨੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਮੁਿਖ ਆਖਣੁ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: The months and the seasons come; see, and do your deeds.
lines.transliteration: maahaa rutee aavn aa vaykh hu karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਆ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who remain merged in the Lord do not wither away; theyremain green forever. ||4||1|| mhlw 1 bsMqu ] (1168-9) mehlaa 1 basant. First Mehl, Basant:
lines.transliteration: naanak haray na sookhee je gurmukh rahay samaa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਹਾ  ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਣਾ  ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The season of spring, so delightful, has come.
lines.transliteration: rut aa-eelay saras basant  maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਰੇ ਨ ਸੂਕਹੀ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with love for You, O Lord, chant Your Name with joy.
lines.transliteration: rang raatay raveh se t ayrai chaa-ay.

lines.english: Whom else should I worship? At whose feet should I bow? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kis pooj charhaava-o laga-o paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King.
lines.transliteration: tayraa d aasan d aasaa kaha-o raa-ay.

lines.english: O Life of the Universe, there is no other way to meet You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan jugat na milai kaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You have only One Form, and yet You have countless forms.
lines.transliteration: tayree moorat  aykaa bahut  roop.

lines.english: Which one should I worship? Before which one should I burn incense?
lines.transliteration: kis pooj charhaava-o d ay-o Dh oop.

lines.english: Your limits cannot be found. How can anyone find them?
lines.transliteration: tayraa ant  na paa-i-aa kahaa paa-ay.

lines.english: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayraa d aasan d aasaa kaha-o raa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The cycles of years and the places of pilgrimage are Yours, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayray sath  sambat  sabh  teerthaa.

lines.english: Your Name is True, O Transcendent Lord God.
lines.transliteration: tayraa sach naam parmaysraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਹਾ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your State cannot be known, O Eternal, Unchanging Lord God.
lines.transliteration: tayree gat  avigat  nahee jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: Although You are unknown, still we chant Your Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anjaan at naam vakh aanee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: What can poor Nanak say?
lines.transliteration: naanak vaychaaraa ki-aa kahai.

lines.english: All people praise the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh lok salaahay ayksai.

lines.english: Nanak places his head on the feet of such people.
lines.transliteration: sir naanak lokaa paav hai.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your Names, as many as there are, O Lord. ||4||2|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1168-15) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: balihaaree jaa-o jaytay t ayray naav hai. ||4||2||

lines.english: The kitchen is golden, and the cooking pots are golden.
lines.transliteration: su-inay kaa cha-ukaa kanchan ku-aar.

lines.english: The lines marking the cooking square are silver.
lines.transliteration: rupay kee-aa kaaraa bahut bisthaar.

lines.english: The water is from the Ganges, and the firewood is sanctified.
lines.transliteration: gangaa kaa udak karant ay kee aag.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਜਾਉ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: The food is soft rice, cooked in milk. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garurhaa kh aanaa duDh si-o gaad. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, these things are worthless, pMnw 1169
lines.transliteration: ray man laykhai kabhoo na paa-ay.
jaam na bheejai saach naa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. if you are not drenched with the True Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: One may have the eighteen Puraanas written in his own hand;
lines.transliteration: das ath  leekh ay hoveh paas.
chaaray bayd mukh aagar paath . he may recite the four Vedas by heart,
purbee naavai varnaaN kee daat . and take ritual baths at holy festivals and give charitable donations;
varat naym karay d in raat . ||2|| he may observe the ritual fasts, and perform religious ceremonies day and night. ||2||

lines.english: He may be a Qazi, a Mullah or a Shaykh,
lines.transliteration: kaajee mulaaN hoveh saykh.
jogee jangam bhagvay bh aykh. a Yogi or a wandering hermit wearing saffron-colored robes;
ko girhee karmaa kee sanDh. he may be a householder, working at his job;
bin boojhay sabh  kharhee-as banDh . ||3|| but without understanding the essence of devotional worship, all people are eventually bound and gagged, and driven along by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

lines.english: Each person's karma is written on his forehead.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a likh ee sir kaar.

lines.english: According to their deeds, they shall be judged.
lines.transliteration: karnee upar hovag saar.

lines.english: Only the foolish and the ignorant issue commands.
lines.transliteration: hukam karahi moorakh gaavaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the treasure of praise belongs to the True Lord alone. ||4||3|| bsMqu mhlw 3 qIjw ] (1169-5) basant mehlaa 3 t eejaa. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay kay sifat bh andaar. ||4||3||

lines.english: A person may take off his clothes and be naked.
lines.transliteration: bastar ut aar digambar hog.

lines.english: What Yoga does he practice by having matted and tangled hair?
lines.transliteration: jataaDhaar ki-aa kamaavai jog.

lines.english: If the mind is not pure, what use is it to hold the breath at the Tenth Gate?
lines.transliteration: man nirmal nahee dasvai d u-aar.

lines.english: The fool wanders and wanders, entering the cycle of reincarnation again and again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram aavai moorhHaa vaaro vaar. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate on the One Lord, O my foolish mind,
lines.transliteration: ayk Dhi-aavahu moorhH manaa.
paar utar jaahi ik kh inaaN. ||1|| rahaa-o. and you shall cross over to the other side in an instant. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਆਵੈ  ਮੂੜਾ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some recite and expound on the Simritees and the Shaastras;
lines.transliteration: simrit saast ar karahi vakh i-aan.
naadee bayd ee parhHahi puraan . some sing the Vedas and read the Puraanas;
pakhand d arisat man kapat kamaahi. but they practice hypocrisy and deception with their eyes and minds.

lines.english: The Lord does not even come near them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kai rama-ee-aa nayrh  naahi. ||2||

lines.english: Even if someone practices such self-discipline,
lines.transliteration: jay ko aisaa sanjmee ho-ay.
kir-aa visaykh poojaa karay-i. compassion and devotional worship
antar lobh  man bikh i-aa maahi. - if he is filled with greed, and his mind is engrossed in corruption,
o-ay niranjan kaisay paahi. ||3|| how can he find the Immaculate Lord? ||3||

lines.english: What can the created being do?
lines.transliteration: keetaa ho-aa karay ki-aa ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself moves him.
lines.transliteration: jis no aap chalaa-ay so-ay.

lines.english: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then his doubts are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aaN bharam chukaa-ay.

lines.english: If the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he obtains the True Lord.||4||
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhai t aaN saachaa paa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: If someone's soul is polluted within,
lines.transliteration: jis jee-o antar mailaa ho-ay.
tirath bh avai disant ar lo-ay. what is the use of his traveling to sacred shrines of pilgrimage all over the world?

lines.english: O Nanak, when one joins the Society of the True Guru,
lines.transliteration: naanak milee-ai satgur sang.

lines.english: Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ta-o bh avjal kay t ootas banDh . ||5||4|| then the bonds of the terrifying world-ocean are broken. ||5||4|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1169-12) basant mehlaa 1.

lines.english: All the worlds have been fascinated and enchanted by Your Maya, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan t ayree maa-i-aa moh.

lines.english: I do not see any other at all - You are everywhere.
lines.transliteration: mai avar na deesai sarab t oh.

lines.english: You are the Master of Yogis, the Divinity of the divine.
lines.transliteration: too sur naathaa d ayvaa d ayv.

lines.english: Serving at the Guru's Feet, the Name of the Lord is received. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naam milai gur charan sayv. ||1||

lines.english: O my Beauteous, Deep and Profound Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray sundar gahir gambh eer laal.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name. You are Infinite, theCherisher of all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam gun gaa-ay t oo aprampar sarab paal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਰਬ  ਤੋਹ ॥
lines.english: Without the Holy Saint, association with the Lord is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: bin saaDh na paa-ee-ai har kaa sang.

lines.english: Without the Guru, one's very fiber is stained with filth.
lines.transliteration: bin gur mail maleen ang.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, one cannot become pure.
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na suDh ho-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur sabad salaahay saach so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਰਬ  ਪਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Savior Lord, that person whom You have saved
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o too raakh ahi rakh anhaar.

lines.english: - You lead him to meet the True Guru, and so take care of him.
lines.transliteration: satguroo milaaveh karahi saar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: You take away his poisonous egotism and attachment.
lines.transliteration: bikh ha-umai mamt aa parahraa-ay.

lines.english: You dispel all his sufferings, O Sovereign Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh d ookh binaasay raam raa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: His state and condition are sublime; the Lord's Glorious Virtues permeate his body.
lines.transliteration: ootam gat  mit har gun sareer.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the diamond of the Lord's Name isrevealed.
lines.transliteration: gurmat pargatay raam naam heer.

lines.english: He is lovingly attuned to the Naam; he is rid of the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: liv laagee naam taj d oojaa bh aa-o.

lines.english: O Lord, let servant Nanak meet the Guru. ||4||5|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1169-18) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har gur gur milaa-o. ||4||5||

lines.english: O my friends and companions, listen with love in your heart.
lines.transliteration: mayree sakhee sahaylee sunhu bh aa-ay.

lines.english: My Husband Lord is Incomparably Beautiful; He is always with me.
lines.transliteration: mayraa pir reesaaloo sang saa-ay.

lines.english: He is Unseen - He cannot be seen. How can I describe Him? pMnw 1170
lines.transliteration: oh alakh na lakh ee-ai kahhu kaa-ay.

lines.english: The Guru has shown me that my Sovereign Lord God is with me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur sang dikh aa-i-o raam raa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Joining together with my friends and companions, I am adorned with the Lord's Glorious Virtues.
lines.transliteration: mil sakhee sahaylee har gun banay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਖੇਲਿਹ  ਵਰ ਕਾਮਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਮਨ ਮਨੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The sublime soul-brides play with their Lord God. The Gurmukhs look withinthemselves; their minds are filled with faith. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har parabh sang kh ayleh var kaaman gurmukh  khojat man manay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs, suffering in separation, do not understand this mystery.
lines.transliteration: manmukhee d uhaagan  naahi bh ay-o.

lines.english: The Beloved Lord of all celebrates in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: oh ghat gh at raavai sarab paray-o.

lines.punjabi: ਓਹੁ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਾਵੈ ਸਰਬ  ਪਰ੍ੇਉ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is stable, knowing that God is always with him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh thir cheenai sang d ay-o.

lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur naam drirh-aa-i-aa jap japay-o. ||2||

lines.english: Without the Guru, devotional love does not well up within.
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhagat  na bh aa-o ho-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, one is not blessed with the Society of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: bin gur sant na sang d ay-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, the blind cry out, entangled in worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: bin gur anDhulay Dh anDh ro-ay.

lines.english: That mortal who becomes Gurmukh becomes immaculate; the Word of the Shabad washes away his filth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man gurmukh nirmal mal sabad  kho-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Uniting with the Guru, the mortal conquers and subdues his mind.
lines.transliteration: gur man maari-o kar sanjog.

lines.english: Day and night, he savors the Yoga of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: ahinis raavay bhagat  jog.

lines.english: Associating with the Saint Guru, suffering and sickness are ended.
lines.transliteration: gur sant sabh aa dukh mitai rog.

lines.english: Servant Nanak merges with his Husband Lord, in the Yoga of intuitive ease. ||4||6|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1170-6) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har var sahj jog. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: By His Creative Power, God fashioned the creation.
lines.transliteration: aapay kudrat  karay saaj.

lines.english: The King of kings Himself adminsters true justice.
lines.transliteration: sach aap nibayrhay raaj raaj.

lines.english: The most sublime Word of the Guru's Teachings is always with us.
lines.transliteration: gurmat oot am sang saath.

lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Name, the source of nectar, is easily acquired. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naam rasaa-in sahj aath. ||1||

lines.english: So chant the Name of the Lord; do not forget it, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: mat bisras ray man raam bol.

lines.english: The Lord is Infinite, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; His weight cannot be weighed, but He Himself allows the Gurmukh to weigh Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aprampar agam agochar gurmukh har aap t ulaa-ay at ul tol. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your GurSikhs serve at the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur charan sarayveh gursikh t or.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਤੁਲਾਏ  ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਤੋਿਲ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, they are carried across; they have abandoned any distinctionbetween 'mine' and 'yours'.
lines.transliteration: gur sayv taray t aj mayr t or.

lines.english: The slanderous and greedy people are hard-hearted.
lines.transliteration: nar nindak lobh ee man kath or.

lines.english: Those who do not love to serve the Guru are the most thieving of thieves. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur sayv na bhaa-ee se chor chor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਤਰੇ ਤਿਜ  ਮੇਰ ਤੋਰ ॥
lines.english: When the Guru is pleased, He blesses the mortals with loving devotional worship ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur tuth aa bakh say bh agat bhaa-o.

lines.english: When the Guru is pleased, the mortal obtains a place in the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence.
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai paa-ee-ai har mahal th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਭਾਈ  ਿਸ ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: So renounce slander, and awaken in devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: parhar nindaa har bh agat jaag.

lines.english: Devotion to the Lord is wonderful; it comes through good karma and destiny. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har bhagat  suhaavee karam bh aag. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰ ਮਹਿਲ  ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru unites in union with the Lord, and grants the gift of the Name.
lines.transliteration: gur mayl milaavai karay daat .

lines.english: The Guru loves His Sikhs, day and night.
lines.transliteration: gursikh pi-aaray d inas raat .

lines.english: They obtain the fruit of the Naam, when the Guru's favor is bestowed.
lines.transliteration: fal naam paraapat gur t us day-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, those who receive it are very rare indeed. ||4||7|| bsMqu mhlw 3 iek qukw ] (1170-13) basant mehlaa 3 ik t ukaa. Basant, Third Mehl, Ik-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paavahi virlay kay-ay. ||4||7||

lines.english: When it pleases our Lord and Master, His servant serves Him.
lines.transliteration: saahib bhaavai sayvak sayvaa karai.

lines.punjabi: ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਿਸ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He remains dead while yet alive, and redeems all his ancestors. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai sabh  kul uDh rai. ||1||

lines.english: I shall not renounce Your devotional worship, O Lord; what does it matter if peoplelaugh at me?
lines.transliteration: tayree bh agat na chh oda-o ki-aa ko hasai.

lines.english: The True Name abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saach naam mayrai hirdai vasai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Just as the mortal remains engrossed in attachment to Maya,
lines.transliteration: jaisay maa-i-aa mohi paraanee galat  rahai.
taisay sant  jan raam naam ravat  rahai. ||2|| so does the Lord's humble Saint remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਛੋਡਉ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ॥
lines.english: I am foolish and ignorant, O Lord; please be merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh mugaDh  oopar karahu d a-i-aa.

lines.english: May I remain in Your Sanctuary. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ta-o sarn aagat  raha-o pa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, worldly affairs are fruitless.
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak sansaar kay nihfal kaamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਗਲਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Only by Guru's Grace does one receive the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8|| mhlw 1 bsMqu ihMfol Gru 2  (1170-18) mehlaa 1 basant hindol gh ar 2 First Mehl, Basant Hindol, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1170-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad ko paavai amrit  naamaa. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਤ  ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Brahmin, you worship and believe in your stone-god, and wear your ceremonialrosary beads.
lines.transliteration: saal garaam bip pooj manaavahu sukarit t ulsee maalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord. Build your boat, and pray, "O Merciful Lord, please be merciful to me."||1|| pMnw 1171
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap bayrhaa baaNDhahu d a-i-aa karahu d a-i-aalaa. ||1||

lines.english: Why do you irrigate the barren, alkaline soil? You are wasting your life away!
lines.transliteration: kaahay kalraa sinchahu janam gavaavahu.

lines.english: This wall of mud is crumbling. Why bother to patch it with plaster? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaachee dhahag d ivaal kaahay gach laavhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Let your hands be the buckets, strung on the chain, and yoke the mind as the ox topull it; draw the water up from the well.
lines.transliteration: kar harihat maal tind parovahu tis bh eetar man jovhu.

lines.english: Irrigate your fields with the Ambrosial Nectar, and you shall be owned by God theGardener. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit sinchahu bh arahu ki-aaray t a-o maalee kay hovhu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਹਿਰਹਟ  ਮਾਲ  ਿਟੰਡ ਪਰੋਵਹੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Let sexual desire and anger be your two shovels, to dig up the dirt of your farm, OSiblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh d u-ay karahu basolay godahu Dh artee bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਿਸੰਚਹੁ ਭਰਹੁ ਿਕਆਰੇ  ਤਉ ਮਾਲੀ  ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The more you dig, the more peace you shall find. Your past actions cannot be erased.||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o godahu ti-o t umH sukh  paavhu kirat  na mayti-aa jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸੋਲੇ  ਗੋਡਹੁ ਧਰਤੀ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The crane is again transformed into a swan, if You so will, O Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: bagulay tay fun hansulaa hovai jay t oo karahi d a-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਗੋਡਹੁ ਿਤਉ  ਤੁਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਮੇਿਟਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the slave of Your slaves: O Merciful Lord, have mercy on me. ||4||1||9|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ihMfol ] (1171-5) basant mehlaa 1 hindol. Basant, First Mehl, Hindol:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak d aasan d aasaa d a-i-aa karahu d a-i-aalaa. ||4||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਬਗੁਲੇ  ਤੇ ਫੁਿਨ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ  ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਹ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the House of the Husband Lord - in the world hereafter, everything is jointly owned; but in this world - in the house of the soul-bride's parents, the soul-brideowns them separately.
lines.transliteration: saahurarhee vath sabh  kichh  saajh ee payvkarh ai Dhan vakh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥
lines.english: She herself is ill-mannered; how can she blame anyone else? She does not know howto take care of these things. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap kuchjee dos na d ay-oo jaan aa naahee rakh ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, I am deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: mayray saahibaa ha-o aapay bharam bh ulaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੀ ਵਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ ਸਾਝੀ  ਪੇਵਕੜੈ  ਧਨ ਵਖੇ ॥
lines.english: I sing the Word which You have written; I do not know any other Word. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: akhar likh ay say-ee gaavaa avar na jaan aa ban ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕੁਚਜੀ  ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਜਾਣਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: She alone is known as the Lord's bride, who embroiders her gown in the Name.
lines.transliteration: kadh kaseed aa pahirahi cholee t aaN tumH jaanhu naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਿਹਬਾ  ਹਉ ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਿਮ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: She who preserves and protects the home of her own heart and does not taste of evil,shall be the Beloved of her Husband Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jay ghar raakh ahi buraa na chaakh ahi hoveh kant  pi-aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਖਰ  ਿਲਖੇ ਸੇਈ ਗਾਵਾ  ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If you are a learned and wise religious scholar, then make a boat of the letters of theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jay tooN parhi-aa pandit  beenaa d u-ay akh ar du-ay naavaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, the One Lord shall carry you across, if you merge in the True Lord. ||3||2||10|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 1 ] (1171-9) basant hindol mehlaa 1. Basant Hindol, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak ayk langh aa-ay jay kar sach samaavaaN. ||3||2||10||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਢ  ਕਸੀਦਾ  ਪਿਹਰਿਹ  ਚੋਲੀ  ਤ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The king is just a boy, and his city is vulnerable. He is in love with his wicked enemies.
lines.transliteration: raajaa baalak nagree kaachee dustaa naal pi-aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਹ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਕੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He reads of his two mothers and his two fathers; O Pandit, reflect on this. ||1||
lines.transliteration: du-ay maa-ee d u-ay baapaa parh ee-ah pandit  karahu beechaaro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਪਿੜਆ  ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਬੀਨਾ ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ  ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Master Pandit, teach me about this.
lines.transliteration: su-aamee panditaa t umH dayh mat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਏਕੁ ਲੰਘਾਏ  ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਵ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.english: How can I obtain the Lord of life? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kin biDh paava-o paraanpat ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: There is fire within the plants which bloom; the ocean is tied into a bundle.
lines.transliteration: bheet ar agan banaaspat  ma-ulee saagar pandh ai paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਨਗਰੀ  ਕਾਚੀ  ਦੁਸਟਾ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The sun and the moon dwell in the same home in the sky. You have not obtained thisknowledge. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chand sooraj d u-ay gh ar hee bh eetar aisaa gi-aan na paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਇ ਮਾਈ  ਦੁਇ ਬਾਪਾ  ਪੜੀਅਿਹ  ਪੰਿਡਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who knows the All-pervading Lord, eats up the one mother - Maya.
lines.transliteration: raam ravantaa jaan ee-ai ik maa-ee bh og karay-i.

lines.english: Know that the sign of such a person is that he gathers the wealth of compassion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa kay lakh an jaanee-ahi kh imaa Dh an sangar-hay-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The mind lives with those who do not listen, and do not admit what they eat.
lines.transliteration: kahi-aa suneh na kh aa-i-aa maaneh t inHaa hee sayt ee vaasaa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slave: one instant the mind is huge, and the next instant, it is tiny. ||4||3||11|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 1 ] (1171-15) basant hindol mehlaa 1. Basant Hindol, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak d aasan d aasaa kh in tolaa kh in maasaa. ||4||3||11||

lines.punjabi: ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬਨਾਸਪਿਤ  ਮਉਲੀ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੰਡੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the True Banker, the Giver of peace; He unites the mortal with the Lord,and satisfies his hunger.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahu guroo sukh-d aata har maylay bh ukh gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਦੁਇ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਐਸਾ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Granting His Grace, He implants devotional worship of the Lord within; and then nightand day, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa har bhagat  drirh -aa-ay an-d in har gun  gaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤਾ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਇਕ ਮਾਈ  ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, do not forget the Lord; keep Him in your consciousness.
lines.transliteration: mat bh ooleh ray man chayt  haree.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ  ਜਾਣੀਅਿਹ  ਿਖਮਾ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹੇਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, no one is liberated anywhere in the three worlds. The Gurmukhobtains the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bin gur mukat naahee t arai lo-ee gurmukh  paa-ee-ai naam haree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਆ  ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਨ ਖਾਇਆ  ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship, the True Guru is not obtained. Without good destiny,devotional worship of the Lord is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: bin bhagt ee nahee sat gur paa-ee-ai bin bh aagaa nahee bh agat haree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ ਿਖਨੁ ਤੋਲਾ  ਿਖਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Without good destiny, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is not obtained. By the grace of one's good karma, the Lord's Name is received. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa sat sang na paa-ee-ai karam milai har naam haree. ||2||

lines.english: In each and every heart, the Lord is hidden; He creates and watches over all. Hereveals Himself in the humble, Saintly Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at gupat  upaa-ay vaykh ai pargat gurmukh  sant janaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are drenched with the Lord's Love. Their minds are drenched with the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of theLord. ||3|| pMnw 1172
lines.transliteration: har har karahi so har rang bheenay har jal amrit  naam manaa. ||3||

lines.english: Those who are blessed with the glory of the Lord's Throne - those Gurmukhs are renowned as supreme.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o takh at milai vadi-aa-ee gurmukh  say parDh aan kee-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਿਤ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ  ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.english: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves becomes the philosopher's stone;they become the companions of the Lord, the Guru. ||4||4||12|| bsMqu mhlw 3 Gru 1 duquky  (1172-3) basant mehlaa 3 gh ar 1 d utukay Basant, Third Mehl, First House, Du-Tukas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1172-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: paaras bhayt bh a-ay say paaras naanak har gur sang thee-ay. ||4||4||12||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਿਟ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਸ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਥੀਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Throughout the months and the seasons, the Lord is always in bloom.
lines.transliteration: maahaa rutee meh sad  basant .

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He rejuvenates all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jit hari-aa sabh  jee-a jant .

lines.english: What can I say? I am just a worm.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ha-o aakhaa kiram jant .

lines.english: No one has found Your beginning or Your end, O Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tayraa kinai na paa-i-aa aad  ant. ||1||

lines.english: Those who serve You, Lord,
lines.transliteration: tai saahib kee karahi sayv.
param sukh paavahi aat am dayv. ||1|| rahaa-o. obtain the greatest peace; their souls are so divine. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: If the Lord is merciful, then the mortal is allowed to serve Him.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai taaN sayvaa karai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he remains dead while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jeevat marai.

lines.english: Night and day, he chants the True Name;
lines.transliteration: an-din saach naam uchrai.
in biDh paraan ee dutar tarai. ||2|| in this way, he crosses over the treacherous world-ocean. ||2||

lines.english: The Creator created both poison and nectar.
lines.transliteration: bikh amrit  kartaar upaa-ay.

lines.english: He attached these two fruits to the world-plant.
lines.transliteration: sansaar birakh ka-o d u-ay fal laa-ay.

lines.english: The Creator Himself is the Doer, the Cause of all.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa karay karaa-ay.

lines.english: He feeds all as He pleases. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai t isai kh avaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: O Nanak, when He casts His Glance of Grace,
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no nadar karay-i.

lines.english: He Himself bestows His Ambrosial Naam.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam aapay d ay-ay.

lines.english: Thus, the desire for sin and corruption is ended.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa kee baasnaa maneh karay-i.

lines.english: The Lord Himself carries out His Own Will. ||4||1|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1172-9) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apnaa bh aanaa aap karay-i. ||4||1||

lines.english: Those who are attuned to the True Lord's Name are happy and exalted.
lines.transliteration: raatay saach har naam nihaalaa.

lines.english: Take pity on me, O God, Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa karahu parabh  deen d a-i-aalaa.

lines.english: Without Him, I have no other at all.
lines.transliteration: tis bin avar nahee mai ko-ay.

lines.english: As it pleases His Will, He keeps me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh ai so-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru, the Lord, is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur gopaal mayrai man bhaa-ay.

lines.english: I cannot even survive, without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. But I shall easily unite with the Guru, if He unites me in His Union. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: reh na saka-o darsan d aykhay bin sahj mila-o gur mayl milaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The greedy mind is enticed by greed.
lines.transliteration: ih man lobhee lobh  lubhaanaa.

lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, it regrets and repents in the end.
lines.transliteration: raam bisaar bahur pachhut aanaa.

lines.english: The separated ones are reunited, when they are inspired to serve the Guru.
lines.transliteration: bichhurat  milaa-ay gur sayv raaNgay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਦੇਖੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲਉ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They are blessed with the Lord's Name - such is the destiny written on theirforeheads. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har naam dee-o mast ak vadbh aagay. ||2||
