lines.english: This body is built of air and water.
lines.transliteration: pa-un paan ee kee ih d ayh sareeraa.

lines.english: The body is afflicted with the terribly painful illness of egotism.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog kathin t an peeraa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh has the Medicine: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam d aaroo gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Guru has cured the illness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur rog gavaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The four evils are the four rivers of fire flowing through the body.
lines.transliteration: chaar nadee-aa agnee t an chaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਕੀ ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: It is burning in desire, and burning in egotism.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa jalat  jalay ahaNkaaray.

lines.english: Those whom the Guru protects and saves are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay vadbh aagee t aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in his heart. ||4||2|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1172-16) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ur har amrit Dh aaray. ||4||2||

lines.english: One who serves the Lord is the Lord's person.
lines.transliteration: har sayvay so har kaa log.

lines.english: He dwells in intuitive peace, and never suffers in sorrow.
lines.transliteration: saach sahj kaday na hovai sog.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are dead; the Lord is not within their minds.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mu-ay naahee har man maahi.

lines.english: They die and die again and again, and are reincarnated, only to die once more. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh bhee mar jaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: They alone are alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say jan jeevay jin har man maahi.

lines.english: They contemplate the True Lord, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saach samHaalih saach samaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not serve the Lord are far away from the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har na sayveh tay har t ay door.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: They wander in foreign lands, with dust thrown on their heads.
lines.transliteration: disantar bh aveh sir paavahi Dh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਏ ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself enjoins His humble servants to serve Him.
lines.transliteration: har aapay jan lee-ay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਭੀ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They live in peace forever, and have no greed at all. ||2|| pMnw 1173
lines.transliteration: tin sad aa sukh  hai til na t amaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, egotism is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay chookai abh imaan.

lines.english: Then, the mortal is honored in the Court of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh paavai maan.

lines.english: He sees the Dear Lord always close at hand, ever-present.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o vaykhai sad  hajoor.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sees the Lord pervading and permeating all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord cherishes all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant kee karay part ipaal.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, contemplate Him forever.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee sad samHaal.

lines.english: You shall go to your true home in the Lord's Court with honor.
lines.transliteration: dar saachai pat  si-o gh ar jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall be blessed with gloriousgreatness. ||4||3|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1173-3) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vadaa-ee paa-ay. ||4||3||

lines.english: One who worships the Lord within his mind,
lines.transliteration: antar poojaa man t ay ho-ay.
ayko vaykhai a-or na ko-ay. sees the One and Only Lord, and no other.

lines.english: People in duality suffer terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: doojai lokee bahut  dukh paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru has shown me the One Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur maino ayk d ikhaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: My God is in bloom, forever in spring.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh ma-oli-aa sad  basant .

lines.english: This mind blossoms forth, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih man ma-oli-aa gaa-ay gun gobind . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So consult the Guru, and reflect upon His wisdom;
lines.transliteration: gur poochhahu t umH karahu beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਿਲਆ  ਗਾਇ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taaN parabh  saachay lagai pi-aar. then, you shall be in love with the True Lord God.

lines.english: Abandon your self-conceit, and be His loving servant.
lines.transliteration: aap chhod hohi d aasat  bhaa-ay.

lines.english: Then, the Life of the World shall come to dwell in your mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ta-o jagjeevan vasai man aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Worship Him with devotion, and see Him always ever-present, close at hand.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karay sad  vaykh ai hajoor.

lines.english: My God is forever permeating and pervading all.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh sad  rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: Only a rare few know the mystery of this devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: is bhagt ee kaa ko-ee jaan ai bhay-o.

lines.english: My God is the Enlightener of all souls. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh mayraa parabh  aatam day-o. ||3||

lines.english: The True Guru Himself unites us in His Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay satgur mayl milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ  ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਭੇਉ ॥
lines.english: He Himself links our consciousness to the Lord, the Life of the World.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan si-o aap chit laa-ay.

lines.english: Thus, our minds and bodies are rejuvenated with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: man tan hari-aa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we remain attuned to the Stringof His Love. ||4||4|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1173-9) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rahay liv laa-ay. ||4||4||

lines.english: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells within their minds,
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al har vasai man aa-ay.
gur kirpaa tay sahj subh aa-ay. by Guru's Grace, with intuitive ease.

lines.english: Through devotional worship, self-conceit is eradicated from within,
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karay vichahu aap kh o-ay.
tad hee saach milaavaa ho-ay. ||1|| and then, one meets the True Lord. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: His devotees are forever beauteous at the Door of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  soheh sad aa har parabh  du-aar.

lines.english: Loving the Guru, they have love and affection for the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai hayt saachai paraym pi-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That humble being who worships the Lord with devotion becomes immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karay so jan nirmal ho-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is eradicated from within.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee vichahu ha-umai kh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell within the mind,
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aap vasai man aa-ay.
sadaa saaNt sukh  sahj samaa-ay. ||2|| and the mortal remains immersed in peace, tranquility and intuitive ease. ||2||

lines.english: Those who are imbued with Truth, are forever in the bloom of spring.
lines.transliteration: saach ratay t in sad  basant .

lines.english: Their minds and bodies are rejuvenated, uttering the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: man tan hari-aa rav gun  guvind .

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, the world is dry and parched.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sookaa sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: It burns in the fire of desire, over and over again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: agan tarisnaa jalai vaaro vaar. ||3||

lines.english: One who does only that which is pleasing to the Dear Lord
lines.transliteration: so-ee karay je har jee-o bhaavai.
sadaa sukh  sareer bh aanai chit  laavai. - his body is forever at peace, and his consciousness is attached to the Lord's Will.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਰਿਵ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਿਵੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: He serves His God with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: apnaa parabh  sayvay sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in his mind. ||4||5|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1173-16) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man aa-ay. ||4||5||

lines.english: Attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabad jalaa-ay.

lines.english: The mind and body are rejuvenated by the Love of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man tan hari-aa sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.english: The tree bears fruit at the Lord's Door,
lines.transliteration: safli-o birakh har kai d u-aar.
saachee banee naam pi-aar. ||1|| in love with the True Bani of the Guru's Word, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.english: This mind is rejuvenated, with intuitive ease;
lines.transliteration: ay man hari-aa sahj subhaa-ay.
sach fal laagai satgur bh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. loving the True Guru, it bears the fruit of truth. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away.
lines.transliteration: aapay nayrhai aapay d oor.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is seen to be ever-present, close at hand.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad vaykh ai sad  hajoor.

lines.english: The plants have blossomed forth, giving a dense shade.
lines.transliteration: chhaav gh anee foolee banraa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh blossoms forth, with intuitive ease. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bigsai sahj subh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night.
lines.transliteration: an-din keert an karahi d in raat .

lines.english: The True Guru drives out sin and doubt from within. pMnw 1174
lines.transliteration: satgur gavaa-ee vichahu jooth  bharaaNt.

lines.english: Gazing upon the wonder of God's Creation, I am wonder-struck and amazed.
lines.transliteration: parpanch vaykh rahi-aa vismaad .

lines.english: The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by His Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh paa-ee-ai naam parsaad . ||3||

lines.english: The Creator Himself enjoys all delights.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa sabh  ras bh og.

lines.english: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so-ee par hog.

lines.english: He is the Great Giver; He has no greed at all.
lines.transliteration: vadaa daat aa til na t amaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, living the Word of the Shabad, the mortal meets with God. ||4||6|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1174-3) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak milee-ai sabad kamaa-ay. ||4||6||

lines.english: By perfect destiny, one acts in truth.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag sach kaar kamaavai.

lines.english: Remembering the One Lord, one does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: ayko chaytai fir jon na aavai.

lines.english: Fruitful is the coming into the world, and the life of one
lines.transliteration: safal janam is jag meh aa-i-aa.
saach naam sahj samaa-i-aa. ||1|| who remains intuitively absorbed in the True Name. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh acts, lovingly attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kaar karahu liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Be dedicated to the Lord's Name, and erad icate self-conceit from within. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har naam sayvhu vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: True is the speech of that humble being;
lines.transliteration: tis jan kee hai saachee ban ee.
gur kai sabad jag maahi samaan ee. through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is spread throughout the world.

lines.english: Throughout the four ages, his fame and glory spread.
lines.transliteration: chahu jug pasree saachee so-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord's humble servant isrecognized and renowned. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam rataa jan pargat ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਗ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Some remain lovingly attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ik saachai sabad rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.english: True are those humble beings who love the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say jan saachay saachai bhaa-ay.

lines.english: They meditate on the True Lord, and behold Him near at hand, ever-present.
lines.transliteration: saach Dhi-aa-in d aykh hajoor.

lines.english: They are the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee pag pankaj Dh oor. ||3||

lines.english: There is only One Creator Lord; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayko kartaa avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, comes Union with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee maylaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ  ਧੂਿਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whoever serves the True Lord finds joy.
lines.transliteration: jin sach sayvi-aa tin ras paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, he is intuitively absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1174-9) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay naam samaa-i-aa. ||4||7||

lines.english: The Lord's humble servant worships Him, and beholds Him ever-present, near athand.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karahi jan d aykh hajoor.

lines.english: He is the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee pag pankaj Dh oor.

lines.english: Those who remain lovingly attuned to the Lord forever
lines.transliteration: har saytee sad  raheh liv laa-ay.
poorai satgur d ee-aa bujh aa-ay. ||1|| are blessed with understanding by the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

lines.english: How rare are those who become the slave of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: daasaa kaa d aas virlaa ko-ee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ  ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: They attain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ootam pad vee paavai so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So serve the One Lord, and no other.
lines.transliteration: ayko sayvhu avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: jit sayvi-ai sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: naa oh marai na aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: Why should I serve any other than Him, O my mother? ||2||
lines.transliteration: tis bin avar sayvee ki-o maa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: True are those humble beings who realize the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: say jan saachay jinee saach pachhaan i-aa.

lines.english: Conquering their self-conceit, they merge intuitively into the Naam, the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: aap maar sehjay naam samaani-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs gather in the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds are immaculate, and their reputations are immaculate. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal nirmal sach so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Know the Lord, who gave you spiritual wisdom,
lines.transliteration: jin gi-aan kee-aa tis har t oo jaan .
saach sabad parabh  ayk sinj aan. and realize the One God, through the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.english: When the mortal tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, he becomes pure and holy.
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhai t aaN suDh  ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam - their reputations are true. ||4||8|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1174-16) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sach so-ay. ||4||8||

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their generations are redeemed and saved.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay kulaaN kaa karahi uDh aar.

lines.english: True is their speech; they love the Naam.
lines.transliteration: saachee banee naam pi-aar.

lines.english: Why have the wandering self-willed manmukhs even come into the world?
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh oolay kaahay aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਤ ਸੁਿਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the mortals waste their lives away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naamhu bhoolay janam gavaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: One who dies while yet alive, truly dies, and embellishes his death.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai mar maran  savaarai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad saach ur Dh aarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਕੁਲ  ਕਾ ਕਰਿਹ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Truth is the food of the Gurmukh; his body is sanctified and pure.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach bh ojan pavit  sareeraa.

lines.english: His mind is immaculate; he is forever the ocean of virtue.
lines.transliteration: man nirmal sad gun ee gaheeraa.

lines.english: He is not forced to come and go in the cycle of birth and death.
lines.transliteration: jammai marai na aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he merges in the True Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee saach samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Serving the True Lord, one realizes Truth.
lines.transliteration: saachaa sayvhu saach pachhaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he goes to the Lord's Court with his banners flying proudly. pMnw 1175
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har d ar neesaan ai.

lines.english: In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains true glory.
lines.transliteration: dar saachai sach sobh aa ho-ay.

lines.english: He comes to dwell in the home of his own inner being. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paavai so-ay. ||3||

lines.english: He cannot be fooled; He is the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: aap abhul sachaa sach so-ay.

lines.english: All others are deluded; in duality, they lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: hor sabh bh ooleh d oojai pat  kho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਰ ਸਿਭ ਭੂਲਿਹ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.english: So serve the True Lord, through the True Bani of His Word.
lines.transliteration: saachaa sayvhu saachee banee.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, merge in the True Lord. ||4||9|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1175-3) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naamay saach samaanee. ||4||9||

lines.english: Without the grace of good karma, all are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: bin karmaa sabh bh aram bh ulaa-ee.

lines.english: In attachment to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi bahut d ukh paa-ee.

lines.english: The blind, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ay tha-ur na paa-ee.

lines.english: They are like maggots in manure, rotting away in manure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bistaa kaa keerhaa bistaa maahi samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: That humble being who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command is accepted.
lines.transliteration: hukam mannay so jan parvaan.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is blessed with the insignia and the banner of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad naam neesaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are imbued with the Naam.
lines.transliteration: saach ratay jinHaa Dh ur likh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is forever pleasing to their minds.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, eternal peace is found.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee ban ee sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: Through it, one's light merges into the Light. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milaa-ay so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, can save the world.
lines.transliteration: ayk naam taaray sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one comes to love the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee naam pi-aar.

lines.english: Without the Naam, no one obtains liberation.
lines.transliteration: bin naamai mukat kinai na paa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay naam palai paa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand.
lines.transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujh aa-ay.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is implanted within.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa naam d arirh-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who know the One Lord are approved and accepted.
lines.transliteration: jin ik jaataa say jan parvaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they go to the Lord's Court with His banner and insignia. ||4||10|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1175-9) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay d ar neesaan . ||4||10||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, the Lord leads the mortal to meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karay satguroo milaa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself comes to abide in his mind.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: His intellect becomes steady and stable, and his mind is strengthened forever.
lines.transliteration: nihchal mat sad aa man Dh eer.

lines.english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Ocean of Virtue. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai gun ee gaheer. ||1||

lines.english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord - those mortals die eating poison.
lines.transliteration: naamhu bhoolay mareh bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.english: Their lives are wasted uselessly, and they continue coming and going in reincarnation.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baritha janam fir aavahi jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They wear all sorts of religious robes, but their minds are not at peace.
lines.transliteration: baho bhaykh  karahi man saaNt na ho-ay.

lines.english: In great egotism, they lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: baho abhimaan apn ee pat  kho-ay.

lines.english: But those who realize the Word of the Shabad, are blessed by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee jin sabad  pachh aani-aa.

lines.english: They bring their distractible minds back home. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baahar jaadaa gh ar meh aan i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Within the home of the inner self is the inaccessible and infinite substance.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh vasat  agam apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who find it, by following the Guru's Teachings, contemplate the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmat kh ojeh sabad  beechaaraa.

lines.english: Those who obtain the nine treasures of the Naam within the home of their own innerbeing,
lines.transliteration: naam nav niDh paa-ee gh ar hee maahi.
sadaa rang raat ay sach samaahi. ||3|| are forever dyed in the color of the Lord's Love; they are absorbed in the Truth. ||3||

lines.english: God Himself does everything; no one can do anything at all by himself.
lines.transliteration: aap karay kichh karan  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: When God so wills, He merges the mortal into Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhaavai la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.english: All are near Him; no one is far away from Him.
lines.transliteration: tis tay nayrh ai naahee ko d oor.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||11|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1175-16) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rahi-aa bharpoor. ||4||11||

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remember the Lord with love,
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har chayt  subh aa-ay.
raam naam ras rahai aghaa-ay. and you shall remain satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.

lines.english: The sins of millions upon millions of lifetimes shall be burnt away.
lines.transliteration: kot kotantar kay paap jal jaahi.

lines.english: Remaining dead while yet alive, you shall be absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jeevat mareh har naam samaahi. ||1||

lines.english: The Dear Lord Himself knows His own bountiful blessings.
lines.transliteration: har kee daat  har jee-o jaan ai.

lines.english: This mind blossoms forth in the Guru's Shabad, chanting the Name of the Lord, the Giver of virtue. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ih man ma-oli-aa har gund aataa naam vakh aanai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: No one is liberated by wandering around in saffron-colored robes.
lines.transliteration: bhagvai vays bh aram mukat  na ho-ay.

lines.english: Tranquility is not found by strict self-discipline.
lines.transliteration: baho sanjam saaNt na paavai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ  ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: But by following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed to receive the Naam, the Nameof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmat naam paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.english: By great good fortune, one finds the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har paavai so-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness comes through the Lord's Name. pMnw 1176
lines.transliteration: kal meh raam naam vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay paa-i-aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Naam find everlasting peace.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sad aa sukh  paa-ee.

lines.english: But without the Naam, mortals burn in egotism. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin naamai ha-umai jal jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: By great good furtune, some contemplate the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har naam beechaaraa.

lines.english: Through the Lord's Name, all sorrows are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: chhootai raam naam d ukh saaraa.

lines.english: He dwells within the heart, and pervades the external universe as well.
lines.transliteration: hirdai vasi-aa so baahar paasaaraa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord knows all. ||4||12|| bsMqu mhlw 3 iek quky ] (1176-3) basant mehlaa 3 ik t ukay. Basant, Third Mehl, Ik-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaanai sabh  upaavan haaraa. ||4||12||

lines.english: I am just a worm, created by You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayraa kee-aa kiram jant .

lines.english: If you bless me, then I chant Your Primal Mantra. ||1||
lines.transliteration: deh ta jaapee aad  mant . ||1||

lines.english: I chant and reflect on His Glorious Virtues, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: gun aakh  veechaaree mayree maa-ay.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, I fall at the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jap har kai laga-o paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I am addicted to the favor of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad laagay naam su-aad .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਲਗਉ  ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Why waste your life in hatred, vengeance and conflict? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaahay janam gavaavahu vair vaad. ||2||

lines.english: When the Guru granted His Grace, my egotism was eradicated,
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa keenHee chookaa abhimaan.
sahj bhaa-ay paa-i-aa har naam. ||3|| and then, I obtained the Lord's Name with intuitive ease. ||3||

lines.english: The most lofty and exalted occupation is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ootam oochaa sabad  kaam.

lines.english: Nanak chants the True Name. ||4||1||13|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1176-7) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhaan ai saach naam. ||4||1||13||

lines.english: The season of spring has come, and all the plants have blossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: banaspat ma-ulee charh i-aa basant .

lines.english: This mind blossoms forth, in association with the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih man ma-oli-aa satguroo sang. ||1||

lines.english: So meditate on the True Lord, O my foolish mind.
lines.transliteration: tumH saach Dh i-aavahu mugaDh  manaa.

lines.english: Only then shall you find peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taaN sukh  paavhu mayray manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This mind blossoms forth, and I am in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: it man ma-uli-ai bh a-i-aa anand.

lines.english: I am blessed with the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit fal paa-i-aa naam gobind . ||2||

lines.english: Everyone speaks and says that the Lord is the One and Only.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk sabh aakh  vakh aanai.

lines.english: By understanding the Hukam of His Command, we come to know the One Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hukam boojhai t aaN ayko jaan ai. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, no one can describe the Lord by speaking through ego.
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak ha-umai kahai na ko-ay.

lines.english: All speech and insight comes from our Lord and Master. ||4||2||14|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1176-11) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aakhan  vaykh an sabh  saahib t ay ho-ay. ||4||2||14||

lines.english: All the ages were created by You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh jug t ayray keet ay ho-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one's intellect is awakened. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai mat  buDh  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Dear Lord, please blend me with Yourself;
lines.transliteration: har jee-o aapay laihu milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sach naam samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. let me merge in the True Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਣੁ  ਵੇਖਣੁ  ਸਭੁ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
lines.english: When the mind is in spring, all people are rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: man basant haray sabh  lo-ay.

lines.english: Blossoming forth and flowering through the Lord's Name, peace is obtained. ||2||
lines.transliteration: faleh fulee-ah raam naam sukh ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is in spring forever,
lines.transliteration: sadaa basant  gur sabad  veechaaray.
raam naam raakhai ur Dh aaray. ||3|| with the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

lines.english: When the mind is in spring, the body and mind are rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: man basant t an man hari-aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this body is the tree which bears the fruit of the Lord's Name. ||4||3||15|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1176-15) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ih tan birakh  raam naam fal paa-ay so-ay. ||4||3||15||

lines.english: They alone are in the spring season, who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tinH basant  jo har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.english: They come to worship the Lord with devotion, through their perfect destiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag har bh agat karaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਫਲਿਹ  ਫੁਲੀਅਿਹ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: This mind is not even touched by spring.
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o basant kee lagai na so-ay.

lines.english: This mind is burnt by duality and double-mindedness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih man jali-aa doojai d o-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This mind is entangled in worldly affairs, creating more and more karma.
lines.transliteration: ih man DhanDh ai baaNDhaa karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Enchanted by Maya, it cries out in suffering forever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moothaa sad aa billaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
lines.english: This mind is released, only when it meets with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ih man chhootai jaaN satgur bh aytai.

lines.english: Then, it does not suffer beatings by the Messenger of Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal kee fir aavai na faytai. ||3||

lines.english: This mind is released, when the Guru emancipates it.
lines.transliteration: ih man chhootaa gur lee-aa chh adaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, attachment to Maya is burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||16|| bsMqu mhlw 3 ] (1176-19) basant mehlaa 3. Basant, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak maa-i-aa moh sabad jalaa-ay. ||4||4||16||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੰਤ  ਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Spring has come, and all the plants are flowering.
lines.transliteration: basant charh i-aa foolee banraa-ay.

lines.english: These beings and creatures blossom forth when they focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1|| pMnw 1177
lines.transliteration: ayhi jee-a jant fooleh har chit  laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: In this way, this mind is rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: in biDh ih man hari-aa ho-ay.

lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night, egotism is removed and washed away from the Gurmukhs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam japai din raat ee gurmukh  ha-umai kadh ai Dho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru speaks the Bani of the Word, and the Shabad, the Word of God.
lines.transliteration: satgur ban ee sabad  sunaa-ay.

lines.english: This world blossoms forth in its greenery, through the love of the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ih jag hari-aa satgur bh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The mortal blossoms forth in flower and fruit, when the Lord Himself so wills.
lines.transliteration: fal fool laagay jaaN aapay laa-ay.

lines.english: He is attached to the Lord, the Primal Root of all, when he finds the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mool lagai taaN satgur paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਲਾਗੇ  ਜ ਆਪੇ  ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is the season of spring; the whole world is His Garden.
lines.transliteration: aap basant jagat  sabh  vaarh ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, this most unique devotional worship comes only by perfect destiny.||4||5||17|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 3 Gru 2  (1177-5) basant hindol mehlaa 3 gh ar 2 Basant Hindol, Third Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1177-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak poorai bhaag bh agat niraalee. ||4||5||17||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny. I am devotedand dedicated to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee vitahu vaari-aa bh aa-ee gur sabad  vitahu bal jaa-ee.

lines.english: I praise my Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny. I focus my consciousness on theGuru's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur saalaahee sad apn aa bh aa-ee gur charn ee chit  laa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mayray man raam naam chit laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in lush greenery, and you shall obtain the fruit of the Name of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan t ayraa hari-aa hovai ik har naamaa fal paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਸਦ ਅਪਣਾ  ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, O Siblings of Destiny. They drink inthe Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: gur raakhay say ubray bh aa-ee har ras amrit  pee-aa-ay.

lines.english: The pain of egotism within is eradicated and banished, O Siblings of Destiny, andpeace comes to dwell in their minds. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vichahu ha-umai dukh  uth ga-i-aa bh aa-ee sukh  vuthaa man aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhur aapay jinHaa no bakh si-on bh aa-ee sabd ay la-i-an milaa-ay. Those whom the Primal Lord Himself forgives, O Siblings of Destiny, are united withthe Word of the Shabad.

Dhoorh  tinHaa kee agh ulee-ai bh aa-ee sat sangat  mayl milaa-ay. ||3|| The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in the company of Sadh Sangat, the TrueCongregation, we are united with the Lord. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself does, and causes all to be done, O Siblings of Destiny; He makeseverything blossom forth in green abundance.
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay karay aap bhaa-ee jin hari-aa kee-aa sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਿਠ ਗਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: ||4||1||18||12||18||30|| O Nanak, peace fills their minds and bodies forever, O Siblings of Destiny; they areunited with the Shabad. ||4||1||18||12||18||30|| rwgu bsMqu mhlw 4 Gru 1 iek quky  (1177-13) raag basant mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 ik t ukay Raag Basant, Fourth Mehl, First House, Ik-Tukay: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1177-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ihMfol, mÚ 3) naanak man tan sukh  sad vasai bh aa-ee sabad  milaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਨੋ ਬਖਿਸਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ  ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Just as the light of the sun's rays spread out,
lines.transliteration: ji-o pasree sooraj kiran jot .

lines.punjabi: ਧੂਿੜ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੀ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ti-o gh at ghat rama-ee-aa ot  pot. ||1|| the Lord permeates each and every heart, through and through. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is permeating and pervading all places.
lines.transliteration: ayko har ravi-aa sarab thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with Him, O my mother.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee milee-ai mayree maa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਇਕ ਤੁਕੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is deep within each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar ayko har so-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the One Lord becomes manifest, radiating forth. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai ik pargat ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The One and Only Lord is present and prevailing everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk rahi-aa bharpoor.

lines.english: The greedy, faithless cynic thinks that God is far away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saakat nar lobh ee jaan eh door. ||3||

lines.english: The One and Only Lord permeates and pervades the world.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk vartai har lo-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, whatever the One Lord does comes to pass. ||4||1|| bsMqu mhlw 4 ] (1177-17) basant mehlaa 4. Basant, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har ayko karay so ho-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Day and night, the two calls are sent out.
lines.transliteration: rain d inas d u-ay sad ay pa-ay.

lines.english: O mortal, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, who protects you forever, and savesyou in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man har simrahu ant sad aa rakh  la-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Concentrate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: har har chayt sad aa man mayray.

lines.english: God the Destroyer of all depression and suffering is found, through the Guru'sTeachings, singing the Glorious Praises of God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh aalas d ookh bhanj parabh  paa-i-aa gurmat  gaavhu gun  parabh  kayray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs die of their egotism, over and over again. pMnw 1178
lines.transliteration: manmukh fir fir ha-umai mu-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਲ  ਦੈਿਤ  ਸੰਘਾਰੇ  ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They are destroyed by Death's demons, and they must go to the City of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaal dait  sangh aaray jam pur ga-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are lovingly attached to the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har har har liv laagay.

lines.english: Their pains of both birth and death are taken away. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam maran d o-oo d ukh bhaagay. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord showers His Mercy on His humble devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa ka-o har kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.english: Guru Nanak has shown mercy to me; I have met the Lord, the Lord of the forest. ||4||2|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 4 Gru 2  (1178-3) basant hindol mehlaa 4 gh ar 2 Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1178-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuth aa mili-aa banvaaree. ||4||2||

lines.english: The Lord's Name is a jewel, hidden in a chamber of the palace of the body-fortress.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ratan koth -rhee garh  mand ar ayk lukaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ  ਕੋਠੜੀ  ਗੜ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਏਕ ਲੁਕਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: When one meets the True Guru, then he searches and finds it, and his light mergeswith the Divine Light. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a khojee-ai mil jot ee jot  samaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਖੋਜੀਐ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, lead me to meet with the Holy Person, the Guru.
lines.transliteration: maaDho saaDh oo jan d ayh milaa-ay.

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my sins are erased, and I obtain the supreme, sublime, sanctified status. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daykh at daras paap sabh  naaseh pavit ar param pad  paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਤ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਾਪ ਸਿਭ ਨਾਸਿਹ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The five thieves join together and plunder the body-village, stealing the wealth of theLord's Name.
lines.transliteration: panch chor mil laagay nagree-aa raam naam Dhan hiri-aa.

lines.english: But through the Guru's Teachings, they are traced and caught, and this wealth isrecovered intact. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmat kh oj paray t ab pakray Dh an saabat  raas ubri-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਨਗਰੀਆ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਿਹਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Practicing hypocrisy and superstition, people have grown weary of the effort, but still,deep within their hearts, they yearn for Maya, Maya.
lines.transliteration: pakhand bh aram upaav kar thaakay rid  antar maa-i-aa maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਖੋਜ ਪਰੇ ਤਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਉਬਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Holy Person, I have met with the Lord, the Primal Being, and thedarkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo purakh  purakh pat paa-i-aa agi-aan anDh ayr gavaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਖੰਡ  ਭਰਮ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Lord of the Earth, the Lord of the Universe, in His Mercy, leads me tomeet the Holy Person, the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jagannaath jagdees gusaa-ee kar kirpaa saaDh  milaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪੁਰਖਪਿਤ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, peace then comes to abide deep within my mind, and I constantly sing theGlorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||4||1||3|| bsMqu mhlw 4 ihMfol ] (1178-10) basant mehlaa 4 hindol. Basant, Fourth Mehl, Hindol:
lines.transliteration: naanak saaNt hovai man ant ar nit hirdai har gun  gaavai. ||4||1||3||

lines.english: You are the Great Supreme Being, the Vast and Inaccessible Lord of the World; I am a mere insect, a worm created by You.
lines.transliteration: tumH vad purakh  vad agam gusaa-ee ham keeray kiram t umnachh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਨਤ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, please grant Your Grace; O God, I long for the feet ofthe Guru, the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har deen d a-i-aal karahu parabh  kirpaa gur sat gur charan  ham banchh ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please be merciful and unite me with the Sat Sangat, theTrue Congregation.
lines.transliteration: gobind jee-o sat sangat  mayl kar kirpachh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਵਡ ਅਗਮ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਿਕਰਮ  ਤੁਮਨਛੇ  ॥
lines.english: 4) janam janam kay kilvikh mal bh ari-aa mil sangat  kar parabh  hanchh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. I was overflowing with the filthy sins of countless past lives. But joining the Sangat, God made me pure again. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਚਰਣ  ਹਮ ਬਨਛੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your humble servant, whether of high class or low class, O Lord - by meditating onYou, the sinner becomes pure.
lines.transliteration: tumHraa jan jaat  avijaat aa har japi-o pat it paveechh ay.

lines.english: The Lord exalts and elevates him above the whole world, and the Lord God blesseshim with the Lord's Glory. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kee-o sagal bhavan t ay oopar har sobh aa har parabh  dinchh ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਮਲੁ ਭਿਰਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਨਛੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Anyone who meditates on God, whether of high class or low class, will have all of hishopes and desires fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jaat ajaat  ko-ee parabh  Dhi-aavai sabh  pooray maanas t inchh ay.

lines.english: Those humble servants of the Lord who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, are blessed, and are made great and totally perfect. ||3||
lines.transliteration: say Dhan vaday vad pooray har jan jinH har Dh aari-o har urchh ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਿਤ  ਅਿਵਜਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਵੀਛੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am so low, I am an utterly heavy lump of clay. Please shower Your Mercy on me,Lord, and unite me with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: ham dheeNdhay dh eem bahut  at bhaaree har Dh aar kirpaa parabh  milchh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਓ  ਸਗਲ  ਭਵਨ  ਤੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਦਨਛੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord, in His Mercy, has led servant Nanak to find the Guru; I was a sinner, andnow I have become immaculate and pure. ||||4||2||4|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 4 ] (1178-16) basant hindol mehlaa 4. Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur paa-i-aa har tooth ay ham kee-ay pat it paveechh ay. ||4||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਤ  ਅਜਾਿਤ  ਕੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਸਿਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਨਸ  ਿਤਨਛੇ  ॥
lines.english: My mind cannot survive, even for an instant, without the Lord. I drink in continuallythe sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayraa ik khin manoo-aa reh na sakai nit  har har naam ras geeDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਧੰਿਨ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਉਰਛੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: It is like a baby, who joyfully sucks at his mother's breast; when the breast iswithdrawn, he weeps and cries. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o baarik rasak pari-o than maataa than kaadh ay bilal bileeDh ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਢੀਂਢੇ  ਢੀਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਛੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, my mind and body are pierced through by the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gobind jee-o mayray man t an naam har beeDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਤੂਠੇ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਵੀਛੇ  ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
lines.english: 4) vadai bhaag gur sat gur paa-i-aa vich kaa-i-aa nagar har seeDh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru, and in the body-village, the Lord has revealed Himself. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1179

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰ  ਹਿਰ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Each and every breath of the Lord's humble servant is pierced through with love of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jan kay saas saas hai jaytay har bireh parabh oo har beeDh ay.

lines.english: As the lotus is totally in love with the water and withers away without seeing thewater, so am I in love with the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal kamal pareet at  bhaaree bin jal d aykhay sukleeDh ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਰਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹਿਰ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant chants the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord;through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself.
lines.transliteration: jan japi-o naam niranjan narhar updays guroo har pareeDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਜਲ ਦੇਖੇ ਸੁਕਲੀਧੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The filth of egotism which stained me for countless lifetimes has been washed away,by the Ambrosial Water of the Ocean of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee ha-umai mal niksee har amrit har jal neeDh ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਜਿਪਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਰਹਿਰ  ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਧੇ ॥
lines.english: Please, do not take my karma into account, O my Lord and Master; please save thehonor of Your slave.
lines.transliteration: hamray karam na bichrahu thaakur t umH paij rakh ahu apneeDh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਲੁ ਿਨਕਸੀ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਲ ਨੀਧੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord, if it pleases You, hear my prayer; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.||4||3||5|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 4 ] (1179-5) basant hindol mehlaa 4. Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har bhaavai sun  bin-o baynt ee jan naanak saran  paveeDh ay. ||4||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਕਰਮ  ਨ ਿਬਚਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੁਮ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀਧੇ  ॥
lines.english: Each and every moment, my mind roams and rambles, and runs all over the place. Itdoes not stay in its own home, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: man khin kh in bharam bh aram baho Dh aavai t il ghar nahee vaasaa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਿਣ ਿਬਨਉ  ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਵੀਧੇ  ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: But when the bridle of the Shabad, the Word of God, is placed over its head, it returns to dwell in its own home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur ankas sabad d aaroo sir Dh aari-o gh ar mand ar aan  vasaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, lead me to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation,so that I may meditate on You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: gobind jee-o sat sangat  mayl har Dh i-aa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ਿਤਲੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਨਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am cured of the disease of egotism, and I have found peace; I have intuitivelyentered into the state of Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog ga-i-aa sukh paa-i-aa har sahj samaaDh  lagaa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਅੰਕਸੁ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਦਾਰੂ ਿਸਿਰ  ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਘਿਰ  ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਆਿਣ ਵਸਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This house is loaded with countless gems, jewels, rubies and emeralds, but thewandering mind cannot find them.
lines.transliteration: ghar rat an laal baho maan ak laad ay man bh armi-aa leh na sakaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: As the water-diviner finds the hidden water, and the well is then dug in an instant, sodo we find the object of the Name through the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o odaa koop guhaj khin kaadh ai ti-o sat gur vasat  lahaa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru - cursed, cursed are the lives of thosepeople.
lines.transliteration: jin aisaa satgur saaDh  na paa-i-aa t ay Dh arig Dh arig nar jeevaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: The treasure of this human life is obtained when one's virtues bear fruit, but it is lostin exchange for a mere shell. ||3||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath punn fal paa-i-aa ka-udee bad lai jaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਰਤਨ  ਲਾਲ  ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕ  ਲਾਦੇ  ਮਨੁ ਭਰ੍ਿਮਆ  ਲਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord God, please be merciful to me; be merciful, and lead me to meet the Guru.
lines.transliteration: maDhusood an har Dh aar parabh  kirpaa kar kirpaa guroo milaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਓਡਾ ਕੂਪੁ ਗੁਹਜ  ਿਖਨ ਕਾਢੈ  ਿਤਉ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਲਹਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has attained the state of Nirvaanaa; meeting with the Holy people, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||4||6|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 4 ] (1179-12) basant hindol mehlaa 4. Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak nirbaan pad  paa-i-aa mil saaDh oo har gun  gaa-ee-ai. ||4||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤੇ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਨਰ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going, he suffers the pains of vice and corruption; the body of the self-willed manmukh is desolate and vacant.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  bha-i-aa d ukh bikhi-aa d ayh manmukh  sunjee sunj .

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪੁੰਿਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He does not dwell on the Lord's Name, even for an instant, and so the Messenger ofDeath seizes him by his hair. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam khin pal nahee chayt i-aa jam pakray kaal salunj . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ  ਹਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please rid me of the poison of egotism and attachment.
lines.transliteration: gobind jee-o bikh  ha-umai mamt aa munj .

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਿਨਰਬਾਣ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: The Sat Sangat, Guru's True Congregation is so dear to the Lord. So join the Sangat,and taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Please be kind to me, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of theHoly; I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  saaDh  da-i-aa kar maylhu sarn aagat  saaDh oo pannj .

lines.transliteration: har ustat  Dhaarahu rid  antar su-aamee sat sangat  mil buDh  lanj.

lines.english: I have fallen in love with the Lord's Name; I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: I serve the Guru, and humbly bow to Him.

lines.english: Today is a day of celebration for me.

lines.transliteration: sad Dh i-aanee jis gureh rang. ||2||

lines.english: He alone is fearless, who has the Fear of God.
lines.transliteration: say nirbha-o jinH bha-o pa-i-aa.

lines.english: He alone is peaceful, whose doubts are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: so sukhee-aa jis bh aram ga-i-aa.
