lines.transliteration: an root naahee naahee.

lines.english: Do not wander lost in doubt and delusion.
lines.transliteration: mat bh aram bh oolahu bh oolahu.

lines.english: One who has such destiny written on his forehead, shall meet with the Guru and findthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur milay har paa-ay. jis mastak hai laykh aa.

lines.english: O mortal, this is the season of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: man rut naam ray.

lines.english: Nanak utters the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||2||18|| bsMqu mhlw 5 Gru 2 ihMfol  (1185-9) basant mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 hindol Basant, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Hindol: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1185-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: gun kahay naanak har haray har haray. ||2||18||

lines.english: Come and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; dispel your sense of duality and letyourselves be lovingly absorbed in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay ikatar milhu mayray bh aa-ee d ubiDh aa door karahu liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Let yourselves be joined to the Name of the Lord; become Gurmukh, spread out yourmat, and sit down. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naamai kay hovhu jorhee gurmukh  baishu safaa vichh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: In this way, throw the dice, O brothers.
lines.transliteration: inH biDh paasaa dh aalahu beer.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. At the very last moment, you shall not have to suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam japahu d in raat ee ant  kaal nah laagai peer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Let righteous actions be your gameboard, and let the truth be your dice.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam t umH cha-uparh  saajahu sat  karahu t umH saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤਰ੍  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Conquer sexual desire, anger, greed and worldly attachment; only such a game as thisis dear to the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh jeet ahu aisee kh ayl har pi-aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜੋੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸਫਾ ਿਵਛਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Rise in the early hours of the morning, and take your cleansing bath. Before you go to bed at night, remember to worship the Lord.
lines.transliteration: uth isnaan karahu parbh aatay so-ay har aaraaDh ay.

lines.english: My True Guru will assist you, even on your most difficult moves; you shall reach yourtrue home in celestial peace and poise. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bikh-rh ay daa-o langh aavai mayraa sat gur sukh  sahj sayt ee gh ar jaat ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਅੰਤ ਕਾਿਲ  ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ  ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself plays, and He Himself watches; the Lord Himself created thecreation.
lines.transliteration: har aapay khaylai aapay d aykhai har aapay rachan rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, that person who plays this game as Gurmukh, wins the game of life,and returns to his true home. ||4||1||19|| bsMqu mhlw 5 ihMfol ] (1185-16) basant mehlaa 5 hindol. Basant, Fifth Mehl, Hindol:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gurmukh jo nar kh aylai so jin  baajee gh ar aa-i-aa. ||4||1||19||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਤੁਮ ਚਉਪਿੜ  ਸਾਜਹੁ ਸਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You alone know Your Creative Power, O Lord; no one else knows it.
lines.transliteration: tayree kud rat toohai jaan eh a-or na d oojaa jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੀਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ  ਖੇਲ ਹਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone realizes You, O my Beloved, unto whom You show Your Mercy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis no kirpaa karahi mayray pi-aaray so-ee tujh ai pachh aanai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਿਠ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ  ਸੋਏ ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: tayri-aa bh agtaa ka-o balihaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੜੇ  ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਤੀ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਤੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your place is eternally beautiful, God; Your wonders are infinite. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: thaan suhaavaa sadaa parabh  tayraa rang t ayray aapaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Only You Yourself can perform Your service. No one else can do it.
lines.transliteration: tayree sayvaa t ujh tay hovai a-or na d oojaa kart aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਸੋ ਿਜਿਣ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
lines.english: He alone is Your devotee, who is pleasing to You. You bless them with Your Love. ||2|| pMnw 1186
lines.transliteration: bhagat  tayraa so-ee t uDh bhaavai jis no t oo rang Dh artaa. ||2||

lines.english: You are the Great Giver; You are so very Wise. There is no other like You.
lines.transliteration: too vad d aataa too vad d aanaa a-or nahee ko d oojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ  ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਨਾ  ਅਉਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are my All-powerful Lord and Master; I do not know how to worship You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: too samrath su-aamee mayraa ha-o ki-aa jaan aa tayree poojaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Your Mansion is imperceptible, O my Beloved; it is so difficult to accept Your Will.
lines.transliteration: tayraa mahal agochar mayray pi-aaray bikh am tayraa hai bh aanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਭਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have collapsed at Your Door, Lord. I am foolish and ignorant - please save me! ||4||2||20|| bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 5 ] (1186-3) basant hindol mehlaa 5. Basant Hindol, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak dheh pa-i-aa d u-aarai rakh  layvhu mugaDh  ajaan aa. ||4||2||20||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਢਿਹ ਪਇਆ  ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਰਿਖ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ  ਅਜਾਣਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The mortal does not know the Primal Lord God; he does not understand hmself. He isengrossed in doubt and egotism. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mool na boojhai aap na soojh ai bharam bi-aapee ahaN manee. ||1||

lines.english: My Father is the Supreme Lord God, my Master.
lines.transliteration: pitaa paarbarahm parabh  Dhanee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਿਬਆਪੀ  ਅਹੰ ਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am unworthy, but please save me anyway. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi nistaarahu nirgunee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Creation and destruction come only from God; this is what the Lord's humble servants believe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: opat parla-o parabh  tay hovai ih beechaaree har janee. ||2||

lines.english: Only those who are imbued with God's Name are judged to be peaceful in this DarkAge of Kali Yuga. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam parabhoo kay jo rang raat ay kal meh sukh ee-ay say ganee. ||3||

lines.english: It is the Guru's Word that carries us across; Nanak cannot think of any other way.||4||3||21|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (1186-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu bsMqu ihMfol mhlw 9 ] (1186-7) raag basant hindol mehlaa 9. Raag Basant Hindol, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: avar upaa-o na ko-ee soojhai naanak t aree-ai gur bachnee. ||4||3||21||

lines.punjabi: ਓਪਿਤ  ਪਰਲਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Holy Saints, know that this body is false.
lines.transliteration: saaDho ih t an mithi-aa jaan-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਸੇ ਗਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord who dwells within it - recognize that He alone is real. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: yaa bheet ar jo raam basat  hai saacho t aahi pachh aano. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਉਪਾਉ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The wealth of this world is only a dream; why are you so proud of it?
lines.transliteration: ih jag hai sampat supnay kee d aykh kahaa aidaano.

lines.english: None of it shall go along with you in the end; why do you cling to it? ||1||
lines.transliteration: sang tihaarai kachh oo na chaalai t aahi kahaa laptaano. ||1||

lines.english: Leave behind both praise and slander; enshrine the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises within your heart.
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa do-oo parhar har keerat  ur aano.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, the One Primal Being, the Lord God, is totally permeatingeverywhere. ||2||1|| bsMqu mhlw 9 ] (1186-10) basant mehlaa 9. Basant, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sabh hee mai pooran ayk purakh  bhagvaano. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਯਾ ਭੀਤਿਰ ਜੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਾਚੋ ਤਾਿਹ  ਪਛਾਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The heart of the sinner is filled with unfulfilled sexual desire.
lines.transliteration: paapee hee-ai mai kaam basaa-ay.

lines.english: He cannot control his fickle mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man chanchal yaa tay gahi-o na jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਸੁਪਨੇ  ਕੀ ਦੇਿਖ ਕਹਾ ਐਡਾਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Yogis, wandering ascetics and renunciates
lines.transliteration: jogee jangam ar sanni-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਤਹਾਰੈ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਕਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh hee par daaree ih faas. ||1|| - this net is cast over them all. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਦੋਊ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਉਿਰ ਆਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: Those who contemplate the Name of the Lord
lines.transliteration: jihi jihi har ko naam samHaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ  ਭਗਵਾਨੋ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tay bh av saagar ut ray paar. ||2|| cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

lines.english: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kee sarnaa-ay.

lines.english: Please bestow the blessing of Your Name, that he may continue to sing Your GloriousPraises. ||3||2|| bsMqu mhlw 9 ] (1186-13) basant mehlaa 9. Basant, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: deejai naam rahai gun gaa-ay. ||3||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ  ਯਾ ਤੇ ਗਿਹਓ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mother, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mai Dhan paa-i-o har naam.

lines.english: My mind has stopped its wanderings, and now, it has come to rest. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man mayro Dhaavan t ay chh ooti-o kar baith o bisraam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Attachment to Maya has run away from my body, and immaculate spiritual wisdomhas welled up within me.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mamtaa t an tay bh aagee upji-o nirmal gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਪਿਰ ਡਾਰੀ  ਇਹ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Greed and attachment cannot even touch me; I have grasped hold of devotionalworship of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: lobh moh ayh paras na saakai gahee bh agat bhagvaan. ||1||

lines.english: The cynicism of countless lifetimes has been eradicated, since I obtained the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa sansaa chookaa ratan naam jab paa-i-aa.

lines.english: My mind was rid of all its desires, and I was absorbed in the peace of my own innerbeing. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa sakal binaasee man t ay nij sukh  maahi samaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: That person, unto whom the Merciful Lord shows compassion, sings the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o hot d a-i-aal kirpaa niDh  so gobind  gun gaavai.

lines.english: Says Nanak, this wealth is gathered only by the Gurmukh. ||3||3|| bsMqu mhlw 9 ] (1186-17) basant mehlaa 9. Basant, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih biDh kee sampai ko-oo gurmukh  paavai. ||3||3||

lines.english: O my mind, how can you forget the Lord's Name?
lines.transliteration: man kahaa bisaari-o raam naam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: When the body perishes, you shall have to deal with the Messenger of Death.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan binsai jam si-o parai kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਧਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਿਟਓ  ਕਿਰ ਬੈਠੋ ਿਬਸਰਾਮੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This world is just a hill of smoke. pMnw 1187
lines.transliteration: ih jag Dhoo-ay kaa pahaar.

lines.english: What makes you think that it is real? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tai saachaa maani-aa kih bichaar. ||1||

lines.english: Dhan d aaraa sampat  garayh. Wealth, spouse, property and household

lines.punjabi: ਕਛੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਸਮਝ  ਲੇਹ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kachh sang na chaalai samajh  layh. ||2|| - none of them shall go along with you; you must know that this is true! ||2||

lines.english: Only devotion to the Lord shall go with you.
lines.transliteration: ik bhagat  naaraa-in ho-ay sang.

lines.english: Says Nanak, vibrate and meditate on the Lord with single-minded love. ||3||4|| bsMqu mhlw 9 ] (1187-2) basant mehlaa 9. Basant, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhaj t ih ayk rang. ||3||4||

lines.english: Why do you wander lost, O mortal, attached to falsehood and greed?
lines.transliteration: kahaa bhooli-o ray jh oothay lobh  laag.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਭੂਿਲਓ  ਰੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਾਗ  ॥
lines.english: Nothing has been lost yet - there is still time to wake up! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kachh bigri-o naahin ajahu jaag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You must realize that this world is nothing more than a dream.
lines.transliteration: sam supnai kai ih jag jaan.

lines.english: In an instant, it shall perish; know this as true. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binsai chhin mai saachee maan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਮ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਕੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord constantly abides with you.
lines.transliteration: sang tayrai har basat  neet.

lines.english: Night and day, vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nis baasur bhaj t aahi meet . ||2||

lines.english: At the very last instant, He shall be your Help and Support.
lines.transliteration: baar ant kee ho-ay sahaa-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, sing His Praises. ||3||5|| bsMqu mhlw 1 AstpdIAw Gru 1 duqukIAw  (1187-6) basant mehlaa 1 asatpad ee-aa gh ar 1 d utukee-aa Basant, First Mehl, Ashtapadees, First House, Du-Tukees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1187-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gun taa kay gaa-ay. ||3||5||

lines.english: The world is a crow; it does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jag ka-oo-aa naam nahee cheet.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗਾਇ  ॥੩॥੫॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, it sees the bait, and pecks at it.
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar girai daykh  bheet.

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The mind wavers unsteadily, in guilt and deceit.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa dolai cheet aneet .

lines.english: I have shattered my attachment to the false world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jag si-o tootee jh ooth pareet . ||1||

lines.english: The burden of sexual desire, anger and corruption is unbearable.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh bikh  bajar bh aar.

lines.english: Without the Naam, how can the mortal maintain a virtuous lifestyle? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kaisay gun chaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The world is like a house of sand, built on a whirlpool;
lines.transliteration: ghar baaloo kaa gh ooman gh ayr.
barkhas ban ee bud budaa hayr. it is like a bubble formed by drops of rain.

lines.english: It is formed from a mere drop, when the Lord's wheel turns round.
lines.transliteration: matar boond  tay Dh ar chak fayr.

lines.english: The lights of all souls are the servants of the Lord's Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarab jot naamai kee chayr. ||2||

lines.english: My Supreme Guru has created everything.
lines.transliteration: sarab upaa-ay guroo sir mor.

lines.english: I perform devotional worship service to You, and fall at Your Feet, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  kara-o pag laaga-o t or.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤਰ੍ ਬੂੰਦ ਤੇ ਧਿਰ ਚਕੁ ਫੇਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Imbued with Your Name, I long to be Yours.
lines.transliteration: naam rato chaaha-o t ujh or.

lines.english: Those who do not let the Naam become manifest within themselves, depart like thieves in the end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam duraa-ay chalai so chor. ||3||

lines.english: The mortal loses his honor, gathering sin and corruption.
lines.transliteration: pat kh o-ee bikh  anchal paa-ay.

lines.english: But imbued with the Lord's Name, you shall go to your true home with honor.
lines.transliteration: saach naam rato pat  si-o gh ar jaa-ay.

lines.english: God does whatever He wills.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh keenHas parabh  rajaa-ay.

lines.english: One who abides in the Fear of God, becomes fearless, O my mother. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bhai maanai nirbh a-o mayree maa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The woman desires beauty and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: kaaman chaahai sundar bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੋ ਪਿਤ ਿਸਉ ਘਿਰ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But betel leaves, garlands of flowers and sweet tastes lead only to disease.
lines.transliteration: paan fool meethay ras rog.

lines.english: The more she plays and enjoys, the more she suffers in sorrow.
lines.transliteration: kheelai bigsai t ayto sog.

lines.english: But when she enters into the Sanctuary of God, whatever she wishes comes to pass.||5||
lines.transliteration: parabh sarn aagat  keenHas hog. ||5||

lines.english: She wears beautiful clothes with all sorts of decorations.
lines.transliteration: kaaparh pahiras aDh ik seegaar.

lines.english: But the flowers turn to dust, and her beauty leads her into evil.
lines.transliteration: maatee foolee roop bikaar.

lines.english: Hope and desire have blocked the doorway.
lines.transliteration: aasaa mansaa baaNDho baar.

lines.english: Without the Naam, one's hearth and home are deserted. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa soonaa ghar baar. ||6||

lines.english: O princess, my daughter, run away from this place!
lines.transliteration: gaachhahu put ree raaj ku-aar.

lines.english: Chant the True Name, and embellish your days.
lines.transliteration: naam bhan ahu sach d ot savaar.

lines.english: Serve your Beloved Lord God, and lean on the Support of His Love.
lines.transliteration: pari-o sayvhu parabh paraym aDh aar.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, abandon your thirst for corruption andpoison. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee bikh  ti-aas nivaar. ||7||

lines.english: My Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind.
lines.transliteration: mohan mohi lee-aa man mohi.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have realized You, Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad pachh aanaa t ohi.

lines.english: Nanak stands longingly at God's Door.
lines.transliteration: naanak thaadh ay chaaheh parabh oo du-aar.

lines.english: I am content and satisfied with Your Name; please shower me with Your Mercy. ||8||1|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1187-17) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tayray naam sant okhay kirpaa Dh aar. ||8||1||

lines.english: The mind is deluded by doubt; it comes and goes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: man bhoola-o bh armas aa-ay jaa-ay.

lines.english: It is lured by the poisonous lure of Maya.
lines.transliteration: at lubaDh  lubhaana-o bikh am maa-ay.

lines.english: It does not remain stable in the Love of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: nah asthir deesai ayk bh aa-ay.

lines.english: Like the fish, its neck is pierced by the hook. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o meen kundlee-aa kanth paa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The deluded mind is instructed by the True Name.
lines.transliteration: man bhoola-o samjh as saach naa-ay.

lines.english: It contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1188
lines.transliteration: gur sabad beechaaray sahj bh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The mind, deluded by doubt, buzzes around like a bumble bee.
lines.transliteration: man bhoola-o bh armas bh avar t aar.

lines.english: The holes of the body are worthless, if the mind is filled with such great desire forcorrupt passions.
lines.transliteration: bil birthay chaahai baho bikaar.

lines.english: It is like the elephant, trapped by its own sexual desire.
lines.transliteration: maigal ji-o faasas kaamhaar.

lines.english: It is caught and held tight by the chains, and beaten on its head. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karh banDh an baaDh i-o sees maar. ||2||

lines.english: The mind is like a foolish frog, without devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: man mugDhou d aadar bhagtiheen.

lines.english: It is cursed and condemned in the Court of the Lord, without the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: dar bh arsat saraapee naam been.

lines.english: He has no class or honor, and no one even mentions his name.
lines.transliteration: taa kai jaat  na paat ee naam leen.

lines.english: That person who lacks virtue - all of his pains and sorrows are his only companions. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh d ookh sakhaa-ee gun ah been. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਤੀ  ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨ  ॥
lines.english: His mind wanders out, and cannot be brought back or restrained.
lines.transliteration: man chalai na jaa-ee thaak raakh .

lines.english: Without being imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, it has no honor or credit.
lines.transliteration: bin har ras raatay pat  na saakh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਠਾਿਕ  ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Listener, Lord, and You Yourself are our Protector.
lines.transliteration: too aapay surt aa aap raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਪਿਤ ਨ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhar Dh aaran  daykhai jaan ai aap. ||4|| You are the Support of the earth; You Yourself behold and understand it. ||4||
When You Yourself make me wander, unto whom can I complain?
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa-ay kis kaha-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, I will tell Him of my pain, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: gur maylay birthaa kaha-o maa-ay.

lines.english: Abandoning my worthless demerits, now I practice virtue.
lines.transliteration: avgan chh oda-o gun  kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am absorbed in the True Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee raat aa sach samaa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, the intellect is elevated and exalted.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai mat  ootam ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The mind becomes immaculate, and egotism is washed away.
lines.transliteration: man nirmal ha-umai kadhai Dh o-ay.

lines.english: He is liberated forever, and no one can put him in bondage.
lines.transliteration: sadaa mukat  banDh  na sakai ko-ay.

lines.english: He chants the Naam forever, and nothing else. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sadaa naam vakh aanai a-or na ko-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਬੰਿਧ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The mind comes and goes according to the Will of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man har kai bhaan ai aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The One Lord is contained amongst all; nothing else can be said.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ayko kichh  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Hukam of His Command pervades everywhere, and all merge in His Command.
lines.transliteration: sabh hukmo vart ai hukam samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Pain and pleasure all come by His Will. ||7||
lines.transliteration: dookh  sookh  sabh  tis rajaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: You are infallible; You never make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: too abh ul na bh oolou kad ay naahi.

lines.english: Those who listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad - their intellects become deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad sun aa-ay mat  agaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਭੁਲੁ  ਨ ਭੂਲੌ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: You, O my Great Lord and Master, are contained in the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: too mota-o th aakur sabad  maahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, my mind is pleased, praising the True Lord. ||8||2|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1188-10) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man naanak maani-aa sach salaahi. ||8||2||

lines.english: That person, who thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan,
lines.transliteration: darsan kee pi-aas jis nar ho-ay.
aykat raachai parhar d o-ay. is absorbed in the One Lord, leaving duality behind.

lines.english: His pains are taken away, as he churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: door d arad math amrit  khaa-ay.

lines.english: The Gurmukh understands, and merges in the One Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh boojh ai ayk samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: So many cry out for Your Darshan, Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayray d arsan ka-o kayt ee billaa-ay.

lines.english: How rare are those who realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad and merge with Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: virlaa ko cheenas gur sabad milaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Vedas say that we should chant the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: bayd vakh aan kaheh ik kahee-ai.

lines.english: He is endless; who can find His limits?
lines.transliteration: oh bay-ant ant  kin lahee-ai.

lines.english: There is only One Creator, who created the world.
lines.transliteration: ayko kartaa jin jag kee-aa.

lines.english: Without any pillars, He supports the earth and the sky. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baajh kalaa Dh ar gagan Dh aree-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained in the melody of the Bani, the Word ofthe One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayko gi-aan Dhi-aan Dh un ban ee.

lines.english: The One Lord is Untouched and Unstained; His story is unspoken.
lines.transliteration: ayk niraalam akath kahaanee.

lines.english: The Shabad, the Word, is the Insignia of the One True Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayko sabad sachaa neesaan .

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, the Knowing Lord is known. ||3||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay jaan ai jaan . ||3||

lines.english: There is only one religion of Dharma; let everyone grasp this truth.
lines.transliteration: ayko Dharam d arirhai sach ko-ee.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfect, all the ages through.
lines.transliteration: gurmat pooraa jug jug so-ee.

lines.english: Imbued with the Unmanifest Celestial Lord, and lovingly absorbed in the One,
lines.transliteration: anhad raat aa ayk liv t aar.
oh gurmukh paavai alakh  apaar. ||4|| the Gurmukh attains the invisible and infinite. ||4||

lines.english: There is one celestial throne, and One Supreme King.
lines.transliteration: ayko takh at ayko paat isaahu.

lines.english: The Independent Lord God is pervading all places.
lines.transliteration: sarbee thaa-ee vayparvaahu.

lines.english: The three worlds are the creation of that Sublime Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa kee-aa t aribhavan saar.

lines.english: The One Creator of the Creation is Unfathomable and Incomprehensible. ||5||
lines.transliteration: oh agam agochar aykankaar. ||5||

lines.english: His Form is One, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: aykaa moorat saachaa naa-o.

lines.english: True justice is administered there.
lines.transliteration: tithai nibrh ai saach ni-aa-o.

lines.english: Those who practice Truth are honored and accepted.
lines.transliteration: saachee karnee pat  parvaan .

lines.english: They are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh paavai maan . ||6||

lines.english: Devotional worship of the One Lord is the expression of love for the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykaa bhagat  ayko hai bh aa-o.

lines.english: Without the Fear of God and devotional worship of Him, the mortal comes and goes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: bin bhai bh agtee aava-o jaa-o.

lines.english: One who obtains this understanding from the Guru dwells like an honored guest inthis world. pMnw 1189
lines.transliteration: gur tay samajh  rahai mihmaan .

lines.english: That humble being who is imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord is certified and approved. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har ras raataa jan parvaan . ||7||

lines.english: I see Him here and there; I dwell on Him intuitively.
lines.transliteration: it ut daykh-a-u sehjay raava-o.

lines.english: I do not love any other than You, O Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin th aakur kisai na bh aava-o.

lines.english: O Nanak, my ego has been burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-umai sabad jalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru has shown me the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||8||3|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1189-2) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur saachaa d aras d ikhaa-i-aa. ||8||3||

lines.english: The fickle consciousness cannot find the Lord's limits.
lines.transliteration: chanchal cheet na paavai paaraa.

lines.english: It is caught in non-stop coming and going.
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  na laagai baaraa.

lines.english: I am suffering and dying, O my Creator.
lines.transliteration: dookh  ghano maree-ai kart aaraa.

lines.english: No one cares for me, except my Beloved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin pareetam ko karai na saaraa. ||1||

lines.english: All are high and exalted; how can I call anyone low?
lines.transliteration: sabh oot am kis aakh a-o heenaa.

lines.english: Devotional worship of the Lord and the True Name has satisfied me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bhagt ee sach naam pat eenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have taken all sorts of medicines; I am so tired of them.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  kar thaakee bahut ayray.

lines.english: How can this disease be cured, without my Guru?
lines.transliteration: ki-o dukh  chookai bin gur mayray.

lines.english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, the pain is so great.
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagt ee dookh ghanayray.

lines.english: My Lord and Master is the Giver of pain and pleasure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  daatay thaakur mayray. ||2||

lines.english: The disease is so deadly; how can I find the courage?
lines.transliteration: rog vado ki-o baaNDha-o Dh eeraa.

lines.english: He knows my disease, and only He can take away the pain.
lines.transliteration: rog bujhai so kaatai peeraa.

lines.english: My mind and body are filled with faults and demerits.
lines.transliteration: mai avgan man maahi sareeraa.

lines.english: I searched and searched, and found the Guru, O my brother! ||3||
lines.transliteration: dhoodh at khojat gur maylay beeraa. ||3||

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the Lord's Name are the cures.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad d aaroo har naa-o.

lines.english: As You keep me, so do I remain.
lines.transliteration: ji-o too raakh ahi tivai rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਦਾਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The world is sick; where should I look?
lines.transliteration: jag rogee kah daykh  dikhaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is Pure and Immaculate; Immaculate is His Name. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har nirmaa-il nirmal naa-o. ||4||

lines.english: The Guru sees and reveals the Lord's home, deep within the home of the self;
lines.transliteration: ghar meh gh ar jo d aykh dikhaavai.

lines.english: He ushers the soul-bride into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
lines.transliteration: gur mahlee so mahal bulaavai.

lines.english: When the mind remains in the mind, and the consciousness in the consciousness,
lines.transliteration: man meh manoo-aa chit meh cheet aa.
aisay har kay log ateet aa. ||5|| such people of the Lord remain unattached. ||5||

lines.english: They remain free of any desire for happiness or sorrow;
lines.transliteration: harakh sog t ay raheh niraasaa.
amrit chaakh  har naam nivaasaa. tasting the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, they abide in the Lord's Name.

lines.english: They recognize their own selves, and remain lovingly attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan  rahai liv laagaa.

lines.english: They are victorious on the battlefield of life, following the Guru's Teachings, and theirpains run away. ||6||
lines.transliteration: janam jeet gurmat  dukh bhaagaa. ||6||

lines.english: The Guru has given me the True Ambrosial Nectar; I drink it in.
lines.transliteration: gur dee-aa sach amrit  peeva-o.

lines.english: Of course, I have died, and now I am alive to live.
lines.transliteration: sahj mara-o jeevat hee jeeva-o.

lines.english: Please, protect me as Your Own, if it pleases You.
lines.transliteration: apno kar raakh o gur bh aavai.

lines.english: One who is Yours, merges into You. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tumro ho-ay so t ujheh samaavai. ||7||

lines.english: Painful diseases afflict those who are sexually promiscuous.
lines.transliteration: bhogee ka-o d ukh rog vi-aapai.

lines.english: God appears permeating and pervading in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rav rahi-aa parabh  jaapai.

lines.english: One who remains unattached, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh hee t ay gur sabad  ateetaa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: - O Nanak, his heart and consciousness dwell upon and savor the Lord. ||8||4|| bsMqu mhlw 1 iek qukIAw ] (1189-14) basant mehlaa 1 ik t ukee-aa. Basant, First Mehl, Ik-Tukee:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam ravai hit cheet aa. ||8||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਤੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Do not make such a show of rubbing ashes on your body.
lines.transliteration: mat bh asam anDh oolay garab jaahi.

lines.english: O naked Yogi, this is not the way of Yoga! ||1||
lines.transliteration: in biDh naagay jog naahi. ||1||

lines.english: You fool! How can you have forgotten the Lord's Name?
lines.transliteration: moorhHay kaahay bisaari-o t ai raam naam.

lines.english: At the very last moment, it and it alone shall be of any use to you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ant kaal t ayrai aavai kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Consult the Guru, reflect and think it over.
lines.transliteration: gur poochh t um karahu beechaar.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord of the World. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah saarigpaan . ||2||

lines.english: What can I say? I am nothing.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ha-o aakhaa jaaN kachh oo naahi.

lines.english: All my status and honor are in Your Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaat pat  sabh  tayrai naa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Why do you take such pride in gazing upon your property and wealth?
lines.transliteration: kaahay maal darab d aykh garab jaahi.

lines.english: When you must leave, nothing shall go along with you. ||4||
lines.transliteration: chaltee baar t ayro kachh oo naahi. ||4||

lines.english: So subdue the five thieves, and hold your consciousness in its place.
lines.transliteration: panch maar chit rakh ahu thaa-ay.

lines.english: This is the basis of the way of Yoga. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jog jugat kee ihai paaN-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਾਲੁ ਦਰਬੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਗਰਿਬ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Your mind is tied with the rope of egotism.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai paikharh  tayray manai maahi.

lines.english: You do not even think of the Lord - you fool! He alone shall liberate you. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har na cheeteh moorh ay mukat  jaahi. ||6||

lines.english: If you forget the Lord, you will fall into the clutches of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: mat har visri-ai jam vas paahi.

lines.english: At that very last moment, you fool, you shall be beaten. ||7|| pMnw 1190
lines.transliteration: ant kaal moorh ay chot kh aahi. ||7||

lines.english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and be rid of your ego.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad beechaareh aap jaa-ay.

lines.english: True Yoga shall come to dwell in your mind. ||8||
lines.transliteration: saach jog man vasai aa-ay. ||8||

lines.english: He blessed you with body and soul, but you do not even think of Him.
lines.transliteration: jin jee-o pind dit aa tis cheet eh naahi.

lines.english: You fool! Visiting graves and cremation grounds is not Yoga. ||9||
lines.transliteration: marhee masaan ee moorh ay jog naahi. ||9||

lines.english: Nanak chants the sublime, glorious Bani of the Word.
lines.transliteration: gun naanak bolai bh alee baan .

lines.english: Understand it, and appreciate it. ||10||5|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1190-3) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tum hohu sujaakh ay layho pachh aan. ||10||5||

lines.english: In duality and evil-mindedness, the mortal acts blindly.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa durmat  aDhulee kaar.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wanders, lost in the darkness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh armai majh  gubaar. ||1||

lines.english: The blind man follows blind advice.
lines.transliteration: man anDhulaa anDh ulee mat  laagai.

lines.english: Unless one takes the Guru's Way, his doubt is not dispelled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur karnee bin bh aram na bh aagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The manmukh is blind; he does not like the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: manmukh anDh ulay gurmat  na bh aa-ee.

lines.english: He has become a beast; he cannot get rid of his egotistical pride. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pasoo bha-ay abh imaan na jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: God created 8.4 million species of beings.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jant  upaa-ay.

lines.english: My Lord and Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, creates and destroys them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur bh aanay siraj samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: All are deluded and confused, without the Word of the Shabad and good conduct.
lines.transliteration: saglee bhoolai nahee sabad  achaar.

lines.english: He alone is instructed in this, who is blessed by the Guru, the Creator. ||4||
lines.transliteration: so samjhai jis gur kart aar. ||4||

lines.english: The Guru's servants are pleasing to our Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: gur kay chaakar thaakur bh aanay.

lines.english: The Lord forgives them, and they no longer fear the Messenger of Death. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bakhas lee-ay naahee jam kaan ay. ||5||

lines.english: Those who love the One Lord with all their heart
lines.transliteration: jin kai hirdai ayko bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: - He dispels their doubts and unites them with Himself. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapay maylay bharam chukaa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.english: God is Independent, Endless and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: baymuhtaaj bay-ant  apaaraa.

lines.english: The Creator Lord is pleased with Truth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sach pateejai karnaihaaraa. ||7||

lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru instructs the mistaken soul.
lines.transliteration: naanak bhoolay gur samjh aavai.

lines.english: He implants the Truth within him, and shows him the One Lord. ||8||6|| bsMqu mhlw 1 ] (1190-9) basant mehlaa 1. Basant, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk dikh aavai saach tikaavai. ||8||6||

lines.english: He Himself is the bumble bee, the fruit and the vine.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhavraa fool bayl.

lines.english: He Himself unites us with the Sangat - the Congregation, and the Guru, our Best Friend. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay sangat meet  mayl. ||1||

lines.english: O bumble bee, suck in that fragrance,
lines.transliteration: aisee bhavraa baas lay.
tarvar foolay ban haray. ||1|| rahaa-o. which causes the trees to flower, and the woods to grow lush foliage. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: He Himself is Lakshmi, and He Himself is her husband.
lines.transliteration: aapay kavlaa kant aap.

lines.english: He established the world by Word of His Shabad, and He Himself ravishes it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay raavay sabad thaap. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is the calf, the cow and the milk.
lines.transliteration: aapay bachhroo ga-oo kh eer.

lines.english: He Himself is the Support of the body-mansion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay mandar thamh sareer. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself is the Deed, and He Himself is the Doer.
lines.transliteration: aapay karnee karanhaar.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, He contemplates Himself. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay gurmukh kar beechaar. ||4||

lines.english: You create the creation, and gaze upon it, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: too kar kar d aykheh karanhaar.

lines.english: You give Your Support to the uncounted beings and creatures. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jot jee-a asaNkh day-ay aDh aar. ||5||

lines.english: You are the Profound, Unfathomable Ocean of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: too sar saagar gun  gaheer.

lines.english: You are the Unknowable, the Immaculate, the most Sublime Jewel. ||6||
lines.transliteration: too akul niranjan param heer. ||6||

lines.english: You Yourself are the Creator, with the Potency to create.
lines.transliteration: too aapay kart aa karan  jog.

lines.english: You are the Independent Ruler, whose people are at peace. ||7||
lines.transliteration: nihkayval raajan sukhee log. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁ ਣ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is satisfied with the subtle taste of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: naanak Dharaapay har naam su-aad .

lines.english: Without the Beloved Lord and Master, life is meaningless. ||8||7|| bsMqu ihMfolu mhlw 1 Gru 2  (1190-16) basant hindol mehlaa 1 gh ar 2 Basant Hindol, First Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1190-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bin har gur pareetam janam baad . ||8||7||

lines.english: The nine regions, the seven continents, the fourteen worlds, the three qualities and the four ages - You established them all through the four sources of creation, and Youseated them in Your mansions.
lines.transliteration: na-o sat cha-od ah teen chaar kar mahlat  chaar bahaalee.

lines.english: He placed the four lamps, one by one, into the hands of the four ages. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chaaray deevay chahu hath d ee-ay aykaa aykaa vaaree. ||1||

lines.english: O Merciful Lord, Destroyer of demons, Lord of Lakshmi, such is Your Power - YourShakti. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: miharvaan maDhusood an maaDh ou aisee sakat  tumHaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your army is the fire in the home of each and every heart. And Dharma - righteousliving is the ruling chieftain.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar laskar paavak t ayraa Dh aram karay sikd aaree.

lines.english: Dhart ee dayg milai ik vayraa bh aag tayraa bh andaaree. ||2|| The earth is Your great cooking pot; Your beings receive their portions only once.Destiny is Your gate-keeper. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਸਤ ਚਉਦਹ  ਤੀਿਨ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਮਹਲਿਤ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਬਹਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: But the mortal becomes unsatisfied, and begs for more; his fickle mind brings him disgrace. pMnw 1191
lines.transliteration: naa saaboor hovai fir mangai naarad karay kh u-aaree.

lines.english: Greed is the dark dungeon, and demerits are the shackles on his feet. ||3||
lines.transliteration: lab aDhayraa band eekhaanaa a-ugan  pair luhaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਲਬੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ  ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨਾ  ਅਉਗਣ  ਪੈਿਰ ਲੁਹਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: His wealth constantly batters him, and sin acts as the police officer.
lines.transliteration: poonjee maar pavai nit mud gar paap karay kotvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਵੈ ਿਨਤ ਮੁਦਗਰ  ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਟਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whether the mortal is good or bad, he is as You look upon him, O Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: bhaavai changa bh aavai mand aa jaisee nad ar tumHaaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵੈ ਚੰਗਾ  ਭਾਵੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਿਰ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Primal Lord God is called Allah. The Shaykh's turn has now come.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  ka-o alhu kahee-ai saykh aaN aa-ee vaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਉ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਸੇਖ ਆਈ  ਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The temples of the gods are subject to taxes; this is what it has come to. ||5||
lines.transliteration: dayval d ayviti-aa kar laagaa aisee keerat  chaalee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਲ  ਦੇਵਿਤਆ  ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਐਸੀ  ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਚਾਲੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Muslim devotional pots, calls to prayer, prayers and prayer mats are everywhere;the Lord appears in blue robes.
lines.transliteration: koojaa baaNg nivaaj muslaa neel roop banvaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਜਾ  ਬਗ  ਿਨਵਾਜ ਮੁਸਲਾ  ਨੀਲ  ਰੂਪ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: In each and every home, everyone uses Muslim greetings; your speech has changed,O people. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar mee-aa sabh naaN jee-aaN bolee avar t umaaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਮੀਆ  ਸਭਨ  ਜੀਆਂ  ਬੋਲੀ  ਅਵਰ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: You, O my Lord and Master, are the King of the earth; what power do I have to challenge You?
lines.transliteration: jay too meer maheepat  saahib kud rat ka-un  hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੀਰ ਮਹੀਪਿਤ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਉਣ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the four directions, people bow in humble adoration to You; Your Praises are sungin each and every heart. ||7||
lines.transliteration: chaaray kunt salaam karhigay ghar gh ar sifat  tumHaaree. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਲਾਮੁ  ਕਰਿਹਗੇ  ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Making pilgrimages to sacred shrines, reading the Simritees and giving donations incharity - these do bring any profit.
lines.transliteration: tirath simrit  punn d aan kichh  laahaa milai d ihaarh ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained in an instant, remembering the Naam, theName of the Lord. ||8||1||8|| bsMqu ihMfolu Gru 2 mhlw 4  (1191-8) basant hindol gh ar 2 mehlaa 4 Basant Hindol, Second House, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1191-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee maykaa gharh ee samHaalee. ||8||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਮੇਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਸਮਾਲੀ  ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
lines.english: Within the body-village there lives a child who cannot hold still, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: kaaN-i-aa nagar ik baalak vasi-aa khin pal thir na rahaa-ee.

lines.english: It makes so many efforts, and grows weary, but still, it wanders restlessly again andagain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik upaav jatan kar thaakay baaraN baar bh armaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਇਆ  ਨਗਿਰ  ਇਕੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਿਥਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, Your child has come home, to be one with You.
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur baalak ikat  ghar aan .

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਭਰਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, he finds the Perfect Lord. Meditating and vibrating on the Name of the Lord, he receives the Insignia of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a pooraa paa-ee-ai bh aj raam naam neesaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਇਕਤੁ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: These are dead corpses, these bodies of all the people of the world; the Name of theLord does not dwell in them.
lines.transliteration: ih mirtak marh aa sareer hai sabh  jag jit  raam naam nahee vasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru leads us to taste the water of the Lord's Name, and then we savor andenjoy it, and our bodies are rejuvenated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam gur udak chu-aa-i-aa fir hari-aa ho-aa rasi-aa. ||2||

lines.english: I have examined and studied and searched my entire body, and as Gurmukh, I beholda miraculous wonder.
lines.transliteration: mai nirkhat  nirkh at sareer sabh  khoji-aa ik gurmukh  chalat  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਿਮਰਤਕੁ  ਮੜਾ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: All the faithless cynics searched outside and died, but following the Guru's Teachings,I have found the Lord within the home of my own heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: baahar khoj mu-ay sabh  saakat  har gurmat ee gh ar paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਉਦਕੁ  ਚੁਆਇਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਆ  ਰਿਸਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: God is Merciful to the meekest of the meek; Krishna came to the house of Bidar, adevotee of low social status.
lines.transliteration: deenaa d een d a-i-aal bh a-ay hai ji-o krisan bid ar ghar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਿਨਰਖਤ  ਿਨਰਖਤ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਿਜਆ  ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਲਤੁ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sudama loved God, who came to meet him; God sent everything to his home, andended his poverty. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mili-o sudaamaa bh aavnee Dh aar sabh  kichh  aagai d aalad  bhanj samaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਖੋਿਜ ਮੁਏ ਸਿਭ ਸਾਕਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Great is the glory of the Name of the Lord. My Lord and Master Himself has enshrinedit within me.
lines.transliteration: raam naam kee paij vadayree mayray thaakur aap rakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨਾ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਹੈ ਿਜਉ  ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨੁ ਿਬਦਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Even if all the faithless cynics continue slandering me, it is not diminished by even one iota. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jay sabh saakat  karahi bakh eelee ik rat ee til na gh ataa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਸੁਦਾਮਾ  ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਧਾਿਰ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਗੈ  ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਭੰਿਜ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the praise of His humble servant. It brings him honor in the tendirections.
lines.transliteration: jan kee ustat  hai raam naamaa d ah dis sobh aa paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਡੇਰੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਆਿਪ  ਰਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The slanderers and the faithless cynics cannot endure it at all; they have set fire totheir own houses. ||6||
lines.transliteration: nindak saakat  khav na sakai t il apn ai ghar lookee laa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਿਭ ਸਾਕਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਖੀਲੀ  ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨ ਘਟਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The humble person meeting with another humble person obtains honor. In the gloryof the Lord, their glory shines forth.
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o jan mil sobhaa paavai gun  meh gun  pargaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The servants of my Lord and Master are loved by the Beloved. They are the slaves ofHis slaves. ||7||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur kay jan pareet am pi-aaray jo hoveh d aasan d aasaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਸਾਕਤੁ  ਖਿਵ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਿਤਲੁ  ਅਪਣੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਲੂਕੀ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself is the Water; He Himself unites us in His Union.
lines.transliteration: aapay jal aprampar kartaa aapay mayl milaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in celestial peace and poise, like water blending with water. ||8||1||9|| pMnw 1192 bsMqu mhlw 5 Gru 1 duqukIAw  (1192-2) basant mehlaa 5 gh ar 1 d utukee-aa Basant, Fifth Mehl, First House, Du-Tukee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1192-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sahj milaa-ay ji-o jal jaleh samaavai. ||8||1||9||

lines.english: Listen to the stories of the devotees, O my mind, and meditate with love.
lines.transliteration: sun saakh ee man jap pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੀਆ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Ajaamal uttered the Lord's Name once, and was saved.
lines.transliteration: ajaamal uDhri-aa kahi ayk baar.

lines.english: Baalmeek found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: baalmeekai ho-aa saaDhsang.

lines.english: Dharoo ka-o mili-aa har nisang. ||1|| The Lord definitely met Dhroo. ||1||
I beg for the dust of the feet of Your Saints.
lines.transliteration: tayri-aa sant aa jaacha-o charan rayn.

lines.english: Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, that I may apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lay mastak laava-o kar kirpaa d ayn. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Ganika the prostitute was saved, when her parrot uttered the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ganikaa uDhree har kahai t ot.

lines.english: The elephant meditated on the Lord, and was saved.
lines.transliteration: gaj-indar Dh i-aa-i-o har kee-o mokh .

lines.english: He delivered the poor Brahmin Sudama out of poverty.
lines.transliteration: bipar sudaamay d aalad  bhanj.

lines.english: O my mind, you too must meditate and vibrate on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ray man too bh ee bh aj gobind . ||2||

lines.english: Even the hunter who shot an arrow at Krishna was saved.
lines.transliteration: baDhik uDh aari-o kh am par-haar.

lines.english: Kubija the hunchback was saved, when God placed His Feet on her thumb.
lines.transliteration: kubijaa uDhree angusat Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਭਜੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Bidar was saved by his attitude of humility.
lines.transliteration: bidar uDh aari-o d aasat  bhaa-ay.

lines.english: O my mind, you too must meditate on the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ray man too bh ee har Dh i-aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The Lord Himself saved the honor of Prahlaad.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad rakh ee har paij aap.

lines.english: Even when she was being disrobed in court, Dropatee's honor was preserved.
lines.transliteration: bastar chh eenat  daropat ee rakh ee laaj.

lines.english: Those who have served the Lord, even at the very last instant of their lives, are saved.
lines.transliteration: jin jin sayvi-aa ant baar.

lines.english: O my mind, serve Him, and you shall be carried across to the other side. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ray man sayv too pareh paar. ||4||

lines.english: Dhannai sayvi-aa baal buDh . Dhanna served the Lord, with the innocence of a child.
Meeting with the Guru, Trilochan attained the perfection of the Siddhas.
lines.transliteration: tarilochan gur mil bh a-ee siDh .

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਿਵ ਤੂ ਪਰਿਹ  ਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Guru blessed Baynee with His Divine Illumination.
lines.transliteration: baynee ka-o gur kee-o pargaas.

lines.english: O my mind, you too must be the Lord's slave. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ray man too bh ee hohi d aas. ||5||

lines.english: Jai Dayv gave up his egotism.
lines.transliteration: jaidayv t i-aagi-o ahaNmayv.

lines.english: Sain the barber was saved through his selfless service.
lines.transliteration: naa-ee uDhaari-o sain sayv.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹੋਿਹ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Do not let your mind waver or wander; do not let it go anywhere.
lines.transliteration: man deeg na dolai kahoo-aN jaa-ay.

lines.english: O my mind, you too shall cross over; seek the Sanctuary of God. ||6||
lines.transliteration: man too bh ee tarseh saran  paa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You have shown Your Mercy to them.
lines.transliteration: jih anoograhu thaakur kee-o aap.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਿਗ  ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You saved those devotees.
lines.transliteration: say taiN leenay bh agat raakh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਤਰਸਿਹ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: You do not take their merits and demerits into account.
lines.transliteration: tin kaa gun  avgan  na beechaari-o ko-ay.

lines.english: Seeing these ways of Yours, I have dedicated my mind to Your service. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ih biDh d aykh man lagaa sayv. ||7||

lines.english: Kabeer meditated on the One Lord with love.
lines.transliteration: kabeer Dhi-aa-i-o ayk rang.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ  ਨ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv lived with the Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: naamdayv har jee-o baseh sang.

lines.english: Ravi Daas meditated on God, the Incomparably Beautiful.
lines.transliteration: ravidaas Dh i-aa-ay parabh  anoop.

lines.english: Guru Nanak Dayv is the Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe. ||8||1|| bsMqu mhlw 5 ] (1192-14) basant mehlaa 5. Basant, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak dayv govind  roop. ||8||1||

lines.english: The mortal wanders in reincarnation through countless lifetimes.
lines.transliteration: anik janam bharamay jon maahi.

lines.english: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he falls into hell.
lines.transliteration: har simran bin narak paahi.

lines.english: Without devotional worship, he is cut apart into pieces.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bihoonaa kh and kh and.

lines.english: Without understanding, he is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay jam d ayt dand. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate and vibrate forever on the Lord of the Universe, O my friend.
lines.transliteration: gobind bh ajahu mayray sad aa meet .

lines.english: Love forever the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saach sabad kar sad aa pareet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Contentment does not come by any endeavors.
lines.transliteration: santokh  na aavat  kahoo-aN kaaj.

lines.english: Dhoomm baad ar sabh  maa-i-aa saaj. All the show of Maya is just a cloud of smoke.
The mortal does not hesitate to commit sins.
lines.transliteration: paap karantou nah sangaa-ay.

lines.english: Intoxicated with poison, he comes and goes in reincarnation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa maat aa aavai jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Acting in egotism and self-conceit, his corruption only increases.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ha-o karat baDh ay bikaar.

lines.english: The world is drowning in attachment and greed.
lines.transliteration: moh lobh doobou sansaar.

lines.english: Sexual desire and anger hold the mind in its power.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh man vas kee-aa.

lines.english: Even in his dreams, he does not chant the Lord's Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: supnai naam na har lee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: Sometimes he is a king, and sometimes he is a beggar.
lines.transliteration: kab hee raajaa kab manganhaar.

lines.english: The world is bound by pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: dookh  sookh  baaDh ou sansaar.

lines.english: The mortal makes no arrangements to save himself.
lines.transliteration: man uDhran  kaa saaj naahi.

lines.english: The bondage of sin continues to hold him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: paap banDhan nit  pa-ut  jaahi. ||4||

lines.english: He has no beloved friends or companions.
lines.transliteration: eeth meet  ko-oo sakh aa naahi.

lines.english: He himself eats what he himself plants. pMnw 1193
lines.transliteration: aap beej aapay hee khaaNhi.

lines.english: He gathers up that which brings corruption;
lines.transliteration: jaa kai keenHai hot bikaar.
say chhod chali-aa kh in meh gavaar. ||5|| leaving them, the fool must depart in an instant. ||5||

lines.english: He wanders in attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi baho bharmi-aa.

lines.english: He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions.
lines.transliteration: kirat raykh  kar karmi-aa.

lines.english: Only the Creator Himself remains detached.
lines.transliteration: karnaihaar alipat  aap.

lines.english: God is not affected by virtue or vice. ||6||
lines.transliteration: nahee layp parabh punn paap. ||6||

lines.english: Please save me, O Merciful Lord of the Universe!
lines.transliteration: raakh layho gobind  da-i-aal.

lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Compassionate Lord.
lines.transliteration: tayree saran  pooran kirpaal.

lines.english: Without You, I have no other place of rest.
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa nahee th aa-o.

lines.english: Please take pity on me, God, and bless me with Your Name. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh d ayh naa-o. ||7||

lines.english: You are the Creator, and You are the Doer.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa too karanhaar.

lines.english: You are High and Exalted, and You are totally Infinite.
lines.transliteration: too oochaa t oo baho apaar.

lines.english: Please be merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa larh layho laa-ay.

lines.english: Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||8||2|| bsMq kI vwr mhlu 5  (1193-6) basant kee vaar mahal 5 Basant Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1193-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas parabh  kee sarn aa-ay. ||8||2||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and blossom forth in green abundance.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam Dhi-aa-ay kai hohu hari-aa bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੰਤ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲੁ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: By your high destiny, you have been blessed with this wondrous spring of the soul.
lines.transliteration: karam likhant ai paa-ee-ai ih rut  suhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਕੈ ਹੋਹੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: See all the three worlds in bloom, and obtain the Fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan ma-oli-aa amrit  fal paa-ee.

lines.english: Meeting with the Holy Saints, peace wells up, and all sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo sukh  oopjai lathee sabh  chhaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, remember in meditation the One Name, and you shall never again be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak simrai ayk naam fir bahurh na Dh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਲਥੀ ਸਭ ਛਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The five powerful desires are bound down, when you lean on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: panjay baDhay mahaabalee kar sachaa dh o-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਫਿਰ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਧਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself leads us to dwell at His Feet. He stands right in our midst.
lines.transliteration: aapnay charan  japaa-i-an vich d a-yu kh arho-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਜੇ ਬਧੇ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ  ਕਿਰ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ  ॥
lines.english: All sorrows and sicknesses are eradicated, and you become ever-fresh andrejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: rog sog sabh mit ga-ay nit  navaa niro-aa.

lines.english: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You shall never againdie.
lines.transliteration: din rain  naam Dh i-aa-id aa fir paa-ay na mo-aa.

lines.english: And the One, from whom we came, O Nanak, into Him we merge once again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis tay upji-aa naankaa so-ee fir ho-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Where do we come from? Where do we live? Where do we go in the end?
lines.transliteration: kithhu upjai kah rahai kah maahi samaavai.

lines.english: All creatures belong to God, our Lord and Master. Who can place a value on Him?
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  khasam kay ka-un  keemat  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਥਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ  ਕਹ ਰਹੈ ਕਹ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate, listen and chant, those devotees are blessed and beautified.
lines.transliteration: kahan Dhi-aa-in sun an nit  say bh agat suhaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਖਸਮ  ਕੇ ਕਉਣੁ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; there is no other equal to Him.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar saahibo doosar lavai na laavai.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru has taught this Truth. Nanak proclaims it to the world. ||3||1|| bsMqu bwxI BgqW kI ] (1193-14) basant ban ee bh agtaaN kee. Basant, The Word Of The Devotees, kbIr jI Gru 1  (1193-14) kabeer jee ghar 1 Kabeer Jee, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1193-14) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sach poorai gur updaysi-aa naanak sun aavai. ||3||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਿਹਬੋ  ਦੂਸਰੁ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The earth is in bloom, and the sky is in bloom.
lines.transliteration: ma-ulee Dhart ee ma-oli-aa akaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸਆ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.english: Each and every heart has blossomed forth, and the soul is illumined. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ma-oli-aa aat am pargaas. ||1||

lines.english: My Sovereign Lord King blossoms forth in countless ways.
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam ma-oli-aa anat bh aa-ay.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see Him there pervading. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The four Vedas blossom forth in duality.
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa ma-ulay chaar bayd .

lines.english: The Simritees blossom forth, along with the Koran and the Bible. ||2||
lines.transliteration: simrit ma-ulee si-o kat ayb. ||2||

lines.english: Shiva blossoms forth in Yoga and meditation.
lines.transliteration: sankar ma-uli-o jog Dhi-aan.

lines.english: Kabeer's Lord and Master pervades in all alike. ||3||1||
lines.transliteration: kabeer ko su-aamee sabh samaan. ||3||1||

lines.english: The Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, are intoxicated, reading the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: pandit jan maat ay parhH puraan.

lines.english: The Yogis are intoxicated in Yoga and meditation.
lines.transliteration: jogee maatay jog Dh i-aan.

lines.english: The Sannyaasees are intoxicated in egotism.
lines.transliteration: sani-aasee maatay ahaNmayv.

lines.english: The penitents are intoxicated with the mystery of penance. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tapsee maat ay tap kai bh ayv. ||1||

lines.english: All are intoxicated with the wine of Maya; no one is awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: sabh mad  maat ay ko-oo na jaag.

lines.english: The thieves are with them, plundering their homes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sang hee chor ghar musan laag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Suk Dayv and Akrur are awake and aware. pMnw 1194
lines.transliteration: jaagai sukday-o ar akoor.

lines.english: Hanuman with his tail is awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: hanvant  jaagai Dh ar lankoor.

lines.english: Shiva is awake, serving at the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: sankar jaagai charan sayv.

lines.english: Naam Dayv and Jai Dayv are awake in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kal jaagay naamaa jaidayv. ||2||

lines.english: There are many ways of being awake, and sleeping.
lines.transliteration: jaagat sovat  baho parkaar.

lines.english: To be awake as Gurmukh is the most excellent way.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaagai so-ee saar.

lines.english: The most sublime of all the actions of this body,
lines.transliteration: is dayhee kay aDh ik kaam.
kahi kabeer bhaj raam naam. ||3||2|| says Kabeer, is to meditate and vibrate on the Lord's Name. ||3||2||

lines.english: The wife gives birth to her husband.
lines.transliteration: jo-ay khasam hai jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The son leads his father in play.
lines.transliteration: poot baap kh aylaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without breasts, the mother nurses her baby. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin sarvanaa kh eer pilaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Behold, people! This is how it is in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: daykh hu logaa kal ko bh aa-o.

lines.english: The son marries his mother. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sut muklaa-ee apnee maa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without feet, the mortal jumps.
lines.transliteration: pagaa bin huree-aa maartaa.

lines.english: Without a mouth, he bursts into laughter.
lines.transliteration: badnai bin kh ir khir haast aa.

lines.english: Without feeling sleepy, he lays down and sleeps.
lines.transliteration: nidraa bin nar pai sovai.

lines.english: Without a churn, the milk is churned. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin baasan kheer bilovai. ||2||

lines.english: Without udders, the cow gives milk.
lines.transliteration: bin asthan ga-oo lavayree.

lines.english: Without travelling, a long journey is made.
lines.transliteration: paiday bin baat ghanayree.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, the path is not found.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur baat na paa-ee.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, see this, and understand. ||3||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer samjhaa-ee. ||3||3||

lines.english: Prahlaad was sent to school.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad path aa-ay parh an saal.

lines.english: He took many of his friends along with him.
lines.transliteration: sang sakhaa baho lee-ay baal.

lines.english: He asked his teacher, "Why do you teach me about worldly affairs?
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o kahaa parhHaavas aal jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਪੜਾਵਿਸ  ਆਲ  ਜਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Write the Name of the Dear Lord on my tablet."||1||
lines.transliteration: mayree patee-aa likh d ayh saree gopaal. ||1||

lines.english: O Baba, I will not forsake the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nahee chhoda-o ray baabaa raam naam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡਉ  ਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: I will not bother with any other lessons. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayro a-or parhHan si-o nahee kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sanda and Marka went to the king to complain.
lines.transliteration: sandai markai kahi-o jaa-ay.

lines.english: He sent for Prahlaad to come at once.
lines.transliteration: parahlaad bulaa-ay bayg Dh aa-ay.

lines.english: He said to him, "Stop uttering the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: too raam kahan kee chh od baan.

lines.english: I shall release you at once, if you obey my words."||2||
lines.transliteration: tujh turat chhadaa-oo mayro kahi-o maan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ  ਕੀ ਛੋਡੁ ਬਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Prahlaad answered, "Why do you annoy me, over and over again?
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o kahaa sataavahu baar baar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਝੁ ਤੁਰਤੁ  ਛਡਾਊ  ਮੇਰੋ ਕਿਹਓ ਮਾਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: God created the water, land, hills and mountains.
lines.transliteration: parabh jal thal gir kee-ay pahaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਸਤਾਵਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.english: I shall not forsake the One Lord; if I did, I would be going against my Guru.
lines.transliteration: ik raam na chhoda-o gureh gaar.

lines.english: You might as well throw me into the fire and kill me."||3||
lines.transliteration: mo ka-o ghaal jaar bh aavai maar daar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਗੁਰਿਹ  ਗਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The king became angry and drew his sword.
lines.transliteration: kaadh kh arhag kopi-o risaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਘਾਿਲ  ਜਾਿਰ  ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਿਰ  ਡਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: "Show me your protector now!"
lines.transliteration: tujh raakh anhaaro mohi bat aa-ay.

lines.english: So God emerged out of the pillar, and assumed a mighty form.
lines.transliteration: parabh thambh  tay niksay kai bisthaar.

lines.english: He killed Harnaakhash, tearing him apart with his nails. ||4||
lines.transliteration: harnaakhas chh aydi-o nakh  bidaar. ||4||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Divinity of the divine,
lines.transliteration: o-ay param purakh d ayvaaDh  dayv.
bhagat  hayt narsingh  bhayv. for the sake of His devotee, assumed the form of the man-lion.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, no one can know the Lord's limits.
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ko lakhai na paar.

lines.english: He saves His devotees like Prahlaad over and over again. ||5||4||
lines.transliteration: parahlaad uDh aaray anik baar. ||5||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੋ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Within the body and mind are thieves like sexual desire,
lines.transliteration: is tan man maDh ay mad an chor.
jin gi-aan ratan hir leen mor. which has stolen my jewel of spiritual wisdom.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਦਨ  ਚੋਰ ॥
lines.english: I am a poor orphan, O God; unto whom should I complain?
lines.transliteration: mai anaath parabh kaha-o kaahi.

lines.english: Who has not been ruined by sexual desire? What am I? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ko ko na bigooto mai ko aahi. ||1||

lines.english: O Lord, I cannot endure this agonizing pain.
lines.transliteration: maaDha-o d aarun d ukh sahi-o na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਿਬਗੂਤੋ  ਮੈ ਕੋ ਆਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What power does my fickle mind have against it? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayro chapal buDh si-o kahaa basaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਧਉ  ਦਾਰੁਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਿਹਓ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Sanak, Sanandan, Shiva and Suk Dayv
lines.transliteration: sanak sanandan siv sukaad .
naabh kamal jaanay barahmaad . were born out of Brahma's naval chakra.

lines.english: The poets and the Yogis with their matted hair
lines.transliteration: kab jan jogee jataaDhaar.
sabh aapan a-osar chalay saar. ||2|| all lived their lives with good behavior. ||2||

lines.english: You are Unfathomable; I cannot know Your depth.
lines.transliteration: too athaahu mohi thaah naahi.

lines.english: O God, Master of the meek, unto whom should I tell my pains?
lines.transliteration: parabh d eenaa naath d ukh kaha-o kaahi.

lines.english: Please rid me of the pains of birth and death, and bless me with peace.
lines.transliteration: moro janam maran dukh  aath Dh eer.

lines.english: Kabeer utters the Glorious Praises of God, the Ocean of peace. ||3||5||
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar gun ra-o kabeer. ||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਉ ਕਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: There is one merchant and five traders.
lines.transliteration: naa-ik ayk banjaaray paach.

lines.english: The twenty-five oxen carry false merchandise.
lines.transliteration: baraDh pacheesak sang kaach.

lines.english: There are nine poles which hold the ten bags.
lines.transliteration: na-o bahee-aaN das gon aahi.

lines.english: The body is tied by the seventy-two ropes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kasan bahtar laagee t aahi. ||1||

lines.english: I don't care at all about such commerce. pMnw 1195
lines.transliteration: mohi aisay banaj si-o naheen kaaj.

lines.english: It depletes my capital, and the interest charges only increase. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jih ghatai mool nit  badh ai bi-aaj. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Weaving the seven threads together, they carry on their trade.
lines.transliteration: saat soot  mil banaj keen.

lines.english: They are led on by the karma of their past actions.
lines.transliteration: karam bhaavnee sang leen.

lines.english: The three tax-collectors argue with them.
lines.transliteration: teen jagaat ee karat  raar.

lines.english: The traders depart empty-handed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chalo banjaaraa haath jhaar. ||2||

lines.english: Their capital is exhausted, and their trade is ruined.
lines.transliteration: poonjee hiraanee banaj toot.

lines.english: The caravan is scattered in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: dah d is taaNdo ga-i-o foot.

lines.english: Says Kabeer, O mortal, your tasks will be accomplished,
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer man sarsee kaaj.

lines.english: The mother is impure, and the father is impure. The fruit they produce is impure.
lines.transliteration: maataa jooth ee pit aa bh ee jooth aa jooth ay hee fal laagay.

lines.english: Impure they come, and impure they go. The unfortunate ones die in impurity. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aavahi joothay jaahi bh ee jooth ay jooth ay mareh abh aagay. ||1||

lines.english: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar, which place is uncontaminated?
lines.transliteration: kaho pandit soochaa kavan th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤਾ  ਜੂਠੀ ਿਪਤਾ  ਭੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Where should I sit to eat my meal? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jahaaN bais ha-o bhojan kh aa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਿਹ  ਜੂਠੇ ਜਾਿਹ  ਭੀ ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠੇ ਮਰਿਹ  ਅਭਾਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The tongue is impure, and its speech is impure. The eyes and ears are totally impure.
lines.transliteration: jihbaa joothee bolat  jooth aa karan nayt ar sabh  jooth ay.

lines.english: The impurity of the sexual organs does not depart; the Brahmin is burnt by the fire. ||2||
lines.transliteration: indree kee jooth  utras naahee barahm agan kay looth ay. ||2||

lines.english: The fire is impure, and the water is impure. The place where you sit and cook isimpure.
lines.transliteration: agan bhee jooth ee paanee jooth aa jooth ee bais pakaa-i-aa.

lines.transliteration: apunay thaakur kee ha-o chayree.
