lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaavai naa dukh  paavai naa d ukh darad sareeray.

lines.english: O Nanak, she is intuitively embellished by God; seeing God, her mind is encouraged.||4||2|| swrg mhlw 1 ] (1197-15) saarag mehlaa 1. Saarang, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh t ay sahj suhaylee parabh  daykhat hee man Dh eeray. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਿਚਲ  ਕੁਰੂਿਪ  ਕੁਨਾਿਰ  ਕੁਲਖਨੀ  ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: My Beloved Lord God is not far away.
lines.transliteration: door naahee mayro parabh  pi-aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਸਨ  ਨਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੀ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ ਦੂਖ ਸਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind is pleased and appeased by the Word of the True Guru's Teachings. I have found the Lord, the Support of my breath of life. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1198
lines.transliteration: satgur bachan mayro man maani-aa har paa-ay paraan aDh aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਏ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is the way to meet your Husband Lord. Blessed is the soul-bride who is loved by her Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: in biDh har milee-ai var kaaman Dh an sohaag pi-aaree.

lines.english: Social class and status, race, ancestry and skepticism are eliminated, following theGuru's Teachings and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaat baran kul sahsaa chookaa gurmat  sabad  beechaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਿਬਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਵਰ ਕਾਮਿਨ  ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: One whose mind is pleased and appeased, has no egotistical pride. Violence and greed are forgotten.
lines.transliteration: jis man maanai abhimaan na t aa ka-o hinsaa lobh  visaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਤ  ਬਰਨ  ਕੁਲ ਸਹਸਾ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The soul-bride intuitively ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; as Gurmukh, she isembellished by His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sahj ravai var kaaman pir kee gurmukh  rang savaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਹੰਸਾ  ਲੋਭੁ ਿਵਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Burn away any love of family and relatives, which increases your attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: jaara-o aisee pareet kutamb sanbanDh ee maa-i-aa moh pasaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਰਵੈ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਪਰ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰੰਿਗ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who does not savor the Lord's Love deep within, lives in duality and corruption.||3||
lines.transliteration: jis antar pareet  raam ras naahee d ubiDh aa karam bikaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਰਉ  ਐਸੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਸਨਬੰਧੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: His Love is a priceless jewel deep within my being; the Lover of my Beloved is nothidden.
lines.transliteration: antar rat an pad aarath hit  kou d urai na laal pi-aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਕਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, enshrine the Priceless Naam deep within your being, all theages through. ||4||3|| swrMg mhlw 4 Gru 1  (1198-7) saarang mehlaa 4 ghar 1 Saarang, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1198-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam amolak jug jug ant ar Dh aaree. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਿਹਤ ਕੌ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਲਾਲ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am the dust of the feet of the humble Saints of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant janaa kee ham Dh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਧਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the supreme status. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mil satsangat  param pad  paa-i-aa aat am raam rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meeting the Saintly True Guru, I have found peace and tranquility. Sins and painfulmistakes are totally erased and taken away.
lines.transliteration: satgur sant  milai saaNt paa-ee-ai kilvikh  dukh kaatay sabh  door.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The Divine Light of the soul radiates forth, gazing upon the Presence of theImmaculate Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aatam jot  bha-ee parfoolit  purakh  niranjan d aykhi-aa hajoor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the Sat Sangat; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,is all-prevading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag sat sangat  paa-ee har har naam rahi-aa bh arpoor.

lines.english: I have taken my cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, bathingin the dust of the feet of the True Congregation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: athsath  tirath majan kee-aa sat sangat  pag naa-ay Dh oor. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਿਭ ਦੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Evil-minded and corrupt, filthy-minded and shallow, with impure heart, attached toenticement and falsehood.
lines.transliteration: durmat  bikaar maleen mat  hochh ee hird aa kusuDh  laagaa moh koor.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਭਈ ਪਰਫੂਿਲਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without good karma, how can I find the Sangat? Engrossed in egotism, the mortalremains stuck in regret. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin karmaa ki-o sangat paa-ee-ai ha-umai bi-aap rahi-aa man jh oor. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Be kind and show Your Mercy, O Dear Lord; I beg for the dust of the feet of the SatSangat.
lines.transliteration: hohu da-i-aal kirpaa kar har jee maaga-o sat sangat  pag Dh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਗ ਨਾਏ ਧੂਿਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with the Saints, the Lord is attained. The Lord's humble servant obtains the Presence of the Lord. ||4||1|| swrMg mhlw 4 ] (1198-14) saarang mehlaa 4. Saarang, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sant milai har paa-ee-ai jan har bh ayti-aa raam hajoor. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਲੀਨ  ਮਿਤ ਹੋਛੀ ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਕੁਸੁਧੁ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਮੋਹ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gobind charnan ka-o balihaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਿਕਉ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਆਿਪ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਮਨੁ ਝੂਿਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I cannot swim across the terrifying world ocean. But chanting the Name of the Lord,Har, Har, I am carried across across. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhavjal jagat  na jaa-ee t arnaa jap har har paar ut aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜੀ ਮਾਗਉ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਗ ਧੂਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Faith in God came to fill my heart; I serve Him intuitively, and contemplate Him.
lines.transliteration: hirdai part eet banee parabh  kayree sayvaa surat  beechaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਰਾਮੁ ਹਜੂਿਰ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, I chant the Lord's Name within my heart; it is all-powerful andvirtuous. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din raam naam jap hird ai sarab kalaa gun kaaree. ||1||

lines.english: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, All-pervading everywhere, in all minds andbodies; He is Infinite and Invisible.
lines.transliteration: parabh agam agochar ravi-aa sarab th aa-ee man t an alakh  apaaree.

lines.english: When the Guru bebomes merciful, then the Unseen Lord is seen within the heart.||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal bha-ay t ab paa-i-aa hird ai alakh  lakhaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਤਰਣਾ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Deep within the inner being is the Name of the Lord, the Support of the entire earth, but to the egotistical shaakta, the faithless cynic, He seems far away.
lines.transliteration: antar har naam sarab Dh arneeDhar saakat  ka-o d oor bh a-i-aa ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: His burning desire is never quenched, and he loses the game of life in the gamble.||3||
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa jalat  na kabhoo boojh eh joo-ai baajee haaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਰ੍ਤੀਿਤ  ਬਨੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Standing up and sitting down, the mortal sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, whenthe Guru bestows even a tiny bit of His Grace.
lines.transliteration: oothat  baith at har gun gaavahi gur kichant  kirpaa Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are blessed by His Glance of Grace - He saves and protects their honor. ||4||2|| pMnw 1199 swrg mhlw 4 ] (1199-1) saarag mehlaa 4. Saarang, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin ka-o nadar bh a-ee hai t in kee paij savaaree. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਭਈ ਹੈ ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: O my Beloved Lord, Har, Har, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Name.
lines.transliteration: har har amrit naam d ayh pi-aaray.

lines.english: Those whose minds are pleased to be Gurmukh - the Lord completes their projects.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin oopar gurmukh man maani-aa t in kay kaaj savaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those humble beings who become meek before the Guru-their pains are taken away.
lines.transliteration: jo jan deen bh a-ay gur aagai t in kay d ookh nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, they perform devotional worship services to the Guru; they are embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahi gur aagai gur kai sabad  savaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Within their hearts is the ambrosial essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; theysavor this essence, sing the praises of this essence, and contemplate this essence.
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam amrit  ras rasnaa ras gaavahi ras beechaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ  ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are aware of this ambrosial essence; they find the Gate ofSalvation. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad amrit  ras cheenHi-aa o-ay paavahi mokh  du-aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True is the Primal Being, Unmoving and Unchanging. One who takes the Supportof the Naam, the Name of the Lord - his intellect becomes focused and steady.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  achal achlaa mat  jis darirh-taa naam aDh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਰਸੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: I offer my soul to Him; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis aagai jee-o d ayva-o apunaa ha-o sat gur kai balihaaray. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਚੀਿਨਆ  ਓਇ ਪਾਵਿਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are stuck in doubt and attached to duality; the darkness ofspiritual ignorance is within them.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aram d oojai bh aa-ay laagay ant ar agi-aan gubaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਚਲੁ  ਅਚਲਾ ਮਿਤ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਤਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: They do not see the True Guru, the Giver; they are not on this shore, or the other.||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa nad ar na aavai naa urvaar na paaray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜੀਉ  ਦੇਵਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਹਉ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master is permeating and pervading each and every heart; He issupremely Potent to exercise His Might.
lines.transliteration: sarbay ghat gh at ravi-aa su-aamee sarab kalaa kal Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਗੁਬਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak, the slave of His slaves, says, please, be merciful and save me! ||5||3|| swrg mhlw 4 ] (1199-8) saarag mehlaa 4. Saarang, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daasan d aas kahat  hai kar kirpaa layho ubaaray. ||5||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਿਰ  ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: This is the way to work for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gobid kee aisee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Whatever He does, accept that as true. As Gurmukh, remain lovingly absorbed in HisName. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karay so sat  kar maanhu gurmukh  naam rahhu liv laa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤ  ਹੈ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ  ॥੫॥੩॥
lines.english: The Love of the Lord of the Universe seems supremely sweet. Everything else isforgotten.
lines.transliteration: gobid pareet  lagee at  meeth ee avar visar sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, he is in ecstasy; his mind is pleased and appeased, and his lightmerges into the Light. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din rahas bh a-i-aa man maani-aa jot ee jot  milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, his mind is satisfied. Peace and tranquilitycome to abide within his mind.
lines.transliteration: jab gun gaa-ay t ab hee man t ariptai saaNt vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹਹੁ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Guru becomes merciful, the mortal finds the Lord; he focuses hisconsciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal bha-ay t ab paa-i-aa har charn ee chit  laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The intellect is enlightened, meditating on the Lord. He remains lovingly attuned to the essence of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: mat pargaas bh a-ee har Dh i-aa-i-aa gi-aan t at liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਅਿਤ  ਮੀਠੀ  ਅਵਰ  ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Divine Light radiates forth deep within his being; his mind is pleased andappeased. He merges intuitively into Celestial Samaadhi. ||3||
lines.transliteration: antar jot  pargatee man maani-aa har sahj samaaDh  lagaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹਸੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One whose heart is filled with falsehood, continues to practice falsehood, even whilehe teaches and preaches about the Lord.
lines.transliteration: hirdai kapat nit  kapat kamaaveh mukh ahu har har sun aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਸਿਤ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Within him is the utter darkness of greed. He is thrashed like wheat, and suffers inpain. ||4||
lines.transliteration: antar lobh  mahaa gubaaraa t uh kootai d ukh khaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When my God is totally pleased, the mortal tunes in and becomes Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: jab suparsan bha-ay parabh  mayray gurmukh  parchaa laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ਭਈ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਤਿਤ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has obtained the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting theNaam, he has found peace. ||5||4|| swrg mhlw 4 ] (1199-15) saarag mehlaa 4. Saarang, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niranjan paa-i-aa naam japat sukh  paa-ay. ||5||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਇ  ॥੩॥

lines.transliteration: mai andino sad  sad sadaa har japi-aa har naa-o. ||2||3||10||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Fearless Lord,
lines.transliteration: jap man nirbha-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਘਿਟ  ਘਟੇ ਘਿਟ  ਬਸਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਲ  ਥਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਬਸਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਥਾਨ ਥਾਨੰਤਿਰ  ਬਸਤਾ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਖਨ  ਕੋ ਚਾਓ  ੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sat  sadaa sat . who is True, True, Forever True.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਆਵੈ  ਸੰਤੋ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੰਤੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਜਨੁ ਸੰਤੋ ਮੋਿਹ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਿਦਖਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: He is free of vengeance, the Image of the Undying,
lines.transliteration: nirvair akaal moorat.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਾਓ ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aajoonee sambha-o. beyond birth, Self-existent.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਧਾ  ਤੇ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate night and day on the Formless, Self-sustaining Lord. ||1||Pause|| hir drsn kau hir drsn kau koit koit qyqIs isD jqI jogI qt qIrQ prBvn krq rhq
lines.transliteration: mayray man andino Dh i-aa-ay nirankaar niraahaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਭਏ ਮੈ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਓ ੁ ॥
lines.english: For the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, the three hundred thirty million gods, and millions of Siddhas, celibates andYogis make their pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, and go on fasts.
lines.transliteration: har darsan ka-o har d arsan ka-o kot kot t aytees siDh  jatee jogee t at tirath parbh avan karat rahat  niraahaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਈ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਈ ॥
lines.english: The service of the humble person is approved, unto whom the Lord of the Worldshows His Mercy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin jan kee sayvaa thaa-ay pa-ee jinH ka-o kirpaal hovat  banvaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੋ  ਸਦ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਓ  ੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੦॥
lines.english: They alone are the good Saints of the Lord, the best and most exalted devotees, whoare pleasing to their Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay ho sant bh alay t ay oot am bh agat bhalay jo bh aavat  har raam muraaree.

lines.english: Those who have my Lord and Master on their side - O Nanak, the Lord saves their honor. ||2||4||11|| pMnw 1202 swrg mhlw 4 pVqwl ] (1202-1) saarag mehlaa 4 parh-t aal. Saarang, Fourth Mehl, Partaal: jip mn goivMdu hir goivMdu guxI inDwnu sB isRs it kw pRBo myry mn hir boil hir purKu AibnwsI
lines.transliteration: jinH kaa ang karai mayraa su-aamee tinH kee naanak har paij savaaree. ||2||4||11||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Virtue, the God of all creation. O my mind, chant the Name of theLord, the Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable, Primal Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jap man govind har govind  gunee niDh aan sabh  sarisat kaa parabh o mayray man har bol har purakh abh inaasee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar, Har, Har, Har. He alone drinks it in,whom the Lord inspires to drink it.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam amrit har har haray so pee-ai jis raam pi-aasee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਹਿਰ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||1|| The Merciful Lord Himself bestows His Mercy, and He leads the mortal to meet withthe True Guru. That humble being tastes the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har.||1||
lines.transliteration: swrMg, mÚ 4) har aap da-i-aal d a-i-aa kar maylai jis sat guroo so jan har har amrit  naam chakh aasee.

lines.english: Those who serve my Lord, forever and ever - all their pain, doubt and fear are takenaway.
lines.transliteration: jo jan sayveh sad sad aa mayraa har haray t in kaa sabh  dookh bharam bh a-o jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਸੋ ਪੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਿਪਆਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and so he lives, like the song-bird, which is satisfied only by drinking in the water. ||2||5||12|| swrg mhlw 4 ] (1202-6) saarag mehlaa 4. Saarang, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam la-ay taaN jeevai ji-o chaat rik jal pee-ai t ariptaasee. ||2||5||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰ ਮੇਲੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਚਖਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Supreme Lord.
lines.transliteration: jap man siree raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਭਉ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Lord is All-pervading.
lines.transliteration: raam ramat raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤ ਜੀਵੈ ਿਜਉ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕੁ  ਜਿਲ  ਪੀਐ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨॥
lines.english: True, True is the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sat sat  raam.

lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, forever. He is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bolhu bha-ee-aa sad  raam raam raam rav rahi-aa sarabgay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord Himself is Himself the Creator of all. The Lord Himself is Himself pervadingthe whole world.
lines.transliteration: raam aapay aap aapay sabh kart aa raam aapay aap aap sabh at jagay.

lines.english: That person, upon whom my Sovereign Lord King, Raam, Raam, Raam, bestows HisMercy - that person is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis aap kirpaa karay mayraa raam raam raam raa-ay so jan raam naam liv laagay.||1||

lines.english: O Saints of the Lord, behold the Glory of the Name of the Lord; His Name saves thehonor of His humble devotees in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) raam naam kee upmaa daykh hu har sant ahu jo bh agat janaaN kee pat  raakh ai vich kalijug agay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਸਦ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਰਬਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||2||6||13|| My Sovereign Lord King has taken servant Nanak's side; his enemies and attackershave all run away. ||2||6||13|| swrMg mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 1  (1202-11) saarang mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 1 Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1202-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: siqgur mUriq kau bil jwau ] (1202-12) satgur moorat  ka-o bal jaa-o. I am a sacrifice to the Image of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kaa ang kee-aa mayrai raam raa-ay dusman d ookh ga-ay sabh  bhagay.

lines.english: My inner being is filled with a great thirst, like that of the song-bird for water. When shall I find the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: antar pi-aas chaat rik ji-o jal kee safal d arsan kad  paaN-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ ਆਿਪ  ਸਭਤੁ  ਜਗੇ ॥
lines.english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Cherisher of all. He is the Lover of thedevotees of His Name.
lines.transliteration: anaathaa ko naath sarab partipaalak bh agat vachh al har naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That mortal, whom no one can protect - You bless him with Your Support, O Lord.||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o ko-ay na raakhai paraan ee tis too deh asraa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਦੇਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੋ ਭਗਤ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਅਗੇ ॥
lines.english: Support of the unsupported, Saving Grace of the unsaved, Home of the homeless.
lines.transliteration: niDhri-aa Dh ar nigt i-aa gat  nithaavi-aa t oo thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਦੁਸਮਨ  ਦੂਖ ਗਏ ਸਿਭ ਭਗੇ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Wherever I go in the ten directions, You are there with me. The only thing I do is singthe Kirtan of Your Praises. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dah d is jaaN-o tahaaN too sangay t ayree keerat  karam kamaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰੰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: From Your Oneness, You become tens of thousands, and from tens of thousands, Youbecome One. I cannot describe Your state and extent.
lines.transliteration: aykas tay laakh  laakh  tay aykaa t ayree gat  mit kahi na sakaa-o.

lines.english: You are Infinite - Your value cannot be appraised. Everything I see is Your play. ||3||
lines.transliteration: too bay-ant  tayree mit  nahee paa-ee-ai sabh  tayro kh ayl dikhaa-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਜਉ  ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਫਲ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਿਦ  ਪਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I speak with the Company of the Holy; I am in love with the Holy people of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhan kaa sang saaDh  si-o gosat har saaDh an si-o liv laa-o.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has found the Lord through the Guru's Teachings; please bless me with Your Blessed Vision; O Lord, my mind yearns for it. ||4||1|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1202-18) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak paa-i-aa hai gurmat har d ayh d aras man chaa-o. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥਾ  ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਬ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕੁ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o antarjaamee jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਿਹ ਅਸਰਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal does evil deeds, and hides from others, but like the air, the Lord is presenteverywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karat buraa-ee maanukh  tay chh apaa-ee saakh ee bh oot pavaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You call yourself a devotee of Vishnu and you practice the six rituals, but your innerbeing is polluted with greed.
lines.transliteration: baisnou naam karat kh at karmaa ant ar lobh  jooth aan.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਜਉ  ਤਹ ਤੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who slander the Society of the Saints, shall all be drowned in their ignorance. ||1|| pMnw 1203
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa kee nind aa kart ay doobay sabh  agi-aan. ||1||

lines.english: The mortal eats the food which he has carefully prepared, and then steals the wealth of others. His inner being is filled with falsehood and pride.
lines.transliteration: karahi som paak hireh par darbaa ant ar jhooth gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋਮ ਪਾਕੁ ਿਹਰਿਹ  ਪਰ ਦਰਬਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਝੂਠ ਗੁਮਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: He knows nothing of the Vedas or the Shaastras; his mind is gripped by pride. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saastar bayd  kee biDh  nahee jaan eh bi-aapay man kai maan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਿਬਿਧ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਿਬਆਪੇ  ਮਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He says his evening prayers, and observes all the fasts, but this is all just a show.
lines.transliteration: sanDhi-aa kaal karahi sabh  vartaa ji-o safree d amfaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਧਆ  ਕਾਲ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਵਰਤਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਸਫਰੀ  ਦੰਫਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: God made him stray from the path, and sent him into the wilderness. All his actions are useless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabhoo bh ulaa-ay oojh arh paa-ay nihfal sabh  karmaan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਊਝਿੜ  ਪਾਏ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਮਾਨ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is a devotee of Vishnu and a scholar,whom the Lord God blesses with His Grace.
lines.transliteration: so gi-aanee so baisnou parhH-aa jis karee kirpaa bh agvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੌ  ਪਿੜਆ  ਿਜਸੁ ਕਰੀ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਭਗਵਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, he obtains the supreme status and saves the whole world.||4||
lines.transliteration: on satgur sayv param pad  paa-i-aa uDh ri-aa sagal bisvaan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਓ ੁਿਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਉਧਿਰਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਸਾਨ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: What can I say? I don't know what to say. As God wills, so do I speak.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ham kathah kichh kath nahee jaan ah parabh  bhaavai t ivai bolaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹਮ ਕਥਹ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਿਥ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਬਲਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: I ask only for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.Servant Nanak seeks their Sanctuary. ||5||2|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1203-6) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kee Dh oor ik maaNga-o jan naanak pa-i-o saraan. ||5||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਇਕ ਮਗਉ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਇਓ  ਸਰਾਨ  ॥੫॥੨॥
lines.english: Now, my dancing is over.
lines.transliteration: ab moro naachno raho.

lines.english: I have intuitively obtained my Darling Beloved. Through the Word of the True Guru's Teachings, I found Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laal rageelaa sehjay paa-i-o satgur bachan laho. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The virgin speaks with her friends about her husband and they laugh together;
lines.transliteration: ku-aar kanniaa jaisay sang sahayree pari-a bachan uphaas kaho.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲੁ  ਰਗੀਲਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਿਨ  ਲਹੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ja-o surijan garih bheet ar aa-i-o t ab mukh  kaaj lajo. ||1|| but when he comes home, she becomes shy, and modestly covers her face. ||1||

lines.english: When gold is melted in the crucible, it flows freely everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ji-o kaniko kothaaree charh i-o kabro hot  firo.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਆਰ  ਕੰਿਨਆ  ਜੈਸੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਹੇਰੀ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਬਚਨ  ਉਪਹਾਸ  ਕਹੋ ॥
lines.english: But when it is made into pure solid bars of gold, then it remains stationary. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jab tay suDh  bha-ay hai baareh t ab tay thaan thiro. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਸੁਿਰਜਨੁ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਆਇਓ ਤਬ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਿਜ  ਲਜੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: As long as the days and the nights of one's life last, the clock strikes the hours,minutes and seconds.
lines.transliteration: ja-o din rain t a-oo la-o baji-o moorat  gharee palo.

lines.english: But when the gong player gets up and leaves, the gong is not sounded again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bajaavanhaaro ooth siDh aari-o t ab fir baaj na bh a-i-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਧ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਬਾਰਿਹ  ਤਬ ਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਿਥਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.english: When the pitcher is filled with water, the water contained within it seems distinct.
lines.transliteration: jaisay kumbh ud ak poor aani-o t ab ohu bh inn daristo.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਤਊ ਲਉ ਬਿਜਓ  ਮੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ  ਪਲੋ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, when the pitcher is emptied out, the water mingles again with water.||4||3|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1203-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kumbh jalai meh d aari-o ambh ai ambh  milo. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ  ਊਿਠ ਿਸਧਾਿਰਓ  ਤਬ ਿਫਿਰ ਬਾਜੁ ਨ ਭਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Now if he is asked, what can he say?
lines.transliteration: ab poochhay ki-aa kahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁੰਭ ਉਦਕ  ਪੂਿਰ ਆਿਨਓ  ਤਬ ਓ ੁਹੁ ਿਭੰਨ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੋ  ॥
lines.english: He was supposed to have gathered the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam, theName of the Lord, but instead, the mad-man was busy with poison. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laino naam amrit ras neeko baavar bikh  si-o geh rahaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁੰਭੁ ਜਲੈ ਮਿਹ ਡਾਿਰਓ  ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭ ਿਮਲੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: This human life, so difficult to obtain, was finally obtained after such a long time. Heis losing it in exchange for a shell.
lines.transliteration: dulabh  janam chirankaal paa-i-o jaat a-o ka-udee bad lahaa.

lines.english: He came to buy musk, but instead, he has loaded dust and thistle grass. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaathooree ko gaahak aa-i-o laadi-o kaalar birakh  jivhaa. ||1||

lines.english: He comes in search of profits, but he is entangled in the enticing illusion of Maya.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-o laabh laabh an kai t aa-ee mohan th aaga-uree si-o ulajh  pahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੈਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਨੀਕੋ ਬਾਵਰ  ਿਬਖੁ ਿਸਉ ਗਿਹ ਰਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He loses the jewel, in exchange for mere glass. When will he have this blessedopportunity again? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaach baadrai laal kh o-ee hai fir ih a-osar kad  lahaa. ||2||

lines.english: He is full of sins, and he has not even one redeeming virtue. Forsaking his Lord andMaster, he is involved with Maya, God's slave.
lines.transliteration: sagal paraaDh ayk gun  naahee th aakur chh odah d aas bh ajhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਲਭ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਚਰੰਕਾਲ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਜਾਤਉ  ਕਉਡੀ  ਬਦਲਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: And when the final silence comes, like inanimate matter, he is caught like a thief atthe door. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aa-ee masat jarhvat  kee ni-aa-ee ji-o t askar d ar saaNniHaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਥੂਰੀ  ਕੋ ਗਾਹਕੁ  ਆਇਓ  ਲਾਿਦਓ  ਕਾਲਰ  ਿਬਰਖ  ਿਜਵਹਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cannot see any other way out. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: aan upaa-o na ko-oo soojhai har d aasaa sarn ee par rahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਓ  ਲਾਭੁ ਲਾਭਨ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ਮੋਹਿਨ ਠਾਗਉਰੀ  ਿਸਉ ਉਲਿਝ  ਪਹਾ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the mortal is emancipated, only when all his demerits and faults are erased and eradicated. ||4||4|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1203-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tab hee man chh utee-ai ja-o saglay a-ugan mayt Dh arhaa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚ  ਬਾਦਰੈ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਿਦ  ਲਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O mother, my patience is gone. I am in love with my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee Dheer rahee pari-a bahut  biraagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਧ  ਏਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਹ  ਦਾਿਸ  ਭਜਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: There are so many kinds of incomparable pleasures, but I am not interested in any ofthem. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik bhaaNt aanoop rang ray t inH si-o ruchai na laagi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਈ  ਮਸਿਟ  ਜੜਵਤ  ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਿਜਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਦਿਰ ਸਿਨਹਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Night and day, I utter, "Pri-a, Pri-a - Beloved, Beloved" with my mouth. I cannotsleep, even for an instant; I remain awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: nis baasur pari-a pari-a mukh tayra-o neeNd palak nahee jaagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਉਪਾਉ  ਨ ਕੋਊ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਾ  ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਿਰ ਰਹਾ ॥
lines.english: Necklaces, eye make-up, fancy clothes and decorations - without my Husband Lord, these are all poison to me. ||1|| pMnw 1204
lines.transliteration: haar kajar bastar anik seegaar ray bin pir sabh ai bikh  laagi-o. ||1||

lines.english: I ask and ask, with humility, "Who can tell me which country my Husband Lord lives in?"
lines.transliteration: poochha-o poochh a-o deen bh aaNt kar ko-oo kahai pari-a d aysaaNgi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਛਉ  ਪੂਛਉ  ਦੀਨ  ਭਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਦੇਸਿਗਓ  ॥
lines.english: I would dedicate my heart to him, I offer my mind and body and everything; I place my head at his feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: heeN-o dayN-u sabh  man t an arpa-o sees charan  par raakh i-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਂਓ  ੁਦ ੇ ਂ ਉ  ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ  ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣ  ਪਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I bow at the feet of the voluntary slave of the Lord; I beg him to bless me with theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: charan band naa amol d aasro d ayN-u saaDh sangat  ardaagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਬੰਦਨਾ  ਅਮੋਲ  ਦਾਸਰੋ  ਦੇਂਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਅਰਦਾਿਗਓ  ॥
lines.english: Show Mercy to me, that I may meet God, and gaze upon the Blessed Vision of HisDarshan every moment. ||3||
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa mohi parabhoo milaavhu nimakh  daras paykh aagi-o. ||3||

lines.english: When He is Kind to me, He comes to dwell within my being. Night and day, my mindis calm and peaceful.
lines.transliteration: darisat bh a-ee t ab bh eetar aa-i-o mayraa man an-d in seet laagi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਭਈ ਤਬ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਆਇਓ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਿਗਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I sing the Songs of Joy; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad resoundswithin me. ||4||5|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1204-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ras mangal gaa-ay sabad anaahad  baaji-o. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਿਸ ਮੰਗਲ  ਗਾਏ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਨਾਹਦੁ  ਬਾਿਜਓ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: O mother, True, True True is the Lord, and True, True, True is His Holy Saint.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee sat sat  sat har sat  sat sat saaDh aa.

lines.english: The Word which the Perfect Guru has spoken, I have tied to my robe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bachan guroo jo poorai kahi-o mai chheek gaaNthree baaDh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਸਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, and the stars in the sky shall vanish. The sun and the moon shall vanish.
lines.transliteration: nis baasur nakhi-at ar binaasee rav sasee-ar baynaaDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਹਓ  ਮੈ ਛੀਿਕ  ਗਠਰੀ  ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mountains, the earth, the water and the air shall pass away. Only the Word of theHoly Saint shall endure. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gir basuDhaa jal pavan jaa-igo ik saaDh  bachan atlaaDh aa. ||1||

lines.english: Those born of eggs shall pass away, and those born of the womb shall pass away.Those born of the earth and sweat shall pass away as well.
lines.transliteration: and binaasee jayr binaasee ut-bh uj sayt  binaaDh aa.

lines.english: The four Vedas shall pass away, and the six Shaastras shall pass away. Only the Wordof the Holy Saint is eternal. ||2||
lines.transliteration: chaar binaasee khateh binaasee ik saaDh  bachan nihchalaaDh aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਿਰ  ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਜਲ ਪਵਨ ਜਾਇਗੋ  ਇਿਕ  ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ  ਅਟਲਾਧਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Raajas, the quality of energetic activity shall pass away. Taamas, the quality oflethargic darkness shall pass away. Saatvas, the quality of peaceful light shall passaway as well.
lines.transliteration: raaj binaasee taam binaasee saat ak bh ee baynaaDh aa.

lines.english: All that is seen shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is beyonddestruction. ||3||
lines.transliteration: daristimaan hai sagal binaasee ik saaDh  bachan aagaaDh aa. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself is Himself by Himself. All that is seen is His play.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap aap hee aapay sabh aapan kh ayl dikhaaDhaa.

lines.english: He cannot be found by any means. O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, God is found.||4||6|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1204-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paa-i-o na jaa-ee kahee bhaaNt ray parabh  naanak gur mil laaDh aa. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟਮਾਨ  ਹੈ ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਇਿਕ  ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ  ਆਗਾਧਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, dwells within my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man baasibo gur gobind.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਆਪੇ  ਸਭੁ ਆਪਨ  ਖੇਲੁ ਿਦਖਾਧਾ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever my Lord and Master is remembered in meditation - that village is filled withpeace and bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jahaaN simran bha-i-o hai th aakur t ahaaN nagar sukh  aanand . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਓ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਕਹੀ ਭਿਤ  ਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਲਾਧਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Wherever my Beloved Lord and Master is forgotten - all misery and misfortune isthere.
lines.transliteration: jahaaN beesrai thaakur pi-aaro t ahaaN dookh sabh  aapad .

lines.english: Where the Praises of my Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss and Joy are sung - eternalpeace and wealth are there. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah gun gaa-ay aanand mangal roop t ahaaN sadaa sukh  sampad . ||1||

lines.english: Wherever they do not listen to the Stories of the Lord with their ears - the utterlydesolate wilderness is there.
lines.transliteration: jahaa sarvan har kathaa na sunee-ai tah mahaa bh a-i-aan ud i-aanad .

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਓ  ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤਹ ਨਗਰ  ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung with love in the Saadh Sangat - thereis fragrance and fruit and joy in abundance. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jahaaN keertan saaDh sangat  ras tah sagh an baas falaaNnad. ||2||

lines.english: Without meditative remembrance on the Lord, one may live for millions of years, buthis life would be totally useless.
lines.transliteration: bin simran kot barakh jeevai saglee a-oDh  barithaanad .

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਬੀਸਰੈ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਿਪਆਰੋ  ਤਹ ਦੂਖ ਸਭ ਆਪਦ  ॥
lines.english: But if he vibrates and meditates on the Lord of the Universe, for even a moment, then he shall live forever and ever. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk nimakh gobind  bhajan kar t a-o sad aa sad aa jeevaanad . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ  ਰੂਪ ਤਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary; please mercifullybless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saran saran saran parabh paava-o d eejai saaDh sangat  kirpaanad .

lines.punjabi: ਜਹਾ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ  ਤਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਿਦਆਨਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord is All-pervading everywhere, amongst all. He knows the qualitiesand the condition of all. ||4||7|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1204-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak poor rahi-o hai sarab mai sagal gunaa biDh  jaaNnad. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਰਸੁ ਤਹ ਸਘਨ  ਬਾਸ ਫਲਨਦ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Now, I have obtained the Support of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi raam bharosa-o paa-ay.

lines.english: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the Ocean of Mercy are carried across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo jo saran pari-o karun aaniDh  tay tay bh aveh t araa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਭਜਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੀਵਾਨਦ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: They sleep in peace, and intuitively merge into the Lord. The Guru takes away theircynicism and doubt.
lines.transliteration: sukh so-i-o ar sahj samaa-i-o sahsaa gureh gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ ਸਰਿਨ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਵਉ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਕਰਪਾਨਦ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever they wish for, the Lord does; they obtain the fruits of their minds' desires.||1||
lines.transliteration: jo chaahat so-ee har kee-o man baaNchhat fal paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਹੈ ਸਰਬ  ਮੈ ਸਗਲ  ਗੁਣਾ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਨਦ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: In my heart, I meditate on Him; with my eyes, I focus my meditation on Him. With my ears, I listen to His Sermon. pMnw 1205
lines.transliteration: hirdai japa-o nayt ar Dh i-aan laava-o sarvanee kathaa sunaa-ay.

lines.english: With my feet, I walk on my Lord and Mater's Path. With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: charnee chala-o maarag th aakur kai rasnaa har gun  gaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣੀ  ਚਲਉ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੈ ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: With my eyes, I see the Lord, the Embodiment of Absolute Bliss; the Saint has turnedaway from the world.
lines.transliteration: daykh i-o darisat sarab mangal roop ultee sant  karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਰਬ  ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਉਲਟੀ  ਸੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the Priceless Name of the Beloved Lord; it never leaves me or goesanywhere else. ||3||
lines.transliteration: paa-i-o laal amol naam har chhod na kat hoo jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਓ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਅਮੋਲੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: What praise, what glory and what virtues should I utter, in order to please the Lord?
lines.transliteration: kavan upmaa ka-un badaa-ee ki-aa gun kaha-o reejhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਕਉਨ ਬਡਾਈ  ਿਕਆ  ਗੁ ਨ ਕਹਉ  ਰੀਝਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being, unto whom the Merciful Lord is kind - O servant Nanak, he is theslave of God's slaves. ||4||8|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1205-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hot kirpaal d een d a-i-aa parabh  jan naanak d aas d asaa-ay. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਤ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਏ  ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: Who can I tell, and with whom can I speak, about this state of peace and bliss?
lines.transliteration: o-ay sukh kaa si-o baran sunaavat .

lines.english: I am in ecstasy and delight, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. My mind sings His Songs of Joy and His Glories. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anad binod  paykh  parabh  darsan man mangal gun gaavat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am wonderstruck, gazing upon the Wondrous Lord. The Merciful Lord is All-pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: bisam bha-ee paykh  bismaad ee poor rahay kirpaavat .

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸਨ  ਮਿਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I drink in the Invaluable Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Like the mute, Ican only smile - I cannot speak of its flavor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pee-o amrit naam amolak ji-o chaakh  goongaa muskaavat . ||1||

lines.english: As the breath is held in bondage, no one can understand its coming in and going out.
lines.transliteration: jaisay pavan banDh kar raakh i-o boojh  na aavat  jaavat .

lines.english: So is that person, whose heart is enlightened by the Lord - his story cannot be told.||2||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o ridai pargaas bh a-i-o har u-aa kee kahee na jaa-ay kahaavat . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਓ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕ  ਿਜਉ ਚਾਿਖ  ਗੂੰਗਾ  ਮੁਸਕਾਵਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As many other efforts as you can think of - I have seen them and studied them all.
lines.transliteration: aan upaav jaytay kichh  kahee-ahi t aytay seekh ay paavat .

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਕਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: My Beloved, Carefree Lord has revealed Himself within the home of my own heart;thus I have realized the Inaccessible Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: achint laal garih bh eetar pargati-o agam jaisay parkh aavat . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਰਦੈ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਉਆ  ਕੀ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਕਹਾਵਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Absolute, Formless, Eternally Unchanging, Immeasurable Lord cannot bemeasured.
lines.transliteration: nirgun nirankaar abh inaasee at ulo tuli-o na jaavat .

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਜੇਤੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਤੇਤੇ ਸੀਖੇ ਪਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, whoever endures the unendurable - this state belongs to him alone. ||4||9|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1205-10) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ajar jin jari-aa tis hee ka-o ban aavat . ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਓ  ਅਗਮ  ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਖਾਵਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The corrupt person passes his days and nights uselessly.
lines.transliteration: bikh-ee d in rain iv hee gud aarai.

lines.english: He does not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; he is intoxicated withegotistical intellect. He loses his life in the gamble. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gobind na bh ajai ahaN-buDh  maat aa janam joo-ai ji-o haarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਜਰੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਿਰਆ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਿਨ ਆਵਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, but he is not in love with it. He lovesonly to slander others.
lines.transliteration: naam amolaa pareet na t is si-o par nind aa hit kaarai.

lines.english: Weaving the grass, he builds his house of straw. At the door, he builds a fire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chhaapar baaNDh savaarai t arin ko du-aarai paavak jaarai. ||1||

lines.english: He carries a load of sulfur on his head, and drives the Ambrosial Nectar out of hismind.
lines.transliteration: kaalar pot uthaavai mooNdeh amrit  man t ay daarai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ਨ ਭਜੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਿਧ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਿਜਉ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wearing his good clothes, the mortal falls into the coal-pit; again and again, he triesto shake it off. ||2||
lines.transliteration: odhai bast ar kaajar meh pari-aa bahur bahur fir jh aarai. ||2||

lines.english: Standing on the branch, eating and eating and smiling, he cuts down the tree.
lines.transliteration: kaatai payd daal par thaadh ou kh aa-ay kh aa-ay muskaarai.

lines.english: He falls down head-first and is shattered into bits and pieces. ||3||
lines.transliteration: giri-o jaa-ay rasaatal pari-o chh itee chh itee sir bh aarai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਪਰੁ ਬਿਧ ਸਵਾਰੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਣ  ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਪਾਵਕੁ  ਜਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He bears vengeance against the Lord who is free of vengeance. The fool is not up tothe task.
lines.transliteration: nirvairai sang vair rachaa-ay pahuch na sakai gavaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲਰ  ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਵੈ  ਮੂੰਡਿਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Saving Grace of the Saints is the Formless, Supreme Lord God.||4||10|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1205-15) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak santan kaa raakh aa paarbarahm nirankaarai. ||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਓਢੈ ਬਸਤਰ੍ ਕਾਜਰ  ਮਿਹ ਪਿਰਆ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ  ਝਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: All the others are deluded by doubt; they do not understand.
lines.transliteration: avar sabh bh oolay bh armat  na jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਟੈ ਪੇਡੁ ਡਾਲ  ਪਿਰ ਠਾਢੌ ਖਾਇ  ਖਾਇ  ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: That person, within whose heart the One Pure Word abides, realizes the essence ofthe Vedas. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk suDhaakh ar jaa kai hird ai vasi-aa t in bayd eh tat pachh aani-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He walks in the ways of the world, trying to please people.
lines.transliteration: parvirat maarag jayt aa kichh  ho-ee-ai t aytaa log pachaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਵੈਰੈ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ  ਪਹੁਿਚ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਗਵਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: But as long as his heart is not enlightened, he is stuck in pitch black darkness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ja-o la-o ridai nahee pargaasaa t a-o la-o anDh  anDh aaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੈ  ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The land may be prepared in every way, but nothing sprouts without being planted.
lines.transliteration: jaisay Dhart ee saaDh ai baho biDh  bin beejai nahee jaaNmai.

lines.english: Just so, without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated, nor is egotistical pride eradicated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na ho-ee hai t utai naahee abh imaanai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਿਰ  ਸਿਭ ਭੂਲੇ ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal may churn water until he is sore, but how can butter be produced?
lines.transliteration: neer bilovai at saram paavai nainoo kaisay reesai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਬੇਦਿਹ  ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਿਨਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without meeting the Guru, no one is liberated, and the Lord of the Universe is not met. ||3|| pMnw 1206
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhaytay mukat  na kaahoo milat  nahee jagd eesai. ||3||

lines.english: Searching and searching, I have come to this realization: all peace and bliss are in the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat ihai beechaari-o sarab sukh aa har naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.||4||11|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1206-2) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tis bh a-i-o paraapat  jaa kai laykh  mathaamaa. ||4||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭਇਓ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਥਾਮਾ  ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din raam kay gun  kahee-ai.

lines.english: You shall obtain all wealth, all pleasures and successes, and the fruits of your mind'sdesires. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath sarab sookh  siDh man baaNchhat fal lahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Come, O Saints, let us meditate in remembrance on God; He is the Eternal, Imperishable Giver of Peace and Praanaa, the Breath of Life.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sant paraan sukh -daatay simreh parabh  abhinaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਿਸਿਧ  ਮਨ ਬਛਤ  ਫਲ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Master of the masterless, Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; He is All-pervading and permeating, abiding in all hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anaathah naath deen d ukh bhanjan poor rahi-o gh at vaasee. ||1||

lines.english: The very fortunate ones drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, singing, reciting andlistening to the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: gaavat sunat  sunaavat  sarDh aa har ras pee vadbh aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਿਸਮਰਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: All their sufferings and struggles are wiped away from their bodies; they remainlovingly awake and aware in the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kal kalays mitay sabh t an tay raam naam liv jaagay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥਹ  ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: So abandon your sexual desire, greed, falsehood and slander; meditating inremembrance on the Lord, you shall be released from bondage.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh jh ooth taj nind aa har simran banDh an tootay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਸੁਨਾਵਤ  ਸਰਧਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: The intoxication of loving attachments, egotism and blind possessiveness areeradicated by Guru's Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: moh magan ahaN anDh mamt aa gur kirpaa t ay chh ootay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਿਮਟੇ ਸਿਭ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਲਵ ਜਾਗੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are All-Powerful, O Supreme Lord God and Master; please be Merciful to Yourhumble servant.
lines.transliteration: too samrath paarbarahm su-aamee kar kirpaa jan t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਿਜ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਿਨ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੂਟੇ ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is All-pervading and prevailing everywhere; O Nanak, God is Near.||4||12|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1206-7) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-o sarab meh thaakur naanak so parabh  nayraa. ||4||12||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ  ਅਹੰ ਅੰਧ ਮਮਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Divine Guru.
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gurdayv charan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: I meditate with Him on the Supreme Lord God; His Teachings have emancipated me.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sang paarbarahm Dhi-aa-ee-ai upd ays hamaaree gat  karan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰਬ  ਮਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.english: All pains, diseases and fears are erased, for one who comes to the Sanctuary of theLord's Saints.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog bh ai sagal binaasay jo aavai har sant  saran.

lines.english: He Himself chants, and inspires others to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Heis Utterly All-Powerful; He carries us across to the other side. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap japai avrah naam japaavai vad samrath taaran t aran. ||1||

lines.english: His Mantra drives out cynicism, and totally fills the empty one.
lines.transliteration: jaa ko mantar ut aarai sahsaa oon ay ka-o subh ar bharan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਗਿਤ  ਕਰਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who obey the Order of the Lord's slaves, do not enter into the womb ofreincarnation ever again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har daasan kee aagi-aa maanat  tay naahee fun garabh  paran. ||2||

lines.english: Whoever works for the Lord's devotees and sings His Praises - his pains of birth anddeath are taken away.
lines.transliteration: bhagt an kee tahal kamaavat  gaavat  dukh kaatay t aa kay janam maran.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਜੋ ਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those unto whom my Beloved becomes Merciful, endure the Unendurable Ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bha-i-o kirpaal beeth ulaa t in har har ajar jaran. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ  ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥ  ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are satisfied by the Sublime Essence of the Lord, merge intuitively into theLord; no mouth can describe their state.
lines.transliteration: har raseh aghaanay sahj samaanay mukh  tay naahee jaat  baran.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ  ਸਹਸਾ  ਊਣੇ ਕਉ ਸੁਭਰ  ਭਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they are content; chanting and meditating on God's Name,they are saved. ||4||13|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1206-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak sant okhay naam parabh oo jap jap uDh ran. ||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੀ ਆਿਗਆ  ਮਾਨਤ  ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਫੁਿਨ ਗਰਭ  ਪਰਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I sing, O I sing the Songs of Joy of my Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: gaa-i-o ree mai gun niDh  mangal gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਨ  ਕੀ ਟਹਲ  ਕਮਾਵਤ  ਗਾਵਤ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: Fortunate is the time, fortunate is the day and the moment, when I become pleasingto the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhalay sanjog bh alay d in a-osar ja-o gopaal reejh aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਬੀਠੁਲਾ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਜਰ  ਜਰਨ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I touch my forehead to the Feet of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: santeh charan morlo maathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸਿਹ  ਅਘਾਨੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਨੇ  ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਤ ਬਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints have placed their hands on my forehead. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hamray mastak sant  Dharay haathaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤੋਖੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਜਿਪ ਜਿਪ ਉਧਰਨ  ॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: My mind is filled with the Mantra of the Holy Saints,
lines.transliteration: saaDhah mant ar morlo manoo-aa.
taa tay gat  ho-ay t arai gunee-aa. ||2|| and I have risen above the three qualities||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of God's devotees, my eyes are filled with love.
lines.transliteration: bhagt ah daras d aykh nain rangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ  ਭਲੇ ਿਦਨ  ਅਉਸਰ  ਜਉ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ  ਰੀਝਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Greed and attachment are gone, along with doubt. ||3||
lines.transliteration: lobh moh t ootay bh aram sangaa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found intuitive peace, poise and bliss.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sukh sahj anand aa.

lines.english: Tearing down the wall, I have met the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss.||4||14|| swrg mhlw 5 Gru 2  (1206-18) saarag mehlaa 5 ghar 2 Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1206-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kholiH bheet milay parmaanand aa. ||4||14||

lines.english: How can I express the pain of my soul?
lines.transliteration: kaisay kaha-o mohi jee-a baydnaa-ee.

lines.english: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Enticing and Lovely Beloved.My mind cannot survive - it yearns for Him in so many ways. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1207
lines.transliteration: darsan pi-aas pari-a pareet  manohar man na rahai baho biDh  umkaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: I think thoughts of Him; I miss the Love of my Beloved. When will I obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?
lines.transliteration: chitvan chit va-o pari-a pareet  bairaagee kad  paava-o har d arsaa-ee.

lines.english: I try, but this mind is not encouraged. Is there any Saint who can lead me to God? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jatan kara-o ih man nahee Dh eerai ko-oo hai ray sant  milaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਵਿਨ  ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਕਿਦ  ਪਾਵਉ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting, penance, self-control, good deeds and charity - I sacrifice all these in fire; Idedicate all peace and places to Him.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam punn sabh  homa-o t is arpa-o sabh  sukh  jaaN-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ  ਕਰਉ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who helps me to behold the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, for even an instant - Iam a sacrifice to that Saint. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ayk nimakh pari-a d aras d ikhaavai t is sant an kai bal jaaN-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਪੁੰਨ ਸਿਭ ਹੋਮਉ  ਿਤਸੁ ਅਰਪਉ  ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਜਈ  ॥
lines.english: I offer all my prayers and entreaties to him; I serve him, day and night.
lines.transliteration: kara-o nihoraa bahut baynt ee sayva-o d in rainaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਦਖਾਵੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲ ਜਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have renounced all pride and egotism; he tells me the stories of my Beloved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan ha-o sagal t i-aaga-o jo pari-a baat  sunaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the wondrous play of God. The Guru, the True Guru,has led me to meet the Primal Lord.
lines.transliteration: daykh  charit ar bha-ee ha-o bisman gur sat gur purakh  milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਸਗਲ  ਿਤਆਗਉ  ਜੋ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: ||4||1||15|| I have found God, my Merciful Loving Lord, within the home of my own heart. ONanak, the fire within me has been quenched. ||4||1||15|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1207-6) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh rang d a-i-aal mohi garih meh paa-i-aa jan naanak t apat bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਚਿਰਤਰ੍ ਭਈ ਹਉ ਿਬਸਮਿਨ  ਗੁਿਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You fool, why are you not meditating on the Lord now?
lines.transliteration: ray moorhHay too ki-o simrat  ab naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰੰਗ ਦਇਆਲ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਪਿਤ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥
lines.english: In the awful hell of the fire of the womb, you did penance, upside-down; each andevery instant, you sang His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: narak ghor meh uraDh  tap kart aa nimakh  nimakh  gun gaaNhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You wandered through countless incarnations, until finally you attained this pricelesshuman birth.
lines.transliteration: anik janam bharmat ou hee aa-i-o maanas janam d ulbhaahee.

lines.english: Leaving the womb, you were born, and when you came out, you became attached toother places. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garabh jon chh od ja-o niksi-o t a-o laago an th aaNhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਿਹ ਉਰਧ  ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਗੁਣ ਗਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You practiced evil and fraud day and night, and did useless deeds.
lines.transliteration: karahi buraa-ee thagaa-ee d in rain nihfal karam kamaahee.

lines.english: You thrash the straw, but it has no wheat; running around and hurrying, you obtainonly pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kan naahee t uh gaahan  laagay Dh aa-ay Dh aa-ay d ukh paaNhee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਨਮ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤੌ  ਹੀ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਨਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਦੁਲਭਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The false person is attached to falsehood; he is entangled with transitory things.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa sang koorh laptaa-i-o urajh  pari-o kusmaaNhee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਛੋਿਡ ਜਉ ਿਨਕਿਸਓ  ਤਉ ਲਾਗੋ  ਅਨ ਠਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay jab pakras bavray t a-o kaal mukh aa uth  jaahee. ||3|| And when the Righteous Judge of Dharma seizes you, O madman, you shall arise anddepart with your face blackened. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੁਰਾਈ ਠਗਾਈ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਿਨਹਫਲ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: He alone meets with God, whom God Himself meets, by such pre-ordained destiny written on his forehead.
lines.transliteration: so mili-aa jo parabhoo milaa-i-aa jis mast ak laykh  likhaaNhee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੁਹ ਗਾਹਣ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਧਾਇ  ਧਾਇ  ਦੁਖ ਪਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being, who remains unattached within hismind. ||4||2||16|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1207-12) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tinH jan balihaaree jo alip rahay man maaNhee. ||4||2||16||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਕੂਿੜ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ  ਉਰਿਝ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਕੁਸਮਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: How can I live without my Beloved, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: ki-o jeevan pareetam bin maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਜਬ ਪਕਰਿਸ  ਬਵਰੇ  ਤਉ ਕਾਲ  ਮੁਖਾ ਉਿਠ ਜਾਹੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Separated from Him, the mortal becomes a corpse, and is not allowed to remainwithin the house. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaa kay bichhurat  hot mirtakaa garih meh rahan na paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is the Giver of the soul, the heart, the breath of life. Being with Him, we areembellished with joy.
lines.transliteration: jee-a heeN-a paraan ko daat aa jaa kai sang suhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਜਨ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਜੋ ਅਿਲਪ  ਰਹੇ ਮਨ ਮਹੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Please bless me with Your Gace, O Saint, that I may sing the songs of joyful praise tomy God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa santahu mohi apunee parabh  mangal gun  gaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. My eyes long for their dust.
lines.transliteration: charan santan kay maathay mayray oopar nainhu Dh oor baaNchhaa-eeN.

lines.english: By His Grace, we meet God; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||17|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1207-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jih parsaad milee-ai parabh  naanak bal bal t aa kai ha-o jaa-ee. ||2||3||17||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਿਬਛੁਰਤ  ਹੋਤ ਿਮਰਤਕਾ  ਿਗਰ੍ਹ ਮਿਹ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that occasion.
lines.transliteration: u-aa a-osar kai ha-o bal jaa-ee.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on my God; by great goodfortune, I have found the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar apnaa parabh  simran vadbh aagee har paaN-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਹੀਅ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੁਹਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer is good, the slave of the Lord's slaves; the humble barber Sain is sublime.
lines.transliteration: bhalo kabeer d aas d aasan ko oot am sain jan naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੰਗਲ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Highest of the high is Naam Dayv, who looked upon all alike; Ravi Daas was in tunewith the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ooch tay ooch naamd ay-o samad rasee ravid aas th aakur ban  aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੇ ਮਾਥੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਨੈਨਹੁ ਧੂਿਰ ਬਛਾਈ ॥
lines.english: My soul, body and wealth belong to the Saints; my mind longs for the dust of theSaints.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind tan Dh an saaDh an kaa ih man sant  raynaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਿਮਲੀਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੭॥
lines.english: And by the radiant Grace of the Saints, all my doubts have been erased. O Nanak, Ihave met the Lord. ||2||4||18|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1207-19) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant part aap bh aram sabh  naasay naanak milay gusaa-ee. ||2||4||18||

lines.english: The True Guru fulfills the mind's desires. pMnw 1208
lines.transliteration: manorath pooray satgur aap.

lines.english: All wealth and treasures are obtained by remembering Him in meditation; twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, meditate on Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath simran jaa kai aath  pahar mayray man jaap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਿਸਮਰਿਨ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master. Whoever drinks it in issatisfied.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam su-aamee t ayraa jo peevai t is hee t ariptaas.

lines.english: The sins of countless incarnations are erased, and hereafter, he shall be saved andredeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilbikh naaseh aagai d argeh ho-ay kh alaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Creator, O Perfect Supreme Eternal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: saran tumaaree aa-i-o kart ay paarbarahm pooran abinaas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਨਾਸਿਹ  ਆਗੈ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please be kind to me, that I may meditate on Your Lotus Feet. O Nanak, my mind andbody thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||5||19|| swrg mhlw 5 Gru 3  (1208-5) saarag mehlaa 5 ghar 3 Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1208-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa tayray charan Dh i-aava-o naanak man t an daras pi-aas. ||2||5||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਆਇਓ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, why are you lured away by otherness?
lines.transliteration: man kahaa lubhaa-ee-ai aan ka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਿਧਆਵਉ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਸ  ॥੨॥੫॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, God is forever your Help and Support. He is your soul-mate; He will help you succeed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: eet oot  parabh  sadaa sahaa-ee jee-a sang t ayray kaam ka-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Name of your Beloved Lover, the Fascinating Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar. Drinking itin, you shall find satisfaction.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam pari-a pareet  manohar ihai agh aavan paaNn ka-o.

lines.english: The Being of Immortal Manifestation is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy. Meditate on Him in that most sublime place. ||1||
lines.transliteration: akaal moorat hai saaDh  santan kee th aahar neekee Dh i-aan ka-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ  ਜੀਅ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Bani, the Word of the Supreme Lord God, is the greatest Mantra of all. Iteradicates pride from the mind.
lines.transliteration: banee mant ar mahaa purkh an kee maneh ut aaran maaNn ka-o.

lines.english: Searching, Nanak found the home of peace and bliss in the Name of the Lord.||2||1||20|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1208-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: khoj lahi-o naanak sukh  thaanaaN har naamaa bisraam ka-o. ||2||1||20||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮਨੋਹਰ  ਇਹੈ ਅਘਾਵਨ  ਪਨ ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, sing forever the Songs of Joy of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: man sadaa mangal gobind  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਨੀਕੀ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਕਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: All your disease, sorrow and sin will be erased, if you meditate on the Lord's Name,even for an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rog sog tayray miteh sagal agh  nimakh  hee-ai har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ  ਕੀ ਮਨਿਹ  ਉਤਾਰਨ  ਮਨ ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: Abandon all your clever tricks; go and enter the Sanctuary of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: chhod si-aanap baho chat uraa-ee saaDh oo sarn ee jaa-ay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਿਜ ਲਿਹਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ਕਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
lines.english: When the Lord, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, the Messenger of Death is changed into the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ja-o ho-ay kirpaal deen d ukh bhanjan jam t ay hovai Dh aram raa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. No one else can equal Him.
lines.transliteration: aykas bin naahee ko doojaa aan na bee-o lavai laa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord is Nanak's Mother, Father and Sibling, the Giver of Peace, his Breath of Life.||2||2||21|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1208-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee naanak ko sukh -daata har paraan saa-ay. ||2||2||21||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਸਗਲ  ਅਘ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਹੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servant saves those who accompany him.
lines.transliteration: har jan sagal uDhaaray sang kay.

lines.english: Their minds are sanctified and rendered pure, and they are rid of the pains ofcountless incarnations. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay puneet  pavit ar man janam janam kay d ukh haray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਿਡ ਿਸਆਨਪ  ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who walk on the path find peace; they are saved, along with those who speakwith them.
lines.transliteration: maarag chalay tinHee sukh  paa-i-aa jinH si-o gosat say t aray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਜਮ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even those who are drowning in the horrible, deep dark pit are carried across in theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: boodat gh or anDh  koop meh t ay saaDh oo sang paar paray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਬੀਓ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have such high destiny turn their faces toward the Saadh Sangat.
lines.transliteration: jinH kay bhaag baday hai bh aa-ee t inH saaDh oo sang mukh  juray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸਾਇ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Nanak longs for the dust of their feet; O God, please shower Your Mercy on me! ||2||3||22|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1208-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tinH kee Dh oor baaNchhai nit naanak parabh  mayraa kirpaa karay. ||2||3||22||

lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: har jan raam raam raam Dhi-aaN-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸਗਲ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ਸੰਗ ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: One who enjoys peace in the Company of the Holy, even for an instant, obtainsmillions of heavenly paradises. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk palak sukh saaDh  samaagam kot baikuNthah paaN-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਮਨ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is sanctified by meditating on the Lord. Ittakes away the fear of death.
lines.transliteration: dulabh  dayh jap hot  puneet aa jam kee t araas nivaarai.

lines.english: Even the sins of terrible sinners are washed away, by cherishing the Lord's Namewithin the heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mahaa patit  kay paat ik utreh har naamaa ur Dh aarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਲੇ ਿਤਨੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਗੋਸਿਟ  ਸੇ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Whoever listens to the Immaculate Praises of the Lord - his pains of birth and deathare dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jo jo sunai raam jas nirmal taa kaa janam maran  dukh naasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡਤ  ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Lord is found by great good fortune, and then the mind and body blossom forth. ||2||4||23|| pMnw 1209 swrg mhlw 5 dupdy Gru 4  (1209-2) saarag mehlaa 5 dupd ay gh ar 4 Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1209-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paa-ee-ai vadbhaageeN man t an ho-ay bigaasaa. ||2||4||23||

lines.english: O my Fascinating Lord, I pray to You: come into my house.
lines.transliteration: mohan ghar aavhu kara-o jod ree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I act in pride, and speak in pride. I am mistaken and wrong, but I am still Your hand- maiden, O my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maan kara-o abhimaanai bola-o bh ool chook t ayree pari-a chiree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I hear that You are near, but I cannot see You. I wander in suffering, deluded bydoubt.
lines.transliteration: nikat sun-o ar paykha-o naahee bh aram bh aram d ukh bharee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੈ  ਬੋਲਉ  ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਿਚਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has become merciful to me; He has removed the veils. Meeting with myBeloved, my mind blossoms forth in abundance. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ho-ay kirpaal gur laahi paardo mila-o laal man haree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: If I were to forget my Lord and Master, even for an instant, it would be like millions ofdays, tens of thousands of years.
lines.transliteration: ayk nimakh jay bisrai su-aamee jaan-o kot d inas lakh  baree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਸੁਨਉ  ਅਰੁ ਪੇਖਉ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: When I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, I met my Lord. ||2||1||24|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1209-6) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kee bh eer ja-o paa-ee t a-o naanak har sang miree-aa. ||2||1||24||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਗੁਰ ਲਾਿਹ ਪਾਰਦੋ  ਿਮਲਉ  ਲਾਲ  ਮਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now what should I think? I have given up thinking.
lines.transliteration: ab ki-aa socha-o soch bisaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਜੇ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਾਨਉ  ਕੋਿਟ ਿਦਨਸ  ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: You do whatever You wish to do. Please bless me with Your Name - I am a sacrifice toYou. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karnaa saa so-ee kar rahi-aa d eh naa-o balihaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੀ ਭੀਰ ਜਉ ਪਾਈ  ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਰੀਆ  ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
lines.english: The poison of corruption is flowering forth in the four directions; I have taken theGurMantra as my antidote.
lines.transliteration: chahu dis fool rahee bikh i-aa bikh  gur mant ar mookh  garurh aaree.

lines.english: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me as His Own; like the lotus in the water, Iremain unattached. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh i-o kar apunaa ji-o jal kamlaa alipaaree. ||1||

lines.english: I am nothing. What am I? You hold all in Your Power.
lines.transliteration: ha-o naahee kichh mai ki-aa hosaa sabh  tum hee kal Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣਾ  ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਦੇਿਹ ਨਾਉ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak has run to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save him, for the sake of Your Saints.||2||2||25|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1209-10) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaag pari-o har paachh ai raakh  sant sadkaaree. ||2||2||25||

lines.english: Now I have abandoned all efforts and devices.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi sarab upaav birkaatay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਹੁ ਿਦਸ ਫੂਿਲ ਰਹੀ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਮੂਿਖ ਗਰੁੜਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes, my only Saving Grace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath su-aamee har aykas t ay mayree gaat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਜਲ ਕਮਲਾ ਅਿਲਪਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have seen numerous forms of incomparable beauty, but nothing is like You.
lines.transliteration: daykh ay naanaa roop baho rangaa an naahee t um bh aaNtay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੈ ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਸਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You give Your Support to all, O my Lord and Master; You are the Giver of peace, ofthe soul and the breath of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dayNhi aDh aar sarab ka-o th aakur jee-a paraan sukh -daatay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਕਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Wandering, wandering, I grew so tired; meeting the Guru, I fell at His Feet.
lines.transliteration: bharmat ou bh armat ou haar ja-o pari-o t a-o gur mil charan paraat ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found total peace; this life-night of mine passes in peace.||2||3||26|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1209-14) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai sarab sukh paa-i-aa ih sookh  bihaanee raat ay. ||2||3||26||

lines.english: Now I have found the Support of my Lord.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi labDhi-o hai har taykaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਏਕਸੁ  ਤੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru, the Giver of peace, has become merciful to me. I was blind - I see thejewel of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur da-i-aal bh a-ay sukh -daa-ee anDh ulai maan ik daykhaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have cut away the darkness of ignorance and become immaculate; my discriminationg intellect has blossomed forth.
lines.transliteration: kaatay agi-aan timar nirmalee-aa buDh  bigaas bibaykaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਾ  ਰੂਪ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ  ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੁਮ ਭਤੇ ॥
lines.english: As the waves of water and the foam become water again, the Lord and His servantbecome One. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal tarang fayn jal ho-ee hai sayvak th aakur bh a-ay aykaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਂਿਹ  ਅਧਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ  ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is taken in again, into what from which he came; all is one in the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jah tay uth i-o tah hee aa-i-o sabh  hee aykai aykaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮਤੌ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤੌ  ਹਾਿਰ  ਜਉ ਪਿਰਓ  ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਚਰਨ  ਪਰਾਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I have come to see the Master of the breath of life, all-pervadingeverywhere. ||2||4||27|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1209-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak darisat aa-i-o sarab th aa-ee paraan patee har samkaa. ||2||4||27||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਇਹ ਸੂਿਖ ਿਬਹਾਨੀ  ਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
lines.english: My mind longs for the One Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man aykai hee pari-a maaNgai.

lines.english: I have looked everywhere in every country, but nothing equals even a hair of myBeloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paykh aa-i-o sarab thaan d ays pari-a rom na samsar laagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਲਬਿਧਓ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
lines.english: All sorts of delicacies and dainties are placed before me, but I do not even want tolook at them.
lines.transliteration: mai neeray anik bhojan baho binjan t in si-o d arisat na karai ruchaaNgai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਅੰਧੁਲੈ  ਮਾਿਣਕੁ  ਦੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I long for the sublime essence of the Lord, calling, "Pri-o! Pri-o! - Beloved! Beloved!", like the Bumble bee longing for the lotus flower. ||1|| pMnw 1210
lines.transliteration: har ras chaahai pari-a pari-a mukh tayrai ji-o al kamlaa lobh aaNgai. ||1||

lines.english: The Treasure of Virtue, the Enticer of the mind, my Beloved is the Giver of peace to all.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan manmohan laalan sukh -daa-ee sarbaaNgai.

lines.english: Guru Nanak has led me to You, O God. Join with me, O my Best Friend, and hold meclose in Your Embrace. ||2||5||28|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1210-2) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak parabh paahi path aa-i-o milhu sakh aa gal laagai. ||2||5||28||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਿਹ  ਪਠਾਇਓ  ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸਖਾ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਗੈ  ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
lines.english: Now my mind is pleased and appeased by my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ab moro thaakur si-o man maanaaN.
