lines.english: The Holy Saint has become kind and compassionate to me, and has destroyed thisdemon of duality. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDh kirpaal d a-i-aal bh a-ay hai ih chh aydi-o dusat bigaanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are so beautiful, and You are so wise; You are elegant and all-knowing.
lines.transliteration: tum hee sund ar tumeh si-aanay t um hee sugh ar sujaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਛੇਿਦਓ  ਦੁਸਟੁ ਿਬਗਾਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the Yogis, spiritual teachers and meditators do not know even a bit of Your value.||1||
lines.transliteration: sagal jog ar gi-aan Dhi-aan ik nimakh  na keemat  jaanaaN. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Master, You are the Lord under the royal canopy; You are the perfectly pervading Lord God.
lines.transliteration: tum hee naa-ik t umHahi chh atarpat tum poor rahay bh agvaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਿਸਆਨੇ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁਘਰ  ਸੁਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with the gift of service to the Saints; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to theLord. ||2||6||29|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1210-6) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paava-o daan sant  sayvaa har naanak sad  kurbaanaaN. ||2||6||29||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Love of my Beloved comes into my conscious mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man cheet aa-ay pari-a rangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਨਾਇਕ ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਛਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਤੁਮ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have forgotten the entangling affairs of Maya, and I spend my life-night fighting withevil. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bisri-o DhanDh  banDh  maa-i-aa ko rajan sabaa-ee jangaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਉ  ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥
lines.english: I serve the Lord; the Lord abides within my heart. I have found my Lord in the SatSangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: har sayva-o har ridai basaava-o har paa-i-aa sat sangaa.

lines.english: So I have met with my enticingly beautiful Beloved; I have obtained the peace which Iasked for. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aiso mili-o manohar pareetam sukh  paa-ay mukh  mangaa. ||1||

lines.english: The Guru has brought my Beloved under my control, and I enjoy Him withunrestrained pleasure.
lines.transliteration: pari-o apnaa gur bas kar deenaa bh oga-o bh og nisangaa.

lines.english: I have become fearless; O Nanak, my fears have been eradicated. Chanting the Word, I have found the Lord. ||2||7||30|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1210-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay naanak bh a-o miti-aa har paa-i-o faath angaa. ||2||7||30||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਿਰਓ  ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੋ ਰਜਿਨ  ਸਬਾਈ  ਜੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Dear Lord.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o kay darsan ka-o kurbaanee.

lines.english: The Naad, the Sound-current of His Word fills my ears; my body has settled gentlyinto the Lap of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bachan naad mayray saravnahu pooray d ayhaa pari-a ank samaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਉ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਤਸੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: I was a discarded bride, and the Guru has made me a happy soul-bride. I have foundthe Elegant and All-knowing Lord.
lines.transliteration: chhootar t ay gur kee-ee sohaagan har paa-i-o sugh arh sujaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਮੰਗਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That home, in which I was not even allowed to sit - I have found that place in which Ican dwell. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jih ghar meh baisan nahee paavat  so thaan mili-o baasaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਅਪਨਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਬਿਸ ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨਾ  ਭੋਗਉ  ਭੋਗ ਿਨਸੰਗਾ  ॥
lines.english: God, the Love of His devotees, has come under the control of those who protect thehonor of His Saints.
lines.transliteration: unH kai bas aa-i-o bhagat  bachh al jin raakh ee aan sant aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਉ ਿਮਿਟਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਓ  ਪਾਠੰਗਾ  ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my mid is pleased and appeased with the Lord, and my subservience toother people has come to an end. ||2||8||31|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1210-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har sang man maani-aa sabh chookee kaan  lokaanee. ||2||8||31||

lines.english: Now my association with the five thieves has come to an end.
lines.transliteration: ab mayro panchaa tay sang t ootaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is in ecstasy; byGuru's Grace, I am released. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykh bha-ay man aanad  gur kirpaa t ay chh ootaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਚਨ  ਨਾਦ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰ੍ਵਨਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੇਹਾ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The impregnable place is guarded by countless ramparts and warriors.
lines.transliteration: bikham thaan bahut  baho Dh aree-aa anik raakh  soorootaa.

lines.english: This impregnable fortress cannot be touched, but with the assistance of the Saints, Ihave entered and robbed it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bikham gaarah kar pahuchai naahee sant  saanath bh a-ay lootaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਛੂਟਿਰ  ਤੇ ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਈ  ਸਹਾਗਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਓ  ਸੁਘੜ  ਸੁਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have found such a great treasure, a priceless, inexhaustible supply of jewels.
lines.transliteration: bahut kh ajaanay mayrai paalai pari-aa amol laal aakh ootaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਬਾਸਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, when God showered His Mercy on me, my mind drank in thesublime essence of the Lord. ||2||9||32|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1210-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak parabh kirpaa Dh aaree t a-o man meh har ras gh ootaa. ||2||9||32||

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਸ ਆਇਓ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਛਲੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਾਖੀ  ਆਨ  ਸੰਤਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Now my mind is absorbed in my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ab mayro thaakur si-o man leenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ  ਕਾਿਣ  ਲਕਾਨੀ  ॥੨॥੮॥੩੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the breath of life. I am involved with the Lord, like the fish with the water. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraan daan gur poorai d ee-aa urjh aa-i-o ji-o jal meenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have cast out sexual desire, anger, greed, egotism and envy; I have offered all thisas a gift.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mad matsar ih arap sagal d aan keenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੇਰੋ ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has implanted the medicine of the Lord's Mantra within me, and I have metwith the All-knowing Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mantar drirh -aa-ay har a-ukh aDh gur d ee-o t a-o mili-o sagal parbeenaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਭਏ ਮਿਨ ਆਨਦ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My household belongs to You, O my Lord and Master; the Guru has blessed me with God, and rid me of egotism. pMnw 1211
lines.transliteration: garihu tayraa t oo thaakur mayraa gur ha-o kh o-ee parabh  deenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਿਰ ਹਉ ਖੋਈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found the Lord with intuitive ease, within the home of my own heart. Devotional worship of the Lord is a treasure over-flowing. ||2||10||33|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1211-2) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai sahj ghar paa-i-aa har bh agat bhandaar kh ajeenaa. ||2||10||33||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਸਹਜ  ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੩॥
lines.english: O my Enticing Lord, all beings are Yours - You save them.
lines.transliteration: mohan sabh jee-a t ayray t oo taareh.

lines.english: Even a tiny bit of Your Mercy ends all cruelty and tyranny. You save and redeemmillions of universes. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chhuteh sangh aar nimakh  kirpaa t ay kot barahmand uDh aareh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਨ  ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I offer countless prayers; I remember You each and every instant.
lines.transliteration: karahi ardaas bahut  baynant ee nimakh  nimakh  saamaaHrahi.

lines.punjabi: ਛੁਟਿਹ  ਸੰਘਾਰ  ਿਨਮਖ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਕੋਿਟ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਉਧਾਰਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; please give me Your hand and save me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal deen d ukh bhanjan haath d ay-ay nist aareh. ||1||

lines.english: And what about these poor kings? Tell me, who can they kill?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ay bhoopat  bapuray kahee-ahi kaho ay kis no maareh.

lines.english: Save me, save me, save me, O Giver of peace; O Nanak, all the world is Yours.||2||11||34|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1211-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raakh raakh  raakh  sukh -daatay sabh  naanak jagat  tumHaarahi. ||2||11||34||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਿਨਸਤਾਰਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ab mohi Dhan paa-i-o har naamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਏ ਭੂਪਿਤ ਬਪੁਰੇ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਕਹੁ ਏ ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I have become carefree, and all my thirsty desires are satisfied. Such is the destinywritten on my forehead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay achint  tarisan sabh  bujhee hai ih likh i-o laykh  mathaamaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਤੁਮਾਰਿਹ  ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੪॥
lines.english: Searching and searching, I became depressed; I wandered all around, and finallycame back to my body-village.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat bha-i-o bairaagee fir aa-i-o d ayh giraamaa.

lines.english: The Merciful Guru made this deal, and I have obtained the priceless jewel. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal sa-udaa ih jori-o hath chari-o laal agaamaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਮੋਿਹ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: The other deals and trades which I did, brought only sorrow and suffering.
lines.transliteration: aan baapaar banaj jo karee-ah tayt ay dookh sahaamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨ  ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਿਲਿਖਓ  ਲੇਖੁ ਮਥਾਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Fearless are those traders who deal in meditation on the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, the Lord's Name is their capital. ||2||12||35|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1211-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gobid bh ajan kay nirbh ai vaapaaree har raas naanak raam naamaa. ||2||12||35||

lines.english: The Speech of my Beloved seems so sweet to my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man misat lagay pari-a bolaa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਭਇਓ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਇਓ  ਦੇਹ ਿਗਰਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has taken hold of my arm, and linked me to God's service. My Beloved Lordis forever merciful to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur baah pakar parabh sayvaa laa-ay sad  da-i-aal har dh olaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਿਲ  ਸਉਦਾ  ਇਹੁ ਜੋਿਰਓ ਹਿਥ ਚਿਰਓ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਅਗਾਮਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O God, You are my Lord and Master; You are the Cherisher of all. My wife and I aretotally Your slaves.
lines.transliteration: parabh t oo thaakur sarab part ipaalak mohi kalt ar sahit  sabh  golaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਬਾਪਾਰ  ਬਨਜ  ਜੋ ਕਰੀਅਿਹ  ਤੇਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are all my honor and power - You are. Your Name is my only Support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maan t aan sabh  toohai t oohai ik naam t ayraa mai olHaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਭਜਨ  ਕੇ ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਵਾਪਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਸ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ  ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੫॥
lines.english: If You seat me on the throne, then I am Your slave. If You make me a grass-cutter,then what can I say?
lines.transliteration: jay takh at baisaaleh t a-o daas tumHaaray gh aas badh aaveh kayt ak bolaa.

lines.english: Servant Nanak's God is the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, Unfathomable andImmeasurable. ||2||13||36|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1211-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay parabh purakh  biDhaatay mayray th aakur agah at olaa. ||2||13||36||

lines.english: The tongue becomes beautiful, uttering the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam kahat gun  sohaN.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ  ਸਦ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਢੋਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, He creates and destroys. Gazing upon His Wondrous Plays, my mind isfascinated. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayk nimakh opaa-ay samaavai d aykh charit  man mohaN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Listening to His Praises, my mind is in utter ecstasy, and my heart is rid of pride andpain.
lines.transliteration: jis suni-ai man ho-ay rahas at  ridai maan d ukh johaN.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕੁ  ਮੋਿਹ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਸਿਹਤ  ਸਿਭ ਗੋਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have found peace, and my pains have been taken away, since I became one withGod. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-o d ukh door paraa-i-o ban  aa-ee parabh  tohaN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ  ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਓਲਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Sinful resides have been wiped away, and my mind is immaculate. The Guru has liftedme up and pulled me out of the deception of Maya.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh ga-ay man nirmal ho-ee hai gur kaadh ay maa-i-aa d arohaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤਖਿਤ  ਬੈਸਾਲਿਹ  ਤਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਘਾਸੁ  ਬਢਾਵਿਹ  ਕੇਤਕ  ਬੋਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.||2||14||37|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1211-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai so parabh paa-i-aa karan  kaaran  samrathohaN. ||2||14||37||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਅਗਹ  ਅਤੋਲਾ  ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੬॥
lines.english: With my eyes, I have seen the marvellous wonders of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nainhu daykh i-o chalat  tamaasaa.

lines.english: He is far from all, and yet near to all. He is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, and yet He dwells in the heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sabh hoo d oor sabh  hoo t ay nayrai agam agam gh at vaasaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Infallible Lord never makes a mistake. He does not have to write His Orders, andHe does not have to consult with anyone.
lines.transliteration: abhool na bh oolai likh i-o na chalaavai mat aa na karai pachaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਓਪਾਇ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ਦੇਿਖ ਚਿਰਤ  ਮਨ ਮੋਹੰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In an instant, He creates, embellishes and destroys. He is the Lover of His devotees,the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khin meh saaj savaar binaahai bh agat vachh al gunt aasaa. ||1||

lines.english: Lighting the lamp in the deep dark pit, the Guru illumines and enlightens the heart. pMnw 1212
lines.transliteration: anDh koop meh d eepak bali-o gur rid ai kee-o pargaasaa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I have found peace, and all my hopes have been fulfilled. ||2||15||38|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1212-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak daras paykh  sukh  paa-i-aa sabh  pooran ho-ee aasaa. ||2||15||38||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪੇਿਖ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ  ॥੨॥੧੫॥੩੮॥
lines.english: The most beautiful path for the feet is to follow the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: charnah gobind maarag suhaavaa.

lines.english: The more you walk on any other path, the more you suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan maarag jaytaa kichh  Dhaa-ee-ai t ayto hee d ukh haavaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The eyes are sanctified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. Serving Him, the hands are sanctified.
lines.transliteration: naytar puneet  bha-ay d aras paykh ay hasat  puneet  tehlaavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਮਾਰਗ  ਜੇਤਾ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਧਾਈਐ  ਤੇਤੋ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The heart is sanctified, when the Lord abides within the heart; that forehead whichtouches the dust of the feet of the Saints is sanctified. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ridaa puneet  ridai har basi-o masat  puneet  sant Dhooraavaa. ||1||

lines.english: All treasures are in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he alone obtains it, who has itwritten in his karma.
lines.transliteration: sarab niDhaan naam har har kai jis karam likh i-aa tin paavaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੇਤਰ੍ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਭਏ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪੇਖੇ ਹਸਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਟਹਲਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; he passes his life-night in peace, poiseand pleasure. ||2||16||39|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1212-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o gur pooraa bhayti-o sukh  sehjay anad  bihaavaa. ||2||16||39||

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਦਾ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਿਰਦੈ ਹਿਰ ਬਿਸਓ  ਮਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਾਵਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhi-aa-i-o ant  baar naam sakh aa. Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; at the very last instant, it shall be yourHelp and Support.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਾਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: In that place where your mother, father, children and siblings shall be of no use toyou at all, there, the Name alone shall save you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jah maat pit aa sut  bhaa-ee na pahuchai t ahaa t ahaa t oo rakh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁ ਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਹਜੇ  ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਹਾਵਾ  ॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੯॥
lines.english: He alone meditates on the Lord in the deep dark pit of his own household, uponwhose forehead such destiny is written.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop garih meh t in simri-o jis mast ak laykh  likhaa.

lines.english: His bonds are loosened, and the Guru liberates him. He sees You, O Lord, everywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khoolHay banDh an mukat  gur keenee sabh  toohai t uhee d ikhaa. ||1||

lines.english: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, his mind is satisfied. Tasting it, histongue is satiated.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam pee-aa man t aripti-aa aagh aa-ay rasan chakh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have obtained celestial peace and poise; the Guru has quenched all mythirst. ||2||17||40|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1212-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sukh sahj mai paa-i-aa gur laahee sagal t ikhaa. ||2||17||40||

lines.english: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on God in such a way,
lines.transliteration: gur mil aisay parabhoo Dh i-aa-i-aa.

bha-i-o kirpaal d a-i-aal d ukh bhanjan lagai na t aatee baa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. that He has become kind and compassionate to me. He is the Destroyer of pain; Hedoes not allow the hot wind to even touch me. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਖੂਲੇ ਬੰਧਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਨੀ  ਸਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੁਹੀ ਿਦਖਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With each and every breath I take, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaytay saas saas ham layt ay taytay hee gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤਆ  ਆਘਾਏ  ਰਸਨ  ਚਖਾ ॥
lines.english: He is not separated from me, even for an instant, and I never forget Him. He isalways with me, wherever I go. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nimakh na bichh urai gh aree na bisrai sad  sangay jat  jaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੁ  ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਿਰ ਲਾਹੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਤਖਾ  ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੦॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His Lotus Feet. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bal bal bal bal charan kamal ka-o bal bal gur darsaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I do not care about anything else; I have found the Lord, the Ocean ofpeace. ||2||18||41|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1212-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak kaahoo parvaahaa ja-o sukh saagar mai paa-i-aa. ||2||18||41||

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad seems so sweet to my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man sabad lago gur meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਾਤੀ  ਬਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My karma has been activated, and the Divine Radiance of the Lord, Har, Har, ismanifest in each and every heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khuliHa-o karam bh a-i-o pargaasaa gh at ghat har har deeth aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, beyond birth, Self-existent, is seated within every hearteverywhere.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm aajonee sambha-o sarab thaan gh at beeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹਮ ਲੇਤੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have come to obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I ama sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lotus Feet of God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o paraapat  amrit  naamaa bal bal parabh  charn eethaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਮਖ  ਨ ਿਬਛੁਰੈ  ਘਰੀ  ਨ ਿਬਸਰੈ  ਸਦ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਤ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I anoint my forehead with the dust of the Society of the Saints; it is as if I have bathed at all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  kee rayn  mukh  laagee kee-ay sagal t irath majneeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love; the Love of my Lord shall never fade away. ||2||19||42|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1212-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak rang chalool bha-ay hai har rang na lahai majeeth aa. ||2||19||42||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has given me the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as my Companion.
lines.transliteration: har har naam dee-o gur saathay.

lines.english: If the Word of God dwells within my heart for even an instant, all my hunger isrelieved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nimakh bachan parabh  hee-arai basi-o sagal bh ookh mayree laathay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਸਬਦੁ  ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Treasure of Mercy, Master of Excellence, my Lord and Master, Ocean of peace, Lordof all.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan gun  naa-ik th aakur sukh  samooh sabh  naathay.

lines.punjabi: ਖੁਿਲਓ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My hopes rest in You alone, O my Lord and Master; hope in anything else is useless.||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk aas mohi tayree su-aamee a-or d utee-aa aas biraathay. ||1||

lines.english: My eyes were satisfied and fulfilled, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, when the Guru placed His Hand on my forehead. pMnw 1213
lines.transliteration: nain t ariptaasay d aykh darsaavaa gur kar Dh aaray mayrai maathay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੇ  ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸਾਵਾ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found immeasurable peace; my fear of birth and death is gone. ||2||20||43|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1213-2) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai atul sukh  paa-i-aa janam maran  bhai laathay. ||2||20||43||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਅਤੁਲ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ  ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੩॥
lines.english: You fool: why are you going somewhere else?
lines.transliteration: ray moorhHay aan kaahay kat  jaa-ee.

lines.english: The Enticing Ambrosial Amrit is with you, but you are deluded, totally deluded, and you eat poison. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sang manohar amrit hai ray bh ool bh ool bikh  khaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਆਨ  ਕਾਹੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: God is Beautiful, Wise and Incomparable; He is the Creator, the Architect of Destiny,but you have no love for Him.
lines.transliteration: parabh sund ar chat ur anoop biDh aatay tis si-o ruch nahee raa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਿਗ  ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਰੇ ਭੂਿਲ ਭੂਿਲ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mad-man's mind is enticed by Maya, the enticer; he has taken the intoxicatingdrug of falsehood. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mohan si-o baavar man mohi-o jhooth  thag-uree paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The Destroyer of pain has become kind and compassionate to me, and I am in tunewith the Saints.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o d a-i-aal kirpaal d ukh hartaa sant an si-o ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਅਨੂਪ ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਿਤਸ ਿਸਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained all treasures within the home of my own heart; says Nanak, my lighthas merged into the Light. ||2||21||44|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1213-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sagal niDhaan gh arai meh paa-ay kaho naanak jot  samaa-ee. ||2||21||44||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਿਨ ਿਸਉ ਬਾਵਰ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਝੂਿਠ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My consciousness has loved my Beloved God, since the very beginning of time.
lines.transliteration: o-aN pari-a pareet cheet  pahilaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਿਸਉ ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: When You blessed me with the Teachings, O my True Guru, I was embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo ta-o bachan d ee-o mayray sat gur ta-o mai saaj seegree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਘਰੈ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਏ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੪॥
lines.english: I am mistaken; You are never mistaken. I am a sinner; You are the Saving Grace ofsinners.
lines.transliteration: ham bhoolah t um sad aa abh oolaa ham pat it tum pat it uDhree-aa.

lines.english: I am a lowly thorn-tree, and You are the sandalwood tree. Please preserve my honorby staying with me; please stay with me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ham neech birakh t um mailaagar laaj sang sang basree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: You are deep and profound, calm and benevolent. What am I? Just a poor helplessbeing.
lines.transliteration: tum gambh eer Dh eer upkaaree ham ki-aa bapuray jant ree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Merciful Guru Nanak has united me with the Lord. I lay on His Bed of Peace.||2||22||45|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1213-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal naanak har mayli-o ta-o mayree sookh  sayjree-aa. ||2||22||45||

lines.english: O my mind, blessed and approved is that day,
lines.transliteration: man o-ay dinas Dh an parvaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਅਭੂਲਾ ਹਮ ਪਿਤਤ  ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: safal tay gh aree sanjog suhaavay sat gur sang gi-aanaaN. ||1|| rahaa-o. and fruitful is that hour, and lucky is that moment, when the True Guru blesses mewith spirtual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਿਬਰਖ  ਤੁਮ ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਲਾਜ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਸਰੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhan subh aag Dh an sohaagaa Dh an dayt jin maanaaN. Blessed is my good destiny, and blessed is my Husband Lord. Blessed are those upon whom honor is bestowed.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਧੀਰ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ  ਹਮ ਿਕਆ  ਬਪੁਰੇ  ਜੰਤਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: This body is Yours, all my home and wealth are Yours; I offer my heart as a sacrificeto You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ih tan t umHraa sabh  garihu Dh an tumraa heeN-u kee-o kurbaanaaN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲਓ  ਤਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੂਿਖ ਸੇਜਰੀਆ  ॥੨॥੨੨॥੪੫॥
lines.english: I obtain tens of thousands and millions of regal pleasures, if I gaze upon Your BlessedVision, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: kot laakh raaj sukh  paa-ay ik nimakh  paykh  daristaanaaN.

lines.english: When You, O God, say, "My servant, stay here with me", Nanak knows unlimited peace. ||2||23||46|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1213-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ja-o kahhu mukhahu sayvak ih baisee-ai sukh  naanak ant  na jaanaaN. ||2||23||46||

lines.english: Now I am rid of my skepticism and sorrow.
lines.transliteration: ab moro sahsaa dookh  ga-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਤੇ ਘਰੀ  ਸੰਜੋਗ  ਸੁਹਾਵੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਗਆਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have abandoned and forsaken all other efforts, and come to the Sanctuary of theTrue Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: a-or upaav sagal ti-aag chh oday sat gur saran  pa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have attained total perfection, and all my works are perfectly completed; the illnessof egotism has been totally eradicated.
lines.transliteration: sarab siDh kaaraj sabh  savray ahaN rog sagal hee kh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਸੁਭਾਗ  ਧੰਿਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ  ਧੰਿਨ ਦੇਤ ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Millions of sins are destroyed in an instant; meeting with the Guru, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot paraaDh kh in meh kh a-o bh a-ee hai gur mil har har kahi-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਸਭੁ ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਹੀਂਉ  ਕੀਓ  ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Subduing the five thieves, he Guru has made them my slaves; my mind has becomestable and steady and fearless.
lines.transliteration: panch daas gur vasgat  keenay man nihchal nirbh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਲਾਖ  ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਪੇਿਖ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟਾਨ ॥
lines.english: It does not come or go in reincarnation; it does not waver or wander anywhere. ONanak, my empire is eternal. ||2||24||47|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1213-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaavai na kat hee dolai thir naanak raaja-i-aa. ||2||24||47||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸੇਵਕ  ਇਹ ਬੈਸੀਐ  ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੨੩॥੪੬॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, God is forever my Help and Support.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayro it  ut sadaa sahaa-ee.

lines.english: He is the Enticer of my mind, the Beloved of my soul. What Glorious Praises of His canI sing and chant? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: manmohan mayray jee-a ko pi-aaro kavan kahaa gun gaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He plays with me, He fondles and caresses me. Forever and ever, He blesses me with bliss.
lines.transliteration: khayl kh ilaa-ay laad laadaavai sad aa sad aa and aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਰ  ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਛੋਡੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He cherishes me, like the father and the mother love their child. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paratipaalai baarik kee ni-aa-ee jaisay maat  pitaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant; I shall never forget Him. pMnw 1214
lines.transliteration: tis bin nimakh  nahee reh sakee-ai bisar na kabhoo jaa-ee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, joining the Society of the Saints, I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to my Lord. ||2||25||48|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1214-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mil santsangat  tay magan bh a-ay liv laa-ee. ||2||25||48||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਤੇ ਮਗਨ  ਭਏ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥੨੫॥੪੮॥
lines.english: Sing of your Lord and Master, your Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: apnaa meet su-aamee gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Do not place your hopes in anyone else; meditate on God, the Giver of peace.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aas na avar kaahoo kee keejai sukh-d aata parabh  Dhi-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Peace, joy and salvation are in His Home. Seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: sookh mangal kali-aan  jisahi gh ar tis hee sarn ee paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਨ ਅਵਰ  ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But if you forsake Him, and serve mortal beings, your honor will dissolve like salt inwater. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tiseh t i-aag maanukh  jay sayvhu t a-o laaj lon ho-ay jaa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.english: I have grasped the Anchor and Support of my Lord and Master; meeting with theGuru, I have found wisdom and understanding.
lines.transliteration: ayk ot pakree thaakur kee gur mil mat  buDh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਘਿਰ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has met God, the Treasure of Excellence; all dependence on others is gone.||2||26||49|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1214-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan naanak parabh  mili-aa sagal chukee muht aa-ee-ai. ||2||26||49||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਜ  ਲੋਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have the Almighty Support of my Dear Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ot sataan ee parabh  jee-o mayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਓਟ ਪਕਰੀ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲ  ਮਿਤ ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I do not look up to anyone else. My honor and glory are Yours, O God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darisat na li-aava-o avar kaahoo ka-o maan  mahat  parabh  tayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਚੁਕੀ  ਮੁਹਤਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥੨੬॥੪੯॥
lines.english: God has taken my side; He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the whirlpool ofcorruption.
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-o parabh apunai kaadh  lee-aa bikh  ghayrai.

lines.english: He has poured the medicine of the Naam, the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, into mymouth; I have fallen at the Guru's Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam a-ukh aDh mukh  deeno jaa-ay pa-i-aa gur pairai. ||1||

lines.english: How can I praise You with only one mouth? You are generous, even to the unworthy.
lines.transliteration: kavan upmaa kaha-o ayk mukh nirgun  kay d aatayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਨ ਿਲਆਵਉ  ਅਵਰ  ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਮਾਿਣ  ਮਹਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You cut away the noose, and now You own me; Nanak is blessed with myriad joys.||2||27||50|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1214-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaat silak ja-o apunaa keeno naanak sookh gh anayrai. ||2||27||50||

lines.english: Remembering God in meditation, pains are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: parabh simrat  dookh binaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
lines.english: When the Giver of peace to the soul becomes merciful, the mortal is totally redeemed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal jee-a sukh -daata ho-ee sagal kh alaasee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਦੀਨੋ  ਜਾਇ  ਪਇਆ  ਗੁ ਰ ਪੈਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I know of none other than God; tell me, who else should I approach?
lines.transliteration: avar na ko-oo soojhai parabh  bin kaho ko kis peh jaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਕਹਉ  ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: As You know me, so do You keep me, O my Lord and Master.I have surrenderedeverything to You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jaanhu t i-o raakh o thaakur sabh  kichh  tum hee paasee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਟ  ਿਸਲਕ  ਜਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕੀਨੋ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੈ  ॥੨॥੨੭॥੫੦॥
lines.english: God gave me His Hand and saved me; He has blessed me with eternal life.
lines.transliteration: haath day-ay raakh ay parabh  apunay sad  jeevan abh inaasee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, my mind is in ecstasy; the noose of death has been cut away from myneck. ||2||28||51|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1214-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak man anad bh a-i-aa hai kaatee jam kee faasee. ||2||28||51||

lines.english: My mind contemplates You, O Lord, all the time.
lines.transliteration: mayro man jat kat  tujheh samHaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ  ਖਲਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am Your meek and helpless child; You are God my Father. As You know me, Yousave me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham baarik deen pit aa parabh  mayray ji-o jaaneh t i-o paarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: When I am hungry, I ask for food; when I am full, I am totally at peace.
lines.transliteration: jab bhukh ou tab bh ojan maaNgai agh aa-ay sookh  sagh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਸੂਝੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੋ ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਜਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: When I dwell with You, I am free of disease; if I become separated from You, I turn to dust. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tab arog jab t um sang bast ou chh utkat ho-ay ravaarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What power does the slave of Your slave have, O Establisher and Disestablisher?
lines.transliteration: kavan basayro daas d aasan ko thaapi-o thaapanhaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: If I do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then I die. Nanak offers thisprayer. ||2||29||52|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1214-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam na bisrai tab jeevan paa-ee-ai bint ee naanak ih saarai. ||2||29||52||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹੈ ਕਾਟੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ॥੨॥੨੮॥੫੧॥
lines.english: I have shaken off fear and dread from my mind.
lines.transliteration: man tay bh ai bha-o door paraa-i-o.

lines.english: With intuitive ease, peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Kind, Sweet,Darling Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laal da-i-aal gulaal laadilay sahj sahj gun gaa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਸਮਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Practicing the Guru's Word, by His Grace, I do not wander anywhere anymore.
lines.transliteration: gur bachnaat kamaat  kirpaa t ay bahur na kat hoo Dh aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਜਉ ਜਾਨਿਹ ਿਤਉ  ਪਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The illusion has been dispelled; I am in Samaadhi, Sukh-aasan, the position of peace.I have found the Lord, the Lover of His devotees, within the home of my own heart.||1||
lines.transliteration: rahat upaaDh  samaaDh  sukh  aasan bh agat vachh al garihi paa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: | The Sound-current of the Naad, playful joys and pleasures - I am intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord.
lines.transliteration: naad binod  kod aanand aa sehjay sahj samaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਭੁਖੌ ਤਬ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਗੈ  ਅਘਾਏ  ਸੂਖ ਸਘਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Creator, the Cause of causes. Says Nanak, He Himself is All-in-all.||2||30||53|| pMnw 1215 swrg mhlw 5 ] (1215-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karnaa aap karaavan aapay kaho naanak aap aapaa-i-o. ||2||30||53||

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the mind.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam maneh aaDh aaro.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the One who gave it to me; I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin dee-aa t is kai kurbaanai gur pooray namaskaaro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My thirst is quenched, and I have been intuitively embellished. The poisons of sexualdesire and anger have been burnt away.
lines.transliteration: boojhee t arisnaa sahj suhaylaa kaam kroDh  bikh jaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਦੀਆ  ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This mind does not come and go; it abides in that place, where the Formless Lord sits.||1||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaa-ay basai ih thaahar jah aasan nirankaaro. ||1||

lines.english: The One Lord is manifest and radiant; the One Lord is hidden and mysterious. TheOne Lord is abysmal darkness.
lines.transliteration: aykai pargat aykai guptaa aykai Dh unDh ookaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਝੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਬਖੁ ਜਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: From the beginning, throughout the middle and until the end, is God. Says Nanak, reflect on the Truth. ||2||31||54|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1215-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aad maDh  ant parabh  so-ee kaho naanak saach beechaaro. ||2||31||54||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਬਸੈ ਇਹ ਠਾਹਰ  ਜਹ ਆਸਨੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without God, I cannot survive, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: bin parabh rahan na jaa-ay gh aree.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਏਕੈ ਗੁਪਤਾ  ਏਕੈ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: One who finds joy in the Lord finds total peace and perfection. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh t aahoo kai pooran jaa kai sukh  hai haree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਮਿਧ ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥੨॥੩੧॥੫੪॥
lines.english: God is the Embodiment of bliss, the Breath of Life and Wealth; remembering Him inmeditation, I am blessed with absolute bliss.
lines.transliteration: mangal roop paraan jeevan Dhan simrat  anad  ghanaa.

lines.english: He is utterly All-powerful, with me forever and ever; what tongue can utter HisGlorious Praises? ||1||
lines.transliteration: vad samrath sadaa sad  sangay gun rasnaa kavan bh anaa. ||1||

lines.english: His Place is sacred, and His Glory is sacred; sacred are those who listen and speak ofHim.
lines.transliteration: thaan pavitaraa maan pavit araa pavit ar sunan kehanhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, that dwelling is sacred, in which Your Saints live. ||2||32||55|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1215-8) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tay bh avan pavit araa jaa meh sant  tumHaaray. ||2||32||55||

lines.english: My tongue chants Your Name, Your Name.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa japtee t oohee t oohee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਗਲ  ਰੂਪ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਜੀਵਨ  ਧਨ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਅਨਦ  ਘਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the mother's womb, You sustained me, and in this mortal world, You alone help me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maat garabh  tum hee part ipaalak mit ar mandal ik t uhee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੇ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਨਾ  ਕਵਨ  ਭਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my Father, and You are my Mother; You are my Loving Friend and Sibling.
lines.transliteration: tumeh pit aa tum hee fun maat aa tumeh meet  hit bharaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ  ਮਾਨ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਸੁਨਨ  ਕਹਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Family, and You are my Support. You are the Giver of the Breath of Life.||1||
lines.transliteration: tum parvaar t umeh aaDh aaraa t umeh jee-a paraan-d aataa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਭਵਨ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ  ਜਾ ਮਿਹ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੨॥੫੫॥
lines.english: You are my Treasure, and You are my Wealth. You are my Gems and Jewels.
lines.transliteration: tumeh kh ajeenaa t umeh jareenaa t um hee maan ik laalaa.

lines.english: You are the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree. Nanak has found You through the Guru, andnow he is enraptured. ||2||33||56|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1215-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tumeh paarjaat  gur t ay paa-ay t a-o naanak bh a-ay nihaalaa. ||2||33||56||

lines.english: Wherever he goes, his consciousness turns to his own.
lines.transliteration: jaahoo kaahoo apuno hee chit aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕ  ਿਮਰ੍ਤ ਮੰਡਲ  ਇਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever is a chaylaa (a servant) goes only to his Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kaahoo ko chayro hovat th aakur hee peh jaavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He shares his sorrows, his joys and his condition only with his own.
lines.transliteration: apnay peh dookh  apunay peh sookh aa apnay hee peh birthaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਫੁਿਨ ਮਾਤਾ  ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਮੀਤ ਿਹਤ ਭਰ੍ਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He obtains honor from his own, and strength from his own; he gets an advantage from his own. ||1||
lines.transliteration: apunay peh maan apunay peh taanaa apnay hee peh arthaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਆਧਾਰਾ  ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨਦਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some have regal power, youth, wealth and property; some have a father and amother.
lines.transliteration: kin hee raaj joban Dhan milkh aa kin hee baap meht aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਖਜੀਨਾ  ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਜਰੀਨਾ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਣਕ  ਲਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained all things, O Nanak, from the Guru. My hopes have been fulfilled.||2||34||57|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1215-15) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab thok naanak gur paa-ay pooran aas hamaaree. ||2||34||57||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਪਾਰਜਾਤ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਏ ਿਨਹਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥੩੩॥੫੬॥
lines.english: False is intoxication and pride in Maya.
lines.transliteration: jhooth o maa-i-aa ko mad  maan.

lines.english: Dharoh moh d oor kar bapuray sang gopaaleh jaan. ||1|| rahaa-o. Get rid of your fraud and attachment, O wretched mortal, and remember that the Lordof the World is with you. ||1||Pause||
False are royal powers, youth, nobility, kings, rulers and aristocrats.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa raaj joban ar umray meer malak ar khaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਚੇਰੋ ਹੋਵਤ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਹੀ ਪਿਹ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: False are the fine clothes, perfumes and clever tricks; false are the foods and drinks.||1||
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa kaapar suganDh chat uraa-ee mithi-aa bh ojan paan. ||1||

lines.english: O Patron of the meek and the poor, I am the slave of Your slaves; I seek the Sanctuary of Your Saints.
lines.transliteration: deen baDh ro daas d aasro sant eh kee saaraan.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਪਿਹ ਦੂਖ ਅਪਨੇ  ਪਿਹ ਸੂਖਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਹੀ ਪਿਹ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: I humbly ask, I beg of You, please relieve my anxiety; O Lord of Life, please uniteNanak with Yourself. ||2||35||58|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1215-18) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maaNgan maaNga-o ho-ay achintaa mil naanak kay har paraan. ||2||35||58||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਪਿਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਪਿਹ ਤਾਨਾ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਹੀ ਪਿਹ ਅਰਥਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By himself, the mortal cannot accomplish anything.
lines.transliteration: apunee itnee kachh oo na saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਿਮਲਖਾ  ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: He runs around chasing all sorts of projects, engrossed in other entanglements.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik kaaj anik Dhaavrat aa urjh i-o aan janjaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਥੋਕ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ  ਆਸ ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੩੪॥੫੭॥
lines.english: His companions of these few days will not be there when he is in trouble. pMnw 1216
lines.transliteration: di-us chaar kay d eeseh sangee oohaaN naahee jah bh aaree.

lines.english: He is hand and glove with those who are of no use to him; the poor wretch is affectionately involved with them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin si-o raach maach hit  laa-i-o jo kaam nahee gaavaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਿਸਉ ਰਾਿਚ  ਮਾਿਚ  ਿਹਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ  ਜੋ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am nothing; nothing belongs to me. I have no power or control.
lines.transliteration: ha-o naahee naahee kichh mayraa naa hamro bas chaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਹਮਰੋ  ਬਸੁ ਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Creator, Cause of causes, Lord God of Nanak, I am saved and redeemed in the Society of the Saints. ||2||36||59|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1216-3) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan naanak kay parabh sant an sang uDh aaree. ||2||36||59||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਤਨ  ਸੰਿਗ ਉਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥੩੬॥੫੯॥
lines.english: The Great Enticer Maya keeps enticing, and cannot be stopped.
lines.transliteration: mohnee mohat rahai na horee.

lines.english: She is the Beloved of all the Siddhas and seekers; no one can fend her off.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  sagal kee pi-aaree t utai na kaahoo t oree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Reciting the six Shaastras and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage do not decreaseher power.
lines.transliteration: khat saast ar uchrat  rasnaagar t irath gavan na thoree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਸਗਲ  ਕੀ ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Devotional worship, ceremonial religious marks, fasting, vows and penance - none ofthese will make her release her hold. ||1||
lines.transliteration: poojaa chakar barat naym t apee-aa oohaa gail na chh oree. ||1||

lines.english: The world has fallen into the deep dark pit. O Saints, please bless me with thesupreme status of salvation.
lines.transliteration: anDh koop meh pat it hot jag sant ahu karahu param gat  moree.

lines.punjabi: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤਰ੍ ਉਚਰਤ  ਰਸਨਾਗਰ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਗਵਨ  ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has been liberated, gazingupon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||37||60|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1216-6) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  naanak bh a-i-o mukt aa darsan paykh at bhoree. ||2||37||60||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਕਰ੍ ਬਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਤਪੀਆ  ਊਹਾ ਗੈਿਲ  ਨ ਛੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Why are you working so hard to earn profits?
lines.transliteration: kahaa karahi ray khaat kh aatulee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਿਹ ਪਿਤਤ  ਹੋਤ ਜਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: You are puffed up like a bag of air, and your skin is very brittle. Your body has grownold and dusty. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pavan afaar tor chaamro at  jajree t ayree ray maatulee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ  ਭੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੭॥੬੦॥
lines.english: You move things from here to there, like the hawk swooping down on the flesh of its prey.
lines.transliteration: oohee tay hari-o oohaa lay Dh ari-o jaisay baasaa maas d ayt jhaatulee.

lines.english: You are blind - you have forgotten the Great Giver. You fill your belly like a traveller atan inn. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dayvanhaar bisaari-o anDh ulay ji-o safree ud ar bharai bahi haatulee. ||1||

lines.english: You are entangled in the taste of false pleasures and corrupt sins; the path which youhave to take is very narrow.
lines.transliteration: saad bikaar bikaar jh ooth ras jah jaano t ah bh eer baatulee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਿਨ  ਅਫਾਰ  ਤੋਰ ਚਾਮਰੋ  ਅਿਤ  ਜਜਰੀ  ਤੇਰੀ ਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak: figure it out, you ignorant fool! Today or tomorrow, the knot will be untied! ||2||38||61|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1216-10) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak samajh ray i-aanay aaj kaal kh ulHai tayree gaaNthulee. ||2||38||61||

lines.english: O Dear Guru, by associating with You, I have come to know the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur jee-o sang tuhaarai jaani-o.

lines.punjabi: ਊਹੀ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਓ  ਊਹਾ ਲੇ ਧਿਰਓ  ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸਾ  ਮਾਸ ਦੇਤ ਝਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
lines.english: There are millions of heroes, and no one pays any attention to them, but in the Court of the Lord, I am honored and respected. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot joDh u-aa kee baat  na puchh ee-ai t aaN dargeh bh ee maani-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਿਬਸਾਿਰਓ  ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਿਜਉ  ਸਫਰੀ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਬਿਹ ਹਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: What is the origin of the human beings? How beautiful they are!
lines.transliteration: kavan mool paraanee kaa kahee-ai kavan roop daristaani-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਦ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਝੂਠ ਰਸ ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਭੀਰ ਬਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
lines.english: When God infuses His Light into clay, the human body is judged to be precious. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jot pargaas bh a-ee maatee sang d ulabh  dayh bakh aani-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਝੁ  ਰੇ ਇਆਨੇ  ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਖੁਲੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਠੁਲੀ  ॥੨॥੩੮॥੬੧॥
lines.english: From You, I have learned to serve; from You, I have learned to chant and meditate; from You, I have realized the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: tum t ay sayv t um tay jap t aapaa t um tay tat pachh aani-o.

lines.english: Placing His Hand on my forehead, He has cut away the bonds which held me; ONanak, I am the slave of His slaves. ||2||39||62|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1216-14) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar mastak Dh ar katee jayvree naanak d aas d asaani-o. ||2||39||62||

lines.english: The Lord has blessed His servant with His Name.
lines.transliteration: har har dee-o sayvak ka-o naam.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜੋਧ ਉਆ  ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਐ  ਤ ਦਰਗਹ  ਭੀ ਮਾਿਨਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What can any poor mortal do to someone who has the Lord as his Savior andProtector? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maanas kaa ko bapuro bhaa-ee jaa ko raakh aa raam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He Himself is the Great Being; He Himself is the Leader. He Himself accomplishes thetasks of His servant.
lines.transliteration: aap mahaa jan aapay panchaa aap sayvak kai kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਮੂਲੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਕਾ ਕਹੀਐ  ਕਵਨ  ਰੂਪੁ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟਾਿਨਓ  ॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master destroys all demons; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapay saglay doot  bidaaray th aakur ant arjaam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ਭਈ ਮਾਟੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਦੁਲਭ  ਦੇਹ ਬਖਾਿਨਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself saves the honor of His servants; He Himself blesses them with stability.
lines.transliteration: aapay pat raakh ee sayvak kee aap kee-o banDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਸੇਵ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਜਪ ਤਾਪਾ  ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਿਨਓ  ॥
lines.english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He saves His servants. ONanak, how rare is the person who knows God. ||2||40||63|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1216-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  sayvak kee raakh ai naanak ko parabh  jaan. ||2||40||63||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਿਰ ਕਟੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਿਨਓ  ॥੨॥੩੯॥੬੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, You are my Best Friend, my Companion, my Breath of Life.
lines.transliteration: too mayray meet  sakhaa har paraan.

lines.english: My mind, wealth, body and soul are all Yours; this body is sewn together by YourBlessing. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man Dhan jee-o pind sabh  tumraa ih t an seet o tumrai Dh aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦੀਓ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.english: You have blessed me with all sorts of gifts; you have blessed me with honor andrespect.
lines.transliteration: tum hee d ee-ay anik parkaaraa t um hee d ee-ay maan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਪੁਰੋ  ਭਾਈ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਖਾ  ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, You preserve my honor, O Inner-knower, O Searcher of hearts.||1|| pMnw 1217
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa tum hee pat  raakh o antarjaamee jaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਸੰਤਨ  ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੇ ਆਏ  ਪਰਵਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those Saints who know You, O Lord and Master - blessed and approved is their coming into the world.
lines.transliteration: jin santan jaani-aa t oo thaakur t ay aa-ay parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ  ॥੨॥੪੧॥੬੪॥
lines.english: The Congregation of those humble beings is obtained by great good fortune; Nanak isa sacrifice to the Saints. ||2||41||64|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1217-2) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan kaa sang paa-ee-ai vadbhaagee naanak sant an kai kurbaan. ||2||41||64||

lines.english: Save me, O Merciful Saint!
lines.transliteration: karahu gat d a-i-aal sant ahu moree.

lines.english: You are the All-powerful Cause of causes. You have ended my separation, and joinedme with God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tum samrath kaaran karnaa t ootee t um hee joree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ  ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ  ਤੂਟੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You save us from the corruption and sins of countless incarnations; associating withYou, we obtain sublime understanding.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay bikh-ee t um taaray sumat  sang t umaarai paa-ee.

lines.english: Forgetting God, we wandered through countless incarnations; with each and everybreath, we sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik jon bharamt ay parabh  bisrat  saas saas har gaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਬਖਈ  ਤੁਮ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੁਮਾਰੈ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever meets with the Holy Saints - those sinners are sanctified.
lines.transliteration: jo jo sang milay saaDhoo kai t ay tay pat it puneet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਸਾਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, those who have such high destiny, win this invaluable human life. ||2||42||65|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1217-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jaa kay vadbhaagaa t in janam pad aarath jeet aa. ||2||42||65||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਿਤਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, Your humble servant has come to offer this prayer.
lines.transliteration: thaakur bint ee karan jan aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਜੀਤਾ  ॥੨॥੪੨॥੬੫॥
lines.english: Hearing Your Name, I am blessed with total peace, bliss, poise and pleasure.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh aanand  sahj ras sunat  tuhaaro naa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Treasure of Mercy, the Ocean of Peace - His Praises are diffused everywhere.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan sookh  kay saagar jas sabh  meh jaa ko chh aa-i-o.

lines.english: O Lord, You celebrate in the Society of the Saints; You reveal Yourself to them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsang rang t um kee-ay apnaa aap d aristaa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ  ਸਹਜ  ਰਸ ਸੁਨਤ  ਤੁਹਾਰੋ  ਨਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With my eyes I see the Saints, and dedicate myself to serving them; I wash their feetwith my hair.
lines.transliteration: nainhu sang santan kee sayvaa charan jh aaree kaysaa-i-o.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Saints;this is the peace and comfort which Nanak has received. ||2||43||66|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1217-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aath pahar d arsan sant an kaa sukh  naanak ih paa-i-o. ||2||43||66||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਸੂਖ ਕੇ ਸਾਗਰ  ਜਸੁ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਛਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: One who is lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name
lines.transliteration: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਰੰਗ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ  ਆਪੁ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sajan suridaa suhaylaa sehjay so kahee-ai badbh aagee. ||1|| rahaa-o. is a good-hearted friend, intuitively embellished with happiness. He is said to beblessed and fortunate. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਨ  ਝਾਰੀ  ਕੇਸਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: He is rid of sin and corruption, and detached from Maya; he has renounced the poisonof egotistical intellect.
lines.transliteration: rahit bikaar alap maa-i-aa t ay ahaN-buDh  bikh ti-aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੪੩॥੬੬॥
lines.english: He thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and he places his hopes in theOne Lord alone. The Feet of his Beloved are the Support of his heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daras pi-aas aas aykeh kee tayk hee-aiN pari-a paagee. ||1||

lines.english: He sleeps, wakes, rises up and sits down without anxiety; he laughs and cries withoutanxiety.
lines.transliteration: achint so-ay jaagan uth  baisan achint  hasat  bairaagee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, she who has cheated the world - that Maya is cheated by the humbleservant of the Lord. ||2||44||67|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1217-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jin jagat th agaanaa so maa-i-aa har jan th aagee. ||2||44||67||

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਨੁ ਸੁਿਰਦਾ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਬਡਭਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Now, no one complains about the Lord's humble servant.
lines.transliteration: ab jan oopar ko na pukaarai.

lines.english: Whoever tries to complain is destroyed by the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pookaaran ka-o jo udam kart aa gur parmaysar t aa ka-o maarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Whoever harbors vengeance against the One who is beyond all vengenace, shall losein the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: nirvairai sang vair rachaavai har dargeh oh haarai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਆਸ  ਏਕਿਹ  ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੀਐਂ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, it is the glorious greatnessof God, that He preserves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  parabh  kee vadi-aa-ee jan kee paij savaarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਸੋਇ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਉਿਠ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਅਿਚੰਤ  ਹਸਤ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal becomes fearless, and all his fears are taken away, when he leans on theSupport of the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o bh a-ay sagal bh a-o miti-aa charan kamal aaDh aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਠਗਾਨਾ  ਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਠਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੪੪॥੬੭॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name, through the Guru's Word, Nanak has become famous throughoutthe world. ||2||45||68|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1217-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan japi-o naa-o naanak pargat bha-i-o sansaarai. ||2||45||68||

lines.english: The Lord's humble servant has discarded all self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: har jan chhodi-aa saglaa aap.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਜਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਕੋ ਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: As You see fit, You save us, O Lord of the World. Beholding Your Glorious Grandeur, Ilive. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jaanhu ti-o rakh ahu gusaa-ee paykh  jeevaaN partaap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਕਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ਜੋ ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Instruction, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sorrow and suffering is taken away.
lines.transliteration: gur updays saaDh  kee sangat  binsi-o sagal sant aap.

lines.english: I look upon friend and enemy alike; all that I speak is the Lord's meditation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mitar sat ar paykh  samat  beechaari-o sagal sambh aakhan jaap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਵੈਰੈ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਓਹੁ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The fire within me is quenched; I am cool, calm and tranquil. Hearing the unstruckcelestial melody, I am wonder-struck and amazed.
lines.transliteration: tapat bujhee seet al aagh aanay sun anhad  bisam bh a-ay bismaad .

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am in ecstasy, O Nanak, and my mind is filled with Truth, through the perfect perfection of the Sound-current of the Naad. ||2||46||69|| pMnw 1218 swrg mhlw 5 ] (1218-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anad bh a-i-aa naanak man saachaa pooran pooray naad . ||2||46||69||

lines.english: My Guru has rid me of my cynicism.
lines.transliteration: mayrai gur moro sahsaa utaari-aa.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that Guru; I am devoted to Him, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai jaa-ee-ai balihaaree sad aa sad aa ha-o vaari-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I chant the Guru's Name day and night; I enshrine the Guru's Feet within my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa naam japi-o din raat ee gur kay charan man Dh aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਈਐ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I bathe continually in the dust of the Guru's Feet, washing off my dirty sins. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kee Dhoor kara-o nit  majan kilvikh  mail ut aari-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I continually serve the Perfect Guru; I humbly bow to my Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee kara-o nit sayvaa gur apnaa namaskaari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਓ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਮਿਨ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with all fruitful rewards; O Nanak, the Guru has emancipated me. ||2||47||70|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1218-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab falaa deenHay gur poorai naanak gur nist aari-aa. ||2||47||70||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਕਰਉ  ਿਨਤ  ਮਜਨੁ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal attainssalvation.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam paraan gat  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਉ  ਿਨਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ਨਮਸਕਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: His sorrows are dispelled, and his fears are all erased; he is in love with the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: miteh kalays taraas sabh  naasai saaDh sang hit  laavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਫਲਾ ਦੀਨੇ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁ ਿਰ ਿਨਸਤਾਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥੪੭॥੭੦॥
lines.english: His mind worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; his tongue sings thePraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har har har man aaraaDhay rasnaa har jas gaavai.

lines.english: Abandoning egotistical pride, sexual desire, anger and slander, he embraces love forthe Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan kaam kroDh  nindaa baasud ayv rang laavai. ||1||

lines.english: Worship and adore the Merciful Lord God; chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, you shall be embellished and exalted.
lines.transliteration: daamod ar da-i-aal aaraaDh ahu gobind  karat  sohaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਟਿਹ  ਕਲੇਸ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਹਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, whoever becomes the dust of all, merges in the Blesed Vision of theLord, Har, Har. ||2||48||71|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1218-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sabh kee ho-ay raynaa har har d aras samaavai. ||2||48||71||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: apunay gur pooray balihaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਆਰਾਧੇ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: My Savior Lord has saved me; He has revealed the Glory of His Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pargat partaap kee-o naam ko raakh ay raakh anhaarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He makes His servants and slaves fearless, and takes away all their pain.
lines.transliteration: nirbha-o kee-ay sayvak d aas apnay saglay d ookh bidaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਮੋਦਰ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕਰਤ  ਸਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: So renounce all other efforts, and enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your mind.||1||
lines.transliteration: aan upaav ti-aag jan saglay charan kamal rid  Dhaarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਿਸ  ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥੪੮॥੭੧॥
lines.english: God is the Support of the breath of life, my Best Friend and Companion, the One andOnly Creator of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: paraan aDhaar meet  saajan parabh  aykai aykankaarai.

lines.english: Nanak's Lord and Master is the Highest of all; again and again, I humbly bow to Him.||2||49||72|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1218-12) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch th aakur naanak kaa baar baar namaskaarai. ||2||49||72||

lines.english: Tell me: other than the Lord, who exists?
lines.transliteration: bin har hai ko kahaa bataavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪੁ  ਕੀਓ  ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Creator, the Embodiment of Mercy, bestows all comforts; meditate forever on thatGod. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh samooh karun aa mai kart aa tis parabh  sadaa Dh i-aavahu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All creatures are strung on His Thread; sing the Praises of that God.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai soot paro-ay jant aa tis parabh  kaa jas gaavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਕੀਏ ਸੇਵਕ  ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਿਬਦਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on that Lord and Master who gives you everything. Whywould you go to anyone else? ||1||
lines.transliteration: simar thaakur jin sabh  kichh  deenaa aan kahaa peh jaavhu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਜਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਰਦ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Service to my Lord and Master is fruitful and rewarding; from Him, you shall obtainthe fruits of your mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: safal sayvaa su-aamee mayray kee man baaNchhat  fal paavhu.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ  ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, take your profits and leave; you shall go to your true home in peace.||2||50||73|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1218-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak laabh laahaa lai chaalahu sukh  saytee gh ar jaavhu. ||2||50||73||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ  ॥੨॥੪੯॥੭੨॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, I have come to Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: thaakur t umH sarnaa-ee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The anxiety of my mind departed, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: utar ga-i-o mayray man kaa sansaa jab t ay darsan paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You know my condition, without my speaking. You inspire me to chant Your Name.
lines.transliteration: anbolat mayree birthaa jaanee apnaa naam japaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My pains are gone, and I am absorbed in peace, poise and bliss, singing Your GloriousPraises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dukh naath ay sukh  sahj samaa-ay anad  anad  gun gaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Taking me by the arm, You lifted me up, out of the deep dark pit of household andMaya.
lines.transliteration: baah pakar kadh leenay apunay garih anDh  koop t ay maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਿਤ ਪਰੋਏ  ਜੰਤਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has broken my bonds, and ended my separaation; He hasunited me with God. ||2||51||74|| pMnw 1219 swrg mhlw 5 ] (1219-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur banDhan kaatay bichh urat aan milaa-i-aa. ||2||51||74||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kee gat th aaNdhee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਠਢੀ  ॥
lines.english: Searching, searching the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the Holy Saints haverealized this. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  saaDh oo jan kh ojat khojat kaadh ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਕਾਢੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and Indra, I wandered around, burning up with envy.
lines.transliteration: siv biranch ar indar lok t aa meh jalt ou firi-aa.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, I became cool and calm; my pains, sorrows and doubts are gone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: simar simar su-aamee bha-ay seet al dookh darad bharam hiri-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਿਬਰੰਚ  ਅਰੁ ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਲੋਕ ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਜਲਤੌ  ਿਫਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever has been saved in the past or the present, was saved through lovingdevotional worship of the Divine Lord.
lines.transliteration: jo jo tari-o puraat an navt an bh agat bhaa-ay har d ayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ  ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਿਹਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is Nanak's prayer: O Dear God, please let me serve the humble Saints.||2||52||75|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1219-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl;
lines.transliteration: naanak kee baynantee parabh  jee-o milai sant  jan sayvaa. ||2||52||75||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤਿਰਓ  ਪੁਰਾਤਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: O my tongue, sing the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jihvay amrit gun  har gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੫੨॥੭੫॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, listen to the Lord's Sermon, and chant God'sName. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har bol kathaa sun har kee uchrahu parabh ko naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So gather in the jewel, the wealth of the Lord's Name; love God with your mind andbody.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ratan Dh an sanchahu man t an laavhu bh aa-o.

lines.english: You must realize that all other wealth is false; this alone is the true purpose of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aan bibhoot  mithi-aa kar maanhu saachaa ihai su-aa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਿਲ  ਕਥਾ ਸੁਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਉਚਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Giver of the soul, the breath of life and liberation; lovingly tune in to the Oneand Only Lord.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan mukat ko d aataa aykas si-o liv laa-o.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have entered His Sanctuary; He gives sustenance to all. ||2||53||76|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1219-8) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak taa kee sarn aa-ee d ayt sagal api-aa-o. ||2||53||76||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: I cannot do anything else.
lines.transliteration: hotee nahee kavan kachh  karnee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਿਬਭੂਤ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have taken this Support, meeting the Saints; I have entered the Sanctuary of theOne Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ihai ot paa-ee mil santeh gopaal ayk kee sarn ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਏਕਸ  ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The five wicked enemies are within this body; they lead the mortal to practice evil andcorruption.
lines.transliteration: panch dokh  chhidar i-aa t an meh bikh ai bi-aaDh  kee karn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ  ਅਿਪਆਉ ॥੨॥੫੩॥੭੬॥
lines.english: He has infinite hope, but his days are numbered, and old age is sapping his strength.||1||
lines.transliteration: aas apaar dinas gan  raakh ay garsat  jaat bal jarn ee. ||1||

lines.english: He is the Help of the helpless, the Merciful Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of all pains and fears.
lines.transliteration: anaathah naath da-i-aal sukh  saagar sarab d okh bhai harn ee.

lines.english: Slave Nanak longs for this blessing, that he may live, gazing upon the Feet of God.||2||54||77|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1219-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man baaNchhat  chitvat naanak d aas paykh  jeevaa parabh  charn ee. ||2||54||77||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੈ ਓਟ ਪਾਈ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤਹ  ਗੋਪਾਲ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, flavors are tasteless and insipid.
lines.transliteration: feekay har kay naam bin saad.

lines.english: Sing the Sweet Ambrosial Praises of the Lord's Kirtan; day and night, the Sound-current of the Naad will resonate and resound. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit ras keert an har gaa-ee-ai ahinis pooran naad . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਿਛਦਰ੍  ਇਆ  ਤਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਬਖੈ ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, total peace and bliss are obtained, and allsorrows are taken away.
lines.transliteration: simrat saaNt mahaa sukh  paa-ee-ai mit jaahi sagal bikh aad.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਅਪਾਰ ਿਦਨਸ  ਗਿਣ  ਰਾਖੇ ਗਰ੍ਸਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਬਲੁ ਜਰਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The profit of the Lord, Har, Har, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly; so load it and bring it on home. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har laabh saaDh sang paa-ee-ai gh ar lai aavhu laad . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥਹ  ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਦੋਖ ਭੈ ਹਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Highest of all, the Highest of the high; His celestial ecomony has no limit.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch ooch t ay oocho ant  nahee marjaad .

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਬਛਤ  ਿਚਤਵਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਪੇਿਖ ਜੀਵਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਚਰਣੀ  ॥੨॥੫੪॥੭੭॥
lines.english: Nanak cannot even express His Glorious Grandeur; gazing upon Him, he is wonder- struck. ||2||55||78|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1219-15) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: baran na saaka-o naanak mahimaa paykh rahay bismaad . ||2||55||78||

lines.english: The mortal came to hear and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-o sunan parhan ka-o ban ee.

lines.english: But he has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he has become attachedto other temptations. His life is totally worthless! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam visaar lageh an laalach birthaa janam paraanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗਾਈਐ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਨਾਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my unconscious mind, become conscious and figure it out; the Saints speak theUnspoken Speech of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: samajh achayt  chayt  man mayray kathee sant an akath kahaan ee.

lines.english: So gather in your profits - worship and adore the Lord within your heart; your comingand going in reincarnation shall end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: laabh laihu har rid ai aaraaDh ahu chh utkai aavan  jaanee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸਿਤ  ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਖਾਦ  ॥
lines.english: Efforts, powers and clever tricks are Yours; if You bless me with them, I repeat YourName.
lines.transliteration: udam sakat  si-aan ap tumHree deh ta naam vakh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ ਪਾਈਐ  ਘਿਰ  ਲੈ ਆਵਹੁ ਲਾਿਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They alone are devotees, and they alone are attached to devotional worship, ONanak, who are pleasing to God. ||2||56||79|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1219-19) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: say-ee bhagat  bhagat say laagay naanak jo parabh  bhaanee. ||2||56||79||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਜਾਦ  ॥
lines.english: Dhanvant  naam kay van jaaray. Those who deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are wealthy.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਪੇਿਖ ਰਹੇ ਿਬਸਮਾਦ  ॥੨॥੫੫॥੭੮॥
lines.english: So become a partner with them, and earn the wealth of the Naam. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1220
lines.transliteration: saaNjhee karahu naam Dh an kh aatahu gur kaa sabad  veechaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Abandon your deception, and go beyond vengeance; see God who is always with you.
lines.transliteration: chhodahu kapat ho-ay nirvairaa so parabh  sang nihaaray.

lines.english: Deal only in this true wealth and gather in  this true wealth, and you shall never suffer loss. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sach Dhan van jahu sach Dh an sanchahu kabhoo na aavhu haaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਨਰਵੈਰਾ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਿਨਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Eating and consuming it, it is never exhausted; God's treasures are overflowing.
lines.transliteration: khaat  kharchat  kichh  nikhutat naahee agnat  bharay bh andaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, you shall go home to the Court of the Supreme Lord God with honor andrespect. ||2||57||80|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1220-3) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sobhaa sang jaavhu paarbarahm kai d u-aaray. ||2||57||80||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਨਖੁਟਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਅਗਨਤ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear God, I am wretched and helpless!
lines.transliteration: parabh jee mohi kavan anaath bichaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਭਾ ਸੰਿਗ  ਜਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ  ॥੨॥੫੭॥੮੦॥
lines.english: From what source did you create humans? This is Your Glorious Grandeur. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kavan mool tay maanukh  kari-aa ih part aap tuhaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are the Giver of the soul and the breath of life to all; Your Infinite Glories cannotbe spoken.
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan sarab kay d aatay gun  kahay na jaahi apaaraa.

lines.english: You are the Beloved Lord of all, the Cherisher of all, the Support of all hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh kay pareet am sarab part ipaalak sarab gh ataaN aaDh aaraa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਿਰਆ  ਇਹੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ਤੁਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one knows Your state and extent. You alone created the expanse of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ko-ay na jaanai t umree gat  mit aapeh ayk pasaaraa.

lines.english: Please, give me a seat in the boat of the Holy; O Nanak, thus I shall cross over thisterrifying world-ocean, and reach the other shore. ||2||58||81|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1220-7) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDh naav baith aavahu naanak bh av saagar paar ut aaraa. ||2||58||81||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਗੁਣ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who comes to the Lord's Sanctuary is very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: aavai raam saran vadbh aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕ  ਸਰਬ  ਘਟ  ਆਧਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He knows of no other than the One Lord. He has renounced all other efforts.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aykas bin kichh hor na jaan ai avar upaav t i-aagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਤ  ਆਪਿਹ  ਏਕ ਪਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: He worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, in thought, word and deed; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds peace.
lines.transliteration: man bach karam aaraaDhai har har saaDh sang sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਵ ਬੈਠਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫੮॥੮੧॥
lines.english: He enjoys bliss and pleasure, and savors the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; he mergesintuitively into the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anad binod  akath kathaa ras saachai sahj samaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Sublime and exalted is the speech of one whom the Lord, in His Mercy makes HisOwn.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa jo apunaa keeno taa kee oot am ban ee.

lines.english: Those who are imbued with God in the state of Nirvaanaa, O Nanak, are emancipatedin the Saadh Sangat. ||2||59||82|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1220-10) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang naanak nist aree-ai jo raat ay parabh  nirbaan ee. ||2||59||82||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਿਰ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਿਤਆਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Since I grasped hold of the Sanctuary of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: jaa tay saaDh oo saran  gahee.
saaNt sahj man bh a-i-o pargaasaa birthaa kachh  na rahee. ||1|| rahaa-o. my mind is illuminated with tranquility, peace and poise, and I am rid of all my pain.||1||Pause||
