lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰ੍ਮ ਆਰਾਧੈ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please be merciful to me, O Lord, and bless me with Your Name; this is the prayer Ioffer to You.
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal naam dayh apunaa bint ee ayh kahee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have forgotten my other occupations; remembering God in meditation, I have obtained the true profit. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aan bi-uhaar bisray parabh simrat  paa-i-o laabh  sahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕੀਨੋ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: We shall merge again into the One from whom we came; He is the Essence of Being.
lines.transliteration: jah tay upji-o t ahee samaano saa-ee basat  ahee.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has eradicated my doubt; my light has merged into the Light.||2||60||83|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1220-14) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bharam gur kh o-i-o jot ee jot  samhee. ||2||60||83||

lines.english: O my tongue, sing the Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa raam ko jas gaa-o.

lines.english: Abandon all other tastes and flavors; the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, isso sublime. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan su-aad bisaar saglay bh alo naam su-aa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਮਿਨ ਭਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸਾ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart; let yourself be lovingly attuned to the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basaa-ay hirdai ayk si-o liv laa-o.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become immaculate andpure; you shall not come to be reincarnated again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  hohi nirmal bahurh  jon na aa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਿਬਨਤੀ  ਏਹ ਕਹੀ ॥
lines.english: You are the Support of the soul and the breath of life; You are the Home of the homeless.
lines.transliteration: jee-o paraan aDhaar t ayraa t oo nithaavay thaa-o.

lines.english: With each and every breath, I dwell on the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, I am forever asacrifice to Him. ||2||61||84|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1220-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saas saas samHaal har har naanak sad bal jaa-o. ||2||61||84||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੋ  ਸਾਈ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਅਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: To meditate on the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe is heaven for me.
lines.transliteration: baikunth gobind  charan nit  Dhi-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਖੋਇਓ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਹੀ ॥੨॥੬੦॥੮੩॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the treasure of liberation and theLord's Ambrosial Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mukat pad aarath saaDh oo sangat  amrit  har kaa naa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Lord God, please be kind to me, that I may hear with my ears Your Sublime andExalted Sermon.
lines.transliteration: ootam kathaa sun eejai sarvan ee ma-i-aa karahu bh agvaan.

lines.english: My cycle of coming and going is finally completed, and I have attained peace andtranquility. ||1|| pMnw 1221
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  do-oo pakh  pooran paa-ee-ai sukh  bisraam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਧਤ  ਸੋਧਤ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਰੇਸਟ  ਪੂਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Searching and searching, I have realized the essence of reality: devotional worship is the most sublime fulfillment.
lines.transliteration: soDhat  soDh at tat beechaari-o bh agat saraysat pooree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਿਧ ਊਰੀ ॥੨॥੬੨॥੮੫॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without the Name of the One Lord, all other ways are imperfect. ||2||62||85|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1221-2) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ik raam naam bin avar sagal biDh ooree. ||2||62||85||

lines.english: The True Guru is the True Giver.
lines.transliteration: saachay satguroo d aataaraa.

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my pains are dispelled. I am asacrifice to His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darsan d aykh sagal d ukh naaseh charan kamal balihaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਸਗਲ  ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਿਹ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is True, and True are the Holy Saints; the Name of the Lord issteady and stable.
lines.transliteration: sat parmaysar sat  saaDh  jan nihchal har kaa naa-o.

lines.english: So worship the Imperishable, Supreme Lord God with love, and sing His GloriousPraises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaavnee paarbarahm kee abh inaasee gun  gaa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The limits of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be found; He is the Supportof all hearts.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar mit nahee paa-ee-ai sagal gh ataa aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੀ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chant, "Waaho! Waaho!" to Him, who has no end or limitation. ||2||63||86|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1221-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu kaho taa ka-o jaa kaa ant  na paar. ||2||63||86||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਿਮਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਗਲ  ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan basay man mayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਹੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬੩॥੮੬॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places; He dwells nearby, close toall. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: poor rahi-o thaakur sabh  thaa-ee nikat basai sabh  nayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Breaking my bonds, I have lovingly tuned in to the Lord, and now the Saints arepleased with me.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t or raam liv laa-ee sat sang ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ  ਬਸੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
lines.english: This precious human life has been sanctified, and all my desires have been fulfilled.||1||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath bh a-i-o puneet aa ichh aa sagal pujaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਬਸੈ ਸਭ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my God, whoever You bless with Your Mercy - he alone sings Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o kirpaa karahu parabh mayray so har kaa jas gaavai.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to that person who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lordof the Universe, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||64||87|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1221-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gobind  gun gaavai jan naanak sad  bal jaavai. ||2||64||87||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੋਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: A person is judged to be alive, only if he sees the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevan ta-o ganee-ai har paykh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਪੁਨੀਤਾ  ਇਛਾ  ਸਗਲ  ਪੁਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please be merciful to me, O my Enticing Beloved Lord, and erase the record of mydoubts. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa pareetam manmohan for bh aram kee raykh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: By speaking and listening, tranquility and peace are not found at all. What can anyone learn without faith?
lines.transliteration: kahat sunat  kichh  saaNt na upjat  bin bisaas ki-aa saykh aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬੪॥੮੭॥
lines.english: One who renounces God and longs for another - his face is blackened with filth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabhoo t i-aag aan jo chaahat  taa kai mukh  laagai kaalaykh aa. ||1||

lines.english: One who is blessed with the wealth of our Lord and Master, the Embodiment ofPeace, does not believe in any other religious doctrine.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai raas sarab sukh su-aamee aan na maanat  bhaykhaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, one whose mind is fascinated and intoxicated with the Blessed Vision of theLord's Darshan - his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||2||65||88|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1221-12) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daras magan man mohi-o pooran arath bisaykh aa. ||2||65||88||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਫੋਿਰ ਭਰਮ  ਕੀ ਰੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: simran raam ko ik naam.

lines.english: In this way, the sins of your past mistakes shall be burnt off in an instant. It is likegiving millions in charity, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kalmal dagaDh  hohi kh in ant ar kot d aan isnaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਉਪਜਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਬਸਾਸ  ਿਕਆ  ਸੇਖ ॥
lines.english: Entangled in other affairs, the mortal suffers uselessly in sorrow. Without the Lord,wisdom is useless.
lines.transliteration: aan janjaar baritha saram ghaalat  bin har fokat gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਆਨ  ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕਾਲੇਖਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal is freed of the anguish of death and birth, meditating and vibrating on the Blissful Lord of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam maran sankat tay chh ootai jagd ees bh ajan sukh  Dhi-aan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਿਸ  ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sancutary, O Perfect Lord, Ocean of Peace. Please be merciful, and blessme with this gift.
lines.transliteration: tayree saran pooran sukh  saagar kar kirpaa d ayvhu d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਸ  ਮਗਨ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਰਥ  ਿਬਸੇਖਾ  ॥੨॥੬੫॥੮੮॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, Nanak lives; his egotistical pride hasbeen eradicated. ||2||66||89|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1221-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar simar naanak parabh jeevai binas jaa-ay abh imaan. ||2||66||89||

lines.english: Dhoorat  so-ee je Dh ur ka-o laagai. He alone is a Dhoorat, who is attached to the Primal Lord God.
He alone is a Dhurandhar, and he alone is a Basundhar, who is absorbed in thesublime essence of Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so-ee DhuranDh ar so-ee basunDh ar har ayk paraym ras paagai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਮਲ  ਦਗਧ  ਹੋਿਹ ਿਖਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕੋਿਟ ਦਾਨ  ਇਸਨਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who practices deception and does not know where true profit lies is not aDhoorat - he is a fool.
lines.transliteration: balbanch karai na jaanai laabhai so Dh oorat nahee moorhHaa.

lines.english: He abandons profitable enterprises and is involved in unprofitable ones. He does notmeditate on the Beauteous Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: su-aarath ti-aag asaarath rachi-o nah simrai parabh  roorh aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਜੰਜਾਰ  ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਘਾਲਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਫੋਕਟ  ਿਗਆਨ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is clever and wise and a religious scholar, he alone is a brave warrior, and he alone is intelligent,
lines.transliteration: so-ee chatur si-aan aa pandit  so sooraa so d aanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਭਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਿਧਆਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jin har har japi-o naanak so parvaanaa. ||2||67||90|| who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly. O Nanak, he alone is approved. ||2||67||90|| pMnw 1222 swrg mhlw 5 ] (1222-1) saarag mehlaa 5.

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is the life of the humble Saints.
lines.transliteration: har har sant janaa kee jeevan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Instead of enjoying corrupt pleasures, they drink in the Ambrosial Essence of theName of the Lord, the Ocean of Peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bikhai ras bh og amrit  sukh  saagar raam naam ras peevan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They gather up the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name, and weave it into the fabricof their mind and body.
lines.transliteration: sanchan raam naam Dhan rat naa man t an bh eetar seevan.

lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, their minds are dyed in the deep crimson color ofdevotional love; they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.||1||
lines.transliteration: har rang raaNg bha-ay man laalaa raam naam ras kh eevan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਚਿਨ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨਾ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਸੀਵਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: As the fish is immersed in water, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ji-o meenaa jal si-o urjhaano raam naam sang leevan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਰਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਲਾਲਾ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਖੀਵਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Saints are like the rainbirds; they are comforted, drinking in the drops of the Lord's Name. ||2||68||91|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1222-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sant chaat rik kee ni-aa-ee har boond  paan sukh  theevan. ||2||68||91||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਮੀਨਾ  ਜਲ ਿਸਉ ਉਰਝਾਨੋ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲੀਵਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortal is a ghost.
lines.transliteration: har kay naamheen baytaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਹਿਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਥੀਵਿਨ  ॥੨॥੬੮॥੯੧॥
lines.english: All the actions he commits are just shackles and bonds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaytaa karan karaavan t aytaa sabh  banDh an janjaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Without serving God, one who serves another wastes his time uselessly.
lines.transliteration: bin parabh sayv karat  an sayvaa birthaa kaatai kaal.

lines.english: When the Messenger of Death comes to kill you, O mortal, what will your condition bethen? ||1||
lines.transliteration: jab jam aa-ay sanghaarai paraanee t ab tumro ka-un havaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤਾ  ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨ  ਤੇਤਾ  ਸਿਭ ਬੰਧਨ  ਜੰਜਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please protect Your slave, O Eternally Merciful Lord.
lines.transliteration: raakh layho d aas apunay ka-o sad aa sad aa kirpaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, my God is the Treasure of Peace; He is the wealth and property of theSaadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||69||92|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1222-8) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukh niDh aan naanak parabh  mayraa saaDh sang Dh an maal. ||2||69||92||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ  ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਕਾਟੈ ਕਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body deal only in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man tan raam ko bi-uhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ  ਸੰਘਾਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਤਬ ਤੁਮਰੋ  ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Imbued with loving devotional worship, I sing His Glorious Praises; I am not affected by worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  gun gaavan geeDh ay pohat  nah sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਕਰਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: This is the way of life of the Holy Saint: he listens to the Kirtan, the Praises of his Lordand Master, and meditates in remembrance on Him.
lines.transliteration: sarvanee keert an simran su-aamee ih saaDh  ko aachaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥੬੯॥੯੨॥
lines.english: He implants the Lord's Lotus Feet deep within his heart; worship of the Lord is thesupport of his breath of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal asthit rid  antar poojaa paraan ko aaDh aar. ||1||

lines.english: O God, Merciful to the meek, please hear my prayer, and shower Your Blessings uponme.
lines.transliteration: parabh d een d a-i-aal sunhu baynant ee kirpaa apnee Dh aar.

lines.english: I continually chant the treasure of the Naam with my tongue; Nanak is forever asacrifice. ||2||70||93|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1222-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan uchara-o nit  rasnaa naanak sad  balihaar. ||2||70||93||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ  ਗੀਧੇ ਪੋਹਤ  ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, his intellect is shallow.
lines.transliteration: har kay naamheen mat thoree.

lines.english: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, his Lord and Master; the blind fool suffers in terrible agony. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: simrat naahi sireeDh ar thaakur milat  anDh  dukh ghoree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਣੀ  ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਇਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He does not embrace love for the Name of the Lord; he is totally attached to variousreligious robes.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam si-o pareet na laagee anik bh aykh baho joree.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ ਅਸਿਥਿਤ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: His attachments are shattered in an instant; when the pitcher is broken, the waterruns out. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tootat  baar na laagai t aa ka-o ji-o gaagar jal foree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Please bless me, that I may worship You in loving devotion. My mind is absorbed andintoxicated with Your Delicious Love.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa bhagat  ras d eejai man kh achit paraym ras kh oree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਉਚਰਉ  ਿਨਤ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੭੦॥੯੩॥
lines.english: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary; without God, there is no other at all.||2||71||94|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1222-15) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ee parabh  bin aan na horee. ||2||71||94||

lines.english: In my mind, I think about that moment,
lines.transliteration: chitva-o vaa a-osar man maahi.

ho-ay ikatar milhu sant  saajan gun  gobind  nit gaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o. when I join the Gathering of the Friendly Saints, constantly singing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Without vibrating and meditating on the Lord, whatever deeds you do will be useless.
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan jayt ay kaam karee-ah t aytay birthay jaaNhi.

lines.english: The Perfect Embodiment of Supreme Bliss is so sweet to my mind. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooran parmaanand man meeth o tis bin d oosar naahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Chanting, deep meditation, austere self-discipline, good deeds and other techniques tobeing peace - they are not equal to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam sukh  saaDh an tul na kachh oo-ai laahi.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂਟਤ  ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਿਜਉ ਗਾਗਿਰ ਜਲ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak's mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord; it is absorbed in HisLotus Feet. ||2||72||95|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1222-19) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak man bayDhi-o charnah sang samaahi. ||2||72||95||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਮਨੁ ਖਿਚਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
lines.english: My God is always with me; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh sangay ant arjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਬਨੁ ਆਨ  ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੭੧॥੯੪॥
lines.english: I find happiness in the world hereafter, and peace and pleasure in this world, meditating in remembrance on the Name of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1223
lines.transliteration: aagai kusal paachhai kh aym sookh aa simrat  naam su-aamee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is my Best Friend, my Buddy, my Companion. I sing the Glorious Praises of my Sovereign Lord King.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sakh aa har mayrai gun gopaal har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: I shall not forget Him in my heart, even for an instant; I have met with the Perfect Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bisar na jaa-ee nimakh hird ai tay poorai guroo milaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਪਾਲ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; all beings and creatures are in His Power.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa raakhay d aas apnay jee-a jant  vas jaa kai.

lines.english: One who is lovingly attuned to the One, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God, O Nanak,is rid of all fear. ||2||73||96|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1223-3) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aykaa liv pooran parmaysur bha-o nahee naanak t aa kai. ||2||73||96||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਰਾਖੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਵਿਸ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: One who has the Lord's Power on his side
lines.transliteration: jaa kai raam ko bal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਾ ਿਲਵ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੨॥੭੩॥੯੬॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooran taahoo kay d ookh na bi-aapai ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. - all his desires are fulfilled, and no pain afflicts him. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: That humble devotee is a slave of his God, who listens to Him, and so lives.
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhagat  daas nij parabh  kaa sun  jeevaaN tis so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I have made the effort to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; it is obtained only by good karma. ||1||
lines.transliteration: udam kara-o d arsan paykh an kou karam paraapat  ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਤਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਿਬਆਪੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is only by Guru's Grace that I see His Vision with my eyes which none can equal.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee darisat nihaara-o d oosar naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: Please bless Nanak with this Gift, that he may wash the Feet of the Saints, and so live. ||2||74||97|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1223-7) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daan d eh naanak apnay ka-o charan jeevaaN sant Dho-ay. ||2||74||97||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਿਨਜੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਸੁਿਣ ਜੀਵ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevat raam kay gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਰਉ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਨ  ਕੌ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please be Merciful to me, O my Loving Lord of the Universe, that I may never forgetYou. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karahu kirpaa gopaal beethulay bisar na kab hee jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mind, body, wealth and all are Yours, O my Lord and Master; there is nowhereelse for me at all.
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an sabh  tumraa su-aamee aan na d oojee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਕਉ ਚਰਨ  ਜੀਵ  ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥੭੪॥੯੭॥
lines.english: As You keep me, so do I survive; I eat and I wear whatever You give me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o too raakh ahi tiv hee rahn aa tumHraa painHai khaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I shallnever again fall into reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kai bal bal jaa-ee bahurh  na janmaa Dh aa-ay.

lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sancuary, Lord; as it pleases Your Will, so do You guide him.||2||75||98|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1223-10) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ee ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaa-ay. ||2||75||98||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਬੀਠੁਲੇ  ਿਬਸਿਰ  ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, the Naam is the most sublime peace.
lines.transliteration: man ray naam ko sukh saar.

lines.english: Other affairs of Maya are corrupt. They are nothing more than dust. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aan kaam bikaar maa-i-aa sagal deeseh chh aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਦੂਜੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal has fallen into the deep dark pit of household attachment; it is a horrible, dark hell.
lines.transliteration: garihi anDh koop pat it paraan ee narak gh or gubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਹ ਿਤਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ  ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He wanders in various incarnations, growing weary; he wanders through them againand again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik jonee bharmat  haari-o bh armat  baaraN baar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ  ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Purifier of sinners, O Lover of Your devotees, please shower Your Mercy on Yourmeek servant.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan bh agat bachh al deen kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਿਜਉ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥੭੫॥੯੮॥
lines.english: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, please save me inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||76||99|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1223-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar jorh naanak d aan maaNgai saaDh sang uDh aar. ||2||76||99||

lines.english: The Glorious Radiance of the Lord has spread out everywhere.
lines.transliteration: biraajit raam ko part aap.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The doubts of my mind and body are all erased, and I am rid of the three diseases.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aaDh bi-aaDh  upaaDh  sabh  naasee binsay t eenai t aap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਕਾਮ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਗਲ  ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My thirst is quenched, and my hopes have all been fulfilled; my sorrows and sufferings are over.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa bujh ee pooran sabh  aasaa chookay sog sant aap.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, mymind, body and soul are comforted and encouraged. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat  achut  abhinaasee man t an aat am Dh araap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ ਨਰਕ  ਘੋਰ ਗੁਬਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed, pride and envy are destroyed in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  mad matsar saaDh oo kai sang kh aap.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਹਾਿਰਓ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; O Nanak, He is our Mother andFather. ||2||77||100|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1223-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al bhai kaatanhaaray naanak kay maa-ee baap. ||2||77||100||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਛਲ  ਦੀਨ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is miserable.
lines.transliteration: aatur naam bin sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਨੁ ਮਗੈ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਾਰ  ॥੨॥੭੬॥੯੯॥
lines.english: Like a dog, its desires are never satisfied; it clings to the ashes of corruption.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taripat  na hovat  kookree aasaa it  laago bikh i-aa chh aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Administering the intoxicating drug, God Himself leads the mortals astray; they arereincarnated again and again.
lines.transliteration: paa-ay thag-uree aap bh ulaa-i-o janmat  baaro baar.

lines.english: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death makes him suffer. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kaa simran nimakh na simri-o jamkankar karat  khu-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਧ  ਿਬਆਿਧ  ਉਪਾਿਧ  ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ  ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਤੀਨੈ  ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. pMnw 1224
lines.transliteration: hohu kirpaal deen d ukh bhanjan t ayri-aa sant eh kee raavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਚੈ  ਮਨ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰ  ॥੨॥੭੮॥੧੦੧॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak asks for the Blessed Vision of God. It is the Support of his mind and body. ||2||78||101|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1224-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas d aras parabh  jaachai man t an ko aaDh aar. ||2||78||101||

lines.english: Without the Name of the Lord, the soul is polluted.
lines.transliteration: mailaa har kay naam bin jee-o.

lines.english: The True Lord God has Himself administered the intoxicating drug of corruption, andled the mortal astray. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tin parabh  saachai aap bh ulaa-i-aa bikh ai thag-uree pee-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਿਬਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ  ਪੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Wandering through millions of incarnations in countless ways, he does not findstability anywhere.
lines.transliteration: kot janam bharmat ou baho bh aaNtee thit  nahee kat hoo paa-ee.

lines.english: The faithless cynic does not intuitively meet with the Perfect True Guru; he continuescoming and going in reincarnation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur sahj na bh ayti-aa saakat  aavai jaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਮ ਭਰ੍ਮਤੌ  ਬਹੁ ਭਤੀ  ਿਥਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Please save me, O All-powerful Lord God, O Great Giver; O God, You are Inaccessible and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: raakh layho parabh  sammrith d aatay tum parabh  agam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਨ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਸਾਕਤੁ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, to cross over the terrible world-ocean, and reachthe other shore. ||2||79||102|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1224-5) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas t ayree sarn aa-ee bh avjal ut ri-o paar. ||2||79||102||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਿਮਰ੍ਥ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਤੁਮ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: To chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord is Sublime.
lines.transliteration: raman ka-o raam kay gun  baad .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਉਤਿਰਓ  ਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੯॥੧੦੨॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Transcendent LordGod; The taste of His essence is Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang Dh i-aa-ee-ai parmaysar amrit  jaa kay su-aad . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the One Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, theintoxication of Maya wears off.
lines.transliteration: simrat ayk achut  abhinaasee binsay maa-i-aa maad .

lines.punjabi: ਰਮਣ  ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਦ ॥
lines.english: One who is blessed with intuitive peace and poise, and the vibrations of the UnstruckCelestial Bani, never suffers again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sahj anad anhad  Dhun ban ee bahur na bh a-ay bikh aad. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even Brahma and his sons sing God's Praises; Sukdayv and Prahlaad sing His Praisesas well.
lines.transliteration: sankaadik barahmaad ik gaavat  gaavat  suk par-hilaad .

lines.english: Drinking in the fascinating Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime essence, Nanak meditates on the Amazing Lord. ||2||80||103|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1224-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: peevat ami-o manohar har ras jap naanak har bismaad . ||2||80||103||

lines.english: He commits many millions of sins.
lines.transliteration: keenHay paap kay baho kot.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨਦ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਭਏ ਿਬਖਾਦ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Day and night, he does not get tired of them, and he never finds release. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dinas rainee thakat  naahee kat eh naahee chh ot. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਨਕਾਿਦਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦਕ  ਗਾਵਤ  ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਕ ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦ  ॥
lines.english: He carries on his head a terrible, heavy load of sin and corruption.
lines.transliteration: mahaa bajar bikh bi-aaDh ee sir uth aa-ee pot.

lines.punjabi: ਪੀਵਤ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਮਨੋਹਰ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਪ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਸਮਾਦ  ॥੨॥੮੦॥੧੦੩॥
lines.english: In an instant, he is exposed. The Messenger of Death seizes him by his hair. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ughar ga-ee-aaN khineh bh eetar jameh garaasay jh ot. ||1||

lines.english: He is consigned to countless forms of reincarnation, into beasts, ghosts, camels anddonkeys.
lines.transliteration: pas parayt usat garDh abh anik jonee layt.

lines.english: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, O Nanak, you shall never be struck or harmed at all.||2||81||104|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1224-12) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhaj saaDh sang gobind  naanak kachh  na laagai fayt. ||2||81||104||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰੈਨੀ ਥਕਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕਤਿਹ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is so blind! He is eating loads of poison.
lines.transliteration: anDhay kh aaveh bisoo kay gataak.

lines.english: His eyes, ears and body are totally exhausted; he shall lose his breath in an instant. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nain sarvan sareer sabh huti-o saas ga-i-o t at ghaat. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Making the poor suffer, he fills his belly, but the wealth of Maya shall not go with him.
lines.transliteration: anaath ranjan  udar lay pokh eh maa-i-aa ga-ee-aa haat.

lines.punjabi: ਉਘਿਰ  ਗਈਆਂ  ਿਖਨਿਹ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਜਮਿਹ  ਗਰ੍ਾਸੇ  ਝੋਟ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Committing sinful mistakes again and again, he regrets and repents, but he can nevergive them up. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh karat  karat  pachh utaavahi kabahu na saakeh chh aaNt. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੁ ਪਰੇਤ  ਉਸਟ  ਗਰਧਭ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਨੀ ਲੇਟ ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death comes to slaughter the slanderer; he beats him on his head.
lines.transliteration: nindak jamd ootee aa-ay sangh aari-o d ayveh moond upar mataak.

lines.punjabi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਛੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਫੇਟ ॥੨॥੮੧॥੧੦੪॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he cuts himself with his own dagger, and damages his own mind.||2||82||105|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1224-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapan kataaree aapas ka-o laa-ee man apnaa keeno faat. ||2||82||105||

lines.english: The slanderer is destroyed in mid-stream.
lines.transliteration: tootee nindak kee aDh  beech.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master is the Saving Grace, the Protector of His humble servants; thosewho have turned their backs on the Guru are overtaken by death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jan kaa raakhaa aap su-aamee baymukh  ka-o aa-ay pahoochee meech. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਿਟਓ ਸਾਸੁ ਗਇਓ  ਤਤ ਘਾਟ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one listens to what he says; he is not allowed to sit anywhere.
lines.transliteration: us kaa kahi-aa ko-ay na sun-ee kahee na baisan  paavai.

lines.english: He suffers in pain here, and falls into hell hereafter. He wanders in endless reincarnations. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eehaaN dukh  aagai narak bh unchai baho jonee bh armaavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥ  ਰਞਾਿਣ  ਉਦਰੁ ਲੇ ਪੋਖਿਹ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਗਈਆ  ਹਾਿਟ  ॥
lines.english: He has become infamous across worlds and galaxies; he receives according to whathe has done.
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-i-aa kh andee barahmandee keet aa apn aa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਬਖ ਕਰਤ  ਕਰਤ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵਿਹ  ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸਾਕਿਹ  ਛਿਟ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Fearless Creator Lord; he sings His Glorious Praisesin ecstasy and bliss. ||2||83||106|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1224-19) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran nirbh a-o kart ay kee anad  mangal gun  gaa-i-aa. ||2||83||106||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਜਮਦੂਤੀ  ਆਇ  ਸੰਘਾਿਰਓ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਮੂੰਡ ਉਪਿਰ  ਮਟਾਕ  ॥
lines.english: Desire plays itself out in so many ways. pMnw 1225
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa chalat  baho parkaar.

lines.english: But it is not fulfilled at all, and in the end, it dies, exhausted. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooran hot na kat ahu baat eh ant  partee haar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਤਹੁ ਬਾਤਿਹ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਪਰਤੀ  ਹਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It does not produce tranquility, peace and poise; this is the way it works.
lines.transliteration: saaNt sookh  na sahj upjai ihai is bi-uhaar.

lines.english: He does not know what belongs to him, and to others. He burns in sexual desire and anger. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai kaam kroDh eh jaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ  ਸੂਖ ਨ ਸਹਜੁ  ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਿਬਉਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The world is enveloped by an ocean of pain; O Lord, please save Your slave!
lines.transliteration: sansaar saagar dukh  bi-aapi-o d aas layvhu t aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧਿਹ  ਜਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet; Nanak is forever and ever a sacrifice.||2||84||107|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1225-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sarnaa-ay naanak sad  sadaa balihaar. ||2||84||107||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਿਖ ਿਬਆਿਪਓ ਦਾਸ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O sinner, who taught you to sin?
lines.transliteration: ray paapee tai kavan kee mat  leen.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਸਰਣਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੮੪॥੧੦੭॥
lines.english: You do not contemplate your Lord and Master, even for an instant; it was He whogave you your body and soul. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nimakh gh aree na simar su-aamee jee-o pind jin d een. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Eating, drinking and sleeping, you are happy, but contemplating the Naam, the Nameof the Lord, you are miserable.
lines.transliteration: khaat  peevat  savant  sukh ee-aa naam simrat  kheen.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ  ਤੈ ਕਵਨ  ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਲੀਨ  ॥
lines.english: In the womb of your mother, you cried and whined like a wretch. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garabh ud ar billaat kart aa tahaaN hovat  deen. ||1||

lines.english: And now, bound by great pride and corruption, you shall wander in endlessincarnations.
lines.transliteration: mahaa maad bikaar baaDh aa anik jon bh armeen.

lines.english: You have forgotten the Lord of the Universe; what misery will be your lot now? O Nanak, peace is found by realizing the sublime state of the Lord. ||2||85||108|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1225-7) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gobind bisray kavan d ukh ganee-ah sukh  naanak har pad  cheenH. ||2||85||108||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਵਤ  ਸਵੰਤ  ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਖੀਨ ॥
lines.english: O mother, I have grasped the Protection, the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee ree charnah ot gahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਉਦਰ  ਿਬਲਲਾਟ  ਕਰਤਾ ਤਹ ਹੋਵਤ  ਦੀਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fascinated, and evil-mindedness is taken away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh  mayraa man mohi-o d urmat  jaat bahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਦ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਬਾਧਾ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਮੀਨ  ॥
lines.english: He is Unfathomable, Incomprehensible, Ex alted and High, Eternal and Imperishable; His worth cannot be appraised.
lines.transliteration: agah agaaDh ooch abh inaasee keemat  jaat na kahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਿਬਸਰੇ  ਕਵਨ  ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਿਹ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਦ ਚੀਨ ॥੨॥੮੫॥੧੦੮॥
lines.english: Gazing upon Him, gazing upon Him in the water and on the land, my mind hasblossomed forth in ecstasy. He is totally pervading and permeating all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jal thal paykh paykh  man bigsi-o poor rahi-o sarab mahee. ||1||

lines.english: Merciful to the meek, my Beloved, Enticer of my mind; meeting with the Holy, He is known.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal pareet am manmohan mil saaDh ah keeno sahee.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Nanak lives; the Messenger ofDeath cannot catch or torment him. ||2||86||109|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1225-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar simar jeevat har naanak jam kee bh eer na fahee. ||2||86||109||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਿਖ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਬਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mother, my mind is intoxicated.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee ree man mayro matvaaro.

lines.english: Gazing upon the Merciful Lord, I am filled with bliss and peace; imbued with thesublime essence of the Lord, I am intoxicated. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paykh d a-i-aal anad  sukh  pooran har ras rapi-o kh umaaro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਹ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਊਚ ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
lines.english: I have become spotless and pure, singing the Sacred Praises of the Lord; I shall neveragain be dirtied.
lines.transliteration: nirmal bha-ay oojal jas gaavat  bahur na hovat  kaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪੇਿਖ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਗਿਸਓ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My awareness is focused on the Lotus Feet of God; I have met the Infinite, SupremeBeing. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o doree raachee bhayti-o purakh  apaaro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਮਨਮੋਹਨ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਹ  ਕੀਨੋ ਸਹੀ ॥
lines.english: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything; He has lit up my lamp.
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay sarbas deenay d eepak bh a-i-o ujaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਜੀਵਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਭੀਰ ਨ ਫਹੀ ॥੨॥੮੬॥੧੦੯॥
lines.english: O Nanak, savoring the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I have become detached; mygenerations have been carried across as well. ||2||87||110|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1225-14) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rasik bairaagee kulah samoohaaN taaro. ||2||87||110||

lines.english: O mother, by meditating in remembrance on some other, the mortal dies.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee ree aan simar mar jaaNhi.

lines.english: Forsaking the Lord of the Universe, the Giver of souls, the mortal is engrossed and entangled in Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ti-aag gobid  jee-an ko d aataa maa-i-aa sang laptaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਿਖ ਦਇਆਲ  ਅਨਦ  ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਪਓ  ਖੁਮਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he walks on some other path, and fallsinto the most horrible hell.
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar chaleh an maarag narak ghor meh paahi.

lines.english: He suffers uncounted punishments, and wanders from womb to womb inreincarnation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik sajaaN-ee ganat  na aavai garbh ai garabh  bharmaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਭਏ ਊਜਲ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ  ਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: They alone are wealthy, and they alone are honorable, who are absorbed in theSanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say Dhanvant ay say pat ivantay har kee saran  samaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ ਿਸਉ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਚੀ  ਭੇਿਟਓ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਅਪਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they conquer the world; they do not come and go inreincarnation ever again. ||2||88||111|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1225-18) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naanak jag jeet i-o bahur na aavahi jaaNhi. ||2||88||111||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੀਨੇ  ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਦੀਨੇ  ਦੀਪਕ  ਭਇਓ  ਉਜਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has cut down the crooked tree of my deceit.
lines.transliteration: har kaatee kutiltaa kuth aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਿਸਕ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਕੁਲਹ  ਸਮੂਹ ਤਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੮੭॥੧੧੦॥
lines.english: The forest of doubt is burnt away in an instant, by the fire of the Lord's Name.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharam ban d ahan bh a-ay kh in bheetar raam naam parhaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and slander are gone; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have beaten them and driven them out. pMnw 1226
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh nind aa parharee-aa kaadh ay saaDh oo kai sang maar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੀਿਤਆ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is successful in this priceless human life; he shall not lose it in the gamble ever again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath gurmukh  jeeti-aa bahur na joo-ai haar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ  ਪੂਰਨ ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplate thePerfect Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar parabh  kay gun  gaavah pooran sabad  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੁਨਹ  ਪੁਨਹ  ਨਮਸਕਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੮੯॥੧੧੨॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves; over and over again, he bows in humblereverence to You. ||2||89||112|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1226-3) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daasan d aas jan t ayraa punah punah namaskaar. ||2||89||112||

lines.english: This Holy Book is the home of the Transcendent Lord God.
lines.transliteration: pothee parmaysar kaa thaan.

lines.english: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy, has the perfect knowledge of God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang gaavahi gun  gobind  pooran barahm gi-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Siddhas and seekers and all the silent sages long for the Lord, but those whomeditate on Him are rare.
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  sagal mun locheh birlay laagai Dh i-aan.

lines.english: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is merciful - all his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jisahi kirpaal ho-ay mayraa su-aamee pooran taa ko kaam. ||1||

lines.english: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, knows the whole world.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai bh ai bhanjan t is jaanai sagal jahaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: May I never forget You, even for an instant, O my Creator Lord; Nanak begs for thisblessing. ||2||90||113|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1226-6) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: khin pal bisar nahee mayray kart ay ih naanak maaNgai daan. ||2||90||113||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ  ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The rain has fallen everywhere.
lines.transliteration: voothaa sarab thaa-ee mayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਿਬਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ  ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮਗੈ  ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੯੦॥੧੧੩॥
lines.english: Singing the Lord's Praises with ecstasy and bliss, the Perfect Lord is revealed.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anad mangal gaa-o har jas pooran pargati-o nayhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: On all four sides and in the ten directions, the Lord is an ocean. There is no placewhere He does not exist.
lines.transliteration: chaar kunt dah d is jal niDh  oon thaa-o na kayhu.

lines.english: O Perfect Lord God, Ocean of Mercy, You bless all with the gift of the soul. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDh gobind  pooran jee-a d aan sabh  dayh. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ  ਗਾਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਓ  ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: True, True, True is my Lord and Master; True is the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy.
lines.transliteration: sat sat  har sat  su-aamee sat  saaDh sangayhu.

lines.english: True are those humble beings, within whom faith wells up; O Nanak, they are not deluded by doubt. ||2||91||114|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1226-9) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sat tay jan jin part eet upjee naanak nah bh armayhu. ||2||91||114||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਜਲ ਿਨਿਧ  ਊਨ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord of the Universe, You are the Support of my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: gobid jee-o t oo mayray paraan aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are my Best Friend and Companion, my Help and Support; You are my family.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sahaa-ee t um hee t oo mayro parvaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਿਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: You placed Your Hand on my forehead; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: kar mastak Dh aari-o mayrai maathai saaDh sang gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਿਜਨ ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਉਪਜੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਹ ਭਰਮੇਹੁ ॥੨॥੯੧॥੧੧੪॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, I have obtained all fruits and rewards; I meditate on the Lord's Namewith delight. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumree kirpaa t ay sabh  fal paa-ay rasak raam naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The True Guru has laid the eternal foundation; it shall never be shaken.
lines.transliteration: abichal neev Dharaa-ee sat gur kabhoo dolat  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਜੀਉ  ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak has become merciful to me, and I have been blessed with the treasure ofabsolute peace. ||2||92||115|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1226-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur naanak jab bha-ay d a-i-aaraa sarab sukh aa niDh  paaNhee. ||2||92||115||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Only the true merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, stays with you.
lines.transliteration: nibhee naam kee sach khayp.

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of wealth, and earn your profit; in the midst of corruption, remain untouched. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laabh har gun  gaa-ay niDh  Dhan bikh ai maahi alayp. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures find contentment, meditating on their God.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sagal sant okhay aapnaa parabh  Dhi-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਧਆਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The priceless jewel of infinite worth, this human life, is won, and they are notconsigned to reincarnation ever again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ratan janam apaar jeet i-o bahurh  jon na paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਚਲ  ਨੀਵ ਧਰਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਕਬਹੂ ਡੋਲਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord of the Universe shows His kindness and compassion, the mortal findsthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal d a-i-aal gobid  bha-i-aa saaDh oo sang.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਸਰਬ  ਸੁਖਾ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਹੀ  ॥੨॥੯੨॥੧੧੫॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he is imbued with the Loveof God. ||2||93||116|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1226-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har charan raas naanak paa-ee lagaa parabh si-o rang. ||2||93||116||

lines.english: O mother, I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee ree paykh rahee bismaad .

lines.english: My mind is enticed by the unstruck celestia l melody; its flavor is amazing! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anhad Dh unee mayraa man mohi-o achraj t aa kay savaad . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਭੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਧਨੁ ਿਬਖੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਅਲੇਪ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is my Mother, Father and Relative. My mind delights in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa banDh ap hai so-ee man har ko ahilaad .

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all my illusions are dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang gaa-ay gun gobind  binsi-o sabh  parmaad . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲ  ਸੰਤੋਖੇ  ਆਪਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am lovingly attached to His Lotus Feet; my doubt and fear are totally consumed.
lines.transliteration: doree lapat rahee charnah sang bharam bh ai saglay kh aad.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਜੀਿਤਓ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has taken the Support of the One Lord. He shall not wander in reincarnation ever again. ||2||94||117|| pMnw 1227 swrg mhlw 5 ] (1227-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk aDhaar naanak jan kee-aa bahur na jon bh armaad . ||2||94||117||

lines.english: O mother, I am totally intoxicated with the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee ree maatee charan  samooh.

lines.english: I know of none other than the Lord. I have totally burnt off my sense of duality.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aykas bin ha-o aan na jaan-o dut ee-aa bh aa-o sabh  looh. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: To abandon the Lord of the World, and become involved with anything else, is to fallinto the pit of corruption.
lines.transliteration: ti-aag gopaal avar jo karn aa tay bikh i-aa kay kh ooh.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਉ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ  ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਭਾਉ ਸਭ ਲੂਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind is enticed, thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. He has lifted me up and out of hell. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daras pi-aas mayraa man mohi-o kaadh ee narak t ay Dh ooh. ||1||

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met the Lord, the Giver of peace; the noise ofegotism has been stilled.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  mili-o sukh -daata binsee ha-umai hooh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਗਪਾਲ  ਅਵਰ  ਜੋ ਕਰਣਾ  ਤੇ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕੇ ਖੂਹ ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord; the forests of his mind and bodyhave blossomed forth. ||2||95||118|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1227-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam rang raatay d aas naanak ma-uli-o man t an jooh. ||2||95||118||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਕਾਢੀ  ਨਰਕ  ਤੇ ਧੂਹ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The false dealings are finished.
lines.transliteration: binsay kaach kay bi-uhaar.

lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord.This is the most excellent thing in the world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam bhaj mil saaDh sangat  ihai jag meh saar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਉਿਲਓ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੂਹ ॥੨॥੯੫॥੧੧੮॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, you shall never waver; enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord,within your heart.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  na dol kat hoo naam hird ai Dhaar.

lines.english: The boat of the Guru's Feet is found by great good fortune; it shall carry you acrossthe world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur charan bohith mili-o bhaagee ut ri-o sansaar. ||1||

lines.english: The Infinite Lord is totally permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poor rahi-o sarab naath apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਇਹੈ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, all other tastes are bitter.||2||96||119|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1227-8) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har naam amrit pee-o naanak aan ras sabh  khaar. ||2||96||119||

lines.english: You whine and cry
lines.transliteration: taa tay karan  palaah karay.

lines.punjabi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨ ਡੋਿਲ  ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bikaar moh mad maat ou simrat  naahi haray. ||1|| rahaa-o. - you are intoxicated with the great corruption of attachment and pride, but you donot remember the Lord in meditation. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ  ਬੋਿਹਥ  ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਭਾਗੀ  ਉਤਿਰਓ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy - theguilt of their minstakes is burnt away.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang japt ay naaraa-in  tin kay d okh jaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰਬ  ਨਾਥ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the body, and blessed is the birth of those who merge with God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: safal dayh Dh an o-ay janmay parabh  kai sang ralay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਨ  ਰਸ ਸਿਭ ਖਾਰ ॥੨॥੯੬॥੧੧੯॥
lines.english: The four great blessings, and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers - above allthese are the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat d asaa siDh  sabh  oopar saaDh  bhalay.

lines.english: Slave Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of the humble; attached to the hem of Hisrobe, he is saved. ||2||97||120|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1227-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas Dh oor jan baaNchhai uDh rahi laag palay. ||2||97||120||

lines.english: The Lord's humble servants yearn for the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kay jan kaaNkhee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੌ ਿਸਮਰਤ ਨਾਿਹ  ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In thought, word and deed, they long for this peace, to gaze with their eyes upon theBlessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan bachan ayhee sukh  chaahat  parabh  daras d aykheh kab aakh ee. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: You are Endless, O God, my Supreme Lord and Master; Your state cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: too bay-ant  paarbarahm su-aamee gat  tayree jaa-ay na laakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਜਪਤੇ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਜਰੇ ॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the Love of Your Lotus Feet; this is everything to me - I enshrine it deep within my being. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal pareet man bayDh i-aa kar sarbas ant ar raakh ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲ  ਦੇਹ ਧੰਿਨ ਓਇ ਜਨਮੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the humble and the Holy chant thisBani with their tongues.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan simrit  saaDh oo jan ih ban ee rasnaa bh aakhee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਅਸਟ  ਦਸਾ ਿਸਿਧ  ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, O Nanak, I am emancipated; other teachings of duality areuseless. ||2||98||121|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1227-15) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jap raam naam naanak nistaree-ai hor d utee-aa birthee saakh ee. ||2||98||121||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਧੂਿਰ ਜਨ ਬਛੈ ਉਧਰਿਹ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਪਲੇ ॥੨॥੯੭॥੧੨੦॥
lines.english: A fly! You are just a fly, created by the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maakhee raam kee t oo maakh ee.

lines.english: Wherever it stinks, you land there; you suck in the most toxic stench. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jah durganDh  tahaa t oo baiseh mahaa bikh i-aa mad  chaakh ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਕਖੀ  ॥
lines.english: You don't stay put anywhere; I have seen this with my eyes.
lines.transliteration: kiteh asthaan t oo tikan na paavahi ih biDh  daykhee aakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਬਚਿਨ  ਏਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਚਾਹਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸੁ  ਦੇਖਿਹ  ਕਬ ਆਖੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have not spared anyone, except the Saints - the Saints are on the side of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: santaa bin t ai ko-ay na chh aadi-aa sant  paray gobid  kee paakh ee. ||1||

lines.english: You have enticed all beings and creatures; no one knows You, except the Saints.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant saglay t ai mohay bin sant aa kinai na laakh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਗਿਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ  ਨ ਲਾਖੀ  ॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak is imbued with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. Focusing hisconsciousness on the Word of the Shabad, he realizes the Presence of the True Lord.||2||99||122|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1227-19) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas har keert an raat aa sabad  surat  sach saakh ee. ||2||99||122||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਕਿਰ ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਾਖੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mother, the noose of Death has been cut away.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee ree kaatee jam kee faas.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ  ਿਸਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਭਾਖੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found total peace. I remain unattached in the midst of my household. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1228
lines.transliteration: har har japat sarab sukh  paa-ay beechay garsat  udaas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He has made me His Own. The thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan wells up within me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa leenay kar apunay upjee daras pi-aas.

lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I have givenup other hopes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsang mil har gun  gaa-ay binsee d utee-aa aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਲੀਨੇ  ਕਿਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਉਪਜੀ  ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: The Saint has pulled me out of the utterly desolate wilderness, and shown me thepath.
lines.transliteration: mahaa udi-aan atvee t ay kaadh ay maarag sant  kahi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਿਬਨਸੀ  ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਆਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon His Darshan, all sins are taken away; Nanak is blessed with the jewel ofthe Lord. ||2||100||123|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1228-3) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: daykh at daras paap sabh  naasay har naanak rat an lahi-o. ||2||100||123||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਅਟਵੀ  ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ  ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਸੰਤ ਕਿਹਓ  ॥
lines.english: O mother, I am involved with the Love of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: maa-ee ree ari-o paraym kee khor.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਤ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਾਪ ਸਿਭ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਤਨੁ ਲਿਹਓ  ॥੨॥੧੦੦॥੧੨੩॥
lines.english: I am intoxicated with it. My mind has such a longing and thirst for the Blessed Vision,the Darshan of my Beauteous Lord. No one can break this. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: darsan ruchit  pi-aas man sund ar sakat  na ko-ee t or. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is my breath of life, honor, spouse, parent, child, relative, wealth -everything.
lines.transliteration: paraan maan pat pit  sut banDh ap har sarbas Dh an mor.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਈ  ਰੀ ਅਿਰਓ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Dharig sareer asat  bistaa kiram bin har jaanat  hor. ||1|| Cursed is this body of bones, this pile of maggots and manure, if it knows any other than the Lord. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨ  ਰੁਿਚਤ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਮਿਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਸਕਤ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੋਿਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, by the power ofthe karma of my past actions.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o kirpaal d een d ukh bhanjan paraa poorbalaa jor.

lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Treasure, the Ocean of Mercy; mysubservience to others is past. ||2||101||124|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1228-7) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran kirpaa niDh  saagar binsi-o aan nihor. ||2||101||124||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਪਿਤ ਿਪਤ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਿਰ ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਧਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's melody is noble and sublime.
lines.transliteration: neekee raam kee Dhun so-ay.

lines.english: The Lotus Feet of my Lord and Master are incomparably beautiful. Meditating onthem, one becomes Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal anoop su-aamee japat saaDh oo ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ  ਜੋਰ ॥
lines.english: Just by thinking of the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Lord of the World, the dirtysins are washed away.
lines.transliteration: chitvat aa gopaal d arsan kalmalaa kadh  Dho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord cuts down and weeds out the corruption of the cycle of birth and death.||1||
lines.transliteration: janam maran bikaar ankur har kaat chhaaday kh o-ay. ||1||

lines.english: How rare is that person who has such pre-ordained destiny, to find the Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraa poorab jisahi likhi-aa birlaa paa-ay ko-ay.

lines.english: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, this is Truth. ||2||102||125|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1228-10) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ravan gun  gopaal kart ay naankaa sach jo-ay. ||2||102||125||

lines.english: The intellect of one who dwells on the Name of the Lord is excellent.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam kee mat saar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਪਤ  ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who forgets the Lord and becomes involved with some other - all his showypretensions are false. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bisaar jo aan raacheh mithan sabh bisthaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Meditate, vibrate on our Lord and Master in the Company of the Holy, and your sinsshall be eradicated.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangam bh aj su-aamee paap hovat  khaar.

lines.english: When the Lord's Lotus Feet abide within the heart, the mortal is never again caught inthe cycle of death and birth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charnaarbind basaa-ay hird ai bahur janam na maar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਅੰਕੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾਿਟ ਛਾਡੇ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He showers us with His kindness and compassion; He saves and protects those whotake the Support of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: kar anugrah raakh leenay ayk naam aDh aar.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on Him, day and night, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||103||126|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1228-13) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: din rain simrat  sadaa naanak mukh  oojal d arbaar. ||2||103||126||

lines.punjabi: ਰਵਣ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਚੁ ਜੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੦੨॥੧੨੫॥
lines.english: Honored - you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: maanee tooN raam kai d ar maanee.

lines.english: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and sing the Glorious Praises of theLord; your egotistical pride will be totally dispelled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang mil har gun gaa-ay binsee sabh  abhimaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Dhaar anoograhu apnee kar leenee gurmukh  poor gi-aanee. Showering His kindness and compassion, He shall make you His Own. As Gurmukh,your spiritual wisdom shall be perfect.
All peace and all sorts of ecstasy are obtained, by meditating on the Darshan, theBlessed Vision of my Lord and Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh aanand  ghanayray th aakur d aras Dh i-aanee. ||1||

lines.english: She who dwells close to her Lord is always the pure, happy soul-bride; she is famousin the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: nikat vartan saa sad aa suhaagan d ah dis saa-ee jaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਮ  ਭਜੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਾਪ ਹੋਵਤ  ਖਾਰ ॥
lines.english: She is imbued with the Love of her Loving Beloved Lord; Nanak is a sacrifice to her.||2||104||127|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1228-16) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: pari-a rang rang ratee naaraa-in naanak t is kurbaanee. ||2||104||127||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨਾਰਿਬੰਦ  ਬਸਾਇ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਜਨਮ  ਨ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: tu-a charan aasro ees.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਨੇ  ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: You are my Best Friend and Companion; I am with You. You are our Protector, O Lordof the Universe. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumeh pachh aanoo saak t umeh sang raakh anhaar t umai jagd ees. rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਨ  ਰੈਿਨ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ  ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੧੦੩॥੧੨੬॥
lines.english: You are mine, and I am Yours; here and hereafter, You are my Saving Grace.
lines.transliteration: too hamro ham t umray kahee-ai it  ut tum hee raakh ay.

lines.english: You are Endess and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; by Guru's Grace, a few understand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too bay-ant  aprampar su-aamee gur kirpaa ko-ee laakh ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੀ  ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਮਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without being spoken, without being told, You know all, O Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: bin baknay bin kahan kahaavan antarjaamee jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ਿਬਨਸੀ  ਸਭ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One whom God unites with Himself, O Nanak, that humble being is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||105||128|| pMnw 1229 swrMg mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 5  (1229-2) saarang mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 5 Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1229-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o mayl la-ay parabh naanak say jan d argeh maanay. ||2||105||128||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੇ ॥੨॥੧੦੫॥੧੨੮॥
lines.english: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord; other actions are corrupt.
lines.transliteration: har bhaj aan karam bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰੰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Pride, attachment and desire are not quenched; the world is in the grip of death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maan moh na bujhat  tarisnaa kaal garas sansaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Eating, drinking, laughing and sleeping, life passes uselessly.
lines.transliteration: khaat  peevat  hasat  sovat  a-oDh  bitee asaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਕਾਲ  ਗਰ੍ਸ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mortal wanders in reincarnation, burning in the hellish environment of the womb;in the end, he is destroyed by death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: narak udar bh armant  jalto jameh keenee saar. ||1||

lines.english: He practices fraud, cruelty and slander against others; he sins, and washes his hands.
lines.transliteration: par daroh karat  bikaar nind aa paap rat  kar jh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਵਤ  ਹਸਤ  ਸੋਵਤ  ਅਉਧ  ਿਬਤੀ  ਅਸਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, he has no understanding; he is lost in the utter darkness ofanger and attachment. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binaa satgur boojh  naahee t am moh mahaaN anDh aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਕ  ਉਦਿਰ  ਭਰ੍ਮੰਤ  ਜਲਤੋ  ਜਮਿਹ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He takes the intoxicating drugs of cruelty and corruption, and is plundered. He is notconscious of the Creator Lord God.
lines.transliteration: bikh th ag-uree kh aa-ay mooth o chit  na sirjanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਦਰ੍ੋਹ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਪਾਪ ਰਤ ਕਰ ਝਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is hidden and unattached. The mortal is like a wild elephant,intoxicated with the wine of egotism. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gobind gupat  ho-ay rahi-o ni-aaro maat ang mat  ahaNkaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੂਝ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤਮ ਮੋਹ ਮਹ ਅੰਧਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In His Mercy, God saves His Saints; they have the Support of His Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh sant  raakh ay charan kamal aDh aar.

lines.english: With his palms pressed together, Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Primal Being, the Infinite Lord God. ||4||1||129|| swrg mhlw 5 Gru 6 pVqwl  (1229-9) saarag mehlaa 5 ghar 6 parh -taal Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Partaal: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1229-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kar jor naanak saran aa-i-o gopaal purakh apaar. ||4||1||129||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਪਤ  ਹੋਇ ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਨਆਰੋ  ਮਾਤੰਗ  ਮਿਤ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Chant His Sublime Word and His Priceless Glories.
lines.transliteration: subh bachan bol gun amol.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਅਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Why are you indulding in corrupt actions?
lines.transliteration: kinkree bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ ਜੋਿਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਆਇਓ  ਗਪਾਲ  ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੯॥
lines.english: Look at this, see and understand!
lines.transliteration: daykh  ree beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and attain the Mansion of the Lord'sPresence.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad Dh i-aa-ay mahal paa-ay.

lines.english: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, you shall totally play with Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har sang rang kartee mahaa kayl. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The world is a dream.
lines.transliteration: supan ree sansaar.

lines.english: Its expanse is false.
lines.transliteration: mithnee bisthaar.

lines.english: O my companion, why are you so enticed by the Enticer? Enshrine the Love of YourBeloved within your heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sakhee kaa-ay mohi mohilee pari-a pareet  ridai mayl. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰੰਗ ਕਰਤੀ  ਮਹਾ ਕੇਲ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is total love and affection.
lines.transliteration: sarab ree pareet pi-aar.

lines.english: God is always merciful.
lines.transliteration: parabh sad aa ree d a-i-aar.

lines.english: Others - why are you involved with others?
lines.transliteration: kaaN-ayN aan aan ruchee-ai.

lines.english: Remain involved with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har sang sang khachee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਕਾਇ ਮੋਿਹ ਮੋਿਹਲੀ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਰਦੈ ਮੇਲ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When you join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: ja-o saaDhsang paa-ay.
kaho naanak har Dhi-aa-ay. says Nanak, meditate on the Lord.

lines.english: Now, your association with death is ended. ||2||1||130|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1229-14) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ab rahay jameh mayl. ||2||1||130||

lines.english: You may make donations of gold,
lines.transliteration: kanchnaa baho dat  karaa.
bhoom d aan arap Dh araa. and give away land in charity
man anik soch pavitar karat . and purify your mind in various ways,
naahee ray naam tul man charan kamal laagay. ||1|| rahaa-o. but none of this is equal to the Lord's Name. Remain attached to the Lord's LotusFeet. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: You may recite the four Vedas with your tongue,
lines.transliteration: chaar bayd jihav bh anay.
das asat kh asat sarvan sunay. and listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the six Shaastras with your ears,
nahee tul gobid  naam Dh unay. but these are not equal to the celestial melody of the Naam, the Name of the Lord ofthe Universe.

lines.english: Remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man charan kamal laagay. ||1||

lines.english: You may observe fasts, and say your prayers, purify yourself
lines.transliteration: barat sanDh  soch chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਹੀ  ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਿਲ  ਮਨ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਲਾਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kir-aa kunt niraahaar. and do good deeds; you may go on pilgrimages everywhere and eat nothing at all.

lines.english: You may cook your food without touching anyone;
lines.transliteration: apras karat paaksaar.
nivlee karam baho bisthaar. you may make a great show of cleansing techniques,

lines.english: Dhoop d eep kart ay har naam t ul na laagay. and burn incense and devotional lamps, but none of these are equal to the Lord'sName.
O Merciful Lord, please hear the prayer of the meek and the poor.
lines.transliteration: raam da-i-aar sun d een baynt ee.

lines.english: Please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, that I may see You with myeyes. The Naam is so sweet to servant Nanak. ||2||2||131|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1229-19) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dayh d aras nain paykh a-o jan naanak naam misat laagay. ||2||2||131||

lines.english: Meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam. The Lord is your Help and Support. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1230
lines.transliteration: raam raam raam jaap ramat raam sahaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, I have abandoned sexual desire, anger andgreed. The Guru, the Lord of the World, has been kind to me, and I have realized mydestiny. ||1||
lines.transliteration: swrMg, mÚ 5) santan kai charan laagay kaam kroDh  lobh ti-aagay gur gopaal bh a-ay kirpaal labaDh apnee paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: My doubts and attachments have been dispelled, and the blinding bonds of Maya havebeen broken. My Lord and Master is pervading and permeating everywhere; no one isan enemy.
lines.transliteration: binsay bharam moh anDh  tootay maa-i-aa kay banDh  pooran sarbat ar thaakur nah ko-oo bairaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਚਰਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਿਤਆਗੇ  ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਲਬਿਧ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is totally satisfied with me; He has rid me of the pains of deathand birth. Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord. ||2||3||132|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1230-4) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: swrMg, mÚ 5) su-aamee suparsan bha-ay janam maran d okh ga-ay sant an kai charan laag naanak gun gaa-ee. ||2||3||132||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਸੇ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧ ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਹ ਕੋਊ ਬੈਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, within yourmind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har haray har mukhahu bol har haray man Dh aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ  ਭਏ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੈ ਚਰਨ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
lines.english: Hear Him with your ears, and practice devotional worship - these are good deeds, which make up for past evils.
lines.transliteration: sarvan sunan bhagat  karan anik paat ik punahcharan.

lines.english: So seek the Sanctuary of the Holy, and forget all your other habits. ||1||.
lines.transliteration: saran paran saaDhoo aan baan bisaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Love the Lord's Feet, continually and continuously - the most sacred and sanctified.
lines.transliteration: har charan pareet neet  neet paavnaa meh mahaa puneet .

lines.english: Fear is taken away from the servant of the Lord, and the dirty sins and mistakes ofthe past are burnt away.
lines.transliteration: sayvak bhai d oor karan kalimal d okh jaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਨ ਸੁਨਨ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਨ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਾਿਤਕ  ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: Those who speak are liberated, and those who listen are liberated; those who keepthe Rehit, the Code of Conduct, are not reincarnated again.
lines.transliteration: kahat mukat  sunat  mukat  rahat  janam raht ay.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the most sublime essence; Nanak contemplates the nature ofreality. ||2||4||133|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1230-8) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam raam saar bhoot  naanak t at beechaaray. ||2||4||133||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨੀਤ  ਨੀਿਤ  ਪਾਵਨਾ  ਮਿਹ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.english: I beg for devotion to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I have forsaken all otheractivities. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam bhagat  maag sant  ti-aag sagal kaamee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਭੈ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਨ  ਕਿਲਮਲ  ਦੋਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Meditate lovingly on the Lord, and sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: pareet laa-ay har Dh i-aa-ay gun gobind  sadaa gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਮੁਕਤ  ਰਹਤ  ਜਨਮ  ਰਹਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: I long for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant, O Great Giver, my Lordand Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jan kee rayn baaNchh d ainhaar su-aamee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the ultimate ecstasy, bliss, happiness, peace and tranquility. The fear is death is dispelled by meditating in remembrance on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) sarab kusal sukh bisraam aand aa aanand  naam jam kee kachh  naahi t araas simar antarjaamee.

lines.english: Only the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Lord of the Universe can destroy all thesuffering of the world.
lines.transliteration: ayk saran gobind charan sansaar sagal t aap haran.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਾਗੁ  ਸੰਤ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਸਗਲ  ਕਾਮੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the boat, O Nanak, to carry us acrossto the other side. ||2||5||134|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1230-11) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naav roop saaDhsang naanak paargaraamee. ||2||5||134||

lines.english: Gazing upon my Guru, I sing the Praises of my Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: gun laal gaava-o gur daykh ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ਗੁਨ ਗਿਬੰਦ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I escape from the five thieves, and I find the One, when I join the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: panchaa tay ayk chh ootaa ja-o saaDh sang pag ra-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਬਛੁ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nothing of the visible world shall go along with you; abandon your pride and attachment.
lines.transliteration: darisat-a-o kachh  sang na jaa-ay maan t i-aag mohaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕੁਸਲ  ਸੁਖ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ਆਨਦਾ  ਆਨੰਦ  ਨਾਮ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: Love the One Lord, and join the Saadh Sangat, and you shall be embellished andexalted. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aykai har pareet laa-ay mil saaDh sang sohaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਸਰਨ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਚਰਨ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਤਾਪ ਹਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: I have found the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence; all my hopes have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: paa-i-o hai gun niDh aan sagal aas pooree.

lines.english: Nanak's mind is in ecstasy; the Guru has shattered the impregnable fortress.||2||6||135|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1230-14) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak man anand bha-ay gur bikh am gaarah t oree. ||2||6||135||

lines.english: My mind is neutral and detached; I seek only the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man biraagaigee. khojt ee darsaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Serving the Holy Saints, I meditate on my Beloved within my heart.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sant an sayv kai pari-o hee-arai Dh i-aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਏਕੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਪਗ ਰਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Embodiment of Ecstasy, I rise to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aanand roopee paykh  kai ha-o mahal paav-ogee. ||1||
