lines.english: I work for Him; I have forsaken everything else. I seek only His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: kaam karee sabh t i-aag kai ha-o saran  par-ugee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟਉ  ਕਛੁ ਸੰਿਗ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਮਾਨੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਮੋਹਾ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my Lord and Master hugs me close in His Embrace; the Guru is pleased andsatisfied with me. ||2||7||136|| swrg mhlw 5 ] (1230-17) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak su-aamee gar milay ha-o gur manaav-ugee. ||2||7||136||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਸੋਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is my condition.
lines.transliteration: aisee ho-ay paree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇਓ  ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ  ਆਸ  ਪੂਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Only my Merciful Lord knows it. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaantay d a-i-aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਅਨੰਦ  ਭਏ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਬਖਮ  ਗਾਰ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
lines.english: I have abandoned my mother and father, and sold my mind to the Saints.
lines.transliteration: maatar pit ar ti-aag kai man sant an paahi baychaa-i-o.

lines.english: I have lost my social status, birth-right and ancestry; I sing the Glorious Praises of theLord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaat janam kul kh o-ee-ai ha-o gaava-o har haree. ||1||

lines.english: I have broken away from other people and family; I work only for God.
lines.transliteration: lok kutamb tay tootee-ai parabh  kirat kirat karee.

lines.english: The Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to serve only the One Lord. ||2||8||137|| pMnw 1231 swrg mhlw 5 ] (1231-1) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur mo ka-o updaysi-aa naanak sayv ayk haree. ||2||8||137||

lines.english: You are my Loving Beloved Enticing Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: laal laal mohan gopaal too.

lines.english: You are in worms, elephants, stones and all beings and creatures; You nourish and cherish them all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: keet hasat paakh aan jant sarab mai part ipaal t oo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are not far away; You are totally present with all.
lines.transliteration: nah door poor hajoor sangay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਿਤ ਪਾਖਾਣ  ਜੰਤ ਸਰਬ  ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ਤੂ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are Beautiful, the Source of Nectar. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sundar rasaal t oo. ||1||

lines.english: You have no caste or social class, no ancestry or family.
lines.transliteration: nah baran baran nah kulah kul.

lines.english: Nanak: God, You are Merciful. ||2||9||138|| swrg mÚ 5 ] (1231-3) saarag mehlaa 5. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parabh kirpaal t oo. ||2||9||138||

lines.english: Acting and play-acting, the mortal sinks into corruption. Even the moon and the sunare enticed and bewitched. aupjqw ibkwr duMdr nauprI Junµqkwr suMdr Aing Bwau krq iPrq ibnu gopwl Dohy ] rhwau ] (1231-4, swrMg, mÚ 5) upjataa bikaar d undar na-uparee jh unant kaar sund ar anig bh aa-o karat  firat bin gopaal Dhohay. rahaa-o. The disturbing noise of corruption wells up, in the tinkling ankle bells of Maya the beautiful. With her beguiling gestures of love, she seduces everyone except the Lord.||Pause|| qIin Bauny lptwie rhI kwc krim n jwq shI aunmq AMD DMD ricq jYsy mhw swgr hohy ]1] (1231-5, swrMg, mÚ 5) teen bh a-unay laptaa-ay rahee kaach karam na jaat  sahee unmat  anDh  DhanDh rachit jaisay mahaa saagar hohay. ||1|| Maya clings to the three worlds; those who are stuck in wrong actions cannot escapeher. Drunk and engrossed in blind worldly affairs, they are tossed about on the mightyocean. ||1|| auDry hir sMq dws kwit dInI jm kI Pws piqq pwvn nwmu jw ko ismir nwnk Ehy
lines.transliteration: karat kayl bikh ai mayl chand ar soor mohay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਬਰਨ  ਬਰਨ  ਨਹ ਕੁਲਹ  ਕੁਲ ॥
lines.english: The Saint, the slave of the Lord is saved; the noose of the Messenger of Death issnapped. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; O Nanak,remember Him in meditation. ||2||10||139||3||13||155|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (1231-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwgu swrMg mhlw 9 ] (1231-8) raag saarang mehlaa 9. Raag Saarang, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: uDhray har sant  daas kaat d eenee jam kee faas pat it paavan naam jaa ko simar naanak ohay. ||2||10||139||3||13||155||

lines.english: No one will be your help and support, except the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har bin tayro ko na sahaa-ee.

lines.english: Who has any mother, father, child or spouse? Who is anyone's brother or sister?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaaN kee maat pit aa sut  banit aa ko kaahoo ko bh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤ ਕੇਲ ਿਬਖੈ ਮੇਲ ਚੰਦਰ੍ ਸੂਰ ਮੋਹੇ ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh arnee ar sampat  sagree jo maani-o apnaa-ee. All the wealth, land and property which you consider your own

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਜਤਾ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਦੁੰਦਰ  ਨਉਪਰੀ  ਝੁਨੰਤਕਾਰ  ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਅਿਨਗ  ਭਾਉ ਕਰਤ ਿਫਰਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਧੋਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan chh ootai kachh  sang na chaalai kahaa t aahi laptaa-ee. ||1|| - when you leave your body, none of it shall go along with you. Why do you cling to them? ||1||

lines.english: God is Merciful to the meek, forever the Destroyer of fear, and yet you do not developany loving relationship with Him.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal sad aa dukh bhanjan t aa si-o ruch na badh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਿਨ  ਭਉਨੇ  ਲਪਟਾਇ  ਰਹੀ ਕਾਚ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਨ ਜਾਤ  ਸਹੀ ਉਨਮਤ  ਅੰਧ ਧੰਧ ਰਿਚਤ  ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ  ਹੋਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the whole world is totally false; it is like a dream in the night. ||2||1|| swrMg mhlw 9 ] (1231-11) saarang mehlaa 9. Saarang, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat jagat  sabh  mithi-aa ji-o supnaa rainaa-ee. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਧਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤ ਦਾਸ ਕਾਿਟ  ਦੀਨੀ  ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਓਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੩੯॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੫॥
lines.english: O mortal, why are you engrossed in corruption?
lines.transliteration: kahaa man bikhi-aa si-o laptaahee.

lines.english: No one is allowed to remain in this world; one comes, and another departs.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: yaa jag meh ko-oo rahan na paavai ik aavahi ik jaahee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Who has a body? Who has wealth and property? With whom should we fall in love?
lines.transliteration: kaaN ko tan Dh an sampat  kaaN kee kaa si-o nayhu lagaahee.

lines.english: Whatever is seen, shall all disappear, like the shade of a passing cloud. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so sagal binaasai ji-o baad ar kee chh aahee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Abandon egotism, and grasp the Sanctuary of the Saints; you shall be liberated in an instant.
lines.transliteration: taj abh imaan saran  santan gahu mukat  hohi chh in maahee.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, without meditating and vibrating on the Lord God, there is nopeace, even in dreams. ||2||2|| swrMg mhlw 9 ] (1231-15) saarang mehlaa 9. Saarang, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bhagvant  bhajan bin sukh  supnai bh ee naahee. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਨੀ  ਅਰੁ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਸਗਰੀ  ਜੋ ਮਾਿਨਓ  ਅਪਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, why have you wasted your life?
lines.transliteration: kahaa nar apno janam gavaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਚਾਲੈ  ਕਹਾ ਤਾਿਹ  ਲਪਟਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Intoxicated with Maya and its riches, involved in corrupt pleasures, you have notsought the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mad bikh i-aa ras rachi-o raam saran nahee aavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਰੁਿਚ ਨ ਬਢਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This whole world is just a dream; why does seeing it fill you with greed?
lines.transliteration: ih sansaar sagal hai supno daykh  kahaa lobh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਹਤ  ਜਗਤ  ਸਭ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਿਜਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਰੈਨਾਈ  ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: Everything that has been created will be destroyed; nothing will remain. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo upjai so sagal binaasai rahan na ko-oo paavai. ||1||

lines.english: You see this false body as true; in this way, you have placed yourself in bondage.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa tan saacho kar maani-o ih biDh  aap banDh aavai.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, he is a liberated being, whose consciousness lovingly vibrates, andmeditates on the Lord. ||2||3|| swrMg mhlw 9 ] (1231-18) saarang mehlaa 9. Saarang, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak so-oo jan muktaa raam bh ajan chit  laavai. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਯਾ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਕੋਊ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਿਕ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਇਿਕ  ਜਾਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In my mind, I never sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord. pMnw 1232
lines.transliteration: man kar kabhoo na har gun gaa-i-o.

lines.english: I remained under the influence of corruption, night and day; I did whatever I pleased. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aaskat  rahi-o nis baasur keeno apno bh aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I never listened to the Guru's Teachings; I was entangled with others' spouses.
lines.transliteration: gur updays suni-o neh kaanan par d aaraa laptaa-i-o.

lines.english: I ran all around slandering others; I was taught, but I never learned. ||1||
lines.transliteration: par nindaa kaaran baho Dh aavat  samjh i-o nah samjh aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਿਨਓ  ਨਿਹ ਕਾਨਿਨ  ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ  ਲਪਟਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: How can I even describe my actions? This is how I wasted my life.
lines.transliteration: kahaa kaha-o mai apunee karnee jih biDh janam gavaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਕਾਰਿਨ  ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਤ  ਸਮਿਝਓ  ਨਹ ਸਮਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159|| Says Nanak, I am totally filled with faults. I have come to Your Sanctuary - pleasesave me, O Lord! ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159|| rwgu swrg AstpdIAw mhlw 1 Gru 1  (1232-5) raag saarag asatpadee-aa mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Raag Saarang, Ashtapadees, First Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1232-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mÚ 9) kahi naanak sabh a-ugan mo meh raakh  layho sarnaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਕਹਉ  ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਕਰਨੀ  ਿਜਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: How can I live, O my mother?
lines.transliteration: har bin ki-o jeevaa mayree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਅਉਗਨ  ਮੋ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੩੯॥੪॥੧੫੯॥
lines.english: Hail to the Lord of the Universe. I ask to sing Your Praises; without You, O Lord, Icannot even survive. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jai jagdees t ayraa jas jaacha-o mai har bin rahan na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰਗ  ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I am thirsty, thirsty for the Lord; the soul-bride gazes upon Him all through the night.
lines.transliteration: har kee pi-aas pi-aasee kaaman daykh -a-u rain sabaa-ee.

lines.english: My mind is absorbed into the Lord, my Lord and Master. Only God knows the pain ofanother. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sareeDhar naath mayraa man leenaa parabh  jaanai peer paraa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My body suffers in pain, without the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, Ifind the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ganat  sareer peer hai har bin gur sabd ee har paaN-ee.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, please be kind and compassionate to me, that I might remain merged inYou, O Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hohu da-i-aal kirpaa kar har jee-o har si-o rahaaN samaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਿਪਆਸ  ਿਪਆਸੀ  ਕਾਮਿਨ  ਦੇਖਉ  ਰੈਿਨ ਸਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Follow such a path, O my conscious mind, that you may remain focused on the Feetof the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aisee ravat ravhu man mayray har charn ee chit  laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਨਾਥ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am wonder-struck, singing the Glorious Praises of my Fascinating Lord; I am intuitively absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bisam bha-ay gun  gaa-ay manohar nirbh a-o sahj samaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤ  ਸਰੀਿਰ  ਪੀਰ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਈ  ॥
lines.english: That heart, in which the Eternal, Unchanging Naam vibrates and resounds, does notdiminish, and cannot be evaluated.
lines.transliteration: hirdai naam sad aa Dh un nihchal gh atai na keemat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without the Name, everyone is poor; the True Guru has imparted this understanding.||4||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh ko-ee nirDh an sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੀ  ਰਵਤ  ਰਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My Beloved is my breath of life - listen, O my companion. The demons have takenpoison and died.
lines.transliteration: pareetam paraan bh a-ay sun sajnee d oot mu-ay bikh  khaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਮਨੋਹਰ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As love for Him welled up, so it remains. My mind is imbued with His Love. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jab kee upjee tab kee t aisee rangul bh a-ee man bh aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਿਨ ਿਨਹਚਲ  ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am absorbed in celestial samaadhi, lovingly attached to the Lord forever. I live bysinging the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sahj samaaDh sad aa liv har si-o jeevaaN har gun gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਿਨਰਧਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have become detached from the world.In the profound primal trance, I dwell within the home of my own inner being. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rat aa bairaagee nij gh ar taarhee laa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਿਨ ਸਜਨੀ  ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is sublimely sweet and supremely delicious; withinthe home of my own self, I understand the essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: suDh ras naam mahaa ras meeth aa nij gh ar tat gusaaN-eeN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ  ਤਬ ਕੀ ਤੈਸੀ ਰੰਗੁਲ  ਭਈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Wherever You keep my mind, there it is. This is what the Guru has taught me. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tah hee man jah hee t ai raakh i-aa aisee gurmat  paa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਸਦਾ ਿਲਵ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਜੀਵ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁ ਨ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Sanak and Sanandan, Brahma and Indra, were imbued with devotional worship, and came to be in harmony with Him.
lines.transliteration: sanak sanaad barahmaad  indraadik bhagat ratay ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਤਾੜੀ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. The Name of the Lord isglorious and great. ||8||1|| swrg mhlw 1 ] (1232-16) saarag mehlaa 1. Saarang, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har bin gharee na jeevaaN har kaa naam vadaa-ee. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਧ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਤਤੁ ਗੁਸਈਂ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, how can my mind be comforted?
lines.transliteration: har bin ki-o Dheerai man mayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਜਹ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਐਸੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The guilt and sin of millions of ages is erased, and one is released from the cycle ofreincarnation, when the Truth is implanted within. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot kalap kay dookh  binaasan saach drirh -aa-ay nibayraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨਾਿਦ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦ  ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾਿਦਕ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਤੇ ਬਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Anger is gone, egotism and attachment have been burnt away; I am imbued with Hisever-fresh Love.
lines.transliteration: kroDh nivaar jalay ha-o mamt aa paraym sad aa na-o rangee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘਰੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: Other fears are forgotten, begging at God's Door. The Immaculate Lord is myCompanion. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anbha-o bisar ga-ay parabh  jaachi-aa har nirmaa-il sangee. ||1||

lines.english: Forsaking my fickle intellect, I have found God, the Destroyer of fear; I am lovingly attuned to the One Word, the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: chanchal mat t i-aag bh a-o bh anjan paa-i-aa ayk sabad  liv laagee.

lines.english: Tasting the sublime essence of the Lord, my thirst is quenched; by great goodfortune, the Lord has united me with Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakh t arikhaa nivaaree har mayl la-ay badbh aagee. ||2||

lines.english: The empty tank has been filled to overflowing. Following the Guru's Teachings, I am enraptured with the True Lord. pMnw 1233
lines.transliteration: abhrat  sinch bh a-ay subh ar sar gurmat  saach nihaalaa.

lines.english: My mind is imbued with love for the Naam. The Immaculate Lord is merciful, from the beginning of time, and througout the ages. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man rat naam rat ay nihkayval aad  jugaad  da-i-aalaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰਿਤ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲ  ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My mind is fascinated with the Fascinating Lord. By great good fortune, I am lovinglyattuned to Him.
lines.transliteration: mohan mohi lee-aa man moraa badai bhaag liv laagee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹਿਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਲੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplating the True Lord, all the resides of sins and mistakes are wiped away. Mymind is pure and immaculate in His Love. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saach beechaar kilvikh d ukh kaatay man nirmal anraagee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਅਨਰਾਗੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: God is the Deep and Unfathomable Ocean, the Source of all jewels; no other is worthyof worship.
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer saagar rat naagar avar nahee an poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਰਤਨਾਗਰ  ਅਵਰ  ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.english: I contemplate the Shabad, the Destroyer of doubt and fear; I do not know any other at all. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabad beechaar bh aram bh a-o bh anjan avar na jaani-aa d oojaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਦੂਜਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Subduing my mind, I have realized the pure status; I am totally imbued with thesublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa maar nirmal pad cheeni-aa har ras rat ay aDh ikaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਪਦੁ ਚੀਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਰਤੇ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I do not know any other except the Lord. The True Guru has imparted thisunderstanding. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aykas bin mai avar na jaanaaN satgur boojh  bujhaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸ  ਿਬਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Unmastered and Unborn; through the Guru'sTeachings, I know the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar anaath ajonee gurmat ayko jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ  ਅਜੋਨੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਏਕੋ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Filled to overflowing, my consciousness does not waver; through the Mind, my mind ispleased and appeased. ||7||
lines.transliteration: subhar bh aray naahee chit  dolai man hee t ay man maani-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭਰ  ਭਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਡੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken; I speak what He makes me speak.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee aktha-o kathee-ai kaha-o kahaavai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਅਕਥਉ  ਕਥੀਐ  ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my Lord is Merciful to the meek; I do not know any other at all. ||8||2|| swrg mhlw 3 AstpdIAw Gru 1  (1233-8) saarag mehlaa 3 asatpadee-aa gh ar 1 Saarang, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1233-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak deen d a-i-aal hamaaray avar na jaani-aa ko-ee. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is glorious and great.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har kai naam vadaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: I know of none, other than the Lord; through the Lord's Name, I have attainedliberation and emancipation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bin avar na jaanaa ko-ee har kai naam mukat  gat paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly attuned to the Lord, the Destroyer offear, the Destroyer of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: sabad bh a-o bh anjan jamkaal nikh anjan har sayt ee liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਕੋਈ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have realized the Lord, the Giver of peace; I remain intuitivelyabsorbed in Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har sukh-d aata gurmukh  jaataa sehjay rahi-aa samaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The Immaculate Name of the Lord is the food of His devotees; they wear the glory ofdevotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aaN kaa bh ojan har naam niranjan painHan bhagat badaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਮਕਾਲ  ਿਨਖੰਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They abide in the home of their inner beings, and they serve the Lord forever; theyare honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa sad aa har sayvan har d ar sobh aa paa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is false; his mind wavers and wobbles, andhe cannot speak the Unspoken Speech.
lines.transliteration: manmukh buDh  kaachee manoo-aa dolai akath na kathai kahaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Eternal Unchanging Lord abides within the mind;the True Word of His Bani is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmat nihchal har man vasi-aa amrit  saachee baanee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ ਵਾਸਾ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Shabad calms the turbulent waves of the mind; the tongue is intuively imbued with peace.
lines.transliteration: man kay tarang sabad  nivaaray rasnaa sahj subh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੁਿਧ ਕਾਚੀ  ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਅਕਥੁ  ਨ ਕਥੈ ਕਹਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: So remain united forever with your True Guru, who is lovingly attuned to the Lord.||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur mil rahee-ai sad  apunay jin har sayt ee liv laa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਨੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If the mortal dies in the Shabad, then he is liberated; he focuses his consciousness onthe Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: man sabad marai t aa mukt o hovai har charn ee chit  laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਤਰੰਗ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਨਵਾਰੇ ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is an Ocean; His Water is Forever Pure. Whoever bathes in it is intuitivelyimbued with peace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: har sar saagar sadaa jal nirmal naavai sahj subh aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਸਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who contemplate the Shabad are forever imbued with His Love; their egotismand desires are subdued.
lines.transliteration: sabad veechaar sad aa rang raat ay ha-umai t arisnaa maaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੋ  ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Pure, Unattached Lord permeates their inner beings; the Lord, the Supreme Soul,is pervading all. ||6||
lines.transliteration: antar nihkayval har ravi-aa sabh  aatam raam muraaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਨਾਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Your humble servants serve You, O Lord; those who are imbued with the Truth arepleasing to Your Mind.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sayv rahay sach raatay jo t ayrai man bh aanay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are involved in duality do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence;caught in the false nature of the world, they do not discriminate between merits anddemerits. ||7||
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa mahal na paavai jag jh oothee gun  avgan  na pachh aanay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਵਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: When the Lord merges us into Himself, we speak the Unspoken Speech; True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: aapay mayl la-ay akath kathee-ai sach sabad sach ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਸੇਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the true people are absorbed in the Truth; they chant the Name of the Lord.||8||1|| swrg mhlw 3 ] (1233-19) saarag mehlaa 3. Saarang, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay sach samaanay har kaa naam vakh aanee. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਗ  ਝੂਠੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ  ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is supremely sweet. pMnw 1234
lines.transliteration: man mayray har kaa naam at meeth aa.

lines.english: It is the Destroyer of the sins, the guilt and fears of countless incarnations; the Gurmukh sees the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilvikh bh a-o bh anjan gurmukh  ayko deeth aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Millions upon millions of sins are erased, when the mind comes to love the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: kot kotantar kay paap binaasan har saachaa man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I do not know any other, except the Lord; the True Guru has revealed the One Lord to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har bin avar na soojhai d oojaa sat gur ayk bujh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ  ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਿਬਨਾਸਨ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Love, remain intuitivelyabsorbed in Him.
lines.transliteration: paraym padaarath jin gh at vasi-aa sehjay rahay samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Shabad, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. They are imbued with the Lord's celestial peace and poise. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay say rang chaloolay raat ay sahj subh aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਿਜਨ ਘਿਟ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Shabad, the tongue is imbued with joy; embracing His Love, it isdyed a deep crimson.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa sabad veechaar ras raat ee laal bh a-ee rang laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੇ  ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I have come to know the Name of the Pure Detached Lord; my mind is satisfied andcomforted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam naam nihkayval jaani-aa man t aripti-aa saaNt aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਰਿਸ ਰਾਤੀ  ਲਾਲ  ਭਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and study, and all the silent sages havegrown weary; they have grown weary of wearing their religious robes and wanderingall around.
lines.transliteration: pandit parhH parhH monee sabh  thaakay bh aram bh aykh thakay bh aykh-Dhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਹਕੇਵਲੁ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤਆ  ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I contemplate the True Word ofthe Shabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad niranjan paa-i-aa saachai sabad  veechaaree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਮੋਨੀ ਸਿਭ ਥਾਕੇ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended, and I am imbued with Truth; the TrueWord of the Shabad is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on nivaar sach raat ay saach sabad  man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is found, and self-conceit is eliminated fromwithin. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  paa-ee-ai jin vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਾ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਸਿਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the celestial melody wells up, and the mind islovingly focused on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad sahj Dh un upjai man saachai liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord, abides in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||6||
lines.transliteration: agam agochar naam niranjan gurmukh man vasaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਹਜ ਧੁਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ  ਮਿਨ ਸਾਚੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The whole world is contained in the One Lord. How rare are those who understandthe One Lord.
lines.transliteration: aykas meh sabh jagt o vart ai virlaa ayk pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: One who dies in the Shabad comes to know everything; night and day, he realizes theOne Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sabad marai t aa sabh  kichh  soojh ai an-d in ayko jaan ai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸ ਮਿਹ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੋ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, understands.Nothing else can be said.
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so-ee jan boojh ai hor kahn aa kathan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are forever detached from the world;they are lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad. ||8||2|| swrg mhlw 3 ] (1234-11) saarag mehlaa 3. Saarang, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sad aa bairaagee ayk sabad  liv laa-ee. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, the Speech of the Lord is unspoken.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har kee akath kahaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਏਕ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: That humble being who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains it. How rareis that Gurmukh who understands. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har nadar karay so-ee jan paa-ay gurmukh  virlai jaan ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord is Deep, Profound and Unfathomable, the Ocean of Excellence; He is realized through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har gahir gambheer gun ee gaheer gur kai sabad  pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Mortals do their deeds in all sorts of ways, in the love of duality; but without theShabad, they are insane. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baho biDh karam karahi bh aa-ay d oojai bin sabd ai ba-uraani-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਵਰਲੈ  ਜਾਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: That humble being who bathes in the Lord's Name becomes immaculate; he neverbecomes polluted again.
lines.transliteration: har naam naavai so-ee jan nirmal fir mailaa mool na ho-ee.

lines.english: Without the Name, the whole world is polluted; wandering in duality, it loses itshonor. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag hai mailaa d oojai bh aram pat  kho-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਪਛਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: What should I grasp? What should I gather up or leave behind? I do not know.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa darirh -aaN ki-aa sangrahi t i-aagee mai t aa boojh  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਭਾਇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਬਉਰਾਿਨਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, Your Name is the Help and Support of those whom You bless with Yourkindness and compassion. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hohi da-i-aal kirpaa kar har jee-o naamo ho-ay sakh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਫਿਰ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The True Lord is the True Giver, the Architect of Destiny; as He pleases, He linksmortals to the Name.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sach daat aa karam biDh aataa jis bh aavai t is naa-ay laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਮੈਲਾ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone comes to understand, who enters the Guru's Gate, whom the Lord Himselfinstructs. ||4||
lines.transliteration: guroo du-aarai so-ee boojh ai jis no aap bujh aa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜ  ਿਕਆ  ਸੰਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਿਤਆਗੀ  ਮੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Even gazing upon the wonders of the Lord, this mind does not think of Him. The world comes and goes in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: daykh  bismaad  ih man nahee chayt ay aavaa ga-on  sansaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the mortal comes to understand, and finds the Door ofSalvation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay so-ee boojh ai paa-ay mokh  du-aaraa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਧਾਤਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਇ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who understand the Lord's Court, never suffer separation from him. The TrueGuru has imparted this understanding.
lines.transliteration: jinH dar soojh ai say kad ay na vigaarh eh sat gur boojh  bujhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: They practice truth, self-restraint and good deeds; their comings and goings areended. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam karnee kirat  kamaaveh aavan  jaan rahaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਿਬਸਮਾਦੁ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤੇ ਆਵਾ  ਗਉਣੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the Court of the True Lord, they practice Truth. The Gurmukhs take the Support of the True Lord. pMnw 1235
lines.transliteration: say dar saachai saach kamaaveh jin gurmukh  saach aDh aaraa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander, lost in doubt and duality. They do not know how to contemplate the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: manmukh d oojai bh aram bh ulaa-ay naa boojh eh veechaaraa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਨਾ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਵੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself gives; He Himself creates and beholds.
lines.transliteration: aapay gurmukh aapay d ayvai aapay kar kar vaykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings are approved, whose honor the Lord Himself accepts. ||8||3|| swrg mhlw 5 AstpdIAw Gru 1  (1235-3) saarag mehlaa 5 asatpadee-aa gh ar 1 Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1235-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak say jan thaa-ay pa-ay hai jin kee pat paavai laykh ai. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਥਾਇ  ਪਏ ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord of the World, I gaze upon Your wondrous glory.
lines.transliteration: gusaa-eeN partaap t uhaaro deeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Creator and Destroyer. You are theSovereign Lord of all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan upaa-ay samaavan sagal chhat arpat beeth aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The rulers and nobles and kings shall become beggars. Their ostentatious shows arefalse
lines.transliteration: raanaa raa-o raaj bh a-ay rankaa un jh oothay kahan  kahaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਕਰਾਵਨ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਸਮਾਵਨ  ਸਗਲ  ਛਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਬੀਠਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: . My Sovereign Lord King is eternally stable. His Praises are sung in every heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hamraa raajan sadaa salaamat  taa ko sagal gh ataa jas gaa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: Listen to the Praises of my Lord King, O Saints. I chant them as best I can.
lines.transliteration: upmaa sunhu raajan kee santahu kahat  jayt paahoochaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਣਾ  ਰਾਉ ਰਾਜ ਭਏ ਰੰਕਾ ਉਿਨ  ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਣੁ  ਕਹਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord King, the Great Giver, is Immeasurable. He is the Highest of the high. ||2||
lines.transliteration: baysumaar vad saah daat aaraa oochay hee t ay oochaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰਾ  ਰਾਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਿਤ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ  ਘਟਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He has strung His Breath throughout the creation; He locked the fire in the wood.
lines.transliteration: pavan paro-i-o sagal akaaraa paavak kaasat sangay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਮਾ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜਨ  ਕੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਤ  ਜੇਤ ਪਾਹੂਚਾ ॥
lines.english: He placed the water and the land together, but neither blends with the other. ||3||
lines.transliteration: neer Dharan  kar raakh ay aykat  ko-ay na kis hee sangay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ  ਵਡ ਸਾਹ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ਊਚੇ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In each and every heart, the Story of our Sovereign Lord is told; in each and everyhome, they yearn for Him.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at kathaa raajan kee chaalai gh ar ghar tujheh omaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਿਨ  ਪਰੋਇਓ  ਸਗਲ  ਅਕਾਰਾ  ਪਾਵਕ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਸੰਗੇ ॥
lines.english: Afterwards, He created all beings and crea tures; but first, He provided them with sustenance. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  paachh ai kari-aa parathmay rijak samaahaa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਰੁ ਧਰਿਣ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕਤ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Whatever He does, He does by Himself. Who has ever given Him advice?
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karn aa so aapay karn aa maslat  kaahoo d eenHee.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਕਥਾ ਰਾਜਨ  ਕੀ ਚਾਲੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਉਮਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: The mortals make all sorts of efforts and showy displays, but He is realized onlythrough the Teachings of Truth. ||5||
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar karah d ikhaa-ay saachee saakh ee cheenHee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਿਰਆ  ਪਰ੍ਥਮੇ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸਮਾਹਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Lord protects and saves His devotees; He blesses them with the glory of HisName.
lines.transliteration: har bhagt aa kar raakh ay apnay d eenee naam vadaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਸੁ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਮਸਲਿਤ  ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever is disrespectful to the humble servant of the Lord, shall be swept away anddestroyed. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jin jin karee avgi-aa jan kee tay t aiN dee-ay rurhHaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਕਰਹ  ਿਦਖਾਏ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਸਾਖੀ  ਚੀਨੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are liberated; all their demerits are taken away.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-ay saaDh sangat  kar tin kay avgan sabh  parhari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪਨੇ  ਦੀਨੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing them, God becomes merciful; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o d aykh bha-ay kirpaalaa t in bhav saagar t ari-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਰੀ ਅਵਿਗਆ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਤੈਂ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I am lowly, I am nothing at all; You are my Great Lord and Master - how can I evencontemplate Your creative potency?
lines.transliteration: ham naanHay neech tumHay bad saahib kud rat ka-un  beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਅਵਗਨ  ਸਿਭ ਪਰਹਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of theGuru's Darshan. Nanak takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1|| swrg mhlw 5 AstpdI Gru 6  (1235-15) saarag mehlaa 5 asatpadee gh ar 6 Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1235-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al gur d aras d aykhay naanak naam aDh aaraa. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਿਖ ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Listen to the Story of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: agam agaaDh sunhu jan kathaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨਾਨੇ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮੇ ਬਡ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਕਉਣ  ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Supreme Lord God is wondrous and amazing! ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kee achraj sabhaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ  ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: Forever and ever, humbly bow to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa sat gur namaskaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰਗ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ  ਘਰੁ ੬ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay gun gaa-ay apaar.

lines.english: His Light shall radiate deep within your mind.
lines.transliteration: man bheet ar hovai pargaas.

lines.english: With the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, ignorance is dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan anjan agi-aan binaas. ||1||

lines.english: There is no limit to His Expanse.
lines.transliteration: mit naahee jaa kaa bisthaar.

lines.english: His Glory is Infinite and Endless.
lines.transliteration: sobhaa t aa kee apar apaar.

lines.english: His many plays cannot be counted.
lines.transliteration: anik rang jaa kay ganay na jaahi.

lines.english: He is not subject to pleasure or pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sog harakh d uhhoo meh naahi. ||2||

lines.english: Many Brahmas vibrate Him in the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: anik barahmay jaa kay bayd Dh un karahi.

lines.english: Many Shivas sit in deep meditation. pMnw 1236
lines.transliteration: anik mahays bais Dhi-aan Dh areh.

lines.english: Many beings take incarnation.
lines.transliteration: anik purakh ansaa avt aar.

lines.english: Many Indras stand at the Lord's Door. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anik indar oobh ay darbaar. ||3||

lines.english: Many winds, fires and waters.
lines.transliteration: anik pavan paavak ar neer.

lines.english: Many jewels, and oceans of butter and milk.
lines.transliteration: anik ratan saagar d aDh kheer.

lines.english: Many suns, moons and stars.
lines.transliteration: anik soor sasee-ar nakhi-aat .

lines.english: Many gods and goddesses of so many kinds. ||4||
lines.transliteration: anik dayvee d ayvaa baho bh aaNt. ||4||

lines.english: Many earths, many wish-fulfilling cows.
lines.transliteration: anik basuDhaa anik kaamDh ayn.

lines.english: Many miraculous Elysian trees, many Krishnas playing the flute.
lines.transliteration: anik paarjaat anik mukh  bayn.

lines.english: Many Akaashic ethers, many nether regions of the underworld.
lines.transliteration: anik akaas anik paataal.

lines.english: Many mouths chant and meditate on the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: anik mukhee japee-ai gopaal. ||5||

lines.english: Many Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: anik saastar simrit  puraan.

lines.english: Many ways in which we speak.
lines.transliteration: anik jugat hovat  bakh i-aan.

lines.english: Many listeners listen to the Lord of Treasure.
lines.transliteration: anik sarotay suneh niDh aan.

lines.english: The Lord God totally permeates all beings. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-a pooran bhagvaan. ||6||

lines.english: Many righteous judges of Dharma, many gods of wealth.
lines.transliteration: anik Dharam anik kumayr.

lines.english: Many gods of water, many mountains of gold.
lines.transliteration: anik baran anik kanik sumayr.

lines.english: Many thousand-headed snakes, chanting ever-new Names of God.
lines.transliteration: anik saykh navt an naam layhi.

lines.english: They do not know the limits of the Supreme Lord God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm kaa ant na t ayhi. ||7||

lines.english: Many solar systems, many galaxies.
lines.transliteration: anik puree-aa anik tah kh and.

lines.english: Many forms, colors and celestial realms.
lines.transliteration: anik roop rang barahmand.

lines.english: Many gardens, many fruits and roots.
lines.transliteration: anik banaa anik fal mool.

lines.english: He Himself is mind, and He Himself is matter. ||8||
lines.transliteration: aapeh sookham aapeh asthool. ||8||

lines.english: Many ages, days and nights.
lines.transliteration: anik jugaad d inas ar raat .

lines.english: Many apocalypses, many creations.
lines.transliteration: anik parla-o anik utpaat .

lines.english: Many beings are in His home.
lines.transliteration: anik jee-a jaa kay garih maahi.

lines.english: The Lord is perfectly pervading all places. ||9||
lines.transliteration: ramat raam pooran sarab th aaN-ay. ||9||

lines.english: Many Mayas, which cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: anik maa-i-aa jaa kee lakhee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲਖੀ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Many are the ways in which our Sovereign Lord plays.
lines.transliteration: anik kalaa khaylai har raa-ay.

lines.english: Many exquisite melodies sing of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: anik Dhunit  lalit sangeet .

lines.english: Many recording scribes of the conscious and subconscious are revealed there. ||10||
lines.transliteration: anik gupat pargatay t ah cheet . ||10||

lines.english: He is above all, and yet He dwells with His devotees.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay ooch bh agat jaa kai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਗਤ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, they sing His Praises with love.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaavahi rang.

lines.english: Many unstruck melodies resound and resonate with bliss.
lines.transliteration: anik anaahad aanand  jhunkaar.

lines.english: There is no end or limit of that sublime essence. ||11||
lines.transliteration: u-aa ras kaa kachh ant  na paar. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਉਆ  ਰਸ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: True is the Primal Being, and True is His dwelling.
lines.transliteration: sat purakh  sat asthaan.

lines.english: He is the Highest of the high, Immaculate and Detached, in Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: ooch tay ooch nirmal nirbaan.

lines.english: He alone knows His handiwork.
lines.transliteration: apunaa kee-aa jaaneh aap.

lines.english: He Himself pervades each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: aapay ghat gh at rahi-o bi-aap.

lines.english: The Merciful Lord is the Treasure of Compassion, O Nanak.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan naanak d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Those who chant and meditate on Him, O Nanak, are exalted and enraptured. ||12||1||2||2||3||7|| swrg CMq mhlw 5  (1236-15) saarag chhant  mehlaa 5 Saarang, Chhant, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1236-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jin japi-aa naanak tay bh a-ay nihaal. ||12||1||2||2||3||7||

lines.english: See the Giver of fearlessness in all.
lines.transliteration: sabh d aykhee-ai anbh ai kaa d aataa.

lines.english: The Detached Lord is totally permeating each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at pooran hai alipaat aa.

lines.english: Like waves in the water, He created the creation.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at pooran kar bistheeran jal t arang ji-o rachan kee-aa.

lines.english: He enjoys all tastes, and takes pleasure in all hearts. There is no other like Him at all.
lines.transliteration: habh ras maan ay bh og gh ataan ay aan na bee-aa ko thee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਬਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ  ਿਜਉ  ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The color of the Lord's Love is the one color of our Lord and Master; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, God is realized.
lines.transliteration: har rangee ik rangee thaakur sat sang parabh  jaataa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਭ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਭੋਗ ਘਟਾਣੇ  ਆਨ  ਨ ਬੀਆ  ਕੋ ਥੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am drenched with the Blessed Vision of the Lord, like the fish in the water.I see the Giver of fearlessness in all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak daras leenaa ji-o jal meenaa sabh  daykhee-ai anbh ai kaa d aataa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: What praises should I give, and what approval should I offer to Him?
lines.transliteration: ka-un upmaa day-o kavan badaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਿਸ  ਲੀਨਾ  ਿਜਉ  ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ  ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਅਨਭੈ  ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places.
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahi-o sarab thaa-ee.

lines.english: The Perfect Enticing Lord adorns each and every heart. When He withdraws, the mortal turns to dust. pMnw 1237
lines.transliteration: pooran manmohan ghat gh at sohan jab kh inchai t ab chh aa-ee.

lines.english: Why do you not worship and adore Him? Join together with the Holy Saints; any instant, your time shall come.
lines.transliteration: ki-o na aaraaDhahu mil kar saaDh ahu gh aree muht ak baylaa aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਨ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਿਰ ਸਾਧਹੁ ਘਰੀ  ਮੁਹਤਕ  ਬੇਲਾ  ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: All your property and wealth, and all that you see - none of it will go along with you.
lines.transliteration: arath darab sabh  jo kichh  deesai sang na kachh hoo jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਥੁ  ਦਰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਦੀਸੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. What praise, and what approval,can I offer to Him? ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har har aaraaDhahu kavan upmaa d ay-o kavan badaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਕਵਨ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I ask the Saints, what is my Lord and Master like?
lines.transliteration: poochha-o sant  mayro th aakur kaisaa.

lines.english: I offer my heart, to one who brings me news of Him.
lines.transliteration: heeN-o araapa-uN dayh sad aysaa.

lines.english: Give me news of my Dear God; where does the Enticer live?
lines.transliteration: dayh sad aysaa parabh  jee-o kaisaa kah mohan parvaysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਦੇਸਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ  ਕੈਸਾ ਕਹ ਮੋਹਨ  ਪਰਵੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Giver of peace to life and limb; God is totally permeating all places, interspaces and countries.
lines.transliteration: ang ang sukh-d aa-ee pooran barahmaa-ee thaan thaanant ar daysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗ  ਅੰਗ  ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਈ  ਥਾਨ ਥਾਨੰਤਰ  ਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.english: He is liberated from bondage, joined to each and every heart. I cannot say what theLord is like.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t ay mukt aa gh at ghat jugt aa kahi na saka-o har jaisaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਨ  ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਜੁਗਤਾ  ਕਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜੈਸਾ ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon His wondrous play, O Nanak, my mind is fascinated. I humbly ask, whatis my Lord and Master like? ||3||
lines.transliteration: daykh  charit  naanak man mohi-o poochh ai deen mayro th aakur kaisaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਚਿਰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਪੂਛੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: In His Kindness, He has come to His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apunay peh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Dhan so rid aa jih charan basaa-i-aa. Blessed is that heart, in which the Lord's Feet are enshrined.
His Feet are enshrined within, in the Society of the Saints; the darkness of ignoranceis dispelled.
lines.transliteration: charan basaa-i-aa sant sangaa-i-aa agi-aan anDh ayr gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਬਸਾਇਆ  ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ  ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The heart is enlightened and illumined and enraptured; God has been found.
lines.transliteration: bha-i-aa pargaas rid ai ulaas parabh  lorheedaa paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਿਰਦੈ ਉਲਾਸੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Pain is gone, and peace has come to my house. The ultimate intuitive peace prevails.
lines.transliteration: dukh naath aa sukh  ghar meh vooth aa mahaa anand sehjaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਵੂਠਾ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਸਹਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord; in His Kindness, He has come to Hishumble servant. ||4||1|| swrMg kI vwr mhlw 4 rwie mhmy hsny kI Duin  (1237-10) saarang kee vaar mehlaa 4 raa-ay mahmay hasnay kee Dhuian Vaar Of Saarang, Fourth Mehl, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Mehma-Hasna: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1237-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mhlw 2 ] (1237-11) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mai pooraa paa-i-aa kar kirpaa apunay peh aa-i-aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The key of the Guru opens the lock of attachment, in the house of the mind, underthe roof of the body.
lines.transliteration: gur kunjee paahoo nival man kothaa t an chh at.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਰੰਗ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਰਾਇ  ਮਹਮੇ  ਹਸਨੇ  ਕੀ ਧੁਿਨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Guru, the door of the mind cannot be opened. No one elseholds the key in hand. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1237-12) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur bin man kaa taak na ugh -rhai avar na kunjee hath. ||1||

lines.english: He is not won over by music, songs or the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai raagee naad ee bayd .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਪਾਹੂ ਿਨਵਲੁ  ਮਨੁ ਕੋਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਛਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: He is not won over by intuitive wisdom, meditation or Yoga.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai surt ee gi-aanee jog.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤਾਕੁ  ਨ ਉਘੜੈ  ਅਵਰ  ਨ ਕੁੰਜੀ  ਹਿਥ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is not won over by feeling sad and depressed forever.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai sogee keet ai roj.

lines.english: He is not won over by beauty, wealth and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai roopeeN maaleeN rang.

lines.english: He is not won over by wandering naked at sacred shrines.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai t irath bh avi-ai nang.

lines.english: He is not won over by giving donations in charity.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai d aateeN keetai punn.

lines.english: He is not won over by living alone in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai baahar baith i-aa sunn.

lines.english: He is not won over by fighting and dying as a warrior in battle.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai bh ayrh mareh bh irh soor.

lines.english: He is not won over by becoming the dust of the masses.
lines.transliteration: na bheejai kayt ay hoveh Dh oorh.

lines.english: The account is written of the loves of the mind.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa likee-ai man kai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord is won over only by His Name. ||2|| mhlw 1 ] (1237-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bheejai saachai naa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: You may study the nine grammars, the six Shaastras and the six divions of the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: nav chhi-a kh at kaa karay beechaar.

lines.english: You may recite the Mahaabhaarata.
lines.transliteration: nis din uchrai bh aar ath aar.

lines.english: Even these cannot find the limits of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tin bh ee ant  na paa-i-aa t ohi.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be liberated?
lines.transliteration: naam bihoon mukat  ki-o ho-ay.

lines.english: Brahma, in the lotus of the navel, does not know the limits of God.
lines.transliteration: naabh vasat  barahmai ant  na jaan i-aa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, realizes the Naam. ||3|| pauVI ] (1237-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak naam pachh aani-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Immaculate Lord Himself, by Himself, created Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay aap niranjanaa jin aap upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself created the whole drama of all the world's play.
lines.transliteration: aapay khayl rachaa-i-on sabh  jagat  sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself formed the three gunas, the three qualities; He increased the attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  aap sirji-an maa-i-aa moh vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਭ  ਵਸਤ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੈ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are saved - those who love the Will of God.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ubray jin bhaan aa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the True Lord is pervading everywhere; all are contained within the True Lord. ||1|| pMnw 1238 slok mhlw 2 ] (1238-1) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach varatdaa sabh  sach samaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: He Himself creates, O Nanak; He establishes the various creatures.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay naankaa aapay rakhai vayk.

lines.english: How can anyone be called bad? We have only One Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: mandaa kis no aakh ee-ai jaaN sabh naa saahib ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਰਖੈ ਵੇਕ ॥
lines.english: There is One Lord and Master of all; He watches over all, and assigns all to theirtasks.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa saahib ayk hai vaykh ai DhanDhai laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਜ ਸਭਨਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ॥
lines.english: Some have less, and some have more; no one is allowed to leave empty.
lines.transliteration: kisai thorhaa kisai aglaa kh aalee ko-ee naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Naked we come, and naked we go; in between, we put on a show.
lines.transliteration: aavahi nangay jaahi nangay vichay karahi vithaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of God's Command - what will hehave to do in the world hereafter? ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1238-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na jaanee-ai agai kaa-ee kaar. ||1||

lines.english: He sends out the various created beings, and he calls back the various created beingsagain.
lines.transliteration: jinas thaap jee-aaN ka-o bhayjai jinas thaap lai jaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਅਗੈ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes. He fashions them in variousforms.
lines.transliteration: aapay thaap uthaapai aapay aytay vays karaavai.

lines.english: And all the human beings who wander around as beggars, He Himself gives in charityto them.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a fireh a-uDh ootee aapay bh ikhi-aa paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਿਸ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਜੀਆਂ  ਕਉ ਭੇਜੈ ਿਜਨਿਸ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਲੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: As it is recorded, the mortals speak, and as it is recorded, they walk. So why put on allthis show?
lines.transliteration: laykhai bolan  laykh ai chalan  kaa-it  keecheh d aavay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਪੈ  ਆਪੇ ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: This is the basis of intelligence; this is certified and approved. Nanak speaks andproclaims it.
lines.transliteration: mool mat parvaan aa ayho naanak aakh  sunaa-ay.

lines.english: By past actions, each being is judged; what else can anyone say? ||2|| pauVI ] (1238-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: karnee upar ho-ay t apaavas jay ko kahai kahaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ  ਲੇਖੈ ਚਲਣੁ  ਕਾਇਤੁ  ਕੀਚਿਹ ਦਾਵੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word makes the drama play itself out. Through virtue, this becomes evident.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chalat  rachaa-i-on gun  pargatee aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਮਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ  ਏਹੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਿਖ  ਸੁਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever utters the Word of the Guru's Bani - the Lord is enshrined in his mind.
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee sad  uchrai har man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੀ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Maya's power is gone, and doubt is eradicated; awaken to the Light of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sakat ga-ee bh aram kati-aa siv jot  jagaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who hold onto goodness as their treasure meet the Guru, the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: jin kai potai punn hai gur purakh  milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਚਲਤੁ  ਰਚਾਇਓਨ ੁ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed and blended into the Name of the Lord. ||2|| slok mhlw 2 ] (1238-9) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay mil rahay har naam samaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਸਦ ਉਚਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The merchants come from the Banker; He sends the account of their destiny withthem.
lines.transliteration: saah chalay vanjaari-aa likh i-aa d ayvai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਿਤ  ਗਈ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਿਟਆ  ਿਸਵ ਜੋਿਤ ਜਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: On the basis of their accounts, He issues the Hukam of His Command, and they are left to take care of their merchandise.
lines.transliteration: likhay upar hukam ho-ay la-ee-ai vasat  samHaal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The merchants have purchased their merchandise and packed up their cargo.
lines.transliteration: vasat la-ee van jaara-ee vakh ar baDh aa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some depart after having earned a good profit, while others leave, having lost theirinvestment altogether.
lines.transliteration: kay-ee laahaa lai chalay ik chalay mool gavaa-ay.

lines.english: No one asks to have less; who should be celebrated?
lines.transliteration: thorhaa kinai na mangi-o kis kahee-ai saabaas.

lines.english: The Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, upon those who have preserved theircapital investment. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1238-12) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: nadar t inaa ka-o naankaa je saabat  laa-ay raas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਖੇ ਉਪਿਰ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਈਐ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: United, the united separate, and separated, they unite again.
lines.transliteration: jurh jurh  vichh urhay vichh urh jurhay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਸਤੁ  ਲਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਈ  ਵਖਰੁ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Living, the living die, and dying, they live again.
lines.transliteration: jeev jeev mu-ay mu-ay jeevay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਈ ਲਾਹਾ  ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਇਿਕ  ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They become the fathers of many, and the sons of many; they become the gurus ofmany, and the disciples.
lines.transliteration: kayti-aa kay baap kayt i-aa kay baytay kayt ay gur chaylay hoo-ay.

lines.english: No account can be made of the future or the past; who knows what shall be, or what was?
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai gan at na aavai ki-aa jaat ee ki-aa hun  hoo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜ ਸਾਬਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the actions and events of the past are recorded; the Doer did, He does, and He willdo.
lines.transliteration: sabh karn aa kirat  kar likee-ai kar kar kart aa karay karay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh dies, while the Gurmukh is saved; O Nanak, the GraciousLord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2|| pauVI ] (1238-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: manmukh maree-ai gurmukh  taree-ai naanak nad ree nad ar karay. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wanders in duality, lured and enticed by duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d oojaa bh aram hai d oojai lobh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He practices falsehood and deception, telling lies.
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat kamaavd ay koorh o aalaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਿਤਆ  ਕੇ ਬਾਪ ਕੇਿਤਆ  ਕੇ ਬੇਟੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਹੂਏ ॥
lines.english: Love and attachment to children and spouse is total misery and pain.
lines.transliteration: putar kalat ar moh hayt  hai sabh  dukh sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਗੈ  ਪਾਛੈ ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਤੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਹੁਿਣ ਹੂਏ ॥
lines.english: He is gagged and bound at the door of the Messenger of Death; he dies, and wanderslost in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: jam dar baDh ay maaree-ah bh armeh bh armaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਕਿਰ ਿਲਖੀਐ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh wastes his life; Nanak loves the Lord. ||3|| slok mhlw 2 ] (1238-18) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: manmukh janam gavaa-i-aa naanak har bh aa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮਰੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with the glorious greatness of Your Name - their minds areimbued with Your Love.
lines.transliteration: jin vadi-aa-ee tayray naam kee t ay rat ay man maahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is only One Ambrosial Nectar; there is no other nectar at all.
lines.transliteration: naanak amrit ayk hai d oojaa amrit  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained within the mind, by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: naanak amrit manai maahi paa-ee-ai gur parsaad .

lines.english: They alone drink it in with love, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1|| pMnw 1239 mhlw 2 ] (1239-1) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tinHee peet aa rang si-o jinH ka-o likh i-aa aad . ||1||

lines.english: Why praise the created being? Praise the One who created all.
lines.transliteration: keetaa ki-aa salaahee-ai karay so-ay saalaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is no other Giver, except the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak aykee baahraa doojaa d aataa naahi.

lines.english: Praise the Creator Lord, who created the creation.
lines.transliteration: kartaa so salaahee-ai jin keet aa aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Praise the Great Giver, who gives sustenence to all.
lines.transliteration: daataa so salaahee-ai je sabh sai day aaDh aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the treasure of the Eternal Lord is over-flowing.
lines.transliteration: naanak aap sadeev hai pooraa jis bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਤਾ  ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Praise and honor the One, who has no end or limitation. ||2|| pauVI ] (1239-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: vadaa kar salaahee-ai ant na paaraavaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਦੀਵ  ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is a treasure. Serving it, peace is obtained.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam niDhaan hai sayvi-ai sukh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I chant the Name of the Immaculate Lord, so that I may go home with honor.
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan uchraaN pat si-o gh ar jaaN-ee.

lines.english: The Word of the Gurmukh is the Naam; I enshrine the Naam within my heart.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ban ee naam hai naam rid ai vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The bird of the intellect comes under one's control, by meditating on the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: mat pankh ayroo vas ho-ay sat guroo Dh i-aa-eeN.

lines.english: O Nanak, if the Lord becomes merciful, the mortal lovingly tunes in to the Naam. ||4|| slok mhlw 2 ] (1239-6) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap da-i-aal ho-ay naamay liv laa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: How can we speak of Him? Only He knows Himself.
lines.transliteration: tis si-o kaisaa boln aa je aapay jaan ai jaan .

lines.english: His decree cannot be challenged; He is our Supreme Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: cheeree jaa kee naa firai saahib so parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By His Decree, even kings, nobles and commanders must step down.
lines.transliteration: cheeree jis kee chalnaa meer malak salaar.

lines.english: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, O Nanak, is a good deed.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai naankaa saa-ee bh alee kaar.

lines.english: By His Decree, we walk; nothing rests in our hands.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa cheeree chalnaa hath t inHaa kichh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਰੀ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਾ ਿਫਰੈ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: When the Order comes from our Lord and Master, all must rise up and take to the road.
lines.transliteration: saahib kaa furmaan ho-ay uth ee karlai paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਰੀ  ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਚਲਣਾ  ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ  ਸਲਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: As His Decree is issued, so is His Command obeyed.
lines.transliteration: jayhaa cheeree likhi-aa t ayhaa hukam kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਾਈ  ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Those who are sent, come, O Nanak; when they are called back, they depart and go.||1|| mhlw 2 ] (1239-10) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ghalay aavahi naankaa sad ay uth ee jaahi. ||1||

lines.english: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Praises, are the true keepers of the treasure.
lines.transliteration: sifat jinaa ka-o bakh see-ai say-ee pot aydaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਕਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ਉਠੀ ਕਰਲੈ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with the key - they alone receive the treasure.
lines.transliteration: kunjee jin ka-o dit ee-aa t inHaa milay bh andaar.

lines.english: That treasure, from which virtue wells up - that treasure is approved.
lines.transliteration: jah bhandaaree hoo gun  niklahi t ay kee-ah parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਘਲੇ ਆਵਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਦੇ ਉਠੀ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed by His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, bear the Insignia of the Naam. ||2|| pauVI ] (1239-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: nadar t inHaa ka-o naankaa naam jinHaa neesaan . ||2||

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is immaculate and pure; hearing it, peace isobtained.
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan nirmalaa suni-ai sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: Listening and hearing, It is enshrined in the mind; how rare is that humble being whorealizes it.
lines.transliteration: sun sun  man vasaa-ee-ai boojh ai jan ko-ee.

lines.english: Sitting down and standing up, I shall never forget Him, the Truest of the true.
lines.transliteration: bahdi-aa uth -di-aa na visrai saachaa sach so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ  ਹੂ ਗੁ ਣ ਿਨਕਲਿਹ  ਤੇ ਕੀਅਿਹ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: His devotees have the Support of His Name; in His Name, they find peace.
lines.transliteration: bhagt aa ka-o naam aDh aar hai naamay sukh  ho-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, He permeates and pervades mind and body; He is the Lord, the Guru's Word. ||5|| slok mhlw 1 ] (1239-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak man tan rav rahi-aa gurmukh  har so-ee. ||5||

lines.english: O Nanak, the weight is weighed out, when the soul is placed on the scale.
lines.transliteration: naanak tulee-ah t ol jay jee-o pichh ai paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Nothing is equal to speaking of the One, who perfectly unites us with the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: ikas na pujeh bol jay pooray pooraa kar milai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈਐ  ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: To call Him glorious and great carries such a heavy weight.
lines.transliteration: vadaa aakhan  bhaaraa t ol.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹਿਦਆ  ਉਠਿਦਆ  ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Other intellectualisms are lightweight; other words are lightweight as well.
lines.transliteration: hor ha-ulee matee ha-ulay bol.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਾ  ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Dhart ee paan ee parbat  bhaar. The weight of the earth, water and mountains

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ki-o kandai tolai suni-aar. - how can the goldsmith weigh it on the scale?

lines.english: What weights can balance the scale?
lines.transliteration: tolaa maasaa rat ak paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੁਲੀਅਿਹ  ਤੋਲ ਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਿਪਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when questioned, the answer is given.
lines.transliteration: naanak puchhi-aa d ay-ay pujaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਸੁ  ਨ ਪੁਜਿਹ  ਬੋਲ ਜੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਰ ਿਮਲੈ ॥
lines.english: The blind fool is running around, leading the blind.
lines.transliteration: moorakh anDh i-aa anDh ee Dh aat.

lines.english: The more they say, the more they expose themselves. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1239-17) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kahi kahi kahan kahaa-in aap. ||1||

lines.english: It is difficult to chant it; it is difficult to listen to it. It cannot be chanted with themouth.
lines.transliteration: aakhan  a-ukh aa sunan  a-ukh aa aakh  na jaapee aakh .

lines.english: Some speak with their mouths and chant the Word of the Shabad - the low and thehigh, day and night.
lines.transliteration: ik aakh aakh ahi sabad  bhaakhahi araDh  uraDh  din raat .

lines.english: If He were something, then He would be visible. His form and state cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: jay kihu ho-ay ta kihu d isai jaapai roop na jaat .

lines.english: The Creator Lord does all deeds; He is established in the hearts of the high and the low. pMnw 1240
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaran  kartaa karay gh at a-ugh at ghat thaap.

lines.english: It is so difficult to chant it, O Nanak; it cannot be chanted with the mouth. ||2|| pauVI ] (1240-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aakhan  a-ukh aa naankaa aakh  na jaapai aakh . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਖਿਣ  ਅਉਖਾ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਆਿਖ  ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਿਖ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, the mind is delighted. The Name brings peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai man rehsee-ai naamay saaNt aa-ee.

lines.english: Hearing the Name, the mind is satisfied, and all pains are taken away.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai man t aripat -ee-ai sabh  dukh gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਸੁਿਣਐ  ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, one becomes famous; the Name brings glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai naa-o oopjai naamay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਸੁਿਣਐ  ਮਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੀਐ  ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Name brings all honor and status; through the Name, salvation is obtained.
lines.transliteration: naamay hee sabh jaat  pat naamay gat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਸੁਿਣਐ  ਨਾਉ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh meditates on the Name; Nanak is lovingly attuned to the Name. ||6|| slok mhlw 1 ] (1240-4) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai naanak liv laa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Impurity does not come from music; impurity does not come from the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: jooth na raageeN jooth  na vayd eeN.

lines.english: Impurity does not come from the phases of the sun and the moon.
lines.transliteration: jooth na chand  sooraj kee bh aydee.

lines.english: Impurity does not come from food; impurity does not come from ritual cleansing baths.
lines.transliteration: jooth na annee jooth  na naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਰਾਗੀ ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਵੇਦੀ ॥
lines.english: Impurity does not come from the rain, which falls everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jooth na meehu varHi-ai sabh  thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ  ਕੀ ਭੇਦੀ ॥
lines.english: Impurity does not come from the earth; impurity does not come from the water.
lines.transliteration: jooth na Dh artee jooth  na paan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਅੰਨੀ ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਨਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Impurity does not come from the air which is diffused everywhere.
lines.transliteration: jooth na pa-un ai maahi samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਿਰਐ  ਸਭ ਥਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the one who has no Guru, has no redeeming virtues at all.
lines.transliteration: naanak niguri-aa gun naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਧਰਤੀ  ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Impurity comes from turning one's face away from God. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1240-6) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: muhi fayri-ai muhu joothaa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, the mouth is truly cleansed by ritual cleansing, if you really know how to doit.
lines.transliteration: naanak chulee-aa suchee-aa jay bhar jaan ai ko-ay.

lines.english: For the intuitively aware, cleansing is spiritual wisdom. For the Yogi, it is self-control.
lines.transliteration: surtay chulee gi-aan kee jogee kaa jat  ho-ay.

lines.english: For the Brahmin, cleansing is contentment; for the householder, it is truth and charity.
lines.transliteration: barahman chulee sant okh kee girhee kaa sat  daan.

lines.english: For the king, cleansing is justice; for the scholar, it is true meditation.
lines.transliteration: raajay chulee ni-aav kee parhi-aa sach Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੁਲੀਆ  ਸੁਚੀਆ  ਜੇ ਭਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The consciousness is not washed with water; you drink it to quench your thirst.
lines.transliteration: paanee chit  na Dh op-ee mukh  peetai tikh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਤੇ  ਚੁਲੀ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਕੀ ਜੋਗੀ  ਕਾ ਜਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Water is the father of the world; in the end, water destroys it all. ||2|| pauVI ] (1240-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: paanee pit aa jagat  kaa fir paan ee sabh  khaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਣ  ਚੁਲੀ  ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕੀ ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, all supernatural spiritual powers are obtained, and wealth follows along.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai sabh  siDh hai riDh  pichh ai aavai.

lines.english: Hearing the Name, the nine treasures are received, and the mind's desires areobtained.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai na-o niDh  milai man chind i-aa paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਨ ਧੋਪਈ  ਮੁਿਖ ਪੀਤੈ ਿਤਖ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, contentment comes, and Maya meditates at one's feet.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai sant okh ho-ay kavlaa charan Dh i-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਣੀ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਜਗਤ  ਕਾ ਿਫਿਰ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਸਭੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, intuitive peace and poise wells up.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai sahj oopjai sehjay sukh  paavai.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained; O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||7|| slok mhlw 1 ] (1240-12) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naa-o paa-ee-ai naanak gun  gaavai. ||7||

lines.english: In pain, we are born; in pain, we die. In pain, we deal with the world.
lines.transliteration: dukh vich jaman  dukh maran  dukh vartan sansaar.

lines.english: Hereafter, there is said to be pain, only pain; the more the mortals read, the morethey cry out.
lines.transliteration: dukh dukh agai aakh ee-ai parhH parhH karahi pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਸੁਿਣਐ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਹੋਇ ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ  ਿਧਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The packages of pain are untied, but peace does not emerge.
lines.transliteration: dukh kee-aa pandaa kh ulHee-aa sukh  na nikli-o ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਸੁਿਣਐ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In pain, the soul burns; in pain, it departs weeping and wailing.
lines.transliteration: dukh vich jee-o jalaa-i-aa d ukhee-aa chali-aa ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with the Lord's Praise, the mind and body blossom forth, rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: naanak siftee rat i-aa man t an hari-aa ho-ay.

lines.english: In the fire of pain, the mortals die; but pain is also the cure. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1240-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: dukh kee-aa agee maaree-ah bh ee dukh daaroo ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਦੁਿਖ ਮਰਣੁ  ਦੁਿਖ ਵਰਤਣੁ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, worldly pleasures are nothing more than dust. They are the dust of the dustof ashes.
lines.transliteration: naanak dunee-aa bh as rang bh asoo hoo bh as khayh.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal earns only the dust of the dust; his body is covered with dust.
lines.transliteration: bhaso bh as kamaavn ee bh ee bh as bh aree-ai d ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ  ਪੰਡਾ ਖੁਲੀਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਿਨਕਿਲਓ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the soul is taken out of the body, it too is covered with dust.
lines.transliteration: jaa jee-o vichahu kadhee-ai bh asoo bh ari-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜੀਉ  ਜਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੀਆ  ਚਿਲਆ  ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: And when one's account is called for in the world hereafter, he receives only ten timesmore dust. ||2|| pauVI ] (1240-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: agai laykhai mangi-ai hor d asoon ee paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਫਤੀ  ਰਿਤਆ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, one is blessed with purity and self-control, and the Messenger ofDeath will not draw near.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai such sanjamo jam nayrh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ  ਅਗੀ  ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਭੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai gh at chaann aa aanHayr gavaavai.

lines.english: Hearing the Name, one comes to understand his own self, and the profit of the Nameis obtained.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai aap bujh ee-ai laahaa naa-o paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਭਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਸੂ ਹੂ ਭਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Name, sins are eradicated, and one meets the Immaculate True Lord.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay suni-ai paap katee-ah nirmal sach paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਸੋ ਭਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ  ਭੀ ਭਸੁ ਭਰੀਐ  ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, hearing the Name, one's face becomes radiant. As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name. ||8|| slok mhlw 1 ] (1240-19) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naa-ay suni-ai mukh  ujlay naa-o gurmukh  Dhi-aavai. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਜੀਉ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ  ਭਸੂ ਭਿਰਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In your home, is the Lord God, along with all your other gods.
lines.transliteration: ghar naaraa-in  sabh aa naal.
