lines.english: You wash your stone gods and worship them. pMnw 1241
lines.transliteration: pooj karay rakhai naavaal.

lines.english: You offer saffron, sandalwood and flowers.
lines.transliteration: kungoo channan ful charh aa-ay.

lines.english: Falling at their feet, you try so hard to appease them.
lines.transliteration: pairee pai pai bahut manaa-ay.

lines.english: Begging, begging from other people, you get things to wear and eat.
lines.transliteration: maanoo-aa mang mang painHai khaa-ay.

lines.english: For your blind deeds, you will be blindly punished.
lines.transliteration: anDhee kammee anDh  sajaa-ay.

lines.english: Your idol does not feed the hungry, or save the dying.
lines.transliteration: bhukh i-aa d ay-ay na mard i-aa rakh ai.

lines.english: The blind assembly argues in blindness. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1241-3) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: anDhaa jh agrhaa anDh ee sathai. ||1||

lines.english: All intuitive understanding, all Yoga, all the Vedas and Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: sabhay surt ee jog sabh  sabh ay bayd  puraan .

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਰਤੀ  ਜੋਗ ਸਿਭ ਸਭੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: All actions, all penances, all songs and spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sabhay karn ay tap sabh  sabh ay geet  gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਕਰਣੇ  ਤਪ ਸਿਭ ਸਭੇ ਗੀਤ  ਿਗਆਨ  ॥
lines.english: All intellect, all enlightenment, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: sabhay buDh ee suDh  sabh  sabh  tirath sabh  thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਿਧ ਸਿਭ ਸਿਭ ਤੀਰਥ  ਸਿਭ ਥਾਨ ॥
lines.english: All kingdoms, all royal commands, all joys and all delicacies.
lines.transliteration: sabh paat isaahee-aa amar sabh  sabh  khusee-aa sabh  khaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੀਆ  ਅਮਰ  ਸਿਭ ਸਿਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਸਿਭ ਖਾਨ ॥
lines.english: All mankind, all divinites, all Yoga and meditation.
lines.transliteration: sabhay maan as dayv sabh  sabh ay jog Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਭ ਸਭੇ ਜੋਗ ਿਧਆਨ  ॥
lines.english: All worlds, all celestial realms; all the beings of the universe.
lines.transliteration: sabhay puree-aa kh and sabh  sabh ay jee-a jahaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ  ਖੰਡ ਸਿਭ ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ  ਜਹਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: According to His Hukam, He commands them. His Pen writes out the account of their actions.
lines.transliteration: hukam chalaa-ay aapnai karmee vahai kalaam.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਿਮ ਚਲਾਏ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਵਹੈ ਕਲਾਮ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, True is the Lord, and True is His Name. True is His Congregation and HisCourt. ||2|| pauVI ] (1241-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sach naa-ay sach sabhaa d eebaan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਇ  ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, peace wells up; the Name brings emancipation.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai sukh oopjai naamay gat  ho-ee.

lines.english: With faith in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord is enshrined in the heart.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai pat paa-ee-ai hird ai har so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਗਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and noobstructions are ever again encountered.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai bhavjal langh ee-ai fir bigh an na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, the Path is revealed; through the Name, one is totallyenlightened.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai panth pargataa naamay sabh lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਲੰਘੀਐ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; he alonehas faith, who is blessed with it. ||9|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1241-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai naa-o mannee-ai jin d ayvai so-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The mortal walks on his head through the worlds and realms; he meditates, balaced on one foot.
lines.transliteration: puree-aa khanda sir karay ik pair Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਨਾਉ  ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਿਜਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੯॥
lines.english: Controlling the wind of the breath, he meditates within his mind, tucking his chindown into his chest.
lines.transliteration: pa-un maar man jap karay sir mundee t alai d ay-ay.

lines.english: What does he lean on? Where does he get his power?
lines.transliteration: kis upar oh tik tikai kis no jor karay-i.

lines.english: What can be said, O Nanak? Who is blessed by the Creator?
lines.transliteration: kis no kahee-ai naankaa kis no kartaa d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੁ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਮਿਨ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਸਰੁ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਤਲੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: God keeps all under His Command, but the fool shows off himself. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1241-11) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hukam rahaa-ay aapnai moorakh  aap gan ay-ay. ||1||

lines.english: He is, He is - I say it millions upon millions, millions upon millions of times.
lines.transliteration: hai hai aakhaaN kot kot kotee hoo kot kot.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: With my mouth I say it, forever and ever; there is no end to this speech.
lines.transliteration: aakhooN aakh aaN sadaa sad aa kahan  na aavai t ot.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਿਮ ਰਹਾਏ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਣੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not get tired, and I will not be stopped; this is how great my determination is.
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o thakaaN na thaakee-aa ayvad rakh eh jot .

lines.english: O Nanak, this is tiny and insignificant. To say that it is more, is wrong. ||2|| pauVI ] (1241-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak chasi-ahu chukh bind  upar aakh an dos. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਆਖ  ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਕੋਿਟ ਕੋਿਟ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, all one's ancestors and family are saved.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai kul uDhrai sabh  kutamb sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਖੂੰ  ਆਖ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਹਿਣ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਤੋਿਟ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, one's associates are saved; enshrine it within your heart.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai sangat uDh rai jin rid ai vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਥਕ ਨ ਠਾਕੀਆ  ਏਵਡ  ਰਖਿਹ  ਜੋਿਤ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, those who hear it are saved; let your tongue delight in it.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai sun uDh ray jin rasan rasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਸਅਹੁ ਚੁਖ ਿਬੰਦ ਉਪਿਰ  ਆਖਣੁ  ਦੋਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, pain and hunger are dispelled; let your consciousness be attached to the Name.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai dukh  bhukh ga-ee jin naam chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone Praise the Name, who meet with the Guru. ||10|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1241-16) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinee salaahi-aa jin guroo milaa-i-aa. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਰੈ  ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All nights, all days, all dates, all days of the week;
lines.transliteration: sabhay raat ee sabh  dih sabh  thitee sabh  vaar.

lines.english: All seasons, all months, all the earth and everything on it.
lines.transliteration: sabhay rut ee maah sabh  sabh  DharteeN sabh  bhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸੁਿਣ ਉਧਰੇ  ਿਜਨ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All waters, all winds, all fires and underworlds.
lines.transliteration: sabhay paan ee pa-un  sabh  sabh  agnee paat aal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਿਜਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All solar systems and galaxies, all worlds, people and forms.
lines.transliteration: sabhay puree-aa kh and sabh  sabh  lo-a lo-a aakaar.

lines.english: No one knows how great the Hukam of His Command is; no one can describe His actions.
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaapee kayt-rh aa kahi na sakeejai kaar.

lines.english: Mortals may utter, chant, recite and contemplate His Praises until they grow weary.
lines.transliteration: aakhahi thakeh aakh  aakh  kar sift eeN veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਿਭ ਿਦਹ ਸਿਭ ਿਥਤੀ  ਸਿਭ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The poor fools, O Nanak, cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1241-19) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tarin na paa-i-o bapurh ee naanak kahai gavaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਸਿਭ ਸਿਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਿਭ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.english: If I were to walk around with my eyes wide open, gazing at all the created forms;
lines.transliteration: akheeN parnai jay firaaN daykhaaN sabh  aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਪਾਣੀ  ਪਉਣ  ਸਿਭ ਸਿਭ ਅਗਨੀ  ਪਾਤਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: I could ask the spiritual teachers and religious scholars, and those who contemplate the Vedas; pMnw 1242
lines.transliteration: puchhaa gi-aanee pandh itaaN puchh aa bayd  beechaar.

lines.english: I could ask the gods, mortal men, warriors and divine incarnations;
lines.transliteration: puchhaa d ayvaaN maan saaN joDh  karahi avt aar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਛਾ ਦੇਵ ਮਾਣਸ  ਜੋਧ ਕਰਿਹ  ਅਵਤਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I could consult all the Siddhas in Samaadhi, and go to see the Lord's Court.
lines.transliteration: siDh samaaDh ee sabh  sunee jaa-ay d aykhaaN darbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ  ਸਿਭ ਸੁਣੀ ਜਾਇ  ਦੇਖ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Hereafter, Truth is the Name of all; the Fearless Lord has no fear at all.
lines.transliteration: agai sachaa sach naa-ay nirbha-o bh ai vin  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਇ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਭੈ ਿਵਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: False are other intellectualisms, false and shallow; blind are the contemplations of the blind.
lines.transliteration: hor kachee matee kach pich anDh i-aa anDh  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ  ਮਤੀ ਕਚੁ ਿਪਚੁ ਅੰਿਧਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by the karma of good actions, the mortal comes to meditate on the Lord; byHis Grace, we are carried across. ||2|| pauVI ] (1242-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak karmee bandagee nad ar langh aa-ay paar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਬੰਦਗੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਏ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the intellect is enlightened.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai durmat  ga-ee mat  pargatee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: With faith in the Name, egotism is eradicated, and all sickness is cured.
lines.transliteration: naa-o mani-ai ha-umai ga-ee sabh rog gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਗਈ ਮਿਤ ਪਰਗਟੀ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Believing in the Name, The Name wells up, and intuitive peace and poise areobtained.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai naam oopjai sehjay sukh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਗਈ ਸਿਭ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Believing in the Name, tranquility and peace well up, and the Lord is enshrined in the mind.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai saaNt oopjai har man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Name is a jewel; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||11|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1242-6) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratann hai gurmukh  har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸਿਤ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: If there were any other equal to You, O Lord, I would speak to them of You.
lines.transliteration: hor sareek hovai ko-ee tayraa t is agai t uDh aakh aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: You, I praise You; I am blind, but through the Name, I am all-seeing.
lines.transliteration: tuDh agai t uDhai saalaahee mai anDh ay naa-o sujaakh aa.

lines.english: Whatever is spoken, is the Word of the Shabad. Chanting it with love, we areembellished.
lines.transliteration: jaytaa aakh an saahee sabd ee bh aakhi-aa bh aa-ay subh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਰੁਸਰੀਕੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖ ॥
lines.english: Nanak, this is the greatest thing to say: all glorious greatness is Yours. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1242-8) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bahutaa ayho aakh an sabh  tayree vadi-aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ  ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਮੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਨਾਉ  ਸੁਜਾਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: When there was nothing, what happened? What happens when one is born?
lines.transliteration: jaaN na si-aa ki-aa chaakree jaaN jammay ki-aa kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤਾ  ਆਖਣੁ  ਸਾਹੀ  ਸਬਦੀ  ਭਾਿਖਆ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator, the Doer, does all; He watches over all, again and again
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaran  kartaa karay d aykhai vaaro vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਖਣੁ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: . Whether we keep silent or beg out loud, the Great Giver blesses us with His gifts.
lines.transliteration: jay chupai jay mangi-ai daat  karay d aataar.

lines.english: The One Lord is the Giver; we are all beggars. I have seen this throughout the Universe.
lines.transliteration: ik daat aa sabh  mangt ay fir d aykheh aakaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਨ ਿਸਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਜ ਜੰਮੇ ਿਕਆ  ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Nanak knows this: the Great Giver lives forever. ||2|| pauVI ] (1242-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ayvai jaanee-ai jeevai d ayvan haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, intuitive awareness wells up; through the Name, intelligencecomes.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai surat oopjai naamay mat  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਚੁਪੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਿਗਐ  ਦਾਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, chant the Glories of God; through the Name, peace isobtained.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai gun uchrai naamay sukh  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਿਭ ਮੰਗਤੇ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਦੇਖਿਹ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: With faith in the Name, doubt is eradicated, and the mortal never suffers again.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai bharam katee-ai fir d ukh na ho-ee.

lines.english: With faith in the Name, sing His Praises, and your sinful intellect shall be washedclean.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay mani-ai salaahee-ai paapaaN mat Dh o-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Perfect Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; they alone receive it, unto whom He gives it. ||12|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1242-12) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pooray gur tay naa-o mannee-ai jin d ayvai so-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਮਿਤ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Some read the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: saastar bayd  puraan  parhHaNtaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਿਖ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: They recite them, out of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: pookaarantaa ajaan antaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਿਫਿਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: If they really understood them, they would realize the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaaN boojhai t aaN soojh ai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਪਾਪ  ਮਿਤ ਧੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak says, there is no need to shout so loud. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1242-14) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai kook na ho-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ  ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਿਜਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: When I am Yours, then everything is mine. When I am not, You are.
lines.transliteration: jaaN ha-o tayraa t aaN sabh  kichh  mayraa ha-o naahee t oo hoveh.

lines.english: You Yourself are All-powerful, and You Yourself are the Intuitive Knower. The wholeworld is strung on the Power of Your Shakti.
lines.transliteration: aapay saktaa aapay surt aa sakt ee jagat  paroveh.

lines.english: You Yourself send out the mortal beings, and You Yourself call them back home. Having created the creation, You behold it.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhayjay aapay sad ay rachnaa rach rach vaykh ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, True is the Name of the True Lord; through Truth, one is accepted by thePrimal Lord God. ||2|| pauVI ] (1242-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sachee naaN-ee sach pavai Dhur laykh ai. ||2||

lines.english: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is unknowable. How can it be known?
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan alakh hai ki-o lakh i-aa jaa-ee.

lines.english: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is with the mortal being. How can it be obtained, OSiblings of Destiny?
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan naal hai ki-o paa-ee-ai bhaa-ee.

lines.english: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is all-pervading and permeating everywhere.
lines.transliteration: naam niranjan varatdaa ravi-aa sabh  thaaN-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੂ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained. It is revealed within the heart.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray tay paa-ee-ai hird ai day-ay d ikhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਕਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਕਤੀ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਪਰੋਵਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Grace, the mortal meets with the Guru, OSiblings of Desitny. ||13|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1242-18) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree karam ho-ay gur milee-ai bh aa-ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭੇਜੇ ਆਪੇ  ਸਦੇ ਰਚਨਾ  ਰਿਚ ਰਿਚ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, people have faces like dogs; they eat rotting carcasses for food.
lines.transliteration: kal ho-ee kutay muhee kh aaj ho-aa murd aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਈ  ਸਚੁ ਪਵੈ ਧੁਿਰ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They bark and speak, telling only lies; all thought of righteousness has left them.
lines.transliteration: koorh bol bol bh a-ukan aa chookaa Dh aram beechaar.

lines.english: Those who have no honor while alive, will have an evil reputation after they die. pMnw 1243
lines.transliteration: jin jeevandi-aa pat  nahee mu-i-aa mand ee so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever is predestined, happens, O Nanak; whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1243-1) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa hovai naankaa kart aa karay so ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Women have become advisors, and men have become hunters.
lines.transliteration: rannaa ho-ee-aa boDhee-aa puras ho-ay sa-ee-aad .

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਨਾ ਹੋਈਆ  ਬੋਧੀਆ  ਪੁਰਸ  ਹੋਏ ਸਈਆਦ  ॥
lines.english: Humility, self-control and purity have run away; people eat the uneatable, forbidden food.
lines.transliteration: seel sanjam such bhannee kh aanaa kh aaj ahaaj.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਲੁ  ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸੁਚ ਭੰਨੀ ਖਾਣਾ  ਖਾਜੁ ਅਹਾਜੁ  ॥
lines.english: Modesty has left her home, and honor has gone away with her.
lines.transliteration: saram ga-i-aa ghar aapn ai pat  uth chalee naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਮੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਪਿਤ ਉਿਠ ਚਲੀ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there is only One True Lord; do not bother to search for any other as true. ||2|| pauVI ] (1243-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa ayk hai a-or na sachaa bhaal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You smear your outer body with ashes, but within, you are filled with darkness.
lines.transliteration: baahar bhasam laypan karay ant ar gubaaree.

lines.english: You wear the patched coat and all the right clothes and robes, but you are stillegotistical and proud.
lines.transliteration: khinthaa jh olee baho bh aykh karay d urmat  ahaNkaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭਸਮ  ਲੇਪਨ  ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਬਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You do not chant the Shabad, the Word of Your Lord and Master; you are attached tothe expanse of Maya.
lines.transliteration: saahib sabad na oochrai maa-i-aa moh pasaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਝੋਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Within, you are filled with greed and doubt; you wander around like a fool.
lines.transliteration: antar laalach bh aram hai bh armai gaavaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਊਚਰੈ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, you never even think of the Naam; you have lost the game of life in thegamble. ||14|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1243-5) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na chayt-ee joo-ai baajee haaree. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲਾਲਚੁ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ  ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You may be in love with tens of thousands, and live for thousands of years; but whatgood are these pleasures and occupations?
lines.transliteration: lakh si-o pareet  hovai lakh  jeevan  ki-aa kh usee-aa ki-aa chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ  ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ  ਹਾਰੀ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: And when you must separate from them, that separation is like poison, but they will be gone in an instant.
lines.transliteration: vichhurh i-aa vis ho-ay vichh orhaa ayk gh arhee meh jaa-ay.

lines.english: You may eat sweets for a hundred years, but eventually, you will have to eat thebitter as well.
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o varHi-aa mithaa kh aajai bh ee fir ka-urh aa kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਲਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Then, you will not remember eating the sweets; bitterness will permeate you.
lines.transliteration: mithaa kh aaDhaa chit  na aavai ka-urh -tan Dhaa-ay jaa-ay.

lines.english: The sweet and the bitter are both diseases.
lines.transliteration: mithaa ka-urh aa dovai rog.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਿਰਆ  ਿਮਠਾ  ਖਾਜੈ ਭੀ ਿਫਿਰ  ਕਉੜਾ  ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, eating them, you will come to ruin in the end.
lines.transliteration: naanak ant vigut ay bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਠਾ  ਖਾਧਾ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਕਉੜਤਣੁ  ਧਾਇ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It is useless to worry and struggle to death.
lines.transliteration: jhakh  jhakh jhakh-naa jhagrhaa jhaakh.

lines.english: Entangled in worries and struggles, people exhaust themselves. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1243-9) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jhakh  jhakh jaahi jh akheh tinH paas. ||1||

lines.english: They have fine clothes and furniture of various colors.
lines.transliteration: kaaparh kaath  rangaa-i-aa raaNg.

lines.english: Their houses are painted beautifully white.
lines.transliteration: ghar gach keet ay baagay baag.

lines.english: In pleasure and poise, they play their mind games.
lines.transliteration: saad sahj kar man kh aylaa-i-aa.

lines.english: When they approach You, O Lord, they shall be spoken to.
lines.transliteration: tai sah paashu kahan  kahaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They think it is sweet, so they eat the bitter.
lines.transliteration: mithaa kar kai ka-urh aa kh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The bitter disease grows in the body.
lines.transliteration: tin ka-urh ai tan rog jamaa-i-aa.

lines.english: If, later on, they receive the sweet,
lines.transliteration: jay fir mithaa payrh ai paa-ay.
ta-o ka-urh -tan chookas maa-ay. then their bitterness shall be gone, O mother.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed to receive
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paavai so-ay.

lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jis no paraapat likh i-aa ho-ay. ||2|| what he is predestined to receive. ||2|| pauVI ] (1243-12) pa-orhee.

lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with the filth of deception, may wash themselves on the outside.
lines.transliteration: jin kai hirdai mail kapat hai baahar Dh ovaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They practice falsehood and deception, and their falsehood is revealed.
lines.transliteration: koorh kapat kamaavd ay koorh  pargatee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: That which is within them, comes out; it cannot be concealed by concealment.
lines.transliteration: andar ho-ay so niklai nah chh apai chh apaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Attached to falsehood and greed, the mortal is consigned to reincarnation over andover again.
lines.transliteration: koorhai laalach lagi-aa fir joonee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, whatever the mortal plants, he must eat. The Creator Lord has written ourdestiny. ||15|| slok mÚ 2 ] (1243-14) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo beejai so khaavn aa kart ai likh  paa-i-aa. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Vedas bring forth stories and legends, and thoughts of vice and virtue.
lines.transliteration: kathaa kahaanee bayd eeN aanee paap punn beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: What is given, they receive, and what is received, they give. They are reincarnated inheaven and hell.
lines.transliteration: day d ay lain aa lai lai d aynaa narak surag avt aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਿਨਕਲੈ  ਨਹ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: High and low, social class and status - the world wanders lost in superstition.
lines.transliteration: utam maDh im jaat eeN jinsee bh aram bh avai sansaar.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Word of Gurbani proclaims the essence of reality. Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained within it.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee tat vakh aanee gi-aan Dh i-aan vich aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਲਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs chant it, and the Gurmukhs realize it. Intuitively aware, they meditateon it.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aakh ee gurmukh  jaatee surt eeN karam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.english: By the Hukam of His Command, He formed the Universe, and in His Hukam, He keepsit. By His Hukam, He keeps it under His Gaze.
lines.transliteration: hukam saaj hukmai vich rakhai hukmai and ar vaykh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀ  ਬੇਦੀ ਆਣੀ  ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if the mortal shatters his ego before he departs, as it is pre-ordained, thenhe is approved. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1243-18) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak agahu ha-umai tutai t aaN ko likee-ai laykh ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਲੈਣਾ  ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦੇਣਾ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਸੁਰਿਗ  ਅਵਤਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Vedas proclaim that vice and virtue are the seeds of heaven and hell.
lines.transliteration: bayd pukaaray punn paap surag narak kaa bee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਉਤਮ ਮਿਧਮ  ਜਾਤੀਂ  ਿਜਨਸੀ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Whatever is planted, shall grow. The soul eats the fruits of its actions, andunderstands.
lines.transliteration: jo beejai so ugvai khaaNdaa jaan ai jee-o.

lines.english: Whoever praises spiritual wisdom as great, becomes truthful in the True Name.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan salaahay vadaa kar sacho sachaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਖੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਤੀ  ਸੁਰਤੀ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਧਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: When Truth is planted, Truth grows. In the Court of the Lord, you shall find your place of honor. pMnw 1244
lines.transliteration: sach beejai sach ugvai dargeh paa-ee-ai thaa-o.

lines.english: The Vedas are only merchants; spiritual wisdom is the capital; by His Grace, it is received.
lines.transliteration: bayd vapaaree gi-aan raas karmee palai ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦੁ ਵਪਾਰੀ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without capital, no one has ever departed with profit. ||2|| pauVI ] (1244-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak raasee baahraa lad na chali-aa ko-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਸੀ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਲਿਦ  ਨ ਚਿਲਆ  ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You can water a bitter neem tree with ambrosial nectar.
lines.transliteration: nimm birakh baho sanchee-ai amrit  ras paa-i-aa.

lines.english: You can feed a venomous snake lots of milk.
lines.transliteration: bisee-ar mantar visaahee-ai baho d ooDh pee-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is resistant; he cannot be softened. You might as well watera stone.
lines.transliteration: manmukh abh inn na bh ij-ee pathar navaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Irrigating a poisonous plant with ambrosial nectar, only poisonous fruit is obtained.
lines.transliteration: bikh meh amrit  sinchee-ai bikh  kaa fal paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Lord, please unite Nanak with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, so that he may be rid of all poison. ||16|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1244-4) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sangat mayl har sabh  bikh leh jaa-i-aa. ||16||

lines.english: Death does not ask the time; it does not ask the date or the day of the week.
lines.transliteration: maran na moorat  puchh i-aa puchh ee thit  na vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਿਲ ਹਿਰ ਸਭ ਿਬਖੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Some have packed up, and some who have packed up have gone.
lines.transliteration: iknHee ladi-aa ik lad  chalay iknHee baDh ay bh aar.

lines.english: Some are severely punished, and some are taken care of.
lines.transliteration: iknHaa ho-ee saakh-t ee iknHaa ho-ee saar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਿਣ  ਨ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੁਿਛਆ  ਪੁਛੀ ਿਥਿਤ  ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They must leave their armies and drums, and their beautiful mansions.
lines.transliteration: laskar sanai d amaami-aa chh utay bank d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨੀ  ਲਿਦਆ  ਇਿਕ  ਲਿਦ  ਚਲੇ ਇਕਨੀ  ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the pile of dust is once again reduced to dust. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1244-7) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak dhayree chh aar kee bh ee fir ho-ee chh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਹੋਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਹੋਈ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the pile shall fall apart; the fortress of the body is made of dust.
lines.transliteration: naanak dhayree dh eh pa-ee mitee sand aa kot.

lines.punjabi: ਲਸਕਰ  ਸਣੈ ਦਮਾਿਮਆ  ਛੁਟੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: The thief has settled within you; O soul, your life is false. ||2|| pauVI ] (1244-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: bheet ar chor bahaali-aa kh ot vay jee-aa kh ot. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਢੇਰੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਭੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਹੋਈ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are filled with vicious slander, shall have their noses cut, and be shamed.
lines.transliteration: jin andar nind aa dusat hai nak vadh ay nak vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: They are totally ugly, and always in pain. Their faces are blackened by Maya.
lines.transliteration: mahaa karoop dukh ee-ay sad aa kaalay muh maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਢੇਰੀ ਢਿਹ ਪਈ ਿਮਟੀ  ਸੰਦਾ ਕੋਟੁ ॥
lines.english: They rise early in the morning, to cheat and steal from others; they hide from the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bhalkay uth  nit par d arab hireh har naam churaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਚੋਰੁ ਬਹਾਿਲਆ  ਖੋਟੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਖੋਟੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, let me not even associate with them; save me from them, O my Sovereign Lord King.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tin kee sangat  mat karahu rakh  layho har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs act according to their past deeds, producingnothing but pain. ||17|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1244-10) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak pa-i-ai kirat kamaavd ay manmukh  dukh paa-i-aa. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਨਕ ਵਢੇ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone belongs to our Lord and Master. Everyone came from Him.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko-ee hai kh asam kaa kh asmahu sabh  ko ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਕਰੂਪ  ਦੁਖੀਏ  ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Only by realizing the Hukam of His Command, is Truth obtained.
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaan ai khasam kaa t aa sach paavai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਲਕੇ  ਉਿਠ ਿਨਤ  ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ  ਿਹਰਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes his own self; no one appears evil to him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap pachh aanee-ai buraa na d eesai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Fruitful is his coming into the world. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1244-13) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ee-ai sahilaa aa-i-aa so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਇਐ  ਿਕਰਿਤ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Giver of all; He unites all with Himself.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa d aataa aap hai aapay maylan haar.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are united with the Word of the Shabad; serving the Lord, the GreatGiver, they shall never be separated from Him again. ||2|| pauVI ] (1244-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad milay na vichh urheh jinaa sayvi-aa har d aataar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Peace and tranquility fill the heart of the Gu rmukh; the Name wells up within them.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hird ai saaNt hai naa-o ugav aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Chanting and meditation, penance and self-discipline, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage - the merits of these come by pleasing my God.
lines.transliteration: jap tap t irath sanjam karay mayray parabh  bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: So serve the Lord with a pure heart; singing His Glorious Praises, you shall be embellished and exalted.
lines.transliteration: hirdaa suDh  har sayvd ay soheh gun  gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਸਿਹਲਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Dear Lord is pleased by this; he carries the Gurmukh across.
lines.transliteration: mayray har jee-o ayvai bhaavd aa gurmukh  taraa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is merged with the Lord; he is embellished in His Court. ||18|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1244-16) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mayli-an har d ar sohaa-i-aa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Dhanvant aa iv hee kahai avree Dh an ka-o jaa-o. Thus speaks the wealthy man: I should go and get more wealth.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak becomes poor on that day when he forgets the Lord's Name. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1244-17) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nirDhan t it din jit din visrai naa-o. ||1||

lines.english: The sun rises and sets, and the lives of all run out.
lines.transliteration: sooraj charhai vijog sabh sai gh atai aarjaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੈ ਨਾਉ  ਉਗਿਵ  ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The mind and body experience pleasures; one loses, and another wins.
lines.transliteration: tan man rat aa bh og ko-ee haarai ko jin ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ  ਸੰਜਮ  ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone is puffed up with pride; even after they are spoken to, they do not stop.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko bh ari-aa fook aakh an kahan  na thamH-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦਾ  ਸੁਧੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਸੋਹਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; when He takes the air out of the balloon, the body falls. ||2|| pauVI ] (1244-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak vaykhai aap fook kadh aa-ay dh eh pavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਤਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Name is in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. There, the Lord is found. pMnw 1245
lines.transliteration: satsangat  naam niDh aan hai jithahu har paa-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ghat chaann aa aanHayr gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣਾ  ਆਨੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Iron is transformed into gold, when it touches the Philosopher's Stone.
lines.transliteration: lohaa paaras bhaytee-ai kanchan ho-ay aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਿਸ  ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, the Name is obtained. Meeting Him, the mortal meditates on the Name.
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai naa-o paa-ee-ai mil naam Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who have virtue as their treasure, obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.||19|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1245-3) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinH kai potai punn hai t inHee darsan paa-i-aa. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਨੀ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Dharig t inaa kaa jeevi-aa je likh  likh vaycheh naa-o. Cursed are the lives of those who read and write the Lord's Name to sell it.
Their crop is devastated - what harvest will they have?
lines.transliteration: khayt ee jin kee ujrh ai khalvaarh ay ki-aa thaa-o.

lines.english: Lacking truth and humility, they shall not be appreciated in the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: sachai sarmai baahray agai laheh na daad .

lines.english: Wisdom which leads to arguments is not called wisdom.
lines.transliteration: akal ayh na aakhee-ai akal gavaa-ee-ai baad .

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਰਮੈ  ਬਾਹਰੇ  ਅਗੈ ਲਹਿਹ  ਨ ਦਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Wisdom leads us to serve our Lord and Master; through wisdom, honor is obtained.
lines.transliteration: aklee saahib sayvee-ai aklee paa-ee-ai maan.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਿਲ  ਏਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ  ਅਕਿਲ ਗਵਾਈਐ  ਬਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Wisdom does not come by reading textbooks; wisdom inspires us to give in charity.
lines.transliteration: aklee parhH kai bujh ee-ai aklee keechai d aan.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਲੀ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਅਕਲੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this is the Path; other things lead to Satan. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (1245-6) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai raahu ayhu hor galaaN saitaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਲੀ  ਪਿੜ ਕੈ ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਅਕਲੀ  ਕੀਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Mortals are known by their actions; this is the way it has to be.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa karai kahaavai taisaa aisee banee jaroorat .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਆਖੈ  ਰਾਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਹੋਿਰ ਗਲ  ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: They should show goodness, and not be deformed by their actions; this is how they are called beautiful.
lines.transliteration: hoveh liny jh iny nah hoveh aisee kahee-ai soorat .

lines.english: Whatever they desire, they shall receive; O Nanak, they become the very image ofGod. ||2|| pauVI ] (1245-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jo os ichhay so fal paa-ay t aaN naanak kahee-ai moorat . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ਤੈਸਾ ਐਸੀ  ਬਨੀ ਜਰੂਰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the tree of ambrosia. it bears the fruit of sweet nectar.
lines.transliteration: satgur amrit  birakh  hai amrit  ras fali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਿਲੰਙ ਿਝੰਙ ਨਹ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਐਸੀ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਸੂਰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: He alone receives it, who is so pre-destined, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jis paraapat so lahai gur sabd ee mili-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਓਸੁ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, is blended with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai jo chalai har sayt ee rali-aa.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot even see him; his heart is illumined with God's Light.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal johi na sak-ee ghat chaanan  bali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਿਸ ਫਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God forgives him, and blends him with Himself; he does not rot away in thewomb of reincarnation ever again. ||20|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1245-10) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhas milaa-i-an fir garabh  na gali-aa. ||20||

lines.english: Those who have truth as their fast, contentment as their sacred shrine of pilgrimage, spiritual wisdom and meditation as their cleansing bath,
lines.transliteration: sach varat sant okh tirath gi-aan Dh i-aan isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: da-i-aa d ayvtaa kh imaa japmaalee t ay maan as parDh aan. kindness as their deity, and forgiveness as their chanting beads - they are the mostexcellent people.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਘਿਟ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਬਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who take the Way as their loincloth, and intuitive awareness their ritualisticallypurified enclosure, with good deeds their ceremonial forehead mark,
lines.transliteration: jugat Dh otee surat  cha-ukaa t ilak karn ee ho-ay.

lines.english: Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh ojan naankaa virlaa t a ko-ee ko-ay. ||1|| and love their food - O Nanak, they are very rare. ||1|| mhlw 3 ] (1245-12) mehlaa 3.

lines.english: On the ninth day of the month, make a vow to speak the Truth,
lines.transliteration: na-umee naym sach jay karai.
kaam kroDh t arisnaa uchrai. and your sexual desire, anger and desire shall be eaten up.

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆ  ਦੇਵਤਾ  ਿਖਮਾ  ਜਪਮਾਲੀ  ਤੇ ਮਾਣਸ  ਪਰਧਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: On the tenth day, regulate your ten doors; on the eleventh day, know that the Lord isOne.
lines.transliteration: dasmee d asay d u-aar jay th aakai aykaad asee ayk kar jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਧੋਤੀ ਸੁਰਿਤ ਚਉਕਾ  ਿਤਲਕੁ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: On the twelfth day, the five thieves are subdued, and then, O Nanak, the mind ispleased and appeased.
lines.transliteration: du-aad asee panch vasgat  kar raakh ai ta-o naanak man maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਤ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Observe such a fast as this, O Pandit, O religious scholar; of what use are all the other teachings? ||2|| pauVI ] (1245-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aisaa varat raheejai paaday hor bahut  sikh ki-aa d eejai. ||2||

lines.english: Kings, rulers and monarchs enjoy pleasures and gather the poison of Maya.
lines.transliteration: bhoopat  raajay rang raa-ay saNcheh bikh  maa-i-aa.

lines.english: In love with it, they collect more and more, stealing the wealth of others.
lines.transliteration: kar kar hayt vaDh aa-iday par d arab churaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They do not trust their own children or spouses; they are totally attached to the loveof Maya.
lines.transliteration: putar kalt ar na vishahi baho pareet  lagaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਸਮੀ  ਦਸੇ ਦੁਆਰ  ਜੇ ਠਾਕੈ ਏਕਾਦਸੀ  ਏਕੁ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: But even as they look on, Maya cheats them, and they come to regret and repent.
lines.transliteration: vaykh-d i-aa hee maa-i-aa Dh uhi ga-ee pachh uteh pachh utaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ  ਪੰਚ ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are beaten and punished; O Nanak, itpleases the Will of the Lord. ||21|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1245-17) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jam dar baDh ay maaree-ah naanak har bh aa-i-aa. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਵਰਤੁ  ਰਹੀਜੈ  ਪਾਡੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਸਖ ਿਕਆ  ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The one who lacks spiritual wisdom sings religious songs.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan vihoonaa gaavai geet .

lines.english: The hungry Mullah turns his home into a mosque.
lines.transliteration: bhukh ay mulaaN gharay maseet .

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਪਿਤ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਇ  ਸੰਚਿਹ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The lazy unemployed has his ears pierced to look like a Yogi.
lines.transliteration: makhtoo ho-ay kai kann parh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਦੇ  ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ  ਚੁਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Someone else becomes a pan-handler, and loses his social status.
lines.transliteration: fakar karay hor jaat gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਨ ਿਵਸਹਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he goes around begging
lines.transliteration: gur peer sadaa-ay mangan  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਖਿਦਆ  ਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ਧੁਿਹ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਿਹ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kai mool na lagee-ai paa-ay. - don't ever touch his feet.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: One who works for what he eats, and gives some of what he has
lines.transliteration: ghaal kh aa-ay kichh  hathahu d ay-ay.

lines.english: - O Nanak, he knows the Path. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1246-1) mehlaa 1. First Mehl: pMnw 1246
lines.transliteration: naanak raahu pachhaan eh say-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Those mortals whose minds are like deep dark pits do not understand the purpose of life, even when it is explained to them.
lines.transliteration: manhu je anDhay koop kahi-aa birad  na jaan anHee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹੁ ਿਜ ਅੰਧੇ ਕੂਪ ਕਿਹਆ  ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds are blind, and their heart-lotuses are upside-down; they look totally ugly.
lines.transliteration: man anDhai ooNDhai kaval d isniH kharay karoop.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਅੰਧੈ ਊਂਧੈ ਕਵਿਲ  ਿਦਸਿਨ  ਖਰੇ ਕਰੂਪ  ॥
lines.english: Some know how to speak, and understand what they are told. They are wise and beautiful.
lines.transliteration: ik kahi jaaneh kahi-aa bujh eh tay nar sugh arh saroop.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਕਿਹ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਬੁਝਿਹ  ਤੇ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ  ਸਰੂਪ  ॥
lines.english: Some do not understand about the Sound-current of the Naad or the Vedas, music,virtue or vice.
lines.transliteration: iknaa naad na bayd  na gee-a ras ras kas na jaan ant.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਨਾਦ  ਨ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਗੀਅ  ਰਸੁ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Some are not blessed with understanding, intelligence, or sublime intellect; they do not grasp the mystery of God's Word.
lines.transliteration: iknaa suDh na buDh  na akal sar akh ar kaa bh ay-o na laahant .

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਸੁਿਧ ਨ ਬੁਿਧ ਨ ਅਕਿਲ  ਸਰ ਅਖਰ  ਕਾ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਲਹੰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they are donkeys; they are very proud of themselves, but they have novirtues at all. ||2|| pauVI ] (1246-4) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak say nar asal khar je bin gun  garab karant . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਨਰ ਅਸਿਲ  ਖਰ ਿਜ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ  ਕਰੰਿਤ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: To the Gurmukh, everything is sacred: wealth, property, Maya.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabh  pavit  hai Dh an sampai maa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who spend the wealth of the Lord find peace through giving.
lines.transliteration: har arath jo kharchad ay dayNday sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਭ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name shall never be deprived.
lines.transliteration: jo har naam Dhi-aa-id ay tin tot na aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਰਿਥ  ਜੋ ਖਰਚਦੇ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs come to see the Lord, and leave behind the things of Maya.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaaN nadree aavd aa maa-i-aa sut paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਦੇ  ਿਤਨ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees do not think of anything else; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||22|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1246-6) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt aaN hor chit  na aavee har naam samaa-i-aa. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਆਵਦਾ  ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਿਟ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan say vadbh aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਹੋਰੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: They are lovingly attuned to the True Shabad, the Word of the One God.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad jinHaa ayk liv laagee.

lines.english: In their own household and family, they are in natural Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: girah kutamb meh sahj samaaDhee.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are truly detached from the world. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1246-8) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say sachay bairaagee. ||1||

lines.english: Calculated service is not service at all, and what is done is not approved.
lines.transliteration: gantai sayv na hova-ee keet aa thaa-ay na paa-ay.

lines.english: The flavor of the Shabad, the Word of God, is not tasted if the mortal is not in love with the True Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  na aa-i-o sach na lago bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The stubborn-minded person does not even like the True Guru; he comes and goes inreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: satgur pi-aaraa na lag-ee manhath  aavai jaa-ay.

lines.english: He takes one step forward, and ten steps back.
lines.transliteration: jay ik vikh agaahaa bh aray t aaN das vikh aaN pichh aahaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤੈ  ਸੇਵ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal works to serve the True Guru, if he walks in harmony with the True Guru'sWill.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvaa chaakree jay chaleh sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਸਿਚ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: He loses his self-conceit, and meets the True Guru; he remains intuitively absorbed inthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: aap gavaa-ay satguroo no milai sehjay rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਮਨਹਿਠ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are united in Unionwith the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1246-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak tinHaa naam na veesrai sachay mayl milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਿਵਖ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਭਰੇ ਤ ਦਸ ਿਵਖ  ਿਪਛਾਹਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They call themselves emperors and rulers, but none of them will be allowed to stay.
lines.transliteration: khaan malook kahaa-id ay ko rahan  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਜੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their sturdy forts and mansions - none of them will go along with them.
lines.transliteration: garhH mand ar gach geeree-aa kichh  saath na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their gold and horses, fast as the wind, are cursed, and cursed are their clever tricks.
lines.transliteration: so-in saakhat  pa-un  vayg Dh arig Dh arig chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਸਚੇ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Eating the thirty-six delicacies, they become bloated with pollution.
lines.transliteration: chhat eeh amrit  parkaar karahi baho mail vaDh aa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh does not know the One who gives, and so he suffers in pain. ||23|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1246-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo dayvai t iseh na jaan anHee manmukh  dukh paa-ee. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ  ਕਹਾਇਦੇ  ਕੋ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and recite until they gettired. They wander through foreign lands in their religious robes, until they areexhausted.
lines.transliteration: parhH parhH pandit  monee thakay d aysant ar bhav thakay bh aykh-Dhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰ  ਗਚ ਗੀਰੀਆ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In love with duality, they never receive the Name. Held in the grasp of pain, theysuffer terribly.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay naa-o kad ay na paa-in d ukh laagaa at  bhaaree.

lines.english: The blind fools serve the three gunas, the three dispositions; they deal only withMaya.
lines.transliteration: moorakh anDh ay tarai gun  sayveh maa-i-aa kai bi-uhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਛਤੀਹ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਪਰਕਾਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: With deception in their hearts, the fools read sacred texts to fill their bellies.
lines.transliteration: andar kapat ud ar bharan kai taa-ee paath  parheh gaavaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: One who serves the True Guru finds peace; he eradicates egotism from within.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay so sukh  paa-ay jin ha-umai vichahu maaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is One Name to chant and dwell on; how rare are those who reflect on this and understand. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1246-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak parh-n aa gunn aa ik naa-o hai boojh ai ko beechaaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੇਸੰਤਰ  ਭਿਵ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Naked we come, and naked we go. This is by the Lord's Command; what else can wedo?
lines.transliteration: naaNgay aavnaa naaNgay jaan aa har hukam paa-i-aa ki-aa keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਨਾਉ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The object belongs to Him; He shall take it away; with whom should one be angry.
lines.transliteration: jis kee vasat so-ee lai jaa-igaa ros kisai si-o keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੇਵਿਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਿਬਉਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: One who becomes Gurmukh accepts God's Will; he intuitively drinks in the Lord'ssublime essence.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so bh aanaa mannay sehjay har ras peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕਪਟੁ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਣ  ਕੈ ਤਾਈ  ਪਾਠ ਪੜਿਹ  ਗਾਵਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Giver of peace forever; with your tongue, savor the Lord. ||2|| pMnw 1247 pauVI ] (1247-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh-d aata sad aa salaahihu rasnaa raam raveejai. ||2||

lines.english: The fortress of the body has been decorated and adorned in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: garheh kaa-i-aa seegaar baho bh aaNt banaa-ee.

lines.english: The wealthy wear beautiful silk robes of various colors.
lines.transliteration: rang parang kateefi-aa pahirahi Dh ar maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿੜ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਸੀਗਾਰ  ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: They hold elegant and beautiful courts, on red and white carpets.
lines.transliteration: laal supayd d uleechi-aa baho sabh aa ban aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ  ਕਤੀਿਫਆ  ਪਿਹਰਿਹ  ਧਰ ਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: But they eat in pain, and in pain they seek pleasure; they are very proud of their pride.
lines.transliteration: dukh khaanaa dukh bhognaa garbai garbaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਸੁਪੇਦ  ਦੁਲੀਿਚਆ  ਬਹੁ ਸਭਾ ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the mortal does not even think of the Name, which shall deliver him in theend. ||24|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1247-3) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na chayti-o ant  la-ay chh adaa-ee. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਭੋਗਣਾ  ਗਰਬੈ  ਗਰਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: She sleeps in intuitive peace and poise, absorbed in the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sehjay sukh sut ee sabad  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: God hugs her close in His Embrace, and merges her into Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapay parabh mayl la-ee gal laa-ay.

lines.english: Duality is eradicated with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa chookee sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: The Naam comes to abide in her mind.
lines.transliteration: antar naam vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਮੇਿਲ ਲਈ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He hugs close in His Embrace those who shatter and reform their beings.
lines.transliteration: say kanth laa-ay je bh ann gh arhaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are predestined to meet Him, come and meet Him now. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1247-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo Dhur milay say hun  aan milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord - so what if they chant otherchants?
lines.transliteration: jinHee naam visaari-aa ki-aa jap jaapeh hor.

lines.english: They are maggots in manure, plundered by the thief of worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: bistaa andar keet say muth ay Dh anDhai chor.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਿਣ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; greed for anything else is false. ||2|| pauVI ] (1247-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai jhooth ay laalach hor. ||2||

lines.english: Those who praise the Naam, and believe in the Naam, are eternally stable in thisworld.
lines.transliteration: naam salaahan naam man asthir jag so-ee.

lines.english: Within their hearts, they dwell on the Lord, and nothing else at all.
lines.transliteration: hirdai har har chit vai doojaa nahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਮੁਠੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਿਰ ॥
lines.english: With each and every hair, they chant the Lord's Name, each and every instant, the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rom rom har uchrai khin kh in har so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚ  ਹੋਿਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The birth of the Gurmukh is fruitful and certified; pure and unstained, his filth iswashed away.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh janam sakaarthaa nirmal mal kh o-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditating on the Lord of eternal life, the status of immortality is obtained.||25|| sloku mÚ 3 ] (1247-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevdaa purakh  Dhi-aa-i-aa amraa pad  ho-ee. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਜਿਗ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Naam and do other things,
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa baho karam kamaaveh hor.

lines.english: O Nanak, will be bound and gagged and beaten in the City of Death, like the thiefcaught red-handed. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1247-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jam pur baDhay maaree-ah ji-o sanHee upar chor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਿਮ ਰੋਿਮ ਹਿਰ ਉਚਰੈ  ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Dharat  suhaavarh ee aakaas suhand aa japand i-aa har naa-o. The earth is beauteous, and the sky is lovely, chanting the Name of the Lord.
O Nanak, those who lack the Naam - their carcasses are eaten by the crows. ||2|| pauVI ] (1247-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihooni-aa t inH tan kh aaveh kaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਦਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਅਮਰਾ  ਪਦੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Those who lovingly praise the Naam, and dwell in the mansion of the self deep within,
lines.transliteration: naam salaahan bhaa-o kar nij mahlee vaasaa.
o-ay baahurh jon na aavnee fir hohi na binaasaa. do not enter into reincarnation ever again; they shall never be destroyed.

lines.english: They remain immersed and absorbed in the love of the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.
lines.transliteration: har saytee rang rav rahay sabh  saas giraasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਿਜਉ  ਸੰਨੀ ਉਪਿਰ  ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; the Gurmukhs are enlightened.
lines.transliteration: har kaa rang kaday na ut rai gurmukh  pargaasaa.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He unites them with Himself; O Nanak, the Lord keeps them byHis side. ||26|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1247-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: o-ay kirpaa kar kai mayli-an naanak har paasaa. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਆਕਾਸੁ  ਸੁਹੰਦਾ  ਜਪੰਿਦਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: As long as his mind is disturbed by waves, he is caught in ego and egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: jichar ih man lahree vich hai ha-umai bahut ahaNkaar.

lines.english: He does not find the taste of the Shabad, and he does not embrace love for theName.
lines.transliteration: sabdai saad  na aavee naam na lagai pi-aar.

lines.english: His service is not accepted; worrying and worrying, he wastes away in misery.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa thaa-ay na pav-ee tis kee kh ap kh ap ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਨ  ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਿਨਜ ਮਹਲੀ  ਵਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is called a selfless servant, who cuts off his head, and offers it to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak sayvak so-ee aakhee-ai jo sir Dh aray ut aar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ  ਿਫਿਰ ਹੋਿਹ ਨ ਿਬਨਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: He accepts the Will of the True Guru, and enshrines the Shabad within his heart. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1247-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa man la-ay sabad  rakhai ur Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਿਗਰਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: That is chanting and meditation, work and selfless service, which is pleasing to ourLord and Master.
lines.transliteration: so jap tap sayvaa chaakree jo kh asmai bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself forgives, and takes away self-conceit, and unites the mortals withHimself.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay mayl la-ay aapat  gavaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਮੇਿਲਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਸਾ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: United with the Lord, the mortal is never separated again; his light merges into theLight.
lines.transliteration: mili-aa kaday na veechh urhai jotee jot  milaavai.

lines.english: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, the mortal understands, when the Lord allows him tounderstand. ||2|| pauVI ] (1247-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur parsaadee so bujhsee jis aap bujh aavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: All are held accountable, even the egotistical self-willed manmukhs.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko laykh ay vich hai manmukh  ahaNkaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They never even think of the Name of the Lord; the Messenger of Death shall hit them on their heads. pMnw 1248
lines.transliteration: har naam kaday na chayt -ee jamkaal sir maaree.

lines.english: Their sin and corruption are like rusty slag; they carry such a heavy load.
lines.transliteration: paap bikaar manoor sabh lad ay baho bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਨੂਰ ਸਿਭ ਲਦੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The path is treacherous and terrifying; how can they cross over to the other side?
lines.transliteration: maarag bikham daraavan aa ki-o t aree-ai t aaree.

lines.english: O Nanak, those whom the Guru protects are saved. They are saved in the Name of the Lord. ||27|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1248-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur raakhay say ubray har naam uDh aaree. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਉਧਾਰੀ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds peace; mortals die and are reborn, overand over again.
lines.transliteration: vin sat gur sayvay sukh  nahee mar jameh vaaro vaar.

lines.english: They have been given the drug of emotional attachment; in love with duality, they aretotally corrupt.
lines.transliteration: moh thag-ulee paa-ee-an baho d oojai bh aa-ay vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Some are saved, by Guru's Grace. Everyone humbly bows before such humble beings.
lines.transliteration: ik gur parsaadee ubray tis jan ka-o karahi sabh  namaskaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ  ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, deep within yourself, day and night. You shall find the Door of Salvation. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1248-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak an-din naam Dh i-aa-ay t oo ant ar jit paavahi mokh  du-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸਿਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Emotionally attached to Maya, the mortal forgets truth, death and the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi visaari-aa sach marnaa har naam.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਤੂ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa kart i-aa janam ga-i-aa and ar dukh sahaam. Engaged in worldly affairs, his life wastes away; deep within himself, he suffers inpain.
O Nanak, those who have the karma of such pre-ordained destiny, serve the TrueGuru and find peace. ||2|| pauVI ] (1248-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur sayv sukh  paa-i-aa jinH poorab likh i-aa karaam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਸਚੁ ਮਰਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Read the account of the Name of the Lord, and you shall never again be called toaccount.
lines.transliteration: laykhaa parh ee-ai har naam fir laykh  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੁ  ॥
lines.english: No one will question you, and you will always be safe in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: puchh na sakai ko-ay har d ar sad  dho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਨ ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਰਾਮੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death will meet you, and be your constant servant.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal milai day bh ayt sayvak nit  ho-ee.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, you shall find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. You shall be famous throughout the world.
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay mahal paa-i-aa pat  pargat lo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਫਿਰ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates at your door; come and merge withthe Lord. ||28|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1248-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak anhad Dh unee d ar vajd ay mili-aa har so-ee. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਿਛ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸਦ ਢੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Whoever follows the Guru's Teachings, attains the most sublime peace of all peace.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa kahi-aa jay karay sukhee hoo sukh  saar.

lines.english: Acting in accordance with the Guru, his fear is cut away; O Nanak, he is carriedacross. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1248-10) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur kee karnee bh a-o katee-ai naanak paavahi paar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਿਤ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The True Lord does not grow old; His Naam is never dirtied.
lines.transliteration: sach puraanaa naa thee-ai naam na mailaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਧੁਨੀ ਦਿਰ ਵਜਦੇ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: Whoever walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall not be reborn again.
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhaan ai jay chalai bahurh  na aavan  ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam, come and go in reincarnation. ||2|| pauVI ] (1248-11) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam visaari-ai aavan jaan aa do-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਿਹਆ  ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I am a beggar; I ask this blessing of You: O Lord, please embellish me with Your Love.
lines.transliteration: mangat jan jaachai d aan har d ayh subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ  ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; His Darshan brings mesatisfaction.
lines.transliteration: har darsan kee pi-aas hai d arsan t ariptaa-ai.

lines.english: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without seeing Him, O my mother.
lines.transliteration: khin pal gh arhee na jeev-oo bin d aykhay maraaN maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ  ਨਾ ਥੀਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru has shown me that the Lord is always with me; He is permeating andpervading all places.
lines.transliteration: satgur naal d ikhaali-aa rav rahi-aa sabh  thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: He Himself wakes the sleepers, O Nanak, and lovingly attunes them to Himself. ||29|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1248-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: suti-aa aap uth aal day-ay naanak liv laa-ay. ||29||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not even know how to speak. They are filled with sexualdesire, anger and egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bol na jaan anHee onaa and ar kaam kroDh  ahaNkaar.

lines.english: They do not know the difference between good and bad; they constantly think of corruption.
lines.transliteration: thaa-o kuthaa-o na jaannee sad aa chit vahi bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਗਤ  ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Court, they are called to account, and they are judged to be false.
lines.transliteration: dargeh laykh aa mangee-ai othai hohi koorh i-aar.

lines.english: He Himself creates the Universe. He Himself contemplates it.
lines.transliteration: aapay sarisat upaa-ee-an aap karay beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whom should we tell? The True Lord is permeating and pervading all. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1248-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no aakhee-ai sabh  vartai aap sachiaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਦਖਾਿਲਆ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਭ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs worship and adore the Lord; they receive the good karma of theiractions.
lines.transliteration: har gurmukh t inHee araaDh i-aa jinH karam paraapat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਠਾਿਲ ਦੇਇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1248-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-o balihaaree tinH ka-o jinH har man vasi-aa so-ay. ||2||

lines.english: All people cherish hope, that they will live long lives.
lines.transliteration: aas karay sabh lok baho jeevan  jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੋਿਲ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਓਨਾ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They wish to live forever; they adorn and embellish their forts and mansions.
lines.transliteration: nit jeevan  ka-o chit  garhH mandap savaari-aa.

lines.english: By various frauds and deceptions, they steal the wealth of others.
lines.transliteration: valvanch kar upaav maa-i-aa hir aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਗਹ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਓਥੈ ਹੋਿਹ ਕੂਿੜਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: But the Messenger of Death keeps his gaze on their breath, and the life of those goblins decreases day by day. pMnw 1249
lines.transliteration: jamkaal nihaalay saas aav ghatai bayt aali-aa.

lines.english: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Guru, and is saved. The Guru, the Lord, is his Protector. ||30|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1249-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur sarnaa-ee ubray har gur rakh vaali-aa. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਉਬਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਰਖਵਾਿਲਆ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: Reading and writing, the Pandits engage in debates and disputes; they are attachedto the flavors of Maya.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  vaad  vkhaanday maa-i-aa moh su-aa-ay.

lines.english: In the love of duality, they forget the Naam. Those foolish mortals shall receive theirpunishment.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay naam visaari-aa man moorakh  milai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: They do not serve the One who created them, who gives sustenance to all.
lines.transliteration: jiniH keetay t isai na sayvnHee daydaa rijak samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The noose of Death around their necks is not cut off; they come and go inreincarnation, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: jam kaa faahaa galhu na katee-ai fir fir aavahi jaa-ay.

lines.english: The True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa sat gur mili-aa t in aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ  ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; O Nanak, theymerge into the True Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1249-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: an-din naam Dh i-aa-id ay naanak sach samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who fall at His Feet deal with the True Lord and serve the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach vanjahi sach sayvd ay je gurmukh  pairee paahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who walk in harmony with the Guru's Will are intuitively absorbed inthe True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1249-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur kai bhaan ai jay chaleh sehjay sach samaahi. ||2||

lines.english: In hope, there is very great pain; the self-willed manmukh focuses his consciousnesson it.
lines.transliteration: aasaa vich at d ukh ghanaa manmukh  chit laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs become desireless, and attain supreme peace.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh bh a-ay niraas param sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਿਹ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the midst of their household, they remain detached; they are lovingly attuned to the Detached Lord.
lines.transliteration: vichay girah udaas alipat  liv laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Sorrow and separation do not cling to them at all. They are pleased with the Lord'sWill.
lines.transliteration: onaa sog vijog na vi-aapa-ee har bhaan aa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਅਿਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they remain forever immersed in the Primal Lord, who blends them withHimself. ||31|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1249-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har saytee sad aa rav rahay Dh ur la-ay milaa-i-aa. ||31||

lines.english: Why keep what is held in trust for another? Giving it back, peace is found.
lines.transliteration: paraa-ee amaan ki-o rakh ee-ai d itee hee sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad rests in the Guru; it does not appear through anyoneelse.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad gur thai tikai hor thai pargat na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਸੋਗੁ ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ਨ ਿਵਆਪਈ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਣਾ  ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The blind man finds a jewel, and goes from house to house selling it.
lines.transliteration: aNnHay vas maanak pa-i-aa gh ar ghar vaychan  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਧੁਿਰ ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: But they cannot appraise it, and they do not offer him even half a shell for it.
lines.transliteration: onaa parakh na aavee adh  na palai paa-ay.

lines.english: If he cannot appraise it himself, then he should have it appraised by an appraiser.
lines.transliteration: jay aap parakh na aavee t aaN paarkh ee-aa thaavhu la-i-o parkh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਾਈ  ਅਮਾਣ  ਿਕਉ  ਰਖੀਐ  ਿਦਤੀ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If he focuses his consciousness, then he obtains the true object, and he is blessed with the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: jay os naal chit laa-ay t aaN vath lahai na-o niDh  palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰ ਥੈ ਿਟਕੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The wealth is within the house, while the world is dying of hunger. Without the TrueGuru, no one has a clue.
lines.transliteration: ghar hod ai Dhan jag bh ukhaa mu-aa bin sat gur sojh ee na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨੇ ਵਿਸ ਮਾਣਕੁ  ਪਇਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਵੇਚਣ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the cooling and soothing Shabad comes to dwell in the mind and body, there isno sorrow or separation there.
lines.transliteration: sabad seet al man t an vasai t ithai sog vijog na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਪਰਖ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਅਢੁ ਨ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The object belongs to someone else, but the fool is proud of it, and shows his shallownature.
lines.transliteration: vasat paraa-ee aap garab karay moorakh  aap gan aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਆਿਪ  ਪਰਖ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਤ ਪਾਰਖੀਆ  ਥਾਵਹੁ ਲਇਓ  ੁ ਪਰਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without understanding, no one obtains it; they come and go inreincarnation, over and over again. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1249-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bin boojhay kinai na paa-i-o fir fir aavai jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ਤ ਵਥੁ ਲਹੈ ਨਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is in ecstasy; I have met my Beloved Lord. My beloved friends, the Saints,are delighted.
lines.transliteration: man anad bh a-i-aa mili-aa har pareet am sarsay sajan  sant pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਰ  ਹੋਦੈ ਧਿਨ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਮੁਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੋਝੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who are united with the Primal Lord shall never be separated again. TheCreator has united them with Himself.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur milay na vichh urheh kabhoo je aap maylay kart aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Shabad permeates my inner being, and I have found the Guru; all my sorrows are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: antar sabad  ravi-aa gur paa-i-aa saglay d ookh nivaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਵਸਤੁ  ਪਰਾਈ  ਆਿਪ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਕਰੇ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਣਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: I praise forever the Lord, the Giver of peace; I keep Him enshrined deep within myheart.
lines.transliteration: har sukh-d aata sad aa salaahee ant ar rakh aaN ur Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਿਫਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can the self-willed manmukh gossip about those who are embellished andexalted in the True Word of the Shabad?
lines.transliteration: manmukh t in kee bakh eelee ke karay je sachai sabad  savaaray.

lines.english: My Beloved Himself preserves the honor of those who have come to the Guru's Doorseeking Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: onaa dee aap pat  rakhsee mayraa pi-aaraa sarn aagat  pa-ay gur d u-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ ਸਰਸੇ  ਸਜਣ  ਸੰਤ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are filled with joy; their faces are radiant in the Court of theLord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1249-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh say suhaylay bh a-ay mukh  oojal d arbaaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਕਬਹੂ ਿਜ ਆਿਪ  ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The husband and wife are very much in love; joining together, their love increases.
lines.transliteration: istaree purkh ai baho pareet  mil moh vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਵਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing on his children and his wife, the man is pleased and attached to Maya.
lines.transliteration: putar kalat ar nit vaykh ai vigsai mohi maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਖ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Stealing the wealth of his own country and other lands, he brings it home and feeds them. pMnw 1250
lines.transliteration: days pard ays Dh an choraa-ay aan  muhi paa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the end, hatred and conflict well up, and no one can save him.
lines.transliteration: ant hovai vair viroDh  ko sakai na chh adaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਹੋਵੈ ਵੈਰ ਿਵਰੋਧੁ  ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਛਡਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, those loving attachments are cursed; engrossed in them, he suffers in pain. ||32|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1250-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai Dh arig moh jit  lag d ukh paa-i-aa. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਲਿਗ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam. Eating it, all hunger departs.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh amrit  naam hai jit  khaaDhai sabh  bhukh jaa-ay.

lines.english: There is no thirst or desire at all, when the Naam comes to dwell in the mind.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa mool na hova-ee naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ  ਖਾਧੈ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Eating anything other than the Name, disease runs to afflict the body.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai je hor khaan aa tit rog lagai t an Dh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whoever takes the Praise of the Shabad as his spices and flavors - the Lordunites him in His Union. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1250-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ras kas sabad salaahn aa aapay la-ay milaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਜ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The life within all living beings is the Word of the Shabad. Through it, we meet ourHusband Lord.
lines.transliteration: jee-aa andar jee-o sabad  hai jit  sah maylaavaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਲਾਹਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, the world is in darkness. Through the Shabad, it is enlightened.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai jag aanHayr hai sabd ay pargat ho-ay.

lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages read and write until they areweary. The religious fanatics are tired of washing their bodies.
lines.transliteration: pandit monee parh  parh thakay bh aykh thakay t an Dh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ  ਸਹ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, no one attains the Lord; the miserable depart weeping andwailing.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai kinai na paa-i-o d ukhee-ay chalay ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਜਿਗ  ਆਨੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦੇ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the Merciful Lord is attained. ||2|| pauVI ] (1250-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree paa-ee-ai karam paraapat  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮੋਨੀ ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਤਨੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The husband and wife are very much in love; sitting together, they make evil plans.
lines.transliteration: istaree purkh ai at nayhu bahi mand  pakaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਦੁਖੀਏ  ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All that is seen shall pass away. This is the Will of my God.
lines.transliteration: disdaa sabh  kichh  chalsee mayray parabh  bhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: How can anyone remain in this world forever? Some may try to devise a plan.
lines.transliteration: ki-o rahee-ai thir jag ko kadhahu upaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Working for the Perfect Guru, the wall becomes permanent and stable.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee chaakree thir kanDh sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਤਰ੍ੀ  ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਅਿਤ  ਨੇਹੁ ਬਿਹ ਮੰਦੁ ਪਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord forgives them, and merges them into Himself; they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||33|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1250-9) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhas milaa-i-an har naam samaa-i-aa. ||33||

lines.english: Attached to Maya, the mortal forgets the Fear of God and Guru, and love for theInfinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi visaari-aa gur kaa bha-o hayt  apaar.

lines.english: The waves of greed take away his wisdom and understanding, and he does notembrace love for the True Lord.
