lines.transliteration: lobh lahar suDh  mat ga-ee sach na lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਥਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad abides in the mind of the Gurmukhs, who find the Gate ofSalvation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinaa sabad  man vasai d argeh mokh  du-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord Himself forgives them, and unites them in Union with Himself. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1250-11) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aapay mayl la-ay aapay bakhsan haar. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, without Him, we could not live for a moment. Forgetting Him, we could not succeed for an instant.
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bin gharh ee na jeevn aa visray sarai na bind .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਗੁ ਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O mortal, how can you be angry with the One who cares for you? ||2|| mÚ 4 ] (1250-12) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tis si-o ki-o man roosee-ai jisahi hamaaree chind . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਿਭ ਲਹਿਰ  ਸੁਿਧ ਮਿਤ ਗਈ ਸਿਚ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The rainy season of Saawan has come. The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: saavan aa-i-aa jh imjhimaa har gurmukh  naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: All pain, hunger and misfortune end, when the rain falls in torrents.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhukh kaarh aa sabh  chukaa-isee meehu vuth aa chh ahbar laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੇ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The entire earth is rejuvenated, and the grain grows in abundance.
lines.transliteration: sabh Dh arat bha-ee haree-aavalee ann jammi-aa bohal laa-ay.

lines.english: The Carefree Lord, by His Grace, summons that mortal whom the Lord Himselfapproves.
lines.transliteration: har achint bulaavai kirpaa kar har aapay paavai thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੜੀ  ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ  ਿਵਸਰੇ  ਸਰੈ ਨ ਿਬੰਦ ॥
lines.english: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He shall save you in the end.
lines.transliteration: har tiseh Dh i-aavahu sant  janhu jo ant ay la-ay chh adaa-ay.

lines.english: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and devotion to Him is bliss; peace shall come to dwellin the mind.
lines.transliteration: har keerat bh agat anand hai sad aa sukh  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their pain and hunger departs.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa gurmukh naam araaDh i-aa tinaa d ukh bhukh leh jaa-ay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is satisfied, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. Please embellishhim with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3|| pauVI ] (1250-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak taript ai gaa-ay gun  har d arsan d ayh subh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਕਾੜਾ  ਸਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ  ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru bestows His gifts, which increase day by day.
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee daat  nit dayvai charh ai savaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਧਰਿਤ  ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ  ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਿਮਆ  ਬੋਹਲ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord Himself bestows them; they cannot be concealed by concealment.
lines.transliteration: tus dayvai aap d a-i-aal na chh apai chh apaa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਿਚੰਤੁ  ਬੁਲਾਵੈ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mortal is lovingly absorbed in the state ofsupreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: hirdai kaval pargaas unman liv laa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If anyone tries to challenge him, the Lord throws dust on his head.
lines.transliteration: jay ko karay us dee rees sir chh aa-ee paa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, no one can equal the glory of the Perfect True Guru. ||34|| pMnw 1251 slok mÚ 3 ] (1251-1) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aparh ko-ay na sak-ee pooray sat gur kee vad i-aa-ee-aa. ||34||

lines.english: The Order of the Lord is beyond challenge. Clever tricks and arguments will not work against it.
lines.transliteration: amar vayparvaahu hai tis naal si-aan ap na chal-ee na hujat  karnee jaa-ay.

lines.english: So abandon your self-conceit, and take to His Sanctuary; accept the Order of His Will.
lines.transliteration: aap chhod sarn aa-ay pavai man la-ay rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਸਆਣਪ  ਨ ਚਲਈ  ਨ ਹੁਜਿਤ ਕਰਣੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh eliminates self-conceit from within himself; he shall not be punished bythe Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jam dand na lag-ee ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਿਡ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ਪਵੈ ਮੰਿਨ ਲਏ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, he alone is called a selfless servant, who remains lovingly attuned to theTrue Lord. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1251-3) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sayvak so-ee aakhee-ai je sach rahai liv laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: All gifts, light and beauty are Yours.
lines.transliteration: daat jot sabh  soorat  tayree.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਜ ਸਿਚ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Excessive cleverness and egotism are mine.
lines.transliteration: bahut si-aan ap ha-umai mayree.

lines.english: The mortal performs all sorts of rituals in greed and attachment; engrossed in egotsim, he shall never escape the cycle of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: baho karam kamaaveh lobh mohi vi-aapay ha-umai kad ay na chookai fayree.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator Himself inspires all to act. Whatever pleases Him is good. ||2|| pauVI mÚ 5 ] (1251-5) pa-orhee mehlaa 5. Pauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak aap karaa-ay kartaa jo t is bhaavai saa-ee gal changayree. ||2||

lines.english: Let Truth be your food, and Truth your clothes, and take the Support of the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: sach khaan aa sach painn aa sach naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਲੋਿਭ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru shall lead you to meet God, the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai maylaa-i-aa parabh d ayvan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਜੋ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ  ਗਲ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: When perfect destiny is activated, the mortal meditates on the Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhaag pooraa t in jaagi-aa japi-aa nirankaar.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sangat  lagi-aa t ari-aa sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chant God's Praises, and celebrate His Victory. ||35|| slok mÚ 5 ] (1251-7) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sifat salaah kar parabh  kaa jaikaar. ||35||

lines.english: In Your Mercy, You care for all beings and creatures.
lines.transliteration: sabhay jee-a samaal apn ee mihar kar.

lines.english: You produce corn and water in abundance; You eliminate pain and poverty, and carry all beings across.
lines.transliteration: ann paanee much upaa-ay d ukh daalad  bhann tar.

lines.english: The Great Giver listened to my prayer, and the world has been cooled and comforted.
lines.transliteration: ardaas sun ee daataar ho-ee sisat th ar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਲਾਹ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Take me into Your Embrace, and take away all my pain.
lines.transliteration: layvhu kanth lagaa-ay apd aa sabh  har.

lines.english: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the House of God is fruitful andprosperous. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1251-10) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay parabh  kaa safal gh ar. ||1||

lines.english: Rain is falling from the clouds - it is so beautiful! The Creator Lord issued His Order.
lines.transliteration: vuthay maygh  suhaavan ay hukam keet aa kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ਮੁਚੁ ਉਪਾਇ  ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਿਨ  ਤਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Grain has been produced in abundance; the world is cooled and comforted.
lines.transliteration: rijak upaa-i-on aglaa thaaNdh pa-ee sansaar.

lines.english: The mind and body are rejuvenated, meditating in remembrance on the Inaccessibleand Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: tan man hari-aa ho-i-aa simrat  agam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕੰਿਠ ਲਗਾਇ  ਅਪਦਾ  ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O my True Creator Lord God, please shower Your Mercy on me.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh aapn ee sachay sirjan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ  ਘਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does whatever He pleases; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2|| pauVI ] (1251-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: keetaa lorh eh so karahi naanak sad  balihaar. ||2||

lines.english: The Great Lord is Inaccessible; His glorious greatness is glorious!
lines.transliteration: vadaa aap agamm hai vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I blossom forth in ecstasy;tranquility comes to my inner being.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee vaykh  vigsi-aa ant ar saaNt aa-ee.

lines.english: All by Himself, He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay aap varatd aa aapay hai bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Lord and Master of all. He has subdued all, and all are under theHukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: aap naath sabh nathee-an sabh  hukam chalaa-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord does whatever He pleases. Everyone walks in harmony with HisWill. ||36||1|| Sudh|| rwgu swrMg bwxI BgqW kI ] (1251-16) raag saarang banee bh agtaaN kee. Raag Saarang, The Word Of The Devotees. kbIr jI ] (1251-16) kabeer jee. Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1251-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhaavai so karay sabh  chalai rajaa-ee. ||36||1|| suDh .

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ  ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਸੋ ਕਰਿਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O mortal, why are you so proud of small things?
lines.transliteration: kahaa nar garbas thoree baat.

lines.english: With a few pounds of grain and a few coins in your pocket, you are totally puffed upwith pride. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man das naaj takaa chaar gaaNthee aiNdou taydh ou jaat . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਆਿਪ  ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: With great pomp and ceremony, you control a hundred villages, with an income ofhundreds of thousands of dollars.
lines.transliteration: bahut part aap gaaN-o sa-o paa-ay d u-ay lakh  takaa baraat .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਿਸਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤ  ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The power you exert will last for only a few days, like the green leaves of the forest.||1||
lines.transliteration: divas chaar kee karahu saahibee jaisay ban har paat . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: No one has brought this wealth with him, and no one will take it with him when hegoes.
lines.transliteration: naa ko-oo lai aa-i-o ih Dhan naa ko-oo lai jaat .

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨਾਥੁ ਸਭ ਨਥੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਚਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Emperors, even greater than Raawan, passed away in an instant. ||2|| pMnw 1252
lines.transliteration: raavan hooN tay aDh ik chh atarpat khin meh ga-ay bilaat . ||2||

lines.english: The Lord's Saints are steady and stable forever; they worship and adore Him, and chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant sad aa thir poojahu jo har naam japaat .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਿਥਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are mercifully blessed by the Lord of the Universe, join the Sat Sangat, theTrue Congregation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o kirpaa karat hai gobid  tay sat sang milaat . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਤ  ਹੈ ਗੋਿਬਦੁ  ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਿਗ ਿਮਲਾਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Mother, father, spouse, children and wealth will not go along with you in the end.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa banit aa sut  sampat  ant na chalat  sangaat .

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਨ ਚਲਤ  ਸੰਗਾਤ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate on the Lord, O madman. Your life is uselesslywasting away. ||4||1||
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer raam bh aj ba-uray janam akaarath jaat . ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਕਾਰਥ  ਜਾਤ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not know the limits of Your Royal Ashram.
lines.transliteration: raajaasaram mit nahee jaanee t ayree.

lines.english: I am the humble slave of Your Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray sant an kee ha-o chayree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The one who goes laughing returns crying, and the one who goes crying returnslaughing.
lines.transliteration: hasto jaa-ay so rovat  aavai rovat  jaa-ay so hasai.

lines.english: What is inhabited becomes deserted, and what is deserted becomes inhabited. ||1||
lines.transliteration: basto ho-ay ho-ay so oojar oojar ho-ay so basai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਸਤੋ  ਜਾਇ  ਸੁ ਰੋਵਤੁ  ਆਵੈ  ਰੋਵਤੁ  ਜਾਇ  ਸੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
lines.english: The water turns into a desert, the desert turns into a well, and the well turns into a mountain.
lines.transliteration: jal tay thal kar thal t ay koo-aa koop t ay mayr karaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਸਤੋ  ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਸ ਊਜਰੁ ਊਜਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhart ee tay aakaas chadh aavai chadh ay akaas giraavai. ||2|| From the earth, the mortal is exalted to the Akaashic ethers; and from the ethers onhigh, he is thrown down again. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਥਲ ਕਿਰ ਥਲ ਤੇ ਕੂਆ  ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The beggar is transformed into a king, and the king into a beggar.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh aaree t ay raaj karaavai raajaa t ay bh aykhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤੀ  ਤੇ ਆਕਾਿਸ  ਚਢਾਵੈ  ਚਢੇ ਅਕਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The idiotic fool is transformed into a Pandit, a religious scholar, and the Pandit into afool. ||3||
lines.transliteration: khal moorakh  tay pandit  karibo pandit  tay mugDh aaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ਤੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਤੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The woman is transformed into a man, and the men into women.
lines.transliteration: naaree tay jo purakh  karaavai purkh an tay jo naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਖਲ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਕਿਰਬੋ  ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਤੇ ਮੁਗਧਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, God is the Beloved of the Holy Saints. I am a sacrifice to His image.||4||2|| swrMg bwxI nwmdyau jI kI ] (1252-8) saarang banee naamd ay-o jee kee. Saarang, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1252-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho kabeer saaDhoo ko pareet am tis moorat  balihaaree. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਰੀ  ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਕਰਾਵੈ  ਪੁਰਖਨ  ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, why are you going into the forest of corruption?
lines.transliteration: kaa-ayN ray man bikhi-aa ban jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਧੂ ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: You have been misled into eating the toxic drug. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhoolou ray th agmooree kh aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are like a fish living in the water;
lines.transliteration: jaisay meen paanee meh rahai.
kaal jaal kee suDh nahee lahai. you do not see the net of death.

lines.english: Trying to taste the flavor, you swallow the hook.
lines.transliteration: jihbaa su-aadee leelit  loh.

lines.english: You are bound by attachment to wealth and woman. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aisay kanik kaamnee baaDhi-o moh. ||1||

lines.english: The bee stores up loads of honey;
lines.transliteration: ji-o maDh maakh ee sanchai apaar.
maDh leeno mukh  deenee chh aar. then someone comes and takes the honey, and throws dust in its mouth.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਜਾਲ  ਕੀ ਸੁਿਧ ਨਹੀ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The cow stores up loads of milk;
lines.transliteration: ga-oo baachh ka-o sanchai kh eer.
galaa baaNDh duhi lay-ay aheer. ||2|| then the milkman comes and ties it by its neck and milks it. ||2||

lines.english: For the sake of Maya, the mortal works very hard.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran saram at karai.

lines.english: He takes the wealth of Maya, and buries it in the ground.
lines.transliteration: so maa-i-aa lai gaadai Dharai.

lines.english: He acquires so much, but the fool does not appreciate it.
lines.transliteration: at sanchai samjh ai nahee moorhH.

lines.english: Dhan Dh artee tan ho-ay ga-i-o Dh oorh. ||3|| His wealth remains buried in the ground, while his body turns to dust. ||3||
He burns in tremendous sexual desire, unresolved anger and desire.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh t arisnaa at  jarai.

lines.english: He never joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  kabhoo nahee karai.

lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, seek God's Shelter;
lines.transliteration: kahat naamd ay-o t aa chee aan .
nirbhai ho-ay bh ajee-ai bh agvaan. ||4||1|| be fearless, and vibrate on the Lord God. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ  ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ  ਧੂਿੜ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Why not make a bet with me, O Lord of Wealth?
lines.transliteration: badahu kee na hod maaDh a-o mo si-o.

lines.english: From the master comes the servant, and from the servant, comes the master. This is the game I play with You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: thaakur t ay jan jan t ay thaakur kh ayl pari-o hai t o si-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You Yourself are the deity, and You are the temple of worship. You are the devoted worshipper.
lines.transliteration: aapan day-o d ayhuraa aapan aap lagaavai poojaa.

lines.english: From the water, the waves rise up, and from the waves, the water. They are onlydifferent by figures of speech. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jal tay t arang t arang t ay hai jal kahan sunan ka-o d oojaa. ||1||

lines.english: You Yourself sing, and You Yourself dance. You Yourself blow the bugle.
lines.transliteration: aapeh gaavai aapeh naachai aap bajaavai tooraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਦਹੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਹੋਡ ਮਾਧਉ  ਮੋ ਿਸਉ ॥
lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, You are my Lord and Master. Your humble servant is imperfect; You are perfect. ||2||2||
lines.transliteration: kahat naamd ay-o t ooN mayro th aakur jan ooraa t oo pooraa. ||2||2||

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਪਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ਤੋ ਿਸਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says God: my slave is devoted only to me; he is in my very image.
lines.transliteration: daas aninn mayro nij roop.

lines.english: The sight of him, even for an instant, cures the three fevers; his touch brings liberation from the deep dark pit of household affairs. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jI) darsan nimakh  taap tar-ee mochan parsat  mukat  karat  garih koop. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਦੇਉ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ  ਲਗਾਵੈ  ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.english: The devotee can release anyone from my bondage, but I cannot release anyone from his. pMnw 1253
lines.transliteration: mayree baaNDhee bh agat chhadaavai baaNDhai bhagat na chh ootai mohi.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੁ  ਛਡਾਵੈ  ਬਧੈ ਭਗਤੁ  ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਮੋਿਹ ॥
lines.english: If, at any time, he grabs and binds me, even then, I cannot protest. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ayk samai mo ka-o geh baaNDhai t a-o fun mo pai jabaab na ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗਿਹ ਬਧੈ ਤਉ ਫੁਿਨ ਮੋ ਪੈ ਜਬਾਬੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am bound by virtue; I am the Life of all. My slaves are my very life.
lines.transliteration: mai gun banDh sagal kee jeevan mayree jeevan mayray d aas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਗੁਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਗਲ  ਕੀ ਜੀਵਿਨ  ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਵਿਨ  ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, as is the quality of his soul, so is my love which illuminates him. ||2||3|| swrMg ] (1253-4) saarang. Saarang: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1253-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naamdayv jaa kay jee-a aisee t aiso t aa kai paraym pargaas. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ  ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਐਸੀ  ਤੈਸੋ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: So what have you accomplished by listening to the Puraanas?
lines.transliteration: tai nar ki-aa puraan sun keenaa.

lines.english: Faithful devotion has not welled up within you, and you have not been inspired to giveto the hungry. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anpaavnee bhagat  nahee upjee bh ookhai daan na d eenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You have not forgotten sexual desire, and you have not forgotten anger; greed hasnot left you either.
lines.transliteration: kaam na bisri-o kroDh na bisri-o lobh  na chh ooti-o d ayvaa.

lines.english: Your mouth has not stopped slandering and gossiping about others. Your service isuseless and fruitless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: par nindaa mukh  tay nahee chh ootee nifal bh a-ee sabh  sayvaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਪਾਵਨੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੀ  ਭੂਖੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By breaking into the houses of others and robbing them, you fill your belly, yousinner.
lines.transliteration: baat paar ghar moos biraano payt bh arai apraaDh ee.

lines.english: But when you go to the world beyond, your guilt will be well known, by the acts of ignorance which you committed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jihi parlok jaa-ay apkeerat so-ee abid i-aa saaDh ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਬਸਿਰਓ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਨ ਿਬਸਿਰਓ  ਲੋਭੁ ਨ ਛੂਿਟਓ  ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: Cruelty has not left your mind; you have not cherished kindness for other livingbeings.
lines.transliteration: hinsaa ta-o man t ay nahee chh ootee jee-a d a-i-aa nahee paalee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਿਨਫਲ  ਭਈ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Parmaanand has joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Why have younot followed the sacred teachings? ||3||1||6||
lines.transliteration: parmaanand saaDh sangat  mil kathaa puneet  na chaalee. ||3||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਟ ਪਾਿਰ  ਘਰੁ ਮੂਿਸ ਿਬਰਾਨੋ  ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰੈ ਅਪਰ੍ਾਧੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, do not even associate with those who have turned their backs on the Lord. swrMg mhlw 5 sUrdws ] (1253-11) saarang mehlaa 5 soordaas. Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Sur Daas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1253-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: chhaad man har bimukh an ko sang.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਹ  ਪਰਲੋਕ  ਜਾਇ  ਅਪਕੀਰਿਤ  ਸੋਈ ਅਿਬਿਦਆ  ਸਾਧੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The people of the Lord dwell with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay sang basay har lok.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹੰਸਾ  ਤਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਜੀਅ  ਦਇਆ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: They dedicate their minds and bodies to Him; they dedicate everything to Him. They are intoxicated with the celestial melody of intuitive ecstasy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jI) tan man arap sarbas sabh  arpi-o anad  sahj Dh un jhok. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ ਿਮਿਲ  ਕਥਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਨ ਚਾਲੀ  ॥੩॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, they are cleansed of corruption. They obtain absolutely everything.
lines.transliteration: darsan paykh  bha-ay nirbikh a-ee paa-ay hai saglay thok.

lines.english: They have nothing to do with anything else; they gaze on the beauteous Face of God.||1||
lines.transliteration: aan basat si-o kaaj na kachh oo-ai sund ar bad an alok. ||1||

lines.english: But one who forsakes the elegantly beautiful Lord, and harbors desire for anythingelse, is like a leech on the body of a leper.
lines.transliteration: si-aam sundar t aj aan jo chaahat  ji-o kustee t an jok.

lines.english: Says Sur Daas, God has taken my mind in His Hands. He has blessed me with theworld beyond. ||2||1||8|| swrMg kbIr jIau ] (1253-16) saarang kabeer jee-o. Saarang, Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1253-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: soordaas man parabh  hath leeno d eeno ih parlok. ||2||1||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਬਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਲੋਕ ॥
lines.english: Other than the Lord, who is the Help and Support of the mind?
lines.transliteration: har bin ka-un sahaa-ee man kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਸਰਬਸੁ  ਸਭੁ ਅਰਿਪਓ  ਅਨਦ  ਸਹਜ  ਧੁਿਨ ਝੋਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Love and attachment to mother, father, sibling, child and spouse, is all just an illusion.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banit aa hit  laago sabh  fan kaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So build a raft to the world hereafter; what faith do you place in wealth?
lines.transliteration: aagay ka-o kichh t ulhaa baaNDhahu ki-aa bh arvaasaa Dh an kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਿਖ ਭਏ ਿਨਰਿਬਖਈ  ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਸਗਲੇ  ਥੋਕ ॥
lines.english: What confidence do you place in this fragile vessel; it breaks with the slightest stroke. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahaa bisaasaa is bhaaNday kaa it nak laagai th ankaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਿਸਉ ਕਾਜੁ  ਨ ਕਛੂਐ  ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਦਨ  ਅਲੋਕ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You shall obtain the rewards of all righteousness and goodness, if you desire to be thedust of all.
lines.transliteration: sagal Dharam punn fal paavhu Dh oor baaNchhahu sabh  jan kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਆਮ  ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਤਿਜ ਆਨ  ਜੁ ਚਾਹਤ  ਿਜਉ  ਕੁਸਟੀ  ਤਿਨ ਜੋਕ ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: this mind is like the bird, flying above the forest. ||2||1||9|| pMnw 1254 rwgu mlwr caupdy mhlw 1 Gru 1 (1254-1) raag malaar cha-upday mehlaa 1 gh ar 1 Raag Malaar, Chau-Padas, First Mehl, First House: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1254-2) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: kahai kabeer sunhu ray santahu ih man udan pankh ayroo ban kaa. ||2||1||9||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ  ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Eating, drinking, laughing and sleeping, the mortal forgets about dying.
lines.transliteration: khaan aa peen aa hasn aa sa-un aa visar ga-i-aa hai marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਣਾ  ਪੀਣਾ  ਹਸਣਾ  ਸਉਣਾ  ਿਵਸਿਰ  ਗਇਆ  ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Forgetting his Lord and Master, the mortal is ruined, and his life is cursed. He cannotremain forever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: khasam visaar kh u-aaree keenee Dh arig jeevan  nahee rahn aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੁ  ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ਖੁਆਰੀ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O mortal, meditate on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraanee ayko naam Dh i-aavahu.

lines.english: You shall go to your true home with honor. ||1 Pause||
lines.transliteration: apnee pat sayt ee gh ar jaavhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who serve You - what can they give You? They beg for and receive what cannot remain.
lines.transliteration: tuDhno sayveh t ujh ki-aa d ayveh maaNgeh layveh raheh nahee.

lines.english: You are the Great Giver of all souls; You are the Life within all living beings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too daataa jee-aa sabh naa kaa jee-aa and ar jee-o t uhee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧਨੋ  ਸੇਵਿਹ ਤੁਝੁ ਿਕਆ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਮਗਿਹ  ਲੇਵਿਹ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs meditate, and receive the Ambrosial Nectar; thus they become pure.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh Dh i-aavahi se amrit  paavahi say-ee soochay hohee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਾ ਜੀਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਤੁਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Day and night, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal. It makes the filthy immacuate. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam japahu ray paraanee mailay hachh ay hohee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਿਸ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਸੂਚੇ ਹੋਹੀ ॥
lines.english: As is the season, so is the comfort of the body, and so is the body itself.
lines.transliteration: jayhee rut kaa-i-aa sukh  tayhaa t ayho jayhee d ayhee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਮੈਲੇ ਹਛੇ ਹੋਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that season is beautiful; without the Name, what season is it? ||4||1|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1254-9) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rut suhaavee saa-ee bin naavai rut  kayhee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹੀ ਰੁਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.english: I offer prayers to my Beloved Guru, that He may unite me with my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: kara-o bin-o gur apnay pareetam har var aan  milaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੁਿਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸਾਈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰੁਿਤ ਕੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I hear the thunder in the clouds, and my mind is cooled and soothed; imbued with the Love of my Dear Beloved, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sun gh an gh or seet al man moraa laal rat ee gun  gaavai. ||1||

lines.english: The rain pours down, and my mind is drenched with His Love.
lines.transliteration: baras ghanaa mayraa man bh eenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ  ਿਬਨਉ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਵਰੁ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The drop of Ambrosial Nectar pleases my heart; the Guru has fascinated my mind,which is drenched in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: amrit boond  suhaanee hee-arai gur mohee man har ras leenaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਘਨ ਘੋਰ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਲਾਲ  ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With intuitive peace and poise, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband Lord; her mindis pleased and appeased by the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: sahj sukhee var kaaman  pi-aaree jis gur bachnee man maani-aa.

lines.english: She is the happy soul-bride of her Husband Lord; her mind and body are filled withjoy by His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har var naar bha-ee sohagan  man t an paraym sukh aani-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਨੀ  ਹੀਅਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਲੀਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Discarding her demerits, she becomes detached; with the Lord as her Husband, hermarriage is eternal.
lines.transliteration: avgan t i-aag bh a-ee bairaagan asthir var sohaag haree.

lines.english: She never suffers separation or sorrow; her Lord God showers her with His Grace.||3||
lines.transliteration: sog vijog tis kad ay na vi-aapai har parabh  apnee kirpaa karee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਖੀ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਿਣ  ਿਪਆਰੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Her mind is steady and stable; she does not come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan  nahee man nihchal pooray gur kee ot gahee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵਿਰ ਨਾਿਰ  ਭਈ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮੁ ਸੁਖਾਿਨਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: She takes the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam; you shall be accepted as the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||4||2|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1254-15) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam jap gurmukh Dh an sohagan  sach sahee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਣ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਨ  ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ  ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.english: They pretend to understand the Truth, but they are not satisfied by the Naam; they waste their lives in egotism. pMnw 1255
lines.transliteration: saachee surat naam nahee t ariptai ha-umai karat  gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Caught in slander and attachment to the wealth and women of others, they eat poison and suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: par Dhan par naaree rat  nindaa bikh  khaa-ee d ukh paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ  ਰਤੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They think about the Shabad, but they are not released from their fear and fraud; theminds and mouths are filled with Maya, Maya.
lines.transliteration: sabad cheen bh ai kapat na chh ootay man mukh  maa-i-aa maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਭੈ ਕਪਟ  ਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Loading the heavy and crushing load, they die, only to be reborn, and waste theirlives again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ajgar bhaar lad ay at bhaaree mar janmay janam gavaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਗਿਰ  ਭਾਿਰ  ਲਦੇ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੇ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is so very beautiful; it is pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: man bhaavai sabad  suhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The mortal wanders lost in reincarnation, wearing various robes and clothes; when heis saved and protected by the Guru, then he finds the Truth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram jon bh aykh baho keenHay gur raakh ay sach paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਜੋਿਨ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ  ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He does not try to wash away his angry passions by bathing at sacred shrines. He does not love the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tirath t ayj nivaar na nHaatay har kaa naam na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He abandons and discards the priceless jewel, and he goes back from where he came.
lines.transliteration: ratan pad aarath parhar t i-aagi-aa jat  ko tat hee aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਤੇਜੁ ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਨ ਨਾਤੇ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: And so he becomes a maggot in manure, and in that, he is absorbed.
lines.transliteration: bistaa keet bha-ay ut  hee t ay ut hee maahi samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਿਤਆਿਗਆ  ਜਤ ਕੋ ਤਤ ਹੀ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The more he tastes, the more he is diseased; without the Guru, there is no peace andpoise. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aDhik su-aad  rog aDh ikaa-ee bin gur sahj na paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਕੀਟ ਭਏ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Focusing my awareness on selfless service, I joyfully sing His Praises. As Gurmukh, Icontemplate spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat rahas gun  gaavaa gurmukh  gi-aan beechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਧਕ  ਸੁਆਦ  ਰੋਗ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The seeker comes forth, and the debater dies down; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to theGuru, the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: khojee upjai baad ee binsai ha-o bal bal gur kart aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਰਹਿਸ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am low and wretched, with shallow and false understanding; You embellish andexalt me through the Word of Your Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ham neech hotay heen mat jhoothay too sabad  savaaran haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ  ਬਾਦੀ  ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: And wherever there is self-realization, You are there; O True Lord Savior, You save usand carry us across. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aatam cheen t ahaa t oo taaran  sach t aaray t aaran haaraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਹਤੇ ਹੀਣਮਿਤ  ਝੂਠੇ ਤੂ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Where should I sit to chant Your Praises; which of Your Infinite Praises should I chant?
lines.transliteration: bais suthaan kahaaN gun t ayray ki-aa ki-aa katha-o apaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਣ  ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Unknown cannot be known; O Inaccessible, Unborn Lord God, You are the Lordand Master of masters.
lines.transliteration: alakh na lakh ee-ai agam ajonee t ooN naathaaN naathan haaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਿਸ ਸੁਥਾਿਨ  ਕਹ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਿਕਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਥਉ  ਅਪਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: How can I compare You to anyone else I see? All are beggars - You are the GreatGiver.
lines.transliteration: kis peh daykh  kaha-o t oo kaisaa sabh  jaachak t oo daataaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਜੋਨੀ  ਤੂੰ ਨਾਥ  ਨਾਥਣਹਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Lacking devotion, Nanak looks to Your Door; please bless him with Your One Name,that he may enshrine it in his heart. ||4||3|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1255-10) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhagt iheen  naanak d ar daykhhu ik naam milai ur Dh aaraa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਦੇਿਖ ਕਹਉ  ਤੂ ਕੈਸਾ ਸਿਭ ਜਾਚਕ  ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The soul-bride who has not known delight with her Husband Lord, shall weep and wailwith a wretched face.
lines.transliteration: jin Dhan pir kaa saad  na jaani-aa saa bilakh  badan kumlaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤਹੀਣੁ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਿਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: She becomes hopeless, caught in the noose of her own karma; without the Guru, shewanders deluded by doubt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-ee niraasee karam kee faasee bin gur bh aram bh ulaanee. ||1||

lines.english: So rain down, O clouds. My Husband Lord has come home.
lines.transliteration: baras ghanaa mayraa pir gh ar aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਧਨ ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਸਾ ਿਬਲਖ  ਬਦਨ  ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has led me to meet my Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bal jaavaaN gur apnay pareetam jin har parabh  aan milaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਈ ਿਨਰਾਸੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਿਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My love, my Lord and Master is forever fresh; I am embellished with devotional worship night and day.
lines.transliteration: na-utan pareet  sadaa thaakur si-o an-d in bhagat suhaavee.

lines.english: I am liberated, gazing on the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Devotional worship has made me glorious and exalted throughout the ages. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-ay gur d aras d ikhaa-i-aa jug jug bh agat subh aavee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਵ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਿਣ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am Yours; the three worlds are Yours as well. You are mine, and I am Yours.
lines.transliteration: ham thaaray taribh avan jag tumraa t oo mayraa ha-o t ayraa.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I shall not beconsigned to this terrifying world-ocean ever again. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai niranjan paa-i-aa bahur na bh avjal fayraa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉਤਨ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ॥
lines.english: If the soul-bride is filled with delight on seeing her Husband Lord, then herdecorations are true.
lines.transliteration: apunay pir har daykh  vigaasee t a-o Dh an saach seegaaro.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ ਭਏ ਗੁਿਰ ਦਰਸੁ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਸੁਭਾਵੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: With the Immaculate Celestial Lord, she becomes the truest of the true. Following theGuru's Teachings, she leans on the Support of the Naam. ||4||
lines.transliteration: akul niranjan si-o sach saachee gurmat naam aDh aaro. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਜਗੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: She is liberated; the Guru has untied her bonds. Focusing her awareness on theShabad, she attains honor.
lines.transliteration: mukat bh a-ee banDh an gur kh olHay sabad  surat  pat paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਭਵਜਿਲ  ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is deep within her heart; as Gurmukh, she is united in His Union. ||5||4|| mhlw 1 mlwr ] (1255-18) mehlaa 1 malaar. First Mehl, Malaar:
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam rid ant ar gurmukh  mayl milaa-ee. ||5||4||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਪਰ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਿਖ ਿਵਗਾਸੀ  ਤਉ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: Others' wives, others' wealth, greed, egotism, corruption and poison;
lines.transliteration: par daaraa par Dh an par lobh aa ha-umai bikh ai bikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕੁਲ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਿਸਉ ਸਿਚ ਸਾਚੀ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: dusat bh aa-o t aj nind  paraa-ee kaam kroDh  chandaar. ||1|| evil passions, slander of others, sexual desire and anger - give up all these. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ ਭਈ ਬੰਧਨ  ਗੁਿਰ ਖੋਲੇ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Inaccessible, Infinite Lord is sitting in His Mansion.
lines.transliteration: mahal meh baithay agam apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.english: That humble being, whose conduct is in harmony with the jewel of the Guru's Shabad, obtains the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1256
lines.transliteration: bheet ar amrit  so-ee jan paavai jis gur kaa sabad  ratan aachaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He sees pleasure and pain as both the same, along with good and bad in the world.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  do-oo sam kar jaanai buraa bh alaa sansaar.

lines.english: Wisdom, understanding and awareness are found in the Name of the Lord. In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, embrace love for the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: suDh buDh  surat  naam har paa-ee-ai sat sangat  gur pi-aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦੋਊ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, profit is obtained through the Lord's Name. The Guru, the Giver, has given this gift.
lines.transliteration: ahinis laahaa har naam paraapat gur d aataa dayvan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਧ ਬੁਿਧ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਿਪਆਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: That Sikh who becomes Gurmukh obtains it. The Creator blesses him with His Glanceof Grace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sikh  so-ee jan paa-ay jis no nad ar karay kart aar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The body is a mansion, a temple, the home of the Lord; He has infused His InfiniteLight into it.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa mahal mandar gh ar har kaa t is meh raakh ee jot  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਸਖ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is invited to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; the Lordunites him in His Union. ||4||5|| mlwr mhlw 1 Gru 2  (1256-6) malaar mehlaa 1 ghar 2 Malaar, First Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1256-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mahal bulaa-ee-ai har maylay maylan haar. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਲੁ  ਮੰਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਖੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Know that the creation was formed through air and water;
lines.transliteration: pavnai paan ee jaan ai jaat .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮਹਿਲ  ਬੁਲਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aaN agan karay nibhraaNt. have no doubt that the body was made through fire.

lines.english: And if you know where the soul comes from,
lines.transliteration: jameh jee-a jaanai jay thaa-o.
surtaa pandit  taa kaa naa-o. ||1|| you shall be known as a wise religious scholar. ||1||

lines.english: Who can know the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O mother?
lines.transliteration: gun gobind  na jaan ee-ahi maa-ay.

lines.english: Without seeing Him, we cannot say anything about Him.
lines.transliteration: andeeth aa kichh  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.english: How can anyone speak and describe Him, O mother? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kar aakh vakh aanee-ai maa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is high above the sky, and beneath the nether worlds.
lines.transliteration: oopar dar asmaan pa-i-aal.

lines.english: How can I speak of Him? Let me understand.
lines.transliteration: ki-o kar kahee-ai dayh veechaar.

lines.english: Who knows what sort of Name is chanted, in the heart, without the tongue? ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin jihvaa jo japai hi-aa-ay. ko-ee jaanai kaisaa naa-o. ||2||

lines.english: Undoubtedly, words fail me.
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee rahai nibh raaNt.

lines.english: He alone understands, who is blessed.
lines.transliteration: so boojhai hovai jis d aat.

lines.english: Day and night, deep within, he remains lovingly attuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ahinis antar rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.english: He is the true person, who is merged in the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so-ee purakh je sach samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: If someone of high social standing becomes a selfless servant,
lines.transliteration: jaat kuleen sayvak jay ho-ay.
taa kaa kahn aa kahhu na ko-ay. then his praises cannot even be expressed.

lines.english: And if someone from a low social class becomes a selfless servant,
lines.transliteration: vich sanaateeN sayvak ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, he shall wear shoes of honor. ||4||1||6|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1256-13) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak panHee-aa pahirai so-ay. ||4||1||6||

lines.english: The pain of separation - this is the hungry pain I feel.
lines.transliteration: dukh vaychh orhaa ik d ukh bhookh.

lines.english: Another pain is the attack of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: ik dukh  sakat vaar jamd oot.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Another pain is the disease consuming my body.
lines.transliteration: ik dukh  rog lagai t an Dh aa-ay.

lines.english: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vaid na bh olay d aaroo laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine.
lines.transliteration: vaid na bh olay d aaroo laa-ay.

lines.english: The pain persists, and the body continues to suffer.
lines.transliteration: darad  hovai d ukh rahai sareer.

lines.english: Your medicine has no effect on me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aisaa daaroo lagai na beer. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Forgetting his Lord and Master, the mortal enjoys sensual pleasures;
lines.transliteration: khasam visaar kee-ay ras bh og.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ  ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: taaN tan uth  khalo-ay rog. then, disease rises up in his body.

lines.english: The blind mortal receives his punishment.
lines.transliteration: man anDhay ka-o milai sajaa-ay.

lines.english: O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||2||
lines.transliteration: vaid na bh olay d aaroo laa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The value of sandalwood lies in its fragrance.
lines.transliteration: chandan kaa fal chand an vaas.

lines.english: The value of the human lasts only as long as the breath in the body.
lines.transliteration: maanas kaa fal gh at meh saas.

lines.english: When the breath is taken away, the body crumbles into dust.
lines.transliteration: saas ga-i-ai kaa-i-aa dhal paa-ay.

lines.english: After that, no one takes any food. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa kai paachh ai ko-ay na kh aa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The mortal's body is golden, and the soul-swan is immaculate and pure,
lines.transliteration: kanchan kaa-i-aa nirmal hans.
jis meh naam niranjan aNs. if even a tiny particle of the Immaculate Naam is within.

lines.english: All pain and disease are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: dookh  rog sabh  ga-i-aa gavaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the mortal is saved through the True Name. ||4||2||7|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1256-19) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak chhootas saachai naa-ay. ||4||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸ  ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਘਟ ਮਿਹ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Pain is the poison. The Lord's Name is the antidote.
lines.transliteration: dukh mahuraa maaran  har naam.

lines.english: Grind it up in the mortar of contentment, with the pestle of charitable giving. pMnw 1257
lines.transliteration: silaa santokh  peesan  hath d aan.

lines.english: Take it each and every day, and your body shall not waste away.
lines.transliteration: nit nit  layho na chh eejai d ayh.

lines.english: At the very last instant, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ant kaal jam maarai th ayh. ||1||

lines.english: So take such medicine, O fool,
lines.transliteration: aisaa daaroo kh aahi gavaar.
jit khaaDhai tayray jaahi vikaar. ||1|| rahaa-o. by which your corruption shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Power, wealth and youth are all just shadows,
lines.transliteration: raaj maal joban sabh chh aaNv.
rath firandai d eeseh thaav. as are the vehicles you see moving around.

lines.english: Neither your body, nor your fame, nor your social status shall go along with you.
lines.transliteration: dayh na naa-o na hovai jaat .

lines.english: In the next world it is day, while here, it is all night. ||2||
lines.transliteration: othai dihu aithai sabh  raat. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਨਾਉ  ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Let your taste for pleasures be the firewood, let your greed be the ghee,
lines.transliteration: saad kar samDh aaN tarisnaa gh i-o tayl.
kaam kroDh agnee si-o mayl. and your sexual desire and anger the cooking oil; burn them in the fire.

lines.english: Some make burnt offerings, hold sacred feasts, and read the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: hom jag ar paath puraan .

lines.english: Whatever pleases God is acceptable. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so parvaan . ||3||

lines.english: Intense meditation is the paper, and Your Name is the insignia.
lines.transliteration: tap kaagad  tayraa naam neesaan.

lines.english: Those for whom this treasure is ordered,
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o likhi-aa ayhu niDh aan.
say Dhanvant  diseh gh ar jaa-ay. look wealthy when they reach their true home.

lines.english: O Nanak, blessed is that mother who gave birth to them. ||4||3||8|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1257-6) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jannee Dhannee maa-ay. ||4||3||8||

lines.english: You wear white clothes, and speak sweet words.
lines.transliteration: baagay kaaparh bolai bain .

lines.english: Your nose is sharp, and your eyes are black.
lines.transliteration: lammaa nak kaalay tayray nain .

lines.english: Have you ever seen your Lord and Master, O sister? ||1||
lines.transliteration: kabahooN saahib daykh i-aa bh ain. ||1||

lines.english: O my All-powerful Lord and Master, by Your power, I fly and soar, and ascend to the heavens.
lines.transliteration: oodaaN ood charhaaN asmaan. saahib sammrith t ayrai t aan.

lines.english: I see Him in the water, on the land, in the mountains, on the river-banks,
lines.transliteration: jal thal doongar daykh aaN teer.
thaan thanantar saahib beer. ||2|| in all places and interspaces, O brother. ||2||

lines.english: He fashioned the body, and gave it wings;
lines.transliteration: jin tan saaj d ee-ay naal kh anbh.

lines.english: He gave it great thirst and desire to fly.
lines.transliteration: at tarisnaa udn ai kee danjh .

lines.english: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, I am comforted and consoled.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aaN banDh aaN Dheer.

lines.english: As He makes me see, so do I see, O brother. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o vaykhaalay t i-o vaykh aaN beer. ||3||

lines.english: Neither this body, nor its wings, shall go to the world hereafter.
lines.transliteration: na ih tan jaa-igaa na jaahigay kh anbh.

lines.english: It is a fusion of air, water and fire.
lines.transliteration: pa-unai paan ee agnee kaa san-banDh .

lines.english: O Nanak, if it is in the mortal's karma, then he meditates on the Lord, with the Guruas his Spiritual Teacher.
lines.transliteration: naanak karam hovai japee-ai kar gur peer.

lines.english: This body is absorbed in the Truth. ||4||4||9|| mlwr mhlw 3 caupdy Gru 1  (1257-12) malaar mehlaa 3 cha-upday gh ar 1 Malaar, Third Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1257-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sach samaavai ayhu sareer. ||4||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ  ਨ ਜਾਿਹਗੇ  ਖੰਭ ॥
lines.english: The Formless Lord is formed by Himself. He Himself deludes in doubt.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar aakaar hai aapay aapay bharam bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: Creating the Creation, the Creator Himself beholds it; He enjoins us as He pleases.
lines.transliteration: kar kar kartaa aapay vaykh ai jit bhaavai t it laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਜਪੀਐ  ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: This is the true greatness of His servant, that he obeys the Hukam of the Lord'sCommand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sayvak ka-o ayhaa vadi-aa-ee jaa ka-o hukam manaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Only He Himself knows His Will. By Guru's Grace, it is grasped.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa bh aanaa aapay jaan ai gur kirpaa t ay lahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: When this play of Shiva and Shakti comes to his home, he remains dead while yetalive. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ayhaa sakat sivai gh ar aavai jeevd i-aa mar rahee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They read the Vedas, and read them again, and engage in arguments about Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
lines.transliteration: vayd parh ai parh  vaad  vakh aanai barahmaa bisan mahaysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਵੇਖੈ ਿਜਤੁ  ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਤੁ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: This three-phased Maya has deluded the whole world into cynicism about death andbirth.
lines.transliteration: ayh tarigun  maa-i-aa jin jagat  bhulaa-i-aa janam maran  kaa sahsaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, know the One Lord, and the anxiety of your mind will be allayed.||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ayko jaanai chookai manhu and aysaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਭਾਣਾ  ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: I am meek, foolish and thoughtless, but still, You take care of me.
lines.transliteration: ham deen moorakh  aveechaaree t um chint aa karahu hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹਾ ਸਕਿਤ  ਿਸਵੈ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਜੀਵਿਦਆ  ਮਿਰ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please be kind to me, and make me the slave of Your slaves, so that I may serve You.
lines.transliteration: hohu da-i-aal kar d aas d aasaa kaa sayvaa karee t umaaree.

lines.english: Please bless me with the treasure of the One Name, that I may chant it, day andnight. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayk niDhaan d eh too apn aa ahinis naam vakh aanee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਪਿੜ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, understand. Hardly anyone considers this.
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak gur parsaadee boojh hu ko-ee aisaa karay veechaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਿਤਰ੍ਗੁਣ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: Like foam bubbling up on the surface of the water, so is this world. pMnw 1258
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal oopar fayn budbud aa taisaa ih sansaaraa.

lines.english: It shall eventually merge back into that from which it came, and all its expanse shall be gone. ||4||1|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1258-1) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis tay ho-aa t iseh samaan aa chook ga-i-aa paasaaraa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ਚੂਿਕ ਗਇਆ  ਪਾਸਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command are united with Him; throughthe Word of His Shabad, their egotism is burnt away.
lines.transliteration: jinee hukam pachhaan i-aa say maylay ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay.

lines.english: They perform true devotional worship day and night; they remain lovingly attuned tothe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat  karahi d in raat ee sach rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਸੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They gaze on their True Lord forever, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, withloving ease. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach har vaykh -day gur kai sabad  subh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸਿਚ ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, accept His Will and find peace.
lines.transliteration: man ray hukam man sukh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਿਰ ਵੇਖਦੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God is pleased by the Pleasure of His Own Will. Whomever He forgives, meets noobstacles on the way. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh bh aanaa apn aa bh aavdaa jis bakh say tis bigh an na ko-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Under the influence of the three gunas, the three dispositions, the mind wanderseverywhere, without love or devotion to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  sabh aa Dh aat hai naa har bh agat na bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਣਾ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਭਾਵਦਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one is ever saved or liberated, by doing deeds in ego.
lines.transliteration: gat mukat  kaday na hova-ee ha-umai karam kamaahi.

lines.english: Whatever our Lord and Master wills, comes to pass. People wander according to their past actions. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saahib bhaavai so thee-ai pa-i-ai kirat  firaahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, the mind is overpowered; the Lord's Name comes toabide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh ayti-ai man mar rahai har naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The value of such a person cannot be estimated; nothing at all can be said about him.
lines.transliteration: tis kee keemat  naa pavai kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.english: He comes to dwell in the fourth state; he remains merged in the True Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: cha-uthai pad vaasaa ho-i-aa sachai rahai samaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭੇਿਟਐ  ਮਨੁ ਮਿਰ ਰਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. His value cannot be expressed.
lines.transliteration: mayraa har parabh agam agochar hai keemat  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, he comes to understand, and live the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bujhee-ai sabd ay kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਉਥੈ  ਪਿਦ ਵਾਸਾ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; you shall be honored inthe Court of the Lord. ||4||2|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1258-9) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too har har d ar sobh aa paa-ay. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, understands; the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ko-ee virlaa boojh ai jis no nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: There is no Giver except the Guru. He grants His Grace and forgives.
lines.transliteration: gur bin daat aa ko-ee naahee bakh say nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, peace and tranquility well up; chant the Naam, the Name of theLord, day and night. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai saaNt oopjai an-d in naam la-ay-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har amrit naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕੋਈ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru and the Primal Being, the Name is obtained, and oneremains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  milai naa-o paa-ee-ai har naamay sad aa samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are forever separated from the Lord; no one is with them.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sad aa vichh urhay fireh ko-ay na kis hee naal.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਸਿਤ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They are stricken with the great disease of egotism; they are hit on the head by theMessenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vadaa rog hai sir maaray jamkaal.

lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are never separated from the Sat Sangat, theTrue Congregation. They dwell on the Naam, night and day. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gurmat sat sangat  na vichh urheh an-d in naam samHaal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the One and Only Creator of all. You continually create, watch over and contemplate.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kart aa ayk t oo nit  kar d aykheh veechaar.

lines.english: Some are Gurmukh - You unite them with Yourself. You bless then with the treasureof devotion.
lines.transliteration: ik gurmukh aap milaa-i-aa bakh say bh agat bhandaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸਦਾ ਿਵਛੁੜੇ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਿਕਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself know everything. Unto whom should I complain? ||3||
lines.transliteration: too aapay sabh  kichh  jaand aa kis aagai karee pookaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. By the Lord's Grace, it isobtained.
lines.transliteration: har har naam amrit hai nad ree paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨ ਿਵਛੁੜਿਹ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, night and day, the intuitive peace and poiseof the Guru is obtained.
lines.transliteration: an-din har har uchrai gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਿਨਤ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਖਿਹ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. Focus your consciousness on the Naam.||4||3|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1258-16) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niDhaan hai naamay hee chit  laa-ay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I praise the Guru, the Giver of peace, forever. He truly is the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gur saalaahee sadaa sukh -daata parabh  naaraa-in  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. His glorious greatness is glorious!
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad param pad  paa-i-aa vadee vadi-aa-ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਨਦਰੀ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, merges in the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din gun  gaavai nit  saachay sach samaavai so-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਚਰੈ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, contemplate the Guru's Word in your heart.
lines.transliteration: man ray gurmukh rid ai veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: Abandon your false family, poisonous egotism and desire; remember in your heart, that you will have to leave. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: taj koorh  kutamb ha-umai bikh  tarisnaa chalan  ridai samHaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of the Lord's Name. There is no other giver at all. pMnw 1259
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa raam naam kaa hor d aataa ko-ee naahee.

lines.english: Bestowing the gift of the soul, He satisfies the mortal beings, and merges them in the True Name.
lines.transliteration: jee-a daan d ay-ay t ariptaasay sachai naam samaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਸੇ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they ravish and enjoy the Lord within the heart; they are intuitivelyabsorbed in Samaadhi. ||2||
lines.transliteration: an-din har ravi-aa rid  antar sahj samaaDh  lagaahee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਵਆ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਲਗਾਹੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, has pierced my mind. The True Word of HisBani permeates my heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur sabd ee ih man bh aydi-aa hird ai saachee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਦੀ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੇਿਦਆ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: My God is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Gurmukh speaks the Unspoken.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh alakh  na jaa-ee lakh i-aa gurmukh  akath kahaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਲਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: When the Giver of peace grants His Grace, the mortal being meditates on the Lord, the Life of the Universe. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay da-i-aa karay sukh -daata japee-ai saaringpaan ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਸਾਿਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: He does not come and go in renicarnation any longer; the Gurmukh meditatesintuitively.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa bahurh  na hovai gurmukh  sahj Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣਾ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: From the mind, the mind merges into our Lord and Master; the mind is absorbed intothe Mind.
lines.transliteration: man hee tay man mili-aa su-aamee man hee man samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In truth, the True Lord is pleased with truth; eradicate egotism from within yourself.||4||
lines.transliteration: saachay hee sach saach pateejai vichahu aap gavaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਿਚ  ਪਤੀਜੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Our One and Only Lord and Master dwells within the mind; there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: ayko ayk vasai man su-aamee doojaa avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The One Name is Sweet Ambrosial Nectar; it is Immaculate Truth in the world.
lines.transliteration: ayko naam amrit hai meeth aa jag nirmal sach so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ  ਜਿਗ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Name of God is obtained, by those who are so predestined. ||5||4|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1259-7) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam parabhoo t ay paa-ee-ai jin ka-o Dh ur likh i-aa ho-ee. ||5||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.english: All the heavenly heralds and celestial singers are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gan ganDh arab naamay sabh  uDhray gur kaa sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: They contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Subduing their ego, the Nameabides in their minds; they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar sad man vasaa-i-aa har raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਿਭ ਉਧਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; the Lord unites him withHimself.
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaa-ay so-ee boojh ai jis no aapay la-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਸਦ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, he sings the Word of the Shabad and the Guru's Bani; he remainslovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din ban ee sabd ay gaaNvai saach rahai liv laa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ  ਲਏ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, each and every moment, dwell on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: man mayray khin kh in naam samHaal.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਗਵੈ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Shabad is the Guru's Gift. It shall bring you lasting peace deep within; it shallalways stand by you. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kee daat  sabad  sukh  antar sad aa nibhai t ayrai naal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs never give up their hypocrisy; in the love of duality, theysuffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: manmukh pakh and kad ay na chookai d oojai bh aa-ay d ukh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਿਤ  ਸਬਦ  ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਦਾ ਿਨਬਹੈ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, their minds are imbued with corruption. They waste away theirlives uselessly.
lines.transliteration: naam visaar bikhi-aa man raat ay birthaa janam gavaa-ay.

lines.english: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; night and day, they shall always regret and repent.
lines.transliteration: ih vaylaa fir hath na aavai an-din sad aa pachh utaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: They die and die again and again, only to be reborn, but they never understand. Theyrot away in manure. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mar mar janmai kaday na boojh ai vistaa maahi samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Naam, and are saved; they contemplate the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam rat ay say uDh ray gur kaa sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਹਿਥ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, they are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.They enshrine the Lord within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat har naam Dh i-aa-i-aa har raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਰ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਵਸਟਾ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Their minds and bodies are immaculate, their intellect is immaculate and sublime.Their speech is sublime as well.
lines.transliteration: man tan nirmal nirmal mat  ootam oot am ban ee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They realize the One Primal Being, the One Lord God. There is no other at all. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ayko purakh ayk parabh  jaataa doojaa avar na ko-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਨ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause of causes. He Himself bestowsHis Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay parabh aapay aapay nad ar karay-i.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮ  ਊਤਮ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani. My consciousness isimmersed in His service.
lines.transliteration: man tan raat aa gur kee ban ee sayvaa surat  samay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਏਕੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord dwells deep within. He is seen only by the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: antar vasi-aa alakh  abhayvaa gurmukh  ho-ay lakh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, He gives to whomever He pleases. According to the Pleasure of His Will, He leads the mortals on. ||4||5|| mlwr mhlw 3 duquky ] (1259-17) malaar mehlaa 3 dut ukay. Malaar, Third Mehl, Du-Tukas:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bhaavai t is aapay d ayvai bh aavai t ivai chalaa-ay. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮੇਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Guru, the mortal obtains the special place, the Mansion of theLord's Presence in his own home.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay paavai gh ar dar mahal so thaan.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਵਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his egotistical pride is dispelled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee chookai abh imaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who have the Naam inscribed on their foreheads,
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o lilaat likhi-aa Dh ur naam.
an-din naam sad aa sad aa Dh i-aavahi saachee d argeh paavahi maan. ||1|| rahaa-o. meditate on the Naam night and day, forever and ever. They are honored in the TrueCourt of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: From the True Guru, they learn the ways and means of the mind. Night and day, they focus their meditation on the Lord forever. pMnw 1260
lines.transliteration: man kee biDh sat gur tay jaan ai an-d in laagai sad  har si-o Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they remain forever detached. They are honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur sabad rat ay sad aa bairaagee har d argeh saachee paavahi maan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: This mind plays, subject to the Lord's Will; in an instant, it wanders out in the tendirections and returns home again.
lines.transliteration: ih man khaylai hukam kaa baaDh aa ik kh in meh d ah dis fir aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਹੁਕਮ ਕਾ ਬਾਧਾ  ਇਕ ਿਖਨ ਮਿਹ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਿਫਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: ||3|| When the True Lord God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then this mind isinstantly brought under control by the Gurmukh. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaaN aapay nadar karay har parabh  saachaa t aaN ih man gurmukh  tatkaal vas aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਆਪੇ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਤਤਕਾਲ  ਵਿਸ ਆਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The mortal comes to know the ways and means of the mind, realizing andcontemplating the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: is man kee biDh man hoo jaan ai boojh ai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਿਬਿਧ  ਮਨ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੈ  ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.||4||6|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1260-4) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay sad aa too bh av saagar jit  paavahi paar. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਿਜਤੁ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Soul, body and breath of life are all His; He is permeating and pervading each andevery heart.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind paraan sabh  tis kay gh at ghat rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: Except the One Lord, I do not know any other at all. The True Guru has revealed this to me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aykas bin mai avar na jaanaa sat gur dee-aa bujh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਸਿਭ ਿਤਸ ਕੇ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, remain lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray naam raha-o liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸੁ  ਿਬਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I meditate on the Lord, the Unseen,Unfathomable and Infinite Creator. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: adisat agochar aprampar kart aa gur kai sabad  har Dh i-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Mind and body are pleased, lovingly attuned to the One Lord, intuitively absorbed inpeace and poise.
lines.transliteration: man tan bh eejai ayk liv laagai sehjay rahay samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਦਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, doubt and fear are dispelled, being lovingly attuned to the OneName. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bharam bh a-o bh aagai ayk naam liv laa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: When the mortal follows the Guru's Teachings, and lives the Truth, then he attains thestate of emancipation.
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee sach kaar kamaavai gat mat  tab hee paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਕ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Among millions, how rare is that one who understands, and is lovingly attuned to theName of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay kiseh bujh aa-ay t in raam naam liv laa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ਏਕ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, there I see the One. This understanding has come through theGuru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah ayko so-ee ih gurmat  buDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਗਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I place my mind, body and breath of life in offering before Him; O Nanak, self-conceit is gone. ||4||7|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1260-10) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: man tan paraan Dh areeN tis aagai naanak aap gavaa-ee. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਿਕਸਿਹ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My True Lord God, the Eradicator of suffering, is found through the Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh saachaa d ookh nivaaran  sabd ay paa-i-aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਇਹ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Imbued with devotional worship, the mortal remains forever detached. He is honoredin the True Court of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhagt ee raat ay sad  bairaagee d ar saachai pat  paa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਧਰੀ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: O mind, remain absorbed in the Mind.
lines.transliteration: man ray man si-o raha-o samaa-ee.

lines.english: The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the Lord's Name, lovingly attuned to theLord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam man bh eejai har sayt ee liv laa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰਣੁ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My God is totally Inaccessible and Unfathomable; through the Guru's Teachings, He isunderstood.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh at  agam agochar gurmat  day-ay bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਦਿਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True self-discipline rests in singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, lovingly attuned tothe Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam karnee har keerat  har sayt ee liv laa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself is the Shabad, and He Himself is the True Teachings; He merges our light into the Light.
lines.transliteration: aapay sabad sach saakh ee aapay jinH jotee jot  milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The breath vibrates through this frail body; the Gurmukh obtains the ambrosial nectar.||3||
lines.transliteration: dayhee kaachee pa-un  vajaa-ay gurmukh  amrit  paa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: He Himself fashions, and He Himself links us to our tasks; the True Lord is pervadingeverywhere.
lines.transliteration: aapay saajay sabh kaarai laa-ay so sach rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਿਤ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is anything. Through theNaam,we are blessed with glory. ||4||8|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1260-16) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam binaa ko-ee kichh naahee naamay d ay-ay vadaa-ee. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The mortal is enticed by the poison of corruption, burdened with such a heavy load.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai bikh man mohi-aa lad i-aa ajgar bh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਿਜਨ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has placed the magic spell of the Shabad into his mouth, and destroyed thepoison of ego. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garurh sabad  mukh  paa-i-aa ha-umai bikh  har maaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਚੀ  ਪਉਣੁ  ਵਜਾਏ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O mortal, egotism and attachment are such heavy loads of pain.
lines.transliteration: man ray ha-umai moh dukh  bhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ  ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: This terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed; through the Lord's Name, the Gurmukh crosses over to the other side. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ih bhavjal jagat  na jaa-ee t arnaa gurmukh  tar har t aaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਕੋਈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਮੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ  ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: Attachment to the three-phased show of Maya pervades all the created forms.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  maa-i-aa moh pasaaraa sabh  vartai aakaaree.

lines.english: In the Sat Sangat, the Society of the Saints, the state of supreme awareness isattained. The Merciful Lord carries us across. ||2||
lines.transliteration: turee-aa gun  satsangat  paa-ee-ai nad ree paar ut aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਲਿਦਆ  ਅਜਗਰ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The smell of sandalwood is so sublime; its fragrance spreads out far and wide. pMnw 1261
lines.transliteration: chandan ganDh  suganDh  hai baho baasnaa behkaar.

lines.english: The lifestyle of the Lord's humble servant is exalted and sublime. He spreads the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises throughout the world. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har jan karnee oot am hai har keerat  jag bisthaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਰਣੀ  ਊਤਮ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਜਿਗ  ਿਬਸਥਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, please be merciful, merciful to me, that I may enshrine theLord, Har, Har, Har, within my heart.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kar thaakur mayray har har har ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak has found the Perfect True Guru; in his mind, he chants the Name of the Lord.||4||9|| mlwr mhlw 3 Gru 2  (1261-3) malaar mehlaa 3 ghar 2 Malaar, Third Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1261-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur pooraa paa-i-aa man japi-aa naam muraar. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਜਿਪਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: Is this mind a householder, or is this mind a detached renunciate?
lines.transliteration: ih man girhee ke ih man udaasee.
