lines.english: Is this mind beyond social class, eternal and unchanging?
lines.transliteration: ke ih man avran sadaa avinaasee.

lines.english: Is this mind fickle, or is this mind detached?
lines.transliteration: ke ih man chanchal ke ih man bairaagee.

lines.english: How has this mind been gripped by possessiveness? ||1||
lines.transliteration: is man ka-o mamtaa kithhu laagee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਿਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Pandit, O religious scholar, reflect on this in your mind.
lines.transliteration: pandit is man kaa karahu beechaar.

lines.english: Why do you read so many other things, and carry such a heavy load? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar ke bahutaa parh eh uth aaveh bh aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Creator has attached it to Maya and possessiveness.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mamtaa kart ai laa-ee.

lines.english: Enforcing His Order, He created the world.
lines.transliteration: ayhu hukam kar sarisat upaa-ee.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, understand this, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee boojhhu bh aa-ee.

lines.english: Remain forever in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa rahhu har kee sarn aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: He alone is a Pandit, who sheds the load of the three qualities.
lines.transliteration: so pandit jo t ihaaN gunaa kee pand ut aarai.

lines.english: Night and day, he chants the Name of the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din ayko naam vakh aanai.

lines.english: He accepts the Teachings of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee oh d eekhi-aa lay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਜੋ ਿਤਹ ਗੁਣਾ  ਕੀ ਪੰਡ ਉਤਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: He offers his head to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur aagai sees Dh aray-ay.

lines.english: He remains forever unattached in the state of Nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: sadaa alag rahai nirbaan .

lines.english: Such a Pandit is accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so pandit d argeh parvaan . ||3||

lines.english: He preaches that the One Lord is within all beings.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaaN meh ayko ayk vakh aanai.

lines.english: As he sees the One Lord, he knows the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaaN ayko vaykhai t aaN ayko jaan ai.

lines.english: That person, whom the Lord forgives, is united with Him.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o bakhsay maylay so-ay.

lines.english: He finds eternal peace, here and hereafter. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aithai othai sadaa sukh  ho-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, what can anyone do?
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak kavan biDh  karay ki-aa ko-ay.

lines.english: He alone is liberated, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.
lines.transliteration: so-ee mukat jaa ka-o kirpaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: an-din har gun  gaavai so-ay.

lines.english: Then, he no longer bothers with the proclamations of the Shaastras or the Vedas. ||5||1||10|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1261-12) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saastar bayd  kee fir kook na ho-ay. ||5||1||10||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in reincarnation, confused and deluded bydoubt.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram jon manmukh  bharmaa-ee.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death constantly beats them and disgraces them.
lines.transliteration: jamkaal maaray nit pat  gavaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਸਤਰ੍  ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the mortal's subservience to Death is ended.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvaa jam kee kaan  chukaa-ee.

lines.english: He meets the Lord God, and enters the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har parabh mili-aa mahal gh ar paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraanee gurmukh  naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: In duality, you are ruining and wasting this priceless human life. You trade it away in exchange for a shell. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath d ubiDh aa kh o-i-aa ka-udee bad lai jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਿਣ  ਚੁਕਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh falls in love with the Lord, by His Grace.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gurmukh lagai pi-aar.

lines.english: He enshrines loving devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, deep within his heart.
lines.transliteration: antar bh agat har har ur Dh aar.

lines.english: The Word of the Shabad carries him across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhavjal sabad  langh aavan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਖੋਇਆ  ਕਉਡੀ  ਬਦਲੈ  ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He appears true in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dar saachai d isai sachiaar. ||2||

lines.english: Performing all sorts of rituals, they do not find the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: baho karam karay satgur nahee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Guru, so many wander lost and confused in Maya.
lines.transliteration: bin gur bharam bh oolay baho maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Egotism, possessiveness and attachment rise up and increase within them.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa baho moh vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: In the love of dualty, the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay manmukh  dukh paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: The Creator Himself is Inaccessible and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa agam athaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and earn the true profit.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee japee-ai sach laahaa.

lines.english: The Lord is Independent, Ever-present, here and now. pMnw 1262
lines.transliteration: haajar hajoor har vayparvaahaa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in the Naam. ||4||2||11|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1262-1) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh naam samaahaa. ||4||2||11||

lines.english: Those who are attached to the Guru's Teachings, are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yetalive.
lines.transliteration: jeevat mukat  gurmat ee laagay.

lines.english: They remain forever awake and aware night and day, in devotional worship of theLord.
lines.transliteration: har kee bhagat  an-din sad  jaagay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: They serve the True Guru, and eradicate their self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: I fall at the feet of such humble beings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin jan kay sad  laaga-o paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਨ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live.
lines.transliteration: ha-o jeevaaN sadaa har kay gun  gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is such totally sweet elixir. Through the Name of the Lord, I have attained the state of liberation. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meeth aa har kai naam mukat  gat paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਮੁਕਿਤ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Attachment to Maya leads to the darkness of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh agi-aan gubaar.

lines.english: The self-willed manukhs are attached, foolish and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mohay mugaDh  gavaar.

lines.english: Night and day, their lives pass away in worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: an-din Dh anDhaa karat  vihaa-ay.

lines.english: They die and die again and again, only to be reborn and receive their punishment.||2||
lines.transliteration: mar mar jameh milai sajaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh raam naam liv laa-ee.

lines.english: He does not cling to false greed.
lines.transliteration: koorhai laalach naa laptaa-ee.

lines.english: Whatever he does, he does with intuitive poise.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh hovai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; his tongue delights in its flavor. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har ras peevai rasan rasaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Among millions, hardly any understand.
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay kiseh bujh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Lord Himself forgives, and bestows His glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay d ay vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Whoever meets with the Primal Lord God, shall never be separated again.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur mili-aa so vichh urh na jaa-ee.

lines.english: Nanak is absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||12|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1262-8) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har har naam samaa-ee. ||4||3||12||

lines.english: Everyone speaks the Name of the Lord with the tongue.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa naam sabh ko-ee kahai.

lines.english: But only by serving the True Guru does the mortal receive the Name.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay t aa naam lahai.

lines.english: His bonds are shattered, and he stays in the house of liberation.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orhay mukat  ghar rahai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sits in the eternal, unchanging house. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee asthir gh ar bahai. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, why are you angry?
lines.transliteration: mayray man kaahay ros kareejai.

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the source of profit. Contemplateand appreciate the Guru's Teachings within your heart, night and day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: laahaa kaljug raam naam hai gurmat an-d in hird ai raveejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Each and every instant, the rainbird cries and calls.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa khin kh in billaa-ay.

lines.english: Without seeing her Beloved, she does not sleep at all.
lines.transliteration: bin pir daykh ay neeNd na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ ਕਲਜੁਿਗ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਵੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: She cannot endure this separation.
lines.transliteration: ih vaychhorh aa sahi-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: When she meets the True Guru, then she intuitively meets her Beloved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t aaN milai subh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Lacking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal suffers and dies.
lines.transliteration: naamheen binsai d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: He is burnt in the fire of desire, and his hunger does not depart.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa jali-aa bh ookh na jaa-ay.

lines.english: Without good destiny, he cannot find the Naam.
lines.transliteration: vin bh aagaa naam na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: He performs all sorts of rituals until he is exhausted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: baho biDh thaakaa karam kamaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: The mortal thinks about the Vedic teachings of the three gunas, the three dispositions.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  banee bayd  beechaar.

lines.english: He deals in corruption, filth and vice.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa mail bikh i-aa vaapaar.

lines.english: He dies, only to be reborn; he is ruined over and over again.
lines.transliteration: mar janmeh fir hohi khu-aar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh enshrines the glory of the supreme state of celestial peace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t uree-aa gun  ur Dh aar. ||4||

lines.english: One who has faith in the Guru - everyone has faith in him.
lines.transliteration: gur maanai maanai sabh ko-ay.

lines.english: Through the Guru's Word, the mind is cooled and soothed.
lines.transliteration: gur bachnee man seetal ho-ay.

lines.english: Throughout the four ages, that humble being is known to be pure.
lines.transliteration: chahu jug sobhaa nirmal jan so-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, that Gurmukh is so rare. ||5||4||13||9||13||22|| rwgu mlwr mhlw 4 Gru 1 caupdy  (1262-17) raag malaar mehlaa 4 ghar 1 cha-upd ay Raag Malaar, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1262-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh virlaa ko-ay. ||5||4||13||9||13||22||

lines.english: Night and day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; through the Guru's Teachings, my pain is forgotten.
lines.transliteration: an-din har har Dh i-aa-i-o hird ai mat  gurmat  dookh visaaree.

lines.english: The chains of all my hopes and desires have been snapped; my Lord God hasshowered me with His Mercy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh aasaa mansaa banDh an tootay har har parabh  kirpaa Dh aaree. ||1||

lines.english: My eyes gaze eternally on the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: nainee har har laagee taaree.

lines.english: Gazing on the True Guru, my mind blossoms forth. I have met with the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1263
lines.transliteration: satgur d aykh mayraa man bigsi-o jan har bh ayti-o banvaaree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: One who forgets such a Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his family is dishonored.
lines.transliteration: jin aisaa naam visaari-aa mayraa har har tis kai kul laagee gaaree.

lines.english: His family is sterile and barren, and his mother is made a widow. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har tis kai kul parsoot  na karee-ahu t is biDh vaa kar meht aaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਐਸਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਿਲ  ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, let me meet the Holy Guru, who night and day keep the Lord enshrined in his heart.
lines.transliteration: har har aan milaavhu gur saaDhoo jis ahinis har ur Dh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਿਲ  ਪਰਸੂਿਤ  ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਧਵਾ  ਕਿਰ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Seeing the Guru, the GurSikh blossoms forth, like the child seeing his mother. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur deethai gur kaa sikh  bigsai ji-o baarik d aykh meht aaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਨ ਿਮਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਿਜਸੁ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan pir kaa ik hee sang vaasaa vich ha-umai bh eet karaaree. The soul-bride and the Husband Lord live together as one, but the hard wall ofegotism has come between them.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਡੀਠੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਿਸਖੁ ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਿਰਕੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru demolishes the wall of egotism; servant Nanak has met the Lord, theLord of the World. ||4||1|| mlwr mhlw 4 ] (1263-5) malaar mehlaa 4. Malaar, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai ha-umai bheet  toree jan naanak milay banvaaree. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਿਪਰ ਕਾ ਇਕ ਹੀ ਸੰਿਗ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਭੀਿਤ  ਕਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Ganges, the Jamunaa, the Godaavari and the Saraswati - these rivers strive for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: gangaa jamunaa godaavree sarsut ee tay karahi ud am Dh oor saaDh oo kee t aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਭੀਿਤ ਤੋਰੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੇ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: Overflowing with their filthy sins, the mortals take cleansing baths in them; the rivers' pollution is washed away by the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kilvikh mail bh aray paray hamrai vich hamree mail saaDh oo kee Dh oor gavaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Instead of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, take your cleansingbath in the Name.
lines.transliteration: tirath ath sath majan naa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੰਗਾ  ਜਮੁਨਾ  ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ  ਸਰਸੁਤੀ  ਤੇ ਕਰਿਹ ਉਦਮੁ  ਧੂਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: When the dust of the feet of the Sat Sangat rises up into the eyes, all filthy evil-mindedness is removed. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  kee Dh oor paree ud nayt ree sabh  durmat  mail gavaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਪਰੇ ਹਮਰੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਮਰੀ  ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Bhaageerat'h the penitent brought the Ganges down, and Shiva established Kaydaar.
lines.transliteration: jaaharnavee tapai bh aageerath aan ee kayd aar thaapi-o mehsaa-ee.

lines.english: Krishna grazed cows in Kaashi; through the humble servant of the Lord, these placesbecame famous. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaaNsee krisan charaavat gaa-oo mil har jan sobh aa paa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਪਰੀ ਉਿਡ ਨੇਤਰ੍ੀ  ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: And all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage established by the gods, long for the dust ofthe feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jitnay t irath d ayvee thaapay sabh  titnay locheh Dh oor saaDh oo kee t aa-ee.

lines.english: Meeting with the Lord's Saint, the Holy Guru, I apply the dust of His feet to my face. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kaa sant milai gur saaDh oo lai t is kee Dh oor mukh  laa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਹਰਨਵੀ  ਤਪੈ ਭਾਗੀਰਿਥ  ਆਣੀ  ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਥਾਿਪਓ  ਮਹਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: And all the creatures of Your Universe, O my Lord and Master, long for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: jitnee sarisat t umree mayray su-aamee sabh  titnee lochai Dh oor saaDh oo kee t aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਸੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨੁ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Holy; the Lord carries him across. ||4||2|| mlwr mhlw 4 ] (1263-12) malaar mehlaa 4. Malaar, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak lilaat hovai jis likhi-aa t is saaDh oo Dh oor day har paar langh aa-ee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਸਿਭ ਿਤਤਨੇ  ਲੋਚਿਹ  ਧੂਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord seems sweet to that humble being who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tis jan ka-o har meeth  lagaanaa jis har har kirpaa karai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੈ ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: His hunger and pain are totally taken away; he chants the Glorious Praises of theLord, Har, Har. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis kee bh ookh dookh sabh  utrai jo har gun  har uchrai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਨੀ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਿਤਤਨੀ  ਲੋਚੈ ਧੂਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, the mortal is emancipated.
lines.transliteration: jap man har har har nistarai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਲਲਾਿਟ  ਹੋਵੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਿਰ ਦੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਿਰ ਲੰਘਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: One who listens to the Guru's Teachings and meditates on them, is carried across theterrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kay bachan karan sun Dhi-aavai bh av saagar paar parai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am the slave of that humble being, who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord, Har,Har.
lines.transliteration: tis jan kay ham haat bihaajh ay jis har har kirpaa karai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Lord's humble servant, peace is obtained; all the pollution and filthof evil-mindedness is washed away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har jan ka-o mili-aaN sukh paa-ee-ai sabh  durmat  mail harai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਸਿਭ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰ ਉਚਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord feels hunger only for the Lord. He is satisfied only when he chants the Lord's Glories.
lines.transliteration: har jan ka-o har bhookh  lagaanee jan t ariptai jaa har gun bichrai.

lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord is a fish in the Water of the Lord. Forgetting the Lord,he would dry up and die. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kaa jan har jal kaa meenaa har bisrat foot marai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ  ਕਰਨ  ਸੁਿਨ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He alone knows this love, who enshrines it within his mind.
lines.transliteration: jin ayh pareet laa-ee so jaanai kai jaanai jis man Dh arai.

lines.english: Servant Nanak gazes upon the Lord and is at peace; The hunger of his body is totallysatisfied. ||4||3|| mlwr mhlw 4 ] (1263-18) malaar mehlaa 4. Malaar, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har daykh  sukh  paavai sabh  tan kee bh ookh tarai. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਹਾਿਟ  ਿਬਹਾਝੇ  ਿਜਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: All the beings and creatures which God has created - on their foreheds, He has writtentheir destiny.
lines.transliteration: jitnay jee-a jant  parabh  keenay t itnay sir kaar likh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਮਿਲਆਂ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord blesses His humble servant with glorious greatness. The Lord enjoins him tohis tasks. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har jan ka-o har deenH vadaa-ee har jan har kaarai laavai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਨੀ  ਜਨੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤੈ  ਜਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਿਬਚਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within. pMnw 1264
lines.transliteration: satgur har har naam d arirh-aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਿਸਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਤਰਾਵੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O Sikhs of the Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny. Only the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har bolhu gur kay sikh mayray bh aa-ee har bh a-ojal jagat  taraavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That humble being who worships, adores and serves the Guru is pleasing to my LordGod.
lines.transliteration: jo gur ka-o jan poojay sayvay so jan mayray har parabh bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: To worship and adore the True Guru is to serve the Lord. In His Mercy, He saves usand carries us across. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kee sayvaa satgur poojahu kar kirpaa aap t araavai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਤਰਾਵੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The ignorant and the blind wander deluded by doubt; deluded and confused, they pickflowers to offer to their idols.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh oolay agi-aanee anDh ulay bh aram bh aram fool t oraavai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੂਲੇ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਫੂਲ ਤੋਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: They worship lifeless stones and serve the tombs of the dead; all their efforts areuseless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nirjee-o poojeh marhaa sarayveh sabh  birthee gh aal gavaavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਜੀਉ  ਪੂਜਿਹ  ਮੜਾ ਸਰੇਵਿਹ  ਸਭ ਿਬਰਥੀ  ਘਾਲ  ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He alone is said to be the True Guru, who realizes God, and proclaims the Sermon ofthe Lord, Har, Har. iqsu gur kau Cwdn Bojn pwt ptMbr bhu ibiD siq kir muiK sMchu iqsu puMn kI iPir qoit n AwvY
lines.transliteration: barahm binday so sat gur kahee-ai har har kathaa sun aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਬੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Offer the Guru sacred foods, clothes, silk and satin robes of all sorts; know that He is True. The merits of this shall never leave you lacking. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o chh aadan bh ojan paat patambar baho biDh  sat kar mukh  sanchahu t is punn kee fir tot na aavai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਛਾਦਨ  ਭੋਜਨ  ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮੁਿਖ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Divine True Guru is the Embodiment, the Image of the Lord; He utters the Ambrosial Word.
lines.transliteration: satgur d ay-o part akh har moorat  jo amrit  bachan sun aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਉ ਪਰਤਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਜੋ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਚਨ  ਸੁਣਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, blessed and good is the destiny of that humble being, who focuses hisconsciousness on the Feet of the Lord. ||5||4|| mlwr mhlw 4 ] (1264-7) malaar mehlaa 4. Malaar, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaag bh alay t is jan kay jo har charn ee chit  laavai. ||5||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are filled with my True Guru - those Saints are good and noble inevery way.
lines.transliteration: jinH kai hee-arai basi-o mayraa satgur t ay sant  bhalay bh al bhaaNt.

lines.english: Seeing them, my mind blossoms forth in bliss; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tinH daykhay mayraa man bigsai ha-o t in kai sad  bal jaaNt. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਬਿਸਓ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਭਲ ਭਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O spiritual teacher, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee har bolhu din raat .

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ ਜਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All hunger and thirst are satisfied, for those who partake of the sublime essence of theLord, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tinH kee t arisnaa bh ookh sabh  utree jo gurmat  raam ras kh aaNt. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The slaves of the Lord are our Holy companions. Meeting with them, doubt is takenaway.
lines.transliteration: har kay daas saaDh  sakhaa jan jin mili-aa leh jaa-ay bh araaNt.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੀ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: As the swan separates the milk from the water, the Holy Saint removes the fire of egotism from the body. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 4) ji-o jal duDh  bhinn bh inn kaadh ai chun  hansulaa t i-o dayhee t ay chun  kaadh ai saaDhoo ha-umai t aat. ||2||

lines.english: Those who do not love the Lord in their hearts are deceitful; they continually practicedeception.
lines.transliteration: jin kai pareet naahee har hird ai tay kaptee nar nit  kapat kamaaNt.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਸਖਾ ਜਨ ਿਜਨ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ਭਰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: What can anyone give them to eat? Whatever they themselves plant, they must eat.||3||
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o ki-aa ko-ee d ay-ay kh avaalai o-ay aap beej aapay hee kh aaNt. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਿਭੰਨ ਿਭੰਨ ਕਾਢੈ  ਚੁਿਣ  ਹੰਸੁਲਾ  ਿਤਉ  ਦੇਹੀ ਤੇ ਚੁਿਣ  ਕਾਢੈ  ਸਾਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਾਿਤ ॥੨॥
lines.english: This is the Quality of the Lord, and of the Lord's humble servants as well; the Lordplaces His Own Essence within them.
lines.transliteration: har kaa chihan so-ee har jan kaa har aapay jan meh aap rakhaaNt.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਤੇ ਕਪਟੀ  ਨਰ ਿਨਤ  ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo naanak samad rasee jin nind aa ust at taree t araaNt. ||4||5|| Blessed, blessed, is Guru Nanak, who look s impartially on all; He crosses over and transcends both slander and praise. ||4||5|| mlwr mhlw 4 ] (1264-14) malaar mehlaa 4. Malaar, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਆ  ਕੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਲੈ  ਓਇ ਆਿਪ  ਬੀਿਜ  ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਖਿਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is inaccessible, unfathomable, exalted and sublime. It ischanted by the Lord's Grace.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar naam har ootam har kirpaa t ay jap la-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਚਹਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਜਨ ਮਿਹ ਆਪੁ  ਰਖਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, I have found the True Congregation, and in the Company ofthe Holy, I am carried across. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satsangat  saaDh  paa-ee vadbh aagee sang saaDh oo paar pa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਮਦਰਸੀ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਤਰੀ ਤਰਿਤ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: My mind is in ecstasy, night and day.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man an-din anad  bha-i-aa.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I chant the Name of the Lord. Doubt and fear are gone from my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad naam har japi-aa mayray man kaa bh aram bh a-o ga-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਜਿਪ ਲਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who chant and meditate on the Lord - O Lord, in Your Mercy, please unite mewith them.
lines.transliteration: jin har gaa-i-aa jin har japi-aa tin sangat  har maylhu kar ma-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon them, I am at peace; the pain and disease of egotism are gone. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tin kaa d aras d aykh sukh  paa-i-aa d ukh ha-umai rog ga-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord in their hearts - their lives become totally fruitful.
lines.transliteration: jo an-din hird ai naam Dh i-aavahi sabh  janam t inaa kaa safal bh a-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They themselves swim across, and carry the world across with them. Their ancestorsand family cross over as well. ||3||
lines.transliteration: o-ay aap taray sarisat sabh  taaree sabh  kul bh ee paar pa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.english: You Yourself created the whole world, and You Yourself keep it under Your control. pMnw 1265
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay aap upaa-i-aa sabh  jag tuDh aapay vas kar la-i-aa.

lines.english: God has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has lifted him up, and rescued him from the ocean of poison. ||4||6|| mlwr mhlw 4 ] (1265-2) malaar mehlaa 4. Malaar, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o parabh kirpaa Dh aaree bikh  dubd aa kaadh  la-i-aa. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਿਬਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਿਢ  ਲਇਆ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who do not drink in the Ambrosial Nectar by Guru's Grace - their thirst andhunger are not relieved.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee amrit nahee pee-aa t arisnaa bh ookh na jaa-ee.

lines.english: The foolish self-willed manmukh burns in the fire of egotistical pride; he sufferspainfully in egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh moorhH jalat ahaNkaaree ha-umai vich d ukh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਹੀ ਪੀਆ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going, he wastes his life uselessly; afflicted with pain, he regrets andrepents.
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa d ukh laagai pachh utaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂੜ ਜਲਤ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He does not even think of the One, from whom he originated. Cursed is his life, andcursed is his food. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis tay upjay t iseh na cheet eh Dh arig jeevan  Dharig kh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਦੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੈ  ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: paraanee gurmukh  naam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ  ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ  ਖਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy leads the mortal to meet the Guru; he is absorbed inthe Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karay gur maylay har har naam samaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The life of the self-willed manmukh is useless; he comes and goes in shame.
lines.transliteration: manmukh janam bh a-i-aa hai birthaa aavat  jaat lajaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In sexual desire and anger, the proud ones are drowned. They are burnt in their egotism.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh doobay abh imaanee ha-umai vich jal jaa-ee.

lines.english: They do not attain perfection or understanding; their intellect is dimmed. Tossed bythe waves of greed, they suffer in pain.
lines.transliteration: tin siDh  na buDh  bha-ee mat  maDh im lobh  lahar d ukh paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹੈ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਲਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. Seized by Death, they weep and wail.||2||
lines.transliteration: gur bihoon mahaa dukh  paa-i-aa jam pakray billaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਡੂਬੇ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have attained the Unfathomable Name of the Lord, with intuitive peaceand poise.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam agochar paa-i-aa gurmukh sahj subh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਨ ਬੁਿਧ ਭਈ ਮਿਤ ਮਿਧਮ  ਲੋਭ ਲਹਿਰ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within my heart. My tongue sings the GloriousPraises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan vasi-aa gh at ant ar rasnaa har gun  gaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਹੂਨ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਮ ਪਕਰੇ  ਿਬਲਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am forever in bliss, day and night, lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sadaa anand rahai d in raat ee ayk sabad  liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease; this is the gloriousgreatness of the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath sehjay paa-i-aa ih sat gur kee vadi-aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਘਟ ਅੰਤਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Guru, the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within my mind. I amforever a sacrifice to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay har har man vasi-aa sat gur ka-o sad  bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਰਹੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਏਕ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have dedicated my mind and body to Him, and placed everything before Him in offering. I focus my consciousness on His Feet.
lines.transliteration: man tan arap rakh a-o sabh  aagai gur charn ee chit  laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਹਜੇ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਇਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Please be merciful to me, O my Perf ect Guru, and unite me with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa karahu gur pooray aapay laihu milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am just iron; the Guru is the boat, to carry me across. ||4||7|| mlwr mhlw 4 pVqwl Gru 3  (1265-13) malaar mehlaa 4 parh-t aal gh ar 3 Malaar, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1265-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ham loh gur naav bohithaa naanak paar langhaa-ee. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਰਖਉ  ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ  ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name of the Supreme Lord; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Lord's Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jan bolat sareeraam naamaa mil saaDh sangat  har t or. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਪੇ  ਲੈਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Deal only in the wealth of the Lord, and gather only the wealth of the Lord. No thiefcan ever steal it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har Dhan banjahu har Dh an sanchahu jis laagat  hai nahee chor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਵ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਈ  ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: The rainbirds and the peacocks sing day and night, hearing the thunder in the clouds.||2||
lines.transliteration: chaatrik mor bolat  din raat ee sun gh anihar kee gh or. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the deer, the fish and the birds sing, they chant to the Lord, and no other.||3||
lines.transliteration: jo bolat hai marig meen pankh ayroo so bin har jaapat  hai nahee hor. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਬੋਲਤ  ਸਰ੍ੀਰਾਮ  ਨਾਮਾ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਤੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the sound and fury of Death has totally gone away. ||4||1||8|| mlwr mhlw 4 ] (1265-17) malaar mehlaa 4. Malaar, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan har keerat gaa-ee chh oot ga-i-o jam kaa sabh  sor. ||4||1||8||

lines.english: They speak and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the very fortunate onesseek Him.
lines.transliteration: raam raam bol bol khojt ay badbh aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਬਨਜਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਲਾਗਤ  ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever shows me the Way of the Lord - I fall at his feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kaa panth ko-oo bataavai ha-o t aa kai paa-ay laagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਮੋਰ ਬੋਲਤ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਸੁਿਨ ਘਿਨਹਰ  ਕੀ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord is my Friend and Compansion; I am in love with the Lord. pMnw 1266
lines.transliteration: har hamaaro meet sakh aa-ee ham har si-o pareet  laagee.

lines.english: I sing of the Lord, and I speak of the Lord; I have discarded all other loves. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har ham gaavahi har ham boleh a-or dut ee-aa pareet  ham t i-aagee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਮ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਅਉਰੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹਮ ਿਤਆਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; The Detached Lord God is the Embodiment of Supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: manmohan moro pareetam raam har parmaanand  bairaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਰੋ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ  ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak lives by gazing upon the Lord; may I see Him for a moment, for even just an instant. ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31|| rwgu mlwr mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 1  (1266-4) raag malaar mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 1 Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1266-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har daykh ay jeevat  hai naanak ik nimakh  palo mukh  laagee. ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੀਵਤ  ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਪਲੋ ਮੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੯॥੩੧॥
lines.english: What are you so worried about? What are you thinking? What have you tried?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa too socheh ki-aa t oo chit vahi ki-aa t ooN karahi upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me - the Lord of the Universe - who controls Him? ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o kahhu parvaah kaahoo kee jih gopaal sahaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਤੂ ਸੋਚਿਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਤੂ ਿਚਤਵਿਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਉਪਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The rain showers down from the clouds, O companion. The Guest has come into my home.
lines.transliteration: barsai maygh sakh ee gh ar paahun aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਹ  ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਿਜਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸਹਾਏ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am meek; my Lord and Master is the Ocean of Mercy. I am absorbed in the ninetreasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mohi deen kirpaa niDh  thaakur nav niDh  naam samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰਸੈ  ਮੇਘੁ ਸਖੀ ਘਿਰ  ਪਾਹੁਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: I have prepared all sorts of foods in various ways, and all sorts of sweet deserts.
lines.transliteration: anik parkaar bhojan baho kee-ay baho binjan mistaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਦੀਨ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have made my kitchen pure and sacred. Now, O my Sovereign Lord King, pleasesample my food. ||2||
lines.transliteration: karee paaksaal soch pavitaraa hun  laavhu bh og har raa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The villains have been destroyed, and my friends are delighted. This is Your OwnMansion and Temple, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: dusat bid aaray saajan rahsay ihi mand ir ghar apnaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰ  ਭੋਜਨ  ਬਹੁ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਿਬੰਜਨ  ਿਮਸਟਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: When my Playful Beloved came into my household, then I found total peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ja-o garihi laal rangee-o aa-i-aa ta-o mai sabh  sukh  paa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ  ਸੋਚ ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ਾ ਹੁਿਣ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭੋਗੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, I have the Support and Protection of the Perfect Guru; this is the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa ot gur pooray Dh ur mast ak laykh  likhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਟ  ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਰਹਸੇ  ਇਿਹ ਮੰਿਦਰ  ਘਰ ਅਪਨਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has found his Playful Husband Lord. He shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||4||1|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1266-10) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kant rangeelaa paa-i-aa fir d ookh na laagai aa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ ਲਾਲੁ  ਰੰਗੀਓ  ਆਇਆ  ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.english: When the baby's only food is milk, it cannot survive without its milk.
lines.transliteration: kheer aDh aar baarik jab hot aa bin kh eerai rahan na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਖਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The mother takes care of it, and pours milk into its mouth; then, it is satisfied andfulfilled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saar samHaal maataa mukh  neerai t ab oh t aripat  aghaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਫਿਰ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਏ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: I am just a baby; God, the Great Giver, is my Father.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik pitaa parabh  daataa.

lines.english: The child is so foolish; it makes so many mistakes. But it has nowhere else to go.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhooleh baarik anik lakh  baree-aa an th a-ur naahee jah jaat aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਿਰ ਬਾਿਰਕੁ  ਜਬ ਹੋਤਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਖੀਰੈ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The mind of the poor child is fickle; he touches even snakes and fire.
lines.transliteration: chanchal mat baarik bapuray kee sarap agan kar maylai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਮਾਤਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਨੀਰੈ ਤਬ ਓਹੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: His mother and father hug him close in their embrace, and so he plays in joy and bliss. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maataa pit aa kanth  laa-ay raakh ai anad  sahj t ab kh aylai. ||2||

lines.english: What hunger can the child ever have, O my Lord and Master, when You are hisFather?
lines.transliteration: jis kaa pitaa t oo hai mayray su-aamee t is baarik bh ookh kaisee.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲਿਹ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ  ਅਨ ਠਉਰ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਹ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam and the nine treasures are in Your celestial household. Youfulfill the desires of the mind. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nav niDh naam niDh aan garihi t ayrai man baaNchhai so laisee. ||3||

lines.english: My Merciful Father has issued this Command: whatever the child asks for, is put intohis mouth.
lines.transliteration: pitaa kirpaal aagi-aa ih d eenee baarik mukh  maaNgai so d aynaa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਚਲ  ਮਿਤ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਬਪੁਰੇ  ਕੀ ਸਰਪ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਕਰ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
lines.english: Nanak, the child, longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. May His Feet alwaysdwell within my heart. ||4||2|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1266-17) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak baarik daras parabh  chaahai mohi hird ai baseh nit  charnaa. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤਾ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਰਾਖੈ ਅਨਦ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਤਬ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I tried everything, and gathered all devices together; I have discarded all myanxieties.
lines.transliteration: sagal biDhee jur aahar kari-aa t aji-o sagal and aysaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਿਪਤਾ  ਤੂ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਭੂਖ ਕੈਸੀ ॥
lines.english: I have begun to set all my household affairs right; I have placed my faith in my Lordand Master. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaaraj sagal araambhi-o gh ar kaa th aakur kaa bh aarosaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਤੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਬਛੈ ਸੋ ਲੈਸੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I listen to the celestial vibrations resonating and resounding.
lines.transliteration: sunee-ai baajai baaj suhaavee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਤਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਿਲ  ਆਿਗਆ  ਇਹ ਦੀਨੀ  ਬਾਿਰਕੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਗੈ  ਸੋ ਦੇਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Sunrise has come, and I gaze upon the Face of my Beloved. My household is filledwith peace and pleasure. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhor bh a-i-aa mai pari-a mukh  paykh ay garihi mangal suhlaavee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਾਿਰਕੁ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਚਾਹੈ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਹਰ੍ਦੈ ਬਸਿਹ  ਿਨਤ  ਚਰਨਾ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: I focus my mind, and embellish and adorn the place within; then I go out to speakwith the Saints.
lines.transliteration: manoo-aa laa-ay savaaray thaanaaN poochha-o sant aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Seeking and searching, I have found my Husband Lord; I bow at His Feet and worship Him with devotion. ||2|| pMnw 1267
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat mai paahun mili-o bh agat kara-o niv paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: When my Beloved came to live in my house, I began to sing the songs of bliss.
lines.transliteration: jab pari-a aa-ay basay garihi aasan tab ham mangal gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਆਇ  ਬਸੇ ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਆਸਿਨ  ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My friends and companions are happy; God leads me to meet the Perfect Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: meet saajan mayray bh a-ay suhaylay parabh  pooraa guroo milaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ  ਮੇਰੇ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My friends and companions are in ecstasy; the Guru has completed all my projects.
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahaylee bh a-ay anand aa gur kaaraj hamray pooray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਰਜ  ਹਮਰੇ  ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have met my Husband, the Giver of peace; He shall never leave me and go away. ||4||3|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1267-4) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak var mili-aa sukh-d aata chh od na jaa-ee d ooray. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਛੋਿਡ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: From a king to a worm, and from a worm to the lord of gods, they engage in evil to filltheir bellies.
lines.transliteration: raaj tay keet keet t ay surpat  kar d okh jathar ka-o bh artay.

lines.english: They renounce the Lord, the Ocean of Mercy, and worship some other; they arethieves and killers of the soul. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDh chh od aan ka-o poojeh aat am gh aatee hart ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਕੀਟ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਪਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਦੋਖ ਜਠਰ  ਕਉ ਭਰਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow and die.
lines.transliteration: har bisrat t ay dukh dukh mart ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਛੋਿਡ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜਿਹ  ਆਤਮ  ਘਾਤੀ  ਹਰਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: They wander lost in reincarnation through all sorts of species; they do not find shelteranywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anik baar bharmeh baho jonee tayk na kaahoo Dh artay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who abandon their Lord and Master and think of some other, are foolish,stupid, idiotic donkeys.
lines.transliteration: ti-aag su-aamee aan ka-o chit vat moorh  mugaDh  khal khar tay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਬਾਰ ਭਰ੍ਮਿਹ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਰਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: How can they cross over the ocean in a paper boat? Their eogtistical boasts that theywill cross over are meaningless. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaagar naav langheh kat  saagar baritha kathat  ham t artay. ||2||

lines.english: Shiva, Brahma, angels and demons, all burn in the fire of death.
lines.transliteration: siv biranch asur sur jaytay kaal agan meh jart ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਨ  ਕਉ ਿਚਤਵਤ  ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ  ਖਲ ਖਰ ਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet; O God, Creator, please do not send me into exile. ||3||4|| rwgu mlwr mhlw 5 dupdy Gru 1  (1267-9) raag malaar mehlaa 5 dupd ay gh ar 1 Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Du-Padas, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1267-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak saran charan kamlan kee tumH na daarahu parabh  kartay. ||3||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਗਰ  ਨਾਵ ਲੰਘਿਹ  ਕਤ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਕਥਤ  ਹਮ ਤਰਤੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My God is detached and free of desire.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayray o-ay bairaagee t i-aagee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਿਬਰੰਿਚ  ਅਸੁਰ  ਸੁਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਲ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਿਹ ਜਰਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant. I am so in love with Him.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o ik khin t is bin reh na saka-o pareet  hamaaree laagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲਨ  ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਨ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਰਤੇ  ॥੩॥੪॥
lines.english: Associating with the Saints, God has come into my consciousness. By their Grace, Ihave been awakened.
lines.transliteration: un kai sang mohi parabh chit  aavai sant  parsaad  mohi jaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Teachings, my mind has become immaculate. Imbued with the Lord'sLove, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sun updays bh a-ay man nirmal gun gaa-ay rang raaNgee. ||1||

lines.english: Dedicating this mind, I have made friends with the Saints. They have become mercifulto me; I am very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: ih man day-ay kee-ay sant  meet aa kirpaal bh a-ay badbh aageeN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ਲਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have found absolute peace - I cannot describe it. Nanak has obtained the dust of the feet of the humble. ||2||1||5|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1267-13) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mahaa sukh paa-i-aa baran na saaka-o rayn naanak jan paagee. ||2||1||5||

lines.english: O mother, please lead me to union with my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee mohi pareetam d ayh milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਮੋਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਮੋਿਹ ਜਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: All my friends and companions sleep totally in peace; their Beloved Lord has comeinto the homes of their hearts. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sagal sahaylee sukh bh ar soot ee jih gh ar laal basaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਭਏ ਮਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ਰੰਿਗ ਰਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am worthless; God is forever Merciful. I am unworthy; what clever tricks could I try?
lines.transliteration: mohi avgan parabh sad aa da-i-aalaa mohi nirgun ki-aa chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਕੀਏ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਭਏ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.english: I claim to be on a par with those who are imbued with the Love of their Beloved. Thisis my stubborn egotism. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kara-o baraabar jo pari-a sang raateeN ih ha-umai kee dh eethaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਰੇਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਪਾਗੀ  ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: I am dishonored - I seek the Sanctuary of the One, the Guru, the True Guru, thePrimal Being, the Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: bha-ee nimaan ee saran ik t aakee gur sat gur purakh  sukh -daa-ee.

lines.english: In an instant, all my pains have been taken away; Nanak passes the night of his life inpeace. ||2||2||6|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1267-17) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ayk nimakh meh mayraa sabh  dukh kaati-aa naanak sukh  rain bihaa-ee. ||2||2||6||

lines.english: Rain down, O cloud; do not delay.
lines.transliteration: baras maygh jee t il bilam na laa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਸਹੇਲੀ  ਸੁਖ ਭਿਰ ਸੂਤੀ ਿਜਹ ਘਿਰ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਬਸਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O beloved cloud, O support of the mind, you bring lasting bliss and joy to the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: baras pi-aaray maneh saDhaaray ho-ay anad  sadaa man chaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I take to Your Support, O my Lord and Master; how could You forget me? pMnw 1268
lines.transliteration: ham tayree Dh ar su-aamee-aa mayray t oo ki-o manhu bisaaray.

lines.english: I am Your beautiful bride, Your servant and slave. I have no nobility without my Husband Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: istaree roop chayree kee ni-aa-ee sobh  nahee bin bh artaaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਤਰ੍ੀ  ਰੂਪ ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਸੋਭ ਨਹੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When my Lord and Master listened to my prayer, He hurried to shower me with HisMercy.
lines.transliteration: bin-o suni-o jab thaakur mayrai bayg aa-i-o kirpaa Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਉ  ਸੁਿਨਓ  ਜਬ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮੇਰੈ ਬੇਿਗ  ਆਇਓ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have become just like my Husband Lord; I am blessed with honor,nobility and the lifestyle of goodness. ||2||3||7|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1268-3) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayro bani-o suhaago pat sobh aa bh alay achaaray. ||2||3||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੋ ਬਿਨਓ  ਸੁਹਾਗੋ  ਪਿਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੇ ਅਚਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
lines.english: Meditate on the True Name of your Beloved.
lines.transliteration: pareetam saachaa naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: The pains and sorrows of the terrifying world-ocean are dispelled, by enshrining the Image of the Guru within your heart. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad binsai bh av saagar gur kee moorat  ridai basaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your enemies shall be destroyed, and all the evil-doers shall perish, when you come tothe Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: dusman hat ay dokhee sabh  vi-aapay har sarn aa-ee aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ  ਿਬਨਸੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Savior Lord has given me His Hand and saved me; I have obtained the wealth ofthe Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaarai haath d ay raakh i-o naam pad aarath paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Granting His Grace, He has eradicated all my sins; He has placed the ImmaculateNaam within my mind.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa kilvikh sabh  kaatay naam nirmal man d ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਮਨ  ਹਤੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਿਭ ਿਵਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Treasure of Virtue fills my mind; I shall never again suffer in pain.||2||4||8|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1268-7) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan naanak man vasi-aa baahurh  dookh na thee-aa. ||2||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ  ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Beloved God is the Lover of my breath of life.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayray pareet am paraan pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਸਿਭ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਮਿਨ ਦੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with the loving devotional worship of the Naam, O Kind andCompassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  apno naam d eejai d a-i-aal anoograhu Dh aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ  ॥੨॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: I meditate in remembrance on Your Feet, O my Beloved; my heart is filled with hope.
lines.transliteration: simra-o charan tuhaaray pareet am rid ai tuhaaree aasaa.

lines.english: I offer my prayer to the humble Saints; my mind thirsts for the Blssed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant janaa peh kara-o baynt ee man d arsan kee pi-aasaa. ||1||

lines.english: Separation is death, and Union with the Lord is life. Please bless Your humble servantwith Your Darshan.
lines.transliteration: bichhurat  maran jeevan har milt ay jan ka-o d arsan d eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਅਪਨੋ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my God, please be Merciful, and bless Nanak with the support, the life and wealthof the Naam. ||2||5||9|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1268-10) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam aDhaar jeevan Dh an naanak parabh  mayray kirpaa keejai. ||2||5||9||

lines.english: Now, I have become just like my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: ab apnay pareetam si-o ban aa-ee.

lines.english: Dwelling on my Sovereign Lord King, I have found peace. Rain down, O peace-givingcloud. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam ramat sukh  paa-i-o baras maygh  sukh -daa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਿਹ ਕਰਉ  ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮਿਨ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੀ ਿਪਆਸਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I cannot forget Him, even for an instant; He is the Ocean of peace. Through theNaam, the Name of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: ik pal bisrat nahee sukh  saagar naam navai niDh  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਛੁਰਤ  ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲਤੇ  ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: My perfect destiny has been activated, meeting with the Saints, my help and support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: udout  bha-i-o pooran bh aavee ko bh aytay sant  sahaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਵਨ  ਧਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰ੍ਭ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
lines.english: Peace has welled up, and all pain has been dispelled, lovingly attuned to the SupremeLord God.
lines.transliteration: sukh upjay d ukh sagal binaasay paarbarahm liv laa-ee.

lines.english: The arduous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, O Nanak, by meditating onthe Feet of the Lord. ||2||6||10|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1268-14) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tari-o sansaar kath in bhai saagar har naanak charan Dh i-aa-ee. ||2||6||10||

lines.english: The clouds have rained down all over the world.
lines.transliteration: ghanihar baras sagal jag chh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਬਰਸੁ  ਮੇਘ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Beloved Lord God has become merciful to me; I am blessed with ecstasy, bliss andpeace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bha-ay kirpaal pareet am parabh  mayray anad  mangal sukh  paa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My sorrows are erased, and all my thirsts are quenched, meditating on the SupremeLord God.
lines.transliteration: mitay kalays tarisan sabh  boojh ee paarbarahm man Dh i-aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਿਬਸਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, death and birth come to an end, andthe mortal does not wander anywhere, ever again. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang janam maran nivaaray bahur na kat hoo Dh aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਉਦੌਤੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਾਵੀ  ਕੋ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind and body are imbued with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; I am lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: man tan naam niranjan raat a-o charan kamal liv laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਨਾਸੇ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: God has made Nanak His Own; slave Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||2||7||11|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1268-18) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-o parabh apnai naanak d aas sarn aa-i-aa. ||2||7||11||

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਰਓ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਿਠਨ  ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਚਰਨ  ਿਧਆਈ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Separated from the Lord, how can any living being live?
lines.transliteration: bichhurat  ki-o jeevay o-ay jeevan.

lines.english: My consciousness is filled with yearning and hope to meet my Lord, and drink in thesublime essence of His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chiteh ulaas aas milbay kee charan kamal ras peevan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who are thirsty for You, O my Beloved, are not separated from You.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o pi-aas tumaaree pareet am tin ka-o ant ar naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਭਏ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who forget my Beloved Lord are dead and dying. ||1|| pMnw 1269
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o bisrai mayro raam pi-aaraa say moo-ay mar jaaNheeN. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading my mind and body; I see Him Ever-present, here and now
lines.transliteration: man tan rav rahi-aa jagd eesur paykh at sadaa hajooray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: . O Nanak, He is permeating the inner being of all; He is all-pervading everywhere. ||2||8||12|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1269-2) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rav rahi-o sabh ant ar sarab rahi-aa bh arpooray. ||2||8||12||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਭ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਰਬ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਭਰਪੂਰੇ  ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord, who has not been carried across?
lines.transliteration: har kai bhajan ka-un ka-un na t aaray.

lines.english: Those reborn into the body of a bird, the body of a fish, the body of a deer, and thebody of a bull - in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they are saved.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khag t an meen t an marig t an baraah t an saaDh oo sang uDh aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਜਿਨ  ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ  ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The families of gods, the families of demons, titans, celestial singers and humanbeings are carried across the ocean.
lines.transliteration: dayv kul d ait kul jakh -y kinnar nar saagar ut ray paaray.

lines.punjabi: ਖਗ ਤਨ ਮੀਨ ਤਨ ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਤਨ ਬਰਾਹ  ਤਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever meditates and vibrates on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat - his pains are takenaway. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo jo bhajan karai saaDh oo sang t aa kay d ookh bidaaray. ||1||

lines.english: Sexual desire, anger and the pleasures of terrible corruption - he keeps away fromthese.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh mahaa bikh i-aa ras in t ay bh a-ay niraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਦੈਤ ਕੁਲ ਜਖਯ੍ਯ੍ ਿਕੰਨਰ  ਨਰ ਸਾਗਰ  ਉਤਰੇ  ਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He meditates on the Lord, Merciful to the meek, the Embodiment of Compassion;Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||13|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1269-6) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal jaapeh karun aa mai naanak sad  balihaaray. ||2||9||13||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਿਬਦਾਰੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Today, I am seated in the Lord's store.
lines.transliteration: aaj mai baisi-o har haat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ  ਮਹਾ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਰਸ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਿਨਰਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: With the wealth of the Lord, I have entered into partnership with the humble; I shallnot have take the Highway of Death. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam raas saajhee kar jan si-o jaaN-o na jam kai gh aat. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਜਪਿਹ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Dhaar anoograhu paarbarahm raakh ay bh aram kay kh ulHay kapaat. Showering me with His Kindness, the Supreme Lord God has saved me; the doors ofdoubt have been opened wide.
I have found God, the Banker of Infinity; I have earned the profit of the wealth of HisFeet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baysumaar saahu parabh paa-i-aa laahaa charan niDh  khaat. ||1||

lines.english: I have grasped the protection of the Sanctuary of the Unchanging, Unmoving,Imperishable Lord; He has picked up my sins and thrown them out.
lines.transliteration: saran gahee achut abh inaasee kilbikh  kaadh ay hai chh aaNt.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਿਸ  ਸਾਝੀ  ਕਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਜਉ  ਨ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਘਾਟ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Slave Nanak's sorrow and suffering has ended. He shall never again be squeezed intothe mold of reincarnation. ||2||10||14|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1269-9) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kal kalays mitay daas naanak bahur na jonee maat. ||2||10||14||

lines.english: In so many ways, attachment to Maya leads to ruin.
lines.transliteration: baho biDh maa-i-aa moh hiraano.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਿਰ  ਅਨੁਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਰਾਖੇ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੇ  ਕਪਾਟ  ॥
lines.english: Among millions, it is very rare to find a se lfless servant who remains a perfect devotee for very long. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay ko-oo birlaa sayvak pooran bh agat chiraano. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ  ਸਾਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਲਾਹਾ  ਚਰਨ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਖਾਟ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Roaming and wandering here and there, the mortal finds only trouble; his body andwealth become strangers to himself.
lines.transliteration: it ut dol dol saram paa-i-o t an Dh an hot  biraano.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਗਹੀ ਅਚੁਤ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਕਾਢੇ  ਹੈ ਛਿਟ  ॥
lines.english: Hiding from people, he practices deception; he does not know the One who is alwayswith him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: log duraa-ay karat  thagi-aa-ee hot ou sang na jaano. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ ਕਲੇਸ  ਿਮਟੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪॥
lines.english: He wanders through troubled incarnations of low and wretched species as a deer, abird and a fish.
lines.transliteration: marig pankhee meen d een neech ih sankat fir aano.

lines.english: Says Nanak, O God, I am a stone - please carry me across, that I may enjoy peace inthe Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||15|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1269-13) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak paahan parabh t aarahu saaDh sangat  sukh  maano. ||2||11||15||

lines.english: The cruel and evil ones died after taking poison, O mother.
lines.transliteration: dusat mu-ay bikh  khaa-ee ree maa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਊ ਿਬਰਲਾ  ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਿਚਰਾਨੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: And the One, to whom all creatures belong, has saved us. God has granted His Grace.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis kay jee-a tin hee rakh  leenay mayray parabh  ka-o kirpaa aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is contained within all; why should I be afraid, O Siblings of Destiny?
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee sabh  meh vart ai taaN bha-o kaisaa bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਡੋਿਲ  ਡੋਿਲ ਸਰ੍ਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਿਬਰਾਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: God, my Help and Support, is always with me. He shall never leave; I see Himeverywhere. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sang sahaa-ee chhod na jaa-ee parabh  deesai sabh nee th aa-eeN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਗ ਦੁਰਾਇ  ਕਰਤ  ਠਿਗਆਈ  ਹੋਤੌ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; He hasattached me to the hem of His robe.
lines.transliteration: anaathaa naath deen d ukh bhanjan aap lee-ay larh  laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਪੰਖੀ ਮੀਨ ਦੀਨ  ਨੀਚ ਇਹ ਸੰਕਟ  ਿਫਿਰ ਆਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Your slaves live by Your Support; Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God.||2||12||16|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1269-16) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kee ot jeeveh daas t ayray naanak parabh  sarnaa-ee. ||2||12||16||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਹਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O my mind, dwell on the Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har kay charan raveejai.

lines.english: My mind is enticed by thirst for the Blessed Vision of the Lord; I would take wings andfly out to meet Him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: daras pi-aas mayro man mohi-o har pankh  lagaa-ay mileejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Searching and seeking, I have found the Path, and now I serve the Holy.
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat maarag paa-i-o saaDh oo sayv kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਰਿਖ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਉ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhaar anoograhu su-aamee mayray naam mahaa ras peejai. ||1|| O my Lord and Master, please be kind to me, that I may drink in Your most sublime essence. ||1||
Begging and pleading, I have come to Your Sanctuary; I am on fire - please showerme with Your Mercy!
lines.transliteration: taraahi t araahi kar sarnee aa-ay jalt a-o kirpaa keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਵਰਤੈ  ਤ ਭਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Please give me Your Hand - I am Your slave, O Lord. Please make Nanak Your Own. ||2||13||17|| pMnw 1270 mlwr mÚ 5 ] (1270-1) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar geh layho daas apunay ka-o naanak apuno keejai. ||2||13||17||

lines.english: It is God's Nature to love His devotees.
lines.transliteration: parabh ko bh agat bachh al bird aari-o.

lines.english: He destroys the slanderers, crushing them beneath His Feet. His Glory is manifesteverywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nindak maar charan t al deenay apuno jas vart aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: His Victory is celebrated all throughout the world. He blesses all creatures withcompassion.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar keeno sabh jag meh d a-i-aa jee-an meh paa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਚਰਨ  ਤਲ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hugging him close in His Embrace, the Lord saves and protects His slave. The hotwinds cannot even touch him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kanth laa-ay apuno d aas raakh i-o taatee vaa-o na laa-i-o. ||1||

lines.english: My Lord and Master has made me His Own; dispelling my doubts and fears, He has made me happy.
lines.transliteration: angeekaar kee-o mayray su-aamee bharam bh a-o mayt sukh aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਦਇਆ  ਜੀਅਨ  ਮਿਹ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's slaves enjoy ultimate ecstasy; O Nanak, faith has welled up in my mind.||2||14||18|| rwgu mlwr mhlw 5 caupdy Gru 2  (1270-5) raag malaar mehlaa 5 cha-upday gh ar 2 Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padas, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1270-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mahaa anand karahu daas har kay naanak bisvaas man aa-i-o. ||2||14||18||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਿਠ ਲਾਇ  ਅਪੁਨੋ  ਦਾਸੁ ਰਾਿਖਓ  ਤਾਤੀ  ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh sees God pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh d eesai barahm pasaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ  ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਿਟ ਸੁਖਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh knows that the universe is the extension of the three gunas, the threedispositions.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh t arai gun ee-aaN bisthaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ  ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਸਾਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇਓ  ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh reflects on the Sound-current of the Naad, and the wisdom of theVedas.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naad  bayd  beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Perfect Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin gur pooray ghor anDh aar. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, calling on the Guru, eternal peace is found.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur gur karat sad aa sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: 5) gur updays har hird ai vasi-o saas giraas apn aa kh asam Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o. Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord comes to dwell within the heart; I meditate on my Lord and Master with every breath and morsel of food. ||1||Pause||
I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan vitahu bal jaa-o.

lines.english: Night and day, I continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur kay gun an-d in nit gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I take my cleansing bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: gur kee Dhoorh  kara-o isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਵਿਸਓ ਸਾਿਸ  ਿਗਰਾਿਸ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saachee dargeh paa-ee-ai maan. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru is the boat, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: gur bohith bhavjal t aaran haar.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, I shall not be reincarnated ever again.
lines.transliteration: gur bhayti-ai na ho-ay jon a-ut aar.

lines.english: That humble being serves the Guru,
lines.transliteration: gur kee sayvaa so jan paa-ay.
jaa ka-o karam likhi-aa Dh ur aa-ay. ||3|| who has such karma inscribed on his forehead by the Primal Lord. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru is my life; the Guru is my support.
lines.transliteration: gur mayree jeevan gur aaDhaar.

lines.english: The Guru is my way of life; the Guru is my family.
lines.transliteration: gur mayree vartan  gur parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਭੇਿਟਐ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਿਨ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is my Lord and Master; I seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur mayraa khasam sat gur sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God; His value cannot be estimated.||4||1||19|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1270-13) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur paarbarahm jaa kee keem na paa-ee. ||4||1||19||

lines.english: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart;
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan hirdai vasaa-ay.
kar kirpaa parabh aap milaa-ay. in His Mercy, God has united me with Himself.

lines.english: God enjoins His servant to his tasks.
lines.transliteration: apnay sayvak ka-o la-ay parabh laa-ay.

lines.english: His worth cannot be expressed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat  kahee na jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Please be merciful to me, O Perfect Giver of peace.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa pooran sukh-d aatay.

lines.english: By Your Grace, You come to mind; I am imbued with Your Love, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumHree kirpaa t ay tooN chit aavahi aath  pahar t ayrai rang raat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Singing and listening, it is all by Your Will.
lines.transliteration: gaavan sunan  sabh  tayraa bh aanaa.

lines.english: One who understands the Hukam of Your Command is absorbed in Truth.
lines.transliteration: hukam boojhai so saach samaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਸੇਵਕ  ਕਉ ਲਏ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting and meditating on Your Name, I live.
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeeveh tayraa naaN-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without You, there is no place at all. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tujh bin d oojaa naahee thaa-o. ||2||

lines.english: Pain and pleasure come by Your Command, O Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh  kartay hukam rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਿਚਿਤ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Pleasure of Your Will You forgive, and by the Pleasure of Your Will You awardpunishment.
lines.transliteration: bhaan ai bakh as bh aanai day-ay sajaa-ay.

lines.english: You are the Creator of both realms.
lines.transliteration: duhaaN siri-aaN kaa kart aa aap.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Your Glorious Grandeur. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kurbaan jaaN-ee tayray part aap. ||3||

lines.english: You alone know Your value.
lines.transliteration: tayree keemat  toohai jaan eh.

lines.english: You alone understand, You Yourself speak and listen.
lines.transliteration: too aapay boojh eh sun  aap vakaan eh.

lines.english: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to Your Will. pMnw 1271
lines.transliteration: say-ee bhagat  jo tuDh bhaanay.

lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||20|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1271-1) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai sad  kurbaan ay. ||4||2||20||

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord God has become merciful;
lines.transliteration: parmaysar ho-aa da-i-aal.

lines.english: Ambrosial Nectar is raining down from the clouds.
lines.transliteration: maygh varsai amrit  Dhaar.

lines.english: All beings and creatures are satisfied;
lines.transliteration: saglay jee-a jant t ariptaasay.
kaaraj aa-ay pooray raasay. ||1|| their affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, dwell on the Lord, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa man naam samHaal.

lines.english: Serving the Perfect Guru, I have obtained it. It shall stay with me both here andhereafter. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray kee sayvaa paa-i-aa aithai othai nibhai naal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhannaa bh ai bhanjanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ  ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਿਨਬਹੈ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He takes care of His beings.
lines.transliteration: aapni-aa jee-aa kee keet ee saar.

lines.english: The Savior Lord is kind and compassionate forever.
lines.transliteration: raakhanhaar sad aa miharvaan.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to Him, forever and ever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa jaa-ee-ai kurbaan. ||2||

lines.english: The Creator Himself has eliminated death.
lines.transliteration: kaal gavaa-i-aa kartai aap.

lines.english: Meditate on Him forever and ever, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa man t is no jaap.

lines.english: He watches all with His Glance of Grace and protects them.
lines.transliteration: darisat Dh aar raakh ay sabh  jant.

lines.english: Continually and continuously, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavhu nit  nit bhagvant . ||3||

lines.english: The One and Only Creator Lord is Himself by Himself.
lines.transliteration: ayko kartaa aapay aap.

lines.english: The Lord's devotees know His Glorious Grandeur.
lines.transliteration: har kay bhagat  jaaneh part aap.

lines.english: He preserves the Honor of His Name.
lines.transliteration: naavai kee paij rakh-d aa aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak speaks as the Lord inspires him to speak. ||4||3||21|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1271-7) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai tis kaa bolaa-i-aa. ||4||3||21||

lines.english: All treasures are found in the Sanctuary of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur sarnaa-ee sagal niDh aan.

lines.english: Honor is obtained in the True Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachee dargahi paa-ee-ai maan.

lines.english: Doubt, fear, pain and suffering are taken away,
lines.transliteration: bharam bh a-o dookh darad sabh  jaa-ay.
saaDhsang sad  har gun  gaa-ay. ||1|| forever singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, praise the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: man mayray gur pooraa saalaahi.

lines.english: Chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. You shallobtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan japahu d in raat ee man chind ay fal paa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: No one else is as great as the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: The Guru is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gur paarbarahm parmaysar so-ay.

lines.english: He saves us from the pains of death and birth,
lines.transliteration: janam maran d ookh tay raakh ai.
maa-i-aa bikh fir bahurh  na chaakh ai. ||2|| and we will not have to taste the poison of Maya ever again. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru's glorious grandeur cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa kathan na jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, in the True Name.
lines.transliteration: gur parmaysar saachai naa-ay.

lines.english: True is His self-discipline, and True are all His actions.
lines.transliteration: sach sanjam karnee sabh  saachee.

lines.english: Immaculate and pure is that mind, which is imbued with love for the Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so man nirmal jo gur sang raachee. ||3||

lines.english: The Perfect Guru is obtained by great good fortune.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-ee-ai vad bhaag.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Drive out sexual desire, anger and greed from your mind.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  man t ay ti-aag.

lines.english: By His Grace, the Guru's Feet are enshrined within.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa gur charan nivaas.

lines.english: Nanak offers his prayer to the True Lord God. ||4||4||22|| rwgu mlwr mhlw 5 pVqwl Gru 3  (1271-15) raag malaar mehlaa 5 parh-t aal gh ar 3 Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1271-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh sach ard aas. ||4||4||22||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਚੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Pleasing the Guru, I have fallen in love with my Merciful Beloved Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur manaar pari-a da-i-aar si-o rang kee-aa.

lines.english: I have made all my decorations,
lines.transliteration: keeno ree sagal seeNgaar.
taji-o ree sagal bikaar. and renounced all corruption;

lines.english: Dhaavt o asthir thee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. my wandering mind has become steady and stable. ||1||Pause||
O my mind, lose your self-conceit by associating with the Holy, and you shall find Him.
lines.transliteration: aisay ray man paa-ay kai aap gavaa-ay kai kar saaDhan si-o sang.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ  ਘਰੁ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: ||1|| The unstruck celestial melody vibrates and resounds; like a song-bird, chant the Lord'sName, with words of sweetness and utter beauty. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baajay bajeh maridang anaahad  kokil ree raam naam bolai maDh ur bain at  suhee-aa.

lines.english: Such is the glory of Your Darshan, so utterly inifinte and fruitful, O my Love; so do we become by associating with the Saints.
lines.transliteration: aisee tayray d arsan kee sobh  at apaar pari-a amogh  taisay hee sang sant  banay.

lines.english: Vibrating, chanting Your Name, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhav ut aar naam bh anay.

lines.english: They dwell on the Lord, Raam, Raam, chanting on their malas; pMnw 1272
lines.transliteration: ram raam raam maal.

lines.english: Holy.
