lines.transliteration: man fayrtay har sang sangee-aa. their minds are turned towards the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the

lines.english: O servant Nanak, their Beloved Lord seems so sweet to them. ||2||1||23|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1272-2) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak pari-o pareetam thee-aa. ||2||1||23||

lines.english: My mind wanders through the dense forest.
lines.transliteration: man ghanai bh armai banai.

lines.english: It walks with eagerness and love,
lines.transliteration: umak taras chaalai.
parabh milbay kee chaah. ||1|| rahaa-o. hoping to meet God. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: Maya with her three gunas - the three dispositions - has come to entice me; whomcan I tell of my pain? ||1||
lines.transliteration: tarai gun maa-ee mohi aa-ee kahaN-o bayd an kaahi. ||1||

lines.english: I tried everything else, but nothing could rid me of my sorrow.
lines.transliteration: aan upaav sagar kee-ay neh dookh  saakeh laahi.

lines.english: So hurry to the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak; joining them, sing the GloriousPraises of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||2||24|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1272-4) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhaj saran saaDh oo naankaa mil gun gobind eh gaahi. ||2||2||24||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਈ  ਮੋਿਹ ਆਈ  ਕਹੰਉ  ਬੇਦਨ  ਕਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The glory of my Beloved is noble and sublime.
lines.transliteration: pari-a kee sobh suhaavanee neekee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਸਗਰ  ਕੀਏ ਨਿਹ ਦੂਖ ਸਾਕਿਹ  ਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The celestial singers and angels sing His Sublime Praises in ecstasy, happiness and joy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: haahaa hoohoo ganDharab apsaraa anand mangal ras gaavnee neekee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਿਨ  ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਮਲੁ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਿਬੰਦਿਹ  ਗਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥੨॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Dhunit  lalit gun-ga-y anik bh aaNt baho biDh  roop d ikhaavanee neekee. ||1|| The most worthy beings sing God's Praises in beautiful harmonies, in all sorts of ways,in myriads of sublime forms. ||1||
Throughout the mountains, trees, deserts, oceans and galaxies, permeating each andevery heart, the sublime grandeur of my Love is totally pervading.
lines.transliteration: gir tar thal jal bh avan bh arpur gh at ghat laalan chh aavnee neekee.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Love of the Lord is found; ONanak, sublime is that faith. ||2||3||25|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1272-8) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang raam-ee-aa ras paa-i-o naanak jaa kai bh aavnee neekee. ||2||3||25||

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਹਾ  ਹੂਹੂ ਗੰਧਰ੍ਬ  ਅਪਸਰਾ  ਅਨੰਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਰਸ ਗਾਵਨੀ  ਨੀਕੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: With love for the Guru, I enshrine the Lotus Feet of my Lord deep within my heart.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pareet pi-aaray charan kamal rid  antar Dh aaray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I gaze on the Blessed Vision of His Fruitful Darshan; my sins are erased and takenaway.
lines.transliteration: daras safli-o d aras paykh i-o ga-ay kilbikh  ga-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਨਤ ਲਿਲਤ  ਗੁਨਗਯ੍ਯ੍  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਰੂਪ ਿਦਖਾਵਨੀ  ਨੀਕੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind is immaculate and enlightened. ||1||
lines.transliteration: man nirmal ujee-aaray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਿਰ  ਤਰ ਥਲ ਜਲ ਭਵਨ ਭਰਪੁਿਰ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਲਾਲਨ  ਛਾਵਨੀ  ਨੀਕੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am wonderstruck, stunned and amazed.
lines.transliteration: bisam bismai bisam bha-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਮਈਆ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ  ॥੨॥੩॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of sins are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: agh kot hart ay naam la-ee.

lines.english: I fall at His Feet, and touch my forehead to them.
lines.transliteration: gur charan mastak daar pahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You alone are, You alone are, O God.
lines.transliteration: parabh ayk t ooNhee ayk t uhee.

lines.english: Your devotees take Your Support.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  tayk t uhaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸੁ  ਸਫਿਲਓ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪੇਿਖਓ  ਗਏ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਗਏ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has come to the Door of Your Sanctuary. ||2||4||26|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1272-11) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saran du-aaray. ||2||4||26||

lines.english: Rain down with happiness in God's Will.
lines.transliteration: baras saras aagi-aa.

lines.english: Bless me with total bliss and good fortune. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hohi aanand sagal bh aag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mind blossoms forth in the Society of the Saints; soaking up the rain, the earth is blessed and beautified. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sant sangay man parfarh ai mil maygh  Dhar suhaag. ||1||

lines.english: The peacock loves the thunder of the rain clouds.
lines.transliteration: ghangh or pareet  mor.

lines.english: The rainbird's mind is drawn to the rain-drop
lines.transliteration: chit chaat rik boond  or.
aiso har sangay man moh. - so is my mind enticed by the Lord.

lines.english: I have renounced Maya, the deceiver.
lines.transliteration: ti-aag maa-i-aa Dh oh.

lines.english: Joining with the Saints, Nanak is awakened. ||2||5||27|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1272-14) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mil sant naanak jaagi-aa. ||2||5||27||

lines.english: Sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal gaa-o neet.

lines.english: Enshrine the Lord's Name in your consciousness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhaar cheet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Forsake your pride, and abandon your ego; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: chhod maan t aj gumaan mil saaDh oo-aa kai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਮੇਘ ਧਰ ਸੁਹਾਗ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate in loving remembrance on the One Lord; your sorrows shall be ended, Ofriend. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har simar ayk rang mit jaaNhi dokh  meet . ||1||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful;
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm bha-ay d a-i-aal.
binas ga-ay bikhai janjaal. corrupt entanglements have come to an end.

lines.english: Grasping the feet of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaaN kai charan laag.

lines.english: Nanak sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World. ||2||6||28|| mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1272-17) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gaavai gobind neet . ||2||6||28||

lines.english: The Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe roars like the thunder-cloud.
lines.transliteration: ghan garjat  gobind  roop.

lines.english: Singing His Glorious Praises brings peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat sukh  chain. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet carries us across the world-ocean. His Sublime Word is the unstruck celestial melody. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har charan saran taran saagar Dh un anhat aa ras bain. ||1||

lines.english: The thirsty traveller's consciousness obtains the water of the soul from the pool ofnectar.
lines.transliteration: pathik pi-aas chit sarovar aat am jal lain.

lines.english: Servant Nanak loves the Blessed Vision of the Lord; in His Mercy, God has blessed himwith it. ||2||7||29|| pMnw 1273 mlwr mhlw 5 ] (1273-1) malaar mehlaa 5. Malaar, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har daras paraym jan naanak kar kirpaa parabh  dain. ||2||7||29||

lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, O Lord of the World, O Dear Merciful Beloved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: hay gobind hay gopaal hay d a-i-aal laal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ  ਲਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Master of the breath of life, the Companion of the lost and forsaken, theDestroyer of the pains of the poor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paraan naath anaath sakhay d een d arad nivaar. ||1||

lines.english: O All-powerful, Inaccessible, Perfect Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: hay samrath agam pooran mohi ma-i-aa Dhaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ  ਸਖੇ ਦੀਨ  ਦਰਦ  ਿਨਵਾਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please, carry Nanak across the terrible, deep dark pit of the world to the other side.||3||8||30|| mlwr mhlw 1 AstpdIAw Gru 1  (1273-4) malaar mehlaa 1 asatpadee-aa gh ar 1 Malaar, First Mehl, Ashtapadees, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1273-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: anDh koop mahaa bh a-i-aan naanak paar ut aar. ||3||8||30||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਸਮਰ੍ਥ  ਅਗਮ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਮੋਿਹ ਮਇਆ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The chakvi bird does not long for sleepy eyes; without her beloved, she does not sleep.
lines.transliteration: chakvee nain neeNd neh chaahai bin pir neeNd na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰ  ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
lines.english: When the sun rises, she sees her beloved with her eyes; she bows and touches hisfeet. ||1||
lines.transliteration: soor charHai pari-o daykh ai nainee niv niv laagai paaN-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Love of my Beloved is pleasing; it is my Companion and Support.
lines.transliteration: pir bhaavai paraym sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਚਕਵੀ  ਨੈਨ ਨੀਦ ਨਿਹ ਚਾਹੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without Him, I cannot live in this world even for an instant; such is my hunger andthirst. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tis bin gh arhee nahee jag jeevaa aisee pi-aas t isaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਨੀ ਿਨਿਵ  ਿਨਿਵ  ਲਾਗੈ ਪਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The lotus in the pool blossoms forth intuitively and naturally, with the rays of the sunin the sky.
lines.transliteration: sarvar kamal kiran aakaasee bigsai sahj subh aa-ee.

lines.english: Such is the love for my Beloved which imbues me; my light has merged into the Light.||2||
lines.transliteration: pareetam pareet  banee abh  aisee jot ee jot  milaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Without water, the rainbird cries out, "Pri-o!  Pri-o! - Beloved! Beloved!" It cries and wails and laments.
lines.transliteration: chaatrik jal bin pari-o pari-o tayrai bilap karai billaa-ee.

lines.english: The thundering clouds rain down in the ten directions; its thirst is not quenched untilit catches the rain-drop in its mouth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ghanhar gh or dasou d is barsai bin jal pi-aas na jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: The fish lives in water, from which it was born. It finds peace and pleasure accordingto its past actions.
lines.transliteration: meen nivaas upjai jal hee tay sukh  dukh purab kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਬਨੀ ਅਭ ਐਸੀ  ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: It cannot survive without water for a moment, even for an instant. Life and deathdepend on it. ||4||
lines.transliteration: khin t il reh na sakai pal jal bin maran jeevan t is taaN-ee. ||4||

lines.english: Dhan vaaNdhee pir d ays nivaasee sachay gur peh sabad  pathaa-eeN. The soul-bride is separated from her Husband Lord, who lives in His Own Country. Hesends the Shabad, His Word, through the True Guru.

lines.punjabi: ਘਨਹਰ  ਘੋਰ ਦਸੌ ਿਦਿਸ  ਬਰਸੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਜਲ ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: She gathers virtues, and enshrines God within her heart. Imbued with devotion, she ishappy. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gun sangrahi parabh  ridai nivaasee bh agat ratee harkh aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮੀਨ ਿਨਵਾਸ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone cries out, "Beloved! Beloved!" But she alone finds her Beloved, who ispleasing to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: pari-o pari-o karai sabhai hai jayt ee gur bh aavai pari-o paa-eeN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਲੁ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਿਤਸੁ ਤਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Our Beloved is always with us; through the Truth, He blesses us with His Grace, andunites us in His Union. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pari-o naalay sad hee sach sangay nad ree mayl milaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਵਢੀ  ਿਪਰੁ ਦੇਸ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਹ ਸਬਦੁ  ਪਠਾਈ ॥
lines.english: He is the life of the soul in each and every soul; He permeates and pervades each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh jee-o jee-o hai so-ee gh at ghat rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਰਤੀ ਹਰਖਾਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed within the home of my heart; I am intuitively,naturally, absorbed into Him. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad gh ar hee pargaasi-aa sehjay sahj samaa-ee. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ  ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself shall resolve all your affairs, when you meet with the Giver of peace, theLord of the World.
lines.transliteration: apnaa kaaj savaarahu aapay sukh-d aatay gosaaN-eeN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਨਾਲੇ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਿਚ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਦਰੀ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Husband Lord within your own home; then, ONanak, the fire within you shall be quenched. ||8||1|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1273-15) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad gh ar hee pir paa-i-aa t a-o naanak t apat bujhaa-ee. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ਜੀਉ  ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Remain awake and aware, serving the Guru; except for the Lord, no one is mine.
lines.transliteration: jaagat jaag rahai gur sayvaa bin har mai ko naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Even by making all sorts of efforts, you shall not remain here; it shall melt like glass inthe fire. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar rahan  na paavai aach kaach dh ar paaNhee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਕਾਜੁ  ਸਵਾਰਹੁ ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ  ਗੋਸਈ ॥
lines.english: Tell me - why are you so proud of your body and wealth?
lines.transliteration: is tan Dh an kaa kahhu garab kaisaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਿਪਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਪਿਤ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: They shall vanish in an instant; O madman, this is how the world is wasting away, in egotism and pride. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binsat baar na laagai bavray ha-umai garab kh apai jag aisaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Hail to the Lord of the Universe, God, our Saving Grace; He judges and saves themortal beings.
lines.transliteration: jai jagdees parabh oo rakh vaaray raakh ai parkh ai so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਗਤੁ  ਜਾਿਗ  ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: All that is, belongs to You. No one else is equal to You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jaytee hai t aytee tujh hee t ay tumH sar avar na ko-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਚੁ  ਕਾਚੁ  ਢਿਰ ਪਹੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Creating all beings and creatures, their ways and means are under Your control; You bless the Gurmukhs with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: jee-a upaa-ay jugat vas keenee aapay gurmukh  anjan.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ  ਕੈਸਾ ॥
lines.english: My Eternal, Unmastered Lord is over the heads of all. He is the Destroyer of death and rebirth, doubt and fear. ||3|| pMnw 1274
lines.transliteration: amar anaath sarab sir moraa kaal bikaal bharam bh ai khanjan. ||3||

lines.english: This wretched world is a fortress of paper, of color and form and clever tricks.
lines.transliteration: kaagad kot ih jag hai bapuro rangan chihan chat uraa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਗਦ  ਕੋਟੁ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਬਪੁਰੋ  ਰੰਗਿਨ  ਿਚਹਨ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: A tiny drop of water or a little puff of wind destroys its glory; in an instant, its life is ended. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanHee see boond pavan pat  khovai janam marai kh in taa-eeN. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨੀ  ਸੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਵੈ ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰੈ ਿਖਨੁ ਤਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: It is like a tree-house near the bank of a river, with a serpent's den in that house.
lines.transliteration: nadee upkh anth jaisay gh ar tarvar sarpan gh ar ghar maahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦੀ  ਉਪਕੰਿਠ  ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਿਨ  ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: When the river overflows, what happens to the tree house? The snake bites, like duality in the mind. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ultee nadee kahaaN ghar tarvar sarpan dasai d oojaa man maaNhee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਉਲਟੀ  ਨਦੀ  ਕਹ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਿਨ  ਡਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਮਨ ਮਹੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Through the magic spell of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, and meditation on the Wordof the Guru's Teachings, vice and corruption are burnt away.
lines.transliteration: gaarurh gur gi-aan Dh i-aan gur bachnee bikh i-aa gurmat  jaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਰੁੜ ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The mind and body are cooled and soothed and Truth is obtained, through thewondrous and unique devotional worship of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: man tan hayNv bha-ay sach paa-i-aa har kee bh agat niraaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੇਂਵ ਭਏ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਿਤ ਿਨਰਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: All that exists begs of You; You are merciful to all beings.
lines.transliteration: jaytee hai t aytee tuDh jaachai t oo sarab jee-aaN da-i-aalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੀ  ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆਂ  ਦਇਆਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I seek Your Sanctuary; please save my honor, O Lord of the World, and bless me withTruth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tumHree saran  paray pat  raakh o saach milai gopaalaa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪਰੇ ਪਿਤ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Bound in worldly affairs and entanglements, the blind one does not understand; heacts like a murderous butcher.
lines.transliteration: baaDhee Dh anDh anDh  nahee soojh ai baDh ik karam kamaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਧੀ  ਧੰਿਧ ਅੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਬਿਧਕ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: But if he meets with the True Guru, then he comprehends and understands, and hismind is imbued with true spiritual wisdom. ||8||
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a soojh as boojh as sach man gi-aan samaavai. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝਿਸ ਬੂਝਿਸ  ਸਚ ਮਿਨ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Without the Truth, this worthless body is false; I have consulted my Guru on this.
lines.transliteration: nirgun d ayh saach bin kaachee mai poochh a-o gur apnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਦੇਹ ਸਾਚ ਿਬਨੁ ਕਾਚੀ  ਮੈ ਪੂਛਉ  ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, that God has revealed God to me; without the Truth, all the world is just a dream. ||9||2|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1274-8) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so parabh parabh oo dikhaavai bin saachay jag supnaa. ||9||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਿਦਖਾਵੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ॥੯॥੨॥
lines.english: The rainbird and the fish find peace in water; the deer is pleased by the sound of thebell. ||1||
lines.transliteration: chaatrik meen jal hee t ay sukh  paavahi saaring sabad  suhaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: The rainbird chirps in the night, O my mother. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rain babeehaa boli-o mayree maa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸਾਿਰੰਗ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਹਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, my love for You shall never end, if it is Your Will. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pari-a si-o pareet na ultai kabhoo jo t ai bhaavai saa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: Sleep is gone, and egotism is exhausted from my body; my heart is permeated withthe Teachings of Truth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: need ga-ee ha-umai t an thaakee sach mat  ridai samaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: Flying among the trees and plants, I remain hungry; lovingly drinking in the Naam,the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied. ||4||
lines.transliteration: rookheeN birkh eeN ooda-o bh ookhaa peevaa naam subh aa-ee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਉਲਟੈ  ਕਬਹੂ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I stare at You, and my tongue cries out to You; I am so thirsty for the Blessed Visionof Your Darshan. ||5||
lines.transliteration: lochan taar lalt aa billaat ee darsan pi-aas rajaa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਦ  ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਿਨ  ਥਾਕੀ  ਸਚ ਮਿਤ ਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Without my Beloved, the more I decorate myself, the more my body burns; these clothes do not look good on my body. ||6||
lines.transliteration: pari-a bin seegaar karee tayt aa tan taapai kaapar ang na suhaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਖੀ ਿਬਰਖੀ ਊਡਉ  ਭੂਖਾ ਪੀਵਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without my Beloved, I cannot survive even for an instant; without meeting Him, I cannot sleep. ||7||
lines.transliteration: apnay pi-aaray bin ik khin reh na sakNa-u bin milay neeNd na paa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: Her Husband Lord is nearby, but the wretched bride does not know it. The True Gurureveals Him to her. ||8||
lines.transliteration: pir najeek na boojhai bapurh ee sat gur dee-aa d ikhaa-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ਤੇਤਾ  ਤਨੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਅੰਿਗ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: When she meets Him with intuitive ease, she finds peace; the Word of the Shabadquenches the fire of desire. ||9||
lines.transliteration: sahj mili-aa tab hee sukh  paa-i-aa t arisnaa sabad  bujhaa-ee. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਿਪਆਰੇ  ਿਬਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਰਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਂਉ  ਿਬਨ ਿਮਲੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, through You, O Lord, my mind is pleased and appeased; I cannot expressYour worth. ||10||3|| mlwr mhlw 1 AstpdIAw Gru 2  (1274-16) malaar mehlaa 1 asatpadee-aa gh ar 2 Malaar, First Mehl, Ashtapadees, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1274-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tujh  tay man maani-aa keemat  kahan na jaa-ee. ||10||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਨਜੀਿਕ  ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਖਾਈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The earth bends under the weight of the water,
lines.transliteration: akhlee ooNdee jal bh ar naal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: doogar oocha-o garh paat aal. the lofty mountains and the caverns of the underworld.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧੦॥੩॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the oceans become calm.
lines.transliteration: saagar seetal gur sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲਾਰ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਘਰੁ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The path of liberation is found by subduing the ego. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maarag muktaa ha-umai maar. ||1||

lines.english: I am blind; I seek the Light of the Name.
lines.transliteration: mai anDhulay naavai kee jot .

lines.english: I take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I walk on the path of mystery of the Guru's Fear. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1275
lines.transliteration: naam aDhaar chalaa gur kai bh ai bhayt. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the Path is known.
lines.transliteration: satgur sabd ee paaDh ar jaan .

lines.english: With the Guru's Support, one is blessed with the strength of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur kai takee-ai saachai t aan.

lines.english: Dwell on the Naam, and realize the Beauteous Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: naam samHaalas roorhHee baan .

lines.english: If it is Your Will, Lord, You lead me to find Your Door. ||2||
lines.transliteration: thaiN bhaavai d ar lahas piraan . ||2||

lines.english: Flying high or sitting down, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: oodaaN baisaa ayk liv taar.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I take the Naam as my Suppport.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad naam aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: There is no ocean of water, no mountain ranges rising up.
lines.transliteration: naa jal doongar na oochee Dhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਨ ਊਚੀ  ਧਾਰ ॥
lines.english: I dwell within the home of my own inner being, where there is no path and no one travelling on it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa t ah mag na chaalan haar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਤਹ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You alone know the way to that House in which You dwell. No one else knows theMansion of Your Presence.
lines.transliteration: jit ghar vaseh t oohai biDh  jaaneh beeja-o mahal na jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਘਿਰ  ਵਸਿਹ  ਤੂਹੈ ਿਬਿਧ ਜਾਣਿਹ  ਬੀਜਉ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is no understanding. The whole world is buried under itsnightmare.
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu samajh  na hovee sabh  jag d abi-aa chh aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਮਝ  ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦਿਬਆ  ਛਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: The mortal tries all sorts of things, and weeps and wails, but without the Guru, hedoes not know the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: karan palaav karai billat a-o bin gur naam na jaapai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਿਬਲਲਾਤਉ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.english: In the twinkling of an eye, the Naam saves him, if he realizes the Word of the Guru'sShabad. ||4||
lines.transliteration: pal pankaj meh naam chhadaa-ay jay gur sabad  sinjaapai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ  ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ  ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਸਞਾਪੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: ik moorakh anDh ay mugaDh  gavaar.

lines.english: Some, through fear of the True Guru, take the Support of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ik satgur kai bh ai naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The True Word of His Bani is sweet, the source of ambrosial nectar.
lines.transliteration: saachee banee meeth ee amrit  Dhaar.

lines.english: Whoever drinks it in, finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jin peetee t is mokh  du-aar. ||5||

lines.english: One who, through the love and fear of God, enshrines the Naam within his heart, acts according to the Guru's Instructions and knows the True Bani.
lines.transliteration: naam bhai bh aa-ay rid ai vasaahee gur karn ee sach ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਹੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: When the clouds release their rain, the earth becomes beautiful; God's Lightpermeates each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ind varsai Dh arat suhaavee gh at ghat jot samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਧਰਿਤ  ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਜੋਿਤ ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: The evil-minded ones plant their seed in the barren soil; such is the sign of those whohave no Guru.
lines.transliteration: kaalar beejas durmat  aisee niguray kee neesaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲਿਰ  ਬੀਜਿਸ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਐਸੀ  ਿਨਗੁਰੇ  ਕੀ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is utter darkness; they drown there, even without water.||6||
lines.transliteration: satgur baajh ahu gh or anDh aaraa doob mu-ay bin paan ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ  ਡੂਿਬ ਮੁਏ  ਿਬਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Whatever God does, is by His Own Will.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh keeno so parabh oo rajaa-ay.

lines.english: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so maytn aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Bound to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal does his deeds.
lines.transliteration: hukmay baaDhaa kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Permeated by the One Word of the Shabad, the mortal is immersed in Truth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ayk sabad raachai sach samaa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: Your Command, O God, rules in the four directions; Your Name pervades the four corners of the nether regions as well.
lines.transliteration: chahu dis hukam vart ai parabh  tayraa chahu d is naam pat aalaN.

lines.punjabi: ਚਹੁ ਿਦਿਸ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਹੁ ਿਦਿਸ  ਨਾਮ ਪਤਾਲੰ  ॥
lines.english: The True Word of the Shabad is pervading amongst all. By His Grace, the Eternal Oneunites us with Himself.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh sabad  vartai parabh  saachaa karam milai bay-aalaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਾਚਾ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਬੈਆਲੰ  ॥
lines.english: Birth and death hang over the heads of all beings, along with hunger, sleep anddying.
lines.transliteration: jaaNman marn aa deesai sir oobh ou kh uDhi-aa nid raa kaalaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ  ਦੀਸੈ ਿਸਿਰ  ਊਭੌ ਖੁਿਧਆ  ਿਨਦਰ੍ਾ  ਕਾਲੰ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind; O True Lord, Source of bliss, please bless mewith Your Grace. ||8||1||4|| mlwr mhlw 1 ] (1275-13) malaar mehlaa 1. Malaar, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai man bhaavai saachee nad ar rasaalaN. ||8||1||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: You do not understand the nature of death and liberation.
lines.transliteration: maran mukat  gat saar na jaanai.

lines.english: You are sitting on the river-bank; realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kanthay baith ee gur sabad  pachh aanai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: You stork! - how were you caught in the net?
lines.transliteration: too kaisay aarh  faathee jaal.

lines.english: You do not remember in your heart the Unseen Lord God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: alakh na jaacheh rid ai samHaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: For your one life, you consume many lives.
lines.transliteration: ayk jee-a kai jee-aa khaahee.

lines.english: You were supposed to swim in the water, but you are drowning in it instead. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jal tart ee boodee jal maahee. ||2||

lines.english: You have tormented all beings.
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-a kee-ay paratpaanee.

lines.english: When Death seizes you, then you shall regret and repent. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jab pakrhee t ab hee pachh utaanee. ||3||

lines.english: When the heavy noose is placed around your neck,
lines.transliteration: jab gal faas parhee at  bhaaree.
ood na saakai pankh pasaaree. ||4|| you may spread your wings, but you shall not be able to fly. ||4||

lines.english: You enjoy the tastes and flavors, you foolish self-willed manmukh.
lines.transliteration: ras choogeh manmukh gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਗਿਲ  ਫਾਸ ਪੜੀ ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are trapped. You can only be saved by virtuous conduct, spiritual wisdom and contemplation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: faathee chhooteh gun  gi-aan beechaar. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, you will shatter the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv t ootai jamkaal.

lines.english: In your heart, dwell on the True Word of the Shabad. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hirdai saachaa sabad  samHaal. ||6||

lines.english: The Guru's Teachings, the True Word of the Shabad, is excellent and sublime.
lines.transliteration: gurmat saachee sabad  hai saar.

lines.english: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur Dh aar. ||7||

lines.english: One who is obsessed with enjoying pleasures here, shall suffer in pain hereafter.
lines.transliteration: say dukh  aagai je bh og bilaasay.

lines.english: O Nanak, there is no liberation without the True Name. ||8||2||5|| mlwr mhlw 3 AstpdIAw Gru 1 ] (1276-1) malaar mehlaa 3 asatpadee-aa gh ar 1. Malaar, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees, First House: pMnw 1276 <> siqgur pRswid ] (1276-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak mukat nahee bin naavai saachay. ||8||2||5||

lines.english: If it is in his karma, then he finds the True Guru; without such karma, He cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: karam hovai taa sat gur paa-ee-ai vin  karmai paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.english: He meets the True Guru, and he is transforme d into gold, if it is the Lord's Will. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai kanchan ho-ee-ai jaaN har kee ho-ay rajaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har har naam chit laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਈਐ  ਜ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord is found through the True Guru, and then he remains merged with the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay har paa-ee-ai saachaa har si-o rahai samaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom wells up through the True Guru, and then this cynicism is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay gi-aan oopjai t aaN ih sansaa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the True Guru, the Lord is realized, and then, he is not consigned to thewomb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay har bujh ee-ai garabh  jonee nah paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal dies in life, and by so dying, lives to practice the Word ofthe Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee jeevat marai mar jeevai sabad  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਤ ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He alone finds the Door of Salvation, who eradicates self-conceit from within himself.||3||
lines.transliteration: mukat d u-aaraa so-ee paa-ay je vichahu aap gavaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is reincarnated into the Home of the Lord, havingeradicated Maya from within.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee siv ghar jammai vichahu sakat  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਜੀਵਤ  ਮਰੈ ਮਿਰ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He eats the uneatable, and is blessed with a discriminating intellect; he meets the Supreme Person, the Primal Lord God. ||4||
lines.transliteration: achar charai bibayk buDh paa-ay purkh ai purakh  milaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਿਜ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhaat ur baajee sansaar achayt  hai chalai mool gavaa-ay. The world is unconscious, like a passing show; the mortal departs, having lost hiscapital.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਸਵ ਘਿਰ  ਜੰਮੈ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਸਕਿਤ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The profit of the Lord is obtained in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; by goodkarma, it is found. ||5||
lines.transliteration: laahaa har satsangat  paa-ee-ai karmee palai paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one finds it; see this in your mind, and consider this inyour heart.
lines.transliteration: satgur vin  kinai na paa-i-aa man vaykh hu rid ai beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਤੁਰ  ਬਾਜੀ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ  ਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Guru, and crosses over the terrifyingworld-ocean. ||6||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee gur paa-i-aa bh avjal ut ray paar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਰਮੀ  ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is my Anchor and Support. I take only the Support of the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: har naamaaN har tayk hai har har naam aDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਣੁ ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, please be kind and lead me to meet the Guru, that I may find the Doorof Salvation. ||7||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karahu gur maylhu har jee-o paava-o mokh d u-aar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਉਤਰੇ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The pre-ordained destiny inscribed on the mortal's forehead by our Lord and Mastercannot be erased.
lines.transliteration: mastak lilaat likh i-aa Dh ur thaakur maytn aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ  ਹਿਰ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings are perfect, who are pleased by the Lord's Will. ||8||1|| mlwr mhlw 3 ] (1276-11) malaar mehlaa 3. Malaar, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak say jan pooran ho-ay jin har bhaan aa bh aa-ay. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਪਾਵਉ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The world is involved with the words of the Vedas, thinking about the three gunas -the three dispositions.
lines.transliteration: bayd ban ee jag varatd aa tarai gun  karay beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਲਾਿਟ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਠਾਕੁਿਰ  ਮੇਟਣਾ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, it suffers punishment by the Messenger of Death; it comes andgoes in reincarnation, over and over again.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai jam dand sahai mar janmai vaaro vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਏ ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਣਾ  ਭਾਇ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, the world is liberated, and finds the Door of Salvation.||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytay mukat  ho-ay paa-ay mokh  du-aar. ||1||

lines.english: O mortal, immerse yourself in service to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: man ray satgur sayv samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ  ਜਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Perfect Guru, and meditates on the Nameof the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag gur pooraa paa-i-aa har har naam Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਨਮੈ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The Lord, by the Pleasure of His Own Will, created the Universe, and the Lord Himselfgives it sustenance and support.
lines.transliteration: har aapnai bh aanai sarisat upaa-ee har aapay d ay-ay aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, by His Own Will, makes the mortal's mind immaculate, and lovingly attunes him to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har aapnai bh aanai man nirmal kee-aa har si-o laagaa pi-aar.

lines.english: The Lord, by His Own Will, leads the mortal to meet the True Guru, the Embellisher ofall his lives. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kai bhaan ai sat gur bh ayti-aa sabh  janam savaaran haar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Word of His Bani. Only a few, asGurmukh, understand.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu banee sat  hai gurmukh  boojh ai ko-ay.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Praise God as Great! No one else is as Great as He.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu kar parabh salaahee-ai t is jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: When God's Grace is received, He Himself forgives the mortal, and unites him withHimself. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay mayl la-ay karam paraapat  ho-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has revealed our True, Supreme Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib maahro satgur d ee-aa d ikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਿਟਆ  ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down and the mind is satisfied, remaining lovingly attunedto the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: amrit varsai man sant okhee-ai sach rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਿਤ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In the Lord's Name, it is forever rejuvenated; it shall never wither and dry up again. ||4|| pMnw 1277
lines.transliteration: har kai naa-ay sadaa haree-aavalee fir sukai naa kumlaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; anyone can try and see.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kinai na paa-i-o man vaykh hu ko pat ee-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ  ਮਿਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: By the Lord's Grace, the True Guru is found, and then the Lord is met with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa tay sat gur paa-ee-ai bh aytai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਭੇਟੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is deluded by doubt; without good destiny, the Lord's wealthis not obtained. ||5||
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh aram bh ulaa-i-aa bin bh aagaa har Dh an na paa-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The three dispositions are completely distracting; people read and study andcontemplate them.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  sabh aa Dh aat hai parh  parh karahi veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਕਰਿਹ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those people are never liberated; they do not find the Door of Salvation.
lines.transliteration: mukat kad ay na hova-ee nahu paa-iniH mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਹੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, they are never released from bondage; they do not embracelove for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur banDh an na t uthee naam na lagai pi-aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਨ ਤੁਟਹੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages, reading and studying theVedas, have grown weary.
lines.transliteration: parh parh  pandit  monee thakay bayd aaN kaa abh i-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਕਾ ਅਿਭਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: They do not even think of the Lord's Name; they do not dwell in the home of theirown inner being.
lines.transliteration: har naam chit na aavee nah nij gh ar hovai vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਨਹ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death hovers over their heads; they are ruined by the deceit within themselves. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jamkaal sirahu na utrai ant ar kapat vin aas. ||7||

lines.english: Everyone longs for the Name of the Lord; without good destiny, it is not obtained.
lines.transliteration: har naavai no sabh ko part aapdaa vin  bhaagaaN paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ  ਿਵਣੁ ਭਾਗ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal meets the True Guru, and theLord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay gur bh aytee-ai har naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Name, honor wells up, and the mortal remains immersed in theLord. ||8||2|| mlwr mhlw 3 AstpdI Gru 2 ] (1277-8) malaar mehlaa 3 asatpadee gh ar 2. Malaar, Third Mehl, Ashtapadees, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1277-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naamay hee pat oopjai har si-o rahaaN samaa-ay. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਿਤ ਊਪਜੈ  ਹਿਰ ਿਸਉ ਰਹ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: When the Lord shows His Mercy, He enjoins the mortal to work for the Guru.
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karay gur kee kaarai laa-ay.

lines.english: His pains are taken away, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within.
lines.transliteration: dukh palHar har naam vasaa-ay.

lines.english: True deliverance comes by focusing one's consciousness on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saachee gat saachai chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Listen to the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee sabad  sunaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O my mind, serve the Lord, Har, Har, the true treasure.
lines.transliteration: man mayray har har sayv niDhaan.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. Night and day, focus your meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay har Dh an paa-ee-ai an-d in laagai sahj Dh i-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The soul-bride who adorns herself without her Husband Lord,
lines.transliteration: bin pir kaaman karay seeNgaar.
duhchaarn ee kahee-ai nit  ho-ay kh u-aar. is ill-mannered and vile, wasted away into ruin.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: This is the useless way of life of the self-willed manmukh.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kaa ih baad  aachaar.

lines.english: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he performs all sorts of empty rituals.||2||
lines.transliteration: baho karam darirh aaveh naam visaar. ||2||

lines.english: The bride who is Gurmukh is beautifully embellished.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kaaman  bani-aa seegaar.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, she enshrines her Husband Lord within her heart.
lines.transliteration: sabday pir raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.english: She realizes the One Lord, and subdues her ego.
lines.transliteration: ayk pachhaan ai ha-umai maar.

lines.english: That soul-bride is virtuous and noble. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sobhaavant ee kahee-ai naar. ||3||

lines.english: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin gur daat ay kinai na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The greedy self-willed manmukh is attracted and engrossed in duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh lobh  doojai lobh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Only a few spiritual teachers realize this,
lines.transliteration: aisay gi-aanee boojhhu ko-ay.
bin gur bhaytay mukat  na ho-ay. ||4|| that without meeting the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||4||

lines.english: Everyone tells the stories told by others.
lines.transliteration: kahi kahi kahan kahai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: Without subduing the mind, devotional worship does not come.
lines.transliteration: bin man moo-ay bhagat  na ho-ay.

lines.english: When the intellect achieves spiritual wisdom, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan matee kamal pargaas.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in that heart. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tit ghat naamai naam nivaas. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਿਹ ਕਹਣੁ  ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In egotism, everyone can pretend to worship God with devotion.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai bhagat  karay sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: But this does not soften the mind, and it does not bring peace.
lines.transliteration: naa man bheejai naa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: By speaking and preaching, the mortal only shows off his self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: kahi kahi kahan aap jaan aa-ay.

lines.english: His devotional worship is useless, and his life is a total waste. ||6||
lines.transliteration: birthee bhagat  sabh  janam gavaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  satgur man bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Name.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.english: They behold the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ever-present, near at hand. pMnw 1278
lines.transliteration: sad hee naam vaykh eh hajoor.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rahi-aa bh arpoor. ||7||

lines.english: God Himself forgives, and bestows His Love.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhsay d ay-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: The world is suffering from the terrible disease of egotism.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai rog vadaa sansaar.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, this disease is cured.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay ayhu rog jaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Truth, the mortal remains immersed in the True Lord.||8||1||3||5||8|| rwgu mlwr CMq mhlw 5 ] (1278-3) raag malaar chhant  mehlaa 5. Raag Malaar, Chhant, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1278-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak saachay saach samaa-ay. ||8||1||3||5||8||

lines.english: My Beloved Lord is the Giver of loving devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: pareetam paraym bh agat kay d aatay.

lines.english: His humble servants are imbued with His Love.
lines.transliteration: apnay jan sang raatay.

lines.english: He is imbued with His servants, day and night; He does not forget them from HisMind, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: jan sang raatay d inas raat ay ik nimakh  manhu na veesrai.

lines.english: He is the Lord of the World, the Treasure of virtue; He is always with me. All gloriousvirtues belong to the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: gopaal gun niDh  sadaa sangay sarab gun  jagdeesrai.

lines.english: With His Feet, He has fascinated my mind; as His humble servant, I am intoxicated with love for His Name.
lines.transliteration: man mohi leenaa charan sangay naam ras jan maatay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਤੇ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਿਨਮਖ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my Beloved is forever Merciful; out of millions, hardly anyone realizes Him.||1||
lines.transliteration: naanak pareetam kirpaal sad ahooN kinai kot maDh ay jaat ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਿਧ  ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Beloved, Your state is inaccessible and infinite.
lines.transliteration: pareetam t ayree gat  agam apaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਿਹ ਲੀਨਾ  ਚਰਨ  ਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸ ਜਨ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
lines.english: You save even the worst sinners.
lines.transliteration: mahaa patit  tumH taaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਸਦਹੂੰ ਿਕਨੈ ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਜਾਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Ocean of mercy, our Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: patit paavan bh agat vachh al kirpaa sinDh  su-aamee-aa.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, vibrate and meditate on Him with commitment forever;He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: satsangay bh aj nisangay raN-o sad aa ant arjaamee-aa.

lines.english: Those who wander in reincarnation through millions of births, are saved and carriedacross, by meditating in remembrance on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: kot janam bharmant  jonee t ay naam simrat  taaray.

lines.english: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Dear Lord; please take careof him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak daras pi-aas har jee-o aap layho samHaaray. ||2||

lines.english: My mind is absorbed in the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal man leenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਮ  ਭਰ੍ਮੰਤ  ਜੋਨੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O God, You are the water; Your humble servants are fish.
lines.transliteration: parabh jal jan t ayray meenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ ਆਿਪ  ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Dear God, You alone are the water and the fish. I know that there is no differencebetween the two.
lines.transliteration: jal meen parabh jee-o ayk t oohai bh inn aan na jaanee-ai.

lines.english: Please take hold of my arm and bless me with Your Name. I am honored only by YourGrace.
lines.transliteration: geh bhujaa layvhu naam d ayvhu t a-o parsaadee maanee-ai.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate with love on theOne Lord of the Universe, who is Merciful to the meek.
lines.transliteration: bhaj saaDh sangay ayk rangay kirpaal gobid  deenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀਉ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੈ ਿਭੰਨ ਆਨ  ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak, the lowly and helpless, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, who in His Kindnesshas made him His Own. ||3||
lines.transliteration: anaath neech sarnaa-ay naanak kar ma-i-aa apunaa keenaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ  ਮਾਨੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: He unites us with Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapas ka-o aap milaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਰੰਗੇ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਦੀਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Our Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of fear.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh anjan har raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥ  ਨੀਚ ਸਰਣਾਇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਿਰ ਮਇਆ  ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਕੀਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Wondrous Lord and Master is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. MyBeloved, the Treasure of virtue, has met me.
lines.transliteration: aacharaj su-aamee antarjaamee milay gun  niDh pi-aari-aa.

lines.english: Supreme happiness and peace well up, as I cherish the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: mahaa mangal sookh upjay gobind  gun nit saari-aa.

lines.english: Meeting with Him, I am embellished and exalted; gazing on Him, I am fascinated, andI realize my pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: mil sang sohay daykh  mohay purab likh i-aa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.||4||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran t in kee jinHee har har Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ  ਸੂਖ ਉਪਜੇ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਤ  ਸਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Vaar Of Malaar, First Mehl, Sung To The Tune Of Rana Kailaash And Malda: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1278-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mhlw 3 ] (1278-16) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vaar malaar kee mehlaa 1 raanay kailaas t athaa maald ay kee Dh un.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੋਹੇ ਦੇਿਖ ਮੋਹੇ ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is delighted, like the earth embellished by the rain.
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ai man rehsee-ai ji-o vuthai Dh aran seegaar.

lines.english: Everything becomes green and lush; the pools and ponds are filled to overflowing.
lines.transliteration: sabh d isai haree-aavalee sar bh aray subh ar taal.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰ ਮਲਾਰ  ਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ  ੧ ਰਾਣੇ ਕੈਲਾਸ  ਤਥਾ ਮਾਲਦੇ  ਕੀ ਧੁਿਨ ॥
lines.english: The inner self is imbued with the deep crimson color of love for the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: andar rachai sach rang ji-o manjeeth ai laal.

lines.english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth and the mind becomes true; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is ecstatic and exalted. pMnw 1279
lines.transliteration: kamal vigsai sach man gur kai sabad nihaal.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is on the wrong side. You can see this with your own eyes.
lines.transliteration: manmukh d oojee t araf hai vaykh hu nad ar nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦੂਜੀ  ਤਰਫ  ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: He is caught in the trap like the deer; the Messenger of Death hovers over his head.
lines.transliteration: faahee faathay mirag ji-o sir deesai jamkaal.

lines.english: Hunger, thirst and slander are evil; sexual desire and anger are horrible.
lines.transliteration: khuDh i-aa tarisnaa nind aa buree kaam kroDh  vikraal.

lines.english: These cannot be seen with your eyes, until you contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aynee akhee nad ar na aavee jichar sabad  na karay beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨੀ ਅਖੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਜਚਰੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Whoever is pleasing to You is content; all his entanglements are gone.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bhaavai sant okhee-aaN chookai aal janjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ  ਚੂਕੈ ਆਲ  ਜੰਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Serving the Guru, his capital is preserved. The Guru is the ladder and the boat.
lines.transliteration: mool rahai gur sayvi-ai gur pa-orhee bohith.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਐ  ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ  ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whoever is attached to the Lord receives the essence; O True Lord, You are found when the mind is true. ||1|| mhlw 1 ] (1279-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak lagee tat  lai tooN sachaa man sach. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗੀ  ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਨ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is one path and one door. The Guru is the ladder to reach one's own place.
lines.transliteration: hayko paaDhar hayk d ar gur pa-orh ee nij thaan.

lines.english: Our Lord and Master is so beautiful, O Nanak; all comfort and peace are in the Name of the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1279-5) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: roorha-o th aakur naankaa sabh  sukh  saacha-o naam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇਕੋ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹੇਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ  ਿਨਜ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created Himself; He Himself understands Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapeenHai aap saaj aap pachhaan i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੂੜਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਚਉ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Separating the sky and the earth, He has spread out His canopy.
lines.transliteration: ambar Dharat  vichh orh chand o-aa t aani-aa.

lines.english: Without any pillars, He supports the sky, through the insignia of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: vin thamHaa gagan rahaa-ay sabad  neesaan i-aa.

lines.english: Creating the sun and the moon, He infused His Light into them.
lines.transliteration: sooraj chand upaa-ay jot  samaan i-aa.

lines.english: He created the night and the day; Wondrous are His miraculous plays.
lines.transliteration: kee-ay raat d inant choj vidaan i-aa.

lines.english: He created the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where people contemplate righteousnessand Dharma, and take cleansing baths on special occasions.
lines.transliteration: tirath Dh aram veechaar naavan  purbaan i-aa.

lines.english: There is no other equal to You; how can we speak and describe You?
lines.transliteration: tuDh sar avar na ko-ay ke aakh  vakh aani-aa.

lines.english: You are seated on the throne of Truth; all others come and go in reincarnation. ||1|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1279-9) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sachai takh at nivaas hor aavan  jaani-aa. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four are delighted:
lines.transliteration: naanak saavan jay vasai chahu omaahaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਿਕ ਆਿਖ  ਵਖਾਿਣਆ  ॥
lines.english: First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naagaaN mirgaaN machhee-aaN rasee-aaN ghar Dh an ho-ay. ||1|| the snake, the deer, the fish and the wealthy people who seek pleasure. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1279-10) mehlaa 1.

lines.english: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four suffer the pains of separation:
lines.transliteration: naanak saavan jay vasai chahu vaychh orhaa ho-ay.

lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gaa-ee putaa nirDh anaa panthee chaakar ho-ay. ||2|| the cow's calves, the poor, the travellers and the servants. ||2|| pauVI ] (1279-11) pa-orhee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਵਿਣ  ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You are True, O True Lord; You dispense True Justice.
lines.transliteration: too sachaa sachiaar jin sach vart aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਗ  ਿਮਰਗ  ਮਛੀਆਂ  ਰਸੀਆਂ  ਘਿਰ  ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Like a lotus, You sit in the primal celestial trance; You are hidden from view.
lines.transliteration: baithaa t aarhee laa-ay kaval chh apaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Brahma is called great, but even he does not know Your limits.
lines.transliteration: barahmai vadaa kahaa-ay ant na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਵਿਣ  ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You have no father or mother; who gave birth to You?
lines.transliteration: naa tis baap na maa-ay kin t oo jaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You have no form or feature; You transcend all social classes.
lines.transliteration: naa tis roop na raykh  varan sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You have no hunger or thirst; You are satisfied and satiated.
lines.transliteration: naa tis bh ukh pi-aas rajaa Dh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: You have merged Yourself into the Guru; You are pervading through the Word of Your Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur meh aap samo-ay sabad vart aa-i-aa.

lines.english: When he is pleasing to the True Lord, the mortal merges in Truth. ||2|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1279-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sachay hee patee-aa-ay sach samaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੈ  ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The physician was called in; he touched my arm and felt my pulse.
lines.transliteration: vaid bulaa-i-aa vaid gee pakarh  dhandholay baaNh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ  ਿਕਿਨ  ਤੂ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The foolish physician did not know that the pain was in the mind. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (1279-15) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bholaa vaid  na jaan -ee karak kalayjay maahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਵਰਨ ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O physician, you are a competent physician, if you first diagnose the disease.
lines.transliteration: vaidaa vaid  suvaid  too pahilaaN rog pachh aan.

lines.english: Prescribe such a remedy, by which all sorts of illnesses may be cured.
lines.transliteration: aisaa daaroo lorh  lahu jit  vanjai rogaa gh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਹ ਆਪੁ  ਸਮੋਇ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਰਤਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Administer that medicine, which will cure the disease, and allow peace to come anddwell in the body.
lines.transliteration: jit daaroo rog uth i-ah tan sukh  vasai aa-ay.

lines.english: Only when you are rid of your own disease, O Nanak, will you be known as aphysician. ||2|| pauVI ] (1279-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: rog gavaa-ihi aapnaa t a naanak vaid  sadaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the deities were created.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan mahays dayv upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵੈਦੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ  ਵੈਦਗੀ  ਪਕਿੜ  ਢੰਢੋਲੇ  ਬਹ ॥
lines.english: Brahma was given the Vedas, and enjoined to worship God.
lines.transliteration: barahmay dit ay bayd  poojaa laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੋਲਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਕਰਕ  ਕਲੇਜੇ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The ten incarnations, and Rama the king, came into being.
lines.transliteration: das avt aaree raam raajaa aa-i-aa.

lines.english: According to His Will, they quickly killed all the demons.
lines.transliteration: daitaa maaray Dh aa-ay hukam sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਵੈਦਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਵੈਦੁ  ਤੂ ਪਿਹਲ  ਰੋਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Shiva serves Him, but cannot find His limits.
lines.transliteration: ees mahaysur sayv tinHee ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਦਾਰੂ ਲੋਿੜ  ਲਹੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: He established His throne on the principles of Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachee keemat paa-ay t akhat rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਰੋਗ ਉਿਠਅਿਹ  ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: He enjoined all the world to its tasks, while He keeps Himself hidden from view. pMnw 1280
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa Dh anDhai laa-ay aap chh apaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Dharam karaa-ay karam Dh arahu furmaa-i-aa. ||3|| The Primal Lord has ordained that mortals must practice righteousness. ||3|| slok mÚ 2 ] (1280-1) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; think of your Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: saavan aa-i-aa hay sakh ee kant ai chit  karayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਣੁ  ਆਇਆ  ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤੈ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the discarded bride is in love with another; now she weeps and wails, anddies. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (1280-2) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jhoor mareh d uhaagan ee jinH avree laagaa nayhu. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਝੂਿਰ ਮਰਿਹ  ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਅਵਰੀ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; the clouds have burst forth withrain.
lines.transliteration: saavan aa-i-aa hay sakh ee jalhar barsanhaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the blessed soul-brides sleep in peace; they are in love with their HusbandLord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1280-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh savan sohaagan ee jinH sah naal pi-aar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਣੁ  ਆਇਆ  ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਬਰਸਨਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: He Himself has staged the tournament, and arranged the arena for the wrestlers.
lines.transliteration: aapay chhinjh  pavaa-ay malaakh aarhaa rachi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਵਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: They have entered the arena with pomp and ceremony; the Gurmukhs are joyful.
lines.transliteration: lathay bharh thoo paa-ay gurmukh  machi-aa.

lines.english: The false and foolish self-willed manmukhs are defeated and overcome.
lines.transliteration: manmukh maaray pachh aarh moorakh  kachi-aa.

lines.english: The Lord Himself wrestles, and He Himself defeats them. He Himself staged this play.
lines.transliteration: aap bhirh ai maaray aap aap kaaraj rachi-aa.

lines.english: The One God is the Lord and Master of all; this is known by the Gurmukhs.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa kh asam ayk hai gurmukh  jaanee-ai.

lines.english: He writes the inscription of His Hukam on the foreheads of all, without pen or ink.
lines.transliteration: hukmee likhai sir laykh  vin kalam masvaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ ਿਭੜੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਿਪ  ਆਿਪ  ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਰਿਚਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, Union with Him is obtained; there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are chanted forever.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  maylaap jithai har gun  sadaa vakh aanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਖਸਮੁ  ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praising the True Word of His Shabad, one comes to realize the Truth. ||4|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1280-7) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sabad salaahi sach pachh aanee-ai. ||4||

lines.english: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds are changing color.
lines.transliteration: ooNnav ooNnav aa-i-aa avar karayNdaa vann.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮੇਲਾਪੁ  ਿਜਥੈ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: How do I know whether my love for my Husband Lord shall endure?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jaanaa t is saah si-o kayv rahsee rang.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The love of those soul-brides endures, if their minds are filled with the Love and theFear of God.
lines.transliteration: rang rahi-aa tinH kaamn ee jinH man bh a-o bh aa-o ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, she who has no Love and Fear of God - her body shall never find peace.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1280-9) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhai bh aa-ay baahree t in tan sukh  na ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਊਂਨਿਵ  ਊਂਨਿਵ  ਆਇਆ  ਅਵਿਰ  ਕਰੇਂਦਾ  ਵੰਨ ॥
lines.english: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and pure water rains down.
lines.transliteration: ooNnav ooNnav aa-i-aa varsai neer nipang.

lines.english: O Nanak, that soul-bride suffers in pain, whose mind is torn away from her Husband Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1280-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak dukh  laagaa t inH kaamn ee jinH kantai si-o man bh ang. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord created both sides and pervades the expanse.
lines.transliteration: dovai t arfaa upaa-ay ik vart i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਬਾਹਰੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The words of the Vedas became pervasive, with arguments and divisions.
lines.transliteration: bayd ban ee vart aa-ay and ar vaad  ghati-aa.

lines.english: Attachment and detachment are the two sides of it; Dharma, true religion, is theguide between the two.
lines.transliteration: parvirat nirvirat  haath aa dovai vich Dh aram firai raibaari-aa.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are worthless and false. Without a doubt, they lose in theCourt of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kachay koorh i-aar t inHee nihcha-o d argeh haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਿਜਨ ਕੰਤੈ ਿਸਉ ਮਿਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are the true spiritual warriors; they haveconquered sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee sabad  soor hai kaam kroDh  jinHee maari-aa.

lines.english: They enter into the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, embellished and exalted bythe Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sachai andar mahal sabad  savaari-aa.

lines.english: Those devotees are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord; they dearly love the True Name.
lines.transliteration: say bhagat  tuDh bhaavday sachai naa-ay pi-aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ  ਵਰਤਾਇ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਵਾਦੁ ਘਿਤਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru. ||5|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1280-14) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan aapn aa tinHaa vitahu ha-o vaari-aa. ||5||

lines.english: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and water rains down intorrents.
lines.transliteration: ooNnav ooNnav aa-i-aa varsai laa-ay jharh ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, she walks in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord; she enjoys peaceand pleasure forever. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1280-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaan ai chalai kant  kai so maan ay sad aa ralee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: Why are you standing up, standing up to look? You poor wretch, this cloud hasnothing in its hands.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa uth uth  daykhhu bapurh ayN is maygh ai hath kichh  naahi.

lines.english: The One who sent this cloud - cherish Him in your mind.
lines.transliteration: jin ayhu maygh path aa-i-aa t is raakh o man maaNhi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ  ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਦੇ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਿਪਆਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He alone enshrines the Lord in his mind, upon whom the Lord bestows His Glance ofGrace.
lines.transliteration: tis no man vasaa-isee jaa ka-o nad ar karay-i.

lines.english: O Nanak, all those who lack this Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||2|| pauVI ] (1280-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree baahree sabh  karan  palaah karay-i. ||2||

lines.english: Serve the Lord forever; He acts in no time at all.
lines.transliteration: so har sadaa sarayvee-ai jis karat  na laagai vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਊਂਨਿਵ ਊਂਨਿਵ  ਆਇਆ  ਵਰਸੈ  ਲਾਇ  ਝੜੀ ॥
lines.english: He stretched the sky across the heavens; in an instant, He creates and destroys.
lines.transliteration: aadaanay aakaas kar kh in meh dh aahi usaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਣੇ  ਸਦਾ ਰਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself created the world; He contemplates His Creative Omnipotence.
lines.transliteration: aapay jagat upaa-ay kai kud rat karay veechaar.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh will be called to account hereafter; he will be severely punished. pMnw 1281
lines.transliteration: manmukh agai laykh aa mangee-ai bahut ee hovai maar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh's account is settled with honor; the Lord blesses him with the treasure of His Praise.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh pat  si-o laykh aa nibrh ai bakh say sifat  bhandaar.

lines.english: No one's hands can reach there; no one will hear anyone's cries.
lines.transliteration: othai hath na aprhai kook na sun ee-ai pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ  ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru will be your best friend there; at the very last instant, He will save you.
lines.transliteration: othai satgur baylee hovai kadh  la-ay ant ee vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਥੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ  ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਢ  ਲਏ ਅੰਤੀ  ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: These beings should serve no other than the True Guru or the Creator Lord above the heads of all. ||6|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1281-3) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aynaa jantaa no hor sayvaa nahee sat gur sir kart aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ  ਨੋ ਹੋਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਕਰਤਾਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O rainbird, the One unto whom you call - everyone longs for that Lord.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa jis no too pookaard aa tis no lochai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: When He grants His Grace, it rains, and the forests and fields blossom forth in theirgreenery.
lines.transliteration: apnee kirpaa kar kai vassee van  tarin hari-aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪੂਕਾਰਦਾ  ਿਤਸ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, He is found; only a rare few understand this.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee paa-ee-ai virlaa boojhai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਸੀ  ਵਣੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਣੁ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Sitting down and standing up, meditate continually on Him, and be at peace foreverand ever.
lines.transliteration: bahdi-aa uth -di-aa nit  Dhi-aa-ee-ai sad aa sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down forever; the Lord gives it to the Gurmukh.||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1281-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak amrit sad  hee varasd aa gurmukh  dayvai har so-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਹਿਦਆ  ਉਠਿਦਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਧਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the people of the world are suffering in pain, they call upon the Lord in lovingprayer.
lines.transliteration: kalmal ho-ee maydnee ard aas karay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਸਦਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Lord naturally listens and hears and gives comfort.
lines.transliteration: sachai suni-aa kann d ay Dh eerak d ayvai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.english: He commands the god of rain, and the rain pours down in torrents.
lines.transliteration: indrai no furmaa-i-aa vuth aa chh ahbar laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਮਿਲ  ਹੋਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਰੇ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Corn and wealth are produced in great abundance and prosperity; their value cannot be estimated.
lines.transliteration: an Dhan upjai baho gh anaa keemat  kahan  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਕੰਨੁ ਦੇ ਧੀਰਕ  ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He reaches out and givessustenance to all beings.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too sabh naa jee-aa d aydaa rijak sambaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Eating this, peace is produced, and the mortal never again suffers in pain. ||2|| pauVI ] (1281-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jit khaaDhai sukh  oopjai fir d ookh na laagai aa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਪਜੈ  ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. You blend those who are truthful intoYour Own Being.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sachaa sach too sachay laihi milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ  ਜੀਆ  ਦੇਦਾ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸੰਬਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those caught in duality are on the side of duality; entrenched in falsehood, theycannot merge into the Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojai d oojee t araf hai koorh  milai na mili-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਖਾਧੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; You display Your CreativeOmnipotence.
lines.transliteration: aapay jorh vichh orhi-ai aapay kud rat day-ay d ikhaa-ay.

lines.english: Attachment brings the sorrow of separation; the mortal acts in accordance with pre- ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: moh sog vijog hai poorab likhi-aa kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੇ ਲੈਿਹ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who remain lovingly attached to the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin ka-o jo har charn ee rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਦੂਜੀ  ਤਰਫ  ਹੈ ਕੂਿੜ ਿਮਲੈ ਨ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are like the lotus which remains detached, floating upon the water.
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal meh kamal alipat hai aisee ban at banaa-ay.

lines.english: They are peaceful and beautiful forever; they eradicate self-conceit from within.
lines.transliteration: say sukhee-ay sad aa sohn ay jinH vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.english: They never suffer sorrow or separation; they are merged in the Being of the Lord.||7|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1281-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tinH sog vijog kad ay nahee jo har kai ank samaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Lord; everything is in His power.
lines.transliteration: naanak so salaahee-ai jis vas sabh kichh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਕਮਲੁ  ਅਿਲਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਐਸੀ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Serve Him, O mortal beings; there is none other than Him.
lines.transliteration: tisai sarayvihu paraan eeho t is bin avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਿਜਨ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, and then he is at peace,forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har parabh  man vasai t aaN sadaa sad aa sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਸੋਗੁ ਿਵਜੋਗੁ  ਕਦੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: He is never cynical; all anxiety has been taken out from within him.
lines.transliteration: sahsaa mool na hova-ee sabh chint aa vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.english: Whatever happens, happens naturally; no one has any say about it.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh ho-ay so sehjay ho-ay kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜਸੁ ਵਿਸ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the True Lord abides in the mind, then the mind's desires are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib man vasai taaN man chind i-aa fal paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, He Himself hears the words of those, whose accounts are in His Hands. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1281-17) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kaa aakh i-aa aap sun ay je la-i-an pannai paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down continually; realize this through realization.
lines.transliteration: amrit sad aa varasd aa boojh an boojh anhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸਾ  ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਸਭ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who, as Gurmukh, realize this, keep the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar enshrinedwithin their hearts.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jinHee bujh i-aa har amrit  rakhi-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and remain forever imbued with the Lord;they conquer egotism and thirsty desires.
lines.transliteration: har amrit peeveh sad aa rang raat ay ha-umai t arisnaa maar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਤ ਮਿਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; the Lord showers His Grace, and it rainsdown.
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naam hai varsai kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਿਖਆ  ਆਿਪ  ਸੁਣੇ ਿਜ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh comes to behold the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2|| pMnw 1282 pauVI ] (1282-1) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh nad ree aa-i-aa har aat am raam muraar. ||2||

lines.english: How can the unweighable be weighed? Without weighing Him, He cannot be obtained.
lines.transliteration: atul ki-o t olee-ai vin  tolay paa-i-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਤੁਲੁ  ਿਕਉ  ਤੋਲੀਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and immerse yourself in His Glorious Virtues.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad veechaaree-ai gun  meh rahai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself weighs Himself; He unites in Union with Himself.
lines.transliteration: apnaa aap aap t olsee aapay milai milaa-ay.

lines.english: His value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about this.
lines.transliteration: tis kee keemat  naa pavai kahn aa kichh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; He has made me realize this true realization.
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree gur aapnay jin sachee boojh  ditee bujh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਿਦਤੀ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The world has been deceived, and the Ambrosial Nectar is being plundered. The self-willed manmukh does not realize this.
lines.transliteration: jagat musai amrit  lootee-ai manmukh  boojh  na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ  ਮੁਸੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਲੁਟੀਐ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, nothing will go along with him; he wastes his life, and departs.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai naal na chalsee jaasee janam gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਨ ਚਲਸੀ  ਜਾਸੀ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and remain awake and aware, preserve and protect the home of their heart; demons have no power against them. ||8|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1282-5) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmatee jaagay t inHee gh ar rakh i-aa d ootaa kaa kichh  na vasaa-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਜਾਗੇ  ਿਤਨੀ  ਘਰੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਦੂਤਾ  ਕਾ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨ ਵਸਾਇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: O rainbird, do not cry out. Do not let this mind of yours be so thirsty for a drop ofwater. Obey the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master,
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa naa billaa-ay naa tarsaa-ay ayhu man kh asam kaa hukam man.

lines.english: Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam mani-ai tikh  utrai charh ai chavgal vann. ||1|| and your thirst shall be quenched. Your love for Him shall increase four-fold. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1282-6) mehlaa 3.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਨਾ ਿਬਲਲਾਇ  ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਇ  ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ॥
