lines.english: O rainbird, your place is in the water; you move around in the water.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa jal meh tayraa vaas hai jal hee maahi firaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਮੰਿਨਐ  ਿਤਖ ਉਤਰੈ  ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਿਲ  ਵੰਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: But you do not appreciate the water, and so you cry out.
lines.transliteration: jal kee saar na jaanhee t aaN tooN kookan  paahi.

lines.english: In the water and on the land, it rains down in the ten directions. No place is left dry.
lines.transliteration: jal thal chahu dis varasd aa kh aalee ko thaa-o naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਜਲ ਮਿਹ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਫਰਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: With so much rain, those who are die of thirst are very unfortunate.
lines.transliteration: aytai jal varsad ai tikh mareh bh aag tinaa kay naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ  ਤ ਤੂੰ ਕੂਕਣ  ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs understand; the Lord abides within their minds. ||2|| pauVI ] (1282-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh t in sojh ee pa-ee jin vasi-aa man maahi. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਚਹੁ ਿਦਿਸ ਵਰਸਦਾ  ਖਾਲੀ  ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Yogic Masters, celibates, Siddhas and spiritual teachers - none of them has found the limits of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naath jatee siDh  peer kinai ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੈ ਜਿਲ  ਵਰਸਦੈ  ਿਤਖ ਮਰਿਹ  ਭਾਗ ਿਤਨਾ  ਕੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and merge in You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ay t ujhai samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਿਤਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਿਜਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: For thirty-six ages, God remained in utter darkness, as He pleased.
lines.transliteration: jug chhat eeh gubaar t is hee bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The vast expanse of water swirled around.
lines.transliteration: jalaa bimb asraal tinai vart aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਥ ਜਤੀ  ਿਸਧ ਪੀਰ ਿਕਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator of all is Infinite, Endless and Inaccessible.
lines.transliteration: neel aneel agamm sarjeet sabaa-i-aa.

lines.english: He formed fire and conflict, hunger and thirst.
lines.transliteration: agan upaa-ee vaad bh ukh tihaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Death hangs over the heads of the people of the world, in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kai sir kaal d oojaa bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Savior Lord saves those who realize the Word of the Shabad. ||9|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1282-12) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: rakhai rakh anhaar jin sabad  bujhaa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.english: This rain pours down on all; it rains down in accordance with God's Loving Will.
lines.transliteration: ih jal sabh t ai varasd aa varsai bh aa-ay subh aa-ay.

lines.english: Those trees become green and lush, which remain immersed in the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: say birkhaa haree-aavlay jo gurmukh  rahay samaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, there is peace; the pain of these creatures is gone. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1282-14) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree sukh  ho-ay aynaa jant aa kaa d ukh jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The night is wet with dew; lightning flashes, and the rain pours down in torrents.
lines.transliteration: bhinnee rain  chamki-aa vuth aa chh ahbar laa-ay.

lines.english: Food and wealth are produced in abundance when it rains, if it is the Will of God.
lines.transliteration: jit vuth ai an Dh an bahut  oopjai jaaN saho karay rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਵਰਸਦਾ  ਵਰਸੈ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Consuming it, the minds of His creatures are satisfied, and they adopt the lifestyle ofthe way.
lines.transliteration: jit khaaDhai man t aripat -ee-ai jee-aaN jugat  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਿਬਰਖਾ  ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This wealth is the play of the Creator Lord. Sometimes it comes, and sometimes it goes.
lines.transliteration: ih Dhan kart ay kaa kh ayl hai kad ay aavai kad ay jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Naam is the wealth of the spiritually wise. It is permeating and pervading forever.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee-aa kaa Dhan naam hai sad  hee rahai samaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace receive this wealth. ||2|| pauVI ] (1282-17) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jin ka-o nadar karay t aaN ih Dh an palai paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself does, and causes all to be done. Unto whom can I complain?
lines.transliteration: aap karaa-ay karay aap ha-o kai si-o karee pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਵੁਠੈ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਜ ਸਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself calls the mortal beings to account; He Himself causes them to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay laykhaa mangsee aap karaa-ay kaar.

lines.english: Whatever pleases Him happens. Only a fool issues commands.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bh aavai so thee-ai hukam karay gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਤੇ  ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਦੇ ਆਵੈ  ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself saves and redeems; He Himself is the Forgiver.
lines.transliteration: aap chhadaa-ay chh utee-ai aapay bakh sanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; He gives His Support to all.
lines.transliteration: aapay vaykhai sun ay aap sabh sai day aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He alone is pervading and permeating all; He considers each and every one. pMnw 1283
lines.transliteration: sabh meh ayk varatd aa sir sir karay beechaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh reflects on the self, lovingly attached to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh aap veechaaree-ai lagai sach pi-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, whom can we ask? He Himself is the Great Giver. ||10|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1283-2) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no aakhee-ai aapay d ayvan haar. ||10||

lines.english: This world is a rainbird; let no one be deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa ayhu jagat hai mat  ko bh aram bh ulaa-ay.

lines.english: This rainbird is an animal; it has no understanding at all.
lines.transliteration: ih baabeeNhaa pasoo hai is no boojhan  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਹੈ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭੁਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.
lines.transliteration: amrit har kaa naam hai jit  peetai tikh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਬਾਬੀਂਹਾ  ਪਸੂ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਬੂਝਣੁ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who drink it in shall never again be afflicted by thirst. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1283-4) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh jinH pee-aa t inH bahurh  na laagee aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਿਤਖ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Malaar is a calming and soothing raga; meditating on the Lord brings peace and tranquility.
lines.transliteration: malaar seetal raag hai har Dh i-aa-i-ai saaNt ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜਨ ਪੀਆ  ਿਤਨ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ਆਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then the rain falls on all the people of theworld.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o apnee kirpaa karay t aaN vartai sabh  lo-ay.

lines.english: From this rain, all creatures find the ways and means to live, and the earth isembellished.
lines.transliteration: vuthai jee-aa jugat  ho-ay Dh arnee no seegaar ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲਾਰੁ ਸੀਤਲ  ਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਐ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this world is all water; everything came from water.
lines.transliteration: naanak ih jagat sabh  jal hai jal hee t ay sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ਤ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, a rare few realize the Lord; such humble beings are liberatedforever. ||2|| pauVI ] (1283-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ko virlaa boojhai so jan mukat  sadaa ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵੁਠੈ ਜੀਆ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਧਰਣੀ  ਨੋ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O True and Independent Lord God, You alone are my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: sachaa vayparvaahu iko too Dh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਸਭੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are everything; who else is of any account?
lines.transliteration: too sabh  kichh  aapay aap d oojay kis gan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਕੋ ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ  ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: False is the pride of man. True is Your glorious greatness.
lines.transliteration: maanas koorh aa garab sachee t uDh manee.

lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation, the beings and species of the world came into being.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on rachaa-ay upaa-ee mayd nee.

lines.english: But if the mortal serves his True Guru, his coming into the world is judged to beworthwhile.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay aapn aa aa-i-aa t is gan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਦੂਜੇ ਿਕਸੁ ਗਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: And if he eradicates eogtism from within himself, then how can he be judged?
lines.transliteration: jay ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay ta kayhee gan at ganee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਣਸ  ਕੂੜਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਣੀ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is lost in the darkness of emotional attachment, like the manlost in the wilderness.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mohi gubaar ji-o bh ulaa manjh  vanee.

lines.english: Countless sins are erased, by even a tiny particle of the Lord's Name. ||11|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1283-10) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: katay paap asaNkh naavai ik kan ee. ||11||

lines.english: O rainbird, you do not know the Mansion of your Lord and Master's Presence. Offeryour prayers to see this Mansion.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa khasmai kaa mahal na jaan hee mahal d aykh ardaas paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ਤ ਕੇਹੀ ਗਣਤ  ਗਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You speak as you please, but your speech is not accepted.
lines.transliteration: aapnai bh aanai bahut aa boleh boli-aa thaa-ay na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੋਿਹ ਗੁਬਾਿਰ  ਿਜਉ  ਭੁਲਾ ਮੰਿਝ ਵਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Your Lord and Master is the Great Giver; whatever you desire, you shall receive fromHim.
lines.transliteration: khasam vadaa d aataar hai jo ichh ay so fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੰਖ  ਨਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਕਣੀ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Not only the thirst of the poor rainbird, but the thirst of the whole world is quenched. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1283-12) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa ki-aa bapurhaa jagt ai kee t ikh jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The night is wet with dew; the rainbird sings the True Name with intuitive ease.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa bhinnee rain  boli-aa sehjay sach subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਖਸਮੈ  ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ  ਮਹਲੁ  ਦੇਿਖ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This water is my very soul; without water, I cannot survive.
lines.transliteration: ih jal mayraa jee-o hai jal bin rahan na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this water is obtained, and egotism iseradicated from within.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee jal paa-ee-ai vichahu aap gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੁ  ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I cannot live without Him, even for a moment; the True Guru has led me tomeet Him. ||2|| pauVI ] (1283-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bin chasaa na jeevdee so sat gur dee-aa milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: There are countless worlds and nether regions; I cannot calculate their number.
lines.transliteration: khand pat aal asaNkh mai gan at na ho-ee.

lines.english: You are the Creator, the Lord of the Universe; You create it, and You destroy it.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa govind  tuDh sirjee t uDhai go-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਿਭੰਨੀ  ਰੈਿਣ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The 8.4 million species of beings issued forth from You.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh mayd nee tujh hee t ay ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ  ਹੈ ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some are called kings, emperors and nobles.
lines.transliteration: ik raajay khaan malook kaheh kahaaveh ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some claim to be bankers and accumulate wealth, but in duality they lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: ik saah sadaaveh sanch Dh an doojai pat  kho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ  ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some are givers, and some are beggars; God is above the heads of all.
lines.transliteration: ik daat ay ik mangt ay sabh naa sir so-ee.

lines.english: Without the Name, they are vulgar, dreadful and wretched.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai baajaaree-aa bh eehaaval ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ  ਅਸੰਖ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Falsehood shall not last, O Nanak; whatever the True Lord does, comes to pass. ||12|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1283-18) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: koorh nikh utay naankaa sach karay so ho-ee. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ  ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਤੁਧੁ ਿਸਰਜੀ  ਤੁਧੈ ਗੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O rainbird, the virtuous soul-bride attains the Mansion of her Lord's Presence; theunworthy, unvirtuous one is far away.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa gunvant ee mahal paa-i-aa a-ugan vantee door.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Deep within your inner being, the Lord abides. The Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present.
lines.transliteration: antar t ayrai har vasai gurmukh  sadaa hajoor.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ  ਕਹਿਹ  ਕਹਾਵਿਹ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal no longer weeps and wails.
lines.transliteration: kook pukaar na hova-ee nadree nad ar nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਸਾਹ ਸਦਾਵਿਹ  ਸੰਿਚ ਧਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam intuitively merge with the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1|| pMnw 1284 mÚ 3 ] (1284-1) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay sehjay milay sabad  guroo kai gh aal. ||1||

lines.english: The rainbird prays: O Lord, grant Your Grace, and bless me with the gift of the life ofthe soul.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa bayntee karay kar kirpaa d ayh jee-a d aan.

lines.english: Without the water, my thirst is not quenched, and my breath of life is ended andgone.
lines.transliteration: jal bin pi-aas na ootrai chh utak jaaNhi mayray paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀਅ  ਦਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver of peace, O Infinite Lord God; You are the Giver of the treasure ofvirtue.
lines.transliteration: too sukh -daata bay-ant  hai gund aataa nayDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਊਤਰੈ  ਛੁਟਿਕ  ਜਿਹ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is forgiven; in the end, the Lord God shall be your only friend.||2|| pauVI ] (1284-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh bakh as la-ay ant  baylee ho-ay bh agvaan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ  ਨੇਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: He created the world; He considers the merits and demerits of the mortals.
lines.transliteration: aapay jagat upaa-ay kai gun  a-ugan  karay beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਅੰਿਤ  ਬੇਲੀ  ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who are entangled in the three gunas - the three dispositions - do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tarai gun  sarab janjaal hai naam na Dh aray pi-aar.

lines.english: Forsaking virtue, they practice evil; they shall be miserable in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gun chh od a-ugan  kamaavd ay dargeh hohi kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ  ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They lose their life in the gamble; why did they even come into the world?
lines.transliteration: joo-ai janam tinee haari-aa kit  aa-ay sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਰਬ  ਜੰਜਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਧਰੇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: But those who conquer and subdue their minds, through the True Word of the Shabad- night and day, they love the Naam.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad man maari-aa ahinis naam pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਿਡ ਅਉਗਣ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਹੋਿਹ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those people enshrine the True, Invisible and Infinite Lord in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: jinee purkhee ur Dh aari-aa sachaa alakh  apaar.

lines.english: You, O Lord, are the Giver, the Treasure of virtue; I am unvirtuous and unworthy.
lines.transliteration: too gund aataa niDh aan heh asee avgan i-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: He alone finds You, whom You bless and forgive, and inspire to contemplate the Wordof the Guru's Shabad. ||13|| slok mÚ 5 ] (1284-7) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis bakhsay so paa-isee gur sabd ee veechaar. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਪੁਰਖੀ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics forget the Name of the Lord; the night of their lives does not pass in peace.
lines.transliteration: raat na vihaavee saakt aaN jinHaa visrai naa-o.

lines.english: Their days and nights become comfortable, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord. ||1|| mÚ 5 ] (1284-8) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raatee d inas suhaylee-aa naanak har gun  gaaN-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ  ਸੋ ਪਾਇਸੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: All sorts of jewels and gems, diamonds and rubies, shine forth from their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: ratan javayhar maan kaa habh ay man ee mathann.

lines.english: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1284-9) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak jo parabh bh aani-aa sachai d ar sohann. ||2||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, I dwell on the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachaa satgur sayv sach samHaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਤੀ  ਿਦਨਸ  ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The work you have done for the True Guru shall be very useful in the end.
lines.transliteration: ant kh alo-aa aa-ay je sat gur agai gh aali-aa.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that person who is protected by the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: pohi na sakai jamkaal sachaa rakhvaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਮਾਣਕਾ ਹਭੇ ਮਣੀ ਮਥੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Lighting the lamp of the Guru's Teachings, my awareness has been awakened.
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee jot  jagaa-ay d eevaa baali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਭਾਿਣਆ  ਸਚੈ ਦਿਰ ਸੋਹੰਿਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are false; without the Name, they wander around like demons.
lines.transliteration: manmukh vin  naavai koorh i-aar fireh bayt aali-aa.

lines.english: They are nothing more than beasts, wrapped up in human skin; they are black-hearted within.
lines.transliteration: pasoo maanas chamm palaytay and rahu kaali-aa.

lines.english: The True Lord is pervading all; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is seen.
lines.transliteration: sabho vart ai sach sachai sabad  nihaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਖਲੋਆ  ਆਇ  ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਅਗੈ ਘਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. The Perfect Guru has revealed it to me.||14|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1284-13) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niDhaan hai poorai gur d aykhaali-aa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਪੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਸਚਾ ਰਖਵਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: The rainbird realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command with intuitive ease throughthe Guru.
lines.transliteration: baabeehai hukam pachhaan i-aa gur kai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਜਗਾਇ  ਦੀਵਾ  ਬਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: The clouds mercifully burst forth, and the rain pours down in torrents.
lines.transliteration: maygh varsai d a-i-aa kar goorh ee chh ahbar laa-ay.

lines.english: The cries and wailings of the rainbird have ceased, and peace has come to abide in itsmind.
lines.transliteration: baabeehay kook pukaar reh ga-ee sukh vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੂ ਮਾਣਸ  ਚੰਿਮ ਪਲੇਟੇ  ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise that Lord, who reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings and creatures. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1284-15) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so salaahee-ai je dayNdaa sabh naaN jee-aa rijak samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: O rainbird, you do not know what thirst is within you, or what you can drink to quenchit.
lines.transliteration: chaatrik t oo na jaan hee ki-aa t uDh vich t ikhaa hai kit  peetai tikh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਿਰ ਦੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: You wander in the love of duality, and you do not obtain the Ambrosial Water.
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aa-ay bh arammi-aa amrit  jal palai na paa-ay.

lines.english: When God casts His Glance of Grace, then the mortal automatically meets the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay jay aapn ee taaN satgur milai subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹੈ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Water is obtained from the True Guru, and then the mortalremains merged in the Lord with intuitive ease. ||2|| pauVI ] (1284-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur t ay amrit  jal paa-i-aa sehjay rahi-aa samaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਗੂੜੀ  ਛਹਬਰ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some go and sit in the forest realms, and do not answer any calls.
lines.transliteration: ik van kh and baiseh jaa-ay sad  na dayvhee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹੇ  ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ਰਿਹ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some, in the dead of winter, break the ice and immerse themselves in freezing water.
lines.transliteration: ik paalaa kakar bhann seet al jal hayNvahee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜ ਦੇਂਦਾ  ਸਭਨ  ਜੀਆ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some rub ashes on their bodies, and never wash off their dirt.
lines.transliteration: ik bhasam charhHaavahi ang mail na Dh ovhee.

lines.english: Some look hideous, with their uncut hair matted and dishevelled. They bring dishonor to their family and ancestry. pMnw 1285
lines.transliteration: ik jataa bikat bikraal kul ghar kh ovhee.

lines.english: Some wander naked day and night and never sleep.
lines.transliteration: ik nagan fireh din raat  neeNd na sovhee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਨਗਨ  ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਿਤ  ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: Some burn their limbs in fire, damaging and ruining themselves.
lines.transliteration: ik agan jalaaveh ang aap vigovahee.

lines.english: Without the Name, the body is reduced to ashes; what good is it to speak and crythen?
lines.transliteration: vin naavai t an chh aar ki-aa kahi rovhee.

lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru, are embellished and exalted in the Court of their Lordand Master. ||15|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1285-3) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sohan khasam d u-aar je sat gur sayvhee. ||15||

lines.english: The rainbird chirps in the ambrosial hours of the morning before the dawn; its prayersare heard in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa amrit vaylai boli-aa t aaN dar sun ee pukaar.

lines.english: The order is issued to the clouds, to let the rains of mercy shower down.
lines.transliteration: mayghai no furmaan ho-aa varsahu kirpaa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਵੇਲੈ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਤ ਦਿਰ ਸੁਣੀ  ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who enshrine the True Lord within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: ha-o tin kai balihaarn ai jinee sach rakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਘੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਹੋਆ  ਵਰਸਹੁ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Name, all are rejuvenated, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1285-5) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naamay sabh haree-aavalee gur kai sabad  veechaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਰਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O rainbird, this is not the way to quench your thirst, even though you may cry out ahundred times.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa iv tayree t ikhaa na ut rai jay sa-o karahi pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By God's Grace, the True Guru is found; by His Grace, love wells up.
lines.transliteration: nadree sat gur paa-ee-ai nad ree upjai pi-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, when the Lord and Master abides in the mind, corruption and evil leave fromwithin. ||2|| pauVI ] (1285-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai vichahu jaahi vikaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਇਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਿਤਖਾ  ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕਰਿਹ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Some are Jains, wasting their time in the wilderness; by their pre-ordained destiny,they are ruined.
lines.transliteration: ik jainee ujharh  paa-ay Dh arahu kh u-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not on their lips; they do not bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: tin mukh  naahee naam na t irath nHaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They pull out their hair with their hands, instead of shaving.
lines.transliteration: hathee sir khohaa-ay na bh ad karaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They remain unclean day and night; they do not love the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kuchil raheh din raat  sabad  na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਜੈਨੀ ਉਝੜ  ਪਾਇ  ਧੁਰਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They have no status, no honor, and no good karma. They waste away their lives invain.
lines.transliteration: tin jaat  na pat  na karam janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds are false and impure; that which they eat is impure and defiled.
lines.transliteration: man joothai vayjaat  jooth aa kh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, no one achieves a lifestyle of good conduct.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai aachaar na kin hee paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਿਚਲ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਦਨ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord God, the Universal Creator. ||16|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1285-10) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh o-ankaar sach samaa-i-aa. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਪਿਤ ਨ ਕਰਮੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: In the month of Saawan, the bride is happy, contemplating the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: saavan sarsee kaamn ee gur sabd ee veechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever; her love for the Guru is unlimited. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1285-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa suhaagan ee gur kai hayt  apaar. ||1||

lines.english: In Saawan, she who has no virtue is burned, in attachment and love of duality.
lines.transliteration: saavan d ajhai gun  baahree jis d oojai bh aa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, she does not appreciate the value of her Husband Lord; all her decorationsare worthless. ||2|| pauVI ] (1285-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak pir kee saar na jaan-ee sabh  seegaar kh u-aar. ||2||

lines.english: The True, Unseen, Mysterious Lord is not won over by stubbornness.
lines.transliteration: sachaa alakh abh ay-o hath  na pat eeja-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਿਣ  ਸਰਸੀ  ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Some sing according to traditional ragas, but the Lord is not pleased by these ragas.
lines.transliteration: ik gaavahi raag paree-aa raag na bheej-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਅਪਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some dance and dance and keep the beat, but they do not worship Him withdevotion.
lines.transliteration: ik nach nach pooreh taal bh agat na keej-ee.

lines.english: Some refuse to eat; what can be done with these fools?
lines.transliteration: ik ann na khaahi moorakh  tinaa ki-aa keej-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਵਿਣ  ਦਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Thirst and desire have greatly increased; nothing brings satisfaction.
lines.transliteration: tarisnaa ho-ee bahut  kivai na Dh eej-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some are tied down by rituals; they hassle themselves to death.
lines.transliteration: karam vaDheh kai lo-a kh ap mareeja-ee.

lines.english: In this world, profit comes by drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam sansaar amrit peej-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ  ਅਭੇਉ  ਹਿਠ ਨ ਪਤੀਜਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs gather in loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||17|| slok mÚ 3 ] (1285-16) salok mehlaa 3. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har bhagt ee asnayhi gurmukh  gheej-ee. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀਆ  ਰਾਿਗ  ਨ ਭੀਜਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who sing in the Raga of Malaar - their minds and bodies becomecool and calm.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh malaar raag jo karahi t in man t an seet al ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਨਿਚ ਨਿਚ ਪੂਰਿਹ  ਤਾਲ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਕੀਜਈ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they realize the One, the One True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee ayk pachh aani-aa ayko sachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਿਹ  ਮੂਰਖ ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੀਜਈ  ॥
lines.english: Their minds and bodies are true; they obey the True Lord, and they are known astrue.
lines.transliteration: man tan sachaa sach man sachay sachee so-ay.

lines.english: True devotional worship is deep within them; they are automatically blessed withhonor.
lines.transliteration: andar sachee bh agat hai sehjay hee pat  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਵਧਿਹ  ਕੈ ਲੋਅ ਖਿਪ ਮਰੀਜਈ  ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is utter darkness; the self-willed manmukh cannot find the way.
lines.transliteration: kalijug meh ghor anDh aar hai manmukh  raahu na ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, very blessed are those Gurmukhs, unto whom the Lord is revealed. ||1|| mÚ 3 ] (1285-19) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: say vadbhaagee naankaa jin gurmukh  pargat ho-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The clouds rain down mercifully, and joy wells up in the minds of the people.
lines.transliteration: ind varsai kar d a-i-aa lokaaN man upjai chaa-o.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the One, by whose Command the clouds burst forth with rain. pMnw 1286
lines.transliteration: jis kai hukam ind varasd aa tis kai sad  balihaarai jaaN-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs dwell on the Word of the Shabad. They sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  samHaalee-ai sachay kay gun  gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਮਾਲੀਐ  ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings who are imbued with the Naam are pure andimmaculate. They are intuitively merged in the True Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1286-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay jan nirmalay sehjay sach samaa-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Serving the Perfect True Guru, I have found the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur sayv pooraa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meditating on the Perfect Lord, by perfect karma, I have enshrined the Shabad within my mind.
lines.transliteration: poorai karam Dhi-aa-ay pooraa sabad  man vasaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through perfect spiritual wisdom and meditation, my filth has been washed away.
lines.transliteration: poorai gi-aan Dhi-aan mail chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਧਆਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage and pool of purification; I wash my mind inHim.
lines.transliteration: har sar tirath jaan  manoo-aa naa-i-aa.

lines.english: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind - blessed is the mother who gavebirth to him.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai man maar Dh an jan aydee maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਿਰ ਤੀਰਿਥ  ਜਾਿਣ  ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: He is true in the Court of the Lord, and his coming into this world is judged to be true.
lines.transliteration: dar sachai sachiaar sachaa aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਰ  ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one can challenge that person, with whom our Lord and Master is pleased.
lines.transliteration: puchh na sakai ko-ay jaaN khasmai bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, his pre-ordained destiny is activated. ||18|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1286-5) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach salaahi likhi-aa paa-i-aa. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਿਛ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਜ ਖਸਮੈ  ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who give out ceremonial hats of recognition are fools; those who receive them have no shame.
lines.transliteration: kulhaaN dayNday baavlay laiNday vaday nilaj.

lines.english: The mouse cannot enter its hole with a basket tied around its waist.
lines.transliteration: choohaa khad na maav-ee t ikal banHai chh aj.

lines.english: Those who give out blessings shall die, and those that they bless shall also depart.
lines.transliteration: dayniH du-aa-ee say mareh jin ka-o d ayn se jaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, no one knows the Lord's Command, by which all must depart.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na jaap-ee kithai jaa-ay samaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਚੂਹਾ ਖਡ ਨ ਮਾਵਈ  ਿਤਕਿਲ  ਬੰਨੈ ਛਜ ॥
lines.english: The spring harvest is the Name of the One Lord; the harvest of autumn is the TrueName.
lines.transliteration: fasal ahaarhee ayk naam saavn ee sach naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਨ  ਦੁਆਈ  ਸੇ ਮਰਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਿਨ  ਿਸ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I receive a letter of pardon from my Lord and Master, when I reach His Court.
lines.transliteration: mai mehdood  likhaa-i-aa kh asmai kai d ar jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ  ਿਕਥੈ ਜਾਇ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: There are so many courts of the world, and so many who come and go there.
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kay d ar kayt -rhay kayt ay aavahi jaaNhi.

lines.punjabi: ਫਸਿਲ  ਅਹਾੜੀ  ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਵਣੀ  ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: There are so many beggars begging; so many beg and beg until death. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1286-9) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaytay mangeh mangt ay kayt ay mang mang jaahi. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮਹਦੂਦੁ  ਿਲਖਾਇਆ  ਖਸਮੈ  ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The elephant eats a hundred pounds of ghee and molasses, and five hundred pounds of corn.
lines.transliteration: sa-o man hast ee gh i-o gurh  khaavai panj sai d aanaa kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਕੇ ਦਰ ਕੇਤੜੇ  ਕੇਤੇ ਆਵਿਹ  ਜਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He belches and grunts and scatters dust, and when the breath leaves his body, heregrets it.
lines.transliteration: dakai fookai khayh udaavai saahi ga-i-ai pachh utaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਿਹ  ਮੰਗਤੇ  ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਿਗ  ਮੰਿਗ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The blind and arrogant die insane.
lines.transliteration: anDhee fook mu-ee d ayvaanee.

lines.english: Submitting to the Lord, one become pleasing to Him.
lines.transliteration: khasam mitee fir bh aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਉ ਮਣੁ ਹਸਤੀ  ਿਘਉ  ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਪੰਿਜ ਸੈ ਦਾਣਾ  ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The sparrow eats only half a grain, then it flies through the sky and chirps.
lines.transliteration: aDh gulHaa chirh ee kaa chugan  gain charh ee billaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਡਕੈ ਫੂਕੈ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਵੈ  ਸਾਿਹ  ਗਇਐ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The good sparrow is pleasing to her Lord and Master, if she chirps the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: khasmai bh aavai ohaa changee je karay kh udaa-ay kh udaa-ay.

lines.english: The powerful tiger kills hundreds of deer, and all sorts of other animals eat what itleaves.
lines.transliteration: saktaa seehu maaray sai miri-aa sabh  pichh ai pai kh aa-ay.

lines.english: It becomes very strong, and cannot be contained in its den, but when it must go, itregrets.
lines.transliteration: ho-ay sataan aa gh urai na maavai saahi ga-i-ai pachh utaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਧੁ ਗੁਲਾ  ਿਚੜੀ  ਕਾ ਚੁਗਣੁ  ਗੈਿਣ  ਚੜੀ ਿਬਲਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: So who is impressed by the roar of the blind beast?
lines.transliteration: anDhaa kis no buk sun aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੈ  ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹਾ ਚੰਗੀ  ਿਜ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is not pleasing at all to his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: khasmai mool na bh aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਤਾ  ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੈ ਿਮਿਰਆ  ਸਭ ਿਪਛੈ ਪੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The insect loves the milkweed plant; perched on its branch, it eats it.
lines.transliteration: ak si-o pareet karay ak t idaa ak daalee bahi kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਇ ਸਤਾਣਾ  ਘੁਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਿਹ  ਗਇਐ  ਪਛੁਤਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It becomes good and pleasing to its Lord and Master, if it chirps the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: khasmai bh aavai oho changa je karay kh udaa-ay kh udaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the world lasts for only a few days; indulging in pleasures, pain is produced.
lines.transliteration: naanak dunee-aa chaar d ihaarh ay sukh  keetai dukh ho-ee.

lines.english: There are many who boast and brag, but none of them can remain detached from theworld.
lines.transliteration: galaa vaalay hain ghan ayray chh ad na sakai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਅਕ ਿਤਡਾ  ਅਕ ਡਾਲੀ  ਬਿਹ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The fly dies for the sake of sweets.
lines.transliteration: makheeN mithai marn aa.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਮੈ  ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹੋ ਚੰਗਾ  ਿਜ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, death does not even approach those whom You protect. You carry themacross the terrifying world-ocean. ||2|| pauVI ] (1286-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jin too rakh eh tin nayrh  na aavai t in bha-o saagar t arnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਿਦਹਾੜੇ  ਸੁਿਖ ਕੀਤੈ  ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable, O Invisible and Infinite True Lord Master.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar too Dh anee sachaa alakh  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗਲਾ  ਵਾਲੇ  ਹੈਿਨ ਘਣੇਰੇ  ਛਿਡ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: You are the Giver, all are beggars of You. You alone are the Great Giver.
lines.transliteration: too daataa sabh  mangt ay iko d ayvan haar.

lines.english: Those who serve You find peace, reflecting on the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: jinee sayvi-aa tinee sukh  paa-i-aa gurmat ee veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਤੂ ਰਖਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਨੇਿੜ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਿਤਨ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Some, according to Your Will, are in love with Maya.
lines.transliteration: iknaa no tuDh  ayvai bh aavdaa maa-i-aa naal pi-aar.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praise the Lord with love and affection within.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad salaahee-ai ant ar paraym pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without love, there is no devotion. Without the True Guru, love is not enshrined.
lines.transliteration: vin pareet ee bh agat na hova-ee vin  satgur na lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਿਭ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕੋ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You are the Lord God; everyone serves You. This is the prayer of Your humbleminstrel.
lines.transliteration: too parabh  sabh  tuDh sayvd ay ik dh aadhee karay pukaar.

lines.english: Please bless me with the gift of contentment, that I may receive the True Name as my Support. ||19|| pMnw 1287 slok mÚ 1 ] (1287-1) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: deh d aan sant okhee-aa sachaa naam milai aaDh aar. ||19||

lines.english: Through the night the time ticks away; through the day the time ticks away.
lines.transliteration: raatee kaal gh atai d in kaal.

lines.english: The body wears away and turns to straw.
lines.transliteration: chhijai kaa-i-aa ho-ay paraal.

lines.english: All are involved and entangled in worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: vartan  varti-aa sarab janjaal.

lines.english: The mortal has mistakenly renounced the way of service.
lines.transliteration: bhuli-aa chuk ga-i-aa t ap taal.

lines.english: The blind fool is caught in conflict, bothered and bewildered.
lines.transliteration: anDhaa jh akh jhakh pa-i-aa jh ayr.

lines.english: Those who weep after someone has died - can they bring him back to life?
lines.transliteration: pichhai roveh li-aaveh fayr.

lines.english: Without realization, nothing can be understood.
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay kichh  soojh ai naahee.

lines.english: The weepers who weep for the dead shall themselves die as well.
lines.transliteration: mo-i-aa roNhi roNday mar jaaNheeN.

lines.english: O Nanak, this is the Will of our Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: naanak khasmai ayvai bh aavai.

lines.english: Those who do not remember the Lord, are dead. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1287-4) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: say-ee mu-ay jin chit na aavai. ||1||

lines.english: Love dies, and affection dies; hatred and strife die.
lines.transliteration: mu-aa pi-aar pareet mu-ee mu-aa vair vaad ee.

lines.english: The color fades, and beauty vanishes; the body suffers and collapses.
lines.transliteration: vann ga-i-aa roop vinsi-aa d ukhee dayh rulee.

lines.english: Where did he come from? Where is he going? Did he exist or not?
lines.transliteration: kithhu aa-i-aa kah ga-i-aa kihu na see-o kihu see.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਆ  ਿਪਆਰੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਮੁਈ ਮੁਆ  ਵੈਰੁ ਵਾਦੀ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh made empty boasts, indulging in parties and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: man mukh galaa go-ee-aa keet aa chaa-o ralee.

lines.punjabi: ਵੰਨੁ ਗਇਆ  ਰੂਪੁ ਿਵਣਿਸਆ  ਦੁਖੀ ਦੇਹ ਰੁਲੀ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, his honor is torn away, from head to foot. ||2|| pauVI ] (1287-7) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam bin sir khur pat  paatee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਥਹੁ ਆਇਆ  ਕਹ ਗਇਆ  ਿਕਹੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਿਕਹੁ ਸੀ ॥
lines.english: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of peace. It shall beyour Help and Support in the end.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam sad aa sukh -daata antay ho-ay sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਮੁਿਖ ਗਲਾ  ਗੋਈਆ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਚਾਉ  ਰਲੀ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, the world is insane. It does not appreciate the worth of the Name.
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo jagat  ba-uraanaa naavai saar na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਸਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਟੀ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru are accepted and approved. Their light merges into the Light.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayveh say parvaan  jinH jotee jot  milaa-ee.

lines.english: That servant who enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind, becomes just like his Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: so saahib so sayvak tayhaa jis bh aanaa man vasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me, who has ever found peace by following his own will? The blind act inblindness.
lines.transliteration: aapnai bh aanai kaho kin sukh  paa-i-aa anDh aa anDh  kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ  ਬਉਰਾਨਾ  ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: No one is ever satisfied and fulfilled by evil and corruption. The hunger of the fool isnot satisfied.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa kad ay hee rajai naahee moorakh  bhukh na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਿਜਨ ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to duality, all are ruined; without the True Guru, there is no understanding.
lines.transliteration: doojai sabh  ko lag vigut aa bin sat gur boojh  na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਤੇਹਾ ਿਜਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are blessed with Grace by the Will ofthe Lord. ||20|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1287-11) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay so sukh  paa-ay jis no kirpaa karay rajaa-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੈ  ਭਾਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਿਕਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਅੰਧਾ  ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Modesty and righteousness both, O Nanak, are qualities of those who are blessed withtrue wealth.
lines.transliteration: saram Dharam d u-ay naankaa jay Dh an palai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕਦੇ ਹੀ ਰਜੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Do not refer to that wealth as your friend, which leads you to get your head beaten.
lines.transliteration: so Dhan mit ar na kaaNdhee-ai jit  sir chotaaN khaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਿਗ  ਿਵਗੁਤਾ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who possess only this worldly wealth are known as paupers.
lines.transliteration: jin kai palai Dhan vasai t in kaa naa-o fakeer.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਿਕਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: But those, within whose hearts You dwell, O Lord - those people are oceans of virtue. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1287-13) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinH kai hirdai t oo vaseh t ay nar gun ee gaheer. ||1||

lines.english: Worldly possessions are obtained by pain and suffering; when they are gone, theyleave pain and suffering.
lines.transliteration: dukhee dunee sahayrh ee-ai jaa-ay t a lageh d ukh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਮੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਦੁਇ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਜੇ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, hunger is never satisfied.
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh .

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੁ ਨ ਕਢੀਐ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਚੋਟ ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Beauty does not satisfy hunger; when the man sees beauty, he hungers even more.
lines.transliteration: roopee bhukh  na ut rai jaaN daykhaaN taaN bhukh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਲੈ ਧਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਿਤਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਫਕੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: As many as are the pleasures of the body, so many are the pains which afflict it. ||2|| mÚ 1 ] (1287-14) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaytay ras sareer kay t aytay lageh d ukh. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਤੂ ਵਸਿਹ  ਤੇ ਨਰ ਗੁਣੀ  ਗਹੀਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Acting blindly, the mind becomes blind. The blind mind makes the body blind.
lines.transliteration: anDhee kammee anDh  man man anDh ai tan anDh .

lines.english: Why make a dam with mud and plaster? Even a dam made of stones gives way.
lines.transliteration: chikarh laa-i-ai ki-aa thee-ai jaaN tutai pathar banDh .

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਨੀ  ਸਹੇੜੀਐ  ਜਾਇ  ਤ ਲਗਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ॥
lines.english: The dam has burst. There is no boat. There is no raft. The water's depth is unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: banDh t utaa bayrh ee nahee naa t ulhaa naa haath.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ  ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Name, many multitudes have drowned. ||3|| mÚ 1 ] (1287-16) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachay naam vin kayt ay dubay saath. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜ ਦੇਖ ਤ ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.english: Thousands of pounds of gold, and thousands of pounds of silver; the king over theheads of thousands of kings.
lines.transliteration: lakh man  su-inaa lakh  man rupaa lakh  saahaa sir saah.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ  ਕੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਲਗਿਹ  ਦੁਖ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and spearmen; the emperor ofthousands of horsemen.
lines.transliteration: lakh laskar lakh  vaajay nayjay lakh ee gh orhee paat isaah.

lines.english: The unfathomable ocean of fire and water must be crossed.
lines.transliteration: jithai saa-ir langh-n aa agan paan ee asgaah.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਅੰਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: The other shore cannot be seen; only the roar of pitiful cries can be heard.
lines.transliteration: kanDhee d is na aavee Dh aahee pavai kahaah.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਕਿੜ  ਲਾਇਐ  ਿਕਆ  ਥੀਐ  ਜ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਥਰ  ਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, there, it shall be known, whether anyone is a king or an emperor. ||4|| pauVI ] (1287-19) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak othai jaanee-ahi saah kay-ee paat isaah. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਨਾ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Some have chains around their necks, in bondage to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: iknaa galeeN janjeer band rabaan ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਣੁ ਕੇਤੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਾਥ ॥੩॥
lines.english: They are released from bondage, realizing the True Lord as True. pMnw 1288
lines.transliteration: baDhay chh uteh sach sach pachh aanee-ai.

lines.english: One whose pre-ordained destiny is activated, comes to know the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: likhi-aa palai paa-ay so sach jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: By God's Command, it is ordained. When the mortal goes, he knows.
lines.transliteration: hukmee ho-ay nibayrh ga-i-aa jaan ee-ai.

lines.english: Realize the Word of the Shabad, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bha-ojal t aaran haar sabad  pachh aanee-ai.

lines.english: Thieves, adulterers and gamblers are pressed like seeds in the mill.
lines.transliteration: chor jaar joo-aar peerhay gh aanee-ai.

lines.english: Slanderers and gossipers are hand-cuffed.
lines.transliteration: nindak laa-it baar milay harhHvaanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇ  ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord, and is famous in the Court of the Lord. ||21|| slok mÚ 2 ] (1288-3) salok mehlaa 2. Shalok, Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sach samaa-ay so d argeh jaan ee-ai. ||21||

lines.english: The beggar is known as an emperor, and the fool is known as a religious scholar.
lines.transliteration: naa-o fakeerai paatisaahu moorakh  pandit  naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਫਕੀਰੈ  ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The blind man is known as a seer; this is how people talk.
lines.transliteration: anDhay kaa naa-o paarkh oo ayvai karay gu-aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਪਾਰਖੂ  ਏਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: The trouble-maker is called a leader, and the liar is seated with honor.
lines.transliteration: ilat kaa naa-o cha-uDh ree koorh ee pooray thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਲਿਤ  ਕਾ ਨਾਉ  ਚਉਧਰੀ  ਕੂੜੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs know that this is justice in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1288-5) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh jaan ee-ai kal kaa ayhu ni-aa-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਿਲ  ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਿਨਆਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Deer, falcons and government officials are known to be trained and clever.
lines.transliteration: harnaaN baajaaN tai sikd aaraaN aynHaa parhH-aa naa-o.

lines.english: When the trap is set, they trap their own kind; hereafter they will find no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: faaNDhee lagee jaat  fahaa-in agai naahee thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਣ  ਬਾਜ  ਤੈ ਿਸਕਦਾਰ  ਏਨਾ ਪਿੜਆ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is learned and wise, and he alone is a scholar, who practices the Name.
lines.transliteration: so parhi-aa so pandit  beenaa jinHee kamaan aa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਫਧੀ  ਲਗੀ  ਜਾਿਤ ਫਹਾਇਿਨ  ਅਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: First, the tree puts down its roots, and then it spreads out its shade above.
lines.transliteration: pahilo day jarh  andar jammai t aa upar hovai chh aaN-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਿੜਆ  ਸੋ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਕਮਾਣਾ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The kings are tigers, and their officials are dogs;
lines.transliteration: raajay seeh mukdam kut ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੋ  ਦੇ ਜੜ ਅੰਦਿਰ ਜੰਮੈ ਤਾ ਉਪਿਰ  ਹੋਵੈ ਛਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay jagaa-iniH baithay sut ay. they go out and awaken the sleeping people to harass them.

lines.english: The public servants inflict wounds with their nails.
lines.transliteration: chaakar nahdaa paa-iniH ghaa-o.

lines.english: The dogs lick up the blood that is spilled.
lines.transliteration: rat pit  kutiho chat jaahu.

lines.english: But there, in the Court of the Lord, all beings will be judged.
lines.transliteration: jithai jee-aaN hosee saar.

lines.english: Those who have violated the people's trust will be disgraced; their noses will be cutoff. ||2|| pauVI ] (1288-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: nakeeN vadheeN laa-it baar. ||2||

lines.english: He Himself creates the world, and He himself takes care of it.
lines.transliteration: aap upaa-ay maydnee aapay kard aa saar.

lines.english: Without the Fear of God, doubt is not dispelled, and love for the Name is not embraced.
lines.transliteration: bhai bin bh aram na katee-ai naam na lagai pi-aar.

lines.english: Through the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and the Door of Salvation is found.
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay bh a-o oopjai paa-ee-ai mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਾਏ  ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਦਾ  ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Through the Fear of God, intuitive ease is obtained, and one's light merges into theLight of the Infinite.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay sahj paa-ee-ai mil jot ee jot  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਕਟੀਐ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Fear of God, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, reflecting on theGuru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay bh aijal langh ee-ai gurmat ee veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is found; He has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: bhai t ay nirbh a-o paa-ee-ai jis d aa ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਅਪਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of the Fear of God. Burning indesire, they weep and wail.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bh ai kee saar na jaan nee tarisnaa jalt ay karahi pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਭੈਜਲੁ  ਲੰਘੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Name, peace is obtained, by enshrining the Guru's Teachingswithin the heart. ||22|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1288-12) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai hee tay sukh  paa-i-aa gurmat ee ur Dh aar. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Beauty and sexual desire are friends; hunger and tasty food are tied together.
lines.transliteration: roopai kaamai dost ee bh ukhai saad ai gandh .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਜਲਤੇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Greed is bound up in its search for wealth, and sleep will use even a tiny space as a bed.
lines.transliteration: labai maalai ghul mil michal ooNghai sa-urh  palangh .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਵੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰ ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Anger barks and brings ruin on itself, blindly pursuing useless conflicts.
lines.transliteration: bhaNukai kop kh u-aar ho-ay fakarh  pitay anDh .

lines.english: It is good to be silent, O Nanak; without the Name, one's mouth spews forth only filth. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1288-14) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chupai changa naankaa vin naavai muhi ganDh . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਪੈ ਕਾਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਭੁਖੈ ਸਾਦੈ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
lines.english: Royal power, wealth, beauty, social status and youth are the five thieves.
lines.transliteration: raaj maal roop jaat joban panjay th ag.

lines.punjabi: ਲਬੈ ਮਾਲੈ  ਘੁਿਲ ਿਮਿਲ  ਿਮਚਿਲ  ਊਂਘੈ  ਸਉਿੜ  ਪਲੰਘੁ ॥
lines.english: These thieves have plundered the world; no one's honor has been spared.
lines.transliteration: aynee thageeN jag th agi-aa kinai na rakh ee laj.

lines.punjabi: ਭੰਉਕੈ  ਕੋਪੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਕੜੁ  ਿਪਟੇ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: But these thieves themselves are robbed, by those who fall at the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: aynaa thagniH thag say je gur kee pairee paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੰਗਾ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਵਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਿਹ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the multitudes who do not have good karma are plundered. ||2|| pauVI ] (1288-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak karmaa baahray hor kaytay muth ay jaahi. ||2||

lines.english: The learned and educated are called to account for their actions.
lines.transliteration: parhi-aa laykh aydaar laykh aa mangee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ਰੂਪੁ ਜਾਿਤ  ਜੋਬਨੁ ਪੰਜੇ ਠਗ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, they are judged false; they become miserable and suffer hardship.
lines.transliteration: vin naavai koorh i-aar a-ukh aa tangee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨੀ ਠਗੀਂ  ਜਗੁ ਠਿਗਆ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਰਖੀ ਲਜ ॥
lines.english: Their path becomes treacherous and difficult, and their way is blocked.
lines.transliteration: a-ughat ruDh ay raah galee-aaN rokee-aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨਾ ਠਗਿਨ  ਠਗ ਸੇ ਿਜ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True and Independent Lord God, one becomes content.
lines.transliteration: sachaa vayparvaahu sabad sant okhee-aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮਾ  ਬਾਹਰੇ  ਹੋਿਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord is deep and profound and unfathomable; His depth cannot be measured.
lines.transliteration: gahir gabheer athaahu haath na labh -ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru, the mortals are beaten and punched in the face and the mouth,and no one is released.
lines.transliteration: muhay muhi chotaa khaahu vin  gur ko-ay na chh utsee.

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one returns to his true home with honor.
lines.transliteration: pat sayt ee gh ar jaahu naam vakh aanee-ai.

lines.english: Know that the Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, gives sustenance and the breathof life. ||23|| pMnw 1289 slok mÚ 1 ] (1289-1) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hukmee saah giraah dayNdaa jaan ee-ai. ||23||

lines.english: Living beings are formed of air, water and fire. They are subject to pleasure and pain.
lines.transliteration: pa-unai paan ee agnee jee-o t in ki-aa kh usee-aa ki-aa peerh .

lines.punjabi: ਪਉਣੈ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਅਗਨੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਿਤਨ ਿਕਆ  ਖੁਸੀਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਪੀੜ ॥
lines.english: Dhart ee paat aalee aakaasee ik d ar rahan vajeer. In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic ethers ofthe heavens, some remain ministers in the Court of the Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤੀ  ਪਾਤਾਲੀ  ਆਕਾਸੀ ਇਿਕ  ਦਿਰ ਰਹਿਨ  ਵਜੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: Some live long lives, while others suffer and die.
lines.transliteration: iknaa vadee aarjaa ik mar hohi jaheer.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ  ਇਿਕ  ਮਿਰ ਹੋਿਹ ਜਹੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: Some give and consume, and still their wealth is not exhausted, while others remainpoor forever.
lines.transliteration: ik day kh aahi nikh utai naahee ik sad aa fireh fakeer.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਦੇ ਖਾਿਹ  ਿਨਖੁਟੈ  ਨਾਹੀ ਇਿਕ  ਸਦਾ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਫਕੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: In His Will He creates, and in His Will He destroys thousands in an instant.
lines.transliteration: hukmee saajay hukmee dhaahay ayk chasay meh lakh .

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਿਹ ਲਖ ॥
lines.english: He has harnessed everyone with His harness; when He forgives, he breaks theharness.
lines.transliteration: sabh ko nathai nathi-aa bakh say torhay nath.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਥੈ ਨਿਥਆ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਤੋੜੇ ਨਥ ॥
lines.english: He has no color or features; He is invisible and beyond calculation.
lines.transliteration: varnaa chihnaa baahraa laykhay baajh  alakh .

lines.english: How can He be described? He is known as the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: ki-o kathee-ai ki-o aakhee-ai jaapai sacho sach.

lines.english: All the actions which are done and described, O Nanak, are done by the Indescribable Lord Himself.
lines.transliteration: karnaa kathnaa kaar sabh  naanak aap akath.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣਾ ਕਥਨਾ  ਕਾਰ ਸਭ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਅਕਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever hears the description of the indescribable,
lines.transliteration: akath kee kathaa sunay-ay.

lines.english: ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1289-6) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: riDh buDh  siDh gi-aan sad aa sukh  ho-ay. ||1|| is blessed with wealth, intelligence, perfec tion, spiritual wisdom and eternal peace.

lines.english: One who bears the unbearable, controls the nine holes of the body.
lines.transliteration: ajar jarai ta na-o kul banDh .

lines.english: One who worships and adores the Lord with his breath of life, gains stability in hisbody-wall.
lines.transliteration: poojai paraan hovai thir kanDh .

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਤ ਨਉ ਕੁਲ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Where has he come from, and where will he go?
lines.transliteration: kahaaN tay aa-i-aa kahaaN ayhu jaan .

lines.english: Remaining dead while yet alive, he is accepted and approved.
lines.transliteration: jeevat marat  rahai parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਕਹ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ  ਕਹ ਏਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, realizes the essence ofreality.
lines.transliteration: hukmai boojhai t at pachh aanai.

lines.english: This is known by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: ih parsaad guroo t ay jaan ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, know this: egotism leads to bondage.
lines.transliteration: hoNdaa farh ee-ag naanak jaan .

lines.english: Only those who have no ego and no self-conceit, are not consigned to reincarnation. ||2|| pauVI ] (1289-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naa ha-o naa mai joonee paan. ||2||

lines.english: Read the Praise of the Lord's Name; other intellectual pursuits are false.
lines.transliteration: parhHee-ai naam saalaah hor buDh eeN mithi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਣੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Without dealing in Truth, life is worthless.
lines.transliteration: bin sachay vaapaar janam birthi-aa.

lines.english: No one has ever found the Lord's end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: ant na paaraavaar na kin hee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: All the world is enveloped by the darkness of egotistical pride. It does not like theTruth.
lines.transliteration: sabh jag garab gubaar t in sach na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who depart from this world, forgetting the Naam, shall be roasted in the fryingpan.
lines.transliteration: chalay naam visaar taavan  tati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They pour the oil of duality within, and burn.
lines.transliteration: baldee and ar tayl dubiDh aa gh ati-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਗਰਿਬ  ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਿਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They come into the world and wander around aimlessly; they depart when the play is finished.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa uthee kh ayl firai uvt i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, imbued with Truth, the mortals merge in Truth. ||24|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1289-11) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai mayl sachai rati-aa. ||24||

lines.english: First, the mortal is conceived in the flesh, and then he dwells in the flesh.
lines.transliteration: pahilaaN maasahu nimmi-aa maasai andar vaas.

lines.english: When he comes alive, his mouth takes flesh; his bones, skin and body are flesh.
lines.transliteration: jee-o paa-ay maas muhi mili-aa had chamm tan maas.

lines.english: He comes out of the womb of flesh, and takes a mouthful of flesh at the breast.
lines.transliteration: maasahu baahar kadhi-aa mammaa maas giraas.

lines.english: His mouth is flesh, his tongue is flesh; his breath is in the flesh.
lines.transliteration: muhu maasai kaa jeebh maasai kee maasai and ar saas.

lines.english: He grows up and is married, and brings his wife of flesh into his home.
lines.transliteration: vadaa ho-aa vee-aahi-aa ghar lai aa-i-aa maas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਪਾਇ  ਮਾਸੁ ਮੁਿਹ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਹਡੁ ਚੰਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Flesh is produced from flesh; all relatives are made of flesh.
lines.transliteration: maasahu hee maas oopjai maasahu sabho saak.

lines.english: When the mortal meets the True Guru, and realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he comes to be reformed.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai hukam bujh ee-ai t aaN ko aavai raas.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਹੁ ਮਾਸੈ ਕਾ ਜੀਭ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਸੈ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Releasing himself, the mortal does not find release; O Nanak, through empty words,one is ruined. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1289-15) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aap chhutay nah chh ootee-ai naanak bachan bin aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਵੀਆਿਹਆ  ਘਿਰ  ਲੈ ਆਇਆ  ਮਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The fools argue about flesh and meat, but they know nothing about meditation andspiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: maas maas kar moorakh jh agrhay gi-aan Dh i-aan nahee jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਮਾਸਹੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
lines.english: What is called meat, and what is called green vegetables? What leads to sin?
lines.transliteration: ka-un maas ka-un  saag kahaavai kis meh paap samaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ  ਤ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: It was the habit of the gods to kill the rhinoceros, and make a feast of the burntoffering.
lines.transliteration: gaiNdaa maar hom jag kee-ay dayvit i-aa kee baan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਛੁਟੇ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਚਿਨ  ਿਬਣਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who renounce meat, and hold their noses when sitting near it, devour men atnight.
lines.transliteration: maas chhod bais nak pakrh eh raat ee maan as khaanay.

lines.english: They practice hypocrisy, and make a show before other people, but they do not understand anything about meditation or spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: farh kar lokaaN no dikhlaavahi gi-aan Dh i-aan nahee soojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਿਰ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਝਗੜੇ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, what can be said to the blind people? They cannot answer, or evenunderstand what is said.
lines.transliteration: naanak anDhay si-o ki-aa kahee-ai kahai na kahi-aa boojh ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਣੁ  ਮਾਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ  ਸਾਗੁ  ਕਹਾਵੈ  ਿਕਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਪਾਪ ਸਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: They alone are blind, who act blindly. They have no eyes in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: anDhaa so-ay je anDh  kamaavai t is ridai se lochan naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੈਂਡਾ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਕੀਏ ਦੇਵਿਤਆ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: They are produced from the blood of their mothers and fathers, but they do not eat fish or meat. pMnw 1290
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa kee rakat  nipannay machh ee maas na kh aaNhee.

lines.english: But when men and women meet in the night, they come together in the flesh.
lines.transliteration: istaree purkh ai jaaN nis maylaa othai manDh  kamaahee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਤਰ੍ੀ  ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਜ ਿਨਿਸ  ਮੇਲਾ  ਓਥੈ ਮੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.
lines.transliteration: maasahu nimmay maasahu jammay ham maasai kay bhaaNday.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਿਨੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਡੇ ॥
lines.english: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan kachh  soojh ai naahee chat ur kahaavai paaNday.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ਪਡੇ ॥
lines.english: O master, you believe that flesh on the outside is bad, but the flesh of those in yourown home is good.
lines.transliteration: baahar kaa maas mandaa su-aamee gh ar kaa maas changayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਰ  ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਘਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: All beings and creatures are flesh; the soul has taken up its home in the flesh.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  maasahu ho-ay jee-ay la-i-aa vaasayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਿਭ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੋਏ ਜੀਇ  ਲਇਆ  ਵਾਸੇਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: They eat the uneatable; they reject and abandon what they could eat. They have a teacher who is blind.
lines.transliteration: abhakh  bhakheh bh akh taj chh odeh anDh  guroo jin kayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਭਖੁ  ਭਖਿਹ  ਭਖੁ ਤਿਜ ਛੋਡਿਹ  ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਜਨ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.
lines.transliteration: maasahu nimmay maasahu jammay ham maasai kay bhaaNday.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਿਨੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਡੇ ॥
lines.english: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourselfclever, O religious scholar.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan kachh  soojh ai naahee chat ur kahaavai paaNday.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ  ਪਡੇ ॥
lines.english: Meat is allowed in the Puraanas, meat is allowed in the Bible and the Koran.Throughout the four ages, meat has been used.
lines.transliteration: maas puraanee maas kaytaabeeN chahu jug maas kamaan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਸੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ  ਮਾਸੁ ਕਤੇਬੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਿਗ  ਮਾਸੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: It is featured in sacred feasts and marriage festivities; meat is used in them.
lines.transliteration: jaj kaaj vee-aahi suhaavai othai maas samaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਜ ਕਾਿਜ  ਵੀਆਿਹ  ਸੁਹਾਵੈ  ਓਥੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Women, men, kings and emperors originate from meat.
lines.transliteration: istaree purakh  nipjahi maasahu paat isaah sult aanaaN.

lines.english: If you see them going to hell, then do not accept charitable gifts from them.
lines.transliteration: jay o-ay diseh narak jaaNday taaN unH kaa d aan na lain aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਓਇ ਿਦਸਿਹ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਜਦੇ  ਤ ਉਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The giver goes to hell, while the receiver goes to heaven - look at this injustice.
lines.transliteration: dayNdaa narak surag laid ay daykhhu ayhu Dh inyaanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਂਦਾ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਸੁਰਿਗ  ਲੈਦੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਿਧਙਾਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: You do not understand your own self, but you preach to other people. O Pandit, you are very wise indeed.
lines.transliteration: aap na boojhai lok bujh aa-ay paaNday kh araa si-aan aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਪਡੇ ਖਰਾ ਿਸਆਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Pandit, you do not know where meat originated.
lines.transliteration: paaNday too jaan ai hee naahee kithhu maas upannaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਡੇ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੈ  ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਥਹੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਉਪੰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Corn, sugar cane and cotton are produced from water. The three worlds came fromwater.
lines.transliteration: to-i-ahu ann kamaad  kapaahaaN to-i-ahu t aribhavan gannaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ  ਕਪਾਹ  ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣੁ  ਗੰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Water says, "I am good in many ways." But water takes many forms.
lines.transliteration: to-aa aakh ai ha-o baho biDh  hachh aa toai bahut  bikaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੋਆ  ਆਖੈ ਹਉ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਹਛਾ ਤੋਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਬਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: Forsaking these delicacies, one becomes a true Sannyaasee, a detached hermit.Nanak reflects and speaks. ||2|| pauVI ] (1290-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aytay ras chh od hovai sani-aasee naanak kahai vichaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਛੋਿਡ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹੈ ਿਵਚਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: What can I say with only one tongue? I cannot find your limits.
lines.transliteration: ha-o ki-aa aakhaa ik jeebh  tayraa ant  na kin hee paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Those who contemplate the True Word of the Shabad are absorbed into You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad veechaar say t ujh hee maahi samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਆਖਾ  ਇਕ ਜੀਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Some wander around in saffron robes, but without the True Guru, no one finds theLord.
lines.transliteration: ik bhagvaa vays kar bh aramd ay vin  satgur kinai na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਸੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They wander in foreign lands and countries until they grow weary, but You hide Yourself within them.
lines.transliteration: days disant ar bhav thakay t uDh andar aap lukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਭਗਵਾ  ਵੇਸੁ ਕਿਰ ਭਰਮਦੇ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, through which the Lord shines forth andreveals Himself.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad rat ann hai kar chaanan  aap d ikhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਸ ਿਦਸੰਤਰ  ਭਿਵ ਥਕੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਆਪੁ  ਲੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Realizing one's own self, following the Guru's Teachings, the mortal is absorbed intoTruth.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa aap pachh aani-aa gurmat ee sach samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Coming and going, the tricksters and magicians put on their magic show.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on bajaaree-aa baajaar jinee rachaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਿਣਆ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: But those whose minds are pleased by the True Lord, praise the True One, the Ever-stable Lord. ||25|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1290-14) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ik thir sachaa salaahnaa jin man sachaa bh aa-i-aa. ||25||

lines.english: O Nanak, the tree of actions done in Maya yields ambrosial fruit and poisonous fruit.
lines.transliteration: naanak maa-i-aa karam birakh fal amrit  fal vis.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਥਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ  ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: The Creator does all deeds; we eat the fruits as He ordains. ||1|| mÚ 2 ] (1290-15) mehlaa 2. Second Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaran  kartaa karay jis kh avaalay t is. ||1||

lines.english: O Nanak, burn worldly greatness and glory in the fire.
lines.transliteration: naanak dunee-aa kee-aaN vadi-aa-ee-aaN agee sayt ee jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਬਰਖੁ  ਫਲ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲ ਿਵਸੁ ॥
lines.english: These burnt offerings have caused mortals to forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord.Not even one of them will go along with you in the end. ||2|| pauVI ] (1290-16) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: aynee jalee-eeN naam visaari-aa ik na chalee-aa naal. ||2||

lines.english: He judges each and every being; by the Hukam of His Command, He leads us on.
lines.transliteration: sir sir ho-ay nibayrh hukam chalaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Justice is in Your Hands, O Lord; You are pleasing to my mind.
lines.transliteration: tayrai hath nibayrh  toohai man bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਕੀਆਂ ਵਿਡਆਈਆਂ  ਅਗੀ  ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal is bound and gagged by Death and lead away; no one can rescue him.
lines.transliteration: kaal chalaa-ay bann ko-ay na rakhsee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨੀ ਜਲੀਈਂ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Old age, the tyrant, dances on the mortal's shoulders.
lines.transliteration: jar jarvaanaa kaNniH charh i-aa nachsee.

lines.english: So climb aboard the boat of the True Guru, and the True Lord will rescue you.
lines.transliteration: satgur bohith bayrh  sachaa rakh see.

lines.english: The fire of desire burns like an oven, consuming mortals night and day.
lines.transliteration: agan bhakh ai bharhhaarh  an-din bhakhsee.

lines.english: Like trapped birds, the mortals peck at the corn; only through the Lord's Command will they find release.
lines.transliteration: faathaa chugai chog hukmee chhutsee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਚਲਾਏ  ਬੰਿਨ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass; falsehood shall fail in the end. ||26|| pMnw 1291 slok mÚ 1 ] (1291-1) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kartaa karay so hog koorh  nikhutsee. ||26||

lines.english: The True Guru is the All-knowing Primal Bein g; He shows us our true home within the home of the self.
lines.transliteration: ghar meh gh ar daykhaa-ay d ay-ay so sat gur purakh  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਘਰ ਮਿਹ ਘਰੁ ਦੇਖਾਇ  ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, resonate and resound within; the insigniaof the Shabad is revealed there, vibrating gloriously.
lines.transliteration: panch sabad Dh unikaar Dh un tah baajai sabad  neesaan .

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ  ਧੁਿਨਕਾਰ  ਧੁਿਨ ਤਹ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Worlds and realms, nether regions, solar systems and galaxies are wondrouslyrevealed.
lines.transliteration: deep lo-a paat aal tah kh and mandal hairaan.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ  ਤਹ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ  ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The strings and the harps vibrate and resound; the true throne of the Lord is there.
lines.transliteration: taar gh or baajint ar tah saach t akhat sultaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਬਾਿਜੰਤਰ੍  ਤਹ ਸਾਿਚ  ਤਖਿਤ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Listen to the music of the home of the heart - Sukhmani, peace of mind. Lovingly tunein to His state of celestial ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: sukhman kai gh ar raag sun sunn mandal liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਮਨ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਰਾਗੁ ਸੁਿਨ ਸੁੰਿਨ ਮੰਡਿਲ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Contemplate the Unspoken Speech, and the desires of the mind are dissolved.
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa beechaaree-ai mansaa maneh samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਨਿਹ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus is turned upside-down, and is filled with Ambrosial Nectar. This minddoes not go out; it does not get distracted.
lines.transliteration: ulat kamal amrit bh ari-aa ih man kat ahu na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਉਲਿਟ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਿਤ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: It does not forget the Chant which is chanted without chanting; it is immersed in thePrimal Lord God of the ages.
lines.transliteration: ajpaa jaap na veesrai aad jugaad  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਪਾ  ਜਾਪੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਆਿਦ ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: All the sister-companions are blessed with the five virtues. The Gurmukhs dwell in thehome of the self deep within.
lines.transliteration: sabh sakh ee-aa panchay milay gurmukh  nij gh ar vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸਖੀਆ  ਪੰਚੇ ਿਮਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Nanak is the slave of that one who seeks the Shabad and finds this home within. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1291-6) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabad kh oj ih gh ar lahai naanak t aa kaa d aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਖੋਿਜ ਇਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The extravagant glamor of the world is a passing show.
lines.transliteration: chilimil bisee-aar dunee-aa faanee.

lines.english: My twisted mind does not believe that it will end up in a grave.
lines.transliteration: kaaloob akal man gor na maanee.

lines.english: I am meek and lowly; You are the great river.
lines.transliteration: man kameen kamatreen t oo daree-aa-o kh udaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੂਿਬ  ਅਕਲ  ਮਨ ਗੋਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Please, bless me with the one thing; everything else is poison, and does not tempt me.
lines.transliteration: ayk cheej mujhai d eh avar jahar cheej na bh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਕਮੀਨ  ਕਮਤਰੀਨ  ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਖੁਦਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: You filled this fragile body with the water of life, O Lord, by Your Creative Power.
lines.transliteration: puraab khaam koojai hikmat  khudaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਚੀਜੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਦੇਿਹ ਅਵਰ  ਜਹਰ  ਚੀਜ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: By Your Omnipotence, I have become powerful.
lines.transliteration: man tu-aanaa t oo kud ratee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Nanak is a dog in the Court of the Lord, intoxicated more and more, all the time.
lines.transliteration: sag naanak deebaan mast aanaa nit  charh ai savaa-i-aa.

lines.english: The world is on fire; the Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing. ||2|| pauVI nvI mÚ 5 ] (1291-9) pa-orhee navee mehlaa 5. New Pauree, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aatas d unee-aa kh unak naam kh udaa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਸਤਾਨਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: His wonderful play is all-pervading; it is wonderful and amazing!
lines.transliteration: sabho vart ai chalat  chalat  vakh aani-aa.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, I know the the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysar gurmukh jaan i-aa.

lines.english: All my sins and corruption are washed away, through the insignia of the Shabad, theWord of God.
lines.transliteration: lathay sabh vikaar sabad  neesaan i-aa.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and becomes free.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sang uDh aar bh a-ay nikaan i-aa.

lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Great Giver, I enjoy all comforts and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: simar simar daat aar sabh  rang maan i-aa.

lines.english: I have become famous throughout the world, under the canopy of His kindness andgrace.
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-i-aa sansaar mihar chh aavaan i-aa.

lines.english: He Himself has forgiven me, and united me with Himself; I am forever a sacrifice toHim.
lines.transliteration: aapay bakhas milaa-ay sad  kurbaan i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, by the Pleasure of His Will, my Lord and Master has blended me withHimself. ||27|| slok mÚ 1 ] (1291-13) salok mehlaa 1. Shalok, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak la-ay milaa-ay khasmai bh aani-aa. ||27||

lines.english: Dhan so kaagad  kalam Dh an Dh an bh aaNdaa Dh an mas. Blessed is the paper, blessed is the pen, blessed is the inkwell, and blessed is the ink.
Dhan laykh aaree naankaa jin naam likh aa-i-aa sach. ||1|| Blessed is the writer, O Nanak, who writes the True Name. ||1|| mÚ 1 ] (1291-14) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
You Yourself are the writing tablet, and You Yourself are the pen. You are also what is written on it.
lines.transliteration: aapay patee kalam aap upar laykh bh e tooN.

lines.english: Speak of the One Lord, O Nanak; how could there be any other? ||2|| pauVI ] (1291-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: ayko kahee-ai naankaa doojaa kaahay koo. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਕਲਮ  ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਡਾ  ਧਨੁ ਮਸੁ ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are all-pervading; You Yourself made the making.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay aap varatd aa aap ban at banaa-ee.
