lines.english: Without You, there is no other at all; You are permeating and pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: tuDh bin d oojaa ko nahee t oo rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.english: You alone know Your state and extent. Only You can estimate Your worth.
lines.transliteration: tayree gat  mit toohai jaand aa tuDh keemat  paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ  ਆਿਪ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਲੇਖੁ ਿਭ ਤੂੰ ॥
lines.english: You are invisible, imperceptible and inaccessible. You are revealed through the Guru'sTeachings.
lines.transliteration: too alakh  agochar agam hai gurmat  dikhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਕਾਹੇ ਕੂ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Deep within, there is ignorance, suffering and doubt; through the spiritual wisdom ofthe Guru, they are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: antar agi-aan d ukh bharam hai gur gi-aan gavaa-ee.

lines.english: He alone meditates on the Naam, whom You unite with Yourself, in Your Mercy.
lines.transliteration: jis kirpaa karahi tis mayl laihi so naam Dh i-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Creator, the Inaccessible Primal Lord God; You are all-pervading everywhere.
lines.transliteration: too kart aa purakh  agamm hai ravi-aa sabh  thaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: To whatever You link the mortal, O True Lord, to that he is linked. Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises. ||28||1|| Sudh|| pMnw 1292 rwgu mlwr bwxI Bgq nwmdyv jIau kI  (1292-1) raag malaar banee bh agat naamd ayv jee-o kee Raag Malaar, The Word Of The Devotee Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1292-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jit too laa-ihi sachi-aa t it ko lagai naanak gun  gaa-ee. ||28||1|| suDh .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਨਾਮਦੇਵ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੀ ॥
lines.english: Serve the King, the Sovereign Lord of the World. He has no ancestry; He isimmaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: sayveelay gopaal raa-ay akul niranjan.

lines.english: Please bless me with the gift of devotion, which the humble Saints beg for.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  daan d eejai jaacheh sant  jan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: His Home is the pavilion seen in all directions; His ornamental heavenly realms fill theseven worlds alike.
lines.transliteration: nwmdyv jI) jaaN chai ghar d ig disai saraa-ichaa baikunth  bhavan chit arsaalaa sapat  lok saamaan pooree-alay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Bgq nwmdyv jI) jaaN chai ghar lachh imee ku-aaree chand  sooraj d eevrh ay ka-ut ak kaal bapurh aa kotvaal so karaa siree. In His Home, the virgin Lakshmi dwells. The moon and the sun are His two lamps; thewretched Messenger of Death stages his dramas, and levies taxes on all.
Such is my Sovereign Lord King, the Supreme Lord of all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so aisaa raajaa saree narharee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਚੈ ਘਿਰ ਿਦਗ  ਿਦਸੈ ਸਰਾਇਚਾ  ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਭਵਨ  ਿਚਤਰ੍ਸਾਲਾ  ਸਪਤ  ਲੋਕ ਸਾਮਾਿਨ  ਪੂਰੀਅਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: In His House, the four-faced Brahma, the cosmic potter lives. He created the entire universe.
lines.transliteration: jaaN chai ghar kulaal barahmaa chat ur mukh  daaNvrhaa jin bisav sansaar raacheelay.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਚੈ ਘਿਰ  ਲਿਛਮੀ  ਕੁਆਰੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਦੀਵੜੇ  ਕਉਤਕੁ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਬਪੁੜਾ  ਕੋਟਵਾਲੁ  ਸੁ ਕਰਾ ਿਸਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: In His House, the insane Shiva, the Guru of the World, lives; he imparts spiritualwisdom to expain the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: jaaN kai ghar eesar baavlaa jagat  guroo t at saarkh aa gi-aan bh aakheelay.

lines.english: Sin and virtue are the standard-bearers at His Door; Chitr and Gupt are the recordingangels of the conscious and subconscious.
lines.transliteration: paap punn jaaN chai daaNgee-aa du-aarai chit ar gupat  laykh ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਚੈ ਘਿਰ  ਕੁਲਾਲੁ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਮੁਖੁ ਡਵੜਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਬਸ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰਾਚੀਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay parulee part ihaar. The Righteous Judge of Dharma, the Lord of Destruction, is the door-man.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਈਸਰੁ ਬਾਵਲਾ  ਜਗਤ  ਗੁਰੂ ਤਤ ਸਾਰਖਾ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਭਾਖੀਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the Supreme Sovereign Lord of the World. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so aisaa raajaa saree gopaal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਜ ਚੈ ਡਗੀਆ  ਦੁਆਰੈ  ਿਚਤਰ੍  ਗੁਪਤੁ  ਲੇਖੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: In His Home are the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, Rishis and poor minstrels,who sing so sweetly.
lines.transliteration: jaaN chai ghar gan  ganDh arab rikh ee bapurh ay dh aadhee-aa gavant  aachh ai.

lines.english: All the Shaastras take various forms in His theater, singing beautiful songs.
lines.transliteration: sarab saastar baho roopee-aa angaroo-aa aakh aarhaa mandleek bol boleh kaachh ay.

lines.english: The wind waves the fly-brush over Him;
lines.transliteration: cha-ur dhool jaaN chai hai pavan .

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਚੈ ਘਿਰ  ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਿਰਖੀ  ਬਪੁੜੇ  ਢਾਢੀਆ  ਗਾਵੰਤ ਆਛੈ  ॥
lines.english: His hand-maiden is Maya, who has conquered the world.
lines.transliteration: chayree sakat jeet  lay bh avan.

lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord are said to be exalted in this world; meeting with them, even stones are softened. pMnw 1295
lines.transliteration: har kay jan ootam jag kahee-ahi jin mili-aa paathar sayn.

lines.english: I cannot even describe the noble grandeur of such humble beings; the Lord, Har, Har, has made them sublime and exalted. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan kee mahimaa baran na saaka-o o-ay ootam har har kayn. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਹਮਾ  ਬਰਿਨ  ਨ ਸਾਕਉ  ਓਇ ਊਤਮ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਨ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You, Lord are the Great Merchant-Banker; O God, my Lord and Master, I am just apoor peddler; please bless me with the wealth.
lines.transliteration: tumH har saah vaday parabh  su-aamee ham van jaaray raas d ayn.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਦੇਨ ॥
lines.english: Please bestow Your Kindness and Mercy upon servant Nanak, God, so that he mayload up the merchandise of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1295-3) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o da-i-aa parabh  Dhaarahu lad  vaakh ar har har layn. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਦਇਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਲਿਦ  ਵਾਖਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਲੇਨ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and be enlightened.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam pargaas.

lines.english: Meet with the Saints of the Lord, and focus your love; remain balanced and detachedwithin your own household. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kay sant mil pareet  lagaanee vichay girah ud aas. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I chant the Name of the Lord, Nar-Har, within my heart; God the Merciful has shownHis Mercy.
lines.transliteration: ham har hirdai japi-o naam narhar parabh  kirpaa karee kirpaas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਮਿਲ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਨੀ  ਿਵਚੇ ਿਗਰਹ  ਉਦਾਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, I am in ecstasy; my mind has blossomed forth, rejuvenated. I am trying - I hope to meet my Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an-din anad  bha-i-aa man bigsi-aa ud am bh a-ay milan kee aas. ||1||

lines.english: I am in love with the Lord, my Lord and Master; I love Him with every breath andmorsel of food I take.
lines.transliteration: ham har su-aamee pareet lagaa-ee jit nay saas lee-ay ham garaas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਜਿਪਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਿਕਰਪਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: My sins were burnt away in an instant; the noose of the bondage of Maya wasloosened. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh d ahan bh a-ay kh in ant ar toot ga-ay maa-i-aa kay faas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਿਬਗਿਸਆ  ਉਦਮ  ਭਏ ਿਮਲਨ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am such a worm! What karma am I creating? What can I do? I am a fool, a totalidiot, but God has saved me.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ham kiram ki-aa karam kamaaveh moorakh mugaDh  rakhay parabh  taas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ ਲਗਾਈ  ਿਜਤਨੇ  ਸਾਸ ਲੀਏ ਹਮ ਗਰ੍ਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: I am unworthy, heavy as stone, but joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, Iam carried across to the other side. ||3||
lines.transliteration: avganee-aaray paathar bhaaray sat sangat  mil taray t araas. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਦਹਨ  ਭਏ ਿਖਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤੂਿਟ ਗਏ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਫਾਸ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Universe which God created is all above me; I am the lowest, engrossed incorruption.
lines.transliteration: jaytee sarisat karee jagd eesar t ay sabh  ooch ham neech bikh i-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹਮ ਿਕਰਮ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਿਹ  ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ  ਰਖੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤਾਸ ॥
lines.english: With the Guru, my faults and demerits have been erased. Servant Nanak has beenunited with God Himself. ||4||3|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1295-9) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hamray avgun sang gur maytay jan naanak mayl lee-ay parabh paas. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗਨੀਆਰੇ  ਪਾਥਰ  ਭਾਰੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਤਰੇ ਤਰਾਸ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, through the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man raam naam japi-o gur vaak.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਤੀ  ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਿਰ  ਤੇ ਸਿਭ ਊਚ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਿਬਿਖਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: 4) har har kirpaa karee jagdeesar d urmat  doojaa bh aa-o ga-i-o sabh  jhaak. ||1|| rahaa- o. The Lord, Har, Har, has shown me His Mercy, and my evil-mindedness, love of dualityand sense of alienation are totally gone, thanks to the Lord of the Universe.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਅਵਗੁਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਗੁਰ ਮੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲੀਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: There are so many forms and colors of the Lord. The Lord is pervading each andevery heart, and yet He is hidden from view.
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop rang har kayray ghat gh at raam ravi-o guplaak.

lines.english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, the Lord is revealed, and the doors of corruption areshattered. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har kay sant milay har pargatay ugh ar ga-ay bikh i-aa kay t aak. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪਓ  ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕ ॥
lines.english: The glory of the Saintly beings is absolutely great; they lovingly enshrine the Lord ofBliss and Delight within their hearts.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee bahut  baho sobh aa jin ur Dh aari-o har rasik rasaak.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਿਰ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਗਇਓ  ਸਭ ਝਾਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I meet with the Lord, just as when the calf is seen -the cow is there as well. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har kay sant milay har mili-aa jaisay ga-oo d aykh bachh raak. ||2||

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is within the humble Saints of the Lord; they are exalted - theyknow, and they inspire others to know as well.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant janaa meh har har t ay jan oot am janak janaak.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਹਿਰ ਕੇਰੇ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਵਓ  ਗੁਪਲਾਕ  ॥
lines.english: The fragrance of the Lord permeates their hearts; they have abandoned the foul stench. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tin har hird ai baas basaanee chh oot ga-ee muskee muskaak. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਮਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੇ  ਉਘਿਰ  ਗਏ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕੇ ਤਾਕ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You make those humble beings Your Own, God; You protect Your Own, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: tumray jan t umH hee parabh  kee-ay har raakh  layho aapan apnaak.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਿਜਨ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸਕ ਰਸਾਕ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is servant Nanak's companion; the Lord is his sibling, mother, father, relativeand relation. ||4||4|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1295-16) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay sakhaa har bh aa-ee maat  pitaa banDh ap har saak. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਮਲੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਜੈਸੇ ਗਊ ਦੇਿਖ ਬਛਰਾਕ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O my mind, consciously chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: mayray man har har raam naam jap cheet.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ  ਜਨਕ  ਜਨਾਕ  ॥
lines.english: The commodity of the Lord, Har, Har, is locked in the fortress of Maya; through theWord of the Guru's Shabad, I have conquered the fortress. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har vasat maa-i-aa garh eh vayrhHee gur kai sabad  lee-o garh  jeet. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਾਨੀ  ਛੂਿਟ ਗਈ ਮੁਸਕੀ  ਮੁਸਕਾਕ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: In false doubt and superstition, people wander all around, lured by love and emotionalattachment to their children and families.
lines.transliteration: mithi-aa bharam bh aram baho bh armi-aa lubDh o putar kalt ar moh pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀਏ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ  ਅਪਨਾਕ  ॥
lines.english: But just like the passing shade of the tree, your body-wall shall crumble in an instant.||1||
lines.transliteration: jaisay tarvar kee t uchh chhaa-i-aa kh in meh binas jaa-ay d ayh bh eet. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਈ  ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਬੰਧਪ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਕ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The humble beings are exalted; they are my breath of life and my beloveds; meeting them, my mind is filled with faith.
lines.transliteration: hamray paraan pareetam jan oot am jin mili-aa man ho-ay part eet.

lines.english: Deep within the heart, I am happy with the Pervading Lord; with love and joy, I dwell upon the Steady and Stable Lord. ||2|| pMnw 1296
lines.transliteration: parchai raam ravi-aa ghat ant ar asthir raam ravi-aa rang pareet . ||2||

lines.english: The humble Saints, the Saints of the Lord, are noble and sublime; meeting them, the mind is tinged with love and joy.
lines.transliteration: har kay sant sant  jan neekay jin mili-aaN man rang rangeet .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ  ਿਜਨ ਿਮਿਲਆਂ  ਮਨੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Love never fades away, and it never wears off. Through the Lord's Love,one goes and meets the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har rang lahai na utrai kabhoo har har jaa-ay milai har pareet . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਕਬਹੂ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sinner; I have committed so many sins. The Guru has cut them, cut them, andhacked them off.
lines.transliteration: ham baho paap kee-ay apraaDhee gur kaatay katit  kateet .

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਗੁਿਰ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਿਟਤ  ਕਟੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has placed the healing remedy of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, into mymouth. Servant Nanak, the sinner, has been purified and sanctified. ||4||5|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1296-4) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har naam dee-o mukh  a-ukh aDh jan naanak pat it puneet . ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ  ਮੁਿਖ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਿਤ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: Chant, O my mind, the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam jagannaath.

lines.english: I was caught in the whirlpool of poisonous sin and corruption. The True Guru gave me His Hand; He lifted me up and pulled me out. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghooman gh ayr paray bikh  bikhi-aa sat gur kaadh  lee-ay d ay haath. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O my Fearless, Immaculate Lord and Master, please save me - I am a sinner, asinking stone.
lines.transliteration: su-aamee abhai niranjan narhar t umH raakh  layho ham paapee paath.

lines.punjabi: ਘੂਮਨ  ਘੇਰ ਪਰੇ ਿਬਖੁ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਲੀਏ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am lured and enticed by sexual desire, anger, greed and corruption, but associatingwith You, I am carried across, like iron in the wooden boat. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh bikh i-aa lobh  lubh-tay kaasat loh t aray sang saath. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Great Primal Being, the most Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord God; Isearch for You, but cannot find Your depth.
lines.transliteration: tumH vad purakh  bad agam agochar ham dh oodh rahay paa-ee nahee haath.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਅਭੈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਨਰਹਿਰ  ਤੁਮ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਪਾਥ ॥
lines.english: You are the farthest of the far, beyond the beyond, O my Lord and Master; You aloneknow Yourself, O Lord of the Universe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too parai parai aprampar su-aamee t oo aapan jaaneh aap jagannaath. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਿਬਿਖਆ ਲੋਿਭ ਲੁਭਤੇ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਲੋਹ ਤਰੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Name of the Unseen and Unfathomable Lord; joining the SatSangat, the True Congregation, I have found the Path of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: adrist agochar naam Dh i-aa-ay sat sangat  mil saaDh oo paath.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ  ਬਡ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਹਮ ਢੂਿਢ  ਰਹੇ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Joining the congregation, I listen to the Gospel of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate onthe Lord, Har, Har, and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa sunee mil sangat har har japi-o akath kath kaath. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੂ ਆਪਨ  ਜਾਨਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ਜਗੰਨਾਥ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My God is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe; please save me, O Lord ofall Creation.
lines.transliteration: hamray parabh jagd ees gusaa-ee ham raakh  layho jagannaath.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਏ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the slave of Your slaves. O God, please bless me with Your Grace; please protect me and keep me with Your humble servants. ||4||6|| kwnVw mhlw 4 pVqwl Gru 5 ] (1296-11) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4 parh -taal gh ar 5. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1296-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak daas d aas d aasan ko parabh  karahu kirpaa raakh o jan saath. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨੀ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥ ਕਾਥ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: man jaapahu raam gupaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਗੁਸਾਈ  ਹਮ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Jewel, the Diamond, the Ruby.
lines.transliteration: har ratan javayhar laal.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ  ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਜਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: The Lord fashions the Gurmukhs in His Mint.
lines.transliteration: har gurmukh gh arh taksaal.

lines.english: O Lord, please, please, be Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har ho ho kirpaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your Glorious Virtues are inaccessible and unfathomable; how can my one poortongue describe them? O my Beloved Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: tumray gun agam agochar ayk jeeh ki-aa kathai bichaaree raam raam raam raam laal.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, You, You, You alone know Your Unspoken Speech. I have becomeenraptured, enraptured, enraptured, meditating on the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kwnVw, mÚ 4) tumree jee akath kathaa t oo too too hee jaaneh ha-o har jap bh a-ee nihaal nihaal nihaal. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is my Companion and my Breath of Life; the Lord is my Best Friend. My mind, body and tongue are attuned to the Lord, Har, Haray,Haray. The Lord is my Wealth and Property. jw ko Bwgu iqin lIE rI suhwgu hir hir hry hry gun gwvY gurmiq hau bil bly hau bil bly jn
lines.transliteration: kwnVw, mÚ 4) hamray har paraan sakhaa su-aamee har meet aa mayray man t an jeeh har haray haray raam naam Dhan maal.

lines.english: She alone obtains her Husband Lord, who is so pre-destined. Through the Guru's Teachings, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray, Haray. I am asacrifice, a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord, O servant Nanak.Meditating on the Lord, I have become enraptured, enraptured, enraptured.||2||1||7|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1296-16) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jaa ko bhaag t in lee-o ree suhaag har har haray haray gun gaavai gurmat  ha-o bal balay ha-o bal balay jan naanak har jap bha-ee nihaal nihaal nihaal. ||2||1||7||

lines.english: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavhu jagdees.

lines.english: Let my one tongue become two hundred thousand
lines.transliteration: aykaa jeeh keechai lakh bees.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਗੁਨ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਿਕਆ  ਕਥੈ ਿਬਚਾਰੀ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਲਾਲ  ॥

lines.english: Beg for such blessings from the Lord of the Universe:
lines.transliteration: aisee maaNg gobid t ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਕਰਮ  ਕਿਰ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
lines.english: Name of the Lord, the supreme status is obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tahal santan kee sang saaDh oo kaa har naamaaN jap param gat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. to work for the Saints, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Chanting the

lines.english: Worship the Feet of Your Lord and Master, and seek His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: poojaa charnaa thaakur sarnaa.

lines.english: Take joy in whatever God does. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so-ee kusal jo parabh jee-o karnaa. ||1||

lines.english: This precious human body becomes fruitful, pMnw 1299
lines.transliteration: safal hot ih d urlabh  dayhee.
jaa ka-o satgur ma-i-aa karayhee. ||2|| when the True Guru shows His Kindness. ||2||

lines.english: The house of ignorance, doubt and pain is destroyed,
lines.transliteration: agi-aan bharam binsai d ukh dayraa.
jaa kai hirdai baseh gur pairaa. ||3|| for those within whose hearts the Guru's Feet abide. ||3||

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, lovingly meditate on God.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang rang parabh  Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, you shall obtain the Perfect Lord. ||4||4|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1299-3) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tin pooraa paa-i-aa. ||4||4||

lines.english: Devotion is the natural quality of God's devotees.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhagtan hooN ban aa-ee.

lines.english: Their bodies and minds are blended with their Lord and Master; He unites them with Himself. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan man galat  bha-ay th aakur si-o aapan lee-ay milaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The singer sings the songs,
lines.transliteration: gaavanhaaree gaavai geet.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ  ਭਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਆਪਨ  ਲੀਏ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tay uDh ray basay jih cheet . ||1|| but she alone is saved, within whose consciousness the Lord abides. ||1||

lines.english: The one who sets the table sees the food,
lines.transliteration: paykhay binjan parosanhaarai.
jih bhojan keeno t ay tariptaarai. ||2|| but only one who eats the food is satisfied. ||2||

lines.english: People disguise themselves with all sorts of costumes,
lines.transliteration: anik savaaNg kaachhay bh aykh-Dhaaree.
jaiso saa taiso d aristaaree. ||3|| but in the end, they are seen as they truly are. ||3||

lines.english: Speaking and talking are all just entanglements.
lines.transliteration: kahan kahaavan sagal janjaar.

lines.english: O slave Nanak, the true way of life is excellent. ||4||5|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1299-6) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sach karn ee saar. ||4||5||

lines.english: Your humble servant listens to Your Praises with delight. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayro jan har jas sunat  umaahi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My mind is enlightened, gazing upon the Glory of God. Wherever I look, there He is. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maneh pargaas paykh parabh  kee sobh aa jat  kat paykh a-o aahi-o. ||1||

lines.english: You are the farthest of all, the highest of the far, profound, unfathomable andunreachable. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh t ay parai parai t ay oochaa gahir gambh eer athaahi-o. ||2||

lines.english: You are united with Your devotees, through and through; You have removed Your veilfor Your humble servants. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ot pot  mili-o bh agtan ka-o jan si-o pard aa laahi-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ  ਉਮਾਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; he is intuitively absorbed inSamaadhi. ||4||6|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1299-10) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad gaavai gun  naanak sahj samaaDh  samaahi-o. ||4||6||

lines.english: I have come to the Saints to save myself. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: santan peh aap uDh aaran aa-i-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਪੇਿਖ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਆਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I am sanctified; they have implantedthe Mantra of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytat hot puneet aa har har mant ar darirh-aa-i-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ  ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਅਥਾਿਹਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The disease has been eradicated, and my mind has become immaculate. I have takenthe healing medicine of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaatay rog bha-ay man nirmal har har a-ukh aDh khaa-i-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਉ ਜਨ ਿਸਉ ਪਰਦਾ  ਲਾਿਹਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I have become steady and stable, and I dwell in the home of peace. I shall never again wander anywhere. ||3||
lines.transliteration: asthit bh a-ay basay sukh  thaanaa bahur na kat hoo Dh aa-i-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਸਮਾਿਹਓ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, the people and all their generations are saved; O Nanak,they are not engrossed in Maya. ||4||7|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1299-13) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  taray kul logaa naanak lipat  na maa-i-o. ||4||7||

lines.english: I have totally forgotten my jealousy of others,
lines.transliteration: bisar ga-ee sabh t aat paraa-ee.
jab tay saaDh sangat  mohi paa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. since I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: No one is my enemy, and no one is a stranger. I get along with everyone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naa ko bairee nahee bigaanaa sagal sang ham ka-o ban aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਨ  ਭੇਟਤ  ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever God does, I accept that as good. This is the sublime wisdom I haveobtained from the Holy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jo parabh keeno so bh al maani-o ayh sumat  saaDh oo tay paa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਉਖਧੁ  ਖਾਇਓ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One God is pervading in all. Gazing upon Him, beholding Him, Nanak blossomsforth in happiness. ||3||8|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1299-16) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh meh rav rahi-aa parabh  aykai paykh  paykh  naanak bigsaa-ee. ||3||8||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਤ  ਭਏ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨਾ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my Dear Lord and Master, You alone are my Support.
lines.transliteration: thaakur jee-o t uhaaro parnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਲੋਗਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਲਪਤ  ਨ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: You are my Honor and Glory; I seek Your Support, and Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maan mahat t umHaarai oopar t umHree ot t umHaaree sarnaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are my Hope, and You are my Faith. I take Your Name and enshrine it within my heart.
lines.transliteration: tumHree aas bh arosaa t umHraa tumraa naam rid ai lai Dh arnaa.

lines.english: You are my Power; associating with You, I am embellished and exalted. I do whateverYou say. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tumro bal t um sang suhaylay jo jo kahhu so-ee so-ee karnaa. ||1||

lines.english: Through Your Kindness and Compassion, I find peace; when You are Merciful, I crossover the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: tumree d a-i-aa ma-i-aa sukh  paava-o hohu kirpaal t a bha-ojal t arnaa.

lines.english: Through the Name of the Lord, I obtain the gift of fearlessness; Nanak places hishead on the feet of the Saints. ||2||9|| pMnw 1300 kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1300-1) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: abhai d aan naam har paa-i-o sir d aari-o naanak sant  charnaa. ||2||9||

lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, I focus my consciousness on the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: saaDh saran charan chit  laa-i-aa.

lines.english: When I was dreaming, I heard and saw only dream-objects. The True Guru hasimplanted the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: supan kee baat sunee paykh ee supnaa naam mant ar sat guroo drirh -aa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨ  ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Power, youth and wealth do not bring satisfaction; people chase after them again andagain.
lines.transliteration: nah taript aano raaj joban Dh an bahur bahur fir Dh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have found peace and tranquility, and all my thirsty desires have been quenched, singing His Glorious Praises. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sukh paa-i-aa t arisnaa sabh  bujhee hai saaNt paa-ee gun gaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਨੋ  ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਧਿਨ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਿਫਿਰ  ਧਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without understanding, they are like beasts, engrossed in doubt, emotionalattachment and Maya.
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay pasoo kee ni-aa-ee bh aram mohi bi-aapi-o maa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਸਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: But in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the noose of Death is cut, ONanak, and one intuitively merges in celestial peace. ||2||10|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1300-5) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jam jayvree kaatee naanak sahj samaa-i-aa. ||2||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੂ ਕੀ ਿਨਆਈ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਮੋਿਹ ਿਬਆਿਪਓ  ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Sing of the Lord's Feet within your heart.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan hirdai gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰੀ  ਕਾਟੀ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Meditate, meditate in constant remembrance on God, the Embodiment of soothingpeace and cooling tranquility. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: seetlaa sukh  saaNt moorat  simar simar nit  Dhi-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All your hopes shall be fulfilled, and the pain of millions of deaths and births shall be gone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sagal aas hot pooran kot janam d ukh jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Immerse yourself in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall obtainthe benefits of giving charitable gifts, and all sorts of good deeds.
lines.transliteration: punn daan anayk kiri-aa saaDh oo sang samaa-ay.

lines.english: Sorrow and suffering shall be erased, O Nanak, and you shall never again bedevoured by death. ||2||11|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 3  (1300-8) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 3 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Third House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1300-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: taap sant aap mitay naanak baahurh  kaal na kh aa-ay. ||2||11||

lines.english: Speak of God's Wisdom in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: kathee-ai satsang parabh  gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਆਸ  ਹੋਤ ਪੂਰਨ  ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਮ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Supreme Divine Light, the TranscendentLord God, honor and glory are obtained. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooran param jot parmaysur simrat  paa-ee-ai maan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ  ਅਨੇਕ ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: One's comings and goings in reincarnation cease, and suffering is dispelled,meditating in remembrance in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  rahay saram naasay simrat  saaDh oo sang.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ  ਿਮਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਾਹੁਿੜ ਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Sinners are sanctified in an instant, in the love of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: patit puneet  hohi kh in bheetar paarbarahm kai rang. ||1||

lines.english: Whoever speaks and listens to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is rid of evil- mindedness.
lines.transliteration: jo jo kathai sunai har keertan t aa kee d urmat  naas.

lines.english: All hopes and desires, O Nanak, are fulfilled. ||2||1||12|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1300-12) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath paavai naanak pooran hovai aas. ||2||1||12||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮ  ਜੋਿਤ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is found in the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  niDh har ko naam.

lines.english: It is the Companion of the soul, its Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sang sahaa-ee jee-a kai kaam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਰਹੇ ਸਰ੍ਮ ਨਾਸੇ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Continually bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints,
lines.transliteration: sant rayn nit  majan karai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਹੋਿਹ ਿਖਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay kilbikh harai. ||1|| the sins of countless incarnations are washed away. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਥੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਸ ॥
lines.english: The words of the humble Saints are lofty and exalted.
lines.transliteration: sant janaa kee oochee baanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, mortal beings are carried acrossand saved. ||2||2||13|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1300-14) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simar simar taray naanak paraanee. ||2||2||13||

lines.english: O Holy people, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Haray.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo har haray gun gaa-ay.

lines.english: Mind, body, wealth and the breath of life - all come from God; remembering Him in meditation, pain is taken away. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: maan tan Dh an paraan parabh  kay simrat  dukh jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Why are you entangled in this and that? Let your mind be attuned to the One. ||1||
lines.transliteration: eet oot  kahaa lobh aaveh ayk si-o man laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The place of the Saints is utterly sacred; meet with them, and meditate on the Lord ofthe Universe. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mahaa pavitar sant  aasan mil sang gobid  Dhi-aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: O Nanak, I have abandoned everything and come to Your Sanctuary. Please let memerge with You. ||3||3||14|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1300-17) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag saran aa-i-o naanak layho milaa-ay. ||3||3||14||

lines.english: Gazing upon and beholding my Best Friend, I blossom forth in bliss; my God is theOne and Only. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paykh paykh  bigsaa-o saajan parabh  aapnaa ikaaNt. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is the Image of Ecstasy, Intuitive Peace and Poise. There is no other like Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aandaa sukh  sahj moorat  tis aan naahee bh aaNt. ||1||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, even once, millions of sins are erased. ||2|| pMnw 1301
lines.transliteration: simrat ik baar har har mit kot kasmal jaaNt. ||2||

lines.english: Uttering His Glorious Praises, suffering is  eradicated, and the heart becomes tranquil and calm. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gun ramant  dookh naaseh rid  bha-i-ant  saaNt. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ  ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਿਹ  ਿਰਦ ਭਇਅੰਤ  ਸਿਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Drink in the Sweet, Sublime Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, and be imbued with the Loveof the Lord. ||4||4||15|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1301-2) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: amritaa ras pee-o rasnaa naanak har rang raat . ||4||4||15||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.english: O friends, O Saints, come to me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saajnaa sant aa-o mayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with pleasure and joy, the sins will be erasedand thrown away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aandaa gun gaa-ay mangal kasmalaa mit jaahi parayrai. ||1||

lines.english: Touch your forehead to the feet of the Saints, and your dark household shall beillumined. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sant charan Dh ara-o maathai chaaNdnaa garihi ho-ay anDh ayrai. ||2||

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. Vibrate and meditate onthe Lord of the Universe, and see Him near at hand. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  kamal bigsai gobind  bhaja-o paykh  nayrai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਨਦਾ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਕਸਮਲਾ  ਿਮਿਟ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਪਰੇਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By the Grace of God, I have found the Saints. Over and over again, Nanak is a sacrifice to that moment. ||4||5||16|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1301-5) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabh kirpaa t ay sant  paa-ay vaar vaar naanak uh bayrai. ||4||5||16||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ  ਧਰਉ  ਮਾਥੈ ਚਦਨਾ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਹੋਇ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: charan saran gopaal tayree.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਬਗਸੈ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਭਜਉ  ਪੇਿਖ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Save me from emotional attachment, pride, deception and doubt; please cut awaythese ropes which bind me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: moh maan Dhoh bh aram raakh  leejai kaat bayree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਏ ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਉਹ ਬੇਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
lines.english: I am drowning in the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: boodat sansaar saagar.

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Source of Jewels, I am saved. ||1||
lines.transliteration: uDhray har simar rat naagar. ||1||

lines.english: Your Name, Lord, is cooling and soothing.
lines.transliteration: seetlaa har naam t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਧੋਹ ਭਰਮ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੀਜੈ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God, my Lord and Master, is Perfect. ||2||
lines.transliteration: poorno thaakur parabh  mayraa. ||2||

lines.english: You are the Deliverer, the Destroyer of the sufferings of the meek and the poor.
lines.transliteration: deen d arad nivaar t aaran.

lines.english: The Lord is the Treasure of Mercy, the Saving Grace of sinners. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa niDh pat it uDhaaran. ||3||

lines.english: I have suffered the pains of millions of incarnations.
lines.transliteration: kot janam dookh  kar paa-i-o.

lines.english: Nanak is at peace; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||4||6||17|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1301-9) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sukhee naanak gur naam d arirh-aa-i-o. ||4||6||17||

lines.english: Dhan uh pareet  charan sang laagee. Blessed is that love, which is attuned to the Lord's Feet.
The peace which comes from millions of chants and deep meditations is obtained byperfect good fortune and destiny. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kot jaap taap sukh  paa-ay aa-ay milay pooran badbh aagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I am Your helpless servant and slave; I have given up all other support.
lines.transliteration: mohi anaath daas jan t ayraa avar ot saglee mohi t i-aagee.

lines.english: Every trace of doubt has been eradicated, remembering God in meditation. I haveapplied the ointment of spiritual wisdom, and awakened from my sleep. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhor bh aram kaatay parabh  simrat  gi-aan anjan mil sovat  jaagee. ||1||

lines.english: You are Unfathomably Great and Utterly Vast, O my Lord and Master, Ocean of Mercy,Source of Jewels.
lines.transliteration: too athaahu at  bado su-aamee kirpaa sinDh  pooran rat naagee.

lines.english: ||2||7||18|| Nanak, the beggar, begs for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he rests his foreheadupon God's Feet. ||2||7||18|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1301-13) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachak har har naam maaNgai mastak aan Dh ari-o parabh  paagee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਨ ਉਹ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਚਰਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am filthy, hard-hearted, deceitful and obsessed with sexual desire.
lines.transliteration: kuchil kathor kapat kaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੇ ਪੂਰਨ  ਬਡਭਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please carry me across, as You wish, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o jaaneh ti-o t aar su-aamee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You are All-powerful and Potent to grant Sanctuary. Exerting Your Power, You protectus. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too samrath saran jog t oo raakh ahi apnee kal Dh aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਅਨਾਥੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਵਰ  ਓਟ ਸਗਲੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਿਤਆਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting and deep meditation, penance and austere self-discipline, fasting andpurification - salvation does not come by any of these means.
lines.transliteration: jaap taap naym such sanjam naahee in biDh ay chh utkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਭੋਰ ਭਰਮ  ਕਾਟੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਜਨ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੋਵਤ  ਜਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please lift me up and out of this deep, dark ditch; O God, please bless Nanak withYour Glance of Grace. ||2||8||19|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 4  (1301-16) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 4 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1301-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: garat gh or anDh  tay kaadh ahu parabh  naanak nad ar nihaar. ||2||8||19||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਿਤ  ਬਡੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਸੰਧੁ ਪੂਰਨ  ਰਤਨਾਗੀ  ॥
lines.english: The one who bows in humble reverence to the Primal Lord, the Lord of all beings
lines.transliteration: naaraa-in narpat namaskaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਾਚਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਗੈ  ਮਸਤਕੁ  ਆਿਨ  ਧਿਰਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਗੀ  ॥੨॥੭॥੧੮॥
lines.english: - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to such a Guru; He Himself is liberated, and He carries me across as well. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aisay gur ka-o bal bal jaa-ee-ai aap mukat mohi t aarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Which, which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I chant? There is no end orlimitation to them.
lines.transliteration: kavan kavan kavan gun kahee-ai ant nahee kachh  paarai.

lines.english: There are thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, many millions of them, but those who contemplate them are very rare. ||1|| pMnw 1302
lines.transliteration: laakh laakh  laakh  ka-ee korai ko hai aiso beechaarai. ||1||

lines.english: I am wonder-struck, wonder-struck, wonder-struck and amazed, dyed in the deep crimson color of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: bisam bisam bisam hee bha-ee hai laal gulaal rangaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਮ  ਿਬਸਮ  ਿਬਸਮ  ਹੀ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਲ  ਗੁਲਾਲ  ਰੰਗਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the Saints savor this sublime essence, like the mute, who tastes thesweet candy, but only smiles. ||2||1||20|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1302-2) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak santan ras aa-ee hai ji-o chaakh  goongaa muskaarai. ||2||1||20||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਰਸੁ ਆਈ  ਹੈ ਿਜਉ ਚਾਿਖ  ਗੂੰਗਾ  ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ  ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The Saints do not know any other except God.
lines.transliteration: na jaanee santan parabh  bin aan.

lines.english: They look upon all equally, the high and the low; they speak of Him with their mouths, and honor Him in their minds. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ooch neech sabh paykh  samaano mukh  bakno man maan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is pervading and permeating each and every heart; He is the Ocean of Peace, theDestroyer of fear. He is my praanaa - the Breath of Life.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at poor rahay sukh  saagar bh ai bhanjan mayray paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਪੇਿਖ ਸਮਾਨੋ  ਮੁਿਖ ਬਕਨੋ  ਮਿਨ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind was enlightened, and my doubt was dispelled, when the Guru whispered HisMantra into my ears. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maneh pargaas bha-i-o bh aram naasi-o mant ar dee-o gur kaan. ||1||

lines.english: He is All-powerful, the Ocean of Mercy, the All-knowing Searcher of Hearts.
lines.transliteration: karat rahay kart aga-y karun aa mai ant arjaamee gi-yaan.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day Nanak sings His Praises, and begs for the Gift of the Lord.||2||2||21|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1302-6) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aath pahar naanak jas gaavai maaNgan ka-o har d aan. ||2||2||21||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਭਇਓ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਨਾਿਸਓ  ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਦੀਓ  ਗੁਰ ਕਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Many speak and talk about God.
lines.transliteration: kahan kahaavan ka-o ka-ee kaytai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਤ  ਰਹੇ ਕਰ੍ਤਗਯ੍ਯ੍  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਿਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਨ ॥
lines.english: But one who understands the essence of Yoga - such a humble servant is veryrare||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aiso jan birlo hai sayvak jo tat  jog ka-o bayt ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਮਗਨ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨ  ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
lines.english: He has no pain - he is totally at peace. With his eyes, he sees only the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: dukh naahee sabh  sukh  hee hai ray aykai aykee nayt ai.

lines.english: No one seems evil to him - all are good. There is no defeat - he is totally victorious. ||1||
lines.transliteration: buraa nahee sabh bh alaa hee hai ray haar nahee sabh  jaytai. ||1||

lines.english: He is never in sorrow - he is always happy; but he gives this up, and does not takeanything.
lines.transliteration: sog naahee sadaa harkh ee hai ray chh od naahee kichh  laytai.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਿਬਰਲੋ  ਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਜੋ ਤਤ ਜੋਗ ਕਉ ਬੇਤੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is himself the Lord, Har, Har; he does notcome and go in reincarnation. ||2||3||22|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1302-9) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak jan har har har hai kat aavai kat  ramt ai. ||2||3||22||

lines.english: I pray that my heart may never forget my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: hee-ay ko pareetam bisar na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਭੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੀ ਨੇਤੈ ॥
lines.english: My body and mind are blended with Him, but the Enticer, Maya, is enticing me, O mymother. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan man galat  bha-ay t ih sangay mohnee mohi rahee moree maa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਭਲਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਜੇਤੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those unto whom I tell my pain and frustration - they themselves are caught andstuck.
lines.transliteration: jai jai peh kaha-o baritha ha-o apunee tay-oo t ay-oo gahay rahay atkaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੀ  ਹੈ ਰੇ ਛੋਿਡ ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਲੇਤੈ ॥
lines.english: In all sorts of ways, Maya has cast the net; the knots cannot be loosened. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anik bhaaNt kee aykai jaalee t aa kee ganth  nahee chh oraa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹੈ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਰਮਤੈ  ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Wandering and roaming, slave Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Saints.
lines.transliteration: firat firat  naanak d aas aa-i-o sant an hee sarnaa-ay.

lines.english: The bonds of ignorance, doubt, emotional attachment and the love of Maya have been cut; God hugs me close in His Embrace. ||2||4||23|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1302-13) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaatay agi-aan bharam moh maa-i-aa lee-o kanth  lagaa-ay. ||2||4||23||

lines.english: My home is filled with ecstasy, pleasure and joy.
lines.transliteration: aanad rang binod  hamaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ  ਭਏ ਿਤਹ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੋਹਨੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਰਹੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I sing the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. The Naam is the Support of my breathof life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naamo gaavan naam Dhi-aavan naam hamaaray paraan aDh aarai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Naam is spiritual wisdom, the Naam is my purifying bath. The Naam resolves allmy affairs.
lines.transliteration: naamo gi-aan naam isnaanaa har naam hamaaray kaaraj savaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਪਿਹ ਕਹਉ  ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਹਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਤੇਊ ਤੇਊ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਟਕਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious grandeur; the Naam is gloriousgreatness. The Name of the Lord carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har naamo sobhaa naam badaa-ee bh a-ojal bikh am naam har t aarai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਿਤ  ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲੀ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗੰਿਠ  ਨਹੀ ਛੋਰਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Unfathomable Treasure, the Priceless Gem - I have received it, through theGuru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: agam padaarath laal amolaa bh a-i-o paraapat  gur charnaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਰਤ  ਿਫਰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਆਇਓ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਹੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, God has become Merciful; my heart is intoxicated by the Blessed Visionof His Darshan. ||2||5||24|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1302-17) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak parabh bh a-ay kirpaalaa magan bh a-ay hee-arai d arsaarai. ||2||5||24||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਟੇ ਅਿਗਆਨ  ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਲੀਓ  ਕੰਿਠ ਲਗਾਇ  ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
lines.english: My Friend, my Best Friend, my Lord and Master, is near.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet su-aamee nayro.

lines.english: He sees and hears everything; He is with everyone. You are here for such short time - why do you do evil? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: paykhat  sunat  sabh an kai sangay thorai kaaj buro kah fayro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Except for the Naam, whatever you are involved with is nothing - nothing is yours.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa jayto laptaa-i-o kachh oo nahee naahee kachh  tayro.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hereafter, everything is revealed to your gaze; but in this world, all are enticed by thedarkness of doubt. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aagai darisat aavat  sabh  pargat eehaa mohi-o bh aram anDh ayro. ||1||

lines.english: People are caught in Maya, attached to their children and spouses. They have forgotten the Great and Generous Giver. pMnw 1303
lines.transliteration: atki-o sut banit aa sang maa-i-aa d ayvanhaar d aataar bisayro.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have one article of faith; my Guru is the One who releases me from bondage. ||2||6||25|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1303-1) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak aykai bhaarosa-o banDh an kaatanhaar gur mayro. ||2||6||25||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਏਕੈ ਭਾਰੋਸਉ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Your Saints have overwhelmed the wicked army of corruption.
lines.transliteration: bikhai d al sant an tumHrai gaahi-o.

lines.english: They take Your Support and place their faith in You, O my Lord and Master; they seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tumree tayk bh arosaa th aakur saran t umHaaree aahi-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the terrible sins of countless lifetimesare erased.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay mahaa paraachhat  darsan bh ayt mitaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਟੇਕ ਭਰੋਸਾ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਤੁਮਾਰੀ  ਆਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am illumined, enlightened and filled with ecstasy. I am intuitively absorbed inSamaadhi. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bha-i-o pargaas anad  ujee-aaraa sahj samaaDh  samaahi-o. ||1||

lines.english: Who says that You cannot do everything? You are Infinitely All-powerful.
lines.transliteration: ka-un kahai tum t ay kachh  naahee t um samrath athaahi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਾਛਤ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਿਟ ਿਮਟਾਿਹਓ  ॥
lines.english: O Treasure of Mercy, Nanak savors Your Love and Your Blissful Form, earning theProfit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||26|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1303-5) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kirpaa niDhaan rang roop ras naam naanak lai laahi-o. ||2||7||26||

lines.punjabi: ਭਇਓ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ਅਨਦ  ਉਜੀਆਰਾ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਿਧ ਸਮਾਿਹਓ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The drowning mortal is comforted and consoled, meditating on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: boodat paraanee har jap Dh eerai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ  ਅਥਾਿਹਓ  ॥
lines.english: He is rid of emotional attachment, doubt, pain and suffering. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binsai moh bharam d ukh peerai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੈ ਲਾਿਹਓ  ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
lines.english: I meditate in remembrance, day and night, on the Guru's Feet.
lines.transliteration: simra-o din rain gur kay charnaa.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see Your Sanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jat kat  paykh a-o tumree sarnaa. ||1||

lines.english: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sant parsaad  har kay gun gaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has found peace. ||2||8||27|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1303-8) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gur bhaytat  naanak sukh  paa-i-aa. ||2||8||27||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, peace of mind is found.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam maneh sukh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Meeting the Holy Saint, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDh janaa mil har jas gaa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Granting His Grace, God has come to dwell within my heart.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh rid ai basayro.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan santan kai maathaa mayro. ||1||

lines.english: Meditate, O my mind, on the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm ka-o simrahu manaaN.

lines.english: As Gurmukh, Nanak listens to the Praises of the Lord. ||2||9||28|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1303-10) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak har jas sunaaN. ||2||9||28||

lines.english: My mind loves to touch the Feet of God.
lines.transliteration: mayray man pareet charan parabh  parsan.

lines.english: My tongue is satisfied with the Food of the Lord, Har, Har. My eyes are contented withthe Blessed Vision of God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: rasnaa har har bhojan t ariptaanee akh ee-an ka-o sant okh parabh  darsan. ||1|| rahaa- o.

lines.english: My ears are filled with the Praise of my Beloved; all my foul sins and faults are erased.
lines.transliteration: karnan poor rahi-o jas pareetam kalmal d okh sagal mal harsan.

lines.english: My feet follow the Path of Peace to my Lord and Master; my body and limbs joyfully blossom forth in the Society of the Saints. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paavan Dhaavan su-aamee sukh  panthaa ang sang kaa-i-aa sant  sarsan. ||1||

lines.english: I have taken Sanctuary in my Perfect, Eternal, Imperishable Lord. I do not bothertrying anything else.
lines.transliteration: saran gahee pooran abhinaasee aan upaav thakit  nahee karsan.

lines.english: Taking them by the hand, O Nanak, God saves His humble servants; they shall notperish in the deep, dark world-ocean. ||2||10||29|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1303-14) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar geh lee-ay naanak jan apnay anDh gh or saagar nahee marsan. ||2||10||29||

lines.english: Those fools who bellow with rage and destructive deceit, are crushed and killed innumerable times. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kuhkat kapat kh apat kh al garjat  marjat  meech anik baree-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Intoxicated with egotism and imbued with other tastes, I am in love with my evilenemies. My Beloved watches over me as I wander through thousands ofincarnations. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ahaN mat an rat  kumit  hit pareet am paykh at bharmat  laakh  garee-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਚਰਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰਸਨ  ॥
lines.english: My dealings are false, and my lifestyle is chaotic. Intoxicated with the wine ofemotion, I am burning in the fire of anger.
lines.transliteration: anit bi-uhaar achaar biDh  heenat  mam mad  maat  kop jaree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭੋਜਿਨ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਨੀ  ਅਖੀਅਨ  ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Merciful Lord of the World, Embodiment of Compassion, Relative of the meek andthe poor, please save Nanak; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||11||30|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1303-18) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karun kirpaal gopaal d een banDh  naanak uDh ar saran paree-aa. ||2||11||30||

lines.english: The Giver of the soul, the breath of life and honor
lines.transliteration: jee-a paraan maan daat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨਿਨ ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਜਸੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਕਲਮਲ  ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ  ਮਲ ਹਰਸਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har bisratay hee haan. ||1|| rahaa-o. - forgetting the Lord, all is lost. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਨ  ਧਾਵਨ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਇਆ  ਸੰਤ ਸਰਸਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You have forsaken the Lord of the Universe, and become attached to another - youare throwing away the Ambrosial Nectar, to take dust.
lines.transliteration: gobind t i-aag aan laageh amrit o daar bh oom paageh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਨ  ਗਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ  ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਆਨ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਥਿਕਤ  ਨਹੀ ਕਰਸਨ  ॥
lines.english: What do you expect from corrupt pleasures? You fool! What makes you think that they will bring peace? ||1|| pMnw 1304
lines.transliteration: bikhai ras si-o aaskat  moorh ay kaahay sukh  maan. ||1||

lines.english: Engrossed in unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and greed, you shall be consigned to reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  bi-aapi-o janam hee kee kh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਮ  ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਲੋਿਭ ਿਬਆਿਪਓ  ਜਨਮ  ਹੀ ਕੀ ਖਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: But I have entered the Sanctuary of the Purifier of sinners. O Nanak, I know that Ishall be saved. ||2||12||31|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1304-2) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: patit paavan saran aa-i-o uDh ar naanak jaan. ||2||12||31||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਆਇਓ  ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਿਨ  ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੧॥
lines.english: I gaze on the Lotus-like Face of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aviloka-o raam ko mukhaarbind .

lines.english: Searching and seeking, I have found the Jewel. I am totally rid of all anxiety.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khojat  khojat ratan paa-i-o bisree sabh  chind . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Enshrining His Lotus Feet within my heart,
lines.transliteration: charan kamal ridai Dh aar.
utri-aa d ukh mand . ||1|| pain and wickedness have been dispelled. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord of all the Universe is my kingdom, wealth and family.
lines.transliteration: raaj Dhan parvaar mayrai sarbaso gobind .

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has earned the Profit; he shall never die again. ||2||13||32|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 5  (1304-5) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 5 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1304-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangam laabh  paa-i-o naanak fir na marand . ||2||13||32||

lines.english: Worship God, and adore His Name.
lines.transliteration: parabh poojho naam araaDh .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੋ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: Grasp the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur charnee laag.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਮ  ਲਾਭੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਫਿਰ ਨ ਮਰੰਦ  ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੨॥
lines.english: The Unfathomable Lord shall come into your mind,
lines.transliteration: har paavhu man agaaDh.
jag jeeto ho ho gur kirpaaDh . ||1|| rahaa-o. and by Guru's Grace, you shall be victorious in this world. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: I have studied countless ways of worship in all sorts of ways, but that alone isworship, which is pleasing to the Lord's Will.
lines.transliteration: anik poojaa mai baho biDh kh ojee saa poojaa je har bh aavaas.

lines.english: This body-puppet is made of clay - what can it do by itself?
lines.transliteration: maatee kee ih putree joree ki-aa ayh karam kamaas.

lines.english: O God, those humble beings meet You, whom You grasp by the arm, and place on the Path. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh baah pakar jis maarag paavhu so t uDh jant milaas. ||1||

lines.english: I do not know of any other support; O Lord, You are my only Hope and Support.
lines.transliteration: avar ot mai ko-ay na soojhai ik har kee ot mai aas.

lines.english: I am meek and poor - what prayer can I offer?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa deen karay ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਪੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਖੋਜੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਿਜ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: God abides in every heart.
lines.transliteration: ja-o sabh gh at parabh oo nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਟੀ  ਕੀ ਇਹ ਪੁਤਰੀ  ਜੋਰੀ ਿਕਆ  ਏਹ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is thirsty for the Feet of God.
lines.transliteration: parabh charnan kee man pi-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਿਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੰਤ ਿਮਲਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak, Your slave, speaks: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice toYou. ||2||1||33|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 6  (1304-12) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 6 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1304-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak daas kahee-at  hai tumHraa ha-o bal bal sad  bal jaas. ||2||1||33||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਰ  ਓਟ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਕ ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Your Name, O my Beloved, is the Saving Grace of the world.
lines.transliteration: jagat uDh aaran naam pari-a t ayrai.

lines.english: The Lord's Name is the wealth of the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: nav niDh naam niDh aan har kayrai.

lines.english: One who is imbued with the Love of the Incomparably Beautiful Lord is joyful.
lines.transliteration: har rang rang rang anoopayrai.

lines.english: O mind, why do you cling to emotional attachments?
lines.transliteration: kaahay ray man mohi magnayrai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ  ਹੈ ਤੁਮਰਾ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੩॥
lines.english: With your eyes, gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: nainhu daykh  saaDh  darsayrai.

lines.english: They alone find it, who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so paavai jis likhat  lilayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I serve at the feet of the Holy Saints.
lines.transliteration: sayva-o saaDh sant  charnayrai.

lines.english: I long for the dust of their feet, which purifies and sanctifies.
lines.transliteration: baaNchha-o Dh oor pavit ar karayrai.

lines.english: Just like the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, it washes away filth andpollution.
lines.transliteration: athsath  majan mail katayrai.

lines.english: With each and every breath I meditate on Him, and never turn my face away.
lines.transliteration: saas saas Dhi-aavahu mukh  nahee morai.

lines.english: Of your thousands and millions, nothing shall go along with you.
lines.transliteration: kichh sang na chaalai laakh  karorai.

lines.english: Only the Name of God will call to you in the end. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh jee ko naam ant  pakrorai. ||1||

lines.english: Let it be your wish to honor and obey the One Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maan ayk nirankayrai.

lines.english: Abandon the love of everything else.
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aagahu bh aa-o d oojayrai.

lines.english: What Glorious Praises of Yours can I utter, O my Beloved?
lines.transliteration: kavan kahaaN ha-o gun pari-a tayrai.

lines.english: I cannot describe even one of Your Virtues.
lines.transliteration: baran na saaka-o ayk lutayrai.

lines.english: My mind is so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: darsan pi-aas bahut  man mayrai.

lines.english: Please come and meet Nanak, O Divine Guru of the World. ||2||1||34|| pMnw 1305 kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1305-1) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mil naanak dayv jagat  gur kayrai. ||2||1||34||

lines.english: How may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aisee ka-un biDhay d arsan parsanaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I hope and thirst for Your wish-fulfilling image; my heart yearns and longs for You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aas safal moorat umag hee-o t arsanaa. ||1||

lines.english: The meek and humble Saints are like thirsty fish; the Saints of the Lord are absorbedin Him.
lines.transliteration: deen leen pi-aas meen sant naa har sant naa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਸਫਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਉਮਿਗ  ਹੀਉ ਤਰਸਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am the dust of the feet of the Lord's Saints.
lines.transliteration: har santnaa kee rayn.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਲੀਨ  ਿਪਆਸ  ਮੀਨ ਸੰਤਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਤਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my heart to them.
lines.transliteration: hee-o arap dayn.

lines.english: God has become Merciful to me.
lines.transliteration: parabh bh a-ay hai kirpayn.

lines.english: Renouncing pride and leaving behind emotional attachment, O Nanak, one meets withthe Dear Lord. ||2||2||35|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1305-4) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: maan moh ti-aag chh odi-o t a-o naanak har jee-o bh aytnaa. ||2||2||35||

lines.english: The Playful Lord imbues all with the Color of His Love.
lines.transliteration: rangaa rang rangan kay rangaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਛੋਿਡਓ  ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਭੇਟਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
lines.english: From the ant to the elephant, He is permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: keet hasat pooran sabh  sangaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Some go on fasts, make vows, and take pilgrimages to sacred shrines on the Ganges.
lines.transliteration: barat naym t irath sahit  gangaa.

lines.english: They stand naked in the water, enduring hunger and poverty.
lines.transliteration: jal hayvat bh ookh ar nangaa.

lines.english: They sit cross-legged, perform worship services and do good deeds.
lines.transliteration: poojaachaar karat maylangaa.

lines.english: They apply religious symbols to their bodies, and ceremonial marks to their limbs.
lines.transliteration: chakar karam tilak kh aatangaa.

lines.english: They read through the Shaastras, but they do not join the Sat Sangat, the TrueCongregation. ||1||
lines.transliteration: darsan bh aytay bin sat sangaa. ||1||

lines.english: They stubbornly practice ritualistic postures, standing on their heads.
lines.transliteration: hath nigrahi at  rahat  bitangaa.

lines.english: They are afflicted with the disease of egotism, and their faults are not covered up.
lines.transliteration: ha-o rog bi-aapai chukai na bhangaa.

lines.english: They burn in the fire of sexual frustration, unresolved anger and compulsive desire.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh at  tarisan jarangaa.

lines.english: He alone is liberated, O Nanak, whose True Guru is Good. ||2||3||36|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 7  (1305-9) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 7 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1305-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: so mukat naanak jis sat gur changa. ||2||3||36||

lines.english: My thirst has been quenched, meeting with the Holy.
lines.transliteration: tikh boojh  ga-ee ga-ee mil saaDh  janaa.

lines.english: The five thieves have run away, and I am in peace and poise; singing, singing, singingthe Glorious Praises of the Lord, I obtain the Blessed Vision of my Beloved.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mÚ 5) panch bhaagay chor sehjay sukh aino haray gun gaavt ee gaavt ee gaavt ee daras pi- aar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That which God has done for me - how can I do that for Him in return?
lines.transliteration: jaisee karee parabh mo si-o mo si-o aisee ha-o kaisay kara-o.

lines.english: I make my heart a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sa crifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hee-o tumHaaray bal balay bal balay bal ga-ee. ||1||

lines.english: First, I fall at the feet of the Saints; I meditate, meditate, lovingly attuned to You.
lines.transliteration: pahilay pai sant paa-ay Dh i-aa-ay Dh i-aa-ay pareet  laa-ay.

lines.english: O God, where is that Place, where You contemplate all Your beings?
lines.transliteration: parabh thaan t ayro kayhro jit  jantan kar beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਭਾਗੇ  ਚੋਰ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸੁਖੈਨੋ  ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੀ  ਗਾਵਤੀ  ਗਾਵਤੀ ਦਰਸ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Countless slaves sing Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: anik daas keerat  karahi t uhaaree.

lines.english: He alone meets You, who is pleasing to Your Will. Servant Nanak remains absorbed in his Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: so-ee mili-o jo bhaavt o jan naanak th aakur rahi-o samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਰੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੋ ਿਸਉ ਮੋ ਿਸਉ ਐਸੀ  ਹਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਰਉ  ॥
lines.english: You, You, You alone, Lord. ||2||1||37|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 8  (1305-15) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 8 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1305-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ayk toohee t oohee t oohee. ||2||1||37||

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਉ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ਬਿਲ ਬਲੇ ਬਿਲ ਬਲੇ ਬਿਲ ਗਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Give up your pride and your self-conceit; the Loving, Merciful Lord is watching overall. O mind, become the dust of His Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ti-aagee-ai gumaan maan paykh -taa da-i-aal laal haaN haaN man charan rayn. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੇ  ਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਇ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਿਧਆਇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Mantra of the Lord's Saints, experience the spiritual wisdom andmeditation of the Lord of the World. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har sant mant  gupaal gi-aan Dh i-aan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੇਹਰੋ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਜੰਤਨ  ਕਿਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Within your heart, sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and be lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet. He is the Fascinating Lord, Merciful to the meek and thehumble.
lines.transliteration: hirdai gobind  gaa-ay charan kamal pareet  laa-ay d een d a-i-aal mohnaa.

lines.english: O Merciful Lord, please bless me with Your Kindness and Compassion.
lines.transliteration: kirpaal da-i-aa ma-i-aa Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak maagai naam daan.

lines.english: I have abandoned emotional attachment, doubt and all egotistical pride. ||2||1||38|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1305-19) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: taj moh bh aram sagal abh imaan. ||2||1||38||

lines.english: Speaking of God, filth and pollution are burnt away; This comes by meeting with the Guru, and not by any other efforts. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1306
lines.transliteration: parabh kahan malan d ahan lahan gur milay aan nahee upaa-o. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Making pilgrimages to sacred rivers, observing the six rituals, wearing matted and tangled hair, performing fire sacrifices and carrying ceremonial walking sticks - noneof these are of any use. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tatan kh atan jatan homan naahee dandDh aar su-aa-o. ||1||

lines.english: All sorts of efforts, austerities, wanderings and various speeches - none of these willlead you to find the Lord's Place.
lines.transliteration: jatan bh aaNtan tapan bh arman anik kathan katht ay nahee thaah paa-ee th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਟਨ  ਖਟਨ  ਜਟਨ  ਹੋਮਨ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਡੰਡਧਾਰ  ਸੁਆਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have considered all considerations, O Nanak, but peace comes only by vibrating and meditating on the Name. ||2||2||39|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 9  (1306-3) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 9 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1306-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: soDh sagar soDh naa sukh  naankaa bh aj naa-o. ||2||2||39||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ  ਭਤਨ  ਤਪਨ  ਭਰ੍ਮਨ  ਅਿਨਕ ਕਥਨ  ਕਥਤੇ  ਨਹੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ  ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear - He carries usacross to the other side. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: patit paavan bh agat bachh al bhai haran t aaran t aran. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਿਧ ਸਗਰ  ਸੋਧਨਾ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਭਜੁ ਨਾਉ  ॥੨॥੨॥੩੯॥
lines.english: My eyes are satisfied, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; my ears aresatisfied, hearing His Praise. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nain tipt ay daras paykh  jas tokh sunat  karan. ||1||

lines.english: He is the Master of the praanaa, the breath of life; He is the Giver of Support to theunsupported. I am meek and poor - I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: paraan naath anaath daat ay deen gobid  saran.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਬਛਲੁ  ਭੈ ਹਰਨ  ਤਾਰਨ  ਤਰਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is the Fulfiller of hope, the Destroyer of pain. Nanak grasps the Support of the Feetof the Lord. ||2||1||40|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1306-6) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: aas pooran dukh  binaasan gahee ot naanak har charan. ||2||1||40||

lines.english: I seek the Sanctuary of the Feet of my Merciful Lord and Master; I do not go anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: charan saran da-i-aal th aakur aan naahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨ ਿਤਪਤੇ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਪੇਿਖ ਜਸੁ ਤੋਿਖ ਸੁਨਤ  ਕਰਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: It is the Inherent Nature of our Lord and Master to purify sinners. Those who meditateon the Lord are saved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: patit paavan birad  su-aamee uDh ratay har Dh i-aa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਦੀਨ  ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਸਰਨ  ॥
lines.english: The world is a swamp of wickedness and corruption. The blind sinner has fallen intothe ocean of emotional attachment and pride,
lines.transliteration: saisaar gaar bikaar saagar patit  moh maan anDh .

lines.punjabi: ਆਸ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਦੁਖ ਿਬਨਾਸਨ  ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ॥੨॥੧॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: bikal maa-i-aa sang DhanDh . bewildered by the entanglements of Maya.

lines.english: God Himself has taken me by the hand and lifted me up and out of it; save me, OSovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar gahay parabh aap kaadh ahu raakh  layho gobind  raa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਸਰਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਆਨ  ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Master of the masterless, the Supporting Lord of the Saints, the Neutralizerof millions of sins.
lines.transliteration: anaath naath sanaath santan kot paap binaas.

lines.english: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: man darsanai kee pi-aas.

lines.english: God is the Perfect Treasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: parabh pooran gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸੈਸਾਰ  ਗਾਰ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰ ਪਿਤਤ  ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਅੰਧ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, sing and savor the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Kind and Compassionate Lord of the World. ||2||2||41|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1306-10) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kirpaal da-i-aal gupaal naanak har rasnaa gun gaa-ay. ||2||2||41||

lines.english: Countless times, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice
lines.transliteration: vaar vaara-o anik daara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਿਪ  ਕਾਢਹੁ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sukh pari-a suhaag palak raat . ||1|| rahaa-o. to that moment of peace, on that night when I was joined with my Beloved.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥ  ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੋਿਟ ਪਾਪ ਿਬਨਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: Mansions of gold, and beds of silk sheets - O sisters, I have no love for these. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kanik mandar paat sayj sakh ee mohi naahi in si-o t aat. ||1||

lines.english: Pearls, jewels and countless pleasures, O Nanak, are useless and destructive withoutthe Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mukat laal anik bh og bin naam naanak haat .

lines.english: Even with only dry crusts of bread, and a hard floor on which to sleep, my life passesin peace and pleasure with my Beloved, O sisters. ||2||3||42|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1306-13) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: rookho bh ojan bh oom sain sakh ee pari-a sang sookh  bihaat . ||2||3||42||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨਾ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥੨॥੨॥੪੧॥
lines.english: Give up your ego, and turn your face to God.
lines.transliteration: ahaN toro mukh  joro.

lines.english: Let your yearning mind call out, "Guru, Guru".
lines.transliteration: gur gur karat man loro.

lines.english: My Beloved is the Lover of Love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pari-a pareet pi-aaro moro. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The bed of your household shall be cozy, and your courtyard shall be comfortable; shatter and break the bonds which tie you to the five thieves. ||1||
lines.transliteration: garihi sayj suhaavee aagan chainaa toro ree t oro panch d ootan si-o sang t oro. ||1||

lines.english: You shall not come and go in reincarnation; you shall dwell in your own home deepwithin, and your inverted heart-lotus shall blossom forth.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay na jaa-ay basay nij aasan ooNDh kamal bigsoro.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਨਕ  ਮੰਦਰ  ਪਾਟ ਸੇਜ ਸਖੀ ਮੋਿਹ ਨਾਿਹ  ਇਨ ਿਸਉ ਤਾਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The turmoil of egotism shall be silenced.
lines.transliteration: chhutkee ha-umai soro.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਤ  ਲਾਲ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭੋਗ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਾਤ ॥
lines.english: Nanak sings - he sings the Praises of God, the Ocean of Virtue. ||2||4||43|| kwnVw mÚ 5 Gru 9 ] (1306-16) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 9. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House:
lines.transliteration: gaa-i-o ree gaa-i-o parabh naanak gunee gahayro. ||2||4||43||

lines.punjabi: ਰੂਖੋ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭੂਿਮ ਸੈਨ ਸਖੀ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੂਿਖ ਿਬਹਾਤ  ॥੨॥੩॥੪੨॥
lines.english: This is why you should chant and meditate on the Lord, O mind.
lines.transliteration: taaN tay jaap manaa har jaap.

lines.english: The Vedas and the Saints say that the path is treacherous and difficult. You areintoxicated with emotional attachment and the fever of egotism. ||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo sant bayd  kahat  panth gaakh ro moh magan ahaN taap. rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who are imbued and intoxicated with the wretched Maya, suffer the pains of emotional attachment. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jo raatay maat ay sang bapuree maa-i-aa moh sant aap. ||1||

lines.english: That humble being is saved, who chants the Naam; You Yourself save him.
lines.transliteration: naam japat so-oo jan uDh rai jisahi uDh aarahu aap.

lines.english: Emotional attachment, fear and doubt are dispelled, O Nanak, by the Grace of the Saints. ||2||5||44|| pMnw 1307 kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 10  (1307-2) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 10 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Tenth House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1307-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: binas jaa-ay moh bhai bh armaa naanak sant  partaap. ||2||5||44||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਤਾਪ  ॥੨॥੫॥੪੪॥
lines.english: Give me that blessing, O Dear Saints, for which my soul would be a sacrifice.
lines.transliteration: aiso daan d ayh jee sant ahu jaat  jee-o balihaar.

lines.english: Enticed by pride, entrapped and plundered by the five thieves, still, you live nearthem. I have come to the Sanctuary of the Holy, and I have been rescued from myassociation with those demons. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kwnVw, mÚ 5) maan mohee panch dohee urajh  nikat basi-o t aakee saran saaDh oo-aa d oot sang nivaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾਤ  ਜੀਉ  ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I wandered through millions of lifetimes and incarnations. I am so very tired - I have fallen at God's Door. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kot janam jon bharmi-o haar pari-o d u-aar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਹੀ ਉਰਿਝ  ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਬਿਸਓ  ਤਾਕੀ  ਸਰਿਨ ਸਾਧੂਆ  ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe has become Kind to me; He has blessed me with the Supportof the Naam.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa gobind bh a-ee mili-o naam aDh aar.

lines.english: This precious human life has become fruitful and prosperous; O Nanak, I am carriedacross the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||45|| kwnVw mhlw 5 Gru 11  (1307-6) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5 gh ar 11 Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Eleventh House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1307-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: dulabh  janam safal naanak bh av utaar paar. ||2||1||45||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨਮ  ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਿਮਓ  ਹਾਿਰ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He Himself has come to me, in His Natural Way.
