lines.transliteration: sahj subhaa-ay aapan aa-ay.

lines.english: I know nothing, and I show nothing.
lines.transliteration: kachhoo na jaanou kachh oo dikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਲਭ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਵ ਉਤਾਿਰ  ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥੧॥੪੫॥
lines.english: I have met God through innocent faith, and He has blessed me with peace.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh mili-o sukh  baalay bh olay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By the good fortune of my destiny, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy.
lines.transliteration: sanjog milaa-ay saaDh sangaa-ay.

lines.english: I do not go out anywhere; I dwell in my own home.
lines.transliteration: kathoo na jaa-ay gh areh basaa-ay.

lines.english: God, the Treasure of Virtue, has been revealed in this body-robe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun niDhaan pargati-o ih cholai. ||1||

lines.english: I have fallen in love with His Feet; I have abandoned everything else.
lines.transliteration: charan lubhaa-ay aan t ajaa-ay.

lines.english: In the places and interspaces, He is All-pervading.
lines.transliteration: thaan thanaa-ay sarab samaa-ay.

lines.english: With loving joy and excitement, Nanak speaks His Praises. ||2||1||46|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1307-10) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: rasak rasak naanak gun bolai. ||2||1||46||

lines.english: It is so hard to meet the Lord of the Universe, my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: gobind th aakur milan d uraa-eeN.

lines.english: His Form is Immeasurable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; He is All-pervadingeverywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parmit roop agamm agochar rahi-o sarab samaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By speaking and wandering, nothing is gained; nothing is obtained by clever tricks anddevices. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahan bhavan naahee paa-i-o paa-i-o anik ukat  chaturaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: People try all sorts of things, but the Lord is only met when He shows His Mercy.
lines.transliteration: jatan jat an anik upaav ray t a-o mili-o ja-o kirpaa-ee.

lines.english: God is Kind and Compassionate, the Treasure of Mercy; servant Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||47|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1307-13) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: parabhoo d a-i-aar kirpaar kirpaa niDh  jan naanak sant  raynaa-ee. ||2||2||47||

lines.english: O mother, I meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: maa-ee simrat raam raam raam.

lines.english: Without God, there is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: parabh binaa naahee hor.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਿਮਿਤ  ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮ  ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰਬ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I remember His Lotus Feet with every breath, night and day. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: chitva-o charnaarbind  saasan nis bh or. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He loves me and makes me His Own; my union with Him shall never be broken.
lines.transliteration: laa-ay pareet keen aapan t ootat nahee jor.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਿਨ  ਭਵਿਨ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਉਕਿਤ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: He is my breath of life, mind, wealth and everything. The Lord is the Treasure ofVirtue and Peace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paraan man Dhan sarbaso har gun niDh ay sukh  mor. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ  ਜਤਨ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਰੇ ਤਉ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਜਉ ਿਕਰਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, the Lord is perfectly pervading; He is seen deep within the heart.
lines.transliteration: eet oot  raam pooran nirkh at rid khor.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਦਇਆਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ  ॥੨॥੨॥੪੭॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, I am carried across; O Nanak, the terrible pain has been taken away. ||2||3||48|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1307-16) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sant saran t aran naanak binsi-o d ukh ghor. ||2||3||48||

lines.english: God's humble servant is in love with Him.
lines.transliteration: jan ko parabh sangay asnayhu.

lines.english: You are my Friend, my very best Friend; everything is in Your Home. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saajno too meet  mayraa garihi t ayrai sabh  kayhu. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I beg for honor, I beg for strength; please bless me with wealth, property andchildren. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maan maaNga-o taan maaNga-o Dh an lakh mee sut  dayh. ||1||

lines.english: You are the Technology of liberation, the Way to worldly success, the Perfect Lord ofSupreme Bliss, the Transcendent Treasure. pMnw 1308
lines.transliteration: mukat jugat  bhugat pooran parmaanand  param niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਿਨਹਾਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ  ॥੨॥੪॥੪੯॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God and loving devotion, Nanak is exalted and enraptured, forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||49|| kwnVw mhlw 5 ] (1308-1) kaanrhaa mehlaa 5. Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aa-ay bh agat nihaal naanak sad aa sad aa kurbaan. ||2||4||49||

lines.english: The debaters debate and argue their arguments.
lines.transliteration: karat karat  charach charach charcharee.

lines.english: The Yogis and meditators, religious and spiritual teachers roam and ramble, wandering endlessly all over the earth. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jog Dhi-aan bh aykh gi-aan firat  firat Dharat Dharat Dharcharee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They are egotistical, self-centered and conce ited, foolish, stupid, idiotic and insane.
lines.transliteration: ahaN ahaN ahai avar moorh moorh  moorh  bavra-ee.

lines.english: Wherever they go and wander, death is always with them, forever and ever and ever and ever. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jat jaat  jaat jaat sadaa sad aa sad aa sad aa kaal ha-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੰ ਅਹੰ ਅਹੈ ਅਵਰ  ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਬਵਰਈ  ॥
lines.english: Give up your pride and stubborn self-conceit; death, yes, death, is always close andnear at hand. hir hry hry Bwju khqu nwnku sunhu ry mUV ibnu Bjn Bjn Bjn Aihlw jnmu geI
lines.transliteration: maan maan maan ti-aag mirat  mirat  nikat nikat sad aa ha-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਤ ਜਾਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲ  ਹਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Haray, Haray. Says Nanak, listen you fool:without vibrating, and meditating, and dwelling on Him, your life is uselessly wastingaway. ||2||5||50||12||62|| kwnVw AstpdIAw mhlw 4 Gru 1  (1308-6) kaanrhaa asatpad ee-aa mehlaa 4 gh ar 1 Kaanraa, Ashtapadees, Fourth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1308-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har haray haray bhaaj kahat  naanak sunhu ray moorh  bin bh ajan bh ajan bh ajan ahilaa janam ga-ee. ||2||5||50||12||62||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and find peace.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam sukh paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਭਾਜੁ ਕਹਤੁ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਿਬਨੁ ਭਜਨ  ਭਜਨ  ਭਜਨ  ਅਿਹਲਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੫੦॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
lines.english: The more you chant and meditate, the more you will be at peace; serve the True Guru, and merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o japai tivai sukh  paavai sat gur sayv samaavaigo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਨੜਾ  ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Each and every instant, the humble devotees long for Him; chanting the Naam, theyfind peace.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaaN kee kh in khin lochaa naam japat  sukh  paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The taste of other pleasures is totally eradicated; nothing pleases them, except theName. ||1||
lines.transliteration: an ras saad ga-ay sabh  neekar bin naavai kichh  na sukh aavaigo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਿਜਉ  ਜਪੈ ਿਤਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord seems sweet to them; the Guru inspiresthem to speak sweet words.
lines.transliteration: gurmat har har meeth aa laagaa gur meeth ay bachan kadh aavaigo.

lines.english: Through the Word of the True Guru's Bani, the Primal Lord God is revealed; so focusyour consciousness on His Bani. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur ban ee purakh  purkh otam ban ee si-o chit  laavaigo. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨ ਕੀ ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਲੋਚਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, my mind has been softened and saturated withit; my mind has returned to its own home deep within.
lines.transliteration: gurbaanee sunat  mayraa man d arvi-aa man bh eenaa nij gh ar aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਿਰ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds there continuously; the stream of nectartrickles down constantly. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tah anhat  Dhunee baajeh nit  baajay neejh ar Dh aar chu-aavaigo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਠੇ ਬਚਨ  ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Name of the One Lord each and every instant, and following the Guru's Teachings, the mind is absorbed in the Naam.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ik til t il gaavai man gurmat  naam samaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਣੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਿਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Listening to the Naam, the mind is pleased with the Naam, and satisfied with theNaam. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam sunai naamo man bh aavai naamay hee t ariptaavaigo. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਦਰ੍ਿਵਆ  ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ  ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: People wear lots of bracelets, glittering with  gold; they wear all sorts of fine clothes.
lines.transliteration: kanik kanik pahiray baho kangnaa kaapar bhaaNt banaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਤ  ਧੁਨੀ ਬਾਜਿਹ  ਿਨਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਨੀਝਰ  ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: But without the Naam, they are all bland and insipid. They are born, only to die again, in the cycle of reincarnation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh feek fikaanay janam marai fir aavaigo. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲ  ਿਤਲ ਗਾਵੈ  ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The veil of Maya is a thick and heavy veil, a whirlpool which destroys one's home.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa patal patal hai bhaaree gh ar ghooman gh ayr gh ulaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਤਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Sins and corrupt vices are totally heavy, like rusted slag. They will not let you crossover the poisonous and treacherous world-ocean. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paap bikaar manoor sabh bh aaray bikh  dutar tari-o na jaavaigo. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਨਕ ਕਿਨਕ  ਪਿਹਰੇ  ਬਹੁ ਕੰਗਨਾ  ਕਾਪਰੁ ਭਿਤ  ਬਨਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Let the Fear of God and neutral detachment be the boat; the Guru is the Boatman,who carries us across in the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bha-o bairaag bh a-i-aa hai bohith gur kh ayvat sabad  taraavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਸਿਭ ਫੀਕ ਿਫਕਾਨੇ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰੈ ਿਫਿਰ ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Lord, the Name of the Lord, merge in the Lord, the Name of theLord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: raam naam har bhaytee-ai har raamai naam samaavaigo. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਪਟਲ  ਪਟਲ  ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ  ਘਰੁ ਘੂਮਿਨ  ਘੇਿਰ  ਘੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to ignorance, people are falling asleep; attached to the Guru's spiritualwisdom, they awaken.
lines.transliteration: agi-aan laa-ay savaali-aa gur gi-aanai laa-ay jagaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਮਨੂਰ ਸਿਭ ਭਾਰੇ ਿਬਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਿਰਓ  ਨ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by His Will, He makes us walk as He pleases. ||8||1|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1308-17) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaan ai aapn ai ji-o bh aavai t ivai chalaavaigo. ||8||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਹੈ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਗੁ ਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and be carried across.
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam taraavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਭੇਟੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Whoever chants and meditates on it is emancipated. Like Dhroo and Prahlaad, theymerge in the Lord. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1309
lines.transliteration: jo jo japai so-ee gat paavai ji-o Dh aroo par-hilaad  samaavaigo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Mercy, mercy, mercy - O Dear Lord, please shower Your Mercy on me, and attach meto Your Name.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kirpaa kar har jee-o kar kirpaa naam lagaavaigo.

lines.english: Please be Merciful, and lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, Imeditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa satguroo milaavhu mil sat gur naam Dh i-aavaigo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਲੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of egotism from countless incarnations sticks to me; joining the Sangat, theHoly Congregation, this filth is washed away.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee ha-umai mal laagee mil sangat mal leh jaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਤਿਰਓ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਲਿਗ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: As iron is carried across if it is attached to wood, one who is attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad finds the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o lohaa tari-o sang kaasat lag sabad  guroo har paavaigo. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਤ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, youshall come to receive the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sangat sant  milhu sat sangat  mil sangat  har ras aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੈ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ਕਿਢ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਚੀਕੜੁ  ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: But not joining the Sangat, and committing actions in egotistical pride, is like drawingout clean water, and throwing it in the mud. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin sangat karam karai abh imaanee kadh  paan ee cheekarh  paavaigo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ  ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Protector and Saving Grace of His humble devotees. The Lord'sSublime Essence seems so sweet to these humble beings.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kay har rakh vaaray jan har ras meeth  lagaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਿਖਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Each and every instant, they are blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam;through the Teachings of the True Guru, they are absorbed in Him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: khin kh in naam d ay-ay vadi-aa-ee sat gur upd ays samaavaigo. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਿਨਿਵ  ਰਹੀਐ  ਜਨ ਿਨਵਿਹ  ਤਾ ਫਲ ਗੁਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Bow forever in deep respect to the humble devotees; if you bow to those humblebeings, you shall obtain the fruit of virtue.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa ka-o sad aa niv rahee-ai jan niveh t aa fal gun paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਦੁਸਟ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਭਗਤਾ  ਕੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ  ਿਜਉ  ਪਿਚ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those wicked enemies who slander the devotees are destroyed, like Harnaakhash.||5||
lines.transliteration: jo nindaa d usat karahi bh agtaa kee harnaakh as ji-o pach jaavaigo. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕਮਲ  ਪੁਤੁ ਮੀਨ ਿਬਆਸਾ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ  ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Brahma, the son of the lotus, and Vyaas, the son of the fish, practiced austerepenance and were worshipped.
lines.transliteration: barahm kamal put meen bi-aasaa t ap taapan pooj karaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਗਤੁ  ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਰਮਨ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Whoever is a devotee - worship and adore that person. Get rid of your doubts and superstitions. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jo jo bhagat  ho-ay so poojahu bh arman bh aram chukaavaigo. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਤ  ਨਜਾਿਤ ਦੇਿਖ ਮਤ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ  ਪਗੀਂ  ਲਿਗ  ਿਧਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Do not be fooled by appearances of high and low social class. Suk Dayv bowed at thefeet of Janak, and meditated.
lines.transliteration: jaat najaat  daykh mat bharmahu suk janak pageeN lag Dh i-aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਜੂਠਨ  ਜੂਿਠ ਪਈ ਿਸਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਖਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਿਤਲੁ ਨ ਡੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Even though Janak threw his left-overs and garbage on Suk Dayv's head, his mind didnot waver, even for an instant. ||7||
lines.transliteration: joothan jooth  pa-ee sir oopar kh in manoo-aa t il na dulaavaigo. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਕ  ਜਨਕ  ਬੈਠੇ ਿਸੰਘਾਸਿਨ  ਨਉ ਮੁਨੀ ਧੂਿਰ ਲੈ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Janak sat upon his regal throne, and applied the dust of the nine sages to hisforehead.
lines.transliteration: janak janak baithay singh aasan na-o munee Dh oor lai laavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕਿਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮੈ ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: Please shower Nanak with your Mercy, O my Lord and Master; make him the slave ofYour slaves. ||8||2|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1309-11) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa kirpaa kar thaakur mai d aasan d aas karaavaigo. ||8||2||

lines.english: O mind, follow the Guru's Teachings, and joyfully sing God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: man gurmat ras gun gaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਿਸ ਗੁ ਨ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: If my one tongue became hundreds of thousands and millions, I would meditate onHim millions and millions of times. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jihvaa ayk ho-ay lakh kotee lakh  kotee kot Dh i-aavaigo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਵਾ  ਏਕ ਹੋਇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਿਟ ਿਧਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The serpent king chants and meditates on the Lord with his thousands of heads, but even by these chants, he cannot find the Lord's limits.
lines.transliteration: sahas fanee japi-o saykhnaagai har japt i-aa ant  na paavaigo.

lines.english: You are Utterly Unfathomable, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Wisdom of theGuru's Teachings, the mind becomes steady and balanced. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too athaahu at  agam agam hai mat  gurmat  man th ehraavaigo. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਫਨੀ ਜਿਪਓ  ਸੇਖਨਾਗੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਿਤਆ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who meditate on You are noble and exalted. Meditating on theLord, they are at peace.
lines.transliteration: jin too japi-o t ay-ee jan neekay har japt i-ahu ka-o sukh  paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਿਤ  ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗਮੁ  ਹੈ ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Bidur, the son of a slave-girl, was an untouchable, but Krishna hugged him close inHis Embrace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bidar d aasee sut  chhok chh ohraa krisan ank gal laavaigo. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਤੂ ਜਿਪਓ  ਤੇਈ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਿਤਅਹ ੁ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Wood is produced from water, but by holding onto wood, one is saved from drowning.
lines.transliteration: jal tay opat  bha-ee hai kaasat kaasat ang t araavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਦਰ  ਦਾਸੀ  ਸੁਤੁ ਛੋਕ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਿਕਰ੍ਸਨੁ ਅੰਿਕ  ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself embellishes and exalts His humble servants; He confirms His InnateNature. ||3||
lines.transliteration: raam janaa har aap savaaray apnaa birad rakh aavaigo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਿਤ  ਭਈ ਹੈ ਕਾਸਟ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਅੰਿਗ  ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: I am like a stone, or a piece of iron, heavy stone and iron; in the Boat of the Guru'sCongregation, I am carried across,
lines.transliteration: ham paathar loh loh bad paathar gur sangat naav t araavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਸਵਾਰੇ  ਅਪਨਾ  ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ji-o satsangat  tari-o julaaho sant  janaa man bh aavaigo. ||4|| like Kabeer the weaver, who was saved in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Hebecame pleasing to the minds of the humble Saints. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ  ਲੋਹ ਲੋਹ ਬਡ ਪਾਥਰ  ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Standing up, sitting down, rising up and walking on the path, I meditate.
lines.transliteration: kharay kh aro-ay baith at oothat maarag panth Dh i-aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਤਿਰਓ  ਜੁਲਾਹੋ  ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The True Guru is the Word, and the Word is the True Guru, who teaches the Path of Liberation. ||5||
lines.transliteration: satgur bachan bachan hai sat gur paaDh ar mukat  janaavaigo. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਖਰੇ ਖਰੋਏ  ਬੈਠਤ  ਊਠਤ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪੰਿਥ ਿਧਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: By His Training, I find strength with each and every breath; now that I am trained andtamed, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saasan saas saas bal paa-ee hai nihsaasan naam Dhi-aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਨ  ਬਚਨ  ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਧਰੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਜਨਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, egotism is extinguished, and then, through the Guru's Teachings, I merge in the Naam. ||6|| pMnw 1310
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee ha-umai boojhai t ou gurmat  naam samaavaigo. ||6||

lines.english: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul, but the unfortunate ones do not love Him.
lines.transliteration: satgur d aataa jee-a jee-an ko bh aagheen nahee bh aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੀਅਨ  ਕੋ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ  ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; in the end, they will suffer intorment and regret. ||7||
lines.transliteration: fir ayh vaylaa haath na aavai partaapai pachh utaavaigo. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ  ਹਾਿਥ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਪਰਤਾਪੈ  ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: If a good person seeks goodness for himself, he should bow low in humble surrenderto the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jay ko bhalaa lorh ai bhal apnaa gur aagai dh eh dh eh paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਭਲ ਅਪਨਾ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਢਿਹ ਢਿਹ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak prays: please show kindness and compassion to me, O my Lord and Master, that I may apply the dust of the True Guru to my forehead. ||8||3|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1310-3) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak da-i-aa d a-i-aa kar th aakur mai sat gur bh asam lagaavaigo. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਸਮ  ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: O mind, be attuned to His Love, and sing.
lines.transliteration: man har rang raataa gaavaigo.

lines.english: The Fear of God makes me fearless and immaculate; I am dyed in the color of theGuru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhai bh ai taraas bh a-ay hai nirmal gurmat  laag lagaavaigo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Lord's Love remain balanced and detached forever;they live near the Lord, who comes into their house.
lines.transliteration: har rang raataa sad  bairaagee har nikat t inaa gh ar aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭੈ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: If I am blessed with the dust of their feet, then I live. Granting His Grace, He Himselfbestows it. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin kee pank milai t aaN jeevaa kar kirpaa aap d ivaavaigo. ||1||

lines.english: Mortal beings are attached to greed and duality. Their minds are unripe and unfit, andwill not accept the Dye of His Love.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa lobh  lagay hai paraan ee man korai rang na aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: But their lives are transformed through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. Meeting with the Guru, the Primal Being, they are dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||
lines.transliteration: fir ulti-o janam hovai gur bachnee gur purakh milai rang laavaigo. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਜੀਵਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਆਿਪ ਿਦਵਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There are ten organs of sense and action; the ten wander unrestrained. Under the influence of the three dispositions, they are not stable, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: indree d asay d asay fun Dh aavat  tarai gun ee-aa kh in na tikaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਲੋਿਭ ਲਗੇ ਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਮਿਨ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Coming in contact with the True Guru, they are brought under control; then, salvationand liberation are attained. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur parchai vasgat  aavai mokh  mukat  so paavaigo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਿਰ ਉਲਿਟਓ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One and Only Creator of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. All shall onceagain merge into the One.
lines.transliteration: o-ankaar ayko rav rahi-aa sabh aykas maahi samaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਦਸੇ ਦਸੇ ਫੁਿਨ ਧਾਵਤ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁ ਣੀਆ  ਿਖਨੁ ਨ ਿਟਕਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: His One Form has one, and many colors; He leads all according to His One Word. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ayko roop ayko baho rangee sabh aykat  bachan chalaavaigo. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰਚੈ  ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਆਵੈ  ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh realizes the One and Only Lord; He is revealed to the Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ayko ayk pachh aataa gurmukh  ho-ay lakh aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਓਅੰਕਾਿਰ  ਏਕੋ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਸ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh goes and meets the Lord in His Mansion deep within; the UnstruckWord of the Shabad vibrates there. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jaa-ay milai nij mahlee anhad  sabad  bajaavaigo. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਤੁ  ਬਚਿਨ  ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: God created all the beings and creatures of the universe; He blesses the Gurmukhwith glory.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  sisat upaa-ee gurmukh  sobh aa paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Without meeting the Guru, no one obtains the Mansion of His Presence. They sufferthe agony of coming and going in reincarnation. ||6||
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhaytay ko mahal na paavai aa-ay jaa-ay d ukh paavaigo. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਿਨਜ ਮਹਲੀ  ਅਨਹਦ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਬਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
lines.english: For countless lifetimes, I have been separated from my Beloved; in His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.
lines.transliteration: anayk janam vichhurh ay mayray pareet am kar kirpaa guroo milaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਿਸਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਈ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, I have found absolute peace, and my polluted intellectblossoms forth. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur milat  mahaa sukh  paa-i-aa mat  maleen bigsaavaigo. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋ ਮਹਲੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Lord, Har, Har, please grant Your Grace; O Life of the World, instill faith in theNaam within me.
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa karahu jagjeevan mai sarDhaa naam lagaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਜਨਮ  ਿਵਛੁੜੇ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਮਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru; I am immersed in the Sanctuary of theTrue Guru. ||8||4|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1310-15) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak guroo guroo hai satgur mai sat gur saran milaavaigo. ||8||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਿਮਲਤ  ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਿਤ ਮਲੀਨ  ਿਬਗਸਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O mind, walk on the Path of the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: man gurmat chaal chalaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਮੈ ਸਰਧਾ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Just as the wild elephant is subdued by the prod, the mind is disciplined by the Wordof the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o maigal masat d eejai t al kunday gur ankas sabad  darirh-aavaigo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਿਨ  ਿਮਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.english: The wandering mind wanders, roams and rambles in the ten directions; but the Guruholds it, and lovingly attunes it to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: chaltou chalai chalai d ah dah dis gur raakh ai har liv laavaigo.

lines.english: The True Guru implants the Word of the Shabad deep within the heart; the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, trickles into the mouth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur sabad  day-ay rid  antar mukh  amrit  naam chu-aavaigo. ||1||

lines.english: The snakes are filled with poisonous venom; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is theantidote - place it in your mouth.
lines.transliteration: bisee-ar bisoo bharay hai pooran gur garurh  sabad  mukh  paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਮੈਗਲੁ  ਮਸਤੁ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਤਿਲ  ਕੁੰਡੇ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਕਸੁ  ਸਬਦੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Maya, the serpent, does not even approach one who is rid of the poison, and lovinglyattuned to the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa bhu-i-ang t is nayrh  na aavai bikh  jhaar jh aar liv laavaigo. ||2||

lines.english: The dog of greed is very powerful in the village of the body; the Guru strikes it anddrives it out in an instant.
lines.transliteration: su-aan lobh nagar meh sablaa gur kh in meh maar kadh aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਤੌ  ਚਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Truth, contentment, righteousness and Dharma have settled there; in the village of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3|| pMnw 1311
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh Dharam aan raakh ay har nagree har gun gaavaigo. ||3||

lines.english: The mortal beings are sinking in the swamp of emotional attachment; the Guru lifts them up, and saves them from sinking.
lines.transliteration: pankaj moh nighrat  hai paraanee gur nigh rat kaadh  kadh aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਕਜ  ਮੋਹ ਿਨਘਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਨਘਰਤ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Crying, "Save me! Save me!", the humble come to His Sanctuary; the Guru reachesout His Hand, and lifts them up. ||4||
lines.transliteration: taraahi t araahi saran jan aa-ay gur haathee d ay niklaavaigo. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਜਨ ਆਏ  ਗੁਰੁ ਹਾਥੀ  ਦੇ ਿਨਕਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The whole world is like a game in a dream, all a game. God plays and causes the game to be played.
lines.transliteration: supnantar sansaar sabh  baajee sabh  baajee kh ayl kh ilaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ  ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਿਖਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: So earn the Profit of the Naam by following the Guru's Teachings; you shall go to theCourt of the Lord in robes of honor. ||5||
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam gurmat lai chaalahu har d argeh paiDh aa jaavaigo. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਲੈ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: They act in egotism, and make others act in egotism; they collect and gather up theblackness of sin.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai karai karaavai ha-umai paap ko-ilay aan jamaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਾਪ ਕੋਇਲੇ  ਆਿਨ  ਜਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: And when death comes, they suffer in agony; they must eat what they have planted.||6||
lines.transliteration: aa-i-aa kaal dukh -daa-ee ho-ay jo beejay so kh alaavaigo. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਆ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਦੁਖਦਾਈ  ਹੋਏ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਵਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Saints, gather the Wealth of the Lord's Name; if you depart after packing theseprovisions, you shall be honored.
lines.transliteration: santahu raam naam Dh an sanchahu lai kh arach chalay pat  paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਲੈ ਖਰਚੁ  ਚਲੇ ਪਿਤ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: So eat, spend, consume and give abundantly; the Lord will give - there will be nodeficiency. ||7||
lines.transliteration: khaa-ay kh arach d ayveh bahut ayraa har d ayday tot na aavaigo. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਇ  ਖਰਿਚ  ਦੇਵਿਹ  ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The wealth of the Lord's Name is deep within the heart. In the Sanctuary of the Guru,this wealth is found.
lines.transliteration: raam naam Dhan hai rid  antar Dh an gur sarn aa-ee paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; He has blessed me. Removing painand poverty, He has blended me with Himself. ||8||5|| kwnVw mhlw 4 ] (1311-7) kaanrhaa mehlaa 4. Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak da-i-aa d a-i-aa kar d eenee d ukh daalad  bhanj samaavaigo. ||8||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਇਆ  ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰ ਦੀਨੀ  ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਭੰਿਜ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੮॥੫॥
lines.english: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate.
lines.transliteration: man satgur saran Dh i-aavaigo.

lines.english: Iron is transformed into gold by touching the philosopher's stone; it takes on itsqualities. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: lohaa hiran hovai sang paaras gun paaras ko ho-ay aavaigo. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The True Guru, the Great Primal Being, is the philosopher's stone. Whoever isattached to Him receives fruitful rewards.
lines.transliteration: satgur mahaa purakh  hai paaras jo laagai so fal paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਹਾ ਿਹਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਪਾਰਸ  ਗੁਨੁ ਪਾਰਸ  ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Just as Prahlaad was saved by the Guru's Teachings, the Guru protects the honor ofHis servant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ji-o gur updays t aray par-hilaad aa gur sayvak paij rakh aavaigo. ||1||

lines.english: The Word of the True Guru is the most Sublime and Noble Word. Through the Guru'sWord, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur bachan bachan hai neeko gur bachnee amrit  paavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਜੋ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Ambreek the king was blessed with the status of immortality, meditating on the Wordof the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ambreek amraa pad paa-ay sat gur mukh  bachan Dh i-aavaigo. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਤਰੇ ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦਾ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ  ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Sanctuary, the Protection and Sanctuary of the True Guru is pleasing to the mind.It is sacred and pure - meditate on it.
lines.transliteration: satgur saran saran man bh aa-ee suDh aa suDh aa kar Dh i-aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਨੁ ਬਚਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has become Merciful to the meek and the poor; He has shown me the Path, the Way to the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal d een bh a-ay hai sat gur har maarag panth d ikhaavaigo. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਅੰਬਰੀਿਕ  ਅਮਰਾ  ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ  ਿਧਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Those who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru are firmly established; God comes toprotect them.
lines.transliteration: satgur saran pa-ay say thaapay t in raakh an ka-o parabh  aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਈ  ਸੁਧਾ ਸੁਧਾ ਕਿਰ ਿਧਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: If someone aims an arrow at the Lord's humble servant, it will turn around and hit himinstead. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jay ko sar sanDhai jan oopar fir ulto t isai lagaavaigo. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੀਨ  ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਿਦਖਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who bathe in the Sacred Pool of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are blessedwith honor in His Court.
lines.transliteration: har har har har har sar sayveh tin d argeh maan d ivaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਏ ਸੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਿਤਨ ਰਾਖਨ  ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Guru's Teachings, the Guru's Instructions, the Guru'sWisdom, are united in the Lord's Union; He hugs them close in His Embrace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gurmat gurmat  gurmat  Dhi-aavahi har gal mil mayl milaavaigo. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੈ ਜਨ ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਫਿਰ ਉਲਟੋ  ਿਤਸੈ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad, The Guru's Word is the wisdom ofthe Vedas; coming in contact with the Guru, meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naad  bayd  hai gurmukh  gur parchai naam Dh i-aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ਿਦਵਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: In the Image of the Lord, Har, Har, one becomes the Embodiment of the Lord. TheLord makes His humble servant worthy of worship. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har har roop har roopo hovai har jan ka-o pooj karaavaigo. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਗਿਲ  ਿਮਿਲ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic does not submit to the True Guru; the Lord makes the non-believerwander in confusion.
lines.transliteration: saakat nar sat gur nahee kee-aa t ay baymukh  har bh armaavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਬੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: The waves of greed are like packs of dogs. The poison of Maya sticks to the body- skeleton. ||7||
lines.transliteration: lobh lahar su-aan kee sangat  bikh maa-i-aa karang lagaavaigo. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰੂਪੁ ਹਿਰ ਰੂਪੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Saving Grace of the whole world; join the Sangat, andmeditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: raam naam sabh jag kaa t aarak lag sangat  naam Dh i-aavaigo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ  ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖ  ਹਿਰ ਭਰਮਾਵੈਗੋ  ॥
lines.english: O my God, please protect and preserve Nanak in the Sat Sangat, the TrueCongregation; save him, and let him merge in You. ||8||6|| Ckw 1 ] (1311-19) chhakaa 1. First Set of Six|| pMnw 1312 kwnVw CMq mhlw 5  (1312-1) kaanrhaa chh ant mehlaa 5 Kaanraa, Chhant, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1312-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak raakh raakh  parabh  mayray sat sangat  raakh  samaavaigo. ||8||6||

lines.english: They alone are saved, who meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: say uDhray jin raam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Working for Maya is useless.
lines.transliteration: jatan maa-i-aa kay kaam na aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਕਾਿਮ  ਨ ਆਏ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Lord, all fruits and rewards are obtained. They are blessed, blessed and very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: raam Dhi-aa-ay sabh  fal paa-ay Dh an Dh an tay badbh aagee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਿਧਆਏ  ਸਿਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਧਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: They are awake and aware in the True Congregation; attached to the Naam, they arelovingly attuned to the One.
lines.transliteration: satsang jaagay naam laagay ayk si-o liv laagee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਿਗ  ਜਾਗੇ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਏਕ ਿਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have renounced pride, emotional attachment, wickedness and corruption; attachedto the Holy, I am carried across at their feet.
lines.transliteration: taj maan moh bikaar saaDh oo lag t ara-o t in kai paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਿਬਕਾਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਿਗ  ਤਰਉ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have come to the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; by great goodfortune, I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak saran  su-aamee badbh aag d arsan paa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਬਡਭਾਿਗ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Holy meet together, and continually vibrate and meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo nit  bhajah naaraa-in .

lines.english: With love and excitement, they sing the Glorious Praises of their Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: rasak rasak su-aamee gun gaa-in .

lines.english: Singing His Praises they live, drinking in the Lord's Nectar; the cycle of birth and deathis over for them.
lines.transliteration: gun gaa-ay jeevah har ami-o peevah janam marn aa bh aag-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ਜੀਵਹ  ਹਿਰ ਅਿਮਉ  ਪੀਵਹ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣਾ  ਭਾਗਏ  ॥
lines.english: Finding the True Congregation and meditating on the Lord, one is never againafflicted with pain.
lines.transliteration: satsang paa-ee-ai har Dh i-aa-ee-ai bahurh  dookh na laag-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਿਗ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਏ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the Great Giver, the Architect of Destiny, we work to serve the Saints.
lines.transliteration: kar da-i-aa d aatay purakh  biDhaatay sant  sayv kamaa-in .

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਦਾਤੇ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਬਧਾਤੇ  ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਣ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, I long for the dust of the feet of the humble; I am intuitively absorbed in the Blessed Vision of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak jan Dh oor baaNchheh har d aras sahj samaa-in . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਧੂਿਰ ਬਛਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਿਸ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਣ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: All beings vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: saglay jant bh ajahu gopaalai.

lines.english: This brings the merits of chanting and meditation, austere self-discipline and perfectservice.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam pooran gh aalai.

lines.english: Vibrating and meditating continuously on our Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, theSearcher of hearts, one's life becomes totally fruitful.
lines.transliteration: nit bh ajahu su-aamee ant arjaamee safal janam sabaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਭਜਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਸਫਲ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਬਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Those who sing and meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe - their cominginto the world is blessed and approved.
lines.transliteration: gobid gaa-ee-ai nit  Dhi-aa-ee-ai parvaan  so-ee aa-i-aa.

lines.english: The Immaculate Lord, Har, Har, is meditation and chanting, and austere self-discipline; only the Wealth of the Lord of the Universe shall go along with you in theend.
lines.transliteration: jap taap sanjam har har niranjan gobind  Dhan sang chaalai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਗ  ਚਾਲੈ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and bless me with the Jewel, that Imay carry it in my pocket. ||3||
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak kar d a-i-aa d eejai har rat an baaDh a-o paalai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਿਰ ਦਇਆ  ਦੀਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਾਧਉ  ਪਾਲੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: His Wondrous and Amazing Plays are blissful
lines.transliteration: mangalchaar choj aanandaa.
kar kirpaa milay parmaanandaa. - granting His Grace, He bestows supreme ecstasy.

lines.english: God, my Lord and Master, the Bringer of peace, has met me, and the desires of my mind are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: parabh milay su-aamee sukh hagaamee ichh  man kee punnee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸੁਖਹਗਾਮੀ  ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Congratulations pour in; I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. I shall never again cryout in pain.
lines.transliteration: bajee baDhaa-ee sehjay samaa-ee bahurh  dookh na runnee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਜੀ ਬਧਾਈ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਮਾਈ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਦੂਿਖ ਨ ਰੁੰਨੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: He hugs me close in His Embrace, and blesses me with peace; the evil of sin andcorruption is gone.
lines.transliteration: lay kanth laa-ay sukh  dikhaa-ay bikaar binsay mand aa.

lines.english: Prays Nanak, I have met my Lord and Master, the Primal Lord, the Embodiment ofBliss. ||4||1|| kwnVy kI vwr mhlw 4 mUsy kI vwr kI DunI  (1312-15) kaanrhay kee vaar mehlaa 4 moosay kee vaar kee Dh unee Vaar Of Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl, Sung To The Tune Of The Ballad Of Musa: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1312-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mÚ 4 ] (1312-16) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: binvant naanak milay su-aamee purakh  parmaanand aa. ||4||1||

lines.english: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and enshrine the Treasure of the Lord's Name within your heart.
lines.transliteration: raam naam niDhaan har gurmat  rakh ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਨੜੇ  ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ਮੂਸੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Become the slave of the Lord's slaves, and conquer egotism and corruption.
lines.transliteration: daasan d aasaa ho-ay rahu ha-umai bikh i-aa maar.

lines.english: You shall win this treasure of life; you shall never lose.
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath jeet i-aa kad ay na aavai haar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an vadbh aagee naankaa jin gurmat  har ras saar. ||1|| Blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who savor the SublimeEssence of the Lord through the Guru's Teachings. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1312-18) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Govind, Govind, Govind - the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe is the Treasure ofVirtue.
lines.transliteration: govind govid  govid  har govid  gunee niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਜੀਿਤਆ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on Govind, Govind, the Lord of the Universe, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. pMnw 1313
lines.transliteration: govid govid  gurmat  Dhi-aa-ee-ai t aaN dargeh paa-ee-ai maan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਤ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Meditating on God, chanting Govind, Govind, Govind, your face shall be radiant; you shall be famous and exalted.
lines.transliteration: govid govid  govid  jap mukh  oojlaa parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਗੋਿਵਦੁ  ਜਿਪ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Guru is the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe; meeting Him, you shall obtain the Name of the Lord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1313-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gur govind har jit  mil har paa-i-aa naam. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You Yourself are the Siddha and the seeker; You Yourself are the Yoga and the Yogi.
lines.transliteration: tooN aapay hee siDh  saaDh iko too aapay hee jug jogee-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself are the Taster of tastes; You Yourself are the Enjoyer of pleasures.
lines.transliteration: too aapay hee ras rasee-arh aa too aapay hee bh og bh ogee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕੋ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself are All-pervading; whatever You do comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: too aapay aap varatd aa too aapay karahi so hogee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਰਸ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਹੀ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru. Join them - speak and chant the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  satgur Dh an Dh ano Dh an Dh an Dh ano jit  mil har bulag bulogee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਤੂ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: ||1|| Let everyone chant together the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray, Har, Har, Haray;chanting Har, all sins are washed away. ||1|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1313-6) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kahhu mukh ahu har har haray har har haray har bolat  sabh  paap lahogee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨ ਧਨੋ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਬੁਲਗ  ਬੁਲੋਗੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: Har, Har, Har, Har is the Name of the Lord; rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtainit.
lines.transliteration: har har har har naam hai gurmukh paavai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਤ  ਸਿਭ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੋਗੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Egotism and possessiveness are eradicated, and evil-mindedness is washed away.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mamtaa naas ho-ay d urmat  kadh ai Dho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, one who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny chants the Lord's Praises, night and day. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1313-7) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak an-din gun  uchrai jin ka-o Dh ur likh i-aa ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is Merciful; whatever the Lord Himself does, comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: har aapay aap da-i-aal har aapay karay so ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself is All-pervading. There is no other as Great as the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har aapay aap varatdaa har jayvad avar na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ  ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever pleases the Lord God's Will comes to pass; whatever the Lord God does isdone.
lines.transliteration: jo har parabh bh aavai so thee-ai jo har parabh  karay so ho-ay.

lines.english: No one can appraise His Value; the Lord God is Endless.
lines.transliteration: keemat kinai na paa-ee-aa bay-ant  parabh oo har so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, praise the Lord; your body and mind shall be cooled andsoothed. ||2|| pauVI ] (1313-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh har salaahi-aa t an man seet al ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: You are the Light of all, the Life of the World; You imbue each and every heart with Your Love.
lines.transliteration: sabh jot  tayree jagjeevanaa t oo gh at ghat har rang rangnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All meditate on You, O my Beloved; You are the True, True Primal Being, theImmaculate Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh Dh i-aavahi t uDh mayray pareet amaa t oo sat  sat purakh  niranjanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ  ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹਿਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The One is the Giver; the whole world is the beggar. All the beggars beg for His Gifts.
lines.transliteration: ik daat aa sabh  jagat  bhikhaaree-aa har jaacheh sabh  mang mangnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਿਹਆ  ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the servant, and You are the Lord and Master of all. Through the Guru'sTeachings, we are ennobled and uplifted.
lines.transliteration: sayvak thaakur sabh  toohai t oohai gurmat ee har chang changnaa.

lines.english: ||2|| Let everyone say that the Lord is the Master of the senses, the Master of all faculties;through Him, we obtain all fruits and rewards. ||2|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1313-14) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh kahhu mukh ahu rikh eekays haray rikh eekays haray jit  paavahi sabh  fal falnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜੋਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੂ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; you shall be honored in theCourt of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ay man har d argeh paavahi maan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮਾ  ਤੂ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: You shall obtain the fruits that you desire, focusing your meditation on the Word ofthe Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jo ichheh so fal paa-isee gur sabd ee lagai Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਭਖਾਰੀਆ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਸਭ ਮੰਗ ਮੰਗਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: All your sins and mistakes shall be wiped away, and you shall be rid of egotism and pride.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh paap sabh  katee-ah ha-umai chukai gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕੁ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਚੰਗ ਚੰਗਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, recognizing God within every soul.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kamal vigsi-aa sabh  aatam barahm pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਿਰਖੀਕੇਸੁ  ਹਰੇ ਿਰਖੀਕੇਸੁ  ਹਰੇ ਿਜਤੁ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸਭ ਫਲ ਫਲਨਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may chant theLord's Name. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1313-17) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa Dhaar parabh  jan naanak jap har naam. ||1||

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Sacred and Immaculate. Chanting the Naam, painis dispelled.
lines.transliteration: har har naam pavit hai naam japat  dukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: God comes to abide in the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in man vasi-aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਛਿਹ  ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਲਗੈ ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru are rid of pain and poverty.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai jo chalai t in daalad  dukh leh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਪਾਪ ਸਿਭ ਕਟੀਅਿਹ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਚੁਕੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: No one finds the Lord by his own will; see this, and satisfy your mind.
lines.transliteration: aapnai bh aanai kinai na paa-i-o jan vaykh hu man pat ee-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਮਲੁ ਿਵਗਿਸਆ  ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the slave of those who fall at the Feet of the True Guru.||2|| pauVI ] (1313-19) pa-orhee. Pauree: pMnw 1314
lines.transliteration: jan naanak daasan d aas hai jo sat gur laagay paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਿਰ  ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹਿਹ ਕਰਤੇ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਵਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You are pervading and permeating all places and interspaces, O Creator. You made all that has been made.
lines.transliteration: tooN thaan thanant ar bharpoor heh kart ay sabh  tayree ban at banaavan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ  ਿਸਸਿਟ  ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ  ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਭਿਤ  ਉਪਾਵਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You created the entire universe, with all its colors and shades; in so many ways andmeans and forms You formed it.
lines.transliteration: rang parang sisat sabh saajee baho baho biDh  bhaaNt upaavan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਿਤ ਜੋਤੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਰਤਿਹ  ਗੁ ਰਮਤੀ  ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਵਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord of Light, Your Light is infused within all; You link us to the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: sabh t ayree jot  jotee vich vart eh gurmat ee tuDhai laavn ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹੋਿਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਿਤਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਮੁਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: They alone meet the True Guru, unto whom You are Merciful; O Lord, You instructthem in the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: jin hohi da-i-aal t in sat gur mayleh mukh  gurmukh  har samjh aavan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੋ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੋ ਿਜਤੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਵਣੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Let everyone chant the Name of the Lord, chant the Name of the Great Lord; allpoverty, pain and hunger shall be taken away. ||3|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1314-4) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh bolhu raam ramo saree raam ramo jit  daalad  dukh bhukh sabh  leh jaavn ee. ||3||

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet; enshrine thisAmbrosial Nectar of the Lord within your heart.
lines.transliteration: har har amrit naam ras har amrit  har ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God prevails in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation; reflect upon the Shabad and understand.
lines.transliteration: vich sangat har parabh  varatd aa bujh ahu sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਬੁਝਹੁ ਸਬਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within the mind, the poison of egotismis eradicated.
lines.transliteration: man har har naam Dhi-aa-i-aa bikh  ha-umai kadh ee maar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਢੀ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who does not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, shall totally lose this lifein the gamble.
lines.transliteration: jin har har naam na chayti-o t in joo-ai janam sabh  haar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਿਤਨ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਭੁ ਹਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, one remembers the Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within theheart.
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai har chayt aa-i-aa har naamaa har ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਿਰ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, his face shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1314-8) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tay mukh  ujlay t it sachai d arbaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: To chant the Lord's Praise and His Name is sublime and exalted. This is the mostexcellent deed in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: har keerat ut am naam hai vich kalijug karn ee saar.

lines.english: His Praises come through the Guru's Teachings and Instructions; wear the Necklace ofthe Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: mat gurmat  keerat  paa-ee-ai har naamaa har ur haar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਉਤਮੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਿਲਜੁਗ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord are very fortunate. They are entrusted with the Treasure of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee jin har Dh i-aa-i-aa t in sa-upi-aa har bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, no matter what people may do, they continue to waste away inegotism.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai je karam kamaavnay nit  ha-umai ho-ay kh u-aar.

lines.english: Elephants can be washed and bathed in water, but they only throw dust on theirheads again.
lines.transliteration: jal hastee mal naavaalee-ai sir bh ee fir paavai chh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਜ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਣੇ  ਿਨਤ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Kind and Compassionate True Guru, please unite me with the Lord, that the OneCreator of the Universe may abide within my mind.
lines.transliteration: har maylhu satgur d a-i-aa kar man vasai aykankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਹਸਤੀ  ਮਿਲ ਨਾਵਾਲੀਐ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਭੀ ਿਫਿਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who listen to the Lord and believe in Him - servant Nanak salutesthem. ||2|| pauVI ] (1314-12) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jin gurmukh sun  har mani-aa jan naanak t in jaikaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the most sublime and precious merchandise. The Primal Lord Godis my Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: raam naam vakhar hai oot am har naa-ik purakh  hamaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੁਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਿਤਨ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord has staged His Play, and He Himself permeates it. The whole world deals inthis merchandise.
lines.transliteration: har khayl kee-aa har aapay vart ai sabh  jagat  kee-aa van jaaraa.

lines.english: Your Light is the light in all beings, O Creator. All Your Expanse is True.
lines.transliteration: sabh jot  tayree jot ee vich kart ay sabh  sach t ayraa paasaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਹੈ ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਇਕੁ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹਮਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: All those who meditate on You become prosperous; through the Guru's Teachings, they sing Your Praises, O Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: sabh Dh i-aavahi t uDh safal say gaavahi gurmat ee har nirankaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਵਣਜਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: ||4|| Let everyone chant the Lord, the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, andcross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1314-15) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh chavahu mukh ahu jagannaath jagannaath jagjeevano jit  bhavjal paar ut aaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have only one tongue, and the Glorious Virtues of the Lord God are Unapproachableand Unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: hamree jihbaa ayk parabh har kay gun  agam athaah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਤੁਧੁ ਸਫਲ  ਸੇ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am ignorant - how can I meditate on You, Lord? You are Great, Unapproachable andImmeasurable.
lines.transliteration: ham ki-o kar japah i-aani-aa har t um vad agam agaah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਚਵਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ  ਿਜਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਾ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Lord God, please bless me with that sublime wisdom, that I may fall at the Feet ofthe Guru, the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har dayh parabh oo mat  ootmaa gur sat gur kai pag paah.

lines.english: O Lord God, please lead me to the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where even asinner like myself may be saved.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  har mayl parabh  ham paapee sang t araah.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੀ  ਿਜਹਬਾ  ਏਕ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਗਮ  ਅਥਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please bless and forgive servant Nanak; please unite him in Your Union.
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har bakhas laihu har t uthai mayl milaah.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਜਪਹ  ਇਆਿਣਆ  ਹਿਰ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please be merciful and hear my prayer; I am a sinner and a worm - please save me! ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1314-19) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa kar sun baynt ee ham paapee kiram t araah. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਮਿਤ ਊਤਮਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਪਿਗ  ਪਾਹ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, Life of the World, please bless me with Your Grace, and lead me to meet theGuru, the Merciful True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har karahu kirpaa jagjeevanaa gur satgur mayl d a-i-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਤਰਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: I am happy to serve the Guru; the Lord has become merciful to me. pMnw 1315
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa har ham bhaa-ee-aa har ho-aa har kirpaal.

lines.english: All my hopes and desires have been forgotten; my mind is rid of its worldly entanglements.
lines.transliteration: sabh aasaa mansaa visree man chookaa aal janjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਿਵਸਰੀ  ਮਿਨ ਚੂਕਾ  ਆਲ  ਜੰਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru, in His Mercy, implanted the Naam within me; I am enraptured with theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai naam drirh -aa-i-aa ham kee-ay sabad  nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ  ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak has obtained the inexhaustible wealth; the Lord's Name is his wealthand property. ||2|| pauVI ] (1315-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak atut Dh an paa-i-aa har naamaa har Dh an maal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਅਤੁਟੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great, the Greatest of the Great, the Most Lofty and Exalted of all, the Greatest of the Great.
lines.transliteration: har tumH vad vaday vaday vad oochay sabh  oopar vaday vadounaa.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Infinite Lord, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har,are rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhi-aavahi har aprampar har har har Dh i-aa-ay haray t ay honaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਵਡੇ ਵਡੌਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those who sing and listen to Your Praises, O my Lord and Master, have millions ofsins destroyed.
lines.transliteration: jo gaavahi suneh t ayraa jas su-aamee t in kaatay paap katonaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇ  ਹਰੇ ਤੇ ਹੋਨਾ ॥
lines.english: I know that those divine beings who follow the Guru's Teachings are just like You,Lord. They are the greatest of the great, so very fortunate.
lines.transliteration: tum jaisay har purakh  jaanay mat  gurmat  mukh  vad vad bh aag vadonaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੋਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, who was True in the primal beginning, and True throughout the ages; He is revealed as True here and now, and He shall be Trueforever and ever. Servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||5|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1315-6) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kwnVw, mÚ 4) sabh Dh i-aavahu aad  satay jugaad  satay part akh satay sad aa sad aa sat ay jan naanak daas d asonaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖ  ਜਾਨੇ ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੁਿਖ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੋਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I meditate on my Lord, the Life of the World, the Lord, chanting the Guru's Mantra.
lines.transliteration: hamray har jagjeevanaa har japi-o har gur mant.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਆਿਦ  ਸਤੇ ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਸਤੇ ਪਰਤਿਖ  ਸਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸੋਨਾ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Lord is Unapproachable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; the Lord, Har, Har, has spontaneously come to meet me.
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar agam har har mili-aa aa-ay achint.

lines.english: The Lord Himself is pervading each and every heart; the Lord Himself is Endless.
lines.transliteration: har aapay ghat gh at varatd aa har aapay aap bi-ant .

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਹਿਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself enjoys all pleasures; the Lord Himself is the Husband of Maya.
lines.transliteration: har aapay sabh ras bh ogdaa har aapay kavlaa kant .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਆਇ  ਅਿਚੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself gives in charity to the whole world, and all the beings and creatureswhich He created.
lines.transliteration: har aapay bhikh i-aa paa-id aa sabh  sisat upaa-ee jee-a jant .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਿਬਅੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Merciful Lord God, please bless me with Your Bountiful Gifts; the humble Saints ofthe Lord beg for them.
lines.transliteration: har dayvhu d aan d a-i-aal parabh  har maaNgeh har jan sant .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਸਭ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ  ਕਵਲਾ  ਕੰਤ ॥
lines.english: O God of servant Nanak, please come and meet me; I sing the Songs of the GloriousPraises of the Lord. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1315-10) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay parabh aa-ay mil ham gaavah har gun  chhant. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਆਪੇ ਿਭਿਖਆ  ਪਾਇਦਾ  ਸਭ ਿਸਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਈ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord God is my Best Friend. My mind and body are drenched withthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: har parabh sajan  naam har mai man t an naam sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਮਗਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥
lines.english: All the hopes of the Gurmukh are fulfilled; servant Nanak is comforted, hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sabh aasaa gurmukh  pooree-aa jan naanak sun  har Dh eer. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੁ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਹ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Pauree:
lines.transliteration: pa-orhee.

lines.english: The Lord's Sublime Name is energizing and rejuvenating. The Immaculate Lord, thePrimal Being, blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: har ootam hari-aa naam hai har purakh  niranjan ma-ulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰੀਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Maya serves at the feet of those who chant and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, dayand night.
lines.transliteration: jo japday har har d inas raat  tin sayvay charan nit  ka-ulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਆਸਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪੂਰੀਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਣ ਹਿਰ ਧੀਰ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord always looks after and cares for all His beings and creatures; He is with all,near and far.
lines.transliteration: nit saar samaalHay sabh  jee-a jant  har vasai nikat sabh  ja-ulaa.

lines.english: Those whom the Lord inspires to understand, understand; the True Guru, God, thePrimal Being, is pleased with them.
lines.transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujh aa-isee jis sat gur purakh  parabh  sa-ulaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰਆ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਮਉਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone sing the Praise of the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of theUniverse, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe; singing the Praise of the Lord, one isabsorbed in His Glorious Virtues. ||6|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1315-15) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh gaavhu gun  govind  haray govind  haray govind  haray gun  gaavat  gunee sama- ulaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ ਿਤਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਚਰਨ  ਿਨਤ ਕਉਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, even in sleep, remember the Lord God; let yourself be intuitively absorbed into the Celestial State of Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: suti-aa har parabh  chayt  man har sahj samaaDh  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਸਾਿਰ  ਸਮਾਲੇ  ਸਭ ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਸਭ ਜਉਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak's mind longs for the Lord, Har, Har. As the Guru pleases, he isabsorbed into the Lord, O mother. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1315-16) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har har chaa-o man gur tuth aa maylay maa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਇਸੀ  ਿਜਸੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਉਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am in love with the One and Only Lord; the One Lord fills my consciousness.
lines.transliteration: har ikas saytee pirharh ee har iko mayrai chit .

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਹਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਹਰੇ ਗੋਿਵੰਦ  ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ  ਗੁਣੀ  ਸਮਉਲਾ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak takes the Support of the One Lord God; through the One, he obtainshonor and salvation. ||2|| pauVI ] (1315-18) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ik aDhaar har parabh  ikas t ay gat  pat. ||2||

lines.english: The Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrate with the Wisdom of the Guru'sTeachings; by great good fortune, the Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds.
lines.transliteration: panchay sabad vajay mat  gurmat  vadbh aagee anhad  vaji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਚੇਿਤ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I see the Lord, the Source of Bliss, everywhere; through the Word of the Guru'sShabad, the Lord of the Universe is revealed.
lines.transliteration: aanad mool raam sabh  daykhi-aa gur sabd ee govid  gaji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚਾਉ  ਮਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ  ਮੇਲੇ ਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From the primal beginning, and throughout the ages, the Lord has One Form. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, I vibrate and meditate on the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  vays har ayko mat  gurmat  har parabh  bhaji-aa.

lines.english: O Merciful Lord God, please bless me with Your Bounty; O Lord God, please preserve and protect the honor of Your humble servant. pMnw 1316
lines.transliteration: har dayvhu d aan d a-i-aal parabh  jan raakh o har parabh  laji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਲਿਜਆ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone proclaim: Blessed is the Guru, the True Guru, the Guru, the True Guru; meeting Him, the Lord covers their faults and deficiencies. ||7|| sloku mÚ 4 ] (1316-2) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh Dh an kahhu gur sat guroo gur sat guroo jit  mil har parh -daa kaji-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਪੜਦਾ  ਕਿਜਆ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The sacred pool of devotional worship is filled to the brim and overflowing in torrents.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  sarovar uchh lai subh ar bharay vahann.

lines.english: Those who obey the True Guru, O servant Nanak, are very fortunate - they find it.||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1316-3) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur mani-aa jan naanak vad bh aag lahann. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਉਛਲੈ  ਸੁਭਰ  ਭਰੇ ਵਹੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: The Names of the Lord, Har, Har, are countless. The Glorious Virtues of the Lord, Har,Har, cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: har har naam asaNkh har har kay gun kathan na jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਲਹੰਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; how can the humble servants of the Lord be united in His Union?
lines.transliteration: har har agam agaaDh har jan kit  biDh mileh milaahi.

lines.english: Those humble beings meditate and chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, but theydo not attain even a tiny bit of His Worth.
lines.transliteration: har har jas japat japant  jan ik t il nahee keemat  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਅਸੰਖ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Lord God is Inaccessible; the Lord has attached me to His Robe,and united me in His Union. ||2|| pauVI ] (1316-6) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har agam parabh har mayl laihu larh  laa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਕਤੁ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਿਮਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. How will I see the Blessed Vision of theLord's Darshan?
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar agam har ki-o kar har darsan pikh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਜਪੰਤ  ਜਨ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If He were a material object, then I could describe Him, but He has no form or feature.
lines.transliteration: kichh vakh ar ho-ay so varnee-ai t is roop na rikh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਲੈਹੁ ਲਿੜ  ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Understanding comes only when the Lord Himself gives understanding; only such ahumble being sees it.
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaa-ay aap bujh aa-ay d ay-ay so-ee jan d ikhaa.

lines.english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru, is the school of the soul,where the Glorious Virtues of the Lord are studied.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  satgur chatsaal hai jit  har gun  sikhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਿਪਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an so rasnaa Dh an kar Dh an so paaDh aa sat guroo jit  mil har laykh aa likh aa. ||8|| Blessed, blessed is the tongue, blessed is the hand, and blessed is the Teacher, theTrue Guru; meeting Him, the Account of the Lord is written. ||8|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1316-9) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਛੁ  ਵਖਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਵਰਨੀਐ  ਿਤਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਿਰਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Meditate on the Lord, with lovefor the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: har har naam amrit hai har japee-ai sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ  ਆਿਪ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਿਦਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har is Sacred and Pure. Chanting it and listening to it,pain is taken away.
lines.transliteration: har har naam pavit hai har japat  sunat  dukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਚਟਸਾਲ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਿਸਖਾ  ॥
lines.english: They alone worship and adore the Lord's Name, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.
lines.transliteration: har naam tinee aaraaDh i-aa jin mast ak likh i-aa Dh ur paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਧੰਨੁ ਕਰ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਪਾਧਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਲੇਖਾ  ਿਲਖਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord; the Lord comes to abide intheir minds.
lines.transliteration: har dargeh jan painaa-ee-an jin har man vasi-aa aa-ay.

lines.english: O servant Nanak, their faces are radiant. They listen to the Lord; their minds are filledwith love. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1316-12) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tay mukh  ujlay jin har sun i-aa man bh aa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੀਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the greatest treasure. The Gurmukhs obtain it.
lines.transliteration: har har naam niDhaan hai gurmukh  paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: jin Dhur mast ak likh i-aa tin sat gur mili-aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਨੀ  ਆਰਾਿਧਆ  ਿਜਨ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed; peace and tranquility come to dwellin their minds.
lines.transliteration: tan man seet al ho-i-aa saaNt vasee man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਜਨ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਿਨ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all poverty and pain is dispelled.||2|| pauVI ] (1316-14) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak har har cha-udi-aa sabh  daalad  dukh leh jaa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਿਣਆ  ਮਿਨ ਭਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, forever and ever, to those who have seen my Beloved True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o vaari-aa tin ka-o sad aa sad aa jinaa sat gur mayraa pi-aaraa d aykhi-aa.

lines.english: They alone meet my True Guru, who have such pre-ordaind destiny written upon theirforeheads.
lines.transliteration: tin ka-o mili-aa mayraa sat guroo jin ka-o Dh ur mast ak laykh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Inaccessible Lord, according to the Guru's Teachings; God has noform or feature.
lines.transliteration: har agam Dhi-aa-i-aa gurmat ee tis roop nahee parabh  raykh -i-aa.

lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Inaccessible Lord, merge with their Lord and Master and become one with Him.
lines.transliteration: gur bachan Dhi-aa-i-aa jinaa agam har t ay thaakur sayvak ral ayki-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਹੋਇਆ  ਸਿਤ  ਵਸੀ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Let everyone proclaim out loud, the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord; the profit of devotional worship of the Lord is blessed and sublime. ||9|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1316-18) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kwnVw, mÚ 4) sabh kahhu mukh ahu nar narharay nar narharay nar narharay har laahaa har bh agat vasaykhi-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਚਉਿਦਆ  ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਦੁਖੁ ਲਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is permeating and pervading all. Repeat the Name of the Lord,Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ram rav rahay ram raamo raam rameet.

lines.english: The Lord is in the home of each and every soul. God created this play with its variouscolors and forms.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at aat am raam hai parabh  khayl kee-o rang reet .

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਿਪਆਰਾ  ਦੇਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Life of the World, dwells near at hand. The Guru, my Friend, has made this clear. pMnw 1317
lines.transliteration: har nikat vasai jagjeevanaa pargaas kee-o gur meet.

lines.english: They alone meet the Lord, the Lord God, their Lord and Master, whose love for the Lord is pre-ordained.
lines.transliteration: har su-aamee har parabh t in milay jin likh i-aa Dh ur har pareet .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਤਨ ਿਮਲੇ ਿਜਨ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, chant it consciously with your mind. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1317-2) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam Dhi-aa-i-aa gur bachan japi-o man cheet . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਜਿਪਓ  ਮਿਨ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Seek the Lord God, your Best Friend; by great good fortune, He comes to dwell withthe very fortunate ones.
lines.transliteration: har parabh sajan  lorh lahu bh aag vasai vadbh aag.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed, O Nanak, and one is lovingly attuned to theLord. ||2|| pauVI ] (1317-3) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: gur poorai daykh aali-aa naanak har liv laag. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋਿੜ  ਲਹੁ ਭਾਿਗ  ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an suhaavee safal gh arhee jit har sayvaa man bh aanee. Blessed, blessed, beauteous and fruitful is that moment, when service to the Lordbecomes pleasing to the mind.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਿਲਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਿਗ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: So proclaim the story of the Lord, O my GurSikhs; speak the Unspoken Speech of myLord God.
lines.transliteration: har kathaa sunavhu mayray gursikh ahu mayray har parabh  akath kahaan ee.

lines.english: How can I attain Him? How can I see Him? My Lord God is All-knowing and All-seeing.
lines.transliteration: ki-o paa-ee-ai ki-o daykh ee-ai mayraa har parabh  sugh arh sujaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ  ਸਫਲ  ਘੜੀ  ਿਜਤੁ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਿਨ ਭਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself; we merge in absorption in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har mayl dikh aa-ay aap har gur bachnee naam samaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਿਸਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਕਥ  ਕਹਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is a sacrifice unto those who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||10|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1317-6) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tin vitahu naanak vaari-aa jo japd ay har nirbaan ee. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਕਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਮੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: One's eyes are anointed by the Lord God, when the Guru bestows the ointment ofspiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: har parabh rat ay lo-in aa gi-aan anjan gur d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਦਖਾਏ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have found God, my Best Friend; servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord.||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1317-7) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mai parabh sajan  paa-i-aa jan naanak sahj milay-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Gurmukh is filled with peace and tranquility deep within. His mind and body areabsorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar saaNt hai man t an naam samaa-ay.

lines.english: He thinks of the Naam, and reads the Naam; he remains lovingly attuned to theNaam.
lines.transliteration: naam chitvai naamo parh ai naam rahai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ  ਿਗਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: He obtains the Treasure of the Naam, and is rid of anxiety.
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paa-ee-ai chint aa ga-ee bilaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਲੇਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, the Naam wells up, and all hunger and thirst depart.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai naam oopjai t arisnaa bh ukh sabh  jaa-ay.
