lines.english: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Naam, gathers the Naam in his lap. ||2|| pauVI ] (1317-10) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak naamay rati-aa naamo palai paa-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਤਿਰ ਸਿਤ  ਹੈ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself control it.
lines.transliteration: tuDh aapay jagat  upaa-ay kai t uDh aapay vasgat  keetaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some are self-willed manmukhs - they lose. Others are united with the Guru - they win.
lines.transliteration: ik manmukh kar haaraa-i-an iknaa mayl guroo t inaa jeet aa.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, the Lord God is Sublime. The fortunate ones chant it, throughthe Word of the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: har ootam har parabh  naam hai gur bachan sabh aagai leet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: All pain and poverty are taken away, when the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: dukh daalad  sabh o leh ga-i-aa jaaN naa-o guroo har d eetaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੇ ਰਿਤਆ  ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let everyone serve the Enticing Enticer of the Mind, the Enticer of the World, whocreated the world, and controls it all. ||11|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1317-13) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh sayvhu mohno manmohno jagmohno jin jagat  upaa-ay sabh o vas keet aa. ||11||

lines.english: The disease of egotism is deep within the mind; the self-willed manmukhs and the evil beings are deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: man antar ha-umai rog hai bh aram bh oolay manmukh  durjanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ  ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਕੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the disease is cured only by meeting with the True Guru, the Holy Friend.||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1317-14) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rog vanjaa-ay mil sat gur saaDh oo sajnaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਿਰ ਹਾਰਾਇਅਨ ੁ ਇਕਨਾ  ਮੇਿਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਤਨਾ  ਜੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are embellished and exalted, when I behold the Lord with my eyes.
lines.transliteration: man tan t aam sagaaravaa jaaN daykhaa har nain ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਸਭਾਗੈ  ਲੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meeting with that God, I live, hearing His Voice. ||2|| pauVI ] (1317-15) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: naanak so parabh mai milai ha-o jeevaa sad  sunay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ  ਸਭੋ ਲਿਹ ਗਇਆ  ਜ ਨਾਉ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਦੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator is the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, the Infinite PrimalImmeasurable Being.
lines.transliteration: jagannaath jagdeesar kart ay aprampar purakh  atol.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਨੋ  ਮਨਮੋਹਨੋ  ਜਗਮੋਹਨੋ  ਿਜਿਨ ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਸਭੋ ਵਿਸ ਕੀਤਾ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord's Name, O my GurSikhs; the Lord is Sublime, the Lord's Name isInvaluable.
lines.transliteration: har naam Dhi-aavahu mayray gursikh ahu har oot am har naam amol.

lines.english: Those who meditate on Him in their hearts, day and night, merge with the Lord -there is no doubt about it.
lines.transliteration: jin Dhi-aa-i-aa hird ai dinas raat  tay milay nahee har rol.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, they join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, and speak the Word of the Guru, the Perfect True Guru.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee sangat  milai gur sat gur pooraa bol.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੋਗੁ ਵਞਾਇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, by which alldisputes and conflicts with Death are ended. ||12|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1317-18) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh Dh i-aavahu nar naaraa-in o naaraa-in o jit chookaa jam jh agarh  jhagol. ||12||

lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name, Har, Har. The foolish idiot shootsarrows at him.
lines.transliteration: har jan har har cha-udi-aa sar sanDh i-aa gaavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਿਮ  ਸਗਾਰਵਾ  ਜ ਦੇਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਨੈਣੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is saved by the Love of the Lord. The arrow is turned around, and kills the one who shot it. ||1|| pMnw 1318 mÚ 4 ] (1318-1) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak har jan har liv ubray jin sanDhi-aa t is fir maar. ||1||

lines.english: The eyes which are attracted by the Lord's Love behold the Lord through the Name ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: akhee paraym kasaa-ee-aa har har naam pikh aNniH.

lines.english: If they gaze upon something else, O servant Nanak, they ought to be gouged out.||2|| pauVI ] (1318-2) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jay kar doojaa d aykh-day jan naanak kadh  dichaNniH. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੀ  ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਕਸਾਈਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਪਖੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: The Infinite Lord totally permeates the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al poorno aprampar so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕਿਰ ਦੂਜਾ  ਦੇਖਦੇ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਿਢ  ਿਦਚੰਿਨ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures; whatever He does comes to pass.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant part ipaald aa jo karay so ho-ee.

lines.english: Without Him, we have no mother, father, children, sibling or friend.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa sut  bharaat meet  tis bin nahee ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਲ  ਥਿਲ ਮਹੀਅਿਲ  ਪੂਰਨੋ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He is permeating and pervading deep within each and every heart; let everyonemeditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar rav rahi-aa japi-ahu jan ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Let all chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, who is manifest all over theworld. ||13|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1318-4) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sagal japahu gopaal gun pargat sabh lo-ee. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਭਰ੍ਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who meet as friends are blessed with the Lord God's Love.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh milay se sajn aa har parabh  paa-i-aa rang.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ ਜਿਪਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall go to His court injoyous high spirits. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1318-5) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too lud lud d argahi vanj . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਜਪਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਗੁਨ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Lord, You are the Great Giver of all; all beings are Yours.
lines.transliteration: har toohai d aataa sabh as daa sabh  jee-a t umHaaray.

lines.english: They all worship You in adoration; You bless them with Your Bounty, O Beloved.
lines.transliteration: sabh t uDhai no aaraaDh aday daan d eh pi-aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਮਲੇ ਿਸ ਸਜਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: The Generous Lord, the Great Giver reaches out with His Hands, and the rain poursdown on the world.
lines.transliteration: har daat ai daataar hath kadh i-aa meehu vuth aa saisaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਲੁਿਡ  ਲੁਿਡ  ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਵੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The corn germinates in the fields; contemplate the Lord's Name with love.
lines.transliteration: ann jammi-aa khayt ee bh aa-o kar har naam samHaaray.

lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the Gift of the Support of the Name of his Lord God. ||2|| pauVI ] (1318-8) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mangai daan parabh  har naam aDh aaray. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤੂਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭਸ  ਦਾ ਸਿਭ ਜੀਅ  ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The desires of the mind are satisfied, meditating on the Ocean of Peace.
lines.transliteration: ichhaa man kee pooree-ai japee-ai sukh  saagar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਿਹ ਿਪਆਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Worship and adore the Feet of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, thejewel mine.
lines.transliteration: har kay charan araaDhee-ah gur sabad  ratnaagar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਾਿਰ  ਹਥੁ ਕਿਢਆ  ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and the Decree of Death is torn up.
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhoo sang uDh aar ho-ay faatai jam kaagar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਿਮਆ  ਖੇਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The treasure of this human life is won, meditating on the Lord of Detachment.
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath jeet ee-ai jap har bairaagar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Let everyone seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru; let the black spot of pain, the scarof suffering, be erased. ||14|| slok mÚ 4 ] (1318-10) salok mehlaa 4. Shalok, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sabh pavahu saran sat guroo kee binsai d ukh daagar. ||14||

lines.english: I was seeking, searching for my Friend, but my Friend is right here with me.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhooNdhayNdee sajn aa sajan  maidai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਇਛਾ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਐ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O servant Nanak, the Unseen is not seen, but the Gurmukh is given to see Him. ||1|| mÚ 4 ] (1318-12) mehlaa 4. Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak alakh na lakh ee-ai gurmukh  deh dikhaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਾਧੀਅਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am in love with the True Lord; I cannot survive without Him.
lines.transliteration: naanak pareet laa-ee t in sachai t is bin rahan  na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the Perfect Lord is found, and the tongue savors His SublimeEssence. ||2|| pauVI ] (1318-13) pa-orhee. Pauree:
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t a pooraa paa-ee-ai har ras rasan rasaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤੀਐ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਬੈਰਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Some sing, some listen, and some speek and preach.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee gaavai ko sunai ko uchar sunaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਪਵਹੁ ਸਰਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕੀ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਦੁਖ ਦਾਗਰੁ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The filth and pollution of countless lifetimes is washed away, and the wishes of the mind are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee mal utrai man chind i-aa paavai.

lines.english: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa maytee-ai har kay gun  gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਢੂੰਢੇਂਦੀ  ਸਜਣਾ  ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੈਡੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: They save themselves, and save their companions; they save all their generations aswell.
lines.transliteration: aap tareh sangee t araahi sabh  kutamb t araavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਿਹ ਿਦਖਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||15||1||Sudh|| rwgu kwnVw bwxI nwmdyv jIau kI  (1318-16) raag kaanrhaa ban ee naamd ayv jee-o kee Raag Kaanraa, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1318-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaarn ai jo mayray har parabh  bhaavai. ||15||1|| suDh .

lines.english: Such is the Sovereign Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts;
lines.transliteration: aiso raam raa-ay antarjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਾਈ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਚੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He sees everything as clearly as one's face reflected in a mirror. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jaisay darpan maahi bad an parvaanee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਸਨ  ਰਸਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He dwells in each and every heart; no stain or stigma sticks to Him.
lines.transliteration: basai ghataa gh at leep na chh eepai.

lines.english: He is liberated from bondage; He does not belong to any social class. ||1||
lines.transliteration: banDhan mukt aa jaat  na deesai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ  ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋ ਉਚਿਰ  ਸੁਨਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: As one's face is reflected in the water,
lines.transliteration: paanee maahi daykh  mukh  jaisaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Raag Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl: <> siqnwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1319-2) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear.No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: naamay ko su-aamee beethal aisaa. ||2||1|| so does Naam Dayv's Beloved Lord and Master appear. ||2||1|| pMnw 1319 rwgu kilAwn mhlw 4 (1319-1) raag kali-aan mehlaa 4

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਿਲਆਨ  ਮਹਲਾ  ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਨਾਮੁ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord, the Beauteous Lord - no one has found His limits.
lines.transliteration: raamaa ram raamai ant na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਾ  ਰਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I am a child - You cherish and sustain me. You are the Great Primal Being, my Mother and Father. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham baarik partipaaray t umray t oo bad purakh  pitaa mayraa maa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਾਿਰਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਰੇ  ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਤੂ ਬਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Names of the Lord are Countless and Unfathomable. My Sovereign Lord isUnfathomable and Incomprehensible.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam asaNkh agam heh agam agam har raa-i-aa.

lines.english: The virtuous and the spiritual teachers have given it great thought, but they have not found even an iota of His Value. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gunee gi-aanee surat  baho keenee ik t il nahee keemat  paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਸੰਖ  ਅਗਮ  ਹਿਹ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਮ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe forever. They singthe Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, but they do not find His limits.
lines.transliteration: gobid gun  gobid  sad gaavahi gun  gobid  ant na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣੀ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are Immeasurable, Unweighable, and Infinite, O Lord and Master; no matter howmuch one may meditate on You, Your Depth cannot be fathomed. ||2||
lines.transliteration: too amit  atol aprampar su-aamee baho japee-ai thaah na paa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਸਦ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬਦ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Lord, Your humble servants praise You, singing Your Glorious Praises, O SovereignLord.
lines.transliteration: ustat karahi t umree jan maaDh ou gun gaavahi har raa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਿਮਿਤ  ਅਤੋਲੁ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਬਹੁ ਜਪੀਐ  ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You are the ocean of water, and I am Your fish. No one has ever found Your limits. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tumH jal niDh  ham meenay t umray t ayraa ant  na kat hoo paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਜਨ ਮਾਧੌ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Please be Kind to Your humble servant, Lord; please bless me with the meditation ofYour Name.
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o kirpaa karahu maDhsood an har d ayvhu naam japaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਿਨਿਧ  ਹਮ ਮੀਨੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ  ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a blind fool; Your Name is my only Support. Servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, has found it. ||4||1|| kilAwnu mhlw 4 ] (1319-10) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh anDh ulay naam tayk hai jan naanak gurmukh  paa-i-aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ  ਹਿਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord sings the Lord's Praise, and blossoms forth.
lines.transliteration: har jan gun gaavat hasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: My intellect is embellished with devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, through the Guru'sTeachings. This is the destiny which God has recorded on my forehead. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat  banee mat  gurmat  Dhur mast ak parabh  likhi-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I meditate in remembrance on the Guru's Feet, day and night. The Lord, Har, Har,Har, comes to dwell in my mind.
lines.transliteration: gur kay pag simra-o din raat ee man har har har basi-aa.

lines.english: The Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is Excellent and Sublime in this world. His Praiseis the sandalwood paste which I rub. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har har keerat jag saaree gh as chand an jas gh asi-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ ਬਨੀ ਮਿਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har, Har; all thefaithless cynics pursue him.
lines.transliteration: har jan har har har liv laa-ee sabh saakat  khoj pa-i-aa.

lines.english: The slanderous person acts in accordance with the record of his past deeds; his foottrips over the snake, and he is stung by its bite. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o kirat sanjog chali-o nar nind ak pag naagan chh uhi jali-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਿਸਮਰਉ  ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਬਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: O my Lord and Master, You are the Saving Grace, the Protector of Your humble servants. You protect them, age after age.
lines.transliteration: jan kay tumH har raakh ay su-aamee t umH jug jug jan rakh i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਜਿਗ  ਸਾਰੀ  ਘਿਸ  ਚੰਦਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਘਿਸਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: What does it matter, if a demon speaks evil? By doing so, he only gets frustrated.||3||
lines.transliteration: kahaa bha-i-aa d ait karee bakh eelee sabh  kar kar jh ar pari-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਸਿਭ ਸਾਕਤ  ਖੋਿਜ ਪਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: All the beings and creatures created by God are caught in the mouth of Death.
lines.transliteration: jaytay jee-a jant  parabh  kee-ay sabh  kaalai mukh  garsi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਕਰਤ  ਸੰਜੋਿਗ  ਚਿਲਓ  ਨਰ ਿਨੰਦਕੁ  ਪਗੁ ਨਾਗਿਨ  ਛੁਿਹ ਜਿਲਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord are protected by the Lord God, Har, Har, Har;servant Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||2|| kilAwn mhlw 4 ] (1319-16) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl: pMnw 1320
lines.transliteration: har jan har har har parabh raakh ay jan naanak saran pa-i-aa. ||4||2||

lines.english: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Master of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap jap jagaNnaathay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, meditate on the Lord's Name, and be rid of all thepainful past sins. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur updays har naam Dh i-aa-i-o sabh  kilbikh  dukh laathay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I have only one tongue - I cannot sing His Praises. Please bless me with many, manytongues.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa ayk jas gaa-ay na saakai baho keejai baho rasunathay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਏਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇ  ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ  ਬਹੁ ਰਸੁਨਥੇ  ॥
lines.english: Again and again, each and every instant, with all of them, I would sing His Glorious Praises; but even then, I would not be able to sing all of Your Praises, God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baar baar khin pal sabh  gaavahi gun kahi na sakahi parabh  tumnathay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲ ਸਿਭ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਨ ਕਿਹ ਨ ਸਕਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਨਥੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am so deeply in love with God, my Lord and Master; I long to see God's Vision.
lines.transliteration: ham baho pareet lagee parabh  su-aamee ham lochah parabh  dikhnathay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਬਹੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਲੋਚਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਦਖਨਥੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Great Giver of all beings and creatures; only You know our inner pain.||2||
lines.transliteration: tum bad d aatay jee-a jee-an kay t um jaanhu ham birthay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਬਡ ਦਾਤੇ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੀਅਨ  ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਿਬਰਥੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If only someone would show me the Way, the Path of God. Tell me - what could Igive him?
lines.transliteration: ko-ee maarag panth bataavai parabh  kaa kaho t in ka-o ki-aa d inthay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਿਕਆ  ਿਦਨਥੇ  ॥
lines.english: I would surrender, offer and dedicate all my body and mind to him; if only someonewould unite me in God's Union! ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabh t an man arpa-o arap araapa-o ko-ee maylai parabh  milthay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ  ਅਰਿਪ  ਅਰਾਪਉ  ਕੋਈ ਮੇਲੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਮਲਥੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are so many and numerous; I can describe only a tinybit of them.
lines.transliteration: har kay gun bahut bahut  baho sobh aa ham t uchh kar kar barnathay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਮ ਤੁਛ ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਬਰਨਥੇ  ॥
lines.english: My intellect is under Your control, God; You are the All-powerful Lord God of servantNanak. ||4||3|| kilAwn mhlw 4 ] (1320-7) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: hamree mat vasgat  parabh  tumrai jan naanak kay parabh  samrathay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੀ  ਮਿਤ ਵਸਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਮਰਥੇ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, which are said to be inexpressible.
lines.transliteration: mayray man jap har gun akath suntha-ee.

lines.english: Dharam arath sabh  kaam mokh  hai jan peechh ai lag firtha-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o. Rightousness and Dharmic faith, success and prosperity, pleasure, the fulfillment ofdesires and liberation - all follow the humble servant of the Lord like a shadow.||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਅਕਥ  ਸੁਨਥਈ  ॥
lines.english: That humble servant of the Lord who has such good fortune written on his foreheadmeditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: so har har naam Dhi-aavai har jan jis badbh aag math-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮੁ  ਅਰਥੁ  ਸਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਮੋਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਿਗ  ਿਫਰਥਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In that Court, where God calls for the accounts, there, you shall be saved only bymeditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jah dargahi parabh  laykh aa maagai t ah chh utai naam Dh i-aa-itha-ee. ||1||

lines.english: I am stained with the filth of the mistakes of countless lifetimes, the pain and pollutionof egotism.
lines.transliteration: hamray dokh  baho janam janam kay d ukh ha-umai mail lagtha-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵੈ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਿਜਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਈ  ॥
lines.english: Showering His Mercy, the Guru bathed me in the Water of the Lord, and all my sinsand mistakes were taken away. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur Dhaar kirpaa har jal naavaa-ay sabh  kilbikh  paap gath-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦਰਗਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮਾਗੈ  ਤਹ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਥਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: God, our Lord and Master, is deep within the hearts of His humble servants. Theyvibrate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jan kai rid ant ar parabh  su-aamee jan har har naam bh ajtha-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੇ  ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਕੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗਥਈ  ॥
lines.english: And when that very last moment comes, then the Naam is our Best Friend andProtector. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jah antee a-osar aa-ay banat  hai tah raakh ai naam saath-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਲ  ਨਾਵਾਏ  ਸਭ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਪਾਪ ਗਥਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Your humble servants sing Your Praises, O Lord, Har, Har; they chant and meditate on the Lord God, the Master of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: jan tayraa jas gaavahi har har parabh  har japi-o jagaNnatha-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਥਈ  ॥
lines.english: O God, my Saving Grace, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, please save me, thesinking stone. ||4||4|| kilAwn mhlw 4 ] (1320-13) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kay parabh raakh ay su-aamee ham paathar rakh  budtha-ee. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਅੰਤੀ  ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ  ਬਨਤੁ  ਹੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਥਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Only the Lord God knows my innermost thoughts.
lines.transliteration: hamree chitvanee har parabh  jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਜਗੰਨਥਈ  ॥
lines.english: If someone slanders the humble servant of the Lord, God does not believe even a tinybit of what he says. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kilAwn, mÚ 4) a-or ko-ee nind karai har jan kee parabh  taa kaa kahi-aa ik t il nahee maanai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ  ਰਖੁ ਬੁਡਥਈ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: So give up everything else, and serve the Imperishable; The Lord God, our Lord andMaster, is the Highest of all.
lines.transliteration: a-or sabh t i-aag sayvaa kar achut  jo sabh  tay ooch th aakur bh agvaanai.

lines.english: When you serve the Lord, Death cannot even see you. It comes and falls at the feetof those who know the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har sayvaa tay kaal johi na saakai charnee aa-ay pavai har jaanai. ||1||

lines.english: Those whom my Lord and Master protects - a balanced wisdom comes to their ears.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o raakh lay-ay mayraa su-aamee t aa ka-o sumat  day-ay pai kaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਿਨੰਦ  ਕਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਹਆ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: No one can equal them; their devotional worship is accepted by my God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o ko-ee apar na saakai jaa kee bh agat mayraa parabh  maanai. ||2||

lines.english: So behold the Wondrous and Amazing Play of the Lord. In an instant, He distinguishes the genuine from the counterfeit.
lines.transliteration: har kay choj vidaan daykh  jan jo kh otaa kh araa ik nimakh  pachh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਰ ਸਭ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਰ ਅਚੁਤ  ਜੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: And that is why His humble servant is in bliss. Those of pure heart meet together,while the evil ones regret and repent. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa tay jan ka-o anad  bha-i-aa hai rid  suDh  milay kh otay pachh utaanai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ  ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਚਰਨੀ ਆਇ  ਪਵੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Lord, You are the Great Giver, our All-powerful Lord and Master; O Lord, I beg foronly one gift from You.
lines.transliteration: tum har d aatay samrath su-aamee ik maaga-o t ujh paashu har d aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਦੇਇ ਪੈ ਕਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Lord, please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace, that Your Feet may abide forever within my heart. ||4||5|| pMnw 1321 kilAwn mhlw 4 ] (1321-1) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har kirpaa kar deejai sad  baseh rid ai mohi har charaanai. ||4||5||

lines.english: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless me, that I may sing the Glorious Praises of theLord.
lines.transliteration: parabh keejai kirpaa niDh aan ham har gun gaavhagay.

lines.english: I always place my hopes in You; O God, when will you take me in Your Embrace?||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ha-o tumree kara-o nit  aas parabh  mohi kab gal laavhigay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਹਮ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a foolish and ignorant child; Father, please teach me!
lines.transliteration: ham baarik mugaDh i-aan pit aa samjaavhigay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ  ਕਰਉ  ਿਨਤ  ਆਸ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮੋਿਹ ਕਬ ਗਿਲ  ਲਾਵਿਹਗੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your child makes mistakes again and again, but still, You are pleased with him, O Father of the Universe. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sut kh in khin bhool bigaar jagat  pit bhaavhigay. ||1||

lines.english: Whatever You give me, O my Lord and Master - that is what I receive.
lines.transliteration: jo har su-aamee tum d ayh so-ee ham paavhagay.

lines.english: There is no other place where I can go. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mohi doojee naahee th a-ur jis peh ham jaavhagay. ||2||

lines.english: Those devotees who are pleasing to the Lord - the Lord is pleasing to them.
lines.transliteration: jo har bhaaveh bh agat tinaa har bh aavhigay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਮ ਪਾਵਹਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Their light merges into the Light; the lights are merged and blended together. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jotee jot  milaa-ay jot  ral jaavhagay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਦੂਜੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਠਉਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਿਹ ਹਮ ਜਾਵਹਗੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself has shown mercy; He lovingly attunes me to Himself.
lines.transliteration: har aapay ho-ay kirpaal aap liv laavhigay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵਿਹ ਭਗਤ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵਿਹਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Door of the Lord, who protects his honor.||4||6|| Ckw 1 ] (1321-6) chhakaa 1. First Set of Six|| kilAwnu BopwlI mhlw 4  (1321-7) kali-aan bhopaalee mehlaa 4 Kalyaan Bhopaalee, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1321-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saran du-aar har laaj rakh aavhigay. ||4||6||

lines.english: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord and Master, Destroyer of pain, Transcendental Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parmaysur su-aamee dookh  nivaaran  naaraa-in ay.

lines.english: 4) sagal bhagat  jaacheh sukh  saagar bh av niDh  taran har chint aaman ay. ||1|| rahaa-o. All Your devotees beg of You. Ocean of peace, carry us across the terrifying world- ocean; You are the Wish-fulfilling Jewel. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਦੁਆਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਲਾਜ  ਰਖਾਵਿਹਗੇ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Merciful to the meek and poor, Lord of the world, Support of the earth, Inner-knower,Searcher of hearts, Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal jagd ees d amod ar har ant arjaamee gobind ay.

lines.english: Those who meditate on the Supreme Lord become fearless. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, they meditate on the Lord, the Liberator Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tay nirbh a-o jin sareeraam Dh i-aa-i-aa gurmat  muraar har mukand ay. ||1||

lines.english: Those who come to Sanctuary at the Feet of the Lord of the Universe - those humblebeings cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jagdeesur charan saran jo aa-ay t ay jan bh av niDh  paar paray.

lines.english: The Lord preserves the honor of His humble devotees; O servant Nanak, the LordHimself showers them with His Grace. ||2||1||7|| rwgu kilAwnu mhlw 5 Gru 1  (1321-13) raag kali-aan mehlaa 5 ghar 1 Raag Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl, First House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1321-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bhagat  janaa kee paij har raakh ai jan naanak aap har kirpaa karay. ||2||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਭਗਤ  ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਭਵ ਿਨਿਧ ਤਰਣ  ਹਿਰ ਿਚੰਤਾਮਣੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please grant me this blessing:
lines.transliteration: hamaarai ayh kirpaa keejai.

lines.english: May the bumble-bee of my mind be immersed again and again in the Honey of YourLotus Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: al makrand charan kamal si-o man fayr fayr reejh ai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਦਮੋਦਰ  ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦੇ  ॥
lines.english: I am not concerned with any other water; please bless this songbird with a Drop ofYour Water, Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aan jalaa si-o kaaj na kachhoo-ai har boond  chaat rik ka-o d eejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਜਨ ਸਰ੍ੀਰਾਮੁ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Unless I meet my Lord, I am not satisfied. Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Visionof His Darshan. ||2||1||
lines.transliteration: bin milbay naahee santokh aa paykh  darsan naanak jeejai. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ  ਚਰਨ  ਸਰਨ ਜੋ ਆਏ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kali-aan mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ  ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
lines.english: This beggar begs and begs for Your Name, Lord.
lines.transliteration: jaachik naam jaachai jaachai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਿਲਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Support of all, the Master of all, the Giver of absolute peace. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sarab Dhaar sarab kay naa-ik sukh  samooh kay d aatay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So many, so very many, beg for charity at Your Door; they receive only what You are pleased to give. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaytee kayt ee maaNgan maagai bh aavnee-aa so paa-ee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਲ  ਮਕਰੰਦ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਫੇਿਰ ਫੇਿਰ ਰੀਝੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Fruitful, fruitful, fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; touching His Touch, Ising His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: safal safal safal daras ray paras paras gun gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, one's essence is blended into the Essence; the diamond of the mind ispierced through by the Diamond of the Lord. ||2||2|| pMnw 1322 kilAwn mhlw 5 ] (1322-1) kali-aan mehlaa 5. Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak tat  tat si-o milee-ai heerai heer biDh aa-ee-ai. ||2||2||

lines.english: O, the Wondrous Glory of my Beloved!
lines.transliteration: mayray laalan kee sobhaa.

lines.english: My mind is rejuvenated forever by His Wondrous Love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sad navt an man rangee sobh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra beg for the charity of HisPraise and devotion to Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: barahm mahays siDh mun ind raa bh agat daan jas mangee. ||1||

lines.english: Yogis, spiritual teachers, meditators and the thousand-headed serpent all meditate onthe Waves of God.
lines.transliteration: jog gi-aan Dhi-aan saykh naagai sagal jaapeh t arangee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਮਹੇਸ ਿਸਧ ਮੁਿਨ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਦਾਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਮੰਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Saints, who are the Eternal Companions of God. ||2||3|| kilAwn mhlw 5 Gru 2  (1322-4) kali-aan mehlaa 5 ghar 2 Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl, Second House: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1322-4) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak santan balihaarai jo parabh  kay sad  sangee. ||2||3||

lines.english: Belief in You, Lord, brings honor.
lines.transliteration: tayrai maan har har maan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੀ  ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.english: To see with my eyes, and hear with my ears - every limb and fiber of my being, andmy breath of life are in bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nain bain sarvan sunee-ai ang angay sukh paraan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Here and there, and in the ten directions You are pervading, in the mountain and theblade of grass. ||1||
lines.transliteration: it ut dah dis ravi-o mayr t ineh samaan. ||1||

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, the Supreme Lord, the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: jat kat aa tat paykh ee-ai har purakh  pat parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਸੁਨੀਐ  ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗੇ  ਸੁਖ ਪਰ੍ਾਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, doubt and fear are dispelled. Nanakspeaks the Wisdom of God. ||2||1||4|| kilAwn mhlw 5 ] (1322-7) kali-aan mehlaa 5. Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang bh aram bh ai mitay kathay naanak barahm gi-aan. ||2||1||4||

lines.english: The Glory of God is the Sound-current of the Naad, the Celestial Music of Bliss, and the Wisdom of the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: gun naad Dh un anand bayd .

lines.punjabi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਰਿਵਓ  ਮੇਰ ਿਤਨਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Speaking and listening, the silent sages and humble beings join together, in the Realmof the Saints. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kathat sunat  mun janaa mil sant  mandlee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤਾ  ਤਤ ਪੇਖੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖ  ਪਿਤ ਪਰਧਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Spiritual wisdom, meditation, faith and charity are there; their minds savor the Tasteof the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting it, sins are destroyed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan maan d aan man rasik rasan naam japat  tah paap kh andlee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭੈ ਿਮਟੇ ਕਥੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨ  ॥੨॥੧॥੪॥
lines.english: This is the technology of Yoga, spiritual wisdom, devotion, intuitive knowledge of the Shabad, certain knowledge of the Essence of Reality, chanting and unbroken intensivemeditation.
lines.transliteration: jog jugat gi-aan bh ugat surat  sabad  tat baytay jap t ap akh andlee.

lines.english: Through and through, O Nanak, merging into the Light, you shall never again sufferpain and punishment. ||2||2||5|| kilAwnu mhlw 5 ] (1322-10) kali-aan mehlaa 5. Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: ot pot  mil jot  naanak kachh oo dukh na dandlee. ||2||2||5||

lines.english: What should I do, and how should I do it?
lines.transliteration: ka-un biDh t aa kee kahaa kara-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਥਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharat  Dhi-aan gi-aan sast argi-aa ajar pad  kaisay jara-o. ||1|| rahaa-o. Should I center myself in meditation, or study the spiritual wisdom of the Shaastras?How can I endure this unendurable state? ||1||Pause||
Vishnu, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - at whose door should I seek sanctuary? ||1||
lines.transliteration: bisan mahays siDh mun ind raa kai d ar saran para-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ  ਮਨ ਰਿਸਕ ਰਸਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ  ਤਹ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਲੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some have power and influence, and some are blessed with heavenly paradise, butout of millions, will anyone find liberation?
lines.transliteration: kaahoo peh raaj kaahoo peh surgaa kot maDhay mukat  kaha-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਭੁਗਿਤ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਬਦ  ਤਤ ਬੇਤੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਅਖੰਡਲੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have attained the Sublime Essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.I touch the feet of the Holy. ||2||3||6|| kilAwn mhlw 5 ] (1322-13) kali-aan mehlaa 5. Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak naam ras paa-ee-ai saaDhoo charan gaha-o. ||2||3||6||

lines.punjabi: ਓਿਤ  ਪੋਿਤ ਿਮਿਲ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਛੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਡੰਡਲੀ  ॥੨॥੨॥੫॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Breath of Life, the Merciful Primal Lord God, is my Friend.
lines.transliteration: paraanpat d a-i-aal purakh  parabh  sakhay.

lines.english: The Lord saves us from the womb of reincarnation and the noose of death in this DarkAge of Kali Yuga; He takes away our pain. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: garabh jon kal kaal jaal d ukh binaasan har rakh ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhaaree saran t ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਸਸਤਰ੍ਿਗਆ  ਅਜਰ  ਪਦੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Merciful Lord God, You are my only Support. ||1||
lines.transliteration: parabh d a-i-aal tayk mayree. ||1||

lines.english: You are the only Hope of the helpless, the meek and the poor.
lines.transliteration: anaath deen aasvant .

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਨ  ਮਹੇਸ  ਿਸਧ ਮੁਿਨ ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾ  ਕੈ ਦਿਰ ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your Name, O my Lord and Master, is the Mantra of the mind. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam su-aamee maneh mant. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੂ ਪਿਹ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਿਹ ਸੁਰਗਾ  ਕੋਿਟ ਮਧੇ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕਹਉ  ॥
lines.english: I know of nothing except You, God.
lines.transliteration: tujh binaa parabh  kichh oo na jaanoo.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ  ਗਹਉ  ॥੨॥੩॥੬॥
lines.english: Throughout all the ages, I realize You. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sarab jug meh tum pachh aanoo. ||3||

lines.english: O Lord, You dwell in my mind night and day.
lines.transliteration: har man basay nis baasro.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is Nanak's only Support. ||4||4||7|| kilAwn mhlw 5 ] (1322-17) kali-aan mehlaa 5. Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gobind naanak aasro. ||4||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਭ  ਜੋਿਨ ਕਿਲ  ਕਾਲ  ਜਾਲ  ਦੁਖ ਿਬਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Within my mind and body I meditate on the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: man tan jaapee-ai bh agvaan.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru is pleased and satisfied; I am blessed with eternal peace andhappiness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooray suparsan bha-ay sad aa sookh  kali-aan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: All affairs are successfuly resolved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of theWorld.
lines.transliteration: sarab kaaraj siDh bh a-ay gaa-ay gun gupaal.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I dwell upon God, and the pain of death is taken away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mil saaDhsangat  parabh oo simray naath i-aa d ukh kaal. ||1||

lines.english: Please take pity on me, O my God, that I may serve You day and night. pMnw 1323
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa parabh mayri-aa kara-o d in rain sayv.

lines.english: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Perfect, Divine Primal Being. ||2||5||8|| kilAwnu mhlw 5 ] (1323-1) kali-aan mehlaa 5. Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sarn aagat ee har purakh  pooran d ayv. ||2||5||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪੁਰਖ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੫॥੮॥
lines.english: My God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts.
lines.transliteration: parabh mayraa ant arjaamee jaan .

lines.english: Take pity on me, O Perfect Transcendent  Lord; bless me with the True Eternal Insignia of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa pooran parmaysar nihchal sach sabad neesaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: O Lord, other than You, no one is all-powerful. You are the Hope and the Strength ofmy mind.
lines.transliteration: har bin aan na ko-ee samrath tayree aas t ayraa man t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰ  ਿਨਹਚਲੁ  ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the Giver to the hearts of all beings, O Lord and Master. I eat and wearwhatever You give me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab ghataa kay d aatay su-aamee d eh so pahiran  khaan. ||1||

lines.english: Intuitive understanding, wisdom and cleverness, glory and beauty, pleasure, wealth and honor,
lines.transliteration: surat mat  chaturaa-ee sobh aa roop rang Dh an maan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਆਨ  ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ਤੇਰਾ ਮਿਨ ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh aanand  naanak jap raam naam kali-aan . ||2||6||9|| all comforts, bliss, happiness and salvation, O Nanak, come by chanting the Lord'sName. ||2||6||9|| kilAwnu mhlw 5 ] (1323-5) kali-aan mehlaa 5.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਘਟਾ  ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਦੇਿਹ ਸੁ ਪਿਹਰਣੁ  ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet bring salvation.
lines.transliteration: har charan saran kali-aan karan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.english: God's Name is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: parabh naam pat it paavno. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਿਪ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਲਆਣੁ  ॥੨॥੬॥੯॥
lines.english: Whoever chants and meditates in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shallundoubtedly escape being consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang jap nisang jamkaal t is na kh aavno. ||1||

lines.english: Liberation, the key to success, and all sorts of comforts do not equal loving devotionalworship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mukat jugat  anik sookh  har bh agat lavai na laavno.

lines.english: Slave Nanak longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; he shall never againwander in reincarnation. ||2||||7||10|| kilAwn mhlw 4 AstpdIAw ] (1323-8) kali-aan mehlaa 4 asatpadee-aa. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1323-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: parabh d aras lubaDh  daas naanak bahurh  jon na Dh aavno. ||2||7||10||

lines.english: Hearing the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, my mind is drenched with joy.
lines.transliteration: raamaa ram raamo sun man bheejai.

lines.english: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar, the most Sweet and Sublime Essence; through the Guru's Teachings, drink it in with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam amrit ras meeth aa gurmat  sehjay peejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The potential energy of fire is within the wood; it is released if you know how to rub itand generate friction.
lines.transliteration: kaasat meh ji-o hai baisantar math sanjam kaadh  kadh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਅਿਨਕ ਸੂਖ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਨੋ  ॥
lines.english: In just the same way, the Lord's Name is the Light within all; the Essence is extractedby following the Guru's Teachings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: raam naam hai jot sabaa-ee t at gurmat  kaadh  la-eejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਰਸ  ਲੁਬਧ  ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਧਾਵਨੋ  ॥੨॥੭॥੧੦॥
lines.english: There are nine doors, but the taste of these nine doors is bland and insipid. TheEssence of Ambrosial Nectar trickles down through the Tenth Door.
lines.transliteration: na-o darvaaj navay d ar feekay ras amrit  dasvay chu-eejai.

lines.english: Please take pity on me - be kind and compassionate, O my Beloved, that I may drinkin the Sublime Essence of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kirpaa kar pi-aaray gur sabdee har ras peejai. ||2||

lines.english: The body-village is the most sublime and exalted village, in which the merchandise ofthe Lord's Sublime Essence is traded.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar nagar hai neeko vich sa-udaa har ras keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਾ  ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਸੁਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The most precious and priceless gems and jewels are obtained by serving the True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ratan laal amol amolak sat gur sayvaa leejai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The True Guru is Inaccessible; Inaccessible is our Lord and Master. He is theoverflowing Ocean of bliss - worship Him with loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: satgur agam agam hai th aakur bh ar saagar bh agat kareejai.

lines.english: Please take pity on me, and be Merciful to this meek song-bird; please pour a drop ofYour Name into my mouth. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kar deen ham saaring ik boond  naam mukh  deejai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਸਟ  ਮਿਹ ਿਜਉ ਹੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਮਿਥ ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਕਢੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Beloved Lord, please color my mind with the Deep Crimson Color of Your Love; Ihave surrendered my mind to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: laalan laal laal hai rangan man rangan ka-o gur deejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਬਾਈ  ਤਤੁ ਗੁ ਰਮਿਤ  ਕਾਿਢ ਲਈਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, continuallydrink in this essence in big gulps, savoring its sweet taste. ||5||
lines.transliteration: raam raam raam rang raatay ras rasik gatak nit  peejai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜ  ਨਵੇ ਦਰ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਦਸਵੇ  ਚੁਈਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: If all the gold of the seven continents and the oceans was taken out and placedbefore them,
lines.transliteration: basuDhaa sapat  deep hai saagar kadh  kanchan kaadh  Dhareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਪਆਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur kay jan inahu na baachh eh har maageh har ras d eejai. ||6|| the humble servants of my Lord and Master would not even want it. They beg for theLord to bless them with the Lord's Sublime Essence. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਨਗਰੁ ਨਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਉਦਾ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics and mortal beings remain hungry forever; they continually cry outin hunger.
lines.transliteration: saakat nar paraanee sad  bhookhay nit  bhookhan bh ookh kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ  ਅਮੋਲ  ਅਮੋਲਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  Dhaa-ay Dh aaveh pareet  maa-i-aa lakh  kosan ka-o bith d eejai. ||7|| They hurry and run, and wander all around, caught in the love of Maya; they cover hundreds of thousands of miles in their wanderings. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗਮੁ  ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਿਰ ਸਾਗਰ  ਭਗਿਤ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The humble servants of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are sublime and exalted.What praise can we bestow upon them? pMnw 1324
lines.transliteration: har har har har har jan ootam ki-aa upmaa t inH deejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਿਲ  ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਉਪਮਾ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.english: Nothing else can equal the Glory of the Lord's Name; please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace. ||8||1|| kilAwn mhlw 4 ] (1324-1) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: raam naam tul a-or na upmaa jan naanak kirpaa kareejai. ||8||1||

lines.english: O Lord, please bless me with the Touch of the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.
lines.transliteration: raam gur paaras paras kareejai.

lines.english: I was unworthy, utterly useless, rusty slag; meeting with the True Guru, I wastransformed by the Philosopher's Stone. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ham nirgunee manoor at  feekay mil sat gur paaras keejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਿਨਰਗੁਣੀ  ਮਨੂਰ ਅਿਤ  ਫੀਕੇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Everyone longs for paradise, liberation and heaven; all place their hopes in them.
lines.transliteration: surag mukat baikunth  sabh  baaNchheh nit  aasaa aas kareejai.

lines.english: The humble long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they do not ask for liberation.Their minds are satisfied and comforted by His Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har darsan kay jan mukat  na maaNgeh mil d arsan t aripat  man Dh eejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਗ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਸਿਭ ਬਛਿਹ  ਿਨਿਤ  ਆਸਾ  ਆਸ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is very powerful; this attachment is a black stain which sticks.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh sabal hai bhaaree moh kaalakh  daag lageejai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸਨ  ਕੇ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਮਗਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ ਦਰਸਨ  ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The humble servants of my Lord and Master are unattached and liberated. They are like ducks, whose feathers do not get wet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: mayray thaakur kay jan alipat  hai mukt ay ji-o murgaa-ee pank na bh eejai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਲੁ  ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ  ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਲਖ  ਦਾਗ  ਲਗੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The fragrant sandalwood tree is encircled by snakes; how can anyone get to the sandalwood?
lines.transliteration: chandan vaas bh u-i-angam vayrh ee kiv milee-ai chand an leejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੇ ਜਨ ਅਿਲਪਤ  ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਿਜਉ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ  ਪੰਕੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Drawing out the Mighty Sword of the Guru's Spiritual Wisdom, I slaughter and kill thepoisonous snakes, and drink in the Sweet Nectar. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaadh kh arhag gur gi-aan karaaraa bikh  chhayd chhayd ras peejai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨ  ਵਾਸੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ  ਵੇੜੀ ਿਕਵ ਿਮਲੀਐ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: You may gather wood and stack it in a pile, but in an instant, fire reduces it to ashes.
lines.transliteration: aan aan samDhaa baho keenee pal baisant ar bhasam kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਿਢ  ਖੜਗੁ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ  ਿਬਖੁ ਛੇਿਦ  ਛੇਿਦ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic gathers the most horrendous sins, but meeting with the Holy Saint,they are placed in the fire. ||4||
lines.transliteration: mahaa ugar paap saakat nar keenay mil saaDh oo lookee d eejai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਨ  ਆਿਨ  ਸਮਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ  ਪਲੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ  ਭਸਮ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Holy, Saintly devotees are sublime and exalted. They enshrine the Naam, theName of the Lord, deep within.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo saaDh  saaDh  jan neekay jin ant ar naam Dh areejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਉਗਰ੍ ਪਾਪ ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰ ਕੀਨੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਲੂਕੀ  ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: By the touch of the Holy and the humble servants of the Lord, the Lord God is seen.||5||
lines.transliteration: paras nipras bha-ay saaDh oo jan jan har bh agvaan d ikheejai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ  ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The thread of the faithless cynic is totally knotted and tangled; how can anything be woven with it?
lines.transliteration: saakat soot  baho gurjh ee bh ari-aa ki-o kar t aan taneejai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਸ  ਿਨਪਰਸੁ  ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਿਦਖੀਜੈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: This thread cannot be woven into yarn; do not associate with those faithless cynics. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tant soot kichh  niksai naahee saakat  sang na keejai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੂਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਰਝੀ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਨੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are exalted andsublime. Joining the Congregation, meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur saaDh sangat  hai neekee mil sangat  raam raveejai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਤੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: The gems, jewels and precious stones are deep within; by Guru's Grace, they arefound. ||7||
lines.transliteration: antar rat an javayhar maan ak gur kirpaa t ay leejai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹੈ ਨੀਕੀ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is Glorious and Great. How can I be united in His Union?
lines.transliteration: mayraa thaakur vadaa vadaa hai su-aamee ham ki-o kar milah mileejai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ  ਮਾਣਕ  ਗੁ ਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Perfect Guru unites His humble servant in His Union, and blesses himwith perfection. ||8||2|| kilAwnu mhlw 4 ] (1324-12) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak mayl milaa-ay gur pooraa jan ka-o pooran deejai. ||8||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਮ ਿਕਉ  ਕਿਰ ਿਮਲਹ ਿਮਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: raamaa ram raamo raam raveejai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਏ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.english: The Holy, the humble and Holy, are noble and sublime. Meeting with the Holy, I joyfully love the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo saaDh  saaDh  jan neekay mil saaDh oo har rang keejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The minds of all the beings and creatures of the world waver unsteadily.
lines.transliteration: jee-a jant sabh  jag hai jayt aa man dolat  dol kareejai.

lines.english: Please take pity on them, be merciful to them, and unite them with the Holy; establish this support to support the world. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kirpaa kirpaa kar saaDh milaavhu jag thamman ka-o thamm d eejai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The earth is beneath us, and yet its dust falls down on all; let yourself be covered bythe dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: basuDhaa t alai talai sabh  oopar mil saaDh oo charan ruleejai.

lines.english: You shall be utterly exalted, the most noble and sublime of all; the whole world willplace itself at your feet. ||2||
lines.transliteration: at oot am at  ootam hovhu sabh  sisat charan t al deejai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਜੰਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ  ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ  ਡੋਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are blessed with the Divine Light of the Lord; Maya comes to servethem.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jot  bhalee siv neekee aan paanee sakat  bhareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਸਾਧੁ ਿਮਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਥੰਮਨ ਕਉ ਥੰਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, they bite with teeth of wax and chew iron,drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: maindant  niksay gur bachnee saar chab chab har ras peejai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ  ਰੁਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord has shown great mercy, and bestowed His Name; I have met with the HolyGuru, the Primal Being.
lines.transliteration: raam naam anoograhu baho kee-aa gur saaDhoo purakh  mileejai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਊਤਮ  ਅਿਤ  ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਭ ਿਸਸਿਟ  ਚਰਨ  ਤਲ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name have spread out everywhere; the Lord bestows fame all over the world. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gun raam naam bistheeran kee-ay har sagal bhavan jas d eejai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੋਿਤ  ਭਲੀ ਿਸਵ ਨੀਕੀ  ਆਿਨ  ਪਾਨੀ  ਸਕਿਤ  ਭਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Beloved Lord is within the minds of the Holy, the Holy Saadhus; without seeingHim, they cannot survive.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo saaDh  saaDh  man pareet am bin d aykhay reh na sakeejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈਨਦੰਤ  ਿਨਕਸੇ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ  ਸਾਰੁ ਚਿਬ ਚਿਬ ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The fish in the water loves only the water. Without water, it bursts and dies in an instant. ||5|| pMnw 1325
lines.transliteration: ji-o jal meen jalaN jal pareet hai kh in jal bin foot mareejai. ||5||

lines.english: Those who have terrible luck and bad fortune do not drink in the water which washes the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: mahaa abhaag abh aag hai jin kay t in saaDh oo Dh oor na peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਅਭਾਗ  ਅਭਾਗ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਿਤਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਿਰ ਨ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The burning fire of their desires is not extinguished; they are beaten and punished bythe Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tinaa t isnaa jalat  jalat nahee boojh eh dand Dh aram raa-ay kaa d eejai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਜਲਤ  ਜਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕਾ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: You may visit all the sacred shrines, observe fasts and sacred feasts, give generouslyin charity and waste away the body, melting it in the snow.
lines.transliteration: sabh t irath barat  jag-y punn kee-ay hivai gaal gaal t an chh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਭ ਤੀਰਥ  ਬਰਤ  ਜਗਯ੍ਯ੍ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀਏ ਿਹਵੈ ਗਾਿਲ  ਗਾਿਲ  ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The weight of the Lord's Name is unweighable, according to the Guru's Teachings;nothing can equal its weight. ||7||
lines.transliteration: atulaa t ol raam naam hai gurmat  ko pujai na t ol tuleejai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਅਤੁਲਾ  ਤੋਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਕੋ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲੀਜੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues. Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: tav gun barahm barahm t oo jaaneh jan naanak saran pareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਤੂ ਜਾਨਿਹ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Ocean of water, and I am Your fish. Please be kind, and keep me always with You. ||8||3|| kilAwn mhlw 4 ] (1325-5) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: too jal niDh  meen ham t ayray kar kirpaa sang rakh eejai. ||8||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਜਲ ਿਨਿਧ  ਮੀਨ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਖੀਜੈ  ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.english: I worship and adore the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: raamaa ram raamo pooj kareejai.

lines.english: I surrender my mind and body, and place everything before Him; following the Guru'sTeachings, spiritual wisdom is implanted within me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: man tan arap Dh ara-o sabh  aagai ras gurmat  gi-aan d arirheejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: God's Name is the tree, and His Glorious Virtues are the branches. Picking andgathering up the fruit, I worship Him.
lines.transliteration: barahm naam gun saakh  tarovar nit  chun chun pooj kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਿਪ  ਧਰਉ  ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ  ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The soul is divine; divine is the soul. Worship Him with love. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aatam d ay-o d ay-o hai aat am ras laagai pooj kareejai. ||1||

lines.english: One of keen intellect and precise understanding is immaculate in all this world. Inthoughtful consideration, he drinks in the sublime essence.
lines.transliteration: bibayk buDh sabh  jag meh nirmal bichar bichar ras peejai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ  ਿਨਤ  ਚੁਿਨ ਚੁਿਨ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the treasure is found; dedicate this mind to the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad pad aarath paa-i-aa sat gur ka-o ih man d eejai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਦੇਉ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਆਤਮੁ  ਰਿਸ ਲਾਗੈ  ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Priceless and utterly sublime is the Diamond of the Lord. This Diamond pierces the diamond of the mind.
lines.transliteration: nirmolak at heero neeko heerai heer biDh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਬੁਿਧ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਿਬਚਿਰ  ਿਬਚਿਰ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The mind becomes the jeweller, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; it appraises the Diamond of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: man motee saal hai gur sabd ee jit heeraa parakh  la-eejai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Attaching oneself to the Society of the Saints, one is exalted and uplifted, as thepalaas tree is absorbed by the peepal tree.
lines.transliteration: sangat sant  sang lag oochay ji-o peep palaas kh aa-ay leejai.

lines.english: That mortal being is supreme among all people, who is perfumed by the fragrance ofthe Lord's Name. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabh nar meh paraanee oot am hovai raam naamai baas baseejai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਪਰਿਖ  ਲਈਜੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who continually acts in goodness and immaculate purity, sprouts green branchesin great abundance.
lines.transliteration: nirmal nirmal karam baho keenay nit saakh aa haree jarh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਤ ਸੰਿਗ ਲਿਗ  ਊਚੇ ਿਜਉ ਪੀਪ ਪਲਾਸ  ਖਾਇ  ਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam ful fal gur gi-aan drirh -aa-i-aa behkaar baas jag d eejai. ||5|| The Guru has taught me that Dharmic faith is the flower, and spiritual wisdom is thefruit; this fragrance permeates the world. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਨਰ ਮਿਹ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਊਤਮੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸੀਜੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The One, the Light of the One, abides within my mind; God, the One, is seen in all.
lines.transliteration: ayk jot ayko man vasi-aa sabh  barahm d arisat ik keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਕਰਮ  ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ  ਿਨਤ  ਸਾਖਾ  ਹਰੀ ਜੜੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord, the Supreme Soul, is spread out everywhere; all place their headsbeneath His Feet. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aatam raam sabh  aykai hai pasray sabh  charan t alay sir d eejai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮੁ  ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਆ ਬਹਕਾਰ  ਬਾਸੁ ਜਿਗ  ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, people look like criminals with their noses cut off; bit by bit, their noses are cut off.
lines.transliteration: naam binaa naktay nar daykh hu tin ghas gh as naak vadh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਜੋਿਤ  ਏਕੋ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਭ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਇਕੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynics are called egotistical; without the Name, their lives are cursed.||7||
lines.transliteration: saakat nar ahaNkaaree kahee-ahi bin naavai Dh arig jeeveejai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਪਸਰੇ  ਸਭ ਚਰਨ  ਤਲੇ ਿਸਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: As long as the breath breathes through the mind deep within, hurry and seek God'sSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: jab lag saas saas man antar t at baygal saran pareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਕਟੇ  ਨਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਿਤਨ ਘਿਸ  ਘਿਸ ਨਾਕ  ਵਢੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Please shower Your Kind Mercy and take pity upon Nanak, that he may wash the feetof the Holy. ||8||4|| kilAwn mhlw 4 ] (1325-16) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa kirpaa kar Dhaarahu mai saaDh oo charan pakh eejai. ||8||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਨਰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜੀਵੀਜੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Lord, I wash the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: raamaa mai saaDhoo charan Dh uveejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਤਤੁ ਬੇਗਲ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: May my sins be burnt away in an instant; O my Lord and Master, please bless me withYour Mercy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kilbikh d ahan hohi kh in ant ar mayray th aakur kirpaa keejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ ਕਿਰ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ  ਪਖੀਜੈ  ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.english: The meek and humble beggars stand begging at Your Door. Please be generous andgive to those who are yearning.
lines.transliteration: mangat jan d een kh aray d ar thaadhay at tarsan ka-o d aan d eejai.

lines.english: Save me, save me, O God - I have come to Your Sanctuary. Please implant the Guru's Teachings, and the Naam within me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: taraahi t araahi saran parabh  aa-ay mo ka-o gurmat  naam d arirheejai. ||1||

lines.english: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the body-village; I rise up to fight thebattle against them.
lines.transliteration: kaam karoDh nagar meh sablaa nit  uth uth joojh  kareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਦਹਨ  ਹੋਿਹ ਿਖਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please make me Your Own and save me; through the Perfect Guru, I drive them out.||2||
lines.transliteration: angeekaar karahu rakh layvhu gur pooraa kaadh  kadh eejai. ||2||

lines.english: The powerful fire of corruption is raging violently within; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the ice water which cools and soothes. pMnw 1326
lines.transliteration: antar agan sabal at  bikhi-aa hiv seet al sabad  gur d eejai.

lines.english: My mind and body are calm and tranquil; the disease has been cured, and now I sleep in peace. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tan man saaNt ho-ay aDh ikaa-ee rog kaatai sookh  saveejai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਨ ਸਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ਰੋਗੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੂਿਖ ਸਵੀਜੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As the rays of the sun spread out everywhere, the Lord pervades each and everyheart.
lines.transliteration: ji-o sooraj kiran ravi-aa sarab th aa-ee sabh  ghat ghat raam raveejai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਸੂਰਜੁ  ਿਕਰਿਣ  ਰਿਵਆ  ਸਰਬ  ਠਾਈ  ਸਭ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Holy Saint, one drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord; sitting in thehome of your own inner being, drink in the essence. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo saaDh  milay ras paavai t at nij gh ar baith i-aa peejai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਿਮਲੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਬੈਿਠਆ  ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
lines.english: The humble being is in love with the Guru, like the chakvi bird which loves to see the sun.
lines.transliteration: jan ka-o pareet lagee gur sayt ee ji-o chakvee d aykh sooreejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗੀ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਜਉ ਚਕਵੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਸੂਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: She watches, and keeps on watching all through the night; and when the sun showsits face, she drinks in the Amrit. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nirkhat  nirkh at rain sabh  nirkh ee mukh  kaadh ai amrit  peejai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਖਤ  ਿਨਰਖਤ  ਰੈਿਨ ਸਭ ਿਨਰਖੀ  ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਢੈ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic is said to be very greedy - he is a dog. He is overflowing with thefilth and pollution of evil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: saakat su-aan kahee-ahi baho lobh ee baho d urmat  mail bh areejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੁਆਨ  ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: He talks excessively about his own inte rests. How can he be trusted? ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapan su-aa-ay karahi baho baataa t inaa kaa visaahu ki-aa keejai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨ  ਸੁਆਇ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਕਾ ਿਵਸਾਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo saaDh  saran mil sangat  jit har ras kaadh  kadh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਿਨ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਕਾਿਢ  ਕਢੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: They do good deeds for others, and speak of the Lord's many Glorious Virtues; pleasebless me to meet these Saints, these devotees of the Lord. ||7||
lines.transliteration: par-upkaar boleh baho gunee-aa mukh  sant bhagat har d eejai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ  ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣੀਆ  ਮੁਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਦੀਜੈ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: You are the Inaccessible Lord, Kind and Compassionate, the Great Giver; pleaseshower us with Your Mercy, and save us.
lines.transliteration: too agam d a-i-aal d a-i-aa pat  daataa sabh  da-i-aa Dh aar rakh  leejai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਦਇਆ  ਪਿਤ ਦਾਤਾ  ਸਭ ਦਇਆ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਰਿਖ ਲੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Life of all the beings of the world; please cherish and sustain Nanak.||8||5|| kilAwnu mhlw 4 ] (1326-8) kali-aan mehlaa 4. Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sarab jee-a jagjeevan ayko naanak partipaal kareejai. ||8||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਅ  ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲ  ਕਰੀਜੈ  ॥੮॥੫॥
lines.english: O Lord, please make me the slave of Your slaves.
lines.transliteration: raamaa ham daasan d aas kareejai.

lines.english: As long as there is breath deep within my mind, let me drink in the dust of the Holy.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jab lag saas ho-ay man antar saaDh oo Dh oor piveejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Shiva, Naarad, the thousand-headed cobra king and the silent sages long for the dustof the Holy.
lines.transliteration: sankar naarad saykh naag mun Dh oor saaDh oo kee locheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਿਗ  ਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਿਰ ਿਪਵੀਜੈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: All the worlds and realms where the Holy place their feet are sanctified. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhavan bh avan pavit  hohi sabh  jah saaDh oo charan Dh areejai. ||1||

lines.english: So let go of your shame and renounce all your egotism; join with the Saadh Sangat,the Company of the Holy, and remain there.
lines.transliteration: taj laaj ahaNkaar sabh  tajee-ai mil saaDh oo sang raheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਕਰੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ  ਸੇਖਨਾਗ  ਮੁਿਨ ਧੂਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਲੋਚੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Dharam raa-ay kee kaan chukh aavai bikh  dubd aa kaadh  kadh eejai. ||2|| Give up your fear of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and you shall be lifted up andsaved from drowning in the sea of poison. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਨ  ਭਵਨ  ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਹੋਿਹ ਸਿਭ ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ  ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Some are standing, parched and shrivelled up by their doubts; joining the SaadhSangat, they are rejuvenated.
lines.transliteration: bharam sookay baho ubh  suk kahee-ahi mil saaDh oo sang hareejai.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ  ਲਾਜ  ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਜੀਐ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: So do not delay, even for an instant - go and fall at the feet of the Holy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taa tay bilam pal dh il na keejai jaa-ay saaDh oo charan lageejai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੀ ਕਾਿਨ  ਚੁਕਾਵੈ  ਿਬਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਿਢ  ਕਢੀਜੈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Kirtan of the Praise of the Lord's Name is a priceless jewel. The Lord has given it for the Holy to keep.
lines.transliteration: raam naam keertan rat an vath har saaDh oo paas rakh eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਿਮ  ਸੂਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਉਿਭ ਸੁਕ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਿਗ  ਹਰੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever accepts and follows the Word of the Guru's Teachings as True - this Jewel istaken out and given to him. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jo bachan gur sat sat  kar maanai t is aagai kaadh  Dhareejai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਿਬਲਮੁ ਪਲੁ ਿਢਲ  ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾਇ  ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਿਨ  ਲਗੀਜੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Listen, O Saints; listen, humble Siblings of Destiny: the Guru raises His Arms andsends out the call.
lines.transliteration: santahu sunhu sunhu jan bh aa-ee gur kaadh ee baah kukeejai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨ  ਰਤਨ  ਵਥੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਿਸ ਰਖੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: If you long for everlasting peace and comfort for your soul, then enter the Sanctuaryof the True Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jay aatam ka-o sukh  sukh  nit lorhahu taaN satgur saran paveejai. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਨੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕਾਿਢ  ਧਰੀਜੈ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: If you have great good fortune and are very noble, then implant the Guru's Teachingsand the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within.
lines.transliteration: jay vad bhaag ho-ay at  neekaa t aaN gurmat  naam d arirheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ  ਗੁ ਿਰ ਕਾਢੀ  ਬਾਹ ਕੁਕੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is totally treacherous; drinking in the Sublime Essenceof the Lord, you shall easily, intuitively cross over the world-ocean. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sabh maa-i-aa moh bikh am jag t aree-ai sehjay har ras peejai. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਆਤਮ  ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਿਨਤ  ਲੋੜਹੁ ਤ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਵੀਜੈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who are totally in love with Maya, Maya, shall rot away in Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa maa-i-aa kay jo aDhikaa-ee vich maa-i-aa pachai pacheejai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਿਤ  ਨੀਕਾ  ਤ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: The path of ignorance and darkness is utterly treacherous; they are loaded down withthe crushing load of egotism. ||7||
lines.transliteration: agi-aan anDhayr mahaa panth bikh -rhaa ahaNkaar bh aar lad  leejai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਿਬਖਮੁ  ਜਗੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Nanak, chanting the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, one is emancipated.
lines.transliteration: naanak raam ram ram ram ram raamai tay gat  keejai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੇ ਜੋ ਅਿਧਕਾਈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਪਚੈ ਪਚੀਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting the True Guru, the Naam is implan ted within; we are united and blended with the Lord's Name. ||8||6|| Ckw 1 ] (1326-19) chhakaa 1. First Set of Six|| pMnw 1327 <> siqnwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1327-1) ik-oNkaar satnaam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu prBwqI ibBws mhlw 1 caupdy Gru 1 ] (1327-3) raag parbhaat ee bibh aas mehlaa 1 cha-upd ay gh ar 1. Raag Parbhaatee Bibhaas, First Mehl, Chau-Padas, First House:
lines.transliteration: satgur milai t aa naam drirh -aa-ay raam naamai ralai mileejai. ||8||6||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Your Name carries us across; Your Name brings respect and worship.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay tayrai t arnaa naa-ay pat  pooj.

lines.english: Your Name embellishes us; it is the object of the awakened mind.
lines.transliteration: naa-o tayraa gahn aa mat  maksood .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਤੇਰੈ ਤਰਣਾ  ਨਾਇ  ਪਿਤ ਪੂਜ ॥
lines.english: Your Name brings honor to everyone's name.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay tayrai naa-o mannay sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: Without Your Name, no one is ever respected. ||1||
lines.transliteration: vin naavai pat  kabahu na ho-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਉ  ਮੰਨੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: All other clever tricks are just for show.
lines.transliteration: avar si-aanap saglee paaj.

lines.english: Whoever the Lord blesses with forgiveness - his affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jai bakhsay t ai pooraa kaaj. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Your Name is my strength; Your Name is my support.
lines.transliteration: naa-o tayraa t aan naa-o d eebaan .

lines.english: Your Name is my army; Your Name is my king.
lines.transliteration: naa-o tayraa laskar naa-o sult aan.

lines.english: Your Name brings honor, glory and approval.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay tayrai maan  mahat  parvaan .

lines.english: By Your Grace, one is blessed with the banner and the insignia of Your Mercy. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tayree nad ree karam pavai neesaan . ||2||

lines.english: Your Name brings intuitive peace and poise; Your Name brings praise.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay tayrai sahj naa-ay saalaah.

lines.english: Your Name is the Ambrosial Nectar which cleans out the poison.
lines.transliteration: naa-o tayraa amrit  bikh uth jaa-ay.

lines.english: Through Your Name, all peace and comfort comes to abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: naa-ay tayrai sabh  sukh  vaseh man aa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Name, they are bound and gagged, and dragged off to the City of Death. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai baaDhee jam pur jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: Man is involved with his wife, hearth and home, land and country,
lines.transliteration: naaree bayree ghar d ar days.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਇ  ਤੇਰੈ ਸਿਭ ਸੁਖ ਵਸਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee-aa khusee-aa keecheh vays. the pleasures of the mind and fine clothes;
jaaN saday t aaN dhil na paa-ay. but when the call comes, he cannot delay.

lines.english: O Nanak, in the end, the false turn out to be false. ||4||1|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1327-10) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak koorh koorh o ho-ay jaa-ay. ||4||1||

lines.english: Your Name is the Jewel, and Your Grace is the Light. In awareness, there is YourLight.
lines.transliteration: tayraa naam rat an karam chaanan  surat  tithai lo-ay.

lines.english: Darkness fills the dark, and then everything is lost. ||1||
lines.transliteration: anDhayr anDh ee vaaprai sagal leejai kh o-ay. ||1||

lines.english: This whole world is corrupt.
lines.transliteration: ih sansaar sagal bikaar.

lines.english: Your Name is the only cure; nothing else works, O Infinite Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayraa naam d aaroo avar naasat  karanhaar apaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ  ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਿਤਥੈ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One side of the scale holds tens of thousands, millions of nether regions and realms.
lines.transliteration: paataal puree-aa ayk bh aar hoveh laakh  karorh .

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਅੰਧੀ  ਵਾਪਰੈ  ਸਗਲ  ਲੀਜੈ  ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O my Beloved, Your Worth could only be estimated if something else could be placed on the other side of the scale. ||2|| pMnw 1328
lines.transliteration: tayray laal keemat  taa pavai jaaN sirai hoveh hor. ||2||

lines.english: Out of pain, pleasure is produced, and out of pleasure comes pain.
lines.transliteration: dookh aa tay sukh  oopjahi sookh ee hoveh d ookh.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਿਹ  ਸੂਖੀ ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਦੂਖ ॥
lines.english: That mouth which praises You - what hunger could that mouth ever suffer? ||3||
lines.transliteration: jit mukh  too salaahee-ah t it mukh  kaisee bh ookh. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਮੁਿਖ ਤੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਅਿਹ ਿਤਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, you alone are foolish; all the rest of the world is good.
lines.transliteration: naanak moorakh ayk t oo avar bh alaa saisaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੈਸਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: That body in which the Naam does not well up - that body becomes miserable. ||4||2|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1328-3) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jit tan naam na oopjai say t an hohi kh u-aar. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ  ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਿਹ ਖੁਆਰ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: For His sake, Brahma uttered the Vedas, and Shiva renounced Maya.
lines.transliteration: jai kaaran bayd  barahmai uchray sankar chh odee maa-i-aa.

lines.english: For His sake, the Siddhas became hermits and renunciates; even the gods have not realized His Mystery. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jai kaaran siDh  bha-ay ud aasee d ayvee maram na paa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਬੇਦ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੈ  ਉਚਰੇ  ਸੰਕਿਰ  ਛੋਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, keep the True Lord in your mind, and utter the Name of the True Lord withyour mouth; the True Lord will carry you across.
lines.transliteration: baabaa man saachaa mukh saachaa kahee-ai t aree-ai saachaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਿਣ ਿਸਧ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਦੇਵੀ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Enemies and pain shall not even approach you; only a rare few realize the Wisdom ofthe Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: dusman d ookh na aavai nayrh ai har mat  paavai ko-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬਾ  ਮਿਨ ਸਾਚਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਸਾਚਾ  ਕਹੀਐ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Fire, water and air make up the world; these three are the slaves of the Naam, theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: agan bimb pavnai kee ban ee teen naam kay d aasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਨੇੜੈ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who does not chant the Naam is a thief, dwelling in the fortress of the fivethieves. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tay taskar jo naam na layveh vaaseh kot panchaasaa. ||2||

lines.english: If someone does a good deed for someone else, he totally puffs himself up in hisconscious mind.
lines.transliteration: jay ko ayk karai changi-aa-ee man chit bahut  bafaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਿਬੰਬ ਪਵਣੈ  ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਤੀਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord bestows so many virtues and so much goodness; He does not ever regret it.||3||
lines.transliteration: aytay gun  aytee-aa chang-aa-ee-aa d ay-ay na pachh otaavai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਤਸਕਰ  ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵਿਹ  ਵਾਸਿਹ  ਕੋਟ ਪੰਚਾਸਾ  ॥੨॥
